d3d483a5de67fecab5b4.source: Your Renown will increase, which means higher pay for contracts and potentially unlocking new types of contracts.
d3d483a5de67fecab5b4.translation: 提升战团声望，从而获得更高的委托报酬，并有可能解锁新的委托类型。

0ac027f22aeccc3a2e29.source:
We need allies. Forging a bond of friendship and trust with one of the towns will
get the company better prices, more volunteers and more steady work.
0ac027f22aeccc3a2e29.translation:
我们需要盟友。与一座城镇建立友谊和信任，
就能获得更好的价钱、更多愿意入伙的人，以及稳定的工作。

422fe9cc4b85c9385d31.source: Get to 'Friendly' relations with a civilian faction
422fe9cc4b85c9385d31.translation: 与一个平民势力达到“友好”关系

dc0af20661029bd2bd03.source: Having good relations will get you better prices and more men to hire.
dc0af20661029bd2bd03.translation: 良好的关系能让你获得更优惠的价格，也能找到更多可雇用的人手。

be019f012ddbf3991818.source: Increase the relation with a civilian faction of one of the world's villages or towns to 'Friendly' by fulfilling contracts given in the faction's settlement. Failing contracts or betraying their trust will lower your relations. Increasing relations with city states takes longer than increasing relations with small villages. Noble houses do not count as civilian factions.
be019f012ddbf3991818.translation: 完成某座村庄或城镇发布的委托，将与当地平民势力的关系提升至“友好”。委托失败或背弃信任会降低关系。城邦比小村庄更难建立友谊，所需时间更长。贵族家族不算平民势力。

a0ddf33740d7a50f5053.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]Deciding that %friendlytown% is a good place to invest your efforts, you decide to offer the protection of the company and take up any work suitable to your talents. You act like a gentleman in your dealings with the locals, and encourage the men to mind their manners while in the settlement. There was of course some griping at first. %brawler% was sorely disappointed to give up brawling with the farmers, especially with the %companyname% spending so much time in %friendlytown%.

But you convinced the men that having a friendly base of operations is important in your line of work, as it meant getting better prices on the market and more people willing to join your motley band. It's also much less tiring not having to dodge the militia all the time. You even enlisted the men to do some small tasks in exchange for nothing but goodwill.%SPEECH_ON%I found that little brat who wandered off and dragged him right home.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% brags, quickly outvied by %randombrother2%.%SPEECH_ON%I went to the market for the old spinster, split her firewood for winter, and even put out her washing, but I draw the line at rescuing treed cats.%SPEECH_OFF%
a0ddf33740d7a50f5053.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]你认为%friendlytown%值得用心经营，于是决定由战团提供保护，接下力所能及的工作。与当地人打交道时，你举止有礼，也叮嘱弟兄们进城后收敛些。起初自然免不了抱怨，%brawler%尤其失望，毕竟%companyname%在%friendlytown%待得这么久，他却不能再找农夫打架。

不过，你还是说服了众人：干这一行，有个友好的落脚点十分重要，市场上能买得便宜些，也有更多人愿意加入你们这支杂牌队伍。何况不用整天躲着民兵，活得也轻松得多。你甚至让弟兄们免费帮些小忙，只求结个善缘。%SPEECH_ON%我找到了那个乱跑的小崽子，直接把他拖回家了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%正得意地吹嘘，转眼就被%randombrother2%比了下去。%SPEECH_ON%我替那个老姑娘去集市买东西，劈好了过冬的柴，还帮她晾了衣服。不过，爬树救猫这种事，我可不干。%SPEECH_OFF%

eb2e884dcc7947e49852.source:
We shall earn the trust of a noble house and become their ally. Surely they will
share the fruits of their well-stocked armories with good friends.
eb2e884dcc7947e49852.translation:
我们要赢得一个贵族家族的信任，与之结盟。
对待好朋友，他们总该舍得拿出军械库中的好东西。

e704cd8e64c45fbf877b.source: You'll be awarded equipment unique to the noble house with which you ally
e704cd8e64c45fbf877b.translation: 获得结盟贵族家族的专属装备

55195008ffde757cf2e3.source: Get to 'Allied' relations with a noble house
55195008ffde757cf2e3.translation: 与一个贵族家族达到“结盟”关系

6c73909ac4d968db3c7e.source: Increase the relation with any noble house to 'Allied' by fulfilling contracts given by members of the faction. Failing contracts or betraying their trust will lower your relations.
6c73909ac4d968db3c7e.translation: 完成任意贵族家族成员发布的委托，将与该家族的关系提升至“结盟”。委托失败或背弃信任会降低关系。

f72d3c47e60a0c836311.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]You had long heard, and through experience learned it to be true, that noblemen are a difficult, fickle lot, but your relationship with %noblehouse% proves profitable and in the end even pleasant. They may not see you as equals when everyone is seated at a feast, but neither are they your equals on the battlefield. Having earned their trust through hard work and commitment, the %companyname% has finally been acknowledged as a trusted ally of %noblehouse%.

One benefit of this station is that your men are allowed a worthwhile browse through the noble's armory. A few bitter partisans may call you lapdogs for allying yourselves with the nobility, and presenting their banners on your shields, but never to your face.
f72d3c47e60a0c836311.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]你早就听说贵族难伺候、又善变，亲身经历也证明了这一点。不过，你与%noblehouse%的来往颇有收益，到后来甚至相处得还算愉快。宴席上，他们也许不把你视作同等身份的人；可到了战场，他们同样不配与你平起平坐。凭着苦干和守信，%companyname%终于赢得认可，成为%noblehouse%值得信赖的盟友。

有了这层关系，弟兄们便获准去贵族的军械库挑些好东西。或许有几个心怀怨怼的反对者，会因为你们与贵族结盟、在盾上绘出其纹章，而骂你们是走狗。不过，他们绝不敢当着你的面说。

e9b520113cabf508b2b8.source:
We shall outfit a contingent of at least three men with heavy armor
to act as a bulwark against dangerous opponents.
e9b520113cabf508b2b8.translation:
我们要让至少三名弟兄披上重甲，
筑起抵挡强敌的坚实防线。

d2cd15b2fcea18c72e4a.source: Have 3 pieces of armor and helmets with 230+ durability
d2cd15b2fcea18c72e4a.translation: 护甲与头盔各3件，耐久均为230+

a81c1193d326cc28a7e1.source: Have 3 pieces of body armor, and 3 helmets, each with 230 durability or more. Whether you buy them or loot them off of the battlefield, they will protect your men equally well.
a81c1193d326cc28a7e1.translation: 拥有3件身体护甲和3顶头盔，每件耐久都不低于230。无论是买来的，还是从战场上缴获的，都能同样好地保护弟兄们。

d5d7c096b510f71bb668.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]Spirits rise with the acquisition of more heavy armor and helmets for the %companyname%.%SPEECH_ON%Feel that? That is craftsmanship.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says, rapping a hardwood pommel against his fellow brother's newly armored head.%SPEECH_ON%Think of all the well-paid contracts we missed out on because of our crummy armor and pathetic equipment before.%SPEECH_OFF%From now on, the backline can breathe easier going into battle, knowing that their heavily armored brothers will be there to take the brunt of the assault. Should they fall, their unwieldy bulk will at least delay the enemy, giving their lightly armored companions a chance to swiftly retreat.
d5d7c096b510f71bb668.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]%companyname%添置了更多重甲与头盔，弟兄们都振奋起来。%SPEECH_ON%听见没有？这才叫好手艺。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%拿硬木柄头敲了敲同伴新戴的头盔。%SPEECH_ON%想想从前，就因为护甲破烂、装备寒酸，多少好价钱的委托跟咱们擦肩而过！%SPEECH_OFF%从今往后，后排的弟兄上阵时可以安心些了：前头有重甲同伴替他们扛住猛攻。就算这些同伴倒下，笨重的身躯至少也能挡敌人一阵，让轻装的伙伴赶紧逃命。

cfeb6ccc6d2fa7ad9bd4.source: This will serve us well in the battles to come.
cfeb6ccc6d2fa7ad9bd4.translation: 今后的战斗中，这些装备会派上大用场。

2acada777277b3a8bb6b.source:
We need a battle standard so that we're recognized from afar!
Having one be made is costly, so we shall gather 2,000 crowns for this.
2acada777277b3a8bb6b.translation:
我们需要一面战旗，让人远远就能认出我们！
定制战旗花费不菲，先为此攒够2,000克朗。

79cfed5ac4bfe2aba3bf.source: You'll be awarded a unique item that grants anyone near the wearer additional resolve.
79cfed5ac4bfe2aba3bf.translation: 获得一件独特物品，可提高持有者附近所有同伴的意志。

f0085ea073dc4f75ca5a.source: Gather the amount of 2,000 crowns or more, so that you can afford to have a battle standard made for the company. You can make money by completing contracts, looting camps and ruins, or trading. You'll also need space enough in your inventory for a new item.
f0085ea073dc4f75ca5a.translation: 积攒至少2,000克朗，为战团定制战旗。完成委托、搜掠营地与遗迹，或经商都能赚钱。仓库中还需留出放置新物品的空间。

2e45bd074f82c05705cb.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]No one likes a skinflint, least of all a group of wandering, bloodthirsty rabble motivated primarily by a love of coin. Not everyone, or more precisely, no one, was thrilled when you suggested cutting back on spending to save up for a company standard.

Once the %companyname%'s standard is finally paid for and hoisted for the first time to proudly snap in a fresh dawn breeze, however, no one claims it wasn't worth it. The men are proud of their new standard, even tossing around names for it around the campfire, though none of them really stick.

It's clear for everyone to see now, this is not some band of hired thugs, this is becoming a true mercenary company. Who should have the honor of carrying the standard?
2e45bd074f82c05705cb.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]没人喜欢吝啬鬼，尤其是一群四处漂泊、嗜血好斗、一心只认钱的家伙。你提议节省开支，为战团攒钱做面旗帜时，并非人人都高兴——准确地说，是没有一个人高兴。

不过，等到%companyname%的战旗终于付清款项，首次高高升起，在清晨的微风里猎猎作响时，再没人说这钱花得不值。弟兄们为新战旗自豪，甚至围着篝火争相替它取名，只是没有哪个名字最后叫开了。

如今，谁都看得出来：你们已不仅是一伙受雇打架的暴徒，而是渐渐成了一支真正的佣兵战团。这面战旗，又该由谁有幸执掌呢？

a590761056472b417361.source: Men, those are our colors now!
a590761056472b417361.translation: 弟兄们，从今往后，这就是我们的旗帜！

1fa2247821abfec32eb9.source:
We can barely carry any more equipment or spoils of war.
Let us save up 7,500 crowns to buy us a cart and relieve our backs!
1fa2247821abfec32eb9.translation:
我们的背包已经快装不下更多装备和战利品了。
攒够7,500克朗买辆货车，让大伙儿的肩背轻松些！

645d1e7a2a948eb9e218.source: You'll unlock an additional 27 slots in your inventory.

b0f220429431673bbe26.source: Gather the amount of 7,500 crowns or more, so that you can afford to buy a cart for additional inventory space. You can make money by completing contracts, looting camps and ruins, or trading.
b0f220429431673bbe26.translation: 积攒至少7,500克朗，购买货车以增加仓库容量。完成委托、搜掠营地与遗迹，或经商都能赚钱。

72f4540aa514c86ce3f7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_158.png[/img]Gathering enough crowns to pay the cartmaker for his work did cost you an arm and a leg, quite literally in some cases. Now the proud owner of a new wagon, you're able to carry both more equipment and more spoils of war, be it silverware and golden crowns, or the half-torn and lice filled gambeson of a random thug.

After traveling the first miles with the new wheels you notice that %randombrother% seems to be missing. Looking around, you eventually find him hidden behind some grain bags on the wagon, snoring away peacefully. Some cold water to the head and a boot to the butt quickly get the sluggard back on his feet and walking like the others. Still, you better make sure the men know their place.%SPEECH_ON%I won't have any of this! The only way anyone of the %companyname% will ever find himself on this wagon is carrying his own head under the arm! Be ever watchful and have your arms at the ready when we travel these lands!%SPEECH_OFF%The men grumble and continue on.
72f4540aa514c86ce3f7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_158.png[/img]为了凑够付给车匠的钱，你们付出了惨重代价——有些弟兄还真丢了胳膊或腿。如今终于有了新货车，你们能带上更多装备和战利品，无论是银器、金币，还是从哪个恶棍身上扒下来的、破了半边又满是虱子的软甲。

新车上路没走几英里，你就发现%randombrother%不见了。找了一圈，才瞧见他躲在车上的粮袋后头，睡得正香。冷水当头一浇，屁股上再挨一脚，这懒鬼很快便乖乖下地，跟别人一样步行。不过，还是得让弟兄们明白规矩。%SPEECH_ON%我可不许这种事！%companyname%的人想躺上这辆车，除非已经脑袋搬了家，得夹在胳膊底下带着！行路时都给我警醒些，随时准备动刀！%SPEECH_OFF%众人嘟囔几句，继续前进。

32414d423d693aaff885.source:
We need to establish ourselves as mercenaries that can be relied on.
Let us be tested over and over to prove it without doubt!
32414d423d693aaff885.translation:
我们必须树立可靠佣兵的名声。
让我们一次次接受考验，证明自己的信誉！

40fdb4ebce273c2e0e96.source: Complete 8 more contracts of any kind to prove yourselves reliable beyond doubt.
40fdb4ebce273c2e0e96.translation: 再完成8份任意类型的委托，让所有人都确信你们值得信赖。

3c48c2f3eac6dc9d0578.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]When starting out, the world saw you for what you were: ambition armed with a weapon. Everyone has a dream, and about half those men have weapons on them. You were not unique, not outstanding, not even particularly dangerous if you're giving your old self a good look in the eye. But you made it. The doors shut in your face. The attempts at haggling that lost you good deals. The spitting. So much spitting. It's a cold world and you dared to warm your own damn self. And you succeeded.

 Contracts under your belt, contracts on the horizon, they're blurring together. A culture of victory has started to wash over the %companyname% and you've good reason to be proud of your command of it.
3c48c2f3eac6dc9d0578.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]刚起步时，世人一眼就看穿了你：不过是拿着武器的野心。谁都有梦想，而这些人里，大约一半还都带着兵器。你既不独特，也不出众；若肯正眼瞧瞧当年的自己，就会承认，甚至谈不上多危险。可你终究走到了今天。迎面关上的门，讨价还价谈崩的好买卖，还有那些啐向你的唾沫，一口接一口。世道冷酷，你却偏要为自己挣一分暖意。而你做到了。

一份份委托已经完成，更多委托近在眼前，接连不断，渐渐分不清彼此。胜利已成为%companyname%的习惯，而能统领这样的战团，你有充分的理由自豪。

cb8824cde6881e0277cd.source: We're making a name for ourselves.

ddba5dd9a0251520e42f.source:
Wild beasts beset villages on the fringes of civilization.
Hunting them down for a profit is what we shall be doing!
ddba5dd9a0251520e42f.translation:
野兽侵扰着文明边缘的村庄。
我们就去猎杀这些畜生，顺便挣上一笔！

cc187e9c69c2fef7eee1.source: Defeat 5 packs of roving beasts in battle, such as Direwolves or Nachzehrers, whether as part of a contract or by seeking them out on your own.
cc187e9c69c2fef7eee1.translation: 击败5群游荡的野兽，例如恐狼或食尸鬼。执行委托时消灭的，或自行追猎的，都算在内。

f20b3f64ae6a435be8bb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_56.png[/img]Having dispatched yet another band of beasts, you find yourself pondering the nature of your ancestors. Here you are, organized, armed and armored, world-traveled, experienced in matters of war and combat, and yet the monsters of this world still serve to be as dangerous as ever. Your ancestors, what did they have? No civilization to blanket themselves under, no cities to light the night and warm the courage, no maps to give a comforting border to the world. And yet... they survived. What was it? How? Perhaps, in those days, it was man who was the threat, and the beasts saw him the monster. Or perhaps there are times before the ancients, times of when they had their own cities, and all the world simply shifts in balance, beast and man, since time immemorial. And if that is the case, then it is not the past you should dwell on, but the days and years and millennia to come...
f20b3f64ae6a435be8bb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_56.png[/img]又一群野兽被消灭后，你不禁想起远古的先民。如今，你们组织严密，披甲执兵，走过四方，熟悉战争与厮杀，可这世上的怪物仍旧危险得令人胆寒。祖先们又有什么？没有文明可供庇护，没有城市点亮长夜、壮起胆量，甚至没有地图，为这片世界勾出一道让人安心的边界。然而……他们活下来了。凭什么？又是怎么做到的？也许在那个时代，人类才是威胁，野兽眼中的怪物反而是人。又或许，在古人之前还有更古老的岁月，他们也曾拥有自己的城市；而自亘古以来，人兽之间的强弱便一直此消彼长。如果真是如此，你该忧虑的便不是过去，而是未来的日子、岁月，乃至千年之后……

a392664d6c9c54b1259c.source: Man and beast alike shall know our name.
a392664d6c9c54b1259c.translation: 无论人还是野兽，都将知晓我们的名号。

99b1412568f1f0be795d.source:
If we can win this war for one of the noble houses, our name will be unmatched.
Let us pick a side, bask in the glory of battle and get rich for it!
99b1412568f1f0be795d.translation:
若能帮助一个贵族家族赢下战争，我们的声名将无人能及。
选好阵营，赢取战场荣耀，再赚个盆满钵满！

ad27750bbb303b42d7bf.source: End the war between noble houses
ad27750bbb303b42d7bf.translation: 终结贵族家族之间的战争

57381b7eed590a9538fc.source: Pick one of the noble houses and work with them to crush their enemies. Every army destroyed, and every contract fulfilled, will bring you closer to ending the war.
57381b7eed590a9538fc.translation: 选择一个贵族家族，协助他们击败敌人。每消灭一支军队、完成一份委托，都会让战争更接近终结。

4c5d38c267a1e1fbe9d7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]At the behest of %winninghouse%, the %companyname% confronted the armored ranks of the other houses, a seemingly insurmountable challenge. It was a hard fought struggle, against opponents trained, disciplined, and well equipped, but in the end you overcame the enemies of %winninghouse% and triumphed on its behalf.

During the celebrations that follow, %randomnoble%, one of the lesser members of %winninghouse%, suggests that you end the festivities early. Your men are getting too rowdy, and he's concerned they may take advantage of his family's hospitality, walking off with the silver plate or fighting with the staff. He notes that there has already been a broken window and points towards some broken glass on the floor.

You reply that although %winninghouse% was victorious, it is also at this point much weaker and more vulnerable than ever. Now would be a foolish time to alienate friends... or to make new enemies.

He takes your advice to heart and the celebration continues until dawn.
4c5d38c267a1e1fbe9d7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]受%winninghouse%之托，%companyname%迎战其他家族的重甲军阵，这曾是个看似不可能完成的任务。对手训练有素、纪律严明、装备精良，战斗艰苦至极。不过最终，你们还是击败了%winninghouse%的敌人，为它赢得胜利。

随后的庆功宴上，%winninghouse%的一位旁支成员%randomnoble%劝你提早散席。你的弟兄们闹得太凶，他担心众人得寸进尺，顺走家中的银盘，或与仆役打架。他说已经有人砸碎了窗户，还指了指地上的碎玻璃。

你回答说，%winninghouse%虽是胜者，此时却也比以往更加虚弱，更易遭人趁虚而入。眼下疏远朋友……或是再树新敌，可不是什么明智之举。

他认真听进了这番劝告，于是宴会一直持续到天亮。

addcb23b65e86d7d2a38.source: Whether they love or hate us, everyone knows the %companyname% now!
addcb23b65e86d7d2a38.translation: 无论爱我们还是恨我们，如今谁都知道%companyname%的名号了！

d9144112f2070a281383.source:
Only the most daring take on goblins in larger numbers. We shall burn some
of their fetid camps to the ground, and word of it will travel!
d9144112f2070a281383.translation:
只有最胆大的人才敢挑战成群的地精。
烧平几座臭气熏天的营地，我们的事迹便会传遍四方！

4ecf93a75f4edca34f50.source: You'll be awarded a unique accessory that makes the wearer immune to being rooted.
4ecf93a75f4edca34f50.translation: 获得一件独特饰品，佩戴者可免受定身效果影响。

d9058aa448015f8624b8.source: Destroy four locations controlled by goblins to prove the company's prowess, whether as part of a contract or by heading out on your own. You'll also need space enough in your inventory for a new item.
d9058aa448015f8624b8.translation: 摧毁四处地精据点，证明战团的实力。执行委托或自行出击均可。仓库中还需留出放置新物品的空间。

6259c8d12b656581ce2b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_83.png[/img]The men are scattered across the battlefield, still breathing heavily after a hard fight. As you survey the ground, so do %randombrother% and %randombrother2% scour it for valuables.%SPEECH_ON%We advance, they retreat. We fall back, they harry us. Fire a volley of arrows and they take cover. A shieldwall is pricked through with poisoned blades, and at a charge they scatter like bugs. Those damned things they fling at you will fly through my dreams in nights to come.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother2% pokes a dead goblin with his weapon, and, satisfied that he is very much dead indeed, knees down to take a closer look at its belongings.%SPEECH_ON%But the more bitter the fight, the sweeter the victory.%SPEECH_OFF%He stands up and meets %randombrother%'s gaze.%SPEECH_ON%The more bitter the fight, the more alive I feel. Come on.%SPEECH_OFF%They slowly continue on to join up with the rest of the men, stopping here and there to look for things worth a crowns or two when next the company makes it away to a city.
6259c8d12b656581ce2b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_83.png[/img]弟兄们散在战场各处，苦战过后仍喘着粗气。你巡视四周，%randombrother%和%randombrother2%则在搜寻值钱的物件。%SPEECH_ON%我们进，他们退；我们退，他们追。放一轮箭，他们就找掩体；结起盾墙，毒刃又从缝里钻进来；一冲锋，他们便像虫子似的四散。我看接下来几晚，梦里都会是它们扔过来的那些鬼东西。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother2%用武器戳了戳一具地精尸体，确认死透后，才跪下来仔细翻看它的随身物品。%SPEECH_ON%不过，打得越苦，赢得才越痛快。%SPEECH_OFF%他站起身，与%randombrother%对视。%SPEECH_ON%打得越苦，我才越觉得自己还活着。走吧。%SPEECH_OFF%两人慢慢走去与众人会合，不时停下来翻找些东西，好在下次进城时换上一两枚克朗。

757044aa7f8824164d52.source:
The Greenskin Invasion is threatening to sweep away our world.
We shall stand strong and fend it off, for this is how legends are born!
757044aa7f8824164d52.translation:
绿皮的入侵正威胁着整个世界。
我们要挺身而出，挡住这股狂潮——传奇便是如此诞生的！

bb3f7a8c67e80aff825f.source: Defeat the Greenskin Invasion! Every contract against them, and every army or location destroyed, will bring you closer to saving the world of man.
bb3f7a8c67e80aff825f.translation: 击退绿皮入侵！每完成一份讨伐绿皮的委托、消灭一支绿皮军队或摧毁一处据点，都会让人类世界更接近获救。

1a6b1168126477645dbe.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]This was a task like none undertaken by the men of the company before, to fend off an entire invasion by some of the fiercest foes man has ever faced. A foe that could not be reasoned with, whose alien mind knows not mercy or compassion, but only war. Orcs and goblins had united in a savage green tide that threatened to wash away the race of man.

Under a pitiless sun at day and by the light of burning towns at night, the company campaigned against the green menace across the borderlands, rooting it out wherever it raised its ugly, scarred head. The men faced many a hard battle, and made many a sacrifice, but it was all worth it.

The %companyname% prevailed. After many a savage struggle, after uncounted days where each man's life seemed to hang on the roll of a die, the green tide finally seemed to ebb. As orcs and goblins scatter back into the wild, you know that the world of man is saved. For now.
1a6b1168126477645dbe.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]战团从未肩负过如此重任：抵挡一场全面入侵，而来犯者是人类有史以来面对过的最凶残之敌。它们不讲道理，不知怜悯，异类的脑袋里只有战争。兽人与地精合成了一股凶蛮的绿色狂潮，几乎要将人类整个抹去。

白日顶着无情的烈日，夜晚借着城镇燃烧的火光，战团在边境各处征战。无论这股绿色祸患从何处探出丑陋、满是伤疤的脑袋，你们都将它连根拔起。弟兄们经历了无数苦战，也付出了许多牺牲，但一切都值得。

%companyname%终究撑了下来。经历一场场惨烈厮杀，熬过无数仿佛掷枚骰子就能决定生死的日子，绿色狂潮终于开始退去。兽人与地精四散逃回荒野，你知道，人类的世界得救了。至少眼下如此。

485d5ee651510e7d8ff7.source: Bards will sing our names now. If there are any left.
485d5ee651510e7d8ff7.translation: 吟游诗人该传唱我们的名字了。要是还有活着的。

6cd0ff80d50d56b9e919.source:
The fires of religious turmoil threaten to engulf the lands. Let the company be forged
stronger than ever by its heat and flames, and earn a fortune by winning the war!
6cd0ff80d50d56b9e919.translation:
宗教纷争的烈火即将吞噬大地。让战团在烈焰中
淬炼得更加强大，再以战争的胜利换来一笔横财！

560246ecd74326a56530.source: End the war between north and south

8ff122e53f9a14dc36b1.source: Pick either the northern noble houses or the southern city states and work with them to win their holy war. Every army destroyed, and every contract fulfilled, will bring you closer to ending the war.
8ff122e53f9a14dc36b1.translation: 选择支持北方贵族家族或南方城邦，帮助他们赢得圣战。每消灭一支军队、完成一份委托，都会让战争更接近终结。

6b1005b2e421b1922e06.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]{The air you breathe, the ground beneath your feet, neither feel the least bit different. Yet around you there is the rejoice of the northern throngs as though every soul had been gifted their every wish. You've gotten news that the Southerners have relented and sent the doves, ending the holy war in the favor of the North. In turn, the North will have occupation of the holy sites and permit southern entrance so long as they submit that their 'Gilder' is but one of many in the pantheon of the old gods. A young girl comes to you with a flower.%SPEECH_ON%They speak of knights and heroes, but I seen you myself. You went that way, and good news came, and you went thataway, and more good news came. It was as if you were heaven sent, the right hand of the old gods themselves.%SPEECH_OFF%You thank the girl and she pirouettes and runs off. %randombrother% walks up to you with pursed lips.%SPEECH_ON%Heaven sent and the best they can do is give you a bloody flower?%SPEECH_OFF%}
6b1005b2e421b1922e06.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]{你呼吸的空气，脚下的大地，感觉都与往常没有半点不同。可周围的北方人却欢声雷动，仿佛每个人的愿望都已得到满足。消息传来，南方人终于让步，遣使求和，圣战以北方获胜告终。此后，北方将占据圣地；南方人若想入内，就得承认他们的“镀金者”只是众多旧神之一。一个小姑娘捧着花走到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%他们总在讲骑士和英雄，可我亲眼见过你。你往那边去，好消息就来了；你又往另一边去，又来了更多好消息。就像上天派你下来，替旧神亲自行事一样。%SPEECH_OFF%你向她道谢，她转了个圈，跑远了。%randombrother%抿着嘴走过来。%SPEECH_ON%上天派来的，结果他们就只舍得给你一朵破花？%SPEECH_OFF%}

55064e543dffd1a14642.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_171.png[/img]{You watch as crowds of the great Gilder's followers stream toward the holy sites, the whole land free from the shackles of religious war, and the holy war settled in the favor of the South. From what you have heard, the Viziers have enforced a rule that while Northerners may visit the holy lands, they must pay a tax to the governors overseeing those territories. It is a miserly result, though not a particularly violent and vengeful one.

 As you take stock of your inventory, a dozen old men come up the road and stop before you. They announce themselves as scribes and historians who are undertaking the great recollection of the holy war. Apparently someone had pointed you out to them, but they're not entirely sure who you are. You explain that the Viziers hired you to-%SPEECH_ON%Hired, you say? As in, you are a Crownling?%SPEECH_OFF%One of the old men cuts you off, his quill pen scratching to a sudden stop. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%No no no, we are looking to catalog the successes of those responsible for returning sacred lands to the Gilder's light. You are a shriveling, opportunistic, and no doubt conniving Crownling. Have a nice day.%SPEECH_OFF%They depart before you can retort, though you suspect if you were in the mood for a bit of back and forth you'd probably have given them a bit of steel to deal with. %randombrother% walks up and asks who they were. You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Just a bunch of nobodies.%SPEECH_OFF%}
55064e543dffd1a14642.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_171.png[/img]{你望着镀金者的信徒成群涌向圣地。宗教战争的桎梏已从大地上卸下，这场圣战以南方获胜告终。听说维齐尔们定下新规：北方人可以朝拜圣地，但必须向管辖当地的官员纳税。结果虽透着一股贪财劲儿，倒也不算血腥，更谈不上大肆报复。

你正在清点物资，十来个老者沿路走来，在你面前停下。他们自称书记与史家，正在编纂圣战的宏大史录。显然是有人向他们指认了你，可他们还不清楚你的身份。你解释说，维齐尔雇用你去——%SPEECH_ON%雇用？你是说，你是个克朗客？%SPEECH_OFF%一个老者打断你，羽毛笔的沙沙声戛然而止。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不不不，我们要记载的是那些让圣地重归镀金者光辉之下的功臣。你不过是个畏缩、投机，而且想必满腹算计的克朗客。祝你过得愉快。%SPEECH_OFF%没等你反驳，他们就走了。不过你也觉得，若真有兴致跟这帮人来回较量，自己多半会直接请他们尝尝钢刃。%randombrother%走过来，问那些人是谁。你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%一帮无名小卒。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f6a0c8c59ac3760d6112.source:
There are rumors about a colossal beast that lurks in the swamps.
If we find and slay it, eternal fame will be our reward!
f6a0c8c59ac3760d6112.translation:
传闻沼泽深处潜伏着一头庞然巨兽。
若能找到并杀死它，不朽的声名便属于我们！

b33519f6d965bc2e09c0.source: Defeat a Kraken in battle. You'll find it somewhere out there, in the wild.
b33519f6d965bc2e09c0.translation: 在战斗中杀死一只克拉肯。它就潜伏在荒野的某个地方。

fcdda898995f5e9aa8cc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_89.png[/img]In your dreams it dwells, a slick bulbous head wimpled with lily pads and combed kudzu and its breath lifts the mire like the gargle of a cauldron's broth. Its tentacles writhe in the penumbra like shadows upon shadows. So it is here in the far, far dark, a void into which it has carved a place and become an idle horror. When it appears in your dreams it is such that you have gone to it. You enter the blackness and step forward, hand out, but that's all you do. You never truly draw near. Sometimes your dreams will be of something else, but you know the beast is out there somewhere, you only need to open a door or walk down some steps and you will find it and its domain again. You need not talk to your men to know they dream of it too.

 The world has come to know your slaying of the kraken, but they see it in hearsay, they see it as something drawn by a mother's tongue to rush a child to bed, or a father emboldening his kin by speaking to man's triumph over terror. But they don't see it. They see the rumor, not the monster, and they treat the %companyname% as living legends. And like legends with each day the men of the company fade from the tales and are replaced by proper heroes, every corner of the earth fashioning a more valiant victor over the creature. A common sellsword would never brave such a beast they say! It was the knights of the east! The kingsguard of the north! Vanity has taken your place. But the brothers you battle with know the truth and even a dying truth is well enough to get on.

 So there in the dark it dwells, and there you visit it often.
fcdda898995f5e9aa8cc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_89.png[/img]它仍栖息在你的梦里。滑腻臃肿的脑袋上覆着睡莲，葛藤披散，呼吸掀动泥沼，如釜中浓汤翻滚。触手在幽暗中蠕动，恰似阴影叠着阴影。就在那极深极远的黑暗里，它凿出一片属于自己的虚无，化作静候的恐怖。每逢梦见它，仿佛都是你主动去寻。你踏入黑暗，伸手上前，却仅止于此，永远不曾真正靠近。有时梦里是别的景象，可你知道，那巨兽仍在某处。只要推开一扇门，或走下几级台阶，你就会重返它的领地。不必问弟兄们，你也知道，他们同样梦见了它。

世人已听说你们诛杀克拉肯的壮举，可对他们而言，那不过是传闻：母亲拿来催孩子上床的故事，或父亲讲给家人、借人类战胜恐怖而鼓舞胆气的传奇。他们没见过它。他们看见的是传闻，而非怪物，却把%companyname%奉为活着的传奇。可传奇总会变样，日子一久，战团的弟兄们渐渐从故事里淡去，被体面的英雄取代。天南海北的人，都要塑造一个更英勇的胜者。他们说，普通佣兵哪敢迎战这种怪兽！那是东方的骑士！那是北方的国王卫士！虚荣占据了你们的位置。不过，与你并肩作战的弟兄知道真相；即便真相终将消逝，也足以支撑你们走下去。

于是，它仍栖息在黑暗中，而你时常前去探望。

f3ea67e0ce788b3d4149.source: What other hunter can claim a feat such as this?
f3ea67e0ce788b3d4149.translation: 还有哪个猎人敢说自己立下过这般功绩？

e7f7567507262ea9b98d.source:
The best way to prove that we are the strongest company around
is to defeat another mercenary band in battle!
e7f7567507262ea9b98d.translation:
要证明我们是这里最强的战团，
最好的办法就是在战场上击败另一支佣兵队伍！

6a68f28c7ef212cf3ba9.source: Defeat another mercenary company that is roaming the lands. If you have no enemies that will hire another mercenary company, you can always press CTRL + Left Click to attack anyone - provided you are currently not employed.
6a68f28c7ef212cf3ba9.translation: 击败一支游走各地的佣兵战团。若没有敌人雇用其他战团对付你，只要当前未受雇执行委托，也可以按住CTRL并单击鼠标左键，主动攻击任意队伍。

0dbe2870350e8117a206.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]%randombrother% wipes sweat and blood off of his forehead.%SPEECH_ON%These bunch of cheats! I thought only I knew that trick!%SPEECH_OFF%Mercenaries are a motley bunch and inherently unpredictable, with a bizarre array of equipment, wildly varying skills and experience, and cunning tactics. With no standards for members, they may be nothing more than a bunch of elderly tradesmen, looking for adventure. But then again, you could be surprised by a group of veteran campaigners. Worse, they follow no rules of engagement. The %defeatedcompany% did their best, but though they knew many of the same clever stratagems as the brothers, they were no match for the %companyname%.

Your victory will surely show employers far and wide whose blades are the sharpest.
0dbe2870350e8117a206.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]%randombrother%抹去额头上的汗水与鲜血。%SPEECH_ON%这帮耍诈的混蛋！我还以为只有我会那一招！%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵向来鱼龙混杂、难以揣测，装备五花八门，本领和经验参差不齐，战术又刁钻。招人既无门槛，你遇见的可能只是一群上了年纪、想出来冒险的手艺人；也可能猝不及防，撞上一队身经百战的老兵。更麻烦的是，他们打起仗来毫无规矩可言。%defeatedcompany%已经尽了全力，也熟悉弟兄们惯用的许多诡计，可终究不是%companyname%的对手。

这一胜，必会让远近的雇主明白，谁的刀剑才最锋利。

b8f86755465f1ac8b1a8.source:
Besting orcs in battle and burning down some of their camps would make people
recognize the company's ability on the battlefield. Let us do so!
b8f86755465f1ac8b1a8.translation:
击败兽人，再烧掉它们几座营地，
世人便会认可战团的战力。就这么干！

b42864b881b544d8a787.source: You'll be awarded a unique accessory that makes the wearer immune to being stunned.
b42864b881b544d8a787.translation: 获得一件独特饰品，佩戴者可免疫眩晕。

b29ef9926706d40d7702.source: Destroy four locations controlled by orcs to prove the company's prowess, whether as part of a contract or by heading out on your own. You'll also need space enough in your inventory for a new item.
b29ef9926706d40d7702.translation: 摧毁四处兽人据点，证明战团的实力。执行委托或自行出击均可。仓库中还需留出放置新物品的空间。

c0453a631a062c6481ad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]With the %recently_destroyed% still smouldering in your wake, a group of people come out from their hiding place in a nearby copse of trees where they had been watching the battle from afar. An old woman approaches you.%SPEECH_ON%Those green-skinned fiends drove us from our farm outside %nearesttown%, but thanks to you stalwart fellows we will prosper again. This is for you.%SPEECH_OFF%She proffers a bag of apples. Though it isn't much of a reward, the sentiment will be repeated again and again as word spreads of the orcs' destruction. %highestexperience_brother% barks out a laugh and bites into one of the juicy apples.%SPEECH_ON%With orcs, the big ones are too slow, and the young ones too stupid. Strategy overcomes brute force every time. The great green beasts depend on fear to do their work for them. Stand fast and they can be beat like anyone else!%SPEECH_OFF%The peasants marvel at %highestexperience_brother%'s speech, and prowess, and strength, clapping their hands, showering him with compliments and patting him on the back. While certainly true words, this is hardly the audience that should put his advice to use. You lay your hand on %highestexperience_brother%'s shoulder, as if to say to drop it a notch, lest any of the peasants think themselves heroes next time they spot a greenskin.
c0453a631a062c6481ad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]%recently_destroyed%的余烬还在你们身后冒烟，一群人便从附近的小树林里走出来。他们一直藏在那里，远远望着这场战斗。一个老妇人来到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%那些绿皮恶鬼把我们赶出了%nearesttown%外的农场。多亏你们这些英勇的好汉，我们总算能重新过上好日子。这是给你们的。%SPEECH_OFF%她递上一袋苹果。礼物虽不丰厚，可随着兽人败亡的消息传开，这样的感激还会一次次出现。%highestexperience_brother%放声大笑，咬了一口多汁的苹果。%SPEECH_ON%兽人嘛，大个的太慢，小个的太蠢。打仗靠脑子，蛮力哪次赢得了谋略？那些绿皮大畜生就指望把人吓破胆。站稳了，它们跟别人一样能被打趴下！%SPEECH_OFF%农夫们惊叹于%highestexperience_brother%的豪言、武艺和力量，拍着手，夸个不停，还纷纷上前拍他的背。这话固然没错，可眼前这些人实在不该拿去照做。你将手搭在%highestexperience_brother%肩上，示意他收着点，免得哪个农夫下回见着绿皮，真把自己当成英雄。

cfd2873aa588b2a85ca3.source: Tell everyone it was the %companyname% who won here!
cfd2873aa588b2a85ca3.translation: 告诉所有人，是%companyname%赢下了这一仗！

88d3782669e28612ed38.source:
The Undead are rising all over the lands, killing and devouring at sight.
We need to put an end to this, or soon there will be no world as we know it left!
88d3782669e28612ed38.translation:
各地死者纷纷复起，见人便杀，遇活物便吞食。
必须终结这场灾祸，否则我们熟悉的世界很快就将不复存在！

86e568227cc8dfc83cc4.source: Defeat the Undead Scourge! Every contract against them, and every army or location destroyed, will bring you closer to saving the world of man.
86e568227cc8dfc83cc4.translation: 平息亡灵灾祸！每完成一份讨伐亡灵的委托、消灭一支亡灵军队或摧毁一处据点，都会让人类世界更接近获救。

aafb7340f606a23d6d15.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]Walking corpses shambling about in rags. The graveyards of every hamlet soon began to vomit them up, yet it was only the beginning. Ancient legions from an age long past awoke. Never tiring, never fearful, they marched on like a cold machine, ever forward. They conquered the known world once, and they may well have done so again, were it not for a tightly-knit band of mercenaries.%SPEECH_ON%Dead men marching, walking bones in foreign armor, things not from this world... I never thought I'd see such horrors. But we prevailed!%SPEECH_OFF%%bravest_brother% exclaims, holding high his weapon as if to signal a charge.%SPEECH_ON%The %companyname% prevailed even against this enemy! Who would stand against us now?%SPEECH_OFF%Who, indeed?
aafb7340f606a23d6d15.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]衣衫褴褛的行尸四处蹒跚，各个村庄的墓地很快便开始将它们不断吐出，可这还只是开端。远古时代的军团也苏醒了。它们永不疲倦，永无畏惧，像冰冷的机器一样向前，再向前。它们曾征服过已知的世界；倘若没有这支齐心协力的佣兵队伍，恐怕还会再来一遍。%SPEECH_ON%列队行进的死人，披着异邦护甲的白骨，还有根本不属于这个世界的东西……我从没想过会见到这种噩梦。可我们赢了！%SPEECH_OFF%%bravest_brother%高举武器，仿佛要发起冲锋。%SPEECH_ON%连这样的敌人，%companyname%都打赢了！往后还有谁敢挡在我们面前？%SPEECH_OFF%是啊，还有谁呢？

b180b9862487de1b34ac.source: The world of man is saved. For now.
b180b9862487de1b34ac.translation: 人类的世界得救了。至少眼下如此。

e10de5736483c194d2d0.source:
The walking dead are a terrible curse upon man.
Let us burn some of their lairs to the ground and earn the respect of all decent folk!
e10de5736483c194d2d0.translation:
行尸是降在人类头上的可怕诅咒。
烧平它们几处巢穴，让所有正派人都敬重我们！

19156264f40df8fb1810.source: You'll be awarded a unique accessory that doubles the wearer's resolve when defending against fear and mind control effects.
19156264f40df8fb1810.translation: 获得一件独特饰品，佩戴者抵抗恐惧与精神控制时，意志翻倍。

bbcc9318ca0adf3e2359.source: Destroy four locations beset by undead to prove the company's prowess, whether as part of a contract or by heading out on your own. You'll also need space enough in your inventory for a new item.
bbcc9318ca0adf3e2359.translation: 摧毁四处亡灵盘踞的据点，证明战团的实力。执行委托或自行出击均可。仓库中还需留出放置新物品的空间。

556f6a398fcc32ae1535.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]Thanks to the %companyname%, the shambling monstrosities of the %recently_destroyed% will never again threaten innocent folk. The men, however, will need a few days, and copious amounts of drink, to process the horrors they faced.%SPEECH_ON%How can anything so foul show itself by the light of day?%SPEECH_OFF%Asks %randombrother%, starring blandly into the distance.%SPEECH_ON%It collapsed straight into a heap of rotten bones and dust. Nothing at all holding it together but its curse.%SPEECH_OFF%Even darker fears are sparked for %fearful_brother%.%SPEECH_ON%They told me back in %randomtown% that any good man killed by one of them horrors is doomed to come back from the grave himself and can never sit by the gods.%SPEECH_OFF%Some men argue loudly against this, not because they know better, but because they don't want it to be true. You give the order to bank the fire before someone starts telling any more ghost stories. The men may have trouble sleeping this night, but morale will rise again with the dawn.
556f6a398fcc32ae1535.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]多亏%companyname%，%recently_destroyed%里那些蹒跚的怪物再也不能威胁无辜百姓了。不过，弟兄们恐怕还得缓上几天，再灌下不少酒，才能消化亲眼见到的恐怖。%SPEECH_ON%这么污秽的东西，怎么还敢在大白天出来？%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%呆呆望着远处，喃喃发问。%SPEECH_ON%一倒下就成了烂骨头和灰。除了诅咒，根本没别的东西撑着它。%SPEECH_OFF%%fearful_brother%则生出了更深的恐惧。%SPEECH_ON%以前在%randomtown%，有人告诉我，好人要是被那种怪物杀了，就注定得从坟里再爬出来，永远也不能坐到诸神身旁。%SPEECH_OFF%有些人高声反驳，并非知道得更多，只是不愿相信这是真的。趁众人还没讲出更多鬼故事，你下令压住篝火，准备休息。今晚或许难以入眠，但等到天亮，士气自会重新振作。

1889f0b293084409ac23.source: Be that as it may, we are victorious again!
1889f0b293084409ac23.translation: 不管怎么说，我们又赢了！

1411e7e5ab41e4b81f0b.source:
Places of legend dot the world, hiding wonderous secrets within.
Let's not rest until we've found every last one of them!
1411e7e5ab41e4b81f0b.translation:
传奇之地散落世间，藏着种种奇妙的秘密。
不找齐最后一处，我们绝不罢休！

6b05117e02084d5988ae.source: Discover all legendary locations in the world
6b05117e02084d5988ae.translation: 发现世界上所有传奇地点

fb71b248488f65259be8.source: Discover all legendary treasures that exist in the world by going off on your own and exploring the wilds. Make sure to stock up on provisions before heading out!
fb71b248488f65259be8.translation: 自行探索荒野，发现世间所有传奇宝藏的所在。出发前务必备足口粮！

310b4c197d02199fb5b7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]Your map's edges are frayed, and its creases so worn they may as well be fine felt against the fingers. The paper is heavier than it looks, and it's come to shield you from rain and snow, it's been there stuffed beneath the haystraw upon which you slept, and it's been threatened with use as a kindling in dire times. But it's also lighter than it looks, for the wind has stolen it straight from your fingers a time or many and you've chased it across fields all the while yelling like some jackal losing the chase and calling it a whoreson's work as it twisted and eluded.

Per the original cartographer's work, your company was not to leave the roads or stray from the towns. He'd written warnings such as 'doom and doom only' and 'here be bandits and their no good mothers.' You ignored the lot of these and drew over them with your own squiggly lines of explorative demarcations. These were not places of superstition, these were places the %companyname% would and did go. For etching lines upon a limp map you've become notorious as quasi explorers of places the world long since shut its doors on. And what else may be out there but perhaps a place far beyond this one?
310b4c197d02199fb5b7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]你的地图边缘早已磨毛，折痕反复揉搓，摸起来几乎像细毡。纸张比看上去沉重：它替你挡过雨雪，被塞在你睡觉的干草下面，危急时还险些成了引火物。可它又比看上去轻巧，风曾不止一次将它从你指间卷走，害你满田野追赶，像只扑空的豺狼般嚷嚷，眼见它翻滚躲闪，便骂一句狗娘养的。

照原先那位制图师的意思，你们最好永远别离开道路，也别远离城镇。他在图上标着“唯有死路”和“此地尽是山贼及其缺德老娘”之类的警告。你一概不理，径自在上面画下歪歪扭扭的线，标出自己探索过的疆界。那些地方并非只存在于迷信里，而是%companyname%打算前往、也确实踏足过的土地。在这张软塌塌的地图上添几笔，竟让你们成了小有名气的半路探险家，专去世人早已不愿问津之处。往外，还有什么？也许是远在这片世界之外的另一方天地。

73d1b310e03e3ab19cc9.translation: 我们的地图，由我们自己绘制。

38104232a3b38e33dd93.source:
Great explorers become men of legend. Going into the wild lands is a dangerous
business, but the tales we'll tell afterward will surely increase our renown.
38104232a3b38e33dd93.translation:
伟大的探险家终将成为传奇。深入荒野虽是险事，
可归来后的故事，必能为我们赢得声望。

efcaa18c82f5846f13be.source: Discover hidden locations by exploring the world
efcaa18c82f5846f13be.translation: 探索世界，发现隐藏地点

eef0743bd305145a8f11.source: Discover 8 hidden locations, like ruins or hostile camps, by going off on your own and exploring the world. Make sure to stock up on provisions before heading out!
eef0743bd305145a8f11.translation: 自行探索世界，发现8处隐藏地点，例如遗迹或敌方营地。出发前务必备足口粮！

5ae793d66108bf742bf5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]Seizing destiny by the beard, you declared your intention to travel across the land and make your mark as an explorer. Reasoning that uncovering new locations, be they dens of evil or prosperous villages, would lead to new opportunities for wealth, the men enthusiastically followed.

In the succeeding days, the company has looked upon many a broad vista, surveying high towers and treacherous canyons. You have dodged enemy scouts, and made fireless camps beneath stars like a thousand candle flames in the void. Charting the course of untamed rivers and skirting the hostile edges of uncrossable mountain ranges, the %companyname% can honestly claim themselves more widely traveled than many other band of their kind.
5ae793d66108bf742bf5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]你仿佛一把揪住命运的胡须，宣布要游历四方，以探险家的身份留下名声。弟兄们觉得，无论新发现的是邪恶巢穴还是富庶村庄，总能带来新的发财机会，于是兴致勃勃地跟了上来。

接下来的日子，战团看遍开阔壮景，勘察高塔与险谷。你们躲过敌方斥候，在繁星如万千烛火点缀虚空的夜里，扎下不点火的营地。测绘奔流河道，沿着无法翻越的险峻山脉绕行，%companyname%大可坦言：你们走过的地方，比许多同行都要多。

1c7a2197bbc9355855e1.source:
The wilds are teeming with hidden treasures that others are not bold enough to claim.
This is our chance, so let us head out there and find three legendary places!
1c7a2197bbc9355855e1.translation:
荒野藏着无数宝物，别人却没胆去取。
机会就在眼前，出发去找三处传奇之地！

051ca7a3cdc893de1aeb.source: Discover legendary locations by exploring the world
051ca7a3cdc893de1aeb.translation: 探索世界，发现传奇地点

bb0b6bf799c1ae92f81d.source: Discover 3 legendary locations by going off on your own and exploring the world. Make sure to stock up on provisions before heading out!
bb0b6bf799c1ae92f81d.translation: 自行探索世界，发现3处传奇地点。出发前务必备足口粮！

1da363b893b0b669e1f8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]A man with a mule approaches the party. As he nears, you notice that the draught animal is laden with panniers long and rolled tight like telescopes. Sleek feathervanes stick out of the saddlebags and there's a tub of ink bouncing alongside them. He introduces himself as a cartographer of these parts and knows your company by name. He bows.%SPEECH_ON%As a fellow man of the map, you have my thanks.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what for. The stranger seems rather shocked that he has to explain his adorations, as if you've no notion of your celebrity. Which you don't.%SPEECH_ON%Why, because you opened this land up! Before you not a soul would walk these parts and I'd nothing to plot to the page besides warnings to not go there. You ever see the line about 'here there be dragons'? That's my doing! And now I've mind to erase it and I've never been happier to do so. Thank you, explorer, and you may have one of these, an ornament so that others may know your deeds!%SPEECH_OFF%Explorer? Fellow man of the map? It appears this stranger has you all wrong, but you entertain his notions anyway. He hands you a fancy feather as thanks and then bids adieu. It appears the %companyname% is acquiring a name for itself beyond just killing and slaying. You're not sure if that is good or bad.
1da363b893b0b669e1f8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]一个牵骡子的男人向队伍走来。走近后，你发现驮畜两侧挂着长筐，里面装着卷得紧紧、形如望远镜的纸卷。光洁的羽毛笔从鞍袋中露出，旁边还颠着一罐墨水。他自称本地制图师，竟知道战团的名号，随即躬身致意。%SPEECH_ON%同为绘地图的人，我得向您道一声谢。%SPEECH_OFF%你问谢什么。他颇为惊讶，仿佛没想到自己的敬意还需要解释，更没想到你竟不知道自己多有名。而你确实不知道。%SPEECH_ON%当然是因为您开拓了这片土地！在您之前，没人肯往这里走，我除了写几句“不要去”，根本无从落笔。您见过“此处有龙”那句话吗？就是我写的！如今总算能把它擦掉，我从没这么高兴过。谢谢您，探险家。请收下这个，戴上它，让旁人都知道您的功绩！%SPEECH_OFF%探险家？绘地图的同道？这陌生人显然把你想岔了，不过你还是顺着他的话应承下来。他送你一根漂亮羽毛作为谢礼，随后告辞。看来，%companyname%除了杀人砍怪，也渐渐有了别的名声。你不知这究竟算好事还是坏事。

c0bc8fc3ab9eb6ff05d7.source:
Let us set out into the wilderness, discover the unknown, and plunder it.
Be it a wizard's tomb, goblin camp, or aught else we may find.
c0bc8fc3ab9eb6ff05d7.translation:
深入荒野，探寻未知，再把值钱的都搬回来。
无论是巫师墓穴、地精营地，还是别的什么！

73847a9d40c9ddd3e951.source: Discover a ruin or hostile camp, and destroy it
73847a9d40c9ddd3e951.translation: 发现并摧毁一处遗迹或敌方营地

4261ec769699c81d6b89.source: Discover a ruin, camp or other hostile location on your own by exploring the land, destroy it, and take the plunder.
4261ec769699c81d6b89.translation: 自行探索，发现一处遗迹、营地或其他敌方据点，将其摧毁，并带走战利品。

a8f7fc24e031c51bde19.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]It sounded like a good idea at the time, but tramping around the wilderness without a map or any destination in mind turned out to be quite a strenuous way to find riches, or even a battle. Your footsore band did eventually come upon a worthy target though, and everyone had to agree the venture was worthwhile after all. %farmer% is almost glowing with satisfaction as he surveys the few remaining embers of the %recently_destroyed%.%SPEECH_ON%They hadn't the merest clue we were coming. Like wheat before our scythes, brothers!%SPEECH_OFF%%notfarmer% raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%Speak for yourself. I'm no farmer.%SPEECH_OFF%
a8f7fc24e031c51bde19.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]当初听着是个好主意，可没有地图，也没有明确目的地，只顾在荒野里跋涉，结果发现，这样找财宝，甚至找场仗打，都着实费劲。不过，脚底磨得生疼的队伍终究撞上了一个值得下手的目标。战果到手后，大家也不得不承认，这趟险还是冒得值。%farmer%望着%recently_destroyed%残存的几点余火，满脸都是得意。%SPEECH_ON%他们压根不知道咱们要来。弟兄们，就跟镰刀底下的麦子一样！%SPEECH_OFF%%notfarmer%挑了挑眉。%SPEECH_ON%说你自己吧，我可不是种地的。%SPEECH_OFF%

a402ae6623bfab6c4572.source:
The city states of the south have crowns aplenty.
We shall get rich under the blazing desert sun!
a402ae6623bfab6c4572.translation:
南方城邦有的是克朗。
就在这沙漠烈日下，挣出一身富贵来！

bf5ce9282137b8dcc261.source: Fulfill contracts for the city states

8616d10235405cc66da7.source: Travel south, visit the southern city states and find employment there. Take on and complete contracts for the ruling elite.
8616d10235405cc66da7.translation: 前往南方城邦寻找工作，接受并完成当地统治者发布的委托。

ab1d1dc96893da7b367f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_150.png[/img]For all their intellectual pursuits and proper mannerisms, the Southerners are under no misapprehension as to your role as a mercenary. Whereas in the north they'd call you sellsword, here they dub you crownling. You've spent little mind toward either attribution, recognizing only the stark reality that for as much as they despise you, they seek out your work, award your competency, and remember your billing when future crises arise.

 And therein lies the cornerstone of the North and South: the mighty crown itself. Languages, religion, peoples, all be damned. A bit of gold needs no translation, no accommodation, and no arbitration. Your pursuit of the crown has shown you to be reliable to the Southerners, and your renown has grown as deep as their pockets.
ab1d1dc96893da7b367f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_150.png[/img]南方人再怎么崇尚学识、讲究礼数，也从未看错你这佣兵的身份。北方人叫你卖命的，到了这里，就成了克朗客。叫什么，你并不放在心上；你只认清一个事实：他们再鄙夷你，也得找你干活，为你的本事付钱，等到下一场危机来临，还会记起你的价码。

这便是南北双方共同的根基：无所不能的克朗。语言、信仰、族群，统统见鬼去吧。一点黄金，既不用翻译，也不用迁就，更不用仲裁。你对克朗的执着，已经让南方人认定你值得信赖；你的声望，也像他们的钱袋一样深厚。

6dce81f47fd61d412ff2.source:
Our company is ill-prepared to fight armored opponents. We shall train two men
to master the hammer in combat, and no knight will be safe from us.
6dce81f47fd61d412ff2.translation:
面对重甲敌人，我们还缺少应对手段。训练两名弟兄
精通战锤，让骑士也躲不过我们的锋芒。

ac3f2c825761de99722a.source: Have men with the hammer mastery perk
ac3f2c825761de99722a.translation: 培养掌握战锤精通的弟兄

76a7975d6fdab350ebda.source: Have 2 men with the hammer mastery perk.
76a7975d6fdab350ebda.translation: 有2名弟兄学会战锤精通特长。

70bc80fd1c19f851cc6b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]The men gather around to watch %hammerbrother%'s prowess as he practices his strokes against a pine tree, crack-crack-crack.%SPEECH_ON%Behold the hammer head! You could practically punch right through any helmet and have a good look what's inside that skull-bowl!%SPEECH_OFF%He swings once more and the tree trunk splits in the middle, with the upper half falling directly into the camp. %nothammerbrother% scrambles up from his seat, spilling soup all over himself, to narrowly avoid being crushed. %SPEECH_ON%Here I thought there was nothing new to see in the world but I have never killed a man with a falling tree before!%SPEECH_OFF%%hammerbrother% shouts laughingly. You anticipate that you will fare well next time you come up against heavily armored enemies.
70bc80fd1c19f851cc6b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]弟兄们围成一圈，看%hammerbrother%对着一棵松树练锤，咔、咔、咔，木屑四溅。%SPEECH_ON%瞧这锤头！什么头盔都能凿穿，顺便看看脑壳里装的什么！%SPEECH_OFF%他又挥出一锤，树干从中劈裂，上半截直朝营地倒下。%nothammerbrother%慌忙从座位上跳起，汤洒了一身，总算险险躲开，没被压住。%SPEECH_ON%我还以为世上没什么新鲜事可见了，倒真没试过拿倒下的树砸死人！%SPEECH_OFF%%hammerbrother%大笑着喊道。你想，下次再遇上披重甲的敌人，想必会好对付得多。

d729c3795ddf9e983965.source:
I know you are weary of our bad fortune and the stale fare day after day.
We shall get food and drink from all over the land and have a feast!
d729c3795ddf9e983965.translation:
我知道大家受够了霉运，也吃腻了日复一日的陈旧饭食。
搜罗各地的美食好酒，让我们大宴一场！

6f88b1363882430990e9.source: Significantly improve the mood of your men.
6f88b1363882430990e9.translation: 大幅改善弟兄们的心情。

b4f13958cfd18944fc14.source: Have one of each provision type there is

8fc227a7c749dc13204e.source: Have one of each provision type there is in your stash to hold a feast.
8fc227a7c749dc13204e.translation: 在仓库中备齐所有种类的食物，每种至少一份，以举办宴会。

5e494bbb47d9531db8a8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]Having put in the legwork chasing down provisioners and haggling with farmers, you assemble a selection of foodstuffs that would catch the eye of even the most jaded nobleman. With the larder full, you call a feast for the %companyname% and invite every man to eat his fill. Your brothers waste no time. What they lack in manners, they make up in appetite. %randombrother% uses the opportunity to share his knowledge on meat.%SPEECH_ON%This beast died with joy in its heart, that's why it is so tender.%SPEECH_OFF%To the admiration of his comrades, %strongest_brother% gives a thunderous belch.%SPEECH_ON%I am ashamed to say it, but I must wash this down with water, not more grog.%SPEECH_OFF%After this, there is not much in the way of talk, but greasy beards and full bellies guarantee the men will be in good spirits for your next encounter.
5e494bbb47d9531db8a8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]你跑遍粮商，又与农夫讨价还价，终于凑齐一桌连最挑剔的贵族也会侧目的食物。仓库充盈，你宣布%companyname%开宴，让每个弟兄都敞开肚子吃。众人毫不客气，礼数欠缺的部分，全用胃口补了回来。%randombrother%趁机卖弄起自己品肉的学问。%SPEECH_ON%这畜生死的时候心里高兴，所以肉才这么嫩。%SPEECH_OFF%%strongest_brother%打了一个雷鸣般的饱嗝，引来同伴的敬佩。%SPEECH_ON%说来惭愧，我得喝点水往下顺顺，酒是真灌不下了。%SPEECH_OFF%此后话便不多了，不过，沾满油的胡须和填得鼓鼓的肚皮，足以保证下一场遭遇战时，弟兄们心情都不会差。

d598268f96be003e03f8.translation: 与战团的弟兄们共赴盛宴

d66618e2095c3f2d1de8.source:
Mundane armors won't do for a real mercenary outfit.
We should adorn our gear with trophies of our deeds!
d66618e2095c3f2d1de8.translation:
一支真正的佣兵战团，怎能只穿寻常护甲。
把战绩化作装饰，将猎获之物披挂上身！

699f4e443c16fdd56b4c.source: Have at least 6 armors with attachments
699f4e443c16fdd56b4c.translation: 拥有至少6件装有附加组件的护甲

0948a1bc78324a65e43a.source: Have at least 6 armors with attachments in your possession. Buy them, loot them, or have a taxidermist craft them for you, then combine them with the armor of your men.
0948a1bc78324a65e43a.translation: 拥有至少6件装有附加组件的护甲。组件可通过购买、缴获，或交给剥制匠制作获得，然后安装到弟兄们的护甲上。

8e4c16623415a017f12b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]When you took command of the company it was a ragtag band of men clinging for life, an ad hoc assembly of sellswords stitched together with nothing if not sheer stubbornness and absolute contempt for common sense. Now you watch as the men walk around like frayed revenants of an unworldly wild, their armor adorned with hideous scalps and pelts and bones, the ill-shapen recreation of conquest fitted such that others may know the %companyname% could not be sorted by any measure known to the earth whether it be monster or man.
8e4c16623415a017f12b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]你接掌战团时，手下不过是一群挣扎求生的乌合之众。这些临时拼凑起来的佣兵，能凑在一起，全靠一股死不服输的倔劲，以及对常理的彻底无视。如今再看，弟兄们披挂着狰狞的头皮、兽皮与骨骸，仿佛从异世荒野归来的破败亡魂。那些畸异的战利品覆在护甲上，向世人宣告：%companyname%已经无法用世间任何尺度衡量，既不像寻常的人，也不像寻常的怪物。

573df16050c8ac6ec2cb.source:
We need real talent to bolster our ranks further.
We'll recruit the most talented we can find and mold him into a god of war!
573df16050c8ac6ec2cb.translation:
要让战团更进一步，就得招到真正的人才。
找到天资最出众的人，把他磨炼成战神！

b153f0f55cbe9e91718c.source: Have a character with three times three talent stars
b153f0f55cbe9e91718c.translation: 招到三项属性均有三星天赋的人才

e9612d62987b89469023.source: Have a character in your roster with a three stars talent at three different attributes. Travel the land and seek the best of the best. Consider hiring the 'Recruiter' for your retinue of non-combat followers.
e9612d62987b89469023.translation: 让战团中有一名角色在三项不同属性上都拥有三星天赋。走遍各地，寻觅出类拔萃的人才。也可考虑为非战斗随从队伍雇用“招募官”。

e75ff5a31631bfdd9540.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]When the miner find a diamond in the mountains, it is hurried away to the royal chambers. When the fisherman hauls the fattest catch of the day, a nobleman will have it himself. Good soldiers? To the lords as generals or trainers. Talented tailors? The finest fineries require the finest fingers, to the nobles he goes to serve. Houndmaster shows a bit of skill beyond bopping noses and barking commands? He can train wardogs for the highborn armies. So it is that this world snatches the talented as fast as the hawk pounces the rabbit which reveals itself.

 But now you've your own catch: %star%. He is a genuine talent, showing remarkable aptitude in physicality, martial skills, and courage. Even the rest of the %companyname% can sense the man's presence as sure as one sense destiny and greatness. %star% is everything you'd want in a mercenary, and were the company fitted entirely with a man of his mold, well, you'd do more than chase contracts, you'd conquer the whole world!
e75ff5a31631bfdd9540.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]矿工在山里挖到钻石，转眼就被送进王室的厅堂。渔夫捕到当天最肥的鱼，贵族必会留给自己享用。好士兵？送到领主身边，当将领或教官。巧手裁缝？最华贵的衣裳要最灵巧的双手，也得去侍候贵族。驯犬师若除了敲鼻子、吼命令，还多会几招，便能替贵族军队训练战犬。这世界攫取人才，快得就像苍鹰扑向刚露头的兔子。

可如今，你也有了自己的收获：%star%。他确是难得的人才，体魄、武艺与胆气都显出非凡天赋。%companyname%的其他弟兄也能感到他的不凡，仿佛命运与伟业已经近在眼前。%star%具备你对佣兵的一切期望。倘若全团都是这样的人，你们哪还用四处找委托，早就去征服整个世界了！

0ac306c2ae59c53adde8.source: Unless, of course, a stray arrow catches him next battle.
0ac306c2ae59c53adde8.translation: 当然，前提是他下场战斗别中了流矢。

7f7e9e2e8edd7d5bf772.source:
Should a battle or two go against us we may find ourselves out of pocket and
short of equipment. The company will therefore build a reserve of 10,000 crowns.
7f7e9e2e8edd7d5bf772.translation:
倘若接连吃上几场败仗，我们就可能缺钱少装备。
因此，战团要留存10,000克朗，以备不时之需。

cb50968468dbef840234.source: Have at least 10,000 crowns as a reserve, in order to persevere when things may turn bad in the future. You can make money by completing contracts, looting camps and ruins, or trading.
cb50968468dbef840234.translation: 留存至少10,000克朗，以备将来遭遇困境时支撑战团。完成委托、搜掠营地与遗迹，或经商都能赚钱。

c6d6e4fa0016c168fbf3.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]Your increased store of coin and other valuables lets you sleep easier. The men do too, knowing that they won't have to chase you across the steppe when payroll is due. You'll no longer be at a disadvantage when it comes to contract negotiations, and you'll not end up short on men or equipment should a battle or two go against you.

Your new reserve also begins to open doors for the %companyname%. Merchants, money lenders and nobles have one thing in common: they prefer to rub elbows with their own kind. Merely getting an audience can be a chore if they suspect you have empty pockets. But now that you've proven yourself to be a man of resource, the company has become more attractive to wealthy individuals and decision makers.
c6d6e4fa0016c168fbf3.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]钱币和财物越攒越多，你总算能睡得踏实些。弟兄们也一样，知道发饷时不必满草原追着你讨债。往后商谈委托，你不再处于下风；即使一两场仗没打好，也不至于立刻缺人少装备。

这笔储备还为%companyname%敲开了新的大门。商人、放贷者和贵族有一个共同点：都喜欢结交与自己同等身家的人。若怀疑你两袖空空，想见一面都难。如今，你已证明自己财力不俗，战团在富人和掌权者眼里，也更值得拉拢。

8f487e7dc274fd15f916.source:
Already we are known in some parts of the land, yet we are still far from being
a legendary company. We shall increase our renown further!
8f487e7dc274fd15f916.translation:
我们已在一些地方闯出名号，却还远称不上传奇战团。
继续提高声望，让更多人知晓我们！

f1c92c5fd4ff1ceded03.source: Become known as 'Glorious' (2,750 renown) throughout the land. You can increase your renown by completing contracts and winning battles.
f1c92c5fd4ff1ceded03.translation: 将声望提升至“荣耀”（2,750声望），名扬四方。完成委托与赢得战斗都能提升声望。

b3e3f748b266ae37af2d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]Marching through forests and over plains, the band has smashed any opposition they've been sent after. Trampling foes, shattering battle lines, and sending heads flying, the %companyname% find that they are seldom alone. Crows circle high over the company as they march, they sing as the men take their supper, and more often than not they feast well after their daily work is done.

In their wake, the men leave scorched earth and outlandish rumors everywhere their booted feet have tread, each tale burgeoning in the telling until everyone from milkmaids to blacksmiths to burgomeisters seems to be talking about your exploits. Gossip is a currency valued in every corner of the land, and neither broad rivers nor tall peaks will slow the tales of your victories, and in turn, the prices you can now demand for your services.
b3e3f748b266ae37af2d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]穿过森林，越过平原，战团粉碎了一切奉命讨伐的敌人。踏过倒下的对手，击碎敌方阵线，让头颅高高飞起，%companyname%渐渐发现，自己很少再孤军上路。行军时，乌鸦在头顶盘旋；众人用晚餐时，它们在一旁鸣叫；每天的差事做完，它们往往也能饱餐一顿。

弟兄们的军靴走到哪里，便将焦土和离奇传闻留在哪里。故事越传越夸张，挤奶女工、铁匠、镇长，仿佛人人都在谈论你们的功绩。闲话是天下通行的货币，宽河高山也拦不住捷报流传。随之水涨船高的，自然还有你们接活时的价码。

7f78aa972b2220f39e8e.source:
Crowns mean power and influence, and we can never have enough of either.
Let us gather 50,000 crowns and earn our seat amongst noblemen and kings!
7f78aa972b2220f39e8e.translation:
克朗意味着权力和声势，而这些永远不嫌多。
攒下50,000克朗，让我们在贵族与国王之间也占有一席之地！

e174414676ea6de8dc17.source: Have at least 50,000 crowns to be counted among the wealthy. You can make money by completing contracts, looting camps and ruins, or trading.
e174414676ea6de8dc17.translation: 持有至少50,000克朗，跻身富人之列。完成委托、搜掠营地与遗迹，或经商都能赚钱。

dbd8bfd9498ef1a974f5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]Plunder, plunder and, yes, more plunder! The company has accumulated riches to rival a dragon's hoard. The finest armor and weapons are yours for the asking. Should you wish to hire a ship, or a fleet of ships, you need merely snap your fingers. Vendors of all kinds lay out their best wares when you are in town, most eager to help you find new ways to spend your gold.

As your wealth rivals that of a nobleman, you no longer need defer to them. You could purchase your own noble title and lands, or take up the career of a merchant banker, should you ever tire of acting nursemaid to this bunch of hardheaded, temperamental louts.
dbd8bfd9498ef1a974f5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]掠夺、掠夺，没错，还是掠夺！战团积攒的财宝，已经足以媲美巨龙的宝库。最精良的护甲和兵器，只需你开口便可入手。想雇一艘船，甚至一整支船队，也不过打个响指的工夫。每逢进城，各路商贩便摆出压箱底的好货，迫不及待地替你想些花钱的新法子。

既然身家已与贵族相当，你也无需再对他们低声下气。哪天厌倦了给这帮顽固又喜怒无常的粗汉当保姆，你大可买个爵位、置下领地，或转行做个经营钱庄的大商人。

7a8e67b068d59847802d.source:
There were few legendary mercenary companies throughout history.
We are close to having our name become immortal and be counted among them!
7a8e67b068d59847802d.translation:
历史上，称得上传奇的佣兵战团屈指可数。
我们即将跻身其中，让自己的名号永垂不朽！

e1bb461e87a8ab746b46.source: Become known as 'Invincible' (8,000 renown) and leave your mark in history. You can increase your renown by completing contracts and winning battles.
e1bb461e87a8ab746b46.translation: 将声望提升至“无敌”（8,000声望），在历史上留下名号。完成委托与赢得战斗都能提升声望。

5d284d24a219a4e56570.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]With rivers of blood, a hundred burned fortresses, and ten thousand fat, feasting crows at your back, the tales of your company's prowess will never die. The name '%companyname%' is spoken in triumphant shouts and hushed awe in every corner of the known world. Fathers name their sons after your bravest men, and those boys will grow up acting out the many famous battles you fought.

Your renown is such now that is has become an inconvenience to visit any place larger than a hamlet. Everywhere you travel you are harried day and night. Eligible maidens competing for the mens' attention end up in fisticuffs. Shopkeepers, thinking you magnificently wealthy, call at all hours with their wares. Worst of all, every braggart in the land wishes to challenge your men, with the militia waiting for the outcome, hoping that the simple fine for fighting in the street may be elevated to a blood debt.

But you achieved what you set out to, even if the result is not quite what you anticipated. Whatever your fate, the %companyname% has already become immortal in the history of the world.
5d284d24a219a4e56570.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]身后血流成河，百座堡垒化作焦土，万只乌鸦吃得肥硕饱足，战团武勇的传说也将永不消亡。已知世界的每个角落，都有人高声欢呼“%companyname%”，也有人带着敬畏低声传诵。父亲们用你麾下最勇猛战士的名字为儿子命名，那些男孩则在成长中，一遍遍扮演你们打过的著名战役。

如今名气太大，去个稍大些的地方都成了麻烦。走到哪里，日夜都有人纠缠。待嫁姑娘为了争得弟兄们的注意，竟动起拳头；店主认定你们富可敌国，没日没夜抱着货物上门。最糟的是，天下的吹牛大王都想挑战你的部下，民兵则在一旁等着结果，巴不得寻常街头斗殴闹出人命，好把罚款换成更大一笔血债赔偿。

但你终究做到了当初想做的事，尽管结果未必与想象相同。无论日后命运如何，%companyname%都已在世间史册中不朽。

647915fc2c4e28a1aacf.source: The %companyname%'s name shall live on forever!

861e23ef7de3c41f074e.source: Your look on the worldmap has been updated
861e23ef7de3c41f074e.translation: 战团在世界地图上的外观已更新

c61255ca13d57a060c6d.source:
There are cooks, scouts and many more who can support us off the battlefield.
We'll hire one that suits our needs best!
c61255ca13d57a060c6d.translation:
厨师、斥候，还有许多人能在战场之外帮上忙。
雇一个最适合我们的人！

90a4b1ea1c1a2fa50ed1.source: Hire someone for your retinue of non-combat followers

3c07864674a461bd56fc.source: Gain a renown of at least 'Recognized' (250) to unlock the first slot for a non-combat follower in your retinue. You can increase your renown by completing contracts and winning battles. Then, hire a non-combat follower in the retinue screen. Some followers require you to fulfill specific prerequisites to unlock their services.
3c07864674a461bd56fc.translation: 将声望提升至至少“广受认可”（250），解锁第一个非战斗随从栏位。完成委托与赢得战斗都能提升声望。随后在随从界面雇用一名随从。部分随从还需要满足特定条件，才会提供服务。

4dc36b20a7cc11f68804.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%So they're not a fighter?%SPEECH_OFF%One of the sellswords asks. You shake your head, and they scratch theirs.%SPEECH_ON%But they're hired on anyway?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The sellsword purses their lips for a second then clarifies.%SPEECH_ON%And absolutely no fighting?%SPEECH_OFF%No fighting.%SPEECH_ON%None? So they'll just fart around doing whatever task here and there?%SPEECH_OFF%You explain that not every important role in a mercenary band needs to be one of fighting. After you've laid out all the jobs others could help out around here, the sellsword thinks for a time.%SPEECH_ON%Can they take up inventory counting, then? Cause I'm real tired of that.%SPEECH_OFF%No. Of course not. You'll never let your secret punishment go to someone else.
4dc36b20a7cc11f68804.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%所以，这人不打仗？%SPEECH_OFF%一个佣兵问道。你摇摇头，他挠挠自己的脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%可咱们还是雇了？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。他抿着嘴想了一会儿，又追问。%SPEECH_ON%真的一次都不用打？%SPEECH_OFF%不用打。%SPEECH_ON%一次也不用？那就东晃西晃，这儿干点，那儿干点？%SPEECH_OFF%你解释，战团中重要的差事，并非样样都得挥刀上阵。等你把旁人能帮忙的活计列过一遍，他又琢磨片刻。%SPEECH_ON%那清点仓库能交给他们吗？我真干腻了。%SPEECH_OFF%不能，当然不能。你才不会把这项暗藏的惩罚交给别人。

28ed7efde24c8e999bbb.source: This will aid us greatly in the days to come.
28ed7efde24c8e999bbb.translation: 往后的日子里，这会大有帮助。

9e5c8e62fead8b8e8cdd.source:
We need to catch the eye of one of the noble houses for more profitable work. They
play their own dangerous game, but what does it matter as long as the pay is good?
9e5c8e62fead8b8e8cdd.translation:
想接更赚钱的活，就得引起某个贵族家族的注意。他们
玩的勾当固然危险，可只要报酬够高，又有什么要紧？

77ce7a3607834a51a781.source: You'll unlock entirely new contracts issued by nobles which pay better.
77ce7a3607834a51a781.translation: 解锁贵族发布的全新委托类型，报酬更为丰厚。

e0e294d8df90edd1d023.source: Become known as 'Professional' (1,050 renown) in order to catch the attention of the noble houses. You can increase your renown by completing contracts and winning battles.
e0e294d8df90edd1d023.translation: 将声望提升至“专业”（1,050声望），引起贵族家族的注意。完成委托与赢得战斗都能提升声望。

7dbcfdc4909964c93e1a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]Thinking to set tongues wagging with the name the %companyname%, and thereby increase your prospects with the nobility, you pushed your men to great deeds, outstanding bravery, and plentiful bloodshed. After several contracts and more than a few skirmishes, you worked hard enough and long enough to have some of the lords take notice of the company's competence.

These are the gentlefolk who rule the land by virtue of some long-dead ancestor subjugating a group of unarmed peasants. As %highestexperience_brother% puts it, now these pampered, inbred fops are well impressed enough with you to grind the company in one of their feuds. If you wash your face and ask politely, they should favor you with a profitable contract now and again. You can congratulate yourself!
7dbcfdc4909964c93e1a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]为了让%companyname%的名号传开，在贵族那里谋得更好的出路，你督促弟兄们立下功绩、奋勇厮杀，也洒下了足够多的鲜血。接了数份委托，打过许多场遭遇战，你们终于凭长期苦干，让一些领主注意到了战团的本事。

这群衣冠楚楚的老爷能统治此地，无非是因为某个早已死去的祖宗，曾征服了一群手无寸铁的农民。照%highestexperience_brother%的说法，如今这些娇生惯养、近亲繁衍出来的纨绔，总算对你们刮目相看，足以把战团送进自家的争斗里消磨。只要洗把脸，说话客气些，他们便会时不时赏下一份赚钱的委托。你大可好好恭喜自己！

bba1a7a2bdac11b9663b.source: We are about to reach into the nobility's deep pockets!
bba1a7a2bdac11b9663b.translation: 该把手伸进贵族那鼓鼓的钱袋了！

f7ed501ca010c8c44f30.source: Nobles will now give you contracts
f7ed501ca010c8c44f30.translation: 现在可以接受贵族委托

6a877116ae17b50fd228.source:
A respectable company is recognized by their equipment. We should head out
and claim either a famed weapon, shield, armor or helmet to increase our renown.
6a877116ae17b50fd228.translation:
一支体面的战团，光看装备就认得出来。我们该出发
寻得一件名器武器、盾牌、护甲或头盔，再添一分声望。

e2fdf27253c635d0b1a1.source: Gain an additional 150 renown for your victory.

8043911d28bc2b7c3dbe.source: Have at least 1 famed piece of equipment

a00cfb8fc63d2e5d1c23.source: Have at least 1 famed piece of equipment in your possession - weapon, shield, armor or helmet. Follow rumors in taverns to learn where famed items can be found, purchase them at specialized shops in large cities and castles, or go out on your own to explore and raid ruins and camps. The further away from civilization, the higher the chance of finding rare items.
a00cfb8fc63d2e5d1c23.translation: 拥有至少1件名器装备，武器、盾牌、护甲或头盔均可。到酒馆打听相关传闻，在大城市和城堡的专门商店购买，或自行探索并攻掠遗迹与营地。离人烟越远，找到稀有物品的机会越大。

3e6d994d99826207bb10.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]It was no easy task seeking out one of those rare items recognized as a talisman of fighting men, but the %nameditem% is truly remarkable. The men fairly glow with pride after acquiring it. Around the fire, some of the brothers even grow maudlin and teary-eyed when in their cups, pawing it like a favorite hound.%SPEECH_ON%Isn't it beautiful?%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% asks while admiring it in the glow of the campfire, quickly cut off by another of the men.%SPEECH_ON%Turn it this way so I can have a proper peek!%SPEECH_OFF%In the days that follow your men are parading the %nameditem% around like the trophy head of some fearsome beast. Usually in taverns or at festivals, and near other sources of mead and beer, the brothers make a habit of showing their prize off everywhere you go.
3e6d994d99826207bb10.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]要找到这种被战士们视为护身宝物的稀世名器，着实不容易，可%nameditem%也确实非同凡响。得到它后，弟兄们满脸都是自豪。围着篝火喝上几杯，有些人甚至多愁善感起来，眼含泪光，像抚摸心爱的猎犬一样摩挲着它。%SPEECH_ON%多漂亮，是不是？%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%借着火光欣赏，话音未落就被另一个弟兄打断。%SPEECH_ON%转过来一点，让我也好好瞧瞧！%SPEECH_OFF%接下来的日子，众人把%nameditem%当成凶兽的首级一般，走到哪儿都要举出来炫耀。尤其是酒馆、庆典，以及其他能喝到蜂蜜酒和啤酒的地方，他们更不会放过显摆的机会。

c152d4d056f131d40faf.source: You gain additional renown for having a famed item
c152d4d056f131d40faf.translation: 因拥有名器而获得额外声望

4b7e4b4f129eb50db8c6.source:
A famed company is recognized by their equipment. We should head out
and claim a prestigious weapon, shield, armor and helmet to increase our renown.
4b7e4b4f129eb50db8c6.translation:
成名战团的装备总是与众不同。我们该出发
凑齐名器武器、盾牌、护甲和头盔，让声名更上一层楼。

1dee22648f759060f4af.source: Have a famed weapon, shield, armor and helmet
1dee22648f759060f4af.translation: 凑齐名器武器、盾牌、护甲和头盔

bdbf16d07d857fbc70df.source: Have at least one famed weapon, shield, armor and helmet each in your possession. Follow rumors in taverns to learn where famed items can be found, purchase them at specialized shops in large cities and castles, or go out on your own to explore and raid ruins and camps. The further away from civilization, the higher the chance of finding rare items.
bdbf16d07d857fbc70df.translation: 拥有名器武器、盾牌、护甲和头盔各至少一件。到酒馆打听相关传闻，在大城市和城堡的专门商店购买，或自行探索并攻掠遗迹与营地。离人烟越远，找到稀有物品的机会越大。

f009a47d1cc177a85d17.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]After weeks spent listening for rumors, buying pints of beer for decrepit old veterans, and negotiating with wheedling crones, you were able to ferret out the locations of a prestigious weapon, shield, armor and helmet. Having learned where to find the pieces, all that remained was the minor matter of defeating the various horrors and cutthroats guarding it. Now soon to be worn by the men of your company, the pieces form a set fearsome to behold. %SPEECH_ON%The man who dons this arming onto the battlefield will see the fiercest enemy hobble away shaking a load down the leg of his pants!%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% exclaims proudly and to the laughing approval of his brothers in arms. You only hope their joy and excitement doesn't turn into envy once you announce which man will get to wear the pieces.
f009a47d1cc177a85d17.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]数周以来，你四处打听消息，请年迈的老兵喝酒，与油嘴滑舌的老妇人周旋，终于查出了一套名器武器、盾牌、护甲和头盔的下落。知道东西在哪儿以后，剩下的不过是一桩“小事”：打败看守它们的各种怪物与亡命徒。如今，这套装备即将披在弟兄们身上，光是摆在一起，就足以令人胆寒。%SPEECH_ON%谁穿这一身上阵，再凶的敌人也得吓得一边瘸着逃，一边把屎顺裤腿抖出来！%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%得意地叫道，引得袍泽们大笑附和。你只盼着，等宣布由谁穿戴之后，这份欢喜和兴奋别转眼变成嫉妒。

67365d07a67f791a9548.source:
The company is doing great, we just need to keep it up!
(No Ambition)
67365d07a67f791a9548.translation:
战团如今一切顺利，继续保持就好！
（暂不设立志向）

3514d1701693527c18c0.source: Don't choose an ambition right now. You'll be asked to choose again after three days.
3514d1701693527c18c0.translation: 暂不选择战团志向，三天后会再次询问。

8582f75665c51978f2d0.source:
There are lots of riches to be claimed from caravans.
We need but take them like fruit from a tree!
8582f75665c51978f2d0.translation:
商队里有的是财宝。
伸手去取，就像从树上摘果子！

de87744f0cf9b34ecfa5.translation: 劫掠贸易商队或补给队

828acac9b93dd2842e73.source: Raid 4 trade or supply caravans along the road. If you're not already hostile to their faction, you can force an attack by holding the CTRL key while left-clicking on them - but only if you're not currently hired for a contract.
828acac9b93dd2842e73.translation: 劫掠路上的4支贸易商队或补给队。若与对方势力尚未敌对，可按住CTRL并单击鼠标左键强行攻击，但必须在当前没有受雇执行委托时才能这样做。

de9fb38f7c330b13ef91.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]A dead merchant's voice rings in your head.%SPEECH_ON%Why did you do it? We'd have given you it all.%SPEECH_OFF%But the memory isn't about him. It's about his wagon, and what parts of it he wouldn't even divulge with his life on the balance. Since setting out to raid them, attacking caravans has turned into something of a sport for you and the %companyname%. Awashed in the riches of your ambushes, the men are happy, and you've accrued a bit of renown for your dastardly deeds.
de9fb38f7c330b13ef91.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]一个死去商人的声音在你脑中回响。%SPEECH_ON%为什么要杀人？我们什么都可以给你们。%SPEECH_OFF%可你惦记的并不是他，而是他的货车，以及那些就算性命攸关，他也不肯透露的藏货之处。自从动了劫掠商队的念头，袭击商队便渐渐成了你和%companyname%的一种消遣。伏击带来的财物让弟兄们喜笑颜开，你也因这些卑劣勾当闯出了一点名声。

82c2ddcf3fca6a79cc36.source: Like taking candy from a child.
82c2ddcf3fca6a79cc36.translation: 就像从孩子手里抢糖一样容易。

52347723e824febd7d18.source:
The company lacks competent archers, limiting our tactical options.
We shall train three men to master bow or crossbow and be deadly from afar!
52347723e824febd7d18.translation:
战团缺少出色的弓手，战术选择因此受限。
训练三名弟兄精通弓或弩，让敌人远在天边也难逃一死！

01136f4cb6247c949330.source: Have men with the bow or crossbow mastery perk
01136f4cb6247c949330.translation: 培养精通弓或弩的弟兄

e3530ad96c6743a95bb5.source: Have 3 men with the bow or crossbow mastery perk.
e3530ad96c6743a95bb5.translation: 有3名弟兄学会弓术精通或弩与火器精通特长。

2f47f5f87f1a0499363c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]At every opportunity, you encourage the men under your command to let loose a few volleys. Everyone participates, even the slow witted louts who would sleep in their armor if you let them. Any target at all suffices: the bole of a small tree, a doe grazing in the early hours, or a goblin scout fleeing for his life.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, we are the terror of hay bales throughout the land!%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says, referring to a common choice of target during practice. He ducks when an arrow from one of his comrades whistles close past his skull and starts cursing at the shooter.

With plenty of practice, those arrows are striking closer and closer to the bullseye, and now that the company is fielding better trained bowmen, your frontline is breathing easier and living, at least marginally, longer.
2f47f5f87f1a0499363c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]只要有机会，你就督促弟兄们放上几轮箭。人人都得练，就连那些脑子迟钝、放任不管便会穿着护甲睡觉的粗汉也不例外。什么都能当靶子：小树的树干，清晨吃草的母鹿，或仓皇逃命的地精斥候。%SPEECH_ON%没错，咱们已经成了全天下草垛的噩梦！%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%拿常用的练习靶开起玩笑。话音未落，同伴射出的一支箭贴着他脑袋呼啸而过，他赶紧低头，转身便骂。

练得多了，箭也越来越接近靶心。如今战团有了训练更精良的弓手，前排弟兄终于能松口气，活得也久了些——哪怕只是多一点。

aa0283325bac4a5e7719.source:
We shall get the company strength to a dozen men! It will make us
a formidable force and will allow us to take on more profitable work.
aa0283325bac4a5e7719.translation:
把战团扩充到十二人！如此便能形成
一股不可小觑的力量，接下更赚钱的工作。

f591e0fc8dae6c279ae8.source: Have a roster of at least 12 men

f63977dd2688743675df.source: Hire enough men to have a full roster of at least 12 men. Visit settlements across the lands to find recruits that suit your needs. Having a full roster will allow you to take on more dangerous and better paying contracts.
f63977dd2688743675df.translation: 招募足够的人手，使战团人数达到至少12人。走访各地聚落，寻找合适的新人。人手齐备后，就能接受更危险、报酬也更高的委托。

f6e4a8233330c354fd9d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]Having finally gathered the coin and equipment, you manage to assemble a full complement of twelve able fighters. When next you walk down %currenttown%'s main street, the men break into a full-throated marching song. A few of the townsfolk mutter under their breath about dirty mercenaries taking over the town, but others walk alongside and shout the words with you. %SPEECH_ON%Stand tall, brothers. People can see this is a real mercenary company now, and not a handful of wandering vagabonds.%SPEECH_OFF%%highestexperience_brother% declares.%SPEECH_ON%We trade in strength, and now that our numbers have gone up, so will our price.%SPEECH_OFF%It appears he has the right of it. You notice one particularly fat nobleman sizing up the company as if he already has a task in mind. The %companyname% are now a force to be reckoned with. Once the men have settled in for a celebratory drink, perhaps you should take another stroll through town to see if any more lucrative contracts may be available.
f6e4a8233330c354fd9d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]终于凑齐钱财与装备后，你招足了十二名能打的战士。再次走上%currenttown%的大街时，弟兄们放开嗓子唱起行军歌。有些镇民低声嘀咕，说肮脏的佣兵要占领镇子；另一些人却并肩跟来，与你们一同高唱。%SPEECH_ON%挺起胸膛，弟兄们。如今谁都看得出来，我们是真正的佣兵战团，可不是几个四处游荡的流浪汉。%SPEECH_OFF%%highestexperience_brother%朗声说道。%SPEECH_ON%我们卖的是实力。人多了，价码自然也得涨。%SPEECH_OFF%他似乎说得没错。你发现一个格外肥胖的贵族正在打量队伍，仿佛心里已经有了要交给你们的差事。如今，%companyname%已是一股不可忽视的力量。等弟兄们坐下来喝酒庆祝，你或许该再去镇上转转，看看有没有更赚钱的委托。

33de05c2a1d28bcd784c.source:
We shall get the company strength to sixteen men! It will make us
a formidable force and will allow us to take on more profitable work.
33de05c2a1d28bcd784c.translation:
把战团扩充到十六人！如此便能形成
一股不可小觑的力量，接下更赚钱的工作。

4c0443227d9a97d86fed.source: Have a roster of at least 16 men

9debf4e4216d11b28b7d.source: Hire enough men to have a full roster of at least 16 men. Visit settlements across the lands to find recruits that suit your needs. Having a full roster will allow you to take on more dangerous and better paying contracts.
9debf4e4216d11b28b7d.translation: 招募足够的人手，使战团人数达到至少16人。走访各地聚落，寻找合适的新人。人手齐备后，就能接受更危险、报酬也更高的委托。

af7c3963acd3935f0b76.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]Having finally gathered the coin and equipment, you manage to assemble a full complement of sixteen able-bodied men. When next you walk down %currenttown%'s main street, the men break into a full-throated marching song. A few of the townsfolk mutter under their breath about dirty mercenaries taking over the town, but others walk alongside and shout the words with you. %SPEECH_ON%Stand tall, brothers. People can see this is a real mercenary company now, and not a handful of rabble.%SPEECH_OFF%%highestexperience_brother% declares.%SPEECH_ON%We trade in strength, and now that our numbers have gone up, so will our price.%SPEECH_OFF%It appears he has the right of it. You notice one particularly fat merchant sizing up the company as if he already has a task in mind. The %companyname% are now a force to be reckoned with. Once the men have settled in for a celebratory drink, perhaps you should take another stroll through town to see if any more lucrative contracts may be available.
af7c3963acd3935f0b76.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]终于凑齐钱财与装备后，你招足了十六名身强力壮的弟兄。再次走上%currenttown%的大街时，众人放开嗓子唱起行军歌。有些镇民低声嘀咕，说肮脏的佣兵要占领镇子；另一些人却并肩跟来，与你们一同高唱。%SPEECH_ON%挺起胸膛，弟兄们。如今谁都看得出来，我们是真正的佣兵战团，可不是一小撮乌合之众。%SPEECH_OFF%%highestexperience_brother%朗声说道。%SPEECH_ON%我们卖的是实力。人多了，价码自然也得涨。%SPEECH_OFF%他似乎说得没错。你发现一个格外肥胖的商人正在打量队伍，仿佛心里已经有了要交给你们的差事。如今，%companyname%已是一股不可忽视的力量。等弟兄们坐下来喝酒庆祝，你或许该再去镇上转转，看看有没有更赚钱的委托。

a29cc929724bd5e488cc.source:
Let's build up our numbers to twenty good men so that the wounded
may rest and the weary regain their strength between skirmishes.
a29cc929724bd5e488cc.translation:
将战团扩充到二十名好手，让伤员有空养伤，
疲惫的弟兄也能在战斗间隙恢复体力。

a7649391ef5d0edf6cb1.source: Hire enough men to have a full roster of 20 men. Visit settlements across the lands to find recruits that suit your needs.
a7649391ef5d0edf6cb1.translation: 招募足够的人手，使战团人数达到20人。走访各地聚落，寻找合适的新人。

e44eb06cc497cd907a2b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]For many days you speak with potential recruits from different backgrounds and from every corner of society, weeding out the incompetent and haggling with the greedy. It seems as if in troubled times every vagrant, daytaler and nobleman's youngest son wishes to become a mercenary.

The men are glad for the company's bigger roster, and those you rejected will be the butt of many jests for weeks to come. %highestexperience_brother% claps you on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%How about that man who said he'd taken the heads of a bunch of orcs, but was really a baker from %randomtown%! Pinching flabby biceps and beating farmers' sons with tree branches was good sport for the first few days but by the end it was more work than chasing brigands around, if you ask me.%SPEECH_OFF%You now have twenty men under your command. Not all are veterans, and not all have been tested, but being able to rotate out your wounded will mean fresher units in the field.
e44eb06cc497cd907a2b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]连日来，你接见了出身各异、来自社会各处的应征者，淘汰没本事的，与贪心的讨价还价。乱世之中，似乎每个流浪汉、短工，乃至贵族家不受重视的小儿子，都想来当佣兵。

战团人丁兴旺，弟兄们也很高兴，那些被你拒之门外的人，往后几周还会不断成为笑料。%highestexperience_brother%拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%还记得那个吹嘘砍过一堆兽人脑袋的家伙吗？其实就是%randomtown%的面包师！捏捏松垮的胳膊，用树枝教训教训农家小子，头几天还挺好玩，可到了最后，依我看，比到处追山贼还累。%SPEECH_OFF%如今，你麾下已有二十人。并非人人都是老兵，也并非个个经受过考验，但能把伤员轮换下来，就意味着上场的人能有更充沛的精力。

58ab500b00ec6abb65cd.source:
We fight well, but we need to be better organized in case things get dire.
I shall name a sergeant to rally you on the battlefield.
58ab500b00ec6abb65cd.translation:
我们虽能打，但想在危急时刻站稳，就得更有章法。
我要任命一位军士，在战场上稳住队伍的士气。

a1b1c19f707fcae89cbe.source: You'll be awarded a unique accessory that grants the wearer additional resolve.
a1b1c19f707fcae89cbe.translation: 获得一件独特饰品，提高佩戴者的意志。

d6178b054ec45f5ca837.source: Have one man with the 'Rally the Troops' perk
d6178b054ec45f5ca837.translation: 有一名弟兄学会“重振士气”特长

3aa7ff6ae0cc600893bc.source: Have at least one man with the 'Rally the Troops' perk. You'll also need space enough in your inventory for a new item.
3aa7ff6ae0cc600893bc.translation: 至少有一名弟兄学会“重振士气”特长。仓库中还需留出放置新物品的空间。

91cad7d3d82e9bb70b52.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You were unsure at first about assigning %sergeantbrother% to this important task, for he was as committed to revelry and carousing as any other man. But %sergeantbrother% takes to his duties with a zeal that is at first admirable, and later worrying.

Scoffing at dawn as the rising hour of the cowardly and infirm, %sergeantbrother% decides that everyone must start the day much earlier.
