He runs the men through the usual sparring routines and checks their equipment for splits and wear, but to such light work he adds strict rules about setting up and breaking camp, formation drills, lessons on flanking, forced marches with stones in their packs, and a detailed punishment regime for anyone who dares fall behind.

Words such as 'back-breaking', 'cruel', 'flint-hearted' and 'merciless', as well as dozens of saltier epithets, ring in the air whenever %sergeantbrother% is safely out of earshot, though never when he is sleeping. For the brothers have learned that %sergeantbrotherfull% never truly sleeps.
91cad7d3d82e9bb70b52.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]起初，把这项重任交给%sergeantbrother%时，你心里还有些打鼓，毕竟他与别人一样，热衷喝酒作乐。可%sergeantbrother%对新职责表现出的热情，起先让人赞许，后来却渐渐令人担忧。

%sergeantbrother%嘲笑天亮才起床是懦夫和病秧子的习惯，决定让大家更早开始一天的操练。他照例带众人对练，检查装备有无裂损磨耗，但这些轻省活计之外，又加上严格的扎营与拔营规矩、队列训练、侧翼战术、往背包里塞石头的强行军，以及一整套专门惩罚掉队者的细则。

每逢%sergeantbrother%走远，确定听不见了，营地里便会响起“折磨人”“残暴”“铁石心肠”“毫不留情”之类的抱怨，还有几十种更难听的称呼。唯独他睡着时，没人敢这么说。因为弟兄们已经明白，%sergeantbrotherfull%从来就没有真正睡着过。

e76959bc6e4c3114e8ab.source: This will help us greatly in the days to come.
e76959bc6e4c3114e8ab.translation: 这会让我们今后的路好走许多。

840d1f918755f0a384e0.source:
Nothing commands respect as a trophy of a giant beast of the frozen wastes.
Let's go hunt and get the taxidermist some work!
840d1f918755f0a384e0.translation:
冰封荒原上巨兽的战利品，最能赢得旁人敬畏。
出发狩猎，给剥制匠找些活干！

211c3b6a6d92fd9a0018.source: Have at least 12 items crafted from beast trophies at the taxidermist. A taxidermist can be found in settlements mostly near woods and swamp, and can craft useful items from trophies dropped by beasts, such as the unusually large wolf pelts dropped by direwolves.
211c3b6a6d92fd9a0018.translation: 在剥制工坊用猎兽材料制作至少12件物品。剥制工坊多见于靠近森林或沼泽的聚落，能将野兽掉落的材料制成实用物品，例如恐狼那异乎寻常的巨大毛皮。

0ebab197e6c81af7ec86.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]A young boy hails you down and asks if you're the leader of the %companyname%. Eyeing the surrounding parts, you ask what it is to him. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Well, I mean nothing by it, sir. If I find and fetch him I get paid three gold coins. Thas all.%SPEECH_OFF%Intrigued, you ask who it is set to pay this reward. The boy is picking a booger and looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Whussat? Ah, I ain't seen the gold yet! Gotta find the man first!%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you pull the boys' hand aside, snot and all, and ask him again. The boy snorts, thinking, staring at the dirt, at the worms there. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%T'was a taxman. Not the gold fetching sort. He'd not pay me a coin, that man's a long-fingered devil so says my pa. I mean the animal taxman. Strips the beasts and fashions something fierce with them, coats, blankets, poisons, dranks. That taxman. Well, they all talkin' to one another. They says the %companyname%'s work makes for the best business in all the land and they all itching to meet them again!%SPEECH_OFF%Ah, he's speaking of the taxidermists. Smiling, you pat the boy on the head and wish him the best of luck in his hunt. He snorts and hocks a loogie.%SPEECH_ON%Luck ain't much all to do with this, I aim to find that man the learned way. Keepin' my eyes open and ears peeled and my britches high and tight.%SPEECH_OFF%
0ebab197e6c81af7ec86.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]一个小男孩喊住你，问你是不是%companyname%的团长。你扫视四周，问这跟他有什么关系。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%没别的意思，先生。找到人，再把他带过去，我就能拿三枚金币。就这回事。%SPEECH_OFF%你来了兴致，问是谁愿意付这笔赏钱。男孩正挖着鼻孔，抬头看你。%SPEECH_ON%啥？啊，金币我还没见着呢！得先找着人！%SPEECH_OFF%你叹口气，把他那只沾着鼻涕的手拉开，又问了一遍。男孩吸吸鼻子，盯着地上的泥土和虫子想了想，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%是个剥皮的。不是收钱那种。收钱那个才不会给我钱，我爹说他是专爱伸手的恶鬼。我说的是给野兽剥皮的，拿那些东西做些厉害玩意儿，衣裳、毯子、毒药、喝的。就是那种剥皮的。他们互相都在说，%companyname%带来的买卖全天下最好，个个都巴不得再见到他们！%SPEECH_OFF%啊，他说的是剥制匠。你笑着拍拍男孩的头，祝他找人顺利。他吸了吸鼻子，又吐出一口痰。%SPEECH_ON%这事儿可不光靠运气，我得用学来的法子。眼睛睁大，耳朵竖起，裤子提好，腰带勒紧。%SPEECH_OFF%

84fbe8438288afdfbb44.source:
There's lots of crowns to be made with trading between towns.
Let's earn us a fortune!
84fbe8438288afdfbb44.translation:
城镇之间的买卖大有赚头。
咱们也去发一笔财！

e2f192bfc86638c93dce.source: Buy and sell 25 items of trading goods, such as furs, salt or spices. Buying them in small villages that produce them and selling them in big cities will earn you the most coin. Some trading goods are also exclusive to certain regions, like the southern deserts, and selling them in other parts of the world can further increase your profit margin.
e2f192bfc86638c93dce.translation: 买入并卖出25件贸易品，例如毛皮、盐或香料。在出产这些货物的小村庄买入，再运往大城市出售，通常最赚钱。部分商品只在南方沙漠等特定地区出产，运往别处贩卖，还能赚取更高利润。

d3725e709a0d0fac8405.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]The thought bore down on you from the start, and it is one that escapes many a mercenary captain. A thought so simple that perhaps its very simplicity camouflages it from a sword wielding leader's ego. If the %companyname% is to be traveling from city to city looking for sellsword work, it may as already have one foot in another vocation altogether: that of trade. You picked up on it quick, realizing that goods carry a different sort of currency than which appears at face, a value hidden from the eye, and hidden in the ripples of time and location themselves. Now you spend evenings struggling to tabulate the crowns. For once, it's a good problem to have.
d3725e709a0d0fac8405.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]打从一开始，你就琢磨着一件事，而许多佣兵团长却从未想到过。道理实在太简单，或许正因如此，那些握剑为生的头领才拉不下面子去想：既然%companyname%总要辗转各城寻找雇佣活计，何不顺路做起另一门生意——贩货？你很快就摸出了门道。货物的价值并不全在标价上，它还藏在旁人看不见的地方，随着时日和地域悄然起落。如今，你每晚都得埋头算账，为那一枚枚克朗伤透脑筋。难得有一回，这烦恼倒是件好事。

2634b3927c5b0fd18e75.source:
I know the soles of your feet are itchy for the open road, and we need to spread
 word about the company. Let us pay visit to every settlement far and wide!
2634b3927c5b0fd18e75.translation:
我知道你们早就脚底发痒，想出去走走了，咱们也该打响战团的名声。
那就把天南地北的城镇都走个遍！

00ce0d5815ac05e73dcd.source: Visit every town and fortification in the world
00ce0d5815ac05e73dcd.translation: 走访世界上所有城镇与堡垒

57d69f184ffd320ca78c.source: Enter each village, city, fortification and castle there is in the world to learn about their goods and services, and spread word about the company.
57d69f184ffd320ca78c.translation: 走访世界上每一座村庄、城市、堡垒和城堡，了解当地的货物与设施，同时打响战团的名声。

facfebaceadadf78b11c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]You soon discover that the wanderlust of which the skalds sing is not as widespread as they say. Your decision for the band to broaden its horizons is met with grumbling about forced marches and nights on the road. But not all join in the lamenting.%SPEECH_ON%If a day's march or a night spent in the rain wears you down, how will you face an orc charge?%SPEECH_OFF%%sergeantbrother% asks the men, only to get a snappish reply.%SPEECH_ON%Dry and alert.%SPEECH_OFF%You cracked the whip though and forced them to it. At each village and town, you encouraged the men to make themselves known, and they take this request to heart, getting in brawls, passing out in the town square, threatening the merchants, and harassing the settlement's daughters. Whatever the poor tradesmen and farmers think of the company, at least they won't soon forget you! Having traveled to the edges of your map, the name '%companyname%' is more widely known, and you earned a better understanding of the land.
facfebaceadadf78b11c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]你很快就发现，吟游诗人歌咏的远游之志，远没有他们唱的那样深入人心。你决定带战团出去长长见识，换来的却是一片抱怨：赶路太急，露宿太苦。不过，也不是人人都跟着牢骚。%SPEECH_ON%走上一天路，或者淋一夜雨，就把你们折腾成这样，那兽人冲过来的时候，你们打算怎么应付？%SPEECH_OFF%%sergeantbrother%质问众人，立刻有人没好气地回嘴。%SPEECH_ON%先把衣服弄干，再打起精神应付。%SPEECH_OFF%你索性拿出团长的威严，赶着他们上路。每到一个村镇，你都鼓励弟兄们让当地人认识认识自己。他们倒真把这话听进去了：打架斗殴，醉倒在广场上，威吓商贩，纠缠姑娘。不管那些可怜的商人和农夫作何感想，至少短时间内，他们是忘不了你们了！如今，地图边缘的地方你们也走遍了，%companyname%的名号传得更远，你对这片土地也多了几分了解。

d917e2b5f0de3d228759.source: There's still some settlements left to visit.
d917e2b5f0de3d228759.translation: 还有一些城镇尚未走访。

a036569b801d85181c9a.source: You've done what you set out to do.
a036569b801d85181c9a.translation: 你已完成这次走访的目标。

4a9690bd9493bbe8aa2a.source:
A cart to carry our things is fine and all, but it won't do.
Let's save up 15,000 crowns and buy us a real wagon!
4a9690bd9493bbe8aa2a.translation:
用小货车拉行李虽说也凑合，可总这么下去不行。
咱们攒够15,000克朗，买辆像样的货车！

fa5a663962b51ff30417.source: Gather the amount of 15,000 crowns or more, so that you can afford to buy a wagon for additional inventory space. You can make money by completing contracts, looting camps and ruins, or trading.
fa5a663962b51ff30417.translation: 攒够至少15,000克朗，以便购置货车、扩充仓库。完成委托、劫掠营地与遗迹，或往来贸易，都能赚到钱。

058323148a00aa3ed296.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_158.png[/img]A wise man once told you that a wagon loses value the second it leaves the lot. The axiom dwells in the back of your head as you hand over 10,000 crowns for the wagon. But then you step up into the boxseat and jack your boot against the toeboard and feel right at home. You turn and take a look into the bed. There the wagonmaker installed a series of side-turned gates with iron spikes situated to hang trophies, pelts, and other goods. There is also a cage to hold a dog or a dog of a man if need be. A wooden toolbox with a heavy slaplatch carries all the means necessary to repair weapons and armor. Spare axles and wheels are held undercarriage.

Nodding, you turn back around and gander at the workhorse. The draught animal is a squat creature with muscled legs and an indifferent demeanor. It mindlessly crops the grass at its feet until you take up the jerkline and jockey it forward. The wagon trundles and tips and sags with nothing to suggest it was made to do anything you've beckoned it to do. And yet there it goes.

 %randombrother% walks by swigging a wine bottle. When he asks how's the ride you steal his bottle and smash it across the wagon's side and yell out 'rawhide!'
058323148a00aa3ed296.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_158.png[/img]有个聪明人曾告诉你，货车只要一驶出车行，就开始贬值。你交出10,000克朗时，这句话还在脑子里打转。不过，等你坐上车夫座，把靴子蹬在脚踏板上，心里立刻就舒坦了。你转身打量车厢。造车匠沿车厢两侧装了一排木架，上面的铁钉可以悬挂战利品、毛皮和其他货物。车里还有个笼子，既能关狗，必要时也能关些狗东西。带着沉重搭扣的木制工具箱里，修理武器和护甲的家伙一应俱全。备用车轴和车轮则固定在车底。

你满意地点点头，转回身去看那匹挽马。它个头敦实，四肢健壮，一副什么都不在乎的模样。它只顾低头啃草，直到你拉动缰绳，催它往前走。货车吱呀作响，左晃右歪，车身还往下沉，仿佛压根就不是为拉货造的。可它到底还是动起来了。

%randombrother%拎着酒瓶走过，一边走一边喝。他刚问这车坐着怎么样，你就抢过瓶子，在车帮上砸得粉碎，扯着嗓子大喊一声：“驾！”

dac9ec98fab5f6ad0ab9.source:
Imagine the trail of terror we could blaze if your skills matched your bravery.
We shall train five men to master their weapons so that they may act as a vanguard!
dac9ec98fab5f6ad0ab9.translation:
想想看，要是你们的本事配得上这份胆量，敌人该有多害怕。
咱们要练出五名精通武器的好手，让他们冲锋在前！

368d671f643a9a7d4cdc.source: Have men with a weapon mastery perk each
368d671f643a9a7d4cdc.translation: 让弟兄们学会武器精通特长

87a239d19f92c315304c.source: Have 5 of your men with a weapon mastery perk each, no matter which one.
87a239d19f92c315304c.translation: 让5名弟兄各自学会一项武器精通特长，武器种类不限。

39c946f38bf9ff2bbb82.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]Introducing a new regimen to train the brothers in mastering a weapon is good for everyone's morale. Those who do the training improve their prowess and chances of survival, and earn the admiration of their companions, while the others have something fun to watch while sitting on a log and stuffing their faces with mutton.

The trainees practice in every spare moment with a variety of weapons until hard arms have become like oaken branches, and sharp eyes grow as keen and unforgiving as those of a great cat.%SPEECH_ON%Not only is %weaponbrother% a fearsome threat to our enemies, but his swift footwork makes you think of dancing girls.%SPEECH_OFF%%notweaponbrother% remarks, only to be soundly chastised with a training sword by %weaponbrother%.
39c946f38bf9ff2bbb82.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]你为弟兄们定下新的训练规矩，让他们练熟手中的武器。这事对全团的士气都有好处：受训的人长了本事，多了几分活命的机会，还赢得了同伴的敬佩；其余人则能坐在圆木上，一边大嚼羊肉，一边看个热闹。

受训的弟兄一有空就操练各种兵器，原本结实的胳膊练得像橡木枝干，锐利的目光也变得像猛兽一般敏捷而冷酷。%SPEECH_ON%%weaponbrother%这家伙，杀起敌人来固然吓人，可那灵巧的小碎步，实在让人想起跳舞的姑娘。%SPEECH_OFF%%notweaponbrother%刚说完，就挨了%weaponbrother%一顿训练剑。

1211a4a4b8c8ad6e2615.source:
Let us set aside skirmishes for now and seek to defeat a group of at least a dozen
opponents. That is how our name will become known throughout the land!
1211a4a4b8c8ad6e2615.translation:
小打小闹先放一边，咱们要找一伙至少十二人的敌人，好好打上一仗。
这样才能让天下人都听说咱们的名号！

767e698164842601b6d8.source: Win a battle against 12 or more enemies
767e698164842601b6d8.translation: 赢得一场对阵至少12名敌人的战斗

d07889c68e48eec320e7.source: Win a battle against 12 or more enemies, whether by killing them or having them scatter and flee. You can do so as part of a contract or by fighting on your own terms.
d07889c68e48eec320e7.translation: 在一场战斗中击败至少12名敌人，将其杀死或逼得溃逃均可。可以通过委托迎战，也可以自行寻找对手。

52d395e9a6a25ba9da47.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]As all your enemies either lie dead or are in retreat, %bravest_brother% waves the company's banner in celebration.%SPEECH_ON%Once more the %companyname% fought, and once more the %companyname% prevailed!%SPEECH_OFF%Raucous cheers echo him all around. You soon discover that your recent battle is the talk of the local towns and villages. Whenever they stop at a tavern along the road, the brothers find that drinks are poured when the story of that battle is told, and the more the telling is embellished, the more freely the libations flow.
52d395e9a6a25ba9da47.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]敌人不是倒地毙命，就是落荒而逃。%bravest_brother%高举战旗，挥舞庆贺。%SPEECH_ON%%companyname%又打了一仗，%companyname%又赢了一仗！%SPEECH_OFF%四下响起震耳的欢呼。没过多久，你就发现，这场战斗已成了附近村镇的热门谈资。如今弟兄们沿路进酒馆歇脚，只要讲起那场仗，就有人请酒喝。故事添的油、加的醋越多，杯里的酒也就倒得越勤。

d12e8b1bdd0b4fab64c8.source: Who dares stand against us now?
d12e8b1bdd0b4fab64c8.translation: 如今，还有谁敢挡我们的路？

0a9fdc75eef68ad65a68.source: You gain additional renown for your victory
0a9fdc75eef68ad65a68.translation: 这场胜利为你赢得额外声望

bbfb569d1c8c2dc59be7.source:
We achieved some renown, but now you can see real fame on the horizon.
Let us defeat a formidable force of two dozen opponents in battle!
bbfb569d1c8c2dc59be7.translation:
咱们已经小有名气，但真正扬名立万的机会就在眼前。
去击败一支至少二十四人的强敌！

2d344b3f626e1f305bd7.source: Win a battle against 24 or more enemies
2d344b3f626e1f305bd7.translation: 赢得一场对阵至少24名敌人的战斗

5001d5b9ac71b46daec9.source: Win a battle against 24 or more enemies, whether by killing them or having them scatter and flee. You can do so as part of a contract or by fighting on your own terms.
5001d5b9ac71b46daec9.translation: 在一场战斗中击败至少24名敌人，将其杀死或逼得溃逃均可。可以通过委托迎战，也可以自行寻找对手。

06faf7aa28e28dc1f5e7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]After the fight, %lowesthp_brother% sits gazing at his feet, looking completely knackered, as do the others. %SPEECH_ON%That was the battle I was born to fight! Now if I die, it will be alongside the bravest and deadliest bunch of men I've ever known, and I'm proud to call them my brothers!%SPEECH_OFF%This is met with a chorus of weary assent all round.%SPEECH_ON%Peasants talk of sweat, blood and tears but the men of the %companyname% have walked through fire and prevailed!%SPEECH_OFF%Three times the men shout the company name, tired but victorious.

In the days to come you find that wherever civilized people gather, they point you out and whisper, whether in fear or admiration you do not know. Everywhere you go, word of your mighty victory has traveled the land before you.
06faf7aa28e28dc1f5e7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]战斗结束后，%lowesthp_brother%坐在那里盯着自己的双脚，累得几乎脱了形。其他人也好不到哪去。%SPEECH_ON%老子生来就是为了打这样的仗！往后就算死，也要跟这群最勇敢、最要命的好汉死在一块。我能管你们叫一声弟兄，这辈子值了！%SPEECH_OFF%四周响起一片疲惫的应和声。%SPEECH_ON%农夫们总把血汗和眼泪挂在嘴边，可%companyname%的弟兄，是从火海里杀出来的！%SPEECH_OFF%众人连喊三遍战团的名号，声音虽倦，却满是胜利的豪气。

此后数日，无论走到哪个有人烟的地方，总有人朝你指指点点，低声议论。那是畏惧还是钦佩，你也说不清。你只知道，不管你们走到哪里，那场大捷的消息总已先一步传到。

708d15e2a7985ab75ac0.source:
Let us seek fame and fortune fighting before crowds that chant our names.
We'll draw blood in the arenas of the south!
708d15e2a7985ab75ac0.translation:
让咱们在高呼自己名字的人群面前厮杀，赢来名声和财富。
南方的竞技场，该见见咱们的刀了！

efb869996bf9dacd4548.source: Enter and win 5 fights in the arena of the southern city states.
efb869996bf9dacd4548.translation: 在南方城邦的竞技场中赢下5场比赛。

990fa3b33c716920ff0a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]Having dispatched all manner of creatures that walk on two legs or more, and sometimes perhaps none at all, you've come to collect a fair bit of renown for your gladiatorial prowess. Southerners speak your name as though itself were the carrier of good news, vicariously relishing in your victories and hoping to see you win more. It is an odd spin of fate, as most attend the arenas to see gladiators find as grisly a demise as possible. To have the masses cheer for you is a strange realization indeed, though you just realize that when it is you in that light, your very presence filling the stands and bannisters, that there is still an ugly end the crowd seeks: that of your opponent. And, frankly, for that much coin you've no problem satiating the audience's bloodlust.
990fa3b33c716920ff0a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]两条腿的、更多条腿的，有时连腿都没有的，你们在场上都收拾过了。靠着这身角斗本事，你已挣下不小的名声。南方人说起你的名字，仿佛那名字本身就带着喜讯。他们把你的胜利当成自己的荣耀，又盼着看你再赢一场。这命运倒也古怪，毕竟大多数人来看角斗，图的就是看角斗士死得有多惨。如今满场观众为你喝彩，反倒让人有些不习惯。可转念一想，当你站在万众瞩目之下，当那些看台和栏杆边都挤满了冲你而来的人，他们盼望的惨死仍然没变——只不过，轮到了你的对手。说实在的，既然钱给得这么足，满足一下观众的嗜血欲望，你倒也乐意。

6387c056887185793e20.source: I still hear them chanting our names!
6387c056887185793e20.translation: 他们高喊咱们名字的声音，我到现在还听得见！

0f4d83c9c27c5d09bc2f.source:
No single Oathtaker can face all the evils of the world alone.
Let us take an Oath of Camaraderie, lest we lose sight of our true allies!
0f4d83c9c27c5d09bc2f.translation:
任何立誓者都无法独自对抗世间的一切邪恶。
让我们立下袍泽之誓，牢记谁才是真正的战友！

d63875558ca53d4b7e19.source: Young Anselm believed that, on occasion, it was right to bring as many to a battle as one could muster, even if the great throngs did threaten the chain of command. Indeed, "All men deserve to stand by their brothers."
d63875558ca53d4b7e19.translation: 小安塞尔姆认为，有时就该尽可能多地召集人手参战，即使人多势众会妨碍指挥也无妨。正如他所言：“每个人都有资格与自己的弟兄并肩而战。”

7965dd6a09c88c4ce066.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{Power in numbers, camaraderie in brotherhood. While fielding additional men encumbered your ability to command, over the course of every battle the %companyname% quickly realized that the chaos of combat could be overcome by standing shoulder to shoulder with the man beside you, trusting him to do his job and him trusting that you do yours. The experience has hardened the company to the havocs of war.

Now that the company knows it can confront its enemies by trusting its own members, it is ready to take on another Oath!}
7965dd6a09c88c4ce066.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{人多力量大，同袍情谊深。增加出战人数虽让指挥变得吃力，%companyname%却在一场场战斗中迅速明白：只要与身边的弟兄并肩而立，彼此相信对方会尽好本分，便能战胜战场上的混乱。这番历练让战团更能经受战争的摧残。

如今，弟兄们已经懂得凭借彼此间的信任迎战敌人，是时候立下新的誓言了！}

ee78e316cc24b76e6e41.source: {For Young Anselm! | As Oathtakers! | And death to the Oathbringers!}
ee78e316cc24b76e6e41.translation: {为了小安塞尔姆！ | 以立誓者之名！ | 让誓言使者去死吧！}

bae5fd843a91539fc4e6.source: Your men always start battle randomly at Wavering or Breaking morale.
bae5fd843a91539fc4e6.translation: 战斗开始时，弟兄们的士气随机处于“动摇”或“濒临崩溃”状态。

5ec24fde00a53a711946.source: You gain extra Renown if your men become confident in battle enough times (
5ec24fde00a53a711946.translation: 弟兄们在战斗中进入“斗志昂扬”状态的次数达到要求后，可获得额外声望 (

77a6f58cb9a683422a20.source:
Truly distinguished are those who can follow Young Anselm's teachings.
Let us take an Oath of Distinction and prove ourselves worthy to walk in his path!
77a6f58cb9a683422a20.translation:
真正卓越之人，必能践行小安塞尔姆的教诲。
让我们立下卓越之誓，证明自己无愧于追随他的足迹！

097aa950715784f8819a.source: Young Anselm frequently pursued solitude, sometimes even on the battlefield. "Prove yourself worthy in such a manner that not even the old gods may claim their eyes have erred in what glories they have seen."
097aa950715784f8819a.translation: 小安塞尔姆时常独来独往，就连战场上也不例外。“以无可辩驳的功绩证明自身的价值，让旧神也无法否认亲眼见证的荣耀。”

3b944bb42dfc7cda7f1c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{Many swordmasters practice solitude. The thought is that they are not fighting the men in front of them, they are fighting for the spaces in between. While you cannot possibly understand the small nuances which differentiate a swordmaster from a would be sellsword hacking at air, you realize the kernel of truth in the axiom. Oathtakers, though honorable and diligent, are still at heart brutally courageous and absurdly overconfident. The Oath of Distinction followed the swordmaster's art in spirit, and the Oathtaker's in mind. Standing out on their own, each man sought to prove himself to his own accord and prove himself worthy of others' praise. And if any unbiased laity happened to be watching, then it'd be damn impossible to say the %companyname% did not distinguish itself as a fine outfit.

But distinction be damned. We can't be glory hogging for all our days! Onto the next Oath!}
3b944bb42dfc7cda7f1c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{许多剑术大师习惯独自作战。他们认为，交锋并非与眼前的敌手较量，而是在争夺彼此之间的空隙。你未必能参透剑术大师与挥剑劈空气的佣兵新手究竟差在哪里，却也听得出这话有几分道理。立誓者虽重荣誉、肯下苦功，骨子里却仍旧勇猛得近乎蛮横，自信得近乎荒唐。卓越之誓以剑术大师的技艺为精神，以立誓者的信念为准则。每个人都独当一面，想凭自己的本事证明价值，赢得旁人的赞许。要是有哪个不偏不倚的外行在场，他也绝不可能否认：%companyname%确实是一支出类拔萃的队伍。

不过，卓越也好，荣耀也罢，哪能一辈子都只顾着出风头！该立下新的誓言了！}

d7e13e6b592fdf4c8fc0.source: ]+3[/color] Fatigue Recovery per turn, and deal [color=

11ef4db10641ad7d6b0e.source: ]+10%[/color] damage if there are no allies on adjacent tiles.
11ef4db10641ad7d6b0e.translation: ]+10%[/color]伤害。以上加成仅在相邻地格没有友军时生效。

1ee1be19c0fbe02a9869.source: Your men gain no experience for allied kills.
1ee1be19c0fbe02a9869.translation: 弟兄们无法从友军的击杀中分得经验。

260bdf9868cf3ed23a2c.source: You gain extra Renown if one of your men levels up
260bdf9868cf3ed23a2c.translation: 若有一名弟兄累计升级达到以下次数，便可获得额外声望：

6a72c73709d403097e50.source:
Beasts have always threatened civilization.
Let us take an Oath of Dominion and stake our claim against the tides of nature!
6a72c73709d403097e50.translation:
野兽始终威胁着文明。
让我们立下统御之誓，在自然的狂潮面前捍卫人类的地位！

9bfb0bd4cd4bc586324e.source: "We are from the beasts, but the beasts wish to have us back. Distance oneself from nature's primitiveness, prove your worth over Her such that your humanity be held in the grip of your own hands and seen through thine own eyes." - Young Anselm
9bfb0bd4cd4bc586324e.translation: “我们出身于野兽，野兽却妄图让我们重归其列。远离自然的蒙昧，证明自身胜过它，让你亲手掌握、亲眼见证自己身为人的价值。”——小安塞尔姆

5e98643a00fcff4b0885.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]There is no more common a menace in this world than that of the common beast. And yet, despite this rampant disease of creatures, very few men are willing to take up arms and go seeking their vanquishment. It is only you all, the %companyname%, who swore an oath to slay the monsters, and slay them you did. With steady hands and stilled hearts, you kept to that Oath.

Triumphant over beasts and monsters, the men are ready to take on whatever's next!
5e98643a00fcff4b0885.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]世间最常见的威胁，莫过于野兽。可即使这些生灵如灾祸般肆虐，也很少有人愿意拿起武器，主动去将它们剿灭。唯有你们，%companyname%，发誓要诛杀怪物，也确实做到了。双手稳如磐石，内心波澜不惊，你们恪守了自己的誓言。

战胜野兽与怪物之后，无论接下来是什么挑战，弟兄们都已准备就绪！

a4c8559e338539a8a08e.translation: 弟兄们获得以下属性修正：[color=

e11dab40e97b80dc5630.source: ]+10[/color] Melee and Ranged Skill when fighting beasts.
e11dab40e97b80dc5630.translation: ]+10[/color]近战命中与远程命中（与野兽作战时）。

ec21070f740d89f0a45b.source: ]-5[/color] Melee and Ranged Skill when fighting any other foe.
ec21070f740d89f0a45b.translation: ]-5[/color]近战命中与远程命中（与其他敌人作战时）。

9c17d0627d4797189d83.source: You gain extra Renown for slaying beasts (
9c17d0627d4797189d83.translation: 击杀野兽可获得额外声望 (

f1c141b78608dcc9ab45.source:
To uphold Young Anselm's Oaths is to take on a duty without end.
Let us take an Oath of Endurance and prepare ourselves for the tasks to come!
f1c141b78608dcc9ab45.translation:
践行小安塞尔姆的誓言，就是肩负永无止境的责任。
让我们立下忍耐之誓，为前路的重任做好准备！

2118299cfc6541d8af74.source: "Thrice times thrice to climb, endurance they did find." It is said that when Young Anselm ascended the highest peak of the Higgarian mountain range, he took nine of his worthiest followers with him.
2118299cfc6541d8af74.translation: “三三九人登高处，千磨百炼识忍耐。”据说，小安塞尔姆攀上 Higgarian mountain range 的最高峰时，身边带着九位最值得信赖的追随者。

47bf5fd5b056355208ed.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{When asked what army he would wish to see deployed before him, a famous general remarked: 'one that does not need to breathe.' No matter how skilled a man is, if he does not have the energy to fight, then all his abilities are reduced to nothing but wheezes of air, and in such a state even a swordmaster may find himself only as dangerous as a dram wench. A good breath taken now is a well-placed sword swing later. The %companyname% has followed that axiom to its fullest!

Now that the company has filled its lungs of proper fire, it is ready to accept another Oath!}
47bf5fd5b056355208ed.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{有人问一位名将，最想统率怎样的军队，他答道：“一支不需要喘气的军队。”任凭本领多高，一旦没了力气，满身武艺也只剩下呼哧带喘；落到这般境地，剑术大师恐怕也不比酒馆里的侍女更有威胁。此刻把气喘匀，稍后才能挥出精准的一剑。%companyname%将这个道理践行到了极致！

如今，战团已是气息充沛、胸中如有烈火，是时候接受新的誓言了！}

0f00c21830cd9a893fd9.source: You can only take up to [color=

10c22c52be1bf4b5b608.source: You gain extra Renown for winning many battles (
10c22c52be1bf4b5b608.translation: 赢得足够多场战斗后，可获得额外声望 (

dcaeae35958b3a59fddc.source:
Evil-doers skulk and hide away from the walls of the just.
Let us take an Oath of Fortification and bring those walls to them!
dcaeae35958b3a59fddc.translation:
恶徒畏惧正义的高墙，躲藏在它庇护不到的地方。
让我们立下坚守之誓，将这道高墙推到他们面前！

ba10fd7f522e206f4201.source: "Trust your shields as you would put faith in the old gods, for the contribution of the trees and the earth shall not be wasted on the nervous hinge of a coward's arm." - Young Anselm
ba10fd7f522e206f4201.translation: “信任你的盾牌，如同信奉旧神。树木与大地献出的恩赐，不该白白耗在懦夫颤抖的臂弯里。”——小安塞尔姆

190ddcda0c19d79c9afb.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{Texts of the Ancient Empire tell of military formations so tightly knit and compact that they were like roving castles on legs: hundreds of shields held together like the scales of a snake or the shell of a tortoise. The %companyname% tried its best to replicate these theories. It always took a few moments to piece the elements together, but you never intended for it to be an exercise in excellence. The ancients had an empire for a reason, and you're a company of misfits and Oathtakers. But by your estimation, which mostly starts and ends on whether or not the company still has a pulse, this oath was an outstanding success.

Now it is time to lower the shields and the Ancient Empire-fervor and take on a new Oath!}
190ddcda0c19d79c9afb.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{古代帝国的文献记载着一种严密紧凑的军阵：数百面盾牌如蛇鳞龟甲般交叠相连，整支队伍便如一座长了腿的移动城堡。%companyname%尽力照着这些理论操练。每次把阵形摆好，总要费上一番工夫，不过你也没指望人人都能练成精锐。古人能建立帝国自有其本事，而你麾下不过是一群怪人和立誓者。可按你的标准——说到底，就是看战团还有没有一口气——这次誓言算得上大获成功。

现在，该放下盾牌，也放下对古代帝国的这股狂热，去立下新的誓言了！}

ed7ba90298a2ad65567c.translation: 弟兄们的疲劳消耗降低[color=

07606bbadc25478cb5ec.source: ]25%[/color] less Fatigue when using shield skills. The 'Shield Wall' skill now grants an additional [color=
07606bbadc25478cb5ec.translation: ]25%[/color]（使用盾牌技能时）。“盾墙”额外提供[color=

3e0aa0d49335782994d4.source: ]+5[/color] Ranged Defense. The 'Knock Back' skill now staggers targets on hit.
3e0aa0d49335782994d4.translation: ]+5[/color]远程防御。“击退”命中后还会使目标踉跄。

4e24fb786b4f5dbe5120.source: Your men cannot move in the first round of combat.
4e24fb786b4f5dbe5120.translation: 弟兄们在战斗的第一回合无法移动。

7a7d057da31c5bd2a777.source: You gain extra Renown if none of your men fall in battle during the Oath (
7a7d057da31c5bd2a777.translation: 誓言期间若无弟兄在战斗中倒下，便可获得额外声望 (目前有

04bd56f7927ae29897a1.source:
As warriors, we must never lose sight of true honor.
Let us take an Oath of Honor and meet our opponents in melee!
04bd56f7927ae29897a1.translation:
身为战士，我们绝不能忘记何为真正的荣誉。
让我们立下荣誉之誓，与敌人短兵相接！

ae8f0a45d082b26dcdd5.source: "While the arrow is nocked, the mind turns. While the sword swings, all is where it should be. Set aside the craft of archery and go unto the melee, trusting that what your steel seeks, it shall find." - Young Anselm
ae8f0a45d082b26dcdd5.translation: “搭箭之时，心思仍在游移；挥剑之际，一切已各得其所。放下弓箭，投身近战，相信你的钢刃终会找到它的目标。”——小安塞尔姆

c09053ffb0233f75d4c0.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]No matter what the bow users wish to say, when it comes down to it there is no greater honor than meeting a man face to face, each of you with sword in hand, locking eyes between crossed steel, in this clash finding a brief respite before one finds their demise. Even in the tournaments, the grand event is not some ridiculous affair like shooting apples off heads or birds out of the sky. No, it is the joust! Martial combat! The greatest honor in battle undertaken by the greatest company in the %companyname%.

Now that the company is of sturdy might and main, it is ready to accept its next Oath!
c09053ffb0233f75d4c0.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]任凭那些使弓的怎么说，世间都没有比迎面而战更大的荣耀：两人各执刀剑，隔着相交的钢刃四目相对，在其中一人命丧当场之前，享受交锋间那片刻的凝滞。即便是在比武大会上，压轴大戏也不是射掉人头顶上的苹果，或把天上的鸟儿射下来这种可笑把戏。是马上对决！是刀兵相见！唯有最伟大的战团——%companyname%，才配得上战斗中至高的荣耀。

如今，战团已身强胆壮，准备好接受下一道誓言了！

4e82e8275666ac7c4068.source: Your men start battle at Confident morale.
4e82e8275666ac7c4068.translation: 战斗开始时，弟兄们的士气处于“斗志昂扬”状态。

fae51283542e0cb2027b.source: Your men cannot use ranged weapons.
fae51283542e0cb2027b.translation: 弟兄们无法使用远程武器。

5c72c23f5cf03660e571.source: You gain extra Renown for defeating enemies without them being engaged by other combatants (
5c72c23f5cf03660e571.translation: 独自击败未与其他战士交战的敌人，可获得额外声望 (

93dfda01c64f93035b00.source:
Arrogance is an insidious killer.
Let us take an Oath of Humility and reflect on our shortcomings for a time.
93dfda01c64f93035b00.translation:
傲慢是个阴险的杀手。
让我们立下谦卑之誓，暂且静心反省自身的不足。

ffd9be3a8e282dd8a00c.source: "As you are indeed men in pursuit of power, always listen to the weak...for the weak know the strong better than you do, and in turn they shall know you better than you know yourself." - Young Anselm
ffd9be3a8e282dd8a00c.translation: “既然追求力量，就务必聆听弱者……因为他们比你更了解强者，也终将比你更了解你自己。”——小安塞尔姆

99721ad59f62c90723e9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]Any weak man can kneel, but to do so from a position of strength is true humility. While the %companyname% could have sought to wield its fame to make new fortunes, it instead stood aside, dedicating portions of its wealth to the needy and back to the communities who were offering these contracts in the first place. Many of the men have learned well from this experience and there is some hope that the methods deployed will be of use going forward, whether in this life or the next.

The %companyname% are ready to take on their next challenge.
99721ad59f62c90723e9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]弱者屈膝并不难，身处强势却甘愿俯首，才是真正的谦卑。%companyname%本可凭借名声攫取更多财富，却选择退让一步，将部分财物留给有需要的人，回馈那些最初向你们提供委托的地方。不少弟兄都从中受益良多。无论今生还是来世，但愿这番处世之道还能派上用场。

%companyname%已经准备好迎接下一个挑战。

035a2d12b4be48d7c1fb.source: You gain extra Renown for completing enough contracts (
035a2d12b4be48d7c1fb.translation: 完成足够多份委托后，可获得额外声望 (

e0deb688fdf33f9bcd71.source:
Few aberrations are as repugnant as the undead.
Let us take an Oath of Righteousness and strike down these mockeries of life!
e0deb688fdf33f9bcd71.translation:
世间鲜有比亡灵更令人憎恶的怪物。
让我们立下正义之誓，消灭这些亵渎生命的存在！

8cad3006cc5813dc6fee.source: "Beware the evil which has stolen into this realm. Set aside the worldly matters and dedicate oneself to putting our dead to rest once and for all. No man deserves to walk twice across this darkened land." - Young Anselm
8cad3006cc5813dc6fee.translation: “警惕潜入此世的邪恶。放下俗务，让逝者得享永恒的安息。谁都不该被迫在这片黑暗的大地上走上两遭。”——小安塞尔姆

d55899e4852523c98000.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]When you walk the earth, one can't help but wonder who came before, and who or what comes after. So the sight of the dead walking again is such a disturbing answer to this inquiry that most would rather run from it than seek confirmation, and in that confirmation: confrontation. But it is these godless cretins which the %companyname% sought, taking an oath to vanquish them wherever found. It was a righteous affair requiring great mettle and stupendous courage, and upon completion there's little doubt that the men of the %companyname% have been spurred with a sense of accomplishment that few who walk this earth, dead or alive, shall ever feel.

With veins aflame with righteousness, the %companyname% is ready to take on its next Oath!
d55899e4852523c98000.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]行走于世，人总难免追问：前人曾走过怎样的路，身后又会迎来什么？于是，死者重新行走便成了一个令人毛骨悚然的答案。多数人宁可转身逃跑，也不愿查个究竟，更不愿面对真相。可%companyname%偏要寻找这些无神庇佑的孽障，发誓无论在哪里遇见，都将其彻底消灭。这桩正义之举需要极大的胆魄与勇气。誓言践行之后，%companyname%的弟兄们无疑满怀成就感；世上无论活人还是死人，都少有谁能体会这般滋味。

正义之火在血脉中燃烧，%companyname%已准备好立下新的誓言！

fabfafdf8a198991361b.source: ]+5[/color] Melee and Ranged Defense when fighting the undead.
fabfafdf8a198991361b.translation: ]+5[/color]近战防御与远程防御（与亡灵作战时）。

63e716f6230d091a8823.source: ]-5[/color] Melee and Ranged Defense when fighting any other foe.
63e716f6230d091a8823.translation: ]-5[/color]近战防御与远程防御（与其他敌人作战时）。

d6d7c03e6d503742c77e.source: You gain extra Renown for slaying the undead (
d6d7c03e6d503742c77e.translation: 击杀亡灵可获得额外声望 (

f7170cf67d1399c7341b.source:
We cannot live up to Young Anselm's example if we obsess over worldly matters.
Let us take an Oath of Sacrifice and hone our purpose to its sharpest point.
f7170cf67d1399c7341b.translation:
若一味执着于世俗之事，我们便无从追随小安塞尔姆的榜样。
让我们立下牺牲之誓，将自己的信念磨砺到极致。

5b6cc7eb631221961320.source: "If all is within the realm of the old gods' gifts, then pain itself shall be their bitterest fruit. But an offering it is, nonetheless, and so our battle against pain is one of great selfishness. Abscise from the healer's mend, and equally so from the merchant's lend." - Young Anselm
5b6cc7eb631221961320.translation: “倘若万物皆是旧神的馈赠，痛苦便是其中最苦涩的果实。可它终究仍是恩赐，抗拒痛苦便成了莫大的自私。拒绝医者的疗治，也拒绝商人的借贷。”——小安塞尔姆

afe54dbcce39b415cb35.source: None of your men take any crowns as wage.
afe54dbcce39b415cb35.translation: 所有弟兄都不再领取薪酬。

ad8c37a2f57ce9cf602d.source: Your men do not heal injuries.
ad8c37a2f57ce9cf602d.translation: 弟兄们的伤势不会愈合。

323ee8e19b8736eec317.source: You gain extra Renown for suffering no more than
323ee8e19b8736eec317.translation: 若战团新增伤势不超过

5cfd0b09274a69009e2f.translation: 处战伤，便可获得额外声望 (目前累计

cc5e859c2e1c12098ac3.source:
We must have the courage to face down any challenge, no matter how daunting.
Let us take an Oath of Valor and prove our bravery to all!
cc5e859c2e1c12098ac3.translation:
无论挑战多么可怕，我们都必须有勇气正面迎战。
让我们立下勇武之誓，向所有人证明自己的胆魄！

9cbd953fca762c82a350.source: "Remember in times of peril that courage can overcome skill. While little can be learned through bravery alone, sheer determination shall keep you alive and that is well enough as any conclusion to the lessons of battle." - Young Anselm
9cbd953fca762c82a350.translation: “危急时刻，须记住勇气足以胜过技艺。单凭勇敢虽学不到多少本事，坚定的意志却能让你活下来；作为战场上的一课，这已足够。”——小安塞尔姆

704a96f1ed90afbf0da2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{A man cannot thrive merely on skill and capability. Many know how to swing a sword, heft an axe, or loose an arrow. It is not in martial matters where man is molded, but within himself, within the corridors of his own heart. The steel forged there can't ever be defeated, for even a felled man of valor shall find himself eternal in the tomes of this world, celebrated in awe, and his name carried on the lips of those like him.

Now that the company has proven itself of the firmest element, it is ready to accept another Oath!}
704a96f1ed90afbf0da2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{人不能单凭技艺和本领立足于世。会挥剑、抡斧、射箭的人多得是。真正造就一个人的，并非武艺，而是他自己的内心。在心中锻出的钢铁永不会被击败：即使勇者倒下，也将永存于世间的史册，受后人敬仰传颂，让同道中人将他的名字铭记于口。

如今，战团已经证明了自身的坚韧，准备好接受新的誓言了！}

b340b58c77b7bfc87bc9.source: Your men will never flee while in battle.
b340b58c77b7bfc87bc9.translation: 弟兄们在战斗中绝不会溃逃。

0008ae3f5e4098c57d45.source: You gain extra Renown for winning battles where you are outnumbered (
0008ae3f5e4098c57d45.translation: 在敌众我寡的战斗中获胜，可获得额外声望 (

5b14124920bffb5737a5.source:
For too long have greenskins plagued our lands.
Let us take an Oath of Vengeance and strike back at this menace!
5b14124920bffb5737a5.translation:
绿皮在我们的土地上为祸已久。
让我们立下复仇之誓，向这些祸害还以颜色！

a48c066c0314065fa7c3.source: Young Anselm's family was killed by orcs during the Battle of Many Names. When he himself faced greenskins, it is said he seemed an unstoppable warrior and his followers seek to emulate this vengeful surge of martial prowess.
a48c066c0314065fa7c3.translation: 小安塞尔姆的家人在众名之战中死于兽人之手。据说，他每逢与绿皮交战，便如战神般势不可挡。追随者们也想效法他，让复仇之火激发自身的武勇。

8294d784d8d51174c8d5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]Greenskins have long plagued the land of man. Despite their everlasting threat, very few would ever take up an oath to destroy the creatures. They are a plague precisely because they are so dangerous, and because they are so dangerous most would rather look the other way than dare confront the beasts. However, the men of the %companyname% decided to take an oath against the orcs and goblins alike, and venture far to find them and hunt them down. Having followed through, a sense of accomplishment washes over the company.

The men are already chomping at the bit: which Oath should be undertaken next?
8294d784d8d51174c8d5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]绿皮长久以来都在人类的土地上肆虐。尽管威胁始终存在，却少有人愿意发誓将它们消灭。它们之所以成为灾祸，正因其凶险；也正因其凶险，多数人宁可视而不见，也不敢正面迎战。然而，%companyname%的弟兄们向兽人和地精一并立下讨伐之誓，深入远方，寻踪猎杀。如今誓言既成，成就与自豪洋溢在战团上下。

弟兄们已经跃跃欲试：接下来，该立下哪一道誓言？

72a63b986f4ffb03355d.source: ]+5[/color] Melee and Ranged Defense when fighting orcs or goblins.
72a63b986f4ffb03355d.translation: ]+5[/color]近战防御与远程防御（与兽人或地精作战时）。

5ba79af31b4d9660fced.source: You gain extra Renown for slaying greenskins (
5ba79af31b4d9660fced.translation: 击杀绿皮可获得额外声望 (

bcdfaadb0f37fef3c2f9.source:
There is no error in battle more fatal than meekness.
Let us take an Oath of Wrath and show our foes what it truly means to be lain low!
bcdfaadb0f37fef3c2f9.translation:
战场上，没有比怯懦更致命的过错。
让我们立下怒火之誓，让敌人见识什么叫彻底击溃！

1f789df9c566231c1bd4.source: Young Anselm wrote many manuals on martial fighting, the most popular of which implore the use of two-handed weaponry and the absconsion of battle tact. Dried blood mottles the pages of these texts.
1f789df9c566231c1bd4.translation: 小安塞尔姆写过许多武艺手册，其中最广为流传的几部力倡使用双手武器，抛却作战时的谨小慎微。这些书页上，斑斑血迹早已干涸。

f9aea5c2d422ab156a14.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]When it comes to mortal combat, there's only one way to be sure: total annihilation. And the weapon of choice in this death dealing endeavor is that of the two-hander. The men of the %companyname% took to the Oath of Wrath like moths to a fiery half-completed blacksmith's iron, when it retches from the coals red hot and blazing, the smithy standing over it as some mad executioner, hammer in hand, ready to flatten its glowing edges into a finished product of ultimate killing, and he turns it up and realizes the chunk of metal is too large for an ordinary man, but big enough to cleave someone in two if put in the proper hands. And so the %companyname% disregarded defense and welcomed bloodletting with open arms.

Bloodslaked and with satiated wrath, the %companyname% is ready to take its next Oath!
f9aea5c2d422ab156a14.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]生死相搏，只有彻底歼灭敌人才能万无一失。而要完成这等杀伐，首选便是双手武器。%companyname%的弟兄们投身怒火之誓，恰如飞蛾扑向铁匠炉中尚未成形的炽红铁坯：它从煤火里被拖出来，红得发亮；铁匠手执重锤，像个疯狂的刽子手俯身其上，要将灼热的边缘锤成一件杀人的利器。待他将成品举起，才发现这块铁对普通人而言实在太大，可若落在合适的人手里，又足以把敌人劈成两半。于是，%companyname%抛开防守，张开双臂拥抱鲜血。

鲜血已饮足，怒火已宣泄，%companyname%准备好立下新的誓言了！

3c0a239c9a352adbcf1b.source: ]+15%[/color] chance to hit when using two-handed or double-gripped melee weapons, and their attacks will always cause fatalities if able.
3c0a239c9a352adbcf1b.translation: ]+15%[/color]命中几率（使用双手近战武器或双手握持单手近战武器时）；击杀敌人时，只要武器允许，必定造成斩首、碎颅等毁尸效果。

d9f70a6e67cd3c542cd5.source: You gain extra Renown for slaying your foes (
d9f70a6e67cd3c542cd5.translation: 击杀敌人可获得额外声望 (
