94e472ab0f5a92cf76ae.source: The house of %noblehousename% revolves around a religious cult that teaches compassion towards their own but turned them zealous and unforgiving towards their foes. Generations ago, a large orc invasion pillaged and destroyed most of what belonged to the family, and it never fully recovered. Since then, the house started many a crusade and punitive expedition deep into orc lands but never managed to drive the greenskins off for good.
94e472ab0f5a92cf76ae.translation: %noblehousename%家族以某个教派为核心，信奉对自己人施以慈悲，对敌人却狂热而绝不宽恕。数代之前，一场大规模兽人入侵洗劫并摧毁了家族的大部分产业，他们至今未能完全恢复。从那以后，这个家族多次发动圣战和征讨，深入兽人领地，却始终无法彻底驱逐绿皮。

4f3f34830194b1f15b09.source: While we have breath we hope

d6f7a62fb912f5923159.source: We scorn to change or to fear

08263a408113b47f726f.source: The house of %noblehousename% holds high the principles of justice and honor, and without irrational rulings their region has prospered. Their reputation may be peaceful, but %noblehousename% knights are battle-hardened and their troops will ferociously fight anyone threatening their realm, subordinates or principles. Many nobles envy their wealth and ridicule their principles; house %othernoblehouse% especially holds a more or less overt grudge against those of %noblehousename%.
08263a408113b47f726f.translation: %noblehousename%家族奉正义与荣誉为准则，治下少有苛政，领地因而繁荣。尽管素有和平之名，%noblehousename%的骑士却都久经沙场；凡有人威胁他们的领土、臣属或信念，其军队必将奋勇迎敌。许多贵族既嫉妒他们的财富，又嘲笑他们的原则，尤其是%othernoblehouse%家族，对%noblehousename%家族的敌意几乎毫不掩饰。

99d4a2947f898642117a.source: This hand is hostile to tyrants

fdd8ec8be3fbd2e0b9aa.source: Wealth is sought by many, but the highly reputable traders of house %noblehousename% are the best when it comes to striking profitable bargains. Bound by ancestral ties to the renown of their forefathers they uphold honesty and integrity as their family values.
fdd8ec8be3fbd2e0b9aa.translation: 追逐财富的人很多，但论起谈成赚钱的买卖，声誉卓著的%noblehousename%家族商人堪称翘楚。他们珍视先祖留下的名声，恪守诚实与正直，将其奉为世代相传的家训。

3e8c3514506974bbac34.source: Reason is the guide of life

fe211c753e7a510f2b1e.source: Firmly in act and gently in manner

2de2770e180f2c7769d6.source: Let us be viewed by our actions

7020f68f56e21fd72770.source: The noble house of %noblehousename% is a proud and unrelenting family with a long and bloodstained history of conquest. Seated in their fortress of %factionfortressname%, they take with arms what they consider theirs by right. An ancestral feud with house %othernoblehouse% provides never ending reasons to keep both hate in the hearts and ore smelters burning.
7020f68f56e21fd72770.translation: %noblehousename%家族骄傲而强硬，漫长的家史写满了血腥征服。他们以%factionfortressname%要塞为根基，凡认定理应归己的东西，就用武力夺取。与%othernoblehouse%家族世代相传的仇怨，让心中的恨火和冶炼炉中的烈焰都永不熄灭。

15d1468b102c2d61dc8b.source: He stands by his own powers

83a61a9c5fd8475412bc.source: Under this sign thou shalt conquer

a9ebf5847d9a6d47b368.source: He dies not whose fame survives

cb29493863981a1ee99f.source: Such is the way to immortality

d944b2ed6d552cbaf678.source: And we also have hurled our javelins

c061a7aba58bf50b6ee5.source: Disdained for their ruthlessness, brutality and greed, house %noblehousename% has little interaction with other noble families. Their captains and soldiers are known for raiding trade caravans, outlying farms and small settlements from their fortress of %factionfortressname%. A life is not worth much in the realm of house %noblehousename% and many a mercenary on the look for a quick coin only found a quick end here.
c061a7aba58bf50b6ee5.translation: %noblehousename%家族以残忍、暴虐和贪婪招致鄙夷，鲜少与其他贵族家族往来。他们的军官和士兵以%factionfortressname%为据点，肆意劫掠商队、偏远农庄和小型聚居地。在%noblehousename%家族的领地，人命不值钱。许多想来捞笔快钱的佣兵，到头来只落得个横死的下场。

00e0e827db7c075ba9a0.source: We trample it under our feet

f38939af4d73ee113a26.source: Sons of hounds come here and get flesh

23c4fb8ecca0c12f79f9.source: House %noblehousename% is hated by many but feared by even more. A number of small and big uprisings have been put down with fire and sword and the %noblehousename% henchmen are known to have eyes in every shady corner and ears in every wall. The family's ancestral home of %factionfortressname% is swarming with armed guards, sniffing wardogs and bulky mercenaries to protect their paranoid leaders.
23c4fb8ecca0c12f79f9.translation: 许多人憎恨%noblehousename%家族，但畏惧他们的人更多。一次次大小起义被烈火与刀剑镇压，%noblehousename%的爪牙似乎在每个阴暗角落都安有眼线，每堵墙后都藏着耳目。家族祖居%factionfortressname%遍布武装卫兵、四处嗅探的战犬和魁梧的佣兵，守护着那些疑心重重的统治者。

e7bdb815672d51f55519.source: Learn to endure what must be borne

1e0135ee56a65000602e.source: The wrath of the lion is noble

e9564c1071ee28763860.source: The house of %noblehousename% is well known for its lavish lifestyle and bacchanal festivities. The price has to be paid by someone, so half-starved cattle, empty granaries and desperate townsfolk are a common sight where house %noblehousename% rules. Although other noble houses may look down on such brutality and depletion they are at the same time desperately awaiting their invitation to the next feast.
e9564c1071ee28763860.translation: %noblehousename%家族以奢华生活和纵情宴饮闻名。总得有人为这一切埋单，因此在%noblehousename%家族的领地，半饥半饱的牲畜、空荡荡的粮仓和绝望的百姓随处可见。其他贵族家族虽鄙夷他们如此残酷地榨干民力，却又个个翘首盼着下一场宴会的请帖。

031ccea3b4388bc9e70f.source: Trading and haggling can be just as fierce as fighting a war, and the house of %noblehousename% is a true master of cunning bargains. Rumor has it that many a profitable deal made by house %noblehousename% is not only based on honest trading but also bribery, extortion and deception. The family resides in the pompous region capitol of %factionfortressname%, but despite their unmeasurable riches they are known to be notoriously close-fisted.
031ccea3b4388bc9e70f.translation: 贸易与讨价还价的激烈程度不亚于战争，而%noblehousename%家族深谙其中的机巧。传闻%noblehousename%家族许多获利丰厚的交易，靠的不仅是正当买卖，还有贿赂、勒索和欺诈。这个家族住在本地区富丽堂皇的首府%factionfortressname%，虽富得难以计数，却也吝啬得远近闻名。

c525b907ee93c0d83893.source: To live without a wish concealed

592e71a48ed74f440781.source: Separate the honest from the useful

f0b0583a212aa4f28baf.source: House %noblehousename% claims to have roots in the time when man first claimed this land, and the first king ruled all men. They are but one of many noble houses now, but proud of their long history and with ambitions to continue writing history. As their renown and their resources dwindle in the now, they are said to finance expeditions in an attempt to unearth long lost treasures from the past, in sunken cities and places long forgotten.
f0b0583a212aa4f28baf.translation: %noblehousename%家族宣称，他们的血脉可以追溯到人类初次占据这片土地、第一位国王统治众人的年代。如今，他们只是众多贵族家族之一，却仍以悠久的历史为傲，渴望继续书写辉煌。随着声名与财力日渐衰退，据说他们开始资助探险队，前往沉没的城市和久遭遗忘的地方，寻找失落于岁月中的宝藏。

17bf8a87f0f0df5120b9.source: He lives twice who lives well

0f1cb6b533b2f519dbd2.source: Wealth to him who knows how to use it

d09537573488555e9775.source: Most members of the house of %noblehousename% live secluded behind thick doors and barred windows and some of them have not been seen for years. Rumor has it that their noble blood is plagued with madness and insanity but no ordinary man dares to utter such claims in fear of their vengeance. Other noble houses mainly avoid contact to house %noblehousename% as guests may be greeted with open arms as well as crossbow bolts.
d09537573488555e9775.translation: %noblehousename%家族的大多数成员隐居在厚重的门扉和铁栅窗后，有些人已多年不曾露面。传闻他们的贵族血脉遭到疯癫侵蚀，但普通人畏惧报复，无人敢公开谈论。其他贵族家族大多也回避与%noblehousename%家族来往：上门的客人可能迎来热情的拥抱，也可能迎来一支弩箭。

0879d799dc1611ac0319.source: A wealthy and independent city state focused mostly on trade and acquiring further wealth.
0879d799dc1611ac0319.translation: 一座富裕而独立的城邦，以贸易为本，致力于积累更多财富。

53063f576bb47a5c4876.source: He lives well who lives peacefully

94a1cf83a601981c9026.source: A city state dedicated to acquiring knowledge above all - even if it comes at the cost of doing autopsies, reading forbidden tomes or engaging with sinister powers not of this world.
94a1cf83a601981c9026.translation: 这座城邦将求知置于一切之上。无论是解剖尸体、翻阅禁书，还是与异界的邪恶力量打交道，只要能换来知识，他们都在所不惜。

ff89456dc84425e37d3f.source: A city state ruled by a ruthless council that is out to achieve power by all means. Many an untimely death is rumored to have been an assassination ordered by the viziers of %citystatename%.
ff89456dc84425e37d3f.translation: 这座城邦由一个冷酷的议会统治，为攫取权力不择手段。许多人的突然死亡，都被传是%citystatename%的维齐尔下令暗杀所致。

2d0c469ad7023f0263eb.source: The men cheer your name as they drink.
2d0c469ad7023f0263eb.translation: 弟兄们边喝酒，边高喊你的名字。

fffd4b298eabecdedbc2.source: The men drink to fallen comrades.
fffd4b298eabecdedbc2.translation: 弟兄们举杯悼念阵亡的同伴。

e25902a81a529f359145.source: The men cheer the company name as they drink.
e25902a81a529f359145.translation: 弟兄们边喝酒，边高喊战团的名字。

9cd63da1889ce48f381c.source: The men drink to women and their bosoms.
9cd63da1889ce48f381c.translation: 弟兄们举杯，敬女人和她们的胸脯。

693a8a49bb57ab561ea9.source: The men drink to the loyal wardogs.
693a8a49bb57ab561ea9.translation: 弟兄们举杯敬那些忠诚的战犬。

c018074153625f716a66.source: Laughter and light-hearted stories fills the tavern as your men drink.
c018074153625f716a66.translation: 弟兄们喝着酒，讲些轻松的故事，酒馆里充满了欢笑。

c1dab7225f069f592d64.source: Hard mercenary life takes a rest as the men share stories of their past lives and enjoy themselves.
c1dab7225f069f592d64.translation: 弟兄们说起各自的往事，谈笑取乐，佣兵生涯的艰辛也暂时被抛到了脑后。

80e7dd76400ae87ca448.source: 'Huzzah to the commander!', the men shout.
80e7dd76400ae87ca448.translation: 弟兄们齐声高喊：“团长万岁！”

204aba2f481f0b7d012b.source: Your men boast with their accomplishments as they drink.
204aba2f481f0b7d012b.translation: 弟兄们喝着酒，吹嘘起自己的丰功伟绩。

dee06b144fb6225c46c9.source: The strong drinks blur the horrors of combat for a while.
dee06b144fb6225c46c9.translation: 烈酒暂时冲淡了战场的恐怖记忆。

f65b2a0f83b5d515612f.source: Your men cheer and toast to riches and a long life.
f65b2a0f83b5d515612f.translation: 弟兄们欢呼举杯，祝愿财源广进、长命百岁。

a7ba259044fbf3b98d6d.source: The beer makes the hardships of the day disappear.
a7ba259044fbf3b98d6d.translation: 几杯啤酒下肚，一天的辛劳便烟消云散。

3c96e327fc0530503ace.source: The patrons shout your name as they clink their cups. The drink loosens their tongues.
3c96e327fc0530503ace.translation: 酒客们高喊你的名字，举杯相碰。酒一下肚，话也多了起来。

414b12add068979010db.source: People raise their mugs in appreciation.
414b12add068979010db.translation: 众人举起酒杯，向你致谢。

9f01ef883a9ee33fd9e3.translation: 众人低声议论，纷纷表示赞同。

048b0452183f2db88f33.source: The innkeeper rings a bell to let everyone know the next round is on you.
048b0452183f2db88f33.translation: 酒馆老板摇响铃铛，宣布下一轮酒由你请客。

5b1d8252f1182b1815dc.source: There's a place called %location% %terrain% to the %direction% of here. Most people know about it, I think, but few would venture there.
5b1d8252f1182b1815dc.translation: 这里%direction%的%terrain%有个叫%location%的地方。我想大多数人都知道，可没几个敢去。

3951e3ec34fedb0dda29.source: %randomname% told me 'bout %location% the other day. Full of treasure he said, %distance% %direction% of here. Or maybe I'm remembering it wrong.
3951e3ec34fedb0dda29.translation: 前几天%randomname%跟我提起过%location%，说那儿满地都是财宝，就在这里的%direction%，离这儿%distance%。也可能是我记岔了。

bbd143e4ade03c2e266b.source: If it's adventure you seek, there's a place called %location% %terrain% %direction% of here. Don't know who lives there nowadays, though.
bbd143e4ade03c2e266b.translation: 想冒险的话，这里%direction%的%terrain%有个叫%location%的地方。不过，如今住着什么人，我可不知道。

865bb93fcb66a427d8c2.source: Heard of %location%? People say it's haunted, the dead walking and all. Somewhere %direction% of here. Maybe someone else in %townname% can tell you more...
865bb93fcb66a427d8c2.translation: 听过%location%吗？人们说那里闹鬼，死人到处走。就在这里%direction%的某个地方。也许%townname%的其他人知道得更清楚……

54cb3799e3674c5d4495.source: You know of... gosh, what was it called again? To the %direction% %distance% from here, %terrain%. Can't for the life of me remember what we used to call it...
54cb3799e3674c5d4495.translation: 你知道那个……哎呀，叫什么来着？就在%direction%，离这儿%distance%，%terrain%那里。真是想破脑袋也记不起我们以前怎么叫它了……

5f7db8822c9447037e49.source: Came across %location% on your way here? Why, it's %terrain% to the %direction%. Someone should hire you to burn that thing to the ground. Nothing good's coming from there, that's for sure.
5f7db8822c9447037e49.translation: 你来的路上经过%location%没有？就在%direction%的%terrain%。真该有人雇你把那鬼地方烧成灰，那里头肯定出不了好东西。

5c503f1b247c8472d7e2.source: We spotted something on our way here, hidden way off the road, %terrain% %distance% %direction% of %townname%. Don't know what the locals call it, or if they even know about it, but it might be worth it going back there.
5c503f1b247c8472d7e2.translation: 我们来的路上看见了个地方，离大路很远，藏在%townname%的%direction%、%distance%外的%terrain%。不知道当地人叫它什么，甚至不知道他们知不知道那里。不过，回去看看也许值得。

fd64e84a9f76597eefdf.source: I've heard the council of %settlement% is looking to hire mercenaries. Don't know what for.
fd64e84a9f76597eefdf.translation: 听说%settlement%的议会想雇佣兵，做什么就不知道了。

654db4f2f940dd114e06.source: A group of young lads left for %settlement% some days ago. They're looking to hire armed men over there, willing to pay real good. I just hope they make it back alive.
654db4f2f940dd114e06.translation: 几个小伙子前些天去了%settlement%。那边正招武装人手，出手很阔绰。我只盼他们能活着回来。

62bfb69fab2b65304b3e.source: If you lot is looking for work, I've heard that they're hiring sellswords over at %settlement%.
62bfb69fab2b65304b3e.translation: 你们要找活干的话，听说%settlement%正在雇佣兵。

071c5b1c58ae0e01b5b5.source: You heard that they're looking to hire fighting men at %settlement%?
071c5b1c58ae0e01b5b5.translation: 听说了吗？%settlement%正在招会打仗的人。

447edc3c6828bf8ed435.source: Some guy from %settlement% was here just the other day, wanted to hire strong lads for some problem they have over there. Don't think many went with him, though.
447edc3c6828bf8ed435.translation: 前几天有个%settlement%的人来过，想雇些壮小伙，替他们解决那边的麻烦。不过，跟他走的人好像不多。

0a62cfcd35b9ce5c94c1.source: Mercenaries, eh? We got a few of those these days. Just some days ago a bunch that called themselves %randommercenarycompany% travelled through. On their way to %settlement%, they said, good coin to be made there.
0a62cfcd35b9ce5c94c1.translation: 佣兵，是吧？这阵子见过不少。就在前几天，一伙自称%randommercenarycompany%的人路过，说要去%settlement%，那边有大钱可挣。

af90326e1ae6acf29434.source: If it's work you're looking for, they're taking crowns in hand over at %settlement% to hire strong men.
af90326e1ae6acf29434.translation: 你要找活干，就去%settlement%。那边正掏克朗雇壮丁呢。

47eadc186613fda8ec4b.source: Heard that some fancy fat merchant or so from %settlement% is looking to hire armed guards the other day. Well, I ain't going to die for him, no thanks. Have me my house and wife right here.
47eadc186613fda8ec4b.translation: 前几天听说，%settlement%有个肥头大耳、穿金戴银的商人想雇护卫。我可不想替他送命，免了吧。我老婆和房子都在这儿呢。

7b29dfe67d3be9701ec2.source: If you're looking to fetch a good price for your trading goods, my friend, you should go to one of the large cities or castles and not some run-down poor village at world's ass.
7b29dfe67d3be9701ec2.translation: 朋友，想把货卖个好价钱，就去大城或城堡，别往穷得叮当响、偏到天边的破村子钻。

2001b2b7fb36dd182c21.source: The drinks over in %randomtown% are way better than the cat piss they serve here!
2001b2b7fb36dd182c21.translation: %randomtown%的酒，可比这里卖的猫尿强多了！

12c93ba8f65a2fdb9c49.source: A trader came by this morning, claims he saw dead people shuffling through the hills nearby. Won't buy that humbug, that's for sure!
12c93ba8f65a2fdb9c49.translation: 今天早上来了个商人，非说看见死人在附近山丘上拖着腿乱晃。谁信那种鬼话！

4f772a339a694ad6f678.source: There is many a place out there, long lost and forgotten, that holds great riches.
4f772a339a694ad6f678.translation: 外头有不少早已失落、被人遗忘的地方，埋着大笔财富。

6b964e1d81f84ba25f3b.source: If you're ever visiting the tavern in %randomtown% make sure to try their roasted goat - you'll never eat that good elsewhere!
6b964e1d81f84ba25f3b.translation: 以后要是去%randomtown%的酒馆，一定尝尝他们的烤山羊，别处可吃不到那么好的！

c710b9125f0e5227e9f3.source: Mercenaries aren't very popular around these parts. They kill, plunder and pillage like common brigands, so don't expect to be greeted with cheers and flowers.
c710b9125f0e5227e9f3.translation: 佣兵在这一带可不招人待见。杀人、抢劫、掠夺，跟普通匪徒没两样，所以别指望有人捧着鲜花、欢呼着迎接你们。

8b0325ee189cf136edd4.source: If you're in need of supplies, head over to old %randomname% on the market here in %townname%. Tell him I send you!
8b0325ee189cf136edd4.translation: 缺补给的话，就去%townname%这里的集市找老%randomname%。告诉他是我介绍的！

6b5721500d52b5f35a14.source: Tomorrow night the famous minstrel %randomname% {the Songbird | the Bard | the Storyteller | the Nightingale | the Poet} is coming to this very tavern, you better not miss it!
6b5721500d52b5f35a14.translation: 明晚，著名的游吟艺人%randomname%{“歌鸟” | “吟游诗人” | “说书人” | “夜莺” | “诗人”}就要来这间酒馆，你可别错过！

5a996eff15a662af3c17.source: Don't trust the barber's potions! A friend of my cousin's friend's uncle drank one and it turned him into a toad, I swear!
5a996eff15a662af3c17.translation: 别信理发师那些药水！我表亲的朋友的叔叔，有个朋友喝了一瓶，结果变成了癞蛤蟆。我发誓！

2379e3ac103d046861a0.source: So I heard of a free company by the name of %randommercenarycompany% and it's said they collect the ears of their enemies and wear them 'round their necks!
2379e3ac103d046861a0.translation: 我听说有支自由佣兵团叫%randommercenarycompany%，他们会割下敌人的耳朵，串起来挂在脖子上！

cf48aae893427538eb65.source: Don't drink the water in %randomtown%, let me tell you. It'll give you the runs in no time!
cf48aae893427538eb65.translation: 听我的，别喝%randomtown%的水，保准叫你拉个没完！

14127fcfef7fbb192100.source: My cousin %randomname% left town with a mercenary company like yours, %randommercenarycompany% or something like that it was called. Haven't heard from him since...
14127fcfef7fbb192100.translation: 我表亲%randomname%跟着一支像你们这样的战团离开了镇子，好像叫%randommercenarycompany%，还是别的什么。从那以后就没了音信……

56f7dea2ba2da32867db.source: From one sellsword to another: If you value your reputation as a mercenary, you'd better not double-cross your employers. Some will go to great lengths to hunt you down, tell ill of you and make you pay.
56f7dea2ba2da32867db.translation: 都是吃刀口饭的，我劝你一句：要是还在乎自己的名声，就别坑雇主。有些人会不惜代价追杀你，四处败坏你的名声，非让你付出代价不可。

66f07a4df0c278db3e8a.source: The noble houses act like an old couple; constant quarreling and wrangling. And who suffers most from those feuds? Not the high lords up in their castle towers, no, it's us simple folk, of course!
66f07a4df0c278db3e8a.translation: 贵族家族就像一对老夫妻，成天吵吵闹闹、争个没完。可这些争斗最苦的是谁？绝不是住在高高城堡里的老爷们，当然是我们这些小百姓！

98febeda0aa97c807b77.source: I'd stay clear of swamps and marshes. There's ghastly diseases there just waiting to latch onto you.
98febeda0aa97c807b77.translation: 要我就离沼泽湿地远远的。那地方有的是可怕的怪病，专等着缠上你。

92589dc912eb379cdd24.source: I've heard they have a mage on the council of %randomtown%, a real wizard. Not sure if I believe that.
92589dc912eb379cdd24.translation: 听说%randomtown%的议会里坐着个法师，真会法术的那种。我也拿不准该不该信。

931eaf44575bdd3c3ee1.source: I love women! The way they look, the way they talk. Don't know what I'd do in a world without 'em...
931eaf44575bdd3c3ee1.translation: 我喜欢女人！喜欢她们的模样，喜欢她们说话的样子。真不知道这世上要是没了女人，我该怎么办……

ba984746e1164880ad0d.source: It's you and the %companyname%! Remember me from %randomtown%? We talked about... well, I don't really remember, but here we are! Let's drink! How have you been faring?
ba984746e1164880ad0d.translation: 是你，还有%companyname%！记得我吗？我们在%randomtown%见过，聊过……唉，我也记不清了。反正又碰上了，喝一杯！近来怎么样？

e48b4163b13070752121.source: Death is a part of life. The sooner you accept it, the more you can cherish your stay in this world.
e48b4163b13070752121.translation: 死亡也是人生的一部分。越早接受这一点，就越能珍惜留在世上的时光。

994cf7eb0f44b2c55d50.source: One of my teeth fell out just the other day, see? I think the others are so loose, they're about to follow. Can you feel it? Go on, touch. They're loose, right?
994cf7eb0f44b2c55d50.translation: 前几天我掉了颗牙，看见没？剩下的好像也松了，眼看就要跟着掉。你摸摸？来，碰一下。松得很，对吧？

6c5ebd4a8b5f7f32d79f.source: Gods, I need to take a piss. Will you watch that beer for me?
6c5ebd4a8b5f7f32d79f.translation: 诸神啊，憋死我了，得去撒泡尿。帮我看着这杯酒？

7e0da6306dc6c91820cd.source: Always be sceptical towards the nobility, my friend. You never know what their real agenda might be.
7e0da6306dc6c91820cd.translation: 朋友，跟贵族打交道，永远得留个心眼。你不知道他们心里究竟打着什么算盘。

2638acff6526ec588a8f.source: Ever considered putting down your sword and settling down? Mercenaries tend to have rather short lives.
2638acff6526ec588a8f.translation: 想过放下剑，找个地方安家吗？当雇佣兵的，往往都活不长。

2e84637c26b33b9c2b09.source: They found the farm of old %randomname% burned to the ground the other day. That whole family was hanging from a nearby oak...
2e84637c26b33b9c2b09.translation: 前几天有人发现，老%randomname%的农场烧成了灰。他全家都吊在旁边的一棵橡树上……

6946b848692a4ed2cf86.source: Since some brigands burned down my old man's farm I switched the pitchfork for the beer mug. I hope they get what they deserve some day.
6946b848692a4ed2cf86.translation: 自从那帮土匪烧了我爹的农场，我就把草叉换成了酒杯。但愿他们迟早遭报应。

ee7caeb6aa4cc4fd2533.source: Our militia is in a pitiful state, rusty pikes and worm-eaten shields everywhere. I wish the council would take crowns in hand and buy the poor sods some real weapons.
ee7caeb6aa4cc4fd2533.translation: 咱们的民兵太寒碜了，满眼都是锈矛和被虫蛀烂的盾。真希望议会肯掏点克朗，给那帮可怜虫买几件像样的武器。

8876941bb82651494977.source: We don't need sellswords like you here! You're nothing but trouble. Our militia can take care of us. Always has, always will.
8876941bb82651494977.translation: 我们这里不需要你们这种佣兵！除了惹麻烦，你们还能干什么？民兵会保护我们，从前是，以后也是。

730989e8285cf699ed90.source: The miller's daughter went missing last night. They found her and she is well, but she's not willing to talk about it.
730989e8285cf699ed90.translation: 磨坊主的女儿昨晚失踪了。人倒是找回来了，也没受伤，可她什么都不肯说。

32414f3b70fdf47d3608.source: Farkin' %randomname% and his farkin' dog. Rug of flea's barking day and night, rain or sunshine. Can't take it much longer, I really can't...
32414f3b70fdf47d3608.translation: 该死的%randomname%，还有他那条该死的狗！那团跳蚤窝，不分白天黑夜、刮风下雨，叫个没完。我快受不了了，真受不了了……

fe67894d9fa54f7e72c8.source: I heard some tombstones in the old graveyard have been toppled over. But no one in their right mind would go there anyways.
fe67894d9fa54f7e72c8.translation: 听说旧墓地里有几块墓碑倒了。不过但凡脑子正常，谁会去那儿呢。

06c533f4939daadb5683.source: Bought me this scramasax the other day from a travelling merchant. Real bargain, he said. A man's got to protect himself and his family, see.
06c533f4939daadb5683.translation: 前几天从一个行商手里买了这把单刃短刀。他说我捡了大便宜。男人嘛，总得能护住自己和家人，你说是不是？

f21e81a67d40ab710f16.source: I don't trust the militia here. One time, as a band of outlaws approached, they turned tail and ran for the hills without giving any fight!
f21e81a67d40ab710f16.translation: 我信不过这里的民兵。有一回一伙匪徒靠近，他们连打都没打，掉头就往山里跑了！

28b6fb2e4e1cabc8fbb0.source: We had a murder here. Some bastard from %randomtown% put a knife into the back of one of the merchants. He'll see the noose on Sunday, you should come watch!
28b6fb2e4e1cabc8fbb0.translation: 我们这儿出了桩命案。一个从%randomtown%来的混账，往商人背后捅了一刀。星期天就绞死他，你也来看看吧！

ca34256e6fb42143b3d6.source: They burned %randomfemalename% at the stake last week, some witchhunter did. Just appeared one day, accused her of sorcery and whatnot and had her burned. The council didn't object and that man just left soon after. Wish I knew who he was, really. Good thing he saved us from that witch, I suppose...
ca34256e6fb42143b3d6.translation: 上礼拜，有个猎巫人把%randomfemalename%绑在柱子上烧死了。他突然冒出来，指控她施巫术什么的，然后就点了火。议会没反对，他也很快走了。真希望能知道他到底是谁。唉，算是多亏他替我们除掉了女巫吧……

04057d0b2dddb00632a1.source: Ever fought an orc? It's said they're twice as tall and thrice as strong as a man, and that they can split us clean in half with a single strike!
04057d0b2dddb00632a1.translation: 跟兽人打过吗？听说它们有两个人那么高，三个人那么大力气，一下就能把人劈成两半！

70b33d14db2d72578b34.source: Picking up desperate farmers and fishers for your company is all good and well, but you should look for recruits in a castle like this one. Here you'll find people who actually know which end of the sword goes where.
70b33d14db2d72578b34.translation: 收留些走投无路的农夫和渔民进战团，当然也不错。不过你该在这样的城堡里招人，这里的人至少真知道该把剑的哪一头朝向敌人。

d73efe51ad8c1a603779.source: A sturdy shield is a real life-saver, let me tell you. Wouldn't have a man fight without one.
d73efe51ad8c1a603779.translation: 听我一句，结实的盾牌真能救命。没有盾，我可不敢让谁上阵。

dd0f1faf8ba248cf69e0.source: The garrison commander fought in the Battle of Many Names. Claims large orcs just shrug off hits to the head with a waraxe, he does. Don't know what to make of this.
dd0f1faf8ba248cf69e0.translation: 驻军指挥官参加过众名之战。他说有些大兽人，脑袋挨了战斧都跟没事一样。听了这话，我都不知道该怎么想。

e0dc4d482bd4b06eba94.source: There're things out there way more scary than some group of brigands. You'll see what I mean soon enough if you head out beyond the borderlands.
e0dc4d482bd4b06eba94.translation: 外头有些东西，可比一群土匪吓人多了。你只要越过边境往外走，很快就明白我的意思了。

610102c3f90af91b296a.source: I always rely on my axe to smash the enemy's shield. Even the tallest man will fall quickly once he can not defend himself any more.
610102c3f90af91b296a.translation: 我向来靠这把斧头砸烂敌人的盾。没了防护，再高大的汉子也撑不了多久。

70312a97310e18140a04.source: If I learned one thing during my soldiering years, it's that the high ground wins battles. Trust me on this one.
70312a97310e18140a04.translation: 当了那些年兵，我至少明白一个道理：占住高地，就能赢下战斗。信我这句话。

bf34f2a08f115e013fce.source: I once was a mercenary like you but then I took an arrow to the knee.
bf34f2a08f115e013fce.translation: 我从前也跟你一样是个佣兵，直到膝盖中了一箭。

c68fcd76073f827e77b7.source: I've seen %randomnoble% at a tourney recently. Damn, what a sight, that man. The way he jousts, I mean. Took the prize and all the ladies loved him.
c68fcd76073f827e77b7.translation: 最近在比武大会上见到了%randomnoble%。真他娘的漂亮！我是说他骑枪比武的架势。他拿了头奖，在场的女士们个个都迷上了他。

736f4c2735e17ee0557d.source: I'm old now, but I still remember my first battle. Pissed my pants even before the first arrow flew. Ha!
736f4c2735e17ee0557d.translation: 我老了，可第一回打仗的事还记得清清楚楚。头一支箭还没飞来，我就尿裤子了。哈！

5cd2f033baadf05201d4.source: Been to %randomtown% not long ago and they told me about wolves as large as a man, with teeth as long as the fingers on my hand. Really don't want to meet one of those.
5cd2f033baadf05201d4.translation: 不久前我去过%randomtown%，当地人说有种狼跟人一样大，牙齿有我的手指那么长。我可不想碰见。

9619132201b5f9a8f722.source: You know that orcs make their armor out of what they strip from those who fall against them? Honest, I'm not making this up. They wear it as trophies or something. If you ever meet one of them large orcs, you'll see. They look like it's a knight or two wrapped around them.
9619132201b5f9a8f722.translation: 知道吗？兽人会扒下战败者身上的装备，拼成自己的护甲。真的，我可没瞎编。好像是把那些当战利品穿在身上。你要见到那种大兽人就明白了，看着简直像把一两个骑士裹在了身上。

3790ce5273d752a4778d.source: 1st %townname% Company. Best lot of halfwits and scallywags I've ever served with. Wouldn't trade 'em for the world.
3790ce5273d752a4778d.translation: %townname%第1连。我这辈子一起当过兵的，就数那帮傻子和混账最够意思。拿全世界来换，我也不换。

1287d648fea964e2c31d.source: I miss my wife and my two daughters. Been stationed at %townname% for too long already, but a man's got to put food on the table somehow.
1287d648fea964e2c31d.translation: 我想老婆，也想我那两个女儿。在%townname%驻扎得太久了，可一家人的饭，总得有人挣啊。

c413f77a692abd42c023.source: We'll head out again soon to patrol the roads. Sometimes I feel everything would go down the shitter if it weren't for us keeping order 'round here.
c413f77a692abd42c023.translation: 我们很快又要出发巡路了。有时候真觉得，要不是我们在这里维持秩序，什么都得烂成一摊屎。

74bb2a820e027adbac28.source: Farkin' patrol duty. Barely got back 'ere, blisters on me feet still from all the marchin' and we're about to 'ead out again. Just put us on 'orses, I say!
74bb2a820e027adbac28.translation: 去他娘的巡逻！这才刚回来，脚上行军磨的泡还没消呢，又得往外走了。要我说，就该给我们配马！

28ecb7faa42dc3b10338.source: Got wounded bad some months back in a skirmish 'gainst goblins. Couldn't feel me legs anymore, but the lads carried me all the way back to %townname%. Gods bless 'em.
28ecb7faa42dc3b10338.translation: 几个月前跟地精打了一仗，我伤得很重，两条腿都没知觉了。是弟兄们一路把我抬回%townname%的。愿诸神保佑他们。

6030356c85d1fd16baec.source: You'll know greenskin territory from the idols they erect out of skulls and bones. Of human skulls and bones.
6030356c85d1fd16baec.translation: 看见那些用头骨和骨头竖起来的神像，就知道到了绿皮的地盘。是人的头骨，人的骨头。

3f36a3724fb583a1faa6.source: Fourteen. That's how many men I've killed. Women I count extra, three so far. What about you?
3f36a3724fb583a1faa6.translation: 十四个。我杀过这么多男人。女人另算，到现在三个。你呢？

c5f1405fe88f7ba964b9.source: I usually stand guard on the gate tower. To be honest, spitting down on some travellers is the only fun I get all day.
c5f1405fe88f7ba964b9.translation: 我平常在城门楼上站岗。说实话，朝底下过路的人吐口唾沫，就是我一天里唯一的乐子。

4cc12e24a055f9b29d17.source: The mood amongst the garrison is pretty bad. They say that pay's been delayed a few times already and everyone's starting to lose patience.
4cc12e24a055f9b29d17.translation: 驻军里怨气很重。听说已经拖欠了好几回军饷，大家都快没耐性了。

268ec2a47abea939d329.source: When I was moved to %townname% I never imagined life here to be so dull and hard. But still better than working the fields until your back snaps, I suppose...
268ec2a47abea939d329.translation: 当初调到%townname%时，我从没想过这里的日子这么无聊、这么苦。不过，总比在地里干到折了腰强吧……

409be24b5a62554f8167.source: I prefer fighting with my flail. Hard to defend against and it don't matter if they carry a shield, I'll just swing around it and make pulp of their head!
409be24b5a62554f8167.translation: 我打仗就爱用连枷，难防得很。拿盾也没用，我绕过去一甩，就能把他的脑袋砸成烂泥！

26698bcd7308f61428c0.source: Damn nigh impossible to find a reliable shield 'round here, bloody things keep breaking in two. Been keeping a spare on me back now just incase. I should charge more for fighting men with axes, ha!
26698bcd7308f61428c0.translation: 这附近就找不到一面靠谱的盾，动不动就裂成两半。我现在背上都得多背一面，以防万一。跟拿斧头的家伙打仗，我真该多收钱，哈！

15b6d04c5e17a41f40e9.source: One day I'll be standard bearer of the company. It's only the bravest of us all and they've been with the company for years and years, y'know, but it's the greatest honor for a man with common blood. I've seen even a knight once shake the hand of ours.
15b6d04c5e17a41f40e9.translation: 总有一天，我要当上队里的掌旗手。那位置只留给最勇敢、资历最老的人，你知道吧？可对咱们这种平民来说，那是天大的荣耀。我还亲眼见过一个骑士，跟咱们的掌旗手握手呢。

6134e6d91340ec85675a.source: I've trained militia before, and let me tell you, spears are the best weapons for when the men don't know what they're doing yet. Cheap and easy to hit with. Put a few men together for a spearwall and it's hard to even get close to them without a spear in your belly.
6134e6d91340ec85675a.translation: 我带过民兵，听我的：对那些还不知道该怎么打仗的人来说，矛最好。便宜，也容易戳中。几个人并排摆起矛墙，谁想靠近，肚子上多半都得挨一矛。

9af5860e79ad19f483cb.source: Ever fought goblins? Nastly little buggers, don't be fooled by their size. I'd take large kite shields to protect the men from their arrows. And a pack of wardogs to run them down as they scatter, if you can afford it.
9af5860e79ad19f483cb.translation: 跟地精打过吗？那群小混账阴着呢，别让它们的个头骗了。我会带上大鸢盾，替弟兄们挡箭。钱够的话，再养一群战犬，等它们四散逃跑时放狗去追。

637155fa426aa38c9bf7.source: The other day my pickaxe broke while I was hammering away. Piece of it clipped my cheek. Not much and I'd be missing an eye!
637155fa426aa38c9bf7.translation: 前几天正挖着矿，镐头突然断了，一块碎片擦着我的脸飞过去。再偏一点，我就瞎一只眼了！

f57802d5dbdd0877a579.source: The mines are a real deathtrap, we're losing men every week. Even venturing with you might be better for longevity, ha!
f57802d5dbdd0877a579.translation: 矿井就是个吃人的坑，每个礼拜都有人死。没准跟你出去闯荡，还能活得久点，哈！

06a8d14990c31487aa33.source: Working the mines has its merits, too, you know. We never get wet from the rain, it's just the dust that kills you eventually.
06a8d14990c31487aa33.translation: 下矿也有好处，你知道吗？至少从不挨雨淋，到头来不过是让粉尘要了命。

87fc6e63f93e4d2e8597.source: In the other mine shaft, %randomname% found a nugget the size of me fist! The overseer got to him before he could hide it, though.
87fc6e63f93e4d2e8597.translation: %randomname%在另一条矿道里挖到块矿金，有我的拳头这么大！可惜还没藏好，就让监工逮着了。

1fc3fdccf86ee561995a.source: Even with the bad harvest this year the landlord won't give us a rest! The high folks got to have their feasts, you know...
1fc3fdccf86ee561995a.translation: 今年收成这么差，领主还是不肯放过我们！你也知道，上头那些老爷可不能少了他们的宴席……

a7272de32393dc111492.source: If you're looking to stack up on food and supplies head over to the market and look for %randomname%. He has the best quality and the lowest prices!
a7272de32393dc111492.translation: 要添置粮食和补给，就去集市找%randomname%。他的货最好，价钱也最低！

4739f7ce2843da517bc6.source: I've been a farmhand all my life and sometimes I wish I'd taken the chance to venture with a company like yours... well, it's too late for that now.
4739f7ce2843da517bc6.translation: 我这辈子都在农场给人干活。有时也想，要是当年抓住机会，跟你们这样的战团出去闯闯就好了……唉，现在太晚了。

3cb0aeb5a623c1820a5e.source: There's lots of young and naive lads out there looking for adventure. I hope you take good care of them and return them safely to their families one day.
3cb0aeb5a623c1820a5e.translation: 外头好多年轻小伙子天真得很，一心想冒险。希望你照顾好他们，有朝一日让他们平平安安回到家人身边。

b89ccb71f4aaed1d3675.source: The sea is a fickle mistress. One moment it is as calm as a mirror and the next you find yourself in a tempest fighting for your life.
b89ccb71f4aaed1d3675.translation: 大海像个善变的情妇，前一刻还平静如镜，转眼就把你卷进暴风雨，让你为活命拼尽全力。

6ae6a7f0ea77ae467186.source: Nobody knows what lives in the deep black waters, but you hear the old fishermen talk about giant fish larger than any ship, tentacles that crush boats like they were nutshells, and evil, dead eyes under the surface.
6ae6a7f0ea77ae467186.translation: 没人知道漆黑的深水里藏着什么。可老渔夫们总说，底下有比任何船都大的巨鱼，能像捏碎坚果壳一样碾碎小船的触手，还有藏在水面下、邪恶而死寂的眼睛。

7c946b2e098aac10180e.source: Some of the old fishermen will tell you that those lost at sea are cursed to walk the seabed, only to be released if they drag others down to take their place. Priest says it ain't true, but I don't know. What are the elders telling it for, then?
7c946b2e098aac10180e.translation: 有些老渔夫会告诉你，葬身海上的人都受了诅咒，得永远走在海底，只有拖个人下去替自己，才能解脱。祭司说那是假的，可我拿不准。要不然，老人们为什么老这么说？

45639b460dc71d27710d.source: The biggest fish of my catch I always place in front of %randomfemalename%'s door to woo her. Some day I'm going to reveal myself as her secret admirer and ask for her hand!
45639b460dc71d27710d.translation: 每回打鱼，我都把最大的那条放在%randomfemalename%门前，讨她欢心。总有一天，我会告诉她，那个默默爱慕她的人就是我，然后向她求婚！

f965260b0f9214faf4f6.source: I've been a lumberjack all my life, just like my father before me. But the young folk these days are all 'bout adventure and seeing the lands, you may well find some hanging 'round the market that'll have no qualms 'bout coming with you on the road.
f965260b0f9214faf4f6.translation: 我跟我爹一样，一辈子都在伐木。可如今的年轻人满脑子都是冒险、见世面。你去集市转转，没准就能找到几个，二话不说就肯跟你上路。

8460229338d0bba9fc57.source: There are things in the forest... in the deep, dark parts, there are things. Nobody dares speak of them but trust me, those are no animals...
8460229338d0bba9fc57.translation: 林子里有东西……很深、很黑的地方，有东西。没人敢提，但你信我，那些绝不是野兽……

3be166ec86b22be100b4.source: Say, you interested in woodcarvings? The works of %randomname% are true pieces of art and made our town known throughout the realm!
3be166ec86b22be100b4.translation: 哎，你对木雕有兴趣吗？%randomname%的手艺，那才叫艺术！我们镇子靠他的作品名扬全国！

e4a8017162f3b87bd124.source: Hiring a man of the woods could be a good idea for a mercenary like you, I'd say. They ought to know how to fling around those large axes!
e4a8017162f3b87bd124.translation: 要我说，你这样的佣兵，雇个常年在林子里干活的人准没错。那帮人最知道怎么使唤大斧头！

826270efca9b1dbaf8b6.source: I've been hearing folk tell of eyes watching them from the forest's edge. Seems to be some vile creatures making their nests in these here woods. Perhaps they're sizing up their prey before striking.
826270efca9b1dbaf8b6.translation: 最近老听人说，林子边缘有眼睛盯着他们。看来这片林子里住进了什么邪恶的东西，说不定正在打量猎物，挑下手的时机呢。

859b74ab5b0b02cf4436.source: Long as I can remember the woods around here have been full of wildlife. Deer, boar, wolves and bear roam them in great number. Because of this it's been tradition for families to teach the art of archery at childhood. Try to outmatch any of our lads with a bow and you're sure to be disgraced.
859b74ab5b0b02cf4436.translation: 我记事起，这附近林子里的野物就多，鹿、野猪、狼和熊到处都是。所以我们这儿家家都有从小教孩子射箭的传统。你随便找个小伙子比比弓，准叫你丢脸。

57a04650eef4b0f06ecf.source: You may think our land is barren and scant but once you live here you will learn to love it like no other!
57a04650eef4b0f06ecf.translation: 你也许觉得我们这片土地贫瘠荒凉，可真住下来，就会知道它有多好，再也不想换个地方！

3aa4a64b9311f6cc6f9a.source: The clans and families in these parts are still strong and define who we are. Those nancy southern folks will never understand how things work here in the north.
3aa4a64b9311f6cc6f9a.translation: 这片土地上的氏族和家族，至今都很有分量，也决定了我们是谁。南方那些娘娘腔，永远弄不懂咱们北方的规矩。

c289c5211580eb154740.source: If you're looking to make a quick coin with some trades look around for furs. The ones from around here are the best far and wide.
c289c5211580eb154740.translation: 想倒腾点货赚快钱，就留心毛皮。我们这儿产的皮子，方圆老远都数得着。

d6b00613e2ee7a76413e.source: You came to the right place if you're looking for able men to bolster your company. Us northern folk are strong, rugged and honest!
d6b00613e2ee7a76413e.translation: 要找能干的人壮大战团，你算来对地方了。我们北方人强壮、结实，又实诚！

071f5f114fda3f966add.source: The best remedy against biting winds and freezing cold can be found right here: Beer and mead!
071f5f114fda3f966add.translation: 对付刺骨寒风和冰天雪地，最管用的东西就在这儿：啤酒和蜂蜜酒！

7522b135387d9d4c5f2c.source: A fortnight ago %randomname% went missing on the way home from the tavern. Found him frozen rock solid the next morning. Could have sold him to some fancy noble as a statue, haha!
7522b135387d9d4c5f2c.translation: 两周前，%randomname%从酒馆回家的路上失踪了。第二天早上找到他时，人已经冻得梆硬。没准能当雕像卖给哪个讲排场的贵族呢，哈哈！

ff50db45ae9449b3d07c.source: There are tales of figures shifting in snowstorms and unearthly howls that mix with the winds... but I wouldn't want to unsettle you with the common folk's farytales.
ff50db45ae9449b3d07c.translation: 有传闻说，暴风雪里会有身影晃动，风声中还夹着非人的嚎叫……不过，都是民间的鬼故事，我可不想吓着你。

fe9d821cf2fe6a26af05.source: I've been told that a long time ago this land was all green with many proud castles and awe-inspiring towers. Most of them have crumbled to ruins by now and are covered with snow. But they'll have to be out there somewhere...
fe9d821cf2fe6a26af05.translation: 听人说，很久以前，这片土地满眼翠绿，到处是巍峨的城堡和高耸的塔楼。如今大多塌成了废墟，被积雪盖住。不过，它们总还在什么地方吧……

0ec35cf8a2f591b976c7.source: Four winters. Four winters since I saw a chance for quick coin and raided a roadside chapel. Put the iron to a holy man that tried to hold me back; now no amount of crowns can repay the debt that my spirit owes.
0ec35cf8a2f591b976c7.translation: 四个冬天了。四个冬天前，我想捞笔快钱，劫了路边的一座小教堂。一个圣职者拦着我，我就给了他一刀。如今再多克朗，也还不清灵魂欠下的债。

191c87e650f8a73276a9.source: You men must be sweating like pigs under all that armor. Maybe you should travel when the moon is out?
191c87e650f8a73276a9.translation: 你们裹着这么厚的护甲，怕不是汗流得跟猪一样。不如等月亮出来再赶路？

70b5bf81320cb41892be.source: Let me tell you, the southern wine is the best you can find in all the lands. But you better start bashing in some heads or whatever it is you do so you can afford the good stuff, because it doesn't come cheap.
70b5bf81320cb41892be.translation: 告诉你，南方的葡萄酒是天底下最好的。不过，你最好赶紧去砸几颗脑袋，或者干点你们平时干的营生，攒够钱再来尝好东西。那酒可不便宜。

ffdb4cb237e368ef6b71.source: A trader from the north got lost in the steppe the other week. He made it back but did not stop fantasizing about some lake he discovered surrounded by lush plants and strange animals.
ffdb4cb237e368ef6b71.translation: 前些日子，一个北方商人在草原迷了路。他倒是回来了，可一直念叨着自己发现的一座湖，四周草木繁茂，还有各种奇异的动物。

568c0e860d5211cf6bcc.source: Tell your men to keep their mitts off of the innkeeper's daughter. The last lover boy who tried something had his nose cut right off.
568c0e860d5211cf6bcc.translation: 让你手下的人离酒馆老板的女儿远点，别动手动脚。上个想占便宜的情种，鼻子都被削下来了。

4a8029af1c89bc623fe8.source: I'm from up north originally, moved to %townname% just some years ago. Never could stand the cold; snow and wind, day in and out. So one day I just said to myself, %randomname%, I said, go where the sun warms the earth and you're not shivering every time you go out to collect fire wood. And so I did. Didn't regret it since.
4a8029af1c89bc623fe8.translation: 我本是北方人，几年前才搬到%townname%。那里的冷我实在受不了，成天不是风就是雪。有一天我就对自己说，%randomname%啊，去个太阳能晒暖大地的地方吧，别每回出门捡柴都冻得直哆嗦。于是我就来了，从没后悔过。

0e0b2b40ca61e1e23b83.source: You like mushrooms? Well, I most certainly hate them! But there's not much else to be found in this stinking swamp besides biting midges and spiders.
0e0b2b40ca61e1e23b83.translation: 你爱吃蘑菇吗？反正我恨死它了！可这臭沼泽里，除了咬人的蠓虫和蜘蛛，也实在找不出多少别的东西。

f7eb07453e69109f7aae.source: Traders don't come here often. Their large carriages tend to get stuck in the mud and guess who has to help them out once that happens...
f7eb07453e69109f7aae.translation: 商人不常来这里。他们的大车动不动就陷在泥里，等真陷住了，你猜得找谁帮忙拉出来……

9438b9ecedfb7fc44c5a.source: There once was a stone road leading here bringing traders, customers and all kinds of folk. One day it completely sunk into the swamp and look at this place now...
9438b9ecedfb7fc44c5a.translation: 从前有条石板路通到这里，商人、顾客，各种人来来往往。可有一天，整条路都沉进了沼泽。你再看看这里如今的模样……

bb350489cbd58d72b804.source: Don't wander through the swamps at night! You might get lost, yes, but out in the swamp at night there's far worse things that can happen to a man. Just ask anyone around here.
bb350489cbd58d72b804.translation: 别大晚上在沼泽里乱走！迷路还算轻的，那地方到了夜里，有比迷路可怕得多的事等着你。不信你问问这里的人。

9a4150c51c854289c37d.source: Those northeners pay good coin for our silk and spices, so we have caravans going up all the time. And caravans need escorts, you know.
9a4150c51c854289c37d.translation: 北方人肯花大价钱买我们的丝绸和香料，所以商队总往北边跑。商队嘛，总得有人护送，你懂的。

f77d382cad32d207d600.source: If I can give you one piece of advice, it's this: don't venture too far out in the desert. There are things far worse than heat and sand at the edge of the world.
f77d382cad32d207d600.translation: 真要给你一句忠告，那就是别往沙漠深处走。世界尽头的东西，可比烈日和黄沙可怕得多。

65bcf9ffc0c6a741a119.source: Those northern dogs have no right to come into our lands, they should stay where they belong!
65bcf9ffc0c6a741a119.translation: 那帮北方狗没资格踏进我们的土地！他们就该滚回自己的地方待着！

1edc0d0ea7609163b411.source: A caravan transporting some valuable ceremonial weapon has been raided %direction% of here. Rumor is the victims had every single bone broken, and a terrible stench hangs in the air.
1edc0d0ea7609163b411.translation: 有支运送贵重仪式武器的商队，在这里的%direction%遇袭了。听说死者浑身的骨头都被打断了，现场还留着一股恶臭。

5223b6707ea1f000adac.source: A patron recently spoke of some weapon called the %item% he wanted to sell. Said he got spooked by some greenskinned beasts on his way to town and abandoned it %terrain% %direction% from here.
5223b6707ea1f000adac.translation: 最近有个客人说想卖一把叫%item%的武器。他说来镇上的路上遇见绿皮怪物，吓得把东西丢在了这里%direction%的%terrain%。

2f249fdb87715c7426f9.source: A traveler told me the other day that he saw the biggest man alive wielding what he called %item% with his own eyes. Sounds like hogwash to me, but if you're interested the guy left here towards the %direction%.
2f249fdb87715c7426f9.translation: 前几天有个旅人跟我说，他亲眼看见世上最高大的汉子，拿着一件叫%item%的家伙。我看纯属胡扯。不过你要有兴趣，那人从这里往%direction%去了。

3b3e9def2319f5c2f571.source: Big cocked adventurer with a pretty face came by here a few nights ago. He headed %direction% of here looking to slay some greenskins. Wore a fancy shield on his back, looked like some type o' knight, but told me he wasn't.
3b3e9def2319f5c2f571.translation: 前几晚来了个脸蛋俊、胯下家伙也大的冒险者，往这里的%direction%去了，说是要杀几个绿皮。他背着面漂亮的盾，模样像个骑士，可自己又说不是。

db4914ba952860e3052c.source: They say that some famous shield, I forgot what it was called, once stopped a boulder from rolling down a hill and crushing a camp. Sounds like shite to me. Not that we'll ever find out if it's true that it's an orc war trophy now, hidden somewhere %distance% to the %direction% of here.
db4914ba952860e3052c.translation: 听说有面名盾，叫什么我忘了，曾经挡住从山坡滚下来的巨石，救了整座营地。我看就是扯淡。可要是它真成了兽人的战利品，藏在%direction%、离这儿%distance%的地方，那咱们恐怕也没法查证了。

a2eeec3e74de7b835d9c.source: Don't take my word for it, but supposedly some big green oafs %direction% of here are toting around with an incredible shield simply called %item%. How they might've gotten it is beyond me.
a2eeec3e74de7b835d9c.translation: 我也说不准，不过听说这里%direction%有些绿皮大块头，带着一面了不得的盾，名字就叫%item%。它们怎么弄到的，我可猜不透。

dd02ef4fb87d7990f834.source: Some nobleman's manor got raided by greenskins a few days ago. They made off with some famous shield or relic. Supposedly those greenskinned bastards are holed up somewhere %direction% of here.
dd02ef4fb87d7990f834.translation: 前几天绿皮洗劫了一个贵族的庄园，抢走了什么有名的盾，还是圣物。听说那帮绿皮混账就窝在这里%direction%的某个地方。

0b5cb88aa4f0368f4d6b.source: Familiar with orcs? Massive beasts and strong as oxen! A mercenary band that called themselves %randommercenarycompany% came through and headed %direction% to hunt them down some weeks ago. They never returned, but their leader wore the most impressive armor I've ever seen in my life!
0b5cb88aa4f0368f4d6b.translation: 知道兽人吧？那群怪物大得吓人，力气跟牛一样！几周前，有支自称%randommercenarycompany%的佣兵队打这儿经过，往%direction%猎杀它们去了。后来没再回来。他们头领那身护甲，可是我这辈子见过最气派的！

653ce30b4dff548120d5.source: Oh, have you heard of %item%? It's said to have been stolen ages ago during the last orc invasion. There were sightings of it reported %direction% of here, but me, I don't know any details. I didn't mean to get your hopes up about it.
653ce30b4dff548120d5.translation: 哦，你听说过%item%吗？据说很久以前，上次兽人入侵时就被偷走了。有人说在这里的%direction%见过，可我一点详情都不知道。你别抱太大希望。

9be0f3080861c406bd08.source: Some famed armorsmith got slain a few days ago. Rumor has it orcs ransacked his place and ran off with his masterpiece to somewhere %direction% from here. Maybe someone else can tell you more.
9be0f3080861c406bd08.translation: 几天前，有个很有名的制甲匠被杀了。听说兽人洗劫了他的工坊，带着他的得意之作跑到了这里的%direction%。也许别人知道得更清楚。

ee58b98a1a38c01840d6.source: Word has it %randomnoble% got forever put to sleep by a band of greenskins %direction% of here. He was well known for abusing all his servants so you won't find anyone crying for him 'round here. Just a shame for the mastercrafted armor he used to boast, that one could buy us a lot of pigs and cows. And chickens!
ee58b98a1a38c01840d6.translation: 听说%randomnoble%在这里的%direction%，让一帮绿皮送去长眠了。他虐待仆人是出了名的，这儿可没人替他掉眼泪。只是可惜了他老爱炫耀的那身名甲，那可是能换好多猪、好多牛的！还有鸡！

5b7676ceb8fec2a1f5a0.source: A really pissed-off nobleman told me the other day that some stunty greenskins made off with his family heirloom after poisoning his trusted guard dogs. He swears they hid %terrain% somewhere %distance% from here, but I don't think he ever convinced anyone to retrieve it for him. Certainly not me.
5b7676ceb8fec2a1f5a0.translation: 前几天有个贵族气坏了，说一群矮个子绿皮毒死了他的看门犬，还偷走了传家宝。他咬定它们藏在离这儿%distance%的%terrain%，可我看他没能说动谁替他找回来。反正我不去。

ec85d7fd1e6a66ad0981.source: Afraid of greenskins? Some real beaten up soldiers passed down through here the other day. Said they wanted to wrestle a well-known weapon from goblins %direction% of here, but it sure looked like it didn't go down as planned and they had to pull back. Guess their prize is still up for the taking.
ec85d7fd1e6a66ad0981.translation: 怕绿皮吗？前几天有几个伤得很惨的士兵打这儿经过，说是想从这里%direction%的地精手里夺一件有名的武器。看他们那模样，显然事情不顺，最后只好撤了。那件宝贝应该还在。

7e7f1c8f37ac51274252.source: A farmer from up %direction% told me he saw some small, sinister creatures on his land carrying a large, shiny shield and making devilish noises. He says it was goblins, but I say he got pranked by some youngsters!
7e7f1c8f37ac51274252.translation: %direction%那边有个农夫跟我说，他在自家地里看见几个小个子怪物，阴森森的，扛着一面闪亮的大盾，还发出鬼叫。他说是地精，我看就是几个毛头小子捉弄他！

30cbaa116acd16417aab.source: They found the best shieldmaker in the whole region dead with a dart sticking out of his neck %direction% of here. People said they saw little creatures running off with half his wares.
30cbaa116acd16417aab.translation: 这一带最好的制盾匠，在这里的%direction%被人发现死了，脖子上插着支飞镖。有人说，看见几个小怪物扛着他一半的货跑掉了。

5de7782d8320c144345c.source: Somewhere %direction% of here be some goblins. The only reason I know it is because every swinging dick that comes this way talks about how they just barely got away with their life. One even claims he lost his mastercrafted shield when legging it.
5de7782d8320c144345c.translation: 这里%direction%的某个地方有地精。我为什么知道？打那边来的汉子，个个都嚷着自己差点没命。有一个还说，逃跑时丢了面名匠打造的盾。

eddeb328ab39a4c00732.source: Word has it that some overpriced and overvalued piece of armor  was stolen from the guardhouse by some small devil creatures that hauled it to the %direction%. %randomname% said it must've been goblins, but no one here really knows what they look like.
eddeb328ab39a4c00732.translation: 听说卫所里那件被吹上天、贵得离谱的护甲，让几个小恶魔似的怪物偷走了，往%direction%运去了。%randomname%说一定是地精，可这里压根没人真知道地精长什么样。

3e90a627b8c8b3f639d1.source: It's said that kobolds and goblins take a special interest in everything shiny. I never believed this to be true myself, but I repeatedly saw something glistening in the sun %terrain% %direction% from here and heard strange stories about short and stubby creatures roaming that area.
3e90a627b8c8b3f639d1.translation: 听说小妖和地精最喜欢亮闪闪的东西。我原本不信，可好几次看见这里%direction%的%terrain%有东西在太阳底下闪光，又听说那一带有矮小敦实的怪物出没。

870265120a505de80951.source: You may be interested to learn that our old herbalist outside of town got robbed last night just as a wealthy knight payed him a visit. The assailants, he claims it was small creatures looking like deformed kids, killed the knight and made off to %terrain% in the %direction%.
870265120a505de80951.translation: 也许你会感兴趣：昨晚城外那个老草药师被抢了，偏巧有个富有的骑士正去拜访他。草药师说，袭击者是些像畸形孩子的小怪物。它们杀了骑士，往%direction%的%terrain%逃去了。

37686a59d49d6414958a.source: Word has it that a bunch of ne'er do wells %direction% from here got their hands on something real fancy and sharp through a brash heist.
37686a59d49d6414958a.translation: 听说这里%direction%有一帮无赖，干了票胆大包天的劫案，弄到了一件既漂亮又锋利的好东西。

98f10c2f9a5d89cb4eb7.source: Buncha lowlifes tried raiding a caravan %terrain% %distance% from here. They all got slain, but rumor has it that some valuable weapon went missing during the fight. The caravan guards have been searching for it frantically since.
98f10c2f9a5d89cb4eb7.translation: 一帮混账在离这儿%distance%的%terrain%打劫商队，结果全被宰了。可听说打斗中丢了件值钱的武器，商队护卫到现在还在发疯似的找呢。

68f31a1ba12b47f4caae.source: A bewildered patron told me he was held prisoner by some rogues %terrain% %distance% from here. Said they had something real pretty with them. Some sort of curious looking weapon.
68f31a1ba12b47f4caae.translation: 有个吓得不轻的客人跟我说，他被一伙恶棍囚禁过，就在离这儿%distance%的%terrain%。他说那些人手里有件漂亮得很的东西，好像是一把造型古怪的武器。

12bfb30a4ca53465957e.source: The captain of the guard deserted a while ago to join a raider camp hidden %terrain% to the %direction%. My uncle, who served under him, claims he raided the armory before leaving and grabbed a real prize.
12bfb30a4ca53465957e.translation: 卫队长前阵子叛逃了，投奔了这里%direction%的%terrain%里一处隐蔽的劫匪营地。我叔叔以前在他手下当差，说他走前还洗了军械库，顺走了件真宝贝。

f49df999214e2306b2a7.source: I hear the famous shield %item% has been sighted. %randomname% claims that it belongs to a band of hard boiled raiders camping out %direction% of here. But then, %randomname% talks lots about things he knows nothing about.
f49df999214e2306b2a7.translation: 听说那面有名的盾，%item%，有下落了。%randomname%说它在一帮狠辣的劫匪手里，那些人就扎营在这里的%direction%。不过，%randomname%向来爱对自己一窍不通的事胡说八道。

7058d414f23abb154914.source: All anyone talks 'bout 'round these parts are damned raiders. 'Suppose they're the toast of Rumorville 'cause they gots their hands on the %item% or some such thing now. Where at? Oh, somewhere %terrain%.
7058d414f23abb154914.translation: 这一带的人，张嘴闭嘴都是那帮天杀的劫匪。估计是他们弄到了%item%，还是别的什么玩意儿，成了酒馆里的热门谈资。在哪儿？哦，%terrain%的某个地方。

3710735f5b0dfae008cb.source: A friend of a friend got robbed %direction% from here by a group of outlaws the other day. He claims the leader donned the most astonishing armor!
3710735f5b0dfae008cb.translation: 我朋友的一个朋友，前几天在这里的%direction%被一伙匪徒抢了。他说那伙人的头领穿着一身了不得的护甲！

4f0e4f4dc0f6d9d64b5b.source: A brash young man came through just the other day, nobility methinks, looking for an old family heirloom called %item%. Last I saw, he was heading %direction% of here.
4f0e4f4dc0f6d9d64b5b.translation: 前几天来了个冒冒失失的年轻人，我看像个贵族，正在找一件叫%item%的传家宝。最后见到他时，他正往%direction%去。

ce684b4f81c63fd2452e.source: Now, I don't want to start any rumors, but I saw a dead man walking around %direction% of here. His rotten hands clutched an extraordinary weapon but I'd never dare go there again in my life!
ce684b4f81c63fd2452e.translation: 我可不是想造谣，但我真在这里的%direction%看见一个死人走来走去。烂手里攥着一件不寻常的武器。这辈子我都不敢再去那儿了！

84f033c5210dde810f0b.source: Some drunk scavenger came by last night, told us he'd tried to wrestle a weapon beset with gems from a dead man's hands %distance% to the %direction%. Said his grip was like a vice, and then he made a sound, so he ran off. Such nonsense, but he looked spooked as all hell.
84f033c5210dde810f0b.translation: 昨晚来了个喝醉的拾荒者，说他在%direction%、离这儿%distance%的地方，想从一个死人手里掰下一把嵌宝石的武器。那手攥得跟铁钳一样，死人还突然出了声，吓得他撒腿就跑。胡说八道，可他那副模样还真像撞了鬼。

46cb597209a6db4d617b.source: There's lots of talk about the dead walking the earth again. %randomname% says there's some to the %direction% of here. Sounds like hogwash to me.
46cb597209a6db4d617b.translation: 最近到处都在传，死人又开始在世上走动了。%randomname%说这里的%direction%就有。我看纯属胡扯。

b9389025172ff60633d6.source: Supposedly a bunch of graves %direction% of here are turning up empty. Someone said graverobbers were looking for a famed shield buried there. Strangely, nobody's actually seen those graverobbers, so maybe it's all hogwash.
b9389025172ff60633d6.translation: 听说这里%direction%的不少坟墓都空了。有人说是盗墓贼在找一面陪葬的名盾。怪就怪在，谁也没见过那些盗墓贼，没准全是胡扯。

73608e7b21ed75ce8920.source: So I watched over the steward's books and came across old maps that depicted an ancient noble burial ground %terrain% %distance% from here. However, nobody was able to find it yet. Well, some things are just not meant to be found, I suppose.
73608e7b21ed75ce8920.translation: 我替管家翻查账册时，发现了几张旧地图，上面标着一片古代贵族墓地，就在离这儿%distance%的%terrain%。可一直没人找着。唉，有些东西，也许本来就不该被找到吧。

f195aa63d4ef2447042e.source: So %terrain% %direction% of here is supposedly the last resting place of a mystical piece of armor. Don't know the name myself, I just know a lot of adventurers go there and don't come back. Dunno why I told you, really. I like your business.
f195aa63d4ef2447042e.translation: 听说这里%direction%的%terrain%，是一件神秘护甲最后的埋藏之地。叫什么我不知道，只知道好多冒险者去了就没回来。唉，我也不知道为什么要告诉你，我还挺想留着你这位主顾呢。

6976b3a9cf753272ac6e.source: You heard of %location%? Ask anyone around here, it's been haunting %townname% since before I was born. Folks say some armor from the gods is sealed there for all time, back from when man first settled here.
6976b3a9cf753272ac6e.translation: 听过%location%吗？你随便问问，从我出生以前起，那地方就让%townname%的人不得安宁。听说早在人类刚在这里定居的时候，就有一副神赐的护甲被永远封在了里面。

5701a08d6b22db97caa7.source: Nothing is holy to those barbarian brutes! A completely naked priest stumbled in here from %direction%. He was on the way to bring a revered relic to the temple but they took it from him.
5701a08d6b22db97caa7.translation: 那群野蛮畜生什么都敢抢！有个祭司光着身子，从%direction%踉踉跄跄跑到这儿。他原本要把一件受人敬奉的圣物送到神殿，结果让他们抢走了。

c7b8e1838f7983982d36.source: A mercenary company came by here hunting barbarians. The leader wielded a weapon unlike anything I ever saw before. They turned %direction% and were never to be seen again.
c7b8e1838f7983982d36.translation: 之前有支战团经过这里，说要去猎杀野蛮人。他们头领使的武器，我这辈子都没见过。他们转头去了%direction%，从此再没回来。

03ae691198d823f4644a.source: When you head out %terrain% %direction%, keep your eyes peeled for a group of fierce wild men. They may lead you to their stash where a famed stolen weapon is said to be found.
03ae691198d823f4644a.translation: 你去%direction%的%terrain%时，留神一群凶悍的野人。他们没准会把你带到藏东西的地方，听说那里放着一件偷来的名贵武器。

dd2e957b4d3dfd5be2bb.source: Hark! A tribe of uncultured barbarians has been seen %direction% of here with a shield called %item% in their dirty hands! Slay them and get it back!
dd2e957b4d3dfd5be2bb.translation: 听着！有人看见一群未开化的野蛮人在这里的%direction%，脏手里拿着一面叫%item%的盾！宰了他们，把盾夺回来！

8823a649ad842bf094ae.source: A friend of a friend spotted some wildmen in the distance %direction% of here. He swears they carried a finely crafted shield. I call horseshit, as everbody knows they do not use shields like we do!
8823a649ad842bf094ae.translation: 我朋友的一个朋友，在这里%direction%的远处看见了一群荒野人。他拍胸脯说，那些人带着一面做工精良的盾牌。放屁！谁不知道他们才不像我们这样用盾！

bc2e8006adf59631cdf4.source: Only a good defense allows for a strong offense they say. Rumors has it, a band of barbarians %distance% to the %direction% are in the possession of a famed shield...
bc2e8006adf59631cdf4.translation: 都说守得稳，才能打得狠。听说在%direction%，离这儿%distance%，有伙野蛮人拿着一面有名的盾……

540a81603a661f18e20d.source: I used to be trading with some of the not-so-wild barbarians %direction% of here. When I last visited them there was a magnificent shield hanging in one of their huts. They might still be hanging out there %terrain%.
540a81603a661f18e20d.translation: 我从前常跟这里%direction%的一些野蛮人做买卖，那帮人还不算太野。上次去，一间棚屋里挂着面漂亮极了的盾。他们也许还待在那边的%terrain%。

c5fbb708d8959cb2484d.source: You look like you could use some better armor, my friend. If you are not scared of taking on fierce barbarians, there is a mighty fine armor to be claimed in one of their camps called %location%, %terrain% %direction% of here.
c5fbb708d8959cb2484d.translation: 朋友，你看起来该换身好护甲了。要是不怕跟凶狠的野蛮人较量，这里%direction%的%terrain%有座营地叫%location%，里面就有一件上好的护甲，等着人去拿。

479bf0fbd71a580ce899.source: The famed %item% has been guarded in the armory for decades, but when the wild men from the north came they took everything with them. They are said to be camping out somewhere %terrain% %distance% from here.
479bf0fbd71a580ce899.translation: 那件有名的%item%，在军械库里守了几十年。可北方的野人一来，什么都给抢走了。听说他们就在离这儿%distance%的%terrain%某处扎营。

17109de0a06cf74e1b84.source: I came here to pick up an heirloom from my late grandfather just to get to know it has been stolen by marauding barbarians. They are said to loiter somewhere %terrain% %direction% of here, but I fear I will never get it back.
17109de0a06cf74e1b84.translation: 我到这里来，是想取回亡祖留下的一件传家宝，到了才知道被劫掠的野蛮人偷走了。听说他们还在这里%direction%的%terrain%某处晃荡，可我怕是再也拿不回来了。

e1ed87fb5f502db5c82d.source: Are you also here to look for %item% like all those other fools? It is said to lie somewhere %terrain% %direction%. Nothing but hogwash if you ask me...
e1ed87fb5f502db5c82d.translation: 你也跟那群傻子一样，是来找%item%的？听说它在%direction%的%terrain%某处。要我说，都是胡扯……

d3b9c390fe5d4f7e8144.source: The nomads take what they want and hide out in the desert. The guards have been looking for them %terrain% %direction% of here. I think they're %distance%.
d3b9c390fe5d4f7e8144.translation: 游牧民想抢什么就抢什么，抢完往沙漠里一躲。卫兵正在这里%direction%的%terrain%找他们。我估计他们离这儿%distance%。

ea3a2da8c75475096e75.source: The days here in the south are as bright as the nights are dark. I must have stumbled and lost my precious weapon %distance% to the %direction%, but I gave up looking for it.
ea3a2da8c75475096e75.translation: 南方的白天有多亮，夜里就有多黑。我八成是摸黑绊了一跤，把宝贝武器丢在了%direction%，离这儿%distance%。我已经不找了。

4783a061c0fd86dc1483.source: The craftsmen of the ancient times really knew how to make remarkable weapons. Rumors has it such a weapon is with a nomad tribe hiding out in the %direction%, but who should take it from them - me? Ha!
4783a061c0fd86dc1483.translation: 古时候的工匠，真知道怎么造好兵器。听说%direction%有个躲藏的游牧部族，就拿着这样一件。可谁去抢回来呢，我吗？哈！

793e959b5f530b8ee4d1.source: A shield reflecting the sunlight like a mirror, more blinding than the midday in the desert! Where I saw that? Some Nomads had it in the %direction% %distance% from here, if I recall correctly.
793e959b5f530b8ee4d1.translation: 那面盾照着太阳就跟镜子一样，比沙漠正午的日头还晃眼！你问我在哪儿见的？记得是些游牧民拿着，就在%direction%，离这儿%distance%。

b80d71e00190db9bbe80.source: All my life I've been hunting nomads across the borders %terrain%, but I never saw one wield a shield like this one before. It was %distance% to the %direction% at one of their camps.
b80d71e00190db9bbe80.translation: 我这辈子都在%terrain%一带的边境追捕游牧民，从没见过他们用那样的盾。就在%direction%，离这儿%distance%，他们的一处营地里。

7d500283cde9760cb30a.source: Nomads do not only take from the living but from the dead as well! Word has it they plundered the so-called %item% from a tomb %direction% of here where they have their camp still. They really do not have any decency.
7d500283cde9760cb30a.translation: 游牧民不光抢活人，连死人也不放过！听说他们从这里%direction%的一座坟墓里挖出了什么%item%，到现在还在那儿扎营。真是一点体面都不要！

feec18c7d9985ab3865a.source: I used to be first quartermaster to a Vizier. When the famed armor I ordered for a guest of honor did not arrive, I lost my position. The caravan with it was ambushed by nomads, I later learned, %direction% of here.
feec18c7d9985ab3865a.translation: 我从前是一位维齐尔手下的首席军需官。有次给贵客订制的名甲没送到，我就丢了差事。后来才知道，运它的商队在这里的%direction%遭了游牧民的伏击。

569fa69040dd4c429974.source: An opulent armor is said to be hidden out %terrain% %direction% from here. Many treasure seekers failed to claim it so far but maybe you have more luck?
569fa69040dd4c429974.translation: 听说这里%direction%的%terrain%藏着一件华丽的护甲。到现在都没哪个寻宝人能把它带回来，也许你运气更好？

4358ee01e2bf328331d2.source: The most skilled armorsmith around, who happens to be a friend of mine, got tricked by those damned nomads and they made off with one of his prize armors. If you come across any nomads %direction% of here, search their bodies thoroughly!
4358ee01e2bf328331d2.translation: 这一带手艺最好的制甲匠，碰巧是我朋友，叫那帮该死的游牧民骗了，丢了件得意之作。你在这里%direction%碰见游牧民的话，可得好好搜搜他们的尸体！

457a828aa8f4f2133d39.source: The nobles are quarreling again like two old hags at the garden fence. They just can't get over their pride!
457a828aa8f4f2133d39.translation: 贵族们又吵起来了，活像两个隔着篱笆骂街的老太婆。他们就是放不下那点脸面！

a1b6e7def9b037fabe51.source: The nobles will take all your crowns, and your sons and husbands too, and burn them in their pointless struggles - a thousand curses 'pon them!
a1b6e7def9b037fabe51.translation: 贵族会拿走你所有的克朗，再带走你的儿子和丈夫，全扔进他们毫无意义的争斗里烧个干净。愿他们遭千刀万剐！

5f6be31e875feb66cbb1.source: I've served my time in the army twenty years ago. Lost an ear, see? Now my boy's marching. Was snatched right out the stables and forced into the frontline. Different war, same old shit. I pray he stays low and keeps his shield up.
5f6be31e875feb66cbb1.translation: 二十年前我当过兵，少了只耳朵，看见没？现在轮到我儿子上战场了。人家直接从马厩里抓了他，硬塞到前线去。换了一场战争，还是那摊烂事。我只盼他把头压低，盾牌举稳。

50160793c5bcef15335e.source: The green tide keeps washing away one army after the other! We're all doomed! Doomed!
50160793c5bcef15335e.translation: 绿皮的浪潮冲垮了一支又一支军队！我们都完了！都完了！

95520c1a77e94f992f07.source: All are running from the greenskins but not me! I will stand my ground, club in one hand, pitcher in the other! Send them my way!
95520c1a77e94f992f07.translation: 别人一见绿皮就跑，我可不跑！我左手拿棍子，右手提酒壶，就在这儿守着！让它们来！

c98026f0ed40d647bc32.source: We barely fought off the greenskins last time at the Battle of Many Names, just barely made it, and now they're back.
c98026f0ed40d647bc32.translation: 上回众名之战，我们好不容易才把绿皮打退，差一点就完了。现在它们又回来了。

bfa0e4242c7e8773fdf6.source: We hear stories of more and more farms and hamlets getting burned every day. It's greenskins raiding the countryside.
bfa0e4242c7e8773fdf6.translation: 天天都听说更多农场和小村庄被烧了。是绿皮在乡下劫掠。

bcf5568b0f681e71db04.source: May the old gods help us! The dead are stirring in their graves all over the lands. They will come and claim the living. Repent, repent and pray!
bcf5568b0f681e71db04.translation: 愿旧神救救我们！各地的死人都在坟里蠢蠢欲动，要爬出来索活人的命了。忏悔吧，忏悔，快祈祷！

f24b10e0973eeb0ed66a.source: The nobles are on their back foot, and nobody knows how to stop the undead menace coming for us. I have to keep my mind off of it - inkeeper! Another!
f24b10e0973eeb0ed66a.translation: 贵族们节节败退，没人知道怎么挡住逼近的不死大军。我得找点别的事想想……老板，再来一杯！

935b34b3eceb61ecd6ca.source: Maybe I should just hang myself, get it over with and join the ranks of the marching dead. This waiting is driving me insane!
935b34b3eceb61ecd6ca.translation: 也许我干脆上吊算了，一了百了，直接加入那些游荡的死人。这么等下去，我快疯了！

ad97339e323637c6719e.source: A man was found dead on the road. He sat upright on a donkey cart, all dried up, like a puppet of skin, tendrils, and bone. The donkey too. 'Tis like the blood was sucked right out of 'em.
ad97339e323637c6719e.translation: 有人在路上发现了一具尸体，直挺挺坐在驴车上，干得像个用皮、筋和骨头扎成的木偶。驴也一样，仿佛浑身的血都被吸光了。

7004b24a9bfa7f575202.source:
Ghastly ghosts, empty graves, otherworldly mindless slaves!
Have a glass, find a wench before your teeth will clench!
Kill the can, don't stay dry, three days until we die!
7004b24a9bfa7f575202.translation:
鬼影森森坟冢空，异界奴仆没心肠！
喝杯酒来找个妞，莫等牙关再难张！
干了这壶莫停手，三日之后赴死场！

32378c726931f3abc219.source: %randomnoble% had his lunch come back from the dead. Was about to take a healthy bite of stuffed goose when the thing jumped from his plate and started flapping in circles. Sprayed baked apples across the living quarters. Must've been a sight to remember.
32378c726931f3abc219.translation: %randomnoble%的午饭居然死而复生了！他正要狠狠咬一口那只填馅烤鹅，它就从盘子里蹦起来，扑腾着翅膀打转，把烤苹果甩得满屋都是。那场面，肯定一辈子都忘不了。

d6f5440344a9ddae27ab.source: Did you hear the news? Armies are rallying at %randomtown% to march south. I just hope the gilded don't strike back some day...
d6f5440344a9ddae27ab.translation: 听到消息了吗？军队正在%randomtown%集结，准备南下。只盼那些镀金者的信徒别有朝一日打回来……

008b4b33fdf9b22e5a81.source: If you are looking for coin you should head south and teach those sun-worshippers a lesson!
008b4b33fdf9b22e5a81.translation: 想挣钱就往南走，去给那帮拜太阳的家伙点教训！

1c771cc553397777f9c4.source: What.... WHAT!? I can't hear you! I was fighting those Gilder followers at the Oracle and something loud went up near my ear...
1c771cc553397777f9c4.translation: 什么……什么！？我听不见！我在 The Oracle 跟那些镀金者的信徒交战，耳边突然炸响了一声……

3f4570a8895e6fee2762.source: Want some soup? I got beef and potatoes in there. No spices, though. Ran out of 'em on account of the war.
3f4570a8895e6fee2762.translation: 来点汤吗？里面有牛肉和土豆。不过没有香料，打仗打得都断货了。

2b492635b1d0ba5b4819.source: The priest says that the old gods will take you in if you don't make it back from the crusade. 'Tis a good thing to know, right? Those Gilder fanatics are a dangerous lot.
2b492635b1d0ba5b4819.translation: 祭司说了，要是从圣战中回不来，旧神会收留你的灵魂。知道这个，心里多少踏实点，对吧？那群镀金者的狂信徒，可不是好惹的。

bbefaff511b624c9caa8.source: Can you believe it? %randomnoble% paid some nomad folk to guide his host through the desert. Bloody folly if true, that. Wouldn't trust those snakes as far as I can piss.
bbefaff511b624c9caa8.translation: 你信吗？%randomnoble%花钱雇了些游牧民，给他的军队带路穿越沙漠。要是真的，那可蠢透了。换我，连一泡尿远的路都不敢让那群毒蛇带！

0860795e3566701316b0.source: A nephew of mine got killed in the desert. Poor lad. Set out to protect the faith and was ran through with a spear for it. Bastard who did it is still alive. Make 'em pay for it, I say. Make the thrice cursed lot o'em pay!
0860795e3566701316b0.translation: 我有个侄子死在沙漠里了，可怜的孩子。他出门时一心要捍卫信仰，结果让人一矛捅了个对穿。下手的混账还活着呢。要我说，就该让他们偿命！让那群天杀的东西统统付出代价！

4a90c8e97fcfe58cb3bf.source: A large stone boulder. Blocks movement and line of sight.
4a90c8e97fcfe58cb3bf.translation: 一块巨大的岩石，阻挡移动与视线。

136148d2b7f807a10061.source: Ruins from an age long past.

c0b6ac13d10b8b312d0f.source: Very dense shrubbery that blocks movement and line of sight.
c0b6ac13d10b8b312d0f.translation: 茂密的灌木丛，阻挡移动与视线。

c438885b4955f4fefd83.source: A large tree with a massive trunk.

119b8486448324a18991.source: This tree is rotten and long dead.
119b8486448324a18991.translation: 这棵树早已枯死，树干腐朽。

94308b0b3412c5000655.source: A treetrunk half covered in foul water.
94308b0b3412c5000655.translation: 半截泡在污水中的树干。

9cf0a7b822534c5bf733.source: The old and broken wheel of an oxcart.
9cf0a7b822534c5bf733.translation: 牛车上掉下的破旧车轮。

ebe680eea20876512968.source: A cart full of trading goods.

b6a11cf2a10b1879be9a.source: A donkey used for pulling heavy carts.
b6a11cf2a10b1879be9a.translation: 一头用来拖拉重车的驴。

857a8f792eaa7c5ce73a.source: An exotic plant that blocks movement and line of sight.
857a8f792eaa7c5ce73a.translation: 一株奇异的植物，阻挡移动与视线。

63bf00374224276f44ba.source: A dirt road originating from constant use by humans and animals.
63bf00374224276f44ba.translation: 人畜长期踩踏形成的土路。

e67200f4be44abcef7d9.source: A primitve road consisting of tamped clay.
e67200f4be44abcef7d9.translation: 用夯实黏土铺成的简陋道路。

0e5a777bdea86e6258ca.source: A cobblestone road used for carriages and larger vehicles.
0e5a777bdea86e6258ca.translation: 可供马车等大型车辆通行的鹅卵石道路。

a5dd349b33d65a4f7fe3.source: Short grass on flat and solid ground.
a5dd349b33d65a4f7fe3.translation: 平坦坚实的地面上长着矮草。

15eeeb62a046577ea722.source: Bare and flat earth with barely any vegetation.
15eeeb62a046577ea722.translation: 平坦裸露的土地，几乎没有植被。

54aff51034ed5bdfc530.source: Forest ground covered in a thick and soft mossy layer.
54aff51034ed5bdfc530.translation: 森林地面上覆着一层厚实松软的苔藓。

7cfb923674a8078f662f.source: Mostly firm ground covered in tall and soft grass.
7cfb923674a8078f662f.translation: 较为坚实的土地，长着高而柔软的草。

8f25649a3c2e7424c421.source: Shallow, murky water covering a soft and muddy ground.
8f25649a3c2e7424c421.translation: 松软泥泞的地面上覆着浑浊的浅水。

6570789c5747d36facfc.source: Flat and firm ground covered with dry and shriveled grass.
6570789c5747d36facfc.translation: 平坦坚实的土地，覆盖着干枯的草。

a3e6af57b238084db450.source: Hard patches of earth completely dried out by sun and heat.
a3e6af57b238084db450.translation: 被烈日与高温彻底晒干的坚硬土地。

8ae028bf21f16f7c503b.source: Flat and arid ground covered in rough grasses and weeds.
8ae028bf21f16f7c503b.translation: 平坦干旱的土地，长着粗硬的草与杂草。

deeb1a29b896479053ca.source: Frozen ground covered in a thick layer of snow.

92ddbe1a001bdab081a8.source: Frozen ground covered in a light layer of snow.

fbdcb56abb1aa2bed071.source: Smooth stone ground granting a good footing.

ece4d5fd3ed40c25f88f.source:
You soak in the cool morning air. As the sun slowly rises, so does a new chapter in your life begin. After years of bloodying your sword for meager pay you've saved up enough crowns to start your very own mercenary company. With you are %allbrothers% with whom you've fought before side by side in the shieldwall. You are their commander now, the leader of the %companyname%.

As you travel the lands you should hire new men in the villages and cities to fill your ranks. Many who offer their services will have never picked up a real weapon before. Maybe they are desperate, maybe they are greedy for quick spoils of war. Most of them will die on the battlefield. But do not be discouraged. Such is the mercenary life, and the next village will always have new men eagerly looking for a new start in life.

The lands are dangerous these times. Robbers and pillagers lay in ambush by the roads, wild beasts roam the dark forests and orc tribes are restless in the swamps to the east. There are rumors even of dark magic being at work, the dead rising from their graves and walking again. There is plenty of opportunity to earn good money, whether by taking on contracts you can find in the villages, cities and strongholds all over the land, or by venturing out on your own to explore and raid.

Your men look to you to give a command. They live and die for the %companyname% now.

[color=#bd9d71]EARLY ACCESS DISCLAIMER: This version is still heavily work in progress and does not represent the final quality of the product. Features may be incomplete or missing, the UI is unskinned as of yet, there will be bugs, and the balancing and progression of the economy, resources and enemies may need tweaking and can be too challenging or easy occasionally. A lot of additional content will be added over the course of the Early Access, including more enemies, items, contracts, terrain types, unique locations, story events and other features.[/color]
ece4d5fd3ed40c25f88f.translation:
你深吸一口清凉的晨风。朝阳缓缓升起，你的人生也翻开了新的一页。多年来，你以刀头舔血换取微薄报酬，如今终于攒够克朗，组建了自己的佣兵战团。与你同行的%allbrothers%曾在盾墙中与你并肩作战。如今，你成了他们的指挥官，%companyname%的团长。

行走各地时，你应在村庄和城市招募新人，补充队伍。许多前来投效的人从未握过真正的武器；有人走投无路，有人贪图战利品。他们大多会死在战场上，但不必因此灰心。佣兵的日子就是如此，而下一个村庄总有新人盼着重新开始。

如今的世道危机四伏。盗匪潜伏在路旁，野兽徘徊于幽暗的森林，东方沼泽里的兽人部落也蠢蠢欲动。甚至有传言说，黑暗魔法正在施虐，死者从坟墓中爬起，再次行走于世间。不过，赚大钱的机会同样不少：你可以在各地村庄、城市和要塞接取委托，也可以自行探索、出征劫掠。

弟兄们正望着你，等待命令。从今往后，他们将为%companyname%出生入死。

[color=#bd9d71]抢先体验说明：此版本仍处于积极开发中，不代表产品的最终品质。部分功能尚未完成或缺失，界面美术尚未制作，也会存在程序错误。经济、资源和敌人的平衡与成长节奏仍需调整，某些时候可能过难或过易。抢先体验期间还将加入大量内容，包括更多敌人、物品、委托、地形、独特地点、剧情事件及其他功能。[/color]

944b31c87fdf172c64f7.source: Sometimes it's better to do a tactical retreat in order to live and fight another day. The men will attempt to reach the edges of the map by themselves and then safely retreat. However, the enemy may catch up, and anyone currently engaged may not be able to get away unscathed or even alive.
944b31c87fdf172c64f7.translation: 有时，为了活着再战，战术撤退才是上策。弟兄们会自行尝试抵达地图边缘，然后安全撤离。但敌人可能追上来，正在近战缠斗的人未必能毫发无损地脱身，甚至可能丢掉性命。

9873f999397456374d52.source: The enemy is battered and beaten. Those few still alive scatter away in all directions. Will you hunt them down to claim their heads and possessions, or declare the battle won?
9873f999397456374d52.translation: 敌人已被彻底击溃，残存的几人正四散奔逃。要追上去夺取他们的首级与财物，还是就此宣布胜利？

3d13ef51cfbfedecb6ea.source: Don't slow down! At all times your Initiative is reduced only by [color=
3d13ef51cfbfedecb6ea.translation: 别慢下来！疲劳对先攻的惩罚始终只按当前疲劳值的[color=

a763142b6d46eb3d6478.source: Only the character whose turn it is right now can change items
