9dab66810280ebade31e.source: As brothers we fight, as brothers we die!
9dab66810280ebade31e.translation: 生为弟兄并肩战，死为弟兄共赴难！

f9c638b64d60c32efa03.source: Shields can be destroyed using axes and some two-handed weapons.
f9c638b64d60c32efa03.translation: 斧和部分双手武器可以摧毁盾牌。

fd8546c9092b66ac570a.source: Different types of shields are better suited against melee or ranged attacks.
fd8546c9092b66ac570a.translation: 不同盾牌各有所长，有的更适合防御近战，有的更适合抵挡远程攻击。

73df700f1e1a3ef77964.source: Shields take minor damage each time they are used to deflect an attack.
73df700f1e1a3ef77964.translation: 盾牌每次挡开攻击，都会受到少量损伤。

348dba502e942b40e9b2.source: Shrubbery can hide characters from being detected from afar.
348dba502e942b40e9b2.translation: 灌木丛能遮住角色，使远处的敌人难以发现他们。

3f1ac39522b9d542fe50.source: A character with a height level advantage over their opponent is harder to hit.
3f1ac39522b9d542fe50.translation: 占据高处的角色更难被低处的敌人击中。

349c4f52eeeb600544c4.source: Characters can see farther, the higher they are positioned.

f3e61a184972377a233f.source: Having men of different backgrounds in your company may enable you to perform different actions in events.
f3e61a184972377a233f.translation: 战团成员的背景越多样，在事件中可能采取的行动也越丰富。

b670ecee078781f49047.source: Surrounding an opponent from multiple sides makes it easier to score a hit.
b670ecee078781f49047.translation: 从多个方向包围敌人，会使其更容易被命中。

1e36596543100b294da8.source: Consider putting injured characters in reserve until their wounds have healed.
1e36596543100b294da8.translation: 受伤的弟兄可以暂时留在后备队伍，等伤口愈合后再上阵。

a80f4a9f9cc282d21436.source: Consider building up a reserve roster and rotating your men, so you can more easily deal with losses down the road.
a80f4a9f9cc282d21436.translation: 培养后备队员并轮换上阵，今后出现伤亡时便更容易应对。

182cf4ac654e50b5ff9f.source: Ranged weapon accuracy drops with distance.
182cf4ac654e50b5ff9f.translation: 距离越远，远程武器的命中率越低。

6adaa50d862d6af2fa51.source: You don't have to be a hero, you're running a business.
6adaa50d862d6af2fa51.translation: 你不必当英雄，你经营的是一门生意。

31488e764f5e2922e7f0.source: Different backgrounds may unlock additional options at handling events and contracts.
31488e764f5e2922e7f0.translation: 不同的人物背景可能解锁事件与委托中的额外选项。

ad6266ff22ff02ffb45f.source: Drag and drop your men in the inventory screen to where you want them to be in your formation.
ad6266ff22ff02ffb45f.translation: 在装备界面拖动队员，即可调整他们在阵形中的位置。

96809b2f460b62b03cb0.source: A missed ranged attack can hit nearby characters, especially if they are in the direct line of fire.
96809b2f460b62b03cb0.translation: 远程攻击落空后可能击中附近角色，尤其是站在射击路径上的人。

9e435b7b1fe1423c1f87.source: Bows can not be fired and crossbows not be reloaded while engaged in melee.
9e435b7b1fe1423c1f87.translation: 近战缠斗时无法射箭，也无法为弩重新装填。

2e35ac446653128fd6ed.source: Bows perform better against unarmored targets.
2e35ac446653128fd6ed.translation: 弓更适合对付缺乏护甲的目标。

f9116ebcedae20514cd4.source: Daggers can be used to attack weak spots in armor and deal damage directly to hitpoints.
f9116ebcedae20514cd4.translation: 匕首能瞄准护甲的薄弱处，直接造成生命值伤害。

eaa790c10e29bf4a729d.source: Ranged weapons work best when firing into groups of enemies - they are bound to hit someone.
eaa790c10e29bf4a729d.translation: 向密集的敌群射击，远程武器更能发挥作用——总会打中谁。

9b3db48fbaee7327a296.source: Consider forming a shieldwall when surrounded.
9b3db48fbaee7327a296.translation: 遭到包围时，可以考虑结成盾墙。

4a9369a006fe0eb68cb9.source: Conserve your stamina when in prolonged engagements.

661c09113e62f56e911d.source: Success in Battle Brothers is also about picking the right fights.
661c09113e62f56e911d.translation: 在《战场兄弟》中，懂得挑选该打的仗同样重要。

2d37019147e8837727aa.source: Undead are unaffected by fatigue and morale.
2d37019147e8837727aa.translation: 亡灵不受疲劳与士气影响。

4906566bf7560b240d2c.source: Crossbows require less skill to fire accurately than bows, but are slower to use.
4906566bf7560b240d2c.translation: 弩比弓更容易射准，但使用节奏也更慢。

676e1e1392690c8add6a.source: Each type of weapon has advantages and disadvantages.
676e1e1392690c8add6a.translation: 每类武器都有自己的长处与短处。

968f0a0d687f9f0d6ee1.source: Some difficult terrain, like swamp, gives combat penalties.
968f0a0d687f9f0d6ee1.translation: 沼泽等恶劣地形会带来战斗惩罚。

cbcea1c8c8964945f303.source: You can change camera height levels using the + and - keys.
cbcea1c8c8964945f303.translation: 使用+和-键，可以切换镜头显示的地形高度层。

faeedb956fa429cd1513.source: Clubs and maces can stun or incapacitate targets.
faeedb956fa429cd1513.translation: 棍棒和钉锤能将目标击晕，使其暂时失去行动能力。

985bac49ebe2a3236c36.source: Try to save some crowns for when things turn sour.
985bac49ebe2a3236c36.translation: 留些克朗，以备不时之需。

b991694c9a066b17803f.source: Longswords and Greatswords can hit multiple targets with one strike.
b991694c9a066b17803f.translation: 长剑和巨剑能够一击命中多个目标。

da1d211ef7b219244d08.source: You can zoom in and out using the mouse wheel or Page Up and Page Down keys.
da1d211ef7b219244d08.translation: 使用鼠标滚轮，或Page Up与Page Down键，可以缩放镜头。

47404b39254e2e4a2bf8.source: Spears are good defensive weapons due to their Spearwall ability.
47404b39254e2e4a2bf8.translation: 矛墙让长矛成为优秀的防御武器。

b9bc86ba2739f472b3c4.translation: 做好失去一些弟兄的准备。

202efa92ad5fa6ddb499.source: Use terrain and chokepoints to your advantage.
202efa92ad5fa6ddb499.translation: 利用地形与狭窄通道占据优势。

2bfa4e746b0285c4c238.source: The higher their level, the more your men will demand in wages.
2bfa4e746b0285c4c238.translation: 弟兄们等级越高，要求的薪酬也越高。

e028e7d5e33c5de41ecb.source: Selling in rich and big cities will net you the most crowns for your goods.
e028e7d5e33c5de41ecb.translation: 在富裕的大城市出售货物，往往能换来最多的克朗。

d21143e197c37bc51285.source: Use throwing nets to restrict the movement of particularly dangerous enemies.
d21143e197c37bc51285.translation: 用投网限制特别危险的敌人的行动。

56de7ba178afd8768547.source: Use trading to supplement your income.
56de7ba178afd8768547.translation: 买卖贸易货物可以补贴收入。

da3526227cf4373b5c83.source: Learn the 'Rotation' or 'Footwork' perks for additional mobility in battle.
da3526227cf4373b5c83.translation: 学习“换位”或“灵活步法”，可以提升战场上的机动能力。

2c8bf1f465d9bf9caad1.source: View range is decreased at night, both in combat and on the worldmap.
2c8bf1f465d9bf9caad1.translation: 夜间的视野会缩小，战场和大地图都是如此。

b0a85f87f23dcffc49a0.source: Skeletons are highly resistant to ranged attacks and fire.
b0a85f87f23dcffc49a0.translation: 骷髅对远程攻击和火焰有很强的抗性。

9c84023f3d2a54123f1e.source: Heavy armor offers great protection, but also slows down the wearer and makes him tire more quickly.
9c84023f3d2a54123f1e.translation: 重甲防护出色，却也会拖慢动作，让穿戴者更容易疲劳。

1c8e084b7db5359acb5f.source: Heavy helmets can be hard to breathe in and limit the field of vision.
1c8e084b7db5359acb5f.translation: 沉重的头盔可能妨碍呼吸，并限制视野。

c45a330b32129041cb09.source: Warhammers and Military Picks can make short work of heavy armor.
c45a330b32129041cb09.translation: 战锤和军用镐能迅速击碎重甲。

377eadfaf62d265f8f72.source: The Billhook, Pike and Longaxe can attack over 2 tiles, unlike most other melee weapons.
377eadfaf62d265f8f72.translation: 与大多数近战武器不同，钩镰枪、长枪和长柄斧能攻击2格外的目标。

75db4b24b40db26a8b70.source: Flails ignore the defense bonus of shields.
75db4b24b40db26a8b70.translation: 链枷能无视盾牌提供的防御加成。

ea89d96d2a09429df037.source: Different types of enemies require different tactics to beat reliably.
ea89d96d2a09429df037.translation: 对付不同敌人，需要采用不同战术才能稳操胜券。

e26574f6b83a0ade7729.source: Every enemy in the game can be beat reliably with the right approach.
e26574f6b83a0ade7729.translation: 只要方法得当，游戏中的每种敌人都能被稳妥击败。

214fede0de07104c9f32.source: A human is no match for an adult orc physically.
214fede0de07104c9f32.translation: 论体格，人类无法与成年兽人匹敌。

90d4f1b3ca7b8f51ae21.source: Orcs rely on raw power and physical prowess.
90d4f1b3ca7b8f51ae21.translation: 兽人依靠的是蛮力与强悍的体魄。

d680eea17a00609ce365.source: A goblin is no match for an adult human physically, so they rely on wit and dirty tricks.
d680eea17a00609ce365.translation: 地精的体格敌不过成年男人，因此格外倚仗计谋和卑鄙伎俩。

abd2e2c068d8a77c7618.source: Orc Berserkers gain rage and get tougher to take down, the more blood they have drawn.
abd2e2c068d8a77c7618.translation: 兽人狂战士制造的鲜血越多，怒气就越盛，也越难被击倒。

b6cd43dd07d1668d959f.source: Geists are lost between the physical world and the world beyond, constantly shifting between the two.
b6cd43dd07d1668d959f.translation: 怨魂迷失在现世与彼岸之间，不断在两个世界中游移。

c0bf20862b162c5c6e26.source: Geists test the resolve of your men - the lower, the more likely they are to panic and flee.
c0bf20862b162c5c6e26.translation: 怨魂考验的是弟兄们的决心；决心越低，越容易惊慌溃逃。

8a3316509d83db934878.source: Two-handed axes can hit both head and body with a single hit.
8a3316509d83db934878.translation: 双手斧一击可以同时命中头部和身体。

fe5dbab88636c77344ac.source: Two-handed axes can hit up to 6 targets with a single round swing.
fe5dbab88636c77344ac.translation: 双手斧一次回旋斩最多能击中6个目标。

eb64b81a443efbe659b1.source: Roads are the fastest way to travel over land, but not always the safest.
eb64b81a443efbe659b1.translation: 走道路是陆上旅行最快的方式，却未必最安全。

5e0324829879f9780934.source: Forests can hide many dangers within.
5e0324829879f9780934.translation: 森林深处可能潜藏着重重危险。

4d481ed08d586cdb3563.source: Always keep a good stock of provisions - lest your men starve and desert you!
4d481ed08d586cdb3563.translation: 始终备足食物，免得弟兄们挨饿后弃你而去！

ecf6fcc62ebdb957ff20.source: Wiedergangers are the dead walking again.
ecf6fcc62ebdb957ff20.translation: 行尸，就是重新站起来行走的死人。

17e7bb6b14eb88bdbdeb.source: Difficult terrain, such as mountains and swamp, has your men use more supplies on the worldmap.
17e7bb6b14eb88bdbdeb.translation: 山地、沼泽等难行地形会增加队伍在大地图上的补给消耗。

8cc04af626f67a98277c.source: If you can not win, retreat to fight another day.
8cc04af626f67a98277c.translation: 打不赢就撤，留着命下次再战。

833826c581519dab8862.source: Retreat. Flee. Don't fight every battle to the death.
833826c581519dab8862.translation: 撤退也好，逃跑也罢，别每场战斗都拼到最后一人。

178022c2cbd91f5fcffc.source: Use the spacebar key to pause on the worldmap.
178022c2cbd91f5fcffc.translation: 在大地图上按空格键暂停。

44de64758279d8a9b906.source: Elevated terrain like hills and mountains allow you to see farther on the worldmap.
44de64758279d8a9b906.translation: 在大地图上，登上丘陵或山脉等高地能看得更远。

cc76f1cd821eab623b87.source: Not every contract is worth the risk.
cc76f1cd821eab623b87.translation: 并非每份委托都值得冒险。

f88bd2a140a7831f420b.source: Try to negotiate better payment for your contracts.
f88bd2a140a7831f420b.translation: 接取委托时，试着谈个更好的价钱。

76748e5936001f87e037.source: Try to negotiate payment modalities that guarantee you the most money for contracts.
76748e5936001f87e037.translation: 协商委托的付款方式时，尽量选择能确保获得最多报酬的方案。

0c15dd1e8995d0a36fd2.source: Not every battle can be won.
0c15dd1e8995d0a36fd2.translation: 并非每场战斗都能获胜。

cbfc6869274d0a60994c.source: A life can be worth little in this world.
cbfc6869274d0a60994c.translation: 在这个世界，一条人命有时不值几个钱。

10cbb5bebc427408a629.source: Betraying your employer can have repercussions in the long run.
10cbb5bebc427408a629.translation: 背叛雇主可能招来长远的恶果。

cf340ce29f1a72159817.source: Some parts of the world are more dangerous than others.
cf340ce29f1a72159817.translation: 有些地区比其他地方危险得多。

d56ca3b394bc01c4135f.source: Use ports to fast travel around the world.
d56ca3b394bc01c4135f.translation: 利用港口，可以在各地快速往来。

f7dd52bcb2fb5680e993.source: Some people will use you and throw you away.
f7dd52bcb2fb5680e993.translation: 有些人会利用你，再将你弃如敝履。

fcc5ee11359cb55f27db.source: Throwing weapons can be deadly on short distances, but their accuracy drops sharply the farther away the target.
fcc5ee11359cb55f27db.translation: 投掷武器在近距离十分致命，但距离越远，命中率下降越明显。

013f0f2880390fca9378.source: Highly talented characters can come from all backgrounds.
013f0f2880390fca9378.translation: 任何出身都可能出现天赋出众的人才。

3d50825845a23988c3c4.source: Try the Ironman mode to experience Battle Brothers the way it's meant to be played.
3d50825845a23988c3c4.translation: 尝试铁人模式，体验《战场兄弟》原本设想的玩法。

112aa01000e2ab571067.source: Ranged weapons are less accurate at night - those of your enemies included.
112aa01000e2ab571067.translation: 夜间远程武器的命中率更低，敌人的也不例外。

0118994e77103101c0aa.source: Make camp to have your men heal and repair their equipment faster.
0118994e77103101c0aa.translation: 扎营能让弟兄们更快养伤、修理装备。

7c13ceb7de47406720aa.source: Use ALT + Right Click to mark items for repair in your stash. Items equipped by your men are repaired automatically.
7c13ceb7de47406720aa.translation: 按住ALT并右键点击仓库物品，可将其标记为待修理。弟兄们已装备的物品会自动修理。

5cc39a5d44e11c777acd.source: You can have your items repaired at the smith for a fee by using ALT + Right Click.
5cc39a5d44e11c777acd.translation: 在铁匠铺按住ALT并右键点击物品，可以付费修理。

25c43d5ac2b89cbf1f50.source: Breaking a contract will anger your employer - especially if you've received advance payment.
25c43d5ac2b89cbf1f50.translation: 撕毁契约会激怒雇主，尤其是你已经收了预付款的时候。

656031edfb02e4a45c03.source: Fortifications will only offer you contracts from the noble house that owns them.
656031edfb02e4a45c03.translation: 要塞只提供所属贵族家族的委托。

f1b2a348d62c34e58896.source: Nobles give contracts only to mercenary companies with professional renown.
f1b2a348d62c34e58896.translation: 贵族只会将委托交给声望达到“专业”的佣兵战团。

ecbd30344ed707c449de.source: If contract negotiations turn sour, it will damage your relations with your potential employer.
ecbd30344ed707c449de.translation: 委托谈判破裂会损害你与潜在雇主的关系。

05b6f996e02a4dbc46dd.source: You can find contract offers in the top left of settlement screens.
05b6f996e02a4dbc46dd.translation: 聚落界面左上角可以查看可接取的委托。

7d53e8ce21fbe841be3c.source: You may find powerful named items far away from civilization by exploring or following tavern rumors.
7d53e8ce21fbe841be3c.translation: 探索远离文明的荒野，或追寻酒馆中的传闻，可能找到强大的冠名装备。

fd937c58f884fcc13408.source: Dying is part of a mercenary's job description.
fd937c58f884fcc13408.translation: 送命，也是佣兵这份差事的一部分。

582a2cc1e187f9bde8a0.source: Keep an eye on the mood of your men. If they are angry for too long, they may desert!
582a2cc1e187f9bde8a0.translation: 留意弟兄们的心情。积怨过久，他们可能逃离战团！

ed1ca5cebbc96ec7742b.source: If you keep losing to an enemy, change your tactics!
ed1ca5cebbc96ec7742b.translation: 若总被同一种敌人击败，就该换个战术了！

4a42ae5c16d1cc634913.source: The larger a party on the worldmap, the slower it moves. Yours included.
4a42ae5c16d1cc634913.translation: 大地图上的队伍规模越大，行进就越慢，你的队伍也不例外。

fc89a9387b4c1d9fb326.source: Use wardogs to hunt down elusive or fleeing enemies.
fc89a9387b4c1d9fb326.translation: 让战犬追击难以接近或正在逃跑的敌人。

f2c64e6c9136cdc4673f.source: Use a trained falcon to discover hidden enemies on difficult terrain.
f2c64e6c9136cdc4673f.translation: 放出训练有素的猎鹰，可以发现复杂地形中隐藏的敌人。

72756c89fb46c293949b.translation: 砍刀可以撕开流血的伤口。

351f87d0d9135596eb4d.source: Fulfilling ambitions will raise everyone's mood and grant you renown, as well as some unique rewards.
351f87d0d9135596eb4d.translation: 实现抱负能改善全团心情、提升声望，还可能获得独特奖励。

4941b78e31e823a22b44.source: Use CTRL + Left Click to attack allied parties on the worldmap. This only works if you are currently unemployed.
4941b78e31e823a22b44.translation: 按住CTRL并左键点击大地图上的友方队伍，可以发动攻击。仅在当前没有接受委托时可用。

73990c92b30b7b4249e9.source: Your men will interact with each other differently depending on their backgrounds and traits.
73990c92b30b7b4249e9.translation: 弟兄们的背景与特性不同，彼此相处时也会产生不同的互动。

f4696e9153ac2f98178d.source: Stunned characters get no attack of opportunity when someone moves inside their zone of control.
f4696e9153ac2f98178d.translation: 角色眩晕时，敌人在其控制区域内移动也不会触发借机攻击。

1e84adca20686930f1d8.source: Try playing a campaign in veteran mode once you've gained some experience - it's the recommended difficulty.
1e84adca20686930f1d8.translation: 积累一些经验后，可以尝试老兵难度战役，这是推荐的难度。

b4fe05ab2fc55974c933.source: The minimum hit chance for any attack is 5%, and the maximum hit chance for any attack is 95%.
b4fe05ab2fc55974c933.translation: 任何攻击的最低命中率为5%，最高命中率为95%。

41551d876a2ab797870c.source: Characters may sometimes be struck down during combat, but not outright killed, and will survive with a permanent injury.
41551d876a2ab797870c.translation: 角色在战斗中被击倒后，有时并未真正死亡，而是带着永久伤势幸存下来。

14b684d8a27bedba8666.source: Learn from your mistakes. Don't just repeat them and hope you'll get lucky this time.
14b684d8a27bedba8666.translation: 从失误中吸取教训。别一再重蹈覆辙，只盼着这次运气好。

a6937c42ff16cc636c52.source: The natural habitat of direwolves is the forest.
a6937c42ff16cc636c52.translation: 森林是恐狼的天然栖息地。

0c7e47c6b1ea049e115d.source: You can enable faster AI turns in the options menu.
0c7e47c6b1ea049e115d.translation: 在设置中可以开启更快的敌方行动速度。

f8b99eb43ec3161b9f28.source: Trees can be hidden in combat using the 'T' key.
f8b99eb43ec3161b9f28.translation: 战斗中按T键可以隐藏树木。

08b899474c056fbcebd2.source: Objects blocking tiles can be highlighted using the 'B' key.
08b899474c056fbcebd2.translation: 按B键可高亮显示阻挡地格的障碍物。

46b0a36df09454b750b5.source: Higher renown will unlock more difficult contracts and better pay.
46b0a36df09454b750b5.translation: 更高的声望会解锁更难的委托，也能带来更丰厚的报酬。

1aa48894959827fee8cd.source: If your plan can fail with bad luck, maybe it isn't good enough of a plan.
1aa48894959827fee8cd.translation: 如果一点坏运气就能让计划全盘失败，也许计划本身还不够周全。

278b89e0024faa93cf6e.source: Do the job. Survive. Get paid.

054fcb7c6b417c46b636.source: If a character waits their turn, their position in the turn order of the next round is determined with a penalty of 25% to Initiative.
054fcb7c6b417c46b636.translation: 角色选择等待后，下一轮的行动顺序会按先攻降低25%计算。

def430aa56db0a3e3c30.source: A 95% chance to hit is also a 5% chance to miss.
def430aa56db0a3e3c30.translation: 95%的命中率，也意味着5%的落空几率。

4277536eac1501caa27c.source: The 'Lone Wolf' perk is not affected by nearby dogs or allies that are not part of your company.
4277536eac1501caa27c.translation: 附近的犬类或不属于本战团的友军，不会影响“孤狼”特长。

eebcd41115699c8366df.source: The 'Fast Adaptation' perk reduces variance of randomness.
eebcd41115699c8366df.translation: “快速适应”能减轻运气起伏对命中的影响。

7f74f6907a97f238f7b9.source: Consider that enemy encampments on hills are harder to assault, especially if they are fortified.
7f74f6907a97f238f7b9.translation: 山丘上的敌军营地更难攻打，尤其是筑有防御工事的营地。

0e2b51366f23526aa638.translation: 巴拉·斯克拉布斯拉加什

3ce656086234e3262307.translation: %randomname%之墓，称号： {伟大的 | 残酷的 | 暴君}

b48485850d2b5b774154.translation: 被遗忘的伐木工人之家

7c2c1c4c49511604ade0.translation: 过度生长的伐木者小屋

f317eb3550f5979c28c9.translation: 克鲁姆布尔德霍姆斯泰德

7e4d77a80c2de41a36c6.source: A rough and tough band of brigands out to hunt for food.
7e4d77a80c2de41a36c6.translation: 一伙凶悍的强盗，正在外出搜寻食物。

9edb4f2df5a9c4be22c4.source: A band of mischievous goblins, small but cunning and not to be underestimated.
9edb4f2df5a9c4be22c4.translation: 一伙作恶的地精，个头虽小，却十分狡猾，不容小觑。

be0eb18ecef7bbadf835.source: A band of menacing orcs, greenskinned and towering any man.
be0eb18ecef7bbadf835.translation: 一群来势汹汹的兽人，浑身绿皮，比任何人类都高大。

98517734c0f1e5aa16df.source: A legion of walking dead, back to claim from the living what was once theirs.
98517734c0f1e5aa16df.translation: 一支重新站起的亡者军团，要从活人手中夺回曾属于他们的一切。

fba0cb4f8dc011ff2312.source: Equip up to three of your men with arena collars
fba0cb4f8dc011ff2312.translation: 让至多三名弟兄佩戴竞技场项圈

a0516f3612bd96156f9e.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight
a0516f3612bd96156f9e.translation: 再次进入竞技场，开始战斗

c59364ab0af7e1ec39e2.source: The fight will be to the death and you won't be able to retreat or loot afterwards
c59364ab0af7e1ec39e2.translation: 战斗至死方休，无法撤退，战后也不能收取战利品

c40a8d1e0caf2ccc6732.source: Win a piece of gladiator gear

ad8c09b512a79390b6d5.source: {We shall turn the sand red with blood! | I want to hear the crowd chant our names! | We'll slaughter them like lambs!}
ad8c09b512a79390b6d5.translation: {我们要用鲜血染红沙地！ | 我要听全场高呼我们的名字！ | 我们要像宰羊一样杀光他们！}

60189449bee3795611af.source: {This isn't what I had in mind. | I'll sit this one out. | I'll wait for the next fight.}
60189449bee3795611af.translation: {这跟我想的不一样。 | 这次我就不参加了。 | 我等下一场。}

cecf8323057ce4bfd6c3.source: This arena fight works as follows. Do you agree to the terms?
cecf8323057ce4bfd6c3.translation: 本场角斗规则如下。你同意这些条件吗？

ac7876885ca6b8a89a3f.source: I'll have to think it over.

09e467642f708b1bb02b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]{As you wait your turn, the crowd's bloodlust crawls through the dark, sheets of dust falling from above, the stomps of feet thunderous. They murmur in anticipation, and roar at killings. The quiet between battles is mere moments, and this silence is snatched away as the rusted gate lurches upward, chains rankling, the crowd abuzz once more. You step out into the light and so thunderous is the noise against your heart it could surely yet spur a dead man forth... | The arena's crowd is shoulder to shoulder, most blathering drunk. They scream and shout, their languages a mix of local and foreign, though the appeal to their bloodlust needs little articulation beyond their maddened faces and pumping fists. Now, the %companyname%'s men will satiate these mad fools... | Cleaners hurry about the arena. They drag away the bodies, collect what's worth collecting, and occasionally throw a trophy into the crowds, eliciting a moblike rendition of the arena's battles in the stands themselves. The %companyname% is now a part of this affair. | The arena awaits, the crowd alight, and the %companyname%'s turn to gain glory is at hand! | The crowd booms as the %companyname%'s men stride into its bloody pit. Despite the mindless bloodlust of the peoples, you can't help but feel a beat of pride in your chest, knowing that it is your company ready to put on a show. | The gate rises. Nothing is heard save the rattle of chains, the creak of pulleys, the grunts of slaves at work. When the men of the %companyname% step out of the arena's bowels they can hear the crunch of sand underfoot until they come to stand in the center of the pit. A strange voice screams from the tops of the stadium, some lost language beyond your knowing, but the words echo just once before the crowd erupts with cheers and roaring. Now is the time your men shall prove themselves before the watchful eye of the commoner. | The %companyname%'s business is rarely done before the eyes of those who would prefer themselves distantly separated from such violence. But in the arena, the commoner greedily awaits death and suffering, and it growls with bloodlust as your men enter the pits, and roars as the sellswords draw their weapons and ready for battle. | The arena is shaped like the pit of some sore, its ceiling torn away by the gods, revealing the vanity, bloodlust, and savagery of man. And it is man there, yelling and screaming, and if the blood sprays hit them, they wash their faces in the gore and grin at one another as though it were a joke. They fight one another for trophies and relish in the pain of others. And it is before these peoples that the %companyname% will fight, and for them they shall entertain and entertain well. | The arena's crowd is a mash of classes, rich and poor, for only the Viziers separate themselves out into stations above all. Briefly unified, the peoples of %townname% have graciously come together to watch men and monsters murder one another. With pleasure, the %companyname% seeks to do its part. | Boys sitting on the shoulders of fathers, young girls throwing flowers to the gladiators, women fanning themselves, men wondering if they could do it. These are the peoples of the arena - and the rest are all drunk out of their gourd and screaming nonsense. You hope the %companyname% can contribute to at least an hour or two to entertaining this mad lot. | The crowd roars as the %companyname%'s men step into the pit. One would be dumb to confuse excitement for desire, for as soon as the applause ends there is a smattering of empty beer mugs and rotten tomatoes and the general giggling delight of those watching the matter. You wonder if the %companyname%'s men are really best spent here, but then think hard on the gold and glory to be won, and that at the end of the day these mongrels in the stands will go home to their shit lives, and you'll go home to your shit life as well, but at least your pockets will be a bit deeper.}
09e467642f708b1bb02b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]{等候上场时，观众的嗜血狂热钻进了黑暗。头顶尘土簌簌而落，跺脚声轰鸣如雷。他们在期待中低语，又在杀戮时怒吼。两场战斗间的安静不过片刻，随即便被骤然升起的锈铁闸门打破。铁链哗啦作响，人群再次沸腾。你步入阳光，雷鸣般的声浪撞进胸膛，仿佛连死人都能被它催着向前…… | 竞技场的观众挤得肩挨着肩，大多喝得烂醉，满口胡话。他们尖叫呼喊，本地话与异乡话混杂在一起。不过，那些癫狂的脸和挥动的拳头，已经足以说明他们有多渴望鲜血。如今，轮到%companyname%的弟兄们来满足这群疯子了…… | 清场的人在竞技场里忙来忙去，拖走尸体，收起值得留下的东西，偶尔还往看台抛一件战利品。于是观众席也闹成一团，仿佛将场中的厮杀又演了一遍。如今，%companyname%也成了这场盛事的一部分。 | 竞技场虚位以待，观众热血沸腾，%companyname%赢取荣耀的时刻到了！ | %companyname%的弟兄们迈入血迹斑斑的斗场，观众爆发出轰鸣般的欢呼。这些人固然只是盲目地渴求鲜血，可想到即将献上表演的是自己的战团，你胸中仍不禁涌起一丝骄傲。 | 闸门升起，耳边只有铁链的响动、滑轮的吱嘎，以及奴隶干活时的闷哼。%companyname%的弟兄们从竞技场腹地走出来，能清楚听见脚下沙土的摩擦声，直到站定在场地中央。看台高处，一个陌生的声音高声叫喊，说的是你不懂的古老语言。话音只回荡一遍，便被观众的欢呼怒吼淹没。现在，弟兄们该在平民的注视下证明自己了。 | 平日里，%companyname%干活时，很少有旁人围观——人们总希望离那种暴力越远越好。可到了竞技场，平民却贪婪地等候死亡与痛苦。弟兄们入场时，他们嗜血地低吼；佣兵拔出武器准备作战时，他们又纵声咆哮。 | 竞技场像一处溃烂的疮口，被诸神撕去顶盖，将人的虚荣、嗜血与野蛮尽数暴露。里面的确都是人，吼着，叫着；若鲜血溅到身上，他们便抹得满脸都是，再互相咧嘴笑，仿佛这是什么笑话。他们为战利品打成一团，以别人的痛苦取乐。%companyname%就要在这群人面前作战，供他们消遣，而且得让他们看个尽兴。 | 竞技场的观众混杂着各个阶层，贫富挤作一团，只有维齐尔高坐于众人之上，单独占着席位。%townname%的居民暂时放下分歧，欢聚一堂，只为观看人和怪物互相残杀。%companyname%很乐意为此出一份力。 | 男孩骑在父亲肩上，少女向角斗士抛花，女人给自己扇风，男人则暗想自己上去能否有同样的本事。这便是竞技场的观众——剩下的人都已醉得不省人事，只会嚷些胡话。你希望%companyname%至少能让这群疯子快活上一两个小时。 | %companyname%的弟兄们一踏进斗场，观众便纵声欢呼。若把兴奋当作喜爱，那可真是傻：掌声刚落，空酒杯和烂番茄便零零散散地飞来，看热闹的人乐得咯咯直笑。你不禁怀疑，让%companyname%的弟兄们待在这里，是否有些浪费。不过，想想能赢到的金子与荣耀，再想想一天结束后，看台上的杂种们会回去过他们那狗屎般的日子，你也会回去过自己那狗屎般的日子，只是口袋至少能鼓上一点，便又觉得值得了。}

87b205649c2bfa22663e.source: Let's give the crowd something to cheer for!
87b205649c2bfa22663e.translation: 让观众们好好欢呼一场！

75412c1a90ae0e28e6c0.source: We're not doing this. I don't want to die!
75412c1a90ae0e28e6c0.translation: 我们不干了，我可不想死！

2342acff6f6a1358dec5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{The arena master talks as if he doesn't even remember your face, then again he probably doesn't.%SPEECH_ON%Here's your pay, please come again.%SPEECH_OFF%The arena will be closed for the day, but you could return as early as tomorrow. | Without even raising his head from a rag of papyrus, the arena master throws you a purse of coin.%SPEECH_ON%I heard the crowds, and so here are your crowns. May you come visit the pits again.%SPEECH_OFF%The arena will be closed for the day, but you could return as early as tomorrow. | The arena master is waiting for you.%SPEECH_ON%That was a mighty fine show, Crownling. Would not mind it in the slightest if you come back again.%SPEECH_OFF%The arena will be closed for the day, but you could return as early as tomorrow.}
2342acff6f6a1358dec5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{竞技场管事开口时，仿佛连你的脸都不记得了。话说回来，他多半确实不记得。%SPEECH_ON%这是你的酬劳，欢迎再来。%SPEECH_OFF%竞技场今天不再开放，不过最快明天你就能再来。 | 竞技场管事连头都没从那张破纸草上抬起来，便扔给你一个钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%我听见观众的欢呼了，所以这些克朗归你。下回再来竞技场吧。%SPEECH_OFF%竞技场今天不再开放，不过最快明天你就能再来。 | 竞技场管事正在等你。%SPEECH_ON%好一场精彩的表演，克朗客。你要再来，我可是求之不得。%SPEECH_OFF%竞技场今天不再开放，不过最快明天你就能再来。}

9d65bdde1203854e3e45.source: {Victory! | Are you not entertained?! | Killed it. | A bloody spectacle.}
9d65bdde1203854e3e45.translation: {胜利！ | 这场好戏还不够让你们尽兴吗？！ | 干掉了。 | 真是一场血腥的好戏。}

3a9641bbdae0763cb494.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{The %companyname%'s men have been defeated, either dead or, perhaps worse, badly mangled. At least the crowds are happy. In the pits, any showing, even that which ends in demise, is a good showing.}
3a9641bbdae0763cb494.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{%companyname%的弟兄们败下阵来，不是死了，就是——或许比死更惨——被打得残缺不全。至少观众很满意。在竞技场里，凡是演出，哪怕以死亡收场，也算得上一场好戏。}

0bc82f4a680a02fd7b52.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]The time for your arena match has come and passed, but you didn't show up there. Perhaps something more important came up, or perhaps you've just been hiding like cowards. Either way, your reputation will suffer because of this.
0bc82f4a680a02fd7b52.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]约定的角斗赛时间已经过去，你们却没有到场。或许有更重要的事耽搁了，也或许只是像懦夫一样躲了起来。无论如何，这都会损害你们的声誉。

c733a4b8d5b358bb3fb4.source:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]The time for your arena match has come, but none of your men bear the arena collars, and so they aren't let in.

You should decide on who is to fight by equipping them with the arena collars that you've been given, and the match will start once you enter the arena again.
c733a4b8d5b358bb3fb4.translation:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]角斗赛的时间到了，可弟兄们谁也没戴竞技场项圈，因此无法入场。

将领到的竞技场项圈装备给你选定的参赛者，再次进入竞技场，比赛便会开始。

2b5507c55cf33b5b1154.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]The fight over, you find a few women sauntering upon you and the gladiators. They are practically swooning, faces blushed, and the men take special care of them. A little tired yourself, you have one of the fans help you count inventory. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]The battle's over, but a shadow suddenly crosses the ground. In a flash, you unsheathe and slash the sky. Flower petals shower your glistening body and you catch the rest of the bouquet in your teeth. A woman stands there fanning herself.%SPEECH_ON%I wondered why you didn't fight.%SPEECH_OFF%She says. You sheathe your blade and tie the bouquet to your belt. You tell her that if you fought, it wouldn't be a 'fight' at all. The fan goes weak at the knees and finds comfort on the ground. Before leaving, you tell her to drink plenty of water and make sure she stretches in the mornings. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%SPEECH_START%Can I learn to fight like you men?%SPEECH_OFF%The voices catches you off guard and before you know it you have your blade an inch from a little boy's face. His eyes are shut, and he slowly opens one. You sheathe the sword and laugh.%SPEECH_ON%No. What I am cannot be learned.%SPEECH_OFF%You use a bit of ash and blood from the field to sign the kid's shirt and then make your leave. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%SPEECH_START%Are you... are you gladiators?%SPEECH_OFF%You look to see a boy standing there with awe on his face. He almost cries he's so giddy.%SPEECH_ON%You're amazing!%SPEECH_OFF%Tussling the boy's hair, you tell him thanks, and make your leave. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%SPEECH_START%H-how did you get so good?%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to see a boy nervously staring at you. Smiling, you give him the truth.%SPEECH_ON%When I was your age, I was killing men my age.%SPEECH_OFF%Grinning back, he asks if he works on it, can he be like you. Nodding, you answer.%SPEECH_ON%You can't know until you try, kid. Now go on home.%SPEECH_OFF%The boy brandishes a butter knife and fiendishly turns and sprints away. He's a good lad.}
2b5507c55cf33b5b1154.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]战斗结束，几个女人摇曳着身姿，向你和角斗士们走来。她们脸颊绯红，几乎激动得站不住，弟兄们便格外殷勤地照顾起她们。你自己也有点累，于是叫一位崇拜者帮忙清点物资。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]战斗结束，地上却忽然掠过一道影子。电光石火间，你拔剑朝空中一斩。花瓣纷纷洒落在你汗光闪亮的身上，剩下的花束则被你叼在齿间。一个女人站在那里，正给自己扇风。%SPEECH_ON%我还在想，你怎么没上场。%SPEECH_OFF%她说。你收剑入鞘，将花束系在腰带上，告诉她，若你出手，那就根本算不上“较量”了。这位崇拜者双膝一软，只得坐到地上缓口气。临走前，你叮嘱她多喝水，早晨记得活动筋骨。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%SPEECH_START%我能学会像你们一样打仗吗？%SPEECH_OFF%这声音来得猝不及防，等你反应过来，剑锋已抵在一个小男孩脸前，不过一寸之遥。他紧闭着眼睛，随后慢慢睁开一只。你收剑入鞘，笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不能。我这样的本事，学不来。%SPEECH_OFF%你从场上蘸了点灰与血，在孩子的衬衣上签下名字，然后离开。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%SPEECH_START%你们……你们是角斗士吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你循声望去，一个男孩站在那里，满脸敬畏，激动得几乎要哭出来。%SPEECH_ON%你们太厉害了！%SPEECH_OFF%你揉乱他的头发，道了声谢，随后离开。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%SPEECH_START%你、你们怎么变得这么厉害的？%SPEECH_OFF%你转头，看见一个男孩紧张地望着你。微微一笑，你实话实说。%SPEECH_ON%我像你这么大时，就已经在杀跟我一样大的人了。%SPEECH_OFF%他也咧嘴笑了，问只要下功夫，能不能变得和你一样。你点点头，回答道。%SPEECH_ON%不试试怎么知道，孩子。现在回家去吧。%SPEECH_OFF%男孩亮出一把抹黄油的餐刀，坏笑着转身飞奔而去。好孩子。}

02b84a27cdac34f88a31.translation: {他妈的，我们可真有本事。 | 我们就是最好的。}

bfd3ab5ef751cbbbc3a9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]Dozens of men mingle about the arena's entrance. Some stand stoically, not wishing to give any hint of their capabilities. Others, however, boast and brag with aplomb, either sincerely confident in their martial skills or hoping their bravado masks any holes in their game.
bfd3ab5ef751cbbbc3a9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]几十名汉子聚在竞技场入口附近。有些人默然肃立，不愿泄露半点本领；另一些人则大方地夸口吹嘘，或是确实对武艺充满信心，或是盼着这股虚张声势能遮住自己的破绽。

5f9e5fabc36a61bc62e7.source: A grizzled man, the master of the arena, holds up a scroll and taps it with a hook for a hand.
5f9e5fabc36a61bc62e7.translation: 竞技场主管是个饱经风霜的汉子。他举起一卷文书，用代替手的铁钩敲了敲。

2dcb38fd38ca2f12b3e4.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against one Swordmaster
2dcb38fd38ca2f12b3e4.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战一名剑术大师

90b857924504957408c0.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against one Swordmaster and %amount% raiders
90b857924504957408c0.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战一名剑术大师和%amount%名劫掠者

3f55e4ded4138ba6e9ba.source: %SPEECH_ON%They put a star beside his name, the mark of the Gilder. That means his path is a gilded one. What you need to know is that he is a swordmaster. You may find some comfort in that he is an elder man, but you'd not be the first I have said that to, understand? May your path be as Gilded, because this swordmaster's certainly was.%SPEECH_OFF%
3f55e4ded4138ba6e9ba.translation: %SPEECH_ON%他们在他名字旁画了一颗星，那是镀金者的印记，说明他的道路受过镀金赐福。你需要知道的是，他是位剑术大师。听说他年纪大了，你或许能安心一点，不过我可不是头一回跟人这么说，明白吗？愿你的道路也同样受镀金者赐福，因为这位剑术大师的路，显然早就蒙了恩。%SPEECH_OFF%

994faaa8eeb42f41b28d.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against one Hedge Knight
994faaa8eeb42f41b28d.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战一名流浪骑士

6dc6402232acead356da.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against one Hedge Knight and %amount% raiders
6dc6402232acead356da.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战一名流浪骑士和%amount%名劫掠者

1fe8ec7e4ae60fb1aa69.source: %SPEECH_ON%I believe northerners refer to him as a 'hate knight.' Might have that wrong. Don't tell the other arena masters I said this about northern trash, but this knight is one of the most dangerous men I've seen come through here and if you wish your path to continue being gilded then I suggest you make sharp preparations and get a good rest before the fight.%SPEECH_OFF%
1fe8ec7e4ae60fb1aa69.translation: %SPEECH_ON%我记得，北方人管他叫“流氓骑士”。也许记岔了。别告诉其他竞技场管事，我这么夸过北方的废物，不过这位骑士确实是我在这里见过最危险的人物之一。要是还想沿着镀金之路走下去，我劝你备好锋刃，赛前好好休息。%SPEECH_OFF%

0b0a348f04d89c32e789.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against one Blade Dancer
0b0a348f04d89c32e789.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战一名舞刃者

0ffdbb78cc9244913ad5.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against one Blade Dancer and %amount% nomads
0ffdbb78cc9244913ad5.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战一名舞刃者和%amount%名游牧民

f163b08f2e92e206e3c3.source: The arena master holds up a scroll and taps it with a hook for a hand.%SPEECH_ON%A blade dancer of the nomad tribes is on the docket. Now, he might look a bit foppish, but to get the title of 'blade dancer' you must be as articulate with the blade as a bird is with the wind. Dancing expertise is optional, but they're all pretty good at that, too.%SPEECH_OFF%
f163b08f2e92e206e3c3.translation: 竞技场管事举起一卷文书，用代替手掌的铁钩敲了敲。%SPEECH_ON%名单上有一位来自游牧部族的舞刃者。他看着也许有点浮夸，可要配得上“舞刃者”这个称号，使刀就得像鸟儿乘风一样自如。会不会跳舞倒不是硬性要求，不过他们跳得也都不错。%SPEECH_OFF%

873afa634874edaed4a8.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% ifrits
873afa634874edaed4a8.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%只沙魔

ca6a916464099b689627.source: %SPEECH_ON%There's nothing on the page because I fear the desert's wrath if I dare to illuminate its most ferocious presence. You're fighting %number% ifrits. I do not know how they managed to get them here, I just know it was the doing of alchemists. If you ask me, I'd rather you fight them than the ifrits.%SPEECH_OFF%
ca6a916464099b689627.translation: %SPEECH_ON%纸上什么都没画，因为我怕将沙漠最凶暴的存在描绘出来，会招来沙漠的怒火。你要对付%number%只沙魔。我不知道他们怎么把这些东西弄来的，只知道是炼金术士干的。要我说，我宁可让你去打那些炼金术士，也别打沙魔。%SPEECH_OFF%

8b43bf7b7f8823e102fc.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% nachzehrers
8b43bf7b7f8823e102fc.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%只食尸鬼

1a7d968169608c6b0ad3.source: %SPEECH_ON%The alchemists call them, well, I can't even pronounce it. My tongue simply cannot shape itself to the word for it requires specialized northern lexicography and I've no time to narrow northern verbiage in a fruitless matter of mundane minutiae. Do I look like a phonetician to you? Let's just call them 'gnashslashers.' They're ghoulish cretins, it's %number% of them, and I've seen them eat men alive, so you'd best hope the Gilder is watching - I don't think He'll have any light for you in the belly of one of those beasts!%SPEECH_OFF%
1a7d968169608c6b0ad3.translation: %SPEECH_ON%炼金术士管它们叫……算了，我连念都念不出来。要说清那词，舌头得先精通北方词汇学。我可没空为了这种无聊琐事，细抠北方的遣词用字。你看我像语音学家吗？咱们就叫它们“啃咬撕扯怪”吧。一群饿鬼似的蠢东西，总共有%number%只。我亲眼见过它们活吃人，所以你最好祈祷镀金者正看着你——进了那帮畜生的肚子，我可不觉得祂的光还能照到你！%SPEECH_OFF%

0c3f62bac26685082a3e.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against one unhold
0c3f62bac26685082a3e.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战一只巨魔

2cb5634d42eb0ad24bbb.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% unholds
2cb5634d42eb0ad24bbb.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%只巨魔

65f82d2304e1b7e83cca.source: %SPEECH_ON%You're against %number% of what the northern scum refer to as an 'unhold.' The Vizier pays a proper pile of coin to get them here, and the masses love the giant bastards. They do a good job smashing fighters and, on occasion, heaving a warrior clear into the crowds. It's quite wonderful. I think some of the unholds even learn to enjoy it the longer they stay here, like they learn what spurs the mob to cheers and jeer. The brutality is something else. Anyway, may the Gilder watch over you.%SPEECH_OFF%
65f82d2304e1b7e83cca.translation: %SPEECH_ON%你要对付%number%头北方渣滓嘴里的“巨魔”。维齐尔花了一大堆钱，才把它们弄来。观众可喜欢这帮大块头混蛋了：它们把斗士砸得稀烂，偶尔还会把人直接扔进看台，精彩极了。有些巨魔在这里待久了，似乎也开始乐在其中，像是弄明白了怎样才能让观众欢呼叫嚷。那股残暴劲，可真不是盖的。总之，愿镀金者保佑你。%SPEECH_OFF%

965af5adb69e3c57bda0.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% nomads
965af5adb69e3c57bda0.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%名游牧民

6c8e3be51b2d49ecac20.source: %SPEECH_ON%Your opponents will be %number% recently retired desert bandits. And by retired, I mean taken by the Vizier's lawmen, of course. No bandit willingly steps foot in here, haghaghagh!%SPEECH_OFF%
6c8e3be51b2d49ecac20.translation: %SPEECH_ON%你的对手是%number%个刚刚金盆洗手的沙漠匪徒。当然，我说的金盆洗手，是指被维齐尔的执法者抓了。哪有匪徒自愿踏进这里的，哈哈哈！%SPEECH_OFF%

9f9f36b31ba15814e8dd.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% gladiators
9f9f36b31ba15814e8dd.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%名角斗士

49b4cdfba85fa7cc2883.source: %SPEECH_ON%Well, heh, the Gilder must have a sense of humor. You'll be facing %number% gladiators. May your path be ever Gilded, but to be honest, I said that to the gladiators. And I've been saying it to them every day. Understand? You should prepare to the best of your abilities.%SPEECH_OFF%
49b4cdfba85fa7cc2883.translation: %SPEECH_ON%嗯，嘿，镀金者准是个爱开玩笑的。你要面对%number%名角斗士。愿你的道路永受镀金者赐福，不过说实话，我也对那些角斗士说过这话，而且每天都说。懂了吗？尽你所能，好好准备。%SPEECH_OFF%

24f96eaa9e127274ddaa.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% webknechts
24f96eaa9e127274ddaa.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%只巨蛛

433cc419b5ad7c0fc95c.source: %SPEECH_ON%That is not a fig tree, it's a spider. The alchemists, bless their learned hearts, call them webknechts which is a silly northern name, in truth they're spiders. Unfortunately for you a boot will not be sufficient this time around for %number% of them.%SPEECH_OFF%
433cc419b5ad7c0fc95c.translation: %SPEECH_ON%那不是无花果树，是蜘蛛。炼金术士——愿他们那颗学问脑袋得福——管它们叫巨蛛，一个傻里傻气的北方名字。说白了，不还是蜘蛛。可惜这回对你来说，一只靴子可解决不了%number%只这样的家伙。%SPEECH_OFF%

d30852545533c9791baa.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% serpents
d30852545533c9791baa.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%条巨蛇

0408b9e44d1e6c3166c2.source: %SPEECH_ON%What do you mean you don't understand? Huh, it's just a squiggly line? No. Look, this is its tail, and that's the head. It's a snake. You're fighting %number% snakes. 'Serpents' the alchemists like to call them, but if I wanted to draw a serpent I'd just draw an alchemist haghaghagh!%SPEECH_OFF%
0408b9e44d1e6c3166c2.translation: %SPEECH_ON%什么叫看不懂？嗯，只是根弯弯曲曲的线？不对。瞧，这是尾巴，那是脑袋。这是一条蛇，你要对付%number%条蛇。炼金术士爱叫它们“巨蛇”，可要我画一条蛇，画个炼金术士就得了，哈哈哈！%SPEECH_OFF%

aef8d562bbcb25a07ae3.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% hyenas
aef8d562bbcb25a07ae3.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%只鬣狗

80c70b27b179471881e3.source: %SPEECH_ON%Hyenas. Heeheehee. Hyenas. %numberC% of the giggling mutts, to be exact. Good luck, and may the Gilder watch over you.%SPEECH_OFF%
80c70b27b179471881e3.translation: %SPEECH_ON%鬣狗。嘿嘿嘿，鬣狗。确切地说，是%numberC%只咯咯怪笑的畜生。祝你好运，愿镀金者保佑你。%SPEECH_OFF%

6dcc2aa0681ece51e739.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% frenzied hyenas
6dcc2aa0681ece51e739.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%只疯狂鬣狗

4a07e75ff950cbe326b7.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against one lindwurm
4a07e75ff950cbe326b7.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战一条林德蠕龙

5965d1e8441252adb39a.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against two lindwurms
5965d1e8441252adb39a.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战两条林德蠕龙

90edcd345a66241d7b58.source: %SPEECH_ON%Your opponent is a... a... what is this? A worm? It's green. Never seen a worm that col- oh! A wyrm! No wait, 'wurm.' Wurm? A lindwurm! I gots'ta be honest with ya, I don't know what the hell this is, but I imagine our dear matchmakers won't be having you fightin' a worm of the regular sort. Or maybe they is. Maybe they'll just have ye eat it for our entertainment. Maybe they ain't matchmakers, but tastemakers! Herghgheeagghheeehoogh. Ha.%SPEECH_OFF%
90edcd345a66241d7b58.translation: %SPEECH_ON%你的对手是……是……这什么玩意儿？虫？还是绿的。没见过这种颜色的虫——哦！龙！不对，蠕龙。蠕龙？林德蠕龙！我得跟你说实话，我也不知道这是个什么鬼东西，不过我想，安排比赛的诸位大人总不会让你去打一条普通虫子。也没准会。没准只是让你吃下去，给咱们找点乐子。也许他们不是给你配对手，是给你配菜的！嘿呵嘎哈哈哈哈。哈。%SPEECH_OFF%

0148ed0e54a0dd289e9b.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %amount% mercenaries
0148ed0e54a0dd289e9b.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%amount%名佣兵

3cfb33cbab3a0f6913c8.source: %SPEECH_ON%Crownlings like you have ventured down from the north. Up there, they call them 'sellswords.' Hagh! What sort of attempt at poetry is that? Don't they know not every man even uses a sword? They ain't the brightest up there. That's why I like it in the south. The sun is bright, and thus so are we.%SPEECH_OFF%
3cfb33cbab3a0f6913c8.translation: %SPEECH_ON%你们这些克朗客，都从北方一路闯下来。那边管你们叫“卖剑客”。哈！这算哪门子的诗意？他们难道不知道，不是人人都用剑吗？北边那些人可不怎么开窍，所以我才喜欢南方。太阳亮堂，人也聪明。%SPEECH_OFF%

3d697aa0030b32653fd7.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %champion1% and %amount% gladiators
3d697aa0030b32653fd7.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%champion1%和%amount%名角斗士

dd7a194217374d170028.source: %SPEECH_ON%Recognize this face? There's a reason the artists spent time on this here pamphlet and then handed them out to every set of eyes settin' in those seats upstairs. It's %champion1%, one of the greatest fighters in this land. Maybe some day they'll make yer face look so pretty, if the Vizier could ever find someone so talented to salvage, well, whatever ye got there between the ears, hegheghegh.%SPEECH_OFF%
dd7a194217374d170028.translation: %SPEECH_ON%认得这张脸吗？画师费工夫画这小册子，再发给上头看台里的每一双眼睛，可不是白忙活。%champion1%，这片土地上最出色的斗士之一。没准哪天，也有人把你的脸画得这么漂亮——前提是维齐尔真能找到那么有本事的人，把你两只耳朵中间的这块……玩意儿，给拾掇出个样子来。嘿嘿嘿。%SPEECH_OFF%

a72b57b239023a00ca06.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %champion1% and %amount% mercenaries
a72b57b239023a00ca06.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%champion1%和%amount%名佣兵

2d6afd728f160905da77.source: Enter the arena again to start the fight against %champion1% and %amount% nomads
2d6afd728f160905da77.translation: 再次进入竞技场，迎战%champion1%和%amount%名游牧民

b04c16465fad337bff3f.source: He pauses.%SPEECH_ON%We expect important guests for this bout, so everything is set up for you to die proper bloody this time, got it? And if you can't do that, then have your lot dispatch their opponents in the most spectacular way to please the crowd. Do that, and I'll hand you a proper piece of gladiator gear ontop of the coin.%SPEECH_OFF%
b04c16465fad337bff3f.translation: 他停了停。%SPEECH_ON%这场会有贵客到场，所以都安排好了，这回你们得死得血淋淋才行，懂吗？要是做不到，就叫你的人把对手杀得漂亮些，好好取悦观众。办到了，除了钱，我还会给你一件像样的角斗士装备。%SPEECH_OFF%

780a96b08bf55866c30e.source: He points to some strange looking collars and continues.%SPEECH_ON%When you're ready, put these on the three men who'll be doing the fighting. This lets us know who to take into the pits. Anyone not wearing these will not be allowed in, not you, not the Vizier, dare I say even the Gilder may be turned down.%SPEECH_OFF%
780a96b08bf55866c30e.translation: 他指着几只样式古怪的项圈，接着说道。%SPEECH_ON%准备好了，就给要上场的三个人戴上这些，我们才知道该领谁进场。没戴项圈，谁也不许进。你不行，维齐尔也不行，恕我斗胆，恐怕连镀金者来了也得吃闭门羹。%SPEECH_OFF%

70f0c2db8859adf4969b.source: Equip up to five of your men with arena collars
70f0c2db8859adf4969b.translation: 让至多五名弟兄佩戴竞技场项圈

45a6eff1a2175d5e0fb9.source: Enter the arena again to start the first round
45a6eff1a2175d5e0fb9.translation: 再次进入竞技场，开始第一轮

5d697d35f44b7bd6345d.source: Each round will be to the death and you won't be able to retreat or loot afterwards
5d697d35f44b7bd6345d.translation: 每轮都将战斗至死，无法撤退，战后也不能收取战利品

cd44476666baaa3180a2.source: After each round you can elect to drop out for some consolation pay or start the next round right away
cd44476666baaa3180a2.translation: 每轮结束后，可选择退出并领取安慰报酬，或立即开始下一轮

695f72c99324fddee881.source: Get a famed %prizetype% called %prizename% for winning all three rounds
695f72c99324fddee881.translation: 赢下全部三轮，获得名为%prizename%的名品%prizetype%

37bc406e3c9298c05872.source: This arena tournament works as follows. Do you agree to the terms?
37bc406e3c9298c05872.translation: 本次竞技场锦标赛规则如下。你同意这些条件吗？

460de9fa15f493ab8de2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{The first of the three battles is over. You'll have to make a careful assessment of your men and if they can continue to the next round, which will only be harder than the last. Just as you'll find no pride in the grave, there's no shame in leaving. You'd still get some coin, but you'd also forfeit any chance to win the grand prize.}
460de9fa15f493ab8de2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{三场战斗中的第一场已经结束。你得仔细看看弟兄们的状况，判断他们能否继续参加下一轮；下一场只会更难。坟墓里找不到骄傲，退出也没什么可耻。现在离开仍能拿到一些钱，不过也将失去争夺大奖的机会。}

5c9b3e3d3023c215442e.source: We'll win the next round as well!

46480db338bc5c8be71b.source: Time for us to drop out of this tournament.
46480db338bc5c8be71b.translation: 是时候退出这场锦标赛了。

7439842099a3eed723cd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]The penultimate battle is won, leaving you with the choice to drop out now or take on the final fight to win the grand prize.
7439842099a3eed723cd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]你赢下了倒数第二场。现在可以退出，也可以迎接最后一战，争取最终大奖。

43b99a75728139f9a100.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]The combat is over, and the dull warbling in your ear is the roar of the crowd, overwhelming all senses in an explosion of celebratory ecstasy. You are but an avatar for the people, a totem through which they can vicariously electrify their own vanity and vacant heroism. Alongside the adoration of the mob, you are rewarded the grand prize: %prizename%!
43b99a75728139f9a100.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]战斗结束了，耳边沉闷的嗡鸣正是观众的咆哮。庆贺的狂喜骤然爆发，淹没了一切感官。你不过是他们的化身，一尊图腾，让他们借你的胜利，满足自己的虚荣与空洞的英雄梦。除了观众的狂热拥戴，你还赢得了大奖：%prizename%！

45f163d46fd32cb93f18.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{You decide to depart the tournament and preserve your men to fight another day. No boos or hisses are heard as this is done in the belly of the arena. It is a bureaucratic affair at best, a small exchange of monetary compensation and you are sent on your way. No grief is given, especially not from fellow gladiators who understand the point of the decision better than anyone. And the crowd? They just want blood, they'll never even notice which bodies carrying it are gone.}
45f163d46fd32cb93f18.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{你决定退出锦标赛，保住弟兄们，留待来日再战。手续在竞技场内部办理，听不到嘘声，也听不到倒彩。这顶多算件公事：领上一点补偿，便可以离开。没人为难你，尤其是其他角斗士，他们比谁都明白这个决定的意义。至于观众？他们只想看血，哪具盛着血的身躯走了，他们根本不会留意。}

63e22ff556146870f6e2.source: The arena master, typically the most disinterested man you've ever met to have an interesting job, is actually rather lively today. He presents you with a scroll in one hand and three fingers held up in the other.%SPEECH_ON%Three rounds! Three rounds, one after the other and each harder than the last. Win all three with the same five men to earn the grand prize of a famed %prizetype% called %prizename%! It'sahtournamentah! You want in or not-ah?%SPEECH_OFF%
63e22ff556146870f6e2.translation: 这位竞技场管事，平时干着一份有趣的差事，却是你见过最兴味索然的人。今天，他竟难得兴致勃勃，一手递出文书，另一手竖起三根手指。%SPEECH_ON%三轮！三轮连着打，一轮比一轮难！用同一支五人队赢下全部三轮，就能拿走大奖：珍品%prizetype%——%prizename%！这可是锦标赛啊！你到底参不参加呀？%SPEECH_OFF%

ab6184573ddb70ba8934.source: The arena master continues.%SPEECH_ON%When you're ready, have the men who'll be doing the fighting put on the arena collars we'll give you.%SPEECH_OFF%
ab6184573ddb70ba8934.translation: 竞技场主管继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%准备好了，就让参战的人戴上我们发给你们的竞技场项圈。%SPEECH_OFF%

630996ac8707e69e1b05.source: The next round will start automatically

d7f703aee22876fd2e31.source: After each round you can elect to drop out or start the next round right away
d7f703aee22876fd2e31.translation: 每轮结束后，可选择退出或立即开始下一轮

a6036e3a3d16db67e1d8.source: Hunt down the Barbarian King and his warhost
a6036e3a3d16db67e1d8.translation: 追猎蛮族之王及其战军

690df52f16c94bdf4410.source: He was last reported to be in the region of %region%, %direction% from you
690df52f16c94bdf4410.translation: 根据最近的消息，他出现在你%direction%方向的%region%地区

370c176134711071dea4.source: A mighty warhost of barbarian tribes, united by a self-proclaimed barbarian king.
370c176134711071dea4.translation: 一支由自封蛮王集结各部族组成的强大战军。

17ed47b3ea9957ea3e38.source: His warhost was last spotted around %region%, %terrain% %direction% from you, near %nearest_town%
17ed47b3ea9957ea3e38.translation: 他的战军最后出现在%region%一带，位于你的%direction%方向，%nearest_town%附近的%terrain%

13c8e1750666223908d4.source: Travel with the Barbarian King to face a greater threat together
13c8e1750666223908d4.translation: 与蛮族之王一同行军，共同迎战更大的威胁

35695393cfdeb9742b79.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer% is swinging a thin crown around his finger. It is a cheap looking piece of metal, but no doubt a crown from somewhere. He looks you up and down as the tin scrapes and skitters over his fingernail and back again.%SPEECH_ON%I suspect I should have seen this coming. Men seek power, and those cut from the barbarian cloth are no different.%SPEECH_OFF%He lets the crown slide down to his knuckles where it hangs limply.%SPEECH_ON%The barbarians to the %direction% in the region of %region% are uniting under a so-called king. A savage so strong and nasty he threatens to get a horde and after that, well, I suspect he'll want to expand his realm south. I need you to go to this region, find this man, and cut him down.%SPEECH_OFF% | One of %employer%'s servants fetches you to a garden where you find the man tending to a tomato plant. He's pruning it with goat shears and nodding to his own handiwork. He talks loosely.%SPEECH_ON%My scouts tell me that a northern savage in %region% is gathering an army. A gathering of idiots is not too out of the ordinary for those primitives, but I do believe this one is proclaiming himself king. And kings, well, they wish to be suzerain over more than just what they got. They want what everyone else has got. What I got.%SPEECH_OFF%The man pauses and nods to you.%SPEECH_ON%I need you to go to the region of %region%, find this so-called savage king, and kill him. It will not be easy, but you will be paid quite well.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is surrounded by his lieutenants. They regard you with sneers, but %employer% ignores their judgments and makes his own.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellsword, I do believe a man of your chops is just the one I'm looking for. A barbarian in %region% has ordained himself king. He even wears a crown of some sort, probably of bone and antler, but it is the shape and purpose that matters. Not only matters to him, but to us. We can't allow him to live. I need you to go find this primitive and end him before he gathers an army too big for my fellow lieutenants here to deal with.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you with a mug of ale. He himself enjoys a goblet of wine.%SPEECH_ON%I've brought you here because there is a certain primitive in the region of %region% that I need killing. He is calling himself king, heh, suzerain over the savages. Well, while I don't respect his royal authority in the slightest, I know a budding threat when I see one. I can't wait around for this barbarian to round up the villages and gather an army. I need you to find him and kill him. It won't be easy, but you'll be paid well.%SPEECH_OFF%You now wonder if he's slipping you ale to loosen you into accepting this absurd task. | %employer% is holding a pair of deer antlers with the crown still at the base. When he puts it on his desk it stands upright as though still attached to its authorship.%SPEECH_ON%Word on the wind is that a savage in %region% is gathering an army. He is proclaiming himself king and if he can wrangle those primitives under his banner then that no doubt makes him a strong sonuvabitch. It also means we may be in a heap of shit here real soon if he isn't taken care of.%SPEECH_OFF%The man knocks the antlers over and they fall upon their tips with hollow clacks.%SPEECH_ON%So that's what you're here for, sellsword. I need you to find this barbarian and put an end to him before he gets any wise ideas about what he is and isn't suzerain over.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s sitting in his chair with pursed lips. He's thumbing a dagger around, the tip of it auguring a divot into his desk.%SPEECH_ON%My scouts to the %direction% started disappearing a little while ago. And then the survivors trickled in and with them tales of a barbarian proclaiming himself king of %region%. Now, do I need to conjure what the issue is with a savage ordaining himself ruler of a horde of primitives?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him you can imagine it keeps him up at night. %employer% grins.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, that it does. So I need a man such as yourself, a strapping, nice, civilized sellsword. I need you to go and find this so-called king and kill him before he's got all those damn idiots marching under his banner.%SPEECH_OFF%}
35695393cfdeb9742b79.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%正用手指转着一顶薄薄的王冠。那金属看着廉价，却无疑是从某处弄来的真王冠。锡片刮过指甲，又滑回去，他则上下打量着你。%SPEECH_ON%我想，这事本该早有预料。人都渴求权力，生来野蛮的家伙也不例外。%SPEECH_OFF%他任王冠滑到指节处，松松地挂在那里。%SPEECH_ON%%direction%的%region%一带，蛮族正聚集在一个所谓的国王麾下。那家伙既强壮又凶恶，眼看就要拉起一支大军。然后嘛，我想，他就该琢磨着向南扩张王国了。我要你去那片地区，找到这个人，杀了他。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的仆人将你领到花园。雇主正用剪羊毛的剪子修整一株番茄，还不时点头，欣赏自己的手艺。他漫不经心地开口。%SPEECH_ON%斥候告诉我，%region%有个北方野蛮人正在集结军队。那群未开化的家伙聚成一堆，本也不算稀奇。不过，这个似乎自称国王。国王嘛，想统治的可不止自己已有的东西。他们想要别人手里的东西。我手里的东西。%SPEECH_OFF%男人停下，朝你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我要你去%region%，找到这个所谓的蛮王，杀了他。差事不轻松，不过，酬劳会很丰厚。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%身边围着几位副官。他们冷笑着打量你，%employer%却不理会那些目光，自有判断。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵，我想，你这样有本事的人，正是我要找的。%region%有个野蛮人给自己加冕称王，甚至戴上了某种王冠，大概是骨头和鹿角做的。不过，重要的是它的形状，以及它所代表的意思。不只是对他重要，对我们也一样。不能让他活下去。我要你找到这个未开化的家伙，了结他，赶在他聚起一支连我身边这些副官都应付不了的大军之前。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%拿出一杯麦酒欢迎你，自己则品着高脚杯里的葡萄酒。%SPEECH_ON%请你来，是因为%region%有个野蛮人，我要他死。他自称国王，呵，野蛮人的君主。我虽然丝毫不把他的王权放在眼里，却也看得出什么叫初露苗头的威胁。我不能等着他召集村落，拉起军队。我要你找到他，杀了他。不会容易，不过，报酬丰厚。%SPEECH_OFF%你不禁怀疑，他特意拿麦酒招待，是不是想让你喝得松了口，接下这荒唐差事。 | %employer%手里拿着一对鹿角，根部还连着头骨顶。他将它放到桌上，鹿角便直立起来，仿佛仍长在原主身上。%SPEECH_ON%传言说，%region%有个野蛮人正在集结军队，还自称国王。若他真能把那些家伙拢到一面旗帜下，无疑是个厉害的狗娘养的。这也意味着，不尽早解决，我们很快就要陷入大麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%男人推倒鹿角，角尖撞上桌面，发出空洞的脆响。%SPEECH_ON%所以才叫你来，佣兵。我要你找到这个野蛮人，赶在他对自己该统治哪儿、不该统治哪儿生出高见之前，取他的命。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%抿着嘴坐在椅子里，手中转动匕首，用刀尖在桌面上钻出一个小坑。%SPEECH_ON%前些时候，我派往%direction%的斥候开始陆续失踪。后来，幸存者零零散散地回来了，也带回消息：一个野蛮人自称%region%的国王。现在，还需要我解释，让这种家伙当上一大群蛮子的统领，会有什么问题吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你说，想来这事足够让他夜里睡不着。%employer%咧嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，确实如此。所以，我需要你这样的人，一个结实、体面、讲文明的佣兵。我要你找到这个所谓的国王，趁那些该死的蠢货还没全聚到他旗下，把他杀了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1eed808d903f184f9eec.source: {How many crowns are we talking about here? | That's no small feat to ask. | I could be persuaded for the right price. | A task like this better pay well.}
1eed808d903f184f9eec.translation: {你打算出多少克朗？ | 这可不是件小事。 | 价钱合适，就能说服我。 | 这样的差事，报酬最好够高。}

1ed22163e5042d757f2b.source: {We're not about to engage an army. | That's not the kind of work we're looking for. | I won't risk the company against an enemy such as this.}
1ed22163e5042d757f2b.translation: {我们不打算和一支大军交战。 | 这不是我们要找的活儿。 | 我不会让战团冒险对付这样的敌人。}

11283d368e63b951f5f9.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]A throng of refugees passes the company by. Rumors abound that the barbarian king is %distance% to the %direction%. Many of the people on the road are from %nearest_town% and seem to have no interest in waiting around for a sea of savages to descend upon them. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]A trader with an empty merchant cart crosses paths with the company. Though he has nothing to peddle, he does state that the roads are flowing with rumors of a savage calling himself king. He states that the barbarian is somewhere %direction% of where you stand, around %region%. He regards the path of your journey with a nod.%SPEECH_ON%If you're keen on going that way, well, give them primitive bastards all the hell they deserve.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]A half-naked man is found sitting cross-legged to the side of the road. He states that a primitive with an army burned his farmstead, wronged the women, and slew every swinging dick.%SPEECH_ON%I survived hiding in a brush pile with my hands wrapped over my mouth.%SPEECH_OFF%The man wipes his nose.%SPEECH_ON%I seen you with your weapons. If you seek this barbarian then I can tell ya it seemed they was heading %direction% of here, down %terrain% %distance% aways to %region%.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]You find the burnt remains of a small hamlet. A few of its survivors linger, their shapes about as present as the smoke drifting off their destroyed homes. One states that a man posturing like a king came and killed everyone they got their hands on before heading %direction%. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]You've come across a number of flipped carts or burning wagons. They're barren, all the goods gone, only the corpses of their owners remain. A few children are picking through the rubble of one such ruin. When you ask them who did this, a cheeky boy speaks up.%SPEECH_ON%Savages from the north, but they headin' %direction% now. I seen them. They is %terrain%, %distance% I wager. %SPEECH_OFF%He picks his nose.%SPEECH_ON%They is killers, by the way. Kinda look your sort, but larger. Probably stronger.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]A scout of %employer% meets you on the road. He reports that the barbarian king was sighted around %region% to the %direction% %terrain%. He is %distance%. You ask the scout if he'd join you for the fight and the man laughs.%SPEECH_ON%No sir, I'm quite alright. I run about, see things, and report them. In between I fark a whore or two. It's a good life and I don't need your sellsword ways ruinin' it!%SPEECH_OFF%Fair enough. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]%randombrother% spots them first. Signs of a skirmish, charred corpses, faded footprints and wagon tracks, so many that it is clear an army passed through here.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like they was headin' %direction% after the battle, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%}
11283d368e63b951f5f9.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]一群难民与战团擦肩而过。传闻四起，说蛮族之王在%direction%那边。至于远近，传闻的说法是‘%distance%’。路上的许多人都来自%nearest_town%，显然不愿留在原地，等那片蛮族的人潮压过来。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]一个推着空货车的商人与战团相遇。他虽已无货可卖，却告诉你，路上都在传，有个野蛮人自称国王。按他的说法，那家伙就在你们%direction%的某处，%region%一带。他朝你们要走的方向点点头。%SPEECH_ON%如果非要往那边去，就给那些蛮子狠狠吃些苦头。他们活该。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]一个半裸男人盘腿坐在路旁。他说，有个野蛮人带着军队烧了他的农庄，凌辱了女人，杀光了男人。%SPEECH_ON%我躲在一堆灌木里，双手捂住嘴，才捡回一条命。%SPEECH_OFF%男人擦了擦鼻子。%SPEECH_ON%我看见你们带着武器。若是来找那个野蛮人的，我倒能告诉你：他们似乎朝%direction%的%region%去了，%terrain%。离这儿多远？%distance%。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]你发现一座小村落被烧毁的残骸。几个幸存者仍徘徊其间，身影与废墟上飘起的烟雾一样虚无。有人说，一个摆着国王架势的男人来了，逮到谁就杀谁，随后往%direction%去了。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]你一路遇见许多翻倒的小货车和燃烧的货车。车里空空如也，货物尽失，只剩主人的尸体。几个孩子正在其中一处残骸里翻找。你问是谁干的，一个胆大的男孩开口。%SPEECH_ON%北边来的蛮子，不过现在往%direction%去了。我看见他们了。他们%terrain%。要问多远，我猜是‘%distance%’。%SPEECH_OFF%他抠了抠鼻子。%SPEECH_ON%对了，他们杀人。看着跟你们有点像，不过块头更大，八成也更强壮。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]%employer%的一名斥候在路上找到你。他报告说，蛮族之王在%direction%的%region%一带活动，%terrain%。至于远近，他的说法是‘%distance%’。你问斥候要不要加入这场战斗，男人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不了，大人，我现在就挺好。四处跑跑，看看动静，回来报信，空闲时再找一两个婊子。这日子够好了，可不想让你们佣兵的活法把它毁了！%SPEECH_OFF%倒也在理。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]%randombrother%最先发现了痕迹：小规模交战的残迹、烧焦的尸体、渐淡的脚印，还有车辙。痕迹如此之多，显然有一支军队从这里经过。%SPEECH_ON%团长，看样子他们打完以后，往%direction%去了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

c9e973d9b391411943ce.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{There's no doubt now. With all the signs you've encountered, and all the reports that people have given you, you finally know exactly where the Barbarian King and his warhost is headed. The only thing left is to confront him.}
c9e973d9b391411943ce.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{现在已无疑问。结合沿途发现的迹象与众人提供的消息，你终于确切掌握了蛮王及其大军的去向。接下来，只需迎头拦下他。}

494316bfeac6c611f9cc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_135.png[/img]{The Barbarian King comes to the field with his warhost, a party of oversized miscreants, growling warriors, sheepish slaves, and howling women. It is the army of a man who has collected from the land every scrap of resource, every inch of advantage, and will surely collect civilization itself as surely as a simple snowball may become the avalanche. You prepare the men for battle. | The Barbarian King's warband trundles across the land with no hint of training or even semblance of formation. But you know that with the mere wave of the savage's hand he may set upon his enemies a horde of killers who have more than ample supply of carnage to overcome any lack of cohesion. You prepare the men for battle. | The warband of savages is like that of a fever dream, taking shape across the horizon like travelers from every corner of the earth, dressed not in any uniform or armor, but in mockeries of those they have conquered. Warriors with wedding dresses wrapped about their arms, long coats of royal color adorned upon men of no status, some wearing ribs and clattering bones as though they got the last of the pillaging. They were but farmers of horror, villages their crop, and war but a harvest for all seasons.

You shake your head at the sight and prepare the men for battle.}
494316bfeac6c611f9cc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_135.png[/img]{蛮族之王率军来到战场。队伍里有身形魁梧的恶徒、低吼的战士、畏缩的奴隶，还有厉声呼号的女人。这支军队的主人，从土地上搜刮每一分资源，攫取每一点优势。如今，他也要将文明世界吞入腹中，正如小小雪球终会酿成雪崩。你让弟兄们做好战斗准备。 | 蛮族之王的战帮浩浩荡荡地走来，看不出半点操练的痕迹，甚至谈不上阵形。但你知道，只要这个野蛮人一挥手，一群杀人如麻的凶徒就会扑向敌人。哪怕毫无配合，他们也有足够的凶暴来弥补。你让弟兄们做好战斗准备。 | 这支蛮族战帮仿佛高烧中的噩梦，在地平线上渐渐显形，像是从天南地北聚来的旅人。他们穿的既非制式服装，也非整齐的盔甲，而是对被征服者的种种嘲弄。有战士将婚纱缠在臂上，毫无身份的人披着王侯颜色的长袍，还有人挂着肋骨和叮当作响的碎骨，仿佛抢到最后，只剩这些可拿。他们是耕种恐惧的农夫，村庄是庄稼，战争则是四季不断的收成。

你望着这景象，摇了摇头，让弟兄们做好战斗准备。}

1d93308f84c551079323.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{The Barbarian King is dead. Though he adorned himself the title of royalty, he lies amongst the dead like any other of his people. A savage. A primitive. With a slightly hardier body and some accoutrements native to his warring and pillaging and ravaging. Little else distinguishes him. You chop into his neck with your sword and put your boot to his face as you cut him clean off the shoulders. %randombrother% 2takes the heavy head and drops it into a knapsack. You order the men to scavenge what they can before preparing a return to %employer%.}
1d93308f84c551079323.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{蛮族之王死了。纵使给自己冠上王者之名，如今也和其他族人一样，躺在尸堆里。一个野人，一个未开化的家伙，不过身体稍强壮些，身上多了几件征战、劫掠、蹂躏得来的装饰，除此之外，与旁人无异。你挥剑砍进他的脖子，靴子踩住脸，将脑袋从肩上彻底切下。%randombrother%接过沉重的头颅，丢进背囊。你命弟兄们尽量搜刮战利品，随后准备返回%employer%处。}

c9dd6bea8ea8f433430f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{You find the Barbarian King, but a parlay is made. The Barbarian King and an elder step across the field to meet you personally. Against better judgment, you go out to see them. The Barbarian King speaks and the elder translates.%SPEECH_ON%We are not here to conquer, but to defeat the Great Untoward.%SPEECH_OFF%Suspecting a loss of translation, you ask them to explain. The King and elder continue.%SPEECH_ON%Death has left this land, and in its absence a man slain becomes lost between worlds and will rise again. A horde of Untoward, the Undead, are on the march. We are not here for you or your nobles. If you help us destroy them we will depart the land and trouble your people no more. Only the Untoward.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% leans in and whispers.%SPEECH_ON%We could join them, sure, but we could also just go ahead and attack them now. They're clearly not at full strength and whatever they say here the fact is they've been ravaging the lands anyway, because they're primitive savages, sir, and raping and pillaging is just what they got in their blood.%SPEECH_OFF%}
c9dd6bea8ea8f433430f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{你找到了蛮族之王，对方却提出会谈。他和一位长者穿过空地，亲自前来见你。明知不够稳妥，你还是走出去与他们碰面。蛮族之王开口，长者代为翻译。%SPEECH_ON%我们来此，不为征服，而为击败大凶之物。%SPEECH_OFF%你怀疑翻译没把意思说清，便请他们解释。王与长者接着说下去。%SPEECH_ON%死亡离开了这片土地。没有死亡，被杀之人便迷失在世界之间，随后重新站起。一大群凶物，也就是亡灵，正在行军。我们不是冲你们或你们的贵族来的。帮我们消灭它们，我们就离开这片土地，不再侵扰你们的人民。我们只追杀凶物。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%凑近，低声说道：%SPEECH_ON%咱们当然可以跟他们联手，不过，现在直接动手也行。看得出来，他们人马还没齐。再说，不管他们怎么解释，四处烧杀抢掠总是事实。团长，他们就是些未开化的野蛮人，强暴和劫掠，是流在血里的本性。%SPEECH_OFF%}

e93b3d384c6258ce3d5c.source: We'll attack them and rid the north of this so-called king.
e93b3d384c6258ce3d5c.translation: 进攻，替北境除掉这个所谓的蛮王。

fb33f1d45f07cbc848d1.source: We will join with them to march against the Untoward.
fb33f1d45f07cbc848d1.translation: 我们与他们联手，讨伐不祥者。

50a9c1f93718acf1ea57.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{You spit and nod toward the elder.%SPEECH_ON%We walked past burned homes, raped women, and slain men just to find your sorry lot, and now you want to band together? We ain't allies. We ain't friends. Tell your so-called 'King' to pray to whatever shit gods you...%SPEECH_OFF%The elder holds his hand up and talks with the king in their native tongue. The two men nod, turn, and leave. %randombrother% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Brevity is the soul of scorn, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the man to get back to the battle line and prepare for the fight ahead.}
50a9c1f93718acf1ea57.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{你啐了一口，朝长老点头。%SPEECH_ON%为了找你们这帮混账，我们一路经过烧毁的家、遭奸辱的女人、被杀的男人，现在你们倒想联手？我们不是盟友，也不是朋友。告诉你们那位所谓的“国王”，赶紧向你们那些狗屁神祈祷……%SPEECH_OFF%长老抬手打断，用母语与国王交谈。两人点头，转身离开。%randombrother%笑道：%SPEECH_ON%团长，轻蔑的话，短些才有劲。%SPEECH_OFF%你叫他回战列，准备接下来的战斗。}

2021ce5227e1d779caac.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{You nod toward the elder.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, we'll work with you to see to this greater threat.%SPEECH_OFF%The elder smiles and rubs his thumbs together and speaks a few phrases in his native tongue. The Barbarian King slams his chest with his fist and then slugs you in the shoulder with it, before arcing the hand across the sky. Laughing, the elder explains.%SPEECH_ON%So we fight together, but if we shall fall, he will not fight with you as an undead. If slain, the King shall find Death himself and bring his scythe upon his own neck.%SPEECH_OFF%}
2021ce5227e1d779caac.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{你朝长老点头。%SPEECH_ON%好，我们与你们联手，对付更大的威胁。%SPEECH_OFF%长老笑了，搓着两个拇指，用母语说了几句话。蛮王握拳捶胸，又在你肩上重重擂了一下，随后抬手划过天空。长老笑着解释：%SPEECH_ON%那就并肩作战。不过，若是战死，他不会变成亡灵继续跟着你。国王若被杀，就亲自去找死神，拿死神的镰刀割断自己的脖子。%SPEECH_OFF%}

cd58d888a4b68410b164.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]{The savages were not lying: the ancients have put forth an army. It is a warband of decayed faces and rusted armor, a host of groaning, moaning monsters upon which light falls and instantly seeps away. It is surely an army of darkness. Were you or the barbarians to fight it alone you would surely lose, but together you may have a chance yet!}
cd58d888a4b68410b164.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]{野蛮人没有说谎：古人确实派出了一支军队。腐朽的面孔，锈蚀的甲胄，一群不断呻吟哀号的怪物；光落在它们身上，仿佛转瞬便被吸尽。这无疑是黑暗的大军。无论你们还是野蛮人，独自迎战都必败无疑，可若联手，或许还有一线机会！}

77c33b5d44baf745a440.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{The ancient dead have been slain to the last. As your men and the primitives pick the field, the Barbarian King and the elder come to you. The large warrior nods and grunts, and the elder translates.%SPEECH_ON%He says you did well, very well, and that he wishes men such as yourself and your company would fight alongside him, but he understand that cannot happen. We live in a maze of many worlds and in that maze we all shall stay, lost, sometimes hearing one another's shouts, never having enough time to know each other. He says thanks. And he wishes you well.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to the elder and ask if he got all that from a simple grunt. The elder smiles.%SPEECH_ON%A grunt, aye, and a lifelong friendship. Travel well, man of the sword.%SPEECH_OFF%The elder hands you a horned helmet, the very one you'd seen the Barbarian King himself wearing at times. He says nothing, only hits his chest and points to the sky and that's all there is.}
77c33b5d44baf745a440.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{远古亡灵已被尽数消灭。你的弟兄与蛮族人搜寻战场时，蛮族之王和长者来到你面前。魁梧的战士点头，低哼一声，长者随即翻译。%SPEECH_ON%他说，你们打得很好，非常好。他希望你和你的战团这样的人，能与他并肩作战，不过，他明白那不可能。我们活在由许多世界组成的迷宫里，也注定困在其中，迷失方向。偶尔听见彼此的呼喊，却总没有足够的时间相互了解。他向你道谢，也祝愿你一切安好。%SPEECH_OFF%你转向长者，问他怎么从一声哼里听出了这么多。长者微笑。%SPEECH_ON%一声哼，没错，还有一辈子的交情。一路顺风，持剑之人。%SPEECH_OFF%长者递给你一顶角盔，正是你先前见蛮族之王戴过的那顶。他不再说话，只捶了捶胸口，又指向天空。告别便到此为止。}

94b73c515003c97d96d0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%employer% takes the Barbarian King's head and rolls it out of the sack. It tumbles freely, knocking over a tray of goblets which go scattering and clattering about. Even in death the savage is a purveyor of chaos.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%Your employer says, nodding to himself as he rights the head and tilts it onto the flap of neck.%SPEECH_ON%He is an ugly mutt, isn't he? Look at those teeth. Look at them! There's holes in those teeth. Absolutely disgusting.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the man to pay you and he does so as agreed. But he keeps shaking his head and he bares his own teeth and mimics picking at them.%SPEECH_ON%How do you clean teeth like that? With a rope?%SPEECH_OFF%Shrugging, you head out the door, not bothering to tell %employer% that the first thing your men did to that godforsaken head is knife the gold out of its mouth. | You dump the Barbarian King's head onto %employer%'s table. He stares at it, then at you.%SPEECH_ON%That's the biggest fucking head I've ever seen.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask for your pay and it is delivered in appropriate sum. Your employer starts pushing the savage's face around, as though he were a sorcerer looking to steal its secrets.%SPEECH_ON%I'd wager this is where tales of ogres come from, yeah? Like a child sees this ugly thing and there it is, his imagination is set alight, and so the monster is born.%SPEECH_OFF%If only things were that simple. | Even without its massive body the head of the Barbarian King makes quite the splash when shown to %employer%. A host of nobles and servants ooh and ahh at the size of it. A man in a black robe is quick to pay you what you're owed. %employer% himself picks the head up and tosses it into the air as to weigh it.%SPEECH_ON%By the old gods, it is truly heavy! Oy %randomname%.%SPEECH_OFF%A servant steps forward. Your employer grins.%SPEECH_ON%Fetch me a pike. We're going to hoist this horror head high into the heavens.%SPEECH_OFF%A suitable stop for a savage. | Mere moments after giving %employer% the head of the Barbarian King it is being used as a plaything. Children of noblemen roll it back and forth across the stone floor, the savage's head knocking over walls of goblets and fortresses of dinner trays. A dog barks as it tracks the head back and forth. %employer% claps you on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Outstanding work, sellsword. Truly. My scouts tell me it was a hell of a fight, that you were almost like a primitive yourself. But I suppose that's what it had to take, right? A savage to fight a savage? Spirit of such primacy can't be contained by our civilized ways!%SPEECH_OFF%One of the kids kicks the King in the face, breaking its jaw and cutting the child's foot on the teeth. The kid screams for help and, perhaps defending its owner, the dog sets upon the head and starts dragging it around by the flap of neck. %employer% smiles again.%SPEECH_ON%Your pay is waiting for you outside. It is in full, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man in knight's armor takes the Barbarian King's head from you. Immediately, you draw your sword, but %employer% leaps in to end any start to violence.%SPEECH_ON%Oy, sellsword, it is quite alright. Your pay, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%The man hands you a satchel of crowns, but behind him you see the head being given to a man in a black cloak. You nod and ask what they intend to do with it. %employer% grins.%SPEECH_ON%Frankly, steins await me, sellsword, and I'm quite thirsty.%SPEECH_OFF%The man quickly walks past you. You do not see any ale, or any drink at all, he simply follows the man in the cloak. | %employer% stares at the Barbarian King's head like a cat would meanly stare at anything not its own self.%SPEECH_ON%Interesting. I think I'll have it stuffed and put upon my mantle.%SPEECH_OFF%Speaking slightly out of turn, you remind your employer that it is the head of a man he is referring to. %employer% shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%So? It is a monstrosity. There cannot be coexistence between the civilized and the savage. By having it properly taken care of I will ruminate on that reality. What will you do? Advise me again?%SPEECH_OFF%Pursing your lips, you ask for your pay. The man points toward the corner.%SPEECH_ON%In the satchel there. You did well, sellsword, but don't speak to me in such a manner again. Good day.%SPEECH_OFF%}
94b73c515003c97d96d0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%employer%接过蛮族之王的脑袋，将它从袋里倒出来。头颅一路滚过桌面，撞翻一盘酒杯，杯子四处飞散，叮当作响。这个野蛮人死了也照样制造混乱。%SPEECH_ON%多谢，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%雇主一边说，一边自顾自地点头，将脑袋扶正，斜支在断颈的皮肉上。%SPEECH_ON%真是条丑狗，不是吗？看看那些牙，快看！牙上全是洞，恶心透了。%SPEECH_OFF%你叫他付钱，他便依约照办，可还是不停摇头，又龇出自己的牙，比画着剔牙的动作。%SPEECH_ON%这样的牙怎么剔？得用绳子吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，走出门去，懒得告诉%employer%，弟兄们拿到这颗该死脑袋后，头一件事就是用刀挖走嘴里的金子。 | 你将蛮族之王的脑袋倒在%employer%的桌上。他看看脑袋，又看看你。%SPEECH_ON%这他妈是我见过最大的脑袋。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，索要报酬，很快便如数拿到了钱。雇主开始拨弄蛮族人的脸，活像一个想窃取其中秘密的巫师。%SPEECH_ON%我敢说，食人魔的传说就是这么来的，对吧？小孩看见这张丑脸，想象力一下就烧起来了，怪物也就诞生了。%SPEECH_OFF%事情要真有这么简单就好了。 | 即便离开了那副庞大的身躯，蛮族之王的头颅呈到%employer%面前时，还是引起一阵骚动。贵族与仆人围在周围，为它的硕大啧啧惊叹。一名黑袍人很快付清了应给你的钱。%employer%则亲手拿起脑袋，向空中抛了抛，掂量分量。%SPEECH_ON%旧神在上，真够沉的！喂，%randomname%。%SPEECH_OFF%一名仆人上前，雇主咧嘴笑道：%SPEECH_ON%拿根长枪来。我要把这颗骇人的脑袋，高高挑到天上去。%SPEECH_OFF%对一个野蛮人而言，倒也算个合适的归宿。 | 你才把蛮族之王的头颅交给%employer%，它转眼就成了玩物。贵族家的孩子们在石地板上将它滚来滚去，撞倒酒杯堆成的城墙和餐盘搭成的堡垒。一条狗跟着脑袋来回跑，不停吠叫。%employer%拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%干得漂亮，佣兵，真的。斥候说，那是一场恶战，你打起来，简直也像个野蛮人。不过，大概也只能如此，对吧？用野蛮人对付野蛮人？那种原始的凶性，岂是文明的手段压得住的！%SPEECH_OFF%一个孩子踢中蛮王的脸，踢断了下颌，自己的脚也被牙齿划伤。他尖叫着求救，那条狗或许以为要保护主人，便扑向头颅，咬住断颈的皮肉，满地拖拽。%employer%又笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%报酬在外面等着你。答应多少，就有多少。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个身穿骑士铠甲的人接过蛮族之王的脑袋。你立刻拔剑，%employer%却连忙上前，阻止冲突。%SPEECH_ON%喂，佣兵，没事的。这是你的报酬，分文不少。%SPEECH_OFF%他递给你一袋克朗，身后，那颗脑袋却又被交到一个黑斗篷男人手里。你点点头，问他们打算拿它做什么。%employer%咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%说实话，佣兵，酒杯正等着我呢，我也渴得很。%SPEECH_OFF%他匆匆从你身边走过。你没看见麦酒，甚至没看见任何饮料，他只是跟着那个斗篷男人走了。 | %employer%盯着蛮族之王的头颅，神情像一只恶狠狠审视外物的猫。%SPEECH_ON%有意思。我想把它做成标本，摆在壁炉台上。%SPEECH_OFF%你略显冒昧地提醒雇主，他说的，终究是一个人的脑袋。%employer%耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%那又怎样？这是个怪物。文明人与野蛮人不可能共存。好好保存它，正能让我时时思量这个道理。你还想做什么？再教我一次？%SPEECH_OFF%你抿起嘴，索要报酬。男人指向角落。%SPEECH_ON%在那只袋子里。你干得不错，佣兵，不过，别再用这种口气跟我说话。再见。%SPEECH_OFF%}

e27f22dab9e75d74a794.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes you reluctantly.%SPEECH_ON%You realize I have scouts and spies everywhere, don't you?%SPEECH_OFF%Holding up your empty hands, you tell him you had no intent on lying. The 'barbarian king' will bother the lands no more. Your employer taps his fingers together a few times then nods.%SPEECH_ON%Your honesty is refreshing, though I must say it is quite unfortunate the man and his warband still live. That said, all reports suggest they are moving away so I suppose your work is done all the same, a fat pagan head or not. Your pay, as agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF%}
e27f22dab9e75d74a794.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%employer%不太情愿地接待了你。%SPEECH_ON%你知道我的斥候和密探遍布各地，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你摊开空着的双手，告诉他，自己从没打算撒谎。那位‘蛮族之王’不会再侵扰这片土地了。雇主将指尖相抵，敲了几下，点头说道：%SPEECH_ON%你的坦诚倒让人耳目一新。不过，那人和他的战帮竟然还活着，实在遗憾。话虽如此，各方回报都说他们正在撤离。看来，无论有没有带回那颗肥大的异教徒脑袋，你也算完成了差事。报酬在这里，按说好的给。%SPEECH_OFF%}
