c000485c069c044ba371.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{刚割下的人头堆成了一座冢。%randombrother%盯着这座由痛苦面孔垒成的图腾，摇了摇自己的脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%您说，它们会不会把这当艺术？比如哪个蛮子退后一步，说：嗯，这样好看。%SPEECH_OFF%你说不准。你只盼着，人类不是绿皮手中的画笔和画布。 | 你来到一片遍布牲畜尸体的田地。肠子被拖进一道道犁沟，仿佛一套血腥的灌溉系统。要么是某个农民把天气看错得离了谱，要么就是兽人已在附近的明证。 | 到处都是尸体。有的被劈成两半，有的倒颇为安详，只是背上扎着几枚短镖。这两种死法都明确说明，绿皮就在附近。 | 你来到一处废弃的绿皮营地。一只地精的头被砸烂了，也许是和比自己高大强壮得多的兽人打了一架。烤肉架上串着一团骇人的轮廓，你只希望那不是自己想到的东西。%randombrother%指着这顿饭下面噼啪作响的余火。%SPEECH_ON%刚走不久，团长。它们就在附近。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你来到一座谷仓前，刺鼻的风吹得仓门吱呀开合。%randombrother%往里探头一看，立刻捂着鼻子窜了回来。%SPEECH_ON%没错，绿皮来过。%SPEECH_OFF%你省下了进去看一眼的工夫，叫弟兄们准备战斗，因为这一仗已经躲不过了。 | 你发现一具兽人尸体，背上还摊着一只死地精。推开两具尸体，下面露出一个死去的农民。%randombrother%点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%他可真拼了命。可惜，我们没能早些赶到。%SPEECH_OFF%你指向泥地里一串新鲜脚印。%SPEECH_ON%他寡不敌众，剩下的那些也没走远。叫弟兄们准备战斗。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你遇见一个被粗重铁链缠住的人，显然是被活活勒死的。铁链摇晃扭转，缠着那具青紫变形的尸体，叮当作响。%randombrother%把尸体放下来，尸体嘴里涌出暗色鲜血，吓得佣兵一跳。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼，这人刚死！干这事的家伙还没走远！%SPEECH_OFF%你指着泥中的脚印，告诉他这无疑是绿皮所为，而且，确实就在附近。 | 你在路上发现一个皮肉缝成的袋子，里面装着人耳。耳朵被鞣得干硬，还打了孔，能穿上钥匙链。%randombrother%干呕起来。你告诉弟兄们，绿皮没走远。一场战斗无疑即将到来！ | 你遇到一座棚屋的残骸，余烬在焦黑的废墟间噼啪作响。%randombrother%找到几具骨架，发现它们都少了半边身体。看着混有炉灰的泥中那些深深的脚印，你叫弟兄们准备好：绿皮无疑就在附近。 | 你发现一个男人坐在路边哭泣。他盘着腿，身子前后摇晃。你走近时，他转过头来——双眼和鼻子都没了，嘴唇也被割去。%SPEECH_ON%别再来了！求求你，别再来了！%SPEECH_OFF%他歪倒在一旁，开始抽搐，随后便不动了。%randombrother%检查尸体，站起来摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%绿皮？%SPEECH_OFF%你指向泥中深深的脚印，点了点头。 | 你遇见一个伏在尸体上痛哭的女人。她浑身淌着血和碎肉，膝下那具尸体的脑袋已被彻底砸烂。你在旁边蹲下，她瞥了你一眼，低声哀鸣。你问，是谁，或是什么东西干的。女人清了清喉咙，答道。%SPEECH_ON%绿皮。大的，小的。它们边打边笑。棍子抬起，落下，一次又一次，从头到尾都笑个不停。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在路边发现一匹死马，肚腹翻开，内脏拖到了路上，胸腔里还滴着鲜血。%randombrother%注意到，心、肝和其他“美味”的部分都不见了。你指向沿路延伸、带着血迹的大小脚印。%SPEECH_ON%地精和兽人。%SPEECH_OFF%而且，它们没走远。你命令%companyname%充分做好战斗准备。}

f7cc80c5b1acfb7d5211.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]{With this many greenskins dead, it seems only a matter of time until their warlord comes out to play. | You've left a trail of dead greenskins. Their warlord will catch wind of you real soon. | The greenskins' warlord is surely hearing stories of its warriors being cut down by now. He's no doubt getting a scent of you. | If you were the greenskins' warlord, you'd probably be readying to hunt down the bastard cutting down your troops. Keep these killings up and you'll no doubt see how similarly you and that savage think. | A savage understands violence, and you've surely left a trail of gory teachings all over the region. If the warlord is a learning creature, it'll no doubt be heading for you real soon. | By more wrathful estimations, the orc warlord is for sure angered as fark against some wayward human making a mess of his plans. You should expect that savage sooner or later. Most likely the former. | With this many orc and goblin killings, it is only a matter of time until their head master personally comes after you. | If orcs speak the language of violence, then you've been penning a real love letter up and down the region. Surely the orc warlord will be in a requiting mood. | If violence is the orcish language for love, then you've been standing in their warlord's yard throwing a lot of rocks through the window trying to get its attention. But, instead of rocks, it's the limbs and heads of its soldiers. That brute will be sure to respond any day now. | You've left a long trail of dead greenskins no doubt sure to attract the attention of their warlord. | Business is good for the buzzards: you've cut a path of dead greenskins and it seems likely that, any day now, their warlord will come and see for himself what you are up to. | Killing greenskins like you've been doing is a surefire way to get an orc warlord's attention - and that heat is rising. | If things keep going according to plan, that is to say the unimpeded slaughter of green savages, then surely it is only a matter of time until an orc warlord comes to see you personally. | A stampede could hardly make more noise than you have this past week. If you keep it up with slaying greenskins left and right, it is but a matter of time until their warlord shows up. | You have a feeling that somewhere in this region is a very, very mad orc warlord staring at a crude drawing of your face. | You like to think you've generated 'wanted' posters of yourself within the greenskin circles. A stick figure of a man with a price beneath it. Wanted Dead or Very Dead. Problem is you'll keep killing all who come your way until the orc warlord himself makes an appearance - and you got the feeling that will be happening real soon. | Surely by now the greenskins are sharing stories of you around their campfires. Some damned human terrorizing their ranks. And you've little doubt an orc warlord would hear those stories and feel compelled to see for himself if what they say are true... | Keep killing greenskins like this and their warlord will be sure to come around. | You're treading dangerous waters now. With this many greenskins slain, the orc warlord is sure to be coming sooner or later. | You've got a strong inclination that the orc warlord is going to be coming around real soon. Might have something to do with you killing all his soldiers. Just a hunch. | You've killed little greenskins and big greenskins. Now, it's time to kill the biggest of them all: a warlord. That savage has gotta be footing around here somewhere... | You've made war on the greenskins and for that their warlord is sure to appear sooner or later. | Greenskins dying left and right. At some point their warlord is going to realize that it ain't because of natural causes. Once he figures it out, he'll be coming for you double time.}
f7cc80c5b1acfb7d5211.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]{绿皮死了这么多，它们的军阀出来陪你玩，看来只是早晚的事。 | 你身后留下了一路绿皮尸体。它们的军阀很快就会听到风声。 | 绿皮军阀想必已经听说，自己的战士正接连被杀。他无疑快要嗅到你的踪迹了。 | 如果你是绿皮军阀，大概早就在准备追杀那个屠戮部下的混账。继续杀下去吧，很快就能知道，你和那蛮子的想法有多么相似。 | 野蛮人懂得暴力，而你无疑已在这一带留下满地血淋淋的教材。如果军阀是个学得进去的家伙，很快就会来找你。 | 往暴躁了想，那兽人军阀发现自己的计划被一个四处乱闯的人类搅得一团糟，肯定已经气得发狂。那蛮子迟早会来，你最好早作准备。多半，是早。 | 杀了这么多兽人和地精，它们的头领亲自来找你算账，只是时间问题。 | 如果兽人用暴力交流，那你已经在这一带写出了一封情意绵绵的情书。兽人军阀想必也很想回应这份情意。 | 如果暴力是兽人表达爱意的语言，那你就是站在军阀院子里，不停朝窗户扔石子，想引起他的注意。不过，你扔的不是石子，而是他士兵的残肢和脑袋。那畜生随时都可能作出回应。 | 你身后拖着长长一串绿皮尸体，无疑会引起它们军阀的注意。 | 秃鹫的生意兴隆得很：你一路斩杀绿皮，它们的军阀很可能随时都会亲自来看看，你到底在干什么。 | 像你这样杀绿皮，肯定能引起兽人军阀的注意——而火候正越来越足。 | 如果事情继续按计划发展，也就是继续毫无阻碍地屠戮绿皮蛮族，那么兽人军阀亲自来见你，无疑只是时间问题。 | 你这星期闹出的动静，比兽群狂奔还大。只要继续四处斩杀绿皮，它们的军阀迟早会出现。 | 你有种感觉：这一带的某个地方，一个怒不可遏的兽人军阀，正盯着一张粗陋的画像，而画的就是你。 | 你乐意相信，自己已经在绿皮圈子里混到了“通缉令”——画个简笔小人，下面标个价钱。要求：死的，或者死得更透的。问题是，凡来找你的，你都会继续杀掉，直到兽人军阀亲自露面。而你感觉，那一刻已经不远了。 | 到现在，绿皮们一定在篝火旁传着你的故事：一个该死的人类，把它们杀得心惊胆战。你几乎可以肯定，兽人军阀听到这些故事后，会忍不住亲自来看看，传言究竟是真是假…… | 继续这样杀绿皮，它们的军阀肯定会来。 | 你如今正踏入险境。绿皮死了这么多，兽人军阀迟早会找上门。 | 你强烈地感觉，兽人军阀很快就要来了。也许跟你不停杀他士兵有关。只是个直觉。 | 小绿皮你杀过，大绿皮也杀过。现在，该杀最大的一只了：军阀。那蛮子肯定就在这一带某处晃荡…… | 你向绿皮开了战，为此，它们的军阀迟早会现身。 | 绿皮正四处倒毙。总有一刻，军阀会发现，这些家伙可不是寿终正寝。等他想明白，就会加倍赶来找你。}

bc4577b65fde0188e903.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]{You're hearing a lot of rumors from countryfolk that an orcish warlord is amassing his soldiers and heading your way. If these rumors are true, you should prepare as best you can. | Well, there's a lot of buzz about an orc warlord marching through the region. It just so happens to be heading your way - which makes you think your plan has worked! The %companyname% should prepare itself for one hell of a fight. | Word has it that the orc warlord is heading your way! Prepare the %companyname% as they are in for one hell of a fight! | Every peasant you pass seems to be carrying the same rumor: there's an orc warlord coming your way! This is most likely not a coincidence and the %companyname% should prepare itself accordingly. | Well, the news on the wind is that that the %companyname% is the target of an orc warlord marching with a small army. It appears your plan has worked. The company should prepare for the incredible battle coming its way! | It seems that every peasant you pass has a story to tell and they're all the same: an orc warlord has amassed a small army and just coincidentally happens to be heading your way. The %companyname% should prepare itself for a hell of a fight! | A little old lady comes rushing to you. She explains that everyone is talking about an orc warlord that is heading your way. You're not sure if it's true, but given your purpose these past days it is certainly far too coincidental. The %companyname% should prepare for battle. | Well, the %companyname% should prepare itself or a battle. Everybody you pass is telling you the same story: an orc warlord has amassed a small army and is heading your way! | It appears the killings have worked: news has it that an orc warlord and his army is heading your way to take care of the company personally. The %companyname% should prepare itself for a fight! | A small kid approaches you. He glances at the %companyname%'s sigil and then at you. He smiles.%SPEECH_ON%I think y'all need help.%SPEECH_OFF%That might be true, but it sounds strange coming from the kid. You ask him why and he responds.%SPEECH_ON%My father said a big mean orc is going to kill you all. He said traders have been talking about it allllllll day!%SPEECH_OFF%Hmmm, if true it means the strategy has paid off and the %companyname% should prepare for battle. You thank the kid. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%I just saved your life and all I get is a thanks? You people!%SPEECH_OFF%The kid spits and walks off kicking rocks.}
bc4577b65fde0188e903.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]{乡民间传来许多流言，说一个兽人军阀正在集结士兵，朝你们这边赶来。如果传言属实，就该尽可能做好准备。 | 关于兽人军阀率军穿过这一带的消息，已经传得沸沸扬扬。偏巧，他正朝你们这边来——看来计划奏效了！%companyname%该准备迎接一场恶战。 | 听说兽人军阀正朝你们赶来！让%companyname%做好准备，一场恶战就在眼前！ | 每个与你擦肩而过的农民，似乎都在传同一个消息：兽人军阀正朝你们这里来！这多半不是巧合，%companyname%该作好应战准备。 | 风声传来，一个兽人军阀正带着一支小型军队行进，而目标就是%companyname%。看来你的计划成功了。战团该准备迎接这场非同寻常的大战！ | 你遇到的每个农民似乎都有故事要说，而内容全都一样：一个兽人军阀集结了一支小型军队，恰好正朝你们这里来。%companyname%该准备打一场硬仗了！ | 一个矮小的老妇人匆匆跑来，说大家都在议论：有个兽人军阀正朝你们赶来。你不知道真假，不过想到这几天的行动目的，这也实在巧得过了头。%companyname%该准备战斗。 | 好了，%companyname%该准备迎战了。沿途遇见的每个人都在说同一件事：兽人军阀集结了一支小型军队，正朝你们赶来！ | 看来，之前的杀戮起了作用：消息说，一个兽人军阀正率军赶来，要亲自收拾战团。%companyname%该准备战斗！ | 一个小孩走近，先看看%companyname%的纹章，再看看你，笑了起来。%SPEECH_ON%我觉得你们需要帮忙。%SPEECH_OFF%也许不假，可从孩子嘴里说出来，总有些古怪。你问缘由，他答道。%SPEECH_ON%我爹说，有个又大又凶的兽人要把你们全杀了。他说那些商人从早到晚都在讲这事！%SPEECH_OFF%嗯，如果属实，就说明策略奏效，%companyname%该准备迎战了。你向孩子道谢。他耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我救了你一命，就换来一句谢谢？你们这些人啊！%SPEECH_OFF%孩子啐了一口，一路踢着石子走了。}

6fb1161a51da4181100f.source: We need to be ready for this.

21ebe840737fcc88a53e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_49.png[/img]{The warlord is at the head of a group of orcs and goblins. He stands tall among the already enormous warriors which surround him. You order your men to take battle lines and no sooner do the words leave your lips does the warlord roar and his warriors come running toward you! | A large formation of orcs and goblins stand before you, their warlord standing at the front. He steps forward and heaves a knapsack toward you. It unfurls midair and opens upon hitting the ground. A dozen heads roll forth like mere marbles from a kid's playbag. The warlord raises its weapon high and roars. As the greenskins come your way, you quickly order the %companyname% into formation. | The %companyname% stands before a massed array of greenskins: orcs, goblins, and their warlord, a beastly creature that seems ungainly even among the ranks of its own kind. The enormous warrior raises its weapon and roars, flying birds out of trees and sending critters scuttling into holes.

As the greenskins begin to charge, you shout to your men to fall into formation and remember who they are: the %companyname%! | You and the %companyname% finally come to stand before the warlord and its army of orcs and goblins. This seems the occasion or a speech, but before you can even say a word the brutish savages start charging! | Finally, the forces of man and beast square off. Across from the %companyname% are a small army of orcs and goblins, a brutish warlord standing at their head. You take out your sword and the warlord raises its weapon. If only for a moment, there is an understanding that it is warriors and only warriors who are going to die today. | The orc warlord and its army are charging! You tell the %companyname% that this is what they've trained and prepared for.%SPEECH_ON%We wouldn't be here lest we wanted it!%SPEECH_OFF%The men roar and unsheathe their blades and fall into formation. | As a horde of goblins and orcs charge across the battlefield, an enormous warlord at their head, you tell the men to fear not.%SPEECH_ON%We will have much to celebrate tonight, men!%SPEECH_OFF%They unsheathe their weapons and roar, a deafening scream that echoes back upon the greenskins who look, for the first time, momentarily surprised. | %randombrother% comes to you, pointing out a small army of orcs and goblins charging your way, a warlord at their head.%SPEECH_ON%Not to point out the obvious, but the geenskins are here.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and shout to your men.%SPEECH_ON%Who else is here?%SPEECH_OFF%The men draw out their weapons.%SPEECH_ON%The %companyname%!%SPEECH_OFF% | You and %randombrother% watch as an orc warlord charges your way, a small army of orcs and goblins behind it. The mercenary laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Well, here they come.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you address the men.%SPEECH_ON%They charge because they are afraid. Because they have no ground to stand on. But we do, because we make our stand right here!%SPEECH_OFF%You plant a banner of the %companyname% into the ground. The sigil waves in the wind as the men roar to life. | You watch as the greenskins charge forward with their warlord leading the way. Drawing out your sword, you yell at the men.%SPEECH_ON%A good night's to any man who takes a savage's head. Who sleeps well tonight?%SPEECH_OFF%Metals rattle as the men draw their weapons and shout.%SPEECH_ON%The %companyname%!%SPEECH_OFF%}
21ebe840737fcc88a53e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_49.png[/img]{军阀站在一群兽人和地精前方，身边的战士本已高大得惊人，他却还要高出一截。你命令弟兄们列阵，话音刚落，军阀便发出怒吼，麾下战士随即向你冲来！ | 一大队兽人和地精挡在面前，军阀站在最前头。他向前一步，把一个背囊甩向你。袋子在半空散开，落地时敞开了口，十二颗人头滚出来，仿佛只是从孩子玩具袋里倒出的弹珠。军阀高举武器，放声咆哮。绿皮开始逼近，你立即命令%companyname%列阵。 | %companyname%面前，是集结成阵的绿皮：兽人、地精，以及它们的军阀。那野兽般的庞然大物，即便站在同族之中，也显得畸大笨重。他高举武器，发出一声怒吼，惊得树上飞鸟四散，小兽纷纷钻回洞穴。

绿皮开始冲锋，你高喊着让弟兄们列阵，记住自己的身份：他们是%companyname%！ | 你带着%companyname%，终于与军阀及其兽人、地精大军正面相对。这似乎正是来一番阵前演说的时候，可你还没来得及开口，那些粗野的畜生就已经冲了过来！ | 人与野兽的队伍终于摆开阵势。%companyname%对面是一支兽人和地精组成的小型军队，凶悍的军阀立于最前方。你拔出剑，军阀也举起武器。至少在这一瞬间，你们心照不宣：今日赴死的，将是战士，也只会是战士。 | 兽人军阀正率领大军冲锋！你告诉%companyname%，他们一直以来的训练和准备，正是为了这一刻。%SPEECH_ON%既然站在这里，就是冲着这一战来的！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们怒吼着拔出刀剑，进入阵形。 | 大群地精和兽人冲过战场，庞大的军阀一马当先。你叫弟兄们不要畏惧。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，今晚有的是值得庆祝的事！%SPEECH_OFF%他们拔出武器，发出震耳欲聋的怒吼。吼声迎着绿皮传去，那些怪物第一次露出了片刻的惊愕。 | %randombrother%来到你面前，指着一支冲来的兽人和地精军队，军阀正领在最前。%SPEECH_ON%虽说这是明摆着的，不过，绿皮来了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，朝弟兄们大喊。%SPEECH_ON%还有谁在这里？%SPEECH_OFF%众人拔出武器。%SPEECH_ON%%companyname%！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你和%randombrother%看着兽人军阀向这里冲来，身后跟着一支兽人和地精组成的小型军队。佣兵笑了。%SPEECH_ON%好啊，来了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，向众人喊话。%SPEECH_ON%他们冲过来，是因为害怕，因为无处立足。但我们有，因为我们就在这里站稳脚跟！%SPEECH_OFF%你将%companyname%的战旗插进地里。纹章旗迎风招展，弟兄们的怒吼也随之爆发。 | 你看着绿皮在军阀带领下向前冲锋。拔剑在手，你朝弟兄们高喊。%SPEECH_ON%砍下一颗蛮子的脑袋，今晚就能睡个好觉。今晚谁睡得香？%SPEECH_OFF%金属碰撞声中，弟兄们拔出武器，齐声怒吼。%SPEECH_ON%%companyname%！%SPEECH_OFF%}

146eccf7b0d2a0cf38bd.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]{The warlord is right where he should be: dead on the ground. You watch as the rest of the greenskins take for the hills. Your employer, %employer%, will be most pleased with the work the %companyname% has put in this day. | The %companyname% has triumphed this day! The orc warlord is dead in the mud and his army scattered to the hills. This is a result your employer, %employer%, will be most pleased with. | Your employer, %employer%, paid for the best and got just that: the orc warlord is dead and its roaming band of savages has fled. With no leader, there's little doubt the beasts will scatter and die off on their own. You should go back to the nobleman for your pay. | You have stamped out the greenskins, killing their warlord and sending them running for the hills. Your employer, %employer%, will be most pleased with the %companyname%. | The orc warlord is dead and with no head, the snake of the greenskin gang will shrivel and die. Your employer, %employer%, will be most pleased by this news. | The orc warlord is dead. It looks surprisingly at peace given the amount of terror and chaos it put on this earth. %randombrother% comes up, laughing.%SPEECH_ON%It's big, but it dies. I feel like people always forget that last part.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell the men to prepare a return to %employer% at %townname%. | The warlord is dead at your feet, right where he should be. The %companyname% has earned its payday from %employer%. All that's left is to return to the nobleman and give him the news. | %employer% probably didn't believe in you. He probably didn't foresee this moment where you, a mercenary captain, stands over a dead orc warlord. But that's where you are this day, because the %companyname% is not to be trifled with. Time to go back to that nobleman and get your payday. | The orc warlord is dead and its army scattered. You take a look around and yell to your men.%SPEECH_ON%Men, my friend wants to kill his worst enemy, who should he call upon?%SPEECH_OFF%They raise their fists.%SPEECH_ON%The %companyname%!%SPEECH_OFF%You laugh and continue.%SPEECH_ON%An old woman wants us to kill all the rats in her attic, who should she call upon?%SPEECH_OFF%The men, quieter this time.%SPEECH_ON%The %companyname%?%SPEECH_OFF%You grin widely and continue.%SPEECH_ON%If a dainty man is scared of a spider on his wall, who should he call upon?%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% spits.%SPEECH_ON%Let's just get back to %townname% and %employer% already!%SPEECH_OFF% | You watch as the greenskins scatter like rats. %randombrother% looks ready to give chase, but you stop him.%SPEECH_ON%Let them run.%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenary shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%But they'll speak of us! They know who we are.%SPEECH_OFF%You grin widely and clap the man on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Exactly. C'mon, let's head on back to %townname% and %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF% | You walk through the mounds of the dead, coming to stand before the slain orc warlord. The flies are already upon him. %randombrother% stands beside you, looking down at the beast.%SPEECH_ON%He wasn't so bad. I mean, okay, yeah he was pretty scary. A little on the gonna give me nightmares side of things, but all in all, not too bad.%SPEECH_OFF%You smile and clap the man on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%I hope one day you'll be able to scare you grandchildren with stories of it.%SPEECH_OFF% | The battlefield has settled. The dead are in the places they spent their whole lives getting to. The greenskins are out running for the hills. And the %companyname% is cheering in victory. %employer% will be most pleased with this series of events. | The %companyname% stands triumphant over the greenskin savages. You look down upon the orc warlord, taking into consideration that a lot of things had to die just so... it could die. A strange world with strange rules, but this is simply how it is.

%employer% will be pleased and paying you a lot - and the world of the coin is the world you understand best. | You and %randombrother% look at the orc warlord's corpse. Flies are already busying themselves on its tongue, farking one another and spreading their plague. The mercenary looks at you and laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Is that the end you see for yourself, a bunch of insects doing the business on your goddam face?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and answer.%SPEECH_ON%It's a long ways away from dying while wrapped in a blanket and surrounded by family, that's for sure.%SPEECH_OFF%You slap the sellsword on the chest.%SPEECH_ON%C'mon, enough of that talk. Let's get back to %employer% and get our pay.%SPEECH_OFF%}
146eccf7b0d2a0cf38bd.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]{军阀终于去了他该去的地方：死在地上。你看着其余绿皮四散逃进山野。雇主%employer%一定会对%companyname%今天的表现十分满意。 | %companyname%今天赢得了胜利！兽人军阀死在泥地里，麾下大军溃散进群山。这样的结果，雇主%employer%一定会十分满意。 | 雇主%employer%花钱请最好的佣兵，而你们也确实不负所望：兽人军阀已死，四处流窜的蛮族部众也已逃散。没了首领，这些野兽多半会自行分崩离析，渐渐消亡。你该回去找那贵族领钱了。 | 你们击溃了绿皮，杀死军阀，把它们赶进山野四散奔逃。雇主%employer%一定会对%companyname%十分满意。 | 兽人军阀已死。蛇没了头，这群绿皮也会随之萎缩消亡。雇主%employer%一定会为这个消息十分高兴。 | 兽人军阀死了。想到他曾给世间带来多少恐怖与混乱，如今的面容却安详得出奇。%randombrother%笑着走来。%SPEECH_ON%块头是大，可一样会死。我总觉得，大家老忘了后半句。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，叫弟兄们准备返回%townname%，去见%employer%。 | 军阀死在你脚下，正是他该待的地方。%companyname%已经挣到了%employer%的报酬。剩下的，只是回去见那贵族，报告消息。 | %employer%大概从没信过你。他大概没想到，你这个佣兵团长，竟能站在一具兽人军阀的尸体旁。可今天，你就站在这里，因为%companyname%绝不是好惹的。该回去找那贵族领钱了。 | 兽人军阀已死，大军也已溃散。你环顾四周，向弟兄们喊道。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，我有个朋友想杀掉死敌，该请谁出马？%SPEECH_OFF%他们举起拳头。%SPEECH_ON%%companyname%！%SPEECH_OFF%你笑着继续。%SPEECH_ON%有个老太太想杀光阁楼里的老鼠，她该请谁？%SPEECH_OFF%这次，弟兄们声音低了些。%SPEECH_ON%%companyname%？%SPEECH_OFF%你咧开嘴，接着问。%SPEECH_ON%要是一个娇气的男人，被墙上的蜘蛛吓坏了，他该请谁？%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%还是赶紧回%townname%找%employer%吧！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你看着绿皮像老鼠一样四散逃窜。%randombrother%似乎想追，你拦住了他。%SPEECH_ON%让它们跑。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵摇头。%SPEECH_ON%可它们会把我们的事说出去！它们知道我们是谁。%SPEECH_OFF%你咧嘴一笑，拍了拍他的肩。%SPEECH_ON%就是这个意思。走吧，回%townname%，找%employer%去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你穿过层层尸堆，来到被杀的兽人军阀面前。苍蝇已经围上了他。%randombrother%站在你身旁，低头看着这头野兽。%SPEECH_ON%也没那么可怕。我的意思是，好吧，是挺吓人的。稍微到了能让我做噩梦的地步，不过总的来说，也就那样。%SPEECH_OFF%你笑着拍拍他的肩。%SPEECH_ON%希望有一天，你能拿这故事去吓唬自己的孙辈。%SPEECH_OFF% | 战场平静下来。死者躺在他们耗尽一生才抵达的终点，绿皮向群山逃窜，%companyname%则为胜利欢呼。这一连串结果，会让%employer%十分满意。 | %companyname%战胜了绿皮蛮族。你低头看着兽人军阀，想到竟有那么多生命必须先死去，才换来……他的死。奇怪的世界，奇怪的规矩，可事情就是如此。

%employer%会高兴，也会给你很多钱——而钱的世界，才是你最懂的世界。 | 你和%randombrother%看着兽人军阀的尸体。苍蝇已经在他的舌头上忙碌，互相交配，散播瘟疫。佣兵看着你，笑道。%SPEECH_ON%您想过自己也会这么收场吗？一群虫子就在您那张该死的脸上办事。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸肩答道。%SPEECH_ON%这跟裹着毯子、家人围在身边时咽气，确实差得挺远。%SPEECH_OFF%你拍了拍佣兵的胸口。%SPEECH_ON%行了，不聊这个。回去找%employer%，把钱领了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

5a6b0808ee918700a9b2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_93.png[/img]While on the path, %randombrother% suddenly straightens up and tells everyone to get quiet. You crouch low and crabwalk to him. He points through some bushes.%SPEECH_ON%There. Trouble. Big, fat trouble.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare through the bushes to see a camp of orc berserkers. They've got a small fire going with a spit of spinning meat. Nearby are a cluster of cages, each one holding a whining dog. You watch as one of the greenskins opens a cage and yanks a dog out. He drags it kicking and screaming toward the fire and holds it over the flames.

 The mercenary glances at you.%SPEECH_ON%What should we do, sir?%SPEECH_OFF%
5a6b0808ee918700a9b2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_93.png[/img]行路途中，%randombrother%忽然挺直身子，叫大家安静。你压低身体，侧步挪到他身边。他指向灌木后方。%SPEECH_ON%那儿。麻烦。又大又肥的麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%你透过灌木，看见一处兽人狂战士营地。小火堆上，烤叉正转着肉，旁边一排笼子，每只里面都有狗在呜咽。你看着一头绿皮打开笼门，扯出一条狗。它拖着不断挣扎惨叫的狗来到火边，举到火焰上方。

佣兵瞥了你一眼。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我们怎么办？%SPEECH_OFF%

2d29c74a8e6f9ffccf65.source: We're at war and every battle counts. To arms!
2d29c74a8e6f9ffccf65.translation: 眼下正在打仗，每一战都算数。拿起武器！

cd3d5b0ae9eeffc64393.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_93.png[/img]This isn't your fight nor would it ever be. You have the men swing around the encampment, quietly avoiding what could very easily be a devastating fight with a group of berserkers. The howls of dogs seem to chase you away and linger with a few of the men long after you've left the place.
cd3d5b0ae9eeffc64393.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_93.png[/img]这不该是你们的战斗，永远都不该。你带着弟兄们悄悄绕过营地，避开了与一群狂战士可能造成惨重损失的交锋。狗的哀嚎仿佛追在身后，离开很久，仍缠着几个弟兄不散。

cc458d5372a77b0e5fcf.source: Keep your heads on straight, men.

b64cf4c2c90f55d727fd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_32.png[/img]The fight over, you take a good look around the berserkers' encampment. Each of the cages is home to a shriveled, cornered dog. When you open one of the cages, the dog sprints out, yelping and yapping as it darts over the hills and is gone, just like that. Most of the other mutts follow suit. Two, however, remain. They follow you around as you inspect the rest of the encampment. %randombrother% notes that they're war dogs.%SPEECH_ON%Look at the size of 'em. Big, burly, nasty farks. Their owners must've been killed by the orcs and now, well, they've reason to trust us. Welcome to the company, little buddies.%SPEECH_OFF%
b64cf4c2c90f55d727fd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_32.png[/img]战斗结束，你仔细查看狂战士的营地。每只笼子里，都蜷着一条瘦弱的狗。你打开其中一扇，狗立刻冲出，呜叫狂吠着越过山丘，就这样消失了。其余大多也跟着跑了，唯有两条留了下来。你检查营地别处时，它们一路跟随。%randombrother%认出，这是战犬。%SPEECH_ON%瞧这块头，又大又壮，凶得很。主人准是被兽人杀了，如今嘛，它们有理由信我们。欢迎加入战团，小伙计们。%SPEECH_OFF%

7dbde8b60a91718b2ed8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_32.png[/img]With the last of the berserkers slain, you start in on their camp. You find the burnt bones of dogs strewn about the campfire. The meat has been picked clean and a collection of heads was teetering like some sickly cairn. %randombrother% goes about opening the cages. All the dogs, the very second they have a gap, sprint out and run away. The mercenary manages to snag one, but it yelps and goes limp, dying from sheer panic and fear. The rest of the camp has nothing of value aside from disappointment and piles of orc shite.
7dbde8b60a91718b2ed8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_32.png[/img]最后一个狂战士倒下，你们走进营地。篝火旁散着烧焦的狗骨，肉早被啃净，一堆狗头摇摇欲坠地摞着，像某种病态的石冢。%randombrother%逐个打开笼子，只要露出缝隙，狗便立刻窜出逃走。佣兵好不容易抓住一只，它却惨叫一声，软了下去，竟因极度惊恐而死。营地其余地方，除了一堆堆兽人粪便和满心失望，再没什么收获。

f606df1c9a7bea6f5079.translation: 我们在这里还是做了件好事。

5e6501f54a98f1080afd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You find %employer% talking to his generals. He turns to you with a smile and arms open.%SPEECH_ON%Well, you did it, sellsword. I gotta admit, I didn't think you could. Funny business, killing orcs.%SPEECH_OFF%It wasn't especially funny, but you nod anyway. The nobleman goes and gets a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns and hands it to you personally.%SPEECH_ON%Job well done.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found in bed with a few women. His guard stands at the door, shrugging with a 'you said let him in' look on his face. The nobleman waves at you.%SPEECH_ON%I'm a bit busy, but I understand that you have been successful in all your... ehem, endeavors.%SPEECH_OFF%He snaps his fingers and one of the women slides out of the blankets. She daintily crosses the cold stone floor to pick up a satchel and carry it over to you. %employer% speaks again.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns, was it? I think that's some pretty pay for what you have done. I hear killing an orc warlord isn't exactly easy business.%SPEECH_OFF%The woman stares deep into your eyes as she hands the money over.%SPEECH_ON%You killed an orc warlord? That's so brave...%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and the lithe lady twists on her toes. The nobleman snaps his fingers again and she returns to his bed.%SPEECH_ON%Careful, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF% | A guard takes you to a gardening %employer%. He snips at the vegetables and drops them into a basket held by a servant.%SPEECH_ON%Judging by your not being dead, my deductive skills tells me you were successful in killing the orc warlord.%SPEECH_OFF%You respond.%SPEECH_ON%It wasn't easy.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman nods, staring at the dirt, then continues clipping off a series of tomatoes.%SPEECH_ON%The guard standing yonder will have your pay. %reward_completion% crowns as we agreed upon. I'm very busy right now, but you should know that I and the people of this town owe you a lot.%SPEECH_OFF%And by 'a lot' he just means %reward_completion% crowns, apparently. | %employer% welcomes you into his room.%SPEECH_ON%My little birds have been chirping a lot these days, telling me stories of a sellsword that slew an orc warlord and scattered his army. And I thought to myself, hey, I think I know that guy.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman grins and hands over a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Good work, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% greets you with a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_ON%My spies have already told me everything I need to know. You are the man to trust, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | When you enter %employer%'s room you find the nobleman listening to the whispers of one of his scribes. Seeing you, the man bolts upright.%SPEECH_ON%Speak of the devil and he will come. You are the talk of the town, sellsword. Killing an orc warlord and scattering its army? Well, I'd say that's worth the %reward_completion% crowns we agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is staring dutifully at a map.%SPEECH_ON%I'm gonna have to redraw some of this thank to you - and I mean that in the good way. Killing that orc warlord will allow us to rebuild from the ashes it had sown over these lands.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, but subtly ask about the pay. The nobleman smiles.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns, was it? Also, you should at least take a moment to let the accolades come in, sellsword. The money isn't going nowhere, but the pride you feel now will one day fade.%SPEECH_OFF%You disagree. That money is going to fade its way into a pint of good mead. | %employer% is pacing his room while generals stand by the wayside in almost dutiful silence. You ask what the problem is and the man bolts upright.%SPEECH_ON%By the old gods on a fly's ass, I didn't think you'd make it.%SPEECH_OFF%You ignore that soaring vote of confidence and inform the nobleman of all that you've done. He nods repeatedly then takes out a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns and hands it over.%SPEECH_ON%That is a job well done, mercenary. Well damn done!%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% watching a servant chop wood. Seeing your shadow, the nobleman wheels around.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, the man of the hour! I've already heard so much of what you've done. We're actually having a celebration - gotta prep the firewood for cooking and nighttime festivities. I'd invite you, but this is for the highborn only, I'm sure you understand.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and respond.%SPEECH_ON%I'd understand a lot better if I had the %reward_completion% crowns we agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% laughs and snaps his fingers to a guard who promptly brings your pay over. | %employer% is found talking to the captain of another mercenary band. He's a frail leader, probably just getting his start. But upon seeing you, the nobleman quickly dismisses him and welcomes you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah hell, it is good seeing you, mercenary! Things were about to get a little desperate around here.%SPEECH_OFF%You remark that the captain you just saw would be most unfit to handle any job, much less that of hunting an orc warlord. The nobleman hands you a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns and responds.%SPEECH_ON%Look, let's just agree that you've done good this day. We can finally start rebuilding what that damned orc savage destroyed and that's what matters.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowns in your hand are what matters, but you agree to no longer dawdle on the point.}
5e6501f54a98f1080afd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你找到%employer%时，他正与将领们交谈。他转过身，面带笑容，张开双臂。%SPEECH_ON%好啊，你办到了，佣兵。得承认，我原以为你不行。杀兽人，真是桩有趣的活。%SPEECH_OFF%倒也没那么有趣，不过你还是点头。贵族取来一袋%reward_completion%克朗，亲手交给你。%SPEECH_ON%干得漂亮。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正和几个女人躺在床上。门口的守卫耸耸肩，脸上一副“可是你叫我放他进来的”神情。贵族朝你招手。%SPEECH_ON%我有点忙，不过我听说，你的各项……咳，努力，都取得了成功。%SPEECH_OFF%他打个响指，一个女人从被子里滑出来，踮着脚轻轻走过冰冷的石地，拿起钱袋，送到你面前。%employer%又开口。%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion%克朗，对吧？我觉得，这笔钱配得上你干的事。听说，杀个兽人军阀可不容易。%SPEECH_OFF%女人递钱时，深深望着你的眼睛。%SPEECH_ON%你杀了一个兽人军阀？真勇敢……%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，身姿轻盈的女人踮脚转身。贵族又打了个响指，她便回到床上。%SPEECH_ON%留神点，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 守卫带你找到正在园中忙碌的%employer%。他剪下蔬菜，放进仆人提着的篮子。%SPEECH_ON%既然你还没死，以我的推理能力判断，兽人军阀应该已经被你杀了。%SPEECH_OFF%你答道。%SPEECH_ON%可不容易。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族盯着泥土点头，又继续剪下一串番茄。%SPEECH_ON%那边的守卫拿着你的报酬，%reward_completion%克朗，和约好的一样。我现在很忙，不过你该知道，我和镇上的人都欠你很多。%SPEECH_OFF%显然，他所谓的“很多”，也就只是%reward_completion%克朗。 | %employer%请你进屋。%SPEECH_ON%这几天，我的小鸟一直叫个不停，说有个佣兵杀了兽人军阀，还击溃了他的大军。我心想，嘿，这个人我好像认识。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族咧嘴一笑，递来一袋%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%拿着一袋%reward_completion%克朗迎接你。%SPEECH_ON%该知道的事，密探已经全告诉我了。你是个靠得住的人，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，贵族正在听一名书记员耳语。见到你，他猛地直起身。%SPEECH_ON%刚说到你，你就来了。镇上都在议论你，佣兵。杀死兽人军阀，击溃他的军队？要我说，值咱们约好的%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正专注地盯着地图。%SPEECH_ON%多亏你，这上面有些地方得重画了——我是说好事。那个兽人军阀死了，我们终于能在他撒满这片土地的灰烬上重建家园。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，委婉问起报酬。贵族笑了。%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion%克朗，对吧？还有，佣兵，你至少该花点时间，听听别人夸你。钱又不会跑，可眼下这份自豪，总有一天会淡去。%SPEECH_OFF%你可不这么想。那些钱，倒是很快就会消失在一品脱上好的蜜酒里。 | %employer%在屋里踱步，将领们站在一旁，几乎是尽职尽责地保持沉默。你问出了什么事，他猛地直起身。%SPEECH_ON%苍蝇屁股上的旧神在上，我真没想到你能办成。%SPEECH_OFF%你无视这份高得惊人的“信任”，把所做的一切告诉贵族。他连连点头，取出一袋%reward_completion%克朗递给你。%SPEECH_ON%这活干得漂亮，佣兵。真他妈漂亮！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正看着仆人劈柴。发现你的影子，贵族立刻转身。%SPEECH_ON%啊，大功臣！你的事，我已经听说了不少。我们正准备庆祝呢，做饭和晚上的欢宴都需要柴火。我倒想邀请你，可这场宴会只招待出身高贵的人，想必你能理解。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸肩答道。%SPEECH_ON%要是能拿到约好的%reward_completion%克朗，我会理解得更透彻。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%笑了，朝守卫打个响指，对方立刻把报酬送来。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正与另一支佣兵队伍的团长交谈。那团长看着孱弱，大概刚入行。可一见到你，贵族便立刻打发他走，迎了上来。%SPEECH_ON%啊，见鬼，见到你真好，佣兵！这边眼看都快没辙了。%SPEECH_OFF%你说，刚才那位团长，恐怕什么活都干不成，更别说猎杀兽人军阀。贵族递给你一袋%reward_completion%克朗，答道。%SPEECH_ON%听着，咱们只需承认，你今天干得很好。我们终于能开始重建被那个该死兽人蛮子毁掉的东西，这才重要。%SPEECH_OFF%你手里的克朗才重要，不过你也同意，不再纠缠这个话题。}

2f7cec9a9b5185fedbd3.translation: 这些克朗，是我们应得的。

1d2ddcb769e842f3c314.source: A horde of greenskins led by a fearsome orc warlord.
1d2ddcb769e842f3c314.translation: 一支由可怕的兽人督军率领的绿皮大军。

dcb9611a41ae9c303365.source: You didn't help wardogs being eaten by orcs
dcb9611a41ae9c303365.translation: 你没有救下被兽人吞食的战犬

d81534473996984f0db8.translation: 杀死了一名声名远扬的兽人督军

0caa99bd871fed00c8b2.translation: 从南方异教徒手中夺取%holysite%

d5081959821e37852557.source: Destroy or rout enemy regiments in the vicinity
d5081959821e37852557.translation: 消灭或击溃附近的敌军

46d528cc75b13d93fe31.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer% is found surrounded by a congress of holy men, each seemingly more knowledgeable than the last about the intent and desires of the old gods. But there is a clear line of thought arrowing through the conversation: the southerners have taken %holysite% and it must be recovered. The lord points you out.%SPEECH_ON%The %companyname% shall endeavor to end this nightmare!%SPEECH_OFF%Pushing the priors out of the way, %employer% nears and his voice lowers.%SPEECH_ON%For the right price, of course. I've few men to spare, but the holy lands are of great importance to the people and to myself. You must go there and drive out the heathens so that the old gods shall not leave us behind, our failures and all.%SPEECH_OFF% | The door to %employer%'s room flies open and a line of holy men make their leave. A couple pause to glare at you, not a one seemingly happy by your presence. %employer% waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%Do not concern yourself with their pitiful, accusative eyes, sellsword. %holysite% has been lost to the southerners and it has put a whole faggot of sticks up their collective arses. Not that I blame them, even a grouser such as I carries a soft spot for the sacred lands. These priors simply wish to have %holysite% reclaimed by proper royal colors, but alas, I've committed my soldiers elsewhere. You, however, can do the job just fine, for proper coin, aye?%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%The old gods are no doubt looking upon this room, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% swirls his chalice around, the wine sloshing along the rim and leaving a purple glisten behind.%SPEECH_ON%Southerners have taken %holysite% and no doubt profaned it entirely. I'd sooner have a dog find a piss spot on the sacred lands than watch one of those southern shits stand in the supposed sublimity of their god. What was it, the Gilder? What a load of horse shit. Go there and kill them all and return %holysite% to proper standing.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found in his garden and he's almost aggressively alone. Men and women around the fenceline seem scared to even glance his way. Not that care: you freely walk in. He's staring at a kicked ant pile, the insects scurrying around to rebuild. The nobleman sighs.%SPEECH_ON%I sometimes wonder if the old gods look upon us in such a manner.%SPEECH_OFF%You remark that you really only notice ants when they bite. The nobleman gets to his feet.%SPEECH_ON%You should know they're good for the garden, sellsword. If they bite, I surmise it is without passion. It is only them doing what they know to do, just as they know to rebuild when I kick their home over. Just as it is that when I learned the southern roaches had impermanently trespassed upon %holysite% that I, by the way of the old gods, knew they must be rooted out and destroyed.%SPEECH_OFF%You half-expect the nobleman to compare you to an ant, but instead he simply offers you a large chunk of crowns to get to the holy lands and break its occupants.%SPEECH_ON%You would be like a wasp in the garden, perhaps.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman says, to which you respond with a stoic nod. | %SPEECH_ON%I'm not one for pottery, sellsword, so when I say the southern farks are lower than an arsemonger's moonlit depravity, you should know that their trespass alone has compelled me to the way of the minstrel.%SPEECH_OFF%You think to inform %employer% that he may mean 'poetry', but in a way he is breaking pots here. Besides, he no doubt sees you as someone with clay feet.%SPEECH_ON%The savages have taken %holysite% and rumors are they've even killed all 'non-believers.' My soldiers are spread out, the fields of battle plentiful as they are. But you are available. And you're a greedy fark, sure, but I also know the %companyname% is the exact sort of might and main we need to get those bastards out of the holy lands.%SPEECH_OFF%}
46d528cc75b13d93fe31.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%被一群教士围着，他们一个比一个更像是深谙旧神的意图与欲求。不过，纷杂谈话里有一条清楚的主线：南方人占了%holysite%，必须夺回来。领主指向你。%SPEECH_ON%%companyname%会竭尽全力，终结这场噩梦！%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%拨开修道院长们，走近你，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%当然，价钱得合适。我抽不出多少人，可圣地对百姓和我都至关重要。你必须去那里赶走异教徒，免得旧神因我们的失败，彻底抛弃我们。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的房门猛然打开，一队教士鱼贯而出。其中几个停步瞪你，似乎没一个欢迎你的到来。%employer%招手让你进去。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，别理他们那副可怜巴巴、又怨天尤人的眼神。%holysite%被南方人夺了，简直像给他们每人屁股里都捅了一捆柴。我倒不怪他们，就连我这种爱发牢骚的人，对圣地也有几分感情。院长们不过是想让堂堂贵族的旗帜收复%holysite%，可惜我的兵另有去处。不过，你也一样办得到，只要克朗给够，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%佣兵，旧神此刻必定正注视着这间屋子。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%晃着酒杯，酒液沿杯沿涌动，留下紫色的亮痕。%SPEECH_ON%南方人夺了%holysite%，无疑已将那里亵渎殆尽。我宁肯看一条狗在圣地找地方撒尿，也不愿看那些南方杂种摆出一副受了神恩的崇高嘴脸。那神叫什么，镀金者？一派狗屁。去那里，把他们杀光，让%holysite%重归正统。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在花园里找到%employer%。他独处的架势几乎透着敌意，围栏边的男男女女连望一眼都不敢。你却不在乎，径直走了进去。他正盯着一座被踢散的蚁丘，蚂蚁四处奔忙，试图重建。贵族叹道：%SPEECH_ON%我有时会想，旧神看我们，是否也是这般模样。%SPEECH_OFF%你说，自己通常只有被咬时才注意蚂蚁。贵族站起身。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你该知道，蚂蚁对花园有益。它们若咬人，我想也并非出于愤怒，只是在做天性使然的事，就像我踢翻巢穴，它们便知道重建。也正如我听说那些南方蟑螂暂且侵占了%holysite%，便奉旧神之意，明白必须把它们连根铲除。%SPEECH_OFF%你还以为贵族接下来要把你比作蚂蚁，他却只是开出大笔克朗，请你前往圣地，击溃占领者。%SPEECH_ON%或许，你更像花园里的黄蜂。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族说道。你面无表情地点了点头。 | %SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我可不懂陶艺。所以，当我说南方混蛋比月下卖屁股的勾当还下贱时，你就该知道，光是他们的侵占，就逼得我学起了吟游诗人。%SPEECH_OFF%你想提醒%employer%，他要说的大概是‘诗艺’。不过，瞧这副摔坛砸罐的火气，倒也不全算说错。何况在他眼里，你多半也只是个泥脚佣兵。%SPEECH_ON%野蛮人夺走了%holysite%，听说还杀光了所有‘不信神的人’。到处都是战场，我的士兵分散各处，可你有空。你确实是个贪财的混账，但我也知道，要把那帮杂种赶出圣地，正需要%companyname%这样的实力。%SPEECH_OFF%}

5482b1848bddc77c0cb2.source: {I trust you'll pay amply for an assault like this. | We're ready to do our part. | Let's talk some more about payment.}
5482b1848bddc77c0cb2.translation: {这样的攻坚战，想必你会付足报酬。 | 我们准备好了，会尽自己的一份力。 | 我们再谈谈报酬。}

9a7c936ce58d357db4a7.source: {This isn't worth it. | It's too long a march. | We have more pressing business to attend to. | We're needed elsewhere.}
9a7c936ce58d357db4a7.translation: {不值得。 | 这路也太远了。 | 我们还有更紧要的事。 | 别处还有事等着我们。}

4aa138e6ba88505fc577.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{The southerners have posted themselves in and around %holysite%. With time on their side, they've erected a sturdy defense, but nothing the %companyname% can't handle. You draw out your sword and prepare your men for the attack.}
4aa138e6ba88505fc577.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{南方人已在%holysite%内外布防。时间充裕，让他们筑起了坚固防线，不过还难不倒%companyname%。你拔出剑，命令弟兄们准备进攻。}

7581952bbd93061a2412.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%holysite% is already under siege by men carrying %employerfaction%'s banner. As you come closer, a man meets you half way. He raises his hand and then puts it to his belt.%SPEECH_ON%I got word they were sending a mercenary and you appear to be it. The %companyname%, was it? Well, I am %commander%, a lieutenant of %employer%'s. I will be joining you in rooting out these desert rats. I fear, as I'm sure you do, that the old gods will be punish us all if we do not see to this task posthaste.%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenant spits and runs a hand across his grizzled face.%SPEECH_ON%Well. Let the old gods see us as truly as we are, and we shall butcher these dune goons in a manner most righteous.%SPEECH_OFF% | %holysite% is already under siege by men carrying %employerfaction%'s banner. The leader steps forward and speaks loudly.%SPEECH_ON%The %companyname%, my name is %commander%, lieutenant to %employer%'s field army. I have come to join you, or shall I say you will be joining me, in going to %holysite% and ripping out those southern scum from every inch of the place. For the old gods watch over us all, even the likes of you sellswords, and failure today will surely doom us to every hell there is.%SPEECH_OFF%Right. You just want to be sure, help or not, that %employer% will pay you the full amount of that which will be owed. | %holysite% is already under siege by men carrying %employerfaction%'s banner. It's seemingly a congress of holy men and soldiers alike, and the lieutenant leading the troop brandishes his sword before swiftly aiming it toward %holysite%.%SPEECH_ON%The southern lickspittles will either leave, or we will convert them to the hells of the old gods by the grace of our steel. There is no other choice in this matter. Come then, mercenaries!%SPEECH_OFF%It appears the %companyname% will have some help in this endeavor, though you fully expect to still see the entirety of the reward promised.}
7581952bbd93061a2412.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{打着%employerfaction%旗号的军队，已经围住%holysite%。你走近时，一人在半途迎来，抬手致意，再将手搭回腰带。%SPEECH_ON%听说上头派了佣兵，看样子就是你们。%companyname%，对吧？我是%commander%，%employer%的副官。我会和你们一起，把这些沙漠老鼠赶出去。我担心，若不赶紧办妥，旧神会惩罚我们所有人。想必你也一样。%SPEECH_OFF%副官啐了一口，抹过满是胡茬的脸。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，让旧神看清我们真正的模样，再以最正义的方式，宰了那些沙丘蠢货。%SPEECH_OFF% | 打着%employerfaction%旗号的军队，已经围住%holysite%。领队上前，高声说道：%SPEECH_ON%%companyname%，我是%commander%，%employer%野战军中的副官。我来协助你们——或者该说，是你们协助我——杀进%holysite%，把那些南方渣滓从每一寸土地上清出去。旧神注视着我们所有人，连你们这些佣兵也不例外。今天若失败，所有地狱都会等着我们。%SPEECH_OFF%行吧。你只想先确认，无论有没有援军，%employer%都得把该付的钱一分不少地付清。 | 打着%employerfaction%旗号的军队，已经围住%holysite%。士兵与教士似乎都聚在这里，领军的副官挥起剑，猛地指向%holysite%。%SPEECH_ON%南方的奴才要么滚，要么就让我们的刀剑施恩，送他们皈依旧神的地狱。没有第三条路。来吧，佣兵！%SPEECH_OFF%看来，%companyname%这趟会有帮手。不过，先前说好的报酬，你仍打算照数收齐。}

f16732cff2b6e1ce79b8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{%holysite%'s defenders have received reinforcements! Thankfully, there is a silver lining: the additional arms has given them the confidence to leave the natural defenses of the holy site and to approach you in the open field. | You're surprised to see the defenders leaving %holysite% and trekking across the open field. A quick scouting report relays that they received reinforcements sometime in the past few days and are emboldened by numbers alone. On one hand, their deep ranks are a bit unsettling, but on the other hand facing them on even ground will be much easier. Though by your honest estimation it is their mistake to face the %companyname% at all.}
f16732cff2b6e1ce79b8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{%holysite%的守军得到了增援！好在也有转机：援军让他们信心大增，竟舍弃圣地的天然屏障，来到开阔地向你逼近。 | 你惊讶地发现，守军正在离开%holysite%，向开阔地行进。斥候很快回报，他们在过去几天里得到了增援，仗着人数增加便壮起了胆。敌军密集的队列确实令人不安，不过在平地上交战，总要容易得多。说实话，在你看来，胆敢与%companyname%交手，本身就是他们的错误。}

bb2ada27d1b271e43580.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{As %holysite% draws into view, a man who looks almost eerily similar to you approaches. He's got a paymaster and a couple of sellswords at his side.%SPEECH_ON%Evenin', captain. I am %mercenary% of the %mercenarycompany%. I came to these lands in search of crown, just as you have. Now, I wager that fat nobleman wetted his pen in a mighty sound contract for you and your men, but what say you pay me %pay% crowns and I'll help you in this little endeavor? Unless, of course, you want me to offer my services to the other side over yonder.%SPEECH_OFF% | You are approached by a group of men, one of which whose gait and constitution alike seem strangely reminiscent to your own. He announces himself as %mercenary%, captain of the %mercenarycompany%.%SPEECH_ON%I thought %employer% might send his professional army to see to the holy site's change of hands. I will admit to you, captain, that I helped them dune loons take over this prestigious monument in the first place. However, for %pay% crowns, I'm willing to help your side take it back. As a fellow mercenary, I'm sure you can see how this would be a good deal for all involved.%SPEECH_OFF%}
bb2ada27d1b271e43580.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{%holysite%渐入眼帘，一个与你相像得近乎诡异的男人走了过来，身旁跟着军饷官和几个佣兵。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，团长。我是%mercenarycompany%的%mercenary%。跟你一样，来这片土地只为挣克朗。我敢说，那位胖贵族大笔一挥，已经给你和手下签了份相当体面的委托。不过，你若付我%pay%克朗，我就帮你办这桩小事，怎么样？当然，除非你更希望我去替那边干活。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群人向你走来，其中一人的步态与身形，都与你有种奇妙的相似。他自称%mercenary%，是%mercenarycompany%的团长。%SPEECH_ON%我还以为%employer%会派他的正规军，来办圣地易主的事。不瞒你说，团长，当初就是我帮那些沙丘疯子夺下这座大名鼎鼎的圣迹。不过，只要%pay%克朗，我就愿意帮你们夺回来。同为佣兵，你一定看得出，这买卖对大家都好。%SPEECH_OFF%}

fae82c41f5e1dda462b1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{The captain grins and slaps your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Aaahhh, there it is! There it is, the noble sellsword spirit! Aye, commander of the %companyname%, let us venture forth, for a short time, and do battle together, also for a short time!%SPEECH_OFF% | With the deal made, the captain of the mercenary company sidles up next to you. Almost uncomfortably close, and assuredly within range of his breath, which is unappreciated.%SPEECH_ON%You know, men like us, fellas like us, pals, we're pals, right? Pals like us. We gotta stick together. And for this here battle, we'll be sticking together.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods and slugs one into your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%After the fight, well, I hope we can be buddies again sometime, you know?%SPEECH_OFF%}
fae82c41f5e1dda462b1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{那团长咧嘴笑着，拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%啊，就是这个！就是这股高贵的佣兵精神！没错，%companyname%的团长，咱们一道向前走上一程，再一道打上一仗——都只是暂时的！%SPEECH_OFF% | 交易谈妥，对方战团的团长凑到你身旁，近得几乎令人不适，更让你不情愿地闻清了他的口气。%SPEECH_ON%你知道，咱们这种人，你我这种伙计，朋友，咱们是朋友，对吧？像咱们这样的朋友，得抱成团。这一仗，就该抱成团打。%SPEECH_OFF%他点头，在你肩上捶了一拳。%SPEECH_ON%等打完了，嗯，希望往后还有机会再做朋友，你懂吧？%SPEECH_OFF%}

67f841c05a76aa2d3c31.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%That's a shame.%SPEECH_OFF%%mercenary% says as he quickly jaunts back to the ranks of the %mercenarycompany%. He keeps backing up right into the soldiers defending %holysite%. His arms are wide and fanning, as though he were swimming against a current.%SPEECH_ON%A damn shame, I say! Well, captain of the %companyname%, let us see which side purchased the finer sellsword, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenary draws his weapon, as do the southern soldiers at %holysite% behind them. Naturally, you draw your weapon as well. It is time to fight. | %SPEECH_ON%Aye, aye, I see. Well. I didn't expect much. I am, after all, also a seller of the sword. And right now...%SPEECH_OFF%He paces backward to his company, and his company to the ranks of the southern soldiers protecting %holysite%.%SPEECH_ON%Right now, the south proves to be the highest bidder.%SPEECH_OFF%}
67f841c05a76aa2d3c31.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%真遗憾。%SPEECH_OFF%%mercenary%一边说，一边快步退回%mercenarycompany%的队列。他继续后退，直到混入防守%holysite%的士兵之中，双臂张开摆动，仿佛在逆流游泳。%SPEECH_ON%我说，真他妈遗憾！好吧，%companyname%的团长，来看看哪一边雇的佣兵更值钱，如何？%SPEECH_OFF%那佣兵拔出武器，身后守卫%holysite%的南方士兵也纷纷照做。你自然也拔出武器。该开战了。 | %SPEECH_ON%嗯，嗯，我明白。好吧，本来也没抱太大指望。毕竟我也是卖命挣钱的。而眼下……%SPEECH_OFF%他退向自己的战团，战团则退入守卫%holysite%的南方军阵。%SPEECH_ON%眼下，南方出的价最高。%SPEECH_OFF%}

3068271d83ec1dfac971.source: We'll meet again on the battlefield. Begin the assault!

f9fdc30631ff0bb4830d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{The battle is over, but a golden gleam in the distance catches your eye. As you stare at the horizon, a troop of southerners appears, their bright appearance no doubt meant to be seen. It's a counter-attack! | As you sheathe your blade %randombrother% calls out. He points at the horizon. A line of southerners is on the approach, their armor glinting, their gait swaggering. The counter-attackers wish to be seen, and no doubt intend to be victorious...}
f9fdc30631ff0bb4830d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{战斗结束了，可远处一道金光引起了你的注意。你凝视地平线，一队南方人出现在眼前，甲胄亮得扎眼，显然存心让人看见。敌人在反攻！ | 你刚收剑，%randombrother%便喊起来，伸手指向地平线。一列南方人正大摇大摆地逼近，护甲闪闪发亮。这支反攻的队伍既想让人看见，也显然志在必得……}

6667c8ca72abf03e8161.source: We'll make a stand defending the site!

56b21ed9a0c81a0feabd.source: We'll meet them in the open!

deee5e4b4cc1cee1b8dc.source: We can't take another fight. Retreat!

16455a75ec69edf15a0c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{The southerners' approach is ever steady.%SPEECH_ON%Roaches, they just never end.%SPEECH_OFF%You look over to see %randombrother% shaking his head. He lifts up his boot and flicks a bug off the toe. He puts his foot down and nods back toward the attackers.%SPEECH_ON%Don't worry, captain, we'll have %holysite%'s defenses in tip-top shape for them savage bastards.%SPEECH_OFF% | You order the men to defend the site.%SPEECH_ON%Making a stand in %holysite%, what a time to be alive.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says. You nod and tell him you hope it will one day be a memory for him. He laughs and asks how he could ever forget. Another sellsword chimes in that there's one very certain way he can forget, but you cut him off and tell the men to pay attention to the task at hand.}
16455a75ec69edf15a0c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{南方人仍在稳步逼近。%SPEECH_ON%蟑螂，真是没完没了。%SPEECH_OFF%你转头，看见%randombrother%摇着脑袋，抬起靴子，把靴尖上一只虫弹掉。他放下脚，又朝进攻者点头。%SPEECH_ON%别担心，团长。我们会把%holysite%的防线收拾妥当，好好招待那群野蛮杂种。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你命令众人守住圣地。%SPEECH_ON%在%holysite%坚守死战，活着能赶上这场面，也值了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%说道。你点头，说希望有朝一日，他还能回忆起今天。他笑着问，这种事怎么忘得掉。另一个佣兵插话，说倒有个保证能忘的办法。你打断他，让众人专心应付眼前的仗。}

d9f6be221f467d224b3f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{The defenses don't look as solid as they did before. You order the %companyname% to take the field in formation where no faulty constructs will get in the way of your command. The southern lieutenant greets you.%SPEECH_ON%You profane %holysite% with blood, for this the Gilder Himself has no doubt drawn you to the field to die like proper men. What have you to say to this?%SPEECH_OFF%You draw your sword.%SPEECH_ON%Wasn't my blood.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d9f6be221f467d224b3f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{防御工事已不如先前坚固。你命令%companyname%列阵出野，让那些摇摇欲坠的东西别再碍事。南方副官迎向你。%SPEECH_ON%你们用鲜血亵渎%holysite%，镀金者必定亲自将你们引到阵前，好让你们像个男人一样受死。对此，你有何话说？%SPEECH_OFF%你拔出剑。%SPEECH_ON%流的又不是我的血。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a1b019827cc3384d1cb9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{As you sheath your weapon and have the company set out to collect what they can from the dead, you get the strange feeling that this is not the first time %holysite% has been home to such bloodshed. Oh well, if anyone's gonna be dying in their ancestor's footsteps you're glad it's not you. A few northern soldiers come in to secure the holy tract just as you make your leave for %employer%. | The enemy is defeated and %holysite% reclaimed. A crowd of the faithful slowly trickle in, passing by the dead so they may prostrate themselves at the holiest of spots. Not a one says thanks to you. Not that it matters, that's %employer%'s job. A troop of northern soldiers passes you on your way out, each of the fighters regarding you with sneers and jeers. | With the battle over, little knots of the faithful begins to congregate in the corners of %holysite%. You don't know where these people even came from. They don't mind you, and you don't mind them. What matters now is that %employer% will have a huge trove of crowns awaiting your return. As soon as a few northern soldiers come by, you make your leave.}
a1b019827cc3384d1cb9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{你收起武器，让战团搜集死者身上还能用的东西，心里却生出一种古怪感觉：%holysite%恐怕并非第一次见证这般流血。罢了，若有人非得沿着祖先的足迹赴死，你很庆幸那人不是自己。几个北方士兵赶来接管圣地，你则动身回去见%employer%。 | 敌人已败，%holysite%重归己方。虔诚的信众陆续涌入，越过死者，直奔最神圣的地方伏地祈祷，没一个向你道谢。不过无所谓，酬谢你是%employer%的事。离开时，一队北方士兵与你擦肩而过，人人都报以冷笑和讥讽。 | 战斗结束后，小群信众开始聚集在%holysite%的各个角落。你都不知道他们是从哪儿冒出来的。他们不理你，你也懒得理他们。眼下最要紧的是，%employer%会备好大笔克朗，等你回去。几个北方士兵一到，你便启程离开。}

6b35fe00e980792ced30.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{%holysite% has fallen to the southerners. One sellsword shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Well. I suspect they'll be all over the place shinin' or shittin'.%SPEECH_OFF%Indeed. With the sacred tracts lost, there'll be no reason to get back to %employer% unless you're interested in seeing another kind of holy spectacle.}
6b35fe00e980792ced30.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{%holysite%落入了南方人手中。一个佣兵摇头。%SPEECH_ON%行吧，往后他们就在这儿到处发光，到处拉屎。%SPEECH_OFF%确实如此。圣地既失，便没必要再去见%employer%，除非你还想观赏另一种“神圣奇观”。}

69ed79149aedb859f3c5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%townname%'s priory is flush with more peasants than you've ever seen before. %employer% is outside on the steps and greets you with a hand to your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Welcome back, sellsword. You might be a slight git seekin' his coin, but you carry the wrath of the old gods with you. %holysite% is with whom it belongs now.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman snaps his fingers a few times and a few rotund monks waddle forth carrying chests of %reward% crowns. %employer% makes his leave up the steps.%SPEECH_ON%I'll say a word for you to the crowd, what was your name? Ah, I'm sure you want the company take credit. I'll thank the %companyname% as a whole.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is looking at his battle maps.%SPEECH_ON%It's a mite amusing that where I send my men, I am met with failures, but when the old gods raise hell I am spurred to hire a sellsword and met with... victory. Hopefully with %holysite% back within our grasps it will be drive my men to fight as the %companyname% does. For %reward% crowns, you've sent them southern shits back to the hells of their desert and encouraged the war effort as a whole. I'd almost say I shortchanged you, sellsword. Almost.%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%When the scouts returned the first thing they did was visit the priory. That's how I knew you were successful. I also gave them each a day in the dungeon for vacating their duties to me.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% is sitting on a strange looking cushion, perhaps one he had somehow attained during these wars with the southerners. He swishes wine around in a goblet.%SPEECH_ON%Your %reward% crowns are awaiting outside. I have to ask, when you were down there, did you hear of anything? Perhaps whispers of the old gods? Perhaps even murmurs of this one they call, what is it, the Gilder?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head no. The nobleman shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%A shame. One must wonder what it takes for the gods to come to us again.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him %reward% crowns spent in a particular direction would be a good start. The nobleman smiles cheekily and grants you this wish. | %employer% is found with a young, tanned woman clearly from the southern realms. He looks her up and down.%SPEECH_ON%The old gods sent me this, just as I'm assuming they sent me you.%SPEECH_OFF%He fumbles his words for a second and clears his throat.%SPEECH_ON%I mean, in another way, of course. Your victories at %holysite% have invigorated the men, lifting the spell of defeat from their shoulders. The monks now have the faithful back in their flock, and with good diligence we shall prove to the old gods our worth.%SPEECH_OFF%He pushes the woman away and tries to get to his feet, but the cushion is too deep, possibly too comfortable. He stays put.%SPEECH_ON%Your %reward% crowns will be out in the hall. Send for one of my servants to come and fetch this sand-lass for prayers in the priory.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% in one of the town's temples, standing beneath a statue of one of the old gods.%SPEECH_ON%I'd gotten word of your successes. The town has been elated, and the region as a whole is murmuring with delight. They won't speak of you, of course, they'll speak of me.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman seems quite happy with himself. He turns and pats you on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%I hope them southern shits didn't trouble you much. My lieutenants will bring your %reward% crowns. Say, do you think %holysite% is worth a visit? I've never been. In fact, don't care to. I am blessed wherever my feet go.%SPEECH_OFF%You purse your lips as the nobleman makes his leave.}
69ed79149aedb859f3c5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%townname%的修道院挤满了农民，你从未见过这么多人。%employer%站在外面的台阶上，抬手拍着你的肩迎接。%SPEECH_ON%欢迎回来，佣兵。你或许只是个贪财的小混蛋，却替旧神带去了怒火。如今，%holysite%终于回到了应有的主人手中。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族打了几个响指，几个圆滚滚的修士摇晃着走来，抬着装有%reward%克朗的箱子。%employer%转身拾级而上。%SPEECH_ON%我会在人群面前替你美言几句。你叫什么来着？啊，你一定更希望战团得这份功劳。那我就感谢整个%companyname%吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正在查看作战地图。%SPEECH_ON%说来也有些好笑，我派自己的兵去，得到的总是失败；旧神一发怒，逼得我去雇佣兵，迎来的却是……胜利。如今%holysite%已重回掌握，但愿能激励手下，学学%companyname%怎么打仗。花了%reward%克朗，你就把南方杂种赶回沙漠地狱，还提振了整个战局的士气。我几乎想说，是给少了，佣兵。几乎。%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%斥候一回来，先去的竟是修道院。我这才知道，你成功了。当然，擅离职守、耽搁复命，我也让他们每人去地牢待了一天。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%坐在一个模样古怪的软垫上，或许是同南方人交战时弄来的。他晃着杯中葡萄酒。%SPEECH_ON%给你的%reward%克朗已备在外面。不过我得问，在那边时，你有没有听见什么？比如旧神的低语？或者那个叫……叫什么来着，镀金者的呢喃？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头。贵族耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%可惜。真让人好奇，要怎样诸神才肯再次降临我们身边。%SPEECH_OFF%你说，先把%reward%克朗花到该去的地方，便是个不错的开始。贵族狡黠一笑，满足了你的愿望。 | 找到%employer%时，他正陪着一个肤色黝黑的年轻女人，显然来自南方。他上下打量着她。%SPEECH_ON%旧神把她送给了我，想必也一样把你送来了。%SPEECH_OFF%他一时语塞，清了清嗓子。%SPEECH_ON%当然，我是说，以另一种方式。你在%holysite%的胜利鼓舞了士兵，让他们摆脱了失败的阴影。修士们又找回了虔诚的羊群，只要尽心尽力，我们终会向旧神证明自己的价值。%SPEECH_OFF%他推开女人，试着起身，软垫却陷得太深，或许也太舒服，于是他又坐住不动了。%SPEECH_ON%你的%reward%克朗在走廊里。叫个仆人来，带这沙漠姑娘去修道院祈祷。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在镇上一座神殿里找到%employer%，他正站在某位旧神的雕像下。%SPEECH_ON%我听说你的胜利了。镇上喜气洋洋，整个地区都在高兴地议论。当然，他们说的不会是你，而是我。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族显得十分自得，转身拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%但愿南方杂种没给你添太多麻烦。我的副官会送来%reward%克朗。对了，你觉得%holysite%值得一去吗？我从没去过。其实也懒得去，反正我的双脚走到哪儿，福泽便跟到哪儿。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族离开时，你抿紧了嘴。}

65c5a16bb3513b1bd297.source: I'm afraid we don't have that kind of coin.
65c5a16bb3513b1bd297.translation: 恐怕我们拿不出这么多钱。

463c335bbfaf43fbc18b.source: Find your own work, %mercenary%. We don't need help.
463c335bbfaf43fbc18b.translation: %mercenary%，另找活干吧。我们不需要帮手。

e5d8d0685d55d1e0acdd.source: Failed to conquer a holy site

a255d39dc0162943603e.source: Conscripted soldiers loyal to their city state.
a255d39dc0162943603e.translation: 忠于所属城邦的征召士兵。

7ab50105d8baa92c02c8.translation: 从北方异教徒手中夺取%holysite%

789e17c0092b89d853ac.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{You find %employer% behind a pile of scrolls. He is busy to the task of writing and the holy men around him are just as busy paying attention, being certain to steal away a scroll the second it has captured the Vizier's final utterances. The man of scribbling import finally looks up.%SPEECH_ON%We've a matter of %holysite% being trespassed by northern rats. I will try and temper my feelings on the matter, as it is not the Gilder's way to sully emotions with shades of fury, so let me just state clearly that the presence of these savages offends the rational appetite.%SPEECH_OFF%The Vizier dunks a quill pen and returns to his writing and speaking.%SPEECH_ON%However, shall the dog bark the birds will fly. I need a dog, Crownling, and one with bite. Take your company to the holy land and root out the reprobates. If we have agreement, then %reward% crowns and the Gilder's gleam shall await your return.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you with surprising warmth.%SPEECH_ON%I knew it true that the Gilder would bring me a man of great import, a man of serious might and main. A Crownling, sure. But a warrior? Certainly!%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can ask the nature of the business, the Vizier holds up a golden chalice with half of the cupping sliced like the rim of the moon.%SPEECH_ON%Our holiest land, %holysite%, has been taken by savage northerners. Our world is threatened with darkness, and to fend the shadow we must be propitious in our endeavors. The men of my domain are plenty, but the lands beneath the Gilder's eye stretch far. I need soldiers such as yourself to help claim %holysite%. For it is a part of this earth which the Gilder is suzerain, and the Gilder pays us all: %reward% crowns for the task's completion. Do we have an arrangement?%SPEECH_OFF% | In a rare sight, you find %employer% prostrated beneath the sublimity of a glinting, shiny emblem shaped like the sun. He whispers a few words to himself then rises, then whispers again, cleans his fingertips one at a time, and turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Whilst my troops make propitious advances elsewhere, %holysite% has been left undefended. In my wont to win this war, I have left the door open for the barbarian northerners to take it over. I request, face to face with you, a parcel of outside help. The Gilder will provide us all the gilded path, Crownling, and you are not outside His generosity. Through my hand, you shall have %reward% crowns if you take back %holysite%!%SPEECH_OFF% | A golden goblet scatters across the marbled floors and the wine sprays every which way. The Vizier yells at you, a mix of anger and need.%SPEECH_ON%Finally, someone who can be of assistance!%SPEECH_OFF%He waves off a few helpers and even a few of what appear to be his own lieutenants.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, %holysite% has been conquered by the northern filth. I have wept at the thought of them ransacking it, and I shall weep again for every day they sully one of the Gilder's footprints. %reward% crowns. That is how much shall be procured and placed into your pockets. A hefty amount for you, surely, but it is true what they say, that for some the way of the gilded path is perhaps more literal than for others.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is surrounded by silk-laden men. One carries fireflies in a hooded cage, the dull insect-lights winking here and there. The other has a cage with the remains of a dead bird, stripped entirely to the bone save for two feathers which seem to replicate the entirety of what were once its wings. Seeing you, the Vizier steps out between these men as one would step between the unmovable pillars of a temple.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, you are here! My scouts have reported that we have taken a step back in this war against the dogs of the north. %holysite% has been captured and, per the Gilder's whispers, I must have it returned to us. Not only for my domain, but so that His sublimity may bear the slightest shade. You will be given %reward% crowns for this venture, a heavy sum for a heavy task, yes!%SPEECH_OFF% | Ordinarily ordained in opulence and surrounded by familiar profligates, you find %employer% kneeled and dressed in somewhat modest attire. He's wearing a headdress with corded black around his pate. The socially muted Vizier speaks to you calmly.%SPEECH_ON%Northern heathens have taken %holysite% from our lands. I do not blame them for their actions, they know not what it is they do. By my honest hands, the Gilder shall know my faults. But failure does not mean surrender. I need you to travel to the holy grounds and return it to our realm. For this, you shall have %reward% crowns placed within your coffers.%SPEECH_OFF%}
789e17c0092b89d853ac.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer%坐在一堆卷轴后，忙着书写。周围的祭司也全神贯注，维齐尔最后一字刚落，便立刻收走写好的卷轴。这位奋笔疾书的大人物终于抬头。%SPEECH_ON%有件事：北方老鼠侵占了%holysite%。我会尽量克制情绪，毕竟用怒火的阴影玷污内心，不合镀金者之道。所以，我只直言一句：这些野蛮人的存在，令一切理性都难以容忍。%SPEECH_OFF%维齐尔蘸了蘸羽毛笔，又边写边说。%SPEECH_ON%不过，狗一叫，鸟就会飞。我需要一条狗，克朗客，而且得会咬人。带上战团去圣地，把那些恶徒赶走。若谈得拢，%reward%克朗与镀金者的辉光，将一同等你归来。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%迎接你的热情，出乎意料。%SPEECH_ON%我就知道，镀金者会送来一个举足轻重的人，一个真正有本事的强者。是个克朗客，没错。可也是战士？当然！%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及问是什么生意，维齐尔已举起金酒杯。杯身缺了一半，边沿宛如弯月。%SPEECH_ON%我们至圣之地，%holysite%，被野蛮的北方人夺走了。黑暗威胁着我们的世界，要抵御阴影，我们就必须奋力争取神眷。我治下人手虽多，镀金者目光所及的疆土却也辽阔。我需要你这样的战士，帮忙夺回%holysite%。这片土地本就归镀金者统御，而祂不会亏待我们：完成此事，酬金%reward%克朗。能谈妥吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 难得一见，%employer%正俯伏在光芒耀眼的太阳徽记下。他低声念了几句，起身，又念几句，将指尖逐一擦净，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%我的军队在别处顺利推进，%holysite%却因此无人设防。急于赢下战争，反倒让我给野蛮的北方人留下了可乘之机。如今，我当面向你请求外援。克朗客，镀金者会为我们所有人铺就金色道路，祂的慷慨也不会将你拒之门外。只要夺回%holysite%，你便能通过我的手，得到%reward%克朗！%SPEECH_OFF% | 一只金酒杯飞过大理石地面，酒液四溅。维齐尔冲你喊道，愤怒中夹着迫切。%SPEECH_ON%终于来了个能帮上忙的人！%SPEECH_OFF%他挥手赶走几个侍从，连几个看似副官的人也一并打发。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，%holysite%落入了北方渣滓手中。一想到他们在里面洗劫，我便流泪。他们多玷污镀金者的足迹一天，我便还要再哭一天。%reward%克朗，这笔钱会筹齐，放进你的口袋。对你而言，想必数目不小。不过世人说得对：有些人走上镀金之路的方式，就是比别人更实在些。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%被身披丝绸的人围着。一人提着罩笼，里面萤火虫微弱的光时隐时现；另一人笼里装着死鸟，只剩骨架与两根羽毛，仿佛用那两根羽毛，就能补全曾经的双翼。看见你，维齐尔从两人之间走出，宛如穿过神殿岿然不动的柱廊。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，你来了！斥候禀报，我们与北方恶犬的战争遭受了挫折。%holysite%被夺走了，依镀金者的低语，我必须将它收回。不只是为了我的领地，更不能让祂无上的荣光蒙受阴影。此行酬你%reward%克朗，重任配重赏，没错！%SPEECH_OFF% | 平日满身珠光宝气、身边尽是熟面孔的奢靡之徒，如今%employer%却穿得颇为朴素，跪在那里，头巾外束着一圈黑绳。收敛排场的维齐尔平静地对你说道：%SPEECH_ON%北方异教徒夺走了我们境内的%holysite%。我不责怪他们，他们不懂自己在做什么。我会坦然向镀金者承认过错，可失败不等于投降。我要你前往圣地，将它夺回我们的疆域。作为酬劳，你的钱库将添上%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f90c55cc7fb09fafb4c0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{As the Vizier believed, the northerners have taken up positions in and around %holysite%. Most of the riffraff religious folk have long since departed, leaving only the %companyname% and the opposing force. You draw out your sword and order the men to make the attack.}
f90c55cc7fb09fafb4c0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{正如维齐尔所料，北方人已占据%holysite%内外阵地。大部分闲杂信众早已散去，如今只剩%companyname%与对面的敌军。你拔出剑，命令弟兄们进攻。}

f141c4ec059b02648c7b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{As you near %holysite%, a man rises seemingly from the ground itself. Startled, you draw your weapon but the man reveals himself to be a camouflaged commander of %employer%.%SPEECH_ON%Easy, Crownling, you'll have your coin yet. The Vizier's birds have told my outfit of your approach and I must say, you're a bit late. I know this isn't your war, but, well, I suppose this is no time for admonishment. Let us reclaim the holy lands for the Gilder, and may both our paths forward be ever gilded by his shine.%SPEECH_OFF% | %holysite% is in sight when a man seemingly appears out of the ground. He asks if you are the commander of the %companyname%, and a slight pause must have given him the answer for he speaks straight away.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, of course you are. I am %commander%, lieutenant of %employer%. The Vizier's birds told you may come. You may be chasing coin, Crownling, but if we are victorious today the Gilder will shine brightly upon your morrow's path!%SPEECH_OFF%}
f141c4ec059b02648c7b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{接近%holysite%时，一个人仿佛从地里站了起来。你吃了一惊，拔出武器，才发现对方是做了伪装的%employer%麾下军官。%SPEECH_ON%放轻松，克朗客，钱少不了你的。维齐尔的飞鸟已把你将至的消息送到军中。我得说，你有点晚。我知道这不是你的战争，不过，眼下也不是责备的时候。让我们为镀金者夺回圣地，愿祂的辉光为你我前路永镀金光。%SPEECH_OFF% | %holysite%已在眼前，一个人却仿佛从地里冒出来。他问你是否是%companyname%的团长。你略一迟疑，似乎已让他得到答案，他随即开口。%SPEECH_ON%是，当然是你。我叫%commander%，是%employer%的副官。维齐尔的飞鸟告诉我，你可能会来。克朗客，你或许只为追逐钱财，可今天若能得胜，镀金者必将照亮你明日的道路！%SPEECH_OFF%}

7d17fcbb66b0e22d8b00.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{As %holysite% draws into view, a man who looks almost eerily similar to you approaches. He's got a paymaster and a couple of sellswords at his side.%SPEECH_ON%Evenin', captain. I am %mercenary% of the %mercenarycompany%. I came to these lands in search of crown, just as you have. Now, I wager the Vizier wetted his pen in a sound contract for you and your men, but what say you pay me %pay% crowns and I'll help you in this little endeavor?%SPEECH_OFF% | You are approached by a group of men, one of which whose gait and constitution alike seem strangely reminiscent to your own. He announces himself as %mercenary%, captain of the %mercenarycompany%.%SPEECH_ON%I thought the Vizier might send his professional army to see to the holy site's change of hands. I will admit to you, captain, that I helped the northerners take over this prestigious monument in the first place. However, for %pay% crowns, I'm willing to help your side take it back. As a fellow mercenary, I'm sure you can see how this would be a good deal for all involved.%SPEECH_OFF%}
7d17fcbb66b0e22d8b00.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{%holysite%渐入眼帘，一个与你相像得近乎诡异的男人走了过来，身旁跟着军饷官和几个佣兵。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，团长。我是%mercenarycompany%的%mercenary%。跟你一样，来这片土地只为挣克朗。我敢说，维齐尔已经给你和手下签了份体面的委托。不过，你若付我%pay%克朗，我就帮你办这桩小事，怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群人向你走来，其中一人的步态与身形，都与你有种奇妙的相似。他自称%mercenary%，是%mercenarycompany%的团长。%SPEECH_ON%我还以为维齐尔会派正规军，来办圣地易主的事。不瞒你说，团长，当初就是我帮北方人夺下这座大名鼎鼎的圣迹。不过，只要%pay%克朗，我就愿意帮你们夺回来。同为佣兵，你一定看得出，这买卖对大家都好。%SPEECH_OFF%}

439ce8e9e9ca2cf6a5a9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{The captain grins and slaps your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Aaahhh, there it is! There it is, the noble sellsword spirit! Aye, commander of the %companyname%, let us venture forth, for a short time, and do battle together, also for a short time!%SPEECH_OFF% | With the deal made, the captain of the mercenary company sidles up next to you. Almost uncomfortably close, and assuredly within range of his breath which is unappreciated.%SPEECH_ON%You know, men like us, fellas like us, pals, we're pals, right? Pals like us. We gotta stick together. And for this here battle, we'll be sticking together.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods and slugs one into your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%After the fight, well, I hope we can be buddies again sometime, you know?%SPEECH_OFF%}
439ce8e9e9ca2cf6a5a9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{那团长咧嘴笑着，拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%啊，就是这个！就是这股高贵的佣兵精神！没错，%companyname%的团长，咱们一道向前走上一程，再一道打上一仗——都只是暂时的！%SPEECH_OFF% | 交易谈妥，对方战团的团长凑到你身旁，近得几乎令人不适，更让你不情愿地闻清了他的口气。%SPEECH_ON%你知道，咱们这种人，你我这种伙计，朋友，咱们是朋友，对吧？像咱们这样的朋友，得抱成团。这一仗，就该抱成团打。%SPEECH_OFF%他点头，在你肩上捶了一拳。%SPEECH_ON%等打完了，嗯，希望往后还有机会再做朋友，你懂吧？%SPEECH_OFF%}

d6194f29640f917edd31.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%That's a shame.%SPEECH_OFF%%mercenary% says as he quickly jaunts back to the ranks of the %mercenarycompany%. He keeps backing up right into the soldiers defending %holysite%. His arms are wide and fanning, as though he were swimming against a current.%SPEECH_ON%A damn shame, I say! Well, captain of the %companyname%, let us see which side purchased the finer sellsword, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenary draws his weapon, as do the soldiers of the north around him, and you do the same. It is time to fight. | %SPEECH_ON%Aye, aye, I see. Well. I didn't expect much. I am, after all, also a seller of the sword. And right now...%SPEECH_OFF%He paces backward to his company, and his company to the ranks of the northern soldiers protecting %holysite%.%SPEECH_ON%Right now, the north proves to be the highest bidder.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d6194f29640f917edd31.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_134.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%真遗憾。%SPEECH_OFF%%mercenary%一边说，一边快步退回%mercenarycompany%的队列。他继续后退，直到混入防守%holysite%的士兵之中，双臂张开摆动，仿佛在逆流游泳。%SPEECH_ON%我说，真他妈遗憾！好吧，%companyname%的团长，来看看哪一边雇的佣兵更值钱，如何？%SPEECH_OFF%那佣兵拔出武器，周围的北方士兵也纷纷照做，你同样拔出武器。该开战了。 | %SPEECH_ON%嗯，嗯，我明白。好吧，本来也没抱太大指望。毕竟我也是卖命挣钱的。而眼下……%SPEECH_OFF%他退向自己的战团，战团则退入守卫%holysite%的北方军阵。%SPEECH_ON%眼下，北方出的价最高。%SPEECH_OFF%}

b9b924aa1d020c5c21e8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{The battle is over, but there's a glint and gleam of armor winking in the distance. You slim your eyes and focus on the approaching silhouettes. Perhaps they are the faithful come to fill the holy site and - no, they're northeners! It's a counter-attack! | As you sheathe your blade an arrow zips overhead and hits the sand with a muted spiff. You look toward the source and see a young and nervous archer being slapped upside the head, and beside this man is an entire contingent of northerners! It's a counter-attack!}
b9b924aa1d020c5c21e8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{战斗结束，远处却有甲胄闪闪发光。你眯起眼，注视那些逼近的人影。也许是信徒来重返圣地……不，那是北方人！敌人在反攻！ | 你正收剑，一支箭掠过头顶，噗地扎进沙里。循着来处望去，一个年轻紧张的弓箭手正挨人巴掌，而他身旁，是整整一队北方士兵！敌人在反攻！}

a365670db766a6799adf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%Just more northerners.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says. You nod and respond.%SPEECH_ON%More logs for the Gilder's fire.%SPEECH_OFF%The sellsword mentions the Gilder is more keen on gold than flame, but you tell him to shutup and get prepared for what's coming. The defenses of %holysite% itself should serve the company well here. | You order the men to defend themselves within %holysite%. %randombrother% looks around.%SPEECH_ON%You ever wonder if the god or gods watching this get a little ornery? Ya know? Like are we making a mess of their pots and pans?%SPEECH_OFF%You slap him upside the head and tell him to focus.}
a365670db766a6799adf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%又来一群北方人。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%说道。你点头回应：%SPEECH_ON%镀金者的火里又添了些柴。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵说，镀金者看重的是金子，不是火。你叫他闭嘴，准备迎敌。%holysite%本身的防御工事，眼下应该能帮上战团不少忙。 | 你命令众人在%holysite%内防守。%randombrother%四下张望。%SPEECH_ON%你有没有想过，在上头看着的那位神，或者那群神，会不会有点恼火？你懂吧？就好像我们正把他们的锅碗瓢盆砸得稀烂？%SPEECH_OFF%你在他脑袋上拍了一巴掌，让他集中精神。}

cf42f74b275e95a55e44.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{You order the %companyname% into the field. The northern lieutenant greets you with a wave and a grin.%SPEECH_ON%Coming on out, are ye? What, tired of prayin'?%SPEECH_OFF%You turn and spit.%SPEECH_ON%We were running out of room to bury your bodies.%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenant's smile fades and he orders a charge. To battle!}
cf42f74b275e95a55e44.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{你命令%companyname%出阵迎敌。北方副官挥手，咧嘴笑道：%SPEECH_ON%出来啦？怎么，祷告祷累了？%SPEECH_OFF%你转头啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%没地方埋你们的尸体了。%SPEECH_OFF%副官脸上的笑消失了，随即下令冲锋。开战！}

66df2e6888e3e1fcf3a6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{As you sheath your weapon and have the company set out to collect what they can from the dead, you get the strange feeling that this is not the first time %holysite% has been home to such bloodshed. Oh well, if anyone's gonna be dying in their ancestor's footsteps you're glad it's not you. A few southerners arrive to secure the holy tract. With them here, you make your leave, knowing that %employer% will welcome the news you have to bring him. | The enemy is defeated and %holysite% reclaimed. Southern soldiers slowly fill the defenses. Trickling behind them is a crowd of the faithful, passing by the dead so they may prostrate themselves at the holiest of spots. Not a one says thanks to you. Not that it matters, that's %employer%'s job. | With the battle over, a small crowd of the faithful begins to congregate in the corners of %holysite%. You don't know where these people even came from. They don't mind you, and you don't mind them. What matters now is that %employer% will have a huge trove of crowns awaiting your return. As you leave, a few southern soldiers take the post with not a thanks to their lips either.}
66df2e6888e3e1fcf3a6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{你收起武器，让战团搜集死者身上还能用的东西，心里却生出一种古怪感觉：%holysite%恐怕并非第一次见证这般流血。罢了，若有人非得沿着祖先的足迹赴死，你很庆幸那人不是自己。几个南方人赶来接管圣地。既然他们到了，你便动身离开，知道%employer%会乐于听见你带回的消息。 | 敌人已败，%holysite%重归己方。南方士兵陆续进入防线，信众跟在后面缓缓涌入，越过死者，直奔最神圣的地方伏地祈祷，没一个向你道谢。不过无所谓，酬谢你是%employer%的事。 | 战斗结束后，一小群信众开始聚集在%holysite%的各个角落。你都不知道他们是从哪儿冒出来的。他们不理你，你也懒得理他们。眼下最要紧的是，%employer%会备好大笔克朗，等你回去。你离开时，几个南方士兵接过了岗哨，同样连声谢都没有。}

7d8001817864a3580914.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{You've failed to protect %holysite% from the northerners. There's no reason to stick around, and the only reason to return to %employer% is if you want your head on one of the Vizier's gold-encrusted platters.}
7d8001817864a3580914.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{你没能守住%holysite%，让它落入北方人手中。再待下去毫无意义；若要回去见%employer%，除非你想让自己的头摆上维齐尔那镶金的盘子。}

e59b00622c2bbc90a445.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% is sitting beneath the glow of a golden bauble, an enormous piece of metal like the sun with chains holding it from the ceiling. It must have been erected while you were away. When you come forward, a holy man stops you and shakes his head. He draws a circle in the air with his hand and then touches his fingertip upon your pate. Smiling, he warmly guides you to another side of the room where %reward% crowns have been stacked neatly inside wooden trays.

 The man bows, points his hands to the golden bauble, shaping his palms as though he carried the very construct, and then he seems to guide its sublimity upon your payment, the coins crackling with light. Some sort of trick, but the pay is real so you take it and go. | When you enter %employer%'s room, a number of guards bow and prostrate themselves momentarily and then get to their feet. In the distance, the Vizier is silently sitting on a throne with silk-wearing holy men all around him. It seems you will not be approaching him on this day, but a group of young boys carry trays of coins to you one at a time until you have %reward% crowns. The Vizier nods and turns his hand over. You take the payment and go. | You enter the grand hall to find %employer% seemingly ensorcelled by a swirl of golden mist. He stands upon a rotating platform - revolving rather roughly with the help of nearly unseen slaves beneath the floor itself - and there are strips of cloth tied to his wrists. His harem stands off to the side filling their mouths with some golden liquid before spraying it out in lip-spattering mists. Upon closer inspection, it is not so glorious an event as you first thought walking in here. Fortunately, you will not be afforded a closer look: a large man in religious frock cuts you off and guides you to a table at the back of the room. It is lined with trays filled with coin, their entirety being your reward of %reward% crowns. With your pay in hand, you are hurriedly ushered out of the room.}
e59b00622c2bbc90a445.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer%坐在一件金饰的辉光下。那是一块宛如太阳的巨大金属饰物，由锁链悬在天花板上，想必是你离开期间才挂起来的。你走近时，一名祭司拦住你，摇了摇头。他抬手在空中画圈，再用指尖轻触你的头顶，微笑着热情引你走向房间另一侧，那里，%reward%克朗整齐地码在木盘里。

祭司鞠躬，双手指向那件金饰，掌心虚托，仿佛托着它本身；接着，他像是把那份神圣辉光引到你的报酬上，硬币顿时闪闪发亮。某种戏法罢了，不过钱是真的。你收下便走。 | 走进%employer%的房间，几名卫兵躬身伏地片刻，随后起立。远处，维齐尔静坐王座，身边围满披着丝绸的祭司。看来今天轮不到你近前，不过一群男孩接连将钱盘端来，直到凑齐%reward%克朗。维齐尔点头，翻了翻手掌。你收钱离开。 | 你走进大厅，发现%employer%仿佛受了法术笼罩，周身旋转着金色薄雾。他站在转台上，双腕系着布条；地板下几乎看不见的奴隶推着台子，使它磕磕绊绊地旋转。他的妻妾站在一旁，将某种金色液体含入口中，再喷成沾满唇边的水雾。仔细一看，场面远没有刚进门时想的那般庄严。不过，你也没机会再看清楚：一个身穿祭司袍的壮汉拦住去路，将你带到厅后的一张桌旁。桌上排满装钱的盘子，合起来正是你的报酬，%reward%克朗。钱一到手，你便被匆匆请出房间。}

1004219044976e3f4c1d.source: Move to the war camp and report to %commander%

928e0ab32b6b10514cc2.source: Assist the army in their battle against %feudfamily%

ff451eeb37794ad8f479.source: Wait in the war camp until your services are called upon

610763c5108a5a831bf7.source: Intercept scouts of %feudfamily% last seen %direction% of the warcamp
610763c5108a5a831bf7.translation: 截击%feudfamily%的斥候；他们最后出现在军营的%direction%方向

63a84527635de8661f0e.source: Requisition supplies at %objective% to the %direction% of the warcamp
63a84527635de8661f0e.translation: 前往军营%direction%方向的%objective%征用补给

4c48923cb6d6ab44610c.source: Follow the footprints and approach the deserters
4c48923cb6d6ab44610c.translation: 沿着脚印追踪，接近逃兵

9dcdeb235ec35aa6cbb3.source: Either convince them to come back or kill them
9dcdeb235ec35aa6cbb3.translation: 说服他们归队，或将他们杀死

0c5f10f2b8f3d4269560.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes you inside. He's wearing armor, though his commanders seem to be trying to talk him out of doing any actual fighting. The man welcomes you warmly nonetheless and quickly explains what he needs from you.%SPEECH_ON%We are about to conclude this silly war. My largest forces are organizing %direction% from here. I need you to go there and meet with %commander%. He will explain his uses for you. If you manage to help us swing the tides, then you will be paid handsomely, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | You walk into %employer%'s room to see him feeding a %feudfamily% banner to some dogs. The mongrels tear at it with practiced viciousness. %employer% looks up at you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellsword. Glad that you are finally here. I need you to go visit %commander% %direction% of here. We are beginning the final stages of this damned war and I believe men such as yourself can help quicken its end. I can't tell you what to expect other than that these wars usually end most spectacularly. Your pay, too, will be spectacular.%SPEECH_OFF% | You walk into %employer%'s room to find him surrounded by his generals. They're looking down at a map where a great number of opposing tokens are facing off. The nobleman looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellsword.
