I need you to go here.%SPEECH_OFF%He drops a stick on the map.%SPEECH_ON%And meet with %commander%. We are preparing to end this war once and for all and your help will be most crucial.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, but linger. The man raises his eyebrows then a finger.%SPEECH_ON%Oh yes, your help will be paid for! Make no mistake about that.%SPEECH_OFF% | You cannot enter %employer%'s room. Instead, one of his commanders meets you outside with a map and a contract. He explains that a great battle is coming and that your help is needed. If you choose to accept, you'll go to %commander% %direction% of here and there await further instruction. | A guard outside %employer%'s room stops you from going in. He stares at the sigil you have of the %companyname% then speaks to you directly.%SPEECH_ON%I'm supposed to give you this.%SPEECH_OFF%He slaps a scroll into your chest. The instructions state that a war-ending battle is coming and, if you so choose to help, you are to report to %commander% at his camp for further instruction. You ask if you are to barter with the guard or with %employer%. The guard swallows hard and a bead of sweat runs down his cheek.%SPEECH_ON%If you must haggle, you are to try and haggle with me.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% greets you and takes you outside to his personal houndmaster. The dogs sit obediently as he walks down their line. He takes a hand across the tops of their heads, an easy, commandeering pet.%SPEECH_ON%%commander% is leading my men %direction% of here and he has reported to me that a large battle may be on the horizon.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman stops and turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%He thinks this could end the war with %feudfamily%. So I want you to go there and help out, anything to put an end to his horrid conflict.%SPEECH_OFF% | You meet with %employer% in a room full of generals. His commanders stare at you suspiciously, but the man invites you to a corner to talk personally.%SPEECH_ON%Don't mind them. Quickly now, I have an army being led by %commander% just %direction% of here. I need you to go and meet him for further instructions. My commanders believe a final battle may be soon upon us and we need all the help we can get. If this fight does indeed end this war, you'll be rewarded accordingly.%SPEECH_OFF% | A guard lets you into %employer%'s room and there you find the man surrounded by squabbling generals. They yell over one another, knocking over war tokens on a map, and making a mess of the arrangement that is battle planning. %employer% stands up and meets with you personally.%SPEECH_ON%Don't mind the noise. The men are on edge because it's quite possible that we are at the cusp of ending this damned war with %feudfamily%. %commander% and most of my army is resting %direction% of here. He has called for as many reinforcements as he can get, including mercenaries. If you go there and help put an end to this shite we call war, then you will be most rewarded, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% takes you outside to some pig pens. There you find the swine chomping on a corpse. Nearby, a few goats munch a banner of %feudfamily%. %employer% turns to you with a grin.%SPEECH_ON%A spy, you understand how these things are. Anyway, %commander% has reported to me that he believes a final battle with %feudfamily% may be at hand. He has asked for all the help he can get and I plan on sending it. If you go there, meet with him, and do as he asks, you will be rewarded most handsomely.%SPEECH_OFF% | You meet with one of %employer%'s guards who takes you to the man personally. He's roosted in a small room that must be a sort of cubby away from the annoyances of the world. A candle flickers as he flips through a book. He speaks without looking at you.%SPEECH_ON%Hello, sellsword. My field commander, %commander%, has sent me a little bird that the armies of %feudfamily% may be coming together. He believes we have a chance at ending this war once and for all.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman licks his thumb and slowly turns a page. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%I want you to go and join him. Naturally, your pay will accommodate what you have to offer, which I suspect is quite a lot.%SPEECH_OFF% | One of %employer%'s guards takes you to the top of a tower where you find the nobleman himself. He looks to you.%SPEECH_ON%Nice view, no?%SPEECH_OFF%You glance around. The land stretches and people become small mites bounding across it. A little donkey-pulled cart rattles its way beneath the tower, entering %townname% for business. You shrug. %employer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%I figured you for one to enjoy sights such as these, but I suppose a man of business wouldn't have such thoughts on this mind when business is at hand. And, dear sellsword, business is at hand. One of my commander has reported that the armies of %feudfamily% are coming together. He thinks that it's possible we can end this war with them in a big, final battle. Understand?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%If this goes according to plan, you'll be paid according to your services. I don't know if you have ever helped end a war before, sellsword, but many men would pay a king's ransom for such services.%SPEECH_OFF%}
0c5f10f2b8f3d4269560.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%招呼你进去。他穿着铠甲，可几位将领似乎正劝他别亲自上阵。不过，他依然热情地接待了你，很快说明了要你做什么。%SPEECH_ON%这场荒唐的战争快要结束了。我的主力正在这里的%direction%集结。我要你前去与%commander%会合，他会告诉你该怎么做。佣兵，要是你能帮我们扭转战局，报酬绝不会少。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，看到他正把一面%feudfamily%的旗帜丢给几条狗撕咬。恶犬撕得又狠又熟练。%employer%抬头看向你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵，你总算来了。我要你去这里的%direction%找%commander%。这场该死的战争已经到了最后关头，我相信你这样的人能让它更快结束。具体会碰上什么，我没法告诉你。不过，这种战争收尾时往往都十分壮观。你的报酬也会同样可观。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，看到一群将军围在他身边。他们俯视着地图，上面摆着大量相互对峙的敌我棋子。贵族看向你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵，我要你去这里。%SPEECH_OFF%他把一根指挥棒搁在地图上。%SPEECH_ON%与%commander%会合。我们准备一举结束这场战争，而你的帮助将至关重要。%SPEECH_OFF%你点了点头，却没有离开。他扬起眉毛，随即竖起一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%哦，对，你的帮助当然是有报酬的！这一点绝不会含糊。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你没能进入%employer%的房间。他的一名将领拿着地图和契约，在门外接待了你。他说，一场大战即将打响，需要你出力。若愿意接受，你就得去这里的%direction%找%commander%，在那里等候进一步指示。 | %employer%房间外的守卫拦住了你。他盯着你身上%companyname%的徽记，直截了当地开口。%SPEECH_ON%有人吩咐我把这个交给你。%SPEECH_OFF%他把一卷文书拍到你胸前。上面写道，一场足以结束战争的大战即将打响。若你愿意相助，就去%commander%的营地报到，听候下一步安排。你问，要谈价钱的话，是找他还是找%employer%。守卫使劲咽了口唾沫，一滴汗顺着脸颊滑下。%SPEECH_ON%如果你非要讨价还价，那就……跟我谈。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%向你打了招呼，带你到外面去见他的私人驯犬师。他沿着犬群走过，猎犬全都老老实实地坐着。他的手依次拂过它们的头顶，动作随意，却透着发号施令的威势。%SPEECH_ON%%commander%正在这里的%direction%率领我的军队。他来报说，一场大战可能就要来了。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族停下脚步，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%他认为这一仗或许能结束我们与%feudfamily%的战争。所以我要你过去帮忙。只要能结束这场可怕的冲突，做什么都行。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在一间挤满将军的房间里见到了%employer%。将领们满怀疑虑地打量着你，但他把你请到角落，单独交谈。%SPEECH_ON%别理他们。长话短说，%commander%正率领我的一支军队，驻扎在这里的%direction%。我要你过去见他，听候安排。我的将领们认为，决战可能很快就会到来，我们需要一切能得到的帮助。如果这一仗真能结束战争，你会得到相应的酬劳。%SPEECH_OFF% | 守卫让你进了%employer%的房间。里面围着一群争吵不休的将军。他们一个比一个嗓门大，把地图上的兵棋撞得东倒西歪，好好的作战部署被搅成一团。%employer%站起身，亲自过来接待你。%SPEECH_ON%别在意这些吵闹。大家都绷紧了神经，因为我们与%feudfamily%的这场该死的战争，很可能就要结束了。%commander%正带着我的大部分军队在这里的%direction%休整。他要求尽可能多派援军，佣兵也算。佣兵，要是你肯去帮忙，把这堆被我们称作战争的狗屎彻底收拾干净，我会重重赏你。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%带你来到外面的猪圈。猪群正在啃食一具尸体，旁边几只山羊嚼着%feudfamily%的旗帜。%employer%咧嘴一笑，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%是个间谍。你明白，这种事就是这么处理的。说正事，%commander%来报，他认为我们与%feudfamily%的决战或许近在眼前。他请求一切能得到的支援，我也打算满足他。你若去与他会合，照他的吩咐做事，就能拿到一笔极其丰厚的酬劳。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的一名守卫领你去见他。他窝在一间小屋里，想必是躲避世间烦扰的僻静角落。烛火摇曳，他翻着书，头也不抬地开口。%SPEECH_ON%你好，佣兵。我的前线指挥官%commander%传来消息，说%feudfamily%的军队可能正在集结。他认为，我们有机会一举结束这场战争。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族舔了舔拇指，慢慢翻过一页，继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%我要你去加入他的队伍。报酬自然会与你能出的力相称，而我想，你能出的力一定不少。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的一名守卫带你登上塔顶，贵族本人就在那里。他看向你。%SPEECH_ON%风景不错，不是吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾四周。大地绵延开去，行人缩成了在地面跳动的小虫。一辆驴拉的小货车从塔下辘辘驶过，进%townname%做买卖。你耸了耸肩。%employer%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我还以为你会喜欢这样的景色。不过，正事临头，做生意的人想必也无暇欣赏。亲爱的佣兵，眼下就有一桩生意。我的一名指挥官来报，%feudfamily%的军队正在集结。他认为，我们或许能靠一场大决战，彻底结束与他们的战争。明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，他接着说。%SPEECH_ON%如果一切按计划进行，你会得到与你的贡献相称的酬劳。佣兵，我不知道你以前是否帮人结束过战争，不过这种本事，足以让许多人付出赎回国王般的巨款。%SPEECH_OFF%}

6760b779858078b0d920.source: {I won't submit the %companyname% to another man's command. | I have to decline. | We're needed elsewhere.}
6760b779858078b0d920.translation: {我不会把%companyname%交给别人指挥。 | 恕我拒绝。 | 别处还有事等着我们。}

9b713614860a28793a2d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{You arrive at the camp, which is more akin to a tent city, and find %commander%. He welcomes you into his tent which is more akin to a map city as he surveys where his army is, and where he thinks %feudfamily%'s army might be.%SPEECH_ON%Welcome, sellsword. You arrived just in time.%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%'s war camp is filled with bored men. They're stirring stews or playing card games. The most exciting thing available is a battle between a beetle and a worm, a fight neither side seems particularly interested in. %commander% himself welcomes you and takes you inside his tent which is adorned with maps and other tools of planning. | You come into %commander%'s tent to find a less than enthused group of men. One calls out.%SPEECH_ON%You are not the wenches we asked for.%SPEECH_OFF%The soldiers laugh. %randombrother% barks back.%SPEECH_ON%Your mothers took care of us first.%SPEECH_OFF%Predictably, all sides begin drawing their weapons. %commander% himself intervened to stop an outright bloodletting battle from breaking out. He takes you to his tent.%SPEECH_ON%Glad you're here, although your men could be less of a nuisance if we are to win farkin' war.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come into %commander%'s camp to find the men partaking in a beetle race. They cheer on the beetles which, halfway down a track made of haystraw, turn on one another and start fighting. The soldiers' cheers get ever louder. %commander% finds you through the crowds and takes you to his tent.%SPEECH_ON%I am glad you are here, sellsword. I have something for you to do right now.%SPEECH_OFF% | Arriving at %commander%'s war camp, you find the men cheering on a barely dressed woman riding around on a donkey. The lady and the ass ride off into a tent which quickly swells with men. %randombrother% asks if he can go. You state that you're going too, so yes, of course. Just then, %commander% grabs you. He leads you to his command tent.%SPEECH_ON%Trust me, you don't want to see that.%SPEECH_OFF%You do not trust him. | %commander%'s war camp has turned the land into mud. They've cut down all the nearby trees, constructing in their place little poorly made hovels that slant wherever the mud gives. Tents go out as far as your eye can see. Fires brim along the way, like stars glowing along a white sky.

 You meet with %commander% in his tent which is full of maps and lieutenants awaiting orders. | The war camp is full of clinking and clanking. Blacksmiths work to repair equipment, cooks stew what horrid messes they suggest is food, and soldiers hammer in posts for their tents. You meet with %commander% in his tent. Stolen away from all that metal noise, it is instead replaced by the arguments of his lieutenants. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%When a large battle draws nigh, the men get nervous. Do not mind their bickering.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9b713614860a28793a2d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{你抵达营地——那地方更像一座帐篷城——找到了%commander%。他请你进帐，而帐内又像一座地图城。他正查看己方军队的位置，并推测%feudfamily%的军队可能在哪里。%SPEECH_ON%欢迎，佣兵。你来得正是时候。%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%的军营里满是无所事事的士兵，有的搅着炖锅，有的玩着纸牌。最刺激的消遣，是看一只甲虫与一条虫子搏斗，可双方似乎都没什么兴趣。%commander%亲自迎接你，把你带进摆满地图和筹划用具的帐篷。 | 你走进%commander%的帐篷，迎面是一群兴致缺缺的士兵。一人喊道。%SPEECH_ON%你们可不是我们叫来的姑娘。%SPEECH_OFF%士兵们哄堂大笑。%randombrother%立刻回敬。%SPEECH_ON%你们的娘先把我们伺候好了。%SPEECH_OFF%毫不意外，两边都开始拔武器。%commander%亲自介入，才阻止了一场流血冲突。他把你带到自己的帐篷里。%SPEECH_ON%很高兴你来了，不过，想赢下这场该死的战争，你的人最好少惹点麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%commander%的营地，发现士兵们正在赛甲虫。他们为甲虫加油，甲虫却沿着稻草铺出的赛道爬到半途，就转头互相厮打起来。士兵们的欢呼越发响亮。%commander%穿过人群找到你，把你带进帐篷。%SPEECH_ON%你来了真好，佣兵。我马上就有事要你去办。%SPEECH_OFF% | 到达%commander%的军营时，你看见士兵们正为一个衣不蔽体、骑着驴四处转悠的女人欢呼。女人骑着驴进了一顶帐篷，很快便有大群士兵挤了进去。%randombrother%问自己能不能去。你说，你也要去，当然可以。偏在这时，%commander%一把拉住你，把你带向指挥帐篷。%SPEECH_ON%相信我，你不会想看那个的。%SPEECH_OFF%你不信他。 | %commander%的军营把大地踩成了泥浆。附近树木被砍光，原地搭起简陋的小棚屋，哪里泥地塌陷，棚屋就往哪里歪。帐篷延伸到视线尽头。沿途篝火熊熊，像在白色天空中闪烁的星点。

 你在帐篷里见到%commander%，四周摆满地图，副官们正等候命令。 | 军营里尽是叮叮当当的敲击声。铁匠忙着修补装备，厨子熬煮着被他们称作食物的可怕糊糊，士兵则敲下支撑帐篷的木桩。你进入帐篷，与%commander%会面。终于摆脱了金属噪声，耳边却又换成副官们的争论。他摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%大战临近，人难免紧张。别在意他们拌嘴。%SPEECH_OFF%}

9f93b195a3dda70c02d6.source: What do you need the %companyname% to do?

065ddadd6f7087dd6111.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{You return to the war camp and order your men to get some rest. Who knows what awaits you tomorrow. | Well, %commander%'s orders have been fulfilled, but there's surely to be more tomorrow. Get some rest while you can! | The war camp is just as you left it. You're not sure if that's good or bad. Tomorrow will bring more shite to take care of so you order the %companyname% to get some rest.}
065ddadd6f7087dd6111.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{你回到军营，命令弟兄们休息。谁知道明天等着你们的是什么。 | %commander%的命令已经完成，可明天必定还有更多差事。趁能睡，赶紧歇着！ | 军营和离开时一模一样，你也说不准是好是坏。明天还有更多破事要处理，你便命令%companyname%先休息。}

8a82134861b55231de2a.source: Rest well, we'll soon be called upon again.
8a82134861b55231de2a.translation: 好好休息，很快又有差事了。

f462262e00892d60a8e9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]%commander% explains the situation.%SPEECH_ON%{Our scouts have located their scouts. Unfortunately, I did not arm my scouts for battle so they have requested help. The enemy is located %direction% of here. Kill them all and %feudfamily% will be left in the dark about our army's movements. | A few of my pathfinders have located some of %feudfamily%'s scouts just %direction% of here. They're rummaging around looking for the main army, but they won't find it because you'll be going out there to kill them all. Got it? | %feudfamily%'s scouts have been spotted %direction% from here. I need you to go and kill them all before they find us or report whatever they've learned in the past days. | In war, information is god. And I have recently acquired information that %feudfamily%'s scouts are on the prowl just %direction% of here. If I can learn things about them, and then destroy what they've learned about us, then we have acquired quite the advantage for the upcoming fights.}%SPEECH_OFF%
f462262e00892d60a8e9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]%commander%说明了情况。%SPEECH_ON%{我方斥候找到了敌方斥候。可惜，我没给他们配上作战装备，所以他们请求支援。敌人就在这里的%direction%边。全杀掉，%feudfamily%就无法掌握我军的动向。 | 几个探路兵在这里%direction%边，发现了%feudfamily%的斥候。他们正四处搜寻我军主力，但不会找到了，因为你要过去，把他们全部杀光。明白吗？ | %feudfamily%的斥候出现在这里的%direction%边。我要你去全部杀掉，赶在他们找到我们，或者把这些天探得的消息送回去之前。 | 战争中，情报就是神明。我最近得到消息，%feudfamily%的斥候就在这里%direction%边活动。若我能知道他们的情况，再让他们对我们的了解全数断送，我们便能在接下来的战斗中占尽优势。}%SPEECH_OFF%

e9d4feb919a25841c005.source: The company will head out immediately.

e8c872dd9773ee590a68.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{Unfortunately, one or more of the scouts managed to slip out of the battle. Whatever information they had collected is now in the hands of %feudfamily%. | Damn it all! Some of the scouts managed to escape and no doubt make their way back to %feudfamily%.}
e8c872dd9773ee590a68.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{可惜，还是有斥候从战场溜走。他们搜集的情报，如今已落入%feudfamily%手中。 | 该死！有些斥候成功逃脱，想必正赶回%feudfamily%复命。}

4dd4dd3dec3d244d2c1c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{All of the scouts have been slain. Whatever information they had died with them. This will be a great boon for the upcoming battle. | The scouts are dead and whatever they had learned is dead with them.}
4dd4dd3dec3d244d2c1c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{斥候已全部被杀，他们掌握的情报也随之埋葬。这对即将到来的决战大有好处。 | 斥候都死了，他们探知的一切，也一同死在了这里。}

62b62350c70d0bd611db.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{%commander% sighs and begins to talk.%SPEECH_ON%I don't mean to waste your talents, sellsword, but I need someone to go out and requisition food supplies for the army. We are running low on supplies and need all the help we can get.%SPEECH_OFF%Hey, if you're getting paid then it is no insult to you. | %commander% stuffs a dried leaf behind his lip and crosses his arms.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, I know you're here to fight. I know you're here to kill men and get paid well for doing it. But right now, my army needs to be fed and to get fed I need someone to go out there and get the food.%SPEECH_OFF%He goes to one of his maps and points down at it.%SPEECH_ON%I need you to visit these farmers and load up their food. They will be expecting you so there shouldn't be any problems. Consider this an easy day before the battle, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander% points at a scroll laid across one of his maps. There are numbers down it, and the numbers are shrinking the lower they get down the page.%SPEECH_ON%We are running low on food supplies. We usually requisition stores by visiting the farmers %direction% of here. I need you to go down there and pick more up. They'll be expecting you there shouldn't be any problems.%SPEECH_OFF% | You look down at a plate with a dried loaf of bread on it. There's meat on the plate next to it, half-eaten, the rest taken to by the flies. A well-fed, healthy dog wags its tail in one of the corners. %commander% walks around to one of his maps.%SPEECH_ON%We're running very low on food stores. If my men go hungry, they won't fight, and if they won't fight then we lose!%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The math checks out. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%We've been taking food from farmers %direction% of here for some time now. I need you to go there and do the same. One of my guards will get you a list of things to get. The farmers themselves will not oppose you. They know what happens if they do.%SPEECH_OFF% | You see a studious man in the corner of the tent. He's running a dried quill pen down a scroll, shaking his head all the while. Suddenly, he rises to his feet and hands the page to %commander%. The commander nods a few times then looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%This might seem beneath some mercenaries, but I need the %companyname% to visit the farms %direction% of here and 'requisition' the foods that they have. It will not be the first time our army has made requests of these farmers. The last time we went, they tried to resist but, well, lessons were learned. My scribe will write down everything we need. Think of it as a day shopping at the markets.%SPEECH_OFF%The commander grins wryly.}
62b62350c70d0bd611db.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{%commander%叹了口气，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%我无意大材小用，佣兵，可我需要有人出去，为军队征集粮食。我们的补给快耗尽了，能有多少帮助，就得争取多少。%SPEECH_OFF%嗐，只要有钱拿，你就不觉得这算什么侮辱。 | %commander%把一片干叶塞进嘴唇内侧，抱起双臂。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼，我知道你们是来打仗的，是来杀人、挣大钱的。但眼下，我的军队得吃饭，要吃饭，就得有人出去把粮食弄来。%SPEECH_OFF%他走到一张地图前，伸手指了指。%SPEECH_ON%我要你去找这些农民，把他们的粮食装回来。他们会等着你，不该有什么麻烦。就当大战前轻松一天，怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%指向摊在地图上的一份卷轴。上面列着一串数字，越往下，数目越小。%SPEECH_ON%粮食储备快见底了。平时我们都向这里%direction%的农民征粮。你去那儿，再弄一些回来。他们会等着你，不该有什么麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你低头看见一个盘子，上面放着干硬的面包。旁边另一盘肉吃了一半，剩下的全便宜了苍蝇。角落里，一条喂得膘肥体壮的狗正摇着尾巴。%commander%绕到一张地图前。%SPEECH_ON%我们的存粮严重不足。士兵饿着肚子，就不肯打仗；不肯打，我们就得输！%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。这账算得没错。他接着说道。%SPEECH_ON%这段时间，我们一直从这里%direction%的农民那里拿粮。我要你再去一趟，照样办。守卫会给你一张清单，列明要拿什么。农民不会反抗，他们知道反抗的下场。%SPEECH_OFF% | 帐篷角落里坐着一个书生模样的人。他拿干掉的羽毛笔沿卷轴往下划，一路摇头。忽然，他站起身，把那页账目递给%commander%。指挥官点了几下头，望向你。%SPEECH_ON%有些佣兵可能觉得这活不够体面，不过，我需要%companyname%去这里%direction%的农场，“征用”他们的粮食。这不是我军第一次向这些农民提要求。上次去的时候，他们试着反抗，嗯，后来学到了教训。我的书记员会列出所有需要的东西。就当去集市逛一天，买点东西吧。%SPEECH_OFF%指挥官露出一丝狡黠的笑。}

72526c6bf6ba5af71c46.source: The company will move out within the hour.
72526c6bf6ba5af71c46.translation: 战团将在一小时内开拔。

d6d1406d16723dcd812f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]{The farmhouses draw near. A sea of crops stretches before you, the fields gliding wavelike as the winds soar through. %randombrother% runs his hand through a field of wheat. %randombrother2% slugs him in the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%You wanna bring sawflies home with us? Get yer hand out of there.%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenary rubs his shoulder before slugging back.%SPEECH_ON%Fark you. My hand goes where it please, just ask yer mother.%SPEECH_OFF%The punches rapidly increase in volume and the idyllic scene breaks. | The farmhouses are in the distance. Fields of crops seesaw to a crisp wind, rustling like calm ocean waves. Farmhands chop through the fields with scythes, a crew of followers heaving the remains with pitchforks. Donkeys bring up the rear, drawing carts through the roughshod terrain. | The farms roll amongst the hills, the soil too good to let a bit of geography get in the way. Every field is flush with crops, and piping through them are the farmhands, scythes and pitchforks glinting as they rise and fall. In the distance, you see the owners of the farms standing together. They look mighty pissed, but rarely does anyone stay angry in front of the %companyname%.}
d6d1406d16723dcd812f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]{农舍越来越近，庄稼如海铺展眼前，风一掠过，田野便荡起波浪。%randombrother%伸手拂过麦田，%randombrother2%朝他肩膀捶了一拳。%SPEECH_ON%想把麦叶蜂一起带回去？把手拿出来。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵揉揉肩膀，随即回敬一拳。%SPEECH_ON%去你的。我的手爱去哪儿就去哪儿，问你娘就知道。%SPEECH_OFF%拳头来往得越来越密，这幅田园美景也随之破灭。 | 农舍在远处，田间庄稼随着清风起伏，沙沙作响，仿佛平静的海浪。农场杂工挥镰穿过田地，后方一队人用草叉挑起割下的作物。驴子压在队尾，拖着小车驶过崎岖土地。 | 农田沿着丘陵铺开，土壤太肥，没人肯因一点地势起伏就放弃。每块田都庄稼茂盛，杂工穿行其间，镰刀与草叉一起一落，闪着光。远处，几个农场主站在一块儿，看起来很生气。不过，面对%companyname%，很少有人能一直气势汹汹。}

40e50b13e3add7d14a47.source: Let's get what we're here for.
40e50b13e3add7d14a47.translation: 拿到我们此行要的东西。

b62ab77edfe92d0da234.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{As you near the farmers, a shout comes from your sides and out jumps a group of well-armed men. This is an ambush! | Closing in on the farmhouses, the food-filled carts begin to trundle backwards. As they shuffle away, they slowly reveal a troop of well-armed men. The farmers quickly clear out. %randombrother% draws his weapon.%SPEECH_ON%This is an ambush!%SPEECH_OFF% | You draw in on the food carts. The farmers step aside as %randombrother% goes forward and throws the tarp off one of the wagons. There's nothing inside. Suddenly, an arrow slams against the wagon side with a wooden thwang. The farmers duck down and run off as well-armed men stream in from the sides. This is an ambush!}
b62ab77edfe92d0da234.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{你刚靠近农民，侧面便传来喊声，一群全副武装的人跳了出来。这是埋伏！ | 靠近农舍时，装满食物的货车开始慢慢后退，渐渐露出后方一队武装精良的人。农民们迅速散开，%randombrother%拔出武器。%SPEECH_ON%有埋伏！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走近粮车，农民让开，%randombrother%上前掀掉一辆货车的篷布。里面空无一物。突然，一支箭砰地射中车身，木板震响。农民们缩头逃开，武装精良的人从两侧涌入。这是埋伏！}

9d3523c19b36c062f866.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]You get up to the farmers only for them to resist. Their leader crosses his arms and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%{Look. My men have already loaded the carts. I'm willing to meet halfway here, you know? Because we got families to feed and debts to pay just like anybody else. How about you pay us %cost% crowns and we'll let all this go up to %commander%. | You're mercenaries, right? Then you'd understand the need for gold more than most. We're simple farmers, not money changers. All we ask for is a little compensation for our work. You give us %cost% crowns, and we'll give you the food. We're still taking a loss with that agreement, but I still think it's fair. | You come up here you're your gaudy outfit thinking you're just going to bully us into submission. %commander%'s already taken too much, I say, and it's about time he pays for his food just like everybody else! So here's the deal. I'll sell you the food for %cost% crowns. I think that is perfectly fair for what we have to offer.}%SPEECH_OFF%
9d3523c19b36c062f866.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你来到农民面前，对方却不肯配合。领头者抱起双臂，摇头说道。%SPEECH_ON%{听着，弟兄们已经把车装好了。我也愿意各退一步，懂吗？我们跟别人一样，要养家，还要还债。这样，你付%cost%克朗，这批东西就全让你送去给%commander%。 | 你们是佣兵，对吧？那该比多数人更懂，金子有多要紧。我们只是农民，不是兑换钱币的商人，只求劳动能有一点补偿。你给%cost%克朗，粮食就给你。即便如此，我们还是赔本，不过我觉得，这也算公平。 | 你们穿着花哨行头过来，就以为能把我们吓得服服帖帖。我说，%commander%已经拿得太多，该像所有人一样，掏钱买饭了！条件就是这样：%cost%克朗，粮食卖你。照我们给的这些东西，我觉得价钱完全公道。}%SPEECH_OFF%

577fe530cbbe7eb3a856.source: You forget your place, farmer. You want us to take it by force?
577fe530cbbe7eb3a856.translation: 农夫，认清自己的身份。难道要我们动手抢？

cdef6ab461e73e89d398.source: I understand. You shall have your %cost% crowns and we the supplies.
cdef6ab461e73e89d398.translation: 我明白了。你拿%cost%克朗，我们拿补给。

a5e9e8007c3dc5b17043.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]The ambush is too strong! You take what men are still standing and beat a retreat. %commander%'s men will have to ration even more now and news of the %companyname%'s defeat here will no doubt spread.
a5e9e8007c3dc5b17043.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]伏兵太强了！你带上还能站着的弟兄，仓促撤退。%commander%的部队如今得进一步缩减口粮，而%companyname%在此战败的消息，也势必传开。

20fc8a0619ceb948ea24.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{The farmers and their hired swords are put down. One of the farmhands, kicking backward with his guts hanging out, begs for mercy as you close in for the kill. You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%You're all turned out, kid. This right here is mercy.%SPEECH_OFF%The blade slides easily through his throat. He gargles, but it's over very quickly. You order the men to collect the foodstuffs and prepare to return to %commander%. | The farmers and their hired ambush have been slain to a man. You order the men to gather the foodstuffs. %commander% and his men should be happy to see your return. | There's blood on some of the food, but a little water will rub that right out. %commander%'s men will appreciate your work here. | %randombrother% picks up a farmer that was playing dead and slashes him across the throat. The man gargles and wriggles free of the mercenary's grip. He jaunts over to one of the wagons, spewing blood all over the food. You call out.%SPEECH_ON%Goddammit, get him off there!%SPEECH_OFF%The farmer is quickly disposed of, but that shipment is no doubt ruined. You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%Put a blanket on those ones. Maybe no one will notice.%SPEECH_OFF% | Getting the food required a little more work than you bargained for, but it's all in your hands now. You bestow ownership of the farmlands to a poor farmhand with woolsacks for shoes.%SPEECH_ON%Don't you forget what happened to your master here, because it sure as shit can happen to you to, got it?%SPEECH_OFF%The kid quickly nods. You order the %companyname% to prepare its return to %commander%.}
20fc8a0619ceb948ea24.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{农民和他们雇来的打手已倒在血泊中。一个农场杂工肠子拖在外面，双腿蹬地，向后挪动。你上前要了结他时，他乞求饶命。你摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%小子，你里面的东西都翻出来了。我这么做，才是饶你。%SPEECH_OFF%剑刃轻易穿过喉咙，他咯咯作响，很快便结束了。你命弟兄们收集粮食，准备返回%commander%处。 | 农民和他们雇来的伏兵，一个不剩，全都死了。你命弟兄们收集粮食。%commander%和他的部下，想必会很高兴看见你们回来。 | 有些粮食沾了血，不过用一点水就能洗掉。%commander%的部下会感谢你们在这里的辛劳。 | %randombrother%揪起一个装死的农民，划开喉咙。那人咯咯喘着，挣脱佣兵的手，跌跌撞撞跑到货车旁，把血喷得粮食上到处都是。你大喊。%SPEECH_ON%该死，把他弄走！%SPEECH_OFF%农民很快被处理掉，可那批粮无疑毁了。你摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%拿毯子盖上这些，也许没人注意。%SPEECH_OFF% | 为了弄到粮食，你付出的工夫比预想多了些，不过现在总算全在手里。你把农田的所有权，赐给一个拿粗布袋当鞋的可怜杂工。%SPEECH_ON%别忘了你主人在这儿落的下场，因为同样的事，他娘的也能落到你头上，懂吗？%SPEECH_OFF%小伙子赶紧点头。你命%companyname%准备返回%commander%处。}

825c05dbf547afb82e87.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{The farmers greet you warmly.%SPEECH_ON%Lemme guess, %commander% sent y'all?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The farmer spits and nods back.%SPEECH_ON%Well alright. You'll have no trouble here. Men, help them get on the road.%SPEECH_OFF%Farmhands come out to help your men take the foodstuffs and prepare the journey home to %commander%. | You meet the leader of the farmers. He shakes your hand.%SPEECH_ON%%commander%'s little bird told me he'd sent mercenaries, but your outfit looks a step above any company I've ever seen. My boys'll help you load the carts so you can be on your way.%SPEECH_OFF% | The farmers begin loading the carts as you near. Their leader steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%I ain't happy about doing this, but I'm happier here in these fields than sitting in some war camp waitin' to die in a war I don't care about. My men will help you load the carts so you can be on yer way. When you see %commander%, put in a good for me, would ya? I'd like to keep farming.%SPEECH_OFF%}
825c05dbf547afb82e87.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{农民们热情迎接你。%SPEECH_ON%让我猜猜，%commander%派你们来的？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。农民啐了一口，也点点头。%SPEECH_ON%行吧，这里不会给你添麻烦。伙计们，帮他们上路。%SPEECH_OFF%农场杂工纷纷出来，帮弟兄们接收粮食，准备返回%commander%处。 | 你见到农民的领头者，他握了握你的手。%SPEECH_ON%%commander%的报信人说，要派佣兵来。不过，你们这身行头，比我见过的任何战团都强。我的伙计们会帮着装车，让你们早点上路。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你靠近时，农民们便开始装车。领头者上前说道。%SPEECH_ON%我不喜欢干这个，可比起蹲在军营，等着死在一场与我无关的仗里，还是待在田里高兴些。我的人会帮你们装车，好让你们上路。见到%commander%，替我说句好话，成吗？我还想接着种地。%SPEECH_OFF%}

42538cc7b53553f6be5b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{You draw out your sword. The farmers step back and a clatter of pitchforks being grabbed rattles through their lines. Their leader spits and runs a sleeve across his mouth.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, you wanna take it there? Then we'll go there.%SPEECH_OFF% | You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%No deal. Give up the foodstuffs or face our wrath.%SPEECH_OFF%The farmer swings a pitchfork from side to side. His men slowly begin picking up arms. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%We're farmers, asshole. Wrath chose us a long, long time ago.%SPEECH_OFF% | You did not come here to broker deals.%SPEECH_ON%There will be no compensation. %commander% sent us here to...%SPEECH_OFF%The farmer laughs and interrupts.%SPEECH_ON%The commander sent some lapdogs. Well I'll tell you what little doggie, let's see if your men are more bark than bite.%SPEECH_OFF%}
42538cc7b53553f6be5b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你拔出剑。农民后退，人群里响起拿取草叉的碰撞声。领头者啐了一口，用袖子擦嘴。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼，非要闹到这一步？那就来吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你摇头。%SPEECH_ON%没得谈。交出粮食，否则就承受我们的怒火。%SPEECH_OFF%农民左右晃动草叉，身后的人也慢慢拿起武器。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%混账，我们是种地的。老天的怒火，早就盯上我们了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你来这里，可不是谈买卖。%SPEECH_ON%没有补偿。%commander%派我们来，是要……%SPEECH_OFF%农民笑着打断。%SPEECH_ON%指挥官派来了几条哈巴狗。小狗崽，告诉你吧，咱们这就看看，你的人究竟只会叫，还是也会咬。%SPEECH_OFF%}

06bad5e30e5ea69782d7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{You see no reason to shed the blood of some poor farmers just trying to live their lives. Handing over the crowns, you warn the farmer to be careful trying to cut deals like this.%SPEECH_ON%Not everyone is so kind as to try and broker with you.%SPEECH_OFF%The farmer turns his head, revealing a long scar the runs from scalp to shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%I know well enough. Thank you for your consideration, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | You're only in the farmer-kill business if someone pays you to do just that. %commander% did not. You agree to the farmers' terms. Their leader shakes your hand.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you mercenary. It's rare to see a man willing to cede some ground. I took you for a brute, but clearly you are a man of much acumen.%SPEECH_OFF% | You did not come out all this way to slaughter some poor farmers. You agree to the man's terms. He thanks you for not coming out all this way to slaughter some poor farmers. %randombrother%, however, quietly states that he did not come all this way to... You loudly tell him to shut his mouth and start loading the carts.}
06bad5e30e5ea69782d7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{这些可怜农民不过想过自己的日子，你看不出有何必要让他们流血。交出克朗，你告诫对方，这样讨价还价可得小心。%SPEECH_ON%不是每个人都肯好心坐下来跟你谈。%SPEECH_OFF%农民转过头，露出一道从头皮直延伸到肩膀的长疤。%SPEECH_ON%我很清楚。佣兵，多谢体谅。%SPEECH_OFF% | 只有别人专门付钱，你才会接杀农民的活。%commander%可没付这份钱。你答应条件，领头者握住你的手。%SPEECH_ON%多谢，佣兵。肯退让一步的人，很少见。我原以为你是个蛮人，可显然，你很明事理。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你大老远过来，可不是为了屠杀几个可怜农民。你答应那人的条件。他感谢你，没有大老远过来屠杀几个可怜农民。可%randombrother%低声说，他大老远过来，可不是为了……你大声叫他闭嘴，开始装车。}

4f88dc2dddaa385b1d48.source: Let's hurry up and get back to the war camp.

b4492cf596e0ab0197ff.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{The morning sun leaks into your tent, running a beam right across your eyes to really rub it in that you've a new day to put up with. | You get up and put your boots on, slapping out some spiders that thought it the place to rest overnight. | Outside your tent, a rooster loudly lets everyone know what a real asshole of an animal it is. You begrudgingly get up. | You wake to yet another day. Great. | You slept like a dead man and wake like one, too. The sunlight slipping into the tent is too blinding to go back to bed and the flaps are too far to shut. To hell with it, you'll get up. | Morning. That inevitable hour where a thousand regrets arrive on the glowy limelight of a new day.}

 A young boy stands outside your tent with a scroll. He unfurls and struggles to read it.%SPEECH_ON%{Your... co-co-commander has re... rekeestered... uh, you'd just better go and see him yourself. | %commander% wi-wishes to see you, he... he says, wait, no horses do? What? Look I can't read. Just go see the commander. | Sir, this here paper tells me to tell you that, you... uh, you should... er, uh, go see the commander. There's a lot more, but we'd be here all day if I tried finish it. | So yeah, I can't actually read, but I think the commander wishes to see you. | Let's see, this letter... I know this letter... it's the letter 'I', and I think the rest of the sentence is a whole lot of I can't read a damn lick of this shite. Look, just go see the commander. I think that's what he wants.}%SPEECH_OFF%
b4492cf596e0ab0197ff.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{晨光漏进帐篷，一道光正好划过双眼，像是非要提醒你，又有新的一天得熬。 | 你起身穿靴，先拍掉几只蜘蛛。它们竟把这里当成了过夜的好地方。 | 帐篷外，一只公鸡高声向所有人证明，自己是个多么混账的畜生。你不情不愿地起床。 | 你醒来，又是一天。真棒。 | 你睡得像死人，醒来也像死人。透进帐篷的阳光刺得没法继续睡，帐帘又远得懒得去关。去他的，起床吧。 | 清晨。这个不可避免的时刻，千百种懊悔伴着新一天的耀眼光辉，一同到来。}

一个小男孩拿着卷轴站在帐外，展开，费力地念。%SPEECH_ON%{您的……指、指、指挥官，已要……要情……呃，你还是亲自去见他吧。 | %commander%希、希望见你，他……他说，等等，没有马会？什么？听着，我不识字，去见指挥官就行。 | 长官，这张纸让我告诉你，你……呃，你应该……嗯，呃，去见指挥官。后面还有好多，可要我全念完，咱们得在这儿待上一整天。 | 嗯，是这样，我其实不会认字，不过我想，指挥官想见你。 | 我看看，这个字母……我认得，是“I”，意思是“我”。后面整句大概就是“我他娘的一个字也看不懂”。听着，去见指挥官吧，我想他就是这个意思。}%SPEECH_OFF%

064aa5c774aca4f945c2.source: Time to pay a visit to the commander...

b5df4493fb1baeb5d439.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]You meet with %commander% in his tent. He looks rather excited. A shrewd and shrouded little man stands by his side. The commander talks hurriedly.%SPEECH_ON%{My little bird here has reported that a shipment of equipment is heading toward %feudfamily%'s army. If we can intercept and destroy it, they won't be nearly as ready to fight in the future! | Hello, sellsword. My spies tell me that %feudfamily% has a much needed shipment of equipment heading toward their camp. I need you to go and destroy it. | Aren't spies the best? Look at this little man. He tells me, sir, %feudfamily% has a large shipment of goods coming in. Weapons, armor, food, so and so forth. Well I say, I've got just the man to take advantage of this news: you! Go and find this shipment and lay it to waste. | Battles are oft won before they ever take place, you know that, right? My little spy here tells me that %feudfamily% has a shipment of arms and armor coming in. If you can manage to take it out, then their army will be far less prepared for a fight on open ground. | Did you know I once won a battle without so much as raising a sword? I managed to intercept a shipment of goods which left my enemy wholly unready to fight, so they surrendered instead. My little spy here tells me that %feudfamily% has a similar shipment of equipment coming in. I'm sure it won't end the war, but if you could go and take it out that would be a huge boon. | Did you know that an army without equipment is hardly an army to begin with? %feudfamily%'s army is running low on supplies. In fact, the reason they haven't attacked yet is because they're waiting for more arms and armor to arrive! Well, my little spy here has spotted that shipment. And I want you to go and destroy it. | I've acquired a bit of most excellent news, sellsword. %feudfamily% is awaiting the arrival of arms and armor - and we know exactly where it's coming from. I just need you to go and do the obvious: destroy that shipment and cripple my enemy before he even knows what's hit him.}%SPEECH_OFF%
b5df4493fb1baeb5d439.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]你在帐篷里与%commander%会面。他看起来颇为兴奋，身旁站着一个精明的矮个子，裹得严严实实。指挥官语速飞快。%SPEECH_ON%{我这只小鸟带回消息，一批装备正在运往%feudfamily%的军队。要是能截住并销毁它，他们今后打仗可就没那么充分的准备了！ | 你好，佣兵。我的密探说，%feudfamily%急需的一批装备正往他们的营地运。我需要你去把它毁掉。 | 密探真是好东西，对吧？瞧瞧这个小个子。他告诉我：大人，%feudfamily%有一大批物资要运到，武器、盔甲、粮食，诸如此类。我便说了，正好有个人能帮我好好利用这消息——就是你！去找到那批物资，把它毁个干净。 | 许多仗还没开打，胜负就已经定了，你明白吧？我的这位小密探说，%feudfamily%有一批武器和盔甲正在运来。如果你能把它毁掉，他们的军队在野外迎战时，就会准备不足得多。 | 你知道吗？有一回，我连剑都没举就赢了一场仗。我截下了一批物资，让敌人完全没法备战，结果他们直接投降了。我的这位小密探说，%feudfamily%也有这么一批装备正要运来。我当然不指望这就能结束战争，但你要是能去毁掉它，可就帮了大忙。 | 你知道，一支没有装备的军队，压根就算不上军队吧？%feudfamily%的军队补给短缺。事实上，他们迟迟没进攻，就是因为还在等更多武器和盔甲！我的这位小密探已经找到了那批货。我要你去毁掉它。 | 我刚得到一个绝好的消息，佣兵。%feudfamily%正在等一批武器和盔甲，而我们清楚地知道它从哪儿来。我要你做的事很简单：毁掉这批货，让敌人还没弄明白怎么回事，就先折了翅膀。}%SPEECH_OFF%

ebfcd03a88ba1a8f55c6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{You failed to destroy the caravan. Obviously, all its goods have reached %feudfamily%'s army which will make the fighting much harder in the coming days. | The caravan was not destroyed. You can be most assured that %feudfamily%'s army will be near full-strength for the big battle ahead. | Well, shite. The caravan was not destroyed. Now, %feudfamily%'s army is going to be very well prepared for the battle ahead.}
ebfcd03a88ba1a8f55c6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{你没能摧毁商队。显然，全部物资已送到%feudfamily%的军中，接下来的战斗会艰难得多。 | 商队未被摧毁。可以肯定，即将决战时，%feudfamily%的军队会接近全盛状态。 | 好吧，妈的，商队没被摧毁。如今%feudfamily%的军队可要准备充足地迎接决战了。}

4cd0776e0311a6bcf787.source: We should head back to the camp...

e1c4b33ded6d5a7bf8e8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{You had hoped to perhaps raid all that you could from the caravan, but the guards set fire to everything before it could be stolen away. Unfortunate, but all that matters is that %feudfamily%'s army did not get their hands on all this equipment. | You destroyed much of the caravan and that which you didn't the guards did themselves in an effort to keep the equipment out of enemy hands. %commander% will be most pleased by these results. | It was hard fought, but you managed to kill off the caravan guards. Unfortunately, the troop seems to have employed a scorched earth policy as they managed to raze every wagon before they could be captured. They knew better than to let all this equipment fall into enemy hands. %commander% will be more than happy nonetheless. | The caravan guards put up a good fight, all considered, but the %companyname% manages to slay them to a man. Or so you think: during the battle, one of the guards managed to slip away and employ a bit of scorched earth. Every wagon has been set alight. Obviously, if %feudfamily% could not get the equipment, then nobody could. Annoying, but smart. Nonetheless, %commander% and his men will appreciate the news. | The caravan has been put to waste. You had hoped to perhaps capture the wagons and take the equipment for yourself, but one of the guards managed to burn them all, no doubt to keep such gear out of enemy hands. Regardless, %feudfamily%'s army has most definitely been weakened.}
e1c4b33ded6d5a7bf8e8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{你原本想尽量搜刮商队，可护卫们赶在东西被抢走前，把一切都烧了。可惜，不过要紧的是，%feudfamily%的军队没能拿到这批装备。 | 你摧毁了商队的大部分，剩下的也被护卫们亲手毁掉，免得装备落入敌手。%commander%会对这个结果十分满意。 | 经过一番苦战，你终于杀光商队护卫。可惜，对方似乎早有焦土之策，所有货车都在被夺取前付之一炬。他们知道，不能让整批装备落入敌手。不过，%commander%仍会十分高兴。 | 平心而论，商队护卫打得不错，可%companyname%还是将他们斩尽杀绝。至少你原本这么以为：战斗中，一名护卫设法脱身，施行了一点焦土之策。如今，每辆货车都着了火。显然，若%feudfamily%拿不到装备，谁也别想拿。讨厌，却聪明。无论如何，%commander%和他的部下都会乐于听见这消息。 | 商队已被摧毁。你本想夺下货车，将装备据为己有，可一名护卫设法把车全烧了，无疑是为了不让这些东西落入敌手。不管怎样，%feudfamily%的军队确实受到了削弱。}

8191a466c22af75f0a9d.source: One less problem to deal with in the coming battle.
8191a466c22af75f0a9d.translation: 接下来的大战又少了一个麻烦。

7422324065b6ae18d128.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{You enter %commander%'s tent just in time to watch a candle go flying by your face. Its wick sizzles into the mud as you watch a table follow after it, flipping over and over with all its maps going flying. A red-faced %commander% stands at the foot of the carnage, his hands on his hips, breathing heavy as he recollects himself. He explains himself.%SPEECH_ON%Deserters! They've deserted! On the eve of the most important battle of my life, I can't even keep my goddam men around. Look, I cannot have this army coming apart at the seams. I need you to go and find those deserters and bring them back to me. If they refuse to return, well, kill them all. One of the sentries said he saw them going %direction% of here. Now hurry up!%SPEECH_OFF% | Just as you are about to enter %commander%'s tent, a man comes flying out. %commander% rushes forth from the tent and slams him into the mud. He grabs him by the collars and picks him up like a ragdoll.%SPEECH_ON%Where did they go? I swear by the old gods I will have you begging for death if you do not answer me honestly!%SPEECH_OFF%The man cries out and points.%SPEECH_ON%%direction%! They went that way, I swear!%SPEECH_OFF%%commander% drops the man who is quickly dragged away by a pair of guards. The commander stands up straight and runs a hand through his hair.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, a few of my men thought it best to desert the camp. Find them. Bring them back. Got it?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, but ask what if the men refuse. The commander shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Slaughter them, of course.%SPEECH_OFF% | You enter %commander%'s tent to find him stepping away from a seated man. The commander has pliers in his hands and there's a white tooth clamped in between the prongs. You notice that the seated man is passed out, head lolling, blood dripping from his mouth. %commander% throws the pliers on his table and runs a reddened hand through his hair.%SPEECH_ON%A few of my men have deserted. I cannot risk this army coming undone, not at this hour, not when the battle is so close. My little friend here, when he was still speaking anyway, told me that his compatriots saw fit to run off %direction% of here. Go, sellsword, and bring those deserters back to me.%SPEECH_OFF%Before you go, you ask what to do if the deserters refuse to return. The commander glares at you.%SPEECH_ON%What do you think? Kill them all!%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %commander% brooding over his maps. His knuckles turn into his table, the legs groaning and wobbling. He looks up. His eyes flash, a quick glance of unbelievable anger.%SPEECH_ON%A few of my men saw fit to desert my army. The sentries tell me they saw them running %direction% of here. Go and bring them back.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if he wants them alive. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%I want them back healthy as can be so I can better remind them what it means to abandon my army. Of course, if they absolutely refuse then I want them dead. That is also a good reminder to not abandon the army, wouldn't you agree?%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%'s got one of his lieutenants tied to one of the tent poles. The commander's got a long stick in hand and uses it bash the lieutenant across the chest and legs. The man cries out, spinning himself around only for his back to be beaten. When the lieutenant spins back around, his purpled face is snorting into unconsciousness.

 %commander% throws the stick down and starts pulling splinters out of his fingers.%SPEECH_ON%Glad you came, sellsword. A few of my men have deserted and I need you to go and find them. Bring them back alive, kill them all if they refuse. This here friend of mine said that they ran %direction%. For his sake, I hope he's telling the truth.%SPEECH_OFF%You hope he's telling the truth, too.}
7422324065b6ae18d128.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{你刚走进%commander%的帐篷，一根蜡烛便擦着脸飞过，烛芯落入泥中，嘶地熄灭。紧接着，一张桌子也翻滚着飞来，地图四散。满脸通红的%commander%站在狼藉前，双手叉腰，重重喘气，努力平复自己。他解释道。%SPEECH_ON%逃兵！他们逃了！我这辈子最重要的一仗就在眼前，我却连自己该死的士兵都留不住。听着，我不能让这支军队散架。我要你去找到那些逃兵，把他们带回来。要是不肯回来，那就全杀了。一名哨兵说，看见他们往这里%direction%去了。现在快去！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你正要走进%commander%的帐篷，一个男人却从里面飞了出来。%commander%紧跟着冲出，把他摔进泥里，又揪住衣领，像拎布偶一样提了起来。%SPEECH_ON%他们去哪儿了？我向旧神发誓，你要是不老实回答，我会让你求死都不能！%SPEECH_OFF%那人哭喊着伸手指去。%SPEECH_ON%%direction%！他们往那边去了，我发誓！%SPEECH_OFF%%commander%松开手，两名守卫立刻把那人拖走。指挥官直起身，伸手捋过头发。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我有几个士兵觉得，逃离军营才是明智之举。找到他们，带回来，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，又问，要是他们不肯呢？指挥官耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%当然是全宰了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%commander%的帐篷，看见他正从一个坐着的人身旁走开。指挥官手里拿着钳子，钳口夹着一颗白牙。那人已经昏过去，脑袋耷拉着，血从嘴角滴下。%commander%把钳子扔在桌上，用染红的手捋了捋头发。%SPEECH_ON%我有几个士兵逃了。我不能让军队散架，尤其不能在这个节骨眼，不能在大战这么近的时候。我这位小朋友——至少在他还能说话的时候——告诉我，他的同伙决定往这里%direction%逃。去吧，佣兵，把那些逃兵带回来。%SPEECH_OFF%离开前，你问，要是逃兵拒绝回来，该怎么办。指挥官瞪着你。%SPEECH_ON%你觉得呢？全杀了！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%commander%时，他正阴沉着脸盯着地图。拳头抵住桌面，压得桌腿吱呀摇晃。他抬起头，眼中骤然闪过难以置信的怒火。%SPEECH_ON%我有几个士兵，居然觉得逃离军队是条好路。哨兵说，看见他们往这里%direction%跑了。去把他们带回来。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，要活的吗？他点头。%SPEECH_ON%我要他们尽可能完好地回来，这样才能好好提醒他们，背弃我的军队意味着什么。当然，要是死活不肯，就给我杀了。这也能很好地提醒别人，别当逃兵，你说呢？%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%把一名副官绑在帐篷支柱上。他手持长棍，朝副官的胸口和双腿猛打。那人惨叫着转身躲避，后背却又挨了打。等副官转回来，青紫的脸抽搐着，已闷哼着失去知觉。

 %commander%丢下棍子，开始拔手指上的木刺。%SPEECH_ON%你来得正好，佣兵。我有几个士兵逃了，要你去把他们找出来。带活的回来，要是不肯，就全杀了。我这位朋友说，他们往%direction%跑了。为了他自己好，我希望他说的是真话。%SPEECH_OFF%你也希望他说的是真话。}

9a8d51d0f61ce0994efb.source: The company will head out within the hour.
9a8d51d0f61ce0994efb.translation: 战团将在一小时内出发。

9618115416eebe2ed8cc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{You come upon the deserters sitting around a smoldering campfire, one of them desperately kicking dust over the coals. He stops when he sees you. The rest of the deserters follow his gaze before springing to their feet.%SPEECH_ON%We ain't going back. You can tell %commander% to go to hell.%SPEECH_OFF% | The deserters are arguing amongst themselves when you crash their little runaway party. One of the men jumps back.%SPEECH_ON%%commander% sent you, didn't he? Well, you can tell him to go to hell.%SPEECH_OFF%Another man pumps his fist.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, we ain't going back!%SPEECH_OFF%They're an unruly bunch, no doubt. | %randombrother% points out a group of men standing at a road sign. They're arguing too loudly amongst themselves to hear you approach. You give out a sharp whistle which simultaneously silences and spins the men around. One rears back.%SPEECH_ON%That rat commander sent mercenaries after us?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and explain that they should come on back with you. Another deserter shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Go on back? How about you go on and get the hell out of here? We ain't going back so you go on and tell the commander just that.%SPEECH_OFF% | The deserters are found sharing food out of a wool sack. They pause at the sight of you and one elects to try and swallow his food whole. He chokes. The rest of the men don't move. The choker scrambles around for help, his face going purple. His legs scissor over the wool sack, kicking food everywhere. You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Help your man.%SPEECH_OFF%The deserters quickly run to the choking man and knock the food out of his throat. He gasps for air. You begin to explain what %commander% has asked of you, but one of the deserters interrupts.%SPEECH_ON%No. We are not going back. This war is a waste and we want no part of it.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9618115416eebe2ed8cc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{你撞见逃兵们围坐在一堆余火旁，其中一人正拼命踢起尘土，想盖住炭火。一看见你，他便停住了。其他人顺着他的目光望来，随即纷纷跳起。%SPEECH_ON%我们不回去。你可以叫%commander%下地狱了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你闯进这群逃兵的小聚会时，他们正在争吵。一个人猛地后退。%SPEECH_ON%是%commander%派你来的，对吧？好，你可以叫他下地狱了。%SPEECH_OFF%另一人挥起拳头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，我们绝不回去！%SPEECH_OFF%毫无疑问，这是一群难以管束的家伙。 | %randombrother%指了指路牌旁的一群人。他们吵得太响，根本没听见你们走近。你吹了声尖锐的口哨，那些人顿时住嘴，齐齐转身。其中一人往后一缩。%SPEECH_ON%那个耗子指挥官派佣兵来抓我们？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，说明他们该跟你回去。另一名逃兵摇头道。%SPEECH_ON%回去？要不你先给我滚远点？我们不回去，你就照这话告诉指挥官。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你们找到逃兵时，他们正在分食一个毛布袋里的食物。看见你，他们全都停住了，只有一人试着把嘴里的食物整口吞下，结果噎住了。其他人纹丝不动。那人四处挣扎求救，脸憋得发紫，双腿胡乱蹬过布袋，把食物踢得到处都是。你点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%帮帮你们的人。%SPEECH_OFF%逃兵们这才赶紧跑过去，把卡在他喉咙里的食物拍了出来。他大口喘气。你正要说明%commander%交代的任务，一个逃兵却打断了你。%SPEECH_ON%不。我们不会回去。这场仗毫无意义，我们不想再掺和。%SPEECH_OFF%}

11077287bbeb66db60c6.source: Is this who you want to be? Cowards that won't defend their own lands?
11077287bbeb66db60c6.translation: 连自己的土地都不敢保卫？你们就甘心当这样的懦夫？

73f66a7e1ae530b8114e.source: Your choice is simple. Fight for your lord, or die here.
73f66a7e1ae530b8114e.translation: 选择很简单：为领主作战，或者死在这里。

b42db180504910978b47.source: Let's be honest what this is about. Here's %bribe% crowns if you return.
b42db180504910978b47.translation: 咱们把话挑明吧。只要归队，这%bribe%克朗就是你们的。

5243c2fed0e615701ad5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{You take out a bag and put %bribe% crowns into it.%SPEECH_ON%I will personally pay you men to come back with me to the war camp. %commander% is furious with you, make no farkin' mistake about it, but he needs every man he can get. If you fight for him in this coming battle, I've no doubt he'll pardon this little error you have made.%SPEECH_OFF% | You offer the deserters %bribe% crowns. The men look at one another, then speak to you.%SPEECH_ON%And what good is money when the commander hangs us all?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and answer.%SPEECH_ON%Good question, but %commander% is no fool. He needs all the men he can muster for the coming battle. Prove yourself in that battle and this little pity party you've thrown for yourselves will be forgotten.%SPEECH_OFF%}{The deserters mull their options and eventually agree to come back with you. | The deserters huddle and come to some sort of agreement. Breaking the huddle, their leader steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%Despite some objections, we agree to come back with you to the war camp. 5243c2fed0e615701ad5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{你取出一个钱袋，装入%bribe%克朗。%SPEECH_ON%我自己掏钱，请你们跟我回军营。%commander%对你们火冒三丈，这他妈一点都不假，可他现在需要每一个能用的人。只要你们在接下来的大战中替他卖命，我敢说，他会原谅你们这点小过失。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你提出给逃兵们%bribe%克朗。众人互相看了看，随后开口。%SPEECH_ON%要是指挥官把我们全吊死，钱还有什么用？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头答道。%SPEECH_ON%问得好，可%commander%不是傻子。大战在即，他得调集所有人手。只要你们在战场上证明自己，今天这出自怨自艾的小闹剧，很快就会被忘掉。%SPEECH_OFF%}{逃兵们掂量了一番，最后同意跟你回去。 | 逃兵们围在一起，似乎达成了某种共识。人群散开后，他们的头领走上前。%SPEECH_ON%虽然有人反对，我们还是同意跟你回军营。希望我不会后悔。%SPEECH_OFF% | 短暂争论之后，逃兵们决定投票。虽未全票通过，但他们总算达成一致：跟你回去见%commander%。 | 逃兵们争论着下一步该怎么办，最终免不了要投票。毫不意外，票数打平了。众人于是决定抛一枚克朗：正面就回营，反面就离开。头领抛起硬币，所有人都盯着它翻转、闪光。硬币落下，正面朝上。看到结果，每个人都叹了口气，仿佛偶然与命运替他们卸下了某种重担，终于不用再由自己作出抉择。}

da594e1587529cf5d5ac.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{%bigdog%向前一步，轻轻松松地把武器转过肩头。他点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%你们怕%commander%。我懂。你们认识他，知道他的脾气，也清楚他做得出什么事。问题是……%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵咧嘴一笑，那狡黠的笑容映在雪亮的刀刃上。%SPEECH_ON%你们认识我吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 逃兵们眼看就要离开，%bigdog%忽然吹了声响亮的口哨。%SPEECH_ON%喂，你们这帮混账，我的团长给你们下命令了。%SPEECH_OFF%一个逃兵嗤笑道。%SPEECH_ON%是吗？他他妈又不是我们的指挥官，拿着你的命令塞屁股去吧。%SPEECH_OFF%%bigdog%拔出一把巨刃，插进地里，双手交叠着压在剑首上。%SPEECH_ON%你们怕%commander%，这没什么。可你要再这么嘴贱，朋友，咱们就来看看，你们真正该怕的到底是哪位指挥官。%SPEECH_OFF% | 逃兵们转身要走。%bigdog%拔出巨刃，在自己的铠甲上敲得铿铿作响。逃兵们慢慢回过身。%bigdog%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%你们有人尿过裤子吗？%SPEECH_OFF%一个逃兵摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%喂……喂，少他妈胡说八道。%SPEECH_OFF%%bigdog%猛地提起刀刃，刀尖直指那名逃兵。%SPEECH_ON%噢，想让我闭嘴？再这么跟我说话，用不了多久，这里就没人开得了口了。%SPEECH_OFF%}{逃兵们掂量了一番，最后同意跟你回去。 | 逃兵们围在一起，似乎达成了某种共识。人群散开后，他们的头领走上前。%SPEECH_ON%虽然有人反对，我们还是同意跟你回军营。希望我不会后悔。%SPEECH_OFF% | 短暂争论之后，逃兵们决定投票。虽未全票通过，但他们总算达成一致：跟你回去见%commander%。 | 逃兵们争论着下一步该怎么办，最终免不了要投票。毫不意外，票数打平了。众人于是决定抛一枚克朗：正面就回营，反面就离开。头领抛起硬币，所有人都盯着它翻转、闪光。硬币落下，正面朝上。看到结果，每个人都叹了口气，仿佛偶然与命运替他们卸下了某种重担，终于不用再由自己作出抉择。}

2fdbb399de2d030d0039.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{逃兵们转身要走，%motivator%上前一步，清了清嗓子。%SPEECH_ON%所以，就这么算了，是吗？你们打算像一群软蛋，缩着身子逃掉自己的责任？我知道你们怎么想。你们觉得这场仗毫无意义，也不想为某个趾高气扬、根本不懂你们处境的贵族拼命。这都没错。可是多年以后，你坐在那里，逗着膝头上的孙子，他会问起你当年打仗的事。到时候，你就只能对那个小男孩撒谎了。%SPEECH_OFF% | %motivator%把手指含在唇间，吹出一声尖锐的口哨。逃兵们转向他，他随即开口。%SPEECH_ON%所以，就这样了？你们非要给自己背上这份愧疚？等那一天到了，你们要怎么对孩子说，嗯？说自己是个没出息的逃兵，丢下同袍，任他们替自己去死？别弄错了，因为你们不在，本不该死的人就会死。你们的缺席，会带来远超想象的后果！%SPEECH_OFF% | %motivator%朝逃兵们喊道。%SPEECH_ON%好啊，现在就走。丢下旗帜，就当这场仗打完了。可要是%feudfamily%赢了呢，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%一个逃兵耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%他们又不认识我。我要回家，陪家人种地。%SPEECH_OFF%%motivator%笑着摇头。%SPEECH_ON%是吗？那等那些外来兵闯进你家院子，你怎么办？等他们看见你的妻子，看见你的孩子，你怎么办？你到底以为这场仗是为什么打的？到时候，你连家都没得回，蠢货！%SPEECH_OFF%}{逃兵们掂量了一番，最后同意跟你回去。 | 逃兵们围在一起，似乎达成了某种共识。人群散开后，他们的头领走上前。%SPEECH_ON%虽然有人反对，我们还是同意跟你回军营。希望我不会后悔。%SPEECH_OFF% | 短暂争论之后，逃兵们决定投票。虽未全票通过，但他们总算达成一致：跟你回去见%commander%。 | 逃兵们争论着下一步该怎么办，最终免不了要投票。毫不意外，票数打平了。众人于是决定抛一枚克朗：正面就回营，反面就离开。头领抛起硬币，所有人都盯着它翻转、闪光。硬币落下，正面朝上。看到结果，每个人都叹了口气，仿佛偶然与命运替他们卸下了某种重担，终于不用再由自己作出抉择。}

Their leader claps you on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Fortune has decided our fates.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and draw out your sword, the rest of the company following suit.%SPEECH_ON%You keep that in mind when we're killing the lot of you.%SPEECH_OFF%The leader smiles weakly as he draws his blade.%SPEECH_ON%It's quite alright. We'd rather die on freedom's doorstep than go back to that grind.%SPEECH_OFF% | The leader politely refuses to come back.%SPEECH_ON%We didn't choose this path lightly, sellsword. We're not coming back.%SPEECH_OFF%You order the %companyname% to draw out their weapons. The deserter's leader sighs, but nods understandingly.%SPEECH_ON%I suppose it is what it is. We talked of this, and we are prepared to die here, walking where we wish, than die out there on some dog's orders. This is all the world to us now.%SPEECH_OFF%Shrugging, you respond.%SPEECH_ON%Tis only business for us.%SPEECH_OFF%}
5659f94cd0aa983feaa8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{逃兵们转身要走，%motivator%上前一步，清了清嗓子。%SPEECH_ON%所以，就这么算了，是吗？你们打算像一群软蛋，缩着身子逃掉自己的责任？我知道你们怎么想。你们觉得这场仗毫无意义，也不想为某个趾高气扬、根本不懂你们处境的贵族拼命。这都没错。可是多年以后，你坐在那里，逗着膝头上的孙子，他会问起你当年打仗的事。到时候，你就只能对那个小男孩撒谎了。%SPEECH_OFF% | %motivator%把手指含在唇间，吹出一声尖锐的口哨。逃兵们转向他，他随即开口。%SPEECH_ON%所以，就这样了？你们非要给自己背上这份愧疚？等那一天到了，你们要怎么对孩子说，嗯？说自己是个没出息的逃兵，丢下同袍，任他们替自己去死？别弄错了，因为你们不在，本不该死的人就会死。你们的缺席，会带来远超想象的后果！%SPEECH_OFF% | %motivator%朝逃兵们喊道。%SPEECH_ON%好啊，现在就走。丢下旗帜，就当这场仗打完了。可要是%feudfamily%赢了呢，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%一个逃兵耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%他们又不认识我。我要回家，陪家人种地。%SPEECH_OFF%%motivator%笑着摇头。%SPEECH_ON%是吗？那等那些外来兵闯进你家院子，你怎么办？等他们看见你的妻子，看见你的孩子，你怎么办？你到底以为这场仗是为什么打的？到时候，你连家都没得回，蠢货！%SPEECH_OFF%}{逃兵们无法达成一致，便决定投票。继续逃亡的选择占了多数。头领把这个众人表决的结果告诉你，向你告别。%commander%不会高兴，不过你已拔出剑，告诉他们，剩下就只有另一条路了。头领转过身，拔出刀刃，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，我就知道，你不会大老远赶来，只为听我们说声再见。弟兄们，拿起武器。%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%肯定会恼火，可逃兵们拒绝回去。他们觉得，没理由再跳进那场厮杀。你祝头领好运。他正要道谢，却见你拔出武器，%companyname%其余人也照做，顿时沉默下来。他叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，我就知道会这样。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。%SPEECH_ON%无关私人恩怨。你们想干什么，我不在乎。可这是一桩生意，我们得把它办到底。%SPEECH_OFF% | 逃兵们无法作出决定，便交给运气：头领取出一枚硬币，抛向空中。正面就回营，反面就继续离开。硬币落下，反面朝上。逃兵们齐齐松了口气，头领拍拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%命运已经替我们作了决定。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，拔出剑，战团其余人也随之亮出武器。%SPEECH_ON%等我们杀光你们的时候，也别忘了这句话。%SPEECH_OFF%头领勉强笑了笑，拔出刀刃。%SPEECH_ON%没关系。我们宁愿死在自由门前，也不想再回去受那份罪。%SPEECH_OFF% | 头领礼貌地拒绝回去。%SPEECH_ON%我们不是一时冲动才选这条路，佣兵。我们不会回去。%SPEECH_OFF%你命令%companyname%拔出武器。逃兵头领叹了口气，却也理解地点头。%SPEECH_ON%看来只能如此了。我们谈过，宁愿在自己选择的路上死在这里，也不愿奉某条狗的命令，死在别处。如今，这就是我们的一切。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸肩答道。%SPEECH_ON%对我们来说，只是生意。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f53020973ca79a0e2736.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{%randombrother% cleans his blade on the tabard of one of the corpses.%SPEECH_ON%Shame they went out that way. They could have lived. They had a choice.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and respond.%SPEECH_ON%They had death on all sides of them. They merely chose us as the executioner.%SPEECH_OFF% | The deserters are dead all around you. One is crawling along the ground, ever putting distance between himself and %commander%'s army. You crouch beside him, dagger in hand to finish the job. He laughs at you.%SPEECH_ON%No need to dirty the dirk, sellsword. Just give me time. That's all I g-got, augh.%SPEECH_OFF%A spurt of blood runs down his chin. His eyes narrow, staring straight, and he slowly sinks to the ground. You stand and tell the company to get ready to leave. | The last deserter is found leaning against a rock, his hands limp at his sides, both turned up like a beggar with plenty of business. There's blood running down his chest and legs and pooling about the ground. He stares at it.%SPEECH_ON%I'm alright, thanks for asking, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him you didn't say anything. He looks at you, genuinely confused.%SPEECH_ON%You didn't? Well then.%SPEECH_OFF%A moment later and he falls to a side, face frozen in that deadened way. | Some men fancy the hilarity of a doomed life. With all choices and freedom stripped from them, what else is there to do but laugh in the face of such cruel fate? Every deserter died with a look of absolute aplomb across their faces. | The last deserter alive is found staring at the sky. He pedals a hand in the air.%SPEECH_ON%Goddammit, I just wanna see one.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what it is he wishes to see. He laughs, a hearty chuckle quickly interrupted by a surge of pain.%SPEECH_ON%A bird. Oh, there's one. It's so big, so beautiful.%SPEECH_OFF%He points and you look up. A vulture cycles overhead. When you look back down, the man is dead.}
f53020973ca79a0e2736.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{%randombrother%在一具尸体的罩袍上擦净刀刃。%SPEECH_ON%死成这样，真可惜。他们本来能活的，是有得选的。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，答道。%SPEECH_ON%他们四面都是死路，只不过选了我们来行刑。%SPEECH_OFF% | 逃兵的尸体横七竖八地躺在你四周。还有一个人在地上爬，不肯停下，仿佛只想离%commander%的军队再远一点。你握着匕首在他身旁蹲下，准备送他一程。他却笑了。%SPEECH_ON%别弄脏刀了，佣兵。再给我一点时间。我只……只剩这个了，呃。%SPEECH_OFF%一口鲜血顺着他的下巴流下。他眯起眼睛，直直望着前方，慢慢伏倒在地。你站起身，叫战团准备离开。 | 你们找到最后一名逃兵时，他正靠着一块石头。双手无力地垂在身侧，掌心朝上，像个生意兴隆的乞丐。血从胸口和腿上流下，在地上汇成一摊。他盯着那摊血。%SPEECH_ON%我挺好的，多谢关心，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，你什么也没说。他看着你，脸上满是真切的困惑。%SPEECH_ON%没说？那好吧。%SPEECH_OFF%片刻后，他歪向一旁，面容定格成死人才有的僵冷模样。 | 有些人觉得，注定毁灭的一生实在可笑。选择也好，自由也罢，全被夺走之后，除了对着这残酷的命运大笑，还能做些什么？每个逃兵死去时，脸上都带着全然无惧的神情。 | 最后一名活着的逃兵正仰望天空，一只手在空中来回挥动。%SPEECH_ON%他妈的，我就想看见一只。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他想看什么。他开怀地笑起来，却立刻被一阵剧痛打断。%SPEECH_ON%一只鸟。噢，在那儿。真大，真漂亮。%SPEECH_OFF%他指了指，你抬起头。一只秃鹫正在头顶盘旋。等你再低头时，那人已经死了。}

b8efb7b9575fe154fb90.source: Unfortunate, but it had to be done.

e0679e097196276df0d3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{%commander% informs you that tomorrow is the big day. You return to your tent for a good and earned rest. | You return to %commander% and inform him of the news. He is very subdued, his thoughts consumed with what is coming tomorrow: a large and decisive battle. The day over, you decide to turn in and wait for morning. | You report to %commander%, but he hardly even responds. He's practically living in his battle maps.%SPEECH_ON%I'll see you tomorrow, mercenary. Get a good night's rest because you'll be needing it.%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander% welcomes you into his tent, but seemingly ignores your reports. Instead, he is focused in on his maps and is continuing debates with his lieutenants on tomorrow's battle plans. You decide to turn in and get a good night's rest. | %commander% nods to your reports, but is otherwise not really paying any attention to you. A bunch of battle maps are laid out on a table and his eyes are focused in on those instead. You understand it: tomorrow's the big battle and he has better things to think about. You decide to turn in for the night.}
e0679e097196276df0d3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{%commander%告诉你，明天就是决战之日。你返回帐篷，享受这份应得的安眠。 | 你回到%commander%处，报告消息。他十分沉默，心思全被明日将至的大规模决战占据。一天结束，你决定歇下，等待清晨。 | 你向%commander%汇报，可他几乎没有回应，整个人简直已钻进作战地图里。%SPEECH_ON%明天见，佣兵。好好睡一觉，你会需要的。%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%让你进帐，却似乎没在听报告。他专注地图，继续与副官们争论明日的作战计划。你决定回去，好好睡一觉。 | %commander%听报告时点了点头，可除此之外，几乎没注意你。桌上摊着多张作战地图，他的目光全在上面。你能理解，明天就是大战，他有更要紧的事要想。你决定今晚就此歇下。}

7700431f9d2c78cfb9f4.source: Rest well this night, for tomorrow battle awaits!
7700431f9d2c78cfb9f4.translation: 今晚好好休息，明天还有大战！

cc6fc33f8678af6fa0f2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%commander% walks before an assembly of his soldiers. Some idle with weary faces, having not slept through the night. Others still shake with the jitters. Their commander calls to them.%SPEECH_ON%Are you afraid? Are you scared? That's fine. I'd be worried if you weren't.%SPEECH_OFF%Scattered laughter lifts the mood. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%But right now I'm asking you not to be scared for your own hide, but instead to be scared for the lives of your countrymen, your families! They are who we fight for this day! Let us worry about ourselves tomorrow, for today we will be men!%SPEECH_OFF%The laughter turns into roaring cheers. | %commander% has his men assembled before him. Footmen, archers, reserves, all standing in a stiff wind. The commander looks them up and down.%SPEECH_ON%I know what you're thinking, 'What am I doing fighting for this sorry git. If he's so noble, where's his high horse to stand on?'%SPEECH_OFF%The soldiers laugh, easing some tension. %commander% continues.%SPEECH_ON%Well, ugly sod or not, I like nothing better than a good fight. And that's where I'll be, men. I'll be in there with you, fighting until I can't, fighting until the very end, because that is what a fighter is supposed to do!%SPEECH_OFF%The soldiers raise their arms and cheer. Their commander turns around, sword raised.%SPEECH_ON%Now follow me, and we'll show %feudfamily% what it is to be men!%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%'s motley army has come together for the big battle. Walking up and down the battle lines, the commander starts in on a speech.%SPEECH_ON%Some of y'all looked sapped of sleep. What are you, nervous? Me too! Didn't sleep a wink.%SPEECH_OFF%This loosens some of the men up. It is good to know you are not alone, whether in flesh or spirit. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%But I am awake for today, for this fight. I wouldn't miss it for the world. So rub that sleep from your eyes men, for today we show those %feudfamily% bastards they should have stayed in their beds!%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander% addresses his readying men. You don't listen to a word of it. Instead, you prepare your men for the coming fight. | You watch as %commander% goes to his men and peppers them with lines of inspiration. Many you've heard before. In fact, did these lines come from some scroll of old? A motivational speaker whose energy has been passed down through the generations? %randombrother% comes up to you chuckling.%SPEECH_ON%I know that commander speaks empty rhetoric, yet I feel compelled to do a pushup or two anyway.%SPEECH_OFF%Laughing, you tell the man to get in line with the rest of the company. He barbs back.%SPEECH_ON%Will there be a speech?%SPEECH_OFF%You push the man as he turns laughing. | %commander% walks up and down his battle lines. He comes to a boy who is shaking so hard his armor is rattling.%SPEECH_ON%You remind me of myself, kid, you know that? You think I haven't been where you are? Heh, take it easy, because someday you might be where I am.%SPEECH_OFF%The kid looks up with a new glint in his eye. He steadies himself and nods determinedly. The commander raises his voice, barking at his men to prepare for the battle of their lives. | %commander% goes about his men, yelling out that this battle is the most important event that they will ever experience in their lives. You're not so sure, but what is sure is that it will be the last thing many of them will ever experience. The cruelties of war don't make for the best of motivation, though, so you keep your mouth shut. | You tighten your boots as %commander% readies his men with a big, pompous speech about the grand importance of a war between the noble houses. It's very convincing. It has to be, if men with nothing to gain from fighting are going to be doing the dying. | %commander% comes to stand in front of his men. He's attired in spectacular battle garments, standing astride his men like a pearl among beach sands. He explains that they must win the battle, for losing it might just as well lose the entire war. He's saying anything to get the men invested, you think. You sure as shit wouldn't die for dainty nobility just because some honor-seeking commander divined it from political spirits. Then again, that attitude is why you're a mercenary to begin with. | War is a hell of a thing. How does one sell a man on it? %commander% does his best, pontificating on numerous subjects as he addresses his men. First, he states that it is the honorable thing to do. Then he states that they are many soldiers here, no doubt increasing the odds that some other schmuck will die instead of you. Health in numbers! Then he argues that losing this battle might mean losing their wives, their children, their country. This last number seems to work the best as the men roar with anger and energy. Through the now cheering crowd of soldiers, you can easily spot the cynics and sodomites. | %commander% addresses his men with a deep, strong tone.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, some of you are looking very giddy. Can't wait to slaughter %feudfamily%'s men, huh? I know that feeling.%SPEECH_OFF%A scattering of nervous laughter. The commander continues.%SPEECH_ON%Keep your families in mind, men, for they are surely depending upon us this day!%SPEECH_OFF%}
cc6fc33f8678af6fa0f2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%commander%从集结的士兵面前走过。有人一夜未眠，满脸疲惫地站着；有人仍紧张得发抖。指挥官向他们喊道。%SPEECH_ON%害怕吗？胆怯吗？没关系。你们要是一点都不怕，我倒该担心了。%SPEECH_OFF%零星的笑声让气氛轻松了一些。他继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%但现在，我要你们担心的不是自己的小命，而是同胞和家人的性命！今天，我们是为他们而战！自己的事，留到明天再操心。今天，我们要做顶天立地的汉子！%SPEECH_OFF%笑声化作震耳欲聋的欢呼。 | %commander%把部队集合在面前。步兵、弓箭手、预备队，全都立在劲风中。指挥官打量着他们。%SPEECH_ON%我知道你们在想什么：‘我干吗要替这个窝囊废打仗？他不是贵族吗，怎么没骑着高头大马，在上头摆架子？’%SPEECH_OFF%士兵们笑了，紧绷的气氛稍稍缓和。%commander%继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，不管我是不是个丑八怪，我这辈子最喜欢的就是痛痛快快打一仗。弟兄们，我会去的地方，就是战场。我会和你们一起战斗，直到再也打不动，直到最后一刻。因为一个战士，就该如此！%SPEECH_OFF%士兵们举臂欢呼。指挥官转过身，高举长剑。%SPEECH_ON%现在，跟我来！让%feudfamily%看看，什么才叫汉子！%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%麾下这支成分混杂的军队已经集结，准备迎接大战。指挥官沿着阵线来回走动，开始训话。%SPEECH_ON%有些人看着没睡够啊。怎么，紧张？我也紧张！一宿没合眼。%SPEECH_OFF%有些士兵听后放松下来。知道有人和自己一样，无论处境还是心情，总是件好事。他继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%但今天，我醒着，就等这一仗。天塌下来我都不会错过。所以，弟兄们，把眼里的睡意揉掉！今天，我们要让%feudfamily%的杂种们明白，他们就该老老实实待在被窝里！%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%正在向备战的士兵训话。你一个字也没听，而是忙着让自己的弟兄准备迎战。 | 你看着%commander%走到士兵面前，接连抛出鼓舞人心的话。许多句子你早就听过。说起来，这些话是不是抄自某卷古老文书？某个善于煽动人心的演说家，竟把那股热乎劲一代代传了下来？%randombrother%笑着凑到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%我知道那指挥官说的全是空话，可还是忍不住想趴下做一两个俯卧撑。%SPEECH_OFF%你笑着让他回战团的队列里去。他又揶揄了一句。%SPEECH_ON%咱们也要训话吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他笑着转身，你顺手推了他一把。 | %commander%沿着阵线来回巡视，走到一个少年面前。那孩子抖得太厉害，连铠甲都在哗啦作响。%SPEECH_ON%小子，你让我想起了年轻时的自己，知道吗？你以为我没像你这样过？嘿，放轻松。说不定哪天，你也能站到我这个位置上。%SPEECH_OFF%少年抬起头，眼里多了一丝光亮。他稳住身子，坚定地点点头。指挥官提高嗓门，吼着让士兵们准备迎接他们一生中最重要的战斗。 | %commander%在士兵间走动，高声宣称，这一仗将是他们一生中最重要的经历。你不太肯定这话是否属实，但能肯定的是，对很多人来说，这会是他们最后的经历。不过，战争的残酷并不适合用来鼓舞士气，所以你闭口不言。 | 你勒紧靴带，%commander%则用一番冠冕堂皇的长篇演说，向士兵们阐述贵族家族之间这场战争的重大意义。听上去很有说服力。必须得有说服力才行，毕竟要那些打赢也捞不到好处的人去送死。 | %commander%来到士兵们面前。他穿着华丽的战袍，立在人群中，仿佛沙滩里的一颗珍珠。他解释说，这场战斗必须取胜，因为一旦输了，整场战争很可能就输了。你心想，只要能让士兵死心塌地，他什么话都说得出来。你可不会因为某个渴望荣誉的指挥官，揣摩出一套政治上的神谕，就他妈去替娇贵的贵族送死。话说回来，也正因如此，你才当了佣兵。 | 战争真他妈不是个好东西。该怎么说服一个人投身其中？%commander%竭尽所能，对士兵们夸夸其谈，各种道理轮番上阵。先说参战是光荣之举，又说这里兵多将广，你死不了，倒霉的多半是别人。人多保命嘛！接着，他声称一旦战败，大家可能失去妻儿，失去家园。最后这番话似乎最管用，士兵们满怀怒火与斗志，吼声震天。在欢呼的人群里，你倒很容易认出那些愤世嫉俗的家伙，以及只对男人感兴趣的人。 | %commander%用低沉有力的声音向士兵们训话。%SPEECH_ON%啊，有些人看起来兴奋得不得了。等不及要宰了%feudfamily%的士兵，是吧？这种心情我懂。%SPEECH_OFF%人群里响起几声紧张的笑。指挥官继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，想想你们的家人。今天，他们的安危可全都系在我们身上！%SPEECH_OFF%}

d8ddc4548ad98a399e1f.source: Onwards, brothers, there's a battle to be won!
d8ddc4548ad98a399e1f.translation: 前进，弟兄们！还有一场仗等着我们去赢！

1bffcc861c302d711c36.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_86.png[/img]{Dead bodies everywhere. The silhouette of %commander% atop the corpses, his armor glinting, a shiny encasement of a fleshen ruin. %employer% will no doubt be saddened by the loss of the battle here, but there is nothing more that can be done. | The battle is lost! %commander%'s men have been slain to a scattering of survivors and the commander himself has been struck down. Vultures are already cycling overhead and %feudfamily%'s men steadily work through the mounds of bodies to kill off any man pretending to be dead. You quickly gather the remnants of the %companyname% to retreat. %employer% will no doubt be horrified by the results here, but there's nothing that can be done now.}
1bffcc861c302d711c36.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_86.png[/img]{尸体遍地。%commander%的身影躺在尸堆之上，盔甲闪亮，包着一团破碎血肉。%employer%无疑会因这场败仗而悲痛，可已经无力挽回。 | 战败了！%commander%的部下被杀得只剩零星幸存者，指挥官本人也已倒下。秃鹫开始在头顶盘旋，%feudfamily%的士兵则不紧不慢地翻查尸堆，杀死每一个装死的人。你赶紧收拢%companyname%的残部撤退。%employer%无疑会被这结果震惊，可如今已无能为力。}

169068fff0d87e90167f.source: Not every battle can be won...

40496366cc5580b3ebd5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{You've triumphed! Well, you and %commander%'s men both. The battle has been won, that's what is most important. You step over the mounds of bodies to prepare a return to your employer. | Corpses in piles five deep. Vultures plucking morsels from the mounds. Wounded begging for help. Surely, to a stranger's eye, there does not appear to be any winner here. %commander%, however, comes over with a wide grin.%SPEECH_ON%{Good work, sellsword! You should get on back to your employer and tell him what's happened here. | Well if it isn't the sellsword. Wasn't sure if you'd make it. You should get on back to your employer and tell him what happened here.}%SPEECH_OFF% | A wounded man begs at your feet. You can't tell if he's one of %commander%'s or an enemy. Suddenly, a spearhead jets in and pierces the man through the head, leaving him permanently side-eyed. You look over to see the killer tenting his hands atop the spear with an accomplished look on his face. He points a finger.%SPEECH_ON%You're that sellsword, right? %commander% told me to tell you that you should head on back to your employer. That sound right to you?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. A groan rises from the piles of corpses. The man picks his spear back up, catching it in his other hand.%SPEECH_ON%Whelp, back to it!%SPEECH_OFF% | The battle over, you find %commander% roaring and ripping off his armor and undershirt. He shows off his wounds, flexing so they open agape like seeping rinds of freshly cut fruit. He demands his men to do the same, turning each around so that he can see their back.%SPEECH_ON%You see, good warriors like us carry our wounds here, here, and here...%SPEECH_OFF%He points to every spot on the front of his body, and then he points to his back.%SPEECH_ON%But here, no man carries an injury here. Because we die going forward, not one step back! Isn't that right?%SPEECH_OFF%The men cheer, though some are woozy on their feet, blood trickling from their injuries. You ignore the theatrics and gather the men of the %companyname%. Your employer will surely be happy to hear of the results here and that's all you really care about. | %commander% greets you after the battle. He's drenched in blood as if he cut someone's head off and bathed beneath the spewing trunk. A white stroke of teeth glimmers when he smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Now that is what I call a fight.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if he'd say the same had he lost. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, the cynic are we? No, I had no intention of losing here and, if I did, I had no intention of being alive to witness my own defeat.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and respond.%SPEECH_ON%Rare is the man who gets to still be around to see his greatest defeat. It was good fighting with you, commander, but I must return to your employer now.%SPEECH_OFF%The commander nods and then turns around, yelling for someone to fetch him a towel. | You find %commander% squatting over a wounded enemy soldier. He's running a dagger along the poor man's chest, back and forth, scraping it along the armor. The commander looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%What do you think, sellsword? Should I let him live?%SPEECH_OFF%The prisoner stares at you, he juts his head forward, blinking hard. You suppose this is a 'yes.' You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%That is not up to me. Look, it was good fighting with you, but I must return to your employer now.%SPEECH_OFF%%commander% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Be seeing you, then.%SPEECH_OFF%As you leave, the commander is still back there hunched beside his prisoner, the blade clinking as it goes back and forth, back and forth, back and forth. | You find %commander% punching a dagger into the side of a wounded man's chest. The felled enemy seizes to the pain, but he quickly fades thereafter, going limp in mere moments. A gush of blood follows the blade's retrieval as the commander wipes it on his pantleg.%SPEECH_ON%Right to the heart, quick and easy. What man could hope for better?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell the commander that you are returning to your employer for your pay. | You watch as %commander% and a troop of soldiers bandy about the battlefield, killing any wounded enemies they discover. %randombrother% asks if we should report to the commander. You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%No. We report to your employer. To hell with this place, let's go get paid.%SPEECH_OFF% | The battlefield is littered with the dead and those who wish they were. %commander%'s men go about collecting their wounded and killing any enemies they find. The commander himself claps you on the shoulder, a fleck of blood splattering your cheek.%SPEECH_ON%Good work, sellsword. I wasn't sure if your men would hold their end of the bargain, but you damn well did. Your employer should be very happy to see you, I believe.%SPEECH_OFF% | You go around gathering the men of the %companyname%. %commander% comes to you, wiping a cloth over a sword, blood washing off in thick gobs.%SPEECH_ON%Leaving so soon?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Your employer is the one who is paying us, so to him we go.%SPEECH_OFF%The commander sheathes his weapon and nods back.%SPEECH_ON%Makes sense. Good fightin' with you, sellsword. A shame I couldn't have you in my outfit. Guess you blokes gotta keep chasing that coin, huh?%SPEECH_OFF%}
40496366cc5580b3ebd5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{你赢了！好吧，是你和%commander%的军队一起赢了。最要紧的是，这一仗打赢了。你跨过堆积的尸体，准备回去见雇主。 | 尸体堆了足足五层，秃鹫在尸堆上啄食，伤者苦苦求救。在一个陌生人眼里，这里恐怕根本没有赢家。然而，%commander%却满脸笑容地走了过来。%SPEECH_ON%{干得好，佣兵！你该回去见雇主，把这里的事告诉他。 | 哟，这不是那个佣兵吗。我还真拿不准你能不能活下来。回去见雇主吧，把这里的事告诉他。}%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个伤员在你脚边哀求。你分不清他是%commander%的手下，还是敌军。突然，一截矛尖刺来，贯穿了他的脑袋，让那双眼睛永远歪向了一边。你转头看去，杀人者正双手搭在矛杆顶端，脸上一副大功告成的神情。他伸出一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%你就是那个佣兵，对吧？%commander%让我告诉你，该回去见雇主了。是这么回事吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。尸堆里传出一声呻吟，那人重新提起长矛，换到另一只手里。%SPEECH_ON%得，接着干活！%SPEECH_OFF% | 战斗结束后，你看到%commander%正大吼着扯掉铠甲和贴身衣服，炫耀身上的伤口。他绷紧肌肉，伤口便跟着咧开，像刚切开的水果，沿着切口渗出汁液。他命令手下照做，还把每个人都转过身去，检查他们的后背。%SPEECH_ON%看见没有，我们这样的好战士，伤都在这里、这里，还有这里……%SPEECH_OFF%他指遍身前各处，随后又指了指后背。%SPEECH_ON%但这里，没有一个人的伤在这里。因为我们宁可向前战死，也绝不后退一步！对不对？%SPEECH_OFF%士兵们大声欢呼，尽管有些人已经站立不稳，伤口还在滴血。你懒得理会这场表演，开始集合%companyname%的弟兄。雇主听到战果一定会高兴，而你真正关心的只有这个。 | 战后，%commander%过来向你打招呼。他浑身浴血，仿佛刚砍掉谁的脑袋，又站在喷血的躯干下面冲了个澡。他一笑，一排白牙便闪了出来。%SPEECH_ON%这才叫打仗。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，要是输了，他还会不会这么说。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%哦，还挺爱泼冷水？不会。我压根没打算输，就算输了，也没打算活着见证自己的失败。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头答道。%SPEECH_ON%能活着目睹自己一生最惨败仗的人，本就不多。指挥官，与你并肩作战很愉快，但我现在得回去见雇主了。%SPEECH_OFF%指挥官点点头，转身大喊，让人给他拿条毛巾。 | 你看到%commander%正蹲在一名受伤的敌兵身旁。他拿匕首在那可怜人的胸前来回划动，刀锋刮擦着铠甲。指挥官抬头看向你。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你觉得呢？该不该留他一命？%SPEECH_OFF%俘虏死死盯着你，脑袋向前探，使劲眨眼。你猜，这意思是“该”。你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%这事不由我做主。听着，并肩打这一仗很愉快，但我得回去见雇主了。%SPEECH_OFF%%commander%点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%那就后会有期。%SPEECH_OFF%你离开时，指挥官仍弓着身子蹲在俘虏旁边，刀锋叮叮作响，来来回回，来来回回，来来回回。 | 你看到%commander%把匕首猛地捅进一名伤员的胸侧。倒地的敌人痛得浑身抽搐，却很快失去气力，片刻便瘫软下来。指挥官拔出匕首，鲜血随之涌出。他把刀在裤腿上擦了擦。%SPEECH_ON%直入心脏，干净利落。还能指望什么更好的死法呢？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，告诉指挥官，你要回雇主那里领钱了。 | 你看着%commander%带一队士兵在战场上来回搜寻，见到受伤的敌人就杀。%randombrother%问，要不要去向指挥官报到。你摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不用。我们只向雇主交差。让这个鬼地方见鬼去吧，走，领钱去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 战场上横七竖八地躺满了死人，以及巴不得自己已经死去的人。%commander%的士兵四处收拢己方伤员，遇上敌人就补上一刀。指挥官本人拍了拍你的肩，一滴血溅到了你的脸颊上。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，佣兵。我本来还担心，你的人能不能履行约定。结果你们真他妈做到了。我想，雇主见到你一定会很高兴。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你四处集合%companyname%的弟兄。%commander%一边用布擦剑，一边走过来，浓稠的血污被一块块抹下。%SPEECH_ON%这么快就走？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%付钱的是雇主，我们自然要去找他。%SPEECH_OFF%指挥官收剑入鞘，也点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%有道理。佣兵，和你一起打仗很痛快。可惜没法把你留在我的队伍里。你们这些家伙，总得追着钱跑，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%}

b348d83078dfc298bf22.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You find %employer% drunk as a skunk. He stares at you over the lip of a cup and speaks in the bowl of it before drinking.%SPEECH_ON%Ah hell, you're back.%SPEECH_OFF%The cup falls away as he swallows. You quickly report of your success. The man smiles although he's so drunk he almost looks confused.%SPEECH_ON%Then it is done. Victory is mine. That is what I wanted. I hope too many didn't die doing what I wanted.%SPEECH_OFF%He breaks into laughter. One of his guards hands you a satchel and ushers you out of the room. | %employer% welcomes you with a satchel of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%{Victory is ours. Thank you, sellsword. | Hell of a job out there, sellsword. Victory belongs to us and we have, in part, you to thank for that. Your %reward_completion% crowns is right here. | What was it, %reward_completion% crowns? A small price to pay for defeating that army and bringing us one step closer to ending this war. | My little birds told me you did well out there, sellsword. Of course, they also tell me that the army of %feudfamily% is in retreat. What more could I ask for? Your %reward_completion% crowns, as promised.}%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% barking orders at his commanders. Seeing you, he quickly points your way.%SPEECH_ON%See this man right here? He's a man that gets things done. Guards! Hand him %reward_completion% crowns. If only I could pay you sorry dogs to do half as good of a job as him!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found in his garden telling jokes to a group of women. You break into their group, soaked in blood, covered in mud. The women gasp and step away. %employer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, the sellsword returns! You're such a lady's man, mercenary. I wish I could offer one of these fine women to you, but I'm afraid their fathers would have your nuts if you even so much as touched one.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the ladies runs a hand along her bosom.%SPEECH_ON%He can touch me if he likes.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% laughs again.%SPEECH_ON%Oh dear, haven't you already gotten enough men in trouble? Run along, ladies, and tell one of my guards to fetch a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% trying to train his cat to shake.%SPEECH_ON%Look at this little bugger. He won't even meet my eyes! And when I feed him, he behaves as though it was expected of me. I could punt this little fark out that damn window if I wanted.%SPEECH_OFF%You respond.%SPEECH_ON%It'd land on its feet.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman nods.%SPEECH_ON%That's the damnedest part.%SPEECH_OFF%Your employer picks the resilient cat up and throws it out the window. He claps his hands before giving you a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Sorry if I seem preoccupied. You did well out there. %feudfamily%'s army in retreat and I couldn't possibly ask for more these days.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% having an impromptu trial for one of his commanders. You're not sure what it is over, but the commander's chin is high and defiant. When it's over, he's roughed up and taken outside. %employer% beckons you to him.%SPEECH_ON%{Thank you, mercenary. Victory is ours and I'm not sure that could have been the case without your help. Of course, your reward of %reward_completion% crowns, as agreed upon. | The man refused my orders, it is what it is. You, however, performed exemplarily! Your %reward_completion% crowns, as agreed upon. | That man would not fight for me. Said he wouldn't raise a sword against his half-brother who fights for the enemy. What a crock. You did well, sellsword. Your %reward_completion% crowns, as promised.}%SPEECH_OFF% | You return to %employer% who is in the middle of a line of commanders.%SPEECH_ON%{Thank you, mercenary. Victory belongs to us now. Your %reward_completion% crowns, as agreed upon. | The war goes on, but the end is perhaps nigh because of you. With the enemy army in full retreat, we are one step closer to ending this damned thing once and for all. Your %reward_completion% crowns are crowns well-earned, sellsword.}%SPEECH_OFF% | One of %employer%'s guards stops you from getting close. He carries a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns which are quickly handed over.%SPEECH_ON%My liege tells me that you did well in battle.%SPEECH_OFF%The guard looks around awkwardly.%SPEECH_ON%That... that was all I was supposed to say.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you into his war room which has been emptied of his commanders.%SPEECH_ON%Good seeing you, sellsword. As I'm sure you're aware, the army of %feudfamily% is already in retreat. Who knows if we could have done it without you. %reward_completion% crowns just for you, as agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is feeding a tall, dumb looking bird. You've never seen a bird of that proportion before and so keep your distance. An amused nobleman talks as he lets the creature eat out of his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Nothing to fear here, sellsword. Just so you know, I already have word of your doings. The army of %feudfamily% is in retreat and so we're stepping ever closer to ending this damned war. That guard yonder, the one holding the satchel, has your %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%The bird flaps its wings and squawks as you leave. | You find %employer% hanging out at a man-made pond. He's scooping up frogs with a gentle hand. The slimy critters squirm and jump away.%SPEECH_ON%Victory belongs to us. I'd say that is a job well done, sellsword.
