I gave you a huge opportunity and you really... jumped, on it.%SPEECH_OFF%You must have visibly cringed for the nobleman quickly gets to his feet, wiping his hands on his pants.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, that wasn't so bad, was it? Well, the guard yonder has your payment of %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b348d83078dfc298bf22.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你找到%employer%时，他已经醉得一塌糊涂。他从杯沿上方望着你，朝杯肚说了句话，随即喝酒。%SPEECH_ON%啊，见鬼，你回来了。%SPEECH_OFF%咽下酒，他放低杯子，你迅速报告成功的消息。他笑了，可醉得太厉害，看起来倒像在困惑。%SPEECH_ON%那就结束了。胜利属于我。这就是我要的。希望没太多人为了办成我想办的事而死。%SPEECH_OFF%他放声大笑。一名守卫把钱袋交给你，引你离开房间。 | %employer%拿着一袋克朗迎接你。%SPEECH_ON%{胜利属于我们。谢谢你，佣兵。 | 干得真漂亮，佣兵。胜利属于我们，其中有一份功劳归你。你的%reward_completion%克朗就在这里。 | 多少来着，%reward_completion%克朗？能击败那支军队，让我们离结束战争更近一步，这点代价算得了什么。 | 我的小鸟说，你在战场上干得不错，佣兵。当然，它们还说，%feudfamily%的军队正在撤退。我还能奢求什么？按约定，这是你的%reward_completion%克朗。}%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在向指挥官们厉声下令。看见你，他立刻伸手指来。%SPEECH_ON%看见这个人了吗？这才是能办事的人。守卫！给他%reward_completion%克朗。要是花钱就能让你们这群窝囊废，有他一半能干，那该多好！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在花园里给一群女人讲笑话。你满身血污、浑身泥泞，闯进人群。女人们惊呼着退开。%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵回来了！你可真招姑娘喜欢。我真想把其中一位佳人送给你，只怕你碰她们一下，她们的父亲就会要了你的命根子。%SPEECH_OFF%一个女人用手抚过胸前。%SPEECH_ON%他愿意的话，可以碰我。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%又笑了。%SPEECH_ON%噢，亲爱的，被你害得惹上麻烦的男人还不够多吗？去吧，姑娘们，顺便叫个守卫，拿一袋%reward_completion%克朗来。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正想教猫握手。%SPEECH_ON%看看这个小混账，连眼睛都不肯看我！我喂它，它还一副理所当然的样子。我要愿意，一脚就能把这小王八蛋踢出窗外。%SPEECH_OFF%你答道。%SPEECH_ON%它会四脚着地的。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族点头。%SPEECH_ON%最气人的就是这个。%SPEECH_OFF%雇主抱起那只耐摔的猫，扔出窗外，拍拍手，随后递给你一袋%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_ON%抱歉，有些分心。你在战场上干得很好。%feudfamily%的军队正在撤退，如今我实在没什么可奢求的了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正临时审判一名指挥官。你不知道缘由，可那指挥官高昂着下巴，毫不服软。审判结束，他挨了一顿粗暴对待，便被押了出去。%employer%招手让你过去。%SPEECH_ON%{谢谢你，佣兵。胜利属于我们，没有你的帮助，结果还真不好说。当然，这是约好的报酬，%reward_completion%克朗。 | 那人违抗命令，事情就是这样。至于你，表现堪称楷模！你的%reward_completion%克朗，按约定支付。 | 那人不肯为我作战，说不能向敌军里那个同父或同母的兄弟拔剑。真是扯淡。你干得不错，佣兵。这是答应你的%reward_completion%克朗。}%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回去见%employer%，他正站在一排指挥官中间。%SPEECH_ON%{谢谢你，佣兵。如今胜利属于我们。你的%reward_completion%克朗，和约好的一样。 | 战争还在继续，可因为你，终点也许已经不远。敌军全面撤退，我们离彻底结束这场该死的战争，又近了一步。这%reward_completion%克朗，你挣得实至名归，佣兵。}%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的一名守卫拦住你，不让你靠近。他提着一袋%reward_completion%克朗，迅速交到你手里。%SPEECH_ON%领主说，您在战场上表现很好。%SPEECH_OFF%守卫尴尬地环顾四周。%SPEECH_ON%就……他只让我说这些。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%请你进入作战室，指挥官们已被遣走。%SPEECH_ON%见到你真好，佣兵。想必你已经知道，%feudfamily%的军队正在撤退。没有你，我们能不能办到，谁也说不准。按约定，%reward_completion%克朗，专门给你的。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正在喂一只又高又呆的大鸟。你从没见过这种体型的鸟，便留了些距离。贵族觉得有趣，一边让那东西啄食掌中食物，一边开口。%SPEECH_ON%没什么可怕的，佣兵。告诉你，你做的事，我已经听说了。%feudfamily%的军队正在撤退，我们离结束这场该死的战争越来越近。那边那个提钱袋的守卫，拿着你的%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%你离开时，大鸟扑打翅膀，嘎嘎叫了起来。 | 你在一处人工池塘边找到%employer%。他轻轻捧起青蛙，黏滑的小东西扭动着，又跳开了。%SPEECH_ON%胜利属于我们。要我说，这活干得漂亮，佣兵。我给了你一个大好机会，而你真是……一跃而上，抓住了它。%SPEECH_OFF%你脸上的难受想必相当明显，贵族立刻站起，把手往裤子上擦。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼，这笑话没那么差吧？好吧，那边的守卫拿着你的报酬，%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%}

21ac01b45a07ddc6f824.source: A caravan with armed escorts transporting provisions, supplies and equipment between settlements.
21ac01b45a07ddc6f824.translation: 一支配有武装护卫的商队，在聚落间运送粮食、补给和装备。

27fa5fe866f962bc5d68.source: Move to %holysite% and defend it against southern heathens
27fa5fe866f962bc5d68.translation: 前往%holysite%，抵御南方异教徒的进攻

acae3f2fd70671416a6d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%Dune rune bastards.%SPEECH_OFF%This is the first thing you hear upon entering %employer%'s room. He begrudgingly waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%The war with the South continues, but they've taken it upon themselves to break bonds of unspoken agreements: they're moving on %holysite% and I've no means to protect it. I'm not one to dally on how important the grounds are, but if I were to let it slide the public will undoubtedly clip my nuts. Being that I quite like my balls, I'll put %reward% crowns on the table for you to go there and defend %holysite%.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% trying to talk his way over a throng of peasants. It appears news has arrived that Southern soldiers are approaching %holysite%.%SPEECH_ON%We've unspoken rules that these sacred grounds, they're, they're... they're sacred!%SPEECH_OFF%Seeing you, the nobleman clears a path, announcing you as brave warriors that he beckoned a week ago. When he gets near, however, he shelters his voice in a whisper.%SPEECH_ON%These idiots don't need to know you're sellswords. Look, the Southerners jammed a stick far up my ass on this one. The savages truly are making a move on %holysite% and I need you to get there and stop them. %reward% crowns should be sufficient for this task, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%}
acae3f2fd70671416a6d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%那帮在沙丘上鬼画符的杂种。%SPEECH_OFF%刚走进%employer%的房间，你就听见这么一句。他不情不愿地招手，让你进来。%SPEECH_ON%与南方的战争还没打完，他们倒先坏了彼此心照不宣的规矩：他们正朝%holysite%进军，而我手里没有兵力守那里。我懒得跟你细说那地方有多重要，只知道，真放任不管，百姓肯定要把我的蛋割下来。我还挺舍不得这两个宝贝，所以，我愿意出%reward%克朗，请你去守住%holysite%。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正扯着嗓子，想压过一群农民的叫嚷。看来，南方士兵逼近%holysite%的消息已经传到了这里。%SPEECH_ON%大家有不成文的规矩！这些神圣的地方，它们……它们……它们是神圣的！%SPEECH_OFF%看见你，贵族挤开人群，宣布你们就是他一周前召来的英勇战士。可一凑到你身边，他便压低了声音。%SPEECH_ON%不必让这些蠢货知道你们是佣兵。听着，南方人这回可是把棍子捅进我屁眼里了。那些野蛮人真的要进攻%holysite%，我需要你赶过去拦住他们。%reward%克朗，办这件事应该够了吧？%SPEECH_OFF%}

318e9312c54bc72dcadb.source: {The %companyname% can help you with this. | Defending against a southern host better pay well. | I'm interested, go on.}
318e9312c54bc72dcadb.translation: {%companyname%能帮你办这件事。 | 抵挡南方大军，报酬最好够高。 | 我有兴趣，继续说。}

258525382ee9a6ed2149.source: {This isn't worth it. | We're needed elsewhere. | I won't risk the company against southern machines of war.}
258525382ee9a6ed2149.translation: {不值得。 | 别处还有事等着我们。 | 我不会让战团冒险迎战南方的战争机器。}

de5bdc525af6313daea0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{The great caldera has been mostly emptied of its faithful and curious occupants. Even the slightest suggestion of war has dispersed believers back to the shelters of their respective priories. After all, there will be a winner and a loser in the hours to come. A certain level of vigor may entreat the former to overindulging themselves on righteousness...}
de5bdc525af6313daea0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{巨大的火山口里，信众和好奇的访客大多已经离去。哪怕只露出一点战争迹象，也足以让他们返回各自修道院避难。毕竟，几个时辰后便会分出胜负，而某种狂热，很可能让胜者放纵于“正义”之名……}

b209fe6d394e258deee8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{The Oracle isn't as you last remember it: many of the faithful have departed and the drums of war have come to the ancient temple's doorstep. Not that it matters. You've no visions to seek here, no dreams to unwind, only nightmares to provide your enemies.}
b209fe6d394e258deee8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{The Oracle已不同于你记忆中的模样：许多信徒散去，战鼓敲到了古老神殿的门前。不过无所谓，你来这里既不求启示，也不解梦，只准备给敌人一场噩梦。}

e1984ae1258ef490163f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{Ironically, the leveled city which dwells beneath the half-blown mountain finally feels eerily abandoned. Few of the faithful linger, the rest having departed long before the religious strife arrives upon their tent cities and spiritual interloping.}
e1984ae1258ef490163f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{讽刺的是，这座位于残破山体之下、早已夷平的城，如今终于显出令人不安的荒凉。只剩少数信徒逗留，其他人早在宗教冲突波及他们的帐篷聚落与寻灵之旅前，就已经离去。}

71389ccf5ee804484295.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{You believe you have made a modest defense out of what positions %holysite% can give. With what little time remains, there's probably at least one serious task you can set the %companyname% to completing. It's just a question of what exactly would suit the company best.}
71389ccf5ee804484295.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{利用%holysite%现有的地势，你自认已布置起一条还算像样的防线。时间所剩不多，不过至少还能让%companyname%完成一项要紧事务。只需决定，做什么最合适。}

0c91245aab80de4ccfa2.source: Build palisades to further bolster the walls!
0c91245aab80de4ccfa2.translation: 修筑木栅，进一步加固城墙！

0eaa29d74a613ccb18de.source: Search these grounds for anything that could be of use to us!
0eaa29d74a613ccb18de.translation: 搜遍这片地方，找找有什么能派上用场！

faea1db35cfaa468708c.source: Recruit some of the faithful to help us in the defense!
faea1db35cfaa468708c.translation: 招募一些信徒，协助我们防守！

00c6f174ec764f2eee5a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{Looting the holy site itself, which you'll tell no one of your doing, and pilfering through the abandoned belongings of the faithful, you manage to scrap together enough wood to reinforce a set of walls that ring a corner of %holysite%. It is in your estimation the best spot for an attacker to come in, and thus the one you'll want to defend most.}
00c6f174ec764f2eee5a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{你们从圣地本身拆取材料——这事当然不会告诉任何人——又翻遍信徒丢下的家当，总算凑齐木材，加固了围住%holysite%一角的几段墙。你判断，那里最利于敌人攻入，因此也是最该严守之处。}

65d3495e85ef9ae89afc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{You have the men scour the area for battle supplies. A litany of items are pilfered and piled. Once the whole of %holysite% has been combed, you and the men spend a few minutes figuring out what would be of most use...}
65d3495e85ef9ae89afc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{你命令弟兄们搜寻作战物资。各种东西被翻出来，堆成一团。等整个%holysite%都搜遍，你们又花了几分钟，挑选最能派上用场的物件……}

4f7e4be24663e5b25727.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{What few faithful still linger around the %holysite% must be the most fervid and zealous. Being that you are here representing the north, you have the men pick out a few hardy looking old gods zealots and ask that they fight for their gods. It is a convenient recruiting tool if there ever was one, and they are quick to arm themselves and undergo the shortest of training. You can only hope they are of any use in the actual battle to come.}
4f7e4be24663e5b25727.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{仍留在%holysite%附近的少数信徒，想必是最狂热虔诚的一批。既然你代表北方而来，便让弟兄们挑出几个身板结实的旧神信众，请他们为诸神而战。这招募办法再方便不过，他们很快武装起来，接受了最简短的训练。只盼真正开战时，能派上点用场。}

e7d4d12c8cfb71c0bfec.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{The southerners appear over the horizon. Followers of the Gilded One is an apt description for their armor glints and shines even at great distance. %randombrother% spits and looks over.%SPEECH_ON%They look far too dapper for a buncha dead men. You ever wonder if we just dressed ourselves like a buncha djinn and rode out with all the confidence of little devils them southerners would just up and leave?%SPEECH_OFF%Smiling, you draw out your sword and command the men to battle.}
e7d4d12c8cfb71c0bfec.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{南方人出现在地平线上。称他们为镀金者的信徒，倒真贴切，隔着老远都能看见甲胄闪耀。%randombrother%啐了一口，望向他们。%SPEECH_ON%一群快死的人，打扮得倒够体面。你说，咱们要是扮成一群精怪，再拿出小恶魔那股神气冲过去，南方人会不会掉头就跑？%SPEECH_OFF%你笑着拔剑，命令众人迎战。}

569547437dda00d8bade.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_158.png[/img]{Leaving %townname%, you're approached by a man flying %employerfaction%'s banner off the back end of a wagon. He states that he is a quartermaster for your employer and he has a few supplies to offload.%SPEECH_ON%Got a couple of wardogs, nets and throwing spears. I've been told you can have one or the other, but not all as there are plenty of fightin' men in need around here.%SPEECH_OFF%}
569547437dda00d8bade.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_158.png[/img]{离开%townname%时，一名男子赶着货车靠近，车尾挂着%employerfaction%的旗帜。他自称是雇主手下的军需官，有一些补给可交给你。%SPEECH_ON%有几条战犬，还有网和投矛。上头说你们能选其中一类，不能全拿，这附近等着补给的战士可多了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

c454fd97d0cf2c56d313.source: We have all that we need. Save it for the others.
c454fd97d0cf2c56d313.translation: 我们什么都不缺，留给别人吧。

7728b6a64d3b28de3a9b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{The southerners appear, but it is not in full force, and nor is it necessarily just their scouts. It seems they have spent little time keeping cohesion and have instead spread themselves out on the approach. If you were to sally forth and attack now, you'd likely catch them with their drawers down.}
7728b6a64d3b28de3a9b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{南方人出现了，但并非全军到齐，也不单是斥候。看来他们急于赶路，顾不上维持队形，反而一路分散开来。若此刻出击，很可能打他们个措手不及。}

e5b1b8e54d795f6a7ef6.source: We need to seize this opportunity. Prepare the men to sally forth!
e5b1b8e54d795f6a7ef6.translation: 必须抓住这个机会，准备率众出击！

df2acce8d04eb8c64e3c.source: We have a defensible position here. We stay put.
df2acce8d04eb8c64e3c.translation: 这里易守难攻，我们守在原地。

84ec6c34aa35ff8c0646.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%Good call.%SPEECH_OFF%The words of %randombrother% follow your order. Set to a fast pace, the %companyname% sets out to catch the southerners before they muster their full strength. You cross the field and before you know it are upon them. They're still offloading gear and equipment and at the very sight of you a few camp followers up and run for their lives. The rest of the soldiers hurry to collect their weapons.

Judging by his shrill voice, the only commander in the area isn't trained for this sort of thing as his voice cracks with every barked order as some semblance of a formation tries to take shape. Wasting no more time, you charge into the fray!}
84ec6c34aa35ff8c0646.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%这主意好。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚下令，%randombrother%便应了一声。%companyname%加快脚步，打算赶在南方人集结完毕前动手。你们穿过旷野，转眼便杀到敌人跟前。他们还在卸载装备和物资，几个随军杂役一看见你，立刻逃命去了。其余士兵则手忙脚乱地寻找武器。

附近似乎只有一个指挥官。他嗓音尖利，每喊一道命令就要破一次音，显然没受过应付这种场面的训练。他手下的队伍勉强摆出一点阵形的模样。你不再给他们时间，立即率众冲入敌阵！}

0ad2b21201f1adbe9e18.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{You finish off the last of the soldiers, the look of surprise still grimly shaped across their faces.%SPEECH_ON%Captain, got the rest coming.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says, returning from a quick gaze of the horizon. Nodding, you order the men to get ready. This time, the southerners are making an approach in good formation, though it briefly waivers at the sight of you and the dead littered about your feet. Their banner rises into the sky and the southerners are revivified, charging forth with anger and energy. Shouts of 'for the Gilder!' ripple through the air. You point your sword forward.%SPEECH_ON%Admirable in their faith they might be, no god shall find them here, only the %companyname% awaits and we've but one prayer to offer.%SPEECH_OFF%The men roar as the battle hastens upon them.}
0ad2b21201f1adbe9e18.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{你了结了最后几个士兵，他们脸上仍僵着惊愕的表情。%SPEECH_ON%团长，剩下的敌人来了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%刚去远处望了一眼，回来便如此禀报。你点头，让众人做好准备。这一次，南方人排着整齐的阵形逼近，不过，看见你和你脚边遍地的尸体，他们的脚步还是乱了片刻。旗帜随即高高扬起，南方士兵又振作起来，满腔怒火地发起冲锋。‘为了镀金者！’的呐喊响彻四野。你将剑指向前方。%SPEECH_ON%他们的虔诚或许值得敬佩，但这里没有神来接应他们，只有%companyname%在等着。而咱们只会一种祈祷。%SPEECH_OFF%战斗转瞬即至，弟兄们齐声怒吼。}

0a545d00c7915355a661.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%Good call.%SPEECH_OFF%The words of %randombrother% follow your order. Set to a fast pace, the %companyname% sets out to catch the southerners before they muster their full strength. You cross the field and before you know it are upon them. They're still offloading gear and equipment and at the very sight of you a few camp followers up and run for their lives. The rest of the soldiers hurry to collect their weapons. Just when you think you have the upper hand, another contingent arrives from the side.%SPEECH_ON%The Gilder smiles only upon those who deserve His gleam, Crownling!%SPEECH_OFF%The southern commander shouts mockingly. With the defenses too far, and the enemy too close, there's only one place to go now. You raise your sword and ready the men to charge.}
0a545d00c7915355a661.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%这主意好。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚下令，%randombrother%便应了一声。%companyname%加快脚步，打算赶在南方人集结完毕前动手。你们穿过旷野，转眼便杀到敌人跟前。他们还在卸载装备和物资，几个随军杂役一看见你，立刻逃命去了。其余士兵则手忙脚乱地寻找武器。你正以为已经占尽先机，另一队敌军却从侧面赶了过来。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，镀金者只会垂青配得上祂辉光的人！%SPEECH_OFF%南方指挥官高声讥笑。己方阵地太远，敌人又已近在眼前，眼下只剩一条路可走。你举起剑，让弟兄们准备冲锋。}

992278fc1c6c2508e7e3.source: We'll fight our way out of this!

2f160bb816edee73ee8a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{You figure it's best to man the defenses. It might let an opportunity slip, but it is in part the safest of all available options.%SPEECH_ON%Shoulda went out. We missed something there on that one, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%Looking over you find %randombrother% shrugging. You tell him to mind his tongue, or he'll be missing something himself.}
2f160bb816edee73ee8a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{你觉得，还是守住防线最好。或许会错过机会，可在现有选择里，这至少最稳妥。%SPEECH_ON%该出去的，团长，那边肯定漏了好机会。%SPEECH_OFF%你转头看见%randombrother%正耸肩，便叫他管好舌头，免得自己身上也少点什么。}

f399387ea235987c1fdf.source: Everyone, get ready. They'll soon attack in full force.
f399387ea235987c1fdf.translation: 所有人准备，他们马上就会全力进攻。

43c7d53a2c6a1a20b513.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{As you await the southerners, a troop of northerners arrives. Their lieutenant tips his helmet.%SPEECH_ON%When they told me to come out this way to aide a sellsword, I said they can go shit that command out their arse. But you know what convinced me? Knowing it was the %companyname%. You've reputation, and I've men to spare for this fight.%SPEECH_OFF%Judging by their equipment, they'd be best used as a screening force to perhaps draw away elements of the oncoming enemy force. That, or perhaps it'd be best to just fold them into the company, bolstering your ranks where you're already strongest.}
43c7d53a2c6a1a20b513.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{等待南方人来袭时，一队北方士兵赶到。他们的副官扶了扶头盔，向你致意。%SPEECH_ON%上头让我跑来支援一个佣兵，我说，让他们把这道命令塞回屁眼里去。可你知道我后来为什么改了主意吗？因为听说来的是%companyname%。你们有名声，我手里正好也抽得出些人，能帮忙打这一仗。%SPEECH_OFF%看这些士兵的装备，最合适的安排，或许是让他们充当前方的掩护部队，引开一部分来犯之敌。当然，也可以将他们编入战团，进一步增强你们原本就最有优势的战线。}

1c134dcb426a638fda8d.source: I need you and your men to flank their gunners, lieutenant.
1c134dcb426a638fda8d.translation: 副官，我要你带人侧击他们的火铳手。

1b8364a3c27a407cb85b.source: I need you and your men to lure away some of their infantry, lieutenant.
1b8364a3c27a407cb85b.translation: 副官，我要你带人引走他们的一部分步兵。

31901af715ab87a66e29.source: I need you and your men to fight at our side, lieutenant.
31901af715ab87a66e29.translation: 副官，我要你带人和我们并肩作战。

58fdc0aec0a14f2b7a9b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{You take out a long-glass and scope the battlefield ahead. The northern troop charge toward the enemy in a chevron formation, and then split off at the wings to run off in separate directions. It seems a suicidal charge, but much to your surprise they've made a tasty retreat the southerners can't quite resist. You watch as the Gilder's followers don't keep their eye on the shine, instead depleting their ranks to chase down the feint.%SPEECH_ON%Worked like a charm, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says.}
58fdc0aec0a14f2b7a9b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{你拿出长筒望远镜，观察前方战场。北方部队排成楔形冲向敌人，随后从两翼分开，朝不同方向撤退。乍看简直像送死，可出乎意料，这场佯退诱人得让南方人无法抵挡。你看着镀金者的信徒忘了正事，分兵追赶诱饵，削弱了自己的阵列。%SPEECH_ON%团长，真是灵验得很。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%说道。}

6c5e40f91d96f027db5f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{You'd rather the soldiers stay with you. The lieutenant nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yessir, captain, uh, what's your name?%SPEECH_OFF%Ignoring him, you tell %randombrother% to accommodate the northern troop to the defenses.%SPEECH_ON%Make sure they know it well, but not too well.%SPEECH_OFF%The sellsword leans in and whispers.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, if they're spies we don't want to give them too much detail, aye captain?%SPEECH_OFF%You lean in and whisper back.%SPEECH_ON%No. Put them where we are weakest. Hopefully they all eat shit on the frontline and then we'll have their belongings.%SPEECH_OFF%}
6c5e40f91d96f027db5f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{你决定让这些士兵留在身边。副官点头应道：%SPEECH_ON%是，团长，呃，您叫什么来着？%SPEECH_OFF%你没理他，转而让%randombrother%带北方士兵熟悉防御阵地。%SPEECH_ON%让他们了解清楚，不过，也别太清楚。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵凑近，低声问道：%SPEECH_ON%啊，怕他们是奸细，不能泄露太多细节，对吧，团长？%SPEECH_OFF%你也凑过去，压低声音回答。%SPEECH_ON%不。把他们放到咱们最薄弱的地方。盼着他们全死在最前头，东西就都归咱们了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

cc26f22f3f49275ad412.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{The last southern soldier looks up at you.%SPEECH_ON%By the Gilder's gleam, I am ready.%SPEECH_OFF%You draw out your sword.%SPEECH_ON%And of what use was that gleam if I'm the one here, and you there?%SPEECH_OFF%Before he can respond, you put the blade through his neck. You tell the sellswords to loot the remains and ready a return to %employer%. | You find the last of the southern soldiers perched against a rock, his arm slung across its top as though it were a drinking buddy. He spits blood and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Perhaps my path was not so gilded as I thought.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding back, you tell him that he can ask the Gilder about that himself real soon here.%SPEECH_ON%And I'll ask Him about you, too.%SPEECH_OFF%He responds. You pause for a moment on that comment, then run him through with the sword. The rest of the remains will need to be looted. %employer% should be happy to see you. | The battle is over and the dead litter the field. You stand over the last breathing southerner. He stares over your shoulder at the sky. When you ask if he thinks his 'Gilder' is watching, the man smiles.%SPEECH_ON%He's watching us both.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and then end his life. With a sharp whistle, you get the %companyname%'s attention. Your orders are simple: loot what's worthwhile, and then ready to return to %employer%.}
cc26f22f3f49275ad412.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{最后一个南方士兵抬头望着你。%SPEECH_ON%蒙镀金者辉光照耀，我已准备好了。%SPEECH_OFF%你拔出剑。%SPEECH_ON%可站在这儿的是我，倒在那儿的是你。这辉光又有什么用？%SPEECH_OFF%不等他回答，你便一剑刺穿了他的脖子。你吩咐佣兵搜刮尸体，准备回去向%employer%复命。 | 你找到最后一个南方士兵。他倚着岩石，一条胳膊搭在石头上，仿佛搂着酒友。他吐出一口血，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%看来，我的前路并没有想象中那般金光灿灿。%SPEECH_OFF%你也点头，告诉他，很快就能亲自去问镀金者了。%SPEECH_ON%我也会向祂问起你。%SPEECH_OFF%他如此回答。这句话让你顿了片刻，随后，你一剑贯穿了他。其他尸体还得搜一搜。%employer%见到你，应该会很高兴。 | 战斗已经结束，遍地都是尸体。你站在最后一个尚有气息的南方人面前。他的目光越过你的肩头，望向天空。你问他，是否觉得他的‘镀金者’正在看着。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%祂看着我们两个。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，结束了他的性命，随后吹了声尖锐的口哨，让%companyname%的弟兄们听令。命令很简单：搜走值钱的东西，准备回去向%employer%复命。}

e62684b2e6e334d42228.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{The southerners raise their banners over %holysite%.%SPEECH_ON%I suppose that's it, then.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says. If by 'it' you mean there's no reason to see %employer% about the end of the contract then yes, that is indeed it.}
e62684b2e6e334d42228.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{南方人将旗帜升起在%holysite%上空。%SPEECH_ON%看来，就这样了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%说。如果“就这样”指的是没必要再去找%employer%结算委托，那么没错，确实就这样了。}

ca7e86f7f814f3f650b8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%I take it them southern shits squealed when you put an end to their farkin' around.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% bites into half a chicken breast before you can respond. And he keeps talking anyway, mouth only full of contents insofar as they have not yet launched out and spread across the table.%SPEECH_ON%Ya know, I'd doubt of the old gods, but now, with this, I can see their ways are true, and their divinity most righteous.%SPEECH_OFF%He swallows what's left and slams the chicken on his plate.%SPEECH_ON%Pay the sellsword his money.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% in the company of a few monks, their prior, and women who don't look in remotely marital status with anyone. The nobleman is grinning ear to ear.%SPEECH_ON%Word of your doings reached us a few days ago. The old gods raise their chalices to your men, sellsword. I'm sure you gave them southerners all the hells they deserve, and in which they no doubt dwell. Your payment, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%A few of the women go toward you, but are quickly reeled back.%SPEECH_ON%Ladies, ladies, please, be proper. Sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% points toward a chest of %reward% crowns. | You find %employer% in a priory. He is praying alone at an altar, and when he finishes he speaks without turning back.%SPEECH_ON%I believe the old gods spoke to me last night. Said you were returning with good news and indeed, here you are. Because we are alone, I'll tell you something. The 'Gilded' ones riding around in that desert, I think them an earnest sort. I think whatever buildings they pray in, they're praying in them now. You've not shook their faith at all, and someday we'll be out there again.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman stands up and turns around.%SPEECH_ON%Defeat hardens the faithful. I've taken my licks, and now they have theirs. When you take your gold for the job, put in a prayer that it's the last you take for it.%SPEECH_OFF%You'll not be doing that, but feel it improper to tell the truth to an opened heart. %reward% crowns, however, makes a very proper entrance into the company's purse strings.}
ca7e86f7f814f3f650b8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%那些南方杂种瞎折腾到头的时候，想必叫得挺惨吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及答话，%employer%就啃掉了半块鸡胸肉。他嘴里塞着东西，话却没停；说着说着，食物便喷得满桌都是。%SPEECH_ON%说真的，我也曾怀疑过旧神。不过如今，有了这件事，我看清了：祂们指引的道路确实正确，祂们的神威也最为公正。%SPEECH_OFF%他咽下剩下的食物，把鸡肉往盘里一摔。%SPEECH_ON%把钱付给这个佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他身边围着几个修士、一位院长，还有几个怎么看都不像在场任何人妻子的女人。这位贵族笑得合不拢嘴。%SPEECH_ON%你的事迹几天前就传到了我们耳中。佣兵，旧神正举起圣杯，向你的弟兄们致意。我想，你一定让那些南方人尝够了地狱的滋味。他们也活该下地狱，如今想必已经到了。报酬都在这儿，分文不少。%SPEECH_OFF%几个女人朝你走来，却立刻被拉了回去。%SPEECH_ON%女士们，女士们，请守些规矩。佣兵，看这边。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%指了指箱子，里面装着%reward%克朗。 | 你在修道院里找到%employer%。他独自跪在祭坛前祈祷。祷告结束，他没有回头，便开口说道：%SPEECH_ON%我相信，昨夜旧神曾对我说话。祂们说你会带着好消息回来，而你果然来了。这里没有旁人，我就跟你说点心里话。那些在沙漠里来回奔走的‘镀金之民’，我相信他们也是真心虔诚。不管他们在什么样的屋子里祈祷，此时此刻，他们一定还在祈祷。你丝毫没有动摇他们的信仰，总有一天，我们还得回到那里。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族起身，转过脸来。%SPEECH_ON%挫败会让信徒更加坚定。我吃过苦头，如今轮到他们。你领这份报酬时，也祈祷一句吧，但愿以后再不用为这桩事领钱。%SPEECH_OFF%你可不会这么祈祷，不过，对着一个敞开心扉的人说实话，总觉得不太合适。至于让%reward%克朗落进战团的钱袋，那就再合适不过了。}

bc7b9fa5ffbe0104ce5c.source: Failed to defend a holy site

38dcdf6397f97b64fcce.source: Move to %holysite% and defend it against northern heathens
38dcdf6397f97b64fcce.translation: 前往%holysite%，抵御北方异教徒的进攻

26f115c6625dd722ad34.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]%employer% is nowhere to be seen. Instead a man in clerical colors approaches with a lieutenant general at his side. They state that a contingent of northern soldiers is approaching %holysite% with the aim to take it wholly for the North. With the city-state's soldiers elsewhere, they will have to lean on you to hurry to the location and defend it. Their heavy-handed manner of speaking combined with a hint of anxiety no doubt makes this a potentially pocket-deepening payday. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]You are pushed into %employer%'s room and the Vizier nods at you and claps.%SPEECH_ON%Finally, the little Crownling is here, ready to do big things for us all. Come, look at this map. Do you see where my men are? And do you see where %holysite% is? And here, the northern rats... They're near to the sacred grounds and my men far. You, however, are here, close indeed, no? For %reward% crowns I want you to travel to %holysite% and defend it.%SPEECH_OFF%The Vizier stares at you with a warm smile as though this wasn't a question, but a request so weighted with gold it may as well have been an order.}
26f115c6625dd722ad34.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]你没有见到%employer%。来接待你的是一个穿着教士服的人，身旁跟着一位副将。他们说，一支北方军队正在逼近%holysite%，企图将那里彻底据为北方所有。城邦的军队都在别处，只能指望你尽快赶去守住圣地。两人语气强硬，却掩不住一丝焦虑。看来，这回你的钱袋有望好好鼓上一鼓。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]你被推搡着带进%employer%的房间，维齐尔朝你点头，拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%小小的克朗客终于来了，准备为我们办一桩大事。来，看看这张地图。看见我的军队在哪儿了吗？再看看%holysite%在哪儿。还有这里，这些北方老鼠……他们离圣地很近，我的人却很远。而你在这里，离得确实很近，是不是？我出%reward%克朗，要你赶到%holysite%，守住那里。%SPEECH_OFF%维齐尔带着和蔼的微笑看着你，仿佛这根本不是询问，而是一项用黄金压得沉甸甸、与命令无异的要求。}

2daef4f1defa2bff008a.source: {The %companyname% can help you with this. | Defending against a northern host better pay well. | I'm interested, go on.}
2daef4f1defa2bff008a.translation: {%companyname%能帮你办这件事。 | 抵挡北方大军，报酬最好够高。 | 我有兴趣，继续说。}

e9b053b2e0e9cbc99f4b.source: {This isn't worth it. | We're needed elsewhere. | I won't risk the company against northern armies.}
e9b053b2e0e9cbc99f4b.translation: {不值得。 | 别处还有事等着我们。 | 我不会让战团冒险迎战北方军队。}

1882df1e0a88c431b4a1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{What few faithful still linger around %holysite% must be the most fervid and zealous. Being that you are here representing the south, you have the men pick out a few followers of the Gilder and ask that they fight for their God. It is a convenient recruiting tool if there ever was one, and they are quick to arm themselves and undergo the shortest of training. You can only hope they are of any use in the actual battle to come.}
1882df1e0a88c431b4a1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{仍留在%holysite%附近的少数信徒，想必是最狂热虔诚的一批。既然你代表南方而来，便让弟兄们挑出几个镀金者的信众，请他们为自己的神而战。这招募办法再方便不过，他们很快武装起来，接受了最简短的训练。只盼真正开战时，能派上点用场。}

ada0837587bab0cdb86e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{The northern army is here. Or, at least, what's left of it. With such heavy armor and arms, the long travel has left their ranks a little thinned, but they still look quite the considerable challenge. You look over at %randombrother% who shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%{Aside from the scenery, just another battle, ain't it? | I know everyone is going to chat about this and that religious bullshit, but frankly, this is just another fight to me. And I love it.}%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you unsheathe your sword and command the men to the ready.}
ada0837587bab0cdb86e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{北方大军到了，至少，剩下的这些到了。武器护甲如此沉重，长途跋涉让他们掉了些人，不过看起来仍很难对付。你望向%randombrother%，他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%{除了风景不同，不就是再打一仗吗？ | 我知道大家都要扯那些宗教的狗屁道理，可对我来说，不过是再打一仗。而我就喜欢这个。}%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，拔剑，命令弟兄们准备迎战。}

e28fa1f4a4ac0b6c3b01.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{A man approaches you at the gates of %townname%. Judging by the madly colored bandoliers and phylacteries about his chest, he is an alchemist. He announces that he was sent by the Vizier.%SPEECH_ON%I am a bit short on material, but I've enough to produce content of a very specific manner, of your call, of course.%SPEECH_OFF%He describes his solutions as thus: fire pots, flash pots, or smoke pots.}
e28fa1f4a4ac0b6c3b01.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{一名男子在%townname%的城门口找到你。看他胸前那些色彩夸张的挎带和护符，应是个炼金术士。他说自己奉维齐尔之命而来。%SPEECH_ON%材料不太够，不过足以制成某一类特定的东西，当然，由你决定。%SPEECH_OFF%他列出三种选择：燃烧罐、闪光罐，或烟雾罐。}

62316ab577fc64110723.source: We have all that we need.

0403ad2c5a01a124b9b6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{The alchemist works quickly, pouring an entire pile of powdered ingredients into a bowl and then mashing in a smattering of materials you can't even recognize. It takes a surprisingly short period of time, and you're not sure if that's because he's so talented or this whole thing is a farce. Either way, he hands you the pots as promised.%SPEECH_ON%May the Gilder shine light upon your path, and may your swords bring peace back to %holysite%.%SPEECH_OFF%}
0403ad2c5a01a124b9b6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{炼金术士动作飞快，把整堆粉末配料倒进碗里，又捣入一些你认不出的材料。短短片刻便完成了，你也说不准是本领高超，还是纯粹装模作样。不过，他确实按约交来了罐子。%SPEECH_ON%愿镀金者照亮你的前路，愿你们的刀剑让%holysite%重归安宁。%SPEECH_OFF%}

cf4285e9781500a54340.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{The northerners appear, but it is not in full force, and nor is it necessarily just their scouts. It seems they have spent little time keeping cohesion and have instead spread themselves out on the approach. If you were to sally forth and attack now, you'd likely catch them with their drawers down.}
cf4285e9781500a54340.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{北方人出现了，但并非全军到齐，也不单是斥候。看来他们急于赶路，顾不上维持队形，反而一路分散开来。若此刻出击，很可能打他们个措手不及。}

db5e7d5ad95b99dde892.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_156.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%Good call.%SPEECH_OFF%The words of %randombrother% follow your order. Set to a fast pace, the %companyname% sets out to catch the northerners before they muster their full strength. You cross the field and before you know it are upon them. They're still offloading gear and equipment and at the very sight of you a few camp followers up and run for their lives. The rest of the soldiers hurry to collect their weapons. Judging by his shrill voice, the only commander in the area isn't trained for this sort of thing as his voice cracks with every barked order as some semblance of a formation tries to take shape. Wasting no more time, you charge into the fray!}
db5e7d5ad95b99dde892.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_156.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%这主意好。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚下令，%randombrother%便应了一声。%companyname%加快脚步，打算赶在北方人集结完毕前动手。你们穿过旷野，转眼便杀到敌人跟前。他们还在卸载装备和物资，几个随军杂役一看见你，立刻逃命去了。其余士兵则手忙脚乱地寻找武器。附近似乎只有一个指挥官。他嗓音尖利，每喊一道命令就要破一次音，显然没受过应付这种场面的训练。他手下的队伍勉强摆出一点阵形的模样。你不再给他们时间，立即率众冲入敌阵！}

95eea55a022179b700c7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{You finish off the last of the soldiers, the look of surprise still grimly shaped across their faces.%SPEECH_ON%Captain, got the rest coming.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says, returning from a quick gaze of the horizon. Nodding, you order the men to get ready. This time, the northerners are making an approach in good formation, though it briefly waivers at the sight of you and the dead littered about your feet. Their banner rises into the sky and the northerners are revivified, charging forth with anger and energy. You look down at %randombrother% and brush a piece of organ off his shoulder. When he looks back you simply smile.%SPEECH_ON%The fun's here, you should look nice for it.%SPEECH_OFF%}
95eea55a022179b700c7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{你了结了最后几个士兵，他们脸上仍僵着惊愕的表情。%SPEECH_ON%团长，剩下的敌人来了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%刚去远处望了一眼，回来便如此禀报。你点头，让众人做好准备。这一次，北方人排着整齐的阵形逼近，不过，看见你和你脚边遍地的尸体，他们的脚步还是乱了片刻。旗帜随即高高扬起，北方士兵又振作起来，满腔怒火地发起冲锋。你低头看了看%randombrother%，替他拂去肩上的一块内脏。他转过头来，你只是笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%好戏开场了，总得穿戴整齐些。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a69e75b3da94d66427f7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%Good call.%SPEECH_OFF%The words of %randombrother% follow your order. Set to a fast pace, the %companyname% sets out to catch the northerners before they muster their full strength. You cross the field and before you know it are upon them. They're still offloading gear and equipment and at the very sight of you a few camp followers up and run for their lives. The rest of the soldiers hurry to collect their weapons. Just when you think you have the upper hand, another contingent arrives from the side.%SPEECH_ON%Farkin' hell, that's nearly the whole lot of them.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says. The defenses are too far, and the enemy too close. There's only one place to go now. You raise your sword and ready the men to charge.}
a69e75b3da94d66427f7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%这主意好。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚下令，%randombrother%便应了一声。%companyname%加快脚步，打算赶在北方人集结完毕前动手。你们穿过旷野，转眼便杀到敌人跟前。他们还在卸载装备和物资，几个随军杂役一看见你，立刻逃命去了。其余士兵则手忙脚乱地寻找武器。你正以为已经占尽先机，另一队敌军却从侧面赶了过来。%SPEECH_ON%他妈的，差不多全来了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%说道。己方阵地太远，敌人又已近在眼前，眼下只剩一条路可走。你举起剑，让弟兄们准备冲锋。}

bb9d4b76d6e0b3415e7e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{As you await the northerners, a small band of southern soldiers almost gets the drop on you. Thankfully, they're still on your side and offer their services.%SPEECH_ON%The Gilder told us you would be here, and though you are a Crownling we will submit to your command in defending this site in His glory.%SPEECH_OFF%Judging by their equipment, they'd be best used as a screening force to perhaps draw away elements of the oncoming enemy force. That, or perhaps it'd be best to just fold them into the %companyname% for now, bolstering your ranks where you're already strongest.}
bb9d4b76d6e0b3415e7e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{你正等待北方人来袭，一小队南方士兵却险些悄无声息地摸到你跟前。幸好，他们仍是友军，来意也是助你一臂之力。%SPEECH_ON%镀金者指引我们来此寻你。你虽是克朗客，我们仍愿听从你的指挥，为祂的荣耀守住此地。%SPEECH_OFF%看这些士兵的装备，最合适的安排，或许是让他们充当前方的掩护部队，引开一部分来犯之敌。当然，也可以暂时将他们编入%companyname%，进一步增强你们原本就最有优势的战线。}

93722b3898f011a49c77.source: I need you and your men to flank their arbalesters, lieutenant.
93722b3898f011a49c77.translation: 副官，我要你带人侧击他们的弩手。

9c894756a9830237a782.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{You take out a long-glass and scope the battlefield ahead. The southern soldiers fan out like ants and get into a skirmish with the northerners. Much to your surprise, the feint works. Grinning, you watch as the northern troop split and give chase, weakening their ranks in the process.}
9c894756a9830237a782.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{你拿出长筒望远镜，观察前方战场。南方士兵如蚁群般散开，与北方人短兵相接。出乎意料，这场佯攻奏效了。你笑着看北方部队分兵追赶，自己的阵列也因此变得薄弱。}

42cc4c87d07668d64241.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{You'd rather the soldiers stay with you. The lieutenant nods.%SPEECH_ON%The Gilder has trusted us to help you, and whether you believe it or not, He trusts you, too.%SPEECH_OFF%Alright. Sure. You tell them where to go and they hop to it with annoyingly religious obedience, going on and on about gold and lights and the like.}
42cc4c87d07668d64241.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_164.png[/img]{你更愿意让士兵留下。副官点头。%SPEECH_ON%镀金者信任我们，命我们助你。无论你信不信，他也信任你。%SPEECH_OFF%好，是，随你说。你指明去处，他们便带着令人厌烦的虔诚顺从立刻照办，嘴里还不停念叨黄金、光明之类的话。}

f0a9cd899e471d3cf50d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{The last living northerner is on the ground, a wound in his chest, blood about the ground. He's got a long look in his eyes and breathes calmly and with a sense that this is the end of things. You take out your sword but he holds out his hand. Not for mercy, but for a moment.%SPEECH_ON%No need for that. I can see it already. It goes. And it goes. Don't know why I cared so much.%SPEECH_OFF%He slumps over and his hand tenses and falls from his chest. %randombrother% prods the corpse, then loots it. You sheathe your sword and tell the men to ready for a return to the Vizier. | Your men go about finishing off the last of the survivors. It's mostly a matter of running corpses through with a quick stab or two. Some bodies still jump, but you know they're gone. You're not sure why they still move like that, as if the man that once was left his fear behind. Others don't react at all. There's one scream from a soldier who tried to hide, but he is quickly silenced. With the field littered with the defeated, you tell the %companyname% to go loot what they can and prepare for a trip back to the Vizier. | One last northerner has backed himself between the wedge of two rocks, his hands splayed out to the sides like a spider receding back into its hidden hole.%SPEECH_ON%The old gods shant have mercy on ye lot.%SPEECH_OFF%A shadow briefly comes and goes from above, and then the rock which manifested it follows and crushes the man's head. He falls to the ground, body jerking, mouth gargling. %randombrother% stares from the peak of the two rocks.%SPEECH_ON%That's the last of them. We should get their gear and get back to uh, that fella, the one with the pomp, the viz... vis... viscount?%SPEECH_OFF%Vizier. But close enough.}
f0a9cd899e471d3cf50d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{最后一个活着的北方人倒在地上，胸口有伤，身下尽是鲜血。他目光悠远，呼吸平静，仿佛已接受一切将要结束。你拔出剑，他却抬起手。他不是求饶，只是想再等片刻。%SPEECH_ON%不用了。我已经看见了。就这么过去了。就这么过去了。也不知道，以前为什么那么放不下。%SPEECH_OFF%他身子一歪，手掌绷紧，随即从胸前滑落。%randombrother%戳了戳尸体，开始翻找财物。你收剑入鞘，让众人准备回去见维齐尔。 | 弟兄们四处补刀，了结残存的敌人。大多只是朝尸体上迅速刺一两下。有些身躯仍会抽动，但你知道，人早就没了。你也不明白它们为什么还会动，仿佛死者离去时，把恐惧留在了身体里。另一些则毫无反应。一个装死躲藏的士兵发出惨叫，却很快没了声息。战败者的尸体铺满战场，你让%companyname%的弟兄搜走能用的东西，准备回去见维齐尔。 | 最后一个北方人退进两块岩石间的夹缝，双手撑向两旁，活像一只缩回暗穴的蜘蛛。%SPEECH_ON%旧神不会宽恕你们这些人。%SPEECH_OFF%一道阴影从头顶掠过，紧接着，投下阴影的石头便砸了下来，将他的脑袋砸得稀烂。他瘫倒在地，身体抽搐，嘴里咕噜作响。%randombrother%站在两块岩石顶上，俯视着下面。%SPEECH_ON%最后一个了。拿上他们的装备，回去找那个……就那个排场很大的家伙，维……维……子爵？%SPEECH_OFF%是维齐尔。不过，也差不多吧。}

c44d5f696d3151207741.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{Well, %holysite% belongs to the northerners now. Given that you place heavy value upon your own head, and wish to keep it there, you see no point in returning to the Vizier for at least awhile.}
c44d5f696d3151207741.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/%illustration%.png[/img]{好吧，%holysite%如今归北方人了。你很看重自己这颗脑袋，也希望它继续待在脖子上，所以至少暂时没必要回去见维齐尔。}

103434cca62b1c57241d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% is found in a small priory far from his palace. It is an unusual place to find him, and there's but a small crowd of impoverished followers at his feet, listening as he speaks. The Vizier glances at you, and then, mid-talk, nods at someone else. A moment later, a bearded man with two swords approaches. He looks you up and down, then moves aside to reveal two servants carrying a chest.%SPEECH_ON%The Vizier wishes to thank you Crownling. And may you forever travel the Gilded path.%SPEECH_OFF%Of course, you're ushered right back out the moment the money is transferred. Not so much as a nod or wave comes from the Vizier as the doors close behind you. | You are led down a long hall and are brought to an empty room. For a moment, you wonder if you are meant to be betrayed here. Betrayals rarely come in places where a mess would be unwanted. While you stare at the clean stone flooring, %employer% enters from the opposite side. He stands many feet away and the room echoes his voice.%SPEECH_ON%It is said that you fought well, and that the northerners proved themselves shrill dogs in battle. I imagine this latter statement is an untruth meant to induce my personal happiness. But I am a thinker and a realist. I imagine you found the enemy's determination to be quite formidable, just as they would ours. You will be rewarded our agreed price, Crownling.%SPEECH_OFF%A group of men suddenly file into the room behind the Vizier and, again, you wonder if they are meant there for another purpose entirely. Much to your relief, they carry with them purses of coin. When you look back toward the door, %employer% is gone and a moment later his servants are gone as well. | %employer% welcomes you into a room with himself and a few select religious figures. Each of these modest priors comes and briefly bows before you. The Vizier does not partake, but he does snap his fingers and his servants lug over a large chest of crowns. Finally, the religious men now turn to the Vizier and in a similar procession bow before him. They also kiss his feet and a ring, things not on the docket for yourself. %employer% speaks.%SPEECH_ON%My path has been ever gilded, Crownling. For the Gilder to bestow upon me such knowledge that you, a modest sellsword many would overlook, should be the one I hire to spare %holysite%. I am blessed. Truly.%SPEECH_OFF%You take the gold and go, and the last thing you see are the frocked men going back around for seconds.}
103434cca62b1c57241d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你在远离宫殿的一间小修道院里找到%employer%。他竟会出现在这种地方，着实少见。脚边围着一小群穷苦信众，正听他讲话。维齐尔瞥了你一眼，说话间，又朝另一个人点头。片刻后，一个佩着双剑的大胡子走来。他上下打量你一番，侧身让开，露出身后抬着钱箱的两个仆人。%SPEECH_ON%维齐尔向你致谢，克朗客。愿你永远行于镀金之路。%SPEECH_OFF%果然，钱刚一交到手里，你就又被请了出去。身后大门合上时，维齐尔连头也没点一下，更别说挥手道别。 | 你沿着长长的走廊，被带进一间空屋。一瞬间，你怀疑自己会不会在这里遭人暗算。毕竟，谁也不会在不愿弄脏的地方动手。你正望着干净的石地板，%employer%从对面走了进来。他站得很远，话声在房间里回荡。%SPEECH_ON%据说你作战英勇，那些北方人在战场上却像丧家犬一样哀嚎。我猜，后半句只是为了讨我欢心而编出的谎言。可我会思考，也尊重现实。我想，敌人的决心一定令你印象深刻，正如我们的决心也会让他们如此。克朗客，你会得到我们谈妥的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%一群人忽然从维齐尔身后鱼贯而入，你又不禁怀疑，他们是否另有所图。好在，他们带来的只是一个个钱袋。等你再望向门口，%employer%已经不见了；片刻之后，他的仆人也退得一干二净。 | %employer%将你迎进房间。他身边还有几位特意请来的宗教人物。这些谦和的院长依次走到你面前，略略躬身。维齐尔没有跟着行礼，只打了个响指，仆人便抬来一大箱克朗。接着，那些教士又转向维齐尔，排着队，依次向他鞠躬。他们还亲吻他的双脚和戒指，你可没享受到这份待遇。%employer%开口说道：%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，我的前路始终镀满金光。许多人会忽略你这样一个不起眼的佣兵，镀金者却赐我慧眼，让我知道，应当雇你去保全%holysite%。我蒙受神恩。千真万确。%SPEECH_OFF%你拿钱走人，临走前最后看见的，是那些长袍教士又排起队，准备再来一遍。}

0e6c4dc1e21c38ef1443.source: Defend %townname% and its outskirts from raiding parties
0e6c4dc1e21c38ef1443.translation: 保卫%townname%及其郊区，抵御劫掠队伍

a2f89a8ab64fcb53ab24.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer%'s looking out the window. He waves you to join him.%SPEECH_ON%Look at those people.%SPEECH_OFF%There's a throng of people below, wailing about this or that.%SPEECH_ON%Brigands have been roaming these parts for awhile now and people believe that they are about to attack us in great numbers.%SPEECH_OFF%The man throws the curtains closed and goes to light a candle. He speaks over it, his breath flicking the flame.%SPEECH_ON%We need you to protect us, mercenary. If you can stop these brigands, you'll be paid handsomely. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | A few peasants are roaming outside the halls of the room. You can hear their shouting and it is of a nervous tone. %employer% pours a drink and sips it with a shaking hand.%SPEECH_ON%I'll just be clear with you, sellsword. We have many, many reports that brigands are about to attack this town. If you want to know, those reports came by way of dead women and children. Clearly, we've no reason to doubt the seriousness of these reports. So, the question is, will you protect us?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s looking at some papers on his desk. You take a seat and ask what it is he wants.%SPEECH_ON%Hello, sellsword. We have a problem I think you will... excel at taking care of.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask him to be straight with you and he jumps right to the point.%SPEECH_ON%Brigands have burned down some homes and hovels just outside town. News is that they are preparing a much larger, gustier attack. I need you here to stop them. Do you think you can handle this task?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s staring at his bookshelf, his back to you. He talks somberly.%SPEECH_ON%It's a shame not many can read these. Maybe our issues would go away if they could. Or maybe they'd just get worse.%SPEECH_OFF%He shakes his head and turns around.%SPEECH_ON%We've got a gang of brigands soon to descend upon us. I need you, sellsword, to stop them. My books sure as hell won't. If the pay is right, which I promise it will be, are you in?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s got two papers in hand. There are faces sketched onto them.%SPEECH_ON%We caught these two the other day. Hanged 'em, burned the remains.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Congratulations?%SPEECH_OFF%The man is not very amused.%SPEECH_ON%Now we've gotten word that their brigand friends are coming to exact revenge on us! And, yes, we need your help to fight them off. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | You settle into %employer%'s room, taking a seat, rubbing your hands along the wooden frame. It's a good oak. A once-tree worth sitting in.%SPEECH_ON%Glad you're comfortable, sellsword, but I sure as hell ain't. We have many, many warnings that a large group of brigands are about to attack our town. We're quite short on defense, but not short on crowns. Obviously, that's where you come in. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% slams a cup against the wall. It scatters, turning and pinwheeling, flecks of wine dotting your cheek.%SPEECH_ON%Vagabonds! Brigands! Marauders! It never ends!%SPEECH_OFF%He absently hands you a napkin.%SPEECH_ON%Now I'm getting news that a large group of these thugs are coming to burn this town to the ground! Well, I've gotten something in store for them: you. What do you say, sellsword? Will you defend us?%SPEECH_OFF% | A few grieving women can be hear wailing just outside %employer%'s room. He turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Hear that? That's what happens when brigands come here. They steal, they rape, and they murder.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. It is, after all, the way of the brigand.%SPEECH_ON%Now some peasants in the hinterland say the thugs are preparing for a massive assault on our village. You must do something to help us, sellsword. Heh, of course I say 'must'. What I really mean is that we'll pay you to help us...%SPEECH_OFF%}
a2f89a8ab64fcb53ab24.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer%正望着窗外，招手让你过去。%SPEECH_ON%看看那些人。%SPEECH_OFF%楼下聚着一群人，为各种事情哭喊不休。%SPEECH_ON%强盗在这一带游荡有些时候了，大家都觉得，他们马上就会大举来袭。%SPEECH_OFF%他猛地拉上窗帘，转身点燃蜡烛。说话时，呼出的气把烛火吹得摇晃。%SPEECH_ON%我们需要你保护，佣兵。只要挡住这些强盗，报酬会很丰厚。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 几个农民徘徊在房间外的走廊里，叫喊声透着焦虑。%employer%倒了一杯酒，手颤抖着啜了一口。%SPEECH_ON%我就直说了，佣兵。我们收到太多消息，说强盗即将袭击镇子。你若想知道消息从哪儿来，那就是女人和孩子的尸体。显然，我们没理由怀疑这些警告的严重性。所以，问题是：你愿意保护我们吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正看着桌上的文书。你坐下，问他有什么事。%SPEECH_ON%你好，佣兵。我们遇到个问题，我想你会……很擅长解决。%SPEECH_OFF%你叫他直说，他便立刻切入正题。%SPEECH_ON%强盗烧了镇外一些民居和棚屋。消息说，他们正在准备规模更大、来势更猛的一次进攻。我需要你留下，挡住他们。你觉得能接下这差事吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%背对着你，凝视书架，语气低沉。%SPEECH_ON%可惜，能读懂这些的人不多。要是人人都识字，也许问题就没了。也许，只会更糟。%SPEECH_OFF%他摇摇头，转过身。%SPEECH_ON%一伙强盗很快就要扑过来。佣兵，我需要你挡住他们。这些书肯定挡不住。价钱要是合适——我保证会合适——你接吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%手里拿着两张纸，上面各画着一张脸。%SPEECH_ON%前些天，我们抓住了这两个家伙，吊死了，尸体也烧了。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%恭喜？%SPEECH_OFF%他并不觉得好笑。%SPEECH_ON%现在传来消息，他们的强盗同伙要来报仇！没错，我们需要你帮忙击退他们。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在%employer%的房间坐定，手掌抚过椅子的木框。是块好橡木，曾经那棵树，如今倒成了值得一坐的好椅子。%SPEECH_ON%你坐得舒服就好，佣兵，可我他妈一点也不舒服。接连不断的警报说，一大群强盗马上就要进攻镇子。我们缺防御，却不缺克朗。显然，这就轮到你出场了。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%把杯子狠狠砸向墙壁。碎片旋转飞散，几点酒液溅到你脸上。%SPEECH_ON%流寇！强盗！劫掠者！没完没了！%SPEECH_OFF%他心不在焉地递给你一块餐巾。%SPEECH_ON%现在又传来消息，一大群暴徒要来把镇子烧成平地！好啊，我也给他们准备了点东西：你。怎么说，佣兵？愿意守住我们吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的房间外，传来几名悲痛妇人的哭嚎。他转向你。%SPEECH_ON%听见了吗？强盗一来，就是这样。他们抢劫，强暴，杀人。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。毕竟，这就是强盗的行当。%SPEECH_ON%现在，腹地的一些农民说，那帮暴徒正准备大举进攻我们的村子。你必须帮我们做点什么，佣兵。呵，我还说“必须”呢。其实是说，我们会出钱，请你帮忙……%SPEECH_OFF%}

d86c89f1dbe21603cd4f.source: {What is %townname% prepared to pay for their safety? | This should be worth a good amount of crowns to you, right?}
d86c89f1dbe21603cd4f.translation: {为了自己的安全，%townname%愿意付多少？ | 这件事值得你花上一大笔克朗，对吧？}

93c14f337f81bbe70945.source: {I'm afraid you're on your own. | We have more important matters to settle. | I wish you luck, but we'll not be part of this.}
93c14f337f81bbe70945.translation: {恐怕你只能自求多福了。 | 我们还有更重要的事。 | 祝你好运，但我们不掺和。}

5ee3cc4e48329dee9bc7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{As you're leaving %employer% with a rejection, you come outside to find a throng of peasants standing around. Each is holding some sort of oddity, the sort of wealth that the laymen could scrounge together as best they could: chickens, cheap necklaces, worn clothes, rusted blacksmith gear, the list of belongings go on and on. One steps forward, a chicken tucked under each arm.%SPEECH_ON%Please! You can't leave! You have to help us!%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% laughs, but you have to admit that the poor folk do know how to pull a heartstring or two. Maybe you should stay and help after all? | When you leave %employer%, you come outside to find a woman standing there with a mob of her spawn running around and between her legs and a babe sucking her teat.%SPEECH_ON%Mercenary, please, you mustn't leave us like this! This town needs you! The children need you!%SPEECH_OFF%She pauses, then lowers the other side of her shirt, revealing a rather salacious and seductive temptation.%SPEECH_ON%I need you...%SPEECH_OFF%You hold a hand up, both to stop her and wipe your suddenly sweaty brow. Maybe helping this pair, uh, poor people out wouldn't be so bad after all? | Getting ready to leave %townname%, a small puppy runs up to you barking and licking your boots. An even smaller child is in chase, practically on the coattails of its literal tail. The kid falls to the mutt and wraps his arms around its nappy fur.%SPEECH_ON%Oh {Marley | Yeller | Jo-Jo}, I love you so much!%SPEECH_OFF%An image of brigands slaughtering the child and his pet runs across your mind. You've better things to do than play sheriff and constable against common thieves, but the dog just keeps licking the boy's face and the kid just seems so happy.%SPEECH_ON%Haha! We're going to live forever and ever, aren't we? Forever and ever!%SPEECH_OFF%Goddammit. | A man walks up to you as you leave %employer%'s abode.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, I heard you turn that man's offer down. It's a shame, that's all I wanted to say. I thought there were plenty of good men in this world, but I suppose I was wrong on that. Godspeed on your journey, and I do hope you pray for us in your travels.%SPEECH_OFF%}
5ee3cc4e48329dee9bc7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你拒绝%employer%的雇佣，走到门外，却发现一群农民等在那里。每个人都拿着些稀奇古怪的东西——这是他们竭尽所能凑出的家当：鸡、廉价项链、旧衣服、生锈的铁匠工具，林林总总，不一而足。一个人走上前，两边腋下各夹着一只鸡。%SPEECH_ON%求求你！你不能走！你得帮帮我们！%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%笑了，不过你也得承认，这些穷苦人确实知道怎样叫人心软。要不，还是留下帮帮他们？ | 你离开%employer%的住处，一出门便看见一个女人。她的孩子们围着她跑来跑去，从她两腿间钻过，怀里还有个婴儿正在吃奶。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，求求你，别就这样丢下我们！镇子需要你！孩子们需要你！%SPEECH_OFF%她顿了顿，又拉下另一边衣襟，露出一番相当诱人的春色。%SPEECH_ON%我也需要你……%SPEECH_OFF%你抬起手，一边阻止她，一边擦去额头上突然冒出的汗。也许帮帮这对……呃，这些可怜人，也没什么不好？ | 你正准备离开%townname%，一只小狗跑来，汪汪叫着舔你的靴子。一个更小的孩子紧追其后，几乎就贴在狗尾巴后面。孩子扑到小狗身上，抱住它乱蓬蓬的毛。%SPEECH_ON%噢，{马利 | 耶勒 | 乔乔}，我太爱你了！%SPEECH_OFF%强盗杀死孩子和小狗的画面从你脑海中闪过。你有更要紧的事，没空扮演治安官，去对付寻常毛贼，可那狗仍在舔孩子的脸，孩子又是那么快活。%SPEECH_ON%哈哈！我们会一直一直活下去，对吧？永远永远！%SPEECH_OFF%他妈的。 | 你离开%employer%的住处时，一个男人走到面前。%SPEECH_ON%先生，我听说你拒绝了他的提议。真可惜，我只想说这个。我原以为这世上还有不少好人，看来是我想错了。祝你一路平安，也希望你旅途中祈祷时，能记得我们。%SPEECH_OFF%}

09e4e0ff1dd81b28168f.source: {Damn, we can't leave these people to die. | Fine, fine, we won't leave %townname%. Let's talk payment, at least.}
09e4e0ff1dd81b28168f.translation: {该死，我们不能眼看着这些人送命。 | 好吧，好吧，我们留在%townname%。至少先把报酬谈妥。}

ce0315f98fd2c3c7ef43.source: {I'm sure you'll pull through. Make way. | I won't risk the %companyname% to save some starved peasants.}
ce0315f98fd2c3c7ef43.translation: {你们肯定能熬过去。让路吧。 | 我不会让%companyname%为几个挨饿的农民冒险。}

4500f0f68aeb0d01ef5f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]{While standing guard, a crazed peasant comes running up to you. He's slackjawed, out of breath. Hands on his knees, he damn near vomits out the words:%SPEECH_ON%The dead... they're coming!%SPEECH_OFF%Peering over him, you do indeed see a throng of rather pale creatures shuffling in the distance. | No brigands here, but undead! While waiting for the thugs and miscreants to come storming into the town, you instead spot a large throng of shambling creatures coming your way. Just because the target changes doesn't mean the contract does - prepare yourself! | Alarm bells sound off from the town chapel. You listen to them while eyeing the horizon. They keep ringing. A local stands by your side.%SPEECH_ON%One... two... three rings... four...%SPEECH_OFF%He begins to sweat. Then his eyes widen as the bells toll one final time.%SPEECH_ON%That's... that can't be.%SPEECH_OFF%You inquire as to what he's so scared of. He backs away.%SPEECH_ON%The dead walk the earth again!%SPEECH_OFF%Great, just when you thought a contract was going to be easy. | Groaning, moaning, the undead shuffle into view. There are no brigands here - maybe these foul creatures ate them - but the contract isn't null: protect the town!}
4500f0f68aeb0d01ef5f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]{站岗时，一个惊慌失措的农民跑来，嘴巴大张，上气不接下气。他双手撑膝，几乎像呕吐一般挤出话来。%SPEECH_ON%死人……它们来了！%SPEECH_OFF%你越过他望去，远处确实有一大群苍白身影蹒跚而来。 | 来的不是强盗，是亡灵！你正等着暴徒恶棍冲进镇子，却发现一大群步履蹒跚的生物朝这边靠近。敌人换了，不代表委托就作废。准备迎战！ | 镇上礼拜堂响起警钟。你一边听，一边望向地平线。钟声还在响，一个本地人站到你身旁。%SPEECH_ON%一……二……三声……四……%SPEECH_OFF%他开始冒汗。最后一声钟响时，双眼猛然睁大。%SPEECH_ON%这……这不可能。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，他为何如此害怕。他退后一步。%SPEECH_ON%死人又在大地上行走了！%SPEECH_OFF%真好，你刚还以为，这回的委托会很轻松。 | 亡灵呻吟、哀号，蹒跚进入视野。这里没有强盗，也许已经被这些污秽生物吃了。可委托并未作废：保卫镇子！}

0bb25377d1d2fa9ae152.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]The brigands are in sight! Prepare for battle and protect the town!
0bb25377d1d2fa9ae152.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]强盗出现了！准备战斗，保卫城镇！

8cb10aeafab5e080708f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{The fighting is over and the men idle in a welcome respite. %employer% will be waiting for you back in town. | With the battle over, you survey the corpses littered across the field. It is a gruesome sight, yet for some reason it spurs you with energy. The ghastly hills of dead only remind you of the vitality you've yet to yield to this horrid world. People like %employer% should come and see it, but he won't, so you'll have to go and see him instead. | Flesh and bone scattered across the field, hardly discernible from one owner to the next. Black buzzards cycle overhead, halos of chevron shadows rippling over the dead, the birds waiting for the mourners to clear out. %randombrother% comes to your side and asks if they should start the return trip to %employer%. You leave the sight of the battlefield behind and nod. | A peaceful sort of ruin is made of the dead. Like it was their natural state, stiffened and at a permanent loss, and their whole living was but a fleeting fit of an accident finally come to an end. %randombrother% comes up and asks if you're alright. You're not sure, to be honest, and simply answer that it is time to go see %employer%. | Misshapen men and crooked corpses litter the ground for battle gives the dead no sovereignty over how one comes to a final rest. The bodiless heads look at most peace, for in battle no man or beast has time to truly hack a neck away, it only comes by the quickest and sharpest of blade swings. A part of you hopes to go with such instant finality, but another part hopes you get the chance to take your killer down with you.

 %randombrother% comes to your side and asks for orders. You turn away from the field and tell the %companyname% to get ready to return to %employer%.}
8cb10aeafab5e080708f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{战斗结束了，弟兄们终于得以喘口气，享受片刻清闲。%employer%会在镇上等你。 | 战斗结束，你环顾散落满地的尸体。景象惨不忍睹，却不知为何让你精神一振。这些可怖的尸山，只是在提醒你：自己仍有生机，尚未向这个恐怖的世界屈服。像%employer%这样的人，本该来亲眼看看，可他不会来，你只得去见他。 | 血肉与碎骨洒满战场，几乎分不清谁是谁。黑色秃鹫在上空盘旋，翼影如一圈圈尖角状的光环，在死者身上掠过，等着哀悼的人离开。%randombrother%来到你身旁，问是否该动身回%employer%那里。你把战场抛在身后，点了点头。 | 死者构成一片宁静的废墟，仿佛僵硬、永远失去一切才是他们本来的模样，而那一生不过是一场短暂的意外，如今终于结束了。%randombrother%走来，问你还好吗。说实话，你也不确定，只答道，该去见%employer%了。 | 残缺的人形与扭曲的尸身遍布大地。战斗从不让死者决定，自己该以何种姿态安息。那些与身体分离的头颅看起来最为平静，因为厮杀之中，无论人还是野兽，都没工夫慢慢砍断一根脖子；能斩下头颅的，必定是最快、最利落的一击。你心底有一部分盼着自己也能这样瞬间解脱，另一部分却希望，至少能有机会拉凶手一同上路。

 %randombrother%来到你身旁，请示命令。你转身背对战场，叫%companyname%准备返回%employer%那里。}

0380aa0cacd9f0527ab2.source: We head back to the townhall!

9f509758660d8921e3e9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]Smoke fills the air, smoke and the caustic smell of burning wood, burning livelihoods. %townname%'s folk put all their hopes into hiring the %companyname%, a fatal mistake.
9f509758660d8921e3e9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]浓烟弥漫，木头燃烧的刺鼻气味充斥四周，连同人们的生计一起化为灰烬。%townname%的居民把全部希望寄托在受雇而来的%companyname%身上，这是个致命的错误。

32f1e4d7c4773402457e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]{While preparing to defend %townname%, the local militia has come to your side. They submit to your orders, only asking that you send them where you think they are most needed. | It appears the local militia have joined the battle! A ragtag group of men, but they'll be useful nonetheless. Now the question is, where to send them? | %townname%'s militia has joined the fight! Although a shoddy band of poorly armed men, they are eager to defend home and hovel. They submit to your command, trusting that you will send them to where they are most needed. | You're not alone in this fight! %townname%'s militia have joined you. They're eager to fight and ask you where they are needed most.}
32f1e4d7c4773402457e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]{准备保卫%townname%时，当地民兵来到你身旁。他们愿听从指挥，只请你将他们派往最需要的地方。 | 看来，当地民兵也加入了战斗！虽然装备杂乱，但总能派上用场。现在的问题是，该把他们派到哪里？ | %townname%的民兵参战了！这群人衣甲寒酸、武器简陋，却热切地想保卫家园。他们听从你的指挥，相信你会将他们派往最需要的地方。 | 这一仗，你们并非孤军奋战！%townname%的民兵已前来相助。他们急于上阵，问哪里最需要自己。}

fc78cf13b0eaea0902e8.source: Fall in line, you'll be under my command.

5187056c6e0e57dfa720.source: Go and defend the townhall of %townname%.

b7338cfbb7dc649d287e.source: Go and defend the outskirts of %townname%.

c42ae78c19b1624a2ffa.source: Go hide somewhere and stay out of our way.
c42ae78c19b1624a2ffa.translation: 找个地方躲好，别碍我们的事。

7291ff23703868020203.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]Now that you've decided to take some of the locals under your command, they ask how they should arm themselves for the battle to come.
7291ff23703868020203.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]既然你决定将一些当地人编入麾下，他们便来请示：该带上什么武器，迎接接下来的战斗？

b04716b4f43cc34f2de9.source: Take bows, you'll be shooting from the back.
b04716b4f43cc34f2de9.translation: 拿起弓，你们在后方射击。

35714edf840fbde92b3e.source: Take sword and shield, you'll be fighting in the front.
35714edf840fbde92b3e.translation: 拿起剑盾，你们到前排作战。

2cbf4dc63d919b7ea2e7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]{The fighting over, one of the militiamen that helped in the defense comes to you personally, bending low and offering his sword.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, my time with the town of %townname% is at an end. But the prowess of the %companyname% is truly an amazing sight. If you would permit it, sir, I would love to fight alongside you and your men.%SPEECH_OFF% | With the battle over, one of the militiamen from %townname% states that he will gladly come and fight for the %companyname%. Partly because he was most impressed with the mercenary band's fighting, and partly because being conscripted into the town's defense is neither financially or physically healthy.}
2cbf4dc63d919b7ea2e7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]{战斗结束，一名协助防守的民兵亲自来见你，深深鞠躬，献上自己的剑。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我在%townname%的日子已经到头了。而%companyname%的勇武，实在令人叹服。若你允许，我愿与你和弟兄们并肩作战。%SPEECH_OFF% | 战斗结束后，%townname%的一名民兵表示，愿意为%companyname%效力。一来，佣兵们的表现令他深感钦佩；二来，被征召守城，对钱袋与身体都没什么好处。}

47ee9d51772dff89a344.source: This is no place for you.

36e5419fcb316fc41d28.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{While keeping watch for the brigands, a peasant comes up telling you that a group of the thugs attacked nearby, taking off with a group of hostages. You shake your head in disbelief. How were they able to sneak in and do this? The layman shakes his head, too.%SPEECH_ON%I thought y'all were supposed to help us. Why didn't you do anything?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if the brigands have gone far. The peasant shakes his head. Looks like you still have a shot to get them back. | A man wearing rags and carrying a broken pitchfork sprints up to your company. He drops and wails at your feet.%SPEECH_ON%The brigands attacked! Where were you? They killed people... burned some... and... and they took some prisoner! Please, go save them!%SPEECH_OFF%You eye %randombrother% and nod.%SPEECH_ON%Get the men ready. We need to chase these thugs down before they escape entirely.%SPEECH_OFF% | You have your eyes peeled to the horizons, looking for any sight or sound of vagabond or vagathief. Suddenly, %randombrother% comes to you with a woman by his side. She tells a story that the thugs have already attacked, killing a great number of peasants and those they didn't kill they made off with. The mercenary nods.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like they snuck past us, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You've only one choice now - go get those people back! | Stationing yourself close to %townname%, you anticipate the brigands' attack. You thought this would be easy, but the sudden arrival of a crazed layman says otherwise. The peasant explains that the marauders have already ambushed the outskirts. They slaughtered everyone they could, then made off with a few men, women, and children. The man, either drunk or in shock, slurs his pleas.%SPEECH_ON%Get... get them back, would ya?%SPEECH_OFF% | Keeping watch, a few angry peasants take the roads, storming toward you in a swirl of mob anger.%SPEECH_ON%I thought we were paying you to protect us! Where were you!%SPEECH_OFF%They are covered in blood. Some are half-clothed. A woman hangs a breast, too angry to care about the indecency. You ask the group what it is they are talking about. A man, clutching a cane close to his chest, explains that the raiders and thugs had already attacked, taking to a nearby hamlet. They slaughtered everything in sight then, with their bloodlust satiated, took as many prisoners as they could.

You nod.%SPEECH_ON%We'll get them back.%SPEECH_OFF%}
36e5419fcb316fc41d28.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{你正警戒强盗来袭，一名农民跑来告诉你，一群暴徒已经袭击了附近，还掳走了一批人质。你难以置信地摇头。他们是怎么偷偷溜进来干下这事的？农民也摇着头。%SPEECH_ON%我还以为你们是来帮我们的。你们怎么什么都没做？%SPEECH_OFF%你问强盗是否走远。农民摇了摇头。看来，还有机会把人救回来。 | 一个衣衫褴褛、拿着断草叉的男人冲向战团。他跪倒在你脚边，放声哭喊。%SPEECH_ON%强盗打来了！你们当时在哪儿？他们杀了人……烧死了一些……还……还抓走了一些！求求你，快去救他们！%SPEECH_OFF%你望向%randombrother%，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%让弟兄们准备好。得在这帮暴徒彻底跑掉之前追上他们。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你紧盯着远方，不放过游民或游匪的一点动静。忽然，%randombrother%带着一个女人走来。她说，暴徒早已发动袭击，杀了许多农民，没杀的则统统掳走了。佣兵点点头。%SPEECH_ON%看来他们从我们眼皮底下溜过去了，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%如今你只有一个选择：把那些人救回来！ | 你在%townname%附近驻守，等待强盗来袭。本以为这差事轻而易举，可一个惊慌失措的平民突然到来，打破了你的想法。农民说，劫掠者已经突袭了外围，能杀的人都杀了，又掳走几个男人、女人和孩子。那人不知是喝醉了，还是惊吓过度，含混地哀求。%SPEECH_ON%救……把他们救回来，行吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你正在放哨，一群愤怒的农民沿路而来，气势汹汹地冲向你。%SPEECH_ON%我们付钱是让你们保护我们！你们都去哪儿了！%SPEECH_OFF%他们满身是血，有些人衣不蔽体。一个女人袒着一边乳房，怒火让她根本顾不上遮掩。你问他们到底出了什么事。一个把拐杖紧抱在胸前的男人解释说，劫掠者和暴徒早已袭击了附近的村落。他们见什么杀什么，直到嗜血的欲望得到满足，又把能抓的人尽数掳走。

你点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%我们会把他们救回来。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a301ac2c3f37f5c8f9cd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{Sheathing your sword, you order %randombrother% to go free the prisoners. A litany of bewildered peasants are freed from leather leashes, chains, and dog cages. They thank you for your timely arrival, and for the violence you brought to the brigand. | The brigands are slaughtered to a man. You set your men out to go rescue every peasant they can find. Each one comes together, hugging and crying, mad with happiness that they have survived this horrifying ordeal. | After killing the last brigand around, you tell the company to go around freeing the hostages the vagabonds had taken. Each one comes to you in turn, some kissing your hand, others your feet. You only tell them to get back to %townname% as you will do yourself.}
a301ac2c3f37f5c8f9cd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{你收剑入鞘，命%randombrother%去释放俘虏。一群惊魂未定的农民，从皮绳、锁链和狗笼中得到解救。他们感谢你及时赶到，也感谢你施加在强盗身上的暴力。 | 强盗已被杀得一个不剩。你派弟兄们去救出所有能找到的农民。获救者聚在一起，拥抱哭泣，为熬过这场可怕劫难而欣喜若狂。 | 杀掉附近最后一个强盗后，你让战团四处解救被这些恶徒掳来的人质。他们依次来见你，有的亲吻你的手，有的亲吻你的脚。你只叫他们返回%townname%，自己也将一同回去。}

c2d9b45a9687ad3e40d1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{Unfortunately, the brigands got away with the hostages. May the gods be with those sorry souls now. | You couldn't do it - you couldn't save those poor peasants. Now only the gods know what will happen to them. | Sadly, the marauders got away with their human cargo in tow. Those poor folks will have to fend for themselves now. The stories you hear, however, tell you they will not fare well at all. | The brigands got away, their prisoners alongside with them. You've no idea what will happen to those people now, but you know it isn't good. Slavery. Torture. Death. You're not sure which is the worst.}
c2d9b45a9687ad3e40d1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{可惜，强盗带着人质逃走了。愿诸神护佑那些可怜人。 | 你没能做到，没能救下那些可怜农民。如今，只有诸神知道，他们会遭遇什么。 | 遗憾的是，劫掠者带着他们的活人货物逃走了。那些可怜人只能自己求生，可你听过的故事表明，他们绝不会有好下场。 | 强盗逃走了，俘虏也被一同带走。你不知道那些人接下来会遭遇什么，只知道绝非好事。奴役，折磨，死亡。你甚至不确定，哪一种最糟。}

43efe95ef1daac0f9ce9.source: {They won't like that in %townname%... | Maybe they can be bought back...}
43efe95ef1daac0f9ce9.translation: {%townname%的人听说后，肯定不会高兴…… | 也许能花钱把他们赎回来……}

ed113e548c676cee98dd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You return to %employer% looking rightfully smug.%SPEECH_ON%Work's done.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods, tipping a goblet of wine while not necessarily offering it.%SPEECH_ON%Yes. The town is eternally grateful for your help. They are also... monetarily grateful.%SPEECH_OFF%The man gestures toward the corner of the room. You see a satchel of crowns there.%SPEECH_ON%%reward% crowns, just as we had agreed. Thanks again, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes your return with a glass of wine.%SPEECH_ON%Drink up, sellsword, you've earned it.%SPEECH_OFF%It tastes... particular. Us, the good guys.%SPEECH_OFF%The other eyebrow goes up.%SPEECH_ON%Well... anyway, your payment, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%The man hands over a chest of %reward% crowns. | When you return to %employer% you find his room has almost been packed up, everything ready to move and go. The people here love you now.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, but the love of the common man is not what brought you here.%SPEECH_ON%What else have I earned?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% smiles.%SPEECH_ON%A man on point. I bet that's what gives you your... edge. Of course, you've also earned this.%SPEECH_OFF%He heaves a wooden chest onto his desk and unlatches it. The shine of gold crowns warms your heart. | %employer%'s staring out his window when you enter. He's almost in a dreamstate, head bent low to his hand. He unlatches it as he sets it on the table. A glorious pile of gold crowns stare you in the face. %employer% grins.%SPEECH_ON%Now who is dreaming?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s at his desk when you enter.%SPEECH_ON%I saw a good deal of it. The killing, the dying.%SPEECH_OFF%You take a seat.%SPEECH_ON%Hope you enjoyed the show. Viewing's ain't free, though.%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods, taking a satchel and handing it over.%SPEECH_ON%I'd pay for an encore, but I'm not sure %townname% wants that.%SPEECH_OFF%}
ed113e548c676cee98dd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你回去见%employer%，脸上带着理所当然的得意。%SPEECH_ON%活干完了。%SPEECH_OFF%他点头，抬了抬酒杯，却未必有请你喝的意思。%SPEECH_ON%是的。镇民永远感激你的帮助。而且，他们也会……拿钱表示感激。%SPEECH_OFF%他朝房间角落示意。那里放着一袋克朗。%SPEECH_ON%%reward%克朗，和约好的一样。再次感谢，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%拿着一杯酒迎接你回来。%SPEECH_ON%喝吧，佣兵，这是你应得的。%SPEECH_OFF%酒的滋味……颇为特别。若说傲慢也有味道，大概就是这样。雇主绕过书桌，喜气洋洋地坐下。%SPEECH_ON%你果然兑现承诺，保住了镇子！真让我刮目相看。%SPEECH_OFF%他点点头，用酒杯朝一只木箱示意。%SPEECH_ON%实在是刮目相看。%SPEECH_OFF%你打开箱子，里面堆着金灿灿的克朗。 | %employer%请你进屋。%SPEECH_ON%我在窗边看着呢，你知道吗？全看见了。嗯，大部分吧。精彩的部分，至少是。%SPEECH_OFF%你扬起一边眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%噢，别那样看我。我可不觉得看得开心有什么好羞愧的。我们还活着，对吧？我们这些好人。%SPEECH_OFF%你的另一边眉毛也扬了起来。%SPEECH_ON%好吧……总之，这是约好的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%他递给你一箱%reward%克朗。 | 你回去见%employer%，发现房间几乎已收拾一空，东西都打包妥当，随时可以搬走。你半开玩笑地表示关切。%SPEECH_ON%准备去哪儿？%SPEECH_OFF%他在椅子里坐定。%SPEECH_ON%我确实没什么把握，佣兵。这也不能怪我吧？不过，你尽可以放心，我付钱的本事不用怀疑。%SPEECH_OFF%他伸手在桌面上一带。角落里放着一只钱袋，被硬币塞得鼓鼓囊囊。%SPEECH_ON%%reward%克朗，说到做到。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进门时，%employer%从椅子上站起，向你鞠了一躬，神情既难以置信，又十分诚恳。他朝窗外示意，那里传来农民欢欣的喧闹声。%SPEECH_ON%听见了吗？这是你赢来的，佣兵。这里的人现在都爱戴你。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，可平民的爱戴不是你此行的目的。%SPEECH_ON%我还赢来了什么？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%开口便直指要害。想必这就是你如此……锋利的缘故。当然，你还赢来了这个。%SPEECH_OFF%他把一只木箱搬上书桌，打开搭扣。金克朗的光芒让你心头一暖。 | 你进门时，%employer%正望着窗外，低头以手支额，像在做梦。你打断了他的思绪。%SPEECH_ON%在想我？%SPEECH_OFF%他轻笑着，打趣般捂住胸口。%SPEECH_ON%你真是我的梦中之人，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他穿过房间，从书架上取下一只箱子，放到桌上时顺手打开。金光灿灿的克朗堆在你面前。%employer%咧嘴笑道。%SPEECH_ON%现在轮到谁做梦了？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进门时，%employer%正坐在桌前。%SPEECH_ON%我看见不少。杀人的，被杀的。%SPEECH_OFF%你坐了下来。%SPEECH_ON%希望这场戏让你看得尽兴。不过，看戏可不免费。%SPEECH_OFF%他点点头，拿起一只钱袋递过来。%SPEECH_ON%再演一场，我也愿意付钱，只是不知道%townname%乐不乐意。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f9e88b1fb2bea6b527a7.source: {The %companyname% will make good use of this. | Payment for a hard day's work.}
f9e88b1fb2bea6b527a7.translation: {%companyname%会好好用这笔钱。 | 辛苦一天，该拿的报酬。}

132917ddbcba4108cd8b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your return with a point out his window.%SPEECH_ON%You see that? There, in the distance.%SPEECH_OFF%You join his side. He asks.%SPEECH_ON%What is it that you see?%SPEECH_OFF%There's smoke on the horizon. You let him know that's what you see.%SPEECH_ON%Right, smoke. I didn't hire you to let the brigands make smoke, understand? Of course... most of the town is still upright...%SPEECH_OFF%He heaves a satchel into your chest.%SPEECH_ON%Good work, sellsword. Just... not good enough.%SPEECH_OFF% | You return to %employer%, he looks a mix of happy and sad, somewhere between drunk and straight. This is not the look you want to see.%SPEECH_ON%You did good, sellsword. Word has it you laid those brigands utterly flat. Word also has it that they burned parts of our outskirts.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Not worth lying about what you can't cover up.%SPEECH_ON%You'll be getting paid, but you have to understand that it takes money to rebuild those areas. Obviously, the crowns for that will be coming out of your pockets...%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s slouched in his seat when you return.%SPEECH_ON%Most in %townname% are happy, but a few are not. Can you guess which of those aren't?%SPEECH_OFF%The brigands did manage to destroy a few parts of the outskirts, but this here was rhetorical question.%SPEECH_ON%I need funds to help rebuild the territories those marauders managed to get their hands on. I'm sure you understand, then, why you'll be receiving less pay...%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug. It is what it is. | %employer%'s at his bookshelf. He takes a book, spinning around and opening it all in one move. He lays it across his table.%SPEECH_ON%There's numbers there. I'm sure you can't read them, but here's what they say: the brigands managed to destroy parts of this town and now I need crowns to help rebuild. Unfortunately, I don't have that many crowns on hand to do this. I'm sure you understand this predicament.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and state the obvious.%SPEECH_ON%It's coming out of my pay.%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods and slides an open hand across his desk, drawing your attention to a satchel. There's no point in arguing about pay. You take the sack and make your leave.}
132917ddbcba4108cd8b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer%见你回来，伸手指向窗外。%SPEECH_ON%看见了吗？那边，远处。%SPEECH_OFF%你走到他身旁。他又问。%SPEECH_ON%你看见了什么？%SPEECH_OFF%天边有烟，你便照实说了。%SPEECH_ON%没错，烟。我雇你来，可不是让那些强盗放烟的，明白吗？当然……镇子大部分地方还立着……%SPEECH_OFF%他把一只钱袋扔到你胸前。%SPEECH_ON%干得不错，佣兵。只是……还不够好。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回去见%employer%。他脸上喜忧参半，似醉非醉。你可不想看到这副表情。%SPEECH_ON%干得不错，佣兵。听说你把那些强盗收拾得干干净净。还听说，他们烧了我们一部分外围聚落。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。瞒不住的事，撒谎也没用。%SPEECH_ON%钱会付给你，不过你得明白，重建那些地方需要钱。显然，这笔克朗只能从你口袋里出了……%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%正瘫坐在椅子里。%SPEECH_ON%%townname%的大多数人都很高兴，但也有些人不高兴。你能猜到是哪些人吗？%SPEECH_OFF%强盗确实毁了几处外围聚落，不过他这话本就没打算让你回答。%SPEECH_ON%那些劫掠者糟蹋的地方，需要拨钱重建。所以，我想你也明白，为什么这次报酬要少一些……%SPEECH_OFF%你耸了耸肩。也只能这样了。 | %employer%站在书架旁。他抽出一本账簿，转身翻开，一气呵成，随后摊在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%上面都是数字。我想你也看不懂，就直说吧：强盗毁了镇上的一些地方，现在我需要克朗来重建。不巧，我手头没那么多钱。我想你能理解我的难处。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，说出那个显而易见的结论。%SPEECH_ON%从我的报酬里扣。%SPEECH_OFF%他点头，摊开的手掌从桌面划过，示意你去看一只钱袋。为钱争吵已无意义。你拿起钱袋，转身离开。}

880b1f9bf6b3c42ecdfe.source: {That's just half of what we agreed to! | It is what it is...}
880b1f9bf6b3c42ecdfe.translation: {这才是说好的一半！ | 世道就是如此……}

3562f3b5735ff101bf0c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your return with a point out his window.%SPEECH_ON%You see that? There, in the distance.%SPEECH_OFF%You join his side. He asks.%SPEECH_ON%What is it that you see?%SPEECH_OFF%There's smoke on the horizon. You let him know that's what you see.%SPEECH_OFF%Right, smoke. I didn't hire you to let the brigands make smoke, understand? Of course... most of the town is still upright...%SPEECH_OFF%He heaves a satchel into your chest.%SPEECH_ON%Good work, sellsword. Just... not good enough. And a shame about those poor peasants you let those damned brigands run off with.%SPEECH_OFF% | You return to %employer%, he looks a mix of happy and sad, somewhere between drunk and straight. This is not the look you want to see.%SPEECH_ON%You did good, sellsword. Word has it you laid those brigands utterly flat. Word also has it that they burned parts of our outskirts.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Not worth lying about what you can't cover up.%SPEECH_ON%You'll be getting paid, but you have to understand that it takes money to rebuild those areas. And what of those poor people you let the raiders kidnap? Their families are going to want help, too. Obviously, the crowns for that will be coming out of your pockets...%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s slouched in his seat when you return.%SPEECH_ON%Most in %townname% are happy, but a few are not. Can you guess which of those aren't?%SPEECH_OFF%The brigands did manage to destroy a few parts of the outskirts, but this here was rhetorical question.%SPEECH_ON%I need funds to help rebuild the territories those marauders managed to get their hands on. I also need crowns to help the survivors of those peasants you failed to save. I'm sure you understand, then, why you'll be receiving less pay...%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug. It is what it is. | %employer%'s at his bookshelf. He takes a book, spinning around and opening it all in one move. He lays it across his table.%SPEECH_ON%There's numbers there. I'm sure you can't read them, but here's what they say: the brigands managed to destroy parts of this town and now I need crowns to help rebuild. Unfortunately, I don't have that many crowns on hand to do this. I'm sure you understand this predicament.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and state the obvious.%SPEECH_ON%It's coming out of my pay. And those peasants you let the brigands run off with? They have families. Survivors. They'll be getting a share of our 'agreement,' too.%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods and slides an open hand across his desk, drawing your attention to a satchel. There's no point in arguing about pay. You take the sack and make your leave.}
3562f3b5735ff101bf0c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer%见你回来，伸手指向窗外。%SPEECH_ON%看见了吗？那边，远处。%SPEECH_OFF%你走到他身旁。他又问。%SPEECH_ON%你看见了什么？%SPEECH_OFF%天边有烟，你便照实说了。%SPEECH_OFF%没错，烟。我雇你来，可不是让那些强盗放烟的，明白吗？当然……镇子大部分地方还立着……%SPEECH_OFF%他把一只钱袋扔到你胸前。%SPEECH_ON%干得不错，佣兵。只是……还不够好。还有那些可怜的农民，你竟让该死的强盗把他们掳走了，真遗憾。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回去见%employer%。他脸上喜忧参半，似醉非醉。你可不想看到这副表情。%SPEECH_ON%干得不错，佣兵。听说你把那些强盗收拾得干干净净。还听说，他们烧了我们一部分外围聚落。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。瞒不住的事，撒谎也没用。%SPEECH_ON%钱会付给你，不过你得明白，重建那些地方需要钱。还有那些被劫掠者掳走的可怜人呢？他们的家人也需要帮助。显然，这笔克朗只能从你口袋里出了……%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%正瘫坐在椅子里。%SPEECH_ON%%townname%的大多数人都很高兴，但也有些人不高兴。你能猜到是哪些人吗？%SPEECH_OFF%强盗确实毁了几处外围聚落，不过他这话本就没打算让你回答。%SPEECH_ON%那些劫掠者糟蹋的地方，需要拨钱重建。你没救下的那些农民，他们留下的家属也需要克朗接济。所以，我想你也明白，为什么这次报酬要少一些……%SPEECH_OFF%你耸了耸肩。也只能这样了。 | %employer%站在书架旁。他抽出一本账簿，转身翻开，一气呵成，随后摊在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%上面都是数字。我想你也看不懂，就直说吧：强盗毁了镇上的一些地方，现在我需要克朗来重建。不巧，我手头没那么多钱。我想你能理解我的难处。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，说出那个显而易见的结论。%SPEECH_ON%从我的报酬里扣。还有那些被强盗掳走的农民？他们有家人，有留下的亲属。也得从咱们“约好”的那份里，分一部分给他们。%SPEECH_OFF%他点头，摊开的手掌从桌面划过，示意你去看一只钱袋。为钱争吵已无意义。你拿起钱袋，转身离开。}

002d9f3be18e7ff235af.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{When you enter %employer%'s room, he tells you to close the door behind you. Just as the latch clicks, the man slams you with a stream of obscenities which you couldn't hope to keep track of. Calming down, his voice - and language - return to some level of normalcy.%SPEECH_ON%Every bit of our outskirts were destroyed. What is it, exactly, did you think I was paying you for? Get out of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s slamming back goblets of wine when you enter. There's the din of angry peasants squalling outside his window.%SPEECH_ON%Hear that? They'll have my head if I pay you, sellsword. You had one job, one job! Protect this town. And you couldn't do it. So now you could do one thing and it comes free: get the hell out of my sight.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% clasps his hands over his desk.%SPEECH_ON%What is it, exactly, are you expecting to get here? I'm surprised you returned to me at all. Half the town is on fire and the other half is already ash. I didn't hire you to produce smoke and desolation, sellsword. Get the hell out of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | When you return to %employer%, he's holding a mug of ale. His hand his shaking. His face is red.%SPEECH_ON%It's taking everything in me to not throw this in your face right now.%SPEECH_OFF%Just in case, the man finishes the drink in one big gulp. He slams it on his desk.%SPEECH_ON%This town expected you protect them. Instead, the brigands swarmed the outskirts like they were taking a goddam leisure trip! I'm not in the business of giving marauders a good time, sellsword. Get the farkin' hell out of here!%SPEECH_OFF%}
002d9f3be18e7ff235af.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{你进入%employer%的房间，他叫你关门。门闩刚咔哒扣上，一连串脏话便劈头盖脸砸来，快得你根本记不住。冷静下来后，他的声音和措辞才恢复几分正常。%SPEECH_ON%城外每一处都被毁了。你到底以为，我付钱是让你干什么？滚出去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进门时，%employer%正一杯接一杯地灌酒。窗外传来愤怒农民的叫嚷。%SPEECH_ON%听见了吗？佣兵，我要是给你钱，他们就会要我的脑袋。你只有一件事要做，就一件！保住镇子。可你没做到。现在还有一件事，不用收钱：滚出我的视线。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%在桌前交拢双手。%SPEECH_ON%你到底还指望在这儿拿到什么？我倒惊讶，你竟有脸回来。半个镇子在烧，另外半个已经成灰。佣兵，我雇你可不是为了制造浓烟与废墟。给我滚出去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回到%employer%处，他手里端着一杯麦酒，手在发抖，脸涨得通红。%SPEECH_ON%我现在拼尽全力，才没把这杯东西泼到你脸上。%SPEECH_OFF%以防万一，他干脆一口喝尽，猛地把杯子拍在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%镇民指望你保护他们，结果强盗涌进城外，简直像他娘的在郊游！佣兵，我可不是花钱让劫匪玩得痛快的。给我他娘的滚出去！%SPEECH_OFF%}

4576219144a925979bd6.source: {Damn this peasantfolk! | We should have asked for more payment in advance... | Damnit!}
4576219144a925979bd6.translation: {这群该死的农民！ | 早该多要点预付款…… | 该死！}

bbd0550e97121a3906ad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{When you enter %employer%'s room, he tells you to close the door behind you. Just as the latch clicks, the man slams you with a stream of obscenities which you couldn't hope to keep track of. Calming down, his voice - and language - return to some level of normalcy.%SPEECH_ON%Every bit of our outskirts were destroyed. People were even taken to the old gods know what ends! What is it, exactly, did you think I was paying you for? Get out of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s slamming back goblets of wine when you enter. There's the din of angry peasants squalling outside his window.%SPEECH_ON%Hear that? They'll have my head if I pay you, sellsword. You had one job, one job! Protect this town. And you couldn't do it.
