Hell, you couldn't even save those poor peasants thatgot kidnapped! So now you could do one thing and it comes free: get the hell out of my sight.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% clasps his hands over his desk.%SPEECH_ON%What is it, exactly, are you expecting to get here? I'm surprised you returned to me at all. Half the town is on fire and the other half is already ash. Survivors tell me that their family members were even kidnapped! Do you know what happens to those taken by raiders? I didn't hire you to produce smoke and desolation, sellsword. Get the hell out of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | When you return to %employer%, he's holding a mug of ale. His hand his shaking. His face is red.%SPEECH_ON%It's taking everything in me to not throw this in your face right now.%SPEECH_OFF%Just in case his rage gets the best of him, the man finishes the drink in one big gulp. He slams it on his desk.%SPEECH_ON%This town expected you protect them. Instead, the brigands swarmed the outskirts like they were taking a goddam leisure trip! I'm not in the business of giving marauders a good time, sellsword. Get the farkin' hell out of here!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% laughs when you step into his room.%SPEECH_ON%The outskirts are destroyed. The people of %townname% are in an uproar, at least those alive to be angry in the first place, that is. And what's more? You let a few of our townspeople get taken by these monsters!%SPEECH_OFF%The man shakes his head and points his hand to the door.%SPEECH_ON%I don't know what you expected me to pay you for, but it wasn't this.%SPEECH_OFF%}
bbd0550e97121a3906ad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{你走进%employer%的房间，他叫你把门关上。门闩刚咔哒落下，劈头盖脸的脏话便朝你砸来，快得你根本记不住。他终于冷静下来，语气和用词也多少恢复了正常。%SPEECH_ON%外围全毁了。还有人被掳走，只有旧神知道他们会落到什么下场！你到底以为我付钱是让你干什么的？滚出去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进门时，%employer%正在一杯接一杯地灌酒。窗外传来愤怒农民的叫骂声。%SPEECH_ON%听见了吗？我要是还付钱给你，他们就会要我的脑袋，佣兵。你只有一项任务，就一项！保护这座镇子。可你没做到。见鬼，你连那些被掳走的可怜农民都没能救下！现在，你倒是可以免费替我做件事：滚出我的视线。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%双手交握，放在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%你到这儿来，到底还指望拿到什么？你居然敢回来，真让我吃惊。半座镇子还在烧，另一半已经成了灰。幸存者告诉我，他们的家人甚至被掳走了！你知道落进劫掠者手里会怎样吗？我雇你可不是为了换来浓烟和废墟，佣兵。给我滚出去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回去见%employer%时，他正握着一杯麦酒。手在发抖，脸涨得通红。%SPEECH_ON%我现在得拼命忍着，才没把这杯酒泼到你脸上。%SPEECH_OFF%为免怒火失控，他一大口喝干杯中酒，将空杯重重砸在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%镇上的人指望你保护他们。结果呢，强盗涌进外围，简直他妈像在郊游！我可不是花钱让劫掠者来找乐子的，佣兵。给我他妈的滚出去！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进房间时，%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%外围毁了。%townname%的人都闹翻了——至少那些还活着、还有机会发火的人是这样。还有呢？你居然让那些畜生掳走了我们几个镇民！%SPEECH_OFF%他摇摇头，指向门口。%SPEECH_ON%我不知道你凭什么觉得我还该付钱，但我花钱买的绝不是这种结果。%SPEECH_OFF%}

8112de61125792eb451e.source: Brave men defending their homes with their lives. Farmers, craftsmen, artisans - but not one real soldier.
8112de61125792eb451e.translation: 一群舍命保卫家园的勇士。他们是农夫、工匠和手艺人，却没有一个是真正的士兵。

d558dc5c63ed968ea611.translation: 守住了城镇，击退了强盗

279d507852a3ac23820f.source: Failed to defend the town against brigands
279d507852a3ac23820f.translation: 未能保住遭强盗袭击的城镇

85e11db5309b7cf58218.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{When you see %employer% he's got sweat pouring down his face and dabbing it with a nicely embroidered cloth that seems to achieve nothing in stemming the tide.%SPEECH_ON%Mercenary, it is oh so good  to see you! Please, please come in and listen to what I have to say.%SPEECH_OFF%You cautiously walk into the room and take a seat, glancing momentarily to make sure nobody was hiding behind the crook of the door or behind one of the bookshelves lining the walls. %employer% pushes a map across his table.%SPEECH_ON%See those green markings? Those are greenskin movements, tracked by my scouts. Sometimes they tell me by word, sometimes they don't tell me at all. Those scouts just... poof, disappear. It doesn't take a genius to know what really happened to them though, does it?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what the man wants. He slams the map, his fist landing square on %townname%.%SPEECH_ON%Can you not see? They're coming this way and I need you to help defend us!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s nervously picking his nails when you find him. He's got them down to nubs by this point, just flecks of skin and blood shaving away at this point.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you for coming, sellsword. I'll be frank with you, the greenskins are coming.%SPEECH_OFF%Using a hand for height measurements, you ask what sort of greenskin, the ones yeigh big, or the ones about hmmm, big. %employer% shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%I've no idea. My scouts keep disappearing and the villagers that keep arriving aren't exactly the most accurate of witnesses to depend upon. All you need to know is that we need your help, because those greenskins are coming this way.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s drunk and nestled deep into his chair. He thumbs toward an opened book on his table.%SPEECH_ON%Have you heard of the Battle of Many Names? It went down about ten years ago when the orcs came streaming into man's land, and when man fielded his armies and said, No.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, knowing the battle well, and the war it helped end. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%Unfortunately, we have reason to believe that they're coming back. Greenskins, don't know what type, don't know how tall or what sort, but this way they do indeed come.%SPEECH_OFF%He throws back the rest of his drink, swallowing as though it were to be the last thing that'd go down his throat before an executioner removed his head.%SPEECH_ON%Will you stay here and protect us? For the right price, of course. I haven't forgotten your station yet.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s by his window when you enter.%SPEECH_ON%You hear that?%SPEECH_OFF%A throng of people are practically baying in the streets, a mix of apathetic moans and outright horrified crying.%SPEECH_ON%That's what you hear when the greenskins are coming.%SPEECH_OFF%The man shutters the windows and turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%I know it's a lot to ask, but we do have money so I'll go ahead and ask anyway. Will you help protect %townname%?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s fighting off a crowd when you find him.%SPEECH_ON%Everyone calm down! Just calm down!%SPEECH_OFF%Someone throws an onion, battering the man upside the head with a tearjerking rap of sour vegetable. Someone else quickly scurries to pick it up and take a bite. %employer% points you out in the crowd.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! I am so glad you came!%SPEECH_OFF%He fights through the crowd. He leans in close to your ear, yet still has to shout to be heard.%SPEECH_ON%We have money! We have what you need! Just help protect this town from the greenskins!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s employees are rummaging about his room, collecting scrolls and books alike before hurrying off to who knows where. The man himself is simply sitting in his chair, occasionally drinking from a goblet while perusing a map. He waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%Take a seat. Don't mind my workers.%SPEECH_OFF%You do as asked, but it's hard to ignore the frenzy around you. %employer% sits back, tenting his fingers atop his belly.%SPEECH_ON%I'm sure you've noticed things are rather unusual around here. That's because a large band of greenskins have been spotted and they're heading this way, murdering and destroying all that stands before them. Obviously, I'd like you to help defend %townname% before we all end up in some scribe's footnote, understand?%SPEECH_OFF% | You enter %employer%'s abode and can't help but notice there's mud all over the floor and a squelched fire in his pit. Some of his workers hurry about with scrolls stuffed in their arms. You can barely even see their heads over all the paper. You see %employer% standing in the midst of the chaos, simply directing his employees to do this or that. When you walk up to him he simply nods.%SPEECH_ON%Greenskins are coming. What kind? I don't know. What I do know is what will happen if I can't help defend this town which is why we're doing a little bit of prep work here, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod in return, but then ask what else he wants.%SPEECH_ON%Help us fight these greenskins, of course. There's plenty of money in it for you, obviously.%SPEECH_OFF% | Peasants have come to %employer%'s abode. They're carrying armfuls of belongings, a litter of it trailing behind their every step, so urgent to flee they don't even bother picking up any of it. %employer% himself sees you through one of his window's and waves you to come in through a side door. When you sneak in, he simply plops down in his chair and pours you a drink.%SPEECH_ON%Greenskins are coming and I don't believe there are enough men on hand to defend %townname%. Obviously, I'm willing to call on and pay for your services to help keep %townname% safe from this green menace.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man is standing outside %employer%'s abode, two painted slabs of wood dressed over himself. On each board is written some prophetic doomsayer's tale. You ignore the man and enter the house. %employer% is standing there, laughing and shaking his head.%SPEECH_ON%That guy standing out there ain't wrong. My scouts have been reporting greenskins moving through the area for a while. I should have listened for how my scouts haven't said anything for a good week, presumably because those very same greenskins got their hands on them. Now I got the commonfolk coming to me with horror stories of what is going on out there, and how a large horde of those awful creatures are coming this way.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns to you, grinning, madness spinning in his grin.%SPEECH_ON%So what say you and I broker a deal and shut up that doomsayer's shrill crying? Will you help protect %townname%?%SPEECH_OFF%}
85e11db5309b7cf58218.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{见到%employer%时，他满脸都是汗，正用一块绣工精美的手帕不停擦拭，可似乎怎么也止不住。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，见到你真是太好了！请，请进来，听我说。%SPEECH_OFF%你谨慎地走进房间，坐了下来，顺带扫了一眼门后的角落和靠墙的书架，确认没有人藏在那里。%employer%把一张地图从桌子对面推了过来。%SPEECH_ON%看见那些绿色标记了吗？那是绿皮的动向，由我的斥候探明。有时候他们回来亲口报告，有时候就再无消息。那些斥候就这么……噗，消失了。不过，不用多聪明，也能猜到他们出了什么事，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你问他到底要做什么。他猛拍地图，拳头正砸在%townname%上。%SPEECH_ON%这还看不出来吗？它们正往这里来，我需要你帮我们守住这里！%SPEECH_OFF% | 找到%employer%时，他正紧张地抠着指甲。指甲已经被抠得所剩无几，此刻剥下来的只剩碎皮和血。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你肯来，佣兵。我就直说了，绿皮要来了。%SPEECH_OFF%你用手比画着高度，问是哪种绿皮：这么高的，还是……唔，这么高的？%employer%耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我不知道。斥候一个接一个失踪，不断逃来的村民也算不上可靠的目击者。你只需要知道，我们需要你的帮助，因为那些绿皮正朝这里来。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%醉醺醺地深陷在椅子里，用拇指指了指桌上摊开的书。%SPEECH_ON%你听说过众名之战吗？大约十年前，兽人潮水般涌入人类的土地，人类列阵出兵，对它们说：不。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。那场战役，以及它帮助终结的战争，你都很清楚。他继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%可惜，我们有理由相信，它们又回来了。绿皮，不知道是哪一种，不知道多高多大，但它们确实正朝这里来。%SPEECH_OFF%他仰头喝光杯中残酒，吞咽的模样，仿佛这是刽子手砍下他的脑袋前，最后一次有东西滑过喉咙。%SPEECH_ON%你愿意留下来保护我们吗？当然，价钱好商量。我还没忘记你是干哪一行的。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进去时，%employer%正站在窗边。%SPEECH_ON%听见了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%街上挤着一群人，近乎哀号，麻木的呻吟和惊恐的哭喊混作一团。%SPEECH_ON%绿皮要来的时候，听见的就是这个。%SPEECH_OFF%他关上百叶窗，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%我知道这要求不小，但我们确实有钱，所以还是得问一句。你愿意帮忙守卫%townname%吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 找到%employer%时，他正竭力应付一群人。%SPEECH_ON%大家冷静！都冷静下来！%SPEECH_OFF%有人扔来一个洋葱，酸冲冲的菜疙瘩砸在他脑袋侧面，疼得人眼泪直冒。另一个人赶紧窜过去捡起来，咬了一口。%employer%从人群中认出了你。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！你来了真是太好了！%SPEECH_OFF%他奋力挤过人群，凑到你耳边，却还是得扯着嗓子喊，你才能听清。%SPEECH_ON%我们有钱！你要的我们都有！只求你帮这座镇子挡住绿皮！%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的雇员在房里四处翻找，把卷轴和书籍收拢起来，匆匆搬往不知什么地方。他本人只是坐在椅子里看地图，偶尔端起高脚杯喝上一口。他招手让你进来。%SPEECH_ON%坐吧，别管我的人。%SPEECH_OFF%你依言坐下，却很难不去注意周围的慌乱。%employer%向后靠去，双手指尖相抵，搭在肚子上。%SPEECH_ON%想必你已经看出来，这里有点不寻常。那是因为有人发现一大群绿皮正往这边来，沿途见人就杀，见东西就毁。很显然，我希望你帮忙守卫%townname%，免得我们全变成哪个抄书人笔下的一条脚注。明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的住处，立刻注意到满地泥污，壁炉里的火也被浇灭了。几个雇员匆匆来去，怀里塞满卷轴，纸堆高得几乎把脑袋都挡住了。%employer%站在混乱之中，指挥手下做这做那。你走到他面前，他只是点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%绿皮要来了。哪一种？我不知道。我只知道，要是守不住这座镇子，会发生什么。所以我们才在这里做点准备，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你也点头，接着问他还想要什么。%SPEECH_ON%当然是帮我们对付那些绿皮。报酬很丰厚，这还用说吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 农民们涌到%employer%的住处，怀里抱满家当，走一步掉一地，却急着逃命，连捡都顾不上。%employer%从一扇窗户里看见你，招手让你走侧门。你悄悄溜进去后，他一屁股坐回椅子，给你倒了一杯酒。%SPEECH_ON%绿皮要来了，我不认为现有的人手足够守住%townname%。所以，我愿意出钱雇你帮忙，让%townname%免遭这场绿色灾祸。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的住处外站着一个人，身前身后各挂着一块涂过漆的木板，板上写满宣告末日的预言。你没理他，径直进了屋。%employer%就站在里面，一边笑，一边摇头。%SPEECH_ON%外面那家伙说得没错。我的斥候早就报告过，有绿皮在附近活动。我早该听进去。现在斥候已经整整一星期没消息了，多半是落进了那些绿皮手里。如今来找我的都是平民，一个个讲着外面发生的恐怖故事，说有大群可怕的怪物正朝这里赶来。%SPEECH_OFF%他转向你，咧嘴笑着，笑容里透着一股疯劲。%SPEECH_ON%那么，咱们谈笔生意，让那个预言末日的家伙闭上尖叫的嘴，怎么样？你愿意帮忙守卫%townname%吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

100d86464902df60bf47.source: {What is %townname% prepared to pay for their safety? | This should be worth a good amount of crowns to you, right? | Fighting greenskins won't come cheap.}
100d86464902df60bf47.translation: {为了自己的安全，%townname%愿意付多少？ | 这件事值得你花上一大笔克朗，对吧？ | 对付绿皮，价钱可不会便宜。}

583783681cbecd92bbe2.source: {I'm afraid you're on your own. | I'm afraid this isn't worth it for the %companyname%. | I wish you luck, but we'll not be part of this.}
583783681cbecd92bbe2.translation: {恐怕你只能自求多福了。 | 恐怕这对%companyname%来说不划算。 | 祝你好运，但我们不掺和。}

49590dffbf4dde806f5e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{Leaving %employer% with a rejection, you come across a man who laughs and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Hey now, the greenskins ain't that way, unless, of course, that was in your plan you no good coward.%SPEECH_OFF%You draw out your sword, letting its steel scratch the scabbard good and long. The man laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, and what are you going to do with that? Run me through? Alright. Go ahead. Do worse than the greenskins, I dare ya.%SPEECH_OFF%A woman rushes out, grabbing the man and dragging him back.%SPEECH_ON%Get the children, would ya? We need to leave, now!%SPEECH_OFF%The huddled pair shuffles off, but your head is still swimming with the peasant's accusation of cowardice. | The peasants are already packing the road to get the hell out of %townname%. A few glance at you and one even steps forward, an old man with a stick of a cane.%SPEECH_ON%See, this is what it's like in today's world! All the good men are dead, and only those left are the cowards like this so called swordsman here.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% steps forward, heaving his weapon out and looking ready to kill.%SPEECH_ON%You dare insult %companyname%? I'll have your tongue and then your head, old man!%SPEECH_OFF%You grab the mercenary by the shoulder. The last thing these people need is violence, but the man spoke good and loud. Now you wonder who heard him and who will live to spread the weight behind his words. | A woman clutches onto you as you try and get back to the company.%SPEECH_ON%Mister, please! You mustn't leave us to this fate! You know not what the greenskins will do to us!%SPEECH_OFF%You actually have a very strong notion, but keep it to yourself. The woman drops to her knees and clutches both your ankles. You manage to step out of her grasp. For a brief moment she scrambles after you, slopping through the mud, then stops and begins sobbing.%SPEECH_ON%You don't know what it's like. It don't ever seem to get better for us. For me.%SPEECH_OFF%By the gods that is pathetic, but you find a tiny bit of sympathy welling up within you. | As you leave %employer% with the rejection, a man steps out from his dwelling. He's petting a chicken and there's tears in his eyes.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, if you'd stay, you can have her.%SPEECH_OFF%The peasant kisses the chicken. It squawks mindlessly, not exactly mirroring the anguish in its owner's face.%SPEECH_ON%Just stay and help save this town. You can have her. Just stay, please.%SPEECH_OFF%Oh boy, is this really what it's going to come down to? | A disheveled and very old man steps toward you.%SPEECH_ON%So, you decided not to help? I suppose I can't fault that.%SPEECH_OFF%He fans an arm out to a few peasants standing nearby. They have crates of goods with them, stuffed belongings that range from moldy vegetables to a chicken or two, or maybe those two chickens are one just tiny and squawky lamb.%SPEECH_ON%Those people would like to you to stay and help. But I understand why you wouldn't. I was there at the Battle of Many Names. I know what it's like to fight those beasts. I won't fault you. It takes a man of great measure to take them on. So it is, so it is, yessir, and I won't fault ya, not one bit.%SPEECH_OFF%He slowly hobbles away and it is then that you notice that one of his legs is replaced by a wooden peg. A few children run to him and he speaks with the group of peasants. He looks back at you, then back to them, and shakes his head. You can almost feel the sadness and disappointment wash over you.}
49590dffbf4dde806f5e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你拒绝%employer%的雇佣，离开时遇到一个男人。他笑着摇头。%SPEECH_ON%喂，绿皮可不在那边。除非，你本来就打算往反方向走，你这没用的懦夫。%SPEECH_OFF%你缓缓拔剑，让钢刃沿剑鞘刮出长长一声。男人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%噢，想拿它干什么？把我捅穿？行啊，来吧。我倒要看你能不能比绿皮更狠。%SPEECH_OFF%一个女人冲出来，抓住他往后拖。%SPEECH_ON%去把孩子带上，行吗？我们得走，现在就走！%SPEECH_OFF%两人挤在一起，匆匆离开，可那农民骂你懦夫的话，仍在脑海里打转。 | 农民们已经挤满道路，急着逃离%townname%。几个人瞥了你一眼，还有一个拄着细棍当拐杖的老人走上前。%SPEECH_ON%看见了吗？如今的世道就是这样！好人全死光了，剩下的都是懦夫，就像眼前这个所谓的剑士。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%向前一步，猛地抽出武器，一副要杀人的架势。%SPEECH_ON%你敢侮辱%companyname%？老东西，我先割了你的舌头，再砍你的脑袋！%SPEECH_OFF%你抓住佣兵的肩。这些人最不需要的，就是再挨一顿刀剑，可老人骂得响亮又清楚。你不禁想，有谁听见了，又有谁能活下来，把这番指责传出去。 | 你正想回到战团，一个女人紧紧抓住了你。%SPEECH_ON%先生，求求你！别把我们丢给这种命运！你不知道绿皮会对我们做什么！%SPEECH_OFF%其实你心里很清楚，不过没说出口。女人跪倒，抱住你的双脚。你设法挣脱，她在泥里跌跌撞撞追了一小段，随后停下，哭了起来。%SPEECH_ON%你不知道那是什么滋味。日子好像从来没为我们好过。也没为我好过。%SPEECH_OFF%诸神在上，实在可怜，而你心里也涌起了一点同情。 | 你拒绝%employer%，走出门时，一个男人从住处出来。他抚摸着一只鸡，眼里含着泪。%SPEECH_ON%先生，只要你留下，她就归你。%SPEECH_OFF%农民亲了亲那只鸡。鸡只是懵懂地咯咯叫，丝毫不懂主人脸上的痛苦。%SPEECH_ON%留下来，救救这座镇子吧。她可以给你。只要留下，求你。%SPEECH_OFF%老天，最后真要变成这副场面吗？ | 一个衣衫凌乱、十分年迈的老人走近。%SPEECH_ON%所以，你决定不帮忙了？我想，也不能怪你。%SPEECH_OFF%他伸手指向旁边几个农民。他们带着装满家当的箱子，从发霉蔬菜到一两只鸡都有——也许那并非两只鸡，而是一头个子很小、叫声尖细的羊羔。%SPEECH_ON%那些人希望你留下帮忙。可我明白你为什么不肯。我参加过众名之战，知道和那些野兽交手是什么滋味。我不会怪你。得是极有胆量的汉子，才敢迎战它们。就是这样，就是这样，是啊，先生，我一点也不怪你。%SPEECH_OFF%他缓缓蹒跚离去，你这才发现，他的一条腿已被木桩替代。几个孩子跑向他，他和那群农民说起话，回头看看你，再转回去，摇了摇头。那股悲伤与失望，你几乎能感到它正涌向自己。}

c3b33c3d98150170a4cf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_49.png[/img]The greenskins are in sight! Prepare for battle and protect the town!
c3b33c3d98150170a4cf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_49.png[/img]绿皮出现了！准备战斗，保卫城镇！

f0b2e1cfebfc612d6b4c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]The greenskins are in sight! Prepare for battle and protect the town!
f0b2e1cfebfc612d6b4c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]绿皮出现了！准备战斗，保卫城镇！

deef0636d46f7571b627.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{The fighting's over. %employer% will no doubt be pleased to see you again. | The fighting is over and the men idle in a welcome respite. %employer% will be waiting for you back in town. | With the battle over, you survey the corpses littered across the field. It is a gruesome sight, yet for some reason it spurs you with energy. The ghastly hills of dead only remind you of the vitality you've yet to yield to this horrid world. People like %employer% should come and see it, but he won't, so you'll have to go and see him instead. | Flesh and bone scattered across the field, hardly discernible from one owner to the next. Black buzzards cycle overhead, halos of chevron shadows rippling over the dead, the birds waiting for the mourners to clear out. %randombrother% comes to your side and asks if they should start the return trip to %employer%. You leave the sight of the battlefield behind and nod. | A peaceful sort of ruin is made of the dead. Like it was their natural state, stiffened and at a permanent loss, and their whole living was but a fleeting fit of an accident finally come to an end. %randombrother% comes up and asks if you're alright. You're not sure, to be honest, and simply answer that it is time to go see %employer%. | Misshapen men and crooked corpses litter the ground for battle gives the dead no sovereignty over how one comes to a final rest. The bodiless heads look at most peace, for in battle no man or beast has time to truly hack a neck away, it only comes by the quickest and sharpest of blade swings. A part of you hopes to go with such instant finality, but another part hopes you get the chance to take your killer down with you.

 %randombrother% comes to your side and asks for orders. You turn away from the field and tell the %companyname% to get ready to return to %employer%.}
deef0636d46f7571b627.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{战斗结束了。%employer%再见到你，无疑会很高兴。 | 战斗结束了，弟兄们终于得以喘口气，享受片刻清闲。%employer%会在镇上等你。 | 战斗结束，你环顾散落满地的尸体。景象惨不忍睹，却不知为何让你精神一振。这些可怖的尸山，只是在提醒你：自己仍有生机，尚未向这个恐怖的世界屈服。像%employer%这样的人，本该来亲眼看看，可他不会来，你只得去见他。 | 血肉与碎骨洒满战场，几乎分不清谁是谁。黑色秃鹫在上空盘旋，翼影如一圈圈尖角状的光环，在死者身上掠过，等着哀悼的人离开。%randombrother%来到你身旁，问是否该动身回%employer%那里。你把战场抛在身后，点了点头。 | 死者构成一片宁静的废墟，仿佛僵硬、永远失去一切才是他们本来的模样，而那一生不过是一场短暂的意外，如今终于结束了。%randombrother%走来，问你还好吗。说实话，你也不确定，只答道，该去见%employer%了。 | 残缺的人形与扭曲的尸身遍布大地。战斗从不让死者决定，自己该以何种姿态安息。那些与身体分离的头颅看起来最为平静，因为厮杀之中，无论人还是野兽，都没工夫慢慢砍断一根脖子；能斩下头颅的，必定是最快、最利落的一击。你心底有一部分盼着自己也能这样瞬间解脱，另一部分却希望，至少能有机会拉凶手一同上路。

 %randombrother%来到你身旁，请示命令。你转身背对战场，叫%companyname%准备返回%employer%那里。}

76be861552baa8ce5db2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{While keeping watch for the greenskins, a peasant comes up telling you that a group of the beasts attacked nearby and they seem to have made off with a good lot of hostages. You shake your head in disbelief. How were the brutes able to sneak in and do this? The layman shakes his head, too.%SPEECH_ON%I thought y'all were supposed to help us. Why didn't you do anything?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if the greenskins have gotten far. The peasant shrugs, but he thinks they're still close enough to catch. Looks like you still have a shot to get those poor people back before the gods know what happens to them. | A man wearing rags and carrying a broken pitchfork sprints up to your company. He drops and wails at your feet.%SPEECH_ON%The greenskinns attacked! Ohh, they were just like my grandfather said they was! And where were you? They killed people... burned some... and... I think they ate a few... oh by the gods. But that's not the worst of it! The greenskins took some poor folks prisoner! Please, go and save them!%SPEECH_OFF%You eye %randombrother% and nod.%SPEECH_ON%Get the men ready. We need to chase these foul beasts down before they escape entirely.%SPEECH_OFF% | You have your eyes peeled to the horizons, looking for any sight or sound of the foul greenskins. Suddenly, %randombrother% comes to you with a woman by his side. He pushes her forward and nods. Clutching her chest, she sobs and tells a story about how the greenskins already attacked, tearing through a nearby hamlet. She explains that they didn't just kill people, though, but instead grabbed a few as prisoners. The mercenary nods.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like they snuck past us, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You've only one choice now - go and get those people back! | Stationing yourself close to %townname%, you await the greenskins' assault. You thought this would be easy, but the sudden arrival of a crazed layman says otherwise. The peasant explains that the foul marauders have already ambushed a small village in the hinterland. They slaughtered everyone they could, then, with their bloodlust satiated, made off with a few men, women, and children. The peasant, either drunk or in shock, slurs his pleas.%SPEECH_ON%Get... get them back, would ya?%SPEECH_OFF% | A few angry peasants take the roads, storming toward you in a swirl of mobly anger.%SPEECH_ON%I thought we were paying you to protect us! Where were you?%SPEECH_ON%They are covered in blood. Some are half-clothed. One man cradles an arm against his chest. The limb is missing a hand. You ask the group what it is they are talking about. A woman steps forward with children huddled around her feet. She covers their ears.%SPEECH_ON%What is it we're talking about? You damned sellswords! The greenskins came, who else? You were s'posed to protect us, but must've been too busy wanking one another off and shatting the bed to realize they'd already slipped through! We escaped, but those who couldn't got taken prisoner! Do you know what happens to those taken by the greenskins? Because, well, I mean I don't, but I suspect it ain't songs and pie!

 You tell the woman to shut it before her mouth starts plucking chickens her body can't eat.%SPEECH_ON%We'll get them back.%SPEECH_OFF%}
76be861552baa8ce5db2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{你正警戒绿皮来袭，一名农民跑来告诉你，一群野兽袭击了附近，似乎还掳走了不少人质。你难以置信地摇头。这些畜生是怎么偷偷溜进来干下这事的？农民也摇着头。%SPEECH_ON%我还以为你们是来帮我们的。你们怎么什么都没做？%SPEECH_OFF%你问绿皮是否走远。农民耸耸肩，不过他觉得它们还在附近，来得及追上。看来，还有机会在那些可怜人遭遇诸神才知道的惨祸之前，把他们救回来。 | 一个衣衫褴褛、拿着断草叉的男人冲向战团。他跪倒在你脚边，放声哭喊。%SPEECH_ON%绿皮打来了！噢，和我爷爷说的一模一样！你们当时在哪儿？它们杀了人……烧死了一些……还有……我想有几个被吃了……诸神在上。可这还不是最糟的！绿皮抓走了一些可怜人！求求你，快去救他们！%SPEECH_OFF%你望向%randombrother%，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%让弟兄们准备好。得在这帮肮脏野兽彻底跑掉之前追上它们。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你紧盯着远方，不放过绿皮的一点动静。忽然，%randombrother%带着一个女人走来。他把她轻推到前面，点头示意。女人捂着胸口，哭着说，绿皮早已袭击了附近的村落，横冲直撞。它们不只杀人，还抓走几个当俘虏。佣兵点点头。%SPEECH_ON%看来它们从我们眼皮底下溜过去了，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%如今你只有一个选择：把那些人救回来！ | 你在%townname%附近驻守，等待绿皮来袭。本以为这差事轻而易举，可一个惊慌失措的平民突然到来，打破了你的想法。农民说，那些肮脏的劫掠者已经突袭了腹地的一座小村。能杀的人都杀了，等嗜血的欲望得到满足，又掳走几个男人、女人和孩子。农民不知是喝醉了，还是惊吓过度，含混地哀求。%SPEECH_ON%救……把他们救回来，行吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 几个愤怒的农民沿路而来，气势汹汹地冲向你。%SPEECH_ON%我们付钱是让你们保护我们！你们都去哪儿了？%SPEECH_ON%他们满身是血，有些人衣不蔽体。一个男人把胳膊护在胸前，手已经没了。你问他们到底出了什么事。一个女人走上前，孩子们挤在她脚边。她捂住孩子的耳朵。%SPEECH_ON%出了什么事？你们这些该死的佣兵！绿皮来了，还能是谁？你们本该保护我们，却准是忙着互相撸管、往床上拉屎，连它们早就溜进来都没发现！我们逃出来了，逃不掉的全被抓走了！你知道落到绿皮手里是什么下场吗？我嘛，我是说，我也不知道，可总不会是唱歌吃馅饼！

 你让女人赶紧闭嘴，免得这张嘴再惹出她自己吃不消的麻烦。%SPEECH_ON%我们会把他们救回来。%SPEECH_OFF%}

0821091df6194d66c20a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{Sheathing your sword, you order %randombrother% to go free the prisoners. A litany of bewildered peasants are freed from leather leashes, chains, and dog cages. They thank you for your timely arrival. One scratches the wounds on his wrists where the chains used to be.%SPEECH_ON%Appreciate it, sellsord.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods to a spit where a shriveled black corpse is hanging over a spent fire.%SPEECH_ON%Shame you didn't arrive in time to rescue her. She was a real looker. Now, well, look at 'er.%SPEECH_OFF%The man smiles wryly before bursting into tears. | The damned greenskins are slaughtered. You set your men out to go rescue every peasant they can find. Each one comes together, hugging and crying, mad with happiness that they have survived this horrifying ordeal. | After killing the last greenskin, you tell the company to go around freeing the hostages. Each one comes to you in turn, some kissing your hand, others your feet. You only tell them to get back to the townhall of %townname%, as you will be heading there, too. | Having slain the last greenskin, you order the men to free the hostages. They clamber out, completely in shock as they stumble about the ruins of the battle. A few dig through the greenskins' encampment. You watch as a {man | woman} picks up a pile of smoking, charred bones. They simply stare at the remains, put them down, then get up and walk further into the wilds.}
0821091df6194d66c20a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{你收剑入鞘，命%randombrother%去释放俘虏。一群惊魂未定的农民，从皮绳、锁链和狗笼中得到解救。他们感谢你及时赶到。一人抓挠着手腕上锁链留下的伤口。%SPEECH_ON%多谢了，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他朝一根烤叉点点头，那里挂着干瘪焦黑的尸体，下方的火早已熄灭。%SPEECH_ON%可惜，没赶上救她。她原来可漂亮了。如今，唉，你瞧瞧。%SPEECH_OFF%男人勉强苦笑，随后泪如雨下。 | 该死的绿皮已被杀光。你派弟兄们去救出所有能找到的农民。获救者聚在一起，拥抱哭泣，为熬过这场可怕劫难而欣喜若狂。 | 杀掉最后一头绿皮后，你让战团四处解救人质。他们依次来见你，有的亲吻你的手，有的亲吻你的脚。你只叫他们返回%townname%的镇政厅，自己也将前往那里。 | 杀掉最后一头绿皮，你命弟兄们释放人质。他们挣扎着爬出来，惊魂未定，在战场残骸间踉跄徘徊。几个人翻找着绿皮营地。你看见一个{男人 | 女人}捧起一堆仍在冒烟的焦骨。那人只是望着遗骸，放下，随后站起，朝荒野更深处走去。}

63a34ab877c341c656b3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{Unfortunately, the greenskins got away with the hostages. May the gods be with those sorry souls. | You couldn't do it - you couldn't save those poor peasants. Now only the gods know what will happen to them. Actually, you do too, but you'll play dumb just so you can sleep at night. | Sadly, the foul beasts got away with their human cargo in tow. Those poor folks will have to fend for themselves now. The stories you hear, however, tell you they will not fare well at all. | The greenskins got away, their prisoners alongside with them. You've no idea what will happen to those people now, but you know it isn't good. Slavery. Torture. Death. You're not sure which is the worst. | The greenskins and their unfortunate hostages got away. You wish those people the best, but as the wind curls around, blowing an empty and stiff song, you know damn well that no wish or prayer is going to save those sorry souls. | Well, the greenskins got away. The trail of gnawed human bones and piles of peeled flesh speak volumes about your failure. | You pick up a scrap of clothing to find it had been resting atop a pile of bones.%SPEECH_ON%Well, shit.%SPEECH_OFF%There's a trail of 'food' scraps leading away from the site. The greenskins got away and the poor prisoners have disappeared along with them. | %randombrother% calls you over. When you stand next to him he points at a pile of shite on the ground. You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah. It smells. What else?%SPEECH_OFF%He kicks a piece of white, lifting what appears to be a bone from the goop.%SPEECH_ON%That's a human bone. Them prisoners been ate, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You look about the grass and see even more remains. Footprints lead away from the site, the greenskins clearly having escaped your chase. You sigh and tell the men to get ready to leave.}
63a34ab877c341c656b3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{遗憾的是，绿皮带着人质逃走了。愿诸神庇佑那些可怜人。 | 你没能做到——你没能救下那些可怜的农民。现在，只有诸神知道他们会遭遇什么。其实你也知道，只是为了夜里还能睡着，你宁愿装糊涂。 | 可惜，那些肮脏的野兽带着掳来的人逃掉了。如今，那些可怜人只能自求多福。可你听过的种种传闻都在告诉你，他们的下场绝不会好。 | 绿皮逃走了，俘虏也被一并带走。你不知道那些人接下来会遭遇什么，只知道绝非好事。奴役，折磨，死亡。你说不准哪一种更糟。 | 绿皮带着不幸的人质逃走了。你希望那些人能有个好结局，可风在四周盘旋，吹出空洞而僵冷的曲调，你心里再清楚不过：无论祝愿还是祈祷，都救不了那些可怜的性命。 | 唉，绿皮逃掉了。一路上被啃过的人骨和一堆堆剥落的血肉，已经把你的失败说得再明白不过。 | 你捡起一片碎布，才发现下面压着一堆骨头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，见鬼。%SPEECH_OFF%一串“残羹剩饭”从这里延伸出去。绿皮逃了，那些可怜的俘虏也随它们一起消失了。 | %randombrother%叫你过去。你站到他身旁，他指向地上的一堆粪便。你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，很臭。还有呢？%SPEECH_OFF%他踢了踢其中一块白色的东西，从黏糊糊的秽物里翻出一截像是骨头的东西。%SPEECH_ON%那是人骨。那些俘虏被吃了，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾草地，看见更多残骸。脚印通向远方，绿皮显然已经甩掉了追兵。你叹了口气，叫弟兄们准备离开。}

139c9cbc5d660a86bd40.source: {They won't like that in %townname%... | I hope it will be a quick death for them.}
139c9cbc5d660a86bd40.translation: {%townname%的人听说后，肯定不会高兴…… | 但愿他们能死得痛快些。}

49c8175d7c0749ebcd7c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your return with a chest of %reward% crowns.%SPEECH_ON%You've earned this one, sellsword, I'll say that much. Not a single part of this town, well nothing important anyway, was touched.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses as you stare at the chest. It was hard fought and hard earned. You just expected more of it. Sometimes the simplicity of being a mercenary really bugs you. | You find %employer% feeding some of his dogs. He pets one over and over as it chows down.%SPEECH_ON%I really thought I'd have to give this up.%SPEECH_OFF%He gives the mutt one final pat before turning his eyes to you.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sellsword. You did more than just protect this town, you protected a way of life. Without you, we either would have all died or, worse, lived to see the horridness that tomorrow surely would have brought.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and step forward to give one of the dogs a pat, but it leers up at you and growls. %employer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Please forgive his ignorance.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s got a gang of men and women surrounding him. When you enter the room they turn to you in almost creepy unison. They stare for a moment before breaking into celebrations and rushing to you, hugs and tears and all. Fighting them off, you find %employer% standing there with a satchel in hand.%SPEECH_ON%This is for saving %townname%, sellsword. If I'm being honest, it ain't as heavy as it should be, but it's all we got.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s looking out his window when you return to him. Outside, militiamen are running about and the towns people are hugging one another.%SPEECH_ON%Not a greenskin entered the town commons.%SPEECH_OFF%He smiles as he hands over a satchel of goods.%SPEECH_ON%You went above and beyond this day, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | Finding %employer% wasn't easy: the entire town is in an uproar of celebrations. They're plucking chickens so fast the birds sometimes manage to escape, running half-cocked and half-feathered down the roads while children give chase. %employer% manages to sneak up on you in the midst of the festivities.%SPEECH_ON%There is plenty of mourning to do, but we shall save that for tomorrow. For today, we celebrate life, and your deeds, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%The man hands over a satchel of goods and it weighs down in your grip. | You find %employer% rearranging a bookshelf. He seems to be restocking his wares, carefully counting and numbering his goods like a shopkeep. He jumps when the door slams shut behind you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellsword! You spooked me there.%SPEECH_OFF%He grabs a chest off one of the book shelves and hands it over to you.%SPEECH_ON%I'd plan to take all these books, all these scrolls, and run for it. Now, though, I shan't need to and that's all thanks to you.%SPEECH_OFF%His smiles sour for just a moment.%SPEECH_ON%Not everyone was so lucky as to see this day, and your victory. Tonight I must see to it that the fallen get a proper burial.%SPEECH_OFF%}
49c8175d7c0749ebcd7c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer%拿着一箱%reward%克朗迎接你回来。%SPEECH_ON%这份钱你挣得实至名归，佣兵，我得承认。镇上没有一处遭殃，嗯，至少要紧的地方都没事。%SPEECH_OFF%你望着箱子，他便停住了话。你们拼命打了一场，这钱挣得艰难。可你总觉得，回报本该更多一些。有时候，佣兵这一行的简单直白，实在让你心烦。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正在喂狗。一条狗狼吞虎咽，他一遍遍抚摸它。%SPEECH_ON%我真以为，再也过不上这样的日子了。%SPEECH_OFF%他最后拍了拍那条狗，抬眼望向你。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，佣兵。你保住的不只是一座镇子，还有我们的生活。没有你，我们要么全都死去，要么更惨，活着面对明天必将带来的恐怖。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，上前想摸摸一条狗，它却恶狠狠地抬头，发出低吼。%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%请原谅它不懂事。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群男男女女围着%employer%。你进屋时，他们整齐得近乎诡异地转过身，盯了你一会儿，随即欢呼着扑来，又抱又哭。你好不容易挣脱，看见%employer%拿着钱袋站在那里。%SPEECH_ON%这是你救下%townname%的报酬，佣兵。老实说，这袋钱本该再沉些，可我们只有这么多了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回去见%employer%时，他正望着窗外。外面民兵四处奔走，镇民彼此拥抱。%SPEECH_ON%没有一只绿皮闯进镇上的公共广场。%SPEECH_OFF%他微笑着递来一袋东西。%SPEECH_ON%今天，你做得远比我们期待的还好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 要找到%employer%可不容易：整座镇子都沉浸在喧闹的庆祝中。人们急着杀鸡拔毛，动作快得有时连鸡都逃脱了，顶着半身羽毛，跌跌撞撞跑上街，孩子们在后面追赶。%employer%趁热闹悄悄来到你身旁。%SPEECH_ON%我们有许多人要哀悼，但那留到明天吧。今天，我们庆祝生命，也庆祝你的功绩，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他递来一袋东西，沉甸甸地坠在你手中。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正在整理书架。他似乎在重新归置家当，像店主一样仔细清点、逐一编号。门在你身后砰地关上，把他吓得一跳。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵！你吓了我一跳。%SPEECH_OFF%他从一层书架上取下箱子，递给你。%SPEECH_ON%我本打算带上所有书籍、所有卷轴，逃之夭夭。现在不用了，全都多亏你。%SPEECH_OFF%他的笑容短暂地黯淡下来。%SPEECH_ON%并不是每个人都有幸活到今天，看见你的胜利。今晚，我得确保死者都能得到妥善安葬。%SPEECH_OFF%}

dfcd54394f5f334f233a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer%'s head is in his hands. You point out his window.%SPEECH_ON%Town's saved, why you having a tear, huh?%SPEECH_OFF%He lifts his eyes to you.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, most of the people made it, I suppose that's true. But that doesn't mean the greenskins didn't tear a hole through a good lot of this damn town.%SPEECH_OFF%He pushes a chest of goods across his table before thumbing his brow.%SPEECH_ON%Apologies for being so somber, but I'm sure you understand how it is, sellsword. At least, I hope you do.%SPEECH_OFF%You do, but you pretend you don't give a good god damn. | You find %employer% behind his abode. He's got a shovel in hand and he's sending off a few peasants. There's fresh mounds of dirt here and there.%SPEECH_ON%You're a sight for sore eyes, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%He borrows his weight onto the shaft of the shovel.%SPEECH_ON%Just, uh, burying those who didn't make it. You did a damned good job, and I don't want you to think otherwise, but many people didn't make it. I'm not blaming you at all, the greenskins are a fierce opponent and against them it wouldn't be wise of me to expect perfection.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and the man nods in return. He picks up a satchel that'd been laying amongst a pile of muddied shovels. It leaves a trail of mud as it flies through the air. You catch it and nod again before leaving the man to his task. You can hear the schkk, schkk of his shovel driving into the earth as you walk away. | %employer%'s studying a map when you return. He puts a finger on one spot, then practically uses his words to navigate the finger along.%SPEECH_ON%This place didn't make it. This home got burned. These people are dead. We found these folks in the woods. I think they were trying to hide, but they just had a newborn. I suspect that's what gave them away.%SPEECH_OFF%He leans forward, knuckling his hands on the table.%SPEECH_ON%You did well, mercenary, but not everyone could be saved. It is what it is, as they say, and I shan't hold it against you. Not while I and many others still breathe.%SPEECH_OFF%He throws a satchel of crowns at you. You take it and nod back. It is what it is, and what it is, is a good payday. | You find %employer% slowly crawling a long scroll through his plying fingers. He's nodding and humming to himself.%SPEECH_ON%Do you know what it's like to read the names of dead neighbors?%SPEECH_OFF%You do, but don't bother interrupting.%SPEECH_ON%It's a strange feeling. I know them, but now, I can't see their faces. I just recognize their names, like words, no more extraordinary than any other. They're just a bunch of vocabulary now. Descriptions of a memory, I suppose.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks up at you, then throws the scroll aside to fetch you a satchel of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, I don't mean to bother you like that, mercenary. Here's your reward as promised.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s directing a man with a paint brush. Their canvas is a mix of thick paper and what appears to be glass. Curious, you ask what's going on.%SPEECH_ON%I'm enshrining the battle. Memorializing it.%SPEECH_OFF%He points at a segment where a building is burning.%SPEECH_ON%See that? When you went off to fight the greenskins, they burned that place down. And that one, too. We'll remember it all lest we forget.%SPEECH_OFF%The man gives you a satchel of crowns before quickly returning to the artistry. Staring at the picture, you don't see your company anywhere in it.}
dfcd54394f5f334f233a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer%双手抱头。你指向窗外。%SPEECH_ON%镇子保住了，还哭什么，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%他抬眼看你。%SPEECH_ON%是，大多数人活下来了，这倒没错。可绿皮还是把这座该死的镇子糟蹋了一大片。%SPEECH_OFF%他把一箱东西推过桌面，随后用拇指揉着额头。%SPEECH_ON%抱歉，这么垂头丧气。不过我想，你该明白这种滋味，佣兵。至少，我希望你明白。%SPEECH_OFF%你明白，却装出一副压根不在乎的样子。 | 你在屋后找到%employer%。他手里拿着铁锹，正在打发几个农民离开。四周散布着新堆起的土包。%SPEECH_ON%见到你真好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他把身体的重量倚在锹柄上。%SPEECH_ON%只是在，呃，埋葬没能活下来的人。你们干得很好，我不希望你有别的想法，可还是有许多人死了。我一点也不怪你。绿皮是凶悍的对手，面对它们，我还指望万无一失，就太不明智了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，他也点头回应。他从一堆沾满泥的铁锹间拿起钱袋，抛过来时，泥点在空中洒下一路。你接住钱袋，再次点头，便留他继续忙碌。走远时，你还能听见铁锹铲入泥土的嚓嚓声。 | 你回来时，%employer%正研究一张地图。他把手指放在一处，随后边说边挪，仿佛话语在指引它前行。%SPEECH_ON%这里没保住。这户人家烧了。这些人死了。我们在树林里找到这几个人。他们大概想躲起来，可家里刚添了个婴儿。我猜，就是那孩子暴露了他们。%SPEECH_OFF%他俯身向前，指节抵住桌面。%SPEECH_ON%你干得不错，佣兵，可不是所有人都救得下来。事情就是这样，我不会怪你。至少，我和许多人都还活着。%SPEECH_OFF%他把一袋克朗抛给你。你接过，点头回应。事情就是这样，而你拿到了一笔不错的报酬。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正用手指慢慢卷动一份长长的卷轴，一边点头，一边低声哼着。%SPEECH_ON%你知道读着死去邻居的名字，是什么滋味吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你知道，不过没有打断他。%SPEECH_ON%很奇怪。我认识他们，可现在，想不起他们的脸了。我只认得名字，像些普通的词，和别的字没什么不同。他们如今只是一串词汇。我想，是对一段回忆的描述吧。%SPEECH_OFF%他抬头看看你，把卷轴丢到一旁，取来一袋克朗。%SPEECH_ON%唉，我不是有意拿这些烦你，佣兵。这是答应你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正指点着一个拿画笔的人。画布像是厚纸与玻璃拼成的。你好奇地问他们在做什么。%SPEECH_ON%我要把这场战斗留下来，作个纪念。%SPEECH_OFF%他指向画中一栋燃烧的房屋。%SPEECH_ON%看见了吗？你出去与绿皮交战时，他们烧了那里。还有那边。我们得把这一切记下来，免得遗忘。%SPEECH_OFF%他给你一袋克朗，便又急忙回去指点画作。你盯着画面，却到处都找不到战团的影子。}

1c5ba3cf3aacbfba9829.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your return with a chest of %reward% crowns.%SPEECH_ON%You've earned this one, sellsword, I'll say that much. Unfortunately, the greenskins managed to abduct a few of our own. I'm withholding some of your pay to help compensate those who trusted their lives with you.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses as you stare at the chest. You nod, both understanding of the peasants' plight, but realizing that any arguments here would not suit your future prospects. | You find %employer% feeding some of his dogs. He pets one over and over as it chows down on dinner scraps.%SPEECH_ON%I really thought I'd have to give all this up.%SPEECH_OFF%He gives the mutt one final pat before turning his eyes to you.%SPEECH_ON%But not all of us made it. Your pay is in the corner, but it will be less than agreed upon. I must see to the comforts of those who were abducted, I'm sure you understand why I'm taking that pay from you.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s got a gang of men and women surrounding him. When you enter the room they turn to you in creepy unison. %employer% is handing them crowns. He speaks to you as he does this.%SPEECH_ON%Your pay is outside with one of my guards. It will be light, for I have taken some to help comfort those who were lost in the battle.%SPEECH_OFF%You glance at the poor souls lingering about the room. They must be related to those the greenskins kidnapped. | %employer%'s looking out his window when you return to him. Outside, militiamen are running about and the towns people are hugging one another.%SPEECH_ON%The town proper has been spared, but I must regret to tell you that there will be fewer people treading its roads in the coming days.%SPEECH_OFF%He smiles as he hands over a satchel of crowns that feels a little bit lighter than it should.%SPEECH_ON%You went above and beyond this day, sellsword, but not all could be saved. Those who were taken by the greenskins left behind family, and those families I will seek to comfort in these dire times.%SPEECH_OFF% | Finding %employer% wasn't easy: the entire town is in an uproar of celebrations. They're plucking chickens so fast the birds sometimes manage to escape, running half-cocked and half-feathered down the roads while children giddily give chase. %employer% manages to sneak up on you in the midst of the festivities. The man hands over a satchel of goods and it weighs down in your grip.%SPEECH_ON%Not everyone can be so jovial, sellsword. Those kidnapped souls whom you cannot save? They left behind families, and to those families goes some of your pay. I'm sure you understand.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% rearranging a bookshelf. He seems to be restocking his wares, carefully counting and numbering his goods like a shopkeep. He jumps when the door slams shut behind you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellsword! You spooked me there.%SPEECH_OFF%He grabs a chest off one of the bookshelves and hands it over to you.%SPEECH_ON%I had planned to take all these books, all these scrolls, and run for it. Now, though, I shan't need to and that's all thanks to you.%SPEECH_OFF%His smile sours.%SPEECH_ON%Not everyone was so lucky to see this day. Locals have told me what happened, that the greenskins kidnapped some of our own and you could not save them. Failing them is understandable, but I'm sure you personally understand, then, that I took some of your pay to help those surviving families along.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1c5ba3cf3aacbfba9829.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer%拿着一箱%reward%克朗迎接你回来。%SPEECH_ON%这份钱你挣得实至名归，佣兵，我得承认。可惜，绿皮还是掳走了我们几个人。我要扣下一部分报酬，用来补偿那些把性命托付给你的人。%SPEECH_OFF%你盯着箱子，他便停住了话。你点头，既理解农民的苦处，也明白在这里争辩，对今后接活没有好处。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正在喂狗。一条狗大嚼着剩饭，他一遍遍抚摸它。%SPEECH_ON%我真以为，再也过不上这样的日子了。%SPEECH_OFF%他最后拍了拍那条狗，抬眼望向你。%SPEECH_ON%可不是所有人都活了下来。你的报酬在角落里，会比约定的少。我得为那些被掳走的人作些抚恤安排，想必你明白，为什么这笔钱要从你那里扣。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群男男女女围着%employer%。你进屋时，他们整齐得令人发毛地转过身。%employer%正在给他们分发克朗，一边发，一边对你说。%SPEECH_ON%你的报酬在外面，一名守卫拿着。会轻一些，因为我抽出了一部分，抚恤那些在战斗中失去的人。%SPEECH_OFF%你望了望屋内徘徊的可怜人。他们一定都是被绿皮掳走之人的亲属。 | 你回去见%employer%时，他正望着窗外。外面民兵四处奔走，镇民彼此拥抱。%SPEECH_ON%镇子本身保住了，可我不得不遗憾地告诉你，往后在街上走动的人，会比从前少了。%SPEECH_OFF%他微笑着递来一袋克朗，分量似乎比应有的轻一些。%SPEECH_ON%今天，你做得远比我们期待的还好，佣兵，但并非所有人都能得救。被绿皮掳走的人留下了家属，在这艰难的时候，我得设法安抚他们。%SPEECH_OFF% | 要找到%employer%可不容易：整座镇子都沉浸在喧闹的庆祝中。人们急着杀鸡拔毛，动作快得有时连鸡都逃脱了，顶着半身羽毛，跌跌撞撞跑上街，孩子们兴高采烈地在后面追赶。%employer%趁热闹悄悄来到你身旁，递来一袋东西，沉甸甸地坠在你手中。%SPEECH_ON%不是人人都能这么高兴，佣兵。那些被掳走、你没能救下的人呢？他们留下了家属，所以你的报酬有一部分要分给他们。我想你能理解。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在整理书架。他似乎在重新归置家当，像店主一样仔细清点、逐一编号。门在你身后砰地关上，把他吓得一跳。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵！你吓了我一跳。%SPEECH_OFF%他从一层书架上取下箱子，递给你。%SPEECH_ON%我本打算带上所有书籍、所有卷轴，逃之夭夭。现在不用了，全都多亏你。%SPEECH_OFF%他的笑容黯淡下来。%SPEECH_ON%并不是每个人都有幸活到今天。当地人告诉我，绿皮掳走了我们一些人，而你没能救下他们。失手可以理解，不过，我想你也一定能理解，我扣下了一部分报酬，帮留下的家属渡过难关。%SPEECH_OFF%}

985e46d335cf297a3fc6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your return with a lighter than expected satchel. He explains.%SPEECH_ON%The outskirts were nearly destroyed and a great number of people kidnapped. I'm sorry, sellsword, but I needed the money to help this town recover. You can threaten me if you want, but it is what it is.%SPEECH_OFF%You decide to accept the losses and move on. | You find %employer% surveying the town. A few fires burn along the outskirts, piping black smoke into the skies. Weary peasants trudge along the roads. They carry what things they can, some carrying one another for their wounds are horrid. %employer% nods at the scene.%SPEECH_ON%A great deal of destruction, sellsword. You and I both know that I was paying you to save the town in whole, and to keep its people safe. Neither truly happened, but at the very least we're still talking, so you'll still be getting a piece of the reward, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%He hands over a satchel of crowns. It is, indeed, lighter than what was agreed upon, but for the sake of future prospects you don't argue over it. | %employer%'s found looking out his window. He's got a scroll and pen in each hand, making notes here and then. He speaks without looking at you.%SPEECH_ON%Well, we're alive and well, that's good. What's not good are those fires ravaging the outskirts of town, are the horrid news that the greenskins kidnapped some of our own.%SPEECH_OFF%Finally, he pauses writing just long enough to turn and stare at you.%SPEECH_ON%Your pay is out in the hall. It's less than what you were expecting. If you want to argue about it, I'm all, and will only be, ears.%SPEECH_OFF%You realize it would be pointless arguing over the pay and simply take what you've earned.}
985e46d335cf297a3fc6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer%迎接你回来，递上的钱袋却比预料中轻。他解释道。%SPEECH_ON%外围几乎全毁了，还有很多人被掳走。抱歉，佣兵，我得留些钱帮镇子恢复。你想威胁我也行，但事情就是这样。%SPEECH_OFF%你决定认下这笔损失，继续上路。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正在查看镇子的情况。外围几处火头仍在燃烧，黑烟直冲天空。疲惫的农民沿路艰难行走，能带的东西都带上了，有些人还搀着、背着伤势骇人的同伴。%employer%朝眼前的景象点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%毁得够惨，佣兵。你我都清楚，我付钱是要你保全镇子，保护这里的人。两样都没真正做到，不过至少咱们还活着，能站在这儿说话，所以我会按约定，付你一部分报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%他递来一袋克朗。确实比约定的轻，但为了今后还能接到活，你没有争辩。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正望着窗外，一手卷轴，一手笔，不时记上几笔。他头也不回地说道。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，咱们都还活得好好的，这很好。可镇外肆虐的大火就不怎么好了，还有绿皮掳走了我们的人——这噩耗也不好。%SPEECH_OFF%他终于停笔，转头盯住你。%SPEECH_ON%你的报酬在外面走廊里，比你期待的少。要是想争，我洗耳恭听，但也只是听听。%SPEECH_OFF%你明白争这笔钱毫无用处，便拿走了到手的报酬。}

ea7213131652e75b4d37.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{When you enter %employer%'s room, he tells you to close the door behind you. Just as the latch clicks, the man slams you with a stream of obscenities which you couldn't hope to keep track of. Calming down, his voice - and language - return to some level of normalcy.%SPEECH_ON%Every bit of our outskirts were destroyed. What is it, exactly, did you think I was paying you for? Get out of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s slamming back goblets of wine when you enter. There's the din of angry peasants squalling outside his window.%SPEECH_ON%Hear that? They'll have my head if I pay you, sellsword. You had one job, one job! Protect this town. And you couldn't do it. So now you could do one thing right and it comes free: get the hell out of my sight.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% clasps his hands over his desk.%SPEECH_ON%What is it, exactly, are you expecting to get here? I'm surprised you returned to me at all. Half the town is on fire and the other half is already ash. I didn't hire you to produce smoke and desolation, sellsword. Get the hell out of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | When you return to %employer%, he's holding a mug of ale. His hand his shaking. His face is red.%SPEECH_ON%It's taking everything in me to not throw this in your face right now.%SPEECH_OFF%Just in case, the man finishes the drink in one big gulp. He slams it on his desk.%SPEECH_ON%This town expected you protect them. Instead, the greenskins swarmed the outskirts like they were taking a goddam leisure trip! I'm not in the business of giving greenskins a good ol' time in destroying my town, sellsword. Get the farkin' hell out of here!%SPEECH_OFF%}
ea7213131652e75b4d37.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{你进入%employer%的房间，他叫你关门。门闩刚咔哒扣上，一连串脏话便劈头盖脸砸来，快得你根本记不住。冷静下来后，他的声音和措辞才恢复几分正常。%SPEECH_ON%城外每一处都被毁了。你到底以为，我付钱是让你干什么？滚出去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进门时，%employer%正一杯接一杯地灌酒。窗外传来愤怒农民的叫嚷。%SPEECH_ON%听见了吗？佣兵，我要是给你钱，他们就会要我的脑袋。你只有一件事要做，就一件！保住镇子。可你没做到。现在还有一件事能做对，不用收钱：滚出我的视线。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%在桌前交拢双手。%SPEECH_ON%你到底还指望在这儿拿到什么？我倒惊讶，你竟有脸回来。半个镇子在烧，另外半个已经成灰。佣兵，我雇你可不是为了制造浓烟与废墟。给我滚出去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回到%employer%处，他手里端着一杯麦酒，手在发抖，脸涨得通红。%SPEECH_ON%我现在拼尽全力，才没把这杯东西泼到你脸上。%SPEECH_OFF%以防万一，他干脆一口喝尽，猛地把杯子拍在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%镇民指望你保护他们，结果绿皮涌进城外，简直像他娘的在郊游！佣兵，我可不是花钱让绿皮痛痛快快毁掉镇子的。给我他娘的滚出去！%SPEECH_OFF%}

400ba9b50ee6bd3731c9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{%employer% is nowhere to be found. One of his guards comes up to you.%SPEECH_ON%If you're looking for my boss, you best give up. Half this town is destroyed and he's out there trying to fix it.%SPEECH_OFF%You inquire about your pay. The man bursts into sad, rough laughter.%SPEECH_ON%Pay? Sorry, you sword-selling bum. He wasn't paying you to fail. And that money is going right back into the town, anyway.%SPEECH_OFF% | You search the burning wastes of %townname% in search of %employer%. He's found pulling black bodies out of a smoldering ruin that was once a house. Dropping a charred corpse at his feet, he just about stares a hole through you.%SPEECH_ON%What is it you want, sellsword? I hope it isn't pay because this shit right here is not what I was paying you to do.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s found staring out his window. The entire horizon is aflame, as though there were two suns to set on this world. He shakes his head when he sees you.%SPEECH_ON%The hell you doing here? Did we agree to pay you for letting the town go to ash? I don't think so, sellsword. Get out of here.%SPEECH_OFF%}
400ba9b50ee6bd3731c9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{你到处找不到%employer%，他的一名卫兵走来。%SPEECH_ON%要找我老板，就别费劲了。半个镇子都毁了，他正在外面设法补救。%SPEECH_OFF%你问起报酬，那人爆发出悲凉而粗哑的笑。%SPEECH_ON%报酬？抱歉，你这卖命的穷鬼，他可不是付钱请你失败的。何况，那笔钱也得花回镇子里。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在%townname%燃烧的废墟中寻找%employer%，终于发现他正从曾经是房屋的冒烟残骸里，拖出焦黑尸体。他将一具烧焦的遗体放到脚边，瞪得几乎要把你看穿。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你想要什么？但愿不是报酬，因为眼前这摊破事，绝不是我付钱让你做的。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正望着窗外。整片地平线都在燃烧，仿佛这世上有两轮太阳同时落下。看见你，他摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%你他娘的来干什么？我们说好过，付钱让你看着镇子烧成灰吗？我不记得有，佣兵。滚出去。%SPEECH_OFF%}

94e0258b8e08e47a9d67.translation: 守住了城镇，击退了绿皮

52b30dafa787355e485b.source: Failed to defend the town against greenskins
52b30dafa787355e485b.translation: 未能保住遭绿皮袭击的城镇

c8c7acf50774d7041cff.source: Deliver cargo to %recipient% in %objective% about %days% to the %direction% by road
c8c7acf50774d7041cff.translation: 将货物送给%objective%的%recipient%，沿路向%direction%行进约%days%

d9ce0e1df4ec6aa2aa93.source: Follow the thieves' tracks and return your cargo
d9ce0e1df4ec6aa2aa93.translation: 循着盗贼的足迹，夺回货物

f442fb751d4fbff39fbe.source: {Let's talk money. | How many crowns are we talking about?}
f442fb751d4fbff39fbe.translation: {谈谈报酬吧。 | 你打算出多少克朗？}

f6cc7757f346ec7749d3.source: {Not interested. | Our travels will not take us there for a while. | This is not the kind of work we're looking for.}
f6cc7757f346ec7749d3.translation: {没兴趣。 | 我们暂时不会往那边走。 | 这不是我们要找的活儿。}

46f4f1072aab894f42cf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_112.png[/img]{One of the Vizier's aldermen approaches with a retinue of servants. They're laboring a modestly sized crate in your general direction.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, the Vizier has use for you. Have these servants load the crate into your keeping then take it to %recipient% in %objective%, a good %days% by road to the %direction%.%SPEECH_OFF%The alderman bows.%SPEECH_ON%Though a simple task it may be, the Vizier is willing to pay a plentiful sum for the task's completion.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% awaiting in the foyer. He is listening to a row of merchants, each with their own request or offer, and all the while a scribe at his side makes notations in a ledger which unfurls ever longer across the marbled floor. Seeing you, the Vizier snaps his fingers and a man off to the side approaches.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, the majesty wishes to make use of your services. Take a crate with this labeling to %recipient% in %objective%, about %days% by road. You will be compensated upon arrival.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man with peacock feathers in a jaunty cap approaches you seemingly out of nowhere. He sidles along with a ledger in hand, though the ledger carries the emblem of one of %townname%'s Viziers and his guard.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% wishes to employ your services, Crownling. You are to handle a fine material, crated away from your devilish eyes of course, and secret it to %recipient% in %objective%, located %days% by road to the %direction%. Once the material is delivered, you will then be paid at the location upon which you have arrived.%SPEECH_OFF%The man rakes the feathers back and briefly shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Do you find this offer congruent with your current financial wishes?%SPEECH_OFF% | You're first hailed by a pigeon with a note, the note pointing you to a young boy who then takes you to a servant, the servant guides you through a harem hall of naked women after which you arrive to the room of a wealthy merchant.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, finally, you have arrived. I set out a simple task to my indebted and it takes this long to complete? I'll have to look into that.%SPEECH_OFF%The merchant tosses you a ledger and simultaneously falls into a pile of cushions.%SPEECH_ON%I, excuse me, the Vizier needs you to take a crate of goods to %recipient% in %objective%, located %days% on the road to the %direction%. You are not to open said goods, only deliver them. If you open the goods, the Vizier will hear of it. And trust me, Crownling, the Vizier only likes to hear of splendid things. That is why I am here instead of the majesty.%SPEECH_OFF%What a courtesy.}
46f4f1072aab894f42cf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_112.png[/img]{维齐尔的一位属官带着仆从走来，仆人们正费力地把一只中等大小的箱子搬向你。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，维齐尔有事要你办。让这些仆人将箱子交给你保管，再送往%objective%，交给%recipient%。沿路往%direction%走，足有%days%的路程。%SPEECH_OFF%属官躬身行礼。%SPEECH_ON%事情虽简单，只要办妥，维齐尔愿意付给你丰厚报酬。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在前厅找到了%employer%。一排商人轮流向他提出请求或交易，旁边的书记不断记账，长长的账册在大理石地面上越铺越远。维齐尔看见你，打了个响指，侧旁一人便走上前。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，尊贵的大人要你效劳。将贴着这种标签的箱子送到%objective%，交给%recipient%，沿路约有%days%的行程。送到就付钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个戴着孔雀羽饰俏帽的人不知从哪里冒了出来。他侧身走近，手持一本账册，上面印着%townname%某位维齐尔及其卫队的徽记。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，%employer%要雇你办事。你将运送一批上等货物，当然，货物会装在箱子里，免得你那双狡猾的眼睛乱看。将它秘密送给%objective%的%recipient%，沿路往%direction%走，约有%days%的路程。货物送达后，当地便会付给你报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%他往后理了理羽毛，轻轻摇头。%SPEECH_ON%这份差事是否符合你眼下的求财心愿？%SPEECH_OFF% | 先是一只鸽子送来纸条，指引你找到了一个男孩；男孩又将你带给仆人，仆人领你穿过满是裸身女子的后宫大厅，最后来到一个富商的房间。%SPEECH_ON%啊，总算来了。我给那些欠我债的人派点简单活计，竟要花这么久？这事我得过问一下。%SPEECH_OFF%商人将账册扔给你，自己倒进一堆软垫里。%SPEECH_ON%我——抱歉，是维齐尔，要你将一箱货送给%objective%的%recipient%，沿路往%direction%走，大约%days%。不许开箱，只管送到。你若打开，维齐尔必会知道。相信我，克朗客，维齐尔只爱听好消息。所以坐在这里的是我，而不是尊贵的大人。%SPEECH_OFF%还真是体贴周到。}

17d5bff8f7ca2464966c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{While on the road, a band of well-armed men cross your path. | Marching toward %objective%, a few men interrupt your quiet travels, the clinky-clank of their weapons and armor filling the air as they step into formation. | Your travels, unfortunately, are not to be simple. A number of men have stepped out in front of you, clearly blocking your way. | Some armed and well armored men have come out to make something of a metal impasse. They look as though they intend to make sure you go no farther. | A few of the men come to a stop. You go to the front to figure out what is going on, only to see a line of well-armed men standing in %companyname%'s way. Well, this should be interesting.} The enemy lieutenant steps forward and pounds his chest with his fist clenched.%SPEECH_ON%{It is us, the %mercband%, that stand before you. Slayers of beasts beyond imagination, the last hope of this godsforsaken land! | The name is %mercband% and we're well known throughout this land as splitters of heads, drinkers of kegs and lovers of ladies! | 'Tis the legendary %mercband% standing before you. It is we, saviors of %randomtown% and slayers of the false king! | Behold my proud band, the %mercband%! We, who fought off a hundred orcs to save a city from certain doom. What have you to your name? | You're talking to a man of the %mercband%. No common brigand, foul greenskin, bag of coins or skirt ever escaped from us!}%SPEECH_OFF%After the man finishes his posturing and personal pontificating, he points at the cargo you are carrying.%SPEECH_ON%{So now that you realize the danger you are in, why don't you go ahead and hand that cargo over? | I hope you realize who you've come to face, pathetic sellsword, so that you may best make sure your men make it to their beds tonight. All you need to do is hand over the cargo and we won't have to add you to the history of %mercband%. | Ah, I bet you'd like to be a part of our history, wouldn't you? Well, good news, all you gotta do is not hand over that cargo and we'll scribble you in with our swords. Of course, you can escape the scribe's pen if you just give us that cargo. | Now, if it isn't the %companyname%. As much as I'd like add you to our list of victories, I'll give you a chance here, mercenary to mercenary. All you have to do is hand over that cargo and we'll be on our way. How's that sound?}%SPEECH_OFF%{Hmm, well it was a bombastic request if nothing else. | Well, the theatrics were pretty entertaining if nothing else. | You don't quite understand the need for showmanship, but there's little doubt about the seriousness of this new situation you've found yourself in. | While you appreciated the superlatives and hyperbole, there remains the very terse reality that these men do actually mean business.}
17d5bff8f7ca2464966c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{行路途中，一队装备精良的人挡住了去路。 | 朝%objective%行进时，几个人打破了旅途的宁静。他们排开阵形，武器甲胄铿锵作响。 | 遗憾的是，这趟路注定不得安生。一群人走到你面前，摆明了要拦路。 | 几个全副武装的人走了出来，排成一道铁墙，似乎不打算让你再往前走。 | 队伍前头的几人停下脚步。你上前查看，只见一排装备精良的家伙挡在%companyname%面前。这下可有意思了。}对面的副手走上前，攥拳重重敲了敲胸膛。%SPEECH_ON%{站在你们面前的，正是%mercband%！斩杀过超乎想象的凶兽，这片神弃之地最后的希望！ | 我们是%mercband%，天下闻名的开瓢好手、酒桶克星和姑娘们的情人！ | 站在你们面前的，是传奇的%mercband%！我们拯救过%randomtown%，还斩杀过伪王！ | 瞧瞧我引以为傲的战团，%mercband%！我们击退过一百个兽人，将整座城市从覆灭边缘救回。你们又有什么拿得出手的？ | 你正在和%mercband%的人说话。寻常强盗、肮脏绿皮、钱袋子，还是姑娘的裙摆，从没什么能逃出我们的手心！}%SPEECH_OFF%等这人摆完架势、自吹自擂，他指向你们带着的货物。%SPEECH_ON%{现在知道自己有多危险了吧？那就乖乖把货交出来。 | 可怜的佣兵，希望你认清了面前是谁，最好让手下今晚还能回床上睡觉。只要交出货物，我们就不必把你写进%mercband%的战史。 | 啊，你也想在我们的历史里留名吧？好消息，只要不交货，我们就用剑把你写进去。当然，把货给我们，你也能躲过史官这一笔。 | 这不是%companyname%吗？我很想把你们也列入战绩，不过，看在同为佣兵的份上，给你一次机会。交出货物，我们就走，怎么样？}%SPEECH_OFF%{好吧，别的不说，这要求倒是提得气势十足。 | 别的不说，刚才那出戏还挺好看。 | 你不明白何必摆这番架势，但眼前的处境有多严峻，却毋庸置疑。 | 吹嘘和夸张之辞听起来颇有趣，可现实很简单：这些人确实是来动真格的。}

68c000cc0ccef911f7d6.source: If you want it, come and take it!

98b1fb4fa17123b93ecc.source: It's not worth dying over. Take that damn cargo and be gone.
98b1fb4fa17123b93ecc.translation: 不值得为它送命。拿走这该死的货，滚吧。

4698fcbc6ea0a2beb168.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{Not wanting a fight, you hand the cargo over. They laugh as they take it off your hands.%SPEECH_ON%Good choice, mercenary. Maybe someday you'll be the one doing the threatening.%SPEECH_OFF% | The cargo, whatever it is, isn't worth the lives of your men. You hand the crate over and the mercenaries take it. They laugh at you as you leave.%SPEECH_ON%Like charming a whore!%SPEECH_OFF% | This does not seem like the time or place to be sacrificing your men in the name of %employer%'s delivery service. You hand the cargo over. The mercenaries take it then make their leave, their lieutenant flipping you a crown that spins its way into the mud.%SPEECH_ON%Get yerself a shinebox, kid, this work ain't cut out for you.%SPEECH_OFF% | The mercenaries are well armed and you don't know if you could sleep at night knowing you spent the lives of your men just for some silly crate carrying the old gods know what. With a nod, you hand the cargo over. The mercenary band gladly takes it from you, their lieutenant pausing to nod back with respect.%SPEECH_ON%A wise choice. Don't think I didn't make many like it when I was coming up.%SPEECH_OFF%}
4698fcbc6ea0a2beb168.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{你不愿开战，便交出了货物。对方笑着接过箱子。%SPEECH_ON%选得好，佣兵。也许哪天就轮到你来威胁别人了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 不管箱子里装的是什么，都不值得让兄弟们赔上性命。你交出货箱，那些佣兵接了过去，还在你离开时放声嘲笑。%SPEECH_ON%跟哄个婊子一样容易！%SPEECH_OFF% | 为了%employer%的送货差事，让兄弟们在此送命，怎么看都不合适。你交出货物，对方拿了便走。他们的副手朝你弹出一枚克朗，钱币打着转落进泥里。%SPEECH_ON%小子，买个擦鞋箱去吧，你吃不了这碗饭。%SPEECH_OFF% | 对方装备精良。若只是为了一个天知道装着什么的破箱子，就让兄弟们送命，你怕是再也睡不安稳。你点头交出货物。佣兵们欣然接下，他们的副手停了停，也郑重地点头致意。%SPEECH_ON%明智的选择。我刚入行时，这样的选择可没少做。%SPEECH_OFF%}

386a8f3d6a3137db2682.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{While on the roads, you come across a band of bounty hunters. Their prisoner calls out to you, his voice cracking as he begs for you to save him. He claims he is an innocent man. The bounty hunters tell you to fark off and die. | You're traveling the roads when you come across a group of well-armed bounty hunters. They're yanking along a man shackled from head to toe.%SPEECH_ON%You want no part of this fellow.%SPEECH_OFF%One man says, striking his prisoner in the back of the shins. The man yelps and crawls to you on bloodied hands and knees.%SPEECH_ON%They're all liars! These men will kill me even though I've done nothing wrong! Save me, sirs, I beg of you!%SPEECH_OFF% | You come across a large band of bounty hunters, your two groups oddly mirroring one another, though your purposes in this world clearly diverge. They're transporting a prisoner who has been chained and his mouth stuffed with a rag. The man yells out to you, almost pleading, choking on his words until he's red in the face. One of the bounty hunters spits.%SPEECH_ON%Pay him no mind, stranger, and get on down the road. Best there be no trouble between men such as we.%SPEECH_OFF%}
386a8f3d6a3137db2682.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{路上，你遇见一队赏金猎人。他们押着的囚犯朝你呼救，求你救命，嗓音都喊破了。他声称自己无辜，赏金猎人则骂你滚远点，别来找死。 | 你们沿路而行，遇到一群全副武装的赏金猎人，正拖着一个从头到脚都被锁住的人。%SPEECH_ON%这个家伙的事，你们最好别掺和。%SPEECH_OFF%一人说着，重重踢向囚犯的小腿。囚犯惨叫一声，用血淋淋的双手和膝盖爬向你。%SPEECH_ON%他们都在撒谎！我什么坏事也没做，他们却要杀我！诸位，救救我，求求你们！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你遇见了一大队赏金猎人。两支队伍看起来出奇地相似，干的却显然不是同一行。他们押着一个锁链缠身、嘴里塞布的囚犯。那人朝你拼命喊叫，近乎哀求，话都堵在喉咙里，憋得满脸通红。一名赏金猎人啐了口唾沫。%SPEECH_ON%别理他，陌生人，继续赶路吧。咱们这样的人，最好别互找麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%}

252b1d2d3bfa4e07ed66.source: This isn't any of our business.

ec96882adae603fb2983.source: Perhaps we can buy the prisoner?
ec96882adae603fb2983.translation: 或许我们能买下这个囚犯？

8f2c0c0e9911aab93cc4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You raise up from a nap and turn over, looking for the package as though it were a lover. But she's not there and neither is the cargo. Quickly getting to your feet, you begin ordering the men to attention. %randombrother% runs up and says he's tracked some footprints leading off from the site. | While taking a rest, you hear a disturbance somewhere in the camp. You rush to it to find %randombrother% face down in the dirt, rubbing the back of his head.%SPEECH_ON%Sorry sir, I was taking a piss, and then they went on ahead and took it out of me. Also, they stole the package.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him to repeat that last part.%SPEECH_ON%Goddamn thieves have stolen the goods!%SPEECH_OFF%Time to track those bastards down and get it back. | Naturally, it wouldn't be an ordinary trip. No, this world is too shite for that to be the case. It appears thieves have taken off with the cargo. Luckily, they've left a hell of a lot of evidence, namely footprints and dragmarks from toting the package around. They should be easy to find... | Just once you'd like to have a nice walk from one town to the next. Instead, your agreement with %employer% has attracted trouble once again. Thieves, somehow, managed to sneak into the camp and make off with the cargo. The good news is that they didn't manage to sneak back out: you've found their footprints and they won't be hard to follow.}
8f2c0c0e9911aab93cc4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你从小睡中醒来，翻身去找包裹，仿佛在找枕边的情人。可情人不在，货也不在。你立刻起身，喝令众人警戒。%randombrother%跑来报告，他发现了一串离开营地的脚印。 | 休息时，你听见营地一角传来骚动。赶过去一看，%randombrother%正脸朝下趴在泥里，揉着后脑勺。%SPEECH_ON%抱歉，团长。我正撒尿，他们就过来，把剩下的也给我打出来了。对了，包裹也被偷走了。%SPEECH_OFF%你让他把最后一句再说一遍。%SPEECH_ON%该死的贼把货偷了！%SPEECH_OFF%该追上那些混蛋，把东西拿回来了。 | 果然，这趟路不会太平。这个烂透了的世界，哪会让人安生赶路。盗贼已经带着货跑了。幸好他们留下了大量痕迹，脚印，还有搬动包裹时拖出的印子，想找到他们应该不难…… | 你只是想有那么一次，能安安稳稳从一个镇子走到另一个。可与%employer%的这笔买卖又惹来了麻烦。不知贼人怎么潜进了营地，竟把货偷走了。好消息是，他们离开时没能做到不留痕迹：脚印已经找到了，循迹追踪并不困难。}

1348b5ce95bc0db28a50.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{Thief blood runs thick. You manage to find your employer's goods still in the camp, all locked and safe. He doesn't need to know about this little excursion. | Well, everything's right where it should be. %employer%'s cargo was found underneath a thief's writhing body. You made sure to kick him off before running him through. Wouldn't want to get blood on the package, after all. | Killing off the last of the thieves, you and the men spread out through the brigands' camp looking for the package. %randombrother% spots it right quick, the container still held in the clutches of a dead fool. The mercenary fumbles with the corpse's grasp and, in frustration, simply cuts the arms off the bastard. You retrieve the package and hold it a little closer for the trip going forward. | Staring over the bodies of the felled thieves, you wonder if %employer% needs to know about this. The package looks alright. Some blood and bone on it, but you can rub that right off. | The package's a little scuffed, but it'll be fine. Alright, there's blood all over it and a thief's degloved finger is all smashed up into one of the latches. Those issues aside, everything is perfectly fine.}
1348b5ce95bc0db28a50.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{贼人的鲜血流了一地。你在营地找到了雇主的货物，箱子仍锁得好好的，安然无恙。没必要让他知道这段小插曲。 | 好了，该在的东西都在。%employer%的货箱就在一个挣扎的贼人身下。你先把他踢开，才一剑刺穿，毕竟不能让血溅到包裹上。 | 杀掉最后一名盗贼后，你和兄弟们散开，在匪徒营地里搜寻包裹。%randombrother%很快就找到了，一具蠢货的尸体还死死抱着它。佣兵掰不开那双手，恼火之下干脆剁掉了混蛋的胳膊。你收回包裹，余下路程里打算看得更紧些。 | 看着倒毙的贼人，你琢磨要不要告诉%employer%这件事。包裹看起来还好，就是沾了点血和碎骨，擦掉便是。 | 包裹只是有点磕碰，没什么大碍。好吧，上面到处是血，一名贼人被剥掉皮的手指还碎塞在锁扣里。抛开这些问题，东西完全没事。}

58a0e848fb7b2a772078.source: {The cemetery is layered in fog - that or a thick miasma given off by the dead. Wait... that IS the dead! To arms! | You eye a tombstone with a mound of soil unearthed at its base. Blots of mud lead away like a crumb trail. There are no shovels... no men... As you follow the lead, you come across a band of undead moaning and groaning... now staring at you with insatiable hunger... | A man lingers deep in the rows of tombstones. He seems to be wavering, as though ready to pass out. %randombrother% comes to your side and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%That's no man, sir. There's undead afoot.%SPEECH_OFF%Just as he finishes talking, the stranger in the distance slowly turns and there in the light reveals he's missing half his face. | You come to find many of the graves are emptied. Not just emptied, but unearthed from below. This is not the work of graverobbers...}
58a0e848fb7b2a772078.translation: {墓地笼罩着浓雾，或者说，是死者散发的厚重瘴气。等等……那就是死者！准备战斗！ | 你望见一块墓碑，碑下泥土被翻开，土块像面包屑一样一路散落，却不见铁锹，也不见活人。循迹前行，你撞见一群呻吟嘶叫的亡灵……此刻正带着永不满足的饥饿望向你…… | 墓碑深处徘徊着一个人，身形摇晃，仿佛随时会昏倒。%randombrother%来到你身旁，摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%团长，那不是活人。这里有亡灵。%SPEECH_OFF%话音刚落，远处的身影缓缓转过头，光线照出它缺失了半边的脸。 | 你发现许多墓穴都空了。不只是空了，而是被人从下面挖开。这绝不是盗墓贼干的……}

0de3478f023e834fd669.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{While on the move, you notice that something else is moving, too: the cargo. The lid on it is jumping around and there's a strange glow emerging from its sides. %randombrother% approaches, looks at it, then looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%Should we open it, sir? Or I can take it and throw it in the closest pond because none of that right there is alright.%SPEECH_OFF%You jab the man and ask if he's scared. | Moving along the paths, you begin to hear a low hum emanating from the package %employer% had given you. %randombrother% is standing beside it, poking it with a stick. You slap him back. He explains himself.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, there's something that ain't right with the cargo we're tugging...%SPEECH_OFF%You take a good look at it. There's a faint color brimming at the edges of the lid. As far as you know, fire can't breathe in such a space, and the only thing else that glows in the dark are the moons and the stars. You worry that curiosity is starting to get the better of you... | The cargo rests in the wagon beside you, jostling about to the tilts and turns of the paths. Suddenly, it begins to hum and you swear you saw the lid float upward for just a second. %randombrother% glances over.%SPEECH_ON%You alright, sir?%SPEECH_OFF%Just as he finishes talking, the lid explodes outward, a swirl of colors, mist, ash, fiery heat and brutish cold. You throw your arms up, shielding yourself, and when you take a peek through your elbows the package is completely still, the lid back on. You exchange a glance with the sellsword, then both of you stare at the cargo. This might be a little more than an ordinary delivery... | A low hum emanates from nearby. Thinking a bee hive nearby, you instinctively duck, only to realize the sound is coming from the cargo %employer% had handed you. The lid atop the container is rattling side to side, jostling the latches and nails that are supposed to keep it there. %randombrother% looks a little frightened.%SPEECH_ON%Let's just leave it here. That thing ain't right.%SPEECH_OFF%}
0de3478f023e834fd669.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{行军时，你发现还有一样东西也在动：货箱。箱盖不断跳动，边缝里透出诡异的光。%randombrother%走过来，先看看箱子，又看看你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，要打开吗？要不我把它扔进最近的池塘吧，这玩意儿怎么看都不对劲。%SPEECH_OFF%你捅了捅他，问他是不是怕了。 | 沿路前进时，你听见%employer%交来的包裹发出低低嗡鸣。%randombrother%站在旁边，拿树枝戳它。你一巴掌把他拍开，他连忙解释。%SPEECH_ON%团长，咱们拖着的这箱货不大对劲……%SPEECH_OFF%你仔细一看，箱盖边缘正漫出淡淡光彩。据你所知，这么密闭的地方烧不起火，黑暗里会发光的也只剩星星和月亮。你开始担心，自己的好奇心快要占上风了…… | 货箱就在你身旁的车上，随着路面的起伏转折颠簸。忽然，它开始嗡鸣，你发誓看见箱盖向上浮了一瞬。%randombrother%瞥了过来。%SPEECH_ON%团长，你没事吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他话音未落，箱盖便猛然炸开，色彩、雾气、灰烬、炽热和刺骨寒意混成一团。你举臂护住自己，再从臂弯间望去，箱子却已静止，盖子也完好扣着。你与那佣兵对视一眼，又一同盯住货箱。这恐怕不只是一趟普通送货…… | 附近传来低沉嗡鸣。你以为有蜂巢，下意识缩了缩头，却发现声音来自%employer%交给你的货箱。箱盖左右震颤，将本该固定它的钉子与锁扣摇得咔咔作响。%randombrother%看起来有些害怕。%SPEECH_ON%把它留在这儿吧。这东西不对劲。%SPEECH_OFF%}

6652052370058ee066fd.source: I want to know what's going on.

cac51a17900e3978ca63.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]{Curiosity gets the best of you. Slowly you start prying at the lid. %randombrother% takes a step back and protests.%SPEECH_ON%I think we should leave it alone, sir. I mean c'mon, look at it.%SPEECH_OFF%Ignoring him, you tell the men it's going to be alright, and then you lift the lid up.

 It isn't alright. The explosion knocks you off your feet. Horrible shapes and shrieks swirl all around you. The men instinctively arm themselves as the piloted specters spear into the earth. There the ground lifts in mounds, and there, too, the earth begins to groan. You watch as hands shoot forth, dragging decrepit bodies from their pit. The dead live again and surely they mean to add to their ranks! | Against anyone's best judgment, you pry the cargo open. At first, there is nothing. It's just an empty box. %randombrother% nervously laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Well... I guess that's it then.%SPEECH_OFF%But that can't be it, can it? Why would %employer% have you delivering an empty container unless -- 

 You wake up to a ringing slowly fading from your ears. Turning over, you see that the box has completely evaporated, a flurry of snowy sawdust all that remains of it. %randombrother% rushes over, picking you up and dragging you toward the rest of the company. They point, their mouths moving, shouting...

 A mob of well-armed men are... shuffling your way? As you get a better sight of them, you realize that they are armed with old wooden shields painted with odd spiritual rites, and their armor is of shapes and sizes you have never seen before, as though they were crafted by men just learning the trade, yet still well learned in what they had learned thus far. These are like ancients... the first men. | %randombrother% shakes his head as you go to pick up the lid. With some effort, it's pried open and you quickly step back, expecting the worst. But there's nothing. Not even a sound comes out of the box. You take a sword and rattle it around in the empty box, looking for a secret compartment or something. %randombrother% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, we're just delivering a bunch of air! And to think I thought that damned thing was too heavy!%SPEECH_OFF%Just then, the box lifts briefly into the air, spins, and smashes itself into the ground. It breaks perfectly, noiselessly, and with no wasted movements, every piece of wood laid against the grass like ancient stoneworks. An incorporeal shape leers up from the splintered rites, grinning as it twists.%SPEECH_ON%Oh humans, it is truly good to see you again.%SPEECH_OFF%The voice is like ice down your back. You watch as the specter shoots into the sky then slams back down, spearing into the very earth. Not a second passes before the ground is erupting as bodies begin to clamber out. | The box magnetizes you. Without hesitation, you crank the cargo open and take a look inside. You smell before you see - a horrid stench overwhelming you almost to the point of blindness. One of the men pukes. Another retches. When you look back at the box, blackened tendrils of smoke are sifting out of it, stretching long and far, probing the ground as they go. When they find what they're looking for, they dive into the earth, yanking up bones of dead men like a lure would a fish. | Ignoring the worries of a few of the men, you bust the package open. A pile of heads are to be found, their glowing eyes flickering awake. Their jaws crackle open, shifting from unmoved states to rattle in laughter. You quickly close the box, but a force pushes it back open. You struggle with it, %randombrother% and a few others trying to help, but it's almost as if the utterly silent winds of a storm are pushing back against you.

A bare moment later, you're all thrown back, the lid of the crate soaring into the sky, ushered upward by a gust of blackened souls. They zip around, combing the earth, then collectively position opposite the %companyname%. There you watch in horror as the incorporeal begins to take shape, the foggy mists of souls hardening into the very real bones of souls lost long ago. And, of course, they come armed, the crackling jawbones still clattering with hollow laughter.}
cac51a17900e3978ca63.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]{好奇心终于占了上风，你慢慢撬起箱盖。%randombrother%退后一步，出声阻止。%SPEECH_ON%团长，还是别碰了。你看看它那样子。%SPEECH_OFF%你没理他，只说不会有事，然后掀开盖子。

事情坏得很。爆炸将你掀翻在地，可怖的影子和尖啸围着你盘旋。兄弟们本能地拿起武器，一道道幽魂仿佛受了指引，直刺大地。地面隆起土包，低沉呻吟从地下传来。一只只手破土而出，将腐朽躯体拖出深坑。死者再次行走，而它们显然想让你们也加入行列！ | 不顾众人的判断，你撬开了货箱。起初什么也没有，只有一只空箱。%randombrother%紧张地笑了。%SPEECH_ON%好吧……看来也就这样。%SPEECH_OFF%可不该就这样吧？%employer%为什么让你送一个空箱，除非——

你醒来时，耳中的嗡鸣正在缓缓退去。翻身一看，箱子已经无影无踪，只剩漫天如雪的木屑。%randombrother%冲过来将你拉起，拖向战团。他们指着前方，嘴巴一张一合，大喊着……

一群全副武装的人正……蹒跚着朝你走来？看清之后，你发现他们拿着绘有怪异祭仪图案的古旧木盾，甲胄的形状和尺寸也从未见过，仿佛出自刚学会这门手艺、却已精熟现有技法的人。他们像是古人……最早的人类。 | 你伸手去掀箱盖时，%randombrother%摇了摇头。费了番力气，盖子终于撬开，你立刻退后，准备迎接最坏的情况。可什么都没有，连一丝声响也没有。你拿剑在空箱里敲了敲，想找出暗格之类的东西。%randombrother%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，原来咱们送的是一箱空气！亏我还嫌这鬼东西太沉！%SPEECH_OFF%就在此时，箱子短暂浮起，旋转着砸向地面。它碎得无声无息，整齐得不可思议，没有一片木头落错位置，铺在草地上宛如古老石阵。虚幻的形体从这片木屑祭阵中探出头，一边扭动，一边狞笑。%SPEECH_ON%啊，人类，又见到你们，真好。%SPEECH_OFF%那声音如寒冰滑过脊背。幽魂窜上天空，又猛然落下，直刺大地。片刻之间，土地翻涌，一具具躯体开始向外攀爬。 | 箱子仿佛有种魔力吸住了你。你毫不犹豫地撬开它，往里张望。先扑来的是气味——骇人的恶臭几乎熏得你两眼发黑。一人吐了，另一人也开始干呕。再看箱中，漆黑的烟状触须正缓缓伸出，越伸越长，沿途探查地面。找到目标后，它们猛钻进土里，像鱼钩拽起鱼一样，将死人的骨骸从地下扯出。 | 你不顾几名手下的担忧，砸开了箱子。里面堆着人头，发光的眼睛一双双醒来。下颌咔咔张开，从僵止中活动起来，发出空洞笑声。你连忙关箱，却被一股力量推开。你拼命压住，%randombrother%和其他几人也来帮忙，阻力却如一场完全无声的狂风。

片刻之后，你们一齐被掀开。漆黑灵魂卷起狂风，将箱盖托上天空。它们四下飞窜，扫过地面，随后聚在%companyname%对面。你惊恐地看着虚影逐渐成形，朦胧魂雾凝为远古亡者实实在在的白骨。当然，它们还带着武器，开合的颌骨依旧空洞地咯咯发笑。}

7009647432981f01c564.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{The battle over, you quickly rush back over to the artifact, finding it floating in the air. %randombrother% runs up to your side.%SPEECH_ON%Destroy it, sir, before it causes any more trouble!%SPEECH_OFF% | Your men weren't the only thing to survive the battle - the artifact, or whatever remains of its pulsing power, floats innocently where you'd last seen it. The thing is an orb swirling with energy, occasionally rattling, sometimes whispering a language you know not of. %randombrother% nods toward it.%SPEECH_ON%Smash it, sir. Smash it and let us be done with this horror.%SPEECH_OFF% | Such power was not meant for this world! The artifact has taken the shape of an orb the size of your fist. It floats off the ground, humming as though singing a song from another world. The thing almost seems to be waiting for you, like a dog would wait its master.%SPEECH_ON%Sir.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% tugs on your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, please, destroy it. Let us not take that thing another step with us!%SPEECH_OFF%}
7009647432981f01c564.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{战斗结束，你立刻跑回遗物旁，发现它正浮在空中。%randombrother%赶到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%团长，快毁了它，别让它再惹祸！%SPEECH_OFF% | 活过这场战斗的，不只你的手下。那件遗物，或是其中仍在搏动的残余力量，若无其事地浮在原处。那是一个能量旋涌的球体，偶尔咯咯作响，有时用你听不懂的语言低语。%randombrother%朝它点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%砸了它，团长。把它砸了，让这场噩梦结束吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 这样的力量根本不属于这个世界！遗物化成了拳头大小的球，悬在地面上方，嗡嗡低鸣，仿佛唱着异世的歌。它似乎在等你，就像狗等待主人。%SPEECH_ON%团长。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%拉了拉你的肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%团长，求你了，毁掉它。别再带着这东西走哪怕一步！%SPEECH_OFF%}

9b0f71880ce00bb9f440.source: We're paid to deliver this, so that's what we'll do.
9b0f71880ce00bb9f440.translation: 收了送货的钱，就把货送到。

22080c7ebb0c4f8c982f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{You take out your sword and stand before the artifact with the blade slowly raised over your head.%SPEECH_ON%Don't do it!%SPEECH_OFF%Glancing over your shoulder, you see %randombrother% and the other men scowling at you. Blackness surrounds them and the whole world as far as your eye can see. Their eyes glow red, pulsing furiously with every spoken word.%SPEECH_ON%You shall burn forever! Burn forever! Destroy it and you shall burn! Burn! BURN!%SPEECH_OFF%Screaming, you turn around and slice your sword through the relic. It splits effortlessly in two and a wave of color sweeps back into your world. Sweat pours from your forehead as you find yourself leaning on the pommel of your weapon. You look back to see your mercenary company staring at you.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, are you alright?%SPEECH_OFF%You sheathe your sword and nod, but you've never felt so horrified in all your life. %employer% won't be happy, but he and his anger be damned! | Just as soon as the thought of destroying the relic crosses your mind, so too does a wave of horrified screaming. The shrill crying of women and children, their voices cracking with terror as though they had come running at you all on fire. They scream at you in hundreds of languages, but every so often the one you know passes you and it's always with the same word: DON'T.

 You draw your sword and swing it back over your head. The artifact hums and vibrates. Smoky tendrils waft off it and a brutish heat washes over you. DON'T.

 You steady your grip.

 Davkul. Yekh'la. Imshudda. Pezrant. DON'T.

You swallow and steady your aim.

 DON'T.RAVWEET.URRLA.OSHARO.EBBURRO.MEHT'JAKA.DON'T.DON'T.DON'T.DO--

 The strike is true, the word is lost, the artifact falls to the earth in twine. You fall with it, to your knees, and a few of the company's brothers come to lift you back up. %employer% won't be happy, but you can't help but feel as though you've spared this world a horror it need not ever see or hear.}
22080c7ebb0c4f8c982f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{你拔剑站在遗物面前，缓缓将剑举过头顶。%SPEECH_ON%别动手！%SPEECH_OFF%你回头看去，%randombrother%和其他人正怒视着你。黑暗包围了他们，也包围了目之所及的整个世界。他们双眼泛红，每吐出一个字，红光便猛烈跳动。%SPEECH_ON%你将永世焚烧！永世焚烧！毁了它，你就会燃烧！烧吧！烧吧！%SPEECH_OFF%你大喊着转身，一剑劈向遗物。它轻易裂成两半，色彩如潮水般重返世界。额头汗流不止，你发现自己正撑着剑柄，勉强站稳。回头望去，兄弟们正看着你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，你没事吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你收剑点头，却从未在一生中感到如此恐惧。%employer%不会高兴的，可让他和他的怒气都见鬼去吧！ | 刚生出毁掉遗物的念头，你便听见一阵惊恐的尖叫。女人和孩子的凄厉哭喊中满是恐惧，仿佛他们正浑身燃烧着朝你奔来。他们用数百种语言尖叫，偶尔掠过你听得懂的一种，却总是同一个词：不许。

你拔出剑，将它举过头顶。遗物嗡鸣震颤，烟状触须从中飘出，骇人的热浪扑面而来。不许。

你稳住握剑的手。

达夫库尔。耶赫拉。伊姆舒达。佩兹兰特。不许。

你咽了口唾沫，瞄准目标。

不许。拉夫维特。乌尔拉。奥沙罗。埃布罗。梅特贾卡。不许。不许。不许。不——

一剑正中，话音断绝，遗物裂成两半落地。你也随之跪倒，几个兄弟赶来将你扶起。%employer%不会高兴，但你总觉得，自己替这个世界挡下了一场本不该被看见、更不该被听见的恐怖。}

da8d336a6e91894a05e3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{You shake your head and get another crate, carefully pushing the floating artifact into it then closing the lid. %employer% was paying you good money and, well, you plan on seeing it through.
