But for some reason you're not sure if that choice is your own, or if this strange relic's whispering is guiding your hand for you. | You go and retrieve a wooden chest and lift it up to the artifact, quickly closing the lid over it. A few of the mercenaries shake their head. It's probably not the best of ideas, but for some reason you fill compelled to finish your task. | Better judgment says you should destroy this horrible relic, but better judgment fails once more. You take a wooden chest and move it over the artifact before closing the lid and snapping shut the latches. You've no idea what you are doing this, but your body is filled with newfound energy as you get ready to get back on the road.}
da8d336a6e91894a05e3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]{你摇摇头，找来另一只木箱，小心地将浮空遗物推入其中，盖上箱盖。%employer%出了好价钱，你打算把差事办到底。可不知为何，你不确定这是自己的决定，还是那诡异遗物的低语在操纵你的双手。 | 你找来木箱，举到遗物下方，迅速将它合在里面。几个佣兵摇着头。这大概不是什么好主意，可不知为何，你就是非要把任务完成不可。 | 理智告诉你，该毁掉这可怕的遗物。但理智又一次败下阵来。你拿木箱罩住遗物，合上盖子，扣紧锁扣。你不知道自己为什么这么做，准备重新上路时，身体却涌满了前所未有的力量。}

ee95ca784e5fb919f7c7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%recipient%'s waiting for you as you enter the town. He hurriedly takes the cargo off your hands.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, ohhh I did not think you would get here.%SPEECH_OFF%His grubby fingers dance along the chest carrying the cargo. He turns around and barks an order to one of his men. They step forward and hand you a satchel of crowns. | Finally, you've made it. %recipient% is standing there in the middle of the road, his hands clasped over his stomach, a slick grin on his cheeky face.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, I was not sure you'd make it.%SPEECH_OFF%You lug the cargo up and hand it over.%SPEECH_ON%Oh yeah, and why do you say that?%SPEECH_OFF%The man takes the box and hands it off to a robed man who quickly hurries away with it tucked under an arm. %recipient% laughs as he hands you a satchel of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%The roads are rough these days, are they not?%SPEECH_OFF%You understand he's making small talk, anything to get your attention off the cargo you just handed over. Whatever, you got your pay, that's good enough for you. | %recipient% welcomes you and a few of his men hurry over to take the cargo. He claps you on the shoulders.%SPEECH_ON%I take it your journey went well?%SPEECH_OFF%You spare him the details and inquire about your pay.%SPEECH_ON%Bah, a sellsword through and through. %randomname%! Get this man what he deserves!%SPEECH_OFF%One of %recipient%'s bodyguards walks over and hands you a small chest of crowns. | After some looking, a man asks who you're looking for. When you say %recipient%, he points you out toward a nearby paddock where a man is strutting about on a rather opulent looking horse.

 You walk on over and the man rears the steed and asks if that's the cargo %employer% sent. You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Leave it there at your feet. I'll come and get it.%SPEECH_OFF%You don't, instead asking about your pay. The man sighs and whistles to a bodyguard who hurries over.%SPEECH_ON%See to it that this sellsword gets the pay he deserves.%SPEECH_OFF%Finally, you put the crate on the ground and make your leave.}
ee95ca784e5fb919f7c7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{进城时，%recipient%已经等在那里，急忙从你手中接过货物。%SPEECH_ON%哦，哦……我还以为你到不了呢。%SPEECH_OFF%他脏兮兮的手指在货箱上来回摸索，随后转身朝一个手下喝了一声。那人走上前，递给你一袋克朗。 | 总算到了。%recipient%站在路中央，双手交握在腹前，厚脸皮上挂着狡猾的笑。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我还真不敢肯定你能到。%SPEECH_OFF%你费力举起货箱，递了过去。%SPEECH_ON%哦？为什么这么说？%SPEECH_OFF%他接过箱子，转手交给一个穿袍子的人。那人将箱子夹在腋下，匆匆离开。%recipient%笑着递给你一袋克朗。%SPEECH_ON%这年头路上不太平，不是吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你明白他只是在闲扯，好将你的注意力从刚交出的货上引开。随便吧，报酬到手，对你来说就够了。 | %recipient%迎上来，几个手下赶忙接走货物。他拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%一路还顺利吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你略去经过，直接问起报酬。%SPEECH_ON%哈，果然是个地道的佣兵。%randomname%！把他应得的拿来！%SPEECH_OFF%%recipient%的一名护卫走过来，递给你一小箱克朗。 | 找了一阵，有人问你要找谁。你报出%recipient%的名字，他便指向附近的马场，一个人正骑着华贵的骏马来回炫耀。

你走过去，那人勒得马匹扬起前蹄，问这是不是%employer%送来的货。你点头。%SPEECH_ON%放在脚边吧，我来拿。%SPEECH_OFF%你没有照做，而是先问报酬。那人叹口气，吹声口哨，一名护卫快步赶来。%SPEECH_ON%把这位佣兵应得的报酬付给他。%SPEECH_OFF%这下，你才放下箱子，转身离开。}

6a3cf77a31ce64781271.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%Ah, the Crownling.%SPEECH_OFF%The voice comes from a nearby alley. Usually that means you're about to have some coin lifted off ya, but instead find a man offering you gold.%SPEECH_ON%I am %recipient%, and that package belongs to me. Send %employer% my regards, or don't, I don't care.%SPEECH_OFF%The man steals away and is gone just as soon as he came. | %recipient% is a squat man and he carries the Vizier's emblem and signage as though it were as heavy as the crate you just brought him.%SPEECH_ON%I've given the Vizier much, and what does he use to repay me? A Crownling's sweat. May the Gilder blink when gazing upon that man's future.%SPEECH_OFF%You say nothing to this, in part because you wonder if it is a 'test' to see if you'll agree with him and turn yourself out to be an enemy of the ever majestic Vizier. The man stares at you for a moment, then shrugs and continues.%SPEECH_ON%I have your payment here. The coin is all accounted for, though I will not take offense if you wish to count it yourself. Ah, I see you already are. Good. See? It's all there. Now run along little Crownling.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %recipient% holding court over a small throng of children. He quickly singles you and teaches them a lesson about keeping to their studies lest they end up like you. After the kids are dismissed, the man comes over with a satchel of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%My men told me you had arrived and that the material was still in good standing. Here is your motly payment, Crownling.%SPEECH_OFF% | You enter %recipient%'s home where the package is finally dropped off and whisked away by servants. Staring at you from a comfortable looking chair, %recipient% asks if your journey went well. You state that idle talk does not fill your pockets and then inquire about your pay. The man raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, have I offended the Crownling with my kind, civilized sensibilities? How dare I. Well then, your pay is in the corner and it is in full as agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF% | %recipient% is pontificating about the nature of birds to a mirror. When he sees you in the reflection, he turns around and speaks as though nothing unusual had been going on at all.%SPEECH_ON%A Crownling. Of course the Vizier sends a Crownling. I like to imagine you did not dare profane the materials of the crate with your eyes, but I can't even trust such professionalism out of your sort. But you can expect it of me: your payment is in the corner, and in full.%SPEECH_OFF%}
6a3cf77a31ce64781271.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%啊，克朗客。%SPEECH_OFF%声音从附近的小巷传来。通常这意味着你要被摸走几枚钱币，这次却有人主动给你钱。%SPEECH_ON%我是%recipient%，那包裹是我的。替我向%employer%问好。不问也罢，我无所谓。%SPEECH_OFF%那人悄然退走，来去一样迅速。 | %recipient%身材矮胖，捧着维齐尔的徽记与标牌，仿佛那东西和你刚送来的箱子一样沉。%SPEECH_ON%我为维齐尔付出那么多，他拿什么回报我？一个克朗客的汗水。愿镀金者看向那人的前程时，恰好眨了眼。%SPEECH_OFF%你一言不发，多少怀疑这是不是试探：只要附和一句，便会被算作尊贵维齐尔的敌人。那人盯着你看了片刻，耸耸肩继续说。%SPEECH_ON%报酬在这里。钱都点清了，你若想再数一遍，我也不介意。啊，已经数上了。很好。看见了吧？一分不少。去吧，小克朗客。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%recipient%时，他正被一小群孩子围着。他立刻指着你，教训孩子们要用功读书，否则就会落得你这般下场。打发走孩子后，他提着一袋克朗走来。%SPEECH_ON%手下说你到了，货物也完好。这是你的报酬，克朗客。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%recipient%的家，终于卸下包裹，仆人立刻将它搬走。%recipient%坐在一张看起来很舒服的椅子上，问你旅途是否顺利。你说闲聊装不满钱袋，随即问起报酬。他扬起一边眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%啊，我这番文明友善的礼数，竟冒犯了克朗客？真是不该。那么，钱就在角落，按约定付足了。%SPEECH_OFF% | %recipient%正对着镜子大谈鸟类的天性。他从倒影里看见你，便转过身，仿佛刚才什么怪事也没有发生。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客。维齐尔果然派了个克朗客来。我倒希望你没敢用眼睛亵渎箱中之物，可你们这种人，连这点行规也叫人信不过。我的行规你却可以放心：钱在角落，一分不少。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a30d23ca3a1386aca2eb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{%employer%'s reading a scroll when you enter. He waves you off, perhaps thinking you're just a servant. You clank your scabbard against the wall. The man glances up, then quickly drops his papers.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellsword! It is good to see you. I have a problem specifically for a man of your... proclivities.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses as if expecting your input. When you've none, he awkwardly continues.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, of course, the task. There are goblins %direction% of %origin% who have established something of a foothold. I'd take myself and some of my knights to go take care of it, but as it turns out, 'killing gobbos' is beneath those men. Hogwash, I say. I think they just don't want to die at the hands of the stunty little gits. Honor, valor, all that.%SPEECH_OFF%He smirks and raises a hand.%SPEECH_ON%But it's not beneath you, so long as the pay is right, yes?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s yelling at a man leaving his room. When he settles down, he bids you a fair greeting.%SPEECH_ON%Farkin' hell, it's good to see you. Do you have any notion as to how hard it is to get your 'loyal' men to go kill some goblins?%SPEECH_OFF%He spits and wipes his mouth on his sleeve.%SPEECH_ON%Apparently it is not the most noble of tasks. Something about how those little gits don't ever fight fair. Can you believe that? Men telling me, a highborn nobleman, what is 'noble' or not. Well, there it is anyway, sellsword. I need you to go %direction% of %origin% and root out some goblins that have set up a camp. Can you do that for me?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s unsheathing and sheathing a sword. He seems to look at himself in the blade's reflection before snapping it away again.%SPEECH_ON%The peasants are badgering me again. They say there are goblins camping at a place called %location% %direction% of %origin%. I've no reason to disbelieve them after a young boy was brought to my feet today, a poison dart in his neck.%SPEECH_OFF%He slams the sword into its scabbard.%SPEECH_ON%Are you willing to take care of this problem for me?%SPEECH_OFF% | Red in the face, a drunken %employer% slams a mug down when you enter his room.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, right?%SPEECH_OFF%His guard looks in and nods. The nobleman laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Oh. Good. More men to send to their deaths.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses before bursting into laughter.%SPEECH_ON%I joke, what a joke, right? We are having an issue with some goblins %direction% of %origin%. I need you to go take care of them, are you -hic- up for that or should I go ask someone else to dig their own... I mean...%SPEECH_OFF%He shuts himself up with another drink. | %employer%'s comparing two scrolls when you enter.%SPEECH_ON%My taxmen are falling a little short these days. A shame, though I guess it's good business for you now that I can't afford to send my so called 'loyal' knights anywhere.%SPEECH_OFF%He throws the papers aside and tents his hands over his table.%SPEECH_ON%My spies are reporting goblins have set up camp at a place they call %location% %direction% of %origin%. I need you to go there and do what my bannermen refuse to do.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% breaks bread as you enter, but he doesn't share any. He dips both ends into a goblet of wine and stuffs his mouth. He speaks, but it's more crumbs than words.%SPEECH_ON%Good seeing you, sellsword. I have some goblins %direction% of %origin% that need rooting out. I'd send my knights to go take care of them, but they're, uh, a little more important and less expendable. I'm sure you understand.%SPEECH_OFF%He manages to stuff the rest of the bread into his ugly maw. For a moment, he chokes, and for a moment you consider shutting the door and letting this end here and now. Unfortunately, his throes of anguish garner the attention of a guard who swoops in and slams the nobleman in the chest, spilling the hazard right out in all its goopy, near-assassinating glory. | When you find %employer%, he's sending off a few knights, chasing them out the door with a few parting curses. The sight of you, however, seems to momentarily settle the man.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! Good to see you! Better you than those so-called 'men'.%SPEECH_OFF%He takes a seat and pours himself a drink. He takes a sip, stares at it, then downs it all in one go.%SPEECH_ON%My loyal bannermen refuse to go take on the goblins which have camped %direction% of %origin%. They talk of ambushes, poison, all that...%SPEECH_OFF%His speech is increasingly slurred.%SPEECH_ON%Well... -hic-, you know all that, right? And you know what I'm asking next, right? Of - of course you do, -hic-, I need you to hand me another drink! Ha, kidding. Go kill those goblins, wouldya?%SPEECH_OFF%}
a30d23ca3a1386aca2eb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{你进来时，%employer%正在读一份卷轴。他摆手示意你退下，大概把你当成了仆人。你用剑鞘撞了一下墙，发出铿锵声。他抬眼一看，赶紧放下手里的文书。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵！见到你真好。我这里有件麻烦，正适合你这种有着……特殊偏好的人。%SPEECH_OFF%他停了停，像是在等你接话。你没吭声，他只得尴尬地继续。%SPEECH_ON%是，对，说正事。有些地精在%origin%的%direction%边站稳了脚跟。我本想亲自带几位骑士去解决，可他们却觉得，宰地精有失身份。要我说，简直胡扯。我看他们只是不愿死在那些矮小的崽子手里，才扯什么荣誉、英勇之类的鬼话。%SPEECH_OFF%他似笑非笑地抬起一只手。%SPEECH_ON%不过，只要价钱合适，你总不会嫌这事有失身份，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正冲着一个出门的人破口大骂。等平静下来，他才和气地向你打招呼。%SPEECH_ON%他娘的，见到你可真好。你知道要让那些忠心耿耿的手下去杀几只地精，有多难吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他啐了一口，用袖子擦擦嘴。%SPEECH_ON%听他们说，这活不够高贵。无非就是那些小崽子从不光明正大地交战。你敢信吗？一帮手下居然来教我这个出身高贵的贵族，什么高贵、什么不高贵！总之就是这么回事，佣兵。我要你去%origin%的%direction%边，把在那里扎营的地精连窝端掉。你能办到吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%把剑拔出又收回。他似乎总要借剑刃上的倒影照一照自己，才又啪地推剑入鞘。%SPEECH_ON%农民们又来纠缠我。他们说，地精在%origin%的%direction%边，一个叫%location%的地方扎了营。今天，一个脖子上插着毒镖的小男孩被抬到我面前，我也没理由不信他们了。%SPEECH_OFF%他猛地把剑送回鞘中。%SPEECH_ON%你愿意替我解决这个麻烦吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进房间时，喝得满脸通红的%employer%重重搁下酒杯。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他的卫兵往里看了一眼，点了点头。贵族大笑起来。%SPEECH_ON%哦，好啊。又有一批人可以派去送死了。%SPEECH_OFF%他停了片刻，随即爆出一阵大笑。%SPEECH_ON%开个玩笑，挺好笑吧？%origin%的%direction%边有些地精，给我们惹了不少麻烦。我要你去解决它们，你——嗝——干得了吗？还是我得另找人去挖自己的……我是说……%SPEECH_OFF%他又灌了一口酒，把后半句话堵了回去。 | 你进来时，%employer%正在对照两份卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%这些日子，税吏交来的钱有点不够数。真遗憾。不过对你倒是好事，毕竟我现在已经没钱让那些所谓忠心耿耿的骑士出门办事了。%SPEECH_OFF%他把文书丢到一边，双手指尖相抵，支在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%密探来报，有群地精在%origin%的%direction%边扎营，它们把那里叫作%location%。我要你去那里，做那些家臣不肯做的事。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进来时，%employer%正在掰面包，却没有分你半点。他把两截面包都蘸进酒杯，塞满嘴巴。他开口说话，喷出来的面包屑比字还多。%SPEECH_ON%见到你真好，佣兵。%origin%的%direction%边有些地精，需要清除。我本想派骑士去，可他们，呃，比你们重要些，也损失不起。想必你能理解。%SPEECH_OFF%他又把剩下的面包一股脑塞进那张丑陋的大嘴，一时噎得喘不过气。你也有那么一刻，想干脆关上门，让这一切就此了结。可惜，他痛苦挣扎的动静引来了卫兵。卫兵冲上前，朝贵族胸口猛捶一记，把那团几乎完成刺杀大业的黏糊凶器给震了出来。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正把几个骑士往外赶，临出门还不忘追骂几句。不过一看见你，他似乎暂时平静了下来。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！见到你真好！总比见到那些所谓的男人强。%SPEECH_OFF%他坐下来，给自己倒了杯酒。先抿一口，盯着杯子看了看，随后一饮而尽。%SPEECH_ON%我的忠实家臣不肯去对付那些在%origin%的%direction%边扎营的地精。什么埋伏啊、毒药啊，借口一大堆……%SPEECH_OFF%他说话越来越含糊。%SPEECH_ON%嗯……嗝，你都明白，对吧？也知道我接下来要你做什么，对吧？当、当然明白，嗝，我要你再给我来杯酒！哈，开个玩笑。去把那些地精杀了，成吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

cb7efd98d4948d7b250e.source: {Fighting goblins won't come cheap. | I trust you'll pay amply for this. | Let's talk money.}
cb7efd98d4948d7b250e.translation: {对付地精，价钱可不会便宜。 | 想必你会付足报酬。 | 谈谈报酬吧。}

5e5689788e7155decd15.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]{You enter the goblin camp to find it empty. But you know better - you know you've just walked into a trap. Just then, the damned greenskins emerge from all around you. With the loudest warcry you can muster, you order the men to prepare for battle! | The goblins have fooled you! They left the camp and maneuvered back around, encircling you. Prepare the men carefully, because this trap will not be easy to escape. | You should have known better: you've stepped right into a goblin trap! They have their soldiers placed all around while the company is standing around like a bunch of sheep to the slaughter!}
5e5689788e7155decd15.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]{你走进地精营地，发现里面空无一人。但你没那么天真：你知道，自己已经踏进陷阱了。就在这时，该死的绿皮从四面八方现身。你竭力发出一声战吼，命令弟兄们准备迎战！ | 你中了地精的诡计！它们撤出营地后又迂回包抄，将你们团团围住。这次得小心列阵，要逃出这个陷阱可不容易。 | 你本该多长个心眼：现在竟一头扎进了地精的陷阱！它们早在四周布下兵力，战团却还杵在那里，像一群任人宰割的绵羊！}

8f3c7d71b72971e61328.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{As you finish the last goblin you are suddenly greeted by a heavily armed group of men. Their lieutenant steps forward, his thumbs hooked into a belt holding up a sword.%SPEECH_ON%Well, well, you really are stupid. %employer% does not forget easily - and he hasn't forgotten the last time you betrayed him. Consider this a little... return of the favor.%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly, all the men behind the lieutenant charge forth. Arm yourselves, this was an ambush! | Cleaning gobbo blood off your sword, you suddenly spot a group of men walking toward you. They're carrying %employer%'s banner and are drawing their weapons. The realization that you've been setup dawns on you just as the men begin to charge. They let you fight the goblins first, the bastards! Let them have it! | A man seemingly from nowhere comes to greet you. He's well armed, well armored, and apparently quite happy, grinning sheepishly as he approaches.%SPEECH_ON%Evening, mercenaries. Good work on those greenskins, eh?%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses to let his smile fade.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% sends his regards.%SPEECH_OFF%Just then, a group of men swarm out from the sides of the road. It's an ambush! That damned nobleman has betrayed you! | A group of armed men wearing the colors of %faction% fall in behind you, the group fanning out to stare at your company. Their leader sizes you up.%SPEECH_ON%I'm going to enjoy prying that sword from your cold, dead hands.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and ask why you've been setup.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% doesn't forget those who doublecross him or the house. That's about all you need to know. Not like anything I say here will do you good when you're dead.%SPEECH_OFF%To arms, then, for this is an ambush! | Your men scour the goblin camp and find not a soul. Suddenly, men in the colors of %faction% appear behind you, the lieutenant of the group walking forward with ill intent. He's got a cloth embroidered with %employer%'s sigil.%SPEECH_ON%A shame those greenskins couldn't finish you off. If you're wondering why I'm here, it is to collect a debt owed to %employer%. You promised a task well done. You could not own up to that promise. Now you die.%SPEECH_OFF%You unsheathe your sword and flash its blade at the lieutenant.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like %employer% is about to have another promise broken.%SPEECH_OFF%}
8f3c7d71b72971e61328.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{你刚解决最后一只地精，一群全副武装的人便突然出现在面前。他们的副官上前一步，双手拇指钩着悬挂佩剑的腰带。%SPEECH_ON%啧啧，你还真是蠢。%employer%记性好着呢，上次你背叛他的事，他可没忘。就当这是一点……回礼吧。%SPEECH_OFF%副官身后的众人突然冲了上来。拿起武器，这是一场伏击！ | 你正擦拭剑上的地精血，突然看见一群人走来。他们打着%employer%的旗号，纷纷拔出武器。等到他们开始冲锋，你才恍然明白，自己中计了。这帮混蛋，居然先让你跟地精拼了一场！给他们点颜色看看！ | 一个男人不知从哪儿冒出来，走上前跟你打招呼。他兵甲齐全，心情似乎也不错，走近时还带着几分扭捏的笑。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，佣兵们。那些绿皮，收拾得不错啊？%SPEECH_OFF%他顿了顿，收起笑容。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%托我向你们问好。%SPEECH_OFF%就在这时，一群人从道路两侧蜂拥而出。是伏击！那个该死的贵族出卖了你！ | 一队身穿%faction%军服的武装士兵出现在你们身后，散开队形，盯着战团。他们的头领上下打量着你。%SPEECH_ON%等你的尸体凉透了，我要亲手掰开你的手指，拿走那把剑。想想就痛快。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，问他为什么设下这个圈套。%SPEECH_ON%谁敢背叛%employer%或他的家族，他都不会忘。你知道这些就够了。反正人都要死了，我再多说什么，对你也没用。%SPEECH_OFF%那就拔剑吧，这是一场伏击！ | 弟兄们搜遍地精营地，没找到半个活物。突然，一群身穿%faction%军服的人出现在你们身后，带队的副官来势不善地走上前。他拿着一块绣有%employer%徽记的布。%SPEECH_ON%可惜，那些绿皮没能收拾掉你。要问我为什么来，是替%employer%讨债的。你答应把差事办妥，却没兑现承诺。现在，拿命来还吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你拔出剑，将明晃晃的剑刃对着副官。%SPEECH_ON%看来，又有人要对%employer%食言了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

c2a292723024eb9f732f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{You wipe your sword on your pant leg and quickly sheathe it. The ambushers lay dead, skewered into this grotesque pose or that one. %randombrother% walks up and inquires what to do now. It appears that %faction% isn't going to be on the friendliest of terms. | You kick the dead body of an ambusher off the end of your sword. It appears %faction% isn't going to be on the friendliest of terms from now on. Maybe next time, when I agree to do something for these people, I actually do it. | Well, if nothing else, what can be learned from this is to not agree to a task you can't complete. The people of these land are not particularly friendly to those who fall short of their promises... | You betrayed %faction%, but that's not something to dwell on. They betrayed you, that's what is important now! And going into the future, you best be suspicious of them and anyone who flies their banner. | %employer%, judging by the dead bannermen at your feet, appears to no longer be happy with you. If you were to guess, it's because of something you did in the past - doublecross, failure, back-talking, sleeping with a nobleman's daughter? It all runs together that you try and think about it. What's important now is that this wedge between you two will not be easily healed. You best be wary of %faction%'s men for a little while.}
c2a292723024eb9f732f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{你在裤腿上擦净剑刃，迅速收剑入鞘。伏击者已经死了个精光，被利刃刺穿的尸体歪扭成各种怪样。%randombrother%走过来，问接下来怎么办。看来，%faction%不会再对你们有什么好脸色了。 | 你一脚踹开串在剑上的伏击者尸体。看来，从今往后，%faction%不会再对你们有什么好脸色。下次替这些人接活，或许真该把答应的事办完。 | 好吧，就算没有别的收获，至少也能从中记住一件事：办不到的活，就别答应。这地方的人，对食言之辈可不怎么友善…… | 你背叛了%faction%，但这有什么好纠结的。现在要紧的是，他们居然也背叛了你！往后可得多长个心眼，提防他们，也提防任何打着他们旗号的人。 | 看看脚下这些阵亡的家臣，%employer%似乎已经对你很不满意了。要你猜，大概是因为从前做过的某件事——出尔反尔、办事不力、顶撞了他，还是跟某位贵族的女儿上了床？细想起来，这些事全混在了一起。眼下要紧的是，你们之间这道裂痕可没那么容易弥合。最近最好小心些，提防%faction%的人。}

e486e150fd71655eef8a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_83.png[/img]{Having slain the last of the goblins, you take a peek about their encampment. They seem the merry sort - piles of trinkets and instruments, all of which could double as a weapon. All it'd require would be to dip them in the giant pot of poison resting right in the middle of the ruins. You kick it over and tell the men to get ready to head back to %employer%, your employer. | The goblins put up a good, crafty fight, but you've managed to kill them all. Their camp set aflame, you order the men to get ready to return to %employer% with the good news. | While the short-greenskins put up a hell of a fight, your company managed a better one. The last of the goblins slain, you take a look around their ruined encampment. It appears they were not totally alone - there's evidence that other goblins ran off while the fighting was going on. Maybe family? Children? No matter, it's time to return to %employer%, the man who hired you. | Ah, it was a good fight. %employer% will be expecting to hear word of it now. | No wonder men do not wish to fight goblins, they put up a fight far beyond their stature. A shame one could not put their minds into a man, but perhaps it is for the best that such ferocity is contained within such small beings!}
e486e150fd71655eef8a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_83.png[/img]{杀死最后一只地精后，你打量了一番它们的营地。这些家伙似乎还挺会找乐子，堆了不少小玩意儿和乐器，而且件件都能当武器用。只要往废墟正中那口装满毒药的大锅里蘸一蘸就行。你一脚踢翻毒锅，叫弟兄们准备回去见雇主%employer%。 | 地精打得狡猾又顽强，但你们还是把它们杀了个干净。营地已经燃起大火，你命令弟兄们准备返回，向%employer%报喜。 | 这些矮个子绿皮确实难缠，不过你的战团技高一筹。杀死最后一只地精后，你环顾已经毁坏的营地。看来，原先待在这里的不只它们：有些迹象表明，交战时另有地精逃了出去。或许是家眷？孩子？无所谓，该回去见雇主%employer%了。 | 啊，打得痛快。如今，%employer%该等着听这场胜仗的消息了。 | 难怪人们不愿跟地精交战，这些小东西打起仗来，凶悍程度远超它们的个头。可惜，没法把它们的脑子装进人的身躯里。不过，这等凶性被困在如此矮小的身子里，或许反倒是件好事！}

cde726bc0d365d3cc761.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You enter %employer%'s room and drop a few goblin heads on the floor. He glances at them.%SPEECH_ON%Huh, they're actually a lot bigger than the scribes tell.%SPEECH_OFF%With a few words you report the destruction of the greenskins' encampment. The nobleman nods, rubbing his chin.%SPEECH_ON%Excellent. Your pay, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%He hands over a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns. | %employer%'s throwing rocks at a skittish cat when you enter. He glances at you, giving the poor creature the slightest opening to escape out a window. The nobleman chases it out with a few rocks, thankfully missing with every one.%SPEECH_ON%Good to see you, sellsword. My spies have already told me of your doings. Here's your pay, as agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF%He slides a wooden chest of %reward_completion% crowns across his table. | %employer%'s shucking nuts when you return. He throws the shells on the ground, jawing and gnashing as he speaks.%SPEECH_ON%Oy, it's good to see you again. I take it you were successful, yes?%SPEECH_OFF%You lift a few goblin heads up, each one tethered to a unifying band. They twist and stare at the room and at one another. The man puts his hand up.%SPEECH_ON%Please, we are dignified people here. Put that away.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and hand them to %randombrother% who is waiting out in the hall. %employer% walks around his table and hands you a satchel.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns, as agreed upon. Good job, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% laughs when he sees you come in with the goblin head.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, man, don't be bringing those in here. Give 'em to the dogs.%SPEECH_OFF%He's a bit drunk. You're not sure if he's elated that you were successful or if he's just naturally merry with a bit of ale in him.%SPEECH_ON%Your payment was -hic- %reward_completion% crowns, right?%SPEECH_OFF%You think to 'alter' the details, but a guard outside looks in on the talks and shakes his head. Oh well, looks like it was %reward_completion% crowns then. | When you return to %employer% he's got a woman over his legs. In fact, she's bent over and his hand is in the air. They both stare at you, pausing, then she quickly scurries under his table and he straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! It's good to see you! I take it you were successful destroying those greenskins, yes?%SPEECH_OFF%The poor lady bumps her head underneath the desk, but you try to pay it no mind as you inform the man of the expedition's success. He claps his hands, looks to stand, then thinks better of it.%SPEECH_ON%If you would, your payment of %reward_completion% crowns is on the bookshelf behind me.%SPEECH_OFF%He smiles awkwardly as you retrieve it.}
cde726bc0d365d3cc761.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你走进%employer%的房间，把几颗地精脑袋丢在地上。他瞥了一眼。%SPEECH_ON%咦，比那些文书描述的可大多了。%SPEECH_OFF%你用几句话禀报了捣毁绿皮营地的经过。贵族摸着下巴，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%很好。这是答应你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%他递来一个装着%reward_completion%克朗的钱袋。 | 你进来时，%employer%正拿石子砸一只受惊的猫。他分神看了你一眼，那可怜的小东西便趁机从窗户逃了出去。贵族又朝窗外追扔了几颗石子，幸好一颗也没砸中。%SPEECH_ON%很高兴见到你，佣兵。密探已经把你做的事告诉我了。这是你的报酬，按约定的数目。%SPEECH_OFF%他将一个装着%reward_completion%克朗的木箱沿桌面推了过来。 | 你回来时，%employer%正在剥坚果。他把果壳扔在地上，一边嚼得咯吱作响，一边开口。%SPEECH_ON%噢，又见到你了，真好。想必你得手了，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你提起几颗串在同一根带子上的地精脑袋。它们晃来转去，时而瞪着屋内，时而面面相觑。他抬起一只手。%SPEECH_ON%拜托，这里都是体面人。把那东西收起来。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，把脑袋交给等在走廊里的%randombrother%。%employer%绕过桌子，递给你一个钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion%克朗，按说好的数目。干得漂亮，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%看见你拎着地精脑袋进来，笑了起来。%SPEECH_ON%老兄，别把那玩意儿带进来，扔给狗吧。%SPEECH_OFF%他有些醉了。你拿不准他是因为你得手了才这么高兴，还是只要几杯麦酒下肚，就会喜笑颜开。%SPEECH_ON%你的报酬是——嗝——%reward_completion%克朗，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你正想给数目稍作改动，门外一个卫兵探头看着这场谈话，冲你摇了摇头。好吧，看来还是%reward_completion%克朗。 | 你回到%employer%那里时，一个女人正弯腰伏在他腿上，他的一只手举在半空。两人盯着你，僵了片刻，随后她赶紧钻到桌底，他则坐直了身子。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！见到你真高兴！想必你已经成功消灭那些绿皮了，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%可怜的女人在桌下撞了头，你尽量装作没听见，向他禀报此行告捷。他拍了拍手，似乎想起身，又打消了念头。%SPEECH_ON%劳烦你自己拿一下，报酬是%reward_completion%克朗，就在我身后的书架上。%SPEECH_OFF%你去取钱时，他尴尬地笑着。}

f43b9d32597c19da9ab5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{%employer% huffs and puffs.%SPEECH_ON%Goddammit.%SPEECH_OFF%He goes to his window, looking out it.%SPEECH_ON%I had a jousting tournament recently and there was a bit of a controversy. Now, none of my knights will fight for me until it's taken care of.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if you want sellswords to settle a dispute amongst nobility. The man bursts into laughter.%SPEECH_ON%Gods no, lowborn. I need you to handle some greenskins that are camping %direction% of %origin%. They've been terrorizing the region for awhile now and I'd like you to return the favor. Does that sound like something you're interested in, or should I have to go talk to another sword for hire?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% kicks his feet up on his table.%SPEECH_ON%Any opinions on greenskins, sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head no. The man tilts his head.%SPEECH_ON%Interesting. Most say they're afraid, or that they're nasty brutes who can cleave a man in two. But you... you're different. I like it. What say you go %direction% of %origin% to a place the locals have dubbed %location%? We've sighted a large band of orcs there that need scattering.%SPEECH_OFF% | A cat is on %employer%'s table. He pets it, the feline scrunching up to the scratch, but then it suddenly hisses, bites the man, and sprints out the door you just came through. %employer% dusts himself off.%SPEECH_ON%Farkin' animals. One moment they love you, the next, well...%SPEECH_OFF%He sucks on a drop of blood coming from his thumb. You ask if you should come back so he can nurse himself back to health.%SPEECH_ON%Very funny, sellsword. No, what I want you to do is go %direction% of %origin% and take on a group of greenskins inhabiting those parts. We need them destroyed, scattered, whatever word you like so long as they're 'gone'. Does that sound like something you could do for us?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s rolling up a scroll as he explains his predicament.%SPEECH_ON%A dispute amongst the nobility has me short on good, fighting men. Unfortunately, a band of greenskins have chosen this exact moment to come into these parts. They're camping to the %direction% of %origin%. I can't get the house in order while simultaneously being raided by these damned things, so I'm mighty hopeful that this interests you, mercenary...%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% looks you up and down.%SPEECH_ON%You fit enough to take on a greenskin? What about your men?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and pretend the hassle would be no more than retrieving a cat from a tree. %employer% smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Good, because I got a whole bunch of them being sighted to the %direction% of %origin%. Go there and destroy them. Simple enough, right? Surely it interests a man of your... confidence.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% tends to his dogs, feeding each one a meal some peasants would kill for. He claps his hands of the meaty grease.%SPEECH_ON%My chef made that, can you believe it? Horrid. Disgusting.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod as though you could possibly understand what world this man lives in where shoveling good food to dogs is normal. %employer% pitches his elbows onto his table.%SPEECH_ON%Anyway, the folks who deliver meat to us are reporting that greenskins are killing their cows. Apparently, a camp has been sighted %direction% of %origin%. If you're interested, I'd like you to go there and destroy them all.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% staring over some scrolls. He glances up at you and offers a chair.%SPEECH_ON%Glad you're here, mercenary. I've got an issue with greenskins in these parts - they've made camp %direction% from here.%SPEECH_OFF%He lowers one of the scrolls.%SPEECH_ON%And I can't afford to send my own men. Knights are rather... unexpendable. You, however, are just right for the job. What do you say?%SPEECH_OFF% | As you enter %employer%'s office, a group of men leave. They're knights, their scabbards clinking just beneath their garbs. %employer% welcomes you in.%SPEECH_ON%Don't worry about them. They're just wondering what happened to the last man I hired.%SPEECH_OFF%You raise an eyebrow. The man waves it off.%SPEECH_ON%Oh don't give me that shit, sellsword. You know the business as well as I do, sometimes you guys fall short and you know that means...%SPEECH_OFF%You say nothing, but after a pause, give him a nod.%SPEECH_ON%Good, glad you understand. If you want to know, I've got greenskins out %direction% of %origin%. They've set up camp which I presume hasn't moved since I last, uh, sent some men there. Are you interested in rooting them out for me?%SPEECH_OFF%}
f43b9d32597c19da9ab5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{%employer%气得直喘粗气。%SPEECH_ON%真他妈该死。%SPEECH_OFF%他走到窗边，望向外头。%SPEECH_ON%我最近办了一场骑枪比武，闹出了点争端。现在，这事不解决，我手下的骑士就谁也不肯为我作战。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他，是不是想让佣兵调解贵族之间的纠纷。他大笑起来。%SPEECH_ON%诸神啊，当然不是，平民。我要你去对付那些在%origin%的%direction%边扎营的绿皮。它们已经祸害这片地方好一阵了，我希望你也让它们尝尝滋味。你有兴趣吗，还是要我去找别的佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%把双脚翘上桌面。%SPEECH_ON%说到绿皮，你有什么看法，佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头，表示没有。他歪了歪脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%有意思。大多数人会说害怕，或者说那是一群能把人劈成两半的凶残畜生。可你……你不一样。我喜欢。去%origin%的%direction%边怎么样？当地人把那地方叫作%location%。我们在那里发现了一大群兽人，需要有人去打散它们。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的桌上趴着一只猫。他抚摸着它，猫顺着他的抓挠蜷起身子，却突然嘶叫一声，咬了他一口，从你刚走进来的门窜了出去。%employer%掸了掸身上的毛。%SPEECH_ON%该死的畜生。刚才还亲热，转眼就……唉。%SPEECH_OFF%他吮掉拇指上渗出的一滴血。你问他要不要改日再来，好让他先把身子养好。%SPEECH_ON%真会逗乐，佣兵。不必了，我要你去%origin%的%direction%边，对付盘踞在那里的绿皮。消灭也好，打散也罢，随你怎么说，只要让它们消失。这样的差事，你能替我们办吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%一边卷起文书，一边解释自己的困境。%SPEECH_ON%贵族之间起了纠纷，弄得我手下缺少能战的好手。偏偏就在这个节骨眼上，一群绿皮跑到了这附近，在%origin%的%direction%边扎下营来。被这些该死的东西连番劫掠，我怎么整顿家族事务？所以，佣兵，我很希望你对这件差事有兴趣……%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%上下打量着你。%SPEECH_ON%你的本事，够对付一只绿皮吗？你手下的人呢？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，装得仿佛这活跟上树抱只猫一样轻松。%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%很好，因为有人在%origin%的%direction%边发现了一大群。去那里，消灭它们。很简单，对吧？像你这样……有自信的人，一定会感兴趣。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正忙着喂狗，给每条狗吃的饭菜，都好得足以让某些农民为之杀人。他拍了拍沾着肉油的手。%SPEECH_ON%你敢信吗，这是我的厨子做的。难吃。恶心。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，装得仿佛能够理解：在这个人的世界里，把好端端的饭菜铲给狗吃，原来是件天经地义的事。%employer%把双肘支上桌面。%SPEECH_ON%总之，给我们送肉的人说，绿皮正在杀他们的牛。似乎有人在%origin%的%direction%边发现了一座营地。你若有兴趣，我想请你去那里，把它们统统消灭。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正盯着几份卷轴。他抬头看你，示意你坐下。%SPEECH_ON%你来得正好，佣兵。我被附近的绿皮弄得很头疼，它们在这里的%direction%边扎了营。%SPEECH_OFF%他放下一份卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%我又不能派自己的人去冒险。骑士嘛，实在……损失不起。不过，你倒正适合这活。怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的书房时，一群人正往外走。他们都是骑士，衣袍下的剑鞘碰得叮当作响。%employer%招呼你进来。%SPEECH_ON%别管他们。他们只是想知道，我上次雇的那个人后来怎么样了。%SPEECH_OFF%你挑起一边眉毛。他不以为意地摆摆手。%SPEECH_ON%少来这套，佣兵。这行当你跟我一样清楚。有时候，你们办不成事，你也知道那意味着什么……%SPEECH_OFF%你没说话，停了一会儿，才点点头。%SPEECH_ON%很好，你明白就好。说正事，%origin%的%direction%边有群绿皮，扎了一座营地。从我上次，呃，派人过去以后，我想它们应该还没搬过地方。你有兴趣替我把它们连窝端掉吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

e0dd4edf4653d6c12261.source: {Fighting orcs won't come cheap. | I trust you'll pay amply for this. | Let's talk money.}
e0dd4edf4653d6c12261.translation: {对付兽人，价钱可不会便宜。 | 想必你会付足报酬。 | 谈谈报酬吧。}

da74cfdfdd425c60721c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_49.png[/img]{As you order your men to attack, they come across a number of orcs... fighting each other? The greenskins appear to be divided, and they are settling their differences by dividing one another in half. It's a gruesome display of violence. When you figure to let them fight it out, two of the orcs battle their way toward you, and soon enough every orc is staring at you. Well, no running now... to arms! | You order the %companyname% to attack, believing you've gained the upperhand on the orcs. But they're already armed! And... fighting one another?

 One orc cleaves another orc in twine, and another crushes the head of another. This seems to be some sort of clan conflict. A shame you didn't wait a moment longer for these brutes to settle their differences, now it's a free for all! | The orcs are battling one another! It's some sort of greenskinned fracas which you've made yourself a part of. Orc against orc against man, what a sight to behold! Get the men close together and you might just make it out of this goatfark alive. | By the gods, the orcs are greater numbers than you ever could have thought! Luckily, they seem to be murdering one another. You don't know if they're separate clans or if this is just greenskins' version of a drunken brawl. Regardless, you're in the middle of it now!}
da74cfdfdd425c60721c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_49.png[/img]{你命令弟兄们进攻，却撞见一群兽人正在……自相残杀？这些绿皮似乎起了分歧，解决的办法就是把对方劈成两半。眼前的暴行令人胆寒。你正想着让它们先打个够，两只兽人却一路厮打到了你面前，转眼间，所有兽人都盯住了你。好吧，现在跑也来不及了……拿起武器！ | 你以为已经抢占先机，命令%companyname%发动进攻。可兽人早就拿好了武器！而且……正在互相厮杀？

 一只兽人将另一只劈成两半，旁边又有一只砸碎了对手的脑袋。看来是部族之间起了冲突。可惜你没再多等一会儿，让这些蛮物先解决彼此的分歧，现在谁都卷进混战了！ | 兽人正在自相残杀！这是一场绿皮之间的火并，而你们也一头闯了进来。兽人打兽人，又来打人，真是好一场热闹！让弟兄们靠紧些，或许还能从这场该死的混战里活着出去。 | 诸神在上，兽人的数量远远超出你的预料！幸好，它们似乎正在互相残杀。你不知道这是不同部族之间的冲突，还是绿皮喝醉了打群架的方式。无论如何，你们已经被卷进去了！}

963a374a008934b8ee84.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{As you finish the last orc you are suddenly greeted by a heavily armed group of men. Their lieutenant steps forward, his thumbs hooked into a belt holding up a sword.%SPEECH_ON%Well, well, you really are stupid. %employer% does not forget easily - and he hasn't forgotten the last time you betrayed %faction%. Consider this a little... return of the favor.%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly, all the men behind the lieutenant charge forth. Arm yourselves, this was an ambush! | Cleaning orc blood off your sword, you suddenly spot a group of men walking toward you. They're carrying %faction%'s banner and are drawing their weapons. The realization that you've been setup dawns on you just as the men begin to charge. They let you fight the orcs first, the bastards! Let them have it! | A man seemingly from nowhere comes to greet you. He's well armed, well armored, and apparently quite happy, grinning sheepishly as he approaches.%SPEECH_ON%Evening, mercenaries. Good work on those greenskins, eh?%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses to let his smile fade.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% sends his regards.%SPEECH_OFF%Just then, a group of men swarm out from the sides of the road. It's an ambush! That damned nobleman has betrayed you! | The battle is barely over that a group of armed men wearing the colors of %faction% fall in behind you, the group fanning out to stare at your company. Their leader sizes you up.%SPEECH_ON%I'm going to enjoy prying that sword from your cold grip.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and ask why you've been setup.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% doesn't forget those who doublecross him or his house. That's about all you need to know. Not like anything I say here will do you good when you're dead.%SPEECH_OFF%To arms, then, for this is an ambush! | Your men scour the orc camp and find not a soul. Suddenly, a few strangers appear behind you, the lieutenant of the group walking forward with ill intent. He's got a cloth embroidered with %employer%'s sigil.%SPEECH_ON%A shame those orcs couldn't finish you off. If you're wondering why I'm here, it is to pay a debt owed to %faction%. You promised a task well done. You could not own up to that promise. Now you die.%SPEECH_OFF%You unsheathe your sword and flash its blade at the lieutenant.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like %faction% is about to have another promise broken.%SPEECH_OFF%}
963a374a008934b8ee84.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{你刚解决最后一只兽人，一群全副武装的人便突然出现在面前。他们的副官上前一步，双手拇指钩着悬挂佩剑的腰带。%SPEECH_ON%啧啧，你还真是蠢。%employer%记性好着呢，上次你背叛%faction%的事，他可没忘。就当这是一点……回礼吧。%SPEECH_OFF%副官身后的众人突然冲了上来。拿起武器，这是一场伏击！ | 你正擦拭剑上的兽人血，突然看见一群人走来。他们打着%faction%的旗号，纷纷拔出武器。等到他们开始冲锋，你才恍然明白，自己中计了。这帮混蛋，居然先让你跟兽人拼了一场！给他们点颜色看看！ | 一个男人不知从哪儿冒出来，走上前跟你打招呼。他兵甲齐全，心情似乎也不错，走近时还带着几分扭捏的笑。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，佣兵们。那些绿皮，收拾得不错啊？%SPEECH_OFF%他顿了顿，收起笑容。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%托我向你们问好。%SPEECH_OFF%就在这时，一群人从道路两侧蜂拥而出。是伏击！那个该死的贵族出卖了你！ | 战斗才刚结束，一队身穿%faction%军服的武装士兵就出现在你们身后。他们散开队形，盯着战团。头领上下打量着你。%SPEECH_ON%等你的尸体凉透了，我要亲手掰开你的手指，拿走那把剑。想想就痛快。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，问他为什么设下这个圈套。%SPEECH_ON%谁敢背叛%employer%或他的家族，他都不会忘。你知道这些就够了。反正人都要死了，我再多说什么，对你也没用。%SPEECH_OFF%那就拔剑吧，这是一场伏击！ | 弟兄们搜遍兽人营地，没找到半个活物。突然，几个陌生人出现在你们身后，带队的副官来势不善地走上前。他拿着一块绣有%employer%徽记的布。%SPEECH_ON%可惜，那些兽人没能收拾掉你。要问我为什么来，是替%faction%讨债的。你答应把差事办妥，却没兑现承诺。现在，拿命来还吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你拔出剑，将明晃晃的剑刃对着副官。%SPEECH_ON%看来，又有人要对%faction%食言了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

9799229c31fe8f5969b4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_32.png[/img]{The battle over, you search the orc camp. Amongst the ruins, you find what appears to be heavy armor and human weapons in a very unusable state. Sadly, you do not find those they perhaps once belonged to. | With the orcs slain, you take a look around their camp. It's full of shite. Literally, shite is everywhere. The damned things don't know a thing about cleanliness. %randombrother% waddles up, wiping his boot on a tentpost.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, shall we move on or keep looking...?%SPEECH_OFF%You've seen, and smelled, enough. | The orc camp is a wasteland filled with all manner of depravity. You can smell their sex and waste. It's no wonder they're so warlike, for they know not even the beginnings of what a civilized man understands. | The orc camp is destroyed, but you take a moment to sift through the ruins. Amidst the ashen pit of a campfire you find a few human corpses. Judging by their arms, they seem to have been mercenaries like yourself. A shame... that none of their gear is useful now that it's all burned up. | A few of your mercenaries walk through the ruins of the orc camp. They pick about the remains, turning up this or that unusable trinket. %randombrother% sheathes his bloody sword.%SPEECH_ON%Naught all here, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and get the men ready to return to %employer%. | The battle over, you trundle about the camp, looking for anything useful. You find nothing you can take, but you do find a stack of dead knights. Their pale, wormed and maggot-buggered faces suggest they'd been there awhile. Who knows what the orcs were doing with them.}
9799229c31fe8f5969b4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_32.png[/img]{战斗结束，你搜索兽人营地。在废墟中，你找到一些似乎是重甲和人类武器的东西，可惜已经破损得完全没法用了。至于它们原先可能的主人，你遗憾地一无所获。 | 兽人已死，你环顾它们的营地。这里简直就是个粪坑——不是比喻，到处都是屎。这些该死的东西压根不懂什么叫干净。%randombrother%蹒跚着走来，把靴子往帐篷立柱上蹭。%SPEECH_ON%团长，咱们走，还是再找找……？%SPEECH_OFF%你已经看够了，也闻够了。 | 兽人营地一片狼藉，充斥着种种不堪入目的污秽。交配的腥臊和排泄物的恶臭扑鼻而来。难怪它们如此好战，文明人懂的那些道理，它们连最起码的一点都不明白。 | 兽人营地已被摧毁，你还是花了些工夫翻检废墟。在一处满是灰烬的火坑里，你发现了几具人类尸体。从兵器看来，他们似乎也曾是佣兵。可惜啊……装备全烧坏了，一件能用的都没有。 | 几个佣兵走过兽人营地的废墟，翻翻找找，搜出来的不是这件废物，就是那件破烂。%randombrother%将染血的剑插回鞘里。%SPEECH_ON%什么都没有，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，让弟兄们准备回去见%employer%。 | 战斗结束，你在营地里慢慢转悠，想找点有用的东西。能带走的物件没找到，倒是发现了一堆骑士尸体。他们惨白的脸已经被虫蛆钻得千疮百孔，看来搁在这里有一阵子了。谁知道兽人拿他们做了些什么。}

d471455c7ba6c02d4a20.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_32.png[/img]{The battle's over, but you still hear screaming. You tell %randombrother% to shut it, as he is somewhat predisposed to the random growl or yelp, but he shakes his head and says it's not him. Just then, a shackled man rises up out of a pile of ashes that used to be the orc camp.%SPEECH_ON%Evening, fine sirs! I do believe you have freed me.%SPEECH_OFF%He stumbles forth, a ghostly, twisting cloud of ash spinning off behind him.%SPEECH_ON%I am quite grateful, obviously, and I'd like to repay the favor. You're mercenaries, correct? If so, I'd like to fight for you.%SPEECH_OFF%He picks a blade up off the ground and twirls it around in hand, weaving it as though it had been his since birth. An interesting offer that just got more interesting... | Cleaning your blade, a voice pipes in from a collapsed orcish tent.%SPEECH_ON%Good sirs, you've done it!%SPEECH_OFF%You watch as a grinning man emerges.%SPEECH_ON%You've freed me! And I'd like to repay that service you've done by offering my hand!%SPEECH_OFF%He holds his hand out, pauses, then takes it back.%SPEECH_ON%I mean to fight for you! I'd like to fight for you, sir! If you can do all this, then surely I'd be in good company, right?%SPEECH_OFF%Hmm, an interesting offer. You toss him a weapon and he catches with ease. He twists the handle about, twirling it hand-over-hand before trying to sheathe it into an invisible scabbard.%SPEECH_ON%The name's %dude_name%.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man in tattered and dented armor comes sprinting toward you. His arms are tied behind his back.%SPEECH_ON%You did it! I can't believe it! Sorry, let me explain my immodesty. I was captured by the orcs a day ago as we tried to take the camp. I think they were about to put me on a spit when you showed up. I took the first moment I could to make my escape, but now I see you and your group might be worth joining.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask the man to get to the point. He does.%SPEECH_ON%I'd like to fight for you, sir. I've got experience - been with the lord's army, a mercenary, and... well, other things.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d471455c7ba6c02d4a20.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_32.png[/img]{战斗已经结束，你却还听见有人喊叫。%randombrother%一向爱莫名其妙地吼两嗓子，你便叫他闭嘴，可他摇头说不是自己。这时，一个戴着镣铐的人从灰堆里爬了出来，那地方原先还是兽人的营地。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，好心的老爷们！看来，是各位救了我。%SPEECH_OFF%他踉跄着走上前，身后扬起一团扭卷的灰雾，像幽魂一般。%SPEECH_ON%我当然感激不尽，也想报答这份恩情。你们是佣兵，对吧？那我愿意替你们作战。%SPEECH_OFF%他从地上拾起一把利刃，在手中旋转挥舞，娴熟得仿佛打娘胎里就握着这把武器。这个提议本就值得考虑，现在就更值得了…… | 你正擦拭剑刃，一顶坍塌的兽人帐篷里传来喊声。%SPEECH_ON%好心的老爷们，你们成功了！%SPEECH_OFF%你看见一个满面笑容的人从里面钻出来。%SPEECH_ON%你们救了我！为报答这份恩情，我愿献上这只手！%SPEECH_OFF%他伸出手，顿了顿，又缩回去。%SPEECH_ON%我是说，为你们打仗！我愿为您作战，老爷！能干出这么一番大事，跟着你们准没错，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%嗯，这个提议有意思。你扔给他一把武器，他轻松接住，转动握柄，让武器在双手间翻飞，最后还试图收进腰间那副并不存在的鞘里。%SPEECH_ON%我叫%dude_name%。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个男人朝你奔来，身上的铠甲破损凹陷，双臂反绑在背后。%SPEECH_ON%你们竟然办到了！真不敢相信！抱歉，我太冒失了，让我解释一下。昨天，我们试图攻下这座营地，结果我被兽人俘虏了。你们出现时，我觉得它们正准备把我串到烤架上。我一找到机会就逃了出来，不过现在看来，你和你的弟兄们倒是值得追随。%SPEECH_OFF%你让他直说来意。他便开了口。%SPEECH_ON%我愿为您作战，老爷。我有经验，当过领主的兵，也当过佣兵，还有……嗯，别的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

ca14841346f07b7d3dcf.source: You'll have to find your luck elsewhere.
ca14841346f07b7d3dcf.translation: 你得去别处碰碰运气了。

b18c1c625d8cd688e2ef.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You return to %employer% and report your doings. He waves you off.%SPEECH_ON%Oh please, sellsword. I already know. You don't think I have spies in these parts?%SPEECH_OFF%He gestures toward a satchel on the corner of his table. You take it and the man flicks his wrist.%SPEECH_ON%That should be thanks enough, now please leave my sight.%SPEECH_OFF% | You show %employer% a head of an orc. He stares at it, then at you.%SPEECH_ON%Interesting. So should I take it that you've completed what I've asked of you?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The man smiles and hands over a wooden chest with %reward% crowns inside.%SPEECH_ON%I knew I could trust you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% stares at you as you return.%SPEECH_ON%I've heard of what you've done.%SPEECH_OFF%It's a strange tone in his voice, a tone that has you quickly reviewing everything you've done in the past week. Was that a noble woman at the... no, couldn't be.%SPEECH_ON%The orcs are dead. Good work, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%He slides you a satchel of %reward% crowns and a wave of relief also washes over you. | You enter %employer%'s room and take a seat, pouring yourself a cup of wine. The nobleman stares a hole through you.%SPEECH_ON%I dare say that's a drawing-and-quartering offense, a hanging one if I'm feeling kind, a burning one if I ain't.%SPEECH_OFF%You finish the drink and then slam an orc head on the man's table. The cup totters and rolls around on its side. %employer% reels back, then calms himself.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, yes, a drink well earned. That wasn't my best wine, anyway. %randomname%, my guard, is waiting for you outside. He'll have the %reward% crowns we agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF% | You lift an orc head to show %employer%. The green maw falls open, its tongue lolling between the teeth one might mistake for tusks. %employer% nods and flicks his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Please, have some mercy for my dreams and take it away.%SPEECH_OFF%You do as told. The man shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%How am I to get any sleep these days with things like that being lugged around? Anyhow, you have %reward% crowns already waiting for you outside with one of my guards. Thanks for your work, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come to %employer%'s room to find him looking at a drawing on a scroll. He stares at you, the lip of the paper folding backward.%SPEECH_ON%My daughter thinks herself an artist, can you believe that?%SPEECH_OFF%He shows you the scroll. It's a pretty well done drawing of a man who looks suspiciously like %employer%. The drawn figure is facing a hangman. %employer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Dumb girl.%SPEECH_OFF%He crumples the scrolls and tosses it aside.%SPEECH_ON%Anyway, my spies have already told me of your successes. Here is your payment as we agreed.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b18c1c625d8cd688e2ef.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你回到%employer%那里，向他禀报经过。他摆了摆手。%SPEECH_ON%行了，佣兵。我早知道了。你该不会以为我在这附近没有密探吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他指了指桌角的钱袋。你拿起钱袋，他便甩了甩手腕。%SPEECH_ON%这份谢礼该够了。现在，请从我眼前消失。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你给%employer%看了一颗兽人的脑袋。他盯着脑袋，又看看你。%SPEECH_ON%有意思。那么，我可以认为你已经办妥了我交代的事？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。他笑了笑，递来一个装着%reward%克朗的木箱。%SPEECH_ON%我就知道信得过你，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%盯着你。%SPEECH_ON%你干的事，我已经听说了。%SPEECH_OFF%他的语气有些古怪，让你立刻把过去一周做过的事在脑子里过了一遍。那天在……遇到的女人，该不会是个贵妇吧？不，不可能。%SPEECH_ON%兽人都死了。干得好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他把装着%reward%克朗的钱袋推过来，你也跟着松了口气。 | 你走进%employer%的房间，径自坐下，给自己倒了杯酒。贵族死死瞪着你，像要把你盯出个窟窿。%SPEECH_ON%要我说，这可是该拖出去分尸的罪。心情好，便宜你个绞刑；心情不好，就烧死你。%SPEECH_OFF%你喝完酒，将一颗兽人脑袋重重砸在他桌上。酒杯晃了晃，侧倒下去，滚到一边。%employer%惊得往后一缩，随后稳住了神。%SPEECH_ON%啊，对，你当然配得上这杯酒。反正也不是我最好的酒。我的卫兵%randomname%在外面等你，约定的%reward%克朗就在他手里。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你提起一颗兽人脑袋给%employer%看。绿色的大嘴张开，舌头耷拉在两排几乎能叫作獠牙的牙齿之间。%employer%点点头，连连摆手。%SPEECH_ON%拜托，可怜可怜我晚上的梦，把它拿走吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你照办了。他摇着头。%SPEECH_ON%成天有人拎着这种东西到处走，我还怎么睡得着？总之，%reward%克朗已经备好了，就在外头一名卫兵手里。多谢你了，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你来到%employer%的房间，见他正看着纸卷上的一幅画。他抬头望着你，纸边朝后卷曲。%SPEECH_ON%我女儿还真把自己当画家了，你敢信吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他把画给你看。画得相当不错，画中那个男人跟%employer%像得令人起疑，而且正面对着一个刽子手。%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%傻丫头。%SPEECH_OFF%他把纸卷揉成一团，扔到旁边。%SPEECH_ON%总之，密探已经告诉我你成功了。这是我们说好的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%}

58ced39ea5d8c35b8f07.source: Find %location% %distance% to the %direction% and somewhere around the region of %region%
58ced39ea5d8c35b8f07.translation: 寻找%location%；目标位于%direction%方向，距离%distance%，在%region%地区一带

4d3a30850c0c78123a0b.source: Find %location% to the %direction% and around the region of %region%
4d3a30850c0c78123a0b.translation: 寻找%location%；目标位于%direction%方向，在%region%地区一带

02836b801180c64f4482.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer% is looking at a poorly drawn map, then looks up at you as though you're the one responsible for making it.%SPEECH_ON%Look, mercenary, this is a strange thing to task you with, but you seem to have a good head on your shoulders. See this dark spot here? Would you be willing to venture that way and try and find the %location%? It's somewhere at or around the region of %region%.%SPEECH_OFF% | You step into %employer%'s room and he shoves a map into your face.%SPEECH_ON%{Sellsword! Time for you to go exploring! See this uncharted spot, %direction% of here in the region of %region%? That's where I need you to go in search of the %location%. Do you accept or not? | Alright, this might seem strange, but I need a place by the name of the %location% located and charted. Our maps are incomplete in regards to this spot which, at the very least, I believe is at or near the region of %region% %direction% of here. Go, find it, and come back with the coordinates and you will be properly rewarded. | There are parts of this world man still has yet to find and chart into his maps. I'm looking for %location% %direction% of here at or near the region of %region%. That's about all I know of it, but I do know it exists. So you go and find it for me and you'll be properly rewarded. | I need a place found, sellsword. It lies %direction% of here at or near to the region of %region%. The laymen call it %location%, but whatever it is, I need to know WHERE it is, understand? Find it and you will be paid handsomely. | I'm in need of a soldier and explorer, sellsword, and I think you're just the man to be both in one. Now, before you accuse me of being cheap by not hiring both vocations, let's just say I have plenty of crowns for you to earn in doing this for me. What is it, hm? Well, I know of a place by the name of %location%, but I know not where it is other than it resides %direction% of here in the strip of land called %region%. Find it, draw its place on the map, and you'll get the pay of both a soldier and an explorer!}%SPEECH_OFF%}
02836b801180c64f4482.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%正盯着一幅画得很糟的地图，抬头看你的神情，倒像这地图就是你画坏的。%SPEECH_ON%听着，佣兵，这件差事有点古怪，不过我看你脑子挺清楚。看到这里这片阴影了吗？愿不愿意往那边走一趟，替我找找%location%？应该就在%region%一带，或附近。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你刚走进%employer%的房间，他就把一张地图推到了你眼前。%SPEECH_ON%{佣兵！该去探路了！看见这里这片没画出来的地方没有？就在这里的%direction%，%region%一带。我要你去那里寻找%location%。你接不接？ | 好吧，这听起来可能有些古怪，但我要你找到一个叫%location%的地方，并标在地图上。我们这一带的地图并不完整，不过至少我认为，它应该位于这里的%direction%，在%region%一带或附近。去找到它，带回准确的位置，自然少不了你的报酬。 | 世上还有许多地方，人们尚未找到，也不曾画进地图。我要找的是%location%，就在这里的%direction%，%region%一带或附近。我知道的就这么多，但我确定它确实存在。替我找到它，你会得到应有的酬劳。 | 我要找个地方，佣兵。就在这里的%direction%，%region%一带或附近。当地人管它叫%location%。它究竟是什么不重要，我要知道的是它究竟在哪儿，明白吗？找到它，我会重重酬谢。 | 我既需要战士，也需要探险者，佣兵，我觉得你一个人就能兼任。先别说我舍不得花钱雇两个人；只要替我办成这件事，就有大把克朗可赚。什么事？嗯，我知道有个地方叫%location%，却不知道具体在哪儿，只知道它在这里的%direction%，一片叫%region%的地方。找到它，标到地图上，你就能拿到战士和探险者两份报酬！}%SPEECH_OFF%}

0a284812a1d2c1edafd4.source: {What does it pay? | For the right price we'll find it.}
0a284812a1d2c1edafd4.translation: {这活儿给多少报酬？ | 价钱合适，我们就把它找出来。}

539be467f45771494b96.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{You sight %location% in the glass of your scope and mark it on your maps. Easy enough. Time to return to %employer%. | Well, it's already time to return to %employer% as %location% was easier to find than you figured. Marking it on your map, you pause and chuckle and shake your head. What luck. | %location% comes into view and it's immediately reborn upon your map to the best of your illustrative capabilities. %randombrother% asks if that's all there is to do. You nod. A rough go or an easy one, %employer% will be waiting to pay you all the same.}
539be467f45771494b96.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{你从望远镜里发现了%location%，随即在地图上做了标记。够简单的。该回去找%employer%了。 | 好了，已经可以回去找%employer%了。%location%比你想象中好找得多。你在地图上标好位置，停下来笑了笑，摇摇头。运气真不错。 | %location%映入眼帘，你立即尽自己最大的绘图本事，把它画到了地图上。%randombrother%问，这样就算办完了？你点点头。不管差事难还是容易，%employer%都得照约付钱。}

712c52661f95cb5fc3cc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]The %location% has been spotted - and so has the %companyname%. The supposed 'altruist' who had given you the directions is standing there, except now he has a band of hardy and unfriendly men with him.%SPEECH_ON%{Well, looks like you can follow directions after all. Setting an ambush is pretty easy when you tell the idiot where to meet ya. Anyway, kill them all! | Hey there, sellsword. Strange seeing you here. Oh wait, no it isn't. Kill them all! | Damn, took you long enough! What, you can't follow simple instructions on how to walk into your own graves? Foolish, sellsword, and annoyingly dumb. Well, let's get this over with. Kill them all.}%SPEECH_OFF%
712c52661f95cb5fc3cc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]你们发现了%location%，%companyname%也被人发现了。先前那个好心指路的所谓“善人”就站在那里，只是如今身边多了一伙结实凶悍、来者不善的汉子。%SPEECH_ON%{瞧，原来你们还认得路啊。告诉傻子在哪儿碰头，设伏就是这么简单。好了，全部杀光！ | 哟，佣兵。在这里碰见你，可真稀奇。哦，等等，其实一点也不稀奇。全部杀光！ | 该死，可算来了！怎么，连走进自己坟墓的路都得找这么久？蠢佣兵，蠢得让人心烦。行了，赶紧了结吧。全部杀光。}%SPEECH_OFF%

b4fd99efcb1c6dd2c7fb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{Waving his hand rather friendly-like, a man approaches. You respond by unsheathing your sword halfway. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%So many are interested in the %location%, so I can't fault you for being so defensive. Look, I'll tell you exactly where it's at. Just %distance% to the %direction% of here, %terrain%.%SPEECH_OFF%He heads off, cackling with laughter.%SPEECH_ON%I dunno if I've done good or ill, and that's just the sort of fun I like!%SPEECH_OFF% | A group of world-weary explorers! They seize up in the middle of the road, half covered in mud and half in leaves and all in unintentional camouflage. One rubs his forehead, eyeing you carefully before a smile widens.%SPEECH_ON%Eh, I know a searcher when I see one. You're looking for the %location%, aintcha? Well yer in luck, we was just coming from there! Here, give me your map and I'll show you just where it is. You see, %terrain% %distance% to the %direction% of where we are now.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b4fd99efcb1c6dd2c7fb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{一个人友好地挥着手，朝你走来。你的回应，是把剑拔出一半。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%对%location%感兴趣的人太多了，你这么戒备，我倒也理解。听着，我直接告诉你在哪儿：从这里往%direction%，走%distance%，就在%terrain%。%SPEECH_OFF%他一边往远处走，一边咯咯笑着。%SPEECH_ON%我也不知道自己是做了好事还是坏事，这才有趣，我就喜欢这样！%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群饱经风霜的探险者！他们在路中间停了下来，半身泥、半身叶，倒是无意间做好了伪装。一个人揉着额头，仔细打量你，随后咧嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，我一眼就认得出找路的人。你们在找%location%，对吧？运气不错，我们刚从那儿来！来，把地图给我，我指给你看。瞧，从咱们这里往%direction%，走%distance%，就在%terrain%。%SPEECH_OFF%}

cb12945b29bd1ebf9323.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{The stranger is a lone man who keeps his distance, one foot on the path, the other inching toward escape.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there.%SPEECH_OFF%He glances across your men, slowly smiling as though he can sense our being lost.%SPEECH_ON%Searching for the %location% are ya? Hmm, yeah. Well I'll tell you what, hand me %hint_bribe% crowns and I'll tell you exactly where it is! Come after me with yer swords and I'll be gone quicker than you can blink!%SPEECH_OFF% | You watch as the stranger comes into the light of the path, shielding his eyes so as to keep much of his face hidden.%SPEECH_ON%You look like the sort to be in search of something, but you know not where it be! The %location% is tricky like that. Good thing I know where it is. Good thing you, too, can know where it is by sliding %hint_bribe% crowns my way. I'm the fastest sprinter you ever did see, so don't try and wring it out of me with one of them shiny swords you got.%SPEECH_OFF%}
cb12945b29bd1ebf9323.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{陌生人孤身一人，远远站着，一只脚踩在路上，另一只脚却悄悄朝退路挪。%SPEECH_ON%喂，你们好。%SPEECH_OFF%他打量你的弟兄们，脸上慢慢浮起笑容，仿佛看出了你们正在迷路。%SPEECH_ON%在找%location%，对吧？嗯，是这么回事。这样，给我%hint_bribe%克朗，我就告诉你们确切的位置！可别拿剑追我，你们眼睛一眨，我就没影了！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你看着陌生人走到道路的亮处。他抬手遮住眼睛，也挡住了大半张脸。%SPEECH_ON%看你们这模样，是想找东西，却不知道在哪儿吧！%location%就是这么难找。好在我知道它在哪儿。更好的是，只要给我%hint_bribe%克朗，你们也能知道。我跑得比你们见过的任何人都快，别想拿那些亮闪闪的剑逼我开口。%SPEECH_OFF%}

13fcf4cb875540d1db41.source: Fine, here's the crowns. Now speak.

6642622682354f56b375.source: No need, we'll find it on our own.

2b91778905480d4c8909.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]You accept the man's offer and he dishes out the details as promised.%SPEECH_ON%You see, it's there, of course, %terrain% %distance% to the %direction% of where we are now. Easy.%SPEECH_OFF%He whistles as he walks off, no doubt a very easy payday for him.
2b91778905480d4c8909.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]你接受那人的开价，他也依约说出了详情。%SPEECH_ON%你看，当然就在那儿，离咱们这里%distance%，%direction%的%terrain%。简单得很。%SPEECH_OFF%他吹着口哨离开了。对他来说，这钱无疑挣得轻松。

6e44feb92c95cfe51b11.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{As you and the %companyname% prepare their journey, %randombrother% states that there is a man who wishes to speak to you directly. You nod and have him led to you. He's a glum, small man who states that the 'rulers' of %townname% have no interest in the %location% other than ones of greed. Of course that's the case, so what's the problem? The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%Look, I've some folks who are interested in keeping the %location% hidden away for good. If you find it, well, talk to me first. We'll make you a pretty penny.%SPEECH_OFF% | While the %companyname% readies its trip to find the %location%, a man sidles up next to you. He hands you a note and departs without saying a word. The scroll reads: LEAVE THE %locationC% WHERE IT BE. IF YOU FIND IT, TALK TO US. OUR CROWNS FOR YOUR SILENCE. THE RULERS OF %townnameC% NEED NOT KNOW NOTHIN'! | A man approaches the company. Behind him you spy a couple of poor families staring on. You're not sure if he's their ambassador or not, but either way he comes right for you with a proposition spoken low and quiet.%SPEECH_ON%Listen here, sellsword. If you go out and find the %location%, come to us first. The rulers of %townname% need not bring their greed and lust for power to that place. Leave it to us, alright? We'll pay you well.%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can say a word, he straightens up and continues on. When you look back down the road those families are no longer around.}
6e44feb92c95cfe51b11.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你正与%companyname%准备出发，%randombrother%来报，说有人要亲自跟你谈谈。你点头，让他把人带来。来人身材矮小、神情沮丧，开口便说，%townname%的“统治者”惦记%location%，纯粹是出于贪婪。当然是这样，所以有什么问题？那人点点头。%SPEECH_ON%听着，我和一些人希望%location%永远不被发现。要是你找到了……先来找我谈谈。我们会给你一笔好钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | %companyname%正准备出发寻找%location%，一个人悄悄凑到你身边，递给你一张纸条，一句话不说便走了。纸条上写着：别动%locationC%。若你找到了，就来找我们。我们给钱，你们闭嘴。%townnameC%的统治者不必知道任何事！ | 一个人走近战团。你瞥见他身后有几户穷苦人家，正朝这里张望。不知道他是不是这些人的代表，总之，他径直来到你面前，压低声音提出一个建议。%SPEECH_ON%听好了，佣兵。要是你出去找到了%location%，先来找我们。别让%townname%的统治者把他们的贪欲和权欲带到那里。把那地方留给我们，好吗？我们会好好付钱。%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及开口，他就直起身，继续赶路。你再望向路那头时，那几户人家也不见了。}

592eb018e28e731c028d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{As you head toward %townname%, a stranger comes out to the path. He's the man you talked to before, but this time he has a satchel in hand.%SPEECH_ON%{You've no reason to tell the rulers of this town where the %location% is. Leave its secrets to us, you've no idea what heirlooms and history we have there. For your silence, we're willing to give you this as payment, %bribe% crowns. Please, sir, accept. | Look, sellsword, I know you speak one language and that is the language of money. Take this satchel as a token of our appreciation - if you stay silent. You needn't tell the rulers of %townname% where the %location% is. That place belongs to our families. Those petty rulers will only ruin it with their greed and power-seeking. So, what say you, will you take this? There are %bribe% crowns in there. All you gotta do is take it and not talk.}%SPEECH_OFF% | Entering %townname%, you're headed off by a familiar face: the man who had greeted you just before you had departed in the first place. But this time he has a satchel with him.%SPEECH_ON%{%bribe% crowns for your silence. Tell the rulers of this town absolutely nothing and it's yours. They need not know about our deal, they just need not know where this place is. It's important to us, with history beyond measure, and all they'll do is raid and pillage it. Please, accept. | Take this, it's %bribe% crowns. That's how much we're prepared to give you for your silence. The rulers of %townname% will take your information and use it to pillage the %location%, because they know of our own familial relations to it and, well, we've long since fallen out of favor around here. We've little left so, please, let us keep our heirlooms and old home.}%SPEECH_OFF%}
592eb018e28e731c028d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你朝%townname%走去，一个人来到路上。正是先前跟你谈过话的那人，只是这回手里多了一只钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%{你没有必要告诉镇上的统治者，%location%到底在哪儿。把那里的秘密留给我们吧，你不知道那里有多少我们的传家之物和往日历史。只要你保密，我们愿意付出这些，%bribe%克朗。求你了，先生，收下吧。 | 听着，佣兵，我知道你只听得懂一种话，那就是钱的话。只要你闭口不言，这袋钱就是我们的谢礼。你不必告诉%townname%的统治者，%location%到底在哪里。那地方属于我们的家族。那些卑劣的掌权者，只会为了财富与权力毁掉它。怎么样，收不收？里面有%bribe%克朗。你只需要拿走钱，什么也别说。}%SPEECH_OFF% | 你刚走进%townname%，就被一张熟悉的面孔拦住：正是出发前曾来找过你的那人。这次，他带着一只钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%{%bribe%克朗，换你保持沉默。什么都别告诉镇上的统治者，钱就是你的。他们不必知道我们的交易，也不必知道那个地方在哪里。它对我们意义重大，承载着无可衡量的往昔，而他们只会去洗劫、掠夺。求你，答应吧。 | 收下吧，%bribe%克朗。只要你不说出去，这就是我们愿意付的钱。%townname%的统治者得到你的消息，就会去洗劫%location%，因为他们知道那地方与我们家族的关系。而我们……早已在这里失势了。我们所剩无几，所以求你，让我们保住祖传之物和旧日家园吧。}%SPEECH_OFF%}

760407b244206abe234c.source: I don't think so. Only our employer will learn where it is.
760407b244206abe234c.translation: 不行。我们只把位置告诉雇主。

82fc7c15abf408e5ead9.source: We have a deal. You and no one else will learn where it is.
82fc7c15abf408e5ead9.translation: 成交。除了你，不会有别人知道它的位置。

d0f15fcafa837f913a3d.source: Why get paid only once if we can get paid twice?
d0f15fcafa837f913a3d.translation: 既然能收两份钱，何必只拿一份？

d4450a8ccdd8251368a9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{After telling the man no, he falls to his knees and cries out, much to the amusement of the %companyname%. He wails on about how you've left the historic past of his family in the hands of lechers and usurers. You tell him that you don't care. | Telling the man that you've no interest in betraying your original employer sets him off. He tries to attack you, launching forward to glom onto you with angry hands. %randombrother% pushes him away and threatens to kill him with a blade. The man backs off. He sits beside the path, head between his knees, sobbing. One of the men gives him a handkerchief as they pass by. | You tell the man no. He begs. You tell him no again. He begs some more. You suddenly realize you've done with this with a woman or two. It really isn't a good look. You tell him as much, but the emotion of the moment is too much for him. He starts to wail, going on about how his family name will be ruined by the greedy bastards that run %townname%. You tell him that his supposed family name would be spared if, perhaps, he was the one running this town. This does not clear his tears.}
d4450a8ccdd8251368a9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你一口回绝，那人便跪倒在地，放声大哭，惹得%companyname%的弟兄们看足了笑话。他哭嚎着，指责你把他家族的往昔交到了色鬼和高利贷商手中。你告诉他，你不在乎。 | 你说自己无意背叛原来的雇主，他顿时暴怒，扑上来就想揪住你。%randombrother%将他推开，亮出刀刃，警告再上前就宰了他。那人退缩了，在路边坐下，把头埋进双膝间哭泣。一个弟兄经过时，递给他一块手帕。 | 你说不行，他苦苦哀求。你再次拒绝，他继续恳求。你忽然想起，自己也曾对一两个女人做过同样的蠢事，实在不好看。你照实告诉他，可他已经被情绪淹没，只顾放声痛哭，说掌管%townname%的贪婪混账会毁掉他的家族名声。你说，要是这镇子归他管，他那所谓的家族名声也许就能保住了。这话没能止住他的眼泪。}

16857a704e634253e1fc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{You agree to sell the man the details of your expedition. He's overly joyous about the whole affair, but %employer% is not. Apparently, a little child saw this exchange and reported your betrayal to the head of %townname%. Your reputation here has, no doubt, been a little hurt. | Well, on one hand you spared this man's supposed familial home from destruction at the hands of those who run %townname%. On the other, those who run %townname% quickly heard of what you'd done. You should have paid more mind to a small town's population to double as rumormills extraordinaire.}
16857a704e634253e1fc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你同意把这次探查的消息卖给那人。他喜出望外，%employer%却不高兴。原来一个小孩看见了这笔交易，将你的背叛告诉了%townname%的当权者。毫无疑问，你在这里的声誉受损了。 | 一方面，你保住了那人所谓的祖居，免遭%townname%的统治者破坏。另一方面，%townname%的统治者也很快听说了你干的事。你早该多留个心眼：小镇上的每一个居民，都堪称散播闲话的好手。}

c919eacfe2ddb91b2a13.source: Well, %employer% should have just payed us more.
c919eacfe2ddb91b2a13.translation: 唉，%employer%本该多付我们一点钱。

2c58aa526abcf8a2a2c0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]You tell the man that you'll keep the location of his familial home a secret. While he celebrates, you go and tell %employer% where the %location% is. Getting paid by both sides makes for a pretty sweet gig. Catching hate from both not so much, but what did they expect in dealing with a sellsword?
2c58aa526abcf8a2a2c0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]你答应那人，会替他保守祖居位置的秘密。他还在欢天喜地，你便转身把%location%的位置告诉了%employer%。两头收钱，这差事确实美得很；两头结仇，就没那么美了。不过，跟佣兵做生意，他们还指望什么呢？

625ee7ec06ed4f717e49.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes you back. You hand over your recently illustrated map and he pores over it, swatting the spotted mark with the back of his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Of course that's where it is!%SPEECH_OFF%He smirks and pays you what you're owed. | You come to %employer%'s room, a fresh map in hand. He takes it from you and looks it over.%SPEECH_ON%Well then. I'd mind to think this was a spot too easy, but an agreement is an agreement.%SPEECH_OFF%He hands you a satchel weighed with precisely what is owed. | You report to %employer%, telling him of %location%'s location. He nods and scribbles, copying the notes from your map. Curious, you ask how he knows you're not lying. The man sets down in a chair and leans back, clasping his hands over his belly.%SPEECH_ON%I invested in a tracker who kept close to your company. He made it here before you did and you've but confirmed what I already know. Hope you don't mind the measures taken.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you think it a wise move and take your pay and go.}
625ee7ec06ed4f717e49.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer%欢迎你归来。你交上刚绘好的地图，他仔细看了看，用手背拍着新标出的地方。%SPEECH_ON%果然就在这里！%SPEECH_OFF%他得意地一笑，付清了应给你的报酬。 | 你拿着新绘的地图，来到%employer%的房间。他接过去看了一遍。%SPEECH_ON%好吧。我本想说，这钱未免挣得太容易，可约定就是约定。%SPEECH_OFF%他递给你一只钱袋，分文不少，分文不多。 | 你向%employer%汇报，告诉他%location%的位置。他边点头，边从你的地图上抄录笔记。你好奇地问，他怎么知道你没有撒谎。那人坐进椅子，向后靠去，双手交叠在肚子上。%SPEECH_ON%我花钱雇了个追踪者，一直跟着你的战团。他比你先回来，你不过是证实了我已经知道的事。希望你别介意这点防备。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，觉得此举明智，随后拿钱离开。}

085cee2d1093d482896c.translation: 向竞争对手提供了情报

df41a0463c2ec6a7166b.source: {How many crowns are we talking about? | What is %townname% prepared to pay for their safety? | Let's talk money.}
df41a0463c2ec6a7166b.translation: {你打算出多少克朗？ | 为了自己的安全，%townname%愿意付多少？ | 谈谈报酬吧。}

9cfa2d0b646ed2450295.source: {Not interested. | We have more important matters to settle. | I wish you luck, but we'll not be part of this.}
9cfa2d0b646ed2450295.translation: {没兴趣。 | 我们还有更重要的事。 | 祝你好运，但我们不掺和。}

6db0e40c9947392ba180.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]{While spying on the brigand encampment, you notice the profile of a man you've heard the locals almost fervently describing: it is %robberbaron%, a famed robber baron that terrorizes these parts. He's got a retinue of brutish looking men following him everywhere he goes.

You wager his head is worth a few extra crowns. | You didn't plan to see him, but it's no doubt the man himself: %robberbaron% is at the brigands' encampment. The famed killer is apparently paying a visit to one of his criminal offshoots, studiously marching around the thieves, pointing his finger to this or that, remarking about the quality of that and this.

A few bodyguards follow him everywhere. You estimate that between him and the rest of the brigands, there's about %totalenemy% men mucking about. | The contract was just to wipe out the brigands, but it appears another, much heavier carrot has been added to the stick: %robberbaron%, the infamous killer and road raider, is at the camp. Followed by a bodyguard, the robber baron seems to be assessing one of his criminal outfits.

You wonder how much %robberbaron%'s head would weigh in crowns... | %robberbaron%. It's him, you know it. Eyeing through a spyglass, you can easily see the silhouette of the infamous robber baron as he moves about the brigands' encampment. He wasn't in your plans, nor mentioned in the contract, but there's little doubt that if you bring his head back to town you'll be getting a little extra for your troubles. | While spying on the brigands - you count about %totalenemy% men moving about - you spot a figure you did not at all expect: %robberbaron%, the infamous robber baron. The man and his bodyguard detail must be inspecting the state of the camp.

What luck! If you could take his head back to your employer, you might just earn yourself a little bonus.}
6db0e40c9947392ba180.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]{窥探强盗营地时，你注意到一个熟悉的身影。当地人曾反复、激动地描述过他：%robberbaron%，那个横行此地、恶名远扬的强盗头子。他走到哪里，都有一群凶悍的手下跟到哪里。

你估摸着，他的脑袋应该能多换些克朗。 | 你没料到会撞见他，可确实就是本人：%robberbaron%正在强盗营地里。这位臭名昭著的杀手，显然来视察手下的一处分支。他在盗匪间认真地巡视，指指这里，点点那里，对各种东西的好坏评头论足。

几个护卫寸步不离地跟着。你估算了一下，连他和其余强盗在内，营地里大约有%totalenemy%人。 | 委托原本只是清剿强盗，眼下却似乎又添了一份更诱人的赏头：恶名昭彰的杀手兼拦路匪首，%robberbaron%，就在营地里。他身后跟着护卫，像是在检查自己手下一支匪帮的状况。

你不禁琢磨，%robberbaron%的脑袋若换成克朗，能有多沉…… | %robberbaron%。就是他，你认得出来。透过望远镜，这个臭名昭著的强盗头子在营地里来回走动，身影看得一清二楚。他不在你的计划内，委托里也没提到。不过，有一点几乎可以肯定：把他的脑袋带回镇上，就能为这番辛苦多挣一笔。 | 你正在侦察强盗，数到大约%totalenemy%人来回走动，忽然发现一个完全没料到的身影：%robberbaron%，那个恶名远扬的强盗头子。他与随行护卫，想必正在巡视营地。

运气真好！如果能把他的脑袋带回雇主面前，也许就能额外赚上一笔。}

72151d1ddb139a21f2fb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{The battle finished, you walk over to %robberbaron%'s slain body and remove his head with two quick thwacks of your sword, the first cutting the meat, the second the bone. You drive a hook through the lip of neckflesh and draw a rope so as to attach it your hip. | With the fighting over, you quickly search for and find %robberbaron%'s corpse amongst the dead. He still looks mighty mean even as the color leaves his body. He still looks quite  mean when you relieve his head of his body and though you can't see his face any longer as you toss his head into a burlap sack, you assume he still looks pretty mean then, too. | %robberbaron% lies dead at your feet. You turn the body over and straighten out the neck, giving your sword a better target. It takes two good cuts to remove the head which you quickly put into a mealsack. | Now that he's dead, %robberbaron% suddenly reminds you of a lot of men you used to know. You don't settle on the deja vu for long: with a few quick slashes of a sword, you remove the man's head before tossing it into a sack. | %robberbaron% put up a good fight and his neck put up another, the sinews and bones not letting his head go easily as you collect your bounty. | You collect %robberbaron%'s head. %randombrother% points at it as you walk past.%SPEECH_ON%What is that? Is that %robberbaron%'s...?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%Naw, that man is dead. This here is just bonus pay.%SPEECH_OFF%}
72151d1ddb139a21f2fb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{战斗结束，你走到%robberbaron%的尸体旁，利落地挥出两剑，第一剑斩开皮肉，第二剑斩断颈骨，将脑袋砍下。你用钩子穿过断颈边缘的皮肉，再系上绳子，挂到腰间。 | 战斗结束，你迅速在死者中寻找，很快便发现了%robberbaron%的尸体。即使血色已经褪去，他看着依旧凶狠。你把脑袋与身体分开时，他还是那副凶相。等头颅被扔进粗布袋，虽然已经看不见脸，你猜，他多半仍凶得很。 | %robberbaron%死在你脚边。你翻过尸体，将脖子摆直，好让剑有个下手的地方。结结实实砍了两下，脑袋终于掉了，你随即将它装进粮袋。 | 一旦死去，%robberbaron%忽然让你想起许多从前认识的人。你没有在这份似曾相识中停留太久，迅速挥剑几下，砍掉男人的脑袋，扔进袋里。 | %robberbaron%活着时很能打，死后那条脖子还要再斗一场。你收取赏金凭证时，筋肉与骨头死死连着，就是不肯让脑袋轻易离身。 | 你取下%robberbaron%的脑袋。经过%randombrother%身边时，他指着问道：%SPEECH_ON%那是什么？是%robberbaron%的……？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不是。那个人已经死了，这只是额外酬劳。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a301233beeb77df1bb3e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{Heading back to collect on your contract, a few men step out onto the road. One of them points at the head of %robberbaron%. %SPEECH_ON%We are the highest paid bounty hunters in these parts and I believe you're carrying off a bit of our business. Give us that there head and all parties shall get to sleep in their beds tonight.%SPEECH_OFF%You laugh.%SPEECH_ON%You will have to try better than that. %robberbaron%'s head is worth a lot of crowns, my friend.%SPEECH_OFF%The leader of these supposed bounty hunters laughs right back at you. He lifts up a bulbously weighted sack.%SPEECH_ON%This here is %randomname%, one of the more wanted fellas in these parts. And this...%SPEECH_OFF%He holds up another sack.%SPEECH_ON%Is the head of the man who killed him. Understand? So hand over the bounty and we can all be on our way.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man steps out onto the road, straightens up, and postures toward you.%SPEECH_ON%Hello good sirs. I believe you have the head of %robberbaron% in your midst.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The man smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Would you please kindly turn it over to me.%SPEECH_OFF%You laugh and shake your head. The man doesn't smile, instead he raises a hand and snaps his fingers. A throng of well-armed men pour out of some nearby bushes, marching onto the road to the tune of heavy metal clinks and clanks. They look like what a man on death row might dream of the night before his reckoning. Their leader flashes a gold-speckled grin.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not gonna ask you again.%SPEECH_OFF% | While talking to %randombrother%, a loud yell draws your attention. You look up the road to see a mob of men standing in your way. They got all manner of weaponry and armor. Their ringleader steps forward, announcing that they are famed bounty hunters.%SPEECH_ON%We only wish to have the head of %robberbaron%.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%We killed the man, we're collecting on his head. Now get out of our way.%SPEECH_OFF%When you take one step forward, the bounty hunters raise their weapons. Their leader takes one step toward you.%SPEECH_ON%There's a choice to be made here that could get a lot of good men killed. I know it isn't easy, but I do suggest you think it over very carefully.%SPEECH_OFF% | A sharp whistle draws the attention of you and your men. You turn to the side of the road to see a group of men emerging from some bushes. Everyone draws their weapons, but the strangers don't move a foot further. Their ringleader steps forward. He's got a bandolier of ears going across his chest, a summation of his handiwork.%SPEECH_ON%Hello fellas. We here are bounty hunters, if you couldn't tell, and I do believe you have one of our bounties.%SPEECH_OFF%You lift the head of %robberbaron%.%SPEECH_ON%You mean this?%SPEECH_OFF%The ringleader smiles warmly.%SPEECH_ON%Of course. Now if you could please hand it over, that'd sit pretty well with me and my friends.%SPEECH_OFF%Tapping the hilt of his sword, the man grins.%SPEECH_ON%It's only a matter of business. I'm sure you understand.%SPEECH_OFF%}
a301233beeb77df1bb3e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{你正返程领取委托报酬，几个人却走到路上，挡住去路。其中一人指向%robberbaron%的头颅。%SPEECH_ON%我们是这一带身价最高的赏金猎人。我看，你手里提着的，是我们的一桩生意。把脑袋交出来，今晚大家都能回床上睡觉。%SPEECH_OFF%你笑了。%SPEECH_ON%光这么说可不够，朋友。%robberbaron%的脑袋，值不少克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%这伙自称赏金猎人的头领也笑起来，举起一只沉甸甸、鼓成球形的袋子。%SPEECH_ON%这里面是%randomname%，本地赏格最高的通缉犯之一。而这个……%SPEECH_OFF%他又举起另一只袋子。%SPEECH_ON%是杀掉他的那个人的脑袋。明白了？把赏金交出来，咱们各走各的路。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个男人走到路上，挺直身子，对着你摆足架势。%SPEECH_ON%各位先生，日安。我想，%robberbaron%的脑袋就在你们手里。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。男人微笑。%SPEECH_ON%那么，能否劳烦交给我？%SPEECH_OFF%你笑着摇头。男人却不再笑，抬手打了个响指。一群武装精良的人从附近灌木间涌出，踏着沉重的金属碰撞声走上道路。那副模样，足以成为死囚行刑前夜的噩梦。头领咧嘴，露出几点金牙。%SPEECH_ON%我不会再问一次。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你正与%randombrother%交谈，一声大喊引起了注意。抬头望向前路，一伙人已经挡在那里，武器盔甲五花八门。头领上前，宣称他们是声名远扬的赏金猎人。%SPEECH_ON%我们只想要%robberbaron%的脑袋。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%人是我们杀的，赏金也是我们领。现在，让路。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚向前一步，赏金猎人便举起武器。他们的头领也朝你迈近一步。%SPEECH_ON%眼下这个决定，可能会害死不少好汉。我知道不容易，不过，我劝你仔细想清楚。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一声尖锐的口哨吸引了你和弟兄们的注意。转向路旁，一群人正从灌木里走出。双方纷纷拔出武器，陌生人却没再逼近。头领走上前，斜跨胸前的带子上串满耳朵，展示着他的战绩。%SPEECH_ON%各位好。要是还看不出来，我们是赏金猎人。我想，我们的一份赏金正在你们手里。%SPEECH_OFF%你提起%robberbaron%的脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%你说这个？%SPEECH_OFF%头领和气地笑了。%SPEECH_ON%当然。现在，若你肯把它交出来，我和朋友们都会很高兴。%SPEECH_OFF%男人敲敲剑柄，咧嘴说道：%SPEECH_ON%生意而已。你肯定明白。%SPEECH_OFF%}

8486679fdd9ff1305cb5.source: Take the damned head then and leave.
8486679fdd9ff1305cb5.translation: 拿上这该死的人头，滚吧。

c9bb693e152a989b3c38.source: {You'll have to pay with blood if you want it so badly. | If you want your head to join this one, go on, take your chances.}
c9bb693e152a989b3c38.translation: {真那么想要，就拿血来换。 | 想让自己的脑袋也落得这下场，就尽管试试。}

06f04d4c7bbd8bd3317c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]You've seen enough bloodshed for today and hand the head over.
06f04d4c7bbd8bd3317c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]今天流的血已经够多了，你把人头交了出去。

bb0428f16a33c07286a1.source: Let's move on. We still have payment to collect.
bb0428f16a33c07286a1.translation: 继续走吧，还有报酬等着我们去领。

b7b8880aa2e0419e7eaa.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]The bounty hunters are too much for the %companyname%! Not wanting your men needlessly killed, you order a hasty retreat. Unfortunately, the head of %robberbaron% was lost in the chaos...
b7b8880aa2e0419e7eaa.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]赏金猎人太强了，%companyname%无力抵挡！你不愿让弟兄们白白送命，下令急撤。可惜混乱之中，%robberbaron%的首级遗失了……

459b293590e2f8bac57c.source: Oh well. We still have payment to collect.
459b293590e2f8bac57c.translation: 算了，还有报酬等着我们去领。

949cd5d0c0d42851a25f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{With the battle drawing to a close, a few enemies drop to their knees and beg for mercy. %randombrother% looks to you for what to do next. | After the battle, your men round-up what brigands remain. The survivors beg for their lives. One looks more like a kid than a man, but he is the quietest of them all. | Realizing their defeat, the few last standing brigands drop their weapons and ask for mercy. You now wonder what they would do were the shoe on the other foot. | The battle's over, but decisions are still yet to be made: a few brigands survived the battle. %randombrother% stands over one, his sword to the prisoner's neck, and he asks you what you wish to do.}
949cd5d0c0d42851a25f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{战斗渐近尾声，几个敌人跪倒在地，哀求饶命。%randombrother%望向你，等候下一步命令。 | 战斗结束，弟兄们将残存的强盗押到一处。幸存者纷纷乞命，其中一个看着更像孩子，还谈不上男人，却是所有人里最沉默的。 | 明白败局已定，最后几个仍站着的强盗扔下武器，开口求饶。你不禁想，如果彼此处境对调，他们又会怎么做。 | 战斗结束，却还有决定要下：几个强盗活了下来。%randombrother%站在其中一个身前，剑抵着俘虏的脖子，问你打算如何处置。}

481e8f6f0402db259033.source: Take their arms and chase them away.
481e8f6f0402db259033.translation: 收走他们的武器，把人赶走。

ff953136b7b95632cc48.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{Altruism is for the naive. You have the prisoners slaughtered. | You recall how many times brigands slew hapless merchants. The thought is barely out of your mind when you give the order to have the prisoners executed. They pipe up a brief protest, but it is cut short by swords and spears. | You turn away.%SPEECH_ON%Through their necks. Make it quick.%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenaries follow the order and you soon here the gargling of dying men. It is not quick at all. | You shake your head 'no'. The prisoners cry out, but the men are already upon them, hacking and slashing and stabbing. The lucky ones are decapitated before they can even realize the immediacy of their own demise. Those with some fight in them suffer to the very end. | Mercy requires time. Time to look over your shoulder. Time to wonder if it was the right decision. You've no time. You've no mercy. The prisoners are executed and that takes little time at all.}
ff953136b7b95632cc48.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{为别人着想，那是天真的人才做的事。你命人杀光俘虏。 | 你想起强盗曾多少次杀害无助的商人。念头还未散去，处决俘虏的命令就已出口。他们短暂地抗议了几声，随即被刀剑与长矛截断。 | 你转过身去。%SPEECH_ON%往脖子上招呼，干净利落些。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵依令行事。很快，你便听见濒死者喉中的咕噜声。死得一点也不利落。 | 你摇头拒绝。俘虏们哭喊起来，可弟兄们已经扑上去，劈砍、挥斩、刺杀。幸运的，还没意识到死亡已迫在眼前，便被砍掉脑袋；有力气挣扎的，则一直痛苦到最后。 | 仁慈需要时间。得不时回头提防，得反复琢磨决定是否正确。你没有时间，也没有仁慈。俘虏被处决了，这倒没花多少时间。}

0769bf18268a5838a812.source: We have more important things to take care of.
0769bf18268a5838a812.translation: 我们还有更重要的事要办。
