a1c7aba39690d05ad19f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{There's been enough killing and dying today. You let the prisoners go, taking their arms and armor before sending them off. | Clemency for thieves and brigands doesn't come often, so when you let the prisoners go they practically kiss your feet as though they were attached to a god. | You think for a time, then nod.%SPEECH_ON%Mercy it is. Take their equipment and cut them loose.%SPEECH_OFF%The prisoners are let go, leaving behind what arms and armor they had with them. | You have the brigands strip to their skivvies - if they even have them - then let the men go. %randombrother% rummages through what equipment is left behind as you watch a group of half-naked men hurry away.}
a1c7aba39690d05ad19f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{今天的杀戮与死亡已经够多了。你决定放走俘虏，先收缴他们的武器和盔甲，再让他们离开。 | 对盗贼与强盗而言，宽赦可不常有。因此，你放走俘虏时，他们几乎要亲吻你的双脚，仿佛那是神明的脚。 | 你想了片刻，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%饶了他们。收走装备，解开绳子。%SPEECH_OFF%俘虏获释离去，留下了随身的武器和盔甲。 | 你让强盗脱得只剩内裤——前提是他们真有——再放他们走。%randombrother%翻找留下的装备，你则看着一群半裸男人匆匆逃远。}

3e247af02d52512a20bc.source: We're not getting paid for killing them.

558f9c8d16903f645b84.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{Just as the battle ends and things begin to quiet, you hear a man shouting. You move toward the noise to find a prisoner of the brigands. He's got ropes over his mouth and hands which you quickly undo. As he catches his breath, he meekly asks if maybe he could join your outfit. | You find a prisoner tied up in the brigands' camp. Freeing him, he explains that he is from %randomtown%, and was kidnapped by the vagabonds just a few days ago. He asks if maybe he could join your band of mercenaries. | Rummaging what's left of the brigands' camp, you discover a prisoner of theirs. Freeing him, the man sits up and explains that the brigands kidnapped him as he was traveling to %randomtown% in seek of work. You wonder if maybe he could work for you instead... | A man is left behind after the battle. He's not a brigand, but in fact a prisoner of theirs. When you ask who he is, he mentions that he is from %randomtown% and that he's looking for work. You ask if he can wield a sword. He nods.}
558f9c8d16903f645b84.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{战斗刚结束，四周渐渐安静下来，你却听见有人喊叫。循声走去，你发现一个被强盗囚禁的人，嘴和双手都缠着绳索。你迅速替他解开，他喘匀气后，怯生生地问，能不能加入你的战团。 | 你在强盗营地发现一个被捆住的人。解开绳索后，他说自己来自%randomtown%，几天前才被这些流寇绑架。他问，能否加入你的佣兵战团。 | 翻找强盗营地的残余物资时，你发现一个囚犯。获释后，男人坐起身，解释说，他原本正赶往%randomtown%找工作，半路却遭流寇绑架。你琢磨着，或许可以让他为自己干活…… | 战斗之后，还剩一个男人留在营地。他不是强盗，而是被强盗囚禁的人。你问他是谁，他说自己来自%randomtown%，正在找工作。你问他会不会用剑。他点点头。}

b3289a83899ee28ac682.source: You might as well join us.

065a574c47ccf2d03b7e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{The man joins your ranks, immersing himself in a crowd of brothers who seem to take to him warmly enough for a group of paid killers. The newly hired states he's good with all weapons, but you figure you'll be the one to decide what he's best with. | The prisoner grins from ear to ear as you wave him in. A few brothers ask what weapons they should give him, but you shrug and figure you'll see to yourself what to arm the man with.}
065a574c47ccf2d03b7e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{那人走进队伍，融入弟兄们中间。以一群拿钱杀人的家伙来说，他们待他已算热情。新来的自称各种武器都会使，不过你觉得，最适合什么，还是由你决定。 | 你招手让俘虏加入，他笑得合不拢嘴。几个弟兄问该给他什么武器，你耸耸肩，打算亲自替他配备。}

125e6ba6823a82115e21.source: Let's see about a weapon for you.

2c940edce85e25cacc20.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{You shake your head no. The man frowns.%SPEECH_ON%Are you sure? I'm pretty good with...%SPEECH_OFF%You cut him off.%SPEECH_ON%I'm sure. Now enjoy your newfound freedom, stranger.%SPEECH_OFF% | You appraise the man and figure he's not fit for the life of a sellsword.%SPEECH_ON%We appreciate the offer, stranger, but the mercenary life is a dangerous one. Go home to your family, your work, your home.%SPEECH_OFF% | You've enough men to see you through, although you find yourself tempted to replace %randombrother% just to see the man's reaction to a demotion. Instead, you offer the prisoner a handshake and send him on his way. Although disappointed, he does thank you for freeing him.}
2c940edce85e25cacc20.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{你摇头拒绝，男人皱起眉。%SPEECH_ON%确定吗？其实我很擅长……%SPEECH_OFF%你打断他。%SPEECH_ON%确定。陌生人，去好好享受重获的自由吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你打量男人一番，觉得他不适合当佣兵。%SPEECH_ON%多谢你的好意，陌生人，不过，佣兵的日子很危险。回去吧，回到家人身边，回去干活，过你自己的生活。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你已经有足够的人手。不过，想到把%randombrother%换掉，看看他被贬下去时的反应，你倒有点心动。最后，你只是与获救的囚犯握手，送他上路。他虽然失望，仍感谢你救了自己。}

0078c6505366fddd73fe.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You return to %townname% and talk to %employer%. The details of your journey are simple: you killed the brigands. He nods, smiling tersely before handing over your payment as agreed upon.%SPEECH_ON%Good work, men. Those brigands were giving us plenty of trouble.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% opens the door for you as you get to his home. He's got a satchel in hand and holds it up.%SPEECH_ON%I take it by your return that the brigands are dead?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The man heaves the satchel your way. You tell him you could be lying. %employer% shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Could be, but word travels fast for those who bite the hands that feed. Good work, sellsword. Unless you're lying of course, then I'll come find you.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% grins as you enter his room and lay a sacked head on his desk.%SPEECH_ON%You need not stain my fineries to show you've completed the task, sellsword. I've already gotten news of your success - the birds in these lands do travel fast, don't they? Your payment is in the corner.%SPEECH_OFF% | As you finish your report, %employer% wipes his forehead with a handkerchief.%SPEECH_ON%Really, they're all dead then? Boy... you have no idea how much you've lifted off my shoulders, sellsword. No idea at all! Your crowns, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%He sets a satchel on his desk and you quickly take it. All is there, as promised. | %employer% sips his goblet and nods.%SPEECH_ON%You know, I don't take kindly to your sort, but you did a good job, mercenary. %randomname% reported to me, before you even got here, that all the brigands had been slain. It was some mighty fine work by the way he describes it. And, well...%SPEECH_OFF%He heaves a satchel onto the desk.%SPEECH_ON%Here's some mighty fine pay, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% leans back in his chair, folding his hands over his lap.%SPEECH_ON%Sellswords don't sit right with many folks, I suppose on the account of y'all killing and destroying whole villages on a shortchanged whim, but I'll admit you've done good.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods to a corner of the room where a wooden chest lays unopened.%SPEECH_ON%It's all there, but I won't be offended if you need to count it.%SPEECH_OFF%You do count it, and it is indeed all there. | %employer%'s desk is blanketed in dirtied and unfurled scrolls. He's smiling warmly over them as if he's crooning over a pile of treasure.%SPEECH_ON%Trade deals! Trade deals everywhere! Happy farmers! Happy families! Everyone's happy! Ah, it's good to be me. And, of course, it's good to be you, sellsword, because your pockets just got a little bit heavier!%SPEECH_OFF%The man tosses a small purse your way, then another and another.%SPEECH_ON%I would've paid with a larger satchel, but I just like doing that.%SPEECH_OFF%He cheekily tosses another purse which you casually catch with the sort of unamused aplomb of a man who still has fresh blood on his sword.}
0078c6505366fddd73fe.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你回到%townname%，向%employer%复命。经过很简单：强盗全被你杀了。他点点头，略一微笑，便交出约定的报酬。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，各位。那些强盗可给我们添了不少麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你来到%employer%的住处，他亲自开门，举起手中的钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%看你回来了，强盗应该都死了？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，男人便将钱袋抛来。你说，自己也可能在撒谎。%employer%耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%是有可能。不过，忘恩负义之徒的名声，一向传得很快。干得好，佣兵。当然，你要是撒谎，我会去找你的。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进房间，把一颗装在袋里的头颅放到桌上，%employer%咧嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，不必弄脏我的好东西来证明你完成了差事。我早已收到捷报。这片土地上的信鸟，飞得很快，不是吗？报酬在角落里。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你汇报完毕，%employer%用手帕擦了擦额头。%SPEECH_ON%真的，全死了？天哪……佣兵，你根本不知道替我卸下了多重的担子，根本想不到！答应你的克朗，都在这儿。%SPEECH_OFF%他将钱袋放到桌上，你迅速拿起。果然，分文不少。 | %employer%啜饮杯中酒，点头说道：%SPEECH_ON%你知道，我对你们这种人没多少好感。不过，佣兵，你干得不错。你还没到，%randomname%就来报告，说强盗已被尽数消灭。按他的描述，那一仗打得真漂亮。那么……%SPEECH_OFF%他将一只钱袋重重放上桌。%SPEECH_ON%这份报酬也够漂亮，按说好的给。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%向椅背一靠，双手交叠放在腿上。%SPEECH_ON%许多人看佣兵不顺眼。我想，大概因为少给几个钱，你们就会一时兴起，杀光烧光整座村子。不过，我承认，这回你们干得不错。%SPEECH_OFF%他朝房间角落点头，那里放着一只尚未打开的木箱。%SPEECH_ON%全在里面。你若要数，我也不介意。%SPEECH_OFF%你确实数了，钱也确实齐全。 | %employer%的桌上铺满展开的脏卷轴。他含笑望着它们，温柔得像在对一堆财宝低吟。%SPEECH_ON%贸易契约！到处都是贸易契约！农民高兴，家人高兴，人人都高兴！啊，当我可真好。当然，佣兵，当你也不错，因为你的口袋又要沉上一些了！%SPEECH_OFF%男人朝你抛来一个小钱袋，又一个，再一个。%SPEECH_ON%本来可以用个大袋子付清，不过，我就是喜欢这样。%SPEECH_OFF%他顽皮地又抛来一袋。你随手接住，镇定，却毫无笑意，毕竟剑上的血都还没干。}

cbf78b680a82c5de7d14.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You throw the criminal's head on %employer%'s table. With a grin, you point at it.%SPEECH_ON%That's %robberbaron%.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% stands up and unveils the burlap sack covering the trophy. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, that's him alright. I guess you'll be getting extra for that.%SPEECH_OFF%You're paid a tidy sum of %reward% crowns for killing the brigands as well as destroying the leadership of many nearby syndicates. | %employer% leans back as you enter his room, carrying a head by its hair. Luckily, it is not dripping.%SPEECH_ON%This here is %robberbaron%. Or should I say was?%SPEECH_OFF%Slowly standing, %employer% takes a cursory look.%SPEECH_ON%'Was' works... So, not only did you destroy the brigands' rat hole, but you've brought me the head of their leader. That is some mighty fine work, sellsword, and you'll be getting extra for this.%SPEECH_OFF%The man forks over a satchel of %original_reward% crowns and then takes a purse off his own self and pitches it toward you. | You hold %robberbaron%'s head up, its sloped gaze turning to the ropes of bloodied hair. A slow smile etches across %employer%'s face.%SPEECH_ON%You know what you've done, sellsword? Do you know how much relief you've brought to these parts just by removing that man's head from his shoulders? You'll be getting more than what you bargained for! %original_reward% crowns for the original task and...%SPEECH_OFF%The man slides a chunky purse across his table.%SPEECH_ON%A little something for that... extra weight you've been carrying around.%SPEECH_OFF%}
cbf78b680a82c5de7d14.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你将恶徒的头颅扔到%employer%的桌上，咧嘴一笑，指着它说道：%SPEECH_ON%这是%robberbaron%。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%站起身，揭开罩住战利品的粗布袋，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，确实是他。看来，得再给你添一笔。%SPEECH_OFF%你剿灭了强盗，又铲除了附近多个匪帮的首脑，最终得到一笔可观的酬劳：%reward%克朗。 | 你揪着头发，提着一颗头颅走进房间，%employer%向后缩了缩。幸好，头颅已经不再滴血。%SPEECH_ON%这位就是%robberbaron%。还是该说，曾经是？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%缓缓站起，粗略看了一眼。%SPEECH_ON%‘曾经是’很合适……这么说，你不但端了强盗的鼠窝，还带回了头目的首级。佣兵，干得实在漂亮，这事得另加报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%男人交来装着%original_reward%克朗的袋子，又从自己身上解下一只钱袋，抛给了你。 | 你举起%robberbaron%的头颅，倾斜的脸朝向一缕缕染血的头发。%employer%脸上渐渐浮起笑容。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你知道自己干成了什么吗？光是把这人的脑袋从肩上搬走，就给这一带解除了多少祸患，你知道吗？你拿到的，会比谈好的更多！原来那桩差事，%original_reward%克朗，再加上……%SPEECH_OFF%男人将一只鼓鼓的钱袋推过桌面。%SPEECH_ON%一点额外的心意，酬谢你一路提着的……额外分量。%SPEECH_OFF%}

0f16f102876aa9f0b086.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer% sighs as he pushes a scrap of paper toward you. It is a list of crimes. You nod, observing that it is quite a lot of wrongdoing. The man nods back.%SPEECH_ON%T'was an affair of a mere criminal I'd spiff a constable or maybe a bounty hunter. But I've brought you here, sellsword, because this is the work of barbarians. All that they've done, all that is listed there, I need done to them. They've a village %direction% from here. I need you to pay them a visit and show that while we live with hearths and civilization, the spark of the wild has not left us yet, and that barbarian actions will be met with barbaric retribution. Understand?%SPEECH_OFF%You now notice that the page of crimes is smattered with stricken feather tips, as though the one writing it got increasingly upset by its cataloging. | A group of local knights are in the room with %employer%. They regard you plainly, as though you were a dog who had pushed the door open and moseyed in. %employer% reaches down from his chair and retrieves a scroll and throws it your way.%SPEECH_ON%Barbarians left that for me when I went to make sense of a nearby farmstead that was obliterated.%SPEECH_OFF%The paper has runic drawings and what look like depictions of a hanging. %employer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%They massacred the farmers, the men anyway. The old gods know what came of the women. Go %direction% of here, sellsword, and find the barbarians responsible. You'll be paid handsomely for their outright, total, and complete annihilation.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is looking rather bugged when you enter the room. He states that %townname% used to have good relations with the barbarians to the north.%SPEECH_ON%But I suppose I was just fooling myself to think we could stay on even terms with those savages.%SPEECH_OFF%He states they have been attacking caravans, murdering travelers, and attacking homesteads.%SPEECH_ON%So I'll treat them in kind. Go %direction% of here and slaughter their village whole. You keen to doing that?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% laughs when you enter the room.%SPEECH_ON%Not having a jake at your expense, sellsword, only at that cruel congruity of seeking a mercenary for prompt and total erasure of barbarians. You see, just %direction% of here stands a tribe of bearskin wearin' arsefucks that have been scalping and axing traders and travelers. I won't stand for it. Partly because they're in the wrong, but especially because I have the coin to pay someone of your ill manners to take care of it for me.%SPEECH_OFF%He laughs to himself again. You get the feeling this man has never put a sword in any breathing being.%SPEECH_ON%So what say you, sellsword, interested in slaughtering some savages?%SPEECH_OFF% | When you enter %employer%'s room he is staring at a dog's head. A steady leak from the neck drips over the table's edge. The man is rubbing one of the ears.%SPEECH_ON%Who kills a man's dog, cuts off its head, and fucking sends it to him?%SPEECH_OFF%You imagine someone with a hated enemy, but say nothing. %employer% nods at one of his servants and the dog's head is taken away. He looks to you now.%SPEECH_ON%Savages to the %direction% did this. First they started in on the merchants and homesteaders, raping and pillaging as the barbarians do. So I sent a response, killed a few of theirs, and this is what I get in return. Well, no more of these whoresons. I want you to go their village and annihilate them to the last.%SPEECH_OFF%You almost ask if that would include the destruction of their dogs. | You find %employer% with a dirtied and mudslaked woman sat beside his chair. Her hair is matted and her flesh stricken with all manner of punishment. She sneers at you as if it was all your doing. %employer% kicks her over.%SPEECH_ON%Don't mind this wench, sellsword. We caught her and her friends raiding the granary. Killed the lot of the savages, I'd say we spared her for the fun of it but beating on her is about as fun as doing it to a dog. Her mannishness just steals the joy.%SPEECH_OFF%He kicks her again and she snarls back.%SPEECH_ON%See? Well, I have news! We have located the stain she came from and I have every intention of burning it to the ground. That's where you come in. The barbarian village is %direction% of here. Stomp it out and you'll be paid very well.%SPEECH_OFF%The woman doesn't know what is being said, but some slack in her stare seems to indicate she's beginning to understand why a man of your sort walked through that door in the first place. %employer% grins.%SPEECH_ON%You interested or do I have to find a man of meaner character?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% has a crowd of peasants in his room. More of them than any man of his station would be comfortable with in such proximity, but they surprisingly don't seem to be interested in lynching him. Seeing you, %employer% calls you forward.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, finally! Our answer is here! Sellsword, the barbarians %direction% of here have been pillaging nearby villages and raping anything with a hole. We're sick of it and frankly I don't want some mangy savage cock anywhere near my arse no more than the next man.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd of peons jeers, one man yelling out that the barbarians {cut the head off his mother | also murdered his pet goats | stole all his dogs, the bastards | ate the liver of his youngest son}. %employer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye. Aye, men, aye! And so I say, sellsword, that you plot a path to the barbarians' village and treat them to measured, appropriate, civilized justice.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% waves you into his room. He's holding a firepoke, a scalp hanging off its tip.%SPEECH_ON%The northern barbarians sent me this today. It was stuck to its messenger, a man they took the eyes and tongue out of. Such is their nature, these savages, to speak to me without a word. And so I have a feeling I shall return the favor with your help, sellsword. Go %direction% of here, find their little village, and burn it to the ground.%SPEECH_OFF%The scalp unsticks from the firepoke and slaps against the stone floor with a wet slap. | %employer% reluctantly welcomes you in, as is one is wont to do when the world has pressed them into needing a mercenary. He speaks succinctly.%SPEECH_ON%The barbarians have a village %direction% of here from which they are sending raiding parties. They rape, they pillage, they are nothing but insects and varmints in the shape of men. I want them all gone, to the very last. Are you willing to take on this task?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s got a cat in his lap, but as you draw near you realize it's just the head and he's simply been thumbing a delimbed tail around with his thumb. He purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%The barbarian savages did this. They also raped and pillaged a number of surrounding farmsteads and they hung a pair of twin infants from a tree, but this...%SPEECH_OFF%His palms open up and the cat's head rolls out and hits the stone floor with a matted clap.%SPEECH_ON%No more. I want you to go %direction% of here and find the village those savages call home and do unto it what they have done unto us!%SPEECH_OFF%}
0f16f102876aa9f0b086.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer%叹着气，把一张纸推给你。上面列着一串罪行。你点点头，表示这些恶行确实不少。他也点头。%SPEECH_ON%如果只是普通罪犯，我花点钱找个治安官，或者赏金猎人便是。可我找的是你，佣兵，因为这些全是蛮族干的。他们做过的一切，纸上列的一切，我都要他们自己尝一遍。他们的村庄在这里的%direction%边。我要你去拜访一下，让他们知道，我们虽有炉火与文明相伴，骨子里的野性却还没熄灭。野蛮的行径，理当换来野蛮的报复。明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%这时你才注意到，纸上沾着不少折断的羽笔尖，仿佛书写者越记越愤怒，下笔也越来越重。 | 几名当地骑士待在%employer%的房间里。他们平淡地打量着你，仿佛你是条拱开门、溜达进来的狗。%employer%从椅旁俯身拾起一份卷轴，扔给你。%SPEECH_ON%附近一座农庄被毁得干干净净。我去查明情况时，蛮族给我留了这个。%SPEECH_OFF%纸上画着符文，还有些像是描绘绞刑的图案。%employer%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%他们杀光了农夫，至少男人全死了。女人遭了什么罪，只有旧神知道。往这里的%direction%去，佣兵，找到干出这些事的蛮族。把他们彻底、全部、一个不留地消灭，我会重重酬谢。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进房间时，%employer%满脸烦躁。他说，%townname%从前与北方蛮族的关系还不错。%SPEECH_ON%不过，我竟以为能跟那些野蛮人平等相处，大概只是自欺欺人。%SPEECH_OFF%他说，他们最近袭击商队，杀害旅人，劫掠农庄。%SPEECH_ON%所以，我要以牙还牙。从这里往%direction%走，把他们整个村子屠尽。你愿意干吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你一进门，%employer%就笑了起来。%SPEECH_ON%不是拿你取笑，佣兵。我只是觉得，找个佣兵，去迅速而彻底地抹掉一群蛮族，实在契合得残酷。就在这里的%direction%边，有一伙披熊皮的混账，专拿商人和旅客剥头皮、练斧头。我不会容忍。一来，他们有错在先；更要紧的是，我有钱雇你这种品行不端的人，替我解决他们。%SPEECH_OFF%他又自顾自地笑了。你觉得，这人恐怕从没亲手把剑捅进过任何活物。%SPEECH_ON%怎么样，佣兵，有兴趣杀些野蛮人吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，见他正盯着一颗狗头。断颈处不断渗血，顺着桌沿滴下。他揉着其中一只耳朵。%SPEECH_ON%什么人会杀了别人的狗，砍下脑袋，还他妈给送回来？%SPEECH_OFF%你猜，大概是个怀着深仇大恨的人，不过没说出口。%employer%向一名仆人点头，狗头便被拿走。他这才看向你。%SPEECH_ON%是%direction%边的野蛮人干的。起初他们袭击商人和农户，照着蛮族那套，强奸、抢掠。我便还以颜色，杀了他们几个人，结果换来这个。好了，那些狗娘养的，一个也别留。我要你去他们村里，杀到最后一人。%SPEECH_OFF%你差点问出口，那是不是连他们的狗也要杀。 | 你找到%employer%时，一个浑身脏污、裹满泥浆的女人坐在他椅子旁。她头发纠结，身上遍布各种折磨留下的伤痕。她恶狠狠地瞪着你，仿佛一切都是你干的。%employer%一脚把她踹倒。%SPEECH_ON%别理这娘们，佣兵。她跟同伙袭击粮仓，被我们逮住了。其他野蛮人全杀了，留她一个，本想找点乐子，可打她跟打条狗差不多。她这副男人婆的样子，实在扫兴。%SPEECH_OFF%他又踢了一脚，她冲他低吼。%SPEECH_ON%看见了吧？不过，我有个好消息！我们已经找到养出她的那个脏窝，正打算烧个精光。这就是你的差事。蛮族村庄就在这里的%direction%边。把它踏平，你就能拿到丰厚报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%女人听不懂他们说什么，可目光中渐渐透出一丝动摇，仿佛开始明白，你这种人为何会走进这扇门。%employer%咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%你有兴趣，还是得让我另找个更狠的？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的房间里挤满农民。这样的身份，身边凑着这么多平民，照理早该不自在了，不过这些人看起来倒并不打算把他拖出去私刑处死。看见你，%employer%招手叫你上前。%SPEECH_ON%啊，终于来了！能替我们解决问题的人来了！佣兵，这里的%direction%边有群蛮族，不断劫掠附近村庄，见着个洞就要强奸。我们受够了。说实话，跟任何人一样，我也不想让那些癞皮野人的脏玩意儿靠近自己的屁股。%SPEECH_OFF%人群爆发出一阵怒骂，有个人高声控诉，蛮族{砍掉了他母亲的脑袋 | 还杀了他养着的山羊 | 偷走了他所有的狗，这些混蛋 | 吃了他小儿子的肝}。%employer%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，是啊，各位，我都知道！所以，佣兵，找条路去他们村里，让他们见识一下克制、恰当、文明的正义。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%挥手让你进去。他拿着火钩，钩尖挂着一块头皮。%SPEECH_ON%北方蛮族今天送来了这个。它原先还连在送信人身上，那人的眼睛被挖了，舌头也被割了。那些野蛮人就是这般本性，一句话不说，也要给我传话。所以，佣兵，我想借你的手回礼。从这里往%direction%走，找到他们的小村庄，烧个干净。%SPEECH_OFF%头皮从火钩上滑落，湿答答地拍在石地板上。 | %employer%不太情愿地迎你进门。一个人被世道逼得非找佣兵不可时，往往就是这副样子。他言简意赅地说道。%SPEECH_ON%蛮族在这里的%direction%边有座村庄，不断从那里派出劫掠队。他们强奸、抢掠，不过是披着人皮的虫豸和害兽。我要他们彻底消失，一个不剩。你愿意接这件差事吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%膝上放着一只猫。可你走近才发现，只有猫头，而他一直用拇指拨弄的，也只是一截断尾。他抿紧嘴唇。%SPEECH_ON%那些蛮族野人干的。他们还在周围好几座农庄强奸抢掠，把一对双胞胎婴儿吊上树，可这个……%SPEECH_OFF%他张开手，猫头滚落，沉闷地砸在石地板上。%SPEECH_ON%不能再这样了。我要你从这里往%direction%走，找到那些野蛮人称作家园的村庄，把他们对我们做过的事，全数还给他们！%SPEECH_OFF%}

3cbfc2bec8c09dd9c7be.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_138.png[/img]{You've found the barbarian village and a series of cairns that lead toward it. The stones are stacked in the shapes of men, and at the top of each cairn rests a freshly hewn human head. %randombrother% nods.%SPEECH_ON%I wonder if they believe doing that gets them closer to their gods.%SPEECH_OFF%You suspect you have another way to get them closer to their gods: by killing them all. It's time to plan a way of attack. | You find the barbarian village and just to its outskirts lies a round stone in the snow. It's so large the entire company could lay foot-to-head and still not stretch across its middle. Runes have been carved into its outer rim, long divots that are caked with dried blood. In the center of the slab is a small square rise with a curve to hold the neck. %randombrother% spits.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like a sacrificial square, er, circle.%SPEECH_OFF%Looking around, you wonder aloud where they put the bodies. The sellsword shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Dunno. Probably ate 'em.%SPEECH_OFF%It wouldn't surprise you if they did. You stare at the village and ponder attacking or waiting. | The barbarian village lies just a little ways away. It's a nomadic scene, tents surrounded by ad hoc smithy sites and tarped wagons for granaries. You get the feeling that they are not long for any particular part of the world. %randombrother% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Look at that one. He's shittin'. What a fucker.%SPEECH_OFF%Indeed, one of the savages is squatting while talking to his fellow villagers. It is almost a metaphor in and of itself for catching the entire encampment with their pants down. | The village of savages is surprisingly not the hellscape you expected. Aside from the flayed corpse hanging upside down from a wooden holy totem, it looks like any other place with ordinary folks. Aside from the heavy set clothes and every individual carrying an axe or sword of some kind. All quite normal. There's a guy chopping a corpse's legs off and feeding them to pigs, but you'll see that just about anywhere. %randombrother% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Well, we're ready to attack. Just give the word, captain.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find the barbarian village squatting in the snowy wastes. It couldn't have been there long: it's mostly tents and the tops of them don't carry much snow. They must set up for a time then get back on the road, either to keep hunts fresh or to avoid the retribution of those they raid. What a shame they've failed to do the latter. You ready the company for action. | You find the village of savages. Though, from first glance, they look an ordinary sort. Men, women, children. There's a blacksmith, a tanner, a one-eyed guy making arrows, and a huge executioner disemboweling corpses and washing the offal scum on a donkey. That one. That one reminds you of why you're here. | You find the barbarian village. The savages are in the midst of some religious ritual. An elderly man with a tortoise shell necklace has his fist up the decapitated and shaved head. He's letting the blood run down his forearm where children take horsehair brushes and sweep up the 'paint' and go to run it against a wooden holy totem that stands a good ten feet high. The primitives watch and chant in a tongue totally foreign to you. %randombrother% whispers as though out of respect for the ritual moreso than fear of them hearing.%SPEECH_ON%Well. I say we go on down there and make an introduction, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find the barbarians moseying about their village. It's mostly tents and impromptu snow houses. Elderly women sit in a circle weaving baskets and younger women are making arrows while throwing glances at the burly men walking around. The men themselves pretend they don't care, but you know a peacock in action when you see it. There are also children hurrying to and fro this task or that. And just outside the village stand a series of wooden stakes impaling naked corpses from anus to mouth, and their chest cavities have been spread apart like butterfly wings and the insides draped down like loosened embroidering.%SPEECH_ON%Horrid.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says. You nod. It is, but that's why you're here.}
3cbfc2bec8c09dd9c7be.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_138.png[/img]{你找到了蛮族村庄，一连串石堆通向村内。石头垒成人形，每一堆顶部都搁着一颗刚砍下的人头。%randombrother%点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%不知道他们是不是觉得，这样就能更接近自己的神。%SPEECH_OFF%你觉得还有个办法也能让他们更接近神：把他们全杀了。该想想如何进攻了。 | 你找到蛮族村庄，村外雪地里有一块圆形巨石。它大得惊人，整个战团头脚相接地躺下，恐怕都铺不到它的另一边。石缘刻着符文，长长的凹槽里凝着干血。石台中央有一块小方形凸起，上面凹出一道能搁住脖子的弧槽。%randombrother%啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%看来是个祭祀方台，呃，圆台。%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾四周，随口问尸体都去了哪儿。佣兵耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%不知道。大概吃了吧。%SPEECH_OFF%真要如此，你也不会吃惊。你盯着村庄，考虑该进攻还是等待。 | 蛮族村庄就在不远处。一派逐地而居的景象：帐篷周围是临时搭起的锻造点，蒙着篷布的货车则充当粮仓。你觉得，他们不会在世上的任何一个地方久留。%randombrother%笑了起来。%SPEECH_ON%看那个，他在拉屎。真他妈的。%SPEECH_OFF%确实，一个蛮族正蹲着解手，还跟同村人说话。要形容整个营地毫无防备，裤子都没提起来，眼前这景象倒是再贴切不过。 | 蛮族村庄竟不像你预料的那般如同地狱。除了一具剥皮尸体倒挂在神圣的木图腾上，这里看起来和普通百姓居住的地方差不多。再除去那些厚重衣物，以及人手一把的斧头或刀剑。一切都挺寻常。有个人正砍下尸体的双腿喂猪，不过这事也随处可见。%randombrother%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%好了，我们准备进攻了。团长，就等你一声令下。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在白雪覆盖的荒原上找到了蛮族村庄。这里扎营肯定不久，住处大多是帐篷，顶上还没积多少雪。他们想必暂住一阵就会继续赶路，或为追逐新猎物，或为逃避受害者的报复。可惜，后一件事，他们没能办到。你让战团准备行动。 | 你找到了蛮族村庄。乍看过去，倒都是寻常人：男人、女人、孩子。有铁匠，有制革匠，有个独眼人正在制箭，还有个体形巨大的刽子手正在给尸体开膛，将内脏的污秽往一头驴身上抹。就这个家伙。他让你想起了此行的缘由。 | 你找到了蛮族村庄。这些野蛮人正在举行某种宗教仪式。一个戴着龟壳项链的老人，将拳头探进一颗剃光头发的断头中，高高托着，任鲜血沿着前臂流下。孩子们拿马鬃刷蘸取这些颜料，跑去涂抹一根足有十英尺高的神圣木图腾。旁边的人一面观看，一面用你完全听不懂的语言吟唱。%randombrother%低声说道，那语气更像是出于对仪式的尊重，而非怕对方听见。%SPEECH_ON%那么，我看咱们该下去打声招呼，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你发现蛮族正在村里闲逛。这里大多是帐篷和临时搭起的雪屋。老妇们围坐编篮，年轻女人则一边制箭，一边瞟向四处走动的壮汉。男人们装得毫不在意，可孔雀开屏那套，你一眼就能看穿。孩子们也来来回回，为这件事那件事奔忙。村外却立着一排木桩，赤裸的尸体从肛门贯穿到嘴，被穿在上面；胸腔像蝶翼般敞开，内脏如散开的绣线般垂落。%SPEECH_ON%太惨了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%说道。你点头。确实，所以你们才会来到这里。}

542f2b98e71c5c92bb2f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_139.png[/img]{Just as it seems the %companyname% is ready to clash with the savages, a lone figure steps out and stands between the battle lines. He's got a parted long beard knotted around tortoise shells and his head is sheltered beneath a sloping snout of a wolf's skull. The elder stands unarmed save for a long staff which clatters with tethered deer horns. Shockingly, he speaks in your tongue.%SPEECH_ON%Outsiders. Welcome to the North. We are not so inhospitable as you may think. As is our tradition, we believe that battle between two men is just as honorable and of value as that between two armies. So it is, I offer my strongest champion, %barbarianname%.%SPEECH_OFF%A burly man steps forward. He unhooks the pelts and tosses them aside to reveal a body of pure muscle, tendon, and scars. The elder nods.%SPEECH_ON%Put forth your champion, Outsiders, and we shall share a day that all our ancestors will smile upon.%SPEECH_OFF%}
542f2b98e71c5c92bb2f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_139.png[/img]{就在%companyname%即将与蛮族交锋时，一个身影独自走出，站到两军之间。他分成几绺的长胡子绕着龟壳打结，头上罩着狼头骨，低垂的吻部遮住额头。这位长老没有武器，只有一根系着鹿角、动起来哗啦作响的长杖。令人意外的是，他竟说起了你的语言。%SPEECH_ON%外来者，欢迎来到北方。我们并不像你们想的那般不懂待客之道。依照传统，两人之间的交锋，与两军之间的战斗，同样光荣，也同样有意义。因此，我派出最强的勇士，%barbarianname%。%SPEECH_OFF%一个壮汉走上前，解下皮毛扔到一边，露出满是肌肉、筋腱和伤疤的躯体。长老点点头。%SPEECH_ON%派出你们的勇士吧，外来者。让我们共同度过一个足以令双方祖先含笑的日子。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a075d5741c1c957ff519.source: I'd rather burn down this whole camp. Attack!
a075d5741c1c957ff519.translation: 我宁可烧掉整个营地。进攻！

eabc10f49145cf72ca27.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_138.png[/img]{%champbrother% sheathes his weapons and stands over the corpse of the slain savage. Nodding, the victorious sellsword stares back at you.%SPEECH_ON%Finished, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%The elder comes forward again and raises his staff.%SPEECH_ON%So it is, what is it that you wish to have been solved by the violence you sought coming here?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him that those to the south are furious and want them gone from these lands. The elder nods.%SPEECH_ON%If by battle you would have accomplished, then by honorable duel it is finished. We shall leave.%SPEECH_OFF%The savages are told in their tongue to pack up and go. Surprisingly, there's little backtalk or complaining. If they're true to their word then you can go and tell %employer% now.}
eabc10f49145cf72ca27.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_138.png[/img]{%champbrother%收起武器，站在被杀的蛮族尸体旁。这位得胜的佣兵点点头，回望着你。%SPEECH_ON%解决了，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%长老再次上前，举起手杖。%SPEECH_ON%胜负已定。那么，你们来到这里寻求杀戮，究竟想以此解决什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，南方人已经怒不可遏，要他们离开这片土地。长老点头。%SPEECH_ON%既是你们想通过战斗达成的事，如今便已由这场荣誉决斗定下。我们会离开。%SPEECH_OFF%他用蛮族的语言下令，让众人收拾行装动身。令人意外的是，几乎没人顶嘴或抱怨。如果他们说到做到，你现在就能回去向%employer%复命了。}

39b75cec8a384c19d433.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_138.png[/img]{It was a good fight, a clash between men upon the earth with those in observation silent as though in awe of some timeless and honorable rite. But. %champbrother% lies dead on the ground. Bested and killed. The elder steps forward again. He does not carry any hint of gloating or grin.%SPEECH_ON%Outsiders, the battle between two men is as such as it were between all of us combined. We have won, blessed is the Far Rock's gaze, and so we request that you depart these lands and do not return.%SPEECH_OFF%A few of the sellswords look to you with anger. One says he doesn't think the savages would abide the agreement were things the other way around, that the company should wipe these barbarians out regardless of the outcome.}
39b75cec8a384c19d433.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_138.png[/img]{那是一场精彩的决斗。两人在大地上厮杀，旁观者鸦雀无声，仿佛正敬畏地注视某种古老而庄严的仪式。可是，%champbrother%已经倒毙在地。他输了，也死了。长老再次上前，脸上没有半点得意或嘲笑。%SPEECH_ON%外来者，两人之间的胜负，也就是我们双方全体之间的胜负。承蒙远岩垂顾，我们赢了。因此，我们要求你们离开这片土地，不再回来。%SPEECH_OFF%几个佣兵愤怒地望向你。其中一人说，换成蛮族输了，他们肯定不会信守约定；无论决斗结果如何，战团都该把这些蛮族杀光。}

bcfd68c192a3503dcddb.source: We will stay true to our word and leave you in peace.
bcfd68c192a3503dcddb.translation: 我们信守承诺，不再打扰你们。

be3e1f1a2eb56b7c655e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{The battle over, %randombrother% beckons you over. In one of the tents is a barbarian nursing a wound. Men, women, and children litter the floor around him. The sellsword points to him.%SPEECH_ON%We chased the savage in here. I think that's his family all around him, or someone he knows, cause he just collapsed and hasn't moved since.%SPEECH_OFF%You walk toward the man and crouch before him. You tap one of his deerskin boots and ask if he understand you. He nods and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Little. You did this. Didn't have to, but did. Finish me, or I fight with you. One, the other, all honorable.%SPEECH_OFF%It seems he's offering his hand to fight with the company, no doubt part of some northern code that's foreign to yourself. He's also offering his head if you want that, too, and he seems totally unafraid of giving it up.}
be3e1f1a2eb56b7c655e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{战斗结束，%randombrother%招手叫你过去。一顶帐篷里，一个蛮族捂着伤口，周围地上横七竖八躺着男人、女人和孩子。佣兵指向他。%SPEECH_ON%我们追着这野蛮人进来。他身边这些，我看是他的家人，或是什么认识的人。他进来就瘫下了，再没动过。%SPEECH_OFF%你走到那人面前蹲下，轻拍他的一只鹿皮靴，问他能否听懂。他点点头，又耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%一点。你干的。不必干，可是干了。杀我，或者，我跟你打仗。这个，那个，都有荣誉。%SPEECH_OFF%看来，他愿意加入战团效力。这无疑是北方某种你不懂的规矩。若你更想要他的脑袋，他也愿意奉上，而且看起来毫不畏惧。}

1f1cd53e8eb4ca41af30.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{You unsheathe your sword and lower the blade toward the man, the corpses in the tent blurring along its metal curvature, and the surviving barbarian's face blobbing at the tip. He grins and grips the edges, sheathing it in his huge hands. Blood drips steadily from his palms.%SPEECH_ON%Death, killing, no dishonor. For us both. Yes?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you push the blade into his chest and sink him back to the floor. The weight of him on the sword is like a stone and when you unstick him the corpse claps back against the pile of corpses. Sheathing the sword, you tell the company to round up what goods they can and to ready a return to %employer%.}
1f1cd53e8eb4ca41af30.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{你拔剑，将剑刃垂向那人。帐篷里的尸体沿着弧形剑身映出模糊的倒影，剑尖处则是幸存蛮族扭曲的脸。他咧嘴一笑，用两只大手握住锋刃，像将剑收进掌中。鲜血不断从掌心滴下。%SPEECH_ON%死，杀，都不丢荣誉。你我，都不丢。对？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，将剑推入他的胸口，压着他倒回地上。他沉沉挂在剑上，像块石头；等你抽出剑，尸体便重重落回尸堆。你收剑入鞘，命令战团尽量收集物资，准备回去见%employer%。}

9a6c6c23dccc09069e02.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{You unsheathe your blade halfway, hold it long enough that the savage sees it, then you slam it back into the scabbard. Nodding, you ask.%SPEECH_ON%Understand?%SPEECH_OFF%The barbarian stands up, briefly slumping against the tent's post. You turn and hold your hand out to the tent flap. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, I know.%SPEECH_OFF%He stumbles out and into the light and away into the northern wastes, his shape tottering side to side, shrinking, and is then gone. You tell the company to get ready to return to %employer% for some well-earned pay.}
9a6c6c23dccc09069e02.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{你将剑拔出一半，停留片刻，让野蛮人看清，再猛地推回鞘中。你点头问：%SPEECH_ON%明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%野蛮人站起来，短暂倚住帐柱。你转身，伸手示意帐门。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，我懂。%SPEECH_OFF%他踉跄着走进日光，走向北方荒原，身影左右摇晃，渐渐缩小，最终消失。你让战团准备回去找%employer%，领取辛苦挣来的报酬。}

e8d5fed360fd6df6a9d2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{You stare at the man, then take out your dagger and slice the inside of your palm. Squeezing the blood, you toss the dagger to the barbarian and then hold your hand out, the blood dripping steadily. The savage takes the blade and cuts himself in turn. He stands and puts his hand out and you shake. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Honor, always. With you, the only way, all the way.%SPEECH_OFF%The man stumbles out of the tent. You tell the men to not kill him, but instead to arm him which raises some eyebrows. His addition to the company is unforeseen, but useful. The southern sellswords will get used to it in time, but for now the %companyname% needs to return to %employer%.}
e8d5fed360fd6df6a9d2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{你注视着那人，取出匕首，划开自己的掌心。挤出鲜血后，你把匕首抛给蛮族，伸出不断滴血的手。他接过刀，也割开掌心，起身与你握手，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%荣誉，不变。跟你，一条路，走到底。%SPEECH_OFF%他踉跄着走出帐篷。你告诉弟兄们，别杀他，给他武器。几个人惊讶地挑起了眉毛。他加入战团虽出人意料，却也能派上用场。南方的佣兵们迟早会习惯，眼下，%companyname%得先回到%employer%那里。}

57db2f8e42bc25b33c8f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_135.png[/img]{A man stands out into your path. He's an elder and not of southern reaches.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, the Outsiders. You come to our lands and ravage an undefended village.%SPEECH_OFF%You spit and nod. %randombrother% yells out that it's what the savages themselves do. The old man smiles.%SPEECH_ON%So we are in cycle, and through this violence we all shall regenerate, but violence there shall be. When we are through with you, %townname% will not be spared.%SPEECH_OFF%A line of strongmen get up out of the terrain where they were hiding. By the looks of it, this is the main war party of the village you burned down. They may have been out raiding when you sacked the place. Now here they are seeking barbarian retribution.}
57db2f8e42bc25b33c8f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_135.png[/img]{一个人挡在路上。是位长老，显然不是南方人。%SPEECH_ON%啊，外来者。你们闯入我们的土地，蹂躏了一个毫无防备的村庄。%SPEECH_OFF%你啐了一口，点头承认。%randombrother%高声反驳，说这些野蛮人自己也干同样的事。老人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%于是轮回继续，我们都将在杀戮中重生，而杀戮也必将延续。收拾完你们，%townname%同样逃不过。%SPEECH_OFF%一排壮汉从藏身的地形后站起。看样子，他们正是被你烧毁的那个村庄的主力。你攻入那里时，他们可能还在外出劫掠。如今，他们回来讨还蛮族的血债了。}

566ce964afd56d977a21.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{The savages are driven from %townname%. Despite the results, it takes time for the villagers to emerge and see your victory in full. %employer% eventually comes out clapping and hollering. There's a retinue of sheepish lieutenants looking around, their knees muddied, stray straw and clods of earth all over them. It appears they were hiding.%SPEECH_ON%Well done, sellsword, well done! The old gods surely all of that and will reward you in good time!%SPEECH_OFF%You sheathe your sword and nod at the man's useless lieutenants.%SPEECH_ON%Maybe, but you better do it first anyway. The old gods would surely appreciate your acting on their behalf given that others, shall we say, could not?%SPEECH_OFF%The man purses his lips and glances at his lieutenants who glance away. Your employer smiles and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course, of course, sellsword. I understand you well. You shall be paid in full and then some! All well-earned, truly!%SPEECH_OFF%}
566ce964afd56d977a21.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_145.png[/img]{蛮族被赶出了%townname%。尽管胜负已分，村民们还是过了许久，才敢出来看清你们的胜利。%employer%终于现身，边鼓掌边欢呼。几个副官跟在身后，神情窘迫，四下张望，膝盖沾着泥，身上满是散乱的稻草和土块。看来，他们之前躲了起来。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，佣兵，干得好！旧神必定见证了这一切，到了时候，一定会赐你奖赏！%SPEECH_OFF%你收剑入鞘，朝那几个没用的副官点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%也许吧，不过你最好先赏。想必旧神会很高兴，由你代为酬谢，毕竟其他人，怎么说呢，似乎没能替神做点什么？%SPEECH_OFF%他抿起嘴，瞥向副官们，后者纷纷避开目光。雇主笑着点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然，当然，佣兵。我明白你的意思。报酬分文不少，还会另有酬谢！都是应得的，当之无愧！%SPEECH_OFF%}

9f6988f2dfda0d079ef8.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]{You're run off the field of battle and retreat to a safe enough spot to watch the ruination of %townname%. The savages dip into homes and start raping and murdering of both men and women. Children are collected up and heaved into cages made of bone and hide where the elder gently hands them sliced apples and cups of camphor. At the town square you watch as the primitives set upon %employer%'s home. A few guards step forward, but they're cut down almost immediately. One man is laid out upon the ground and is stripped and kicked toward a pair of dogs who tear at him from every which way and he survives and uncomfortably long time. 

 Finally, %employer% is dragged out of his home. The barbarian leader stares down at him, nods, then grabs him by the neck with one hand and covers his face with the other. In this suspension the man is suffocated. The corpse is then thrown to the warband who have it stripped, desecrated, and then impaled from anus to mouth and lifted high up in the town square. Once the pillaging is done, the savages take what look they want and depart. The last you see of them is a dog trotting with a human ribcage in its maw. %randombrother% comes to your side.%SPEECH_ON%Well. I don't think we're getting paid, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%No. You suspect not.}
9f6988f2dfda0d079ef8.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]{你们被逐出战场，退到一处还算安全的地方，眼看着%townname%毁于一旦。蛮族闯入民宅，对男人女人施暴、奸淫、杀戮。孩子被收拢起来，塞进用骨头和兽皮做成的笼子，长老则温和地递给他们切好的苹果和一杯杯樟脑水。镇中广场上，蛮族扑向%employer%的住所。几个卫兵挺身上前，几乎转眼便被砍倒。有个人被按倒、扒光衣服，踢到两条狗面前。恶犬从各个方向撕咬，而他迟迟不死，活得令人不忍再看。 

 最后，%employer%被拖出屋子。蛮族首领俯视着他，点了点头，一手攥住他的脖子将他提起，另一手捂住他的脸。就这样，他被悬在半空，活活闷死。尸体随后抛给战帮，遭到剥衣凌辱，再被木桩从肛门贯穿到嘴，高高竖在镇中广场上。劫掠结束，蛮族带走想要的东西，扬长而去。你最后看见的，是一条叼着人类肋骨架、小跑着跟上的狗。%randombrother%来到身旁。%SPEECH_ON%看来，咱们拿不到报酬了，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%嗯。你想也是。}

4d8c9a399f517e2db53f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your entrance with applause.%SPEECH_ON%My scouts tracked your company to the north and to its, dare I say, inevitable success! Splendid work murdering those savages. Surely this will make them think twice about venturing down here again!%SPEECH_OFF%The man pays you what you're owed. | You enter %employer%'s room and find him slackened into his chair. He's watching a naked woman saunter from one side of the room to the other. Shaking his head, he talks to you while not taking his eyes from the show.%SPEECH_ON%My scouts have already told me of your doings. Said you put it to the barbarians like they'd done their wrongs against you personally. I like that. I like the lack of restraint. Wish more of my own men had it.%SPEECH_OFF%A servant, previously unseen, quickly marches across the room. He's got a red candle atop his head and a chest of crowns in his hands. You take your pay and leave the room as quick as you can. | You find %employer% and a group of armored men standing around a table. A barbarian's corpse is on it. The flesh is greyed, but the body's musculature and grit has not yet been decayed. They ask if you truly fought men of this sort. You cut to the chase and ask for your pay. %employer% claps and shows you off to the group.%SPEECH_ON%Gentlemen, this is the sort of man I want in my ranks! Unfearful and always focused.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the nobles spits and says something you don't hear. You ask him to speak up if he's something to say, but %employer% rushes forward, chest of crowns in hand, and sends you on your way. | Finding %employer% proves a little difficult, a hunt that ends in a seemingly abandoned barn. You see him standing before a dead barbarian, the corpse hanging from the rafters by his legs like a fisherman's haul. The body has been burned, mutilated, and all else. %employer% crouches and washes his hands in a bucket.%SPEECH_ON%I've to say, sellsword, you killing a whole number of these savages is most impressive. This one here lasted a good long while. Took to the pain like he was gonna pay it forward to me tenfold. But he never did. Did you?%SPEECH_OFF%The man gently slaps the barbarian's face and the chains clink as the body gently twists. %employer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%A servant outside will have your pay. A job well done, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% and a group of men overseeing the defense of %townname%, no doubt preparing themselves for whatever attack may come next. Judging by the appearance of the men, their ambitions of survival will meet a reality far more cruel than they are ready for. But you keep that to yourself. %employer% thanks you for a job well done and pays you what is owed. | A few denizens of %townname% see your return with horrified confusion, mistaking you for the savages that they'd come to know. Windows are shuttered, doors slammed closed, children hurried away, and a few braver souls step out with pitchforks. %employer% hurries out of his abode and sets them straight, explaining you are the heroes of the tale, that you went north and annihilated the savages, burned their village, and scattered them to the wastes. Windows swing wide and doors creak open and the children return to their play. Just when you think order has returned, an old woman snarls.%SPEECH_ON%A sellsword is just a savage by another name!%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you tell %employer% to pay what is owed. | %employer% is studying a few scrolls. He's also penning notes into them and crossing others out. Looking up, he explains that he's putting you into the records as a 'hero who went to the wastes' and 'slaughtered the savages in a fashion most proper and southernly.' He asks you to remind him what your name is. You ask him to pay you what you're owed. | %employer% is in the company of a group of sobbing women. He's consoling them and when you enter he stands and points you out to them.%SPEECH_ON%Behold! The man who has slain those who murdered your husbands!%SPEECH_OFF%The women wail and clamber to you, one after the other, and you know what to do besides nod sternly and stoically. %employer% is the last of the crowd to find you, a chest of crowns in his arm and a wry smile on his lips. You take your pay and the man returns to the women.%SPEECH_ON%There there, fine ladies, the world will see a new dawn. Please, come with me. Does anyone want wine?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you with open arms. You decline a hug and ask for your pay. He returns to his desk.%SPEECH_ON%I wasn't trying to hug you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%He taps the chest rather despondently.%SPEECH_ON%But you did a good job slaughtering those savages. I've a number of scouts who reported it as a 'splendid time' you had out there. You've earned this.%SPEECH_OFF%He pushes the chest across the desk and you take it at arm's length, meeting a slight bit of resistance as he holds onto it. You hurriedly leave the room without looking at him again. | You have a hard time finding %employer%, eventually finding him halfway down a well shaft plugging a hole with a stone slab. He shouts up to you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, the sellsword. Hoist me up, men!%SPEECH_OFF%A pulley system draws up the plank upon which he sits. He swings his legs off and rests them on the rim of the wellhead.%SPEECH_ON%Our mason was killed by a donkey so I thought I'd lend a hand myself. Nothing like a little dirty work to get a good man up in the morn'.%SPEECH_OFF%He slaps your chest with his glove, it leaves a powdered outline. He nods and fetches a servant to go get your pay.%SPEECH_ON%A job well done, sellsword. Very, very well done. Heh.%SPEECH_OFF%You don't humor him. | %employer% is found giving a speech to a crowd of peasants. He describes an unnamed force of southerners that headed north and annihilated the savage scum. At no point are you or the %companyname% named. When he's done, the mob of peons cheer and clap and flowers are thrown and a general state of festivity takes over. %employer% seeks you out and shakes your hand while pushing a chest of crowns toward you.%SPEECH_ON%I wish I could call you the hero to these fine folk, but mercenaries are not seen in the best of light.%SPEECH_OFF%You wrap your hands around the payment and lean forward.%SPEECH_ON%All I want is the pay. Have fun out there, %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% attending a funeral ceremony. They're burning a pyre weighed with three corpses and what may possibly be a fourth, smaller one. Possibly a whole family. %employer% says a few kind words and then sets the woodwork ablaze. A servant surprises you with a chest of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% does not wish to be bothered. Here is your pay, sellsword. Please count if you do not trust it is all there.%SPEECH_OFF%}
4d8c9a399f517e2db53f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer%鼓着掌迎你进来。%SPEECH_ON%我的斥候一路追踪你们北上，直到战团赢得了——容我说一句——意料之中的胜利！那些野蛮人，杀得漂亮。这下，他们再想往南来，总得先掂量掂量了！%SPEECH_OFF%他付清了应给你的报酬。 | 你走进%employer%的房间，见他懒洋洋地陷在椅子里，正看着一个赤裸的女人从房间一侧缓步走向另一侧。他摇了摇头，目光始终没离开眼前的景象，却跟你说起话来。%SPEECH_ON%斥候已经告诉我了。说你收拾那些蛮族，狠得像是他们跟你本人有仇。我喜欢这样，放开手脚，毫无顾忌。真希望我的人也能多几分这股劲。%SPEECH_OFF%一个先前没被你留意到的仆人快步穿过房间，头顶红蜡烛，手捧装满克朗的箱子。你领过报酬，尽快离开了房间。 | 你找到%employer%时，他和一群披甲的人正围着一张桌子。桌上放着蛮族的尸体，皮肉已经灰败，肌肉的轮廓与结实的体格却尚未腐坏。他们问你，是否真与这样的人交过手。你直截了当地索要报酬。%employer%拍起手，向众人夸耀你。%SPEECH_ON%诸位，这才是我想要的战士！无所畏惧，始终专注！%SPEECH_OFF%一个贵族啐了口唾沫，嘟囔了句你没听清的话。你叫他有话就大声说，可%employer%已经抱着钱箱赶过来，赶紧把你送走了。 | 要找到%employer%还真不容易，最后，你在一座似乎废弃的谷仓里找到了他。他站在一具蛮族尸体前，尸体双腿吊在房梁上，活像渔夫倒挂的渔获。那身躯被烧伤、摧残，受尽了折磨。%employer%蹲下，在桶里洗手。%SPEECH_ON%不得不说，佣兵，你能杀掉那么多野蛮人，确实了不起。眼前这个，可是撑了好一阵。受刑时那副劲头，像是打算把痛苦十倍还给我。可惜，他没办到。对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他轻轻拍了拍蛮族的脸，尸体微微转动，铁链叮当作响。%employer%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%外面的仆人拿着你的报酬。干得好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正带着一群人查看%townname%的防务，显然在防备下一次可能到来的袭击。看那些人的模样，他们虽想活下去，迎面而来的现实却恐怕比他们准备承受的残酷得多。不过，你没把这话说出口。%employer%感谢你办妥差事，付清了报酬。 | %townname%的几个居民看见你回来，惊恐又困惑，把你们错当成了他们熟悉的那群野蛮人。窗户紧闭，大门砰然关上，孩子被匆匆拉走，几个胆大的还提着草叉走了出来。%employer%急忙从住处跑出，向他们解释，你们才是故事里的英雄，曾北上歼灭蛮族，焚毁村庄，将他们赶回荒原。窗户随即敞开，门也吱呀开启，孩子重新出来玩耍。你正以为一切恢复了正常，一个老妇却厉声啐道。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵不过是换了个名字的野蛮人！%SPEECH_OFF%你叹了口气，叫%employer%把该付的钱付了。 | %employer%正在研读几份卷轴，时而提笔加注，时而划去文字。他抬头解释，自己正将你载入记述，称你为深入荒原的英雄，以及用最体面、最有南方风范的方式屠灭野蛮人的勇士。他问你叫什么名字，想再确认一遍。你叫他先把欠你的钱付了。 | %employer%身边围着一群哭泣的女人，他正在安慰她们。你一进来，他便站起身，指向你。%SPEECH_ON%看啊！正是这个人，杀死了谋害你们丈夫的凶手！%SPEECH_OFF%女人们哭喊着，一个接一个涌到你面前。你也只能板着脸，故作沉稳地点头。%employer%最后才挤到你面前，臂弯里抱着钱箱，嘴角挂着一抹会意的笑。你收下报酬，他便又回到女人们身边。%SPEECH_ON%好了，好了，各位夫人，世上总会有新的曙光。请随我来。有人想喝杯酒吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%张开双臂欢迎你。你谢绝拥抱，开口索要报酬。他回到书桌后。%SPEECH_ON%我可没想抱你，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他有些沮丧地敲了敲钱箱。%SPEECH_ON%不过，那些野蛮人，你确实杀得漂亮。好几个斥候回报，都说你们在那里过得十分痛快。这是你应得的。%SPEECH_OFF%他把钱箱沿桌面推来，你伸直胳膊去接，才发现他还攥着不放，手上略有阻力。你匆匆离开房间，没再看他一眼。 | 你费了好一番工夫寻找%employer%，最后发现他竟在井筒半腰，用一块石板堵洞。他朝井口的你喊道。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵。伙计们，把我吊上去！%SPEECH_OFF%滑轮将他坐着的木板拉上来。他翻过腿，将双脚搁在井沿。%SPEECH_ON%我们的石匠被驴弄死了，我就想亲自搭把手。对一个好人来说，没什么比干点脏活更能让他清早起床来劲了。%SPEECH_OFF%他用戴着手套的手拍了拍你的胸口，留下一个粉尘印子。他点点头，叫来仆人去取报酬。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，佣兵。非常、非常好。嘿。%SPEECH_OFF%你没陪他笑。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正向一群农民演说，讲述一支未具名的南方队伍如何北上，将野蛮人的渣滓斩尽杀绝。从头到尾，既没提你，也没提%companyname%。演说结束，百姓欢呼鼓掌，鲜花四下抛洒，到处都是庆贺的气氛。%employer%找到你，一边握手，一边将装满克朗的箱子推给你。%SPEECH_ON%我也想让这些善良的百姓知道，你才是英雄，可佣兵的名声毕竟不太好。%SPEECH_OFF%你抱住钱箱，倾身向前。%SPEECH_ON%我只要报酬。你尽兴吧，%employer%。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在主持葬礼。柴堆上放着三具尸体，似乎还有第四具，更小一些。也许是一整家人。%employer%说了几句慰问的话，随后点燃柴堆。一个仆人突然来到你身边，捧着钱箱。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%不想被打扰。这是您的报酬，佣兵。若不放心数目，可以自己点清。%SPEECH_OFF%}

3c5f1928240b79703e50.source: Failed to destroy a barbarian encampment threatening
3c5f1928240b79703e50.translation: 未能摧毁蛮族营地，受威胁的聚落：

297b13ea91dba528142e.source: We could need a man like this.

6d17ffe0a1bd74f330ff.source: Has seen his village being slaughtered
6d17ffe0a1bd74f330ff.translation: 目睹了自己的村庄遭到屠戮

4924611b1ee8105edb77.source: You destroyed a barbarian encampment that threatened
4924611b1ee8105edb77.translation: 你摧毁了蛮族营地，解除了威胁，受益的聚落：

68957b7850b713262181.translation: 免遭前来寻仇的蛮族袭击

424f354aa623544eb886.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{There are no horns, no confetti, no cheers, but there's still yet a certain level of pomp when you enter %employer%'s room. It is so decorated with golds and silvers, intricate jewelries made by genuine craftsmen, and a harem of nothing but the most attractive women, that one can't help but be spurred to do whatever is asked if only to have a chance to partake in the seemingly day-to-day festivities. %employer% sits upon a pile of cushions.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, Crownling. I've been expecting you. Please, come no closer, you will scare my attractions. I have a simple task for you. Nomads have been plundering my caravans, hereat, I am with fewer coins in my coffers. I'm sure you understand what it is like to be deprived of in any manner, yes? Ah, you seem so dumb. So blank. So, well, involved with what you do. I need those nomads killed, and I'm willing to pay %reward% crowns to have it done. Does this language please whatever resides between those ears?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is partly sitting on a throne of silken cushions, and partly on the bodies of a harem of attractive women. He puts his hand up.%SPEECH_ON%If you step further, Crownling, then you will grow in sight but diminish in view, understand? A smart man knows his place. I have a simple task for your swordhand. Nomads outside %townname% have taken to thievery and thuggery. For a handsome handsel, I need you to annihilate these men who have made my life uncomfortable.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% feeding a bird in a cage. The bird is a collage of colors some of which you're not sure you have even seen before. Suspecting your presence, or perhaps smelling it, %employer% turns with a hint of disgust.%SPEECH_ON%You are scaring my bird, Crownling, so I will make this brief for her sake. There are nomads roaming the peripheral of my lands and I need them destroyed. I'm sure a man of your, eh, station, would be willing to undertake such a simple, easy task?%SPEECH_OFF% | You enter %employer%'s room. He's feeding on fruits and his lower half is submerged in a sea of flesh, a harem of caretakers who are noisily at work. Standing idly for far too long, you open your mouth but the man throws a hand up. He points at one of his servants and snaps his fingers. The servant skirts across the marble floor on sandals with silken soles. He presents to you a piece of paper. It reads:%SPEECH_ON%To Crownlings who are interested, nomads have taken to disturbing the peace around %townname%. They are to be dealt with posthaste for a reward of %reward% crowns. Uninterested parties are to leave immediately.%SPEECH_OFF%The servant looks at you for an answer. | %employer% sighs as you enter his room.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, a Crownling, I'd almost forgotten I had requested your sort to come ruin my day.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at the Vizier as he is far too belabored to extricate himself from a sea of cushions and the harem of women who are there to fluff each and every one.%SPEECH_ON%Well, I suppose I shall sully an hour if only to get this matter settled. Nomads are ravaging my caravans, as they are wont to do, and hereat my markets are deprived of certain goods which I wish to have. I offer %reward% crowns to find and destroy these sand ridden mites.%SPEECH_OFF%}
424f354aa623544eb886.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{走进%employer%的房间，没有号角、彩纸，也没有欢呼，却仍有一种铺张的排场扑面而来。金银饰物四处闪耀，珠宝皆出自真正的匠人之手，姬妾更是个个姿容出众。看着这仿佛日日不散的盛宴，人难免愿意替主人做任何事，只为分得一席之地。%employer%坐在一堆软垫上。%SPEECH_ON%啊，克朗客，我一直等着你。请别再靠近了，你会吓着我的美人。我有件简单差事交给你。游牧民一直在劫掠我的商队，导致我库里的钱少了。我想，你一定明白缺这少那是什么滋味，对吧？啊，你看起来真木讷，真空洞，真是……全副心思都放在你那营生上了。我要那些游牧民死，愿意为此支付%reward%克朗。这种说法，能让你两只耳朵之间的东西满意吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%半坐在丝绸软垫堆成的宝座上，半倚在美艳姬妾的身上。他抬起一只手。%SPEECH_ON%再往前一步，克朗客，你在我眼里会变大，在我心里却会变小，明白吗？聪明人懂得自己的位置。我有件简单的活要交给你那只握剑的手。%townname%城外的游牧民四处盗抢、横行霸道。我愿付一笔丰厚的酬金，要你铲除这帮害我日子不舒坦的家伙。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你看见%employer%正在喂笼中的鸟。鸟儿的羽毛五彩斑斓，有些颜色你甚至不确定自己是否见过。察觉到你的到来，或者闻到了你的气味，%employer%带着一丝嫌恶转过身。%SPEECH_ON%你吓着我的鸟了，克朗客。为了它好，我长话短说。领地边缘有些游牧民四处游荡，我要你消灭他们。像你这种，嗯，身份的人，应该很乐意接下这么一桩简单又轻松的差事吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间。他正吃着水果，下半身掩在一群贴身侍女之间，她们忙着伺候，动静不断。你干等了许久，终于张嘴想说话，他却抬手制止，朝一个仆人指了指，打了个响指。那仆人穿着丝底凉鞋，快步滑过大理石地面，将一张纸呈给你。上面写道：%SPEECH_ON%告有意接活的克朗客：游牧民正在滋扰%townname%周边的安宁，须即刻予以处置。酬金%reward%克朗。无意者速退。%SPEECH_OFF%仆人看着你，等候答复。 | 你一进房间，%employer%便叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%啊，一个克朗客。我差点忘了，是我自己叫你们这种人来毁掉好心情的。%SPEECH_OFF%你盯着这位维齐尔。他深陷软垫堆，连脱身都嫌费劲；姬妾们则围在四周，把每只垫子都拍得松松软软。%SPEECH_ON%唉，为了把事情解决，也只好糟蹋这一小时了。游牧民又在劫掠我的商队，那是他们的老本行。结果，我想要的某些货物在市面上断了供。我出%reward%克朗，去找出并消灭那群沙里的螨虫。%SPEECH_OFF%}

0d588df528fefd4e831d.source: {Let's talk some more about payment. | I can make this problem disappear.}
0d588df528fefd4e831d.translation: {我们再谈谈报酬。 | 我能替你解决这个麻烦。}

6f6cd048d5275267061b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]{The nomads are surprisingly stationary and suprisingly many, but it appears there's a reason for that: you find the sand dwellers huddled around a hole in the ground. They've constructed pullies around it and are working feverishly to drag up whatever it is they've found in the desert. Based upon the grin of the man overseeing the operation, it is no doubt a trove of treasure.

You could attack now, and face more opposition, or you could wait until they're done and have left with whatever they're digging up.}
6f6cd048d5275267061b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]{这些游牧民居然一动不动地聚在一起，人数也出乎意料地多，不过很快你就看出了缘由：这群沙漠住民正围着地上的一个大坑，四周架起滑轮，拼命想把在沙漠中发现的东西拖出来。看监工脸上那副笑容，底下无疑藏着一笔财宝。

你可以立刻进攻，迎战更多敌人；也可以等他们挖完，带着发现的东西离开。}

20469ad91a1b16229a27.source: We'll wait until they're done and the camp is less well defended.
20469ad91a1b16229a27.translation: 等他们忙完，营地守备薄弱时再动手。

ff72993144c528051828.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]{You wait for the nomads to pull the treasure out. As expected, it is a chest. When they break it open there is a hint of satisfaction on their faces. And, as also expected, the nomads split off, with a contingent of their strongest men moving off with the treasure, presumably to sell it somewhere. The nomads' camp is weaker now and far more vulnerable to attack...}
ff72993144c528051828.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_54.png[/img]{你等着游牧民把宝物吊上来。果然，是一只箱子。他们撬开后，脸上都露出了满意的神情。接下来也不出所料，游牧民分了队，一批最强壮的汉子带着宝箱离开，大概是要找地方卖掉。如今留在营地的人少了，攻打起来容易得多……}

f87718a7eca04a2366da.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{The nomads slain, you, naturally, go see what the hell they were digging out of the earth. You stand over the pulley they rigged up and stare into the hole. A chest can be seen with ropes already bound around it. You thank the dead nomads for all the work they've done, then turn to easily pull the chest up and out of the ground. You open it to find...}
f87718a7eca04a2366da.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{游牧民已被杀光，你自然要去看看，他们究竟在挖什么。你站到他们架起的滑轮旁，往坑里望去，看见一只箱子，绳索都已经捆好了。你谢过死去的游牧民替你忙了这么多，随后轻轻松松把箱子吊出地面。打开一看，里面是……}

56dc1f4e730f9a353dd4.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_160.png[/img]{As you prepare to attack, a man suddenly rises up out of the sands. Startled, he jerks away and screams, rolling down the sand dune toward the nomads' camp. You chase after him with a weapon out ready to kill. In your bouncing peripheral you can see the nomads clambering over one another and toppling tents to get to their weapons. When you look back at the spotter, he suddenly disappears in sandy clasp, and the arm attached to the dunes extends out of the earth and rises before you, dust and sand and earth falling off its shapes.

You're hardly able to understand what you're seeing, but the nomads all seem to be screaming the same thing: 'Ifrit! Ifrit! Ifrit!' And this faceless, seemingly endless, 'Ifrit' has no allegiances in the combat to come. | You charge down the dunes at the nomads. Startled, they bark out orders and run for their weapons. As you near the camp, a wave of sand blasts the corner of the camp and a few of the nomads go flying. One second later and a boulder comes sailing out of the dust cloud and pulverizes a nomad entirely. A huge, earthen creature bellows and stomps forward. 'Ifrit! Ifrit!' the nomads scream, and you surmise that this 'Ifrit' will be on no man's side.}
56dc1f4e730f9a353dd4.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_160.png[/img]{你正准备进攻，一个人突然从沙里站了起来。他大吃一惊，猛地后退，尖叫着滚下沙丘，朝游牧民营地跌去。你拔出武器追赶，准备取他性命。奔跑中，余光里尽是游牧民相互推挤、掀倒帐篷抢拿武器的身影。可当你再次看向那个哨兵，他突然被一只沙土巨手攥住，消失不见。连着沙丘的手臂从大地中伸出，在你面前高高抬起，尘土、沙粒和泥块纷纷剥落。

你几乎无法理解眼前的景象，游牧民却都在惊叫同一个名字：“沙魔！沙魔！沙魔！”这个没有面孔、仿佛无穷无尽的“沙魔”，在即将到来的战斗中不属于任何一方。 | 你沿着沙丘向游牧民冲去。他们惊慌地吼着命令，奔向各自的武器。你刚接近营地，一股沙浪突然轰击营地一角，几个游牧民被掀上半空。紧接着，一块巨石从尘云中飞出，将一个游牧民彻底砸碎。巨大的土石怪物咆哮着迈步向前。“沙魔！沙魔！”游牧民放声尖叫。看来，这个“沙魔”不会站在任何人一边。}

655d28e3bf8409536e35.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_165.png[/img]{You charge the camp just in time to see a man in black clothes step out of one of the tents. He is shaking hands with the nomads' leader which is probably not the best sign. Both men pausing mid-handshake and staring at your attack is presumably just as sour a result. The nomad leader calls out, demanding his assassins earn their keep. The blackened killer nods and draws out a blade, and a troop of fellow assassins stream out of the tent in turn to join the nomads in the battle!}
655d28e3bf8409536e35.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_165.png[/img]{你率队冲进营地，正赶上一个黑衣人走出帐篷。他正和游牧民头领握手，这多半不是什么好兆头。两人握手握到一半，同时转头盯着你的进攻，看样子结果同样不妙。游牧民头领高声呼喊，要他的刺客们拿出配得上酬金的本事。黑衣杀手点点头，拔出利刃，一队刺客也接连涌出帐篷，加入游牧民的战阵！}

af29a654d61eafd8dd5d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{Shredded tents. Baskets unwoven. Clothes rolling across the sands. And in the middle of it all sits a man in a black cloak, his ghastly face peering from its hooded shade.%SPEECH_ON%You are both late and right on time.%SPEECH_OFF%He says and gets to his feet. The tarps rustle, the baskets tilt, and the clothes jerk aside, the land riffling with liveliness. Suddenly, the sand slips into cavernous channels and inimical nomads empty from the earth, climbing out, some leaping forth as though to revivify themselves on fresh air, others tilting upward from heel to toe, bodies straight like flagpoles. They move unnervingly, stilted and tilted, and the man in black grins behind their shambling formation. He is no ordinary blaggard, but a necromancer!}
af29a654d61eafd8dd5d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{帐篷被撕烂，篮筐散了架，衣物在沙地上翻滚。残破营地的中央，坐着一个披黑斗篷的男人，兜帽阴影下露出一张鬼气森森的脸。%SPEECH_ON%你们来晚了，却又来得正是时候。%SPEECH_OFF%他说着站起身。篷布沙沙作响，篮筐歪倒，衣物被猛地拨开，整片地面忽然活了起来。沙土陷进一道道深沟，怀着敌意的游牧民从地下爬出。有的猛然跃起，仿佛要借新鲜空气重新活过来；有的则以脚跟为轴，身体如旗杆般笔直竖起。他们摇摇晃晃，动作僵硬得令人发毛。那黑衣人站在蹒跚的队列后，露齿而笑。他可不是普通恶棍，而是一个亡灵法师！}

53d429bbb3ac4a1f30cb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{A servant heads you off from meeting %employer%. He hands you a scroll as well as a satchel. Despite having already handed you the paper, the servant puts his hands behind his back and looks at the ceiling as he recites.%SPEECH_ON%The Crownling is rewarded %reward_completion% crowns as per prior arrangements. Having taken his reward, he is dismissed from the property posthaste.%SPEECH_OFF%The servant looks down at you and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Leave.%SPEECH_OFF%He says. | You try to enter %employer%'s room but a large, scarred guard lowers the business end of a polearm across the door.%SPEECH_ON%No visitors.%SPEECH_OFF%You state that you have business with the Vizier. The guard shakes his head. A servant comes up behind you and puts a satchel in your arms and then departs just as fast. The guard returns the polearm to his side.%SPEECH_ON%Your trivialities with the Vizier concluded when you first departed his presence. You are not to poison his mood any further. Leave. Now. Before you poison mine.%SPEECH_OFF% | As you approach %employer%'s room, a woman claps from across the lobby. You look over and she's already far too close. Four birds perch upon her shoulders and they sway with her every step.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling.%SPEECH_OFF%She produces a satchel and hands it over.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% need not smell you once more, this far into his home is sufficient. Count it if you wish to insult us, leave if you wish to please us.%SPEECH_OFF%She turns on her heels and walks away, her otherworldly dress flowing side to side. One of the birds rotates on her shoulder and squawks at you.}
53d429bbb3ac4a1f30cb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你正要去见%employer%，一个仆人将你拦下，递来一卷文书和一只钱袋。明明已经把纸交给你，他却仍背起双手，望着天花板朗诵起来。%SPEECH_ON%依照先前约定，赏予克朗客%reward_completion%克朗。领取报酬后，即刻离开本府，不得逗留。%SPEECH_OFF%仆人低头看着你，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%走吧。%SPEECH_OFF%他说。 | 你想走进%employer%的房间，一个魁梧、满脸伤疤的卫兵却放低长柄武器，将利刃横在门前。%SPEECH_ON%不见客。%SPEECH_OFF%你说，自己有事找维齐尔。卫兵摇头。一个仆人从你身后走来，把钱袋塞进你怀里，又迅速离开。卫兵把武器收回身侧。%SPEECH_ON%你头一次告退时，跟维齐尔之间那点琐事就已经结束了。不得再败坏他的心情。走，立刻。趁你还没败坏我的心情。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你朝%employer%的房间走去，大厅另一头有个女人拍了拍手。你转头时，她已走得过分近了。四只鸟栖在她肩上，随着步伐左右摇晃。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客。%SPEECH_OFF%她取出一只钱袋，递了过来。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%不必再闻到你的气味。你能进府这么深，已经够了。想侮辱我们，就数数；想讨我们欢心，就离开。%SPEECH_OFF%她脚跟一转，飘然而去，奇异华美的裙摆左右流荡。一只鸟在她肩上转过身，冲你怪叫了一声。}

9c718cc27c2065472d2d.translation: 摧毁了一处游牧民营地

f8be53f66859ebe11c1f.source: Escort caravan to %objective% about %days% to the %direction%
f8be53f66859ebe11c1f.translation: 护送商队前往%objective%：朝%direction%走，约需%days%

282afd743fabcf0ecdeb.source: Provisions for the way are provided to your men
282afd743fabcf0ecdeb.translation: 商队会为弟兄们提供沿途口粮

c8aab3bf969f1971e7d4.source: Get paid for every head of an attacker you slay (%killcount%/%maxcount%)
c8aab3bf969f1971e7d4.translation: 每击杀一名袭击者可获得赏金（%killcount%/%maxcount%）

1b385efa2550eb667b85.source: Get a reward once you arrive

ed17d7130384a62d2d97.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_98.png[/img]{%employer%'s study is lit by a warm fire. He offers you a seat and a goblet of wine, both of which you take.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, you're familiar with how dangerous the roads are these days?%SPEECH_OFF%By the gods, that is some good wine. You nod and try to hide your astonishment. %employer% smiles tersely and continues.%SPEECH_ON%Good, then you'll understand this task I have for you. I need a caravan escorted along the roads to %objective% about %days% from here. Pretty simple, right? Do you have the time for it? Let's talk if you do.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% studying a few maps on his desk. He trails a finger to the edge of one map and continues it onto another.%SPEECH_ON%I need an escort for a caravan to %objective%, %days% %direction% of here. Will it be dangerous? Of course. That's why I go to you, sellsword. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s crosses his arms and purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%Ordinarily I wouldn't ask some sellswords to guard a caravan, but my usual crew is a little out of it - sickness, drunkenness, licentiousness... I think you get it. What's important is that I have important cargo going to %objective% about %days% to the %direction% and I need someone watching it. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% stares out his window, watching a group of men loading cargo into a number of wagons. He talks without looking your way.%SPEECH_ON%I have an important delivery heading out to %objective% roughly %days% %direction% of here. Unfortunately, a competitor outbid me in acquiring a local band of caravan guards. Now I need your services. Let's talk numbers if you're interested.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% grabs a chest off his shelf and puts it on his desk. When he opens it, a bevy of papers pop out, almost scurrying to get free. He grabs one and lays it out. On one side, there's a contract, and the other a small drawing of a map.%SPEECH_ON%It's real simple, sellsword. I have been contracted to deliver some... particular cargo to %objective%. I have the goods, but I don't have the guards. If you're interested in being caravan guards for a time, maybe %days% or so, let me know and we can hash out some numbers.%SPEECH_OFF% | You look out %employer%'s window and watch men load a few wagons with goods. %employer% joins you, two goblets of wine in hand. You take one and drink it all in one swig. The man stares at you.%SPEECH_ON%That wasn't cheap. You're supposed to enjoy it.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Sorry. Can I have another to get it right?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% turns around and goes to his desk.%SPEECH_ON%So, I need a caravan guarded to %objective%. It's %days% to the %direction% of here. Pretty simple, right? There's plenty of crowns in it for you if you're interested.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% looks at some of his books, perusing what appear to be a good deal of numbers.%SPEECH_ON%I got a shipment of particular goods going to %objective% and they're leaving soon. I need a bunch of sturdy swordsmen to help make sure it gets there safely. Should take you about %days% of travelling. Are you up for it?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% cuts right to the point.%SPEECH_ON%I've got a shipment of... well, what it is doesn't concern you. It's going to %objective% and, like many folks, I'm worried about brigands on the road. I need you to watch the caravan to make sure it arrives safe and sound in about %days%. Does that sound something you'd be interested in?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% looks out his window.%SPEECH_ON%We both know that brigands and the gods know what else are terrorizing these parts, and they all are quite fond of the roads. After a particularly bad run, my old caravan guards lost the heart for the job. Now I need someone else to watch my shipment. Next one out is going to %objective% to the %direction%, maybe %days% or so from here. Does that sound like a place you'd like to be paid to go to?%SPEECH_OFF%}
ed17d7130384a62d2d97.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_98.png[/img]{%employer%的书房里炉火温暖。他请你坐下，又递来一杯葡萄酒，你都欣然接受。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，如今路上有多危险，你应该很清楚吧？%SPEECH_OFF%诸神在上，这酒可真不赖。你点点头，尽量掩饰脸上的惊讶。%employer%淡淡一笑，接着说道。%SPEECH_ON%好，那你就明白我为什么要找你了。我需要人护送一支商队，沿大路去%objective%，离这里约有%days%的路程。很简单，对吧？你有空接这活儿吗？有的话，我们就谈谈。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你看见%employer%正俯身研究桌上的几张地图。他的手指划到一张图的边缘，又接着划向另一张。%SPEECH_ON%我需要人护送商队去%objective%，朝%direction%走，约有%days%的路程。危险吗？当然。所以我才找你，佣兵。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%抱起双臂，抿了抿嘴。%SPEECH_ON%平时我不会找佣兵来护送商队，但惯用的那帮人最近不太顶事——病倒的、喝烂醉的、沉迷女人的……你懂吧。总之，我有一批要紧的货物运往%objective%，朝%direction%走约%days%，需要人沿途照看。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%望着窗外，看工人们把货物装上几辆马车。他没有回头，便开了口。%SPEECH_ON%我有一批重要货物要送去%objective%，朝%direction%走，大约%days%就到。可惜竞争对手出价更高，把当地那队商队护卫雇走了。现在，我需要你们。要是有兴趣，我们就谈谈报酬。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%从架子上抱下一只箱子，放到桌上。箱盖一开，大摞文书便挤了出来，像是急着逃走。他抽出一张摊开，一面是契约，另一面画着一幅小地图。%SPEECH_ON%事情很简单，佣兵。有人雇我把一批……特别的货物送到%objective%。货我有了，护卫却还没有。要是你们愿意当一阵商队护卫，大概%days%左右，告诉我，我们就商量价钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你站在%employer%的窗前，看工人往几辆马车上装货。%employer%端着两杯葡萄酒走来，你接过一杯，一口喝干。他瞪着你。%SPEECH_ON%这酒可不便宜。你该慢慢品。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%抱歉。能再给一杯，让我好好品品吗？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%转身走回书桌。%SPEECH_ON%那么，我需要有人护送商队去%objective%。朝%direction%走，离这里约%days%。很简单，对吧？只要你有兴趣，报酬不会少。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%翻着几本账簿，仔细查看上面密密麻麻的数字。%SPEECH_ON%我有一批特别的货物要送到%objective%，很快就出发。我需要一队靠得住的剑士，确保货物平安抵达。路上大约要走%days%。你们能接吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%开门见山。%SPEECH_ON%我有一批货……具体是什么与你无关。货要送去%objective%，而我和其他人一样，担心路上的强盗。我需要你照看商队，确保它在大约%days%后平安抵达。你有兴趣接这活儿吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%望向窗外。%SPEECH_ON%我们都知道，这一带强盗横行，还有些只有诸神才知道是什么的东西，它们都爱盯着大路。上次跑商吃了大亏，我原来的商队护卫已经吓破了胆，不肯再干。现在，我得找别人照看货物。下一批要送去%objective%，在%direction%边，离这里约有%days%的路程。去那里走一趟就能挣钱，你们愿意吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

72e4b8f649389f4a777a.source: {Let's talk money. | How many crowns are we talking about? | What does it pay?}
72e4b8f649389f4a777a.translation: {谈谈报酬吧。 | 你打算出多少克朗？ | 这活儿给多少报酬？}

1ebe90d4d5bf23dd124a.source: {Not interested. | This is not the kind of work we're looking for.}
1ebe90d4d5bf23dd124a.translation: {没兴趣。 | 这不是我们要找的活儿。}

60670a0ab9afc0041952.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_98.png[/img]{Nested in towers and aviaries, bells and birds alike echo in the air like the rattled voluntaries of a caged city. Beneath the noise, in the dull marbled halls of a palace, you find %employer% ordering the death of a servant. The offense is unknown to you, not that it bothers the Vizier in the slightest as he approaches you with a smile and clean hands.%SPEECH_ON%A number of councilmen are sending goods to %objective%, a good %days% to the %direction%. These goods must arrive in a shape that is passable to the awaiting merchants. I believe a Crownling such as yourself can see to this task, yes?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find a few of the councilmen and aldermen of %employer%, the resident Vizier. They approach you with a document stamped with his emblem.%SPEECH_ON%We shall soon be off for to %objective% with a caravan of goods. The city guard refuse to aide us in defending our wares, however we are still bright beneath the Gilder's eye, and our pockets full of shine. We'll pay you, Crownling, to help us to our destination for the next %days%.%SPEECH_OFF% | A servant boy carries a leash of slaves in one hand and a note in the other. He presents the latter which carries written instruction to meet with a set of merchants. They announce that they are traveling to %objective%, around %days% to the %direction%, under orders of the Gilder and Vizier alike, and need protection. For this, your services are needed and will be paid for quite handsomely. | The town's merchant square is rife with business and, apparently, you are wanted to be a part of it. A few of the Vizier's 'finest' peddlers are wanting to take a caravan of goods to %objective%, a good %days% of travel. One explains tersely.%SPEECH_ON%If the Gilder might look the other way, I pray the so-called 'soldiers' of this town find the world of shade. You, Crownling, I suspect you'd be willing to help us where others are not? For coin, of course.%SPEECH_OFF% | You watch as slaves bundle goods and load them into a series of wagons. The caravan's owners spot you and seek you out, pushing their workforce out of the way or smacking them for apparently no reason at all other than it brings some unknown pleasure to do so. One beams with delight as he greets you. He puts one hand out, but you do not shake it.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, Crownling, it is true that this hand has profaned itself with the flesh of an indebted, but you shouldn't be so shy. We are all bright beneath the Gilder's eye, are we not? We've a task for you, one of some import given the governance of our suzerain %employer%. The caravan is heading to %objective%, a good %days%'s travel, and requires a fair bit of guard so that it may arrive in good health. Is this task amenable to your coin-seeking interests?%SPEECH_OFF%}
60670a0ab9afc0041952.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_98.png[/img]{高塔间钟声回荡，鸟舍中鸣声不绝，仿佛整座囚笼般的城市都在喧响。你循着声音走入宫殿昏暗的大理石长廊，正遇见%employer%下令处死一名仆人。你不知道那人犯了什么罪；大臣显然毫不在意，带着微笑走向你，双手仍旧干干净净。%SPEECH_ON%几位议员有一批货物要送去%objective%，朝%direction%走，足有%days%的路程。货物必须完好抵达，好向等候的商人交差。我想，你这样的逐冠客，能办妥这件事吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你遇到了本地大臣%employer%麾下的几位议员和长老。他们带着一份盖有大臣印记的文书走来。%SPEECH_ON%我们很快就要带商队启程，运货去%objective%。城卫军拒绝为货物提供保护，不过，镀金者的目光仍照耀着我们，我们的钱袋也依旧闪闪发亮。逐冠客，我们会付钱，请你在接下来的%days%里护送我们抵达目的地。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一名仆童一手牵着拴奴隶的绳索，一手拿着字条。他递上字条，上面让你去见几名商人。商人们说，奉镀金者与大臣之命，他们要前往%objective%，朝%direction%走约有%days%的路程，需要沿途护卫。他们愿为你的服务支付丰厚报酬。 | 城里的商贸广场买卖兴隆，而显然，也有一笔生意在等你。大臣手下几位“最优秀”的商贩想带一支商队去%objective%，路上足有%days%的行程。其中一人直截了当地说。%SPEECH_ON%但愿镀金者此刻把目光转开，好让我诅咒城里那群所谓的“士兵”坠入阴影之地。逐冠客，别人不愿帮忙，你想必愿意吧？当然，是有报酬的。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你看着奴隶把货物捆好，搬上长长一列马车。商队主人发现了你，便走过来，一路推开挡道的劳工，还不时打上几下，似乎纯粹以此为乐。其中一人满脸堆笑地向你伸手，你没有去握。%SPEECH_ON%啊，逐冠客，这只手确实刚碰过负债之人的皮肉，沾了污秽，但你也不必如此拘谨。镀金者的目光不是平等地照耀着我们吗？我们有件事想请你办，事关我们的尊主%employer%的政务。商队要去%objective%，足有%days%的路程，需要足够的护卫，好让它平安抵达。这桩差事，可合你逐利的心意？%SPEECH_OFF%}

d5aa89b49a3c57aaaba8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{A group of men flying the banner of %noblehouse% appear on the road. Their horses are off to the side, their reins pitched to the dirt. Looks like they've been waiting for you. One of them steps forward, hands on his hips.%SPEECH_ON%You are transporting stolen goods, friends. Stolen goods that belong to %noblehouse%. Hand them over immediately or pay the consequences.%SPEECH_OFF%Hmm, you should have known %employer% would be transporting something fishy. | A few men step out onto the road. They carry the banner of %noblehouse% which probably is not a good sign of what's to come. Their lieutenant confronts you all.%SPEECH_ON%Greetings! Unfortunately, you are transporting stolen goods that belong to %noblehouse%. Step aside from the caravan, turn back, and go the way you came. Do that, and you live. Stay, and you will die here today.%SPEECH_OFF% | Well, it looks like %employer% wasn't completely honest with you: a group of bannermen from %noblehouse% are inquiring as to what you are doing transporting goods that were stolen from them. Their lieutenant shouts at you all.%SPEECH_ON%If you wish to live to see tomorrow, turn over the goods and go back the way you came. I understand you are just doing your jobs. However, your job is not to disobey me. Do that and, I promise, you will all die here today.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man steps out into the road and doesn't appear ready to move. One of the caravan drivers seizes up on his reins and just as he does, a large group of other armed men join the loner on the road. They carry the sigil of %noblehouse%.%SPEECH_ON%So, this is where %noblehouse%'s goods have gone. You fellas are transporting goods which belong to our noble house. If you wish to live, turn them all over. If you wish to die, well, just don't do what I ask and see what happens.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% walks up to you, whispering.%SPEECH_ON%We shouldn't have trusted that rat %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF% | You really should push harder to learn what you are transporting. A group of men has accosted you on the road, demanding you turn over the caravan and go back the way you came. When you inquire as to whom exactly is making this demand, they state they are from %noblehouse% and that every good you are transporting was stolen a week ago. Their lieutenant makes the option for a peaceful passage clear.%SPEECH_ON%Leave and you shall live. I have no qualms with you people, only with your taskmaster. However, you impede our reacquisitions here and you shall die. Don't die over goods that don't belong to you. It's not worth it.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d5aa89b49a3c57aaaba8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{一队打着%noblehouse%旗号的人出现在路上。他们的马拴在路旁，缰绳系着钉入泥地的木桩，看样子已经等候多时。其中一人叉着腰走上前。%SPEECH_ON%朋友，你们运的是赃物，属于%noblehouse%的赃物。马上交出来，否则后果自负。%SPEECH_OFF%嗯，你早该想到，%employer%运的东西恐怕不干净。 | 几个人走到路中央，打着%noblehouse%的旗号。这多半不是什么好兆头。带队的军官朝你们喊话。%SPEECH_ON%各位好！很遗憾，你们正在运送从%noblehouse%偷来的货物。离开商队，转身，原路返回。照办，就能活着离开；留下，今天就死在这里。%SPEECH_OFF% | 看来，%employer%没有对你说实话：一队%noblehouse%的家兵拦住了你们，质问你们为何运送从他们那里偷来的货物。带队的军官高声喝道。%SPEECH_ON%想活到明天，就交出货物，原路返回。我知道你们只是拿钱办事。但违抗我可不在你们的差事里。真要这么做，我保证，你们今天全得死在这里。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个人走到路中央，丝毫没有让开的意思。车夫刚拉紧缰绳，一大群武装人员便来到那人身旁。他们佩着%noblehouse%的纹章。%SPEECH_ON%原来%noblehouse%的货物被运到这儿来了。各位，你们运的东西属于我们的贵族家族。想活，就全部交出来；想死，那就别照办，看看会有什么下场。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%走到你身旁，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%我们就不该相信%employer%那只老鼠。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你真该坚持问清楚自己护送的究竟是什么。一群人拦住去路，要求你交出商队，原路返回。你问究竟是谁提出这种要求，对方声称来自%noblehouse%，你们运的每件货物，都是一周前失窃的赃物。军官把和平离开的条件说得很清楚。%SPEECH_ON%离开，就能活。我和你们无冤无仇，要找的是雇你们的人。但谁妨碍我们收回失物，谁就得死。别为不属于自己的货物送命，不值得。%SPEECH_OFF%}

06136d898775c209be2f.source: I don't think so. We'll defend it if need be.
06136d898775c209be2f.translation: 恐怕不行。必要时，我们会战斗到底。

b4cbad2e83df816e4708.source: We aren't paid enough to make enemies of %noblehouse%. Take them.
b4cbad2e83df816e4708.translation: 这点钱还不值得让我们与%noblehouse%为敌。货物归你们了。

4b19525ba088459de884.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{You nod.%SPEECH_ON%That sounds well and all, but unfortunately we are being paid to protect these goods, not figure out who they belong to.%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenant also nods, almost understandingly.%SPEECH_ON%Alright then.%SPEECH_OFF%He draws out his sword. You draw out yours. The man holds up his hand, ready to give the order.%SPEECH_ON%A shame it came to this. Charge!%SPEECH_OFF% | You draw out your sword.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not here to parlay between noble houses. I'm here to guard this caravan to %objective%. If you want to get in the way of that then, yes, some people are going to die here today.%SPEECH_OFF% | You throw your hands toward the line of wagons.%SPEECH_ON%%employer%'s ordered that I guard his goods to their destination. That's just what I plan to do.%SPEECH_OFF%Looking at the lieutenant, you slowly unsheathe your sword. He does the same, nodding.%SPEECH_ON%A shame it has to come to this.%SPEECH_OFF%}
4b19525ba088459de884.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%你说得倒在理。可惜，我们拿钱是来保护货物的，不是来查它们归谁。%SPEECH_OFF%军官也点了点头，仿佛能够理解。%SPEECH_ON%那好吧。%SPEECH_OFF%他拔出剑，你也一样。他举起手，准备下令。%SPEECH_ON%真遗憾，竟然走到了这一步。冲锋！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你拔出剑。%SPEECH_ON%我不是来替贵族家族调解纠纷的。我来这里，是要护送商队抵达%objective%。你们若执意挡路，那今天确实会有人死在这里。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你摊开手，指向身后的车队。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%雇我把他的货物护送到目的地。我正打算照约办事。%SPEECH_OFF%你看着军官，缓缓拔剑。他也拔出剑，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%真可惜，非得走到这一步。%SPEECH_OFF%}

693d9fd85d1fefabf739.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%employer% isn't going to like this, but if he was shipping stolen goods he should have told you. With a flick of your hand, you order your men to step aside. The bannermen immediately converge on the caravan, unloading its goods while hapless daytalers and merchants watch on. | You're not going to have a nasty fight over goods you could care less about. Stepping aside, you invite the bannermen to take the goods that rightfully belong to them. %randombrother% says %employer% won't be happy about this. You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Well, that's his problem.%SPEECH_OFF% | You're not in the market of transporting stolen goods or killing bannermen who have no qualm with you. Against the protest of a few merchants, you step aside, letting the caravan and its goods return to its rightful owners. One merchant shakes his fist, letting you know that %employer% will be most unhappy to hear you did not own up to your contract.}
693d9fd85d1fefabf739.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{%employer%肯定不会高兴，但既然运的是赃物，他就该提前说清楚。你一挥手，命令手下让开。家兵立刻围住商队，卸下货物，倒霉的短工和商人只能在一旁干瞪眼。 | 你可不打算为一批毫不在乎的货物打一场恶仗。你退到路旁，让家兵拿回本就属于他们的东西。%randombrother%说，%employer%肯定不会高兴。你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%那就是他的事了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你不做护送赃物的生意，也不想杀那些与你无冤无仇的家兵。几个商人的抗议毫无用处，你让到一旁，把商队和货物交还给原主。一名商人挥着拳头，嚷嚷说%employer%要是听说你没履行契约，一定会大发雷霆。}

57067c0ebaf62bf84c82.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{You tell the men that you are good friends with their %noblehouse% and have no intention of souring those relations. One of the attackers is given pause.%SPEECH_ON%Dammit, he could be lying, but if he ain't... this isn't worth the trouble. Let's get out of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | With a few terse words, you tell the men that you're quite familiar with the %noblehouse% family, naming a few of the lineage by name. The men settle their swords, not wishing to muddy the situation any further. Better safe than sorry in this world. | You let the men know that you're in good with the %noblehouse% family. They ask you to prove it, and you do by telling them every noble name you can, and a little about the particular proclivities of some of them. The proof is sufficient - the attackers put down their weapons and leave you alone.}
