The townsman and firstborn embrace like the telling of two separate dreams of identical circumstance, slowly coming together despite the appeals of reality. Finally, they hug and clench one another and pause to stare at one another to be sure it's all real. You tell %employer% that every witch is dead, but that he should keep the tale to himself. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Spirits feed on hubris, I know that much, and I shall take this story to the grave. I thank you for what you've done today, sellsword. I thank you to such lengths you could not possibly know. I've but one way to express my appreciation.%SPEECH_OFF%He brings you a satchel of gold. The sight of the bag bulging with coin brings a warm smile to your face. | %protectee% runs from your side and into the arms of %employer%. The townsman looks over his firstborn's shoulders.%SPEECH_ON%So it's done then, we are free of the curse?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and respond.%SPEECH_ON%You're free of the witches.%SPEECH_OFF%The townsman purses his lips and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Well, that's good enough. Your payment is over there in the satchel, as much as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b3870a7ca534fa41e952.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{%employer%抱住%protectee%，将长子紧紧搂在怀里，抬眼看向你。%SPEECH_ON%这么说，都结束了？那些女巫全死了？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，镇长也跟着点头。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢！谢谢你，佣兵！%SPEECH_OFF%他指向房间角落的一只箱子，里面装满了给你的报酬。 | 你将%protectee%送回%employer%身边。镇长与长子缓缓靠近，仿佛两场情景相同却各自独立的梦，迟迟不肯相信眼前已是现实。终于，两人拥抱，紧紧抓住彼此，又停下来互相端详，确认一切都是真的。你告诉%employer%，女巫已全部死去，不过，这件事最好不要对外声张。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%精怪以人的傲慢为食，这点我懂。我会把这件事带进坟墓。佣兵，谢谢你今天所做的一切。我的感激有多深，你大概永远也想不到。不过，我能拿来表达的，只有一样东西。%SPEECH_OFF%他给你拿来一袋金币。看见袋子被硬币撑得鼓鼓的，你脸上也浮起了温暖的笑。 | %protectee%从你身边跑开，扑进%employer%的怀里。镇长越过长子的肩膀，望着你。%SPEECH_ON%这么说，结束了？我们摆脱诅咒了？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，回答道：%SPEECH_ON%你们摆脱女巫了。%SPEECH_OFF%镇长抿起嘴唇，点头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，这就够了。报酬在那边的袋子里，答应多少，就是多少。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1d73a4c506e69acaf73b.source: All worked out in the end.

ebde8e2efee5ef8d535a.source: and struck a deal with witches

4010263a6731a4083bf0.translation: 追猎附近的林德蠕龙，地点：

9f0525dcb0d1ac4f18ac.source: A Lindwurm - a wingless bipedal dragon resembling a giant snake.
9f0525dcb0d1ac4f18ac.translation: 一条林德蠕龙：双足无翼，形如巨蛇的龙。

e29b694c65eb5e6b1471.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_77.png[/img]{%employer% is staring into a basket when you find him. A few peasants are off in the corner scratching themselves and looking rather tense. You ask what is going on. Your potential employer brings you over to the basket and inside you find a snake slithering about. It's a docile one, and the colors aren't arranged in a manner to suggest it carries poison in its belly. You tell him as much. He shrugs and closes the lid.%SPEECH_ON%Gonna kill it and eat it anyhow, take its skin for a dagger sheath. What I need you to do is go find a much larger snake than this. I'm talking lindwurms, sellsword. Bigguns. Roaming about, eating folks in the hinterland. You the kind to see this situation sorted?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% mucking about his personal library that's more cobweb than knowledge. He seems to sense your entrance and asks if you know about lindwurms. Before you can answer he wheels around, scroll in hand.%SPEECH_ON%I need you to go out to the hinterland. We got a couple of them monsters on our hands. They're killing farmers, peddlers. Hell, some of those folks were even well liked. I figure you'd be just the man we'd need to get these beasts off our backs. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF%You see his scroll unfurl a bit to reveal a crudely drawn woman and her exposed breast. The man hurriedly rolls it back up and stows it behind his back. He smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Well are ya?%SPEECH_OFF% | A line of peasants stand outside %employer%'s door. You cut by them all and when a few protest you grab the handle on your sword. %employer% jumps out of his door and intervenes.%SPEECH_ON%Ease up, ease up everyone. This is the mercenary I wanted to hire. Sir, please, let me explain the short tempers. Lindwurms are ravaging the countryside and we need a strapping sellsword such as yourself to slay them all. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF%The once angry peons now stare at you as though you were a savior.}
e29b694c65eb5e6b1471.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_77.png[/img]{你找到%employer%时，他正盯着一只篮子。角落里的几个农民不停抓挠身体，神色紧张。你问出了什么事，这位潜在雇主便把你领到篮边。里面有条蛇，正在游动。它很温顺，身上的花色看着也不像有毒。你把判断告诉他，他耸耸肩，盖上篮盖。%SPEECH_ON%反正要杀来吃，皮还能做个匕首鞘。不过，我要你找的蛇，比这条大得多。我说的是林德蠕龙，佣兵，大家伙。在郊野游荡，吃人。你有没有本事把这事解决？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正在自己的藏书室里翻找东西，那里似乎蛛网比学问还多。他察觉你进来，便问你知不知道林德蠕龙。还没等你回答，他就拿着一卷卷轴转过身。%SPEECH_ON%我要你去一趟乡下。来了几只怪物，杀农民，也杀小贩。见鬼，那里面甚至还有几个挺招人喜欢的。我觉得，要让这些野兽别再缠着我们，你正是合适的人。感兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他手里的卷轴松开一点，露出一幅画工拙劣的女人像，胸部袒露。男人连忙卷紧，将它藏到背后，笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%那么，有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 农民在%employer%的门外排成长队。你径直越过众人，几个人出声抗议，你便握住剑柄。%employer%连忙从门里冲出，打圆场。%SPEECH_ON%都消消气，消消气。这就是我要雇的佣兵。先生，请让我解释，大家为什么这么暴躁。林德蠕龙正在乡间肆虐，我们需要像你这样强健的佣兵，把它们全杀了。你有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF%刚才还愤怒不已的农民，如今却望着你，仿佛看见了救星。}

ff2d77e4b092deeb389a.source: {That's a mighty big task you're asking of us. | I expect to be well compensated to fight an enemy such as this. | I expect you to make me a rich man for this.}
ff2d77e4b092deeb389a.translation: {你让我们接的，可是个大活儿。 | 要对付这样的敌人，报酬必须丰厚。 | 这趟差事，我可指望着发笔财。}

e6d574582e42c72eaab1.source: {Sounds more like what you need are heroes and fools. | It's not worth the risk. | I don't think so.}
e6d574582e42c72eaab1.translation: {听起来，你需要的更像是英雄和傻子。 | 不值得冒险。 | 恐怕不行。}

52bf611b6d9b65153c7a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]{%randombrother% holds a sleeve of scaly skin at the length of his weapon. He wiggles it around, the shedding scratching itself in dry rasps. You tell him to put it down and to be on guard. The lindwurms are no doubt close. | %randombrother% states that he once heard the story of a lindwurm that killed someone without eating them.%SPEECH_ON%That's right. They said it spewed green water and the man just melted into his own boots. Said it looked like soup with his shins for stirring.%SPEECH_OFF%A disgusting tale, but one that hopefully keeps the men rightfully on their toes. Those lindwurms can't be far. | The tracks have the grass flattened in a snaking pattern with holes set to the sides. %randombrother% crouches beside the patterns.%SPEECH_ON%Either a plough with no dig or this be the critters we're lookin' for.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The lindwurms can't be far.}
52bf611b6d9b65153c7a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]{%randombrother%用武器挑着一截筒状的鳞皮，来回晃动，干燥的蛇蜕彼此摩擦，发出沙沙声。你叫他放下，保持警惕。林德蠕龙肯定就在附近。 | %randombrother%说，他曾听过一个故事：有条林德蠕龙杀了人，却没吃。%SPEECH_ON%没错。听说它喷出绿水，那人就化在自己的靴子里了。像一锅汤，两根胫骨正好拿来搅。%SPEECH_OFF%故事恶心得很，不过，也希望它能让弟兄们打起应有的精神。那些林德蠕龙不会离得太远。 | 地上的草被压出蜿蜒的蛇形痕迹，两侧还有一个个凹坑。%randombrother%蹲下来察看。%SPEECH_ON%要么是有张不翻土的犁从这儿经过，要么就是咱们要找的家伙。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。林德蠕龙不会离得太远。}

9614c3fe5480f1e548bf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_129.png[/img]{You're checking the map when %randombrother% calls out. Looking up, you see the lindwurms emerging from a hole in the ground, great sheets of dust streaming off their sides. Their bodies sway low to the ground as they whip their way toward the %companyname%. You draw out your sword and order the men into formation. | The company comes upon a cave lined with boulders at its front. But as you draw near, the rocks uncoil and flip mid-air and legs shoot out their bellies to plant the landings of what are clearly lindwurms. You step back as the beasts wriggle the dust off their backs and snap their maws with guttural croaking. They turn to you, eyes blinking, and begin to lazily come forward as though your mercenaries were but a minor inconvenience to dispatch. You order the company into formation. The monsters, perhaps sensing you're more of a threat, suddenly surge forward, powerfully hissing as their bodies sidewinder over the ground with surprising speed. | The %companyname% steps toward a hill with bones crunching under every step. %randombrother% shushes the company and points to the hilltop. Lindwurms are curved about its crest as though to embroider the very earth. Seemingly sensing your stare, the beasts unfurl and slumber down the slope, some half twisting like children rolling down a hill. Their maws clap and snap, tongues licking the dust out of their eyes, altogether looking like sleepwalking critters more than murderous monsters. But the second their feet step upon the flat earth they seize up and bolt forward, their snaky shapes streaking across the boneyard, powdered bonemeal rooster tailing up in their wake. Drawing your sword, you urgently order the men to formation.}
9614c3fe5480f1e548bf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_129.png[/img]{你正察看地图，%randombrother%忽然喊了起来。抬头一看，林德蠕龙正从地洞中钻出，大片尘土沿身体两侧倾泻而下。它们贴地摆动身躯，鞭子般抽甩着，向%companyname%扑来。你拔剑，命令弟兄们列阵。 | 战团发现一处洞穴，洞口前排着几块巨石。可走近之后，石头竟舒展开来，在半空翻转，腹下伸出双腿，稳稳落地。那分明是林德蠕龙。你后退一步，看着怪物扭动身体，抖去背上尘土，大口开合，喉中发出沙哑的低鸣。它们转向你，眨眨眼，懒洋洋地向前走来，仿佛这些佣兵不过是随手就能打发的小麻烦。你命令战团列阵。怪物也许察觉到你们并不好惹，忽然厉声嘶鸣，猛冲上前。蛇一般的身躯侧摆着掠过地面，速度快得惊人。 | %companyname%走向一座小丘，每踏一步，脚下便有碎骨咔嚓作响。%randombrother%示意众人安静，伸指指向丘顶。几条林德蠕龙盘在那里，像是缀在大地上的纹饰。仿佛察觉到你的注视，怪物舒展开身子，睡意未消地滑下坡来。有的扭着身体半滚半滑，活像从山坡上滚下的孩子。它们张嘴咂动，吐舌舔去眼中的沙尘，看着更像梦游的小兽，而非杀人的怪物。可双脚一踏上平地，它们便猛地绷紧，疾冲而来。蛇形长躯飞掠过骸骨堆，身后扬起扇状的骨粉。你拔出剑，急忙喝令弟兄们列阵。}

8d0c4aab8924145e00db.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{You find the lindwurms slithering about a dugout in the ground, but before you can go to battle a man interrupts you with a humanly hiss. He looks like he hasn't shaved in days and he's got a fat satchel yoked over both shoulders and a bandana bunches up his hair like potted sagebrush. Aside from his haggard looks there isn't a weapon on him. You ask what he wants. He speaks hurriedly and in a hushed tone.%SPEECH_ON%You here to kill the lindwurms?%SPEECH_OFF%The nasty snakelike monsters are wriggling around in the distance, seemingly playing with one another like puppies or kittens would. You nod and tell him they're killers and you've been paid to slay them all. The man purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON% See that gleam in their coat? That's unique to them, and they are the last of their kind. These are rarified lindwurms, sir, and it'd be a horrid ruin upon the world itself for them to be made wholly nonexistent. How about I give you %bribe% crowns and, uh, you was paid by someone, right? So you take this, too.%SPEECH_OFF%He pulls a great, scratchy lindwurm skinsuit out of his satchel and offers to hand it over.%SPEECH_ON%Tell your employer you'd found and killed the lindwurms and show them this. They won't know the difference. And if you think about doublecrossing me here let me say this, I look a hint of crazy but I'm actually a barrel of it. And a crazy fark like myself wouldn't survive following these giant, wonderful, and beautiful lindwurms around if he didn't know a thing or two, got it?%SPEECH_OFF%}
8d0c4aab8924145e00db.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{你发现林德蠕龙在一处土坑周围游动，正要开战，一个男人却模仿着蛇嘶，出声拦住了你。他似乎好几天没刮胡子，双肩背着鼓鼓的袋子，头巾将头发拢成一蓬，活像盆里栽的蒿草。除了形容憔悴，他身上连一件武器也没有。你问他想干什么。他压低声音，急急说道：%SPEECH_ON%你们来杀林德蠕龙？%SPEECH_OFF%远处，那些丑恶的蛇形怪物正扭动身躯，像小猫小狗般彼此嬉戏。你点头，告诉他，这些东西会杀人，你收了钱，要将它们尽数消灭。男人抿起嘴。%SPEECH_ON%看见它们鳞皮上的光泽了吗？那是它们独有的，而它们已经是最后的一群了。先生，这是极其罕见的林德蠕龙。若让它们彻底绝迹，对这个世界将是多么可怕的损失。这样吧，我给你%bribe%克朗。还有，呃，是有人付钱雇你来的，对吧？那你把这个也拿上。%SPEECH_OFF%他从袋子里拉出一件又大又扎手的蠕龙皮衣，递向你。%SPEECH_ON%告诉雇主，你已经找到并杀死了林德蠕龙，再把这个给他看。他们分不出来。你若打算拿了东西再出卖我，我先说明白：我看着有点疯，实际上是疯透了。我这种疯子，若没点本事，跟着这些巨大、美妙又漂亮的林德蠕龙到处跑，早就活不到今天了。懂吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

58eda083bd14fc02a157.source: Out of the way, fool. We have a beast to slay.
58eda083bd14fc02a157.translation: 让开，蠢货。我们还要去猎杀巨兽。

178246e676b6550ef30b.source: Very well. I accept your offer.

b69bcc528630c680878e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{The way you see it the lindwurms here are not truly your problem, you were just paid to take care of them. And you could potentially get paid twice if the crazy lindwurm protector's skinsuit fools %employer%.

You take the deal. The fool thanks you and hugs you unexpectedly. He smells awful and his hair has become so matted and thick that tiny little bugs have bored out caves there and can be seen staring at you. A tiny skink scuttles between the stinky stalks and snatches one of the bugs. You throw the man back and wish him luck in whatever the hell he's doing. He puts out his thumb and pinky finger and wags the hand.%SPEECH_ON%You, sir, are righteous.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b69bcc528630c680878e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{在你看来，这里的林德蠕龙本来就不算你的麻烦，你只是收钱办事。若这个护龙疯子给的皮衣能骗过%employer%，你兴许还能拿到两份报酬。

你答应了交易。那傻子连声道谢，冷不防抱住了你。他臭得厉害，头发又厚又结，细小的虫子竟在里面蛀出了洞，正从洞口盯着你。一只小石龙子在臭烘烘的发丛间爬过，叼走了一只虫。你把男人推开，祝他不管在折腾什么，都能走运。他伸出拇指和小指，晃了晃手。%SPEECH_ON%先生，你真仗义。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a90efad468dde0849819.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_129.png[/img]{Dust clouds belch from a distant cave entrance. As you draw near, you can hear the hiss of the lindwurms and intermittent growling of something else entirely.%SPEECH_ON%Look, sir!%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% points to the rim of the cave dugout. There's a pair of nachzehrers tackling a lindwurm, one being slung around as it holds onto the tail, the other is hand fighting its maw to not get bit. The monsters are fighting one another!

Shaking your head, you draw out your sword and order the men into formation. Looks like this is going to be a proper barnstormer if there ever was one.}
a90efad468dde0849819.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_129.png[/img]{远处的洞口喷出滚滚尘土。走近之后，你听见林德蠕龙的嘶鸣，还夹杂着另一种截然不同的低吼。%SPEECH_ON%团长，快看！%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%指向洞口边缘。两只食尸鬼正围攻一条林德蠕龙：一只死死抓着尾巴，被甩来甩去；另一只则用双手抵住巨口，拼命不让它咬下。这些怪物竟然打起来了！

你摇摇头，拔出剑，命令弟兄们列阵。看来，这回真要闹个天翻地覆了。}

a1965cd16a811fbae5a1.source: I don't know if this is good or bad.

bf016f698c6187cbb2f5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{You spot a merchant and his wagon trundling up the road. The rear of the wagon lifts upward and the caravan hand on the back is launched like a ragdoll. A streak of green slips behind the caravan and another goes to the side. The merchant turns and jumps into the wagon as lindwurms start their assault. These are no doubt the creatures you've been looking for. At your command, the %companyname% can rush forward before the caravan is destroyed.}
bf016f698c6187cbb2f5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{你看见一个商人赶着货车沿路行进。车尾突然翘起，后面的商队杂工像布娃娃般被掀飞。一道绿影从车后闪过，另一道掠向侧面。商人转身跳进货车，林德蠕龙已发起攻击。毫无疑问，这正是你们要找的怪物。只要你下令，%companyname%就能赶在商队覆灭前冲上去。}

91f63124c1b1e3909827.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{The battle is over. You have the men skin a few of the lindwurms while you go and talk to the merchant. He bows in thanks and kisses your ringless finger.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sir, thank you! Ohhh, my wagon! My goods!%SPEECH_OFF%His eyes twist away to the remains of his caravan. He collapses, his knees in the debris, and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I wish I had anything to pay you with, stranger, but it's all gone.%SPEECH_OFF%But then he holds a finger up. He jumps back to his feet and asks if you have a map. You show what you got, and he takes out a quill pen.%SPEECH_ON%Here, I know of a spot that is said to hold great treasure. I don't know if that's true or not, but the rumor's as good as gold if it is!%SPEECH_OFF%Yeah, if. You thank the merchant for his generosity anyway and wish him better luck on his journey ahead. As for the %companyname%, it needs to return to %employer% to get paid.}
91f63124c1b1e3909827.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{战斗结束，你让弟兄们剥下几条林德蠕龙的皮，自己去找商人说话。他躬身道谢，亲吻了你那根连戒指都没有的手指。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢您，大人，谢谢！啊，我的货车！我的货！%SPEECH_OFF%他目光一转，看向商队的残骸，顿时跪倒在废墟里，连连摇头。%SPEECH_ON%陌生人，我真想拿点什么酬谢您，可一切都没了。%SPEECH_OFF%忽然，他竖起一根手指，跃起身来，问你有没有地图。你拿出地图，他则取出羽毛笔。%SPEECH_ON%这里，我知道一个地方，据说藏着大笔财宝。我不知道是真是假，可若是真的，这消息就值金子！%SPEECH_OFF%没错，得是真的才行。不过，你还是谢过商人的慷慨，祝他往后的路能走运些。至于%companyname%，该回去找%employer%领钱了。}

bc0e1e144f11ec9ba197.source: We should pay a visit to that place one day.
bc0e1e144f11ec9ba197.translation: 改天应该去那地方看看。

b4eeb0583da07b754da6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{The battle is over. You have half your men go about skinning the lindwurms to show %employer% when you get back. The other half sift through the remains of the merchant's caravan. There is nothing of note to find, not even gold. Anything of value has been smashed to pieces in the fighting. The merchant himself has been torn in half and the legs sit a way away with their pockets turned out and empty, %randombrother% squatting beside the remains. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Well, that's a sorry way to go. Broke and even more broke.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod back and then holler at the men to pack their things. It's time to return to your employer and collect your pay.}
b4eeb0583da07b754da6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{战斗结束，你让一半弟兄去剥林德蠕龙的皮，带回去给%employer%过目；另一半则搜查商队残骸。可没什么值得拿的，连金币都没有。值钱的东西全在战斗中被砸得粉碎。商人本人也被撕成两半，双腿落在远处，口袋翻在外面，空空如也。%randombrother%蹲在尸体旁，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%真是个惨死法。钱袋空了，身子也散了。%SPEECH_OFF%你也点点头，随后大声吩咐弟兄们收拾东西。该回雇主那里领报酬了。}

2c5b37bad3e4db3ff6bb.source: At least we put an end to those beasts.
2c5b37bad3e4db3ff6bb.translation: 至少我们除掉了那些畜生。

dce0b4685ad9bda99381.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_130.png[/img]{Fighting the lindwurms was like taking a butterknife and jabbing it into a basket of vipers. They fought like something from another world, hissing and spewing and biting, but they were no match for the %companyname%'s resolve and skill. You have the men scalp and skin the creatures and ready them for a return to %employer% for a well earned payday. | The lindwurms lay in well earned ruin. Your company goes about poking the corpses at a distance, making sure the bastards are truly dead. A few gargle and flip over, but that's about the last of their living issuances. You order the overgrown lizards scalped and skinned. %employer% will be expecting proof, after all. | You crouch beside a lindwurm and take your hand over its skin. The way you figure, the scales are long and sharp enough to cut your fingers off if jammed in between the wedges. You then stand akimbo over the head and stare into its maw, getting a measure of its teeth with your hands and its gullet with the steel of your sword. %randombrother% comes to your side and asks what they're to do next. You unsheathe your sword from the lindwurm's throat, wipe it clean, and sheathe it proper. You order the men to skin a few of the beasts and ready a return to %employer%. | The battle over, you have the lindwurms skinned and dressed for anything of value. It isn't long for the field to stink of the skinks, the overly large lizards being shorn of the scales that once protected them. Their sickly, glistening musculature bared for all to see, a nakedness and vulnerability is wrought upon the once and always monsters. %randombrother% snorts and runs a sleeve beneath his nose. He nods at his handiwork.%SPEECH_ON%Nothing more than a common creature, just a shade larger than it ought to be.%SPEECH_OFF%Damn right. You order the men to collect what they've got and ready a return to %employer%.}
dce0b4685ad9bda99381.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_130.png[/img]{与林德蠕龙搏斗，简直像拿一把黄油刀，往满筐毒蛇里乱戳。它们嘶鸣、喷吐、撕咬，凶暴得仿佛来自另一个世界，却终究敌不过%companyname%的决心与身手。你让弟兄们割下头皮，剥取兽皮，准备回去见%employer%，领取这份浴血挣来的报酬。 | 林德蠕龙终于得到了应有的下场。弟兄们隔着距离，用武器戳探尸体，确认这些混账真的死了。有几条喉中咕噜作响，身子翻转，可那已是最后的挣扎。你命令割下这些大得过头的蜥蜴的头皮，再剥取兽皮。毕竟，%employer%还等着看凭证。 | 你蹲在一条林德蠕龙旁，将手悬在鳞皮上方。那些鳞片又长又利，你估摸着，手指若卡进缝里，足以被切断。随后，你叉腰站在它头前，打量巨口，用手比量牙齿，再拿剑探入喉咙，估量深浅。%randombrother%走到身旁，问接下来该做什么。你从蠕龙喉中拔出剑，擦净，这才插回真正的剑鞘。你命令弟兄们剥下几条怪物的皮，准备回去见%employer%。 | 战斗结束，你让人将林德蠕龙剥皮开膛，取走一切值钱的部位。没过多久，战场便弥漫起蜥蜴般的腥臭。那些巨大的身躯失去了曾经保护它们的鳞皮，露出湿亮、病态的肌肉。这些始终骇人的怪物，如今也显出赤裸而脆弱的模样。%randombrother%哼了一声，用袖子擦过鼻下，朝自己的手艺点点头。%SPEECH_ON%说到底，也就是普通野兽，只是长得太大了些。%SPEECH_OFF%说得没错。你吩咐弟兄们收好东西，准备回去见%employer%。}

7a42f206cfc324d8a71a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_77.png[/img]{You enter %employer%'s room dragging in some lindwurm flesh. He looks up from his desk, eyes the scales and long sleeve of reptilian skin, glances at you, then glances at his paymaster and gives a steady nod. The paymaster takes a satchel of crowns and hands them over. %employer% returns to his work, addressing you as he writes with a quill.%SPEECH_ON%Good work, sellsword. Reports of the bastards has died off in total, so I wager our money here has been put to good use. Leave the skin. I've a man who can fix up some mean boots with it.%SPEECH_OFF%Did the %companyname% just work to get this fool new boots? You shake your head and make your leave. | %employer% welcomes you and your booty, a long, scratchy, scaly, scraping piece of lindwurm skin. You heave it across the floor where it skitters like a stiff leather jacket. The mayor nods.%SPEECH_ON%Very, very well done, good sir! Most excellent. Your pay, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%The man hands you a satchel heavy with well earned crowns. | %employer% is found warming himself beside a fire. He turns around in the seat to see the lindwurm flesh you have brought in with you. The mayor nods.%SPEECH_ON%Quite alright work, sellsword. I'm curious, do the lizard bastards grow their limbs back? I've heard tales of the reptilian sort carrying such tricks.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and state each creature was slain with as much scientific curiosity a good sword can muster. %employer% purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%Ah. Right. Well your pay is in the corner there, as much as agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF%He returns to the fire, cozying himself up in a blanket and sipping at the lip of a steamy mug. | %employer% is found outside and surrounded by raucous peasants. You yell over the crowd and display the lindwurm skin which you've brought. The crowd quiets for a moment, whispers amongst its numbers, then returns to shouting. You purse your lips and elbow your way into the mob and demand the pay which you are owed. %employer% yells at the peons to spread out and let him breathe. While two guards stand close, he hands you a leather satchel.%SPEECH_ON%Good work, sellsword. If it ain't all there feel free to come back and kill me. I won't mind, not on this damned day.%SPEECH_OFF%As you take the satchel and leave, a peasant jabs his finger at the mayor.%SPEECH_ON%Tellin' ya, that damned bastard, my supposed 'neighborly neighbor', stole my birds and if he don't return them I'mma burn his whole farm to the farkin' ground!%SPEECH_OFF%}
7a42f206cfc324d8a71a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_77.png[/img]{你拖着一截林德蠕龙皮肉，走进%employer%的房间。他从桌后抬头，看看鳞片和那条长长的爬虫皮，再看看你，最后望向军饷官，郑重地点了点头。军饷官拿来一袋克朗，交给你。%employer%继续忙自己的事，一边用羽毛笔书写，一边开口。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，佣兵。那些混账出没的报告已经彻底停了，看来，我们的钱花得很值。皮留下。我认识个人，能用它做双漂亮靴子。%SPEECH_OFF%%companyname%这么卖命，就是为了给这傻子挣双新靴子？你摇摇头，告辞离开。 | %employer%迎接你和你的战利品：一大条粗糙扎手、布满鳞片的林德蠕龙皮。你用力将它甩过地板，硬皮像件僵硬的皮衣，擦着地面滑出去。镇长点头。%SPEECH_ON%先生，干得好，太好了！真出色。这是答应你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%他递来一只沉甸甸的钱袋，里面的克朗都是你凭本事挣来的。 | %employer%正在炉火边取暖。他在椅子上转过身，看见你带来的林德蠕龙皮肉，点头说道：%SPEECH_ON%干得不错，佣兵。我有点好奇，这些蜥蜴混账，断掉的肢体还能再长出来吗？听说有些爬虫会这手本事。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，说每一只都已被杀死，至于研究精神，你的好剑能拿出多少，你就拿出了多少。%employer%抿了抿嘴。%SPEECH_ON%啊，好吧。报酬就在那边角落，按说好的数目给。%SPEECH_OFF%他又转回炉火，将毯子裹得更舒适些，啜饮冒着热气的杯中物。 | %employer%正在屋外，被一群吵闹的农民围着。你提高嗓门，盖过人群，举起带来的林德蠕龙皮。人群安静片刻，彼此低语一阵，又继续嚷了起来。你抿起嘴，用胳膊肘挤进去，索要该得的报酬。%employer%喝令众人散开，让他喘口气。两名卫兵贴身站着，他将一只皮钱袋递给你。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，佣兵。要是钱不够，尽管回来杀我。我不介意，至少今天这鬼日子不介意。%SPEECH_OFF%你拿起袋子离开，一个农民正伸手戳向镇长。%SPEECH_ON%我跟你说，那该死的混账，我那所谓的‘好邻居’，偷了我的禽鸟！他要是不还，老子就把他整个农庄烧成灰！%SPEECH_OFF%}

306ed0124dce2c30236a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{You find %employer% in his room and it is full of guards. Not sure what is going on, you display the lindwurm's flesh to the mayor and demand your pay. His fingers clap together before fanning forward like a lumber saw.%SPEECH_ON%I don't think that will be happening, sellsword. I don't know where you got that goddam skinsuit you're carrying, and trust me I can tell it's old as shite and not some new flay, but I'm still getting reports of lizards tearing the hinterlands a new arshole so if you don't mind, please kindly leave this town before I sic a whole different predator upon ya.%SPEECH_OFF%Taking a deep breath, you eye the guards. There's too many to fight off. %employer% sighs.%SPEECH_ON%If it's your honor you're thinking to protect, don't. I already talked these folks down from ambushing your arse the second you were to walk through that door. I did that out of little respect I have left. Don't waste it, hm?%SPEECH_OFF%Fair enough. It is what it is and you've no one else to blame but yourself anyhow. You close the door and take your leave.}
306ed0124dce2c30236a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你走进%employer%的房间，发现里面站满卫兵。弄不清情况，你仍将蠕龙皮肉呈给镇长，要求领钱。他合起双手，随即将手指向前摊开，像展开一排锯齿。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我看，这钱你是拿不到了。我不知道你从哪儿弄来这件该死的皮衣，不过相信我，我看得出它陈年老旧，绝不是刚剥下来的。而那些蜥蜴把乡下祸害得鸡飞狗跳的消息，我到现在还在收。所以，劳烦你赶紧离开镇子，免得我放出另一种猛兽，来找你的麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%你深吸一口气，打量卫兵。人太多，打不过。%employer%叹气道：%SPEECH_ON%如果你想着维护什么荣誉，省省吧。他们本想等你一进门，就直接动手，还是我劝住的。我对你仅剩的那点尊重，都花在这里了。别再浪费，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%倒也没错。事已至此，怪来怪去也只能怪自己。你合上门，告辞离开。}

c62657681978e834f6bb.translation: 替城镇除掉了林德蠕龙

23569f63854bb22dd60a.source: Tried to swindle the town out of money

19f66f1a78bd6160ee66.source: Hunt down what kills people in the desert around
19f66f1a78bd6160ee66.translation: 追猎在附近沙漠杀人的怪物，地点：

c717965e24df79174855.source: Creatures of living stone shaped by the blistering heat and fire of the burning sun of the south.
c717965e24df79174855.translation: 由南方烈日的酷热与火焰塑造的生灵，躯体是有生命的岩石。

aedf62a38c05adc088af.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer% lifts his head and seemingly regards you down the bridge of his nose. It is a powerful sneer, but he does bring you in. The Vizier claps his hands and a servant comes to you with a scroll, unfurls it, and reads.%SPEECH_ON%Ifrits have been spotted in the sands. A Crownling - that is you, traveler - is to....%SPEECH_OFF%The Vizier claps his hands again.%SPEECH_ON%Could be him, servant. That COULD be him. Be mindful with your distinctions.%SPEECH_OFF%You know the servant wants to say he didn't write the scroll, but he keeps that to himself. He finishes the announcement.%SPEECH_ON%...is to be incentivized to dispel the scorching sands back into their natural state. Annihilation of said monsters would be compensated with %reward% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%The scroll rolls back up, the servant catches it at the sides, and he slides back out of scene. You see the Vizier again, but he is not paying attention as a slave girl feeds him grapes. | A Vizier by the name of %employer% greets you, though all the grace in the meeting is entirely invested into the bureaucratic side of the discussion.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, Ifrits stalk the sands. Your services have been summoned to help deal with it. If you do not agree to the compensation of %reward% crowns, then we shall summon ourselves another in your stead.%SPEECH_OFF% | You enter a room to find a number of viziers buried beneath the bodies of slave girls. There is a good deal of giggling and playful skin pulling, but most notably nobody seems to notice you are there. Save for an older man who shuffles over and bows.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, the Vizier %employer% has summoned a Crownling for the task of hunting Ifrits.%SPEECH_OFF%The old man glances over, then straightens up. The next time he speaks it is stripped of the high falutin nonsense.%SPEECH_ON%They're large sandy bastards, and they are tearing up the countryside. I warn you that they are not to be trifled with, so don't let all this show of pomp and gold fool you into tackling something you shouldn't. %reward% crowns are on the table if you accept.%SPEECH_OFF%Straightening up and clearing his throat, the old man loudly asks.%SPEECH_ON%Do you accept your summons?%SPEECH_OFF%}
aedf62a38c05adc088af.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer%抬起头，仿佛正沿着鼻梁俯视你。那副冷笑的模样满是轻蔑，不过，他还是让你进了门。维齐尔拍了拍手，一个仆人拿着卷轴走来，展开宣读。%SPEECH_ON%沙漠中发现沙魔。一名克朗客，也就是您，旅人，将……%SPEECH_OFF%维齐尔又拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%可能是他，仆人。是‘可能’。措辞要分清楚。%SPEECH_OFF%你知道，仆人很想说卷轴又不是他写的，不过这话终究没出口。他继续念完。%SPEECH_ON%……将获酬劳，以平息灼热的狂沙，使其恢复自然之状。剿灭上述怪物，可获酬金%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%卷轴重新卷起，仆人接住两端，悄然退下。维齐尔再次出现在你眼前，却已无心顾你，正等着一个女奴把葡萄喂进嘴里。 | 一位名叫%employer%的维齐尔接待了你。不过，这场会面里的礼数，全都花在了公事公办的辞令上。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，沙魔正在沙漠中肆虐。召你前来，是要你协助处置此事。酬金%reward%克朗，你若不答应，我们便再召别人来。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进房间，只见几个维齐尔埋在女奴的身体之间。笑声不断，手指在肌肤上嬉闹着拉扯，却似乎没有一个人注意到你。只有一名老人拖着脚步走来，向你鞠躬。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，维齐尔%employer%召请一位克朗客，前来承担狩猎沙魔之责。%SPEECH_OFF%老人朝那边看了一眼，直起身。再次开口时，那些故作高深的废话已荡然无存。%SPEECH_ON%那是些黄沙堆成的大混账，正把郊野搅得天翻地覆。我提醒你，它们可不好惹。别让这里满眼的排场和黄金冲昏头脑，接下自己对付不了的活儿。你若肯干，报酬%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%老人挺直身子，清了清嗓子，高声问道：%SPEECH_ON%您是否应召效命？%SPEECH_OFF%}

0a03ee120ff37f0645a8.source: {I'm interested, go on. | Hunting down an enemy like this doesn't come cheap. | This is going to cost you. | Hunting a mirage in the desert. What is not to like. | The %companyname% can help, for the right price.}
0a03ee120ff37f0645a8.translation: {我有兴趣，继续说。 | 追杀这样的敌人，价钱可不会便宜。 | 这可得让你破费了。 | 去沙漠里追逐幻景。听起来可真不错。 | 价钱合适，%companyname%就能帮忙。}

547c137fe112ba7f72a5.source: {This doesn't sound like our kind of work. | I won't lead the men on a wild goose chase through the desert. | I don't think so. | I say no. The men prefer known enemies of flesh and blood.}
547c137fe112ba7f72a5.translation: {听起来，这不是我们干的活儿。 | 我不会带弟兄们去沙漠里白跑一趟。 | 恐怕不行。 | 不接。弟兄们更愿意对付熟悉的、有血有肉的敌人。}

07ec72a54a5d2e3a5683.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{While tracking the mysterious Ifrits, you come across an old crone who has feet like leather. She bows at your appearance.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, slaves of the coin, it is the Ifrits you seek, yes? Of course. I can see it on your faces.%SPEECH_OFF%She pauses and points out toward the dunes where you are heading.%SPEECH_ON%We are of these lands, understand? We are one with them, and when we banish and harm and be cruel to one another, the sands take to the sides of those who have been wronged. Fear yourself not the monster, but the reason it has been created, for that reason permeates these sands, and in that reasoning you shall slay but one monster but not salt the waters which cause it to spring eternal.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come across a well in the desert. A man offers you a few buckets of refreshment, remarking that the water below is unending. With not a single farm in sight, you've reason to believe there's enough water below to slake one's thirst for all time. The man does seem to sense you've other purpose in these parts though.%SPEECH_ON%I take it is the Ifrits you seek, is it not?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask him how he knew that. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%Cause I've seen them, and what they've done, and I believed it would only be a short time until a professional army or slave of the crown would come along to resolve their disputes. The Ifrit is a monster of vengeance, and it will only succumb to that which ushered it out of the earth: cruelty.%SPEECH_OFF%Finishing your drink, you thank the stranger for his words and continue on. | A few corpses in the sands. Some have slid halfway down a dune. Another rests at the base, another far from the base. Seemingly thrown that way. The bodies being uncovered by the sands hints at some recency in the deaths. It seems whatever attacked the people pulverized them with incredible force then spent a brief time mutilating what was left, sanding the flesh down to the bone in spots. The Ifrits must be close...}
07ec72a54a5d2e3a5683.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{追踪神秘的沙魔时，你遇见一个老婆婆，双脚粗硬得像皮革。她见到你，弯腰行礼。%SPEECH_ON%啊，钱币的奴仆，你们在找沙魔，是不是？当然，我从你们脸上看得出来。%SPEECH_OFF%她顿了顿，指向你们要去的沙丘。%SPEECH_ON%我们生于这片土地，明白吗？我们与它本是一体。当我们彼此放逐、伤害、残酷相待，黄沙便会站到受冤者那一边。你该怕的不是怪物，而是造出怪物的缘由。那缘由早已渗透这片沙海。所以，你即便杀掉一头怪物，也无法毒死那眼源泉，怪物仍会从中不断涌出。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在沙漠里遇到一口井。一个男人提来几桶水，请你们解渴，说井底的水永远也用不完。四周连一块农田都看不见，你倒有理由相信，这口井的水足够人一直喝下去。不过，男人似乎也看出，你们来这里另有目的。%SPEECH_ON%我猜你们在找沙魔，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，问他怎么知道。他咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%因为我见过它们，也见过它们干的事。我就想，用不了多久，总会有正规军，或是克朗的奴仆，过来解决这场纷争。沙魔是为复仇而生的怪物，要想让它屈服，只能用当初将它从大地里唤出来的东西：残暴。%SPEECH_OFF%你喝完水，谢过陌生人的告诫，继续赶路。 | 沙地里散着几具尸体。有些滑到了沙丘半腰，一具倒在坡底，另一具则远远躺在坡底之外，像是被抛过去的。尸体尚未被流沙掩埋，说明人死得不久。袭击者似乎用骇人的力量将他们砸烂，又花了些工夫摧残残尸，有些地方的血肉甚至被沙子磨得只剩白骨。沙魔一定就在附近……}

2c8ae9a04fc2e774f379.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_153.png[/img]{At first glance, it is a mirage. The desert shifts and blurs at distance, and to the unwitting or exhausted, these sights alter and change to be whatever one wishes them to be. It is when the Ifrit turns around and rips a human body in half and slings the parts across the sands that you realize this is not an imagined monstrosity at all. It is a hellish creature, a spinning cloud of sand with stones shifting about to give it some shape of what a man might be. And as it leans forward you realize if nothing else it does share a man's disposition toward armed strangers on its land: murderous rage. | The sand dunes ahead slip from top to bottom, the sands curling toward you like a sheet being pulled off a bed. But a stone appears unearthed and another and another, and when the first stone rises you realize it is an Ifrit. A growl scratches out, a deep bellow that is crackling with the clash of sandy winds. The Ifrit takes some sloping, disjointed shape of a man, stones for bones, and sands for flesh, and it charges forth. | You find the Ifrit holding a distended sense of an arm down toward the earth. Sand blows out of the arm and the grains press a dead body into the desert, the force ripping away the clothes, and then peppering open the flesh, then it is stripped to the bone entirely and when the Ifrit is done it turns to you and ferociously growls.}
2c8ae9a04fc2e774f379.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_153.png[/img]{乍看之下，那只是海市蜃楼。远处的沙漠扭曲模糊，在浑然不觉或筋疲力尽的人眼中，往往会变幻成心底渴望的景象。可那头沙魔转过身，将一具人体撕成两半，把残躯抛向沙地时，你才明白，这怪物绝非幻觉。那是个地狱般的造物，一团旋转的沙云，石块在其中游移，拼出些许人的形状。它向前俯身，你随即意识到，至少有一点，它与人类十分相像：面对踏入自己领地的持械陌生人，它满腔怒火，只想杀戮。 | 前方的沙丘从顶到底滑落，沙层向你卷来，仿佛有人正将床单从床上扯下。一块石头露出沙面，接着又是一块，再一块。第一块石头腾空而起时，你才看清，那是沙魔。它发出低沉的咆哮，狂风挟沙的碰撞声在吼声里噼啪作响。沙魔以石为骨，以沙为肉，拼成一副歪斜、错落的人形，猛地冲了过来。 | 你发现一头沙魔，正将一条膨胀得勉强算作手臂的肢体垂向地面。沙粒从臂中喷涌而出，将一具尸体死死压进沙地。强劲的沙流先撕碎衣物，再打穿皮肉，最后将尸身彻底剥成白骨。沙魔做完这一切，便转向你，发出凶狠的咆哮。}

3207ac32a303869c5d35.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_160.png[/img]{As you reach the top of a sand dune, it immediately stretches away from your very feet. You find yourself sinking and roll out before the earth swallows you whole. As you tumble down the slopes, you find the adjacent dunes similarly receding, and in your belly there is a tremble, not of fear, but of the ground itself violently shaking. When it is over, you stand up and steady your feet. And Ifrits come to stand at the rim of the crater and look down at you. They scream at you, hissing ferocity scraping with the sound of sand crystalizing past one another. You are surrounded! | You pause and sigh. The desert just seems to go on and on, and just as you think that you find the view shrinking away. It takes a moment for you to realize the ground is shaking and as the sand shifts you are being sucked down. You roll away from danger and find yourself tumbling down the sand slopes. At the bottom you quickly jump to your feet and draw your weapon to face what you already know is there: the Ifrits. They stand at the rim of the dunes, staring down at you as though they trapped a rat. Their bodies are clouds of sand with floating stones to give a sort of staccato shape of what might be a man. They growl and descend downward!}
3207ac32a303869c5d35.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_160.png[/img]{你刚登上沙丘顶端，脚下的沙地便突然向四周退去。身体开始下沉，你赶在大地将你整个吞没前翻身滚开。顺着沙坡滚落时，你看见旁边的沙丘也在向后塌退，腹中传来阵阵震颤，并非因为恐惧，而是大地本身正在剧烈摇晃。动静终于停下，你站起身，稳住双脚。沙魔纷纷出现在凹坑边缘，居高临下地俯视着你。它们发出尖厉的嘶吼，狂暴的声音中夹着沙晶相互刮擦的刺响。你被包围了！ | 你停下脚步，叹了口气。沙漠仿佛永无尽头。念头刚起，眼前的景象却忽然向远处缩去。过了片刻，你才意识到大地正在震动，流动的沙子正把你往下吸。你翻身避开险处，却一路滚下沙坡。刚到坡底，你便迅速跃起，拔出武器，迎向心里早已有数的敌人：沙魔。它们站在沙丘边缘，俯视着你，仿佛抓住了一只老鼠。它们的身体是一团团沙云，悬浮的石块在其中断断续续地勾出人形。它们咆哮着，冲下沙坡！}

e5d104d4a859adb83918.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_160.png[/img]{The battle is over, but the Ifrits do not depart entirely. The sands which made their bodies bubble, and the stones which framed their bodies shift and tremble angrily. You can hear the hiss not of some monstrosity at all, but what is clearly the sound of humans. They hiss, the sound right at your ears. You twist around to find nothing. They hiss behind you again, and this time when you turn around the noise is gone and the sands are still and the stones earth bidden as they should be. The beasts are slain, and possibly whatever inhabited them, too. It is time to return to %employer%. | The Ifrits are slain, but the bodies only seemed to serve as vessels for something far more sinister. You catch glimpses of spirits soaring toward the horizon, but perhaps it is merely the desert itself playing tricks on you. There's no saying, except to say that the beastly nature of the Ifrits has been defeated and %employer% needs to pay you for that alone.}
e5d104d4a859adb83918.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_160.png[/img]{战斗已经结束，沙魔却没有彻底消散。组成身躯的沙粒仍在翻涌，撑起骨架的石头仍在愤怒地挪动、震颤。你听见嘶声，听来竟不像怪物，分明像人。那嘶声贴着耳畔响起，你猛然回头，却什么也没有。身后又响起嘶声。这一次，你再回头时，声音已经消失，沙粒平静下来，石头也老老实实地伏在地上，恢复了本来的样子。怪物已经死了，或许寄居其中的东西也一并消亡了。该回去见%employer%了。 | 沙魔已被消灭，但那些躯壳似乎只是容器，盛装着某种更加邪恶的东西。你瞥见幽灵飞向天际，却也可能只是沙漠又在捉弄你的眼睛。真相无从判断，不过有一点可以确定：凶暴的沙魔已被击败，光凭这一条，%employer%就得付钱。}

1df0d59d1838e5e0536d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{You try and enter %employer%'s room, but a guard stops you. With a bit of a brow raiser, you tell the man that the Vizier is expecting you. The guard stares down at you.%SPEECH_ON%He expects you, he does not wish to see you. Those are two different things, Crownling. The scouts have confirmed your doings in the deserts. Here is your pay, as agreed upon. Now depart. I said depart!%SPEECH_OFF%The guard stamps his foot and all the guards posted down the hall stamp their feet and face you. Now, you are no genius, but you get the feeling that it is probably time to go. | %employer% stares down at you from a throne of pillows and women. Slave women, judging by their chains, though perhaps that is just their thing. The sad faces say otherwise. The Vizier speaks, but it is almost as if it is a show for all those listening and you're just playing a part.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, my little hawks have told me of your doings. The Ifrits have been put to rest and their sorcery shall be a threat no more! Such is the power of my gold. It is work which we have agreed to, and for that %reward% crowns is your reward.%SPEECH_OFF%As a servant hands you a purse of coins, the Vizier flitters his fingers dismissively toward you.%SPEECH_ON%Begone.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% turning an hourglass one way and back again. The sands are equally pitted to the halved bulbs. There are servants all along the wall with their heads bowed. At the adjacent wall are a line of cushions upon which sit gaudy women whose hair is tended to by women in chains. The Vizier slams the hourglass down. He crouches behind it, his eyes visile to either side of the glass, the pupils staring inward. You finally notice that the sands within are not shifting as they should, but instead twirling angrily.%SPEECH_ON%The Ifrits have been dealt with, this my hawks have told me so. Crownling, you have done your job as you were summoned to do, and for that you are to be given %reward% crowns. I hope your time in the deserts rewarded you not only with experience of combat and war, but also graced you with the notion of contemplation.%SPEECH_OFF%You're not sure what this man means. He yanks the hourglass up and starts to tilt it side to side again. The sands thrash as they bounce from side to side. A servant hands you a purse of coins and you could not depart the room faster. | You return to %employer% to find the Vizier facedown on a couch. A number of old men are knuckling his back or rubbing his feet. Across the room, a woman fans herself. She is entirely naked and her eyes never leave the Vizier's, nor his hers. The man talks almost as if you are not even in the room at all.%SPEECH_ON%Servants, hand this Crownling the purple purse with black thread. Crownling, you have done well in handling the spirits of the sands, these so-called Ifrits. It was my gold which ushered you into those deserts, and my gold which rewarded you, so let the scribes know that it is my gold which has settled this issue truly, and that the tool, this Crownling, was paid fairly.%SPEECH_OFF%A servant stabs a purple sack into your arms. The Vizier groans as an old man plants an elbow right into his ass crack.%SPEECH_ON%Need I tell you to depart, Crownling?%SPEECH_OFF% | An old man with no eyebrows greets you, stopping you just outside %employer%'s door. He pushes a sack into your arms.%SPEECH_ON%There are %reward% crowns in there, as the Vizier agreed.%SPEECH_OFF%The man looks around for listeners and seems to nod when you seeing you are the only one within earshot.%SPEECH_ON%The Ifrits are not just demons, they are wronged spirits, and you have set them free. But they will likely return, because men such as %employer% have nothing to offer this world but a waterfall of gold, and they forget that beneath that waterfall many are crushed or drowned.%SPEECH_OFF%You're not sure what he means, but an approaching guard ends the conversation and the old man slaps you across the face.%SPEECH_ON%Begone, Crownling! Take your pay and leave my sight!%SPEECH_OFF% | Of all things, a troop of cats welcome you enter %employer%'s room. You can just barely see the Vizier on the other side of a mesh with a crowd of equally amused onlookers.

 You look down and see the cats are carting around a piece of wood with a purse atop it. You look back up. The silhouettes are holding their breath. Sighing, you bend down and pick up the purse. One voyeur erupts and claps but is met by stern hushing. Their task complete, the cats fall down and spread out on the tile, dozing or grooming themselves or pawing at the shadows which flitter in the sunbeams. You're pretty sure %reward% crowns are in the sack, but not wanting to spend another second in the room you step outside to count.}
1df0d59d1838e5e0536d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{你想走进%employer%的房间，却被卫兵拦下。你扬了扬眉，告诉他，维齐尔正等着自己。卫兵低头盯着你。%SPEECH_ON%他料到你会来，不代表他想见你。这是两回事，克朗客。斥候已经证实了你在沙漠里的战果。这是谈好的报酬。现在走吧。我说，走！%SPEECH_OFF%卫兵一跺脚，走廊里的所有卫兵便一同跺脚，转向你。你虽然算不上什么天才，也觉得眼下大概是该告辞了。 | %employer%从软枕与女人堆成的宝座上俯视着你。看那些锁链，女人应该都是奴隶。当然，也可能她们只是喜欢这样，可那一张张愁苦的脸却不这么说。维齐尔开口了，听来更像是给在场众人演戏，而你只是其中一个角色。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，我的小鹰已经禀报了你的事迹。沙魔已归于沉寂，它们的妖术再也不能为祸！这便是我黄金的力量。既然你完成了约定的工作，%reward%克朗就是你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%仆人递给你一袋钱，维齐尔则漫不经心地朝你摆摆手指。%SPEECH_ON%退下。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正把一只沙漏翻过来，又翻回去。沙子均匀分在上下两个玻璃球里。仆人沿墙站成一排，个个低着头。另一面墙边铺着一排软垫，衣饰艳丽的女人坐在上面，戴着锁链的女人则替她们梳理头发。维齐尔猛地放下沙漏，蹲到后面，两只眼睛从玻璃两侧露出，瞳孔往中间聚拢。你这才发现，里面的沙子没有照常流动，而是在愤怒地旋转。%SPEECH_ON%沙魔已经解决，我的鹰已将消息带回。克朗客，你按召命完成了职责，应当得到%reward%克朗。我希望，这趟沙漠之行带给你的，不只有战斗与战争的经验，也能让你懂得沉思。%SPEECH_OFF%你不明白他的意思。他又猛然举起沙漏，左右倾斜。沙粒撞向两侧，狂乱翻腾。仆人递给你钱袋，你简直一刻也不想在这屋里多待。 | 你回来找%employer%，发现维齐尔正趴在长榻上，几个老人有的用指节捶他的背，有的揉他的脚。房间另一头，一个女人替自己扇风。她浑身赤裸，始终与维齐尔四目相对。男人说起话来，仿佛你根本不在房间里。%SPEECH_ON%仆人，把那个黑线缝边的紫钱袋交给这位克朗客。克朗客，你把那些沙中幽灵，也就是所谓的沙魔，处理得很好。是我的黄金将你引入沙漠，也是我的黄金给了你酬劳。所以，让书记官记清楚，真正解决此事的是我的黄金，而这件工具，这位克朗客，也得到了公允的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%仆人将紫色袋子猛地塞进你怀里。一个老人把肘尖抵进维齐尔的臀缝，后者呻吟一声。%SPEECH_ON%还需要我开口请你走吗，克朗客？%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个没有眉毛的老人迎上来，将你拦在%employer%的门外。他把袋子塞进你怀里。%SPEECH_ON%里面有%reward%克朗，维齐尔答应的数目。%SPEECH_OFF%老人左右张望，像是在察看有没有人偷听。确认只有你听得见，他似乎点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%沙魔不只是恶魔，它们是受冤的亡魂，你让它们得到了解脱。可它们多半还会回来，因为像%employer%这样的人，能给这世界的，只有瀑布般倾泻的黄金。他们忘了，瀑布之下，有多少人被砸碎，被淹没。%SPEECH_OFF%你还没弄明白他的意思，一个走近的卫兵便让谈话戛然而止。老人一巴掌扇在你脸上。%SPEECH_ON%滚吧，克朗客！拿上钱，别让我再看见你！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，迎接你的竟然是一群猫。隔着一张网帘，你只能勉强看见维齐尔。他与一群同样兴致勃勃的看客待在另一边。

你低头一看，猫儿们正拖着一块木板四处走，板上放着一个钱袋。你再抬头，那些人影都屏住了呼吸。你叹了口气，弯腰拿起钱袋。一名偷看的客人忍不住欢呼鼓掌，却立刻被其他人严厉地嘘止。差事一完，猫儿们便纷纷瘫在地砖上，有的打盹，有的舔毛，有的伸爪去拍阳光中晃动的影子。袋里应该装着%reward%克朗，不过，你连一秒也不想再待下去，便走到屋外清点。}

24ac9360d17d937dde8b.source: Hunt down what kills people in the woods around
24ac9360d17d937dde8b.translation: 追猎在附近树林杀人的怪物，地点：

e5a2a6b9fe9d00518ae6.source: A creature of bark and wood, blending between trees and shambling slowly, its roots digging through the soil.
e5a2a6b9fe9d00518ae6.translation: 由树皮与木头构成的生物，混迹于群树之间，蹒跚挪动，树根在泥土里钻行。

0a1ad8522d6da04aa514.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]{You find a town board littered with notes written in cheap scrap or even on leaves and held there with the most rusted of nails. %employer% sidles up to you.%SPEECH_ON%We've been waiting for a man of your sort, sellsword. Folks keep going missing in the woods and I've no recourse in getting them back. I've heard tales of trees on the move and killing the lumberjacks hacking at their trunks, but who knows if any of that's true. I need your company to head into the woods and find out what's causing all this carnage. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is rolling a piece of bark between his fingers like a gambler's coin. He sighs and throws it across his table.%SPEECH_ON%I've been receiving stories about lumberjacks and peddlers going missing in the woods. Some say the trees are coming alive to have their revenge, but that sounds like hogwash to me. Either way, a sum of coin has been readied to help 'solve' this issue and I'm willing to dispense it. What say you, sellsword, are you interested in finding whatever monsters are hounding this town?%SPEECH_OFF% | There's a pile of sawdust on %employer%'s desk and his eyes are intently staring into the mound. He waves you in without breaking his glare, and speaks all the same.%SPEECH_ON%The local lumberjacks are reporting that men are going missing in the woods. They say the trees are up to it, something about monsters made of wood and roots. Parts of me believe they're hiding a murder and won't fess to the crime, but then maybe the spooky stories are true. Either way, I've coin to see it to an end and you're just the man the task, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF% | Entering %employer%'s room, your foot clips a slat of chopped wood. It tumbles over and falls flat edged, the round trunk and its bark now up at you. The mayor claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%So it didn't move! Ah, you're probably wondering what I'm on about. Here.%SPEECH_OFF%He throws you a drawing of what looks like a tree with arms. He goes on.%SPEECH_ON%I've word from the roads that the trees are coming alive. Even have a trusted friend who works as a lumberjack said, straight faced, that some spiritual beast in the trees had taken the wood and roots and wielded them as weapons. Whatever is out there, I need a set of killers to seek it out. Are you and your company up for the task?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found sitting on a trunk of a tree while surrounded by peasants. After a few minutes he throws his hands out.%SPEECH_ON%See! Ain't nothing wrong! It's a tree! A tree, see?%SPEECH_OFF%The peasants are not convinced and go on about monsters in the forest shaped like the woods themselves. Sighing, %employer% throws his hand out to you.%SPEECH_ON%Fine, we'll hire some mercenaries? Does that suit everyone? What say you, sellsword. We've coin to pay and murderous trees for you to hunt. Sound good?%SPEECH_OFF%}
0a1ad8522d6da04aa514.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]{镇上的告示板贴满留言，纸张多是廉价碎纸，甚至还有树叶，全用锈得不成样子的钉子固定着。%employer%靠到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我们一直在等你这样的人。总有人在树林里失踪，我却无计可施，找不回来。听说有树会自己走动，还会杀死砍它们树干的伐木工，可谁知道真假。我需要你的战团进林子，查清究竟是什么在伤人害命。你有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%让一小片树皮在指间翻转，像赌徒摆弄硬币。他叹口气，将树皮扔到桌子另一头。%SPEECH_ON%最近总有人来报，伐木工和小贩在林子里失踪。有些人说，树活过来寻仇了。我觉得全是胡说。不过，不管怎样，镇上已经凑了笔钱，准备‘解决’这件事，我也愿意拿出来。佣兵，你怎么说？有没有兴趣，找出究竟是什么怪物在祸害这座镇子？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的桌上堆着一小丘木屑，他正目不转睛地盯着。他招手让你进来，目光却没移开，说话也如此。%SPEECH_ON%本地伐木工说，林子里有人失踪。他们说是树干的，什么木头和树根组成的怪物。我总有些怀疑，是他们杀了人，想瞒下来，不肯认罪。但也许，那些怪谈真有其事。无论如何，我有钱把这件事了结，而你正是合适的人选，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 走进%employer%的房间时，你踢到一截劈开的木头。木块翻滚一下，以平面着地，弧形的树皮朝了上来。镇长拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%原来它没动！啊，你一定不明白我在说什么。看这个。%SPEECH_OFF%他扔来一张画，上面像是一棵长着胳膊的树。他接着说道：%SPEECH_ON%路上传来消息，说树活了。就连我一个信得过的伐木工朋友，也一本正经地告诉我，树里有什么精怪，把木头和树根都当成了武器。不管外头是什么，我需要一群会杀人的家伙，去把它找出来。你和你的战团，接得下吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正坐在一截树干上，周围站满农民。过了几分钟，他摊开双手。%SPEECH_ON%看！什么事也没有！这就是棵树！一棵树，看见了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%农民们仍不信服，七嘴八舌地说，森林里有长得跟树木一模一样的怪物。%employer%叹口气，朝你一挥手。%SPEECH_ON%行，那就雇几个佣兵？大家总该满意了吧？佣兵，你怎么说？我们有钱可付，也有会杀人的树等着你猎。怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%}

0573b990da614e83e7d6.source: {Interested for sure. | Let's talk pay. | Let's talk crowns. | This is going to cost you. | A wild chase through the forest, then? Count me in. | The %companyname% can help, for the right price.}
0573b990da614e83e7d6.translation: {当然有兴趣。 | 谈谈报酬吧。 | 谈谈克朗吧。 | 这可得让你破费了。 | 要在森林里追个痛快？算我一个。 | 价钱合适，%companyname%就能帮忙。}

fe3920c02eb8014403e3.source: {This doesn't sound like our kind of work. | I won't lead the men on a wild goose chase through the woods. | I don't think so. | I say no. The men prefer known enemies of flesh and blood.}
fe3920c02eb8014403e3.translation: {听起来，这不是我们干的活儿。 | 我不会带弟兄们去林子里白跑一趟。 | 恐怕不行。 | 不接。弟兄们更愿意对付熟悉的、有血有肉的敌人。}

fdafb3afc3a69388ed6a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]{The company is increasingly on edge, insomuch as a company would be in a forest while hunting murderous trees. Every crack of a branch has the men drawing swords and one of them screamed when a fallen leaf fell into the nape of shirt. Your enemy is already scoring wins without even having to do anything! | The forest is making the men uneasy. You tell them to shape up for the enemy is out there one way or another, and it is not worth being fearful of that which is certain. It is you who shall be feared, the %companyname%, and these damned murderous trees will be wishing you were simple lumberjacks by the time you're done with them! | %randombrother% heaves his weapon over his shoulders and totters on with his arms swinging around dramatically. He's sizing up the forest foliage.%SPEECH_ON%Hey cap', what you say we smash up one of these trees here and call it a day! Pitch 'em a pile of chopped wood and mulch and ain't no one gonna know the difference when it's all said and told. If they ask questions just tell 'em the bark had some bite!%SPEECH_OFF%The men laugh and you tell the sellsword you'll take his idea into consideration.}
fdafb3afc3a69388ed6a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]{弟兄们越来越紧张。当然，在树林里追猎会杀人的树，谁的神经也松不下来。每一声树枝脆响，都有人拔剑；一片落叶掉进某个弟兄的后领，他竟吓得叫了起来。敌人什么都没做，就已先胜一筹！ | 林子让弟兄们心神不宁。你叫他们振作起来：敌人肯定就在某处，害怕一件已成定局的事，毫无用处。该让人害怕的是你们，是%companyname%！等你们收拾完这些杀人的该死树木，它们只会后悔，来找它们的怎么不是普通伐木工！ | %randombrother%将武器扛到肩上，摇摇晃晃地往前走，双臂甩得夸张，一边打量林木。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，团长，要不咱们随便砸烂这里一棵树，就算收工了？扔给他们一堆碎木头和烂树皮，到头来谁能分清？真有人问，就说那树皮看着老实，下嘴可狠！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们大笑起来。你告诉这个佣兵，自己会考虑他的主意。}

7eda60ecc5af0e4567b8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_107.png[/img]{While standing around getting a lay of the land, %randombrother% calls out that there's something moving in the distance. As you come to his side, he points a finger into the foliage and draws his sword. A great tree is marching toward you, shambling from side to side like an old man in a library's familiar corridors. You draw your own sword and order the men into formation. | %randombrother% is sitting on a fallen tree when he suddenly jumps up yelling and grabbing his weapon. You look over to see the tree itself rising up into the air, clumps of earth raining below and a great wet ditch left as though it had bedded there for eons. It leans against its healthier brethren like a drunkard would into a friend's shoulder. Slowly, it twists its body around, a pair of green eyes flared from somewhere deep in its trunk, and its sharp branches wheel around with it, splayed wide with their shadows falling over the company like a web. You grab your sword and order the men into formation.}
7eda60ecc5af0e4567b8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_107.png[/img]{你正停下来察看地形，%randombrother%忽然喊道，远处有东西在动。你走到他身边，他指着林木深处，拔出了剑。一棵大树正朝你们走来，摇摇晃晃，仿佛一个老人在藏书室里走过熟悉的廊道。你也拔出剑，命令弟兄们列阵。 | %randombrother%正坐在一棵倒树上，忽然大叫着跳起，抓过武器。你转头一看，那棵树竟自己升了起来，泥块簌簌落下，留下一条又深又湿的沟，仿佛它已经在这里躺了无数岁月。它倚向旁边长势更好的树，像个醉汉靠在朋友肩上。随后，它缓缓转过身来，一双绿眼从树干深处亮起，尖利的枝条随之旋转，向两侧伸展，投下蛛网般的阴影，笼罩住整个战团。你抓住剑柄，命令弟兄们列阵。}

0bbd87cbad31a8273e9b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_118.png[/img]{You spot pairs of green eyes glowing in the distance. No doubt a sight of the schrats themselves, and so you order your men to clamber toward them quietly.

Cresting a hill you find the trunk of one tree is surrounded by direwolves. They're crouched beneath it like knights swearing fealty. Your arrival has not gone unnoticed as the schrat leans forward with a seemingly ancient crooning. The creatures at its roots growl and turn as though commanded. You're not sure what to make of such arboreal allegiance, but the %companyname% will break them all the same.}
0bbd87cbad31a8273e9b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_118.png[/img]{你看见远处亮起一双双绿色的眼睛。毫无疑问，那就是树妖。你让弟兄们放轻脚步，朝它们攀行。

翻上山坡，你发现一棵树的树干周围，竟聚着一群恐狼。它们伏在树下，宛如宣誓效忠的骑士。你们的到来没有逃过树妖的察觉，它俯下身，发出仿佛来自远古的低吟。树根旁的野兽像接到了命令，纷纷低吼着转过身来。你不知道该如何理解这种向树木效忠的关系，不过，%companyname%会将它们一并击溃。}

ff30bab3eb16ef5dcbea.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_121.png[/img]{The schrats are slain, their arboreal remains now resembling little more than ordinary trees. You carve trophies and evidence for a return to %employer%. | You stare at a felled tree and then at a felled schrat. Between the two you see almost no difference, which makes you ponder about all those supposedly dead trees you've been hopping over your whole life. Not one to dwell on such matters, you order the company take trophies as proof of the battle and ready a return to %employer%. | The schrats are felled, each draped against the rest of the forest foliage like brawlers resting between rounds. You walk up beneath the roots of one and get a good look at it, but now it appears no different than any other tree around. You order the company to take what trophies they can to show %employer%.}
ff30bab3eb16ef5dcbea.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_121.png[/img]{树妖已经伏诛，木质的残骸看上去与普通树木相差无几。你割下战利品，留作凭证，准备回去见%employer%。 | 你看看倒下的树，又看看倒下的树妖，两者几乎没有区别。这让你不禁想起，这辈子跨过的那些树，究竟有多少只是‘看起来死了’。不过，你向来不爱钻这种牛角尖，便命令战团取些战利品，作为战斗的凭证，准备回去见%employer%。 | 树妖全被放倒了，一头头搭在周围林木上，仿佛在回合间歇休息的拳斗者。你走到一头树妖的根部下方，仔细打量，可它如今看上去，与附近其他树木已无两样。你命令战团尽量取些战利品，带给%employer%过目。}

e9e73749816424c45dbe.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_121.png[/img]{As you're departing the battlefield, %randombrother% remarks that the surrounding area looks rather ripe. You turn around to see that he's indeed correct: a beautiful crop of trees served host to the schrats, presumably chosen for good reason. And if the schrats took it for a good home, then it surely means the wood is very fine. You order the men to make use of this quality glade and chop as many trees down as time and energy permits. The harvested timber is very fine indeed.

 It begins to rain as you depart the impromptu lumbermill.}
e9e73749816424c45dbe.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_121.png[/img]{正要离开战场，%randombrother%说附近这片林子长得不错。你回头看，果然如此：树妖栖居的这片树木繁茂秀美，想必选址有因。连树妖都看中的家园，木材自然不会差。你命令众人利用这片好林地，趁时间和体力允许，尽量多砍些树。收下的木料果然上乘。

离开这座临时伐木场时，天开始下雨。}

6ebad41986c58fcd32e9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_121.png[/img]{Just as you're departing a glint catches your eye. You turn around and come to one of the schrats' trunk. An axe is embedded in the wood. Moss has long since overgrown the handle, and yet the metal of the tool is without error, not a smidge of rust upon it. Scraping the moss away, you uncover wooden fingertips still at full grip. Tracing the fingers ends at the tree trunk where the wrist becomes a vein of wood. You follow that along to a wooden face with a twisted maw, like a face of brown wax melted by time alone. The frame of a helmet twists around the face and there's a chest plate cresting below like the reservoir of a deerchaser.

You shake your head and retrieve the axe, breaking it free and throwing the wooden fingers off its handle. The misshapen face blankly observes your theft, its stare preserved in the very annihilation from which it is eons removed. You don't dwell on the sight and return to the company with the axe.}
6ebad41986c58fcd32e9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_121.png[/img]{正要离开时，一点亮光吸引了你的目光。你回过身，走到一头树妖的躯干旁。一把斧头嵌在木头里。斧柄早已覆满青苔，金属部分却完好无损，连一点锈迹都没有。刮去青苔，你发现几根木质的手指，仍将斧柄握得死紧。沿着手指看去，手腕没入树干，化作一道木纹。木纹延伸到一张木头脸上，嘴巴扭曲张开，仿佛一张褐蜡做的脸，被漫长岁月独自熔坏。头盔的残框扭曲着箍在脸周围，下方则翘起一块胸甲，凹处宛如一只接水的斗槽。

你摇摇头，拔出斧头，掰掉斧柄上那些木头手指。畸形的面孔空洞地望着你的劫掠，那道目光凝固于毁灭降临的瞬间，至今已不知过去多少岁月。你不再多想眼前的景象，带着斧头回到战团。}

5cddbc4aa421b9ee5df2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]{You find %employer% carving a toy out of wood. He blows the shavings off his desk and claps the sawdust from his fingers. He sets the toy up on its legs, shaped like a knight that's eaten too many sweets, but it promptly falls over. Sighing, he turns to you for help. You pull the schrat's head into the room and let it rock back and forth on the floor til it rests upon one of its horns. The mayor nods.%SPEECH_ON%Quite good, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%He fetches your promised reward. | %employer% is shocked at your return, and shocked at the schrat's remains which you have brought upon his doorstep. He looks down at it, ever incredulous as to its source. Like a cat pawing at a bug's shorn wings he rummages the pile with his foot.%SPEECH_ON%I'd no imagination of you bringing these back, but damned if you didn't find and kill those bastard trees. Well, I'll fetch your reward.%SPEECH_OFF%He brings you the contracted coin as promised. | %employer% is running a carver down the arm of a wooden chair when you find him. He looks up at your arrival and you present the remains of a schrat. The man gets up and takes a piece, coming to sit in his chair to get a good look at it, but his chair blows apart beneath his arse and claps the boards against the ground with a tremendous clatter as if his original designs all along were to export a great cacophony. %employer% throws his tools in a fit.%SPEECH_ON%By the gods I'll, well, I'd best not make myself a savage and threaten them. Suppose doing that got me to this state in the first place.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, stating it's unwise to anger the old gods. You also suggest that it is unwise to let a sellsword go unpaid for his work. The mayor jumps to his feet and runs to get a satchel of coin.%SPEECH_ON%Of course, mercenary! You need not lecture me on such matters!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found beneath a copse of trees. He's got his hands over his belly and he's staring at the sky. A smile crosses his face and he points up at a cloud as though someone should be beside him to witness, but he's all by himself and says nothing. You throw a chunk of schrat at his feet and ask if he has your payment. He turns over a satchel that had heretofore gone unseen.%SPEECH_ON% A couple of lumberjacks saw you in battle with them and told me the tale, already. I'd not thought the schrats entirely real. Deadly trees seem like a superstition for children, but I suppose I've things to learn yet. Good work, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%}
5cddbc4aa421b9ee5df2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]{你找到%employer%时，他正在雕一个木头玩具。他吹去桌上的刨花，拍拍手，将指间的木屑掸净。玩具像个甜食吃太多的骑士，他想让它双脚站稳，可刚放好，它就倒了。他叹口气，转向你，像是盼你帮忙。你将树妖的脑袋拖进房间，让它在地板上来回晃动，直到支住一根尖角，终于停稳。镇长点点头。%SPEECH_ON%干得不错，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他去取来答应你的报酬。 | 你的归来让%employer%大吃一惊，门前那些树妖残骸，更让他惊讶不已。他低头看着，仍不敢相信这些东西的来历，又伸脚拨弄，像猫摆弄虫子撕落的翅膀。%SPEECH_ON%我可没想到你会带回这些。见鬼，你还真找到了那些混账树，还把它们杀了。好吧，我去拿报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%他果然按委托约定，付清了钱。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正用雕刀削一把木椅的扶手。见你进来，他抬起头，你便呈上树妖残骸。男人站起来，拿了一块，坐回椅子，想仔细看看。可椅子在他屁股底下轰然散架，木板砸落地面，响声震耳，仿佛他忙活半天，原本就只是为了造出这场吵闹。%employer%怒气冲冲地摔开工具。%SPEECH_ON%诸神在上，我非得……算了，我最好别像个野蛮人一样，连神都敢威胁。说不定，我就是这么把自己弄到如今这步田地的。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，说惹怒旧神确实不明智。随后，你又提醒，佣兵干完活却拿不到钱，同样不是什么明智之举。镇长一跃而起，跑去拿来一袋钱。%SPEECH_ON%那是当然，佣兵！这种事，用不着你教训我！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在一片小树林下找到%employer%。他双手放在肚子上，正望着天空。脸上浮起笑意时，他伸手指向一朵云，仿佛身旁该有个人陪他一起看；可他独自一人，也什么都没说。你将一块树妖残骸扔到他脚边，问他报酬备好了没有。他递来一只先前被遮住的钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%几个伐木工看见你们与那些东西交战，已经把经过告诉我了。我原本还不太信真有树妖。会杀人的树，听着像是哄小孩的迷信故事。看来，我还有不少东西要学。干得好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%}

40bc6e3036d3e7ec2c9c.source: Rid the town of living trees
40bc6e3036d3e7ec2c9c.translation: 替城镇除掉了活树怪物

7a61f4b46e9741e664ea.source: Hunt down Serpents in the wetlands %direction% of
7a61f4b46e9741e664ea.translation: 前往%direction%面的湿地追猎巨蛇，参照地点：

151c9e3df96b3b6119b6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes you into his room which is a space of ultimate luxury - there are numerous fineries ranging from silks, pelts, women, and gems. So many gems.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, about time you'd come here. We have an economic matter that needs settling. Serpents are nastily assailing the population near wetlands %direction% of here. But more importantly, we desire the scales of these serpents. They make the utmost...%SPEECH_OFF%The man kisses his fingers.%SPEECH_ON%Bags and shoes. Look at these women, do they not show their desire for said scales?%SPEECH_OFF%The women are staring at their hands or talking amongst themselves. The Vizier claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Handbags, my sweet, beautiful doves, handbags made from serpent scales! Yes, smile. There you go. See? How hard was that? Alright, Crownling. The offer to return these scales is %reward% crowns. For such a price do you agree to dispatch yourself upon this task?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% petting a wildly tall bird with pink feathers and long black legs. He is feeding it crickets, which the bird doesn't seem to much care for.%SPEECH_ON%Ahh, I have spoiled you, Little Doveling.%SPEECH_OFF%He begins to feed the strange creature long silvered fish which he pulls, alive, out of a golden bucket. He talks without looking at you as the bird gulps down fish after fish.%SPEECH_ON%We here have acquired knowledge that serpents are in the wetlands %direction% of here. The scales of said serpents is worth a considerable amount, not in gold, of course, but in our fine tastes. We desire that you head there and herd said scales into your backpacks and trot your little legs back here.%SPEECH_OFF%The man raises a finger, raises it even further, then points it at the tiles beneath his feet.%SPEECH_ON%And for that, we will pay you %reward% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%The pink bird prunes itself and seemingly stares at you in the stead of its caretaker. | %employer% is setting on what seems like the ledge of a sauna, but his feet are buried in the hands of women laying in what is some sort of indoor aqueduct. They are using reeds to breathe, and from what you can tell they are massaging the man's feet. It is an absurd sight, but the Vizier pays it as much mind as he does you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah the Crownling arrives. We desire, as we always have desired, the scales of serpents for which we use to gild our luxuries. These scales can be found upon the serpents, who themselves, hmmm, yes, can be found %direction% of here. In the, ahhh, wetlands.%SPEECH_OFF%The man leans back and briefly raises his toes out of water. They wiggle as he stares at you.%SPEECH_ON%The offer is %reward% crowns, are you in agreement with such a fine, fair offer?%SPEECH_OFF%}
151c9e3df96b3b6119b6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer%将你迎进房间，里面奢华到了极点：丝绸、皮毛、女人、宝石，应有尽有。尤其是宝石，多得惊人。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，你总算来了。我们有桩生意上的事需要解决。这里%direction%的湿地附近，巨蛇正在凶残地袭击居民。不过，更要紧的是，我们想要这些巨蛇的鳞片。用来制作那种最绝妙的……%SPEECH_OFF%男人亲吻了一下自己的指尖。%SPEECH_ON%包和鞋。看看这些女人，难道她们还没流露出对蛇鳞的渴望吗？%SPEECH_OFF%女人们不是低头看手，就是彼此闲聊。维齐尔拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%手提包，我甜美、漂亮的小鸽子们，用巨蛇鳞片做的手提包！对，笑一笑。这就对了。看见了吗？有那么难吗？好了，克朗客。把蛇鳞带回来，酬金%reward%克朗。这个价钱，你愿意接下差事吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正抚摸一只高得惊人的鸟，粉红羽毛，漆黑长腿。他喂它蟋蟀，鸟却似乎没多大兴趣。%SPEECH_ON%啊，我把你宠坏了，小鸽儿。%SPEECH_OFF%他改从金桶里捞出一条条细长的银鱼，活着喂给这只怪鸟。鸟接连吞鱼，他一边说话，眼睛却不看你。%SPEECH_ON%我们已经得知，这里%direction%的湿地中有巨蛇出没。这些蛇的鳞片价值不菲，当然，我指的不是黄金，而是它们符合我们的高雅品味。我们希望你前往那里，将鳞片收进背包，再迈着你的小腿跑回来。%SPEECH_OFF%男人竖起一根手指，又举高些，最后指向脚下的地砖。%SPEECH_ON%为此，我们会付你%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%粉红色的鸟梳理着羽毛，似乎代替照料它的人，打量起你来。 | %employer%坐在一处像是蒸浴池边沿的地方，双脚埋在女人们的手中。那些女人躺在一道室内水渠里，用芦管呼吸。依你所见，她们是在替他按摩双脚。这景象荒唐至极，维齐尔却毫不在意，正如他并不在意你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，克朗客来了。我们想要巨蛇的鳞片，一向都想要，用它们装点我们的奢华生活。这些鳞片长在巨蛇身上，至于巨蛇，嗯，对，就在这里的%direction%。在那片，啊……湿地。%SPEECH_OFF%男人向后靠了靠，将脚趾短暂地抬出水面，一边扭动，一边看着你。%SPEECH_ON%出价%reward%克朗，如此优厚、公道的条件，你同意吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

61f26e1cac3fbed9ec48.source: {This doesn't sound like our kind of work. | That's not the kind of work we're looking for.}
61f26e1cac3fbed9ec48.translation: {听起来，这不是我们干的活儿。 | 这不是我们要找的活儿。}

8f014ff807419a6f77cc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{You find a long sheath of dried scales, fat enough to stick your arm through, an unsettling sight as it is a feeling. The serpents are no doubt not far from these husks. | A man with green chew in his mouth stops you. He has a dagger sheathed in his belt, it has scales for a handle and there's a golden snake head for a pommel.%SPEECH_ON%Serpent hunters, are ya? I'd do it myself, as you can tell my fascinating swagger and my delicious dagger, but alas, I now prefer to watch others at work. I'll say this much, they are quite close, these little snakes.%SPEECH_OFF%You bid the man farewell as fast as you can. | There's a few children playing in a swampy puddle, mud caked up to their knees and elbows alike. They look at you and ask what you're up to. When you state your business, the kids laugh.%SPEECH_ON%Serpents! They're small game! Nothing with which to concern yourself as far as I am concerned.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find a pile of snake skins wrapped around a wetland's tree trunk. The serpents no doubt used the trunk to shed the scales. And the size of the scales, each one far bigger than an arrowhead, are enough evidence you need that the serpents are close.}
8f014ff807419a6f77cc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{你发现一条长长的干蛇蜕，粗得能将整条胳膊伸进去。无论看着还是摸着，都让人心里发毛。巨蛇无疑就在这些空皮囊附近。 | 一个嘴里嚼着绿色草叶的男人拦住了你。他腰带里插着一把带鞘匕首，柄身覆鳞，柄端饰着一颗金色蛇头。%SPEECH_ON%猎蛇的，是吧？我本来可以亲自出手，你们看看我这迷人的派头，再看看这把漂亮的匕首，就该明白了。不过嘛，我现在更喜欢看别人干活。就告诉你们一点：这些小蛇，离这里可近得很。%SPEECH_OFF%你赶紧与他道别，能有多快就有多快。 | 几个孩子在泥泞的水洼里玩耍，膝盖和手肘都糊满了泥。他们望着你，问你来干什么。你说明来意，孩子们便笑了。%SPEECH_ON%巨蛇！小意思！要我说，压根不用放在心上。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你发现湿地的一棵树干上缠着许多蛇蜕。巨蛇显然借着树干摩擦蜕皮。那些鳞片，每一片都比箭头大得多，光凭这一点便足以确定：巨蛇就在附近。}

527276dc503a6083e7b9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_169.png[/img]{The last of the serpents is dead. You step on its head, then raise your foot realizing it's actually the tail. You step along the length of the snake and get to its head and there chop it clean off. It's a lot easier now that it's not writhing and slipping about. %employer% will be wanting to see you return with the head and all the scales with it. | You go around the field slinging snakes into a knapsack, the body of which bulges with their girth, and even in death they seem to writhe amongst each other in the sack. Having collected each serpent, you ready a return to %employer%. | The serpents are all dead, strongly indicated by their unmoving status. Just to be sure, though, you go around chopping all their heads off. Sufficiently assured nothing can survive such strokes of damage, you sling the serpents into a knapsack and ready a return to %employer%.}
527276dc503a6083e7b9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_169.png[/img]{最后一条巨蛇死了。你踩住它的脑袋，又抬起脚，才发现那其实是尾巴。你沿着蛇身走到头部，将蛇头一刀砍下。如今它不再扭动滑窜，这活儿轻松多了。%employer%想必正盼着你带回蛇头，还有全部蛇鳞。 | 你在战场上走了一圈，将蛇尸扔进背囊。粗大的蛇身把袋子撑得鼓鼓囊囊，明明已经死了，它们却仿佛还在袋里彼此缠动。收齐所有巨蛇后，你准备回去见%employer%。 | 巨蛇全都死了，最有力的证据，就是它们一动也不动。不过，为了保险，你还是挨个砍掉了它们的脑袋。确信没有什么东西受了这种伤还能活下来，你便将蛇尸扔进背囊，准备回去见%employer%。}

d5dc53e9594a7a541067.source: Let's be done with this, we have crowns to collect.
d5dc53e9594a7a541067.translation: 赶紧了结这件事，我们还得去领钱。

e700582f7cfb27a38749.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_129.png[/img]You see the first serpent writhing about what looks like a fallen wetland tree. As you gain on the snake, you realize there are a few more sneaking about. And then you realize the tree they've taken to is no tree at all: its girth shifts and rolls over, and you see the scales, fat as your own hand, glisten in the light, and the lindwurm rears its head and turns it round, its sharp eyes focusing with slimming blackness, and then it opens its maw and roars, the wetland water rippling as its growl sears across the surface.
e700582f7cfb27a38749.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_129.png[/img]你先看见一条巨蛇，正绕着湿地里一根倒木般的东西蜿蜒。走近后，才发现还有几条在附近游动。接着你又明白，它们缠绕的根本不是树：那庞大的身躯扭动、翻转，巴掌大的鳞片在光中闪耀。林德蠕龙昂起头，转向你，锐利的黑色瞳孔渐渐收窄，随后张开巨口咆哮，声浪掠过水面，震起层层涟漪。

34f0d560deee96ef1719.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_149.png[/img]{The wetlands are not ordinarily home to caravans, so it of some surprise that you find one with all its guards running about. You at first think they are unloading goods, that perhaps they're bandits who have arrived at their secret bolthole, but as you near you see one guard get wrapped up in a curling, murderous snake and fall down. Another guard turns around a serpent's maw claps over his head. The merchants are under attack!}
34f0d560deee96ef1719.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_149.png[/img]{商队通常不会待在湿地里，因此，你发现一支护卫四处奔跑的商队时，颇为惊讶。起初你以为他们在卸货，或许是一群回到秘密窝点的土匪；可走近后，一名护卫被凶猛盘绕的巨蛇缠住，倒了下去。另一人刚转头，脑袋便被蛇口一口咬住。商人们正在遭受袭击！}

ad9f041ac5ab8209800c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_169.png[/img]{The battle over, the head of the caravan comes to you personally.%SPEECH_ON%I thank you, Crownling. A slave to the coin you may be, but not without a chain or two adorned upon what we all wish we had, a sense of doing good.%SPEECH_OFF%Well, you were just here for the serpents and the caravan was but happenstance, a welcome supplement of live bait that kept the monsters off your own men. You're just about to tell him this, but he cuts you off with a bag of treasures in hand.%SPEECH_ON%As reward for your intervention, Crownling. May your road to the coin be ever more gilded.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you shake his hand and then go about collecting the serpent scales. The merchant asks if he may have one, but with a hand on your sword you tell him this is not a trading post he has stopped at. He gets the message.}
ad9f041ac5ab8209800c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_169.png[/img]{战斗结束，商队首领亲自来见你。%SPEECH_ON%多谢，克朗客。你或许是钱币的奴仆，但你身上的锁链，也不全系在钱上，还有一两根，系着我们都希望自己拥有的东西：行善之心。%SPEECH_OFF%其实，你只是来猎巨蛇，碰上商队纯属偶然。多了这么一批活饵，怪物便没去咬自己的弟兄，倒也算件好事。你刚想告诉他，商队首领却举起一袋财物，抢先开了口。%SPEECH_ON%这是你出手相助的酬谢，克朗客。愿你求财之路，今后更添金光。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，与他握手，随后开始收集巨蛇的鳞片。商人问能否给他一片，你却将手搭上剑柄，告诉他，这里可不是供他讨价还价的商站。他明白了。}

d46a26bc09a717ba21b8.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{A flock of women rush you. There are far too many, and the door to %employer%'s room appears and disappears, winking behind a flurry of silken scarves, flittering feathers, glistening jewelry, and the general swirling and throwing of hair finer than any you've ever seen. There is also the noise which is of considerable distraction.

 You are practically robbed of the scales and, being in the Vizier's place, do not exactly resist the purloining. As the women scatter away giggling, a much older woman is left in the wake. She holds out a satchel of crowns, your payment.%SPEECH_ON%The Vizier does not wish to speak with you, Crownling. He thinks it beneath him.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if it is beneath her to meet with you. She nods.%SPEECH_ON%It is, but I'd rather find myself beneath a task, than beneath the Vizier himself. Have a fine day, Crownling, and may your road to the coin be gilded.%SPEECH_OFF% | You are relieved of the serpent scales by a horde of helpers. The Vizier is at their command, staring quite sternly from the rear of the room. As they depart, he raises his hands and claps. Four helpers come over carrying one satchel. You think you are being surprised with extra pay, but when they hand it off you can hold it just fine all by yourself. You look over the lid to see the Vizier grinning sheepishly. You take the %reward_completion% crowns and make your leave. | On the Vizier's grounds, the serpent scales do not stay in your hands for long. You find a series of helpers that all rush to his side to come and relieve you of the goods. The Vizier himself is nearby, you just know it, probably watching from a window of some sort or through a door portal. But you never really see him. You do see his coin, though, in a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns as given by a shy helper.%SPEECH_ON%From our grace, into your graces.%SPEECH_OFF%The servant says, and then he trots away and is gone just like that.}
d46a26bc09a717ba21b8.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{一大群女人朝你涌来。人实在太多，丝巾翻飞，羽饰颤动，珠宝闪耀，满头秀发旋转、甩动，那发质好得你生平仅见。%employer%的房门在这一片纷乱后时隐时现，像是在眨眼。再加上那阵喧闹，实在令人分神。

你手里的蛇鳞几乎是被抢走的。不过，身在维齐尔的地方，你也没怎么反抗这场劫掠。女人们嬉笑着散去，只留下一位年长许多的妇人。她递来一袋克朗，那是你的报酬。%SPEECH_ON%维齐尔不愿与你交谈，克朗客。他觉得有失身份。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，与自己见面，是否也让她有失身份。她点头。%SPEECH_ON%是。不过，我宁可为一桩差事屈身，也不愿躺在维齐尔身下。祝你安好，克朗客，愿你求财之路遍镀金光。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群帮工接过你带来的蛇鳞。维齐尔站在房间后方，神色严厉地盯着他们。众人退下后，他举起手，拍了拍。四个帮工走过来，共同抬着一个钱袋。你以为他竟意外地多给了酬劳，可袋子一交到手里，你独自拿着便绰绰有余。你越过袋口望去，维齐尔正讪讪地笑。你收下%reward_completion%克朗，告辞离开。 | 到了维齐尔府上，蛇鳞没能在你手里多留片刻。帮工接连赶来，取走货物，又匆匆送往主人那边。维齐尔本人肯定就在附近，你知道的。多半正从某扇窗或门孔后看着你，可你始终没见到他。不过，他的钱倒是见到了：一个腼腆的帮工递来袋子，里面装着%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_ON%这是敝主的恩赏，愿您笑纳。%SPEECH_OFF%仆人说完，便小跑着离开，转眼没了踪影。}

97b48e3f358ec82162f3.translation: 一只或多只步履沉重的巨人。

7c25f51b62d8b077a9ac.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{When you enter %employer%'s room you find the man stooped beside his window, looking out it with nearly conspiratorial flinching. His eyes slim and open wide and slim again. He snaps a curtain over the window and jerks his head to look at you.%SPEECH_ON%You didn't happen to see a very angry woman heading my way, did you? Ah, nevermind it. Look at this.%SPEECH_OFF%He tosses you a scroll which you unfurl. There's a crude drawing of what looks like a man hunched over an ant or some insect. You can't really tell. %employer% claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Local farmers are reporting missing livestock. All they found were footprints large enough for a man to lay a coffin in. Sounds like hearsay and rumormongering to me, could be rivals trying to hide their misdoings, but I'll leave you to it. Search the surrounding lands and see what you find. If you come upon an actual giant I think you know what do.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% sitting at his desk and seemingly in congress with half the village's farmers. They're hunched over scrolls and streaking lead prints over the papers, drawing up what look like giants or fat men with horns. One man is doodling a stick figure farking another stick figure. %employer% throws you a more prescient page upon which is the visage of a monster.%SPEECH_ON%These fine gentlemen tell me that a giant is afoot. I do not wish to doubt the concerns of my peers and so I request your services, sellsword. The money's on the table, all you need to do is search the area round %townname% and find this beast. What say you?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% staving off a throng of peasants. They've entered his room with pitchforks and unlit torches, which he must constantly warn them not to light given the all-wood architecture. Seeing you, %employer% calls out like a drowning man yelling for a raft.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! By the gods get over here. These fine folks state that there is a beast afoot.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the peasants stomps his pitchfork into the ground.%SPEECH_ON%Naw, no ordinary beast, but a monster ya? A giant! A biggun. A big ol' giant. Out there. Right out that way. I seen it.%SPEECH_OFF%With a sigh and a nod, %employer% butts back in.%SPEECH_ON%Right. So, I'm willing to offer you payment to seek this giant out. Are you up to the task?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is at his desk with his head in his hands. He's mumbling to himself.%SPEECH_ON%Monster this, beast that. 'Oh my chicken got taken', oh maybe you should consider putting it in a pen you damned piece of - oh hi sellsword!%SPEECH_OFF%The man rises from his chair and throws you a piece of paper. There's a crude drawing of a large headed beast on it.%SPEECH_ON%Folks are reporting there's a giant roaming around these parts. I'll pay good money to see these reports investigated properly, and of course good money to see the beast slain properly as well. Are you up for it? Please say yes.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% reluctantly welcomes you into his room, pretending that he doesn't need your help, thought it's clear he'd rather not want it at all.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, mercenary. It's not often a place such as %townname% would seek out men of your ilk, but I'm afraid there have been sightings of unholds scouring these lands, stealing enough livestock that the townsfolk have put in the coin to fetch a man such as yourself. Are you interested in hunting down this foul creature?%SPEECH_OFF%}
7c25f51b62d8b077a9ac.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{走进%employer%的房间时，你看见他缩在窗边，鬼鬼祟祟地向外窥探。双眼眯起，又睁大，再眯起。他猛地拉上窗帘，转头看向你。%SPEECH_ON%你来的时候，没碰见一个怒气冲冲、正往我这里走的女人吧？啊，算了。看看这个。%SPEECH_OFF%他扔来卷轴，你展开一看，上面画得粗糙，像是一个人弯腰俯视蚂蚁或别的虫子，实在难以分辨。%employer%拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%当地农民报告说，牲畜失踪了，只找到一些脚印，大得足够放下一口棺材。我觉得像是道听途说、煽风点火，也可能是仇家想掩盖自己干的坏事。不过，交给你查。到周围看看，有什么发现再说。真要碰上巨人，我想你知道该怎么办。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%坐在桌后，仿佛正与半个村的农民议事。众人伏在卷轴上，用铅笔划来划去，画出些巨人，或是长角的胖子。有个人还在涂画两个交媾的火柴人。%employer%挑出一张更像回事的纸扔给你，上面是一张怪物的脸。%SPEECH_ON%这些好乡亲告诉我，有巨人在附近出没。我不愿怀疑他们的担忧，因此想请你效劳，佣兵。钱已经备好，你只需搜索%townname%周边，找出这头野兽。你怎么说？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正费力应付一群农民。他们拿着草叉和未点燃的火把闯进房间，屋子全是木头造的，他只得不断提醒，千万别点火。看见你，%employer%立刻高声呼救，活像溺水者望见了木筏。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！诸神在上，快过来。这些好乡亲说，附近有野兽出没。%SPEECH_OFF%一个农民将草叉往地上一顿。%SPEECH_ON%不，不是普通野兽，是怪物，懂吗？巨人！大家伙！老大一个巨人，就在外头，就那边。我亲眼见的。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%叹口气，点点头，插话道：%SPEECH_ON%是。所以，我愿意付钱，请你把这个巨人找出来。你接得下吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%双手抱头，坐在桌后自言自语。%SPEECH_ON%一会儿怪物，一会儿野兽。‘哎呀，我的鸡被抓了。’哎呀，你他妈怎么不先把鸡关进笼子，你这该死的……哦，佣兵，你好！%SPEECH_OFF%男人从椅子上站起，扔给你一张纸，上面粗粗画着一只大脑袋怪兽。%SPEECH_ON%乡亲们说，有巨人在附近游荡。我愿出一笔好价钱，请人认真调查。当然，要是能将野兽杀掉，也会厚酬。你愿意干吗？拜托，说愿意。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%不情愿地将你迎进房间，装出一副不需要帮助的样子，不过看得出来，他其实只是希望自己不必找你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵。像%townname%这样的地方，平时很少求助于你们这种人。不过，恐怕有人看见巨魔在这一带横行，掠走的牲畜太多，镇民终于凑了钱，要请你这样的人来。你愿意猎杀这头恶兽吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

0b61769798ad03fdd961.source: {Fighting giants won't come cheap. | The %companyname% can help for the right price. | Let's talk crowns.}
0b61769798ad03fdd961.translation: {对付巨人，价钱可不会便宜。 | 价钱合适，%companyname%就能帮忙。 | 谈谈克朗吧。}

b31a5abb7821cc3c3ece.source: {This doesn't sound like our kind of work. | This won't be worth the risk.}
b31a5abb7821cc3c3ece.translation: {听起来，这不是我们干的活儿。 | 这不值得冒险。}

2a5a633b1577f2d99863.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{%randombrother% returns from his reconnoiter. He reports that a nearby farm has been destroyed, a hole blown through its roof likened to someone kicking an ant pile. You ask if there are survivors. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of a sort. A young lad who refuses to speak a word. A woman who kept yelling at me to git. That aside, no. They're survivors by circumstance and good luck. This world won't permit them being here much longer.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the sellsword to keep the judgments to himself and get the company moving forward again. | You find a half a cow beside the path. It has not been butchered so much as pulled apart unevenly and with great violence. Much of its innards have slopped to the ground in a pile. Footprints the size of graves lead away. The trail of carnage goes through a fence which lays sundered and further down the way you can see the wreckage of a barn. %randombrother% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%All we're missing is a giant pile of shit.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him to check his boot. | A few peasants on the road warn you off.%SPEECH_ON%Get on out of here! That armor won't save you from a single lick!%SPEECH_OFF%You ask them about the unhold and they garner up a great description of a monstrous giant which tore through the land not long ago. It appears you're on the right track. | The unhold has left a giant mess in its wake. Stomped livestock, others broke apart and slurped like honeysuckles. Chickens mill about pecking the ground, a farmer keeping watch of them. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Just missed the show.%SPEECH_OFF%Looks like you're getting close.}
2a5a633b1577f2d99863.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{%randombrother%侦察归来，报告说，附近一座农场被毁了，屋顶破了个大洞，像蚁堆被人一脚踢开。你问有没有幸存者，他点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%勉强算有。一个年轻小子，半句话也不肯说。一个女人，只顾着冲我喊，叫我滚。除此之外，没有了。他们全凭偶然和运气活下来，这世界恐怕容不了他们多久。%SPEECH_OFF%你叫佣兵把这种断言留在自己肚子里，带战团继续前进。 | 路旁躺着半头牛。它不像被屠宰，倒像被蛮力硬生生撕开，断口参差不齐，内脏大半淌到地上，堆成一团。坟坑般大的脚印一路延伸，穿过已经碎裂的篱笆；再往前，还能看见谷仓的残骸。%randombrother%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%现在就差一大坨屎了。%SPEECH_OFF%你叫他看看自己的靴子。 | 路上几个农民出声警告你们。%SPEECH_ON%赶紧离开这里！那身盔甲，连一下都挡不住！%SPEECH_OFF%你问起巨魔，他们便七嘴八舌地描述那头骇人的巨兽，说它不久前刚蹂躏过这片土地。看来，你们追对方向了。 | 巨魔经过之处，一片狼藉。有的牲畜被踩扁，另一些被撕开，像吸金银花蜜般吸干。鸡群仍在地上来回啄食，一个农夫守在旁边。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%你们刚好错过这场好戏。%SPEECH_OFF%看来，目标已经不远。}

0c8f8c6dabcde9de9ea7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_104.png[/img]{The unholds in part remind you of any group of laborers, circled around a dead fire, rubbing their bellies and looking like boulders there hunched on the ground. Of course, your arrival brings them to their feet and destroys any notion that you've anything resembling them at all, except maybe similarly sized third legs.
