The beasts growl and stomp, but they do not attack. They throw their hands out and try and shoo you away. But the %companyname% didn't come this far to quit. You draw your sword and lead the men forward. | Each unhold is enormous beyond measure. They're bewildered at the ants come to do battle with them. One scratches his head and blithely belches, freckling the company with bovine blood. They seem to recognize the steel of your drawn sword, though, and the flash of it wakes them from their satiated slumbers. After earthshaking stomps of their feet, they stride forward to run you from the land or into it. | The %companyname% stacked from leg to head still would not size up to a single unhold. Yet here you stand, waving a sword and ready to combat the tremendous monsters. They regard you with incredulous stares, not quite sure what to make of these tiny creatures so willing to confront them. One scratches his belly and flakes of molted skin the size of dogs come twirling down. Well, there's no point dwelling on it any longer. You order the company forward! | The unhold sniff you out and come charging across the land to meet the %companyname%. They look like toddlers the size of mountains, legs awkwardly trundling forward yet each step sends tremors through the earth, their maws agape and slobbering for a meal. You calmly draw out your sword and put the men into formation.}
0c8f8c6dabcde9de9ea7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_104.png[/img]{这些巨魔有几分像一群劳工，围着熄灭的篝火，揉着肚子，佝偻在地上，像一块块巨石。不过，你们一到，它们便站了起来，任何相似之处都随之烟消云散。或许，除了胯下那条腿的尺寸还算相近。怪物低吼、跺脚，却没有攻击，而是张开双手，想把你们赶走。可%companyname%走到这里，不是为了知难而退。你拔剑，带着弟兄们向前。 | 每头巨魔都庞大得难以估量。看着这些主动来打仗的蚂蚁，它们似乎颇为困惑。一头挠了挠脑袋，若无其事地打了个嗝，喷出的牛血溅了弟兄们一身。不过，它们似乎认得你拔出的钢剑。剑锋一闪，便将这些饱食后的家伙从昏沉中惊醒。它们跺得大地震颤，随即大步上前，准备把你们赶出这片土地，或者踩进土里。 | 就算让%companyname%的弟兄们头顶着脚叠起来，恐怕也比不上一头巨魔。可你仍站在这里，挥着剑，准备与这些庞然大物交战。它们难以置信地看着你，不明白这些小东西怎么会如此急着找上门。一头挠了挠肚子，脱落的皮屑竟有狗那么大，打着旋落下。算了，再琢磨也没用。你命令战团前进！ | 巨魔嗅到了你们的气味，越过旷野，朝%companyname%冲来。它们像山一样大的幼童，双腿笨拙地向前迈，可每一步都震得大地颤动。大嘴张开，口涎横流，显然盼着饱餐一顿。你平静地拔剑，命令弟兄们列阵。}

85b1ea34c6dd7576030b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_104.png[/img]{As you put the men into formation, %shouter% goes running by you and right toward the unholds. He's hooting and hollering, his arms flailing like a sea cretin drawn up by the hook. The unholds pause and stare amongst one another. You're not sure whether this should be allowed to continue...}
85b1ea34c6dd7576030b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_104.png[/img]{你正让众人列阵，%shouter%却从身旁跑过，径直冲向巨魔，一路大呼小叫，双臂乱挥，活像被鱼钩扯出水面的海怪。巨魔停下来，面面相觑。你拿不准该不该让他继续闹下去……}

7e4cdfffb344d4580f04.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_104.png[/img]{Against better judgment, you let %shouter% go. He doesn't stop for nothing, like he was chasing down a throng of beautiful women undressing just for him. Shockingly, the unholds take a step back. They start to retreat one by one until only a lone giant remains.

%shouter% runs up to its feet like a yapping dog and lets forth some atavistic scream so hoarsely made that you wonder if every ancestor of the earth buried or otherwise had heard it. The unhold slings an arm before its face as though to shield it, then starts stepping back, further and further until it's gone! They're all gone!}
7e4cdfffb344d4580f04.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_104.png[/img]{明知这主意不靠谱，你还是放%shouter%去了。他一往无前，仿佛正追着一群专为他宽衣解带的美人。令人吃惊的是，巨魔竟后退了一步。随后，它们一个接一个地撤开，直到只剩最后一头。

%shouter%像条叫个不停的小狗，冲到巨魔脚边，发出一声原始而沙哑的怒吼。你不禁怀疑，这世上所有祖先，不论是否已经入土，都听见了这一嗓子。巨魔抬起胳膊，像要护住脸，接着开始后退，越退越远，直到彻底消失！它们全走了！}

89bf0dd9840bee50b912.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_104.png[/img]{Against better judgment, you let %shouter% go. He doesn't stop for nothing, like he was chasing down a throng of beautiful women undressing just for him. Shockingly, the unholds take a step back. They start to retreat one by one until only a lone giant remains.

%shouter% runs up to its feet like a yapping dog and lets forth some atavistic scream so hoarsely made that you wonder if every ancestor of the earth buried or otherwise had heard it. The unhold slings an arm before its face and then throws it down and swats %shouter% away. The man goes cartwheeling through the air and his screams go with him like a rabbit stolen up by a hawk. His shouts somersault back to earth in an echo of dizzying whoops and he lands with a hardy thud. The giant jiggles with an earthen chuckle. It's amusement catches the attention of the departed unholds who all turn around and start to return.}
89bf0dd9840bee50b912.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_104.png[/img]{明知这主意不靠谱，你还是放%shouter%去了。他一往无前，仿佛正追着一群专为他宽衣解带的美人。令人吃惊的是，巨魔竟后退了一步。随后，它们一个接一个地撤开，直到只剩最后一头。

%shouter%像条叫个不停的小狗，冲到巨魔脚边，发出一声原始而沙哑的怒吼。你不禁怀疑，这世上所有祖先，不论是否已经入土，都听见了这一嗓子。巨魔抬臂挡在面前，随即向下一挥，将%shouter%拍飞出去。男人在空中翻滚，惨叫跟着他一路飞，像只被鹰抓上天的兔子。那些叫声翻着跟头回荡下来，绕得人头晕，最后，他砰地重重落地。巨魔发出大地般低沉的笑，浑身肉都在颤。它笑得开心，竟把已经离开的同伴也吸引住了。那些巨魔纷纷转身，又走了回来。}

a93bb3024d227a0bda75.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_113.png[/img]{The unholds slain, you order the men to take what trophies they can as proof of your work, and possibly as something to use for yourself. If man can make leather from a cow, surely there's something worthy of giants such as these? Either way, %employer% will be waiting. | With the giants slain to the last, %employer% should be awaiting your return now. His town will be forever safe now and no longer require the services of sellswords such as yourself. You dwell on the thought until you start a laughing fit to which none of your men understand. You tell them to ignore it and round them up for the return trip. | The ghastly monsters put up a hell of a fight, but they were no match for the collective strength, smarts, and sheer balls of the %companyname%. You tell the men to take what trophies they can and to prepare for the return march to %employer%. | With the last of the unholds slain, you round up the men. %randombrother% is found jumping on one's belly and seems disappointed when you tell him to quit it and get down. %employer% will be looking for killers and their trophies, not a bunch of children.}
a93bb3024d227a0bda75.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_113.png[/img]{巨魔已被消灭。你命令弟兄们尽量取些战利品，既能证明战果，也许自己还能派上用场。既然牛皮能制成皮革，这样的巨兽身上，想必也有值得利用的东西。无论如何，%employer%还在等你。 | 巨人已被尽数消灭，%employer%应该正等着你们回去。从此，他的镇子便可永享太平，再也不需要你这样的佣兵。你琢磨着这个念头，终于忍不住笑得停不下来，弟兄们却全都莫名其妙。你叫他们别在意，集合队伍，准备返程。 | 这些骇人的怪物打得凶狠，可面对%companyname%合在一处的力量、头脑与胆量，仍不是对手。你让弟兄们尽量收取战利品，准备启程回去见%employer%。 | 最后一头巨魔也死了，你召集众人，却发现%randombrother%正在一头巨魔肚子上蹦跳。你让他停下、赶紧下来，他似乎还很失望。%employer%等的是杀手与战利品，可不是一群孩子。}

2499bda29409cc2d7427.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_113.png[/img]{With the giants slain, you get the men ready for a return to %employer%, but %randombrother% fetches your attention with a bit of quiver in his throat. You head on over to see him standing before one of the felled unholds. He points across its flesh which has been torn asunder in slices and hangs like the ears of a corn stalk. The damage is far beyond the ability of your own weaponry. The sellsword turns and looks past you with his eyes widening.%SPEECH_ON%What do you imagine did that?%SPEECH_OFF%Further along the skin are concave scars shaped like saucers with punctures rent right into the holes. You climb atop the unhold and crank your sword into one of these divots, wrenching free a tooth about the length of your forearm. Along its edges are barbs, teeth upon teeth it seems. The men see this and start muttering amongst themselves and you wished you'd never saw it at all for you've no sense to make of it.}
2499bda29409cc2d7427.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_113.png[/img]{巨人已经伏诛，你正让弟兄们准备回去见%employer%，%randombrother%却叫住了你，声音微微发颤。你走过去，看见他站在一头倒下的巨魔面前，指向它的躯体。皮肉被撕成一条条，像玉米穗般垂挂。这种伤口，远非你们手中的武器所能造成。佣兵转过身，目光越过你，双眼渐渐睁大。%SPEECH_ON%你觉得，什么东西能干出这种事？%SPEECH_OFF%再往旁边看，皮肤上还有茶碟般的凹陷伤疤，凹处深深贯着刺孔。你爬上巨魔的身体，将剑卡进一处凹孔，用力撬出一颗足有你前臂长的牙。牙缘满是倒刺，仿佛牙齿上还长着牙齿。弟兄们看见后，开始低声议论。你却宁愿自己从未见过，因为你根本想不明白，这究竟意味着什么。}

dbaad04033effb8866db.source: The wilds are dark and full of terrors.

9bfb9db597218c973dd3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your return, almost immediately stating that he hasn't heard a single story of the unholds' ravaging since you left. You nod and present evidence of the reason why, the slick remains of the slain giants sputtering as you bowl them across his floor. The wood is stained as though you'd unfurled a carpet. The mayor purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%What the hell, sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF%You cock your head and raise an eyebrow. The man lets his hands fall and he bows a bit.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, no worries! All is well! Here, your reward as promised!%SPEECH_OFF% | You return to %employer% and find the man reading stories to children. He rends his hand through the air and growls like a beast. Knocking on the door, you intrude upon the theater.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, and then the ever honorable sellswords slew the monster!%SPEECH_OFF%The children cheer at your timely arrival. The mayor stands and gives you the promised reward, declaring he had a scout following your every move and he's already heard the reports of your success. He asks if you'll stick around and tell the tale for the kiddos. You tell him you don't work for free and leave the room. | You have to root about the town a while to find %employer%, the man himself found kept up in his room by a young lass who hides beneath the sheets you caught them in. The mayor gets dressed with no hesitation as to his own nakedness. He pitches a coin toward the girl and then speaks to you.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, sellsword, I've been expecting you! Your reward, as promised!%SPEECH_OFF%He gives you the satchel, but a coin slips free and runs between the floorboards. The man purses his lips a moment then runs back to the girl and snatches the coin out of her hands and drops it in the satchel. | %employer% is found arguing with peasants about unpaid taxes and how the lords of the land will get their coin one way or another. The arrival of an armed fellow such as yourself is rather apropos and sends the peons scuttling for their coin purses. You tell them to quiet down and then address the mayor to get your money. He fetches it from a drawer, pausing only to fill it to the brim by taking a coin from a peasant, and then he hands it over to you.%SPEECH_ON%Appreciate your work, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | You report to %employer% of your doings and he is, surprisingly not incredulous in the least.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, I had a scout tracking your company and he'd beaten you back to town. Every word you say mirrors his. Your pay, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%He hands you a satchel.}
9bfb9db597218c973dd3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{%employer%欢迎你归来，几乎一开口就说，自你们走后，他再没听见一桩巨魔肆虐的消息。你点头，随即拿出原因作为凭证，将那些湿滑的巨人残骸一路滚过他的地板，血水四溅。木地板染出长长一片，仿佛铺开了地毯。镇长抿起嘴。%SPEECH_ON%你搞什么，佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF%你歪头，扬起眉。他双手垂下，略略躬身。%SPEECH_ON%啊，没事！一切都好！来，答应你的报酬！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来见%employer%，发现他正在给孩子们念故事，一边挥舞双手，一边模仿野兽咆哮。你敲门，打断这出戏。%SPEECH_ON%没错，然后，那些无比高尚的佣兵杀死了怪物！%SPEECH_OFF%你来得正是时候，孩子们顿时欢呼。镇长起身，交给你答应的报酬，说他派了斥候全程跟随，已经知道你们得胜的消息。他问，你愿不愿意留下，给孩子们讲讲经过。你告诉他，自己不白干活，随后便离开了房间。 | 你在镇里找了好一会儿，才找到%employer%。他正被一个年轻女人留在房间里。被你撞见后，女人躲进被单。镇长倒毫不在意自己赤身裸体，从容穿衣，向姑娘扔去一枚硬币，再转向你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵，一直等着你呢！报酬在这里，按约定给！%SPEECH_OFF%他递来钱袋，却有一枚硬币滑出，掉进地板缝。男人抿嘴片刻，又跑到姑娘身边，从她手里夺回那枚硬币，扔进袋中。 | %employer%正与农民争论拖欠的税款，强调领主无论如何都要拿到钱。你这样一个全副武装的人到场，可谓恰逢其时，农民们纷纷慌忙摸向钱袋。你让他们安静，转向镇长，索要报酬。他从抽屉里取出钱袋，只停顿了一下，从一个农民手里拿来一枚硬币添进去，才将装满的钱袋交给你。%SPEECH_ON%辛苦了，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你向%employer%报告经过，出乎意料，他竟毫不怀疑。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，我派了斥候跟着你们战团，他比你先回镇。你说的每一句，都跟他的报告相符。这是答应你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%他递给你一只钱袋。}

e2f162e85e64092639a4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{%employer% drives his fingers up to the corners of his eye then fans them forward.%SPEECH_ON%Let me get this straight, one of your sellswords shouted the giants into a retreat?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell him the direction they went which is, rather importantly, away from %townname%. The mayor leans back in his chair.%SPEECH_ON%Well. Alright then. I guess it ain't my problem now. Dead or gone, all the same I suppose.%SPEECH_OFF%He hands you a satchel, but holds his hand on it a moment.%SPEECH_ON%You know if you're lying and they come back I'll send every messenger bird I got to speak of your honor.%SPEECH_OFF%You stand up, draw your sword, and tell him they'll have his skull to rest in when they get there. The man nods and lets the coin go.%SPEECH_ON%No bother, sellsword, only business.%SPEECH_OFF%}
e2f162e85e64092639a4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{%employer%将手指抵到眼角，又向前摊开。%SPEECH_ON%让我理清楚：你的一个佣兵，靠吼声就把巨人吓退了？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，告诉他巨魔离去的方向。最要紧的是，那个方向远离%townname%。镇长向椅背一靠。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，好吧。那大概就不再是我的麻烦了。死了也好，走了也好，应该没区别。%SPEECH_OFF%他递来钱袋，却又按住片刻。%SPEECH_ON%你要知道，如果你撒谎，它们又回来了，我会放出手里每一只信鸟，好好宣扬你的信誉。%SPEECH_OFF%你起身，拔剑，告诉他，那些鸟到时可以落进他的头骨里歇脚。男人点点头，松开钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%别动气，佣兵，生意而已。%SPEECH_OFF%}

efc04e9c5ef4eaff9ebd.source: Managed to drive off unholds all by himself

3e5557e8dd8a58884e2d.source: Failed to drive off unholds all by himself

4fe8c8cd7a3840c67af0.source: Hunt down Webknechts in the woods around
4fe8c8cd7a3840c67af0.translation: 追猎附近树林中的巨蛛，地点：

d750f812f894ca4a987d.source: A swarm of webknechts skittering about.

561b4744a35afb78fc77.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{%employer% waves you into his room. You notice that there are pitchfork-armed men keeping vigilant watch by means of grimly staring out his windows, though one of these fellows is clearly asleep against the wall. You ask the settlement's mayor what it is he wants. He gets to the point.%SPEECH_ON%Townsfolk in the hinterland are reporting monstrosities taking children and dogs and the like. Now I don't mean to give leeway to paranoia and superstition, but it sounds an awful lot like these reports are talking about spiders. Webknechts as my father would call 'em, and if it's true then it is likely they've a nest in these parts and I need you to find and destroy it. Are you interested, sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% stretching a cobweb between two forks. He turns one of the utensils and wraps the webbing around a twine. Sighing, he finally looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%I've little mind to bring sellswords to these parts, but I'm at my wit's end here. Enormous spiders are afoot, stealing livestock, pets. One lady reported her infant taken from the crib, all there being a pit of webbing where it slept. I need these horrid creatures taken care of, their nest destroyed. With proper incentive, would you be interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | You come to %employer% and your shadow alone startles the man. He sits up straight at his desk and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, I got the fits. No mind to your being here, sellsword, though you're scary enough, but word around these parts is that large spiders are afoot. I've reason to believe the stories, being that I'd gone to a farmstead and seen the large webbings and the devoured livestock. I need a man privy to absolute violence, speaking to you here, and I need such a man to find the nest of monsters and put them to an end. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF%}
561b4744a35afb78fc77.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{%employer%招手让你进屋。几个拿着草叉的男人正神情严肃地盯着窗外，警惕地守着，尽管其中一个明显靠墙睡着了。你问镇长有什么事，他开门见山。%SPEECH_ON%住在偏远地方的镇民来报，说有怪物抓走孩子、狗之类的。我不想助长疑神疑鬼和迷信，可这些说法听来，实在像是在讲蜘蛛。我父亲管它们叫巨蛛。若传闻属实，它们多半就在附近筑了巢。我需要你找到巢穴，把它毁掉。有兴趣吗，佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正用两把叉子撑开一片蛛网。他转动其中一把，将蛛丝绕在细绳上，叹了口气，终于抬头看你。%SPEECH_ON%我本不愿把佣兵招到这里，可现在实在没办法了。巨大的蜘蛛到处出没，偷走牲口和宠物。有个女人说，婴儿都被从摇篮里抓走了，睡觉的地方只剩一团蛛网。我需要有人除掉这些可怕的东西，毁掉它们的巢。只要报酬合适，你愿不愿意干？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你来见%employer%，还没开口，光是影子就吓了他一跳。他在桌后坐直，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%啊，我最近总是一惊一乍的。不是怕你来，佣兵，虽然你也挺吓人。只是这附近都在传，有大蜘蛛出没。我有理由相信那些传闻，因为我去过一处农庄，亲眼见过巨大的蛛网，还有被吃掉的牲口。我需要一个下得去狠手的人，说的就是你。我需要这样的人找出怪物巢穴，将它们消灭。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

934add81aaefc1f12883.source: {How many crowns can you muster? | Let's talk pay. | Let's talk crowns.}
934add81aaefc1f12883.translation: {你能凑出多少克朗？ | 谈谈报酬吧。 | 谈谈克朗吧。}

5f0679ed5eb21ea52a15.source: {This doesn't sound like our kind of work.}
5f0679ed5eb21ea52a15.translation: {听起来，这不是我们干的活儿。}

ae01e4a73db177d09478.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]{You stumble across a dead cow with its flesh sucked to its very bones, yet its hide does not carry any sign of being sundried. %randombrother% crouches and runs his finger among a number of puncture wounds. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%The work of a webknecht, no doubt to it. I'd say they poisoned it and then fed upon its paralyzed body. And a fresh corpse means they're close...%SPEECH_OFF% | You find a webbed corpse leaning against a lone tree. You slash the filaments away. A child's body slips out and crumples to the ground. Its face is tight to the bone, a pallid skull with the eyeballs peeking from deep in the sockets. The tongue is equally receded and there's hardly a nose at all. %randombrother% spits and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Alright. We're close. Rather, they're close. If it's solace to you folks, the boy died prior to this here state of being. Webknechts bring poison with their puncturing and no kid would stand to survive it long.%SPEECH_OFF%Well that's good. Time for the men to find these monsters. | You find a lad hiding beneath an upturned wheelbarrow. He refuses to come out, his tiny head staring out from the shelter like a pearl from a clamshell. You ask what he's doing. He frantically explains that he's hiding from the spiders and that you should go.%SPEECH_ON%Getcher own barrow. This here's mine.%SPEECH_OFF% Brandishing your sword, you tell him that it's the spiders you're looking for. The boy stares at you. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%That's a right goddam bad idea, sir. And no, I ain't a clue where'd they gone to. I was here with a caravan and do you see a caravan? No that's right you damn don't cause they all spider salad now, so git before they see you speaking to me!%SPEECH_OFF%The barrow clatters closed. You've no mind to lift it back up, though you do give it a good kick as you depart.}
ae01e4a73db177d09478.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]{你发现一头死牛，血肉已被吸得只剩皮包骨，牛皮却没有被烈日晒干的迹象。%randombrother%蹲下来，用手指沿着几处刺孔摸了摸，点头说道：%SPEECH_ON%肯定是巨蛛干的。我看，它们先注了毒，等牛身子麻痹，再趴上去吃。尸体还新鲜，说明它们就在附近……%SPEECH_OFF% | 一具裹着蛛网的尸体靠在孤零零的树上。你割开蛛丝，一个孩子的身体滑出来，软塌塌地倒在地上。脸皮紧贴骨头，活像一颗苍白的骷髅，眼球从深陷的眼窝里露出。舌头也萎缩了，鼻子几乎看不见。%randombrother%啐了一口，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，我们快到了。或者说，它们就在附近。要是这能让大家好受点，这孩子变成这副样子之前，就已经死了。巨蛛刺中猎物时会注毒，小孩子撑不了多久。%SPEECH_OFF%那还算好。该让弟兄们找出这些怪物了。 | 一个小伙子躲在翻扣的独轮车底下，怎么也不肯出来。小小的脑袋从藏身处探望，像蚌壳里露出的珍珠。你问他在干什么。他慌忙解释，自己在躲蜘蛛，叫你赶紧走。%SPEECH_ON%找你自己的车去。这辆是我的。%SPEECH_OFF%你亮出剑，告诉他，你就是来找蜘蛛的。男孩盯着你，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%先生，这他妈可真是个烂主意。而且，不，我根本不知道它们去哪儿了。我跟商队一起来的，你看见商队了吗？没错，压根没有，因为他们全成蜘蛛的凉拌菜了。所以快走，别让它们看见你跟我说话！%SPEECH_OFF%独轮车哐当一声扣下。你懒得再掀开，不过离开时，还是狠狠踢了一脚。}

96210877a0d99ec59b13.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_123.png[/img]{The last of the webknechts is dealt with, its legs gating itself as though to eternally clutch at the weapon which had slain it. You nod at the company's good work then order the whole place torched. Fires rapidly run the length of the webs, breaking bridges of filament apart and sending fiery doom to their connectors. The whole nest is consumed in the inferno and somewhere deep in its bedding you hear the shrill cry of spiderlings set alight. | You step close to the last of the webknechts and stare at its grisly maw. It carries a vicious set of mandibles for a sort of gum guard, the mouth itself a slit lined with razor sharp teeth pointed counter-current as to shred anything that tried to escape.

 You order the whole nest put to the torch. As the flames rise, there comes the cry of spiderlings somewhere in their warrens. | You ready a return to %employer%, but first have the nest torched entirely. The company stands before the flames listening to the shrill cries of spiderlings and at times laughing at the little mites scuttling around like tiny fireballs on legs. | The spiders defeated, you have the whole godsforsaken place burned and ready a return to %employer%. As the fires rise, tiny spiderlings come running out with their bodies aflame like fireflies in the night. A few sellswords take up an impromptu game of seeing who can squash the most, an affair which ends with a particularly ambitious spiderling almost setting a mercenary's pants alight.}
96210877a0d99ec59b13.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_123.png[/img]{最后一只巨蛛也被解决了。它的长腿向内合拢，仿佛要永远抱紧那件杀死自己的武器。你点头肯定弟兄们的战果，随即命令将这里付之一炬。火焰沿蛛网飞速蔓延，烧断丝桥，也将烈火送到丝桥另一端。整个巢穴陷入火海，深处某个角落，传来幼蛛被烧着时的尖叫。 | 你走近最后一只巨蛛，凝视它骇人的口部。凶恶的口器像一层护具，挡在嘴边；嘴本身则是一道窄缝，里面排列着剃刀般锋利的倒齿，专为撕碎一切试图逃脱的猎物。

你命令放火烧掉整个巢穴。烈焰升起，巢中某处传来幼蛛的尖叫。 | 你准备回去见%employer%，不过，得先把巢穴烧个干净。战团站在火前，听着幼蛛刺耳的惨叫。有时，小东西们像长腿的小火球般乱窜，还会引来弟兄们一阵笑声。 | 蜘蛛已经被击败，你让人把这片鬼地方整个烧掉，准备回去见%employer%。火势渐起，细小的幼蛛浑身冒火地奔逃，像夜里的萤火虫。几个佣兵临时比起赛，看谁踩死的最多。直到一只格外有进取心的幼蛛，险些点着某个佣兵的裤子，这场游戏才告结束。}

28a16b33399ad97a3f2d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_123.png[/img]{With the webknechts dispatched you have the company briefly search the creatures' nest, though the mercenaries are ordered to never wander alone. You muck about as well, %randombrother% at your side. Together, you spot a tree that's remarkably untouched by the webs. As you circle around, you find a knight's corpse leaning against its trunk. His hand rests atop a broken sword's pommel, the other hand is missing altogether, nothing but sleeve at the wrist with the mutilated arm couched at his belly. The corpse rests in a nest of its own making, a thicket of what look like spoiled rhubarb stalks and decayed carapaces, the broken bodies caverned and smelling of poison. %randombrother% nods.%SPEECH_ON%That's a right shame. I'd wager he would have made a sound addition to the %companyname%, whoever he was.%SPEECH_OFF%Indeed, it has all the look of a great fighter's end. You've mind to bury him, but you've no time. You tell %randombrother% to fetch what he can from the corpse and to ready a return to %employer%.}
28a16b33399ad97a3f2d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_123.png[/img]{消灭巨蛛后，你让战团在巢穴里简单搜寻一番，同时严令任何人都不许独自行动。你也四处翻找，%randombrother%跟在身旁。你们发现一棵树，竟几乎没有沾上蛛网。绕到树后，才看见一具骑士的尸体倚着树干。一只手搭在断剑柄端，另一只手已经不见了，腕部只剩空袖，残缺的胳膊蜷在腹前。他给自己堆出了一座巢，四周尽是朽烂大黄茎般的断肢，以及腐败的甲壳。那些破碎的蛛尸内部空空，散发着毒液的气味。%randombrother%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%真可惜。不管他是谁，我敢说，要是能加入%companyname%，一定是把好手。%SPEECH_OFF%确实，这怎么看，都是一位强大战士的最后一战。你想把他埋了，却没有时间。你让%randombrother%从尸体上取走能用的东西，准备回去见%employer%。}

26270ffea8440de456d7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_123.png[/img]{The battle over, you find a man dangling by webbing attached to his feet. Half of his body is bound in the filaments and more dangle from his hip like a shredded dress. Seems the spiders deserted him upon the %companyname%'s arrival. He smiles at the sight of you.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there. Mercenaries ain't ya? Yeah I see it. You've no mind being here lest it was coin that brought ya, and you fought like bastards that'd been bet on. Absolute savages.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask the man what you'll get for cutting him down. He turns his head up, his whole body then starting to swing about and at times twist him away from you entirely. He speaks, either to you or to whichever direction he's facing.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, good question! Well, you may not see it here and now, but I'm a sellsword m'self, and wouldn't you know that my company and its captain all been done stringed up and consumed whole by them spiders! Cut me down and I've nowhere else better to go then your company. That is, if you'd have me.%SPEECH_OFF%You have the man cut free and debate what to do before returning to %employer%.}
26270ffea8440de456d7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_123.png[/img]{战斗结束，你发现一个男人被缠住双脚，倒吊在蛛网上。他半边身子裹着蛛丝，更多丝缕从胯边垂下，像条撕烂的裙子。看来，%companyname%到来时，蜘蛛撇下了他。他一看见你，便笑起来。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，佣兵吧？嗯，我看得出来。要不是为了钱，你们才不会来这儿。打起架来也像是身上压了重注，玩了命地干，简直一群野人。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，把他割下来，自己能得到什么。他仰起头，整个身子便晃了起来，时不时还会转到背对着你的方向。他继续说着，有时是冲你，有时则不知冲哪儿。%SPEECH_ON%哈，问得好！你现在或许看不出来，我也是个佣兵。谁能想到，我的战团，连团长在内，都被这些蜘蛛吊起来，吃了个干净！放我下来，除了加入你的战团，我也没更好的去处了。当然，得看你愿不愿意收。%SPEECH_OFF%你让人割断蛛丝，把他放下来。回去见%employer%之前，还得想想怎么安排这家伙。}

196311367959ca337d31.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]{%employer% meets you at the town entrance and there's a crowd of folks beside him. He welcomes you warmly, stating he had a scout following you who saw the whole battle unfold. After he hands you your reward, the townsfolk come forward one by one, many of them reluctant to stare a sellsword in the eyes, but they offer a few gifts as thanks for relieving them of the webknecht horrors. | You have to track down %employer%, ultimately finding the man in a stable livery with a peasant girl. He saws upward from the hay, startling the horses which whinny and stamp their feet. Half-dressed, the man states he already has your pay and forks it over. Eyeing you eyeing the girl, he then starts to grab whatever's in reach, including from the saddlebags of stabled mounts, and hands them over.%SPEECH_ON%The, uh, townsfolk also sought to pitch in. You know, as thanks.%SPEECH_OFF%Right. For further 'thanks' you ask if he'll give you whatever's in a nearby satchel. | %employer% welcomes you back with a great clap and rub of his hands, as though you'd just brought in a turkey and not the horrifying evidence of your victory. After paying you the agreed reward, you hear some surprising news. The mayor states that the estate of a lost townsman could not be properly divvied up and, as further thanks, you're free to take what's left of it.}
196311367959ca337d31.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]{%employer%在镇口迎接你，身边站着一群镇民。他态度热络，说自己派了斥候跟在你们后面，亲眼看见了整场战斗。他付过报酬，镇民便依次走上前来。许多人不太敢直视佣兵的眼睛，但还是送上些小礼物，感谢你替他们消除了巨蛛带来的恐惧。 | 你费了些工夫寻找%employer%，最后才在寄养马匹的马厩里找到他，身旁还有个农家姑娘。他猛地从干草堆里坐起来，惊得马匹嘶鸣跺蹄。男人衣衫不整，说报酬早已备好，随即交到你手里。见你盯着姑娘，他又开始把手边够得着的东西一件件拿来给你，连马厩里坐骑的鞍袋也没放过。%SPEECH_ON%镇民们，呃，也想凑些东西。你知道，表示感谢。%SPEECH_OFF%原来如此。为了让他再‘感谢’一下，你问，旁边那只袋子里的东西，能不能也给你。 | %employer%用响亮的掌声迎接你，接着搓起双手，仿佛你带来的不是骇人的战果凭证，而是一只火鸡。付清约定的报酬后，镇长又告诉你一个意外消息：一位死去镇民的遗产始终没能妥善分配。为进一步表示感谢，剩下的东西，你可以随意拿取。}

fb1619e5f24760bb6ab4.source: You found %name% dangling from a tree, the sellsword the last survivor of a mercenary band sent to kill webknechts. He joined the company after you rescued him.
fb1619e5f24760bb6ab4.translation: 你发现%name%悬在树上。他所在的战团受雇猎杀巨蛛，最终只剩他一人生还。被你救下后，这名佣兵加入了战团。

1db65e403c9fe662eda9.source: Lost his previous company to webknechts
1db65e403c9fe662eda9.translation: 曾经的战团覆灭于巨蛛之口

69ad46a3d59b0c756ed9.source: Intercept all southern raiding parties around %objective%
69ad46a3d59b0c756ed9.translation: 截击%objective%附近的所有南方劫掠队伍

4e259b561f6dffc43841.source: Don't let them burn any locations
4e259b561f6dffc43841.translation: 阻止他们焚毁任何设施

ae874ecee90ccaf0b54f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%'s room is dark and quiet. It would be black and silent were it not for a few candles flickering and birds chirping. Standing in the shadows, the nobleman speaks.%SPEECH_ON%The southern shits have been sending raiding parties north. It is a troublesome affair, you know, to have a couple of bronzed looking mutts mucking around, looting, pillaging, killing, raping. They wish to have me draw my main forces to the rear, but I won't have it. That is why you are here, sellsword. I need you to seek out these interloping saboteurs and kill them all. There's %reward% crowns awaiting you if you're up to the task.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% in talk with his lieutenants. He has two stack of chips, one much higher than the other. He takes from the taller stack and puts it upon the smaller.%SPEECH_ON%And if I allotted this many?%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenants shake their heads.%SPEECH_ON%That is precisely what the southerners want. If we draw men from the frontline, then they will surely know and use it as the time to attack.%SPEECH_OFF%All the men suddenly look up at you. %employer% grins.%SPEECH_ON%Ah-ha, it seems our savior is none other than a mercenary! Oh, I dare say a sellsword may take care of this for us. You there, captain, I need fighters to stay around %townname% and defend it from southern saboteurs and raiders. You'll have %reward% crowns waiting a proper completion of this task!%SPEECH_OFF%The army lieutenants look hesitant to make this offer to a mercenary such as yourself, but you get the feeling times are grim. | You are directed to %employer%'s library where you find him reading over scrolls. He holds one up.%SPEECH_ON%During times such as these, what is it that you think I am reading about?%SPEECH_OFF%You guess military matters. The man shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Agrarianism. You see, I am currently in a war. But wars are not just fought with men, but with supply chains, logistics, food. And it is all these things which the homefront provides. The southern mutts understand this concept as well as we do, and they have sent raiders and infiltrators to destroy the homefront. To distract me, to distract my soldiers. I need you to root out these bastards and protect our homes, our shops, our farms. For proper completion, I will offer you %reward% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%}
ae874ecee90ccaf0b54f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%的房间昏暗寂静。若不是几支摇曳的蜡烛和窗外的鸟鸣，这里简直会漆黑无声。贵族站在阴影里，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%那些南方混蛋一直在往北派出劫掠队。一群古铜皮的狗崽子四处乱窜，抢掠、杀人、强奸，实在是件麻烦事。他们想逼我把主力调回后方，我偏不如他们的愿。所以才找你来，佣兵。我要你把这些潜入我们腹地的破坏者找出来，统统杀掉。你若办得到，就有%reward%克朗等着你。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正与几名副官商议。面前摆着两摞筹码，一摞远比另一摞高。他从高的那摞取下几枚，放到矮的那摞上。%SPEECH_ON%要是我再拨这么多人呢？%SPEECH_OFF%副官们摇头。%SPEECH_ON%这正是南方人想要的。一旦从前线抽调兵力，他们必然会得到消息，趁机进攻。%SPEECH_OFF%众人突然一齐抬头看向你。%employer%咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%哈，看来我们的救星竟然是个佣兵！要我说，这事交给佣兵，也许真能办成。那边的团长，我需要些战士守在%townname%附近，抵御南方的破坏者和劫掠队。只要妥善办完这件差事，就有%reward%克朗等着你！%SPEECH_OFF%几名军中副官似乎不太情愿，把这样的任务交给你这种佣兵。不过你看得出，局势已很严峻。 | 有人领你到%employer%的书库。他正翻阅卷轴，见你进来，便举起其中一卷。%SPEECH_ON%你猜，这种时候，我在读什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你猜是军务。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%农政。你看，我现在正打一场仗。可战争靠的不只是人，还要靠补给、运输、粮食。这一切，都由后方供给。南方那些狗东西跟我们一样明白这个道理，于是派出劫掠者和潜入者，破坏我们的后方，好让我分心，让我的士兵分心。我要你揪出这些混蛋，保护我们的家园、店铺和农田。事情办妥，我付你%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%}

18b9981c3f2b5f720e2c.source: {This may just be the right kind of work for us. | Repel invaders from the south? This here company answers the call! | Very well. Let's discuss payment further.}
18b9981c3f2b5f720e2c.translation: {这份差事，也许正合我们的本事。 | 击退南方入侵者？这支战团愿意应召！ | 很好。我们再细谈报酬。}

7e6fb0c9404bb43366e3.source: {This isn't worth it. | We're needed elsewhere. | This will take too much of our time.}
7e6fb0c9404bb43366e3.translation: {不值得。 | 别处还有事等着我们。 | 这会耽误我们太多时间。}

2529384e69fdf1473eda.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{Smoke rises in the distance. Screams beneath the clouds, and flighty silhouettes in the fires that produced them. It is the %location% at %objective%, and it has no doubt been destroyed.}
2529384e69fdf1473eda.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]{远处浓烟升起，烟下传来惨叫，火光中人影仓皇奔逃。那是%objective%的%location%，显然已经毁了。}

912abfe44eef5b99071a.source: We need to stop this before it's too late.
912abfe44eef5b99071a.translation: 必须在为时已晚之前阻止这一切。

578eb3ca98b80feaa194.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_156.png[/img]{The southerners appear as though in geographic transition, half-dressed in their own clothes and that of northern garb, while also laden with chests of pillaged loot. One man playfully twirls around in a northern wedding dress. It would seem a friendly party on approach were they not also covered in blood and ash. To battle! | You find the raiding party of northbound southerners. Judging by the blood on them, you wager they've already paved a road of chaos through the homesteaders in the hinterland. To battle!}
578eb3ca98b80feaa194.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_156.png[/img]{这些南方人看着像正在换地方，半身是本地衣裳，半身又套着北方装束，还扛满一箱箱掠来的财物。有人穿着北方婚纱，嬉笑着转圈。若非浑身血污与灰烬，远看简直像支友善的游行队伍。开战！ | 你找到了北上的南方劫掠队。从他们身上的血迹看，沿途腹地农庄恐怕已经遭了不少殃。开战！}

64250b2aa0a4e1a1f27b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{You find the last breathing southerner and grab him by his hair and hold him up for all to see. Peasants and farmers alike watch as you cut from throat to neck until his body falls free and his head holds high in your hands. The crowd cheers.%SPEECH_ON%Our savior!%SPEECH_OFF%No doubt %employer% will be happy to hear of your work. | The southerners are slain, and any who survived their injuries are set upon by the locals. It is a torturous affair, with plenty of skin flaying, cock cutting, and general bloody creativity. But you've no sympathy for the outlanders. %employer%'s awaiting payment, however, does garner a bit of interest for you. | With the last of the southerners put to the grave, you know %employer% will be more than happy to pay you what you're worth. As you depart, you find a few of the locals mutilating the corpses of the raiders, as is tradition in this part and all other parts of this world. | With a terrifying cry betraying his former sense of control in this world, the last raider is put to the blade and ended. His fellow brothers in arms are dragged about by the locals, the corpses either chopped to pieces or set afire. You watch for a time, but ultimately move on, knowing that %employer% is going to be waiting. | Luckiest amongst the raiders are the dead, for the gravely wounded are shown no mercy. The locals and homesteaders file into the battlefield to claim their victims, some even exchanging crowns for it, and the selected raiders are then defiled, mutilated, and tortured. You don't see any outright killed, and in fact in one case a healer seems to be present just to extend the suffering. It's quite the sight, but an even better one would be %employer% dropping a large reward in your coffers.}
64250b2aa0a4e1a1f27b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{你找到最后一个还在喘气的南方人，揪住头发，将他提起来，让所有人看清。农民们围观着，你从喉咙一路割过脖颈，直到身躯脱落，手中只剩高高举起的头颅。人群欢呼起来。%SPEECH_ON%我们的救星！%SPEECH_OFF%毫无疑问，%employer%听到你的战绩会很高兴。 | 南方人已经败亡，负伤未死的，也落进了当地人手里。那是一场折磨：剥皮、割去下体，种种血腥花样层出不穷。你对这些外来者没有同情。不过，%employer%那里等着你的报酬，倒让你有些兴趣。 | 最后一个南方人也已丧命，你知道，%employer%会十分乐意付给你应得的报酬。离开时，你发现几个当地人正在残毁劫掠者的尸体。这里是这般习俗，世上其他地方也差不多。 | 最后一个劫掠者死在刀下，临死前的惨叫，早没了他原先那种掌控一切的自信。他同袍的尸体被当地人拖来拖去，不是剁碎，就是焚烧。你看了一会儿，终于还是离开了，毕竟%employer%还在等着。 | 劫掠者中，最幸运的反倒是死者，重伤者得不到半点怜悯。当地百姓和农户陆续走上战场，挑选要折磨的人，甚至有人为此交易克朗。被选中的劫掠者遭到凌辱、残害和酷刑。你没见谁被直接杀死，甚至有一处还站着医师，似乎专为延长痛苦而来。这场面确实难忘，不过更值得一看的，还是%employer%把大笔报酬装进你的钱箱。}

b5df430862c30de4167b.source: Get the men ready to move out.

7c13eef9b1ce2bb37161.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]{The enemy is gone, but their work is finished. Smoke lingers around buildings burned to the ground, and those who haven't been taken as indebted to be sold down south lie dead in the streets.

There is little point in you returning to your employer, for you stand little chance to get paid for failure. Best to look for new work elsewhere.}
7c13eef9b1ce2bb37161.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]{敌人已离开，恶行却已做尽。烧成平地的房舍间仍有烟雾缭绕，没被抓作负债者贩往南方的人，都已横尸街头。

再回去见雇主也没有意义，失败几乎不可能换来报酬。还是去别处找新活吧。}

fe72d07407f6ece39f85.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_165.png[/img]{You find a farmer dead in the road with a curved dagger in his back. Nobody leaves a dagger that nice behind, and just as you suspect his murderers are still here: a group of southern assassins. They shift around like shades, and their sharpened steel blade glint with every twist and turn. To battle! | A woman hurriedly rushes to you, her shredded dress flailing, arms swaying, eyes wide, the whites of them pitted in a sea of red blood like shells on a crimson beach. Before she can say a word she grunts and drops to the ground in an instant. A dagger is in the back of her skull, and further behind her a man in black stands with a company of assassins!}
fe72d07407f6ece39f85.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_165.png[/img]{你发现一名农夫死在路上，背后插着一把弯匕首。没人会舍得丢下这样一把好匕首。果然不出所料，凶手还在附近：一群南方刺客。他们像影子般游走，每次转身挪步，锋利的钢刃都会闪出寒光。准备战斗！ | 一个女人急急奔向你，破碎的裙摆翻飞，双臂摇摆，惊恐地瞪大双眼。满脸鲜血中，眼白像散落在猩红沙滩上的贝壳。她还没来得及说话，就闷哼一声，骤然倒地。一把匕首插在她的后脑，而在她更后方，一个黑衣人正与一群刺客站在一起！}

363b571724a04c7bd8aa.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{The southern raiding party looks a collective of all the world's men. It is upon closer inspection that you realize it is because they are slavers! The mishmash of masters and slaves moves on the %companyname%, a flailing formation of trained and untrained alike. You can see that there are northern faces amongst the crowd, but sadly they are a broken lot and will sooner raise arms against the company than fight for freedom. | You come across the southerners, but they are not raiders at all - they are slavers! They've carts of women and children, and upon your discovering them the slavers hurriedly start decapitating any recently enslaved man who poses a threat while the rest of the group charges the %companyname%. With carnage in the air, you bear down on the group with impunity!}
363b571724a04c7bd8aa.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{这支南方劫掠队的人看着五花八门，仿佛把全世界的人都凑了进来。走近细看，你才明白缘由：他们是奴隶贩子！主人与奴隶混作一团，朝%companyname%逼来，受过训练和毫无训练的人挤在一起，队形乱七八糟。人群里也有北方人的面孔，可惜他们早被折断了脊梁，宁肯向战团举起武器，也不敢为自由而战。 | 你遇上了那些南方人，可他们根本不是劫掠队，而是奴隶贩子！车上装满妇女和孩子。一发现你们，奴隶贩子便急忙将新俘获、可能构成威胁的男人斩首，其余人则向%companyname%冲来。血腥气弥漫，你毫不留情地迎头杀向他们！}

fb794c08c697325a382b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{You put down the last of the southern raiders. As you order the company to collect what's of value, a couple of villagers come out with goods of their own.%SPEECH_ON%We thought it the end of the world, and yet here you are, our knights.%SPEECH_OFF%While you're not a knight, you're not averse to taking a knight's praise - and a knight's reward: the villagers give you gifts! | With the raiders dispatched, you find yourself slowly surrounded by villagers. They look haggard and afraid, yet they carry with them baskets of goods. You are offered these as rewards for saving them. They seem to confuse you for %employer%'s own soldiers, but you don't even think to reveal that you are a mercenary. You take the offerings and even tip your hat and say it's just your job, which it is.}
fb794c08c697325a382b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{你解决了最后一个南方劫掠者。正命令战团收集值钱的东西，几个村民带着自家的物资走了出来。%SPEECH_ON%我们以为末日到了，没想到各位来了，我们的骑士老爷！%SPEECH_OFF%你虽不是骑士，却并不介意领受骑士般的赞誉，以及骑士般的酬谢：村民们送来了礼物！ | 劫掠者已被消灭，你发现村民们渐渐围拢过来。他们神色憔悴，仍带着惧意，手里却提着一篮篮物资，作为你救了他们的谢礼。他们似乎将你误认成%employer%手下的士兵，你却丝毫没打算揭穿自己只是佣兵。你收下馈赠，还抬了抬帽子，说这只是分内之事。确实如此。}

90c8046bfe594dadb432.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% waves you in, though it isn't as beaming a welcoming as you'd hope. His tone is somewhere in the realm of fatherly disappointment.%SPEECH_ON%You got a couple of the southern brigandines. Not great, but not terrible either. I'll pay you per each party stopped, but I'd only wished you'd done better.%SPEECH_OFF%You almost want to apologize, but you know any sign of weakness are your end might result in some shortchanging and keep it to yourself. He pays the %reward% as earned. | %employer% has a few guards with him when you enter, though there are some faces missing amongst the crowd. The man speaks somberly.%SPEECH_ON%You did what you could, sellsword. It wasn't likely that you could have gotten all the raiders. That I realize now. I am, of course, offering a bit of rational respite for you here. For all I know I hired the wrong man, but I will not decide that this day. There is too much to rebuild. You %reward%, as agreed upon per raiding party destroyed.%SPEECH_OFF% |  You enter %employer%'s room to find your reward of %reward% crowns already accounted for and on the table. He points at it with a flippant turn of his hand.%SPEECH_ON%The raiders came, a few you took care of, the rest pillaged and looted and murdered. So. Take your pay of %reward% crowns, sellsword. It is in accordance to the quality of your work, so please do not be surprised if you find the crowns stacked a little short.%SPEECH_OFF%}
90c8046bfe594dadb432.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer%招手让你进去，迎接的神情却没有你盼的那么热切。他的语气，颇像一位对孩子失望的父亲。%SPEECH_ON%你截住了几队南方袭击者。说不上好，也不算太糟。我会按每支被拦下的队伍付钱，只是原本盼着你能干得更好。%SPEECH_OFF%你几乎想道歉，但你知道，哪怕露出一点心虚，都可能让他趁机克扣报酬，于是忍住没说。他付给你应得的%reward%克朗。 | 你进来时，%employer%身边站着几个卫兵，可人群中少了几张熟悉的脸。他语气沉重。%SPEECH_ON%你尽了力，佣兵。要你截住所有袭击者，确实不大可能，我现在明白了。当然，这话也算是给你找个说得过去的宽慰。说不定只是我雇错了人，但今天我不打算下这个结论。要重建的地方太多了。这是你的%reward%克朗，按说好的，每消灭一队袭击者算一份。%SPEECH_OFF% |  你走进%employer%的房间，发现%reward%克朗报酬已经点好，放在桌上。他漫不经心地翻了翻手，指向钱堆。%SPEECH_ON%袭击者来了，你收拾了其中几队，剩下的照样抢掠、杀人。就这样。拿走你的%reward%克朗吧，佣兵。报酬是按你干的活算的，若觉得钱堆矮了些，也不必吃惊。%SPEECH_OFF%}

018dd772fa2303d7da78.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You find %employer% not in his war room, but in his side office with a number of ladies milling about. They're attending to the cobwebs amongst the corners, filing scrolls into a bookshelf, or dusting the furniture. And they're all naked, naturally. The man opens his arms.%SPEECH_ON%I thought it well that I should celebrate, for %townname% has been saved, saved by the likes of you, sellsword!%SPEECH_OFF%He is drunk, and the women gently move out of his way as he veers about the room.%SPEECH_ON%Now... now -hic- now I assure you, that, that I did not take a loan from you %reward% crowns. It is all there -hic- there as promised. The peasantry is pleased, and I am pleased. Most pleased.%SPEECH_OFF%He gives one of the women a squeeze and she responds about as lively as a mottled rug. You grab the purse and go and a few of the lasses slip out the door with you as %employer% falls into a mumbling stupor. | You find %employer% outside his war room and in his library of which there are perhaps more shelves than books. But he seems impressed with himself all the same.%SPEECH_ON%Your work out there was splendid, sellsword. Absolutely splendid. Of course, there were casualties, but in the whole all things are where they should be and them southern shits have been sent running. With your help, our frontlines did not have to slacken to tend to the homes. Here, your %reward% crowns as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%When the man moves out of the way, you see he has stocked a freshly slickened skull on the shelf. He points at it with childish charm.%SPEECH_ON%It's one of their skulls. I'm going to drink wine out of it, or piss into it. Haven't decided yet.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is sitting at his desk with a pyramid of three skulls. His hand rests atop it as though one would be patting the head of a dog. You notice that there are still strips of flesh and even hair on them, the bleaching process presumably hurried. The man speaks happily.%SPEECH_ON%My soldiers may stay upon the frontlines because of you, sellsword. Having handled these raiders not only saved the lives of many here, but perhaps prevented the fall of the first domino in a series of many. Without your help, the fathers and brothers and sons on the front may have fallen back to tend to their families and this whole war would have gone all fucked.%SPEECH_OFF%With his free hand, he pushes forward a purse.%SPEECH_ON%Your %reward% crowns. A well earned weight of coin, I'd say.%SPEECH_OFF%He smiles grimly and cocks his head at the skulls.%SPEECH_ON%I'd think they would agree, though I must say that in this affair I will be speaking for them.%SPEECH_OFF%}
018dd772fa2303d7da78.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你没在作战室找到%employer%，却在旁边的书房里找到了他，几名女子正在屋里忙碌。她们有的扫除角落的蛛网，有的把卷轴归入书架，还有的给家具掸尘。当然，全都一丝不挂。他张开双臂。%SPEECH_ON%我想，该好好庆祝一下！%townname%得救了，是你这样的人救了它，佣兵！%SPEECH_OFF%他已经醉了，在屋内东倒西歪，女子们轻轻闪身让开。%SPEECH_ON%那么……那么，嗝，那么我向你保证，我、我可没从你的%reward%克朗里借钱花。一分没少，嗝，就按说好的。百姓满意，我也满意。十分满意。%SPEECH_OFF%他在一名女子身上捏了一把，她的反应却跟一块斑驳的地毯差不了多少。你拿起钱袋离开。%employer%陷入含糊不清的醉呓时，几个姑娘也跟着你溜出了门。 | 你在作战室外的书库里找到%employer%。这书库的架子说不定比书还多，他却仍显得十分自得。%SPEECH_ON%你干得漂亮，佣兵。真是漂亮。当然，难免有些伤亡，但总的来说一切安好，那些南方混蛋也已经夹着尾巴逃了。有你帮忙，前线便不必抽调人手回来保家。这是说好的%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%他挪开身子，你看见架上摆着一颗刚清理过、还泛着湿光的头骨。他带着孩子般的得意指向它。%SPEECH_ON%从他们其中一人身上弄来的。我打算拿它喝酒，或者接尿。还没拿定主意。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%坐在桌前，面前有三颗头骨，垒成一座小塔。他把手搭在上面，像是在抚摸狗头。你注意到骨头上还黏着肉条，甚至有头发，想必漂洗得颇为仓促。他兴高采烈地说。%SPEECH_ON%多亏了你，我的士兵才能继续守在前线，佣兵。你解决了这些袭击者，不仅救了本地许多人的命，或许还制止了一场接踵而来的溃败。没有你，那些身为父亲、兄弟、儿子的前线士兵，可能就得退回来照顾家人，整场战争也就全他妈乱套了。%SPEECH_OFF%他用空着的手将一个钱袋推到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%你的%reward%克朗。要我说，这些沉甸甸的硬币，你拿得实至名归。%SPEECH_OFF%他露出阴冷的笑容，朝头骨歪了歪头。%SPEECH_ON%想必他们也会同意。不过这件事，就只能由我替他们开口了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

01f4e0cf5d4eb5deefce.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer% restlessly walks up and down while stopping now and then to address you.%SPEECH_ON%The folks are in turmoil! Graves in the cemetery have been found opened and raided. Some simpleton claims it to be the dead rising from the graves - superstitious nonsense. It's quite obviously some graverobbers audacious enough to come to %townname% and plague us with their greedy presence!%SPEECH_OFF%He bangs his fist on the table in anger.%SPEECH_ON%Go out to the cemetery and end this nuisance once and for all!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% settles down into his chair, laughing to himself as he does it.%SPEECH_ON%Don't be alarmed, sellsword, but they say ghosts are afoot! Yes, yes, the local peasants are poisoning my mornings with constant talk of ghosts and goblins. They say that these supposed creatures are turning the cemetery upside down, raiding the graves to enlarge their army or some such nonsense. Obviously, it's just the work of some spade-wielding men intent on robbing graves for jewelry. I've seen it before.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks down at his hands, briefly chuckling.%SPEECH_ON%Anyway, I can't just let it rest because these peasants won't get off my back about it. So, to ease them, there's... you. I need you to go to the cemetery and clear out any troublemakers you find. How you do that is up to you, but I'll go ahead and suggest a good steel, if you know what I mean...%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s got a map of a cemetery on his desk. Half the plot squares appear to have been filled in with ink.%SPEECH_ON%Every square you see there has been robbed. Every night they come, and every night I can't quite seem to catch them. I'm at my wit's end here so I've decided to end this once and for all. I want you to go to that graveyard and kill every grave robbing fool you see. Got it?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s standing by his window, peering out while nursing a mug of mead. He doesn't really seem to be focused on anything in particular and even talks as if he couldn't care less about the conversation.%SPEECH_ON%Graverobbers are plundering the cemetery. Again. I'm not really asking much of you, sellsword, other than to go there and put an end to this foolish business. Go to that cemetery and kill every graverobber you see. Got it? Good.%SPEECH_OFF%}
01f4e0cf5d4eb5deefce.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer%焦躁地来回踱步，时不时停下来对你说话。%SPEECH_ON%百姓都乱了套！墓地里的坟被挖开，里面的东西也被洗劫。有个蠢货竟说是死人从坟里爬了出来，迷信的胡话！分明是一群胆大包天的盗墓贼，跑到%townname%来，拿他们的贪欲祸害我们！%SPEECH_OFF%他愤怒地一拳砸在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%去墓地，把这个麻烦彻底解决！%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%坐进椅子，自顾自地笑着。%SPEECH_ON%别吓着，佣兵，据说这里闹鬼了！是啊，是啊，本地那些农民天天大清早就跟我念叨鬼魂地精，搅得人不得安宁。说那些所谓的怪物把墓地翻了个底朝天，掘开坟墓，壮大它们的军队，诸如此类的鬼话。明摆着，不过是几个拿铁锹的人，想从坟里挖点珠宝。我从前见过。%SPEECH_OFF%他低头看看双手，短促地笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%总之，也不能放着不管，那些农民会一直缠着我。所以，要让他们安心，就得靠……你。我要你去墓地，把找到的惹事者全清掉。怎么做，由你决定，不过我倒建议用点好钢铁。明白我的意思吧……%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的桌上摊着一幅墓地地图，标示墓穴的方格，大约一半被墨水涂黑了。%SPEECH_ON%这些涂黑的格子，每一处都被盗过。他们夜夜来，我却夜夜抓不着。实在没辙了，所以我决定把这事彻底了结。我要你去那墓地，见着盗墓的蠢货就杀。明白了吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%站在窗边，端着蜂蜜酒向外张望。目光似乎没落在任何具体东西上，连说话都像是懒得搭理这场谈话。%SPEECH_ON%盗墓贼又在洗劫墓地。又来了。我对你的要求不多，佣兵，只要你去那里，把这荒唐事了结。去墓地，把看见的盗墓贼全杀掉。明白吗？很好。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1b82c8f089e665234a2e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_69.png[/img]{Crunching. Munching. The snicker-snacker of someone - or something - enjoying a good meal. As you step through the cemetery, you stumble upon a clearing filled with Nachzehrers. They're huddled over the remains of what appear to have been the graverobbers you were looking for. The hideous monsters slowly turn to you, their red eyes widening at the sight of fresh meat. | Tombstones fall over as a group of Nachzehrers clamber over them. They appear to have been having something of a feast, a few of them still gnawing on this arm or that leg, presumably the limbs of your supposed graverobbers. | You hear a shrill scream and quickly turn the corner of a mausoleum to find a Nachzehrer driving his teeth into the nape of a man's neck. The beast, blood filling his mouth so much as to pour from his nostrils, only glances up at you. Smaller Nachzehrers surround it, stepping forward to see to it that their next meal doesn't get away...}
1b82c8f089e665234a2e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_69.png[/img]{咔嚓。吧唧。有人——或者有什么东西——正在享用一顿好饭。你穿过墓地，来到一片挤满食尸鬼的空地。它们俯伏在尸骸上，而那些死者，看起来正是你要找的盗墓贼。这些丑恶的怪物缓缓转向你，一见新鲜的血肉，红眼便睁得更大了。 | 一群食尸鬼攀爬着越过墓碑，将石碑纷纷撞倒。它们似乎刚享用过一场盛宴，有几只还在啃胳膊嚼腿，想必都是那些本该由你对付的盗墓贼留下的肢体。 | 你听见一声尖叫，迅速绕过陵墓转角，正看见一只食尸鬼咬进某人的后颈。鲜血灌满那怪物的嘴，甚至从鼻孔涌出，它却只抬眼瞥了瞥你。较小的食尸鬼围在它身旁，向前逼来，准备确保下一顿饭不会逃走……}

8690518dccfde033fbcb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{The graverobbers are here, just as promised. You catch them mid-dig, your brothers jumping over tombstones with their weapons raised. | Walking into the cemetery, you find the graverobbers just as %employer% thought they might be there. They spot you just as you do them. Your men fan out with weapons drawn to stop any escape. | As you step through the tombstones, a few voices murmur over the otherside of a mausoleum. When you turn the corner, you find a group of men standing over an emptied grave. They have an open coffin before them, a few of the men taking jewelry out of it. You order your men to charge. | %employer% was right: there have been graverobbers here. You spot a number of tombs turned over and their graves dug up. The mud trails lead you to find the diggers clambering around some new work.%SPEECH_ON%Don't mean to stop you boys, but %employer% is paying pretty well to make sure these people stay in the ground.%SPEECH_OFF%}
8690518dccfde033fbcb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{盗墓贼果然在这里。你们撞见他们正在挖坟，弟兄们举起武器，跃过墓碑，扑了上去。 | 你走进墓地，果然找到了%employer%所说的盗墓贼。双方几乎同时看见彼此。你的人拔出武器，散开阵形，堵住逃路。 | 你穿过墓碑，听见一座陵墓另一侧传来低声交谈。转过墙角，一群人正围着一座挖空的坟墓，面前摆着打开的棺材，其中几人正往外拿珠宝。你命令弟兄们冲锋。 | %employer%说得没错，这里确实来了盗墓贼。好几座墓被翻得乱七八糟，坟土尽遭掘开。循着泥迹，你找到了那些挖墓人，他们正忙着下一桩活。%SPEECH_ON%本不想打扰各位，可%employer%出的价钱不错，要保证这些人好好待在地下。%SPEECH_OFF%}

61b5abd25e8c92a902bf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{The cemetery is layered in fog - that or a thick miasma given off by the dead. Wait... that IS the dead! To arms! | You eye a tombstone with a mound of soil unearthed at its base. Blots of mud lead away like a crumb trail. There are no shovels... no men... As you follow the lead, you come across a band of undead moaning and groaning... now staring at you with insatiable hunger... | A man lingers deep in the rows of tombstones. He seems to be wavering, as though ready to pass out. %randombrother% comes to your side and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%That's no man, sir. There's undead afoot.%SPEECH_OFF%Just as he finishes talking, the stranger in the distance slowly turns and there in the light reveals he's missing half his face. | You come to find many of the graves are emptied. Not just emptied, but unearthed from below. This is not the work of graverobbers...}
61b5abd25e8c92a902bf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{墓地笼罩着层层浓雾，也可能是死者散出的浓重瘴气。等等……那真是死人！拿起武器！ | 你注意到一块墓碑，底下堆着翻出的泥土。泥块一路散落，像撒出的面包屑般指引方向。没有铁锹……没有人……你循着痕迹找去，遇见一群呻吟低嚎的亡灵……如今，它们正盯着你，满眼无法填饱的饥饿…… | 一个身影徘徊在层层墓碑深处，摇摇晃晃，仿佛随时会昏倒。%randombrother%来到你身边，摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%那不是活人，团长。有亡灵出没。%SPEECH_OFF%话音刚落，远处的身影缓缓转身，光线照出他已经缺了一半的脸。 | 你发现许多坟墓都空了。不只是被挖空，而是从下面向上掘开的。这不是盗墓贼干的……}

5793216c7bc836ab88b3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{You enter the graveyard to find the graverobbers right where %employer% thought they'd be: knee deep in someone else's afterlife. Drawing your sword, you tell them to put down whatever jewelry they think they're going to make off with. One of the men stands up, arms raised, and makes his case.%SPEECH_ON%Before you kill us, can I just say something? We have a map... I know, it sounds like a lie, but just hear me out... We have a map that can lead to immense treasures. You let us go, and I'll give it to you. Kill us and well... you'll never see it. What do you say?%SPEECH_OFF% | Just as %employer% suspected, there are graverobbers trundling about the tombstones. You stop them mid-dig and ask them if they have any last words before they join their victims in the mud. One of the men pleads for mercy, stating he's got a treasure map he'll exchange for all their lives. | You stumble upon a few men trying to crack open a mausoleum door. Clinking your sword against your boot gets their attention.%SPEECH_ON%Evening gents. %employer% sent me.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the men drops his tools.%SPEECH_ON%Wait just one second! We have a map... yes, a map! And if you spare us, I will give it to you! But only if you spare us! If you don't... you'll never see that map, understand?%SPEECH_OFF% | You get the jump on the graverobbers, drawing swords as they slam shovels into the earth. One of the men, presumably sensing he's about to join the very grave he's got one foot already in, bargains with you. Apparently, the men have a map to a mysterious treasure. All you have to do is let them go and they'll let you have it. If you kill them, well, the 'map' is hidden, too, and you'll never see sight of it nor the treasures it leads to.}
5793216c7bc836ab88b3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{你走进墓地，果然发现了%employer%说的盗墓贼：他们站在没膝的坟土里，搅扰着别人的死后清净。你拔出剑，让他们放下那些自以为能带走的珠宝。其中一人直起身，举着双手，试图讨价还价。%SPEECH_ON%杀我们之前，能先听我说一句吗？我们有张地图……我知道，这听着像谎话，但先听完……我们有张通往巨大宝藏的地图。放我们走，我就把它给你。杀了我们，那……你就永远见不到它了。怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 正如%employer%所料，墓碑间确有盗墓贼活动。你在他们挖到一半时将其拦下，问他们下去陪那些被盗掘的死者之前，还有什么遗言。其中一人苦苦求饶，说自己有张藏宝图，愿用它换所有人的命。 | 你撞见几个人正试着撬开陵墓大门。你用剑轻敲靴子，声响引来了他们的注意。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，各位。%employer%派我来的。%SPEECH_OFF%其中一人丢下工具。%SPEECH_ON%先等等！我们有张地图……没错，地图！只要你饶过我们，我就给你！不过，非得放我们走才行！不然……你永远也见不到那张图，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 盗墓贼正将铁锹铲进土里，你们突然拔剑现身。其中一人似乎意识到，自己一只脚已踩进的坟墓，马上就要成了自己的埋骨地，于是开口讲价。他们似乎有张通往神秘宝藏的地图。只要放他们走，就能拿到图。可若杀了他们，那张地图也藏在别处，你就再也见不到它，更别提循图寻宝了。}

088fe2df219a3cfb836f.source: Very well, hand over the map and you may leave this place alive.
088fe2df219a3cfb836f.translation: 好，交出地图，你就能活着离开。

c7afc9b80bb042d62328.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{Maybe %employer% was just trying to kill people after some treasure? That... that makes sense, right? You decide to let the men go in exchange for a map that shows you the way to %treasure_location% %treasure_direction% from here. | %employer% didn't say anything about these men having a map... maybe he was trying to erase that knowledge? Who knows. But the temptation of treasure is too much for you and you decide to let the men go in exchange for the information. Their map reveals %treasure_location%. It lies %treasure_direction% from where you stand. | When you were a kid, you used to go on treasure hunts all the time. It's... oddly thrilling. You don't know why, but the allure of revisiting that old adventure has you letting the men go. In return, they show you the map which reveals %treasure_location%, the location of a hidden cache of... who knows? All you really know is that it is due %treasure_direction% from where you stand.}
c7afc9b80bb042d62328.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{也许，%employer%只是想杀掉几个寻宝的人？这……这么想也说得通，对吧？你决定放他们走，换取一张地图，指明前往%treasure_location%的路，那里在此地的%treasure_direction%边。 | %employer%可没说过，这些人手里还有地图……或许他想把知道这事的人都除掉？谁知道呢。不过宝藏的诱惑实在太大，你决定放他们离开，换取情报。他们的地图标出了%treasure_location%，位于你所在之处的%treasure_direction%边。 | 小时候，你常常玩寻宝的游戏。那感觉……竟让人如此兴奋。你也说不清缘由，只是重温旧日冒险的念头实在诱人，于是放走了这些人。作为交换，他们给你看了地图，上面标出%treasure_location%，那里藏着一批……谁知道是什么？你真正能确定的，只有它就在你所在之处的正%treasure_direction%方。}

c41d6e1643a74c3cfbe1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_56.png[/img]{Having slain all the undead, you find a piece of cloth that glows purple in your hand. You're not sure what it is, but for some reason are drawn to keep it. %randombrother% thinks this is stupid, but he's not the one in charge. | After the battle, %randombrother% finds a shovelhead with what appears to be a symbol burned into it. He wonders if maybe %employer%, your employer, knows something about it. You agree, taking the scrap of metal with you to see if the local man can identify it. | With the monstrosities laid low, you sheath your sword and scour the battlefield. In your search, you find an odd talisman of crow feathers and cow leather. You pocket it, figuring %employer%, your employer, might know something about it.}
c41d6e1643a74c3cfbe1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_56.png[/img]{杀光亡灵后，你找到一块布，在手中泛着紫光。你不知它是什么，却莫名想把它留下。%randombrother%觉得这主意很蠢，可做主的人不是他。 | 战后，%randombrother%找到一个铲头，上面似乎烙着某种符号。他猜，雇主%employer%或许知道些什么。你赞同，便带上这块铁片，准备问问这个本地人能否认出来。 | 怪物尽数倒下，你收剑入鞘，搜索战场。翻找中，你发现一枚用乌鸦羽毛和牛皮制成的古怪护符。你将它收进口袋，觉得雇主%employer%也许知道些来历。}

eb9771cfc285dd1795d7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{Returning to %employer%, you quickly explain that there were no graverobbers, but instead a group of undead. He seems shocked, but when you produce the artifact you found he purses his lips and solemnly nods.%SPEECH_ON%That's... that's from %necromancer_location%. We thought we could ignore that place, but it appears I was wrong. Go there, sellsword, and end that ghoulish domain's terror once and for all!%SPEECH_OFF%The man lowers the theatrics a bit.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, and I'm prepared to pay you another %reward_completion% crowns in addition to the %reward_completion% crowns for the original job, of course.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% in his study, solemnly sipping on a goblet.%SPEECH_ON%I've already heard the news. The dead are walking, oh, it's ghastly to even say it!%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and produce the artifact you found in the cemetery.%SPEECH_ON%You know anything about this?%SPEECH_OFF%The man glances at it as if he already knew you had it.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, that belongs to %necromancer_location%. We thought we could ignore the horror coming from there but... well, look. Maybe you can go there? Maybe you can destroy %necromancer_location% and set us free from its terror? Here's your original payment, as agreed upon, but if you help us with %necromancer_location% you'll get another %reward_completion% crowns. Does that sound good to you?%SPEECH_OFF% | You walk into %employer%'s room and slam the artifact down on his desk. He slaps it away with his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Where did you get that?%SPEECH_OFF%Pointing a finger at it, you press the man.%SPEECH_ON%Did you know about the undead in the cemetery?%SPEECH_OFF%He sheepishly looks away, then nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yes... I knew. They, and that artifact, come from %necromancer_location%. Some kind of dark sorcerer dwells there and he's been giving us these... problems for a while now. Please, could you go there and destroy it? Here's your payment for the original contract, but you will be compensated greatly for ridding us of that damned.. whatever he is. Let's say... another %reward_completion% crowns?%SPEECH_OFF% | You explain to %employer% that there were no graverobbers at the cemetery, nor humans of any sort for that matter. Before he can speak, you produce the artifact, holding it in the light so he can see. He quickly backs away.%SPEECH_ON%Put that down!%SPEECH_OFF%Like a voice of fire, his shout turns the artifact alight and it burns painlessly out of your very fingertips, only swirling ash all that remains. %employer% puts his head in his hands.%SPEECH_ON%It's from %necromancer_location%. A... necromancer lives there, a puppeteer that holds the strings to make the dead arise. Please, mercenary, go there and destroy it. We will be so gracious...%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses to produce a satchel of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%This is for what we originally agreed upon. But if you kill that horrid man at %necromancer_location% there will be another %reward_completion% crowns waiting for you on your return.%SPEECH_OFF% | You present the artifact you found in the cemetery. %employer% gasps at the very sight of it, but his expression quickly turns to one of somber acceptance.%SPEECH_ON%I'll be honest with you, sellsword. There is a necromancer who lives in %necromancer_location% not far from here.%SPEECH_OFF%He procures a satchel of crowns and hands it over to you.%SPEECH_ON%That is for the original job. However, I will offer another %reward_completion% crowns, everything we can muster, if you go and kill that evil man right now.%SPEECH_OFF%He leans back, looking very hopeful that you'll accept these new terms.}
eb9771cfc285dd1795d7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{你回到%employer%那里，迅速说明，墓地里没有盗墓贼，只有一群亡灵。他似乎很震惊，可等你拿出找到的古怪物件，他便抿紧嘴，郑重地点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%那……那是从%necromancer_location%来的。我们以为不去理会那里就行，现在看来，是我错了。去吧，佣兵，到那邪恶的巢穴，把这场恐怖彻底终结！%SPEECH_OFF%他稍稍收起夸张的语气。%SPEECH_ON%哦，当然，原先差事的%reward_completion%克朗照付，我还准备另加%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在书房找到%employer%，他神色凝重，正端杯慢饮。%SPEECH_ON%消息我已经听说了。死人在走动，啊，光是说出来都让人发寒！%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，取出在墓地找到的物件。%SPEECH_ON%这个，你知道些什么吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他瞥了一眼，仿佛早就知道你拿着它。%SPEECH_ON%知道，是%necromancer_location%的东西。我们以为可以不理会那里传来的恐怖消息，可……唉，听我说。也许，你可以过去一趟？也许你能摧毁%necromancer_location%，让我们摆脱它的威胁？原先说好的报酬在这里。不过，你若肯替我们解决%necromancer_location%，还能再拿%reward_completion%克朗。怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，把找到的物件重重拍在桌上。他立刻抬手将它挥开。%SPEECH_ON%你从哪儿弄到的？%SPEECH_OFF%你伸指指着它，逼问道。%SPEECH_ON%墓地里有亡灵，你早就知道？%SPEECH_OFF%他心虚地移开目光，随后点头。%SPEECH_ON%是……我知道。它们和那件东西，都来自%necromancer_location%。那里住着某种黑巫师，已经给我们惹了好一阵……这样的麻烦。拜托，你能去把那里摧毁吗？这是原先委托的报酬。你若能替我们除掉那个该死的……不管他是什么，我还会重重酬谢。比如说……再加%reward_completion%克朗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你向%employer%说明，墓地里没有盗墓贼，甚至根本没有活人。没等他开口，你就取出找到的物件，举到亮处让他看清。他迅速后退。%SPEECH_ON%放下那个！%SPEECH_OFF%仿佛喊声里带着火，那物件应声燃起，在你指尖无痛地烧尽，只剩飞旋的灰烬。%employer%双手抱住脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%它来自%necromancer_location%。那里住着一个……亡灵法师，像操弄傀儡一样，牵着线让死人站起来。求你了，佣兵，去把那里毁掉。我们一定感激不尽……%SPEECH_OFF%他停下来，拿出一个钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%这是原先说好的报酬。不过，你若杀了%necromancer_location%的那个恶人，回来时还会有%reward_completion%克朗等着你。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你展示在墓地找到的物件。%employer%一见它便倒吸一口气，不过很快，脸上就只剩认命般的凝重。%SPEECH_ON%我跟你说实话，佣兵。离这里不远，%necromancer_location%里住着一个亡灵法师。%SPEECH_OFF%他拿出钱袋，交给你。%SPEECH_ON%这是原先差事的报酬。不过，你若现在就去杀掉那个恶人，我愿再给%reward_completion%克朗。这已是我们能凑出的全部。%SPEECH_OFF%他靠回椅背，满脸期盼，等着你接受这份新的条件。}

29d320af46f569cd2d2f.source: Very well, we'll hunt that Necromancer down.
29d320af46f569cd2d2f.translation: 好，我们会追杀那个亡灵法师。

888350c8c01e2bd79166.source: No, the company's done enough here.
888350c8c01e2bd79166.translation: 不，战团在这里做得够多了。

bb3bfc462c742f77b551.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_56.png[/img]{%necromancer_location%'s been cleansed. You almost feel holy about it, but then remember you did this for pay, not some righteous cause. Not that you'd ever prefer the latter, anyway. | The necromancer is dead and you've got his head in hand. Now it's time to go tell that sap, %employer%, about it so he can pay you what you've earned. | It wasn't an easy fight, but %necromancer_location% is destroyed. The necromancer died and, like any man, fell into a pile of his own flesh and bones. Curious that his wizard tricks could raise the dead, but not be cast while being dead. Curious, but not unfortunate, either. You take the heathen's head, just in case. | You've slain the necromancer but, worried that his tricks might go beyond the grave, cut his head off his shoulders and stick it in a sack. %employer%, your employer, should be most happy to see it. | The battle over, you take a sword to the necromancer's neck and remove his head from his shoulders. It comes almost too freely, as though it wanted to be in your holding. Well, whatever the case, %employer%, your employer, will want to see it as proof of your doings here.}
bb3bfc462c742f77b551.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_56.png[/img]{%necromancer_location%已经肃清。你几乎觉得自己也沾上了几分神圣，随即又想起，此行是为报酬，可不是什么正义事业。反正，你从来也不会更喜欢后者。 | 亡灵法师已经死了，脑袋就在你手里。现在，该去告诉%employer%那个笨蛋，让他付清你应得的报酬。 | 这一仗并不轻松，但%necromancer_location%已经被摧毁。亡灵法师死后，也像任何人一样，倒成一堆血肉骨骼。真有意思，他的巫术能唤起死人，自己死了却使不出来。奇怪，不过倒是件好事。为防万一，你还是割下了这异教徒的脑袋。 | 你杀了亡灵法师，却担心他的把戏死后仍会作祟，便将脑袋从肩上割下，塞进袋里。雇主%employer%看见它，应该会很高兴。 | 战斗结束，你挥剑斩下亡灵法师的脑袋。切得未免太轻松了，仿佛它自己就想落到你手里。无论如何，雇主%employer%会想看看这件凭证，证明你在这里办妥了差事。}

940a1d639b6431da94ed.source: Time to collect payment for the head.

95e122e1c8dcf5223940.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% is grinning slyly as you return.%SPEECH_ON%Nasty business, wasn't it? I've already heard the news - it travels fast in these parts. A shame we had to do it this way, but who knows what you'd have charged otherwise for fighting these... things.

Hey... you're still getting paid.%SPEECH_OFF%He gestures to a wooden chest in the corner.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns are in there, as we agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% listens to your report then slowly leans back into his chair.%SPEECH_ON%There's been a lot of rumors concerning those... things. The dead walking about?%SPEECH_OFF%He stares at his desk, then angrily looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%Nonsense! I won't believe it. You'll get %reward_completion% crowns as we agreed upon. You will not squeeze anymore from me with these... these lies!%SPEECH_OFF%You really should've brought a head or two, but then again, a dead head looks remarkably similar to an undead one... | %employer% listens to your report of the undead and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%What a shame.%SPEECH_OFF%He nonchalantly sips at the rim of a goblet and pitches a hand to the corner of the room.%SPEECH_ON%Your pay is in that chest. %randomname% will see you out.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% clasps his hands then drops them into his lap.%SPEECH_ON%I've heard of these... things. These shuffling monstrosities. This is not good to hear that they've come to %townname%, but I suppose if they're to be anywhere, the cemetery would be best! Better than the town square, anyway.%SPEECH_OFF%He laughs nervously to himself.%SPEECH_ON%%randomname% is standing out my door with your pay. Thank you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%}
95e122e1c8dcf5223940.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你回来时，%employer%正狡黠地笑着。%SPEECH_ON%这差事不好办，对吧？消息我已经听说了，这一带传得快。可惜，只好用这种办法。否则，谁知道你去跟那些……东西作战，会开出什么价。

嘿……钱不还是照付嘛。%SPEECH_OFF%他指了指角落的木箱。%SPEECH_ON%里面是%reward_completion%克朗，按说好的数目。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%听完你的报告，缓缓靠回椅背。%SPEECH_ON%关于那些……东西，传闻可不少。死人爬起来，到处走动？%SPEECH_OFF%他盯着书桌，随后愤怒地望向你。%SPEECH_ON%胡说八道！我才不信。说好的%reward_completion%克朗，一分不少。可你别想拿这些……这些谎话，再从我手里多榨出钱来！%SPEECH_OFF%你真该带上一两颗脑袋，不过转念一想，死人的脑袋和亡灵的脑袋，看起来确实差不了多少…… | %employer%听你报告亡灵的事，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%真遗憾。%SPEECH_OFF%他若无其事地抿了口酒，抬手指向房间角落。%SPEECH_ON%报酬在那只箱子里。%randomname%会送你出去。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%交握双手，随后放到膝上。%SPEECH_ON%我听说过这些……东西，那些拖着步子走动的怪物。它们竟来了%townname%，可不是什么好消息。不过，真要挑个地方待，墓地总是最合适的！至少比镇中广场强。%SPEECH_OFF%他紧张地干笑了几声。%SPEECH_ON%%randomname%就在门外，拿着你的报酬。多谢你，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%}

4d98c783bbe8d53170bb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes you into his room.%SPEECH_ON%Did you kill them all? Is it secure?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug. %SPEECH_ON%Nobody'll be digging up graves anytime soon.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% nestled into his chair, holding a candlelight close to a well-worn scroll. He talks without looking up.%SPEECH_ON%My problem, did you take care of it?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.%SPEECH_ON%I wouldn't be standing here if I hadn't.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% tips a hand to the corner of his desk.%SPEECH_ON%Your payment. %reward_completion% crowns, as agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s talking to some of his men when you return to his room. He parts them and asks you of the task. You report that it's again safe to bury %townname%'s loved ones. %employer% smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Good. Good. Your payment.%SPEECH_OFF%He snaps his fingers and one of the men steps forward, handing you a satchel. There's %reward_completion% crowns in it, as promised.}
4d98c783bbe8d53170bb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer%迎你进了房间。%SPEECH_ON%都杀了吗？那地方安全了？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%短时间内，不会有人再去掘墓了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他窝在椅子里，举着蜡烛，凑近一份翻得破旧的卷轴。他头也不抬地问。%SPEECH_ON%我的麻烦，解决了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。%SPEECH_ON%要是没解决，我就不会站在这儿了。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%抬手指向桌角。%SPEECH_ON%你的报酬。%reward_completion%克朗，按说好的。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回到房间时，%employer%正与几个手下说话。他让众人散开，询问差事办得如何。你告诉他，%townname%的百姓又可以安心安葬亲人了。%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%好。很好。这是你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%他打了个响指，其中一人上前，将钱袋递给你。里面是说好的%reward_completion%克朗。}

34b00f8fd73a8b1089e2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You return to %employer% with the head of the necromancer. It's so incredibly light for what is ostensibly a human head.%SPEECH_ON%Is that the foul creature who has been turning up our graves with the undead?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you set the head down. The face gasps and %employer% leaps away.%SPEECH_ON%He's still alive!%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and drive a dagger through the brainpan. The necromancer's eyes turn up toward the hilt and his teeth chatter with laughter, then the eyes recede back into their sockets and a faint tendril of red smoke spools out and then there is nothing more. %employer%, shaking, sits back down and motions toward a satchel in the corner. It's your payment and it's quite heavy. | %employer% is sitting down when you enter his study, but he immediately stands and backs away at the sight of the necromancer's head dangling from your hand.%SPEECH_ON%I-I take it that... that's him? Right? That's him? It's over?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and toss the head onto the man's desk. It turns onto its face, wobbling back and forth on the pinched cheeks of a deathly grin. %employer% knocks it away with a book.%SPEECH_ON%Good. Excellent! As promised, your pay...%SPEECH_OFF%He gestures to a corner where a {wooden box | large satchel} rests. You take it, count it, and make your leave. | %employer% looks up from his book.%SPEECH_ON%By the gods, is that the necromancer's head in your hand?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and toss it to the floor. A cat unspools from its bookshelf-roost and comes down to paw at it. %employer% gets up and takes a few books from the shelf, revealing a large box. He takes it and gives it to you.%SPEECH_ON%I'd been saving this for special moments and I suppose this would be one.%SPEECH_OFF%You think it's going to be an item, maybe an amulet or something mysterious, but instead it's just a good pile of crowns. | Returning to %employer%, you've got the necromancer's head in hand and the man quickly motions for you to give it over. No qualms doing that...

%employer% lofts it up in both hands, studying it as though a man would a sick baby. After a few moments, he sets the head down in the clutching grip of a broken trident prong.%SPEECH_ON%I think it looks good there. Yes you do, don't you?%SPEECH_OFF%The man puts a thumb to the necromancer's pale chin. You clear your throat and inquire about payment, to which %employer% motions for one of his guards to come in. A satchel is brought to you from which you count %reward_completion% crowns. Satisfied, you leave %employer% to... whatever it is he's doing.}
34b00f8fd73a8b1089e2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你拎着亡灵法师的脑袋回到%employer%那里。明明是颗人头，却轻得不可思议。%SPEECH_ON%就是这个邪物，带着亡灵翻开我们的坟墓？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，放下脑袋。那张脸突然倒抽一口气，吓得%employer%猛地跳开。%SPEECH_ON%他还活着！%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，将匕首刺进头盖骨。亡灵法师的眼珠向上翻，盯着刀柄，牙齿格格作响，仿佛正在发笑。随后，眼珠缩回眼窝，一缕淡红的烟丝袅袅逸出，便再无动静。%employer%发着抖坐回去，指了指角落的钱袋。那是你的报酬，分量倒十分足。 | 你走进书房时，%employer%原本正坐着。可一看见你手里晃着的亡灵法师脑袋，他便立刻起身后退。%SPEECH_ON%我、我想……就是他？对吧？是他吧？结束了？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，把脑袋扔上他的书桌。它脸朝下翻过去，咧开的死笑挤起双颊，使整颗脑袋左右晃动。%employer%用书把它拨到一边。%SPEECH_ON%好。太好了！按约定，你的报酬……%SPEECH_OFF%他指向角落，那里放着{木箱 | 大钱袋}。你拿过报酬，数清，告辞。 | %employer%从书上抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%诸神在上，你手里拿的是亡灵法师的脑袋？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，将它扔在地上。一只猫从栖身的书架上舒展开身子，跳下来拨弄人头。%employer%起身，从架上抽走几本书，露出一只大盒子，随后拿来交给你。%SPEECH_ON%我一直留着它，等个特别的时刻。我想，现在就是了。%SPEECH_OFF%你还以为会是什么物件，或许是护身符，或某种神秘之物。结果，只是一大堆实实在在的克朗。 | 你拎着亡灵法师的脑袋回到%employer%面前，他立即示意你交出来。你当然毫不介意……

%employer%双手托起脑袋，仔细端详，像在查看一个生病的婴儿。片刻后，他把脑袋安放在一截破损的三叉戟头上，任叉齿将它托住。%SPEECH_ON%我觉得，放在这里很好看。你也觉得自己很好看，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他用拇指碰了碰亡灵法师苍白的下巴。你清清嗓子，问起报酬，%employer%便招来一名卫兵。对方送来钱袋，你数出里面的%reward_completion%克朗，满意地离开，留下%employer%继续……随他在干什么吧。}

7dcd748273d0ad911e99.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{%employer% is standing at the window when you enter.%SPEECH_ON%The songbirds seemed rather angry today. As though nothing they'd say was worth saying. I thought that was interesting. Do you?%SPEECH_OFF%He suddenly turns toward you.%SPEECH_ON%Hmm, mercenary? No? My little birds told me that the graverobbers left town. Alive. Free to go where they please, free to return as they please. What an oddity, because usually dead men aren't free to do anything. What did I ask you to make those graverobbers?%SPEECH_OFF%You hesitate. The man answers for you.%SPEECH_ON%I wanted you to make them dead. Now they aren't. Now you don't get paid. Ah, how simple. And now? Now you get out of my house.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% laughs as you enter his room.%SPEECH_ON%I'm honestly surprised you returned. I should find it insulting, really, that you'd think I wouldn't know better. The graverobbers were spotted on the road. The graverobbers I asked you to kill. Remember that? Remember when I said go and kill them? I'm sure you do. I'm also sure you remember when I said that's what I was paying you for. So... no dead graverobbers...%SPEECH_OFF%He slams his desk with a fist.%SPEECH_ON%No pay! Now get out of my home!%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% in his chair, rolling an empty goblet between his hands.%SPEECH_ON%It's not often I run across someone who tries to cheat me. That's what you were going to do, coming back here, right? I know the graverobbers aren't dead, sellsword. I'm no fool. Leave my sight before I have my men butcher you.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is reading a book when you enter his room.%SPEECH_ON%You have ten seconds to turn around and leave. Ten. Nine. Eight...%SPEECH_OFF%You realize he knows that the graverobbers were not taken care of.%SPEECH_ON%...four... three...%SPEECH_OFF%You turn and hastily leave the room.}
7dcd748273d0ad911e99.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{你进来时，%employer%正站在窗边。%SPEECH_ON%今天那些鸣禽似乎很生气，仿佛觉得自己说什么都白说。我觉得很有意思。你呢？%SPEECH_OFF%他突然转向你。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，佣兵？不觉得？我的小鸟告诉我，盗墓贼离开镇子了。活着走的。想去哪儿就去哪儿，想回来就回来。真奇怪，死人通常可没这份自由。我原本让你把那些盗墓贼变成什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你迟疑了。他替你回答。%SPEECH_ON%我要你把他们变成死人。现在，他们没死。所以，你没钱拿。啊，多简单。接下来呢？接下来，你滚出我的房子。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你刚进房间，%employer%便笑了。%SPEECH_ON%说实话，没想到你还有脸回来。你竟以为我会被蒙在鼓里，真该算是对我的侮辱。有人在路上看见了盗墓贼。就是我让你杀的那些。记得吗？还记得我说，去，把他们杀了吗？我想你记得。你也一定记得，我花钱是为这件事。所以……盗墓贼没死……%SPEECH_OFF%他一拳砸在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%就别想拿钱！现在，滚出去！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他坐在椅子里，双手转动着一个空酒杯。%SPEECH_ON%我不常遇到敢骗我的人。你回来这里，就是打算这么干，对吧？我知道那些盗墓贼没死，佣兵。我不是傻子。趁我还没叫人把你剁了，赶紧从我眼前消失。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进房间，%employer%正在看书。%SPEECH_ON%给你十秒，转身出去。十。九。八……%SPEECH_OFF%你明白，他已经知道盗墓贼没被解决。%SPEECH_ON%……四……三……%SPEECH_OFF%你转身，匆匆离开房间。}

d2fdabbd9e6c9972a660.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{%employer% purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%You've put me in an odd spot, mercenary. You tell me the graverobbers are taken care of, yet... I have no proof. Usually, dead men leave a lot of proof. Especially ones hastily slain before their time.%SPEECH_OFF%He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%I'll pay you half. And you'll take that and then leave. Next time, bring proof. If you're lying... well, I'll figure that out on my own.%SPEECH_OFF% | You return to find %employer% tending to his garden.%SPEECH_ON%Sometimes I plant for one vegetable, and yet what springs forth but another entirely? How does that happen? Did I fool myself? Are you trying to fool me? You say the graverobbers are dead, but my men have scouted the graveyard and have found no such evidence. They also haven't found the graverobbers, and please...%SPEECH_OFF%He holds up a hand.%SPEECH_ON%Don't try and tell me that you did this or that with their bodies. So this is what we're going to do, sellsword. I'm going to pay you half and then I'm going to sit here and wonder if you lied to me. Sound good? Good.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% smiles as you tell him his problem has been taken care of.%SPEECH_ON%That's good news. Unfortunately, my men scouted the cemetery and found no evidence of our dead graverobbers. An interesting development, I'm sure, but I'm not going to hold you here while I figure out what, exactly, happened there. So... I'll be paying you half. Next time, bring me proof. Or... don't lie. I'm not sure which applies to you here.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d2fdabbd9e6c9972a660.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{%employer%抿起嘴唇。%SPEECH_ON%你可让我为难了，佣兵。你说盗墓贼已经解决，可……我看不到证据。通常死人总会留下不少证据，尤其是那些还没活够，就被匆匆杀掉的人。%SPEECH_OFF%他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我付一半。你拿上就走。下次，记得带凭证。要是你在撒谎……嗯，我自己会查清。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%正在照料菜园。%SPEECH_ON%有时候，我种下的明明是一种菜，长出来的却完全是另一种。这是怎么回事？是我自己弄错了？还是你想糊弄我？你说盗墓贼死了，可我的人去墓地查看，什么证据也没找到。他们也没找到那些盗墓贼。还有，拜托……%SPEECH_OFF%他举起一只手。%SPEECH_ON%别跟我编什么，你把尸体这样那样处理了。事情就这么办，佣兵。我付一半，随后坐在这里，慢慢想你是不是骗了我。如何？很好。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你告诉%employer%，麻烦已经解决，他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%那是好消息。可惜，我的人查看过墓地，没找到任何证据，能证明那些盗墓贼已经死了。事情变得挺有意思，不过我也不打算扣着你，等一切水落石出。所以……我付一半。下次，带上凭证。或者……别撒谎。我也拿不准，你该听的是哪一句。%SPEECH_OFF%}

51dc15cfc64b06382147.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You find %employer% helping a young noble boy aim a bow downrange at a strawman. He straightens the kid's back and orders him to breathe deep before shooting. The amateur archer nods and does as told. The arrow is loosed. It wobbles, caroms off the ground, and rattles spinning into a stable where a few horses whinny at the scary disturbance. The nobleman claps the boy on the back.%SPEECH_ON%Trust me, I was worse on my first go. Keep at it. I'll be back in a moment.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman approaches you, shaking his head and lowering his voice.%SPEECH_ON%Things are dire, mercenary. The young know not of what dangers lurk these days, but you do. We have a settlement, %objective% just %direction% of here, that is surrounded by... well, the ills of this world. I've no men to spare, but that's where you come in. Go there and save the village and you'll be paid very well, I can assure you!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found staring at one of his swords. He has it unsheathed, staring at his face in the steeled reflection.%SPEECH_ON%When I was taught how to use one of these, it was meant for men. Now? People speak of the dead, of greenskins, beasts beyond measure!%SPEECH_OFF%He slams the sword to the hilt and throws it and the scabbard on his table. He runs his hand through his hair.%SPEECH_ON%%objective% %direction% of here needs your help. It has been surrounded by these... these things! I know not what they are, only that they kill and kill and kill! I've not a man to spare, but if you go there and help this town then you will be rewarded most handsomely!%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% sitting between an abbot and a scribe who are yelling at each other in jowl-shaking, teeth-rattling old man voices. Given that the dead are arisen, questions of both mortality and life-after-death have become rather furiously debated. The nobleman sees you and jumps to his feet. He hurries to you, the argument raging in the background.%SPEECH_ON%Thank the old gods you are here, mercenary. Just %direction% of here, %objective% is under siege by an army of horribles. Undead, foul things, I don't know, I just know I don't have the men to protect the town myself. Go there and ensure those people are safe and I will pay you well!%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% overseeing a group of sextons lowering a casket into the ground. The coffin is firmly nailed shut, almost hurriedly so: nails corkscrew and bend off the wood, and there are scrape marks along the sides. Seeing you, the nobleman comes over.%SPEECH_ON%The resident of said box decided to come back out. Killed a child and a dog. Almost killed another before the guards put it back down.%SPEECH_OFF%A splurge of black liquid gushes from the bottom of the coffin. The gravediggers jump away, dropping the crate right into its grave with a heavy clatter. %employer% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%With all these 'undead' outbreaks, my forces have been spread thin. I've just gotten word that %objective% just %direction% of here is another one to become under attack. Sellsword, would you go there and help save it?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% studying a crop of books scattered across his desk. He's shaking his head, every twist of the neck seemingly turning another page. Upset, he hurriedly waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%Don't dally, sellsword, we've no time for that. I need you to go to %objective% %direction% of here. My birds tell me it's under assault, more of these damned 'dead' come to life, if that's really the way to say it. Are you interested in going? The pay will more than compensate your efforts.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% watching over some masons putting sharply cut stones together. He shakes your hand.%SPEECH_ON%Building another monastery, sellsword, how does it look?%SPEECH_OFF%It looks good, but you point out that there is another abbey right across the road.
