6747590e831338283ece.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]{弟兄们砍倒最后一只兽人时，你环顾四周。这些绿皮着实打得凶悍。该检查战团的情况，准备返回雇主%employer%那里了。 | 你们刚刚办到的事，%employer%的人绝对办不到。只有%companyname%才能收拾这些绿皮。你为战团感到骄傲，却尽量不露在脸上。 | 战斗分出了胜负，弟兄们之间的一两桩赌局也有了结果。事实证明，只要把脑袋从脖子上砍下来，兽人就不会再磨牙了！雇主%employer%多半不在乎这种野蛮的试验，不过，今天的活他会照付报酬。 | 兽人打得如此勇猛，就连神职人员说不定都敢称这一战打得堂堂正正。可它们依然敌不过%companyname%，至少今天如此！ | 雇主%employer%要你杀掉绿皮，你已经办妥。现在该检查弟兄们的情况，准备回去领取辛苦挣来的报酬了。 | 和兽人交战从来不是件轻松事，这次也不例外。不过，%employer%的报酬，总能让%companyname%吃下的苦头好受一些。 | 雇主%employer%最好为对付这些蛮物付一大笔钱，它们可真难杀！检查一下弟兄们的情况，准备回去见雇主吧。}

3ef008925b1055597be6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_49.png[/img]{As you approach the orcish warband, you spot the unmistakable silhouette of a brutish warlord. It appears your time with the greenskins will be more difficult than originally thought. | The orcs have a huge warlord in their midst. This changes nothing. Well, it changes things a little, but the end goal remains: kill them all. | What unfortunate news! An orcish warlord has been sighted standing tall amongst the orc ranks. Unfortunate for the warlord, that is. You're sure he worked hard to get where he is. A shame %companyname% is about to go and ruin that. | A warlord amongst the greenskins! His size and growl would be unmistakable - you'd hear it even if a bear were grinning its way into your face! No matter, the greenskin shall die just like the rest. | A warlord. A lord of war. A fearsome orc. You've heard them all. One such enormity stands about the greenskins' camp. One of their leaders. One of their best fighters. What does it matter? It matters none at all. Of course not! None at all. Everything will go according to plan.}
3ef008925b1055597be6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_49.png[/img]{靠近兽人战帮时，你看见一道绝不会认错的魁梧身影：一名凶悍的兽人军阀。看来，这场与绿皮的交锋，比原先想的还要难打。 | 兽人中间有个巨大的军阀。这改变不了什么。好吧，是会改变一点，但最终目标还是一样：把它们全杀光。 | 多么不幸的消息！兽人队伍中，赫然站着一个高大的军阀。当然，是对那个军阀而言不幸。想必它费了不少力气，才爬到今天的位置。可惜，%companyname%马上就要把这一切毁了。 | 绿皮中有个军阀！那副体格、那声咆哮，绝不可能认错。就算一头熊正冲着你的脸龇牙，你也能听见它！无所谓，这绿皮会跟其他家伙一样死掉。 | 军阀。战争之主。可怕的兽人。这些叫法，你都听过。如今，这么个庞然大物正站在绿皮营地里。它们的首领之一，它们最强的战士之一。那又怎样？没什么大不了。当然没有！一点也没有。一切都会按计划进行。}

6bba4bd68618cd7266b3.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]{While approaching, you spot a strange smoke clambering upward. It is not ashy or grey, but purple, with tendrils of seemingly living green slipping and looping through it. Goblins are here, and they have a shaman with them! | A shaman! You'd recognize one of those crafty goblins anywhere - the bony jewelry, the sloped eyes, the sense of sapience usually unseen in a gobbo's dumb face. These are dangerous greenskins, be wary! | Oy, watch yer step. A goblin shaman is standing amongst the enemy ranks! This is a most dangerous enemy combatant! Do not take its small shape or size lightly... | You've heard stories of some shamans being able to draw a man's dreams from his ears. You're not so sure if that's true, but you do know they make for crafty combatants, and you're about to face one! | A shamanistic goblin... you'd know that bony garb anywhere, and the camouflaging cloak, too! Keep calm and carry on - killing all these greenskins, that is! | Shaman. One goblin shaman... You've heard horror stories about their 'magicks', but this isn't the time or place. Prepare the men to attack! | A goblin shaman. You've heard stories of these foul gits being able to trick the minds of men. You now wonder if %employer%, your employer, was fooled into bringing you here.

...nah. Surely not, right? | A goblin shaman! You've heard stories of these nefarious things. One was that they feed wasps into the ears of their prisoners! One man, admittedly having a few drinks in his belly, told you that he watched bees turn a man's brains into a honeycomb! Bet that honey smarted the tongue!}
6bba4bd68618cd7266b3.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]{接近敌人时，你看见一股奇异的烟雾向上攀升。它既不是灰烬色，也不是灰白色，而是紫色，里面有绿色细丝游走盘绕，仿佛活物。是地精，它们还带着一名萨满！ | 萨满！这种狡诈的地精，你一眼就认得出：骨制饰物、斜挑的眼睛，还有那副蠢脸上通常见不到的狡黠神色。这类绿皮很危险，小心！ | 喂，小心些。敌军中站着一个地精萨满！这是个极其危险的对手，别因为它个头小就掉以轻心…… | 你听过传闻，说有些萨满能从人的耳朵里抽走梦境。你不敢断定真假，但知道它们打起仗来诡计多端，而你马上就要面对其中一个！ | 一个地精萨满……那身骨饰和用于伪装的斗篷，你怎么都不会认错！稳住，继续干该干的事——也就是把这些绿皮全杀光！ | 萨满。一个地精萨满……你听过不少关于它们邪术的骇人故事，但现在不是琢磨这些的时候。叫弟兄们准备进攻！ | 一个地精萨满。你听说过，这些邪恶的小崽子能蛊惑人心。你不禁开始怀疑，雇主%employer%是不是也受了迷惑，才把你派到这里。

……不会吧。肯定不会，对吧？ | 一个地精萨满！你听过这些邪物的传闻。据说，它们会往俘虏耳朵里塞黄蜂！还有个人告诉你，他亲眼看见蜜蜂将一个人的脑子变成了蜂巢——当然，那人当时已经喝了好几杯。那蜜尝起来，舌头怕是要遭罪！}

e680e3eb93390ca4810c.source:
{The battle over, you discover a surprising captive amongst the ruins of the battle: a merchant. Clothed in bloodied silks, he approaches you ever thankful. He asks if perhaps you could take him to %objective%. Clearly, he is not safe on the roads. You shrug and look the other way. The man quickly pipes up, offering %reward_merchant% crowns if you simply help him. That's a little more to your liking... | A man emerges from a heap of dead greenskins. He is not one of your mercenaries, but in fact a merchant with his hands tied behind his back. You inquire as to how he came into such 'company', and he shrugs, stating he's rarely heard of greenskins taking prisoners. How lucky for him.

 Glancing around, the man pipes back up.%SPEECH_ON%I must thank you, sellsword, but if it weren't obvious then I must state that I no longer feel safe traveling these roads. If you were to get me to %objective% in one piece, I'd be willing to, uh, depart with %reward_merchant% crowns. Does that sound good to you?%SPEECH_OFF% | After the battle, you notice a merchant off to the side sitting ugly on his dead horse. Some wayward violence put an end to the creature and now the merchant is shit out of luck. He looks at the battlefield, then at you. Crossing his arms over the pommel of his saddle, he inquires loudly.%SPEECH_ON%Would you, sir warrior, be willing to escort me to %objective%? As you can see, my mode of travel has shat out beneath me, felled by a battle... not that it is your fault! No sir! However, I really must get to that town.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses and dangles a small purse before you.%SPEECH_ON%I've got %reward_merchant% crowns in it for ya. How does that sound?%SPEECH_OFF% | While you survey the battlefield, a man walks up to you and inquires as to what happened here. Wiping blood off your blade, you tell him to take a good look. He slims his eyes and, for whatever reason, leans forward on the tips of his toes.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, greenskins. A shameful event. Well...%SPEECH_OFF%He falls back on his heels.%SPEECH_ON%Wait a old gods-damned minute. Greenskins? What in the hells are they doing here? By the mercy of the heavens, I can't be safe in these parts! Soldier! I'll pay you %reward_merchant% crowns if you escort me to %objective%. I promise it's not far from here, but I can't afford to go alone.%SPEECH_OFF%He cuts a thumb across his neck and points at a dead greenskin.%SPEECH_ON%I don't think anyone can afford that price, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%}
e680e3eb93390ca4810c.translation:
{战斗结束，你在残破的战场上发现一个意外的俘虏：商人。他穿着染血的绸衣走来，连声道谢，问你能否顺路送他去%objective%。显然，对他来说，路上并不安全。你耸耸肩，朝别处看去。他赶紧补上一句，只要你肯帮忙，就付%reward_merchant%克朗。这话听起来，就顺耳多了…… | 一个人从成堆的绿皮尸体间冒出来。他不是你的佣兵，而是个双手反绑在背后的商人。你问他怎么跟这群家伙结了伴，他耸耸肩，说自己很少听说绿皮还会留俘虏。真算他走运。

 他四下看看，又开了口。%SPEECH_ON%我得谢谢你，佣兵。不过，若还不够明显，那我直说好了：我现在一点也不觉得独自赶路安全。你若能把我完整地送到%objective%，我愿意，呃，割舍%reward_merchant%克朗。你看怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 战后，你注意到旁边有个商人，难堪地坐在自己的死马上。战斗中不知哪来的攻击要了马的命，他如今也彻底没了辙。他看看战场，又看看你，双臂交叠在鞍桥上，高声问道。%SPEECH_ON%勇士老爷，您肯护送我去%objective%吗？您也看到了，我胯下这赶路的家伙完蛋了，被战斗殃及……当然不是您的错！绝对不是！不过，我确实非去那镇子不可。%SPEECH_OFF%他顿了顿，在你面前晃了晃小钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%这里有%reward_merchant%克朗，都给你。怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你正巡视战场，一个男人走来，问这里发生了什么。你擦着剑上的血，叫他自己看清楚。他眯起眼，不知为何又踮起脚，向前探身。%SPEECH_ON%啊，绿皮。真是惨事。那么……%SPEECH_OFF%他落回脚跟上。%SPEECH_ON%等等，旧神在上！绿皮？它们在这里干什么？老天开恩，这地方哪还安全！士兵！只要你护送我去%objective%，我付你%reward_merchant%克朗。我保证，离这里不远，可我实在冒不起独行的险。%SPEECH_OFF%他用拇指在脖子前划过，又指了指一只死去的绿皮。%SPEECH_ON%这样的代价，谁也付不起，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

a4c7a971058c493ab983.source: Very well, we'll take you to %objective%.

b0314bc6fcde39528e54.source: Just go and stay out of our way.

ffd53788c5d497eb0d93.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You return to %employer% and throw a greenskin's head on his table. He scoots away from it.%SPEECH_ON%Excuse me?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding at it, you explain that the foul things are dead. He snaps a handkerchief from his pockets and starts mopping up the blood.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, I can see that. That mess was meant to stay there, not be brought to my feet! Farkin' sellswords... your pay is in the corner! And hail my servant when you leave. Someone's gotta clean this up!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s regaling a woman with tales when you return. Her giggles turn to a longing stare as you enter. He sees this and quickly scoots her out, lest the presence of a real man give her the fainting fits.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! What news do you have?%SPEECH_OFF%You bring the head of a greenskin out of a burlap sack. %employer% gazes at it, purses his lips, smiles, frowns, seems not sure what do with what he's looking at.%SPEECH_ON%Right... right. Well, your pay is here, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%He heaves a wooden chest onto the table.%SPEECH_ON%Bring that girl back in here when you leave.%SPEECH_OFF% | You plant a greenskin's head on %employer%'s desk. He straightens up and unfurls a scroll, comparing a drawing of a greenskin to the very real one.%SPEECH_ON%Hmm, I will have to tell the scholars they're a bit... wrong.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask as to how.%SPEECH_ON%They colored them grey. This one is clearly green.%SPEECH_OFF%You wonder aloud if the scholarly pens even come in green. The man purses his lips and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Huh. Good point. Well the guard outside the door will have your pay. Leave me to this... specimen.%SPEECH_OFF% | A robed man is beside %employer% when you enter. He's face deep into a scroll and doesn't even take a glance at your arrival. Shrugging, you take a greenskin's head from a sack and lay it on your employer's table. Now the stranger takes notice, and he also takes the head! He snatches it and immediately rushes out of the room, almost howling with giddiness. You ask what the hell that was. %employer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%The scholars have been antsy about your return. They've been wanting something new to study for awhile now.%SPEECH_OFF%The man takes a satchel out and hands it over. Counting crowns, you ask if the eggheads will pay you, too. %employer% shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%If you can catch 'em. And I don't mean physically - those men are so deep in their thoughts they act as if the rest of us don't even exist!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s got a bird in his hand and a stone in the other. You ask what he's doing.%SPEECH_ON%I'm trying to figure out which one's worth more. A bird in the hand, or... or a stone... wait...%SPEECH_OFF%You've no time for this and slam a greenskin's head on his table, asking how much it is worth. The man frees the bird and sets the stone on his bookshelf. He turns back around with your payment in hand.%SPEECH_ON%I take it by this here... curiosity, that my problems have been taken care of. Your pay, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%You do wonder how the hell the man managed to catch that bird, but decide not to dwell on it. | %employer%'s having a coughing fit when you return. He glances at you, fisted hand borrowed to his lips.%SPEECH_ON%Surely your presence is not another bad omen?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and place a greenskin's head on his table, explaining that all of them were taken care of. %employer% glances at it.%SPEECH_ON%So my illness must have been caused by something else... but what? {Women? It's probably the women. Let's be honest, it's always the women. | Dogs. People say those mangy mutts are harbingers of madness. | Black cats! Yes, of course! I will have them all killed! | Children. The children have been rather loud lately. What is it they are planning behind the giggles and laughter? | Maybe it was that undercooked meat I ate... or... no I'm pretty sure it's that crazy woman living on the hill. | I did eat bread that I had unwittingly shared with a rat. It's either that, or a woman. You know how those things are, always diseasing and rotting us, those damned women!}%SPEECH_OFF%The man pauses, then shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, no matter. Your pay is being held by a guard outside. It is the amount we agreed to, though feel free to count it. The gods know I may have miscount in my current state!%SPEECH_OFF%}
ffd53788c5d497eb0d93.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你回到%employer%那里，把一颗绿皮脑袋扔上他的桌子。他赶紧挪远了些。%SPEECH_ON%你这是干什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你朝脑袋示意，解释那些恶兽已经死了。他从口袋里抽出手帕，开始擦拭血迹。%SPEECH_ON%看得出来。那些脏东西该留在原地，不该扔到我眼前！该死的佣兵……你的报酬在角落里！走的时候，把我的仆人叫来。总得有人收拾这摊烂事！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%正在给一名女子讲故事逗乐。你一进门，她不再咯咯发笑，目光热切地落在你身上。他看在眼里，赶紧将她送出去，免得她见了真汉子，激动得晕过去。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！有什么消息？%SPEECH_OFF%你从粗麻袋里取出一颗绿皮脑袋。%employer%盯着它，抿嘴、微笑，又皱眉，似乎不知道该如何面对眼前这东西。%SPEECH_ON%好……好。这是你的报酬，按说好的。%SPEECH_OFF%他将一个木箱搬上桌。%SPEECH_ON%走的时候，叫那姑娘回来。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你把一颗绿皮脑袋搁在%employer%的书桌上。他坐直身子，展开卷轴，将画上的绿皮与眼前这个真家伙作比较。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，我得告诉学者们，他们画得有点……不对。%SPEECH_OFF%你问哪里不对。%SPEECH_ON%他们涂成了灰色。这一只明明是绿色的。%SPEECH_OFF%你随口问，学者的笔墨里可有绿色。他抿起嘴唇，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%哦，说得在理。门外的卫兵那里有你的报酬。让我好好看看这件……标本吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进来时，%employer%身边站着一个长袍男子，脸几乎埋进卷轴里，连看都没看你一眼。你耸耸肩，从袋里取出绿皮脑袋，放上雇主的桌子。陌生人这下注意到了，而且直接把脑袋抢了过去！他抱着脑袋立刻冲出房间，高兴得几乎要嚎叫。你问刚才那究竟是怎么回事。%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%学者们早就在焦急地等你回来。他们想找点新东西研究，已经想了很久。%SPEECH_OFF%他拿出一个钱袋，递给你。你数着克朗，问那些书呆子会不会也付钱。%employer%耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%要是你抓得住他们的注意力，就有可能。我可不是说抓住他们的人——那些家伙整天陷在自己的思绪里，简直当我们其他人都不存在！%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%一手握鸟，一手拿着石头。你问他在干什么。%SPEECH_ON%我想弄清哪个更值钱。一鸟在手，胜过……胜过一块石头……等等……%SPEECH_OFF%你没工夫陪他琢磨，把一颗绿皮脑袋砸上桌，问这又值多少。他放走鸟，将石头搁上书架，再转过身时，手里已拿着你的报酬。%SPEECH_ON%看这件……奇物，想必我的麻烦已经解决了。这是说好的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%你倒真想知道，他究竟是怎么捉住那只鸟的，不过还是决定不再深究。 | 你回来时，%employer%正咳得厉害。他握拳掩着嘴，瞥了你一眼。%SPEECH_ON%你这趟来，总不至于又是个凶兆吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，将一颗绿皮脑袋放上桌，说明它们已经全部解决。%employer%扫了一眼。%SPEECH_ON%那么，我的病另有缘故……可是什么呢？{女人？八成是女人。老实说，总是女人惹的祸。 | 狗。人们说那些癞皮杂种是疯癫的先兆。 | 黑猫！没错，当然是黑猫！我要把它们全杀了！ | 孩子。最近孩子们吵得厉害。那些嬉笑背后，到底藏着什么阴谋？ | 也许是我吃了没熟透的肉……或者……不，准是住在山上的那个疯女人。 | 我确实在不知情时，吃过老鼠啃过的面包。不是这个，就是女人。你也知道那些东西有多坏，总害我们染病、烂掉，那些该死的女人！}%SPEECH_OFF%他顿了顿，摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%啊，算了。门外的卫兵拿着你的报酬。是我们说好的数目，不过你尽管点清。诸神知道，我眼下这副样子，说不定数错了！%SPEECH_OFF%}

1ad18a961322b70b9f8b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{Having reached %objective% in safekeeping, the merchant turns 'round and thanks you. He hands over a satchel of crowns, just as promised, and quickly makes his way into the town. | %objective% is a sight for sore eyes, and merry merchants as well - the man you were escorting cries out, ecstatic to either be alive or about to make some money or whatever it is that gets men of business going. He runs to a nearby inn and quickly returns, a satchel of crowns in hand.%SPEECH_ON%As promised, sellsword. I owe you much more.%SPEECH_OFF%You slyly ask how much the man would pay. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%I wouldn't dare price my own head for I guarantee someone out there would want to purchase it!%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, understanding, and being quite fine with the payment as is. | Having reached %objective%, the merchant pays you the amount you two agreed upon. He then quickly rushes off, going on about how he's going to make so many crowns and bed so many women. | You safely get the merchant to %objective%. He thanks you then hurries off to a nearby tavern. When he returns, he's lugging a satchel of crowns like a grapefruit in a sock. He heaves it toward you.%SPEECH_ON%Your payment, mercenary. You have my gratitude and, of course, my crowns. Now excuse me...%SPEECH_OFF%He straightens his shirt and trousers, and lifts his chin up.%SPEECH_ON%...for I have money to make.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns and marches off, a little bit of penny pinching pep in his step.}
1ad18a961322b70b9f8b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{你们平安抵达%objective%，商人转身向你道谢。他交来一袋克朗，兑现承诺，随即匆匆进了镇子。 | 望见%objective%，疲惫的眼睛舒坦了，商人也欢喜了。受你护送的那人兴奋地喊出声，不知是庆幸自己还活着，还是快要赚到钱，又或者是别的什么能让生意人来劲的事。他跑进附近的旅店，很快又回来，手里多了一个钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%说好的报酬，佣兵。我欠你的，可不止这些。%SPEECH_OFF%你狡黠地问，那他还愿意多付多少。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%我可不敢给自己的脑袋开价。敢保证，外头总有人想买！%SPEECH_OFF%你会意地点头，对眼下这笔报酬也颇为满意。 | 抵达%objective%后，商人按约定付清报酬，随即急匆匆地走了，嘴里还念叨着要赚多少克朗、跟多少女人上床。 | 你将商人平安送到%objective%。他向你道谢，随后匆匆奔向附近的酒馆。回来时，他拎着一个沉甸甸的钱袋，活像袜子里塞了个柚子。他用力将钱袋抛给你。%SPEECH_ON%你的报酬，佣兵。我的感激归你，当然，还有我的克朗。现在，失陪了……%SPEECH_OFF%他整了整衣裤，抬起下巴。%SPEECH_ON%……我得去赚钱了。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身大步离开，步子里透着财迷要去捞钱的欢快。}

cfa0e1823fe9ba90aee5.translation: 解决了四处劫掠的绿皮

635ac97b6b46c9bd5194.source: Blood Vial of the Holy Mother

de8cc7a6710da06a195d.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]%employer% welcomes you and walks you toward %townname%'s square. There's a party of peasants milling about, but when they see you coming they shape up and start talking as though they'd been expecting you all along. They mostly talk in descriptors: tall as any man! Armor like you'd never seen before! Spears as sharp as a peddler's tongue! You hold your hand up and ask what it is they are talking about. %employer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%The men here say they saw some oddities out in a spot by the name of %location% just %direction% of here. Naturally, they weren't out there for no reason. They were looking for something by the name of %item%, a relic dear to the town for through it we pray for food and shelter.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the peasants speak up.%SPEECH_ON%And we was lookin' fer it at his behest!%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course. And where they failed, perhaps you can succeed? Get this relic for me and you'll be paid quite well for your services. Pay no mind to their fairy tales. I'm sure there's nothing to worry about.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]%employer% welcomes you into his room and pours you a mug of water. He hands it over with a sheepish smile.%SPEECH_ON%I'd offer a bit of ale or wine if I had it on me, but you know how things are nowadays.%SPEECH_OFF%He takes a sip and clears his throat.%SPEECH_ON%Of course, what I'm not short on are crowns, otherwise we wouldn't be having this conversation, right? I need you to go to a place by the name of %location% just %direction% of here and retrieve a relic by the name of %item%. Pretty simple, no?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what this relic is good for. The man explains.%SPEECH_ON%Townsfolk pray to it. Through it they find peace, call for the rains, fark their goats, I don't care. They believe in it and it keeps them motivated. For that alone it's worth retrieving.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]You step into %employer%'s room to find the man staring at a map of the hinterlands. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%See this spot right here? That's %location%. %townname% used to worship a relic by the name of %item%, but the townsfolk are saying it's gone missing and, well, for whatever reason they think it's there. I've no men to hire and see, for the roads are dangerous and I can't afford to pay for failure, but you, sellsword, seem up to the task. Would you go there and find this %item% for us?%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]You find %employer% talking to a group of peasants. Seeing you, he quiets them all down.%SPEECH_ON%Shush, the lot of you. This man here can solve our problem.%SPEECH_OFF%The townsman takes you aside.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, we have a bit of a problem. There's a relic I need finding, some such thing by the name of %item%. I don't really give a good old gods damn about it, but these people worship it for spring rains and winter shelter. Naturally, it's gone missing. And for whatever reason folks think it's gone off to a place by the name of %location% all on its own. Nobody'll go there, but you will, yes? For the right price, of course.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]You find %employer% talking to a druidic monk cloaked in shapes more familiar to beasts than man. Horns for a helmet, bearskin for armor, and the hooves of deer clattering around his chest in a brutish necklace. He's quite the sight. Seeing you, %employer% waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! It is good to see you--%SPEECH_OFF%The druid pushes the man out of the way mid-talk. He speaks with a wobble in his voice, as though he were speaking from the depths of a cavern.%SPEECH_ON%A mercenary, ha! Surely you are a man of faith, no? We of %townname% have lost the %item%. This relic is of great import to us, for through it we can speak to the old gods and have our prayers answered. It's been stolen away, in some manner or another, to the %location%. Go there and retrieve it.%SPEECH_OFF%You glance at %employer% who nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, what he said.%SPEECH_OFF%}
de8cc7a6710da06a195d.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]%employer%欢迎你到来，带你走向%townname%的广场。一群农民正在闲逛，见你走来，便立刻站得规矩，七嘴八舌说起来，仿佛一直就在等你。说的多半是些形容：比谁都高！从没见过那样的铠甲！长矛像小贩的舌头一样锋利！你抬手，问他们到底在说什么。%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%这些人说，他们在这里%direction%一个叫%location%的地方，看见了些怪东西。当然，他们不是无缘无故跑去的。他们在找%item%，那是镇上珍视的圣物，我们靠它祈求衣食与庇护。%SPEECH_OFF%一个农民插嘴。%SPEECH_ON%而且，是他吩咐我们去找的！%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然。他们没办成的事，也许你能办到？替我取回这件圣物，我会付你丰厚的报酬。别在意他们那些神怪故事，肯定没什么可担心的。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]%employer%请你进屋，倒了一杯水，略带腼腆地笑着递来。%SPEECH_ON%手边要是有麦酒或葡萄酒，我就拿来招待了。不过，如今的光景，你也知道。%SPEECH_OFF%他喝了一口，清清嗓子。%SPEECH_ON%当然，克朗我可不缺，不然咱们也不会坐在这里谈，对吧？我要你去这里%direction%一处名叫%location%的地方，取回一件名为%item%的圣物。很简单，不是吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你问，这圣物有什么用。他解释道。%SPEECH_ON%镇民朝它祈祷，靠它求得安宁、求雨，或是和山羊乱搞，我不在乎。他们信它，有了它就有干劲。光凭这一点，也值得找回来。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]你走进%employer%的房间，发现他正盯着一张腹地地图，摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%看见这里了吗？这是%location%。%townname%一直供奉一件名为%item%的圣物，可镇民说它不见了。不知怎么，他们觉得它就在那儿。道路危险，我手头没有合适的人能雇去查探，也承担不起白花钱的损失。不过你，佣兵，看起来办得成。愿意去替我们找回%item%吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你找到%employer%时，他正和一群农民说话。见你到来，他叫众人安静。%SPEECH_ON%嘘，都别吵。这位能解决我们的问题。%SPEECH_OFF%他把你拉到一旁。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我们有点麻烦。我需要找回一件圣物，好像叫%item%。说真的，旧神作证，我一点也不在乎它，可这些人供奉它，求春雨，求冬天的容身处。偏巧，它不见了。而且不知为什么，大家觉得它自己跑去了一个叫%location%的地方。没人肯去，可你会去，对吧？当然，价钱得合适。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]你找到%employer%时，他正与一名德鲁伊修士交谈。那人身上的装束，与其说属于人，倒更像属于野兽：兽角作盔，熊皮作甲，胸前挂着鹿蹄串成的粗野项链，彼此碰得咔哒作响。实在惹眼。见你到来，%employer%招手让你过去。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！见到你真好——%SPEECH_OFF%话说一半，德鲁伊便把他推到旁边。那人开口时声音颤动，仿佛从洞穴深处传来。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，哈！你想必也是个有信仰的人，对吧？我们%townname%遗失了%item%。这件圣物对我们至关重要，借助它，我们才能与旧神沟通，让祈祷得到回应。它不知被人用什么手段偷去了%location%。去那里，把它取回来。%SPEECH_OFF%你看向%employer%，他点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%对，就照他说的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

836254effd75efd6dd64.source: {You did right by coming to us. Let's talk payment. | Let's talk money. | Sounds simple enough. What's the pay?}
836254effd75efd6dd64.translation: {你找对人了。谈谈报酬吧。 | 谈谈报酬吧。 | 听起来不难。报酬多少？}

eee8ee37bf564bb001d1.source: {Not interested. | We have more important matters to settle. | I'm sure you'll find someone else to do this.}
eee8ee37bf564bb001d1.translation: {没兴趣。 | 我们还有更重要的事。 | 你一定能找到别人来做。}

8742ef0adca81cba148e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]{You don't step into the ruins so much as clamber, hobbling over the stoneworks like a bat trying to walk upright. Getting to the bottom of the descent, you find what looks like hundreds of clay pots, old chariots more mulch than wood, and metal water basins filled with rusted shields and spears. %randombrother% takes a torch and throws its glow toward the walls. Great murals run along the length of them, great artworks depicting battles you've never heard of. Each step you take seems to unveil another ancient victory until, finally, you come to a giant painted map. There you see a continent overrun with the rule of an empire, gilded its belly, blackened its borders.

 %randombrother% walks over, the %item% in hand. You nod and tell him it's time to go. When the two of you turn around, there's a man standing there with a spear in one hand and a shield in the other. Another figure joins him, and another, their steps hitting the stone floor with metal malice. You yell at the mercenary to run and the both of you abandon the ruins in a hurry, the staccato clap of a death march on your heels.

 Outside you wheel around and order the men to get ready for a fight. Before the first sellsword can so much as draw his sword, a stream of armored soldiers emerge from the ruins, stack formation, and level their spears at you. Their lieutenant points a decayed finger and speaks with a voice so graveled the words weigh deep in your chest.%SPEECH_ON%The Empire rises. The False King must die.%SPEECH_OFF% | The hole into the ruins is big enough for only one man to get through. You're worried that if everyone goes in at once they'll get stuck and you'll have basically killed the %companyname% off like a bunch of rats in a tight tunnel. Instead, you send in only %randombrother%, who knows what he's after and who you trust can take care of himself were anything to happen.

 A few minutes later and you hear the man struggling to crawl back out - and he sounds to be in quite the rush. He yells for help and you and a few other mercenaries stick their hands into the hole. He grabs on and, together, you yank him out. He's got the %item%, but a horrified look on his face. He rolls over and gets up in a hurry.%SPEECH_ON%Hurry! To arms!%SPEECH_OFF%As the mercenaries look into the hole to see if something's coming out, you ask the brother what he saw. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I don't know, sir. It was a mausoleum for people I've never seen before. There was armor and spears all over the place, and murals of a great empire that spanned the whole world over! Painted from floor to ceiling! And... and then they started coming out of the walls. I got out of there as fast I could and...%SPEECH_OFF%Before he can even finish, the rubble where the hole used to be begins to shift and move. Stones roll away and suddenly they all burst outward, a malevolent force standing there - armed and well armored men standing in formation, spears over shields, shuffling forward in uniform steps. Their leader points directly at you.%SPEECH_ON%The Empire rises. The False King must die.%SPEECH_OFF%You've never heard surer fighting words and immediately prepare your men for combat. | You venture into the ruins with %randombrother% at your side. The %item% is easy enough to find, if not a little too easy, but something else catches your attention altogether. There are pots strewn all across the stone floor. Each piece of pottery is a reservoir for spears, and shields hang against the walls on hooks that seem far too ancient and rusted to hold up a cobweb much less a piece of metal. Suddenly, %randombrother% grabs your arm.%SPEECH_ON%Sir. Trouble.%SPEECH_OFF%He points down the halls and you see a man standing there, his movements janky and quick, as though he were breaking in his suit of armor. Suddenly, his head snaps up and stares at you. Despite the fact he's standing so far away, his voice carries as though he were speaking right next to you.%SPEECH_ON%The False King dare trespass here? The Empire will rise again, but first you must die.%SPEECH_OFF%These are fighting words, no doubt, and you grab the sellsword and make a quick escape. You don't get far outside before the mercenaries take up arms without your ordering so: following behind you is a formation of soldiers in armor you've never seen before. They step forward in a formation like a turtle's shell, clasped together with their shields held up to provide protection for the whole unit. Based on the fellow in the ruins, you've no doubt they have come to kill you and the rest of the company! | You enter the ruins and find the %item% easily enough. When you turn around, a tall man in rustic armor is standing there, spear in hand, with vacated eye sockets leering down at you. He swings the spear back.%SPEECH_ON%The False King must die.%SPEECH_OFF%The spear stabs forward. %randombrother% leaps over and deflects it to the ground, the spear tip crackling a couple of sparks off the stone floor. You look at the undead man, a worm coursing through its nose. It speaks again.%SPEECH_ON%The False King must...%SPEECH_OFF%With a quick draw, you unsheathe your sword and cut the ancient dead's head right off. The skull and helmet carrying it clatter and clank off the ground. Before you can investigate, %randombrother% grabs you and tells you to run: more undead figures are appearing out of the walls, shaking free of the granitic grip of a mausoleum's entombment.

 Once outside, you order the rest of the company to get into formation. | You send a few of the men into the ruins to find the %item%. All of them return in a hurry, which is unusual as they have a strong inclination to dawdle about to eat up sunlight and earn an easy day's salary. Thankfully, one of them has the relic in hand. Unfortunately, they all look like they've seen a ghost. They need not explain the source of their horror as a group of skittering, armor-clanking undead emerge from the ruins and level their spears at your company. | Arriving at the ruins, you expected some bandits to be footing about. Instead, retrieving the %item% could not have been easier. At least, that's what you thought before a throng of armored undead emerged yelling about the 'False King' and demanding your head on a platter. To arms! | Finding and bagging the %item% was easier than expected. Finding a group of undead men top-heavy with rustic armor and wielding spears in a tighter military formation than even the highest paid army in the realm... not so expected. To arms!}
8742ef0adca81cba148e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]{你与其说是走进遗迹，不如说是攀爬着挪进去的。你在石构之间踉跄翻越，活像一只试图直立行走的蝙蝠。来到坡道底部，眼前似乎摆着数百只陶罐，旧战车的木头几乎全朽成了碎渣，金属水盆里堆满生锈的盾牌和长矛。%randombrother%举起火把，照向墙壁。宏大的壁画沿墙展开，描绘着你从未听说过的战争。每走一步，仿佛就揭开一场古老胜利的面纱。最后，你来到一幅巨大的地图前。图上，一片大陆尽在帝国统治之下，腹地涂金，边疆染黑。

%randombrother%手持%item%走来。你点点头，告诉他该走了。两人刚一转身，就看见一个身影站在那里，一手持矛，一手执盾。又一个身影走到它身旁，接着又是一个，脚步敲在石地上，发出恶意森森的金属声。你大喊一声让佣兵快跑，两人仓皇逃出遗迹，死亡行军短促而齐整的脚步声紧追在后。

到了外面，你猛地转身，命令弟兄们准备战斗。第一个佣兵还没来得及拔剑，一队队披甲士兵便从遗迹中涌出，列成密阵，将长矛对准你们。它们的副官伸出腐朽的手指，嗓音沙哑低沉，每个字都像重重压进你的胸膛。%SPEECH_ON%帝国将再度崛起。伪王必须死。%SPEECH_OFF% | 通往遗迹的洞口只容一人通过。你担心所有人一拥而入会卡在里面，那就等于亲手把%companyname%害死，像把一窝老鼠堵死在狭窄的地道里。因此，你只派了%randombrother%进去。他知道要找什么，你也相信，万一有事，他能照顾好自己。

几分钟后，你听见他正费力往外爬，声音急得很。他大喊救命，你和几个佣兵连忙把手伸进洞中。他一把抓住，众人合力将他拽了出来。%item%已经到手，可他满脸惊恐，翻身便跳了起来。%SPEECH_ON%快！拿起武器！%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵们探头望向洞口，看有没有什么追出来。你问他看见了什么，他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我不知道，团长。那是座陵墓，里面的人我从没见过。到处都是铠甲和长矛，壁画上画着一个统治整个世界的大帝国！从地面一直画到天花板！然后……然后它们就从墙里走出来了。我拼命往外跑，接着……%SPEECH_OFF%他还没说完，洞口周围的碎石便开始挪动。石块滚落，突然向外炸开，一股邪恶的力量现身了：全副武装、铠甲齐整的士兵列着队，长矛从盾牌上方伸出，以整齐的步伐向前推进。它们的首领直指着你。%SPEECH_ON%帝国将再度崛起。伪王必须死。%SPEECH_OFF%这挑衅再明确不过，你立刻让弟兄们准备迎战。 | 你与%randombrother%一同进入遗迹。%item%很容易就找到了，甚至容易得有些过分，但另一些东西吸引了你的注意。陶罐散布在石地上，每一只里面都插着长矛。盾牌挂在墙边的钩子上，而那些钩子古老又锈蚀得厉害，别说挂金属，似乎连一张蛛网都撑不住。忽然，%randombrother%抓住了你的胳膊。%SPEECH_ON%团长，有麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%他指向长廊。你看见一个人站在那里，动作僵硬而急促，仿佛正试着适应身上的铠甲。突然，它猛地抬头，盯住了你。明明相隔很远，那声音却像贴在你耳边响起。%SPEECH_ON%伪王竟敢擅闯此地？帝国必将再起，而你得先死。%SPEECH_OFF%这无疑是开战的宣告。你拽住佣兵，飞快逃走。刚跑到外面没多远，还没等你下令，弟兄们便纷纷拿起武器：一队身披陌生铠甲的士兵正紧随你们而来。它们结成龟甲般的阵形，将盾牌紧密拼合，高举护住整支队伍。想起遗迹里那家伙的话，你毫不怀疑，它们就是来杀你和整个战团的！ | 你进入遗迹，没费多少工夫便找到了%item%。转身时，一个身披古旧铠甲的高大身影站在面前，手中握矛，空洞的眼窝俯视着你。它把长矛向后一收。%SPEECH_ON%伪王必须死。%SPEECH_OFF%长矛猛然刺来。%randombrother%跃上前，将它拨向地面，矛尖在石板上擦出几点火星。你看着那亡灵，一条虫子正穿过它的鼻孔。它再次开口。%SPEECH_ON%伪王必须……%SPEECH_OFF%你迅速拔剑，一刀削下远古亡灵的脑袋。头骨连着头盔落地，哐啷作响。你还没来得及查看，%randombrother%便一把拉住你，叫你快跑：更多亡灵正在从墙中现身，挣脱陵墓花岗岩般的禁锢。

一到外面，你立刻命令其余弟兄列阵。 | 你派几个弟兄进遗迹寻找%item%。他们很快就全跑了回来，这很不寻常，毕竟他们一向喜欢磨磨蹭蹭，耗掉白天，好轻松领一天工钱。好在其中一人手里拿着遗物，坏在他们个个像见了鬼。他们不必解释恐惧从何而来：一群铠甲哐当、步履急促的亡灵正从遗迹涌出，将长矛对准了战团。 | 来到遗迹时，你本以为会有几个强盗在附近游荡。结果，取回%item%简直轻而易举。至少，在一大群披甲亡灵冲出来，嚷着什么“伪王”，非要取你首级之前，你确实这么想。拿起武器！ | 找到%item%并收入囊中，比想象中容易。可一群身披沉重古旧铠甲、手执长矛的亡灵突然出现，阵形比境内军饷最高的军队还严整……这就不在意料之中了。拿起武器！}

a84ece53dcca3b3a98c7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{The battle over, and the %item% obtained, you tell the men to prepare for a return to %employer%. You're not entirely sure who or what just attacked you, but right now it's time to get paid. | With the fighting over, you look over your attackers. They're shelled within armor you don't recognize. %randombrother% tries to pry one of the corpses out of its helm but to no avail. He looks incredulously at the body.%SPEECH_ON%It's like it's just stuck there, or a part of him or something.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the men to gear up and get ready for a return to %employer%. No matter who these men are, you're out here to get the %item% and that part is done. Now it's time to get paid. | You've gotten the %item%, but at the cost of running into a sort of evil you've never seen before. Armored men, ostensibly dead, yet operating in tight formations. %randombrother% holds up the %item% and asks what to do next. You inform the men that it is time to return to %employer%. | You take a look at the %item% and at the men who attacked you over it. Or, at least you think they attacked you over it. The enemy lieutenant seemed to have said something, but you can't remember what it was. Ah well, time to return to %employer% and get paid. | You're not entirely sure what it was you ran into. %randombrother% asks if you know what they said.%SPEECH_ON%Seems like they were pointing you out specifically, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you tell the man you're not sure what the armored man said, but it matters not. You have the %item% and it's time to return to %employer% for your pay. | The %item% is in hand, but at what cost? Strange men, if you can call them that, attacked the company and you swear one of them specifically pointed you out, as though you'd committed a crime that went beyond space and time. Oh well. You're not the sort to dwell on these things. What you're here for is the relic, which you've got, and for a good payday which awaits you with %employer%.}
a84ece53dcca3b3a98c7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{战斗结束，%item%也已到手。你叫弟兄们准备返回%employer%那里。刚才袭击你们的究竟是什么人、什么东西，你还不太清楚，不过现在该去领钱了。 | 战斗结束后，你打量着那些袭击者。他们裹在你从未见过的铠甲里。%randombrother%想把一具尸体的头从头盔里弄出来，却怎么也办不到。他难以置信地看着尸体。%SPEECH_ON%就像卡死了，或者那玩意儿根本就是他身子的一部分。%SPEECH_OFF%你叫弟兄们收拾装备，准备返回%employer%那里。这些人是谁并不重要，你们此行就是来拿%item%的，而东西已经到手。现在该领报酬了。 | 你拿到了%item%，代价却是撞见一种从未见过的邪恶。那些披甲之人显然早已死去，却仍能组成严密的阵形作战。%randombrother%举起%item%，问接下来怎么办。你告诉弟兄们，该回%employer%那里了。 | 你看了看%item%，又看了看那些为它袭击你的人。至少，你觉得他们是为了它来的。敌军副官似乎说过什么，可你想不起来了。算了，该回去见%employer%，领取报酬了。 | 你不太清楚自己究竟撞上了什么。%randombrother%问你是否听懂了他们的话。%SPEECH_ON%团长，他们好像专门指着您说的。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，告诉他，自己也不确定那披甲之人说了什么，不过这不重要。%item%已经到手，该回%employer%那里领钱了。 | %item%已在手中，可代价是什么？一群怪人——如果还能称之为人的话——袭击了战团。你敢肯定，其中一个特意指着你，仿佛你犯下了某种超越时空的罪行。算了，你向来不爱纠缠这些事。此行你要的是圣物，而它已经到手；还有一笔丰厚的报酬，正在%employer%那里等你。}

ca4a21f07401d3cb55f8.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{You step into %location% and take a good look around. It's not a moment later that %randombrother% points out the %item%, the relic sitting atop a stone podium that's covered in moss and cobwebs. He also points to something else sitting across the room: a very nice looking %risk% adorned to a tall statue's body.

The rest of the place is dilapidated and looking ready to crumble right on top of your heads. What the %risk% is doing there is definitely questionable. | The %item% is plain as day to see, but there's something else in the room that catches your attention. Sitting beside an enormous statue is a very unique looking %risk%. Of course, it begs the question, what in all the hells is it doing out there? While you think it's plain as day you should go and grab it, something tells you that might not be the wisest of decisions. | Well, you found the %item%. It was a lot easier than you'd thought it would be. But there's something else here, too. You spot a glittering %risk% adorned to a tall statue of a man with a blank face. You're not sure what a statue is doing with such a thing, but there it is. And there it seems to always have been, which begs the question, why? | The %item% was easy enough to find, but as you prepare to go and grab the townsfolks' relic, you spy a shiny %risk% adorning a tall and ominous statue of a man. Your first thought is to send a mercenary to go and grab it, but then you wonder what in all the hells it is doing there.} Perhaps the %companyname% should stick to what it was tasked to do?
ca4a21f07401d3cb55f8.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{你走进%location%，仔细环顾。没过片刻，%randombrother%便指出了%item%，那件遗物正摆在长满苔藓、结着蛛网的石台上。他还指向房间另一头：高大的雕像身上，装饰着一件十分漂亮的%risk%。

周围其他地方全都残破不堪，仿佛随时会塌到你们头上。%risk%为何会在这里，实在可疑。 | %item%一眼便能看见，可房间里还有别的东西吸引了你。一尊巨大雕像旁，放着一件模样格外独特的%risk%。自然，问题来了，它究竟为什么待在那儿？你本觉得，走过去拿走是再明白不过的选择，可某种感觉又告诉你，这未必明智。 | 好吧，%item%找到了，比预想容易得多。不过，这里还有别的东西。一尊神情空白的高大人像上，装饰着闪亮的%risk%。你不明白雕像为何会有这东西，可它确实就在那儿，而且似乎一直都在。这便让人想问，为什么？ | %item%并不难找，可你正准备拿起镇民的遗物，却看见一件亮闪闪的%risk%，装饰在高大而不祥的人像身上。你第一个念头，是派佣兵过去拿，随即又想，它到底为什么会在这里？}也许，%companyname%还是只做受托的事为好？

bb864dbfcd59bc334652.source: We might as well take that %risk% while we're here.
bb864dbfcd59bc334652.translation: 来都来了，不妨顺手拿走%risk%。

961db3c52dc4955ca1ad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]%employer% asked you to get the %item% and that's exactly what you're going to do. {%randombrother% agrees with this approach.%SPEECH_ON%I think we should leave that %risk% well enough alone. I've never seen a clearer display of a trap than that.%SPEECH_OFF% | Shaking his head, %randombrother% laughs at your hesitancy.%SPEECH_ON%You scared of that big ol' statue, huh? Though you'd have had more guts than that, sir.%SPEECH_OFF% | After you grab the relic, %randombrother% barbs you with an elbow to the side.%SPEECH_ON%Is someone afraid of the big bad statue, huh? C'mon, let me grab it. We can have it and be out the door in two seconds!%SPEECH_OFF%You kindly remind the mercenary who is in charge lest he 'joke' around again. | The relic already in your hand, %randombrother% simply nods.%SPEECH_ON%Good on ya, sir. I say we leave that %risk% well enough alone. That there shining bauble ain't nothing but trouble. Going after it would be akin to a fool chasing a beautiful woman in the middle of all the ocean!%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother% glares at the %risk% and spits, clearing his throat and running a hand across hid disheveled face.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah. Let's leave it well enough alone. If I were to find a pile of gold in the middle of a forest, I think I'd think twice about runnin' fer it. Same notion here.%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother% agrees with your decision.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, let's leave that there %risk% alone. Nothing's free in this world, nothing. Certainly nothing with that sort of shine. No sir.%SPEECH_OFF%}
961db3c52dc4955ca1ad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]%employer%要你带回%item%，你也就只做这件事。{%randombrother%赞同这个办法。%SPEECH_ON%我看，别碰那%risk%最好。没见过比这更明摆着的陷阱。%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother%摇头，笑你犹豫。%SPEECH_ON%怕那尊大破雕像了，嗯？长官，我还以为你胆子更大些。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你拿起遗物后，%randombrother%用胳膊肘顶了顶你。%SPEECH_ON%有人怕那尊凶巴巴的大雕像啦？来嘛，让我去拿。两秒钟，东西到手，人就出门！%SPEECH_OFF%你温和地提醒佣兵，谁才是说了算的人，免得他再“开玩笑”。 | 遗物已经在你手里，%randombrother%只是点头。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，长官。依我看，别碰那%risk%。亮闪闪的小玩意儿，除了麻烦什么都不是。追着它去，就像傻瓜在大海中央追漂亮姑娘！%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother%瞪着%risk%，啐一口，清清嗓子，用手抹过凌乱的脸。%SPEECH_ON%对，还是别碰。要是在林子正中发现一堆金子，我肯定得想想，才会跑过去。这里也是一样。%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother%赞同你的决定。%SPEECH_ON%没错，别碰那%risk%。世上没有白拿的东西，没有。尤其没有那么亮闪闪的白拿之物，绝没有，长官。%SPEECH_OFF%}

bdf4233e57412dda41f2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{With the %item% in hand, you figure you might as well grab the %risk%. %randombrother% goes and does it, carefully freeing the statue of the piece. Once the metal wriggles free, the man pauses, readied to get clobbered if the statue were to jump to life. Instead, nothing happens. He nervously laughs.%SPEECH_ON%E-easy-peasy!%SPEECH_OFF%As relief spreads over the men, you tell them to get ready to return to %employer%. | As you grab the %item%, you glance at the %risk% and figure why not. You climb up the statue and stare into the face of the man it has taken its image from. Whoever it was, they had chiseled cheekbones and a jaw to hang a coat on. Looking past his features, you grab the %risk% and hold it out, waiting for something to happen. Nothing does. %randombrother% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%You gonna tell that statue 'welcome' or not?%SPEECH_OFF%You pat the statue on the head and climb down. The company should head back to %employer% now.}
bdf4233e57412dda41f2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]{%item%已经到手，你想，不如把%risk%也拿上。%randombrother%前去动手，小心地从雕像上取下。金属部件终于松脱时，他停住，做好准备，仿佛雕像随时会活过来，一拳砸下。可什么也没发生。他紧张地笑了。%SPEECH_ON%轻、轻而易举！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们纷纷松口气，你叫大家准备返回%employer%处。 | 你拿起%item%，瞥见%risk%，心想何不一并取走。你爬上雕像，端详被塑成此像的那张脸。不管是谁，都有棱角分明的颧骨，以及突出得能挂外套的下巴。你越过面容，抓下%risk%，举在身前，等着发生什么。什么也没有。%randombrother%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%你不跟雕像说声“不用谢”？%SPEECH_OFF%你拍拍雕像的头，爬了下来。战团该返回%employer%处了。}

cc29943ebc6776f2a296.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]{You send %randombrother% up the statue to retrieve the %risk%. While he's up there, you notice %employer%'s lost bauble tottling about on the podium. Sticking your hand out, you hope to steady it, but instead of it going upright, it simply blows through your fingers like dust. The powdered remains stream around your arm like a snake made of fog. You leap away and the smoke shoots toward the statue, thrusting itself into the eyes which now turn a bright red. The stone cracks and crumbles. The sellsword jumps away. All around there are shapes emerging from the walls, statues breaking apart to give birth to strange looking men armor-clad and with spears yoked over their shoulders.

 You order everyone to prepare for battle! | There's no way you could turn down something like that %risk%. You climb up the statue's face and reach for it, but the second a bit of metal touches your finger there's a rumbling and the statue begins to shake. %randombrother% shouts and you turn around. He's pointing toward the %item% which is dissolving before your very eyes! It turns to powder and you can only watch as a stream of it, like a fog taken to life, swirls around the room and zips right past your face and up the nose of the statue. Its eyes beam red and you immediately jump away. A sellsword comes to your side, his weapon already out.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, sir! Look!%SPEECH_OFF%There are shapes emerging from the walls! Statues that lurch forward like stringed puppets dangling from an old man's fingers. Slowly, each one discards its stony carapace and emerges as an odd looking, armor-clad and spear-wielding man. You quickly command your men into battle formation because whatever it is you have set free here isn't going to be friendly!}
cc29943ebc6776f2a296.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_73.png[/img]{你让%randombrother%爬上雕像，去取%risk%。他还在上面时，你发现%employer%遗失的那件小玩意儿正在台座上摇晃。你伸手想把它扶稳，它却没有立住，反而像尘土一样，从你的指间吹散。粉末绕着你的手臂流转，仿佛一条雾气凝成的蛇。你猛地跳开，烟雾便射向雕像，钻入它的双眼，眼眶随即亮起红光。石头开裂、崩碎。佣兵纵身跳开。四周墙壁中浮现出一个个轮廓，雕像接连裂开，露出身披铠甲、肩扛长矛的怪异人形。

 你命令所有人准备战斗！ | 面对%risk%这样的好东西，你怎么可能不动心？你攀着雕像的脸爬上去，伸手去取，可手指刚碰到金属，四周便响起隆隆声，雕像开始颤动。%randombrother%大喊起来，你回头一看，他正指着%item%——那东西就在你眼前消散了！它化作粉末，你只能眼睁睁看着那股粉尘像活过来的雾气，在室内盘旋，随后掠过你的脸，钻进雕像的鼻孔。它的双眼射出红光，你立刻跳开。一名佣兵来到你身旁，武器已经出鞘。%SPEECH_ON%团长，团长！快看！%SPEECH_OFF%墙壁里正涌出一个个身影！雕像蹒跚向前，像吊在老人指间的提线木偶。它们缓缓褪去石壳，露出怪异的人形，身披铠甲，手持长矛。你立刻命令弟兄们摆好战斗阵形，不管刚才释放了什么，它们都绝不会友善！}

be0b9cb4842df94e1e0d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% meets you at the town square. You hand over the %item% and the man cradles it as if it were an infant he thought lost. After a moment of awkward embrace with the relic, he holds it up high, letting the townspeople see it. They cheer for a time. Too long, truly. You have to elbow %employer% to remind him to pay you. | You find %employer% mucking about in a pig pen. He's kicking the fat sows around, though they seem more focused on the feed than the leather toe tapping on their arse. You loudly clear your throat. %employer% wheels around and his eyes immediately go wide at the sight of the relic. He jumps over a pig and takes the %item%. He shouts to the townsfolk who gather around and pray to the gods for their mercy. Not a one thanks you, naturally. You have to remind %employer% of the crowns he owes you. It's paid and you make your leave as fast as you can. | You find %employer% sitting in the town square, his arms up to the skies, his eyes closed, his mouth murmuring prayers. The townsfolk are all around him, kneeling and doing the same. You pick up a rock and hurl at a weathervane, the clank and rustic spins drawing everyone's attention.

You hold the relic up so all can see. %employer% jumps to his feet and takes the %item%. The people roar with delight, speaking of good things to come. Your payment is handed to you which, truly, is what you would consider a 'good thing'.}
be0b9cb4842df94e1e0d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer%在镇广场迎接你。你交出%item%，他捧在怀里，仿佛抱着一个曾以为失去的婴儿。与遗物尴尬地相拥片刻后，他将其高高举起，让镇民看见。众人欢呼了一阵，说实话，太久了。你不得不用胳膊肘碰了碰%employer%，提醒他付钱。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正在猪圈里忙活，踢着肥母猪。可猪似乎更在意饲料，根本不理屁股上点来点去的皮靴。你大声清清嗓子，%employer%猛然转身，一看见遗物，眼睛立即瞪大。他跨过一头猪，接过%item%，向镇民高声呼喊。众人聚来，祈祷感谢诸神的仁慈。自然，没一个谢你。你得提醒%employer%，还欠你克朗。钱到手，你便尽快离开。 | 你发现%employer%坐在镇广场，双臂朝天，双眼紧闭，口中念念有词地祈祷。镇民围在四周，也跪着做同样的事。你捡起石头，掷向风向标，金属铿锵一响，锈蚀的叶片转动，引来所有目光。

你举起遗物，让众人看见。%employer%一跃而起，接过%item%。人群欢呼，念叨着好事将至。报酬交到你手里，这才是真正称得上“好事”的东西。}

217274452c7cae63f5a8.source: The townsfolk seem to be in a good spirit now.
217274452c7cae63f5a8.translation: 镇民现在看起来心情不错。

037ef873d712db3045bf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{The townsfolk of %townname% are eagerly awaiting your return. A shame, because you don't have the relic that they so desperately need. %employer%, seeing your failure a step ahead of the laymen, meets you at the town entrance and talks to you in whispers.%SPEECH_ON%I take it you do not have the %item%.%SPEECH_OFF%You try to explain all that happened, but he does not seem to listen.%SPEECH_ON%It's no matter, mercenary. I can't pay you, obviously, and the townsfolk shan't hear of your shortcomings lest we have them lose their minds. They depend upon idols to find comfort in this world. I will have to come up with my own solution and, well, pray it works. Good day.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% meets you beside a host of geese. He's feeding them out of hand while, quite casually, a boy will occasionally come by and simply pick up one of the birds and go off with it for a slaughtering. The man smiles warmly at you, but his excitement quickly sours.%SPEECH_ON%I do not see the relic. Am I right to believe you do not have it?%SPEECH_OFF%A simple nod is all you give as an answer. He opens his arms, somewhat confused.%SPEECH_ON%Then why have you come? The townsfolk know you. They know you were out there looking for it. You should leave before they see you've returned without their godly idol.%SPEECH_OFF% | You return to %employer% emptyhanded. He takes you by the side and whispers.%SPEECH_ON%And why have you come at all? Do you not understand what import these townsfolk have put upon the idol? Without it to worship, they'll have nothing to believe in. Men of strong faith needs somewhere to put it. If he can't find it, all he finds is himself. And, like an ugly brute staring into a mirror, we needn't rush to see the anger and confusion in the reflection of the idol's absence. Leave, sellsword, before the people see you've not returned with the %item%.%SPEECH_OFF%}
037ef873d712db3045bf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{%townname%的镇民正热切地盼着你回来。可惜，你没带回他们急需的圣物。%employer%比那些平民更早看出你失败了，便在镇口迎上来，压低声音与你交谈。%SPEECH_ON%看来，你没拿到%item%。%SPEECH_OFF%你试着解释经过，他却似乎没在听。%SPEECH_ON%不必说了，佣兵。我显然不能付钱给你，镇民也不能知道你失手了，否则他们非得发疯不可。他们靠着神像，才能在这世道里找到慰藉。我得另想办法了，然后，好吧，祈祷能管用。再见。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%在一群鹅旁边与你见面。他正把食物放在手心喂鹅，不时有个男孩随意走来，捉起一只，带去宰杀。他向你温和地微笑，可兴奋很快便消失了。%SPEECH_ON%我没看见圣物。是不是可以说，你没拿到？%SPEECH_OFF%你只点了点头。他摊开双臂，有些不解。%SPEECH_ON%那你为什么还来？镇民认得你，知道你出去找它了。趁他们还没发现你空手而归、没有带回神像，赶快走吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你两手空空地回去见%employer%。他把你拉到一旁，低声说道。%SPEECH_ON%那你到底还回来做什么？你不明白镇民把这尊神像看得多重吗？没有它供奉，他们就没了信仰的寄托。信仰越虔诚的人，越需要一个寄托。找不到，眼前就只剩下自己。就像丑陋的莽汉照镜子一样，我们可不必急着去看，神像缺席后映出的愤怒与迷茫。走吧，佣兵，趁人们还没发现你没有带回%item%。%SPEECH_OFF%}

d63f08d395c0de76a5b3.source: Get paid for every head you collect on the road (%killcount%/%maxcount%)
d63f08d395c0de76a5b3.translation: 沿途每取得一颗敌人的首级，都能领取赏金（%killcount%/%maxcount%）

0f24cb6f3f003b8451f1.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer% offers a stern hand to one of his chairs. You take a seat.%SPEECH_ON%The region is not safe. Traders are complaining about brigands and other threats along the road.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks down, massaging his temples.%SPEECH_ON%As all my men are currently tied up, I need you to patrol the area. Travel to %location1%, continue to %location2% and then return here within %days% days. If you encounter any threats, make sure to take care of them. I won't be paying you for a stroll through the woods, mercenary. Payment will be granted per head you bring me.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s crooning over a map, his eyes darting like that of a hawk over a field of scurrying mice. He seems unable to focus.%SPEECH_ON%All over the place, that's where my men are. Here. There. Over there. This part of the map? Doesn't even have a name, but they're there, too. Where they're not is here, and here. And that's where you come in, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses to look up at you.%SPEECH_ON%I need you to patrol the territories to %location1% and then to %location2%. Kill anything or anyone that thinks the road belongs to them. I'm sure you know that type. But I'm not paying you to take a walk, sellsword. Bring me every head you collect within %days% days and I'll pay you for each.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% takes a swig of wine and burps. He seems rather annoyed.%SPEECH_ON%I don't ordinarily ask mercenaries to do patrols for me, but most of my men are currently tied up elsewhere. It's a pretty simple task: just go to %location1% then to %location2%, then return here within %days% days. Along the way, slay every man or beast that'd be a danger to the people of these lands. But do be sure to collect their heads: I'll be paying you by the trophy, not by how many miles you walked.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% grins slyly.%SPEECH_ON%What say I give you a task where you're not paid just for doing it, but paid for how many heads you can collect? Does that prospect interest you? Because right now I need the lands to %location1% and %location2% patrolled. You take a stroll, kill things here and there, and then return to me within %days% days with whatever heads you've collected.

I will pay you for those you kill. Let me know what you think.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% puts a finger to a map.%SPEECH_ON%I need you to go here.%SPEECH_OFF%He trails the finger to another location.%SPEECH_ON%And then to here. One long patrol. You kill anything that thinks it owns the roads that doesn't carry the %noblehousename% name. Do be sure to take their heads, though. I will not be paying you to take a vacation. I'll be paying you for each trophy you bring me on your return within %days% days.%SPEECH_OFF%}
0f24cb6f3f003b8451f1.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%严肃地抬手指向一把椅子，你坐了下来。%SPEECH_ON%这一带不太平。商人们都在抱怨，道路上有土匪，还有其他威胁。%SPEECH_OFF%他低下头，揉着太阳穴。%SPEECH_ON%我的人眼下全脱不开身，所以需要你替我巡逻。先到%location1%，再去%location2%，然后在%days%天内回到这里。途中碰见威胁，务必清除干净。我可不会付钱让你去林子里散步，佣兵。带回多少颗脑袋，就领多少报酬。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%对着地图低声嘀咕，目光像盘旋在鼠群上方的鹰，来回乱转，似乎怎么也定不下来。%SPEECH_ON%我的人到处都是。这里，那里，还有那边。地图上这块地方？连个名字都没有，可那里也有人。偏偏这里和这里没人，这就要靠你了，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他停下来，抬头看你。%SPEECH_ON%我要你巡逻到%location1%，再前往%location2%。不管是人还是别的东西，谁敢把道路当成自己的地盘，就杀了它。你肯定知道我说的是哪种。不过，我可不会付钱请你散步，佣兵。在%days%天内，把收集到的脑袋都带回来，按颗给钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%灌了一大口酒，打了个嗝，看起来十分烦躁。%SPEECH_ON%平时我不会找佣兵替我巡路，可现在大多数人都在别处忙着。差事很简单：去%location1%，再去%location2%，然后在%days%天内回到这里。沿途凡是威胁当地百姓的人和野兽，一律杀掉。但别忘了带上脑袋：我按战利品付钱，可不是按你走了多少里路。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%狡黠地笑着。%SPEECH_ON%我给你一桩差事，报酬不看你做没做，而是看你能收集多少颗脑袋，怎么样，有兴趣吗？我现在正需要人巡查通往%location1%和%location2%的领地。你出去走一圈，沿途该杀的杀，然后在%days%天内，带着收集到的脑袋回来。

杀多少，我就付多少。说说你的意思吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%用手指点住地图。%SPEECH_ON%我要你先去这里。%SPEECH_OFF%他的手指划向另一处。%SPEECH_ON%然后到这里。一趟长途巡逻。凡是敢霸占道路、又不属于%noblehousename%家族的，一律杀掉。务必带上脑袋，我不会花钱送你去度假。你在%days%天内回来，我按带回的战利品付钱。%SPEECH_OFF%}

2b497300f20d3805427d.source: How much are we talking about?

426a89ce110e6ed85027.source: That's too much walking for my taste.

9ce56507789e2218d0b0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]%randombrother% comes back to you with a scouting report.%SPEECH_ON%Some burned hamlets. A dead man cut in half at the belly. Legs missing. His dog was just laying there. Wouldn't leave. Couldn't coax it nowhere. Found a dead donkey up in some trees. The hawing end had a spear sticking out of it.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses, thinks, then snaps his fingers.%SPEECH_ON%Oh! Almost forgot. There's a crucified man down the other side of that hill yonder. He was alive. Doing a bunch of screaming, but I stayed clear. A stranger's pain is tricky business.%SPEECH_OFF%
9ce56507789e2218d0b0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]%randombrother%带着侦察结果回来。%SPEECH_ON%有几个村子烧了。一个死人被从腰上斩成两截，腿不见了。他的狗就趴在旁边，怎么哄都不肯走。树上还挂着头死驴，脑袋上插着一杆矛。%SPEECH_OFF%他停下来想了想，忽然打了个响指。%SPEECH_ON%哦！差点忘了，那边山坡另一头，还钉着个人。他活着，一直在惨叫，不过我没靠近。陌生人的苦难，可不是随便能掺和的。%SPEECH_OFF%

f78a3d94f4d9fc8fd24c.source: Yes. Let's go see this crucified fellow.
f78a3d94f4d9fc8fd24c.translation: 好，去看看那个被钉在十字架上的家伙。

a164eb17d75ed88869d3.translation: 没什么需要处理的。汇报得不错。

84dc2dfb2f6131acc447.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]You decide to venture down and see the crucified fella.

 You top a nearby hill and look down its slopes. It's pretty much as the sellsword put it. There's a crucified man down the end of the hillside. He's hanging limp, though even from here you can hear his occasional scream. %randombrother% asks what to do.
84dc2dfb2f6131acc447.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]你决定过去看看那个被钉起来的人。

你登上附近的山头，向坡下望去，情形跟弟兄说的差不多。山坡尽头钉着一个人，身体软软垂下，隔着这么远，仍能听见他偶尔发出的惨叫。%randombrother%问你打算怎么办。

8ed103ea9ab8c165c75a.source: This is clearly a trap. Let's wait.
8ed103ea9ab8c165c75a.translation: 这明摆着是个陷阱。先等等。

fbb6b681959e16fb5246.source: Let's leave. Something is off about this.

ea09b32bcee4803be2fd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]You're not sure you could sleep at night knowing you left this poor sod to such a horrid fate. You and the company start down the hillside. It's not an especially quick rescue as you're still worried about ambushes, but nothing does spring. The crucified man grins when you near.%SPEECH_ON%Lemme down and I'll fight for you to the end of my days, I promise it!%SPEECH_OFF%The sellswords leverage their weapons beneath the nails and wrench the man free. He slides down the wooden post into the arms of some mercenaries who gently lower him to the ground. In between sips of water, he talks.%SPEECH_ON%Greenskins did this to me. I was the last of my village and I guess they thought to have a bit of fun beyond just putting an axe in my face. I was beginning to prefer the latter until you came along. I'm not in the best of shape, sir, but with time I'll recover and I swear by my name, which I am the last of, that I will fight for you until death or the last victory!%SPEECH_OFF%
ea09b32bcee4803be2fd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]若任由这可怜人落得如此惨烈的下场，你恐怕夜里也睡不踏实。你带着战团走下山坡。因为仍提防着埋伏，救援来得并不算快，但最终也没有敌人跳出来。见你靠近，那人露出笑容。%SPEECH_ON%放我下来，我就为你战斗到死。我发誓！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们把武器垫在铁钉下面，用力撬开。那人沿木柱滑下，落进几名佣兵的怀里，被轻轻放到地上。他喝几口水，说几句话。%SPEECH_ON%是绿皮干的。村里只剩我一个活人，我想，它们不满足于一斧劈烂我的脸，还想找点别的乐子。你们来之前，我已经开始盼着那一斧头了。我现在的状况不太好，先生，但养些日子总会恢复。我以家族最后一个传人的名义起誓，会为你战斗，直到我死去，或你赢得最后的胜利！%SPEECH_OFF%

cb028c0dc0042977c868.source: Few men could survive such horrors. Welcome to the company.
cb028c0dc0042977c868.translation: 很少有人能从那种惨事中活下来。欢迎加入战团。

81ff8a1d1fe9fd899372.source: This company is no place for you.

49e0b1b22997ca610493.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_67.png[/img]Sleeping at night would get a little harder if you left this poor sod behind. You lead the company down the hillside in part to save him and save your own sanity. The crucified fella begins to smile as you near.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, stranger! Thank you thank you thank--%SPEECH_OFF%He's cut off by a sickening 'thunk' of a javelin spearing his chest and into the wooden boards upon which he is crucified. You spin around in time to see greenskins rushing out of some nearby bushes. Goddammit, it was a trap all along! To arms!
49e0b1b22997ca610493.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_67.png[/img]若把这可怜人丢在这里，你往后恐怕难以安睡。你带着战团下坡，既是救他，也是让自己心里好过。见你靠近，被钉起来的人开始微笑。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，陌生人！谢谢，谢谢，谢——%SPEECH_OFF%一声令人牙酸的闷响打断了他，一支标枪刺穿胸膛，深深钉进身后的木板。你猛地转身，正看见绿皮从附近灌木丛里冲出。该死，从一开始就是陷阱！准备战斗！

6fa5f0cf33cd3cd9b796.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]You decide to wait it out. As you sit and listen the dying man's wails slowly quiet down into silence, %randombrother% grabs you by the shoulder and points a little ways off. There are some brigands coming toward the crucified fella. They get there and talk for a time. One man takes out a dagger and starts stabbing it into the dying man's toes. His wails aren't quiet any longer. One of the brigands turns around laughing. He stops. He says something. He points. You've been seen! Before those arseholes can get into formation, you order the %companyname% to charge!
6fa5f0cf33cd3cd9b796.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]你决定继续等。你坐在那里，听着垂死之人的哀嚎渐渐低下，直至无声，%randombrother%忽然抓住你的肩，指向不远处：有几个土匪正朝那人走去。他们到了跟前，说了一会儿话，其中一人拔出匕首，开始刺他的脚趾。哀嚎声立刻又响了起来。一个土匪笑着转过身，忽然停住，喊了句什么，抬手一指。你们被发现了！趁那帮混账还没排好阵，你命令%companyname%冲锋！

39a80aa21fde19a991a3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]Shockingly, the crucified man is still alive after the battle. He calls to you with a raspy voice that carries no words, but a simple tone of 'please help'. You have the brothers cut him down. He passes out the second he hits the ground, then jolts awakes and grabs you by the hand.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, stranger. Thank you so much. The orcs... they came... and then brigands to pillage the remains... but you, you're different. Thank you! I've nothing left in this world but to fight against those who took everything from me. I am %crucifiedman%, the last of my name, and if you give me the honor, I pledge you my sword until the day I die or you see your last victory.%SPEECH_OFF%
39a80aa21fde19a991a3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]令人吃惊的是，战斗结束后，被钉起来的人竟还活着。他用嘶哑的嗓音呼唤你，已说不出字句，却分明是在哀求救命。你让弟兄们把他放下来。他刚落地就昏了过去，转眼又猛地惊醒，抓住你的手。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，陌生人。太感谢了。兽人……它们来了……然后土匪又来抢剩下的东西……可你不一样。谢谢！他们夺走了我的一切，我活在世上，只剩跟他们拼命这一件事。我叫%crucifiedman%，是家族最后的传人。若你肯给我这个荣幸，我愿以手中之剑向你效忠，直到我死去，或你赢得最后的胜利。%SPEECH_OFF%

da3ef5046436fb208520.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]The brigands taken care of, you go to see if the crucified man is still alive. He did not survive. With nothing on his body worth taking, you loot the brigands and get the %companyname% back on the path.
da3ef5046436fb208520.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]收拾完土匪，你走去查看那个被钉起来的人。他没能撑住。尸体上没有值得拿的东西，你便搜刮了土匪的财物，带着%companyname%重回大路。

621813a138775e026efc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]You decide to wait it out. The dying man keeps on dying. His cries get a little bit quieter, which is nice on the ears, but bad on the souls of the men. After a while, %randombrother% comes up and suggests that the company head on down. The likelihood that someone would stay around for an ambush now is very unlikely indeed. You and the company trot down the hillside and get to the crucified man. His chin is to his chest, his eyes half-opened, a froth of drool and blood dripping from his lips. With nothing on him worth taking, you order the %companyname% to get back on the path.
621813a138775e026efc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]你决定再等一等。垂死的人继续挣扎着死去，叫声渐渐低了。耳根清静了些，弟兄们心里却更不好受。过了一会儿，%randombrother%走来，提议下去看看。等了这么久，还会有人守着伏击的可能性已经微乎其微。你带着战团快步走下山坡，来到那人面前。他下巴抵着胸口，双眼半睁，涎水和血沫从嘴角滴落。见他身上没有值得拿的东西，你命令%companyname%回到大路。

674d23eec87cdc73041d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You reach %location1% and have the men take a break. While they rest, you count supplies and make sure everything is in order. Soon enough, you get the company back to marching. | Stopping at %location1%, the first leg of the patrol, you have the men rest for a time. You've more road ahead so you figure now is a good time as any to resupply. | The first leg of the patrol is finished. Now you've to move on to the next one. You inform the men as much and they groan. You also inform them that you are not paying them to bitch, but they groan at that, too. | You reach the first point of patrol and order the men to take five while you count supplies. The patrol is only one third finished. You wonder if you should stock up on more equipment before heading back out. | You reach %location1% safe and for the most part sound.}
674d23eec87cdc73041d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你们抵达%location1%，你让弟兄们休息。趁他们歇脚，你清点补给，确认一切妥当。没过多久，战团便重新上路。 | 你们在巡逻的第一站%location1%停下，弟兄们歇息片刻。前面的路还长，眼下正适合补充物资。 | 第一段巡逻结束，该继续下一段了。你把这话告诉弟兄们，招来一片哀嚎。你又说，自己可不是花钱雇他们发牢骚的，结果他们嚎得更响了。 | 你们抵达巡逻的第一站。你命令弟兄们休息五分钟，自己清点补给。巡逻才完成三分之一，你琢磨着，再次上路前是否该添置些装备。 | 你们平安抵达%location1%，大体上安然无恙。}

8e0762a77f96789d52e4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%location2% is just where it was said to be. You have the men go for some rest and recuperation while you plan out the last leg of the patrol. | The patrol takes you to %location2% which receives you with the same guff and suspicion a mercenary is met with anywhere. You've another leg of the journey to go, so perhaps gathering supplies here is a good idea. | The men fan out into %location2%'s pubs. You simply take stock of your supplies and wonder if resupplying is a good idea. Glancing at the dim lights of a pub, you also wonder if a quick drink wouldn't hurt, either. | Reaching %location2%, %randombrother% suggests that the company should pick up some supplies for the journey back to %employer%. You've already thought of this, but you give the sellsword the satisfaction of having come up with the idea himself.}
8e0762a77f96789d52e4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%location2%果然就在雇主所说的位置。你让弟兄们稍作休整，自己规划巡逻的最后一段路程。 | 巡逻途中，你们抵达%location2%。迎接你们的，仍是佣兵无论走到哪里都会遇到的粗声恶气和猜疑。前面还有一段路，也许该在这里添些补给。 | 弟兄们各自钻进%location2%的酒馆，你则清点物资，盘算是否该补充一些。瞥见酒馆昏暗的灯光，你又想，进去喝一小杯，似乎也无妨。 | 抵达%location2%后，%randombrother%提议，回%employer%那里之前，战团应该先添些补给。你早已想到这一点，不过还是让这位弟兄享受了一下独自想出好主意的满足。}

a74fe8ef3fa47f4beaab.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{Your return to %employer% is met with curiosity. He's counting crowns but, before giving you any, asks you how many 'heads' you collected in your journey. After reporting %killcount% kills, he purses his lips and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Good enough.%SPEECH_OFF%The man spills some crowns into a satchel and hands it over. | Returning to %employer%, you find the man sitting deeply into an enormous chair, as if he needed all that space to support his nobility, opulence, and pride.

You talk about the patrol, how you killed %killcount% while on the road. Your emphasis is on the kills, as that is what you're being paid for. %employer% nods and has one of his men throw crowns into a satchel and hand it over. | %employer% stands by a window, drinking wine and seeming to ogle a few women gardening below. Without turning to face you, he asks how many you killed on your journey.%SPEECH_ON%%killcount%.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman chuckles.%SPEECH_ON%You make it seem so easy.%SPEECH_OFF%Again without looking, he snaps his fingers. A man appears from the side with a satchel in hand. You take it, then take your leave. | %employer% is reading scrolls of papers as he welcomes you in. He's curious as to how many kills you racked up on patrol. You report %killcount%, to which he hums and makes a small note on one of the papers. Nodding his head, he kicks open a chest next to him and starts scooping crowns into a satchel. He hands it over and then, without even looking up, tells you to get out. | There's a party going on at %employer%'s abode. You weave through the crowd drunken opulence to get to the man. He shouts over the music and noise, asking how many you cut down on your patrol. It's odd, but shouting that you killed %killcount% seems to have no effect on the partygoers. Shrugging, %employer% turns and leaves, slipping into the crowd of attendees. You try to chase, but a man cuts you off, slamming a satchel into your chest.%SPEECH_ON%Your payment, mercenary. Now, please, see to the door. People are beginning to notice you and they did not come here to feel uncomfortable.%SPEECH_OFF%}
a74fe8ef3fa47f4beaab.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你回来时，%employer%颇为好奇。他正数着克朗，却不急着给你，先问这趟收集了多少颗“脑袋”。你报出%killcount%个，他抿嘴点头。%SPEECH_ON%够好了。%SPEECH_OFF%他将一些克朗倒进钱袋，递了过来。 | 回到%employer%那里，你发现他深深陷在一把巨大的椅子里，仿佛非得有那么多地方，才托得住他的贵族身份、奢靡气派与傲慢。

你汇报巡逻的经过，说沿途杀了%killcount%个敌人。重点当然放在击杀数上，毕竟报酬就靠这个。%employer%点点头，让手下往钱袋里装了克朗，交给你。 | %employer%站在窗边喝酒，似乎正色眯眯地盯着下面几个摆弄花草的女人。他头也不回，问你路上杀了多少。%SPEECH_ON%%killcount%。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族轻笑起来。%SPEECH_ON%听你说得，可真轻松。%SPEECH_OFF%他仍没回头，只打了个响指。一人拿着钱袋从旁边走出，你接过报酬，告辞离开。 | %employer%一边翻阅文书，一边迎你进来。他想知道你巡逻时杀了多少敌人。你报出%killcount%，他嗯了一声，在一张纸上记了几笔。随后，他点点头，踢开身旁的箱子，开始往钱袋里舀克朗。将钱递给你后，他连头也不抬，便让你出去。 | %employer%的住处正在宴饮。你穿过醉醺醺、满身珠光宝气的人群，来到他面前。他扯着嗓子，压过乐声与喧哗，问你巡逻时砍倒了多少人。说来也怪，你大声报出杀了%killcount%个，在场宾客竟毫无反应。%employer%耸耸肩，转身又钻进人群。你想追上去，一个人却拦在面前，把钱袋往你胸口一撞。%SPEECH_ON%你的报酬，佣兵。现在，请往门口走。宾客已经开始注意到你，他们来这里，可不是为了心里不舒服的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

8f8d464ca89915486f5c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You return %employer% emptyhanded. He sizes you up, notably eyeing your lack of scalps.%SPEECH_ON%Really? No trouble at all?%SPEECH_OFF%You don't move. The man purses his lips and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Ah hell, well...%SPEECH_OFF%He looks at you and almost gags on a chuckle.%SPEECH_ON%Interesting, I guess.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% looks you up and down.%SPEECH_ON%Where are the heads, sellsword? Surely you didn't forget to collect those...?%SPEECH_OFF%You explain that you didn't run into anything on the patrol. The man raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%No shit? Hell... well... bye.%SPEECH_OFF% | You return to %employer% emptyhanded. He stares at your lack of... wares.%SPEECH_ON%What's this? Where the hell are the heads I was gonna pay you for?%SPEECH_OFF%Shrugging, you explain that there was no trouble on the patrol. %employer%'s taking a sip of wine and almost chokes on it at this news.%SPEECH_ON%Wait, really? I mean, I guess that's good and all, but damned... didn't expect that. I, uh, suppose you didn't either.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at each other. A bird coos to fill the silence. The man sips his wine and glances out his window.%SPEECH_ON%So... interesting weather today, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%You roll your eyes.}
8f8d464ca89915486f5c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你空着手回到%employer%那里。他打量着你，尤其留意到你一张头皮也没带。%SPEECH_ON%真的？一点麻烦都没碰上？%SPEECH_OFF%你站着没动。他抿抿嘴，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%啊，该死，好吧……%SPEECH_OFF%他看着你，险些被自己的笑声呛住。%SPEECH_ON%倒也……挺有意思。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%把你从头到脚打量了一遍。%SPEECH_ON%脑袋呢，佣兵？你总不会忘了割下来吧……？%SPEECH_OFF%你解释，巡逻路上什么也没碰见。他扬起眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%不是吧？真他娘的……好吧……再见。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你空手回到%employer%那里，他盯着你看，显然没找到想要的……货物。%SPEECH_ON%怎么回事？我打算付钱买的那些脑袋呢？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，解释巡逻途中没遇到任何麻烦。%employer%正喝酒，听到这话差点呛住。%SPEECH_ON%等等，真的？我是说，这当然是好事，可他娘的……真没想到。我，呃，想必你也没想到。%SPEECH_OFF%你们面面相觑，唯有鸟儿咕咕叫着，填补沉默。他又喝一口酒，望向窗外。%SPEECH_ON%所以……今天天气挺有意思，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你翻了个白眼。}

ee9ddacdf20e67d69191.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You took far too long to complete the patrol you've been tasked with. Consider the contract failed. | A man in the employ of %employer% approaches with a notice. It states that your patrol was meant to be quick, not a merry little walk for yourself. Consider the contract failed. | What were you trying to do, collect as many heads as possible? It's doubtful that your employer, %employer%, would buy such a ruse. There's a reason he only gave you a few days to complete this task. Consider it failed.}
ee9ddacdf20e67d69191.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你花了太长时间，没能按期完成巡逻。这份委托已经失败。 | %employer%手下的人带来一份通知。上面写着，巡逻贵在及时，可不是让你悠闲散步的。这份委托已经失败。 | 你到底想干什么，尽可能多收集些脑袋？雇主%employer%恐怕不会吃这一套。他只给你几天期限，自然有他的道理。这份委托已经失败。}

7a6867c2423cc4703e6e.source: You pulled the crucified %name% down off the means to his execution just in time. He has pledged allegiance to your side until the end of his days or the last of your victories.
7a6867c2423cc4703e6e.translation: 你及时将%name%从处刑的十字架上救了下来。他发誓效忠于你，直至生命终结，或追随你赢下最后一场胜利。

9d5059097a89b03bc798.source: You let a crucified man die a slow death
9d5059097a89b03bc798.translation: 你任由一名被钉在十字架上的人慢慢死去

de0bcd8e2039984caaac.source: Wandered off while tasked to patrol

03538f9d406ecb15e02e.source: Destroy any caravans or patrols of %feudfamily%

d9eccdfce09593bb4d4c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You step into %employer%'s room and he immediately begins talking.%SPEECH_ON%{Good seeing you, sellsword. I need a raiding party to make a mess of %feudfamily%'s pots and pans, if you get my meaning. You don't? Well, basically I need you to go into their territories and burn down everything you can get your hands on. I'd say about %days% of this will do some real damage to their war efforts. And be very, very careful of enemy patrols. | Ah, mercenary. Look, I need some hardy men to go into %feudfamily% territory and burn every caravan and crop they come across. Not the most honorable of work, but efforts like these will help end the war. I'd say spend %days% out there and then head on back. | I need raiders to dive into %feudfamily% territory for %days% and destroy as many of their resources as can be done. You'll be hated and they'll come after you hard and fast, but if you can avoid their patrols the job should be quick and easy. What say you? | We're at war with %feudfamily%, but wars require a bit more than clashing armies against one another. Sometimes they demand a bit of subterfuge. What I need, sellsword, is for you to raid their territories for %days%. Destroy caravans, burn farms, anything that will help the war cause. Of course, you should be wary of enemy patrols. I know if you were coming after my lands and peoples, I'd come after you doubly hard. So, what say you? | Let me be brief. I need someone to raid %feudfamily%'s territories for %days%. Of course, they'll be expecting men such as yourself so I'd work hard to avoid any patrols while you're out there. Are you interested? | I got the perfect job for you, sellsword. I need you to raid %feudfamily%'s territories and destroy as much as you can for about %days%. Efforts such as these can help end wars. Of course, they'll understand that little fact, too, and will do everything they can to stop you.}%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you into his room and points at a map stretched across a table.%SPEECH_ON%Did you know that one of the best ways to fight a man, is to ensure that he is unable to fight at all? I read that in an old book.%SPEECH_OFF%A very artsy view of war, but true. You nod. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%I want you to head into %feudfamily% lands and tear up as much as their territory as possible. Destroy caravans, burn farms, you get the idea. Do as much damage as you can in %days% and then head on back. Oh, one last thing. Be wary of enemy patrols. They will not take kindly to your... excursions.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% perusing a book. He's making notes in it with a quill pen.%SPEECH_ON%My grandfather once defeated an army ten times his size. How did he do it? The historians and scribes, who is paid and fed by my family, tell stories of grandeur on the battlefield. But that is not the truth. Do you know the truth?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and guess that his grandfather used subterfuge of some sort. The nobleman claps the book shut and briefly points a finger.%SPEECH_ON%Exactly! He took a mere handful of men and burned down all their farms, granaries, and food stores. Of what use is such a large army if you cannot feed it? I need you to do the same, sellsword. Go into %feudfamily% territories for %days% and destroy as much as you can. Avoid the patrols, of course. They sure as shite will fight hard to have your neck if they catch ya.%SPEECH_OFF% | You step into %employer%'s room to find him combating with a very old general. The commander straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%I will not sully my family's name with such deplorable actions. Get some low born sod to do it if you want to take this route!%SPEECH_OFF%The commander grabs his things and leaves in a huff, turning his nose up at you as he heads out. %employer% smiles as you walk in. He opens his arms and speaks.%SPEECH_ON%Well, speak of a very needed devil. Sellsword, I need someone to raid %feudfamily% territory for %days%. My noble commanders think this is beneath them, but I think you'll do it just fine. Of course, our enemies will think it is beneath them, too, and so if they find you be prepared because they'll be coming especially hard.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is staring at spilt milk running across his table and dripping off the edge.%SPEECH_ON%Did you ever have a day ruined over something very simple like this?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Who hasn't? The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%My intentions were to make cheese, but now I cannot because the ingredients have been ruined. Sellsword, this prompt and entirely coincidental adage also applies to war. I need you to raid %feudfamily%'s territory and, proverbially speaking, spill their milk: destroy caravans, burn farms, collapse mines, whatever it takes. %days% of that kind of work should do the job. Of course, beware their patrols while you're out there. I sure as shite would be looking to put your head on a pike if you were doing these things in my territories!%SPEECH_OFF% | A guard leads you to %employer% who is tending to some crops in his garden. The plants are keeled over, their leaves serrated and mottled by the munching of invasive insects. Picking up one of the dead plants, %employer% speaks.%SPEECH_ON%This was looking like it was going to be the strongest season for these crops. And yet, here they are, felled by the smallest of bugs which ran wild through here. I'm sure it was a grand ol' time for those tiny bastards.%SPEECH_OFF%He drops the plant and claps you on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, I need someone to be the devilish insect in my enemy's garden. I need you to raid %feudfamily%'s territories for at least %days%. Of course, if they catch you, expect them to treat you like a bug and squash you like one, too. So keep clear of the boots on the ground. You know, like a bug would.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is humoring a wench when you walk into his room. She quickly gathers her things and leaves in a hurry, diverting her eyes from yours. The rather smug nobleman pours himself a glass of wine.%SPEECH_ON%Don't mind her. She's friends with my wife. That's all.%SPEECH_OFF%He sets the decanter back on his desk.%SPEECH_ON%Speaking of just friends, why don't you be a friend of mine and go and raid %feudfamily%'s territories?%SPEECH_OFF%The man wobbles as he steps before sitting on the edge of a desk. He sniffs his fingers, shrugs, and drinks the wine.%SPEECH_ON%Go into their lands and destroy as much as you can for %days%. Then head on back. I mean, you can stay out there if you want, but I highly suggest coming back because their armies won't be putting up with your shite for long. Noblemen don't fancy raiders with much regard. I'm sure you understand the politics there.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is surrounded by his commanders. He beckons you forth and points a finger as if to accuse you of a crime you didn't even know had been committed.%SPEECH_ON%This is our man! This is the one who will do it! Mercenary! I need hard fighters to raid %feudfamily%'s lands for %days%. Destroy as much as you can, whatever hurts their ability to wage war. Of course, stay nimble on your feet. They'll be looking to expediently crush any raids they discover.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d9eccdfce09593bb4d4c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你走进%employer%的房间，他立刻开口。%SPEECH_ON%{佣兵，见到你真好。我需要一支袭扰队，把%feudfamily%的锅碗瓢盆砸个稀烂。你懂我的意思吧？不懂？好吧，简单说，我要你进入他们的领地，见什么烧什么。我看，折腾上%days%，就足以重创他们的战争补给。还有，务必格外小心敌人的巡逻队。 | 啊，佣兵。听着，我需要一些硬汉，进入%feudfamily%的领地，把遇上的商队和庄稼统统烧掉。这活不算光彩，可这种行动能帮助结束战争。在外面干上%days%，然后回来。 | 我需要一支袭扰队，深入%feudfamily%的领地，停留%days%，尽可能摧毁他们的物资。他们会恨你入骨，追得又快又狠。但只要避开巡逻队，这活应该干得既快又轻松。怎么样？ | 我们正与%feudfamily%交战，可战争不只是两支军队正面厮杀，有时候还得用些暗招。佣兵，我要你袭扰他们的领地，持续%days%。摧毁商队，焚烧农场，凡是有利于战事的，都可以做。当然，要提防敌方巡逻队。要是你敢动我的土地和百姓，我准会加倍报复。所以，怎么样？ | 长话短说，我需要人去袭扰%feudfamily%的领地，持续%days%。当然，他们会防备你这种人，所以在那边行动时，务必尽力避开巡逻队。感兴趣吗？ | 佣兵，我有桩再适合你不过的差事。我要你袭扰%feudfamily%的领地，在大约%days%里尽可能多搞破坏。这种行动能帮助结束战争。当然，他们也懂这个道理，所以会想尽办法阻止你。}%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%招呼你进屋，指向铺满桌面的地图。%SPEECH_ON%你知道吗，对付一个人最好的办法之一，就是让他根本无力作战。我在一本古书里读到的。%SPEECH_OFF%很有文人气的战争见解，不过没错。你点点头，他继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%我要你进入%feudfamily%的领地，尽可能把那里搅个天翻地覆。毁掉商队，烧掉农场，你明白的。在%days%里，能破坏多少就破坏多少，然后回来。哦，还有最后一点，提防敌方巡逻队。他们可不会善待你这番……出游。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正读着一本书，用羽毛笔作注。%SPEECH_ON%我的祖父曾击败过十倍于己的军队。他怎么做到的？靠我家供养的历史学者和书记员，都把它写成战场上的辉煌壮举。但那不是真相。你知道真相吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，猜他祖父用了某种计谋。贵族啪地合上书，伸出一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%正是！他只带了寥寥几人，就烧掉敌人所有的农场、粮仓和粮食储备。喂不饱的军队，再大又有什么用？佣兵，我要你照着做。深入%feudfamily%的领地，待上%days%，能毁多少就毁多少。当然，避开巡逻队。要是被逮住，他们准会拼了命地要你的脑袋。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，发现他正与一位年迈的将军争执。指挥官挺直腰背。%SPEECH_ON%我绝不会用这种卑劣行径玷污家族的名声。你若执意如此，就找个出身低贱的家伙去干！%SPEECH_OFF%他拿起东西，气冲冲地离开，经过你身边时还傲慢地扬起鼻子。%employer%见你进来，露出笑容，张开双臂。%SPEECH_ON%哈，正需要个魔鬼，魔鬼就到了。佣兵，我要你去袭扰%feudfamily%的领地，持续%days%。我的贵族将领们觉得这事有失身份，可我相信，你一定干得很好。当然，敌人也会觉得这种事卑鄙。所以，一旦被发现，就得做好准备，他们会追打得格外凶狠。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%盯着桌上洒出的牛奶，看它淌过桌面，滴落边缘。%SPEECH_ON%你有没有因为这种小事，毁掉过一整天的好心情？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。谁没有呢？他继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%我本来想做奶酪，现在不行了，原料没了。佣兵，这个来得及时、纯属巧合的道理，也适用于战争。我要你袭扰%feudfamily%的领地，打个比方，把他们的牛奶也打翻：摧毁商队，焚烧农场，弄塌矿井，什么管用就做什么。这样干上%days%，应该就够了。当然，行动时小心巡逻队。要是你敢在我的领地干这些，我他妈一定想把你的脑袋插到长矛上！%SPEECH_OFF% | 守卫领你去见%employer%，他正在花园里照料作物。植物已经倒伏，叶片被入侵的虫子啃得参差斑驳。%employer%拾起一株枯死的作物，说道。%SPEECH_ON%本来眼看着就要迎来最好的一季收成，结果呢，被小得不能再小的虫子横行一番，全倒下了。那些小杂种想必过得痛快极了。%SPEECH_OFF%他丢下植物，拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我需要有人去当敌人花园里的恶虫。我要你袭扰%feudfamily%的领地，至少持续%days%。当然，若被他们抓到，他们也会把你当虫子，一脚碾碎。所以，躲开地面上的靴子。你懂的，像虫子那样。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进房间时，%employer%正在逗弄一个女人。她赶紧收拾东西，避开你的视线，匆匆离开。贵族颇为得意，给自己倒了一杯葡萄酒。%SPEECH_ON%别在意她。她是我妻子的朋友，仅此而已。%SPEECH_OFF%他把酒壶放回桌上。%SPEECH_ON%说到朋友，你何不也帮我个朋友的忙，去袭扰%feudfamily%的领地？%SPEECH_OFF%他走了几步，晃晃悠悠地坐到桌沿，闻了闻手指，耸耸肩，又喝了一口酒。%SPEECH_ON%进入他们的领地，在%days%里尽可能多搞破坏，然后回来。我是说，你愿意留在外面也行，但我强烈建议回来，因为他们的军队不会一直忍着你的胡作非为。贵族对劫掠者可没多少好感，想必你懂这层利害。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%被一群指挥官围在中间。他招手让你上前，伸出手指指着你，仿佛要指控一桩连你自己都不知道发生过的罪行。%SPEECH_ON%就是他！他就是能办这事的人！佣兵，我需要一群狠角色，去袭扰%feudfamily%的领地，持续%days%。能毁多少就毁多少，只要能削弱他们作战的本钱。当然，脚下得灵活些。他们只要发现袭扰，就会设法尽快扑灭。%SPEECH_OFF%}

2eb6b3422470034fd9f5.source: {Heading out for five whole days will cost you. | That's something the %companyname% can take care of. | Payment?}
2eb6b3422470034fd9f5.translation: {出门整整五天，你可得多付些钱。 | %companyname%能处理这件事。 | 报酬呢？}

369462729a4e608acf6c.source: {This isn't worth it. | We're needed elsewhere. | It's too long a commitment for the company.}
369462729a4e608acf6c.translation: {不值得。 | 别处还有事等着我们。 | 这会把战团拖住太久。}

1fe7ec05871c9b063191.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{You near a farmstead when suddenly one of the shutters bursts open. An old lady yells in a scraggly voice while waving a white flag around. %randombrother% goes to check it out, listening to her for a time before quickly hurrying back.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, she said that %feudfamily% knows where we are and there is a large contingent of enemy forces coming for us. And yes, she used the word 'contingent.'%SPEECH_OFF% | As you pass a homestead a little boy comes running out.%SPEECH_ON%Oooh, are you the ones going to kill the raiders?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask who told him that. The boy shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%I was footsing around the pub and heard that %feudfamily% knew where the raiders were and was sending big men to smash them good!%SPEECH_OFF%The kid claps his hands together as if he was smooshing a bug. You rub the tyke's hair.%SPEECH_ON%Sure, that's us. Now run on back home.%SPEECH_OFF%You quickly inform the %companyname% of the news. | %randombrother% comes running down one of the hillsides. He seizes up next to you, drawing for air.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, I... they...%SPEECH_OFF%He straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%I need to exercise. But that's not what I came to tell you! There is a very large group of enemy soldiers coming our way right this minute. I think they know exactly where we are, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell the men to prepare themselves. | A scouting mission reports that a huge enemy patrol seemingly knows your location and is coming now! The %companyname% should prepare themselves, whether it is to run or stand their ground and fight. | You've been spotted and a large force of %feudfamily% soldiers are coming!
