Prepare the men as best you can, because reports state that these enemies are well armed. | %randombrother% reports to you what he's been hearing from some of the locals. They say a large group of soldiers carrying a banner are heading your way. You ask the mercenary to describe the sigil and he does so in great detail: it belongs to %feudfamily%'s men. They must've caught up to you somehow. The %companyname% should brace itself for a hell of a fight! | A group of women cleaning clothes in a creek ask what you're still doing here. You ask what they mean. One laughs, a barbarous call if there ever was one.%SPEECH_ON%Come again? We asked you what you were still doing here. You know %feudfamily%'s coming hard for the likes of men such as ye. The way I hear it, they'll be on yer arse real soon.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask how they know this. One of the other ladies slaps a shirt in the creek.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, you must be dumber than hell. Rumors travel faster than any horse. Don't ask how. Just the way it is.%SPEECH_OFF%If what these harlots say is true, then surely the %companyname% has a great fight before them! | You step atop a hillside and give the surrounding land as good of a look as you can. Ain't much to the sight except for a large group of men flying the banner of %feudfamily% who seem to be stepping your way. That is one hell of a sight and pretty soon you'll get to see it up close and personal.

 Enemies have caught up to the %companyname%! You should prepare yourself for a hell of a fight on account of burning all their shite.}
1fe7ec05871c9b063191.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{你靠近一处农庄，忽然一扇百叶窗猛地打开。一个老妇人挥着白旗，用沙哑的嗓子大喊。%randombrother%过去查看，听她说了一阵，便急忙回来。%SPEECH_ON%团长，她说%feudfamily%知道我们在哪儿，正派遣大股兵力前来追剿。没错，她用的就是“兵力”这个词。%SPEECH_OFF% | 经过一处农舍时，一个小男孩跑了出来。%SPEECH_ON%噢，你们是去杀劫掠者的吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你问他听谁说的。男孩耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我在酒馆旁边玩，听说%feudfamily%知道劫掠者在哪儿，派了好些大块头，要把他们砸个稀巴烂！%SPEECH_OFF%孩子啪地合起双掌，像在拍扁一只虫。你揉了揉他的头发。%SPEECH_ON%对，就是我们。现在快回家去。%SPEECH_OFF%你立刻把消息告诉%companyname%。 | %randombrother%从山坡上跑下来，停在你身旁，大口喘气。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我……他们……%SPEECH_OFF%他直起身。%SPEECH_ON%我该多锻炼了。不过我来不是说这个！现在正有一大群敌军朝我们这里赶来。我想，他们很清楚我们的位置，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，叫弟兄们做好准备。 | 侦察报告说，一支庞大的敌军巡逻队似乎掌握了你们的位置，正赶来追击！无论是撤走，还是留下迎战，%companyname%都该做好准备。 | 你们被发现了，大批%feudfamily%的士兵正在赶来！尽可能让弟兄们做好准备，情报说，这些敌人装备精良。 | %randombrother%向你报告从当地人那里听来的消息。他们说，大队士兵正打着旗帜朝你们赶来。你让佣兵描述纹章，他说得十分详细：那是%feudfamily%的部队。他们不知用什么办法，已经追上了你们。%companyname%该准备迎接一场恶战！ | 一群在溪边洗衣的女人问，你们怎么还待在这里。你问什么意思。其中一人笑了，笑声粗野得很。%SPEECH_ON%还问？我们是问，你们怎么还没走。%feudfamily%正狠追你们这种人呢。我听说，马上就要撵到你们屁股后头了。%SPEECH_OFF%你问她们怎么知道的。另一个女人把衬衫拍进溪水里。%SPEECH_ON%先生，你可真是笨到家了。流言跑得比什么马都快。别问为什么，事情就是这样。%SPEECH_OFF%如果这帮婆娘说的是真话，%companyname%眼前肯定少不了一场大战！ | 你登上一处山坡，尽力看清周围。景色没什么特别，只是有一大队人打着%feudfamily%的旗，似乎正朝你们走来。这景象可够惊人，而且很快，你就能近距离领教了。

 敌人追上了%companyname%！你把人家的东西烧了个遍，现在该准备迎接一场恶战。}

35c889786f1aaf30418a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]{It's been nearly %maxdays% now. The company should start heading back to %employer% for payment. | The company has been in the field for %maxdays% now. %employer% will be expecting your return now. | With %maxdays% spent raiding, you've reached the time to return to %employer% for pay. No need to spend another second doing what you won't be getting paid for. | %employer% hired you for %maxdays%. The company shouldn't spend another moment in the field that it doesn't have to. Return to the man for your pay. | The %companyname% has put %maxdays% work into doing %employer%'s bidding. That's all the time he was willing to pay so you'd best get back to him now. | %employer% paid for %maxdays% and that's what you've put in. The %companyname% should return to him quickly for payment. | While ravaging the lands is growing on you, %employer% is only paying for %maxdays% work. You'd best get back to him now. | You've put in good work, but it's time to return %employer% as he's only paying you for %maxdays% worth of your services.}
35c889786f1aaf30418a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]{眼看就要到%maxdays%了，战团该动身返回%employer%处，领取报酬。 | 战团已在外行动%maxdays%，%employer%此刻想必正等着你们回来。 | 劫掠已持续%maxdays%，该返回%employer%处领钱了。没有报酬的活儿，多干一秒也没必要。 | %employer%只雇了你们%maxdays%。既然没有必要，战团就不该再在外面多待。回去找他领钱。 | %companyname%已为%employer%效力%maxdays%。他只肯付这么长时间的钱，你最好现在就回去。 | %employer%买的是%maxdays%的工夫，你们也已经干满。%companyname%该尽快回去领钱。 | 蹂躏这片土地虽让你渐渐上瘾，可%employer%只付%maxdays%的工钱。你最好现在就回去。 | 你们干得不错，不过该返回%employer%处了，他只付%maxdays%的报酬。}

92f8ce97ea72e0a71173.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{While on the road, a man in a dark cloak slowly approaches. His face is hidden behind the hood's tuck of darkness. He pauses before you and puts his hands out.%SPEECH_ON%Greetings. I am a messenger of %rivalhouse%. We have an offer for you. Put down your arms for %noblehouse% and join us. You shan't run out of business with us and your company will always be first in line for the best contracts. To sweeten the deal, I am to give you this marvellous weapon called %nameditem%.%SPEECH_OFF%You mull the idea over. Flipping sides is part-and-parcel of the mercenary life. Which noble house is treating the company better? Which house is more likely to win? | You step off the path to take a piss. While relieving yourself, a man suddenly appears out of the dripping bush, although ostensibly dry. You leap back and draw a dagger, but the man puts his hands out.%SPEECH_ON%Woe there, sellsword. I'm a messenger of %rivalhouse%. I am to suggest, and only suggest, to you an offer. Join us. You will assume first priority whenever we are in need of your services, meaning the best contracts with the best pay, and let me tell you, we will always be in need. To help sweeten the deal, I was to offer you this.%SPEECH_OFF%He slowly holds out a masterfully crafted weapon. You tell him to give you a moment and go back to finish pissing. Thoughts rush through your head as something else rushes out your other head. | While getting a lay of the land, a man in a dark cloak approaches. %randombrother% grabs him by the hood and puts a blade to his neck. The man only puts his hands up and says that he's there to send a message from %rivalhouse%. You nod and let him speak and he does so.%SPEECH_ON%We have an offer: join us. Abandon these noble failures you are serving and come work for us. You will be given the best contracts and the best pay and, best of all, you will be on the winning side! As a token of good faith, I am to give you this fine weapon called %nameditem%. If you agree, of course.%SPEECH_OFF%You carefully mull the offer as boardflipping should not be taken lightly. | A shadowy, dark figure comes down the path with a scroll outreached in one hand.%SPEECH_ON%Evening, the %companyname%. I come from %rivalhouse% with an offer of service. Abandon your benefactors and join us. You will find better and more plentiful contracts and, even better, you will be on the winning side of this war! If you agree, and as a token of good faith, you will receive this weapon called %nameditem%.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% looks at you and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Not to step outside my rank, but I'd say this is worth thinking over.%SPEECH_OFF%Indeed it is. | You separate from the company to get a good lay of the land. While surveying the fields before you, a cloaked figure suddenly appears with something outreached. %randombrother% appears and tackles him to the ground and readies to put a blade through his face. The stranger puts his hands up, a rolled-up scroll in hand. You tell the man to stand and present himself. He states he is from %rivalhouse% and he has an offer for the %companyname%.%SPEECH_ON%Switch sides. As mercenaries, there is no honor to lose in doing this, and is in fact wholly expected of you. Chase the crowns, correct? Well, we have the most contracts with the best pay. That's what you are after, no?%SPEECH_OFF%The messenger fixes his clothes, straightening himself like a temporarily embarrassed ambassador.%SPEECH_ON%Additionally, if you choose to accept our offer, I am to give you this weapon known by the name of %nameditem% as a token of good faith. So, what say you?%SPEECH_OFF%}
92f8ce97ea72e0a71173.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{行路时，一个身披深色斗篷的男人缓缓走近，脸藏在兜帽的阴影中。他在你面前停下，摊开双手。%SPEECH_ON%你好。我是%rivalhouse%的信使，带来一个提议。别再替%noblehouse%卖命，来为我们效力。跟着我们，你不会缺生意，最好的委托永远优先交给你的战团。为了表示诚意，我还会送上这件名为%nameditem%的精良武器。%SPEECH_OFF%你仔细考虑起来。改换阵营，本就是佣兵生涯的一部分。哪个贵族家族待战团更好？哪个家族更有望获胜？ | 你走下道路，准备撒泡尿。正方便着，一个男人突然从滴着水的灌木里现身，自己身上倒似乎是干的。你往后一跳，拔出匕首，他却摊开双手。%SPEECH_ON%慢着，佣兵。我是%rivalhouse%的信使，奉命向你提个建议，仅仅是建议。加入我们。只要需要你的服务，你永远是第一人选，也就是说，最好的委托，最高的报酬。而且我可以告诉你，我们总会需要你。为表诚意，我还要送上这个。%SPEECH_OFF%他缓缓递出一件工艺精湛的武器。你叫他等一会儿，转回去把尿撒完。一个脑袋里思绪奔涌，另一个“脑袋”里也有东西奔涌而出。 | 你正查看地形，一个身披深色斗篷的人走来。%randombrother%一把揪住他的兜帽，将刀刃架到他颈边。那人只是举起双手，说自己来替%rivalhouse%传话。你点头，让他说，他便开口。%SPEECH_ON%我们有个提议：加入我们。抛开你如今效力的那些贵族废物，来替我们做事。最好的委托，最高的报酬，而且最重要的是，你会站在胜利的一方！为表诚意，我会送上这件名为%nameditem%的精良武器。当然，前提是你答应。%SPEECH_OFF%你谨慎地掂量条件，毕竟翻脸换边不是能随意决定的事。 | 一个阴沉的黑影沿路走来，一只手向前递着卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，%companyname%。我来自%rivalhouse%，带来一份雇佣提议。离开你的雇主，加入我们。你会得到更多、更好的委托，而且，会站在这场战争的胜利一方！如果答应，作为诚意的表示，你将得到这件名为%nameditem%的武器。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%看看你，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%不是想越俎代庖，不过要我说，值得考虑。%SPEECH_OFF%确实如此。 | 你暂时离开战团，仔细察看地形。正眺望眼前的田野，一个披斗篷的身影突然出现，手里朝前递着什么。%randombrother%冲出来，把他扑倒在地，抬刀就要刺穿他的脸。陌生人举起双手，其中一只还攥着卷轴。你让那人站起来，说明身份。他说，自己来自%rivalhouse%，有个提议要交给%companyname%。%SPEECH_ON%换个阵营吧。你们是佣兵，这么做无损荣誉，事实上，大家本来就料得到。追着克朗走，对吧？我们有最多的委托，付最高的报酬。这不就是你们要的吗？%SPEECH_OFF%信使整理衣服，挺直身板，像一位暂时受窘的大使。%SPEECH_ON%此外，如果你接受提议，我还会把这件名为%nameditem%的武器送给你，以表诚意。那么，你意下如何？%SPEECH_OFF%}

81336f05312a2cfb6c8e.source: You waste your time. Begone or you'll hang from that tree.
81336f05312a2cfb6c8e.translation: 别白费口舌了。滚，否则就把你吊在那棵树上。

4a9eba8773173f10b086.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{You accept the offer. The mysterious messenger takes you to a hidden copse and digs the weapon out from behind some bushes and hands it over.%SPEECH_ON%Good doing business with you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%It's fair to say that %employer% and all his family completely hate you now. | After you accept the offer, the messenger takes you off-path to fish the weapon out from behind some bushes. Handing it over, he also shakes your hand.%SPEECH_ON%You made the right choice, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% no doubt hates you now and there's no point in returning to him, unless your new benefactors request it, of course.}
4a9eba8773173f10b086.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你接受提议。神秘信使把你带到一片隐蔽小树林，从灌木后取出武器，递了过来。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，合作愉快。%SPEECH_OFF%可以肯定，%employer%和整个家族，如今都对你恨之入骨。 | 你接受提议后，信使带你离开道路，从灌木后取出武器，递给你，还握了握手。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你做了正确的选择。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%现在无疑恨透了你，再去见他也毫无意义。当然，除非新靠山提出要求。}

536097a61eb21089b60a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes you into his room. He gives you a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Good work out there, sellsword. You did just about all that could have been asked of you.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found tending to a bunch of chickens. You shoo your way through the flock to get to him and tell him the news. He responds positively.%SPEECH_ON%Ah yeah? Well that's good. Do you want to be paid in chicken feed or crowns?%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman stares at you straight-laced before a smirk betrays him.%SPEECH_ON%You can find %reward_completion% crowns being held by that guard standing yonder. He'll know to hand it over.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is too busy to meet you, but the %reward_completion% crowns one of his guards hands over seems ample enough measurement of how happy he is about your work. | %employer% stirs a finger in a goblet of wine.%SPEECH_ON%Raiding is messy work, but you did good out there. Gotta admit, a part of me was hoping you'd bring the apocalypse itself to my enemies, but what you did is fair enough I suppose.%SPEECH_OFF%He takes his finger out and licks it before throwing you a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns. | %employer% sinks into one of his chairs, hands limp over the rests, his feet kicked out.%SPEECH_ON%Your pay of %reward_completion% crowns is yonder.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods to a corner of the room where a bag is leaning against the wall. You go to retrieve it as he continues talking.%SPEECH_ON%I'd say you did a good enough job. That satchel should weigh heavy with my happiness.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% out in the kennels feeding his dogs.%SPEECH_ON%Good job, sellsword. If all my soldiers were of your constitution and drive, this war would've been over before it saw its first moon. A shame, isn't it?%SPEECH_OFF%He suddenly turns to you, staring intently. You think this is a sly effort to recruit you to his army. You politely give a very political decline before inquiring about the pay. He continues, pointing with a floppy bacon strip to a man standing across the way.%SPEECH_ON%That guard has it. %reward_completion% crowns in total.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% thanks you for your service. That's about all he says before handing you a sum of %reward_completion% crowns. | You find %employer% surrounded by his commanders. They're adjusting the battle map according to the extent of your work. The nobleman straightens up and stares at the results.%SPEECH_ON%It's not all that I could ask for, but it's good. Very good. My guard standing yonder will have %reward_completion% crowns for you.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is standing before a map hanging from the wall. He's using a quill pen to make notes and you notice that these markings follow the path the %companyname% took through %feudfamily%'s territories. The nobleman hums and nods to himself. He speaks without looking at you.%SPEECH_ON%It's not the best, but it's good. %reward_completion% crowns is for you in the corner.%SPEECH_OFF% | One of %employer%'s commanders stops you from entering his room. He hands over a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_ON%The lord is busy. Please take your pay and go.%SPEECH_OFF%}
536097a61eb21089b60a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%请你进屋，递给你一袋%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_ON%干得不错，佣兵。能要求你做的，你差不多都做到了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在照料一群鸡。你边走边赶开鸡群，来到他面前，报告消息。他听后十分满意。%SPEECH_ON%啊，是吗？那就好。报酬你想要鸡食，还是克朗？%SPEECH_OFF%贵族一本正经地盯着你，直到嘴角的笑意出卖了他。%SPEECH_ON%那边站着的守卫，替你拿着%reward_completion%克朗。他知道该交给你。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%忙得没空见你，不过，一名守卫递来的%reward_completion%克朗，似乎已经足以说明他对你的工作有多满意。 | %employer%用一根手指搅动杯中的酒。%SPEECH_ON%劫掠是桩脏活，不过你干得不错。得承认，我心里多少还盼着你给敌人带去末日，不过眼下的成果也算过得去了。%SPEECH_OFF%他抽出手指，舔了舔，随后抛给你一袋%reward_completion%克朗。 | %employer%陷在一张椅子里，双手松垂在扶手外，两腿向前伸着。%SPEECH_ON%你的报酬，%reward_completion%克朗，在那边。%SPEECH_OFF%他朝房间角落点点头，一个钱袋正靠在墙边。你过去取，他继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%要我说，你干得已经够好了。那袋钱里，可装着我沉甸甸的满意。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在犬舍找到%employer%，他正在喂狗。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，佣兵。要是我的士兵都有你这般韧性和干劲，这场战争不出一个月就结束了。真可惜，是不是？%SPEECH_OFF%他忽然转身，紧盯着你。你猜，他是在拐弯抹角地招揽你入伍。你以十分圆滑的说法礼貌谢绝，随后问起报酬。他接着开口，用一条软塌塌的熏肉指向对面站着的人。%SPEECH_ON%在那个守卫手里，一共%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%感谢你的效劳，说的基本也就这些，随后便把%reward_completion%克朗交给了你。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正被指挥官们围着。他们按照你造成的破坏，调整作战地图。贵族直起身，审视结果。%SPEECH_ON%虽说没达到我所有的期望，不过，很好。非常好。那边的守卫会交给你%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%站在墙上悬挂的地图前，用羽毛笔作着标记。你注意到，标记正沿着%companyname%穿行%feudfamily%领地的路线延伸。贵族自顾自哼着、点着头，头也不回地说道。%SPEECH_ON%算不上最好，不过不错。给你的%reward_completion%克朗，在角落里。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的一名指挥官拦住你，不让你进屋，递来一袋%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_ON%大人正忙。请拿好报酬，离开吧。%SPEECH_OFF%}

3774d6eb0ef6238f9f75.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer% and his commanders are getting drunk when you enter their room. One burly general slaps you on the shoulder, looks to say something, then turns and vomits. You hurry your feet away and find %employer% himself.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellsword! I -hic- well, here. %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%He holds out a satchel which you quickly take lest it suffer a fate similarly dispensed by the commander still upchucking behind you. %employer% wobbles backward before leaning against his desk for support.%SPEECH_ON%You damn near punched a hole in %feudfamily%'s war efforts. A damn -hic- fine job! The damned, finest, jobbest, job I ever did -hic- hear of.%SPEECH_OFF%You retreat from the room, weaving around the festivities and puke cities. | %employer% slams a goblet of wine down, sloshing most of it all over himself.%SPEECH_ON%Excellent! Outstanding! Perfection! That is what I have to say about your work, sellsword. Hell, we even got a few deserters from %feudfamily%'s armies who are very worried their side has already lost! Here, have %reward_completion% crowns. It's on me.%SPEECH_OFF%The man bursts into laughter before taking a long drink. | You step into %employer%'s room to find him studying a war map. He tickles his chin with a quill pen, humming to himself and nodding now and again.%SPEECH_ON%You know, I just about ran out of ink tracking your movements through %feudfamily%'s territory. That's how damn good of a job you did, sellsword. You can find %reward_completion% crowns in the corner yonder.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man greets you outside %employer%'s room with a satchel that weighs heavy in your hands.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns for your services. My liege is busy, but most pleased. Hopefully this is a sign of how appreciative he is of your work.%SPEECH_OFF%It's a pretty good sign, yes. | A guard leads you to %employer% who is behind a locked door. There's a woman in there with him and he seems to be in a bit of a... celebratory mood. The guard knocks on the door, then thinks better of it.%SPEECH_ON%I was supposed to tell him you were here, but he doesn't like to be interrupted. Not during times like this. You know. Good times.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and ask where your pay is. The guard leads you to the treasury. You meet a hawkfaced man sitting behind towers of papers and coins. He pushes a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns your way before noting the exchange on a scroll. | %employer% meets you in his garden. He's overseeing some servants putting plants in the fine soil.%SPEECH_ON%What do you have in your garden, sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF%You gently inform the man that you are not the gardening type. He nods as though this was very interesting to him.%SPEECH_ON%I'm thinking of putting turnips in for the coming season. Anyway, enough of that talk. See the servant over there sweating? He's the one holding the heavy satchel. Heavy because it contains %reward_completion% crowns. Your reward for a job well done, sellsword. Maybe you can buy yourself a garden!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% and his commanders are crooning over a battle map. One pushes a token with your company's sigil on it. He tracks the token all across the map, using an inked stick to dab marks every so often. You cross your arms and speak loudly.%SPEECH_ON%Enjoying my work, are we?%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman and his commanders look up at you. %employer% grins and quickly crosses the room.%SPEECH_ON%Don't you know it! You did an amazing job, mercenary. Truly. That guard standing yonder has %reward_completion% crowns as payment for your services.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is standing amongst his commanders. He whoops as you enter the room.%SPEECH_ON%God, damn, son! You near destroyed all that they had! What more could a man like me ask for aside from a smiting bolt from the heavens? You'll get paid %reward_completion% crowns, which I find more than sufficient for a job of this quality!%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% sitting in his room. He looks very happy with you.%SPEECH_ON%{Well well, if it isn't the man of the day. I had a flock of my little birds flying through my window to speak of your work. Word travels fast when you do a job as good as that! %feudfamily% will be crippled and the war brought many steps closer to its ending! I've prepared a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns for you in the corner yonder. | You should carry a little more gusto, sellsword. What you did to %feudfamily% was beyond even what I had asked for. I'm surprised you didn't take it one step further and just kill that whole bloodline while you were at it. Ah, all things in good time. Right now, you got %reward_completion% crowns waiting for you over there in that corner.}%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% crouching before a table with a war map on it. His eyes peer over the edge, scanning a horizon of tokens.%SPEECH_ON%Greetings sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%He jumps to his feet. With one hand, he slowly picks up tokens representing %feudfamily% and begins tossing them aside.%SPEECH_ON%Enjoy your handiwork, sellsword. You managed to cripple my enemies with hardly any effort! I suppose I speak for myself on that front, but what you've done here beats anything a large battle could do! %reward_completion% crowns are waiting for you in the corner yonder. I hope that pay is sufficient, because the job you did certainly was.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% and his commanders and a bevy of womenfolk that don't look properly attired for any war that you know of.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! Come on in%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% wheels backward on his heels, a woman notched to each arm. You follow him in as best you can. A woman tries to drag you into the party, but a general commandeers her. %employer% falls into his seat, the women in his lap.%SPEECH_ON%You are the cause for celebration, mercenary. You did such a good job raiding %feudfamily%'s territories that I think you brought us much closer to ending this war than any big battle ever could have done! Cheers!%SPEECH_OFF%You look around.%SPEECH_ON%Festivities are nice, but I don't have to fight for women and drinks. You owe me money.%SPEECH_OFF%Your employer nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course, of course! Visit my treasurer and give him your sigil. He'll have %reward_completion% crowns waiting for you.%SPEECH_OFF%}
3774d6eb0ef6238f9f75.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你走进房间时，%employer%和将领们已经喝得醉醺醺的。一个魁梧的将军拍了拍你的肩，像是想说什么，却一转头吐了出来。你赶紧挪开脚，找到%employer%本人。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵！我——嗝——好吧，给你。%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%他递出钱袋，你赶紧接过，免得它也遭到身后那位还在呕吐的将军荼毒。%employer%摇摇晃晃地后退，最后靠住书桌才站稳。%SPEECH_ON%你差点把%feudfamily%的战事捅出一个大窟窿。他妈的——嗝——干得漂亮！真他妈，最漂亮，漂亮得不能再漂亮的活，我这辈子——嗝——都没听过。%SPEECH_OFF%你绕过狂欢的人群和遍地呕吐物，退了出去。 | %employer%把盛着酒的高脚杯重重一顿，大半杯酒都泼到了自己身上。%SPEECH_ON%出色！绝妙！完美！佣兵，这就是我对你这次表现的评价。哈，我们甚至收了几个%feudfamily%军中的逃兵，他们很担心自己那边已经输了！来，拿着，%reward_completion%克朗。我请客。%SPEECH_OFF%他爆发出一阵大笑，随后仰头痛饮。 | 你走进%employer%的房间，见他正在研究作战地图。他用羽毛笔挠着下巴，独自哼着曲，不时点头。%SPEECH_ON%你知道吗，为了在地图上标出你穿过%feudfamily%领地的路线，我差点把墨水用光。佣兵，这就说明你干得有多他妈漂亮。那边角落里放着%reward_completion%克朗，去拿吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个人在%employer%的房间外迎上来，交给你一只沉甸甸的钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%这是你的报酬，%reward_completion%克朗。主公事务繁忙，不过非常满意。希望这能让你明白，他有多欣赏你的表现。%SPEECH_OFF%嗯，这表示确实相当明白。 | 一名守卫领你去见%employer%，可门锁着。他在里面，身边还有个女人，听起来似乎正忙着……庆祝。守卫敲了敲门，又觉得还是算了。%SPEECH_ON%本来该告诉他你来了，可他不喜欢被打扰。尤其是这种时候。你懂的，快活的时候。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，问报酬在哪儿。守卫领你去了金库。一个鹰脸男人坐在高高的文书和钱币堆后，把装有%reward_completion%克朗的钱袋推给你，随后在卷轴上记下这笔账。 | %employer%在花园里接待你。他正看着仆人把植物栽进肥沃的土壤。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你的花园里种些什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你委婉地告诉他，自己不种花园。他点点头，仿佛这个回答十分有趣。%SPEECH_ON%我正考虑下一季种些芜菁。好了，闲话到此为止。看见那边那个满头大汗的仆人了吗？他手里提着个很沉的钱袋，沉是因为里面装着%reward_completion%克朗。佣兵，这是你把事情办妥的奖赏。也许你能给自己买座花园！%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%和将领们围着作战地图，兴致勃勃地低声议论。其中一人推着一枚印有战团徽记的棋子，让它在地图上四处移动，不时用蘸墨的木棒点上记号。你抱起双臂，扬声说道。%SPEECH_ON%看来，诸位很欣赏我的杰作？%SPEECH_OFF%贵族和将领们抬头看你。%employer%咧嘴一笑，快步穿过房间。%SPEECH_ON%那还用说！佣兵，你干得实在漂亮，千真万确。那边的守卫拿着%reward_completion%克朗，是给你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%站在一群将领中间。你刚进门，他便欢呼起来。%SPEECH_ON%我的天，好小子！你差点把他们的家底全拆光了！除非老天再劈一道雷下去，我还能奢求什么？你会拿到%reward_completion%克朗。我觉得，这笔钱足够酬谢这样出色的表现了！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在房间里找到%employer%。他坐在那里，对你的表现显然十分满意。%SPEECH_ON%{哟，哟，这不是今天的大功臣吗。我的小鸟们成群飞进窗户，争着告诉我你的事迹。活干得这么漂亮，消息自然传得快！%feudfamily%将元气大伤，这场战争离结束也近了一大步！我给你准备了%reward_completion%克朗，就在那边角落的钱袋里。 | 佣兵，你该更神气一点。你对%feudfamily%做的，远远超出了我的要求。我甚至有点惊讶，你怎么没再往前多走一步，顺手把他们整个家族都杀光。啊，好事总得慢慢来。现在，先去拿那边角落里等着你的%reward_completion%克朗吧。}%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正蹲在铺着作战地图的桌前，双眼刚露过桌沿，扫视着棋子组成的地平线。%SPEECH_ON%你好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他一下站了起来，伸手慢慢拾起代表%feudfamily%的棋子，一枚接一枚地丢到旁边。%SPEECH_ON%欣赏一下你的杰作吧，佣兵。几乎没费什么力气，你就让我的敌人伤筋动骨！当然，说没费力气，大概只适用于我自己。不过，你这番作为，比打一场大战的效果还好！那边角落里有%reward_completion%克朗等着你。我希望这报酬让你满意，因为你干的活，绝对让我满意。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%和他的将领，旁边还有一群女人。就你所知，她们这身打扮可不适合任何一种战争。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！快进来。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%踮着脚跟往后转，两条胳膊各挽着一个女人。你尽力跟了进去。一个女人想把你拉进欢宴，却被一名将军半路截走。%employer%跌坐到椅子里，女人们也落进他怀中。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，这场庆祝就是为了你。你把%feudfamily%的领地劫掠得如此彻底，我想，比起任何一场大战，这都更能让我们接近战争的终点！干杯！%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾四周。%SPEECH_ON%庆祝是不错，但女人和酒，我用不着靠打仗去挣。你欠我的是钱。%SPEECH_OFF%雇主点点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然，当然！去见我的财务官，把你的徽记给他看。他那儿有%reward_completion%克朗等着你。%SPEECH_OFF%}

cedd72077d8eae0ee4b5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You enter %employer%'s room already resigned to what fury he is going to dish out. And dish it out he does.%SPEECH_ON%Lemme get this straight, sellsword. I offer to pay you to go and raid %feudfamily%'s territory. You agree to this offer since, as I thought it was, it was a very good offer and both parties had a lot to gain. Now you stand before me saying you have done fark all in regard to our arrangement. Why did you even bother stepping through that door you sorry piece of a dog's sack? No, you're worse than that, you're a sniveling worm trying to steal from a noble man doing noble work. Get out of here before I lose my temper.%SPEECH_OFF%Despite %employer%'s bravado, he is the one who is sliding into danger. You quickly leave before it is your temper that is lost and a nobleman's life that would go with it. | You return to %employer% but a guard stops you outside the door.%SPEECH_ON%He already knows what you have, or should I say have not done. You'd best not go in there.%SPEECH_OFF%The crashing of a flipped table rattles the door. An incomprehensible scream follows. You take the guard's recommendation and leave. | %employer% runs a finger along the rim of his cup. It whines loudly as he coils around it, again and again.%SPEECH_ON%Such a sweet, sweet tune. How could it be that a simple cup would be better than you, mercenary? I suppose that's just the way this world is sometimes. I ask someone to do something, and they don't do it. What else is there to say? Please, get out.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% feeding scraps to his dogs. Servants watching nearby look as if they'd rather be dogs themselves if this sort of treatment is what they'd get. %employer% turns to you as a dog gently slips a piece of bacon out of his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Dogs have a preference for meat. Here, I feed them the remains of a pig. It was a good pig. A pig that had a good life except for one very bad moment, of course. Now it feeds my dogs. You, sellsword, have brought to me a very bad moment in your own life. Should I also feed you to my dogs? No? Then get out of my room.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% refuses to even meet you. Two of his guards explain that he is furious at your failure to inflict any damage at all upon %feudfamily%'s territories. Fair enough. You thank the guards for saving you from a nobleman's pointless barrage of insults and anger.}
cedd72077d8eae0ee4b5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{走进%employer%的房间时，你已经做好了挨骂的准备。果不其然，他开口便发难。%SPEECH_ON%让我理一理，佣兵。我出钱，让你去劫掠%feudfamily%的领地。你答应了，因为在我看来，这价钱相当不错，双方都有利可图。结果你现在站在我面前，告诉我，约好的事你他妈什么也没干。你这狗卵子一样的废物，究竟哪来的脸踏进这扇门？不，你连狗卵子都不如，你就是条哭哭啼啼的蛆，妄想骗走一位高贵之人行高贵之事的钱。趁我还没发火，滚出去。%SPEECH_OFF%尽管%employer%虚张声势，真正一步步走向危险的却是他。你赶紧离开，免得先失去耐心的是你，而跟着失去性命的是这位贵族。 | 你回去见%employer%，却被门外的守卫拦住。%SPEECH_ON%他已经知道你做了什么，或者该说，什么也没做。你最好别进去。%SPEECH_OFF%屋内传来桌子掀翻的巨响，连门都震了一下，接着是一声听不清内容的怒吼。你接受守卫的建议，转身离开。 | %employer%用一根手指沿杯沿打转。一圈又一圈，杯子发出响亮的鸣音。%SPEECH_ON%多悦耳，多悦耳的曲子。怎么一只普通杯子都比你有用，佣兵？我想，这世道有时就是如此。我叫人去办事，人家偏偏不办。还能说什么呢？请你出去。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正拿碎肉喂狗。旁边的仆人眼巴巴看着，仿佛只要有这等待遇，自己也宁愿当狗。一只狗轻轻叼走他手中的熏肉，%employer%转向你。%SPEECH_ON%狗爱吃肉。我现在喂它们的，是一头猪剩下的肉。那是头好猪，一生过得不错，当然，除了最后那个糟糕的瞬间。如今，它成了我的狗食。至于你，佣兵，你把自己人生中一个糟糕的瞬间，送到我面前来了。我是不是也该拿你喂狗？不想？那就滚出我的房间。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%甚至不肯见你。两名守卫解释说，你没能给%feudfamily%的领地造成任何损失，他为此大发雷霆。也算情有可原。你谢过守卫，让你免去了一场贵族毫无意义的辱骂与怒火。}

f873fac3f394920e5b08.source: Failed to raid the enemy lands

36de30ba8cdbcee38284.source: Raid the caravan going from %start% to %dest%

ab8fc1bb91f5d44ebfa3.source: A caravan with armed escorts transporting something worth protecting between settlements.
ab8fc1bb91f5d44ebfa3.translation: 一支配有武装护卫的商队，在聚落间运送值得严加看守的货物。

3f207599e7d4ae228680.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You take a seat as %employer% folds out a map before you. He drags a finger along one of the poorly drawn roads.%SPEECH_ON%A caravan travels this route. I need it attacked, but wait!%SPEECH_OFF%He holds up the finger.%SPEECH_ON%I need it to look like the work of brigands. No one must know that its destruction came by my order, understand?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% explains that he needs a caravan destroyed. You inquire as to why, exactly, a nobleman such as himself would have such a task to complete, but the man is scarce on details. His primary demand is simple enough, destroy the caravan and kill everyone there. It must look like the work of {brigands | vandals | vagabonds | greenskins}, otherwise the nobleman might be incriminated.%SPEECH_ON%Did you get that last part, sellsword? Of course you did. You're a smart guy, right?%SPEECH_OFF% | You take a seat as %employer% takes a large book from his shelf and opens it before you. Its width encompasses the entire table and the pages are filled with very detailed maps. The nobleman points to a line on one of the topographies.%SPEECH_ON%That's the route of a caravan I need destroyed. Don't ask me anymore questions, I just need it destroyed. Now, all I ask is that you make it look like the work of brigands, alright? It can't be known that I gave the order here. Does that sound doable to you?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% greets you with a handshake, but when you try to get your hand back he holds firm.%SPEECH_ON%What I'm about to say can't leave this room, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and just like that get your hand back.%SPEECH_ON%Good. I need a caravan destroyed, but... no one must know it was you, mercenaries, who did it. If they do, they'll easily track it back to me. I need it to look like the work of brigands. No one must survive, alright?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug as if to say, 'easily done.'%SPEECH_ON%Good, so then we have a deal?%SPEECH_OFF% | As you take a seat in %employer%'s study, a stranger comes in behind you and whispers into the nobleman's ear. Then, just like that, the mysterious man turns and makes his leave. %employer% stands and pours himself a goblet of wine. He doesn't offer you any.%SPEECH_ON%I need a caravan destroyed, but I need this done with a certain amount of discretion. It cannot be known that I, %employer%, told you to do this. No, it was the work of brigands, those bastards... got it? Do you understand? Let's talk numbers if you do.%SPEECH_OFF% | As you take a seat, %employer% inquires as to how familiar you are with the work of brigands. You state that their lives are not too dissimilar from your own, only that you're smarter and have the ear of people who pay better than what you get for robbing peasants. %employer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Good, because I need you to pretend to be a brigand for a day and destroy a caravan. No one must survive. No one must know that you, a mercenary, did it. Understand? If you do, let's talk numbers.%SPEECH_OFF%}
3f207599e7d4ae228680.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你坐下，%employer%在面前展开一张地图。他的手指沿着一条画得歪歪扭扭的道路划过。%SPEECH_ON%有支商队走这条路。我要你袭击它，不过，先等等！%SPEECH_OFF%他举起那根手指。%SPEECH_ON%得让这事看起来是强盗干的。不能让任何人知道，是我下令毁掉商队的，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%说明，他需要你毁掉一支商队。你问，像他这样的贵族，究竟为什么会有这种差事，可他不愿透露细节。主要要求倒很简单：毁掉商队，杀光那里所有人。必须让这事看起来是{强盗 | 暴徒 | 流寇 | 绿皮}干的，否则贵族可能会被牵连。%SPEECH_ON%最后那句听懂了吧，佣兵？当然听懂了。你是聪明人，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你坐下时，%employer%从书架取下一本巨册，在你面前摊开。书页铺满整张桌子，上面全是绘制精细的地图。贵族指着其中一张地形图上的路线。%SPEECH_ON%这是一支商队的路线，我要它毁掉。别多问，我只要它毁掉。唯一的要求是，让这事看起来像强盗干的，明白吗？不能让人知道命令出自我。你觉得办得到吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%握手向你致意，可你想抽回手时，他却牢牢攥着不放。%SPEECH_ON%接下来我说的话，不能传出这个房间，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，他这才松手。%SPEECH_ON%很好。我要毁掉一支商队，不过……不能让人知道，是你们这些佣兵干的。一旦知道，很容易就会追查到我头上。必须看起来像强盗所为。不能留下活口，明白？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，仿佛在说“小事一桩”。%SPEECH_ON%很好，那就说定了？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在%employer%的书房坐下，一个陌生人从身后走来，凑到贵族耳边低语，随后便转身离开。%employer%站起身，给自己倒了一杯酒，没打算分你一点。%SPEECH_ON%我要毁掉一支商队，但这事得做得谨慎些。不能让人知道，是我，%employer%，叫你干的。不，是强盗，是那些混账干的……听懂了？明白了吗？明白的话，咱们就谈价钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你刚坐下，%employer%便问，你对强盗干的活有多熟悉。你说，他们过的日子与你差不了多少，只是你更聪明，还能和付钱比抢劫农民更大方的人说上话。%employer%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%很好，因为我要你当一天强盗，毁掉一支商队。不留活口，也不能让人知道是你这个佣兵干的。明白吗？明白就谈价钱。%SPEECH_OFF%}

09fe6f9e7d44974ba241.source: {What's this worth to you? | Let's talk pay.}
09fe6f9e7d44974ba241.translation: {这件事，你愿意出多少钱？ | 谈谈报酬吧。}

b2c874256ec076606739.source: {This doesn't sound like our kind of work. | I don't think so.}
b2c874256ec076606739.translation: {听起来，这不是我们干的活儿。 | 恐怕不行。}

92c0d418e1c923ca757c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{While closing in on the caravan, one of the guards spots you and everyone draws their weapons. A man, shouting and running with his hands in the air, asks everyone to put their weapons down. He has a satchel in hand, heavy with %bribe% crowns, and says you can take it if you simply let them go. You wonder aloud why you would take the bribe when you could kill them all and take it anyway. The man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Well, it'd certainly save you the trouble of 'killing' us, seeing as how we're not gonna go down without a fight. Just take it and walk, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | As your men approach the caravan, one of the guards spots you and blows a horn, alarming the rest to your presence. Soon, an entire armed guard stands before you, ready to fight. The head of the wagon train comes through their line, holding his hands up.%SPEECH_ON%Stay your weapons, men! Sellsword, I'd like to make you an offer. You take this satchel of %bribe% crowns and walk and nobody has to die here.%SPEECH_OFF%You open your mouth to respond, but the man holds a finger up and keeps talking.%SPEECH_ON%Whoa, think carefully, mercenary. You no longer have the drop on us and I hired these men to protect these wagons for good reason - they're killers, just like you.%SPEECH_OFF% | With your men on the approach, the destruction of the caravan seems to be at hand. Unfortunately, you watch as one of the mercenaries missteps, sliding his foot on a rolling tree limb that sends him skittering and rolling down a small hillside. The disturbance is loud enough to alert the entire wagon train to your presence and you watch as armed guards stream out to meet you. Their lieutenant runs in between the two war bands, his arms in the air.%SPEECH_ON%Wait. Just wait. Before we commence the killin' and slaughterin', let's exchange a few words, shall we? I have here %bribe% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%The man holds up a satchel and waves it toward you.%SPEECH_ON%You take this, walk, and we can all go on our ways. No need for men to be impasses upon one another, right? I'd say it's a mighty fine deal, sellsword, seeing as how you ain't got your sneaking ways on your side anymore - it's gonna be man against man. So what say you?%SPEECH_OFF% | Just as you think your men are about to begin the assault on the caravan, a guard watching the wagons spots them. He hurries to an alarm bell, sounding it loudly just as %randombrother% caves his skull in. Unfortunately, a great number of the guard's compatriots fly out, weapons raised. Their leader is beside them, holding the order back for them to charge.%SPEECH_ON%Ho', men! Not yet. Let us, perhaps, discuss a less... violent end to this here junction.%SPEECH_OFF%He glances at the stoved in head of the guard.%SPEECH_ON%Well, for the rest of us, anyway. I have here in my hand %bribe% crowns. It's yours, ambusher, assassin, whatever you call yourself, if you simply take it and walk. And I'd suggest you do just that - you no longer have the drop on us and I paid good money for these men to watch my goods, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%}
92c0d418e1c923ca757c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{你们逼近商队时，一名护卫发现了你，众人纷纷拔出武器。一个男人高举双手，边跑边喊，叫所有人放下武器。他手里提着一只沉甸甸的钱袋，装着%bribe%克朗，说只要放他们走，钱就归你。你直言疑问：既然可以杀光他们，照样拿走钱，为什么还要收这笔贿赂？男人耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%至少能省下“杀光”我们的麻烦，毕竟我们可不会站着等死。拿钱走人吧，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 弟兄们靠近商队时，一名护卫发现了你们，吹响号角，惊动了其他人。很快，一整队武装护卫便站在面前，准备迎战。车队首领高举双手，从他们的阵列中穿出来。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，先别动手！佣兵，我想和你做笔交易。拿走这袋%bribe%克朗，然后离开，这里就不用死人。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚要回答，那人却举起一根手指，继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%等等，仔细想想，佣兵。你已经没法偷袭了。我雇这些人保护货车，自有我的道理——他们和你一样，都是杀人的好手。%SPEECH_OFF% | 弟兄们步步逼近，眼看商队就要遭殃。可惜，一名佣兵失足踩上滚动的树枝，脚下一滑，连滚带爬地跌下小坡。动静大得惊动了整支车队，武装护卫纷纷冲出，前来迎战。他们的副官高举双臂，跑到两队人之间。%SPEECH_ON%等等，先等等。动刀杀人之前，先说几句话，怎么样？我这里有%bribe%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%那人举起钱袋，朝你晃了晃。%SPEECH_ON%你拿钱走人，大家各走各路。没必要非挡着彼此的道，对吧？要我说，这买卖很划算，佣兵。毕竟你已经没法靠偷偷摸摸占便宜了，真打起来，就是硬碰硬。你怎么说？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你以为弟兄们就要开始突袭商队时，一名看守货车的护卫发现了他们。他急忙奔向警钟，大声敲响，紧接着%randombrother%便砸碎了他的脑袋。可惜，已有大批同伴高举武器冲了出来。首领站在他们旁边，压着没让发起冲锋。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，等等！先别动手。也许，我们可以商量个不那么……血腥的收场。%SPEECH_OFF%他瞥了一眼那护卫被砸烂的头。%SPEECH_ON%至少，对剩下的人来说。我手里有%bribe%克朗。伏击者也好，刺客也好，随你怎么自称，只要拿钱走人，这些就是你的。我劝你照做——你已没法偷袭我们，而我花重金雇这些人守货，可不是白花的，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

f8b2692b4ff20a269fa4.source: {So be it. Hand over the crowns. | A fair offer, we'll take it.}
f8b2692b4ff20a269fa4.translation: {那就这样吧。把钱拿来。 | 价钱公道，我们接了。}

9531cfe9eb8202fa7023.source: Nothing personal, but this caravan is going to burn. And you with it.
9531cfe9eb8202fa7023.translation: 无关私人恩怨，但这支商队要被烧掉。你们也一样。

376d54b94916fb052b8c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{As you begin to leave, the caravan leader grabs you by the arm.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, I'm curious about something, and I bet you got something to scratch that curiosity.%SPEECH_OFF%You angrily retrieve your arm from his grip. He apologizes, but quickly goes into his question.%SPEECH_ON%I'd like to know just who sent you. How does %bribe2% more crowns sound to make my ears privy to such information?%SPEECH_OFF% | The caravan leader catches you before you can depart.%SPEECH_ON%I'm wonderin' something, sellsword, and I know you got the answer for me: who sent you?%SPEECH_OFF%You glance around. He laughs and then slaps you on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Obviously I ain't gonna take an answer for free. How does %bribe2% more crowns in that there satchel sound? Just for a few words that shape to be what they call 'a name.' So how about you give me that name, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF% | The leader calls out to you before you can leave. He's got his arms crossed, his feet mindlessly kicking rocks.%SPEECH_ON%Ya know, I can't just let you leave quite yet. There's some rather pertinent information I'd like to learn of and I'm willing to drop %bribe2% crowns in that satchel there to learn said information.%SPEECH_OFF%You look around, making there isn't an ambush waiting for you. Then you turn back to the man and nod.%SPEECH_ON%You want to know who sent me.%SPEECH_OFF%The leader grins and clasps his hands together.%SPEECH_ON%Boy, you are certainly a quick learner! Why, yes! I do!%SPEECH_OFF%}
376d54b94916fb052b8c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{你正准备离开，商队领队抓住你的胳膊。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，我有点好奇，我打赌，你正好能解开这个疑问。%SPEECH_OFF%你恼火地抽回手臂。他道歉，随即切入正题。%SPEECH_ON%我想知道，究竟是谁派你来的。再加%bribe2%克朗，让我听听这个消息，怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 离开前，商队领队拦住你。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我在琢磨一件事，而且知道你能给答案：谁派你来的？%SPEECH_OFF%你四下瞥了一眼。他笑着拍拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%当然，不会白问。往你那钱袋里再添%bribe2%克朗，怎么样？就换几个字，凑成他们所谓的“名字”。所以，佣兵，把那个名字告诉我吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你还没走，领队便喊住你。他双臂交叉，脚下漫不经心地踢着石头。%SPEECH_ON%你知道，现在还不能就这么让你走。有个相当要紧的消息，我想知道，也愿意往你钱袋里放%bribe2%克朗，来换这个消息。%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾四周，确认没有伏兵等着，随后转回去，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%你想知道谁派我来的。%SPEECH_OFF%领队咧嘴一笑，双手一合。%SPEECH_ON%好家伙，脑子真快！没错！我就是想知道！%SPEECH_OFF%}

19016792d416246fe40f.source: {Hand over the crowns, then. | Very well, not that it makes a difference at this point. | A good deal just got even sweeter.}
19016792d416246fe40f.translation: {那就把钱拿来吧。 | 好吧，反正事到如今也没什么区别。 | 这笔好买卖又多赚了一份。}

334121c6ff49cd3fe492.source: I won't betray our reputation like this, we'll be leaving.
334121c6ff49cd3fe492.translation: 我不会这样败坏战团的名声。我们走。

3fe4aa78360fd2f24031.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{You take the extra crowns, sacking them away, and then give the leader the name: %employer%. He bounces it on his tongue like some sort of poisoned nut.%SPEECH_ON%%employer%. %employer%! Yech, that name. %employer%, like some sort of... well, I won't bore you with my sudden urge to stoop my language into the pits. I thank you, sellsword, and bid you farewell.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and make your leave. | Sacking the extra crowns, you tell the leader the word of the day: %employer%. The man laughs upon hearing it and nods repeatedly as though he expected it all along.%SPEECH_ON%You've done good, sellsword. What a day though, right? First you come here to put a sword through me, but a few minutes later and we are leaving on such good terms. Truly you are a man of business. A shame you decided to put that skill behind a blade instead of a pen. Farewell and godspeed.%SPEECH_OFF% | {In for an ounce, in for a pound. | In for an inch, in for a mile.} You take the man's offer and spill the beans on %employer%'s doings. The caravan leader nods solemnly.%SPEECH_ON%You know, we men of business don't wield weapons like you do, but trust me, it's just as cutthroat. Godspeed, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%}
3fe4aa78360fd2f24031.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{你收下额外的克朗，装进袋里，随后说出名字：%employer%。领队反复咀嚼，仿佛舌头上滚着一颗毒果。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%。%employer%！呸，这名字。%employer%，简直像个……算了，我突然想把话骂得难听些，就不耽误你了。多谢，佣兵，再会。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头离去。 | 将额外的克朗装好，你告诉领队今日的答案：%employer%。那人听见便笑了，连连点头，仿佛早已料到。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，做得好。不过，今天可真有意思，对吧？一开始，你来这儿是要一剑捅穿我，几分钟后，咱们却能这么和气地道别。你真是个做生意的料。可惜，把这本事用在剑后头，没用在笔杆子上。再会，一路顺风。%SPEECH_OFF% | {既然收了一盎司，不妨再收一磅。 | 既然迈出一寸，不妨再走一里。}你接受条件，将%employer%的盘算和盘托出。商队领队郑重点头。%SPEECH_ON%你知道，我们做生意的，不像你们那样挥刀弄剑。不过相信我，一样凶险无情。一路顺风，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%}

ed402dba254e66f69cab.source: Payment without having to kill anyone. I can get used to that.
ed402dba254e66f69cab.translation: 不用杀人也能挣钱。这样的活可以多来点。

f1ebcc34b0abe7496588.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{You tell the man to bugger off. He's already gotten lucky enough. The man nods, agreeing, though his narrowed face tells you all you need to know about your rejection. | You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%I'll be letting you go, but I can't take it that far. I still need the employment %employer% offers, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%A smart decision, though a poor one for me, obviously. But yes, I understand you, sellsword. May the old gods be with you in your travels. Shall we meet again, I hope it is under better terms!%SPEECH_OFF% | Betraying %employer% probably isn't the best of ideas and you tell the man as much. He nods, understanding.%SPEECH_ON%Well, alright then. I can't blame you for keeping those cards in your hand, but damned if I wish you'd have shown them all the same. Godspeed, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%}
f1ebcc34b0abe7496588.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]{你叫那人赶紧滚。他能捡回一条命，已经够走运了。那人点头应下，不过从他绷紧的脸色就看得出，他对你的拒绝作何感想。 | 你摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我可以放你走，但也只能做到这一步。我还得靠%employer%的雇佣吃饭，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%那人点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%明智的决定，当然，对我来说可不是什么好事。不过我明白你的意思，佣兵。愿旧神保佑你一路平安。要是还能再见，希望到时咱们的境遇能好些！%SPEECH_OFF% | 背叛%employer%恐怕不是什么好主意，你把这话明白告诉了那人。他会意地点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，好吧。你不愿亮出底牌，我也怪不得你，可我他妈的还是盼着你肯这么做。一路顺风，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f8e68c3711257b787b95.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{While preparing to assault the caravan, %randombrother% comes to your side and points to one of the men in the wagontrain.%SPEECH_ON%Know who that is?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%That's %swordmaster%.%SPEECH_OFF%Slimming your eyes to get a clearer picture, all you see is an ordinary looking man. The mercenary explains that he's a renowned swordmaster who has killed untold numbers of men. He thumbs his nose and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Still want to attack?%SPEECH_OFF% | You glass the caravan with some spectacles and spot a familiar face: %swordmaster%. A man you saw compete in a jousting tournament in %randomtown% a few years back. If you recall correctly, he won with an arm tied behind his back. Anyone who met him off the horses was quickly slain as he displayed expert swordsmanship. This fellow is a dangerous one and should be approached carefully. | Scouting the wagontrain, you see a face that gives you've seen before. %randombrother% joins you, picking his fingernails with a knife.%SPEECH_ON%That's %swordmaster%, the swordmaster. He's killed twenty men this year.%SPEECH_OFF%A voice barks from behind you.%SPEECH_ON%I heard fifty! Sixty maybe. Forty-five if we're being realistic...%SPEECH_OFF%Hmm, it appears there is a most dangerous opponent in that caravan's guard...}
f8e68c3711257b787b95.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{准备突袭商队时，%randombrother%来到身旁，指着车队中一人。%SPEECH_ON%知道那是谁吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头。%SPEECH_ON%是%swordmaster%。%SPEECH_OFF%你眯眼看得更仔细，却只见一个相貌普通的男人。佣兵解释，那是位著名的剑术大师，死在他手里的人不计其数。他用拇指抹过鼻子，啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%还要打吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你透过镜片观察商队，发现一张熟悉的脸：%swordmaster%。几年前，你曾在%randomtown%的一场骑士比武中见他参赛。若没记错，他一条胳膊绑在身后，还赢了。凡是落马后与他交锋的人，都迅速死于那出神入化的剑术。这家伙很危险，得小心对付。 | 侦察车队时，你看见一张似曾相识的脸。%randombrother%走来，用小刀剔着指甲。%SPEECH_ON%那是剑术大师%swordmaster%。今年已经杀了二十个人。%SPEECH_OFF%身后有人嚷道。%SPEECH_ON%我听说是五十！也许六十。说实在点，就算四十五……%SPEECH_OFF%嗯，看来商队护卫里，确实有个极危险的对手……}

c87f8568731595b277d7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]{Ordering the assault, your men launch across the grass. The caravan guards are already running your way, but they look scared. Behind them follow a throng of garish looking creatures. It's safe to say this is going to be the strangest of meetings... | As the %companyname% sprints toward the caravan, weapons drawn, a few men slow down to point out that there's an even larger party approaching the wagon train from the other side. Pausing to get a good eye at it, you realize that there is a horde of undead converging on this very spot! | Well, it looks like this won't be as easy as you'd thought: as your men begin the attack on the caravan, %randombrother% spots a horde of ghastly undead approaching from the other side! Undead or soon-to-be-dead, it doesn't matter. You're here to do what %employer% paid you to do.}
c87f8568731595b277d7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]{你下令进攻，弟兄们越过草地冲出。商队护卫也已经朝你们跑来，可神情惊恐。后方，跟着一大群模样骇人的生物。可以肯定，这会是一场极其古怪的会面…… | %companyname%亮出武器，冲向商队，几个弟兄却放慢脚步，指出车队另一侧还有一支更大的队伍靠近。你停下仔细看，才发现一整群亡灵正朝此处汇聚！ | 好吧，看来没你想的那么轻松。弟兄们开始进攻商队时，%randombrother%发现另一侧正逼近一大群可怕的亡灵！已经死的，还是马上要死的，都无所谓。你来这里，是为了完成%employer%付钱交办的事。}

d848bab0f6c151f9f1d6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{As your men clean the field of any wounded, %randombrother% comes to you with a line of women and children being toted behind him. You raise your sword and ask what is this.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like they brought their families with them. What do you want us to do?%SPEECH_OFF%If you let them go, there's a good chance they'll spread word of your being here. If you kill them, well, that's got a cost that'll weigh heavy on any mind... | Having won the battle, your men spread out to collect the goods and make sure every caravan guard is good and dead. Unfortunately, not everyone you come across is dead - and not all of them grown men. A throng of women and children emerge from the ruins of the fight, slowly approaching with all the frailty of a wounded dog. Some are covered in blood, others have been shielded from the combat. %randombrother% asks what should be done with them.%SPEECH_ON%We should probably let them go because, well, look at them. But... they might tell someone. You know women and their big mouths.%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenary laughs nervously. One of the women clutches her bosom.%SPEECH_ON%We shan't tell a soul, we swear!%SPEECH_OFF% | The fighting over, you stumble across a party of women and children in the ruins of the caravan. They saunter over, seeming to understand that if they just took off running you'd have reason to chase. One of the women, clutching a babe close to her chest, pleads.%SPEECH_ON%Please, you've already done so much hurt and pain. Our fathers, husbands, brothers, you already killed them all. Is that not enough? Let us go.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% spits.%SPEECH_ON%Them children seen what we did. They gonna grow up remembering it, too. And those women, well, they'll be telling everybody. That's what they do.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks toward you, gesturing toward a half-cocked blade.%SPEECH_ON%What do you want us to do, sir?%SPEECH_OFF%}
d848bab0f6c151f9f1d6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{弟兄们正清理战场上的伤者，%randombrother%带着一列妇女和孩子来到你面前。你提起剑，问这是怎么回事。%SPEECH_ON%看来他们把家眷也带上了。您想怎么处理？%SPEECH_OFF%放他们走，他们多半会把你们来过这里的消息传出去。杀了他们，唉，那份代价会沉沉压在任何人的心头…… | 战斗获胜后，弟兄们分头收拢货物，并确保每个商队护卫都已死透。可惜，你们遇到的并非全是死人，也并非全是成年男人。一群妇女和孩子从战场废墟中走出，像受伤的狗一样脆弱，缓缓靠近。有的满身鲜血，有的则一直被护在战斗之外。%randombrother%问该怎么处置。%SPEECH_ON%大概该放他们走吧，毕竟，您看看他们。可是……他们可能会告密。您也知道，女人的嘴有多碎。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵紧张地笑了笑。一个女人捂住胸口。%SPEECH_ON%我们谁也不说，我们发誓！%SPEECH_OFF% | 战斗结束，你在商队残骸中撞见一群妇女和孩子。他们慢慢走来，似乎明白，一旦转身逃跑，你就有了追赶的理由。一个紧抱婴儿的女人哀求道。%SPEECH_ON%求求你，你们造成的伤痛已经够多了。我们的父亲、丈夫、兄弟，你们全都杀了。难道还不够吗？放我们走吧。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%这些孩子看见我们干了什么。他们长大了也会记着。至于那些女人，她们会到处说的。她们就爱干这个。%SPEECH_OFF%他望向你，朝半举的刀刃示意。%SPEECH_ON%团长，您想让我们怎么做？%SPEECH_OFF%}

650b3f725422a0cdab70.source: We're paid to leave no one alive, so that's what we'll do.
650b3f725422a0cdab70.translation: 雇主要我们不留活口，我们就照办。

99325223751ade258036.source: To hell with it - let them leave.

bc90709decfde40b2909.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{You nod to %randombrother%. He steps forward, weapon in hand, and with a quick slash removes a woman's head. A geyser of crimson fountains forth and her children are too blinded by the blood to see the rest of the blades coming.  The screams gradually die down as your brothers hack their way through the horrified crowd, dwindling their numbers into scattered whimpers. Your men double check their work until the victims are mute and the silence is dripping. | With a quick flick of your hand, you give the order. %randombrother% doesn't take but a moment to drive a blade through a kid's face, pegging the child against its mother's womb before slicing upward to claim her life as well. The rest of the men fan out, some reluctant while others yet go about with reverent diligence.

 As the horrific shrieks fill the air, you get the sense that some mercenaries are hacking and slashing simply to drive the noise out of their heads. The violence consumes all, an orgy of madness you know not whether to claim the pinnacle or nadir of man's doings for all meaning is lost in the event and the words to describe it have yet to be found in your tongue or any that is ancestral or beyond the dimly lit reckoning of what your eye can see. It is simply a happening. | Unfortunately, none can be allowed to live. You bark out an order and the mercenaries jump to the task. A woman approaches, seemingly having misheard you, and asks for directions to the nearest town. %randombrother% answers by stoving her head in with a stone. Frightened children fan out in a winding scatter that reminds you of your rabbit hunting days. Your quickest mercenaries give chase while the rest stay behind to make short work of the parents. It is a gruesome sight indeed.}
bc90709decfde40b2909.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{你向%randombrother%点了点头。他手持武器走上前，迅速一挥，斩下一名女人的头颅。鲜血喷涌，她的孩子被血糊住双眼，没能看见随之而来的刀锋。弟兄们在惊恐的人群里挥砍，尖叫渐渐低落，最后只剩零星的呜咽。他们再次检查，直到受害者全都无声无息，寂静中只剩滴血的声音。 | 你随手一挥，下达命令。%randombrother%片刻也没迟疑，一刀刺穿孩子的脸，将孩子钉在母亲腹前，又向上一挑，连母亲的性命也一并夺去。其他人分散开来，有的迟疑不决，有的却近乎虔诚地认真执行。

 凄厉的惨叫充斥四周，你隐约觉得，有些佣兵不停砍杀，只是想把那些声音赶出自己的脑海。暴力吞没一切。这场疯狂的盛宴，究竟是人类作为的顶峰，还是谷底，你无从判断。所有意义都在其中消失，无论你的语言，先祖的语言，还是目力与幽暗认知之外的语言，都找不到足以描述它的词。它就这样发生了。 | 遗憾的是，不能留下任何活口。你厉声下令，佣兵们立刻动手。一个女人走过来，似乎没听清你的命令，开口询问去最近镇子的路。%randombrother%用石头砸碎她的脑袋，作为回答。惊恐的孩子四散奔逃，弯弯绕绕的逃跑路线，让你想起了从前猎兔的日子。跑得最快的佣兵追了上去，其余人留下，迅速解决那些父母。景象确实惨不忍睹。}

8fb2e319dc2b701399fd.source: Well, it's not a pretty job, but that's what we're being paid for.
8fb2e319dc2b701399fd.translation: 活虽不光彩，可我们收的就是这份钱。

f2322e6d73fc6458ac1e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{As the caravan burns, your men pick through the remains. %randombrother% comes to you with some papers in hand.%SPEECH_ON%These might be of some interest, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You unfurl one of them and take a read. It appears %employer% had a very, very ulterior motive for attacking this particular wagon train. It would be a shame if anyone were to find out these details... | The wagons still burning, you come to a wooden chest and kick it open. Scrolls pop out, unfurling and scattering in the wind. You catch one and give it a read. It's a report on the earnings - or lack thereof - of %employer%'s territory. It appears to have been intended to reveal the man's financial fragility. You could, if you wanted, use this against him... | You find a cache of papers in the ruins of the caravan. One of the scrolls reveals something about %employer% that, more than likely, he knew was traveling with the wagons. This must be the reason why he had you attack it... it could also be used against him. You doubt he expected it to fall into your hands. You're just a stupid sellsword, after all...}
f2322e6d73fc6458ac1e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{商队的货车熊熊燃烧，弟兄们在残骸间翻找着。%randombrother%拿着几份文书走到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%团长，您可能会对这些感兴趣。%SPEECH_OFF%你展开其中一份看了看。看来，%employer%特意袭击这支商队，背后藏着很不寻常的动机。要是有人知道这些内情，那可就不妙了…… | 货车还在燃烧。你走到一只木箱前，一脚踹开箱盖。卷轴迸了出来，在风中展开，四处飞散。你抓住一卷读了读。上面记载着%employer%领地的收入——或者说，根本没什么收入。这份报告似乎是要揭露他的财政窘境。只要你愿意，就能拿它做文章…… | 你在商队的残骸里找出一批文书。其中一卷揭露了%employer%的某个秘密，而他多半知道这东西就在货车上。这想必就是他雇你袭击商队的原因……而你也可以反过来利用它。你猜，他绝没料到它会落进你手里。毕竟，你不过是个没脑子的佣兵嘛……}

43a0d8918bde8973c2bb.translation: 把他们和其他人一起烧掉。

41372454ddd10d351db8.source: We shall give them to our employer as a token of loyalty.
41372454ddd10d351db8.translation: 把这些交给雇主，以表忠心。

751123ae9475af84b268.source: Our employer will have to pay us extra to get these.
751123ae9475af84b268.translation: 雇主要拿到这些，得另加钱。

d88bb8dfa7884929699a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{You return to %employer% and hold the papers up. He almost instantly seems to recognize a seal on one of the scrolls.%SPEECH_ON%What... what are those?%SPEECH_OFF%Lowering the papers, and about to explain, the man takes a lunge, trying to snatch them from you. He falls short as you pull back. He straightens up, seeming to correct a loss of composure.%SPEECH_ON%Alright sellsword. I see where this is going. How much more do you want?%SPEECH_OFF%With the doors closed, the two of you hash out a deal. | %employer% welcomes your return, turning around with two mugs of wine in hand, but his smile quickly fades.%SPEECH_ON%What's that in your hand? Where did you get that?%SPEECH_OFF%You stuff one of the incriminating papers away and nod, answering.%SPEECH_ON%I think you know exactly where I got it. And I think you know exactly where this is going. Now... let's you and I talk business, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%The man drinks one of the mugs, then downs the other.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah. Alright. Close the door, would ya?%SPEECH_OFF% | You enter %employer%'s room and throw the incriminating papers on his desk. He looks at them and then laughs.%SPEECH_ON%What a mistake!%SPEECH_OFF%He crumbles the papers up and stuffs them under his table. You laugh in return and retrieve another set of scrolls.%SPEECH_ON%How stupid do you think I am?%SPEECH_OFF%The man quickly takes his stuffed notes back out and stares at them. He realizes you only put one page in there, the rest just blank spaces. Grinning, you lay out the ground rules.%SPEECH_ON%Now that I know how important these are to you, let us talk business so that ALL of them may return to you, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%The man takes a solemn seat and nods. He retrieves a personal satchel of crowns and sets it on his desk before gesturing toward the entryway.%SPEECH_ON%Please, close the door.%SPEECH_OFF% | When you return, %employer% immediately notices the seal on the papers you've brought. He has a few guards in his room, but quickly hurries them out, telling them to chase the rabbits from his gardens. He closes the door and turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%I see I've been found out.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The man licks his lips and nods in return.%SPEECH_ON%Alright then. Nothing on those papers can leave this room. How much do you want?%SPEECH_OFF%You lift a leg over the edge of his table and take a seat, putting the papers beside you and clasping your hands together. Grinning, you answer.%SPEECH_ON%Everything is worth what the purchaser is willing to pay for it, is it not, nobleman?%SPEECH_OFF%}
d88bb8dfa7884929699a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{你回去见%employer%，举起那些文书。他几乎立刻就认出了其中一卷的印记。%SPEECH_ON%那……那是什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你放低文书，正要解释，他突然扑来，想从你手里抢走。你往后一缩，让他扑了个空。他直起身，努力挽回失态后的体面。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，佣兵。我明白你的意思了。还想多要多少？%SPEECH_OFF%关起门来，你们两人谈定了价钱。 | %employer%欢迎你回来，转身时手里端着两杯酒，笑容却很快消失。%SPEECH_ON%你手里拿的是什么？从哪儿弄来的？%SPEECH_OFF%你把其中一份罪证文书收起来，点头答道。%SPEECH_ON%我想，你很清楚它从哪儿来，也很清楚接下来会怎样。现在……咱俩谈谈生意，如何？%SPEECH_OFF%他喝干一杯，又把另一杯一饮而尽。%SPEECH_ON%行，好吧。把门关上，行吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，把罪证文书扔在桌上。他看了看，随即笑起来。%SPEECH_ON%你犯了个大错！%SPEECH_OFF%他把纸揉成一团，塞到桌下。你也笑了，取出另一叠卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%你觉得我有多蠢？%SPEECH_OFF%他急忙掏出刚塞下去的纸，盯着看，才发现你只放了一页真东西，其余全是白纸。你咧嘴一笑，讲明规矩。%SPEECH_ON%现在我知道这些对你有多重要了。咱们谈谈生意，好让它们一份不落地回到你手里，如何？%SPEECH_OFF%他面色凝重地坐下，点了点头，取出自己的钱袋，放在桌上，又朝门口示意。%SPEECH_ON%请把门关上。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%立刻注意到你带来的文书上的印记。屋里有几名守卫，他急忙把他们遣出去，叫他们赶走花园里的兔子。他关上门，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%看来，事情败露了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。他舔了舔嘴唇，也点点头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧。这些纸上的内容，一个字都不能传出这个房间。你要多少钱？%SPEECH_OFF%你抬腿坐上桌沿，把文书放在身旁，双手交握，笑着回答。%SPEECH_ON%东西值多少钱，要看买家愿意出多少，不是吗，贵族大人？%SPEECH_OFF%}

b2cef5eeb2352b4962ad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{You return to %employer% and he turns to you, seemingly angry.%SPEECH_ON%You know folks are speaking about what you did, right?%SPEECH_OFF%Smiling, you hold up the incriminating papers.%SPEECH_ON%Would you rather they speak about this instead?%SPEECH_OFF%The man almost gasps before settling down into his chair.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, are you extorting me?%SPEECH_OFF%You put the papers on his table and shake your hand.%SPEECH_ON%I thought about it, but I'd rather not bite the hand that feeds just because it so happens to be holding something tasty this one time.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% waves you into his room.%SPEECH_ON%The peasantfolk are talking of ya. People in that caravan got away and between still drawing breath they saw fit to speak of what they experienced.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and agree.%SPEECH_ON%That is quite understandable.%SPEECH_OFF%The man growls and points a finger, but you point the incriminating papers back in his face. He seizes up in rather strained silence.%SPEECH_ON%I... I see... Are you wanting more money?%SPEECH_OFF%You toss him the papers.%SPEECH_ON%No. You forget one of my faults, and I forget one of yours. Fair enough, right?%SPEECH_OFF%The man hastily stuffs the papers into his coat and nods. | You find %employer% tending to his garden. A few guard stand a ways off, and you imagine one of the handful of peasants lingering is really just a guard in disguise.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! It is good to see you, except for one little thing.%SPEECH_OFF%He waves you close and lowers his voice.%SPEECH_ON%You let a few of those caravan folk get away. I don't remember that being part of the deal.%SPEECH_OFF%You hold up the incriminating papers.%SPEECH_ON%I don't remember this being part of the deal either.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% leers back, then composes himself so his guards don't get suspicious.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, I take those, and I forget about the whole letting people live who should be dead ordeal, alright?%SPEECH_OFF%You hand the papers over.}
b2cef5eeb2352b4962ad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{你回去见%employer%，他转过身，似乎很恼火。%SPEECH_ON%你知道人们都在议论你干的事吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你笑着举起那些足以定罪的文书。%SPEECH_ON%还是说，你更愿意让他们议论这个？%SPEECH_OFF%他险些倒抽一口气，随后沉进椅子。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，你是在敲诈我？%SPEECH_OFF%你把文书放在桌上，摆了摆手。%SPEECH_ON%想过。不过，不能因为喂我吃饭的手偶尔握着块肥肉，我就反过来咬它一口。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%招手让你进屋。%SPEECH_ON%那些平民正在议论你。商队里有人逃掉了，喘气之余，还觉得有必要把自己的遭遇讲出来。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头表示同意。%SPEECH_ON%可以理解。%SPEECH_OFF%他低吼着伸手指你，你却把那些罪证文书举到他面前。他顿时僵住，陷入吃力的沉默。%SPEECH_ON%我……我明白了……你想要更多钱？%SPEECH_OFF%你把文书扔给他。%SPEECH_ON%不用。你忘掉我的一个过失，我也忘掉你的一个。公平吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他匆忙把文书塞进外衣，点了点头。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正在打理花园。几名守卫站在不远处，附近逗留的几个农民里，你猜也至少有一个是乔装的守卫。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！很高兴见到你，不过有件小事。%SPEECH_OFF%他招手让你靠近，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%你放跑了几个商队的人。我可不记得约定里有这一条。%SPEECH_OFF%你举起那些罪证文书。%SPEECH_ON%我也不记得约定里有这个。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%恶狠狠地看你一眼，随即镇定下来，免得守卫起疑。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，东西交给我。至于你放走了那些本该灭口的人，这件事我就当没发生，行吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你交出了文书。}

df112e253e7c59d31403.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You return to %employer% with news of your success. He's got a warm greeting - a satchel heavy with crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Good job sellsword. Did you, uh, see anything else while down there?%SPEECH_OFF%It's an odd question, but you don't pursue it. You tell the man it went down just as the results show. He nods and quickly thanks you before returning to his work. | %employer%'s standing by a window when you return. He's drinking a goblet of wine, swishing it around in both cup and mouth.%SPEECH_ON%My little birds tell me the caravan was destroyed. The songs they sing, are they true?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell him of the news. He hands over a chest of crowns, thanking you for your service before returning to the window. You catch a wry grin on the side of his face just before you leave. | %employer%'s petting a dog as you return. His hand his shaking through the fur.%SPEECH_ON%I take it the wagon train is destroyed?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him the details. He nods, but his petting hand comes to a rest.%SPEECH_ON%Did you by any chance... find something interesting?%SPEECH_OFF%You think it over, but can't come up with anything out of the ordinary. The man grins and returns to petting his dog.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you for services, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s writing when you enter his room. He drops the quill pen in a hurry and stands up.%SPEECH_ON%So it's destroyed then? The caravan, I mean.%SPEECH_OFF%You report the results of your 'services.' He laughs and claps his hands together.%SPEECH_ON%Excellent! Most excellent, sellsword! You've no idea what your work has done for me today. Of course, your payment, as promised...%SPEECH_OFF%He hands over a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns. It's all there, but you have to wonder why the man was so giddy about something so seemingly ordinary... did you miss something? | %employer%'s talking to his council when you return. He shoos them out. It is a strange sight - seeing these powerful figures making way for a motley sellsword. You stand a little taller as you report the news of the caravan's destruction.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, mercenary. This is the sort of news I've been waiting for. And your payment, of course...%SPEECH_OFF%He heaves a wooden chest onto his desk and pushes it across. Its heavy enough to leave a mark.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns, as we agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF%You're curious as to why the nobleman would excuse his council to take in a sellsword, but decide not to dwell on it.}
df112e253e7c59d31403.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你回来向%employer%报告成功，他热情地欢迎了你——方式是一袋沉甸甸的克朗。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，佣兵。你在那边，呃，有没有看见别的什么？%SPEECH_OFF%这问题有些古怪，不过你没追问，只说事情经过与眼前的结果一样，没有别的。他点头，匆匆道谢，便继续忙自己的事。 | 你回来时，%employer%正站在窗边喝酒，杯中摇一摇，入口又品一品。%SPEECH_ON%我的小鸟告诉我，商队已经毁了。它们唱的歌，是真的吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，向他报告。他递给你一箱克朗，感谢你的效劳，随后又转回窗前。离开前，你瞥见他侧脸上露出一抹狡黠的笑。 | 你回来时，%employer%正在摸狗，手在狗毛间微微发颤。%SPEECH_ON%看来，车队已经毁掉了？%SPEECH_OFF%你把经过告诉他。他点头，抚摸狗的手却停住了。%SPEECH_ON%你有没有碰巧……发现什么有意思的东西？%SPEECH_OFF%你想了想，没记起任何异常。他咧嘴一笑，又继续摸起狗来。%SPEECH_ON%感谢你的效劳，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进屋时，%employer%正在写字。他急忙放下羽毛笔，站起身。%SPEECH_ON%那么，毁掉了？我是说，商队。%SPEECH_OFF%你报告了这次“效劳”的成果。他笑着拍起手。%SPEECH_ON%太好了！实在太好了，佣兵！你根本不知道，今天这活帮了我多大的忙。当然，你的报酬，按约定……%SPEECH_OFF%他递来一袋%reward_completion%克朗。一枚不少，可你不禁好奇，这样一桩看似寻常的差事，为何让他如此兴奋……你漏掉了什么吗？ | 你回来时，%employer%正与议事会商谈。他挥手让他们退下。看着这些位高权重的人，为一个衣装杂乱的佣兵让路，实在是奇特的景象。你不由挺直了些，报告商队被毁的消息。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，佣兵。这正是我一直在等的好消息。当然，还有你的报酬……%SPEECH_OFF%他搬起一只木箱，放在桌上推过来。箱子沉得在桌面留下了痕迹。%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion%克朗，和约好的一样。%SPEECH_OFF%你好奇，这位贵族为何肯遣散议事会，来接待一个佣兵，不过还是决定不去深究。}

2570532cb45685ba19bf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You return to find %employer% sitting at his desk, tented hands before him, his thumbs practically plugged into his forehead. His hands fall forward when he begins to talk.%SPEECH_ON%You let... them live...%SPEECH_OFF%You raise a finger and make your case: not all of them lived.%SPEECH_ON%By the old gods' endless might, what on earth did I hire you for?%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses, then shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, I'll give you half of what we agreed to. You did destroy the wagon train, after all, I'll give you that.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes your return with his feet up on his desk, the bottom of his muddied shoes greeting you with a drip of slop.%SPEECH_ON%So, mercenary, explain to me what it was that I hired you for?%SPEECH_OFF%He throws a hand out as if to say, 'go ahead.' You state that you were hired to destroy a caravan and leave no survivors. The man shoots a finger up.%SPEECH_ON%Repeat that last part.%SPEECH_OFF%You do. The man grins, satisfied with himself, but then the smile sours to your failure.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, you didn't do what I asked. That's fine. You did do... some of it, I suppose. The caravan is destroyed...%SPEECH_OFF%He shrugs and throws you a satchel. It's half of what you were owed. You figure better that than nothing. | %employer%'s talking to his guards when you return. He fans them away, though one lingers just outside the hall, his eyes nearly poking around his head to check in on you from time to time. You drag out one of %employer%'s chairs, but he tells you to keep standing.%SPEECH_ON%This'll be brief. You didn't do all that I asked, sellsword. People are talking, talking about you. How are they talking about you if I asked that you kill all witnesses? A little curious, no? I suppose it's because you didn't kill all those witnesses, which means you didn't do what I asked.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses, rubbing two knuckles into his forehead.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, this is what I'll do. I'll give you half of what we agreed. Half to you for destroying the caravan, half to me because I gotta pay for the cover-up. Hope that suits you.%SPEECH_OFF%The guard leers in. You nod and take the payment. | %employer% waves you in. He's standing with a scribe who looks ready to spin a tale. Your employer crosses his arms.%SPEECH_ON%People are talking of what you did...%SPEECH_OFF%The man gestures toward the scribe who, surprisingly, doesn't begin writing.%SPEECH_ON%I've had to make some payments to keep lips sealed, understand? So that means you're only getting half of what we agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF%The elder scribe grins. You notice a ring on his finger. It looks newly minted. %employer%'s almost scowling, but the scribe isn't writing anything so you take that for a good sign. You take your pay and make your leave. | A group of grinning men are leaving %employer%'s room when you arrive. He asks you to shut the door behind you then immediately opens up.%SPEECH_ON%Recognize those faces? They were the men who found out what you did. Do you realize how many crowns it took for them to keep their lips sealed? Do you know where those crowns came from?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%Your pay, of course. You're only getting half. Do you understand why?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Business is business. As you turn to leave, %employer% catches you.%SPEECH_ON%And don't dare think about killing one of those men to get the other half of your pay back, sellsword!%SPEECH_OFF%Damn.}
2570532cb45685ba19bf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你回来时，%employer%正坐在桌前，双手交叠成尖，拇指几乎顶进额头。他开口时，双手向前落下。%SPEECH_ON%你竟然……让他们活了下来……%SPEECH_OFF%你竖起一根手指，为自己辩解：又不是全活了。%SPEECH_ON%旧神无尽的神力在上，我到底雇你来干什么？%SPEECH_OFF%他顿了顿，耸起肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，约好的报酬，我给你一半。毕竟商队确实毁掉了，这点我认。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%把双脚架在桌上，迎接你的是沾满污泥的鞋底，还滴下一团烂泥。%SPEECH_ON%那么，佣兵，给我解释一下，我当初雇你是为了什么？%SPEECH_OFF%他把手一伸，示意你“请讲”。你说，任务是毁掉一支商队，不留活口。他猛地竖起一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%把最后那句再说一遍。%SPEECH_OFF%你照做。他得意地咧嘴一笑，随即又为你的失手沉下脸。%SPEECH_ON%好，你没按我说的办。也罢。至少……一部分还是办到了。商队确实毁了……%SPEECH_OFF%他耸耸肩，抛来一个钱袋。里面只有应得报酬的一半。你觉得，总比一无所获强。 | 你回来时，%employer%正和守卫说话。他挥手遣退他们，不过有一人仍留在外面的走廊，不时把眼睛瞪得快凸出来，探头查看。你拉出%employer%的一张椅子，他却叫你站着。%SPEECH_ON%用不了多久。你没把我交代的事全办妥，佣兵。有人在说，说你的事。我明明叫你杀光所有目击者，他们怎么还能议论你？有点奇怪，是不是？我想，是因为你没杀光他们，也就是说，你没按我要求的办。%SPEECH_OFF%他停了停，用两个指节揉着额头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，就这么办。我给你约定报酬的一半。你毁了商队，拿一半；我还得花钱掩盖此事，留一半。希望你能接受。%SPEECH_OFF%守卫从门口投来凶狠的目光。你点头，接过报酬。 | %employer%招手让你进去。他身旁站着一名书记员，看起来随时准备编个故事。雇主抱起双臂。%SPEECH_ON%人们正在议论你干的事……%SPEECH_OFF%他朝书记员示意，对方却出乎意料地没有动笔。%SPEECH_ON%为了让某些人闭嘴，我得花些钱，明白吗？所以，约好的报酬，你只能拿一半。%SPEECH_OFF%年迈的书记员咧嘴一笑。你注意到他指上的戒指，看起来是新打的。%employer%几乎要皱眉发怒，可书记员始终没有写字，你便把这当作好兆头，拿钱离开。 | 你到来时，一群满脸笑容的男人正走出%employer%的房间。他叫你随手关门，随即直说。%SPEECH_ON%认得那些脸吗？就是他们查出了你干的事。你知道让他们闭嘴，花了多少克朗吗？知道那些克朗从哪儿来吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。他接着说。%SPEECH_ON%当然是你的报酬。你只能拿一半。明白为什么了？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。生意就是生意。你转身要走，%employer%又叫住你。%SPEECH_ON%还有，别妄想杀了其中哪个，把另一半报酬拿回来，佣兵！%SPEECH_OFF%该死。}

He asks you to shut the door behind you, but not before a guard steps in. He and %employer% exchange a nod and a glance, and you then shut the door. Your employer speaks frankly.%SPEECH_ON%Recognize those people who just walked out of here? They were the men who found out what you did. Do you realize how many crowns it took for them to keep their lips sealed? Do you know where those crowns came from?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%Your pay, of course. To keep all their traps shut I had to pay a pretty penny indeed.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Business is business and, in this case, you'll be getting none. As you turn to leave, %employer% catches you.%SPEECH_ON%And don't dare think about killing one of those men to get your pay back, sellsword!%SPEECH_OFF%Damn.}
3ff19ba5d43657937874.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你回来时，%employer%正坐在桌前，双肘撑着桌沿，前臂竖起，拇指几乎顶进额头。他开口时，双手向前落下。%SPEECH_ON%你竟然……让他们活了下来……%SPEECH_OFF%你竖起一根手指，为自己辩解：又不是全活了。%SPEECH_ON%旧神无尽的神力在上，我到底雇你来干什么？%SPEECH_OFF%他顿了顿，随即勃然大怒。%SPEECH_ON%我他妈在乎这个吗？你留下的活口，已经够让这个被神遗弃的村子传个遍了。趁我还没叫守卫收拾你，滚出我的视线。%SPEECH_OFF% | 迎接你回来的是%employer%的鞋底，他把双腿架在桌上。你注意到，靴子上有血。%SPEECH_ON%那么，佣兵，给我解释一下，我当初雇你是为了什么？%SPEECH_OFF%他把手一伸，示意你“请讲”。你说，任务是毁掉一支商队，不留活口。他猛地竖起一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%把最后那句再说一遍。%SPEECH_OFF%你照做。他得意地咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%好，你没按我说的办。那你还来做什么？要我叫守卫，还是你自己识趣点走？你我已经没生意可谈了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%正和守卫说话。他挥退几人，单独命令其中最壮的留下。你进门时，他目光森冷地打量着你。

你拉出%employer%的一张椅子，他却叫你站着。%SPEECH_ON%用不了多久。你没把我交代的事全办妥，佣兵。有人在说，说你的事。我明明叫你杀光所有目击者，他们怎么还能议论你？有点奇怪，是不是？我记得，死掉的目击者可不会说话，所以看来，这些目击者还活得好好的。真是奇怪，因为我付钱要的可不是这个。趁我还没叫身旁这位守卫拔剑，把你捅个对穿，你为什么不转过身，滚出我的视线？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你到来时，一群满脸笑容的男人正走出%employer%的房间。他叫你随手关门，不过在那之前，一名守卫先走了进来。守卫与%employer%交换了一个眼神，各自点头，你随后关上门。雇主开门见山。%SPEECH_ON%认得刚出去那些人吗？就是他们查出了你干的事。你知道让他们闭嘴，花了多少克朗吗？知道那些克朗从哪儿来吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。他接着说。%SPEECH_ON%当然是你的报酬。为了堵住他们所有人的嘴，我可是花了不少钱。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。生意就是生意，而这一次，你什么也拿不到。你转身要走，%employer%又叫住你。%SPEECH_ON%还有，别妄想杀了其中哪个，把报酬拿回来，佣兵！%SPEECH_OFF%该死。}

afc6ed2fa1278a789996.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]{Awaiting the caravan, a pair of travelers come up from where the convoy should be going. They remark in detail about a cart which is no doubt the one which you were supposed to be hunting down. No point in returning to %employer%. | Word on the road hints that the caravan you were supposed to be hunting down has given you the slip and reached its destination. The company shouldn't bother reaching %employer%.}
afc6ed2fa1278a789996.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]{等待商队时，两个旅人从车队本该前往的方向走来。他们详细说起一辆货车，毫无疑问，正是你们该追截的目标。没必要再去找%employer%了。 | 路上的消息表明，你该追截的商队已从眼皮底下溜走，平安抵达目的地。战团不用再去见%employer%了。}

c267e1650719bbcbb062.translation: 取得了足以揭人短处的文书

35ff9b6cd4ed6d8ea734.source: Failed to destroy a caravan without letting anyone escape
35ff9b6cd4ed6d8ea734.translation: 未能全歼商队，有人逃脱

0597efe655aa62ec5e9b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{%employer% throws back his silken sleeves and cracks his knuckles.%SPEECH_ON%I hope I can entrust you with a most delicate matter as my family cannot be connected to what I am about to tell you.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod as though a sellsword is often asked to keep a secret. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%The town of %settlementname% is too weak to protect itself and the people are clamoring for protection from brigands. We, the house of %noblehousename%, are the only ones who can truly offer the safety they seek. Unfortunately, the local council is too blind to see this. They are convinced they can guard their people themselves. Let us prove them wrong.

 I want you to burn the %location% close to %settlementname% to the ground and kill the peasantry there. Make it look like brigands did it. I'm sure you are familiar with their work. Now...%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% leans in close.%SPEECH_ON%...let me be very clear and I need you to listen very closely. There must be no survivors that could tell who really attacked them. None! Understand? Good. Return to me once the deed is done.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% stares at a pile of scrolls before angrily swiping them off his table in a flurry of papery madness.%SPEECH_ON%The councilmen of %settlementname% think they can protect their little town from brigands, but I know they can't. I know they need my protection! And I offered it at such a reasonable price...%SPEECH_OFF%He calms down just long enough to glance at you.%SPEECH_ON%I got it. I know what to do. You... you're familiar with a brigand's doings, yes? Of course. So how about you... go to %location% outside of %settlementname% and... do what a brigand what do. Of course, make it actually look like a brigands doing... after that, surely the town will contract me to protect them! And then they will be safe!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% has his hands tented, the tips of them pressed against his forehead. He lets out a long sigh.%SPEECH_ON%I've tried to deal with these people of %settlementname% for quite some years now, but I'm beginning to think I'll have to take drastic measures to get what I want. The council there won't pay me to protect their village because they think they can do it themselves. They say that they've been safe from harm for quite some time now. So what if... they weren't? What if you were to go in there, dressed as a brigand of course, and teach them that without the aid of %noblehousename% nobody is safe! Of course, you mustn't tell anyone of our little talk here... What say you, mercenary?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s staring out the window as you settle into a seat.%SPEECH_ON%Stand up, sellsword. I don't like to whisper down, it gets me to raise my voice and with what I'm about to tell you I don't think I want to be doing that.%SPEECH_OFF%You stand up and lend your ear.%SPEECH_ON%%settlementname% has refused my offer of protection. They've decided to go it alone. Not only are they not paying %noblehousename%, but they're besmirching our name. If this village refuses our protection, what will others do? I need you to take the 'part' of a brigand, go there, and teach them what it is to go in this world without %noblehousename% by your side! Of course, discretion is of the utmost importance. Nothing I've said here must leave this room.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s rubbing an apple raw, peeling back the rind with the grit of his thumb.%SPEECH_ON%My father used to tell me, if you don't have a name that raises respect just by its sound, then you have no name at all. Unfortunately, %settlementname% does not respect the name of %noblehousename%. They've refused my offers of protection and have insulted my family. I want you to pay them back for this. I want you to go there, not as mercenaries but as brigands, and show them what happens in a world without %noblehousename%'s protection. Of course, you must be thorough, sellsword. You mustn't tell anyone of what we say in this here room.%SPEECH_OFF%}
0597efe655aa62ec5e9b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{%employer%甩开丝绸衣袖，把指节掰得咔咔作响。%SPEECH_ON%我希望能把一件极为敏感的事托付给你，因为接下来我要说的，绝不能与我的家族扯上关系。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，一副佣兵常被要求保密的模样。他继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%%settlementname%太弱小，根本无力自保，民众正嚷着要有人保护他们免遭强盗侵害。我们%noblehousename%家族，才是唯一真正能给他们安全的人。可惜，当地议事会有眼无珠，坚信自己能保护民众。就让我们证明，他们错了。

 我要你把%settlementname%附近的%location%烧成平地，杀掉那里的农民。让这事看起来像强盗干的。我相信，你很熟悉他们的手法。现在……%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%凑近你。%SPEECH_ON%……我把话说清楚，你也给我仔细听好。不能留下任何能说出真正袭击者是谁的活口。一个也不能！明白吗？很好。事成之后，回来见我。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%盯着一堆卷轴，忽然愤怒地一挥，把它们扫下桌，纸页狂乱飞散。%SPEECH_ON%%settlementname%的议事官以为，自己能保护那个小镇不受强盗侵害，可我知道他们不行。我知道，他们需要我的保护！而且我开的价已经那么公道……%SPEECH_OFF%他稍稍冷静，抬眼看向你。%SPEECH_ON%有了，我知道该怎么办。你……很熟悉强盗干的事，对吧？当然。所以，不如你……去%settlementname%外的%location%，然后……干点强盗会干的事。当然，要做得真像强盗干的……这样一来，镇上肯定会花钱请我保护他们！他们也就安全了！%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%双手交叠成尖，指尖抵着额头，长长叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%这些年来，我一直想和%settlementname%的人谈妥，可如今看来，想得到我要的东西，恐怕得用点狠手段了。那里的议事会不肯付钱请我保护村子，觉得自己就行。他们说，好长时间都没遭过灾了。那么，要是……不再太平了呢？要是你进去，当然，打扮成强盗，给他们上一课：没有%noblehousename%的帮助，谁也别想安全！当然，我们今天这番话，你一个字也不能告诉别人……怎么说，佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你坐下时，%employer%正望着窗外。%SPEECH_ON%站起来，佣兵。我不喜欢朝下凑着耳语，那会让我不自觉提高声音。而接下来要说的事，我可不想大声讲。%SPEECH_OFF%你站起来，侧耳倾听。%SPEECH_ON%%settlementname%拒绝了我的保护，决定独自撑下去。他们不但不肯付钱给%noblehousename%，还在败坏我们的名声。这个村子拒绝保护，其他地方会怎么想？我要你“扮演”一个强盗，去那里，让他们明白，这世道里没有%noblehousename%撑腰，是什么滋味！当然，保密最为要紧。我在这里说的话，绝不能传出这个房间。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%使劲摩擦一个苹果，用粗糙的拇指一点点蹭开果皮。%SPEECH_ON%我父亲常说，名字若不能让人一听便肃然起敬，就等于没有名字。可惜，%settlementname%并不尊重%noblehousename%的名声。他们拒绝我的保护，还侮辱了我的家族。我要你让他们付出代价。去那里，以强盗的身份，别以佣兵的身份，让他们见识一下，没有%noblehousename%保护的世界是什么样。当然，你得办得彻底，佣兵。我们在这间屋里说的话，不能告诉任何人。%SPEECH_OFF%}

6c67725da6d139374969.source: {Let's talk money. | How many crowns are we talking about? | What will the pay be? | For the right price, everything can be done.}
6c67725da6d139374969.translation: {谈谈报酬吧。 | 你打算出多少克朗？ | 报酬有多少？ | 只要价钱合适，什么都能办。}

e335ccc4f05f3595937f.source: {That's not our line of work. | That's not for the %companyname%.}
e335ccc4f05f3595937f.translation: {这不在我们的营生之内。 | 这不适合%companyname%。}

b7656897936423af8eb9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]{You reach the %location%. Peasants are out and about just as you figured. This will be like spearing fish in a barrel. Now the only question is: how do you want to approach? | %location% is a little more serene than you thought it'd be. A few peasants mosey about, chucking sickles and hoes around as they banter about this or that. You hear them barking with laughter over a joke. What a shame the rest of their day won't be nearly as funny. | You pass through some tall weeds to get a good look at %location%. There are a few peasants walking about, completely oblivious to the cat-like destruction stalking through the grass just outside their little hamlet. Scanning the area, you begin to plot your next move. | %location% is quiet, a little too quiet for a place targeted for destruction. You shake your head at the cruelty of this world, but then remind yourself that this is a job you're going to be getting well paid for. That makes it a little easier. | Killing peasants was never really your forte. Not that you couldn't do it, but the simplicity of it always rubbed you the wrong way. Like killing a legless dog, or stepping on a blind frog. But nobody ever paid you much to put a mutt to sleep. How ironic that these peasants would have been safer as mongrels than humans.}
b7656897936423af8eb9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]{你抵达%location%。如你所料，农民们正在外面走动。收拾他们，就跟往桶里叉鱼一样容易。现在只剩一个问题：你打算怎么动手？ | %location%比你想象中还要安宁。几名农民四处闲逛，一边把镰刀和锄头扔来扔去，一边东拉西扯。你听见他们为一个笑话放声大笑。可惜，今天剩下的时光可就没这么好笑了。 | 你穿过一片高草，仔细打量%location%。几个农民正在走动，全然不知毁灭已像一头猫似的，潜行在他们小村外的草丛中。你扫视四周，开始盘算下一步。 | %location%很安静。对一个即将遭到毁灭的地方来说，实在安静得过了头。你为这世道的残酷摇了摇头，随即提醒自己，这是一桩报酬丰厚的差事。这样想着，心里便好受了些。 | 杀农民从来不是你喜欢的活。倒不是下不了手，只是这事太容易，容易得让人不舒服。就像杀一条没腿的狗，或是踩死一只瞎眼青蛙。可也从没人肯花大价钱雇你弄死一条杂种狗。多讽刺啊，这些农民若是生而为狗，反倒比做人更安全。}

2b6e8ace750238b7faa1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{You reach %location% and immediately tell your men to hold and get down. Peasants are afoot, but so are militia. This was not part of the deal and you must reassess the situation accordingly. | As you near %location%, %randombrother% returns to you with a scouting report. Apparently, there are not just peasants there. A few militiamen are in the area. If you are to do this, you'll have to fight them, too. What now? | Militia! They were not part of the plan at all! If you are to proceed, you'll have to take care of them along with the peasants. Time to think carefully about this... | What is this? You see militiamen marching around %location%. Now you'll have to do some real fighting if you want to complete your task. | As you ready to attack %location%, %randombrother% points out something in the distance.
