Slimming your eyes, you bring into focus a handful of what look like militiamen. This was not part of the agreement! You can still go through with the attack, but there will be some resistance...}
2b6e8ace750238b7faa1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{抵达%location%后，你立刻命令弟兄们停下，伏低身子。那里不光有农民，还有民兵。这可不在约定之内，你得重新掂量眼下的局面。 | 临近%location%时，%randombrother%回来向你报告侦察结果。那里显然不只有农民，附近还有几名民兵。要继续干这桩活，就得连他们一起对付。现在怎么办？ | 民兵！计划里可从来没提过他们！要继续行动，就得把他们和农民一并解决。是时候好好想想了…… | 怎么回事？你看见民兵在%location%四周巡行。现在，想完成任务就得真刀真枪地打上一场了。 | 正准备进攻%location%，%randombrother%忽然指向远处。你眯起眼睛，终于看清那几个人似乎是民兵。这可不在约定之内！进攻仍然可以继续，但你们会遇到抵抗……}

e0eda2271693c6d8daee.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]{The slaughter was a success. You take torches to the place and leave it in smoldering ruin. | A copper smell lingers in the air as you step over and around the bodies of peasants. You nod at your handiwork then look to %randombrother% and give the order.%SPEECH_ON%Burn it all.%SPEECH_OFF% | They put up a little more of a fight than expected, but ultimately you slayed them all. Or, at least, you hope you did. Not wanting to go half-assed on this, you proceed to set fire to every building in sight. | You've brought ruin to the %location%. Its inhabitants are slain, and its buildings set ablaze. A good day's work by any sellsword's summation. | The dead are everywhere and the fresh, sweet smell of their passing is already turning sour. Not one to linger in a stench, you quickly set the %location% ablaze and depart. | ...and so the 'resistance' is put down. A few bodies here, a few there. You hope you got them all. All that's left to do is burn everything to ashes and make your leave. | Well, this is what you came here for. You have a few men display the dead bodies in a manner that you find 'informative', and then have a few other sellswords take torches to every building in sight.}
e0eda2271693c6d8daee.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]{屠杀顺利完成。你举起火把，最终留下一片冒着余烟的废墟。 | 你从农民的尸体间穿过，空气里弥漫着铜锈般的血腥味。你朝自己的杰作点了点头，转向%randombrother%，下达命令。%SPEECH_ON%全烧了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 他们的抵抗比预料中顽强了一些，不过你们终究还是把他们杀光了。至少，你希望如此。既然动了手，就得做得彻底，你随即点燃了眼前的每一栋房屋。 | 你毁掉了%location%。居民惨遭杀戮，房屋付之一炬。按佣兵的标准，这一天干得相当不错。 | 尸体遍地都是，死亡刚刚留下的腥甜气味已经开始发臭。你不想在这股恶臭里久留，便匆匆点燃%location%，转身离去。 | ……就这样，所谓的“抵抗”被平息了。这里几具尸体，那里几具尸体。你希望没有漏网之鱼。接下来，只需把一切烧成灰烬，便可离开。 | 好吧，这就是你们此行的目的。你让几名弟兄把尸体摆成你认为足以“传达意思”的模样，再叫另外几名佣兵拿起火把，点燃眼前所有房屋。}

e17d16730651a867071e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{You get to the %location% only to be greeted by a heavily armed group of men. One of them steps forward, his thumbs hooked into a belt holding up a sword.%SPEECH_ON%Well, well, you really are stupid. %employer% does not forget easily - and he hasn't forgotten the last time you betrayed %faction%. Consider this a little... return of the favor.%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly, all the men behind the lieutenant charge forward. Arm yourselves, this was an ambush! | You walk into the %location%, but the villagers seem prepared: you see windows shuttering and doors clapping closed. Just as you are about to order the company to start the slaughter, a group of men walk out from behind a building.

They are... considerably more armed than a group of laymen. In fact, they're carrying %employer%'s banner. The realization that you've been set up dawns on you just as the men begin to charge and you quickly bark out an order for the men to arm themselves. | A man greets you on the road just outside the %location%. He's well armed, well armored, and apparently quite happy, grinning sheepishly as you approach.%SPEECH_ON%Evening, mercenaries. %employer% sends his regards.%SPEECH_OFF%Just then, a group of men swarm out from the sides of the road. It's an ambush! That damned nobleman has betrayed you! | You step foot in the %location%, but all there is to greet you is a gust of lonely wind groaning between old woodworks. Thinking you've been had, you draw out your sword.%SPEECH_ON%Good thinking.%SPEECH_OFF%The voice comes from a building, out stepping a man with his own hand unsheathing a blade. A retinue of armed men wearing the colors of %faction% follow behind him in lockstep, their group fanning out to stare at your company.%SPEECH_ON%I'm going to enjoy prying that sword from your cold grip.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and ask why you've been setup.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% doesn't forget those who doublecross him or his house. That's about all you need to know. Not like anything I say here will do you good when you're dead.%SPEECH_OFF%To arms, then, for this is an ambush! | The %location% is empty. Your men scour the buildings and find not a soul. Suddenly, a few men crowd the road behind you, the lieutenant of the group walking forward with ill intent. He's got a cloth embroidered with %employer%'s sigil.%SPEECH_ON%Awfully quiet, isn't it? If you're wondering why I'm here, it is to pay a debt owed to %faction%. You promised a task well done. You could not own up to that promise. Now you die.%SPEECH_OFF%You unsheathe your sword and flash its blade at the lieutenant.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like %faction% is about to have another promise broken.%SPEECH_OFF%}
e17d16730651a867071e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{你抵达%location%，迎接你的却是一群全副武装的男人。其中一人走上前，双手拇指勾在挂着佩剑的腰带里。%SPEECH_ON%哎呀，你还真够蠢的。%employer%可没那么健忘——你上次背叛%faction%的事，他一直记着。就把这当作一点……回礼吧。%SPEECH_OFF%突然，副官身后的人全部向前冲来。拿起武器，这是埋伏！ | 你走进%location%，村民似乎早有准备：百叶窗纷纷合拢，房门砰砰关上。你正要命令战团开始屠杀，一群人却从一栋屋舍后走了出来。

他们的装备……可比普通平民好得多。事实上，他们还打着%employer%的旗。那些人开始冲锋时，你才恍然明白，自己中了圈套，连忙厉声命令弟兄们拿起武器。 | %location%外的路上，一个男人迎向你。他武器精良、铠甲齐整，看起来还相当高兴。你走近时，他露出一抹腼腆的笑。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，佣兵们。%employer%向你们问好。%SPEECH_OFF%就在这时，一群人从道路两侧蜂拥而出。是埋伏！那个该死的贵族背叛了你！ | 你踏入%location%，迎接你的却只有一阵孤寂的风，在老旧木屋间呜咽。你怀疑中了圈套，拔出剑。%SPEECH_ON%反应不错。%SPEECH_OFF%声音来自一栋屋舍，一个男人走了出来，手中也正拔剑出鞘。一队身穿%faction%纹色的武装随从紧步跟在他身后，随后散开，盯住战团。%SPEECH_ON%等你手指冰凉僵硬，我会很乐意把那把剑撬出来。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，问为什么要设局害你。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%不会忘记那些背叛他，或背叛他家族的人。你知道这些就够了。反正你死了，我说再多也没用。%SPEECH_OFF%那么，拿起武器吧，这是埋伏！ | %location%空无一人。弟兄们搜遍屋舍，连个人影都没找到。突然，几个人堵住身后的道路，为首的副官来意不善地走上前。他带着一块绣有%employer%纹章的布。%SPEECH_ON%安静得过头了，是不是？你要问我来干什么，就是替%faction%讨债。你答应把事办妥，却没兑现承诺。现在，你该死了。%SPEECH_OFF%你拔出剑，朝副官亮出锋刃。%SPEECH_ON%看来，%faction%又得见识一回承诺落空了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

33c711db8ad73a25fa91.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{You return to %employer% and tell him the news. He sits back and nods.%SPEECH_ON%All of them?%SPEECH_OFF%You look around.%SPEECH_ON%You heard anybody come by?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% smiles and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Only news of some terrible event, of course. Damned brigands.%SPEECH_OFF%He snaps his fingers and a man seemingly steps out of the darkness to pay you your reward. | %employer% welcomes your return, giving you a drink. He smiles warmly for a man who has just ordered the slaughter of peasants.%SPEECH_ON%I hear news on the wind that %location% has been brought to ruin.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Brigands, huh?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% grins. He hands you a satchel of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Brigands indeed.%SPEECH_OFF% | With %location% destroyed, you return to tell %employer% of the news. There's a few locals standing alongside him, so you turn the 'news' that 'brigands' have attacked the place. He nods, concerned, but with a slick sleight of hand slips you a satchel of crowns. He then turns to the locals and says something must be done about a brigand problem... | You tell %employer% of your successes. He smiles and then calls a crowd of commoners to him. He announces that 'brigands' have destroyed %location% and that he'll have to raise taxes to take care of this newfound problem. When he's finished talking, he turns and slides a satchel of crowns into your coat. | You enter %employer%'s abode. There's a woman by his side sobbing. When you look at him, he shakes his head. Nodding, you tell him of the 'news.'%SPEECH_ON%Uh... brigands... have destroyed %location%.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% nods solemnly.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, yes I know. The widow here has told me everything. Tragic news. Very tragic.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the man's employees hands you a satchel of crowns as you leave.}
33c711db8ad73a25fa91.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{你回去向%employer%报告。他靠回椅背，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%一个不剩？%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾四周。%SPEECH_ON%你听见有人来报信吗？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%笑着摇头。%SPEECH_ON%当然，只听说发生了一场惨剧。该死的强盗。%SPEECH_OFF%他打了个响指，一个人仿佛从阴影中走出，将报酬交给你。 | %employer%欢迎你回来，递上一杯酒。一个刚刚下令屠杀农民的人，居然也能笑得如此温和。%SPEECH_ON%我听到风声，说%location%已经毁了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%强盗干的，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%咧嘴一笑，递给你一袋克朗。%SPEECH_ON%没错，强盗。%SPEECH_OFF% | 毁掉%location%后，你回来向%employer%报告。他身旁站着几名当地人，于是你把这件事说成“强盗”袭击那里的“消息”。他忧心忡忡地点着头，却以娴熟的手法悄悄塞给你一袋克朗。随后，他转向当地人，声称必须想办法解决强盗之患…… | 你向%employer%报告任务完成。他微笑着，随后召来一群平民，宣布“强盗”毁掉了%location%，因此必须加税，以应对这个新冒出来的问题。讲完话，他转过身，把一袋克朗塞进你的外衣。 | 你走进%employer%的住处，他身旁有个女人正在抽泣。你望向他，他摇了摇头。你会意地点头，报告起那则“消息”。%SPEECH_ON%呃……强盗……毁了%location%。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%神情肃穆地点头。%SPEECH_ON%是的，是的，我知道。这位寡妇已经全告诉我了。惨痛的消息，实在惨痛。%SPEECH_OFF%离开时，他的一名雇员递给你一袋克朗。}

ea3e82b7259eee01c5fe.source: {Honest pay for honest work. | Crowns is crowns.}
ea3e82b7259eee01c5fe.translation: {干了活，拿了该拿的钱。 | 钱就是钱。}

b614cad3f092e0f359cd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{You enter %townname% to find a number of familiar peasants standing around %employer%. Fearing they'll recognize you, you stay out of sight. They cry out that brigands have destroyed %location%. %employer% looks concerned.%SPEECH_ON%Have they? Oh, that's awful! I will look into this. Fear not, people, I will protect you!%SPEECH_OFF%Just as the man finishes, one of his guards slips you a satchel of crowns. | You enter %employer%'s abode to find a number of bloodied peasants standing around his desk. You stay hidden as they finish their talk and leave. %employer% waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%Brigands. They said brigands did it. Perfect. Your payment is in the corner.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% greets your return with a smile.%SPEECH_ON%There were survivors.%SPEECH_OFF%He waves off your concern.%SPEECH_ON%They think brigands were responsible. A simple raid by vagabonds. You have nothing to worry about. Your payment...%SPEECH_OFF%He slides a satchel across his desk. You take it and nod.%SPEECH_ON%Good doing business with you.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% slaps a scroll down on his desk as you enter.%SPEECH_ON%You left some of them alive! But... it's alright. They think brigands were responsible.%SPEECH_OFF%You put a hand to your sword's hilt and glance at one of %employer%'s guards.%SPEECH_ON%I still expect to be paid in full.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% waves his hand to his desk where a satchel is.%SPEECH_ON%Of course. But next time I ask you to do something, I expect you to do it in full, understand?%SPEECH_OFF% | A throng of peasants have circled %employer%. You briefly wonder if they are about to lynch the man, but instead he sends them off. As he watches them turn a corner, he explains that they are survivors from %location%. Before you can say another word, the man waves off your concern.%SPEECH_ON%They still think brigands were responsible, but I'm not happy about this result. This could have gone very bad for us. For me, I mean.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and ask if you want these few survivors killed, just to be sure. %employer% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%No, no need for that. Here is your payment as promised, sellsword. Next time, though, do be sure to follow my orders.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b614cad3f092e0f359cd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{你走进%townname%，发现几个眼熟的农民围着%employer%。怕被认出来，你躲在暗处。他们哭喊着说，强盗毁了%location%。%employer%满脸忧虑。%SPEECH_ON%是吗？噢，太可怕了！我会调查此事。别怕，乡亲们，我会保护你们！%SPEECH_OFF%他话音刚落，一名守卫便偷偷塞给你一袋克朗。 | 你走进%employer%的住处，看见几个满身是血的农民围在他的桌旁。你藏着身，等他们说完离开。%employer%招手让你进去。%SPEECH_ON%强盗。他们说是强盗干的。很好。你的报酬在角落里。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%笑着迎接你回来。%SPEECH_ON%有活口。%SPEECH_OFF%他摆摆手，示意你不必担心。%SPEECH_ON%他们以为是强盗干的，只是流寇的一次劫掠。你没什么可担心的。你的报酬……%SPEECH_OFF%他把钱袋推过桌面。你接过，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%合作愉快。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进门时，%employer%把一份卷轴拍在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%你留下了活口！不过……没关系。他们以为是强盗干的。%SPEECH_OFF%你把手搭上剑柄，瞥了一眼%employer%的守卫。%SPEECH_ON%我还是要拿足报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%抬手示意桌上的钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%当然。不过下次我让你办事，希望你一件不落地办妥，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群农民围住了%employer%。你一时还以为他们要动私刑，结果他只是把众人打发走了。看着他们消失在拐角，他解释说，那是%location%的幸存者。你还没来得及开口，他便摆手，示意你别担心。%SPEECH_ON%他们仍以为是强盗干的，可我对这个结果不满意。这事差点就让我们倒大霉了。我的意思是，让我倒霉。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，问要不要把这几个幸存者也杀了，以防万一。%employer%摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不，不必了。这是答应你的报酬，佣兵。不过下次，务必按我的命令办事。%SPEECH_OFF%}

8b06479447fab0248241.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{As you enter %employer%'s abode he turns and slaps a scroll of a drawing on his table.%SPEECH_ON%Recognize this person?%SPEECH_OFF%You pick it up. The sketched face looks remarkably like your own. %employer% leans back.%SPEECH_ON%They know someone hired a hit on the place. Get the fark out of here before I have my men run you through.%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%Survivors! Survivors! What did I say, 'no survivors', I believe I said that, right?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod as %employer% curls his knuckles against his desk.%SPEECH_ON%So why in the hell do I get peasants running in here crying that mercenaries stormed their place? Dead people don't talk, but who does? Who talks, sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF%You stand.%SPEECH_ON%Survivors.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% points toward the door.%SPEECH_ON%Right. Now get the hell out of my sight.%SPEECH_OFF% | You nod as %employer% tells you the news: a few peasants escaped and spread word that it was a 'hired job' to destroy %location%. But you're wondering...%SPEECH_ON%Can we still keep all the equipment we've found?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%You can keep whatever the hell you like, but you won't be seeing a single crown out of my pockets. Get out of here, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | Unfortunately, it appears that a few peasants survived the slaughter. They told %employer% of very particular details, namely that well-armed and ill-intentioned men destroyed %location%. Not brigands, but sellswords. You were supposed to kill them all, leaving no survivors, but now... well, now you don't get paid. | %employer% sits across from you, clenching his fist, his face growing red. He asks how he is to raise taxes to protect people from brigands if everyone thinks mercenaries were hired to destroy %location%. You inquire as to what he means and the man is very blunt with you: a few peasants survived, you farkin' idiot. Leaving survivors was not part of the job description, it appears, and now %employer%'s payment won't be a part of your treasury.}
8b06479447fab0248241.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你走进%employer%的住处，他转身把一张画像卷轴拍在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%认得这个人吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你拿起来。画上的脸，与你相像得惊人。%employer%往后一靠。%SPEECH_ON%他们知道有人花钱买凶，毁了那地方。趁我还没叫人把你捅个对穿，赶紧滚。%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%活口！活口！我说的是什么？“不留活口”，我记得是这么说的，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%的指节抵着桌面，你点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%那为什么他妈的还有农民跑来，哭着说佣兵袭击了他们？死人不会说话，可谁会？谁会说话，佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF%你站起身。%SPEECH_ON%活口。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%指向门口。%SPEECH_ON%没错。现在，滚出我的视线。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%告诉你消息，你点头听着：几个农民逃掉了，还把%location%遭毁是“有人出钱雇的”这件事传了出去。不过，你有个疑问……%SPEECH_ON%我们找到的装备，还能留下吗？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%你他妈爱留什么留什么，反正别想从我口袋里拿走一枚克朗。滚出去，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 不幸的是，似乎有几个农民在屠杀中活了下来。他们向%employer%讲出了十分具体的细节：毁掉%location%的，是一群装备精良、心怀歹意的人。不是强盗，而是佣兵。你本该把他们全部杀光，不留活口。可现在……好吧，现在你拿不到钱了。 | %employer%坐在你对面，拳头越攥越紧，脸越来越红。他问，如果人人都觉得%location%是被雇来的佣兵毁掉的，他还怎么以防范强盗、保护民众为由加税？你问他什么意思，他毫不客气地直说：有几个农民活下来了，你这他妈的蠢货。看来，留下活口不在任务要求之内，而%employer%的报酬，也不会进你的钱袋了。}

3d753ae501f8c4e822f6.source: They won't be welcoming us in %settlementname%...

365d0c6b50f61ed6a32f.translation: 清除%townname%附近%location%废墟中的威胁

71b3a31e670d94b41c8d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer% offers some bread and beer, and seems happy to avail himself. After some smalltalk on how you like %townname%, he gets to the point.%SPEECH_ON%This region has been prosperous before, but many of our assets have been pillaged, burned or taken over by brigands. We need you to go to the %location% outside of %townname% and clear it of any occupants so that we can safely send materials there and have our craftsmen rebuild what we once had.%SPEECH_OFF%He leans over the table and looks firmly at you.%SPEECH_ON%Are you willing to assist us in this endeavor?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% takes a bite of an apple then tosses the rest to you. Catching it, you look at the man, not entirely sure what to do with it. When he says nothing, you take a bite and toss it back, thanking him.%SPEECH_ON%No problem, sellsword. Today's a decent day, although, obviously, I need something from you. The %location% outside of %townname% is, I believe, host to a group of brigands. All I need you to do is go there and clear the out so that I can restore the place to its former, crimeless glory. Does that suit your... interests?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% sighs as he drops a scroll from his fingers as though its news weighted it so heavily.%SPEECH_ON%We're not getting enough crowns from %townname%, and I believe it's because brigands may have taken over the %location%. That's not entirely confirmed... I really should follow the news of my people better, but you know how it is.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Anyway, I want you to go there, find the problem, and then report back to me for further instruction. Sounds simple enough, right?%SPEECH_OFF% | Leaning forward in his chair, %employer% points to a map he's got sprawled out across his desk.%SPEECH_ON%The %location% outside of %townname% has been destroyed by brigands. Now, sellsword, I need your services to take the territory back and help me restore it to its former glory or whatever it is I tell the peasants these days. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% sighs, his breath leaving him one way, and his body sinking into his chair the other.%SPEECH_ON%I used to visit the %location% when I was a kid. It was such a prosperous place, but now it lay in ruin thanks to some vagabonds. Obviously, I'm not talking to you just to reminisce. I need you to go there and take it back! Kill those brigands and then report back to me immediately. Does this simple task interest you?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% kicks his feet up on his desk, knocking an empty goblet over.%SPEECH_ON%The peasants are at it again. Bugging me. They say the %location% outside of %townname% has been destroyed. I don't ordinarily take the fools at their word, but a few of my councilmen seem to have confirmed the news. So now I gotta do something about it.%SPEECH_OFF%He swings a finger at you, smiling as he does it.%SPEECH_ON%That's where you come in. Go to the %location%, kill those unruly vagabonds, then report back to me. How's that sound to you?%SPEECH_OFF%}
71b3a31e670d94b41c8d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer%拿出面包和啤酒招待你，自己也吃喝得挺开心。随口聊了几句你对%townname%的印象，他便转入正题。%SPEECH_ON%这一带以前也曾繁荣，可我们许多产业都被强盗劫掠、焚毁或占据了。我们需要你去%townname%外的%location%，清除所有占据那里的人。这样才能安全地运送材料，让工匠重建我们曾经拥有的一切。%SPEECH_OFF%他俯身越过桌面，目光坚定地看着你。%SPEECH_ON%你愿意帮我们完成这件事吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%咬了一口苹果，把剩下的扔给你。你接住，看着他，不太确定该怎么办。他一言不发，你便也咬了一口，扔回去，向他道谢。%SPEECH_ON%不客气，佣兵。今天还算不错，不过，显然，我有事需要你帮忙。我想，%townname%外的%location%被一伙强盗占了。你只需过去把他们清掉，让我把那地方恢复成从前没有罪犯的好模样。这合你的……兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%叹了口气，任卷轴从指间落下，仿佛上面的消息沉重得拿不住。%SPEECH_ON%我们从%townname%收到的克朗太少了，我想，可能是强盗占据了%location%。还没完全查实……我确实该多关心关心民间的消息，不过，你也知道，总是这样。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%总之，你先去看看，查清问题，再回来等我下一步指示。听起来够简单吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%在椅子里前倾，指向摊在桌上的地图。%SPEECH_ON%%townname%外的%location%被强盗毁掉了。现在，佣兵，我需要你夺回那片地方，帮我恢复它往日的繁荣——或者随便我这阵子对农民说的什么漂亮话。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%叹出一口气，气息向外散去，身子却向椅子深处沉下。%SPEECH_ON%我小时候常去%location%。那地方曾经多繁荣啊，如今却被些流寇弄成废墟。当然，我找你来不是为了叙旧。我要你去，把它夺回来！杀掉那些强盗，然后立刻回来报告。这份简单的差事，你有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%把双脚架上桌子，踢倒了一只空酒杯。%SPEECH_ON%农民又来了，又来烦我。他们说，%townname%外的%location%毁了。平时我可不会听那些蠢货的一面之词，可几位议事官似乎也证实了消息。现在，我只好做点什么。%SPEECH_OFF%他笑着朝你一指。%SPEECH_ON%所以，就轮到你了。去%location%，杀掉那些不守规矩的流寇，再回来向我报告。你觉得如何？%SPEECH_OFF%}

2ca5bfff4efef7e8b287.translation: {听起来不难。 | 谈谈克朗吧。}

f384f396a0aacca4b89b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{Arriving at the %location%, you have the men fan out and slowly creep into the area. You march in yourself, carefully weaving your way toward the buildings whose windows whistle as a spurting wind comes through. Investigating further, there doesn't appear to be anyone here. Not even evidence that they'd just left, either. You gather your men and head back to inform %employer%. | %location% is surprisingly empty. You mosey about one of the homes, picking up dusted cups and flipping over straw beds, but find neither insect nor man. The place has been wholly abandoned. You head back to tell %employer% of the news. | A deerscare nods and tips at the edge of %location%, its wooden chiming the only thing around that seems to be alive. If anyone was living here, they left a long time ago. Buildings stand empty. Hollowed out. You can tell just by looking at them that no one is inside. The old gods themselves could destroy this place and not a single person would know or care. Sad. Best let %employer% know of the 'good' news. | %location%'s abandoned, just as you figured, but there is not a bandit or vagabond in sight. You can't blame them for not wanting the place: even though there's few buildings around, everything about them make you on edge. Old, frail... haunted? As though they were home to immeasurable crimes. Maybe %employer%'s workers will tear them down and start anew. | Not a bandit is to be found at %location%. Half the buildings are destroyed while the other half stand empty and abandoned. A few of %employer%'s workers could probably get this place into shape so you'd best go inform him. | You find a weathervane stuck in the mud and a cow carcass beside it. A pig pen is layered with fresh green grass. One of the buildings has been verdantly painted by a crawl of vines. The cemetery's markings are tilted and some flat on the ground. You find a shovel and a hole beside it. Water's filled the unused grave and there blue birds are bathing. You wonder if this place would be best left as is, but it's not your place to wonder. You head back to inform %employer% on the state of things. | You enter the %location% and have the men fan out and start searching the buildings. Not one to leave an investigation entirely to a bunch of sellswords, you enter a nearby home. The door peels open and almost immediately your foot kicks through a pile of pots and pans left on the earthen floor. Trudging in, you spot a few dead mice in the corner of the place, their skeletons still in a state of scurrying, and adjacent to them is a dead cat. There's a bird nest in the rafters. Yellowed eggs wink their shelled hoods, but you have yet to see much less hear a bird.

%randombrother% comes in through the door and says nothing has been found. If brigands were here, they left long ago. You tell the mercenary to gather the men as it is time to report your findings to %employer%.}
f384f396a0aacca4b89b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{抵达%location%后，你让弟兄们分散开，缓缓潜入。自己也走了进去，小心绕向屋舍，阵风灌过窗洞，发出尖啸。继续搜查，却似乎没有任何人在这里，甚至没有刚刚离开的迹象。你召集弟兄们，返回向%employer%报告。 | %location%空得出奇。你在一栋屋里转悠，拿起积灰的杯子，掀开稻草床铺，却连虫子和人都找不到。这地方早已彻底荒废。你回去把消息告诉%employer%。 | %location%边缘，一架木制驱兽器上下倾动，敲击声是这里唯一像还活着的动静。就算从前有人居住，也早已离开很久。房屋空空荡荡，像被掏空了内里。只看一眼，就知道里面没有人。即使旧神亲自毁掉这里，也不会有人知道，更不会有人在乎。可悲。还是把这则“好消息”告诉%employer%吧。 | 如你所料，%location%已经荒废，可也看不见强盗或流寇。倒不能怪他们不想要这地方：虽说只剩几栋屋舍，却处处让人不安。老旧，摇摇欲坠……闹鬼？仿佛里面发生过数不清的罪行。也许%employer%的工人会把它们拆掉，重新建起。 | %location%找不到一个强盗。一半房屋毁了，另一半空置荒废。%employer%派几个工人来，大概就能把这里收拾妥当，你最好回去通知他。 | 你发现一只陷进泥里的风向标，旁边是一头牛的尸骸。猪圈里铺满新生的绿草，一栋房屋被攀爬的藤蔓涂成碧色。墓地的碑石歪斜着，有些已平倒在地。你找到一把铁锹，旁边是个坑。未曾使用的墓穴积满了水，蓝色小鸟正在其中洗浴。你不禁想，也许让这里保持原样才最好，可这不是你该考虑的事。你回去向%employer%报告现状。 | 你进入%location%，命令弟兄们散开，搜查屋舍。你不愿把调查全交给一群佣兵，自己也走进附近一户人家。门艰难地剥离门框，刚一打开，你的脚便踢进泥地上遗留的一堆锅碗。继续往里走，角落里有几只死老鼠，骨架还保持着逃窜的姿态，旁边则躺着一只死猫。椽子上有个鸟巢，泛黄的蛋壳从巢沿露出来，可你既没见到鸟，也没听见鸟叫。

%randombrother%从门口进来，说什么也没找到。就算这里曾有强盗，也早就走了。你叫佣兵召集弟兄们，该回去向%employer%报告发现了。}

a9c62c5ffb50c1ce342c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{You order your men to fan out through the %location%. You creep through the area with your sword in hand. As you turn a corner, you find a man squatting over a shithole. His knees wobble at the sight of you. When he reaches for his weapon, you run him through, quickly kicking his body off your blade and warning your men of brigands who quickly begin streaming out of nearby buildings. | The %location%'s quiet, but not quiet enough. Here and there you hear a creak or croak of wood, the jingle jangle of chains being moved. People are here. You draw out your sword and order you men to prepare for battle. Just as soon as you do, a bandit kicks open a building door and sprints out of it, a throng of equally shouty men piling out behind him. | Brigands! Just as you expected. Not only are they at the %location%, they don't appear to give two shits about how out in the open they are. As your men converge on the area, the brigands lazily gather their weapons as if they've handled men of your ilk already. | The %location%'s completely empty - except for the large group of brigands inhabiting its center, squatting around a fire and a spitted pig. They glance at you, back at the pig, then back at you. One draws a meaty fork away from the fire.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, sir, we just want to eat.%SPEECH_OFF%You draw out your sword and nod.%SPEECH_ON%Me too.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find a bandit just outside the %location%. He's carrying the body of a peasant which is about good of evidence as you need to kill him and all his friends. You order your men to attack. | Brigands scurry from a campfire as you near the %location%. Surprisingly, they arm themselves and come out to defend their newly acquired 'territory.'}
a9c62c5ffb50c1ce342c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{你命令弟兄们在%location%分散搜寻，自己则握剑潜行。转过一处拐角，你看见一个男人蹲在粪坑上。他一见你，膝盖便直打颤。他伸手去拿武器，你一剑刺穿他的身体，随即把尸体踹下剑刃，警告弟兄们：这里有强盗。话音未落，附近屋舍里已接连冲出人来。 | %location%很安静，却还不够安静。不时传来木头吱呀作响的声音，以及挪动铁链的叮当声。这里有人。你拔剑，命令弟兄们准备战斗。刚说完，一个强盗便踹开房门冲了出来，身后跟着一群同样大喊大叫的家伙。 | 强盗！果然不出所料。他们不但占着%location%，似乎还压根不在乎暴露行踪。弟兄们向这里合围时，强盗才懒洋洋地拿起武器，仿佛早就收拾过你们这号人。 | %location%空无一人——除了中央那一大群强盗。他们围着篝火蹲坐，火上串着一头猪。众人看看你，又看看猪，再看看你。其中一人从火上抽回插着肉的叉子。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼，先生，我们只想吃口饭。%SPEECH_OFF%你拔出剑，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%我也是。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在%location%外发现一个强盗。他正扛着一具农民的尸体，这已经足够成为你杀掉他和所有同伙的理由。你命令弟兄们进攻。 | 你们靠近%location%时，一群强盗从篝火旁四散跑开。出乎意料的是，他们拿起武器，又迎了出来，打算保卫刚占下的“领地”。}

3b5294287a938ecc4cbf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_110.png[/img]{The white limply twisting in the wind from the abodes of %location% looks like smoke, but the buildings are untouched. As you near the dwellings, pairs upon pairs of red eyes flare in the dark of their windows. The webknechts scuttle forth, their spiny legs clattering on the slats of wood and scratching the corrugated rooftops, the mass of black bodies fluttering out the window frame like the flakes of a smoldered dandelion. | You find %location% deserted, but there's a silky white film frosting every corner of the place, tendrils of it twisting limply in the wind. %randombrother% touches a tip of one and it stretches back with his arm and he has to cut himself free. Looking back ahead, you see the webknechts rushing toward you, their spiny legs scissoring as they cross ground with frightening speed, their mandibles clattering with hunger.}
3b5294287a938ecc4cbf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_110.png[/img]{%location%的屋舍间，白色丝缕在风中无力地扭动，看起来像烟，可房屋却完好无损。你走近时，漆黑的窗内亮起了一双又一双红眼。巨蛛疾窜而出，带刺的长腿踩得木板咔咔作响，又在起伏的屋顶上刮擦。成团的黑色躯体从窗框中涌出，仿佛烧焦的蒲公英上纷飞的碎絮。 | 你发现%location%已经荒无人烟，但每个角落都蒙着一层霜似的白色丝膜，细丝在风中绵软地飘动。%randombrother%伸手碰了碰一缕蛛丝，手臂缩回来时，蛛丝也跟着拉长，最后他只得拔刀将自己割出来。你再抬头看去，只见巨蛛正向你们冲来。带刺的长腿交错如剪，以骇人的速度掠过地面；饥饿的螯牙咔哒作响。}

2f236d1ee02aaa942a2a.source: These people have nowhere to go. Just... leave them be.
2f236d1ee02aaa942a2a.translation: 这些人无处可去。就……别管他们了。

0537f6c659a57fa255d1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{You order the men to clear the refugees out. They don't put up much of a fight - mostly just moan and groan about cruel the world is. All you can think about is how much you're getting paid, though. | %randombrother% and a few mercenaries are ordered to go in and kick them out. Luckily it is without bloodshed, but every refugee that passes before your gaze meets it with a solemn, sad look. You shrug. | The refugees are kicked out. One looks ready to say something to you, but closes his mouth. It is as though he had said those thoughts before and remembered they had no effect then just as they wouldn't now. You enjoy the silence. | You have %randombrother% dole out a few foodstuffs to the refugees. Items that were close to going bad anyway: or pieces of bread that double as bricks and an old stew that reeks of death when you pull the lid off. The refugees take every item as though you'd given them the world. They don't say thanks, though. They just nod and shrug and carry on.}
0537f6c659a57fa255d1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{你命令弟兄们赶走难民。他们没怎么反抗，只是哀叹这世道太过残酷。不过，你满脑子想的只有这趟能挣多少钱。 | 你命令%randombrother%带上几名佣兵，进去把人赶出来。所幸没有流血，可每个从你面前经过的难民，都用沉重而悲伤的目光望着你。你耸了耸肩。 | 难民被赶了出去。其中一人似乎想对你说点什么，最后却闭上了嘴。仿佛那些话他以前也说过，又想起当时说了没用，如今说了也一样。你乐得清静。 | 你让%randombrother%给难民分些吃的。反正都是快坏的东西：能当砖头使的面包块，还有一揭盖就散发着死尸般恶臭的陈年炖菜。难民接过每样东西时，都像是你把整个世界送给了他们。不过，他们没有道谢，只是点点头、耸耸肩，继续前行。}

482ae8fc7495c40289f2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{You leave the refugees where they are. Might as well not return to %employer% because he won't be happy about this at all. | The men, women, and children look like they've had enough of getting pushed around. You decide to leave them be. | These people have had enough of this world. You don't think they'd survive another trip out into the wilds and decide to leave them where they've settled. | The haggard and harried people don't deserve to be booted from this place. You figure to leave 'em be. They'll turn it into a workable area soon enough, although %employer% won't be happy not having his own people in the area. | %employer% wants his own people settled here, but you figure these folks got to it first. That, and they don't look like they could live any longer being put out into the wild.}
482ae8fc7495c40289f2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{你把难民留在原地。看来也没必要回去见%employer%了，他绝不会对这个结果满意。 | 这些男人、女人和孩子，看起来已经受够了任人驱赶的日子。你决定放他们一马。 | 这些人已经受尽了世道的折磨。你觉得他们熬不过又一次荒野流亡，于是决定让他们留在这处落脚地。 | 这些饱受惊扰、憔悴不堪的人，不该再被赶出这里。你决定由他们去吧。用不了多久，他们也能把这里经营起来，只是这里住的不是%employer%自己的民众，他肯定会不高兴。 | %employer%想把自己的民众安置在这里，可你觉得，凡事总得讲个先来后到。再说，这些人看上去也经不起再次被赶进荒野了。}

5186415a86aec5888561.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{The battle is over and %location% has been secured. It's time to return to %employer%. | You look over the battle and nod, happy to still have a head upon your shoulders with which to nod with. Time to return to %employer%. | As rough a fight as there can be, you gather the men and ready a return to %employer%. | The fight over, you assess the scene and ready a report. %employer% will want to know everything which has happened here.}
5186415a86aec5888561.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{战斗结束，%location%已被夺回。该返回%employer%那里了。 | 你打量战场，点点头，很庆幸脑袋还在肩上，能让自己点得动。该回去见%employer%了。 | 这一仗艰苦至极。你召集弟兄们，准备返回%employer%那里。 | 战斗结束，你查看现场，准备报告。%employer%会想知道这里发生的一切。}

9e7101b94c399ac0f390.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{You return to %location% and watch the workers fan out to the buildings. They get to work, piling slats of wood, putting up support beams, and one group is digging themselves a well. Looks like you can return to %employer% now. | The builders thank you for getting them to the %location% safe and sound. They then turn and begin work, spreading out amongst the location and turning their hands to what tools are about them. The snicker-snacker and snoring haw of hammers and saws echo behind you as you leave to return to %employer%. | Most of the builders head into %location% and begin preparations for its rebuilding. The foreman thanks you for getting them there safely as he knows the dangers of the world. He also thanks you for not betraying them all into an early grave. You take this gratitude with a smirk before starting the return journey to %employer%. | Well, the workers are here safe and sound. You turn back, returning to %employer% to get the pay you've rightly earned. | It's been a long journey, there and back and there again, but it seems %location% is now about to get its legs underneath itself again. After making sure the workers are safe, you start the return trip to %employer% for your pay.}
9e7101b94c399ac0f390.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{你回到%location%，看着工人们各自走向屋舍。他们开始干活，堆放木板、竖起支撑梁，还有一伙人在挖井。看来，现在可以回去见%employer%了。 | 工匠们感谢你护送他们平安抵达%location%，随后便转身开工，分散到各处，抄起手边的工具。你动身返回%employer%那里，身后回荡着锤子的叮当声与锯子的沙沙声。 | 大部分工匠进入%location%，开始为重建做准备。工头深知外面的世道有多危险，因此感谢你把他们平安带到这里。他也谢你没有出卖他们，把所有人送进坟墓。你带着一抹笑意接受了这番谢辞，然后启程返回%employer%那里。 | 好了，工人们已平安抵达。你转身踏上归途，回去找%employer%，领取自己应得的报酬。 | 这一趟可真够折腾的，来回奔波，又重走一遍。不过看来，%location%总算要重新兴旺起来了。确认工人们安然无恙后，你便动身回去找%employer%领钱。}

0d94872037e4a20d1452.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_98.png[/img]{%employer% glances at you as enter.%SPEECH_ON%So is it clear?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. %employer% gets up and gives you instructions: you're to take a troop of builders back to the %location% so that they can rebuild it. | %employer% listens to your report and nods.%SPEECH_ON%I have a group of men going back to the %location% so that they can rebuild it. I need you to escort them. Got it? Good.%SPEECH_OFF% | Rolling up some scrolls, %employer% gives you your next instruction.%SPEECH_ON%I've got a gang of men going back there to rebuild the place. A lot of crowns are involved here, so I need you to make sure those men get there in one piece. After that, come back and get your pay.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% sits back after listening to your report. He's sipping a goblet of cobra wine.%SPEECH_ON%News?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him that the area has been cleared out. The man swigs the rest of the drink in one go and sets the cup down.%SPEECH_ON%Good... good. Now take a gang of my workers back there to help rebuild. Once they are finished, come back for your payday.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% sits back as you enter.%SPEECH_ON%I take it by your return that the %location% has been cleared, yes?%SPEECH_OFF%You confirm what the man wants to hear. He seems happy, though your job is not yet finished: %employer% wants you to take a gang of workers back to the area to help rebuild and resettle it. Once they're there safe and sound, return to him for payment.}
0d94872037e4a20d1452.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_98.png[/img]{你进门时，%employer%瞥了你一眼。%SPEECH_ON%那么，清理干净了？%SPEECH_OFF%你点了点头。%employer%站起身，交代接下来的任务：护送一队工匠返回%location%，让他们着手重建。 | %employer%听完你的报告，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%我有一队人要回%location%重建那里。你负责护送。听明白了？很好。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%一边卷起几份卷轴，一边交代你下一项任务。%SPEECH_ON%我安排了一批人回去重建。这里头牵涉的克朗可不少，所以你得保证他们毫发无损地到达。之后回来领钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | 听完你的报告，%employer%靠回椅背，啜饮着一杯眼镜蛇酒。%SPEECH_ON%有什么消息？%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，那地方已经清理干净了。他把剩下的酒一饮而尽，放下杯子。%SPEECH_ON%好……很好。现在带我的一队工人回去，帮忙重建。等他们干完，你再回来领钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进门时，%employer%往椅背上一靠。%SPEECH_ON%既然你回来了，想必%location%已经清理干净了，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你给了他想听的答复。他似乎很满意，但你的活还没干完：%employer%要你护送一队工人回到那里，协助重建并重新安置居民。等他们平安抵达，你就可以回来领钱了。}

17b22a927e7563e5dae1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your return with a satchel heavy with crowns. He waves you off, hardly even thanking you for your work. Although, screw him and screw the formalities. A bag of crowns is thanks enough. | You enter %employer%'s abode and he waves you in. One of his men hands you a large satchel of crowns. You look at the man.%SPEECH_ON%How did you know they made it?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% smiles sheepishly.%SPEECH_ON%I have many eyes and ears in these parts. Even the birds talk to me...%SPEECH_OFF%That explanation's good enough. | Returning to %employer%, you explain that the %location% is well underway to restoration. He thanks you.%SPEECH_ON%Well, would you look at that? A mercenary who keeps his word and gets his work done. A rarity. Here is your pay.%SPEECH_OFF%One of his men hands you a burlap sack heavy and sharpened by crowns. %employer% tips a hand.%SPEECH_ON%Be seeing you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is in his study when you return. He shows a scroll to you and asks if you know what it is. You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not a learned man. Not of the written word, anyway.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% returns the shrug.%SPEECH_ON%What a shame. But you are a man of the spoken word. You've owned up to your promises and, believe me, that is rare to see. Your pay is in the corner.%SPEECH_OFF%The pay is right where he says it is. You spend little time dawdling on ceremony and take it and make your leave. | %employer% sits back, seemingly smug with himself.%SPEECH_ON%I know how to pick 'em. Sellswords, that is. Most of my compatriots hire folks like you, but it goes tits up because they don't know how to spot a good man from the wag of a dead dog's tail. But you... I knew you were good on your word the second I saw you. Your pay, mercenary...%SPEECH_OFF%He slams a satchel of crowns on his desk.%SPEECH_ON%It's all there, but I understand if you want to count it.%SPEECH_OFF%You do count it - and it's all there.}
17b22a927e7563e5dae1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{%employer%拿出一袋沉甸甸的克朗，迎接你回来，随后便挥手打发你走，连句谢话都懒得说。不过，去他的，什么礼数也都去他的吧。一袋克朗，已经谢得足够了。 | 你来到%employer%的住处，他招手让你进去。一名手下递给你一大袋克朗。你望向雇主。%SPEECH_ON%你怎么知道他们到了？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%略带腼腆地笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%我在这一带耳目不少。连鸟儿都会向我报信……%SPEECH_OFF%有这个解释就够了。 | 你回去见%employer%，告诉他%location%的重建已经顺利展开。他向你道谢。%SPEECH_ON%瞧瞧，一个信守承诺、能把活干完的佣兵。真少见。这是你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%一名手下递来粗麻钱袋，沉甸甸的，硬币边缘在袋面顶出一道道棱角。%employer%抬手致意。%SPEECH_ON%后会有期，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%正在书房。他举起一份卷轴，问你知不知道是什么。你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我没读过什么书。至少白纸黑字的，没读过。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%也耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%真可惜。不过你是个说话算话的人。你兑现了承诺，相信我，这很难得。报酬在角落里。%SPEECH_OFF%钱就在他说的地方。你懒得为客套耽搁，拿上报酬便走了。 | %employer%靠在椅背上，似乎对自己颇为得意。%SPEECH_ON%我会挑人。我说的是佣兵。我的同僚大多也雇过你们这样的人，可最后总是鸡飞蛋打，因为他们连好汉和死狗尾巴都分不清。你呢……第一眼见到你，我就知道你是个守信的人。你的报酬，佣兵……%SPEECH_OFF%他把一袋克朗重重放在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%全在这里了，不过你想数数，我也理解。%SPEECH_OFF%你确实数了——一枚不少。}

594a9563c065b6ab2df3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{The building trek is in ruin and any hope to salvage %location% is lost. At least for the time being.}
594a9563c065b6ab2df3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{建设队伍已被摧毁，修复%location%的希望也随之破灭。至少眼下如此。}

45c8e52d6a2adea27faf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{Your men failed to secure the %location% and so you shouldn't expect any pay.}
45c8e52d6a2adea27faf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{你的弟兄们没能清除%location%的威胁，报酬自然也别指望了。}

5edc682b9bd8ef39e06b.translation: 未能清除废墟中的威胁，地点：

a1511ed2f3f7b8c48943.source: Failed to protect a building trek

34b9878e17996f5076de.source: A caravan of workers and building materials from
34b9878e17996f5076de.translation: 一支运送工人与建材的商队，来自

513a2c02b1b0662f82f6.source: A group of thieves and bandits.

665dec6bc811883ea9b1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer% restlessly walks back and forth while explaining what troubles him.%SPEECH_ON%There has been an audacious act of thievery! The despicable brigands stole my %itemLower% which is of immeasurable value to me. I implore you to hunt down those thieves and return that item to me.%SPEECH_OFF%He lowers his voice to an insisting tone.%SPEECH_ON%Not only will you get paid handsomely, but you would also set the worried minds of the good people of %townname% to rest!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s reading one of many scrolls. He angrily tosses it onto a pile of others.%SPEECH_ON%The people of %townname% are rightfully furious. Do you know a brigand, possibly in league with other vagabonds, managed to steal my %itemLower% from us? That artifact is of immeasurable value to me! And... to the people, of course.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%And you want me to get it back for you?%SPEECH_OFF%The man points a finger.%SPEECH_ON%Precisely, smart sellsword! That is exactly what I want you to do. Follow the footprints of thievery and return to me the item which I... the town, rightfully owns!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s turning an apple in hand. He seems frustrated with it, almost as if he wishes it were something else like a valuable trinket or perhaps just a tastier fruit.%SPEECH_ON%Have you ever lost something you loved?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and answer.%SPEECH_ON%There was this girl...%SPEECH_OFF%The man shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%No, not some woman. More important. Because I have! Thieves stole my %itemLower%. How they managed to do get beyond my guards is, well, beyond me. But I know if I set you on them I'll be having what is rightfully mine back where it belongs. Isn't that right? Or have I been mislead as to the quality of your services?%SPEECH_OFF% | A dog is snoring at the feet of %employer%. He leans forward to gently pet the hound behind its ears.%SPEECH_ON%I hear you have a nose for finding people, sellsword. For... solving problems.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. It is true, after all.%SPEECH_ON%Good... good... I have a task for you. A simple one. Something of great value to me has been stolen, my %itemLower%. I need you to track down those who stole it, kill them, obviously, and then bring back the item.%SPEECH_OFF% | A bird is perched on %employer%'s window. The man, seated, points at it.%SPEECH_ON%I wonder if that's how they got in. The brigands, I mean. I think they must've snuck through a window and then right back out. That's how they got away with my %itemLower%.%SPEECH_OFF%The man slowly rises and stalks across the room. He crouches, about ready to pounce on the bird, but the creature scatters before the man can so much as flinch.%SPEECH_ON%Damn.%SPEECH_OFF%He returns to his seat, wiping his hands as if he'd worked up a sweat during his attempted avian ambush.%SPEECH_ON%My task is simple, sellsword. Bring my property back to me. Kill the brigands, too, if you wouldn't mind.%SPEECH_OFF% | Dust covers %employer%'s table, but there is a spot oddly cleaner than the rest. He gestures to it.%SPEECH_ON%That's where my %itemLower% used to sit. If you couldn't tell, it's gone.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. It does appear to be missing.%SPEECH_ON%The thieves who took it should be easy to track down. They're good thinkers in the night, those brigands, but they make mistakes aplenty during the day. Footprints, crowns ill-spent... you should be able to track them down with ease.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks at you with a stern eye.%SPEECH_ON%Do you understand, mercenary? I want you to get my property back. I want it placed right where it belongs. And... I want those thieves dead in the mud.%SPEECH_OFF%}
665dec6bc811883ea9b1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{%employer%焦躁地来回踱步，向你讲述自己的烦心事。%SPEECH_ON%简直是胆大包天的盗窃！那帮卑鄙的土匪偷走了我的%itemLower%，它对我来说是无价之宝。我恳请你追上那些贼，把东西夺回来。%SPEECH_OFF%他压低声音，语气却越发不容推辞。%SPEECH_ON%你不但能拿到丰厚报酬，还能让%townname%的善良百姓放下悬着的心！%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正翻阅一卷文书，忽然怒气冲冲地将它扔到那堆卷轴上。%SPEECH_ON%%townname%的百姓愤怒是有道理的。你知道吗？一个土匪，可能还勾结了别的流浪汉，竟然从我们这里偷走了我的%itemLower%！那件宝物对我来说价值无法估量！当然……对百姓也是。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%所以，你想让我替你找回来？%SPEECH_OFF%他伸出一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%正是，聪明的佣兵！我要你做的就是这个。循着窃贼的足迹，把本来就属于我……属于本镇的东西带回来！%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%在手里转着一只苹果，看上去烦躁不已，似乎恨不得它变成别的东西，比如一件值钱的小玩意儿，或至少变成一只更可口的果子。%SPEECH_ON%你失去过心爱的东西吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，答道。%SPEECH_ON%从前有个姑娘……%SPEECH_OFF%他摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不，不是什么女人，是更重要的东西。因为我就失去了！窃贼偷走了我的%itemLower%。他们怎么绕过卫兵的？说实话，我也想不通。但我知道，只要派你去追，本来就属于我的东西便能物归原主。对吧？还是说，我听到的有关你本事的传闻有误？%SPEECH_OFF% | 一条狗在%employer%脚边打着呼噜。他俯下身，轻轻挠着它的耳后。%SPEECH_ON%听说你很擅长追踪，佣兵。也擅长……解决麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，毕竟他说的是实话。%SPEECH_ON%好……很好……我有件事交给你，很简单。有人偷走了对我极为珍贵的东西，我的%itemLower%。我要你找到那些贼，当然，还得杀了他们，然后把东西带回来。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一只鸟停在%employer%的窗边。他坐在椅子上，抬手指向它。%SPEECH_ON%我在想，他们会不会就是这样进来的。我说那些土匪。他们一定是从窗户溜进来，又从原路溜了出去，就这样带走了我的%itemLower%。%SPEECH_OFF%他慢慢起身，蹑手蹑脚穿过房间，弯下腰，作势要扑向那只鸟。可他还没动，鸟就飞走了。%SPEECH_ON%该死。%SPEECH_OFF%他回到椅子上，擦了擦双手，仿佛刚才那场伏击飞鸟的行动已经让他累出一身汗。%SPEECH_ON%我要你做的很简单，佣兵。把我的财物带回来。不嫌麻烦的话，也把那些土匪杀了。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的桌面落满灰尘，唯独有一块地方干净得显眼。他指了指那里。%SPEECH_ON%我的%itemLower%原来就放在这儿。万一你没看出来，它已经不见了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，确实不见了。%SPEECH_ON%偷走它的贼应该不难追。那帮土匪夜里脑子好使，白天却破绽百出。脚印，胡乱花出去的克朗……顺着这些，很容易就能找到他们。%SPEECH_OFF%他神色严厉地盯着你。%SPEECH_ON%明白了吗，佣兵？我要你找回我的财物，把它放回本该待着的地方。还有……我要那些贼死在烂泥里。%SPEECH_OFF%}

e20d3f33e7dd46992175.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]{Brigands! Just as your employer had thought. They look scared, presumably understanding that %employer%'s well-paid wrath is about to descend upon them. | Ah, the thieves are quite human - a simple crew of vagabonds and brigands. They arm themselves as you order your men to attack. | You catch a group of brigands lugging your employer's property around. They seem shocked that you have found them here and no time is wasted trying to parlay - they arm themselves and you order the %companyname% to charge.}
e20d3f33e7dd46992175.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]{是土匪！果然不出雇主所料。他们看起来很害怕，大概已经明白，%employer%花重金请来的怒火就要落在自己头上。 | 啊，窃贼的确都是活人，不过是一群流浪汉和土匪。你命令弟兄们进攻时，他们也抄起了武器。 | 你逮到一伙土匪，正带着雇主的财物赶路。他们没想到你能追到这里，惊讶之余，一句交涉的话也不说，直接抄起武器。你下令，%companyname%发起冲锋。}

b40550f3763f94583c72.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{There's brigands here, just as expected, but they are handing the %itemLower% to a man in dark, ragged clothes. Your presence, unsurprisingly, brings a halt to the transaction and both the thugs and the ghoulish figure take up weapons. | You catch brigands trading %employer%'s property to what appears to be a necromancer! Maybe he wanted it to cast some sort of vicious spell upon the house. In some light, the notion doesn't seem that bad... but, the man's paying you for a reason. Charge! | %employer%'s property is being sold off by brigands to a pale man in black! He glares at you before anyone else, his beady black eyes narrowing on your company in an instant.}
b40550f3763f94583c72.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{果然，土匪就在这里，但他们正把%itemLower%交给一个身穿破烂黑衣的人。你的出现自然打断了交易，那些恶棍和那个鬼气森森的家伙一同抄起武器。 | 你撞见土匪正在把%employer%的财物卖给一个疑似亡灵法师的人！也许他想用那东西，对雇主家施什么恶毒的咒语。换个角度想想，这主意似乎也不算坏……不过，人家付你钱总有他的道理。冲锋！ | 土匪正在把%employer%的财物卖给一个脸色惨白的黑衣人！他最先察觉到你的到来，细小的黑眼睛一眯，瞬间盯住了你的战团。}

0c74157752aa44541af7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{You clean the blood off your sword and then go to retrieve the item. As you bend over to pick it up, you spot a man watching you in the distance. He comes forth, his two hands totemed together with long sleeves.%SPEECH_ON%I see you've killed my benefactor's men.%SPEECH_OFF%Sheathing your sword, you nod at the man. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%My benefactor paid good money for that artifact. It appears those he paid are no longer owed, so maybe I can speak to you directly. I will give you %bribe% crowns for the item.%SPEECH_OFF%That... is a good amount of money. %employer%, however, will not be happy if you decide to accept... | After the battle, a man emerges from a tree line, clapping his hands together.%SPEECH_ON%I paid those men a great deal of crowns, but it appears I should have paid you. And now that all these skeevy brigands are dead, I can!%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the man to get to the point before you run him through with a sword. He gestures toward the artifact.%SPEECH_ON%I'll pay you %bribe% crowns for the item. It was what was originally owed to these thieves, plus a little more. What do you say?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% won't take kindly to your betrayal, but that is a good bit of money... | The battle over, you pick up the %itemLower% and look it over. Was this really worth the lives of so many people?%SPEECH_ON%I know what you're thinking, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%The voice breaks in. You draw your sword and aim it at a stranger who has seemingly appeared from nowhere.%SPEECH_ON%You're thinking, what if someone paid good money to steal that there artifact? What if that someone would pay me a good deal of money? Perhaps... more than the man who paid you to retrieve it in the first place.%SPEECH_OFF%You lower your weapon and nod.%SPEECH_ON%An interesting thought.%SPEECH_OFF%The man smiles.%SPEECH_ON%%bribe% crowns. That's how much I'll give you for it. That was the thieves' share plus extra. A more than fair deal. Of course, your employer will be most unhappy, but... well, that's not my choice to make.%SPEECH_OFF%}
0c74157752aa44541af7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{你擦去剑上的血，转身去取那件物品。俯身拾起时，你发现远处有人正看着你。他走上前，双手合拢，拢在长袖中。%SPEECH_ON%看来，你杀了我恩主手下的人。%SPEECH_OFF%你收剑入鞘，向他点头。他接着说道。%SPEECH_ON%我的恩主为那件宝物花了大价钱。眼下，原本该拿钱的人已经用不着拿了，或许我可以直接跟你谈。把东西给我，我付你%bribe%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%这……确实是一大笔钱。不过，要是你答应，%employer%肯定不会高兴…… | 战斗结束后，一个男人从林边走出，拍着手。%SPEECH_ON%我花了好多克朗雇那帮人，可看来，我该雇的是你。如今那些鬼祟的土匪全死了，我也就能这么办了！%SPEECH_OFF%你让他赶紧说正事，否则就一剑捅穿他。他指向那件宝物。%SPEECH_ON%把东西卖给我，我付你%bribe%克朗。本来该给那帮贼的报酬，再多加一点。怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%不会轻易咽下这次背叛，但这的确是笔可观的钱…… | 战斗结束，你捡起%itemLower%，仔细端详。就为这么个东西，值得搭上那么多人命吗？%SPEECH_ON%我知道你在想什么，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%一个声音突然响起。你拔剑指向那个仿佛凭空出现的陌生人。%SPEECH_ON%你在想，要是有人出了大价钱，让人偷这件宝物呢？要是那个人愿意把这笔钱给我呢？或许……比最初雇你找回它的人，出得还多。%SPEECH_OFF%你放低武器，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%这想法有点意思。%SPEECH_OFF%那人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%%bribe%克朗。这就是我的价钱。除了那些贼本该分到的，我还多加了一些，绝不亏待你。当然，你的雇主会很不高兴，可……唉，怎么选可不由我。%SPEECH_OFF%}

fe5dc06c6e9caaf332f8.source: I know a good deal when I see one. Hand over the crowns.
fe5dc06c6e9caaf332f8.translation: 划算的买卖，我一眼就看得出来。把钱拿来。

d26a7b715967c3963598.source: We're paid to return it, and that's what we'll do.
d26a7b715967c3963598.translation: 雇主要我们把它带回去，我们就照办。

33c17c8de67338327522.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]You hand over the %itemLower% and the stranger slips you a very heavy, very drooping satchel. The deal is done. It's safe to assume that %employer%, your employer, won't be happy about this.
33c17c8de67338327522.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]你交出%itemLower%，陌生人塞给你一只沉甸甸的钱袋，袋底坠得老长。交易完成。可以肯定，你的雇主%employer%绝不会高兴。

6289a9938eec282e580f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{The battle over, you retrieve the %itemLower% from the wasted clutches of your enemies and prepare to return to %employer%. He will surely be happy to see of your success! | Those who stole the %itemLower% are dead, and thankfully you were able to find the item itself. %employer% will be most pleased with your work here. | Well, you found those responsible for stealing the %itemLower% and put them to the sword. Now you just need to put the %itemLower% back into %employer%'s hands and get your reward! | The battle is done and the %itemLower% was easy to find amongst the corpses of your enemies. You should probably return it to %employer% for your just reward!}
6289a9938eec282e580f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{战斗结束，你从敌人僵死的手中取回%itemLower%，准备返回%employer%那里。他看见你得胜归来，一定会十分高兴！ | 偷走%itemLower%的贼已经死了，幸好东西本身也找到了。%employer%一定会对你这趟的成果非常满意。 | 好了，偷走%itemLower%的罪魁祸首已经找到，也已被你斩于剑下。接下来只需将%itemLower%交回%employer%手中，就能领取报酬！ | 战斗结束，你轻易便从敌人的尸体间找到了%itemLower%。该将它送还给%employer%，领取应得的报酬了！}

107fc1cbe8d31df37410.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% takes the %itemLower% from you, hugging it close as though he'd retrieved a lost child. His eyes get a little teary just looking at his artifact.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sellsword. This means a lot to me... I mean, uh, the town. You have our gratitude!%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses as you stare at him. His eyes bounce to a corner of the room.%SPEECH_ON%Our... gratitude, sellsword...%SPEECH_OFF%A large wooden chest is opened by a guard. You count the crowns and go. | When you return to %employer% he is playing with a bird in a cage.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, the sellsword returns... and?%SPEECH_OFF%You hold up the artifact and then set it on his desk. He takes it, turns it, nods, then puts it away.%SPEECH_ON%Excellent. And for your troubles...%SPEECH_OFF%He waves his hand to a wooden chest filled with crowns. | %employer%'s resting his legs on two dogs, each one passed out atop the other.%SPEECH_ON%These beasts could rip my throat out, yet... look at them. How does that happen? I didn't even train them. Someone else did. I'm a stranger to them yet there they are.%SPEECH_OFF%You place the artifact on the man's table and slide it across. He leans forward, takes it, then places it under his desk. When his hand returns, he's got a satchel in hand. He tosses it over.%SPEECH_ON%As promised. Good work, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF% | When you enter %employer%'s room, there are a host of guards surrounding him. For a second, you think you've stumbled upon a coup, but the men clear out, leaving behind dice and cards. %employer% waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%Come, come. I just lost a good deal of crowns, sellsword. Perhaps you've brought something to help ease my pains...?%SPEECH_OFF%You take out the %itemLower% and hold it in your hand. Rather gingerly, the man takes it.%SPEECH_ON%Good... very good... your pay, of course, is here.%SPEECH_OFF%He hands over a satchel of crowns before turning around in his chair. He seems too consumed by the artifact to say anything else. | %employer% grins as you enter.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, sellsword, will you sell me word of your success?%SPEECH_OFF%You take out the artifact and place it on his table.%SPEECH_ON%Sure.%SPEECH_OFF%The man jolts forward in his chair and takes the item away. He turns back to you, calming himself returning his composure.%SPEECH_ON%Good. You did good. Very good. %reward_completion% crowns, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%He hands over a sack of coins.}
107fc1cbe8d31df37410.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer%接过%itemLower%，紧紧抱在怀里，仿佛找回了失散的孩子。光是看着这件宝物，他的眼里就泛起泪光。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，佣兵。这对我……我是说，对镇子意义重大。我们感激不尽！%SPEECH_OFF%你盯着他，他停了下来，目光飘向房间一角。%SPEECH_ON%我们的……谢意，佣兵……%SPEECH_OFF%一名卫兵打开大木箱。你点清克朗，转身离开。 | 你回到%employer%那里时，他正在逗弄笼子里的鸟。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵回来了……怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%你举起宝物，随后将它放在桌上。他拿起来，翻看一番，点了点头，收了起来。%SPEECH_ON%很好。这是给你的辛苦钱……%SPEECH_OFF%他挥手指向一只装满克朗的木箱。 | %employer%把双腿搭在两条狗身上，那两个家伙叠在一起，睡得正香。%SPEECH_ON%这些畜生本来一口就能撕开我的喉咙，可你看看它们。这是怎么回事呢？我都没训练过它们，是别人训的。对它们来说我是个陌生人，可它们就这么躺着。%SPEECH_OFF%你把宝物放在桌上，推了过去。他探身拿起，放到桌下。手再伸出来时，多了一只钱袋，随手便扔给了你。%SPEECH_ON%按说好的给。干得漂亮，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，发现他被一群卫兵围着。一瞬间，你还以为撞上了兵变，可那些人随即散开，只留下骰子和纸牌。%employer%招手让你进去。%SPEECH_ON%来，来。佣兵，我刚输了一大笔克朗。也许你带来了什么，能让我好受点……？%SPEECH_OFF%你取出%itemLower%，托在手里。他小心翼翼地接了过去。%SPEECH_ON%好……很好……当然，你的报酬就在这里。%SPEECH_OFF%他递来一袋克朗，随后连人带椅转了过去，心思全扑在宝物上，再顾不得多说一句。 | 你一进门，%employer%便咧嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵啊，佣兵，有没有成功的好消息卖给我？%SPEECH_OFF%你取出宝物，放在他桌上。%SPEECH_ON%有啊。%SPEECH_OFF%他猛地从椅子上探出身，把东西一把拿走。随后才转回头，努力镇定下来，恢复仪态。%SPEECH_ON%好，干得好。非常好。说好的，%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%他递来一袋钱。}

2b36c0855794279d35b6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]{You lower yourself to the earth, letting some dirt filter through your fingers. But it is only dirt - there are no footprints that have crossed its path. In fact, you haven't seen any footprints in a good while. %randombrother% joins you, crouching low and shrugging.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, I think we lost 'em.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. %employer% won't be happy about this, but it is what it is. | You've been following the trail of the stolen %itemLower% for a good while now, but the leads have dried up. The commoners you pass know nothing, and the earth shows no footprints with which to track. For all intents and purposes, the %itemLower% is gone. %employer% will not be pleased. | A footprint left long enough is soon stepped on by another. And another. And another. You spent so long catching up to the thieves who stole the %itemLower% that the circuitry of the world, ever busy, has covered their tracks. You've no hope of finding them now and %employer% will be most displeased. | The tracks of the %itemLower%'s thieves have gone dry. The last set of footprints you followed took you to a homestead, and they didn't look like the thieving sort, nor did they know of any such fellows. %employer% won't be happy about the loss of his goods, but there's little you can do here now.}
2b36c0855794279d35b6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]{你俯下身，让一把泥土从指间漏下。可那只是泥土，上面没有留下可供追踪的脚印。事实上，你已经很久没见到足迹了。%randombrother%在你身旁蹲下，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我想我们跟丢了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。%employer%不会高兴，可事已至此。 | 你已追查被盗的%itemLower%许久，如今线索彻底断了。沿途的百姓一无所知，地上也没有可供追踪的足迹。看来，%itemLower%是真的找不回来了。%employer%不会喜欢这个结果。 | 脚印留得太久，就会被别人的脚印覆盖。一重，又一重。你花了太长时间追赶偷走%itemLower%的窃贼，世间川流不息的人与事早已抹去了他们的踪迹。现在再无找到他们的希望，%employer%必然大为不满。 | 偷走%itemLower%的窃贼已经不见踪影。最后一串脚印把你引到一户农家，可那家人怎么看都不像窃贼，也没听说过这样一伙人。%employer%不会甘心丢了财物，但你在这里已无计可施。}

8411bb063c14b9057835.translation: 追猎造成恐慌的怪物，地点：

99577e1822aa7274dad4.source: A pack of ferocious direwolves on the hunt for prey.
99577e1822aa7274dad4.translation: 一群四处寻觅猎物的凶猛恐狼。

16dd19b035c53ef0842b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{While you wait for %employer% to explain what he needs your services for, you contemplate on how silent and eerie the whole settlement was when you first arrived. %employer% raises his voice %SPEECH_ON%This place is cursed by the gods and haunted by unearthly beasts! They come in the night with glowing red eyes and take lives at their whim. Most of our cattle is dead and I fear that once there are no more, we are next to be torn apart. The other day we sent our strongest lads out to find and kill the beasts but we haven't heard of them since.%SPEECH_OFF%He sighs deeply.%SPEECH_ON%Follow the tracks %direction% and hunt down and kill those creatures so that we can live in peace again! We are not wealthy, but all chipped in to pay for your services.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s looking out his window when you find him. There's a goblet in his hand - and there's nothing but silence outside. He turns to you, almost somber.%SPEECH_ON%When you came here, did you realize how quiet it was?%SPEECH_OFF%You remark that you did, but you're a sellsword who looks the part. It's just what you are accustomed to. %employer% nods and takes a drink.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, of course. Unfortunately, it isn't that people are afraid of you. Not this time. We have had people being attacked these past weeks. Beasts of some sort are on the loose, we know not what they are, but only who they take. We've pleaded with our lord, of course, but he has done nothing to help us...%SPEECH_OFF%His next drink is a long one. When he finishes, he turns to you, empty cup in hand.%SPEECH_ON%Would you go hunt these monsters down? Please, sellsword, help us.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s listening to the talk of a few peasants when you find him. When they see you, they quickly depart, leaving the man with a satchel in hand. He holds it up.%SPEECH_ON%There's crowns in here. Crowns that those people are giving me to give someone, anyone, to help us. People are disappearing, sellsword, and when they are found they're... not just dead, but... mangled. Mutilated. Everyone is too scared to go anywhere.%SPEECH_OFF%He stares into the sack, then looks to you.%SPEECH_ON%I do hope you are interested in this task.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% reading a scroll. He throws the paper at you and asks you to read off the names. The handwriting is difficult, but not moreso than the names themselves. You stop and apologize, stating you are not from these parts. The man nods and takes the scroll back.%SPEECH_ON%Tis alright, sellsword. If you were wondering, those were the names of men, women, and children who have passed in the last week.%SPEECH_OFF%Last week? There were a lot of names on that list. The man, seeming to read you, nods somberly.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, we are in a bad way. So many lives lost. We believe this to be the work of foul creatures, beasts beyond our ability to reason. Obviously, we'd like you to go find and destroy them. Would you be interested in such a task, mercenary?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s got a few dogs at his feet, all tuckered out with their tongues lolling.%SPEECH_ON%They've spent the past few days hunting for missing folks. Folks that are seemingly disappearing to the gods know where.%SPEECH_OFF%He leans down and pets one of the hounds, scratching it behind the ear. Usually, a dog would respond to that, but the poor thing barely even responds.%SPEECH_ON%The folks don't know what I know, though, which is that people ain't just disappearing... they're being taken. Horrible beasts are afoot, sellsword, and I need you to go after them. Hell, maybe you'll even find someone or two of the townsfolk, though I doubt it.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the mutts lets out a long, tired wheeze almost as if on cue. | %employer%'s got a satchel with a scroll attached, but the name written on the paper is not yours. He weighs it carefully, the lumps of coin curving about his fingers, their chink and chanks muted. He turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%You recognize that name?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%A week ago we sent the famed %randomnoble% %direction% of here to go hunt down some foul beasts that have been terrorizing the town and surrounding farmsteads for weeks. Do you know why this satchel has remained in my ownership?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and answer.%SPEECH_ON%Because he hasn't returned?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% nods and sets the satchel down. He sits on the edge of his table.%SPEECH_ON%Correct. Because he has not returned. Now, why do you think that is? I think it's because he's dead, but let's not be so negative. I think it's because the beasts out there require more. I think they require someone like you, sellsword. Would you be willing to help us now that this nobleman has failed?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% takes a book from his shelf. When he sets it on his table, dust or maybe even ash plume outward. He opens it up, thumbing slowly from page to page.%SPEECH_ON%Do you believe in monsters, sellsword? I'm asking honestly, as I believe you've had a better walk-about of this world than I.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and speak.%SPEECH_ON%More than just a belief, yes.%SPEECH_OFF%The man thumbs another page. He looks up at you.%SPEECH_ON%Well, we believe monsters have come to %townname%. We believe that's why people are going missing. Understand where this is going? I need you to find these 'make believe' creatures and kill them like any other. Are you interested?%SPEECH_OFF%}
16dd19b035c53ef0842b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你等着%employer%说明需要你做什么，不由想起刚到这里时，整个聚落那种诡异的寂静。%employer%提高了嗓门。%SPEECH_ON%这地方遭了诸神诅咒，有不属于人间的恶兽出没！它们眼里泛着红光，夜里出来，肆意夺人性命。我们的牲畜已经死了大半，我怕等牲畜死光，就轮到我们被撕成碎片了。前些天，我们派出最壮实的小伙子去搜杀那些野兽，可至今杳无音信。%SPEECH_OFF%他深深叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%请沿着踪迹往%direction%追，找到那些怪物，杀了它们，让我们重新过上安生日子！我们不富裕，但大伙都凑了钱，用来付你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正端着酒杯望向窗外，外面一片死寂。他转身看你，神情近乎哀伤。%SPEECH_ON%你来的时候，有没有发现这里安静得出奇？%SPEECH_OFF%你说确实如此，不过自己是个佣兵，长得也像个佣兵。这种冷清的场面，你早就习惯了。%employer%点点头，喝了一口酒。%SPEECH_ON%啊，那倒也是。可惜这次不是因为人们怕你。最近几周，总有人遭到袭击。外头有些野兽四处游荡，我们不知道它们是什么，只知道谁被它们带走了。我们当然向领主求过援，可他什么也没做……%SPEECH_OFF%这一次，他喝了很久。喝完后，他拿着空杯转向你。%SPEECH_ON%你愿意去猎杀这些怪物吗？求你了，佣兵，帮帮我们。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在听几个农民说话。那些人一看见你，就匆匆离开，留下他手拿着一个钱袋。他把钱袋举起来。%SPEECH_ON%这里头装的是克朗。是那些人交给我的钱，让我找个人来帮忙，谁都行。不断有人失踪，佣兵，等找到的时候，他们……不只是死了，而是……血肉模糊，肢体残缺。现在谁也不敢出门。%SPEECH_OFF%他盯着袋口，随后抬眼看你。%SPEECH_ON%我真希望你愿意接下这件差事。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在看一份卷轴。他把纸卷扔给你，叫你念出上面的名字。字迹很难辨认，名字却比字迹更难念。你停下来致歉，说自己不是本地人。他点点头，拿回卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%没关系，佣兵。你若好奇，上面列的是过去一周死去的人，男人、女人，还有孩子。%SPEECH_OFF%一周？那上面可有不少名字。他仿佛看穿了你的心思，沉重地点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，我们的处境很糟。死了太多人。我们觉得是某种恶兽干的，是些我们无法理解的怪物。我们当然希望你能找到它们，把它们除掉。你愿意接下这样的差事吗，佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%脚边趴着几条狗，全都累得吐着舌头。%SPEECH_ON%这几天，它们一直在搜寻失踪的人。那些人到底消失去了哪里，只有诸神知道。%SPEECH_OFF%他俯身摸了摸一条猎犬，挠挠它的耳后。平时狗总会有所回应，可这可怜的小东西几乎一点反应都没有。%SPEECH_ON%但有件事，别人还不知道，我却清楚。那些人不只是失踪……他们是被掳走了。外头有可怕的野兽出没，佣兵，我需要你去追杀它们。说不定，你还能找回一两个镇民，虽说我不抱什么指望。%SPEECH_OFF%一条杂毛狗疲惫地吐出一声长长的喘息，仿佛在应和他的话。 | %employer%拿着一个钱袋，袋上系着纸卷，写的却不是你的名字。他仔细掂量着，硬币隔着布袋硌出指间的轮廓，发出闷闷的叮当声。他转向你。%SPEECH_ON%这个名字，你认识吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇摇头。他继续说。%SPEECH_ON%有些恶兽已经骚扰镇子和周围的农庄好几个星期了。一周前，我们派出大名鼎鼎的%randomnoble%，往%direction%去猎杀它们。你知道这袋钱为什么还在我手里吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，答道。%SPEECH_ON%因为他还没回来？%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%点头，放下钱袋，在桌沿坐下。%SPEECH_ON%没错，因为他还没回来。那你觉得，他为什么没回来？我想他是死了。不过，先别把话说得这么丧气。我想是因为，对付那些野兽得要更有本事的人。得要你这样的人，佣兵。既然那位贵族没能办成，你愿意帮帮我们吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%从架上取下一本书。书一落桌，便扬起一团灰尘，也可能是灰烬。他翻开书，慢慢地一页页翻看。%SPEECH_ON%你相信世上有怪物吗，佣兵？我是真心在问。我想，你走过的地方总比我多。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头回答。%SPEECH_ON%当然，而且我可不只是相信而已。%SPEECH_OFF%他又翻过一页，抬眼看你。%SPEECH_ON%我们觉得，有怪物来到了%townname%。那些人失踪，多半就是这个缘故。明白我要说什么了吧？我需要你找到这些所谓凭空想象出来的东西，像宰别的活物一样宰了它们。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

d049220f89e9a85159d8.source: {What's this worth to you? | What is %townname% prepared to pay? | Let's talk pay.}
d049220f89e9a85159d8.translation: {这件事，你愿意出多少钱？ | %townname%打算付多少？ | 谈谈报酬吧。}

589574f2a8345f674344.source: {This doesn't sound like our kind of work. | I wish you luck, but we'll not be part of this.}
589574f2a8345f674344.translation: {听起来，这不是我们干的活儿。 | 祝你好运，但我们不掺和。}

b635b9672d9ee5224217.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{These aren't beasts at all, but men in wolf's clothing! Having seen the 'true' face of this evil, the men are quite relieved that your enemy is one they know all too well. | As you close in on the monsters, you realize that the foul creatures are not beasts at all, but humans in disguise! You know not why they played such a game of dress-up, but they're drawing weapons. As far as you're concerned, beast or man, they all die the same. | You stumble upon a man removing a wolf head off his shoulders. He glances at you, the disguise still in hand, then quickly puts it back on. You draw your sword.%SPEECH_ON%It's a little late to be playing pretend.%SPEECH_OFF%The slash of your weapon knocks the man's mask off and he stumbles backward. Before you can run him through, he takes off, sprinting toward a collection of similarly skulking fellow. They draw their weapons at the very sight of you. Whatever reason these idiots were playing dress up, it doesn't matter now. | You come across a dead beast with a few arrows stuck in its back. The damage does not seem lethal... and when you tip your sword across the creature's mane, the head tips right off, revealing a human beneath.%SPEECH_ON%Didja do that?%SPEECH_OFF%A voice breaks in from ahead. There stand a few men removing their disguises: that of the beasts you were after. The one in the lead raises his voice.%SPEECH_ON%Kill them! Kill them all!%SPEECH_OFF%Nope, these are still beasts, just of a softer sort.}
b635b9672d9ee5224217.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]{这根本不是什么野兽，而是一群披着狼皮的人！看清这些祸害的真面目后，弟兄们反倒松了口气：这样的敌人，他们再熟悉不过。 | 逼近那些怪物时，你才发现这些恶兽根本就不是野兽，而是乔装打扮的人！你不明白他们为何要玩这套把戏，但对方已经拔出了武器。对你来说，是兽是人都一样，砍下去照样会死。 | 你撞见一个男人正把狼头从肩上摘下来。他瞥了你一眼，伪装还拿在手中，随即又赶紧戴了回去。你拔出剑。%SPEECH_ON%现在才想装模作样，晚了点吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你挥剑打落他的头套，他踉跄着后退。还没等你一剑刺穿他，他就转身逃跑，冲向一群同样鬼鬼祟祟的家伙。那些人一看见你，便纷纷拔出武器。不管这些蠢货为什么乔装打扮，现在都无关紧要了。 | 你遇到一头死去的野兽，背上插着几支箭。那些伤口看起来并不足以致命……你用剑尖拨了拨它的鬃毛，整个脑袋竟翻落下来，露出底下的人头。%SPEECH_ON%你们干的？%SPEECH_OFF%前方有人喊话。几个男人站在那里，正脱下伪装——扮的正是你追猎的野兽。领头的那人高声下令。%SPEECH_ON%杀了他们！一个不留！%SPEECH_OFF%看来没错，还是一群畜生，只是皮肉软些罢了。}

7f63d2dc8100bc4755e9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_56.png[/img]{The beasts slain, you order the men to take their pelts as evidence. Your employer, %employer%, should be most happy to see them. | Having killed the foul creatures, you begin skinning and scalping them. Gruesome creatures require gruesome evidence. Your employer, %employer%, might not believe your work here otherwise. | With the battle over, you have the men start collecting pelts to take back to %employer%, your employer. | Your employer, %employer%, might not believe what happened here without evidence. You order the men to begin taking pelts, trophies, scalps, whatever might show off your victory here.}
7f63d2dc8100bc4755e9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_56.png[/img]{野兽已被杀死，你命令弟兄们剥下兽皮，带回去作证。雇主%employer%见到这些，想必会很高兴。 | 杀死这些恶兽后，你开始剥下它们的皮毛和头皮。如此骇人的怪物，总得拿出同样骇人的凭证，否则雇主%employer%未必肯相信你们的战绩。 | 战斗结束，你让弟兄们开始收集兽皮，带回去给雇主%employer%看。 | 要是没有凭证，雇主%employer%未必会相信这里发生的事。你命令弟兄们动手取下兽皮、头皮和其他战利品，凡是能证明此战告捷的，都带回去。}

cd494e0f18c8b9837a7a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{Your men take the fools' disguises lest your employer, %employer%, not believe your doings here. | Your employer might not believe what was going on here. You order your men to collect the disguises. %bro1%, stripping a mask off one of the slain, starts to wonder.%SPEECH_ON%So they dressed themselves up as the sort of thing to attract us, and now they're all dead. I hope they didn't think it a game.%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2% cleans his blade in the folds of one of the disguises.%SPEECH_ON%Well, if it were a game, I sure enjoyed playing it.%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother% nods at the slain.%SPEECH_ON%It's mighty likely that %employer% wouldn't believe a group of brigands were dressing up as beasts.%SPEECH_OFF%Agreeing, you order the men to begin collecting the masks and disguises as evidence. | You'll need evidence to show your employer, %employer%. These weren't the beasts you were looking for, but they do carry a lot of disguises that your employer would probably be most interested in seeing. One of the men wonders aloud.%SPEECH_ON%So what were they playing dress up for?%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2% folds some of the disguises over his arm as he goes about collecting them.%SPEECH_ON%Suicide by ceremony? Their dance and fun got our attention, after all.%SPEECH_OFF%He picks up one of the disguises only for the head of the dead to get slinged up with it. The sellsword laughs as he kicks the dead man's head out.}
cd494e0f18c8b9837a7a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]{弟兄们拿走这些蠢货的伪装，免得雇主%employer%不相信你们在这里做了什么。 | 雇主未必肯相信这里发生的事。你命令弟兄们收集那些伪装。%bro1%从一具尸体上扯下头套，琢磨起来。%SPEECH_ON%这么说，他们偏偏扮成了能把我们招来的东西，现在全死光了。但愿他们没把这当儿戏。%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2%用一件伪装衣上的褶皱擦拭刀刃。%SPEECH_ON%要真是场游戏，我倒是玩得挺开心。%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother%朝那些尸体点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%要说是一伙强盗扮成了野兽，%employer%八成不会信。%SPEECH_OFF%你赞同他的看法，命令弟兄们收集头套和伪装，带回去作证。 | 你得带些凭证给雇主%employer%看。这些人虽不是你要猎杀的野兽，身上的伪装却不少，雇主多半很有兴趣看一看。一名弟兄忍不住问。%SPEECH_ON%那他们干吗要扮成这样？%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2%边收集伪装，边把它们叠搭在胳膊上。%SPEECH_ON%办场仪式，给自己送终？反正他们又蹦又闹，把咱们招来了。%SPEECH_OFF%他提起一件伪装，死者的脑袋也跟着被兜了起来。这佣兵笑着一脚把脑袋踢了出去。}

cb4005def215e903cb84.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_131.png[/img]{The fight over, you walk to a dead Nachzehrer and take a knee. Were it not for a gate of ill-shapen teeth, you could easily fit your head into the beast's oversized maw. Instead of admiring the dental failures at hand, you instead take out a knife and saw its head off, ripping through a very tough outer layer of skin before, surprisingly, easily cutting through the muscles and tendons. You raise the head up and order the %companyname% follow suit. %employer% will be expecting some proof, after all. | The Nachzehrers's dead body looks more rock than beast as it lays flat and unmoving. Flies are already coupling inside its mouth, sowing life on the frothy remains of death. You order %randombrother% to take its head, for %employer% will be expecting proof. | Dead Nachzehrers are scattered about. You take a knee beside one and look at its mouth. Whatever was in its lungs is still issuing forth, a wheeze burping out. Putting a cloth to your nose, you use the other hand to chop away at its neck with a blade, cutting off the head and holding it up. You order a few brothers to follow suit for %employer% will be expecting proof. | A dead Nachzehrer is an interesting specimen to behold. You can't help but wonder where it falls on the natural spectrum. Shaped like crude men, muscled like some beastly thing, and its head is gnarled with features born out of a wildman's nightmares. You order the %companyname% to start collecting the heads of the foul things for %employer% will surely be wanting proof.}
cb4005def215e903cb84.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_131.png[/img]{战斗结束，你走到一只死去的食尸鬼身边，单膝蹲下。要不是那排歪七扭八的牙齿挡着，你的脑袋都能轻松塞进它大得离谱的嘴里。你无心继续欣赏这副歪牙，抽出小刀，开始割它的脑袋。外层的皮韧得很，可一旦割开，里面的肌肉和筋腱却出奇地容易切断。你提起脑袋，命令%companyname%的弟兄们照着做。毕竟，%employer%总得看到点凭证。 | 食尸鬼的尸体平摊在地上，一动不动，看着更像石头而非野兽。苍蝇已经在它嘴里交配，将新生命播撒在死者冒沫的残躯上。你命令%randombrother%割下它的脑袋，毕竟%employer%会要你拿出凭证。 | 食尸鬼的尸体散落各处。你在其中一具身边单膝蹲下，查看它的嘴。肺里残存的气体还在往外冒，挤出一阵嗬嗬的怪声。你拿块布捂住鼻子，另一只手持刀砍向它的脖子，割下脑袋提起来。你让几个弟兄照着做，毕竟%employer%会要你拿出凭证。 | 死去的食尸鬼倒是个值得端详的标本。你不禁好奇，这东西在天地万物之中究竟算哪一类。身形像粗糙拼凑出来的人，筋肉却像野兽，扭曲的头颅仿佛出自荒野人的噩梦。你命令%companyname%开始收集这些恶兽的头颅，毕竟%employer%肯定想看到凭证。}

24cc32834b7a228b6495.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_123.png[/img]{You order your men to scour the field and collect as many parts as they can of the spiders. A few make the mistake of touching the hairs on the webknechts' legs, leaving them scratching quickly forming rashes. | The spiders litter the field like they would the corner of an attic. In death, they look like giant gloves stiffly clasped together. You have the men wrench the legs apart to harvest evidence of the bestial remains. | The mercenaries scour the field, hacking and sawing at the spiders' stiff remains to take back to %employer%. Even in death, the webknechts are ghastly, looking only a moment away from flinching back to life and wrapping themselves around the nearest breathing animal. Their horrifying features and surreal size does not stop some sellswords from dancing around, clicking their tongues and hissing, and all around preying upon the phobias of those less inclined to go near the damned things.}
24cc32834b7a228b6495.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_123.png[/img]{你命令弟兄们搜索战场，尽量多收集些蜘蛛残骸。几个人不小心碰到巨蛛腿上的茸毛，皮肤很快起了疹子，痒得他们抓挠不止。 | 蜘蛛尸体遍布战场，就像阁楼角落里常见的死蜘蛛。死后蜷起的蛛腿，让它们看起来像一双双僵硬地扣在一起的巨型手套。你让弟兄们掰开蛛腿，从这些怪物的残骸上取下东西，带回去作为凭证。 | 佣兵们四处搜寻，劈砍、锯割蜘蛛僵硬的残骸，准备带回去给%employer%看。巨蛛死后依然面目可憎，仿佛下一刻就会抽搐着活过来，缠住离它最近的活物。然而，这副骇人的模样和大得不合常理的身躯，丝毫没妨碍几个佣兵蹦来跳去，咂舌发出咔哒声，又嘶嘶地学起蜘蛛，专门吓唬那些本就不敢靠近这些鬼东西的人。}

d601d20f18bacf837685.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You return to %employer% and lay one of the pelts clear across his desk. Its limp claws rap against the side of the oak. The man lifts one, then lets it fall again.%SPEECH_ON%I see you've found those beasts we were looking for.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him of the battle. He seems most pleased, taking a small wooden chest out from his bookshelf and handing it over.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns, as agreed upon. The people of %townname% deserve the reprieve you have given them from such horrors.%SPEECH_OFF% | When you step in %employer%'s room he recoils almost instantly.%SPEECH_ON%What in the hells of the gods is in your hand, sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF%You hold up the nape of a pelt. Black blood ropes out from the neck and splatters the floor.%SPEECH_ON%One of the beasts you were looking for. If you need evidence of the rest, I got those waiting outside...%SPEECH_OFF%The man holds his hand up, staying you.%SPEECH_ON%One is sufficient for my belief. Very good work, sellsword. Your pay will be with %randomname%, a councilman you probably passed in the halls. He's got the ugly mug on him and he'll be carrying the %reward_completion% crowns, as promised.%SPEECH_OFF%The man takes another look at the beast then slowly shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%May the dead and their survivors find peace in the passing of those foul creatures.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes your return with a goblet of wine.%SPEECH_ON%Drink up, beast-slayer.%SPEECH_OFF%You're curious as to how he already knows of your success. He waves off your curiosity.%SPEECH_ON%I've many eyes and ears in this land - not spies, of course, but the common folk has a big mouth. I should know, I am one! You did well on this one, sellsword, so have a sip. It's mighty fine wine.%SPEECH_OFF%It's alright. The reward of %reward_completion% crowns you walk out with is far better, though. %employer% stops you.%SPEECH_ON%Just so you know, mercenary, those beasts killed some good men and women out there. Those people might be scared of you, being the sellsword that you are, but they are eternally grateful all the same.%SPEECH_OFF%You weigh the crowns. Quite grateful, yes... | %employer% takes a few steps back.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, uh, I see you've killed the beasts. That's a mighty fine pelt you got there.%SPEECH_OFF%You drop what you've brought: a thick, heavy mane of beastly origin collapsing into a pile of fur and flesh. The man, almost too scared to get close, tosses you a satchel.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns, as agreed upon. I will go to the people and tell them of your success. Finally, we can be at peace.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s sitting at his table, legs up over a corner. His eyes are staring at the ceiling, the corners of his face pinched with withered folds. He looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%Welcome back. I've been getting word of your doings... of your battles with the monsters.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, looking around for your reward. The man shows you the door.%SPEECH_ON%%randomname%, a fellow councilman of %townname%, has your payment outside. %reward_completion% crowns as agreed upon. And the people of %townname%, fear you though they may, are blessed all the same by your arrival here. Thank you, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s feeding one of his dogs when you return. The mutt drops its bone to sniff at what you've brought. The man points at the pelt.%SPEECH_ON%What kind of foul thing is that?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and toss it onto his table. The dog pokes its nose at one of the claws, growls, then begins to lick it. %employer% smiles briefly, but then goes to his bookshelf, picking up a wooden chest and handing it to you.%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion% crowns, was it? You should know that you've brought peace to the people of %townname%.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Does their happiness also come in crowns?%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% frowns at your greedy humor.%SPEECH_ON%No, it does not. Have a good day, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d601d20f18bacf837685.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你回到%employer%那里，把一张兽皮摊开，铺满了他的书桌。软塌塌的兽爪敲在橡木桌侧。他拎起一只爪子，又任它垂落。%SPEECH_ON%看来，你找到了我们要找的那些野兽。%SPEECH_OFF%你向他讲述了战斗经过。他听得十分满意，从书架上取下一个小木箱，交给你。%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion%克朗，按约定的数目。%townname%的百姓受够了那些怪物的惊吓，也该享享你为他们换来的太平了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你刚走进%employer%的房间，他就猛地往后一缩。%SPEECH_ON%诸神在上，你手里拿的到底是什么鬼东西，佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF%你揪住兽皮后颈，将它提起来。黑血从断颈处成缕淌下，溅了一地。%SPEECH_ON%你要找的野兽之一。要是还想验验别的，都在外头……%SPEECH_OFF%他抬手制止了你。%SPEECH_ON%这一只就足够让我相信了。干得好，佣兵。钱在%randomname%那里，一位议员，你刚才经过走廊时应该见过。他长得很丑，身上带着说好的%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%他又看了那野兽一眼，缓缓摇头。%SPEECH_ON%但愿这些恶兽的死，能让死者安息，让生者得到慰藉。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%端着一杯葡萄酒迎接你的归来。%SPEECH_ON%喝吧，屠兽勇士。%SPEECH_OFF%你好奇他怎么已经知道你得手了。他摆摆手，打消你的疑惑。%SPEECH_ON%这片地方到处都有我的耳目。当然，不是什么密探，只是老百姓嘴巴大。我再清楚不过，毕竟我也是老百姓！这次干得漂亮，佣兵，喝一口吧。这酒好得很。%SPEECH_OFF%酒还凑合。不过，比起这杯酒，你带走的%reward_completion%克朗可要好得多。%employer%叫住你。%SPEECH_ON%有件事你该知道，佣兵。那些野兽害死过不少好人。百姓也许怕你，毕竟你是个拿钱杀人的，但他们一样会永远感激你。%SPEECH_OFF%你掂了掂钱袋。嗯，确实很感激…… | %employer%往后退了几步。%SPEECH_ON%啊，呃，看来你把那些野兽杀掉了。好一张漂亮的兽皮。%SPEECH_OFF%你把带来的东西扔在地上：厚重的兽鬃夹着皮肉，塌成一堆。他几乎吓得不敢靠近，只朝你抛来一个钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%%reward_completion%克朗，按说好的数目。我会把你成功的消息告诉百姓。终于能过上安生日子了。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%坐在桌前，双腿搭着桌角，目光望向天花板，脸颊两侧挤着干瘪的褶子。他转眼看向你。%SPEECH_ON%欢迎回来。你的消息已经传到我这儿了……你和那些怪物交战的事。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，四处瞧着，想找到自己的报酬。他朝门口示意。%SPEECH_ON%%randomname%，也是%townname%的议员，就在外头，钱在他手里。说好的%reward_completion%克朗。%townname%的百姓也许怕你，但你的到来仍是他们的福气。谢谢你，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你回来时，%employer%正在喂狗。那条杂毛狗丢下骨头，凑过来嗅你带来的东西。他指着兽皮问。%SPEECH_ON%这是哪种该死的怪物？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，把它扔到桌上。狗拿鼻子拱了拱一只兽爪，低吼一声，接着又舔了起来。%employer%短暂地笑了笑，随即走到书架前，取下一个木箱递给你。%SPEECH_ON%说好的是%reward_completion%克朗，对吧？你该知道，你为%townname%的百姓换来了太平。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%他们的喜悦也能折成克朗吗？%SPEECH_OFF%听到你这贪财的玩笑，%employer%皱起眉头。%SPEECH_ON%不能。祝你今天愉快，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%}

5e31c29286b8ca23b019.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes your return.%SPEECH_ON%I've already heard the, I suppose, splendid news. I can believe it, though. A bunch of brigands playing dress up. Wolves in... wolf clothing?%SPEECH_OFF%He grins at you, expecting a laugh at his cheesy joke. You shrug. He shrugs, too.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, well. Your payment, %reward_completion% crowns, is waiting for you outside. I will tell the people of %townname% that the monsters they fear are but men.%SPEECH_OFF% | You return with the costumes of the foolish brigands. %employer% tilts the disguises left to right.%SPEECH_ON%Interesting. They're very well done. I'd almost say the brigands were clever here.%SPEECH_OFF%He picks up one of the masks and looks just about ready to try it on, then pauses as though he shouldn't do this with an audience. He puts it back down and smiles at you.%SPEECH_ON%Well, anyway, sellsword... good work. You'll have %reward_completion% crowns waiting for you outside with one of %townname%'s councilmen. He'll be looking out for you. Now, the people of %townname% can bury our dead and finally be at peace.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% reels in laughter at your reveal.%SPEECH_ON%Men?
