The nobleman takes it by the legs and heaves it into a cage of barking dogs. The poultry flaps madly, bouncing along a sea of jawing canines before suddenly getting snatched down. It's torn to shreds in mere moments. %employer% turns to you, brushing a feather off your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%So, do we have a deal?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you into his room which has, it appears, been flipped into an adhoc war room. Commanders stand dutifully over a battle map, pushing military tokens back and forth and arguing about the results of the simulacrums. %employer% brings you to a side. He turns the rings on his fingers as he talks.%SPEECH_ON%Commander %commander% needs help sieging %objective%. The birds tell me he is close to a breakthrough, but men such as yourself are needed to really push it through. Go and help him and you will have %reward% crowns waiting here upon your return.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9e0078b627ddf6e2b98e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%招呼你进屋。桌上铺着地图，点缀着代表军队的小木徽记，仿佛那些军队正穿梭于战火中的世界。贵族特意指向其中一处。%SPEECH_ON%我要你去这里，找%commander%谈谈。他正在围攻当地的工事，需要你帮忙完成最后的强攻准备。报酬是%reward%克朗，我想应该绰绰有余，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的作战室，围着地图的一群将军和指挥官顿时安静下来。%employer%招手让你进去，把你带到一旁。军官们瞪了你一阵，才慢慢回头继续讨论战略。%employer%说明了情况。%SPEECH_ON%我派指挥官%commander%围攻%objective%的工事。他还差一些人手，就能发动强攻，你正好补上。去帮他，我会给你%reward%克朗，报酬绝对足够。听起来很公平，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你还没进%employer%的房间，他便突然走出来，抓住你的肩，带你沿走廊来到窗边。他望着庭院，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%不必让我的将军们见到你。他们觉得你这一行不光彩。有时候，雇佣兵也得讲点政治分寸。%SPEECH_OFF%你摇摇头，简短答道。%SPEECH_ON%我们杀人，他们也杀人。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然，佣兵。可将来，你也许会来杀我们。这让我的将军们夜不能寐，有人担忧，有人愤怒。我明白这个世界的现实，所以睡得像婴儿一样香，懂吗？好了，谈生意。我要你去%objective%，协助指挥官%commander%强攻当地工事。报酬是%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%与你见面，带你来到花园。局势如此，他却显得出奇地安闲。他轻抚一株番茄藤，开始说话。%SPEECH_ON%战争真是件可怕的事。就在我们说话的时候，有人正因我说过的几句话而死。就这么简单。我不想滥用手里的权力。%SPEECH_OFF%你把拇指插进腰带，答道。%SPEECH_ON%为了我的弟兄，但愿你确实不会。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%点点头，抓住一个番茄。藤蔓绷紧，随后啪地断开。他咬了一口，又点点头，仿佛自己真正向往的，是园丁的生活。%SPEECH_ON%我有个指挥官，叫%commander%，正在围攻%objective%。他正敲定强攻计划。我知道“强攻”这个词让人不安，但他已经筹划了很久。现在只差最后一点人手，就能确保顺利动手。去找他，帮他，我会付你%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%向你打了招呼，带你来到一张作战地图前，指向%objective%。%SPEECH_ON%指挥官%commander%正在围攻那里的工事。我需要些硬汉帮他发动强攻。去帮他，我会付你%reward%克朗。听着不错，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，看到一群指挥官围着地图。纸上布满代表贵族军队的小棋子，一人用木棒推着木马，越过画得粗糙的平原。%employer%欢迎你的到来，不过，是他的一名将军把你拉到一旁，解释他们的要求：

指挥官%commander%目前正在%objective%围城。守军即将崩溃，但他担心援军正在赶来。因此，他想在援军抵达前发动最后的强攻。你去那里，帮指挥官完成所需之事，就能拿到%reward%克朗。 | 你停在%employer%的门外，问自己：这辈子，非得掺和这种破事吗？突然，一名仆人捧着钱箱撞到了你。他问%employer%是否在里面，因为给佣兵的%reward%克朗已经备好了。你立刻抢到仆人前面，走进房间。%employer%热情地欢迎你，解释说，指挥官%commander%正在围攻%objective%，很快就能打开局面，只需再加一点人手，便能一举推进。%employer%装模作样地想了想，最后补充道。%SPEECH_ON%这桩差事，给你%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%你也装出对这个数目颇为惊讶的样子。 | 你不清楚%employer%的战事是否顺利，也不知道他的将军们在这种时候是否总如此焦虑。看他们的样子，宁愿扑到自己的剑上，也不想再盯着作战地图多看一秒。%employer%坐在房间角落，旁边是火炉，还有一名捧着酒壶的仆人。贵族招手让你过去，开始说道。%SPEECH_ON%别理那些愁眉苦脸的家伙。战事顺利，一切都好。为了让你明白有多好，我要你去%objective%找指挥官%commander%，因为他对那座该死工事的围攻，很快就要结束了。胜利近在眼前，你只要帮我拿到手！%reward%克朗，怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进%employer%的房间，发现贵族深陷在一张看起来很舒服的椅子里。两条大狗睡在脚边，腿上趴着一只呼噜作响的猫。他本人也睡得死沉，鼾声如雷，伸出的胳膊竟还紧攥着高脚杯，酒正往下滴。一名身着将军服饰的人招手，让你到房间另一头。%SPEECH_ON%别打扰大人。战争让他劳心伤神。听着，我接了命令，也带着给你的安排。我们需要你去%objective%，协助指挥官%commander%围攻那里的工事。就这些。%SPEECH_OFF%你问起报酬，将军的脸立刻沉了。%SPEECH_ON%对。报酬。当然。我奉命许给你%reward%克朗。希望这足以酬谢你……光荣的效劳。%SPEECH_OFF%最后几个字，似乎说得他十分痛苦。显然，他受命尽可能保持客气。 | %employer%的一名将军在外面的走廊与你见面。%SPEECH_ON%大人事务繁忙。%SPEECH_OFF%他把卷轴按到你胸前。你展开阅读，文书上说，指挥官%commander%正在围攻%objective%，需要支援。毫无疑问，这就是%companyname%该出场的地方。你抬头看向他，他低声咕哝，咬着牙挤出一句话。%SPEECH_ON%你的报酬是%reward%克朗，尊贵的佣兵阁下。%SPEECH_OFF%最后那称呼，听着像事先被人教过。 | 你找到%employer%，他带你来到私人犬舍，一边走，一边给狗丢些碎食。%SPEECH_ON%战事好极了。这简直是我做过最伟大的事，整件事都让我无比愉快。%SPEECH_OFF%他挠挠一条杂毛狗的耳后，又让它舔自己的手指。%SPEECH_ON%不过，也并非事事都尽如人意。我要你去%objective%，协助正在主持围城的指挥官%commander%。你的帮助，会得到%reward%克朗的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%一名仆人抱着活鸡跑来。贵族抓住鸡腿，将它扔进一笼狂吠的狗中。鸡拼命扑翅，在一片乱咬的犬口上方颠簸，突然被拽了下去，顷刻撕得粉碎。%employer%转向你，拂去你肩上的一根羽毛。%SPEECH_ON%那么，成交吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%欢迎你进入房间。这里显然已被临时改成作战室，指挥官们尽职地站在地图旁，来回推动兵棋，争论推演的结果。%employer%把你带到一旁，一边转着手上的戒指，一边说道。%SPEECH_ON%指挥官%commander%围攻%objective%，需要帮助。我的小鸟说，他离突破只差一步，但要真正迈过去，还得有你这样的人。去帮他，等你回来，这里就有%reward%克朗等着你。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1164788f49fe1e781e0d.source: How many crowns, did you say?

f30d9ab1724d656083af.source: {This isn't worth it. | We have other obligations. | I won't grind the company in some siege.}
f30d9ab1724d656083af.translation: {不值得。 | 我们另有约定在身。 | 我不会把战团耗在围城战里。}

3ab5f0f2f04a115c4e0f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%commander% greets you at the outskirts of his siege city. He's got a troop of horsemen with him and there's an awfully sour look on his face. He quickly explains the situation.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, you have most excellent timing. My scouts have just reported that reinforcements are coming to lift the siege on %objective%. We need to either attack, or try and burn this damned place down and smoke them out that way. Won't be much to take over if we go that route, though.%SPEECH_OFF%Strangely enough, the commander actually looks at you for ideas. | %objective% has been surrounded by %commander%'s men, but it is the besiegers who seem more on edge than the defenders. %commander% himself draws you into his tent. He knuckles the table as he explains what is going on.%SPEECH_ON%My scouts have spotted a force coming to lift the siege. We do not have enough men, much less the energy, to fight them off. We can either launch an assault now, or load our catapults with fire and burn that damned place to the ground. The defenders will no doubt come out, but there won't be much to salvage out of the ruins.%SPEECH_OFF%And then, shockingly, the commander looks up and asks.%SPEECH_ON%What do you think we should do, sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF% | When you come to %commander%'s tent, him and his lieutenants are standing around a map and your presence brings a quick end to an argument. The commander points at you.%SPEECH_ON%Mercenary! We've gotten word that reinforcements are coming to lift the siege and we've not the men to fight it off. We either assault %objective% or scorch earth this hellhole, smoke the defenders out with fire, and then take whatever ruins remain. My lieutenants are divided on the issue. What say you have the final vote?%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenants grumble, but are oddly alright with leaving this decision in the hands of a sellsword.}
3ab5f0f2f04a115c4e0f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%commander%在围城营地外围迎接你。他带着一队骑兵，脸色难看得很，随即向你说明局势。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你来得正好。斥候刚刚报告，有援军正赶来解除%objective%之围。我们得立刻进攻，或者干脆烧了这鬼地方，把他们熏出来。不过真要这么干，拿到手的也剩不下多少了。%SPEECH_OFF%奇怪的是，指挥官居然望向你，等你出主意。 | %commander%的部下已经包围%objective%，可围城的人看起来比守军还紧张。%commander%亲自把你拉进帐篷，指节抵着桌面，说明情况。%SPEECH_ON%斥候发现有军队正赶来解围。我们人手不足，更没精力击退他们。要么现在发动强攻，要么给投石机装上火弹，把这该死的地方烧成平地。守军肯定会出来，可废墟里也剩不下多少能收用的东西了。%SPEECH_OFF%接着，指挥官竟抬头问道。%SPEECH_ON%你觉得该怎么办，佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你来到%commander%的帐篷时，他正和副官们围着地图争论。你的出现让争吵戛然而止。指挥官指向你。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！消息说有援军正赶来解围，我们没足够的人手去挡。要么强攻%objective%，要么把这鬼地方烧成焦土，用火把守军熏出来，再接收剩下的废墟。我的副官们各执一词，不如由你投下决定性的一票，如何？%SPEECH_OFF%副官们低声抱怨，却奇怪地接受了把这个决定交给一名佣兵。}

94bc8c409af83d716302.source: I say we do a full assault on the castle.
94bc8c409af83d716302.translation: 依我看，应该全力强攻城堡。

9538925e7a11dc1cf556.source: I say we rain down fire on the castle and smoke them out.
9538925e7a11dc1cf556.translation: 依我看，应该向城堡投下火雨，把他们熏出来。

6768585d128ede45a130.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%commander% has given the order attack.

 {The %companyname% and a contingent of the nobleman's soldiers are to assault the front gate. You all stack up underneath the hood of a battering ram that's more shanty on wheels than a compelling war machine. With all arms on the rowbars, you push the ram forward. The roof rattles with a series of ponk-ponk-ponks as arrows riddle across it. You look up to see a few arrowheads have pierced through. When you get to the gate, you order the men to heave the ram backward, and then on command they let it go.

Groaning with heavy oaken deliberation, the ram sails forward and slams against the gate. It fractures in the middle and through the gap you can see %objective%'s defenders waiting on the other side for you. Another order, another ramming. This time it batters straight through the gate, breaking the hinges and causing each door to fall away in a spray of splinters and metal. Arms at the ready, you and all the men rush through to the other side. | With a retinue of the commander's men, the %companyname% pushes a hooded battering ram toward the gates of %objective%. A few defenders bark down at you with jeers.%SPEECH_ON%{Aren't you going to take us out to dinner first? | Hmm, nice long ram you got there. Trying to make up for something? | Come and get it ya ugly cunts. | Hope yer praying to the old gods underneath that little roof of yours.}%SPEECH_OFF%Their barbs go quiet as you bump against the gate and, with one swing of the ram, blow it apart. Your men quickly charge through the opening. | Taking a few of the commander's men, you and the %companyname% push a battering ram toward the gate of %objective%. The rooftop bumbles and rattles, disturbingly appearing more shanty than shield. You pray it holds. Arrows plock above while others ricochet with sharp scratches of metal across wood. As you get ever closer to %objective%'s gate, the arrows become rocks, cracking heavily against the war machine's hood. %randombrother% looks over the ram, laughing.%SPEECH_ON%Farkin' hell, man.%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly a horrid hiss surrounds everyone as though you'd pitched yourself into a den of vipers. All becomes shade as hot oil runs off the sides of the roof. A stream of it pours down a nobleman's back and he cries out, falling forward and becoming a screaming golem of black sludge. You hurriedly order the men to start ramming. Thankfully, it only takes one swing of the ram to blow the gate of %objective% wide open. Your men quickly rush through the opening to battle what few defenders are around to meet you.} | An order to assault %objective% comes down the line. You ready the %companyname%. Your men and %commander%'s push a battering ram toward the fortification's front gate. Arrows sail through the sky, blinkering in the light before whistling into the waves of attackers. Men fall aside in silent collapses, others go down clutching their wounds.

 The front gate is quickly bashed open and your men pour through the gap and into a courtyard where some of %objective%'s defenders await. | %commander% gives the order to begin an assault. Your company and his army rush the fortifications, a barrage of siege shots sailing overhead like a darkly hailstorm. The walls are battered and the defenders kept ducking as %commander%'s archers keep the pressure on. You manage to push a battering ram to the front gate and swiftly knock it open. As the %companyname% rushes through, the defenders of %objective% organize themselves in the courtyard to meet you. | The order to assault %objective%'s fortifications comes down the line. Preparations render an apocalyptic scene of a sky darkened with siege shot and arrows. Fires pipe over the walls of %objective% and you see %commander%'s men staging ladders against the crenelations and fighting their way up and in. Meanwhile, you and your men trundle beneath the hood of a battering ram, pushing it to a front gate and quickly knocking it open. As you rush in, defenders fill the courtyard and prepare to fight. | %commander% gives an order to assault %objective%'s fortifications. The assault goes like this: the sky darkens with exchanges of arrows, rattling rains that fly past and ricochet off one another. Siege shots hurtle through the sky like cold comets before bouldering into walls and towers. Defenders fight to push ladders off the crenelations. Attackers climb the ladders, the highest man holding up a shield, the man beneath him stabbing forth with a pike. You and the %companyname% push a rickety battering ram to the front gate, largely left alone under the cover of all this chaos.

 When the front gate is bashed open, you and your men rush through just in time to meet a group of defenders who have assembled there. All around the surrounding walls you can see %commander%'s men desperately fighting for control. | Unfortunately, %commander% sees fit to take the fortifications of %objective% head on. You and the %companyname% are charged with taking a battering ram to the front gate. As you push the siege machine through the mud, you notice a man with a steaming cauldron waiting for you just over the gate. You glance around to see soldiers carrying ladders start rushing the walls. They quickly climb up and start battling. When you look back forward, the defender with the burning oil is gone, but there's a pair of legs sticking out of the cauldron.

 There is no issue bashing open the front gate and rushing in. You are quickly met by an assembly of defenders while all around the surrounding walls %commander%'s men keep on fighting.}
6768585d128ede45a130.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%commander%下达了进攻命令。

{%companyname%和一队贵族士兵负责攻打正门。众人挤在攻城槌的顶棚下。与其说它是件像样的攻城兵器，不如说是装了轮子的破棚屋。所有人抓住横杆，合力把攻城槌向前推。箭矢密密麻麻地钉在顶棚上，发出一连串砰砰声。你抬头看去，已有几枚箭头穿透了木板。来到门前，你命令众人将槌身拉向后方，再一声令下，齐齐放手。

沉重的橡木槌呻吟着向前荡去，猛撞城门。门板从中央裂开，透过缝隙，你看见%objective%的守军正在另一边等着。再下一道命令，再撞一次。这回攻城槌径直破门而入，撞断铰链，两扇门在飞溅的木屑与金属碎片中倒下。你和所有人拿好武器，冲向另一边。 | %companyname%与指挥官派来的士兵一起，将带顶棚的攻城槌推向%objective%的城门。几名守军朝下高声嘲弄。%SPEECH_ON%{不先请我们吃顿饭吗？ | 嗯，这根槌可真够长的。想拿它弥补点什么？ | 来啊，你们这些丑逼，进来领死。 | 躲在那小棚子底下，可得好好向旧神祈祷啊。}%SPEECH_OFF%攻城槌抵住城门，猛撞一下便将门撞碎，嘲骂声戛然而止。弟兄们迅速从缺口冲了进去。 | 你带着%companyname%和指挥官派来的几个士兵，将攻城槌推向%objective%的城门。顶棚颠簸作响，与其说是护罩，不如说是破棚子，怎么看都不让人放心。你祈祷它能撑住。箭矢在头顶砰砰落下，有的弹飞，金属刮过木头，发出尖锐声响。越靠近%objective%的城门，落下的箭便越少，转而变成石头，重重砸在攻城槌的顶棚上。%randombrother%隔着槌身看过来，笑了一声。%SPEECH_ON%真他妈见鬼了。%SPEECH_OFF%突然，骇人的嘶嘶声笼罩众人，仿佛一头闯进毒蛇窝。热油沿顶棚两侧流下，四周顿时暗了。一股油淋上贵族士兵的后背，他惨叫着向前扑倒，变成一团裹着黑色黏液、不断尖叫的人形。你急忙命令众人开始撞门。幸好，只撞了一下，%objective%的城门便轰然洞开。弟兄们迅速冲过缺口，迎战赶来阻拦的少量守军。} | 攻打%objective%的命令沿队列传来。你让%companyname%做好准备，与%commander%的士兵一起，将攻城槌推向要塞正门。箭矢掠过天空，在光线中一闪，随后呼啸着落入进攻的人潮。有人无声倒下，有人捂着伤口栽倒。

正门很快被撞开，弟兄们从缺口涌进庭院，那里已有一些%objective%的守军等着迎战。 | %commander%下令进攻。你的战团和他的军队冲向工事，攻城器械射出的弹石从头顶飞过，仿佛一场漆黑的冰雹。城墙不断受击，%commander%的弓箭手也持续压制，逼得守军纷纷低头躲避。你们成功把攻城槌推到正门，迅速撞开。%companyname%冲入缺口时，%objective%的守军正在庭院里集结，准备迎战。 | 攻打%objective%防御工事的命令沿队列传来。进攻的序幕犹如末日降临，弹石和箭矢遮暗了天空。火焰从%objective%的城墙后腾起，你看见%commander%的士兵将云梯架上垛口，边打边往上爬，攻入墙内。与此同时，你和弟兄们躲在顶棚下，推着攻城槌缓缓前行，抵达正门后很快将它撞开。你们冲进去时，守军已经挤满庭院，准备战斗。 | %commander%下令攻打%objective%的工事。进攻就这样展开：双方箭矢往来交错，遮暗天空，像哗哗作响的雨幕，彼此擦过、撞开。攻城弹石如冰冷的彗星划过长空，轰进城墙与塔楼。守军拼命把云梯从垛口推开，攻城者则奋力攀爬，最上面的人举盾遮挡，下面的人用长枪向前刺击。你和%companyname%将摇摇欲坠的攻城槌推到正门，借着这片混乱，几乎没受到注意。

城门撞开后，你和弟兄们冲了进去，恰好迎上一群已经集结的守军。四周城墙上，%commander%的士兵仍在拼死争夺。 | 遗憾的是，%commander%认为应该正面强攻%objective%的工事。你和%companyname%奉命将攻城槌推到正门。攻城器械在泥地里前行，你注意到门楼上有个人守着一口冒热气的大锅，正等你们过去。你环顾四周，看见扛着云梯的士兵开始冲向城墙，迅速攀上梯子，展开厮杀。再向前看时，那名准备泼滚油的守军已经不见了，大锅里却朝天伸出两条腿。

撞开正门、冲进堡内，都没遇到什么麻烦。很快，一群守军迎了上来，而四周城墙上，%commander%的士兵仍在继续战斗。}

b1ba2d860c5124424dc4.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_68.png[/img]{A line of archers poke their arrowheads into bundled cloth and dip them in pitch. As they hold the arrows out, a young boy runs across with a torch to set them all alight. The commander holds his hand up, the archers raise their fiery weapons. He lowers his hand, the bowmen let loose. Fire arrows sail into the sky, crackling and hissing before going quiet and dimly seen. They fall over the fortification and at first that's all that seems to happen. A soldier calls out and points at some smoke starting to rise. Soon, fire licking up into the sky. A few minutes later and the front gate bursts open, ashen and smoky men rushing out like golems of the hells.

 %commander% raises his arm again, but this time there's a sword in the hand.%SPEECH_ON%CHARGE!%SPEECH_OFF% | Catapults, ballistae, and archers launch fire over the walls of %objective%. The shots whistle and hiss as their capes of fire stretch across the sky.

 The fortification is soon brimming with an orange hue. Smoke bubbles in gobs of choking black. Fingers of fire slowly crawl up after them. The front gate rattles once, twice, then bursts open. Blackened and coughing men pour out, clambering over one another for fresh air. %commander% draws his sword and points it toward the enemy.%SPEECH_ON%No prisoners!%SPEECH_OFF%The defenders of %objective% seem to have heard this as they quickly rush to formation. For a moment, you wonder if perhaps they once had a white flag of surrender somewhere amongst their blackened shapes. | An order comes down to set %objective% ablaze. You watch as %commander%'s war camp sets the skies alight in a hellstorm of fiery siege shots and arrow showers. Fires soon start rising from behind the walls and you see men running around wrapped in flames. As the inferno begins to consume the insides of %objective%, the front gates open and a group of blackened, desperate men rush out. Seeing them, %commander% orders everyone to charge. | %commander% orders his men to set %objective% ablaze. This is done by loading catapults and trebuchets with stones wrapped in firewood and dipped in pitch. They're set alight and sent hurling through the air. Huge volleys of fire arrows follow suit, sailing deep into %objective%'s bowels where you start seeing smoke rise. An inferno builds within the fortifications and it isn't long at all before the front gates break open and men come running out. %commander% draws his sword.%SPEECH_ON%There they are, men. Let's put an end to this once and for all!%SPEECH_OFF% | Archers start wrapping their arrows in cloth and dipping them into pitch. Kids run around with buckets of oil and start lathering the catapult shots. When the preparations are done, %commander% gives the order to let loose. Man perhaps once worshipped fire, but here it is fashioned into a furious terror that goes whistling through the sky, barraging %objective% with fiery ruin. Siege shots pulverize towers and crash through roofs and set the entire place alight. Defenders run around with burning arrows sticking out of them. As the inferno intensifies, the front gate opens and golems of smoke and ash come hurtling out, clambering over themselves to escape the hell which was brought upon them.

 Seeing this, %commander% draws his weapon.%SPEECH_ON%At 'em, men, and show them no mercy!%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander% orders his men to launch hell itself upon %objective%. You watch as catapults, trebuchets, and archers fill the sky with a flurry of fiery shots. The fortifications are quickly brimming with fires that churn into an inferno. Desperate men open the front gates and rush out, coughing and desperately clawing over one another for air. %commander% draws his weapon and laughs at the sight of this.%SPEECH_ON%There they are, there they shall fall! Charge!%SPEECH_OFF% | You watch as the siege engineers fill their catapults and trebuchets with cow carcasses and other fatty morkin. Kids with buckets of pitch run the battle line, dousing each shot before setting them alight. The second after, the engineers send the corpses flying. They blubber and drip through the sky. You watch as one shot hits a tower and explodes outward, sending fire raining into the fortification's courtyard. It isn't long until this animalistic aerial assault has %objective% churning with an inferno.

 The front gates burst open and a mob of men come hurtling out. They clamber over one another, looking like smoke and ash come alive, a darkly bracken unfurling before the gate. %commander% draws his weapon.%SPEECH_ON%This is what we've been waiting for, men. Well, wait no more! Charge!%SPEECH_OFF%}
b1ba2d860c5124424dc4.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_68.png[/img]{一排弓箭手把箭头裹上布，浸入沥青。他们伸出箭矢，一个男孩举着火把跑过，将箭头一一点燃。指挥官举手，弓箭手便抬起燃烧的武器；手一落，弓弦齐发。火箭飞上天空，噼啪嘶响，随后渐渐安静，只剩隐约的火光。箭雨落入要塞，起初似乎再无变化。一名士兵忽然喊叫，指向刚刚升起的烟。很快，火舌舔向天空。几分钟后，正门轰然打开，满身烟灰的人冲了出来，仿佛地狱里的魔像。

 %commander%再次举起手臂，这次手中握着剑。%SPEECH_ON%冲锋！%SPEECH_OFF% | 投石机、弩炮与弓箭手，把火焰射过%objective%的城墙。弹矢拖着火披风掠过天空，呼啸嘶鸣。

 要塞很快被橙红色笼罩，呛人的黑烟一团团翻涌，火焰像手指，缓缓攀着烟柱升起。正门震了一下，又一下，随后猛地打开。熏黑的士兵咳嗽着涌出，为了呼吸新鲜空气，彼此踩踏攀爬。%commander%拔剑，指向敌人。%SPEECH_ON%不留俘虏！%SPEECH_OFF%%objective%的守军似乎听见了，急忙集结成阵。有那么一瞬间，你不禁猜想，那群漆黑的身影之中，是否原本还藏着一面投降的白旗。 | 火烧%objective%的命令传了下来。你看着%commander%的军营点亮天空，燃烧的攻城弹药与箭雨汇成地狱般的火风暴。火头很快从墙后升起，你看见浑身着火的人四处奔跑。烈焰开始吞噬%objective%内部时，正门打开，一群熏得漆黑、走投无路的士兵冲了出来。%commander%见状，下令全军冲锋。 | %commander%命令部下火烧%objective%。士兵将石块裹上柴薪、浸透沥青，装进投石机和配重投石机，点燃后抛向天空。大批火箭随之齐射，深深落入%objective%腹地，那里开始升起烟柱。烈火在工事内蔓延，很快正门便被撞开，士兵向外奔逃。%commander%拔出剑。%SPEECH_ON%他们出来了，弟兄们。让我们把这事彻底了结！%SPEECH_OFF% | 弓箭手开始给箭矢裹布、浸沥青。孩子们提着油桶四处奔走，把投石机弹药淋透。准备完毕，%commander%下令发射。人类也许曾经崇拜火焰，可如今却把它制成暴怒的恐怖，呼啸着掠过天空，将燃烧的毁灭倾泻在%objective%头上。攻城弹砸碎塔楼、撞穿屋顶，整片地方都烧了起来。守军身上插着燃烧的箭，四处乱跑。火势越烧越猛，正门终于打开，一群烟灰凝成的魔像跌跌撞撞冲出，互相踩踏，只求逃离降临到自己头上的地狱。

 %commander%见状，拔出武器。%SPEECH_ON%上，弟兄们，一个也别留情！%SPEECH_OFF% | %commander%命令部下把地狱本身砸向%objective%。你看着投石机、配重投石机和弓箭手，让燃烧的弹矢铺满天空。工事里很快处处起火，翻涌成一片烈焰。绝望的士兵打开正门，咳嗽着冲出，为争一口空气，拼命攀过彼此的身体。%commander%看着这一幕，笑着拔出武器。%SPEECH_ON%他们到了哪儿，就让他们倒在哪儿！冲锋！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你看着攻城工兵把牛尸和其他肥厚的牲畜尸体装入投石机与配重投石机。孩子们提着沥青桶沿阵线奔跑，逐一浇透弹药，再将它们点燃。下一刻，工兵便把尸体抛向天空。肥脂在空中爆响滴落。一发砸中塔楼，炸散开来，让火雨落满要塞内院。没过多久，这场牲畜组成的空袭，就把%objective%变成了翻腾的火海。

 正门轰然打开，一群人跌撞而出。他们互相攀爬，仿佛烟与灰活了过来，在门前展开一丛漆黑的蕨叶。%commander%拔出武器。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，等的就是这一刻。不用再等了！冲锋！%SPEECH_OFF%}

e4e2d4827f5ec0147b08.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%objective%'s gate has been taken, but there's more to do. The momentum needs to be maintained: you quickly order your men to push into the courtyard. | The gate has been taken, but %objective%'s courtyard has yet to fall. You order the %companyname% to keep pressing forward. | The %companyname% has taken the gate and %commander%'s men are currently rushing around the walls of the fort to clean out the towers. You do not want to lose momentum here so you quickly order the men to continue the assault into the courtyard. | As you rush into the courtyard, %commander%'s men fight above for control of the walls. | You and the %companyname% rush into %objective%'s courtyard. Above you is the clanging of %commander%'s men fighting for control of the walls. | The courtyard must be taken! You and the %companyname% rush into the fortifications ready to do battle. Circled all around you are %commander%'s men fighting for control of the walls. | As you rush into %objective%'s courtyard, slain men fall from above, killed by %commander%'s men in a desperate bid to control the walls. | %commander%'s men are assaulting the walls. Now you must do your part and secure the courtyard! | While %commander%'s men secure the walls, you are to secure the courtyard. Do not fail!}
e4e2d4827f5ec0147b08.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%objective%的大门已经攻下，但战斗还没结束。必须乘胜追击：你立即命令弟兄们杀进内院。 | 大门已经攻下，可%objective%的内院还未失守。你命令%companyname%继续向前推进。 | %companyname%已经攻占大门，%commander%的士兵正沿着堡垒的城墙四处突进，清剿塔楼。你不想在这里失去攻势，便立刻命令弟兄们继续进攻内院。 | 你冲进内院时，%commander%的士兵正在上方争夺城墙。 | 你带着%companyname%冲入%objective%的内院。头顶上，%commander%的士兵还在争夺城墙，兵刃相击之声不绝于耳。 | 必须拿下内院！你与%companyname%冲进防御工事，准备厮杀。环绕四周的城墙上，%commander%的士兵正在争夺控制权。 | 你冲进%objective%的内院时，尸体从上方坠落。那是%commander%的士兵为夺取城墙，拼死厮杀时斩落的敌人。 | %commander%的士兵正在进攻城墙。现在轮到你完成自己的任务，拿下内院了！ | %commander%的士兵负责控制城墙，你则负责攻占内院。不能失败！}

acc1f66ac3380afa80d1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%commander% returns with news that the defenders might be weakening. He hopes to avoid a deadly assault and simply wait them out instead. You are instructed to stay with the siege camp until further notice. | One of %commander%'s lieutenant informs you that the commander has elected to wait a little bit longer, hoping that the defenders will surrender instead of drawing out a fight. The %companyname% is ordered to standby until further notice. | News comes your way that the siege is going to be maintained a little while longer. You are instructed to wait some time until further notice.}
acc1f66ac3380afa80d1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%commander%带回消息，守军可能已经开始支撑不住了。他希望继续围困，熬到他们投降，免去一场伤亡惨重的强攻。你接到命令，留在围城营地，等候进一步指示。 | %commander%的一名副官告诉你，指挥官决定再等一阵，希望守军自行投降，免得继续打下去。%companyname%奉命待命，等候进一步指示。 | 消息传来，围城还将持续一段时间。你接到命令，继续等候指示。}

ded7bf2bddc1cf6ce864.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{%commander% orders you and the men out on a patrol. While making the rounds, you spot a few of %objective%'s defenders slipping out of a creekbed beside one of the fort's walls. They're slipping through some sort of secret passageway. Thinking fast, you order you men to charge down on them, hoping to capture the passageway before they can see you first. Make sure none of those bastards can slip back through the secret passageway! | While you wait to see where the siege goes, %commander% comes by and orders you and the %companyname% to start patrols of %objective%'s outer defenses.

 Lo' and behold, while you're footing about you see a few of %objective%'s defenders sneaking through a hatch. You crouch and watch them closely. When the hatch closes, you see that the top of it has been covered in moss and grass to mask its location. If you leave now to tell %commander%, it's very likely that one of the men will see you and destroy the passageway. You decide to seize the moment and order an attack. The %companyname% needs to ensure that no defenders get away! | As the siege lulls on, you decide to take a bit of initiative and ask if you and the %companyname% can go on patrols. A little bit of walking will keep the men fresh and on their toes. That, or they can linger around the camp and get into fights with the professional soldiers. %commander% agrees.

 No more than a few minutes into the patrol do you spot a few of %objective%'s defenders dragging themselves up the embankment of a half-assed moat. They're swimming into it through a sewage hatch close to the fortification walls. %randombrother% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I'll be farkin' damned.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him to stay quiet. If any of the defenders learn that their secret passageway has been found, they'll be sure to close it. You wait for all the defenders to get out into the open, then order an attack. None of the defenders can be allowed to get away! | A patrol is ordered and you elect the %companyname% for the job. Your men grumble and complain, but tasks like this are good for keeping the grunts fresh and on their toes.

 Finding a group of %objective%'s defenders slipping out of a secret passageway is also a great way to keep things fresh! No more than a few minutes out and about do you find the defenders doing just that. You watch as the defenders collect themselves and, just as they're about ready to sneak out into the hinterland, do you order an attack. None of these defenders can be allowed to escape! | As the siege goes on, %commander% orders you and your men to start patrols of the fortifications around %objective%. Halfway through the rounds your men stumble upon a few defenders slipping out of a secret passageway, some shitmired grate where the moat goes up to chest level. Capturing this passageway would be an enormous tactical advantage in the days to come. You quickly order your men to attack - and that none of the defenders can be allowed to get away!}
ded7bf2bddc1cf6ce864.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{%commander%命你带人出去巡逻。巡查途中，你发现几名%objective%的守军，正从堡墙旁的溪床里悄悄钻出。他们走的似乎是一条密道。你立刻作出决定，命令弟兄们冲下去，争取在对方发现你之前夺下通道。决不能让任何一个混账逃回密道！ | 你正等着看围城局势如何发展，%commander%走来，命你带%companyname%巡查%objective%的外围防御。

 没想到，刚走出去，就看见几名%objective%的守军从一扇暗门钻出。你蹲低身子，仔细观察。暗门合上时，你发现盖板上覆着苔藓和草，用来掩藏位置。如果现在回去通知%commander%，很可能会被其中一人发现，继而毁掉通道。你决定抓住机会，立刻进攻。%companyname%必须确保没有守军逃脱！ | 围城迟迟没有动静，你决定主动些，请求带%companyname%出去巡逻。走动走动，能让弟兄们保持精神和警觉；否则，他们留在营地里，也只是和正规军士兵打架。%commander%同意了。

 巡逻没过几分钟，你就发现几名%objective%的守军，正从一条草草挖成的护城河里爬上堤岸。他们是从紧靠城墙的排污暗门游出来的。%randombrother%摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%真他妈见鬼了。%SPEECH_OFF%你让他安静。只要有守军知道密道暴露，就一定会将它封死。你等所有人都来到开阔处，随即下令进攻。不能放走任何一名守军！ | 上头安排巡逻，你主动让%companyname%接下差事。弟兄们满腹牢骚，不过这种任务正好能让他们保持精神和警觉。

 发现一群%objective%的守军正从密道溜出，同样很能提神！你们才出来几分钟，就撞见了这一幕。你看着守军集合，等他们正要悄悄溜往城外腹地时，下令进攻。决不能让任何一名守军逃脱！ | 围城仍在继续，%commander%命你带人巡查%objective%四周的防御工事。巡到一半，弟兄们偶然撞见几名守军正从密道溜出：那是一处糊满污物的栅口，外面护城河的水深及胸。如果能夺下这条通道，接下来几天便能占据巨大的战术优势。你立即命令弟兄们进攻——一个守军也不许放走！}

214c9411638321068539.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{Damn it all. A few of the defenders managed to sneak back through the passageway and you can already hear it being sealed up. | You just weren't quick enough to stop all the defenders and a few got away. They slipped back into %objective% and sealed the passageway behind them. | Well, the whole point here was to kill those sneaking out and secure the passageway. Instead, a few escaped back into %objective% and closed the passageway behind them.}
214c9411638321068539.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{该死！几个守军溜回了通道，你已经听见里面正在封堵出口。 | 你出手不够快，没能拦下全部守军。几个人逃回%objective%，把身后的通道封死。 | 这趟本该杀死偷溜出来的守军，控制通道。结果却有几个人逃回%objective%，顺手封住了身后的路。}

d55c69035287d08f5152.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{You managed to kill all the defenders and secure the passageway. When you report the news to %commander%, he tells you to sneak through the secret gate and assassinate %objective%'s leading commander. You'll have a few hours to prepare, but time is of the essence and you'll have to strike before the night is over. | Killing all the defenders, you manage to secure the passageway. You return to %commander% and explain the situation. He nods dutifully then turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%I want you to sneak through the secret passage, get inside the fortifications, and assassinate their leader.%SPEECH_OFF%Compared to the alternative of a frontal assault, this night operation is about as agreeable of an action that you've heard in some time. | The secret passageway is secured and news of it reported to %commander%. He laughs, shaking his head.%SPEECH_ON%We'd been looking for such a thing for so long now, and there you are, first patrol out and already finding the keys to %objective%.%SPEECH_OFF%He states that he wants you and the %companyname% to sneak through the passage and assassinate the leadership. Once that is done, the defenders will be ruined and %objective% can be taken easily. It's either this or try a frontal assault, the latter of which you have no interest in. You'll have a few hours to get ready, but the mission should be undertaken before the night is over. | One of the defenders screams out for help.%SPEECH_ON%They found ughhh-%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% is quick to slap a cloth over the man's mouth and then slit his throat. You look about %objective%'s walls for activity, but it appears nobody heard the cry.

 Returning to the siege camp, you are intercepted by %commander%. He's looking for good news and you readily depart with it. The leader stomps his foot.%SPEECH_ON%By the gods that's the best news I've heard in weeks! Alright, this is excellent, but we need to take action and fast. I want you and your men to slip through that passageway and assassinate %objective%'s leadership. We need to do this as soon as possible, a few hours wait at the most, got it?%SPEECH_OFF%}
d55c69035287d08f5152.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你们杀死了所有守卫，控制了通道。向%commander%报告后，他命你潜过暗门，刺杀%objective%的最高指挥官。你们有几个小时可以准备，但时间紧迫，必须在天亮前动手。 | 你们杀死所有守卫，控制了通道。你回去向%commander%说明情况。他认真地点点头，随后转向你。%SPEECH_ON%我要你从密道潜进去，进入要塞，刺杀他们的首领。%SPEECH_OFF%和正面强攻相比，这次夜间行动可算是你近来听过最顺耳的安排了。 | 密道已经控制，消息也已报告给%commander%。他笑着摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我们找这种地方找了那么久，你倒好，第一次巡逻，就拿到了打开%objective%的钥匙。%SPEECH_OFF%他要你带着%companyname%潜过密道，刺杀守军首领。事成之后，守军便会崩溃，%objective%也将唾手可得。要么这么干，要么正面强攻，而你对后者毫无兴趣。你们有几个小时准备，但必须在这一夜结束前执行任务。 | 一名守卫大声呼救。%SPEECH_ON%他们发现了——呃！%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%迅速用布捂住他的嘴，随后割断喉咙。你观察%objective%的城墙，没发现动静，似乎无人听见那声叫喊。

 返回围城营地时，%commander%迎面拦住了你。他正等着好消息，你便痛快地告诉了他。指挥官兴奋地一跺脚。%SPEECH_ON%诸神在上，这是我几个星期来听过最好的消息！好，太好了，可我们得马上行动。我要你带人潜过密道，刺杀%objective%的守军首领。越快越好，最多只能等几个小时，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

1c917e80634a5061c267.source: We'll prepare and then sneak in.
1c917e80634a5061c267.translation: 我们先做准备，再潜进去。

9471466d1f4f0206c249.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{You failed to kill the defender's leader and with their commander still at the helm %commander% had to call off the siege. Although the failure of the siege wasn't entirely your fault, it's a good bet that %employer% will see it that way. | The secret passage has been closed! With the defenders' commander still alive, the fortifications will be far too costly to assault. %commander% has called off the siege and you've received a fair bit of the blame for that. | Well, you took too long to use the secret passage. The defenders must have gotten leery of keeping it open and closed it with a pile of rocks. With the defenders still under their steady commander, attacking the fortifications will be very costly for %commander%'s army. He has called off the siege. %employer% will not be happy.}
9471466d1f4f0206c249.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你没能杀死守军首领。敌人仍有指挥官坐镇，%commander%只得下令解除围困。围城失败虽不全是你的错，可%employer%十有八九会把账算到你头上。 | 密道已经封死！守军指挥官仍然活着，强攻这处要塞的代价太大。%commander%已经下令撤围，而你为此背上了不少责难。 | 唉，你迟迟没利用那条密道。守军大概也担心留着它会出事，便搬来一堆石头堵死了通道。如今敌军仍在那位沉稳的指挥官统领之下，%commander%的军队若想强攻要塞，势必要付出惨重代价。他已下令撤围。%employer%不会高兴的。}

c15ede94d1767bd7a032.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{You and the %companyname% quietly slip through the passageway. The walls of the tunnel drip shit and piss and the waters you trudge through are no better. %randombrother% complains a bit, but you tell him to shut it.

 Coming out the other side, you spill into a courtyard, the company sneaking along a line of bushes and then lying flat as you survey the field.

 A few of the defenders walk about. They're sighing and groaning and moaning. Hunger rumbles their bellies, and curses wag their tongues. Soon enough, the commander is seen with a troop of his best guards at his side. He's passing through the courtyard for an inspection. You will not get a better chance than this and order the attack! | The %companyname% and yourself open the secret passageway. You find a small stable boy exiting with a list of requested goods written on a scroll. He begs for his life, but you can't risk anything now. %randombrother% slits his throat and drowns him in the filth pouring out of the passageway's tunnel. You continue on and spill out into a courtyard. The men and yourself slip along a row of bushes and observe for a time.

 As you wait, a man attired in a commander's garb comes down some steps with a band of guards behind him. You doubt you'll get a better opportunity than this and order the attack! | The secret passageway is dark and murky, the waters that run through the tunnels full of shite and piss. You hike up your pants and start inward. Torches would give you away, so you go in blind and feeling the walls. You know not what horrors your fingers run over and you hope to never know. Eventually, a dim light flickers at the far end and you slip out of the passageway and into a courtyard.

 %objective%'s commander is assessing his troops, but stops to turn and look at you and the %companyname% making a grand, stinky entrance. His eyes widen and he points with one hand while the other reaches for his weapon.%SPEECH_ON%Assassins!%SPEECH_OFF%You order the %companyname% to attack! | The secret passageway is a surprisingly short trip to the other side of %objective%'s walls. On the other side of the tunnels is a man standing guard. He sees the shapes of you and your men coming through the darkness. He asks.%SPEECH_ON%I hope to every farkin' old god that you got what we requested. Remember, I asked for eggs and...%SPEECH_OFF%For a moment, he sees %randombrother%'s face emerging from the shadows, and for another moment realizes this stranger before him is no errand boy. The guard reels back, but before he can shout for help your sellsword puts a blade through his chest and both go flying into a bush. With him out of the way, you quietly sneak into %objective% and find its commander doing drills in the courtyard.

 Having no better chance than this, you order the %companyname% to attack!}
c15ede94d1767bd7a032.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你带着%companyname%悄悄穿过密道。通道墙上滴着屎尿，脚下蹚过的污水也好不到哪儿去。%randombrother%抱怨了几句，你叫他闭嘴。

 从另一头钻出，你们进入一处内院。战团沿着灌木丛潜行，随后伏倒，等你观察四周。

 几名守军正在走动，唉声叹气，满腹牢骚。饥肠辘辘，嘴里骂个不停。不久，指挥官出现了，身边带着一队最精锐的护卫，正穿过内院巡视。不会再有比这更好的机会了，你立即下令进攻！ | 你和%companyname%打开密道，发现一个小马童正往外走，手里拿着写有采购清单的卷轴。他哀求饶命，可此刻你不能冒任何风险。%randombrother%割开他的喉咙，把他淹死在通道涌出的污水中。你们继续前进，来到内院，沿着一排灌木潜伏，观察了一阵。

 等候间，一名身着指挥官服饰的男人走下台阶，后面跟着一队护卫。你想，恐怕不会再有更好的机会了，于是下令进攻！ | 密道漆黑潮湿，流过通道的水里满是屎尿。你提起裤脚，开始往里走。点火把会暴露，只能摸着墙壁，在黑暗中前行。你不知道手指划过了什么可怕的东西，也希望永远别知道。终于，远端闪出微光，你钻出密道，进入一处内院。

 %objective%的指挥官正在检阅部下，忽然停下，转头看向你和%companyname%这番气派又臭气熏天的登场。他瞪大眼睛，一手指来，另一手伸向武器。%SPEECH_ON%刺客！%SPEECH_OFF%你命令%companyname%进攻！ | 没想到，密道很短，片刻就到了%objective%城墙另一侧。通道尽头有个守卫，看见你和弟兄们的轮廓从黑暗中浮现，便问道。%SPEECH_ON%我他妈向所有旧神祈祷，你们最好把要的东西都带回来了。记着，我要的是鸡蛋，还有……%SPEECH_OFF%一瞬间，他看清%randombrother%从阴影中露出的脸；下一瞬间，便意识到眼前的陌生人根本不是跑腿的。他猛地后退，可还没来得及喊，佣兵就一刀刺穿他的胸膛，两人一同扑进灌木。清掉这个障碍后，你们悄悄潜入%objective%，发现指挥官正在内院操练。

 再没有更好的机会了，你命令%companyname%进攻！}

1b117c8404c06c0efef2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%objective%'s commander has fallen and his men quickly lay down their arms. One lieutenant raises his hands and speaks hurriedly.%SPEECH_ON%We've no interest in carrying on with this losing proposition. The only man who did is dead there. We surrender.%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% will be most happy about this turn of events. | The battle over, you find the dying commander of %objective%'s defenses. He's spitting blood as you step over him.%SPEECH_ON%We'll never surrender. Do your worst you deplorable sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%You put a sword through his eye socket. One of his lieutenants drops his weapon and raises his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, he was the only one here who cared about defending this place. It's all yours. Just let us live!%SPEECH_OFF%You give %randombrother% the order to signal %commander% about the taking of the fortifications. | %objective%'s commander is dead, and his men immediately surrender in unison. They explain that only the commander wanted to keep holding the place. Apparently he was jockeying for attention within the noble families and thought a heroic defense would purchase him a seat at the table of the powers that be. Well, now he's dead in the mud. You tell %randombrother% to raise the signal so that %commander% can know %objective% has surrendered. A defender asks you for mercy.%SPEECH_ON%Surely you'll let us live, yes?%SPEECH_OFF%You clean your blade and shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Not up to me. My benefactor and the army he heads is about to come through that door. What his intentions are is beyond me. You want mercy, pick up a weapon and my men will give it to you.%SPEECH_OFF%The defender frowns and nods.%SPEECH_ON%I suppose I'll take my chances with him.%SPEECH_OFF% | %objective%'s commander is dead in the mud. His surviving troops all have their hands in the air. You order your men to shackle the defenders while you give the signal, unfurling your sigil down the side of a tower. %commander%'s siege camp blares a horn in response. The battle is over. %employer% will no doubt be most pleased. | The battle is over and %objective%'s leader is dead in the mud. Having ripped out their heart and soul, the defenders immediately give up. You order the %companyname% to round them up and start shackling them. %randombrother% goes to give %commander% the signal that the fort has been taken. %employer% will no doubt be happy to see you upon your return.}
1b117c8404c06c0efef2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{%objective%的指挥官倒下，部下们很快放下武器。一名副官举起双手，急忙说道。%SPEECH_ON%我们不想再打这场必败的仗了。唯一想打下去的人，已经死在那儿。我们投降。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%一定会对这个结果十分满意。 | 战斗结束，你找到%objective%奄奄一息的守军指挥官。你跨到他面前时，他正往外吐血。%SPEECH_ON%我们绝不投降。有什么手段尽管使吧，你这卑鄙的佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你一剑刺穿他的眼窝。一名副官丢下武器，举起双手。%SPEECH_ON%喂，这里只有他还想守下去。地方全归你们，只求放我们一条生路！%SPEECH_OFF%你命令%randombrother%发信号，通知%commander%要塞已经攻下。 | %objective%的指挥官一死，部下们立即一齐投降。他们解释，只有指挥官想继续死守。显然，他一心想引起贵族家族的注意，以为英勇守城就能换来跻身权贵之列的机会。可现在，他死在了泥地里。你让%randombrother%发出信号，好让%commander%知道%objective%已经投降。一名守军向你求饶。%SPEECH_ON%你们会放我们活命的，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你擦净刀刃，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我说了不算。我的雇主就要带着军队进那道门了，他想怎么处置，我不知道。要是想求个痛快，就拿起武器，我的人会成全你。%SPEECH_OFF%守军皱起眉，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%那我还是在他那儿碰碰运气吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | %objective%的指挥官死在泥里，幸存的部下全都举起了手。你命令弟兄们给守军戴上镣铐，自己则在塔楼一侧展开战旗，发出信号。%commander%的围城营地响起号角回应。战斗结束了，%employer%无疑会十分满意。 | 战斗结束，%objective%的首领死在泥地里。主心骨一倒，守军立刻放弃抵抗。你命令%companyname%把他们集中起来，逐一戴上镣铐。%randombrother%则去向%commander%发信号，报告堡垒已被攻下。等你回去时，%employer%无疑会很高兴。}

e2dcb865065fbbd500a2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{Unfortunately, you did not get into position to assassinate the commander and had to pull back. The defenders of %objective% jeer as you and the men slip back through the tunnels. When you get back outside, you hear the passageway being sealed off. It looks a more difficult route to capturing %objective% will have to be taken. | The battle did not carry on as you hoped. You and the %companyname% are pushed back to the passageway and enact a fighting retreat. When you get back outside, you hear stones and crashing sounds as the defenders seal it all off. You tried your best, but it looks like taking %objective% will not be as easy as you'd hoped. | To their credit, the defenders did a great job. Tired and underfed, they fought like the cornered dogs that they are. When you retreat back outside %objective%'s walls, you hear the distinct sound of the passageway being sealed off.}
e2dcb865065fbbd500a2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{遗憾的是，你没能推进到足以刺杀敌军指挥官的位置，只得撤退。你和弟兄们退入地道时，%objective%的守军放声嘲笑。回到外面后，你听见通道被封堵的声音。看来，想拿下%objective%，得走一条更艰难的路了。 | 战事没能如你所愿。你和%companyname%被逼退到通道口，只能边打边撤。等你们回到外面，便听见守军搬动石块、封死通道的轰隆声。你已经尽了力，可要攻下%objective%，看来没想象中那么容易。 | 不得不承认，守军打得相当出色。他们疲惫不堪、食不果腹，却像被逼到死角的狗一样拼命反抗。你退到%objective%的城墙外时，清楚地听见通道被封死的声音。}

f3589f71516fb8dfb982.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{%commander%'s scouts return with news that a relief force is coming to try and end the siege of %objective%. The commander nods and orders his men to prepare for battle. You do the same. | While waiting around, a few scouts return and enter %commander%'s tent. You go in after them and see the commander nodding and gathering his things. He looks at you and explains.%SPEECH_ON%A relief force is coming. They're going to try and end the siege. Get your men ready.%SPEECH_OFF% | {You watch as %randombrother% arm wrestles one of the professional soldiers. They're betting on a headless chicken. Winner gets a full belly, the loser a sore arm. | One of the sieging soldiers and %randombrother% are about to begin a staring contest. Whoever blinks first, loses. Whoever wins gets a chicken. | You find %randombrother% heaving large stones close to a stake in the mud. A soldier from the sieging army does the same. Apparently they're competing over a chicken and they're down to the very last throw for winner take all.} Before they can start, a scout bursts through the camp and states an army is coming to try and relieve %objective%. %commander% orders his men to get ready. You repeat it to the %companyname%. | %commander%'s scouts have returned with news that an army is coming to try and relieve %objective%. You order the %companyname% to get ready for a large battle. | A large battle is on the horizon: %commander%'s scouts have returned with news that a relief force is coming to try and end the siege. Get ready!}
f3589f71516fb8dfb982.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{%commander%的斥候带回消息：一支援军正赶来，企图解除%objective%之围。指挥官点了点头，命令士兵准备战斗。你也下达了同样的命令。 | 等候之际，几名斥候返回营地，进了%commander%的帐篷。你跟进去，看见指挥官一边点头，一边收拾东西。他抬眼向你解释。%SPEECH_ON%援军来了。他们想给城里解围。让你的人准备好。%SPEECH_OFF% | {%randombrother%正在和一名正规军士兵掰手腕，你在旁看着。他们赌的是一只宰好的鸡。赢家填饱肚子，输家只落得胳膊酸疼。 | 围城部队的一名士兵和%randombrother%正要比试瞪眼。谁先眨眼谁就输，赢家能得一只鸡。 | 你看见%randombrother%正把大石头往泥地里的一根木桩旁扔。围城部队的一名士兵也在做同样的事。看样子，他们在赌一只鸡，而现在只剩最后一掷，胜者通吃。} 还没等他们动手，一名斥候便冲进营地，宣布有一支军队正赶来给%objective%解围。%commander%命令士兵们做好准备，你也向%companyname%下达了同样的命令。 | %commander%的斥候带回消息，一支军队正在赶来，企图给%objective%解围。你命令%companyname%准备迎接一场大战。 | 大战将至：%commander%的斥候带回消息，一支援军正赶来，企图解除围困。做好准备！}

1b72c77dded74aa569a9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_86.png[/img]{The relief force has been defeated and beaten back off the field. %objective%'s defenders no doubt saw the whole battle and have taken a hit to their morale. It's likely only a matter of time until they surrender! | Hurrah! The relief force has been summarily taken care of. %commander% thanks you for the help. He glasses %objective%'s walls with his leather-wrapped scope and smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, they're a beaten bunch. They saw the whole thing. I've never seen such a hopeless lot of men in all my life.%SPEECH_OFF%He claps you on the shoulder with a wide grin.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, I think this siege is almost at an end!%SPEECH_OFF% | You managed to beat back the relief force! That was probably the last hope for %objective% and their surrender is to be expected any day now. | %commander% thanks you for helping destroy the relief force. He believes %objective% is likely to surrender any moment now. | Watching your only hope in the world get annihilated is probably not the best for morale. %objective%'s defenders got to see their relief force slaughtered and no doubt they are now on the verge of surrender. | Well, %objective%'s great last hope has been completely defeated. You and %commander% convene and agree: the defenders are no doubt ready to surrender. It's just a matter of time.}
1b72c77dded74aa569a9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_86.png[/img]{援军已被击败，溃退出战场。%objective%的守军无疑目睹了整场战斗，士气大受打击。他们投降恐怕只是时间问题！ | 好啊！援军已经被彻底解决。%commander%感谢你的协助。他举起包着皮革的望远镜，观察%objective%的城墙，脸上浮出笑意。%SPEECH_ON%噢，他们已经垮了。整场战斗都看在眼里。我这辈子从没见过这么绝望的一群人。%SPEECH_OFF%他咧嘴大笑，拍了拍你的肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我看这场围城快结束了！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你们成功击退了援军！这大概就是%objective%最后的希望了，守军随时都可能投降。 | %commander%感谢你协助消灭援军。他认为，%objective%随时都可能投降。 | 亲眼看着世上仅存的希望灰飞烟灭，想来对士气没什么好处。%objective%的守军目睹了援军遭到屠戮，眼下无疑已经快要投降了。 | 好了，%objective%最后的救命稻草已经被彻底击溃。你和%commander%碰头商议，意见一致：守军无疑已经准备投降，只不过早晚而已。}

bd6edd9cd93528e5dd16.translation: 他们不可能永远撑下去。

87b82821e10f2c65a019.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]%objective% surrenders!

{You walk through the opened gates to find its defenders strewn all about. Hungry men keeled over in pain, others leaning against the walls, chapped lips cracking as they beg for water. No animals are alive. They have all long since been slaughtered. Black birds do stare down from the walls, joining you in the conquest and just waiting for an opportunity to plunder. %commander% claps you on the shoulder and thanks you for the help. | The front gate rattles open and you walk through it like the victor that you are. However, the scene inside should dispel any notion that there was honor in defeating these poor souls. Dead defenders have been stacked in a corner. A few men have been crucified for cannibalism, but even those executed men show signs of being consumed. There's a burnt granary to one side of the courtyard. Some of the men sit with blackened mouths, apparently having tried to scarf down the charred remains of grain. Every single animal has been slaughtered and picked to the bone.

 %commander% laughs at the scene and tells his men to start shackling the prisoners. He turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sellsword. You can return to %employer% now.%SPEECH_OFF% | Inside the fort you find the defenders standing in a line. Two of %commander%'s soldiers are going down it, one hauling chains and the other taking those chains and shackling the men together. You see a corpse impaled atop a stable, having the weathervane blow out his chest and carrying his heart atop it like some visceral end to a ritual. %commander% comes over laughing.%SPEECH_ON%That was their lieutenant. {They said he refused to surrender and threw himself off the tower instead. | Apparently he refused to surrender so his men threw him off the tower.}%SPEECH_OFF%Interesting. Well, %employer% will be more than happy to see you again. | Beyond the walls, %commander%'s men are taking the defenders' weapons and heaving them into a great pile. The defenders themselves are huddled in a corner, each with their arms shackled behind their backs, their heads ducked low, their eyes staring at the mud. A few guards watch over them, occasionally kicking them, spitting on them, or even threatening to kill them. All in good fun.

 %commander% comes over and claps you on the back.%SPEECH_ON%Job well done, sellsword. Your help was much appreciated. Return to %employer%. Your work here is done.%SPEECH_OFF% | Walking through the gate, you find the defenders begging for mercy. Their lieutenant is dead in the mud, still leaking from dozens of stab wounds. One man explains.%SPEECH_ON%We wanted to surrender so long ago but he wouldn't let us! You have to understand! We want no more of this war.%SPEECH_OFF%%commander% walks up beside you and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Your work here is done, sellsword. Go on and see %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what he's going to do with the prisoners. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Dunno. I think I'll eat first. Maybe pen a letter to my loved ones. I try not to be rash about these things.%SPEECH_OFF%Fair enough. | You and %commander% walk through the opened gates. Inside, a few of the surviving defenders are keeled over, begging for food on their hands and knees. They can hardly bend their bodies upward to beg, their stomachs so pitted with pain.%SPEECH_ON%Please! Help...%SPEECH_OFF%%commander% puts a boot on one of the men and pushes him over.%SPEECH_ON%Do we look like help to you?%SPEECH_OFF%The commander turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Good job, sellsword. Get on back to %employer. Your work here is done.%SPEECH_OFF% | Through the gate you find the defenders being rounded up and put into a corner. %commander% asks which of them is the leader. The group uniformly points across the courtyard. A dead man is hanging from one of the towers, pale faced with purpled hands and a purple nose. One of the prisoners explained.%SPEECH_ON%If we didn't do it, you'd still be standing out there and we'd still be in here starving.%SPEECH_OFF%%commander% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Alright. I won't punish ye all for that. Sellsword! You get on back to %employer%. Your work here is done.%SPEECH_OFF% | Going through the gate, you find the fort's commander swinging a longsword around as a few of %commander%'s men corner him with spears. In one big uniform rush, they skewer him like a wild animal. Immobilized by the shafts, he gives up and keels forward, draping his arms over the wood like he was lazily leaning against some fenceposts.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, I suppose ye bastards got me.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns to his men who, it appears, were the ones to actually open the gates.%SPEECH_ON%I'll be seeing the lot of you in the next life.%SPEECH_OFF%Blood pours from his mouth and his body shakes once and that is all. The soldiers retrieve their spears and the leader falls straight into the mud. %commander% stands over him and addresses you.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, sellsword. Get on back to %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF% | The inside of the fort is a place of horror. Men are strewn about clutching their bellies, some already dead, some wishing they were. The commander of the place is hanging from a tower, a family banner wrapped around his neck as though that'd bring some dignity to his death. Bones of animals litter the courtyard and there is shit and piss and vomit potholed all about. %commander% comes to your side and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Looks about right. A shame they didn't surrender earlier.%SPEECH_OFF%You suggest that it was probably the dead lieutenant swinging by his own sigil that was resisting surrender. The commander nods again.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah. He thought that was the honorable thing to do. I'd probably done the same once upon a time, but having seen this, I'm not so sure he's right anymore.%SPEECH_OFF% | Walking through the gate, you find the defenders bunched up outside a place of worship. There aren't many left and not a one is praying. The dead have been piled into a corner and there's evidence of cannibalism. No animals are around. The stable is so busy with flies it's almost roaring with their frenetic buzzing. The pig pen has been outright trampled. One of the prisoners looks up at you.%SPEECH_ON%We ate all that we could. Do you understand? We. Ate. All. That. We. Could.%SPEECH_OFF%%commander% comes up to your side.%SPEECH_ON%Don't let them bother ya, sellsword. Travel on back to %employer%. He'll no doubt be waiting for you.%SPEECH_OFF% | You and %commander% walk through the front gates. The defenders inside are more skeleton than flesh and they shamble about accordingly. One gloms onto your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Food! Food!%SPEECH_OFF%His breath carries the horrid stench of hunger. You throw him to the ground and there he cries out and begins stuffing his mouth with mud. %commander% comes by your side as he munches on a buttered piece of bread.%SPEECH_ON%These bastards look like a sorry lot, no?%SPEECH_OFF%Crumbs spew out of his mouth and the prisoners stare at them as if they were gold. The commander claps you on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Get on back to %employer%, he'll be more than happy to hear the great news.%SPEECH_OFF%}
87b82821e10f2c65a019.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]%objective%投降了！

{你穿过打开的城门，发现守军东倒西歪，散落各处。饥饿的人痛得弯下腰，还有人靠着墙，干裂的嘴唇一张一合，乞求清水。没有动物还活着，早就全被宰了。倒有些黑鸟从城墙上向下凝视，仿佛与你一同参与了征服，只等机会到来，便开始劫掠。%commander%拍了拍你的肩，感谢你相助。 | 正门吱嘎打开，你以胜利者的姿态走了进去。然而，里面的景象足以让人打消任何念头：击败这些可怜人，谈不上什么荣耀。死去的守军被堆在角落，几个人因食人而被钉上十字架，可连这些遭处决的人身上，也有被啃食的痕迹。庭院一侧是烧毁的粮仓，有些人坐在旁边，嘴巴乌黑，显然试着吞过烧焦的谷物。所有动物都被宰杀，连骨头上的肉也剔得一干二净。

%commander%看着这景象，竟笑了，命令士兵开始给俘虏上镣铐。他转向你。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢，佣兵。你现在可以回去见%employer%了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 堡内，守军站成一列。%commander%的两名士兵沿队列走动，一个拖着锁链，一个接过来，把人逐一锁在一起。你看见马厩顶上穿着一具尸体，风向标刺穿胸膛，将心脏挑在顶端，仿佛某种仪式血淋淋的收尾。%commander%笑着走来。%SPEECH_ON%那是他们的副官。{他们说，他拒绝投降，宁愿自己从塔上跳下去。 | 听说他拒绝投降，所以手下把他从塔上扔下去了。}%SPEECH_OFF%有意思。总之，%employer%再见到你，一定会十分高兴。 | 城墙内，%commander%的士兵收走守军的武器，扔成一大堆。守军挤在角落里，双臂反铐，低着头，眼睛盯着泥地。几个看守监视着他们，不时踢上一脚、啐上一口，甚至扬言要杀人。不过是寻开心罢了。

%commander%走来，拍了拍你的背。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，干得好。你的帮助很有用。回去见%employer%吧，这里的活已经做完了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你穿过城门，守军们纷纷求饶。他们的副官死在泥地里，几十处刀伤还在渗血。一人解释道。%SPEECH_ON%我们早就想投降了，可他不让！请你们理解！我们不想再打这场仗了。%SPEECH_OFF%%commander%来到你身旁，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你在这里的活做完了。去见%employer%吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，他打算怎么处理俘虏。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%不知道。我想先吃饭，没准再给亲人写封信。这种事，我尽量不仓促决定。%SPEECH_OFF%倒也合理。 | 你与%commander%走过打开的城门。里面，几个幸存守军佝偻着身子，手脚着地，乞讨食物。饥饿把肚子掏得痛不欲生，他们甚至难以挺直身体求饶。%SPEECH_ON%求求你！帮帮……%SPEECH_OFF%%commander%一脚踩住其中一人，将他推翻。%SPEECH_ON%我们看起来像是来帮你的吗？%SPEECH_OFF%指挥官转向你。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，干得好。回雇主那里去吧，你在这里的活已经做完了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 进门后，你看到守军被集中押到角落。%commander%问，谁是他们的首领。众人齐齐指向庭院另一边。一名死者悬在塔楼上，脸色惨白，双手和鼻子已经发紫。一名俘虏解释道。%SPEECH_ON%要不是我们动手，你们还得站在外面，我们还得留在里面挨饿。%SPEECH_OFF%%commander%点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%好，这事我不罚你们。佣兵！回去见%employer%吧，这里的活做完了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你穿过城门，发现堡垒的指挥官还在挥舞长剑，%commander%的几个士兵持矛将他逼在角落。众人整齐地猛扑一下，像扎野兽般把他刺穿。长矛将他钉住，动弹不得，他终于放弃，向前弯下身，双臂搭在矛杆上，仿佛只是懒洋洋地倚着栅栏。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，看来你们这些杂种抓住我了。%SPEECH_OFF%他转向自己的手下，看来，城门正是他们打开的。%SPEECH_ON%下辈子，我会一个个找上你们。%SPEECH_OFF%血从他嘴里涌出，身体抖了一下，便再无动静。士兵拔回长矛，首领直挺挺跌进泥中。%commander%站在尸体上方，对你说道。%SPEECH_ON%好了，佣兵。回去见%employer%吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 堡内宛如地狱。人们捂着肚子倒在各处，有些已经死了，有些巴不得自己也死了。这里的指挥官悬在塔楼上，脖子绕着家族旗帜，仿佛这样就能给死亡添点体面。庭院到处是动物骨头，坑洼里积着屎尿和呕吐物。%commander%来到你身旁，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%差不多就是这个样子。可惜，他们没早点投降。%SPEECH_OFF%你说，多半是那个吊在自家徽旗下的死副官，一直不肯降。指挥官再次点头。%SPEECH_ON%是。他觉得，这才算有荣誉。要是从前，我大概也会这么做。但看过这里，我已经不那么确定，他究竟对不对了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你穿过城门，发现守军挤在一处礼拜场所外。剩下的人不多，却没有一个在祈祷。死者堆在角落，还留着食人的迹象。动物一只不见，马厩里苍蝇多得惊人，疯狂的嗡鸣几乎成了轰响，猪圈也被彻底踩塌。一名俘虏抬头看你。%SPEECH_ON%能吃的，我们全吃了。你明白吗？能。吃。的。我。们。全。吃。了。%SPEECH_OFF%%commander%来到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，别管他们。回去见%employer%吧，他肯定在等你。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你与%commander%走进正门。里面的守军几乎只剩骨头，拖着身子蹒跚挪动。其中一人扑住你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%吃的！吃的！%SPEECH_OFF%他的口气带着饥饿的恶臭。你把他甩到地上，他哭喊起来，开始往嘴里塞泥。%commander%来到你身边，正嚼着一块抹了黄油的面包。%SPEECH_ON%这些杂种，瞧着可真惨，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%面包屑从他嘴里喷出，俘虏们盯着那些碎屑，仿佛看见了黄金。指挥官拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%回去见%employer%吧，听到这大好消息，他一定高兴。%SPEECH_OFF%}

904c8919d9243a359063.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{A loud squall breaks over the din of the siege camp. You look out to see the gates of %objective% opening up and a band of men running out. %commander% sprints out of his tent, takes one look, then starts yelling at his men.%SPEECH_ON%Sally! Sally! They're coming, men, they're coming! Ready yourselves! Kill these rat bastards to the last man, you hear me?%SPEECH_OFF%The siege camp roars with anticipation. You quickly gather the %companyname% and prepare to join the battle. | The defenders of %objective% are sallying forth! You order you men to ready themselves and prepare to join %commander% in battle. | There isn't going to be any surrender! The defenders of %objective% are sallying forth. They're a poor, hungry looking lot, but it appears they'd rather die out here than give themselves up. %commander% tells his men to get ready and you do the same with the %companyname%. | The gates of %objective% are opening up! At first, that's all that happens, then a muted roar comes and a small band of defenders start marching out. They're raising their arms to cheers and are singing their family's battlecry. They're bringing volume and you'll be bringing violence. To battle! | The squall of rusted hinges rings over the siege camp. You look to %objective% to see its gates slowly opening. A band of men marches out, carrying banners and weapons. They look like they've already been beaten in one battle, shambling forward on hungry bellies. %commander% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Those fools. Why don't they just surrender?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and turn to the %companyname%.%SPEECH_ON%If they wish to die, then so be it. To arms, men!%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother% comes to you and points at the gates of %objective%.%SPEECH_ON%Look, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You watch as the gates slowly open up. A troop of men shambles out. They do not carry a white flag, but instead the sigils of their families. You run to %commander% and inform him that the defenders are sallying forth. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%I knew they were a resilient bunch, but this is just pathetic. No man should die so pointlessly.%SPEECH_OFF%You almost say if that were true no man would be out here doing this shite in the first place. Instead, you hold your tongue and go out to prepare the men of the %companyname% for battle.}
904c8919d9243a359063.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{一声高喊压过围城营地的嘈杂。你望出去，看见%objective%的大门打开，一队人马正向外冲。%commander%奔出帐篷，只看了一眼，便朝部下大喊。%SPEECH_ON%敌军出城！敌军出城！他们来了，弟兄们，他们来了！准备迎战！把这些鼠辈杂种杀个精光，听见没有？%SPEECH_OFF%营地里响起急欲交战的怒吼。你迅速召集%companyname%，准备参战。 | %objective%的守军正在出城突击！你命令弟兄们做好准备，与%commander%一同迎战。 | 不会有什么投降了！%objective%的守军正向城外杀来。他们衣衫寒酸、饥肠辘辘，却宁愿死在城外，也不肯束手就擒。%commander%命令部下准备迎战，你也向%companyname%下达同样的命令。 | %objective%的城门打开了！起初没有其他动静，随后传来一阵低沉的吼声，一小队守军开始向外行进。他们举起武器欢呼，唱着所属家族的战吼。他们带来了喧嚣，而你会带去刀剑。迎战！ | 生锈门铰的尖响传遍围城营地。你望向%objective%，看见城门缓缓打开。一队人举着旗帜、拿着武器走了出来。他们饿着肚子，步履蹒跚，看起来仿佛已经打过一场败仗。%commander%摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%这帮傻瓜，为什么不干脆投降？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，转向%companyname%。%SPEECH_ON%他们既然求死，那就成全他们。弟兄们，拿起武器！%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother%来到你面前，指向%objective%的城门。%SPEECH_ON%团长，看。%SPEECH_OFF%你望着城门缓缓开启，一队人摇摇晃晃走了出来。他们举的不是白旗，而是各自家族的纹章旗。你跑去告诉%commander%，守军正在出城突击。他点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%我知道他们很顽强，可这实在太可悲了。没人该死得如此毫无意义。%SPEECH_OFF%你差点脱口而出：真要如此，哪还有人会来这儿干这种破事？不过，你终究忍住了，转身去让%companyname%的弟兄们准备战斗。}

a6566459765c38d6c3b8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]Unbelievably, the tired defenders of %objective% have won! You retreat as the siege crumbles.
a6566459765c38d6c3b8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]难以置信，%objective%疲惫不堪的守军竟然赢了！围城瓦解，你只得撤退。

fe3185cc800997958791.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{A few of your men managed to capture some of %objective%'s defenders. They stand huddled together, fenced in by your sellsword's weapons. Some are shaking in their boots. One doesn't even have boots. Another has stains down his pants. %randombrother% asks what should be done with them. | %randombrother% reports that a few defenders of %objective% have been captured. You go to find a group of men huddled together, embraced in a circled hug, but with their heads down. One calls out.%SPEECH_ON%Please, don't kill us! We were just doing what we were told, just as you were!%SPEECH_OFF% | Your men have managed to capture a few of %objective%'s defenders. They've been rounded up, stripped to their pants, and ordered facedown into the mud. %randombrother% asks what should be done with them.}
fe3185cc800997958791.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{几名弟兄俘获了%objective%的一些守军。他们在佣兵的刀剑包围下挤作一团。有的人抖个不停，有的人连靴子都没得穿，还有人裤裆下湿了一片。%randombrother%问你该怎么处置。 | %randombrother%报告说，抓到了几名%objective%的守军。你过去一看，那些人低着头，围成一圈，彼此紧紧搂在一起。其中一人喊道。%SPEECH_ON%求求你，别杀我们！我们只是奉命行事，和你们一样！%SPEECH_OFF% | 弟兄们俘获了几名%objective%的守军。他们被赶到一处，剥得只剩裤子，奉命脸朝下趴进烂泥。%randombrother%问你该怎么处置。}

e357c339224e1aa35016.source: Let them go. %rivalhouse% may take it as a sign of good faith.
e357c339224e1aa35016.translation: 放他们走。%rivalhouse%也许会把这看作善意。

5782d9f688edfd2a7375.source: They may be worth something. Take them to %commander% as prisoners.
5782d9f688edfd2a7375.translation: 这些人也许值点钱。押去交给%commander%。

3f358dae8f3662bf7238.source: Better to kill them now than face them again in battle in the days to come.
3f358dae8f3662bf7238.translation: 现在杀掉，总好过过几天在战场上再见到他们。

f4c3529e37c78bb0dc80.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{The prisoners are of no use to you or anyone else. You cut them loose, hoping that you won't come to regret this decision. | You cut the prisoners loose. They cry as they thank you, but you simply hope that this was not a mistake. | You let the prisoners go. They thank you personally before taking off, hopefully to never be seen again.}
f4c3529e37c78bb0dc80.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{这些俘虏对你、对谁都没什么用。你放了他们，只盼日后不会为此后悔。 | 你放走俘虏。他们哭着道谢，而你只希望这不是个错误。 | 你释放了俘虏。他们逐一向你道谢，随后离开，但愿永不再见。}

b42364259b951de409ff.translation: 今天死的人已经够多了。

e63ffd1064fd3c6c7633.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{You nod at %randombrother%.%SPEECH_ON%Kill them all.%SPEECH_OFF%The prisoners get to their feet, but there is no escaping the closure of their worlds. They are slaughtered piecemeal. | There is no use for these men in shackles, but it is quite likely that they'll come back to fight you another day as free men. You order their execution, a command carried out in a frenzy of pleading and throat slashing. | In wars like this, there is no food to house so many prisoners, and there's no use for them while you're still deep in enemy territory. But if you let them go it is very probable they'll raise their swords against you another day.

 With that in mind, you order their executions. The words of protest are short lived, fading into the gargle of throats being slashed, cut, and hacked.}
e63ffd1064fd3c6c7633.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{你朝%randombrother%点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%全杀了。%SPEECH_OFF%俘虏们挣扎着站起，却逃不过末日降临。他们一个接一个地被杀死。 | 这些人戴着镣铐毫无用处，重获自由后却很可能在将来的某一天再次与你为敌。你下令处决他们。哀求声骤然响起，又随着割断喉咙的刀锋一一止息。 | 打这样的仗，哪来那么多粮食养活俘虏？何况你们仍深入敌境，留着他们也派不上用场。可要是放了，他们日后多半又会拿起剑对付你们。

 想到这里，你下令将他们处决。抗议声只持续了片刻，便随着一刀刀划开、割断、斩裂喉咙，化作含混的咕噜声。}

566b566dd739739bee15.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{You take the prisoners to %commander%. The men are lined up and the commander walks up and down their arrangement.%SPEECH_ON%This one. This one. Him. And him. Kill the rest.%SPEECH_OFF%A few lucky ones, who coincidentally happen to be the biggest and most useful looking of the bunch, are pulled forward. The rest are summarily killed with spears through their chests. %commander% hands you some crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Appreciate you catching them. They'll be put to good, hard work.%SPEECH_OFF% | The prisoners are taken to %commander%. He orders the men shackled and ordered to some hard labor. The commander pays you a decent sum for the haul.}
566b566dd739739bee15.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{你把俘虏带到%commander%面前。他们排成一列，指挥官沿着队伍来回走动。%SPEECH_ON%这个，这个，还有他和他。剩下的都杀了。%SPEECH_OFF%几个幸运儿被拉了出来——巧的是，他们恰好都是这群人里最壮、看着最能干活的。其余的人则被长矛当胸刺穿，就地处决。%commander%递给你一些克朗。%SPEECH_ON%多谢你抓住他们。我会让他们好好出力干活的。%SPEECH_OFF% | 俘虏被带到%commander%面前。他下令给这些人戴上镣铐，押去服苦役。作为这批俘虏的报酬，指挥官付给你一笔相当不错的钱。}

621e553277019d96adbe.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You report to %employer% that %objective% has been taken and is now under control. The man hides a smirk behind his hand, keeping some fair bit of composure as if nobility shouldn't lower themselves to the unprofessional excitement of the layman. He simply nods as though this news had been expected.%SPEECH_ON%Good. Good. Of course.%SPEECH_OFF%The man snaps his fingers and a servant hands you a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns. | Entering %employer%'s room brings silence to a throng of commanders, lieutenants, and the nobleman himself. He straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%My birds have already reported of the capture of %objective%. Your pay is outside.%SPEECH_OFF%The leaders hardly even thank you, though %reward_completion% crowns is more than enough thanks as far as you're concerned. | %employer% welcomes you to his war room. A group of commanders linger around a map on a table. You watch as they push one of their tokens over %objective%. %employer% grins.%SPEECH_ON%Those men may not let it slip, but we are might happy about the work you've done. The stories my spies have brought me ensured I did not make a poor investment with the likes of you.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman personally gives you a satchel of %reward_completion% crowns. | %employer%'s room is a hive of business. Commanders run to and fro, arguing with one another no matter which side of the room they're on or how far apart, while servants duck and weave to make sure they're properly fed. War is no time to waste energy on pitiful things like picking up your own cloak or cooking meals. You're surprised there are no servants forking bites into their mouths between arguments.

 However, %employer% is simply off to the side. He's flipping through a book like he was by himself in a chirpy garden. He looks up. Glances at his generals, then at you.%SPEECH_ON%Good job. Your pay.%SPEECH_OFF%A chest is slowly pushed your way. %reward_completion% crowns rest inside. | A servant cuts you off from entering %employer%'s room. He explains.%SPEECH_ON%I've been requested to meet you here with this satchel of %reward_completion% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%You take the satchel and nod. | You try to enter %employer%'s room, but a guard stops you.%SPEECH_ON%Nobles only.%SPEECH_OFF%Pushing the guard's halberd out of your face, you state that you have business with %employer%. The guard lowers the halberd back down.%SPEECH_ON%Nobles only.%SPEECH_OFF%Just as you are about to start an argument, a servant steps out of the room with a large satchel. He sees the sigil of the %companyname% and hands you a satchel.%SPEECH_ON%Your %reward_completion% crowns. I'm afraid my liege and his commanders are busy.%SPEECH_OFF%And just like that the servant is gone. The guard peers down at you.%SPEECH_ON%Nobles only.%SPEECH_OFF% | The reward for helping conquer %objective% is %reward_completion% crowns and a door slammed in your face. %employer% is too busy arguing with his commanders to congratulate you any more than that. | One of %employer%'s commanders meets you in a foyer. He's got a servant with him that's carrying a large satchel. The commander speaks.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, the %companyname%. You've little honor in your vocation, sellsword. You should be a real man and fight with the nobles. There is great honor in what we do. Why not join us?%SPEECH_OFF%The large satchel of %reward_completion% crowns is placed in your hands. You smile back at the commander, a gilded reflection rimming your teeth.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, why?%SPEECH_OFF%}
621e553277019d96adbe.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你向%employer%报告，%objective%已经攻下，并完全控制。他用手掩住笑意，勉强保持体面，仿佛贵族不该像平民那样失态兴奋。他只是点点头，好像早已料到这个消息。%SPEECH_ON%好，很好。当然。%SPEECH_OFF%他打了个响指，一名仆人便递给你一袋%reward_completion%克朗。 | 你一走进%employer%的房间，成群的指挥官、副官，连同贵族本人，全都安静下来。他直起身。%SPEECH_ON%我的小鸟已经报告，%objective%被攻下了。你的报酬在外面。%SPEECH_OFF%这些头头几乎连谢都没谢，不过在你看来，%reward_completion%克朗已经谢得十分充分。 | %employer%请你进入作战室，一群指挥官围在桌上的地图旁。你看着他们把一枚己方标记推到%objective%上。%employer%咧嘴笑道。%SPEECH_ON%那些人也许不肯说出来，可我们对你的表现非常满意。密探带回的故事让我确信，花钱雇你这种人，是笔好投资。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族亲手交给你一袋%reward_completion%克朗。 | %employer%的房间像个忙碌的蜂巢。指挥官们来回奔走，无论身处房间哪一头、相隔多远，都在彼此争论。仆人则闪躲穿梭，确保他们吃喝周全。战争时期，可不能把精力浪费在自己拿披风、自己做饭这种琐事上。你甚至奇怪，竟没有仆人趁争论间隙，把食物一口口喂进他们嘴里。

 不过，%employer%只是待在一旁翻书，仿佛独自坐在鸟鸣啾啾的花园里。他抬头，看看将领，又看看你。%SPEECH_ON%干得好。你的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%一只箱子缓缓推到你面前，里面放着%reward_completion%克朗。 | 一名仆人在%employer%的房门外拦住你，解释道。%SPEECH_ON%我奉命在这里等您，把这袋%reward_completion%克朗交给您。%SPEECH_OFF%你接过钱袋，点了点头。 | 你想走进%employer%的房间，却被守卫拦住。%SPEECH_ON%只许贵族入内。%SPEECH_OFF%你推开挡在面前的长戟，说自己找%employer%有事。守卫又把长戟压了回来。%SPEECH_ON%只许贵族入内。%SPEECH_OFF%你正要争辩，一名仆人提着大钱袋走出房间。他看见%companyname%的纹章，便把钱袋交给你。%SPEECH_ON%您的%reward_completion%克朗。抱歉，领主和指挥官们正在忙。%SPEECH_OFF%话音刚落，仆人便走了。守卫居高临下地看着你。%SPEECH_ON%只许贵族入内。%SPEECH_OFF% | 协助攻下%objective%的回报，是%reward_completion%克朗，以及一扇在你面前砰地关上的门。%employer%正忙着与指挥官们争论，没空给你更多祝贺。 | %employer%的一名指挥官在前厅接待你，身旁仆人提着一只大钱袋。指挥官开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%啊，%companyname%。你这行当可没多少荣誉，佣兵。做个真正的男人吧，和贵族一起作战。我们做的事，才有莫大的荣誉。何不加入我们？%SPEECH_OFF%装着%reward_completion%克朗的大钱袋落进你手中。你朝指挥官微笑，金光映亮了牙齿边缘。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，为什么呢？%SPEECH_OFF%}

da667ccdd866cf367a00.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]What a disaster. The battle is lost and you retreat to spare what men you have left. %objective% will not fall anytime soon.
da667ccdd866cf367a00.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]真是一场灾难。战斗输了，你撤退以保全剩下的弟兄。%objective%短期内是攻不下来了。

da7ef89c8dd29376463a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]{The passage of time as a concept seems to have eluded you. Despite your absence, the siege tried to go on, but eventually collapsed without the expected help of the %companyname%. Don't bother returning to %employer%. | You were hired to help the siege, not abandon it. Without the %companyname% by their side, the soldiers will likely have to withdraw from the field. | You strayed too far from the siege! Without your help, the attackers had to retreat and %objective% was spared %employer%'s conquest. Considering that was what you were hired to help accomplish, it's probably for the best that you do not return to the nobleman.}
da7ef89c8dd29376463a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]{你似乎完全忘了时间还会流逝。你不在时，围城部队仍试图坚持，可迟迟等不到%companyname%的援助，最后还是功亏一篑。别再回去见%employer%了。 | 雇你来是帮忙围城的，不是让你临阵走人的。少了%companyname%并肩作战，士兵们恐怕只能撤离战场了。 | 你离围城部队太远了！得不到你的援助，攻城部队只得撤退，%objective%也因此逃过了被%employer%征服的命运。既然你受雇就是为了协助攻下那里，眼下最好还是别回去见那位贵族了。}

40a5a302aaeb514e1b86.source: Wandered off during the siege of
40a5a302aaeb514e1b86.translation: 围城期间擅自离开，目标：

768fa84d26452e46fe0e.source: Let some of their men go free after battle
768fa84d26452e46fe0e.translation: 战后释放了他们的一些人

f5dc6265892555abf637.source: Took part in the siege of

6158c3213782c48d9943.source: Beat down the uprising of the indebted at the %location% near %townname%
6158c3213782c48d9943.translation: 前往%townname%附近的%location%，镇压负债者起义

03970097c072dc367ffb.source: Hunt down the indebted that are now resorting to banditry around %townname%
03970097c072dc367ffb.translation: 追剿在%townname%附近落草为寇的负债者

c082bee1bfcb8ba4b948.source: Hunt down the indebted that are fleeing from %townname%

68b4448bbbe0d5ce4acc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{Normally surrounded by contemplative opulence, %employer% is in a whirlwind of advisers and fellow Viziers, each counseling the other with snaps of their fingers and aggressive points on a map. Despite all the frenzy, a small servant threads through the crowd and comes to you with a scroll. He deftly explains that indebted have overtaken their masters in %townname%'s %location%.%SPEECH_ON%A Crownling's services are requested. If you wish to partake in the restoration of normative statuses for all parties involved, and for the betterment of indebted and master alike, please take this here pen and cross an X here on the scroll.%SPEECH_OFF%He stares at you and you at him. He sighs and taps the page.%SPEECH_ON%Your pay, if accepted, here. %reward% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF% | As you approach %employer%'s rooms, a pair of guards move to stick you with the business ends of their halberds. This elicits shouting and hurried footsteps from down the hall as an interfering servant comes sprinting down.%SPEECH_ON%Guards! These sloppily dressed travelers are Crownlings. Apologies, Crownling, we are on edge for the very reason the Viziers may need your assistance: the indebted have overtaken the %location% in %townname%. The uprising may spread from there.%SPEECH_OFF%The servant produces a scroll and hands it over. It states that there are %reward% crowns awaiting those who squash the revolt of the indebted, and the scroll bears the sigil of %townname%'s various Viziers. | The Viziers of %townname% are together in their war room and there is more tension than usual in the air. You are gated off from getting anywhere close to them. You're not sure how, but large golden bars have been brought down from the ceiling. They talk amongst themselves, nodding now and again, before handing a servant a scroll. You watch as the servant rushes to you. He hands it over, and then repeats its words from memory.%SPEECH_ON%The indebted have overrun their masters and thence taken over the %location%. %reward% crowns are available to dispatch to the coffers of the man or mans who will crush this band of upstarts.%SPEECH_OFF%}
68b4448bbbe0d5ce4acc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{平日里，%employer%总在奢华陈设间安然沉思，如今却被顾问和其他维齐尔围得团团转。众人争相出谋划策，响指不断，手指在地图上戳得咄咄逼人。一片纷乱中，一个瘦小的仆人穿过人群，拿着卷轴来到你面前。他利落地解释说，%townname%的%location%发生了变乱，负债者已经推翻了主人。%SPEECH_ON%我们需要克朗客效劳。若您愿意协助所有相关人员恢复正常身份，使负债者与主人双方都从中受益，请拿起这支笔，在卷轴这里画个叉。%SPEECH_OFF%他看着你，你也看着他。他叹了口气，点点纸面。%SPEECH_ON%您若接下，报酬在这里。%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你正朝%employer%的房间走去，两名卫兵却挺起长戟，用锋刃拦住了你。走廊那头随即传来喊声与急促的脚步，一个仆人飞奔而来，出声阻止。%SPEECH_ON%卫兵！这些衣着邋遢的旅人是克朗客。抱歉，克朗客，我们如此紧张，恰恰是因为维齐尔可能需要您帮忙的那件事：负债者占领了%townname%的%location%。叛乱可能会从那里蔓延开来。%SPEECH_OFF%仆人取出一份卷轴，交到你手里。上面写着，谁能镇压负债者的叛乱，谁便能领到%reward%克朗；文末盖着%townname%各位维齐尔的印记。 | %townname%的维齐尔们齐聚议事厅，气氛比平日更加紧张。你被一道栅栏挡住，无法靠近。不知用了什么机关，粗大的金色栏杆竟从天花板上降了下来。他们交头接耳，不时点头，最后将一份卷轴交给仆人。你看着仆人匆匆跑来。他递上卷轴，又凭记忆复述其中的内容。%SPEECH_ON%负债者反抗主人，继而占据了%location%。凡有人率众剿灭这群妄图犯上的暴徒，即可获赏%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%}

06315a33146230ef1147.source: {They stand no chance. | We'll make an example out of them. | We'll retake the %location%.}
06315a33146230ef1147.translation: {他们毫无胜算。 | 我们要拿他们杀一儆百。 | 我们会夺回%location%。}

56cdfea24ee36ae0304f.source: {This doesn't sound like our kind of work. | I don't think so. | We're not in the business of fighting former slaves.}
56cdfea24ee36ae0304f.translation: {听起来，这不是我们干的活儿。 | 恐怕不行。 | 我们不靠对付从前的奴隶谋生。}

2466e9fd47035b03de32.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{The indebted at %location% see you coming and you hope the presence of your weapons will help deter them from continuing whatever freedom seeking they've undertaken. Shockingly, they do not lay down their arms but merely come together to stand against you. They are a crude lot, an arrangement of those whom enforced labor and recruitment has put the number on. | You find the indebted and they stare back with a very clear understanding of why you are there. The arrangement of participants, yourself armed to the teeth, coming by way of town, the indebted, armed with whatever they scavenged, far from their chains. They are a motley, sad assembly, but you know well that whatever they lack in weaponry they more than make up for in desire. A taste of freedom is nothing if not a sharpening effect. | As described, the indebted have taken over the %location% and armed themselves with whatever they could find. Upon seeing you, they hurry to some notion of formation, but they lack training, discipline, food, and much else. What they have, though, is no desire to return to whence they came which can be as sharp and dangerous a steel as any.}
2466e9fd47035b03de32.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{%location%的负债者看见了你。你本希望，光是你们手里的武器，就足以吓退他们，让他们放弃这场追求自由的行动。可出乎意料，他们没有放下武器，反而聚在一起，摆出了迎战的架势。这是一群粗陋而疲惫的人，强征与苦役在他们身上留下了深深的伤痕。 | 你找到负债者，他们也望着你，显然很清楚你的来意。双方的处境一目了然：你全副武装，从城里而来；负债者远离了锁链，手中只有东拼西凑的武器。这群人杂乱而凄凉，但你很清楚，他们缺少的装备，足以用那份渴望弥补。尝过自由的滋味，人也会变得锋利。 | 情况果如所述，负债者占领了%location%，找来一切能用作武器的东西。一看见你，他们便匆忙摆出一个勉强算是阵形的架势。他们缺乏训练、纪律和食物，还缺许许多多的东西。可他们有一样东西：绝不愿回到原来的日子。这样的决心，与任何钢刃一样锋利，一样危险。}

7fdde91b590c88dab369.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{The uprising has been crushed. In death, the faces of the slaves do seem to carry some relief, as though the end of all things is preferred to the relentless cruelty of living in the chain. %employer% and the Viziers will be awaiting your return.}
7fdde91b590c88dab369.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{起义已被镇压。奴隶死后的脸上，似乎还带着一丝宽慰，仿佛比起锁链下永无止境的残酷，万事终结倒更可取。%employer%和维齐尔们正等着你回去。}

8a337d8384a315e1aee4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_176.png[/img]{You get to the %location% to find it burned to the ground and ransacked. A survivor stumbles out of the blackened ashes of a building. He explains the indebted set themselves upon everyone available, ravishing the women, killing children, stole everything of value and then split off into the hinterland. | The uprising of the indebted has long since departed %location%, leaving behind a wake of destruction and death. A number of survivors stumble about picking up their things. Those who can still speak talk of horrors, the indebted basically setting upon the area like savages, killing, ravishing, robbing. A man with rags over his eyes says he heard them talk about heading into the countryside and splitting up there.%SPEECH_ON%They're simple bandits now. Animals who have tasted the blood, for them there is no return to the safety of the chain. They are lost.%SPEECH_OFF%}
8a337d8384a315e1aee4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_176.png[/img]{你赶到%location%，却发现这里已经遭到洗劫，被烧成了一片废墟。一个幸存者踉跄着从屋舍焦黑的残骸中走出。他说，负债者见人就下手，强暴妇女，杀害孩子，抢走一切值钱的东西，随后便分散逃进了内陆荒野。 | 叛乱的负债者早已离开%location%，身后只剩毁坏与死亡。几个幸存者跌跌撞撞地翻找自己的东西。还能说出话的人，讲述着遭遇的惨事：负债者像野蛮人一般扑进这里，杀人、强暴、抢劫。一个用破布蒙着眼睛的男人说，他听见那些人商量，要逃到乡野里，再分头散去。%SPEECH_ON%他们如今就是一群强盗。畜生尝过了血，就再也回不到锁链庇护下的安稳日子。他们已经无可救药了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

01b4096c7225c2d1ab68.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{You look down at the corpse of a slave, his body molded by labors of a prior life, but in his hands and around his neck the adornments of stolen weapons and loot. In a cruel turn of thought, you find it strange that they would have been easier to put down had they simply no ambition at all besides their freedom. But it was their greed and sense of wanting that made them all the more dangerous. But. They're dead. And the Viziers of %townname% will be happy regardless of whatever lofty goals the indebted had.}
01b4096c7225c2d1ab68.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{你俯视一具奴隶的尸体。旧日苦役塑成了他的身躯，手里和脖子上却挂着抢来的武器与财物。一个残酷的念头浮现：若他们除了自由再无所求，反而更容易被镇压。正是贪欲与渴望，让他们更加危险。不过，他们已经死了。负债者怀着多么崇高的目标都无所谓，%townname%的维齐尔们终究会高兴。}

1e9c4878fbc793278967.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_166.png[/img]{You find the indebted sitting amongst desert rocks and they do not rise to your arrival. Instead, one man comes to you. Despite his powerful build, you sense that he has come to barter, a diplomatic tongue bedded in all his muscle.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, I figured you would come. My name is %spartacus%, the chosen leader of these freedom seekers, insofar as the open cage is the leader of the bird who wishes to fly. You arrive to us by way of the gilded road, lead by the chain of unseen gold, promises which you cannot guarantee to be kept, and it is upon these forgeries of agreement, these misunderstood arrangements, that you are to come and kill or capture us. Is that so?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. %spartacus% nods back.%SPEECH_ON%So it is. Before we commit ourselves to our agreements, ourselves to be masters of our own hands, and yourself slave to the mighty crown, let me try and negotiate in a manner which you, Crownling, will find beneficial.%SPEECH_OFF%The man kneels.%SPEECH_ON%I am the scion to a lost family, to a lost heritage, to a lost estate. These people, these men, are my family now. But from my previous life I have something which you may find valuable.%SPEECH_OFF%He holds out a piece of paper.%SPEECH_ON%Let us go and I will write upon this paper here the location of treasures which you cannot find elsewhere.
