Attack us, and I shall take my family's final heirlooms to the grave, and gasp my final breath not in concern with such lost riches, but with to breathe the fierce fire of freedom itself, glistening in my lungs, the pain preferable to the comforts of any chain.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1e9c4878fbc793278967.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_166.png[/img]{你发现那群负债者坐在沙漠的岩石间。你到来时，他们也没有起身，只有一个男人走上前来。他体格健壮，你却感觉他是来谈条件的，那一身肌肉里，藏着条善于交涉的舌头。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，我料到你会来。我叫%spartacus%，是这些追求自由之人选出的领袖。不过，若说我是领袖，也只是那扇敞开的笼门，引领着渴望飞翔的鸟。你沿着镀金之路来到这里，被看不见的金链牵着，追逐那些无法保证兑现的许诺。就是凭着这些虚假的契约、这些被误解的安排，你来杀死或抓捕我们，是这样吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。%spartacus%也点头回应。%SPEECH_ON%那么，事情便是如此。我们要做自己双手的主人，你要做克朗威力下的奴仆。在各自履行约定之前，让我试着用一种对你有利的方式谈谈，克朗客。%SPEECH_OFF%男人跪了下来。%SPEECH_ON%我曾是一个家族的后裔，如今家族没了，传承断了，庄园也丢了。这些人，这些弟兄，如今就是我的家人。但从前的生活还留下了一样东西，你或许会觉得有价值。%SPEECH_OFF%他举起一张纸。%SPEECH_ON%放我们走，我就在这张纸上写下宝藏的位置，那是你在别处找不到的珍物。若你攻来，我便将家族最后的遗产一并带进坟墓。咽下最后一口气时，我不会挂念失去的财富，只会尽情呼吸自由的烈焰，让它在肺腑中灼灼生辉。我宁愿承受那样的痛，也不要任何锁链带来的安稳。%SPEECH_OFF%}

ee83b1c6c58df9398c57.source: I agree to your terms. You shall have your freedom.
ee83b1c6c58df9398c57.translation: 我接受你的条件。你们自由了。

a9626f4d1b05e5eae6f4.source: This is just business. Your little rebellion is about to be crushed.
a9626f4d1b05e5eae6f4.translation: 这只是生意。你们这场小小的叛乱，马上就要被碾碎了。

e5e681767735bcd13215.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_166.png[/img]{You stick your hand out. %spartacus% sticks out his. He speaks.%SPEECH_ON%So it is.%SPEECH_OFF%He holds up a pencil made of rock and some black powdery rock at its tip. He points at a far away stone.%SPEECH_ON%As we leave, I will write the location of my family's heirlooms there. Now I see upon your face the question of whether I am lying or not. Such uncertainty is the price of freedom, no? To be unsure of where you go, but to do so of your own mind. That is true freedom. The comfort of the cage is for birds who do not wish to fly, Crownling. May your travels upon the gilded road be as fruitful as our first steps.%SPEECH_OFF%}
e5e681767735bcd13215.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_166.png[/img]{你伸出手，%spartacus%也伸出手。他说道：%SPEECH_ON%那就说定了。%SPEECH_OFF%他举起一支石头做的笔，笔尖是一小块乌黑、易掉粉末的石料。他指向远处的一块石头。%SPEECH_ON%我们离开时，我会在那里写下家族遗物的位置。看你的神情，正在猜我有没有说谎吧。但这种不确定，正是自由的代价，不是吗？不知道前路通向何方，却依自己的意愿迈步，这才是真正的自由。克朗客，笼中的安逸，是留给那些不愿飞翔的鸟的。愿你在镀金之路上的旅途，能像我们踏出的第一步一样，收获丰厚。%SPEECH_OFF%}

5293b69fad361750c1bc.source: Enjoy your freedom while it lasts.

37920d8ce55b796da7df.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_166.png[/img]{%spartacus% sticks his hand out, but you do not stick out yours. Instead, you draw your sword. The rebellion's leader nods.%SPEECH_ON%Alright. You are forbidden to leave the cage of the crown, I see, and you are bidden to the glistening of the gilded road, so urgent your enslavement, so captured, that when the gate is open you do not open your wings, instead you settle for a mere hop to the master's finger. May battle treat us well, Crownling.%SPEECH_OFF%}
37920d8ce55b796da7df.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_166.png[/img]{%spartacus%伸出手，你却没有回应，而是拔出了剑。叛军首领点头。%SPEECH_ON%明白了，你走不出克朗的囚笼，只能服从那条金光闪烁的道路。你受奴役如此之深，被囚得如此彻底，以至于笼门打开，也不肯展翅，只肯轻轻一跳，落上主人的手指。克朗客，愿这场战斗善待我们。%SPEECH_OFF%}

d7a6cb8a4652f468a09f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{You stand over %spartacus%. Despite his fondness for freedom, the rebellion's dead leader is not smiling in his final, liberated moment. His face is wrenched in pain and he has wounds which reveal the slick patterns of that which folds beneath the flesh. But his eyes. There is a spark there, staring up at the sky. A shadow crosses his eyes and you look up expecting a bird, but there is nothing. When you look down, the spark is gone and the dead man is just a dead man.}
d7a6cb8a4652f468a09f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{你站在%spartacus%的遗体前。尽管热爱自由，这位死去的叛军领袖却没有在最终解脱时微笑。他的脸因疼痛而扭曲，伤口露出皮肉下湿滑盘曲的内脏。可那双眼睛里，还有一点火光，仰望着天空。一道影子掠过眼瞳，你以为是飞鸟，抬头却空无一物。再低头时，火光已灭，死人便只是死人。}

b93f622b27dff6dc8ac6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{You find a pile of rankled shackles which are hot to the touch. An old man points his hand north.%SPEECH_ON%The freed men went that way.%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask him why he'd rat out the indebted. He smiles.%SPEECH_ON%I've work that needs finishing and sometimes the Viziers lend me a few. Hard to get a good task done with just my own two hands.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come across a long trail of sand and dirt and scrub which has clearly suffered northbound disturbances. Amongst the littered path you find a shackle, the last bit of evidence needed. The indebted have turned in north and you'll have to hunt them down. | You find a shackle flailing from the bush of desert scrub. An old man sipping water from a mug grunts and points northward.%SPEECH_ON%The indebted rabbited that way. If you manage to gather them back to the Vizier, perhaps put in a good word for me. I could use a man or two around here to fetch water. No freedmen ever fetches me water.%SPEECH_OFF%You'll not be putting in a word for nobody, but thank him anyway and head north.}
b93f622b27dff6dc8ac6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{你发现一堆缠在一起的镣铐，摸上去烫手。一个老人抬手指向北方。%SPEECH_ON%那些自由人往那边去了。%SPEECH_OFF%你有些好奇，问他为什么出卖这些负债者。老人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%我有活儿没干完，维齐尔有时会借我几个。光靠自己这双手，可干不成多少事。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你发现一条穿过沙地、泥土与灌丛的长长踪迹，沿途翻乱的痕迹明显朝着北方。散落的杂物中还有一副镣铐，最后这点证据也齐了。负债者转向了北方，你得继续追上去。 | 一副镣铐挂在沙漠灌木上，晃晃荡荡。一个老人端着杯子喝水，哼了一声，朝北一指。%SPEECH_ON%那些负债者往那边窜了。你要是把他们抓回维齐尔那里，能不能替我说句好话？我这里正缺一两个人打水，可从没哪个自由人肯替我打水。%SPEECH_OFF%你可没打算替谁说好话，但还是道了声谢，继续向北走去。}

bb0ba8565798d938a08a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{You finally catch up to the indebted. They're rough roaders by now, the bleak terrain which they have crossed having left its own marks upon them as they have upon it. But they've not come this far to just to give up: the whole lot arm themselves at the very sight of you and make their own approach. | The indebted are found in a desperate state, insofar as the journey has given them free breath, they've paid for it with mind and body alike. The sunburned, beleaguered and ragged men approach with eyes both wide and weary. You know by the wild stares that they've no quit left in them. They'll be fighting it out one way or another.}
bb0ba8565798d938a08a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{你终于追上了那群负债者。如今，他们已是饱经颠沛的流亡者。他们踏过荒凉的大地，在大地上留下伤痕，大地也将痕迹刻在了他们身上。但走到这里，可不是为了束手就擒：一看见你，所有人便拿起武器，主动迎了上来。 | 找到负债者时，他们已身心俱疲。一路逃亡，让他们得以自由呼吸，却也榨尽了他们的心力与体力。这些被烈日晒伤、衣衫褴褛、困顿不堪的男人向你走来，双眼睁大，满是疲惫。你从那狂乱的目光中看得出，他们已经没有退让的念头。无论如何，这一场非打不可。}

f6374a39ba8b81bcbdcd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{Putting an end to the indebted is a simple matter once it is all said and done. Any survivors make themselves incapable of a return, instead preferring the steel demise. In their skin you are not sure you would choose it any different. You collect what evidences you can and ready a return to %employer%.}
f6374a39ba8b81bcbdcd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_168.png[/img]{到了最后，了结这些负债者已十分简单。幸存者宁可死在刀下，也决不再被带回去。换作是你，恐怕也不会作出不同选择。你收集能找到的凭证，准备返回%employer%那里。}

3fed34cf600b76ccbc78.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{You do not find %employer% with a harem or swimming in wine. Instead you find him strutting about with an empty bird cage at his side. He somberly states that his favorite bird got out and flew away.%SPEECH_ON%Do not consider me dull witted, Crownling, I see that you might find similarity between my pet and my indebted. Feel free, if I may say, to do so. But you are shortsighted to think in such a manner. My bird will fly free, and to the world be of no use than to be consumed. But this is not freedom, Crownling, to resume a duty which birth had given it. Freedom was its escape from such a doom, an escape to my world, an escape not afforded to many of its kind.%SPEECH_OFF%The Vizier snaps his fingers and a servant appears seemingly from nowhere. He hands you a purse of coins. You look up to see the Vizier set the cage down and walk away. | %employer% is buried amongst the limbs of his, in the guard's words, 'favorite harem.' He pokes his mouth out and you get the sense his eyes stare at you from the nook of a sweaty knee, though there's no real telling.%SPEECH_ON%The victorious Crownling returns to feast his weary eyes upon my finest wares. And it is so, my scouts say, that you laid to waste those upstart indebted, and that the message of their death has been reissued as a new utility, a kind word, written by your hand, Crownling, as warning to all other of the indebted.%SPEECH_OFF%The Vizier disappears momentarily, then reemerges between a woman's thighs.%SPEECH_ON%Servants! Pay the Crownling.%SPEECH_OFF%Two wiry-framed boys carry over a small chest and leave it at your feet. It is quite heavy, and you are offered no help carrying it out. | A man in chains meets you outside %employer%'s rooms. He has a chain attached to each arm. One chain runs to the wall, the other chain rankles across the floor to a chest of crowns. Both chains are held by a lock. And this man has the key. He stares at you, his fingers gripping and ungripping the key, his breath uneven. He finally squats and unlocks the lock to your chest which you take up and step back. The slave holds the key at his chest, and he glances at the other lock, and he folds his hand around the key and bows his head and there comes a noise you're not sure what to make of. A guard tells him to keep it quiet before ushering you out the door.}
3fed34cf600b76ccbc78.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{这一次，%employer%身旁没有成群的姬妾，也没有流不尽的美酒。他只是在屋里踱步，手边提着一只空鸟笼。他神情黯然，说最心爱的鸟逃出笼子，飞走了。%SPEECH_ON%别把我当傻子，克朗客。我知道，你或许觉得我的宠物与我的负债者颇为相似。尽管这么想好了，我不介意。不过，你这样想，未免太短视。我的鸟将自由飞翔，可对这世界而言，它除了成为腹中之物，再无别的用处。但这不是自由，克朗客。这只是重新担起它生来就背负的命运。逃离那种厄运、逃进我的世界，才是自由。它的同类中，能有这份福气的可不多。%SPEECH_OFF%维齐尔打了个响指，一名仆人仿佛凭空出现，递给你一袋钱。你抬头时，看见维齐尔放下鸟笼，独自走开了。 | %employer%埋在一堆交缠的肢体中。按卫兵的说法，那都是他‘最宠爱的姬妾’。他只露出嘴来，你觉得他的眼睛正从一处汗涔涔的膝弯里盯着你，却也实在无法确定。%SPEECH_ON%凯旋的克朗客回来了，让我这些上等珍藏，好好慰劳你疲惫的双眼吧。斥候告诉我，你已将那些犯上的负债者尽数消灭。他们的死讯，又有了新的用处：克朗客，那是你亲笔写下的一句善言，告诫其他所有负债者。%SPEECH_OFF%维齐尔消失片刻，又从一个女人的双腿间冒出来。%SPEECH_ON%仆人！给克朗客付钱。%SPEECH_OFF%两个瘦削的男孩抬来一只小箱子，放在你脚边。箱子沉得很，却没人肯帮你抬出去。 | %employer%的房门外，一个戴着锁链的男人来迎接你。他双臂各系着一条链子，一条通向墙壁，另一条蜿蜒拖过地面，连着装满克朗的钱箱。两条链子都有锁，钥匙却在他自己手里。他盯着你，手指在钥匙上攥紧又松开，呼吸时紧时缓。终于，他蹲下来，打开钱箱上的锁。你提起箱子，退后一步。奴隶将钥匙举到胸前，瞥了一眼另一把锁，又将钥匙握进掌心。他低下头，发出一声你说不清是什么的声音。卫兵喝令他安静，随后将你送出门去。}

95ad994c9888c3551de2.source: A group of indebted that turned to banditry.
95ad994c9888c3551de2.translation: 一群落草为寇的负债者。

2d1210fd645d54c78f5d.source: Sided with indebted in their uprising
2d1210fd645d54c78f5d.translation: 在负债者起义中站到了他们一边

e59da4a9b2a8c9f0af35.source: Recruit at least one more man

26cc8da22b4c9efc7084.source: Buy weapons and armor for your men
26cc8da22b4c9efc7084.translation: 为弟兄们购买武器和护甲

e3aecbf94951ffa74897.source: Return to %employer% in %townname% to get paid

7f548083e3b82ddc380d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_21.png[/img]It all went wrong. Two days ago the company was hired to track down %boss% and his band of raiders, but it was them who found you first. An ambush. Some joke about horses, cut short by an arrow to the throat. Arrows shooting in from everywhere and nowhere. Men holler and scream, a great volume before death.

As the hail subsides you draw your weapon with the rest of the men, only to collapse to your knees. An arrow has punctured your side. You shout in pain. A harried glance sees the men charge without you to make a valiant last stand, met in force as steel clashes with steel.

You meet eyes with the captain, a last nod before his throat is cut. You're left in command now of what few men remain. Trembling in pain you lean on your sword and with all the will you can muster slowly rise again...
7f548083e3b82ddc380d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_21.png[/img]全完了。两天前，战团受雇追捕%boss%和他手下的掠夺者，结果却是他们先找到了你们。一场伏击。有人正讲着关于马的笑话，话未说完，一支箭便贯穿了喉咙。箭矢从四面八方射来，却看不见射手。弟兄们呼喊、惨叫，临死前的声音震耳欲聋。

箭雨稍歇，你和其他人一同拔出武器，却突然双膝跪地。一支箭射进了你的腰侧，剧痛让你喊出声来。慌乱中抬眼望去，弟兄们已撇下你冲了出去，要拼死一搏。敌人迎面压来，刀剑激烈相撞。

你与团长四目相对。他最后朝你点了点头，下一刻，喉咙便被割开。如今，剩下的这几个弟兄，只能由你来带领了。你疼得浑身发抖，撑着长剑，竭尽所能地聚起意志，缓缓地，再次站起……

4905a7ee3e59940e07ae.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]You're alive. You won.

The adrenaline fades and in its wake you can't help but sink back to the ground. Gritting your teeth, you snap the arrow's shaft. Your chest heaves, pain for breath, everything blurs.

The company has been devastated, cut down to but a few men. And that bastard Hoggart did justice to his name, fleeing like the weasel he is.%SPEECH_ON%What now, captain?%SPEECH_OFF%A voice says from behind. It's %bro2% who sits down beside you, bedding his bloodied axe on his legs. You turn to him to reply, but before you can answer he continues.%SPEECH_ON%Bernhard's dead. They slit his throat. He was a good man and a damn good leader, but all it took was one mistake. That makes you the one in charge now, don't it?%SPEECH_OFF%%bro3% joins the two of you, still breathing heavily. Then %bro1%.%SPEECH_ON%Save the ceremony and anointments for another day. Let's give the men a good burial and return to %townname% to collect our pay. The weasel's men are slain, afterall. Besides, captain, we ought to see to that wound before we lose you, too. Wouldn't want to leave %bro3% in charge, right?%SPEECH_OFF%
4905a7ee3e59940e07ae.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]你还活着。你们赢了。

拼杀时的亢奋渐渐退去，你再也支撑不住，重新跌坐在地。咬紧牙关，你折断了箭杆。胸膛起伏，每次呼吸都牵动剧痛，眼前的一切渐渐模糊。

战团遭受重创，只剩下寥寥几人。至于霍加特那个混蛋，倒真没辱没“黄鼠狼”的名头，溜得无影无踪。%SPEECH_ON%接下来怎么办，团长？%SPEECH_OFF%身后传来一个声音。是%bro2%。他在你身旁坐下，将染血的斧头搁在腿上。你转头想回答，他却又接着说了下去。%SPEECH_ON%伯恩哈德死了。他们割了他的喉咙。他是个好人，更是个他妈的好团长，可只错了一步，就全完了。如今该由你领着咱们，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%%bro3%走到你们身边，仍在大口喘气，随后%bro1%也来了。%SPEECH_ON%那些仪式和加冕，就留到改天吧。先好好安葬弟兄们，再回%townname%领工钱。毕竟，那只黄鼠狼的手下已经死光了。还有，团长，你那伤也得赶紧处理，可别把你也搭进去。咱们总不想让%bro3%来当家，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%

5c60fe572c2aa32315e2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]What a sorry display it must be for the onlookers as you arrive in %townname%. Four bloodied and beaten mercenaries down on their luck. The man who hired the company days ago, %employer%, no doubt expected you to return in a more glorious fashion.

Still, he welcomes you to his house and offers bread and wine while a servant fetches a healer. Few words are exchanged except for the occasional grunt and wheeze as an elderly man with shaky hands tends your wounds. A pin pierces your skin, the first of many stitches to come. You grit your teeth 'til you think you hear one break. %employer% sits beside you and asks if you took care of Hoggart. You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%We killed his men, but the weasel eluded our blades in the end.%SPEECH_OFF%The healer waves around a glowing firepoke, suggesting he wants to push it into your wound. You nod and he does so. For a moment, that's all there is. You're not a man, but a pinch of fire, flesh from flame, a golem of pain. %employer% hands you a goblet of wine.%SPEECH_ON%You did well, sellsword. The brigands have been removed, though it is a shame that Hoggart still lives.%SPEECH_OFF%
5c60fe572c2aa32315e2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你们抵达%townname%时，在旁人眼里想必狼狈极了：四个浑身是血、伤痕累累的佣兵，倒霉透顶。几天前雇下战团的%employer%，无疑曾盼着你们凯旋而归。

不过，他还是将你们请进宅邸，拿出面包与葡萄酒，让仆人去找医师。一位双手颤抖的老人替你处理伤口，屋里没什么交谈，只有你偶尔的闷哼与喘息。针尖刺入皮肤，漫长的缝合才刚刚开始。你咬紧牙关，几乎听见牙齿崩裂的声音。%employer%坐在身边，问霍加特是否已经解决。你摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%他的手下被我们杀光了，可那只黄鼠狼最终还是逃过了我们的刀。%SPEECH_OFF%医师晃了晃烧红的铁钎，示意要将它按进你的伤口。你点头，他便动手了。有那么一瞬间，你的世界只剩那一处灼烧。你不再是人，而是一簇火、一团从火中扯出的血肉，一个由疼痛捏成的傀儡。%employer%递给你一杯葡萄酒。%SPEECH_ON%你们干得不错，佣兵。匪徒已经清除，可惜霍加特还活着。%SPEECH_OFF%

6fa22c268372e61eb4b9.source: We expect to get paid for this.
6fa22c268372e61eb4b9.translation: 做这件事，我们是要收钱的。

53ce4201033a279be9df.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%employer% gasps.%SPEECH_ON%Well, naturally! 400 crowns as agreed upon.%SPEECH_OFF%He gestures towards a servant who rushes to your side with the pay in hand.%SPEECH_ON%I wonder... may I make use of your services one more time? I'd very much like to end the headache that is Hoggart once and for all. And I would pay you again, of course. Another 400 crowns, shall we say?%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2% scoffs and turns to drink more wine, but %bro1% stands to speak.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, the company is in ruin, but we will rebuild it! Without the %companyname%, %bro2% would drink the crowns away and end up begging on the streets, and %bro3%, by the gods we all know he'd go chasing the womenfolk until one stove his rotted head in. We need the %companyname%, it's all we have! What say you, captain?%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2% burps and raises his cup to you. %bro3% playfully thumbs his nose and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Kill that bastard Hoggart or not, it's up to you, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%
53ce4201033a279be9df.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%employer%吸了口气。%SPEECH_ON%啊，当然！按约定，400克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%他朝仆人示意，后者立刻捧着酬金赶到你身旁。%SPEECH_ON%我在想……能否再请你们办一次事？我很想彻底解决霍加特这个麻烦。当然，我会另外付钱。再给400克朗，怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2%嗤了一声，转身继续喝酒，%bro1%却站起身来。%SPEECH_ON%没错，战团是垮了，可咱们能把它重新建起来！没了%companyname%，%bro2%会把钱全喝进肚子，最后上街讨饭。至于%bro3%，诸神作证，谁都知道他会到处追女人，直到某个女人把他那颗烂脑袋砸开。咱们需要%companyname%，这是咱们仅剩的了！团长，你怎么说？%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2%打了个酒嗝，朝你举杯。%bro3%嬉皮笑脸地拇指一抵鼻头，也点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%宰不宰霍加特那个混蛋，全听你的，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%

5efbb0d0d395b7ac9fc1.source: Yes, we have unfinished business with Hoggart.
5efbb0d0d395b7ac9fc1.translation: 没错，我们和霍加特还有一笔账没算。

e71198f61c037602a03f.source: No, we'll find our fortune elsewhere.
e71198f61c037602a03f.translation: 不，我们去别处碰碰运气。

ce13bfd292440378319c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%employer% claps his hands in satisfaction.%SPEECH_ON%Excellent! My little birds will need some time to find where Hoggart is hiding his hide now. In the meantime, I suggest you see about stocking up on supplies so that you'll be good and ready to end this when the time comes. I shall see you in a few days' time at the latest!%SPEECH_OFF%As you leave %employer%'s house and stand on the outskirts of %townname%, %bro1% seeks a word with you.%SPEECH_ON%We need more men, captain. I know I gave a big speech back there, but bravado won't do shite. We need more warm bodies in the ranks. Figure we find three good men, buy them some decent weapons, and dress them in the best armor we can afford.%SPEECH_OFF%The man pauses to glance around.%SPEECH_ON%I bet this bodunk town's got a desperate peasant or two looking for a new life. Or we could travel to %bigcity% in the %citydirection%. Them cityfolk aren't always as hardy as these country bumpkins, but we're more likely to find men with fighting experience stopping to rest there.%SPEECH_OFF%
ce13bfd292440378319c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%employer%满意地拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%很好！我的耳目还需要些时间，才能查出霍加特如今躲在哪里。在那之前，我建议你们先补齐物资，等时机一到，就能准备妥当地把这事了结。最迟几天之后，我再见你！%SPEECH_OFF%离开%employer%的宅邸，来到%townname%郊外时，%bro1%找你说话。%SPEECH_ON%团长，咱们需要更多人手。我知道自己刚才说了一番豪言壮语，可光逞强顶个屁用。队伍里得添些活人。我看，先找三个好汉，给他们买点像样的兵器，再穿上咱们买得起的最好的甲。%SPEECH_OFF%他停下来，向四周望了望。%SPEECH_ON%这种穷乡僻壤，肯定有一两个走投无路、想换种活法的农夫。咱们也可以去%citydirection%方向的%bigcity%。城里人未必有这些乡下汉子耐折腾，不过更容易碰见有作战经验、正在那里歇脚的人。%SPEECH_OFF%

5b67bb59710a7f72ff00.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_77.png[/img]As %bigcity%'s skyline appears on the horizon, %bro3% seeks a word with you.%SPEECH_ON%Never been to %bigcity% before, but I've been around ones that look a lot like it. Cities like these are great for selling goods as all these prissy, pompous pricks love to have their goods delivered. With so many merchants, you can find almost everything you need, too. Keep an eye out for bargains, and don't get swindled by them cutthroat merchants.%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2% sees fit to add his own opinion of what you should do.%SPEECH_ON%If there's a good tavern, I say that's where we should go first. Nothing helps a man down on his luck more than a good pint. Gods know we earned it!%SPEECH_OFF%%bro3% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%You say that every time we stop into town! You say that even when you're already drunk!%SPEECH_OFF%
5b67bb59710a7f72ff00.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_77.png[/img]%bigcity%的轮廓出现在地平线上，%bro3%前来与你说话。%SPEECH_ON%我以前没来过%bigcity%，不过见过不少差不多的城市。这种地方最适合卖货，那些娇气又自大的混账，就爱等人把东西送上门。商人多，你需要的东西也几乎都能找到。多留心便宜货，别让那些奸商宰了。%SPEECH_OFF%%bro2%也觉得该说说自己的主意。%SPEECH_ON%要是有家好酒馆，我说咱们就先去那儿。对一个走背运的人，什么都不如一大杯好酒管用。诸神作证，咱们配喝这一杯！%SPEECH_OFF%%bro3%摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%每回进城你都这么说！就算已经喝醉了，你还是这么说！%SPEECH_OFF%

6039abefe41d5de634d2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%employer% is pacing back and forth when you find him. The healer who'd damn near killed you with the firepoke is standing nearby. He's picking chunks of dried blood out of his fingernails. %employer% claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Finally, you're here. I have good news! We got hold of one of Hoggart's former men! My good friend here had a nice little talk with the man and now I know where Hoggart's licking his wounds.%SPEECH_OFF%The healer clears his throat, splaying his fingers out like a maiden looking to paint them. He speaks as though he's identifying a disease he is about to excise.%SPEECH_ON%The brigand known as Hoggart is hiding in a small hut %terrain% to the %direction% of here. Based upon my most civil discussion with one of his men, Hoggart knows the  %companyname% is on his heels and will have gathered more men since the last time you met him.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, %employer% waves you off.%SPEECH_ON%Good luck, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%
6039abefe41d5de634d2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]找到%employer%时，他正来回踱步。那个拿烧红铁钎差点要了你命的医师也站在一旁，抠着指甲缝里的干血块。%employer%拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%你总算来了。有好消息！我们抓到了霍加特从前的一个手下！我这位好朋友同他好好聊了一场，如今我知道霍加特躲在哪儿舔伤口了。%SPEECH_OFF%医师清了清嗓子，张开手指，像个准备涂指甲的姑娘。他开口时，那语气仿佛在诊断一种即将切除的病症。%SPEECH_ON%那个叫霍加特的强盗，藏在此地%direction%方向的一间小屋里，就%terrain%。根据我与他一名手下极其文明的交谈，霍加特知道%companyname%正紧追不舍，想必已比你们上次见面时又招了更多人。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%点点头，挥手示意你出发。%SPEECH_ON%祝你好运，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%

c26105b4474812c557df.translation: 我们会提着他的人头回来！

57c9ce5ca2fbaeb5cfa6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]Hoggart lies dead in a pool of his own blood, skewered into a grotesque and panicked pose. He didn't weasel his way out of this one. You put a boot on his corpse and look to your men.%SPEECH_ON%For the company. For all the men who've fallen.%SPEECH_OFF%%bro3% spits on the dead man's face.%SPEECH_ON%Let's take this bastard's head and get back to %townname%%SPEECH_OFF%
57c9ce5ca2fbaeb5cfa6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]霍加特倒在自己的血泊里，身躯被刺穿，扭成一副怪诞而惊恐的模样。这一回，黄鼠狼没能溜掉。你一脚踏上他的尸体，望向弟兄们。%SPEECH_ON%为了战团。为了所有倒下的弟兄。%SPEECH_OFF%%bro3%往死人的脸上啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%带上这混蛋的脑袋，回%townname%。%SPEECH_OFF%

27059bc18d39331a39fd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]%bro3% joins your side.%SPEECH_ON%Got a moment, cap'n?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod for him to speak his mind.%SPEECH_ON%The battle has left some gear worse for wear and some men got a good nickin', too. We can patch up both man and equipment while marching, but it's a lot faster to set down and do it. Of course, if we make camp we should be wary of ambushes. A campfire in these parts can be seen from every which way.%SPEECH_OFF%
27059bc18d39331a39fd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]%bro3%来到你身旁。%SPEECH_ON%团长，有空吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，让他直说。%SPEECH_ON%这一仗下来，装备磕坏了不少，弟兄们身上也添了几道口子。边赶路边修装备、养伤，倒也不是不行，不过扎下营来会快得多。当然，宿营也得提防伏击。这里的篝火，隔老远、从哪边都能看见。%SPEECH_OFF%

de14140b9a6aae131c57.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_24.png[/img]The company returns to %townname% as victors, their heads held much higher this time. The %companyname% are not the size that they once were, but they're still a force to be reckoned with as Hoggart learned in his final moments.

You carry his head in a sack that you empty in front of %employer%'s feet. He jumps back, but the healer quickly picks the head up, stares at it, and nods. %employer% approaches the brigand's bloodied face and eyes it carefully.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, yes... that's his ugly mug alright. Servants! Pay this man his money!%SPEECH_OFF%Coin in hand, you raise your voice to the men.%SPEECH_ON%As long as there is blood coursing through our veins, as long as we can hold sword and shield, there shall stand our company. All through the realm people will know the %companyname%!%SPEECH_OFF%The men cheer. %bro1% puts his hand on your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%You did well, captain. No matter where you lead us, the men will follow you as brothers in battle.%SPEECH_OFF%
de14140b9a6aae131c57.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_24.png[/img]战团以胜利者的身份回到%townname%，这一次，弟兄们的头昂得更高了。%companyname%人数虽已不复从前，却仍是一股不可小觑的力量。霍加特临死前，已经亲身体会过了。

你把他的脑袋装在袋里带回来，倒在%employer%脚边。雇主吓得往后一跳，医师却立刻捡起头颅，端详片刻，点了点头。%employer%凑近那张血淋淋的匪徒面孔，仔细辨认。%SPEECH_ON%对，对……就是这张丑脸。来人！把钱付给他！%SPEECH_OFF%拿到钱后，你提高声音，对弟兄们说道。%SPEECH_ON%只要我们血还未冷，只要我们还能握住剑盾，战团就绝不会倒下。总有一天，整个王国都会知道%companyname%的名字！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们欢呼起来。%bro1%把手搭在你肩上。%SPEECH_ON%干得好，团长。无论你带我们去哪里，弟兄们都会跟着你，一同上阵，一同杀敌。%SPEECH_OFF%

783a6f32d8a707ea694d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{A man surprises you by sliding into your shoulder. You just about draw your sword when he quickly explains that a man by the name of %employer% has sought your acquaintance. Sheathing your weapon, you tell the stranger to take you to him - if he's got business, he should tell you himself. The messenger nods and leads the way to a nobleman's house. | A messenger - a young lad about as tall as a longsword - sprints by you, throwing a scroll into the air as he swings past. You catch it, but by the time you can look for the kid he's already gone. Shrugging, you open the scroll and find the name of %employer%. He appears to be in need of your services. Directions to a nobleman's house tag the bottom of the scroll. | While walking about %townname%, a messenger eases up next to you. A glance at him has the poor guy throwing a scroll into your hands before running off. You open up to see that a local nobleman has requested your audience. | %townname% seems peaceful enough, but something must be going wrong because a messenger comes to you with a notice from a local nobleman. And where there's riches, there's trouble... | A messenger greets you. He names himself as someone forgettable, because you instantly forget his name. However, his information is quite important: a local nobleman has requested your audience. | A bird flies to your shoulder and plants itself there. It coos at you, then gestures towards its feet where a notice has been rolled up. The second you take the message, the bird is off, no friend of anything but its own delivery services. Reading the note reveals that a local nobleman, and presumed friend of the aviary critters, has requested your audience. | A leashed dog runs up to you with a whole lotta barking. The man at the end of the leash nods toward the canine. You see a scroll hooked to its collar, the beast some sort of messenger mongrel. That or someone is having a bit of a laugh.

 Taking the note, you read that a local nobleman has requested your services. Maybe it's not a joke after all. The dog simply barks again and wags its tail, sitting dutifully and looking rather accomplished. | A straight-backed man walks toward you. He's got a scroll in a lifted arm, approaching you like a message board on stilts. He says nothing, merely extends his arm and you merely take the message as you're gestured to do. It reads that a local nobleman is looking for you and presumably your services. You thank the messenger, but he says nothing, simply turning and stilting his way down the road. | While walking down %townname%'s road, a few men cry out from a local tavern, howling with laughter as they wave you over. Snickering and doubling over, they can barely spit out their news: apparently some nobleman has been looking for a sellsword. Interesting, but you can't help but ask why they were laughing. The men go silent for a moment and one shrugs while another coughs out an answer.%SPEECH_ON%Because we're drunk?%SPEECH_OFF%The men keep a strained set of straight faces for but a second longer before bursting into laughter once more. | A servant of a local noble asks you to follow him on his master's behest. He leads you into the wealthier part of %townname%, where the buildings get taller and the people streets don't reek of horse manure. Eventually you reach a manor that looks as if it used to be a temple. Fake owls dot the eaves, staring you down as you walk by. A depressed-looking cat idles on the front steps. You enter through a front door that squalls with opulence, its hinges and wide swing echoing into the foyer. Your mouth drops open as you hardly even know the words to describe the grandeur inside.}
783a6f32d8a707ea694d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{一个人冷不防贴到你肩旁，吓了你一跳。你险些拔剑，他赶紧解释，一位名叫%employer%的人想结识你。你将剑收回鞘中，叫陌生人带路：若有生意，让对方亲自说。信使点点头，将你领向一位贵族的宅邸。 | 一个身高大概只及一柄长剑的小信使飞奔而过，擦身时把一卷文书抛到空中。你接住它，可等抬头找人，那孩子已不见踪影。耸了耸肩，你展开文书，看见了%employer%的名字。他似乎需要你的服务，卷末还写着前往贵族宅邸的路。 | 在%townname%闲逛时，一名信使悄悄靠到你身旁。你只瞥了他一眼，那可怜家伙便把文书塞到你手里，拔腿就跑。打开一看，原来是当地一位贵族请你会面。 | %townname%看上去很太平，可一定有哪里出了问题，因为一名信使带来了当地贵族的通知。有钱财的地方，就有麻烦…… | 一名信使向你问好。他报了个毫不起眼的名字，因为你转眼就忘了。不过，他带来的消息倒很重要：当地一位贵族请你会面。 | 一只鸟飞落在你肩上，咕咕叫着，示意你看它脚边卷起的字条。你刚取下信，鸟便飞走了，除了送信这桩差事，半点交情也不肯留。展开字条，原来当地一位贵族想与你会面，想必也是这些飞禽的朋友。 | 一条拴着绳子的狗跑到你面前，汪汪叫个不停。绳子另一头的男人朝狗点点头，你才看见项圈上挂着一卷文书。这畜生大概是条信使杂种狗，要么就是有人想找点乐子。

你取下字条，得知当地一位贵族想请你效劳。看来也许并非玩笑。狗又叫了一声，摇着尾巴规规矩矩地坐下，一副功成事遂的模样。 | 一个腰背挺直的人朝你走来，抬着胳膊，举着文书，活像一块踩着高跷的告示牌。他一言不发，只把手伸过来，你也照着示意接下信。上面说，当地一位贵族正在找你，想必也需要你的服务。你谢过信使，他仍不吭声，转过身，又像踩高跷一样沿路走了。 | 你沿%townname%的街道走着，当地酒馆里几个男人高声叫你过去，一边招手，一边笑得前仰后合。他们咯咯笑着，弯着腰，几乎连话都说不出来：似乎有个贵族在找佣兵。消息倒值得听，可你还是忍不住问，他们究竟笑什么。众人安静片刻，一个耸耸肩，另一个咳着说出答案。%SPEECH_ON%因为咱们喝醉了？%SPEECH_OFF%他们勉强绷住脸，才撑了一瞬，又爆发出大笑。 | 当地一位贵族的仆人奉主人之命，请你跟他走。他领你进入%townname%的富人区，楼房越来越高，街上也不再弥漫马粪味。最后，你们来到一座看着像由神殿改建的庄园。檐下摆着假猫头鹰，一路盯着你，门前台阶上趴着一只闷闷不乐的猫。豪华的大门敞开，铰链与门扇的响动回荡在前厅。你张着嘴走进去，里面的富丽堂皇，几乎超出了你能想到的所有词。}

3995713c20bfa14706ee.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{A few peasants walk up to you and one even offers a hug. You decline.%SPEECH_ON%It's good to see you again, sellsword. %employer%'s been looking for you.%SPEECH_OFF% | A woman offers you a flower when you walk into town. This is against the usual response which is shutter the windows and hide the kids. You take the flower and she sways her skirt a little before prancing away. A man comes up to you.%SPEECH_ON%Sorry for that bother, sir, the townsfolk seemed to have taken a liking to you. %employer% as well, seeing as how he's been looking for you since the moment he heard you were in town.%SPEECH_OFF% | A pack of dogs streams down the road, a few children in chase. They scatter past you one by one, the dogs howling and huffing with joy, the children screaming out greetings. A woman walks up, a metal skillet in one hand and a wash rag in the other.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there sellsword. I probably should let one of them messenger men find and tell you this, but I got the news so I'll tell you anyhow. %employer%'s looking for you.%SPEECH_OFF%She flutters her eyes. You smile back and nod. %randombrother% smirks.%SPEECH_ON%See something you like, sir?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the man to go fark a goat. | A couple of bleating goats are being lead down the road. They shuffle through the mud, prodding their noses through the muck and somehow finding things to chew up. Their shepherd plants his cane in the ground.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there mercenary. %employer%'s been looking for ya.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man sitting on his porch leans forward at the very sight of you. He points a finger.%SPEECH_ON%Well if it ain't the sellsword everyone been talking of.%SPEECH_OFF%You look around before nodding. He grins and hoots and hollers.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, it's damned nice seeing you around again! And it'd be short of me not to tell you that %employer%'s been tryin' to find ya. Go and see him. Tell him I sent ya, maybe he'll send me a reward. Probably just a bunch of flowers, that bastard. Or a cat. Who wants a cat? Why did he ever send me a cat? I told him I hate cats...%SPEECH_OFF%As the man rambles on, you quietly make your leave. | A woman runs up to you. She brings her children with, not exactly taking precautions with a sellsword. One of the kids swings their arms around your leg.%SPEECH_ON%He's back!%SPEECH_OFF%You look down and grin, subtly trying to shake the bastard off although he just takes it for play. The mother retrieves the spawn before pointing up the road.%SPEECH_ON%%employer%'s been lookin' for ya. Tell him I fetched ya, maybe he'll come and fix our well once he knows I done a favor.%SPEECH_OFF%She looks world weary, dragged to the hells by the cheeriness of her children. | You walk into %townname% and a man beckons you into his garden. He's tending the plants, using a steady hand to clip the vegetables or fruit or whatever it is, you're not a gardener.%SPEECH_ON%How are you doing, sellsword? If you're wondering, %employer% been talking of you. Suppose he's been wanting to see you, too, if yer interested in some more business. Here, catch.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns and tosses a {cabbage | onion | potato | tomato} at you.%SPEECH_ON%Nice catch.%SPEECH_OFF%You take a bite and nod back.%SPEECH_ON%Doesn't taste half bad.%SPEECH_OFF% | An old shopkeep waves at you.%SPEECH_ON%It's good seeing you again, sellsword. How often do you hear that?%SPEECH_OFF%He thumbs down the road.%SPEECH_ON%If you'd like to do some more of that good work, then %employer% been looking for you.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man fleecing a sheep looks over to you, the runt wriggling around.%SPEECH_ON%I should just eat this lil' bastard. Look at her go. Quit it, would ya?%SPEECH_OFF%He elbows the beast and it bleats, cursing back with as much sapience as a sheep can muster. The man looks up at you again.%SPEECH_ON%Say, yer that sellsword everyone's been talking about. I should probably tell you, and I guess I will, heh, that, uh, %employer% been looking for you.%SPEECH_OFF%The sheep jumps in an attempted escape, but the man slams her down.%SPEECH_ON%You little git, I'mma milk yer tits dry if you try that again!%SPEECH_OFF%}
3995713c20bfa14706ee.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{几个农民向你走来，其中一个甚至想拥抱你，被你婉拒了。%SPEECH_ON%又见到你真好，佣兵。%employer%一直在找你。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你进镇时，一个女人递给你一朵花。往常迎接你的，可都是紧闭窗户、藏好孩子的阵仗。你接过花，她轻轻摆了摆裙子，轻快地走开了。一个男人迎上前。%SPEECH_ON%抱歉打扰您，先生。镇民们似乎很喜欢您。%employer%也一样，一听说您进镇，就开始找您了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群狗沿路奔来，几个孩子追在后头。他们接连从你身旁跑过，狗欢快地吠叫、喘气，孩子们则高声向你问好。一个女人走来，一手拿着铁锅，一手攥着抹布。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，佣兵。按说该让那些传话的人来告诉你，不过既然我知道了，顺口说一声也无妨。%employer%在找你。%SPEECH_OFF%她朝你眨眨眼，你微笑着点头。%randombrother%坏笑起来。%SPEECH_ON%看上了，团长？%SPEECH_OFF%你叫他滚去跟山羊快活。 | 几只咩咩叫的山羊被人领着沿路走来。它们在泥里挪步，鼻子拱来拱去，竟还真能找到东西嚼。牧羊人把手杖往地上一杵。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，佣兵。%employer%一直在找你。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个坐在门廊上的人一见到你，便探起身子，伸出手指。%SPEECH_ON%哟，这不就是大伙儿一直念叨的那个佣兵吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾四周，点了点头。他咧嘴笑了，又喊又叫。%SPEECH_ON%哈，又见到你，可真他妈高兴！不告诉你可就不够意思了，%employer%正到处找你呢。去见见他，就说是我让你去的，没准他还会给点赏。多半又是一捧花，那个混蛋。或者一只猫。谁要猫啊？他当初干吗送我一只猫？我明明说过我讨厌猫……%SPEECH_OFF%趁他絮絮叨叨，你悄悄告辞了。 | 一个女人朝你跑来，还带着孩子们，面对佣兵竟毫不防备。一个孩子一把抱住你的腿。%SPEECH_ON%他回来啦！%SPEECH_OFF%你低头咧嘴一笑，悄悄想把这小混蛋甩开，他却当你在陪他玩。母亲将小家伙拉回去，指向路前方。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%一直在找你。告诉他，是我把你找来的。知道我帮了忙，没准他就肯来修修咱家的井了。%SPEECH_OFF%她一脸倦容，孩子们却兴高采烈，简直要把她一路拖进地狱。 | 你走进%townname%，有人招手请你进园子。他正在侍弄植物，手稳稳地修剪着蔬菜，或水果，或别的什么——反正你又不是园丁。%SPEECH_ON%过得怎么样，佣兵？顺便告诉你，%employer%一直在念叨你。要是还想接点活，我猜他也想见你。来，接着。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身朝你抛来一颗{卷心菜 | 洋葱 | 土豆 | 番茄}。%SPEECH_ON%接得好。%SPEECH_OFF%你咬了一口，朝他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%味道还真不错。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一位老店主朝你挥手。%SPEECH_ON%又见到你真高兴，佣兵。这话你平时能听见几回？%SPEECH_OFF%他用拇指朝路前方一指。%SPEECH_ON%要是还愿意再干些那样的好事，%employer%正找你呢。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个正在剪羊毛的人抬头望向你，那只小羊在他手里扭来扭去。%SPEECH_ON%真该把这小混蛋吃了。瞧她闹的。消停点，成不成？%SPEECH_OFF%他拿胳膊肘顶了羊一下，羊便咩咩叫起来，用羊所能有的全部聪明劲回骂。他又抬眼看你。%SPEECH_ON%哎，你就是大伙儿一直在说的佣兵。该告诉你一声，我也确实打算告诉你，嘿，就是……%employer%正找你呢。%SPEECH_OFF%羊猛地一跳，想逃出去，却被他一把按了回去。%SPEECH_ON%小混账，再来一下，信不信我把你的奶都挤干！%SPEECH_OFF%}

38ca0f1e15c4061203df.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{You cautiously enter the home of one of %employer%'s liaisons. He's sitting next to a fire, a scroll in one hand and a goblet in the other.%SPEECH_ON%Don't bother sitting, sellsword. Wouldn't want to bring a chill to my comforts now would we? If you're looking for %employer%, then I'll send word. He's not happy with you, but business is business, or so we like to say.%SPEECH_OFF%He smiles and tips his goblet toward you. | A few of %employer%'s personal bodyguards stand before you, arms crossed.%SPEECH_ON%What was it we were supposed to do with him again?%SPEECH_OFF%You clutch your sword's handle. One of them laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Send him on through. That's what. %employer% wants further business with him, dunno why, the way I see it we should just run him through here and now.%SPEECH_OFF%They let you on through, but you keep a good eye on your surroundings. | You can't quite put your finger on it, but %townname% seems rather hostile lately. Windows shutter when you walk past, as though your steps carry the wind with them. While doors slam shut and peasants scurry away, a militiaman approaches.%SPEECH_ON%%employer% wishes to have your audience, though you may want to keep on your best behavior. He is not in the happiest of moods right now.%SPEECH_OFF% | A few militiaman whistle and hoot as you walk by.%SPEECH_ON%Some nuts on that man coming through here again. Hey sellsword! If you want more business, %employer% is open to some more talks. Just, you know, don't fark it up this time!%SPEECH_OFF% | A man grips the leashes on some war dogs, the hounds snapping their jaws right before they can glom onto one of your legs. Their handler looks at you and for a second he almost seems ready to loosen the harnesses.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, it's you. Well, %employer%'s been looking for you.%SPEECH_OFF% | You pass by a few militiamen. They spit and rattle their scabbards, but you pay it no mind. A man in a well furnished cloak comes to you.%SPEECH_ON%If it is business you seek, then come with me. %employer% would like to speak with you.%SPEECH_OFF% | You pass by a woman who throws a rotten vegetable your way. It sails wide, but you retaliate with a mean, mugging look. She snaps at you.%SPEECH_ON%I say you deserved truer aim!%SPEECH_OFF%You rattle your scabbard and she scurries off. A man approaches, chuckling as he had seen the whole affair.%SPEECH_ON%You are not the most popular person in this town, sellsword. Please, come with me so that you may speak with %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF% | A few militiamen running sword over a grindstone glance at you.%SPEECH_ON%Isn't there a price on his head?%SPEECH_OFF%Another man slugs him in the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Aren't you saying that a bit farkin' too loud? Why hey there, sellsword! %employer% would most like to speak with you!%SPEECH_OFF%Uh, yeah, of course. | You approach a man who has a number of warhounds on leashes. They're sitting upright and under command, not a single tongue aloll. Their handler stares at you, the ropes of their bindings in one unclenched hand.%SPEECH_ON%You know, %employer% told me to sic these mutts on you at first sight. And then he said, no, I'd better not. So it went, back and forth, let 'em feast, let the man live.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask the houndmaster which it is now. He turns and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Go up and see %employer%. He just wants to talk.%SPEECH_OFF% | You pass a rope swinging from a tree. A man calls out from your side.%SPEECH_ON%Look out, dead man a-walkin'!%SPEECH_OFF%When you turn to him he laughs aloud.%SPEECH_ON%Don't worry, I think they just put that up for practice. Ain't no reason to use it, yet. Go ahead and see %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF% | You walk past a man looking at a wanted poster. He stares at it, then at you, then at the poster, then at you again.%SPEECH_ON%Damn. So close. Hey there, mercenary! I hear %employer% would like to talk to ya!%SPEECH_OFF%}
38ca0f1e15c4061203df.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{你谨慎地走进%employer%一名联络人的家。他坐在炉火旁，一手拿着文书，一手端着酒杯。%SPEECH_ON%不必坐了，佣兵。可别搅了我这点舒坦，对吧？要找%employer%，我可以替你传话。他对你很不满意，不过生意归生意，咱们常这么说。%SPEECH_OFF%他微笑着，朝你倾了倾酒杯。 | %employer%的几名贴身护卫抱臂站在你面前。%SPEECH_ON%咱们该怎么处置他来着？%SPEECH_OFF%你握紧剑柄，其中一人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%放他进去，就这样。%employer%还想跟他做生意，也不知道为什么。照我看，现在就该在这儿给他捅个对穿。%SPEECH_OFF%他们放你通过，你仍留心着四周。 | 具体哪里不对，你也说不清，可%townname%近来似乎格外不友好。你一走过，窗板便纷纷合上，仿佛脚步带着风。门扇砰砰关紧，农民匆忙躲开，一名民兵朝你走来。%SPEECH_ON%%employer%想见你，不过你最好规矩点。他眼下心情可不怎么样。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你经过时，几个民兵吹着口哨起哄。%SPEECH_ON%这人还敢回来，胆儿可真肥。喂，佣兵！想再接活的话，%employer%倒还愿意跟你谈谈。只是，你懂的，这回别他妈再办砸了！%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个人牵着几条战犬，犬牙在你腿前猛地咬合，只差一点就能叼住你的腿。驯犬师看着你，有那么一瞬间，几乎就要松开束带。%SPEECH_ON%哦，是你。嗯，%employer%一直在找你。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你从几个民兵身旁走过，他们吐着唾沫，晃得剑鞘作响，你却没理会。一个披着华美斗篷的人迎面走来。%SPEECH_ON%要找生意，就跟我来。%employer%想与你谈谈。%SPEECH_OFF% | 路过一个女人身边时，她朝你扔来一块烂菜。菜扔偏了，你便狠狠瞪她一眼，她冲你嚷道。%SPEECH_ON%就该扔准些，砸中你才好！%SPEECH_OFF%你晃了晃剑鞘，她赶紧溜了。一个男人走来，显然看见了全过程，正低声发笑。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你在这个镇上可不怎么受欢迎。请随我来，去和%employer%谈谈吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 几个正拿磨刀石磨剑的民兵朝你瞥了一眼。%SPEECH_ON%他脑袋上不是挂着赏金吗？%SPEECH_OFF%另一人朝他肩上捶了一拳。%SPEECH_ON%你他妈是不是说得太响了？哟，你好啊，佣兵！%employer%可想和你好好谈谈呢！%SPEECH_OFF%呃，是啊，当然。 | 你走近一个牵着数条战犬的人。狗都端端正正地坐着，令行禁止，连舌头都没一条吐出来。驯犬师盯着你，牵绳松松搭在他张开的手上。%SPEECH_ON%知道吗，%employer%叫我一见到你，就放这些杂种狗扑上去。后来又说，不，还是别了。就这么反反复复，一会儿让它们开荤，一会儿又让你活。%SPEECH_OFF%你问驯犬师，现在到底是哪一个。他转头啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%上去见%employer%吧。他只想谈谈。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你从树下经过，一根绳子正在树上晃荡。旁边有人喊道。%SPEECH_ON%当心啊，死人上路啦！%SPEECH_OFF%你转头看他，他放声大笑。%SPEECH_ON%别担心，我猜他们挂那玩意儿只是练练手。还没理由真用呢。去吧，去见%employer%。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你路过一个正在看通缉告示的人。他看看告示，又看看你，再看看告示，再看看你。%SPEECH_ON%该死，就差一点。嘿，佣兵！听说%employer%想跟你谈谈！%SPEECH_OFF%}

561356dfbef63f24fe28.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{A cowl-shaded man hisses at you, his teeth and nose winking momentarily from the dark of his hood. You've no time for lepers or jokers and demand the man to get out of your way. Instead, he starts talking.%SPEECH_ON%My master requires your services, he's heard of your exploits. Follow me and I shall take you to him.%SPEECH_OFF%You rest your hands on the handle of your sword and nod. | You sit alone, studying a map as a stiff breeze tries to take off with it. As you struggle to keep the sheet on the table, %randombrother%, one of your men, approaches and slams a mug on the paper's corner. You look up to see he's a bit slackjawed with drink on his breath. He explains that he shared stories with a local by the name of %employer% who has a proposal for you. The maps and the lands they detail aren't going anywhere, so you agree to meet with him and hear him out. | You enter %townname% and a man immediately approaches, trundling through the mud to get to you. He announces himself as someone in the employ of %employer%, a man of some power in this town and he, along with the thoughts and monies of others, have decided to seek your services. | A man walks up to you and holds a scroll halfway between he and you.%SPEECH_ON%My name is %randomname%, representative of %employer% and speaking on behalf of the good people of %townname%. We seek your services, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man approaches from the side of the road. He's dressed in a peasant's garb, yet is guarded by two well-armed men. He announces himself as a councilman in the employ of %employer%, a local leader of %townname%. You are asked to take audience with the man. | A hooded man gestures you to follow him. Nervously looking over his shoulder, he leads you to the backroom of a local tavern. Before addressing you, he takes his time to peek out the windows - probably looking for anyone eavesdropping.%SPEECH_ON%A figurehead by the name of %employer% wishes to see you. He's a man of some repute in this town, so you understand my discretion.%SPEECH_OFF%He slides a paper toward you - there are directions written on it. | A drunken woman throws herself at you. She practically drools licentious horrors into your ear and you beat her off with a stick. One onlooker rushes to your side, yanking the wench away.%SPEECH_ON%Begone, whore! How many times must I tell you?%SPEECH_OFF%The lady saunters off, clambering from one man to another like an animal between tree branches. Your 'rescuer' offers his hand.%SPEECH_ON%I am %randomname%. A man of some import, %employer%, has been looking for you. Please, follow me and I shall bring you to him.%SPEECH_OFF% | While your men venture around town, you go to a pub and take a seat. As soon as you do, a strange man joins you.%SPEECH_ON%You with the %companyname%?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The man nods back then reaches into his pocket. You reach for your dagger. The stranger puts his hand out.%SPEECH_ON%Easy there. I'm wearing a sword. If I wanted to kill ya, taking a seat probably wouldn't be the best route.%SPEECH_OFF%The man lifts the sheath and it bumps the underside of the table. He cocks his head as if to say, 'see?' You nod and the man continues with his move, taking out a note and passing it to you.%SPEECH_ON%A local councilman by the name of %employer% wishes to see you.%SPEECH_OFF% | You walk around %townname% before stopping a man and asking him if there's anything interesting around. He balances a smelly and dripping pitchfork on his shoulder as he thinks.%SPEECH_ON%Well. There's the hoo-ores, mmhmm.%SPEECH_OFF%The man grins, mostly to himself on that one.%SPEECH_ON%They alright. There's also %employer%. Wait, are you that sellsword feller?%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger squints at you then quickly continues.%SPEECH_ON%Ah shit, of course. Yeah, %employer% talked about you. He said... '%randomname%, go and clear out the shit in the horse stalls. And if you see that mercenary people are talking of, fetch 'im for me.'%SPEECH_OFF%He stops and points down the road toward a building.%SPEECH_ON%So, yeah, if ya want some money then that fella in there wants to pay ya. I don't think he needs another man slingin' shit, if you was worried about that. I got that shit under lock!%SPEECH_OFF% | You enter a tavern and garner a few looks for your arrival. Men whisper to one another, the women ogle as they tend to do. The bartender fists a cloth into a mug then calls you over.%SPEECH_ON%You're that mercenary people been wonderin' about.%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask how could he know, being that you aren't the only man walking around with a sword. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%The eyes. That's where I can see it. You're a man who hunts a most dangerous sort of prey. A life of taking lives is a world in and of itself, but you seek out those whose lives have gained such odd values that their death would be but a monetary appreciation for others. A purchase is placed, so thus you become the means to a transaction. It is so, isn't it? You're a bone collector, my friend. A gravedigger paid in advance.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, understanding. Suddenly, a man comes up to you and explains that a local figurehead by the name of %employer% wishes to have your ear. When you turn back, the bartender is gone. | You come across a man leaning against a porch post. He hails you down.%SPEECH_ON%%employer%'s been looking for you, sellsword. He's down yonder in the village communal.%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger nods towards a large building a little ways along the road.%SPEECH_ON%I hope you do good, mercenary. The people of %townname% are wary of your sort, but that don't mean their hearts can't be won over.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man strums a stringed instrument as you walk by. He slashes an ear-piercing chord and you turn to find him laughing.%SPEECH_ON%Heh, I thought that mind fetch your attention. %employer% said we should keep a lookout for a man of your... vocation. If you're looking for work, he's the man to go to.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if this figurehead pays well. The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yup. He gave me this here lute as payment once. Now I'm just waiting for the old devils to come down and challenge me to a tune. %employer% said if you best one in a game of songs, then they'll give ya golden lute. Now that's what I call good payment, wouldn't you agree?%SPEECH_OFF%The man turns back to the instrument, drawing a mewling tune out from the strings. In the distance, dogs begin to howl. | As you take stock of your inventory, a rather well-to-do man spots you and heads your way. He announces himself as being in the employ of %employer%, an influential person in %townname% that wishes to talk business. You hand your duties over to %randombrother% and let the man lead the way. | %randombrother% comes along with a small boy racing at his side. When they get to you, the pair talk at the same time, stop, and then start again. You hold your hand up, and then point to the little boy who immediately says that %employer% wishes to see you. You then point to the battle brother who says a local bitch has birthed puppies and maybe the %companyname% could take one. Pursing your lips, you tell the boy to take you to his master who is found already waiting for you.}
561356dfbef63f24fe28.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{一个兜帽遮面的男人冲你低声招呼，帽下黑暗中，牙齿和鼻尖一闪而过。你没空搭理麻风病人或装神弄鬼的家伙，叫他让开，他却自顾自地说起来。%SPEECH_ON%我家主人听过您的事迹，想请您效劳。请随我来，我带您去见他。%SPEECH_OFF%你将手按在剑柄上，点了点头。 | 你独自坐着看地图，一阵劲风却总想把它卷走。正忙着把纸按回桌面，手下的%randombrother%走了过来，啪地将一只杯子压在地图一角。你抬头一看，他嘴巴微张，满口酒气。他说，自己与当地一个叫%employer%的人聊了些故事，对方有桩提议想与你谈。地图和上面的山川又不会长腿跑掉，你便答应去听听。 | 刚进%townname%，就有人蹚着泥朝你赶来。他自称替%employer%办事；那人在镇上颇有权势，已与其他人商量过，也凑了钱，决定请你效劳。 | 一个人走到你面前，把一卷文书递到两人之间。%SPEECH_ON%我叫%randomname%，是%employer%的代表，也替%townname%的良民传话。佣兵，我们需要你的本事。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个人从路边走来，穿着农民的衣服，却有两名全副武装的护卫随行。他自称议事会成员，替%townname%的一位头面人物%employer%办事，请你前去会面。 | 一个戴兜帽的人示意你跟上。他紧张地回头张望，将你带进当地一家酒馆的后屋。开口前，他还花了些时间往窗外窥探，大概是在提防偷听的人。%SPEECH_ON%有位叫%employer%的头面人物想见你。他在镇上颇有声望，想必你能体谅我这番谨慎。%SPEECH_OFF%他将一张纸推到你面前，上面写着去处。 | 一个醉女人朝你扑来，几乎流着口水，在你耳边说些不堪入耳的淫话，你拿棍子把她拨开。一名旁观者赶上前，将那女人扯走。%SPEECH_ON%滚开，婊子！要我说多少遍？%SPEECH_OFF%那女人扭着身子离去，从一个男人身上攀向另一个，活像在树枝间跳跃的野兽。你的“救命恩人”伸出手。%SPEECH_ON%我叫%randomname%。有位颇有身份的人，%employer%，一直在找你。请跟我来，我带你去见他。%SPEECH_OFF% | 弟兄们在镇上四处闲逛，你则进了酒馆找地方坐下。刚一落座，一个陌生人便凑过来。%SPEECH_ON%你是%companyname%的人？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。他也点点头，伸手去掏口袋，你立刻摸向匕首。陌生人抬起一只手。%SPEECH_ON%别紧张。我带着剑呢。真想杀你，先坐下来可不是什么好办法。%SPEECH_OFF%他抬起剑鞘，顶得桌底一响，歪了歪头，仿佛在说：“瞧见没？”你点点头，他才继续从口袋里取出一张字条，递给你。%SPEECH_ON%当地一位叫%employer%的议事会成员想见你。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在%townname%闲逛，拦住一个人，问附近有什么有趣的事。他把一柄滴着污物、臭气熏天的草叉搭在肩上，想了想。%SPEECH_ON%嗯……有婊——子，嘿嘿。%SPEECH_OFF%他咧嘴笑了，倒更像在自得其乐。%SPEECH_ON%还不错。还有%employer%。等等，你是不是那个佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人眯眼打量你，随即飞快地接着说道。%SPEECH_ON%哎，他妈的，可不就是。对，%employer%提过你。他说……‘%randomname%，去把马厩的屎清干净。要是碰见大家都在说的那个佣兵，就把他给我找来。’%SPEECH_OFF%他停下来，指向路边一栋建筑。%SPEECH_ON%所以嘛，你要想挣钱，里面那位就想给你钱。要是你担心这个，我觉得他用不着再找人铲屎。这点屎，我一个人包了！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进酒馆，引来几道目光。男人们交头接耳，女人们照例上下打量。酒保攥着布往杯子里擦了擦，招手叫你过去。%SPEECH_ON%你就是大家一直在说的那个佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你有些好奇，问他怎么认出来的，毕竟街上带剑的又不止你一个。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%眼睛。我从眼睛里看得出来。你猎的是最危险的猎物。夺人性命本就是一种截然不同的活法，可你专找的那些人，命又有种古怪的价码：他们一死，别人便得了好处，愿意为此付钱。买卖一成，你就成了办成交易的那只手。是这样吧？朋友，你是个收骨头的，是提前领了工钱的掘墓人。%SPEECH_OFF%你会意地点头。忽然，有人上前告诉你，当地一位叫%employer%的头面人物想与你谈谈。等你回过头来，酒保已经不见了。 | 你遇见一个靠着门廊柱子的人，他招呼你停下。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，%employer%一直在找你。他就在前头的村公所。%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人朝路前方不远的一座大屋点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%但愿你能办些好事，佣兵。%townname%的人对你们这种人有戒心，可也不代表他们的心就赢不过来。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你路过时，一个人正拨弄弦乐器。他猛地扫出一道刺耳的和弦，你转头一看，他正笑着。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，我就想这能让你留意。%employer%叫我们留心，找个干你这种……行当的人。想找活干，去找他就对了。%SPEECH_OFF%你问这位头面人物出手是否大方，他点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%大方。有一回，他就拿这把鲁特琴给我抵工钱。现在我只等老魔鬼下来，跟我比上一曲。%employer%说，要是在比歌时赢了魔鬼，它就会送你一把金鲁特琴。这才叫好报酬，你说对不对？%SPEECH_OFF%说完，他又拨弄起琴弦，拉出猫叫似的曲调。远处，狗开始嚎了起来。 | 你正在清点物资，一个衣着体面的人看见你，走了过来。他自称替%employer%办事，那是%townname%一位颇有影响力的人物，想与你谈桩生意。你把手头的事交给%randombrother%，让来人带路。 | %randombrother%走了过来，身旁还有个小男孩一路小跑。两人一到你面前便同时开口，又同时停下，接着又一齐说起来。你抬手制止，先指了指孩子，他立刻说，%employer%想见你。你再指向那位弟兄，他说当地一条母狗生了崽，也许%companyname%可以抱一只。你抿起嘴，让男孩带你去见主人。到地方时，对方已在等候。}

2dcd2864f1ed34a43dad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{An old man's sitting out on a hovel's porch when you enter the town. He spits at the very sight of you.%SPEECH_ON%Some balls on you showing your face around these parts, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%He wipes his mouth on his sleeve.%SPEECH_ON%But I won't lie and say we don't need you, though I hate to all the hells that I have to admit it. Come on then, you know who to see if it's money yer after. %employer% be where he always be.%SPEECH_OFF% | You enter %townname% and a man barks out at you.%SPEECH_ON%Well shit, if it ain't the %companyname% and the snake in the grass it calls a leader.%SPEECH_OFF%You raise an eyebrow, and put a hand to your sword. The man laughs.%SPEECH_ON%We don't care for you, sellsword, but we do need ya. Come on, slither this way so we can talk business. That's what you really care about, right? %employer% is the man you want to be seeing.%SPEECH_OFF% | %townname%'s denizens duck out of sight as you enter. Many a shutter slam close, and children are hushed and hurried away. A man's standing in the middle of the road, his hands on his hips.%SPEECH_ON%Well, it's you.%SPEECH_OFF%You look around, making sure some ambush isn't about to fall down on your damn head. The man laughs.%SPEECH_ON%We ain't gonna kill ya, sellsword. I'm out here to broker a deal, that's all. If you're interested, come see %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF%He spits, turns, and walks off. You spend a second longer looking out for that ambush. | Frightened women and children run from the sight of you. A few men linger, clutching their pitchforks or sidearms as you pass. An elder steps forward, eyeing you up and down.%SPEECH_ON%%employer%'s been looking for ya. I don't know why after all that you've done, but I won't get between him and his business.%SPEECH_OFF% | Some of %townname%'s ragged militia give you the side-eye as you enter the town. One spits and yells out.%SPEECH_ON%%employer%'s looking for you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%His voice trails off into what you thought sounded like obscenities. | A woman hurries across the road to pick up her child. She twirls the kid around, a protective hand clutching the back of its head.%SPEECH_ON%I don't know what you're doing here again, sellsword, but %employer%'s been looking for you anyhow.%SPEECH_OFF%She runs off, though occasionally looking behind her with furtive glances. | Kids cycle around your feet as you walk down the road. Their parents come out screaming, telling the kids to get away from you. A mother ushers her daughter away while mean mugging you.%SPEECH_ON%Don't ever touch my child. And if it's business you want, then go see %employer%.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man's repairing the roof of his home when he sees you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah hell, you again?%SPEECH_OFF%You look around then turn back to the man. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Most folks don't take kindly to yer being here. I suppose I'm neutral on the matter, but then again it's easy to be on the fence when yer ten feet up in the air.%SPEECH_OFF%He grins, but his foot kicks out and he almost slides off his roof. He clutches onto the thatching.%SPEECH_ON%Whoa! Well, uh, anyway %employer%'s looking for you. Don't mind the hate of the people. It's what comes natural to them.%SPEECH_OFF% | People scurry from the sight of the %companyname%. One man yells out from his window.%SPEECH_ON%'Ey mercenary! %employer% been wanting to see you!%SPEECH_OFF%He quickly shutters his windows before you can respond.}

315cc058f1a1534fe93f.translation: {我会先付给你 | 你将提前拿到 | 预先支付给你们的报酬是 | 预付款是} %reward_advance%克朗，每带回一颗首级再付%reward_count%克朗，{最多计酬%maxcount%颗首级 | 我最多为%maxcount%颗首级付钱 | 上限为%maxcount%颗首级}，任务完成后，另外再付%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%

998813ca6caeb918f52b.source: crowns per head you bring back, up to
998813ca6caeb918f52b.translation: 克朗／带回的首级，最多计酬

81bee40aeb7ba3542bc2.source: We need to be paid per head we arrive with.
81bee40aeb7ba3542bc2.translation: 我们要求按带到目的地的首级领取赏金。

3e24394542b1303e73b9.source: We need to be paid more per head we arrive with.
3e24394542b1303e73b9.translation: 送达的每颗首级，赏金还得再高些。

ea08b2241b1e2aa4a924.source: {You'll get | You are to receive | You'll be paid | It's} %reward_count% crowns per head you arrive with, {for up to %maxcount% heads | and I'll pay for up to %maxcount% heads | %maxcount% heads at most}.%SPEECH_OFF%
ea08b2241b1e2aa4a924.translation: {每带到目的地一颗首级，你将获得 | 每颗送达的首级，我会付给你 | 你带到目的地的每颗首级，报酬是 | 每颗送达的首级值} %reward_count%克朗，{最多计酬%maxcount%颗首级 | 我最多为%maxcount%颗首级付钱 | 上限为%maxcount%颗首级}。%SPEECH_OFF%

4eabf283d94e12f9daf8.source: {You'll get | You are to receive | You'll be paid | It's} %reward_advance% crowns in advance, and another %reward_count% crowns per head you arrive with, {for up to %maxcount% heads | and I'll pay for up to %maxcount% heads | %maxcount% heads at most}.%SPEECH_OFF%
4eabf283d94e12f9daf8.translation: {我会先付给你 | 你将提前拿到 | 预先支付给你们的报酬是 | 预付款是} %reward_advance%克朗，此外，每带到目的地一颗首级再付%reward_count%克朗，{最多计酬%maxcount%颗首级 | 我最多为%maxcount%颗首级付钱 | 上限为%maxcount%颗首级}。%SPEECH_OFF%

3f9635e2686ed4f6cd6b.source: {You'll get | You are to receive | You'll be paid | It's} %reward_count% crowns per head you arrive with, {for up to %maxcount% heads | and I'll pay for up to %maxcount% heads | %maxcount% heads at most}, and another %reward_completion% when the job is done.%SPEECH_OFF%
3f9635e2686ed4f6cd6b.translation: {每带到目的地一颗首级，你将获得 | 每颗送达的首级，我会付给你 | 你带到目的地的每颗首级，报酬是 | 每颗送达的首级值} %reward_count%克朗，{最多计酬%maxcount%颗首级 | 我最多为%maxcount%颗首级付钱 | 上限为%maxcount%颗首级}，任务完成后，另外再付%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%

5d82bb08c9c9d3d69b71.source: {You'll get | You are to receive | You'll be paid | It's} %reward_advance% crowns in advance, %reward_count% crowns per head you arrive with, {for up to %maxcount% heads | and I'll pay for up to %maxcount% heads | %maxcount% heads at most}, and another %reward_completion% when the job is done.%SPEECH_OFF%
5d82bb08c9c9d3d69b71.translation: {我会先付给你 | 你将提前拿到 | 预先支付给你们的报酬是 | 预付款是} %reward_advance%克朗，每带到目的地一颗首级再付%reward_count%克朗，{最多计酬%maxcount%颗首级 | 我最多为%maxcount%颗首级付钱 | 上限为%maxcount%颗首级}，任务完成后，另外再付%reward_completion%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%

d7522a3f11ca0eede5fa.source: crowns per head you arrive with, up to
d7522a3f11ca0eede5fa.translation: 克朗／送达的首级，最多计酬

41c3ecad3d46e885f789.source: The southern city states have made unparalleled advancements in medicine, astrology and alchemy.
41c3ecad3d46e885f789.translation: 南方城邦在医学、占星术和炼金术上的成就，无人能及。

cc484bd5f2b4d57c0e2f.source: The southerners call themselves 'Gilded' after their god, in whose shine they bask day in and out.
cc484bd5f2b4d57c0e2f.translation: 南方人以自己的神祇为名，自称“镀金之民”，相信自己日夜沐浴在祂的光辉之下。

e58f2ef8ddcc0246c3f4.source: The 'indebted' are a social caste of de-facto slaves in the city states, made up of criminals, prisoners of war and violators of religous dogma.
e58f2ef8ddcc0246c3f4.translation: “负债者”是城邦中的一个社会阶层，实际上与奴隶无异，包括罪犯、战俘和违背教义的人。

a1f7c9e62b2b75520d07.source: The southern city states are built on the ruins of the Ancient Empire.
a1f7c9e62b2b75520d07.translation: 南方城邦建立在古老帝国的废墟之上。

a6a167a3e51f67feba18.source: Nomads are a southern people that are not subject to the rule of a city state.
a6a167a3e51f67feba18.translation: 游牧民是生活在南方、不受城邦统治的族群。

a88d2c6d9bfa974a0978.source: Nomads are experts in desert warfare and using the environment to their advantage - including throwing it in your face.
a88d2c6d9bfa974a0978.translation: 游牧民擅长沙漠作战，也懂得利用环境取胜——包括把沙子直接扬到你脸上。

62740eed608580c30af1.source: An Ifrit is a demonic entity possessing rocks, stone and shifting sands.
62740eed608580c30af1.translation: 沙魔是一种附身于岩石、石块和流沙的恶魔。

c2daa1695de77ca167ba.source: A Qatal Dagger is best used in combination with other weapons that can stun or daze opponents.
c2daa1695de77ca167ba.translation: 卡塔尔匕首适合搭配能使敌人眩晕或恍惚的武器使用。

c452467d8957aff40391.source: The Handgonne takes a whole turn to reload - unless your character has the 'Crossbows & Firearms Mastery' perk.
c452467d8957aff40391.translation: 手铳装填需要一整个回合；拥有“弩与火器精通”特长的角色除外。

0006221c75c15b1f8d49.source: The Handgonne is a ranged weapon that can hit up to 6 targets with a single attack, but has less range than either bows or crossbows.
0006221c75c15b1f8d49.translation: 手铳一次攻击最多可命中6个目标，但射程比弓和弩都短。

dc608b41d86be8274e53.source: The Fire Lance is reloaded after every battle just like throwing weapons are.
dc608b41d86be8274e53.translation: 火矛和投掷武器一样，会在每场战斗结束后补充弹药。

a086ca30506b4d590d92.source: Arena matches offer a quick way to earn coin - but you can't retreat during matches or loot afterwards.
a086ca30506b4d590d92.translation: 竞技场比赛能让你快速挣钱，但比赛中无法撤退，赛后也无法搜刮战利品。

523df5d45147e731a40a.source: Arena tournaments are special events with different rules. Fight with five men over three consecutive rounds and win a famed item!
523df5d45147e731a40a.translation: 竞技场锦标赛采用特殊规则：派五人连续赢下三轮，即可获得一件名器！

e91cb3e1e8d8edd82306.source: Every fifth arena match offers the chance to win a piece of gladiator equipment that can't be bought otherwise.
e91cb3e1e8d8edd82306.translation: 竞技场每逢第五场比赛，你都有机会赢得一件无法购买的角斗士装备。

b86a71e975a66b03a972.source: Fire Pots can be used not just to inflict damage on your opponents, but also to deny them access to tiles and delay them.
b86a71e975a66b03a972.translation: 燃烧罐不仅能伤害敌人，还能封锁地格、延缓敌人的行动。

716778c0da320d747b9f.source: Smoke Pots can be used for a safe retreat even if your men are already locked in melee.
716778c0da320d747b9f.translation: 烟雾罐能帮助弟兄们安全撤离，即使他们已经与敌人贴身交战。

6bbbe00b3ebace69229c.source: Mortars of the city states can only fire if an engineer is next to them to operate them.
6bbbe00b3ebace69229c.translation: 城邦的臼炮只有在工程师站在旁边操作时，才能开火。

08a3e33f56d065f20c77.source: With the 'Manhunters' origin you can make prisoners after every battle against humans and force them to fight for you.
08a3e33f56d065f20c77.translation: 选择“捕奴者”起源，每次与人类敌人战斗后，都可以俘虏敌人，强迫他们为你作战。

f0cacd198d162780ce7e.source: With the 'Gladiators' origin you start with three powerful characters, but losing all three will end your campaign.
f0cacd198d162780ce7e.translation: 选择“角斗士”起源，会以三名强大的角色开局；若三人全部死去，战役就会结束。

2a4ececeae97eaa82e17.source: Hire non-combat followers for your retinue to customize your campaign to your playstyle.
2a4ececeae97eaa82e17.translation: 雇用非战斗随从，让战役中的战团更符合你的玩法。

382cba7ae7c66f6097f0.source: Losing named shields to orcs? Hire a blacksmith for your retinue and repair any item, even if its durability reaches zero.
382cba7ae7c66f6097f0.translation: 名盾总被兽人劈坏？为随从队伍雇用铁匠，即使装备耐久降至零，也能保下来修复。

1ff61a2b7be83abdef07.source: Training your new recruits takes too long? Hire a drill sergeant to have them gain experience faster.
1ff61a2b7be83abdef07.translation: 新人练得太慢？雇用训练教官，可以加快他们获取经验的速度。

4a7b03dd60121851aa86.source: Facing too few enemy champions? Hire a bounty hunter to find more and even earn a bounty for every one you kill.
4a7b03dd60121851aa86.translation: 遇到的敌方精英太少？雇用赏金猎人，便能找到更多精英，每击杀一个还能领取赏金。

d5d934b93cafff39384e.source: Paying too much in wages? Hire a paymaster to reduce the wages you have to pay.
d5d934b93cafff39384e.translation: 军饷负担太重？雇用军饷官，可以减少需要支付的薪水。

6ce9a034c11b4de6e64e.source: Wondering who went there? Hire a Lookout and get more information on any footprints on the world map.
6ce9a034c11b4de6e64e.translation: 想知道谁刚刚经过？雇用瞭望员，便能从世界地图上的足迹中获取更多信息。

4fc466b6151bcf7fa8d4.source: Always out of ammo and tools? Hire a scavenger to reclaim ammo you spent and gather tools from armor you destroyed.
4fc466b6151bcf7fa8d4.translation: 弹药和修缮物资总不够用？雇用拾荒者，可回收消耗的弹药，并从被你摧毁的护甲中搜集修缮物资。

cd004b19138240ad6eb4.source: Inventory full? Buy carts and wagons for your company in the Retinue screen.
cd004b19138240ad6eb4.translation: 仓库满了？到随从界面为战团购置手推车和货运马车。

affa85cb21ce749926db.source: You unlock slots for your retinue of non-combat followers by gaining Renown.
affa85cb21ce749926db.translation: 提升名望，可以解锁更多非战斗随从席位。

ff84e415c22e2206ae63.source: Ferocious hyenas roam the southern deserts, with strong jaws that can crush even metal armor and inflict bleeding wounds.
ff84e415c22e2206ae63.translation: 凶猛的鬣狗游荡在南方沙漠，强有力的颌骨甚至能咬碎金属护甲，造成流血创伤。

aa9fd3ffb6506823c92e.source: Try out different retinue followers to find those that complement your playstyle and chosen company origin.
aa9fd3ffb6506823c92e.translation: 尝试不同的随从组合，挑选适合你的玩法和战团起源的人选。

4b7715c2eabc6531f11f.source: With the 'Anatomists' origin, defeating new enemies grants potions that mutate your men and grant them special abilities.
4b7715c2eabc6531f11f.translation: 选择“解剖学者”起源，击败新的敌人可获得药剂，使弟兄发生变异，获得特殊能力。

d55014c8cc470b16ebb1.source: With the 'Oathtakers' origin, instead of ambitions you'll pick oaths that grant special boons and burdens.
d55014c8cc470b16ebb1.translation: 选择“立誓者”起源，将以誓言代替战团志向。不同誓言会带来各自的恩惠与负担。

037554b19ef30dadab9b.source: The frozen wasteland of the north is home to a giant beast not seen anywhere else.
037554b19ef30dadab9b.translation: 北方冰封的荒原上，生活着别处见不到的巨兽。

a551087f8fa19f1b650b.source: A Lindwurm is a wingless bipedal dragon resembling a large snake.
a551087f8fa19f1b650b.translation: 林德蠕龙是一种没有翅膀、长着两条腿的龙，外形如同巨蛇。

1aafc11cbc3fa48419be.source: There are different regional variants of the Unhold.
1aafc11cbc3fa48419be.translation: 不同地区的巨魔，存在各自的变种。

c53b652373d7e21815d2.source: Unholds can heal wounds quickly, even in combat.
c53b652373d7e21815d2.translation: 巨魔能迅速愈合伤口，即使身处战斗之中也不例外。

c69a600b8e63b9dba8b0.source: Alps feed on the fear and agony of people having nightmares.
c69a600b8e63b9dba8b0.translation: 梦魇以人们做噩梦时产生的恐惧与痛苦为食。

146980ab4e8f7df985f2.source: Explore the world to find legendary locations with legendary treasure.
146980ab4e8f7df985f2.translation: 探索世界，寻找传奇地点和其中的传奇宝物。

49359a37acb98341b2dc.source: Two-handed maces excel in disabling single opponents.
49359a37acb98341b2dc.translation: 双手钉锤擅长削弱单个敌人的战斗能力。

8a73590d75502f65d5d7.source: Axes are particularly effective against trees.
8a73590d75502f65d5d7.translation: 对付树木，斧头格外有效。

2d3eba52100c946b2e74.source: A Schrat is a living tree, a being of bark and wood, with a mind truly alien.
2d3eba52100c946b2e74.translation: 树妖是活着的树，由树皮和木质构成，其心智与人类截然不同。

7e47a0ddf5169ae6e842.source: Use armor attachments to further improve and specialize the equipment of your men.
7e47a0ddf5169ae6e842.translation: 利用护甲附件，可以进一步强化弟兄们的装备，并针对不同用途加以调整。

a15d10e154093fa5eb9e.source: A Hexe appears as a youthful lady with radiant beauty to those she enthralls.
a15d10e154093fa5eb9e.translation: 在被魅惑的人眼里，女巫是一位年轻、光彩照人的美人。

51d02aec358404d415d8.source: Hexen are known to strike ill-omened deals that people come to regret.
51d02aec358404d415d8.translation: 女巫常与人订立不祥的契约，让对方事后悔恨不已。

d3ad6b446d34f929edf0.source: A Hexe can curse one of your men to suffer the same wounds as she does.
d3ad6b446d34f929edf0.translation: 女巫可以诅咒一名弟兄，使他承受与自己相同的伤害。

943ef1d9b939206f514a.source: Webknechts inflict additional damage to targets trapped in their webs.
943ef1d9b939206f514a.translation: 巨蛛攻击被蛛网缠住的目标时，会造成额外伤害。

69ec19c6ff3f29af2417.source: Webknechts are more confident, the larger the group they are in.
69ec19c6ff3f29af2417.translation: 巨蛛的群体越大，它们就越有自信。

5852247e64e415278169.source: The Webknecht is a large arachnid that lives in sizable colonies in the dark areas of forests throughout the world.
5852247e64e415278169.translation: 巨蛛是一种大型蛛类，成群栖息在世界各地森林的阴暗角落。

f6059670b19f47e9a26c.source: Collect trophies from slain beasts and have the taxidermist craft useful items from them.
f6059670b19f47e9a26c.translation: 收集猎杀野兽后得到的材料，再交给剥制工匠，便能制成实用物品。

3ec10553daed5d1b336f.source: Selling trophies from slain beasts can be lucrative. You can always get new ones.
3ec10553daed5d1b336f.translation: 出售猎兽所得的材料，可以赚上一笔。以后总还能猎到新的。

91c1941fd0dbb6959ccc.source: Fencing swords are most powerful in the hands of characters with high initiative.
91c1941fd0dbb6959ccc.translation: 先攻高的角色能发挥刺剑的最大威力。

99ee02f0ff7d0a4b3479.source: Use throwing spears to destroy the shields of your most dangerous opponents from afar.
99ee02f0ff7d0a4b3479.translation: 用投矛远远击毁最危险敌人的盾牌。

5e07fa3d079cde7aea72.source: Nachzehrers are found more often in the southern parts of the world.
5e07fa3d079cde7aea72.translation: 食尸鬼在世界南部更为常见。

adba681333a0e7249f2c.source: Alps are almost exclusively encountered at night.
adba681333a0e7249f2c.translation: 梦魇几乎只会在夜间出现。

b3dadb1a6204a101803e.source: The further away from civilization, the more dangerous the beasts that roam the land.
b3dadb1a6204a101803e.translation: 越远离文明之地，游荡的野兽就越危险。

10623159367f5158c470.source: Potions, despite their colorful descriptions, are essentially drugs, and characters can get addicted to them.
10623159367f5158c470.translation: 药剂的介绍说得再花哨，本质上仍是药物，角色可能对其产生依赖。

8327a26be0f03b3ef0a3.source: Overdosing on potions can lead to characters vomiting and getting sick.
8327a26be0f03b3ef0a3.translation: 饮用过量药剂，可能导致角色呕吐、生病。

2e6313750b9763694279.source: With the 'Beast Slayers' origin you'll have an easier time tracking beasts and get more trophies from any of those you slay.
2e6313750b9763694279.translation: 选择“猎兽者”起源，更容易追踪野兽，猎杀后也能获得更多材料。

b34e8d4c2daded7bf658.source: The north is inhabited by fierce barbarian tribes.
b34e8d4c2daded7bf658.translation: 北方生活着凶悍的野蛮人部族。

97800bbc0aca783ae470.source: Barbarians often overwhelm their opponents at the start of battle, but quickly become fatigued.
97800bbc0aca783ae470.translation: 野蛮人往往在开战时攻势凶猛，很快就能压制对手，但也容易迅速积累疲劳。

dbffcebac2274813b615.source: Northern warhounds are sturdier than southern wardogs, but not as quick and agile.
dbffcebac2274813b615.translation: 北方战獒比南方战犬更为健壮，但速度和灵活性稍逊。

6968b82ec2d086b3d471.source: The rhythmic tribal beats of drummers reduce the fatigue of all barbarians on the field by a small amount each round.
6968b82ec2d086b3d471.translation: 鼓手富有节奏的部族鼓点，会在每轮为战场上的所有野蛮人减少少量疲劳。

30a12c480f73b94a6d8b.source: Beastmasters can not crack the whip to direct their beastly warmachines when adjacent to an enemy.
30a12c480f73b94a6d8b.translation: 驯兽师与敌人相邻时，无法挥鞭指挥麾下那些活生生的战争机器。

b2e1780328b219c3fdc9.source: Barbarians look forward to meeting their ancestors in the afterlife.
b2e1780328b219c3fdc9.translation: 野蛮人期盼死后与先祖团聚。

09b7860b1724afed2326.source: Try different origins to tailor your campaign to your play style.
09b7860b1724afed2326.translation: 尝试不同的战团起源，找到适合自己玩法的开局。

827ab99474fc1c8c3b1a.source: With the 'Lone Wolf' origin you'll have a player character in the world. If you die, the campaign ends.
827ab99474fc1c8c3b1a.translation: 选择“孤狼”起源，你会亲自化身为队伍中的角色。你一旦死亡，战役就会结束。

ecad4c7a38c1d6b34db8.source: With the 'Peasant Militia' origin you can take up to 16 men into battle at once.
ecad4c7a38c1d6b34db8.translation: 选择“农民民兵”起源，一场战斗最多可带16人上阵。

a3ffc323a661dd270440.source: With the 'Cultists' origin your god will demand sacrifices from you, but also bestow boons upon those loyal to him.
a3ffc323a661dd270440.translation: 选择“教徒”起源，你的神祇会索要祭品，也会赐福于忠诚的信徒。

176e37026b46f9ba42a1.source: With the 'Band of Poachers' origin you'll move faster on the worldmap.
176e37026b46f9ba42a1.translation: 选择“偷猎团伙”起源，战团在世界地图上的移动速度会更快。

022e9a8d511db884ff27.source: With the 'Trading Caravan' origin you'll get better prices for both buying and selling.
022e9a8d511db884ff27.translation: 选择“贸易商队”起源，无论买进还是卖出，都能得到更好的价格。

d599f39b56eeeb962df9.source: Slings inflict the 'Daze' status effect on a hit to the head.
d599f39b56eeeb962df9.translation: 投石索命中头部时，会使目标陷入“恍惚”状态。

617f1cc2b27fea1287dd.source: With stones abundant everywhere, Slings will never run out of ammunition.
617f1cc2b27fea1287dd.translation: 石块随处可得，因此投石索永远不会耗尽弹药。

15314c7090b647497c48.source: Battle Whips can temporarily disarm opponents, preventing them from using weapon skills.
15314c7090b647497c48.translation: 战鞭能暂时缴械，使敌人无法使用武器技能。

b06fa9ecd1d34240ff33.source: Battle Whips can inflict bleeding wounds, but perform dismally against armor.
b06fa9ecd1d34240ff33.translation: 战鞭可以造成流血创伤，对付护甲却收效甚微。

f3832171666942c7c821.source: Scimitars and Shamshirs are more likely to inflict debilitating injuries when hitting a target.
f3832171666942c7c821.translation: 弯刀和舍施尔弯刀命中目标时，更容易造成削弱能力的创伤。

f69f0b89bc94c9d9ac1f.source: is reborn by the power of the Lorekeeper!
f69f0b89bc94c9d9ac1f.translation: 借助典籍守护者的力量重生了！

400ce6a336c99123ff84.translation: 凭借九命猫特长死里逃生！

9e34fdb97a09e0321cda.source: A spectator cheering for the arena fight
9e34fdb97a09e0321cda.translation: 一名正在为竞技场搏杀欢呼的观众

ce23a7349924c64d5695.source: Dense shrubbery that blocks movement and line of sight.
ce23a7349924c64d5695.translation: 茂密的灌木丛，阻挡移动与视线。

b97d961e98d16e7d8d32.source: A tall and slim birch tree with its leaves starting to turn brown and red.
b97d961e98d16e7d8d32.translation: 一棵高而纤细的桦树，叶片开始转为褐色与红色。

5d64d3e613cf75ed355b.translation: 一处用来烹煮食物的火塘。

33a522df158be2a7043e.source: A barbarian idol carved from wood.
33a522df158be2a7043e.translation: 一尊用木头雕成的蛮族神像。

ac6815f6b8cc0887337f.source: A long, wooden pole with a recently cut horse head at the end, directed towards the enemy and target of a curse.
ac6815f6b8cc0887337f.translation: 长长的木杆顶端插着一颗刚斩下的马头，朝向敌人，也朝向诅咒所指之人。

cb70da49bc70b1e44bcb.source: A standard that leaves no doubt about who this camp's inhabitants are.
cb70da49bc70b1e44bcb.translation: 这面旗帜清楚地宣示着营地主人的身份。

4cdc11bc3ec7aa6d2f24.source: Wooden furniture for this camp's inhabitants.
4cdc11bc3ec7aa6d2f24.translation: 营地居民使用的木制家具。

a669ecfdcb1c9d17b84f.source: A marquee provides cover from the harsh sun of the south.
a669ecfdcb1c9d17b84f.translation: 这顶大帐篷遮挡着南方的毒辣日头。

3aee8e3ec4c3670d0d04.source: Weapons on display, perhaps as a warning to intruders.
3aee8e3ec4c3670d0d04.translation: 陈列在外的武器，或许是在警告闯入者。

b73fda8fcb0cb87aa2d1.source: Supplies to feed this camp's inhabitants.
b73fda8fcb0cb87aa2d1.translation: 供营地居民食用的补给。

b104fcf8a5cb8fb1632a.source: This greenskin siege engine has been rendered unusable.
b104fcf8a5cb8fb1632a.translation: 这台绿皮攻城器械已经无法使用。

6e01d1e145340d9ae455.source: A stone receptacle housing a variety of gore and viscera.
6e01d1e145340d9ae455.translation: 一座装着血肉与内脏的石制容器。

cdea746fb1b4c8ea703d.source: A destroyed stone receptacle. The guts and gore once housed within have slopped onto the surrounding ground.
cdea746fb1b4c8ea703d.translation: 一座被摧毁的石制容器，原本装在里面的血肉内脏洒满了周围地面。

6e3992eb0013f1bbc33e.source: A brazier filled with burnt wood.

0f8f4dbc026a86e6c53c.source: A cage containing the remains of some unfortunate prisoner.
0f8f4dbc026a86e6c53c.translation: 笼中装着某个不幸囚犯的遗骸。

19b76fc29cc2e5816c42.source: Several polearms on display, perhaps to mark territory or as a warning to intruders.
19b76fc29cc2e5816c42.translation: 几件长柄武器陈列在外，或许是用来标示领地，或警告闯入者。

d80e0843c4f248ef6130.source: A golem of flesh, watching you in stony silence
d80e0843c4f248ef6130.translation: 一具血肉魔像默然不动，凝视着你

5377dc7dca4527f8fa74.source: The last resting place of some unfortunate souls.
5377dc7dca4527f8fa74.translation: 一些不幸之人的长眠之所。

4e0936f96b997fa49e8d.source: A bronze statue from an age long past.
4e0936f96b997fa49e8d.translation: 一尊来自远古时代的青铜雕像。

291a423c2cc79f6a51a4.source: Presumably the last resting place of someone who died long ago.
291a423c2cc79f6a51a4.translation: 想必是某个早已逝去之人的长眠之所。

918e471e811e1a37d76f.source: An old and partly crumbled wall.
918e471e811e1a37d76f.translation: 一堵年久失修、部分坍塌的墙。

28279bc8e0ff0a49afa9.source: Wood chopped as firewood or for constructing palisades.
28279bc8e0ff0a49afa9.translation: 砍下堆好的木料，可用来生火或修建寨墙。

f3f918bd3eb5845a75fa.source: A fireplace. You don't want to know what they're cooking here.
f3f918bd3eb5845a75fa.translation: 一处火塘。你不会想知道他们在煮什么。

a4fb79e6e50eaab32742.source: A gruesome display of what happens to humans around here.
a4fb79e6e50eaab32742.translation: 这般骇人的展示，让人明白人类落到这里会有什么下场。

46cb18bddbc8b0399324.source: Flayed skin and intestines on display.
46cb18bddbc8b0399324.translation: 剥下的皮与肠子被悬挂展示。

d6b727e033c5396b10db.source: Gruesome remains of some kind of animal.
d6b727e033c5396b10db.translation: 某种动物惨不忍睹的残骸。

c53421a0cd9cf74aaa34.source: The remains of a once proud tree.
c53421a0cd9cf74aaa34.translation: 一棵昔日高大挺拔的树，如今只剩残躯。

ef3c368335447980580c.source: A cypress tree. Blocks movement and line of sight.
ef3c368335447980580c.translation: 一棵柏树，阻挡移动与视线。

f2694f872ce37b4f082b.source: This tree has withered and is long dead. Blocks movement and line of sight.
f2694f872ce37b4f082b.translation: 这棵树早已枯死，阻挡移动与视线。

cc72dd90b86e635ddee1.source: A large olive tree. Blocks movement and line of sight.
cc72dd90b86e635ddee1.translation: 一棵高大的橄榄树，阻挡移动与视线。

2d4bb0fdebcf9882c1d2.source: The remains of a cut-down tree.
2d4bb0fdebcf9882c1d2.translation: 树木被砍伐后留下的残桩。

747aa9e0c2ea5cf3acc9.source: With the company from the very beginning.
747aa9e0c2ea5cf3acc9.translation: 从战团创立之初便一路相随。

ce7a3c02a5c3170db708.source: The most powerful opponent he vanquished was
ce7a3c02a5c3170db708.translation: 他击败过的最强敌人是

b5397c14bfd2f8e16f62.translation: 出战的负债者人数不足

6b02c9ead06924ebe1f5.source: The collectors living in these huts search for valuable amber shards along the shore.
6b02c9ead06924ebe1f5.translation: 住在这些小屋里的采集者沿着海岸搜寻珍贵的琥珀碎块。

e877ecdf41bfc6081dc2.source: Surrounded by humming bees, these small huts are home to beekeepers. The honey they produce is a precious ingredient to sweeten pastries and other foods.
e877ecdf41bfc6081dc2.translation: 蜂群嗡嗡作响，环绕着养蜂人的小屋。他们出产的蜂蜜十分珍贵，可用来为糕点和其他食物增添甜味。

5cdd016be27d136cfe6c.source: The blast furnace produces the blazing temperatures needed to make the most durable of metal alloys. Handy armorsmiths will use these alloys to create sturdy armor in the nearest settlement.
5cdd016be27d136cfe6c.translation: 高炉能达到冶炼坚韧合金所需的炽热高温。附近聚落中技艺娴熟的铠甲匠会用这些合金打造坚固的护甲。

4ad5a365c89f8ca37bae.source: This brewery produces large quantities of beer for both local taverns and traders.
4ad5a365c89f8ca37bae.translation: 这座酿酒坊大量生产啤酒，供应当地酒馆，也出售给往来的商人。

565e2554b8679f8adbab.source: This dye maker creates precious dies from all kinds of ingredients. The recipes for these expensive goods are well-kept secrets.
565e2554b8679f8adbab.translation: 作坊用各种原料制成珍贵的染料，这些昂贵商品的配方都是严守的秘密。

e7654f733ba06d4c7682.source: A small group of huts surrounded by nets, spears, hooks and other fishing equipment. The smell from baskets of fish guts travels quite a distance.
e7654f733ba06d4c7682.translation: 几间小屋周围摆满了渔网、鱼叉、鱼钩和其他渔具。一筐筐鱼内脏散发的腥臭，远远就能闻到。

008c35a5efa63252f996.source: The arrow makers in these sheds produce all kinds of ranged ammunition which they then sell at the nearest settlement.
008c35a5efa63252f996.translation: 工棚里的制箭匠制作各种远程武器弹药，再运到附近的聚落出售。

429b6eaa2551a61f7ba7.source: Large barracks housing a host of professional soldiers.
429b6eaa2551a61f7ba7.translation: 一座驻扎着大批职业士兵的大型兵营。

a288c5310c3b4c2278b4.source: Even in sparse environments an experienced gatherer can find berries, roots and other edible things. Although not the most delicious, it can still keep a man fed.
a288c5310c3b4c2278b4.translation: 即便土地贫瘠，经验老到的采集者也能找到浆果、根茎和其他可食之物。虽然谈不上美味，至少能填饱肚子。

e2102dfcc55c0b2d260b.source: The shiny gems found in this mine are usually brought directly to the next settlement in well-guarded caravans for further refinement.
e2102dfcc55c0b2d260b.translation: 矿中开采出的璀璨宝石通常由守卫森严的商队直接运往附近聚落，继续加工打磨。

b3c79187aff60bb886a5.source: The goats held here are mainly used for their milk which is then turned into cheese to make it more durable.
b3c79187aff60bb886a5.translation: 这里饲养的山羊主要用于产奶，羊奶随后被制成奶酪，以便长久保存。

403e9caf75cf85f70e59.source: A deep mine build atop a gold ore vein. This rare metal has a tendency to bring out the worst in people.
403e9caf75cf85f70e59.translation: 一座沿着金矿脉开掘的深井。黄金这等稀有金属，总能勾出人心中最丑恶的一面。

3a0346069b7fbe75c6e6.source: A road checkpoint manned by professional soldiers.
3a0346069b7fbe75c6e6.translation: 一处由职业士兵驻守的道路关卡。

a05d79d0451771a07b68.source: A harbor that serves both foreign trading ships and local fishermen.
a05d79d0451771a07b68.translation: 这座港口既供外来的商船停泊，也为本地渔民提供便利。

ca2df243aff6662175ab.source: In this remote grove the knowing herbalist collects all kinds of medicinal plants and roots.
ca2df243aff6662175ab.translation: 在这片偏僻的林地里，熟谙药性的草药师采集着各类药草和根茎。

125246dd3a97fc6c551c.source: Hunters take shelter in these small huts while on the hunt. Chopped up game, venison and hides hung up to dry in the sun surround the huts.
125246dd3a97fc6c551c.translation: 猎人们外出狩猎时在这些小屋里落脚。屋外摆着切好的猎物和鹿肉，兽皮则挂在阳光下晾晒。

7297c19180006c40071e.source: Tree sap is gathered from the surrounding trees and dried in the sun to create valuable incense.
7297c19180006c40071e.translation: 人们从周围的树木上采集树脂，在阳光下晒干，制成珍贵的熏香。

f3b9a67d74f1b5a30a20.source: This leather tanner's workshop produces durable leather pieces from hides. The supply of this leather will increase the availability of light armor in the nearest settlement.
f3b9a67d74f1b5a30a20.translation: 制革坊将兽皮加工成耐用的皮革。充足的皮革供应使附近聚落能出售更多轻型护甲。

e300e97829399ac480df.source: This lumber camp is used as a base for lumberjacks on the search for the most precious and durable materials in the nearby woods.
e300e97829399ac480df.translation: 伐木工以这里为落脚点，在附近的林中寻找珍贵而耐用的木材。

454da9751cba37051ca4.source: A large compound of militia barracks. This camp will turn ordinary peasants into somewhat able soldiers that can defend their home and their loved ones.
454da9751cba37051ca4.translation: 一片规模不小的民兵营房。普通农夫在这里受训，成为能保卫家园与亲人的士兵，多少也算有了些本事。

31c6dde023bb85d887c0.source: Hidden in the mud and reed, the expert gatherer can find groves and caves full of precious mushrooms like these.
31c6dde023bb85d887c0.translation: 经验丰富的采集者能在泥淖和芦苇的遮掩下，找到这般长满珍贵蘑菇的林地与洞穴。
