4fc973aa07aa990e3758.source: Dense rows of trees with ripe fruit frame a small warehouse where everything is stored until offered on local markets.
4fc973aa07aa990e3758.translation: 结满熟果的树木密密排列，围着一座小仓库。采下的果实在此存放，等着送往当地市场出售。

1a4e1df777a140f599cd.source: The burning hot ore smelters produce high quality metal ingots used by able weapon smiths to create the most sophisticated of arms.
1a4e1df777a140f599cd.translation: 炽热的熔炉将矿石炼成优质金属锭，供手艺精湛的武器匠打造精良兵器。

51476f574fe29754e6f9.source: These peat pits produce a valuable fuel source once the peat has been dug up and dried.
51476f574fe29754e6f9.translation: 从这些坑中挖出的泥炭，晒干后便是一种实用的燃料。

dc7c191193d66025f168.source: The smell of this pig farm is just as distinct as the squeeking sounds coming from the muddy pits. The pork chops produced here are usually sold in the nearby settlement.
dc7c191193d66025f168.translation: 猪圈的气味和泥坑里传出的尖叫声一样引人注意。这里出产的猪肉通常会送到附近聚落出售。

279067e159ef12655fa6.source: All kinds of wonderous spices and herbs are cultivated in this plantation. A small and rare fruitful spot in the barren desert.
279067e159ef12655fa6.translation: 种植园里栽培着各种奇妙的香料和草药，是荒凉沙漠中难得的一小片沃土。

7d41c950f20fc590b669.source: A mine in which precious rock salt is extracted and shipped off to only the most trustworthy traders.
7d41c950f20fc590b669.translation: 这座矿场开采珍贵的岩盐，只交由最值得信赖的商人贩运。

35c283b5d3b840e84bab.source: In these huts the precious silk is spun from cocoons of small insects by secret methods.
35c283b5d3b840e84bab.translation: 小屋里的人们用秘传的手艺，从虫茧中抽出珍贵的丝线。

28fcd1696a6c8e7dbef2.source: A stone watchtower occupied by well trained soldiers on guard duty.
28fcd1696a6c8e7dbef2.translation: 一座石砌哨塔，由训练有素的士兵驻守警戒。

2caceb01032a4870cb06.source: A mining camp has been set up to mine a surfaced copper vein and smelt the ore into ingots on the spot.
2caceb01032a4870cb06.translation: 人们在裸露的铜矿脉旁搭起营地，开采矿石，并就地熔炼成锭。

3587bd9522dc49ccc084.source: This surfaced iron vein attracted a small mining camp that is gathering the precious metal. Access to this resource increases the selection of weapons available in the next settlement.
3587bd9522dc49ccc084.translation: 裸露的铁矿脉吸引了一批矿工，他们扎下营地，开采这些宝贵的金属。充足的铁料使附近聚落出售的武器种类更加丰富。

2416678056a263af1df2.source: Small huts provide shelter for the trappers living here and setting traps for animals with valuable furs.
2416678056a263af1df2.translation: 捕兽人住在这些小屋里，外出布设陷阱，捕捉皮毛值钱的动物。

b3b2ab03f13aa213e48b.source: Golden wheat can be seen glistening in the sun from afar. Many people from the nearby settlement work here, farmhands and daytalers mostly.
b3b2ab03f13aa213e48b.translation: 远远便能望见金黄的麦穗在阳光下闪耀。附近聚落有不少人在这里劳作，大多是农场帮工和短工。

b7e573cc06feffe0d579.source: This winery is surrounded by a large vineyard. The wine produced here is a priced commodity in wealthier circles.
b7e573cc06feffe0d579.translation: 酒庄周围是一大片葡萄园。这里酿出的葡萄酒颇受富人追捧。

ae81379399dd5dee885e.source: A wooden watchtower with a small garrison on watch duty.
ae81379399dd5dee885e.translation: 一座木制哨塔，驻有一小队负责警戒的士兵。

6a6ce40c5d9a684b55aa.source: The wool of the sheep herded here is spun into wool and then shipped to the next settlement. Refined wares like these can be quite valuable.
6a6ce40c5d9a684b55aa.translation: 这里饲养的绵羊提供羊毛，纺成毛线后再运往附近聚落。这类加工过的货物颇有价值。

8768ca5f432c12a4c4b8.source: The workshop is proficient in making all kinds of tools and other supplies needed to keep carts and machines working.
8768ca5f432c12a4c4b8.translation: 作坊擅长制作各种工具与维修物资，用于维护车辆和机械。

7fb964151344b92e0924.source: Once part of the nearby settlement, these are now burned down and abandoned ruins.
7fb964151344b92e0924.translation: 这里曾是附近聚落的一部分，如今已被焚毁，只剩下无人问津的废墟。

51ff13fcfc26fd1f08d3.source: A free mercenary company travelling the lands and lending their swords to the highest bidder.
51ff13fcfc26fd1f08d3.translation: 一支独立的佣兵战团，游走四方，为出价最高的人效力。

0c9bfed629585d570673.source: The remains of an old fortress. It looks entirely abandoned.
0c9bfed629585d570673.translation: 一座古老要塞的残骸，看上去已彻底废弃。

3cf53071f76d4fa825d9.source: A fortified wooden encampment used by outlaws to stash their loot, rest in between raids and play drinking games.
3cf53071f76d4fa825d9.translation: 一处设有防御工事的木制营寨。匪徒在这里藏匿赃物，在劫掠之间休息，也少不了喝酒作乐。

d67a225d8b4f1a5f23d9.source: An abandoned homestead with a collapsed roof.
d67a225d8b4f1a5f23d9.translation: 一座屋顶坍塌的废弃农庄。

0f2cb8c0cfbc393bf711.source: These ancient ruins cast their shadows far over the surrounding sands.
0f2cb8c0cfbc393bf711.translation: 古老的废墟在四周沙地上投下长长的阴影。

56097107e959cadec5cf.source: A once proud fortress now lying in ruins.
56097107e959cadec5cf.translation: 昔日雄伟的要塞，如今只剩断壁残垣。

bdb52e57f07b38d3887f.source: A set of fur jurts typical for the barbarians of the northern regions.
bdb52e57f07b38d3887f.translation: 几顶兽皮圆帐，是北方蛮族惯用的样式。

97543372882cdc1044d8.source: Barbarians have flocked to this place and set up camp around a site of worship. A lot of fierce northern warriors are likely to be found nearby.
97543372882cdc1044d8.translation: 蛮族聚集于此，围绕着祭祀之地扎下营地。附近很可能有大量凶悍的北方战士。

96302525afdc63dfdc00.source: A couple of simple barbarian fur huts huddled down in a circle.
96302525afdc63dfdc00.translation: 几间简陋的蛮族兽皮棚屋低矮地围成一圈。

65ee1ac9902a52a801d5.source: A battle took place here a short while ago. Broken and lost equipment, blood stains and torn ground tell of a determined fight.
65ee1ac9902a52a801d5.translation: 不久前，这里爆发过一场战斗。破损和遗落的装备、斑斑血迹、被翻起的泥土，无不诉说着交战的惨烈。

6bb57b01d87e3ae2672c.source: A makeshift encampment erected by goblins for shelter and stashing supplies.
6bb57b01d87e3ae2672c.translation: 地精搭起的临时营地，用来栖身和囤积补给。

84e2ac10ab3a72dcdbdf.source: A great goblin city nested into the remains of an ancient fortress. Protected by dark and towering walls, it is host to a standing army of vicious greenskins.
84e2ac10ab3a72dcdbdf.translation: 一座庞大的地精城市盘踞在古代要塞的遗址中。高耸阴暗的城墙后，驻扎着一支凶狠的绿皮常备军。

f20249fd8ef5d56b96b6.source: A defensible outpost erected by goblins.
f20249fd8ef5d56b96b6.translation: 地精修筑的一处易于防守的前哨据点。

8b531722091e76fd8cd1.source: The gates to a great underground Goblin city, its maze-like tunnels teeming with vicious greenskins.
8b531722091e76fd8cd1.translation: 这里通向一座庞大的地精地下城。迷宫般的坑道里，凶恶的绿皮成群出没。

47d5252a44d8ba235e19.source: A seemingly abandoned village, with a towering statue dominating the square.
47d5252a44d8ba235e19.translation: 一座看似已被遗弃的村庄，广场上矗立着高大的雕像。

cca25d487defd201b4d9.source: A huge statue glittering in the sun that towers over the surrounding landscape.
cca25d487defd201b4d9.translation: 一座巨大的雕像高出周围地势，在阳光下闪闪发亮。

a9bf61ee0644ab9cdf01.source: The sunken and half buried entrance to some sort of temple or mausoleum that sticks out of the ground.
a9bf61ee0644ab9cdf01.translation: 某座神殿或陵墓的入口，已沉陷半埋，只余一部分露出地面。

3bd6ad17a29f9d05c3f2.source: A thin spire reaching high into the sky. The view from the top must be staggering.
3bd6ad17a29f9d05c3f2.translation: 一座纤细的高塔直插天际，塔顶的景色想必令人叹为观止。

44b20cc8bd934f7b96ee.source: A collapsed ruin from days long past. The occasional flicker of torchlight betrays the presence of current inhabitants, as do the strange sounds eminating from deep within.
44b20cc8bd934f7b96ee.translation: 一片年代久远、坍塌破败的遗址。偶尔闪动的火光，以及深处传来的怪声，都表明如今仍有东西住在里面。

403e24db6eb4f71e006d.source: A pitch black monolith towers over the surrounding lands, emitting a baleful aura. No living being dares drawing close to it.
403e24db6eb4f71e006d.translation: 漆黑的巨石高踞于周围大地之上，散发着不祥的气息，没有任何活物敢于靠近。

a8dbcfa8e66d9dc07e3a.source: A small clearing in the forest centered around a curios, slender tree. Something seems to be off about this tree but it is difficult to make out from afar.
a8dbcfa8e66d9dc07e3a.translation: 森林里的一小片空地中央，长着一棵纤细而古怪的树。它似乎有什么不对劲，可离得太远，难以看清。

75e1036fba1736ae5f27.source: A cave amidst a sea of snow and rock. A thick gate of icicles keeps your entrance well stayed.
75e1036fba1736ae5f27.translation: 一座洞穴隐于茫茫积雪与岩石之间，厚密的冰柱如闸门般封住了入口。

227cbd4faf585f83513e.source: Stone circles and pillars with strange markings hint at something eerie looming in the area.
227cbd4faf585f83513e.translation: 石圈与石柱上刻着奇异的纹样，仿佛有什么诡谲之物潜伏在附近。

6f558954c152123be97e.source: Atop some trees sits a large wooden structure. As strange as it seems, it looks a lot like a ship.
6f558954c152123be97e.translation: 树梢上架着一座庞大的木制结构。说来古怪，那东西看上去竟很像一艘船。

437411d23c0889518ccd.source: A great crater in the ground made by a rock that fell from the sky. A mausoleum was built around it a long ago, and to this day people from all corners of the world set out to pilgrimage here.
437411d23c0889518ccd.translation: 从天而降的巨石在地面砸出了一座大坑。很久以前，人们围着它修建了陵庙，直到今日，仍有来自四面八方的朝圣者前来拜谒。

b63cdef858197ab37458.source: The remains of a temple that once housed an oracle in an age long past. Although ruined now, people still flock to it and have visions of things that will come to pass.
b63cdef858197ab37458.translation: 一座古老神殿的遗迹，远古时曾有先知居于此处。如今虽已破败，人们仍纷至沓来，并在此看见预示未来的幻象。

07236d9b4e42ecb7d323.source: Shimmering in the sun, golden domes peer out of the sand and give away that something larger lies dormant here, sunken and buried under the sand for ages.
07236d9b4e42ecb7d323.translation: 金色穹顶从沙中露出，在阳光下熠熠生辉。这些残迹表明，更庞大的建筑仍沉睡在地下，已被黄沙掩埋多年。

9980fc581af4fcdea5e6.source: A lone elk grazes on green meadows, in the shadow of some trees and by a small lake.
9980fc581af4fcdea5e6.translation: 小湖边，树荫下，一头孤鹿正在青绿的草地上觅食。

5aa26daafd3f70c82d21.source: A wide field littered with gigantic bones and skulls. Some are bleached to white but some are fresh and still have flesh attached to them.
5aa26daafd3f70c82d21.translation: 广阔的荒地上散落着巨大的骨骼与头颅。有些早已风化成白骨，有些却还新鲜，仍挂着残肉。

799a5bb0f75715f2810d.source: Once a thriving city, now but ruins covered in ash. A fallen metropolis with many names, it has become an object of cultural and religious pride for north and south alike.
799a5bb0f75715f2810d.translation: 昔日繁华的城市，如今只剩覆盖着灰烬的废墟。这座毁灭的都城有许多名字，南北双方都将它视为各自文化与信仰的荣耀。

5e423dbc224b529d433f.source: A small watermill with a stony house at its side. It looks like someone might be living here.
5e423dbc224b529d433f.translation: 一座小水磨，旁边有间石屋，似乎仍有人居住。

6fd53fe28fb34b0aa1ed.source: A skewed and withered hut that looks like it could collapse at any moment. Smoke is rising from an awry chimney.
6fd53fe28fb34b0aa1ed.translation: 一间歪斜腐朽的小屋，看上去随时都会坍塌。倾斜的烟囱里升起缕缕炊烟。

7a5e0f81f6b467fc7767.source: A sea of tents, host to the army of a noble house.
7a5e0f81f6b467fc7767.translation: 营帐绵延如海，一支贵族家族的军队驻扎于此。

aaf0f4da2879a2718bfe.source: Nomads hide their camps well to avoid unwanted visitors or pursuing soldiers of the city states.
aaf0f4da2879a2718bfe.translation: 游牧民善于隐藏营地，以避开不速之客和城邦的追兵。

2570d9e2347e9c0ee7c2.source: A large collection of colorful nomad huts and tents huddled together in the desert.
2570d9e2347e9c0ee7c2.translation: 大片色彩鲜艳的游牧民棚屋与帐篷，在沙漠中紧密相连。

9a4db73a02f5b9187e2b.source: A small camp of nomad tents that can be packed up and moved quickly.
9a4db73a02f5b9187e2b.translation: 一处小型游牧民营地，帐篷可以迅速拆收，随时转移。

2666117b3e6006e21b54.source: A small camp erected by Orcs, either as part of a large horde in the vicinity or a small tribes of its own. They'll eventually move on to hunt and pillage elsewhere.
2666117b3e6006e21b54.translation: 兽人搭起的小营地，可能隶属于附近的大部落，也可能自成一支小部落。迟早，它们会转往别处狩猎和劫掠。

300afffa0d2b51e2415e.source: This cave has been occupied by greenskins and turned into a foul-smelling camp.
300afffa0d2b51e2415e.translation: 这座洞穴已被绿皮占据，成了一处恶臭熏天的营地。

eef6074ea798a783319b.source: A mighty fortress made from massive iron wood logs and covered in tribal paintings of war. The bloodthirsty shouts of orcs echoing behind the walls can be heard from afar.
eef6074ea798a783319b.translation: 巨大的铁木原木筑成坚固的堡垒，外墙绘满部落的战争图腾。兽人嗜血的吼声从墙后传出，远远就能听见。

a2d518ff344c4029340b.source: A large and foul-smelling sea of tents, with a warlord's tent and throne-room in the middle, the largest of all. It's home to a whole tribe until they move on to hunt and raid elsewhere.
a2d518ff344c4029340b.translation: 大片营帐散发着恶臭，正中央那顶最大，是军阀的居所与王座厅。整个部落暂居于此，直到前往别处狩猎和劫掠。

a4d34ae5d80f0041d5af.source: Sunken into the ground, this castle has been long abandoned, only to give refuge to much darker creatures.
a4d34ae5d80f0041d5af.translation: 这座城堡沉陷于地下，早已被人遗弃，如今却成了邪恶生物的藏身之所。

98769a26bc7a237e14f9.source: A long forgotten crypt haunted by the ghosts of the past. The dead won't find sleep here.
98769a26bc7a237e14f9.translation: 一座早被遗忘的墓穴，往昔的幽魂在其中徘徊。死者在此无法安眠。

cf0973b18d458e58a8fd.source: A place where people have buried their dead, placing them down for their last rest. Or at least they hoped so.
cf0973b18d458e58a8fd.translation: 人们将死者埋葬于此，愿他们长眠不醒。至少，活着的人是这么希望的。

06b9fac7bb971e3e4ed7.source: The sad remains of a merciless battle, an epidemic or other catastrophe. The survivors dug a large hole and piled all the corpses into it to get rid of them quickly.
06b9fac7bb971e3e4ed7.translation: 一场惨烈战事、瘟疫或其他灾难留下的凄凉遗迹。幸存者挖出大坑，将尸体层层堆入，好尽快处理这些死者。

e849331009e86cfd702e.source: A necromancer has made this lair his refuge for practicing dark rituals undisturbed.
e849331009e86cfd702e.translation: 一名亡灵法师以此为巢穴，在无人打扰的地方举行黑暗仪式。

134e95a4b27783b493fc.source: Once a thriving human settlement, this place has been defiled and fallen into ruin, turned into a necropolis of the undead. Waves of walking corpses pour forth to spread terror and fear in the surrounding lands.
134e95a4b27783b493fc.translation: 这里曾是繁荣的人类聚落，如今却遭亵渎、化为废墟，成了亡灵之城。成群的行尸不断涌出，将恐怖散播到周围各地。

664da2039aab75ec6ffb.source: Hidden for centuries, this ancient place became a safe haven for a coven of hemovores.
664da2039aab75ec6ffb.translation: 这处古老之地隐匿了数百年，成了一群嗜血生物的避难所。

3e219034a78c463323e0.source: Only ruins are left of what was once a formidable castle.
3e219034a78c463323e0.translation: 昔日坚不可摧的城堡，如今只剩废墟。

ed4f8bed5fd0a52e038c.source: Only ruins are left of what was once a flourishing town.
ed4f8bed5fd0a52e038c.translation: 昔日繁华的城镇，如今只剩废墟。

d3a00e329512c6087e73.source: You've never been to this place.

f6c571565d31488af2d4.source: Exotic and dangerous alchemical contraptions can be bought here
f6c571565d31488af2d4.translation: 这里出售各种奇异而危险的炼金器具

140bc3a6fd5de431a5f0.source: This armorer's workshop is the right place to look for well-made and durable protection
140bc3a6fd5de431a5f0.translation: 想找做工精良、坚固耐用的护甲，来这家铠甲铺就对了

3e2eec4376a68e5c4ecb.source: Customize the appearance of your men at the barber
3e2eec4376a68e5c4ecb.translation: 在理发店调整弟兄们的外貌

d63190db8790d6d38aea.source: All kinds of expertly crafted ranged weaponry can be found here
d63190db8790d6d38aea.translation: 这里出售各式精工打造的远程武器

476d3da9757dcce59d84.source: Strong and fast wardogs are bred and kept at this kennel
476d3da9757dcce59d84.translation: 这家犬舍繁育和饲养着强壮敏捷的战犬

89263c5518dfad3009db.source: A lively market offering all sorts of goods common in the region
89263c5518dfad3009db.translation: 热闹的集市，出售当地常见的各类货物

54a8782c3807b9724cf9.source: A harbor that serves both foreign trading ships and local fishermen
54a8782c3807b9724cf9.translation: 供外来商船和本地渔民停泊的港口

248f0aca8401b3c09745.source: A harbor that allows you to book passage by ship to other parts of the continent
248f0aca8401b3c09745.translation: 可在此付费搭船，前往大陆其他地方

b5aa711b4f512613a95d.source: {A fast ship | A sturdy ship | A cog | A longship | A small ship | A trading ship | A knarr | A local fishing boat | A creaking old ship} by the name of '%shipname%' {would take your company onboard and to %destname% | happens to sail to %destname% and would take your company onboard | is soon to depart and could be a way to safely and quickly make passage to %destname% | could provide a means to reach %destname% a lot faster than going overland | could drop you off at %destname% for a full purse of crowns}.
b5aa711b4f512613a95d.translation: {一艘快船 | 一艘坚固的船 | 一艘科格船 | 一艘长船 | 一艘小船 | 一艘商船 | 一艘北欧商船 | 一艘本地渔船 | 一艘吱呀作响的旧船}名为“%shipname%”，{愿意搭载战团前往%destname% | 恰好要驶往%destname%，愿意让战团搭船同行 | 即将启航，能让你们安全迅速地抵达%destname% | 能送你们前往%destname%，比走陆路快得多 | 只要收下一满袋克朗，就能将你们送到%destname%}。

96e819983da60ea2b4f6.source: The patrons raise their cups to you, but it seems there is nothing more to be learned by talking to them tonight.
96e819983da60ea2b4f6.translation: 酒客们向你举杯致意，不过今晚再聊下去，似乎也打听不到更多消息了。

db8009d4cf9f3c1fae24.source: The patrons talk about this and that.
db8009d4cf9f3c1fae24.translation: 酒客们东拉西扯，聊着各种闲话。

21ca44363a6c3f7aeca8.translation: 与战团的弟兄们喝了个酩酊大醉

d85b7dfd43f4d1247d89.source: A taxidermist can create useful items from all kinds of trophies you claimed
d85b7dfd43f4d1247d89.translation: 剥制匠能将你缴获的各类猎物材料制成实用物品

26989b3b15a51fdc4379.source: Have your wounded treated by priests

85dfd4a1f1f7b54be90d.source: Have your men train for combat and learn from veterans
85dfd4a1f1f7b54be90d.translation: 让弟兄们接受战斗训练，向老兵请教

71fc7dc65d55382b75eb.source: A weaponsmith's workshop displaying all kinds of well crafted weapons
71fc7dc65d55382b75eb.translation: 武器铺陈列着各式做工精良的兵器

a0f477019abef5d9ad16.source: A large and rich city state that thrives on trade at the edge of the desert
a0f477019abef5d9ad16.translation: 沙漠边缘的一座富庶大城邦，因贸易而繁荣

24e0846e47de5d76ad98.source: A large and rich city state that thrives on trade at the edge of the desert.
24e0846e47de5d76ad98.translation: 沙漠边缘的一座富庶大城邦，因贸易而繁荣。

fcb40bfd35131d756f07.source: This massive citadel guards a warport and the surrounding trade routes
fcb40bfd35131d756f07.translation: 这座宏伟的城塞守卫着军港和周边商路

670367d05153700a3e25.source: This massive citadel guards a warport and the surrounding trade routes. It is a seat of power for nobility and home to a large garrison.
670367d05153700a3e25.translation: 这座宏伟的城塞守卫着军港和周边商路，既是贵族的权力中心，也驻有大批军队。

425a4276da4ae3fb0b3c.source: A massive citadel towering over the open plains
425a4276da4ae3fb0b3c.translation: 一座巍峨的城塞，耸立于开阔的平原之上

489ef790b87ae5339573.source: A massive citadel towering over the open plains surrounding it. A seat of power to nobles, and housing large armed forces for a firm grip on the region.
489ef790b87ae5339573.translation: 巍峨的城塞俯瞰着四周开阔的平原。这里是贵族的权力中心，驻扎着大批军队，牢牢控制着整片地区。

564fc533c6ab1ce32ee2.source: A large city thriving on trade and agriculture
564fc533c6ab1ce32ee2.translation: 依靠贸易和农业繁荣起来的大城

6f8d0ee78144d561419f.source: A large city surrounded by lush green meadows, orchards and fields. Food stocks are usually filled to the brim.
6f8d0ee78144d561419f.translation: 一座大城，周围遍布青翠的草场、果园和农田，粮仓通常堆得满满当当。

b363dd3bf008a2fbfbff.source: A large coastal city and trading hub
b363dd3bf008a2fbfbff.translation: 一座大型海滨城市，也是贸易枢纽

7e764a1e6e7860fc09e7.source: A big harbor city relying on trade and fishing, and an important hub for travellers arriving or leaving by ship.
7e764a1e6e7860fc09e7.translation: 一座依靠贸易与渔业兴盛的港口大城，也是旅人乘船来往的重要枢纽。

ac22a78b305ff4951707.source: A citadel towering high over the surrounding woods
ac22a78b305ff4951707.translation: 一座高踞于周围林海之上的城塞

5a5319023583b61cc7a9.source: This citadel towers high over the surrounding forests and dominates the region.
5a5319023583b61cc7a9.translation: 这座城塞高出周围的森林，控制着整片地区。

eb9c21dfcfdf5d839427.source: A prospering city with its main produce being valuable timber and venison
eb9c21dfcfdf5d839427.translation: 一座主要出产珍贵木材和鹿肉的繁荣城市

93ab83505c32dcb535e2.source: A prospering city located close to the forest with its main produce being valuable timber and venison.
93ab83505c32dcb535e2.translation: 一座靠近森林的繁荣城市，主要出产珍贵木材和鹿肉。

3e40b3a3e72e905a7a33.source: A massive stone citadel built into the steep mountains
3e40b3a3e72e905a7a33.translation: 一座依险峻山势修建的庞大石制城塞

f713294691d12d2d67e9.source: This massive stone citadel is built into the steep mountains. A large number of men are stationed here to hold a firm grip on the land.
f713294691d12d2d67e9.translation: 这座庞大的石制城塞依着险峻的山势而建，驻有大批士兵，牢牢控制着周围土地。

dd209f0620e8bd7dee87.source: This large citadel looks wide over the endless snow
dd209f0620e8bd7dee87.translation: 这座大型城塞俯瞰着无边雪原

5590cbec93839b3ed865.source: This large citadel looks wide over the endless snow and is a stronghold against anything that may come down from the far north. As people flocked to its protection over the years, the many houses and workshops in its vicinity now also grant shelter and supply to travelers, mercenaries and adventurers in the area.
5590cbec93839b3ed865.translation: 这座大型城塞俯瞰无边雪原，抵挡着一切可能从极北之地南下的威胁。多年来，人们纷纷投奔它的庇护，附近渐渐聚起许多房屋与工坊，也为往来的旅人、佣兵和冒险者提供歇脚之处与补给。

445ccbef6da12de913a0.source: A large city sheltering travelers and traders from snow and cold
445ccbef6da12de913a0.translation: 一座让旅人和商人躲避严寒风雪的大城

e2cd74086edb24f57ef8.source: A large city far up north. Traders, travelers and adventurers come here for shelter from snow and storms.
e2cd74086edb24f57ef8.translation: 遥远北方的一座大城。商人、旅客和冒险者来到这里，躲避风雪侵袭。

18ee365c28857503a97c.source: A mighty citadel towering above the surrounding steppe
18ee365c28857503a97c.translation: 一座雄伟的城塞，高踞于四周草原之上

b43c07af3083cd990b97.source: This mighty citadel towers high above the surrounding steppe and is the seat of power in the region. It houses a large garrison and offers all kinds of services valuable to travellers and mercenaries.
b43c07af3083cd990b97.translation: 雄伟的城塞高踞于四周草原之上，是这一地区的权力中心。这里驻有大批军队，也为旅人和佣兵提供各类实用的服务。

45c946b818e94437c213.source: A large city thriving on trade and fine arts
45c946b818e94437c213.translation: 一座依靠贸易与精美工艺品兴盛的大城

2da45846f7bc88519793.source: A large city thriving in the southern steppe by trading and producing valuable goods and fine arts.
2da45846f7bc88519793.translation: 南方草原上的一座大城，依靠贸易、珍贵物产和精美工艺品而繁荣。

a9b9a61b01104f3e6001.source: A modest city spread out over dry spots in the swampy area
a9b9a61b01104f3e6001.translation: 一座规模不大的城市，散布于沼泽间的干燥地带

670ac0dac16ad160296f.source: A collection of many smaller settlements spread out over dry spots in the swampy area to form one modestly sized city.
670ac0dac16ad160296f.translation: 许多小聚落散布在沼泽间的干燥地带，连成了一座规模不大的城市。

6507e7ba0b8bed211160.source: A large citadel towering high over the surrounding tundra
6507e7ba0b8bed211160.translation: 一座高踞于周围苔原之上的大型城塞

2c0fad80ce115638277b.source: A large citadel towering high over the surrounding tundra and securing the large and open region. Many come here to resupply, make repairs and rest until venturing on.
2c0fad80ce115638277b.translation: 大型城塞高踞于苔原之上，守卫着这片广阔而开敞的地区。许多人在此补给、修理装备，稍作休整后再度上路。

8b33290ebb9010ca7e06.source: A large city and trading hub surrounded by barren tundra
8b33290ebb9010ca7e06.translation: 四周环绕着荒凉苔原的大城，也是当地的商贸中心

27074efb665ee65fd051.source: Surrounded by barren tundra, this large city has lasted as an important trading hub and home to thinkers and fine arts.
27074efb665ee65fd051.translation: 这座大城四周尽是荒凉的苔原，长久以来既是重要的商贸中心，也是学者与艺术家的汇聚之地。

95559148a37b60c28813.source: A stone keep that controls a strategically important port and protects nearby trading routes
95559148a37b60c28813.translation: 一座控制着重要港口、守卫附近商路的石堡

730145ca50bc772dcff0.source: This stone keep controls a strategically important sea access and protects nearby trading routes.
730145ca50bc772dcff0.translation: 这座石堡控制着一处重要的出海口，保护附近的商路。

bbf8f4e38c28958b6edc.source: A stone keep surrounded by fertile lands
bbf8f4e38c28958b6edc.translation: 一座被肥沃土地环绕的石堡

644b1e0ec84793d34e77.source: A stone keep surrounded by fertile lands and acting as a strongpoint and base of operations in the region.
644b1e0ec84793d34e77.translation: 这座石堡周围土地肥沃，是本地区的军事据点与行动基地。

208099c7c2c8995e58a0.source: A prospering village surrounded by fertile land
208099c7c2c8995e58a0.translation: 一座被肥沃土地环绕的兴旺村庄

e53736aae927417d11b4.source: A prospering village surrounded by fertile land. The market is usually filled with all kinds of fresh food.
e53736aae927417d11b4.translation: 村庄周围土地肥沃，日子颇为兴旺，市场上通常摆满了各类新鲜食物。

bc0566600cb1e73091d6.source: A larger spread out village relying on fishing and a little trade
bc0566600cb1e73091d6.translation: 一座房屋分布较广的大村庄，依靠捕鱼和少量贸易维生

b87d3988ea19aa7c41eb.source: A larger spread out village relying on fishing and a little trade.
b87d3988ea19aa7c41eb.translation: 一座房屋分布较广的大村庄，依靠捕鱼和少量贸易维生。

1ec233354eef95bb7474.source: A mighty stone keep surrounded by woods.
1ec233354eef95bb7474.translation: 一座被树林环绕的坚固石堡。

245a10806368bd8e1177.source: This mighty stone keep surrounded by forest acts as a base of operations in the area.
245a10806368bd8e1177.translation: 这座坚固的石堡被森林环绕，是周边地区的行动基地。

227bfeb9a439246e99ac.source: A developed village thriving on lumber and game
227bfeb9a439246e99ac.translation: 一座依靠木材与野味兴盛起来的村庄

4aeb25da55b0aabb05ed.source: An established village close to the forest living mainly from lumber cutting and game.
4aeb25da55b0aabb05ed.translation: 森林边一座颇具规模的村庄，主要靠伐木和狩猎维生。

2181f49be33927ffc1fd.source: A stretched out settlement nestled into the surrounding mountains
2181f49be33927ffc1fd.translation: 一处依山延展开来的聚落

958b0ae43e3fafc0e54e.source: A stretched out settlement nestled into the surrounding mountains. The hammering of pickaxes against stone can be heard from a distance.
958b0ae43e3fafc0e54e.translation: 聚落依着周围山势延展开来。远处便能听见矿镐敲击岩石的声响。

c635df563400a28807e3.source: A stone keep that is towering high over the surrounding mountains
c635df563400a28807e3.translation: 一座高踞于周围群山之上的石堡

9807dbab3299ccad02d6.source: A stone keep that is towering high over the surrounding mountains. Lookouts on the towers can see approaching troops from miles away.
9807dbab3299ccad02d6.translation: 这座石堡高踞于周围群山之上，塔楼中的哨兵在数英里外就能发现逼近的军队。

12c4a979058fc18e38fb.source: This stone keep shelters a garrison from the snow
12c4a979058fc18e38fb.translation: 这座石堡为驻军遮挡风雪

9e311a56971ba3a9bd4d.source: This stone-built keep offers protection both from the cold and any invaders.
9e311a56971ba3a9bd4d.translation: 这座石堡既能抵御严寒，也能阻挡入侵者。

6c978cdde7137b067b98.source: A medium sized village covered in snow throughout most of the year
6c978cdde7137b067b98.translation: 一座中等规模的村庄，一年中大部分时候都覆着积雪

e26d45246ff402dbdf32.source: A medium sized village covered in snow throughout most of the year.
e26d45246ff402dbdf32.translation: 一座中等规模的村庄，一年中大部分时候都覆着积雪。

a4705547dd7c86653cec.source: A stone keep projecting power over the flat steppe
a4705547dd7c86653cec.translation: 一座威慑着周围平坦草原的石堡

9fdfd4c72aa8a8d1e4f8.source: This stone keep is a strongpoint in the area and grants a good view of the surrounding flat and dry lands.
9fdfd4c72aa8a8d1e4f8.translation: 这座石堡是本地区的军事据点，能将周围平坦干燥的土地尽收眼底。

58e7e7ce3632b0391042.source: An established and thriving settlement in the steppe
58e7e7ce3632b0391042.translation: 草原上一处颇具规模、兴旺繁荣的聚落

0675787b9e34a0343cfe.source: An established settlement surrounded by the dry and flat lands of the steppe.
0675787b9e34a0343cfe.translation: 一处颇具规模的聚落，周围是平坦干燥的草原。

5663f3cf785ecc72ee40.source: A stone keep controlling routes through the swamps
5663f3cf785ecc72ee40.translation: 一座控制着沼泽间通路的石堡

707835ba2d13da02bfc8.source: A stone keep controlling routes through and access to the surrounding swamps and marshes.
707835ba2d13da02bfc8.translation: 这座石堡控制着进出及穿越周围沼泽湿地的道路。

950bf7154c7662df0809.source: A larger settlement surrounded by foul swamps
950bf7154c7662df0809.translation: 一处被恶臭沼泽环绕的大型聚落

59e7c67419013ea773c3.source: A somewhat larger settlement spread out across various dry and firm spots in the swamp.
59e7c67419013ea773c3.translation: 一处规模较大的聚落，房屋散布在沼泽中干燥坚实的地面上。

dea53cf773965dc665b6.source: A stone keep securing the surrounding tundra
dea53cf773965dc665b6.translation: 一座守卫着周围苔原的石堡

0cfd2650e6679c7f2741.source: A stone keep that is the seat of power in the surrounding tundra. It acts as a base of operations for a decently sized garrison.
0cfd2650e6679c7f2741.translation: 这座石堡是周围苔原的权力中心，也是当地一支颇具规模的驻军的行动基地。

f869095f3acd8c148d6f.source: An established village in the rough tundra
f869095f3acd8c148d6f.translation: 荒凉苔原上一座颇具规模的村庄

6fa599fa2ae5b47a679f.source: An established village in the rough tundra that is a meeting point for the area.
6fa599fa2ae5b47a679f.translation: 荒凉苔原上一座颇具规模的村庄，是周围居民往来聚集之地。

e76bb5d5d74ccff793dc.source: Children have been disappearing from this settlement. Distrust and fear rule the streets and are slowly poisoning the community.
e76bb5d5d74ccff793dc.translation: 聚落中接连有孩子失踪。猜忌与恐惧笼罩街巷，正一点点侵蚀着邻里间的信任。

d4dc483f5a87c586437a.source: Rumor is that children disappear from their cribs in %settlement% into thin air. Imagine the parents' terror...
d4dc483f5a87c586437a.translation: 听说%settlement%的孩子会从摇篮里凭空消失。想想那些爹娘该有多害怕……

4a2808bd45c9b174f75f.source: My grandma told me a story about witches abducting children for their innocent blood. And now in %settlement%, kids have gone missing just like in the stories.
4a2808bd45c9b174f75f.translation: 我祖母给我讲过女巫掳走孩子、取他们纯洁鲜血的故事。如今%settlement%的孩子也失踪了，简直跟故事里一模一样。

fac3e2277ccb4ad67503.source: Never ever strike a deal with witches! A relative in %settlement% did it years ago and now his kid is gone missing.
fac3e2277ccb4ad67503.translation: 千万别跟女巫做交易！我在%settlement%的一个亲戚，几年前干过这种蠢事，如今他孩子不见了。

1d1bc5aff6278f9601d4.source: The roads leading here are unsafe of late, and many a caravan has been ambushed and plundered. With little successful trade, the selection of goods is lower and the prices higher.
1d1bc5aff6278f9601d4.translation: 近来通往此地的道路很不安全，不少商队遭到伏击和洗劫。贸易受阻，商品种类减少，价格也随之上涨。

b526d62d540949c435d4.source: Brigands and raiders are the bane of us traveling merchants! An old friend of mine got ambushed, robbed and beaten just outside of %settlement%!
b526d62d540949c435d4.translation: 山贼劫匪就是我们行商的灾星！我的一个老朋友就在%settlement%外头遭了埋伏，被抢得精光，还挨了一顿毒打！

843efa8ff7baaf28b684.source: If you have any valuables on you, stay away from %settlement%. The place is scourged by cutthroats, bandits and highwaymen!
843efa8ff7baaf28b684.translation: 身上要是有值钱的东西，就离%settlement%远点。那地方被一帮杀人越货、拦路打劫的恶棍祸害惨了！

bdf6c4c5fe869c4a2d34.source: The guardsmen are doing what they can, but these brigands just move on to the next town and waylay traders on the road. They're said to lurk around %settlement% now!
bdf6c4c5fe869c4a2d34.translation: 守卫也算尽力了，可这帮山贼只要换个城镇，照样能在路上截杀商人。听说眼下就藏在%settlement%附近！

682dce4dc09191c76771.source: A contest in archery has attracted anyone proficient with a bow. A good time, perhaps, to look for according recruits.
682dce4dc09191c76771.translation: 一场射箭比赛吸引了各路弓术好手，眼下或许正是招募弓手的好时机。

ebd73ced2cfee63eafd2.source: If you're a skilled archer, you might want to head to that big contest over in %settlement% and let fly some arrows!
ebd73ced2cfee63eafd2.translation: 要是你箭术不错，不妨去%settlement%那场大赛上露两手！

a59b694ae2cfb97f9bb8.source: You know, I myself was once the best archer near and far, I swear! Until a damned donkey stepped on my hand, that is. Otherwise, I'd be in %settlement% for the archery contest right now...
a59b694ae2cfb97f9bb8.translation: 我跟你说，当年方圆百里就数我箭术最好，我发誓！后来一头该死的驴踩坏了我的手，要不然，这会儿我早就在%settlement%参加射箭比赛了……

34079f711568aede3a77.source: Anyone skilled with a bow is making their way to %settlement% these days for some contest. Most of them poachers and other lowlifes, I imagine.
34079f711568aede3a77.translation: 这几天，凡是会使弓的，都往%settlement%赶，说是要参加什么比赛。依我看，多半是偷猎的和别的下三烂。

0f32ab5a87ab123441e6.source: A large tournament is to be held at the arena. Enter it to win marvelous prizes!
0f32ab5a87ab123441e6.translation: 竞技场即将举办大型锦标赛，参赛便有机会赢取丰厚奖品！

0452ccccc69e1a48d0ff.source: You look like an able fighter. The arena in %settlement% is hosting a tournament and you can surely still enter!
0452ccccc69e1a48d0ff.translation: 瞧你像个能打的。%settlement%的竞技场正在办锦标赛，现在去报名肯定还来得及！

cf9d0a8aad80a0a66b07.source: After this drink I will head straight out towards %settlement% to watch the great arena tournament! Best entertainment all year!
cf9d0a8aad80a0a66b07.translation: 喝完这杯，我就直奔%settlement%看竞技场锦标赛去！一年里再没比这更精彩的乐子了！

5a83851e9e5e68c4bb4f.source: I heard the prize for the arena tournament winner in %settlement% is even more marvelous this year!
5a83851e9e5e68c4bb4f.translation: 听说今年%settlement%竞技场锦标赛的冠军奖品，比往年还要了不得！

8b34d49e3f4048fc263b.source: This place is or has until recently been besieged by the enemy! It's suffered damage, the supplies are low and many have lost their lives.
8b34d49e3f4048fc263b.translation: 此地正在遭受围攻，或刚刚结束围城。建筑受损，补给短缺，许多人已经丧命。

e7c6951e45bc03d1e735.source: Rocks and fire arrows flying, hot oil being poured, people starving and dying - that is a siege. You can head over to %settlement% and get a good close look yourself.
e7c6951e45bc03d1e735.translation: 飞石火箭满天，滚油当头浇下，百姓挨饿等死——这就是围城。你可以去%settlement%，凑近了亲眼瞧瞧。

f80c12a28f78e3c06827.source: When I was younger, I served in %randomnoble%'s army. The worst was a siege we partook in, it lasted for months. A shame that it is happening again right now in %settlement%.
f80c12a28f78e3c06827.translation: 年轻时，我在%randomnoble%的军队里当过兵。最难熬的就是那次围城，足足打了好几个月。真作孽，如今%settlement%又在遭这种罪。

1f713d115b1b925f246a.source: Heard the word? %settlement% is under siege! Poor folks up in there will suffer a lot.
1f713d115b1b925f246a.translation: 听说了吗？%settlement%被围了！困在里头的百姓可要遭大罪了。

1aab18ee7ef27dd1e84a.source: The city council ordered a time of food, drink and games for everyone to keep the population happy. Food and drink are easy to come by, gladiators are flocking to the city, and arena fights pay more than usual.
1aab18ee7ef27dd1e84a.translation: 城邦议会下令设宴供酒、举办竞技，让百姓尽情欢庆。食物与酒水供应充足，角斗士纷纷赶来，竞技场的报酬也高于平日。

b213a517f4b4f822753d.source: Praise the wise council of %settlement%! A time of food, drink and games is upon us!
b213a517f4b4f822753d.translation: 赞美%settlement%英明的议会！有酒有肉有竞技的好日子到了！

4ddfd103faa2b4163cb5.source: Ever been to the famed games of the south? Head to %settlement% and see for yourself the glory of the festivities!
4ddfd103faa2b4163cb5.translation: 你见识过南方有名的竞技盛会吗？去趟%settlement%，亲眼看看那庆典有多气派！

b57f89036ed4c213fede.source: All the hard work through the year and for what? I will tell you: Food, drink and games! I will head out to %settlement% to join in, and so should you.
b57f89036ed4c213fede.translation: 一年到头辛苦劳作，为的是什么？我告诉你：吃好、喝好、看热闹！我要去%settlement%凑一回，你也该去。

8ea861b0a21daa6ae370.source: During the ceremonial season, large amounts of incense are used by temples. The demand and prices for incense are at an all-time high.
8ea861b0a21daa6ae370.translation: 祭典期间，神殿大量焚香，熏香的需求和价格都达到高峰。

603812b6333ed2c92293.source: During this time of the year, the temples in %settlement% smoke like a hovel that's on fire! I wonder where they get all that incense from...
603812b6333ed2c92293.translation: 每年这个时候，%settlement%的神殿都冒烟冒得跟茅屋着火似的！也不知他们哪来那么多熏香……

0bc71831b8958e1592a3.source: If you are a godly person you might want to head to %settlement% to burn some incense and say some prayers.
0bc71831b8958e1592a3.translation: 要是你虔诚信神，不妨去%settlement%焚些香，祷告几句。

af49dc8b7d504c42d3c4.source: Several collectors seeking exotic curios have made their way into town. There's good coin to be made selling beast trophies and like here.
af49dc8b7d504c42d3c4.translation: 几位搜寻奇珍异物的收藏家来到城中。在这里出售猎兽战利品之类的物件，能赚上一笔好钱。

aec4548804a16ff24804.source: Are you lot beast hunters? I've heard that some strange characters have shown up in %settlement% and are buying every exotic monster trophy they can find.
aec4548804a16ff24804.translation: 你们是猎兽的？听说%settlement%来了几个怪人，见到稀奇的怪物战利品就买，一件都不放过。

77839225ec36be5411ec.source: See this here dog tooth? I plan on selling it over in %settlement%, I heard they pay good coin for animal parts there.
77839225ec36be5411ec.translation: 瞧见这颗狗牙了吗？我打算拿到%settlement%卖掉，听说那边收动物身上的东西，价钱给得挺好。

8636b5c036e906cdbe45.source: It seems all sorts of beast slayers and corpse-pickers are gathering in %settlement%. Something about selling beast trophies, I heard. Sounds like witchcraft to me.
8636b5c036e906cdbe45.translation: 各种猎兽者和捡尸的都往%settlement%聚。听说是去卖野兽身上的东西，我听着可像巫术那一套。

d20b8712fb4390741dc8.source: This place has recently been conquered. Many lives were lost, and the survivors had to endure the conquerors taking their spoils of war. Much of the settlement is still damaged, and spirits are low.
d20b8712fb4390741dc8.translation: 此地最近被攻占，许多人丧命，幸存者也饱受胜者劫掠之苦。聚落中仍有大片建筑受损，居民情绪低落。

e0add334da70addec97c.source: %settlement% was recently captured, or so I have heard. 'New Lords - same shit' is what I always say...
e0add334da70addec97c.translation: 听说%settlement%最近被攻下了。我向来那句话：换了老爷，照样是一摊烂事……

ab7cbd95b2d226e3c872.source: Conquering new lands is the game of nobles. I heard they just sacked %settlement%.
ab7cbd95b2d226e3c872.translation: 攻城略地，那是贵族们玩的游戏。听说他们刚把%settlement%劫掠了一遍。

dbdcacc0cb0c8c306f6d.source: Oh, hey sellsword! Were you at the siege of %settlement%? Well, fucking congratulations. How many did you kill? How many did you rape?
dbdcacc0cb0c8c306f6d.translation: 哟，佣兵！围攻%settlement%时有你一份吗？那可真他妈恭喜了。杀了多少人？又强奸了多少人？

fd119ecf51ba50bd2842.source: There's a procession of cultists going through the city; a steady stream of people seemingly manifested themselves out of thin air and now slowly makes their way along the main roads. Clad in muted colors they ring bells and chant monotonously the name of Davkul.
fd119ecf51ba50bd2842.translation: 一支邪教徒队伍正在城中游行。人潮仿佛凭空涌现，沿着大道缓缓前进。他们衣着暗淡，摇响铃铛，单调地吟诵着达夫库尔之名。

289cb1d616eebc29ec0f.source: I just saw the most bone chilling procession coming through %settlement%! Masked figures, whipping themselves on the backs until they were all bloodied up...
289cb1d616eebc29ec0f.translation: 我刚看见一支队伍穿过%settlement%，真叫人毛骨悚然！那些人戴着面具，挥鞭抽自己的背，直抽得浑身是血……

6a39faddbe57a164a2a3.source: %settlement% is swarming with strange cultists, they are surely up to no good! Somebody should send the witch hunters their way, I'd say!
6a39faddbe57a164a2a3.translation: %settlement%挤满了古里古怪的邪教徒，准没安好心！要我说，就该找些猎巫人去收拾他们！

01f7e9bcac50a22b9009.source: It has awakened! The sleeping beast is about to rise from its century long slumber! Go to %settlement% and my brothers in faith will tell you the same! Davkul will come!
01f7e9bcac50a22b9009.translation: 祂已苏醒！沉睡的巨兽即将从百年长眠中起身！去%settlement%，我的同道弟兄也会这么告诉你！达夫库尔必将降临！

e95317f2b008d0799ff2.source: Villagers have been disappearing from this town, putting everyone on edge. Fewer potential recruits are to be found on the streets, and people deal less favourably with strangers.
e95317f2b008d0799ff2.translation: 镇上不断有村民失踪，人人惶恐不安。街上可供招募的人变少了，居民也不再愿意给陌生人好价钱。

5f7edf57e45433257597.source: I just cancelled my visit to %settlement% after I heard that people go missing over there. Staying out of trouble served me well so far!
5f7edf57e45433257597.translation: 一听说%settlement%那边有人失踪，我就打消了去那儿的念头。这么些年，少惹麻烦总归没错！

45edff1e44c600f70424.source: Me neighbour %randomname% went to %settlement% 'bout a week ago. Haven't heard a word of him since. I just hope nothing happened to him, you know, with them brigands and monsters and all roaming 'bout...
45edff1e44c600f70424.translation: 俺邻居%randomname%大约一星期前去了%settlement%，之后就一点音讯都没有。只盼他别出事，你也知道，到处都是山贼、怪物，还有别的鬼东西……

8c60c46b2a2f6158723c.source: The forces of evil are strong in this world. They hide in the woods, and in the mountains, and in the shadows, and sometimes folk just disappear without a trace. It's happening again right now over in %settlement%.
8c60c46b2a2f6158723c.translation: 这世上的邪恶可厉害着呢。它们藏在林子里、山里、阴影里，有时人就这么没影了，一点痕迹都不留。眼下%settlement%又在出这种事。

9051eaccc4eab4aa6283.source: With a local conflict now solved, many levied troops and their weapons are no longer needed. A good time to grab a bargain or hire experienced new men.
9051eaccc4eab4aa6283.translation: 当地冲突已经平息，大批征召士兵和他们的武器不再派得上用场。眼下正适合淘些便宜货，或招募有经验的新成员。

799b59f0ee9f07986129.source: Standing armies are expensive, my friend. I heard an entire regiment was disbanded at %settlement%. Surely there'll be some veteran fighters lingering there still, desperate for coin.
799b59f0ee9f07986129.translation: 朋友，养常备军可是很烧钱的。听说%settlement%解散了整支军团，那儿肯定还滞留着一些缺钱的老兵。

fb219a8acb7a7a29e67e.source: When I was young I used to be a soldier, and I liked it. Even the marching. But when my unit was disbanded I didn't know what the hell to do with myself. Now they're disbanding one of them regiments over at %settlement%, from what I hear.
fb219a8acb7a7a29e67e.translation: 年轻时我当过兵，还挺喜欢，连行军都不讨厌。可部队一解散，我真他妈不知道该怎么过了。听说%settlement%那边，现在又在解散一支军团。

337f2f72a8bbba587705.source: I'm concerned for my niece; an entire unit of soldiers got disbanded at %settlement%, right near where she lives. Things won't end well if those brutes don't find employment soon!
337f2f72a8bbba587705.translation: 我真替侄女担心，%settlement%解散了整整一队士兵，就在她住的地方附近。这些粗汉要是不赶紧找份活计，迟早要出事！

d79802eca8a28e7d10d5.source: An unexpected heatwave burnt many of the local crops. There is less food available and prices are higher.
d79802eca8a28e7d10d5.translation: 突如其来的热浪烤坏了大片庄稼，食物供应减少，价格随之上涨。

0757ca737f7cf2151fc9.source: A terrible drought is ailing %settlement% from what I hear. It's always been hard for the folks over there, but this time it's dire.
0757ca737f7cf2151fc9.translation: 听说%settlement%遭了场大旱。那边的百姓本来就过得苦，这回怕是真撑不住了。

8f2e42906944186309b4.source: If you are as reckless as you look, you might make a quick crown selling food in %settlement%. A harsh drought has the people starving, so they'll pay anything to get something between their teeth.
8f2e42906944186309b4.translation: 要是你真像看上去那么不怕惹事，可以去%settlement%卖粮，赚笔快钱。大旱闹得人快饿死了，只要能有口吃的，什么价他们都肯出。

18e90912a9b9dcd5b853.source: Oh, son, I used to be a rainmaker over in %settlement%, but the fools chased me off! Now, admittedly, the village was suffering from a draught, but isn't that all the more reason to rely on me? Fools, I say!
18e90912a9b9dcd5b853.translation: 唉，孩子，我以前在%settlement%替人求雨，可那帮蠢货把我赶走了！好吧，村里当时确实闹旱灾，可越是这样，不就越该依靠我吗？蠢货，都是蠢货！

ebdc0329c4868902f732.source: The waters are teeming with swarms of fish. Fresh Fish is abundant and cheaply available.
ebdc0329c4868902f732.translation: 水中鱼群密集，鲜鱼供应充足，价格低廉。

324cfebd42ff2b468f43.source: This time o' year large schools of fish always come by %settlement%. All they need do is throw some nets into the water and then pull out more fish than they could ever eat! Lucky bastards!
324cfebd42ff2b468f43.translation: 每年这时候，大群的鱼都会游到%settlement%附近。他们只管下网，捞上来的鱼就多得吃不完！真是群走狗屎运的家伙！

f5ee6166bd079ec3f385.source: Tomorrow I'll head out to %settlement% and fill my carts with fish. Rumor has it the fishermen over there hit a lucky streak!
f5ee6166bd079ec3f385.translation: 明天我就去%settlement%，装上满满几车鱼。听说那边的渔民最近运气好得不得了！

d9061b30acd2d4c194d2.source: You in the trading business? I hear they have their nets filled to the brim with fish over at %settlement%.
d9061b30acd2d4c194d2.translation: 你做买卖吗？听说%settlement%那边，每张渔网里都装满了鱼。

0af67dccf5bf29b0cf83.source: Conditions for crops have been perfect. Food is readily available and offered at lower prices.
0af67dccf5bf29b0cf83.translation: 风调雨顺，庄稼长势极佳，粮食供应充足，售价也更低。

4d45bd0c57a757e4dbbe.source: Head over to %settlement% if you need to restock on food. Those lucky bastards have had themselves a bountiful harvest season this year.
4d45bd0c57a757e4dbbe.translation: 要补充粮食，就去%settlement%。那帮走运的家伙今年可是大丰收。

53bc22f6b04ef80e9114.source: I came here from %settlement% to sell our extra produce. The gods have been smiling on us and granted us the best harvest in many years!
53bc22f6b04ef80e9114.translation: 我从%settlement%来，卖些多余的农产。诸神保佑，我们今年的收成是多年来最好的一回！

31fe142e8910e0ea3f83.source: I just learned that in %settlement% the granaries and larders are filled to the brim thanks to a good harvest.
31fe142e8910e0ea3f83.translation: 刚听说%settlement%今年丰收，粮仓和食窖都堆得满满当当。

0a71e1fd97e0972cfd50.source: Greenskins are terrorizing the surrounding lands, and many lives have been lost as orcs or goblins continue to raid outlying farms and raze caravans. Supplies are beginning to run low and people become desperate.
0a71e1fd97e0972cfd50.translation: 绿皮在周围肆虐，兽人或地精不断袭击偏远农场、摧毁商队，已经夺去许多人的性命。补给渐渐不足，居民陷入绝望。

1265bda57509f54c8eee.source: I heard rumors that vile greenskins are marauding around %settlement%! Is it true? I hope they don't make their way over here...
1265bda57509f54c8eee.translation: 听说可恶的绿皮正在%settlement%周围抢掠！是真的吗？可别一路跑到咱们这儿来……

40be0fb2899a9dc2a2e8.source: Did you see the columns of smoke in the evening sky? They are rising over from %settlement% where greenskins are burning and pillaging the countryside.
40be0fb2899a9dc2a2e8.translation: 看见傍晚天边那几道烟柱了吗？那是%settlement%方向，绿皮正在乡下烧杀抢掠。

79bdd2b76c91424ba8dd.source: Here, take a look at what's left of my hand! Can hardly use it anymore on account of it having no fingers since that run-in with greenskins a while ago. Now I hear they are back, marauding around %settlement% right as we speak.
79bdd2b76c91424ba8dd.translation: 来，瞧瞧我这只手还剩下什么！前阵子撞上绿皮，手指全没了，如今几乎派不上用场。听说它们又回来了，咱们说话这会儿，正劫掠%settlement%附近呢。

041b85989c09d3cb24a3.source: Spirits are high here, and people are eager to do business with you.
041b85989c09d3cb24a3.translation: 这里的居民心情高涨，乐于与你做生意。

b046367210ee3130bda8.source: I arrived from %settlement% today, my clothes are still dusty from the road. The folks over there surely were in a good mood, not quite sure why though...
b046367210ee3130bda8.translation: 我今天刚从%settlement%过来，衣服上的尘土都还没拍干净。那边的人个个兴高采烈，不过是为了什么，我也说不准……

74999affe2e73cd35a82.source: No need to get me a mug, I am still drunk from the celebrations in %settlement%. They sure know how to have a good time!
74999affe2e73cd35a82.translation: 别给我倒了，我在%settlement%参加庆典喝的酒，到现在还没醒呢。那帮人可真会找乐子！

6771a7a9fa7860cadf4f.source: Rumor has it that the townsfolk of %settlement% just got an important relic back.
6771a7a9fa7860cadf4f.translation: 听说%settlement%的镇民刚找回了一件重要的圣物。

619f931e89a267cb1abc.source: The forests are bustling with deer and it is hunting season. Venison and furs are in rich supply.
619f931e89a267cb1abc.translation: 林中鹿群繁盛，正值狩猎时节，鹿肉与毛皮供应充足。

ebbba757b2d355bb2b9c.source: Do you like venison, sellsword? And how about your men? I heard that hunting season has started in %settlement%. Just saying.
ebbba757b2d355bb2b9c.translation: 佣兵，你爱吃鹿肉吗？你那些弟兄呢？听说%settlement%已经开猎了。我就随口一提。

744812a671ddc4a0ecff.source: It's the time of the year that all hunters have been eagerly waiting for. The hunting season started around %settlement% just now!
744812a671ddc4a0ecff.translation: 猎人们一年到头盼的就是这个时候！%settlement%周边的狩猎季刚刚开始！

a2780041b303b2a26b39.source: Hunting outside the season might get you your hands cut right off! Doesn't matter, though, as the season will start any day now in the forests over by %settlement%.
a2780041b303b2a26b39.translation: 禁猎时节出去打猎，可是要被剁手的！不过也无妨，%settlement%附近的林子，这两天就该开猎了。

641b1230cc0cf097d374.source: A local holiday has the people in a generous mood. Time for food and drink!
641b1230cc0cf097d374.translation: 当地节庆让居民格外慷慨，正是畅饮饱餐的好时候！

89acd7acff9a804f4fe8.source: If you're looking to have a good time, head on over to %settlement% and join their celebration! Boy, I wish I could be there.
89acd7acff9a804f4fe8.translation: 想找乐子，就去%settlement%参加庆典吧！唉，真希望我也能去。

ec21a6467a8a8d413085.source: You don't look quite like the festive type, if I might say so, but perhaps your men would enjoy some food and drink. Alas, both can be found aplenty in %settlement%, as they're celebrating some holiday over there.
ec21a6467a8a8d413085.translation: 恕我直言，你看着不像爱凑热闹的人，不过你的弟兄们也许想吃喝一顿。%settlement%正过什么节，酒肉可都管够。

46c5839e3115b005b555.source: The good folks over in %settlement% are having their annual holiday right now. I'd be there drinking and eating and all, if only I had the crowns. Mind getting me another ale, friend?
46c5839e3115b005b555.translation: %settlement%的乡亲们正在过一年一度的节日。要是兜里有克朗，我早就过去大吃大喝了。朋友，再请我喝杯啤酒怎么样？

9abae24f31ab79a48592.source: A boat with fishermen has been lost at sea during a storm. Both fresh fish and willing recruits are a rare sight.
9abae24f31ab79a48592.translation: 一艘载着渔民的船在风暴中失踪。如今鲜鱼难寻，愿意受雇的人也寥寥无几。

86d518f373a7a21b2a15.source: They never came back from the sea... thinking about all the poor souls lost from %settlement% makes me shiver.
86d518f373a7a21b2a15.translation: 他们出海后，再也没回来……一想到%settlement%那些葬身海中的可怜人，我就直打寒战。

ec89639929c87f3d7382.source: Damn wenches by %settlement%, wailin' and wailin'. Went over to sell them some of me pigs, but they only wailin' with nary a man to be found. Some boat lost at sea or sumthin'. Went right back with not a single pig sold.
ec89639929c87f3d7382.translation: %settlement%那帮婆娘，哭啊哭个没完。俺赶着猪去卖，她们光知道哭，男人一个都找不着。好像是什么船在海上没了。俺只好原路回来，一头猪也没卖掉。

50dd6e8feb13211bed2d.source: Seafaring has always been a dangerous profession. That's why I turned my back to the water. And right in time, might I say, for otherwise it might have been me on that boat that got lost by %settlement%.
50dd6e8feb13211bed2d.translation: 出海向来危险，所以我才改行上岸。要我说，改得正是时候，不然%settlement%那艘失踪的船上，也许就有我了。

54ee7e22778815817776.source: A tragic accident occured, and there was a cave-in in one of the mines. Production came to a halt until the damages are repaired, and miners are without means to feed their families.
54ee7e22778815817776.translation: 一座矿井发生了惨痛的塌方事故。损毁修复之前，采矿只能停工，矿工们也失去了养家糊口的收入。

263701482f360eff6dc0.source: I'd never work underground, I am no stinkin' mole! It's a damn deathtrap! Not long ago a mine gave in by %settlement%, don't even want to know how many died that day...
263701482f360eff6dc0.translation: 我可不下地干活，我又不是臭鼹鼠！那就是个送命的地方！不久前%settlement%就塌了一座矿，我连那天死了多少人都不敢问……

51146f772f4ebdb15573.source: A delivery of ores and minerals from the mines of %settlement% was due today, but alas it did not arrive yet. Something must have happened over there.
51146f772f4ebdb15573.translation: 本该今天运到的一批矿石，来自%settlement%的矿场，可到现在也没见影子。那边一定出了什么事。

11df15726647f86a530c.source: Heard there was a cave-in on one of the mines at %settlement%. Just imagine being buried alive deep under rock and earth...
11df15726647f86a530c.translation: 听说%settlement%有座矿井塌了。想想看，被活埋在厚厚的泥土岩石下面……

1fd97c2ba2fca0d4b454.source: The cracking heat and flickering air have caused a lot of mirage sightings with reportedly strange figures shuffling within them.
1fd97c2ba2fca0d4b454.translation: 酷热使空气扭曲闪烁，海市蜃楼频频出现。据说其中还隐约有古怪的身影挪动。

ee2b0e3fedccfb27f131.source: I tell you, a wonderous lush oasis, golden roofs flimmering in the distance, rainbow colored birds ahead! Where I saw that? Well, it was on the road to %settlement%. I swear!
ee2b0e3fedccfb27f131.translation: 我跟你说，那是一片葱郁得不得了的绿洲，远处金顶闪闪发亮，前头还有彩虹似的鸟！问我在哪儿看见的？就在去%settlement%的路上，我发誓！

799f3ed6cf1a3b9f07f8.source: Some evils do not come in the dark of the night or hide in the shadows. They come out in the scorching sun, during the mid of day. Head on to %settlement% if you want to find out what I am talking about.
799f3ed6cf1a3b9f07f8.translation: 有些邪恶既不趁夜色降临，也不藏在阴影里。它们偏在正午的烈日下现身。想知道我说的是什么，就去%settlement%吧。

3dd4372ace9bdd355c3c.source: Mirages can be seen occasionally in the deserts, and following them can lead to a fate way worse than getting lost in the desert.
3dd4372ace9bdd355c3c.translation: 沙漠里偶尔能看见海市蜃楼，追着它们走，结局可能比迷失沙海还要可怕。

f85b2e8e002eec16a061.source: The area around the city has been infested with swarming serpents, some especially large. Trade has suffered and goods have become more rare and expensive.
f85b2e8e002eec16a061.translation: 城外蛇群泛滥，其中有些体型格外庞大。贸易受到影响，货物日益稀少，价格也更高。

cd7325229f4746170b69.source: Word is that traders on the road to %settlement% have been swallowed whole by shifting sands. But who believes nonsense like that?
cd7325229f4746170b69.translation: 听说有商人在去%settlement%的路上，被会动的沙子整个吞了。不过，谁会信这种鬼话？

321006df18e22cf7fbb0.source: You afraid of snakes? A lot have been seen near %settlement% lately, some as long as my arm, some as long as a whole trader's wagon!
321006df18e22cf7fbb0.translation: 你怕蛇吗？最近%settlement%附近出现了好多，有的跟我胳膊一样长，有的跟商人的整辆货车一样长！

35298109ee523ff176dc.source: Order has been given to muster troops for service in this settlement. Equipment and recruits are in short supply, but a quick crown can be made by selling arms and armor here.
35298109ee523ff176dc.translation: 此地奉命征召军队，装备和可招募人员都很紧缺。在这里出售武器与护甲，倒能赚上一笔快钱。

f46c88931401c2b13899.source: Another damn noble is pressing younglings into a regiment at %settlement%. Ach, why am I even talking to you about this, sellsword? You are no better!
f46c88931401c2b13899.translation: 又有个该死的贵族在%settlement%抓壮丁了。唉，我跟你一个佣兵说这些干什么？你们也好不到哪儿去！

c0fb1d1d10d3e28278fc.source: If I were a merchant with a wagonload full of weapons and armor, I'd know just where to sell it all - they're mustering troops at %settlement% and will surely pay good coin. Alas, I'm neither a merchant nor do I have any weapons.
c0fb1d1d10d3e28278fc.translation: 要是我是商人，手里有满满一车武器护甲，我准知道去哪儿卖——%settlement%正在征兵，肯定舍得出钱。可惜，我既不是商人，也没有什么武器。

35c4bce6be68aab0c9c9.source: I'm just passing trough. Narrowly escaped from impressment at %settlement%. They wanted to force me to fight for some lord, but no thanks, I says, not gonna happen, and away I went. I'll strike my luck further down south.
35c4bce6be68aab0c9c9.translation: 我只是路过。刚从%settlement%的征兵队手里逃出来，差点就走不成了。他们想逼我替哪个老爷打仗，我说算了吧，门儿都没有，拔腿就跑。再往南去碰碰运气吧。

862261fe6f9acf163adf.source: The nobles are preparing for a feast. Cook houses and kitchens are buying food in bulk.
862261fe6f9acf163adf.translation: 贵族们正在筹备宴会，各处厨房都在大量采购食物。

a8929b9e0f1bfb1ceea6.source: The oh-so-noble highborns are preparing a feast at %settlement% while us peasants have but old grain to choke on...
a8929b9e0f1bfb1ceea6.translation: 那些高贵得不得了的老爷们正在%settlement%筹备盛宴，我们这些农民却只能啃陈粮，噎得直伸脖子……

e9506263136b33bf2d29.source: My uncle is a servant at %settlement%, and he tells me that they're preparing a big feast. No point in going there unless you're invited, though.
e9506263136b33bf2d29.translation: 我叔叔在%settlement%当仆人，说他们正筹备一场大宴。不过，没收到请帖的话，去了也是白去。

95ed207b9d1cb193eeeb.source: A public execution is not to be missed and provides entertainment for the whole family. Food and drink are abundant during such an occasion, but merchants may also try to take advantage of spectators.
95ed207b9d1cb193eeeb.translation: 公开处刑是一场不容错过、老少皆宜的热闹。这种时候，吃喝供应充足，不过商人也可能趁机宰观众一笔。

672c8fb6bf60f865eaf3.source: A whole bunch of folks is headin' over to %settlement% for the big spectacle! Men, womenfolk, young ones, all on the road to see the upcoming executions!
672c8fb6bf60f865eaf3.translation: 一大群人都往%settlement%赶，要看大热闹呢！男人、婆娘、小娃子，全上了路，就等着看行刑！

9c3724cc5182fb824415.source: I heard they grabbed some brigands near %settlement% and are putting them to the chopping block. Serves them just right, waylaying poor folk on the roads...
9c3724cc5182fb824415.translation: 听说%settlement%附近抓了几个山贼，马上就要砍头了。活该，谁让他们在路上拦抢穷苦人……

9a3ee2e7e5c2b77b04db.source: Us poor folks don't have much to enjoy these days, but a good hanging is always welcome. Hasn't been one here since autumn, but they is hanging folk over at %settlement% is what %randomname% tells me.
9a3ee2e7e5c2b77b04db.translation: 咱们穷人如今没多少乐子可找，不过看场绞刑总归不错。自打秋天，这儿就没办过了。倒是%randomname%跟我说，%settlement%那边要绞死人。

daf46921507678c51cb8.source: This place has been recently raided! It's suffered damage, has lost valuable goods and supplies, and lives were lost.
daf46921507678c51cb8.translation: 此地最近遭到劫掠，建筑受损，财物和补给被夺走，还有不少人丧命。

14991ea1d416bfc57773.source: You one of them raiders? Sure look and smell like one! Your men pillage %settlement%? Get out of here, I says, we don't want your kind around!
14991ea1d416bfc57773.translation: 你也是劫匪？瞧着像，闻着更像！%settlement%是你们抢的吗？给我滚出去，我们不欢迎你这种人！

ef7e35acc922b91cbaac.source: Folks' arrivin' from %settlement%, sayin' it's been raided and plundered right good. Poor sobs, but what're we to do? Ain't got much ourselves. It's up to the lord to protect them!
ef7e35acc922b91cbaac.translation: 有些人从%settlement%逃过来，说那儿被抢了个底朝天。可怜是可怜，可咱们又能怎样？自己也没多少家当。该保护他们的是领主！

c7db4fc2cf23c32e485e.source: These are dangerous times indeed, sellsword. I just got word that %settlement% was plundered and raided not two nights past.
c7db4fc2cf23c32e485e.translation: 佣兵，这世道可真凶险。我刚听说，就在这两夜里，%settlement%遭了袭击，被抢了个精光。

34369d5c320a58f6a3fc.source: This place has been razed. Many of its inhabitants lie slain, and any valuables have been plundered.
34369d5c320a58f6a3fc.translation: 此地已被夷为平地，大量居民惨遭杀害，值钱的东西也被洗劫一空。

fca8aa88b6a8da3afe62.source: Smoke columns can be seen from miles and miles away. There is naught more than a burning pile of rubble where %settlement% once stood.
fca8aa88b6a8da3afe62.translation: 隔着老远就能看见烟柱。原本的%settlement%，如今只剩一堆燃烧的瓦砾。

58d1bc2638b90ae70dcb.source: Floods of refugees have been arriving from %settlement%. They claim that most of it has been burned to the ground! Can this be true?
58d1bc2638b90ae70dcb.translation: 大批难民从%settlement%涌来，都说那地方大半已被烧成平地！这会是真的吗？

d793699ecd00382cf725.source: %settlement% is no more, just a black charred skeleton smoking and smoldering... How did it come to this?
d793699ecd00382cf725.translation: %settlement%已经没了，只剩下一副焦黑的骨架，还在冒烟、阴燃……怎么会落到这种地步？

d55db3643f2696e7e26e.source: In an effort to rebuild a nearby site, building materials are in high demand and low supply.
d55db3643f2696e7e26e.translation: 附近一处设施正在重建，建筑材料需求旺盛，供应紧缺。

7baaa1ed1a8a0656aa22.source: Finally they're starting to rebuild around %settlement%. That place was in ruins for long enough.
7baaa1ed1a8a0656aa22.translation: %settlement%周围总算开始重建了。那地方荒废得够久了。

22109c612ac2b88593e1.source: I heard they're bringing in wood to %settlement% with wagons now. The new Burgomeister is surely trying to fix things up over there.
22109c612ac2b88593e1.translation: 听说如今一车车木材都往%settlement%送，新镇长看来真想把那地方重新收拾起来。

179ddf5d3f08b7214de8.source: In an effort to rebuild the nearby

9541ce1a5bb121f4fe93.source: , building materials are in high demand and low supply.
9541ce1a5bb121f4fe93.translation: ，建筑材料需求旺盛，供应紧缺。

e680a20114008c1e0588.source: With the war raging, a constant stream of refugees is pouring into this settlement. It puts a strain on local economy, but it also means cheap recruits for anyone that can offer work.
e680a20114008c1e0588.translation: 战火蔓延，难民不断涌入聚落。当地经济不堪重负，不过对能提供工作的人来说，这也意味着可以低价招到人手。

d3d76422b2041604c41b.source: Come morning I'll head out to %settlement%. Word is a large group of refugees just arrived and I need more hands for my farm.
d3d76422b2041604c41b.translation: 天一亮，我就去%settlement%。听说刚到了一大批难民，我农场里正缺干活的人手。

aec8ac4b3c3ba16ecdbe.source: From what I've heard, %settlement% is flooded with refugees nowadays. Those cowards should have stayed and fought for their home, I'd say!
aec8ac4b3c3ba16ecdbe.translation: 听说这些日子，%settlement%到处都是难民。要我说，那帮懦夫就该留下来保卫自己的家！

cbc89f4f1e8adb73cc42.source: The beggars, the downtrodden, the fugitives, they all have to go somewhere. A large group of them just arrived at %settlement% from what I heard.
cbc89f4f1e8adb73cc42.translation: 乞丐、落魄人、逃难的，总得有个去处。听说刚有一大群到了%settlement%。

d77bdb6b68aa4be22437.source: Some lucky miner struck a particularly rich vein! Extraction of minerals and metals will be greatly increased until it is exhausted, but the settlement also experiences an inflation of prices.
d77bdb6b68aa4be22437.translation: 一个走运的矿工挖到了格外富集的矿脉！在矿脉耗尽之前，矿物与金属的产量将大幅增加，不过当地物价也在上涨。

16d9b7820efe16340be2.source: They struck a mother lode over in %settlement%. I myself worked the mines for decades, too, and all I got to show for it is a bad cough.
16d9b7820efe16340be2.translation: %settlement%那边挖到了大矿脉。我自己也在矿井里干了几十年，到头来就落下一身咳嗽病。

065698d4e2b1a65d21c5.source: Those lucky bastards in %settlement% have found a new vein in the mine. Caravans can't come fast enough now with what they're shoveling up.
065698d4e2b1a65d21c5.translation: %settlement%那帮走运的家伙找到了新矿脉。照他们往外挖的那个劲儿，商队再怎么赶也运不完。

14186f39acb44388184e.source: I hear that the mines in %settlement% are awfully productive these days. Not a bad way to make some coin if you're in the trading business.
14186f39acb44388184e.translation: 听说%settlement%的矿场最近出矿特别多。要是你做买卖，这倒是个不错的挣钱门路。

9ba54cb5bc139a1f9d74.source: The roads leading here have been reasonably safe of late, which allowed for many a profitable trade to be made and the settlement to prosper somewhat.
9ba54cb5bc139a1f9d74.translation: 近来通往此地的道路颇为安全，商贸往来获利丰厚，聚落也因此兴旺了些。

e83062fd26c32b3c281f.source: Seems the brigands around %settlement% are having a rough time now with all those patrols going on.
e83062fd26c32b3c281f.translation: 巡逻队来来往往，看来%settlement%附近的山贼最近日子不好过啊。

3d2b69958e38f68c20b2.source: Just got back from %settlement% last night. No brigand in sight on the roads, thank the gods.
3d2b69958e38f68c20b2.translation: 昨晚刚从%settlement%回来，一路上连个山贼影子都没见着，感谢诸神。

2fb92304011897790be2.source: Been telling my cousin for years to stop robbing people on the road. Ain't no way for it but to end badly. And right I was, it did. Got his comeuppance the other day by %settlement%. Place is crawling with militia.
2fb92304011897790be2.translation: 劝了我表弟多少年，别再拦路抢人了，迟早没好下场。你看，我没说错吧。前几天在%settlement%附近遭了报应，那地方到处都是民兵。

288662d0dc4a81874b98.source: Howling sandstorms have engulfed the city and hinder traders both from entering and leaving it safely. Goods are becoming more rare and prices higher.
288662d0dc4a81874b98.translation: 呼啸的沙尘暴吞没了整座城市，商人难以安全出入。货物日渐稀少，价格随之上涨。

9d96a68a17491e806f7d.source: I just came back from %settlement%, barely made it out! A sandstorm has engulfed the whole city!
9d96a68a17491e806f7d.translation: 我刚从%settlement%回来，差点就出不来了！沙尘暴把整座城都吞了！

5d4344e53b98195b2eef.source: It happened again, %settlement% has been engulfed in the most terrible of sandstorms.
5d4344e53b98195b2eef.translation: 又来了，%settlement%被一场可怕的沙尘暴卷进去了。

f8b4d0da7946501e46cd.source: Traders from far and wide gather here for the seasonal fair. Lots of people flock here from the surrounding countryside, and it's a great time to sell goods or rummage through plentiful offers.
f8b4d0da7946501e46cd.translation: 各地商人汇聚于此，参加时令集市，周围乡间的居民也纷纷赶来。眼下正适合出售货物，或在琳琅满目的商品中淘些心仪之物。

1bc9f636ffaaa11705fe.source: What's going on around here you're asking? Well, there's a fair over in %settlement%. Merchants from far and wide gather to offer their wares.
1bc9f636ffaaa11705fe.translation: 你问附近有什么事？嗯，%settlement%正在赶大集，四面八方的商人都带着货物去了。

c32995c52942357f35ff.source: Me, I am more of the solitary type. Big fairs like the one over in %settlement% just don't appeal to me at all....
c32995c52942357f35ff.translation: 我这人喜欢清静。像%settlement%那样的大集市，对我一点吸引力都没有……

ceafdacd3e433e5e43c0.source: Recent events have left this place short on food. As people are on the verge of starving, food is hard to come by and prices are on the rise.
ceafdacd3e433e5e43c0.translation: 近来的变故导致此地粮食短缺。百姓濒临饥饿，食物难以买到，价格也不断攀升。

aab5754fe3997127e3df.source: The men and women in %settlement% are starving, I heard, with nothing but dirt to eat. I don't think I'll ever complain about my mouldy grain soup again!
aab5754fe3997127e3df.translation: 听说%settlement%的男女老少都在挨饿，除了泥土，什么都没得吃。以后我可再不嫌弃自己那碗发霉的谷物汤了！

6cf725c45294efdab6f8.source: Some farmer just arrived today from %settlement%. Told stories of slain cattle, burned fields and empty larders. Looked like a damn walking skeleton himself!
6cf725c45294efdab6f8.translation: 今天来了个%settlement%的农民，说那边牲口被杀、农田被烧，食窖里空空如也。他自己看着就他妈像具会走路的骷髅！

bdd810d58b5e8852658d.source: A sickness has struck down many folks in this settlement. There are fewer recruits available, and food and medical supplies are scarce.
bdd810d58b5e8852658d.translation: 疾病使聚落中的许多人倒下，可供招募的人减少，食物与医疗物资也很紧缺。

e398aaf886be84dc6405.source: Don't go near %settlement%! A sickness struck that poor town and the folks are dying like flies over there...
e398aaf886be84dc6405.translation: 别靠近%settlement%！那可怜的镇子染上了病，人死得跟苍蝇一样多……

6872e7d221c2d6564ecb.source: We had some folks coming here from %settlement%, but had to send them away at the gates. Everybody knows that a cruel disease is spreading in that cursed town.
6872e7d221c2d6564ecb.translation: 有些人从%settlement%跑来，可我们只能在城门口把他们赶走。谁都知道，那个倒霉镇子正在流行一场恶疾。

37a7b4d5c5658b4fcfca.source: Fancy my herbal necklace? It protects me against even the most pestilent disease. You better get yourself one, too, if you're planning to ahead on towards %settlement%.
37a7b4d5c5658b4fcfca.translation: 喜欢我这串草药项链吗？再厉害的瘟疫，它也挡得住。你要打算去%settlement%，最好也给自己弄一串。

05321c46d3eb13cdc541.source: The indebted, the slave class of the city states, have taken up arms and rise against their masters! Indebted are hard to come by, and weapons and armors have been swept from the market.
05321c46d3eb13cdc541.translation: 城邦的奴隶阶层——负债者，拿起武器反抗主人！如今很难再雇到负债者，市场上的武器护甲也被抢购一空。

9fa7294bda92fca07051.source: The slaves over at %settlement% took up arms and turned to banditry and waylaying. Unsullied or whatever they call them, I mean. There is surely some work to be done for a mercenary like you.
9fa7294bda92fca07051.translation: %settlement%的奴隶拿起武器，干起拦路抢劫的勾当了。什么无垢者，还是叫别的什么来着。像你这样的佣兵，肯定有活干。

3ca82705ed01636e0be0.source: Word has made it here that the slaves at %settlement% are rebelling. A proper revolt could topple their whole city, and I hope it does.
3ca82705ed01636e0be0.translation: 消息传到这儿了，%settlement%的奴隶正在造反。闹得够大的话，整座城都可能被掀翻。我倒真希望如此。

74ee4febf466df280553.source: Snow storms have more or less isolated this settlement from trade. Because few new goods have been coming in, the selection is lower and prices are higher.
74ee4febf466df280553.translation: 暴风雪几乎切断了聚落的贸易。运来的新货寥寥无几，商品种类减少，价格也更高。

80656b48c631207764f8.source: Bad weather out there towards %settlement%, looks like a full-blown blizzard.
80656b48c631207764f8.translation: %settlement%那边天气糟透了，看样子是一场大暴风雪。

f8e7630274b30f0f76c4.source: The villagers here are terrified of unknown horrors. Fewer potential recruits are to be found on the streets, and people deal less favourably with strangers.
f8e7630274b30f0f76c4.translation: 当地村民被未知的恐怖笼罩，街上可供招募的人减少，居民与陌生人交易时也不再给好价钱。

95cb401f5c605febb6a4.source: The dead ain't really dead, sometimes they come back to haunt the living! Don't believe me? Just head over to %settlement% and see for yourself!
95cb401f5c605febb6a4.translation: 死人可不一定真死透了，有时还会回来缠着活人！不信？去%settlement%亲眼看看！

3aeb35883507b4cb6c12.source: You look like an able swordsman! I heard rumors of the dead walking again near %settlement%. Humbug probably, but frightened folks often pay good crowns to feel safe again.
3aeb35883507b4cb6c12.translation: 瞧你剑术应该不错！听说%settlement%附近有死人重新爬起来了。多半是胡扯，不过吓坏了的人，总肯掏不少克朗买个安心。

5e9b0e81b48c2bcc9441.source: The people of this settlement are terrorized by nightmares. Many prefer to stay awake all night just to be safe.
5e9b0e81b48c2bcc9441.translation: 聚落居民饱受噩梦折磨，许多人宁愿整夜不睡，也要保个平安。

b75421266373879bcbac.source: The other day I came through %settlement%. Something is wrong there. Pale faces, tired eyes and shambling walks. It's like they didn't sleep in a week!
b75421266373879bcbac.translation: 前几天路过%settlement%，那地方不大对劲。人人脸色惨白，眼神疲倦，走路拖拖沓沓，跟一个星期没睡过似的！

5836a4231f2f16d746da.source: I just got a letter from my aunt in %settlement% claiming that the whole town is troubled by terrible nightmares. I don't know, she's always been overly dramatic.
5836a4231f2f16d746da.translation: 刚收到我姑妈从%settlement%寄来的信，说全镇都在做可怕的噩梦。谁知道呢，她向来喜欢大惊小怪。

6735a195ee7d5419b958.source: The best recipe for a good night's sleep is hard work and a pint of ale! Come to think of it, someone should tell it to the folks over in %settlement%; from what I've heard, whole town's got trouble sleeping.
6735a195ee7d5419b958.translation: 要想睡个好觉，最好的办法就是卖力干活，再喝上一大杯啤酒！说起来，该有人把这法子告诉%settlement%的居民。听说他们全镇都睡不好。

02f98d0fd89fde0cf1ac.source: Large Unholds have been seen and heard in the area. The townsfolk are scared of leaving the vicinity of the settlement.
02f98d0fd89fde0cf1ac.translation: 附近出现了巨魔的踪迹和吼声，镇民们不敢离开聚落太远。

9f8b4186052a8c1f3753.source: A traveling merchant told me about giant footprints near the road from %settlement%. Sure as hell would not want to meet whatever beast left those!
9f8b4186052a8c1f3753.translation: 一个行商跟我说，%settlement%出来的路边有巨大的脚印。不管是什么怪物踩出来的，我都他妈不想碰上！

6e04459045520d8ba677.source: When I was in %settlement% the other day, a group of hunters went missing. They were after some sort of giant...
6e04459045520d8ba677.translation: 前几天我在%settlement%时，一队猎人失踪了。他们好像是去追什么巨人……

3874a9ba69560f77f766.source: Ever heard of unholds? Huge monsters that stomp whole carts under a foot! I heard rumors of sightings near %settlement%.
3874a9ba69560f77f766.translation: 听说过巨魔吗？庞然大物，一脚就能踩扁整辆马车！听说%settlement%附近有人见到了。

e6b78d361cb90396287c.source: A recent fire in a warehouse caused significant damage. What survived the fire is now sold at high prices.
e6b78d361cb90396287c.translation: 最近一场仓库大火造成了重大损失，侥幸保留下来的货物如今都卖得很贵。

ea0bd3ce37875bcfac30.source: Seen the smoke on the horizon last night? They say it was the big warehouse in %settlement% burning down to the ground.
ea0bd3ce37875bcfac30.translation: 昨晚看见天边的烟了吗？听说是%settlement%的大仓库烧了个精光。

4a622cd338bd12afc594.source: I heard they caught the arsonist lighting the warehouse up in %settlement%. Hanged him from a tree right then and now, but it'll take them a lot longer to build up the warehouse again.
4a622cd338bd12afc594.translation: 听说%settlement%抓到了烧仓库的纵火犯，当场就吊在树上了。可要把仓库重建起来，那就得费上许多工夫。

64ecce868c5670a4e502.source: This place has been recently supplied with fresh wares, and many of those can now be bought for the right price.
64ecce868c5670a4e502.translation: 此地最近运来了一批新货，如今有不少商品可以以合适的价格购得。

9708e2d42e776d82c9e9.source: Trade with %settlement% is prospering, my friend! Safe roads and full stocks, let's hope it stays this way...
9708e2d42e776d82c9e9.translation: 朋友，跟%settlement%的买卖可兴旺着呢！道路安全，货物充足，但愿能一直这样……

1f93cb9e14ec1f070f59.source: My cousin over in %settlement% keeps bragging about how good they have it there. Well stocked market stands and all. Not like this rotten place.
1f93cb9e14ec1f070f59.translation: 我在%settlement%的表亲老吹嘘那边日子好，市场上样样货物都充足。不像咱们这个破地方。

63e427e3a2d05283e46e.source: A fiery spectacle, witch burnings attract spectators, and spectators attract food stands. And then, there's bound to be a number of witchhunters in town...
63e427e3a2d05283e46e.translation: 火烧女巫总能招来围观的人，围观的人又能招来卖吃食的摊贩。此外，城里想必也少不了猎巫人……

ae949f7531ef25bf80d0.source: Some witch hunters came by yesterday. They didn't find what they were looking for and headed on to %settlement%.
ae949f7531ef25bf80d0.translation: 昨天来了些猎巫人，没找到要找的东西，就往%settlement%去了。

9d66b673bb845ee20eb3.source: From what I hear they found a witch in %settlement% and will put her to the pyre. Come to think of it, maybe I should report that old shrew that bested me on the market the other day, she's a witch for sure!
9d66b673bb845ee20eb3.translation: 听说%settlement%抓到一个女巫，要把她绑上火刑柱。说起来，前几天在市场上让我吃亏的那个老泼妇，我也该去告发才对。她肯定也是女巫！

c082f3b0d7cb5db356d3.translation: 一座由几间简陋小屋组成的小渔村。

c01483df3d80df06327d.translation: 一座依靠木材和各种林产维生的村庄

0d271739f618eb585c50.translation: 一座依靠木材和各种林产维生的村庄。

8aa5fb07655372231f90.source: Some huts and small buildings housing workers for the nearby mines
8aa5fb07655372231f90.translation: 几间棚屋和小房舍，住着附近矿场的工人

5d5ad34e5bea5a772cbe.translation: 几间棚屋和小房舍，住着附近矿场的工人。

158c9f5ec7bd981c48dd.translation: 一座建在山中的小型堡垒

00239716cc6eef457248.source: A small fortification has been built in this mountainous region to act as a base of operations and control the surrounding lands.
00239716cc6eef457248.translation: 这座小型堡垒建在山区，既是行动基地，也控制着周围的土地。

f9f6a6b86a25a5c61e68.source: This motte with bailey looks wide over the endless snow
f9f6a6b86a25a5c61e68.translation: 这座带外院的土丘堡俯瞰着无边雪原

9f0114d950d67e8fb73a.source: This motte with bailey looks wide over the endless snow, and offers shelter from the cold and warm food to the garrison stationed here.
9f0114d950d67e8fb73a.translation: 这座带外院的土丘堡俯瞰着无边雪原，为驻守的士兵提供避寒之处和热饭。

e3e8bf99fe474d274a2c.translation: 几间紧挨在一起的小屋

48facb55a7a4a716dc47.translation: 这座小木堡俯瞰着干燥的草原，为疲惫的士兵提供遮阴歇脚之处。

f3834887cdd51c232a2b.source: A small village in the steppe living mainly off of modest trading

0318d2779e9387817c82.source: A small village in the steppe living mainly off of modest trading.
0318d2779e9387817c82.translation: 草原上的一座小村庄，主要依靠小本买卖维生。

6ea56f61a171d98f2bd9.source: A motte with bailey built on a spot of dry ground
6ea56f61a171d98f2bd9.translation: 一座建在干燥地面上、带有外院的土丘堡

74e00e105e65fe0860d6.source: Placed on a small bit of solid ground, this motte and baily controls the surrounding lands.
74e00e105e65fe0860d6.translation: 这座带外院的土丘堡坐落在一小片坚实的地面上，控制着周围的土地。

271fe58b9cd15838599d.source: A small and crude settlement in a swampy area

8bacfeb5bc868b7827e9.source: A small settlement in a swampy area. The people living here sure know hardship.
8bacfeb5bc868b7827e9.translation: 沼泽地带的一处小聚落。住在这里的人，深知生活的艰辛。

80b26622ca16be8e18fb.source: A wooden motte towering above the tundra
80b26622ca16be8e18fb.translation: 一座高踞于苔原之上的土丘木堡

c92672ff7e4db895d994.source: In the flat lands of the tundra, this small fortification can be spotted from quite a distance.
c92672ff7e4db895d994.translation: 苔原地势平坦，因此远远就能望见这座小型堡垒。

dbda5f69c17b0e456c47.source: A humble village that managed to survive in the sparse tundra
dbda5f69c17b0e456c47.translation: 一座在贫瘠苔原上艰难维生的小村庄

e570517ed0a2d4bdc524.source: A humble village that managed to survive in the sparse tundra.
e570517ed0a2d4bdc524.translation: 一座在贫瘠苔原上艰难维生的小村庄。

40650dc2e91ed2b5ffb2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You noticed the mutt a few miles back, and a few miles forward he's still there, bobbing and slinking in and out of sight.

A mongrel such as he doesn't follow a band of dangerous men for no reason - maybe someone is feeding it?
40650dc2e91ed2b5ffb2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]几里路前，你就注意到了这条杂毛狗。如今又走出几里，它还跟在后面，时而蹿出，时而缩回视线之外。

像它这样的流浪狗，不会无缘无故跟着一群危险人物——难道有人在喂它？

af6f8fbb2a414f033084.source: Better to put it down now before it steals any of our supplies later.
af6f8fbb2a414f033084.translation: 趁它还没偷咱们的补给，现在就杀了。

89eaffd3cd230f7f35db.source: The company needs a mascot. Take it in.
89eaffd3cd230f7f35db.translation: 战团需要一个吉祥物。收留它。

7fcf5af3f6a727629f0a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]This is no place for a pup to be. The next time the dog appears, you crack it between the eyes with a well-placed stone. Yelping, the dog retreats. It pauses, perhaps thinking that there was some sort of mistake here, but you quickly correct the foul thing with another rock. The dog leaves and is not seen again.
7fcf5af3f6a727629f0a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]这里不是小狗该来的地方。它再次现身时，你抄起一块石头，不偏不倚砸在它两眼之间。狗哀叫着退开，停了一下，似乎以为其中有什么误会。你又补上一块石头，让这碍事的东西彻底明白。狗走了，再也没出现。

48ebebd45e32246a385b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]You take a bow and nock an arrow. A few of the brothers watch as you take aim. The shot goes wide, but the dog gets the message and quickly scampers off.
48ebebd45e32246a385b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]你取来弓，搭上一支箭。几个弟兄在旁看你瞄准。箭射偏了，不过狗领会了意思，赶紧逃得没影。

f28a6ca150fe05cb261c.source: I meant to scare it off.

6503e35782d71f13c5c0.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You take a bow and nock an arrow. A few of the brothers watch as you take aim. The wind comes, goes, and comes again. You wait patiently before drawing the string and closing one eye to put the dog into focus. It sits down and stares at you between long-tongued pants.

You release the shot. The arrow zips through the air and the dog yelps. It keels back on its hind legs and falls over, its feet kicking and scraping on the ground until it stops. You put the bow back into its holding and get the company back on the road.
6503e35782d71f13c5c0.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你取来弓，搭上一支箭。几个弟兄在旁边看着你瞄准。风起了，停了，又起了。你耐心等候，随后拉开弓弦，闭上一只眼，将狗锁在准星里。它坐下来，吐着长舌喘气，直直地望着你。

你松开弓弦。箭矢破空而去，狗发出一声惨叫。它后腿一仰，翻倒在地，四肢蹬踢刨抓，终于不再动弹。你把弓放回原处，带着战团继续赶路。

1fbd729bd49bafc27f25.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You decide to take a chunk of meat and approach the dog. It is skittish at first, backing away on your approach, but the aroma you have in hand is an alluring one to be sure. The mongrel slinks back toward you, pausing here and there, eyes flicking in search of an ambush.

You can see a barrel of ribs on the dog, many days on the road having given the pup a gaunt frame. Its ears are stitched up and its tail bolted with signs of battle. This here animal knows how to fight and that's just what it'll be doing for you from now on.
1fbd729bd49bafc27f25.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你拿起一块肉，朝狗走去。它起初十分警惕，你往前，它就往后退。不过，你手里的香味实在诱人。杂毛狗又悄悄靠了过来，走几步便停一下，眼珠四处转动，提防着埋伏。

它的肋骨根根分明，流浪多日，早已饿得瘦骨嶙峋。耳朵伤痕交错，尾巴也留下不少打斗的痕迹。这家伙显然知道怎么打架，而从今往后，它就要替你打了。

b7de030263effd96b36a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_37.png[/img]A rugged dog such as he would make for a great mascot. The little mutt could definitely boost morale. You order %bro% to feed it some food in the hopes that it'll tag along. He goes out with a scrap of leftovers and crouches down.%SPEECH_ON%Good dog.%SPEECH_OFF%The mongrel sniffs the food, then chomps down on it - and the mercenary's hand along with it. The brother jumps back, nestling his arm into his chest as though he might lose it otherwise. The dog, on the other hand, swallows the scrap and then runs off.
b7de030263effd96b36a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_37.png[/img]这么一条皮实的狗，正适合当战团的吉祥物。小家伙肯定能让弟兄们高兴些。你叫%bro%拿点吃的喂它，希望它肯留下。他拿着一块剩饭剩肉走过去，蹲下身。%SPEECH_ON%好狗，乖。%SPEECH_OFF%杂毛狗嗅了嗅食物，接着一口咬下——连佣兵的手也一并咬住了。弟兄猛地跳开，把胳膊紧紧抱在胸前，仿佛稍一松手就会掉下来。狗则吞下食物，一溜烟跑了。

c609d0cb513d117c3979.source: Damn, he really would have fit in.
c609d0cb513d117c3979.translation: 可惜了，它本来挺适合咱们的。

09293ccc7bb7322065e0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You ask %houndmaster% the houndmaster if he can try and 'woo' this dog. He nods and steps toward it. The wild mongrel's ears go from pinned to pointed. Crouched, the houndmaster slowly edges his way toward the beast. He keeps his hand out with a piece of meat in the palm. Hunger overcomes heedfulness and the dog sniffs its way ever closer to the houndmaster's hand. The dog tongues it out of his palm and chows down. The dog trainer feeds him another bite. He scruffs him up and finds the sweet spot behind his ears. Looking back, %houndmaster% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, it's an agreeable beast and will be easily trained.%SPEECH_OFF%That's great. You ask if it can fight. The houndmaster purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%A dog is akin to a man. If it can breathe, it can fight.%SPEECH_OFF%
09293ccc7bb7322065e0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你问驯犬师%houndmaster%，能不能试着把这条狗“哄”过来。他点点头，迈步上前。那杂毛野狗原本紧贴脑后的耳朵顿时竖了起来。驯犬师蹲下身，一点点挪近，伸出的手掌里放着一块肉。饥饿终究压过了戒心，狗一边嗅，一边靠近他的手，伸舌卷走肉块，狼吞虎咽地吃了。驯犬师又喂了一口，揉揉它的皮毛，找准耳根后最舒服的地方挠起来。%houndmaster%回过头，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，性子还算温顺，训起来不难。%SPEECH_OFF%那很好。你问它能不能打。驯犬师抿了抿嘴。%SPEECH_ON%狗跟人一样。只要还喘气，就能打。%SPEECH_OFF%

02b0dbc8d7a9d0509143.source: %houndmaster%, you're trained to handle dogs, right?

55f9fcd9d6bb634c0aa4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]You find %swordmaster% struggling to set himself down on a tree stump. As he gingerly lowers, you see his legs quaking as though they can barely bend at all. He lets out a long sigh after he takes his seat. His sword is beside him. It is younger than the hands that own it, a replacement of a replacement of a replacement. He shows no fondness for it, but when he touches it you sense there is a reflection in the very idea of a sword, of how a man lengthens himself with it, and how he shortens others by its very blade. You turn to leave, hoping to give the swordmaster time to himself, but he notices your departure and calls out.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there, captain. Didn't mean for you to see that.%SPEECH_OFF%
55f9fcd9d6bb634c0aa4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]你看见%swordmaster%正费力地往一截树桩上坐。他小心翼翼地压低身子，双腿直打颤，仿佛根本弯不下去。终于坐稳，他长长地叹了口气。剑放在身旁，比握它的那双手年轻得多，是换过一把又一把之后留下的。他对这把剑并无多少眷恋，可手指碰到剑身时，你仍能觉出他对“剑”本身的感慨：人借它延伸自己的臂膀，也借它斩短别人的性命。你转身想走，留他独处一会儿，他却察觉了你的动静，出声叫住你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，原来你在啊。本不想让你看见这副模样的。%SPEECH_OFF%

c52a92e0aa1064b47827.source: Well, I saw it. Now get moving.
c52a92e0aa1064b47827.translation: 行了，我已经看见了。赶紧跟上。

a9ff0cc19afbff6c91d5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]He leans back, rubbing one of his knees with a calloused hand. A bit of wind throws his tufts of greyed hair around.%SPEECH_ON%Old. That's how I'm doing. And I don't mean my age. By the years, I've been old for a while now. I mean I'm old in the bones. I suppose I get by on reputation a lot more than skills these days.%SPEECH_OFF%You immediately disagree, telling him that he's one of the deadliest men you've ever met.%SPEECH_ON%Save the niceties for the women, captain. My vision's going. You probably don't want to hear that, but it is. My lead foot doesn't step like it used to. The knee clicks, seizes up. One day that is going to cost me. My off-hand has no feeling.%SPEECH_OFF%The swordmaster clenches and unclenches his free-hand.
a9ff0cc19afbff6c91d5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]他向后靠去，用长满老茧的手揉着膝盖。一阵风吹乱了他几绺灰白的头发。%SPEECH_ON%老了。就这么回事。不是说年纪——论年纪，我早就老了。我说的是骨头里透出来的老。如今我多半是靠名气吃饭，本事倒用得少了。%SPEECH_OFF%你立刻反驳，说他仍是你见过最可怕的杀手之一。%SPEECH_ON%好听话留着哄女人吧，团长。我的眼睛不行了。你大概不爱听，可事实就是如此。前脚迈出去，也不如从前利索。膝盖咔咔响，时不时就僵住，迟早要吃大亏。另一只手，已经没知觉了。%SPEECH_OFF%剑术大师将空着的那只手握紧，又松开。

108f6fba2f19fcb2f94e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%Nothing. I suppose the nerves are dying. And sometimes I forget things. I don't mean where I left my boots, either. I forget if there is someone standing behind me or not. My sense of my surroundings, my real blade, has been dulled.
