For all my speed and instinct it was time that has crept upon me, slow and steady, with no heat nor cold to give it away, it simply was and is and will be. I always thought I'd be bested by another swordsman. Someone of talent. But I suppose I was too good for that.%SPEECH_OFF%The swordmaster grins playfully. You ask if he fears a death with no honor.%SPEECH_ON%I realized a long time ago that, when you become someone of my reputation, any route to death is going to be a disappointing one. They'll write it in the books how someone below my stature slew the great swordmaster. It's hogwash. If you want the truth I'll tell ya. I fear what I know is coming. That my body will betray me in the last moments. With time at its side, my body is what is going to kill me. The knee will lock, the grip will loosen, the shoulder will weaken. I don't fear death. I was too good for death, so death'll have to wait. My body is going to kill me first, then death can have what's left, the sorry blackened sod. The writers and historians? Piss on 'em. If I wanted eternal glory I would've fought an army by myself.%SPEECH_OFF%
108f6fba2f19fcb2f94e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%一点也没有。大概是神经快死了。有时我还会忘事，不是忘了靴子放在哪儿那种。我会忘记身后有没有人。我对周围的感知——那才是我真正的利刃——已经钝了。我有速度，有直觉，却还是让岁月悄无声息地摸到了身边。它不紧不慢，不冷不热，没半点征兆。它过去在，现在在，将来也会在。我总以为，自己会败给另一个剑客，一个有天赋的好手。不过看来，我的本事还是太好了。%SPEECH_OFF%剑术大师露出一丝促狭的笑。你问他，是否害怕死得不够光彩。%SPEECH_ON%我早就明白，人到了我这份名气，怎么死都会叫人失望。书里会写，一个名不见经传的小子杀死了伟大的剑术大师。全是狗屁。你要听实话，我就告诉你：我怕的是明知会来的那一刻——这副身子在最后关头背叛我。有岁月帮忙，它迟早会要了我的命。膝盖会卡住，手会握不牢，肩膀会使不上劲。我不怕死。死神拿我没办法，就让它等着。我的身子会先把我弄死，然后那黑漆漆的可怜家伙，才有资格来收拾剩下的。至于那些作家和史官？让他们滚蛋。我要真想名垂千古，早就一个人去打一整支军队了。%SPEECH_OFF%

3ff9fe1b0b5853563329.source: From what I heard, you did.
3ff9fe1b0b5853563329.translation: 照我听来的那些事，你还真有这本事。

5304228979c7750faa80.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]The old swordmaster smiles. %SPEECH_ON%Oh get off it, captain. Now help me up so we can get back on the road.%SPEECH_OFF%
5304228979c7750faa80.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]年迈的剑术大师笑了。%SPEECH_ON%行了，团长，少逗我。扶我一把，咱们也该赶路了。%SPEECH_OFF%

c590c06a0947c33b47b6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]You hear the old swordmaster sigh as you move away. Keeping up with the rest of the company, it seems, has become a battle in and of itself for him.
c590c06a0947c33b47b6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]你走开时，听见老剑术大师叹了口气。看来，光是跟上战团的脚步，对他来说就已经是一场苦战。

9456cbbab274c5f6cea4.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]%swordmaster% enters your tent. You wave him to the chair across your table. He sits so slowly and feebly that you fear him standing back up will take twice as long. The man clasps his hands together and elbows his arms onto the table, grunting and shifting, finding little comfort even in doing nothing at all. His lips are dry, his face withered. Liver spots mottle his head and even the hairs about his nose and ears are grey.

 You always have time for %swordmaster% so you ask what it is he wishes to speak about.%SPEECH_ON%This might sound peculiar coming from a blade for hire, but I think it needs saying anyway, and it'd make me sleep better at night. I'll be forward with you: I am not the man you hired so long ago. You know that. I know that. Some of the men know it, but they're respectful as good men are.%SPEECH_OFF%You agree, but don't nod. Instead, you ask what the man is getting at.%SPEECH_ON%I wish to lower my wage. Now don't be saying no, you don't have to bullshit me. I'll take a cut. Money's never been an issue anyhow. Those crowns could be used to help arm the men or even pay them better. God knows a young man could always use an extra crown or two.%SPEECH_OFF%Before you say another word, the man springs to his feet with surprising speed. He nods and grins playfully before yelling loudly.%SPEECH_ON%I agree with your decision, good sir. I could use a paycut!%SPEECH_OFF%You laugh as the man leaves your tent almost as soon as he'd come in.
9456cbbab274c5f6cea4.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]%swordmaster%走进帐篷，你示意他坐到桌子对面。他坐得如此迟缓无力，你几乎担心，待会儿再站起来要花两倍工夫。他双手交握，把胳膊肘撑在桌上，哼着气挪来挪去，仿佛连什么也不做都找不到舒坦的姿势。他嘴唇干裂，面容枯槁，头上布满老人斑，连鼻边和耳边的毛发也白了。

只要是%swordmaster%来找你，你总有时间。你问他想谈什么。%SPEECH_ON%一个拿钱挥剑的人说这种话，听起来可能古怪，不过还是得说，不然晚上睡不踏实。我就直说了：我已经不是你当初雇来的那个人了。你知道，我也知道。有些弟兄也知道，只是他们都是好人，肯给我留体面。%SPEECH_OFF%你心里赞同，却没有点头，只问他究竟想说什么。%SPEECH_ON%我想把工钱降一降。别急着说不，你用不着哄我。就这么定了。反正我也不缺钱。省下来的克朗，可以给弟兄们添置装备，或是多发点军饷。老天知道，年轻人手头总能多用上一两枚。%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及开口，他竟以惊人的利落劲儿站了起来，点点头，促狭地一笑，随后故意扯开嗓门。%SPEECH_ON%我赞成您的决定，团长！这工钱，早该给我降了！%SPEECH_OFF%他几乎刚来就走。望着他离开帐篷，你忍不住笑出了声。

e3f9a95ef49389e75f15.source: An honorable man if there ever was one.
e3f9a95ef49389e75f15.translation: 这才是真正有风骨的人。

cbf086fdaacc3dbbc860.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]You find %swordmaster% sitting on a stump. He's looking out at the land.%SPEECH_ON%You know, I've realized something as an old man who has operated far too long in this business of killing. I'm so much wiser these days. I've come to know so much, so much that I now know what I don't know. And I look back and think, I was such a dummy back in my youth. Then I thought, what of all the men I've slain, stopping their mortal coil when it was young and so ready to spring?%SPEECH_OFF%You take a seat and shrug. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%What I've realized is that I'm a killer of wisdom. That I took a lot of old men out of this world, and with them went so much learning and knowledge. There's so many worlds out there that I destroyed. Worlds where those men lived and went on living and did the great things they knew not was in them. Had the first man I fought slew me down, how many lives would he have saved? How much wisdom would have been spared? I'm sorry, I don't mean to drone on.%SPEECH_OFF%The man stands, patting his wobbly legs. You grab his arm.%SPEECH_ON%Have you considered that you may have also saved worlds? That some of those men you've slain could have lived on to be horrible monsters?%SPEECH_OFF%He smiles, but you know he's already thought that through and doesn't wish to disturb you with the answer. He simply nods before going off to join the rest of the company.
cbf086fdaacc3dbbc860.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]你发现%swordmaster%坐在树桩上，眺望远方。%SPEECH_ON%你知道，像我这样在杀人行当里干得太久的老头，最近总算想明白一件事。如今我比从前懂得多了，懂得越多，就越清楚自己还有多少不懂。回头一想，年轻时的我真是个蠢货。可再想想那些死在我剑下的人呢？他们还那么年轻，还有那么多活头，就被我一剑截断了。%SPEECH_OFF%你在旁边坐下，耸了耸肩。他继续说。%SPEECH_ON%我明白了，我杀掉的，其实是智慧。我让这世上少了许多本能活到老的人，也带走了他们本可积累的学问与见识。我毁掉了多少种未来啊。在那些未来里，他们活下去，继续活下去，做出连自己都还没想到的伟大事情。要是我第一次与人交手，就被对方杀了，他能救下多少条命？又能留下多少智慧？抱歉，我不是有意唠叨。%SPEECH_OFF%他站起身，拍拍颤巍巍的腿。你拉住他的胳膊。%SPEECH_ON%你有没有想过，你也可能救下了许多种未来？那些被你杀掉的人，或许活下去会变成可怕的恶徒。%SPEECH_OFF%他笑了笑。但你知道，他早已想过这一层，只是不愿拿答案来搅扰你。他只是点点头，便去追赶其他弟兄了。

63c8ba2a4f2c6a68de53.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]Marching along, you spot a fellow traveler who leans forward and then back and then forward again, all the while his hand knowing not whether to shield the sun or peel away to let himself be blinded. He shakes his head and spits.%SPEECH_ON%I'd heard word of you folks. Buncha trouserless men in a land of evil, like some devil's little joke sprung to life. The hell are you?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and tell the man that, so far, you've no issue with taking on your troubles sans leather or plate or cloth of loin. Again, the traveler shakes his head and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Farkin' hell. A man in battle with nothing on him is more naked than the day he'd done been born! I s'pose the irony is that if we - and I mean anybody-we - come find ya dead in the fields, then we'll probably dress ya better for the grave than you dress yourself now. Which shan't be hard, seeing as how you've dressed yourself none at all.%SPEECH_OFF%With a bit of a wave, you thank the traveler for his kind words before continuing your merry march.
63c8ba2a4f2c6a68de53.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]行军途中，你遇到一个旅人。他身子前倾，又后仰，接着再凑近，手也不知该举起来遮太阳，还是干脆拿开，任由阳光晃瞎眼睛。他摇摇头，啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%早听说过你们。这么个妖魔横行的世道，偏有一帮不穿裤子的家伙到处跑，活像恶魔开了个玩笑，还真成了精。你们到底是什么东西？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，告诉他，至少到目前为止，不穿皮甲、板甲，连兜裆布也省了，并不耽误你们应付麻烦。旅人又摇头，又吐了口唾沫。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼。光着身子上战场，比刚从娘胎里出来还赤裸！说来也好笑，要是哪天我们——我是说随便什么人——在野地里发现你们的尸体，收殓时给你们穿的，多半都比你们现在体面。这倒也不难，毕竟你们现在压根没穿。%SPEECH_OFF%你挥挥手，谢过旅人的好意，随后继续愉快地赶路。

b6d25b8619093494b93a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]The apprentice %apprentice% has apparently become a ward to %teacher%. While the swordmaster is long in the tooth, he seems quite eager to help the young man become a better fighter. The apprentice uses a real sword, the swordmaster but a wooden one. It is in this rather large difference of chosen weaponry that the swordmaster displays the usefulness of positioning, finding openings, and getting out of the way of danger.

Even in his old age the man twirls and whirls, becoming impossible for the apprentice to hit. In one particularly brilliant trick, the swordmaster senses that he is about to be struck so he closes distance with the apprentice and steps on his foot. When the apprentice tilts back to give himself space, his foot does not go with him. The sudden imbalance brings the trainee tumbling to the ground wherein he looks up to find a wooden sword prodding his neck.

You find the man patting the dirt off himself pretty often, but he is at least getting up for more. Let's just say he is improving one splinter at a time.
b6d25b8619093494b93a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]学徒%apprentice%似乎已被%teacher%收作门生。剑术大师虽然年事已高，却很乐意帮年轻人练好本事。徒弟用的是真剑，师父手里却只有木剑。也正是凭着兵器上的悬殊，剑术大师向他展示了步位、破绽与闪避的妙用。

老人辗转腾挪，虽已上了年纪，学徒却怎么也打不着。有一招尤其漂亮：眼见一剑将至，师父反而贴近徒弟，踩住他的脚。徒弟向后仰，想拉开距离，脚却没能跟着移动。重心一失，他便栽倒在地；抬头时，木剑已抵在喉间。

你时常看见小伙子拍打身上的尘土，不过他至少肯爬起来继续。要说他是怎么长进的，大概就是一点点挨木剑打出来的。

bedbf97bed01a977d496.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%teacher% the unretired soldier has taking a liking to %apprentice%. You find the two practicing their craft whenever possible. The old grunt believes in the value of the offensive, showing the apprentice how to turn a blade, axe, or mace in such a manner that it inflicts the most damage. Unfortunately, they are using the company dining equipment to set up little dolls to beat up. The young lad has certainly made a mess of those pots and pans in his continuous pursuit of being a better fighter.
bedbf97bed01a977d496.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]重返行伍的老兵%teacher%很喜欢%apprentice%这个小伙子。你常看见他们一有空就凑在一起操练。老兵笃信进攻的重要，教徒弟怎样运使刀剑、斧头和钉锤，才能造成最大的伤害。可惜，他们拿战团的炊具扎成靶子来练手。小伙子为了长本事，着实把那些锅碗瓢盆折腾得够呛。

f9da943a3e2b0f2f4c36.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]It appears as though %teacher% the ol' sellsword has a little bird following him around: young %apprentice%. Now in the company of mercenaries, the apprentice must want to learn from those with plenty of experience on the road earning blood money. While they train, you notice that the sellsword puts most of his emphasis on exercising one's body. Being faster than your opponent and outlasting him are just as important as putting a blade through his brainbox. The earnest lad seems increasingly sturdy, earning some sense of vigor you did not notice before.
f9da943a3e2b0f2f4c36.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]老佣兵%teacher%身后似乎多了只跟脚的小鸟：年轻的%apprentice%。如今既然进了佣兵团，学徒自然想向那些常年在刀口上挣钱的人讨教。看他们训练时，你发现老佣兵尤其看重身体的锻炼：比对手更快、比对手更能撑，与一剑扎进对方脑壳同样重要。小伙子练得认真，身板也越来越结实，渐渐显出从前不曾有过的精神劲儿。

0568aec5f4f2e2dd4140.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]A couple of times now you've caught %apprentice% watching %teacher% from a distance. The young apprentice seems rather enraptured by the hedge knight's brute violence. After a few days, the knight relents, asking the lad to come and have a chat. You know not what they say, but now you've noticed they have been training together. The hedge knight is not a kind trainer, either. He beats the boy frequently, toughening him up. At first, the apprentice flinches before every strike, but now you see that he is showing a little more resolve in the face of such towering adversity. The hedge knight is also showing the man how to kill fast and efficiently. Little mind is paid to defense in these talks you overhear, but who needs to defend themselves from a dead opponent?
0568aec5f4f2e2dd4140.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你已经好几次撞见%apprentice%远远地盯着%teacher%看。年轻学徒似乎被那位流浪骑士凶猛粗暴的打法迷住了。过了几天，骑士终于松口，叫小伙子过去聊聊。你不知道他们说了什么，只发现此后两人开始一起训练。流浪骑士可不是个温柔的老师，动不动就揍徒弟，非要把他练结实不可。起初，学徒每次挨打前都会畏缩，如今面对这座山一般的对手，倒渐渐稳住了心神。骑士也教他如何干净利落地杀人。你偶尔听见他们讲解招式，几乎不提防守——可对手既然已经死了，又有什么可防的？

98cbb0d523ace495a0b9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Something of a commotion draws you from your tent. Men are sitting on a few stumps or on the ground, eagerly watching something in the distance. With squinting eyes, you spot %clown% and %archer% doing something odd. An apple rests on one man's head, while the other is walking away - a bow in hand.

You ask %otherguy% what is going on and he explains that the two men are going to try some sort of stunt or trick that involves shooting a piece of fruit off a man's head. Shocked, you exclaim that's not safe at all, to which the brother grins and explains that is the point.
98cbb0d523ace495a0b9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]一阵喧闹把你引出帐篷。弟兄们坐在树桩上或地上，兴致勃勃地望着远处。你眯眼看去，发现%clown%和%archer%正干一件怪事：一个头顶苹果，另一个握着弓，正往后退。

你问%otherguy%这是怎么回事。他解释说，两人要表演一种把戏，把人头顶的果子射下来。你惊呼这也太危险了，那弟兄却咧嘴一笑，说要的就是这个。

b7e42eca02fc19bbbcdc.translation: 嗯……倒要看看他们的本事。

b6c73274c921e0a1607e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]You mull the situation over. The brothers look to you, expecting a stoppage, but instead you take a seat amongst them. This spurs a brief cheer from the crowd which quickly quiets to hushed whispers as %clown% and %archer% get ready.%SPEECH_ON%Make sure to hit the apple!%SPEECH_OFF%One brother shouts. Laughter ripples through the group.%SPEECH_ON%From that distance %clown_short%'s nose kinda looks like an apple to me.%SPEECH_OFF%More laughter, but it is ever nervous as the stunt is about to unfold.
b6c73274c921e0a1607e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]你琢磨片刻。弟兄们都看着你，以为你要喊停，谁知你却在人群中坐了下来。众人短促地欢呼一声，随着%clown%和%archer%开始准备，又迅速压低嗓音，窃窃私语。%SPEECH_ON%记住了，射的是苹果！%SPEECH_OFF%一个弟兄喊道，引来一片笑声。%SPEECH_ON%隔这么远看，%clown_short%的鼻子也挺像苹果。%SPEECH_OFF%笑声又起，可随着表演临近，这笑里也越来越透着紧张。

90e22968a2640a5d814d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]%archer% angles his shoulders to %clown% and draws his bow, the silhouette of the man but a crescent of wood, string, and arm. You can't see %clown%'s face, but you assume his eyes are closed. The shot is released. It zips. It disappears. %clown% rocks backward, clutching his face. This isn't looking good. The man screams. The crowd oohs. %archer% slowly lowers his bow and looks at it as though it is at fault.

 Eventually, %clown% is carried past you, a shaft of an arrow sticking out of his head. Another brother lingers behind, quietly eating an apple in the wake of the chaos.
90e22968a2640a5d814d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]%archer%侧身对准%clown%，拉开长弓。人影、弓身、弓弦和手臂，绷成一弯紧紧的月牙。你看不清%clown%的脸，不过猜他大概闭着眼。箭出弦了，嗖的一声，转眼便没了踪影。%clown%猛地向后一仰，双手捂住脸。看来不妙。那人惨叫起来，围观者齐齐倒吸一口凉气。%archer%慢慢放下弓，盯着它看，仿佛错全在弓上。

最终，%clown%被人从你身边抬过，头上还插着一截箭杆。另一个弟兄落在后面，趁着混乱，默默啃着苹果。

c5a8dcd015af2ff20463.source: That's going to leave a mark...

6de425e84468f6a8add5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]The men cheer as you give an affirming nod. You take a seat amongst them as %archer% and %clown% get ready, the former nocking an arrow while the latter balances an apple atop his head. When the fruit is good and steady, the archer draws back his bow, forming but a silhouette of man, wood, and string, a crescent of determination as he aims downfield. The men are exchanging bets on whether or not he misses. You want to look away, but the spectacle truly is too much.

 A great gasp follows the arrow's release, as though some ominous event long foretold had finally happened. Men reel back in their seats, wincing and gritting their teeth. The apple is shot off %clown%'s head, fruit and arrow spinning away. After a brief silence, the men erupt in cheers. %clown% takes a bow, while %archer% slackens his draw and looks a bit relieved.
6de425e84468f6a8add5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]你点头应允，弟兄们立刻欢呼起来。你在众人中间坐下，%archer%与%clown%开始准备：前者搭好箭，后者小心地将苹果顶稳。等果子不再晃动，弓手拉满弓弦，人、木弓与细弦绷成一弯坚定的月牙，直指场地另一头。弟兄们纷纷下注，赌他会不会射偏。你想别过头去，可这场面实在让人移不开眼。

箭一离弦，众人便齐齐惊呼，仿佛预言已久的凶兆终于应验。有人向后缩，有人龇牙咧嘴，紧紧咬住牙关。苹果从%clown%头顶飞了出去，连同箭矢一起翻滚。短暂的寂静过后，欢呼声骤然爆发。%clown%躬身谢幕，%archer%则松下弓，明显舒了口气。

9d9dde10808bee25ce77.source: You shake your head 'no' as you walk out into the field and step between the two men.%SPEECH_ON%If y'all wanted to play tricks, you should've joined a circus. Now get back to work before someone gets seriously hurt.%SPEECH_OFF%A wave of disappointment washes over the men. A few even boo and give you a thumbs down or other, rowdier, gestures.
9d9dde10808bee25ce77.translation: 你摇着头走进场地，站到两人之间。%SPEECH_ON%想耍把戏，就该去马戏团。趁还没人受重伤，赶紧回去干活。%SPEECH_OFF%人群顿时一片失望。有几个人甚至发出嘘声，冲你倒竖拇指，还有些手势更不客气。

2dbc26320fa14d3e667b.source: Didn't get the entertainment he had hoped for

aa7826d2260ebcaf0dd1.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%superstitious% enters your tent with hat in hand. The rim of it turns round and round in his fingers as though he were plucking feathers from it. Even though you haven't said a word the man's head nods furiously and his eyes jet around as if looking for the words to say.

You put your quill pen down and ask what the issue is. Licking his lips, he nods again and begins to explain his predicament. The words come fast, but the general gist of it seems to be that a local witch has cursed the man to be incapable of some sexual export, as it were.

You shake your head and ask what it is the witch wants and %superstitious% says %payment% crowns, lest the curse be on him for life.
aa7826d2260ebcaf0dd1.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%superstitious%拿着帽子走进帐篷，手指不停地转着帽檐，仿佛要从上面拔出羽毛来。你还一言未发，他就已经拼命点头，目光四下乱窜，似乎正在搜肠刮肚，寻找开口的词句。

你放下羽毛笔，问他出了什么事。他舔舔嘴唇，又点了点头，开始讲自己的难处。话说得飞快，大意是当地一个女巫给他下了咒，让他在男女之事上……有些力不从心。

你摇摇头，问那女巫想要什么。%superstitious%说，要%payment%克朗，否则这诅咒就得跟他一辈子。

9ae56415b7451cae0297.source: If it must be... go take care of it. Here are the crowns.
9ae56415b7451cae0297.translation: 非要这样的话……拿着钱，去把事情了结了。

da49617ef5fc4503be67.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Thumb and finger pinching your eyes shut, you wonder if maybe this wasn't the life for you. Killing's easy, but this? Whatever. You throw your hands up and get out of your chair to retrieve a satchel of crowns. The superstitious man totters up on the tips of his toes.%SPEECH_ON%Please count it out! It mustn't be a crown short!%SPEECH_OFF%You begrudgingly set the satchel on the table and begin counting. Once the appropriate number is had, you shuffle it into a purse and toss it to %superstitious%. He bows, thanking you and your mercy. You wave the man off to quickly get him out of your tent.
da49617ef5fc4503be67.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你捏住眉心，闭上眼，不禁怀疑自己是不是选错了行。杀人倒容易，可这种事？算了。你摊开双手，起身去拿钱袋。那迷信的家伙踮起脚，急得直晃。%SPEECH_ON%求您数清楚！一枚也不能少！%SPEECH_OFF%你不情不愿地把袋子放到桌上，开始数钱。数够之后，你把克朗装进小袋，扔给%superstitious%。他连连鞠躬，谢你大发慈悲。你挥挥手，只想让他快点离开帐篷。

be2df06fb8f21a268555.source: The things I put up with...
be2df06fb8f21a268555.translation: 我到底还得忍受多少怪事……

eb23c9bd96536284ecd8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You further muddy %superstitious%'s poor countenance with some bad news: you're not paying any witch anything.%SPEECH_ON%A few farcical words from some strange woman in the woods is no basis for an exchange of business. What you've heard is a tramp's attempt to get at you, mercenary. You cannot listen to such tripe, especially a tramp's tripe for a tramp's tripe is always in pursuit of one's coin.%SPEECH_OFF%None of these words help %superstitious% for he quickly runs out of the tent, perhaps in pursuit of another mercenary who will give him a loan.
eb23c9bd96536284ecd8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你又给%superstitious%本就难看的脸色添了一层阴云：你不会给什么女巫付半枚钱。%SPEECH_ON%林子里一个怪女人随口念几句胡话，就值得掏钱？佣兵，你听到的，不过是个女骗子讹人的把戏。别信那些鬼话，尤其别信骗子的鬼话——骗子满嘴胡话，图的从来都是你的钱袋。%SPEECH_OFF%这番话对%superstitious%毫无用处。他转身冲出帐篷，大概去找肯借钱给他的其他佣兵了。

2579fcd1958c3a480652.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Wondering if maybe %monk% the monk could help, you go and fetch the holy man.

He says he can indeed lend a hand for the old gods are always at war with the evils of witchcraft and other sorcery. Before he goes off on a long monologue about this old god or that one, you dip away and send him %superstitious%. For a few minutes, there is peace and quiet in your tent. But you know it can't last, for you are like a man beneath a rockslide, awaiting the tumbling stone with his name on it.

 However, %superstitious% doesn't return. After a few minutes more you realize he still hasn't made a disruptive entrance. In fact, his absence altogether has you on edge, as though silence itself might be haranguing. You leave the tent to find the monk and so-called cursed man deep in religious talks. Smiling, you return to your tent. If there's one thing the holy men are best at, it's maintaining a sense of tranquility.
2579fcd1958c3a480652.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你想到修士%monk%或许能帮上忙，便去把他找来。

他说自己确实有办法：旧神向来与巫术及各种邪法势不两立。他正要长篇大论地讲起这位神、那位神，你便溜开了，把%superstitious%打发过去。接下来的几分钟，帐篷里安安静静。可你知道，这太平维持不了多久。你就像站在山崩之下的人，等着那块专冲自己砸来的石头。

然而，%superstitious%没有回来。又过了几分钟，他还是没来打扰。这彻底的缺席反倒让你有些不安，仿佛连寂静都在喋喋不休。你走出帐篷，发现修士与那位自称中了咒的人正热烈地探讨信仰。你笑了笑，回到帐篷。要说这些圣职者最擅长什么，那还得是让人清静。

6e3bce65b74eea73322f.source: That should put an end to this.

925e9b4675e661e875dd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You snap your fingers, suddenly remembering %sorcerer%, the so-called sorcerer. Wanting to not spend another minute being a part of this bizarre affair, you refer %superstitious% to the sorcerer. He is quick to leave, but unfortunately returns a few minutes later, explaining that %sorcerer% has set him free from his curse.%SPEECH_ON%All I had to do was...%SPEECH_OFF%You hold your hand up, stopping the man's story right where it be. He asks if you want to hear the rest of it and you give a firm no.
925e9b4675e661e875dd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你一打响指，忽然想起那个自称巫师的%sorcerer%。你实在不想再为这桩怪事多耗片刻，便把%superstitious%打发给他。那人走得很快，可惜几分钟后又回来了，说%sorcerer%已经替他解除了诅咒。%SPEECH_ON%我只需要……%SPEECH_OFF%你立刻抬手，把故事截在这里。他问你想不想听后面，你斩钉截铁地说：不想。

ae9cc9f09b23de474df4.source: Have %monk% the monk take a look instead.

55bfa41013abffe21e34.source: Have %sorcerer% the sorcerer take a look instead.

1c4ef50bd56170cc930c.source:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]Cries whip through the party like the howls of the wind. There is not an enemy in sight so you've no idea what is causing this. You walk the ranks to find %superstitious% practically sobbing on the ground. He is clutching his chest with one hand while the other points to the sky, the finger shaking in pointed fear. %otherguy% explains that the man saw a great blaze of fire cross by the stars. Apparently this pathetic fool takes it for an omen and, of course, it isn't a good one. Whatever it is, it isn't going to get you where you need to be so you order the men to march. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img] Shadows begin to fold in and on themselves in strange ways. You turn around to see the sun darkening, a great rim of black moving over it. Soon there is no sun at all. %superstitious% cries out that the end times are coming, but before his wailing can find a grip on the rest of your men, the great shade unveils the sun once more and there is light again as though nothing happened at all. You tell the pathetic fool to get to his feet. You've places to march and tears sure as hell won't get you there. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img] %superstitious% is poking his sword into a warren when he suddenly cries out. He leaps away from the rabbit hole and screams that there is a two headed bunny within. Apparently this is a bad omen of things to come. All you can think is that two heads just means more meat for the stew. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]You pass beneath a tree whose branches are occupied by both a black cat and an albino crow. %superstitious% cries at the sight of it, saying that this is surely a sign of the end times. Why yes, of course it is. These things are never a sign of good things, right? Yeesh. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img] You come across a deer skull. At first it means nothing to you, but %superstitious% picks it up with earnest. Muted dust pours out of the cavity as he turns it this way and that. Hands trembling, he throws the head out of his hands. It clatters hollow against the ground, tumbling over onto where the horns should be. The scared man claims that a soothsayer once told him that he would come across a skull such as this.

There are many skulls out here, you argue, because things have a tendency to die. Your words do nothing for the man as he slowly, and nervously, shuffles back into the marching rank. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img] Marching along, a few of the men take up a game of finding shapes in the clouds. They banter back and forth about dogs and fat women and even of home, but the fun takes a wild turn when %superstitious% sees one odd-shaped cloud that brings him to his knees. He cries out that it is a bad omen, this cloud, and that doom will soon be upon the company. Thankfully, the fear does not grip the rest of the company who, instead of trembling, soon start bickering over whether or not the cloud is truly representative of %randombrother%'s impressive endowment.}
1c4ef50bd56170cc930c.translation:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]哭喊声如狂风般掠过队伍。四下连个敌人都没有，你完全不知道出了什么事。你沿队列找过去，发现%superstitious%几乎瘫在地上痛哭，一只手捂着胸口，另一只手指向天空，指尖怕得直抖。%otherguy%解释说，他刚看见一道大火光划过星空。显然，这可怜的傻瓜把它当成了预兆——当然，还偏偏是凶兆。不管那是什么，都不会替你们赶路，于是你下令继续前进。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]影子开始以诡异的形状交叠扭曲。你回头一看，太阳正渐渐暗下去，一道巨大的黑边缓缓将它吞没。很快，太阳彻底消失了。%superstitious%哭喊着末日将至，可他的哀号还没来得及吓住其他人，那片黑影便又退去，阳光重现，仿佛什么都没发生。你叫那可怜的傻瓜站起来。你们还得赶路，眼泪可不会把人送到地方。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]%superstitious%正拿剑往兔子洞里捅，突然一声惊叫，跳得老远。他嚷着洞里有只两个脑袋的兔子，认定这预示着大祸临头。你却只想到：两个脑袋，炖起来岂不是多一份肉。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]你们走过一棵树，枝头同时蹲着一只黑猫和一只白乌鸦。%superstitious%一见便叫了起来，说这肯定是末日来临的征兆。是啊，当然了。这种东西从来不会预示好事，对吧？真受不了。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]你们碰见一颗鹿头骨。你起初并不在意，%superstitious%却郑重其事地捡了起来，翻来覆去地看，灰尘无声地从骨腔里漏下。忽然，他双手发抖，把头骨扔了出去。骨头落地，发出空洞的响声，滚了几圈，最后倒扣在本该长着鹿角的一面。他惊恐地说，曾有个占卜者告诉他，有朝一日会遇到这样一颗头骨。

你反驳说，野外头骨多得是，毕竟万物都有死的时候。可你的话毫无作用，那人只是战战兢兢地挪回行军队列。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]赶路时，几个弟兄玩起了看云猜形状的游戏。他们笑着争论，有的云像狗，有的像胖女人，有的甚至像故乡。可%superstitious%看见一朵怪模怪样的云，竟一下跪倒在地，叫嚷着这是凶兆，战团马上就要遭殃。幸好，其他人并没跟着害怕。他们不但没发抖，反而很快争论起来：那朵云究竟像不像%randombrother%胯下那件惊人的家伙。}

57af79375b173f668a31.source: {Pull yourself together! | And I thought only children had such silly fears.}
57af79375b173f668a31.translation: {振作起来！ | 我还以为，只有孩子才会怕这种蠢事。}

93af0bf0b003d56fbc9e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]The company comes across a small boy who has climbed up a tree and out to the edge of a branch. He's reaching for a ball that's gotten stuck on the roof of his home. There's not a parent in sight to help him. When he sees you, he asks if you can help get the ball. Seems simple enough.
93af0bf0b003d56fbc9e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]战团遇见一个小男孩。他爬上树，挪到枝条末端，正伸手够自家屋顶上的球，四周却不见父母来帮忙。看见你们，他便开口求助，请你们把球取下来。看着倒不难。

bba7909fee382bcae8cb.source: I guess we can help him.

132d9c0cea709ebec7a5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You send %otherbrother% to try and retrieve the ball. Using %otherother% as a stepstool, he launches himself onto the roof and gets the toy. The boy is ecstatic and the smile on his face warms even the most cynical of your mercenaries.
132d9c0cea709ebec7a5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你让%otherbrother%去取球。他踩着%otherother%借力一蹿，翻上屋顶，拿回了玩具。男孩高兴极了，脸上的笑容连你麾下最冷漠的佣兵也给暖化了。

ccd5669d4a6d20df49a7.source: What a good sword sellin' samaritan.
ccd5669d4a6d20df49a7.translation: 拿钱杀人的，也能做回好人嘛。

b2c6c8b69704b4821f6f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You send %otherbrother% to try and retrieve the ball. He climbs the tree and jumps across a branch to land atop the roof. Mission complete, he tosses the ball to the kid. Unfortunately, the boy lets go of the tree branch to try and catch it. He slips off the branch and falls a good fifteen feet to the earth. The wallop of his landing has the whole company cringing. When you check on him he isn't moving and his back has taken a new shape. %otherother% yells at the idiot still standing in shock on the roof.%SPEECH_ON%What the hell were you thinking? Holy shit, man!%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenary climbs down off the roof. He looks at the kid and then nervously looks around.%SPEECH_ON%Well he, uh, he's got the ball. Let's get the hell out of here. Our... our work here is done.%SPEECH_OFF%What a goatfuck of a situation. You and the company quickly leave the scene before the parents get back.
b2c6c8b69704b4821f6f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你让%otherbrother%去取球。他爬上树，从树枝跃到屋顶，顺利拿到了玩具。活干完，他随手把球扔给孩子。不幸的是，男孩为了接球，松开了抓着树枝的手，从离地足有十五尺的地方摔了下去。那一声闷响，让全团的人都缩了缩身子。你上前查看时，孩子已经不动了，背脊也扭成了不该有的形状。%otherother%冲着还在屋顶发愣的蠢货大吼。%SPEECH_ON%你他妈到底怎么想的？见鬼啊！%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵爬下屋顶，看看孩子，又心虚地四下张望。%SPEECH_ON%这个，呃，他拿到球了。咱们赶紧走吧。咱们……咱们的活干完了。%SPEECH_OFF%真是一场烂到家的祸事。趁孩子父母还没回来，你赶紧带着战团离开现场。

4e2fd29ca7ad709b159b.translation: 谁也没看见，什么也没发生。

ccc744f3a5ad5bb49300.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%surefooted% clears his throat and steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%I'll be your hero, kid.%SPEECH_OFF%He opens his arms and the kid jumps down into them. The boy is set aside and the sellsword points a finger to the earth.%SPEECH_ON%Stay down here.%SPEECH_OFF%The surefooted mercenary easily clambers up the tree and jumps over to the roof. He picks the ball up and spins it on a finger before he pirouettes off the eave like a tornado, landing right on his toes with rather feminine grace. The boy claps excitedly and takes the toy and even the most cynical of men in the company are warmed by his happiness.
ccc744f3a5ad5bb49300.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%surefooted%清清嗓子，走上前去。%SPEECH_ON%孩子，今天我来当你的英雄。%SPEECH_OFF%他张开双臂，孩子跳了下来，被他稳稳接住。他把男孩放到一旁，指指地面。%SPEECH_ON%乖乖待在这儿。%SPEECH_OFF%这位脚步稳健的佣兵轻松爬上树，又跃到屋顶。他捡起球，让它在指尖转了几圈，接着像旋风般从屋檐上旋身跃下，脚尖轻巧着地，姿态优雅得近乎妩媚。男孩兴奋地拍手，接过玩具。连战团里最冷漠的人，也被这份快乐感染了。

1b5fe629968d4cf705e2.source: %surefooted%, you're sure-footed. Give him a hand.

a4ef24823fd4bccbc279.source: We have no time for this.

fdc80d9e235582b1a5f2.translation: 失手害一个小男孩落下残疾

6fb6a8ae36e88ca10573.translation: 凭自己的身手赢得众人赞叹

68f2e4e87af23173e2ce.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Under the cover of night, a man slips into your tent beneath the folds wafting just over the ground. He's masked with a black cloak and noble pauldrons. You arm yourself, but he holds a hand out.%SPEECH_ON%Don't bother, sellsword, for I am not here for you.%SPEECH_OFF%That's not good enough for you. The second the man takes another step, you charge and plant him on your table and with your free arm put a dagger to his neck. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%I already told you that I am not here for you. I am here for %bastard%.%SPEECH_OFF%The bastard nobleman? You ask what the stranger wants with him.%SPEECH_ON%Well, that depends, are you willing to talk?%SPEECH_OFF%
68f2e4e87af23173e2ce.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]夜色中，一个男人从贴近地面、随风摆动的篷布下钻进帐篷。他蒙着脸，披黑斗篷，肩上却戴着贵族式样的护肩。你抓起武器，他抬起一只手。%SPEECH_ON%别费劲，佣兵。我不是来找你的。%SPEECH_OFF%这可不足以让你放心。他刚再迈一步，你便扑上去，把他按在桌上，腾出另一只手，将匕首抵住他的喉咙。他咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%我已经说过，不是来找你的。我找的是%bastard%。%SPEECH_OFF%那个贵族私生子？你问陌生人找他做什么。%SPEECH_ON%那得看情况。你愿意谈谈吗？%SPEECH_OFF%

8890bdf30441a00b57cd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You lift the dagger from his neck. He straightens up on the table and glances at the map.%SPEECH_ON%I see the %companyname% has marched far and wide. %bastard% chose wisely to fit himself into its ranks.%SPEECH_OFF%When a drop of blood spatters the paper, he pauses to scratch a small nick you left on his neck, pursing his lips as though he had done it to himself in a morning shave.%SPEECH_ON%Anyway, let's get down to business. My benefactors want %bastard% dead. Seeing as how I've been paid a large sum of coin, I am obligated to see this ambition to its end. Or... maybe not.%SPEECH_OFF%When he raises a playful eyebrow, you tell him to spill what he's thinking. He stiltwalks a sexton across the map as he talks.%SPEECH_ON%%bastard% has an army waiting for him if he so chooses. That's why the nobles want him dead, because he stands as a real and viable threat to the status quo and this he does not yet know. I suppose he doesn't have to, either, but it'd be a nice send off, no? You get to see to it that his place in this world is justified and that he isn't some accident gliding through a world he believes to hate him. But what about me, a grossly talented assassin with a perfect streak of kills, hm? What about me? Well, I don't want this life anymore. So here's my offer: I take his place. He goes home, I go with you. He goes and conquers, my benefactors are nonethewiser and for all they know, I simply disappeared. Sounds good, no?%SPEECH_OFF%
8890bdf30441a00b57cd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你把匕首从他喉间移开。他在桌边直起身，扫了一眼地图。%SPEECH_ON%看来%companyname%走过不少地方。%bastard%选择混进你们的队伍，眼光不错。%SPEECH_OFF%一滴血落在纸上。他停下来，摸摸脖子上被你划开的小口，抿着嘴，仿佛那只是早晨刮胡子时留下的。%SPEECH_ON%言归正传。我的雇主想要%bastard%的命。他们付了大笔钱，我就有义务把这件事办妥。又或者……未必。%SPEECH_OFF%他意味深长地挑挑眉，你让他有话直说。他一边拨弄着地图上的测绘工具，一边开口。%SPEECH_ON%只要%bastard%愿意，就有一支军队等着他。这才是贵族想杀他的原因：他真能动摇他们眼下的地位，只是他自己还不知道。当然，他也不必知道。可给他这样的前程，岂不是一场体面的送别？你可以让他明白，他在这世上自有一席之地，并非一次意外留下的孽种，也不必觉得整个世界都恨他。那我呢？我这么一个本领高强、从未失手的刺客，该怎么办，嗯？说到底，我不想再过这种日子了。我的条件是：我顶替他。他回家，我跟你走。他去打天下，我的雇主蒙在鼓里，只当我凭空消失。听起来不错吧？%SPEECH_OFF%

601d68e32e9880b19441.source: How much are you paid for this?

249e833842ab57e5d3e2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%bastard% deserves better. Not that the %companyname% is beneath him, but he is a man who has spent his whole life seeing himself as an outsider, a blight upon his own family name, a threat to those he love merely because they carry a finer bloodline than he. You agree to the assassin's demand and send for the bastard to enter your tent. When he does, you quickly explain the situation. He asks for proof that an army is awaiting him and the hired killer quickly complies, producing a stamped scroll with a sigil and signature only the bastard could recognize. %bastard% reads it carefully. He lowers and looks to you.%SPEECH_ON%And you are alright with this? The destiny is mine to take, but you have my sword and allegiance for as long as you want.%SPEECH_OFF%You clap the man on the shoulder and tell him to go forge his path. The assassin tells him if he is to do it then he should do it quickly. A little tearful, and not at all trying to hide it, %bastard% thanks you for at the very least believing in him even if only for the short time he was with the %companyname%. And then he leaves. Turning around, you find the assassin bowing.%SPEECH_ON%And just like that, you have my sword, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%This will take some explaining to the other men, but they'll be sure to trust your intuition here.
249e833842ab57e5d3e2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%bastard%值得更好的前程。并非%companyname%配不上他，只是他一辈子都把自己当成局外人、家族姓氏上的污点。仅因血统不及那些所爱的人高贵，他的存在便成了对他们的威胁。你答应刺客的条件，派人叫私生子进帐篷。他一来，你便简要说明情况。他要求证明真有一支军队在等他，那受雇的杀手马上取出一卷盖了印的文书，上面的徽记与签名，只有私生子认得。%bastard%仔细读完，放下卷轴，看着你。%SPEECH_ON%你当真同意？这命运固然等着我去争，可只要你需要，我的剑和忠诚就始终属于你。%SPEECH_OFF%你拍拍他的肩，叫他去闯出自己的路。刺客催促说，既然要走，就该尽快动身。%bastard%眼里泛起泪光，也并不掩饰。他感谢你，至少在他效力%companyname%的这段短暂时日里，你始终相信他。随后，他离开了。你转回身，发现刺客正在鞠躬。%SPEECH_ON%就这样，我的剑归你调遣了，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%这事得向其他弟兄解释一番，不过，他们一定会相信你的判断。

8c394e74704421d98743.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Before you decide anything, you ask the assassin how much was offered to slay the bastard. He weighs the numbers by tilting his head side to side.%SPEECH_ON%Well, it was... and then, deducting travel time, equipment costs, the time it took to find the damn sod, and the time it took scouting your encampment and figuring out whether you'd be open to dialogue I'd say... five-thousand crowns. If you're thinking of matching that, it's going to be a bit more. About one-thousand more, so that'd be six-thousand crowns on your bill. You still up for that sort of 'discussion', hm?%SPEECH_OFF%
8c394e74704421d98743.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]做决定之前，你先问刺客，杀掉私生子能拿多少报酬。他脑袋左右轻晃，盘算着数目。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，本来是……再扣掉旅途上的工夫、装备花费、找那倒霉蛋的时间，还有摸清你们营地、判断你肯不肯谈的工夫，我看……五千克朗。要是你想出同样的价，那还得添点。大概再添一千，所以算你六千克朗。这种“谈法”，你还想继续吗，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%

f34342e434ab0d3d56dd.source: I agree to your offer. %bastard% will go, and you will take his place.
f34342e434ab0d3d56dd.translation: 我答应了。%bastard%离开，你顶替他的位置。

f433de54592e124bec9b.source: I will pay you those 6,000 crowns, and both %bastard% and you will stay.
f433de54592e124bec9b.translation: 我付你6,000克朗，你和%bastard%都留下。

9312a205f246da70a4ac.source: I think I'll just kill you.

86145d98cb8611c55e2b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]While the %companyname% is doing well, it could be doing the best in the world and six-thousand crowns would still be a lot to ask for. But... you agree. The assassin hears your words and sits there for a moment.%SPEECH_ON%You agree? You'll pay six-thousand crowns, really?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. He mulls the words over for another moment, a slight break in an otherwise stalwart presentation he has been putting on.%SPEECH_ON%Gotta be honest, didn't think you'd do that. But a deal is a deal, and I am not one to playfully waste words.%SPEECH_OFF%He jets his hand out and you take it with a firm shake - just in case it is a ruse. He bows gracefully, no doubt something he learned in the halls of the noblemen that had sent him here in the first place.%SPEECH_ON%Captain of the %companyname%, you have my blade!%SPEECH_OFF%It'll take some explaining as to how a random man slipped into the company overnight, but the men have enough faith in your command that you could have recruited a sword-wielding goat and they would go along with it.
86145d98cb8611c55e2b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%companyname%如今虽说过得不错，可即使成了天下最富的战团，六千克朗也绝不是个小数目。不过……你还是答应了。刺客听完，坐在那里愣了一会儿。%SPEECH_ON%你答应？真肯付六千克朗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。他又琢磨片刻，那副始终从容镇定的模样，总算露出一点裂缝。%SPEECH_ON%说实话，我没想到你会答应。不过，成交就是成交，我不拿承诺开玩笑。%SPEECH_OFF%他猛地伸出手，你牢牢握住——万一这也是个圈套呢。他优雅地鞠了一躬，这礼数，想必正是从雇他来的那些贵族厅堂里学到的。%SPEECH_ON%%companyname%的团长，我的刀归你调遣！%SPEECH_OFF%战团里一夜之间多了个陌生人，你免不了解释一番。不过，弟兄们如此信任你的带领，哪怕你招来一只会挥剑的山羊，他们大概也肯点头。

b3bb34cc83e86e147d3f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You refuse the assassin's offer. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Alright.%SPEECH_OFF%The dagger comes quick, faster than you thought it would have. Your hand rises to deflect, but it's a moment too slow. A knife's edge clips your cheek and draws blood. By the time you draw your sword, the assassin has already leapt out of the tent. You hear a commotion outside and rush to it. %bastard% the bastard is laying on the ground, a few other brothers beside him. %otherbrother% comes over to ask if you're okay. He says a man in black tried to kill the bastard.%SPEECH_ON%I think we mortally wounded him, but I don't know where he went. Farker slashed the lot of us. Sir, you're bleeding.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him you know and that the priority right now is to take care of the bastard and the rest of the men.
b3bb34cc83e86e147d3f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你拒绝了刺客的提议。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%好。%SPEECH_OFF%匕首来得比你预想的还快。你抬手格挡，却慢了一瞬，刀锋擦过脸颊，划出一道血口。等你拔出剑，刺客已经跃出帐篷。外面传来骚动，你赶紧冲出去。私生子%bastard%倒在地上，几个弟兄守在旁边。%otherbrother%过来问你有没有事，说一个黑衣人企图刺杀私生子。%SPEECH_ON%我想我们给了他致命伤，可不知道他跑哪儿去了。那混蛋把咱们几个都划伤了。团长，你在流血。%SPEECH_OFF%你说自己知道，眼下要紧的是先照顾私生子和其他受伤的弟兄。

4d91fc1bada1e1392a43.source: Well, at least no one was killed.

3b6ca0d83d4ac870a75b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You put a hand to the pommel of your sword and decline the assassin's request. He claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, sellsword. Fair enough. And don't bother with the theatrics there.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods to your sword-hand.%SPEECH_ON%If I really wanted the bastard dead, do you think I'd be standing here? I came to talk, and talk we did. The killing life has left me and with it, apparently, so too did my poker face. You called my bluff and I suppose that's that. Good evening, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can say another word, the assassin ducks out of the tent. You rush to see where he'd gone to, but all you find is the dark of night. %bastard% the bastard spies you peering around and asks what you're up to. You smile and tell him to get some rest for he truly deserves it. Confused, the man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Well, uh, I guess so. Thanks, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%
3b6ca0d83d4ac870a75b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你把手按在剑柄上，拒绝了刺客的要求。他拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，佣兵。也罢。你也不用再摆那架势了。%SPEECH_OFF%他朝你按剑的手点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我要真想杀那私生子，你觉得我还会站在这里？我是来谈的，也已经谈过了。我不想再当杀手，看来连装模作样的本事都跟着没了。你看穿了我在虚张声势，事情也就到此为止。晚上好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及再说一句，刺客便钻出了帐篷。你赶出去看他去了哪里，眼前却只有黑夜。私生子%bastard%见你四处张望，问你在做什么。你笑笑，叫他去好好休息，说这是他应得的。那人一头雾水，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，呃，大概是吧。谢了，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%

9d027bd333467c621d46.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You refuse the assassin's offer. He nods, coursing a hand over a candle.%SPEECH_ON%Well then. I guess our talk has come to an end and so something else must begin.%SPEECH_OFF%His face turns to you. He winks.

 The dagger comes quick, its sheen flashing as it slashes just before your face. You reach for your blade but the man kicks your hand, slamming the sword back into its scabbard. A second dagger comes - this one yours, unsheathed from behind your back and launched forward with murderous intentions. The assassin's dagger pops open into a trident into which your blade gets caught. He twists his hand, disarming you in an instant, then twists his hand back around, closing the dagger into one blade again. Sonuvabitch...

 The man goes for a stab, but you catch his arm. He shushes you with his free hand before retrieving another blade which you've no means to stop. He whispers with disturbing calmness.%SPEECH_ON%Die with grace, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%As his hand goes backward, it suddenly disappears in a glint of metal. All that remains is a nub spewing crimson. The assassin looks at the stump and screams. %bastard% is standing there, weapon in hand. Another flash of metal and the assassin's head rolls off his shoulders. A gush of blood pours out of the hole as his torso slams into your table and back against the ground. The bastard hurriedly asks.%SPEECH_ON%Are you alright? Who in the fark was that?%SPEECH_OFF%More sellswords enter the tent to see what the commotion was. You let them know an assassin had come for the bastard, but you weren't going to give him over that easy. The men applaud your defense of the mercenary.
9d027bd333467c621d46.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你拒绝了刺客的提议。他点点头，手从烛火上方缓缓掠过。%SPEECH_ON%那好。既然话已说完，也该换个法子了。%SPEECH_OFF%他转过脸，冲你眨了眨眼。

匕首来得极快，寒光贴着你的面前划过。你伸手拔剑，他却一脚踢中你的手，把剑撞回鞘里。第二把匕首随即出手——这次是你从背后抽出的，直奔他的要害。刺客手中的匕首骤然分成三叉，卡住你的刀刃。他手腕一拧，你便被缴了械；再一转，那柄匕首又合回单刃。狗娘养的……

他挺刀刺来，你抓住他的手臂。他用空着的手示意你噤声，随后又抽出一把刀，而你已经无力阻拦。他低声说，平静得令人发寒。%SPEECH_ON%死得体面些，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%他正往后收手蓄势，一道寒光闪过，那只手忽然没了，只剩断腕喷涌鲜血。刺客看着断处，惨叫起来。%bastard%手持武器，站在一旁。又一道金属闪光，刺客的头颅滚落肩头。血从脖颈里喷出，躯干撞上你的桌子，又重重摔倒在地。私生子急忙问。%SPEECH_ON%你没事吧？这他妈是谁？%SPEECH_OFF%更多佣兵涌进帐篷，查看出了什么事。你告诉他们，有刺客要来杀私生子，可你没打算轻易把人交出去。弟兄们为你护着同伴的举动纷纷喝彩。

796f55b080a5e92330a6.source: %name% joined the company in exchange for

4ff2cc3e601bbbaa6778.source: 's life. Little is known about the assassin and most remain wary of him. With a dagger in hand, the killer's sword-hand swerves and sways more akin to a snake than a man.
4ff2cc3e601bbbaa6778.translation: 的性命。没人清楚这刺客的来历，大多数人仍对他心存戒备。匕首一入手，他挥动兵刃的动作便如灵蛇游走，几乎不像人的手臂。

e5ede64989e0e00c0e6d.source: An assassin tired of the killing life, %name% offered to join your company at a large price which you were quick to match. He is extremely skilled with a short-blade, twirling daggers around with more dexterity and control than some men have over their own fingers.
e5ede64989e0e00c0e6d.translation: %name%厌倦了刺客生涯，开出高价，愿意加入你的战团，而你很快便答应了。他极擅短刃，匕首在手中翻飞自如；有些人连自己的手指，都未必使得像他这样灵巧。

45609189b9997f3daa3d.source: You risked your life for him

f296fc3605bdc08b96c7.source: You risked your life for the men
f296fc3605bdc08b96c7.translation: 你为弟兄们冒了性命之险

c87ee5e7cca712fc0575.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{You come across an old man hobbling along the road. He settles himself against his walking stick and awaits your approach. His eyes are grey, but he tilts his head as though to see you with his ears.%SPEECH_ON%Chinking armor. Heavy footsteps. Steady breaths. More warriors for a land of war.%SPEECH_OFF%The man straightens up as though to say 'am I right?'. You tell him that you're not here to harm him.%SPEECH_ON%So yes, I am right, as usual. It wouldn't be too much of a bother to run me through, though. My hearing's going and I suppose once it is gone so shall I be.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses and turns his head.%SPEECH_ON%Did you say something?%SPEECH_OFF%You notice the man's got a nice jeweled ring on one of his bony fingers. %aggro_bro% sidles up to you.%SPEECH_ON%We could take that... you know, like taking a tart from a baby. A really blind, more helpless than usual baby.%SPEECH_OFF% | An old man with a walking stick is found resting against a stone wall. His hand caresses the stones with a familiar touch. He stares at you, a jeweled ring glistens on one of his bony fingers.%SPEECH_ON%Evening, sirs. What a fine day, no?%SPEECH_OFF%Getting a good look at him, you realize he is a blind man. | You come to an old man standing in the middle of the road, his body leaning against a walking stick. He's staring up at a road sign. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I know there is a sign here. I think %randomtown% is that way, if I recall correctly.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns to you grinning. His eyes glint white, blinded by old age. A very nice, very expensive looking jeweled ring glistens on one of his bony fingers.}
c87ee5e7cca712fc0575.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{你遇到一位沿路蹒跚而行的老人。他拄稳手杖，等着你走近。双眼一片灰白，却偏着头，仿佛要用耳朵看清你。%SPEECH_ON%护甲碰响，脚步沉重，呼吸平稳。这战乱之地，又来了些战士。%SPEECH_OFF%他直起身，像是在问“我没说错吧”。你告诉他，自己无意伤害他。%SPEECH_ON%那么，我果然又说中了。不过，给我一剑倒也不算多麻烦。我的耳朵也快不行了。等彻底听不见，我想自己也就差不多了。%SPEECH_OFF%他顿了顿，转过头。%SPEECH_ON%你刚才说什么了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你注意到，他一根枯瘦的手指上戴着一枚漂亮的宝石戒指。%aggro_bro%凑到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%咱们可以拿走……你懂，就像从孩子手里抢块饼。还是个瞎了眼、格外没法反抗的孩子。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个拄着手杖的老人靠在石墙边休息，手掌熟稔地抚过石块。他朝着你看过来，一根枯瘦的手指上，宝石戒指闪着光。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，各位。天气真不错，不是吗？%SPEECH_OFF%等看清他的模样，你才发现，他是个盲人。 | 你遇到一个站在路中央的老人，身子倚着手杖，仰头望着路牌。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我知道这里有块路牌。如果没记错，%randomtown%应该往那边走。%SPEECH_OFF%他转向你，咧嘴一笑。双眼泛白，早已被岁月夺去了光明。一枚精美得显然价值不菲的宝石戒指，在他枯瘦的手指上闪闪发亮。}

9b588b3aef67740378d8.source: That jeweled ring. Hand it over.

a8d452b363eea34d4294.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{You approach the man. His head tilts up.%SPEECH_ON%That is a quickened pace, stranger, but I do not hear the sound of a sword, instead...%SPEECH_OFF%With a sudden push you knock the man to the ground. He clutches his walking stick, the end of it pointed upward as though you might impale yourself on its rounded tip. You kick his hand out of the way and step on his wrist, bending down to take the ring.%SPEECH_ON%Put steel through my heart while you're at it, ya bastard!%SPEECH_OFF%You let off the man and hand him back his stick, even helping him to his feet.%SPEECH_ON%No hard feelings, old man.%SPEECH_OFF% | You kick the man down. He grunts as though you'd just punted a pregnant boar. Turning over and clutching his stomach, he asks why, but you only kick him again to get him on his back. From there you easily rob him of the jeweled ring and make your leave. | The man smacks his old-man lips, that disgusting, crackling dry-mouth noise. In return, you rear back and throw a punch right into his stomach. Not seeing it coming, the elder eats it in full, blowing the air out of his lungs and bowling over. As he gasps for breath, you relieve him of the ring and leave. | The old man stands and leans against his walking stick. He raises his head up.%SPEECH_ON%Hmm, silence. The sound of ill intent between strangers. I stand in the dark, and you in the light, but where are we soon to be?%SPEECH_OFF%You kick the man's walking stick out from him and he topples over in a bumbling heap, his bony frame collapsing like a rickety hut. He rolls over and espouses some wisdom about violence between men. You boot him in the chest and tell him to shut up. The ring comes free of his finger with ease and you make your leave. | You crack your knuckles. The old man leans back.%SPEECH_ON%Surely violence is not the answer? This world doesn't need more of it.%SPEECH_OFF%With a swift punch, you knock him down and he crumples into a dry heaving mess. Taking the ring, you respond.%SPEECH_ON%I don't give a damn what this world needs or doesn't. I'm my own world and you yours. They just happened to cross paths, that's all. And guess what, old man? My world is bigger.%SPEECH_OFF%}
a8d452b363eea34d4294.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{你走近老人。他抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%脚步挺急啊，陌生人。不过，我没听见拔剑声，倒像是……%SPEECH_OFF%你猛地一推，将他掀翻在地。他紧握手杖，杖尖朝上，仿佛那圆钝的木头也能把你刺穿。你踢开他的手，踩住手腕，弯腰去摘戒指。%SPEECH_ON%有种再往我心口捅一刀，混蛋！%SPEECH_OFF%你松开脚，把手杖递还给他，甚至扶他站了起来。%SPEECH_ON%别往心里去，老头。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你一脚踹倒老人。他闷哼一声，活像被踢中了肚子的怀孕母猪。他翻过身，捂着腹部问你为什么，你却又踢一脚，让他仰面躺好。接着，你轻易夺走宝石戒指，转身离去。 | 老人咂着干瘪的嘴，发出干裂黏腻、令人作呕的声响。你回敬他的，是蓄足力气打在肚子上的一拳。他看不见拳头袭来，结结实实挨了个正着，肺里的气一下被挤空，弯腰倒了下去。趁他挣扎着喘气，你摘下戒指，离开了。 | 老人站起身，撑着手杖抬头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，沉默。陌生人心怀恶意时，就是这般声响。我立于黑暗，你身在光明，可接下来，我们又会落到何处？%SPEECH_OFF%你一脚踢飞他的手杖。那副嶙峋的身躯像破屋倒塌一样，狼狈地摔成一团。他翻过身，还想说些人为何彼此施暴的道理。你踹中他的胸口，叫他闭嘴。戒指很轻易就从手指上滑了下来，你拿着它走了。 | 你把指节掰得咔咔响。老人向后一缩。%SPEECH_ON%总不至于非得动手吧？这世上的暴行，已经够多了。%SPEECH_OFF%你一拳将他打倒。他蜷成一团，阵阵干呕。你摘下戒指，答道。%SPEECH_ON%这世界缺什么、不缺什么，关我屁事。我有我的天地，你有你的天地，不过恰巧撞上了而已。知道吗，老头？我的天地比你的大。%SPEECH_OFF%}

fc8c67b14692f4c73951.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{As you take stock of the inventory, you can't help but notice %beggar% lingering in your peripheral. Sighing, you finally turn to the former beggar and ask what he wants. Like the poorest of the poor he holds a hand out, asking if maybe you could spare a few crowns. | With practiced theatrics, %beggar% approaches you and lets loose a long tale of troubles and squabbles and empty bottles. The former beggar is down on his luck, apparently, and just needs a few extra crowns to get by. | %otherguy% tells you that %beggar% is going around the camp asking for crowns. Apparently the former beggar just needs a little more, expressing a longwinded sob story to anyone who'll listen. Hearing this news, you go to see the man yourself but before you can even get a word out the man lets loose his long narrative. Finished, he looks you in the eye, trying to gauge whether or not you'll give him something. | Apparently %beggar% the former beggar needs some help. He's come to you, begging for a few crowns to help him get by. The man looks like he's in a poor state, but he's had plenty of practice of actually being poor so it's hard to tell if he's being honest or not.}
fc8c67b14692f4c73951.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{清点物资时，你总瞥见%beggar%在旁边徘徊。终于，你叹了口气，转向这个曾当过乞丐的家伙，问他到底想要什么。他像个穷得揭不开锅的人那样伸出手，问你能不能赏几枚克朗。 | %beggar%带着一套娴熟的演技走上前来，讲起没完没了的苦难、争执和喝空的酒瓶。看来，这位昔日的乞丐又走了霉运，只差几枚克朗就能度过难关。 | %otherguy%告诉你，%beggar%正在营地里四处讨钱。那位昔日的乞丐似乎总差那么一点，逮着肯听的人，就讲一大通辛酸往事。听到这事，你亲自去找他，谁知还没开口，他便先滔滔不绝地讲了起来。终于讲完，他直盯着你的眼睛，揣摩你肯不肯给点东西。 | 看来，曾当过乞丐的%beggar%需要些帮助。他找上你，恳求施舍几枚克朗，好让他应付眼下的困境。他看起来确实落魄，不过这人从前穷惯了，很有经验，眼下这副模样究竟是真是假，实在难说。}

2842ae5e6e0a6ae224a1.source: Here you go, have a few crowns.

fae08b4ffac8234faf23.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You tell the beggar you'll cross his hands with a sword if he doesn't get back to work. The man shrugs and pretty much does as told. That was easier than expected. | The beggar's shoulders sag as you tell him to get back to work. You feel a little bad, but then remember that's how they get ya.}
fae08b4ffac8234faf23.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你告诉乞丐，再不回去干活，你就在那双讨钱的手上划一剑。他耸耸肩，基本照办了。倒比预想的容易。 | 你让乞丐回去干活，他的肩膀顿时垮了下来。你有些过意不去，随即又想起：他们要的就是这个。}

344e35046b654ce92427.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{The beggar takes the crowns and with a smile gets right back to work. | Tired of his games, you give the beggar a few crowns and tell him to get back to work. He bows and thanks you and, surprisingly, actually gets back to work.}
344e35046b654ce92427.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{乞丐接过克朗，笑着回去干活了。 | 你受够了他这套把戏，给了几枚克朗，叫他回去干活。他鞠躬道谢，然后——出乎意料地——还真去干活了。}

c17e6bbeea6daceae642.source: Got a few extra crowns from you
c17e6bbeea6daceae642.translation: 从你这里额外得到了几枚克朗

9497473de196f0eddba6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%bowyer% the bowyer comes to you with a bit of request: he wishes to build a weapon for the ages. Apparently, the man has been attempting to build a bow of legendary qualities for many years, but now that he has been on the road he's picked up a few things to fill in his gaps of knowledge. Truly, he believes he can get it right this time. All he needs is a few resources to help procure the elements needed to construct it. A sum of 500 crowns is what he humbly requests, and the quality wood you carry.
9497473de196f0eddba6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]制弓匠%bowyer%来找你，提出一个请求：他想造一件足以传世的兵器。多年来，他一直想做出一张传奇般的好弓，却始终未能如愿。如今四处闯荡，他又学到了不少东西，补上了过去欠缺的门道。他相信，这次一定能成。眼下只差些物资，好备齐制弓所需的材料。他谦恭地请求你拨出500克朗，再加上战团带着的那些优质木材。

5d2a7e8b395354a93938.source: Build me a bow of legends!
5d2a7e8b395354a93938.translation: 给我造一张能传世的好弓！

038fa730a0790ee75563.source: We don't have time for this.

41634b087b14e2ef6e54.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{The bow isn't quite legendary, but it is quite good. It's light in the grip, easily spun from side to side with the air whistling as it whirls. You test the draw. A strong man will be required to wield it that is for sure. When you loose an arrow, the shaft travels unbelievably straight and the shot almost seems to aim itself. A brilliant weapon if you ever saw one! | The bow was constructed with a mix of woods whose names you do not know. Colors of this tree and that spiral through the curve of the weapon, looking arboreally damascened. Testing the draw, the string proves itself mighty. You're no marksman, but when you loose an arrow it almost seems to guide itself to its target. A terrific weapon, if for no other reason it made you look better than you really are. You congratulate the bowyer.}
41634b087b14e2ef6e54.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{这张弓离传奇尚有距离，却确实是件好东西。握在手里轻巧得很，左右一转，便卷起呼呼的风声。你试着开弓，立刻明白，这非得是个壮汉才能使得动。可一箭射出，箭路直得难以置信，仿佛它自己就会瞄准。你这辈子见过的好兵器里，绝对算它一件！ | 这张弓用了好几种你叫不上名字的木材。深浅各异的木纹顺着弓身盘旋，犹如木头里锻出了花纹钢。你试着拉弦，劲道相当足。你并非神射手，可箭一出弦，几乎像自己认得靶子。别的不说，光凭它能把你衬得比实际高明，就称得上好兵器。你向制弓匠道了贺。}

7f1824f3b243143c9bba.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Is this thing a wild experiment? The wood cricks and cracks when bent, the string frizzes and goes wiry every time you draw it back, and you swear you saw a termite poking its head out of the shaft. Every tested arrow goes haywire, skirting this way or that, anywhere but its supposed target.

You ease the bowyer's pain by blaming yourself for how inaccurate the weapon is, but %otherguy1% and %otherguy2% both give it a try and come to even worse results. The bowyer eventually shuffles off, cradling his construction in his arms before tossing it onto the stockpile of weapons where you'd wish it'd look just like any other bow, but its obscene ugliness makes it stick out like a hot coal on a haystack. Surely no man will be accidentally wielding that thing!
7f1824f3b243143c9bba.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]这玩意儿究竟是什么怪试验？弓身一弯，木头就咯吱作响；每拉一次，弦上就多散出几缕毛丝。你甚至发誓，刚才看见一只白蚁从弓身里探出头来。试射的箭全都乱飞，左偏右歪，除了靶心，哪儿都肯去。

为了安慰制弓匠，你把射不准的责任揽到自己身上。可%otherguy1%和%otherguy2%也试了，结果还不如你。制弓匠终于抱着作品，垂头丧气地挪开，把它扔进武器堆。你原希望它混在别的弓里就看不出来了，可那副丑得惊人的模样，简直像干草堆上的火炭一样扎眼。肯定没人会拿错这东西上战场！

6b118b956275d543519a.source: I see now why you're no longer working as a bowyer.
6b118b956275d543519a.translation: 我算明白你为什么不再当制弓匠了。

009d1653bf884da5c76b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You tell the bowyer that the %companyname% has no resources to spare. The man grinds his teeth, and apparently whatever words he had to say, for he says nothing and turns on his heels and stomps off. In the distance you finally hear what kindness he had in store for you - a litany of swearing and cursing and eventually moaning disappointment.
009d1653bf884da5c76b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你告诉制弓匠，%companyname%没有多余物资给他折腾。他咬紧牙关，似乎连想说的话也一并咬碎了，半声不吭地转身，重重踏步离去。直到走远，你才听见他为你准备的那些“好话”：先是一连串咒骂，最后变成失望的哀叹。

cbb705ccfd53d6880008.translation: 未能制出心目中的杰作

f23d8716f8223cfdf78e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]A shadow crosses over you from behind. When you look back, %brawler% is standing there with a rather distant look in his eyes. He cracks his knuckles in one long staccato before asking if he can train up %noncom%. You ask why. The brawler looks down at you.%SPEECH_ON%Because he is weak.%SPEECH_OFF%Hmmm, good enough.
f23d8716f8223cfdf78e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]一片阴影从身后罩住你。你回头，发现%brawler%站在那里，目光有些出神。他把指节掰得接连作响，随后问你，能不能让他操练操练%noncom%。你问为什么。拳斗者低头看着你。%SPEECH_ON%因为他太弱。%SPEECH_OFF%嗯，这理由倒也够了。

0b5694c3cf1545985663.source: See how long you can keep him going.

4ab35bbb174b5d6f7715.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]%brawler% and %noncom% are found in a mudpit with their hands wrapped in cloth and leaves, padding for the knuckles and to keep them from cutting one another with every punch. The brawler has his trainee bouncing counter-clockwise along the ring of the fighting circle, punching the air as he goes, and with his trainer hitting or kicking him every time he passes by. The men glisten with sweat as they work. When %noncom% begins to slow, %brawler% hits him as though a jockey would a sluggish horse.

 After an hour of this, %brawler% steps back and invites his trainee to attack him. Predictably, the assault is aimless and pitiful. Long, looping punches are thrown with no energy behind them. The brawler ducks and weaves out of the way, punching every attempted strike with a counter-punch of his own.%SPEECH_ON%See what happens when you are tired? This is why we must train. Even the most able and deadly are worth nothing without air in their lungs and fresh legs beneath them.%SPEECH_OFF%
4ab35bbb174b5d6f7715.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你看见%brawler%与%noncom%站在泥地里，双手缠着布条和树叶，给指节垫上一层，免得拳拳都把对方打得皮开肉绽。拳斗者让徒弟沿着圈子逆时针蹦跳，一边移动一边对空挥拳。每次从师父面前经过，还得挨上一拳或一脚。两人练得汗光淋漓。只要%noncom%稍一慢下来，%brawler%就像骑手抽打懒马一样，打他一下。

练了一个时辰，%brawler%退后，示意徒弟攻过来。不出所料，进攻既杂乱，又可怜。拳头抡得老远，却半点劲道也没有。拳斗者左闪右避，每躲过一次攻击，便还上一记反击。%SPEECH_ON%看见累了会怎么样了吧？所以才要练。再能打、再狠的人，肺里喘不上气，脚下没了力气，也一样是废物。%SPEECH_OFF%

a36755f8b4440cde54a0.source: I'm getting tired just watching this.

d6c1372befc6ff5822cd.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]The brawler has %noncom% stand completely still. He circles about the man, cracking his knuckles as he sizes him up. Finally, he lets his intentions be known.%SPEECH_ON%I am going to beat you until you break.%SPEECH_OFF%A moment is given to the trainee to acknowledge what is about to happen. He sucks in a great gulp of breath and then nods. %brawler% wastes no time wheeling a bola punch right into the man's chest. He bowls over at which point he is kicked in the shoulder repeatedly until he stands back up.

There the brawler continues to circle and deliver blows. Not every strike is thrown with conviction: most are meant to inflict pain, but not what could be called irreversible damage. The brawler, if he wanted to, could kill this man with his bare fists, but that is not the purpose of this training. You realize that this mode of 'toughening up' probably happened to the brawler himself at some point or another.
d6c1372befc6ff5822cd.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]拳斗者让%noncom%站定不动。他绕着对方打转，一边掰响指节，一边上下打量。终于，他说出了自己的打算。%SPEECH_ON%我要一直揍，揍到你撑不住为止。%SPEECH_OFF%他给徒弟留了片刻，好让他明白即将发生什么。那人深吸一口气，点点头。%brawler%毫不耽搁，抡起一记重拳，正中胸口。徒弟弯腰倒下，又挨了好几脚踢在肩上，直到重新爬起来。

拳斗者继续绕行，继续出拳。并非每一击都使足力气：大多只是要让人疼，还不到留下无法挽回的损伤那一步。他若真想动手，徒手便能打死眼前这人，可那不是训练的目的。你忽然觉得，这种所谓的“练结实”，拳斗者自己大概也曾挨过。

493440cd6bfc56c5f166.source: What doesn't kill you makes you stronger?
493440cd6bfc56c5f166.translation: 打不死你的，会让你更强？

0324ce09c44440735727.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]%brawler% the heavy-handed-rough-and-tumble brawler is found leaning over, his arms fenced out before himself in a defensive posture, and %noncom% is standing adjacent, trying to mimic the stance. The brawler drops his body low and shoots in under %noncom%'s arms, there wrapping both hands around the man's waist and lifting him up in the air before dumping him on his back. %brawler% steps away, cracking his knuckles and telling %noncom% to get up.%SPEECH_ON%You need to be ready for two things: me coming in low, and me coming in high.%SPEECH_OFF%%noncom% dusts himself off then complains a little.%SPEECH_ON%How can I possibly do both?%SPEECH_OFF%The brawler ignores the question and simply asks the man to attack him. %noncom% obliges, coming in high with a hurled fist. %brawler% deflects the blow with a shoulder-roll before throwing a cross-counter that has %noncom% spinning on his feet. The fist-fighter cracks his knuckles again and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Practice. That's how. Now get back up and let's go again.%SPEECH_OFF%
0324ce09c44440735727.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你看见那个拳重手狠、惯于扭打的拳斗者%brawler%弓着身，双臂护在面前；%noncom%站在一旁，努力模仿这副架势。拳斗者突然压低身体，钻到%noncom%双臂下，环抱住腰，将人举起，重重摔在地上。%brawler%退开，掰掰指节，叫%noncom%起来。%SPEECH_ON%你得防住两样：我从下面扑上来，还有我从上面打过来。%SPEECH_OFF%%noncom%拍掉身上的土，有些不服气。%SPEECH_ON%这叫我怎么同时防？%SPEECH_OFF%拳斗者不回答，只叫他进攻。%noncom%照做了，抡拳直取上身。%brawler%转肩卸开这一击，反手一记交叉反击，打得%noncom%原地转了个圈。拳斗者又掰了掰指节，啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%靠练。就这么防。起来，再来。%SPEECH_OFF%

7d11e366f70ef4bc5ee1.source: Maybe he'll shape up to be a real mercenary after all.
7d11e366f70ef4bc5ee1.translation: 没准他还真能练成个像样的佣兵。

4e87047b843f95186b19.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]As you sit with the men around the fire, a discussion across the flames starts to get a little loud. %brawler% the brawler stands up and points at his own chest with a hearty laugh.%SPEECH_ON%You? You think you could take me?%SPEECH_OFF%The other brawler, %brawler2%, jumps to his feet.%SPEECH_ON%Take you? I could put ya under the ground ya farkin' pillowfisted fool!%SPEECH_OFF%The slightest suggestion that %brawler%'s fists weren't made of jaw-demolishing bricks kicks off a brutal fight. The brawlers grab one another and swing their free hands in looping undercuts. Each punch lands with cracking ferocity. Surely no man could take so much damage and stay on his feet, but here you're witnessing two fellas doing just that. You order the company to break up the fight.

%brawler% pinches a nostril and shoots blood out of the other. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Just havin' a bit o' a scrap, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%Popping a shoulder back into socket, %brawler2% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, no harm no foul.%SPEECH_OFF%You watch as the two men shake hands and clap one another on the shoulder, each congratulating the other on how nasty their punches were.
4e87047b843f95186b19.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你与弟兄们围坐火旁，火堆对面的争论渐渐高了起来。拳斗者%brawler%站起身，指着自己的胸口哈哈大笑。%SPEECH_ON%你？你觉得能打赢我？%SPEECH_OFF%另一个拳斗者%brawler2%也一跃而起。%SPEECH_ON%打赢你？我能把你打进土里，你这拳头像枕头一样软的蠢货！%SPEECH_OFF%仅仅暗示%brawler%的拳头不是专砸下巴的砖头，就足以引发一场恶斗。两人互相揪住对方，腾出另一只手，接连抡起下勾拳。每一拳都砸得令人心惊。常人挨上这么多下，早该倒了，可你眼前这两个偏偏还站着。你命令弟兄们上前拉架。

%brawler%捏住一侧鼻孔，从另一侧喷出一股血，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%就是切磋两下，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%%brawler2%把脱臼的肩膀接回去，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，不碍事，不伤和气。%SPEECH_OFF%你看着两人握手、拍肩，还互相夸赞对方的拳头有多狠。

19928a580e2eea511dfa.source: That's one way to come together.

89f22614c98d6dbba725.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]%dumb% is perhaps one of the dumbest individuals you've ever met but, for a brief moment, it does appear that %bright% gets through and teaches him a thing or two about critical thinking and memorization. You watch as the two sit together and look over some scrolls. You're not sure where the smart man got such papers, but the unlearning oaf is certainly paying a lot of attention to them.

As you watch, %dumb% is asking rather deep, profound questions. Questions about the land and its relationship to people, and the sky and its relationship to the birds. You slowly realize the idiot is merely glancing around and describing what he's seeing in the sort of 'inquisitive' language %bright% has taught him - namely by attaching a smarmily-intoned question to the end of every sentence. When the two finish up, %bright% comes to you with a grin.%SPEECH_ON%I think we're really getting somewhere with him. He's learning, you know? With students like that, all you gotta do is be patient and take your time.%SPEECH_OFF%A little ways away, %dumb% is pounding ants with a rock. You simply nod and let %bright% live out every teacher's biggest fantasy.
89f22614c98d6dbba725.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]%dumb%大概是你见过最笨的人之一。不过，眼下似乎真有那么一刻，%bright%把道理讲进了他的脑袋，教会了他一点思考和记忆的方法。你看见两人坐在一起，翻看几卷文书。你不清楚那个聪明人从哪儿弄来这些东西，不过这不开窍的笨蛋，确实看得很专心。

你在旁观察，发现%dumb%竟接连提出深奥的问题：土地与人的关系，天空与鸟的关系。慢慢地，你才明白，这傻瓜不过是在环顾四周，把看见的东西套进%bright%教他的“探究”语气里——也就是每说一句话，便自作聪明地添个问句。等两人学完，%bright%笑着来找你。%SPEECH_ON%我觉得他真有长进。他在学，你看出来了吗？这种学生，只要有耐心，慢慢教就行。%SPEECH_OFF%不远处，%dumb%正拿石头砸蚂蚁。你只是点点头，任由%bright%沉浸在每位老师最美好的幻想里。

7b0b311242fe06ad19c0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]While marching down the road, you find a man with a broken cart by the side of the path. By the wagon there is a donkey standing idle and as defeated as a donkey can look. The trader looks a little better than that and your appearance seems to have scared him. He rears up, backing away momentarily.%SPEECH_ON%Have you come to take my things? If so, you needn't kill me. Take what you want.%SPEECH_OFF%
7b0b311242fe06ad19c0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]沿路行军时，你发现路边停着一辆坏车，一个男人守在旁边。车旁的驴呆站着，丧气得几乎不像一头驴。商人的模样也好不到哪去，看见你们，更是吓了一跳，连忙往后退。%SPEECH_ON%你们是来抢东西的？要是这样，用不着杀我，想拿什么就拿吧。%SPEECH_OFF%

de1703ef6aef0b2cad63.source: Men, take everything we can use from the cart!
de1703ef6aef0b2cad63.translation: 弟兄们，车上能用的，全拿走！

b9865f5bfd540758d0f7.source: Let us help you get your cart on the road again.
b9865f5bfd540758d0f7.translation: 我们帮你把车弄回路上。

178f32c09610eb67c9e7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]You disarm the man from his fears and order a few of the %companyname%'s finest to get the wagon back on the road. They make short work of it, the trader looking rather impressed by their efficiency. With his wares back on the road, he offers a few tokens of gratitude right off the wagon itself. These provisions will be useful in the days to come.
178f32c09610eb67c9e7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]你安抚了商人，叫%companyname%里几个最精壮的弟兄把货车弄回路上。他们三两下就办妥了，商人看得满脸佩服。货物终于能继续上路，他当场从车上拿出些东西答谢。这些口粮，往后几天正好用得上。

fd4148198ae77a6aa6e6.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]The merchant is scared in your presence, but you quickly disarm him of his fears. A few brothers are ordered to get the cart back onto the path. They do it as fast as hardy men can, but when it's over one of them cries out and doubles over.

The trader, eyes wide with renewed horror, quickly offers you some provisions as a token of his gratitude. Maybe he thinks you'll punish him for the injuries? Regardless, the supplies will be a welcome addition for the days to come.
fd4148198ae77a6aa6e6.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]商人见到你十分害怕，不过你很快就打消了他的顾虑。你叫几个弟兄把车搬回路上。他们都是壮汉，动作利落得很，可刚忙完，其中一人便痛叫着弯下腰。

商人刚平静下来的眼睛又惊恐地瞪大，连忙送上些口粮表示感谢。或许，他怕你因弟兄受伤而迁怒于他？不管怎样，这些补给在接下来的日子里总用得上。

debdf5388dadaa08f44d.source: I hope it was worth it.

cba61d72d7395787566b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]You order the men to search the cart and take what they can. %randombrother% draws his sword and looks ready to slay the donkey, the animal looking stupidly at its own mortality in the reflection of the blade. The merchant cries out and you hold your hand out, staying the execution.%SPEECH_ON%Leave the draught animal where it stands.%SPEECH_OFF%The trader offers meager thanks as a line of your men walk behind him, his very goods in their hands.
cba61d72d7395787566b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]你命令弟兄们搜车，能拿的都拿走。%randombrother%拔出剑，似乎还想杀掉那头驴。驴呆呆望着刀刃里的倒影，浑然不知死期将至。商人惊叫起来，你抬手叫停。%SPEECH_ON%那牲口留着，别动。%SPEECH_OFF%商人低声道谢，而你的弟兄们正列队从他身后走过，手里抱着他的货物。

865972245f7e4f3cc1b8.source: %terrainImage%You find an abandoned wagon amongst some tall reeds. %randombrother% checks it out and barks back.%SPEECH_ON%It's broke as shit, but I think we can salvage parts of it.%SPEECH_OFF%
865972245f7e4f3cc1b8.translation: %terrainImage%你在高高的芦苇丛中发现一辆废弃货车。%randombrother%上前检查，回头喊道。%SPEECH_ON%烂得没样了，不过还有些零件能拆下来用。%SPEECH_OFF%

e6c9f04339173e082312.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]Swamps are no safe place for a man's travels. Judging by the neverending smog and the way the trees bend, there's little doubt that it's a bubbling domicile for all things demonic. At least that's what the druids of these parts like to say. All you find is a couple of dead horses drowned in the mire and a wagon crushed by the mud which has seeped over its wheels and bed. %randombrother% rifles through the remains and manages to recover some items.%SPEECH_ON%Well, it's something. Whoever left this here left a short while ago. Probably spooked by whatever the hell lives out here in the day-to-day.%SPEECH_OFF%
e6c9f04339173e082312.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]沼泽绝非适合赶路的地方。看那终年不散的雾气和扭曲的树木，谁都会觉得，这里简直是各种邪物栖身的冒泡烂泥窝。至少，这一带的德鲁伊总是这么说。你们实际找到的，却只有几匹淹死在泥里的马，以及一辆被泥沼压坏的货车。泥浆漫过车轮，灌进车厢。%randombrother%翻找残骸，抢救出几件东西。%SPEECH_ON%总算没白找。把车扔在这儿的人，应该刚走不久。八成是被这鬼地方常住的那些东西吓跑了。%SPEECH_OFF%

af9ca1da443fed51eb9c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%Sir, wait.%SPEECH_OFF%The former butcher, %butcher%, says. He moves on ahead and starts hacking at the corpse of a horse. He cuts out a series of chunks, wraps them in large leaves, dries them with a bit of dirt and salt, and hands them over.%SPEECH_ON%No reason in leaving behind what can be used.%SPEECH_OFF%
af9ca1da443fed51eb9c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%团长，等等。%SPEECH_OFF%曾做屠夫的%butcher%说道。他走上前，开始分割一匹马的尸体，切下几块肉，用大叶子裹好，又抹上些土和盐，吸去水分，随后递了过来。%SPEECH_ON%还能用的东西，没道理就这么扔下。%SPEECH_OFF%

e052756944031817e82a.source: And you're sure this is edible still?

826e890b485b57313f46.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]You find %butcher% the butcher tracing a finger along %flagellant%'s unclothed back. He finds a point between the sinews and scars and taps it.%SPEECH_ON%Here. If you strike yourself here, the largest amount of meat - I mean muscle, will be hit.%SPEECH_OFF%The flagellant looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Will it be painful?%SPEECH_OFF%A grin crosses the butcher's face.%SPEECH_ON%Oh yes, very much so.%SPEECH_OFF%It appears the man is giving the flagellant pointers on how to mark himself up. Before you can step in, %flagellant% takes up a whip and hits himself right where %butcher% had directed him to. The tendrils of leather, glass, and sharpened bone snap against the man's back, dig in, and then upon retrieval tear his flesh asunder.
826e890b485b57313f46.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]你发现屠夫%butcher%正用手指沿着%flagellant%裸露的后背摸索。他在筋肉与伤疤之间找准一点，轻轻敲了敲。%SPEECH_ON%这儿。往这儿抽，能打着最多的肉——我是说，肌肉。%SPEECH_OFF%苦修者抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%会很疼吗？%SPEECH_OFF%屠夫咧嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%哦，当然。疼得很。%SPEECH_OFF%看来，这人正在指导苦修者如何更好地伤害自己。你还没来得及阻止，%flagellant%便抄起鞭子，正抽在%butcher%指点的位置。皮条、碎玻璃与尖骨一起劈上后背，深深咬入，再被猛地扯回，撕开一片血肉。

57a5b73abc343d459e18.source: Why the hell would you show him that?

cc44c33811ab83f1e2b8.source: Took pleasure from someone else's pain
cc44c33811ab83f1e2b8.translation: 从别人的痛苦中得到乐趣

69580f1e99369512047a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You hear a yelp and quickly rush to the noise. When you get there, you're not sure whether it was man or dog that produced it. %butcher% the butcher is holding a cleaver up and a wardog is rearing beneath him, both sides ready to lunge. The man sees you and quickly sweeps the weapon behind his back. The hound takes a squat and throws some puppy eyes your way. Raising an eyebrow, you try not to make sense of the scene.%SPEECH_ON%Play nice now.%SPEECH_OFF%The butcher scoffs.%SPEECH_ON%Oy', me and the bitch were just having a talk that's all.%SPEECH_OFF%
69580f1e99369512047a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你听见一声尖叫，赶忙循声跑去。到了近前，却分不清刚才叫的是人还是狗。屠夫%butcher%举着剁肉刀，一条战犬在他面前龇牙，两边都摆着随时扑上去的架势。那人看见你，立刻把刀藏到背后；狗也蹲下来，冲你露出可怜巴巴的眼神。你挑挑眉，懒得深究眼前这一幕。%SPEECH_ON%都老实点，别闹。%SPEECH_OFF%屠夫嗤了一声。%SPEECH_ON%嗨，我跟这狗娘们说两句话罢了。%SPEECH_OFF%

b06ed25043a8d4d57531.source: Didn't get along with the company's wardogs
b06ed25043a8d4d57531.translation: 与战团的战犬相处不睦

1bc17c4c119bddc08924.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You open a crate of food to find the last of your reserves. An apple rolls across the bottom, sounding not unlike the grumble of an empty stomach as it totters about. A few loaves of bread give it some company and there is a piece of meat wrapped in a thick leaf. That's it.

When you close the lid and turn around, %butcher% the butcher is standing there.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there boss. I see we got a problem. So how about I... fix it?%SPEECH_OFF%Just then, he thumbs over his shoulder, right in the direction of two war dogs chained up to a stake.
1bc17c4c119bddc08924.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你打开粮箱，看到了最后一点储备。一只苹果在箱底滚来滚去，咕噜作响，像极了空肚子的抱怨。旁边还有几块面包，以及一块裹在厚叶子里的肉。就这些了。

你合上箱盖，转过身，屠夫%butcher%正站在面前。%SPEECH_ON%头儿，看样子咱们遇上麻烦了。要不，让我……解决一下？%SPEECH_OFF%说着，他用拇指朝身后一指，正对着拴在木桩上的两条战犬。

1eba2baab90436e8d4a3.source: I will not have our trusty hounds be butchered and eaten.
1eba2baab90436e8d4a3.translation: 我不会让忠心的战犬被宰来吃。

f02174e773406646718b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]The dogs are sitting rather studiously, panting and looking pretty content, so durable is their sense of happiness. But you've mouths to feed and battles to fight. You give %butcher% the go ahead to do what is right for the company.

The butcher meanders his way toward the mutts, holding out one hand to pet them as the other clutches a knife behind his back. You do not stick around to watch what happens next, but a short yelp quickly followed by another turns your already empty stomach.
f02174e773406646718b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]狗儿们乖乖坐着，吐舌喘气，一副心满意足的模样。它们的快乐，似乎总那么牢靠。可你还有人要喂，还有仗要打。你准许%butcher%动手，做对战团有利的事。

屠夫慢慢走向那几条狗，一只手伸出去抚摸，另一只手把刀藏在背后。你没留下看接下来的一幕，可一声短促的哀叫之后，紧接着又是一声，仍让你本就空着的胃翻腾起来。

3769f8a610ee1f045cd3.source: At least the men won't go hungry tonight.
3769f8a610ee1f045cd3.translation: 至少今晚弟兄们不用挨饿了。

d1a74ee3142345b8f12f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You shake your head no.%SPEECH_ON%Absolutely not. They are as part of the company as any man, and certainly some men would rather starve than eat their own.%SPEECH_OFF%The butcher shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%They're just dogs, sir. Mutts. Mongrels. Ain't nothing but a beast that knows its name and little else. There are plenty of pups to find when we need them.%SPEECH_OFF%Again, you shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%We're not killing the dogs, %butcher%. And don't think I don't see the glint in your eye. There's more to slaughtering them animals than just feeding a few mouths.%SPEECH_OFF%%butcher% can only shrug again.%SPEECH_ON%I can't pick and choose what gives me pleasure, sir, but I'll follow yer orders.%SPEECH_OFF%
d1a74ee3142345b8f12f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你摇头拒绝。%SPEECH_ON%绝对不行。它们跟任何一个弟兄一样，都是战团的一员。肯定有人宁愿挨饿，也不肯吃自己的同伴。%SPEECH_OFF%屠夫耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%团长，不过是狗罢了。杂毛狗，野种。除了认得自己的名字，什么也不懂的畜生。往后需要，幼崽到处都能找。%SPEECH_OFF%你再次摇头。%SPEECH_ON%狗不能杀，%butcher%。也别以为我没看见你眼里那点兴奋。你想宰它们，可不只是为了填几张嘴。%SPEECH_OFF%%butcher%只好又耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%什么事能让我快活，也不是我能选的，团长。不过，我听命令。%SPEECH_OFF%

9ccea1c47aa07a08caf2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]While you expect the men you hire to leave their old lives behind, sometimes it is not so. It appears that %caravanhand% and %raider% are well acquainted: the caravan hand once dealt with the raider personally in some sort of battle that ended with no victors. Now they seek to finish what they'd started long ago, the two tumbling about on the ground, throwing punches and elbows and some spit if an eye or cheek calls for it. You separate the two yourself, pulling them apart and making it quite clear that they are sellswords now, not enemies. You force the two to shake hands and they do so. The caravan hand nods.%SPEECH_ON%Nice left, %raider%.%SPEECH_OFF%The raider nods back, wiping away a bit of blood running clear of his nose.%SPEECH_ON%Yer stronger than I remember.%SPEECH_OFF%The two men go off together to get fixed up, going as men do, their troubles so easily left behind.
9ccea1c47aa07a08caf2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你指望招来的弟兄能把过去抛在身后，可有时偏偏做不到。%caravanhand%与%raider%显然早就认识：商队杂工曾在一场没分出胜负的交锋中，亲手与这位劫掠者过过招。如今，两人打算把旧账算完。他们在地上翻滚，拳头、肘子轮番招呼，瞅见眼睛和脸颊，也不忘啐上一口。你亲自把他们拽开，说得再明白不过：现在你们是一起拿钱打仗的弟兄，不再是仇敌。你逼两人握手，他们照办了。商队杂工点点头。%SPEECH_ON%左拳不错，%raider%。%SPEECH_OFF%劫掠者抹去鼻下的鲜血，也点点头。%SPEECH_ON%你比我记得的更有劲了。%SPEECH_OFF%两人结伴去处理伤处。男人有时就是这样，打过一场，旧怨便轻易丢在身后。

abb290a750694b3ac0ed.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]While you expect the men you hire to leave their old lives behind, sometimes it is not so. It appears that %caravanhand% and %raider% are well acquainted: the caravan hand once dealt with the nomad raider personally in some sort of battle that ended with no victors. Now they seek to finish what they'd started long ago, the two tumbling about on the ground, throwing punches and elbows and some spit if an eye or cheek calls for it. You separate the two yourself, pulling them apart and making it quite clear that they are sellswords now, not enemies. You force the two to shake hands and they do so. The caravan hand nods.%SPEECH_ON%Nice left, %raider%.%SPEECH_OFF%The nomad nods back, wiping away a bit of blood running clear of his nose.%SPEECH_ON%Yer stronger than I remember.%SPEECH_OFF%The two men go off together to get fixed up, going as men do, their troubles so easily left behind.
abb290a750694b3ac0ed.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你指望招来的弟兄能把过去抛在身后，可有时偏偏做不到。%caravanhand%与%raider%显然早就认识：商队杂工曾在一场没分出胜负的交锋中，亲手与这位游牧劫掠者过过招。如今，两人打算把旧账算完。他们在地上翻滚，拳头、肘子轮番招呼，瞅见眼睛和脸颊，也不忘啐上一口。你亲自把他们拽开，说得再明白不过：现在你们是一起拿钱打仗的弟兄，不再是仇敌。你逼两人握手，他们照办了。商队杂工点点头。%SPEECH_ON%左拳不错，%raider%。%SPEECH_OFF%游牧民抹去鼻下的鲜血，也点点头。%SPEECH_ON%你比我记得的更有劲了。%SPEECH_OFF%两人结伴去处理伤处。男人有时就是这样，打过一场，旧怨便轻易丢在身后。

33ad1f8fd40d9e46a853.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]You come across the once-caravan hand, %caravanhand%, finicking with the company wagon. He's nailing a slat of board to the bed and using pins to put it on a roller. The board can then drop down into the belly of the wagon with a little bit of a pull and switch. Rather ingenious. This will allow you to load more onto the wagon.
33ad1f8fd40d9e46a853.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]你发现曾做商队杂工的%caravanhand%正在摆弄战团的货车。他往车厢底部钉上一块木板，又用销钉把它装到滚轴上。只需拉动一下，再拨开卡榫，木板便能落进车腹。构思相当巧妙，这下货车能装更多东西了。

42a161a6b5322648926a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You find a boy and girl looking up a tree. The girl throws her hands up.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, stay there until you die! See if I care!%SPEECH_OFF%The boy, spotting you, asks if perhaps you could help them get their cat out of the tree. Looking up, you do see a feline flopped over a branch, basking in the sun.
42a161a6b5322648926a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你看见一个男孩和一个女孩正仰头望树。女孩举起双手，气呼呼地喊。%SPEECH_ON%行啊，你就待在上面，待到死好了！看我管不管你！%SPEECH_OFF%男孩看见你，问你能不能帮忙把猫从树上弄下来。抬头一看，果然有只猫懒洋洋地瘫在树枝上晒太阳。

61689e92267261c04c9d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%archer% nocks an arrow and sticks his tongue out as he aims up the tree. The girl and boy don't seem fond of this idea and clap their hands over their eyes.
