The archer looses the shot and it cracks against the cat's branch, breaking it and sending the cat cartwheeling down the tree like a game of devil sticks. When it hits the ground, the boy and girl lunge on it. They pet it and thank you for your troubles. The girl squeezes the cat warmly.%SPEECH_ON%Finally, we got ourselves something to eat!%SPEECH_OFF%
61689e92267261c04c9d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%archer%搭上箭，吐着舌头，抬头瞄向树梢。两个孩子似乎不怎么赞成这个主意，连忙用手捂住眼睛。弓手一箭射出，正中猫栖着的树枝。枝条应声折断，猫像杂耍用的花棍一样，翻着跟头一路滚下树来。刚一落地，男孩和女孩就扑了过去。他们摸着猫，感谢你费心相助。女孩亲热地抱紧它。%SPEECH_ON%总算有东西吃啦！%SPEECH_OFF%

7f5b5ef5760b8b587525.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%archer% readies himself, nocking an arrow and taking aim. The cat purrs as it stares down the line of the shot, rather sublime in its suicidal stance. Closing one eye, the archer lets the arrow fly. There isn't much mewling to be had. The cat tumbles down the tree like a game of devil sticks and lands on the ground with an arrow shaft halfway out its head. The girl crouches down and stares at the slinky bit of brain wobbling off the arrowtip. She looks up at you, as though it were you who fired the shot.%SPEECH_ON%That was my friend.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell her you're sorry and that she'll find more friends. As for the boy, he pockets the bit of brain and slings the cat carcass over his shoulder. He bleakly states.%SPEECH_ON%At least we've somethin' to eat now.%SPEECH_OFF%
7f5b5ef5760b8b587525.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%archer%做好准备，搭箭瞄准。猫正对着箭路，喉间还发出咕噜声，那副自寻死路的姿态，竟显得颇为超然。弓手闭上一只眼，松开弦。猫几乎没来得及叫，就像杂耍花棍般沿着树枝翻滚而下，落在地上，箭杆半截穿出了脑袋。女孩蹲下来，盯着箭尖上晃荡的那点脑浆，随后抬头看你，仿佛箭是你射的。%SPEECH_ON%它是我的朋友。%SPEECH_OFF%你向她道歉，说她还会交到别的朋友。男孩则把那点脑浆揣进兜里，将猫尸扛上肩，闷闷地说道。%SPEECH_ON%至少现在有东西吃了。%SPEECH_OFF%

654e5e3b40b4d805425d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%ratcatcher% snaps his fingers.%SPEECH_ON%Oy, I'veuhplan! You little runts just wait a moment!%SPEECH_OFF%The rat catcher takes a rat out of his pocket you'd no idea he even had. Chirping his lips like a mewling cat himself, he holds the little rodent up. The cat takes notice, perking its ears.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah that's right you pussy, c'mon down, it's lunch time.%SPEECH_OFF%The rat catcher brings the rat to his lips and whispers.%SPEECH_ON%No it's not, heheh.%SPEECH_OFF%As the cat descends, %ratcatcher% holds his friend out a little more. It begins to scrape and scuttle against his hands, perhaps not trusting its master to keep it. But the moment the cat lunges for the meal, the rat catcher pockets the rat and snags the cat all in one swift motion. The children clap and cheer as he hands the cat over. Even some of the men are impressed by the fella's feline-like reflexes!
654e5e3b40b4d805425d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%ratcatcher%一打响指。%SPEECH_ON%嗨，我有办法！你们几个小鬼，等着瞧！%SPEECH_OFF%捕鼠人从口袋里掏出一只老鼠——你甚至不知道他还随身带着这东西。他噘起嘴，学猫轻叫，把小小的啮齿动物举了起来。树上的猫顿时竖起耳朵。%SPEECH_ON%对啦，小猫咪，下来吧，开饭了。%SPEECH_OFF%捕鼠人又把老鼠凑到嘴边，悄声说道。%SPEECH_ON%才怪，嘿嘿。%SPEECH_OFF%猫开始往下爬，%ratcatcher%便把小伙伴再往外递一点。老鼠在他手里乱抓乱蹬，似乎不太相信主人会保护自己。可猫刚扑向食物，捕鼠人便一气呵成：把老鼠塞回口袋，同时一把抓住猫。孩子们拍手欢呼，从他手里接过猫。连几个弟兄也被他这猫一般的敏捷身手折服了！

28861a5b23ef0976183e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You bluntly tell the kids they should get a dog and make your leave.
28861a5b23ef0976183e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你直截了当地告诉孩子们：改养条狗吧。随后便离开了。

5ff10d5dc56f99aa14cf.source: The cat doesn't wanna be your friend anyway.
5ff10d5dc56f99aa14cf.translation: 反正那猫也没想跟你交朋友。

4388e0933ed08e501c10.source: %archerfull%, try to knock it down with an arrow?

632d120fb328032d2e9d.source: Accidentally shot a little girl's pet cat
632d120fb328032d2e9d.translation: 失手射杀了小女孩的宠物猫

a7b7bd7af7b9ef5763fa.translation: 凭敏捷的身手赢得众人赞叹

d8232b5f58f59a41e066.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]While on the path, you come across a small army of children. The oldest and biggest amongst them is probably fifteen at most with a tussled crop of orange hair and a spear for a weapon. He's leading the troop, a little fighting force provincial to the path more than any town or city. As they cross paths with you, this little leader tips his head at you.%SPEECH_ON%Make way! We are on a righteous march and shan't be stopped!%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask where it is they are off to. The kid answers as though incredulous you don't know.%SPEECH_ON%Well let me tell you, sellsword. We are heading north through the frozen wastes. Uncultured and uncivilized tribes need to hear of the old gods, either by the word or by the sword.%SPEECH_OFF%He lifts the spear. A rather chirpy 'warcry' is raised from the army. It appears some religious fervor has taken ahold of this wandering and harmless, and therefore suicidal, group.
d8232b5f58f59a41e066.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]路上，你遇见一支小小的童子军。领头的是其中年纪最大、个头最高的，顶多十五岁，一头乱蓬蓬的橘色头发，拿着长矛。这支小队伍看着更像归这条路管，压根不像隶属哪座城镇。与你们迎面相逢，小头领抬起下巴。%SPEECH_ON%让路！我们奉行正义之征，谁也不许阻拦！%SPEECH_OFF%你有些好奇，问他们要去哪儿。孩子回答得十分诧异，仿佛你本该知道。%SPEECH_ON%听好了，佣兵。我们要往北，穿过冰封的荒原。那些不知礼数、不通文明的部落，必须听闻旧神的名号。能讲道理，就讲道理；讲不通，就用刀剑。%SPEECH_OFF%他举起长矛，小小的军队发出一阵尖细的“战吼”。看来，宗教狂热已经攫住了这群四处游荡、毫无威胁，也因此等同于自寻死路的孩子。

f06e4588c90da6071cfd.source: You ought to go home to your parents, kids.
f06e4588c90da6071cfd.translation: 孩子们，你们该回家找父母了。

0fe9af37942f6a222f12.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You tell the kids to go home to their parents. The leader laughs and the others follow suit, like little 'uns easily impressed by their big brother. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Why do you think we've come this far? Our parents know right where we are, and they know where we are is truthfully right. The old gods need to be known throughout the land! Now, make way!%SPEECH_OFF%The kids press forth. A little banner flaps past you and there is much clinking and clanking of their little weapons, mostly bottles and sling shots and tableware.

 No doubt they are marching toward certain doom. Raiders and vagabonds are sure to prey upon them, like hawks upon lemmings, and slaves don't mind making ostensibly orphaned children 'disappear.' Were they to get further than those threats, the northern wastes will provide for them a frozen coffin to die in.
0fe9af37942f6a222f12.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你叫孩子们回家找父母。小头领笑了，其他孩子也跟着笑，活像一群轻易就被大哥哥带动的小不点。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%你以为，我们为什么能走到这里？父母知道我们在哪儿，也知道我们走的是正道。旧神的名号，必须传遍大地！现在，让路！%SPEECH_OFF%孩子们继续向前。一面小旗从你身边飘过，他们的小小兵器叮当作响——大多是瓶子、弹弓和餐具。

毫无疑问，他们正走向必死的结局。劫掠者和游荡的恶徒会像鹰扑旅鼠一样捕食他们，奴隶贩子也不介意让几个看似无家可归的孩子“消失”。即使侥幸躲过这些危险，北方荒原也会为他们备好一口冰冷的棺材。

b752a68bd09d29dfe2d8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%monk% the monk steps forward and brings the children to a huddle. They instantly respect the man, for he represents in part the very cause they wish to promote. He bends a knee.%SPEECH_ON%Was it the old gods who told you to come out and do this?%SPEECH_OFF%The little leader nods.%SPEECH_ON%They spoke to me in my sleep.%SPEECH_OFF%The monk nods back, rubbing his chin and mulling it over. He pats the boy on his head.%SPEECH_ON%The old gods speak to me and I for them. Interpreting their message requires years of study, let me tell ya! Are you certain that it was you, little one, that was meant to carry this burden? Perhaps you were to be the messenger, no? See us, we're warriors. Fit, fighting men who can kill those who despise and demark the old gods. You are not yet like us, but you have a strong voice and the command of a true leader yet. I believe the old gods wanted to use you for your charisma, not your muscles.%SPEECH_OFF%The monk gives the boy a playful push. He smiles, realizing the truth of what the friar has to say. The little leader tells his party that they are to return home as the monk is assuredly right. Some men are thankful that these kids were talked out of going to a certain doom.
b752a68bd09d29dfe2d8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]修士%monk%走上前，把孩子们聚拢过来。孩子们立刻对他肃然起敬，毕竟他多少代表着他们想宣扬的信仰。他屈下一膝，蹲到孩子们面前。%SPEECH_ON%是旧神叫你们出来做这件事的吗？%SPEECH_OFF%小头领点点头。%SPEECH_ON%他们在梦里跟我说的。%SPEECH_OFF%修士也点点头，捋着下巴思索片刻，随后摸摸男孩的头。%SPEECH_ON%旧神也对我说话，我也替他们传言。要读懂神意，可得钻研好多年呢！孩子，你确定，他们是要你亲自挑起这副担子吗？或许，你该做的是传递消息，对不对？你看我们，都是战士，身强体健，会打仗，能杀死那些轻蔑、诋毁旧神的人。你还没长成我们这样，可你的声音有力量，也已经懂得像个真正的领袖那样带领别人。我相信，旧神想借重的是你的号召力，而不是你的胳膊。%SPEECH_OFF%修士打趣地轻推男孩一下。男孩笑了，明白这番话在理。他告诉同伴，修士说得对，大家该回家了。有些弟兄很感激修士，毕竟这些孩子总算被劝离了那条必死之路。

979b8583250dd238ddaf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%walker% takes his boots off and show the bottom of his feet to the children. They recoil, gagging and covering their mouths. A little girl lets out a long 'ewww' to really drive the point home. The man wags his foot around, showing off disgustingly calloused skin.%SPEECH_ON%I spent years on the road and most of them without a good shoe to step with. I know what it's like out there. I've seen the dangers. People stabbing one another in their sleep. Killing for a bite of a biscuit. Strangers befriend ya so they can betray ya. And all that is when it's going well! When it goes bad, it gets... well, it gets real bad. You kids got no business being out here. You'll be raped, murdered, enslaved, tortured, fed to dogs, eaten by boars, bears, wolves, all things that look at ya like it's lunchtime on two legs. Go home. The lot of you.%SPEECH_OFF%The band of children murmurs amongst themselves. One announces he's going back to his mom. A little girl states that she didn't even want to be out here anyway and never got the treats she was promised. Sensing a morale break, the little leader tries to corral the children, but it's no use. The group breaks apart and, thankfully, starts going home. Some of the men are relieved as they did not wish to see the little ones continue their doomed journey.
979b8583250dd238ddaf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%walker%脱下靴子，把脚底亮给孩子们看。他们纷纷后缩，捂嘴作呕。一个小女孩拖长声音“咦”了一声，更添几分嫌恶。那人晃着脚，展示满是厚茧的皮肤。%SPEECH_ON%我在路上过了好多年，大半时候连双像样的鞋都没有。我知道外头是什么样，也见过那些危险。有人趁别人睡觉捅刀子，有人为一口饼杀人。陌生人跟你交朋友，只是为了找机会害你。这都还算好的！真要坏起来，那就……坏透了。你们这些孩子，根本不该在外头乱跑。会被强暴、被杀、被卖作奴隶、被折磨、被拿去喂狗，还会被野猪、熊和狼吃掉。它们看见你们，就像看见两条腿走路的午饭。回家去。一个不落。%SPEECH_OFF%孩子们开始低声议论。一个说要回去找妈妈，一个小女孩说自己本来就不想来，答应给她的零嘴也没拿到。眼见人心散了，小头领还想收拢队伍，却毫无用处。孩子们散开，幸好，都是朝家里去了。有些弟兄松了口气，他们实在不愿看这些小家伙继续走向绝路。

089a4bdc7c3ebe463a90.source: You should probably get those feet looked at.
089a4bdc7c3ebe463a90.translation: 你那双脚，恐怕也该找人看看了。

9fb1dbff49a765d0c87b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You doubt that you can talk the fervor out of these kids, but if your pop's parenting is anything to go by you can probably beat it out of them. With a swift order, you have the company set upon the kids, knocking them around and taking their stuff. The little leader tries to spear a sellsword and gets cold cocked for his troubles.

 This isn't the prettiest of things to do and it'd look really bad if anyone saw the company beating up children, but this 'end' to their crusade is preferable to the nastier sorts that await them on the road.
9fb1dbff49a765d0c87b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你怀疑光靠说教，劝不散这些孩子的狂热。不过，照你爹当年的教养法子，打大概是打得散的。你一声令下，弟兄们便扑上去，把孩子们推搡打倒，夺走随身东西。小头领还想举矛刺向一名佣兵，结果挨了一记重拳，当场昏了过去。

这事做得并不好看。若有人瞧见战团殴打孩子，名声肯定糟透了。可相比他们在路上迟早遇到的种种恶事，这场远征以这样的方式“收场”，总归更好些。

bdb515f65a3a8645f4fb.source: %monk%, you speak for the old gods. What say you?
bdb515f65a3a8645f4fb.translation: %monk%，你替旧神传言。这事你怎么看？

850b0ff65bcba4dbc281.source: %walker%, you've travelled up there. Say something.

5087eaa5b4cc5c09a7d3.source: I'll save you the long walk and rid you of any valuables right here.
5087eaa5b4cc5c09a7d3.translation: 省得你们白跑一趟，值钱的东西现在就交出来吧。

ec2eea872d1a8029eb48.source: Saved some children from certain doom
ec2eea872d1a8029eb48.translation: 救下了一群险些送命的孩子

7a0f98327d4478be8afc.translation: 救下了一群险些送命的孩子

97970408291306f4e80a.source: Was appalled by your order to rob children
97970408291306f4e80a.translation: 因你下令抢劫孩子而震惊

e7f76bef186f955bed85.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]While joining the company at a campfire, %cocky% stands up and speaks with reddened face.%SPEECH_ON%I don't know about the rest of you sad clods, but I think I could run this camp better than anyone! Especially better than him!%SPEECH_OFF%He points a finger at you.

You take a seat. The men are staring at you, waiting for a response.
e7f76bef186f955bed85.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你来到营火旁，与弟兄们待在一起。%cocky%忽然站起来，满脸通红地开口。%SPEECH_ON%你们这些可怜虫怎么想，我不知道。反正我觉得，这营地交给我，肯定比谁都管得好！尤其比他强！%SPEECH_OFF%他伸手指向你。

你坐下来。弟兄们都盯着你，等你回应。

958ad80b746a63a86cab.source: You're totally right. You should be in charge.
958ad80b746a63a86cab.translation: 你说得对极了。该由你来当团长。

5ea8e2f40564cfc87839.source: Time to cut you down to size.
5ea8e2f40564cfc87839.translation: 该让你知道自己几斤几两了。

f5f902df5945fa1f7e24.source: I'm in charge here! This is my company!
f5f902df5945fa1f7e24.translation: 这里我说了算！这是我的战团！

1779540fb8a76d42584f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]You kick your feet out, legs akimbo, and place your hands in your lap. Nodding, you speak to the man.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, %cocky%. You're the man now. You gotta count inventory every morning and night. I know you can't count for shite, but you'll learn. Don't want these fine men going into battle a few arrows short.%SPEECH_OFF%You throw a hand out to a few of the tents.%SPEECH_ON%You'll also need to keep a steady count on your people. They're not easily controlled, to which you might find some irony - or not.%SPEECH_OFF%Looking at your hands, which have grown calloused and bruised over the days, you keep talking.%SPEECH_ON%And you'll need to bark orders that aren't just there to be heard - but there to keep men alive and breathing. You know, like yourself and those who sit around you. So yeah, take the job, %cocky%. It's yours.%SPEECH_OFF%As soon as you finish, a group of brothers immediately stands up and begs for you to remain in charge. %cocky%, seeing this, backs down and slinks away as yells of 'you're in charge!' fill the air.
1779540fb8a76d42584f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你舒展双腿，把手放在膝上，点着头对那人说道。%SPEECH_ON%好啊，%cocky%。现在你当家。每天早晚，你都得清点物资。我知道你数数一塌糊涂，不过可以学。总不能让这些好弟兄上战场时，才发现少了几支箭。%SPEECH_OFF%你抬手指了指几顶帐篷。%SPEECH_ON%你还得随时管好手下。他们可不好管，这话听起来是不是有点讽刺——也许你听不出来。%SPEECH_OFF%你低头看看那双日渐长满老茧、遍布瘀伤的手，继续说。%SPEECH_ON%还有，下命令不能光图喊得响，得让弟兄们活下来，喘着气回来。比如你，还有围在你身边这些人。所以，接任吧，%cocky%。这差事归你了。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚说完，一群弟兄便立刻站起来，恳请你继续领队。%cocky%见状，泄了气，悄悄溜走。四下满是“还是你来当家”的呼声。

c43812eb2c2664e4733b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]The campfire crackles an orange glow across your face. Nodding, you stand up and walk up to %cocky%. He takes a step back, but not before you throw a hand out and grab him by the shoulder. You quickly step forward, scissoring a leg back behind his knee, buckling him and throwing him onto his back. You follow him to the ground and there plant one hand around his throat while the other points an accusing finger.%SPEECH_ON%You're a good man %cocky%, but a stupid one, too. Now, I see some of y'all aren't happy about how things are going, but let me remind you that you are all still alive! If someone like %cocky% was in charge you'd all be dead in a fortnight!%SPEECH_OFF%Standing up, you actually help %cocky% to his feet. He sneers at you and takes off, kicking a stack of barrels over as he leaves. A wave of pain eminates from where the arrow hit you not long ago, but you clench your teeth and try not to give away anything as you sit down again.
c43812eb2c2664e4733b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]营火噼啪作响，橙光映着你的脸。你点点头，站起身，走到%cocky%面前。他想后退，却已被你一把抓住肩膀。你迅速上步，用腿别住他的膝弯，把人掀翻在地。你跟着压下去，一只手扼住他的喉咙，另一只手指着他斥责。%SPEECH_ON%你是条好汉，%cocky%，可也是个蠢货。我知道，有些人对眼下的日子不满意。可别忘了，你们都还活着！要是换成%cocky%这样的人领队，半个月内就得死个精光！%SPEECH_OFF%你站起身，竟又伸手把%cocky%拉了起来。他冲你冷笑，转身走开，临走还踢翻了一摞木桶。前些日子中箭的伤处传来阵阵疼痛，你咬紧牙，若无其事地重新坐下。

0b11086b480b16606b33.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]You immediately jump back to your feet and begin shouting.%SPEECH_ON%I'm the one in charge here! Me! Who has the money? Me! If it weren't for me, none of y'all would even be here! You'd still be in the pits of whatever old lives you had! You should be groveling before my feet for the opportunities I have provided! And %cocky%, if you contest me again I swear to the gods I will have you flogged and hanged, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%The outburst instantly quiets the camp. %cocky% nods and backs away. A few of the men murmur between themselves as you take your seat again.
0b11086b480b16606b33.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你立刻跳起来，放声怒吼。%SPEECH_ON%这里我说了算！是我！谁掏的钱？我！没有我，你们能在这儿？早就还在从前那摊烂泥里打滚了！我给你们活路，你们就该趴在我脚边道谢！还有你，%cocky%，再敢跟我叫板，我向诸神发誓，先抽你鞭子，再把你吊死，听懂了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%这一通怒喝，瞬间让营地鸦雀无声。%cocky%点点头，退了下去。你重新落座时，几个弟兄开始低声嘀咕。

818a582657bbd00cb3f3.source: Felt humiliated in front of the company

a2e24a396a2411982c12.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]As you roll up some maps and put them back in their panniers, a commotion draws you outside your tent. The men are dragging %cocky% across the ground. His clothes are sopping wet and his face one shade short of death. The men give him some good slaps on the cheeks. Eventually, he wakes up, eyes wild, mouth gargling water like a broken fountain. He looks around and asks what you, too, wish to know.%SPEECH_ON%What happened?%SPEECH_OFF%%ironlungs% walks over, a similarly wet visage, but with a far more colorful complexion.%SPEECH_ON%You cocky cunt dared to see which of us could hold their breath the longest. You lost because they don't call these the iron lungs for nuttin'.%SPEECH_OFF%The men have a laugh as %ironlungs% boastfully pounds his chest. %cocky%, still wobbly, gets to his feet. Mere moments after being completely unconscious, he's already back to his prideful ways.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah yeah, you bested me this day, but I shall be the best, just you wait!%SPEECH_OFF%Another sellsword whimsically points out that the cocksure fella has a huge string of snot dangling from his nose. He confidently wipes it away despite the roaring laughter of the company.
a2e24a396a2411982c12.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你正把地图卷好，放回行囊，帐篷外的一阵骚动吸引了你的注意。弟兄们正拖着%cocky%从地上过来。他衣服湿透，脸色惨白得离死人只差一线。众人朝他脸上狠狠拍了几下，他总算醒了，双眼乱转，嘴里像坏喷泉一样往外呛水。他环顾四周，问出你也想问的话。%SPEECH_ON%怎么回事？%SPEECH_OFF%%ironlungs%走过来，也是满身湿透，气色却好得多。%SPEECH_ON%你这自大的混蛋，非要跟我比谁憋气久。你输了，我这铁肺可不是白叫的。%SPEECH_OFF%%ironlungs%得意地拍着胸口，弟兄们一阵哄笑。%cocky%摇摇晃晃地站起身。才从昏迷里醒来片刻，那股傲气就又回来了。%SPEECH_ON%行，行，今天算你赢。可迟早我才是最强的，等着瞧！%SPEECH_OFF%另一个佣兵打趣地指出，这位自信满满的好汉，鼻子下还挂着一长条鼻涕。尽管战团笑得前仰后合，他仍昂着头，把鼻涕一抹。

6b639e25cd891f1ac19f.source: Ah, the always safe measurement of manliness.
6b639e25cd891f1ac19f.translation: 又是在比谁更像男人，真是“稳妥”。

75cfeadb059de8bfae84.source: Was humiliated in front of the company
75cfeadb059de8bfae84.translation: 当着全团的面受了羞辱

5acc308fb22d1802afd2.translation: 看得很尽兴，逗乐他的是

cad356392d7139c63169.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You step out of your tent to survey the men. A great many of them are freshly hired grunts, nervously buddying up with one another or trying their hand at some of the weapons. %oldguard% comes to your side.%SPEECH_ON%I know what yer thinking. Yer thinking you'd just hired a bunch of meat for a thresher. How about I whip these boys into shape so they don't eat an orcish blade their first go in the field?%SPEECH_OFF%
cad356392d7139c63169.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你走出帐篷，巡视弟兄们。许多人刚刚入伙，有的紧张地找人结伴，有的正笨拙地试用武器。%oldguard%来到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%我知道你在想什么。你觉得自己刚招来一群等着进绞肉机的鲜肉。要不让我好好操练操练他们，免得第一次上阵，就喂了兽人的刀？%SPEECH_OFF%

f07de7abf6d1a89f3ca5.source: Very well, see if you can teach them to fight man against man.
f07de7abf6d1a89f3ca5.translation: 好，教教他们近身交手的本事。

b0063efef6a76a29451c.source: Very well, see that they can put bow and arrow to use.

968f67ea351b23d7704f.source: Very well, get them in shape to carry real armor.
968f67ea351b23d7704f.translation: 好，把他们练得能扛起像样的护甲。

638905ec40670fe1fc35.source: No, they need to keep what little strength they have for battle.
638905ec40670fe1fc35.translation: 不行，他们那点力气得留着打仗。

ea877120e2e665d85113.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%oldguard% tells the recruits to take up weapons. When every single one of them picks up a sword, the old guard yells at them, stating that not every foe hankering for you being graveyard dead is gonna be wielding the exact same blade. A few nod before hurriedly exchanging their swords for axes and spears. With the crew equipped, the training begins. Mostly, %oldguard% teaches basics like how a formation makes it easier to defend not only one another, but also yourself.%SPEECH_ON%Ye need not watch corner-to-corner if ya know a brother is by yer side. But if yer separated, if yer all out there by yer lonesome, then ye might be proper farked lest ye got a heretofore unknown way with a blade which I'll go ahead and assume ye don't.%SPEECH_OFF%The training moves to offense where %oldguard% shows a few tricks with various weapons.%SPEECH_ON%With swords ye can slash, cut, stab, and riposte. Proper-hard to miss with a sword, given every side of it is a killin' side. If I see any of you trying to cut down an arrow with a sword like the fairy tales told ya I'mma beat ya down myself. It ain't true, so stop fancying it!

Spears are good for keeping distance. They won't do much to armor, but they'll keep ya safe. Just point this sharp-end away from ya. If an armored brute gets past this pointy end here then yer probably proper farked so don't let that happen.

Finally, there's the axe. Just pretend the other man is a tree and cleave it so. Now let's practice!%SPEECH_OFF%
ea877120e2e665d85113.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%oldguard%让新兵拿起武器。结果人人都挑了剑，老兵当即开骂：想把你们送进坟地的敌人，可不会全拿一模一样的兵器。几个人连忙点头，换上斧头和长矛。众人装备妥当，训练开始。%oldguard%主要教些基本功，比如怎样结阵，既护住同伴，也更容易保全自己。%SPEECH_ON%知道弟兄就在身边，就不用每个角落都自己盯着。可要是散了阵，孤零零落在外头，那多半就完蛋了。除非你们藏着什么从没露过的绝世剑法——我先当你们没有。%SPEECH_OFF%接着练习进攻，%oldguard%用各种武器演示了几手。%SPEECH_ON%剑能劈、能割、能刺，还能反击。浑身都是伤人的地方，想打偏倒不容易。可谁要学童话里那套，用剑去劈飞来的箭，我先亲手揍翻他。那都是假的，别做梦！

长矛适合把敌人挡远些。对付护甲不怎么顶用，却能保命。尖头朝外就行。要是披重甲的壮汉越过这截尖头，你们多半也就完了，所以千万别让他进来。

最后是斧头。把对面那人当成一棵树，照着砍就是。现在，开练！%SPEECH_OFF%

94a2547493db99e58075.source: Show me what you can do!

0dd0469132609f7e562b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]The training goes fairly well from there, though the men do come out the other side with a few bumps and bruises.
0dd0469132609f7e562b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]之后的训练还算顺利，只是收场时，弟兄们身上免不了多几处肿包和瘀伤。

e918102d6f69ca24f95c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] %oldguard% musters the men together and begins handing them training bows.%SPEECH_ON%Now these ain't made for killing unless ye got an axe to grind with a newborn babe, which I'm sure of y'all do, but for now we'll just use them to practice.

Here's how this contraption works. Oh, ye already know? Yer not a bunch of fools? Well go ahead, then, show me what ye sharpshooters got.%SPEECH_OFF%
e918102d6f69ca24f95c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%oldguard%把弟兄们集合起来，发下训练用弓。%SPEECH_ON%这些弓可杀不了人，除非你们非要跟刚出生的娃娃结仇——我看你们里头还真有这种货色。不过，眼下咱们先拿它们练习。

这玩意儿该这么使。哦，你们已经懂了？不是一群傻子？那就来吧，让我见识见识各位神射手的本事。%SPEECH_OFF%

5e5721750d41879840fb.source: Let's see if you lot can hit anything.
5e5721750d41879840fb.translation: 让我看看，你们这帮家伙到底射不射得中。

6fadc9ea51fbff669b17.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]The men take practiced shots downrange, the arrows peppering all around their targets, a scant few lucky ones going where they should. %oldguard% spends the rest of the day exhaustingly having the men shoot and shoot and shoot until luck is squeezed out of the equation altogether.
6fadc9ea51fbff669b17.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]弟兄们朝远处的靶子练习放箭。箭落得到处都是，只有寥寥几支走运地射中了。%oldguard%用余下的一整天，逼着他们不停地射、再射、继续射，直到命中终于不必再靠运气。

cc65b97e312d17f6731d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%oldguard% looses a sharp whistle, gathering the new recruits around him. He looks around, grinning, then nods.%SPEECH_ON%Alright ye limpdick teatsucking noodlearm goatfarkers, we're going on a march!%SPEECH_OFF%The veteran spends the rest of the day ruthlessly running the recruits as far as he can until the last one drops from exhaustion.%SPEECH_ON%Breathe, little babe, breathe! Take it all in. There's plenty to go around for the rest of us, don't feel bad! Swallow it like yer mother should've swallowed you. Now, I've shot stains that ran faster than the lot of ye, so I'll be seeing y'all again tomorrow on good, proper time. That'd be before the sun rises, shitsticks.%SPEECH_OFF%
cc65b97e312d17f6731d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%oldguard%打了声响亮的唿哨，把新兵召到身边。他环顾一圈，咧嘴点头。%SPEECH_ON%行了，你们这群软蛋、吃奶娃、细胳膊、操羊的货，开拔！%SPEECH_OFF%接下来一整天，老兵毫不留情地赶着新兵长跑，能跑多远跑多远，直到最后一人也累倒。%SPEECH_ON%喘气啊，小崽子，喘气！使劲吸！空气多的是，不会把我们那份吸光，别客气！往肚子里咽，你娘当初就该把你咽了！老子射出去的那点玩意儿，都比你们跑得快。明天准时见，一个也别迟到。所谓准时，就是太阳出来之前，听懂没，你们这群搅屎棍！%SPEECH_OFF%

942e033426d8ef304e34.source: %oldguard% shows little mercy and has the men running again and again in the days to come. After all, he says, it's for their own damn good.
942e033426d8ef304e34.translation: %oldguard%毫不留情，往后几天仍赶着弟兄们一遍遍地跑。他说，归根到底，都是为了这帮小子的好。

ec245a026d1135f19e7e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]While on the road, you come across a crowd of people huddled around a mound of earth. Getting closer, you realize that it's a funeral. One of the attendees turns to look at you.%SPEECH_ON%Did you know him? Did you fight by his side?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head and start cutting into the crowd to see the man himself. You find a man looking about as old as the dead can look. He's got a terrifically sharp and glinting sword running along his chest with his grubby, wormfood fingers clutching the pommel. %randombrother% joins your side and whispers.%SPEECH_ON%That's, uh, a pretty nice lookin' weapon there, just saying.%SPEECH_OFF%
ec245a026d1135f19e7e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]赶路时，你遇到一群围着土堆站立的人。走近才发现，这是一场葬礼。一名送葬者转头问你。%SPEECH_ON%你认识他？曾和他并肩打过仗？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇摇头，挤进人群，想看看死者。他老得几乎到了死人能有的极限。一柄锋利耀眼的长剑横放在胸前，那双肮脏、很快就要喂蛆的手，仍握着剑柄。%randombrother%凑到你身边，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%那把兵器，呃，看着真不错。我就是随口一说。%SPEECH_OFF%

1715f796344de4f0bdbe.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]You draw out your sword and the rest of the company does the same. The mercenaries push the crowd back, but there isn't as much resistance as you expected. One of the attendees steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%It's the sword you want, isn't it? Go on, take it. That there dead man spoke of someone like you. Said you'd need it more than he ever would.%SPEECH_OFF%Sheathing your sword, you ask him if that's why they were all standing around. The man laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Naw, he also said he'd never die, so we were curious to know if that part of his sayings would come true.%SPEECH_OFF%You slowly take the sword, now curious if there was some saying about butchering the man who laid his hands upon it. Thankfully, ostensibly, the mighty dead man said no such thing.
1715f796344de4f0bdbe.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]你拔出剑，弟兄们也随之亮出兵器。佣兵把人群向后逼退，可抵抗远比你预想的少。一名送葬者走上前。%SPEECH_ON%你想要那把剑，是吧？拿去吧。躺着的这位，早提起过你这样的人。他说，你们会比他更需要它。%SPEECH_OFF%你收剑入鞘，问他们围在这里，难道就是为了等这件事。那人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不是。他还说过，自己永远不会死。所以我们想看看，这句话会不会也成真。%SPEECH_OFF%你慢慢拿起剑，心里却开始犯嘀咕：他会不会还说过，要宰掉碰这把剑的人？幸好，至少看起来，这位了不起的死者没留下那样的话。

ac4db9f246c48993b3bd.source: He won't be needing that anymore.

d1c593f1b42bcc982fcf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]You reach through the crowd and grab the dead man's sword. One of the attendees screams out. %randombrother% uncorks a punch and sends the peasant astral planing. The rest of the company draw out their weapons to make sure any further protests don't get far. An elderly woman cuts through the crowd as well as an elderly woman can, wobbling and shaking.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, that don't belong to you. Put it back.%SPEECH_OFF%
d1c593f1b42bcc982fcf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]你从人群中伸手，抓起死者的剑。一名送葬者惊叫出声，%randombrother%抡起一拳，打得那农夫魂飞天外。其余佣兵也拔出兵器，确保接下来不会有人抗议得太过分。一位老妇颤颤巍巍地挤出人群。%SPEECH_ON%先生，那不是你的东西。放回去。%SPEECH_OFF%

bc57191ef9dbcdfdd8d3.source: The crone is right, we shan't disturb the burial any further.
bc57191ef9dbcdfdd8d3.translation: 老太太说得对，别再打扰葬礼了。

b4ceea2476fd7d1e2d65.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]You tell the old lady to crawl her crotchety ass into a hole and die there. The dead man's sword is put in with your inventory and the %companyname% get back on the road.

Upset, the peasants cry out that word of what you'd done would travel the winds like the shitting farts of a thousand cows. You simply laugh and appreciate their imaginativeness.
b4ceea2476fd7d1e2d65.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]你叫那多管闲事的老太婆自己钻个坑，死在里面算了。死者的剑被收入行囊，%companyname%重新上路。

愤怒的农夫们在身后大喊，说你们的恶行会像一千头牛放出的臭屁一样，随风传遍四方。你只是大笑，颇为欣赏他们的想象力。

ea34a56fc1514729df4a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]You put the sword back into the dead man's hands. The old lady nods.%SPEECH_ON%So there are good men who will still listen to the wise.%SPEECH_OFF%Another peasant hails your honor and others follow suit. It appears that simply taking the weapon and then putting it back was enough to warrant a manner of celebratory prestige in the eyes of the laymen. Perhaps you should feign theft more often.
ea34a56fc1514729df4a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]你把剑放回死者手中。老太太点点头。%SPEECH_ON%看来，世上还有肯听明白话的好人。%SPEECH_OFF%另一个农夫称赞你的品行，其余人也跟着附和。看来，在这些平民眼里，拿走兵器，再放回去，就足以赢得一番颂扬。或许，你该多假装抢几次东西。

77dba46e5ffbe152a20d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]It's not a rare sight to find a dead body on your journey. This one, though, is rather unusual. %randombrother% takes a long look.%SPEECH_ON%What's that on his chest?%SPEECH_OFF%You crouch down and throw back the corpse's shirt. Scars run lengthwise all about his body, drawn in very familiar shapes: forests, rivers, mountains. %randombrother% walks up.%SPEECH_ON%Ain't that a sight. Wolves do that or something?%SPEECH_OFF%You stand back up.%SPEECH_ON%I think he did it to himself.%SPEECH_OFF%Bloody footprints lead away from the scene...
77dba46e5ffbe152a20d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]旅途中见到尸体，并不稀奇，可这一具实在古怪。%randombrother%盯着看了许久。%SPEECH_ON%他胸口是什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你蹲下，掀开死者的衣服。长长的伤疤遍布全身，刻出的形状十分眼熟：森林、河流、山脉。%randombrother%走上前。%SPEECH_ON%真邪门。狼咬的，还是别的什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你站起来。%SPEECH_ON%我看，是他自己干的。%SPEECH_OFF%一串带血的脚印，从这里延伸出去……

215947e0e47336dacaae.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]As you follow the foosteps, you begin to hear the murmurs of a chant. You tell the company to rest while you sneak forward, eventually finding a large bonfire with cloaked men circling around it. They stomp their feet and throw their hands up, shouting some token words to their elder god, Davkul. It's a bestial ceremony, roaring and growling abound, and the men dance about with their oversized clothes like darkly spirits still angry at the world they'd departed. %randombrother% crawls up beside you and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Just what is going on down there? What should we do?%SPEECH_OFF%
215947e0e47336dacaae.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]沿脚印前行，你渐渐听见低沉的吟诵声。你让战团停下，自己悄悄上前，终于看见一大堆篝火，披袍的人们围着它转圈。他们跺脚、举手，向那古老的神祇达夫库尔高喊着仪式用语。这场典礼满是兽性，咆哮与低吼此起彼伏。人们裹着宽大的衣袍舞动，像一群死后仍怨恨人间的幽魂。%randombrother%爬到你身边，摇着头问。%SPEECH_ON%底下到底在搞什么？咱们该怎么办？%SPEECH_OFF%

2649a3a7ca43e91329d9.source: We need to stop this now. Attack!
2649a3a7ca43e91329d9.translation: 不能再让他们继续了。进攻！

f0965a02e152b8cd090e.source: Let's wait and see what happens.

b04d4d6e83db54b8ecf4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]You decide to wait it out and see what happens. Just as you say that, the cultists drag an old man before the fire. He bows his head before the flames, opens his arms, and then falls in. There are no screams. Another man is pulled forward. He whispers words to a cultist, they both nod, and so too this man puts himself to the flame. A third is pushed forth, but unlike the others he is shackled and wild-eyed. He screams at the cultists.%SPEECH_ON%Fark your god, he means nothing! It's all a lie!%SPEECH_OFF%A face appears in the flames, its shape bulbous and churning in the smoke and fire. It is cruelty embodied, and could be no better painted by flames than by darkness itself. It turns and grins. One of the cultist shouts.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits you!%SPEECH_OFF%But the prisoner kicks one of his imprisoners and tries to make a run for it.
b04d4d6e83db54b8ecf4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]你决定再等一等。话音刚落，教徒们便把一个老人拖到火前。他向火焰低头，张开双臂，倒了进去，没有发出惨叫。又一个人被带上前。他与一名教徒低语几句，彼此点头，随后也投身火中。第三个人被推了出来，却与前两个不同：他戴着镣铐，双眼惊恐地乱转，冲教徒们破口大骂。%SPEECH_ON%去他妈的神！那东西什么都不是！全是谎话！%SPEECH_OFF%火焰中浮现一张脸，在烟火之间鼓胀、翻涌。那是残酷本身的化身，烈焰与黑暗都同样适合勾勒它的面貌。它转过来，咧嘴一笑。一名教徒高喊。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔在等着你！%SPEECH_OFF%囚徒却踢开一名看守，试图逃跑。

a0303dc09bdf674ff944.source: I've seen enough. We need to help him, now!

4e418d3bdb807c7e7577.source: Hold on, let's see what happens next.
4e418d3bdb807c7e7577.translation: 等等，看他们接下来做什么。

cf854186168c7f33bdde.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]You decide to wait and see what happens. The bonfire's face returns, a great magmatic maw opening up as the chained man is pushed forward. He screams and bends backward, but it's no use. His clothes burn away and the tatters fly backward in flailing orange ruin. His skin peels as though it were not fire, but a thousand scalpels running across his body. By sharpened white fire he is flayed. His skull is bored out, wriggling and shaking like a snake shedding its skin, and his eyes remain forever seeing though the rest of his body is stripped away by flesh and organs and bones. When he is but a skull with eyes, the face in the fire closes its mouth and the great howls of the sacrifice come to a snapping silence. The bonfire dies out in an instant, and the man, or what's left of him, falls to the earth. The eyes burn bright, slowly fading like a cooling hot iron.

 One of the cultists bends down and picks up the skull. He easily cracks it in half, dropping the brainpan while holding onto what used to be a face. As he holds the remains outward, the bones blacken and invert, creating a cruel visage of utter darkness wreathed by a rim of bone. He puts it on and begins to leave.
cf854186168c7f33bdde.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]你决定继续看下去。篝火中的脸再次浮现，熔岩般的巨口张开，被锁住的男人也被推向前。他尖叫着，拼命向后仰，却毫无用处。衣物燃尽，化作橙红的碎片向后翻飞。皮肤一层层剥落，仿佛掠过身体的不是火，而是千百把小刀。锋利的白焰将他剥皮拆骨，头颅从血肉中暴露出来，扭动颤抖，如蛇蜕皮。血肉、内脏、骨骼逐一被剥去，可那双眼睛始终还在看。直到只剩一颗带着双眼的头骨，火中的脸才合上巨口，祭品的嚎叫戛然而止。篝火瞬间熄灭，那个人——或者说，他的残余——落到地上。双眼亮得灼人，又像冷却的烙铁一样，缓缓暗下去。

一个教徒俯身捡起头骨，轻轻一掰，将它裂成两半。他丢下后颅，只留下曾是脸庞的那一面。残骸被举在身前，骨头发黑、内翻，化成一张纯粹由黑暗构成的狰狞面容，四周嵌着一圈白骨。他戴上它，转身离去。

2b5b3302781afb2e3f51.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]You ask %cultist% if he can do anything. He simply walks past you and down the hill. The group of cultists turn and look to him. He walks through the crowd to the prisoner. They talk. He whispers, the prisoner nods. When they finish, the %cultist% nods to the crowd of cultists. One member steps forward, disrobes, and pitches himself into the fire, screamless and without protest. Another cultist pitches a rake into the flames, tearing something out of it and handing it over to %cultist%. The prisoner, his life ostensibly spared in an exchange, is freed and you watch as %cultist% grabs him and takes him back up the hill. He pushes the man forward as he speaks.%SPEECH_ON%You have taken from Davkul, but the debt is paid.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what it is he has in his hand. The cultist holds up what had been retrieved from the flames. It is a skull patched over in leathered flesh, and stretched taut over its face is a freshly singed visage, presumably of the man who had tossed himself into the fire. Slight hints of his face twist and turn, his mouth wringed ajar, misshapen by a cruel and murmuring darkness. Still holding it aloft like a native showing off a prized scalp, %cultist% speaks bluntly.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits us all.%SPEECH_OFF%
2b5b3302781afb2e3f51.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]你问%cultist%有没有办法。他径直从你身边走过，下了山坡。教徒们转身看着他。他穿过人群，来到囚徒面前。两人交谈起来，他低声说着什么，囚徒点头。谈完，%cultist%朝教徒们点了点头。一个人走出队列，脱去衣袍，投身火中，既无惨叫，也无抗拒。另一名教徒把耙子伸进火焰，扯出一件东西，递给%cultist%。囚徒被解开锁链，看来是以另一条命换得了生还。你看着%cultist%拉住他，带回山坡。教徒把人往前一推，说道。%SPEECH_ON%你从达夫库尔手中带走了人，但债已偿清。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他手里拿着什么。他举起刚从火中取出的东西：一块裹着皮革般血肉的头骨，脸部绷着一张刚被烧焦的面皮，想来属于投火的那个人。依稀可辨的五官扭曲抽动，嘴巴被拧得张开，残酷而低语不止的黑暗将它歪曲成异形。%cultist%像展示珍贵头皮的部族人一样高举着它，直截了当地说。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔终将迎接我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%

437eebd50e66b16eb069.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]You give the order to attack. Your men arm themselves and rush forward. The fire dies in an instant, swirling down to nothing but ash which plumes out in a great cloud. Once it is gone, the eerie crowd opens their arms and speak in unison.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits. Come and greet him.%SPEECH_OFF%
437eebd50e66b16eb069.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]你下令进攻。弟兄们拿起兵器，冲了出去。篝火瞬间熄灭，旋转着塌缩成灰，随后扬起一大团尘云。待灰烬散去，那群阴森的人张开双臂，齐声说道。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔正在等候。来迎接他吧。%SPEECH_OFF%

fff7ff6d4355226cf005.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]You won't stand for this injustice and decide to charge and save the man. As you stand and raise your sword to give the order, the bonfire whips forth a great magmatic tentacle that grabs the chained man and yanks him into the flames. There is but the briefest of screams and then he's gone. The fire condenses into a pillar that quickly collapses. A plume of ash explodes outward. The man is gone and it is as if there was no fire at all. There's not even smoke in the sky.

 The cultists turn to you and point and speak in unison.%SPEECH_ON%Bring death, yours or ours, for Davkul awaits us all.%SPEECH_OFF%You waiver a moment, then give the order to charge.
fff7ff6d4355226cf005.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]你不能容忍这样的暴行，决定冲下去救人。可你刚站起来，举剑准备下令，篝火中便甩出一条熔岩般的巨大触须，抓住囚徒，把他拖入烈焰。惨叫只响了极短的一声，他便消失了。火焰收束成柱，又迅速坍塌，炸出一蓬灰烬。人没了，火也仿佛从未存在，连天空中都不留一丝烟。

教徒们转向你，齐齐伸手指来，异口同声。%SPEECH_ON%带来死亡吧，你们的，或我们的。达夫库尔终将迎接我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%你迟疑片刻，随后下令冲锋。

164937739dcd44af23cf.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]While on the march, you come across a lone cow standing in a field. Not much to it: it's just a cow.

 But then %randombrother% sidles up next to you. He's gnawing on some broomstraw and twists it around as he talks.%SPEECH_ON%So who do you think can do it?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask 'do what.' He smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Aw, sorry cap'. Didn't realize you hadn't heard. We're gonna see if someone can knock that cow over! Say, seeing as how we can only knock it over once, how about you choose which of us has a go?%SPEECH_OFF%
164937739dcd44af23cf.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]行军途中，你们看见一头牛独自站在田里。没什么稀奇，就是头牛。

可%randombrother%凑到了你身边，嘴里嚼着一根草茎，边说边转。%SPEECH_ON%你看谁能成？%SPEECH_OFF%你问，成什么。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%哦，抱歉，团长，我还以为你听说了呢。咱们打算找个人，试试能不能把那头牛推倒！既然最多只能推倒一次，不如你来挑谁上？%SPEECH_OFF%

b16113d08385d0f787d6.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]You tell the men to sort it out themselves. They quickly choose %cowtipper% who, after some badgering, agrees to give it a go.

 The sellsword carefully steps across the field, trying his best to avoid the cow patties. The cow itself nonchalantly looks over. It moos once before returning its short bovine attention to the grass. Snickering, the men shoo %cowtipper% onward, mouthing 'do it!' and 'what are you waiting for?' Finally, standing a few feet from the cow, %cowtipper% charges.%SPEECH_ON%Yaaahh!%SPEECH_OFF%He storms into the cow's side and he might as well have run into a house: his feet slip out from beneath him and he goes skidding beneath the animal, a glide well-oiled by fresh shit. The company bursts out laughing.%SPEECH_ON%You can't tip a cow ya fool! They're too goddam heavy!%SPEECH_OFF% %cowtipper% no doubt has a new beef with these jokers, but his 'sacrifice' was worth the easy entertainment.
b16113d08385d0f787d6.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]你让弟兄们自己决定。他们很快选中%cowtipper%，一番怂恿后，他终于答应试试。

佣兵小心地走过田地，尽量避开牛粪。牛漫不经心地看了他一眼，哞了一声，很快又把那点有限的心思放回草上。弟兄们窃笑着催%cowtipper%往前走，张嘴比划：“快上！”“还等什么？”终于，离牛只剩几步时，%cowtipper%发起冲锋。%SPEECH_ON%呀啊啊！%SPEECH_OFF%他猛撞牛身，结果跟撞上屋子没什么两样：脚下一滑，整个人从牛肚子底下溜了过去，新鲜牛粪倒替这趟滑行润得十分顺畅。战团笑作一团。%SPEECH_ON%傻子，牛哪推得倒！重得要命！%SPEECH_OFF%%cowtipper%无疑要跟这些爱耍人的家伙结下新仇，不过，他这番“牺牲”换来的乐子，确实便宜又好看。

8c60beebaab8d234221f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]You tell the men to sort it out themselves. They quickly choose %cowtipper%. The sellsword carefully steps across the field, trying his best to avoid the cow patties. The cow itself nonchalantly looks over and moos once before returning its attention to the grass. Snickering, the men shoo %cowtipper% onward, mouthing 'do it!' and 'hurry now!'. Finally, standing a few feet from the cow, %cowtipper% charges forward.%SPEECH_ON%Yaaahh!%SPEECH_OFF%The scream spooks the cow. She dips her withers and kicks, catching %cowtipper% with a bit of hooved heel. He violently spins on his feet and twists right into the grass. The men laugh for a moment, then realize it's serious. As the cow moos and trots away, the sellsword is 'rescued.' Though badly hurt, he'll survive this near-bovine homicide.
8c60beebaab8d234221f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]你让弟兄们自己决定，他们很快选中了%cowtipper%。佣兵小心走过田地，尽力避开牛粪。牛漫不经心地看他一眼，哞了一声，又低头吃草。弟兄们窃笑着催%cowtipper%上前，嘴里比划着“动手！”“快点！”终于，离牛只有几步时，%cowtipper%冲了过去。%SPEECH_ON%呀啊啊！%SPEECH_OFF%这声吼吓着了牛。它压低前身，一脚向后蹬出，蹄子正踢中%cowtipper%。他被踢得原地猛转，扭着身子摔进草里。弟兄们笑了片刻，随即意识到不对劲。牛哞叫着小跑离去，佣兵才被“救”了回来。他虽然伤得不轻，好在没有命丧牛蹄。

54759bf46adbbb5cef90.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]You figure the strong and burly %strong% could give the cow a good tipping. Your awkward wording alone has the men laughing, but %strong% respectfully bows.%SPEECH_ON%I am honored, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%He rolls up his sleeves and strolls across the field, striding over cow patties like a merchant stepping over the homeless. The cow looks over, raising a curious eyebrow. %strong% nods.%SPEECH_ON%That's right, I'm coming.%SPEECH_OFF%More phrasing issues abound. Despite the laughter of the company, %strong% charges the cow. At first, he simply presses against its side, muscled and heaving with breath. The men laugh as his efforts get him nowhere, but they quickly quiet down when the cow slides across the mud and grass. With a mighty roar, %strong% surges forward and the cow goes falling sideways with a confused moo.

 %otherbrother% stands there, slackjawed.%SPEECH_ON%It was a joke... I didn't think it was actually possible...%SPEECH_OFF%The company erupts in cheers for the strong man's incredible feat!
54759bf46adbbb5cef90.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]你觉得，膀大腰圆的%strong%应该能把那头牛好好“推倒”一番。光这别扭的说法，就惹得弟兄们发笑，%strong%却恭敬地鞠了一躬。%SPEECH_ON%荣幸之至，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%他卷起袖子，走进田里，跨过一摊摊牛粪，像商人跨过路边的流浪汉。牛转头看他，神情颇为好奇。%strong%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，我这就来了。%SPEECH_OFF%这话又添了几分歧义。任凭身后笑声不断，%strong%直冲向牛。起初，他只是顶在牛肚旁，绷紧肌肉，呼哧喘气。看他毫无进展，弟兄们笑得更厉害，可牛一旦开始沿着泥草滑动，笑声便迅速止住。%strong%一声暴吼，猛然发力，牛带着一声困惑的哞叫，侧翻在地。

%otherbrother%站在原地，嘴张得老大。%SPEECH_ON%只是个玩笑……我没想到真有人能办到……%SPEECH_OFF%战团爆发出欢呼，为壮汉这惊人的本事喝彩！

134f936092345d35fa70.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]Before you can even finish your sentence, %cocky% beats his chest and steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%I will fell that petty cow!%SPEECH_OFF%You remind him that the company has no beef with the bovine creature and that this is all for fun and games. He stands there, arms tent-poled with his fists at his hips.%SPEECH_ON%Nonsense. The company laughs and thinks this an impossibility, but I'm here to show them all just how wrong they are!%SPEECH_OFF%The cocksure sellsword steps into the field and immediately cuts his boot across a cow patty. He sidewinders forward, arms flailing for balance, but it's all for naught as he slams to the ground. The men burst into laughter. The cow glances over before simply walking off. %cocky% cleans himself up.%SPEECH_ON%A minor misstep. But look! The cowardly cattle wants no part of me!%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother% laughs and points at the sellsword's stained garb.%SPEECH_ON%Maybe, but it looks like you got a little part of her.%SPEECH_OFF%The cocky sellsword quickly swipes the shite off his shirt. Despite the failure, he is undeterred and the men are almost passing out they're laughing so hard.
134f936092345d35fa70.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]你话还没说完，%cocky%就拍着胸膛站了出来。%SPEECH_ON%区区一头牛，我来放倒它！%SPEECH_OFF%你提醒他，战团跟牛无冤无仇，这不过是找个乐子。他双拳叉腰，胳膊支得像帐篷架。%SPEECH_ON%胡说。弟兄们笑我，觉得不可能，可我今天偏要让所有人看清，他们错得有多离谱！%SPEECH_OFF%这位自信十足的佣兵迈进田里，第一脚便踩上牛粪。他歪扭着向前滑，双臂乱挥，想找回平衡，最终还是重重摔在地上。弟兄们哄堂大笑。牛扭头看了一眼，便径自走开。%cocky%拍打着身上。%SPEECH_ON%不过是小小失足。你们看！那头胆小牛根本不敢跟我沾边！%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother%笑着指向佣兵污秽的衣服。%SPEECH_ON%也许吧，可它倒有点东西沾到你身上了。%SPEECH_OFF%狂妄的佣兵赶紧抹去衣上的屎。即使失败，他仍毫不气馁，而弟兄们已经笑得快要昏过去了。

638ee62cf4cec2da010b.source: Pick whoever you think is best.
638ee62cf4cec2da010b.translation: 你们觉得谁最行，就挑谁。

565218ac31d41fbae6a2.source: I bet %strong% is strong enough to do it.

1002dde8431308e43dc0.source: That cocky bastard %cocky% looks itching to have a go.
1002dde8431308e43dc0.translation: 看那狂妄的%cocky%，早就跃跃欲试了。

0f9b5d40b53d750560f4.source: Humiliated himself in front of the company

f2da38ecc878217e4f2a.source: 's attempt to tip over a cow

5b6b6ef15a1e1b2f8a6a.source: Has shown off of his physical prowess

dcd991cce9e083ab0c17.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]While walking the streets of %townname%, you come upon a crowd standing around a hanged man. He must have been of some notoriety: the folks are muscling one another to try and get a turn to cut a toe or finger off as a sort of hanging-heirloom. An old man is quickly elbowed out of the mob. He turns to you, voice raspy, his bony fingers tented like sickly ribs.%SPEECH_ON%Ahh, sellsword are ye? O'course, I can smell your business, the purchases ye have made. Say, would you do a bit of work for me? I need a number of that dead man's fingers and toes. It's for m'work, ye shall see. I'll give you five hundred crowns in return for it.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask why he needs that particular man's appendages. The crooning, shoulder-cowed man laughs, a heckle if there ever was one.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, good question. The man earned his walk to the hangman's noose with a penchant for violence and an unerring strength to see his desires through. The toes and fingers of a simpleton won't do. I need a man of uncinched cruelty, and the only one I see right now is swinging by that there rope. So, what say ye? Five hundred crowns, remember?%SPEECH_OFF%
dcd991cce9e083ab0c17.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你走在%townname%的街上，遇到一群围着绞刑架上死人的民众。那人想必恶名不小，众人推推搡搡，都想抢着割下一根手指或脚趾，当作行刑的纪念。一名老人很快被挤出人群。他转向你，嗓音沙哑，枯瘦的手指拱在一起，像一排病弱的肋骨。%SPEECH_ON%啊，是佣兵吧？当然，你们做的买卖、沾的那些生意，我闻得出来。替我干点活，怎么样？我要那死人几根手指、几根脚趾，做事用得着。办成了，给你五百克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他，为什么非得要这个人的断肢。那缩着肩、声音拖长的老人笑了，笑得格外刺耳。%SPEECH_ON%问得好。这人嗜好暴行，又有足够的狠劲，把心中恶念一一做成，这才一路走上绞架。随便一个蠢人的指头可不行，我要的是一个残忍得毫无约束的人。眼下看得见的，就只有绳子上晃着那位。怎么样？五百克朗，记着呢？%SPEECH_OFF%

1c4f21533734bef89261.source: Alright, I'll go and find them.

920f877b45f26de2622e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]You muscle your way into the crowd, looking for fingers and toes or bloodied pockets. One man's got a good, lumpy sag in his pocket. You drive him into a corner and shake him down with a dagger to his throat.

 After him, you see a woman with a sickly grin on her face prancing along the cobbled stones. That's a scornful wench if you've ever seen one. Pulling her aside, you quickly find the a finger and a toe in the linens of her frock. She lies and says they're just cooking ingredients. You tell her if that's the case then you'll report her to the guards for cannibalism. She gives them up.

 Returning the grossly extremities to the old man, you are promptly paid the five hundred crowns. He hardly even thanks you for your 'work' before rushing away. He never did explain what, exactly, such things were for. You don't care. Five hundred crowns is five hundred crowns.
920f877b45f26de2622e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你挤进人群，寻找断指断趾和染血的口袋。一个人的衣兜沉甸甸地鼓着。你把他逼到角落，匕首往喉间一抵，便搜了出来。

接着，你看见一个女人沿石板路轻快走来，脸上带着令人不适的笑。那副刻薄相，真是少见。你把她拉到一旁，很快就在裙子的布兜里找出一根手指和一根脚趾。她撒谎说那只是做饭的材料。你告诉她，既然如此，就去向卫兵举报她吃人。她只好交了出来。

把这些恶心的断肢交给老人，你当即拿到五百克朗。他几乎没为你的“辛苦”道谢，便匆匆走了。他终究没解释，究竟要拿这些东西做什么。你也不在乎。五百克朗，就是五百克朗。

0cea52fde225a85a8fbd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]You agree to the creepy old man's task and start going through the crowd, keeping a careful eye out for toes and fingers being where they shouldn't be, or lumpy pockets freshly and redly wet. It doesn't take long: a woman prances down the road, the front of her frock bubbling rather curiously with whatever she's got in the pocket. You pull her into an alleyway, drawing a dagger to keep her quiet. A finger and toe are found. As you go to take them, a man suddenly tackles you from behind. Crowns from your purse and the appendages go skittering across the cobblestones. A child takes one, a rat the other, where either runs off to is quickly obscured by a frenzy of peasants going after your coins. The man who tackled you loads up a punch.%SPEECH_ON%Sumbitch, you want her you gotta pay!%SPEECH_OFF%You cross your arms, block the strike, and twist your body to put him on the ground. He's about to say something else, but you momentarily replace his teeth with your knuckles and he goes quiet. Unfortunately, you won't be able to finish what you started and you've lost a few coins in the process.
0cea52fde225a85a8fbd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你答应阴森老人的差事，钻进人群，仔细寻找出现在不该出现之处的手指脚趾，以及鼓鼓囊囊、刚渗出鲜血的口袋。没找多久，一个女人蹦蹦跳跳地沿路走来，裙子前兜鼓得颇为可疑。你把她拉进小巷，亮出匕首，示意她别出声。果然，搜出一根手指和一根脚趾。你正要拿走，忽然被人从背后扑倒。钱袋里的克朗和那两截断肢，一起滚散在石板路上。一个孩子捡走一截，一只老鼠叼走另一截；转眼间，争抢钱币的农民乱作一团，谁也看不清他们去了哪里。扑倒你的男人抡起拳头。%SPEECH_ON%狗东西，想碰她就得付钱！%SPEECH_OFF%你交叉双臂，挡住一拳，扭身将他摔到地上。他还想开口，你便用指节招呼了他的牙，让他安静下来。可惜，这差事已经办不成了，还白丢了几枚钱。

beb23c9201d7b2ea3bef.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]%thief% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, this'll be easy.%SPEECH_OFF%He goes off to the crowd and you lose sight of him in an instant. The old man chews on his gums for awhile before raising his voice.%SPEECH_ON%This feller, he is one to trust?%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can answer, %thief% emerges from behind the old man's shoulder and drops a bloody bandage into his palms. The creepy man unwraps the linens to discover freshly strewn extremities. The thief smugly smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Any thief worth his salt learns to pickpocket before anything else. I usually go after keys instead of toes, but a job is a job. Also 'picked' some other things of interest here and there. Take a look.%SPEECH_OFF%
beb23c9201d7b2ea3bef.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]%thief%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%嗨，小事一桩。%SPEECH_OFF%他走进人群，转眼便没了踪影。老人咂着牙床等了一会儿，抬高声音问。%SPEECH_ON%这家伙，信得过吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你还没回答，%thief%就从老人肩后冒出来，把一团染血的绷带丢进他手里。阴森的老人拆开布条，里面是新鲜的断指断趾。小偷得意地笑着。%SPEECH_ON%像样的贼，头一门就得学会掏口袋。我平时摸的是钥匙，不是脚趾，不过干活就是干活。顺手还“摸”到些别的好东西，看看吧。%SPEECH_OFF%

63ec49399b144e0f83da.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]%minstrel% the minstrel grabs the old man by his shoulders.%SPEECH_ON%Say, what mighty muscles you seem to have, my burly friend. I shan't ask why you need the toes and fingers of that dead man...%SPEECH_OFF%The old man nods and says he'd never tell anyway. The minstrel continues.%SPEECH_ON%...but if you want a good, strong, and violent man, then am I not looking at it? It's you, old man! Take yer own fingers and toes and go with them to complete the task - ahem, whatever weird shite that might be, ahem - and you'll find the 'reward' you're after. You are the hero of this story, can't you see?%SPEECH_OFF%The old man spits and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%You take me for a fool, don't ya? Our business here is through! Get out of my way you sorry sellswords.%SPEECH_OFF%The old man leaves. You ask the minstrel what the hell he's doing. He shrugs and holds up a purse of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Sleight of hand.%SPEECH_OFF%Nicely done. But you ask where your own purse is. %minstrel% raises another sack.%SPEECH_ON%Really, really good sleight of hand.%SPEECH_OFF%
63ec49399b144e0f83da.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]吟游诗人%minstrel%抓住老人的双肩。%SPEECH_ON%瞧瞧，我这壮实的朋友，你的肌肉可真结实。我就不问，你要那死人的手指脚趾干什么了……%SPEECH_OFF%老人点头，说反正也不会告诉他。吟游诗人继续道。%SPEECH_ON%……不过，要找一个强壮、凶狠、够分量的人，我眼前不就有吗？就是你呀，老人家！拿自己的手指脚趾，去完成那件事——咳，不管那是什么怪勾当，咳——不就能得到你想要的“回报”了？你才是这个故事的英雄，难道还没看明白？%SPEECH_OFF%老人啐了一口，摇着头说。%SPEECH_ON%你拿我当傻子，是吧？这桩买卖到此为止！滚开，你们这些没用的佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%老人走了。你问吟游诗人究竟搞什么鬼。他耸耸肩，举起一袋克朗。%SPEECH_ON%一点小手法。%SPEECH_OFF%干得漂亮。不过，你又问自己的钱袋去哪了。%minstrel%再举起另一袋。%SPEECH_ON%非常、非常高明的小手法。%SPEECH_OFF%

45e5baea0dcf116cba76.source: Very funny. Now hand it back.

0e883e3b056279cf64d5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_19.png[/img]%butcher% the butcher spits and says he'll do it. You tell him that he's not exactly the thieving sort. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Naw. I mean I'll give him a finger. Just one, but it'll be a doozy and worth its weight in gold as far as this old fart's concerned. As far as you're concerned, captain, I want half the reward.%SPEECH_OFF%The creepy stranger nods as a smile crackles his dried, flaky skin.%SPEECH_ON%Yes... yes! A man who would do this would certainly fit the profile of the ingredients I need. Do it. Do it!%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can even agree to this, the butcher grabs a tong hanging off a nearby wall, leverages it atop an anvil, wedges a finger between the pincers, and presses his knee to the handle, promptly severing a finger all in one go. He wraps the hand before giving up the extremity to the stranger.%SPEECH_ON%There you have it: one especially cruel man's finger.%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger grabs it as though it were the key to the world. 'Marvelous!', you think he says, but it's hard to hear as he hurriedly gives you some crowns and runs off. It's actually more than you originally agreed to. The butcher has certainly 'earned' his half and you hand it over.
0e883e3b056279cf64d5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_19.png[/img]屠夫%butcher%啐了一口，说他来办。你提醒他，他可不像会偷东西的人。他摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不是。我是说，给他一根手指。就一根，可绝对是好货，对这老东西来说，值钱得很。至于你，团长，赏钱我要一半。%SPEECH_OFF%阴森的陌生人连连点头，一笑，干裂起皮的脸也跟着绽开。%SPEECH_ON%对……对！肯做这种事的人，正符合我需要的材料。动手吧，动手！%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及答应，屠夫便抓起旁边墙上挂着的钳子，架在铁砧上，把一根手指伸进钳口，再用膝盖压下手柄，一下将手指截断。他先包好伤手，才把断指交给陌生人。%SPEECH_ON%拿去，一个格外残忍之人的手指。%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人一把抓住它，仿佛抓到了通往整个世界的钥匙。你觉得他喊了一句“妙极了”，可他塞来克朗就匆匆跑开，实在听不真切。钱竟比原先谈好的还多。屠夫确实“挣”到了他那一半，你如数交给了他。

a0a85c40c5454aadefd5.source: Our thief, %thief%, seems to have an idea.
a0a85c40c5454aadefd5.translation: 咱们的小偷%thief%似乎有主意。

5a05b86db7af92e87035.source: It seems that %butcher% wants to give you a hand.

04a86cc10ef4b941bdb8.source: Has used his unique talents to great success
04a86cc10ef4b941bdb8.translation: 用独门本领漂亮地办成了事

5c45605d695cfca41c1c.source: Has made a tidy sum selling one of his fingers
5c45605d695cfca41c1c.translation: 卖掉自己的一根手指，赚了一笔钱

4af54e995c104423a796.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]%cripple% the cripple asks how %veteran% does it. The veteran raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%Do what?%SPEECH_OFF%The cripple bounces his head around as he figuratively beats around the bush.%SPEECH_ON%You know, it. Fight. Every time I get out there, I just think I'm not up to it, as though I were dragging you fellas down.%SPEECH_OFF%%veteran% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, I get what you mean. A cripple ain't fit for sellswording. But is that who you are? Just a cripple? Or are ye a man? You can choose to let your wobbles and ungainliness define who you are, or you can make your own path, as crooked and hobbled it may be.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, %cripple%'s face starts to glow.%SPEECH_ON%You're right. I'm not all that I could be and I got the body of a dying nun, but no man will put in more effort than I!%SPEECH_OFF%
4af54e995c104423a796.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]身有残疾的%cripple%问%veteran%，他是怎么做到的。老兵挑起眉。%SPEECH_ON%做到什么？%SPEECH_OFF%那人晃着脑袋，绕了好大一个圈才说出口。%SPEECH_ON%就是那个，打仗。每次上阵，我都觉得自己不行，好像只会拖累你们。%SPEECH_OFF%%veteran%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，我懂。残废不适合当佣兵。可你就只是个残废？除了残废，什么都不是？还是说，你也是条汉子？你可以让这副摇摇晃晃、不听使唤的身子决定自己是什么人，也可以自己走出一条路——哪怕走得歪歪斜斜，一瘸一拐。%SPEECH_OFF%%cripple%连连点头，脸上渐渐有了光彩。%SPEECH_ON%你说得对。我还没尽到自己的本事，这身子也跟快断气的修女差不多，可论拼命，谁也别想超过我！%SPEECH_OFF%

672ff0dd6fc2a55d7324.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]The recent battle left %injured% with a horrific and permanent injury. As he sits glumly about the campfire, %cripple% the cripple takes a seat next to him.%SPEECH_ON%So here you sit, bummed out about something that don't matter. Look at me. Just look at me! Look at where I am! I've lost that which can't be returned, but did I dwell on it? No. I pressed on. I joined the %companyname%. Because that, that injury right there, that's gone and done. This up here...%SPEECH_OFF%The cripple taps the side of his head.%SPEECH_ON%Up here is what can be made anew. Up here is where you can think, yeah, that happened, but I'm still a man and I'm still in this. If the world wants me dead, it'll have to take all the pieces I got to give because I'm not giving up until the last of me is gone!%SPEECH_OFF%%injured% nods and his mood already seems infinitely improved.
672ff0dd6fc2a55d7324.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]最近那场战斗给%injured%留下了可怕而永久的伤残。他闷闷不乐地坐在营火边，身有残疾的%cripple%在旁坐下。%SPEECH_ON%你就坐在这儿，为一件已经不重要的事垂头丧气。看看我，好好看看！再看看我如今在哪儿！我也失去过再拿不回来的东西，可我一直揪着不放了吗？没有。我往前走，加入了%companyname%。因为那伤——就在那儿的伤——已经发生了，改不了。可这儿……%SPEECH_OFF%他敲敲自己的脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%这儿可以重新来。你可以在这里想：没错，我伤了，可我还是个人，我还没退出。要是这世界非要我死，就得把我剩下的每一块都拿走。只要我还剩一点，就绝不会认输！%SPEECH_OFF%%injured%点点头，心情似乎已经好了许多。

da3480697b9435d648f5.source: Quite the spirit on that man.

b3b32c5dece630a0bc4e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]Forests hide many things, being the natural resort of predators and men of wilder intents. But you know this well, and you know how to spot shadows most unnatural to this climate. It doesn't take you long to realize that there are more than just trees here, and with a quick punch into the thicket of a bush you pull out a young boy with a bow. He cries for help and the reinforcements arrive like songbirds to the prettiest of tunes: a dozen men emerge from the shadows, but the company is prepared, drawing their weapons and coming to stand on equal footing.

 An elderly man steps forth, holding his hands up.%SPEECH_ON%Wait, there is no need for violence here.%SPEECH_OFF%He comes to you personally and in a muted, scholarly tone explains what is happening. The small bunch of peasants are preparing to ambush a troop of %noblehouse% soldiers that will be coming this way any moment. He states you'll get a piece of the rewards if you help. If not, please get out of the way.
b3b32c5dece630a0bc4e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]森林藏得住许多东西，既是猛兽的天然巢穴，也是心怀歹意之人的容身处。你深知这一点，也懂得分辨林间那些不该有的影子。很快，你便察觉这里不光有树。猛地伸手探入灌木，你拽出一个拿弓的小男孩。他高声呼救，援手便如闻声聚来的鸣禽：十来个人从暗处现身。然而弟兄们早有准备，纷纷拔出武器，与他们对峙。

一个老人举着双手走上前。%SPEECH_ON%等等，没必要动武。%SPEECH_OFF%他径直来到你面前，压低声音，像个读书人般解释原委。这一小群农民准备伏击一队随时可能经过的%noblehouse%士兵。他说，只要你帮忙，战利品便有你一份。若不帮，烦请让路。

20f95ebe08ba5ac4b87a.source: We have to warn the soldiers.

0772d99bece060801cc7.source: We've no time for any of this.

8262fc0c1b89bcdb2b47.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]They're peasants, scroungy and looking like they came here to find leaves to dress themselves. But flimsy bows like theirs come with hardened hands, well versed in getting arrows to targets they got no business finding. These are men of the forests. With confidence that this ambush will go right, you elect to join them.

 You don't have to wait long for the soldiers of %noblehouse% to start trundling there way over. They're loud, obnoxious, and some of them farting and complaining about mushrooms that they mistakenly ate.

 A kid about half your size releases the first shot. The arrow streaks between two branches and the lead scout drops to his knees. Leaves ruffle as though a great wind has come - arrows, sight unseen, zip into the soldiers' column and they're so true in aim that their targets die silently. A few of the soldiers manage to close the distance, raising swords and shields, but here the %companyname% steps in and cuts them down. After but a minute, the entire troop has been slain.
8262fc0c1b89bcdb2b47.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]这些农民邋里邋遢，看着像是来林子里找树叶蔽体的。不过，他们握着简陋弓箭的双手布满老茧，总能把箭送到本不该射得到的地方。这些人熟悉森林。你确信这场伏击能成，决定助他们一臂之力。

没等多久，%noblehouse%的士兵便拖拖拉拉地走来了。他们吵嚷不休，惹人生厌；有几个一路放屁，抱怨自己误吃了蘑菇。

一个只有你半身高的孩子射出第一箭。箭从两根树枝间穿过，走在最前面的斥候双膝跪倒。树叶沙沙作响，仿佛骤起狂风——看不见来处的利箭接连射入队列，准得让中箭者连声音都没发出便死了。几个士兵勉强冲近，举起剑盾，却被迎上来的%companyname%砍倒。前后不过一分钟，整队士兵便全军覆没。

fc2de076fb4587e379aa.source: That went well. Let's divide the goods.

cc13e33b8286bce9b816.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]Your men go picking through the corpses, joined by the motley crew of killers. A scuffle breaks out over who should take a shield. You explain that the only reason the shield exists for the taking is because your men stepped forward to kill its owner. The leader of the group nods in agreement. He calls out that your company should take the heavier equipment as your men most certainly have better use for such things.

 As you divvy up the goods, one of the bowmen comes forward.%SPEECH_ON%I think one of them got away. There's tracks, but he must've been a bit smarter than his dead brothers because he doubled back and covered them quite well.%SPEECH_OFF%Just when you thought you could get away with something...
cc13e33b8286bce9b816.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]弟兄们开始搜刮尸体，那群杂牌杀手也凑了过来。有人为一面盾牌推搡起来。你告诉他们，这盾牌之所以能让人捡走，全是因为你的弟兄上前杀了它的主人。对方的首领点头赞同，招呼众人把重装备留给战团，毕竟这些东西在你手下显然更派得上用场。

正分着战利品，一名弓手走上前。%SPEECH_ON%好像有一个逃掉了。我发现了脚印，不过这家伙比死去的同伴聪明些，折回来把痕迹掩得挺好。%SPEECH_OFF%你还以为这回能做得神不知鬼不觉呢……

0f26670922343ddccfeb.source: Except for the guy who got away, that also went well.
0f26670922343ddccfeb.translation: 除了跑掉一个，其他都挺顺利。

d7cd2770d1b15851784e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]You tell the peasants you want no part of their war, but you'll stay out of it nonetheless.

 As soon as they're out of sight and sound, you find the soldiers of %noblehouse% and inform them of the troubles that are soon to come. The lieutenant doesn't believe you until you lead him to the peasants and point them out or, rather, their slim shadows sneakily lingering behind this branch or that one.

 Going back to the troop, you organize an assault. It's pretty simple - you go around the ambush and come up from behind. The old men, desperate men, and naive boys are all slain in turn. They did not see it coming, but in the thick of the chaos some almost certainly escaped and have told of your betrayal. You collect a few goods from the battlefield and a summation of goodwill from the %noblehouse% bannermen.
d7cd2770d1b15851784e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]你告诉农民，自己不想掺和他们的战争，也不会妨碍他们。

一离开他们的视线和耳目，你就去找到%noblehouse%的士兵，告知前方有埋伏。副官起初不信，直到你带他靠近那些农民，指给他看——准确地说，是指给他看那些躲在枝丫后鬼鬼祟祟的瘦长人影。

回到队伍中，你安排了一次进攻。办法很简单：绕过埋伏，从背后袭击。老人、走投无路的汉子和天真的少年接连被杀。他们毫无防备，不过混乱之中，肯定有人逃脱，把你的背叛传了出去。你从战场上收走一些财物，也从%noblehouse%的士兵那里赢得了不少好感。

cdf77e1781fd610087e1.source: So the locals may hear of this, what does it matter?

524e45a7b51a87df61c6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{Soldiers of %noblehouse% are trying to conscript the locals. The peasants, understandably, want no part of the war and are refusing to go willingly. A lieutenant of the bannermen, his men clearly understaffed for this situation, asks you for help. | You come across a throng of peasants shouting down a few soldiers of %noblehouse%. They state that they will not take part in the wars between noble houses.%SPEECH_ON%What have the lords done for us!%SPEECH_OFF%One man asks to the cheers of many. A lieutenant barks back.%SPEECH_ON%He has graced you with his land, so that you and your families may prosper!%SPEECH_OFF%An old man spits back.%SPEECH_ON%Wasn't that old cunt's land. It wasn't nobody's land until that fark said so. And why? Because he fooled some armored gits into thinking he was right?%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd cheers ever louder.%SPEECH_ON%You've already taken many from us, so be gone already! If their lives couldn't solve your noble squabbling, than what is taking the last of us to do?%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenant turns to you and asks for help, as though you might be particularly persuasive in getting people to die for causes they could care less about. | A busy throng of peasants is cluttering the roadway that passes through %town%. As you get closer, you realize that a group of bannermen from %noblehouse% are trying to conscript the laymen and, clearly, it is not a fight those people wish to partake in. Not having enough men to handle the situation by himself, the soldiers' lieutenant turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, mercenary. Would you please kindly get these runts to come with us? The noblemen will hear of your deed...%SPEECH_OFF% | Seemingly every villager is standing out in the road that snakes through %town%. Pushing your way through the crowd, you come to a small group of bewildered and scared soldiers of %noblehouse%. Their lieutenant has his hands up, a scroll dangling from one.%SPEECH_ON%These are not my orders, but I intend to carry them out!%SPEECH_OFF%A peasant spits.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, carry them to the grave!%SPEECH_OFF%Seeing you, the lieutenant pleas for your help.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! We require soldiers for the great war between noble houses... These... fools, are not following orders. The order of the lords! Help us with this and I will personally ensure that the nobles hear of your work here.%SPEECH_OFF%}
524e45a7b51a87df61c6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{%noblehouse%的士兵正在征召本地人入伍。农民不愿卷进战争，拒绝乖乖跟走，这倒也不难理解。领头的副官人手明显不足，无法控制局面，便向你求助。 | 你遇见一群农民，正冲着几个%noblehouse%的士兵高声叫骂，说绝不参加贵族家族之间的战争。%SPEECH_ON%领主为我们做过什么！%SPEECH_OFF%一个男人大声质问，四下响起喝彩。副官吼了回去。%SPEECH_ON%他把土地赐给你们，供你们一家老小安居乐业！%SPEECH_OFF%一个老人啐了一口，反驳道：%SPEECH_ON%那地本来就不是那老杂种的。那狗东西开口之前，地也不归谁！凭什么归他？就凭他骗得几个穿盔甲的蠢货信了他的话？%SPEECH_OFF%人群的喝彩声更响了。%SPEECH_ON%你们已经带走那么多人了，滚吧！他们的命都没能了结贵族老爷的争吵，再把我们这些剩下的拉走，又有什么用？%SPEECH_OFF%副官转向你求助，仿佛你特别擅长劝人为了毫不在乎的事情去送死。 | 一大群农民堵住了穿过%town%的道路。走近后你才看清，原来是%noblehouse%的一队士兵正在征召平民。显然，这些百姓不愿去打那场仗。副官独力难以控制局面，便转向你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵。劳驾，替我们叫这些贱民乖乖跟上，好吗？贵族老爷会知道你的功劳……%SPEECH_OFF% | 几乎全村的人都站到了蜿蜒穿过%town%的路上。你挤过人群，来到一小队惊慌失措的%noblehouse%士兵面前。副官举着双手，一只手上垂着卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%命令不是我下的，但我必须执行！%SPEECH_OFF%一个农民啐道：%SPEECH_ON%是啊，带进坟墓里执行吧！%SPEECH_OFF%副官一看见你，便开口求援。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！贵族家族之间开战了，我们需要士兵……这些……蠢货，竟然不听命令。那可是领主的命令！帮我们一把，我亲自保证，贵族老爷一定会知道你在这里的功劳。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a8f7c42b28ab3559fed9.source: Very well. You need to pull your weight, peasants!
a8f7c42b28ab3559fed9.translation: 好吧。农民们，你们也该出份力！

de2d25b66062769a47b3.translation: 军官，这不是他们该打的仗。

72e2ba4e48c576e1b88d.source: This isn't our fight at all.

9b1c5e15a7121fcd9e2d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{While this is not your fight, and has almost nothing to do with you, you can't help but feel that goodwill with the nobles will pay off in the future. With that in mind, you order your men to start rounding up the peasants, separating the young from the old, and the weak from the strong. Seeing as how your men look like they'd have no inhibitions about cutting down the common folk, the common folk go right along with your orders. The lieutenant plucks a few from this 'batch' 'and pushes them onto the road. He thanks you greatly for your work and says the nobles will hear of the %companyname%. | Unsheathing your sword, you command the peasants to order themselves from strong to weak. You glance at the lieutenant.%SPEECH_ON%Women?%SPEECH_OFF%He shakes his head. You return to the crowd.%SPEECH_ON%Men only! Strongest to weakest. Get to it.%SPEECH_OFF%With scattered grumbles and meaningless weeping, the laymen follow the order. The lieutenant informs you that the nobles will hear of your doings here.}
9b1c5e15a7121fcd9e2d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{这不是你的战争，与你也几乎毫无干系，但你还是觉得，博取贵族的好感，日后总能派上用场。于是你命令弟兄们把农民赶到一起，将年轻人与老人、强壮者与体弱者分开。百姓一看你手下的架势，便知他们砍起平民来绝不会犹豫，只得乖乖听令。副官从这一批人里挑出几个，推到路上。他连声道谢，还说一定会让贵族知道%companyname%的功劳。 | 你拔剑出鞘，命令农民按强壮到瘦弱的顺序排好，随后瞥向副官。%SPEECH_ON%女人也要？%SPEECH_OFF%他摇头。你转回人群。%SPEECH_ON%只要男人！壮的在前，弱的在后，快点！%SPEECH_OFF%平民们零星抱怨了几句，又徒劳地哭了几声，最终还是听从了命令。副官告诉你，贵族会知道你在这里的所作所为。}

1f47664c5b3ad6d9af8a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{This isn't your war, but you've little doubt that gaining good favor with the nobles will help you down the road. You order your men to start separating the crowd, plucking the strongest from the weak. But the peasants don't cooperate - a stone goes spiraling past your face. %randombrother% charges into the crowd and stabs the assailant through the chest. A few laymen retaliate, bringing out pitchforks and torches. The rest of the %companyname% draws weapons and, after a few quick slayings, the crowd settles. You look around for the lieutenant, but he and his men are nowhere to be seen. | Drawing out your sword, you order the village to start lining up, strongest to weakest. Instead, an old man rallies them with poorly timed anti-war sentiments. %randombrother% walks over to the fool and uncorks a punch to silence him right into the mud. Sadly, this only pisses the crowd off more and a great melee breaks out. Your mercenaries are merciless, cutting down anyone who dares stand against the company. After it's all said and done there are dead and dying in the mud, all tended to by women with confused and saddened faces, and the lieutenant and his soldiers are nowhere to be seen.}
1f47664c5b3ad6d9af8a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{这不是你的战争，但讨得贵族欢心，今后无疑大有好处。你命令弟兄们分开人群，从羸弱者中挑出最强壮的人。然而农民并不配合——一块石头擦着你的脸飞过。%randombrother%冲进人群，一剑刺穿扔石者的胸膛。几个平民拿出草叉和火把还击，%companyname%的其他人便也拔出武器。接连杀掉几个人后，人群终于安静下来。你四下寻找副官，他和士兵们却早已不见踪影。 | 你拔出剑，命令村民按强壮到瘦弱的顺序列队。一个老人却在这时候鼓动众人反对战争。%randombrother%走向那蠢货，一拳把他打进泥里，让他闭了嘴。可惜，这只让人群更加愤怒，一场混战就此爆发。手下毫不留情，把所有胆敢与战团作对的人尽数砍倒。事后，泥里躺满了死人和垂死之人，女人们满脸茫然与悲痛，照料着伤者；副官和他的士兵却不知去了哪里。}

9397242a68985c55294c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{You turn to the lieutenant.%SPEECH_ON%This isn't our fight, and if you can't get a few good men to fight for ya, maybe it isn't your fight either. Go home.%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenant fixes his armor and straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%With or without you, they're coming with us.%SPEECH_OFF%Just as he finishes, a stone pangs off his head, knocking him unconscious. Two of his soldiers rush to his side and start pulling him away. One spits your way.%SPEECH_ON%Don't think we'll forget this.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod at the lieutenant.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, you'd best remember, because he sure won't.%SPEECH_OFF% | The lieutenant crosses his arms as if to say 'well?'. You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%Get someone else to muscle peasants. If you can't do it yourself, maybe your side isn't fit enough to win in the first place?%SPEECH_OFF%He huffs and steps up, meeting his chest with yours. A few peasants approach from all sides, suddenly armed with pitchforks and scythes. The lieutenant glances at your unexpected reinforcements, then back at you. He steps off.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, I suppose that's how it's going to be. The nobles will hear of your faults here, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9397242a68985c55294c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你转向副官。%SPEECH_ON%这仗和我们无关。要是连几个像样的人都招不到，或许你也不该打这场仗。回家吧。%SPEECH_OFF%副官整了整盔甲，挺直身子。%SPEECH_ON%不管你帮不帮，他们都得跟我们走。%SPEECH_OFF%话音刚落，一块石头便砸中他的脑袋，把他打昏在地。两个士兵赶忙上前，拖着他后退。其中一个冲你啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%别以为我们会忘了这事。%SPEECH_OFF%你朝副官扬了扬下巴。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，你们最好记牢，他肯定是记不住了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 副官抱起双臂，像是在问“怎么样？”。你摇头。%SPEECH_ON%找别人去欺负农民吧。要是你自己办不到，没准你们这边压根就没本事打赢？%SPEECH_OFF%他怒哼一声，走上前来，胸口抵住你的胸口。几个农民从四周围来，手里不知何时多了草叉和长柄镰。副官瞥了眼这些意外的援手，又看看你，退了回去。%SPEECH_ON%好，看来只能这样了。佣兵，贵族老爷会知道你今天的过错。%SPEECH_OFF%}

20d0132e6edcfc15b6f4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{You tell the lieutenant you'll have no part of his roaringly unsuccessful recruiting campaign. He nods and draws his sword, his men following suit.%SPEECH_ON%Alright then, if we won't take these gits by the hand, we'll take them by the neck. Anyone who denies the right of the lords' call dies here today.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd shrinks back with the ruffling of poor clothes and timid murmurs. %randombrother% glances at you.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, should we do something? That peacock over there is gonna get a lot of people killed over his pride.%SPEECH_OFF% | The lieutenant taps his boot.%SPEECH_ON%Well, are you gonna help or not?%SPEECH_OFF%You look at the crowd, barefooted and ragged, though a few strong men stand amongst the weak, like trees beside a frail fence. Turning back to the lieutenant, you shake your head no. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Alright men. We sure as shit aren't going back without them. We'll go back with their heads if we have to!%SPEECH_OFF%The man draws his sword and soldiers follow suit. The crowd rears back like a cloud of flies shooed %randombrother% comes to your side.%SPEECH_ON%Should we do something? These idiots are outnumbered, but they'll no doubt get a lot of people killed as they go to their moronic deaths.%SPEECH_OFF%}
20d0132e6edcfc15b6f4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你告诉副官，不打算掺和他这场彻底失败的征兵。他点点头，拔出了剑，手下也纷纷照做。%SPEECH_ON%那好，既然请不动这些贱民，就掐着脖子带走。谁敢抗拒领主征召，今天就死在这里。%SPEECH_OFF%人群畏缩后退，破旧衣服窸窣作响，低语中满是惶恐。%randombrother%看向你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我们要做点什么吗？那只花孔雀为了面子，要害死不少人。%SPEECH_OFF% | 副官不耐烦地用靴尖敲着地。%SPEECH_ON%怎么样，到底帮不帮？%SPEECH_OFF%你望向人群：衣衫褴褛，赤着双脚；几名壮汉站在瘦弱的村民间，像朽篱旁的树木。你转向副官，摇了摇头。他耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，弟兄们。反正他妈的不把他们带走，咱们就不回去。实在不行，把脑袋带回去！%SPEECH_OFF%他拔出剑，士兵随即跟着拔剑。人群如被挥赶的苍蝇般猛地退散，%randombrother%来到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%要出手吗？这帮蠢货人少，可在蠢死之前，肯定要拉不少人陪葬。%SPEECH_OFF%}

d2afd3cc21e175977aa4.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]The nobles' war wasn't your fight. Wrangling up peasants wasn't your fight. And stopping soldiers from slaughtering laymen isn't your fight either. You tell the brothers to stand aside.

 Predictably, the soldiers charge into the crowd, swords swinging, maces clubbing. A few good laymen go down, having nothing to stop the onslaught, but the sheer number of peasants quickly overwhelms the lieutenant and his men. A couple of children push a hovel's chimney over and the rain of stones crushes a soldier into the mud. As the rest of the soldiers pause, a farmer runs up and impales one with a pitchfork and lifts him skyward as though he were a bale of hay. The lieutenant breaks and flees, but he's tripped up by a pair of women who descend upon him with shearing knives.

 After it's all said and done, many villagers and every single soldier is dead. Victorious, the townspeople drag the bannermen into the trees and hang their bodies for further mutilation. The mercenaries thank you for not needlessly getting involved.
d2afd3cc21e175977aa4.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]贵族的战争与你无关。抓农民充军与你无关。阻止士兵屠杀平民，也与你无关。你让弟兄们站到一边。

不出所料，士兵冲进人群，刀剑劈砍，钉锤猛砸。几个无力抵挡的平民倒下了，但农民人数众多，很快淹没了副官和他的手下。几个孩子推倒一间破屋的烟囱，落石把一个士兵砸进泥里。其他士兵愣神之际，一名农夫冲上来，用草叉捅穿其中一人，像挑干草般把他挑到半空。副官吓破了胆，转身逃跑，却被两个女人绊倒，随后便遭她们扑上去用剪羊毛的刀子捅刺。

一切结束后，许多村民死了，士兵更是一个不剩。得胜的村民把士兵拖到树下，吊起尸体继续泄愤。佣兵们感谢你没让他们白白卷进去。

950ae697c6b042f075e9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]There's a choice to be made here - stand with the powerless commoners, or go with the violent ambassadors of those who wield power like the goblet of a drunk wench. Of the two, you figure the latter might serve a greater purpose in the future. You order the %companyname% to stand with the soldiers. It's a quick battle, one which ends with the peasants fleeing across the fields and women begging for the wounded to not be executed. Their pleas are not heard.

 Cleaning his blade, the lieutenant thanks you for saving him and his men.%SPEECH_ON%That wasn't the smartest decision I could have made, but for some reason I knew you'd step in to help out. Been awhile since I had a good day of killin'. Thanks, sellsword. The nobles will hear of your deeds here.%SPEECH_OFF%
950ae697c6b042f075e9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]眼下得选一边：是无权无势的平民，还是那些权贵派来的打手？他们滥用权力，就像醉醺醺的娘们胡乱挥舞酒杯。想来想去，你觉得后者今后更有用，便命令%companyname%协助士兵。战斗很快结束，农民四散逃进田野，女人们苦求别处死伤者。没人理会她们。

副官一边擦剑，一边感谢你救了他和手下。%SPEECH_ON%我刚才那决定是有点蠢，不过不知怎么的，我就觉得你会来帮忙。好久没杀得这么痛快了。谢了，佣兵。贵族老爷会知道你今天的功劳。%SPEECH_OFF%

81175136276f1917196d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]Ah, powerless commoners standing up against the boot of the amoral nobility. You stand with the poorer of the two assholes. As soon as the soldiers clash with the peasants, you order the %companyname% to swoop in behind the bannermen and clean up. Each soldier is swiftly stabbed in the back. You take care of the lieutenant yourself, slicing a dagger across his neck. He turns around, clutching his mortal wound in an attempt to mend the unmendable. Seeing you, his eyes go wide and confused, as though he'd never expected a sellsword to betray him. He coughs out a surge of crimson and then falls to his knees and backward into the mud.

 An elderly man slowly approaches as you clean your blade. He thanks you for saving the village, small it may be, and promises to spread word of your - apparently - 'saintly' reputation.
81175136276f1917196d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]啊，无权无势的平民，要反抗毫无廉耻的贵族踩下来的靴子。这两拨混账里，你选择站在更穷的一边。士兵一与农民交手，你就命令%companyname%从士兵背后扑上去收拾残局。每个士兵都迅速挨了背后一刀。副官由你亲自料理：匕首划过他的脖子。他转过身，捂着致命的伤口，妄想堵住那道再也合不拢的裂口。看见你，他瞪大双眼，满脸错愕，仿佛从未想过佣兵竟会背叛。他咳出一大口鲜血，跪倒下来，随即向后栽进泥里。

你擦拭刀刃时，一个老人缓缓走近。他感谢你救了这座不起眼的小村庄，答应传扬你的美名——照他的说法，简直如同“圣人”。

41850d27c7d59fe9c49b.translation: 协助征召了他们的领民

5a1ddab1dcdbca9add5f.source: Prevented their men from conscripting peasants
5a1ddab1dcdbca9add5f.translation: 阻止了他们的士兵征召农民

80742c3a1a1096356ab2.source: Saved their populace from being conscripted
80742c3a1a1096356ab2.translation: 使他们的领民免遭征召

e15736ca7f155ecf8fbc.source: Helped their men conscript some peasants
e15736ca7f155ecf8fbc.translation: 帮助他们的士兵征召农民

5ca530d482bc1b4abc88.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You happen across a throng of kids scrambling around something in the grass like flies on a shitpile. %randombrother% starts booting them away.%SPEECH_ON%Scamper you larks. Scamper! Oh, damn. Sir, come take a look!%SPEECH_OFF%A fat-faced chubster of a kid yells at you.%SPEECH_ON%I found it first! It's mine!%SPEECH_OFF%You effortlessly palm him out of the way and get a look. There's a dead knight in the grass and he's no doubt been there for a while. A soft tik-tik-tik noise emits from his armor as ants crawl all over it. A little girl holds her nose with a pinch. Somewhat nasally and high-pitched, she tries her hand at some astute diplomacy.%SPEECH_ON%Let 'em have it, Robbie! These men are dangerous! Aren't ya? Aren't ya some dangerous men?%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% unsheathes his weapon and dramatically flashes it around.%SPEECH_ON%The tiny wench is right! Y'all best git before we put ya in the dirt just like we did this here knight! That's right, we are his murderers and we've come back to see our handiwork!%SPEECH_OFF%Screaming and crying, the kids are scattered like birds from a bush. Robbie remains behind, leering over a bush at his lost treasures. You tell the mercenary he didn't need to scare them so badly. He shrugs and starts collecting the knight's gear.
5ca530d482bc1b4abc88.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你遇见一群孩子，围着草里的什么东西争抢，像一窝扑在粪堆上的苍蝇。%randombrother%上去踢赶他们。%SPEECH_ON%滚开，小崽子们，滚！哦，该死。团长，来看看！%SPEECH_OFF%一个圆脸胖小子冲你喊。%SPEECH_ON%是我先找到的！是我的！%SPEECH_OFF%你毫不费力地伸手拨开他，低头查看。草里躺着一名死去的骑士，显然已有些时日。蚂蚁爬满盔甲，发出细微的嗒嗒声。一个小女孩捏着鼻子，用尖细的鼻音，试着说了几句颇有眼色的话。%SPEECH_ON%让给他们吧，罗比！这些人不好惹！是吧？你们都不好惹，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%拔出武器，故作凶狠地来回挥舞。%SPEECH_ON%小丫头说得对！最好赶紧滚，不然我们把你们也埋进土里，就跟这骑士一样！没错，人是我们杀的，现在回来瞧瞧自己的杰作！%SPEECH_OFF%孩子们哭喊着四散逃开，如同惊出灌木的鸟。只有罗比还躲在一丛灌木后，愤愤地盯着失去的宝贝。你告诉那佣兵，没必要把孩子们吓成这样。他耸耸肩，开始收拾骑士的装备。

620cfe8078b1408b686f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%thief% eyes Robbie who you notice is beginning to sweat. The sellsword points a finger.%SPEECH_ON%You're not just a fat piece of shit, kid. What are you hiding under your shirt? You won't fool a thief, c'mon, show it!%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, Robbie lifts his shirt and a bunch of crowns go clattering into the grass. The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%That's what I thought. Now git.%SPEECH_OFF%
620cfe8078b1408b686f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%thief%盯住罗比，你注意到那小子开始冒汗了。佣兵伸手一指。%SPEECH_ON%小子，你肚子上可不全是肥肉。衣服底下藏了什么？想骗过一个贼？快，掀开给我看看！%SPEECH_OFF%罗比叹了口气，撩起上衣，一堆克朗哗啦啦落进草丛。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%果然不出我所料。现在滚吧。%SPEECH_OFF%

5dc31fe51f2899441bbd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]{While on the road you come across two soldiers of %noblehouse%'s army and they're stringing up what it appears to be one of their own.
