There's a war a comin'.%SPEECH_OFF%Believing this snarky little runt isn't high on your to do list. You ask how he knows that. He smiles again.%SPEECH_ON%I fetch water for a man who wears silk britches. He said, 'I can give ye some sweets, or give ye something to think about.' I said tell me something good. He said, 'the nobility are gonna fight one another.' So that's what I'm telling ya.%SPEECH_OFF%The kid pauses.%SPEECH_ON%Say, ya wouldn't happen to have any sweets, would ya? Hey... hey!%SPEECH_OFF%You push the kid's head back into the bushes. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]An old man and a fair-skinned maiden meets you on the road. She's twisting a braid of hair over a shoulder, glancing at a couple of your better looking men with plying eyes. Before you get a word out, she asks if you're going to fight for %noblehouse% or %noblehouse2%.%SPEECH_ON%They say a prince ran off with a princess, said it t'was a matter of love. Isn't that dreamy?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug. The elderly man hocks and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Don't bother the sellswords with your fantasies, woman. Sorry, mercenary, she gets these ideas in her head and I don't know where from. The houses are talking of war, but it sure as shite ain't over a prancing prince or some punter of a princess. Economics! That's the issue. Long standing trade agreements are falling apart just like the paper they was written upon. Let me tell you, I was there when they...%SPEECH_OFF%The old fart dawdles on. You much preferred the lady's story, as ludicrous as it sounded. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]You come across a man sitting atop a signpost. He's tightening strings on a lute and testing the sounds.%SPEECH_ON%Mmhmm, that was better, wouldn't you agree? Just agree.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask the man what he is doing. He jumps off the signpost and lands arms and legs out like a jester at the end of his act.%SPEECH_ON%Practicing! War is comin', heard on the winds m'self, and with war comes a need for... for... for... c'mon, you can do it, entertainment! That's right! And in any call for nightly pleasures is a call for me - and in more ways than one, let me tell ya.%SPEECH_OFF%He pirouettes and grins. You've never seen a man with a whiter smile and you have a strong urge to blacken it dearly. The minstrel prances down the path.%SPEECH_ON%Don't you worry, sellsword, with the nobles fighting amongst themselves there shall never be a shortage of work for men of your, er, talents. G'day!%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]More and more, you're coming across peasants and merchants murmuring about a war between the noble houses. Your station as a sellsword has them asking you which side you are planning to carry your banner for. If these rumors are true, then the %companyname% stands to make a great deal of coin out of the misery wrought between pompous highborn. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]You come across a number of gamblers on the road. They've positioned little flags representing all the noble families of the land. The bookie is writing down notes and looks over his scroll.%SPEECH_ON%Now remember, the results of this war between houses isn't going to be obvious for some time. Hell, I most of ye will be conscripted. But all who survive shall return to me in one year's time. From there, we will pay out the monies to those who bet on the winning noble house. Deal?%SPEECH_OFF%Crooked faced and slackjawed peasants shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Sounds like a deal to me!%SPEECH_OFF%The bookie grins, a golden incisor glinting ever so slightly.%SPEECH_ON%Great!%SPEECH_OFF%He takes the bets in a satchel and loads up for the road, most likely to never return again. Truly a shame what sorta nonsense the lowborn get themselves into. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]During your travels, you keep hearing a particularly interesting rumor: that the noble houses are positioning for war. If true, the %companyname% could stand to make a lot of coin, particularly if it chooses a winning side. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_23.png[/img]Peasant after peasant is telling the same story lately. In fact, they seem to be repeating it every time you meet them...

 War. War is on their lips. The noble houses are squabbling over something you could care less about, but what it means is war, and war means crowns for a sellsword, and crowns are good, so war is good. Should these rumors be true, the %companyname% should measure its options carefully and choose a noblehouse to support in the conflict to come. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]You've noticed recruiters for the noble houses are afoot, pulling young, fresh men out of their homes. Conscription isn't unordinary, but typically you still need the fellas to farm the fields. If the highborn are leaving that to the womenfolk, then it means something else is of greater import, and that something else is undoubtedly a brewing war. The %companyname% should prepare itself for the worst - well, the worst for everyone else. A war between rich arseholes is the greatest time to be a sellsword!}
46ab0b650c499b7f8b2f.translation:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]你在路上遇见一个陌生人，羊和狗懒散地聚在他身边。他用冷硬的目光打量你。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，你该不会正准备替%noblehouse%打仗吧？听说他们跟其他家族吵起来了。为的什么，我不懂。我只知道，他们会来我家，说‘%randomname%，来替我们打仗，不然吊死你’，然后我说‘好吧’。一群穿金戴银的贵族老爷毁掉我这一年的日子，也算生活的一部分。生活嘛，本就不公平。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]战团行进时，一个女人站在路边，上下打量你们的纹章。%SPEECH_ON%哼，这个不认识。想必贵族老爷很快就要雇你们了。%SPEECH_OFF%你问她什么意思。她耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%听说那些装腔作势的小杂碎，为一桩搞砸的王室婚事闹翻了。吵吵嚷嚷，说什么要打仗，诸如此类的狗屁。他们总有事可吵，迟早要拔剑互砍，或者叫我们这些穷人替他们砍。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]一个坐着抽烟斗的老人，隔着烟雾久久打量战团。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，是吧？接下来的日子，你们会有不少好差事。%SPEECH_OFF%你问是什么意思。他把烟斗磕在椅子上，清掉烟灰。%SPEECH_ON%哦，你懂的。那些戴羽毛的贵族，又像孔雀一样斗起来了。战争要来了，准没错——总不能白白浪费这大好天气。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]一名信使沿路走来，空挎包晃来晃去。%SPEECH_ON%啊，消息都送完了。不过你若有兴趣，我倒听说些传闻。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%我就知道。有时贵族老爷叫我过去，给我文件送走。有时呢，小人物如我，也会偷听几句。他们嘴里尽是军队，还有什么‘咱们得征服那帮狗娘养的’。所以，佣兵，你很快就该有好生意了。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%嘘，嘘！喂！%SPEECH_OFF%你转头，看见一个男孩从灌木里探出脑袋，正冲你笑。%SPEECH_ON%喂，我有事告诉你。快打仗了。%SPEECH_OFF%你可不怎么相信这油嘴滑舌的小崽子，便问他从哪儿知道的。他又笑了。%SPEECH_ON%我替一个穿丝绸裤子的人打水。他说，‘我可以给你些糖，也可以给你个值得琢磨的消息。’我说，那就讲个有意思的。他说，‘贵族要互相开战了。’我这就告诉你啦。%SPEECH_OFF%孩子顿了顿。%SPEECH_ON%对了，你该不会恰好有糖吧？喂……喂！%SPEECH_OFF%你把他的脑袋推回灌木丛。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]路上，你遇见一个老人和一位肤色白皙的姑娘。她绕着垂在肩上的发辫，向几个模样俊俏的弟兄暗送秋波。你还没开口，她就问，你打算替%noblehouse%还是%noblehouse2%作战。%SPEECH_ON%听说一位王子带着公主私奔了，说是为了爱情。多浪漫呀？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸肩。老人清嗓吐痰。%SPEECH_ON%丫头，别拿你那些幻想烦佣兵。抱歉，佣兵，她脑子里尽是这种念头，我也不知道哪儿来的。各家确实在谈开战，可他妈的绝不是为了什么轻浮王子、花痴公主。经济！那才是症结。多年的贸易协议，就跟写协议的纸一样，一张张破了。跟你说，当年他们……%SPEECH_OFF%老东西滔滔不绝。比起这个，你还是更喜欢姑娘的故事，尽管听起来荒唐。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]你遇见一个坐在路牌顶上的男人，正在拧紧鲁特琴弦，拨弄试听。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，这下好多了，对吧？你只管说对。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，问他在干什么。他从路牌上跳下，张开四肢落地，像小丑刚演完最后一幕。%SPEECH_ON%练习！战争要来了，我亲耳听到了风声。有了战争，就少不了……少不了……少不了……来呀，你猜得到的，消遣！对喽！夜里想找乐子，自然得找我。而且我能给的乐子，还不止一种呢。%SPEECH_OFF%他转个圈，咧嘴笑了。你从没见过哪个男人的牙这么白，忍不住想给它们添点黑。吟游诗人蹦跳着沿路走去。%SPEECH_ON%放心吧，佣兵，贵族彼此打起来，像你这样有，呃，特殊本领的人，永远不愁没活干。日安！%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]近来，越来越多农民和商人低声议论贵族家族即将开战。知道你是佣兵，他们便问，你打算把旗帜立在哪一边。如果传闻属实，这些傲慢权贵酿出的苦难，会让%companyname%大赚一笔。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]你在路上遇见一群赌徒。他们摆出小旗，分别代表各个贵族家族。庄家记着账，抬眼越过卷轴说道：%SPEECH_ON%记住，这场家族战争一时半会儿分不出胜负。见鬼，你们大半人恐怕还得被征去当兵。不过，凡是活下来的，一年后都来找我。到时谁押中了获胜的家族，我们就给谁钱。说定了？%SPEECH_OFF%几个歪脸呆相的农民耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我看成！%SPEECH_OFF%庄家咧嘴一笑，金门牙微微闪光。%SPEECH_ON%好极了！%SPEECH_OFF%他把赌资装进挎包，收拾上路，多半再也不会回来。平民百姓总会卷进这种荒唐事，实在可悲。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]旅途中，你不断听见一条颇有意思的传闻：贵族家族正在调兵备战。如果属实，%companyname%就能大赚一笔，尤其是选对胜利的一方。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_23.png[/img]最近，一个又一个农民都在讲同一件事。事实上，仿佛每次遇见他们，都要再讲一遍……

战争。他们嘴里说的全是战争。贵族家族正为某件你毫不在乎的事情争吵，可争吵意味着战争，战争意味着佣兵有克朗可挣，而克朗是好东西，所以战争也是好东西。如果传闻属实，%companyname%就该仔细权衡，在即将到来的冲突中选一个家族支持。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]你注意到，各贵族家族的征兵者已开始四处活动，把年轻壮实的男人从家里带走。征兵不算稀奇，可通常总得有人种田。若贵族连农活都交给女人去做，便说明另有更要紧的事，而那毫无疑问，就是正在酝酿的战争。%companyname%该为最坏的局面做好准备——对其他人最坏的局面。阔佬混账们打起来，正是当佣兵的最好时候！}

e3953854668f8ac63f9e.source: We better leave him alone and move on.

32cdf681b2e0f71fc8e8.source: That armor and weapon may be useful, and he won't be needing them in the afterlife.
32cdf681b2e0f71fc8e8.translation: 那副护甲和武器还有用，他到了来世也用不着。

357655a6c14ac43ac493.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_21.png[/img]{You unsheathe your sword and approach the soldier. He cries out, but it is brief, ending on the sharp twang of your blade running his tongue through the back of his head. Gargling, he batters the metal of the killing blow before settling down. Shivering eyes look up at you as a cold death takes him. Retrieving your sword, you look over your shoulder and tell the men to take everything he had on him. You wipe your blade on the cloth of the dead man's banner. | The man sees in the intent in your eyes and quickly raises his voice, but you dash forward, unsheathing your blade and running it through his brainpan in one swift motion. He dies, and you feel a pang in your side. Not a moral one, but an older, more real pain. %randombrother% steadies you with a hand on your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Easy, sir, you're not as limber as you once were.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you clean your blade and tell the men to loot what they can. | The soldier leans back.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, I see.%SPEECH_OFF%He lifts his neck.%SPEECH_ON%You got me. I'll go out like a man should.%SPEECH_OFF%With a quick cut, he puts his head back down, a bubbling crimson froth running down his chest. Your men loot what they can. | You take out your dagger. The man lifts his weapon, but you kick it aside. His arm falls effortlessly, as though you'd actually just relieved him of a huge burden. He stares up at you.%SPEECH_ON%Wait...%SPEECH_OFF%That is his last word. He tries to utter something else, but the massive gash you've opened across his throat only produces horrid gargling. You order %randombrother% to loot all that he can from the body.}
357655a6c14ac43ac493.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_21.png[/img]{你拔剑走向士兵。他叫出声来，却只叫了短短一下：剑刃刺穿舌头，贯入后脑，利落地终结了呼声。他喉中咯咯作响，拍打着夺命的剑身，随后渐渐安静。冰冷的死亡攫住他，颤动的双眼还望着你。你抽回剑，回头让弟兄们把他身上的东西全部取走，又在死者的旗布上擦净剑刃。 | 那人看出你眼中的杀意，立刻高喊，可你已冲上前，拔剑、刺入头颅，一气呵成。他死了，你肋侧却猛地一痛。不是良心作祟，而是更久远、更实在的旧伤。%randombrother%伸手扶住你的肩，让你站稳。%SPEECH_ON%慢点，团长。你可没以前那么灵便了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，擦净剑刃，让弟兄们把能拿的都拿走。 | 那人向后靠了靠。%SPEECH_ON%啊，我懂了。%SPEECH_OFF%他仰起脖子。%SPEECH_ON%栽在你手里了。我会像个男人一样死。%SPEECH_OFF%利刃迅速划过，他的头垂了下去，猩红的血沫沿胸口淌下。弟兄们搜走一切能拿的东西。 | 你抽出匕首。那人抬起武器，却被你一脚踢开。胳膊随即无力垂下，仿佛你反倒替他卸下了一副重担。他仰头看着你。%SPEECH_ON%等等……%SPEECH_OFF%这是他最后的话。他还想再说什么，可你割开的喉咙只能发出骇人的咯咯声。你命令%randombrother%搜走尸体上一切能用的东西。}

58164ecfc69423839225.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{You take out your sword and step toward the man. He puts his hand up and you drive the blade through his palm and straight into his brainpan. His tongue lolls his final words, some slobbering bloodslaked utterance. Cleaning your blade, you turn to %randombrother%, only to see bannermen standing on the horizon.%SPEECH_ON%Oh bloody shite. Everybody run!%SPEECH_OFF%The %companyname% makes a quick, though messy escape, bounding through copses and creekbeds and doubling back and hiding and silently killing one hound dog before it could bark. You manage to get away in the end, but without time to take anything. | You take out your sword and plunge it into the man's chest. He reaches out and grabs you by your shirt, pulling himself up the blade. He bears his teeth in a bloodying grin.%SPEECH_ON%Go fark yourself, mercenary. I'll see you on the other side.%SPEECH_OFF%He lets go and falls back, a gush of red spewing out as your sword leaves him. Suddenly, %randombrother% calls to you, his voice pitched high.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, we should go! The bannermen, look!%SPEECH_OFF%Standing atop a nearby hill are the riders of %noblehouse% and they no doubt saw what you did. Shouting as loud as you can, you order the men to beat a quick retreat. Although you manage to get away, you no doubt exchanged for good will of your potential employer. | The soldier laughs as you bear down on him. He laughs as you stick him in the chest with your sword. And he laughs, a final, tired guffaw, as you retrieve your blade. His eyes fade staring beyond you at a nearby hill where, apparently, the killing joke stands: the soldier's bannermen are astride the horizon, having ostensibly seen your deed.

Shouting, you order the %companyname% to make a hasty retreat lest a whole army bear down on you and slaughter you to a man. In the hurried flight you forego taking any prize for your deed. A reasonable exchange for keeping your heads on your shoulders, though. | With a quick slash of your sword you open the man's throat. He claps his hand over the wound, but his life slips between his fingers quite literally. As he falls over, %randombrother% shouts to you.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, look!%SPEECH_OFF%The soldier's fellow bannermen are standing on a far hill, no doubt having seen what you just did. With a quick order, you get the %companyname% on a hurried withdrawal, leaving the area as quick as you can before an entire army bears down on top of you. In the frenzied retreat you have no time to take any prize for your bloody deed.}
58164ecfc69423839225.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]{你拔剑走向那人。他抬手阻挡，你的剑穿透手掌，直入颅骨。他的舌头费力吐出最后几个字，含混不清，裹着血沫。你擦拭剑刃，转向%randombrother%，却看见天边站着一队士兵。%SPEECH_ON%他妈的，见鬼。所有人，快跑！%SPEECH_OFF%%companyname%逃得飞快，却也狼狈不堪：钻树林，穿溪床，折返，藏匿，还赶在一条猎犬吠叫前悄悄杀了它。最终总算脱身，却根本没来得及拿走任何东西。 | 你拔剑刺进那人的胸膛。他伸手抓住你的衣襟，迎着剑刃将自己拉近，露出满口血的笑。%SPEECH_ON%去你妈的，佣兵。咱们那边见。%SPEECH_OFF%他松手后仰，剑身退出，鲜血随之涌出。突然，%randombrother%尖声喊你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，得走了！看，那些士兵！%SPEECH_OFF%附近的山顶站着%noblehouse%的骑兵，无疑已看见你做了什么。你扯着嗓子，命令手下立即撤退。虽然最终脱身，可潜在雇主对你的好感，显然已经赔了进去。 | 你逼近时，士兵在笑。你用剑刺入他胸口时，他仍在笑。等你抽回剑，他还挤出了最后一声疲惫的大笑。眼神渐黯，目光却越过你，望向附近的山丘。那里显然站着这场致命笑话的包袱：他的同袍列在天际，看来已目睹你的所作所为。

你高喊着命令%companyname%赶紧撤离，免得整支大军压上来，把你们杀个精光。仓促逃命之下，这次下手没捞到任何好处。不过，能保住项上人头，这买卖也算合理。 | 你迅速挥剑，割开那人的喉咙。他猛地捂住伤口，生命却真的从指缝间流走。他倒下时，%randombrother%向你高喊：%SPEECH_ON%团长，快看！%SPEECH_OFF%远处山坡上站着伤兵的同袍，显然看见了你刚才做的事。你立刻下令，让%companyname%迅速撤离，在整支大军扑上来之前，尽快离开此地。这一通慌忙逃窜，让你完全没空为这桩血腥勾当收取战利品。}

ba19114c0b5832f571af.translation: 自大误事！好歹还没送命！

5d9cb87355453a4c9ab1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{Cresting a small hill, you see a caravan of people along the road. They're trundling down the path with pots and pans clinking along the wagon sides, children swinging their legs off the edges, women at the front bidding the draught animals forward with sharp whippings. Men march together, looking at a map and arguing over it, gesticulating in different directions to show a difference in geographic opinion. And then, further up the road, beyond the travelers' eyes, are a few goblins laying in the grass. %randombrother% sees them, too, and comments.%SPEECH_ON%We'd best get down there now, sir, before there's a slaughter.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother2% shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Or... we let the goblins make their move, then we swoop in and clean up the mess. Easier to fight them when they're tangled up, no?%SPEECH_OFF%}
5d9cb87355453a4c9ab1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{登上一座小丘，你看见一队赶路的人。货车沿路缓缓前行，两侧锅碗瓢盆叮当作响，孩子坐在车沿晃腿，前头的女人扬鞭催赶牲口。男人们聚在一起步行，围着地图争论，不时指向不同方向，用手势表明各自对方位的看法。再往前，旅人看不到的地方，几个地精正伏在草里。%randombrother%也看见了，说道：%SPEECH_ON%团长，最好现在就下去，免得酿成屠杀。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother2%耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%或者……先让地精动手，咱们再冲下去收拾残局。它们缠斗起来，岂不是更好打？%SPEECH_OFF%}

f2a35a3312ecc5cb1957.source: We wait for the goblins to attack first, then we charge!
f2a35a3312ecc5cb1957.translation: 先等地精动手，然后我们再冲！

70e13b9ca1aca1743520.source: We don't need to get involved in this. March on!

de7c6830172d4eb3ac99.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]{You won't sacrifice these innocent people for tactical advantage! You order the men to attack now. The goblins immediately hear you come and turn face. In the distance, the peasants clear out, seeing the danger ahead. It appears you've saved them, but now you'll have to face the goblins in whole!}
de7c6830172d4eb3ac99.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]{你不肯为了战术上的便宜牺牲这些无辜者，当即命令弟兄们出击。地精立刻听见动静，转身迎敌。远处的农民发现前方有险，纷纷逃开。看来你救下了他们，不过现在得独自迎战全部地精了！}

da5f1ab2e54a445113ed.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_83.png[/img]{With the goblins taken care of, the peasants slowly bring their wagons back around. They look at the scene with plenty of awe. One shakes your hand.%SPEECH_ON%By all the old gods, everyone we meet shall hear the name of the %companyname%!%SPEECH_OFF%A few others give you food, kisses, and plenty of thanks.}
da5f1ab2e54a445113ed.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_83.png[/img]{地精被消灭后，农民们慢慢把货车赶回来，敬畏地望着战场。其中一人握住你的手。%SPEECH_ON%我向所有旧神起誓，今后遇见的每一个人，都会听到%companyname%的名字！%SPEECH_OFF%其他人送上食物、亲吻和道不尽的谢意。}

8482f4149fa85ad424e8.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{You order the men to wait for the right moment.

 When the peasants march further down the road, the goblins waylaid them with a volley of poison arrows. The arguing men go down, arrows stuck in their chests, muscles stiffening, faces drawn taut as the poison courses through. A few other men grab the reins from their wives and steer the wagons around. Some stand guard, a bunch of pitchfork-carrying farmers for a  rearguard, but they don't last long in the face of the dishonorable gobbos. Seeing that the goblins are scattered in their attack, you order the %companyname% to begin its own ambush.}
8482f4149fa85ad424e8.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{你命令弟兄们等候时机。

农民们再往前走了一段，地精便射出一轮毒箭，发动伏击。争论不休的男人们胸口中箭，纷纷倒下。毒液流遍全身，肌肉僵硬，脸也绷得扭曲。其他几个男人从妻子手里抢过缰绳，掉转货车。有人留下断后，不过是一群拿草叉的农夫，在卑鄙的地精面前撑不了多久。眼看地精进攻时已经散开，你便命令%companyname%发动自己的伏击。}

b08a80afcdec60595b06.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_83.png[/img]{The scattered remains of the traveling peasants slowly emerge out of the strewn battlefield. An old man shakes your hand.%SPEECH_ON%Thank ye, sir, had you not happened upon us we would have all been green-meat!%SPEECH_OFF%But before he can let your hand go, another, younger man springs over, pointing with a finger.%SPEECH_ON%To hell with that, old man, I saw that bastard up on the hill just watching the whole time! He left us out as bait!%SPEECH_OFF%The old man yanks his hand back.%SPEECH_ON%Well I'll be. May you experience all the hells, sellsword!%SPEECH_OFF%Like you give a shite. You tell the old man that anything you find is yours. If they want to protest, they can stick their mouth on the end of a blade for all you care.}
b08a80afcdec60595b06.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_83.png[/img]{赶路农民中剩下的幸存者，渐渐从凌乱的战场上聚拢。一个老人握住你的手。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，大人。要不是你恰好赶来，我们全得成绿皮的口粮！%SPEECH_OFF%他的手还没松开，一个年轻些的男人便冲了过来，伸手指着你。%SPEECH_ON%去他妈的，老头！我看见这混蛋一直站在山上看戏！他把我们当诱饵！%SPEECH_OFF%老人猛地抽回手。%SPEECH_ON%真没想到。佣兵，愿所有地狱都让你尝个遍！%SPEECH_OFF%说得好像你在乎似的。你告诉老人，搜到的东西都归你。有意见，大可以对着剑尖去说，你才不管。}

bef6b7451b8cd586eec8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]{One way or another, this isn't your problem. You quietly leave the scene, though a few brothers are rather disturbed that you left those poor peasants to such a gruesome fate, particularly when the whole realm is trying to survive these green savages.}
bef6b7451b8cd586eec8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]{不管怎么说，这都不关你的事。你悄悄带人离开。几个弟兄却很不安：眼下整个国度都在苦苦抵御这些绿皮野蛮人，你却仍把可怜的农民丢给如此残酷的命运。}

69ea93d3cf1a101571f4.source: Disappointed that you avoided battle and let peasants die
69ea93d3cf1a101571f4.translation: 因你避战、任由农民丧命而失望

e51fb18e6a77025aefeb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]%randombrother% enters your tent.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, we got a group of refugees out here that'd like to talk to you.%SPEECH_OFF%You set aside your quill pen and go to meet them. They're an awful mess, looking more like dishrags thrown to the mud than people. One, a man nursing a nub where his hand used to be, steps forward and speaks.%SPEECH_ON%I take it you're the one in charge?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask the man what has happened and why it concerns the company. He explains, gesticulating with his one good hand.%SPEECH_ON%The greenskins are attacking.%SPEECH_OFF%Well, that's nothing new. You ask where they are and if they're goblins or orcs. The man shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Well, see, that's just the thing. It's both. They're... they're working together. Hordes of them as numerous as the blades of grass beneath our feet. I misspoke, in a way. What I should have said is that they aren't just attacking, they're INVADING. All of them. Together. An invasion beyond any scope or measure, don't you understand?%SPEECH_OFF%You look at the crowd of refugees. Children huddled beneath the skirts of their mothers, men looking lost. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%My father fought in the Battle of Many Names. He always did say they'd come back and now I suppose he's right. We hear the noble houses are panicking and might join forces, lest we all be overrun! If you want my advice, I say stay out of it. Those hordes... there's no stopping them. And the things they do...%SPEECH_OFF%You grab the man by his shirt.%SPEECH_ON%The things they do don't worry me. Get out of here, peasant, and leave the fighting to the fighters.%SPEECH_OFF%
e51fb18e6a77025aefeb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]%randombrother%走进帐篷。%SPEECH_ON%团长，外头来了一群难民，想跟你说话。%SPEECH_OFF%你放下羽毛笔，出去见他们。这些人狼狈不堪，与其说像人，不如说像扔进泥里的抹布。一个捧着断手残端的男人上前问道：%SPEECH_ON%你就是管事的吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，问出了什么事，又与战团有何关系。他用仅剩的好手比画着解释。%SPEECH_ON%绿皮正在袭击我们。%SPEECH_OFF%这倒不新鲜。你问敌人在哪里，是地精还是兽人。那人摇头。%SPEECH_ON%问题就在这儿，两种都有。他们……他们联手了。成群结队，多得像脚下的草叶。说起来，我刚才用错了词。他们不只是袭击，而是在大举入侵！全都来了，一起！规模之大，根本无法想象，也无从计数，你明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你望向难民。孩子缩在母亲裙下，男人们一脸茫然。那人接着说：%SPEECH_ON%我父亲打过众名之战。他总说绿皮会再来，如今看来，他说对了。听说贵族家族都慌了，可能要联手，否则大家全得被淹没！要听我的劝，就别掺和。那些大军……根本挡不住。还有他们干的那些事……%SPEECH_OFF%你揪住他的衣襟。%SPEECH_ON%他们干什么，吓不倒我。农民，离开这里，把打仗的事留给会打仗的人。%SPEECH_OFF%

12968e2dad6e9ec8ea64.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]While you restock your inventory and give the men some rest, the lord of the castle, %nobleman%, calls for you. He says that there is a goblin loose in the castle and he wants you to track it down.%SPEECH_ON%I'd ask my men, but they couldn't find their own arses even if they ate their eyes and shat them out.%SPEECH_OFF%
12968e2dad6e9ec8ea64.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你正补充物资、让弟兄们休息，城堡领主%nobleman%派人召见你。他说有个地精在城堡里乱窜，要你把它找出来。%SPEECH_ON%我倒想交给自己的人，可那帮废物就算把眼珠吞下去再拉出来，也找不着自己的屁股。%SPEECH_OFF%

c656359e7b44b8323d5d.translation: 我们去搜查粮食储藏室。

a78a72c2d19188cd647f.source: We have no time for favors.

bff9d2a332519d5208ed.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You search the pantry, opening the door to shelves upon shelves of foodstuffs from cheeses to salted meats to vegetables which dangle from wall hooks. Wickerwork carboys tempt you, but just as you reach out to get a taste a shape darts across your peripheral. You turn, blade in hand, and stab the goblin just as it lunges toward you with a broken bottle. It dies instantly and makes quite a mess of the floor, ruining a couple bags of flour. The greenskin killed, you calmly drag it to %nobleman%. The nobleman puts his hands to his hips.%SPEECH_ON%Most impressive, sellsword, but did you have to drag it all the way here? My servants will have to scrub the floor for weeks!%SPEECH_OFF%
bff9d2a332519d5208ed.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你搜查食品储藏室。推开门，满眼都是一架架食物，从奶酪、腌肉，到挂在墙钩上的蔬菜，应有尽有。包着柳条的大酒瓶颇为诱人，可你刚伸手想尝一口，余光中便有道影子窜过。你握剑转身，恰逢地精拿着破酒瓶扑来，便一剑刺中了它。它当场死去，把地板弄得一片狼藉，连几袋面粉也糟蹋了。杀掉绿皮后，你若无其事地把尸体拖到%nobleman%面前。贵族双手叉腰。%SPEECH_ON%了不起，佣兵，可你非得一路拖到这里吗？我的仆人得擦上好几个星期的地板！%SPEECH_OFF%

5be94f0ab93819257264.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You go down to the pantry and open the door. Inside, you find shelves upon shelves of foods and goods. There also happens to be a man and woman having a good shag in the corner. They yelp like a couple of pups and cover themselves, the man using a wet flour bag, the woman strategically angling herself behind a shelf of melons. The man clears his throat.%SPEECH_ON%Please, sir, do not tell %nobleman%.%SPEECH_OFF%You were not even aware that this was the nobleman's wife, but now it's good to know. The man offers a deal.%SPEECH_ON%Look, I'm just a stable boy. I can't offer you gold or nothing like that, but a famous jouster is staying here for a week and I can nab you his shield. It's a right pretty thing and you'll love it, I promise. All I ask is that you don't tell the lord!%SPEECH_OFF%
5be94f0ab93819257264.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你下到食品储藏室，打开门，里面层层货架堆满吃食和杂物。角落里还恰好有一男一女正在亲热。他们像小狗般惊叫，急忙遮身：男人拿起潮湿的面粉袋，女人则巧妙地躲到一架瓜果后面。男人清了清嗓子。%SPEECH_ON%求你了，大人，千万别告诉%nobleman%。%SPEECH_OFF%你原本还不知道这是贵族的妻子，如今倒是知道了。男人提出条件。%SPEECH_ON%听着，我只是个马夫，拿不出金子之类的东西。不过，一位有名的比武骑士要在这里住一周，我能替你弄到他的盾。那东西漂亮极了，我保证你会喜欢。只求你别告诉领主！%SPEECH_OFF%

af67ce111ae2705f03e3.source: Your lord will hear of this.
af67ce111ae2705f03e3.translation: 我会把这事告诉你们的领主。

3cbd8e84ba0409075f67.source: Your secret is safe with me.
3cbd8e84ba0409075f67.translation: 你的秘密，我会守口如瓶。

dafca180204cc02ab056.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]This seems as good of a time as any to develop a steady relationship with %townname%, and the best way to go about doing that is absolutely ruining this relationship you've stumbled upon. You return to %nobleman%'s room and report your findings. His face goes red, his knuckles a stark white.%SPEECH_ON%I figured. I figured. I farkin' figured! But the stable boy? I will not be so insulted!%SPEECH_OFF%He snaps his finger to his guards.%SPEECH_ON%Bring me tongs and a blacksmith's fire. Take my 'wife' to the tower. I'll deal with her later. And you, sellsword, thank you for bringing this news to me. As for the goblin, it's been found and taken care of. You need not worry about that no longer.%SPEECH_OFF%
dafca180204cc02ab056.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]眼下正是与%townname%建立稳固关系的好机会，而最佳办法，就是彻底毁掉你偶然撞见的那段关系。你回到%nobleman%的房间，禀报所见。他满脸通红，攥紧的指节却白得分明。%SPEECH_ON%我就知道，我就知道，我他妈的早就知道！可竟然是个马夫？我绝不容忍这种羞辱！%SPEECH_OFF%他向卫兵打了个响指。%SPEECH_ON%拿钳子来，把铁匠的炉子烧旺。把我的‘妻子’带到塔里，待会儿再收拾她。至于你，佣兵，谢谢你告诉我这些。地精已经找到并处理了，你不用再操心。%SPEECH_OFF%

cdd7bd66d1cbf9aef996.translation: 真是蛮横地坏了人家的好事。

010d43821786bb92e5e9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You decide not to tell the nobleman of what is wife is up to. The two lovebirds get dressed and hurry out of the pantry, the stable boy pausing to tell you he'll have that shield ready when you leave the castle. In the meantime, you report to the lord who stays you with a hand.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, you need not worry yourself any longer, sellsword. The goblin was found in the stables. One of the horses kicked it clear across the barn! I'll have to reward the stable boy on the soldiering abilities of his steeds!%SPEECH_OFF%Hmm, of course.

 When you leave the castle, the stable boy is there, a suspiciously shield-shaped sack in his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Here, take this. Hurry. And thanks again, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him it'd be best if he kept it in his pants from now on. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Nah. She's worth it. See you later, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%
010d43821786bb92e5e9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你决定不把妻子的所作所为告诉贵族。那对鸳鸯穿好衣服，匆忙走出储藏室；马夫停了一下，保证等你离开城堡时，盾牌一定备好。你先去向领主复命，他抬手打断。%SPEECH_ON%啊，不必再费心了，佣兵。地精在马厩里找到了，一匹马把它踢得横飞过整个棚子！马夫把马养得这么能打，得好好奖赏他！%SPEECH_OFF%嗯，当然。

你离开城堡时，马夫等在那里，手中的袋子形状可疑，实在太像盾牌。%SPEECH_ON%给，拿着，快点。再次谢谢你，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你劝他往后最好管住裤裆。他摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不，她值得。回见，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%

4d3030d2bfe9f3870695.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You investigate the halls to see if the little green runt is footing about. Walking down a hallway, you hear the cry of two women come from a nearby room. You draw your sword and barge in. A scribe and treasurer are standing atop a desk while a little goblin jumps up and down to try and knife their ankles. You casually walk in and stab the greenskin through the chest and loft it up like a skewered squirrel. The men calm down and thank you for your work. You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Anytime, ladies.%SPEECH_OFF%They clear their throats and offers nervous smiles. You head on back to %nobleman% and get your pay.
4d3030d2bfe9f3870695.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你搜查走廊，看看那绿色小崽子是否在附近乱窜。走着走着，邻近房间传来仿佛两个女人的尖叫。你拔剑闯入，只见书记员和财务官站在桌上，一个小地精在下面蹦来跳去，想用刀割他们的脚踝。你若无其事地走近，一剑刺穿绿皮胸膛，像挑起一只穿串的松鼠般把它挑起。两人平静下来，向你道谢。你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%随时效劳，两位女士。%SPEECH_OFF%他们清了清嗓子，紧张地陪笑。你回去找%nobleman%领钱。

e13aea6d8f77c2e22455.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You figure the halls are as good a place as any to start your search. No more than a few twists and turns later do you hear a disturbing noise coming from the treasury. Drawing your blade, you ease up next to the door and then shoulder it open, leveling your weapon at whatever may stand on the other side. Instead of a goblin, you find a young and old man who jump in a fright, each with trousers well dropped, and there's a tub of slopped butter on the desk against which they had been leaning. The room smells... awful.

 Dressing themselves, the younger fellow states that he is the treasurer while the elder informs you of his position as scribe. The treasurer quickly offers you a good deal of coin to keep silent about these delicate matters. You laugh.%SPEECH_ON%I won't be falling for that trick. If I take that coin, you simply run along to your lord and tell him I stole it, no? What better way to protect yourself than to ensure my execution?%SPEECH_OFF%The treasurer retreats and the scribe steps forward. He is an elderly man who smells of arse and candlewax.%SPEECH_ON%In my repository, I have many things which are owned by me, not my lord. These items might be of great interest to you. Potions, drinks, goods which a fighting man such as yourself could make use of. And... and I'll throw in a wardog! A local houndmaster owes me a favor and now is as good of a time as any to call upon it!%SPEECH_OFF%The scribe laughs nervously as you mull the idea over. If you turned them in, who knows what may happen. Sodomites bother you none, but there are lords across the realm who consider such fornications to be abhorrent. If %nobleman% is such a fellow, you might gain favor by 'rooting' these men out.
e13aea6d8f77c2e22455.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你觉得先搜走廊也不错。才拐过几个弯，就听见库房传出令人不安的声响。你拔剑，悄悄贴近房门，用肩膀撞开，将武器平举，指向门后的任何东西。里面却没有地精，只有一老一少两个成年男人，惊得跳了起来，裤子都褪在下面，倚靠的桌上放着一盆抹得乱七八糟的黄油。屋里的气味……一言难尽。

两人一边穿衣，一边说明身份：年轻的是财务官，年长的是书记员。财务官立刻许诺一大笔钱，要你对这桩难以启齿的事情保密。你笑了。%SPEECH_ON%这套骗不了我。我拿钱，你就去告诉领主，说是我偷的，对吧？要保住自己，还有什么比送我去死更稳妥？%SPEECH_OFF%财务官退后，书记员上前。这老人身上混着屁股和烛蜡的气味。%SPEECH_ON%我的库藏里有不少东西，归我本人所有，并非领主的财产。你可能很感兴趣。药剂、酒水，还有你这样的战士用得上的物资。再……再添一条战犬！本地驯犬师欠我个人情，眼下正好让他还！%SPEECH_OFF%你权衡着，书记员紧张地陪笑。要是告发他们，会发生什么可说不准。男人与男人私通，你倒不在意，可各地有些领主对此深恶痛绝。若%nobleman%也属此列，‘揪出’这两人，或许能替你博得好感。

52780526ead66bc5b5ec.source: The lord of the castle will decide your fates.
52780526ead66bc5b5ec.translation: 你们的命运，由城堡的领主决定。

8284c109727d6840d490.source: Your secret is safe with me.
8284c109727d6840d490.translation: 你的秘密，我会守口如瓶。

952470b8d5a9552f744d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You close the closet door and hurry to %nobleman%. You explain to the nobleman what you've seen. When you finish, he states that the goblin had been found drowning in a sewage stream and has been put out of its misery.%SPEECH_ON%As for the sodomites, yes, what of it? Have you looked around? A fort is a nonsensical place to the urges of a man. Swingin' dicks as far as the eye can see and nowhere to put them. Do I like it? No, of course not. Absolutely disgusting nonsense, truly. But if I punished every instance of this behavior I'd be left with a bunch of scarecrows and farm animals, and I can't even be sure of the latter.%SPEECH_OFF%He waves you off.%SPEECH_ON%The goblin's been taken care of, sellsword, I've little else to speak to you about. However, if you could, please inform the servants that the room in which you found them needs cleaning. I care not to look over taxes in a smog of shite.%SPEECH_OFF%
952470b8d5a9552f744d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你关上门，赶去见%nobleman%，向他说明所见。听完后，他说地精已在污水沟中找到，挣扎着快淹死了，卫兵替它结束了痛苦。%SPEECH_ON%至于那两个搞在一起的男人，是啊，那又怎样？你看看四周。堡垒这种地方，根本不管男人的欲望合不合理。满眼都是带把的，却没处泄火。我喜欢吗？不，当然不，简直恶心透顶。可若每次都罚，我手下就只剩稻草人和牲畜了——连牲畜都未必保得住。%SPEECH_OFF%他挥手赶你。%SPEECH_ON%地精已经处理了，佣兵，我没别的可说。不过，劳驾通知仆人，把你发现他们的房间打扫一下。我可不想坐在一团屎臭里核算税款。%SPEECH_OFF%

ce1a8e1e12c0fedea739.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You decide to keep their secret under the pretense that the scribe will give you what he has promised. The old man nods as you leave.%SPEECH_ON%I will find you in the courtyard, sellsword, with everything that you are owed. Your silence on this matter is most appreciated.%SPEECH_OFF%When you return to %nobleman%, he explains that the goblin had been found and taken care of. Seeing as how you weren't responsible, he sends you off without pay.

 Outside, the scribe does in fact meet you. He's got a leash in one hand and a sack in the other. He hands them both over.%SPEECH_ON%Once again, my thanks, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%
ce1a8e1e12c0fedea739.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你答应保守秘密，条件是书记员兑现承诺。临走时，老人点头说道：%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我会到庭院找你，该给的东西一样不少。多谢你肯守口如瓶。%SPEECH_OFF%回到%nobleman%那里，他告诉你，地精已被找到并处理。既然不是你的功劳，便一分钱没给，直接打发你走了。

到了外面，书记员果然来见你，一手牵着绳，一手提着袋子。他把两样东西都交给你。%SPEECH_ON%再谢一次，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%

2b1d14592e6be3197d70.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]If you were a goblin in a castle of people wanting to kill you, where would you go? Putting yourself in the mind of the runt, you come to the conclusion that the armory would be as good a place as any to start your search. When you get there, you do find an apprentice standing outside and trying to hold the door shut. He yells that the goblin is inside and has already killed the blacksmith. Drawing your blade, you tell the apprentice to stand aside.

 The second he does, the door bursts open and a goblin, shaped like a scarecrow built out of broken buckets, shambles out, armored head-to-toe, a shield and spear clumsily stationed at its front. Ignoring the absurdity of what is being seen, you strike through the clutter and pierce the beast's skull, instantly killing it. When you withdraw your sword, all the armor and weapons fall away as though you'd just slain an apparition holding them up.

 The apprentice quickly shakes your hand before falling to his knees, weeping over the loss of the blacksmith. With no time for tears, you take the goblin's head and return to %nobleman% for your pay.
2b1d14592e6be3197d70.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]假如你是地精，困在一座人人都想杀你的城堡里，会躲去哪儿？设身处地想一想，你觉得先搜军械库准没错。到了那里，果然有个学徒站在门外，拼命顶着门。他大喊，地精在里面，已经杀了铁匠。你拔出剑，让学徒闪开。

他刚让开，门便被撞开，一个地精摇摇晃晃地走出来，模样像用破桶拼成的稻草人。它从头到脚套满盔甲，盾牌和长矛笨拙地支在身前。你没理会这荒唐的装扮，一剑刺穿那堆杂物，贯入怪物的头骨，当场将它杀死。剑一抽回，所有武器盔甲都散落下来，仿佛你杀掉的只是撑着它们的幽灵。

学徒匆匆握手道谢，便跪地痛哭，哀悼铁匠。你没工夫陪他流泪，提起地精的脑袋，回去找%nobleman%领钱。

8c08b4cf4f0a0be53b3d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]Well, if you were a tiny dwarf in a hostile fortress the first place you'd go is the armory. When you get there, you don't find any goblin, but instead there's a kid drawing a dagger out of a man who is face down on the floor. The murderer drops his weapon and holds his hands up.%SPEECH_ON%I had no choice! No choice at all!%SPEECH_OFF%You ask the kid who he and the dead man are. He quickly explains.%SPEECH_ON%I'm the apprentice and this is... was the blacksmith. Now, this had to be done. Had to! You've no idea what horrors this man has put upon me! Every time I errored, he punished me as though I was a kingslaying cretin! See this?%SPEECH_OFF%He sweeps a length of hair out of the way, revealing the bulbous scars of burns. Letting go of the hair, he holds up a hand with a grotesque pinky that rests at a right angle, and the other hand which has no pinky at all. He starts taking a boot off, but you stop him, getting the point. The apprentice clasps his hands together, his pinky sticking out like a haughty highborn sipping wine.%SPEECH_ON%You're after the goblin, right? Just tell them the goblin did it! I'll... look, I'm not much of an armorer, but I can forge a sword like nobody's business and I will forge you the absolute best that I can do. Just keep this secret between us, that's all I ask.%SPEECH_OFF%
8c08b4cf4f0a0be53b3d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]要是你是个小矮子，身处敌意四伏的堡垒，首先自然会去军械库。可到了那里，没找到地精，却看见一个少年正从俯卧的男人身上拔出匕首。凶手丢下武器，举起双手。%SPEECH_ON%我没得选！真的没得选！%SPEECH_OFF%你问他和死者是谁。他急忙解释。%SPEECH_ON%我是学徒，这人是……曾是铁匠。这事非做不可，非做不可！你不知道他怎样折磨我！每次出错，他都把我当成弑君的恶贼来罚！看这里！%SPEECH_OFF%他拨开一缕头发，露出鼓胀的烧伤疤痕。松开头发后，他又抬起双手：一只手的小指畸形地折成直角，另一只则根本没有小指。他还想脱靴子，你拦住了，已经明白。学徒双手合十，那根小指翘在外面，活像啜酒的傲慢贵族。%SPEECH_ON%你在追地精，对吧？就说是地精干的！我会……听着，造盔甲我不算擅长，可论锻剑，我有真本事。我会尽我所能，给你打最好的剑。只求把秘密留在咱们之间，就这一件事。%SPEECH_OFF%

29f15e9105b4a55d719b.source: Such a crime can't go unpunished!

93b10a9175bfc470795c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You close the door and lock it, ensuring that the murderer will not be able to flee. As the apprentice screams and bangs against the door, you return to the nobleman.

 %nobleman% listens to your report and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Mmhmm, yes. The blacksmith is not the first to fall by that boy's hand - we've had a series of murders here, but have never been able to find the culprit. Many believed it him on account of his bashing his hands with hammers and putting his face to a torch. The stable boy even saw him cut the cock off a rat. He was a disturbed fellow, but now you've given us definitive proof of his doings. Well done, sellsword! The goblin you were after has already been taken care of, but this... this is far better than hunting down some greenskin. Consider your payment doubled!%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman snaps his fingers at his scribe and starts uttering orders, ostensibly issuing a writ of execution. He goes into incredible detail about the logistics of the matter: horses, ropes, blades, tongs, hot fires, a litany of horrors to keep bored soldiers entertained for hours.
93b10a9175bfc470795c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你关门落锁，确保凶手无法逃走。学徒在门后尖叫拍打，你则回去见贵族。

%nobleman%听完报告，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，是啊。铁匠不是第一个死在那孩子手上的。这里已经出了好几桩命案，却一直找不到凶手。很多人都怀疑他，毕竟他会拿锤子砸自己的手，把脸凑到火把上烧。马夫甚至见过他割掉一只老鼠的生殖器。他是个疯癫的家伙，如今你总算替我们找到了确凿证据。干得好，佣兵！你追的地精已经处理了，可这件事……比追杀一个绿皮强多了。报酬翻倍！%SPEECH_OFF%贵族向书记员打了个响指，开始口述命令，显然是在签发处决令。他把所需之物交代得无比细致：马匹、绳索、刀刃、铁钳、烈火……一长串骇人的东西，足以让无聊的士兵消遣好几个小时。

dbbadf00a77d748dee45.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You come across a handful of soldiers from %randomnoblehouse%. They tilt their caps at you.%SPEECH_ON%Evening, mercenaries.%SPEECH_OFF%Not sure if they're about to attack, you make a subtle nod toward %dude%. He puts his weapon within hand's reach and nods back. You return your attention to the soldiers, giving them a friendly wave. Their lieutenant steps forward, grinning.%SPEECH_ON%Oy' mercenary, we've little use for you in this world now.%SPEECH_OFF%Slowly, you lower your hand, hovering it above the pommel of your sword. You ask what the man means by that. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%You haven't heard? War's over. The greenskins were routed from %randomtown% just a few days ago. Scouts report seeing them bastards running for the hills every which way, fighting amongst themselves, the orcs killing the goblins, goblins killing the orcs, just a full on rout. So, yeah, noble houses need not pay your sorry arse for nothing now because us real soldiers got it under control. Now why don't you and your pathetic lot clear out of the way. Us fighters got places to be, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%
dbbadf00a77d748dee45.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你遇见几个%randomnoblehouse%的士兵。他们抬了抬帽檐。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你拿不准他们是否要动手，便悄悄朝%dude%点头。他把武器放到伸手可及的地方，点头回应。你重新看向士兵，友善地挥手。副官咧嘴走上前。%SPEECH_ON%喂，佣兵，如今这世道，可没多少地方用得上你们了。%SPEECH_OFF%你缓缓放下手，停在剑柄上方，问他是什么意思。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%还没听说？战争结束了。几天前，绿皮在%randomtown%被打得大败。斥候说，那帮杂种正四处往山里逃，还互相打起来了：兽人杀地精，地精杀兽人，彻底溃散。所以，贵族家族用不着再花钱养你们这帮废物了，真正的士兵已经把局面管住了。现在，带你那群可怜虫让开。我们这些战士还有正事，懂吗？%SPEECH_OFF%

80c0cf8d5d28c4d080b5.source: Let's move to let these heroes of the realm pass.
80c0cf8d5d28c4d080b5.translation: 让开路，让这些王国英雄过去。

6319879d420488a43c67.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%dude% reaches for his weapon, but you shake your head. The lieutenant nods toward the mercenary.%SPEECH_ON%Best keep that dog on its leash, aye?%SPEECH_OFF%You fan your arm out, inviting the soldiers a 'passage' they knew they already had. The soldiers gear up and the lieutenant smirks.%SPEECH_ON%I knew you'd make the right choice. We're just 'aving a bit of fun, yeah? You ladies stay tight.%SPEECH_OFF%The man blows a kiss as he walks by. %dude% stands up looking like someone just socked his mother. You tell him to sit back down and he begrudgingly does so. It's all bullshit, these theatrics, but you're not one to lose your temper and get people killed over it.

The incident does make you wonder if maybe it's time to turn it all in. The greenskins are beaten back and you've made enough money to leave the life for good, but then again you'd hate to live out the rest of your days wondering 'what if'...

%OOC%You've won! Battle Brothers is designed for replayability and for campaigns to be played until you've beaten one or two late game crises. Starting a new campaign will allow you to try out different things in a different world.

You can also choose to continue your campaign for as long as you want. Just be aware that campaigns are not intended to last forever and you're likely to run out of challenges eventually.%OOC_OFF%
6319879d420488a43c67.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%dude%伸手去拿武器，你却摇了摇头。副官朝那佣兵点头。%SPEECH_ON%最好把你那条狗拴牢，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%你展开胳膊，给士兵们‘让出’一条他们早已认定有权走的路。他们整顿装备，副官得意地笑道：%SPEECH_ON%我就知道你会选对。咱们不过开个玩笑，对吧？娘们儿，好好待着。%SPEECH_OFF%经过时，他还送了个飞吻。%dude%猛地站起来，脸色像刚有人打了他母亲。你叫他坐回去，他不情不愿地照办。这些装腔作势全是狗屁，可你还不至于为一时火气，让人白白送命。

不过，这件事确实让你琢磨，是否该就此收手。绿皮已被击退，你挣的钱也足够彻底告别这行。可另一方面，你又不愿余生总在想：‘要是当初继续下去……’

%OOC%你赢了！《战场兄弟》注重重复游玩的乐趣，通常建议在一场战役中战胜一至两次后期危机后，开启新战役，在不同的世界尝试新的玩法。

你也可以继续当前战役，想玩多久都可以。不过，游戏并非按无限期游玩设计，最终可能会缺少新的挑战。%OOC_OFF%

15201c1e538cf7dd6bd1.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]The soldiers' lieutenant glares at you.%SPEECH_ON%Do as I said, sellsword, or there will be trouble.%SPEECH_OFF%Ignoring him, you give another nod to %dude%. He gets up, the blade of his weapon loudly scraping off the dirt. The soldiers turn to the mercenary. He hefts his weapon into both hands and stares back. As the lieutenant starts to talk, %dude% bluntly interrupts.%SPEECH_ON%Shush, little man. I see softness in your skin. Not a scar to be seen. Eyes as fresh as the day they were born. Hands as smooth as untouched candles. If you was of the fightin' sort, you'd be out there in those battles you speak of, not out here pissing into the wind. I'll give you two options because I'm feeling nice. First option, are you listening? First option is this. Go where you are going and don't say another goddam word.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses to hold up two fingers.%SPEECH_ON%Option two is a mystery. Speak and ye shall learn of it.%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenant's eyes have gotten a little wider, and his mouth infinitely quieter. He glances at you, but all you can do is shrug. After another moment, the soldiers hurry away with determined silence.

%dude% laughs it up, but the incident has you wondering if perhaps it is finally the time to retire. How many more of these cockups are in your future? How many more battles? How many more dead men will you have to bury? The company would do well standing on the foundations you've built for it. But on the other hand, if you retired now, what adventures would you miss out on?

%OOC%You've won! Battle Brothers is designed for replayability and for campaigns to be played until you've beaten one or two late game crises. Starting a new campaign will allow you to try out different things in a different world.

You can also choose to continue your campaign for as long as you want. Just be aware that campaigns are not intended to last forever and you're likely to run out of challenges eventually.%OOC_OFF%
15201c1e538cf7dd6bd1.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]副官瞪着你。%SPEECH_ON%照我说的做，佣兵，否则有你好看。%SPEECH_OFF%你不理会，又向%dude%点了点头。他站起身，武器刃口刮过泥地，发出刺耳的声响。士兵们转向他。他双手握起武器，直视回去。副官刚想开口，%dude%便生硬地打断。%SPEECH_ON%嘘，闭嘴，小家伙。我看你细皮嫩肉，连道疤都没有。眼睛干净得像刚生下来，双手光滑得像没碰过的蜡烛。真要是会打仗的人，你就该在你吹嘘的战场上，而不是在这里迎风撒尿。我今天心情好，给你两个选择。第一个，听清了吗？第一个是，去你该去的地方，再他妈多一个字也别说。%SPEECH_OFF%他停下，竖起两根手指。%SPEECH_ON%第二个，暂且保密。你再开口，自然就知道了。%SPEECH_OFF%副官的眼睛睁大了些，嘴却安静得多。他看向你，你只能耸肩。又过片刻，士兵们一声不吭，匆匆离去。

%dude%放声大笑，这件事却让你想，也许终于到了退休的时候。往后还要遇见多少这种混账事？还要打多少仗？还要埋多少人？凭你为战团打下的根基，它应该能走得很好。可反过来，若现在退休，又会错过多少冒险？

%OOC%你赢了！《战场兄弟》注重重复游玩的乐趣，通常建议在一场战役中战胜一至两次后期危机后，开启新战役，在不同的世界尝试新的玩法。

你也可以继续当前战役，想玩多久都可以。不过，游戏并非按无限期游玩设计，最终可能会缺少新的挑战。%OOC_OFF%

aa0714877d01b7d6cca9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]While walking through the forest, you come into a clearing where a small little hut sits. There are bear traps hanging from its walls, squirrel pelts from the eaves, and the windows are dressed with wet leaves in their corners. An old man is on the porch, rocking in his chair. He has a crossbow aimed at you.%SPEECH_ON%This is my property.%SPEECH_OFF%There's a chain running from the arm of his chair to a hatch on the bottom of the cabin door. It moves slightly to the man's speaking and he turns and butts the crossbow against the door.%SPEECH_ON%Hush, you! Now you, man with the sword, and all yer friends, get going. Another the step the wrong way, which would be my way, and I'll put a bolt up yer arse.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% eases up to your side.%SPEECH_ON%What should we do, sir?%SPEECH_OFF%
aa0714877d01b7d6cca9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]穿行森林时，你来到一片空地，一间小屋坐落其中。墙上挂着捕兽夹，檐下垂着松鼠皮，窗角塞着湿树叶。门廊上，一个老人坐在摇椅里，端着弩瞄准你。%SPEECH_ON%这是我的地盘。%SPEECH_OFF%一条铁链从摇椅扶手延伸出去，穿过屋门底部的小活门。老人说话时，铁链微微动了动，他便转身用弩托撞门。%SPEECH_ON%你给我安静！还有你，拿剑的，带上你的朋友们，走。再迈错一步——也就是往我这边迈——我就给你屁股钉一支弩箭。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%悄悄来到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%团长，怎么办？%SPEECH_OFF%

f577e3805acaaea2d662.source: We've got no time for crazies.

4b8dbff58c2c1fba1586.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You've no reason to further transgress upon this old man's day, and so you tell the company to give him and his hut a wide berth. The elder eyes you suspiciously every step of the way.%SPEECH_ON%Mmhmm, y'all have a good day now.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and respond.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, you too.%SPEECH_OFF%The chain moves again and is met with another hushing. Who knows what the hell was going on here, but the company has places to be.
4b8dbff58c2c1fba1586.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]没理由继续搅扰老人的日子，你让战团绕开他和他的木屋。老人一路狐疑地盯着你。%SPEECH_ON%嗯哼，祝各位今天过得愉快。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头答道：%SPEECH_ON%好，你也是。%SPEECH_OFF%锁链又响了，随即又是一声制止它的嘘声。鬼知道这里是怎么回事，不过战团还得赶路。

748d6e946e7166ea6afe.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You take a step forward. The old man springs off his chair and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Sonuvabitch.%SPEECH_OFF%He lifts the crossbow and shoots it from the hip. The shot goes wide and into the trees where it clacks and clatters off branches and shrubs. %randombrother% rushes the porch and tackles the man to the ground.%SPEECH_ON%Get your whoremongering hands off me you, you, you whoremonger!%SPEECH_OFF%While the man spits and kicks, you calmly walk up to the porch and open the door to his hut. The chain shoots across the floorboards and goes taut. A dark shape takes to the corner, scuttling up its walls trying to get further than its shackles will allow. You take a torch and wave it into the darkness. There you see the prisoner. The old man shouts from the porch.%SPEECH_ON%You leave us alone! Go on now, you leave us alone!%SPEECH_OFF%There, shrinking away from your torch, is a goblin.
748d6e946e7166ea6afe.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你向前迈了一步。老人从摇椅上蹦起来，啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%狗娘养的。%SPEECH_OFF%他抬起弩，从腰间射出一箭，却射偏进林子，撞得枝叶咔啦乱响。%randombrother%冲上门廊，将老人扑倒在地。%SPEECH_ON%拿开你那双嫖客的脏手，你、你、你这嫖客！%SPEECH_OFF%老人踢蹬吐唾沫，你则从容走上门廊，打开屋门。铁链在地板上迅速滑过，猛地绷紧。一团黑影窜到角落，攀着墙往上蹿，想逃到镣铐允许的范围之外。你取来火把，照向暗处，终于看见被囚禁的东西。老人从门廊上喊道：%SPEECH_ON%别碰我们！走开，别碰我们！%SPEECH_OFF%缩在火光之外的，是一个地精。

a5b814a695ffe70f5152.source: Why would you keep a goblin chained up here?
a5b814a695ffe70f5152.translation: 你为什么在这儿锁着一只地精？

ed3aa2764968afe70c88.source: Better to kill that thing now.
ed3aa2764968afe70c88.translation: 还是现在就杀了那东西。

694a968dd2da4f16ba62.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You take a step forward. The old man springs off his chair and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Sonsabitches, I warned ye! I warned ye good and clear!%SPEECH_OFF%He lifts the crossbow and shoots it from the hip. The shot sails over your shoulder and shoots clear through %hurtbro%'s arm. The sellsword looks down, a feather of a shot teetering from one end of the hole, a bloodied shaft wiggling from the other. He takes a seat.%SPEECH_ON%Well fark me.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% screams and rushes ahead. As the old man tries to reload, the mercenary kicks the crossbow away and throws the shooter to the ground. You tell the sellsword to keep the man alive. While the man spits and kicks, you calmly walk up to the porch and open the door to his hut. As the door swings wide, the chain shoots across the floorboards and goes taut. A dark shape takes to the corner, scuttling up its walls trying to go further than its shackles will allow. You take a torch and wave it into the darkness. There you see the prisoner. The old man shouts from the porch.%SPEECH_ON%You leave us alone! Go on now, you leave us alone!%SPEECH_OFF%There, shrinking away from your torch, is a goblin.
694a968dd2da4f16ba62.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你向前迈了一步。老人从摇椅上蹦起来，啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%狗娘养的，我警告过你们！说得够清楚了！%SPEECH_OFF%他抬起弩，从腰间射出一箭。弩箭掠过你的肩头，贯穿%hurtbro%的胳膊。佣兵低头看去，伤口一侧晃着箭羽，另一侧颤着染血的箭杆。他坐了下来。%SPEECH_ON%操他妈的。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%怒吼着冲上前。老人正要重新装填，弩便被他踢飞，人也被摔倒在地。你让佣兵留他一命。老人踢蹬吐唾沫，你则从容走上门廊，打开屋门。门一敞开，铁链在地板上迅速滑过，猛地绷紧。一团黑影窜到角落，攀着墙往上蹿，想逃到镣铐允许的范围之外。你取来火把，照向暗处，终于看见被囚禁的东西。老人从门廊上喊道：%SPEECH_ON%别碰我们！走开，别碰我们！%SPEECH_OFF%缩在火光之外的，是一个地精。

d3996d5edd1cbf55ffa3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You take out your sword and step into the cabin. The old man calls out to you. All the threat and posturing is gone. He's almost manically pleading for you to not hurt the goblin. But you do just that, thrusting a blade through the greenskin's chest. It heaves against the metal, gripping it with its slimy, disgusting fingers. Its grip weakens as the light leaves its eyes. You draw out the blade and wipe the blood on your pants. As though grief renewed him with unseen power, the old man cries out and manages to wrestle to his feet. He draws a dagger and comes after you, but %randombrother% stops him with a dagger of his own, bedding the blade just beneath the man's breast. Blood spews over the hilt as his heart rapidly beats the last of its life. The old man's knees buckle and slides down, clutching at his killer's arms.%SPEECH_ON%Cruel creatures... cruel...%SPEECH_OFF%He collapses onto the floorboard. You tell the company to search the cabin and take what they can.
d3996d5edd1cbf55ffa3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你拔剑走进小屋。老人朝你呼喊，威胁与逞强已荡然无存，只剩近乎疯狂的哀求，请你别伤害地精。可你还是将剑刺进绿皮胸膛。它顶着剑身抽搐，用黏腻恶心的手指抓住利刃。眼里的光渐渐熄灭，手也松了。你抽出剑，在裤子上擦掉血。悲痛仿佛给了老人某种看不见的力量，他大叫着挣扎起身，抽出匕首扑向你。%randombrother%却用自己的匕首截住他，将刀刃送进胸下。心脏用最后的力气跳动，鲜血涌过刀柄。老人双膝一软，抓着杀他之人的胳膊滑下去。%SPEECH_ON%残忍的东西……残忍……%SPEECH_OFF%他倒在地板上。你让战团搜查小屋，把能拿的都拿走。

09bd2af1e31822447752.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]Keeping the goblin in sight at all times, you ask the man why he has a greenskin tied up in his cabin. The hermit cries into the floorboards.%SPEECH_ON%He's a friend! My only friend!%SPEECH_OFF%
09bd2af1e31822447752.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你始终盯紧地精，问那男人为什么把一只绿皮绑在屋里。隐士伏向地板，哭喊道：%SPEECH_ON%他是我的朋友！唯一的朋友！%SPEECH_OFF%

a064943c573acdb849fd.translation: 哪有人用锁链拴着朋友？

7665fa966241b5bd1b3d.source: That goblin will only get free and report to its true friends!
7665fa966241b5bd1b3d.translation: 那地精迟早会挣脱，回去给真正的同伙报信！

8115bfd9a5b7b2464164.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You retreat from the cabin and crouch before the old man. He wriggles and begs.%SPEECH_ON%Please, don't kill 'im!%SPEECH_OFF%The man has gone mad and you tell him as much. He sobs into the porch floorboards, his breath powdering sawdust into the air. Finally, he eases his breathing and calms down.%SPEECH_ON%Yer right. I'm not all there in the head. I found the goblin in a trap a few days ago and took him in, healed him. I've no company in these parts. It gets lonely, you understand.%SPEECH_OFF%You take and reload the crossbow and then offer it to the old man.%SPEECH_ON%Can you do it?%SPEECH_OFF%The old man stares at the crossbow. He blinks a number of times and nods. Your sellswords let him up. He takes the crossbow and steps into the cabin. His aim is shaky and he's muttering apologies under his breath. The goblin is curled into a ball, shielding itself with its sickly hands.%SPEECH_ON%I'm so sorry. So very sorry.%SPEECH_OFF%The old man readies the crossbow's release, slides his finger over the trigger, and then puts the bolt beneath his chin and fires. He buckles to the floor, the shot twanging as it slams into the ceiling, scant blood dripping off its feathers. You shake your head and step into the cabin and kill the goblin off yourself. Finished, you tell the men to search the hut and take what they can.
8115bfd9a5b7b2464164.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你退出小屋，蹲在老人面前。他扭动着哀求。%SPEECH_ON%求求你，别杀他！%SPEECH_OFF%这人已经疯了，你也直言不讳。他伏在门廊地板上抽泣，呼出的气把锯末吹上半空。终于，他喘息渐缓，平静下来。%SPEECH_ON%你说得对，我脑子不大正常。几天前，我在陷阱里找到这个地精，把他带回来，治好了他。这里没人陪我。一个人待着很孤独，你懂的。%SPEECH_OFF%你拿起弩，重新装填，再递给老人。%SPEECH_ON%你下得了手吗？%SPEECH_OFF%老人盯着弩，眨了几次眼，点头。佣兵们放他起身。他接过弩，走进屋内，瞄得颤颤巍巍，嘴里不停低声道歉。地精蜷成一团，用病弱的手护住自己。%SPEECH_ON%对不起，真的对不起。%SPEECH_OFF%老人准备扣动弩机，手指搭上扳机，却突然将弩口转向下颌，扣了下去。他瘫倒在地，弩箭嗡地钉进天花板，尾羽滴下少许鲜血。你摇头，走进屋，亲自杀了地精。事情了结后，你让弟兄们搜查小屋，把能拿的都拿走。

93dfd084d02c786f4cae.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]Cautiously, you go back to the old man. You pick up the chain and rankle it, asking the man.%SPEECH_ON%A friend you keep shackled? If it were your true friend, you wouldn't need the chains, no?%SPEECH_OFF%The hermit shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Yer right. Lemme go and I'll prove to you he's a real friend.%SPEECH_OFF%You let the man up and tell him to 'prove' it. He pats the dust off his clothes and steps into the cabin. The chain slackens a bit as the goblin takes a step away from the fall. Crouching before the greenskin, the hermit extends a hand.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there, buddy.%SPEECH_OFF%As he reaches to unshackle the greenskin, the goblin growls and launches forward, sinking its teeth into the man's face. You rush into the cabin and kick the goblin back. It lands against the corner, flesh and blood hanging from its lips. %randombrother% stabs a sword through the creature's face. The old man cries out, his face a visage of gore.%SPEECH_ON%You were right, I knew it true, but my heart... it's in so much pain.%SPEECH_OFF%Getting a better look, you now see a seeping crimson chasm where his nose should be. As the hermit crawls into a ball, he points across the cabin.%SPEECH_ON%Beneath the floorboards there, where the dust is unsettled. I've no use for it anymore.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell %randombrother% to fix the man up. The rest of the company starts ripping out the floorboards to look beneath the crawlspace. After getting what they need, you tell the men it's time to leave. The hermit returns to his rocking chair and takes a seat. He's got his hands face up on his knees, blood running down the lengths of the fingers, and more blood dripping from a wound that is sure to fester. You can hear the blood choking him on every breath.%SPEECH_ON%I should've hidden away. That's what I always do. Why didn't I hide?%SPEECH_OFF%
93dfd084d02c786f4cae.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你谨慎地回到老人身旁，捡起铁链，晃了晃，问道：%SPEECH_ON%你把朋友锁起来？真是朋友，还用得着铁链吗？%SPEECH_OFF%隐士耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%你说得对。放开我，我证明给你看，他真是我朋友。%SPEECH_OFF%你让他起身，叫他‘证明’。他拍掉衣上的灰，走进小屋。地精从墙边挪开一步，铁链稍稍松弛。隐士蹲在绿皮面前，伸出手。%SPEECH_ON%你好啊，伙计。%SPEECH_OFF%他伸手解锁时，地精低吼着猛扑上来，一口咬住他的脸。你冲进屋，一脚把地精踢开。它撞到墙角，嘴边挂着血肉。%randombrother%一剑刺穿怪物的脸。老人满面血污，哭喊道：%SPEECH_ON%你是对的。我其实知道，可我的心……疼得受不了。%SPEECH_OFF%仔细一看，他鼻子原来的位置，如今只剩一道不断渗血的窟窿。隐士蜷成一团，指向屋内另一边。%SPEECH_ON%那块地板下面，灰被动过的地方。我用不着了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，让%randombrother%替他包扎。其他弟兄撬开地板，搜查底下的夹层。拿到所需之物后，你叫众人离开。隐士回到摇椅上坐下，掌心向上搁在膝头。血流过指尖，那道注定会溃烂的伤口也仍在滴血。每次呼吸，你都能听见血在呛着他的喉咙。%SPEECH_ON%我该躲起来的。我向来都躲着。为什么这次没躲？%SPEECH_OFF%

81b81e58643b36bf2811.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You back out of the cabin and yell at the man.%SPEECH_ON%What in the old hells do you think you're doing? If that thing gets loose, it will run to the nearest greenskin encampment and bring their wrath upon this land!%SPEECH_OFF%The old man nods toward the chain.%SPEECH_ON%My very good friend is very safe, stranger, you shouldn't worry. You know nothing about who he is or his character!%SPEECH_OFF%You knock down the man with a punch and crouch low so he hears you good and proper.%SPEECH_ON%That thing is not your friend. It is a danger.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod to %randombrother% who promptly enters the cabin and kills the goblin with a quick stab. The old man cries out, blood already clotting between his teeth like crimson rinds.%SPEECH_ON%But why? What did he ever do to you? Have you no honor, killing a creature such as he?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head at the madman and order the rest of the company to fan out and search for items. When they're done, you leave the old man to his cabin and dead friend.
81b81e58643b36bf2811.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你退回屋外，冲老人吼道：%SPEECH_ON%见鬼，你到底在干什么？那东西一旦逃脱，就会跑去最近的绿皮营地，把他们的怒火引到这片土地上！%SPEECH_OFF%老人朝铁链点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%我的好朋友拴得很牢，陌生人，用不着你担心。你根本不认识他，也不懂他的性情！%SPEECH_OFF%你一拳把老人打倒，蹲下来，让他听个清楚。%SPEECH_ON%那东西不是你的朋友，是个祸患。%SPEECH_OFF%你朝%randombrother%点头，他立即进屋，一剑刺死地精。老人哭喊着，齿间凝着一块块暗红的血。%SPEECH_ON%为什么？他到底对你做过什么？杀害他这样的生灵，你还有没有荣誉？%SPEECH_OFF%你对着疯老头摇头，命令其他弟兄分头搜查财物。搜完后，你把老人留给他的小屋，以及死去的朋友。

a2cc0fc9dda8eaf36051.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]While marching, a man crosses paths with the %companyname%. He is well armored and appears rather knightly save for one feature: a bone necklace hanging from his neck. With each step it clatters with sickly hollowness against his breastplate. You regard this stranger and his skeletal adornments with caution, lest he make a belt out of yer cock and a breast plate out of yer...%SPEECH_ON%Evening, sellswords.%SPEECH_OFF%The warrior waves. There's an unseen weight to this man, as though surrounded by dead air or perhaps the souls of his victims. He nods and continues speaking.%SPEECH_ON%You seem the greenskin skinnin' sort, and that's the sort of company I'd be most agreeable to joining.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% exchanges a glance with you and shrugs. He whispers his indifference.%SPEECH_ON%If he's a problem, we can handle him.%SPEECH_OFF%The man shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, I'll be no problem. I just want to kill orcs and goblins. What more do you need to know? Once these greenskins are taken care of, I'll be out of your hair.%SPEECH_OFF%
a2cc0fc9dda8eaf36051.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]行军途中，一个男人与%companyname%相遇。他盔甲精良，很像个骑士，唯独有一点不同：颈上挂着骨头项链。每走一步，骨头就撞在胸甲上，发出令人发冷的空响。你警惕地打量这陌生人，以及他那身骸骨饰物，生怕他用你的命根子做腰带，再用你的……做胸甲。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%战士挥手致意。他身上有股看不见的沉重，仿佛四周聚着死气，又或是死于他手的亡魂。他点头，继续说道：%SPEECH_ON%你们看着就是敢给绿皮剥皮的人。这种战团，我最乐意加入。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%与你交换眼色，耸耸肩，满不在乎地低声说：%SPEECH_ON%真惹麻烦，我们也收拾得了他。%SPEECH_OFF%那人摇头。%SPEECH_ON%哦，我不会惹麻烦。我只想杀兽人和地精，还需要知道什么？等这些绿皮处理干净，我就走，不碍你们的事。%SPEECH_OFF%

c87c200e02c54c3512a3.translation: 不必了，多谢，我们应付得来。

fc72037c953a29cc6e8b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]%orcslayer% the orcslayer walks up to you.%SPEECH_ON%Well, I guess that's it then. There ain't as many orcs and goblins around to kill. I bid you farewell, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what he's going to do. He takes off his armor and puts it on the ground before you.%SPEECH_ON%My family has been avenged.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and wish him well now that his apparent demons have been put to rest. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Just kidding. I don't have no family. I killed them bastards because I enjoyed spilling their guts, but my heart isn't in it anymore. Send the rest of the men my regards.%SPEECH_OFF%And with that the orcslayer, or former-orcslayer, departs the company.
fc72037c953a29cc6e8b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]兽人杀手%orcslayer%走到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，看来就到这里了。如今没那么多兽人和地精可杀了，佣兵，我来道别。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他接下来打算做什么。他脱下盔甲，放在你面前的地上。%SPEECH_ON%家人的仇已经报了。%SPEECH_OFF%既然看似已了却心魔，你便点头，祝他往后顺遂。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%开玩笑的。我没什么家人。杀那些杂种，只因喜欢看它们肚破肠流。不过，现在没那份心思了。替我向其他弟兄问好。%SPEECH_OFF%就这样，兽人杀手——或者说，曾经的兽人杀手——离开了战团。

875275cdece0a4f63256.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]{Somber news on the road. Refugees and traders are reporting that %city% has been destroyed by the greenskins! If this keeps up, there shan't be a land to call home when it's all said and done. | You find a noble messenger watering his horse beside the path. He states that the greenskins have annihilated the human armies around %city% and destroyed the town itself! | You come across a cartographer and a trader with an empty cart. They're redrawing a map and there's something curious about it: the mapmaker is erasing %city% from the paper. When you ask why, he raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, you haven't heard? %city%'s been destroyed. Greenskins overran the defenses and killed everyone they got their hands on.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come across a trader on the path. His cart is emptied and missing some draught animals. There's blood on his face and clothes. You ask the man for his story. He straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%My story? No, it ain't my story. I was on my way to %city% only to find it overrun by greenskins. I barely escaped with my life. The town itself is done for. If that's the way you was headed, don't bother. It's gone. Completely gone.%SPEECH_OFF%}
875275cdece0a4f63256.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]{路上传来噩耗。难民和商人都说，%city%已被绿皮摧毁！再这样下去，等一切结束，恐怕连个能称作家园的地方都不剩。 | 你遇见一名贵族信使，正在路旁饮马。他说，绿皮歼灭了%city%周围的人类军队，连城镇本身也一并摧毁！ | 你遇见一名制图师和一个赶着空车的商人。他们正在重绘地图，有一件事很古怪：制图师正从纸上擦掉%city%。你问缘由，他扬起眉。%SPEECH_ON%哦，还没听说？%city%毁了。绿皮冲破防线，见人就杀。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在路上遇见一个商人，货车空了，拉车的牲口也少了几头，脸上和衣服上满是血。你问他遭遇了什么。他挺起身子。%SPEECH_ON%我的遭遇？不，这可不只是我的事。我本来要去%city%，到了一看，那里已经被绿皮攻陷。我好不容易才保住命。城镇完了。要是你也往那边走，就别费劲了。没了，彻底没了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

471f771fdc9854904f09.translation: 这场战争，我们要输了吗？

274df6509e9552f24e65.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]The company steps through some brush and into a clearing where they find a goblin squatting. It turns toward the company, its breath labored, its eyes somber. You see that there's a large bear trap tightly clenching its lower thigh. The greenskin tries a growl, but only manages to cough some blood.

 Beside the dying goblin is a man face down in the grass. There's something shiny attached to his hip, but you can't quite tell what it is. %randombrother% comes to your side.%SPEECH_ON%Could be a trap. A trap within a trap. The rest of his buddies are probably not far. Then again, if we leave, he might get free and tell everyone we were here. What should we do?%SPEECH_OFF%
274df6509e9552f24e65.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]战团穿过灌木，来到一片空地，发现一个地精蹲在那里。它转向你们，呼吸吃力，眼神黯淡。一个硕大的捕兽夹，正紧紧咬住它的大腿下部。绿皮试图低吼，却只咳出血来。

垂死的地精旁，一个男人俯卧在草里。腰间挂着什么闪亮的东西，可你看不清。%randombrother%来到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%可能是陷阱。陷阱里的陷阱。它的同伙大概就在附近。不过，咱们若走了，它也许能挣脱，再告诉其他家伙我们来过。怎么办？%SPEECH_OFF%

4a19bbe21c24f0e92ebe.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]One way or another, the goblin cannot be allowed to live. You step into the clearing to put it out of its misery and, perhaps, get a glimpse at what treasures the corpse might carry. The greenskin shrinks at the sight of you, snarling and rearing up, the trap wrinkling the chains to which it is attached. %randombrother%, weapon in hand, carefully gets near to the beast and then kills it with a single blow.

 With the threat taken care of, you roll the dead man's body over and loot everything worth taking.
4a19bbe21c24f0e92ebe.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]无论如何，不能让这只地精活下去。你走进空地，准备结束它的痛苦，顺便看看旁边的尸体带了什么财物。绿皮见到你便畏缩起来，继而龇牙嘶吼，猛地挣扎起身，捕兽夹拖得铁链一阵作响。%randombrother%手持武器，小心接近，随后一击了结了它。

威胁已除，你把那具男尸翻过来，将值钱的东西搜刮一空。

f0ffbf995d07c485e9e1.source: One goblin less to worry about.

571450f898bcfda7b23c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_69.png[/img]This is a war of annihilation and no greenskin can be allowed to live. You step into the field and slay the foul thing. With it out of the way, you roll the dead man's body over and loot all that's worth taking. Just as you get ready to leave, a gargling growl rumbles from the treeline. %randombrother% takes out his weapon and points.%SPEECH_ON%Nachzehrers!%SPEECH_OFF%Damn! They must have smelled the dying goblin and came to feast. Some of them are already picking their teeth with orc bones...
571450f898bcfda7b23c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_69.png[/img]这是一场灭族之战，不能留下任何活着的绿皮。你走进空地，杀死那肮脏的东西，随后翻过男尸，把值钱的东西全拿走。正要离开，林缘传来低沉的咕噜嘶吼。%randombrother%拔出武器，指向那边。%SPEECH_ON%食尸鬼！%SPEECH_OFF%该死！它们准是闻到了垂死地精的气味，赶来赴宴。有几个还拿着兽人的骨头剔牙……

97979488274b32ec96b4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You're not going to risk the company over a single measly goblin and a dead man who may or may not have anything valuable. The company gives a wide berth to the clearing and continue on through the forest without any issue.
97979488274b32ec96b4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]区区一只地精，加上一具不知有没有值钱物件的男尸，不值得让战团冒险。你带人远远绕过空地，平安穿过了森林。

83ca7f6cd84851eeeec0.source: Best keep the company in shape for bigger threats.
83ca7f6cd84851eeeec0.translation: 还是保存战团的实力，留着应付更大的威胁。

52168c7455575f91d105.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]You're not going to risk the company over a single measly goblin and a dead man who may or may not have anything valuable. The company gives a wide berth to the clearing and continue on through the forest.

 No more than five minutes down the road do you hear a thundering of footsteps coming up from the rear. Loud and burly enough that whoever is making it has no fear of being heard. You duck and wait and, unsurprisingly, orcs and goblins come through the trees. One of them is the bastard you'd left to the bear trap, his leg hurriedly wrapped in linens and leaves.
52168c7455575f91d105.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_48.png[/img]你不打算为了一个不起眼的地精，以及一个身上未必有值钱东西的死人，让战团冒险。众人远远绕过空地，继续穿行森林。

走了还不到五分钟，身后便传来雷鸣般的脚步，沉重又响亮，来者显然丝毫不怕被发现。你俯身隐蔽，静候片刻，果然，一群兽人和地精从林中出现。其中就有先前留在捕兽夹里的那个杂种，腿上草草裹着亚麻布和树叶。

5882dcc174118c72701c.source: Damn, the little runt found us!
5882dcc174118c72701c.translation: 该死，那小东西发现我们了！

9ab51c9db3b2359c10d6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]A man in a suit of armor stops you on the path. You put a hand to your sword and order him to announce his intentions, all the while keeping your eyes peeled for an ambush. The stranger takes a step forward and removes his helm.%SPEECH_ON%I am %crusader%, a fighter from a fiery land with no name. I stood upon the hills of evil counsel. I slew the monsters of Dev'ungrad. I gave peace to the spirits at Shellstaya. When the ancients speak, I listen. And so here I am.%SPEECH_OFF%You take your hand off your sword and ask him of the ancients. He nods and speaks.%SPEECH_ON%The men before men, the ancients were suzerain over all things, having forged an empire that stretched to realms far beyond this one. All this chaos is mere fragments of their destruction. A man may die, but an empire does not. An empire decays, piece by piece, and takes with it all that it thinks it is owed.%SPEECH_OFF%The crusader puts his helmet back on and holds his sword up.%SPEECH_ON%The Empire of the Ancients stirs in its grave. I wish to help quiet it. I offer you my sword, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%
9ab51c9db3b2359c10d6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]一个身披全甲的男人在路上拦住你。你把手搭在剑上，命他说明来意，同时警惕地扫视四周，提防埋伏。陌生人上前一步，摘下头盔。%SPEECH_ON%我是%crusader%，来自无名烈焰之地的战士。我曾踏上hills of evil counsel，斩杀Dev'ungrad的怪物，让Shellstaya的亡魂安息。远古先民开口，我便聆听。于是，我来到了这里。%SPEECH_OFF%你把手从剑上移开，问起那些远古先民。他点头说道：%SPEECH_ON%先民，是人类之前的人。他们曾统御万物，建立的帝国远远超出这片天地。眼前一切混乱，不过是帝国毁灭留下的碎片。人会死，帝国却不会。帝国只是逐渐腐朽，一块接一块，将它认为属于自己的一切，都一并拖走。%SPEECH_OFF%圣战士重新戴上头盔，举起剑。%SPEECH_ON%先民的帝国正在坟墓中翻动。我愿助它归于沉寂。佣兵，我愿为你执剑。%SPEECH_OFF%

8899900553043067f5a3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]%crusader% the crusader approaches you with his armor off and his helmet tucked into the nook of his elbow.%SPEECH_ON%Good sir, I must bid the company adieu. With the undead beaten, my mission is complete.%SPEECH_OFF%You go to shake the man's hand, but he simply hands you his helm and weapon.%SPEECH_ON%You've more use for these than I. My fighting days are over. It was a pleasure to ride them into the twilight with you by my side. Send the men my regards.%SPEECH_OFF%
8899900553043067f5a3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]十字军%crusader%卸下了盔甲，臂弯里夹着头盔，走到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我得向战团道别了。亡灵已败，我的使命也已完成。%SPEECH_OFF%你伸手想与他相握，他却把头盔和武器交给了你。%SPEECH_ON%你比我更用得着这些。我的征战生涯结束了。能在最后这段日子与你并肩作战，我很高兴。替我向弟兄们问好。%SPEECH_OFF%

06f0c0d878458db778a3.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]While traversing the cold wastes, you come to the lip of a frozen pond. %randombrother% spots something sticking out its middle. You see that it's a knight whose body has been frozen hip-deep, but the upper body is still moving around. The eyes glow red and its fingers, jet black from frost bite, still manage to clench and grip. Its jaw is held together by ice for muscles as though with decaying and translucent tendons.

%randombrother% points to the giant wiederganger with the frozen visage.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, look! That farker's got a big ol' sword on him. That might be worth trying to nab, no?%SPEECH_OFF%
06f0c0d878458db778a3.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]穿越寒冷荒原时，你来到一座冰池边。%randombrother%发现池中央有什么东西露在外面。你看清那是个骑士，下半身被冰封到髋部，上半身却还在动。双眼泛着红光，冻得漆黑的手指依旧能屈伸抓握。冰块代替肌肉连着下颌，仿佛腐烂而半透明的筋腱。

%randombrother%指着那具面容冰封的高大行尸。%SPEECH_ON%喂，快看！那混蛋手里有把大剑。值得想法子弄过来，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%

895820364af1331f6d44.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%chosenbrother% elects to try and make a run on getting the dead knight's sword. His first step on the pond sends an icy warble clear across the underbelly of the frozen sheet. He tests his footing again. The ice shifts and chitters, but it does not crack. With every step, the sellsword measures his own weight and its likelihood to collapse the ice - all the meanwhile, making sure he doesn't step on one of the corpses littered about.

He successfully gets to the undead knight. Icicles dangle off its sword, the blade itself encapsulated in a layer of ice. The sellsword grabs the blade and yanks. The undead knight's arm lurches forward and breaks off at the elbow, sending the sellsword arse-skating backward across the pond. He slides up against the edge where your men help him up. The sword will need to be heated to get the ice off, but the weapon is definitely usable.
895820364af1331f6d44.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%chosenbrother%决定试着取回死骑士的剑。他一脚踏上池面，整片冰层下便传开低沉的颤鸣。他又试了试脚下，冰面挪动吱响，却没有裂开。每迈一步，佣兵都仔细掂量自身重量会不会压塌冰层，同时还得避免踩上四处散落的尸体。

他成功走到亡灵骑士面前。剑上垂着冰凌，整个剑刃裹在冰层里。他握住剑，用力一拽。亡灵骑士的胳膊猛地前伸，在肘部折断，佣兵也一屁股向后滑过池面。滑到岸边，弟兄们把他拉起来。这把剑还得加热除冰，不过肯定能用。

42ed41041a210c646599.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%chosenbrother% tries the ice, putting a foot right on the edge of the pond. A soft warble echoes across the pondwater's cold underbelly, as though someone had skipped a drumming rock across a barreled surface. He looks back at the party and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Seem's aight.%SPEECH_OFF%His next step sends him crashing through the ice. Shards break into a sort of chevron entrapment and when he reaches out to grab one it slices his hands. The men quickly throw him a rope and drag him out.

Bloodied and shivering, %chosenbrother% shakes his head as he's wrapped in blankets.%SPEECH_ON%I-I-I-I believe that was aw-aw-aw-awful. Aw-aw-awful idea, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%
42ed41041a210c646599.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%chosenbrother%将一只脚放到池边，试探冰面。冰下传出轻微的颤鸣，仿佛有人用石子在鼓面似的冰层上打了个水漂。他回头看向众人，耸肩道：%SPEECH_ON%好像挺结实。%SPEECH_OFF%下一步，他便踏破冰面，掉了下去。碎冰裂成一圈尖角，像牢笼般围住他；伸手去抓，反而割伤了双手。弟兄们赶紧抛绳，将他拖出来。

%chosenbrother%浑身是血，冷得发抖，被裹进毯子时直摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我、我、我觉得，这主意糟、糟、糟透了。团长，真糟、糟透了。%SPEECH_OFF%

b3f8862becfeb3d1dfd9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%lightweight% steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%Ice? Ice is nothing. You can glide on it like this.%SPEECH_OFF%Without even a pause, the man leaps out onto the frozen pond and skates across its surface. Cracks emerge out from behind him like a wake of imminently bad news, but he remains unperturbed. He swings by the undead knight and grabs the frozen sword. The wiederganger groans as its arm breaks off at the elbow. The man merrily skates his way back to the edge of the pond and presents the sword to you. %otherbrother% steps forward and cracks the wiederganger's frozen arm off the handle like a man breaking a crab claw.%SPEECH_ON%Would ya look at that?%SPEECH_OFF%He crushes the fingers into fragments and in the powdered remains there is a signet. A sword and jewelry, what's not to love about this result?
b3f8862becfeb3d1dfd9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%lightweight%走上前。%SPEECH_ON%冰？冰算什么。像这样滑过去就行。%SPEECH_OFF%他片刻不停，纵身跃上冰池，沿着冰面滑行。裂纹在身后蔓延，如同坏事将至的尾波，他却毫不在意。滑过亡灵骑士身旁时，他一把抓住冻剑。行尸的胳膊从肘部断开，发出一声呻吟。那人兴高采烈地滑回池边，把剑献给你。%otherbrother%上前，像掰蟹钳一样，把行尸冻住的手臂从剑柄上掰掉。%SPEECH_ON%瞧瞧，这是什么？%SPEECH_OFF%他把手指捏成碎屑，粉末中露出一枚印戒。宝剑加首饰，这结果还有什么不满意？

335c56534c780acd0977.source: You are quick on your feet, %lightweightfull%. Give it a try?

e1fd8175142ad6433fc2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]Marching through a foggy, hot rain, you spot a figure standing in the middle of the path. He's holding a metal-wreathed torch, no doubt the fire of a man wanting to be seen. As you draw near, he puts the torch down, giving light to an oddly familiar face, though you can't quite put your finger on it. You order him to announce himself.%SPEECH_ON%Are ye a lot of sellswords, hm?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him that is not a name. He clears his throat, a soft orange glow of his face peering through the storm's dark.%SPEECH_ON%My name is Barnabas. Are ye sellswords or not?%SPEECH_OFF%Carefully, you cross the path and come close to the man. He waves the torch aside.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, I figured as much. My brother, I need someone... I mean, I can't...%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and speak for him.%SPEECH_ON%He's come up out of the grave and now you want someone to take care of him.%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods, he waves the torch to a yonder spot where a dim light burns in the distance.%SPEECH_ON%He's thataway. I'll pay you %reward% crowns, seeing as how you're sellswords and all.%SPEECH_OFF%
e1fd8175142ad6433fc2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]闷热的雨雾中，你看见路中央站着一个人，举着带铁箍的火把，显然存心让人看见。你走近时，他放低火把，照亮一张似曾相识的脸，却一时想不起像谁。你命他报上名来。%SPEECH_ON%你们是佣兵，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你说，这可不是名字。他清清嗓子，橙色火光将面孔映在暴雨的幽暗中。%SPEECH_ON%我叫巴纳巴斯。你们到底是不是佣兵？%SPEECH_OFF%你小心走过道路，靠近那人。他将火把摆向一边。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，我就知道。我兄弟，我需要有人……我是说，我没法……%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，替他说了下去。%SPEECH_ON%他从坟里爬出来了，你想找人替你处理。%SPEECH_OFF%那人点头，将火把指向远处一点黯淡的光。%SPEECH_ON%他就在那边。既然你们是佣兵，我出%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%

f73d44cc5aa61ea221b3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]You tell the man to show the way, bringing %chosenbrother% with you and leaving another sellsword in charge while you're gone. Barnabas leads you down a hillside and to the fence line of a property home to a decently sized stone house. Candlelight flickers beyond the windows. Barnabas stares forward.%SPEECH_ON%Nobody's there. The only one here is Hoggart.%SPEECH_OFF%That name... Barnabas's face... You grab the man and push him into the fence, demanding to know if he is the bandit's brother. Barnabas quickly nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, that I am! What of it?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him that Hoggart nearly wiped out the %companyname% and that, in return, you slew the man dead. Barnabas holds his hands up.%SPEECH_ON%If that's so, it is what it is. Hoggart was only doing what he needed to keep the property in the family. After our father died, we took on debts - debts we could not pay.%SPEECH_OFF%You draw a dagger and put it to the man's throat. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not here to ambush or rob you. The home's been sold. It's out of the family. But Hoggart... he's come back and he won't leave.%SPEECH_OFF%You look over Barnabas's shoulder. There's a dark figure standing before the home, its silhouette lit by the windowlight.
f73d44cc5aa61ea221b3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]你让那人带路，带上%chosenbrother%，另留一名佣兵暂时管事。巴纳巴斯领你们走下山坡，来到一处宅产的篱笆边。里面有座颇具规模的石屋，窗后烛光摇曳。巴纳巴斯直望前方。%SPEECH_ON%屋里没人。这里只有霍加特。%SPEECH_OFF%这个名字……巴纳巴斯的脸……你一把抓住他，将他推到篱笆上，喝问他是否就是那土匪的兄弟。巴纳巴斯急忙点头。%SPEECH_ON%是，我是！那又怎样？%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，霍加特差点灭了%companyname%，所以你后来杀了他。巴纳巴斯举起双手。%SPEECH_ON%若真如此，那就是如此。霍加特所做的一切，只为保住家族的宅产。父亲死后，我们背上了债，还不起的债。%SPEECH_OFF%你抽出匕首，抵住他的喉咙。他摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我不是来埋伏你，也不是来抢你。房子已经卖了，不再属于我们。可霍加特……他回来了，不肯走。%SPEECH_OFF%你越过巴纳巴斯的肩望去，一个黑影站在屋前，窗内的光勾勒出他的轮廓。

d84d31d6cf62877a4535.source: This is not our problem anymore.
d84d31d6cf62877a4535.translation: 这已不再是我们的麻烦。

9740ed0408a5b239641b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]Bloodlines are not easily broken. Whatever Barnabas is saying, it's likely that he'll come after the company someday, someday when it's cold and quiet and the fires of vengeance can't be so easily quenched.

 You tell the man to lead the way, and the second he turns about you stab him just beneath the armpit, piercing his heart. He doesn't say anything. He simply goes to his knees, facing the back of his brother and the home he grew up in. He sits there, crumpled and dying, the rain pattering against the torch until it sizzles dead. %chosenbrother% spits.%SPEECH_ON%Good call, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%He rifles through the body and finds a shiny dagger. Perhaps the tool to an assassin, perhaps the last heirloom of a dead family name. Either way, you take it and return to the %companyname%.
9740ed0408a5b239641b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]血缘不是轻易能斩断的。无论巴纳巴斯嘴上说什么，他很可能总有一天会找战团报仇。某个寒冷寂静的日子，复仇之火便再也压不住。

你让他带路。他刚转身，你就从腋下刺入，贯穿心脏。他什么也没说，只是跪了下去，面对兄弟的背影，以及自己长大的家。他蜷在那里，渐渐死去。雨打在火把上，火光嘶地一声熄了。%chosenbrother%啐道：%SPEECH_ON%团长，做得对。%SPEECH_OFF%他搜查尸体，找到一把闪亮的匕首。也许是刺客的工具，也许是这个断绝家族最后的遗物。无论如何，你收下它，回到%companyname%。

f848d18c7de998239a56.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]This is not your problem, nor should it ever be. Hoggart is dead and that's all you need, or want, to know about him or any of his family name. You leave Barnabas there in the rain and return to the %companyname% to plan for the next trip.
f848d18c7de998239a56.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]这事与你无关，也永远不该与你有关。霍加特已经死了，关于他，关于他那一家子，你只需要知道这些，也只想知道这些。你把巴纳巴斯留在雨中，回到%companyname%，筹划下一段行程。

1dbda0615ec51828c5ab.source: We got enough undead problems on our hands.
1dbda0615ec51828c5ab.translation: 手头的亡灵麻烦已经够多了。

623ab49b4a7c19f64b2a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]Against better judgment, you go and see if this really is Hoggart. Marching toward him, he growls and peers over his shoulder. It is indeed Hoggart, but he does little more than snarl at you before turning to stare at the home again. Taking out your sword, you approach carefully. From closer up, you can see that the man's head has been stitched back onto someone else's body, perhaps a knight's based upon the armored crest it is wearing.

 But enough lollygagging. You swing your sword back and bring it down upon Hoggart for one final blow - but a faint, blue hand launches out, stopping the blade as though you'd struck a slab of stone. Slowly, a spectral face turns, independent of Hoggart, and looks at you. He shrieks before disappearing back into the dead man's lent body.

 Barnabas stands beside you.%SPEECH_ON%If I could do it that easily, I would have done it myself.%SPEECH_OFF%It appears there's a powerful, malevolent force at play here. You will need to find a different solution.
623ab49b4a7c19f64b2a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]明知不够明智，你还是走过去，要看看这是否真是霍加特。你靠近时，他低吼着回头望来。确实是霍加特，可他只是冲你龇牙咆哮，便又转回去盯着房子。你拔剑，小心接近。从近处看，他的脑袋被缝在别人的身体上。凭那副盔甲的纹饰判断，身躯原主或许是个骑士。

不过，不能再磨蹭了。你挥剑蓄势，朝霍加特劈下最后一击——一只淡蓝色的手却突然伸出，挡住剑刃，犹如砍在石板上。一张幽魂的面孔缓缓转来，独立于霍加特，望向你。它尖叫一声，随即缩回死人借来的身躯。

巴纳巴斯站在旁边。%SPEECH_ON%要有这么容易，我早就自己动手了。%SPEECH_OFF%看来，这里盘踞着强大而邪恶的力量，得另想办法。

8472009d386488e3e15c.source: We need to burn down the house.

273b1448ff40b0f49a38.source:
