[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]Hoggart reaches a hand out to his home, gripping at it from a distance. His growls turn to soft moans. A disfigured and desiccated tongue rolls a few words out.%SPEECH_ON%Ours... ours... always...%SPEECH_OFF%You glance at the house, then at %chosenbrother%. He nods. The house has to be ridden of. You go about setting the place aflame from the inside, pitching torches through its windows and setting alight its thatched roof. Even in the rain it catches ablaze. Hoggart growls and his body lurches forward, arms out, hands reached to the furthest fingertips. The specter spawns out of his shoulders, its translucent arms grabbing Hoggart by the head and trying to hold him back. The dead man growls and tries to run forward, his head tearing at the seams of his stitches. He screams.%SPEECH_ON%OURS! I TRIED. SO. HARD!%SPEECH_OFF%The stitches snap free and his body somersaults backwards, his head torn asunder and falling into the mud. The blue specter, wrenched free from the neck, screams and soars into the night sky, a mere shimmer against the rain until it is gone.

 Barnabas goes and sits beside Hoggart, the dead man's eyes staring blankly at the inferno consuming their childhood home. %chosenbrother% retrieves the armor from the body upon which Hoggart's head had rested. You try and talk to Barnabas, but he refuses to speak. Understanding, you do not prod him and leave the place behind, the fires still unerring against the rain when you depart.
273b1448ff40b0f49a38.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]霍加特伸手朝向家宅，隔空抓握。低吼变成了轻轻的呻吟，扭曲干瘪的舌头挤出几个字。%SPEECH_ON%我们的……我们的……永远……%SPEECH_OFF%你看看房子，又看向%chosenbrother%。他点头。这房子必须毁掉。你开始放火，将火把从窗户扔入，点燃茅草屋顶，从屋内烧起。即便下着雨，火势仍然蔓延。霍加特低吼，身躯猛然前扑，双臂伸展，连指尖都拼命探向前方。幽魂从他肩头冒出，用半透明的双臂抓住霍加特的脑袋，试图将他拉住。死人咆哮着向前冲，头颅扯得缝线崩紧。他尖叫：%SPEECH_ON%我们的！我已经！那么！拼命！%SPEECH_OFF%缝线断裂，身体向后翻倒，脑袋被扯离，掉进泥里。蓝色幽魂从脖颈间挣脱，尖啸着冲入夜空，在雨中闪过一丝微光，随即消失。

巴纳巴斯走到霍加特身旁坐下。死者的双眼空洞地望着烈焰，那是他们童年家园正在燃烧。%chosenbrother%从曾缝着霍加特头颅的尸身上取下盔甲。你想与巴纳巴斯说话，他却拒绝开口。你能理解，便不再追问，带人离开。临走时，火势仍在雨中顽强地烧着。

ed36787d55f48002bf5f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]You whisper to %chosenbrother% to attack Hoggart, but only to try and distract the specter inhabiting his body. The sellsword nods and immediately gets to work, drawing out his weapon and charging forward. Predictably, a blue arm shoots out, crossing its unerring yet translucent shape with %chosenbrother%'s weapon. He looks over the interlocking and screams.%SPEECH_ON%Now!%SPEECH_OFF%You jump forward and swing your sword. The specter whips around, screaming, but it is too late. Your blade passes through Hoggart's neck, rending his head free with a quick slash, his dome rolling down his chest into the mud while the body flails backward. Ushered into the world all by itself, the specter shrieks and swirls around in the sky, finding naught but chaos in its newfound freedom. %chosenbrother% looks at the chest armor that had been on Hoggart's body and shakes his head. Damn thing broke.

 A group of men suddenly start across the yard, holding out torches and swords alike. One especially opulent fellow leads them.%SPEECH_ON%Is that you Barnabas? I thought I told you to never step foot on my property again!%SPEECH_OFF%You explain to them what happened. The man, ostensibly the buyer of the land, nods, saying he'd brought with him a cleric to solve the issue, but now that you have he pays you a tidy sum of crowns. When you turn back around, Barnabas and Hoggart's head are both gone.
ed36787d55f48002bf5f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]你低声让%chosenbrother%进攻霍加特，只为牵制寄居其体内的幽魂。佣兵点头，立即拔出武器，冲了上去。果然，一条蓝色手臂探出，半透明的形体坚实地挡住%chosenbrother%的武器。他越过相抵之处望来，高喊：%SPEECH_ON%现在！%SPEECH_OFF%你跃上前，挥剑斩下。幽魂尖叫着转身，可已来不及。剑刃掠过霍加特的脖颈，迅速斩断，脑袋沿胸口滚落泥中，身体则向后翻倒。被迫独自来到世间的幽魂，在空中盘旋尖啸。新得的自由，带给它的只有混乱。%chosenbrother%看了看霍加特身上的胸甲，摇了摇头。该死，弄坏了。

突然，一群人举着火把和刀剑穿过院子，领头的衣着格外奢华。%SPEECH_ON%巴纳巴斯，是你吗？我不是说过，再也不许踏进我的地盘！%SPEECH_OFF%你向他们说明经过。那人显然就是宅地的买主，点头说自己已请来教士处理，可既然你办妥了，便付了一笔可观的克朗。你再回头时，巴纳巴斯和霍加特的头颅都已不见。

3443c3742ae55cdf6290.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]%chosenbrother% says that %witchhunter% probably knows what to do here. You agree and run to go get the witch hunter. On your return, he assesses the situation before consulting a thick book that'd been hidden away in a pocket. He nods, murmuring to himself as he reads. Finally, he snaps his fingers.%SPEECH_ON%This is a Gespenst von Zwei, a haunting of two souls. In this case, Hoggart's and that of the man whose body his head now rests upon. One soul egregiously cast out is simple enough, but two combined is a malevolent and angry force. If we simply destroy the body or the head, the souls will be bound together and will haunt the lands forever. Some even blunder into the skies. Unfortunately, instead of finding the heavens, they find a hell of unending confusion and the fury that brings. I believe Hoggart's soul, or whatever binds him to this world, is stronger than that of the other man's. The struggle he had in life was too great to simply end on his final breath and that is why he stands at his old home.%SPEECH_OFF%You stop the witch hunter and ask the most pertinent question...
3443c3742ae55cdf6290.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]%chosenbrother%说，%witchhunter%大概知道该怎么办。你同意，赶紧跑去找猎巫人。回来后，他审视现场，再翻看藏在口袋里的一本厚书。他边读边点头，低声自语，最后打了个响指。%SPEECH_ON%这是双魂怨灵，由两个灵魂纠缠而成。这里，一个是霍加特，另一个是这具身躯原来的主人，如今霍加特的头就安在他身上。单个被强行逐出的灵魂，尚且容易对付；两个合在一起，就成了恶毒而暴怒的力量。若只毁掉身体或头颅，灵魂便会永远绑在一起，祸害这片土地。有些甚至误入高空，可找到的并非天堂，而是无尽迷惘与狂怒构成的地狱。我认为，霍加特的灵魂，或者把他系在现世的执念，比另一人的更强。他生前的挣扎太深，无法随着最后一口气就此了结，所以才会站在旧居前。%SPEECH_OFF%你打断猎巫人，问了最要紧的问题……

e521d9c40fb237a4d63b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]%witchhunter% forces a smile.%SPEECH_ON%Apologize to him.%SPEECH_OFF%Not sure you heard him right, you echo his phrase and the witch hunter nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, apologize. And mean it, too. Many men are so filled with hate, or so filled with desire, that any failure contextualizes itself as an energy beyond the mortal coil. You killed this man. It is you who upended a life which could not brook even the slightest of pauses, much less the ultimate defeat that is death. It is you who can end his struggle now. I believe apologizing would do this.%SPEECH_OFF%Barnabas steps forward and explains, again, that Hoggart only worked to ensure that the estate stayed within the family. All that he did was for the family. He was not an evil or cruel man, he was only doing what he thought was right. %witchhunter% throws a hand out as if to say 'see'.%SPEECH_ON%Well, there ya go. Captain, listen. Whatever feud there was between you two is over. This is something else. No man deserves this fate. Apologize to him from the heart and you can end his suffering once and for all.%SPEECH_OFF%
e521d9c40fb237a4d63b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]%witchhunter%勉强笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%向他道歉。%SPEECH_OFF%你怀疑听错，重复了一遍。猎巫人点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，道歉，而且得发自真心。有些人被仇恨或欲望填满，任何失败都会化成超越肉身的执念。你杀了他。是你终结了他的人生，而那样的人生，连片刻停顿都无法容忍，更别说死亡这种彻底的失败。如今，能结束他挣扎的人也是你。我想，道歉就能做到。%SPEECH_OFF%巴纳巴斯上前，再次解释，霍加特做的一切，只为保住家族的宅产。他所有努力都是为了家人。他不是恶毒残忍的人，只是在做自己认定正确的事。%witchhunter%摊出一只手，仿佛在说‘你看’。%SPEECH_ON%就是这样。团长，听我说。不管你们有过什么仇怨，都已经结束了。眼前是另一回事，没人该遭受这种命运。诚心向他道歉，你就能彻底结束他的痛苦。%SPEECH_OFF%

93f1ca33e390c323808e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]You step toward Hoggart. He growls and eyes you for a moment before staring back at the home. With another cautionary step, you come to stand in front of him. His glazed, desiccated eyes glare at you, but he doesn't look away this time. You speak.%SPEECH_ON%Hoggart...%SPEECH_OFF%The undead man leans back, his eyes slimming incredulously, his hand touching his chest. His voice seems to unfurl, strained from the depths of a borrowed body.%SPEECH_ON%Ho...ggart... I... tried...%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you jack your thumbs into your belt line.%SPEECH_ON%I know you tried. I mean, I didn't know you were trying to begin with, but now I know. Look, your brother told me everything. Had I known, I wouldn't have taken that contract. You didn't...%SPEECH_OFF%You glance at %witchhunter% who nods. You continue.%SPEECH_ON%Hoggart, you didn't deserve to die. Not like that. Were I in your shoes, I would have been doing the same. But I wasn't in your shoes. I could not have understood who you were or what you were doing. I was only doing what I was paid to do. I can't take back what's been done, all I can do is say... I'm sorry. You don't deserve this pain and I am sorry.%SPEECH_OFF%Hoggart's glazed, drooping eyes stare at you a moment longer, then suddenly his body wobbles and falls forward. Two spirits emerge, one twisting and shooting across the muddied land, wimpling stones with tears of its blue spectra as it streaks straight to the horizon. But the other spirit remains, glowing a faint gold now, and it simply floats toward the home. Barnabas follows after it and you after him. Together, you round a corner and head toward the back end of the property where Hoggart's ghost pauses.%SPEECH_ON%All I did, for this. No longer mine. Yours.%SPEECH_OFF%The spirit fades away as Barnabas reaches out to it, glistening dust floating away from his touch. You notice that the earth has been upturned here and a crate is sinking into the rainwater. Dragging it up and opening it, you find an enormous sword with decorations of Hoggart's family name. Baranabas looks as shocked as you about it.%SPEECH_ON%The family heirloom. He said he'd never sell it to save the estate, he thought one couldn't be without the other. When I told him it had to be done he took it town and then came back and told me he lost it gambling... I never talked to him again. Last thing I said to him was that he was a no good vagrant and the worst brother anyone could ever have. Now I know the truth. You have brought me and my brother peace, sellsword, and that peace is all I want to remember. Please, as my brother said, take the heirloom.%SPEECH_OFF%You take the sword and wish Barnabas the best. The last you see of him he is sitting in the mud, body hunched, tottering and weeping with the rain all around him until there's no man at all, just a warm home and a storm booming with golden lightning.
93f1ca33e390c323808e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]你走向霍加特。他低吼着看了你一会儿，又盯回家宅。你再小心迈出一步，站到他面前。混浊干瘪的双眼瞪着你，这次没有移开。你开口。%SPEECH_ON%霍加特……%SPEECH_OFF%亡者向后仰，不可置信地眯起眼，一只手摸向胸口。声音仿佛从借来的身躯深处费力舒展开来。%SPEECH_ON%霍……加特……我……尽力了……%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，将拇指勾进腰带。%SPEECH_ON%我知道你尽力了。我是说，一开始我不知道你在争取什么，可现在知道了。你兄弟把一切都告诉我了。要是早知道，我不会接那份委托。你不该……%SPEECH_OFF%你看向%witchhunter%，他点头。你继续说：%SPEECH_ON%霍加特，你不该死，至少不该那样死。换作是我，也会做同样的事。可我没站在你的位置，不懂你是什么人，也不知道你在做什么。我只是拿钱办事。已经做过的，我收不回来。唯一能说的，是……对不起。你不该受这种痛苦，我很抱歉。%SPEECH_OFF%霍加特混浊低垂的双眼又望了你片刻，身躯突然一晃，向前倒下。两个灵魂随之浮现：一个扭动着掠过泥地，蓝色幽光如泪洒过石块，直奔天际；另一个却留了下来，泛起淡淡金光，轻轻飘向家宅。巴纳巴斯跟了上去，你也跟着。你们一起绕过拐角，来到宅地后方，霍加特的鬼魂在那里停下。%SPEECH_ON%我做的一切，为了这个。不再属于我。是你的了。%SPEECH_OFF%巴纳巴斯伸手时，灵魂渐渐消散，指边只有闪亮的尘埃飘走。你注意到，这里的土被翻动过，一只箱子正往雨水里沉。拉出来打开，里面是一把大剑，纹饰中带着霍加特的家族名。巴纳巴斯与你一样震惊。%SPEECH_ON%传家宝。他说，宁可宅产保不住，也绝不卖掉它。在他看来，两样缺一不可。我告诉他，非卖不可，他便拿去镇上，回来却说赌博输掉了……从那以后，我再没跟他说过话。最后骂他的话，是说他是个一无是处的流浪汉，世上再没有比他更糟的兄弟。如今，我终于知道真相。佣兵，你让我们兄弟都得了安宁，我只想记住这份安宁。求你，照我兄弟说的，收下传家宝吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你收起剑，祝巴纳巴斯往后一切安好。最后看见他时，他蜷坐在泥里，微微摇晃，哭泣，四周落满雨。渐渐地，仿佛那里已不再有一个人，只剩温暖的家，以及金色闪电轰鸣的风暴。

f0a71bfdd0437d142a12.source: Let's get %witchhunter%. Vile spirits are his forte.
f0a71bfdd0437d142a12.translation: 把%witchhunter%叫来，对付恶灵是他的拿手好戏。

f49537fb9fcbe11a7e8d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]You put your head down for a nap.

 The silky bedsheet slides off your body as you roll to a side. Birds flutter past a sleek, ivory-framed window. A voice pours into your ear, a hint of an aroma you've never smelled before gracing you.%SPEECH_ON%You're awake.%SPEECH_OFF%A woman rolls herself over, running a finger down your chest before going back up and seizing your chin. Lithe, pretty, the sun glowing across her smooth face, and lighting up a set of emerald eyes. She goes for a kiss. You quickly slide out of the bed and frantically look around. She grips the sheets and comes to her knees, confused.%SPEECH_ON%What's wrong? Where are you going my Emperor?%SPEECH_OFF%Looking up, you see a ceiling that stretches so far up you can hardly even see the artwork which has been exquisitely embroidered there. You open a door and step out onto a balcony. Impossibly tall buildings, red, white, gold banners, a horizon steepled with black shapes stretching as far as the eye wishes to see. Domes, fountains, great arches, statues that stand so tall they seem to be commanding the structures as soldiers. Atop each roof is a garden greater and more flush than anything you've seen in the eternal springs of nature itself. Suddenly, two men emerges at your sides with cages of doves and let them out. The birds desperately scatter and just then a roar erupts beneath you. Great crowds of people jumping and waving banners around.%SPEECH_ON%They love their Emperor.%SPEECH_OFF%The woman speaks from the doorway.%SPEECH_ON%Go to them.%SPEECH_OFF%You look down to see a stream of soldiers marching down the middle of the road, each man stepping in unison with his brother, a steady staccato clap of boots. Their faces stern in their gilded helms, long polearms glistening upward as though they meant to defeat their enemies with opulence itself.%SPEECH_ON%They're going off to war. To face the Great Beyond, and to defeat it.%SPEECH_OFF%The woman is at your side. She smiles warmly, taking you by the arm. You feel ready to agree to it, to this new reality, whatever it be. You take her by the cheek, ready to fall into her embrace, but a cry from below wails loud and clear over all else. You glance down to see the soldiers, once joined in perfect uniformity, breaking rank. In the distance, a great mountain is erupting, jetting great bursts of red fire and an enormous cloud of hot ash which quickly pools into the city. Buildings disintegrate, gardens burst into flames, and the people... the people scream. They turn away, but there is no escaping the heat. The soldiers collapse and scream. A surging, searing heat, and soon enough you see the denizens melting in it, the soldiers becoming metal golems, singed into the very armor which was meant to protect them, and the unarmored crowds simply burst aflame. The woman cries at your side.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, it is horrible! Horrible! Would you look at it? But it's okay, understand? It's perfectly okay. Look at me. Look at me!%SPEECH_OFF%The woman grabs you and spins you. Her once soft features have hardened into blackened flakes, the top of her head already burnt bald, her teeth falling out of dripping gums. Yet she's grinning.%SPEECH_ON%We'll rise again, Emperor! We... shall... rise... again!%SPEECH_OFF%Her skull breaks apart and her body collapses into a pile of burning bones.

 You jerk awake to find %randombrother% shaking you.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, wakeup! We've got a group of refugees here saying that the dead are rising from the earth and killing everything in sight!%SPEECH_OFF%The woman's face flashes before your eyes. It is horrifically scarred, but this doesn't stop her from grinning.%SPEECH_ON%The Empire rises.%SPEECH_OFF%
f49537fb9fcbe11a7e8d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]你低头小睡片刻。

翻身时，丝滑的床单从身上滑落。鸟儿掠过光洁的象牙窗框，一道声音流进耳中，带来一缕从未闻过的幽香。%SPEECH_ON%你醒了。%SPEECH_OFF%一个女人翻身靠近，指尖沿你胸口向下，又向上，轻轻托住下巴。她身姿轻盈，容貌秀美，阳光掠过光滑的脸颊，映亮一双翡翠般的眼睛。她想吻你。你却迅速下床，慌忙打量四周。她攥着床单跪坐起来，满脸困惑。%SPEECH_ON%怎么了？我的皇帝，你要去哪儿？%SPEECH_OFF%抬头望去，天花板高得几乎看不清上面精美的图案。你推开一扇门，走上阳台。建筑高得不可思议，红、白、金色的旗帜处处飘扬，黑色尖塔的轮廓铺满天际，一直延伸到视线尽头。穹顶、喷泉、宏伟拱门，还有高耸的雕像，仿佛正将周围建筑当作士兵统领。每座屋顶都有花园，比你在大自然最丰盛的春天里见过的还要壮丽葱郁。突然，两个人提着鸽笼出现在你两侧，开笼放飞。鸟儿拼命散去，脚下随即爆发欢呼。无数人跳跃着，挥舞旗帜。%SPEECH_ON%他们爱戴自己的皇帝。%SPEECH_OFF%女人在门边说道：%SPEECH_ON%到他们身边去吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你低头，看见士兵沿大道中央源源行进，每一步都与身旁同袍整齐一致，靴声短促有力，节奏分明。镀金头盔下，面容肃穆，长柄兵器高举闪光，仿佛要凭奢华本身击败敌人。%SPEECH_ON%他们要去打仗，面对彼岸，征服彼岸。%SPEECH_OFF%女人已来到身边，温柔地微笑，挽住你的胳膊。你觉得自己愿意接受这一切，接受这个新的现实，无论它究竟是什么。你抚住她的脸颊，正要投入怀抱，脚下却传来一声清晰的尖叫，压过所有声响。低头望去，方才整齐如一的士兵正阵脚大乱。远处，一座大山喷发，赤焰冲天，庞大的炽热灰云迅速涌入城中。建筑崩解，花园起火，人们……人们在尖叫。他们转身逃跑，却避不开热浪。士兵倒地惨呼，灼热一波接一波涌来。很快，你看见居民在其中熔化；士兵与本该护体的盔甲烧熔在一起，成了金属魔像；没有盔甲的人群，则直接化作火焰。身边的女人哭喊：%SPEECH_ON%哦，太可怕了！太可怕了！你看见了吗？可没关系，明白吗？完全没关系。看着我，看着我！%SPEECH_OFF%女人抓住你，将你转过来。曾经柔软的面容已硬化成焦黑的碎片，头顶烧秃，牙齿从融烂的牙龈中脱落。可她仍在笑。%SPEECH_ON%我们会再起的，皇帝！我们……终将……再次……崛起！%SPEECH_OFF%她的头骨碎裂，身体塌成一堆燃烧的骸骨。

你猛然惊醒，发现%randombrother%正在摇晃你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，醒醒！来了一群难民，说死人正在从地下爬出来，见什么杀什么！%SPEECH_OFF%女人的脸在眼前闪过，伤痕狰狞，却仍咧嘴笑着。%SPEECH_ON%帝国正在苏醒。%SPEECH_OFF%

94f14d57dbc97e79d40e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]A pile of rubble stands off the side of the path. There before it is a studious greybeard looking keenly at the stones. He's so deep in thought he probably wouldn't notice if you simply walked on.
94f14d57dbc97e79d40e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]路旁堆着一片瓦砾。一个学者模样的灰胡子老头站在跟前，专注地端详石块。他沉思得如此入神，哪怕你径直走过，恐怕也不会察觉。

d02b2c5435b67c22e7ab.source: Let's see what he's up to.

d2616170dbe799b6fa2a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]You're not about to leave this poor old sod out here by himself. You sidle over to him and ask what he's up to. He looks over at you, what must be at least seventy winters having weathered his skin into a leathery and permanent wince. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Trying to make sense of it all. The dead are rising up out of the earth and, seeing as how I'm about to shuffle off to a grave of my own any day now, I figured why not be sure I'm not one to join their ranks? This here was a temple where I was offered purgation as a child. I was also wedded here and saw my only son wedded here as well.%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask what destroyed the building. The man laughs again.%SPEECH_ON%People came here asking the same questions I did. Godly questions in a world where the earth has manifested itself deific and rebirthed the dead. Violence was the answer they found - and so they decided to dismantle it stone by stone. I'd admonish them for that, but it'd be a ruse. I'd probably do the same as they did had I the means, but, you know, I'm old as shite and can't do much beyond lifting my own fingers. It's quite easy to be the pacifist when even a fly can lick your nose free of punishment.%SPEECH_OFF%His hearty laugh returns. He offers you a silver bowl.%SPEECH_ON%Found this in my search. Monks used to splash water in it to cleanse the sick. It ain't the answer I was looking for, but here, take it. I've no use for such things. Not now. Not in any sense. Good luck out there and if you, you know, see me again like 'that', please put me out of my misery.%SPEECH_OFF%
d2616170dbe799b6fa2a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]你不打算把这可怜老人独自留在这里，便走到旁边，问他在做什么。他望向你，至少七十个寒冬已将皮肤磨得如同旧革，永久皱成一副痛苦神情。他笑道：%SPEECH_ON%想把这些事弄明白。死人正从地下爬出来，而我自己随时也要进坟墓，就想先确认，别让我也跟他们一样。这里原本是座神殿，我小时候在这儿受过净化礼，后来在这儿成婚，也在这儿看着独子成婚。%SPEECH_OFF%你好奇，问神殿怎么毁了。老人又笑。%SPEECH_ON%人们来问和我一样的问题。在这个大地自行显灵、让死人重生的世界里，向神求答案。他们找到的答案是暴力，于是把这里一块石头一块石头地拆掉。我本该责备他们，可那是装样子。有本事的话，我多半也会一样干。不过你知道，我老得快散架，除了抬抬手指，几乎什么也做不了。连苍蝇舔鼻子都无可奈何时，当然很容易主张和平。%SPEECH_OFF%他再次爽朗地笑起来，递给你一只银碗。%SPEECH_ON%找答案时翻到的。以前修士用它盛水，给病人行洁净礼。这不是我要找的答案，不过给你，拿着。我用不上这些东西了。现在，用什么说法都一样。祝你在外好运。还有，要是哪天，你懂的，看见我成了‘那样’，劳驾让我解脱。%SPEECH_OFF%

49bc9b294ab7530bb6b3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]These are dangerous times for even men of strong stock, it sure as hell isn't safe for an old fart who has probably lost a couple of marbles. You go over and call out to him. Instantly, he jerks his head around, eyes flared, the pupils bloated to make his sight a starless abyss. He points a finger right at you.%SPEECH_ON%Your blood. Give it to me.%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger slowly rises to his feet. His cloak falls off his body, revealing a naked skeleton with only the thinnest veneer of flesh. He shambles toward you. His mouth is open, but there are no articulations. He seems to be speaking from some other world entirely.%SPEECH_ON%My reckoning, your crimson, my reckoning, your crimson.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% jumps forward, weapon in hand.%SPEECH_ON%He's a sorcerer!%SPEECH_OFF%The men arm themselves as the necromancer leans back, his cloak lifting up off the ground and clothing him as though the wind itself were at his beck and call. Suddenly, bodies emerge from the earth, growling and mewling. He stares at you from beneath the rim of hat slowly lowering over his eyes.%SPEECH_ON%So be it.%SPEECH_OFF%
49bc9b294ab7530bb6b3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]如今连身强体壮的人都不安全，更别说一个大概脑子也不大灵光的老头。你走过去招呼，他猛地转头，双眼暴睁，瞳孔膨胀得像没有星光的深渊。他伸指对准你。%SPEECH_ON%你的血。给我。%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人缓缓站起，斗篷滑落，露出几乎赤裸的骨架，仅蒙着一层薄薄皮肉。他蹒跚着走来，嘴张着，却没有发音的动作，声音仿佛来自另一个世界。%SPEECH_ON%我的清算，你的鲜血。我的清算，你的鲜血。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%握着武器跃上前。%SPEECH_ON%他是巫师！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们纷纷备战，亡灵法师向后仰去，斗篷从地上浮起，重新披到他身上，仿佛连风都听其使唤。突然，尸体从地下钻出，低吼哀鸣。帽檐缓缓垂到眼前，他从下面盯着你。%SPEECH_ON%那就这样吧。%SPEECH_OFF%

327492d06645742230da.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]Suddenly, a crossbow aims over your shoulder and fires so closely you can feel the air rushing past the twang of its rope. The bolt pierces the old man's skull and he tips forward, head to the mud, arse in the air, hands still beside himself in dispirited supination.

You turn to see %witchhunter% the witch hunter standing behind you. He lowers the crossbow and walks over to the corpse, grabbing it by the nape of the neck and putting a stake through its back. The body wretches with a shriek and the clothing bloats as the body implodes, a swirling dust hurriedly exiting out the cloak as though it had been caught impersonating a man.

 The witch hunter turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Necrosavant. Rare. Extremely dangerous.%SPEECH_OFF%
327492d06645742230da.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]突然，一把弩从你肩头探出，近得弦声响起时，你几乎能感觉空气擦过。弩箭穿透老人的颅骨，他向前栽倒，头扎进泥里，屁股翘着，双手仍摊在身旁，无力地掌心朝上。

你转头，发现猎巫人%witchhunter%站在身后。他放下弩，走向尸体，揪住后颈，将一根木桩刺入背部。身体扭动着尖叫，衣服鼓起，里面的躯壳却向内塌缩。一团旋转的尘埃急匆匆从斗篷中涌出，像是冒充人类被当场揭穿了。

猎巫人转向你。%SPEECH_ON%死灵剑士。罕见，而且极其危险。%SPEECH_OFF%

2a693d795bf21cad6a94.source: Killed a Necrosavant on the road
2a693d795bf21cad6a94.translation: 在路上杀死一名死灵剑士

f2608bfead333ddbc168.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You take a nap.

 Blackness. Darkness. All what a dream should be, save for one small fact: you know you're in it. Standing in the void like a lost thought. A voice breaks over you, dripping down from all sides as though you were in the very mouth that produced it.%SPEECH_ON%Why did you forsake us, Emperor?%SPEECH_OFF%You spin about, or at least think you do, for there is nothing around with which to base even the faintest of movements.%SPEECH_ON%You promised me, don't you remember? You said it would be okay if it all fell apart. You said you had a plan, that you had made a deal with that ugly, ugly man. What happened?%SPEECH_OFF%
f2608bfead333ddbc168.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你小睡了一会儿。

漆黑。幽暗。梦本该如此，唯有一件小事不对：你知道自己正在梦里。你站在虚无中，像一个迷失的念头。声音忽然笼罩下来，从四面八方滴落，仿佛你就在发出它的那张嘴里。%SPEECH_ON%皇帝，你为什么抛弃我们？%SPEECH_OFF%你转过身，至少以为自己转了身，毕竟四周空无一物，连最细微的移动都无从确认。%SPEECH_ON%你答应过我，不记得了吗？你说，即便一切崩塌，也没关系。你说你有计划，和那个丑陋、丑陋的男人做了交易。到底怎么了？%SPEECH_OFF%

cbc8d05b65614727b498.source: I was not the chosen one.

4307511234f043cf17f6.source: Rest easy, my love. There is nothing to fear in death.
4307511234f043cf17f6.translation: 安心长眠吧，我的爱人。死亡已无须畏惧。

36ef6627f3f20a815d4a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You raise your voice.%SPEECH_ON%I am not the chosen one.%SPEECH_OFF%Before the admission even clear the air, she begins sobbing. Her words burst through the weeps like hiccupped honesty.%SPEECH_ON%I-I know... I did not wish to admit it, but I know. The Empire dies with us. Sy'leth daef'nya, my Emperor.%SPEECH_OFF%'Emperor' echoes, fainter by the repeat, until you are left with darkness and silence.
36ef6627f3f20a815d4a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你提高声音。%SPEECH_ON%我不是天选之人。%SPEECH_OFF%话音未落，她便抽泣起来，真心话夹在哽咽中断断续续地涌出。%SPEECH_ON%我……我知道。我不愿承认，可我知道。帝国将与我们一同消亡。希勒斯·戴夫尼亚，我的皇帝。%SPEECH_OFF%“皇帝”二字不断回荡，一声比一声微弱，直到四周只剩黑暗与寂静。

719edfe5ffc4c46c690d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]At first, you say nothing. She begins to cry. You hear the tears, each drop reverberating all around you.%SPEECH_ON%Are you there, my Emperor?%SPEECH_OFF%You clear your throat and answer.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, I am. The Empire will not rise again. We must go. There is nothing to fear in Death.%SPEECH_OFF%The woman weeps, but slowly steadies herself.%SPEECH_ON%I am not afraid. On the other side, ish'nyarh ishe'yarn, my Emperor.%SPEECH_OFF%As her words fade from the black, and perhaps your mind, all you are left with is silence.
719edfe5ffc4c46c690d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]起初，你一言不发。她哭了起来。你听见泪水滴落，每一滴都在四周回响。%SPEECH_ON%您还在吗，我的皇帝？%SPEECH_OFF%你清了清嗓子，答道：%SPEECH_ON%我在。帝国不会再崛起了。我们该走了。死亡并不可怕。%SPEECH_OFF%女人仍在啜泣，却渐渐平静下来。%SPEECH_ON%我不害怕。在彼岸，伊什尼亚尔，伊什雅恩，我的皇帝。%SPEECH_OFF%她的话音从黑暗中淡去，或许也从你的脑海中淡去，最后只剩寂静。

4392a6741c2736967668.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You turn about.%SPEECH_ON%Who is the ugly man?%SPEECH_OFF%The woman's voice stutters in shock.%SPEECH_ON%You, you don't remember?%SPEECH_OFF%Clearing your throat, you feign the honesty of lost memories.%SPEECH_ON%I remember nothing, my love.%SPEECH_OFF%A great sigh falls over the darkness. You can feel its frustration. She talks with exasperation.%SPEECH_ON%I knew we should not have trusted him... The ugly man came to us in the night when our child was born still. He said if he could take our blood, as well as that of our dead child, he would ensure that the Empire would never die, us its eternal rulers. But... it had a cost.%SPEECH_OFF%You quickly figure it out and respond.%SPEECH_ON%He made you barren.%SPEECH_OFF%The woman sobs.%SPEECH_ON%We should have never trusted him! I will have that ugly man! Have no doubt, kearem su'llah. I will treat him to eternity, an eternity of pain and suffering!%SPEECH_OFF%The once black void glows red, flashing a world of crimson, ferocity in color. You throw a hand up, shielding your eyes. She screams, piercing your ears until all you hear is a harsh ringing.
4392a6741c2736967668.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你转过身。%SPEECH_ON%那个丑陋的男人是谁？%SPEECH_OFF%女人惊得声音发颤。%SPEECH_ON%你，你不记得了？%SPEECH_OFF%你清了清嗓子，装出失忆之人的真诚。%SPEECH_ON%什么都不记得了，我的爱人。%SPEECH_OFF%一声长叹笼罩黑暗，你能感觉到其中的沮丧。她懊恼地说道：%SPEECH_ON%我就知道，不该相信他……我们的孩子生下来就没了气，那天夜里，丑陋的男人来到我们面前。他说，只要让他取走我们的血，以及死去孩子的血，就能让帝国永不灭亡，让我们永远统治。可……那是有代价的。%SPEECH_OFF%你立刻明白，答道：%SPEECH_ON%他让你再也无法生育。%SPEECH_OFF%女人哭了。%SPEECH_ON%我们根本不该相信他！我一定要抓住那个丑陋的男人！别怀疑，凯亚雷姆·苏拉。我会赐他永恒，永恒的痛苦与折磨！%SPEECH_OFF%原本漆黑的虚空泛起红光，映出一片猩红世界，仿佛颜色本身就充满暴怒。你举手遮眼。她尖叫起来，刺穿双耳，直到你只能听见尖锐的嗡鸣。

2fb08780d6f653b395f8.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You wake. A rough wind bends the tent, curling the leather and rolling tides across the ceiling. Faint candlelight flicks and dashes darkness and light all the same. %dude% is standing there, watching you, shadows crossing back and forth across his chest. He shifts on his feet, an uneasy look on his face.%SPEECH_ON%Who were you talking to?%SPEECH_OFF%Rolling out of bed, you put your boots to the ground, wanting to be sure of this reality before you dare parlay with it. Dirt rustles and crunches beneath your feet. You answer.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not sure. I think... I think the invasion is over.%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenary nods and turns a hand to the tent's entrance.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, that's why I'm here. A noble messenger arrived just a minute ago. He says the undead have ceased erupting from the ground. The scribes believe it is over. Are you alright, sir?%SPEECH_OFF%You rub your head. Is it time to retire? What can you make of this world now that you know what you do? It is either go live out the rest of your days in peace, or say damn it all and command the %companyname% to further glory.

%OOC%You've won! Battle Brothers is designed for replayability and for campaigns to be played until you've beaten one or two late game crises. Starting a new campaign will allow you to try out different things in a different world.

You can also choose to continue your campaign for as long as you want. Just be aware that campaigns are not intended to last forever and you're likely to run out of challenges eventually.%OOC_OFF%
2fb08780d6f653b395f8.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你醒了。狂风扯动帐篷，皮革翻卷，帐顶如波浪起伏。微弱烛火闪烁，光与暗一同摇曳。%dude%站在那里看着你，阴影来回掠过他的胸前。他不安地挪了挪脚。%SPEECH_ON%你在跟谁说话？%SPEECH_OFF%你翻身下床，双靴落地，想先确认这现实是真的，才敢与它交谈。泥土在脚下沙沙作响。你回答：%SPEECH_ON%不清楚。我想……我想，入侵结束了。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵点头，抬手指向帐门。%SPEECH_ON%是，所以我才来。一分钟前到了个贵族信使，说亡灵不再从地下涌出。书记员们认为，一切结束了。团长，你还好吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你揉着脑袋。该退休了吗？知道了这些，你还能怎样看待这个世界？要么安安稳稳过完余生，要么让一切见鬼去，带领%companyname%争取更大的荣耀。

%OOC%你赢了！《战场兄弟》注重重复游玩的乐趣，通常建议在一场战役中战胜一至两次后期危机后，开启新战役，在不同的世界尝试新的玩法。

你也可以继续当前战役，想玩多久都可以。不过，游戏并非按无限期游玩设计，最终可能会缺少新的挑战。%OOC_OFF%

7a8d5c00831fde3bd3e3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]You come across a group of peasants sitting by the edge of the path. Men, women, children. Dirtied clothes, muddied boots, sores on their skin. A few carry wounds shaped like bitemarks. The eldest of the party speaks.%SPEECH_ON%Please, sir, do you have any food or water to give us?%SPEECH_OFF%He seems to see you eyeing the pustules and bitemarks. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, don't mind those. Simple fox huntin' gone awry. We could just use a bit of help and then we can be on our way.%SPEECH_OFF%
7a8d5c00831fde3bd3e3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]路边坐着一群农民，有男人、女人，也有孩子。衣衫污秽，靴子沾满烂泥，皮肤上生着疮，有几人的伤口看起来像是咬痕。队伍中最年长的老人开口了。%SPEECH_ON%行行好，大人，能给我们些吃的喝的吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他似乎注意到你正盯着脓疮和咬痕，连忙摇头。%SPEECH_ON%哦，别在意。只是猎狐狸时出了点岔子。帮我们一把，我们就能继续赶路了。%SPEECH_OFF%

646b23214cbb2cb8b7d9.source: We can spare a bit of food.

4c68991d2ca1c3495cb3.source: You'll only make the undead ranks swell. Better we finish you now.
4c68991d2ca1c3495cb3.translation: 你们只会给亡灵添兵，不如现在就送你们上路。

99a8f41569920eaeb3ab.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]You command these sickened souls to be well - by commanding your men to kill them all. The elder leads the women and children away while the men rise up to stand their ground. One, wavering on green and peeling legs, points at you.%SPEECH_ON%What a saint you are ya prick. I hope I do come back from the dead. I hope my corpse kills the lot of you ya farkin' savages.%SPEECH_OFF%
99a8f41569920eaeb3ab.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]你决定让这些病人彻底解脱——命令手下把他们全杀了。老人带着妇孺撤离，男人们则起身挡在前面。其中一人双腿发青、皮肉剥落，摇晃着指向你。%SPEECH_ON%你可真是个大善人啊，混蛋。但愿我死后真能爬起来，但愿我的尸体能把你们这些该死的畜生全杀光。%SPEECH_OFF%

bb2ded3c056f01ebc778.source: I look forward to killing you twice, then.

e980502ac1e4d871e140.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]You tell %randombrother% to hand out some food and supplies. The elder thanks you and says he'll speak highly of the %companyname% wherever he goes. A few of the men seem relieved that you didn't ask something awful of them.
e980502ac1e4d871e140.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]你让%randombrother%分发些食物和物资。老人连声道谢，说今后无论走到哪里，都要称颂%companyname%。你没有下达什么可怕的命令，几个弟兄似乎为此松了口气。

dd7b045db53ad12fd8b3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]You tell %randombrother% to hand out some food and supplies. The elder thanks you and says he'll speak highly of the %companyname% wherever he goes. Taking a piece of bread, you squat beside a sickly child and the father holding him. But when you hold the loaf out, the child turns its head up and bites into his father's neck. Any peasant healthy enough to stand does so and runs off. The rest... well, the rest shamble to their feet, faces pale, jaws slacked, eyes glowing red with furious hunger. You quickly order the mercenaries into formation.
dd7b045db53ad12fd8b3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]你让%randombrother%分发些食物和物资。老人连声道谢，说今后无论走到哪里，都要称颂%companyname%。你拿着一块面包，在一名抱着病弱孩子的父亲身边蹲下。可你刚递出面包，孩子就仰起头，一口咬住父亲的脖子。还有力气站起来的农民全都拔腿逃跑。剩下的人……剩下的人摇摇晃晃地站起来，面色惨白，下颚松垂，眼中因狂暴的饥饿泛起红光。你立刻命令佣兵列阵。

50e1f9fffa87497b6364.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_99.png[/img]{You come across a donkey standing beside a cart full of burnt corpses. A man stands beside it looking, understandably, worse for the wear. He looks at you and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Hope yer not heading to %city%.%SPEECH_OFF%Not one to tell strangers where you're heading, you simply ask him why. He shakes his head a second time.%SPEECH_ON%Walking dead got it. Disease spread through the town and those who were dying kept rising up again. Wasn't long until the whole place fell to those undying souls. Word has it that the city is now governed by necromancers, but who really knows. I sure as hell ain't gonna get close to find out.%SPEECH_OFF% | There's a pale greybeard squatting in the middle of the path. He hears you coming, but doesn't turn to look. Instead he simply speaks.%SPEECH_ON%Saw you in the vision. All of you. Sellswords on the path to righting the ills of this world, though ye might not know this purpose any better than a royal infant understands its kingly place. But you're too late.%SPEECH_OFF%His head snaps around. White eyes stare out from beneath bushy eyebrows. He's missing a nose and his lips sneer with sickly yellow creases.%SPEECH_ON%%city% is lost! The dead wander the streets, leashed by the ones you call necromancers.%SPEECH_OFF%Carefully, you tread forward and ask how he knows any of this. The pale man holds up a round bauble that ripples as though a god were holding the shape of a pond in his palm. Images twist in its reflections, coming and going, events with no start or end. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Who better to know the fate of the city than the man who orchestrated its demise?%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly, the stranger's flesh shatters, revealing nothing but air beneath, and the blackened shards of his new form spread out into a cloud of bats. You draw out your sword, but the creatures wheel away, shrieking and chirping as they soar toward the horizon. | Two men are found off the side of the path. One is standing before an easel, in one hand a brush, in the other a palette of mixed colors. The other man is posing, hands to his head, holding an expression of absolute horror. The painter glances at you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellswords. I suppose you're heading toward city, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask why he would say that. He nervously puts the brush down. You see his painting is of a darkened city with blue miasma rising out from behind its walls, a pale moon hovering oppressively overhead. A half-painted figure stands in the foreground, mirroring the look of the painter's model. Without moving an inch, the poser answers your question.%SPEECH_ON%%city%'s been destroyed. Well, not destroyed, but overrun with those walking corpses. Word has it that pale men hold governance over it.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if they know this for sure. The painter waves an arm to present his work.%SPEECH_ON%Had I not seen it with my own eyes, would this not be the work of a madman? Now, please, I must get back to work before the macabre memory fades.%SPEECH_OFF%}
50e1f9fffa87497b6364.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_99.png[/img]{一头驴站在装满焦尸的货车旁，一个男人守着车，满脸憔悴，倒也不难理解。他看看你，摇头道：%SPEECH_ON%但愿你不是往%city%去。%SPEECH_OFF%你向来不对陌生人交代去处，只问为什么。他又摇头。%SPEECH_ON%行尸把那里占了。疫病传遍城镇，死去的人不断爬起来。没多久，整个地方都落进了那些不死之物手里。听说如今由亡灵法师统治，可谁知道真假。反正我他妈的绝不会凑过去查。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个脸色苍白、胡须花白的人蹲在路中央。他听见你来，却没回头，只是开口说道：%SPEECH_ON%我在幻象里见过你们。所有人。走在扫除世间祸患之路上的佣兵，尽管你们未必懂得自己的使命，就像王室婴孩不懂天生的王位。可你们来晚了。%SPEECH_OFF%他猛地转头，浓眉下，一双白眼直瞪着你。鼻子没了，嘴唇勾出病态发黄的皱褶，像在冷笑。%SPEECH_ON%%city%沦陷了！死人游荡街头，由你们所谓的亡灵法师牵着走。%SPEECH_OFF%你谨慎上前，问他怎么知道。苍白的男人举起一颗圆珠，里面波纹荡漾，仿佛神把整片池水托在掌心。影像在反光中扭曲，来去不定，尽是不知始终的片段。他笑道：%SPEECH_ON%要说这座城的命运，谁能比亲手安排它覆灭的人更清楚？%SPEECH_OFF%突然，陌生人的皮肉碎裂，里面竟空无一物。焦黑的碎片散开，化为一团蝙蝠。你拔出剑，可那些东西已盘旋飞走，尖叫吱鸣着掠向天际。 | 路旁有两个人。一人站在画架前，一手执笔，一手托着混有各种颜料的调色板；另一人抱着脑袋，摆出惊恐至极的表情。画家瞥向你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵。想必是往城里去吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你问为何这么说。他紧张地放下画笔。画上是一座暗沉的城市，城墙后升起蓝色瘴气，苍白的月亮压在上空。前景人物只画了一半，神情与模特如出一辙。摆姿势的人纹丝不动，回答了你。%SPEECH_ON%%city%毁了。嗯，也不算毁了，是被那些会走路的尸体占了。听说掌权的是一群苍白的人。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他们是否确定。画家抬手展示自己的作品。%SPEECH_ON%若非亲眼所见，画出这种东西，岂不只有疯子？现在请容我继续，趁那些阴森的记忆还没淡去。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a5902a53426c5e0fd280.source:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]While stopping for a brief respite, a stranger approaches the camp. He's got a wooden stake for a leg, though he wobbles on it with practiced efficiency. Hobbling to you, he tips a cap of broomstraw.%SPEECH_ON%I suppose you fellas are here for the happenings?%SPEECH_OFF%You glance at %randombrother% then back to the man. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, mayhaps ye don't know. I don't really know, either, but there be a lot of grisly stories about what is happening all around these parts. The way I hear it, the dead are walking the earth, but that's hogwash. I think it's just a bunch of brigands with new tricks up their sleeves. Anyway, be seeing you. Stay safe and all that malarkey.%SPEECH_OFF%The man laughs as he stilts away. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]A child is found beside the path with a skull laid between their legs. Its upside down with insects battling one another in the bowl of the brainpan. The kid briefly looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Hi there.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask where his parents are. He picks up a dead bug from the skull, looks at it, then tosses it over his shoulder. He puts another wriggling gladiator into the grey arena then stares at you.%SPEECH_ON%Parents? Why they ain't been around for awhile. Father went to his parents, and mother to hers. And they both was ate'n.%SPEECH_OFF%You raise an eyebrow and ask for him to repeat what he just said, but the kid ignores you, absentmindedly cheering into the hollow head as his bugs do battle. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]You come to a man standing in the path. He's got a shovel yoked over both shoulders, his hands crucifixed across each side, and he's dripping with mud. He glances up, this golem of earth, and asks where you're going. Before you answer, he interrupts.%SPEECH_ON%Don't go that way. Don't go no way. They're everywhere. I was digging, you see? Digging to get to them first. But they know. They where we are. Don't go nowhere, because they're everywhere. Don't go nowhere, because they're everywhere, and they know... they know, don't you see?%SPEECH_OFF%He presses his head forward, his cringing face crooning forth from his dripping arms like some muddied bat come to feast on your dreams. You ease past the man. %randombrother% looks him up and down, shrugs, and follows you. The %companyname% has no time for such madmen. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]While on the road, you come to a small, empty hut. %randombrother% snoops around inside, you beside him, the both of you with blades out. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Ain't shit here.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks up and points.%SPEECH_ON%Except there.%SPEECH_OFF%You look up and see that the ceiling is covered in blood. Not just covered... written over. Unfortunately, the script is hard to read as the crimson words are muddied by mold and termitic erasure.

 You mouth the visible letters: DO---GO---IDE---WE---LL---R---OOMED.

 Clearly the work of a madman. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]There's a copse in the path, a little set of trees that stand tall in an otherwise flat clearing. You take some respite there, for little trees such as these borrow the silence and sereneness from their larger forest cousins. Except not this one. This one you find a dead child in the bushes.

 %randombrother% comes up and covers his mouth.%SPEECH_ON%By the might of the old gods, who would do such a thing?%SPEECH_OFF%You take a knee. There are tracks all over the area. It appears the kid was chased and ended up running into the bushes. Probably got tied up there, stuck. More footsteps followed. Way more. They stayed for a while, then left with bloody footprints. The kid, what is left of him, is covered in bite marks. You turn to the mercenary and answer.%SPEECH_ON%I think it's a matter of what, not who. But they're gone. Somewhere yonder, a few days ahead I'd wager, but...%SPEECH_OFF%You count the footsteps, but they prove too many.%SPEECH_ON%I think whatever did this... we'll be seeing it soon.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]You come to a man standing with a white banner, an unthreaded sigil in the middle, its frayed remains billowing in the wind. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Good to see some flesh.%SPEECH_OFF%Well, that was not what you were expecting as his first words. Naturally, you inquire as to what he means. He looks incredulous.%SPEECH_ON%You know, flesh. As opposed to bones. I've seen too many of those lately so, yeah, it's nice seeing some flesh.%SPEECH_OFF%You inquire further, asking what kind of bones this man has been seeing. He slims his eyes as if guarding them against the winds of a past he'd prefer to forget.%SPEECH_ON%The walkin' kind. Bones that'll walk through your door in the middle of the night. Bones that kill everything in front of them. Bones that want to see more bones just like them. Them sort of bones, got it?%SPEECH_OFF%His face lightens up, the eyes widening. He pivots toward you and suddenly leans forward.%SPEECH_ON%You wouldn't happen to be made of bones, would you?%SPEECH_OFF%Sensing a threat in the words, %randombrother% jumps in, positioning to kill the man before he can act. You settle everyone down. The stranger appears at ease, but you order the %companyname% to walk around him with care. He doesn't move. He simply stands as the last tendrils of his banner unravel into the wind. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]There's a man in the path. He's on his hands and knees with scrolls littered all around. He bounds from one to the other like a dog would a scattering of treats. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%No no no, no! Where is it? Ah! Stranger! I mean, uh, sellsword, er, friend! Friend?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what the man is doing. His hands are shaking as he answers.%SPEECH_ON%I, uh, have a theory. About who we are, er, were. In the past. Way before today, understand? Of course you do.%SPEECH_OFF%You watch as the man gathers his notes, stuffing them into a satchel. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%I think our past is coming to haunt us again, my dear sir sellsword friend, and when they come, they will kill us all. Because they want it back. They want it ALL back.%SPEECH_OFF%The man throws the satchel over his shoulder and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Now I have others to inform. Thanks for listening and, uh, farewell.%SPEECH_OFF%Well... bye. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]While marching, something crunches awkwardly underfoot. You stop and take a knee to see. Swiping away some dirt, you find splintered shards of pottery. They appear to be, or used to be, part of a piece of art. You piece them together until a picture comes into view. %randombrother% stands behind you and asks.%SPEECH_ON%So, what is that?%SPEECH_OFF%You trace a finger along the artwork. Depicted are armored soldiers with spears and behind them more men stand with polearms, their formation as thick as the forests from which they made their weapons. They appear to be marching forward one step at a time, cutting down all the enemies in their path with brutal efficiency.

 You try and pick the shards up. A low hum emits from the clay and each piece suddenly turns to powder, the remains streaming between your fingers. Something that old... that peculiar... what is it doing out here in the middle of nowhere? | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]An odd figure shuffles across the path. You draw your sword and follow, eventually creeping behind a small girl holding an infant. The child wheels around to look at you, the bundled babe in her arms comfortably asleep. You ask what they are doing way out here. The girl shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Running from the bads.%SPEECH_OFF%You cautiously glance around before asking what she means. She responds as if the answer to the question is tiresomely obvious.%SPEECH_ON%The bads. We buried them good, but they came up bad. Now they're killing everyone. So I run. I run from the bads.%SPEECH_OFF%She peers down at the infant and then out toward the land.%SPEECH_ON%Excuse me, sir. My grandfather lives yonder. He is expecting me and me alone.%SPEECH_OFF%You grab her shoulder and ask where her parents are. She shrugs off your hand.%SPEECH_ON%They're with the bads. Now excuse me, I must get going.%SPEECH_OFF%Clutching the baby, the girl quickly ducks into some brush. Such a little thing, she hardly makes a noise thereafter, and you've little doubt that her safe silence will see her to her destination. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]You come to an old woman in the road. She waves you down with one hand while the other clutches her neck. As you get closer, you see that her white hairs are waning, leaving a dome of her skull revealed, and her garish nose wheeze with every breath. Age has been most unkind in all resorts. Her words are expectedly labored.%SPEECH_ON%Have you seen an old man on the roads?%SPEECH_OFF%Shaking your head, you ask what happened to her. She reveals her neck from which there are two holes. A bit of pus flows from each until she covers back up.%SPEECH_ON%My husband and I were attacked last night. I don't know where he is. I think they took him. They tried to take me, but the man attacking me must've smelled something foul because he got but a small taste before running off. Maybe it was my cooking. I always add too much garlic. My husband, he skipped dinner that night, that grouchy fool.%SPEECH_OFF%You put up a hand, slowing her down. You tell her to carefully explain who or what actually attacked. She nods and responds.%SPEECH_ON%Right, it was...%SPEECH_OFF%She pauses and her eyes seem to change attention, as if she blinked without closing a single eyelid. She glances back at you and smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Hello, have you seen an old man on the roads? He's my husband. We were attacked last night and I think they took him...%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]You come to a tiny little town by the side of the path. An insular place where no doubt everyone knows everyone. Outside one of the hovels, there's the charred remains of a bonfire. The sickly black shape of a person is in the ruins. One of the townspeople comes over, tipping their strawhat up while tenting their hands on a pitchfork. He speaks rather cheerily.%SPEECH_ON%That right there is taking care of a problem once and for all.%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask what happened. The man answers earnestly, as if happy to relive the moments.%SPEECH_ON%Well, that there deadened thing you see used to be %randomname%. The man lived yonder from here, in the backend parts of this backend town. He used to do readings, like you know, from bones and blood or some sorry sortition. Fool kept going on and on about how the dead were going to come back and kill us all. We don't take kindly to shamanistic reckonings so we gave him the straight-and-narrow side of what is right and lawful.%SPEECH_OFF%The man spits and nods.%SPEECH_ON%And that was that.%SPEECH_OFF%Almost as if on cue, the bonfire crumbles and the boneshards scatter. A plume of ash and smoke are all that remain. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]You come across a graveyard off to the side of the path. The place is a mess. The plots are uncovered and the gravestones overturned and scattered. It is as if a horde of graverobbers descended upon the place and picked it clean. Except... they took the bodies too? %randombrother% stands at your side and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Cannibals?%SPEECH_OFF%This was not the work of cannibals, but you nod for that answer is more calming then what might be the truth: whatever was buried here got up and left on their own two feet... | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]While marching, you come across an abandoned camp. %randombrother% walks through it and kick over a pan slick with oil. Rotten bacon and eggs spill into the grass. He turns his attention to some bags but comes up empty.

 The ground reveals fresh footprints. A clutter of them circle around what was the fire, but there is no dance in their evidence, instead it seems they were frantically rushing to and fro. Marching toward them is a horde of prints, shuffling and dragging their feet with no order. And then, as these two storied prints meet, only the latter continues forward.

 %randombrother% pulls back a bush to reveal a dead body. There's a shovel firmly slotted into its skull. The skin of it makes you think the person had been dead for at least two or three weeks - so the footprints are far too fresh for this body to have created them. You've no idea what happened here, but it could not have been good. Going forward, the men of %companyname% should stay sharp for some evil walks these lands.}
a5902a53426c5e0fd280.translation:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]短暂休息时，一个陌生人来到营地。他以木桩代腿，却早已走得熟练，摇摇晃晃也不耽搁。踱到你面前，他抬了抬草帽。%SPEECH_ON%想必诸位是为那些怪事来的？%SPEECH_OFF%你看看%randombrother%，再看向来人。他耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%啊，或许还不知道。其实我也不明白，就是这一带到处都在传骇人的故事。听说死人正在地上走，可那纯属胡扯。我看只是土匪又想出了新花招。总之，回见。多加小心，诸如此类的废话。%SPEECH_OFF%那人笑着，踩着木腿走了。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]路旁一个孩子坐着，双腿间放了一颗倒扣的头骨。头颅的碗状空腔里，虫子正在互相争斗。他短暂抬头。%SPEECH_ON%你好呀。%SPEECH_OFF%你问父母在哪里。他从头骨里捡出死虫，看了看，越过肩头扔掉，又放进一个蠕动的角斗士，送回那座灰白的竞技场，再望向你。%SPEECH_ON%爹娘？他们有阵子没在了。爹去找他的爹娘，娘去找她的爹娘。然后，都让吃了。%SPEECH_OFF%你扬眉，让他再说一遍。孩子却不再理会，只心不在焉地对着空脑壳喝彩，看虫子厮杀。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]路中央站着一个人，铁铲横架双肩，双手搭在两端，如被钉在那里。浑身泥水滴落，这泥土魔像般的人抬头，问你要去哪儿。你还没回答，他便抢着说：%SPEECH_ON%别往那儿走。哪儿都别走。他们到处都是。我在挖，你明白吗？挖，抢先找到他们。可他们知道。我们在哪儿，他们就在哪儿。哪儿都别去，他们到处都是。哪儿都别去，他们到处都是，而且知道……他们知道，你还不懂吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他将脑袋探向前，畏缩的脸从滴泥的双臂间凑来，喃喃低语，像只裹泥的蝙蝠，要来吞噬你的梦。你小心绕过。%randombrother%上下打量他，耸肩跟上。%companyname%没工夫理会这种疯子。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]路上，你来到一间空荡小屋。%randombrother%进屋搜查，你跟在旁边，两人都拔着刀。他摇头。%SPEECH_ON%屁也没有。%SPEECH_OFF%他抬头一指。%SPEECH_ON%除了那儿。%SPEECH_OFF%你望上去，天花板上满是血。不只是血……是用血写的字。可惜字迹难辨，霉斑和白蚁啃蚀，糊掉了大半猩红的笔画。

你默念着尚可辨认的残字：别---去---面---我---全---要---完了。

显然是疯子所为。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]路旁一片小树林，在四周平坦的空地上显得格外挺拔。你到那里歇脚，小树林往往也能借来大森林的静谧与安宁。可这片没有。你在灌木中发现一个死去的孩子。

%randombrother%走过来，捂住嘴。%SPEECH_ON%旧神在上，谁会干这种事？%SPEECH_OFF%你单膝跪下。附近到处是脚印。看来孩子曾遭追赶，最后跑进灌木，多半被枝条绊住，困在里面。更多脚步追了过来，多得多。他们停留了一阵，再带着血脚印离开。孩子残破的遗体上满是咬痕。你转向佣兵，答道：%SPEECH_ON%我想，该问的不是谁，而是什么。可它们已经走了，往那边去，算来大概领先了几天。不过……%SPEECH_OFF%你数了数脚印，实在太多。%SPEECH_ON%不管是什么干的……我想，我们很快就会遇见。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]一个男人举着白旗站在路上，旗中央的纹章已被拆掉，只剩破线随风飘动。他点头道：%SPEECH_ON%看见些肉，真好。%SPEECH_OFF%这可不是你预想的开场白。你自然要问，他是什么意思。那人一脸不可思议。%SPEECH_ON%就是肉啊，不是骨头。最近骨头见太多了，所以，对，能看见肉挺好。%SPEECH_OFF%你继续追问，究竟见过什么样的骨头。他眯起眼，仿佛挡住某段不愿回首的往事吹来的风。%SPEECH_ON%会走的那种。半夜能走进你家门的骨头。见什么杀什么的骨头。想把别人也变成一样骨头的骨头。就是那种，懂吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他的脸忽然亮起来，双眼睁大，转向你，猛地探身。%SPEECH_ON%你该不会也是骨头做的吧？%SPEECH_OFF%听出话里威胁，%randombrother%立刻上前，摆好架势，准备在对方动手前杀了他。你安抚众人。陌生人似乎平静了，可你仍命令%companyname%小心绕过。他一动不动，只站在那里，任旗上最后几缕线头散进风中。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]路上有个人四肢着地，卷轴撒了一圈。他在卷轴间来回扑蹿，像狗追着四散的食物，边找边摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不不不，不！在哪儿？啊！陌生人！我是说，呃，佣兵，嗯，朋友！朋友？%SPEECH_OFF%你问他在做什么。他双手发抖，答道：%SPEECH_ON%我，呃，有个想法。关于我们是谁，呃，曾经是谁。从前，很久很久以前，懂吗？你当然懂。%SPEECH_OFF%你看着他收起笔记，塞进挎包。他继续说道：%SPEECH_ON%我认为，过去又要回来纠缠我们了，我亲爱的佣兵大人朋友。等他们来，就会杀光所有人。因为他们要把东西拿回去。所有东西，全都拿回去。%SPEECH_OFF%他把挎包甩到肩上，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%我还得去通知别人。谢谢你肯听，呃，告辞。%SPEECH_OFF%好吧……再见。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]行军途中，脚下突然传来古怪的碎裂声。你停下，跪地查看，拨开泥土，露出破碎的陶片。看起来，它们属于，或者曾属于某件艺术品。你将碎片拼拢，图案渐渐显现。%randombrother%站在身后问：%SPEECH_ON%这画的是什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你用指尖沿图案划过。画中是持矛的披甲士兵，身后还有更多举着长柄兵器的人，阵列密得如同制造武器木料的森林。他们似乎正一步步向前，残酷而高效地砍倒沿途的一切敌人。

你试着捡起陶片。陶土发出低沉嗡鸣，碎片突然全化成粉末，从指缝间流走。如此古老……如此诡异的东西……怎么会出现在这荒无人烟的地方？ | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]一个古怪的身影蹒跚穿过道路。你拔剑跟上，最终悄悄来到一个抱着婴儿的小女孩身后。她回头看你，怀中襁褓里的婴儿睡得安稳。你问他们跑这么远来做什么。女孩耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%躲坏东西。%SPEECH_OFF%你警惕地看看四周，再问是什么意思。她回答得仿佛这问题明摆着，令人厌烦。%SPEECH_ON%坏东西。我们好好埋了他们，可他们坏坏地爬出来，现在到处杀人。所以我跑，我躲着坏东西跑。%SPEECH_OFF%她低头看看婴儿，又望向远处。%SPEECH_ON%大人，借过。我爷爷住那边，他只等着我，就我一个。%SPEECH_OFF%你抓住她肩膀，问父母在哪里。她甩开你的手。%SPEECH_ON%他们跟坏东西在一起。请让开，我得走了。%SPEECH_OFF%女孩抱紧婴儿，迅速钻进灌木。她个头小，随后几乎没发出一点声响。你相信，这份保护她的寂静，能送她平安抵达。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]路上一个老妇人一手挥着招呼你，一手捂着脖子。走近后，你看见她白发稀疏，露出秃秃的头顶，难看的鼻子随每次呼吸发出喘鸣。岁月没有哪一处善待过她。开口说话，也果然吃力。%SPEECH_ON%你在路上见过一个老头吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头，问她出了什么事。她松手露出脖子，上面有两个洞，各流出一点脓水，随即又被捂住。%SPEECH_ON%昨晚我和丈夫遭了袭击。不知道他在哪儿，我想他们把他抓走了。他们也想带走我，可咬我的那个，似乎闻着了什么怪味，只尝了一小口就跑了。也许是我做的饭，我总放太多蒜。丈夫那晚没吃饭，那个爱发脾气的傻子。%SPEECH_OFF%你举手让她慢些，叫她仔细说清，究竟是谁，或者什么东西袭击了他们。她点头回答：%SPEECH_ON%对，是……%SPEECH_OFF%她停住，眼神忽然变了，仿佛没合眼皮，就眨过了一次眼。她重新看向你，微笑道：%SPEECH_ON%你好，你在路上见过一个老头吗？他是我丈夫。昨晚我们遭了袭击，我想他们把他抓走了……%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]路旁有座很小的村镇，与外界隔绝，想必家家户户彼此相识。一间破屋前，篝火烧成了焦黑残骸，里面留着一个可怕的人形。村民走过来，抬起草帽，双手搭在草叉顶端，语气颇为轻快。%SPEECH_ON%这就叫一劳永逸地解决问题。%SPEECH_OFF%你好奇地问出了什么事。他答得认真，仿佛很乐意重温当时。%SPEECH_ON%你看见的那块死东西，以前叫%randomname%。住在那边，我们这偏僻镇子最偏僻的地方。他老搞占卜，你知道，用骨头、血，或者什么破签。那蠢货没完没了，说死人要回来，把我们全杀光。我们不欢迎这种巫术预言，就让他尝尝什么叫正道，什么叫法度。%SPEECH_OFF%那人啐了一口，点头。%SPEECH_ON%事情就这样。%SPEECH_OFF%仿佛应声一般，篝火残骸塌了，骨片散开，最后只剩一缕烟灰。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]路旁有座墓地，一片狼藉。坟穴敞开，墓碑被推倒，散得到处都是，像遭大群盗墓贼洗劫一空。可……连尸体也偷走了？%randombrother%站在身旁，摇头道：%SPEECH_ON%食人者？%SPEECH_OFF%这不是食人者干的，你却仍点了头。比起可能的真相，这个答案总让人安心些：埋在这里的东西，自己站起来，用两条腿走了…… | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]行军途中，你遇见一处废弃营地。%randombrother%走进去，踢翻一口油腻的锅，腐烂的熏肉和鸡蛋洒进草里。他又翻了几个袋子，仍一无所获。

地上留着新鲜脚印。一群脚印绕着原先的火堆，却没有跳舞的痕迹，倒像是人们慌乱奔跑，来回逃窜。另一大群脚印朝他们走来，拖曳蹒跚，毫无秩序。等这两段故事在地面交汇，继续向前的便只剩后一种。

%randombrother%拨开灌木，露出一具死尸，铲子牢牢嵌在头骨里。看那皮肤，这人至少已死了两三个星期——相较之下，脚印新得实在不像它留下的。你不知道这里发生过什么，可绝不是什么好事。往后，%companyname%的弟兄得打起精神，有邪恶之物正在这片土地上行走。}

afc18be7d037467b4e4b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]You come across a man hollering for help, so hysterical that he seems to pay no mind to gaining the attention of armed sellswords who have no allegiance to any house or their laws.%SPEECH_ON%Please! Help me! There's a... a corpse! In the granary!%SPEECH_OFF%He thumbs over his shoulder to a large, wooden building. Its front door rattles almost as if on cue. The man loses his mind.%SPEECH_ON%That's it! That's the monster! Please, go in there and kill it! We can't afford to lose all the food in there!%SPEECH_OFF%
afc18be7d037467b4e4b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你遇到一个高声呼救的男人。他吓得歇斯底里，全然顾不得自己招来的是一群披甲带刀、既不效忠贵族也不在乎律法的佣兵。%SPEECH_ON%救命！帮帮我！有一具……一具尸体！在粮仓里！%SPEECH_OFF%他用拇指指向身后的一座大木屋。像是回应他的话，前门随即砰砰作响。男人彻底慌了神。%SPEECH_ON%就是它！那怪物！求你们进去杀了它！那些粮食可损失不起啊！%SPEECH_OFF%

f1dea5d60dcfb5d6bbd3.source: It's best to burn that granary down.

fa55d6c03d1790891fb3.source: One of my men will go in and handle this.
fa55d6c03d1790891fb3.translation: 我会派一个弟兄进去处理。

891eaf7393b360c21b9d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]You grab the man by the shoulders and stare at him as you talk.%SPEECH_ON%We are going to burn down the granary. What food that is in there, are you listening? Listen carefully to what I'm going to say. The food in there is diseased and should not be eaten. There is nothing to save.%SPEECH_OFF%The peasant, his body shaking as though with a cold, steps out of the way. He squishes his face behind both hands, barely able to watch as two of your sellswords step forward, torches in hand, and set the granary ablaze.

The door stops rattling for a moment, then picks back up, nearly breaking its hinges. As smoke streams out from its bottom, someone begins crying out.%SPEECH_ON%A joke! A joke! Please, let me out! Aaah, AAAHH!%SPEECH_OFF%%dude% rushes to the door and breaks it down. A little boy runs out, a body for a torch, limbs flailing arches of flame. He settles down on the ground where the mercenaries try to cover him, but it's too late. He's a smoldering ruin by the time the fire is put out. The peasant man looks absolutely horrified.%SPEECH_ON%I... I had no idea, I thought it... he kept making growling noises.%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head and tell the company to quickly get back on the road.
891eaf7393b360c21b9d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]你抓住那人的双肩，盯着他说：%SPEECH_ON%我们要烧掉粮仓。里面的粮食——在听吗？仔细听我说。里面的粮食已经染病，不能吃。没有什么值得保住的。%SPEECH_OFF%农民浑身发抖，像冷得受不了，慢慢让到一旁。他双手捂脸，几乎不敢看。两个佣兵举着火把上前，点燃了粮仓。

门的撞击声停了片刻，随即更加猛烈，几乎要震断铰链。烟从门底涌出时，里面有人哭喊：%SPEECH_ON%开玩笑的！开玩笑的！求求你，放我出去！啊，啊啊！%SPEECH_OFF%%dude%冲向门，一脚踹开。一个小男孩跑了出来，身体如同火把，挥舞的四肢甩出道道火弧。他倒在地上，佣兵们试着扑盖灭火，可已经太迟。火熄灭时，他已烧得焦黑，余烟未散。农民惊骇欲绝。%SPEECH_ON%我……我真不知道，我以为……他一直在发出低吼。%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头，命令战团赶紧回到路上。

747582432e61c2fa5f51.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]The food is no doubt lost to the diseases by now, and the entire building might be infected with evils beyond human measure. Slowly, you explain to the man that you will burn his granary down. He doesn't refuse, only hurriedly nods his head.%SPEECH_ON%I know. I didn't want to do it myself, I suppose, maybe hanging onto the idea that someone would come along and tell me what I wanted to hear, not what needed to be done.%SPEECH_OFF%A few sellswords set torches to the corners of the granary and it doesn't take long at all for the fires to crawl up its walls and roof. But a minute later the entire structure is blazing. When the front door breaks apart, a wiederganger shuffles through the gap, its entire body curling with fire and smoke. It's all but blackened bones by now, skin dripping off its skeleton in great, gooey gobs. %dude% cuts its head off with a swift blow. The peasant watches the rest of his building collapse, the glow of the fire shining the tears on his cheek.%SPEECH_ON%Well, I guess that's it then. Thank you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%He offers you a modest sum of crowns which you are more than happy to take for your 'services.'
747582432e61c2fa5f51.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]粮食想必早已染上疫病，整栋建筑也可能被人类无法揣度的邪恶侵染。你缓缓解释，打算烧掉粮仓。那人没有反对，只急忙点头。%SPEECH_ON%我知道。大概只是自己下不了手，还抱着一点念想，等个人来，说些我想听的话，而不是告诉我非做不可的事。%SPEECH_OFF%几个佣兵举火把，点燃粮仓四角。火焰很快爬上墙壁与屋顶，不过片刻，整栋建筑便烧了起来。大门崩裂时，一具行尸从缝隙中蹒跚而出，全身缠绕着火与烟。它几乎只剩焦黑骸骨，皮肤成团黏腻地从骨架上滴落。%dude%利落一击，斩掉它的脑袋。农民看着粮仓其余部分倒塌，火光映亮脸上的泪。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，看来就这样了。谢谢你，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他拿出一小笔克朗。既然是你提供‘服务’的报酬，你自然乐意收下。

03f8de83bae6bdff3297.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]You decide to solve this wiederganger problem as though it were facing you in the field. %dude% kicks the front door down and stabs the first thing he sees. The undead corpse lurches, the momentum bending its body over the blade. And then you see it: blood slowly running down the metal. As the mercenary steps back, the light reveals that the corpse is not an undead body, but a simple boy. He's gargling, eyes wide, hands shaking against his wound.%SPEECH_ON%I... I was just playing...%SPEECH_OFF%The sellsword wrenches an arm back and withdraws his weapon. The boy collapses. You turn to the peasant man. He holds his hands up.%SPEECH_ON%I had... I had no idea! He was making noises! He kept, I heard... growling! There was so much growling, I don't...%SPEECH_OFF%The man falls to his knees. You look at the boy who is beyond help, his skin going paler by the second as ropes of crimson splurge from his wounds. You shake your head and tell the men to get back on the road before anything bad comes of the scene.
03f8de83bae6bdff3297.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你决定照战场上的办法，解决这具行尸。%dude%踢开大门，一剑刺向眼前第一个身影。‘尸体’猛地一顿，身子随冲力伏到剑上。随后，你看见了：鲜血正沿金属缓缓流下。佣兵退开，光线照进去，那根本不是亡灵，只是个普通男孩。他喉中咯咯作响，双眼睁大，双手在伤口前发抖。%SPEECH_ON%我……我只是在玩……%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵猛地抽臂，拔出武器，男孩倒了下去。你转向农民，他举起双手。%SPEECH_ON%我……我真的不知道！他在弄出声音！一直在，我听见……低吼！全是低吼，我不……%SPEECH_OFF%那人跪倒。你看着男孩，已无可挽救，脸色一刻比一刻苍白，鲜血从伤口不断涌出。你摇摇头，让弟兄们赶紧上路，免得这场面再惹出什么祸事。

9e1f45424f29ecaee301.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]You send %dude% into the granary to handle it. He claps his shoulders to loosen up.%SPEECH_ON%One dead wiederganger coming right up.%SPEECH_OFF%The sellsword kicks the door in and rushes through. There's the din of fighting and a flash of light hits the metal of the mercenary's weapon as he works through the darkness and evil. A moment later, he steps back out, wiping sweat from his forehead.%SPEECH_ON%Done. Blood on some of the food, but you can just eat around that.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to the peasant and hold your hand out. He begrudgingly hands you a small purse of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you... mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%
9e1f45424f29ecaee301.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你派%dude%进粮仓处理。他拍拍肩膀，活动筋骨。%SPEECH_ON%马上给你一具死透的行尸。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵踢门冲入。打斗声随即响起，他在黑暗与邪恶中挥动武器，金属偶尔掠过一道寒光。片刻后，他走了出来，抹去额头的汗。%SPEECH_ON%办完了。有些粮食沾了血，挑开吃就行。%SPEECH_OFF%你转向农民，伸出手。他不情不愿地递来一小袋克朗。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你……佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%

6c1a02c2fda0cee21f05.source: You had a boy burned by accident
6c1a02c2fda0cee21f05.translation: 你的命令意外烧死了一个男孩

933f6f1dd79ee91739a6.source: Killed a little boy by accident
933f6f1dd79ee91739a6.translation: 失手杀死了一个小男孩

491197727fd838a4d882.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%cultist% enters your tent and a strong, brisk wind chases in after him, rearing up your scrolls and other notes. He walks forward, hands crossed before him, a rather priestly look to his approach.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, I've been spoken to and it is a grave matter which I've been given responsibility for.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask the man who the hell he's talking about. The cultist bows forward as though the words weighed his tongue down just so.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%Ah, of course, who else? You tell the man to explain what it is he needs. The man responds.%SPEECH_ON%No, not I, Davkul. Davkul is the one in need - and he needs blood, a sacrifice.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the man the company can stop at the next town and get some chickens, lambs, or whatever else he needs if it's so important. %cultist% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%The blood of some impish beast? No, he demands the blood of a warrior. A true fighting spirit and he has trusted me to find a man of such import - and that I have.%SPEECH_OFF%The cultist straightens up, the tent's candlelight suddenly fickle and uneasy.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul demands the blood of %sacrifice%.%SPEECH_OFF%
491197727fd838a4d882.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%cultist%走进你的帐篷，一股凛冽的强风紧随其后，掀起桌上的卷轴和笔记。他双手交叠在身前，缓步走近，颇有几分祭司的模样。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我聆听了神谕，并受托去办一件极其重大的事。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他，到底是谁跟他说了话。教徒低头躬身，仿佛那个名字沉重得压弯了他的舌头。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔，长官。%SPEECH_OFF%啊，当然，还能是谁？你叫他说清楚需要什么。他答道。%SPEECH_ON%不，是达夫库尔，不是我。有所求的是达夫库尔——祂要鲜血，要一场献祭。%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，如果这事如此重要，战团可以在下个镇子停一停，买几只鸡、几头羊，或者其他他需要的牲畜。%cultist%摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%低贱畜生的血？不，祂要的是战士之血。一个真正的战斗之魂。祂信任我，命我找到这样一个举足轻重的人——而我已经找到了。%SPEECH_OFF%教徒直起身，帐篷里的烛光忽然摇曳不定，令人不安。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔要%sacrifice%的血。%SPEECH_OFF%

5d632042bf917b3fdf46.source: And what if I do or don't agree to this insanity?
5d632042bf917b3fdf46.translation: 这等疯事，我答应或不答应，又会怎样？

9c549650e34c527e8a9d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Walking to a flickering candle, %cultist% holds his hand over the flame and the fire comes to a standstill, pointing upright and unmoving. You've seen icicles more animated than it. He speaks as he stares into the glow.%SPEECH_ON%If we do this, Davkul will be most happy. If not, well, we shall see. Not even I know what may happen then.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the cultist that he's asking you to kill one of your own men. He'll need to do better than that. Hearing this, he walks over and grabs you by the shoulders. The tent melts away, slipping into the folds of an immense and immutable darkness. The cultist is gone. In his place is a black cloak, its arms to your shoulders, a slate of granite for a head, its edges chipped and cracking. It appears there is something behind this mask, behind this futile effort to keep your mind safe from its true visage. A voice speaks, a guttural, booming voice that is yet narrowed into a brutish whisper only for you to hear.%SPEECH_ON%I'll give you Death, mortal, and warmed in its comforts, Death shall be visited upon your enemies. %sacrifice% will not be lost, he will be with you always, this I promise you.%SPEECH_OFF%A whiteness snaps back over you, a rush of wind, tent flaps curling outward, candleflames tilting impossibly without going out, and a frigid coolness that has your first breath seen floating across the air. %cultist% is nowhere to be seen. You quickly get up and touch your face and skin, making sure that you are all that you're supposed to be. The vision remains, though, and its pulsing imprint has left behind a grisly reality that what the cultist has suggested is something to be measured seriously.
9c549650e34c527e8a9d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%cultist%走到一支摇曳的蜡烛旁，将手悬在火焰上方。烛火顿时静止，笔直朝上，一动不动。你见过的冰凌都比它有生气。他盯着火光，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%如果我们这样做，达夫库尔会十分满意。如果不做，嗯，届时便知道了。连我也不知道会发生什么。%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉这名教徒，他要你杀的可是自己的弟兄。光凭这几句话，还说服不了你。听罢，他走来，双手抓住你的肩膀。帐篷融化了，滑入浩瀚而亘古不变的黑暗褶皱中。教徒不见了。取而代之的是一袭黑斗篷，双臂仍搭在你的肩头，头颅却是一块花岗岩，边缘崩缺，裂纹横生。那面具后面似乎藏着什么；这徒劳的遮掩，只为护住你的心智，不让你直面它真正的容貌。一个声音响起，低沉而轰然作响，却又收束成粗暴的耳语，仅供你一人听见。%SPEECH_ON%我将赐你死亡，凡人。你将在死亡的怀中安然取暖，而它将降临于你的敌人。%sacrifice%不会逝去，他将永远与你同在。我向你保证。%SPEECH_OFF%一片白光骤然将你拉回。狂风涌动，帐帘向外卷起，烛火以不可思议的角度倾斜，却没有熄灭。刺骨的寒意中，你呼出的第一口气化作白雾，飘过眼前。%cultist%已不知所踪。你急忙起身，摸过自己的脸和皮肤，确认自己仍是原来的自己。可那幻象仍挥之不去，烙印般在脑中跳动，留下一个可怕的事实：教徒提出的建议，你不得不认真权衡。

1d1226742b57193658dd.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You decide to fall to the undeniable impression that Davkul would be most unhappy with your failure to obey. But %sacrifice% also has earned a departing word from you. Clearing up your face, you step out of your tent and go to speak to the man. Perhaps just hearing his voice will knock some sense into you before you step off the ledge into an insane void from which this act has no doubt been beckoned.

 When you get to his tent, you notice that its flap is already open and gently waving in the wind. You step inside and find the sellsword in bed, his blanket tossed over him. You take a seat, speak a few words, hoping deep down that he'll wake up in the middle of them.%SPEECH_ON%You've been good, %sacrifice_short%, better than I could have asked for. A true brother to the %companyname% and the sort of fighter any captain would be proud to have.

Hey, don't leave me rambling here. I know you're awake, you lark.%SPEECH_OFF%You reach over to the blanket and draw it back. You jump to your feet and nearly knock the whole tent over. In the bed is not %sacrifice%, but a torso, its flesh torn asunder and stretched around armor made of unknown metal, teeth for rivets, tendons for strappings, bones for pauldrons, a cuirass of absolute carnage. %cultist% stands in the tent's opening.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul is most pleased and has graced us with an aspect of Death.%SPEECH_OFF%This... this is not what you were expecting. You don't even know what you were expecting, but this could never have been imagined or prepared for. What's done is done, and may the soul of %sacrifice% rest in peace. It is unlikely you ever will.
1d1226742b57193658dd.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]有一点已不容否认：若你拒不服从，达夫库尔将极为不悦。你决定屈从。可%sacrifice%也值得你亲口道别。你整了整神色，走出帐篷，去找他说话。也许，只要听见他的声音，你就能清醒过来，不至于踏入那疯狂的深渊——这般行径，无疑正是从那里受到的召唤。

 来到他的帐篷前，你发现帐帘已经敞开，在风中轻轻摆动。你走进去，见佣兵躺在床上，身上搭着毯子。你坐下，低声说了几句，心底盼着他能在你开口时醒来。%SPEECH_ON%你一直做得很好，%sacrifice_short%，比我能奢求的还要好。你是%companyname%真正的弟兄，是任何团长都能引以为傲的战士。

嘿，别让我一个人在这儿唠叨。我知道你醒着呢，滑头。%SPEECH_OFF%你伸手掀开毯子，随即猛地跳起，险些掀翻整顶帐篷。床上躺着的并非%sacrifice%，而是一截躯干：血肉被撕开、撑展，包裹着某种未知金属铸成的盔甲。牙齿做铆钉，肌腱做束带，骨头做肩甲，整副胸甲就是一场血腥屠戮的凝结。%cultist%站在帐篷入口。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔十分满意，赐予了我们死亡的化身。%SPEECH_OFF%这……这不是你预想的结果。你甚至不知道自己原先在期待什么，但眼前这一幕，绝无可能事先想象，更无从准备。事已至此，但愿%sacrifice%的灵魂能安息。你恐怕永远也不能了。

3e05f705e92959063cec.source: May the old gods not be watching me on this night.
3e05f705e92959063cec.translation: 但愿今夜旧神没有看着我。

39c26187f2d346bf0660.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Despite the horror which you have just been witness to, you decide that %sacrifice% shall live. Just as you stand to go tell %cultist% of this, half the candles in the room suddenly blow out. Tendrils of smoke waft upward, a twisting haze through which, for but a moment, you swear you see a hard edged and angry visage turn and fade away. You get the feeling that %cultist% already knows what choice you've made. You stay in the tent and light those candles back up.
39c26187f2d346bf0660.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]尽管刚刚目睹了那般恐怖的景象，你仍决定让%sacrifice%活下去。你正起身去告诉%cultist%，屋内半数蜡烛忽然熄灭。缕缕烟雾升起，在扭曲的薄霭中，有那么一瞬，你确信看见一张棱角分明、怒气冲冲的面孔转身消散。你隐隐觉得，%cultist%已经知道了你的选择。于是你留在帐篷里，把蜡烛一一重新点亮。

a2482f73471bdec77d06.source: Somewhere along the road, this company took a wrong turn.
a2482f73471bdec77d06.translation: 不知从何时起，这战团走上了歧路。

ef16edbbcd09cbcde693.source: A grisly aspect of Davkul, an ancient power not from this world, and the last remnants of
ef16edbbcd09cbcde693.translation: 达夫库尔的一具骇人化身。这股古老力量不属于此世，而其中最后残存的遗骸来自

9c780be80226c4020c87.source: from whose body it has been fashioned. It shall never break, but instead keep regrowing its scarred skin on the spot.
9c780be80226c4020c87.translation: 。它由他的躯体塑成，永不破损，伤痕累累的皮肤会当场重新长合。

075b61d3c58fab76579e.translation: 因同伴之死而惊恐，死者是

fc9cd10455994790e94f.source: Was denied the chance to appease Davkul

7e7e4071b99c64f6a7ad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]While enjoying a slice of bacon, you hear wind of a quarrel going on. You ignore it for a time, but the shouts only get louder, quickly rising over your ability to enjoy a good meal. Angered, you stand up and head toward the disturbance. You find %cultist% and %oldgods% facing off, the cultist and follower of the gods having apparently discovered some differences.
7e7e4071b99c64f6a7ad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你正享用一片熏肉，忽然听见争吵声。起初你没理会，可叫喊越来越响，终于吵得这顿好饭都吃不下去了。你怒气冲冲地起身，循声而去，发现%cultist%与%oldgods%正针锋相对。看来，这位教徒和那位旧神信徒在信仰上有了些分歧。

8ab64c0ac84181f06e81.source: Let's get godly with the goriest!
8ab64c0ac84181f06e81.translation: 让我们以鲜血敬奉神明！

e7bc69c3ad9e366efca4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img] You step off to the side, letting the men hash out their differences as men with great differences do. Fists for arguments, the follower of the old gods makes his case, battering the cultist again and again. But the man with the scarred head only grins in return. His eyes are puffing up, the lids purpled and puckering over his eyesight. Yet, still, he grins, and there is bloody laughter spewing out of his reddened mouth.%SPEECH_ON%Such darkness! Davkul is most pleased!%SPEECH_OFF%With an anxious look, %oldgods% steps off %cultist% and backs away. He's rubbing his bloodied knuckles, realizing he may have broken a few in the seemingly one-sided scuffle. But it's the cultist's words that hurt him most of all.%SPEECH_ON%Man isn't tempted by the darkness, he is called to it! Lost without it! Gleeful in its return!%SPEECH_OFF%Almost afraid to look back, %oldgods% hurries away as the cultist remains behind, laughing and chuckling on the grass, nobody daring to get near him.
e7bc69c3ad9e366efca4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img] 你退到一旁，让两人按分歧极大的人惯用的方式解决分歧。旧神信徒以拳头讲道理，一下接一下地痛打教徒。可那个满头伤疤的人只报以笑容。他的眼睛渐渐肿起，青紫的眼皮挤得几乎遮住视线，却仍咧嘴笑着，从染红的嘴里喷出带血的笑声。%SPEECH_ON%多么深沉的黑暗！达夫库尔十分欢喜！%SPEECH_OFF%%oldgods%神色不安，从%cultist%身上下来，往后退去。他揉着沾血的指关节，意识到这场看似一边倒的殴打，可能打断了自己几根手指。可最令他难受的，还是教徒的话。%SPEECH_ON%人并非受黑暗诱惑，而是听见它的召唤！失去它便迷失！待它归来便欢欣！%SPEECH_OFF%%oldgods%几乎不敢回头，匆忙离去。教徒仍留在草地上，时而大笑，时而低笑，谁也不敢靠近。

7e0718f8a1692e026907.source: I didn't know %oldgods% had it in him.

9cec1de86d42916a6825.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img] The way things are going, you've hardly a man to spare. Just as fists are about to start flying, you step in between the two men and put an end to it. You tell %oldgods% he is better than this, and you tell %cultist% nothing, for the cultist is almost bowled over in fits of laughter. He points, grinning madly.%SPEECH_ON%The light steps in, but darkness is patient. Davkul awaits you all.%SPEECH_OFF%
9cec1de86d42916a6825.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]眼下这局面，你几乎损失不起任何一个人。两人刚要挥拳，你便挡在中间制止了他们。你告诉%oldgods%，别自降身份；至于%cultist%，你什么也没说，因为那教徒已经笑得快站不住了。他伸手指着，脸上挂着疯狂的笑。%SPEECH_ON%光明出手干预，黑暗却有的是耐心。达夫库尔等着你们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%

9b84bdc4512d2b364aeb.source: And work is waiting for you, get moving.
9b84bdc4512d2b364aeb.translation: 可还有活在等你，赶紧去干。

b8a5a7042fa1fdaab4cd.source: Lost composure and resorted to violence

d957d2fa7aed0f4ed68d.source: Was denied the chance to enlighten a cultist

2f491996a4bce68424cd.source: Was denied the chance to break a follower of the old gods
2f491996a4bce68424cd.translation: 未获准动摇旧神信徒的信仰

07a481cf1e387790ea47.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]A few brothers come to you looking rather worried. They say %cultist% has been sitting with %uneducated% for a few hours now. When you ask what's the worry, they remind you that the cultist has a scarred forehead and speaks of incredibly strange things. Ah, right.

You go and see the two men. %uneducated% looks up at you, smiling, and says the cultist actually has a lot to teach him. Grimacing, you wonder if you should put a stop to these... lessons.
07a481cf1e387790ea47.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]几个弟兄忧心忡忡地找来，说%cultist%已和%uneducated%坐在一起聊了几个时辰。你问这有什么可担心的，他们便提醒你：那教徒额头刻着伤疤，嘴里说的全是古怪至极的东西。啊，确实。

你过去查看。%uneducated%抬头冲你一笑，说这教徒真有不少学问可教给他。你皱起脸，琢磨着要不要叫停这番……授课。

f622b3d330661f3e2a1a.source: Do as you wish, as long as you don't forget what I hired you to do.
f622b3d330661f3e2a1a.translation: 随你们，只要别忘了我雇你们来做什么。

c009f2251a2d521d4b9d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You nod and turn away. The rest of the brothers shake their heads. By next morning, %uneducated% is found with a fresh wound on his forehead, the blood of conversion. When you ask how he is doing, he only says a few words.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul is coming.%SPEECH_OFF%Well, great.
c009f2251a2d521d4b9d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你点点头，转身离开，其余弟兄纷纷摇头。第二天清早，%uneducated%额头上多了一道新伤口——那是皈依的血印。你问他怎么样，他只说了几个字。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔即将降临。%SPEECH_OFF%好，真是好极了。

0b2e75a13f4991a08a1d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You separate the two men, telling %uneducated% to go count some inventory. When he leaves, the cultist sneers at you.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits. You see him in your sleep. You see him in the nights. His darkness is coming. No light burns forever.%SPEECH_OFF%
0b2e75a13f4991a08a1d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你把两人分开，叫%uneducated%去清点物资。他走后，教徒对你冷笑。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔在等待。你在梦中见到他，在黑夜里见到他。他的黑暗即将来临，没有光能永远燃烧。%SPEECH_OFF%

35d6b086a616d1c41bd3.source: Yeah, well, until then you work for me.
35d6b086a616d1c41bd3.translation: 行，在那之前，你还是替我干活。

91f588659d774744c081.source: has been converted to a Cultist
91f588659d774744c081.translation: 已皈依，成为达夫库尔教徒

04643374130a9792b753.source: Was denied the chance to convert

5af980571b0f9f6a4942.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]You come across %braveman1% and %braveman2% sitting with %dastard%. The two men are pepping up the rather skittish brother, letting him know that there is nothing to fear in battle. %dastard% explains that he is fearful of a painful death. %braveman1% says he has seen many men die and by the sword, truly, is one of the fastest. %braveman2% raises his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Unless it gets you in the stomach.%SPEECH_OFF%%braveman1% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Right. But other than that, you have nothing to fear!%SPEECH_OFF%
5af980571b0f9f6a4942.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]你看见%braveman1%和%braveman2%正与%dastard%坐在一起。两人给这位胆战心惊的弟兄打气，说上战场没什么好怕的。%dastard%解释，自己怕的是死得太痛苦。%braveman1%说，他见过不少人死去，死在刀剑之下确实算最快的几种之一。%braveman2%举起手。%SPEECH_ON%除非捅中了肚子。%SPEECH_OFF%%braveman1%点头。%SPEECH_ON%对。除此之外，没什么好怕的！%SPEECH_OFF%

e3fa69b3dd7def64847f.source: Growing up to become a real sellsword after all, are we?
e3fa69b3dd7def64847f.translation: 总算有点真正佣兵的样子了，是吧？

4dea09071a5f86030c9f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img] {While marching through the forest, %randombrother% calls out to the company. You look over to see him pointing somewhere beyond a line of brush. When you walk to him, you see what he sees: three bodies hanging from a tree. Their purpled faces and grey feet sway and turn, the wind sometimes forcing them to grimly face one another. %randombrother% notes that they're wearing wood: signs of their crimes. 'Thief,' reads one. 'Whore' another. 'Traitor' the last. Having seen enough, you tell the men to get moving again. | The forest offers no relief, no little road or sidepath for you to travel down. It is thick and unrelenting and does not seem to want you there. You soon find that it did not want someone else, either: a corpse is found tied up in a thorn bush, legs crooked, arms bent, all rather finagled to to their supposed purpose. The mouth rests agape with the eyes drawn slim in some sort of final frustration. %randombrother% catches up to you, looks the body up and down, then nods.%SPEECH_ON%Body's clean as a whistle, aside from the thorn's work of course. I'd say that man right there was so lost no animal could find him. Just died, no use to anyone or anything.%SPEECH_OFF%You point at an ant mindlessly bumbling about the dead man's teeth. The brother laughs and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%You sure he ain't lost too?%SPEECH_OFF% | You stare up at the forest canopy, watching what angles the lightbeams are coming in at. While getting your bearings, %randombrother% comes by looking rather distraught.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, you oughta come see this.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell him to lead the way. He brings you to a clearing, though not much about it is clear.

Legs. Legs everywhere. Some severed at the ankle, some at the thigh, and everywhere else in between. They've no place, no order. They're just about, some by themselves and others all twisted up in bunches, some planted upright with sticks like they were walking jokes and a few even seem to have been thrown into the trees where they rest limply over branches or upside down by their feet. One hangs from a spit, the calf burnt black as though someone had run off, leaving it there over a fire that had long since died.

The brother that found the disgusting sight comes to stand next to you.%SPEECH_ON%No bodies, sir. Just.. legs.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to look at the mercenary, but all he can do is shrug.%SPEECH_ON%We've not found a single body, sir. I mean, the top-half, anyway. Do you think it means anything? I mean, who would do that? Remove someone's legs and then take off with the rest?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head in disbelief. Having seen enough, and having no answer for such questions, you quickly usher the rest of the men away from the clearing and get back to marching. | You stop at a creekbed to wash yourself and get something of a drink, but before you take the first sip %randombrother% grabs your shoulder. He points upriver. A woman's body is face down in the water, her long hair twisting rather lively to the ripples. You thank the sellsword for saving you from any disease the dead press onto the world. | The tree canopy is thick and twisting. Whatever light there is above can barely come through, braids of shadow encompassing your men as they march. But further on ahead you see a pillar of light gleaming into the forest. Naturally, someone else saw it first. And it was the last thing they saw.

In that stroke of light a boy rests with his back up against a tree. His head is aloll and his hands turned up and open. Purple smudges stain his palms. %randombrother% walks up and immediately shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Poison berries. Damned kid didn't stand a chance.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to the battle brother and inquire if the boy might have gone peacefully. The man shakes his head again. %SPEECH_ON%No.%SPEECH_OFF% | A dead body. Rather, what should be a body. The chest is open and the viscera laid out in all directions, grey and sagging and soft. You can't tell if it was a man or woman, only that it had to have been an adult cut down to much smaller sizes. What creature could have done this work is beyond you, though %randombrother% suggests maybe it was the deed of a very determined man. | You find the body of a woman with its back resting against a tree. There is a knife in her chest, the wound so quickly fatal that she appears to have died while in some motion of life. Above her, another woman swings from a branch. Red are her clothes. The body's head tilts forward as though to stare at her crime, and the rope that hangs her there groans to a muted wind. | You come across some scene of battle. Men, armor, weapons, not a single one of them useable. The dead got that way through some sheer form of brutality you do not wish to learn. Footprints in the earth suggest something big had come through, leaving behind a wake of ruin and calamity, and no urge on your part to follow where those steps go. | Marching along, you find a dead man with a few broken arrows in his back. More puncture wounds where his killer managed to retrieve his ammunition in one piece. The man was carrying a love letter, its destination a woman that had, apparently, already been spoken for. Ah, romance.}
4dea09071a5f86030c9f.translation:
