[img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img] {行军穿过森林时，%randombrother%叫住众人。你转头，看见他指着灌木后方。走近后，你也看清了：三具尸体吊在树上。青紫的脸、灰白的脚随风摇摆旋转，有时被吹得彼此相对，凄惨地面面相觑。%randombrother%说，他们身上还挂着木牌，写着各自的罪名。一块是“盗贼”，一块是“娼妓”，最后一块是“叛徒”。看够了，你叫弟兄们继续赶路。 | 森林没有留出半点方便，既无小路，也无岔道可走。林木密不透风，顽固地拦在前方，似乎并不欢迎你们。很快，你发现它同样不欢迎另一个人：荆棘丛中缠着一具尸体，腿歪着，胳膊弯着，像被胡乱摆弄，勉强凑成该有的姿势。嘴巴张开，双眼眯成细缝，仿佛死前还满是不甘。%randombrother%赶上来，上下打量尸体，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%身上干干净净，当然，荆棘划的那些不算。依我看，这人迷路迷得连野兽都找不着。就这么死了，对谁都没派上用场。%SPEECH_OFF%你指了指一只蚂蚁，它正漫无目的地在死者牙齿间转悠。弟兄笑着摇头。%SPEECH_ON%你确定，它不是也迷路了？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你仰望树冠，看阳光从什么角度照入，借此辨认方向。%randombrother%走来，神色颇为不安。%SPEECH_ON%长官，你得来看看。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，让他带路。他将你领到一片空地，可那地方一点也不空。

腿。到处都是腿。有的从脚踝截断，有的从大腿截断，还有断在两者之间各处的。它们没有固定位置，也毫无排列章法，就那么四处散着。有的孤零零一条，有的扭成一团；有的用棍子撑得直立，像个会走路的笑话；还有几条似乎被扔上了树，软塌塌搭在枝头，或脚朝上倒挂着。一条腿架在烤叉上，小腿烧得焦黑，仿佛有人将它留在早已熄灭的火上，匆匆跑了。

发现这恶心景象的弟兄站到你身旁。%SPEECH_ON%没有尸体，长官。只有……腿。%SPEECH_OFF%你转头看他，他只能耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%一具尸体都没找到，长官。我是说，上半截。你觉得这有什么含义吗？我是说，谁会这样干？砍掉人的腿，再把剩下的带走？%SPEECH_OFF%你难以置信地摇头。既已看够，也答不上这些问题，你赶紧将其他弟兄带离空地，重新上路。 | 你在溪边停下，洗洗身子，想喝几口水。还没来得及喝，%randombrother%便抓住你的肩膀，指向上游。一具女尸脸朝下漂在水里，长发随涟漪扭动，竟颇有生气。你谢过佣兵，免得自己染上死者散布给世间的病。 | 树冠浓密交错，上方仅有的光线几乎透不下来，编织般的阴影包裹着行进的弟兄们。可前方，有一道光柱照入森林。显然，有人比你们更早看见它，而那也是他看见的最后一样东西。

光柱中，一个男孩背靠树干，脑袋歪垂，双手摊开，掌心朝上，沾着紫色污渍。%randombrother%走近，立即摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%毒浆果。可怜的孩子，一点活路都没了。%SPEECH_OFF%你转向这位战团弟兄，问男孩是否走得安详。那人又摇摇头。 %SPEECH_ON%没有。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一具尸体。或者说，本该是一具尸体的东西。胸膛敞开，内脏向四面铺散，灰白、软塌、松垂。你分不清是男是女，只能确定，那原本是个成年人，如今被肢解成小得多的部分。你想不出什么生物会做出这种事，%randombrother%却说，也许只是一个特别执着的人。 | 你发现一具女尸，背靠树干，胸口插着一把刀。那伤口致命得太快，她仿佛还没做完活着时的一个动作，便已死去。上方，另一个女人吊在树枝上摇晃，衣服染成了红色。尸体低着头，像在凝视自己的罪行，悬着她的绳索在微弱的风中呻吟。 | 你走进一处战斗遗迹。人、盔甲、武器，没有一样还派得上用场。死者遭受过某种极端的暴行，你并不想知道具体是什么。泥土上的足迹表明，有个庞然大物曾经过此地，沿途留下毁灭与灾难，也让你半点不想循着脚印追过去。 | 行军途中，你发现一个死者，背上插着几支断箭。还有更多穿刺伤，说明凶手成功收回了一部分完好的箭。那人身上带着一封情书，收信的女人似乎早已有了归属。啊，爱情。}

7a18b49594d5bfb593b1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]The forest is home to many curiosities and dead bodies, really, aren't even the most curious of those. So when you stumble upon a litter of dead lumberjacks the only thing that piques your interest is the lump of a direwolf slain beside them. %randombrother% eyes the tracks going back and forth across a cutting field so abruptly interrupted that some axes were left hewn into tree trunks. He spits and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Poor fellas. Looks like some direwolves bushwhacked them something fierce.%SPEECH_OFF%You have the men collect what's left to be recovered and make your leave.
7a18b49594d5bfb593b1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]森林里怪事多，尸体甚至都算不上最稀奇的。所以，撞见一地伐木工的尸首时，唯一引起你兴趣的，是旁边也倒着一头死去的恐狼。%randombrother%打量着伐木场上纵横交错的足迹。袭击来得如此突然，有些斧头还嵌在树干里。他啐了一口，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%可怜的家伙。看样子，是几头恐狼突然扑出来，狠狠袭击了他们。%SPEECH_OFF%你让弟兄们收走还能用的东西，随后离开。

6ea12a2ba5bba0975f50.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]While marching through the forest, you come across a body swinging from a branch. It appears it has been there long enough for even the flies to have gotten their fill. %randombrother% notes some sharp suede shoes on the corpse's feet.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like a merchant to me, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You agree and have it cut down. Upon closer inspection, the eyes have been carved out and tattoos drawn across his chest. Given that you find some crowns still on the body, this was likely to be the work of uncivilized wildmen being spooked by an outsider.
6ea12a2ba5bba0975f50.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]穿过森林时，你看到一具尸体吊在树枝上晃荡。看来已经挂了很久，连苍蝇都吃饱离开了。%randombrother%注意到死者脚上那双漂亮的绒面革鞋。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我看像是个商人。%SPEECH_OFF%你也这么想，便叫人把尸体放下来。凑近查看，只见双眼已被剜去，胸前画满刺青。尸体身上还留着些克朗，想来多半是未开化的荒野人受外来者惊扰后下的毒手。

b4e0577cb2b93fc146ed.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]While trundling through the forest, birds suddenly scatter into the sky, shaking the trees and branches with the very frightful urgency of their leaving. Not a moment later does a man come barreling through a bush, looking more flash flood than flesh and blood. He seizes up, this earthen golem, and begs you to hide him.%SPEECH_ON%Look, I'll be perfectly honest. I'm a deserter. That's that. I didn't, I mean, alright I don't really have a defense. But look, what are you? Mercenaries? Great! Hide me and I'll fight for you to the end of time!%SPEECH_OFF%Halfway through his pleading spiel, you hear dogs barking in the distance. The man instinctively hides away into an arboreal cubby, quickly covering himself with dirt. He nods as if to say you've already come to an agreement.

 Bounty hunters come through the tree line, their dogs already sniffing around. Their lieutenant looks around.%SPEECH_ON%Don't even try to fool me, sellsword. I know that deserter came this way. Two hundred crowns for his head. Where is he?%SPEECH_OFF%
b4e0577cb2b93fc146ed.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你们正穿过森林，鸟群忽然惊飞，仓皇振翅，将枝叶摇得簌簌作响。紧接着，一个男人从灌木里猛冲出来，看着不像血肉之躯，倒像一股暴洪。这浑身泥土的家伙猛然刹住，求你藏起他。%SPEECH_ON%听着，我实话实说，我是逃兵。就是这么回事。我没……好吧，我确实没什么可辩解的。不过，你们是干什么的？佣兵？太好了！帮我躲过去，我就替你们打仗，打到天荒地老！%SPEECH_OFF%他还没求完，远处便传来犬吠。那人本能地钻进树间凹处，迅速往身上盖土，还朝你点点头，仿佛你们已经说定了。

 赏金猎人穿过林边，猎犬四处嗅探。副官环顾四周。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，别想糊弄我。我知道那个逃兵往这边来了。他的脑袋值两百克朗。人在哪儿？%SPEECH_OFF%

6f6b446a099b642a0cdb.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You spit and shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%I've not the faintest farkin' clue what you're talking about, bounty hunter.%SPEECH_OFF%The lieutenant eyes you up, staring you down with an old man's wisdom.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, mercenary. So be it. I know you're lying, but there's not much I can do about it.%SPEECH_OFF%The bounty hunter looses a sharp whistle and orders his band of men forth. The dogs bark briefly at the cubby where the deserter had hidden. Laughing, the lieutenant mockingly wishes you the best.

 With his hunters gone, the deserter emerges.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, mercenary. I owe you my life! You'll not regret this, not ever!%SPEECH_OFF%
6f6b446a099b642a0cdb.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你啐了一口，摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%赏金猎人，我他娘的根本不知道你在说什么。%SPEECH_OFF%副官上下打量着你，那双老于世故的眼睛仿佛要把你看穿。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，佣兵。就这样吧。我知道你在撒谎，可我也拿你没什么办法。%SPEECH_OFF%赏金猎人吹了声尖锐的口哨，招呼手下继续前进。猎犬冲逃兵藏身的角落吠了几声。副官笑着祝你好运，语气里满是嘲弄。

 追兵走后，逃兵钻了出来。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，佣兵。你救了我的命！我绝不会让你后悔，绝不会！%SPEECH_OFF%

85fd02af11d2e2a73a66.source: I better not reget this. Welcome to the company.
85fd02af11d2e2a73a66.translation: 希望你别让我后悔。欢迎加入战团。

0aa2993140943eb7de19.source: Keep on running. We have no place for a deserter.
0aa2993140943eb7de19.translation: 继续逃吧。我们不收逃兵。

38e3ec5ff64fa4974f3c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You nod to where the deserter is hiding. He must have kept one distrusting eye on you because he immediately jumps out of the hole and goes fleeing. The dogs run him down with ease, glomming onto him with caninal ferocity and dragging his screaming ass to the ground. Before you can even so much as laugh, the bounty hunter puts a bag of crowns into your palm.%SPEECH_ON%That's half my cut, but without the happenstance of your being here, I'm not sure we would have caught that wily bastard.%SPEECH_OFF%
38e3ec5ff64fa4974f3c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你朝逃兵藏身之处点了点头。他想必一直疑心重重地盯着你，立刻跳出地洞，拔腿就跑。猎犬轻易追上，凶狠地咬住他，把惨叫不止的家伙拖倒在地。你还没来得及笑，赏金猎人已把一袋克朗塞进你手里。%SPEECH_ON%这是我那份的一半。若不是碰巧遇见你们，恐怕还真逮不住这滑溜的混蛋。%SPEECH_OFF%

5a5141278c3eed3f6d88.source: You found %name% the deserter being chased through the forest. Though bounty hunters were hot on his trail, you elected to defend him and for that he swore an oath to you.
5a5141278c3eed3f6d88.translation: 你在森林里遇见了正遭追捕的逃兵%name%。赏金猎人紧追不舍，你却选择护住他。为报救命之恩，他向你宣誓效忠。

c8f8f59daabcf5c4820d.source: You gave up a deserter to bounty hunters
c8f8f59daabcf5c4820d.translation: 你把一名逃兵交给了赏金猎人

5745339d9729cdfa9c9d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]You are beginning to worry that a sort of malaise has fallen upon the men. They sit about the campfire, mindlessly poking sticks into the flames. Each face shows a loss of control, a loss of governance over one's own destiny. If a man can't know if tomorrow will be better than today, then how is he to keep pushing forward? Just as you are about to address this, %determined% stands up and so despondent is the mood that even the swift motion by itself catches the company's attention.%SPEECH_ON%Look at you bunch of sorry sad sacks. Do you think you're unique? Do you think you're the first to feel like shit? No, of course not. You'd not be the first to give up, either. To lay down and not rise again. That's the easy thing to do. That's what the world wants you to do. There's enough sonsabitches around, no need in having some sorry asses like yourselves mucking things up if you don't want no part and parcel in this punishment we call life.%SPEECH_OFF%Roused by this speech, you see a bit of a glint falling over the company.
5745339d9729cdfa9c9d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]你开始担心，某种萎靡正笼罩弟兄们。他们围坐篝火旁，漫不经心地用棍子拨弄火焰。一张张脸都像是失去了对命运的掌控。若连明天能否比今天好都不知道，又该如何坚持走下去？你正准备说点什么，%determined%却站了起来。营地里如此消沉，单是这一下利落的动作，就吸引了全团的目光。%SPEECH_ON%看看你们这帮丧气包。以为自己多特别？以为自己是头一个觉得日子烂透的人？当然不是。就算放弃，你们也不会是第一个。往地上一躺，再也不起身，多容易啊。这世道就盼着你们这么干。世上混蛋已经够多，要是你们不想在这叫作人生的酷刑里挣扎，就没必要再留着一群垂头丧气的家伙添乱。%SPEECH_OFF%这番话激起了众人的精神，你看见弟兄们眼里重新有了一点光。

c8d00713b3469502c259.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]%determined% continues, almost stabbing his thumb into his chest.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not taking the world's shit. I'm gonna make the world sorry for having me here. I didn't ask for no invitation so I ain't gonna play nice to this farkin' party. See you in the next life, men, but until then, let's dance in this one!%SPEECH_OFF%A cheer erupts and the men get to their feet, a sense of elation bursting forth as though the ground had them chained all along.
c8d00713b3469502c259.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]%determined%继续说着，拇指几乎要戳进自己胸口。%SPEECH_ON%我不受这世道的鸟气。我要让这世道后悔把我弄到这儿来。我又没求它请我来，凭什么在这场破宴席上规规矩矩？弟兄们，来世再见吧；不过在那之前，先把这辈子闹个痛快！%SPEECH_OFF%欢呼声骤然响起，弟兄们纷纷站起，兴奋之情喷薄而出，仿佛一直锁住他们的地面突然松开了镣铐。

e9fc48a83c8e0fe6034b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]You find %disowned% sitting by himself outside the camp. As the jeers and cheers of the men around the campfire crackle behind you, you approach the man and ask what he's sulking for. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Not sulking, sir, just thinking. Though I suppose one could be easily mistaken for the other.%SPEECH_OFF%Chuckling, he offers a bit of his drink, which you take. Settling down beside him, you ask what it is he is 'thinking' about. The disowned nobleman shrugs again.%SPEECH_ON%Ahh, nothing really. Just thinking about home. I'm a long ways away from it now, and the last I remember of it isn't exactly the best, yet I still find myself wishing to be there now and again. Homesick for a land that thinks me a sort of noble sickness, go figure.%SPEECH_OFF%You hand him back to his drink as he probably needs it more than you. While you're still clearheaded, you try and speak your mind...
e9fc48a83c8e0fe6034b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你发现%disowned%独自坐在营地外。篝火旁的起哄与欢笑在身后此起彼伏，你走过去，问他为何闷闷不乐。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我没生闷气，只是在想事情。虽说这两副模样确实容易让人弄混。%SPEECH_OFF%他轻笑着递来酒，你接过喝了一口，在他身旁坐下，问他究竟在“想”什么。这位被家族放逐的贵族又耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%唉，也没什么，就是想家了。如今离得这么远，最后留下的回忆也算不上好，可有时候，我还是盼着能回去。自己思念故土，故土却把我这贵族当成祸害，你说怪不怪。%SPEECH_OFF%你把酒还给他，毕竟他大概比你更需要。趁自己脑子还清醒，你试着说说心里话……

7963c99579e92f35809c.source: Fark the old home, you're with us now.
7963c99579e92f35809c.translation: 去他的老家，你现在跟我们是一伙的。

633ffe087ecb17d742cd.source: It's alright to think of home now and again.

9498399349dfb5932bb3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]You speak.%SPEECH_ON%Where you're from is a house, not a home. You yearn for a different place in a different time, when you're in this place, right here, right now. The %companyname% looks after you, and you it, and only together will we persevere.%SPEECH_OFF%The man stares into his drink for a time. He chuckles, sips, and wipes the froth away.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, I suppose that's one way to look at it. Thank you, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%
9498399349dfb5932bb3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你开口说道：%SPEECH_ON%你出身的地方，只是一个家族，并不是家。你惦记的是另一个地方、另一个时光，可你此时此刻就在这里。%companyname%照顾你，你也照顾战团；只有靠在一起，我们才能撑下去。%SPEECH_OFF%他盯着杯中酒看了一会儿，随后轻笑一声，喝了一口，抹去泡沫。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，换个角度看，的确如此。谢谢你，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%

28b91425d4a5a72ec67d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]You clap the man on his shoulder and speak.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, thinking of the old is good for the soul, even if it's through a thicket of shit and cruelty and evil and all else that makes any man stay up at night. But it's only good for a time. You look at the past, you acknowledge it, and then you move on. You have to be sure to only visit the past, not dwell in it. Everyone here has a past, %disowned%, and in that respect you will never be alone.%SPEECH_OFF%The disowned nobleman stares at the ground for a time. He slowly starts to nod.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, yeah, that's right. I guess a part of me was worried that I was genuinely wanting to return there. I was picturing it with the hearth alight, smoke out of the chimney, soft candlelight beyond the windows, and my family there awaiting me. I was ignoring the locked door, the guard dogs squatting outside, and those I love telling me to never come back lest it's in a box to bury far beneath the earth. I wasn't thinking of my past so much as dreaming of it, and I think you've helped me realize that, captain. Thank you. I know that, one day, I shan't have to dream about the %companyname%, but instead remember it clearly and fondly.%SPEECH_OFF%
28b91425d4a5a72ec67d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你拍了拍他的肩膀，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，回想往事对人有好处，哪怕那些往事满是烂事、残忍、邪恶，以及种种让人彻夜难眠的东西。可回想也得有个限度。看看过去，认清它，然后继续往前走。记住，你只能回去看看，不能住在那里。这里每个人都有自己的过去，%disowned%，在这件事上，你永远不会孤单。%SPEECH_OFF%被家族除名的贵族低头看了地面一会儿，慢慢点起头来。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，是啊，你说得对。我想，我心里一直有点担心，怕自己其实还想回去。我想象炉火正旺，烟囱里冒着烟，窗后透出柔和的烛光，家人正等着我。可我忘了紧锁的大门，忘了守在外面的恶犬，也忘了那些我爱的人曾说，永远别再回来，除非装在棺材里，好让他们把我埋到地底深处。我不是在回忆过去，而是在梦里美化它。团长，是你让我明白了这一点，谢谢。我知道，终有一天，想起%companyname%时，我不必靠做梦；我会清楚地记得这里，心怀眷恋。%SPEECH_OFF%

1d33f8cd45d143e9d88f.source: Had a good talk with you

532a71eedc9dfe47e112.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You go to check the inventory only to find %addict% splayed half-assed into a barrel, all four limbs hanging over the lip. There's a number of vials collected onto his belly. He stares at you with dim, reddened eyes, and the sockets holding them are purple as though all the blood had rushed there. You ask what the hell is going on and %addict% only smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Do, uh, do what you must. Er, captain. For I have already won.%SPEECH_OFF%}
532a71eedc9dfe47e112.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你去检查物资，却发现%addict%半截身子歪在桶里，四肢搭在桶沿上，肚子上堆着好几个小药瓶。他眼神涣散，双眼通红，眼窝紫得仿佛全身血液都涌到了那里。你问这他妈是怎么回事，%addict%只是咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%该……该怎么办，就怎么办吧。呃，团长。反正我已经赢了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

d4f31166efde05e70276.source: I just hope you'll heal in time.
d4f31166efde05e70276.translation: 只希望你能及时养好伤。

b9c0118ed904d8d22b28.source: Enough. I'll have this bloody demon whipped out of you!
b9c0118ed904d8d22b28.translation: 够了。我非得用鞭子把你这该死的瘾抽出去！

5e9001ab23fd0d0911b4.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]{You have %addict% taken to an ad-hoc whipping post. He lays limply against the wood, his fingers splayed out and pinching and clenching. He looks like he's chasing butterflies, and he carries that absent look when %otherbrother% hides him fierce with the whip.

 At first, the whipping does nothing, not even as it snaps across the man's back, leaving crescents of crimson. But after a few strikes, he wakes to reality and begins to scream. You come around to face him and ask if he'll swallow his addiction. He nods hurriedly. You let him get whipped again, and ask again, and again he nods. Another whipping, another question, another answer. So this goes, until he is broken and whatever ailed him is gone.}
5e9001ab23fd0d0911b4.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]{你命人把%addict%押到临时搭起的鞭刑柱前。他软绵绵地靠着木柱，手指时而张开，时而捏拢攥紧，像是在捕捉蝴蝶。%otherbrother%抡起鞭子狠狠抽在他身上，他依旧一脸恍惚。

 起初，他对鞭打毫无反应，任凭鞭梢在背上甩出一道道弯月般的血痕。挨了几鞭之后，他终于清醒过来，开始惨叫。你绕到他面前，问他能不能克制住毒瘾。他忙不迭地点头。你让人再抽一鞭，又问了一遍，他再次点头。一鞭，一问，一次点头。如此反复，直到他彻底屈服，那股折磨他的瘾头也终于消散了。}

fa67cec9c67af5c3f2b4.source: Get him out of my sight.

d5af95bac134c50e01bf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You pull %addict% out of the barrel and throw him to the ground. He wobbles there as though the earth was a staircase and he was looking down the top step's precipice.%SPEECH_ON%Oy, sir, careful, it's just down and down!%SPEECH_OFF%At first you think to kick his arse, but relent. You crouch and set down next to the man as he rolls over to stare at the clouds. Time passes, and after a while %addict% purses his lips and you can see clarity has returned to his eyes.%SPEECH_ON%I got a problem, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell him to ease up on the potions, that you can't trust him in this state. If he's got a problem with being a sellsword, if that's why he's like this, then that's okay, but it is a problem. He purses his lips again and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sir. I'll do my best to unfark myself and set things straight.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d5af95bac134c50e01bf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你把%addict%从桶里拖出来，扔到地上。他摇摇晃晃，仿佛脚下的大地变成了一道长阶，而自己正站在最高一级的边缘。%SPEECH_ON%喂，长官，小心啊，底下深着呢，一直往下！%SPEECH_OFF%你本想踹他几脚，最后还是作罢。你蹲下来，在他身旁坐下，看他翻过身，仰望云朵。过了一阵，%addict%抿了抿嘴，眼神终于恢复清明。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我是有毛病了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，让他少碰药剂。他成了这副模样，你没法再信任他。如果是佣兵这行让他受不了，才弄成这样，那你能理解，可问题终归得解决。他又抿了抿嘴，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢，长官。我会尽力把这烂摊子收拾好，让自己回到正道上。%SPEECH_OFF%}

876cf592ffca227a70d4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You pull %addict% out of the barrel and throw him to the ground. He wobbles there as though the earth was a staircase and he was looking down the top step's precipice.%SPEECH_ON%Oy, sir, careful, it's just down and down!%SPEECH_OFF%At first you think to kick his arse, but relent. You crouch and set down next to the man as he rolls over to stare at the clouds. After a while he looks over.%SPEECH_ON%You trying to help me?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and say you are, but %addict% simply smiles and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Ain't talking to you, I'm talking to you!%SPEECH_OFF%He points behind you at the barrel, and by the time you look back the man is up to his feet and charging forward.%SPEECH_ON%Fat sumbitch gon' be smart with me huh!%SPEECH_OFF%The sellsword tackles the barrel and it splinters from top to bottom and a number of items within spill out and shatter. A few mercenaries rush over and get the man and take him away while you count what's been lost.}
876cf592ffca227a70d4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你把%addict%从桶里拖出来，扔到地上。他摇摇晃晃，仿佛脚下的大地变成了一道长阶，而自己正站在最高一级的边缘。%SPEECH_ON%喂，长官，小心啊，底下深着呢，一直往下！%SPEECH_OFF%你本想踹他几脚，最后还是作罢。你蹲下来，在他身旁坐下，看他翻过身，仰望云朵。过了一阵，他望过来。%SPEECH_ON%你想帮我？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头说是，%addict%却只是笑着摇头。%SPEECH_ON%没跟你说，我跟你说呢！%SPEECH_OFF%他指向你身后的桶。等你回过头，他已跳起来冲了过去。%SPEECH_ON%肥混蛋，敢跟老子耍嘴皮子，是吧！%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵一头撞上桶，木桶从上到下裂开，里面好些物品滚出，摔得粉碎。几个弟兄赶来把他架走，留下你清点损失。}

bf141049f1f7c9983d20.source: Appalled by your order to have

4b59349f7008aa2e7c49.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{%ailing% is walking around camp with his hands out and his fingers stretched as though he were balancing across a rope. He nods to himself as he turns around, foot placed before foot, marching his way back across.%SPEECH_ON%For the first time in a long time I actually feel quite alright. Thanks, %healer%!%SPEECH_OFF%It seems %healer% knew of a couple means to rid what ailed %ailing%.}
4b59349f7008aa2e7c49.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{%ailing%伸着双手，张开手指，在营地里走来走去，像在绳索上保持平衡。他转身时兀自点头，一步接着一步，又走了回来。%SPEECH_ON%好久没这么舒坦过了。谢谢你，%healer%！%SPEECH_OFF%看来%healer%确实有几招，治好了%ailing%的老毛病。}

30407c2382d6d513c0fa.source: Feels the best he did in a long time
30407c2382d6d513c0fa.translation: 许久没有这样神清气爽了

9c04bdf67951a6efd679.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{You find a man sitting next to a hole in the ground. Beside him is a metal stake attached to which is a chain that runs into the hole. The hole is covered with goatskin. He regards you with a wave, but says if you wanna see it you'll have to pay. You ask what it is he's got. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%The darndest thing, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%A few armed men stand off a ways, no doubt a part of whatever scheme is in play here.}
9c04bdf67951a6efd679.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你发现一个男人坐在地洞旁。身边的铁桩拴着链子，链子一直伸进洞里，洞口则蒙着山羊皮。他挥手招呼你，却说想看就得付钱。你问他里面是什么，他咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%稀奇得很，大人。%SPEECH_OFF%不远处站着几个带武器的人，显然也参与了这场不知名目的勾当。}

dce6f05403b92fe8dc6e.source: Alright I'll pay a bit to have a look.

999c2671ad8fd95d1359.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{You flip the man a few coins. He bites them in his teeth and you tell him to be wary of doing that, there's blood on some of them. He shrugs and pockets the pay. You come to the hole and the man throws the tarp off. A gruesome looking alp stares up and hisses at you with rows of sharp teeth and a face like curtain made of pale flesh. There is a shackle around its neck and the man whistles at the reveal as though it was the first time he ever saw it there.%SPEECH_ON%Awful little bugger, ain't it? Don't get too close, it'll have you seeing things. Unless you wanna do that, of course. Some folks do. But if you start seeing things and you enjoy then you gotta pay a little more!%SPEECH_OFF%}
999c2671ad8fd95d1359.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你朝那人抛去几枚钱币。他放到嘴里咬了咬，你提醒他小心些，上头有几枚还沾着血。他耸耸肩，把钱揣进口袋。你走到坑边，他一把掀开篷布。一只面目狰狞的梦魇仰头看着你，露出一排排尖牙，嘶嘶作响。它的脸像一幅苍白皮肉做成的帘子，脖子上扣着镣铐。那人吹了声口哨，仿佛也是头一回看见坑里的东西。%SPEECH_ON%这小畜生够瘆人的，是吧？别靠太近，它会让你看见些不存在的东西。当然，你要是就想看，那也行。有些人就好这一口。不过丑话说在前头，看上瘾了可得加钱！%SPEECH_OFF%}

c8c17d4cba3263467f98.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{Such hideous creatures cannot stand to survive. You tell the man that it is likely to get its way out of the hole at some point and start wreaking havoc on the world, if not moreso than usual in a fit of primeval vengeance. The man spits.%SPEECH_ON%Go fark yourself. Get on out of here and you ain't getting your money back. You take one wrong step and I'll have to defend myself and my investment. Was a right bitch capturing that thing, don't you know?%SPEECH_OFF%}
c8c17d4cba3263467f98.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{如此可憎的生物不能留活口。你告诉那男人，这东西迟早会逃出洞来，祸害世人；若被原始的复仇欲驱使，恐怕比平日更加凶残。他啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%去你妈的。滚远点，钱也别想退。你敢乱来，我就得护住自己和这笔本钱。你知不知道，抓这东西费了老子多大劲？%SPEECH_OFF%}

4a641deb6a8e346894d9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{You grab a spear from one of the guards and throw it into the pit, striking the alp through its brainpan. Its pale flesh deflates around the spear shaft as though you'd struck down an enormous curtain. The monster enslaver draws a dagger and goes to stab you. %randombrother% parries the blow and cuts the man across the throat. A few guards dive into the fray, all of them dying in quick and hurried fashion, though a few of the mercenaries get hurt in the fracas. With the violence over, you collect whatever gold the enslaver had on him. You have the bodies dumped into the hole with the dead alp and then fill it up.}
4a641deb6a8e346894d9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{你从一名守卫手中夺过长矛，掷进坑里，刺穿了梦魇的脑壳。它苍白的皮肉瘪了下去，软软地挂在矛杆上，像一幅被你捅落的巨大帘幕。奴役怪物的那人拔出匕首，朝你刺来。%randombrother%挡开这一击，随即割开了他的喉咙。几名守卫也扑进混战，转眼便都丢了性命，不过也有几个弟兄在打斗中受了伤。厮杀结束后，你搜走那人身上的钱，把尸体统统扔进坑里，与死去的梦魇埋在了一起。}

72eedfd903442f1dc763.source: Let's get back on the road.

237d5ba0eb0f59d132db.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{You're not going to bother quarreling with these men. Some of the best fighters you've seen have gotten killed in reckless and pointless bar fights. If these idiots want to keep the monster, so be it. But a few of the company's mercenaries are not happy with the idea of an alp allowed to live, especially as the creature gazed its faceless stares upon a number of them and seemed to nod as though it'd be seeing them at a later juncture.}
237d5ba0eb0f59d132db.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你懒得与这些人纠缠。你见过最能打的几个好手，就死在鲁莽而无谓的酒馆斗殴中。这帮蠢货想留着怪物，就随他们去吧。可有些弟兄对放过梦魇很不满，尤其那东西还用没有面孔的脸“看”过他们中的几人，微微点头，仿佛日后还会再见。}

25a7e469ca23adf8982b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img]{%beastslayer% the beast slayer walks up to the hole and stares in. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%You don't have it captured. Alps cannot be captured.%SPEECH_OFF%The monster enslaver looks over and asks how so. The slayer laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Because that is no ordinary creature. This alp is biding its time. You said it sends nightmares to people looking in, yeah? Yeah, that's right. Fear is its blade and it is sharpening it right and steady. It is practicing its craft the best it can. Alps use environments to put their victims in and currently it's making do with the dirt. But eventually you'll look in and it'll be looking up, ready for the very moment, and you'll find yourself in the hole with it. Not you, yourself. No, the body would be spared. It will take your mind into that hole. And it will be there. You and that monstrosity alone in all the dark this world has to spare. For how long? Days, weeks. A very dangerous alp can cage your mind for what seems like years. You'll come out of it a fool, broken and slobbering and begging for death, that is if you still have the capacity to speak by then.%SPEECH_OFF%The slayer takes a bow from one of the enslaver's guards. He nocks an arrow. The alp looks up and its mouth blossoms open to rows of razor sharp teeth. The slayer shoots it right in the maw killing it instantly. He hands the bow back and unfurls his journeyman sheet.%SPEECH_ON%This is the pay I am owed. Extra for saving your soul and mind from an alp's forever harvest. I'll also be taking the alp's skin. Agreed?%SPEECH_OFF%The enslaver hurriedly nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, yes of course!%SPEECH_OFF%}
25a7e469ca23adf8982b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img]{猎兽者%beastslayer%走到坑边，朝里面看了看，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%你根本没抓住它。梦魇是抓不住的。%SPEECH_OFF%那个想奴役怪物的人望过来，问他为什么。猎兽者笑了。%SPEECH_ON%因为它不是普通的野兽。这只梦魇只是在等待时机。你说，往坑里看的人都会做噩梦，对吧？没错。恐惧就是它的刀，它正不紧不慢地磨着刃，尽力练习自己的手艺。梦魇会把猎物困进它编造的环境，眼下，不过是拿这泥坑凑合。但总有一天，你往下看时，它会抬头望着你，早已等好了那一刻。然后，你就会发现自己也在坑里。不，不是你本人。你的身体不会进去，它要拖下去的是你的心智。而它，就在那里。你和那怪物独处，四下是这世间所能容纳的一切黑暗。多久？几天，几周。厉害的梦魇能将你的意识困住，让你觉得过了好多年。等你出来，人就废了，痴傻崩溃，流着口水，只求一死——前提是，到那时你还会说话。%SPEECH_OFF%猎兽者从对方的一名护卫手中拿过弓，搭上一支箭。梦魇抬起头，嘴如花般张开，露出一排排剃刀般锋利的牙齿。猎兽者一箭射进它嘴里，当场将其杀死。他把弓递回去，展开自己的价目单。%SPEECH_ON%这是该付我的报酬。把你的灵魂和心智从梦魇永无止境的收割中救出来，还要另算。这张梦魇皮我也要带走。同意吗？%SPEECH_OFF%那人忙不迭点头。%SPEECH_ON%同意，同意，当然！%SPEECH_OFF%}

b742d15d522f29a470b7.source: You'll be splitting that with the company.

d1b5460876ad91799e85.source: %beastslayer%, you're an expert on these things. What say you?

60116c37aecb6153c788.source: You let some alp live which may haunt the company later
60116c37aecb6153c788.translation: 你放过了一只梦魇，它日后可能缠上战团

2752b08209f985501994.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{The men are talking around the campfire when %spiderbro% suddenly jumps to his feet screaming. He bounds backward, and lit by the flames you see a spider the size of a helmet glommed onto his boot!}
2752b08209f985501994.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{弟兄们正围着篝火闲聊，%spiderbro%突然尖叫着跳起来，连连向后蹦。借着火光，你看见一只头盔大小的蜘蛛紧紧扒在他的靴子上！}

81ff3d4168c8c205e02d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{You draw your blade, but %otherbro% has already beaten you to the punch. He yells at %spiderbro% to stand still which he reluctantly does. But the armed sellsword swings his blade far too high and cuts straight through the man's neck. The headless body buckles and the rest of the company screams in horror and rage.}
81ff3d4168c8c205e02d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{你拔出刀，可%otherbro%已经抢先出手。他大喊着让%spiderbro%站住，后者勉强照做。然而这佣兵一刀挥得太高，竟直接砍断了同伴的脖子。无头的身躯瘫倒下去，弟兄们顿时惊恐而愤怒地叫喊起来。}

22e38dc18a5f0e0073ba.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{You run toward %otherbro% looking to choke the very life out of him, only for your hands to sift through the flesh like fingers into fog and your momentum sails you into the ground.%SPEECH_ON%Uh, you alright captain?%SPEECH_OFF%Looking back, you see a perfectly healthy %spiderbro% sitting beside the fire. Far off in the distance, something pale and sleek steps back from a tree trunk. When you blink, it's gone. You tell the men to mind the perimeter and then return to your tent, shaking your head and pinching your eyes.}
22e38dc18a5f0e0073ba.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{你冲向%otherbro%，恨不得活活掐死他。可双手竟像伸进雾里一般穿过了血肉，冲势带得你一头扑倒在地。%SPEECH_ON%呃，团长，你没事吧？%SPEECH_OFF%回头一看，%spiderbro%正完好无损地坐在火边。远处，一个苍白光滑的东西从树干后退去。你眨了眨眼，它便消失了。你嘱咐弟兄们看好周围，随后摇着头、捏着眼角，回到帐篷。}

b00e580186f5afce5a49.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%spiderbro% nods and stiffly walks toward the campfire with the spiderling looking up at him with oddly trusting eyes. He puts the critter to the pit and it is immediately set ablaze. At first, you think he's done it, he's in the clear, but the fiery spiderling sprints up the man's pantleg, setting his attire alight, and gloms onto his head. Set afire, the man throws his hands out and begins to run around for help. The beast burrows its fangs into his skull and the screaming ceases in sudden paralysis and the sellsword falls into the campfire like a board of wood.}
b00e580186f5afce5a49.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%spiderbro%点点头，僵硬地走向篝火，小蜘蛛抬眼望着他，目光竟透着古怪的信赖。他把小家伙放进火坑，它立刻燃烧起来。起初，你以为事情已经办妥，他终于没事了。可那只着火的小蜘蛛突然沿着他的裤腿疾奔而上，点燃衣服，死死抱住他的脑袋。浑身起火的男人张开双手，四处奔跑求救。蜘蛛将毒牙刺进他的头骨，尖叫随着突如其来的麻痹戛然而止，佣兵像块木板一样倒进篝火。}

56c1673c0988a7be2735.source: Get his body out of there!

abcf548aa7ba072d0eed.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{You scream at the mercenaries to do their part, but when you jump toward the campfire and %spiderbro% there's a wash of embers and sparks and when they fade you find the sellsword calmly sitting beside the flames.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, captain, did you say something?%SPEECH_OFF%Looking around, you find the rest of the company engaged in idle chat. When you look back at %spiderbro% you thought you saw a white shadow passing behind him, but upon second glance it is gone. You tell the men to keep a vigilant eye for intruders and then return to your tent.}
abcf548aa7ba072d0eed.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{你大声催促佣兵出手帮忙，朝篝火和%spiderbro%扑去。忽然，余烬与火星扑面而来；待它们散去，那个佣兵正安然坐在火旁。%SPEECH_ON%啊，团长，你刚才说什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾四周，弟兄们都在闲聊。再看向%spiderbro%时，你似乎瞥见一道白影从他身后掠过，定睛再看，却已无影无踪。你让众人严防外敌，随后回了帐篷。}

3367e23634a4e859a5a3.source: I need to get more rest.

c1d1f4910640b8fb4703.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]{You have %addict% taken to an ad-hoc whipping post. He lays limply against the wood, his fingers splayed out and pinching and clenching. He looks like he's chasing butterflies, and he carries that absent look when %otherbrother% hides him fierce with the whip.

 At first, the whipping does nothing, not even as it snaps across the man's back, leaving crescents of crimson. But after a few strikes, he wakes to reality and begins to scream. You come around to face him and ask if he'll swallow his addiction. He nods hurriedly. You let him get whipped again, and ask again, and again he nods. Another whipping, another question, another answer. Finally, %otherbrother% slackens the whip and coils it.%SPEECH_ON%He's dead, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%}
c1d1f4910640b8fb4703.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]{你命人把%addict%押到临时搭起的鞭刑柱前。他软绵绵地靠着木柱，手指时而张开，时而捏拢攥紧，像是在捕捉蝴蝶。%otherbrother%抡起鞭子狠狠抽在他身上，他依旧一脸恍惚。

 起初，他对鞭打毫无反应，任凭鞭梢在背上甩出一道道弯月般的血痕。挨了几鞭之后，他终于清醒过来，开始惨叫。你绕到他面前，问他能不能克制住毒瘾。他忙不迭地点头。你让人再抽一鞭，又问了一遍，他再次点头。一鞭，一问，一次点头。终于，%otherbrother%垂下手，将鞭子盘了起来。%SPEECH_ON%长官，他死了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

30b8181ed2575527eacb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{You rush forward and go to lift the man's head up only for it to be a jug tied to a spear. Stepping back, you bump into %addict% who is sorting the inventory.%SPEECH_ON%Captain, you doing alright?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask him how the stores of potions are doing. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%All accounted for. Should I count again?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him to count something else and head to your tent for a drink. Turning around, a pale figure shifts away from one of the crates. You draw your sword and chase after it only to find a sheet billowing in the wind.}
30b8181ed2575527eacb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{你赶忙上前托起他的脑袋，手里却只是一个绑在长矛上的罐子。你后退一步，撞上了正在清点物资的%addict%。%SPEECH_ON%团长，你还好吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，问他药剂储备如何。他咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%一瓶没少。要再数一遍吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你让他换点别的东西数，自己回帐篷喝上一口。转身时，一个苍白身影从货箱旁闪开。你拔剑追去，却只找到一张随风飘动的床单。}

68650c2399997701ce45.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{You pull %addict% out of the barrel and throw him to the ground. He quickly flips around and yells out with perfect clarity.%SPEECH_ON%What the fark, captain?%SPEECH_OFF%It's not %addict% at all, but %otherbrother%. Looking away, you see %addict% stropping a blade. A pale figure shifts in the distance, but when you blink it is gone. You pull %otherbrother% to his feet and tell him to keep an eye out for robbers. He nods dutifully, perhaps sensing something is off with you, or perhaps not wanting to confront you for a mistake. You return to your tent for a drink.}
68650c2399997701ce45.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{你把%addict%从桶里拽出来，扔到地上。他迅速翻身，口齿清清楚楚地喊道。%SPEECH_ON%团长，你他妈干什么？%SPEECH_OFF%那根本不是%addict%，而是%otherbrother%。你转头望去，只见%addict%正在皮带上荡刀。一道苍白的人影在远处晃过，可你眨一下眼，它便消失了。你拉起%otherbrother%，叫他留神盗贼。他顺从地点头，也许察觉到你不太对劲，也许只是不想为这场误会跟你争执。你回帐篷喝了一杯。}

dfd0c8209941c90aa086.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You leave the man be, but the second you turn away you hear the shatter of glass and the gargle of the man which ruined it. Spinning back, you find %addict% doubled over with strips of flesh for a neck and he's picking glass out of an exposed throat. You rush to his aid, putting your hand against the bloodletting and you can feel his throat puckering against your fingers like the mouth of a beached fish. The man collapses to the ground, his full weight, his lifeless weight, his dead weight.}
dfd0c8209941c90aa086.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你不再理会他，可刚一转身，就听见玻璃碎裂声和那男人喉间的咯咯声。你猛地回头，只见%addict%弯着腰，脖子上只剩几条烂肉，正从敞开的喉咙里抠玻璃。你冲上去按住伤口，试图止血，能感觉到他的喉咙贴着手指一张一缩，活像搁浅的鱼嘴。他倒了下去，全身的重量压向地面——那是失去生命的重量，死人的重量。}

e13f5c39ab2f084f4c11.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{You bow your head to the earth, feeling such shame that you harken to the days when you gave a shite about the old gods. When you look back up, you find your fingers into a grain sack with its contents spilling all over.%SPEECH_ON%Oy captain, we gotta put those to use.%SPEECH_OFF%Looking over, you see %addict% and a white shadow standing behind him. You rush to your feet, but somewhere in all that hustle the shadow departed. You cannot find it nor any footprint and, not wishing to scare %addict% any further, you tell the sellsword to keep a watchful eye on the perimeter. Yourself, you go to your tent for a drink.}
e13f5c39ab2f084f4c11.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{你羞愧地低下头，恨不得找个地缝钻进去，甚至想起了自己还把旧神当回事的那些日子。再抬起头时，你却发现手指正插在一只粮袋里，粮食撒了一地。%SPEECH_ON%喂，团长，那些粮食咱们还要吃呢。%SPEECH_OFF%你转头看去，%addict%站在那里，身后立着一道白影。你猛地起身，可就在这阵忙乱之间，白影已经消失了。你既找不到它，也找不到半个脚印。不愿再吓着%addict%，你只叮嘱他多留意营地四周，随后独自回帐篷喝了一杯。}

62bcc7b551a795ef4d5e.source: Maybe two or three drinks, even.
62bcc7b551a795ef4d5e.translation: 说不定还该再喝上两三杯。

2ff3624f56f960ceb6d3.source: %terrainImage%{While traveling the land, %birdbro% gets struck by birdshite. It hits his swordhand and splashes crosswise all over his armor.%SPEECH_ON%Aww, awwww!%SPEECH_OFF%His arms go wide like chicken wings as he looks at the damage.%SPEECH_ON%Bloody hell, just my luck!%SPEECH_OFF%}
2ff3624f56f960ceb6d3.translation: %terrainImage%{行路途中，一坨鸟粪砸中了%birdbro%，落在握剑的手上，又溅了满身护甲。%SPEECH_ON%啊，啊——！%SPEECH_OFF%他像只鸡一样张着双臂，打量自己的惨状。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼，我可真走运！%SPEECH_OFF%}

b09cff4b4d6b27a80e0e.source: Yeah, don't dwell on it and let's get going.

a99d6fbe96b166b3d788.source: %terrainImage%{%birdbro% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Course. Just ruined m'day that's all.%SPEECH_OFF%}
a99d6fbe96b166b3d788.translation: %terrainImage%{%birdbro%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然，就是一整天的好心情都给毁了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

586691e74d22df7b2781.source: %terrainImage%{The ever superstitious %superstitious% analyzes the shit with the appraising eye of a proper jeweler. He purses his lips and nods, as satisfied a summary of bird shit as there ever was. He says.%SPEECH_ON%This is a good thing.%SPEECH_OFF%In the face of very incredulous company the man calmly explains that being shat on by a bird is an omen of good things to come. A few of the sellswords seem convinced by this notion. It is rather spectacular to have a bird choose you, out of all earth below, to land a squat on. You nod and say %birdbro% should open his mouth next time for extra special good fortune.}
586691e74d22df7b2781.translation: %terrainImage%{向来迷信的%superstitious%仔细端详那坨鸟粪，眼神专业得仿佛珠宝匠在估价。他抿唇点头，像是终于得出了一个对鸟粪再满意不过的结论。随后说道。%SPEECH_ON%这是好事。%SPEECH_OFF%面对满营狐疑的弟兄，他平静地解释，被鸟粪砸中，是好运将至的预兆。几个佣兵似乎真信了。脚下大地如此广阔，鸟却偏偏挑中你来拉上一泡，确实不凡。你点头赞同，还说%birdbro%下次该张开嘴，接一份格外特别的好运。}

b546c13a9fb92130025c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{%archer% looks up, hand shielded over his eyes, tongue out. He sees the bird and nods. He licks a finger, puts it to the air, and nods again. The archer grins as he nocks an arrow.%SPEECH_ON%With crime there is punishment.%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenaries groan and mock the man's moralizing, but he calmly raises the bow and lets the arrow loose. It zips and shrinks high into the air and you can hardly see the shot but you do see the bird suddenly crank sideways and start twirling to the earth. The sharpshooter nods and looks over at the company.%SPEECH_ON%You laughing now?%SPEECH_OFF%This only brings more jeers. The archer snidely comments about his importance and this brings about a healthy debate between the men who stand on the frontline and those in the back. You tell the men that if they want to argue which is better they can prove it on the battlefield.}
b546c13a9fb92130025c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{%archer%抬头望去，手搭凉棚，舌头微微伸出。他找到了那只鸟，点点头，又舔湿手指举起来试风，再点一次头。弓手咧嘴搭上一支箭。%SPEECH_ON%有罪，就该受罚。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵们纷纷嘘他，嘲笑这番大道理。他却镇定地抬弓放箭。箭嗖地飞向高空，越飞越小，几乎看不清了，你却看见那只鸟猛地向侧面一歪，打着旋坠了下来。神射手点点头，转向众人。%SPEECH_ON%这下还笑得出来吗？%SPEECH_OFF%回答他的，是更多嘘声。弓手阴阳怪气地强调自己的重要，惹得前排与后排的弟兄们好一番争论。你告诉他们，若真想分出谁更有用，就到战场上证明。}

e1b2750739304914666f.source: %terrainImage%{You tell %birdbro% that being shit on is a part of life and get the company ready to get back on the road. But a modest %historian% comes up and tells the ill-fated sellsword to hold off on cleaning the shite. The historian takes a good look at the shite and then up at the bird which authored it.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, yes... I know that bird! That magical creature!%SPEECH_OFF%The men look up at the bird as though they were sealeagured sailors finding rarified land. %historian% points at %birdbro%.%SPEECH_ON%You got shat on by a red-and-blue mockingbird! That's all I wanted to say, really. I just hadn't seen one in awhile. You... you can clean it now.%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenaries stand slackjawed before bursting into laughter. %birdbro% grabs the historian and uses his sleeves to clean the shit off which brings more roars from the men.}
e1b2750739304914666f.translation: %terrainImage%{你告诉%birdbro%，被屎砸中也是人生的一部分，便招呼战团准备上路。平日谦和的%historian%却走上前，让这个倒霉蛋先别擦。他仔细端详那摊鸟屎，又抬头看看肇事的鸟。%SPEECH_ON%是了，是了……我认得这只鸟！多么神奇的生灵！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们纷纷抬头，像饱受海浪折磨的水手终于望见了陆地。%historian%指着%birdbro%。%SPEECH_ON%拉你头上的是只红蓝相间的嘲鸫！真的，我就想说这个，只是很久没见过了。你……你现在可以擦了。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵们张着嘴愣了片刻，随后爆发出大笑。%birdbro%一把抓住历史学者，拿他的袖子擦掉鸟屎，惹得众人笑得更响了。}

47cf5866acc2eb2e74e6.source: Someone bring down that plumed transgressor!
47cf5866acc2eb2e74e6.translation: 谁去把那长羽毛的肇事者射下来！

42422317fd95399907aa.source: Got shit on by a bird

4b52638c4f2fc7c3038b.source: Got shit on by a bird for good luck
4b52638c4f2fc7c3038b.translation: 被鸟屎砸中，据说是个好兆头

d889dcb914c3d0c2573a.source: being shat on by a bird

055ea3febe6ea1778276.source: Got revenge on a bird that shat on him
055ea3febe6ea1778276.translation: 报复了往自己身上拉屎的鸟

3512a7e8495d2f68ca61.source: Exacted revenge on a bird that shat on
3512a7e8495d2f68ca61.translation: 一箭报了鸟粪之仇，被鸟拉了一身的是

26a176393fb47724fccc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{You go out for a piss and find yourself midstream when the din of combat erupts behind you. Pinching it off, you fix your drawers and head back for the encampment. There you find the whole company engaged in battle not with any particular foe, but with itself. Sellswords are clambering over equipment and the campfire and each other to swing fists and spin elbows and wrestle one another around or tackle each other to the ground. Anyone who falls gets their ass kicked, literally, until someone else comes along to distract the ones doing the kicking, then the one who had fallen jumps to their feet and throws themselves back into the fray. The ol' fracas eases as the men slowly realize you're there and they shape up and line up as though a swift reorganization would be a suitable resolution for their churlish behavior.

 Shaking your head, you ask what sparked it. The men shrug. Not a one can remember. You do a role call to make sure nobody's dead. You then tell them all to shake hands, keeping an eye on them as they do so. No bad blood to sniff out. Seems like this was just a bit of a fun tussle and wrassle, that's all.}
26a176393fb47724fccc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{你出去撒尿，尿到一半，身后突然响起打斗声。你连忙憋住，提好裤子，赶回营地。只见整个战团都打成了一片，敌人却不是别人，正是他们自己。佣兵们翻过装备、营火，甚至同伴的身子，挥拳甩肘，扭打摔跤，把彼此扑倒在地。谁一倒下，屁股就真得挨踢，直到旁人过来引开踢人的家伙，倒地者才跳起来，重新扑回混战。弟兄们陆续发现你站在那里，打斗便渐渐平息。他们理好衣裳，站成队列，仿佛只要赶紧归队，就能抵消刚才那番粗野行径。

 你摇摇头，问这架怎么打起来的。弟兄们耸耸肩，没一个记得。你点了遍名，确认没人丧命，然后叫他们挨个握手言和，全程盯着。看不出谁心里还记着仇。看来，这只是场闹着玩的打闹摔跤，仅此而已。}

02ef8dcb111e323f04f4.source: Nothing like a good brawl, eh?
02ef8dcb111e323f04f4.translation: 痛痛快快打一架，最舒坦了，是吧？

5d0267127e9c31925630.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{While browsing the town's markets, a man in silk approaches. He's wearing a grin with more glitter than chomp, and each of his fingers are adorned to glint. | As you take a look at the local market's wares, a strange man approaches. He has baubles of strange liquids hanging from his hip and there's a strange wood taking the place of most of his teeth. | It's not a true trip to the markets without some strange fella accosting you. This time it's a man with a large face, his mouth a bear trap of jagged teeth, and his cheeks set high as though they were meant to be shelves. Features aside, he swings his weight around like someone of import and wealth.}%SPEECH_ON%{Ah sellsword, I see you have some interesting trophies with ya. How about I take that %trophy% for, say, %reward% crowns? | That's an interesting trophy you got there, the %trophy%. I'll give you %reward% crowns for it, hand over fist, easy money! | Hmm, I see you are of the adventuring sort. You wouldn't come by that %trophy% without some guile in ya. Well I got some gold in me, and I'll give you %reward% of it for that trinket.}%SPEECH_OFF%You consider the man's offer.
5d0267127e9c31925630.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{你正逛着镇上的集市，一个身穿丝绸的男人走了过来。他咧嘴一笑，满口牙齿闪光有余、嚼东西怕是不足，每根手指也都缀满亮闪闪的饰物。 | 你正查看本地集市的货物，一个怪人走了过来。他腰间挂着些装有古怪液体的小瓶，大部分牙齿则被某种奇怪的木头替代。 | 逛集市时若没遇上怪人搭话，这趟集就算白逛了。这回是个脸盘硕大的男人，满口参差的牙齿像捕熊夹，两边颧骨高高耸起，仿佛要拿来搁东西。相貌且不论，他走起路来趾高气扬，倒像个有钱有势的人。}%SPEECH_ON%{啊，佣兵，我看你带着些有趣的战利品。那件%trophy%，卖给我怎么样？比如说，%reward%克朗？ | 你这件%trophy%挺有意思。我出%reward%克朗买下，当场付钱，轻轻松松赚一笔！ | 嗯，看得出你是个冒险家。没点本事，可弄不到那件%trophy%。我呢，正好有些金子，愿意出%reward%买你这小玩意儿。}%SPEECH_OFF%你考虑起他的报价。

793959c65f7905f7af44.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{%peddler% steps forward and pushes you back as though you were a random customer and not the company captain. He yells at the buyer and throws a hand up and the buyer responds and it's like two dogs barking at one another and it's all so fast and with so many numbers being thrown around it may as well be another language. After a minute passes, the peddler returns.%SPEECH_ON%Alright. He's now offering %reward% crowns. I'm off to look at some pots and pans, good luck.%SPEECH_OFF%He pats you on the shoulder and walks off.}
793959c65f7905f7af44.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{%peddler%上前把你挤到后面，仿佛你只是个闲逛的顾客，而非战团团长。他扬手冲买家嚷嚷，买家也嚷了回来，两人像对着狂吠的狗，语速飞快，报出的价码满天飞，听着简直像另一种语言。一分钟后，小贩回到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%行了，他现在肯出%reward%克朗。我去看看锅碗瓢盆，祝你顺利。%SPEECH_OFF%他拍拍你的肩膀，转身走了。}

4d5d8fb1bab2b55bfc1b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{While marching through the forest you come across a pile of burnt corpses clutching themselves in a final fiery embrace. It is a writhing mass of black limbs and the occasional face which gapes up at the sky. The faint smell of burnt pigs is still present, but there are no pigs with it. %randombrother% nods at the sight.%SPEECH_ON%That there is one big pile of awful.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Indeed it is.}
4d5d8fb1bab2b55bfc1b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{穿过森林时，你遇见一堆烧焦的尸体，彼此紧抱在一起，定格在烈火中的最后一拥。焦黑的四肢扭缠成团，偶尔露出一张朝天张嘴的脸。空气里还残留着淡淡的烤猪味，可这里没有猪。%randombrother%朝那景象点点头。%SPEECH_ON%真是一大堆惨不忍睹。%SPEECH_OFF%你也点了点头。的确如此。}

8d92d0bd986f20908d65.source: Maybe there's something useful in there.
8d92d0bd986f20908d65.translation: 里面或许有能用的东西。

7db9f05ffce3ff20f3b7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{The mercenaries start going through the bodies. Most of the corpses come in bundles of three or four which have to cracked apart like eggs. It takes a boot or steel wedge to get them apart. Chips of charred flesh flutter away as the men work. Burnt children are peeled off like breast plates, their chests caved in and their arms firmly out like spokes. Not much is discovered beneath the bodies. A few bits of gold at most. %randombrother% finds a grisly looking mask of sorts. You're not entirely sure what it is, but figure it wouldn't hurt to take it along. Maybe some trader will find it interesting.}
7db9f05ffce3ff20f3b7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{佣兵们开始翻找尸体。大多数尸体三四具烧结成团，得像敲开蛋壳一样将它们分开，靠靴子踹，或用钢片撬。弟兄们忙碌间，焦黑的皮肉碎屑纷纷飘落。烧焦的孩子尸体像胸甲一样被揭开，胸膛塌陷，双臂却仍僵直外伸，像车轮的辐条。尸堆下没找到多少东西，至多一点金子。%randombrother%发现一张模样可怖的面具。你也不太清楚那是什么，不过带着总没坏处。说不定会有商人感兴趣。}

c7d2505df46f58d4f9f5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{%randombrother% crouches beside the ball of charred corpses and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I don't rightfully think there's anything in there, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can respond a black hand shoots out and grabs the man by his ankle. The bodies rise and shift, a lone victim pulling himself out of the seared grotesquerie with a cape of charred corpses riding his back like spiderlings. His mouth is firmly agape, the lips burned away and the cheeks hollowed, and his eyes are flat in their sockets. His hand has the grip of a stone gargoyle's claw and when the mercenary crawls backward it only pulls the burnt man with him. The whole pile jerks and tumbles with some bodies rolling off the pile with their limbs firmly out like coffee tables and others totters over to stare at the sky and another pitches forward and smashes its head into the ground, pasting it there into a powdery blackmark.

 Groaning, the survivor yells for water. You draw your sword and put it through his neck, ending his pain there and then. %randombrother% breaks the fingers off to free his boot from the grisly hand. A few of the sellswords are shaken by the event.}
c7d2505df46f58d4f9f5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{%randombrother%蹲在那团焦尸旁，摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我真不觉得这里面还有什么东西。%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及回答，一只漆黑的手猛地伸出，抓住了他的脚踝。尸体堆抬起、挪动，一个尚未断气的人从焦黑畸形的尸丛里往外爬，背上拖着几具焦尸，仿佛披了件爬满幼蛛的斗篷。他的嘴张着，再也合不上，嘴唇已烧没了，两颊凹陷，眼球瘪在眼眶里。那只手像石像鬼的爪子般紧紧箍住佣兵的脚，佣兵向后爬，也只把这焦人一同拖了出来。整堆尸体随之抽动、翻倒：有的四肢僵直地滚下来，像翻倒的茶几；有的晃晃悠悠倒向一边，面朝天空；还有一具向前栽倒，脑袋砸在地上，碎成一摊粉末状的黑印。

 幸存者呻吟着喊水喝。你拔出剑，刺穿他的脖子，当场结束了他的痛苦。%randombrother%掰断那只骇人手掌的手指，才把靴子挣脱出来。几个佣兵被这一幕吓得不轻。}

1e374bec0bc3d1685a49.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{%beastslayer% holds his hand up.%SPEECH_ON%They weren't murdered, they were purged.%SPEECH_OFF%He squats beside the rim of the pile and lifts a charred arm and wrenched it free at the elbow. He flips the arm around and gives it a squeeze. Green puss oozes out from where the veins would be, dripping steadily to the ground. The beast slayer takes a vial and collects what he can.%SPEECH_ON%These people were infected with a Webknecht's poison. It usually dissolves the organs and kills, but sometimes, rarely, it has other effects. Causes bristles of thick hair to grow out on the arms, long fingernails, the shoulder blades start to ache and protrude from the back. Unsightly. And the poisoned, well, they go insane.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if all these people were poisoned. The beast slayer shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%This one I knew from the shoulders, the rest, I dunno. When an illness grips a village, it grips the village whole, and soon chaos and confusion become the contagion and the illness itself is but a forgotten spark drifting in the very bonfire it started.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1e374bec0bc3d1685a49.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{%beastslayer%抬起手。%SPEECH_ON%他们不是被谋杀的，是被当成祸患清除的。%SPEECH_OFF%他蹲在尸堆边，抬起一条焦黑的手臂，从肘部将它拧断扯下。他把断臂翻过来，挤了挤。原本该是血管的地方渗出绿色脓液，不断滴到地上。猎兽者拿出小瓶，尽量收集了一些。%SPEECH_ON%这些人中了巨蛛的毒。通常毒液会溶解内脏，要人性命，但有时候，极少数时候，还会发生别的变化。胳膊上长出粗硬的毛，指甲变得老长，肩胛骨开始疼痛，从背后凸出来。模样很难看。而中毒的人，唉，会发疯。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，这些人全都中了毒吗？猎兽者摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%这个我能从肩膀看出来，其余的，不好说。疾病一旦攫住一个村子，就会把整个村子都卷进去。很快，混乱与恐慌才成了真正四处传播的东西，而疾病本身，不过是飘在熊熊烈火里、早被遗忘的那点火星，尽管大火正是它点起来的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

6f35409ccdb5f3ce2c1f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{%killer% the murderer on the run smirks and snorts and he nods and spits and nods again. He points at the pile of bodies.%SPEECH_ON%That's a cruelty so fierce I don't think its doer survived the doing.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what he means, but the man holds a finger up and walks about the forest, looking behind tree after tree until he comes to a stop.%SPEECH_ON%Just as I thought.%SPEECH_OFF%You come round to see a man hanging there. His fingertips are black and there's ash on his face and a noose about his neck. A note in his hand carries apologies, though it does not describe the nature of his crime or if it were a crime at all. Below his feet is his armor and weapons. He may have been a nobleman. Regardless, you have the body cut down and everything looted.}
6f35409ccdb5f3ce2c1f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]{在逃杀人犯%killer%咧嘴冷笑，哼了一声，点点头，吐了口唾沫，又点点头。他指着尸堆。%SPEECH_ON%这手段狠得过了头，我看下手的人，事后也没能活下来。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他什么意思，他却竖起一根手指，走进林子，逐棵树往后查看，最后停下脚步。%SPEECH_ON%果然不出所料。%SPEECH_OFF%你绕过去，看见一个吊死的人。他指尖焦黑，脸上沾着灰，脖子套在绳圈里。手中一张字条写满歉意，却没交代他犯了什么罪，甚至没说那到底算不算罪。他脚下放着盔甲与武器，也许曾是个贵族。无论如何，你都让人割断绳索放下尸体，把值钱的东西一并取走。}

1c4774c43c5cd5fff724.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]A shrill cry pierces the doldrums of the swamp. You rush forward and find a man thrashing about in the waters, his arms swinging ropes of kudzu. The water is foaming and bubbling and the snout of a dog briefly appears and spends that second barking for help instead of breathing for any momentary extension of life. Seeing you, the dog's owner calls out.%SPEECH_ON%Please, help! Something's got my dog!%SPEECH_OFF%
1c4774c43c5cd5fff724.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]一声尖叫打破沼泽的死寂。你赶忙上前，只见一个男人在水里扑腾，双臂甩动着一根根葛藤。水面翻起泡沫与气泡，一只狗的口鼻短暂地露了出来，却把这片刻全用来吠叫求救，连口续命的气都没顾上吸。狗主人看到你，立刻大喊。%SPEECH_ON%救命！帮帮忙！有东西抓住我的狗了！%SPEECH_OFF%

263a246d34c3a1bb6764.source: Men, we've got to help that dog!

39619400c73ba775e9f3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]%helpbro% wades into the swampwater with his arms out and swaying as though he were screwing the lid off a barrel. He lifts the weapon on high and the dog's owner nervously watches. A grin crosses the sellsword's face.%SPEECH_ON%Gotcha!%SPEECH_OFF%He skewers the swamp water and wrangles up a snake longer than any you've ever seen, the length of it flopping about as the mercenary parades its corpse like a colored rope of a reward. The owner goes for his dog, but it slips out his grasp as though his arms were but another snake and it sprints right to your side. You ask if it's his dog at all. He nods, then slowly shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I suppose it's yer dog now. He's a fighter, that one, but he ain't nothing at all if not a goddam shite swimmer. I'd see it a fair trade if I can keep that there snake.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and make the trade, telling %helpbro% to hand over his newfound trophy.
39619400c73ba775e9f3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]%helpbro%蹚进沼泽，双臂向外伸着，摇摇摆摆，像是在拧开一只大桶的盖子。他高高举起武器，狗主人紧张地盯着。佣兵脸上忽然露出笑容。%SPEECH_ON%逮着你了！%SPEECH_OFF%他猛地刺入水中，挑起一条你从未见过的长蛇。蛇身来回甩动，他得意地展示着尸体，活像拎着一条彩绳做的奖品。主人伸手去抱狗，狗却像把他的胳膊也当成了蛇，挣开便跑到你身旁。你问，这究竟是不是他的狗。他先点头，又慢慢摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我看它现在归你了。这家伙能打，就是游水实在烂得要命。要是那条蛇能留给我，这交换也算公道。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头答应，让%helpbro%交出刚到手的战利品。

24afc5f7f9c2e7279008.source: I think I'll name you... Swimmer.

4e6d3b084c17667bb65c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]%helpbro% heads to the shoreline and draws his weapon. He wades into the mire like some ale strewn saint departing a crowd before they recognize his face. Such is his struggle that he topples over on top of the dog and disappears into the froth and bubbles of the battle. You rush to his side and pull him ashore, the man covered in moss and his boots wrapped in lily pads and he's hacking nasty swamp water and picking out the brine which fermented it. There's no sight of the dog, just a slight ripple of water which trails away from the scene. Unnerved, its owner nods.%SPEECH_ON%Appreciate the effort, but it is what it is. The swamp sees to such things because it's a swamp and fark this goddam farkin' place I'd see this whole shitstain of geographical oddity drained and burned and salted to nothing but a wasteland whole if I could!%SPEECH_OFF%You raise an eyebrow and ask if he lives in the swamp. He takes a long breath and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yessir. Rent free.%SPEECH_OFF%
4e6d3b084c17667bb65c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]%helpbro%来到岸边，拔出武器，蹚进泥沼，步履活像个浑身酒气、趁众人还没认出自己便匆匆离席的圣徒。他挣扎得厉害，一头栽到狗身上，消失在翻腾的水花与泡沫中。你赶紧冲过去，将他拖回岸边。他浑身青苔，靴子缠着睡莲叶，不停呛咳着吐出臭水，往外拣那些咸腥腐烂的污物。狗已经不见了，只剩一道细细的涟漪向远处划去。主人惊魂未定地点头。%SPEECH_ON%多谢帮忙，可事已至此。沼泽就爱干这种事，因为它就是沼泽，去他娘的这个该死的烂地方！要是能办到，我非把这片狗屎似的怪地形抽干、烧光、撒满盐，彻底弄成荒地不可！%SPEECH_OFF%你扬起眉毛，问他是不是住在沼泽里。他深吸一口气，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%是，先生。不用交租。%SPEECH_OFF%

cdfaca8c3b3dcecbc45b.source: Well, that was a whorthwile endeavour.

d00f0a432fc946cad4b2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]%houndmaster% the houndmaster rushes forward to help, but the dog the swamp surface goes still. The man slips into the water and feels about. His hands clench and he stares back at the stranger.%SPEECH_ON%I'm a dog handler at heart. That means I train 'em to not get into this much trouble. But I ain't ever would need to train a dog to beware this here bog, which means this sonuvabitch here threw him in there, ain't that right?%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger's first words are excuses and so the houndmaster batters him. The stranger scissors his legs backwards so awkwardly his pants fall about his ankles and there in his drawers spill an assortment of treasures. The damned fool is a treasure hunter! %houndmaster% draws a weapon and looks ready to murder this man. Screaming, the stranger kicks his pants off and runs off into the swampwoods hooting and pallidly half naked like some potato sack governed by a ghost. Laughing, you crouch to sift through the departed's goods, not all of which is shiny.
d00f0a432fc946cad4b2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]驯犬师%houndmaster%冲上前救援，可狗已没了动静，沼面也静了下来。他滑入水中，摸索片刻，攥紧双拳，回头盯着陌生人。%SPEECH_ON%我打心底就是个驯犬的，会教它们别惹这么大的麻烦。可哪条狗需要我专门教它避开这种烂沼泽？也就是说，是你这王八蛋把它扔进去的，对不对？%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人一开口就忙着辩解，驯犬师便动手揍他。那人双腿交错，狼狈地往后退，裤子竟滑到了脚踝，各种宝物从裤子里散落出来。这该死的蠢货原来是个寻宝的！%houndmaster%拔出武器，像是准备杀人。陌生人尖叫着踢掉裤子，半裸着苍白身体，嚎叫着逃进沼泽林，活像一个被鬼附身的土豆袋。你笑着蹲下，翻检逃亡者留下的东西，其中也不全是亮闪闪的财宝。

638b4bc351a6cfbb6819.source: What a shame. And what a gain!
638b4bc351a6cfbb6819.translation: 可惜了。不过，收获也不小！

87c95fc8de74e600695d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]The slayer of creatures, %beastslayer%, nods and wades into the swamp. He calmly comes to the thrashing water and stands over it, staring into the mire with his eyes tracking left to right as though he were watching carp in clear waters. Finally, he draws a dinner knife and slashes it into the water. Once more. And again. The dog surfaces and it snorts for air. The slayer stabs again and this time the dog runs free and goes between your legs where it huddles wet and whimpering. %beastslayer% holds something in his hand and then lets it go, whatever it is diving across the swamp, the water rippling in its wake.%SPEECH_ON%Nothing but a snake, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%The beast slayer kicks his foot up out of the water and riding his toe is a shiny goblet. He regards the swamp stranger with complete contempt.%SPEECH_ON%Your cowardice has made you a monster, treasure hunter, a right savage that'd use a dog in place of his own two hands. You've no business in these swamps. When I turn around, you'd best be gone, got it?%SPEECH_OFF%The beast slayer hands you the goblet and the stranger retreats without delay.
87c95fc8de74e600695d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]猎兽者%beastslayer%点点头，涉入沼泽。他从容地来到翻腾的水边，站在上方，凝视泥水，目光左右移动，仿佛正在清水里看鲤鱼。终于，他拔出一把餐刀，猛地刺进水里。又一下，再一下。狗浮出水面，喷着鼻息拼命吸气。猎兽者又刺了一刀，这回狗挣脱出来，钻到你两腿之间，湿淋淋地蜷着身子呜咽。%beastslayer%手里捏着什么，随即松了手。那东西潜过沼泽，身后荡开一串涟漪。%SPEECH_ON%不过是条蛇，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%猎兽者把脚从水里一挑，脚尖上托着一只亮闪闪的高脚杯。他望向那个沼泽里的陌生人，满脸鄙夷。%SPEECH_ON%胆怯把你变成了怪物，寻宝的。你不敢自己动手，就拿条狗替你下水，真是个畜生。这片沼泽不欢迎你。等我转过身，你最好已经滚了，听明白了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%猎兽者把杯子交给你，陌生人立刻退走，片刻也没耽搁。

eecce6e3d2d68e380fb6.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]You fetch a net from the inventory and toss it over the dog. Despite the thrashing, the rim of the net sifts ever so gently into the mire like a child would slowly capture a jittery fly. A few of the sellswords join your side and go into the bog and tighten the ropes then drag the net ashore. The dog's legs stick out the bindings every which way and even with its life on the line it stares blankly in some sort of shamed caninity. Whatever held the dog seems to have gotten a sense of danger and releases itself and you watch a slippery green rope unfurl and dive back into the water and it's gone in the slightest of ripples.

 %randombrother% notes the mutt's fit frame and obedient demeanor. Indeed, it already seems unaffected by its brush with death, offering a friendly bark as deposition. You tell the stranger the dog now belongs to the company.
eecce6e3d2d68e380fb6.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img]你从储备里取出一张网，罩在狗身上。任它如何挣扎，网沿仍缓缓沉进泥水，像孩子小心翼翼地围捕一只乱窜的苍蝇。几个弟兄来到你身旁，下到沼泽里，收紧绳索，把网拖上岸。狗的四条腿从网眼里乱七八糟地伸着，哪怕命悬一线，仍呆呆看着，流露出一种狗才有的羞耻。缠住它的东西似乎察觉危险，松开了束缚。你看着一条湿滑的绿绳般的身影舒展开来，钻回水里，只留下一点涟漪。

 %randombrother%夸这狗体格结实，性子也听话。确实，它似乎已经忘了方才死里逃生的经历，还友好地叫了一声，替这番评价作证。你告诉陌生人，这条狗如今归战团了。

07956ccd647b06d5325e.source: Maybe I can use one of our nets to save that dog.
07956ccd647b06d5325e.translation: 也许能用一张网把那条狗救上来。

1124c61eabe0340c0be9.translation: 也许咱们的驯犬师能帮忙？

504e4a77c7c36206d2e3.source: %beastslayer%, you're used to deal with beasts. Know what this is?
504e4a77c7c36206d2e3.translation: %beastslayer%，你常和野兽打交道，认得这是什么吗？

ff179da89cc584f21d5a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You give the men a break and decide to scout the forest ahead yourself. Not more than five minutes out you hear the steady hum of chanting. Drawing your sword, you crest an embarkment of fallen trees and look over the side. There you see a dozen of what look like miniature men dancing in a circle. Half or whistling lowly while the rest keep repeating some word you've never heard before. In the center of the nonsense is a mushroom and a very bored looking toad which, occasionally, one mini man will run up and touch before sprinting back to the circle grinning as though he got away with some roguish crime.

 This is too much. You crawl forward to get a better look only to have a branch snap under your weight. The little men stop instantly and look toward you like a herd of prey. One yells in gibberish and the lot of them skip and hop away, diving into tree holes or into bushes. When you go down to see them out, you find nothing. They've vanished entirely. You go to the stump and find the toad impaled to the hilt by a dagger and the mushroom gone.
ff179da89cc584f21d5a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你让弟兄们歇歇，决定亲自去探前方的森林。走了不到五分钟，便听见低沉而有节奏的吟唱。你拔出剑，爬上倒木堆成的土坡，向下望去：十几个像是缩小了的人围成一圈跳舞，一半低声吹口哨，另一半反复念着你从未听过的词。圈中央摆着一朵蘑菇，还有一只看起来无聊透顶的蟾蜍。时不时有个小人跑上去摸它一下，又冲回圈里，笑得仿佛刚干了坏事却没被逮住。

这也太离奇了。你向前爬，想看得更清楚，却将身下树枝压断。小人们立刻停下，像一群受惊的猎物般望向你。一个用怪话尖叫，其他便连蹦带跳地四散，钻进树洞和灌木。你下去寻找，却什么也没找到，他们全消失了。走到树桩旁，你发现蟾蜍被一把匕首钉住，刀刃直没至柄，蘑菇则不知所踪。

61d14dccefcb04e68778.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%brother% is carving a rabbit into a piece of bark. It's shaping up nicely until he angrily throws the whole thing into the campfire.%SPEECH_ON%Oh who the fark am I kidding? I wish I was out here hunting game! But this ain't game, these are monsters! Creatures of the night! Bullshit, all of it, where'd they even come from? Well I tell you what, I ain't gonna be killed by one of them things! Not a farking chance!%SPEECH_OFF%The rest of the company stares at him as he comes down from the outburst. He quietly watches the rabbit carving churn and burn.}
61d14dccefcb04e68778.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%brother%正在一块树皮上刻兔子，刻得颇为像样，却忽然怒气冲冲地把整块树皮扔进篝火。%SPEECH_ON%我他妈骗谁呢？我倒希望是在外头打猎！可那些不是猎物，是怪物！黑夜里的怪物！简直荒唐，它们到底哪儿来的？我把话撂在这儿，我绝不会死在那种东西手上！绝他妈不会！%SPEECH_OFF%他发作过后，弟兄们都盯着他。他沉默下来，看着兔子雕刻在火里翻滚、燃烧。}

85028d0d54037227e41c.source: This is taking a toll on the men.
85028d0d54037227e41c.translation: 这些事正在消磨弟兄们。

9e257c9513dd1f4a4b8f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%brother% stares at the campfire with his hands bridged between his knees.%SPEECH_ON%Fark, man. I don't know if I can look at a greenskin again. They're so much stronger and faster than us! We, we shouldn't face them again until we got at least, two, no three times as many men!%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the company to keep an eye on him. Fear is justified but spreading it sure as hell ain't.}
9e257c9513dd1f4a4b8f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%brother%双手交握在膝间，盯着篝火。%SPEECH_ON%他妈的，我不知道还敢不敢再看绿皮一眼。它们比我们强壮那么多，还那么快！我们……至少得有两倍，不，三倍的人手，才能再跟它们打！%SPEECH_OFF%你叫弟兄们留意他。害怕情有可原，可散播恐惧就绝不行。}

ccf4eaf79c49d3824693.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%brother% looks around at the men around the campfire. He then looks at the ground for a few minutes before exploding.%SPEECH_ON%Am I the only one here who is sane? How is no one else losing their farking minds over the dead walking the earth again? What the hell, where are the old gods in all this, they just farking gonna watch this shitshow?%SPEECH_OFF%The company tries to temper his fears, but he goes back to a ponderous silence of a man with too much to think about and no one willing, or wanting, to truly listen.}
ccf4eaf79c49d3824693.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%brother%看了看篝火旁的众人，接着低头盯着地面数分钟，突然爆发。%SPEECH_ON%这里只有我一个正常人吗？死人又在地上走了，怎么其他人他妈的都不发疯？到底怎么回事，旧神都在哪儿，难道就他妈看着这出烂戏？%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们试着安抚他，可他又陷入沉重的沉默。这个人有太多心事，却没有谁肯——或者想——真正听他说。}

697cf76a5161d24a2231.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]{Shouting and hollering, %other% drags %addict% into your tent, drops him, and draws his weapon on the man who looks around dazed and confused. You demand to know what is going on. %addict% slaps the weapon out of his face and tries to get up, but %other% kicks him back down.%SPEECH_ON%Fellas got it rich for the potions, captain. We can hardly keep him away from the stock.%SPEECH_OFF%%addict% slurs his words, grunts and pauses, then nods. He speaks clearly, like a drunkard trying to explain his crime to the constable.%SPEECH_ON%I do not have a problem, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You get up and check the man's forehead. It is cold, yet drawing sweat. %other% spits.%SPEECH_ON%He'll get a smidge violent if you confront him about the potions, sir. I think he's addicted to the damned things.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell the two to keep it on level to the best of their abilities. | %addict% comes into your tent with sweat on his brow and blackeyes.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, I thought I'd tell you this personally, you know, to take full responsibility.%SPEECH_OFF%He explains that he has become addicted to the potions. He says he'll do his best to manage. You nod and thank him for his honesty. The news worries you, but there is little recourse as of yet. | The men explain that %addict% has strongly taken to the potions and vials and flasks, the ones that carry spirits beyond just good ale and mead. You're not sure if it's from overuse or because he is having difficulty handling the struggles of being a sellsword. A few of the men are told to keep an eye on him. It's the best you can do for now.}
697cf76a5161d24a2231.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]{%other%大呼小叫地把%addict%拖进你的帐篷，扔在地上，拔出武器指着他。那人四下张望，神情恍惚，满脸迷茫。你厉声问出了什么事。%addict%拍开脸前的武器，想站起来，又被%other%一脚踹倒。%SPEECH_ON%团长，这家伙迷上药剂了。我们都快拦不住他往库存里钻了。%SPEECH_OFF%%addict%含糊地咕哝几句，哼了一声，停了停，才点头开口。他努力字字说清，像个醉汉正向治安官解释自己的罪行。%SPEECH_ON%我没什么问题，长官。%SPEECH_OFF%你起身摸了摸他的额头。皮肤冰凉，却冒着汗。%other%啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%长官，跟他提药剂的事，他就有点要动手的意思。我看，他是对那些该死的东西上瘾了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，叫两人尽量保持克制。 | %addict%走进你的帐篷，额头冒汗，眼圈发黑。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我想亲口告诉你，你知道，也好把责任全担起来。%SPEECH_OFF%他解释，自己已经对药剂上瘾，会尽力控制。你点头，感谢他的坦诚。消息让你担忧，可眼下也没什么办法。 | 弟兄们告诉你，%addict%已经离不开那些药剂、小瓶和酒壶了——里面可不只是麦酒、蜂蜜酒那种寻常的提神东西。你不清楚是用得太多，还是佣兵生涯的艰难让他难以承受。你叫几个人留心照看他。眼下，也只能如此。}

c02d7c15300039d0d18b.source: The road takes its toll, but can the men manage?
c02d7c15300039d0d18b.translation: 这一路代价不小，弟兄们撑得住吗？

e383866dc8a3d8ee10e3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]{You come to a commotion between %glutton% the glutton and a bucket. He's heaving into it so hard his back lurches like a cat and his hurls sound like an undead cow giving birth. When he lifts his head his face looks like a gourd, cheeks ballooned, his mouth still all agargle. %otherbrother% comes over.%SPEECH_ON%He ate the witch's apple.%SPEECH_OFF%Raising an eyebrow, you ask the glutton why he would do such a thing. Vomit strings wriggle from his wrist as he wipes his eyes.%SPEECH_ON%{Cause I'm always hungr-hurgh, uh, hungregghhh! | I don't rightfully know sir can't I just be in pain without having to validate my actiiiherrrghh! | Would I have to explain myself if I wasn't losing my gouerrrghhhh! | Cause you told me to eat healthy and it was an apperrrghghh!}%SPEECH_OFF%He pitches his head back into the bucket like a man who dropped a million crowns down a well. You tell the mercenaries to keep an eye on him until it's all out of his system, that is if it ever will be.}
e383866dc8a3d8ee10e3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]{你循着动静赶来，发现贪吃的%glutton%正与一只桶较劲。他吐得后背像猫一般弓起，声音活像死牛在产崽。抬头时，他脸胀得像个葫芦，两腮鼓起，嘴里仍咕噜翻涌。%otherbrother%走过来。%SPEECH_ON%他吃了女巫的苹果。%SPEECH_OFF%你扬起眉毛，问贪吃鬼为何要干这种事。他抬手擦眼，黏成丝的呕吐物从手腕上晃荡下来。%SPEECH_ON%{因为我总是饿——呕，呃，饿啊——呕！ | 长官，我真不知道，就不能让我安安静静难受一会儿，别逼我解释自己做的——呕！ | 我要不是吐得肠子都快出来了，还用得着解释——呕！ | 因为您叫我吃得健康点，而那是个苹——呕呕呕！}%SPEECH_OFF%他又把脑袋猛扎进桶，像有人把一百万克朗掉进井里。你叫弟兄们看住他，直到那东西全吐干净——但愿真能吐干净。}

7808ac82aa333926f492.source: %image%{%brother% growls and throws his arms wide like a man overtaken by a primal rage to shed blood.%SPEECH_ON%To hell with those savages! To hell with the greenskins! My life is unfinished so long as they are allowed to walk the same earth as me, my kin, or my children's kin! I will rip their tusks from their mouths, ravage their women, I don't know if they have women, don't know if I'd go near them if they did actually, but I'll ravage something and see to it an annihilation so fierce and thorough the old gods will come to me to borrow a tip!%SPEECH_OFF%}
7808ac82aa333926f492.translation: %image%{%brother%低吼着张开双臂，像被最原始的嗜血怒火吞没。%SPEECH_ON%让那些野蛮东西见鬼去！让绿皮见鬼去！只要它们还跟我、我的亲人、我的子孙踏着同一片土地，我这辈子就不算完！我要拔掉它们的獠牙，糟蹋它们的女人——我不知道它们有没有女人，就算有，我也不知道自己敢不敢靠近——反正我要狠狠干一场，把它们灭得干干净净，连旧神都得来向我请教！%SPEECH_OFF%}

7f9ca918b02ff4e16359.source: %image%{%brother% spits and runs his hand under his nose. His face scowls and he seems to be talking to himself as others look on.%SPEECH_ON%The old gods will have our arses if we permit the dead to walk again! You fellas can go to the hereafter thinking you did right in this world, but I ain't following the idle road cause by my sum that road goes straight to the hells. I'll see to it that I meet a righteous end, and I'll see to that by felling every godforsaken undead fark I see!%SPEECH_OFF%}
7f9ca918b02ff4e16359.translation: %image%{%brother%啐了一口，手背擦过鼻下。他皱着脸，在旁人的注视下像是自言自语。%SPEECH_ON%放任死人爬起来走路，旧神绝不会饶过我们！你们尽管去另一个世界，自以为这辈子没做错什么；可我不走袖手旁观那条路，依我看，那路直通地狱。我要死得堂堂正正，为此，我见到一个该死的亡灵混账，就要砍倒一个！%SPEECH_OFF%}

ac77ae25727aea90dee8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]%hedgeknight% the hedge knight walks up to an eating %refugee%. The former refugee sees the shadow loom over him and slowly turns about.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%The hedge knight snorts and spits a loogie about the size of a baby's arm. He snorts again.%SPEECH_ON%You ran from your home. You watched it burn and put yer back to the flames rather than fight them. This company is your home now. What stops you from running from the fire now?%SPEECH_OFF%
ac77ae25727aea90dee8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]流浪骑士%hedgeknight%走到正在吃饭的%refugee%面前。这个曾经的难民见阴影压来，慢慢转过头。%SPEECH_ON%有事？%SPEECH_OFF%流浪骑士吸了吸鼻子，吐出一口大得夸张的浓痰，又哼了一声。%SPEECH_ON%你从自己家里逃走了。眼看家园着火，你却背过身去，没想着扑灭它。如今战团就是你的家。下次起火，又有什么能拦住你逃跑？%SPEECH_OFF%

4ba27626639cb06fd4f4.source: You can deal with this yourselves.

4f96fc6b847488715f45.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]You step forward and tell the hedge knight to stuff it. The company ain't here to stroke his ego. Laughing, the bear of a man steps off.%SPEECH_ON%As you say, sir. Wouldn't want to get into a scrap with the company princess.%SPEECH_OFF%The company laughs, but the refugee only stares into is bowl of food like someone'd just spat in it.
4f96fc6b847488715f45.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]你上前叫流浪骑士闭嘴，战团不是来满足他那点虚荣心的。这个壮得像熊的男人笑着走开。%SPEECH_ON%遵命，团长。可不能跟咱们战团的小公主打起来。%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们哄笑起来，难民却只是盯着自己的饭碗，仿佛有人刚往里面啐了一口。

c7ffcc6ba61975888cf6.translation: 好吧，看来这就算了结了。

13be8118d7d854bb6a00.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]You don't intervene. The hedge knight continues.%SPEECH_ON%I've no pity for your pain. You understand?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, the refugee looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, but what pity does anyone have for yours?%SPEECH_OFF%%refugee%'s arm shoots forward so fast it flips the plate into the campfire. The fork sticks in the thigh of %hedgeknight% and %refugee% can't wrench it out no better than if it were stuck in a trunk of oak. The hedge knight grits and falls on the refugee and flattens him. His giant hands press the refugee's skull into the earth until the poor man's breathing dirt. The rest of the company stands up and backs off. You step forward, but %hedgeknight% holds his hand out before standing back up.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, little runner, alright. You've fight in you yet.%SPEECH_OFF%He retrieves the fork and holds it out. A drop of blood grooves between he tines.%SPEECH_ON%Whatcha eating? Oh yeah? Good. I'll double it with my portion. Come and sit.%SPEECH_OFF%
13be8118d7d854bb6a00.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你没有插手。流浪骑士继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%我可不心疼你受的苦，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%难民点点头，抬起眼。%SPEECH_ON%明白，可谁又会心疼你的苦呢？%SPEECH_OFF%%refugee%猛地伸出胳膊，快得把餐盘都掀进了火堆。叉子扎进%hedgeknight%的大腿，%refugee%使劲一拔，却像扎在橡木里一样，根本拔不动。流浪骑士咬紧牙，扑倒难民，将他死死压住。那双巨手把难民的脑袋按进泥土，直到可怜人连呼吸都在吞土。其他弟兄起身退开。你正上前，%hedgeknight%却抬手示意，自己站了起来。%SPEECH_ON%好了，小逃难的，好了。你倒还有股敢打的劲儿。%SPEECH_OFF%他拔出叉子，递出去，一滴血顺着叉齿流下。%SPEECH_ON%吃什么呢？哦，是吗？好，我这份也给你，吃个双份。过来坐。%SPEECH_OFF%

b4052cc2e6db09053345.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]%streetrat% steps forward. He points a finger at the hedge knight.%SPEECH_ON%You ain't got a lick of understanding of no flame nor fire.%SPEECH_OFF%Laughing, %hedgeknight% turns around and cracks his knuckles.%SPEECH_ON%Course I do. I AM the fire.%SPEECH_OFF%The lowborn defiantly crosses his arms.%SPEECH_ON%And we ain't the ash, but the wood itself. You're a whore for the noblemen, that's what you truly are. They pay you a high price and you go on with your strength and cruelty and do what they tell you to do. Like... like a whore...%SPEECH_OFF%Another sellsword holds up a finger.%SPEECH_ON%I think yer describing us in general. We're mercenaries.%SPEECH_OFF%And another adds.%SPEECH_ON%Did you just compare yerself to kindling?%SPEECH_OFF%%streetrat% rubs the back of his head.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah I'm gonna be honest the hedge knight scared me a bit there and I lost what I was going to say.%SPEECH_OFF%The company looks around before bursting into laughter and whatever animosity there was is gone.
b4052cc2e6db09053345.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]%streetrat%走上前，指着流浪骑士。%SPEECH_ON%你压根不懂什么火焰、什么燃烧。%SPEECH_OFF%%hedgeknight%笑着转过身，捏响指关节。%SPEECH_ON%当然懂，我就是那把火。%SPEECH_OFF%这个出身卑微的人倔强地抱起双臂。%SPEECH_ON%而我们不是灰，是木头本身。你其实就是贵族养的婊子。他们出高价，你就仗着力气和残忍，乖乖按他们吩咐办事。就像……就像个婊子……%SPEECH_OFF%另一个佣兵竖起手指。%SPEECH_ON%我看你说的是咱们所有人吧，咱们本来就是佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%又一个接话。%SPEECH_ON%你刚才是不是把自己比作柴火了？%SPEECH_OFF%%streetrat%摸了摸后脑勺。%SPEECH_ON%说实话，刚才流浪骑士有点吓着我，我忘了本来想说什么。%SPEECH_OFF%众人面面相觑，随即爆发出大笑，方才那点敌意就此消散。

c1093eaeec308049875b.source: What were we fighting about again?
c1093eaeec308049875b.translation: 咱们刚才到底在争什么来着？

7d51e88da2c266fa7604.source: Wait. %streetrat%, you look like you have something to say?

b039a328acabfb19564b.source: Got humiliated in front of the company
b039a328acabfb19564b.translation: 当着全团的面受了羞辱

4de906f834496ac41a8f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{While walking about the shops of %townname%, you feel a tug at your sleeve. You turn to find a child there with a face smeared black with two bright white eyes staring out. He asks if you know anything about swords. You gesture toward the one you got sheathed at your side. He claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Great! I work for a blacksmith yonder, but he's away fetching iron ingots. He told me to keep watch of this special sword he was making, but it, uh, it fell. And broke. Fell on its own and broke on its own. Will you help me put it back together?%SPEECH_OFF%}
4de906f834496ac41a8f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你正逛着%townname%的店铺，忽然有人拽你的袖子。回头一看，是个满脸煤黑的孩子，两只眼睛亮得发白。他问你懂不懂剑，你示意了一下腰间佩剑。他拍起手来。%SPEECH_ON%太好了！我在那边的铁匠铺干活，师傅去取铁锭了。他让我看着一把正在打造的特别的剑，可它……呃，掉了，还断了。自己掉的，自己断的。你能帮我把它拼回去吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

b354fb902a0d3ad02fea.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You tell the kid to piss off. Probably a scheming little pickpocket anyhow. Speaking of which, you check your pockets to ensure everything is still there.}
b354fb902a0d3ad02fea.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你叫孩子滚开，多半又是个耍花招的小扒手。想到这里，你摸了摸口袋，确认东西一件没少。}

ef2f08b352f9e36dd7ad.source: What a relief, nothing seems to be missing.

a1f64a3b4cb8e9a4f01e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{%other% is fetched to go help the kid. He helps place the sword's handle and steel together and the kid works his magic on his own, easily mending the sword back into one piece. You're amazed by his skill and wonder how good the blacksmith himself must be if this is his apprentice. After the work is done, the boy offers to fix some of the weapons for the %companyname% which you happily accept.}
a1f64a3b4cb8e9a4f01e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你叫来%other%帮孩子的忙。他帮着把剑柄和剑身对齐，孩子独自施展手艺，轻轻松松便将断剑修复如初。你惊叹于他的本事，不禁想：学徒尚且如此，铁匠本人又该有多厉害？完工后，男孩主动提出替%companyname%修几件武器，你欣然答应。}

24a2677126ab005078da.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{%other% sighs after you ask that he go help the kid with his duties. He lazily steps over to the blacksmith's anvil which is shaped like a molar as it rests on thin iron stilts. The blacksmith's goods are hanging from ad hoc walls manufactured out of old iron fences, the spokes curved outward to help catch the metalworks. The kid claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Now don't touch nothing else, just help me with this.%SPEECH_OFF% %other% turns 'round with confusion and mid-sentence knocks the anvil's leg out. It starts to crumple sideways and the kid rushes to catch it if only to stem the tide of trouble which has beset his day. The insane weight pastes him flat against the cobblestones, his limbs briefly stretched up like a cricket smooshed beneath a thumb. You see this all from a distance and whistle for the mercenary to head back before there's trouble. He makes his escape just as a few passersby start to take notice. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%We didn't do nothing, right sir?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.}
24a2677126ab005078da.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你叫%other%去帮孩子干活，他叹口气，懒洋洋地走向铁匠的砧台。那铁砧像颗大臼齿，靠几根细铁腿撑着。铺里的货物挂在旧铁栅栏拼成的临时墙上，栏杆被掰弯朝外，充作挂钩。孩子拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%别碰其他东西，就帮我弄这个。%SPEECH_OFF% %other%疑惑地转身，话说到一半，却撞掉了铁砧的一条腿。铁砧开始向旁倾倒，孩子急忙去扶，像是还想挽救这倒霉透顶的一天。沉重的铁块将他压在石板路上，四肢短暂地翘起，像拇指下被按扁的蟋蟀。你在远处看着这一切，赶紧吹口哨，叫佣兵趁惹出麻烦前回来。几个路人才刚注意到，他便已脱身。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%长官，咱们什么也没干，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。}

a3687c8fc435636e89c4.source: You should probably stay low for awhile.

ce541acb953ad9c542e6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{Your suspicions about the juggler volunteering to be sent to help are confirmed true as you soon see him throwing daggers and axes into the air and wowing the public at large. Seeing the crowds gather, he places a hat upon the cobblestones and continues the act. They throw plenty of coin in, and the applause is deafening as he plays out his final act of five maces at the same time. Bowing, he picks up the hat and rushes back over.%SPEECH_ON%A fine day's work, aye sir?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask about the boy's broken sword. He clears the sweat from his brow.%SPEECH_ON%What you say, sir? Get back with the company? Aye sir, I'll get back with the company now.%SPEECH_OFF%Pursing your lips, you look back toward the smithery to see the boy bent over an anvil and taking a sound leather hiding from the returned blacksmith.}
ce541acb953ad9c542e6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{杂耍艺人主动请缨时，你就怀疑他另有所图。果不其然，没一会儿，他便把匕首和斧头抛向半空，惹得路人惊叹连连。眼看观众越聚越多，他把帽子放在石板路上，继续卖弄本事。钱币纷纷落入帽中，最后一手同时抛接五柄钉头锤，更赢得震耳欲聋的掌声。他鞠躬谢幕，拾起帽子，快步跑回来。%SPEECH_ON%长官，今天这活儿干得不错吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，问那孩子的断剑修得如何。他抹去额头的汗。%SPEECH_ON%您说什么，长官？归队？是，长官，我这就归队。%SPEECH_OFF%你抿着嘴，回头望向铁匠铺。那孩子正趴在铁砧上，被回来的铁匠拿皮带狠狠抽打。}

bbe67b10375e9d130579.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{%apprentice% the young apprentice is tasked with helping the kid. He saunters over to the smithy and starts helping the kid. But he does more than just help: he fashions the sword back together in such a way that is stronger than it was to begin with. The blacksmith returns to find the handiwork and demands to know how to do it, almost begging for insight. %apprentice% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%You give me this sword and I'll give you the secret my meister passed down to me.%SPEECH_OFF%You didn't even know the apprentice knew how to do any of this, but the lad is nothing if not a sponge in boots. A trade is made with the blacksmith and both parties leave more than happy.}
bbe67b10375e9d130579.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你让年轻的学徒%apprentice%去帮那孩子。他晃悠着走到铁砧旁，搭了把手。但他做的远不止帮忙：他将断剑重新锻接好，竟让它比原先还结实。铁匠回来看到这手艺，非要问出其中的诀窍，几乎是在苦苦央求。%apprentice%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%这把剑归我，我就把师傅传给我的秘诀告诉你。%SPEECH_OFF%你都不知道这小子还有这番本事，不过他学起东西来，确实像海绵吸水一样快。铁匠答应了这桩交换，双方都心满意足。}

cf91a5d5d5d439705f7d.translation: 我还以为你学的是编篮子？

faca22067eb4eb5b011c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You ask %killer% the murderer to help the kid. The man obliges with a smile to which the kid seems intuitively offended by. He takes a few steps back and waves the help away.%SPEECH_ON%No sir, I think I'm quite alright. Th-thank you. After all, a man's gotta do what a man's gotta do, right?%SPEECH_OFF%The killer smiles, crouches, and puts a thumb to the kid's cheek and leaves it laying there.%SPEECH_ON%That's right, boy. That's right. A man does what he needs.%SPEECH_OFF%Now you're offended and ask %killer% to go count inventory. He rubs the lad's hair and then rises and departs. The kid runs off, but quickly returns with a dagger.%SPEECH_ON%H-here, take this. Keep that fella all the hells away from me, please sir. Got it? I want no business with that man and would sooner seek a blacksmith's hiding than see him ever again. You take the weapon, you keep him away. Deal? Deal, yeah?
