Take it!%SPEECH_OFF%You measure that the kid's never bargained in his life, that or this is the first time he's felt his life on the line. Either way, you accept the dagger. The kid sighs in relief before returning to the smithy, there working away, and there always keeping an eye over his shoulder.}
faca22067eb4eb5b011c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你叫杀人犯%killer%去帮帮那孩子。他微笑着答应，孩子却仿佛本能地察觉到那笑容不对，连退几步，摆手谢绝。%SPEECH_ON%不用了，先生，我自己应该能行。谢、谢谢。毕竟，男人总得做自己该做的事，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%杀人犯笑着蹲下，用拇指贴住孩子的脸颊，就那么停在那里。%SPEECH_ON%没错，孩子，没错。男人总要做自己需要做的事。%SPEECH_OFF%这下连你都觉得不对劲了，叫%killer%去清点库存。他揉了揉男孩的头发，起身走开。孩子跑走了，却很快拿着一把匕首回来。%SPEECH_ON%给、给你。把那家伙带得远远的，求你了，先生。明白吗？我不想跟那人有任何瓜葛，宁可挨铁匠一顿打，也不想再见到他。你拿走武器，别让他靠近。成交？成交了吧？拿着！%SPEECH_OFF%你估摸着，这孩子不是一辈子都没谈过价，就是头一次觉得自己性命攸关。无论如何，你收下了匕首。孩子如释重负地叹了口气，回到铁匠铺干活，却始终不忘回头张望。}

2195371d738897a38f04.source: You're a killer with the kid, %killer%.

f05cc648d2a2b7bc1807.source: Looks like %juggler% wants to help you.

973c2ab969ec95e486c7.source: Looks like %apprentice% wants to help you.

c70495e806d47d30237f.source: Looks like %killer% wants to help you.

b592f5e07cae93cba6c3.source: Basked in the admiration of a crowd

897bb58782de59c2ef5e.source: Brought his blacksmithing skills to bear
897bb58782de59c2ef5e.translation: 派上了自己的锻造本领

5ff6440d0490121c3e7e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_116.png[/img]{A golden man the size of a castle sits atop his stone throne with such august stature it seems even he, as inanimate as he is, should rule the land. And perhaps the world would be better for it, this nonspeaking entity with such awesome presence would make a finer ruler than the lot of skunks you constantly run into. The bulk of the statue rests upon an enormous disc made of spiraling square stones. Were they coffins it'd take all of two bricks to store the %companyname% whole. %randombrother% tilts his helm up.%SPEECH_ON%If it ain't the biggest thing I ever seen I don't know what is.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother2% smirks and makes a reach for the sellsword's crotch.%SPEECH_ON%I thought the womenfolk said that little worm was the biggest thing to ever be seen!%SPEECH_OFF%As the company laughs, you step forward and look up. You're not much for kneeling, but you feel the urge here. The statue's staring out at the world with firm authority, and its hands are out at the sides, one upon a sword staked into the earth, and the other supinated as though to weigh justice herself. You nod at the golden sheen present before you. That there is not a single scratch of a wouldbe robber suggests its austere presence still has some ethereal grip on the world. But that doesn't make sense. Any smart man would be nicking a fair share from the statue's shins alone. A few mercenaries ask if they can have a stab at collecting some gold for themselves.}
5ff6440d0490121c3e7e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_116.png[/img]{一尊城堡般巨大的金色人像端坐石制王座，仪态如此庄严，仿佛即便毫无生气，也理应统治这片土地。说不定那样还更好些：这位一言不发、威势惊人的统治者，总比你时常碰上的那些臭鼬强。巨像坐落在庞大的圆形石台上，方石盘旋铺砌。若将这些石块当成棺材，只需两块，就装得下整个%companyname%。%randombrother%把头盔往上抬了抬。%SPEECH_ON%这要还不是我见过最大的东西，那我可真不知道什么才算了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother2%坏笑着，伸手去抓那佣兵的裤裆。%SPEECH_ON%我还以为，女人们说你这条小虫子，才是她们见过最大的东西呢！%SPEECH_OFF%战团哄笑时，你走上前，仰头望去。你素来不爱跪拜，此刻却生出了这样的冲动。雕像以坚定威严的目光凝视世间，双手伸在身侧，一只扶着插入大地的剑，另一只掌心向上，仿佛要掂量正义本身。面对眼前的金光，你微微点头。巨像身上连一道贪财者留下的刮痕都没有，说明这肃穆的形象，似乎仍以某种无形力量影响着世间。可这又说不通，任何聪明人单从它的小腿上，便能凿走不少金子。几个佣兵问，能不能让他们试着给自己弄点黄金。}

20b84d449b3aafaf8024.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_116.png[/img]{The statue is so huge perhaps it scared off the lesser scapegraces by superstition alone. You've no reason to let a good thing go, like a nearly endless pile of gold shaped into something 'pretty.' To hell with history and the artistry. You tell the men to have it. They leap to the task with the tools available, but the second %randombrother% makes contact he falls limp and slumps against the statue. Another mercenary goes to help him, brushes the enormous toe there, and collapses atop the sellsword. Just as the company begins to panic, the two mercenaries bolt back to their feet and start screaming about amazing sights, sights beyond this world, sights of the future itself!

 Invigorated by this, the company gladly runs themselves into the statue, the lot banging against its giant toes and falling backward like mimes unexpectedly finding a very real wall. It's the most ridiculous thing you've ever seen, but each man springs back to his feet spilling out fantastic stories. You shrug and walk up to the statue yourself, standing before the big toe with its big toenail. The men urge you forward. Sighing, you put your hand out and touch the toenail. Nothing. Nothing happens. You fist the gap between the nail and golden flesh. You angrily put both hands to the toe like it owes you money. Nothing. Well then. Looks like you've riches to harvest. You draw your sword out...}
20b84d449b3aafaf8024.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_116.png[/img]{雕像如此巨大，也许光凭迷信，就吓退了那些胆小的无赖。你没理由放过这种好事：近乎无穷的黄金，不过被塑成了个“好看”的东西。历史与艺术都见鬼去吧。你叫弟兄们动手，他们立刻操起现有的工具，可%randombrother%刚一碰到雕像，便浑身一软，瘫倒在它身上。另一个佣兵前去搀扶，擦到那根巨大的脚趾，也倒在了同伴身上。战团刚要惊慌，两人却猛地跳起，嚷着自己看见了奇观，看见了世外之景，甚至看见了未来！

受此鼓舞，弟兄们兴冲冲地往雕像上撞，一个个碰上巨趾，向后栽倒，像哑剧演员演着演着，突然撞见一堵真墙。这是你见过最荒唐的景象，可每个人爬起来，都讲出一番不可思议的见闻。你耸耸肩，也走到雕像跟前，站在巨大的脚拇趾和巨大的趾甲前。弟兄们催你试试。你叹口气，伸手摸上趾甲。没有动静，什么也没发生。你用拳头顶了顶趾甲与金色皮肉之间的缝隙，又气恼地把双手按在脚趾上，仿佛它欠了你的钱。仍然没反应。好吧，看来这笔财富正等着你来收取。你拔出了剑……}

c921565651b112268d46.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_116.png[/img]{You swing the sword but the second steel touches gold the sheen of the world flashes over you as though you'd struck the sun itself and drew blood. The sword continues on into the darkness like a star across the night sky and it cuts a world of its own into reality, as though you'd slashed the magician's cloth off his trick, revealing a room with pillared corners and beautiful silk curtains, and the sword continues on until it slams against a spear shaft. You look down to see a man with gilded armor and red eyes holding his guard with a grimace. He slides across the tiled floor to his right and lets your momentum fall to the ground, then he twirls the spear around his back and strikes it forward. You throw your arm wide and close rank with the killer, catching the spear shaft beneath your armpit and driving forward to stab him just beneath his pauldron, driving the sword into the heart. The man's red eyes drain to a pure white and he goes limp and slides right off the steel.

 As he clatters to the ground, you quickly look around. Against the far wall stands an enormous bed with corners of marble, each statue shaped to a woman or man, each of them adorned submissively to what looks like a rising sun. There's an elderly man in the bed who is looking at you. Bearded. Eyes dim, weathered. Familiarity in his stare. He smiles, but it quickly fades. He yells, but you don't understand the words. A shadow slides across the room and you wheel around to see a large knight with fire in his eyes bearing down with a two-hander.}
c921565651b112268d46.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_116.png[/img]{你挥剑斩下，可钢刃触及黄金的瞬间，整个世界的光泽便朝你闪耀而来，仿佛你砍中了太阳，令它流血。剑锋继续划入黑暗，如星辰掠过夜空，在现实中劈出另一个世界，仿佛一剑挑落了魔术师遮掩把戏的布。眼前是一间四角立柱、垂着华美丝帘的房间，剑仍向前，直到重重撞上一杆长矛。你低头望去，一个身披镀金盔甲、双眼赤红的男人正咬牙招架。他向右滑过砖地，让你的冲势落空，随即将长矛绕过背后，旋转刺来。你张开手臂，贴近这名杀手，将矛杆夹在腋下，继续向前，剑尖从他肩甲下刺入，直贯心脏。那双红眼褪成纯白，他浑身瘫软，从剑刃上滑落。

 他铿锵倒地，你迅速环顾四周。远墙边立着一张巨床，四角是大理石雕像，或男或女，全都以臣服之姿装点着一轮仿佛正在升起的太阳。床上躺着一位老人，正望着你。他留着胡须，双眼黯淡，饱经风霜，目光中透着熟悉。他笑了笑，笑意却很快消失，随后大喊起来，可你听不懂那些话。一道阴影掠过房间。你猛然转身，只见一个高大的骑士眼中燃着火光，双手大剑迎面劈下。}

9484af476b6fcba9a1f6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_116.png[/img]{You step back and flip your sword crosswise and crouch at the knees to brace for impact. The killer's two-hander slams against your sword and just like that the world snaps away and still frozen in a parry you can feel the issuance of time and space fly by your sides like a plow wind, and ungodly amounts of suffering, screaming, living and dying, and in the far distance a speck of light that fast approaches until you arrive back in your body and your sword hits the statue and swings backward so hard it flies out of your hands and sails through the air until stabbing into the earth with an earthen chunk. The men look about one another. You go and fetch your sword.%SPEECH_ON%I think you broke it, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%Says %randombrother% as he gets handsy with the pinky toe. You tell him and the rest of the men to pack their things, it's time to leave this place. Looking at the statue, you see that it is all rusted bronze now. You think to ask one of the mercenaries if it had been gold earlier, but you already know the answer to that. Instead, you stare at the head of the statue. At the face. At the very familiar face.}
9484af476b6fcba9a1f6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_116.png[/img]{你后退一步，横过剑身，屈膝稳住架势，准备承受撞击。杀手的双手剑重重砸在你的剑上，刹那间，整个世界骤然抽离。你仍凝固在格挡的姿势中，感觉时间与空间如狂风般从两侧掠过，裹挟着难以想象的苦难、尖叫、生与死。远方有一点光，飞快逼近，直到你重新回到自己的身体。你的剑撞上雕像，猛地向后弹去，力道大得让它脱手而出，飞过半空，噗地扎进泥土。弟兄们面面相觑。你走过去取回剑。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我看你把它打坏了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%一边说，一边摸弄着雕像的小脚趾。你叫他和其他人收好东西，该离开这里了。再看雕像，如今通体都是生锈的青铜。你本想问个佣兵，它先前是不是金色的，可你早已知道答案。于是，你只是盯着雕像的头。盯着那张脸。那张无比熟悉的脸。}

ebbf983fd06c9ec83aeb.source: Impressed by a magnificent statue of old
ebbf983fd06c9ec83aeb.translation: 为宏伟的古代雕像所震撼

1369e319b42172854b29.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{Only half of the temple's entrance is visible, the rest long since sunk into the earth as though unsure whether to be coffin or mausoleum. Along a visible frieze you can see a stony relief of tables being thrown and monied men running from what looks like an armored skeleton with a whip. A few of the mercenaries seem uncomfortable with the idea of going in, but you've the notion that others have felt that way as well and have thus left the place unmolested.

 You take out a torch and enter with a sellsword's spirit and robber's resolve. After gathering supplies, you crouch and enter the temple by slinging your legs over the earth and jumping into the steps below. The clap of your boots snickers into the marbled halls and you wave the torch before you as if to watch the echoes go. Looking back, the light between the shelf of earth and the temple top silhouetting your company as though they were a throng of sextons satisfied at their work. %volunteer% shakes his head and says he's coming with. The rest of the company mutually agrees to keep watch.}
1369e319b42172854b29.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{神殿的入口只有一半露在外面，其余部分早已沉入地下，仿佛还没想好自己究竟该做棺材还是陵墓。露出的饰带上刻着石雕：桌子被掀翻，富人们四散奔逃，身后追着的东西像是一具披甲的骷髅，手里挥着鞭子。几个佣兵一听要进去就面露不安，但你觉得，旁人多半也曾如此，所以这里才一直无人动过。

 你取出火把，准备带着佣兵的胆气、盗贼的决心进去探一探。收拾好物资后，你弯下身，把腿跨过积土，跳到下方的台阶上，钻进神殿。靴子落地的脆响在大理石厅堂间窜动，你将火把在面前一晃，仿佛想看清回声的去向。回头望去，积土与殿顶之间透入的光，将战团映成一排剪影，像一群刚办完丧事、对活计颇为满意的墓园看守。%volunteer%摇摇头，说他要一起进去。其余弟兄则一致同意留在外面放哨。}

6b0e0d33f8fd286217c4.source: Forget those ruins, we're moving on.
6b0e0d33f8fd286217c4.translation: 别管那些遗迹了，继续走。

397ca4d888d4e67945bf.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{The sides of the halls are blanketed in military mosaics so large they're more fit to a whole campaign than any single battle. One parcel in particular stretches seemingly forever down the hall, a scene of armored men running roughshod over what looks like a barbarian horde so thick in number they lose humanity and begin to look indiscernible from bugs. Your torch bulbs and dims in the dark, the light bringing an artist's battlefield to an orangish life and in the corners you find depictions of righteous torture and outrage. Between the lockstep forces and the disassembled mob, it looks like order and chaos have come to clash, and while order is surely set to win, it is chaos itself which is driving the way to victory.

 %volunteer% whistles. You look to see his torch flaring in the distance like an ignis fatuus. You run over to find him holding a vial with a strange liquid inside. The sellsword swings his torch to an alcove in the wall. A marbled post hold the center and there's a throng of skeletons at its base.%SPEECH_ON%I found the vial on the pedestal there. And I see two more like it yonder, but they're behind gates.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask the sellsword why he didn't tell you about the bodies. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%They ain't breathing, then I ain't caring. You wanna make a try for the other two flasks or no?%SPEECH_OFF%}
397ca4d888d4e67945bf.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{厅堂两侧铺满战争题材的镶嵌画，规模宏大得足以记录整场战役，而非一场交锋。尤其有一幅，沿着走廊延伸，仿佛没有尽头：披甲的士兵肆意践踏一大群蛮族，后者密集得失去了人的模样，几乎与虫群无异。火把在黑暗里忽明忽暗，将画中战场映成一片仿佛活过来的橙红。画面角落里，还有以正义之名施加的折磨与暴行。整齐划一的军阵，与支离破碎的乌合之众，恰如秩序和混乱迎面相撞。可尽管胜利显然属于秩序，真正将它推向胜利的，却正是混乱本身。

 %volunteer%吹了声口哨。你望过去，看见远处他的火把像鬼火般闪耀。你跑到近前，发现他正拿着一只装有奇怪液体的小瓶。佣兵把火把朝墙上的凹室一晃，中央立着一根大理石柱，柱脚堆满骷髅。%SPEECH_ON%小瓶是从那座台子上拿的。那边还看见两只一样的，不过都隔着闸门。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，他怎么没先提这些尸骨。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%不喘气的东西，我就懒得管。那另外两瓶，你到底想不想试着拿？%SPEECH_OFF%}

aad52bf3e7eddcf2e870.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{You find the next vial set behind a chest-high gate. The flask itself is grasped by the stone claw of a wingless gargoyle hanging down from the ceiling. There are a few glyphs on a slab in front of the gate, but the words are ancient and even if they weren't you're not sure how well you'd be able to read them anyway. Suddenly, a voice booms overhead.%SPEECH_ON%A flock of birds are in a field when a hunter comes along. The hunter draws an arrow and yells out as though in pain. A few birds fly up. The hunter kills them. More birds fly up, the hunter kills them just as well and he begins to cry as he collects their bodies. More birds fly at the sound of him. The hunter's crying and killing. He can hardly nock arrows fast enough and he has to pause to wipe his eyes. One bird turns to his friend and says he should go console the man. What does the bird's friend say in return?%SPEECH_OFF%}
aad52bf3e7eddcf2e870.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{你在一道齐胸高的栅门后找到下一只药瓶。它被一只无翼石像鬼的石爪攥着，那石像鬼倒悬在天花板上。门前石板刻着几行符文，但文字太古老了。就算不古老，你也不敢说自己能认出多少。忽然，头顶响起洪亮的声音。%SPEECH_ON%一群鸟待在田里，一个猎人走了过来。他抽出箭，像受了伤似的大喊。几只鸟惊飞，他便将它们射杀。更多鸟飞起，他照样射杀，一边收拾鸟尸，一边流泪。又有鸟听见动静飞起来。猎人边哭边杀，忙得搭箭都来不及，还得停下来擦眼泪。一只鸟转头对朋友说，自己该去安慰这个人。它的朋友会怎么回答？%SPEECH_OFF%}

ee1ff3f433727fd26c29.source: Nevermind his tears, watch his hands!
ee1ff3f433727fd26c29.translation: 别管他的眼泪，盯住他的手！

9110e34e688af71454eb.source: From the brink a broken man must be saved.
9110e34e688af71454eb.translation: 须从绝境中，救回一个支离破碎的人。

9664cbc7b6bf52e979fe.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{The voice is silent for a moment, then returns.%SPEECH_ON%Correct!%SPEECH_OFF%Jolting with ancient engineering, the gate slides down and the gargoyle lowers within arm's reach, the vial's rigid guardian staring with stoic aplomb. You grab the vial and hold it close as though the monstrous stonework might come alive to take it back. You wave your torch around and demand to know who is speaking. The voice laughs, but that is all. %volunteer% looks at you and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Well, we got the treasure did we not? No harm in trying for another.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9664cbc7b6bf52e979fe.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{那声音沉默片刻，再次响起。%SPEECH_ON%答对了！%SPEECH_OFF%古老机关震动，闸门滑落，石像鬼降到触手可及之处。这位药瓶的石质守卫依旧镇定地凝视着前方。你拿起药瓶，紧紧护在怀里，仿佛那怪异石雕随时会活过来夺走它。你挥动火把，厉声追问究竟是谁在说话。回应只有笑声。%volunteer%看着你，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%反正宝贝到手了，不是吗？再试一次也无妨。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f08c8bba0815633208b4.source: Seems dangerous. Let's get out now.

d3a286b731ef6b1564ac.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{You shake your head no. The first vial was circumstance, and probably the end result of another robber's failure. You were lucky. The second vial comes attached with a voice that asks you nonsensical shite. That's enough. You order %volunteer% out of the temple and you quickly depart with the two vials and the common sense to find happiness in that alone.

 Outside, you find the %companyname% kicking and poking at a corpse still freshly leaking. They say the man came running out of the temple while you were down there. One mercenary produces a scrap of paper. Drawings on it depict the vials, and they show the liquids expunging wiedergangers like molten metal poured on an ant. %volunteer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Well I guess that explains what these are for.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask if the dead fella had anything else on him. Another sellsword shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%He walked up out where you went in. He said 'an armed man, a steel companion, for you I have a riddle', and then I cut him down. He seemed a dangerous sort.%SPEECH_OFF%}
d3a286b731ef6b1564ac.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{你摇头拒绝。第一只药瓶是碰巧捡到的，多半还是另一个盗贼失手后留下的，你只是走运。第二只却附带一个声音，专问些莫名其妙的蠢问题。够了。你命令%volunteer%离开神殿，带着两只药瓶迅速退出，也算还有点见好就收的理智。

外面，%companyname%的弟兄正踢弄一具还在淌血的尸体。他们说，你在底下时，这人从神殿里跑了出来。一个佣兵拿出纸片，上面画着药瓶，瓶中液体将行尸消融，像熔化的金属浇在蚂蚁身上。%volunteer%笑道。%SPEECH_ON%这下知道它们干什么用了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，问死者身上还有没有别的东西。另一个佣兵耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%他从您进去的地方走出来，说什么“武装的人，钢铁的同伴，我有一道谜语给你”，我就把他砍了。看着不像善类。%SPEECH_OFF%}

7bcbe09bf8ef63c2fcce.source: Probably the best way to answer a riddle yet.
7bcbe09bf8ef63c2fcce.translation: 这大概是解谜最痛快的办法了。

dc2b5ac24eeb8ac3925e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{The last vial is behind another gate, an unsettling one to look at just by an architectural standpoint. There are not mere stone bars here, but twisted iron spires scarred with scoria and slag, and the gate is not at chest level, but at your shins. The vial itself is on a further rise, meaning you'd have to reach under the wall and then up again to get it. The voice returns.%SPEECH_ON%From me all comes to being, from me all shall be in the end. When man crosses the earth, I follow in his footsteps.%SPEECH_OFF%You stand in the silence and look over at %volunteer%. He shrugs.}
dc2b5ac24eeb8ac3925e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{最后一只小瓶在另一道栅门后。光看这门的构造，就让人心里发毛。这里用的不是普通石栏，而是扭曲的铁尖柱，表面结满熔渣与炉渣。门也不在齐胸处，而低及胫骨。小瓶却放在更深处的一块高台上，你得先从墙下伸手进去，再向上探，才够得着。那个声音又响起来。%SPEECH_ON%万物由我而生，终亦归于我。人行于大地，我便随其足迹。%SPEECH_OFF%你站在寂静中，转头看向%volunteer%。他耸了耸肩。}

2132040b2881f8eed0ef.source: Help me kick in that gate, %volunteer%!

fbd7e2ca843788ab781a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{As soon as the word leaves your lips the gate jolts up. You pensively stare at the remaining gap. %volunteer% crouches down and slings his arm under the gateway's top and gets up at the vial. His fingers scrape its glass while the gate's spires rattle in their catches like a bear reluctantly letting someone brush its teeth. The man finally pinches the vial between two fingers and scissor-flips it into the safe embrace of his palm. He stands up and hands it over.%SPEECH_ON%Simple enough, eh?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod but then turn around with your torch and yell out, demanding to know who was talking. There is no answer. A brief search in the darkness turns up no hidey-holes or dugouts, but you do find scraps and notes with drawings on them. The pages seem to indicate the vials are capable of killing wiedergangers with but a single touch of the liquid within each flask. There is also a sticky paper with a crudely drawn woman on it. Whoever was here, you don't care. You take the vials back out and return to the %companyname%. They draw swords at the sound of you, then sheepishly sheathe them once they see your face.%SPEECH_ON%Sorry captain, thought ya a mite dead. And walking. A walking dead man.%SPEECH_OFF%}
fbd7e2ca843788ab781a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{话刚出口，闸门便猛地抬起。你若有所思地盯着余下的缝隙。%volunteer%蹲下来，把胳膊伸进门楣下方，向上够那只小瓶。他的指尖刮过玻璃，闸门的尖齿在卡槽里咯咯晃动，仿佛一头不情不愿让人刷牙的熊。终于，他用两根手指夹住小瓶，灵巧地一转，把瓶子稳稳翻进掌心。随后他站起来，将它递给你。%SPEECH_ON%挺简单的，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，却又举着火把转过身，大声质问方才是谁在说话。无人应答。你在黑暗里略作搜寻，没有找到暗穴或藏身之处，却发现了一些画着图的碎纸和笔记。纸上的内容似乎表明，只要让行尸沾上一滴瓶中液体，就能将其杀死。此外，还有一张黏糊糊的纸，上面粗陋地画着一个女人。无论先前是谁待在这里，你都没兴趣追究了。你带着小瓶走出去，回到%companyname%身边。他们听见动静便拔出剑，待看清你的脸，又讪讪地收了回去。%SPEECH_ON%抱歉，团长，还以为你咽了气，又爬起来了。就是那种会走路的死人。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a0aa331110ffc2f70218.source: Well, we got vials for just that problem now.
a0aa331110ffc2f70218.translation: 正好，这些药瓶能治这毛病。

da0e8a4ea7f82b2a0ea5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{As soon as the word leaves your lips the gate jolts up. You pensively stare at the remaining gap. %volunteer% crouches down and slings his arm under the gateway's top and gets up at the vial. His fingers scrape its glass while the gate's spires rattle in their catches. The voice suddenly booms back in.%SPEECH_ON%G-go fark myself? How about fark you, uh, pal!%SPEECH_OFF%With that, the gate's catch fails and its tips sink down and spear %volunteer%'s arm. The man yells out and you drop to your knees and yank the gate back up. It's heavier than expected and when you let go it slams with unnerving finality, a strip of the sellsword's arm here, a gush of his veins there. You wrap the wound and help the man toward the exit, all the while waving the torch around to ward off any would be ambush. However, while heading out, you pause and look at the skeleton's you found beside the first flask. You take a drop from the vial and touch it to your fingertips. No response. You then put your finger on one of the bones and it sizzles and smokes. %volunteer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%That's why you're captain, sir. Intuition like that can take you far!%SPEECH_OFF%You never hear the mysterious voice again and, not wanting to sound insane, make no reference of the riddler to the %companyname%.

 %volunteer%'s wounds won't be the end of him. Tis but a small price to pay for the ancient vials.}
da0e8a4ea7f82b2a0ea5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{话刚出口，闸门便猛地抬起。你若有所思地盯着余下的缝隙。%volunteer%蹲下来，把胳膊伸进门楣下方，向上够那只小瓶。他的指尖刮过玻璃，闸门的尖齿在卡槽里咯咯晃动。那个声音突然又轰然响起。%SPEECH_ON%让、让我滚蛋？你才给我滚蛋，呃，老兄！%SPEECH_OFF%话音一落，闸门的卡榫便脱开，尖齿直坠而下，刺穿了%volunteer%的胳膊。他惨叫起来，你跪倒在地，拼命把闸门往上拉。它比想象中更沉，等你松手时，又轰然砸下，声音叫人心惊。佣兵的胳膊少了一条皮肉，血管里鲜血直涌。你替他包扎伤口，扶着他走向出口，一路挥着火把，提防可能的伏击。不过，离开时，你在第一只小瓶旁的骸骨前停了下来。你取一滴瓶中液体，沾在指尖，没有反应；再把手指碰上一根骨头，骨头便嘶嘶作响，冒起烟来。%volunteer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%难怪你是团长，长官。有这份直觉，往后肯定大有作为！%SPEECH_OFF%你再也没听见那个神秘的声音，也不想让人觉得自己疯了，便没向%companyname%提起那个出谜语的家伙。

 %volunteer%的伤不至于致命。能换来这些古老药瓶，这点代价还算值得。}

86ff33c6b0f1c50930e6.source: Glad someone else paid that price, though.
86ff33c6b0f1c50930e6.translation: 好在，付出代价的不是我们。

1aae1d47d781a959daa8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{You've had enough of this shit. If the voice is that of an ancient or that of some jester, you might as well find out fully. You take a step back and smash the gate with your boot. The rails crank into chevrons at the first strike, and snap apart on the second. Briefly, and rather squeakily, the voice returns.%SPEECH_ON%H-hey! You can't do that!%SPEECH_OFF%Clearing out the rusted pieces and the sharp spires, you crouch to look at the vial. Just then you see a man jumping down into the vial's tiny room. He lands like a baby deer falling off a cliff and knocks the flask from its hold. You watch it tumble to the floor with a pitiful, glassy crash. You grab the man by his foot and drag him out through the spines of the gate and all. He holds shaking hands before himself as %volunteer% presses a sword against his throat.%SPEECH_ON%I-I-I didn't mean nothing by nothing. I meant nothing at all. Just nothing.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask who he is. You ask if he killed those men at the first vial.%SPEECH_ON%M'name's %idiot% a-a-and them there fellas ain't no skellies. They the walking dead, and then they sniffed that there flask and went down like drunks. Look, sir, I'd not meant anything by nothin'! Just having a bit of fun, that's all. I-I'll do anything for a reprieve! Well, almost anything.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks worried. You look at %volunteer% who shrugs.}
1aae1d47d781a959daa8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{你受够了这些烂事。不管那个声音来自古人，还是哪个耍宝的家伙，你都要查个明白。你后退一步，抬脚猛踹闸门。第一脚，栏杆弯成尖角；第二脚，便彻底断开。那个声音短暂地响起，这回尖细得很。%SPEECH_ON%喂、喂！你不能这样！%SPEECH_OFF%你拨开锈铁碎片与尖刺，蹲下查看小瓶。就在此时，一个男人跳进放瓶子的小室，落地时像头从悬崖跌下的小鹿，撞得小瓶从支架上脱落。你眼看它跌到地上，发出可怜的玻璃碎裂声。你抓住那人的脚，连拖带拽，将他从闸门尖刺间扯了出来。%volunteer%把剑抵上他的喉咙，他举起颤抖的双手，挡在身前。%SPEECH_ON%我、我、我真没别的意思。什么都没想，真的什么都没有。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他是谁，又问第一只瓶子旁的那些人是不是他杀的。%SPEECH_ON%我、我叫%idiot%。那、那些家伙原本不是骷髅，是会走的死人！后来凑近闻了闻那瓶子，就像醉汉一样倒了。长官，我真没想干什么！就找点乐子，仅此而已。只要饶命，我、我什么都肯做！唔，差不多什么都肯。%SPEECH_OFF%他满脸担忧。你看向%volunteer%，后者耸了耸肩。}

fc67fc47573933ed9513.source: Well, fine. You can join us.

b6f6423cf1c992e299d4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{The man's eyes gleam in the dark and each glance is like an ember scattered.%SPEECH_ON%Ya mean it? I can join ya? Alright!%SPEECH_OFF%He slowly gets to his feet as though quick action might lead to even quicker reneging. He puts a hand out, which you do not shake.%SPEECH_ON%My name's %idiot%. I've got half a brain, rest is wood and pulp. I'm kindling, of course. Kidding. Kindling. Get it?%SPEECH_OFF%You look at %volunteer% who stabs the man in the chest. The idiot's face goes tense as he looks down at the sword impaling his heart.%SPEECH_ON%Hey. I think you killed me.%SPEECH_OFF%%volunteer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye. I did. You got seconds. Speech?%SPEECH_OFF%The riddler thinks briefly.%SPEECH_ON%Well, I didn't prepare one, but... since... ya... asked...%SPEECH_OFF%He dies on the word and the blade. The sellsword cleans the blood and picks through the body, finding only musty rat bones in his pockets. When he lets the corpse go it clunks the tile rather hollowly. You crouch and feel the man's skull and find he actually wasn't kidding, its half made of wood! You look at %volunteer% who shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%He could have shat gold for all I care, I ain't putting up with his mouth. Besides, look at his eyes! That fool was blind as a bat.%SPEECH_OFF%The riddler's eyes are a blank grey. Who knows how long he spent in this temple.}
b6f6423cf1c992e299d4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{男人的眼睛在黑暗中闪亮，每次转动，都像散出一粒火星。%SPEECH_ON%真的？我能加入你们？好啊！%SPEECH_OFF%他慢慢站起身，仿佛动作稍快，就会让你反悔得更快。他伸出手，你却没去握。%SPEECH_ON%我叫%idiot%。我只有半个脑子，剩下全是木头和木浆。当然，我是在开木笑。开玩笑。木头的木，懂了吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你看向%volunteer%，他一剑刺进男人的胸膛。傻子的脸绷紧了，低头看着贯穿心脏的剑。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，我想你把我杀了。%SPEECH_OFF%%volunteer%点头。%SPEECH_ON%是，杀了。你还剩几秒。说两句？%SPEECH_OFF%出谜语的人想了一下。%SPEECH_ON%唔，我没准备，不过……既然……你……问了……%SPEECH_OFF%话音未尽，他便死在剑上。佣兵擦去血，在尸体上翻找，口袋里却只有几块发霉的鼠骨。他松开尸体，它落到地砖上，竟发出空洞的咚声。你蹲下摸了摸那人的头骨，才发现他真的没开玩笑：半边脑袋竟是木头做的！你望向%volunteer%，他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%就算他能拉出金子，我也不在乎。我可受不了那张嘴。而且你瞧他的眼睛！这蠢货根本是个瞎子。%SPEECH_OFF%出谜语之人的双眼灰白空洞。谁知道他在这座神殿里待了多久。}

df5067bca92460dd2210.source: Ah well. Two of the vials are ours.
df5067bca92460dd2210.translation: 也罢，至少两瓶归我们了。

44db269c2eb6f5008915.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{You've no time for the idiot. You let him go and he runs off and you listen to his footsteps snickering through the dark like the flaps of a bat through a familiar cave. It's not long until you hear him making an exit, and no sooner does he get that far does the %companyname% cut him down in a series of hollers and one short-lived scream. By the time you surface you find the sellswords kicking the idiot's corpse and robbing anything worth having, which is mostly a pile of poorly written riddles.

 %volunteer% laughs and puts the seemingly magical flasks into the inventory. You order the men to get ready to head out again.}
44db269c2eb6f5008915.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_111.png[/img]{你没工夫再搭理这个蠢货，挥手放他离开。他拔腿就跑，脚步声在黑暗中窸窣远去，如同蝙蝠穿行于熟悉的洞穴。没多久，你便听见他找到了出口；可刚一出去，就在一阵呼喝和一声戛然而止的惨叫中，被%companyname%的弟兄们砍翻了。等你回到地面，佣兵们正踢着他的尸体，搜刮值钱的东西，可搜出来的多半只是一堆写得蹩脚的谜语。

 %volunteer%笑着把那些似乎带有魔力的小瓶收进储备。你命令众人收拾行装，准备继续上路。}

74688f15c8a141c441d6.source: Still a successful go, all things considered.
74688f15c8a141c441d6.translation: 总的来说，这趟还是赚了。

2d175389a88d02b93b80.source: Got injured navigating an ancient mausoleum
2d175389a88d02b93b80.translation: 探索古老陵墓时受了伤

a6b481146b6ac690b4fc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_108.png[/img]{The spire is twice as tall as any castle you've seen, and narrower than any tower. It is as though someone had all the material to build a fortress, and instead of building the bastion they built the spire. %randombrother% squints as he looks up at its rise.%SPEECH_ON%Like it just goes on forever, sir. Damn near right to the clouds.%SPEECH_OFF%You enter with a map and a few men. Inside you find a glass sphere sitting on a hollowed lectern. Inside the bulb sits some powdery remains. Perhaps the last issuance of magic, you know not. Your intuition tells you that whoever dwelled in this slender refuge did not always take the stairs. But you'll have to. The climb is brutal and long. At the top you find yet another bulb, this one jagged and shattered, and beneath the glass a skeleton. A broken staff lies nearby. You shake your head and head toward the crenelations. So far are the sights the world itself seems to curve at the horizon, a strange trick of the eye no doubt. You draw the geography upon your map, take a five minute breather, then descend back down.

When you get to the bottom the skeleton is there with its staff beside it and the busted bulb is on the lectern. The whole group of men run out the door and you're hot on their heels. Looking back, you see the spire's gate slowly close with a mighty metal clank.}
a6b481146b6ac690b4fc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_108.png[/img]{这座尖塔比你见过的任何城堡都高上一倍，却比任何塔楼都细。仿佛有人攒够了修建一座堡垒的石料，最后却全用来向上堆了一根尖塔。%randombrother%眯着眼仰望。%SPEECH_ON%长官，像是根本没有尽头，都快直插进云里了。%SPEECH_OFF%你带着地图和几个弟兄走进去，发现一只玻璃球放在镂空的讲经台上，球内留着些粉末状残渣。也许是魔法最后的遗留，你说不准。直觉告诉你，住在这狭长居所里的人，恐怕不是每次都靠楼梯上下。不过，你们只能爬楼。楼梯又长又难走，到了顶上，又见一只玻璃球，只是已经破裂，边缘参差，碎玻璃下压着一副骸骨，旁边躺着折断的法杖。你摇摇头，走向城垛。目光能望得极远，连天地交界处都像在弯曲，想必只是眼睛开的怪玩笑。你将周围地形画上地图，喘了五分钟气，才沿阶返回。

到了底层，那副骸骨竟已躺在那里，法杖仍在身旁，破碎的玻璃球也出现在讲经台上。弟兄们一齐冲出门，你紧跟在后。回头望去，尖塔的大门缓缓合拢，发出一声沉重的金属轰响。}

665c60b030b44ba2e5c9.source: Well, at least we got a lay of the land.
665c60b030b44ba2e5c9.translation: 好歹摸清了周围的地势。

ba64c0d1693759e3e3f6.source: We need to get the hell out of here. Fast.
ba64c0d1693759e3e3f6.translation: 得赶紧离开这鬼地方。快。

cf07be8bd024cfd04636.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_114.png[/img]{Upon entering the clearing, the bizarre creature straightens up, swaying its heads from side to side like a peacock readying a display. They speak to you.%SPEECH_ON%The. Elder. Yes. Here. Yes. Him. We. Know. Him. We. Knew.%SPEECH_OFF%The faces warp and discolor as though blemished in the wake of the words leaving their very mouths. Slowly they reform to speak again, a grotesque panoply punctuating itself one head at a time.%SPEECH_ON%Drink. Little. Heal. All. Drink. All. Become. One.%SPEECH_OFF%You look down to see an earthen overhang curving across a puddle the size of a plate. There's a faint trickle as water drips into it from the overhang, and from where that water comes is anyone's idea. You look up to see the faces looking down, their appearances molding from anguish to happiness to surprise to fear to confusion.%SPEECH_ON%Familiar. Always. Familiar. Drink. Little. Yes. No. Drink. All.%SPEECH_OFF%Looking back down, you take out your waterskin and pop the cork.}
cf07be8bd024cfd04636.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_114.png[/img]{你刚走进空地，那古怪生物便挺起身，几颗脑袋左右摇摆，像一只准备开屏的孔雀。它们对你说话。%SPEECH_ON%那。老人。对。在这。对。他。我们。认识。他。曾经。认识。%SPEECH_OFF%话语一出口，那些脸便扭曲变色，仿佛声音本身灼伤了它们。随后，面孔缓缓重塑，轮流开口，一颗脑袋接着一颗，拼成一幕骇人的景象。%SPEECH_ON%喝。少许。治愈。一切。喝。全部。融为。一体。%SPEECH_OFF%你低头，看见一道弯曲的土檐，下面聚着餐盘大小的一汪水。细流从土檐滴入水中，至于水从哪儿来，谁也说不清。你抬头，那些脸正俯视着你，神色不断从痛苦变成欢喜、惊讶、恐惧，又变成迷惑。%SPEECH_ON%熟悉。始终。熟悉。喝。少许。对。别。喝光。%SPEECH_OFF%你再次低头，取出水囊，拔掉塞子。}

62761b31209bde0f7949.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_114.png[/img]{You crouch beneath the grotesque tree. The heads sway downward, the shade coming with them as though someone were placing the lid upon a basket. When you look up, they stare from a foot away, rippling and forever moving. Yet, one on the far end is very still. Its face is stuck on an old man's grimace, the brow furrowed, the jowls taut, the elderly lines ever creased as if the fury was folding upon itself like a well-crafted sword. A bulb of darkness surrounds it, the penumbra pulsing, as if the head was staring in from another world altogether.

 Hands firm, you take the waterskin and pour out its contents. Emptied, you put it beneath the dripping overhang and listen to each drop hit its bottom. The faces lean in ever closer, surrounding you in a cone of chaos. As they draw near, you can hear the tearing of their reality as they come to and fall out of shape. The waterskin shakes in your hand as if you had to hold it against the surge of a waterfall. You yank it out from the overhang and as you tumble backward you realize the heads have long since reared upright. Rolling over, you crawl your way to your feet and run out of the clearing. Seemingly safe you look back to see the creature is gone. There is nothing there at all. No tree. No fountain. The waterskin, however, remains.}
62761b31209bde0f7949.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_114.png[/img]{你蹲在这棵怪诞的树下。那些头颅向下垂来，阴影也随之罩下，仿佛有人正给篮子盖上盖。你抬头时，它们已在一英尺之外盯着你，起伏、扭动，永不止息。唯独远端的一颗，纹丝不动。那是一张凝固在痛苦表情里的老人脸，眉头紧锁，两颊绷起，年老的皱纹层层堆叠，仿佛怒火正如精锻的刀剑般反复折叠。一团黑暗将它包围，边缘的暗影隐隐搏动，仿佛这颗头正从另一个世界向内凝视。

你稳住双手，取出水囊，将里面的水倒空，再放到滴水的悬垂处下方，听着水滴一声声敲在囊底。那些脸越凑越近，将你围在混乱的锥形包围中。随着它们靠近，形体时聚时散，你甚至能听见它们的存在本身遭到撕裂的声响。水囊在手里颤动，仿佛你正举着它承受瀑布冲刷。你猛地将它抽出来，向后翻倒，才发现那些头颅早已重新抬直。你翻过身，连滚带爬地站起来，冲出空地。到了似乎安全的地方，你回头一看，那生物已经消失，那里什么也没有。没有树，没有泉。可是，水囊还在。}

1b10ec8254248f5d0abb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{As you count the loot, the stranger who ordained this entire goblin-slaying strategy reappears. You can't even see the color of him for he is utterly drenched in goblin guts and gore. He's got a few scalps in hand and a pouch that has ears and noses poking out the top and blood dripping from the bottom. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%All is well, traveler, all is well. We did good.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask him if he set the fire. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Goblins stagger their rearguard in mazes of walls and mines. I shuttered their escapes to hem the population between two walls, closed the way out, closed the way in, and set fire to everything. They perished quickly. I see you fared well. You can keep the loot. I've no use for it.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns and walks away. You yell out to him, this outrageous warrior, and ask how much he'd want to join the company. This time he turns back.%SPEECH_ON%Heh, heh, haha, hahaha! Traveler! This joke, ah. Comedy. Delightful. Truly. But my work will not be stalled until every goblin has been destroyed.%SPEECH_OFF%Fair enough, a man's purpose is his own. But you're curious. You ask how many cities are out there.%SPEECH_ON%Twenty three, oh, sorry, did you ask how many there are in total? Twenty three I've destroyed, but still in existence there are, ah, two, three, hmmm. I wager four thousand. Good travels, traveler.%SPEECH_OFF%This time he departs for good. You look back at the %companyname%. They are in rare agreement: they wish they hadn't heard any of that.}
1b10ec8254248f5d0abb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{你清点战利品时，那个制定了整套猎杀地精计划的陌生人又出现了。他从头到脚浸透了地精的血肉与内脏，连本来的颜色都看不出来。手里攥着几块头皮，腰包上方支出耳朵和鼻子，下方不断滴血。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%一切都好，旅人。一切都好。我们干得不错。%SPEECH_OFF%你问火是不是他放的，他又点头。%SPEECH_ON%地精的后卫分散在墙壁与矿坑组成的迷宫里。我封住退路，把它们赶进两道墙之间，出入口全堵死，再把一切点燃。它们死得很快。看来，你也很顺利。战利品归你，我用不上。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身离去。你喊住这位强得离谱的战士，问要付多少钱，他才肯加入战团。这回，他转了回来。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，嘿，哈哈，哈哈哈！旅人！这笑话，啊，真逗。妙极了，真的。不过，只要还有一只地精没被消灭，我就不会停下。%SPEECH_OFF%也罢，人各有志。不过，你很好奇，便问这样的城市还有多少。%SPEECH_ON%二十三，噢，抱歉，你是问总共有多少？我毁掉的有二十三座，至于还剩下的，啊，两、三，嗯……我估摸着有四千。一路顺风，旅人。%SPEECH_OFF%这一次，他真的走了。你回头望向%companyname%。弟兄们难得意见一致：真希望刚才什么都没听见。}

a667e7bcb0e594e8cf78.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{After observing the city for a time, you know that you can't simply assault it head on. There are far too many to take on and with the numbers already on their side it is even likely the families of the goblins will partake in your slaughter, and you will have only enshrined the city whole with further experience in slaughtering humans. So you wait. And think. And then the man approaches.

 He's bound in light armor with a leafy hood used to camouflage the metal beneath and a multitude of swords clank from his hip and a spear yokes across his back one way and an axe the other and bandolier of potions chime as he comes to a halt. You can't see his face, much less his eyes, and he's dripping with the blood of recent action.%SPEECH_ON%Despite their cruelties and cruel appearance, the goblins are in a way a civilized group. They will respond to violence that is at its base nothing more than senseless savagery. If you wish to draw them out, then you must do as the orcs do. My plan was to slaughter as many as I could find in the fields, raiding parties, scouts, the like, but it is just as well that their encampments are destroyed in great number. Together, the carnage will be a pincer upon their fears, for they fear reckless orcs more than anything and will seek to preemptively snuff them out.%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods as though you've already agreed to something.%SPEECH_ON%So choose, traveler, the manner in which you wish to have this city laid flat. Slaughter their raiding parties and scouts, or burn their forward posts? Whatever you do, I'll do the other, alone, and we shall meet here when the summary of our actions is obvious.%SPEECH_OFF%}
a667e7bcb0e594e8cf78.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{观察这座城市一阵后，你明白不能正面强攻。敌人实在太多，占尽人数优势，恐怕连地精的家眷都会来分一份杀戮。到头来，你只会让整座城更加熟练于屠杀人类。于是，你等待，思索。然后，那个男人走了过来。

他裹着轻甲，用缀满树叶的兜帽掩住下方的金属。腰间挂着许多剑，叮当作响；背上交叉负着长矛与斧头。停步时，胸前弹带般排列的药瓶碰得清脆。你看不见他的脸，更别说双眼，只有鲜血不断滴落，显然刚经历过一番厮杀。%SPEECH_ON%地精模样凶残，行事也凶残，但从某种意义上说，它们算是个文明的群体。面对毫无道理的野蛮暴行，它们一定会作出反应。想把它们引出来，就得学兽人的做法。我原本打算，尽可能多杀些野外的地精，劫掠队、斥候之类。但若能大批摧毁它们的营地，也一样有效。两路杀戮会从两侧夹击它们的恐惧。它们最怕肆意妄为的兽人，一定会主动出击，抢先将威胁扑灭。%SPEECH_OFF%他点了点头，仿佛你们已经达成了某种约定。%SPEECH_ON%选吧，旅人。你想用哪种方式让这座城夷为平地？屠杀劫掠队与斥候，还是烧毁前哨？你选一边，另一边我独自去办。等战果已经显而易见，我们便在这里会合。%SPEECH_OFF%}

6294c3d9942b6db5320b.source: We'll slaughter their scouts and raiding parties.
6294c3d9942b6db5320b.translation: 我们去歼灭它们的斥候和劫掠队。

cefc1bbcf4f9fae377bd.source: We'll take on the forward posts.

48c7438814e75f67b403.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{You tell him that the %companyname% will slaughter the goblins in the fields. The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, traveler, that is a good choice. The disappearances of these parties will put a strain upon the greenskins' beliefs. They're natural scouts and raiders, so when those in that ilk go missing it unnerves them to the core. The forward posts will retreat and spread rumors to this city and out shall come an expeditionary force. While you take them in the fields, I shall see to it that many of the encampments are destroyed. By my own experience, you need to destroy somewhere around %goblinkillcount% parties of them and that shall be sufficient.%SPEECH_OFF%He heads off, but you call out asking who he is, or if perhaps it would be a better idea to join together. He ignores you completely and walks away.}
48c7438814e75f67b403.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{你告诉他，%companyname%会在野外歼灭地精队伍。那人点头道。%SPEECH_ON%啊，旅人，这个选择很好。那些队伍接连失踪，会动摇绿皮的信心。它们天生擅长侦察和劫掠，连这些好手都不见了，足以让它们打心底发慌。前哨的守军会撤回，把流言带进城里，城中就会派出远征军。你们在野外收拾队伍，我来摧毁各处营地。依我的经验，大约消灭%goblinkillcount%支队伍，就足够了。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身便走。你喊住他，问他究竟是谁，又提议不如一起行动。他却充耳不闻，径自走远了。}

16a35fce11c36a0cc7fe.source: We'll return after %goblinkillcount% goblin parties have been destroyed.
16a35fce11c36a0cc7fe.translation: 消灭%goblinkillcount%支地精队伍后，我们再回来。

95bf5bceb64ef0a8a1aa.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{You tell the stranger that the %companyname% will pursue the destruction of the encampments. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Excellent, traveler, excellent! The goblins send raiding parties frequently and when they come home to ashes they will return here, spread word of destruction, and be lead out. Very well. We have a plan and by my own experiences you need only march down around %goblinpostcount% encampments. You take their posts, I will take their parties.%SPEECH_OFF%He heads off, but you call out asking who he is, or if perhaps it would be a better idea to join together. He ignores you completely and walks away.}
95bf5bceb64ef0a8a1aa.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{你告诉陌生人，%companyname%会去摧毁那些营地。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%太好了，旅人，太好了！地精时常派出劫掠队。等它们回去发现营地成了一片灰烬，就会返回这里报信，再把城里的兵引出去。很好，计划就这么定了。依我的经验，你们只要踏平大约%goblinpostcount%处营地就够了。你们拔掉据点，我来对付劫掠队。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身便走。你喊住他，问他究竟是谁，又提议不如一起行动。他却充耳不闻，径自走远了。}

9f431eba8b8231c7c96a.source: We'll return after five outposts have been razed.
9f431eba8b8231c7c96a.translation: 摧毁五座前哨后，我们再回来。

9dd9a5b5d4bc500873d9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{You return to the city, but the stranger you met earlier is nowhere to be seen. However, what is seen is an enormous contingent of goblin forces marching out of their city. They're in lockstep and chittering loudly. Their leaders sit atop saddled wolves with their war banners tilting side to side as though it were a fleet set to sea. Goblin families stand perched at the gates. They're throwing handfuls of bones upon the marchers, and sometimes you see a dog or human limb get tossed down and whichever goblin catches it holds it up like a trophy and the surrounding troop cheers. It takes a full hour for the army to pass at which time the goblins at the gates recede back into the city and a few guards mill about.

There's still plenty yet to put up a good fight, but not enough to handle the %companyname%.}
9dd9a5b5d4bc500873d9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{你返回城外，却找不到先前那个陌生人。眼前所见的，是一支庞大的地精军队正在出城。它们步调一致，喧嚷不休。头领骑着配鞍的狼，战旗左右摇摆，宛如一支即将出海的舰队。地精家属挤在城门高处，向行进的队伍抛撒一把把骨头。偶尔还有狗腿或人的断肢扔下来，哪个地精接到，便像得了战利品般高高举起，引得周围同伴大声喝彩。足足过了一个钟头，大军才走完。城门上的地精随之退回城里，只剩几个守卫来回游荡。

城中余下的守军仍能打一场硬仗，但已不足以抵挡%companyname%。}

a373b56a723e39306abf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{The goblin city remains guarded by a horde of the little greenskins. You recall that the %companyname% will have to destroy a couple more of their patrols and scouts to draw the army away from the city.}
a373b56a723e39306abf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{地精城仍有大群小绿皮把守。你想起，%companyname%还得消灭几支巡逻队和侦察队，才能把军队从城里引出来。}

f9e29c6fd8c81f366822.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{The goblin city remains guarded by a horde of the little greenskins. You recall that the %companyname% will have to destroy a couple more of their encampments and forward posts to draw the army away from the city.}
f9e29c6fd8c81f366822.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{地精城仍有大群小绿皮把守。你想起，%companyname%还得摧毁几处营地和前哨，才能把军队从城里引出来。}

3ae90c52bb17ef206807.source: We'll return after %goblinpostcount% outposts have been razed.
3ae90c52bb17ef206807.translation: 摧毁%goblinpostcount%座前哨后，我们再回来。

8d6a87f964452eec3299.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{With so many goblins taken care of, it is likely that word of their deaths and annihilations will reach back to the greenskins' city. If that goblin expert is as learned as he seems, the goblins will overreact and send their armies out, leaving the gates largely undefended. Perhaps it is time to return to the goblin city and see if the stranger's summations ring true.}
8d6a87f964452eec3299.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_119.png[/img]{你们已经消灭了这么多地精，它们接连覆灭的消息想必会传回城中。如果那位地精专家果真见多识广，地精就会反应过度，倾巢出兵，留下守卫空虚的城门。也许该回地精城看看，验证那陌生人的推断了。}

56975147c544cc673852.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_125.png[/img]{The ship is wrecked amongst the trees some of which have long since started to grow through it. As far as you're aware, there is neither sea nor river for miles. %observer% walks up and halts at the very sight.%SPEECH_ON%By the old gods, is that a ship?%SPEECH_OFF%You sigh and tell the company to stay here while you and the very observant sellsword go take a look.}
56975147c544cc673852.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_125.png[/img]{一艘破船搁在树林里，有些树早已穿过船身长了出来。据你所知，方圆数里内既没有海，也没有河。%observer%走上前，一见这景象便停住脚步。%SPEECH_ON%旧神在上，那是艘船？%SPEECH_OFF%你叹了口气，让战团原地等候，自己带着这位“眼尖”的佣兵前去查看。}

3b67650ca34c1850492b.source: Let's see what secrets are inside.
3b67650ca34c1850492b.translation: 看看里面藏着什么秘密。

39830cd8a0b9ebd0b0f5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_125.png[/img]{You step into the bowels of the ship. It's completely vacant save for a stump with an axehead chopped into it. %observer% looks at it.%SPEECH_ON%There's an axehead.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you say there it is indeed. But the metal of it carries veins of a sort of golden hue. Getting closer to the stump, you can see embers flittering upward out of the wedge. %observer% taps your shoulder and you find him pointing into the dark of the ship.%SPEECH_ON%Skeleton. Dead one.%SPEECH_OFF%Just faintly can you see the pale bones. As you draw near, the clothing becomes apparent, and readily obvious as royal attire. There is a cracked ale horn in one hand and a molded loaf of bread in the other. His jacket is blown open and shredded by splinters. Upon closer inspection, some of the wood is embedded in his brainpan.}
39830cd8a0b9ebd0b0f5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_125.png[/img]{你走进船舱深处。里面空空荡荡，只有一截树桩，上头嵌着一块斧头。%observer%望着它。%SPEECH_ON%有块斧头。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，确实如此。不过，那金属里有些金色纹路。走近树桩，你还能看见斧刃处有火星向上飘起。%observer%拍拍你的肩，指向船里的黑暗。%SPEECH_ON%有具骷髅。死的。%SPEECH_OFF%你勉强能辨认出苍白的骨头。再走近些，衣服便显出形来，一眼就能看出是王室服饰。它一手握着开裂的麦酒角杯，另一手拿着发霉的面包。外衣被炸开，碎木将布料撕得稀烂。仔细一看，还有些木片嵌进了它的颅骨。}

b8d2d899a66becbcf67e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_125.png[/img]{Seeing as how the skeleton and his beer and bread ain't going anywhere, you leave it be. The axehead however draws your eye again. %observer% walks over to the stump and the glowing wedge. He tries to take it out. Finding no luck there, he angrily steps back and kicks it. The stump cracks in twain and the sellsword suddenly flies upside down and the axehead shoots through the ceiling and you can hear it clunk and clatter down the starboard. Debris and smoke drift lazily about. The sellsword gets up and pats himself off.%SPEECH_ON%What in all the hells was that?%SPEECH_OFF%You shush him and point. A little golden goose squats where the stump's base used to be. The sheen of its metal glows and swirls. You've heard stories of a golden goose, but never thought they were anything beyond that!}
b8d2d899a66becbcf67e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_125.png[/img]{骷髅和它的啤酒面包反正也跑不了，你便先放在一旁。那块斧头却又吸引了你的目光。%observer%走到树桩旁，试着拔出那块发光的斧刃。拔不动，他便恼火地退开一步，一脚踢去。树桩应声裂成两半，佣兵突然倒飞出去，斧头则冲破顶板，你听见它沿右舷一路哐当滚落。碎屑与烟尘缓缓飘散。佣兵爬起来，拍掉身上的灰。%SPEECH_ON%这他娘的是什么玩意儿？%SPEECH_OFF%你让他噤声，抬手一指。原先树桩底座的位置，蹲着一只小小的金鹅。它身上的金属光泽闪烁流转。你听说过金鹅的故事，却从没想过那竟会是真的！}

4fed58db1fff3ca13031.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_125.png[/img]{%observer% stumbles forward.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, what are you doing?%SPEECH_OFF%You wave him off and pick the golden goose up. Holding it in both hands, it feels oddly warm. And it isn't exploding or melting your face. You can feel its metal rippling ever so slightly against your fingers. It might even be growing? With the treasure safely huddled beneath your elbow, you wonder why the skeleton didn't fare better. %observer% walks up and touches the golden goose on the head, but quickly recoils. You ask if it burned him. The sellsword purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%Really, sir? Was it not obvious?%SPEECH_OFF%He sticks his finger in his mouth. You tell him to not be so snappy with his commander or you'll throw the goose at him and see if it makes short work of him as it did the skeleton. The man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Oh look at the man chosen by a shiny bauble, put a blade beneath a wing so it can knight ye, or hells why not put it on yer head and call yerself king already?%SPEECH_OFF%You look down at the goose. A drop of red blood runs down its length, turns gold, and drops to the ground with a tiny plink. You pick it up and bite it. The gold smooshes satisfyingly in your teeth and you then throw it to %observer%. It does not burn him this time, and you realize you may have found the genuine Golden Goose from the tales!}
4fed58db1fff3ca13031.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_125.png[/img]{%observer%跌跌撞撞地上前。%SPEECH_ON%长官，你在干什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你挥手让他退开，拿起金鹅。双手捧着它，竟感到一股古怪的温热。它没有爆炸，也没把你的脸熔掉。你能感觉到，金属表面正贴着指尖极轻地起伏，甚至可能还在长大？你把宝物稳稳夹在肘下，不禁奇怪，那副骷髅怎么就没这么好运。%observer%走来，摸了摸金鹅的头，却立刻缩回手。你问，是不是烫着了。佣兵抿起嘴。%SPEECH_ON%长官，这还用问吗？不够明显？%SPEECH_OFF%他把手指含进嘴里。你叫他别这么顶撞团长，否则就把鹅扔到他身上，看看它会不会像对付那副骷髅一样，轻松把他也解决了。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%噢，瞧瞧，被亮闪闪的小玩意儿选中的大人物！往它翅膀下面塞把剑，让它封你做骑士吧。见鬼，何不干脆把它顶在头上，自封国王？%SPEECH_OFF%你低头看向金鹅。一滴鲜红的血沿着鹅身滑落，变成黄金，叮的一声落在地上。你捡起，咬了一口，黄金在牙间柔软地变形，令人满意。你把它丢给%observer%，这回没有烫伤他。你意识到，自己或许找到了传说中真正的金鹅！}

8b45b1b8cd2dac393a6f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_105.png[/img]{Tentacles chain across the swamp in a corrupted mass such that you didn't slay the kraken so much as annihilate the very place it called home. Each wormy vestige is wimpled with swamp moss, a stretch of profitable farmland to hatch the very mushrooms you saw the woman eating time and time again. You crouch beside one unharvested batch, poking at their caps like a cat at a wingless moth. The fungi deflate at the touch. %randombrother% looks at them.%SPEECH_ON%Mycologist might know what those are.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Yeah. Might. You move along, crushing the shrooms underfoot and wading through limbs and bloodied cloaks floating along the swamp and the tentacles' faceless heads with their leafy maws folded over each other and their tongues lolled like whips. You find the woman nestled behind a cast of kudzu, yourself parting the vines like a man seeking his fortune. She regards you with a grin.%SPEECH_ON%Did you hear it? Did you hear its beauty?%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you tell her that the shrooms overtook her mind, and the shrooms were likely there for a reason and that the kraken had her well before it ever rose, that it used her to bring everyone here. Grinning ever more, she only asks again if you heard its beauty. You tell her you heard it die. Her brow furrows.%SPEECH_ON%A cry of death? Is that what you think? Oh my, oh no. Stranger, that was a cry for help. Don't you get it? That means more are out there! More! Perhaps hundreds! And now they are awake! Now they are all awake!%SPEECH_OFF%You step back and close the kudzu curtain. %randombrother% tells you that the company has found something. For a moment, you think to save this woman, but you know better. You know the grip she is in and leave her be.}
8b45b1b8cd2dac393a6f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_105.png[/img]{触手一条条横贯沼泽，堆成腐败的巨团。与其说你杀死了克拉肯，不如说你摧毁了它栖身的整片地方。每截蠕虫般的残肢上，都覆着沼泽苔藓，像肥沃的田地，长着你屡次见那女人吃下的蘑菇。你蹲在一丛尚未采摘的蘑菇旁，像猫逗弄失去翅膀的蛾子般，戳了戳菌盖。蘑菇一碰便瘪。%randombrother%看着它们。%SPEECH_ON%研究菌类的人，也许知道这是什么。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。是啊，也许。你继续前行，踩碎脚下的蘑菇，涉过漂浮的断肢、染血的斗篷，以及触手末端无面的头。它们叶片般的巨口互相叠压，舌头像鞭子一样耷拉着。你像拨开藤蔓寻找财宝的人一样，掀开一片葛藤，终于发现女人蜷在后面。她咧嘴望着你。%SPEECH_ON%你听见了吗？听见它有多美了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你叹了口气，告诉她，是蘑菇侵占了她的头脑，而那些蘑菇生在那里，多半并非偶然。克拉肯尚未现身，就早已控制了她，借她将所有人引来。她笑得更开，只管再次追问，你是否听见了那份美。你说，你听见的是它死时的声音。她皱起眉。%SPEECH_ON%垂死的哀号？你真这么想？噢，天哪，不，不。陌生人，那是在求救。你还不明白吗？这说明，外面还有更多！更多！也许有几百只！现在，它们醒了！全都醒了！%SPEECH_OFF%你后退一步，放下葛藤的帘幕。%randombrother%告诉你，弟兄们发现了些东西。有那么一瞬，你还想救下这个女人，可你知道那是妄想。你明白她被什么攥住，便任她留在那里。}

27e356a372c753d2a5d8.source: Alright, show me what's been found.
27e356a372c753d2a5d8.translation: 好，拿来看看找到了什么。

638f7c2f2d705f738e9c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_105.png[/img]{The creature was almost too large to die properly on its side and instead tilts forward with its horrid mouth gaping like a hole blasted into a leaning bastion. One sellsword sits crosslegged atop the kraken's dome like a monk deep in study. Another is poking the creature in its eyes until one pops and the corners of the socket slurp the liquid in a frothy gargle. You ask the mercenaries what of import has been found and one waves you over to the creature's maw. With slackened gums the teeth now hang downward, limp crenellations to a tower of horror, the slew of razors coated in clothes and flesh and so large that whole limbs are wedged between them. And so is the blade.

 You reach into the mouth and wrench out the blade and wipe it down with a cloth. Turning the blade, you spot glyphs in the fuller with numbers beside them, a suggestion of smithing eternal yet purposed particular to a time and place. The steel is so vibrant it seems to have been fashioned by the light of the stars themselves. Unfortunately, there is no handle for it. The magnificence of the blade suggests it is not to be accommodated by any mere hilt. Putting the blade in inventory, you tell the men to collect what they can from the 'Beast of Beasts' and to get ready to leave this wretched place.}
638f7c2f2d705f738e9c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_105.png[/img]{这生物庞大得几乎无法好好侧卧着死去，只能向前倾倒，可怖的巨口大张，像倾斜堡垒上被轰开的洞。一名佣兵盘腿坐在克拉肯圆顶般的脑袋上，活像潜心研读的修士。另一人正戳弄它的眼睛，直到其中一颗破裂，眼眶边缘咕噜咕噜地吸进混着泡沫的液体。你问有没有找到要紧的东西，一个弟兄挥手叫你去看巨口。牙龈松弛后，牙齿纷纷垂下，仿佛恐怖高塔上软塌塌的城垛。那排剃刀般的巨齿沾满衣物与血肉，齿间甚至夹着整条肢体。还有那片剑刃。

 你探进嘴里，把剑刃用力拔出，用布擦净。翻转查看时，你发现血槽里刻着符文，旁边还有数字，仿佛锻造它的技艺足以流传永世，它本身却是为某个特定时地而生。钢铁光华如此鲜明，像是由星光亲手铸成。可惜，它没有剑柄。剑刃如此华美，显然不是随便装个柄就能相配的。你将剑刃收进库存，叫弟兄们尽量从“万兽之王”身上收集材料，准备离开这个鬼地方。}

a1545846609d3ef83e97.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_105.png[/img]{The creature was almost too large to die properly on its side and instead tilts forward with its horrid mouth gaping like a hole blasted into a leaning bastion. One sellsword sits crosslegged atop the kraken's dome like a monk deep in study. Another is poking the creature in its eyes until one pops and the corners of the socket slurp the liquid in a frothy gargle. You ask the mercenaries what of import has been found and one waves you over to the creature's maw. With slackened gums the teeth now hang downward, limp crenellations to a tower of horror, the slew of razors coated in clothes and flesh and so large that whole limbs are wedged between them. And so is the blade.

 You reach into the mouth and wrench out the blade and wipe it down with a cloth. Turning the blade, you spot glyphs in the fuller with numbers beside them, a suggestion of smithing eternal yet purposed particular to a time and place. The steel is so vibrant it seems to have been fashioned by the light of the stars themselves. Unfortunately, there is no handle for it and you immediately do the math on that: a sword of unseen magnificence with no handle and one strange old man in a secluded wheelhouse with a blade-less handle. You think you know just where to take this. You put it in the inventory and order the company to plunder whatever else is worth taking, including from the so-called 'beast of beasts.'}
a1545846609d3ef83e97.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_105.png[/img]{这生物庞大得几乎无法好好侧卧着死去，只能向前倾倒，可怖的巨口大张，像倾斜堡垒上被轰开的洞。一名佣兵盘腿坐在克拉肯圆顶般的脑袋上，活像潜心研读的修士。另一人正戳弄它的眼睛，直到其中一颗破裂，眼眶边缘咕噜咕噜地吸进混着泡沫的液体。你问有没有找到要紧的东西，一个弟兄挥手叫你去看巨口。牙龈松弛后，牙齿纷纷垂下，仿佛恐怖高塔上软塌塌的城垛。那排剃刀般的巨齿沾满衣物与血肉，齿间甚至夹着整条肢体。还有那片剑刃。

 你探进嘴里，把剑刃用力拔出，用布擦净。翻转查看时，你发现血槽里刻着符文，旁边还有数字，仿佛锻造它的技艺足以流传永世，它本身却是为某个特定时地而生。钢铁光华如此鲜明，像是由星光亲手铸成。可惜，它没有剑柄。你立刻把两件事联系起来：一片举世罕见的华美剑刃，没有剑柄；一位住在偏僻水磨坊里的怪老头，手里却有个没有剑刃的剑柄。你想，已经知道该把它送去哪儿了。你将剑刃收进库存，命令战团继续搜刮一切值得带走的东西，包括这头所谓的“万兽之王”身上的材料。}

bc71417c940f0fd7eab0.source: So what all do you know?

7dfe9d38e02c51400b05.translation: 你就是个彻头彻尾的疯子。

ef45499537532882fe64.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{You stumble across a woman in the swamps, alone and with a rucksack and a pannier with rolls of what may be maps, and there's a dagger to her left hip and pots and pans to her right. There's a kicked campfire nearby and a pile of tomes shoed into a velvet sock. Everything she is and everything she has is covered in the greenery of the mire. She's standing there staring at you and you at her. It is not exactly ordinary for a woman to be out alone in the bog. She smiles quaintly, hesitantly.%SPEECH_ON%Hello.%SPEECH_OFF%With a hand on the handle of your sword, you eye the surrounding parts for an ambush. You ask her what she's doing out this way and she says you wouldn't believe her. You've seen enough to lend credence to even the edges of whatever insanity she could respond with. The woman nods.%SPEECH_ON%Well, alright then. Come on over and I'll show ya.%SPEECH_OFF%}
ef45499537532882fe64.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{你在沼泽里偶遇一个独行的女人。她带着背囊和一只驮篮，里面塞着几卷像是地图的东西，左腰挂匕首，右腰挂锅碗。附近一堆篝火已被踢散，几本厚书硬塞在一只天鹅绒长袜里。她本人和所有家当，都沾满了沼泽的绿苔污泥。她站在那里望着你，你也望着她。一个女人独自在沼泽游荡，可不是寻常景象。她露出一个拘谨而迟疑的笑容。%SPEECH_ON%你好。%SPEECH_OFF%你按住剑柄，扫视四周，提防埋伏。你问她在这里干什么，她说你不会相信。你见过的怪事已足够多，她便是说些疯话，你也未必全然不信。女人点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，那就过来，我带你看看。%SPEECH_OFF%}

066edee2a88d2e31ec7a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{You tell the company to keep vigilant for scapegraces hiding in the swamp, but they only laugh and say you should have stopped at the whorehouse if you were so up and in a fit. Ignoring them, you head toward the woman. You find her on a log, a mushroom cap twisting in her hands, and she speaks rather honestly.%SPEECH_ON%I'm in search of a monster and whether real or farce, to me it is a monster all the same. Understand?%SPEECH_OFF%In a way, you do. Not all monsters are real, and a bog broad like this could be crazy. You ask her what this supposed beast is. She eats the mushroom and then grabs a book and throws it your way. There's a page held by a leaf and you open to it. Drawn there is what looks like an octopus with limbs the size of longships. It is in battle with a whole navy and seems to even be winning. The woman leans forward, her limp green hands hanging like kudzu between her knees.%SPEECH_ON%The monster I'm seeking is the kraken.%SPEECH_OFF%}
066edee2a88d2e31ec7a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{你叮嘱战团，提防藏在沼泽里的歹人，弟兄们却只笑着说，你要是憋得如此心烦，先前就该去趟妓院。你不理他们，走向女人。她坐在圆木上，手里转着一朵蘑菇的伞盖，坦然开口。%SPEECH_ON%我在找一个怪物。是真是假都一样，对我而言，它就是怪物。明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%某种程度上，你明白。并非所有怪物都真实存在，而这种独居沼泽的女人，也可能是个疯子。你问她，所谓的怪兽究竟是什么。她吃下蘑菇，抓起一本书扔过来。书里夹着一片树叶，你翻到那页，画着一只像章鱼的东西，每条腕足都有长船那么大。它正与整支舰队交战，看起来甚至占着上风。女人俯下身，染绿的双手软软垂在膝间，像两条藤蔓。%SPEECH_ON%我要找的怪物，是克拉肯。%SPEECH_OFF%}

5660d53b8671407f9bc2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{The woman leans back. She eats another mushroom and turns and stabs her dagger into a bug that had been scuttling across the log. Without so much as a pause she eats it off the tip and speaks between mashing its carapace.%SPEECH_ON%Ordinarily, I'd be short on details and already waving this here dagger at your pecker, but I think you're keen on helping. I can see it in your eyes. You're a killer, a murderer, a lech, a fancier of the coin, and a crazy sumbitch.%SPEECH_OFF%She swallows the remains of the insect and spits out its remains like the shells of a sunflower seed. She nods.%SPEECH_ON%I'm the daughter of a wealthy nobleman, but I'm clearly far away from that life.%SPEECH_OFF%That she is.}
5660d53b8671407f9bc2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{女人往后一靠，又吃下一朵蘑菇，转身用匕首扎住一只爬过圆木的虫子。她毫不迟疑地从刀尖上把虫子咬进嘴里，一边嚼碎甲壳，一边说话。%SPEECH_ON%换了平时，我懒得多解释，早拿这把刀指着你裤裆了。可我觉得，你是真想帮忙。我从你眼睛里看得出来。你是个杀手、刽子手、色鬼、贪财货，还是个不要命的疯种。%SPEECH_OFF%她咽下虫肉，把残壳像瓜子皮一样吐出来，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%我父亲是个有钱的贵族，不过你也看到了，我早就不再过那种日子了。%SPEECH_OFF%这倒是一眼就看得出来。}

503aa62ef0fb759ef5f3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{She turns to her tomes and stares at them as though they were gravestones.%SPEECH_ON%My father owns one of the largest libraries in all the land. In those halls I discovered stories of these very swamps. Stories by authors who, unwittingly, were repeating themselves. Ten years ago. A hundred. A thousand. All the same tale. A tale of men coming here, and men disappearing. Resolution is not sought and the answers are ambiguous. Bandits. Diseases. One scholar simply said the men experienced such wonder at the beauties of the swamp that they decided to stay there. Can you believe that? Beauties of the swamp?%SPEECH_OFF%Smirking, you say you're looking at one. She laughs.%SPEECH_ON%I haven't seen myself in months, but I'm serious, stranger. I've searched these parts and I haven't found a goddam thing.%SPEECH_OFF%She points a finger at her books.%SPEECH_ON%Twenty disappearances with up to three hundred men, armored, with horses, some with caravans, some with protected highborn, and yet I look around out here and I don't see a single goddam thing.%SPEECH_OFF%You suspect if you fucked off and died in a swamp no one would give a shit about you either, but that many tales is a little suspicious.}}
503aa62ef0fb759ef5f3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{她转向那些大部头，盯着它们，仿佛在看一排墓碑。%SPEECH_ON%我父亲拥有这片土地上最大的藏书馆之一。我在那里读到了关于这片沼泽的故事。那些作者并不知道，自己写下的不过是同样故事的重演。十年前，一百年前，一千年前，全都是一样的故事。有人来到这里，然后消失。没人追查到底，给出的解释也含糊不清：强盗，疾病。有个学者干脆说，那些人被沼泽的美景深深震撼，所以决定留下。你能信吗？沼泽的美景？%SPEECH_OFF%你坏笑着说，眼前不就有一位。她笑了。%SPEECH_ON%我已经几个月没照过镜子了。不过我是认真的，陌生人。我搜遍了这一带，却连个鬼影都没找到。%SPEECH_OFF%她伸出手指，指向书本。%SPEECH_ON%二十起失踪案，前后多达三百人，有盔甲，有马，有些跟着商队，有些护送着贵族。可我在这里到处找，竟然什么都找不到。%SPEECH_OFF%你心想，要是自己跑到沼泽里死了，多半也没人会在意。但这么多起故事，确实有些蹊跷。}}

9a76baf35214b5128e84.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{She shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Maybe, but at least I didn't hire a company full of assholes.%SPEECH_OFF%You look back at the %companyname% who on one side of the camp are having fistfights and in the middle someone is slipping a swamp snake up a sleeping sellsword's pants and on the closer side of things a few are pointing at you two and grabbing their crotches and humping the air. You turn back and tell her they aren't so bad. Just then, a mercenary screams across the swamp.%SPEECH_ON%Tell her about the time everyone fucking died and so we made you captain cause there was no one else! Ladies love heroics!%SPEECH_OFF%Grinning, you repeat yourself.%SPEECH_ON%Honestly, not the worst.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9a76baf35214b5128e84.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{她耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%也许吧，可至少我没雇上一整团混蛋。%SPEECH_OFF%你回头看看%companyname%的弟兄们：营地一头有人正在打架，中间有人把沼泽蛇往熟睡同伴的裤子里塞，靠近你们的几个则一边指指点点，一边抓着裤裆，朝空气挺动腰身。你转回来，告诉她，他们其实也没那么糟。话音未落，一个佣兵隔着沼泽嚷了起来。%SPEECH_ON%告诉她那回大家他妈的都死光了，实在没人可选，咱们才让你当了团长！女人就爱听英雄故事！%SPEECH_OFF%你咧嘴笑着，又说了一遍。%SPEECH_ON%说真的，还不算最糟。%SPEECH_OFF%}

5bc4184d9c70e5a376cf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{The woman rummages through her rucksack and produces a signet unlike any you've seen before. She flips it to you as though it were a shite counterfeit coin.%SPEECH_ON%Got plenty more where that came from. Well, not here exactly. Wouldn't want you get any ideas about robbing and ravaging, you know. But you do what I ask and I'll dump a chest of those on ya.%SPEECH_OFF%You pocket the signet and ask her what's needed. She answers.%SPEECH_ON%That I'm not entirely yet sure of. Sailors talk of the krakens as being natural enemies to whales, but well, there are no whales around these parts given we're on land and all. But there is something close. An unhold of the bog. I suspect the krakens, through eons of time, moved inland and fed upon what they could and, like when they were in the seas, found an enemy here just as well. Bring me %hides% unhold hides and I may be able to lure the beast out of its slumber yet.%SPEECH_OFF%Out of its slumber? Where the hell would it even be sleeping? You shrug and figure if she's willing to rid herself of such magnificent jewelry then you'd be more than happy to oblige her.}
5bc4184d9c70e5a376cf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{女人在背包里翻找，拿出一枚你从未见过的印章戒指，像扔劣质假钱一样抛给你。%SPEECH_ON%这种东西，我还有一大堆。当然，不在这里，免得你动了劫财劫色的心思。只要办好我交代的事，我就给你满满一箱。%SPEECH_OFF%你收起戒指，问她需要什么。她答道。%SPEECH_ON%这我还没完全弄清。水手说，克拉肯与鲸鱼是天敌。可这里毕竟是陆地，附近没有鲸鱼。不过，有种东西倒挺像：沼泽巨魔。我怀疑，克拉肯在漫长的岁月里迁入内陆，逮着什么就吃什么，也像当年在海里一样，在这里遇上了天敌。给我带来%hides%张巨魔皮，我也许就能把那头巨兽从沉睡中引出来。%SPEECH_OFF%从沉睡中？那鬼东西到底能睡在哪儿？你耸耸肩，心想，既然她愿意拿这么精美的珠宝往外送，你当然乐意替她办事。}

3efc260dc2c8847e444a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{You bring the woman her unhold hides only to find there are more people now. A few men and women milling about, poking around the swamp, eating mushrooms. They ask if you are here to help find the kraken. You sternly ask if they're here to get paid as well because you are sure as shite not sharing the goods. The woman calls out to you and runs over. She turns her head and scrunches swamp slush out of her hair as though it were a dirty rag.%SPEECH_ON%Are those the, they are!%SPEECH_OFF%She snaps her fingers and a few helpers take the hides away. You ask who the hell these people are. She shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%They just started arriving, I guess. Said it was in the stars for them to be here and I ain't one to question that. And no, I ain't going to pay them what I owed you. They're just happy to be here, away from everywhere else, away from everything always.%SPEECH_OFF%You raise an eyebrow.}
3efc260dc2c8847e444a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{你带着女人要的巨魔皮回来，却发现这里多了些人。几个男男女女到处闲逛，翻找沼泽，吃着蘑菇。他们问你是不是来帮忙找克拉肯的。你板着脸反问，他们是不是也想来分钱，因为你可没打算跟谁分享报酬。女人扬声招呼你，跑了过来，歪过头，把头发里的沼泽泥水挤出来，像在拧一块脏抹布。%SPEECH_ON%那是我要的……对，就是那些！%SPEECH_OFF%她打个响指，几个帮手便把皮子搬走。你问这些人究竟是干什么的。她耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%就这么陆续来了呗。他们说，星辰指引他们来这儿，我也没什么好质疑的。至于钱，放心，我欠你的不会拿去付给他们。他们能待在这里就很开心，远离外头的一切，最好永远都别再回去。%SPEECH_OFF%你扬起了眉毛。}

902d3d8d1da18719a5d7.source: So the deal is done then?
902d3d8d1da18719a5d7.translation: 这么说，这笔买卖算结清了？

7d6e97f51f56cd21daad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{With the hides delivered, you ask for what you're owed. She flips you another signet as though you were a beggar and then waves for you toward her books. As you walk over, you see the helpers cutting up the unholds' hides. They seem to be tailoring them as cloaks. The woman talks.%SPEECH_ON%I think we're closer to the awakening. The helpers here said they saw stars, but I think what they really saw were fireflies. I see them sometimes myself. Little bugs that glow in the dark. I've tried to capture a few, but they keep winking away.%SPEECH_OFF%Right. You ask for your payment. Again. She answers by reopening that old tome and looking at the drawing of the sailors being attacked by the kraken.%SPEECH_ON%With so much help around I have had more time to delve into the books, and in that time I noticed something. What do you see in this picture? Look closely now.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at it, but shrug. She drags her finger across the particularities of the drawing, as though her narration were etching it there and then.%SPEECH_ON%Moonlight. This battle occurred at night. What are these here, flying above the fight? Seagulls? No. Those are bats. What in the hells are bats doing flittering around in the middle of the ocean? And then there's this man here, at the helm of the ship, with the long ears and the black cloak. An interesting figure, no? And then there's this, a few pages down, a record of, I quote, 'a vagabond who threw bats out of his cloak to mask his escape'. Rather particular, no? I think these were called Necrosavants. Ancient ones. And I think they weren't ambushed by the kraken. I think they were hunting it.%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you ask what she needs. The woman claps the book closed.%SPEECH_ON%Depends if they exist or not, for with mine own eyes I have not witnessed them, but in my days I have seen the shamans and the magicians with their strange glittery ashes. Perhaps trickery, perhaps not. Bring me %remains% ash piles of these nightmen and we may have our kraken yet.%SPEECH_OFF%The woman excitedly stuffs her face with more mushrooms. She pauses, grinning with black caps for teeth.%SPEECH_ON%And then you'll have your crowns, too, of course.%SPEECH_OFF%}
7d6e97f51f56cd21daad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{交出兽皮后，你索要应得的报酬。她又扔来一枚印章戒指，像在打发乞丐，接着招手叫你去书旁。走过去时，你看见帮工正在裁剪巨魔皮，似乎要做成斗篷。女人开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%我想，离苏醒越来越近了。帮工们说看见了星星，可我觉得，他们真正看见的是萤火虫。我自己有时也能看见，那种在黑暗里发光的小虫。我试着抓过几只，可它们总是一闪就没了。%SPEECH_OFF%好吧。你再次索要报酬。她却重新翻开那本古书，望着水手遭克拉肯袭击的插图。%SPEECH_ON%如今帮手多了，我有更多时间钻研书本，也因此注意到一点。你在这幅图里看见什么？仔细看。%SPEECH_OFF%你盯了一阵，只能耸肩。她的手指划过画上的细节，仿佛讲到哪里，哪里才刚刚被刻出来。%SPEECH_ON%月光。这场战斗发生在夜里。上面这些，在战场上飞的是什么？海鸥？不，是蝙蝠。蝙蝠在大海中央飞来飞去，究竟搞什么鬼？还有这里，掌舵的这个人，长耳朵，黑斗篷。有意思的人物，对吧？再往后翻几页，还有一条记载，我照着念：“一个流浪者从斗篷里抛出蝙蝠，掩护自己逃离。”相当特别，不是吗？我想，它们被称为死灵剑士，古老的存在。而我觉得，它们不是遭克拉肯伏击，而是在猎杀它。%SPEECH_OFF%你叹口气，问她需要什么。女人啪地合上书。%SPEECH_ON%得看它们究竟存不存在，我可没亲眼见过。不过，这些年我见过萨满和法师，带着奇怪的闪光灰烬。也许是把戏，也许不是。给我带来%remains%堆这种夜行者的灰烬，我们或许真能找到克拉肯。%SPEECH_OFF%女人兴奋地又往嘴里塞了些蘑菇。她停下来，咧嘴一笑，黑色菌盖代替了牙齿。%SPEECH_ON%当然，到时候，你也会拿到克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1c070ba370b7b223d1c3.translation: 尘归尘，如今又得去寻尘。

021f029f96e7cf007a53.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{With all the time spent there, you thought this place an increasingly familiar mire, but the swamp suddenly feels strange and foreign, like walking into an old bedroom only to know something has been moved around.

You find the woman standing at a distance, a formation of her helpers behind her. They're all wearing cloaks made of unhold hides. They're crouching before bulbs of green lights, cupping them in their hands, and you can see slivers of grins brokered in each viridian sheen, rinds of lips hissing softly in fading sanity. The woman's books and tomes and papers are littered all around. A fog lingers, and it has brought with it a horrible stench. You ask where your money is. The woman grins and her eyes are jaundiced and her lips parched and splintered and mushrooms bits are smattered across her cheeks.%SPEECH_ON%The sellsword wants his crowns! There is nothing here but escape! Escape from everything everywhere!%SPEECH_OFF%}
021f029f96e7cf007a53.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_120.png[/img]{在这里来回许多次，你本以为自己已越来越熟悉这片泥沼。可此刻，沼泽突然显得陌生而古怪，像走进旧卧室，却立刻知道里面有什么被挪动了。

女人站在远处，身后是列成阵形的帮手。他们全披着巨魔皮制成的斗篷，蹲在一团团绿光前，双手捧着它们。每一道碧绿光泽里都映出狭窄的笑容，嘴唇干硬如壳，随着理智消退，轻轻嘶鸣。女人的书册与纸张散落各处，雾气久久不散，带来一股可怕恶臭。你问，自己的钱在哪里。女人咧嘴笑了，眼白发黄，嘴唇干裂，脸颊沾满蘑菇碎屑。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵想要他的克朗！这里唯有逃离！逃离万事万物，逃离天涯海角！%SPEECH_OFF%}

5b78f977e3561bd32175.source: I demand to be paid right now.

a237483dd4f7b73e3be2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_103.png[/img]{You watch as one of the helpers suddenly lifts into the air, and in the green light you see the slick tentacle drag him backward and it seems as though the earth itself opens up, and a thousand wet boughs and branches crinkle and drip, and rows upon rows of fangs bristle, clattering against one another as though shouldering for a slice, and the helper is thrown into it the maw and the gums twist and he is disrobed and defleshed and delimbed and destroyed. The woman chomps on another mushroom and then her hands caress bulbs of green, and you can see the tentacles slithering beneath each.%SPEECH_ON%Join us, sellsword! Let the Beast of Beasts have its feast!%SPEECH_OFF%}
a237483dd4f7b73e3be2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_103.png[/img]{你眼看着一名帮手突然腾空而起。绿光下，一条湿滑的触手拽着他向后拖去，仿佛连大地都随之裂开。无数潮湿的枝杈般的东西扭曲、滴水，一排排獠牙竖起，彼此碰撞，好似都想抢先分得一口血肉。那帮手被抛进巨口，蠕动的牙龈瞬间将他剥去衣衫、撕开皮肉、扯断四肢，吞噬殆尽。女人又嚼起一朵蘑菇，双手轻抚那些泛着绿光的圆球。你看得见，每一颗下面都有触手游动。%SPEECH_ON%加入我们吧，佣兵！让万兽之王享用它的盛宴！%SPEECH_OFF%}

8fa3a7c2bf1dbf291d29.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_101.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%It's disappointing.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% says as he looks at the slain corpses. He snorts and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Don't think disappointing is the word for it, though. They're just lying there, bones and coats, like we'd fought a closet. No flesh, no blood. It's unsatisfying. And knowing that, thinking it true, well that unnerves me.%SPEECH_OFF%You got nothing to say to such things other than there's a kernel of truth in the matter. If it weren't the issuances of its lust, why else the vigor for violence? Another sellsword calls you over, interrupting any solemn introspection.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, come have a look.%SPEECH_OFF%You head over and spot a skull sitting in the bed of pauldrons like an egg in the bosom of a well-endowed southerner. The rest of its body is battered and thrown to the winds as far as you can tell. What remains is a decadent slab of chest armor. It is covered in glyphs and treatments, fortunes and historical retellings, and is embroidered with red tassels and combs made of bristly hair. You touch the metal and the second you do the skull beside it powders and blows away. The mercenary seeing this shrugs rather sheepishly.%SPEECH_ON%If you got magical powers I won't tell no one.%SPEECH_OFF%You slug the sellsword in the shoulder and tell him to the load armor into the inventory for later allocation.}
8fa3a7c2bf1dbf291d29.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_101.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%真让人失望。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%看着被杀倒的尸骸说道。他哼了一声，啐了口唾沫。%SPEECH_ON%不过，“失望”好像也不太对。它们就这么躺着，只剩骨头和衣服，好像我们刚跟一个衣柜打了仗。没有肉，没有血，一点也不痛快。而知道自己竟这么想，才真让我心里发毛。%SPEECH_OFF%你对此没什么可说的，只能承认，他的话里有几分道理。若非为了满足某种欲望，人又为何如此热衷暴力？另一名佣兵叫你过去，打断了这番沉重的自省。%SPEECH_ON%长官，过来看看。%SPEECH_OFF%你走过去，发现一颗头骨嵌在肩甲之间，像一枚鸡蛋搁在丰腴南方女人的胸口。据你所见，其余躯体早已被打碎，散落四方。留下的是一件极尽奢华的胸甲，表面满是符文与饰纹，刻着祝祷与历史传说，还缀有红色流苏，以及刚毛制成的梳状饰物。你刚碰上金属，旁边的头骨便化作粉末，被风吹散。目睹这一幕的佣兵讪讪地耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%你要是会魔法，我不会告诉别人。%SPEECH_OFF%你往他肩上捶了一拳，叫他把盔甲收进库存，留待日后分配。}

ee07f7eeb6d0d2529198.source: I should take a closer look at that armor.

808f878820c5815da968.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_101.png[/img]{As the men pack up to leave, you hear a voice behind you.%SPEECH_ON%...never were...%SPEECH_OFF%You turn back and the world darkens in a shrouded tunnel, your men and their voices fading into the dark until all that remains is an elderly man and a light at the end of all that black, an unsteady flicker and a warble of flesh trying to hold it. You approach slowly, getting bearing on the speaker. It is a shrewd, elderly man, bent at the waist and bent again at the back, and his arms are thinner than a sword's hilt. You look back to see the world of dark had followed you forward, nothing behind but blackness. Looking forward again, the man is suddenly before you. He looks so similar, like someone you had seen in the past and yet had forgotten, perhaps someone you had seen in your childhood, a dying uncle glimpsed on your fourth winter and his last. He is holding the candlestick with the wax drooping over his knuckles and rolling down his wrist.%SPEECH_ON%You never were meant to be... never were... never were... never were meant to be, you, the one they call the False King.%SPEECH_OFF%You wake on the ground. A mercenaries are looking down at you with concerned stares.%SPEECH_ON%Uhh, you alright captain?%SPEECH_OFF%Getting up, you tell them that you were just fell into a quick nap. You look back at the Black Monolith and you can see yourself in the obelisk's reflection, and it is your reflection alone.}
808f878820c5815da968.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_101.png[/img]{弟兄们收拾行装准备离开时，你听见身后传来一个声音。%SPEECH_ON%……从来都不是……%SPEECH_OFF%你转过身，世界暗了下去，仿佛被罩进一条幽深隧道。弟兄们连同他们的声音渐渐隐没，最后只剩一个老人，以及黑暗尽头的一点光。那光摇曳不定，一双衰弱的手正颤抖着竭力托住它。你慢慢走近，辨认说话的人。他是个神情精明的老者，腰弯着，背又弯下一层，胳膊比剑柄还细。你回头，发现黑暗随着你一同向前，身后只剩漆黑。再转回来，老人已倏然到了面前。他如此眼熟，像一个你早年见过、后来遗忘的人，也许是在童年见过的亲人：你四岁那年冬天，瞥见一个垂死的叔父，那也是他最后的冬天。他握着烛台，蜡滴淌过指节，沿手腕滚落。%SPEECH_ON%你本就不该是……从来不该……从来不该……你本就不该成为那个人，那个被称为伪王的人。%SPEECH_OFF%你在地上醒来，佣兵们正关切地俯视着你。%SPEECH_ON%呃，团长，你没事吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你起身，告诉他们，自己只是忽然打了个盹。回头望向Black Monolith，你能在碑身上看见自己的倒影，而且只有你一个人的倒影。}

d8a40e6f042a48b2fcbc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_101.png[/img]{From a distance, the Black Monolith looked like a black tower tilting from the earth. The sky above was without blemish, as though the clouds and the birds were circumventing some unseen mountain. A numbness settled its hinterland, terra neither dying nor growing, and a cruel silence left the listless life worse than no life at all. Adventurers went to it and did not return. Stories of their demise stacked high until their absence shielded the monolith whole, clothing it in such fear and menace no one dared go near.

 But now the %companyname% stands before the obelisk like ants at the steel of a staked sword. Here you see that the structure was not built upon the earth at all: the obelisk rests in the pit of an abandoned quarry. Roads and paths sidewinder into the depths like some great and hollow terra socket. Ropes carrying buckets hang across every gap, innumerable pails of dirt left listing like fireless lanterns on a festive night. More bindings hold the frames of bridges, the walkway planks long since fallen, and more yet wrap about the monolith as though a great bevy of men had attempted to pull it down or perhaps even correct its tilt. At the bottom of this abandoned pit is the base of the monolith, but to you this is only a guess. It has every appearance of never stopping its descent into the very earth and whatever is below. Shovels and pickaxes litter about its obsidian walls with soil still clumped on their metals. %randombrother% nods at the scene.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like whoever was digging there got interrupted.%SPEECH_OFF%The man's words carry far into the quarry and there become so presently shaped in echo that you just about watch them go. Looking back, you see that the silence itself has followed you in, but even here at the edge of the pit it is pensive and cut with ease. The decision to enter the quarry rests heavy on your shoulders.}
d8a40e6f042a48b2fcbc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_101.png[/img]{从远处看，Black Monolith像一座斜斜刺出大地的黑塔。上方天空一片澄澈，仿佛云朵与飞鸟都在绕开一座无形的山。周遭陷入麻木，土地既不衰败，也不生长；残酷的寂静笼罩着无精打采的生灵，竟比毫无生命还要糟糕。冒险者前往那里，再未归来。关于他们死亡的故事越积越多，最终，他们的缺席成了巨石碑的屏障，披上恐惧与凶险，令所有人望而却步。

如今，%companyname%却站在这方尖碑前，渺小得如同插地长剑旁的蚂蚁。到了近处，你才看清，它根本不是建在地面上的，而是坐落于一座废弃采石场的深坑中。道路与小径蜿蜒盘入深处，像深入大地空洞的眼窝。绳索横跨每一道沟壑，吊着无数土桶，歪斜悬垂，仿佛节庆之夜未曾点亮的灯笼。还有绳索绑着桥架，桥面的木板却早已坠落；另一些则缠在巨石碑上，仿佛许多人曾试图将它拉倒，或矫正它的倾斜。废弃深坑的底部就是石碑基座——至少，你猜是这样。它看上去像是永无止境地深入地下，延伸向更下方不知何物的所在。黑曜石壁旁散落着铁锹与镐头，金属上还粘着土块。%randombrother%朝眼前景象点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%看来，挖到这儿的人突然被什么打断了。%SPEECH_OFF%他的声音传入采石场深处，化作如此分明的回声，你几乎能看见它离去的形状。回望来路，你发现寂静本身也跟了进来，可即便在坑边，它也像正凝神等待，稍一出声就会被划破。是否进入采石场，这个决定沉沉压在你肩上。}

19ed805c0ba816fb3134.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_101.png[/img]{Halfway into the quarry and rounding a long bend, you notice a series of hallways cut into the lower wall. You cast up a fist. The company seizes, bumbling into one another as the formation comes to a stop. %randombrother% asks what's wrong. You put a finger to your lips. 

 With the lightest of steps you approach one of the ropes strung between this level and the very bottom of the pit. A pail filled with soil totters the tether as though jittered by your appearance. The pulley used to draw it up and down has long since rusted over. You draw your sword and cut the rope. The binding shoots back like a whip and the bucket plummets. It clatters side to side off the rocks until striking the ground with a metal pang and a cloud of dust. And just like that, the silence is gone.

 Pale men flood out of the hallways below, a stream of malignant miners and ditch diggers in haggard drawers and boots and capes of shredded shirts, shambling back out as though returning to some long gone work left incomplete. You try and count their numbers but are mightily distracted when a throng of armored soldiers march out behind the mob, this outfit carrying polearms, shields, spears and, most dangerously of all, a sense of cohesion.

 No point in running out of the quarry. Nothing in the land to run to. When you look back at the men, they're already drawing out their weapons. %randombrother% nods.%SPEECH_ON%With you to the end, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%}
19ed805c0ba816fb3134.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_101.png[/img]{深入采石场半途，绕过一道长弯，你发现下层岩壁里凿着一连串通道。你举起拳头，战团骤然停步，队列里几个人撞成一团。%randombrother%问怎么了，你把一根手指竖在唇前。 

 你放轻脚步，走近一根从这一层垂向坑底的绳索。一只装满土的桶挂在绳上微微晃动，仿佛被你的出现惊扰。升降用的滑轮早已锈透。你拔剑割断绳子，断索如鞭般抽回，桶则急坠而下，左右撞着岩石，最后铛地砸到地面，激起一片尘土。就这样，寂静被打破了。

 苍白的人影从下方通道里涌出，一股凶恶的矿工与掘沟者汇成的人流，穿着破烂裤子和靴子，碎衬衣像披风般挂在身上，拖着脚步走来，仿佛要重新干起早已荒废的未竟工作。你想数清它们的数量，却被随后走出的另一群人牢牢吸引：一队披甲士兵，手持长柄武器、盾牌与长矛。最危险的是，它们步调一致，俨然一支军队。

 逃出采石场也没有意义，这片土地上根本无处可逃。你回头看向弟兄们，他们已纷纷拔出武器。%randombrother%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%团长，陪你走到最后。%SPEECH_OFF%}

02c0dbc23b23d6a2fe9f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{The waterwheel totters at the hinges as its buckets dip and draw water. Attached to its side is a stonewalled abode with a chimney piping bulbs of black. There are pelts and traps hanging outside on the walls, and an oaken chair sets on the porch. Its windows are too blurry to look through, but you can hear the mill inside rising and churning with wooden groans. Drawing your sword, you step up to the porch and open the door.

 A man welcomes you in the first and only room there is. He's standing beside the mill well, running his hand through the grains. He is an elderly fellow yet of modest stature, as though time had no warrant for his posture or abilities. There is a sword hilt hanging above the fireplace. Its glint is unmistakably rich and the old man regards your stare with a warm smile.%SPEECH_ON%Only those who are worthy may have the hilt of the %weapon%. You, stranger, are not.%SPEECH_OFF%}
02c0dbc23b23d6a2fe9f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{水轮摇晃着转动，一格格水斗没入水中，舀水而起。旁边连着一座石墙小屋，烟囱正吐出团团黑烟。外墙挂着皮毛与捕兽夹，门廊上摆着一张橡木椅。窗户模糊得看不清里面，却能听见磨坊运转，木头嘎吱作响。你拔出剑，踏上门廊，推开了门。

 屋里只有一个房间，一名男子迎接了你。他站在磨机的槽边，手从谷粒间缓缓拂过。虽然年迈，他的身形仍然挺拔匀称，仿佛岁月对他的体态和身手都无权过问。壁炉上方悬着一柄剑柄，那光泽一看便知价值不菲。老人顺着你的目光望去，露出温和的笑容。%SPEECH_ON%唯有配得上的人，才能拥有%weapon%的剑柄。陌生人，你还不配。%SPEECH_OFF%}

921e315081f8f15e6ece.source: This old man ain't stopping me.
