a5520491f5898ed0c843.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{You step forward and threaten the man to stand aside or face your steel. He waves his hand and your feet leave the ground. A rush of wind slams you against the wall with such force you hear silverware clattering and dust streams down from the ceiling. The old man looks at you as calmly as the second you walked through his door.%SPEECH_ON%Only the worthy. Do you understand?%SPEECH_OFF%There's no other answer here than to nod in agreement. The old man's hand goes to his side and you fall to the floor. You pick up your sword, making sure he understands you're only sheathing it. You ask what would make you worthy. The old man smiles again.%SPEECH_ON%My only son was worthy. He left to fight the great beast. Avenge him and ye shall be worthy.%SPEECH_OFF%You're shunted from the home and the door slams behind you. Seems you have a quest, though you've not even the faintest notion of a compass's northern point to know where to go with it.}
a5520491f5898ed0c843.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{你上前一步，威胁老人让开，否则就尝尝刀锋。他一挥手，你的双脚便离开地面。一股疾风将你狠狠拍在墙上，震得餐具叮当乱响，天花板上尘土簌簌落下。老人望着你，依旧像你刚进门时那般平静。%SPEECH_ON%只有配得上的人，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%此刻除了点头，你别无选择。老人垂下手，你便跌落地板。你捡起剑，特意让他看清，自己只是要收剑入鞘。你问，如何才算配得上。他再次微笑。%SPEECH_ON%我唯一的儿子配得上。他出门讨伐巨兽去了。替他报仇，你也就配得上。%SPEECH_OFF%你被一股力量推出屋子，门在身后砰然关上。看来你接了桩差事，可该往哪儿走，却连个方向都摸不着。}

d467c98093e5abdfd9e6.source: We'll have to resolve it ourselves.
d467c98093e5abdfd9e6.translation: 只好由我们自己解决了。

455b9668a144973e42c7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{The old man stares into the mill. His hand rises up and a swarm of grain revolves around his fingertips like bees around the buds of sugarcane.%SPEECH_ON%My only son departed to slay the great beast. His squire returned the hilt to me, but the blade was gone. Avenge my son, and you shall be worthy yet, stranger.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask where the beast is and the man puts his hand into the millwork again.%SPEECH_ON%If only I knew. I trust you will find out, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%Your feet suddenly slide back across the floor and to the porch and onto the grass. The door slams in front of you and won't be opened again. Seems you've unwittingly taken up a quest, or perhaps one to keep on the side.}
455b9668a144973e42c7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{老人望着磨坊深处，抬起一只手。谷粒成群地绕着他的指尖盘旋，如同围着甘蔗嫩芽飞舞的蜜蜂。%SPEECH_ON%我唯一的儿子出门去讨伐巨兽。他的侍从把剑柄带了回来，剑刃却不知所踪。替我儿子报仇，你才配得上它，陌生人。%SPEECH_OFF%你问巨兽在哪里，老人又把手伸进磨坊的机关。%SPEECH_ON%我要是知道就好了。我相信你能找到它，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你的双脚忽然不由自主地向后滑去，穿过地板，退出门廊，落到了草地上。大门在你面前砰然关上，任你怎么推也不再开启。看来你莫名其妙地接了桩差事，或许可以留待日后再办。}

5c6aed2ced2aa67a5982.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{The elderly man is already waiting for you when you enter. He turns rather rapidly as though interrupted.%SPEECH_ON%So you have returned! And have you succeeded? Have you avenged my boy? Are you, sellsword, worthy?%SPEECH_OFF%}
5c6aed2ced2aa67a5982.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{你进去时，老人已经在等着了。他猛地转过身，仿佛被人打断了什么。%SPEECH_ON%你回来了！成了吗？替我儿子报仇了吗？佣兵，你配得上吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

b5af2b5ea050a378d587.translation: 有了这个，我算有资格了吗？

312077aeee21970ce5a3.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{The waterwheel totters at the hinges as its buckets dip and draw water. Attached to its side is a stonewalled abode with a chimney piping bulbs of black. There are pelts and traps hanging outside on the walls, and an oaken chair sets on the porch. Its windows are too blurry to look through, but you can hear the mill inside rising and churning with wooden groans. Drawing your sword, you step up to the porch and open the door.

 A man welcomes you in the first and only room there is. He's standing beside the mill well, running his hand through the grains. He is an elderly fellow yet of modest stature, as though time had no warrant for his posture or abilities. There is a sword hilt hanging above the fireplace, and its glint is unmistakably rich and the old man regards your stare with a warm smile.%SPEECH_ON%Only those who are worthy may have the hilt of the %weapon%. Only those who avenge my son and bring me his blade will be worthy. To do that, you would need to find the beast.%SPEECH_OFF%}
312077aeee21970ce5a3.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{水轮摇晃着转动，一格格水斗没入水中，舀水而起。旁边连着一座石墙小屋，烟囱正吐出团团黑烟。外墙挂着皮毛与捕兽夹，门廊上摆着一张橡木椅。窗户模糊得看不清里面，却能听见磨坊运转，木头嘎吱作响。你拔出剑，踏上门廊，推开了门。

 屋里只有一个房间，一名男子迎接了你。他站在磨机的槽边，手从谷粒间缓缓拂过。虽然年迈，他的身形仍然挺拔匀称，仿佛岁月对他的体态和身手都无权过问。壁炉上方悬着一柄剑柄，那光泽一看便知价值不菲。老人顺着你的目光望去，露出温和的笑容。%SPEECH_ON%唯有配得上的人，才能拥有%weapon%的剑柄。替我儿子报仇，再将他的剑刃带回来，才算配得上。而要做到这些，你得先找到那头巨兽。%SPEECH_OFF%}

75f6e3670c04d9a3744b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{The blade of the %weapon% vibrates and hums. You hold it forward in both hands, the steel wobbling ever so slightly on your fingers. Smiling once more, the elder nods and turns his hand to the hanging hilt. It lifts up off its holder and floats across the room to your hands. There it turns aside and melds with the steel, becoming whole with a flash of orange and blue. It is one of the most incredible blades you've ever seen with glyphs of moons and stars flaring along the fuller. When you look up, you can see through the elder's chest as he steadily fades away.%SPEECH_ON%My son has been avenged. His spirit can rest, and now so can mine.%SPEECH_OFF%You watch as the finished sword lifts into the air and rotates with the steel pointed down. The cupboards burst open and strips of leather fly out and clasp shots of bindings that draw together to complete a sheathe.}
75f6e3670c04d9a3744b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{%weapon%的剑刃轻颤着发出嗡鸣。你双手托住它，向前递去，钢刃在指间微微摇动。老人再次微笑，点点头，向悬挂的剑柄伸出手。剑柄脱离支架，飘过房间，来到你手中，旋转着与剑刃接合。橙蓝光芒一闪，长剑终于完整。那是你见过最惊人的剑之一，剑身血槽里，星月符文熠熠生辉。你抬起头，竟已能透过老人的胸膛看见身后，他正渐渐消散。%SPEECH_ON%我儿子的仇已经报了。他的灵魂可以安息，如今，我也可以了。%SPEECH_OFF%你看着修复的长剑升到半空，缓缓转动，剑尖向下。柜门猛然弹开，条条皮革飞出，与扣件和系带绞合收拢，织成了一具完整的剑鞘。}

1377cab2359bf3c5c29b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{The %weapon% then falls and you reach to catch it, but a ghostly hand steals it away. You look up to see the elder unsheathing the blade, revealing its fire and ice as though he brokered a new day and gloomy night in the very spectrum of its steel. He chokes with laughter.%SPEECH_ON%'Avenge my son!' 'Be worthy!' Idle doings for simpletons. You did well to chase the carrot, sellsword, and for that I will kill you quick.%SPEECH_OFF%Pauldrons and bracers and a chest plate rise out of the mill well, sheets of grain streaming off them to reveal their garish shapes, and the metals twist and float to the elder, fiercely striking his body as though they meant to armor the very anvil that helped craft them. The suit of steel comes together as its occupant croaks with laughter. Hands grab you by your shoulders and drag you out of the house. You are shielded by the %companyname%. The elder geist turns his head.%SPEECH_ON%A mob of morons, is it? Depart, the lot of you, and you shall be spared. I only ask that you leave me the captain as I have already promised his demise.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% draws his weapon and the rest of the company follows suit. The elder holds up the crepuscular sword in return. Though the steel is firmly real, the elder's body is rippling to and fro like a thinly veiled curtain on a moonlit night. He sighs and parts of blue ether drift from his lips. He turns the blade so its edge faces you.%SPEECH_ON%So be it.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1377cab2359bf3c5c29b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_109.png[/img]{%weapon%随即落下，你伸手去接，一只幽灵般的手却抢先夺走。你抬头，看见老人抽剑出鞘，显露其中的火与冰，仿佛他在钢刃的光谱中，同时划开了新生白昼与阴郁长夜。他笑得喉头发哑。%SPEECH_ON%“替我儿子报仇！”“证明你配得上！”给傻瓜找点闲事罢了。佣兵，你追着那根胡萝卜跑得不错，作为奖赏，我会让你死得痛快。%SPEECH_OFF%肩甲、护臂和胸甲从磨坊井中升起，谷粒成片滑落，露出华而诡异的轮廓。金属扭转着飘向老人，猛烈撞上他的身体，仿佛要给锻造自己的铁砧披上盔甲。整套钢甲拼合之时，里面的人仍在嘶哑地笑。一双手抓住你的肩膀，将你拖出屋外，%companyname%的弟兄们挡在你前面。老人模样的怨魂转过头。%SPEECH_ON%一群蠢货，是吗？你们全都走，我可以饶命。只需把团长留下，我已经许诺，要让他死。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%拔出武器，其余弟兄纷纷效仿。老人举起那柄暮色长剑回应。钢刃确是真实之物，可老人的身体却来回波动，像月夜里一层轻薄的纱帘。他叹了口气，蓝色幽雾从唇边散出。他转动剑身，让刃锋正对你。%SPEECH_ON%那就如此吧。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f3d268b969b4fa6ba919.source: How do you know who I am?

44fffbe1dd0b4344d464.source: Why did you call me the False King?

3d3e041153b90cbef88d.source: What is it that I dream of?

c0b337724428ea347500.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{The last of the witches is slain and you have their corpses mutilated for good measure. Ears. Lips. Noses. Toes. All of them cut off. Their bags are emptied out and the items crushed into powder and covered in dust. Fleshy bits or animal parts are dumped into a pile and promptly burned. As the fire rises, the hexen from the hut seemingly appears out of nowhere and takes you by the arm. Your men draw their swords, but you hold your hand up. You tell them to keep salting the earth, so to speak, and as you enter the hut you take a look back to see a few of the men pissing on the embers of the fire.

 Inside the hut you sit where you had before. On the table you find something rolled up in a handkerchief and the witch pinches its corner and rolls it between her finger and thumb. She looks up and tips her chin forward and turns her hands palms up.}
c0b337724428ea347500.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{最后一个女巫倒下后，你还让人毁掉尸体，以绝后患。耳朵、嘴唇、鼻子、脚趾，全都割下。她们的袋子被倒空，里面的东西砸成粉末，再覆上尘土。肉块和动物残骸堆在一起，当即焚烧。火焰升起时，小屋里的女巫仿佛凭空出现，挽住了你的胳膊。弟兄们纷纷拔剑，你却抬手制止，让他们继续把这里清理干净，别留下祸根。跟她进屋时，你回头看了一眼，几个弟兄正往余烬上撒尿。

 进屋后，你坐回先前的位置。桌上放着一件裹在手帕里的东西，女巫捏住帕角，在拇指与食指间轻轻捻动。她抬头看向你，下巴朝前一扬，翻过双手，掌心向上。}

6d2f1591df6dfab72350.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{The witch smiles.%SPEECH_ON%An old hag in a forest hut. Everything else is hearsay.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at her long enough to see there's little fruit to bear in chasing this question further.}
6d2f1591df6dfab72350.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{女巫微微一笑。%SPEECH_ON%我就是个住在林中小屋的老太婆。其余都是传言。%SPEECH_OFF%你盯了她好一会儿，终于明白，这个问题再追下去也问不出什么。}

1ae344257be14db45997.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{She stares at the wrapped item.%SPEECH_ON%I don't even know your name, sellsword, and I haven't the slightest inclination to begin to care. It is not a matter of who you are, but what you are.%SPEECH_OFF%She turns her hands as though they were following a tune.%SPEECH_ON%The blood of the ancients resides within you. It resides within us all, but you in particular, well.%SPEECH_OFF%Her nose crinkles as she snorts, and she exhales she grins madly.%SPEECH_ON%It is ever so there. And if I can smell it, then the whole world can smell it.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1ae344257be14db45997.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{她盯着包裹中的东西。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我连你的名字都不知道，也丝毫不想知道。要紧的不是你是谁，而是你是什么。%SPEECH_OFF%她转动双手，仿佛在随着某段曲调起舞。%SPEECH_ON%你体内流着古人的血。我们每个人都有，可你，尤其是你，嗯……%SPEECH_OFF%她皱鼻嗅了嗅，呼气时露出疯狂的笑。%SPEECH_ON%那血味，浓得很。我闻得到，整个世界也就闻得到。%SPEECH_OFF%}

9afb7e2f869d7fad0136.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{She taps the handkerchief and whatever is beneath raps the table. She answers.%SPEECH_ON%The ancients were men before our time. Truly, truly before our time. Imagine a kingdom, now imagine a kingdom that ruled kingdoms. An empire, that's correct. Now imagine an empire that ruled empires. Unfathomable power such as that leaves the world with great vengeance, and will spend its dying days ruining those which have ruined it.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if the empire is dead. The witch smiles.%SPEECH_ON%I suspect not, but I do not truly know.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9afb7e2f869d7fad0136.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{她敲了敲手帕，底下那东西也随之叩响桌面。她答道：%SPEECH_ON%古人活在我们的时代之前，远得多，远得多。想一个王国，再想一个统治诸多王国的王国。没错，就是帝国。现在，再想一个统治诸多帝国的帝国。如此不可想象的力量，离开这世界时必然满怀怨愤，并会用最后的时日摧毁那些毁了它的人。%SPEECH_OFF%你问那个帝国是否已经死了。女巫笑了。%SPEECH_ON%我猜没有，可我也说不准。%SPEECH_OFF%}

eaf308676a79344d4a62.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{Shrugging and leaning back, the hexen asks you to repeat the name. 'Davkul.' She shakes her head.%SPEECH_ON%I have heard nothing about this Davkul. A supposed god you say? Well, he has not spoken to me.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at her and try to pry a hidden truth from her eyes, but she seems earnest in her response and you change the subject.}
eaf308676a79344d4a62.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{女巫耸耸肩，向后靠去，让你再说一遍那个名字。“达夫库尔。”她摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我没听说过什么达夫库尔。你说是个神？反正他没跟我说过话。%SPEECH_OFF%你盯着她，想从眼睛里挖出藏着的真相，可她看起来答得很诚恳，你只好换了话题。}

c8cfb13e21724f9f3341.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{The hexen cackles.%SPEECH_ON%I wish! Have you seen what orcs got between their legs? Wouldn't mind a ride on that if I knew it wouldn't tear me in half and fark one end while wearing the other for a glove!%SPEECH_OFF%You raise an eyebrow and nod as though to say 'of course.'}
c8cfb13e21724f9f3341.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{女巫咯咯大笑。%SPEECH_ON%我倒想呢！你见过兽人两腿之间那东西吗？要是能保证它不会把我撕成两半，一半拿来泄欲，另一半当手套，我还真不介意骑上一回！%SPEECH_OFF%你挑起眉毛，点了点头，像是在说“那当然”。}

ffb638b1c605ef59abdb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{For the first time there is a crack in the witch's facade. She purses her lips.%SPEECH_ON%When did I call you that?%SPEECH_OFF%You point to the door and then to the table. You answer.%SPEECH_ON%I walked in here and you said I'd seek the truth, that you know what the False King dreams of.%SPEECH_OFF%The hexen taps the handkerchief rather mindlessly. She looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Then you have my apologies, sellsword, I remember no such thing. I am but a fragile and old woman, older than I look, and I'm not being cheeky about that.%SPEECH_OFF%You press her on the matter, but she only stonewalls you further.}
ffb638b1c605ef59abdb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{女巫的镇定头一回露出破绽。她抿起嘴唇。%SPEECH_ON%我什么时候那样叫过你？%SPEECH_OFF%你先指指门，又指向桌子，回答道。%SPEECH_ON%我走进这里时，你说我会追寻真相，还说你知道伪王梦见了什么。%SPEECH_OFF%女巫漫不经心地轻敲手帕，随后抬头。%SPEECH_ON%那我向你道歉，佣兵。我完全不记得这回事。我不过是个衰弱的老妇，比看起来还老。这话可不是在跟你打趣。%SPEECH_OFF%你继续追问，她却更加不肯松口。}

83c9641d4b9822ad94fb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{The hexen leans forward. She puts her hands to your face and you feel the leathery fingers press deep into your cheeks like a half-dozen walnuts. They rub the corners of your eyes and tap your temples. All the while she is smiling, and then she pulls back.%SPEECH_ON%You go to the noblemen and the rich and they pay you gold and in return you risk life and limb and you slaughter and murder and kill all that you can, and there you are day after day, wondering if that's all you are good for, and afterward the highborn shut the door on you and your deeds, and you hear them inside having a grand time, music playing, womenfolk laughing, jesters joking, the festivities are riotous, and you are outside with a bag of gold in hand and its bloodslaked receipt, and you go down to the pub and buy yourself a whore and tip a coin to the minstrel for a song and you can taste a fine wine in even the cheapest of cellars, but there is no escape from that horrible feeling in the back of your head, that feeling you were born into fever and all this violence and death is not a means to an end, but the end itself. It is what you are and what you always will be.%SPEECH_OFF%She pauses. Sighs. Continues.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, the power of a lie is only equaled by one's desire to believe in it. You live a powerful lie, and such power will not go easily. I beg of you, be only what you can understand.%SPEECH_OFF%It was not yourself, or your weaponry, or the presence of your company whole which brought her fear, but only the dawning of some unknown realization as she speaks to you now.}
83c9641d4b9822ad94fb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{女巫俯身上前，双手捧住你的脸。皮革般粗硬的手指深深按进两颊，像半打核桃抵在上面。她揉着你的眼角，轻敲太阳穴，始终面带微笑，随后退开。%SPEECH_ON%你去找贵族和富人，他们给你金子，你便拿性命和四肢冒险，去屠戮、谋杀，杀尽一切能杀的。日复一日，你不禁怀疑，自己难道就只配干这个？事后，那些贵人把你和你的功劳一同关在门外。你听见里面尽情享乐，乐声流淌，女人欢笑，弄臣逗趣，盛宴热闹非凡。你却站在外面，手里一袋金子，还有那张血浸的收据。于是，你去酒馆，买个妓女，再给吟游诗人一枚硬币，换首歌听。即便在最便宜的地窖里，你也能尝出美酒滋味，却始终摆脱不了脑后那可怕的念头：你生来就染着一场高烧，这所有的暴力与死亡，并非通向目的的手段，而就是目的本身。那就是你，永远都是。%SPEECH_OFF%她停下来，叹息，又接着说。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，谎言有多大力量，只取决于人有多想相信。你活在一个强大的谎言里，而这样的力量，绝不会轻易离去。我求你，只做你能够理解的自己。%SPEECH_OFF%令她害怕的，并不是你，不是你的武器，也不是整支战团在场。只有此刻向你说话时，某个不知为何的领悟正在她心中浮现，才让她感到了恐惧。}

14b86f1d8f2bbb8d00fa.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{You stand up yelling at the woman for answers. She slaps you in the face and you stiffen and falter back a step. A drop of blood slips down your cheek and you catch it in your cuff. The witch grabs the handkerchief and throws it off, revealing the obsidian blade beneath. It is sharper than you remember, a vivid sliver of yourself running down the edge as though you cracked a door toward a mirror. The hexen sits back down and pushes the weapon across the table.%SPEECH_ON%No more questions, sellsword. There's only so much I know, and so much you need to know. We've made a deal and this is the end of it.%SPEECH_OFF%Taking the dagger, you ask what she did to it, but she refuses to answer. You then ask if there are more out there like her. She grins playfully.%SPEECH_ON%I pray there are not.%SPEECH_OFF%}
14b86f1d8f2bbb8d00fa.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{你站起身，大声逼问女人。她一巴掌扇在你脸上，你浑身一僵，踉跄着退了一步。一滴血沿着脸颊滑落，你用袖口接住。女巫抓起手帕掀开，露出底下的黑曜石刀。它比你记忆中更加锋利，刃口映出一道清晰的自身倒影，仿佛朝镜子推开了一条门缝。女巫重新坐下，将武器沿桌面推来。%SPEECH_ON%别再问了，佣兵。我知道的只有这么多，你该知道的也只有这么多。咱们的交易，到此结束。%SPEECH_OFF%你拿起匕首，问她对它做了什么，她却拒不回答。你又问，外面是否还有像她这样的人。她露出顽皮的笑。%SPEECH_ON%但愿没有。%SPEECH_OFF%}

eabe95925a9afbd67e23.source: We're done, then, and I shall take my leave.
eabe95925a9afbd67e23.translation: 既然事已办完，我就告辞了。

36a2d8a89be2e8fc9689.source: You've served your purpose, then. Die, witch!
36a2d8a89be2e8fc9689.translation: 那你也没用了。受死吧，女巫！

f3571a4db2adda26845e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{You bid the witch adieu and she says nothing more. Outside, the men ask what she said, while others making reference to sexual escapades. You think you're smirking, but you really don't know. The conversation has left you in a fog and from within the mist you only depend upon what you know: ordering the company back on the road.}
f3571a4db2adda26845e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{你向女巫道别，她没有再说话。出了门，弟兄们问她说了什么，也有人拿风流韵事开起玩笑。你觉得自己似乎在笑，却又说不准。这场谈话让你脑中雾气蒙蒙，而在迷雾里，你只能抓住自己熟悉的事：命令战团继续赶路。}

df531947a812bb71f0e1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{The witch folds her fingers and nods. You nod back. And then grab the obsidian dagger and plunge it into her chest. She bleeds like any man or woman you know. She coughs and chokes on her blood like any living being you know. And she reels backward, eyes wide with fear, like many you've known before. You draw the dagger out and kick her. She goes wailing and her hands reach out and drag down fistfuls of dreamcatchers and cobwebs alike and her elbow slaps a board of wooden cutlery and the utensils scatter all over the hut with hollow clattering. Weak fingers clasp a butterknife, her eyes piercing yours. She coughs once, twice. She drops the butterknife to pound her chest with a fist and a spurt of blood spurts onto her chin. She looks up.%SPEECH_ON%We had a deal, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%You sheathe the dagger and nod.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, you had a deal with a mercenary and you got what you wanted out of it. Myself? I had a deal with the world to get rid of you and your ilk whole. Nice talk and have a good life.%SPEECH_OFF%Gargling, the hexen's head lowers to the floor and her body goes limp. When you head outside the company asks what happened. You tell them to burn the hut and prepare to get back on the road.}
df531947a812bb71f0e1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{女巫交拢手指，点了点头。你也点头回应，接着一把抓起黑曜石匕首，扎进她的胸口。她像你认识的任何男人或女人一样流血，像任何活物一样咳嗽，被自己的血呛住；也像许多你曾见过的人一样，踉跄后退，双眼因恐惧而圆睁。你抽出匕首，踢了她一脚。她哀嚎着伸手乱抓，把捕梦网和蛛网一把把扯下来，手肘又撞翻盛着木制餐具的托板。刀叉匙勺撒满小屋，发出空洞的叮当声。她无力的手指攥住一把黄油刀，目光直刺着你。她咳了一下，又一下，丢开黄油刀，用拳头捶着胸口，一口血涌出来，溅上了下巴。她抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我们说好的。%SPEECH_OFF%你收起匕首，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，你跟佣兵做了交易，也拿到了想要的。至于我？我跟这世道约好了，要把你和你那一类东西清个干净。聊得愉快，祝你往后顺心。%SPEECH_OFF%女巫喉中咯咯作响，头垂落到地板上，身体软了下去。你走出门，弟兄们问里面出了什么事。你叫他们烧掉小屋，准备重新上路。}

26ba8275ff3adb23a1eb.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{You pause at the forest clearing. The hut before you stands like a mere crumb. It's so quaint and easily forgotten you wondered how it could survive, but perhaps its total banality and unassuming nature is itself a sort of armor. But you've been around this world long enough to know to trust your instinct, and right now your instinct is to wait.

 Soon enough, the hut's door pops open and an elderly woman hobbles out. She immediately waves in your direction.%SPEECH_ON%You, and only you.%SPEECH_OFF%Confused, you ask why just yourself, or more particularly why would you ever trust her to begin with. She smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Because I know what the False King dreams of at night.%SPEECH_OFF%The mercenaries around you turn about and ask what she said. You put a hand up and tell them to stay their ground while you go have a talk with the mysterious woman.}
26ba8275ff3adb23a1eb.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{你在林间空地前停下。眼前小屋小得像一粒碎屑，古朴而不起眼，几乎转眼就会被遗忘。你不禁好奇，它如何存续至今；可也许，正是这份平凡与毫不张扬，成了它的铠甲。你闯荡世间已久，知道该相信自己的直觉，而此刻，直觉让你等等。

 不多时，屋门忽然打开，一个老妇人蹒跚着走出来，立刻朝你这边招手。%SPEECH_ON%你来，只许你一个人。%SPEECH_OFF%你不解地问，为何非要你独自前去，更要紧的是，你凭什么相信她。她微微一笑。%SPEECH_ON%因为我知道，伪王夜里梦见了什么。%SPEECH_OFF%身边的佣兵转头问你，她说了什么。你抬手，让他们留在原地，自己过去与这神秘老妇谈谈。}

7c6b39aa35e65aeef7ca.source: Stay here and stay on guard.

bcaa32e588dd0a6a8620.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{You come in with your sword drawn just to find the woman offering you a bowl of stew. She suggests it is only rabbit and potatoes, and more the former than the latter. Sheathing your sword, you take the bowl and have a seat at a table with her opposite you. A couple of candles burn nearby, and there are glyphs painted on the walls in white, and similar shapes hang from the ceiling as dreamcatchers. The woman puts her elbows on the table. There are trinkets wound into her hair, clips of bird bones and feathers. She carries a weathered face, though her eyes are starkly young like pearls glimmering from the depths of a swamp.%SPEECH_ON%I knew you would come in, a phantom of a friend, like a moth to the flame, seeking truth which cannot be tamed.%SPEECH_OFF%Pushing the bowl back across the table, you ask if she is a witch. She nods affirmatively and stares at you before nodding again.%SPEECH_ON%Good. You haven't killed me which means you're thinking now. I am indeed a so-called witch, but I am alone. Entirely alone. And hounded by the others. You might call them my 'sisters', but these others know who you are, just as I do, and they want your blood. They can smell it and that is why I want to talk.%SPEECH_OFF%}
bcaa32e588dd0a6a8620.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{你拔剑走进去，却见那女人正端着一碗炖菜递给你。她说里面只有兔肉和土豆，兔肉比土豆还多。你收起剑，接过碗，在桌边坐下，她坐在对面。旁边燃着几支蜡烛，墙上用白色画着符文，天花板下也悬着形状相似的捕梦网。女人把双肘支在桌上，头发里缠着小饰物，夹着鸟骨和羽毛。她的面容饱经风霜，眼睛却年轻得出奇，像沼泽深处闪光的珍珠。%SPEECH_ON%我早知你会走进来，似友似幻，如飞蛾赴火，追寻那不受羁束的真相。%SPEECH_OFF%你把碗沿桌面推回去，问她是不是女巫。她肯定地点头，盯着你，又点了一次。%SPEECH_ON%很好。你没杀我，说明你开始动脑子了。我确实是所谓的女巫，可我只有一个人，孤身一人，还被其他女巫追杀。你可以叫她们我的“姐妹”，但她们和我一样，知道你是谁，而且想要你的血。她们闻得到。这就是我想和你谈谈的原因。%SPEECH_OFF%}

704e38424172f7600879.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{The woman draws a long object wrapped in table cloth and sets it on the table. She throws back its linens to reveal a jagged obsidian blade with a leather strips for a grip.%SPEECH_ON%Cut your flesh and bleed upon the black. The hexen and their lowly craft shall come, and then you shall kill them all. After that, we can talk. Sellsword and witch, witch and sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what is in it for you. The witch cackles.%SPEECH_ON%Oh sellsword, you are not in the business of allegiance, but in the business of gold, and with a clever turn of coin you know friend can turn to foe. But I offer something more. A truth which cannot be seen, a truth for the False King.%SPEECH_OFF%}
704e38424172f7600879.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{女人取出一件裹在桌布里的长物，放到桌上。她掀开布料，露出一把刃口参差的黑曜石刀，握柄上缠着皮条。%SPEECH_ON%划开你的皮肉，把血滴在这黑刃上。那些女巫自会带着低劣的巫术找上门来，你再把她们全都杀了。到那时，我们才能谈一谈。佣兵与女巫，女巫与佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你问自己能得到什么。女巫咯咯笑了。%SPEECH_ON%哦，佣兵，你做的买卖向来只认金子，不认忠义。钱币稍稍转个手，朋友便能成敌人，这道理你再清楚不过。但我给你的远不止这些。我会告诉你一个眼睛看不见的真相，一个关于伪王的真相。%SPEECH_OFF%}

ee370fb1406cc1352111.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{The black blade rests in your hand, and your reflection rests jaggedly in its stony grooves, stretched and pulled into every divot and edge. Tis a simple stone. A simple dagger. That is all. Not the least bit heavy, but you can feel the import, like dust tossed upon a grave, there is not so much weight in the sand as there is in the throw itself. This blade is either loss or gain and there's only one way to see to which. The witch nods. You nod back and slash your upper arm. The blood pools onto the stone and your reflections disappear beneath the crimson. Almost growling, the witch eagerly leans in and presses the blade against the skin.%SPEECH_ON%More. More, sellsword. More!%SPEECH_OFF%You slash again and flex. A spurt hits the stone. She takes the knife and slaps a spotless cloth onto the wound.%SPEECH_ON%Well enough, sellsword. Go to your men and prepare.%SPEECH_OFF%You stand and look at the woman. You ask.%SPEECH_ON%And once I kill your enemies, then we talk again?%SPEECH_OFF%She smiles.%SPEECH_ON%In so many words, yes.%SPEECH_OFF%}
ee370fb1406cc1352111.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{黑刃卧在你手中，你的倒影碎在石质沟槽里，被每道凹痕与刃缘拉扯变形。不过一块石头，一把匕首，仅此而已。它一点也不重，你却能感到其中的分量，像向坟上撒一把土，沉重的并非沙尘，而是抛下它的那个动作。这把刀带来的是得是失，唯有一试才知。女巫点头，你也点头，划开上臂。血汇上石刃，猩红掩住了倒影。女巫几乎低吼着急切凑近，将刀刃压向皮肤。%SPEECH_ON%再多些，再多些，佣兵，再多些！%SPEECH_OFF%你又划一刀，绷紧胳膊，一股血喷上石面。她取走刀，将一块洁白无瑕的布按在伤口上。%SPEECH_ON%够了，佣兵。回你的人那里，做好准备。%SPEECH_OFF%你站起来，望着女人问道。%SPEECH_ON%等我杀了你的仇人，咱们就再谈？%SPEECH_OFF%她微笑着。%SPEECH_ON%大体如此。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1d494f194e8ad0f24166.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{When you step outside and inform the company that hostiles are coming. Soon enough, the haggard women are spotted walking between the trees of the forest, their long fingernails scratching across the bark and their drooling lips sniveling up to snort and cackle. The first to come through has a long head shaped like a canoe. An infant's skull dangles from her necklace, and a leather bag bounces at her hip, two rabbit feet sticking out of the pouch. She glares at the hut and sniffs the air, then shifts her eyes upon you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, you have made covenant with that bitch?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.%SPEECH_ON%The deal's been made, aye, and it will end with you dying on the end of this blade. And I believe she prefers to just be called 'witch.'%SPEECH_OFF%Another hexen steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%We prefer to call her cunt. Kill the sellswords. Take the captain alive, but remove his eyes and that lousy tongue.%SPEECH_OFF%The throng of witches rush forward, some already shifting into licentious looking younglings while others revolve their arms in ritual rites.}
1d494f194e8ad0f24166.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{你走到外面，告诉战团，敌人就要来了。果然，不久便看见几个形容枯槁的女人穿行林间，长指甲刮过树皮，流着涎水的嘴唇抽动着，又是哼气，又是怪笑。最先走出来的一个，脑袋狭长，像只独木舟。她的项链上吊着婴儿的头骨，腰间的皮袋随着步子晃动，两只兔脚从袋口伸出来。她瞪着小屋，嗅了嗅空气，随后把目光转向你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，你跟那个婊子订了约？%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%是，约已经订好了，结局就是你死在这把剑下。而且我想，她更愿意让人叫她“女巫”。%SPEECH_OFF%另一个女巫走上前。%SPEECH_ON%我们更愿意叫她贱货。杀光佣兵。团长留活口，不过挖掉他的眼睛，再割了那条讨厌的舌头。%SPEECH_OFF%成群的女巫向前扑来，有的已经开始化作妖媚的年轻女子，有的则挥动双臂，施起邪术。}

929ec02b261f98adce7f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{%addict% enters your tent with his hands behind his back in a respective posture. He asks if you have a moment. You nod and he states that he is rid of his tremors and ailments. You ask what he means. He twists his hand above his mouth as though taking a swig.%SPEECH_ON%The potions, sir, I've no longer any overbearing affinity for the things. I'm good. Sound. Quite sound. Ready to fight as the man I am.%SPEECH_OFF%You're not entirely sure what he's driving at. You thought most men took to alcohol, but you've no issue with that. Whatever it is it appears he's bettered it. | You find %addict% sitting on the ground looking at his palms. He's following the grooves with a finger.%SPEECH_ON%I hear you, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask what he's up to. He smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Feeling better. Feeling like I don't need to loosen myself with them potions no longer. Feeling myself, I suppose. Ready to kill, as you command, sir, and do it with clarity of mind to know what I'm doing and why.%SPEECH_OFF%Great. You're not sure what that was about but wish him good luck in staying that way.}
929ec02b261f98adce7f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{%addict%走进帐篷，双手背在身后，态度恭敬地问你有没有空。你点头，他便说，自己的颤抖和种种不适已经消失了。你问他什么意思，他抬手到嘴边，做了个喝东西的动作。%SPEECH_ON%药剂，长官。我不再非喝那些东西不可了。我好了，恢复了，确实没事了。我准备好了，要凭自己的本事去战斗。%SPEECH_OFF%你不完全明白他想说什么。你原以为大多数人只是爱喝酒，而你对此也没意见。不管怎么说，看来他已经克服了自己的问题。 | 你发现%addict%坐在地上，看着自己的掌心，用一根手指顺着掌纹描画。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我听见你来了。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，问他在做什么。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%感觉好多了。觉得自己不再需要靠那些药剂才能放松了。我想，我又像自己了。只要你下令，长官，我随时都能去杀敌，而且头脑清醒，知道自己在做什么，又是为了什么。%SPEECH_OFF%很好。你虽不太明白这是怎么回事，还是祝他能一直保持下去。}

63b790bfea4e3610bfa6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{The company is gathered around the campfire enjoying rest and a meal when %fearful% stands up. Given that everyone else is sitting, he seems to have taken the 'floor' so to speak and uses his newfound privilege.%SPEECH_ON%If men were to be fearful of beasts, then men would be the beasts! But we're the ones with the homes and the fire and the trade and the money! Us! Not them! They sleep where they shit, what are they good for, really?%SPEECH_OFF%Despite the bizarre outburst, a few of the men raise their mugs and give a hearty 'hear hear.'}
63b790bfea4e3610bfa6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{战团围着篝火歇脚吃饭，%fearful%忽然站了起来。别人都坐着，他便自然而然地占了“讲台”，行使起这份新得的特权。%SPEECH_ON%人要是怕野兽，那人不就成了野兽？可有房子、有火、有买卖、有钱的是我们！我们！不是它们！它们拉在哪儿就睡在哪儿，到底有什么了不起？%SPEECH_OFF%虽说这番发作来得古怪，还是有几个弟兄举起酒杯，痛快地喊了声“说得好”。}

f619ef6a3f4133aba714.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%fearful% is staring into the campfire and nodding as he mumbles to himself. It's a worrisome sight, but almost on cue of that thought he speaks up.%SPEECH_ON%You know what? The greenskins ain't shit.%SPEECH_OFF%}
f619ef6a3f4133aba714.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%fearful%盯着篝火，边点头边嘟囔，看着有些令人担忧。可你刚想到这里，他便开口了。%SPEECH_ON%你们知道吗？绿皮算个屁。%SPEECH_OFF%}

d0030e5207caa3e35d39.source: If it bleeds, we can kill it.

f1ed1d40b1f9a62a5b35.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%fearful% interrupts a company break with a sudden speech.%SPEECH_ON%I've killed and buried so many men, you know? And if they were worth their salt then they wouldn't have the opportunity to come back as undead to begin with! And if they come back from ancient times then I'll be damned, they're persistent! But they ain't me. I'm living. I'm breathing. And I aim to keep it that way. And when it's my time I aim to stay dead, because I've the gumption to know I've troubled this world enough.%SPEECH_OFF%Clapping, %otherbrother% offers a plate of food.%SPEECH_ON%Well alright, now stop troubling us!%SPEECH_OFF%The men laugh and %fearful% joins right in.}
f1ed1d40b1f9a62a5b35.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{战团休息时，%fearful%忽然站出来发表了一番演说。%SPEECH_ON%你们知道吗，我杀过、埋过的人多得数不清！他们要真有本事，打从一开始就不会死，更轮不到变成亡灵再爬起来！至于那些从远古活到现在的，见鬼，确实够能熬！可他们跟我不一样。我还活着，还喘着气，也打算一直这么下去。等我该死的时候，我就老老实实地死透。我好歹有这点自知之明，知道自己已经给这世道添够麻烦了。%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother%拍了拍手，递给他一盘食物。%SPEECH_ON%好极了，那就先别给我们添麻烦了！%SPEECH_OFF%众人哄堂大笑，%fearful%也跟着笑了起来。}

8db6ceb3c2f0e5a7a196.source: This world belongs to the living.

3fa3eef74afc1ccf4fee.source: %terrainImage%{%lucky% the ever lucky sellsword has managed to find something interesting. You ask how he came across the item. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%{I was walking, and then I stepped on it. Simple enough. | I looked up and this bird shat and it just missed me. When I looked at where it landed, well, there it was. The bird shit and that thing you got in your hands. | Felt a tingle in my fingers, and then a tingle in my cock. After that I got to looking around for somethin' boring to absolve myself and saw it just settin' there. | Saw a horseshoe just layin' on the ground there and thought to go and fetch it and, well, that was underneath. | Well, see, I saw this four-leaf clover just setting there and I was gonna add it to my bag, see, I got dozens, anyway when I went to go pick it up I saw that item just settin' there. Pretty nifty, huh?}%SPEECH_OFF%}
3fa3eef74afc1ccf4fee.translation: %terrainImage%{一向走运的%lucky%又捡到了件有意思的东西。你问他怎么找到的，他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%{走着走着，就踩着了。就这么简单。 | 我一抬头，有只鸟拉了泡屎，刚好没砸中我。我低头看看落在哪儿，喏，就在那儿。鸟屎，还有你手里那东西。 | 先是手指一阵酥麻，随后连裤裆里的家伙也有了反应。我就四处找些无聊东西看看，好压下邪念，结果看见它就搁在那儿。 | 我看见地上躺着块马蹄铁，便想过去捡起来，结果这东西就在底下。 | 嗯，我看见那儿长着株四叶草，想摘下来收进袋子。我已经攒了几十株了。总之，弯腰去摘的时候，就看见那东西搁在旁边。挺不错吧？}%SPEECH_OFF%}

7826836da241efec2e73.source: %terrainImage%{Marching all around the world has put some wear and tear on the men. Whenever a mercenary takes off a boot you can see the blood seeping through his sock. They've accumulated sores and boils. One man peels the flesh off his toe and says he regrets doing that and you nod. All in all, this is the price to pay for being on the road so much.}
7826836da241efec2e73.translation: %terrainImage%{连日东奔西走，弟兄们的身体渐渐吃不消。谁一脱靴子，都能看见血从袜子里渗出来，脚上尽是磨伤和水泡。有个人撕掉脚趾上的一块皮，立刻说自己后悔了，你也点头。总之，整天在路上奔波，就得付这份代价。}

b9ec9514a9d65ac8e25a.source: %terrainImage%{The next stop ain't far. You hope the men can keep it together until they get there. What bandages you have are applied as necessary.}
b9ec9514a9d65ac8e25a.translation: %terrainImage%{下一处落脚点不远了，但愿弟兄们能撑到那里。手头的绷带按伤情分给了需要的人。}

1ba99b71cd4993e43fb4.source: %terrainImage%{%tailor% the tailor rubs his chin with two fingers. He finally points them forward.%SPEECH_ON%I've got it. Gentlemen, give me every scrap of unused or trashy clothing you have. Every article you got. Hand it over. There you go. Yes, that's absolutely trash, %otherbrother%. Your favorite shirt? By the gods, just give it to me already. Thank you.%SPEECH_OFF%The tailor collects armfuls of discarded clothing and gets to work with his scissors. He slices and dices and pauses. He pauses a lot, always unsure of his work. But finally he presents the results. A pile of fresh socks and enough left over scraps to furnish some extra bandages. He's also wearing a surprisingly flashy new garb that you've no clue how he created.}
1ba99b71cd4993e43fb4.translation: %terrainImage%{裁缝%tailor%用两根手指摩挲着下巴，最后朝前一指。%SPEECH_ON%有办法了。诸位，把用不着的破衣烂衫都给我。有多少拿多少。交过来。对，就这样。没错，%otherbrother%，那件绝对算破烂。你最喜欢的衬衫？诸神在上，赶紧拿来吧。谢谢。%SPEECH_OFF%裁缝抱着收来的旧衣，抄起剪刀忙活起来。他剪剪裁裁，又停下思索。他停下来的时候可真不少，似乎总拿不准自己的手艺。不过最后，他还是交出了成果：一堆崭新的袜子，剩下的布料还够多做些绷带。他自己也换上了一身出奇花哨的新衣，你完全想不通那是怎么做出来的。}

9241c7af8930b14a845d.source: Now that's a magician if I've ever see one.

db7de89057699ef80d5c.source: %terrainImage%{When it comes to walking the earth, %travelbro% is longer in the tooth than anyone. He laughs at the plight of his fellow sellswords.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, now this is what I'm talking about! Nevermind the pain, men, embrace the soreness!%SPEECH_OFF%The company collectively tells him to stuff it, but the roadman happily wiggles his toes around. You didn't even realize he had his boots off before that, his feet are so calloused you thought the bony figures but folds of leather!}
db7de89057699ef80d5c.translation: %terrainImage%{论四处奔波，没人比%travelbro%更有资历。他看着佣兵同伴的惨状，哈哈大笑。%SPEECH_ON%啊，这才对嘛！别管疼不疼，弟兄们，好好享受这股酸痛！%SPEECH_OFF%全团齐声叫他闭嘴，他却乐呵呵地晃着脚趾。你这才发现他早脱了靴子：那双脚结的茧实在太厚，骨节分明的轮廓，方才竟被你看成了皮革的褶皱！}

0ad13c4f0d0e2306a1bf.source: Put your damn boots back on.
0ad13c4f0d0e2306a1bf.translation: 把你那该死的靴子穿上。

f2a7a1eed9a3a88fac6a.source: %terrainImage%{%thief% the thief sidles up to you. Stepping away and putting your hands in your pockets, you ask what he wants. He smirks and answers.%SPEECH_ON%Alright I'll be honest with you, captain. Last time we stopped in town I helped myself to a blind peacemaker's wares. What? I'd a sore tooth. No reason to pay to fix what the old gods gave me. Anyway, I fixed my tooth. See? What a smile, right? But then I thought I felt some aches, man, aches all over the place! So I visited the peacemaker again and...%SPEECH_OFF%You interrupt the man and ask just how much he stole. He produces a sack of medicinal goods. He proudly puts his hands to his hips and stare out at the world with his crooked grin.%SPEECH_ON%Suffice it to say I ain't hurtin' no more.%SPEECH_OFF%}
f2a7a1eed9a3a88fac6a.translation: %terrainImage%{小偷%thief%悄悄凑到你身旁。你退开一步，把手插进口袋，问他有什么事。他咧嘴一笑，答道。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，团长，我就直说了。上回进城，我从一个瞎眼医者那儿顺了些药。怎么？我牙疼啊。旧神给的毛病，凭什么要我花钱治？总之，牙是治好了。瞧，这笑容不错吧？可后来我又觉得身上疼，这儿疼，那儿也疼！于是我又去找了那医者一趟，然后……%SPEECH_OFF%你打断他，问他到底偷了多少。他掏出一袋药物，得意地叉着腰，歪咧着嘴，放眼望向四周。%SPEECH_ON%这么说吧，我现在是哪儿都不疼了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

4df41e2c3723595884f4.source: What were we complaining about again?
4df41e2c3723595884f4.translation: 咱们刚才在抱怨什么来着？

e46a8d11c8db67cc7e5b.source: Maybe we can fashion some fresh wrappings from what we've got?
e46a8d11c8db67cc7e5b.translation: 用现有的布料做些新绑脚布，怎么样？

fce08fb25222b7203d72.source: Fashioned himself something nice from cloth scraps
fce08fb25222b7203d72.translation: 用碎布给自己做了件好东西

b45ad7199351672e9fba.source: %terrainImage%{%miner% the miner sucks in great gulps of breath and then lets them out in long, albeit a little wheezy exhales. He nods to himself as though satisfied by something everyone does. It seems some folks are easily pleased. But he does explain himself.%SPEECH_ON%You know I spent years in the dank and dark of the mines, breathing in the dust and the metals. I think being surface side this long has been a fortune of its own, a treasure I didn't know was out here for the taking. Thank you, captain, cause I wouldn't be here right now if it weren't for you.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and thank him for the kind words.}
b45ad7199351672e9fba.translation: %terrainImage%{矿工%miner%大口吸气，再长长吐出，呼气时带着些喘声。他满意地点点头，仿佛做了件了不得的事，尽管人人都要呼吸。有些人似乎就是容易满足。不过，他倒解释了缘由。%SPEECH_ON%你也知道，我在潮湿黑暗的矿井里待了好多年，吸进去的全是尘土和金属粉末。能在地面上待这么久，本身就是一笔财富，是我从前根本不知道外面还藏着的宝藏。谢谢你，团长。没有你，我今天就不会站在这里。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，也谢过他的这番好话。}

ca7c513974f04b030e26.source: There's a fresh breeze coming from the sea.

1e37aa949a912dd213f4.source: Happy to have a new life surface-side
1e37aa949a912dd213f4.translation: 为能在地面上开始新生活而高兴

21531928da5734a75ba5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{%monk% the modest monk enters your tent with a vial in hand. The flask is topped with a bark stopper and a wreath of greenery with berries hanging beneath the leaves. Inside the vial is a goldish liquid sloshing about. Whatever it is, it catches any glimpse of light and seems to capture it and swirl it around. He holds it out.%SPEECH_ON%Blessed water, sir, to fight the dead that walk again.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if it's a gift from the old gods. He nods. You ask if it's really a gift from the old gods, though. He purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%No, not exactly. The monasteries know how to make it, but it is an ancient recipe protected under penalty of death.%SPEECH_OFF%Of course. You thank the man for taking such a risk to contribute and tell him to put it in the inventory.}
21531928da5734a75ba5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{谦和的修士%monk%拿着一只小瓶，走进你的帐篷。瓶口塞着树皮塞，绕了一圈绿枝，叶片底下还垂着浆果。瓶内淡金色的液体轻轻晃动，无论接住哪一缕微光，仿佛都能将它留在里面，旋转流淌。他将瓶子递给你。%SPEECH_ON%长官，这是圣水，用来对付那些重新行走的死者。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，这是旧神赐下的礼物吗？他点头。你又问，当真是旧神亲手所赐？他抿了抿嘴。%SPEECH_ON%不，也不全是。修道院知道怎么调制，只是这古老配方严禁外传，违者处死。%SPEECH_OFF%果然如此。你谢他冒险为战团出力，让他把圣水收进储备。}

5861f18e97d85f18ad8b.source: Even holy men have tricks of the trade.
5861f18e97d85f18ad8b.translation: 圣职者也有自家的看家本领。

6620c75d8af69b8f7ef6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{Waking from a strange dream, you step out of your tent to find most of the company asleep, aside from the night owl %nightowl%. He's at the edge of the camp with his back turned, but he seems to hear you approaching and speaks without looking.%SPEECH_ON%This is how it starts, sir. The rage. The fever. That turns good men, hoooo.%SPEECH_OFF%He wheels around to show off an actual owl he has caught. Its eyelids are half-closed, probably worn out from escaping and now simply humiliated at being caught without any carnivorous purpose. You ask %nightowl% how the hell he caught it. The sellsword lets the bird go and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%With my hands. I also caught this.%SPEECH_OFF%He crouches and pulls up a heretofore unseen corpse.%SPEECH_ON%Slick little thief. I happened upon him, eh, discounting our wares so to speak. I was a little too tired to talk, so I let my blade here tell him the shop's closed. I then followed his footsteps out to where he came from and found his, eh, let's say accoutrements.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Right. Of course. You tell the man you're going back to sleep and you'll make judgments of his doings in the morning. He nods back.%SPEECH_ON%Right sir. I'll try and get some shuteye myself. Been a couple days. Or was it weeks?%SPEECH_OFF%}
6620c75d8af69b8f7ef6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你从一个怪梦中醒来，走出帐篷，发现战团大多数人都睡了，只有夜猫子%nightowl%还醒着。他背对你站在营地边缘，似乎听见了你靠近，没回头便开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%一切就是这样开始的，长官。那怒火，那狂热，让好人变得……咕——%SPEECH_OFF%他猛地转身，亮出一只真的猫头鹰。它眼皮半垂，大概是挣扎逃脱耗尽了力气，如今又发现自己被抓并不是为了给人当食物，只剩满腔屈辱。你问%nightowl%，他到底怎么抓到的。佣兵放走鸟，耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%用手抓的。我还抓到了这个。%SPEECH_OFF%他蹲下身，拽起一具方才没看见的尸体。%SPEECH_ON%滑头小贼。我碰见他时，他正给我们的货物，呃，来点特别优惠。我有点累，懒得说话，就让这把刀告诉他，本店打烊了。后来我顺着脚印找到他的来处，发现了他的，呃，姑且叫随身行头吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。好，当然。你告诉他，自己要回去睡了，等早上再评判他的所作所为。他也点头。%SPEECH_ON%好的，长官。我也试着眯一会儿。好几天没睡了，还是好几个星期来着？%SPEECH_OFF%}

ad2bdabf2263ab8deb76.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{You come across a goatskin tent beside the road. The hide tarps have been dipped in purple dyes and there are fresh daisies twisted into the knots of matted goat hair. An old woman with a hunchback stands outside with her hands clasped and hanging. She sizes you up and down with withered eyes.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, a sellsword. No, a captain of sellswords. Or perhaps something more. You smell of a strange odor, and not just that of a man. Do you wish to have your fortune told?%SPEECH_OFF%She gestures to inside the tent. You see a number of long, cards laid facedown across the table.}
ad2bdabf2263ab8deb76.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{你在路边遇到一顶山羊皮帐篷。皮篷染成紫色，纠结的羊毛里还缠着新鲜雏菊。一个驼背老妇站在外面，双手交握垂在身前，用衰老的眼睛上下打量你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，一个佣兵。不，是佣兵的团长。又或者，还不止如此。你身上有股奇怪的气息，可不只是男人的气味。想算算命吗？%SPEECH_OFF%她朝帐篷内示意。你看见桌上摊着好几张长牌，背面朝上。}

0d30c091f71fa24b053b.source: Tell me my fortune, old woman.

1a88df405ea59b454232.source: I'll tell you yours instead: You're about to give us all your valuables.
1a88df405ea59b454232.translation: 不如我替你算一算：你马上要把值钱的东西全交给我们。

0791a0ad328f7196a43e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{A card reader such as this has probably done a fair bit of business, enough so that you wouldn't mind taking it for yourself. You order the company to pick the place apart. The woman says nothing as you move her out of the way, and she says nothing as the sellswords swarm her tent and tilt its pole to the ground. She smiles a little as they throw the goatskin tarp off to see the loot like magicians unveiling a failed trick. The smile fades as they begin to pick through her things, their boots crushing and smashing anything of no use to them. The hag shrugs and holds up two cards seemingly pulled right out of her sleeves.%SPEECH_ON%Tell me, sellsword, what do you see?%SPEECH_OFF%You take a look. The tarot cards depict a group of knights ransacking a village, and another is of a graveyard guarded by a particularly punitive keeper. You shrug and tell her she keeps those two cards tucked for events just like this and you're no fool to the notion of a helpless hag being runover on the road. You tell her she may have scared a few robbers with that trick, but you're not so easily fooled. She laughs.%SPEECH_ON%You are as wise as you are cruel.%SPEECH_OFF%Damn straight. Now let's see what the company has found.}
0791a0ad328f7196a43e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{像这样的纸牌占卜者，想必做成过不少生意，赚下的钱已足够让你惦记了。你命令战团把这里翻个底朝天。你将女人推到一旁，她没说话；佣兵们冲进帐篷，把支柱扳倒，她仍没说话。他们掀开山羊皮篷布，查看下面的财物，活像变戏法的人揭开一个失败的把戏，她还微微笑了笑。可等他们开始翻动她的东西，用靴子踩碎一切看不上的物件，那笑容便消失了。老妇耸耸肩，举起两张仿佛从袖子里抽出的纸牌。%SPEECH_ON%告诉我，佣兵，你看到了什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你瞧了一眼。一张塔罗牌画着一群洗劫村庄的骑士，另一张则画着一座墓园，由一名格外严酷的看守把守。你耸耸肩，告诉她，这两张牌就是专门藏着，应付眼下这种事的；你可不会因为路边一个无助老妇受了欺负，就信了她这套。你说，这把戏也许吓退过几个强盗，但想唬住你，没那么容易。她笑了。%SPEECH_ON%你有多残忍，就有多精明。%SPEECH_OFF%说得一点没错。现在，看看弟兄们找到了什么吧。}

0de8067ed870afde8860.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{You take a good look around you. If the hag had an ambush waiting somewhere you certainly don't see it. With a wave of your hand, you order the company to ransack her place. A few brothers slide into her tent and start picking it apart, flipping tables and yanking out drawers. The old woman steps aside, and keeps stepping, and keeps stepping. She's... grinning?%SPEECH_ON%Ay, take a look at this thing!%SPEECH_OFF%You turn back to see one of the mercenaries grabbing an orb that hangs from the tent ceiling. He yanks it down. The chain goes taut, snags, and there's a clank of a wire snapping loose. Blue sparks sidewind up the chain and zip down the length right into the orb. You don't hear a thing. The tent rips apart in a burst of blue flame and the pole punches into the sky and the silhouettes of sellswords stumble through the hot smoke. Grey and burning daisies twist through the air. You augur your ears to get your hearing back and then look to see where the woman is, but she's gone. Pursing your lips, you rush to see what damage has been done.}
0de8067ed870afde8860.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{你仔细环顾四周。老妇若真设了埋伏，你反正没看出来。你一挥手，命战团搜刮她的住处。几个弟兄钻进帐篷，翻桌子、拽抽屉，开始拆屋翻找。老妇人退到一旁，又退一步，再退一步。她……竟在笑？%SPEECH_ON%嘿，看看这个！%SPEECH_OFF%你转头，看见一个佣兵抓住悬在帐顶的圆球，往下一拽。铁链骤然绷紧，卡了一下，随后传来钢丝脱开的铮响。蓝色火花沿铁链窜起，又顺着整条链子钻进球中。你什么也没听见。帐篷却在爆发的蓝焰中撕裂，撑杆直冲天际，佣兵的黑影踉跄穿过滚烫烟雾，灰白而燃烧的雏菊在半空翻飞。你掏着耳朵，想恢复听觉，又去找老妇，却发现她早已不见。你紧抿嘴唇，赶紧查看损失。}

ae497733f1ac399d465f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{The tent closes shut as you step in. An orange glow flicks and bobs from a lantern. Groaning, the old woman leans into it with a candlestick and broadens the light to a table and two chairs. She motions toward them.%SPEECH_ON%Sit.%SPEECH_OFF%You sit. She sits. She smacks her lips over toothless gums and nods and begins flipping the cards.%SPEECH_ON%First there is...%SPEECH_OFF%You lean forward to get a better look and the table breaks beneath your weight. The cards go fluttering and the woman falls backwards and the candle goes flying. You catch its stick midair with one hand and rush to save the lady from falling with the other. You set her back down and give her candle back. She stares at you, grinning with a black rim of a smile, her eyes squinted into dots.%SPEECH_ON%Let's forget this happened and say you get all that you ever wished for, sellsword, starting with this.%SPEECH_OFF%She gives you a slobbery kiss on the forehead and prods you with a dagger handle.%SPEECH_ON%Deal!%SPEECH_OFF%}
ae497733f1ac399d465f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{你走进帐篷，帐帘随即合拢。灯笼里橙光摇曳，老妇人哼哼着凑过去，用烛台引火，将一张桌子和两把椅子照亮。她指了指椅子。%SPEECH_ON%坐。%SPEECH_OFF%你坐下，她也坐下。她瘪着没牙的嘴咂了咂，点点头，开始翻牌。%SPEECH_ON%首先是……%SPEECH_OFF%你想看清些，向前一倾，桌子却被你的重量压塌了。纸牌四散飞舞，老妇人向后倒，蜡烛也飞了出去。你一手在半空接住烛台，另一手赶忙托住老妇，扶她坐稳，再把蜡烛还给她。她盯着你，笑得露出黑洞洞的牙床，眼睛眯成两点。%SPEECH_ON%咱们就当没这回事。佣兵，你想要的都能如愿，先从这个开始。%SPEECH_OFF%她在你额头上亲下一个湿漉漉的吻，又用匕首柄顶了顶你。%SPEECH_ON%说定了！%SPEECH_OFF%}

4a1460ce78d5ad20659b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{You step into the tent. A concerned %randombrother% looks in as the folds close him and the rest of the world out. The old woman lights a candle and carries it to her seat. Ironically, her olden shapes take further prominence in the dark as shadows find crevices you never knew could exist on a person, and her skin brims with lightning brought permanence. She immediately starts flipping cards and speaking.%SPEECH_ON%Defeat. Speculation. Doubt.%SPEECH_OFF%Poorly painted knights come and go, their limbs askew in bizarre poses.%SPEECH_ON%More defeat. But, also, victory. Many victories. You forget weakness. You grow tired of its contagious nature. You become powerful. Strength is survival. And there you are. Old. You die.%SPEECH_OFF%Raising an eyebrow you grab that last card and slide it into the light. You see a man with a long grey beard sitting in a chair. You tell the woman you've never really been able to grow a beard and she snuffs the candle out and shoos you out of the tent.}
4a1460ce78d5ad20659b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{你走进帐篷，%randombrother%担忧地往里望，帐帘却已将他与外面的世界一并隔开。老妇人点起蜡烛，带到座位旁。讽刺的是，黑暗反而让她的老态更加分明：阴影钻进你从未想过人身上会有的沟壑，满身皱纹如凝固的闪电。她立刻翻牌，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%失败。猜疑。犹豫。%SPEECH_OFF%画得粗糙的骑士一张张翻过，四肢扭成古怪姿势。%SPEECH_ON%更多失败。但也有胜利，许多胜利。你忘却软弱，厌倦它像疾病般蔓延。你变得强大，强大才能活命。再看此时的你，老了，死去。%SPEECH_OFF%你扬起眉毛，抽过最后一张牌，移到烛光下。上面一个长灰胡子的男人坐在椅中。你告诉老妇，自己向来长不出什么胡子，她便吹灭蜡烛，把你赶出了帐篷。}

4c2e898fcf6c42ed0b0c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{You step into the tent and its folds close and you're in nothing but darkness. You stand there for a time and ask the woman where she went. Pursing your lips, you open the tent flap to bring in some light. The slip of light strikes a sheen from the darkness and you turn around to see the dagger soaring forward. You block it away with your gauntlet and draw your sword and plunge it into the hag's chest. She drops the knife and clutches your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Such a monster you are, sellsword, killing a kind old woman such as I. You'll die for this. You and your men will all die.%SPEECH_OFF%You bring the witch in close and get a look at suddenly bright, wicked cat eyes. You spit and nod.%SPEECH_ON%Foretelling doom in a world where everything dies? Not a hard job. Do you know what my job is, you witch?%SPEECH_OFF%She grins a black rind of a gummy smile. Black blood spurts over her lips as she laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, sellsword! We shall see what you are when Davkul has you in his hands.%SPEECH_OFF%The witch's body goes limp and your sword suddenly cuts straight through her flesh, leaving sliced flesh folding at your feet. You quickly exit the tent and have the whole thing burned. Some of the men swear they can see the woman's face grinning in the palls of smoke.}
4c2e898fcf6c42ed0b0c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_11.png[/img]{你走进帐篷，门帘合拢，四周顿时一片漆黑。你站了一会儿，问女人去了哪儿。你抿起嘴，掀开门帘，让光照进来。一线亮光从黑暗中映出寒芒，你转身，正看见匕首迎面刺来。你用护手将它格开，拔剑捅进老妇的胸膛。她丢下刀，抓住你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你真是个怪物，连我这样善良的老妇也杀。你会因此而死，你和你的人全都要死。%SPEECH_OFF%你将女巫拉近，看清那双忽然亮起、猫一般邪恶的眼睛。你啐了一口，点头。%SPEECH_ON%在一个万物都会死的世界里，预言死亡？这差事不难。女巫，你知道我的差事是什么吗？%SPEECH_OFF%她咧嘴笑了，露出一道漆黑的牙床，笑声中，黑血从唇上喷出。%SPEECH_ON%噢，佣兵！等达夫库尔把你攥在手里，我们再看看你究竟是什么东西。%SPEECH_OFF%女巫的身体软了下去，你的剑忽然径直切穿她的血肉，割开的躯体折叠着落在脚边。你迅速退出帐篷，叫人将它整个烧掉。几个弟兄发誓，他们看见那女人的脸正在浓烟中咧嘴微笑。}

6eec5f52387908178d32.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{You hear a commotion and go to find %paranoid% waving a weapon at his fellow sellswords.%SPEECH_ON%I know who you is, and I know who you ain't, and what you ain't are friends of mine!%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% looks over and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Never said you was my friend.%SPEECH_OFF%The paranoid mercenary barks on anyway, demanding everyone keep a good distance away or he'll cut them. You manage to calm the man down, mostly by explaining what his daily rate is and how he'll struggle without it, but it's no doubt a short term solution. | You find %paranoid% the increasingly paranoid sellsword huddled by himself with his hands around his knees. Despite the infantile posture, his eyes are steeled and he's keeping careful watch of everything. When you ask him how he's doing, he simply laughs.%SPEECH_ON%I dunno, sir, just surrounded by a mob of money-driven assholes who will stab me in the back whenever it suits them.%SPEECH_OFF%In a way, you understand where he's coming from, but you hope this mood is not contagious with the rest of the company.}
6eec5f52387908178d32.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{你听见争吵，走过去发现%paranoid%正朝同伴挥舞武器。%SPEECH_ON%我知道你们是谁，也知道你们不是什么——你们绝不是我的朋友！%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%望过来，耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我也没说过我是你朋友啊。%SPEECH_OFF%多疑的佣兵仍吼个不停，要求所有人离远点，否则就动刀。你总算劝他冷静，主要靠提醒他每日能拿多少工钱，以及没了这份收入会有多难过。不过，这显然只能管得了一时。 | 你发现越来越多疑的%paranoid%独自蜷坐，双手抱膝。姿势虽像个婴儿，目光却冷硬，警惕地观察一切。你问他怎么样，他只是笑。%SPEECH_ON%不知道啊，长官，无非是被一群唯利是图的混蛋围着，只要对他们有利，随时都能从背后捅我一刀。%SPEECH_OFF%某种程度上，你能理解他为什么这么想，可还是希望这股情绪别传给其他弟兄。}

357a315992048624cef5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]{A few of the men run into your tent, each of them wide-eyed and sweating. They absentmindedly shrink from each other's touch or violently push back. You ask what is the problem and they explain as a mob like birds crowing at someone hiding a piece of bread from them. It takes some parsing, but it sounds as though the artifact superstitiously called the 'petrified scream' has been giving the men nightmares. You tell the men the item is in the inventory and is of no harm. The men quietly leave.

 You return to your map only to see something black hidden under the paper. Lifting the page, you find the alp's death mask there, maw open in grisly black permanence. You stare at the mask, you can hear something within it, something clattering its teeth like thrown dice, and the sides of it seem to be vibrating, giving its flesh a bubbling look. With a shrug and laugh you throw it on top of the map as a paperweight. Damn thing is gonna get lost if the men keep moving it around like this.}
357a315992048624cef5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]{几个弟兄冲进帐篷，个个瞪大眼睛，汗流不止。彼此一碰到，不是下意识缩开，就是猛地推回去。你问出了什么事，他们七嘴八舌，像一群对藏着面包的人争相聒噪的鸟。费了些力气才理清：那件被迷信地称作“凝固的尖啸”的奇物，让他们噩梦不断。你告诉众人，东西好好放在储备里，伤不了人。弟兄们这才默默离开。

你回头看地图，却发现纸下藏着一块黑东西。掀开一看，正是那张梦魇的死亡面具，狰狞大口永远凝固在黑暗中。你盯着面具，似乎能听见里面有东西，牙齿碰得像骰子乱落，边缘也仿佛在颤动，让那层皮肉看起来如同冒泡。你耸肩一笑，把它扔到地图上当镇纸。弟兄们老这么搬来搬去，这该死的东西迟早得丢。}

9d35f15b0f40a508577e.source: How do you keep misplacing that?

da2a3bc7947d77b109b3.source: Concerned about carrying around a Petrified Scream artifact
da2a3bc7947d77b109b3.translation: 因随身带着“凝固的尖啸”而不安

8451206445c47fa40876.source: %terrainImage%{You come across a young traveler on the road. His straw hat is turned inside out as though he meant for it to catch rain. He's got a walking stick with its end shaved to a ball to navigate muddy roads. When you get near, he straightens up and tents his hands on the top of the staff.%SPEECH_ON%Oy', mercenaries are ye? I'd avoid the forests if I were ye. They say trees roam those parts now. They don't do so in menace, but neither does a motha' bear when it chows down on your balls for getting too close. It's a matter of nature, ye know?%SPEECH_OFF%Uh, sure. | A man is found beside the road reading some tomes. He looks up, turning one of the pages for you to see, displaying a drawing of a tree with long branches extended to the ground. The trunk is lit with eyes.%SPEECH_ON%They call 'em schrats. Trees that will claw and kill anything that gets close, but I don't think that's quite right. I don't think they're animals, I think they're calculating and smart monsters with a vengeful attitude toward matters of trespass. So don't trespass upon them, understand? Stay out of the forests.%SPEECH_OFF%Not in the mood for idle tree talk, you wish the man well in his studies and quickly move on. | An elderly woman carrying a basket crosses paths with your company. She gestures toward the goods, a pile of chopped firewood.%SPEECH_ON%If ye want some fyewood, aye, best stay clear of where I got it.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what she means. She grins all wily like.%SPEECH_ON%A schrat in the forest watched me do it, gave me propuh permission to warm meself with this here tinder. Didn't give my uncle permission. It tore my uncle in half and hung his flesh. Peehaps ornamental value, ye know?%SPEECH_OFF%Er, of course.}
8451206445c47fa40876.translation: %terrainImage%{你在路上遇见一个年轻旅人。他把草帽翻了过来，仿佛要拿它接雨水。手中的拐杖末端削成圆球，便于走过泥泞道路。见你靠近，他挺直腰，把双手拢在杖顶。%SPEECH_ON%喂，你们是佣兵吧？换我，就离森林远点。听说，那边的树如今会自己走动。倒未必是存心害你，可你靠得太近，母熊咬掉你的卵蛋时，也不算存心害你。天性如此，懂吧？%SPEECH_OFF%呃，当然。 | 你发现一个男人坐在路边读厚书。他抬头翻过一页，举给你看：图上是一棵树，长枝垂到地面，树干上亮着眼睛。%SPEECH_ON%人们叫它们树妖，说是会撕碎、杀死一切靠近之物的树。不过，我觉得不大对。它们不是野兽，而是精明、会算计的怪物，对闯入领地的行为怀恨在心。所以，别闯进去，明白吗？离森林远点。%SPEECH_OFF%你没心情闲聊树木，祝他研究顺利，便匆匆上路。 | 一个提着篮子的老妇与你们迎面相遇。她指了指篮中的东西，一堆劈好的柴。%SPEECH_ON%要是想弄点柴火，唉，最好别去我捡柴的地方。%SPEECH_OFF%你问她什么意思。她狡黠地咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%林里有只树妖，看着我捡的，还正经准许我拿这些柴取暖呢。可它没准许我叔叔。它把我叔叔撕成两半，肉挂了起来。没准是为了好看，你懂吧？%SPEECH_OFF%呃，当然。}

a5b4869d0e902c5c7714.source: An enemy such as this shouldn't be taken lightly.
a5b4869d0e902c5c7714.translation: 这样的敌人，绝不能掉以轻心。

79bf6853fc10aa5a660f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]While camping in the woods, %randombrother% calls you out of the command tent. You ask what it is he wants and he pushes a finger to his lips in a silent shush. He points up a tree which grows tall into the evening darkness. You hear cracks as though something were making a nest out of branches whole. The noisemaker only pauses to snort and chortle in a quick tittering of guttural chirps, like a bird crying for help from the belly of a snake. When you look back down, the men are staring at you, looking for an idea as to what to do about this event.
79bf6853fc10aa5a660f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]林中扎营时，%randombrother%把你叫出指挥帐篷。你问有什么事，他将手指压在唇上，示意噤声，随后指向一棵高耸入暮色的大树。树上传来噼啪断裂声，仿佛有东西正拿整根树枝搭窝。那东西偶尔停下，发出短促的鼻息与咯咯怪响，低沉又尖细，像一只困在蛇腹中求救的鸟。你收回目光，发现弟兄们全看着你，等你拿主意。

f4b4f8701dd9b5dae000.source: It's just some animal. Get back to doing your jobs.
f4b4f8701dd9b5dae000.translation: 不过是只野兽，回去干活。

5a69af8b3021c4aaa8e6.source: Better safe than sorry. We'll cut down the tree.
5a69af8b3021c4aaa8e6.translation: 小心点总没错。把树砍了。

c5b2c891b058dd85464d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You order %lumberjack% the lumberjack to bring the tree down. He nods and gets to work, using a host of tools available, not all of which are axes. He plies the wood open in a divot on one side and jams the gaps with the helves of weapons and then goes to the other side and chops away at its trunk. He works with the sort of speed you'd love to see on the battlefield. It's the sort of authenticity one rarely sees in life, a man home at his work, his eyes settled on modeling an undeniable future, his hands hardly assigned to the task so much as born for it.%SPEECH_ON%Ay-yo!%SPEECH_OFF%He yells out and the tree is felled. It cracks and slumbers down the heft and tilts into the forest where its long stock falls through the wickets and slams the ground so hard it seems to ache the very earth. Drawing your sword, you go to investigate the felled treetop. You find a pair of Nachzehrers there, smashed flat, teeth skittered to the forest floor like capless shrooms. The company's fear is settled by the grisly sight.
c5b2c891b058dd85464d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你命伐木工%lumberjack%砍倒那棵树。他点头开工，用上各种趁手工具，可不只有斧头。他先在树的一侧开出豁口，用武器柄塞进缝隙撑住，再绕到另一侧劈砍树干。动作快得让你恨不得他在战场上也能如此。人一旦回到熟悉的行当，便会显出生活中罕见的笃定：他的目光早已看见必然到来的结果，双手与其说是在执行任务，不如说生来就为此而长。%SPEECH_ON%树倒喽！%SPEECH_OFF%他喊了一声，大树轰然倒下。树干开裂，沉重地倾向林中，长长的树身压过枝杈，砸得大地仿佛都痛了一下。你拔剑查看倒下的树梢，发现两只食尸鬼被压得扁平，牙齿散落林地，像一丛失去菌盖的蘑菇。如此惨状，反倒平息了弟兄们的恐惧。

2034f8d5bc0149caebb7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]%bravebro%, the ever brave sellsword, clambers up the tree with speed not to be erred by fear or reluctance. You'd think they spotted a fair maiden up in those parts the way he's going. It isn't long until he's gone, though the scratch 'n' scratch of his noisy ascent is unmistakable. Finally you hear him returning, the clutter of his descent coming in stops and starts as he finds safe footing. You see him break back into view, the soles of his boots first to appear like butter trays dangling in the dark. His shadowy silhouette follows, sliding ever downward until he makes a last leap to the earth. He intentionally buckles at the knees and rolls back against the tree trunk with his tired hands limp across his knees.%SPEECH_ON%T'was a black bear head deep in a honeycomb, but the beast been dead at least two days. I saw a group of bats skitter on out when I approached, I think they was eating its insides. This tumbled on out when they fled.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns and throws a sword upon the ground. It's covered in sticky honey and pinestraw, but otherwise looks like a remarkable blade.
2034f8d5bc0149caebb7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]向来胆大的%bravebro%飞快爬上树，半点也不受恐惧或迟疑的拖累。看他那股劲头，不知道的还以为树梢上坐着位美人。没多久，他便消失在枝叶间，只剩抓挠攀爬的声响清晰可闻。终于，你听见他开始往回下，每找一处稳妥落脚点，响动便停上一停。最先重现眼前的是他的靴底，像两只黄油托盘悬在黑暗里，接着才是朦胧的人影。他一路往下滑，最后纵身跃回地面，顺势屈膝，向后一靠，坐在树干边，疲惫的双手软软搭在膝上。%SPEECH_ON%是头黑熊，脑袋扎进蜂巢里，不过已经死了至少两天。我靠近时，一群蝙蝠从它身上蹿出来，我看是在吃它的内脏。它们逃走的时候，这东西掉了下来。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身把一柄剑扔在地上。剑上沾满黏稠的蜂蜜和松针，除此之外，看着倒是把难得的好剑。

3db218945baa2da1e287.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You order the company to chop the tree down. They get to the task, though there's little experience in doing it and the end result is a frantic run for safety as the trunk comes barreling down in an unexpected direction. A very frightened black bear bolts off the treetop. It has a honeycomb for a snout and huffs its way into the dark of the forest.

 No one is crushed, but the chaos and debris leaves a few of the men worse for the wear.
3db218945baa2da1e287.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你命令弟兄们把树砍倒。他们照做了，可惜没多少伐木经验，结果树干朝意料之外的方向轰然倾倒，众人慌忙逃命。一头吓坏了的黑熊从树冠里窜出，鼻口上扣着蜂巢，呼哧呼哧地逃进黑暗的森林。

没人被压住，不过这场混乱和四散的枝木，还是让几个弟兄挂了彩。

c910a53d306a65147e8e.source: Well, that was a worthwhile endeavour...

bc1ed63505ba9b76d7f7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You order the men to cut the tree down. %randombrother% starts in with a heavy thwack. He plants a foot on the trunk to wrench the tool free and that's about the last you see of him as he goes flying away. A tree branch swings back into view with a long groan emanating from the trunk as though some ancient wood were being felled inside its very body. You watch as the wood cracks loose of the soil and uproots itself. Emerald eyes flare and widen, their stare blinkered by the twists of falling leaves.
bc1ed63505ba9b76d7f7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你命令众人砍倒大树。%randombrother%上前狠狠劈了一下，接着一脚蹬住树干，想把工具拔出来——这几乎是你最后看清他的时刻，转眼间他便飞了出去。一根树枝摆回眼前，树干发出悠长呻吟，仿佛里面有一株远古巨木正被伐倒。你看着木根挣裂泥土，整棵树拔地而起。翠绿的眼睛骤然亮起、睁大，飘旋的落叶时而遮住那道凝视。

de363864e4b1029a4e07.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You can't be bothered by such trivial nonsense. It's likely to be a lynx or an eagle of some sort. If it's worse, it'll come on down and the company will deal with it then. This line of thinking doesn't sit well with some of the men.
de363864e4b1029a4e07.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你懒得为这种小事操心，多半是只猞猁或者什么鹰。就算更凶，等它下来，战团再收拾它也不迟。不过，有些弟兄对这想法并不买账。

d1b3d8a4f39685339bfd.source: %lumberjack%, you know well how to bring down trees. Do it.

ed32473abf789a083285.source: %bravebro%, you're the bravest of the lot. Go see what this is about.
ed32473abf789a083285.translation: %bravebro%，就数你胆子大，去看看怎么回事。

b142648f1ddeb8df4343.source: Concerned that you didn't act on a possible threat
b142648f1ddeb8df4343.translation: 因你未处理潜在威胁而担忧

6b6aa9966da96a224f4c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]{%teamplayer%, always the sort to take one for the company, seems to have singlehandedly helped the resolve of the men. As one sellsword explains it.%SPEECH_ON%I dunno how to explain it.%SPEECH_OFF%As another more articulate mercenary says.%SPEECH_ON%It's like he's more than just a sword for hire, you know? He's someone we can depend on. Like a brother. But not a whole brother, obviously. More like a halfbrother. A bro, if you will.%SPEECH_OFF%}
6b6aa9966da96a224f4c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]{%teamplayer%向来愿意替战团吃亏，似乎凭着一己之力便鼓舞了众人的意志。一位佣兵如此解释：%SPEECH_ON%我也不知道该怎么说。%SPEECH_OFF%另一位更善言辞的佣兵接着说：%SPEECH_ON%他不只是个拿钱挥剑的人，你明白吗？这人靠得住。像兄弟。当然，不是那种完完整整的亲兄弟，大概算半个兄弟吧。叫声弟兄，你懂的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

fad632b30b422f880a07.source: Happy to have a bro in

b6f55eb1ce69657e225c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_107.png[/img]{%randombrother% wrinkles his calf into a hole in the forest floor and curses with frustration.%SPEECH_ON%For farks sake as if my dogs weren't barking enough!%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to tell him to keep it quiet when suddenly you see an unhold scrambling up the forested hillside the company just climbed. Whereas you all struggled to ascend, the giant is hurdling upward and scrambling the incline, leaving small landslides in its wake. Before you can call it out, an enormous tree swerves down from a crowd of its still brethren and clotheslines the giant. A ball of spit zips through the forest breaking branches and brush and the giant slams its back to the forest floor and even at this distance it rumbles the ground beneath your feet. You see more unhold giants coming and more schrats unweaving themselves from the camouflage of the forest to do battle with them. It's a schrat against unhold no holds barked brawl!}
b6f55eb1ce69657e225c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_107.png[/img]{%randombrother%一脚陷进林地的坑里，扭了小腿，气得破口大骂。%SPEECH_ON%他娘的，嫌老子的腿还不够酸吗！%SPEECH_OFF%你转头正要叫他安静，却忽然看见一只巨魔爬上战团刚翻过的林间山坡。你们费力攀登的地方，它却纵跃飞奔，身后掀起一片片小小的滑坡。你还没来得及示警，一棵巨树猛地从静立的同类之间探下身，用横枝拦住巨魔的脖子，将它掀翻。巨魔喷出的唾沫成团飞过林间，打折枝杈灌木，庞大后背重重砸向地面。即使隔着这么远，你脚下的土地仍在颤动。更多巨魔冲来，更多树妖也从森林的伪装中舒展身形，迎上去厮杀。这是一场树妖对巨魔、毫不留手的大混战！}

00a0f1c4159676e580d2.source: Let's get the hell out of here.

4bf5c93088227ca4b09e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_107.png[/img]{You crouch low and order the men to come forward and to do so quickly. They march past like ants as leaves and mats of hair sputter down from above and the violence of the giants claps against your ears like lightning. But you do manage to get out of there and leave the war of the monsters behind.}
4bf5c93088227ca4b09e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_107.png[/img]{你压低身子，命令弟兄们赶紧向前。他们像蚂蚁般鱼贯而过，头顶不断落下树叶与成团的毛发，巨兽搏杀的轰响如雷霆般震耳欲聋。不过，你们终究逃了出来，把怪物之间的战争留在了身后。}

84c09351c13063c5defd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_107.png[/img]{You draw your sword, but %randombrother% puts his hand on your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Really, captain?%SPEECH_OFF%}
84c09351c13063c5defd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_107.png[/img]{你拔出剑，%randombrother%却把手按在你肩上。%SPEECH_ON%团长，真要上？%SPEECH_OFF%}

a2da09f2e9cd79d857e6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]%randombrother% brings you to a crack in the side of a caliche berm. You can see something glinting in the dark. Whatever it is, its earthen hold would be hard going to dig through. The sellsword nods.%SPEECH_ON%I know it's in there good and solid, but I reckon that's something worth fetching. Whatchu think?%SPEECH_OFF%
a2da09f2e9cd79d857e6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]%randombrother%带你来到一处钙质硬土埂旁，侧面的裂缝里，有东西在暗处闪光。无论那是什么，要挖穿外面这层土壳都不容易。佣兵点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我知道它卡得够牢，不过我看值得挖出来。你说呢？%SPEECH_OFF%

6241709ccbb72bd722d9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]%miner% nods at your request. He gathers his tools and surveys the berm for a few minutes. He spits at the rock and nods and gets to work. A few minutes time and this stone hewer's already weeding out the weakspots and bringing the hard soil to crumbling dust. The hidden treasure reveals itself and the man pulls it free and hands it over.%SPEECH_ON%A nice workout, captain, and I'd say well worth the time. Appreciate you depending on me, I mean that honestly.%SPEECH_OFF%
6241709ccbb72bd722d9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]%miner%点头应下你的要求，拿齐工具，花了几分钟查看土埂。他朝石头啐了一口，点点头，开始干活。没一会儿，这位凿石好手便找准薄弱处，把坚硬的土石敲成碎屑。藏着的宝物显露出来，他取出来交给你。%SPEECH_ON%正好活动筋骨，团长，花这点工夫也值了。谢谢你信得过我，真心的。%SPEECH_OFF%

c2ed0266e1f825b15468.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]The ever tiny %tiny% walks up to the crack in the berm and stares into it. He turns 'round like a top.%SPEECH_ON%Now I ain't one to assume, but I've the sense of being slighted here.%SPEECH_OFF%You assure him that you mean nothing at all by asking he make use of his comical size. He nods and gets to the task as though he were born for it, easily wiggling his way into the crack until it's just a pair of boots sticking out the earth. One of the sellswords glances over and quietly asks if it's weird that he feels the urge to tickle the feet. You ask what in the fark does that mean with no intention of attaining an answer. Thankfully, %tiny% yells out that he's got the item and the men help yank him back out. %tiny% flips over with the treasure held aloft in his tiny hands.
c2ed0266e1f825b15468.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]个头一向矮小的%tiny%走到土坡裂缝前，向里张望，随即像陀螺似的转过身。%SPEECH_ON%我不是爱胡乱猜的人，可怎么觉得自己被小瞧了呢？%SPEECH_OFF%你向他保证，请他发挥这副滑稽身量的用处，绝无半点别的意思。他点点头，像生来就会似的轻巧钻进裂缝，直到外头只剩两只靴子。一个弟兄瞥了一眼，低声问，自己有点想挠那脚底，这算不算古怪？你反问他在说什么鬼话，却根本不想听答案。幸好，%tiny%在里面喊道，东西找到了，众人便合力把他拽出来。%tiny%翻过身，用小小的双手高高举起宝物。

ee18cd2e469fdc583f67.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]You order the sellswords to use whatever tools are available to dig into the berm. It takes a good clip of time to make headway into the caliche, but eventually %randombrother% manages to loosen the earth enough to reach in and take the hidden treasure right out. It's a golden chalice and a scattering of other items one could sell on the market.
ee18cd2e469fdc583f67.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]你命令佣兵利用手头的工具挖开土埂。硬土很难凿开，费了不少工夫，%randombrother%终于把土层挖得足够松，伸手取出了藏着的宝物。那是一只金酒杯，还有些可以拿到市场上卖掉的零碎物件。

e582f9e07bc1ef32cd35.translation: 今天运气站在咱们这边。

2eacbbd506089739e049.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]You order a few of the mercenaries to set upon the berm with whatever tools are good for the task. They get to it to the best of their abilities, but they've barely started the dig when a chunk of caliche slides free and clips %hurtbro%, knocking him out cold. The desired treasure rolls out after him and you come to find it's a rusted and rusticated piece of metal of almost no use to anyone.
2eacbbd506089739e049.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_66.png[/img]你叫几个佣兵找来合适的工具，动手挖掘土埂。他们尽力干活，可刚挖没多久，一大块硬土便滑落下来，撞中%hurtbro%，把他当场砸晕。你们惦记的宝贝随后也滚了出来：原来不过是一块锈迹斑斑、粗陋不堪的金属，几乎毫无用处。

41f7ab978174f4ff9365.source: Some miner's expertise could be of use here.
41f7ab978174f4ff9365.translation: 这事或许能用上矿工的经验。

d0ab07fa51d9976bdf0f.source: Any of you tiny enough to fit into that hole?
d0ab07fa51d9976bdf0f.translation: 谁的身板够小，能钻进那洞？

9830b2e4ac7cf528775a.source: That's not what we're after. Get ready to move on.
9830b2e4ac7cf528775a.translation: 这不是咱们要找的。准备继续走。

2f81a39a6aea6cbf6626.source: Used his mining experience to benefit the company

dbb1bd517c07bccec6d7.source: Used his unique stature to benefit the company
dbb1bd517c07bccec6d7.translation: 凭特殊的身材帮了战团

64f182048adb44a28f6f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_126.png[/img]{An old man is drawing upon a rock with some chalk. He regards the company as though it were a distraction to his art, but when you come around the side you see he's been 'painting' what look like giants looming over tribes of man. Tapping the chalk to the rock, he speaks as though in lesson.%SPEECH_ON%I wager the unhold giants have been here much longer than any man. Did you know there's sorts that live in the colds, others in the forests, and some in the swamps? And none of them is keen to one another. They're basically man at his most basic instincts, destructive toward and spiteful of its own kind, yet most animus is directed at one thing in particular.%SPEECH_OFF%The old man points the chalk at you and tips its end so that powder drifts from its tip.%SPEECH_ON%Outsiders. Stay away from them unholds, traveler.%SPEECH_OFF%He seems a bit wrong in the head and has nothing of value to rob except more chalk, so you hurry the company along. | A young child is found drawing in the mud of the path. As you draw near, you realize he's not actually on the path so much as inside a large divot of it where the mud cratered in the shape and size of a sarcophagus. The child is drawing along the inner walls, mostly crude shapes of dogs.%SPEECH_ON%My pa said they was 'unholds', unholds came thew right this way and to yonder, giants of lore, except they was 'as real as your mother's leaving me for that bastard Birk, who I will kill', he says that part a lot. Birk got it comin'. So he says. A lot. I think you should stay away from the unholds, mister. My pa says so, so I will too, and you should too. By the way, is yer name Birk?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head no and wish the child the best. In many regards you believe what he said was fair enough advice from a kid. | An elderly man with an absolutely boulder of a body regards you from a homestead porch.%SPEECH_ON%You know, I once saw an unhold in person. That's right. A real bonafide giant, the size of ten men stacked, if not larger. Was straying down the steppes, chasing horses and such. They sent a militia out after it and the damn thing threw them around like dolls. Picked one man up and threw him so hard I thought he'd fly over the damn mountains. You seem the fightin' type, so take it from this old geezer, keep away from them unholds.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and wish the elder the best.}
64f182048adb44a28f6f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_126.png[/img]{一个老人正用粉笔在石头上画画。他看待战团的目光，仿佛你们打扰了他的艺术。你绕到一旁，才看见他“画”的是巨人，俯视着人类部落。他用粉笔敲着石头，像在授课般说道。%SPEECH_ON%我敢说，巨魔来到这里，比人类早得多。你知道吗？有的住在寒地，有的住森林，还有的住沼泽，而且它们彼此也不对付。说白了，就是只剩原始本能的人类，敌视同类，互相破坏。可最深的敌意，终究还是冲着一种东西。%SPEECH_OFF%老人把粉笔指向你，轻轻一抖，粉末从笔尖飘落。%SPEECH_ON%外来者。离那些巨魔远点，旅人。%SPEECH_OFF%他似乎脑子有些毛病，身上除了更多粉笔，也没什么值得抢的，你便催战团继续前进。 | 你发现一个小孩正在路上的泥里画画。走近才看清，他与其说坐在路上，不如说坐在路面一个巨大的凹坑里，那泥坑形状、大小都像石棺。孩子沿着内壁画画，大多是些粗糙的狗形。%SPEECH_ON%我爹说，那叫“巨魔”。巨魔从这边走过去，一直走到那边。传说里的巨人，不过它们“就跟你娘跟着比尔克那个混蛋跑了一样真，我早晚杀了他”。他老说后半句。比尔克迟早遭报应，他这么说，老这么说。我觉得你该离巨魔远点，先生。我爹这么说，所以我也这么说，你也该听。对了，你叫比尔克吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头否认，祝孩子一切顺利。从许多方面看，一个孩子能给出这样的忠告，已经相当不错了。 | 一位壮得像块巨石的老人，从农舍门廊上打量你。%SPEECH_ON%你知道，我可亲眼见过巨魔。没错，货真价实的巨人，十个人摞起来那么高，没准还不止。它沿草原游荡，追马什么的。他们派了民兵去对付，结果那该死的东西把人当布娃娃扔。抓起一个，一甩，我还以为他要飞过那该死的山。你们像是打仗的，听老头子一句，离那些巨魔远点。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，向老人道了声珍重。}

f486453ecef35a97c187.source: Someone ought to pay us for taking care of them.
f486453ecef35a97c187.translation: 收拾这些东西，总该有人给咱们付钱。

d5e1cc705af89de864df.source: %terrainImage%{You find a man beside the road churning leaves with a mortar and pestle. He's also chewing some of the goods himself and looks up at you with a green grin.%SPEECH_ON%I've dealt with the bugs and insects all m'life, but them webknechts are something else entirely. I ain't ever seen a bug move tha' fass. Scissorin' and zippin' forward, grabbin' dogs and cats and such, stealing them aways. You stay clear of them right bastard spiders, ye hear?%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger hocks a loogie and then gets on with his work as though you'd never come by at all. | A woman in the doorway of a homestead regards the company with a series of nods. With a mug in hand she points at you, sloshing her drink around just as much as her speech.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, spiderfood comin' thew? Eh? Well git, them eight legged farks ain't keen on a game of wait and see, they'll find ye as soon as they hungry, and they always hungry, yessir, always foamin' at the mouth with that poison of theirs, yessir yessir.%SPEECH_OFF%She throws back a mug and falls back into the home's doorway with a clunk and clatter. | You come across a young man up in a poplar tree. He's somehow managed to construct a tiny abode the size and shape of an outhouse up in the heights. Looking down at you, he nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah you are incredulous about me and this here tree, well let me tell ya, them webknechts come fast. Spiders the size of dogs! And you know what I say to that? Fuck all of it. You can find me in these here trees from now on and if those damn beasts grow wings I'll just up and off my ownself thank ye very much.%SPEECH_OFF%Webknechts seem to be driving the locals mad, though you can't really blame them.}
d5e1cc705af89de864df.translation: %terrainImage%{你发现路边一个男人，正用杵臼捣碎叶子。他自己也嚼着一些，抬头冲你露出一嘴绿笑。%SPEECH_ON%我这辈子都跟虫子打交道，可那些巨蛛完全是另一回事。从没见过跑得那么快的虫子。腿一剪，嗖地就冲过去，抓住猫啊狗啊什么的，转眼就掳走。离那些混蛋蜘蛛远点，听见没？%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人咳出一口浓痰，继续干活，仿佛你压根没来过。 | 一户农家的门口，女人朝战团连连点头。她端着杯子指向你，酒晃得厉害，话也一样摇摇晃晃。%SPEECH_ON%啊，蜘蛛的口粮路过啦？嗯？快走吧，那些八条腿的混蛋可没耐心等着看。只要饿了，它们就来找你，而它们一直都饿，是啊，嘴里永远冒着毒沫子，对啊，对啊。%SPEECH_OFF%她仰头灌下一杯，随后往屋门里一倒，砰当哐啷一阵响。 | 你遇见一个待在白杨树上的年轻人。不知他怎么做到的，竟在高处搭了间厕所大小、模样也像厕所的小屋。他低头看着你，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%没错，你觉得我跟这棵树挺不可思议吧？我跟你说，那些巨蛛跑得可快了。跟狗一样大的蜘蛛！你知道我怎么想吗？去他妈的，爱咋咋地。往后就在树上找我吧。要是那些该死的畜生再长出翅膀，我就干脆自己了断，谢谢了。%SPEECH_OFF%看来，巨蛛已经把当地人逼疯了。不过，你也实在怪不得他们。}

33808f1dc6678271d427.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{%callbrother% runs into your tent and says something is watching the camp. You come outside to see a silhouette in the distance, skulking behind brush and tree limbs. You know its staring when it hisses, for what else would it be looking at to elicit such a charge. Its arms are long and slender and end in claws. You take a torch and sling it toward the beast. Its slick skin winks a vibrant orange and it shrieks away from the cloud of embers and sparks as the torch lands and rolls past. The toothy maw is the last thing you see fading back into the darkness.%SPEECH_ON%I think it's an alp, sir. It's all by itself as far as we can tell.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if the sellsword has had visions. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, some, but I also been drinking so there's that.%SPEECH_OFF%}
33808f1dc6678271d427.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{%callbrother%冲进帐篷，说有东西正窥探营地。你来到外头，看见远处一道黑影，在灌木和树枝后鬼祟游移。它嘶叫一声，你便知道它在盯着你们——除了你们，还有什么能惹来这样的挑衅？它的双臂细长，末端生着利爪。你取来火把，朝它掷去。火把落地翻滚，溅起一片火星，它湿滑的皮肤映出鲜亮橙光，尖叫着躲开。最后消失在黑暗中的，是那张满口尖牙的嘴。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我看是只梦魇。目前只发现它一个。%SPEECH_OFF%你问这佣兵有没有看见幻象。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，是有些。不过我也喝了酒，说不好。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1106385e20e4d23c34f7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img]{The alp is alone and possibly a youngling. Even monsters have to cut their cloth and put in the work to become truly horrible beasts, and this one just doesn't seem there yet. You send a pair of sellswords to slay the beast. They close in on it through the shroud of darkness. You see the silhouettes rising up in ambush and there's a clatter and a scream, and another scream which is nothing humanlike at all. Shrieking now. And this time a man crying. Someone speaking. Quiet. A long, long quiet. Then the pair comes back. One is clutching his head as though taken by a terrific ache, the other looks at you and nods.%SPEECH_ON%We killed it and, uh, I think we need to lie down.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1106385e20e4d23c34f7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img]{这只梦魇孤零零的，兴许还是个幼崽。即使是怪物，也得磨炼一番，才能长成真正可怕的恶兽；眼前这只显然还差些火候。你派出两个弟兄去宰了它。他们借着夜色慢慢靠近。你看见两道黑影暴起袭击，随即传来一阵碰撞声和一声惨叫，接着又是一声，听着全然不像人类。然后是刺耳的尖啸。再然后，一个男人哭了起来。有人在说话。四周安静下来，久久没有声响。终于，两人回来了。一个抱着脑袋，像是头疼欲裂；另一个看着你，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%杀掉了。呃，我想我们得躺会儿。%SPEECH_OFF%}

755deb9b10870b9c7de3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{You tell the men to ignore the alp. If it were of any danger it would have already proven so. Instead, it has let you know it is there, whether by ignorance or arrogance, neither of which bother you none. A few of the men do not agree with this decision and they stay up all night watching for the beast.}
755deb9b10870b9c7de3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你告诉弟兄们别理会那只梦魇。它若真有危险，早该有所行动；如今却让你们发现了踪迹，无论出于无知还是傲慢，你都懒得在意。有几个弟兄不同意，整夜未眠，守着那怪物的动静。}

de8a5443960e1cc1d088.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img]{%beastslayer% the beast slayer comes over.%SPEECH_ON%It ain't dangerous, it's confused. I'll take care of this.%SPEECH_OFF%He's chewing on a dried biscuit and grunts and puts the biscuit in his pocket and sets off into the dark all by himself. A moment later, the alp's silhouette suddenly falls away and disappears. A few minutes later and the slayer returns, shoving the last morsels of the biscuit into his mouth. You ask why the alp didn't put up much of a fight. The beast slayer laughs.%SPEECH_ON%You said %callbrother% fetched you from your tent, right? Right. And where is %callbrother%?%SPEECH_OFF%The beast slayer points toward the campfire. The sellsword is there. Asleep. Deeply asleep. %beastslayer% gets himself another biscuit.%SPEECH_ON%Young alps are still learning how to pry into your mind. They're not good at it and often call attention to themselves while trying. They're like thieves who can't pick a lock, so they knock on the door instead.%SPEECH_OFF%A few of the men listen to this and are emboldened by the apparent flaws of these otherwise horrifying creatures.}
