de8a5443960e1cc1d088.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img]{猎兽者%beastslayer%走了过来。%SPEECH_ON%它不是要害人，只是迷糊了。我来处理。%SPEECH_OFF%他正嚼着一块干饼，哼了一声，把饼揣进口袋，独自走入黑暗。片刻后，梦魇的轮廓忽然退去，消失不见。又过了几分钟，猎兽者回来了，把最后几口饼塞进嘴里。你问，那梦魇为何没多作反抗。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%你说，是%callbrother%到帐篷里把你叫出来的，对吧？好，那%callbrother%在哪儿？%SPEECH_OFF%猎兽者指向营火。佣兵正躺在那里，睡着了，睡得很沉。%beastslayer%又给自己拿了块饼。%SPEECH_ON%年幼的梦魇还在学怎么钻进人的脑子。本事不到家，动手时往往先暴露了自己。就像不会撬锁的贼，只好改去敲门。%SPEECH_OFF%几个弟兄听见这番话，得知这些可怕的生物原来也有如此明显的弱点，胆气顿时壮了不少。}

59d4c5fba88782ff9118.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{%flagellant% the flagellant is at the rim of the camp whipping himself raw. His soul cleansing tool is rigged with broken glass and cat claws, bound tight with leather rinsed taut in urine, and tassels of twisted horse hair. He walks out into the wilderness, hiding himself with every step.%SPEECH_ON%It's not that I fear you, creature in the shadows. It's not that I fear you, shadows in my mind. It's not that I fear you, mind in my body.%SPEECH_OFF%The man stops walking, but the urgency of his flagellation increases and you can see the flecks of blood winking in the moonlight.%SPEECH_ON%It is that I fear the old gods of which you are not! Of which you are but an insect!%SPEECH_OFF%The alp's silhouette shrinks away, shrieks, and then scurries off altogether. The man returns and collapses into the camp. A few of the men are horrified, while others are emboldened by his courage and righteousness.}
59d4c5fba88782ff9118.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{苦修者%flagellant%站在营地边缘，正把自己抽得皮开肉绽。他那件净化灵魂的刑具嵌着碎玻璃和猫爪，用尿液浸制绷紧的皮条牢牢缚住，还垂着拧成束的马鬃。他走向荒野，每迈一步，就往自己身上抽一鞭。%SPEECH_ON%阴影中的怪物，我不怕你。心中的阴影，我不怕你。体内的心智，我不怕你。%SPEECH_OFF%他停住脚步，鞭打却愈发急促，飞溅的血珠在月光下闪烁。%SPEECH_ON%我所畏惧的是旧神，而你根本不是！在祂们面前，你不过是只虫子！%SPEECH_OFF%梦魇的轮廓向后缩去，发出尖叫，随后彻底逃远。他折返营地，倒在地上。几个弟兄被吓得不轻，另一些却因他的勇气与正气而备受鼓舞。}

8fad167ec7fdb49e8ef4.source: Had an alp invade his mind

be299625995e1f81541d.source: Emboldened by learning of the weakness of young alps
be299625995e1f81541d.translation: 得知幼年梦魇的弱点后，胆气大增

4749b623db697ec84a8b.source: %terrainImage%{You come across a caldera the bottom of which you find a few sheep nuzzling something. As you draw close, you see that there is an enormous hound there, its fur matted with blood, its collar shredded, and its paws wiry where the claws have come apart. It regards you with a growl, but can't maintain it for long as it simply puts its head down with an exhausted huff. The sheep depart and beyond them you find a man leaning against a rock. His chest has been ripped open and whatever killed him did it with such force as to spray his innards all along the rocks. Following the trail, you do find a monstrous Nachzehrer whose throat has been ripped out. %randombrother% nods.%SPEECH_ON%I think that pup might be worth having in the company.%SPEECH_OFF%}
4749b623db697ec84a8b.translation: %terrainImage%{你来到一处火山口，发现底下有几只羊正拱着什么东西。走近一看，竟是一条硕大的猎犬。它的毛被血黏成一团，项圈撕烂了，爪子也劈裂磨损得不成样子。它冲你低吼，却没能坚持多久，便疲惫地呼了口气，重新垂下头去。羊群散开后，你看见更远处有个男人靠在岩石上。他的胸膛被撕开了，下手的东西力气大得惊人，把他的内脏喷溅得到处都是。你循着痕迹找去，果然发现一只硕大的食尸鬼，喉咙已被扯断。%randombrother%点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%我看这条狗值得带回战团。%SPEECH_OFF%}

716bc58ddc431e0b34a2.source: He'll fit right in with us.

8a6d01b0abaed434b166.source: %terrainImage%{You reach out to the hound and it lifts it head to you as though you were another threat. Its eyes peer blackly from a long-matted mane that still drips with blood. The sheep, having seen what carnage this beast has already wrought, bay nervously as they watch you. But you won't be deterred. You put your hand forth, palm supinated, and the weary dog slowly lowers into it. You nod.%SPEECH_ON%There's more fight in you yet, friend.%SPEECH_OFF%}
8a6d01b0abaed434b166.translation: %terrainImage%{你朝猎犬伸出手，它抬起头，像是又遇到了一个威胁。纠结已久的鬃毛仍滴着血，一双黑眼睛从中望来。羊群见识过这头猛兽造成的杀戮，一边紧张地叫着，一边盯着你。你却没有退缩，而是掌心朝上，把手递过去。疲惫的狗慢慢将头放进你手里。你点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%朋友，你还有力气再战。%SPEECH_OFF%}

2c26ba9c89d7a81e134a.source: %terrainImage%{You move to take the hound, but as you crouch down one of the sheep bays and charges, knocking you over. The men laugh and by the time you get to your knees another sheep crushes you from behind to many cheers. Drawing out your sword emits a sharp twang that sends the sheep scurrying. When you look back at the hound its nose is to the dirt and its eyes peerless. It has died and the sheep slowly collect around it bleating and crying out. You sheathe your sword and tell the company to move on.}
2c26ba9c89d7a81e134a.translation: %terrainImage%{你上前想带走猎犬，可刚蹲下，一只羊便咩叫着冲来，把你撞倒。弟兄们哈哈大笑。你才撑起膝盖，又被另一只羊从后面撞趴，惹来一片喝彩。你拔剑出鞘，铮然一响，羊群顿时四散。再看猎犬时，它的鼻子已经贴着泥土，双眼失去了神采。它死了。羊群慢慢围拢，咩咩哀叫。你收剑入鞘，命令战团继续赶路。}

5e48796aa2bb84cdcd60.source: %terrainImage%{%houndman% steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%I know this breed. It is of northern stock, a sturdy creature. There is one thing it shall respect in a man and it is strength.%SPEECH_OFF%The sellsword crouches before the dog and without pause puts its hands around the scuff of its neck and starts to scratch. Despite the sudden movements, the dog responds positively and when the man stops scratching the dog lifts up off the ground and lopes forward and follows the man. %houndman% stares back at you as he roughs the dog up with some heavy petting.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah he'll fight for us. Fightin' is what he's made for. He just needed someone to watch him rip and tear.%SPEECH_OFF%What a lovely creature this is. And the dog is fine, too.}
5e48796aa2bb84cdcd60.translation: %terrainImage%{%houndman%走上前。%SPEECH_ON%我认得这个品种。北方的血统，结实得很。要让它服一个人，就得拿出力气来。%SPEECH_OFF%他在狗面前蹲下，毫不迟疑地双手抓住它颈后的皮毛，揉搓起来。动作虽突然，那狗却很受用。他一停手，狗便从地上爬起来，小跑着跟上了他。%houndman%一边大力揉着狗，一边回头看你。%SPEECH_ON%行了，它会替咱们打仗。这家伙天生就是干这个的，只是少个看它撕咬敌人的伴儿罢了。%SPEECH_OFF%真是个讨人喜欢的家伙。那条狗也不错。}

28f06657de4d6c9c7df5.source: %houndman%, you've dealt with hounds before, right?
28f06657de4d6c9c7df5.translation: %houndman%，你以前跟猎犬打过交道，对吧？

630611368b7fd5be8312.source: Just put it out of its misery.

1807f3e7922d78d9a289.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%barbarian% shares tales around the campfire of northern heroics and monsters. There can't be much said of his dialogue, given that he isn't the most eloquent, but he does a great job of it through miming and drawing in the ground. {One tale seems to be that of a huge warrior defeating a much larger warrior, or perhaps even defeating an ogre. It's hard to tell, but the barbarian makes a fascinating display of combat which the men applaud. | One tale is of two lovers, and with great use of his hands, makes a riveting show of what it is to plough and be ploughed. And, apparently, what it is to be betrayed and stabbed in the back. You're not sure who is stabbing whom, nor when or in what sense, but the tale has the men on the edges of their seats and ends with applause. | One tale speaks to a friendly unhold. The men gasp at the very notion of it, but the barbarian slaps his wrists and wags his finger. This, you assume, is his way of telling you it's all true, every word or grunt. The idea of a friendly monster unsettles the men initially, but by the end of the story they clap and nod as though they wish it really were the truth.}
1807f3e7922d78d9a289.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%barbarian%围着营火，讲起北方的英雄与怪物。他实在算不上口齿伶俐，单听言语，着实没什么可称道；可他连比带画，又在地上作图，倒把故事讲得有声有色。{其中一个故事，似乎讲的是一名魁梧战士打败了另一名更魁梧的战士，也可能是打败了一头食人魔。很难分清，不过蛮族演起搏斗来精彩极了，赢得弟兄们阵阵掌声。 | 其中一个故事讲的是一对情人。他双手并用，把如何“耕耘”与如何“被耕耘”演得引人入胜。显然，故事里还有背叛和背后捅刀。你弄不清谁在捅谁，什么时候捅，又是哪种意义上的捅，但弟兄们都听得坐不住，结尾时掌声四起。 | 其中一个故事讲的是一头友善的巨魔。光是这个说法，就让弟兄们倒吸一口气，蛮族却拍着手腕，摇着手指。你猜，他是在保证这全是真的，每句话、每声哼哼都是真的。起初，友善的怪物这个念头让大家有些不安，可等故事讲完，他们纷纷鼓掌点头，仿佛真心希望世上有这样的事。}

0c1805ce610dcb7c269a.source: %terrainImage%{Unlike the south, finding travelers on the northern 'roads' is often a cause for caution. You never know what monstrous man or beastly barbarian you'll come across next. This time it is a large man limping with a dog beside him. You draw your sword halfway out of its sheath and loud enough to gain his ear. The man looks up and his dog rears to the sudden yank of a leash. The northerner can speak a bit of your tongue.%SPEECH_ON%Ahh, fighters. I'm a fighter myself.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask why he is alone. He explains that his clan had a dispute, and that he was to duel another man to decide who would take control. You ask why he did not duel this man, you ask if he is afraid. The traveler shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%No. The clansman was my brother. And I'd no desire to kill kin. They gave me this bitch here as both insult and reward and threw me from the tribe. I've no land or people to go to, but if you'd have me, I'd surely fight for you just as well as anyone else.%SPEECH_OFF%}
0c1805ce610dcb7c269a.translation: %terrainImage%{与南方不同，在北方的“道路”上遇见旅人，往往得先提起戒心。谁也不知道，下一次撞上的会是什么怪人或凶蛮之徒。这回，是个身材高大的男人，一瘸一拐地走着，旁边跟着狗。你把剑拔出半截，故意让出鞘声引起他的注意。男人抬头，手中牵绳猛地一扯，狗也跟着后仰。他倒能说几句你们的语言。%SPEECH_ON%啊，战士。我也是战士。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他为何独行。他解释，氏族里起了争执，本该由他与另一人决斗，决定谁掌权。你问他为什么没打，是不是害怕。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不是。那族人是我兄弟，我不想杀自己的亲人。他们把这条母狗给我，既是羞辱，也是赏赐，然后把我赶出部族。我已无地可去，无人可投。你若肯收留，我定能像其他人一样为你作战。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1be183e082984bd5dfd5.source: You've found a new tribe, friend.
1be183e082984bd5dfd5.translation: 朋友，你找到新的部族了。

a7f62f7adb384d3ffcb4.source: We have no need for you.

f556a836ec0c091e9bfa.source: %name% joined you after being exiled from his tribe in the north for refusing to kill his brother. He'll fight for you as well as for anyone.
f556a836ec0c091e9bfa.translation: %name%因不肯杀死自己的兄弟，被北方部族放逐，随后加入了你。他会尽心为你作战，就如同曾为旁人效力一样。

a938cfb5e63f4339f444.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{While visiting %townname%, you are called on by a young boy who comes crying that undead are coming to eat his family. You ask how many and he says just one, but that it's of deadly stock.%SPEECH_ON%I think it's my old babysitter. She was never keen on me. Please, help!%SPEECH_OFF%If it's just one wiederganger it should not be that much trouble and you can probably handle it yourself.}
a938cfb5e63f4339f444.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{造访%townname%时，一个小男孩哭着跑来，说亡灵要吃掉他全家。你问有几个，他说只有一个，却凶得很。%SPEECH_ON%我觉得是以前照看我的老太太。她一直不喜欢我。快帮帮忙！%SPEECH_OFF%若只有一具行尸，应该不太难对付，你一个人多半就能解决。}

b9d4c07821fc713d9b1e.source: Lead us to your house, kid.

412dd4798dc49989eb8e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You rush to the boy's home and rush through the door. You find his family setting up the dinner table. They look at you as though you were a madman and one asks if they can help you. The boy starts laughing so hard he clenches his stomach and rolls around on the ground. The mother grabs him by the ear. She apologizes as she hands him off to his father for a good whipping.%SPEECH_ON%Sorry, sellsword, we mean no trouble but this boy, well he does as he pleases sometimes.%SPEECH_OFF%Can't really fault a boy for being a boy, though this one is definitely a little shite if you've ever seen one. You head back to the markets.}
412dd4798dc49989eb8e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你冲到男孩家，闯进门，却发现他家人正在摆餐桌。他们像看疯子一样望着你，有人问你有什么事。男孩笑得捂住肚子，在地上打滚。母亲揪住他的耳朵，一边道歉，一边把他交给父亲，好好抽上一顿。%SPEECH_ON%对不起，佣兵，我们无意惹麻烦。只是这孩子，有时就是由着性子胡来。%SPEECH_OFF%孩子淘气，本也不能全怪他。不过你见过的小混蛋里，这个绝对算得上一个。你转身回了集市。}

553cd6bd3809cfa5e3a7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{As you peruse a merchant's goods, a little voice yells out for you. Turning, you see it's that damned kid again. He's pointing homeward once more.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! One's there! I'm serious! You have to help!%SPEECH_OFF%You ask why he doesn't bother one of the townguards and he says that none trust him.%SPEECH_ON%Fetched them on too many lies I 'ave! Please, help! My family is going to be slaughtered!%SPEECH_OFF%}
553cd6bd3809cfa5e3a7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{你正在查看商人的货物，一个细小的声音又叫住了你。回头一看，又是那个该死的孩子，正朝自己家指。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！真有一个在那儿！这次没骗你！快帮忙啊！%SPEECH_OFF%你问他为什么不去找镇上卫兵，他说已经没人肯信他了。%SPEECH_ON%以前骗他们去过太多次了！求求你，救命啊！我全家都要被杀了！%SPEECH_OFF%}

4b952a725f701c2e5618.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{Sighing, you tell the boy to lead the way. Surprise surprise, you've been made a fool of again. The boy can't stop laughing even as his father whips him a good one. The mother, again, apologizes and hands you a small giftbag of goods for your trouble and 'looking out' for them. You head back to the markets.}
4b952a725f701c2e5618.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你叹了口气，让男孩带路。毫不意外，你又被耍了。即使父亲狠狠抽了他一顿，他还是笑个不停。母亲再次向你道歉，送上一小袋东西，感谢你来回奔忙、“照顾”他们一家。你回了市场。}

e4b4baa7b09adb10a771.source: That makes up for the trouble.

0b2a274f5518ddb043ae.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{While back in the market, you're already expecting that savage little liar to come by. You feign shock when he's pulling on your hand. A moment comes by and you see yourself socking him right in the jaw. Of course, that would not look good to those who know naught what is going on so you keep yourself steady.}
0b2a274f5518ddb043ae.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{再次来到市场，你已经料到那个野性难驯的小骗子还会出现。他拽住你的手时，你装出一副惊讶模样。有那么一瞬，你仿佛看见自己一拳砸在他下巴上。不过，不明缘由的旁观者可不会觉得这好看，所以你还是忍住了。}

a83e97d203bbad9b54f1.source: Gee, I wonder how this will turn out.
a83e97d203bbad9b54f1.translation: 哟，倒要看看这事会怎么收场。

fca7fd6a5751e1dd7bcc.source: Run before you get a beating, boy!

da08e8450739d1b3754a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{Warily, you return to the boy's home. The second you open the door to see the family enjoying a game of cards you to turn around and grab the kid by his throat and slam him against the wall. You kick the door closed so no one can see. The father gets up and tells you that's his son you're manhandling. You tell the father to give you the switch used to beat his boy. Cautiously, he does as told. This time, you punish the kid yourself and when you're finished he's a welted, weeping mess.

You throw the switch at the crumpled child and tell the parents to pay you for your time, informing them that a 'sellsword never works for free.'}
da08e8450739d1b3754a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你满心戒备，再次来到男孩家。门一开，看见全家人正高高兴兴地打牌，你立刻转身掐住男孩的脖子，把他摁到墙上，又一脚关上门，不让外人看见。父亲站起身，说你粗暴对待的是他的儿子。你叫他把平时教训孩子的藤条拿来。他小心翼翼地照办。这回，你亲自惩罚男孩，等停手时，他浑身鞭痕，哭成一团。

你把藤条扔向蜷缩的孩子，叫父母赔偿你浪费的时间，并告诉他们：‘佣兵从不白干活。’}

df6900da4cba60f60ddc.source: Punitive measures had to be taken.

083bc8a6112ed65d9d54.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{Warily, you return to the boy's home. Opening the door, you turn to the kid and tell him if he's lying once again you'll... before you can even finish the threat a scream draws your attention to the family. A large, ghoulish figure is terrorizing the mother and the father is using a broom to try and beat it back. You draw your sword, step forward, and cut the wiederganger down. Its head rolls free and splashes into a crockpot while the body crumples and spews black sludge across the floorboards.

 You turn to the boy and tell him that you almost didn't come for a liar's truth will always remain a lie to all others. He nods and thanks you for believing him this time. The parents thank you, too, but with a little more care: a satchel of crowns and goods.}
083bc8a6112ed65d9d54.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你满心戒备，再次来到男孩家。打开门，你转头告诉他，要是又撒谎，你就……威胁尚未说完，一声尖叫便让你望向屋内。一具高大骇人的行尸正扑向母亲，父亲挥着扫帚，试图把它赶开。你拔剑上前，将行尸砍倒。脑袋滚落，扑通掉进炖锅，身躯则瘫倒在地，把黑色污液泼满地板。

你转向男孩，说自己差点就没来，因为骗子即便说了真话，在别人耳里也还是谎言。他点头，感谢你这回肯相信他。父母也向你致谢，而且更实在一些：送上了一袋克朗和财物。}

b8e6bee2d2405aa17cba.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You distrust the little runt and tell him to stop playing games. He spits and churns some rocks beneath a boot.%SPEECH_ON%Hell, mister, I was trying to 'ave some fun.%SPEECH_OFF%When he turns to leave, you give him a swift kick in the arse.}
b8e6bee2d2405aa17cba.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你不信这个小崽子，叫他别再耍花样。他啐了一口，用靴子碾着碎石。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼，先生，我只是想找点乐子。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身要走，你照着屁股飞快踹了一脚。}

9498aa9134f9448dedcf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You tell the boy if he doesn't get out of sight you'll report him to the guards and have him thrown into the dungeons. He huffs and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Shite, mister, just 'aving a bit of a laugh, that's all.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9498aa9134f9448dedcf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你告诉男孩，再不从眼前消失，就叫卫兵把他扔进地牢。他哼哼唧唧，啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%妈的，先生，不就是开个玩笑嘛。%SPEECH_OFF%}

bd905bbec3b7ec15f8ad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You crouch down low so you and the kid can see eye to eye. You ask if he's lying. Slowly, he nods. A guard, overhearing this, comes over and grabs the child by his arm.%SPEECH_ON%Oy', lying again are we? What did I tell you about bothering the travelers, hm? I suppose your father hasn't been strong with his switch-hand if yer at it again. Now we'll see how you fare in the dungeons!%SPEECH_OFF%The boy is taken away, balling his eyes out as a couple of rusty shackles are slapped on him. This is one of the happiest moments of your life.}
bd905bbec3b7ec15f8ad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你蹲下来，与孩子平视，问他是不是在撒谎。他慢慢点了头。一个卫兵听见了，走过来一把抓住他的胳膊。%SPEECH_ON%喂，又骗人？我怎么跟你说的，不许骚扰旅人，嗯？看来你爹抽藤条的手还是不够狠，居然又犯。那就去地牢里尝尝滋味！%SPEECH_OFF%一副锈镣铐铐上身，男孩哭得泪如泉涌，被人拖走。这真是你此生最开心的时刻之一。}

21f6d439d1bf82af9027.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]{You tell the boy to stuff it. He begs again and, for a moment, it's as though something real is behind his lying eyes. But you're not buying it. The boy runs off, now asking the guards for help. They also turn him down. A few merchants laugh.%SPEECH_ON%Nobody believes your lies, little runt.%SPEECH_OFF%But a shriek cuts the humor short. A man limps across the street, clutching his neck which is spraying blood between the fingers. He collapses to the ground. A sallow skinned woman chases after, falling to the man's body and biting into his leg. Guards rush to the scene and slaughter the dead and dying while the newly orphaned by wails on.}
21f6d439d1bf82af9027.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_29.png[/img]{你让男孩闭嘴。他再次哀求，有那么一瞬间，那双惯于撒谎的眼睛里，仿佛真藏着什么。可你不信。男孩跑开，转而向卫兵求助，也被拒绝了。几个商人笑道：%SPEECH_ON%小崽子，没人再信你的鬼话了。%SPEECH_OFF%一声惨叫却突然打断了笑声。一个男人踉跄着穿过街道，紧捂脖子，鲜血仍从指缝间喷出。他倒在地上，一个皮肤蜡黄的女人紧追而来，扑到他身上，咬住他的腿。卫兵冲上前，将死者与将死之人一并砍倒，刚刚沦为孤儿的男孩在旁嚎啕大哭。}

f872fb71a17d4271a26f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{An urgency takes %randomcultist%. He stands, removes himself from the party's campfire, strides across the campground and retires to his tent. It is there that you see him at work, his silhouette and shadows moving frenetically. And there's more than just him in there: curves of unknown come and go beside him, reaching up in poles of black, tendrils of darkness, whipping and flailing to match the energy of his own procession. And then he is done, his silhouette falling forward before yanking something to the light.

 He leaves his tent with the sort of hurry with which he entered, but this time he has a piece of leather chest armor in hand. He drops it to the ground.%SPEECH_ON%He awaits us all, brothers.%SPEECH_OFF%The chest armor is patterned with unique cuts which are arranged in strips that, to the unbelieving eye, would be meaningless. To you, it is but a language of Davkul.}
f872fb71a17d4271a26f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{一股急迫感突然攫住%randomcultist%。他站起身，离开众人围坐的篝火，快步穿过营地，钻进自己的帐篷。你看见他在里面忙碌，身形与影子急促晃动。可里面似乎不止他一个：不明的弧影在他身旁来去，时而竖成漆黑的长杆，时而化作黑暗的卷须，跟着他的动作抽打翻腾。终于，他停下，影子向前俯倒，又猛地将什么东西拽到灯光下。

 他像来时一样匆忙走出帐篷，这回手中却多了一件皮胸甲。他把它扔在地上。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，祂在等待我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%胸甲上刻着独特的切口，排列成一道道条纹。不信之人看来，那全无意义；可你知道，那是达夫库尔的语言。}

dbaaf5dae5fb9408d5e5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%cultist% enters your tent and a strong, brisk wind chases in after him, rearing up your scrolls and other notes. He walks forward, hands crossed before him, a rather priestly look to his approach.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, I've been spoken to and it is a grave matter which I've been given responsibility for.%SPEECH_OFF%You put your hand up and tell the man to be silent. Carefully, you reach out to each candle in the tent and snuff them out until one remains. You bring it to your face...
dbaaf5dae5fb9408d5e5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%cultist%走进帐篷，一阵劲风紧随其后，掀起你的卷轴与笔记。他双手交叠身前，像个祭司般走上前来。%SPEECH_ON%大人，我聆听了启示，受托办理一件极为重大的事。%SPEECH_OFF%你抬手叫他安静，随后小心地将帐内蜡烛逐一掐灭，只留最后一支。你把它举到脸前……

28dd8b86479485b4c8b9.translation: 达夫库尔，向我降下神谕。

fb224f1f546d03431a93.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Kneeling before the candle, you hold your hand over the flame and the fire comes to a standstill, pointing upright and unmoving. You've seen icicles more animated than it. You stare into the glow and the tent melts away, slipping into the folds of an immense and immutable darkness. The cultist is gone. In his place is a black cloak, its arms to your shoulders, a slate of granite for a head, its edges chipped and cracking. It appears there is something behind this mask, behind this futile effort to keep your mind safe from its true visage. You reach out to the mask, but some invisible force stops you.%SPEECH_ON%In good time you shall see all that I am.%SPEECH_OFF%The voice is booming yet narrowed into a brutish whisper only for you to hear.%SPEECH_ON%I'll give you Death, mortal, and warmed in its comforts, Death shall be visited upon your enemies. %sacrifice% will not be lost, he will be with you always, this I promise you.%SPEECH_OFF%A whiteness snaps back over you, a rush of wind, tent flaps curling outward, the candle's flame tilting impossibly without going out, and a frigid coolness that has your first breath seen floating across the air. %cultist% is nowhere to be seen. You quickly get up and touch your face and skin, making sure that you are all that you're supposed to be. To your great disappointment, Davkul is gone and you are still you.
fb224f1f546d03431a93.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你跪在蜡烛前，将手悬在火焰上方。火苗骤然静止，笔直向上，纹丝不动，连你见过的冰柱都比它活泛。你凝视着烛光，帐篷渐渐融化，滑进无边无际、亘古不变的黑暗褶皱里。教徒不见了，取而代之的是一袭黑斗篷，双臂搭在你的肩上，头颅的位置却是一块花岗岩板，边缘残破开裂。面具后似乎还有什么；这层遮掩徒劳地挡住真容，想让你的心智免受伤害。你伸手探向面具，却被一股无形之力拦住。%SPEECH_ON%时机到了，你自会看清我的全部。%SPEECH_OFF%那声音轰然震响，却又收束成只让你听见的粗暴低语。%SPEECH_ON%凡人，我将赐你死亡。你将安卧于它的慰藉之中，而死亡将降临你的敌人。%sacrifice%不会消逝，他将永远与你同在，这是我的承诺。%SPEECH_OFF%一道白光猛地将你罩住，疾风涌来，帐篷门帘向外翻卷，烛焰倾斜到不可思议的角度，却始终未熄。刺骨的寒意里，你第一口呼吸化作白雾，飘过眼前。%cultist%已不知去向。你赶紧起身，摸摸自己的脸与皮肤，确认该在的都还在。令你无比失望的是，达夫库尔已经离开，而你仍只是你。

57e02bb33f92ee5a73e2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Davkul would be most unhappy with your failure to obey, not that you feel any urge other than to do what is asked. You and the %cultist% go to %sacrifice%'s tent. He leans up as though already expecting you and he sees the knife in the carriage of your party and nods at the simple sight of it. %cultist% kneels beside the man and you realize they've already talked before this, that the question to you very well may have been a test of your devotion to Davkul. You are happy to have passed.

%sacrifice% unbuttons his shirt and %cultist% pierces his chest as though he were putting a key into a lock, and he twists it all the same. The sacrifice gasps and tenses, for no devotion to Davkul can put aside the manner in which death may be permitted, which is in pain and suffering. But he smiles, and the light doesn't so much go out of his eyes as the darkness, a sort you haven't seen before, replaces it. And like that, he is gone.

 %cultist% gets to work on the still warm corpse, carving the flesh with rapid slices across the skin and hard cuts into the tendons. He pulls the chest apart. A black fog lingers with the blade's every move, and it seems to sway cheerily after its every move. When %cultist% is done, %sacrifice% has been turned into a slab of armor, flesh torn asunder and stretched, teeth for rivets, tendons for strappings, bones for pauldrons, a cuirass of absolute carnage. And it pulses and moves as though that manifested it still lived. %cultist% turns to you, his hands slopped red.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits us all.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and embrace your fellow comrade.
57e02bb33f92ee5a73e2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]若你拒不服从，达夫库尔必然极为不悦。不过，你本来也只想遵从吩咐。你与%cultist%前往%sacrifice%的帐篷。他撑起身子，仿佛早已等着你们，看见来人带着刀，便平静地点了点头。%cultist%跪在他身旁。你这才明白，他们此前已经谈过；向你提出这个问题，很可能只是试探你对达夫库尔的虔诚。你很高兴自己通过了考验。

%sacrifice%解开上衣，%cultist%将刀刺入他的胸口，像把钥匙插进锁里，又同样转动了一下。祭品猛吸一口气，全身绷紧。再虔诚地信奉达夫库尔，也无法免除死亡降临时必经的痛苦与折磨。可他仍在微笑。那双眼里的光，与其说是熄灭，不如说被一种你前所未见的黑暗取代。就这样，他死了。

 %cultist%开始处理仍有余温的尸体，迅疾划开皮肤，用力切断肌腱，再将胸膛撑开。每一次运刀，都有黑雾萦绕，仿佛欢快地追随刀刃摇摆。等%cultist%做完，%sacrifice%已变成一副盔甲：血肉撕开、撑展，牙齿做铆钉，肌腱做束带，骨头做肩甲，整副胸甲就是一场血腥屠戮的凝结。它还在起伏、蠕动，仿佛化作它的人仍然活着。%cultist%转向你，双手沾满鲜血。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔等待着我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，拥抱了这位同道。

c2de1e0a8a802257b862.source: It is done, and it is good.

758296a151402bdd13d5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You feel this is a test. Not one to pass by sacrificing one of your men, but quite the opposite. Davkul may have sent false believers to see if you would do all that they say, simply because they say it. You do not know how you know this, you just know, which is the very sort of certainty a man should follow most. Just as you stand to go tell %cultist% of your decision, half the candles in the room suddenly blow out. Tendrils of smoke waft in the remaining gloom, a twisting haze through which, for but a moment, you swear you see a blackened visage fade out the tent's opening. You get the feeling that %cultist% already knows what choice you've made. You stay in the tent and await Davkul's presence. When it is not felt, you simply light the candles again and speak to the emptied room.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits us all.%SPEECH_OFF%
758296a151402bdd13d5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你觉得，这是一场考验。过关的方法并非献祭一个弟兄，恰恰相反。达夫库尔或许派来了伪信者，要看你会不会只因对方开口，便言听计从。你不知道这份确信从何而来，但你就是知道，而人最该遵从的，正是这样的笃定。你刚站起身，准备将决定告诉%cultist%，帐内一半蜡烛突然熄灭。烟丝在余下的昏暗中盘旋。有那么一瞬，你敢发誓，自己看见一张漆黑面孔在扭曲烟霭间退向帐门，渐渐消失。你有种感觉，%cultist%已经知道你的选择。于是，你留在帐内，等待达夫库尔降临。始终未能感知祂的存在，你便重新点起蜡烛，向空荡荡的帐篷说道。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔在等待我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%

15b7b482818e869c35ba.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{%joiner%, a wandering devotee of Davkul, has come to join the %companyname%. The company gathers around him, he nods, they nod back, and just like that he is with you. | %joiner%, a man in rags, yet armored in the shadows of Davkul, has joined the %companyname%. | A man by the name of %joiner% shows you his dedication to Davkul, a series of spiritual rites shaped about his skull as gruesome scars. He is welcomed into the %companyname%. | %joiner% stalked the company for a time before approaching you directly. He is an advocate for Davkul's purpose, and with that his argument has been made and yourself engendered to it all the same. The man joins the company. | Davkul surely watches over you as a man by the name of %joiner% joins the %companyname%. He stated that he had but one purpose and it was to find you and ensure that this world sees all that awaits it. | %joiner% says that he saw the shadows flicker behind your body as though they were 'of flame.' He states that he will join your cause for surely Davkul has embedded in you an aspect of the dark and infinite. | %joiner% walks beside you. He calls you an aspect of Davkul's darkness, and that eternal eyes surely watch over your party whole. The %companyname% takes him beneath its many shadowed wings. | %joiner% finds the %companyname% on the march and joins its ranks as though he were no stranger at all. No one says a word and you simply direct him to the inventory where his purpose may gather teeth. | With a showing of his scarred head, %joiner% states he is at the speartip of Davkul's purpose. You nod and welcome him into the %companyname%. | Walking in the shadow of Davkul, you were bound to find men such as %joiner%. He is keen on joining the company, in particular because you are in command of it, and more particularly because he believes Davkul has chosen you. | %joiner% bands with the company and there is little argument as to why. When asked where he came from, he shrugs and speaks of Davkul while nodding knowingly in your direction.}
15b7b482818e869c35ba.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{四处游历的达夫库尔信徒%joiner%，前来加入%companyname%。弟兄们围拢过来，他点头，众人也点头，就这样，他成为了你们的一员。 | %joiner%衣衫褴褛，却以达夫库尔的阴影为甲，如今加入了%companyname%。 | 一个名叫%joiner%的人，向你展示他对达夫库尔的虔诚：一次次灵性仪式，在他头颅周围留下狰狞伤疤。%companyname%欢迎他的加入。 | %joiner%跟踪战团一段时日，才直接走到你面前。他拥护达夫库尔的旨意，这便足以说明来意，你也同样认同。此人加入了战团。 | 达夫库尔必定正注视着你，因为一个名叫%joiner%的人加入了%companyname%。他说自己只有一个目标：找到你，确保这个世界看见那等待着它的一切。 | %joiner%说，他看见你身后的阴影闪烁，仿佛“由火焰构成”。他愿加入你的事业，因为达夫库尔显然已在你体内，植入了黑暗与无尽的一种化身。 | %joiner%走在你身旁，称你为达夫库尔黑暗的化身，说永恒的双眼必定注视着整支队伍。%companyname%以重重暗翼将他接纳。 | %joiner%在行军途中找到%companyname%，走进队列，仿佛从来就不是外人。无人开口，你只让他去库存领装备，好让他的使命长出利齿。 | %joiner%亮出伤痕累累的头颅，宣称自己正是达夫库尔旨意的矛尖。你点头，欢迎他加入%companyname%。 | 行走于达夫库尔的阴影下，你注定会遇见%joiner%这样的人。他热切希望加入战团，尤其因为由你指挥，更因为他相信，是达夫库尔选中了你。 | %joiner%加入战团，没人觉得有必要争论理由。问起他从何处来，他只是耸肩，谈起达夫库尔，又意味深长地朝你点头。}

0677f04bade61f1ef6df.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{%randomcultist%, one your followers, enters your tent and then just as soon leaves. You stand to see where he's gone, but come to find a leather half-helm sitting atop your table. The leather is stitched with hairs of unknown origin and pinched together by what look like hooks and fingernails. The holes of the helm are a pitch black, and you get the sense that even if you filled them the darkness would never depart. It is then, staring into those emptied sockets, that you know something is staring back. You nod approvingly.}
0677f04bade61f1ef6df.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{你的追随者%randomcultist%进了帐篷，转眼又离开。你起身想看他去了哪儿，却发现桌上多了一顶皮制半盔。皮革用来历不明的毛发缝合，又被类似钩子和指甲的东西扣在一起。盔上的孔洞漆黑一片，仿佛即使填满它们，那黑暗也不会离去。凝视着空荡荡的眼窝，你终于明白：里面也有东西在看着你。你赞许地点了点头。}

31e4ed6869926e9f0375.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]{Most would consider the dream to have been a nightmare: the darkness surrounded you, a black so flat you could reach out and touch it. The voice spoke a language you'd never heard before, and yet you understood it nonetheless. Two faces emerged for the infinite shade: %sac1% and %sac2%. The men seemed so close, yet when you reached out they shrank, as though your fingers stretched infinitely into the void.

 Upon waking, you knew what must be done. But a trust had been put in you here, a trust by Davkul. A trust to do what few men can: make a choice. | Davkul's presence arrived during a campfire. The rest of the men faded into the aether of infinite black, and a strange entity replaced them. An entity which you could not see, but whose presence was but a penumbra of crossing shadows. It requested a sacrifice, not by speaking to you, but by showing: %sac1% and %sac2%. First one melted away before revivifying, then the other repeated the process until both existed with their hands out and eyes closed. It was clear that Davkul was trusting you with a choice. 

 When the shadows snapped away, the campfire was blinding. %sac1% and %sac2% were staring at you.%SPEECH_ON%Is all alright, sir?%SPEECH_OFF% | You traveled to the place. You knew you were sleeping, but you knew damn well you traveled there nonetheless, shifting beyond your mind, beyond your body, coursing over the earth, over its rivers, across its dry earth, and past the mountains which would crumble. There you found Davkul, the immutable darkness, the inviting shade.

 %sac1% and %sac2% were already there, standing closest to you and Davkul's shape shifted restlessly behind their images. A black hand of fog pushed one man forward and then yanked him back, then repeated it with the other man. You nodded in understanding. A sacrifice was required and you were to choose.}
31e4ed6869926e9f0375.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]{多数人会将这个梦称为噩梦：黑暗包围着你，黑得如此平整，仿佛伸手就能触到。声音说着你从未听过的语言，你却仍然听懂了。两张脸从无尽阴影中浮现，是%sac1%和%sac2%。两人仿佛近在咫尺，可你一伸手，他们便缩小了，似乎你的手指正在虚空中无限延伸。

醒来时，你已明白该做什么。不过，达夫库尔在此将一份信任交给了你：相信你能做到少有人能做到的事——作出选择。 | 篝火边，达夫库尔降临了。其余弟兄消隐于无尽黑暗中，一个奇异的存在取代了他们。你看不见它，只能从交错阴影形成的半暗轮廓，感知它的存在。它要求献祭，却并非开口，而是向你展示：%sac1%和%sac2%。一人先融化消失，又重新活现，另一人随后重复同样的过程。最终，两人都站在那里，伸出双手，闭着眼睛。显然，达夫库尔信任你，让你来选。 

阴影骤然散去，篝火刺眼得令人难以直视。%sac1%和%sac2%正望着你。%SPEECH_ON%长官，没事吧？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你去了那个地方。你知道自己正在睡觉，却也无比确信，自己确实到了那里。你越出心智，越出肉身，掠过大地、河流、干涸土壤，越过终将崩塌的群山。在那里，你找到了达夫库尔：亘古不变的黑暗，向你敞开的阴影。

%sac1%和%sac2%早已在场，就站在离你最近的地方，达夫库尔的形体在他们身后不断变幻。一只黑雾之手将其中一人推上前，又猛然拉回，接着对另一人重复此举。你点头，明白了。需要一名祭品，而选择由你作出。}

5658fb6e539934216597.source: %sac1% will have the honor to meet Davkul.

57abf086128562bd5ba5.source: %sac2% will have the honor to meet Davkul.

7bec380aa9bca8e87e5f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]{%sacrifice% is bound and put to the fire. The smell of burnt pork fills the air and the men around you rejoice with tears in their eyes. You see a face twisting in the smoke of the sacrifice, a knowing visage that approves. The men are emboldened. | %sacrifice% is chopped to pieces until he is but a torso and head. The blood has emptied across the ground and yet there's still light in his eyes and a perverse smile upon his face. You take an axehead and run it into his throat until he is no more. Every bodypart is separated and put upon a pole, caked in grease, and lit aflame. You and the men dance beneath the pyres as the night comes and the night goes. | The procession is such: %sacrifice% is flayed alive and pierced with sharpened sticks through each limb and held aloft, spread-eagled over a fire which cooks him until death. The men watch his passing in silence, but as soon as one of his charred limbs breaks and collapses his corpse into the flames the men cheer and hoot and holler, some pray, others roll around in the ashes of %sacrifice%, some licking it off their fingertips like it were sweets. It is a good night. | A long stick is pierced through %sacrifice% from posterior to out the side of his neck. He is tilted up into the sky and held there by one man while others use long spears to stab him through until his corpse is the apex of an uncovered tent. The conical corpse is then covered with grass and mud until there stands a tipi, a torso and head of %sacrifice% all that remains above, and should you enter the tent you would find his legs dangling from its ceiling. The monument should stand as an omen for those to come, and a sign that they should come to accept that which awaits us all.}
7bec380aa9bca8e87e5f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]{%sacrifice%被捆起来，送上火堆。烧焦猪肉般的气味弥漫开来，身旁的弟兄们热泪盈眶，欢欣不已。献祭的烟雾中，一张脸扭曲浮现，那神情洞悉一切，满是赞许。众人的信念愈发坚定。 | %sacrifice%被砍去四肢，只剩躯干与头颅。鲜血流遍地面，他眼中却仍有光，脸上还挂着反常的笑。你拿起斧头，劈入他的喉咙，直到他彻底死去。身体各部分被一一分开，插在杆上，厚涂油脂，点火燃烧。你和弟兄们在火堆下舞蹈，直到长夜来临，又悄然离去。 | 仪式如下：%sacrifice%被活活剥皮，削尖的木棍刺穿四肢，将他四肢张开，高架于火上，烤至死去。弟兄们沉默地看着他断气，直到一条焦黑的肢体折断，尸体坠入火中，众人才欢呼、叫喊、吼叫。有人祈祷，有人在%sacrifice%的骨灰里打滚，还有人舔着指尖的灰，仿佛那是甜食。这是个美好的夜晚。 | 一根长棍从%sacrifice%的臀部刺入，自颈侧穿出。一人将他向上支起，悬在空中，其他人则用长矛接连刺穿，直到尸体成了无篷帐架的顶端。众人再用草与泥覆盖这副锥形架子，搭成一座尖顶帐篷，只有%sacrifice%的躯干和头颅露在上方。若走进去，还能见到双腿从帐顶垂下。这座纪念物将成为后来者的预兆，提醒他们接受那等待着我们所有人的存在。}

c9baa2621994736407c8.translation: 愿所有人都牢记这一刻。

bbeb5ad59ff096793d78.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]While enjoying a slice of bacon, you hear a quarrel taking shape. You ignore it for a time, but the shouts only get louder, quickly rising over your ability to enjoy a good meal. Angered, you stand up and head toward the disturbance. You find %cultist% and %oldgods% facing off, the cultist and follower of the old gods having apparently discovered some differences to which the latter no doubt cannot even begin to truly understand.
bbeb5ad59ff096793d78.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你正享用一片熏肉，忽然听见争吵声。起初你没理会，可叫喊越来越响，终于吵得这顿好饭都吃不下去了。你怒气冲冲地起身，循声而去，发现%cultist%与%oldgods%正针锋相对。看来，这位教徒和那位旧神信徒在信仰上有了些分歧，而后者显然连这些分歧的真正含义都无从理解。

976b96b74656094b2b82.source: Davkul awaits, we need not go to him.
976b96b74656094b2b82.translation: 达夫库尔正在等候，我们不必急着去见他。

36294a08856935e691f7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]You step off to the side, letting the men hash out their differences as men with great differences do. Fists for arguments, the follower of the old gods makes his case, battering the cultist again and again. But the man with the scarred head only grins in return. His eyes are puffing up, the lids purpled and puckering over his eyesight. Yet, still, he grins, and there is bloody laughter spewing out of his reddened mouth.%SPEECH_ON%Such darkness! Davkul is most pleased!%SPEECH_OFF%With an axious look, %oldgods% steps off %cultist% and backs away. He's rubbing his bloodied knuckles, realizing he may have broken a few in the seemingly one-sided scuffle. But it's the cultist's words that hurt him most of all.%SPEECH_ON%Man isn't tempted by the darkness, he is called to it! Lost without it! Gleeful in its return!%SPEECH_OFF%Almost afraid to look back, %oldgods% hurries away as the cultist remains behind, laughing and chuckling on the grass. You go over and pick him up, clapping a hand on his shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits us all, brother. You did well.%SPEECH_OFF%
36294a08856935e691f7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你退到一旁，让两人按分歧极大的人惯用的方式解决分歧。旧神信徒以拳头讲道理，一下接一下地痛打教徒。可那个满头伤疤的人只报以笑容。他的眼睛渐渐肿起，青紫的眼皮挤得几乎遮住视线，却仍咧嘴笑着，从染红的嘴里喷出带血的笑声。%SPEECH_ON%多么深沉的黑暗！达夫库尔十分欢喜！%SPEECH_OFF%%oldgods%神色不安，从%cultist%身上下来，往后退去。他揉着沾血的指关节，意识到这场看似一边倒的殴打，可能打断了自己几根手指。可最令他难受的，还是教徒的话。%SPEECH_ON%人并非受黑暗诱惑，而是听见它的召唤！失去它便迷失！待它归来便欢欣！%SPEECH_OFF%%oldgods%几乎不敢回头，匆忙离去。教徒仍留在草地上，时而大笑，时而低笑。你走过去扶起他，拍了拍他的肩。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔等待着我们所有人，弟兄。你做得很好。%SPEECH_OFF%

3b4bc8f7b89f9dd9b92a.source: May the darkness be ever infinite.

884e43ed19e8a99e695f.translation: 他终将迎接我们所有人。

3ba9f75dfc42a5777f1a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]A few brothers come to you looking rather worried. They say %cultist% has been sitting with %uneducated% for a few hours now. When you ask what's the worry, they remind you that the cultist has a scarred forehead and speaks of incredibly strange things. Yeah. Those are the demands of Davkul, an example of one's committment. You do not understand what could possibly be wrong with that.

 You go and see the two men. %uneducated% looks up at you, smiling, and says the cultist actually has a lot to teach him. Perhaps he does, but you know Davkul's presence need not be felt in all, and if it desired being forced upon the world it would be a misapprehension of Davkul's purpose.
3ba9f75dfc42a5777f1a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]几个弟兄忧心忡忡地来找你，说%cultist%已经和%uneducated%坐在一起聊了好几个钟头。你问他们有什么可担心的，他们提醒你：那个教徒额头上全是伤疤，嘴里说的也尽是怪事。是啊，那都是达夫库尔的要求，是虔诚的明证。你实在想不出，这能有什么不妥。

 你走过去看看两人。%uneducated%抬起头，笑着说，这位教徒还真有不少东西可以教他。或许如此，但你知道，并非人人都必须感知达夫库尔的存在。若执意将信仰强加于世人，反倒是误解了达夫库尔的旨意。

339e000ac0739eb98228.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You nod and turn away. By next morning, %uneducated% is found with a fresh wound on his forehead, the blood of conversion and the price some must pay to devote themselves to Davkul. When you ask how he is doing, he only says a few words.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul is coming.%SPEECH_OFF%Shaking your head, you correct him.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul is not coming. Davkul AWAITS us all.%SPEECH_OFF%
339e000ac0739eb98228.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你点点头，转身离开。第二天清早，%uneducated%额头上多了一道新伤口——那是皈依的血印，也是一些人献身达夫库尔必须付出的代价。你问他怎么样，他只说了几个字。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔即将降临。%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头纠正他。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔并非即将降临。达夫库尔在等待我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%

1b8529bff07ccdec18af.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You separate the two men, telling %uneducated% to go count some inventory. When he leaves, %cultist% sneers at you.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits. You see him in your sleep. You see him in the nights. His darkness is coming. No light burns forever.%SPEECH_OFF%The man pauses and stares into your soul. And you stare back from somewhere not of your body. You can only see infinite blackness around you and a pip of light through which %cultist% is looking. Slowly, you float back toward the light and find yourself blinking and staring at the man. He bows.%SPEECH_ON%Apologies, captain, I did not know that Davkul had such plans.%SPEECH_OFF%Blinking again, you can only nod.
1b8529bff07ccdec18af.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你把两人分开，吩咐%uneducated%去清点物资。他走后，%cultist%冷笑着看向你。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔在等待。你在梦中见到祂，在黑夜中见到祂。祂的黑暗即将降临，没有光能永远燃烧。%SPEECH_OFF%他停下来，直视你的灵魂。而你也从身体之外的某个地方回望着他。四周唯有无穷无尽的黑暗，远处一粒微光中，%cultist%正注视着你。你慢慢飘向那点光，忽然发现自己正眨着眼，仍站在他面前。他向你躬身。%SPEECH_ON%请原谅，团长，我不知道达夫库尔另有这般安排。%SPEECH_OFF%你又眨了眨眼，只能点头。

72b3100bf74b26641d09.translation: 达夫库尔终将迎接我们所有人。

4bc56f6235248d77d615.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{A pair of men looking disheveled and weary emerge from some bushes beside the road. They hold their hands up as if they'd come to surrender themselves.%SPEECH_ON%Are ye the %companyname%? We'd heard you were a band of deserters. And I don't mean that as an insult. We're runners, too, but we got nowhere else to go. Everywhere we turn there are bounty hunters and executioners. Let us fight for you. It ain't the fight that ever scared us, we swears by that.%SPEECH_OFF%}
4bc56f6235248d77d615.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{两个衣衫凌乱、满脸疲惫的男人从路旁灌木里钻出来，举着双手，像是来投降的。%SPEECH_ON%你们就是%companyname%？听说你们是逃兵组的团。别误会，我们没骂人的意思。我们也是逃出来的，可已经无处可去。走到哪儿都是赏金猎人和刽子手。让我们替你打仗吧。我们发誓，从来就不是因为怕打仗才逃的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

dee06f104fb28402a6ac.source: We could use fighting men like you.
dee06f104fb28402a6ac.translation: 我们正需要你这样的好手。

940317ccd3810c82587a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{It would be almost satisfyingly ironic to string these men up and hang them for what they'd done, but you are not about to set that tone for the company. You welcome them to the band, sending them forth to the inventory. %victim% keeps an eye on them for a time, but he reports that the men are true to their word and will fight.}
940317ccd3810c82587a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{为他们的逃兵行径把这两人绞死，倒是讽刺得令人痛快，不过你不打算给战团立下这种规矩。你欢迎他们入伙，派去领取装备。%victim%盯了他们一阵，回来报告说，这两人没有食言，确实肯出力作战。}

6a5fa4fac83593644661.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{It would be almost satisfyingly ironic to string these men up and hang them for what they'd done, but you are not about to set that tone for the company. You welcome them to the band, sending them forth to the inventory with %victim% keeping an eye on them. Except you don't see your sellsword for a suspicious length of time. When you go looking, he's found knocked out on the ground and the inventory ransacked. The two men are nowhere to be seen!}
6a5fa4fac83593644661.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{为他们的逃兵行径把这两人绞死，倒是讽刺得令人痛快，不过你不打算给战团立下这种规矩。你欢迎他们入伙，派去领取装备，并让%victim%盯着。可过了很久，你都没再见到这个弟兄，久得令人起疑。你去寻找，才发现他已被打晕在地，物资遭到洗劫，那两个男人早已无影无踪！}

bd8b4ff2c4f6a293ecd8.source: Running from bounty hunters and executioners for some time, %name% bumped into your company on the road and promptly volunteered.
bd8b4ff2c4f6a293ecd8.translation: 躲避赏金猎人与刽子手一段时日后，%name%在路上遇见了你的战团，立刻自愿加入。

1fc11af3b480fa9b87ac.source: %name% deserted an army regiment together with

d749e53f7139cfafb985.source: before he volunteered to join your company.
d749e53f7139cfafb985.translation: 一同逃离军伍，后来主动加入了你的战团。

7bdf03fed76fa1e82ffb.source:
%terrainImage%{While on the march, you find a drunken nobleman tottering side to side on the path. Mussy is the name of his hair, leaves and grass and what looks like birdshit swept up in it like someone stirred the ingredients to a prank. But his clothes sweep about with the finest of silks and his fingers glisten with jewelry. He has a bottle in each hand and he swings them around as he sings gibberish pub songs.

He is in all regards the greatest magnet for a mugging you've ever seen. %randombrother% purses his lips and he looks like a wolf staring at a fat sheep.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not saying nothing, sir, I'm just. I'm just seeing it. That's a lot of juice. A lot of juice limping down the road. But again I ain't saying nothing.%SPEECH_OFF%You know what he's talking about.}
7bdf03fed76fa1e82ffb.translation:
%terrainImage%{行军途中，你发现一个醉醺醺的贵族在路上东倒西歪地晃荡。他的头发乱得不成样子，里面夹着树叶、草屑，还有疑似鸟粪的东西，活像有人把捉弄人的材料全拌在了他头上。可他身上飘动的却是上好的丝绸，手指上的珠宝也闪闪发亮。他两只手各拎一瓶酒，胡乱挥舞，嘴里唱着含混不清的酒馆小调。

你从没见过如此招人抢的家伙。%randombrother%抿着嘴，目光活像一头盯上肥羊的狼。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我可什么都没说。我就是，就是看见了。好多油水啊。好多油水正一瘸一拐地走在路上。不过我还是那句话，我什么都没说。%SPEECH_OFF%你当然明白他的意思。}

07798f788321babf9a50.source: %terrainImage%{You walk up to the man and help him sit down. He grins as one of his bottles clanks off the path and rolls away.%SPEECH_ON%Thankiicup, sir, jast, no, well, ya.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you hold his hand out and spit on his fingers, then roll the jewelry off and pocket them. He merely watches as though you were a physician treating a malady. The rest of your mercenaries strip him down and throw a goatskin tarp over him and then leave him there. As you walk away he asks if you know about the drink.%SPEECH_ON%Not, not sayin' away the secret, but, sirs, drinks are good.%SPEECH_OFF%Yes, are they ever. Unfortunately, as you rejoin the company %randombrother% reports that a kid saw everything and scampered off. You ask why he didn't chase after him. He looks at you shrewdly.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not the scampering sort, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%}
07798f788321babf9a50.translation: %terrainImage%{你走到那人面前，扶他坐下。一只酒瓶撞在路上，咣当滚远，他却还咧着嘴笑。%SPEECH_ON%谢、嗝，谢谢，先生，就、不是，嗯，是啊。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，拉出他的手，往指头上啐点唾沫，把戒指一枚枚撸下来，揣进口袋。他只是看着，仿佛你是个替他治病的医师。其他弟兄把他扒得精光，扔来一张山羊皮篷布盖住，就这样把他留在路边。你走开时，他问你懂不懂喝酒。%SPEECH_ON%这、这可不算泄密啊，诸位，酒是真好。%SPEECH_OFF%是啊，真是好东西。可惜，刚归队，%randombrother%便报告，有个孩子目睹了全程，已经撒腿跑了。你问他为什么不追。他精明地看着你。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我可不是会到处撒腿乱跑的人。%SPEECH_OFF%}

519832cd6c52a947d569.source: %terrainImage%{You walk up to the man and, startled, he reels back with a hiccup.%SPEECH_ON%Oy, who are ye?%SPEECH_OFF%Telling him you're a good friend, you approach to rob him of everything, but as you take another step his eyes clear and he drops both bottles and suddenly reaches into his coat and pulls out a crossbow.%SPEECH_ON%Not another step you lout. I got men yonder who are watching. I don't want no trouble. We ain't keen on getting squirrely with sellswords. We're here to rob travelers, no good travelers at that, choosing to rob a drunk! Now why dontcha just get on down the road and we all leave without impasse upon our purposes.%SPEECH_OFF%The crossbow crickets as its wood shakes in his loose grip.}
519832cd6c52a947d569.translation: %terrainImage%{你走到那人面前，他吓得打了个嗝，向后一晃。%SPEECH_ON%喂，你、你谁啊？%SPEECH_OFF%你自称是他的好朋友，准备凑上去把他洗劫一空。可你刚迈出一步，他的眼神便清醒了。他丢下两个酒瓶，猛地从外套里掏出一把弩。%SPEECH_ON%站住，你这浑蛋。我的弟兄就在那边盯着。我不想惹事，也不想跟佣兵纠缠。咱们在这儿是为了打劫过路人，专挑坏东西下手，比如连醉鬼都要抢的！所以你们何不继续赶路，大家各干各的，互不耽搁？%SPEECH_OFF%他握弩的手松松垮垮，弩身随之颤抖，发出吱吱声。}

a9d91bd970a6ea770253.source: %terrainImage%{You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Quite alright. I'm assuming all that you got is counterfeit, aye?%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course. The finest fitting counterfeit this side of %townname% this is! But enough chin wagging shenanigans. Appreciate ya keeping this square, but we got work to do.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding again, you wish him luck in them doings.}
a9d91bd970a6ea770253.translation: %terrainImage%{你点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%没问题。我猜，你身上那些东西全是赝品，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他也点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然。这可是%townname%这一带最合身的一套假货！好了，闲话就到这儿。多谢你肯好聚好散，可我们还得干活。%SPEECH_OFF%你再次点头，祝他干得顺利。}

9630ad6ed27dd8a88308.source: %terrainImage%{You look back at the company, then unsheathe your sword as you turn around. You swing it up and clip the crossbow and the man shoots it just over your shoulder. You drive the blade down the slat of wood and cut the cords of the weapon and stab the steel into the man's chest. He goes down easy and you hear men shout in the distance, but they're scared and scampering away. Thieves like this know not to fight with sellswords. You collect whatever goods the man had already stolen up to this point.}
9630ad6ed27dd8a88308.translation: %terrainImage%{你回头看了战团一眼，转身的同时拔剑出鞘，向上一挑，击中弩身。那人射出的弩矢擦着你的肩头飞过。你顺着木弩身劈下，切断弩弦，再将剑锋送进他的胸口。他轻易便倒了下去。远处有人叫喊，却只是在惊慌逃散；这种贼知道不能和佣兵硬拼。你收走了那人此前偷来的所有财物。}

3ab980ac16bbd0fd6927.source: %terrainImage%{You look back at the company, then unsheathe your sword as you turn around. You swing it up and clip the crossbow and the man shoots it just over your shoulder. You drive the blade down the slat of wood and cut the cords of the weapon and stab the steel into the man's chest. He goes down easy and you hear men shout in the distance, but they're scared and scampering away. Thieves like this know not to fight with sellswords. Unfortunately, the crossbow bolt that went over your shoulder struck %hurtbro%. He'll survive, but it is a garish wound.}
3ab980ac16bbd0fd6927.translation: %terrainImage%{你回头看了战团一眼，转身的同时拔剑出鞘，向上一挑，击中弩身。那人射出的弩矢擦着你的肩头飞过。你顺着木弩身劈下，切断弩弦，再将剑锋送进他的胸口。他轻易便倒了下去。远处有人叫喊，却只是在惊慌逃散；这种贼知道不能和佣兵硬拼。可惜刚才那支弩矢击中了%hurtbro%。他能活下来，不过伤口着实难看。}

7123bb47c60f59875f03.source: %terrainImage%{As you near the nobleman, his eyes go wide and he points at %servant% the servant.%SPEECH_ON%Jast wait a sssec, I know youuu.%SPEECH_OFF%You look back. He does? The nobleman stumbles forward with his legs scissoring side to side.%SPEECH_ON%You were servant to my cousin in %randomtown% one fine evening. You were great! The greatest. Greeaaatest. S-servant. Hargh. Well -hic- I dare say you can have all this shite cause I don't think -hic- we explained yee, sorry, paid ya.%SPEECH_OFF%The man takes anything of value and throws it over. He seems happy just to be relieved of the weight of it all.%SPEECH_ON%If ye see my c-cousin again, let, let him know that I killed his brother, with the, the, mantlepiece. No harsh -hic- feelings.%SPEECH_OFF%Well alright then.}
7123bb47c60f59875f03.translation: %terrainImage%{你走近那贵族，他突然瞪大眼睛，指着仆人%servant%。%SPEECH_ON%等、等一下，我认得你——%SPEECH_OFF%你回头看看。还真认识？贵族两条腿交错打晃，踉跄着走上前。%SPEECH_ON%有天晚上，在%randomtown%，你伺候过我那表亲。你真棒！最棒的。最——棒的仆、仆人。嗝。嗯，我看这些破玩意儿都归你了，因、因为我想咱们还没招待过你，不对，是没付过钱。%SPEECH_OFF%他把身上值钱的东西一件件扔过来，卸掉这些累赘，似乎让他高兴极了。%SPEECH_ON%下回见到我那表、表亲，替我告诉他，是我杀了他兄弟，用、用的是壁炉架。叫他别往心里去，嗝。%SPEECH_OFF%那好吧。}

604de326485dc860ae50.source: Good job doing that thing awhile back.
604de326485dc860ae50.translation: 先前那桩活，你干得不错。

0c86fc5c03113026b967.source: %terrainImage%{As you approach the drunkard, a sharp whistle cracks across the path. You and the drunkard both look to see %thief% the thief standing there with a weapon to the back of another man.%SPEECH_ON%That feller's no nobleman, and probably aint no drunk neither. They're working together to either ambush travelers or threaten them with blackmail. They're robbers, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You look back to see the man smiling nervously. He explains with suddenly sharpened clarity.%SPEECH_ON%We'd no interest in robbing sellswords, sir, I-I-I swear I was about to explain myself soon as I sawr yer swords.%SPEECH_OFF%%thief% yells out, asking where the cache is. You look back at the man and tell him to hand over everything he's stolen. He nods and asks if you'll gut him if he refuses. You nod and tell him the gutting will come last, and by that point it'll be a relief. The man puts a little pep in his step.%SPEECH_ON%Yessir gotcha sir, right this way.%SPEECH_OFF%}
0c86fc5c03113026b967.translation: %terrainImage%{你刚靠近醉汉，一声尖锐口哨便划过道路。你与醉汉一同望去，只见小偷%thief%站在那里，武器抵着另一个男人的后背。%SPEECH_ON%那家伙不是什么贵族，多半也没喝醉。他们合伙埋伏过路人，或者设局敲诈。长官，他们是劫匪。%SPEECH_OFF%你回头，看到那人紧张地笑着。他忽然口齿清楚地解释起来。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我们绝没想抢佣兵。我、我、我发誓，一看见你们的剑，就打算坦白了。%SPEECH_OFF%%thief%高声喝问，赃物藏在哪儿。你望着那人，叫他把偷来的东西全交出来。他点点头，又问，要是不交，你是不是会给他开膛？你点头，说开膛会留到最后，到了那时，反倒算是解脱。那人的脚步立刻轻快起来。%SPEECH_ON%是，长官，明白，长官，这边请。%SPEECH_OFF%}

20314122973829cf101b.source: Ol' thief sniffed that right out.
20314122973829cf101b.translation: 老贼一眼就看出门道了。

aff83ead1a53c120ae98.translation: 也许%thief%能替他减轻点负担。

9fae137cbf868555e325.source: Rumored to have robbed a family member on the road
9fae137cbf868555e325.translation: 据传在路上抢劫了他们的家族成员

6c3b7a76427f081b8633.source: Finally got paid for a job while back
6c3b7a76427f081b8633.translation: 终于拿到先前那桩活的报酬

d7c0afdd030f257c74da.source: %terrainImage%{You come across a man holding the reins of a lanky horse whose mangy mane has seen better days. The horse has a grey beard forming and its got dry caliche lips smacking desperately for water. Seeing you, its owner waves.%SPEECH_ON%Come, come! I've a bet to make for those brave and fast enough to think they'll win it!%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask what the bet is. The man pats the horse, a plume of dust lifting on the pat and you can see his handprint on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Race m'horse! Not with another horse, mind, but your humanly legs! If you lose, you give me %reward% crowns. If you win, I'll pay you triple. You up for it?%SPEECH_OFF%}
d7c0afdd030f257c74da.translation: %terrainImage%{你遇到一个牵着瘦高老马的人。马鬃稀疏斑秃，下巴已经泛白，干得结壳的嘴唇不停翕动，显然渴坏了。马主人看见你，招起手来。%SPEECH_ON%来呀，来呀！谁有胆量，又觉得自己跑得够快，就来跟我赌一把！%SPEECH_OFF%你好奇地问他赌什么。他拍了拍马，一蓬灰尘扬起，马肩上留下一个清晰的手印。%SPEECH_ON%跟我的马赛跑！可不许骑另一匹马，得用你自个儿那两条腿！输了给我%reward%克朗，赢了我赔你三倍。敢不敢？%SPEECH_OFF%}

d1e5584315b94c687ca1.source: Very well. Someone step forward and race that horse!
d1e5584315b94c687ca1.translation: 好，来个人跟那匹马赛一场！

4db2dcb1dbebc54706f4.source: %terrainImage%{You nominate %randombrother% to try and see if he can best the beast. The race's rules are first to the apple tree and before you can even begin to root for the sellsword the horse smokes him completely. It gets to the finish line and begins fishing the branches for apples. The company is sitting completely silent, but when %randombrother% crosses the finish line in a distant last place they roar with delight as though he just won the keys to the kingdom's finest whorehouse. The horse's owner laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Don't be hard on yerself, kind sir. The fun is in the chance.%SPEECH_OFF%Indeed it seems the spectacle of the man's efforts entertained the company.}
4db2dcb1dbebc54706f4.translation: %terrainImage%{你挑了%randombrother%，让他试试能不能跑赢那匹马。规矩很简单，谁先到苹果树下谁就赢。可你还没来得及给弟兄加油，老马就已经把他甩得老远。它冲过终点，径自伸嘴去够枝上的苹果。战团上下鸦雀无声，直到%randombrother%远远落在后面跑过终点，众人才轰然欢呼，仿佛他刚赢下了王国里最好的妓院。马主人笑道。%SPEECH_ON%好先生，别太难过。图的就是赌这一把的乐子嘛。%SPEECH_OFF%的确，他拼命奔跑的样子，倒让弟兄们看得很开心。}

4ecc0ac57ea540ba3ad0.source: %terrainImage%{%athlete% steps forward. His calves bulge from his socks and he shoulder rolls to loosen up.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah I'll race that sorry horse.%SPEECH_OFF%The wager is made and the horse's owner directs you to a path. With the race set up, he holds up a pair of wooden tongs held apart, and backwards, by some tine. When he cuts the rope, the tongs snap clap together and start the race. Despite being looking like a wart left in the rain, the horse instantly gets a step on the nimble sellsword. It's only halfway down the track does the mercenary's stamina seem to put him back in the race, but he ultimately fails at the finish line. The owner claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, that was a close one! The closest I've seen!%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and pay the man what he is owed. %athlete% was beaten, but despite that it seems the loss has bettered him in some regard and the company certainly enjoyed the spectacle.}
4ecc0ac57ea540ba3ad0.translation: %terrainImage%{%athlete%走上前，小腿肌肉将袜子绷得鼓起，转动双肩活动筋骨。%SPEECH_ON%行，我来跟这匹破马跑一场。%SPEECH_OFF%赌约定下，马主人领你们到一条小路。准备妥当后，他举起一副木夹，夹口被一根尖齿反向撑开。绳子一割断，木夹啪地合拢，比赛便开始了。那匹马虽丑得像个被雨泡烂的疣，起跑却立刻抢在身手矫健的佣兵前面。直到赛程过半，佣兵才凭着耐力逐渐追上，可冲过终点时，还是差了一步。马主人拍起手来。%SPEECH_ON%哎呀，就差一点！这是我见过最接近的一回！%SPEECH_OFF%你点头付清赌注。%athlete%虽败了，这番较量似乎仍让他有所长进，战团上下也着实看了场好戏。}

66b2b9be08e5f78ff3a4.source:
%terrainImage%{Feeling rather courageous, you nominate the fattest man in the company to handle the race. %fat% steps forward with an eyebrow raised, asking if you're sure about taking him as your horseracing champion. You hold your hand on his shoulder and say he's the fattest fark you've ever seen being a sellsword, but that you believe in him. You also believe the horse is a haggard draught animal that's on its last legs, but you keep that part to yourself.

 The man and horse are put next to each other. An apple tree stands in the distance and the first to it is the winner. With the rules laid out, the race is started. It's not an especially close one. %fat% falls behind almost instantly and trundles down the track with his face beet red and huffing breath and the men nearly die laughing at the sight. The fat sellsword and dire horse meet back up at the apple tree and there share the fruits of their labors. You pay the horse's owner what he is owed. He smiles as he counts the coin.%SPEECH_ON%Don't usually get a show with the race, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%}
66b2b9be08e5f78ff3a4.translation:
%terrainImage%{你忽然胆气十足，决定派全团最胖的人去赛跑。%fat%走上前，扬着眉毛问，你当真要选他当赛马健将？你把手搭在他肩上，说他是你见过最胖的佣兵，不过你相信他。你也相信，对面那匹马只是个形容枯槁、快走到头的老畜力，只是后半句没说出口。

一人一马并排站好。远处有棵苹果树，谁先到谁赢。规矩说清，比赛开始，胜负却毫无悬念。%fat%几乎立刻落后，涨红着脸，呼哧呼哧地沿路奔跑，惹得弟兄们笑得快断气。最后，胖佣兵与那匹可怜老马在苹果树下碰头，一道分享劳动的果实。你向马主人付清赌注。他边数钱边笑。%SPEECH_ON%长官，平常赛马，可没这么好的戏看。%SPEECH_OFF%}

e1bc8db257489b1cafed.source: %terrainImage%{You elect %dumb%, the company's biggest idiot, to be your horse racing champion. The horse's owner takes one look at the man and raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%Well. Alright.%SPEECH_OFF%Rules of the race are clear: first to a distant apple tree is the winner. The man and animal line up on the track. Pretending that he knows what he's doing, %dumb% crouches in a tri-pointed stance. The horse owner yells and slaps his beast on the buttocks. %dumb% releases into a nice stride and shockingly gets ahead of the horse, but he's unable to handle his speed and tilts into the second lane and collides with the beast. The horse buckles at the knees and flips head over hind and %dumb% somehow ends up in the curve of its loins and on the flip around is catapulted through the air. It's a damned sight and one you'll surely never see again. The horse gets back to its feet and stares around confused while %dumb%'s unconscious body flies over the finish line. You turn your palms to the horse owner whose hands are gripping his head.%SPEECH_ON%By the old gods, man, are you not concerned for your sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF%}
e1bc8db257489b1cafed.translation: %terrainImage%{你选了战团里最傻的%dumb%，派他代表你参加赛马。马主人瞧了他一眼，挑起眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%唔。行吧。%SPEECH_OFF%比赛规则很简单：谁先到远处那棵苹果树，谁就赢。一人一马在跑道上就位。%dumb%装出一副很懂行的样子，蹲成三点着地的起跑姿势。马主人一声吆喝，拍了拍马屁股。%dumb%迈开大步冲出去，竟然抢到了马前头，却控制不住速度，身子一歪，冲进旁边的跑道，撞上了马。马的膝盖一软，整个向前翻去，%dumb%不知怎么卷进了马腹的弯处，又随着这一翻，被猛地弹上半空。这场面真是见鬼，恐怕一辈子也见不到第二次。马重新站起来，茫然地四下张望，而%dumb%已经昏迷的身体正飞过终点线。你朝马主人摊开手，他却双手抱着脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%旧神在上，伙计，你就不担心自己的佣兵吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

024ca6a4d8e4bdfba13e.source: Our most athletic man, %athlete%, will race that horse.
024ca6a4d8e4bdfba13e.translation: 派身手最矫健的%athlete%跟那匹马赛跑。

bd82d73fbb8bb7e2fbc5.source: Our fattest man, %fat%, will race for our enjoyment.
bd82d73fbb8bb7e2fbc5.translation: 派咱们最胖的%fat%去，给大家找个乐子。

5ad2582da3efa32c2a3b.source: I can think only of %dumb% to be dim enough to race a horse.

8588473e0549b8f4e8c7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%randombrother% hails you down and says that there's something you should come take a look at. Surely something that's out in all this ice and nothingness is worth seeing.

 The sellsword brings you to a cavernous hole in the ground. He lights a torch and steps into and you follow. There at the bottom you find a few more of your men. They're standing around what looks like a sarcophagus made of ice, except there's no lid. A frozen blackness cakes the edges of the container. In the corner of the room is an icy corpse stuck to the wall. His hands are at his sides and icicles of blood run from his wrists. Adjacent to it is a pair of clothes hanging from icehooks, but there is no body attached. A trail of blood leads from the clothes to the other man, then back out the cave.%SPEECH_ON%I don't know what to make of this sir.%SPEECH_OFF%One mercenary says. You ask the men if they've seen anything in their scouting, and you mean damn near anything. But they all shake their heads no. If something was in that box then it is surely out now. You tell the men to get on out of the cave and back to camp.
8588473e0549b8f4e8c7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%randombrother%叫住你，说有样东西该让你看看。在这片除了冰雪便一无所有的地方，能发现点什么，想必都值得一看。

 佣兵带你来到地面上一处洞穴般的大口子前，点亮火把，钻了进去，你跟在后面。到了底部，你发现还有几个弟兄在那里，正围着一口像是用冰做成的石棺，只是棺材没有盖子。容器边沿结着一层冻硬的黑色污物。洞室角落里，一具冻尸黏在墙上，双手垂在身侧，手腕上挂着凝成冰柱的鲜血。旁边的冰钩上挂着一身衣服，里面却没有人。一道血迹从衣服下方延伸到那具尸体旁，又通往洞外。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我实在看不明白。%SPEECH_OFF%一名佣兵说道。你问弟兄们侦察时有没有看见什么，任何东西都算。可他们全都摇头。如果那口箱子里曾装着什么，如今肯定已经出来了。你叫大家立刻离开洞穴，返回营地。

8373ed4a150b827e4d66.source: And keep your wits about you.

c84d269f20cf70673b5d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{A blotch in the snowy wastes catches your eye. With a couple of scouts you go out to see what it is, suspecting little more than perhaps an animal carcass or abandoned camp. Instead, you find a party of naked corpses with their bodies crouched as though they were sitting upon chairs. They're in a close-knit circle, all facing inward, some with their hands out as if warming them at a fire. You push one of the corpses. As it tips back, the body sitting opposite raises up. %randombrother% jumps away.%SPEECH_ON%By the old gods!%SPEECH_OFF%A rim of flesh runs just beneath the powdered snow, and the ring connects one corpse to the other, a shared desecration beyond your understanding. The skin runs inward, meeting at a fleshen fulcrum which rises out of the snow shaped like some macabre flower pot. Nothing is inside. One of the scouts demands a return to the safety of the company and you very much agree with him.}
c84d269f20cf70673b5d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{雪原上一块异色吸引了你的目光。你带着几个斥候前去查看，本以为无非是动物尸体，或一处弃营。走近才发现，那是一圈赤裸的死者，身体蜷曲，像坐在无形的椅子上。他们紧密围成一圈，全部朝里，有人还伸着手，仿佛在火边取暖。你推了一具尸体，它向后倾倒，对面的那具竟随之抬起。%randombrother%猛地跳开。%SPEECH_ON%旧神在上！%SPEECH_OFF%薄雪底下藏着一圈血肉，将尸体彼此连结，组成一种你无法理解的共同亵渎。皮肉又朝内延伸，汇聚在中央的支点，从雪里隆起，形似一只可怖的肉质花盆。里面空无一物。一个斥候强烈要求回战团寻求安全，你再赞同不过。}

b4433d2c905602f2a41d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{While camping in the northern wastes, a silhouette approaches, a flat black whose appearance was seemingly cut out of the thin air itself. As it nears, an orange glow blossoms from a horn of fire. The company draw their weapons for what shadowy figure could possibly be out here in all this nothing? What 'something' crosses such a wretched land? But you find it is just elderly man with a bald pate and bulbous, red nose. If the snow could carve man from granite, this would be the look of its creation. The stranger passes through the camp with the company turning to him and yelling out, but not one sellsword goes near him. He finally leans down and puts the horn to the ground and the snow extinguishes its fire. Then he gets up and keeps going and soon disappears into the fog of night.

  %randombrother% picks up the horn and tips it over. A rose falls out and its clear even in the dark that the petals are soft, but already curling to the brutal cold. You look around for the old man and see his tracks still fresh in the powder.}
b4433d2c905602f2a41d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]{你们在北方荒原扎营时，一道剪影走近，漆黑而平整，仿佛从空气中直接裁了出来。近些，一只燃着火的角杯透出橙光。弟兄们拔出武器：这片空无一物的地方，怎会有人影？究竟是什么“东西”穿过了这片险恶土地？可来者只是个秃顶老人，鼻头硕大通红。若风雪能从花岗岩里雕出一个人，大概就是这副模样。他穿过营地，众人纷纷转身呼喊，却没有一个佣兵上前。最后，他俯身把角杯放到地上，雪熄灭了火。他随即起身，继续走去，很快隐没在夜雾中。

  %randombrother%捡起角杯，往外一倒，一朵玫瑰落了出来。即使在黑暗里，也看得出花瓣柔软，却已被酷寒冻得卷曲。你四下寻找老人，只看见粉雪上仍新鲜的脚印。}

9459157c7bb4e514d065.source: All sorts of strange in these wastes.
9459157c7bb4e514d065.translation: 这片荒原真是什么怪事都有。

7a4560bfb08fe6698bae.source: %terrainImage%{The snowy wastes are home to not much of anything, so to find a man half-naked in its frigid geography is rather unusual. That he is actually alive even more so. You crouch beside him. His eyes are hollow and rime frosts make blinking them a struggle. His lips are jagged and purple. His nose a deep red bordering on black. You ask if he can speak. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Barbarians. Took. Me.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask where his kidnappers are. He shrugs and continues his cold cadence.%SPEECH_ON%They. Got. Bored. And. Left.%SPEECH_OFF%It does seem in tune with the primitives to up and leave a prisoner in the ice. He explains that he was once a sturdy swordfighter. A smile squeezes  through the pain.%SPEECH_ON%A. King's. Guard. In. The. Kingless. Land. Things. Could. Be. Worse?%SPEECH_OFF%}
7a4560bfb08fe6698bae.translation: %terrainImage%{冰雪荒原几乎容不下什么活物，因此，在严寒中发现一个半裸男人，已经够稀奇；他竟还活着，就更加不可思议。你蹲到他身旁。他眼窝深陷，结着霜，连眨眼都困难。嘴唇紫得发裂，鼻子深红，已近乎发黑。你问他还能不能说话。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%蛮族。抓了。我。%SPEECH_OFF%你问绑匪去了哪里。他耸耸肩，依旧被冻得一顿一顿。%SPEECH_ON%他们。腻了。就。走了。%SPEECH_OFF%把俘虏丢在冰天雪地里，确实像那群蛮子的作风。他解释，自己曾是个健壮的剑士，痛苦中勉强挤出一丝笑。%SPEECH_ON%一个。国王卫士。在。没有国王的。土地上。还能。更糟吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

81a8965615657802169c.source: We have a place for you, friend.
81a8965615657802169c.translation: 朋友，我们这里有你的位置。

47c00bfbb55f4fb8200e.source: You're on your own in this world.

24555192663f3592efaf.source: %terrainImage%{You pat the man on his head, but tell him it's already over. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Speak. For. Yourself. Mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%He smiles again, but this time it does release. It sticks. Literally. And he leans forward and his eyes are open and do not blink and in this state he is gone. You get the men back on the road, or what one can make of a road in these snowed stretches.}
24555192663f3592efaf.translation: %terrainImage%{你拍了拍他的头，告诉他已经没救了。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%管好。你。自己。佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%他又笑了，可这一次，笑容再也没有散去，就这样僵在脸上。他向前倾倒，双眼睁着，不再眨动，就此死去。你叫弟兄们继续上路——至少沿着这片雪原上勉强能称作路的地方走。}

d8c9549b91c16f766760.source: %terrainImage%{The nearly frozen man joins the company. He's a ragged wreck, but if what he said is true maybe he will someday become the fighter he could barely speak of.}
d8c9549b91c16f766760.translation: %terrainImage%{这个几乎冻僵的男人加入了战团。他如今衣衫褴褛，形容枯槁，可若所言属实，或许有一天还能恢复昔日的身手——尽管现在，他连这段往事都快无力诉说了。}

f84efc300adbdf201fb2.source: You found %name% frozen half to death in the north. He claims he was a King's Guard once, but looking at him now you see but a cripple.
f84efc300adbdf201fb2.translation: 你在北方发现了几乎冻死的%name%。他自称曾是国王卫士，可如今看上去只是个瘸弱的残疾人。

a42f3a6c453f943acf69.source: Got taken by barbarians and left to die in the cold
a42f3a6c453f943acf69.translation: 遭野蛮人掳走，又被丢在严寒中等死

8a69bf3cf90a4e740fa5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]{You find %guard% stretching about with surprising limberness. He looks nothing at all like the freezing, frigid man you found abandoned in the ice by those barbarians. Spotting you, he nods and comes over with a quiet voice.%SPEECH_ON%I'm glad you trusted in me, captain. Perhaps you did it out of the kindness of your heart, but I need to show you something.%SPEECH_OFF%He flashes an emblem you have heard referenced many times, but have never seen: it carries the sigil of the King's Guard and its pristineness is such that there is no way it could have been a farce. The man smiles at you.%SPEECH_ON%I think I am in good health and ready to serve you as I did my liege.%SPEECH_OFF%The kings of these lands have long since fallen, replaced by squabbling lords and nobles. If this man can fight for you as he did for the kings, then the %companyname% has brighter days ahead surely.}
8a69bf3cf90a4e740fa5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]{你发现%guard%正在舒展筋骨，动作灵活得出人意料，完全不像当初被蛮族遗弃在冰原上、冻得奄奄一息的那个人。看见你，他点头走近，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%团长，谢谢您愿意相信我。也许当时您只是心善，不过，有样东西我得让您看看。%SPEECH_OFF%他亮出一枚徽章，上面的国王卫士徽记，你听说过许多次，却从未亲眼见过。它做工精美、完好如新，绝不可能是假货。那人微笑着看向你。%SPEECH_ON%我想，我已经恢复了，可以像当年侍奉君王那样为您效力。%SPEECH_OFF%这片土地上的国王早已陨落，取而代之的是争斗不休的领主与贵族。若这人能像当初为国王作战时一样为你挥剑，%companyname%的前程必将更加光明。}

eb5432b8a4da633f5921.source: I'm glad we found you on that fateful day.

e5a9ed1d0284654e7f86.source: You found %name% frozen half to death in the north. With your help, the former King's Guard regained his strength and now fights for you.
e5a9ed1d0284654e7f86.translation: 你在北方发现了几乎冻死的%name%。在你的帮助下，这位昔日的国王卫士恢复了力量，如今为你而战。

97995fef6746a1571e34.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_144.png[/img]{You discover a cave in the ice with its maw shielded by a gate of thick icicles. Looking through the icy bars, you find the cave quickly declines down a steep slope and toward what may be an underground riverbank that has long since frozen. Something is huddled beside it hitting the ice with a pickaxe over and over again. The wind whistles as it grates against the teeth of the cave. You call out to the huddled man, but there is no response.

It will take some time to chop through this thick ice and get in there. Fortunately, one of the sellswords reports that there may be a rear entrance. It is blocked just as well, but a strong enough man just might be able to squeeze through and face any dangers within.}
97995fef6746a1571e34.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_144.png[/img]{你发现一座冰窟，洞口被粗大的冰柱封住，如同一道栅门。透过冰柱望去，洞内是一道陡坡，尽头似乎是早已封冻的地下河岸。那儿蜷着一个身影，正拿镐子一遍遍敲击冰面。寒风掠过洞口的冰牙，发出尖啸。你朝那人喊话，却没有回应。

要凿穿这么厚的冰进去，得花不少工夫。好在一个弟兄来报，说洞后似乎另有入口。那里同样堵着冰，不过足够强壮的人或许能挤进去，独自面对洞中的危险。}

f48c57b1bae8e141e1c2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_144.png[/img]{%chosen% heads off while you and the rest work on the front of the cave. You knock a few of the thick icicles out letting you see into the cave with better eyes. Just as you do, %chosen% comes tumbling down an adjacent slope and lands right in the middle of the cave and slides across the frozen river and rides up its embankment. He hops to his feet and dusts himself off with a childish grin.

 In a flash the huddled man slams the pickaxe into the ice with unhinted power and the shards splinter from one side of the embankment to the other. The clank of the metal and shattered ice reverberates as though lightning itself had struck. Now you can finally see the stranger: he is a barbarian shelled in broken armor that rattles as he moves. The icy walls mirror his steps, scattering his presence all around the cave in transient sheens. Jittery and jutting, his walk is seemingly going backwards despite his advance as though his shadow were his true self and his flesh the afterimage. Despite being in a cave, his loud voice echoes not at all.%SPEECH_ON%An interloper in my midst, a mere moment from the mist, these things I shall not miss.%SPEECH_OFF%He approaches the sellsword like a cold spider unfurling from its trapdoor. You see that his face is half-frozen, and a wry smile squeezes across the half that could still be called flesh.%SPEECH_ON%I long to leave this body, my dear fighter. Will you help guide me out and to something higher?%SPEECH_OFF%}
f48c57b1bae8e141e1c2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_144.png[/img]{%chosen%绕路去了，你与其余弟兄继续清理洞口。你敲掉几根粗大的冰柱，终于能更清楚地望进洞里。就在这时，%chosen%从旁边的斜坡翻滚下来，正落在洞穴中央，滑过冻河，又冲上河岸。他跳起身，拍掉身上的冰屑，咧嘴笑得像个孩子。

转瞬间，原本蜷缩的人以毫无预兆的巨力，将镐头砸进冰面。碎冰从河岸一端炸向另一端，金属与冰块的撞击声如雷击般回荡。这时，你终于看清陌生人的模样：一个蛮族人裹在破碎盔甲中，动一下便叮当作响。冰壁映照着他的脚步，在短暂闪过的光泽里，将他的身影散布到洞穴各处。他的步态突兀而抽搐，明明向前，却像正在后退，仿佛影子才是真身，血肉不过是残像。虽身处洞穴，他洪亮的声音却没有半点回响。%SPEECH_ON%有闯入者来到我身旁，距那迷雾不过片刻时光。这一切，没什么值得念想。%SPEECH_OFF%他走向佣兵，像冰冷的蜘蛛从活板洞门下舒展开来。你看见他的半张脸已被冻住，余下还算血肉的那一半，挤出一抹讥诮的笑。%SPEECH_ON%亲爱的战士，我渴望离开这具身体。你愿引我脱身，去往更高之地吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

d4d76b9306a1ca1081a0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_144.png[/img]{Through the icicles you can see the madman cutting down %chosen%. Even as he lies dead on the ground, the stranger continues to hack away at him, and each time a muffled thump echoes through the cave. What will you do now?}
d4d76b9306a1ca1081a0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_144.png[/img]{透过冰柱，你看见那个疯子砍倒了%chosen%。人已经死在地上，陌生人却还在不停劈砍，每一下闷响都在洞穴中回荡。现在该怎么办？}

6fa709f530dd009ad630.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_144.png[/img]{As you depart the cave, a local northerner covered in bear furs stands across the company. He looks at you and then the cave entrance. He asks.%SPEECH_ON%Do you speak the southern or native tongue?%SPEECH_OFF%Keeping your guard, you confirm the former. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%And what did you see in that cave? Did you see it?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him you found nothing, only a madman. The stranger smirks.%SPEECH_ON%A madman. A madman, that is what you think you saw. It is within us all to speak warily of the unnatural, but not within us to recognize when nature herself takes a step back. Horrors are easier said than seen. That was no ordinary man, you fool, but the Ijirok, a transient spirit that shifts from one vessel to another. No one really knows what it looks like, the whole world is simply a series of masks and it will happily go from one to the other, usually taking the shape of animals, sometimes a man if he is so weak. It is a being of absolute malice. It cannot be killed, no, it sees death, even its own, as entertainment. It remembers those who escape it, it remembers those it wishes to play with. I pray you've a face worth forgetting.%SPEECH_OFF%You put your hand on the pommel of your sword and tell him that whatever mysticism and mythmaking he's got left he can keep to himself. You saw the madman in the cave, and that's all he was, a man. The stranger nods again and backs off.%SPEECH_ON%As you wish, and may you travel well.%SPEECH_OFF%}
6fa709f530dd009ad630.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_144.png[/img]{离开洞穴时，一个披着熊皮的当地北方人站在战团面前。他看看你，又看看洞口，问道。%SPEECH_ON%你说南方话，还是本地话？%SPEECH_OFF%你保持警惕，回答说南方话。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%那你在洞里看见了什么？看见它了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，什么也没找到，只有一个疯子。陌生人露出一丝讥笑。%SPEECH_ON%疯子。一个疯子，你以为自己看见的是这个。人人都会小心翼翼地谈论异物，可当自然本身退让一步时，却未必认得出来。恐怖说起来容易，亲眼看见却是另一回事。蠢货，那可不是普通人，而是伊吉罗克，一个在不同躯壳间游移的精魂。没人真知道它是什么模样。整个世界不过是一张张面具，它乐于从这张换到那张。通常化作动物，偶尔也会附在足够虚弱的人身上。它是纯粹恶意的化身。杀不死它，不，它把死亡当消遣，连自己的死也一样。它记得逃脱的人，记得想要戏弄的人。我祈祷你有张不值得记住的脸。%SPEECH_OFF%你把手搭上剑柄，告诉他，剩下那些玄奥神话，留着自己听就好。你在洞里看见的是个疯子，他也仅此而已，一个人。陌生人又点点头，后退让开。%SPEECH_ON%随你怎么想。愿你一路平安。%SPEECH_OFF%}

357b5bde180ef171e959.source: I need you to scout ahead,

ae3be5b41fff230a0c5c.source: I need you to go in there,

aa1e6afb6d3342b47458.source: This isn't worth it. We should leave this place.
aa1e6afb6d3342b47458.translation: 不值得。我们该离开这里。

8a0f9cec5fea7996a329.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_142.png[/img]{Within the barren tundra, you find a prime hunting ground around a small lake, and so you decide to go on a short one-day kill.

You quickly spot a sizeable elk cropping the scant tundra grass. Just as you ready a kill shot, the elk's neck seizes with its snout pointed straight out. The bones crack and its limbs go bow legged as they are gripped by instant death, but it does not fall. The withers tremble and then bulb and shift as though fists rolled beneath its fur. Suddenly, the flesh tears asunder and you can see a slick blue mass bubbling between the wounds. Its legs burst apart and the torso rises high into the air as long stalks of thick bone clap to the ground and wormy, snakelike straps of muscle wrap about the shafts. You believed the elk dead, but its maw groans wildly just as its face rips apart from crown to jaw like a blossoming flower. The face of something else entirely emerges, and it pushes forward as though generated by the very gore it was busy reaping. As the new monster finds its strength, it seizes up on both hind legs and reaches his hands back to tear away the fur of the elk like a man would a cloak. Blood and bones splatter.

 A hideous beast three times the height of any man turns and feels out its limbs, tensing its hands, cracking its knees and shoulders, turning its head from side to side with its fat nostrils flaring like a bull. The eye sockets are all bone and a blue haze pulses within them like crackling storms. The elk's beautiful antlers have been abrogated by horrible horns. A frosty air curls from its mouth and you can see the leaves of a nearby tree go cold and brittle. 

 You have the uneasy feeling that this monster is not in fact a monster at all, but a transient spirit which manifests itself as it sees fit, carving itself into the world as an aspect of chaos and little else. Just as you think this, the beast turns its head toward you and it hooks its long nails into the corners of its fanged mouth and stretches the lips so far out the corners could be its ears.%SPEECH_ON%Ahhh, this is the place to be, this is the place where I am happy. Why do you look with such fear, am I not but a simple deer?%SPEECH_OFF%Its head cocks to a side with the drool slopping over its bottom lip and playful tears fill its eyes. You've heard stories of this creature, a cruel horror the northerners call the Ijirok or the Beast of Winter. You know it is not here to speak poetry and play games. You draw your sword, but then a hand claps your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Here with you always, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to see the company at your side and ready to fight.}
8a0f9cec5fea7996a329.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_142.png[/img]{荒凉的苔原上，你在一座小湖周围发现了绝佳猎场，便决定花一天时间，短暂狩猎一番。

你很快看见一头颇大的麋鹿，正在啃食稀疏的苔原草。刚准备瞄准射杀，鹿的脖子忽然僵住，口鼻直直朝前。骨骼咔嚓作响，四肢向外弯曲，仿佛顷刻间被死亡攫住，身体却没有倒下。肩背颤动，继而鼓起、移位，像有拳头在皮毛下滚动。突然，血肉撕开，伤口之间涌出光滑的蓝色物质，翻腾着冒泡。它的腿爆裂，躯干高高升起，粗长的骨柱砸向地面，蠕虫与蛇一般的肌肉条缠绕上去。你原以为鹿已经死了，可它的嘴却狂乱呻吟，面孔从头顶到下颌裂开，像一朵绽放的花。另一种东西的脸从中显露，向前挤出，仿佛正从自己制造的血肉惨剧里生长。新生的怪物渐渐获得力气，以两条后腿猛然站直，将双手伸向背后，如同脱斗篷般扯去麋鹿的皮毛。鲜血与碎骨四处飞溅。

一个比人高三倍的丑恶怪兽转过身，试探自己的肢体，握紧双手，让膝盖和肩膀咔咔作响，脑袋左右转动，肥大的鼻孔像公牛般张开。眼窝里尽是骨头，蓝色雾气在其中脉动，如同劈啪闪烁的风暴。麋鹿美丽的鹿角，已被可怕的犄角取代。寒气从嘴里卷出，你能看见附近一棵树的叶子冻得脆硬。 

你隐隐觉得，这东西其实并非野兽，而是一个游移的精魂，随心所欲地显形，以混沌的化身雕入世间，除此之外别无目的。正想着，怪物把头转向你，长指甲钩住獠牙巨口两侧，将嘴唇拉得极远，嘴角几乎能当耳朵。%SPEECH_ON%啊，这里正合我心意，这里才是欢喜之地。为何满眼都是恐惧，我不就是一头小鹿？%SPEECH_OFF%它将头歪向一侧，口水流过下唇，眼中泛起嬉闹般的泪光。你听过这种生物的故事，北方人把这残酷的恐怖存在称作伊吉罗克，或寒冬之兽。你知道，它可不是来吟诗玩闹的。你拔出剑，这时，一只手拍上你的肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我们一直与你同在。%SPEECH_OFF%你转头，看见弟兄们已站到身旁，准备迎战。}

181a92932e00d580a9d1.source: We need to get out of here! Fast!

64c79c644a78ffb9d65f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{%squire% comes up to you scratching the back of his head. He looks like he has something on his mind, and you prod him to let it out. Sighing, he asks why %squire2% was hired onto the company.%SPEECH_ON%He's a squire, I'm a squire, are we both your squires?%SPEECH_OFF%You inform the lad that %squire2% was squire to another man, but things changed in his life to lead him here. For all intents and purposes, he is a sellsword now and %squire% is indeed still your squire. %squire% lights up with a smile, but it quickly goes awry.%SPEECH_ON%Wait, does that mean I'm more sellsword than squire?%SPEECH_OFF%You press a ledger into the kid's chest and tell him to go count inventory.}
64c79c644a78ffb9d65f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{%squire%挠着后脑勺走过来，一副心事重重的样子。你让他有话直说。他叹了口气，问你为什么要把%squire2%招进战团。%SPEECH_ON%他是侍从，我也是侍从，那我们两个都是您的侍从吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉这小子，%squire2%原本侍奉的是别人，只因人生有了变故，才来到这里。如今他就是一名佣兵，而%squire%仍是你的侍从。%squire%顿时笑逐颜开，可那笑容很快又僵住了。%SPEECH_ON%等等，那是不是说，我现在也更像佣兵，而不是侍从了？%SPEECH_OFF%你把账本往这小子怀里一塞，叫他去清点物资。}

a9efe640f99b54b18eae.source: And to think I used to roam these lands alone...
a9efe640f99b54b18eae.translation: 想当年，我还是独自闯荡这片土地……

4830209bb8b464709753.source: Confused about his role as your squire
4830209bb8b464709753.translation: 对自己作为你的侍从的职责感到困惑

b2ac229445fce17a73bf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]{You come across an old woman outside of the home of a nobleman. She sizes you up as though she were looking into her own past. Amused, you ask her what it is she wants. The lady smiles.%SPEECH_ON%What is it you think you're doing, exactly? Wandering the land as a hedge knight, killing and slaying and farkin' the ladies now and again?%SPEECH_OFF%Politely, you inform her that you are in fact not just some tournament hopper, but a bonafide sellsword. She shrugs and throws her hand to a nobleman's house.%SPEECH_ON%And what of it? They'll never accept you. You'll be a fighter. You're out here, forever. You only go inside when they let you. This is not a world you can improve yourself in. You are what you are born as.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b2ac229445fce17a73bf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]{你在一位贵族的宅邸外遇见一个老妇人。她打量着你，仿佛在回望自己的往昔。你觉得有趣，便问她有什么事。老妇人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%你到底以为自己在干什么？当个流浪骑士，四处游荡，杀来砍去，偶尔再跟女人睡上一觉？%SPEECH_OFF%你客气地告诉她，自己可不只是到处赶比武大会的骑士，而是个货真价实的佣兵。她耸耸肩，抬手指向贵族的宅邸。%SPEECH_ON%那又怎样？他们永远不会接纳你。你只是个打仗的。你永远都得待在外头，只有他们准许，你才能进门。这个世道容不得你往上爬。生来是什么，一辈子就是什么。%SPEECH_OFF%}

c5d7ee2636aab3dbf613.source: This world is what I make of it.
c5d7ee2636aab3dbf613.translation: 这世道如何，由我自己闯出来。

0f146745bb80ea4108b6.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]The pub is full of drunk denizens sloshing about, cheering, singing, carousing with the womenfolk of either wench or wife or whore. A man with a lute dances and plays and another with metal cymbals crashes overhead while a fat man booms with songs of battles or love, and whether a tale of victory or defeat they provoke rounds of ale and more merriment all the same.

 You leave the pub and enter the next building over. The wind whistles down a pew filled nave as you stand at the door. A man sweeping the stone floor looks up for a time then continues with his work. Another man cheerfully crosses the room and asks if you'd like to pray. You decline and he purses his lips and crosses his arms. The crowd next door roars with drunken delight as though to make a mockery of you both and then he moves on.
