You stay for a moment longer and then leave and go back out to the town center and squat on a series of steps. It seems there used to be a statue at the top of those steps, but vandals and raiders alike have made short work of another's artisanry. You fall asleep there at the foot of impermanence. 

 Waking from a nap, you find a young man at the bottom of the steps. He says he knows you're a knight and he's come to offer his services as a squire.
0f146745bb80ea4108b6.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]酒馆里挤满了醉醺醺的镇民，摇摇晃晃，欢呼高歌，搂着姑娘、妻子或妓女纵情作乐。一个男人抱着鲁特琴，边跳边弹；另一个高举金属铙钹，敲得震天响；还有个胖子放声唱着战争与爱情。无论歌里是胜是败，都能换来一轮轮麦酒，让众人更加快活。

 你离开酒馆，走进隔壁的建筑。你站在门口，风沿着摆满长椅的中殿呼啸而过。一个清扫石地板的人抬头看了片刻，又继续干活。另一个人满面笑容地穿过屋子，问你是否想祈祷。你谢绝了，他便抿起嘴唇，抱起双臂。隔壁忽然爆发出醉酒者的欢叫，仿佛在嘲弄你们两人，他随后也走开了。你又停了一会儿，才离开这里，回到镇中心，在一排台阶上蹲坐下来。台阶顶上似乎曾立着雕像，可破坏者和劫掠者早已将别人的匠心毁于一旦。你就在这无常的残迹脚下睡着了。 

 小睡醒来，你发现台阶下站着一个年轻人。他说知道你是骑士，特地来毛遂自荐，想当你的侍从。

43cd4f088139b94a8e29.source: I take you as my squire.

9412cfaf783cf7f80076.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{The man shakes his head no.%SPEECH_ON%Ain't never killed no one, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9412cfaf783cf7f80076.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{那人摇头否认。%SPEECH_ON%大人，我从没杀过人。%SPEECH_OFF%}

20ee6420e768d4e3ba9a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{The man stands up straight.%SPEECH_ON%I know how to sharpen steel and mend leather. I can disassemble and reassemble heavy and light armors both, no matter how complex or simple, and I can do it fast. If we have a horse.%SPEECH_OFF%You interrupt.%SPEECH_ON%I walk.%SPEECH_OFF%Shifting uneasily on his feet, the man continues.%SPEECH_ON%Alright. Well I can cook. I can cook a fine meal whether I got the ingredients or not. I make do. And. And. That's. That's about it. But I'm willing to learn!%SPEECH_OFF%}
20ee6420e768d4e3ba9a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{那人挺直腰杆。%SPEECH_ON%我会磨刀，也会补皮子。重甲轻甲，无论结构复杂还是简单，我都能拆开装回去，而且手脚很快。如果有马……%SPEECH_OFF%你打断他。%SPEECH_ON%我走路。%SPEECH_OFF%他不安地挪动双脚，继续说道：%SPEECH_ON%好。嗯，我会做饭。有料没料，都能弄出顿好吃的，我能凑合着做。还有……还有……大概就这些。不过我愿意学！%SPEECH_OFF%}

f2b03d81568fab8e1e8d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{You ask the man his name. He swallows nervously.%SPEECH_ON%%squire%, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Well alright then. I'll take ya with me.%SPEECH_OFF%He smiles.%SPEECH_ON%That's. That's it?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah. That's it.%SPEECH_OFF%%squire% looks around.%SPEECH_ON%Well. Alright. What now?%SPEECH_OFF%You lean back against the stone steps.%SPEECH_ON%You follow me. Right now I'm gonna take another nap. If yer still around when I wake, well, then you've passed your first test. Defeating boredom.%SPEECH_OFF%The squire is grinning ear to ear. He's still there when you wake.}
f2b03d81568fab8e1e8d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{你问他叫什么。他紧张地咽了口唾沫。%SPEECH_ON%%squire%，大人。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。%SPEECH_ON%那好，跟我走吧。%SPEECH_OFF%他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%这……这就行了？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。%SPEECH_ON%对，就这么简单。%SPEECH_OFF%%squire%环顾四周。%SPEECH_ON%好吧。那么，现在呢？%SPEECH_OFF%你向后倚着石阶。%SPEECH_ON%跟着我。眼下我打算再睡一觉。等我醒来，你要是还在，就算过了第一关：熬过无聊。%SPEECH_OFF%侍从笑得合不拢嘴。你醒来时，他果然还在。}

c43502f94314a0022ed1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{You look at the would-be squire long and hard and then tell him no. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Just so you know, you ain't gotta be alone in this world. Loneliness has no presence. It is not a place. It is not a being. It is action!%SPEECH_OFF%Spitting, you wipe your face and laugh.%SPEECH_ON%Is that what you tell yourself every morning? Get out of here.%SPEECH_OFF%}
c43502f94314a0022ed1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{你仔细打量了这个想当侍从的人许久，最后拒绝了。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%你得知道，在这世上不一定非得独来独往。孤独并非实物，不是一处地方，也不是一个活物。它是一种选择！%SPEECH_OFF%你啐了一口，抹了把脸，笑道：%SPEECH_ON%你每天早上就拿这话哄自己？走吧。%SPEECH_OFF%}

c1e105b29da9e9090e36.source: where he volunteered to be your squire. He probably had no idea what he was getting into back then.
c1e105b29da9e9090e36.translation: ，并在那里主动请求做你的侍从。那时，他大概还不知道自己踏上的是怎样一条路。

6fa84c53f69f0ad105b2.source: Has become a squire to a knight
6fa84c53f69f0ad105b2.translation: 成为了一名骑士的侍从

7c0af74d0a50e799a3bc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{%monk% is a monk who, by this point, is very, very far from his home. The days on the road alone are hard enough, and the days off it being filled with violence and pillaging even worse so. It's no surprise that he has come to you with an offer. Despite being with your company for some time now, it is clear that he is still a man of civilization.

 He explains an old law: as a raider you are persona non grata, but as a raider with a lot of money there is a chance you can buy your way back into dealing with the nobles of this land. The monk says he knows whose palms to cross. Apparently, %noblehouse% is interested in 'opening channels', and they would just appreciate %crowns% crowns to settle into new affairs. Civilized indeed.}
7c0af74d0a50e799a3bc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{修士%monk%如今已经离家很远、很远了。单是一路奔波就已够难熬，而停下脚步时，等着他的却是暴力与劫掠，那就更难忍受了。他会来向你提个建议，实在不足为奇。尽管跟随战团已有一段时日，他显然仍眷恋着文明社会。

 他向你解释了一项古老的规矩：身为劫掠者，你当然不受欢迎；但若是个有钱的劫掠者，便有机会花钱打通关节，重新与这片土地上的贵族做生意。修士说，他知道该把钱塞进谁的手里。看来%noblehouse%有意“疏通关系”，只需%crowns%克朗，就愿意与你展开新的往来。果然文明得很。}

23faba54ae21ced170ee.source: We have no need for this.

025118c20d4a9567d364.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{You agree to the monk's notions. Together, you meet with an intermediary and one of the nobles himself. The meeting takes place in secret and at first there is a lot of dramatic cloak and dagger nonsense. Men wearing black and keeping their hands to their weapons, nobles whispering to one another, but after it's all said and done... you have a good long drink together. In the future, %noblehouse% will be more open to dealings.}
025118c20d4a9567d364.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{你接受了修士的提议，与他一道去见一位中间人，以及亲自到场的一名贵族。会面秘密进行，一开始尽是些装腔作势的谍谋戏码：黑衣人始终按着武器，贵族们交头接耳。可折腾到最后……你们却坐下来痛痛快快喝了很久。今后，%noblehouse%会更愿意与你们打交道。}

42a85f1543c52e83749c.source: Doing mercenary work for them would further mend relations.
42a85f1543c52e83749c.translation: 再替他们办些委托，还能进一步改善关系。

05a41c6a0f54cf9d1d6c.source: Was bribed to have dealings with you
05a41c6a0f54cf9d1d6c.translation: 收下贿赂，同意与你往来

4ff6acfc1b8a663c91c9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{Being the collection of hunters that you are, it becomes readily apparent that you've entered some fine hunting grounds. %randombrother% suggests the company go for a hunt, though he warns the group should be mindful of just how much they pluck from these bountiful stretches.}
4ff6acfc1b8a663c91c9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{你们这一帮都是猎人，很快便看出已经进入了一片好猎场。%randombrother%建议战团出去打猎，不过也提醒众人，虽说这里猎物丰富，仍得留意，别拿得太多。}

8d8ee0e6bbe16ccf55c4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{The men are ordered to go on a hunt and they take an inch a mile! They shoot and strip and slaughter just about everything breathing animal in range. You're wary of this leading to the attention of local nobles, but they are none the wiser. Inventory stores will be brimming!}
8d8ee0e6bbe16ccf55c4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{你命令弟兄们去打猎，他们却得寸进尺，射杀、剥皮，几乎把射程内一切会喘气的野兽都屠了个遍。你担心这会引起当地贵族注意，所幸他们毫不知情。仓库这下要装得满满当当了！}

9ddeaea72d336b7f199a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{A few of the men depart on the hunt and return with a couple of kills. You ask if they ran into any trouble and they shake their heads no. Looks like the inventory will see some tasty additions and no nobleman will be any wiser!}
9ddeaea72d336b7f199a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{几个弟兄外出打猎，带回了几只猎物。你问有没有遇上麻烦，他们都摇头。看来储备里又添了些美味，而贵族老爷们将一无所知！}

465d3d1f171b1fbd8fc8.source: %terrainImage%{An hour or so after sending the men off on a hunt, they return. Except they're dragging a bloodied and shredded %bearbrother% back into camp. They report the group had crossed paths with a momma brown bear. Her fight was tremendous, and she only stopped mauling the wounded poacher because one of the men threatened her babies with a torch. You're happy the men are all alive, albeit %bearbrother% is going to require a long time to recover.}
465d3d1f171b1fbd8fc8.translation: %terrainImage%{派弟兄们出去打猎约一个时辰后，他们回来了，却拖着浑身是血、皮开肉绽的%bearbrother%。据说一行人撞见了一头带崽的棕熊。母熊凶悍至极，直到有人举火把威胁幼崽，它才停止撕咬受伤的偷猎者。你庆幸无人丧命，不过%bearbrother%恐怕得养上很久。}

900f2d1a340161daf9f1.source: This mercenary work is dulling our senses.
900f2d1a340161daf9f1.translation: 佣兵这行，把咱们的感官都磨钝了。

4bca329f8b064d213d68.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{As the snow and stiff winds beat down upon your face, it seems almost miraculous that there's someone on this mountain waving you down. But there he is, a bearded fella with two sleds in hand. He yells out if you're interested in a race.%SPEECH_ON%First one to split them two rocks shaped like cocks is the winner!%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what it is that's on the line. When he looks at you like a dog spoken to in the wrong language, you ask what you're betting. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Ain't no bet! Just a matter of fun!%SPEECH_OFF%Fair enough. Maybe one of the %companyname% would like to try?}
4bca329f8b064d213d68.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{风雪迎面扑打，这座山上竟然还有人朝你招手，简直像个奇迹。可他确实在那里，一个留胡子的家伙，手边牵着两架雪橇，高声问你有没有兴趣比一场。%SPEECH_ON%谁先穿过那两块像鸡巴的石头，谁就赢！%SPEECH_OFF%你问赌的是什么。他茫然地看着你，像条听不懂人话的狗。你便又问，拿什么作赌注。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不赌钱！就是图个乐子！%SPEECH_OFF%也好。说不定，%companyname%里有人想试试？}

1abbf2708bcb76391e06.source: Someone step forward and do it!

6b4bac3a35d0ca025862.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{%sledder% takes the sled from the mountain man.%SPEECH_ON%I'll beat ya to them rock dicks in proper time.%SPEECH_OFF%Everyone raises an eyebrow as he sets the sled down. He jacks his boots against its front and tips it toward the edge of the hillside.%SPEECH_ON%Ready when you are.%SPEECH_OFF%The mountain man gives a signal to start the race and the two zip down the snow in an instant. You're not sure if your sellsword played cheap, but the mountain man suddenly turns sideways and flips his sled and he goes rolling through the powder in a flail of beard and limbs. %sledder% meanwhile coasts to an easy victory. The company roars to the victory and carry him up the mountain on their shoulders. If the mercenary did cheat it doesn't show on the mountain man's face, he is just happy to have had raced at all.}
6b4bac3a35d0ca025862.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{%sledder%从山民手里接过雪橇。%SPEECH_ON%我准能抢在你前头，滑到那几根石鸡巴旁边。%SPEECH_OFF%众人扬着眉毛，看他放下雪橇。他把靴子抵在前端，将雪橇倾向坡边。%SPEECH_ON%你一声令下，咱就走。%SPEECH_OFF%山民发出信号，两人瞬间掠过雪面，冲向山下。你说不准手下是不是使了阴招，只见山民突然横过身，雪橇翻了，人也滚进雪粉，胡子与四肢乱甩。%sledder%却顺顺当当地滑过终点，轻松获胜。弟兄们放声欢呼，把他扛在肩上抬回山顶。就算佣兵真耍了赖，山民脸上也看不出介怀；能痛快赛上一场，他就已经很高兴了。}

a2652288c95635985dc7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{%sledder% takes the sled from the mountain man.%SPEECH_ON%I'll beat ya to them rock dicks in proper time.%SPEECH_OFF%Everyone raises an eyebrow as he sets the sled down. He jacks his boots against its front and tips it toward the edge of the hillside.%SPEECH_ON%Ready when you are.%SPEECH_OFF%The mountain man gives a signal to start the race and the two zip down the snow in an instant. Rooster tails of powder shower in their wake and it seems like %sledder% is going to win until he angles incorrectly and smashes right into one of the rock cocks. The sled shatters to pieces and the sellsword goes flying over the stone and lands limply into the snow. Laughing, the company rushes to his aide and brings him back to his feet. He's got some raspberries and something is clicking, but he'll live. The mountain man cheers.%SPEECH_ON%Ye almost had me, but yer s'posed to split the dicks, not ride up them!%SPEECH_OFF%This brings your men to their knees in crying laughter.}
a2652288c95635985dc7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{%sledder%从山民手里接过雪橇。%SPEECH_ON%我准能抢在你前头，滑到那几根石鸡巴旁边。%SPEECH_OFF%众人扬着眉毛，看他放下雪橇。他把靴子抵在前端，将雪橇倾向坡边。%SPEECH_ON%你一声令下，咱就走。%SPEECH_OFF%山民发出信号，两人瞬间掠过雪面，身后扬起高高的雪尾。眼看%sledder%就要赢了，他却转错角度，一头撞上那根石鸡巴。雪橇碎成片，佣兵从岩石上方飞过，软绵绵地摔进雪里。弟兄们笑着跑去救他，把他扶起来。他擦破了几处皮，身上某处还咔咔作响，不过命保住了。山民大声叫好。%SPEECH_ON%你差点就赢了！可说好是从两根鸡巴中间穿过去，不是骑上去啊！%SPEECH_OFF%这话让弟兄们笑得跪在地上，眼泪都出来了。}

2fb38f4468ae71097071.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_08.png[/img]{%fat%, the fattest man in the company, elects to give it a try. You like his chances - given his weight it's likely he'll blow right down the mountainside. The mountain man readily accepts the challenge, sets the ground rules, and starts the race proper. The two rip through the snow with ease and, just as you thought, the fat man roars through the powder like lightning through a cloud. But he doesn't seem to slow. He plows right between the two cock rocks, signaling his win, but he's unable to seize the reins or slow down. He barrels over an escarpment and that's about the last of you see of him. The mountain man grimaces and runs toward the hillside.%SPEECH_ON%He's alive! Little busted up, but alive!%SPEECH_OFF%Though you're mightily concerned, you look back to see that the company whole is doubled over or on their knees choking with laughter.}
2fb38f4468ae71097071.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_08.png[/img]{战团里最胖的%fat%决定试上一试。你很看好他——凭这体重，怕是能一路飞下山坡。山民爽快应战，讲清规矩，比赛正式开始。两人轻松划开积雪，果然不出你所料，胖子穿过雪粉，快得像劈进云层的闪电。可他似乎完全慢不下来。他从两块形似鸡巴的岩石间直冲而过，已经赢了比赛，却怎么也抓不住缰绳，无法减速。随后，他一头冲下陡坎，从你眼前消失了。山民龇着牙，赶紧跑向坡边。%SPEECH_ON%还活着！摔得有点惨，不过还活着！%SPEECH_OFF%你正担心得紧，回头却发现，全团不是笑弯了腰，就是跪在地上，笑得喘不过气。}

243e3ca32111627d183a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{%shortsighted% volunteers to race the mountain man. You are reluctant to allows that, given the sellsword's poor eyesight, but he is pretty diligent about the matter. As he squats on the sled and takes up the reins you can't help but notice that he is already squinting downhill as though he wouldn't tell a mountainside from a red barn.%SPEECH_ON%Ready!%SPEECH_OFF%The mountain man sets the rules and starts the race. Almost immediately the shortsighted sellsword veers off course. Thankfully he's not even full speed when he slams head first into a rock formation. The sled shatters like a tomato against a pillory and the man himself pancakes against the stone. You rush to his aide and get him to his feet, but there you find your foot stepping on something metallic. A treasure chest! You tell the company to get the man some proper help while you dig out what you can.}
243e3ca32111627d183a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{%shortsighted%主动提出，要和山民比试滑雪橇。想到他那糟糕的视力，你本不愿答应，可他坚持得很。他蹲上雪橇，抓起缰绳，你已经看见他眯着眼望向山下，仿佛连山坡和红谷仓都分不清。%SPEECH_ON%准备好了！%SPEECH_OFF%山民讲完规矩，宣布开始。几乎刚出发，这个近视佣兵就偏离了路线。幸好，一头撞上岩石时，他还没冲到最快。雪橇像砸在刑柱上的番茄一样散开，人则整张饼似的拍在石头上。你赶过去扶他起身，脚下却踩到一个金属物件。是宝箱！你叫弟兄们好好救治那人，自己则动手挖掘，看能取出些什么。}

402566648e661be75974.translation: 眼神不好的，倒领起明眼人来了。

da92e1f719dce97e7cb5.source: %terrainImage%{You come across a man beside a hole in the ice. He's got a fishing pole next to him and, despite the environment, welcomes you warmly.%SPEECH_ON%Care to have a chat, traveler? You don't seem to be from these parts.%SPEECH_OFF% | A man wearing bear fur is cutting a hole in the ice. He looks at you just as the rim of his cuts drops and he punches it into the water.%SPEECH_ON%Come traveler, take ease beside me for a time. I'm harmless.%SPEECH_OFF%}
da92e1f719dce97e7cb5.translation: %terrainImage%{你遇见一个坐在冰窟窿旁的男人，身边搁着钓竿。天寒地冻，他招呼你时却十分热情。%SPEECH_ON%旅人，想聊几句吗？你看起来不是这一带的人。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个披熊皮的男人正在冰面上凿洞。他望向你时，刚凿出的冰圈落了下去，便一拳将它捣进水里。%SPEECH_ON%来吧，旅人，在我身边歇会儿。我不会害你。%SPEECH_OFF%}

45c9423a1655072c0440.source: Join us at the campfire for tonight.
45c9423a1655072c0440.translation: 今晚就和我们一起围着营火过夜吧。

c5ecfc3b32dd95fc64c3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{You ask the man if the North has seen any devastating wars. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, we've our differences. This spat and that. But a century ago a collective of warriors was formed to defeat a horde of undead. Ohh ya, see it in yer eyes that ye didn't know that one. It is likely that if they were defeated the walking corpses would have flooded south and killed you all. You're welcome. Bet they don't teach that in your fancy southern scripts.%SPEECH_OFF% | The man snorts and nods at the fishing pole.%SPEECH_ON%They say there's large fish down under there. Harmless ones, but big enough to spur the imagination. I can't say I've seen them in the flesh, but there was a time when a large shadow passed beneath my feet, passed right there through the waters, and it passed and passed, felt like forever. And then it was gone.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask how he thinks it a harmless beast. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Cause it didn't do nothing but go from there to there and onward still.%SPEECH_OFF% | The man tests a fishing pole then crouches on his haunches. He nods across the ice.%SPEECH_ON%Ol' white bears will cross these stretches. Gotta keep your mind out for 'em. A bit of fire will fend them off, that or you dump your fish and make a run for it. I'd known a man who got eaten by a white bear. They said it ate him from legs up, giving no shits about his screaming and hollering. I'd sooner slit my own throat than let one of them beasts get a hold of me.%SPEECH_OFF% | A friendly enough fellow, the man rests beside his fishing poles and speaks to the nature of his own people.%SPEECH_ON%I'd been close enough south to know you think us savages. That's quite alright, but there's more to it than that, or less I suppose. We got less. Far less. And make do with it anyhow.%SPEECH_OFF%You remark that northerners frequent the south only to rape and pillage what it has. The man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%And you send war parties north to treat us to a sense of southern justice. Seems fair enough. Nobody's doing nothing that don't have a bit of retribution hanging there clear as day to see. We're all on level.%SPEECH_OFF% | As you set beside the man he catches a fish and yanks it onto the ice. He grasps it with a fur-gloved hand and smashes its head to stop its flopping. He talks as he guts and salts it.%SPEECH_ON%Some of the northerners figured out a way to tame them giants, the unholds I think you call them.  Don't ask me how. Anytime I'd heard of a giant going anywhere all it did was kill anyone in its path and eat all the livestock.%SPEECH_OFF% | The man snorts and tests his fishing rods and sighs when there's no pull.%SPEECH_ON%I went south a few years back. Stayed there a few years just as well. That's how I know your tongue so well. When I was down that way, I tasted what you call vegetables. Disgusting things, truly, and the south wonders how we grow so big and strong up there in these wastes? I'll tell ya, we can't grow no fucking vegetables. Only thing we eat has to die and nothing with a heartbeat is willing to die easy.%SPEECH_OFF% | The friendly northern fisherman tells you stories of how the tribes come and go.%SPEECH_ON%I'll say this much, we're only run by the strong, but a strong man is only as good as his health and constitution. When he gets old, he loses both. When he gets old, he therefore loses. And so the new strong man comes to power, and with it a shattering of the tribe's history and successes. I do in part envy the southerner's sense of greater purpose, and the southerner's ability to hide his power, to stock it at arm's length so that others must do more than just swing a sword to get it from him. I tell you this in truth, and only here, as far away from my countrymen as I can be. You'll never hear me say any of this around no ordinary campfire, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%}
c5ecfc3b32dd95fc64c3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{你问那人，北方是否经历过毁灭性的战争。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，我们也有纷争，这一场，那一场。不过，一百年前，各路战士曾聚到一起，打败了一支亡灵大军。噢，对，看你的眼神就知道，这事你没听过。要是他们败了，那些会走路的尸体大概早已涌向南方，把你们全杀光。不用谢。我打赌，你们南方那些花哨的典籍可不教这个。%SPEECH_OFF% | 那人哼了一声，朝鱼竿点点头。%SPEECH_ON%听说下面有大鱼。无害，可大得足够让人胡思乱想。我没亲眼看过全貌，不过有一回，一大片影子从我脚下游过，就从那片水里，游啊，游啊，仿佛永远也游不完。然后，就没了。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他，凭什么觉得那东西无害。他耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%因为它什么都没干，只是从那边游到这边，又接着往前游。%SPEECH_OFF% | 那人试了试鱼竿，蹲下来，朝冰面另一头点头。%SPEECH_ON%白熊会横穿这一片，得留神。弄点火能赶走它们，或者扔下鱼，拔腿就跑。我认识一个被白熊吃了的人。听说从腿开始往上吃，根本不在乎他怎么哭喊。我宁可自己割喉，也不想落进那种畜生手里。%SPEECH_OFF% | 这人颇为友善，坐在鱼竿旁，说起自己族人的秉性。%SPEECH_ON%我去过够靠南的地方，知道你们把我们当野人。没关系，不过其中还有别的缘由，或者该说，更少的缘由。我们拥有的少，少得多，可也得想法子活下去。%SPEECH_OFF%你指出，北方人常来南方，干的却只是奸淫掳掠。那人耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%而你们派军队北上，让我们领教南方的正义。看着挺公平。谁干的事，都明摆着有一份报复在后头等着。大家彼此彼此。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在那人身旁坐下时，他恰好钓起一条鱼，甩到冰面上。他用戴毛皮手套的手抓住鱼，砸碎脑袋，不让它再扑腾，一边剖腹撒盐，一边说。%SPEECH_ON%有些北方人琢磨出了驯服巨人的办法，我想，你们叫它们巨魔。别问我是怎么做到的。我每次听说巨人去了哪里，都只有杀光挡路的人、吃光牲口这回事。%SPEECH_OFF% | 那人哼了一声，试试鱼竿，没感觉到咬钩，便叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%几年前我去过南方，还待了几年，所以你们的话，我说得这么熟。那时候，我尝过你们所谓的蔬菜。恶心，真恶心。南方人还纳闷，我们怎么能在这些荒地里长得又高又壮？告诉你吧，我们种不出他娘的蔬菜。能吃的东西都得先杀死，而有心跳的东西，没有哪个肯轻易去死。%SPEECH_OFF% | 友善的北方渔夫，向你讲起部落如何兴起，又如何消亡。%SPEECH_ON%我只能这么说，我们只听强者的。可强者的本事，也只撑得到他身体还结实、精力还旺盛的时候。一老，两样都没了。一老，也就输了。新的强者掌权，部落过去的历史和成就，往往也跟着碎掉。我有一点羡慕南方人，能为更长远的目标打算；也羡慕他们把权力藏起来，放在别人够不着的地方，让人想夺走时，不只是挥一剑那么简单。我说的都是真心话，可只会在这里说，离同胞越远越好。在寻常篝火边，你绝不可能听见我说这些，懂吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

2a7932b2db8de9e911ab.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{As the company camps, %randombrother% stops stropping a blade and looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Y'all hear that?%SPEECH_OFF%You do. Wild dogs are yipping and howling. You shrug and say it's nothing, but in that moment there's a yelp and the yips turn into snarling and you hear the distinct sound of animalistic struggle. The snarls turn to whines. Something is losing the fight. %randombrother% turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Sounds close, should we check it out? I don't wanna sleep with that around.%SPEECH_OFF%}
2a7932b2db8de9e911ab.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{扎营时，%randombrother%停下用皮带磨刀的动作，抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%都听见了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你听见了，是野狗在吠叫、嚎叫。你耸耸肩，说没什么，可就在此时，一声惨叫响起，吠声化为咆哮，兽类搏斗的动静清晰传来。咆哮又变成呜咽，有什么东西正在败下阵来。%randombrother%转向你。%SPEECH_ON%听着挺近，要去看看吗？旁边有这动静，我可睡不着。%SPEECH_OFF%}

368260acdd94eb869179.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{You tell the company to ignore the sounds. That's a hard task to oblige as the cries of the wild dogs only grow louder and louder until, just like that, they stop. Your men stand still as though making any noise could bring the hell of whatever horror it is that's out there. Nothing comes to pass, but a number of the men have a hard time sleeping through the night.}
368260acdd94eb869179.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你命令战团别理会那些声音。可这命令很难照办：野狗的惨叫越来越响，随后，骤然停止。弟兄们一动不动，仿佛发出一点声响，就会把外头不知名的恐怖招来。最终什么也没发生，但不少人一夜难眠。}

af41bc5b0136807740c3.translation: 拿出点胆量来，你们这些蠢货。

8a2a06f74657c207f0ab.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{You tell the company to plug their ears if it bothers them so much. As the cries of the wild dogs grow louder the men turn to impromptu ear candling to keep the sounds at bay. Eventually, the sense deprived sellswords are awkwardly walking around like animatronics. You look to join the muted, plugging a waxball into your ear, but before you can get the second ear a loud crash sends inventory flowing and a tent billows as it collapses. You drain your ear and bark orders to the mercenaries who are scattered all over the camp.}
8a2a06f74657c207f0ab.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你告诉弟兄们，真那么受不了，就把耳朵堵上。野狗叫得愈发凄厉，他们便临时拿蜡塞耳，隔绝声音。不一会儿，听不见动静的佣兵们走起路来都别别扭扭，像一群机关木偶。你也想加入这片清静，刚往一只耳朵里塞进蜡球，还没来得及堵另一只，便听见轰隆一声，物资滚落四处，帐篷翻飞着塌了。你掏空耳朵，对营地里乱作一团的佣兵吼出命令。}

c85fbbd9a90a5e4630a0.translation: 拿起武器，你们这群聋子！

a40e909393f2b75b3965.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{It does appear the men will not be assuaged by telling them to grow a pair. %hunter% elects to go seek out the noise, as he's sure it's nothing more than the wild dogs squabbling over primacy over the pack. You send him on his way, the man venturing into the dark all by his lonesome. Just as soon as he's gone the canines cease their crying and you hear a growl that seems as though it came from a much higher ground. The whole camp is dead silent, daring not to even move.

 An hour later and the hunter walks into camp, nobody having heard him come in. He's camouflaged himself in mud slaked with twigs and leaves. He's grafted stems into a hood which he wears like some arboreal abbess. With hushed tones, the sellswords ask what he saw. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Well. I seen about a dozen dead dogs. Some ripped apart. Found a few in the pit of very large footprints and they'd not found the print but had been stomped there, you know. And I saw something move along in the shadows between the tree tops and it went the other way and I did not follow. I found a deer dead on its feet leaning against a tree. Heart faltered by whatever it saw, I suppose. I harvested everything I could.%SPEECH_OFF%The man turns and slings forward a rack of meat strung to a paneling of wood and leaves.%SPEECH_ON%Anyone hungry?%SPEECH_OFF%}
a40e909393f2b75b3965.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{看来，光叫弟兄们拿出点胆量，是安抚不了他们了。%hunter%自告奋勇去查声音的来处，坚信不过是一群野狗在争头领。你让他去了，他独自走进黑暗。可他前脚刚离开，犬吠便停了，接着响起一声低吼，仿佛来自高得多的地方。整个营地死一般寂静，谁都不敢动。

一个小时后，猎人走进营地，竟没人听见他靠近。他把树枝和叶片糊在泥里，涂满全身作掩护，又将植物茎秆编进兜帽，戴着像一位林木修女院长。佣兵们压低声音，问他看见了什么。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%唔，看见十几条死狗，有些被撕碎了。几条躺在巨大的脚印坑里，不是自己跑进去的，是被一脚踩成那样，明白吧？还有个东西，在树梢间的暗影里移动，后来往另一个方向去了，我没跟。我还找到一头死鹿，四条腿撑着，靠在树上。想必看见了什么，吓得心脏停了。我把能取的都取了。%SPEECH_OFF%他转过身，将背上的木片与树叶架子甩到前面，上头挂着肉。%SPEECH_ON%有人饿了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

9bfede410141a8db0525.source: Hell of a haul, I suppose.

074817e3ac4073c1c80e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{Fear comes over the camp, but you fetch %wildman% to your side. The wildman snorts and runs his hand along his nose as though you've inconvenienced whatever inexplicable notion he has of his own time. He raises an eyebrow as you suggest, to the best of your pantomiming abilities, that he go and seek out the noise. With little further suggestion, the man grunts and takes off into the woods.

 You swear he's a good hundred meters off but you can still hear him barreling through the bushes making all the goddam noise in the world. The wild dogs quit their baying and in their place you hear a loud growl and the hoots of a smaller one. They bandy back and forth and you notice you can feel the ground tremoring beneath your feet. The vibrations falter and fade and the screaming halts altogether. Just as you begin to worry, the wildman walks back into camp. He sits beside the campfire, yawns, turns over, and falls asleep. It is as though he'd never left at all.}
074817e3ac4073c1c80e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{恐惧笼罩营地，你却把%wildman%叫到身旁。荒野人哼了一声，抹过鼻子，像是你耽误了他那只有自己才懂的安排。你竭尽所能地比画，叫他去查探声音，他扬起眉毛，没等你再多示意，便低吼一声，钻进林子。

你敢说他至少走出一百米了，可那撞穿灌木的声响仍清晰可闻，仿佛全世界的噪声都被他揽去。野狗停止嚎叫，取而代之的是一声巨大的咆哮，以及另一阵较细的吼叫。声音来回交锋，你甚至感觉脚下大地在震动。震动渐弱、消散，尖叫也彻底停了。你刚开始担心，荒野人便走回营地，坐在篝火旁，打个哈欠，翻身睡了。仿佛他从未离开过。}

243deb002f1df46bed89.source: Problem good as solved, I guess.
243deb002f1df46bed89.translation: 大概也算把问题解决了。

88466b1e810cb7731d1a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{You look about the company. A young %recruit% looks back. He looks down, as though to look within himself, and then hurriedly gets to his feet.%SPEECH_ON%Say no more, captain. I will find out what this disturbance is.%SPEECH_OFF%The fresh recruit gathers his things and then stands at the edge of the camp's light, a very dark forest looking back at him. The man stares down again and clenches and unclenches his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Alright. Alright.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Let's do this.%SPEECH_OFF%The man is never seen again.}
88466b1e810cb7731d1a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你扫视战团，年轻的%recruit%回望着你。他垂下头，像是在审视自己的内心，随后匆忙起身。%SPEECH_ON%不用说了，团长。我去查清楚那是什么。%SPEECH_OFF%新兵拿齐东西，站到营火照亮的边缘，漆黑的森林仿佛也在望着他。他又低下头，双手握紧又松开。%SPEECH_ON%好。好。%SPEECH_OFF%他抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%走吧。%SPEECH_OFF%从此，再没人见过他。}

00fd954a0c8a6cae5439.source: Perhaps sending a greenhorn wasn't the best idea.

aaa9abc4222e14c25e74.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{You look about the company. A young %recruit% looks back. He looks down, as though to look within himself, and then hurriedly gets to his feet.%SPEECH_ON%Say no more, captain. I will find out what this disturbance is.%SPEECH_OFF%The fresh recruit gathers his things and then stands at the edge of the camp's light, a very dark forest looking back at him. The man stares down again and clenches and unclenches his hands. He huffs and then steps forth, immediately slipping into the shadows. Hours pass. Finally, he returns. His clothes are in tatters. His weapons are gone. He spits forth story after story. Magic rings, volcanoes, giant eagles, absolute nonsense. Whatever he saw, it's clear the blubbering sellsword needs to clear his head with some well earned beauty sleep. Which he'll get since all that awful noise has ceased.}
aaa9abc4222e14c25e74.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]{你环顾战团，年轻的%recruit%回望过来。他低下头，像在审视内心，随即匆忙站起。%SPEECH_ON%团长，不必多说。我去查清这动静究竟是怎么回事。%SPEECH_OFF%新兵收拾好东西，站在营火照亮的边缘，面前的幽暗森林仿佛也在注视着他。他再次低头，双手攥紧又松开。深吸一口气后，他迈步向前，立刻隐入阴影。几个钟头过去，他终于回来了。衣服破破烂烂，武器也没了，嘴里接连冒出各种故事：魔戒、火山、巨鹰，全是胡言乱语。不管看见了什么，这个语无伦次的佣兵显然需要好好睡上一觉，让脑子清醒清醒。他也算挣得了这番休息——那些可怕的噪声毕竟已经停了。}

aa39fc06937346d94720.source: You're a hunter, %hunter%, go take a look.

5b49a8fdcd3a65266566.source: You are a man of the wilds, %wildman%, go take a look.

ab40c80815a7a75d371b.source: Looks like a job for the new guy. Go take a look, %recruit%!

23e6533e4c9f826ff75d.source: Didn't get a good night's sleep

3dab6753a66733a3b1d3.source: Concerned that there's something big out there
3dab6753a66733a3b1d3.translation: 担心外面藏着某种庞然大物

e108cba095fde8f31e2c.translation: 经历了一场精彩的冒险

f344ef4667a68feb6bb9.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]A couple of children dash across your path, one holding up a toy shield, the other staking into it with a very real pitchfork. You grab the farm equipment and yank it away to which the child cries out that they're only having fun. The older of the two explains that they're merely excited for the coming gladiator tournament. They say that %town% is hosting a series of arena matches and the reward is something big. Very interesting. Using the pitchfork, you scoot the children off the road and then hurl the tool to the other side. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You find two boys trying to wrangle a dog into a net. The dog playfully jukes left to right, but eventually they ensnare it. The mutt, almost immediately resigned to its fate, lays down. You think they'll butcher and eat the animal, but the boys merely let it go to start the game again. When asked, they explain that some gladiators in %town% use nets in combat. But more interestingly, they also state a large series of gladiator games are going on and that apparently there's a big prize for the winner of it. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]A messenger wearing buskin boots comes down the road and throws you a scroll and breathlessly sprints by all in the span of seconds. You unfurl the paper to find an announcement: %town% is hosting a tournament of gladiator games. The winner of a series of combats will earn a prize, alongside adoration and fame, of course. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_34.png[/img]You find a man squatting beside the road. He's half-naked and, judging by the here-and-there state of his clothes, he did not undress himself. He explains that he was traveling to %town% to partake in the gladiator games, but a group of rogues robbed him. Not interested in his woes, you inquire about these games. He explains that it's a series of fights like a tournament and the winner gets a big prize. The man shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Suppose the only prize I got was getting my arse kicked. Hey, you look like you could use some help, what say I...%SPEECH_OFF%You walk off, mulling over whether or not to seek out %town% and its festive arena.}
f344ef4667a68feb6bb9.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]两个孩子从你面前冲过，一个举着玩具盾牌，另一个却拿货真价实的草叉往上刺。你抓住农具，一把夺下，孩子便喊，他们只是在玩。年长些的解释，马上要举办角斗锦标赛，他们太兴奋了。听说%town%要举行一连串竞技场对决，奖品十分丰厚。有意思。你用草叉把孩子们赶到路边，再将农具抛到另一侧。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你发现两个男孩正试着用网罩住一条狗。狗嬉闹着左右闪躲，最终还是落网，几乎立刻认命地趴下。你以为他们要宰了吃肉，可男孩们只是将狗放走，再玩一遍。问起缘由，他们解释，%town%有些角斗士就用网作战。更有意思的是，他们还说，当地正在举行一系列大型角斗比赛，赢家似乎能拿到一份厚礼。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]一名穿高筒靴的信使沿路奔来，抛给你一卷纸，气喘吁吁地飞奔而过，前后不过几秒。你展开纸卷，是一则公告：%town%正在举办角斗锦标赛。赢下一连串战斗的人，将获得奖赏，当然，还有世人的倾慕与名声。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_34.png[/img]你发现一个男人蹲在路边，半身赤裸。从衣服东一块西一块的模样看，显然不是他自己脱的。他说，本要去%town%参加角斗比赛，却被一群恶棍抢了。你对他的苦难没兴趣，只问比赛的事。他解释，类似锦标赛，要连打几场，胜者有丰厚奖品。男人摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%看来我唯一的奖品，就是挨了一顿揍。嘿，你们像是还缺帮手，不如我……%SPEECH_OFF%你已经走开，盘算着要不要去%town%，看看那热闹的竞技场。}

e496fa0b14afe39283d7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{A belly dancer magnetizes %townname%'s center plaza. Rhythmic movements on their own can coerce a beggar to donating a crown, but with the stage of the whole plaza it is enough to draw crowds and with it heaps of gold. Masked by green silk, nearly see through, and clothed in thin silks with the whole mid rift exposed, the dancer is no doubt an expert in her field. She whirls, hips hypnotic, elbows bowed, hands clapping little cymbals, her feet tiptoeing as she spins a spot so tight there very well may be an invisible god above holding her in place as she razzles and dazzles.

 Someone throws an apple through the air and the dancer spins around and shoots a tiny dagger through it, plugging it dead center and dropping the fruit to the ground. Another apple soars in and this time a large saber is produced and slashes the stem off and she catches the rest and takes a bite. The crowd claps gently to this.}
e496fa0b14afe39283d7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{一名肚皮舞者吸引了%townname%中心广场的目光。光凭那充满韵律的动作，就足以让乞丐掏出一枚克朗；如今以整座广场为舞台，自然更招来人潮与成堆的钱。舞者以近乎透明的绿纱遮面，身披薄绸，腰腹尽露，无疑是个中高手。她旋转着，腰胯摄人心魄，双肘微曲，指间小钹轻响，踮起脚尖在极小的一点上打转，仿佛有看不见的神明悬在上方，将她稳稳牵住，任她炫出满场光彩。

有人抛来一只苹果，舞者转身掷出小匕首，正中果心，将它钉落地面。又一只苹果飞来，这回她抽出大弯刀，削掉果梗，接住余下的果子，咬了一口。人群为这手绝活轻轻鼓掌。}

cf1bb79bb390660556ba.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You take out a crown and flip it to the dancer. Her eyes catch its glint, but she doesn't break the dance. She drops her weapons and sashays over, cymbals clattering, hips gyrating, her knees hardly bending, her feet almost mystically carrying her across the ground. She gets near. The face is narrow, but the jaw broad. Her temples deep. She grins. It's a man. She's a man. He claps the cymbals in your face, then swings around, briefly gracing your groin with his ass, and starts to dance back to the middle. He picks up your coin with a toe and flips it up and it lands in a clay pot. The crowd cheers.}
cf1bb79bb390660556ba.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你掏出一枚克朗，弹向舞者。她的目光捕捉到钱币的闪光，舞步却丝毫没乱。她放下武器，摇曳着走近，指镲叮当，腰胯旋转，膝盖几乎不弯，双脚却如施了魔法般掠过地面。近了。那张脸狭长，下颌却宽，太阳穴深陷。她咧嘴一笑。是个男人。原来她是个男人。他在你面前敲响指镲，随即转身，臀部在你胯前轻擦而过，又舞回场中。他用脚趾夹起你的钱币，向上一抛，正落入陶罐。人群欢呼起来。}

6de532c7a0422b204db1.source: Maybe we can make use of this man?

c37742ed9d5b564963af.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{After the mannish belly dancer takes your crown you wait around for the show to end. You approach as he picks up his things. He looks at you with a wry smile.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, an admirer. Sorry, only one show tonight, good stranger.%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head and ask if he knows anything about fighting. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course I do. The Gilded One's gleam is upon us all, but not at all hours or days. Sometimes we must find our own way through the dark. I take it by your dress that you are a Crownling, putting that blade of yours where it does and sometimes does not belong.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and ask him if he'd be interested in joining. He goes bowlegged and sinks to the ground like a collapsing truss. He counts his crowns.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not sure if you have a good eye for the wandering nature of men such as myself. Perhaps you saw a vocational tiredness not even I was aware of until this present moment. That said, you'll have to try harder to get me to go around killing for coin.%SPEECH_OFF%}
c37742ed9d5b564963af.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{那位带着男儿气的肚皮舞者收下你的克朗后，你留到演出结束。趁他收拾东西，你走上前。他意味深长地笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%啊，一位仰慕者。抱歉，好心的陌生人，今晚只演一场。%SPEECH_OFF%你摇头，问他懂不懂打仗。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然。镀金者的光辉照耀我们所有人，却不会时时刻刻如此。有时候，黑暗里的路得靠自己找。看您的装束，是个克朗客吧，手里的刀往该去的地方捅，偶尔也捅进不该去的地方。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，问他有没有兴趣加入。他分开双腿，像塌下的支架般蹲坐在地，数起克朗。%SPEECH_ON%不知您是不是一眼就看出了，我这种人骨子里的漂泊性子。或许，您察觉了连我自己直到此刻都没意识到的倦意。不过，要让我改行拿钱杀人，您还得多下点功夫。%SPEECH_OFF%}

bd6ca5df2b8325aced6e.source: You've talent with the blade like I've never seen before.
bd6ca5df2b8325aced6e.translation: 这样的刀上天赋，我从未见过。

40d85532cd751e1e8332.source: I'll pay you 500 crowns right now if you join us.
40d85532cd751e1e8332.translation: 加入我们，我立刻付你500克朗。

2688b6c9f0853f865718.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You assuage his ego by saying he's one of the best with the blade you've seen. The dancer turns his hands to the dust, his fingers sliding beneath each coin and flipping it into his clay pot. His left hand reaches across the ground, but as this catches your eye, his right hand snatches a blade that had been entirely buried beneath the sands. He holds it toward your crotch.%SPEECH_ON%I'm deadly with the blade, as I'm sure you are with that stinger there. Now, I know you are merely petting things which shall make me purr, preying upon my pride as the hunter does the lions, and I will say this: it has worked. I will fight for you, captain of the Crownlings, and I will fight well.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you ask that he lower the blade. He spins it in his hand and sheathes it in one swift motion. He gets to his feet, stripping himself down until he is buck naked.%SPEECH_ON%This life I will leave behind in total, and to the Crownling's life I will be devoted in whole.%SPEECH_OFF%You shake the man's hand. A passerby glances over and scratches his head.%SPEECH_ON%Wait a minute, you've a snake down there! I thought you were a lady of the dance, but this...%SPEECH_OFF%He dabs his forehead with a cloth and lowers his voice.%SPEECH_ON%This makes it even better.%SPEECH_OFF%The dancer looks at you and laughs.%SPEECH_ON%We've all dangers to confront in our respective vocations, Crownling, and I look forward to seeing yours.%SPEECH_OFF%}
2688b6c9f0853f865718.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你顺着他的自尊心，说他是自己见过最出色的刀手之一。舞者将双手伸向尘土，指尖滑到钱币下面，将它们一枚枚弹进陶罐。左手横扫地面，吸引了你的目光，右手却趁机抓起一把完全埋在沙里的刀，指向你的裤裆。%SPEECH_ON%我用刀可是会要命的，想必你那根刺也不差。我知道，你是在顺毛摸，想让我舒服得呼噜起来，像猎人拿捏狮子一样拿捏我的傲气。不过我得说，这招管用了。克朗客的团长，我会为你战斗，而且会打得很漂亮。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，请他把刀放下。他将刀在手中一转，一气呵成地收进鞘，随后站起身，把衣物脱了个精光。%SPEECH_ON%旧日的生活，我要彻底抛下；克朗客的生涯，我将全心投入。%SPEECH_OFF%你与他握手。一个路人望过来，挠了挠脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%等等，你下面竟有条蛇！我还以为你是位舞娘，可这……%SPEECH_OFF%他用布擦擦额头，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%这可就更妙了。%SPEECH_OFF%舞者看着你，笑了起来。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，各行各业都有各自的危险。我很期待，看看你们面对的是哪一种。%SPEECH_OFF%}

9e5f3ebe607e4d724240.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You tell the dancer that he is one of the best you've seen with a blade. He laughs.%SPEECH_ON%A truly well intentioned attempt on your part, Crownling, to drag me to your ways of life. But you know well that there is nothing you could say or do that would take me away from this life. Yes, the blade suits me well, but so does flittering about for the crowd, earning praise without spilling blood to do it. You go play gladiator on the sands and earn you coin, Crownling, and I will be here earning mine.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9e5f3ebe607e4d724240.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你告诉舞者，他的刀法是你见过最好的几种之一。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，你想把我拉进你们那种生活，倒真是用心良苦。可你也明白，无论说什么、做什么，都不能让我舍弃现在的日子。不错，我用刀很顺手，可我也喜欢在人群前舞动，不流一滴血就能赢来喝彩。你去沙场里扮角斗士，挣你的钱吧，克朗客，我在这里挣我的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

920422c77bb09d30ea1e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You offer five hundred crowns to the dancer. He keeps picking up coins - one at a time - and putting them in his clay pot. It is almost a silent affair, coins clapping loudly as they fall into a nearly empty barrel of clay. He looks up, looks down. He puts in one more crown then gets to his feet. He strips off his clothes and holds out his hand.%SPEECH_ON%The Gilded One must be gleaming upon us both, for you to have earned such keep, and no doubt He has guided your purse here to bring it to me.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and shake his hand. A passerby glances over and scratches his head.%SPEECH_ON%Wait a minute, you've a snake down there! I thought you were a lady of the dance, but this...%SPEECH_OFF%He dabs his forehead and lowers his voice.%SPEECH_ON%This makes it even better.%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, the dancer asks that he take a look at your inventory.%SPEECH_ON%A body like mine, anything will fit, inside or out, I'll make it work.%SPEECH_OFF%}
920422c77bb09d30ea1e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你向舞者开价五百克朗。他仍一枚一枚捡起钱，放进陶罐，几乎一句不说，唯有钱币落入近乎空荡的罐中，发出响亮碰撞。他抬头，又低头，再投进一枚克朗，终于站起身，脱下舞衣，向你伸出手。%SPEECH_ON%镀金者必定同时照耀着你我，才让您挣得这么多钱，也必定是祂将您的钱袋引到这里，交到我手中。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，与他握手。一个路人瞥过来，挠着脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%等等，你下面有条蛇！我还以为是位跳舞的姑娘，没想到……%SPEECH_OFF%他擦了擦额头，压低嗓门。%SPEECH_ON%这下更妙了。%SPEECH_OFF%舞者叹口气，说想看看你的储备。%SPEECH_ON%我这身段，什么都合适，往里装也好，往外套也好，总能有办法。%SPEECH_OFF%}

b92b1b4a11b1d92353fc.source: , masked by green silk and drawing crowds with rhythmic movements and impressively precise fruit slicing. The latter skill is a boon to any mercenary company, and so you didn't hesitate to recruit him.
b92b1b4a11b1d92353fc.translation: ，他蒙着绿色丝巾，凭节奏明快的舞姿和精准得惊人的切水果刀法吸引人群。后一项本领对任何佣兵团都大有用处，你便毫不犹豫地招募了他。

4334528e4ecaef8d6e5b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_177.png[/img]{You come across a man in military garb with a pair of similarly dressed guards. Between them is a man with his arms and legs tied akimbo to a giant mortar, his torso facing into the barrel, his head resting atop its sights. He looks up at you with a side eye.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, traveler. I'm in quite the predicament. You see, these fine, muted gentlemen wish to splash me across the sands using the greatest technical marvel of our age. Whilst I can see the benefit of avoiding the executioner's rusted sword, I must confess that to have my final moment be one of watching my own body parts bomb the desert creatures to be one of severe embarrassment. A fair penalty for some crimes, no doubt, but I am a mere thief.%SPEECH_OFF%The military executioner glances at you, but just as the thief said, he appears to be a mute. Or possibly deaf, as his role as mortarman might imply on its own.}
4334528e4ecaef8d6e5b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_177.png[/img]{你遇见一个身穿军服的男人，身边还有两名同样装束的守卫。三人之间，一名男子四肢大张，被捆在巨型臼炮上，躯干正对炮口，脑袋搁在瞄准具上。他斜眼抬头看向你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，旅人，我眼下可真有点麻烦。您看，这几位沉默寡言的好先生，打算用当世最了不起的造物，把我喷得满沙漠都是。省得挨刽子手的锈剑，当然也算好处。可我得承认，临死前还要看自己的身体零件轰炸沙漠里的小动物，实在丢脸得很。某些罪行，受这惩罚自然公道，可我不过是个贼。%SPEECH_OFF%行刑的军人瞥了你一眼，却正如盗贼所言，似乎是个哑巴。也可能只是聋了，毕竟他干的是炮手这行。}

2766020c65a5998c365a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_177.png[/img]{The executioner surprisingly answers, plugging one ear with a finger as he talks.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, this does not concern you. Move along.%SPEECH_OFF%The thief tries to turn his head again.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, ah! He speaks! Wonderful. Let us hash this out like good gentlemen with sensibilities kind to but also ahead of our current era.%SPEECH_OFF%The executioner ignores the thief's articulate pleas.%SPEECH_ON%I shall make a deal for your neutrality, Crownling. When this thief is splashed across the desert, you may have whatever is inside of him for, you see, it is said that he carries a heart of gold.%SPEECH_OFF%The thief nervously speaks.%SPEECH_ON%That means something else where I'm from.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask the executioner to explain. He states that the Gilder 'touches' those who oppose Him, condemning and dooming the hated with insides made of gold. The condemnation is a level beyond being merely indebted. It sounds rather fantastical, even for you.}
2766020c65a5998c365a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_177.png[/img]{出乎意料，刽子手竟然回了话，说话时还用一根手指堵着耳朵。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，这与你无关。走你的路。%SPEECH_OFF%那贼又想转过头来。%SPEECH_ON%啊，啊！他开口了！太好了。咱们好好商量，就当是几个明事理的绅士，既通晓世情，又有超越当世的见识。%SPEECH_OFF%刽子手对小偷这番伶牙俐齿的求饶充耳不闻。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，我可以给你点好处，换你袖手旁观。等这贼炸得满沙漠都是，他肚子里的东西就归你了。要知道，据说他有一颗金子般的心。%SPEECH_OFF%小偷紧张地插嘴。%SPEECH_ON%这话在我家乡可不是这个意思。%SPEECH_OFF%你请刽子手解释一下。他说，镀金者会“点化”那些胆敢忤逆祂的人，把这些遭祂憎恨之人的内脏变成黄金，使其蒙受诅咒、万劫不复。这种惩罚比沦为负债者还要严厉。即便是你，也觉得这说法未免太离奇了。}

423e7d6ba82279f47e28.source: Carry on with the execution then.

72199da92c7725f85864.source: You need to stop this execution.

df47f910f5ef12361081.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_177.png[/img]{You're interested to see if what the executioner says is true and stand aside. The thief sighs.%SPEECH_ON%Well. Alright then. Just make sure that when they write about me, that this execution isn't canon. That's 'canon' spelled with one-%SPEECH_OFF%The explosion disintegrates the man and the pulverizing force shunts a wave of sand clear of the mortar itself, expelling a cloud of dust and gore, swirling through the air like some storm of viscera, and a few moments later the body parts begin to pitter-patter about the ground. None of these bits and pieces are golden. In fact, most are charred black or vibrantly red, freshly bared to the world to see. The executioner wipes the gunpowder from his face.%SPEECH_ON%It appears we were wrong. The thief shall be compensated by the Gilder Himself, oh to be that lucky.%SPEECH_OFF%}
df47f910f5ef12361081.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_177.png[/img]{你想看看行刑官的话是否属实，便退到一旁。盗贼叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，那就这样。只求写我的故事时，别把这场炮刑算进正典。是典籍的“典”，不是点炮的——%SPEECH_OFF%爆炸瞬间将他粉碎，强劲冲击从臼炮四周掀起一圈沙浪，将尘土与血肉喷向半空，旋转成一场内脏风暴。片刻后，残肢碎块开始噼啪落地。没有一块是金色的。大多数不是焦黑，就是鲜红，才刚暴露在世人眼前。行刑官抹掉脸上的火药灰。%SPEECH_ON%看来我们错了。镀金者会亲自补偿这个贼。唉，真是走运。%SPEECH_OFF%}

0c134c6ad7e398bea2f1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_177.png[/img]{You inform the guards and executioner that you'll be stopping the execution. They immediately stand back from the mortar. The executioner plugs his ear again.%SPEECH_ON%A stay of execution? Or did you say to start it?%SPEECH_OFF%The thief nervously laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, Crownling, please clear that up for our friend here.%SPEECH_OFF%The matter is settled slowly and for all to hear. Surprisingly, the guards agree. They see you not as a random intervention, but as one sent from the Gilder Himself, for why else would you be there? The thief is cut free from the device and he is handed over to the company. He holds his hand out.%SPEECH_ON%All funny business aside, I'll fight for you, uh, hmmm... the %companyname%. Quaint. But I'm no ordinary thief, I'm a man of pride, and a man with a sense of duty, and a man with a sense of crowns!%SPEECH_OFF%}
0c134c6ad7e398bea2f1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_177.png[/img]{你告诉守卫和行刑官，要阻止这次处决。他们立即退离臼炮，行刑官又把手指塞进耳朵。%SPEECH_ON%缓刑？还是开刑？%SPEECH_OFF%盗贼紧张地笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%对，克朗客，劳驾给这位朋友说清楚。%SPEECH_OFF%你放慢语速，把意思说得人人都听明白。出乎意料，守卫们同意了。他们认为，你并非偶然插手，而是镀金者亲自派来的，否则怎会恰好出现在这里？盗贼被割断绳索，从炮口解救下来，交给战团。他伸出手。%SPEECH_ON%不闹了，我愿为你们效力。呃，唔……%companyname%。名字挺别致。不过，我可不是普通毛贼。我有尊严，有责任心，当然，也懂得克朗的分量！%SPEECH_OFF%}

c186c0ea89c71a2e1375.source: Welcome to the company, I suppose.

b18d47b0f2603edc2874.source: We saved your life. That doesn't mean you're welcome with us.
b18d47b0f2603edc2874.translation: 救了你的命，不等于要收留你。

bb468f78c4181f8a5a76.source: Only by your timely intervention was %name% saved from execution by being shot at with a giant mortar. An eccentric thief, his latest failed attempt to burglarize a Vizier's palace was deemed a good reason to set a very clear deterrent for anyone else harboring similar plans.
bb468f78c4181f8a5a76.translation: 多亏你及时出手，%name%才免于被一门巨型臼炮轰死。这个古怪的盗贼最近一次潜入维齐尔宫殿行窃，却失了手；对方正好借此立威，狠狠震慑其他打着相同主意的人。

54f20a040fdf7e4b934b.source: Almost got executed by a technological marvel in spectacular fashion
54f20a040fdf7e4b934b.translation: 险些被一件奇巧兵器轰轰烈烈地处决

ea91bbba71cef99da4f3.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{In the middle of the desert wastes one has to be somewhat suspicious of anything they come across, especially if it's a lone man on a cross. The crucified figure looks entirely dead, given the buzzards clerically perched on each shoulder, but as you draw near the birds take flight and the man lifts is head. Despite gruesome injuries to hands and feet, he's rather lively and asks for water. Instead of giving it to him, you ask why he's here. The man sighs.%SPEECH_ON%I was a crusader. Came in with the army looking to gain glory for the old gods. Except when I got down here, and got to talking with the locals and the priests, I had a change of heart.%SPEECH_OFF%}
ea91bbba71cef99da4f3.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{在荒凉的沙漠里，遇见什么都得留几分疑心，尤其是孤零零挂在十字架上的人。两只秃鹫如主持仪式般各栖一肩，怎么看，这人都已死透。可你走近时，鸟飞了，他也抬起了头。手脚虽然伤得可怕，人却还颇有精神，开口便讨水。你没有立刻给他，而是问他为何落到这里。那人叹道：%SPEECH_ON%我曾是圣战士，随大军南下，要为旧神争取荣耀。可到了这里，跟当地人和祭司聊过之后，我改了主意。%SPEECH_OFF%}

875fe342e10d5ac2f6d7.source: The other crusaders did this to you?
875fe342e10d5ac2f6d7.translation: 是其他圣战士把你害成这样的？

94828cec641bc33b6063.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, that they did. Mind, I was there when they crucified someone else on account of the same reason. So in part I'm not the brightest fella to follow in his footsteps, nor am I clean of heart, for I cheered it on when they did it to him. But perhaps the Gilder will see the true light I carry within, you know?%SPEECH_OFF%He turns his head to the skies, and to the buzzards cycling above.%SPEECH_ON%I'm still one open to fight, no matter who it is, south, north, doesn't matter. I've the Gilder in my heart.%SPEECH_OFF%}
94828cec641bc33b6063.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{那人点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，他们是这么干的。说来惭愧，之前他们因为同样的缘由把另一个人钉起来时，我也在场。明知如此还步那人的后尘，说明我确实不聪明；当时我还叫过好，也谈不上心地纯净。不过，也许镀金者能看见我内心真正的光，你明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他仰头望向天空，以及盘旋的秃鹫。%SPEECH_ON%我还愿意打仗，不管敌人是谁，南方人也好，北方人也罢，都无所谓。镀金者在我心中。%SPEECH_OFF%}

1dfb4c48d6e253f36bea.source: Only thing you've in your heart are these buzzards.
1dfb4c48d6e253f36bea.translation: 如今能钻进你心窝的，也只有这些秃鹫。

fd6ba356493185dddfff.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{You draw out your dagger and cut the man down. He's got injuries aplenty but is no doubt of strong enough constitution to one day recover. He thanks you with remarkable mildness given the doom which awaited him.%SPEECH_ON%Glad to stretch. I mean, you know, stretch on my terms. Lead the way, captain of the Gilder's circumstance, captain of His mighty sublimity.%SPEECH_OFF%Many in the company do not care for taking in a man who has turned his back not only on his fellow man, but his own gods.}
fd6ba356493185dddfff.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{你拔出匕首，将他放下来。他遍体鳞伤，不过体魄足够结实，终有恢复的一天。想到他刚才还命悬一线，道谢的语气却平和得出奇。%SPEECH_ON%总算能伸展筋骨了。我是说，按自己的意思伸展。请带路吧，蒙镀金者安排而来的团长，承他无上威仪的团长。%SPEECH_OFF%战团里不少人不愿收留他：这个人不仅背弃了同胞，还背弃了自己的神。}

8c8405f0a62168b419fe.source: Ah, he'll fit in with the rest of the misfits.
8c8405f0a62168b419fe.translation: 他跟咱们这群怪人，倒正好合得来。

39bcca7e6b8978a1524e.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{You tell the man he'll be talking to his god or gods real soon. He sighs.%SPEECH_ON%In a manner, I deserve this, but I am at peace with it.%SPEECH_OFF%There's mixed reactions about the company on it, and by mixed it is mostly varying levels of exuberance. After all, the man is a traitor to both terra and celestial, making him easily hated by anyone and everyone.}
39bcca7e6b8978a1524e.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{你告诉他，很快就能跟他的神——无论一个还是几个——说上话了。他叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%某种意义上，这是我应得的。不过我已坦然接受。%SPEECH_OFF%战团对此反应各异，所谓各异，主要不过是高兴的程度不同。毕竟，这人既背叛凡世，也背叛诸神，任谁都容易讨厌他。}

ea73130985e884e1831e.source: You found %name%, a former crusader from the north, crucified in the middle of the desert after turning his back to the old gods. After cutting him down, he pledged his services to you. Despite his attempts to conceal it, he doesn't seem to be in the most stable mental condition.
ea73130985e884e1831e.translation: 你在沙漠中央发现了被钉在十字架上的%name%。这位北方十字军战士因背弃旧神落得如此下场。你将他救下后，他便宣誓为你效力。虽极力掩饰，他的神志似乎仍不太正常。

11e2cce25ea101390676.source: Saw the light and accepted the sublimity of the Gilder
11e2cce25ea101390676.translation: 见到神光，信服了镀金者的伟大

8a0604aa7d0f0c134768.source: Disliked that you prevented rightful punishment for betraying the old gods
8a0604aa7d0f0c134768.translation: 因你阻止惩罚背弃旧神之人而不满

a8dde02acdfe8e8b3656.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_95.png[/img]The homestead is a smoldering ruin and its occupants have all been beheaded save one. An unlucky figure has instead been prostrated and spread-eagled on the ground and has been set afire from what looks like the belly out: his chest is a cratered, ashen ruin, and his limbs blackened and charred, yet still skeletal in their remains. His face is untouched, perhaps by design, and by the look of him he did not die in a manner you'd find suitable to anyone, not even your own enemies. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]You find some southern soldiers hanging from a tree, their eyes long since plucked by crows and their feet by fortune hunters. They twist listlessly in the wind and none of the locals seem in a hurry to cut them down. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]A wagon train is splattered to both sides of a path, the wood and material littering the fields beside them. Everything of value has been taken, and the merchant slain to the last. The wounds indicate southern intents, yet the mortal carvings don't quite seem as clean as you're used to seeing. This could very well be the work of thieves using the holy war as cover. Either way, there's nothing of value left and you have the men continue on. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]You find a battlefield, though your arrival is far too late to make any dramatic appearance: the dead are all over the place, southern and northern, and the sutlers and scavengers and scapegraces have already looted the entirety of the aftermath. Judging the frail appearances of a big heap of southerners piled in one spot, and fast footed retreat from it, you've little doubt the Gilded threw forward their indebted souls to spare the rest of the troop.}
a8dde02acdfe8e8b3656.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_95.png[/img]农庄烧成了余火未熄的废墟，住户除一人外，全被砍掉脑袋。那个更不幸的人四肢摊开，趴伏在地，身上的火仿佛是从腹中向外烧起的：胸口只剩凹陷的灰烬，四肢焦黑，依稀保留着骨架的形状。脸却完好无损，或许是刻意留下的。从表情看来，这样的死法，你连自己的敌人都不愿施加。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img]几个南方士兵吊在树上，眼睛早被乌鸦啄走，脚也被搜财者削去。他们随风无力地转动，当地人似乎一点也不急着把尸体放下。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]一列货车毁在道路两旁，木料和杂物散满田野。值钱的东西全被拿走，商人无一幸免。伤口看似出自南方人的手笔，却没有你惯见的那般利落。也可能是盗贼借圣战之名趁火打劫。不管怎样，已没什么值得拿的，你让弟兄们继续前进。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]你来到一处战场，可惜到得太晚，已无从上演什么关键登场：南方人与北方人的尸体遍地都是，随军商贩、拾荒者和无赖早已把战场搜刮一空。有一处堆着大批南方人的尸体，身形瘦弱，旁边留着匆忙撤退的足迹。你几乎可以断定，镀金之民把负债者推到前头，保全了其他部队。}

1d2c39de3e17a2bc79a3.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]A wagon is stopped on the side of the road. You find a man looking at a wide variety of wares. He turns to your and speaks.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, a sellsword. I imagine you're apart of the holy war, huh? Well, I hope you do right by your gods. I know coin's important, but there's more to life, and more after, understand?%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You find a few children playfighting each other, some dressed up in loose clothing like you'd find in the southern deserts. The latter bunch fall easy to the preying swords of the more northern dressage.%SPEECH_ON%Ah-ha! The Gilded fall, and may the old gods take the glory we've to give!%SPEECH_OFF%The kids calm down and then reset to positions. This time, they change guard, each exchanging clothes until the 'bad guys' become 'good guys' and then the play resumes. The holy war of the future will not be on short supply of faithful fighters, that's certain. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]You come across a monk reading a scroll. He states that the old gods have willed the north to victory, and that glory shall be shared in terraria and more. You ask what happens if the north loses. It is a brazen question, certainly, yet he takes it on the chin with a smile.%SPEECH_ON%Do not fool yourself, sellsword, in thinking that our holy war today is all that there will be. These wars will continue until an obvious end, and it will be at that end where we shall find most glory. I pray I live to see it, but my father and his father prayed the same, and alas I believe it will be my son who shall see the holy war brought to their righteous end.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1d2c39de3e17a2bc79a3.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]路旁停着一辆货车，一个男人正在查看琳琅满目的货物。他转向你说道：%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵。想必你也投身圣战了吧？愿你别辜负自己的神。我知道钱重要，可人生不止钱，死后更是如此，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]几个孩子在玩打仗，其中一伙穿着南方沙漠常见的宽松衣裳。他们很快便倒在身着北方服饰的孩子们挥来的剑下。%SPEECH_ON%啊哈！镀金之民倒下了，愿旧神收下我们奉献的荣耀！%SPEECH_OFF%孩子们安静下来，重新站位。这回换了阵营，彼此交换衣服，直到‘坏人’变成‘好人’，游戏才再度开始。可以肯定，未来的圣战绝不缺虔诚的战士。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]你遇见一名研读卷轴的修士。他说，旧神已注定北方得胜，这份荣耀将为现世乃至来世共享。你问，若北方输了会怎样。这问题无疑大胆，可他笑着接了下来。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，别以为如今这场圣战，就是全部。这样的战争会一直延续，直到迎来注定的结局；到了那一日，我们将见证最伟大的荣耀。我祈求有生之年能看到，可我父亲和他的父亲，也都这么祈求过。唉，我想该是我的儿子，才能亲眼看见圣战迎来正义的终结。%SPEECH_OFF%}

15ca07fdffbfaba2a1cf.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]You find the disassembled remains of a battlefield: a litter of unusables with corpses so shriveled it's hard to discern to which side they belonged. The scraphunters no doubt took anything of use. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]A smoldering wagon with its owner left beside it, headless, and the rest of his body plucked to the bone. Given the war going on, it's hard to say who exactly is responsible for it. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]You find the defaced remains of an old gods banner, staked into the sands with a headless corpse strung up on the pole. No doubt a northerner, the body is practically bubbling in appearance as sand lizards snake to and fro, trying to get the last of the good morsels. There's a smattering of more bodies across the sands, most crawling with beetles or being tugged at by snakes and other vulturous creatures. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_167.png[/img]You find a dead northern man propped up in the sands, his arms and legs bound to a wooden chair. In front of him is a large pole with a catch frame and ropes which hang limp from its corners. It seems it once held something large and rotund. The man's head has a hole bored through it, and the wound is unlike any you've ever seen: it's almost as if they drilled through it with heat alone. Perhaps the Gilded used the reflection of a great medallion to intensify the sun? It's hard to say. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_167.png[/img]You find a row of corpses in the sand, and upon closer inspection find they're all southern women and what looks like a man who could possibly be on a Vizier's council. All their heads have been removed and placed upon their backs, the eyes facing their buttocks. You're not sure what any of this means, but no doubt it is the result of internal quarrels within the Vizier's own ranks. There's nothing of value to take so you have the men move on.}
15ca07fdffbfaba2a1cf.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]你发现一处被拆掠殆尽的战场，只剩一地废物和干瘪得难辨阵营的尸体。搜刮者无疑把一切有用的东西都带走了。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]一辆货车仍在冒烟，主人倒在旁边，脑袋已被砍掉，身体也被啄得只剩白骨。战争仍在进行，很难说究竟是谁下的手。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]一面旧神的旗帜遭到毁污，插在沙里，旗杆上挂着一具无头尸体，想必是个北方人。沙蜥钻来钻去，争抢最后的血肉，使尸身表面看着仿佛不断鼓泡。沙地上还散着更多尸体，大多爬满甲虫，或被蛇与其他食腐动物拉扯。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_167.png[/img]一个死去的北方人被立在沙中，四肢绑在木椅上。前方竖着高杆，杆上装有支架，四角绳索松垂，似乎曾托着某件硕大的圆形物体。死者头上穿了个洞，伤口与你见过的全不一样，仿佛单凭热力就钻透了颅骨。莫非镀金之民用一面巨大的圆形饰牌反射阳光，聚成了这样的高热？很难说。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_167.png[/img]沙里排列着一行尸体。走近一看，全是南方女人，另有一个男人，衣着像是维齐尔议事会中的人物。所有脑袋都被割下，放在各自身背上，双眼朝着臀部。你不清楚这是什么意思，但无疑是维齐尔内部争斗的结果。没什么值钱的东西，你便让弟兄们继续走。}

f8b6114bc5d932471450.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]Children peep their heads over a sand dune, just missing another group of children hiding in the shade of a defilade. When the first troop come over the top, the ambushing kids jump out and stab them with sticks and slay them down.%SPEECH_ON%Death to the northerners, may the Gilder's gaze shine upon us!%SPEECH_OFF%The slain kids slide down the dune, limp and lifeless, before jolting back to their feet and arguing that it is their turn to play the 'good guys.' It seems the holy war has already invigorated the next generation to be ready when their time comes. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_166.png[/img]Rows and rows of the faithful bend to the sands to give their prayers to the Gilder. All manner of men and women and children alike, and dissimilar, being that there were wealthy merchants beside impoverished beggars. The only real standouts are the Vizier and the councilmen, who all pray beside the priests at the head of the procession. That is if these men are praying at all: as far as you can tell, the council is whispering amongst themselves, some not paying the slightest bit of attention to the ceremony.}
f8b6114bc5d932471450.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]几个孩子从沙丘后探出脑袋，没发现另一伙正藏在凹地的阴影里。等前一伙翻过坡顶，埋伏的孩子猛地跳出，用木棍乱戳，将他们‘杀倒’。%SPEECH_ON%北方人去死！愿镀金者的目光照耀我们！%SPEECH_OFF%‘战死’的孩子们软绵绵地滑下沙丘，忽然又跳起来，争吵着说该轮到自己演‘好人’了。看来，圣战已激起下一代的热情，只待他们上场的时候到来。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_166.png[/img]一排又一排信徒俯身于沙地，向镀金者祈祷。男人、女人、孩子，都聚在这里，彼此相似，又各不相同，富商与穷乞丐也并肩而跪。真正与众不同的，只有维齐尔和议事会成员，他们在队伍最前端，挨着祭司祷告——如果他们真在祷告的话。至少依你看，议事会的人正彼此低声交谈，有些压根没把心思放在仪式上。}

6b21385b602612d4f9da.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{You come across a homestead and think to pass it but all of a sudden the door swings open and a man falls out, legs scissoring across the porch until he falls flat in the front yard. Drawing your sword, you investigate him. Turning him over reveals a green and purple face, a mouth caked with vomit and dried blood, and hair falling out of his head. You leave the body and enter the homestead where you find more men like him. They're all southerners and seem to have come down with some northern illness that they are perhaps uninitiated to. Judging by the slovenly state of their equipment, they've been holed up here for quite some time.

 One of the southerners reaches out to you with a decrepit hand.%SPEECH_ON%Please, send us to the Gilder. The light of this world is no more.%SPEECH_OFF%}
6b21385b602612d4f9da.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{你经过一座农舍，本想就此走过，门却突然打开，一个男人跌了出来，双腿在门廊上胡乱蹬划，最后扑倒在前院。你拔剑上前查看，将他翻过身，露出一张青紫的脸，嘴边糊着呕吐物和干血，头发正成片脱落。你留下尸体走进农舍，发现里面还有更多同样的人。他们全是南方人，似乎染上了某种从未接触过的北方疫病。从装备的脏乱程度看，已在这里躲了很久。

其中一人向你伸出枯槁的手。%SPEECH_ON%求求你，送我们去见镀金者吧。这世上的光，已经没有了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

2303b56466fffed8644f.source: Let us end them with dignity
2303b56466fffed8644f.translation: 给他们一个体面的了结。

13e244eb98dd96895251.source: May the flies feast upon your decrepit flesh.
13e244eb98dd96895251.translation: 让苍蝇去享用你们腐败的血肉吧。

cad4a5ebc16dbd61c9b2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{The southerners are killed with dignity, or at least as much dignity a sword can afford. Of course, you kill them at length, not daring to lay a hand on their diseased bodies. After each is laid to rest, you take a look around the homestead. To your luck, and probably because the material was rubbing their skins raw, the sickly had lain some equipment off to the side. You have the brothers scrub it clean and take it with you onto the road. While leaving, there's some grousing about how maybe these men deserved worse, but others are quite fine with the mercy killings.}
cad4a5ebc16dbd61c9b2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{南方人得以体面地死去，至少，剑刃能给的体面也就这么多了。当然，你隔着距离下手，不敢碰他们染病的身体。等所有人都安息，你打量了一遍农舍。运气不错，或许因为装备磨得皮肤生疼，病人们已把其中一些脱下来放到旁边。你让弟兄们擦洗干净，带着上路。离开时，有人嘀咕，说这些人也许活该受更重的罪；另一些人却很赞同给他们这份解脱。}

8edd5c515545d70d3de8.source: Better they don't suffer any longer.

5d185d4bee252c0d1c5a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{Some of the southerners' gear has been taken off and placed about the room. You have the sellswords take these and scrub them clean. Going to the front door, you light a torch and tell them the Gilder shall be seeing them in his true self real soon. The soldiers beg for mercy, a writhing mass of silhouettes crawling toward you, groaning in weakness and fear. You close the door and set the rooftop alight before pitching the torch through a window.

You've taught your men well to not take it personal on these sorts of decisions, but you suspect some in the %companyname% might not care for this one.}
5d185d4bee252c0d1c5a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]{南方人脱下了一些装备，散放在屋里。你让佣兵们收走，仔细擦洗干净。来到门口，你点起火把，告诉他们，很快便能见到镀金者的真容。士兵们哀求宽恕，虚弱又恐惧地呻吟着，扭动的身影挤作一团，朝你爬来。你关上门，点燃屋顶，再把火把从窗户扔了进去。

你早已教会手下，遇到这种决定，不该让私人情感掺和进来。可你怀疑，%companyname%里还是有人不会喜欢这一次。}

6ed1f24ee982d28a08e2.source: They have no place invading the north.
6ed1f24ee982d28a08e2.translation: 他们本就不该入侵北方。

e82754750a64e39ddcd4.source: Approved of your decision to end the suffering of fellow Gilded
e82754750a64e39ddcd4.translation: 赞同你结束镀金之民同胞的痛苦

4b772e452e0c8b01796a.source: Disliked that you ended the suffering of southern invaders
4b772e452e0c8b01796a.translation: 不满你结束南方入侵者的痛苦

0a1f416b1df7d26f9546.source: Disliked that you left fellow Gilded to suffer a slow death
0a1f416b1df7d26f9546.translation: 不满你让镀金之民同胞在痛苦中慢慢死去

b97fb99d6570b4b4529e.source: Approved of your decision to leave southern invaders to die
b97fb99d6570b4b4529e.translation: 赞同你任由南方入侵者等死

aef9a50d278796bce968.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%Alright, alright, sort yerself, sort yerself.%SPEECH_OFF%You come to a peasant holding court with, unsurprisingly, more peasants.%SPEECH_ON%Now I just got told that these Gilded farks in the south think their 'maker' has something in store for the old gods.%SPEECH_OFF%A voice from the crowd asks what that could be. The speaker shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Dunno. Now, I think we can all agree that the old gods settled their wars many years ago, and there's no need for violence. But the Gilder, he ain't no old god. That there is a heresy.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd cheers. You're beginning to wonder if this man is a cleric in commoner's clothing. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%Gather up yer weapons, yer armor, yer gold, and most importantly, yer faith, we're going to put some shadow on that 'Gilder'! The old gods will it!%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd roars this time, so deafening that your ears crackle. It is good to see such energy. Once the fighting starts, there will be plenty of business as the righteous shall certainly find faith in the %companyname%. | A bearded cleric stands before a crowd of peasants.%SPEECH_ON%It is said that the old gods fought their wars to completion many years ago, that they tore this world asunder, and left us in the devastation, and they have been impressed by our ability to persevere against such great struggle.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd murmurs. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%But we are challenged yet, ye faithful! To the south wander heretics, followers of the 'Gilder', a false god of opulence, profligacy, and a lowly prestidigitation they pass for righteousness.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd doesn't know what any of those words mean, but they raise their pitchforks to the air and roar, beckoning the clerics to tell them where to go. Smiling, the elders turn to one another and nod. You have little care for who or what is starting this crusade between north and south, only that the %companyname% will stand to earn a fair bit of coin in the gross matter. | The arsenal assembled before you is unlike any you've ever seen. Armaments piled higher than three men head to feet. Soldiers are lined up, half of them holding religious banners, each adorned with one of the old gods. Clerics and monks walk the lines, speaking to the matter in both earthly and heavenly tones. This is the crusade, the great religious arrest of the northerners to take on the Gilder's followers.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, are ye?%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to see a young lad gearing up.%SPEECH_ON%You'll be on the righteous path, I know it, and the old gods will watch over us all. Do by them well, little scapegrace.%SPEECH_OFF%Of course. But first you'll do right by the %companyname% and getting a fat purse from all the action to come.}
aef9a50d278796bce968.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%好了，好了，都站好，都站好。%SPEECH_OFF%你遇见一个农民正在主持集会，听众当然也全是农民。%SPEECH_ON%我刚听说，南边那些镀金杂碎，觉得他们的‘造物主’要给旧神点颜色看看。%SPEECH_OFF%人群里有人问，会是什么颜色。讲者耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%不知道。我想大家都同意，旧神早在很多年前就打完了自己的仗，如今没必要再动刀枪。可镀金者，他又不是旧神，那就是异端！%SPEECH_OFF%人群欢呼起来。你开始怀疑，这人莫非是穿着平民衣服的教士。他继续喊道：%SPEECH_ON%拿好武器、盔甲和金子，最要紧的，是带上你们的信仰！咱们要让那个‘镀金者’见见阴影！这是旧神的旨意！%SPEECH_OFF%这回人群发出怒吼，震得你耳膜生疼。有这股劲头倒是好事。一旦开战，生意自会源源不断，这些满怀正义的人，定会信赖%companyname%。 | 一个蓄须教士站在农民面前。%SPEECH_ON%相传，旧神早在很多年前便结束了诸神的战争。他们撕裂世界，留下我们面对满目疮痍。可我们挺过了如此艰难的磨砺，令诸神亦为之动容。%SPEECH_OFF%人群低声议论。他继续说道：%SPEECH_ON%然而，信徒们，考验尚未结束！南方游荡着异端，那些‘镀金者’的追随者！一个崇尚奢靡、挥霍的伪神，凭卑劣障眼法，冒充正义！%SPEECH_OFF%人群根本不懂那些词是什么意思，却仍将草叉举向空中，吼叫着请教士指明去处。长老们微笑着互望，点了点头。谁挑起这场南北圣战，为了什么，你都不甚在意。只要%companyname%能在这桩肮脏事里挣一笔可观的钱，就够了。 | 你从没见过眼前这样的军械堆积。兵器盔甲摞得比三个人头脚相接还高。士兵列队而立，半数举着宗教旗帜，各自绣着一位旧神。教士与修士沿队列来回，从尘世讲到天国，宣说此战的意义。这就是十字军南征，北方人信仰狂热的大集结，矛头直指镀金者的追随者。%SPEECH_ON%你是佣兵吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你回头，看见一个小伙子正在披挂装备。%SPEECH_ON%你会走上正义之路的，我知道。旧神会庇佑我们所有人。别辜负他们，你这小无赖。%SPEECH_OFF%当然。不过，首先得对得起%companyname%，从即将到来的战事里，挣一个鼓囊囊的钱袋。}

ad285f51a38cb0f818d8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%May our paths be gilded in the days to come.%SPEECH_OFF%The priest speaks loudly to his congregation.%SPEECH_ON%I ask of you, faithful, where is the light brightest?%SPEECH_OFF%A throng of peasants murmur about themselves. Finally, the priest holds his hand up.%SPEECH_ON%It is upon the horizon, fighting against the shade of the earth herself, that we find the Gilder's gleam to be its fiercest. And we are now fighting against the shade, and the horizon is not the earth, but the improprieties of the northern stock who dare to profane the holy lands!%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd, once confused, is suddenly unified, seemingly all too knowledgeable about religious war. The priest grins.%SPEECH_ON%That is right, I see your hearts burn with the fire of the Gilder already! We must defend the sacred grounds no matter the cost!%SPEECH_OFF%Again, the crowd roars. You're not sure what to make of the peoples themselves, but if there's one thing you know about war it is that it is good for business and a bit of holy fury might make it all the better. | The Vizier has made a rare appearance for the plebs of his land, and beside him is the greater councils of nearby cities. But he does not speak. A man clothed in gold steps forward instead.%SPEECH_ON%The path of us all has been gilded, has it not?%SPEECH_OFF%Far less gleaming than the priest, the crowd murmur amongst themselves, though none dare to contradict the holy man's assertion. The priest continues.%SPEECH_ON%The Gilder has spoken to many of us, and revealed to us a new event threat: the northerners, spurred by their so-called old gods, have swept south. They entertain the thought of a crusade! To come here, right here, and take all our lands and sacred grounds. You see, the Gilder's shine shows us the path, but perhaps to others it is far too blinding. These northerners do not understand, but we will teach them, and by the Gilder's fire we shall!%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd roars to life and any sense of hesitancy is long gone. You chow down on a local delicatessen and wonder just how much money you're going to make in this holy war to come.}
ad285f51a38cb0f818d8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{%SPEECH_START%愿今后的道路，皆为我们镀上金光。%SPEECH_OFF%祭司向会众高声说道：%SPEECH_ON%信徒们，我问你们，光芒何处最盛？%SPEECH_OFF%一群农民窃窃私语。最后，祭司抬起手。%SPEECH_ON%是地平线！在那里，镀金者的光辉与大地自身的阴影交战，也因此最为炽烈。如今，我们也正与阴影交战。这次的地平线，并非大地，而是胆敢亵渎圣地的北方人的恶行！%SPEECH_OFF%原本困惑的人群突然齐心一致，仿佛对宗教战争再熟悉不过。祭司咧嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%没错，我已看见镀金者的圣火，在你们心中燃烧！我们必须不惜代价，守住圣地！%SPEECH_OFF%人群再次怒吼。你不知道该如何评价这些人，不过有一件事你很清楚：战争有利于生意，再添一把神圣怒火，生意或许就更好了。 | 维齐尔难得在治下平民面前露面，身旁还有邻近诸城的议事会大员。不过，他没有开口，反而是一个披金戴金的人走上前。%SPEECH_ON%我们所有人的道路，早已铺满金光，不是吗？%SPEECH_OFF%人群远没有祭司那样光鲜，彼此低声议论，却无人敢反驳圣者的断言。祭司继续说道：%SPEECH_ON%镀金者已向我们许多人降下神谕，揭示新的威胁：北方人受他们所谓旧神的驱使，席卷南下。他们妄想发动十字军南征！来到这里，就在这里，夺走我们的全部土地与圣地。镀金者的光辉为我们指路，可在别人眼里，或许太过刺目。北方人不懂，我们便来教他们——凭镀金者的圣火，我们必将做到！%SPEECH_OFF%人群骤然爆发欢呼，方才的迟疑早已荡然无存。你大嚼着当地的小吃，琢磨起即将到来的圣战，究竟能让自己挣多少钱。}

13adeb12dc140eb2aac1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_170.png[/img]{You come across a band of nomads. Despite the severity of a war going on, they do not treat you as a threat. One welcomes you with a drink and the shade of an umbrella which you accept.%SPEECH_ON%I hope your travels have been kind, Crownling. You share a similarity with us dune runners, that of the interloper. The grievances between the north and south need not concern us.%SPEECH_OFF%He sips his own drink and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Though I suspect you have made a great deal of coin in the conflict. Some of my countrymen would consider you most faithful to the Gilder because of it.%SPEECH_OFF%}
13adeb12dc140eb2aac1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_170.png[/img]{你遇见一群游牧民。尽管战事严峻，他们并未把你当成威胁。其中一人请你喝一杯，邀你到伞下纳凉，你接受了。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，愿你一路顺遂。你和我们这些穿行沙丘的人有个相似之处：都是局外人。南北之间的恩怨，无须让我们烦心。%SPEECH_OFF%他也啜了口饮料，点头道：%SPEECH_ON%不过，我想你已经从这场冲突里挣了不少钱。凭这一点，有些同胞大概要认定，你才是镀金者最虔诚的信徒。%SPEECH_OFF%}

4755e2bd8fa9a8e82af8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_170.png[/img]{The nomad laughs.%SPEECH_ON%In matters of faith, why would anyone think alike?%SPEECH_OFF%He gathers up his rugs and umbrellas.%SPEECH_ON%I have heard in the north that there are wildmen like us.%SPEECH_OFF%You purse your lips, holding back a laugh.%SPEECH_ON%We've men of the forest who have absconded civilization, aye. But they're a more... peculiar sort compared to you and yours. They are not so much like you.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, the nomad gives you a gift.%SPEECH_ON%But maybe they are and you just have not been listening to them.%SPEECH_OFF%He touches his chest with a fist then the nomads continue on their journey.}
4755e2bd8fa9a8e82af8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_170.png[/img]{游牧民笑道：%SPEECH_ON%信仰这种事，为何非得人人想得一样？%SPEECH_OFF%他收起毯子和遮阳伞。%SPEECH_ON%听说北方也有像我们这样的荒野人。%SPEECH_OFF%你抿住嘴，忍下笑意。%SPEECH_ON%确实有些人远离文明，住进森林。可他们跟你们相比，要更……古怪些，没那么相像。%SPEECH_OFF%游牧民点点头，递给你一份礼物。%SPEECH_ON%也许很像，只是你从未认真听过他们说话。%SPEECH_OFF%他握拳轻触胸口，随后，游牧民们继续踏上旅途。}

880858625dcff83f0c48.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_170.png[/img]{You finish your drink and tell the man your time with him was all very interesting. He goes to shake your hand at which point you put the sword through him. The rest of the company joins in and the battle is as short-lived as your sense of hospitality. The nomads have little worthwhile in their holding, but no one will know of what you've done here, though it's unlike they would care anyway.}
880858625dcff83f0c48.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_170.png[/img]{你喝完杯中饮品，告诉那人这番相处很有意思。他伸手想与你相握，你却一剑将他刺穿。其余弟兄随即动手，这场战斗和你的礼数一样，转眼便结束了。游牧民没藏多少值钱东西，不过也没人会知道你在这里做了什么——即使知道，多半也不会在乎。}

ce0003d3c71819d323ed.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_170.png[/img]{%wildman% the wildman steps beneath the umbrella. The nomad stares at him, and the wildman at the nomad. You ask if they know each other. The nomad smiles.%SPEECH_ON%No, but yes. We've kindred spirits. I can see it in his eyes.%SPEECH_OFF%The wildman hoots and grunts, then turns and leaves. When you return your gaze to the nomad he is holding out a gilded dagger.%SPEECH_ON%Treasures, golds, those things which shine and catch a man's eye, they carry little value to me. I found this upon one of the Vizier's guards. We had slain him and his caravan for their food and water, the things which I believe most important. You may have the dagger, as nothing more than a gift.%SPEECH_OFF%You take it, but warn him that if he ambushes you the way he did the Vizier's men that you will perhaps use the very same dagger against him. The nomad nods.%SPEECH_ON%And yet it is still my gift. I would find the occasion to be of such irony that it could only be a pleasure to die in such a manner. There are worse ways to go here in the desert, friend.%SPEECH_OFF%}
ce0003d3c71819d323ed.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_170.png[/img]{荒野人%wildman%走进伞下。游牧民望着他，他也望着游牧民。你问他们是否相识。游牧民笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不认识，也算认识。我们的灵魂相通，我从他眼里看得出来。%SPEECH_OFF%荒野人呼喝哼哼几声，转身走了。你再看向游牧民时，他已递出一把镀金匕首。%SPEECH_ON%珍宝、黄金，那些闪闪发亮、引人注目的东西，对我而言没多少价值。这是在维齐尔一名卫兵身上找到的。我们为食物和水，杀了他，也灭了他的商队。我认为那些才最重要。匕首给你，只当是件礼物。%SPEECH_OFF%你收下，却警告他，若像伏击维齐尔手下一样伏击你，自己或许就会用这把匕首对付他。游牧民点头。%SPEECH_ON%即便如此，它仍是我的礼物。若真有那一天，想来这份讽刺也足够让我死得愉快。朋友，在沙漠里，更糟的死法多的是。%SPEECH_OFF%}

97c2cadf5fa3325750e5.source: You don't follow the beliefs of your countrymen?
97c2cadf5fa3325750e5.translation: 你不信奉同胞们的神明？

5192b6b3feef785ca2ea.source: And I'm about to make even more after you're dead.
5192b6b3feef785ca2ea.translation: 等你死了，我还能再赚一笔。

83892f624e04e1dcb527.translation: 享受了游牧民的盛情款待

638422a7bf453c36921e.source: Disliked that you killed and robbed your hosts
638422a7bf453c36921e.translation: 不满你杀害并抢劫招待自己的人

ab01b8c7c3a40920f409.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_%image%.png[/img]{News travels fast with a bit of religious spurring: %holysite% has been taken by northern crusaders! | Crusaders from the north have taken %holysite%. You're not sure if this means the war is soon to be at an end. It would be a shame if that were the case as all this strife has made for such great opportunities. | %holysite% has fallen under the banner of northern crusaders! While the old gods no doubt rejoice, the followers of the Gilder will presumably seek to have it taken back. This may present opportunities for the %companyname%.}
ab01b8c7c3a40920f409.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_%image%.png[/img]{宗教热情推波助澜，消息传得飞快：北方十字军夺取了%holysite%！ | 北方十字军夺取了%holysite%。你不确定这是否意味着战争将近尾声。若真如此，倒有些可惜，毕竟这场纷争带来了太多好机会。 | %holysite%已落入北方十字军的旗帜之下！旧神想必欢欣鼓舞，镀金者的信徒则多半会设法夺回圣地。这或许能给%companyname%带来机会。}

9e86baa3943627ef5a1c.source: The fires of religious turmoil burn bright.
9e86baa3943627ef5a1c.translation: 信仰纷争的烈火，正烧得炽烈。

24219bceb044f6778f40.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_%image%.png[/img]{News is coming that the Gilded ones have conquered %holysite%. What they plan to do with it, who knows. Maybe put up a gold-plated fence to keep the northerners out? You're mostly concerned the fighting might be nearing an end, and with it all the sweet religious honey the %companyname% has been eating up. | The Gilder's gleam must be brighter than ever now: %holysite% has fallen under control of the southerners. Perhaps the Gilded folk will ask the %companyname% to help defend it, or maybe the old gods will need a bit of proper gumption in taking it back. Either way, the %companyname% is still on the catbird seat for fattening its purse.}
24219bceb044f6778f40.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_%image%.png[/img]{消息传来，镀金之民已经占领%holysite%。他们打算拿那里做什么，谁知道呢？或许立一道镀金围栏，把北方人挡在外面？你更担心的是，战事可能快结束了，%companyname%一直享用的宗教甜头，也会随之断掉。 | 镀金者如今的光辉，想必比以往更耀眼：%holysite%已落入南方人手中。也许镀金之民会请%companyname%协助防守，也许旧神一方需要些真正有胆量的人，把它夺回来。无论哪种，%companyname%都仍占着挣钱的好位置。}

4a3d2f4e7552032efafb.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]{Faith placed in the old gods has been rewarded: the holy war is over, and the northerners stand victorious. Songs fill the air as crowds move as a mob, fists pumping, flags flying, becoming briefly uniform in a shared sense of piety. You stand by the wayside, your shoulders already wreathed in adornments, beads, necklaces, things of no material value, and yet they bear some weight which the wearer can only find by looking into the eyes of those who hand them out.

 Of course, certain dignities go unrealized in the celebration: the bodies of the defeated are put on display, thrashed in ways meant to satisfy the old gods that are watching, and holy totems of the Gilder are mocked, desecrated, and ultimately burned. And it is indeed certain that not a joyful soul will recognize you as a force in this cheerful culmination. You've merely slipped right into the background once more, sellsword, crownling, interloper. But the %companyname% made a small fortune in the religious endeavors. Despite the smiles and laughs, you know that strife such as this is buried in the mind, not in the earth, and someday someone or something will come and resurrect it, and there the company will await another glorious payday. Or perhaps now would be a good time to put up the sword and enjoy your crowns?

%OOC%You've won! Battle Brothers is designed for replayability and for campaigns to be played until you've beaten one or two late game crises. Starting a new campaign will allow you to try out different things in a different world.

You can also choose to continue your campaign for as long as you want. Just be aware that campaigns are not intended to last forever and you're likely to run out of challenges eventually.%OOC_OFF%}
4a3d2f4e7552032efafb.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]{对旧神的信仰得到了回报：圣战结束，北方人获得胜利。人群结队涌动，挥拳扬旗，歌声充盈四野。共同的虔诚，让他们短暂地融为一体。你站在路旁，肩头已挂满饰物、珠串与项链。它们不值什么钱，却自有一份分量，佩戴者只有看向赠予之人的眼睛，才能领会。
