当然，欢庆并不总顾得上体面：败者的尸体被摆出来示众，遭到种种凌辱，好让注视着这一切的旧神满意；镀金者的圣物则被嘲弄、亵渎，最终付之一炬。可以肯定，欢欣的人群中，不会有谁记得你也促成了这个结局。你只是再次退回背景里，做你的佣兵、克朗客、局外人。不过，%companyname%已经从这场宗教大业中赚了一笔。尽管四下欢声笑语，你却知道，这种仇怨埋在人心里，而非泥土里。总有一天，某个人或某件事会把它重新唤醒，到时战团又能迎来一次丰厚进账。又或许，现在正是收起刀剑、享用克朗的好时候？

%OOC%你赢了！《战场兄弟》注重重复游玩的乐趣，通常建议在一场战役中战胜一至两次后期危机后，开启新战役，在不同的世界尝试新的玩法。

你也可以继续当前战役，想玩多久都可以。不过，游戏并非按无限期游玩设计，最终可能会缺少新的挑战。%OOC_OFF%}

539ebe18331243e7b026.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]{Uttering their name is to draw words from tongue to intemporal: the old gods. They are beyond time, and their vast number invoke awe over specificity. Endearing as this is to any listener familiar or not with the faith, it also brings greater weight to any defeat of those who follow these unbranded beings. The crusades are over, and the northerners have lost.

 You watch as the northerners try and explain it to one another how it came to pass. It was not a terrestrial defeat here, nor even a victory by the southerners - no, this was punishment. Northerners have grazed far from the holy lands, they have meadowed in the material world, priories and churches dot the realm, empty and hollow for far too long. Naturally, inquiries about the nature of this southern 'Gilder' have also come, but they quickly pass. To even dwell on Him is to invite doubt, and right now doubt is as dangerous as any poison. Of course, the %companyname% stays at a distance. Sellswords that you are, you put faith in your sword and in the purse, and both got their dues in this war. The only philosophizing you'll be doing in the days to come is pondering just how soon the north and south will resume stating their differences. Perhaps now would be a good time to put up the sword and enjoy your crowns?

%OOC%You've won! Battle Brothers is designed for replayability and for campaigns to be played until you've beaten one or two late game crises. Starting a new campaign will allow you to try out different things in a different world.

You can also choose to continue your campaign for as long as you want. Just be aware that campaigns are not intended to last forever and you're likely to run out of challenges eventually.%OOC_OFF%}
539ebe18331243e7b026.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]{说出这个称呼，仿佛就让话语越过舌尖，抵达了时间之外：旧神。他们超越岁月，数量繁多，比起某个具体的名号，更足以唤起敬畏。无论是否熟悉这一信仰，听者都容易为之动容；可也正因如此，这些无名神祇的信徒一旦失败，那失败便更加沉重。十字军南征结束，北方输了。

你看着北方人彼此解释，怎么会落到这一步。这不是一场尘世的败仗，甚至不算南方人的胜利——不，这是惩罚。北方人远离圣地，在物欲的草场上流连；遍布各处的修道院与教堂，空寂荒废得太久。当然，也有人开始打听南方那位‘镀金者’究竟是什么，但这些话很快就消失了。连多想一想祂，都足以招来怀疑，而此刻，怀疑与任何毒药一样危险。%companyname%自然置身事外。你们是佣兵，信仰在刀剑与钱袋上，这场战争也让两者都得到了该得的。今后若还要琢磨什么大道理，无非是南北双方究竟多久以后，又会重新摆出各自的分歧。或许现在正是收起刀剑、享用克朗的好时候？

%OOC%你赢了！《战场兄弟》注重重复游玩的乐趣，通常建议在一场战役中战胜一至两次后期危机后，开启新战役，在不同的世界尝试新的玩法。

你也可以继续当前战役，想玩多久都可以。不过，游戏并非按无限期游玩设计，最终可能会缺少新的挑战。%OOC_OFF%}

526499455a9b9f88c08c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]{You recall the followers of the Gilder to once be united in their pursuit of leveling the old gods. Some misplaced notion that, were they to satisfy their God enough, He would put his powerful eye upon all enemies of His faithful and obliterate them. Instead, the Gilded find their resolve greatly tested: they have lost the holy war. Cities and towns have been burned, holy totems desecrated, and sacred grounds looted.

 Crowds of people listlessly shift about in the streets, wailing now and again, not with purpose, but as though they've lost all language to articulate the pain they must now endure. On occasion, a body will plummet from above, or you find the guards pulling corpses out of the well only for an onlooker to pitch herself in. A few prostrate themselves before golden relics, letting themselves cook in the sun struck glare of the shiny emblems, the grief stricken crawling beneath the simmering reflections until their skins turn to crust and their throats choke on their own flesh, and as the sun comes and goes, bodies lay in the wake of its stare. As for the %companyname%, you've put yourself to one side or the other, and regardless of winners or losers, you made a small fortune. For the future you need not wish to have the opportunity again, either: if there's one thing you know about a man of faith it's that defeat is only but one strike upon the hardening iron. With all that you've achieved, perhaps now would be a good time to put up the sword and enjoy your crowns?

%OOC%You've won! Battle Brothers is designed for replayability and for campaigns to be played until you've beaten one or two late game crises. Starting a new campaign will allow you to try out different things in a different world.

You can also choose to continue your campaign for as long as you want. Just be aware that campaigns are not intended to last forever and you're likely to run out of challenges eventually.%OOC_OFF%}
526499455a9b9f88c08c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]{你还记得，镀金者的信徒曾团结一心，要把旧神彻底打垮。他们抱着某种错觉，以为只要足够讨神欢心，祂便会将强大的目光投向信徒的一切敌人，将其尽数抹去。结果，镀金之民的信念遭受了严峻考验：他们输掉了圣战。城镇被焚，圣物遭亵渎，圣地被洗劫。

人群在街上失魂落魄地游荡，时而哀号，并非有意表达什么，而是仿佛已失去言语，无法诉说如今承受的痛苦。偶尔，有人从高处坠下；又或卫兵正从井里捞尸体，旁观的女人却纵身跳了进去。还有人伏在金色圣物前，任凭耀眼徽记反射的日光炙烤。悲痛的人们爬行于滚烫的反光之下，直到皮肤焦硬，喉中肿烂窒塞。太阳东升西落，目光所及，只留下一具具尸体。至于%companyname%，无论选择了哪一边，无论谁输谁赢，你都挣了一笔。今后甚至不必祈求再有这样的机会：对于信仰之人，你至少懂得一点——失败，不过是锻铁时落下的一锤，只会让它更加坚硬。既已成就这么多，或许现在正是收起刀剑、享用克朗的好时候？

%OOC%你赢了！《战场兄弟》注重重复游玩的乐趣，通常建议在一场战役中战胜一至两次后期危机后，开启新战役，在不同的世界尝试新的玩法。

你也可以继续当前战役，想玩多久都可以。不过，游戏并非按无限期游玩设计，最终可能会缺少新的挑战。%OOC_OFF%}

8af9ae755d243197d9b3.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]{Faith placed in the Gilder has been rewarded: the holy war is over, and the southerners stand victorious. The Vizier, councilmen, and clergy alike are found in the streets, each riding great wagons which, in place of wheels, are lofted on the backs of slaves. Northern slaves, particularly, indebted to the Gilder for their crimes. You can hardly see the men, just their legs black in shadow as though a procession of swaying beetles was on the go. The wealthy and profligate men take great chalices and hurl what looks like golden water upon the cheering faithful. You yourself lean into one of these splashes, but find it is merely just tinted water.

 While the faux fortunes served only to slake your thirst, the very real war between the followers of the old gods and the Gilded themselves served to fill the %companyname%'s treasury. As a Crownling, you'll never find the respect of bared heads and bowed bodies, nor the prostrations of peasants, nor the gleam of gold too heavy for any one man to carry. That is the reality for you, but that won't stop the company from being ready the next time the pious wanna have a squabble over righteousness. Or perhaps now would be a good time to put up the sword and enjoy your crowns?

%OOC%You've won! Battle Brothers is designed for replayability and for campaigns to be played until you've beaten one or two late game crises. Starting a new campaign will allow you to try out different things in a different world.

You can also choose to continue your campaign for as long as you want. Just be aware that campaigns are not intended to last forever and you're likely to run out of challenges eventually.%OOC_OFF%}
8af9ae755d243197d9b3.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_84.png[/img]{对镀金者的信仰得到了回报：圣战结束，南方人获得胜利。维齐尔、议事会成员和祭司都上了街，各自乘着巨大的车舆。不过，车下没有轮子，只有奴隶的脊背。尤其是北方奴隶，他们因自己的罪，欠下了镀金者的债。你几乎看不见这些人，只能看见阴影中乌黑的双腿，仿佛一队甲虫摇摇晃晃地行进。富贵奢靡的大人物们举起大酒杯，将看似金水的液体泼向欢呼的信徒。你也凑过去接了一捧，却发现不过是染了色的水。

这份假财宝只够解渴，旧神信徒与镀金之民之间那场真战争，却填满了%companyname%的钱库。身为克朗客，你永远不会得到人们脱帽鞠躬的敬意，不会让农民伏地叩拜，也不会披挂多得一人都背不动的耀眼黄金。这就是你的现实，却不妨碍战团做好准备，等虔诚信徒下一回再为正义吵起来。又或许，现在正是收起刀剑、享用克朗的好时候？

%OOC%你赢了！《战场兄弟》注重重复游玩的乐趣，通常建议在一场战役中战胜一至两次后期危机后，开启新战役，在不同的世界尝试新的玩法。

你也可以继续当前战役，想玩多久都可以。不过，游戏并非按无限期游玩设计，最终可能会缺少新的挑战。%OOC_OFF%}

67ddf3c6a4dfd207a46a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{You come across a troop of men half-buried in sand. Northerners caught in a sandstorm over night. They're writhing in pain, the ones alive at least. Some have had their flesh rent from bone, and others are already being picked at by scorpions and buzzards. It seems some have killed themselves. Not one of the souls can be saved, they're just clinging on to the end.}
67ddf3c6a4dfd207a46a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{你遇见一队半埋在沙里的北方人，他们昨夜遭了沙暴。还活着的那些，正痛苦地扭动。有的人血肉已从骨头上剥离，有的人正在被蝎子和秃鹫啃食，似乎还有人已经自尽。谁也救不回来了，他们只是在苦撑最后一口气。}

cadcf0457c5431afd47a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{Drawing your sword, you ask the men if they will accept the dignity of a swift death by your steel. They're too parched and starved to speak, but a few nod. One dies before he can even answer. You go to each, crouch, wish them well, and push the sword in. The skin cracks beneath the blade, and the dying men are briefly revivified by the piercing pain, and then they are relinquished from this world. A few in the company have varying opinions about this matter.

You have the sellsword pick up what things they can, though much of the equipment has been laid to waste by the fury of the desert.}
cadcf0457c5431afd47a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{你拔出剑，问这些人，是否愿意体面些，由你的剑给个痛快。他们饥渴得说不出话，但有几个人点了头。有一个甚至没来得及回答，就已咽气。你逐一走近，蹲下，送上祝愿，再将剑刺入。皮肤在刃下裂开，剧痛让垂死之人短暂醒转，随后便离开了这个世界。战团中，有些人对此各执一词。

你让佣兵们捡起还能用的东西，尽管大部分装备，都已被沙漠的狂暴毁掉。}

0f9fa6aafd5b1aedbf1c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{You order the sellswords to strip the dying men of any useful gear. The crusaders can only mumble and groan as they are stripped of arms and armor. Their naked bodies are left to the burning sands, and as you depart with whatever scraps of useful gear the animals of the waste already begin to move in and feed. Mixed feelings run through the %companyname% about this decision, but ultimately contentions or support alike stay quiet.}
0f9fa6aafd5b1aedbf1c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{你命令佣兵剥走垂死之人身上还能用的装备。武器与护甲被取走时，十字军战士只能含糊低语、呻吟不止。赤裸的身体被丢在滚烫沙地上。你带着那点可用的零碎离开时，荒原上的动物已经围拢进食。%companyname%中有人赞成，也有人反感，可最后谁都没有出声。}

c7b668d489373a812e58.translation: 镀金者已对他们作出裁决。

c3d80009eea4ea26e4fe.source: Approved of your decision to end the suffering of fellow northerners
c3d80009eea4ea26e4fe.translation: 赞同你结束北方同胞的痛苦

bcc1217a06922ac3c510.source: Disliked that you ended the suffering of northern invaders
bcc1217a06922ac3c510.translation: 不满你结束北方入侵者的痛苦

6775e74f8117b117b52f.source: Disliked that you left fellow northerners to suffer a slow death
6775e74f8117b117b52f.translation: 不满你让北方同胞在痛苦中慢慢死去

315bb149984d19a33c22.source: Approved of your decision to leave northern invaders judged by the Gilder
315bb149984d19a33c22.translation: 赞同你将北方入侵者交由镀金者裁决的决定

f7d1682042d618cad578.source: %terrainImage%{A peasant passes you on the path. He mentions off-hand that he doesn't understand why gods would have their followers fight each other. If it really wanted to be settled, why not do it themselves? You grab him by the shirt and ask what he's blathering about. He pulls away.%SPEECH_ON%Oy! Hands off, or I'll nip ya! And I'm just grousing, thass'all. Lotta talk going around about the Gilded folk and the followers of the old gods butting heads. Again. Now lemme bitch in peace!%SPEECH_OFF%The man walks off, mumbling and, ironically, getting louder in volume the further away he gets from you. | You come across a congress of Gilded and old gods' monks alike. They're discussing the possibility of an upcoming war, and how to protect themselves if such a time comes to pass. It's admirably amicable, all told, but it does seem there's a hint of religious reckoning in the air. | A man fixing a wagon beside the road shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%You know, I'd just like to go from one spot of the world t'another, and that be that. But no. Farking... something! Always something! Has gotta go wrong. Hey, speaking of wheels, here's one I hear turning: the Gilder and the old gods might be knocking heads again. Seen storm clouds of it. Holy war in the sky. Which means holy war here. I hope to get clear of it before it starts. You seen the last one? Nasty business.%SPEECH_OFF%You're sure it is, but nasty business means good business for the %companyname%. | %SPEECH_ON%Knees bothering me.%SPEECH_OFF%You look over to see an old man wiggling two stumps. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%That is to say, the spirit of my knee is getting ornery. When I had m'legs, the tinge in the knee meant bad weather. Now the twinge in no-knee means something worse.%SPEECH_OFF%A young boy comes and hauls the elder into a wheelbarrow. Before he departs, you ask what he means. He turns aside, elbow cocked and hand planted on his hand, looking dapper and lively for what he is.%SPEECH_ON%A reckoning from above. The Gilder, the old gods, maybe even more than just them. I think they're all toying with us, spurring us folk to kill one another to appease them, so they can have a watch. You look the part of a sellsword, so I imagine business will be kind to you once them clerical colors wanna go red.%SPEECH_OFF%}
f7d1682042d618cad578.translation: %terrainImage%{一个农民从你身旁走过，随口抱怨，不懂诸神为什么非要让信徒互相厮杀。真想分个高下，自己动手不好吗？你揪住他的衣襟，问他在嘀咕什么。他挣开了。%SPEECH_ON%喂！放手，不然我可咬你！我就发几句牢骚，没别的。到处都在传，镀金之民又跟旧神的信徒杠上了。又来了！现在，让我安安静静骂两句行不行！%SPEECH_OFF%他边走边嘟囔，说来讽刺，离你越远，声音反倒越大。 | 你遇见一场僧侣聚会，镀金者与旧神的追随者都在。他们讨论着战争可能将至，以及到时如何自保。总的说来，双方和睦得令人钦佩，可空气中也隐约透出宗教清算将临的气息。 | 路旁一个修货车的人摇着头。%SPEECH_ON%你知道吗，我就想从世上这个地方，到另一个地方，仅此而已。可不行。总他妈有……事情！总有事情！非得出岔子。嘿，说起轮子，我听说又有一轮麻烦要转起来了：镀金者和旧神，可能又要碰一碰。我都看见那片风暴云了。天上圣战，地上也得圣战。但愿开打前我能躲远点。上回那场你见过吗？真够糟的。%SPEECH_OFF%你相信是够糟的，可这种糟心事，对%companyname%而言却是好生意。 | %SPEECH_ON%膝盖又闹腾了。%SPEECH_OFF%你转头，看见一个老人晃着两截断腿。他咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%我是说，膝盖的魂儿又不安分了。腿还在的时候，膝盖一酸，就是天要变坏。现在连膝盖都没了还疼，那就要来更坏的事。%SPEECH_OFF%一个小男孩走来，把老人搬进独轮车。临走前，你问他什么意思。他侧过身，支起胳膊，摆出一副从容姿态，对一个如此残缺的人来说，倒显得格外精神。%SPEECH_ON%天上要算账了。镀金者、旧神，也许还不止他们。我看他们全在耍我们，挑唆凡人互相残杀，讨他们高兴，好让他们看戏。你看着像个佣兵，想必等那些教派的旗号都染了红，你的生意就该兴隆了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

41ef6d0eb16b8015e905.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{You come over a sand dune to see a half dozen men. They are wearing black cloaks and have their sleeve-sheathed hands holding onto one another to form a complete circle. Despite every one of their heads being down, they all seem to sense your presence and turn to stare. One man lets his hands go and steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits us all, traveler, even the gilded path permits his patience.%SPEECH_OFF%}
41ef6d0eb16b8015e905.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{翻过沙丘，你看到六个男人。他们身披黑袍，双手藏在袖中，彼此相牵，围成一个完整的圆。虽然人人垂着头，却似乎同时察觉了你的到来，转头凝视。其中一人松开双手，走上前。%SPEECH_ON%旅人，达夫库尔等待着我们所有人，即使镀金之路也容得下他的耐心。%SPEECH_OFF%}

cec9d6f8989840b4ea85.source: We'll leave you guys to it.

3601a7a5187a9e197b89.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]{You draw your sword and order the company to make short work of the cultists. They are set upon with ease, the cultists not even so much as raising a hand to resist their own demise. A survivor coughs as he lets an open wound bleed. He holds his hand out as if to show you your handiwork.%SPEECH_ON%With all your hard work you cannot buy time, sellsword. Davkul awaits us all.%SPEECH_OFF%You take your dagger out and end the man. You kick his body over and loot it, as well as the other corpses, though not much is to be found.}
3601a7a5187a9e197b89.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]{你拔剑下令，叫战团迅速解决这些教徒。杀戮轻而易举，他们甚至没有抬手反抗自己的死亡。一个尚未断气的人咳嗽着，任伤口流血，伸出手来，仿佛要让你欣赏自己的杰作。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，再怎么卖力，你也买不来时间。达夫库尔等待着我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%你拔出匕首，结果了他，随后踢翻尸体搜刮财物。其余尸体也没放过，可找到的东西寥寥无几。}

80ed9beb097477b8bfac.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{%cultist% steps forward, brandishing his scarred pate for all the strangers to see. They nod and bow, and their leader speaks with his eyes to the sands.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul has spoken.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, %cultist% responds.%SPEECH_ON%And to every word I listen.%SPEECH_OFF%The leader retrieves a strange blade seemingly out of nowhere and runs it across his fingers. He speaks again without looking up.%SPEECH_ON%Then do as he requests.%SPEECH_OFF% %cultist% takes the blade and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits us all.%SPEECH_OFF%The strange men collapse to the ground and put their faces into the sand. Their chests rise and fall, tremor, and then they move no more. They have drowned themselves into the desert herself. %cultist% returns carrying a bizarre dagger with him.}
80ed9beb097477b8bfac.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{%cultist%走上前，向陌生人们展示自己满是伤疤的头顶。他们点头躬身，领头者垂眼望着沙地，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔已降下谕示。%SPEECH_OFF%%cultist%点头回应。%SPEECH_ON%祂的每一句话，我都聆听。%SPEECH_OFF%领头者不知从何处取出一把奇异的刀，划过自己的手指，仍不抬头。%SPEECH_ON%那就遵从祂的旨意。%SPEECH_OFF% %cultist%接过刀，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔在等待我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人们齐齐伏倒，将脸埋进沙里。胸膛起伏、颤抖，随后再也不动。他们竟把自己溺死在沙漠之中。%cultist%带着那把怪异匕首走了回来。}

7622c0ec36fdeba90c8f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{You offer a modest hello and goodbye to the black cloaks, then move on. They do not resist you, nor call out to you in any manner. The last you see of them they are holding hands again and have their heads crooned forward and staring into the sands. There is not a single jug of water or basket of food anywhere to be seen. If they had not come here to die, what could possibly save them?}
7622c0ec36fdeba90c8f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{你向黑袍人简单问候、告别，继续前行。他们既不阻拦，也不出声呼唤。最后一眼望去，他们又牵起手，低垂着脑袋，凝视沙地。周围看不到一罐水，也没有一篮食物。如果不是来这里等死，还有什么能救他们？}

aeec680f768f37b63cf0.source: Not for us to know, maybe.
aeec680f768f37b63cf0.translation: 或许这不是咱们该知道的。

7c3f04cc7acfc9df9105.source: Have a word with your brothers in faith, %cultist%.

c4f09a870f0e597ddec4.source: Had an understanding with his brothers in faith
c4f09a870f0e597ddec4.translation: 与同教的弟兄达成了默契

3036eacee279fba0a73f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_175.png[/img]{Shouting and yelling drags you from counting inventory. You find a few of the men standing at opposite ends of the campfire pointing fingers and even a weapon or two. Seems there's a bit of a dustup over whose women are more beautiful: southerners or northerners. Ironically, the northerners are voting for the southerners and vice versa. A couple of stern commands brings order back to the company, but the tensions remain. | There's been a bit of fisticuffs between some of the men. Apparently, there was a disagreement about the marriage rites between men and women. The northerners believe it should be one and one, while the southerners prefer marrying as many women as one can get their hands on. You tell the men to stop fighting like women and focus on the task at hand, which may or may not be to finish a job to get coin to then spend on a woman, but that's neither here nor there. | A couple of the men get into it over some religious differences. Some conflict over the old gods and the Gilder, each man a little ambassador of his faith, diplomatically putting fists into the opposition's faces. You tell them all to quit it and get their heads straight. If they want to argue over which gods are best, they can do it in the afterlife. | A couple of the men get into it over matters of... sand? It seems the northerners in the company are poking fun at the southerners, asking how stupid one would have to be to settle in a land with nothing but sand.%SPEECH_ON%Who looks around in a hot arse sandy dune and thinks, aye, this'll be my home. Bet you wish yer forefathers had a proper mind to realize there's more to the world than a gods damned forever sunburn.%SPEECH_OFF%This garners the first punch thrown. The scuffle has a few injured, but you get the men back to order, commanding them to keep their geographic opinions to themselves. | An argument breaks out when southerners in the company start poking fun at their northern brothers' lack of articulation. One mimics with his hands splayed out at his ears.%SPEECH_ON%We's all talks like this, aye, yessir, ain't y'all ready to come on to somesuch sumbitch thing, aye? Ain't ain't ain-%SPEECH_OFF%Fisticuffs end the jestering. A few are bruised in the exchange, but you manage to break it up before it gets more serious. | Though normally dismissive of their overlords, the northerners and the southerners take to defending the lords and Viziers of their lands respectively. It seems the foil of having some cultural opposition has spurred heretofore unseen fealties. The arguments unwind into an actual fist fight, with not a lord around to be impressed, mind. You break it up, telling them the only one they should look to impress is either you or each other as brothers in battle.}
3036eacee279fba0a73f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_175.png[/img]{叫嚷声打断了你清点库存的工作。你发现几个弟兄分站篝火两侧，互相指指点点，甚至有人亮出了武器。似乎是在争论，南方女人和北方女人，究竟谁更漂亮。讽刺的是，北方人支持南方，南方人反而支持北方。你厉声喝令几句，战团恢复秩序，可紧张的气氛仍未消散。 | 几个弟兄打起拳来。原来，他们对男女婚配的规矩有分歧。北方人认为该一男一女，南方人则觉得，能娶到多少女人，就该娶多少。你叫他们别像泼妇般争闹，专心眼前的差事。虽然这差事，也可能只是干完活挣点钱，再花在女人身上，不过，那是另一回事。 | 几个弟兄因宗教分歧打了起来。争的是旧神与镀金者，每人都是自己信仰的小小使节，以把拳头送进对方脸上的方式，进行“外交”。你叫他们全都停下，清醒一点。想争哪位神更好，死后再争。 | 几个弟兄因为……沙子，吵了起来？看来，是战团中的北方人正在嘲弄南方同伴，问得蠢到什么地步，才会定居在满眼只有沙子的地方。%SPEECH_ON%谁会站在热得烫屁股的沙丘上四下看看，然后说，行，这儿就是我家了？你们肯定希望祖宗能有点脑子，知道这世上不止有他娘的无休无止的暴晒。%SPEECH_OFF%这话引来了第一拳。混战伤了几人，不过，你让弟兄们恢复了秩序，命令他们把对各地的高见留在自己肚子里。 | 战团中的南方人开始嘲笑北方弟兄说话不利索，争吵随之爆发。一人把双手摊在耳边，学起对方的腔调。%SPEECH_ON%俺们就这么说话，哎，对咧，你们是不是要整那个啥混账玩意儿，啊？是不是，是不是，是不——%SPEECH_OFF%拳头结束了模仿。几个人挨得鼻青脸肿，好在闹大之前，你已将他们分开。 | 北方人和南方人平时都不大看得起头上的统治者，如今却分别维护起各自的领主与维齐尔。看来，一旦有了异乡文化作对照，竟能激起前所未有的忠诚。争论最终变成拳脚相向，偏偏周围连个领主都没有，没人能为这份忠心感动。你拉开众人，告诉他们，真想赢得谁的认可，就该争取你的，或彼此作为战友的认可。}

0146ae185e14f8016be2.source: Why can't we all just get along?
0146ae185e14f8016be2.translation: 大家怎么就不能好好相处？

bb2341733d1409ef11b5.source: Had a brawl over cultural differences
bb2341733d1409ef11b5.translation: 因习俗不同而打了一架

9f19b9760aa70bd1fb82.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{While standing around looking at maps and taking inventory, %bitbro% suddenly yells out and falls over in the sand. He slaps at his legs and a black scorpion goes soaring. Another sellsword screams and chops the bug in half with the sort of ferocity you've never even seen him use on the battlefield. %bitbro% clenches his teeth as he takes off his boots. It looks like someone jammed a nail into his ankle. He says he's feeling woozy, but it's not too serious.}
9f19b9760aa70bd1fb82.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{你们正站着查看地图、清点物资，%bitbro%忽然大叫一声，倒在沙里，拍打着腿，一只黑蝎子被甩飞出去。另一名佣兵尖叫着将蝎子砍成两半，那股狠劲，你在战场上都没见他使出来过。%bitbro%咬牙脱下靴子，脚踝看起来像被人钉了一根钉子。他说有点头晕，不过应该不算严重。}

1d24fe8670367652a31d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{As you tread down the slope of a dune, %fallbro% loses his footing and starts to slide down. He yells out for help, flailing as he tumbles downward. Each tumble gains speed and air, every roll of the limbs seemingly arcing him higher into the air than the last. Despite the silky slipperiness of the dune's slope, the bottom of its valley is a hard firmament and the sellsword grinds across it until he comes to a complete stop. He's not dead but comes away a little banged up, with scrapes, bruises, burns, and a hint of embarrassment.}
1d24fe8670367652a31d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{下沙丘时，%fallbro%脚下一滑，开始向下滚落。他手脚乱舞，高声求救，每翻一圈都更快，弹得也更高。沙坡虽柔滑如绸，谷底却硬实得很，这佣兵一路擦着地面滑行，好不容易才停住。他没有送命，只落下些擦伤、淤青、磨破的皮肉，还有一点难堪。}

897a2537121d72833fb3.source: Bruised his leg when sliding down a sand dune

ff9431ae13737a24f8ab.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{Marching through sand dunes for days has built up a lot of grit in the boots of the men. A few take pause, emptying out their shoes, while others reveal that their feet have been ground raw. This is a hellish landscape, it seems, no matter if it's the sun above or the sands below, it's all out to get you.}
ff9431ae13737a24f8ab.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{接连数日在沙丘间跋涉，弟兄们靴里灌满了砂砾。有几人停下来倒沙，另一些人的脚已经磨得血肉模糊。这真是片地狱般的荒原，无论头顶烈日还是脚下黄沙，似乎都想要你的命。}

651b5f0bfbc9fdaeb64a.source: Had his feet ground raw by desert sand

787172f4298e0438ea92.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{%heatbro% sags into the sands, one knee buckling, and as soon as it straightens back up the other buckles in turn. You look back just in time to watch as his eyes roll back in his head and he crumples. The company rushes to his help, getting him water and shade. He hacks and thrashes back to life, but the withering heat has already done its damage.}
787172f4298e0438ea92.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{%heatbro%身子一歪，一条腿跪进沙里，刚勉强撑直，另一条腿又软了下去。你回头时，正看见他双眼翻白，瘫倒在地。弟兄们赶忙上前，把水和遮阴物送来。他呛咳着挣动，总算缓过气，可酷热已经伤了身子。}

5042c19af7161eeb2813.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{A desert is unfriendly land to interlopers. Even if your equipment bears the weight of this natural hostility: some of the gear has been worn down by the sands themselves. Cleaning and sharpening will be needed to maintain to the quality of the %companyname%'s equipment.}
5042c19af7161eeb2813.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_161.png[/img]{沙漠对外来者毫不客气，连装备也得承受这份敌意：黄沙本身就磨损了部分器械。若要让%companyname%的装备保持完好，便得清理、打磨一番。}

ca266f5e983de5c92ce1.translation: 这鬼地方真是容不下一点活物。

1e7bd510e15fcab23d5c.source: %terrainImage%{You come to a watering hole. The well's walled exterior is embroidered with animal skulls and similarly stitched with their ribs. As you draw near, there's a faint hiss from the depths. Staring in, you see a tiny orange glow snaking left to right.%SPEECH_ON%You might want to try not looking down there.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn around to see a man dressed in rags. His hair is spiked backwards in black chevrons. Dark splotches pepper his face and he's got bruises on every fingernail and a tarred smile.%SPEECH_ON%It's about to blow.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1e7bd510e15fcab23d5c.translation: %terrainImage%{你来到一处水井旁。井沿外壁嵌着兽骨，头骨像装饰，肋骨像缝线。走近时，井底传出微弱的嘶嘶声。你探头望去，只见一点橙光左右蜿蜒。%SPEECH_ON%最好别往里看。%SPEECH_OFF%你转身，看见一个衣衫褴褛的男人。漆黑头发向后炸成一束束尖角，脸上满是黑斑，每片指甲下都有淤伤，笑容也像抹了焦油。%SPEECH_ON%快炸了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

530572b67016abb9b294.source: %terrainImage%{The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%That ain't no watering hole, that's a cannon. I got a pile of fire powder in the bottom. The chute is armed with buckets, and fishing rods, all manner of cutlery, some soldier's metal boots, a broken sword, couple of scabbards, I think a few animals fell in but they no doubt dead now, if not they're going for a ride.%SPEECH_OFF%}
530572b67016abb9b294.translation: %terrainImage%{那人点头。%SPEECH_ON%那不是水井，是门炮。我在底下堆了火药，炮筒里装着水桶、钓竿、各种刀叉、某个士兵的铁靴、一把断剑、几个剑鞘。我想还有几只牲口掉进去，不过肯定早死了；没死的话，也要飞上一回。%SPEECH_OFF%}

3cd60feefcca2c8ee838.source:
%terrainImage%{The man grins.%SPEECH_ON%You don't know a damn thing about me, stranger. Maybe I aim to kill myself cause I done a terrible crime. I mean, I haven't, but what're you doing going off about 'don't do it'? You've seen my preparation, were I of the mind to pause wouldn't I have done it at any prior moment? Now you set back there and watch this.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns and leaps into the hole. There's a clatter of his crashing, some murmuring about how there's more debris than he remembers. When you look down he yells at you to clear out and the orange glow zips into a hole. The man bows.%SPEECH_ON%I bid you good stranger, a strange farewe-%SPEECH_OFF% The explosion blows out your ears and puts you on the ground. The earth rolls beneath you in tremble that can be felt through the deafness which you are now submerged. A pluming cloud of fire spears into the sky and growls with the clinking and clanking of metals and the dull plops of leather and other goods, and you roll to your belly and cover your head as it all comes down like the scraps of some god's hellstorm.

 Absolutely none of the debris is of any use. As for the man himself, well, he got his wish. He no doubt died in the blink of an eye, all that remains are charred chunks here and there and broiled lungs and seared strips of sinews and more. You check to make sure your eyebrows are still there and, satisfied, prepare to move on.}
3cd60feefcca2c8ee838.translation:
%terrainImage%{男人咧嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%陌生人，你对我根本一无所知。说不定我是犯了滔天大罪，才想一死了之。我的意思是，我没犯，可你凭什么张口就劝我“别这么干”？你也看见我准备得多周全了。要是我想停，早先哪一刻不能停？现在，退后，好好看着。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身跳进坑里，下面传来一阵碰撞声，又听见他嘟囔，说杂物比记得的还多。你探头往下看，他便叫你躲开，一点橙色火光倏地没入孔洞。男人鞠了一躬。%SPEECH_ON%好陌生人，容我向你道一声，奇异的永——%SPEECH_OFF% 爆炸震得你两耳失聪，将你掀倒在地。脚下大地翻滚，即便听不见，你也能感到剧烈的震颤。火云直冲天空，轰鸣声中夹杂着金属叮当、皮革与杂物闷闷的撞击。你翻身趴下，护住头，任那些碎片如某位神明掀起的地狱风暴般纷纷落下。

残骸里没有一样东西还能用。至于那人，唔，他如愿以偿了。毫无疑问，他在一瞬间便死了，只剩四散的焦块、烤熟的肺、烧焦的筋腱和种种残片。你摸摸自己的眉毛，确认还在，便满意地准备继续上路。}

05843131e2cd62c3a8e9.source: Sometimes you wish these things were just mirages.
05843131e2cd62c3a8e9.translation: 有时候，真希望这些事只是海市蜃楼。

9069b5e94ba1ce0209e8.source: %terrainImage%{%monk% the monk steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%That's a lotta work to end yourself, friend.%SPEECH_OFF%The man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%I'm not really your friend.%SPEECH_OFF%The monk nods.%SPEECH_ON%Turn of phrase, nothing more. In truth I know nothing about you. In truth you likely have a good reason to be doing this. How much time have you spent putting this together?%SPEECH_OFF%The strange man thinks for a time, then says he thinks it's been months. %monk% smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Now that's good, hard work.%SPEECH_OFF%The man says.%SPEECH_ON%You trying to coddle me?%SPEECH_OFF%The monk shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%No Sir.%SPEECH_OFF%The man slims his eyes and stares incredulously.%SPEECH_ON%Sounds to me like motherly talk. Like you're trying to sweet talk me into not killing myself. Well I won't have it!%SPEECH_OFF%%monk% shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Again, no sir. You go on and end yourself if that's what you wish. Today or later, the old gods will be waiting.%SPEECH_OFF%The man turns and spits.%SPEECH_ON%No old gods down here. Only the Gilder's gleam and glow.%SPEECH_OFF%%monk% nods then turns to look at you.%SPEECH_ON%To be frank, captain, I really only got one thing left to say. Can I say it? I just wanna tell it to the stranger, tell it to him straight.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9069b5e94ba1ce0209e8.translation: %terrainImage%{修士%monk%走上前。%SPEECH_ON%朋友，为了结束自己的性命，你可费了不少工夫。%SPEECH_OFF%男人耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我可不是你的朋友。%SPEECH_OFF%修士点点头。%SPEECH_ON%只是个称呼，别无他意。说实话，我对你一无所知。说实话，你要这么做，多半也有自己的理由。布置这些，你花了多久？%SPEECH_OFF%怪人想了一阵，说大概有几个月了。%monk%笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%那可真是一番扎扎实实的苦功。%SPEECH_OFF%男人说。%SPEECH_ON%你这是在哄我？%SPEECH_OFF%修士摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%没有，先生。%SPEECH_OFF%男人眯起眼睛，满脸不信。%SPEECH_ON%听着就像老妈子哄人。你想说几句好听的，劝我别自杀。我可不吃这套！%SPEECH_OFF%%monk%耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我再说一次，没有，先生。若你执意如此，那便去结束自己的性命吧。无论今天还是来日，旧神都在那里等着。%SPEECH_OFF%男人转过身，啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%这边没有旧神。只有镀金者的光与辉。%SPEECH_OFF%%monk%点点头，转身看向你。%SPEECH_ON%坦白说，团长，我真只剩一句话想讲了。能让我说吗？我就想告诉这陌生人，把话直说给他听。%SPEECH_OFF%}

a5ca2dad22d9f05ee319.source: Let him end himself if that's what he wants.

67b4c7d73ac425a676b5.source: %terrainImage%{The monk nods with your approval then suddenly swings around and cold cocks the stranger. He falls off the well wall and collapses into the dirt, staring up with his eyes wonked.%SPEECH_ON%What'd you go and do that for?%SPEECH_OFF%He asks, touching his lip. %monk% crouches down.%SPEECH_ON%How's that feel?%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger sneers and spits blood. He says it hurts. The monk nods.%SPEECH_ON%Feel alive?%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger gets to his feet and dusts himself off. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%A little, yeah.%SPEECH_OFF%The two talk for a time and when it is over the man is willing to join the company free of charge. He also says that there are a number of goods in the well if they want to be used, though to be mindful to not drop any fire in there cause it'll blow sky high.}
67b4c7d73ac425a676b5.translation: %terrainImage%{得到你的许可，修士点点头，猛然转身，一拳放倒了那个陌生人。那人从井沿上栽下来，瘫在尘土里，两眼发直地望着天。%SPEECH_ON%你干吗打我？%SPEECH_OFF%他摸着嘴唇问。%monk%蹲下身。%SPEECH_ON%感觉怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人龇牙吐了口血，说疼。修士点点头。%SPEECH_ON%觉得自己还活着吗？%SPEECH_OFF%那人站起来，拍掉身上的灰，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，有点。%SPEECH_OFF%两人聊了一阵。谈完后，那人愿意分文不取地加入战团。他还说，井里有不少物资，尽管拿去用，不过千万别往里掉火星，否则一准炸上天。}

afeef6a8a09d552d2543.source: The gods talk to you, %monk%, now you talk to him!
afeef6a8a09d552d2543.translation: %monk%，诸神会向你说话，现在换你去劝劝他！

6f26d1fb99b52df5c0dd.source: A string of bad fortune led the former arms-peddler %name% to attempt to end his life by blowing himself up, but
6f26d1fb99b52df5c0dd.translation: 接连遭遇厄运后，曾贩卖军械的%name%打算把自己炸死，好一了百了，不过

1f6a4ff46b7b32e26645.source: intervened and convinced him to join your company instead to make a new life for himself.
1f6a4ff46b7b32e26645.translation: 出面劝阻，让他加入你的战团，重新开始生活。

b623471a4de9691ce1d8.source: Had a string of bad fortune and lost everything
b623471a4de9691ce1d8.translation: 接连遭遇厄运，落得一无所有

8194f6c7b87255f99e20.source:
%terrainImage%{The desert is so awash in similarity that seeing a bit of greenery immediately draws the eye. Such is the magnetism of an oasis. You spot it at great distance, and upon approach you realize the green is not a tree at all, but a banner flying from the catch of a dead, dried tree. Around it are more dead trees, some having crumpled into the sands which eat at them from every side. And in the midst of this passed oasis sets a skeleton with its face down in a small bowl of earth where, perhaps, water once was. To the skeleton's side is a pile of treasures. All the crowns in the world, but not a single drop of water with which to spend it on.

 You move to get the gold, but the coins move with you, sliding apart as a black snake rises up and hisses at you. Green poisons slickly drip from its fangs.}
8194f6c7b87255f99e20.translation:
%terrainImage%{沙漠千篇一律，哪怕一抹绿色，也足以牢牢吸住目光。绿洲便有这样的诱惑。你远远看见那点绿，走近才发现，根本不是树，而是一面挂在枯枝上飘动的旗。周围还有更多死树，有些已倒入沙中，被流沙从四面吞噬。这片逝去的绿洲中央，一具骷髅俯着脸，趴在一小块碗状凹地里，那儿或许曾经有水。骷髅身旁堆着财宝。钱再多，也换不来这里早已消失的一滴水。

 你伸手去取金子，钱币却随之滑动散开。一条黑蛇昂起头，朝你嘶鸣，绿色毒液从獠牙上黏滑地滴落。}

d2caff75eabedb3dbeb1.source: %terrainImage%{%brother% walks forward with his weapon in hand. The snake rears up and the man stabs it clean through, instantly killing the creature. He holds it up at the end of his steel, wriggling its flesh before tossing it aside.%SPEECH_ON%Easiest pay I've ever had.%SPEECH_OFF%He says as the treasure is taken into the company's inventory.}
d2caff75eabedb3dbeb1.translation: %terrainImage%{%brother%手持武器走上前。蛇昂起身子，他一击将它刺穿，当场杀死。他用兵刃挑起蛇身，晃了晃，随手抛开。%SPEECH_ON%我这辈子没挣过这么轻松的钱。%SPEECH_OFF%说话间，宝物已收入战团仓库。}

9943ab8e249f408933bd.source:
%terrainImage%{%brother% walks forward with his weapon in hand. The snake rears up and the man laughs and stabs down with his weapon. The snake deftly sidewinders around the steel and strikes up the shaft and nicks the man across his knuckles. Screaming, he falls backwards, and the men collect him and drag him off. Soon he is convulsing and frothing and his entire hand bulbs and spews pus.

You believe he'll survive, but it will be a great deal of time until he is ready to fight again. As for the treasure, it shifts in the sands and you can only watch as it slowly slips into the dune itself like a boat sinking into water. When you lean to see the last of it go, more black snakes emerge as if to warn you just who it belongs to: it's the desert's treasure now and forever.}
9943ab8e249f408933bd.translation:
%terrainImage%{%brother%提着武器走上前。蛇昂起头，他笑了一声，挥动武器向下猛刺。蛇灵巧地侧身游开，避过锋刃，顺着长柄蹿起，一口咬中了他的指关节。他惨叫着向后跌倒，弟兄们赶紧把他拖走。很快，他便浑身抽搐、口吐白沫，整只手肿成了一团，还往外冒着脓水。

你觉得他应该能活下来，但要重新上阵，恐怕得休养很久。至于宝藏，它在沙中松动，你只能眼睁睁看着它像船沉入水中一般，缓缓没入沙丘。你探身想看它最后一眼，却又有更多黑蛇钻了出来，仿佛是在警告你，宝藏究竟属于谁：它属于沙漠，从此永远如此。}

63d586fc2d2b00387fe6.source: %terrainImage%{%beastslayer% looks down at the snake. He nods as though recollecting an old lesson.%SPEECH_ON%You only see these in the dunes. Highly venomous.%SPEECH_OFF%The serpent hisses at him. The man nods back before shooting a hand out and snatching the snake by its head.%SPEECH_ON%Your venom begin and ends in your mouth, little one, but I can use it everywhere. I trust that you will be understanding of the trade.%SPEECH_OFF%The man cracks the snake's head before cutting it clean off with a small blade and he pinches his finger over the reptile's stringy corpse. He nods again.%SPEECH_ON%I'll make use of the snake, and I trust you captain to make use of the treasure.%SPEECH_OFF%}
63d586fc2d2b00387fe6.translation: %terrainImage%{%beastslayer%低头看着那条蛇，点了点头，仿佛想起了过去学过的本领。%SPEECH_ON%这种蛇只在沙丘里才有，毒性极强。%SPEECH_OFF%蛇朝他嘶嘶吐信。他又点点头，随即猛地伸手，一把捏住蛇头。%SPEECH_ON%小家伙，你这毒只能靠嘴来用，我却能拿它做不少事。我想，你会体谅这笔买卖的。%SPEECH_OFF%他捏碎蛇头，又用小刀将其齐根切下，手指夹着那细长的蛇尸，再次点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%这条蛇我自有用处。至于宝藏，团长，我相信您也知道该怎么花。%SPEECH_OFF%}

560d201ca95e706d08d8.source: %terrainImage%{You've heard of such snakes killing men outright. With that threat on the table, you do not feel it worth the trouble and leave the treasure behind.}
560d201ca95e706d08d8.translation: %terrainImage%{你听说过这种蛇能当场要人性命。既有这份危险，宝物便不值得冒险，你们将它留在了原地。}

31f3d38019ccd37092af.source: This is not worth our trouble.

fa6f9af77469b20aca3f.source: Was bitten by a desert snake

7260639f236a5e7cb266.translation: 运用了自己对野兽的了解

639e3243c848317d0ada.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{A fire juggler has the eyes of everyone in a plaza of %townname%. He's got a trip-set of torches with bronze handles. His routine goes fairly well, but he does drop a torch at one point which raises some jeers in return. The next act he is to place a board over an open barrel of oil and then juggle the torches, arms out at his sides, except now with five torches instead of three.

In summary, his next act seems to be one of suicide and he unsurprisingly looks reluctant to follow through with it. But the crowed continues to cheer and jeer, no doubt snorting and huffing like a wolf pressing a deer to the cliffside, and the juggler, wide-eyed looks around for some form of escape.}
639e3243c848317d0ada.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{%townname%的广场上，一个耍火的艺人吸引了所有人的目光。他轮番抛接三支铜柄火把，整套表演还算顺利，只是中途失手掉了一支，引来几声嘲笑。接下来，他要在一桶敞口的油上架块木板，站到上面，双臂向两侧展开，继续抛接火把。而且这回要从三支增加到五支。

说白了，下一个节目简直就是寻死。他迟迟不敢开始，也在情理之中。可人群依旧喝彩起哄，喷着鼻息，像狼一样把猎物往悬崖边逼。艺人瞪大了眼睛，四处寻找脱身的办法。}

03a1cb3f6c9d720b4774.source: Let's see how he does it.

c4a2b0bc486091966e23.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You sigh and step forward, yelling loudly at the juggler, feigning as though you are his manager, telling him he is not to give away the big show quite yet. The crowd quiets down, confused, then jeers at you. A draw of half your sword quiets them, and others murmur word of 'Crownling', manifesting a series of hisses and boos. But they ultimately disperse. The fire juggler steps down from his theater piece and thanks you repeatedly.%SPEECH_ON%I am not ready, I am not ready, and this you see with an eagle's eye, kind stranger! Here, my day's earnings, have all of it, for none of it would have meant a crown to me were I to step up there and die!%SPEECH_OFF%}
c4a2b0bc486091966e23.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你叹了口气，走上前去，大声训斥艺人，装作是管着他的人，责怪他不该这么早亮出压轴的绝活。人群先是不明所以地安静下来，随即冲你起哄。你把剑拔出一半，他们便闭上了嘴。另有人低声念叨“克朗客”，惹来一阵嘘声与喝倒彩声。不过，他们最终还是散了。艺人从表演的架子上下来，连声向你道谢。%SPEECH_ON%我还没准备好，真的没准备好！好心的陌生人，您眼光像鹰一样锐利，一眼就看出来了！拿着，这是我今天挣的，全给您。要是刚才我上去送了命，这些钱对我就连一个克朗都不值了！%SPEECH_OFF%}

8e819aa99d51a2e3576e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You cross your arms and await the show. The fire juggler swallows hard and gets up on the barrel. He lowers a torch down and one of the villagers lights it, but when the jester pulls the torch up the villager pretends to throw their own fire into the vat of oil. The juggler jerks away momentarily and the crowd laughs as the bemused jester laughs.

 But the jester nails the act. All five torches whirl and twirl and a couple of times an ember sputters down and hits the rim of the oil barrel, but he is in control, and the crowd's jeers turn to cheers and when he is done they clap and then slowly disperse, going on to the next form of entertainment. One man drops a few crowns in the juggler's hands and that's that.}
8e819aa99d51a2e3576e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你抱起双臂，等着看戏。耍火艺人用力咽了口唾沫，爬上油桶。他垂下一支火把，让一名村民点燃。可他刚把火把收上去，那村民就假装要将手里的火扔进油桶。艺人吓得猛地一缩，众人哄笑起来，他自己也只好尴尬地陪着笑。

 不过，他把这套节目完成得漂亮极了。五支火把翻飞旋转，虽有几次火星落到了桶沿上，场面始终稳稳地掌握在他手中。人群的嘲笑渐渐变成喝彩。表演结束，人们鼓了掌，随后慢慢散去，另找乐子。一个人往艺人手里塞了几枚克朗，这事便算完了。}

c23ec60cfc05c78f24e9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You cross your arms and await the show. The fire juggler swallows hard and gets up on the barrel. He lowers a torch down and one of the villagers lights it, but when the jester pulls the torch up the villager pretends to throw their own fire into the vat of oil. The juggler jerks away momentarily and the crowd laughs as the bemused jester laughs.

 When the jester starts his act, he begins with setting himself on fire. Literally the first torch slips his hand and goes right into the vat which launches a plume of flame from which there is no discerning between man and fire aside from the hellish screams. He scrambles off the 'stage' and the crowd only rears back to point and laugh. When he is dead, his crowns are taken by one of the residents. They lift the gold to the sky, make a passing mention of the Gilded one, then dump the crowns into the flames. His body is left for the dogs. After all is said and done, you kick around in the ashes and find a plate of melted gold. Not exactly of much value, but it's gotta be worth something and you take it when no one - not even the dogs - are looking.}
c23ec60cfc05c78f24e9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你抱起双臂，等着看表演。耍火艺人艰难地咽了口唾沫，爬上桶。他把火把递下去，一名村民帮忙点燃；可等艺人收回火把，那村民却假装要把自己手里的火扔进油桶。艺人吓得猛地一缩，人群哈哈大笑，他自己也不知所措地陪着笑。

 艺人的表演以点燃自己拉开了序幕。真就是第一支火把一脱手，直直落进油桶，冲起一大团烈焰。除了凄厉得如同地狱传来的惨叫，已分不清哪里是人、哪里是火。他挣扎着扑下“舞台”，人群却只是向后躲开，指着他笑。等他死了，一名居民取走他身上的克朗，将金币举向天空，随口念了句镀金者，又把钱全倒进火里。尸体则留给了狗。一切结束后，你用脚拨了拨灰烬，找到一片熔成饼的金子。虽算不上多值钱，总归也能卖点什么。趁没人看见——连狗都没看见——你把它收了起来。}

2938b778737e7eec01dd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{%juggler%, the company's own former juggler, steps forward. He walks up on the 'stage' which precariously hangs over the vat of oil. The two exchange words, then %juggler% is the one left standing. He performs the act - one he has neither practiced nor seen before - and completes it without issue. The crowd is silent, though. They merely watch, only occasionally glancing at you and the company. When %juggler% finishes he opens his arms wide, but there is no applause.%SPEECH_ON%The Gilded spits on Crownlings, interloper, you dance for no one. And you, fire juggler, what do you have to say for yourself?%SPEECH_OFF%%townname%'s fire juggler thinks, then turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%I say I am tired of this nonsense, and if the Gilded one so despises us, then I'll have him despise me between the ranks of this here company. What say you, captain of the Crownlings, will you take me aboard?%SPEECH_OFF%}
2938b778737e7eec01dd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{战团里曾做过杂耍艺人的%juggler%走上前，踏上摇摇欲坠地架在油桶上的“舞台”。两人说了几句，随后只剩%juggler%留在上面。他开始表演这套既没练过、也没见过的把戏，竟顺顺利利地完成了。观众却始终沉默，只是盯着看，偶尔瞥你和战团几眼。%juggler%演完，张开双臂，却没有半点掌声。%SPEECH_ON%镀金者唾弃克朗客。外乡人，没人稀罕你卖弄。还有你，耍火的，有什么话要说？%SPEECH_OFF%%townname%的耍火艺人想了想，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%我要说，这些荒唐事我受够了。镀金者既然如此厌恶我们，那就让我站进这支战团里，继续让祂厌恶好了。克朗客的团长，您意下如何，肯收下我吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

d39dad6a33e64d840b4e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Fireling, Crownling, whatever. You're with the %companyname%.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd hisses again, but you tell them to fuck off, peppering the threat with a flash of your sword just in case they had any problems understanding. %firejuggler%, the fire juggler, thanks you profusely and quickly goes to your ranks where the company welcomes him about as begrudgingly as they do any new recruit. As for %townname%'s people, they quickly tire of the drama and move on with their lives.}
d39dad6a33e64d840b4e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你点头。%SPEECH_ON%火焰客也好，克朗客也罢。现在你属于%companyname%。%SPEECH_OFF%人群再次发出嘘声，你叫他们滚蛋，还亮了一下剑，免得有人听不明白。火焰杂耍艺人%firejuggler%连声道谢，迅速跑进队伍。战团对他的欢迎，和对任何新人一样勉强。至于%townname%的居民，很快便对这出戏失去兴趣，各忙各的去了。}

c432ae39499be9b9bbb2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{You shake your head. The fire juggler lowers his.%SPEECH_ON%Oh. I thought we had a thing here.%SPEECH_OFF%Pursing your lips, you shake your head again.%SPEECH_ON%No...there is no 'thing' here. I just don't want you in my company, no hard feelings. Keep, uh, practicing. You know, with the fire, and the sticks, you'll get it someday I'm sure.%SPEECH_OFF%The fire juggler nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course. And though you have rejected me, I believe the Gilder has us both just where we are meant to be, and that His intention was not for our paths to cross fruitlessly. I will be sure to speak highly of your company wherever I go!%SPEECH_OFF%}
c432ae39499be9b9bbb2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_163.png[/img]{你摇摇头。耍火艺人垂下脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%哦。我还以为，咱们之间挺有缘分。%SPEECH_OFF%你抿着嘴，又摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%没有……谈不上什么缘分。我只是不想招你进战团，别往心里去。继续，呃，多练练吧。就是那些火啊、棍子啊，我相信你总有一天能练好的。%SPEECH_OFF%艺人点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然。您虽拒绝了我，我依然相信，镀金者已将我们各自安置在应在之处。祂让我们相遇，必不会毫无意义。无论今后走到哪里，我都会向人称颂您的战团！%SPEECH_OFF%}

520f13871c7adcfa991d.source: May the Gilder's path for us both be as good as you hope.

8978beab56967b156ef3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]{角斗士们要求改善伙食。%SPEECH_ON%恕我直言，“团长”，你打算让我拿这东西怎么办？%SPEECH_OFF%%gl%举起一条面包。%SPEECH_ON%肉呢？看看它。好好看！谁做的？面包师？你让我吃面包师烤的面包？我要吃会反抗的东西。面包会反抗吗？我看不会。%SPEECH_OFF%看来，角斗士们虽已远离竞技场，却还惦记着那里厨子天天伺候出来的好日子。也许该找些种类丰富的上好食物，才能让他们消停。 | %SPEECH_START%好吃的都去哪儿了，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%%gl%举起一块吃食，纤维拉成丝，在他手里软塌塌地晃动。%SPEECH_ON%这不是角斗士吃的，这是给软蛋吃的！%SPEECH_OFF%他转身将食物扔出去，啪地粘上战团货车的侧板，又慢慢滑脱，弯卷得像只倒挂的钩子。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我们要好饭好菜，不要这些膻腥的破烂！%SPEECH_OFF%你大概该想办法，弄些更合角斗士胃口的食物。 | %SPEECH_START%酒呢？美味佳肴呢！%SPEECH_OFF%%gl%抓起食盘，像掷铁饼般甩了出去。盘子飞得出奇地远，食物碎屑沿途撒出一片，白白浪费了大把热量。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我要美味佳肴！我的美味佳肴在哪儿？%SPEECH_OFF%看来，角斗士们需要更精细的伙食。}

f9959ba108c5d937a335.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]{%gl1%看着%gl2%对着兵刃的光泽当镜子，拔修眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%%gl2%，你这背看着又厚又紧实。就该这样，兄弟。%SPEECH_OFF%角斗士转身点头。%SPEECH_ON%谢了，我就靠它扛着整个战团呢。%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%看看动作！看看动作！%SPEECH_OFF%%gl1%蹲到一半，大声喊着。%gl2%冲过来，一掌托住角斗士的屁股，喊了声“下！”。那人继续蹲下，远远超过九十度。%SPEECH_ON%真紧实！%SPEECH_OFF%%gl2%确认道。%SPEECH_ON%有多紧？%SPEECH_OFF%%gl2%收回一只手，握成拳，朝那屁股打了一拳，随即甩个不停，像碰了滚烫的锅。%SPEECH_ON%比维齐尔的钱袋还紧！%SPEECH_OFF%%gl1%做完深蹲，站起身，两人撞了撞胸。%SPEECH_ON%轮到你了，兄弟！来吧！%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%嘿，瞧这个。%SPEECH_OFF%%gl1%的胸脯开始跳动，一边一下。你说了句“好奶子”，便想离开，他却抓住你。%SPEECH_ON%不是奶子，是胸肌。而且很漂亮。嘿，说它们漂亮。%SPEECH_OFF%左边一跳，右边一跳，来来回回。你叹口气，说它们很漂亮。%gl1%点头，抹去眼角的什么东西。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢，团长。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你发现%gl1%正拿%gl2%做卧推，后者随着身体上下起伏，还在读卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%听说%randomcitystate%的女人很漂亮。%SPEECH_OFF%他回头看了看举着自己的人。%gl1%瞥你一眼，又专心练习。%SPEECH_ON%九十八，九十九，一百！好了，翻身。%SPEECH_OFF%%gl2%翻过身，%gl1%的双手陷进他胸腹的肌肉里。%SPEECH_ON%好，再来一百下。%SPEECH_OFF% | %gl1%竖起四根手指，%gl2%竖起六根。%gl1%歪头笑了。%SPEECH_ON%一晚上？%SPEECH_OFF%另一名角斗士点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，就一晚上。%SPEECH_OFF%%gl1%笑着问，是不是全是女人。%gl2%迟疑了一下。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，也有几个男人。不过我们可没，你懂的，碰彼此什么的。倒是靠得挺近，因为有一阵他在下面，我就这么待在后边——%SPEECH_OFF%你拍着手走过去，不是鼓掌，而是叫角斗士们收收心。你理解路途漫长又乏味，可这话题已经越来越不像话了。 | %gl1%绷起双臂的肌肉。%SPEECH_ON%我一条胳膊就能拧断骡子的脖子。%SPEECH_OFF%%gl2%摇头，问那他为什么两条胳膊都在使劲。%gl1%歪了歪头。%SPEECH_ON%显然，因为我打算同时杀两头骡子啊，兄弟。%SPEECH_OFF%你打断他们，告诉角斗士，先完成%companyname%的正经差事，再谈杀什么动物——虽然这些差事有时确实就是杀动物。 | %gl1%坐到%gl2%身边，背过身，说道。%SPEECH_ON%把手放我脊背上，就两肩之间。%SPEECH_OFF%另一名角斗士不问缘由，也不好奇，直接照做。随后，%gl1%绷紧肌肉，将那只手夹在两团肌肉之间。%SPEECH_ON%这力量怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%%gl2%依然毫无讥讽或疑惑，认真答道。%SPEECH_ON%太棒了，兄弟！我都听见手骨咔咔响了！%SPEECH_OFF%你想打断，可严格说来，还没人受伤……暂时没有。于是，你让角斗士们继续满足自己的，呃，癖好。 | %SPEECH_START%我就让她这么趴在水果车上，正玩得痛快，她爹进来了。他张着嘴，几乎一句话也说不出来。%SPEECH_OFF%%gl1%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%于是我跟他说，看着。然后我往后一站，双臂绷紧，慢慢地，特别慢地，她就离了地。%SPEECH_OFF%%gl2%拍了一下对方油亮的胸膛。%SPEECH_ON%胡扯！全是鬼话！%SPEECH_OFF%角斗士举起手。%SPEECH_ON%以镀金者的光辉起誓，也以任何愿意欣赏我身体的神明起誓，这是真的。我的杆子有的是劲儿。%SPEECH_OFF%}

5b15faaf7c456de11ca4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]{%gl1%冲进帐篷。%SPEECH_ON%团长！快，%gl2%需要帮忙！%SPEECH_OFF%你赶忙跑出去，发现%gl2%正坐在篝火前，浑身都在发抖。%gl1%告诉你，他做了个噩梦。%SPEECH_ON%他梦见自己瘦得连一篮苹果都提不起来。女人朝他吐口水，孩子们吓得逃开。他还去了竞技场，可只能坐在看台上！%SPEECH_OFF%%gl2%悲伤地抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%团长，连座位都不好。连座位都不好啊。%SPEECH_OFF%}

5f23775e4d1f70786534.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_171.png[/img]{A series of camels come into view. They've dozens of satchels and knapsacks bobbing at their sides, and large umbrellas hoisted above. The camels are guided by a singular jockey riding the lead mount: an old man seated side-saddle with one foot in a stirrup and the other balancing a plate. He's eating nuts and berries and enjoying a cool beverage. He is nonplussed at the sight of you.%SPEECH_ON%Crownlings, yes? I can tell by your swagger, the braggadocio alchemists, transmuting raw gold in the copper of his fellow man's blood. I do not look down upon you, Crownling, and you shan't look upon me as prey to the brigandage that I know pulses whimsically in your heart.%SPEECH_OFF%He holds up a stick with a black mark at the top, his thumbnail pressed into it.%SPEECH_ON%I carry saltpeter for the Viziers' various war machines. You see, the great cast iron shots do not travel high and far without my ingredient, this here gentle dust which fills my camels' every bag. Were you to think yourself a brave robber I will set alight my wares and make us all together shine so bright the Gilder Himself shall shade His very eyes.%SPEECH_OFF%}
5f23775e4d1f70786534.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_171.png[/img]{一队骆驼出现在视野里，身侧挂着几十只晃来晃去的挎包与背囊，头顶支着大伞。整支驼队只有领头坐骑上的一个人带领：一位老人侧坐着，一只脚踏在镫里，另一只脚托着盘子。他正吃着坚果和浆果，喝着清凉的饮料，见到你也不慌张。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，对吧？看这大摇大摆的派头就知道，一群爱吹嘘的炼金术士，从同胞带着铜腥气的鲜血里炼出真金。我并不轻视你，克朗客，你也别把我当成可以随手抢劫的猎物。我知道，你心里那点强盗念头正时不时地蠢动。%SPEECH_OFF%他举起一根顶端带黑色印记的细棍，将拇指甲抵在上面。%SPEECH_ON%我运的是硝石，供维齐尔们的各式战争机器使用。要让巨大的铸铁炮弹飞得又高又远，少不了我的这味原料，也就是装满骆驼上每只袋子的细粉。你若自认是个胆大的强盗，我就点燃这些货，让我们一同亮得连镀金者本尊都得抬手遮眼。%SPEECH_OFF%}
