Hopefully, with a bit of time, he might get better. | %anatomist% isn't necessarily sick from drinking his potions. After all, he is still able to move and get around, and even fight if necessary. But he is certainly affected by said potions in a manner most unsightly. Great boils have appeared on his cheeks, and occasionally his eyes spring from their sockets and he has to push them back in which is something you wished you hadn't seen. Strings of drool come down the corners of his lips and his nostril is home to snails of snot and boogers and blood. As you can imagine, he is rather down about the whole looking uglier than a dead pig carcass-thing, but you've faith that in good time he will get better.}
e9bf3763ad31e76f6fb7.translation:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{%anatomist%坐在篝火边，近得有些过头。你把他往后拉了拉，免得烧着。他抬起头，脸上布满脓疱，已经破裂的脓液油腻地糊成一片。%SPEECH_ON%我开始怀疑，喝下那瓶药剂是不是犯了大错。%SPEECH_OFF%他又往火边挪，眼神里透着一股想把自己扔进去的意味。你帮不了太多，主要是他眼下实在恶心得厉害，你不太想再碰他。 | 你发现%anatomist%站在战团货车旁，挽起袖子，用手指抠着胳膊上的古怪斑痕。你好奇地问，是不是胎记。解剖学者转身摇头，掀起上衣，让你看见这种斑痕已遍布全身。皮肤被丑陋的颜色染得斑驳，看起来粗糙不平，像揭不掉的痂。%SPEECH_ON%是我喝的药剂弄的，我不知道该拿自己怎么办。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，说一定会好起来。他叹口气，只是放下衣服，移开目光。 | %anatomist%站在一桶水前，看着其中黯淡的倒影，叹了口气。你问他怎么样，他转身，露出皮肤上可怕的疹子和疖肿。%SPEECH_ON%说实话，不太好。我服用的配方似乎产生了严重的不良影响，虽然这样措辞，或许还太客气了。我能活下来，可受到的伤害，不仅在皮肤和身体，也在心智。我原以为，自己早已超脱这类顾虑。如今看见这张可怕的脸……却始终不得安宁。%SPEECH_OFF%你捏了捏他的肩膀，又拍拍后背，提些多喝水、别太难过之类的建议。你本来就不擅长安慰男人，更别说这种因学术狂热惹上可怕怪病的人。 | 解剖学者%anatomist%情绪低落。他亲手调制、又迫不及待喝下的药剂，令全身患上种种毛病，从皮疹、疖肿，到奇怪的抽搐，还有流不完的鼻涕。你向他保证会好起来，可这副骇人模样，正让他备受折磨。 | 解剖学者%anatomist%配制的古怪药液，他也一直往自己肚里灌。结果毫不意外：皮疹、感染、异味、脱发，还有更多。他嘴上宣称一切为了学术，可你看得出来，这些病症与毁容，正在一点点摧垮他的士气。你只能盼着，时间能让他好起来。 | 那些远超你理解的学术研究，似乎总伴随着风险。你记得小时候，一个朋友冒险抓着绳子荡向河面，于是阴差阳错，大家都知道了，秋日的树枝究竟能承受多少重量。

如今，解剖学者%anatomist%似乎也在亲身体会，喝下自己那怪药后，会落得何种衰败。他浑身皮疹与感染，不知为何还格外招蚂蚁。那些小东西如今昼夜不停地往他身上爬，原因无人知晓。但愿过些时日，这些病症能消退，也把该死的蚂蚁一并带走。 | 你早知道解剖学者们脑子有些不对，可看他们不停配药、往自己肚里灌，仍叫你目瞪口呆。就连水，杯子选错都可能有毒，更别说那些从当日各种学术念头的泥潭里蒸馏出来的整瓶怪物。果然，没过多久，其中一个书呆子%anatomist%便病了。他还能走动，也能料理日常事务，可巨大的疣和渗漏的脓疱，让人不忍直视。他也许自认早已远离俗世，但顶着一副擦过猪粪的破布模样到处走，肯定无益于心神。但愿给他些时间，还能好起来。 | %anatomist%喝下药剂后，倒不一定算是病了。毕竟，他还能活动、四处走动，必要时甚至能打仗。不过，药剂带来的变化，确实难看得出奇。两颊长出巨大疖肿，眼珠偶尔还会弹出眼窝，他得亲手推回去——这一幕，你真希望自己没见过。嘴角垂着一丝丝涎水，鼻孔里盘着蜗牛般的鼻涕、鼻垢和血。可想而知，对自己如今比死猪尸体还丑这回事，他十分沮丧。不过，你相信，慢慢总会好起来。}

a2267f185c47826f04ed.source: Upset at how his mutations have changed him
a2267f185c47826f04ed.translation: 为突变给自己带来的变化而苦恼

295905fd8af6f9f26168.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{You come into %townname% to find a white bearded and eloquent elder helping a family with their ill child. To you, this sight isn't anything unusual. To %anatomist% the anatomist, however, some great offense is at hand. So quick is his walk across the road to the elder that you jump in front of him, sensing that whatever it is he aims to do might reflect poorly on the %companyname% as a whole. %anatomist% stands up straight.%SPEECH_ON%Excuse me, this man is dispensing poor medical advice. He needs to be corrected.%SPEECH_OFF%Mindful of the natives, you warn him that it can be unwise to try and wedge yourself in on local customs, of which an elder is almost assuredly the spearpoint of. He might be and likely is of even greater import as well, such as overseeing the local militia. The anatomist, however, is rather diligent about the task, and seeks to weaponize his own knowledge and use it even if it tears the local politic apart.}
295905fd8af6f9f26168.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{你来到%townname%，看到一位口齿伶俐的白胡子长者，正在帮一户人家照料生病的孩子。你觉得这没什么稀奇，解剖学者%anatomist%却像是看到了什么不可饶恕的事。他快步穿过街道，直奔长者而去。你察觉他接下来要做的事可能会让整个%companyname%名声受损，赶忙闪到他面前拦住去路。%anatomist%挺直了身子。%SPEECH_ON%劳驾让一让，这个人正在传授错误的医治方法，必须纠正。%SPEECH_OFF%顾及周围的当地人，你提醒他，贸然干涉此地的习俗并不明智，而这位长者几乎肯定是拥护这些习俗的头面人物。他也许还担任着更重要的职务，比如统领当地民兵，而且很可能确实如此。可解剖学者仍执意要管，打算拿自己的学识当武器，哪怕把当地的人情关系搅得天翻地覆，也非出手不可。}

3d3debc368210f91bbc3.source: Go on and correct him then.

a8917ede069ce3de159e.source: It's not worth upsetting the locals.
a8917ede069ce3de159e.translation: 不值得为这事得罪当地人。

b725edfa8e27000288b3.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{You think it over for a time, and decide to let the anatomist do as he pleases. Stepping aside, you turn to watch the goings on, hoping that this won't be an event to tarnish the %companyname%'s name any more than this quack already seems determined to do. %anatomist% sidles next to the old man and they look at each other for a moment, and a few peasants stare over as well. The anatomist pops a squat and asks the old man if he knows that the information he is giving out is incorrect.

Surprisingly, the old man is receptive to the occasion, and the two sit and talk for a long while. Instead of being offended by some outsider's input, the townspeople are equally enthralled by any knowledge he might have. There's some disagreements about trivial matters, but %anatomist% himself is so warmed by the reception that he handwaves them away and even lies and says those matters are still yet to be medically settled. By the time it is all over, the anatomist hands off some notes to the old man, and the village in turn give him a bevy of treats and goods as thanks.}
b725edfa8e27000288b3.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{你考虑了一会儿，决定让解剖学者按自己的意思去做。你退到一旁看着，只盼这事别让%companyname%的名声更糟——这位庸医看起来已经很乐意给战团惹麻烦了。%anatomist%挨到老人身旁，两人对视片刻，几个农民也望了过来。解剖学者蹲下，问老人知不知道，自己正在传授错误的医治方法。

出乎意料，老人很愿意听，两人坐着聊了许久。镇民们也没因外乡人插嘴而生气，反而对他带来的学问同样着迷。双方在一些细枝末节上仍有分歧，可%anatomist%被这番热情接纳打动，挥挥手就不再计较，甚至违心地说，那些问题在医学上还没有定论。最后，解剖学者把一些笔记交给老人，村民们则送他许多吃食和物品，以表谢意。}

2303ff97f142dcda2220.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{You think it over for a time, and decide to let the anatomist do as he pleases. Stepping aside, you turn to watch the goings on, hoping that this won't be an event to tarnish the %companyname%'s name any more than these quacks already seem determined to do. %anatomist% sidles next to the old man and they look at each other for a moment, and a few peasants stare over as well. The anatomist pops a squat and asks the old man if he realizes he is a charlatan. You put your head in your hands. The old man stands up and pushes the anatomist backward.%SPEECH_ON%And who the fark are you, huh? A traveler with a toolbox of fancy vocabulary, huh?%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist holds his hands out and plainly explains himself to be an intelligent, very well educated man from- before he can even finish, a peasant comes over and decks him, knocking him right into the mud. The %companyname% jumps in to save the anatomist and in the scuffle a few more blows are exchanged, but thankfully that's where it ends. You get %anatomist% back into your ranks and order everyone to settle down before the sellswords-side of the %companyname% is drawn out into the open for all the laity to see. The elder nods and says he wishes not to invite the militia to these affairs. It seems everyone barely escaped a far more gruesome affair. %anatomist% only looks at the blood coming out of his nose and ponders if anyone has been counting time to see how long it takes to coagulate.}
2303ff97f142dcda2220.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{你考虑了一会儿，决定让解剖学者按自己的意思去做。你退到一旁看着，只盼这事别让%companyname%的名声更糟——这群庸医看起来已经很乐意给战团惹麻烦了。%anatomist%挨到老人身旁，两人对视片刻，几个农民也望了过来。解剖学者蹲下，问老人是否意识到自己是个江湖骗子。你双手抱住脑袋。老人站起身，一把将解剖学者推开。%SPEECH_ON%你他娘的又是谁？带着满箱花哨词儿的过路人，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者摊开双手，直截了当地解释，自己聪明过人，受过极好的教育，来自——话还没说完，一个农民便冲上来，一拳将他打进泥里。%companyname%的弟兄们立刻上前护住他，推搡间又互相挨了几下，好在也就到此为止。你把%anatomist%拉回队伍，命令所有人冷静，免得%companyname%作为佣兵团的狠辣本性，彻底亮在这群平民眼前。长者点点头，说自己也不想把民兵叫来。看来，所有人都险些卷入一场血腥得多的冲突。唯独%anatomist%仍盯着自己流出的鼻血，琢磨有没有人在计时，好看看究竟多久才能凝固。}

813bc5ddedc1444cf537.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{%anatomist% moves to get past you, but you put your hand to him and hold him where he is. You explain that correcting locals on their own customs and beliefs is dangerous ground to trod on, and as a sellsword you're already distrusted and seen in a bad light. The last thing you need is a few embers blown onto the drywood that is villager traditions. The anatomist protests, but you holdfast. If he wants to go around correcting everyone and everything, he can return to the schools or universities from which he came. Eventually, %anatomist% slinks off. You glance back at the town elder just in time to see him bite the head off a frog and pour its blood into a bowl for future divinations.}
813bc5ddedc1444cf537.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{%anatomist%想从你身边挤过去，你伸手拦住了他。你解释说，当面纠正当地人的习俗与信仰，是件很容易惹祸的事。身为佣兵，你们本就不受信任，名声也不好，犯不着再往村民的传统这堆干柴上添火星。解剖学者还想争辩，你却丝毫不让步。他若非要见人就纠错，不妨回自己原来的学堂或大学去。最后，%anatomist%悻悻地走了。你回头望向镇上的长老，正好看见他一口咬掉青蛙的脑袋，把血倒进碗里，留作日后占卜之用。}

c1d24569b97099f55cb0.source: Let's get on on the road.

6a6c68b0d7d80970eaf5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{As %anatomist% tries to move past you, %monk% the monk intervenes. He stands by the anatomist and calmly explains that just because someone is wrong needn't mean that a foreign party step in and correct them. The loss of face in the public's eye is not going to end with the individual being corrected, it will merely bring the light of scrutiny back upon the one doing the criticizing. %anatomist% thinks this over for a time.%SPEECH_ON%Are you telling me that the error here is not in the poor advice being given out, but in the community as a whole being so maligned with falsehoods that an entrance of truth would do not all but stoke a fire to protect what they wrongfully believe?%SPEECH_OFF%The monk purses his lips and shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Sure.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist does not combat it any further and walks off, perhaps mulling over some scientific element to the affair. After he is gone, the monk shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I just don't want him being an arse and getting the %companyname% in more trouble than it needs to be.%SPEECH_OFF%You agree, and thank the monk for putting it in better words than you ever could.}
6a6c68b0d7d80970eaf5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{%anatomist%正想绕过你，修士%monk%上前拦了下来。他站在解剖学者身旁，平静地解释：别人说错了，并不意味着一定要由外人介入纠正。让人当众失了面子，事情不会随着错误被纠正就结束，反而会让众人将审视的目光投向提出批评的人。%anatomist%琢磨了一阵。%SPEECH_ON%你的意思是，问题并不在于这个人在传授错误的建议，而在于整个群体都被谬误浸染得太深，以至于真相一旦闯入，非但无益，反而会激起他们的怒火，让他们拼命捍卫自己错信的东西？%SPEECH_OFF%修士抿起嘴，耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%是吧。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者没再争辩，转身走了，或许正在琢磨这件事里有什么值得研究的科学道理。等他离开，修士摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我只是不想让他犯浑，给%companyname%惹来不必要的麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%你深以为然，谢他把话说得如此妥帖，这一点你可做不到。}

ac63c9e73ff179189c03.source: %monk%, can you talk some sense into him?

db7f55fe27b425796028.source: Gave medical advice to a receptive audience
db7f55fe27b425796028.translation: 传授医理，听众虚心受教

73139294ba65e78e9c91.translation: 医术上的建议遭到拒绝

850395c40d3d7b718d05.source: Was denied the chance to correct improper medical practice
850395c40d3d7b718d05.translation: 未获准纠正错误的医术

8c6afc54e738dca9749d.source: Learned something about dealing with the peasantry
8c6afc54e738dca9749d.translation: 学到了一些与农民打交道的门道

12c0d4b106778a450ae1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{Despite the noise of the surrounding villagers and their commerce, %anatomist% opens up a book of dissections and starts poring through its contents. While a local peasant might not be able to read the texts, he can absolutely see the disgusting images drawn on the pages: lurid documentation of opened bodies, identifications of body parts the peasant didn't even know he had, and a number of inane symbolism that any layman would use to invite his own devilments. Unsurprisingly, the peasant takes an interest in the anatomist's tome.%SPEECH_ON%So are you some sort of sorcerer or something?%SPEECH_OFF%Smiling, %anatomist% turns and says if the peasant thought that was remotely true, would he ever ask it of him? The peasant leans back.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, so yer a wiseacre, huh? Some smartass with a book for fools.%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist% watches the peasant turn and leave, then looks at you with a wide grin.%SPEECH_ON%That peasant had a curious bulge on his cheek. He'll be dead within a year. Two if he's unlucky and death is too generous with its time.%SPEECH_OFF% | Taking a break from the road and sellswording, %anatomist% sets down on a stone and opens up one of his books. A few moments into his studies, a little girl approaches, flowers in hand. She hands him one and asks what it is he's reading. The anatomist holds up his book and turns it around. She stares at the grisly drawings of beasts and monsters ripped open and their curious insides churned out. After a pause, she slowly pushes the book down to stare at the anatomist holding it. She says.%SPEECH_ON%I know of a beast you could have.%SPEECH_OFF%You and the anatomist turn a keen ear. The little girl lowers her voice, nearly hissing with childlike conspiracy.%SPEECH_ON%My little brother. He's two, but I swear he forsakes the old gods and the devilry is in him.%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist% nods dutifully.%SPEECH_ON%But of course. I will put it in my notes to see to this matter, and if I have time I will find the foulness within your kin.%SPEECH_OFF%The little girl thanks the anatomist once more and gives him more flowers for his promised aid. %anatomist% holds the flowers softly, rolling them back and forth as he goes back to his reading, a small smile on his face. You're hoping that the smile is just an indicator that he's bemused by a child, and not that he actually wishes to see to some ungodly boy. | As the company takes a rest, a man stands off at the side of the path, watching curiously. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%You lot have the stench of death about you, but I can't say I'd take ye for butcherers or executioners. Yer something else entire.%SPEECH_OFF%Without missing a beat, %anatomist% steps up and eyes the man, getting right up in his face, and the man leans away, but doesn't retreat. The anatomist's lost gaze ends with a dutiful nod.%SPEECH_ON%You are right, we do carry a stench, as do you. Ours is a matter of science, yours a matter of disease. And yours, hmm, yes, yours is a hint of the pox. Lemme see your feet.%SPEECH_OFF%The peasant nervously declines the request. He steps back as the anatomist hunts forward, fingers clambering like a spider, his eyes wide. The man eventually screams and runs off. %anatomist% turns around with a smile.%SPEECH_ON%What a curious subject, that man. I believe he was very, very ill, but he does not yet know it. Oh well.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come across an open-air wagon carrying a casket, its pathing trailed by a retinue of mourners. %anatomist% steps out from the company and inquires about the death of the individual. They said it was from a beast's strike. Curious, the anatomist inquires what sort of beast would be capable killing a man. The people look at one another before opening the coffin to reveal a man with a small scratch across his cheek. The wound had long since turned dark purple with veins of green and other disturbing discoloration, evidence that his demise was one of being stricken. One of the peasants looks up.%SPEECH_ON%It was his housecat that did it. Nicked him right there, and he paid little mind to it, then the colors went out and wandered his flesh until he was dead within two nights.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist shares some words with the mourners then returns to you. He sighs.%SPEECH_ON%T'was a simple blighting. All he needed to do was clean the cut. Unfortunate, though I am happy that my learnings are giving me real world insights, even if it is too late to apply them.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what came of the cat. The anatomist nods and says it was in the coffin with its victim, the feline 'beast' tucked there seemingly unawares of its final destination.}
12c0d4b106778a450ae1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{周围村民叫卖来往，吵闹不休，%anatomist%却翻开一本解剖书，埋头钻研。当地一个农民虽不识字，却看得懂纸上那些恶心图画：被剖开的身体，骇人的记录；他连自己也有都不知道的部位，一一标明；还有一堆莫名其妙的符号，换个普通人照着摆弄，怕是只会招来邪祟。毫不意外，农民对解剖学者的书起了兴趣。%SPEECH_ON%所以，你是什么巫师之类的？%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist%笑着转过头，反问，若他真有半点相信这话，还敢当面这样问吗？农民向后一仰。%SPEECH_ON%噢，原来是个自作聪明的，嗯？捧本傻瓜书，就当自己了不起。%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist%看着农民转身离开，随后朝你咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%那农民脸颊上有个有趣的鼓包。一年内就会死。要是运气不好，死亡又太舍得耗时间，就得两年。%SPEECH_OFF% | 暂时歇下旅途与佣兵营生，%anatomist%坐到石头上，翻开一本书。刚读片刻，一个捧着花的小女孩走来，递给他一朵，问他在看什么。解剖学者举起书，转给她看。她盯着骇人的图画：野兽与怪物被剖开，奇异的内脏翻在外面。停了一阵，她慢慢按下书，望着后面的解剖学者，说道。%SPEECH_ON%我知道有头野兽，可以给你。%SPEECH_OFF%你和解剖学者都竖起耳朵。小女孩压低声音，带着孩子密谋时的认真，几乎是在嘶嘶耳语。%SPEECH_ON%我弟弟。他两岁，可我发誓，他背弃旧神，身体里住着魔鬼。%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist%郑重地点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然。我会记下来，留意此事。若有时间，便去查明你亲人身体里的邪恶。%SPEECH_OFF%小女孩再次道谢，为他承诺的帮助，又送上几朵花。%anatomist%轻轻捧着花，指间来回转动，重新读书，脸上挂着浅笑。你希望，这笑只是因为被孩子逗乐，而不是真想去处理什么亵渎神明的小男孩。 | 战团休息时，一个男人站在路边，好奇地观望，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%你们身上有股死味儿，可又不像屠夫或刽子手。你们是另一种人。%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist%立刻上前打量，脸几乎凑到对方面前。男人向后仰，却没有退走。解剖学者出神地看了一阵，郑重点头。%SPEECH_ON%说得对，我们有味道，你也有。我们的源自研究，你的源自疾病。而你的，嗯，没错，带着一点痘疮的气息。让我看看脚。%SPEECH_OFF%农民紧张地拒绝，往后退，解剖学者却像追猎般逼近，手指像蜘蛛爬动，双眼睁得大大的。那人终于尖叫着逃走。%anatomist%转身，面带微笑。%SPEECH_ON%多有意思的研究对象。我相信他病得很重，很重，只是自己还不知道。唉，也罢。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你遇见一辆敞篷货车，载着棺材，后面跟着一队送葬者。%anatomist%走出队列，询问死因。众人说，死者遭野兽袭击。解剖学者好奇地问，是什么野兽，竟能致人于死地。众人互相看看，随后打开棺材。里面的男人脸颊上，只有一道小小的抓痕。伤口早已变成深紫，延伸着绿色纹路和其他令人不安的异色，足见他死于病变。一名农民抬头说。%SPEECH_ON%是他家猫干的，就这儿，挠了一下。他没当回事，后来颜色就在肉里蔓延，两个晚上，人就没了。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者与送葬者说了几句，回到你身边，叹息道。%SPEECH_ON%只是普通的感染。他只需要清洗伤口。可惜。不过，我还是高兴，所学终于让我对现实有所洞察，哪怕已经来不及派上用场。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，猫后来怎样了。解剖学者点头，说它就在棺材里，陪着自己的受害者。那头猫科“野兽”蜷在其中，似乎还不知道自己将去往何处。}

298128888509b0822c51.source: If only he was this happy about mercenary work, too.
298128888509b0822c51.translation: 他要是干佣兵活时也这么开心就好了。

5a0ca4b433f325128283.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]{%anatomist% the anatomist spots something gleaming a little ways off the main path. You walk over and take a look. There's something dark and metallic in the distance. Perhaps a knight's corpse? Though it would make you wonder how he got there by himself. %anatomist% ponders aloud if perhaps something could be learned from the body of presumably great martial prowess. You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%Knights rarely die alone, and if they do they sure as shite don't keep their armor with them. It smells like a trap through and through.%SPEECH_OFF%}
5a0ca4b433f325128283.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]{解剖学者%anatomist%在离大路不远处发现一点闪光。你走过去查看，远处有个乌黑的金属物件。也许是具骑士的尸体？不过，他怎么会独自死在那儿？%anatomist%自言自语，琢磨着从这副想必武艺出众的身体上能学到什么。你摇头。%SPEECH_ON%骑士很少孤零零地死去。真死了，他妈的也不会还穿着一身甲。这怎么看都是个圈套。%SPEECH_OFF%}

326658417c5f384fdc5d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{Against your better judgment you go and take a look. You feel quite naked walking across the open ground to the knight, like a thief who steals by reaching all the way across the aisle. When you get to the knight, you pause and look around. No movement in the land around you. No bandits firing off a trap. No wolfpack finding its prey. You shrug and look down. The man is covered in decent armor and carrying a nice, albeit used sword. His face is dried out and the eyes gone. Dry birdshit crusts on the scuff of his chest armor. You order %anatomist% to get him out of the armor and carry it all back the wagon.%SPEECH_ON%What? Why do I have to do it?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him if he wants to study the body, then the price is he has to strip it down in the first place. Walking off, you tell him that when he puts it in the inventory to make sure to not crush any of the foodstuffs cause that armor does look a bit heavy. Also be sure to clean the bird shit off, too. %anatomist% sighs, but he's still happy to have access to the corpse of one 'hero.' You sometimes wonder what the anatomist would do if he found you dead like this...}
326658417c5f384fdc5d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{尽管理智劝你别去，你还是决定过去看看。穿过空地走向骑士时，你觉得自己毫无遮掩，活像个隔着整条过道伸手偷东西的贼。到了骑士身旁，你停下来环顾四周。周围毫无动静，没有强盗发动伏击，也没有狼群围上猎物。你耸耸肩，低头查看。这人穿着不错的盔甲，带着一把虽用过却仍很精良的剑。他的脸已干瘪，眼睛也没了，胸甲磨损处结着干硬的鸟粪。你命令%anatomist%把盔甲从尸体上剥下来，全部搬回货车。%SPEECH_ON%什么？为什么得我来？%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，想研究尸体，代价就是先把它剥干净。你边走边叮嘱，盔甲放进库存时别压坏食物，因为它看着挺重。另外，鸟粪也得擦干净。%anatomist%叹了口气，但能接触到一位“英雄”的尸身，终究还是高兴的。你有时不禁想，要是解剖学者发现你也这样死在路边，他会怎么做……}

465b9b382c8c97903080.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{You set out to the pile of armor which you hope is not at all the trap it looks like. %anatomist% is practically at your hip, his eyes eating up the prospective 'science' set before him, and his hands have a tome open and are fervently writing into it already.

Surprisingly, %noble% comes along, the man of noble background seeming to recognize the pile of armor itself. Indeed, as you get close he exclaims that it is a good friend of his from days gone by. You nod solemnly, but still say that the armor would be best used with the company instead of just wasting away here on the ground. The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%I think he would prefer the same. I'll get it off him.%SPEECH_OFF%Before he begins, %noble% turns to %anatomist% and tells him that he better not even dare to touch his friend. You go back to the wagon with the anatomist, who you've given the duty of carrying the armor itself. The now sweaty anatomist is upset that he did not get a chance to see the corpse, and %noble% is noticeably upset that the corpse itself was a good friend. All in all, it seems this damn dead man has caused more grief than he was possibly worth.}
465b9b382c8c97903080.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]{你朝那堆盔甲走去，但愿事情不像看上去那样是个陷阱。%anatomist%几乎紧贴在你身旁，两眼贪婪地盯着前方可供研究的“科学”，手里的大部头已经翻开，他正奋笔疾书。

出乎意料，%noble%也跟来了。这位贵族出身的弟兄似乎认得那身盔甲。果然，走近后，他惊呼，死者是自己从前的一位好友。你神情肃穆地点了点头，却仍表示，与其让盔甲扔在这里白白朽坏，不如拿来为战团所用。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我想，他也会希望如此。我来替他脱下。%SPEECH_OFF%动手前，%noble%转向%anatomist%，警告他，碰自己朋友一下的念头都别有。你让解剖学者负责搬盔甲，带着他回到货车旁。如今他累得满身是汗，又因为没机会查看尸体而满心不悦；%noble%则显然因死者是自己的好友而悲伤。总的来说，这该死的死人带来的烦恼，恐怕远超过他留下的这点好处。}

05452f05e7be1606723a.source: At least we got the armor.

622aabe289c90e088704.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_21.png[/img]{You decide to go take a look. As you cross the seemingly open plain you get a feeling you're being watched. Something about all this just feels wrong. Halfway across, you turn to %anatomist% and tell him that it's time to doubleback. He shakes his head and says that you've already come so far, why stop now? Before you can answer, an arrow whistles past your ear and the anatomist falls backward clutching his shoulder.

You gather the man up and drag him back to the wagon, arrows landing in the ground around you, tufts of dirt thrown over your boots, until they start hitting the wagon itself. Gathering up the company for a counter-attack, you see the would-be ambushers think better of their chances and run off, a few of them carrying the knight's armor with them. As you thought, the whole thing was a brigandine honeypot. %anatomist% will live, thankfully, and he's already writing in his book about the experience or perhaps, judging by his fascination with the arrow sticking out of him, writing about his grisly wound.}
622aabe289c90e088704.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_21.png[/img]{你决定过去看看。穿过那片看似空旷的平地时，你总觉得有人在盯着自己。这事处处透着不对劲。走到半途，你转头告诉%anatomist%，该原路返回了。他摇摇头，说都走了这么远，为什么现在放弃？你还没来得及回答，一支箭便擦着你的耳边呼啸而过，解剖学者捂着肩膀向后倒去。

你架起他往货车边拖，箭矢接连钉在周围的土地上，溅起的泥土飞落在你的靴子上，随后连货车也开始中箭。你召集战团准备反击，那群伏击者却掂量了一下胜算，转身逃走了，其中几个还带走了骑士的盔甲。果然不出你所料，这整件事就是拿身甲胄作饵，诱你上钩。好在%anatomist%性命无碍，而且已经开始在本子上记录这番经历了。不过，看他对身上那支箭着迷的样子，写的也可能是他那处骇人的伤口。}

81723b3ce617fdb6d3df.source: Next time I'll listen to my intuition.

c6ecd671869066cf36ab.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{Against your better judgment you go and take a look. You feel quite naked walking across the open ground to the knight, like a thief who steals by reaching all the way across the aisle. Nearing the corpse, you look back to ask the %anatomist% what his plans are for the dead body. You see the anatomist is standing stiff, his head back and eyes open, a nervous and jittery hand pointing forward. You look back to see the corpse moving, slowly gathering itself off the ground, moaning, croaking. The helm juts forward as filth pours through its openings. You draw your sword.

The black knight pushes itself up off the ground, its gauntlets falling away to reveal pale flesh beneath. It turns to look at you and there's a slight hue of red glowing somewhere in that frothing helm. You slash the sword down and the creature's head falls free, clanking against the ground as air sputters out of its neckholes. Sheathing your sword, you tell %anatomist% that if he wants something to study, well, there it is.%SPEECH_ON%Also be sure to carry its armor back to the wagon. Make sure to use your legs when you bend, don't want you hurting your back or anything.%SPEECH_OFF%You walk past the anatomist. He stares, gobsmacked, then closes his mouth and pulls out a quill pen and some scrolls. His fear is put behind him, and his usual self comes to the fore.%SPEECH_ON%A fresh specimen, up close, recently deceased, or perhaps it is re-deceased? Either way...we can learn so much from this.%SPEECH_OFF%}
c6ecd671869066cf36ab.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{尽管理智劝你别去，你还是决定上前看看。穿过无遮无掩的空地，走向骑士时，你觉得自己毫无掩护，像个伸长胳膊，隔着过道偷东西的贼。快到尸体旁，你回头想问%anatomist%打算怎么处理死者，却见解剖学者僵立原地，头向后仰，双眼圆睁，一只手紧张地抖着，直指前方。你转回去，发现尸体正在动，缓缓从地上撑起，呻吟、嘶叫。头盔向前一探，污秽从缝隙里倾泻而出。你拔出剑。

黑骑士撑地起身，手甲脱落，露出下面惨白的皮肉。它转头望你，那不断涌出秽物的头盔深处，隐约亮起红光。你挥剑斩下，怪物的头应声落地，铿锵作响，颈部断口里喷出断续气声。你收剑入鞘，告诉%anatomist%，既然想找东西研究，眼前便是。%SPEECH_ON%还有，记得把盔甲搬回货车。弯身时多用腿发力，可别闪了腰什么的。%SPEECH_OFF%你从解剖学者身旁走过。他瞪着眼，惊得合不拢嘴，随后终于闭上嘴巴，掏出羽毛笔与卷轴。恐惧被抛到脑后，平日的模样又回来了。%SPEECH_ON%新鲜标本，近在眼前，刚刚死亡，或者该说再次死亡？无论如何……能从它身上学到太多东西了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

781f4a20ac7c6b0fb606.source: You can also learn to bend with your knees, chop chop.
781f4a20ac7c6b0fb606.translation: 你也可以学着屈膝搬东西。快点。

74bc257d2eb377b9def5.source: Got to examine the corpse of a heroic knight
74bc257d2eb377b9def5.translation: 得以检查一名英勇骑士的遗体

ff32ecee545fc4be6c9f.source: Was denied the opportunity to examine a promising corpse
ff32ecee545fc4be6c9f.translation: 未获准检查一具很有研究价值的尸体

0c3e0b0c8c4dde21bc46.source: Saw the decaying remains of an old friend
0c3e0b0c8c4dde21bc46.translation: 看到了老友腐烂的遗骸

3a19e65ccb694c93e793.source: Got to study an interesting wound up close
3a19e65ccb694c93e793.translation: 得以近距离研究一道有趣的伤口

da87d013b49cc16420c3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{You find %anatomist% scouring a red book. He closes the book and sighs.%SPEECH_ON%As an anatomist, I am compelled to think that monsters, as you laymen would call them, do not merely appear for the sake of appearance. Instead, everything has a purpose. In a sense, and through the old gods, we can trust that these elements have in actuality a divine purpose. Yet, some of my peers have found bones of creatures that have not once been seen in the flesh. It appears that these entities have disappeared entirely. It begs the question: does such evidence entail that we, ourselves, will one day disappear? An affirmative on that front suggests, then, that the divinities above are not actually weighing their visions in our favor. We walk under the gaze of mere happenstance. A terrible thought, indeed.%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask what these mysterious monsters looked like. The anatomist opens the red book and shows you a drawing.%SPEECH_ON%They are quite similar to humans, but larger with implied bulkiness around the neck and shoulders. The skulls carry these notches, similar to that of horns, and the spinal columns have extra vertebrae with three of them near the top broadening out, as if they were holding onto something, something that would extend far from the body. See? Here? The back is almost like a bony mantle.%SPEECH_OFF%Interesting. You ask the anatomist if he's seen one of these skeletons for himself, and he says no. He says he's only seen it in the text. You ask if he paid for this text and he says he did. You ask him if perhaps the notion of old, bizarre monsters was but a mere sales pitch to get him to buy a book of bullshit. The anatomist ponders for a time. He nods and agrees that it is likely that he has purchased a spoof. He grows angrier by the second and suddenly throws the tome into the campfire, pledging himself to more earthly studies going forward. He thanks you for your ability to cut through the nonsense and eminence fronts this world puts on.}
da87d013b49cc16420c3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{你发现%anatomist%正在细读一本红皮书。他合上书，叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%身为解剖学者，我不得不认为，你们外行所谓的怪物，并非仅仅为了出现而出现。万物都有其目的。从某种意义上说，借由旧神，我们可以相信，这些存在确有神圣的使命。然而，有些同行找到了某些生物的骨骼，却从未有人见过它们活着的样子。看来，这些生灵已经彻底消失。问题便来了：这样的证据，是否意味着我们自身也终有一天会消失？若答案是肯定的，就说明头顶的神明，并没有特意眷顾我们。我们行走在世间，注视我们的，只是偶然。真是可怕的念头。%SPEECH_OFF%你好奇地问，那些神秘怪物长什么模样。解剖学者翻开红皮书，给你看一幅图。%SPEECH_ON%它们与人类颇为相似，但更大，颈肩似乎格外粗壮。颅骨带着这些突起，像角；脊柱还多了些椎骨，靠近上方的三块向外展开，仿佛承托着什么，一种能伸出身体很远的东西。看见了吗？这里，背部简直像一副骨质披肩。%SPEECH_OFF%有意思。你问，他是否亲眼见过这样的骨架。他说没有，只在书里看过。你又问，书是不是花钱买的，他说是。于是，你问，有没有可能，所谓古老怪物，不过是推销的说辞，为的就是骗他买一本胡说八道？解剖学者想了一阵，点头承认，自己很可能买了本编造的笑话。他越想越气，突然把书扔进篝火，发誓今后要做更脚踏实地的研究。他感谢你，能看穿世间的废话与装腔作势。}

54cc9704e2057c33c44b.source: Wasted time reading a sham demonology book
54cc9704e2057c33c44b.translation: 浪费时间读了一本胡编的恶魔学书籍

edeb021f560537239cf4.source: You helped him realize his demonology book was a farce
edeb021f560537239cf4.translation: 你让他明白，那本恶魔学书籍全是胡扯

346ca2b133a34a7fa7ca.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{You find %anatomist% crouching over a piece of log. He's got a trio of beetles laid out. One has a needle pinning it to the wood, its little legs pedaling haplessly in the air. Another is nothing but a bodied husk, its legs removed and set beside it. The last is in a small tin of water with a stone weighing it down. %anatomist% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%The duress these creatures can undergo is quite impressive. Physical damage does not allude to destruction as it does with us. Take these three, for example: pierced, dismembered, and drowning. Yet they all live. The efficiency is something else, wouldn't you agree?%SPEECH_OFF%Sure. You ask him where he even got all those beetles. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%They crawl all over us when we're sleeping. I just happen to stay up to catch them in the act. This underwater one, for example, I caught pecking at your ear opening.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him to continue his research and to capture as many beetles as he can.}
346ca2b133a34a7fa7ca.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{你发现%anatomist%正蹲在一截木头前，面前摆着三只甲虫。一只被针钉在木头上，细腿徒劳地蹬着空气；另一只只剩下躯壳，卸下的腿摆在旁边；最后一只泡在盛水的小铁罐里，被石头压着。%anatomist%摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%这些生物的耐受能力着实惊人。对我们来说，身受重创往往意味着死亡，它们却不同。就拿这三只来说，刺穿、断肢、溺水，可它们全都还活着。这样的生存本领非同寻常，你不觉得吗？%SPEECH_OFF%是啊。你问他从哪儿弄来了这么多甲虫。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我们睡觉时，它们就爬得我们满身都是。我只是恰好熬夜，抓了个现行。比如这只泡在水里的，我抓到它时，它正在啃你的耳朵眼。%SPEECH_OFF%你让他继续研究，甲虫能抓多少就抓多少。}

7e3416a7b97e23a5d047.source: I need to start sleeping with a helmet on.
7e3416a7b97e23a5d047.translation: 以后睡觉，我也得戴着头盔了。

faec55a638e750e22db7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{While in %townname%, you get wind of a local hero who had been recently buried. To you, this is idle news. The man probably wasn't even a hero if you compare him to anything above the level of rat-killer, so you pay it little mind. Naturally, the anatomists are of a different sort, and take to the news like flies to a cadaver's arse. They're propositioning that the company dig up this hero's corpse so that they might see by its shape and make what differentiates this 'heroic element' from the ordinary man. %anatomist% explains.%SPEECH_ON%A hero's corpse is not just another corpse. It is invigorated with something else entire, some alluring drive which separates it from the rest of us.%SPEECH_OFF%Having seen your fair share in life, you assure the anatomists that the corpse will look very much like any other. They're quite fervent about stealing a look, though, even if it offends the masses.}
faec55a638e750e22db7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{在%townname%，你听说一位当地英雄近日刚下葬。对你而言，这不过是闲闻。真要拿比打老鼠高明些的功绩来衡量，那人大概根本称不上英雄，你也就没放在心上。解剖学者们却不同，听见消息便像苍蝇盯上尸体屁股般兴奋起来。他们提议，让战团挖出这位英雄的尸体，好从形态与构造上找出那份“英雄特质”，看看究竟与常人有何不同。%anatomist%解释道。%SPEECH_ON%英雄的尸体绝非普通尸体。其中蕴含着完全不同的东西，某种令人着迷的动力，让他有别于我们这些常人。%SPEECH_OFF%见惯了生死，你向他们保证，挖出来也只会是一具寻常尸体。可他们仍热切地想偷看一番，哪怕因此触怒镇民也在所不惜。}

52d7663bddd62d2d3aeb.source: Alright, let's go dig it up.

0804a72d6fc58a9e14f9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{After much plying, the anatomists break down your defenses and you agree to go fetch the local hero's dead, cold, and allegedly heroically shaped body from the grave. There's much stealth and sneaking done in the matter as you traipse through the graveyard like a bunch of kids up to absolutely no good, which you might as well be. The hero's grave is easy enough to spot, as it is adorned with flowers and other niceties.

%anatomist% kicks the flowers out of the way and shovels off a kid's toy and hurls it across the graveyard. He quickly stakes his shovel and the digging starts. It doesn't take long, the soil so recently disturbed. A few items lie in the grave, and alongside them is the body itself: just an ordinary man with a pale visage. It is jerked up and out of the grave, the anatomists throwing it end over end like a piece of plywood and as it lands in the grass they chase after it like gremlins, slicing and dicing and digging into it with a disturbing fervor. When they're finished, they roll the body back into the grave, its shape more ragged and shredded than before. They complain that you were possibly correct, that a hero's body has no unusual aspects whatsoever. But rather than agree with the likes of an uneducated sellsword, they instead conclude that perhaps he wasn't a hero at all, and that their search will have to continue. You're just glad you didn't get caught.}
0804a72d6fc58a9e14f9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{解剖学者们软磨硬泡，终于说服了你。你答应去坟里，将那位本地英雄冰冷的尸身弄出来，据说他的体格也颇具英雄气概。你们鬼鬼祟祟地穿过墓园，活像一群没安好心的孩子——其实也差不多。英雄的坟很好认，上面摆满鲜花和各式祭物。

%anatomist%一脚踢开花束，又用铲子挑起一个孩子的玩具，远远甩到墓园另一边。他迅速将铲子插入土里，开始挖掘。墓土不久前才翻过，没花多少工夫便挖到底。墓中摆着几件物品，旁边就是尸体：不过一个面色苍白的普通人。解剖学者们将他猛地拽出坟坑，像扔块薄木板一样翻着抛到草地上，又如小妖怪般一拥而上，以令人不安的狂热切割、剖开、翻挖。完事后，他们把尸体滚回墓里，比先前更加残破不堪。他们抱怨说，也许你说得没错，英雄的身体并没有什么与众不同。可与其赞同一个没学问的佣兵，他们宁愿得出另一种结论：此人或许根本算不上英雄，研究还得继续。至于你，没被抓住就已谢天谢地了。}

2887d3f4b317a58a7888.source: Gross. Let's get out of here.

9db4f89b87839978ae9b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{After much plying, the anatomists break down your measly defenses and you agree to go fetch the local hero's dead, cold body from the grave. There's much stealth and sneaking done in the matter as you traipse through the graveyard like a bunch of kids up to absolutely no good, which you might as well be. You get to the graveyard and ask if any of them know the name of the hero. %anatomist% says he thinks it was, ironically, Mortimer.

You find such a named grave and begin the digging, but by the time you get down to the bottom of it you just find a dead cat, curled up and grey and decrepit with more worms than fur. As the anatomists hold it up, a shout shoots in from the treeline. You turn to see a young boy there crying and pointing. Before you can grab him, he turns and runs off shouting rather descriptive prose about your ill-designed venture. In return come the murmurs of the mob, and their words are lost in a frenzy, but you can still make out the name of the %companyname% and the racket a bevy of pitchforks make when they're clattering together. You turn to tell the anatomists to quit the digging only to see they're already halfway out of the graveyard and running for their lives. Cursing, you join them in the dishonorable retreat and cut out from town altogether.}
9db4f89b87839978ae9b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{解剖学者们软磨硬泡，终于攻破了你那点微弱的抗拒。你答应去坟里，把本地英雄冰冷的尸体弄出来。你们鬼鬼祟祟地穿过墓园，活像一群没安好心的孩子——其实也差不多。到了墓地，你问，有没有人知道这位英雄叫什么。%anatomist%说，好像叫莫蒂默，放在眼下这情形，倒颇有几分讽刺。

你们找到刻着这个名字的坟，开始挖掘，可挖到底，只发现一只蜷缩的死猫，灰扑扑，腐烂不堪，虫子比毛还多。解剖学者们刚将它举起，林缘便传来一声喊叫。你回头，看见一个小男孩哭着指向你们。还没来得及抓住他，他已转身跑开，沿路大喊，把你们这场糟糕勾当形容得相当清楚。回应他的，是人群渐起的嘈杂。愤怒的叫嚷已经听不清字句，你却仍能辨出%companyname%的名字，以及一堆干草叉碰撞的哗啦声。你转身想叫解剖学者们别挖了，才发现他们早已跑出半个墓园，正拼命逃命。你骂着脏话，也加入这场不光彩的撤退，干脆一口气逃出了镇子。}

7482baef84e4170ada83.source: The shit they get me into...
7482baef84e4170ada83.translation: 这帮人总把我拖进什么烂事里……

54467195ba5d62833f7d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{%graver% is suddenly at your side. The graveyard familiar stakes a filthy thumb into his chest.%SPEECH_ON%Wanna dig up a corpse? I'm yer man.%SPEECH_OFF%With his expertise on hand, you decide to go along with the anatomists' dire plans. You find the graveyard and set across it in search of the hero's grave. The whole place is a pauper's lot, but you eventually find a marking covered in fresh flowers and other adornments which the men gracelessly stomp and kick away. The groundwork is soon started and with %graver% on hand the body is dug up in incredible speed. The anatomists set to work on the corpse, hunched over it and murmuring to one another, their curled, cloaked forms like buzzards. %graver% meanwhile roots around in the grave itself before coming up with a weapon that had been tucked into a corner. It's a nice find, all things considered, and almost makes this series of events worth it. You turn around to see the anatomists kick the body back into the grave, its limbs coming out of shape and flopping stiffly every which way as the hero's face comes to a rest, eyes open, staring into the disturbed soil where the worms are out and prodding air. Everyone having gotten what they needed, you soon depart the place before the locals show up and lynch you to the last.}
54467195ba5d62833f7d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{%graver%忽然来到你身边。这位熟悉墓地的行家，用脏兮兮的拇指戳了戳自己的胸口。%SPEECH_ON%想挖尸体？找我就对了。%SPEECH_OFF%有这位行家帮忙，你决定配合解剖学者们那不祥的计划。你们找到墓园，穿行其间，寻找英雄的坟墓。这里尽是穷人的埋骨地，不过最终，你们发现一处墓碑，覆满鲜花和其他饰物。弟兄们毫不客气地将它们踩开踢走，随即动土。有%graver%出手，尸体转眼便被挖了出来。解剖学者们立刻围着尸身忙碌，弓着背，低声交谈，裹在斗篷里的蜷曲身影像一群秃鹫。%graver%则继续在墓穴里翻找，最后从角落取出一把藏着的武器。总体来说，这是个不错的收获，几乎让整场闹剧都变得值得了。你回过头，看见解剖学者们把尸体踢回坑里，四肢扭曲，僵硬地向各处甩动。英雄的脸终于停住，双眼仍睁着，盯向被翻动的泥土，那里的虫子正探出头，在空中摸索。人人都拿到了想要的东西，你们便赶紧离开，免得当地人赶来，把你们一个不剩地吊死。}

3290228cadec8f89ad63.source: Got to examine a hero's cadaver
3290228cadec8f89ad63.translation: 得以检查一位英雄的遗体

ea547d30ca4d912f1737.source: Was misled about the peculiarities of said cadaver
ea547d30ca4d912f1737.translation: 被骗得误以为那具尸体有特别之处

afb81fa9d716f4306c75.translation: 你的战团盗墓时被抓了现行

61f35a5791b7d0bea181.source: Was unable to exhume an unusual corpse
61f35a5791b7d0bea181.translation: 没能挖出那具奇异的尸体

8954790f26b8d429cda5.source: Got to examine a hero's unusual cadaver
8954790f26b8d429cda5.translation: 得以检查一位英雄的奇异遗体

f3c4753cf9b212566f31.source: Put his grave-exhuming skills to use

df05c9a6ad2d34fa0075.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{You come across a man being buried alive, an inference you take from the fact that he's bound like a dead man yet still screaming about the whole affair. You ask what is going on and one of the diggers turns and holds a hand out.%SPEECH_ON%Keep yer distance. This man is blighted and anyone he touches becomes blighted. We don't want no disease, and neither should you.%SPEECH_OFF%The man cries out for help as another clump of soil lands on him. He tries to climb back out of the grave but one of the diggers kicks him back in, the kicker himself complaining he'll have to burn his favorite boot. %anatomist% comes over with a quieted voice. He says the man has a skin disease which might look like leprosy or a plague, but is in fact benign. You ask if he's sure of it, and he nods, albeit with a finger of reluctance held up.%SPEECH_ON%I may be wrong, of course. And if I am, then his very real disease might spawn itself upon us all. But to bury a man alive is not something I find, how do you say, scientifically compelling.%SPEECH_OFF%}
df05c9a6ad2d34fa0075.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]{你碰上一个正在被活埋的男人。之所以说是活埋，是因为他虽被捆得像个死人，却还在为自己的处境大喊大叫。你问出了什么事，一个挖坑的人转过身，伸手阻止你靠近。%SPEECH_ON%离远点。这人染了瘟病，碰谁谁就染上。我们可不想得病，你也不想吧。%SPEECH_OFF%又一铲土落在男人身上，他大声求救，试图爬出坟坑，却被一个挖坑的人一脚踹了回去。踹人的家伙还抱怨，这下得烧掉自己最喜欢的靴子了。%anatomist%走过来，压低了声音。他说那人得的是皮肤病，乍看像麻风或瘟疫，实际上并无大碍。你问他是否确定，他点点头，却又有些迟疑地竖起一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%当然，我也可能弄错。如果真是那样，他所患的传染病或许会让我们全都遭殃。可把一个大活人埋进土里，这种做法在我看来，怎么说呢，缺乏科学上的说服力。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f88eba2d2ff97052de65.source: In that case we're going to help him.
f88eba2d2ff97052de65.translation: 既然这样，我们就帮帮他。

be5f397821da7aa049dd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{You draw out your sword and order the diggers to stop. They look at you with incredulous stares. One points at the man in the grave.%SPEECH_ON%Did you not hear? This fella is blighted. What we're doing here might not look right but-%SPEECH_OFF%With a point of your sword, the digger falls quiet. You tell the man in the grave to hop on out, and as he does the diggers drop their shovels and back off. They tell you he's all yours. The supposedly diseased man ambles over, still frightened and no doubt unsure if his rescuers have anything better in mind for him than those who would bury him alive. %anatomist% takes him under his wing and you slowly fall back. The anatomist states that the man is ill, but it's not serious and he will recover in good time. For now, though, he needs rest.}
be5f397821da7aa049dd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{你拔出剑，命令挖坑的人停手。他们难以置信地望着你，其中一个指向墓坑里的男人。%SPEECH_ON%你没听见吗？这家伙染了疫病。咱们这么干是不好看，可——%SPEECH_OFF%你拿剑一指，那人便闭了嘴。你让坑里的人爬出来。眼见他往外爬，挖坑者们丢下铁锹，连连后退，说人归你了。那个据说身染重病的男人慢慢走来，仍惊恐不已，显然拿不准救下自己的人，会不会比要把他活埋的那些人好些。%anatomist%接手照料他，你们便缓缓退开。解剖学者说，他确实病了，但并不严重，休养些时日就能康复。眼下，他需要休息。}

1a8092b1d92609c83359.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]{In the most reluctant rescue ever, you sigh and draw out your sword, ordering the diggers to stop immediately. They look over at you, their hands on their shovels, their eyebrows far up their brows.%SPEECH_ON%What? Did ye you not hear us? The fella's blighted!%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist% comes forward and waves them off. You nod and gesture for the diggers to do as told. The anatomist helps the man out of the grave, though you notice he's doing it with his own sleeve and hand covered. He is helped back to the company. As the man turns to thank you, %anatomist% drives a hammer into the back of his head, knocking him out cold. The anatomist follows him to the ground and begins to cut up the man's arm, removing a slab of flesh before backing away.%SPEECH_ON%This should be good enough for our studies, I believe.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask if the man was indeed sick. The anatomist nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course, but it's better if he's at least useful while sick instead of just dead in the ground like some worm. He may, of course, go die now. There is not much left for him in this world.%SPEECH_OFF%The man moans as he writhes on the ground. There's a bit of a jangle in his boots which you remove to find stowed away crowns. You briefly consider putting him out of his misery, but decide that now he's free of the grave he may himself decide how he wishes to return to it. You do, however, take his money.}
1a8092b1d92609c83359.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]{这是你最不情愿的一次救人。你叹着气拔出剑，命令挖坑的人立刻停手。他们握着铲子看过来，眉毛高高挑起。%SPEECH_ON%什么？没听见我们说的？这家伙染了瘟病！%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist%走上前，挥手叫他们退开。你点点头，也示意照办。解剖学者扶着那人爬出坟坑，不过你注意到，他特意用自己的袖子裹住了手。那人被扶回战团，刚转身要向你道谢，%anatomist%便一锤砸在他后脑，将他当场打昏。解剖学者随他蹲到地上，动刀切开胳膊，取下一片血肉，才退开。%SPEECH_ON%我想，这些就足够供我们研究了。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，那人是否真的有病。解剖学者点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然。不过与其像条虫子一样死在土里，不如至少在患病时发挥点用处。现在，他当然可以去死了。这世界也没剩多少值得他留恋的东西。%SPEECH_OFF%男人倒在地上扭动呻吟，靴子里有些叮当声。你脱下来一看，发现藏着克朗。你一度想结束他的痛苦，但又决定，既然已把他从坟里救出，那要如何回去，就由他自己选吧。不过，钱你还是拿走了。}

1758251d9f3b9a0611d9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You tell the man that the %companyname% doesn't need anymore sellswords. You also imply that, before he goes, he should maybe consider compensating you for the help. He nods and takes off his boot, revealing he had gold stashed in there. Not trusting what illness he has, you tell him to rub the coins on the grass and then kick it over with his feet. He does as told. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Well. I appreciate it. You take care out there.%SPEECH_OFF%}
1758251d9f3b9a0611d9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你告诉那人，%companyname%不需要更多佣兵，又暗示他走之前，或许该为你们的帮助付些酬劳。他点头脱靴，露出藏在里面的金币。你不放心他身上的病，让他先把钱在草上擦过，再用脚踢来。他照做，随后点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，多谢了。各位在外保重。%SPEECH_OFF%}

9597c06725f9100c45d7.source: Good luck to you as well.

f01b7782bb90f85b5123.source: the Anatomist rescued %name% from being buried alive for carrying some strange disease. Now he has the unique pleasure of both bearing the plague AND being a lab rat for some researchers. Stay over there, please.
f01b7782bb90f85b5123.translation: （解剖学者）救下了因身患怪病险遭活埋的%name%。如今，他有幸既做瘟病患者，又当研究者的小白鼠。劳驾，请站远一点。

1969ae5e315b74eb6327.source: Was almost buried alive for bearing a disease
1969ae5e315b74eb6327.translation: 因身染疾病而险遭活埋

c01315d2cba953c9ed57.source: Got to study an unusual blight
c01315d2cba953c9ed57.translation: 得以研究一种罕见的疫病

98d2291cac93a4b40501.source: Was denied the study of an unusual illness
98d2291cac93a4b40501.translation: 未获准研究一种罕见的疾病

9a5befe8767359a1b095.source: Was denied the chance to help a sick man

46070f8bbbc007baf775.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]{The supposedly diseased man the anatomists had rescued from the literal grave comes forward. He's looking better than ever. He thanks the anatomists for their work, though they regard him with barely any notice at all. It seems he was of more interest to them when he was ill, and they could poke and prod and learn from that which ailed him, and there was some unspoken hope that he would in fact die so they could learn even more. Seeing this, the man then turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%It's all much appreciated, I hope at least you know that. You don't know what hells I've been through with that lot who tried to bury me alive. I think they knew I wasn't no blight, they just wanted my property. See, I used to head the local militia, but that position comes with the weight of conspiracy and jealousy.%SPEECH_OFF%He rubs the back of his head, then comes out with it.%SPEECH_ON%I've nothing else after those gravediggers done taken it all so regardless of whether I'm alive or dead, I may well be of the latter. So, well, let me just say I'm glad to be fighting for you and making myself a new living out here.%SPEECH_OFF%}
46070f8bbbc007baf775.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]{那个被解剖学者们真正从坟坑里救出来、据说身染恶疾的男人走了过来，如今气色好得不得了。他感谢解剖学者们的救治，他们却几乎懒得理会。看来，他生病时更令他们感兴趣，毕竟可以戳戳探探，从病症里研究出些东西；他们甚至暗暗盼过他死掉，好学到更多。看出这一点，男人便转向你。%SPEECH_ON%我真的很感激，至少希望你能明白。你不知道，那群想把我活埋的人，让我受了多少罪。我觉得他们知道我没染瘟病，只是想要我的家产。以前我统领当地民兵，可坐上这个位子，也就躲不开阴谋和妒忌。%SPEECH_OFF%他揉了揉后脑勺，终于说出心里话。%SPEECH_ON%那些挖坟的把我的东西全拿走了，我如今一无所有。无论活着还是死了，其实都差不多。不过，唔，我想说的是，能为你战斗，在这里重新挣出一份活路，我很高兴。%SPEECH_OFF%}

36963e8cdf22513278e9.source: You found %name% being buried alive for carrying some unknown blight. The anatomists took interest in him and rescued him, nursing him back to health. Now, he fights for you, putting to use the skills that made him captain of the guard in a previous life.
36963e8cdf22513278e9.translation: 你发现%name%因身患不明怪病，正要被活埋。解剖学者们对他产生兴趣，将他救下，照料至康复。如今他为你而战，再次施展那身曾让他当上卫队长的本领。

b5b9482c72fb48eb4110.source: Recovered from the blight afflicting him
b5b9482c72fb48eb4110.translation: 摆脱了折磨自己的疫病

f503e0676e3f0de2038d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{A man in drab, grey garb approaches. In place of weapons and armor, he has scrolls and papers with him, as well as a bandolier of vials and pouches brimming with strange flesh and fur. He hails you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, the %companyname%. I have been looking for men of such...qualities. You see, I am an anatomist and-%SPEECH_OFF%You stop him right there. You've little time for men who obsess over strange fascinations. Either he wants to join or not, and you tell him that tersely. | You come across a man who is kneeling over a dead dog. He probes the snout with a long stick and nods.%SPEECH_ON%As you can tell, I am a famed anatomist.%SPEECH_OFF%Turning his head up like some creepy puppet, he claims that the %companyname% is slowly becoming renowned for its studious work - and that he wishes to join. | You find a coat, pants, and a pair of boots on a rock. Beside it are some bandoliers and reams of paper and bizarre drawings. Looking out, you see a pond and a man frolicking in it. He jolts at the sight of you and points a finger.%SPEECH_ON%Don't touch that! Hey you, don't touch anything!%SPEECH_OFF%He gets up out of the water, his legs awkwardly splish-splashing through the surface. As he rises up out of the pond you see that, thankfully, he's absurdly hairy in parts, the water turning his hairy crotch into some grey felt loincloth. You draw your sword and the man comes to a stop.%SPEECH_ON%Hold that steel, traveler. I see now that you are of an inquisitive mind and so am I! And, my dear steel-driven traveler, I am in dire need of need of equals. What say you that I join?%SPEECH_OFF%You try to keep your eyes above the neck, but a stiff wind blows through and you can hear water flying off his crotch like a shaking wet dog. The glance down which follows is quite unfortunate. | You come across a man sitting on a rock. Across from him is a slab of stone layered with dissected animals. Puppies, kittens, what might be a frog, some sort of rodent, and...a duck. He jumps to his feet.%SPEECH_ON%Behold, traveler, the result of my studies. Yet I am still short on so many of my studies. I can see that you are of an inquisitive mind albeit no doubt a brute. I would like to offer my services to you, though, I must warn, the advances I have made with these are for me and me alone.%SPEECH_OFF%He protectively holds an arm ahead of the dissected animals as if you'd have any interest with them.}
f503e0676e3f0de2038d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{一个灰衣黯淡的男人走来。身上没有武器与盔甲，只有卷轴和纸张，以及一条挂满小瓶的肩带，袋子里塞着古怪的血肉与皮毛。他招呼道。%SPEECH_ON%啊，%companyname%。我一直在寻找具备这种……资质的人。你看，我是一名解剖学者，而——%SPEECH_OFF%你当即打断。对沉迷古怪癖好的人，你没多少耐心。要么想加入，要么不想，你简短地把话挑明。 | 你遇见一个跪在死狗旁的男人。他用长棍戳着狗的口鼻，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%正如你所见，我是一位著名的解剖学者。%SPEECH_OFF%他像个诡异木偶般抬起头，声称%companyname%正因孜孜不倦的研究而逐渐闻名，而他也希望加入。 | 你发现一块石头上放着外套、裤子和一双靴子，旁边是几条肩带、大叠纸张和怪异图画。向外望去，一人正在池塘里嬉水。看见你，他猛地一惊，伸手指来。%SPEECH_ON%别碰！嘿，你，什么都别碰！%SPEECH_OFF%他从水中起来，双腿笨拙地扑腾水面。幸好，走出池塘时，你发现他有些地方体毛浓密得荒唐，湿毛贴在胯间，仿佛一块灰毡裆布。你拔出剑，男人停住。%SPEECH_ON%收起利刃，旅人。我现在看出来了，你有一颗好奇的心，我也一样！亲爱的、以钢铁开路的旅人，我急需同道。不如，让我加入？%SPEECH_OFF%你尽量只看他的脖子以上，可一阵强风吹过，水从他胯间飞落，声音像湿狗甩毛。你随之往下一瞥，那真是个不幸的决定。 | 你遇见一个坐在岩石上的男人，对面石板上铺着解剖过的动物：小狗、小猫、也许是青蛙的东西、某种啮齿动物，还有……一只鸭。他一跃而起。%SPEECH_ON%看吧，旅人，这是我的研究成果。不过，我还有太多研究未能完成。我看得出，你有求知之心，虽然无疑也是个粗人。我愿为你效力，可得先声明，我从这些标本上取得的进展，只属于我，属于我一个人。%SPEECH_OFF%他护宝似的伸出胳膊，挡住那些解剖动物，仿佛你真会对它们有半点兴趣。}

3d2e113b383b5e1b9907.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{The man briefly bows.%SPEECH_ON%Ahh, it is good to be with my intellectual equals, though I shall remind them that there are some more equal than others, and if they wish to read my works they may submit a request to do so.%SPEECH_OFF%Yeah. Sure.}
3d2e113b383b5e1b9907.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{那人略一鞠躬。%SPEECH_ON%啊，能与才智相当的人共事，实在美妙。不过，我得提醒他们，所谓相当，总有高下。若想拜读我的著作，可以提出申请。%SPEECH_OFF%是。好。随你。}

ec9f0acaf9d5c256f6ef.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{The man nods.%SPEECH_ON%Fair enough. I know that when I came across my intellectual superior, I grew jealous and refused any help he provided. Well, good sir, may you travel well and catch up to me and my discoveries!%SPEECH_OFF%}
ec9f0acaf9d5c256f6ef.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{那人点点头。%SPEECH_ON%情有可原。我第一次遇见学识胜过自己的人时，也曾心生嫉妒，拒绝了他的一切帮助。好吧，先生，祝你一路顺风，争取早日追上我和我的发现！%SPEECH_OFF%}

8a8d10f6b305d5adb354.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{After spending some time with his new malformed shapes, %anatomist% has come to accept who he is now. He sees these horrific scars and ever growing pustules as evidence that he is on the right path. In some way, he is right. These strange changes have made him a far superior fighter than he was before, which is saying a lot for you personally had no hope that these foolish eggheads ever had a shot of becoming even competent fighters at best. Whatever fears and worries he had prior are now gone entirely, replaced by a renewed sense of purpose and desire to do more. | %anatomist% has stopped moping around worrying about his scars and horrible appearance. It seems he has made peace with how he looks now, or possibly he has simply become so ingratiated with the godawful smell emanating from every part of him that he no longer notices. While his stink brings you to nearly vomit every time you're near him, at the very least he has recovered from the dourness which was occupying his every waking minute. Maybe now he can continue on his righteous path to scientific discovery, or however else he put it. | It is hard to come to terms with who you are and, despite the superficiality, it is even more difficult to make peace with how you look. This is even more true when how you look was not the manner in which you were born, but shaped by the actions you took in life. If your own decisions brought you to this newfound state, you have only your own choices to dwell upon for the rest of your life. You've seen it many a time, particularly with sellswords who lose their ears, noses, lips, and worse. It can take a long time for a man to come to peace with his newformed circumstances, and %anatomist% was no different. But come to peace he has. Whatever horrific scars and mutations he has suffered from his own actions are no more - at least mentally. He has moved on and is ready to continue his path in this world as someone seeking scientific endeavors, and the great risks to himself that those endeavors might one day pose. | %anatomist% has come to terms with his new appearances. At first, his body's reactions to the potions and concoctions he's been imbibing were so disturbing that he reeled into a shell of his former self. You could hardly blame him, for he did and does look quite hideous. But after a while, you simply realize that life goes on, and if nothing can be done about it then nothing can be done about it. And, at the very least, the real purpose of the choices made were to satisfy scientific inquiries, and it seems re-realizing that has revivified %anatomist%'s sense of purpose. He is still ungainly and disgusting and you have a hard time looking at him, but least he's happier now. | Once wounded by maladies and disfigurements, %anatomist% the anatomist is starting to look a lot better now. That is to say, he has come to realize that there is little he can do about his physical appearance which is, to be terse, still something that takes courage and willpower to just look at. But the man has remembered the true reason he sought the concoctions and strange mixtures and tinctures which have turned him into a walking and talking monstrosity, and that reason is a matter of scientific endeavor. The anatomist is now a happier man and as long as he can be kept far away from even the smallest of mirrors you imagine that can more or less remain the case. | %anatomist%'s habit of sucking down any every potion he concocts did eventually come to bite him in the ass. His last imbibement when horribly wrong, turning his face into fleshy dough, and arising across his skin all manner of bumps and bruises and pustules and pusses. Naturally, these changes had a deep morale impact on the man. But, finally, he has gotten over it. He is still a walking, talking monstrosity in every sense of the word, but on the inside he is at peace with it, and what's on the inside is what counts. Or at least it better count, because what's on the outside you can barely muster the courage to look at. | %anatomist% the anatomist calls the changes to his body 'mutations', which must be some sort of egghead word for looking like shite. For a while, his appearance was a drag on his day to day life. You can hardly blame him, he inflicted these maladies upon himself which is always far worse than when the world does it to you and leaves little doubt as to how you could have unfarked yourself. Thankfully, the anatomist has gotten over his depression and angst about his horrendous appearance. He might even be more willing than ever to keep imbibing his potions and concoctions. Surely he can't look much worse than he already does and at a certain point of looking completely hideous even the ladyfolk take a turn, like seeing a dog so mangy and decrepit that one can't help but pet it out of curiosity. | After he drank a number of questionable potions, %anatomist% the anatomist's body began to change and, like any grown man, change at that age is rarely a good thing. His face became disfigured, his body mottled with sores and scars. For a time, the anatomist fell into a deep depression over the matter and you wondered if he had been irreversibly damaged not just on the outside, but the inside as well. Thankfully, it is the morale of a man that can be the hardest to break. %anatomist% has come to terms with his new appearance. It's not as though there is much he can do about it, and he now sees it as a sort of fundamental rite by fire that he is the way he is, and that he has helped pursue the scientific endeavors which brought him to these lands in the first place. You yourself just have to make sure that he's not the first thing you see in the morning.}
8a8d10f6b305d5adb354.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{与畸变后的身体相处一段时间，%anatomist%终于接受了如今的自己。他将可怕的伤疤和不断增生的脓疱，视为走在正确道路上的证据。某种意义上，他也没错。这些怪异变化，让他远比从前更能打。你尤其觉得难得，毕竟原本压根没指望过，这群愚蠢书呆子能成为哪怕勉强合格的战士。先前的恐惧与担忧如今已烟消云散，取而代之的，是重燃的志向，以及继续探索的渴望。 | %anatomist%不再为伤疤和可怕模样四处唉声叹气。看来，他已接受现在的外貌，也可能只是彻底习惯了全身散发的恶臭，再也闻不见。每次靠近，你仍被熏得几乎呕吐，不过至少，他已摆脱那曾占据每一刻清醒时光的消沉。如今，也许能继续走他那条通往学术发现的正道了，或者，不管他自己怎么称呼。 | 接受自己是什么样的人并不容易，而尽管外貌看似肤浅，接受自己的模样，往往更难。尤其当这模样并非与生俱来，而是自己一路走来亲手造就。若如今的处境源于自身决定，那么余生能反复咀嚼的，也只有那些选择。你见过太多这样的例子，尤其是失去耳朵、鼻子、嘴唇，乃至伤得更惨的佣兵。一个人往往需要很久，才能与新的处境和解，%anatomist%也不例外。不过，他终于做到了。由自身行为招来的可怕伤疤与畸变，已不再纠缠他，至少在心里如此。他已向前迈步，准备继续投身学术探索，连同那些探索日后可能带给自己的巨大风险。 | %anatomist%接受了自己的新模样。最初，服下药剂与配方后，身体产生的反应过于骇人，让他整个人都萎缩下去，只剩往日的空壳。你很难怪他，因为当时确实丑陋，如今也一样。可日子久了，人总会明白，生活仍要继续，既然无能为力，那便是无能为力。况且，当初作出这些选择，真正的目的本就是满足求知欲。重新想起这一点，似乎让%anatomist%再次找到了方向。他仍然丑陋、恶心，让你难以直视，不过，至少如今开心些了。 | 解剖学者%anatomist%曾饱受疾病与毁容之苦，如今看着好多了。也就是说，他终于意识到，自己对外貌无能为力——简短地说，那仍是一副光看着就需要勇气与意志的模样。可他记起了，为何要服用那些让自己变成能走能说的怪物的药液、混剂与酊剂。答案是学术探索。解剖学者如今开心多了，你想，只要让他远离哪怕最小的一面镜子，大概就能保持下去。 | %anatomist%调出什么药都往肚里灌的习惯，终究让他吃到了苦头。上回服药出了大错，脸变成一团肉面糊，皮肤上冒出各种肿块、淤斑、脓疱与脓液。自然，这些变化重创了他的士气。不过，终于，他想开了。从字面上的任何角度说，他仍是个会走会说的怪物，可内心已坦然接受。而真正重要的是内在。至少，最好如此，因为外表，你几乎连看一眼的勇气都拿不出来。 | 解剖学者%anatomist%把身体的变化称作“变异”，大概是书呆子形容长得像坨屎的专门用语。曾有一阵，这副模样让他每天都过得艰难。你很难怪他，毕竟是自己给自己招来的病，比世界强加的苦难更难受，也让人一清二楚，当初怎样才能免遭此罪。幸好，解剖学者已经摆脱因骇人外貌而生的抑郁与焦虑，甚至可能比以前更愿意继续喝那些药。他大概也不可能更难看了；何况丑到一定地步，连女人的态度也会转变，就像看见一条癞得不成样、老朽得可怜的狗，反而忍不住因好奇摸上一把。 | 喝下多种可疑药剂后，解剖学者%anatomist%的身体开始变化。与所有成年人一样，到了这个年纪，身体变化很少是好事。他面容毁损，遍体疮疤。曾有一段时间，他因此深陷抑郁，你甚至怀疑，受损得无法挽回的，不只是外表，还有内心。幸好，有时最难摧垮的，正是人的心气。%anatomist%已接受新的模样，反正也没多少补救余地。他如今把这副样子视为必经的烈火试炼，证明自己确实推进了当初驱使他来到这些土地的学术事业。至于你，只需确保每天早上睁眼，第一个看见的不是他。}

36a08a86159da63a8896.source: Has come to terms with his mutations

df8307a304c317028741.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_77.png[/img]{%townname%'s denizens have mostly looked upon you and the anatomists as though you were wayward devils. But out of the blue, a man comes down off his porch and strides across the road toward %anatomist% the anatomist, carrying with him an upright posture, swinging gait, and a fat grin. He grabs the anatomist by the hand and starts vigorously shaking it.%SPEECH_ON%Shitfire, I'd figured you'd be back one of these days! You don't recognize me? You done come by this way years ago, many years ago, we both looked a fair bit younger then. I had that fat sack on m'back that you cut out, and my whole life's been much better since! Hells, gimme one second, don't you move a muscle I'll be right back!%SPEECH_OFF%The man quickly returns to his home. You look at %anatomist% who remarks that he remembers the man: he had a giant tumor growing on his spine, and the anatomist in his younger days had successfully cut it out using tongs, shearing blades, and a good number of rags. He laments that he did not keep the fleshy mass for study, but that he was a different sort of physician in those days. The man returns with a weapon which he holds out.%SPEECH_ON%Once I was of good health, I took to the fightin' fields. Was pretty good at it, too, but you know, lives change, and keep on changing. I'd seen you with this sellsword here so I suppose it had done changed for you as well. Please, take it.%SPEECH_OFF%The second the anatomist hesitates, you take the weapon yourself, lest the charitable opportunity be shortlived. You thank the man. He shakes %anatomist%'s hands again, then bids goodbye. The anatomist stares at him as he departs.%SPEECH_ON%We could experiment on him, now that I fully recollect my knowledge of him. That mass from his back is likely to return, I could perhaps...just...open him up and take a look...%SPEECH_OFF%You stop the anatomist from fancying any dissecting of the local laity and get back on the road.}
df8307a304c317028741.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_77.png[/img]{%townname%的居民大多像看走错路的魔鬼般看待你和解剖学者们。可忽然，一个男人走下门廊，穿过道路，直奔解剖学者%anatomist%而来。他腰背挺直，步履轻快，脸上挂着大大的笑。他一把握住解剖学者的手，使劲摇晃。%SPEECH_ON%好家伙，我就知道你总有一天还会回来！不认得我了？你好多年前来过这儿，好多年啦，那时咱俩都年轻得多。我背上那个大包，是你给割掉的，打那以后，我这辈子过得好多了！哎，等一下，一下就好，你千万别走，我马上回来！%SPEECH_OFF%那人飞快跑回家。你看向%anatomist%，他表示记得此人：当年脊柱上长了个巨大的肿瘤，年轻时的自己用钳子、剪刃和许多布条，成功将它切了下来。他遗憾没把那团肉留下研究，不过，那时候的自己，还是另一种大夫。男人抱着一件武器回来，递到面前。%SPEECH_ON%身体好了以后，我就上了战场。干得也挺不错。不过你知道，人生总在变，一直在变。我看你如今跟着这位佣兵，想必你的日子也变了。请收下吧。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者才一犹豫，你便亲自接过武器，免得这份慷慨转眼消散。你向男人道谢。他又握了握%anatomist%的手，随后告辞。解剖学者盯着他离去的背影。%SPEECH_ON%既然我已经完全想起他的情况，我们倒可以拿他做些实验。背上那个肿块很可能会复发，也许我可以……只是……打开看看……%SPEECH_OFF%你打断了解剖学者解剖当地平民的幻想，重新上路。}

5dca53f9d0782168e4ef.source: You'll find plenty of black masses to research elsewhere.
5dca53f9d0782168e4ef.translation: 别处还有的是黑色肿块等你研究。

90395b6f2f0be77cb3ab.source: Saw living proof that his past work was successful
90395b6f2f0be77cb3ab.translation: 亲眼见到自己当年治疗有效的活证据

19e8084e7b440a0c27ef.source: An old patient thanked him for his medical help
19e8084e7b440a0c27ef.translation: 一名旧日病人感谢他的医治

e49bba1c8447d67a3045.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{%anatomist% the anatomist is sitting by the campfire. He seems deep in thought. Being a bit of an arsehole, you feel this is the perfect time to stop by and start asking him questions, particularly the most annoying inquiry in all of existence “What are you thinking about?” The anatomist pinches his eyes and lets out a long sigh. He says,%SPEECH_ON%I am ruminating on the nature of this world's entities, notably the ones furthest above, and furthest below. Understand, scapegrace, that we have met a number of royals in our travels and the impression they've imparted on me is one of dire disappointment. Wild animals operate on an even table such that that which eats, and that which finds itself sniveling for scrap, or being scrap itself, are delineated by talent, pure in its innateness. Is the axiom of being the best allowing one to rise up to the top axiomatic only to the world of animals? I took it as truth that our rulers, and now benefactors, would reflect these realities. Instead I am met, time and time again, by buffoons. Incompetents whose primary talents are in balancing indulgences, too much and the peasants are angered by extravagances, too little and the laity think their rulers improperly wasting their extraordinarily lucky station in life. My evaluation of my fellow man drops with every day. Dare I say, dare I say, scapegrace...scapegrace, are you listening?%SPEECH_OFF%You're spinning a stick in the fire when you hear your byname. Glancing over, you tell him that you're not a stranger to these thoughts, but they're just that: thoughts. Despite the pressures of your surroundings, you still decide what you think about. If it bothers him so much, he should simply set it aside. He has no control over the world, after all, and such thinking will not broker greater change. It is mere whinging. The anatomist stares at you. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%I think it is well enough that I do not dwell on these things, for their errors were not by my hand made, nor by my hand could they ever be unmade.%SPEECH_OFF%}
e49bba1c8447d67a3045.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]{解剖学者%anatomist%坐在篝火旁，似乎正在沉思。你有些混账脾性，觉得这正是过去打扰、开始提问的绝佳时机，尤其要问那句世上最烦人的话：“想什么呢？”解剖学者揉了揉眼睛，长叹一声，说道。%SPEECH_ON%我在思索世间生灵的本性，尤其是居于最上与最下的那些。你要明白，浪荡子，我们一路见过不少贵胄，留给我的印象，却只有深切失望。野兽站在同一条线上，谁能吃饱，谁只能哀求残羹，谁自己成了残羹，全由天赋决定，纯粹而生来的本领。最优秀者升到顶端，这条不言自明的道理，难道只适用于动物？我原以为，我们的统治者，如今也是资助者，该体现这种现实。可一次又一次，遇见的却全是蠢货。这群无能之辈，最大的本领，不过是拿捏享乐的分寸。太过，农民便会因奢靡而愤怒；太少，平民又觉得统治者白白糟蹋了上天赐予的非凡好运。我对同类的评价，每一天都在下降。我敢说，我敢说，浪荡子……浪荡子，你在听吗？%SPEECH_OFF%听见对自己的称呼时，你正在火里转动一根木棍。你瞥过去，告诉他，这些想法自己并不陌生，可它们终究只是想法。无论环境如何逼迫，人仍能决定自己想什么。既然如此烦恼，不如放下。他毕竟左右不了世界，这样思索也带不来什么改变，不过是在发牢骚。解剖学者望着你，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我想，确实不必再纠缠这些。那些错误并非出自我手，也绝非我手所能纠正。%SPEECH_OFF%}

4447b4459e74ff72b6c5.source: Better understands the limits of his volition
4447b4459e74ff72b6c5.translation: 更清楚自己能凭意愿改变什么

8d709b5df92832be7165.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{%anatomist% is holding out his arm, watching a long-legged spider trundling across his flesh. As the creature reaches the ends of its newfound earth, the anatomist turns his arm, suggesting the spider continue on another way. He does this for a time until putting his fingers toward the ground and the spider shuffles off entirely, perhaps not ever once aware it was on a living being. The anatomist writes a few pages down in his notes.%SPEECH_ON%The other day I watched a spider jump twenty-times its body length to snatch a fly. And this spider I've let go would, upon seeing its prey, speed across the ground like a hunting dog. It seems that the old gods have taken pity on us, scapegrace, for neither of these creatures can be found in their larger, webknecht forms.%SPEECH_OFF%While being tackled and ripped apart would be quite terrible, you tell him that being wrapped in a cocoon before having your blood sucked out by fangs is undoubtedly worse. The anatomist raises a finger.%SPEECH_ON%A common misconception, scapegrace, for the webknecht actually prefers to feed long after you are deceased. We believe its toxins are designed to target the belly, opening it up and using its fluids to melt you from the inside out. This is presumably why they hang their prey upside down, so the toxins can slosh over the organs, turning you into a sort of sack of fluids. The consuming phase of the process is merely one of digesting whatever is left. The only time they don't eat you is if they're placing their brood inside you as the spiderlings will need sustenance upon hatching.%SPEECH_OFF%That still sounds infinitely worse than being shanked by a hunting spider, but either way you regret having the conversation and pursue it no further. Unfortunately, %otherbro% is nearby and has heard all too much...}
8d709b5df92832be7165.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{%anatomist%伸着胳膊，看一只长腿蜘蛛慢慢爬过皮肤。每当蜘蛛走到这片新天地的边缘，他便转动手臂，让它换个方向继续走。如此一阵后，他将手指伸向地面，蜘蛛终于爬走，或许始终不知道，自己刚才待在一个活物身上。解剖学者在笔记中写了几页。%SPEECH_ON%前些天，我看见一只蜘蛛跃出自身长度二十倍的距离，捕住一只苍蝇。而我刚放走这只，一旦看见猎物，便会像猎犬般贴地飞奔。看来，旧神终究怜悯我们，浪荡子，因为这两种蜘蛛，都没有长成巨蛛那般庞大的种类。%SPEECH_OFF%被扑倒撕碎固然可怕，你告诉他，可先裹成茧，再被毒牙吸干血，无疑更糟。解剖学者竖起一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%常见的误解，浪荡子。实际上，巨蛛更喜欢等你死了很久再进食。我们认为，它的毒素专门作用于腹部，将其破坏，再利用其中的液体，由内而外把你溶解。想必正因如此，它们才把猎物倒吊，让毒液在脏器间流淌，将你化作一袋液体。所谓进食阶段，不过是消化剩下的东西。它们唯一不吃你的情形，是把卵产进你体内，因为幼蛛孵化后还需要食物。%SPEECH_OFF%听起来，仍比被一只猎食蜘蛛捅死糟糕无数倍。无论如何，你后悔开了这个话题，决定到此为止。可惜，%otherbro%就在附近，已经听得太多了……}

7cde6ed0ea49895768b6.translation: 别再说得大家浑身发毛了，该死的。

11f7d38125f76bbc996f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{%ailing% the ailing sellsword is curled up and staring into the campfire. He's been ill for a while and does not seem to be getting any better. However, %anatomist% the anatomist suggests that he might be able to concoct a solution for the man, a sort of potion that he can imbibe to strengthen his body and heal himself.%SPEECH_ON%I've seen it work many a time. Now, there is an issue: the required ingredients are not native to where we are, but I've read enough on the subject that I can find suitable substitutes with ease.%SPEECH_OFF%}
11f7d38125f76bbc996f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{体弱多病的佣兵%ailing%蜷缩着身子，盯着篝火。他病了好一阵，仍不见好转。不过，解剖学者%anatomist%说，也许能配出一种药剂，让他服下后强健体魄，自行痊愈。%SPEECH_ON%我见它奏效过许多次。眼下倒有个问题：所需材料并非本地产物。不过，这方面的书我读得够多，找些合适的替代品很容易。%SPEECH_OFF%}

8aec9df8058875e1eb68.source: Go and and heal him of his ailments.

126b60746d062d1e0c62.source: No, this doesn't sound safe at all.

ce88d31f3cf1f8e3a591.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You let %anatomist% do his work, whatever that is. The anatomist and %ailing% disappear into a tent for awhile. By the time it is ready for the company to get back on the road, %ailing% is a new man. He is revivified with newfound energies, and he has a certain spring in his step. %anatomist% comes out writing notes in his book.%SPEECH_ON%Results were quite good, quite good indeed.%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask him what he did. He snaps out of his focus and glares up at you, then turns the book away so you cannot read it. He continues murmuring to himself.%SPEECH_ON%Best results? No, I cannot write best results. He might yet still suffer effects which might come in a little, how do I put this, sideways.%SPEECH_OFF%Well. Hopefully %ailing% is merely healed and that's that.}
ce88d31f3cf1f8e3a591.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你准许%anatomist%动手，至于具体做什么，由他去。解剖学者带着%ailing%进了帐篷，过了一阵，战团准备重新出发时，%ailing%已像换了个人。他重新焕发生机，脚步都轻快起来。%anatomist%走出帐篷，还在本子上记着笔记。%SPEECH_ON%结果相当不错，确实相当不错。%SPEECH_OFF%你好奇地问，他究竟做了什么。他从专注中抬起头，瞪你一眼，又把本子转开，不让你看，接着自言自语。%SPEECH_ON%最佳结果？不，不能写最佳结果。也许往后还会出现些影响，稍微，怎么说呢，有点偏离预期。%SPEECH_OFF%好吧。但愿%ailing%只是治好了病，别再有别的事。}

d57da8d3990625767646.source: Let's get back on the road then.

07efbd71244d676c4b58.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You give %anatomist% the go ahead. He and %ailing% step away for a time, going into a tent together. Hours pass and the company should get back on the road soon. You walk over and enter the tent. %ailing% is on a cot with his arms crossed over his head and his legs bowed at the knees. He's covered in sweat and keeps turning his head from left to right. %anatomist% is at his side taking notes.%SPEECH_ON%It appears the procedure did not work as intended, however even unintended consequences can carry information of great import.%SPEECH_OFF%Furious, you ask if the man is going to make it. The anatomist nods.%SPEECH_ON%He might suffer some delusions for a while, but ultimately he will still be a breathing animal-excuse me, a breathing man.%SPEECH_OFF%}
07efbd71244d676c4b58.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你准许%anatomist%动手。他带着%ailing%走开，两人一同进了帐篷。几个钟头过去，战团也该重新上路了。你走过去掀帘进帐，只见%ailing%躺在行军床上，双臂交叉抱在头顶，膝盖弯曲。他浑身是汗，脑袋不停地左右扭动。%anatomist%坐在一旁记笔记。%SPEECH_ON%看来手术没有达到预期效果。不过，即使是意料之外的结果，也能提供极为重要的信息。%SPEECH_OFF%你怒不可遏，问这人还能不能活。解剖学者点点头。%SPEECH_ON%他可能会胡思乱想一阵，但终究还会是一只能呼吸的动物——抱歉，是一个能呼吸的人。%SPEECH_OFF%}

8cf6a7004c2d76ba8d8d.source: Let's just get on the road then.

caa07baff047861e9cde.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You decide to let the anatomist do what he needs to with the hope that %ailing% will make a speedy recovery. As time goes on, you need to get the company back on the road and %anatomist% still hasn't come out of the tent. You go over and peek in.

You find the anatomist sitting on a stool off to the side. He has one arm slung across a table with the hand scratching back and forth in mad notetaking. His other arm is slack between his legs, his thumb and finger pressing together now and again in a strange pinching motion that seems to be counting the seconds. You take your eyes to %ailing% who is sitting up on a cot, his legs over the sides and his feet on the ground. He looks up at you.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there, captain, I think I'm feeling much better now. Much, much better. Ready to...take on the world.%SPEECH_OFF%The man springs to his feet and pounds his chest, yet his voice does not rise.%SPEECH_ON%Shall we resume the road?%SPEECH_OFF%He walks out of the tent and the second the tarp flaps closed, %anatomist% stops writing and sets down his quill pen. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%The procedure was a success. He is no longer ill. He is healed and then some.%SPEECH_OFF%And then some? That's not the sort of language you really want to see right now. You'll have to keep an eye on the man to see what exactly has changed about him.}
caa07baff047861e9cde.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你决定让解剖学者放手施治，盼着%ailing%能早日康复。时间渐渐过去，战团该重新上路了，%anatomist%却还没从帐篷里出来。你走过去，探头张望。

解剖学者坐在一旁的凳子上，一条胳膊搭着桌，手正疯狂地来回写着笔记。另一条胳膊垂在两腿之间，拇指和另一根手指时不时捏合一下，动作古怪，仿佛在数秒。你再看向%ailing%，他已坐在行军床边，两腿垂下，双脚落地。他抬头看你。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，团长，我想自己好多了。好得多，好得多。已经准备好……迎战整个世界了。%SPEECH_OFF%男人猛地站起，拍了拍胸膛，声音却依然平平。%SPEECH_ON%咱们继续上路吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他走出帐篷。门帘刚一合上，%anatomist%便停下书写，放下羽毛笔，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%治疗成功。他已经不再患病，彻底治好了，而且还不止如此。%SPEECH_OFF%不止如此？你此刻可不想听见这种说法。看来还得留意那人，弄清他究竟发生了什么变化。}

4f1323e7fd2a047d8e93.translation: 解剖学者，别再做实验了。

bda4c8bb007ce7240f8f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You tell %anatomist% no. %ailing% is strong enough to heal on his own. The anatomist sighs. You get a sense that he had no real interest in helping the sellsword, only an interest in experimenting on him.%SPEECH_ON%Great advances can only be made with great risks, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%He says before walking off, his quill pen scratching out a name on one of his tomes.}
bda4c8bb007ce7240f8f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你拒绝了%anatomist%，说%ailing%足够坚强，能自己康复。解剖学者叹了口气。你隐约觉得，他并非真想救人，只想拿这佣兵做实验。%SPEECH_ON%团长，伟大的进步只能靠巨大的风险换来。%SPEECH_OFF%说完他便走了，羽毛笔在一本册子上沙沙划去一个名字。}

fa869fb41c5d4708d297.source: About to advance my fist into your...
fa869fb41c5d4708d297.translation: 我倒要把拳头推进你的……

702271c30166ac229ae2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You come up on %anatomist% the anatomist talking to %asthmatic%, a man who is notoriously bad at the simple act of breathing. Almost on cue, the man comes to you with a request. He says that the anatomist has a means to possibly heal his poor lungs. %anatomist% nods.%SPEECH_ON%It is but a small procedure, albeit painful. This daring subject - excuse me, this daring animal - goodness, excuse me, this daring patient has steadied himself of that challenge and is ready to take it on in full. With your say so, I may begin the process and have it done in no time at all.%SPEECH_OFF%You're not sure about this, but it would be nice if %asthmatic% could stop wheezing in the middle of the night like some rabbit having the life squeezed out of it.}
702271c30166ac229ae2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你撞见解剖学者%anatomist%正在与%asthmatic%交谈。后者连喘气这么简单的事都做不好，在战团里是出了名的。他像是算准了时候，立刻上前提出请求，说解剖学者或许有办法治好他的肺。%anatomist%点头道。%SPEECH_ON%只是个小手术，虽说会有些疼。这位勇敢的实验对象——抱歉，这只勇敢的动物——天哪，请原谅，这位勇敢的病人，已经做好准备，愿意全力承受这番考验。只要您点头，我随时可以开始，很快就能做完。%SPEECH_OFF%你心里有些拿不准。不过，%asthmatic%若能不再半夜喘得像只快被掐死的兔子，倒也是件好事。}

7605c1957c887075d5d5.source: Do it, and use whatever means necessary.
7605c1957c887075d5d5.translation: 做吧，有什么手段都用上。

83ed6767030b0f5f9519.source: No, I won't risk his life on this.
83ed6767030b0f5f9519.translation: 不行，我不会拿他的命冒险。

98bc120b4dddf710c010.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You okay the procedure and the two disappear for a time. Not long after, %asthmatic% the man with lungs like a dead dog being stepped on comes to you with a wide grin. He stands straight, puffs out his chest, and takes a long, deep breath, his body swelling like a toad, his cheeks puffing, then he slowly, slowly lets the air out. There is no wheeze. There is no scratch in the throat. His face does not get red. His arms slacken, yet he does not become dizzy.%SPEECH_ON%That anatomist got me patched up just right. He is but a miracle on legs.%SPEECH_OFF%The man turns around, revealing a series of holes in his flesh which suck and pucker as he breathes. %anatomist% comes around cleaning some strange metal utensil. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%At least one of us is satisfied with the results as they have arrived.%SPEECH_OFF%You're not sure why the anatomist is upset, but you do get a glance at one of his texts which reveals an operation of lung-removal via scalpel and spoon. Surely that wasn't what he did to %asthmatic%. Surely.}
98bc120b4dddf710c010.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你批准了手术，两人便离开了一阵。不久之后，%asthmatic%满脸笑容地来找你——这人的呼吸原本像有人在踩一条死狗。他挺直身子，鼓起胸膛，长长地吸了一口气，整个身体像蟾蜍般胀起来，连腮帮子也鼓了起来，随后缓缓地、缓缓地把气吐尽。没有喘鸣，没有喉咙里的沙哑声，脸也没涨红。双臂放松垂下，他却丝毫不觉得头晕。%SPEECH_ON%那位解剖学者把我彻底治好了。他简直就是个活生生的奇迹。%SPEECH_OFF%男人转过身，露出身上一排孔洞，随着呼吸一吸一合。%anatomist%走了过来，正在擦拭一件古怪的金属器具。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%至少我们俩还有一个人对眼下的结果满意。%SPEECH_OFF%你不明白解剖学者为什么不高兴，不过你瞥见他的一篇笔记，上面记着如何用手术刀和勺子摘除肺脏。他总不至于真的对%asthmatic%这么干了吧。肯定不会。}

bce7635753bdb566c006.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You okay the procedure. %asthmatic% turns around to tell the anatomist, who promptly sticks a metal prong deep into the man's chest. The man winces and yelps, his fingers curling as though to grasp the pain itself. He reels backward as %anatomist% holds the utensil like a shank. As the anatomist steps forward for another stab, you jump forward and stop him. He looks at you with confusion.%SPEECH_ON%This is part of the process, do you not understand? Now, I must continue with the puncturing. We will put eight more holes into him.%SPEECH_OFF%%asthmatic% screams, rather undignified in his protest of the process. You tell the anatomist that this is over. He sighs, lowering the tool.%SPEECH_ON%Anything of import requires pain, sellsword. Whether it is you acquiring heads to sell for crowns, or myself, pursuing a cure. If pain were not a critical element, we would not be upsetting the natural order in our own ways.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him to shut his mouth and that it's over. He sighs and walks away, cleaning the utensil with a rag. %asthmatic% wheezes a thanks to you for intervening.}
bce7635753bdb566c006.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你同意了手术。%asthmatic%刚转身告诉解剖学者，对方就猛地将一根金属尖刺扎进他的胸口。他疼得龇牙惨叫，手指蜷曲，仿佛想把疼痛本身抓住。他踉跄着向后退，%anatomist%却像攥着凶器般握着那件器具，又上前准备再刺一下。你赶紧跳过去拦住他。他一脸困惑地看着你。%SPEECH_ON%这是治疗的一部分，你不明白吗？我现在必须继续穿刺，还要再给他开八个孔。%SPEECH_OFF%%asthmatic%放声惨叫，抗议起这种疗法来半点体面也顾不上了。你告诉解剖学者，到此为止。他叹了口气，放下工具。%SPEECH_ON%凡是重要的事，都免不了痛苦，佣兵。无论是你砍下人头去换克朗，还是我寻求治愈之法，都是如此。若痛苦不是其中的关键，我们也就不会各自以自己的方式，扰动自然的秩序。%SPEECH_OFF%你叫他闭嘴，事情结束了。他叹着气走开，用破布擦拭器具。%asthmatic%喘息着向你道谢，感谢你及时制止。}

234c8f51971277655c8a.source: Just take it easy for a bit.

8908eeb148080a8100a5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You think why not just go full donkey and take the experimental route? %asthmatic% agrees.%SPEECH_ON%If this is going to hurt, might as well make it worth my while.%SPEECH_OFF%As the two leave to a tent, a part of you considers watching. Another part realizes you probably don't have the stomach for it, whatever it is, and also that you don't want your presence alone to interfere with the anatomist's work. That said, it actually does not take long for the two to reemerge. %asthmatic% stands up straight, breathing in long and heavy, and then letting it all out in one smooth breath.%SPEECH_ON%I have never felt better.%SPEECH_OFF%He says, then shakes %anatomist%'s hand. The healed man walks off. %anatomist% cleans his hands off.%SPEECH_ON%Unfortunately, there were a few complications. Let me see, what do we have...%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist unfurls a scroll with hastily written notes, some of which are covered in blood. You read...}
8908eeb148080a8100a5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你心想，干脆一条道走到黑，试试那种实验性的治法又何妨？%asthmatic%也同意。%SPEECH_ON%既然免不了受罪，那这罪总得受得值些。%SPEECH_OFF%两人走进帐篷时，你有些想跟去看看。可转念一想，不管他们打算干什么，你多半都受不了，而且也不想仅仅因为自己在场，就妨碍了解剖学者的工作。话虽如此，两人其实没过多久就出来了。%asthmatic%站得笔直，长长地深吸一口气，又一口气顺顺畅畅地吐了出来。%SPEECH_ON%我从没觉得这么舒服过。%SPEECH_OFF%他说着，握了握%anatomist%的手，随后便走开了。%anatomist%擦着双手。%SPEECH_ON%遗憾的是，出现了几项并发症。让我看看，都有哪些……%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者展开一卷草草记下的笔记，有些字迹被血迹盖住了。你读了起来……}

4b97f235726a33642ff0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You tell %anatomist% no. The anatomist purses his lips and makes some eggheaded argument about the value of medicine and science, and you tell him about the value of a sellsword who doesn't have some fool goofing around with his lungs.}
4b97f235726a33642ff0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你拒绝了%anatomist%。解剖学者抿紧嘴唇，搬出一套书呆子论调，谈医学和科学有多重要。你则告诉他，一个肺还没被蠢货胡乱摆弄过的佣兵，同样很重要。}

46e4c886ed2f70b498e2.source: Yeah yeah, go cry into your textbooks.
46e4c886ed2f70b498e2.translation: 行行行，抱着你的课本哭去吧。

cf65627d0973f7735415.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You find %anatomist% the anatomist staring at %clubfoot%'s awkward footing situation: namely that one of his feet looks like a bag of hammers.
