It is a disgusting, unsightly thing, and of course makes it difficult for him to perform the full duties expected of a sellsword. Word is that it is strangely popular with the womenfolk, but this is unconfirmed hearsay. Whatever the case, the anatomist comes to you with a suggestion.%SPEECH_ON%It's actually not at all rare malady, this man's clubfoot. At young age it is easily fixed, but the operation becomes steadily more difficult to amend the older one grows. Thankfully, I am a trained anatomist who has great depths of knowledge on this very subject. If you will let me, I shall attempt to heal this man of his unfortunate and unnecessarily lifelong circumstance.%SPEECH_OFF%%clubfoot% himself nods, saying he's ready to give it a whirl if you think it's best.}
cf65627d0973f7735415.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你发现解剖学者%anatomist%正在盯着%clubfoot%那双不太对劲的脚：具体来说，其中一只活像装满锤子的袋子。这只脚畸形得不忍直视，自然也让他难以胜任佣兵的全部职责。听说女人们倒是莫名喜欢这只脚，不过这种传言还没得到证实。无论如何，解剖学者来找你提了个建议。%SPEECH_ON%此人的畸形足，其实算不上罕见的病症。幼年时很容易矫正，但年纪越大，手术矫正的难度也就越高。好在我受过专业的解剖学训练，对这方面颇有研究。如果你准许，我愿试着治好他，让他摆脱这种本不必伴随一生的不幸。%SPEECH_OFF%%clubfoot%本人也点了点头，说只要你觉得合适，他就愿意试试。}

fcbf127977ab1ea35d48.source: No, the risk is too great.

367bba67b58dde44ce02.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You give %anatomist% the go-ahead. Him and the clubfooted man walk-and-hobble off to handle the business. Naturally, you go to have a look. You watch as %anatomist% brings %clubfoot%'s foot up on a stool. He takes a piece of wood out that already has teeth marks augured into it. He then takes out a vial of liquid, pops the cork, lathers the wood in it, takes a drink of it himself, and then hands the rest to his patient. %clubfoot% chugs the drink, then bites down on the wood. What follows is a disgusting series of leg breaks and castings and re-castings. %anatomist% starts cutting in with a scalpel, grinning madly as he works. %clubfoot% has long since passed out.

When it's all said and done, %clubfoot%'s leg is totally wrecked and casted up. %anatomist% says the operation was a success, though there will be a somewhat lengthy recovery time that will be necessary. The foot will have to be re-casted again and again, and each time moving the foot a little more, but it can be done. A delirious %clubfoot% is smiling as he looks down at his foot.%SPEECH_ON%It will be worth it, captain. For me, and also for the %companyname%.%SPEECH_OFF%The rather dutiful and drugged up mercenary then falls backwards and into a snoring sleep.}
367bba67b58dde44ce02.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你准许%anatomist%动手。他和畸形足的弟兄一前一跛地走去做准备，你自然也跟着看看。%anatomist%把%clubfoot%的脚抬到凳子上，取出一块早已布满牙印的木头。接着，他拿出一小瓶液体，拔开塞子，先往木头上涂抹，又自己喝了一口，再将余下的交给病人。%clubfoot%仰头喝尽，咬住木块。随后便是一连串令人不忍目睹的断骨、固定、拆开再固定。%anatomist%拿起手术刀切了进去，一边忙活，一边露出疯狂的笑容。%clubfoot%早就昏过去了。

等一切结束，%clubfoot%的腿已经被折腾得不成样子，包裹固定起来。%anatomist%说手术很成功，只是必须花相当长的时间恢复。那只脚需要一次又一次重新固定，每次再矫正一点，不过终究可以治好。意识迷糊的%clubfoot%低头看着自己的脚，脸上带着笑。%SPEECH_ON%会值得的，团长。对我，对%companyname%，都是如此。%SPEECH_OFF%这个尽职尽责、又被药物弄得晕乎乎的佣兵随即向后一倒，打着呼噜睡着了。}

0b2fe19e0c3265cc44fa.source: Walk walk, brother, it's your life.
0b2fe19e0c3265cc44fa.translation: 走吧，弟兄，这是你自己的人生。

aa901dbb976cafb6246a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{Reluctantly, you give the go-ahead for %anatomist% the anatomist to get to work. You consider joining him and %clubfoot% in the tent, but something about breaking a foot to heal it doesn't...stand right with you. Instead, you go to your favorite task of counting inventory. The peace and quiet of noting down how much you have of what, how much you'll need, the rate at which the company is chewing through these items. It is all fascinating.

There really isn't anything like counting inventory, and the only thing that could stop your enjoyment is the shrill, horrific screams of %clubfoot% suddenly emanating from the tent you diligently avoided going into. Now, with his shrill cries filling the air, you run to the tent and enter it. You find %anatomist% off to the side wiping sweat from his brow.%SPEECH_ON%Hello captain. Well, let me summarize here. As you can see, there have been some unforeseen complications. He will heal from them, of course, don't you worry about that, but the clubfoot shall remain. It proved, eh, resistant to my applications.%SPEECH_OFF%You look at %clubfoot%. He is now passed out, and beneath the kneecaps his leg is twisted up like a rag. The anatomist nods dutifully.%SPEECH_ON%Don't worry about that, I'll get that fixed, too. Just needed for the man to stop screaming and moving around so much and a little bit of a breather so I can catch my breath. Do you wish to watch?%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist grabs the man's foot. It flops around in his grasp as though he was holding dough. You shake your head and hurry from the tent.}
aa901dbb976cafb6246a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你勉强同意，让解剖学者%anatomist%动手。你本想跟他和%clubfoot%一起进帐篷，可先打断脚再治好的办法，怎么想都……站不住脚。于是，你转而去做最喜欢的事：清点库存。安安静静记下每样东西剩多少，还需要多少，战团又以多快的速度消耗它们。一切都妙趣横生。

确实，没什么比清点库存更惬意。唯一能打断这份乐趣的，就是你刻意避开的那顶帐篷里，突然传来%clubfoot%尖厉而可怕的惨叫。如今，那凄厉的声音充斥四周，你只得冲进帐篷。%anatomist%站在一旁，正擦着额头的汗。%SPEECH_ON%你好，团长。嗯，我简单总结一下。如你所见，出现了一些预料之外的状况。当然，这些都能恢复，不必担心。不过，跛足还是治不好。它对我的疗法，呃，颇为顽固。%SPEECH_OFF%你看向%clubfoot%。他已经昏了过去，膝盖以下的腿扭得像条拧紧的破布。解剖学者一本正经地点头。%SPEECH_ON%那个也别担心，我会修好的。只是得等他别再尖叫，也别乱动，再稍歇一口气，让我缓过来。你要旁观吗？%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者抓起那人的脚。脚在他手里软塌塌晃荡，像块面团。你摇摇头，匆匆逃出帐篷。}

e43e91b3efab967c7243.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You look at %anatomist% inquisitively.%SPEECH_ON%Am I running a horse racing outfit here? If the man wants his busted foot to get fixed, he can go out to pasture with honor and dignity. We won't be needing bizarre experiments that'll end up with the old gods know what results.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist clears his throat and says that the procedures are fairly simple, but he slips up in also saying that the scientific gains to be made from completing them are immense, showing that he did not have %clubfoot%'s interests in mind at all. You tell the man the conversation is over.}
e43e91b3efab967c7243.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你疑惑地看着%anatomist%。%SPEECH_ON%我这儿开的是赛马场吗？他若想治好那只伤脚，大可以体体面面地退下来养伤。我们不需要那些古怪试验，弄到最后会怎样，只有旧神知道。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者清清嗓子，说这些操作其实十分简单，却又失言提到，完成后将带来多么巨大的学术收获，暴露了他压根没将%clubfoot%的利益放在心上。你告诉他，这事到此为止。}

e51ed882d3b02081fa60.translation: 被一个疯子拿来做实验

c2bdaf5ffecc2f1e8472.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]{%anatomist% the anatomist comes up to you with a horrific idea: he wants to take one of the company's dogs and open it up. Just to be sure, you ask him if he means to kill the dog. He throws his head side to side as though to weigh the options.%SPEECH_ON%I believe from the canine's perspective it would be best if it had expired before we go dissecting it.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist explains that the use of dogs for studies isn't unusual, and that this requirement will be for the betterment of understanding direwolves which, by some long stretch, a dog is no doubt related. You can't imagine the slaughtering of a company dog will go well with the rest of the men and tell him to find one of the hundreds of mangy mutts moping around. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%All dogs are almost assuredly cousin to the direwolf, but a fighting dog is of a different breed, and most assuredly the closest to the matter at heart.%SPEECH_OFF%}
c2bdaf5ffecc2f1e8472.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]{解剖学者%anatomist%来找你，提出一个骇人的主意：他想拿战团的一条狗来剖开看看。为了问清楚，你追问他是不是打算杀了那条狗。他把脑袋左右晃了晃，仿佛正在权衡利弊。%SPEECH_ON%我想，站在这只犬的立场上，最好是在我们开始解剖前，就已经断气了。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者解释，用狗做研究并不罕见，这次是为了增进对恐狼的了解。虽然血缘关系可能隔了很远，但狗无疑与恐狼有亲缘。你实在不觉得杀掉战团的狗能让其他人高兴，便叫他从四周晃悠的成百上千条癞皮野狗里挑一条。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%几乎可以断定，所有狗都是恐狼的远亲。但战犬是另一回事，它们的品种不同，与我们真正想研究的对象，亲缘必然也最接近。%SPEECH_OFF%}

ef75e8f740244f035dd8.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_37.png[/img]{You nod and tell the man to do what he must. As far as you're concerned, you're here to help these anatomists do their business, and sometimes that might mean cutting into the company funds. In this case, a fighting dog just happens to represent those funds. %anatomist% is pleased and sets off to do it. You hear the jangle of the dog's collar followed by a brief yelp. You tune out the sounds that come after.

%anatomist% eventually reappears with bloodied hands. He nods and says that the specimen was satisfactory and that much has been learned from its fighting spirit. You tell him to bury the dog. He seems disgusted, but you glare at him and he backs off, saying he'll give it a proper burial.}
ef75e8f740244f035dd8.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_37.png[/img]{你点点头，让他去做该做的事。在你看来，你的差事就是帮这些解剖学者开展研究，有时难免要牺牲一点战团的财产。这一回，恰好是一条战犬。%anatomist%满意地走开了。你听见狗项圈叮当作响，紧接着是一声短促的呜咽。之后的动静，你不再去听。

过了些时候，%anatomist%双手沾血地回来了。他点头说，这份标本十分理想，其战斗本能让他获益良多。你叫他把狗埋了。他面露嫌恶，你狠狠瞪了他一眼，他这才收敛，答应好好安葬它。}

9ce215f11ece2dc67b31.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_19.png[/img]{You give %anatomist% the go ahead. He smiles like a child given his first gift. As he heads off, you wonder if you've made the wrong choice. You hear the anatomist wrangling with the dog, the clinking of its collar and the growling of it being roughed up. You await the yelp, only to hear instead a that's definitely human, and even a little bit feminine. As you race over to the scene, a large dog bolts past. You find %anatomist% on the ground holding his hand. Undeterred or perhaps trying to find some educational value, the anatomist mutters sweet scientific nothings to himself.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, I think that proves that maybe it did have a little direwolf in its blood.%SPEECH_OFF%Regardless of what %anatomist% could glean from a bleeding wound, the dog itself is nowhere to be found. No doubt it even understand that such a betrayal did not emerge from nothing. If there's direwolf in that dog, then there's also regular dog in that dog, and even a dog knows when its masters have betrayed it.}
9ce215f11ece2dc67b31.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_19.png[/img]{你准许%anatomist%动手。他笑得像个头一回收到礼物的孩子。看着他离开，你开始怀疑自己是否做了个错误的决定。接着，你听见解剖学者在跟狗较劲，项圈叮当作响，被粗暴对待的狗不断低吼。你等着听狗的哀叫，传来的却是一声分明属于人类、甚至还有点像女人的尖叫。你冲过去时，一条大狗从身边飞奔而过。%anatomist%坐在地上，捂着手。他毫不气馁，或许也是想从中找点学术价值，便自言自语，用些好听的科学道理安慰自己。%SPEECH_ON%啊，我想这也许证明，它的血统里确实有一点恐狼的成分。%SPEECH_OFF%不管%anatomist%能从流血的伤口里研究出什么，狗已经不见了踪影。它想必也明白，这场背叛绝非无缘无故。即便它有恐狼的血统，终究也有狗的本性；就算是条狗，也知道主人什么时候背叛了自己。}

93025c110d18d81cc59d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]{%anatomist% sighs, but does not offer much protest and ultimately submits to your denial and walks away with a bit of a slouch. You ponder if he had a tail if it would find the place between his legs just then. Just then the prospect of his scientific designs, the dog itself, appears wagging its tail and carrying a stick in its mouth. It puts the stick down at your feet, but when you go to pick the stick up the dog growls and snatches it away. Maybe these strange creatures should have been studied...}
93025c110d18d81cc59d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]{%anatomist%叹了口气，没多争辩，最终接受了你的拒绝，垂头丧气地走开。你琢磨，他若有条尾巴，此刻多半夹在两腿之间。恰在此时，他想拿来研究的那只狗摇着尾巴出现了，嘴里叼着根木棍。它把木棍放到你脚边，可你刚伸手去捡，它又低吼着抢了回去。也许这些怪东西还真该研究一下……}

14a37fe579142bdbfeb1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{You let the %anatomist% do as he desires. If your job is to help them along in their scientific duties, then incidents like this are going to be a part of that. A little off a ways you can hear the anatomist wrestling with the dog and trying to pin it down for a quick death. But then you hear a man's voice bark in from the side, and the wrestling takes on a distinctly human tone, with more shouts and curses, and voices pleading for reprieve. You realize that you had totally forgotten about the company houndmaster. You hurry over to find %houndmaster% whipping the anatomist with a dog leash and throwing the occasional punch.%SPEECH_ON%Does this hurt, huh? How about this? Tell me, do you learn as you bleed? What do you think your teeth will taste like if I turn them into farkin' powder, huh?%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you go over and pull the houndmaster off the anatomist. %houndmaster% defends himself, saying that %anatomist% was trying to kill one of the dogs. You handwave this away, saying that perhaps there must have been some miscommunication somewhere. You look down at the bloodied anatomist and tell him to stay far away from the dogs and before he can bloodily gargle some protest about how it was you who said he could do it, you simply turn and walk away.}
14a37fe579142bdbfeb1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{你让%anatomist%按自己的意思去做。如果你的职责是协助他们完成科学研究，那么这样的事便是其中一部分。不远处，你听见解剖学者正与狗扭打，想将它按住，给它个痛快。可随后，旁边传来一个男人的怒喝，扭打也明显变成人与人之间的动静，夹杂更多喊叫、咒骂和求饶。你这才想起，自己完全忘了战团里还有驯犬师。你匆匆赶过去，发现%houndmaster%正拿狗绳抽打解剖学者，时不时再补一拳。%SPEECH_ON%疼吗，嗯？这下呢？告诉我，流着血是不是也能学到东西？要是我把你的牙全打成粉，你觉得会是什么滋味，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%你叹着气上前，把驯犬师从解剖学者身上拉开。%houndmaster%辩解，说%anatomist%想杀战团的狗。你挥挥手，含糊地说，也许中间有什么误会。你低头看着满身是血的解剖学者，叫他离狗远点。他刚想含着血抗议，说当初明明是你准许的，你已转身走了。}

42cda5370bb62d905808.source: Was denied the opportunity to study a wardog.

6db5ef70324acfec5418.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{%historian% the historian and the anatomists are getting into some sort of scribal spat. You walk over to see that %historian% is holding up a book filled with bodily descriptions and images. He states that it is the most accurate portrayal of the human body known to man, but the anatomists scoff, saying such a book doesn't exist for they have yet to write one. Interested, you take a look at the book. The drawings show man as a series of what look like very long worms, that flow to his heart and back out, each dedicated to one particular traversal. Other pages show the body parts laid out, showing lungs, kidneys, the liver, and more. It does seem rather detailed, but you're not exactly one to know who would ever be right in this case.%SPEECH_ON%Do not ascribe to that book's lies, captain. Let us anatomists do our work, so that such awful tomes may be put to the dust where they belong.%SPEECH_OFF%Furious, the historian snatches the book from your hand and shows a page to them. It has the human brain displayed, with numerous ropes or cords stretching out from it and down the spine. He states that this is central to the human experience, all that we are and all that we think we are is found in this organ. Again, the anatomists scoff. The historian turns to you, as though your layman's perspective might arbitrate the feelings of eggheads, and indeed every party present seems to wait on your word.}
6db5ef70324acfec5418.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{历史学者%historian%和解剖学者们正为某种书本上的事争执。你走过去，见%historian%举着一本满是人体描述与图画的书，声称这是世间已知最准确的人体著述。解剖学者们却嗤之以鼻，说那样的书根本不存在，因为他们还没动笔写呢。你来了兴趣，接过查看。图里的人像由一条条长虫拼成，那些东西流向心脏，再由心脏流出，各有各的路径。其他书页将身体各部分分开排列，展示肺、肾、肝等器官。看起来确实详尽，可你实在不是能判断这事谁对谁错的人。%SPEECH_ON%团长，别相信这书上的谎话。让我们解剖学者专心研究，才能把这种糟糕的著作扫进它该去的尘土里。%SPEECH_OFF%历史学者怒气冲冲地从你手里抢过书，翻出一页给他们看。上面画着人的大脑，许多绳索或细线般的东西由此伸出，沿着脊柱向下。他说，这才是人之所以为人的核心：我们是什么，以及我们自以为是什么，全都藏在这个器官里。解剖学者们再次嗤笑。历史学者转向你，仿佛凭你这个外行的见解，就能调解书呆子们的意气之争。而在场众人，竟真的全在等你开口。}

1ac1baa31ade212eef65.source: I think the historian is correct.
1ac1baa31ade212eef65.translation: 我觉得历史学者说得对。

d92b076520824bd7f9d7.source: The anatomists probably know more on this.
d92b076520824bd7f9d7.translation: 这方面，解剖学者大概更懂。

d2e1f7b907d6ba9bfdd1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{You sigh and say, without literally any knowledge about the subject at all, that the historian has the right idea. After all, if someone put it in ink, then surely it meant something important, and was presumably right. This assertion brings both parties together against you. Even the historian protests, despite your defense of him.%SPEECH_ON%Just because it's in ink does not in anyway mean it is therefore automatically correct.%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing again, you ask who would waste ink on the wrong idea? Both the historian and the anatomists laugh at you for doubling down on such an absurd notion. They walk off together shaking their heads and muttering something about the laity. For a brief moment, you picture yourself running them all through with a sword and the image is grossly satisfying, but that's where you leave it.}
d2e1f7b907d6ba9bfdd1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{你叹口气，明明对此一窍不通，却还是说历史学者的想法是对的。毕竟，既然有人肯费墨水写下来，那一定是重要的道理，想必也没错。这话倒让两派联合起来反对你。就连受你维护的历史学者都提出抗议。%SPEECH_ON%写在纸上，可不意味着它就自动成了真理。%SPEECH_OFF%你又叹口气，反问，谁会浪费墨水去写错话？历史学者与解剖学者们听你还在坚持这荒谬想法，都笑了起来。他们一道摇着头走开，嘴里嘀咕着什么门外汉。那一瞬间，你想象自己拔剑把他们一一捅穿，痛快得有些过分。不过，也就想想到此为止。}

84e22b1e0a5953d454df.translation: 竟让几个书呆子给欺负了。

5aeea8ff8ec5caf871b5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{You tell the historian that the anatomists are well traveled and surely they have seen other books greater and grander than the one he has. The anatomists turn to you. They speak plainly.%SPEECH_ON%No, we haven't.%SPEECH_OFF%Not sure what they mean, you try and press the fact that you're defending them on this issue, reiterating that surely they've read plenty on the subject. Again, they scoff at you.%SPEECH_ON%Read plenty? READ? Do you not see that we have come out this way not in the interest of reading, but of doing. We are men of action, and by action we will find the truth of all matters of this world, particularly those regarding its men and beasts alike. The idea that we read our way to this position is something we take offense to.%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you try to amend the issue, but now %historian% the historian jumps in.%SPEECH_ON%Captain, do you also see me in this light? That I have merely read my way to this position? I, too, can fight, you know? That is why I am here. I hope you do not see me as someone of minor use to read a book here and there and do little else.%SPEECH_OFF%You've enough of this lot and turn and leave, hearing mutterings of how insulting it is that you think of them as mere eggheads and not the warriors that any sellsword company would hire. A thought of challenging them to martial combat arises, but you leave it be. Another thought of simply slaughtering them in their sleep also comes to mind. You dwell on it for a minute, but also let it go.}
5aeea8ff8ec5caf871b5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{你告诉历史学者，解剖学者们见多识广，肯定读过比他手里那本更高明、更了不起的书。解剖学者们转向你，直截了当地说。%SPEECH_ON%没有，我们没读过。%SPEECH_OFF%你没弄懂他们的意思，试图强调自己是在帮他们说话，又重申，他们对这方面一定读过不少。他们却再度嗤之以鼻。%SPEECH_ON%读过不少？读？你没看出来吗？我们千里迢迢出来，为的不是读，而是做。我们是实干之人，要靠行动探明世间万物的真相，尤其是人类与野兽。说我们是靠读书走到今天，简直是侮辱。%SPEECH_OFF%你叹口气，想挽回局面，历史学者%historian%却又插了进来。%SPEECH_ON%团长，你也是这样看我的？觉得我不过靠读书混到了这里？我也能打仗，知道吗？这才是我在这里的原因。我希望你别把我看成一个偶尔翻几页书、除此之外没什么用的人。%SPEECH_OFF%你受够了这群家伙，转身离开。身后还在嘀咕，说你竟把他们当成书呆子，而非任何佣兵战团都会雇用的战士，实在令人受辱。你一度想向他们发起比武挑战，最终作罢。随后又闪过一个念头，干脆趁他们睡着全杀了。你琢磨了一会儿，也放下了。}

4583e5001cfb896c7af7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{Having great stamina is quite important in the world of sellswording, but it is clear that some men are far more capable of combating fatigue than others. %ironlungs% is one such man, a fighter notorious for keeping steady breath long into a grueling battle. To you, this is nothing more than something of a curiosity, like when a man has a weird neck, huge hands, or a big hammer between his legs. But to %anatomist%, it's something else entirely. He wishes to know how exactly one man can have such sturdy and powerful lungs when his day-to-day life is of little difference compared to those around him.%SPEECH_ON%We're all fighters here, so how did it come to pass that this man can breathe at such a steady rate compared to the rest of us? Surely he contains an element that we do not, and I think I may be able to find that element.%SPEECH_OFF%Wait, 'we' are all fighters here? You wouldn't quite go that far, but you don't correct the anatomist. You ask him how exactly he'd study this matter.%SPEECH_ON%A simple dissection would not be a digression, all things considered, but I believe that %ironlungs% would refuse the request. So, that leaves me with one options, which is to study him intently and see if I can replicate his strengths unto myself through bone manipulation and careful incisions.%SPEECH_OFF%}
4583e5001cfb896c7af7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{干佣兵这行，充沛的体力至关重要，可有些人显然比旁人更能忍受疲劳。%ironlungs%就是其中之一：哪怕苦战许久，他仍能保持呼吸平稳，这一点无人不知。在你看来，这无非算件奇事，就像有人脖子古怪、手掌巨大，或是两腿之间长了把大锤。可在%anatomist%眼里，事情全然不同。他想弄清楚，一个人的日常生活与旁人没什么区别，怎么就能长出如此强健有力的肺？%SPEECH_ON%大家都是战士，为何偏偏这人比我们都能保持呼吸平稳？他体内一定有某种我们没有的要素，我想，我能够找到它。%SPEECH_OFF%等等，“大家”都是战士？这话未免说得太满，不过你没纠正解剖学者，只问他究竟打算怎样研究。%SPEECH_ON%综合来看，简单解剖一下，倒不失为切中要害的办法，可我想%ironlungs%不会答应。所以，我只剩一种选择：仔细观察他，再通过调整骨骼和谨慎切开身体，试着将他的长处复制到我自己身上。%SPEECH_OFF%}

7f484ad8bd3f4c1b8340.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You tell the anatomist to go on doing whatever he wants to do. He takes out a quill pen and some books, and then follows that up with a pannier filled with metal tongs and scissors and scalpels. He checks them each for cleanliness, then lofts them up and goes over to %ironlungs%. The sellsword responds with awkward stares. Eventually, the anatomist convinces the man to step into a tent with him. You keep an eye on the area in case the anatomist loses it and goes into a mad egghead rampage. Eventually, %anatomist% returns with a vial in hand which he swirls around for a time, then drinks. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Hopefully this may work. I took great strains to my own body, to really stress the lungs, followed by some ingredients courtesy of %ironlungs% himself. Then, naturally, additional elements which I shall not divulge to anyone, ever, for if this works I may yet be the expert in its field, a true hero to the sciences, and absolutely have one up and over other anatomists.%SPEECH_OFF%Alright. %ironlungs% appears from the tent now. You ask him what all happened. The man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%I told him that I stretch a lot and have good posture, and that I do practice my breathing now and again. He refused these answers, convincing himself there must be some other way. Then he went full on nutbar with the tools he had and started, uh, 'working' on himself. Whatever he did looked mighty painful, but he took it in stride.%SPEECH_OFF%Wait, you practice your breathing?}
7f484ad8bd3f4c1b8340.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你让解剖学者按自己的想法去做。他拿出羽毛笔和几本书，又取来一只篮子，里面装满金属钳、剪刀和解剖刀。他逐一检查是否干净，随后提起工具，走向%ironlungs%。佣兵只能尴尬地瞪着他。最终，解剖学者说服那人一同进了帐篷。你留意着那边，免得这个书呆子忽然发狂，闹出什么事来。过了一阵，%anatomist%拿着一支小瓶回来，晃动片刻，仰头喝下，然后点头。%SPEECH_ON%希望这能奏效。我让自己的身体承受了极大负担，充分压迫肺部，又加入一些由%ironlungs%本人提供的材料。当然，还有些额外成分，我永远不会透露给任何人。倘若成功，我就会成为这一领域的权威，学术界真正的英雄，更能彻底压过其他解剖学者一头。%SPEECH_OFF%好吧。这时，%ironlungs%从帐篷里出来。你问究竟发生了什么，他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我说自己经常拉伸，姿势端正，偶尔也练练呼吸。他不接受这些答案，认定一定另有门道。然后就拿着那些工具彻底发起疯来，开始，呃，在自己身上“动工”。不知道他具体干了什么，看着可疼得要命，不过他居然挺了过来。%SPEECH_OFF%等等，你还练呼吸？}

2303004fbcc0dd625b2a.translation: 这下，我连呼吸都得刻意思量了。

d5bdd2b6a12f04f7f55f.source: When just breathing makes you a dull boy.
d5bdd2b6a12f04f7f55f.translation: 嫌光喘气太无聊，就非得折腾。

0f8c635ca2640a211548.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You tell the anatomist to mind his own business. When he puts up a fuss, which is getting dangerously close to making it your business, you tell him that %ironlungs% is his own man, and wholly his own, and that there's nothing to be taken from his existence aside from a modicum of admiration. And that's that. %anatomist% opens his mouth in response, then closes it. Instead, whatever he was thinking is put down in his notes. You hope any drama behind it dries alongside his ink.}
0f8c635ca2640a211548.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你让解剖学者少管闲事。他开始争辩，眼看就要把闲事变成你的麻烦。你告诉他，%ironlungs%是个独立的人，全身上下都属于他自己；除了稍加钦佩，谁也别想从他身上取走什么。这事到此为止。%anatomist%张嘴想回话，随后又闭上，把心里想的写进笔记。你希望那些是非也能随着墨迹一同干掉。}

368e6c0083cff46b23eb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{You find %anatomist% holding up the bare foot of %splinterbro%. Naturally, you inquire just what they're doing. The anatomist straightens up with a tweezer in hand and pinched between its prongs is a huge splinter. %splinterbro% wiggles his toes then gets to his feet. He walks around, then quickly plants his foot and pivots and walks backwards and forwards.%SPEECH_ON%I'll be damned. I thought I'd just busted my foot or somethin', turns out I'd just been walking around with a huge arsed splinter for years! This feels great!%SPEECH_OFF%Instead of throwing the splinter away, %anatomist% confines it to a wooden box where other medical oddities are rolling around.}
368e6c0083cff46b23eb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{你发现%anatomist%正托着%splinterbro%的一只光脚，自然要问问他们在干什么。解剖学者直起身，手里拿着镊子，镊尖夹着一根硕大的木刺。%splinterbro%活动活动脚趾，站了起来。他走了几步，又猛地踩实地面，转身，前前后后地来回走。%SPEECH_ON%真他娘的！我一直以为是脚受过什么伤，闹了半天，竟是扎着这么大一根木刺走了好几年！这下可舒坦了！%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist%没有丢掉木刺，而是把它收进一只木盒。盒里还有各种稀奇古怪的医用收藏，随着动作滚来滚去。}

0b0aa6f966ebd93f50e1.source: I best not see you using that as a toothpick.
0b0aa6f966ebd93f50e1.translation: 最好别让我看见你拿那东西剔牙。

f4811934720cc534167c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]{You come to a remote village to find a few of its peoples crouched before a large, bleached skull decoratively set on a lectern. Passing peasants pause and profess faith to it. As you get closer, you realize the skull itself is extraordinary: a long, thick forehead juts out from the top, its brow quite dominant and ridged, and the jaw of it, still intact, carries enormous and sharp teeth, most of which are in a state of disorder, as if in any ordinary head closing such a mouth would be a danger to itself. What it very well may be is a Nachzehrer's skull. Naturally, with this strange skeletal sight before you, you hope to turn the company away before-%SPEECH_ON%We should take that for studying.%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you turn to see %anatomist% standing there, ogling the skull. You correct him, saying instead that what he really means is he intends to steal it. The anatomist stares at you.%SPEECH_ON%The vocabulary needn't matter, when the studying is done, it will be of better use in our hands than theirs, that much is clear.%SPEECH_OFF%}
f4811934720cc534167c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]{你来到一个偏僻村庄，发现几个村民正蹲伏在一颗硕大、发白的头骨前。那头骨摆在讲经台上，装点得颇为郑重。路过的农民纷纷驻足，向它祈祷。走近些，你才看出这颗头骨确实非同寻常：额骨又长又厚，向前突出，眉脊高耸而粗粝，尚且完好的颌骨上生着巨大而尖锐的牙齿，大多错乱不齐。换作普通的脑袋，合上这样的嘴恐怕都会扎伤自己。这多半是颗食尸鬼的头骨。眼前摆着如此奇怪的骨头，你自然想赶紧带战团离开，免得——%SPEECH_ON%我们应该把它带回去研究。%SPEECH_OFF%你叹着气转过身，发现%anatomist%正站在那里，两眼放光地盯着头骨。你纠正他，说他真正想说的是把它偷走。解剖学者直直地看着你。%SPEECH_ON%用什么词并不重要。等研究完了，它在我们手里所发挥的作用，一定比留在他们手里大。这一点显而易见。%SPEECH_OFF%}

f838fb13125d3ebf90a7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{Sighing, you agree to the anatomist's fancies, but you tell him that it will be he who does the stealing, if it is he who wishes to do the studying. The man doesn't even hesitate and heads off, eyes narrowed to the bony item central to his scientific fancy. You're not going to be responsible for the mayhem that goes down if he is caught so you leave him to it, returning instead to count inventory while keeping your ears perked for sounds of religion wrecking chaos. A few moments later, %anatomist% returns, a fat skull cradled under an arm and a bit of sweat on his brow.%SPEECH_ON%It's a Nachzehrer's skull and should be of great value to our studies.%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask him how it was that he managed to get the skull in the first place. %anatomist% raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%You weren't watching? I thought the endeavor was quite impressive, but alas so impressive that I believe telling it second hand will make you susceptible to believing me to tell a tall tale. A fable, if you will. Just know that we should probably get out of here soon. Perhaps sooner than soon, and quicker than quick. Do you understand?%SPEECH_OFF%A din of shouting grows in the distance. The anatomist wipes his brow and turns and walks away. The back of his shirt is clawed apart and there are little darts or arrows sticking out of his back - and those distant shouts are getting louder.}
f838fb13125d3ebf90a7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{你叹了口气，答应解剖学者这番异想天开，但告诉他，既然是他想研究，就得由他去偷。他毫不迟疑，眯眼盯着那件让自己满心惦记的骨头，径直走了。若被抓住，闹出乱子，你可不想替他负责，便留他自己办，回去清点库存，只竖着耳朵，留意是否传来信仰遭亵渎后的骚乱。不一会儿，%anatomist%回来了，胳膊下夹着一颗硕大的头骨，额头微微冒汗。%SPEECH_ON%是食尸鬼的头骨，对我们的研究应该大有价值。%SPEECH_OFF%你好奇地问，他到底怎么拿到手的。%anatomist%挑起眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%你没看？我觉得那番壮举相当精彩。唉，精彩得若由我转述，你多半会以为我在吹牛，甚至当成寓言也不为过。你只需知道，我们最好尽快离开，或许还得比尽快更快，比赶紧更赶紧。明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%远处的喊声渐渐响起。解剖学者擦擦额头，转身走开。你这才看见，他背后的衬衣被抓得稀烂，身上还插着几支小飞镖或箭——而远处的喊声，正越来越近。}

0ee452504988e0f56edd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You tell %anatomist% he can take the skull. He stares at you for a time, then says he thought you were the one that was going to do it. You tell him there's no way you're taking a skull from local peasants who worship said skull. If he wishes to do the studying, then it is he who should do the stealing. %anatomist% draws a hand to his chest.%SPEECH_ON%I'm a man of science, and no ordinary scribe, I could not deign myself to a task of such lowness. It requires a man of knowhow, a man who understands the grit and grime of daily life, to steal this skull.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist clenches a fist, so certain that his speech is not an insult to you, and his eyes staring off with determined ferocity that could only be vicarious at best.%SPEECH_ON%What the fark you two strangers talkin' about?%SPEECH_OFF%You both turn around to see a peasant holding a pitchfork, and as a few more join him he motions toward you.%SPEECH_ON%These fellas were aimin' to steal the skull!%SPEECH_OFF%You hold your hands out, explaining that- before you finish, %anatomist% turns and sprints away. Thinking fast, you call him a thief and promise to have his head, making a grand show of drawing out your sword and waving it at the peasants. You pretend to accidentally drop a purse of crowns, turning the peasants' anger into greed, and giving you enough time to escape.}
0ee452504988e0f56edd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你告诉%anatomist%，他可以拿走头骨。他盯着你看了一阵，说自己还以为该由你去拿。你告诉他，你绝不会从一群崇拜这头骨的当地农民手里偷东西。既然他想研究，就该他去偷。%anatomist%把手按在胸口。%SPEECH_ON%我是探求科学的学者，绝非寻常抄写员，岂能屈尊去做这等下作之事。偷走头骨，需要一位有实际手腕的人，一位熟知日常生活中粗鄙与污浊的人。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者攥紧拳头，显然完全不觉得这番话是在侮辱你。他目光坚定而凶狠地望向远处，可那股勇气至多也只是寄托在别人身上。%SPEECH_ON%你们两个外乡人在说什么鬼话？%SPEECH_OFF%你们一齐回头，看见一个农民正拿着干草叉。又有几人围过来，他指向你们。%SPEECH_ON%这两个家伙想偷头骨！%SPEECH_OFF%你摊开双手，正要解释——话还没说完，%anatomist%已转身拔腿就跑。你急中生智，大骂他是贼，声称定要砍下他的脑袋，煞有介事地拔剑，在农民面前挥舞。随后，你假装不慎掉下一袋克朗，让他们的怒气化成贪念，给自己争出足够的逃跑时间。}

44d31bd922b71fd74cd7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]{Sighing, you agree to the idea of stealing the skull. Before you can say anything more, %thief% the thief appears. He comes up chewing grass and walking with swagger.%SPEECH_ON%So you wanna steal something, hm? Just point at whatcha need and I'll go and fetch it for you. Is it gold? A weapon?%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist% points at the skull. The thief stares at it for a time before turning back.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, uh, alright.%SPEECH_OFF%The thief and would be skull stealer wanders off. You go and count inventory, giving him time to do his job. He later returns with the skull in tow, as well as a bevy of weapons and armor which you know he didn't buy. As you stare at the clearly lifted goods, the man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%What? I had to make it worth my time.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist takes the skull away without saying a word, carrying it off while staring into its emptied eyesockets as though it were a lover, muttering that many things will be learned from its vacant stare. The thief does the same, but instead with a satchel of crowns and other goodies, himself muttering that he'll finally be able to afford two whores at the same time, an apparent long held dream of his. You take the weapons and armor to inventory, and in the distance you hear the wailing of peasants looking for the relic.}
44d31bd922b71fd74cd7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]{你叹了口气，答应偷走头骨。还没来得及多说，盗贼%thief%便出现了，嘴里嚼着草，走得大摇大摆。%SPEECH_ON%所以，想偷点东西，嗯？指给我看，我去给你弄来。金子？武器？%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist%指向头骨。盗贼盯着看了一阵，转回头。%SPEECH_ON%噢，呃，行吧。%SPEECH_OFF%这位即将转行偷头骨的盗贼溜达着走了。你去清点库存，留给他办事的时间。后来，他带着头骨回来，还捎上一大堆武器和盔甲，你知道，这些绝不可能是买的。见你盯着那些明摆着偷来的东西，他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%怎么了？总得让这趟工夫花得值吧。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者一言不发地抱走头骨，像凝视情人般盯着空眼窝，嘟囔着从这空洞的目光里能学到许多东西。盗贼也差不多，只是他抱着的是一袋克朗和其他好货，嘴里念的是，终于能同时找两个妓女了，看来这还是他多年的心愿。你把武器盔甲收进库存，远处则传来了农民们寻找圣物的哭喊。}

ac5e9844aeddc35fe3cd.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{You decide that if the anatomists can make some grand use of the skull, then you'll abide by giving them the chance to study it. The question is how does one go about stealing a hideous skull from a group so insane they'd worship it? Almost as if on cue, %wildman% the wildman appears, chowing down on a handful of worms. His nature-rinsed face and cruelly shaped skull seem almost kin to the monstrosity which resides on the village's town center lectern. %anatomist% snaps his fingers and claims to have an idea. He pulls the wildman forward, and the two walk straight toward the village's beloved skull.

The anatomist pushes the wildman before the praying folk, and claims that they have murdered one who is cousin to his being. He states that by stealing the skull of his kin, they have doomed him to a life of being cursed. The crowd is horrified, not realizing the error of their ways. The wildman eats another worm. You continue to watch as the anatomist picks up the skull, lofts it over his head, and says that with this he may finally heal %wildman% of what ails him, and through him also lift any curses which have befallen the village itself. By this point the crowd is arisen, taken to the anatomist like a tentpole priest, and they clap as he leaves, cheering the theft as it were, the skull lofted above his head. The two men return to you. %anatomist% grins.%SPEECH_ON%To study the body, one shouldn't forget to study the mind, and in studying the mind, one shouldn't forget to study minds, plural! For many minds put together are a creature to study in and of themselves.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist walks off. A group of peasants approach carrying goods of all sorts. They throw them at the feet of %wildman% in apology. The wildman eats another worm.}
ac5e9844aeddc35fe3cd.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你决定，既然解剖学者们能让那颗头骨大有用处，就给他们一个研究的机会。问题是，该怎么从一群疯到崇拜丑陋头骨的人手里，把它偷走？仿佛听见了召唤，荒野人%wildman%恰好出现，正大口嚼着一把蠕虫。他那张饱经风吹雨打的脸，以及形状凶悍的脑袋，与村中心台座上那件怪物遗骸，倒真像有几分亲缘。%anatomist%打个响指，宣称想到了办法。他拉过荒野人，两人径直走向村民珍爱的头骨。

解剖学者将荒野人推到祈祷的人群面前，声称他们杀害了此人的同族，又窃取亲人的头骨，害他一生遭受诅咒。众人大惊失色，此前竟从未意识到自己做错了什么。荒野人又吃了一条虫。你继续看着解剖学者捧起头骨，高举过顶，宣称有了它，终于能治好%wildman%的病痛，也能借此解除降临村庄的一切诅咒。此时，众人已激动万分，将解剖学者奉为布道的祭司。他举着头骨离去，人们便鼓掌欢呼，竟为这场盗窃喝起彩来。两人回到你身旁。%anatomist%咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%研究肉体时，也别忘了研究心智。而研究心智时，更别忘了研究许多人的心智！许多头脑聚在一起，本身就是一种值得研究的生物。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者走了。一群农民抱着各式物品过来，放在%wildman%脚边，向他赔罪。荒野人又吃了一条虫。}

ea15db68e35e0f9582cc.source: What's our thief %thief% have to say?
ea15db68e35e0f9582cc.translation: 咱们的小偷%thief%有什么话说？

581ad0065fa22f54c86c.source: That skull looks like our wildman, %wildman%.
581ad0065fa22f54c86c.translation: 那头骨长得挺像咱们的荒野人%wildman%。

f09d98267583a9e87c21.source: Acquired an unusual skull to study
f09d98267583a9e87c21.translation: 得到一颗奇异的头骨用于研究

82540eadad9a1debc48f.translation: 成功从农民那里偷到了东西

4e5b45c79a3159052b55.translation: 弄到了一颗奇异的头骨

c13caf75adcd731d218c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{%anatomist% hasn't been writing in his journals so much lately. When he does, the pen only seems to tap the pages now and again without scribbling anything of import. You inquire as to what has him so bothered. Somber in tone, he says that his primary hope in coming out to these lands was to find the White Nachzehrer, a monster that's larger than any of its kind. You tell him that you've slain a few nachs that were quite rotund, but the anatomist shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Per the literature, this nachzehrer cannot be felled by any man for it has grown to such proportions that its flesh has turned white, and it is covered in great ridges of calloused skin that no steel can penetrate. It was spotted roaming these lands and I'd hoped to find it, but it seems that, perhaps, I have been led astray. Maybe the anatomists who told me this tale have put me on a great snipe hunt. I worry, scapegrace, that I have been made a fool of.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him that this creature sounds like the 'king' of nachzehrers, and if that's the case then perhaps it no longer roams, but instead uses a small army of lesser nachzehrers to do its bidding for it. The anatomist smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Truly, this may be the case! Of course it took the scrying eye of the laity, so used to staring up at our purpled suzerains, to bring this to my clouded attention!%SPEECH_OFF%Agreeing with yourself further, you note that perhaps the 'White Nachzehrer' is so pale cause it doesn't get much sun. The anatomist laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Please, scapegrace, the first observation was sufficient input from your side.%SPEECH_OFF%}
c13caf75adcd731d218c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{%anatomist%近来不大写笔记了。偶尔动笔，也只是用笔尖有一下没一下地点着纸，没写出什么要紧内容。你问他，为何如此烦恼。他语气低落，说此番远行最大的心愿，是找到白色食尸鬼，一头比所有同类都庞大的怪物。你告诉他，自己也杀过几头十分肥硕的食尸鬼，解剖学者却摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%据文献记载，没有人能杀死这头食尸鬼。它长得如此巨大，皮肉已经变白，体表隆起厚厚的硬皮褶皱，任何钢刃都刺不穿。曾有人见它游荡于这片土地，我本想找到它，可现在看来，也许我被误导了。或许，告诉我这个故事的解剖学者们，只是在叫我追捕不存在的猎物。浪荡子，我担心自己成了笑话。%SPEECH_OFF%你说，这生物听起来像食尸鬼之“王”。若果真如此，也许它早已不再四处游荡，而是驱使一小群普通食尸鬼，为自己办事。解剖学者笑了。%SPEECH_ON%确实，很可能就是这样！果然，还得靠惯于仰望紫袍领主的平民那双洞察之眼，才能点醒我这蒙蔽的头脑！%SPEECH_OFF%你越想越觉得有理，又补充说，也许“白色食尸鬼”那么苍白，只是因为晒不到多少太阳。解剖学者笑出声。%SPEECH_ON%得了，浪荡子。你有前一个见解就够了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

99e90c717ae0dd12a5bd.source: Don't let your White Nach' earn you a black eye, bloody loggerhead.
99e90c717ae0dd12a5bd.translation: 别为了那只白食尸鬼，换来一只乌眼圈，蠢货。

ce17e608b42eeaedeee9.source: Had his faith in the existence of the white nachzehrer renewed
ce17e608b42eeaedeee9.translation: 重新坚信白色食尸鬼确实存在

c0689019e43518fe90ef.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You find %apprentice% the apprentice under the wings of %anatomist% the anatomist. It's a bit of a frightful sight, as you briefly wonder if the egghead is planning something nefarious. But %apprentice% is only learning things from him, as he is wont to do with most in the company. This time around it is not martial matters to which the anatomist is privy and the apprentice not, but instead methods of how to think, how to remember, and how to recall. You see %anatomist% tap his own head.%SPEECH_ON%Now remember, the faintest of inks is infinitely stronger than the most incredible of minds. All that you remember, you write down, but also recall this: your mind shall remember things you think you've forgotten. If in a moment of need, do not dwell on your thoughts, but let them come to the fore on their own, as they will usher themselves into the light without aid, but if sought they will only go deeper, and wish to be forgotten.%SPEECH_OFF%The apprentice nods attentively and takes notes. So long as these conversations stay within the bounds of not dissecting animals and questioning the old gods, you've no real qualm about it.}
c0689019e43518fe90ef.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你发现学徒%apprentice%正跟着解剖学者%anatomist%受教。这场面让你有些发毛，一瞬间还以为那书呆子在谋划什么邪恶的勾当。可%apprentice%只是在向他学习，就像平时向战团里大多数人求教一样。这一次，解剖学者懂而学徒不懂的，并非武艺，而是如何思考、记忆，以及唤回记忆的方法。你看见%anatomist%敲了敲自己的脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%记住，再淡的墨迹，也胜过最惊人的记性。记得的东西，都要写下来。但也别忘了，你以为已经忘记的事，头脑其实还替你记着。急用时，不要死盯着那些念头不放，要让它们自己浮上来。没有外力相助，它们也会走进光里；可越是穷追不舍，它们反而藏得越深，宁可被你遗忘。%SPEECH_OFF%学徒认真地点头，记着笔记。只要这些谈话还没越界到解剖动物、质疑旧神的地步，你就没什么好反对的。}

39d3fa419fd4080ac0d9.source: Just don't spend too much time together.

9c5be39949120cf919fb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{%apprentice% the apprentice is sitting beside the campfire when %oathtaker% the Oathtaker starts sizing him up. The apprentice returns a confused look.%SPEECH_ON%What is it?%SPEECH_OFF%The Oathtaker grins.%SPEECH_ON%Young Anselm, the First Oathtaker, was an apprentice much like you. He wandered the lands in seeking knowledge and finding himself the Final Path. You even look just like him.%SPEECH_OFF%The apprentice smiles warmly. It seems this notion of connectedness with the dead Oathtaker has emboldened the apprentice. But, as far as you're concerned, Young Anselm's skull looks absolutely nothing like %apprentice%. The nose is too big, the brow too ridged, and the First Oathtaker's teeth are impeccable while %apprentice% looks like he cleans his with a mallet. But maybe %apprentice% will look more the part when he is also a shiny skull cared for by an unwavering cult.}
9c5be39949120cf919fb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{学徒%apprentice%正坐在篝火旁，立誓者%oathtaker%忽然打量起他。学徒不解地望回去。%SPEECH_ON%怎么了？%SPEECH_OFF%立誓者笑道。%SPEECH_ON%初代立誓者小安塞尔姆，从前也是个和你一样的学徒。他游历四方，求索知识，最终找到了自己的终极之道。你连长相都与他相仿。%SPEECH_OFF%学徒露出温暖的笑容。能与那位逝去的立誓者有所关联，似乎让他备受鼓舞。可依你看，小安塞尔姆的头骨与%apprentice%根本不像。鼻子太大，眉骨太突，而且初代立誓者的牙齿完美无瑕，%apprentice%却像拿木槌刷牙。不过，等%apprentice%也成了颗亮闪闪的头骨，受到一群坚定信徒悉心照料时，兴许就像了。}

d780df99ac5ce67ecd2f.source: Not that I want that to happen.
d780df99ac5ce67ecd2f.translation: 当然，我可不盼着那种事发生。

322c2c40e722f2dc9803.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{A few of the Oathtakers bring a piece of paper to your attention. On it is the name of the %companyname%, a rather amusing drawing of yourself that is not remotely in proportion, and a few choice descriptors of your lowly character. It seems that your reputation in this world is not nearly as high and mighty as you assumed it to be.%SPEECH_ON%We must rectify this, captain! For people to think of the Oathtakers in this manner is a great insult to us, and especially to Young Anselm!%SPEECH_OFF%You agree. | As the company camps, a few of the Oathtakers are grousing about the reputation of the %companyname%.%SPEECH_ON%Young Anselm would not be happy with the way the world sees us. We should be setting an example of how to behave!%SPEECH_OFF%You agree, though it may take some time to repair the Oathtakers' honor. | Young Anselm founded the Oathtakers with the belief that they should be paragons reestablishing a precedence of honor, virtue, and sound character, elements which he believed the world had lost sight of. Unfortunately, you've struggled to maintain these ideals, slipping the %companyname%'s reputation a little lower than it ought to be. A few of the men are rightfully complaining, and if they're not outwardly complaining it is obvious that these faults are draining morale anyway. You think it best to perhaps start mending the %companyname%'s reputation as soon as possible lest the men lose faith in its ultimate purpose.}
322c2c40e722f2dc9803.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{几个立誓者拿来一张纸给你看。上面写着%companyname%的名字，画着一幅你的画像，比例错得离谱，倒颇为可笑，还用几个精挑细选的词，把你的人品贬了个遍。看来，你在世间的名声，远没自己想象中那么高尚伟大。%SPEECH_ON%团长，必须扭转这一切！世人竟这样看待立誓者，这是对我们的莫大侮辱，更是对小安塞尔姆的侮辱！%SPEECH_OFF%你表示同意。 | 战团扎营时，几个立誓者正抱怨%companyname%的名声。%SPEECH_ON%世人这样看我们，小安塞尔姆绝不会高兴。我们本该以身作则，让大家知道该如何做人！%SPEECH_OFF%你同意，不过要挽回立誓者的荣誉，恐怕还得花些时间。 | 小安塞尔姆创立立誓者时，希望他们成为世人的楷模，让荣誉、美德与端正品格重新受到重视；他相信，这些东西早已被世人遗忘。可惜，你没能守住这些理想，让%companyname%的名声跌到了不该有的地步。几个弟兄的抱怨不无道理，即便没有说出口，这些过失显然也在消磨士气。你觉得，还是尽快修复%companyname%的声誉为好，免得弟兄们连战团最终的使命也不再相信。}

a93909c25883360e81be.source: Is upset about the company's evil reputation
a93909c25883360e81be.translation: 为战团恶名远扬而苦恼

54b879a128150c62f443.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{%townname%'s fruit carts are laden with all manner of delicious albeit grossly overpriced treats. You side-eye one of their owners, trying to time his looking away with your own little five finger discount. Right as you're about to sneak a swipe, %anatomist% the anatomist runs up in a hurry, and more importantly gathering all the attention in the world. You put your petty thieving aside and ask what it is he wants. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%We have found the %townname%'s black market.%SPEECH_OFF%You head to the place and find a scrawny man leaning in a chair. On the desk in front of him is an assortment of 'goods', if they can be called that. To you, it looks like a pile of nondescript shite, but to the anatomist it may as well be a gift from the old gods. Yawning, the scrawny man says take your pick. %anatomist% leans in close, appraising the goods, and finds three that look to be of questionable quality and eventually dubious purpose. He cautions that perhaps the company should only purchase one.%SPEECH_ON%If the town guards find us with too many, they may confuse us with peddlers instead of mere purchasers, and peddling such goods is quite the criminal offense.%SPEECH_OFF%You take a look at the options.}
54b879a128150c62f443.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_01.png[/img]{%townname%的水果摊车上堆满了各式美味，可惜贵得离谱。你斜眼盯着其中一个摊主，准备趁他转头时，来一回不花钱的顺手牵羊。你刚要动手，解剖学者%anatomist%便急匆匆跑过来，更要命的是，把周围所有人的注意力都引了过来。你只得放弃这点偷摸的打算，问他有什么事。他咧嘴笑道。%SPEECH_ON%我们找到了%townname%的黑市。%SPEECH_OFF%你来到那里，发现一个瘦削的男人靠坐在椅子上，面前的桌上摆着各式“货物”，姑且这么称呼吧。在你看来，不过是一堆莫名其妙的破烂；可在解剖学者眼里，简直像旧神赐下的礼物。瘦男人打着呵欠，让你们随便挑。%anatomist%凑近端详，从中挑出三样东西，成色可疑，用途恐怕也不怎么正经。他提醒你，战团最好只买一样。%SPEECH_ON%如果被卫兵发现我们带着太多，他们可能会误以为我们是贩子，而非普通买家。贩卖这类东西，可是重罪。%SPEECH_OFF%你查看起可供挑选的几样物品。}

d9aa1a6b6b8b66f81f45.source: Let's get that brain-looking thing for 100 crowns.

21caa946188ea5e75661.source: I'll take the big heart for...550 crowns, is it?
21caa946188ea5e75661.translation: 那个大心脏我要了……550克朗，对吧？

abe5b651eacdd56e4861.source: I'll pay the 200 crowns for that...some kind of gland?

74468033842dd619036a.translation: 我们可供不起这些奢侈爱好。

eb941d511c4a05243bad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{You purchase what looks like a slab of condensed noodles, the spongy ropes grey with black dots mottling the cushy texture. Rather disgustingly, %anatomist% puts his whole palm upon the substance and presses in. When he takes his hand away, the print lingers, the flesh popping as it unsticks and reforms. He smiles.%SPEECH_ON%I believe we can make much use of this in our studies.%SPEECH_OFF%}
eb941d511c4a05243bad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{你买下一块像压实的面条团的东西，灰色软条如海绵般挤在一起，绵软表面斑驳着黑点。%anatomist%竟把整个手掌按上去，用力一压，看得人直犯恶心。他收回手时，掌印仍留在上面；肉块一边脱粘恢复原状，一边发出轻微的啪嗒声。他笑了。%SPEECH_ON%我相信，这对我们的研究大有用处。%SPEECH_OFF%}

2b255449516353aedb52.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{A wheelbarrow is needed to haul the huge organ. %anatomist% claims it is the heart of an Unhold and will be of plenty use as a specimen of study. The wheelbarrow is lowered and you both take a look at it, yourself an uncultured and uneducated layman looking at something gross and unsightly, and the anatomist an uncultured and educated layman looking at something gross and fascinating. What has you uneasy is that something so massive could be at the core of beast. The heart of man is small, yet it pumps with the fire and determination to bring all under his domain. Yet this heart...

Disturbingly, %anatomist% balls up his fist and punches it into one of the heart's chambers. You can see the muscle moving, seemingly pumping and throbbing like it may have once done. He takes his hand back out and looks upon the grime there: black tissues and a filmy layer of mold or blood or molding blood.%SPEECH_ON%Our studies will gain much from this specimen.%SPEECH_OFF%He looks at you as though for confirmation. You look at the weighted wheelbarrow and tell him if it's his specimen then it'll be his spine that gets broken hauling the damn thing around.}
2b255449516353aedb52.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{这颗巨大的器官得用独轮车才能运走。%anatomist%声称，它是巨魔的心脏，作为研究标本大有用处。你们放下独轮车，一同打量：你是个既没教养又没学问的外行，眼里只有恶心难看的东西；解剖学者则是个同样没教养、却读过书的外行，眼里是既恶心又迷人的东西。令你不安的是，一头野兽的胸腔深处，竟能藏着如此庞然大物。人的心脏虽小，跳动时却满是烈火与决心，誓要把世间一切收入自己治下。可这颗心脏……

%anatomist%攥起拳头，一拳捅进心脏的一间腔室，让人看得心惊。你看见肌肉随之蠕动，仿佛又像活着时那样鼓缩、搏动。他抽出手，看着手上沾的污物：黑色组织，以及一层薄薄的霉、血，或者发了霉的血。%SPEECH_ON%这份标本会让我们的研究大有进益。%SPEECH_OFF%他望向你，仿佛在等你认可。你看了一眼沉甸甸的独轮车，告诉他，既然是他的标本，那往后搬着这该死的东西赶路，就该由他的脊梁来受罪。}

9cb3fb063e081fbf0200.translation: 记住，搬东西时屈膝用力。

d3e9644e154d821079ce.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{To you, the purchase has all the appearance of ashen peapods twisted around one another. Grey lumps curve and flatten repeatedly across the organ as its muscles contour and twist like sailor's ropes. The ripples end in a fat bulb of tissue. %anatomist% explains.%SPEECH_ON%It is believed that this is the organ which gives the direwolf so much energy. Even its shape carries a sort of ferocious structure, as if the organ itself meant to replicate its very purpose.%SPEECH_OFF%He cuts into the tissue and pulls it back, revealing a web of fleshen tunnels and channels that end in a bizarre complex of chambers. There's no telling what use a human could make of this part, but as %anatomist% starts fingering around the holes you quickly leave, only warning him to not do that so publicly lest he arise within the peasantry a form of lynch-hungry disgust.}
d3e9644e154d821079ce.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{在你看来，买回来的东西就像几根灰白豌豆荚扭缠在一起。器官表面灰色的肉块反复隆起、摊平，肌束像水手的缆绳般盘曲，末端汇成一团肥厚的球状组织。%anatomist%解释道。%SPEECH_ON%一般认为，恐狼那旺盛的精力正是来自这个器官。就连它的形态都透着凶悍，仿佛连外形也要竭力表现自身的用途。%SPEECH_OFF%他切开组织，将切口拉开，露出密如蛛网的肉质管道，尽头连着一组构造怪异的腔室。你实在想不出，人拿这东西能有什么用。可%anatomist%已开始伸手指在孔洞里摸索，你赶紧离开，只提醒他别如此招摇，免得把乡民恶心得群起动用私刑。}

e05aa0956a964e658548.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{When you get back to the company, %anatomist% seems a little bummed with the purchase. He tries to divest from it something of use, something which perhaps no one else before has seen, but it seems his venture is ending with naught all. He complains that he knows these parts already, that they have already been written about, and that other people have already been made famous on their discoveries of it. Chowing down on some food, you nod as you listen, and pretend to care when he looks at you with sad eyes. He says.%SPEECH_ON%This substance is what the orcs eat, and sometimes it is cut of orc itself. We've known this for years. I thought I might take something out of it that had not been yet learned, yet my overconfidence has only led to the wastage of crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%You take a spoon of chicken grit and shove it in your mouth. You take out the spoon and stare at your misshapen reflection in it. Nodding, you say.%SPEECH_ON%It's all so fascinating. Now, have you tried eating it?%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist stares at the strange meat. He confesses that he does not think anyone has, at least not for the purpose of study. He stares at the meat a while longer. He mumbles.%SPEECH_ON%It would be a scientific matter, would it not?%SPEECH_OFF%You take another bite of grit and nod. %anatomist% digs his hand into the strange meat and pulls out a rib dripping with soggy flesh. He begins to dry heave and quickly gets up and runs off. You take the strange rib and toss it off the table and the second it touches the ground a pack of wild dogs emerge from an alley and fight one another to eat it. You point at the dogs and yell after the anatomist.%SPEECH_ON%Hey I think I just did an experiment!%SPEECH_OFF%}
e05aa0956a964e658548.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]{回到战团，%anatomist%似乎对这次购买颇为失望。他试图从中找出一点有用的东西，最好是前人从未见过的，可这番尝试眼看要一无所获。他抱怨，这些部位自己早已熟悉，书里早已记载，别人也早已凭借相关发现成名。你一边大口吃饭，一边点头听着。每当他用伤心的目光望过来，你便装出关切。他说道。%SPEECH_ON%这些东西就是兽人吃的，有时甚至直接从兽人身上切下来。我们多年前就知道了。我本以为能找出尚未掌握的知识，可过度自信，只让我白白浪费了克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%你舀起一勺鸡肉粥塞进嘴里，抽出勺子，望着勺面上歪曲的倒影，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%真是有趣极了。那么，你尝过没有？%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者盯着那块怪肉，承认自己觉得还没人试过，至少没人为了研究而吃。他又看了一阵，喃喃道。%SPEECH_ON%这也算学术研究，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你再吃一口粥，点头。%anatomist%把手探进怪肉，抽出一根挂着湿烂血肉的肋骨。他立刻干呕起来，匆忙起身跑开。你拿起那根怪肋骨，随手丢下桌。它才落地，一群野狗便从巷里窜出，为抢食打作一团。你指着狗群，冲解剖学者的背影喊道。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，我想我刚做了个实验！%SPEECH_OFF%}

11ddd15b0ac6f59bdf0b.translation: 得到了一份颇有研究价值的标本

16200f6e3b227926939d.source: A promising research specimen turned out to be useless
16200f6e3b227926939d.translation: 寄予厚望的研究标本毫无用处

0bca0e96e7ae13f2f16d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{Without giving you any heads up, it appears that %brawler% the brawler entered a fighting tournament on his own accord, and he's already made it all the way to the final match. He has so easily smashed all his opposition in the first round that he is the heavy favorite to win it all.

However, a few very powerful betting brokers are upset that %brawler% has already caused them to lose a ton of money. Knowing that he is with you, they have asked that you tell %brawler% to take a fall and throw the match. In return, you'll get a percentage of their winnings, which will no doubt be quite substantial...}
0bca0e96e7ae13f2f16d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{拳斗者%brawler%似乎招呼都没打，就擅自参加了一场格斗比赛，如今已经一路杀进决赛。此前每场，他都在首回合轻松击败对手，成了夺冠的头号热门。

可几名颇有势力的赌局庄家很不高兴，%brawler%已经让他们赔了一大笔钱。得知他是你的手下后，他们找上门，希望你让%brawler%故意倒下，输掉比赛。作为回报，你能分到他们赢利的一部分，数目想必相当可观……}

2a45d84c0699109c7afd.source: You need to take a fall.

e08e9b3efbb7c793521e.source: What? There won't be a fight at all!
e08e9b3efbb7c793521e.translation: 什么？这场架根本不许打！

6800dcf3984bade62f3d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{You order %brawler% to take a fall. As expected, he resists the idea, but you remind him that you are captain to the company, and while brawling is his business, the fact a third party entered into business with you makes the brawler's business your business. He sighs and nods.

When the fight occurs, %brawler%, as instructed, takes a few hits then 'sells' a knockout, spinning away from a weak jab. The crowd roars and the underdog cheers and runs around the fighting pit with his hands raised. After the fight, the betting brokers come and give you %reward% crowns for the fall. One looks over at %brawler%.%SPEECH_ON%Gods damned, man, you could have spurred a riot if anyone had been paying attention. You should look into theater training, cause that winning punch wouldn't have harelipped a whore. Next time wait for a cross or solid hook would ya?%SPEECH_OFF%The brawler laughs, but it is forced. He has humiliated himself for a few crowns. Somewhere in %townname% you can hear the townspeople cheering the other fighter's name.}
6800dcf3984bade62f3d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{你命令%brawler%故意输掉比赛。不出所料，他不肯答应，但你提醒他，你才是战团的团长。打拳虽是他的买卖，可既然有人来跟你谈了这笔生意，那他的买卖也就成了你的买卖。他叹了口气，点头同意。

比赛开始后，%brawler%照着吩咐挨了几拳，又在吃到一记软绵绵的刺拳后，转着圈倒下，装作被打昏。人群爆发出吼声，原本不被看好的对手欢呼着举起双手，绕着拳场跑了起来。赛后，开赌局的人过来，给了你%reward%克朗的报酬。其中一人看向%brawler%。%SPEECH_ON%诸神在上，老兄，要是有人认真看了，你非惹出一场乱子不可。你真该去学学演戏，那最后一拳连个婊子的嘴唇都打不破。下次等对面出记直拳，或是像样点的勾拳再倒，行不行？%SPEECH_OFF%拳手笑了，却笑得很勉强。他为了几个克朗，丢尽了自己的脸。%townname%的某个角落里，镇民还在高呼另一个拳手的名字。}

dd3fcd43f18ef8cedad5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{You order %brawler% to take a fall. As expected, he resists the idea, but you remind him that you are captain to the company, and while brawling is his business, the fact a third party entered into business with you makes the brawler's business your business. He sighs and nods.

When the fight occurs, %brawler% does as instructed and goes down to a single punch. He stares at you from the floor of the fighting pit, and you see a fire in his eyes. You tell him to stay down, but instead he gets up and promptly destroys the other fighter with a flurry of hooks and uppercuts. He wins the fight and is carried out of the arena by the crowd. You try and hurry after them and see where he went, only to find him in an alleyway beaten to a pulp. He grins up at you.%SPEECH_ON%Them bettin' brokers weren't happy, but fark them. They shoulda bet on my pride.%SPEECH_OFF%He falls unconscious.}
dd3fcd43f18ef8cedad5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{你命令%brawler%故意输掉拳赛。他果然不肯，你便提醒他，自己才是战团的团长。打拳虽是他的事，可既然第三方已经与你谈了买卖，他的事便也成了你的事。他叹口气，点头答应。

比赛开始，%brawler%照吩咐挨了一拳就倒下。他躺在拳场地上看着你，眼里却燃着火。你叫他别起来，他反而爬起身，一阵摆拳与上勾拳，转眼便将对手彻底击垮。他赢了拳赛，被人群抬出场外。你急忙追上，想找他去了哪里，最后却在一条巷子里发现他已被打得血肉模糊。他仰头冲你咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%开盘的庄家不高兴了，不过去他们的。他们该押的，是我的骨气。%SPEECH_OFF%说完，他昏了过去。}

2db1c9e0f7261a9f05da.source: I've had quite enough betting for now, myself.

ce56be7b81b466448899.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{You tell the gambling brokers that %brawler% will fight however he pleases. The brokers, not wanting to cross paths with a sellsword, do not argue the issue any further. They simply leave before you can even bet on your own man. Now knowing there is a fight, though, you go and watch as %brawler% completely smashes down %townname%'s best brawler. The beatdown was so obviously going to happen that everyone bet on %brawler% and there's a run on the gambling brokers. Fights break out and some betters and brokers start smashing each other. There's no money made out of the fight, but %brawler% is elated to be the champion of %townname%.}
ce56be7b81b466448899.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{你告诉开盘的庄家，%brawler%想怎么打就怎么打。他们不愿招惹佣兵，也就没再争辩，甚至不等你给自己人下注，便匆匆离开了。既然知道有拳赛，你便去看了个热闹。%brawler%把%townname%最厉害的拳手打得毫无还手之力。胜负早就显而易见，人人都押%brawler%赢，赛后纷纷挤着找庄家兑钱。冲突很快爆发，赌客与庄家们打成一团。这场拳赛没给你带来半点进账，不过%brawler%成了%townname%的拳王，倒是高兴坏了。}

9472271adccb48b80344.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{You tell the gambling brokers that %brawler% will fight however he pleases. Not wanting to get tangled up with a mercenary captain, they simply nod and back off. As expected, %brawler% wins the fight and it is not even close. He's the talk of %townname% and you let him go celebrate with the peasants. A few hours pass, though, and you realize you haven't seen him in awhile. You venture into town to find him in an alley with smashed knees, his lead hand has been hammered to a pulp, and his eyes are swollen shut. You shout out to him and run over. He picks his head up off the ground.%SPEECH_ON%Captain? Ayy captain, good to hear your voice. Don't worry about me. It was worth it.%SPEECH_OFF%He passes out. You carry him back to the company and consider hunting down the brokers, but you know that they wouldn't have done such a thing without first preparing to get the hells out of town afterward.}
9472271adccb48b80344.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{你告诉开盘的庄家，%brawler%想怎么打就怎么打。他们不想与佣兵团长纠缠，便点头退开。果然，%brawler%轻松赢了拳赛，成了%townname%人人议论的风云人物。你让他跟乡民去庆祝。可几个钟头过去，你才察觉，已经很久没见着他。进镇寻找，你在巷子里发现了他：双膝被砸坏，前手被锤得稀烂，眼睛肿得睁不开。你高声喊他，跑了过去。他从地上抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%团长？啊，团长，听见您的声音真好。别担心我，值了。%SPEECH_OFF%他昏了过去。你将他背回战团，想着要不要追杀那些庄家，可也明白，他们敢做这种事，必然早已备好事后逃出城镇的路。}

10db32ffcb62e90d09c8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{You tell the gambling brokers that %brawler% will fight however he pleases. The brokers, not wanting to cross paths with a sellsword, do not argue the issue any further. They simply leave before you can even bet on your own man. Now knowing there is a fight, though, you attend the fight. %brawler% starts the bout throwing hooks left and right with zero regard for his opponent's skill. Without a single jab to set it up, his opponent shells up and then screams and throws one desperate hook and %brawler%'s head twists on a swivel, and he falls to the ground unconscious. The crowd goes wild, at least those who didn't just lose a pile of crowns. One of the bettors walks over to you as he counts his money. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%Best go fetch yer boy.%SPEECH_OFF%}
10db32ffcb62e90d09c8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{你告诉开盘的庄家，%brawler%想怎么打就怎么打。他们不愿招惹佣兵，没再争辩，甚至不等你给自己人下注，便匆匆离开。既然知道有拳赛，你就去看了。%brawler%开场便左一记、右一记地猛甩摆拳，完全不把对手的本事放在眼里。对方先缩身抱架防守，忽然大吼一声，连刺拳试探都没有，孤注一掷地挥出一记摆拳。%brawler%的脑袋被打得猛然一扭，当场倒地昏死。观众沸腾起来，至少那些没刚输掉一大堆克朗的人是如此。一个赌客边数钱边走到你面前，咧嘴笑道。%SPEECH_ON%赶紧去把你那小伙子领回来吧。%SPEECH_OFF%}

c33c4d51f4ed31bad1e6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{You shock both parties with an announcement that %brawler% won't be fighting at all. The brokers wipe their brows and sigh. They've lost a great deal of money, but at least now there's some vague reason to stop the bleeding. As for %brawler%, he is wildly upset with your decision. You explain to him that the %companyname% needs all its fighters in the best shape for actual mercenary work. You can't risk his health in some bodunk championship brawl.}
c33c4d51f4ed31bad1e6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{你宣布%brawler%根本不会参赛，双方都吃了一惊。赌局掮客擦着额头叹气，他们已经赔了不少钱，至少如今总算有个勉强说得过去的理由来止损。至于%brawler%，他对你的决定愤怒不已。你向他解释，%companyname%需要所有战士保持最佳状态，去干真正的佣兵活；不能为一场穷乡僻壤的拳赛，拿他的身体冒险。}

163302cd37140a5fee23.source: There'll be plenty of other opportunities to fight, %brawler%.

98ac84443f4e629f38cd.source: Was told to throw a fight

d3b2f6c275a4ad3380b9.source: Was allowed to fight on his own terms
d3b2f6c275a4ad3380b9.translation: 获准按自己的意愿放手一搏

eeee187cbc0fbba0438a.source: Got badly beaten in a fighting tournament
eeee187cbc0fbba0438a.translation: 在格斗比赛中被打得很惨

6b5027620e999c98b2cc.source: Was denied participation in a fighting tournament

2200aab98b4dd857124b.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{One of the men rushes into your tent exclaiming that someone has been caught sneaking into the camp. You ask if it's a thief. The man shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%No, worse. He's an Oathbringer.%SPEECH_OFF%Sonuvabitch. You jump to your feet and rush out, finding this interloper already tied up and being battered by the Oathtakers. You break it up, coming to stand before him.%SPEECH_ON%Oathbringer, where is Anselm's jaw?%SPEECH_OFF%The man spits on your boot and tells you he'd never give that up, and that the Oathtakers can go to the hells where they belong, and that Anselm himself would walk them there if he could. This blaspheming of Young Anselm's name draws gasps from you and your men. %randombrother% leans over.%SPEECH_ON%Just give the word, captain, and we'll show this Oathbringer the error of his ways.%SPEECH_OFF%}
2200aab98b4dd857124b.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{一个弟兄冲进帐篷，喊道，抓住了一个偷偷潜入营地的人。你问是贼吗，他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%更糟，是个誓言使者。%SPEECH_OFF%该死。你腾地站起，冲出帐外，发现入侵者已被捆住，正遭立誓者们痛打。你喝止众人，站到他面前。%SPEECH_ON%誓言使者，安塞尔姆的颌骨在哪儿？%SPEECH_OFF%那人朝你靴子上啐了一口，说自己绝不会交代，立誓者就该滚回该去的地狱，要是安塞尔姆还做得到，他老人家定会亲自押你们过去。如此亵渎小安塞尔姆之名，令你和弟兄们都倒吸一口气。%randombrother%凑过来。%SPEECH_ON%团长，您只管开口，我们定会让这誓言使者知道，自己错在哪儿。%SPEECH_OFF%}

74f81bf446fc4ea736d4.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You draw your sword and plunge it into the man's heart.%SPEECH_ON%Anselm will not await you in the next life, heretic.%SPEECH_OFF%The man's body sags around the steel, his eyes briefly wide before settling into a half-lidded gaze at the ground. You draw out your sword and the %companyname% cheers.%SPEECH_ON%Death to all Oathbringers!%SPEECH_OFF%The Oathtakers draw out their swords and raise them to the skies as a ravenous mood sweeps over the company.}
74f81bf446fc4ea736d4.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你拔剑刺入那人的心脏。%SPEECH_ON%异端，安塞尔姆不会在来世等你。%SPEECH_OFF%他的身体压着剑锋垂下，双眼短暂圆睁，随后半闭着望向地面。你抽回剑，%companyname%爆发出欢呼。%SPEECH_ON%所有誓言使者都得死！%SPEECH_OFF%立誓者拔剑向天，狂热的杀意席卷战团。}

1891cb4c3a85c7b3edce.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Torture him until his tongue points us to Young Anselm's jaw. I don't care how you do it, just do it.%SPEECH_OFF%Turning away, the prisoner screams out that Anselm would not approve. He then just starts screaming indiscriminately and eventually shouting out things that don't make a whole lot of sense. You retire to your tent, bouncing your foot to the screams that now take a rhythmic sort of wailing. Eventually, %randombrother% reappears. He has with him some weapons and armor you know weren't in inventory.%SPEECH_ON%He led us to a location that had these hidden away, but Anselm's jawbone is still missing. I'm afraid the Oathbringers must have it in their own camp, but he wouldn't say where that was. We, uh, we had some difficulties communicating after we cut his tongue out.%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you ask where the prisoner is now. The man clears his throat.%SPEECH_ON%Oh he went all white and fell over. He's dead, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%We did right by Young Anselm, at least.}
1891cb4c3a85c7b3edce.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%给他用刑，直到他开口交代小安塞尔姆的颌骨在哪。我不管你们用什么办法，办成就行。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚转过身，俘虏便大叫，说安塞尔姆绝不会赞同此举。接着，他只剩下不成调的惨叫，最后喊出的话连意思都听不明白了。你回到帐篷，听着逐渐变得抑扬顿挫的哀嚎，脚尖也跟着打起拍子。过了一阵，%randombrother%回来了，带着一些你知道库存里原本没有的武器和盔甲。%SPEECH_ON%他领我们找到了一处藏匿这些装备的地方，不过安塞尔姆的颌骨仍然下落不明。恐怕是誓言使者把它留在了自己的营地里，可他不肯交代营地在哪。我们，呃，自从割了他的舌头，沟通就有点困难了。%SPEECH_OFF%你叹了口气，问俘虏现在在哪。他清了清嗓子。%SPEECH_ON%噢，他浑身发白，接着就倒下了。他死了，长官。%SPEECH_OFF%至少，我们对得起小安塞尔姆。}

5e79abfa594165a9f8dc.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{You tell the men to torture the man for information. If there's one thing every Oathbringer knows, it's where Young Anselm's jawbone is and that is something every Oathtaker wishes to find out. The man screams as he's dragged away, and you retire to your tent to drown out the annoyances of things like shrieking and crying which really put a crimp on your mood. A moment later, %torturer% enters the tent, blood on his shirt. He looks to speak, then collapses to the ground. Another Oathtaker comes in saying the prisoner escaped, shanking his torturer before fleeing. You tell the men to help %torturer% before he bleeds out.%SPEECH_ON%Those damned Oathbringers have no honor! We'll find and kill him dead, so sayeth Young Anselm, so sayeth us all!%SPEECH_OFF%You speak with a clenched jaw, and an air of theatrics. The truth is the bastard got away and those Oathbringers are hard to catch, the rats that they are. You just hope that %torturer% survives.}
5e79abfa594165a9f8dc.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{你命令弟兄们用刑逼问。如果说每个誓言使者都知道一件事，那就是小安塞尔姆的颌骨藏在哪里，而每个立誓者都想探明这个秘密。那人惨叫着被拖走，你则回到帐篷，躲开那些恼人的尖叫和哭喊，免得败了心情。不一会儿，%torturer%走进帐篷，衬衣上沾着血。他似乎想说什么，却一头栽倒在地。另一名立誓者跟进来说，俘虏逃了，逃跑前还捅伤了行刑的人。你叫弟兄们赶紧救治%torturer%，别让他流血流死。%SPEECH_ON%那些该死的誓言使者毫无荣誉可言！我们一定要找到他，取他狗命！小安塞尔姆如此宣告，我们也如此宣告！%SPEECH_OFF%你咬牙切齿地说着，语气不免有几分做戏。说到底，那混蛋已经逃了，而那些耗子般的誓言使者又向来难抓。你只盼%torturer%能活下来。}

c7c9236bad59b13820c6.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{This man has nothing of value. You tell the men to cut him loose. They protest, saying that an Oathbringer has but one choice, to submit to the Oathtakers and to the true Final Path, or to die. There is also room for one who returns Young Anselm's jawbone, but the codes on how to treat an Oathbringer who does that have not yet been worked out. But, as far as this man is concerned, he is of no real use and you're in no mood for bloodspilling. Just as you reiterate to cut him loose, %randombrother% cuts the man's throat, much to the cheering of the others.%SPEECH_ON%You said cut him, right captain? Right?%SPEECH_OFF%You realize the Oathtaker is covering for you, and to keep denying that the Oathbringer had to die might put you in a prickly situation. You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, of course, the little rat had to die, same as all the pathless Oathbringers! And die they all shall!%SPEECH_OFF%The men roar again though you have a feeling that a few will remember your ridiculous suggestion to let an Oathbringer walk.}
c7c9236bad59b13820c6.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{这人身上榨不出什么有用的东西。你叫弟兄们割开他的绑绳，放他走。他们提出抗议，说誓言使者只有一条路：臣服于立誓者，皈依真正的终极之道，否则就得死。当然，归还小安塞尔姆颌骨的人也能获得宽待，只是该如何处置这么做的誓言使者，规矩还没定下来。总之，眼前这人实在派不上用场，你也没心情见血。你刚重申要割开绑绳、放他一马，%randombrother%就割开了他的喉咙，其他人顿时欢呼起来。%SPEECH_ON%你说的是割了他，对吧，团长？对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你明白，这名立誓者是在给你找台阶下；要是继续坚持那誓言使者不该死，你恐怕就要陷入尴尬的境地。你点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%是，当然。这只耗子非死不可，就跟所有背离正道的誓言使者一样！他们统统都得死！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们再度欢呼，不过你觉得，总有几个人会记住你刚才那荒唐的提议：放一个誓言使者离开。}

2d735328a24d43d5fe28.source: I should be more careful what I say.

1bdb40360db246869c2e.source: Pleased you slew an Oathbringer heretic
1bdb40360db246869c2e.translation: 因你杀死一名誓言使者异端而欣喜

c321eade7f2d4b024ffc.source: Disliked that you slew a captive in cold blood
c321eade7f2d4b024ffc.translation: 不满你冷血地杀害俘虏

4d91b265b57fd79240a7.translation: 拷问了一名誓言使者异端

e56da1f9daa1ac7ce75d.source: Is horrified that you ordered a captive tortured
e56da1f9daa1ac7ce75d.translation: 因你下令折磨俘虏而惊恐

92570104f2f3463e1b66.translation: 让一名被俘的誓言使者逃走

23dcb917aead555cd276.source: You almost let a captive Oathbringer roam free
23dcb917aead555cd276.translation: 你差点放走一名被俘的誓言使者

3b0cfcc3f85a6e9a6a02.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%deserter% the deserter and %disowned% the disowned nobleman are staring at each other over a campfire. Being that the camp is a rather romanceless place, such a thing usually precedes one thing: a barn burner of a fight. But, instead, and rather whimsically, both men slowly start to smile. %deserter% points a finger.%SPEECH_ON%You were commanding %randomname%'s levy out west, right?%SPEECH_OFF%The disowned nobleman laughs and smacks his knee.%SPEECH_ON%Sonuvabitch. I knew you looked familiar! You little deserter, you, do you have any idea how long we looked for your damn arse? One whole week! We did catch the rest, but you, you got away.%SPEECH_OFF%The deserter laughs.%SPEECH_ON%And now look at us, fighting for the same mercenary company! What are the odds, right? What'd you do with the guys you did catch, by the way?%SPEECH_OFF%%disowned% shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, we hanged them, of course. In fact, it reminds me of an old trick that...well, let's just say, those were the days!%SPEECH_OFF%%deserter% stares into the fire for a moment. He looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Haha, yeah.%SPEECH_OFF%}
3b0cfcc3f85a6e9a6a02.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{逃兵%deserter%和被家族除名的贵族%disowned%隔着营火，彼此盯着看。营地里向来没什么风花雪月，这种情形通常只会引出一件事：一场闹翻天的恶斗。可偏偏出人意料，两个人竟慢慢笑了起来。%deserter%伸出一根手指。%SPEECH_ON%你以前在西边，指挥过%randomname%的征召兵，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%落魄贵族大笑着拍了拍膝盖。%SPEECH_ON%他娘的，我就知道你眼熟！你这小逃兵，知道我们找了你那该死的屁股多久吗？整整一个星期！其他人都抓回来了，就你，让你跑了。%SPEECH_OFF%逃兵笑了。%SPEECH_ON%再看看现在，咱俩竟在同一个佣兵团里卖命！这得多巧，对吧？说起来，你们后来怎么处置那些被抓回去的家伙？%SPEECH_OFF%%disowned%耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%噢，当然是吊死了。说到这个，我还想起个老法子……唉，反正都是从前的好日子了！%SPEECH_OFF%%deserter%盯着火看了一会儿，抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%哈哈，是啊。%SPEECH_OFF%}

bd3a4e9dc8f706e0998b.source: It's a small world, at least for outcasts.
bd3a4e9dc8f706e0998b.translation: 天下真小，至少对被抛弃的人来说如此。

8b251a694ffd83a66654.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{While in %townname%, you receive a letter from a messenger. He asks that you not read it, but as soon as he's around the corner you do just that, breaking apart a wax royal seal. You read that %disowned%, the disowned nobleman, is no longer exiled. Instead, his place is on the family throne as soon as his already gravely-ill father passes away.

You hold the letter in your hand, unsure of what to do with it. %disowned% has long been a member of the %companyname%. For some, there is a strange appeal to a man who was once in the royal rooms of the world, and now finds himself in the veritable lowlands of a mercenary company. But while a bloodline may dry, a lineage never truly dies...}
8b251a694ffd83a66654.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{在%townname%逗留时，一名信使给你送来一封信。他请你不要拆阅，可他刚转过街角，你便揭开了那枚王室火漆封印。信中说，被家族放逐的贵族%disowned%已经获准回归。等他那病入膏肓的父亲一去世，他便将继承家主之位。

你捏着信，不知道该如何处置。%disowned%在%companyname%已经待了很久。一个曾出入王侯殿堂的人，如今竟落到了佣兵堆里，有些弟兄对这样的经历怀着莫名的兴趣。可血脉纵有枯竭之时，门第却从不会真正消亡……}

a57f521c55fa24a2ec48.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]{Sighing with the realization of what might happen, you decide to go and show him the letter. He reads it for a length of time, then looks up.%SPEECH_ON%I know you've read this.%SPEECH_OFF%He holds the letter back toward you.%SPEECH_ON%And I know you could have just as easily burned this letter. But you didn't. That only goes to show me what I already know: the %companyname% is my family now. If you want me to stay, I'll stay, if you want me to go, I'll go.%SPEECH_OFF%}
a57f521c55fa24a2ec48.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]{想到可能的后果，你叹了口气，还是决定把信给他看。他读了很久，抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%我知道你已经看过了。%SPEECH_OFF%他把信递还给你。%SPEECH_ON%我也知道，你完全可以把它烧掉，可你没有。这只让我更加确信早已明白的事：如今，%companyname%就是我的家。你要我留，我就留；要我走，我就走。%SPEECH_OFF%}

ef7ff064b16125be6f91.source: I think you should stay with us.

1ef88b6e29a3e6cc08a9.source: You should go home to your family.

be5adc02fba4d050d9cb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]{You take the letter back, then put it toward a nearby candle. It burns quickly, ashes feathering way from your fingertips as the fire climbs up the paper. %disowned% nods.%SPEECH_ON%I'm glad you did it. If my homelands need me, I shall only return when my work with the %companyname% is over. But until then, you shall have my sword, my sweat, and my blood.%SPEECH_OFF%He grins.%SPEECH_ON%For the right price, of course. I am, as it is, still yet a sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%}
be5adc02fba4d050d9cb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]{你接回信，把它凑向旁边的蜡烛。纸张烧得很快，火舌向上爬，灰烬从指尖轻轻飘散。%disowned%点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%很高兴你这么做。故乡若需要我，也得等我在%companyname%的事做完。在那之前，我的剑、我的汗、我的血，都归你。%SPEECH_OFF%他咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%当然，价钱得合适。毕竟，我仍是个佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%}

e685f92ee215c68dbe8a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_74.png[/img]{You push the letter back toward him.%SPEECH_ON%I think a man removed from his family is more in need of that family when they call him back, and certainly they must be in dire need of him. Your time with the %companyname% is over.%SPEECH_OFF%At first, the disowned nobleman appears despondent, but he then begins to nod, agreeing with your assessment that his family must be in need of him and he should not leave them twisting in the wind. He says his goodbyes to you and the rest of the company, but before he leaves for good he has prepared you a letter.%SPEECH_ON%You will have my thanks, captain. Don't think I'd ever just leave without acknowledging how important you were to saving my life, because that's precisely what you did, whether you realize it or not.%SPEECH_OFF%}
e685f92ee215c68dbe8a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_74.png[/img]{你把信推回他面前。%SPEECH_ON%一个被家族赶出来的人，等家族召他回去时，想必更需要那份亲情。而家里愿意开口，也一定是迫切需要他。你在%companyname%的日子，就到这里吧。%SPEECH_OFF%起初，被放逐的贵族显得失魂落魄，随后却渐渐点头，同意你的判断：家族既然需要他，他就不该放着他们孤立无援。他向你和弟兄们道别，可在真正离开之前，又为你备好了一封信。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我会永远感激您。别以为我会就这么一走了之，却不承认您对我的救命之恩有多重。不管您自己是否意识到，您确实救了我的命。%SPEECH_OFF%}

9c3387bd494865d56931.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_98.png[/img]{There's no way you're showing that to %disowned%. You promptly burn the letter and all details of his acceptance back into his family lineage. Just then, he comes around the corner. He looks a little perplexed and asks if there's anything wrong. You shake your head and ask if he wants to help count inventory. %disowned% grins.%SPEECH_ON%Of course. The %companyname% can't do what it does without a good inventory, or without your command, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%Just as you turn to join him, you see the messenger from earlier pulling something over. You leave %disowned% to the task and head the man off, asking what it is now. He pulls a heavy chest over and then wipes his brow, stating that this was also intended for the disowned nobleman. You kick it open to find a litany of arms and armor, some of which have his family crest on them. You thank the messenger, send him on his way, and then hurriedly break the crests off and throw the emblems into the gutters lest the nobleman see them himself. Curious, he hollers over if anything is wrong. You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%No, nothing wrong. Just got a shipment of new gear, that's all.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9c3387bd494865d56931.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_98.png[/img]{你绝不打算把这封信交给%disowned%。你立刻将它烧掉，连同家族愿意重新接纳他的全部消息，一并化为灰烬。恰在此时，他从拐角走来，有些困惑地问，是不是出了什么事。你摇头，问他愿不愿意帮忙清点库存。%disowned%咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%当然。%companyname%要做好手头的事，少不了一份清楚的库存，也少不了你的指挥，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%你正要跟他过去，却见先前的信使又拖着什么东西来了。你留下%disowned%清点，迎上去拦住信使，问还有什么事。他把一口沉重的箱子拖过来，擦了擦额头，说这也是送给那位被家族除名的贵族的。你一脚踢开箱盖，里面满是武器和盔甲，其中一些还带着他的家族纹章。你谢过信使，打发他走，随即匆匆掰下纹章，扔进沟里，免得被贵族本人看见。他好奇地远远喊来，问出了什么问题。你摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%没事，一切正常。只是刚收到一批新装备罢了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

e9ea99f560d43e679e29.source: is now a Regent in Absentia

7609e376c6b0720699c2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%eunuch% the eunuch and %insecure% the, rather obviously so, insecure sellsword are sitting and having a chat. The eunuch shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Your timidity makes no sense to me, %insecure%. Look at me. I don't even have the only reason to live as a man. When the wind blows against my pants, all I feel is cloth against my inner thigh. Do you have any idea how awfully strange that feels? But do you see me complaining? No. When half the company goes to the local whorehouse and dogs a broad, do you see me sitting in a corner crying? Of course not!%SPEECH_OFF%%insecure% nods.%SPEECH_ON%You know what, you dickless bastard, you're right. If you can pound air and be happy about it, then I can not be so afraid and small.%SPEECH_OFF%The insecure sellsword gets up and leaves. %eunuch% purses his lips.%SPEECH_ON%Pound air? Did this dumb farker just tell me I pound air? Hey, hey! I'll pound yer mother!%SPEECH_OFF%}
7609e376c6b0720699c2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{阉人%eunuch%正和佣兵%insecure%坐着聊天，后者显然对自己毫无信心。阉人摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%%insecure%，我真不明白你有什么好畏畏缩缩的。看看我，我连当男人唯一的盼头都没了。风一吹裤子，我就只能感觉到布料贴着大腿内侧。你知道那感觉有多古怪、多难受吗？可你见我抱怨过吗？没有。战团一半人去当地窑子里找女人快活的时候，你见我缩在角落里哭过吗？当然没有！%SPEECH_OFF%%insecure%点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%你说得对，你这没屌的混蛋。既然你对着空气干都能自得其乐，我又何必总是胆小怕事、自轻自贱。%SPEECH_OFF%这个原本缺乏自信的佣兵站起身走了。%eunuch%抿起嘴唇。%SPEECH_ON%干空气？这蠢货刚才说我干空气？喂，喂！老子干你娘！%SPEECH_OFF%}

2b2d6dc598d8f4d2af79.source: Don't let his insecurity rub off on you, %eunuch%.

10bdc80cdc5fb62591c1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{You come across a man surrounded by a crowd of angry and drunk peasants. The surrounded man is wearing a black hat and has a crossbow at his side and a finger on the trigger. Nearby stands a pyre with a post in the middle, and tethers missing someone to shackle. The crowd shouts and hollers and through their spit and froth you piece together what had occurred: the town hired a witch hunter and, as one belligerent peasant explains, the hunter found the witch and decided she wasn't a witch at all and let her go. The peasant stumbles around almost crying.%SPEECH_ON%And that ain't right, it just ain't right. We built this pyre and everythin' to see the fires have her. It just ain't right, but we'll make it right. Because we sure as hells gonna burn something ain't that right!%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd roars. It appears this supposed witch hunter committed one of the worst crimes that is out there: boring the laity.}
10bdc80cdc5fb62591c1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你碰见一群愤怒的醉汉农民，正围着一个男人。被围住的人戴着黑帽子，腰侧端着弩，一根手指扣在扳机上。旁边堆着一座柴堆，中央立了根木桩，桩上的绳索还等着绑人。人群叫嚣不休，你从他们唾沫横飞的怒骂中拼出了事情的经过：镇上雇了一名猎巫人，而据一个气势汹汹的农民所说，猎巫人找到那名女巫后，竟认定她根本不是女巫，把她放了。那农民踉踉跄跄，几乎快哭出来。%SPEECH_ON%这不对啊，就是不对。咱们柴堆都搭好了，什么都备好了，就等看她被烧死。这事不对，可咱们得给它掰正了。今儿说什么也得烧点东西，你们说是不是！%SPEECH_OFF%人群轰然响应。看来，这位所谓的猎巫人犯下了世间最不可饶恕的罪过之一：让一群看热闹的俗人扫了兴。}

51955bfefbed2039b34e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{You step forward and explain the rules of an agreement, explaining that surely the village hired the man to kill a witch, and if the person they directed him toward was not a witch, then he cannot kill her. If he still went ahead and did so, then he'd be compelled to act on account of crowns. If he decided not to kill her, and the village rescinded its agreement, then he'd later be compelled to simply do the bidding of every village to prevent that situation from happening again. Through a series of gentle explanations you show that the village is in danger of displaying for all that it is untrustworthy, and that by the virtue of the example it sets it will only be set upon by charlatans and miscreants with aims on their gold and not on completing a task as asked. And, if anything, the hunter's refusal to burn an innocent shows the strength of his character.

When you're finished, the crowd mostly agrees, but then someone says 'burn him anyway!' and everyone roars back into a rage. Turning around, though, they find the witch hunter slipped out while you were giving your spiel. The peasants start blaming one another for not keeping an eye on him. Arguments quickly descend into fighting and you make your leave. When you hit the edge of town, you run across the man of the hour. He thanks you with a count of crowns. You find it very unusual that a man would part with money when he could have simply left. He tips his black hat and says he doesn't do this witch hunting business for the money.}
51955bfefbed2039b34e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{你走上前，解释契约的道理：村子雇这个人来杀女巫，可若他们指认的女人根本不是女巫，他便不能杀她。若明知如此仍然动手，那就是纯粹为钱杀人。可若他不肯杀，村子便撕毁约定，那么往后，为免重蹈覆辙，他就只能照每个村子的意思办事。你耐心说明，这样做等于向所有人宣告，村子不守信用。而这个先例一开，以后来的只会是盯着金子的骗子和恶徒，根本不在乎是否按要求完成任务。况且，猎巫人拒绝烧死无辜者，恰恰证明他的品格坚定。

等你说完，大部分人已表示认同，可忽然有人喊“反正烧了他再说！”，众人又怒吼起来。然而，转头一看，猎巫人早在你长篇大论时溜走了。农民们开始互相埋怨没把人看住，争吵很快变成斗殴，你便趁机离开。走到镇边，你遇见了刚才的主角。他拿出一笔克朗，感谢你解围。明明可以一走了之，却还愿意掏钱，这让你很意外。他扶了扶黑帽，说自己干猎巫这一行，本就不是为了钱。}

8be52c5dc11d88db4f65.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{You step forward shouting and waving your hands. The crowd slowly quiets down and turns around to pay you mind.
