Using a careful choice of words, you explain that there's a commerce to honest dealings, that if one pays crowns to hire someone, and then they turn their back on that someone because of a change of predicaments, then they're only setting themselves up to be an untrustworthy village that no one will want to deal with, and before you can finish your spiel someone hurls a rock just over your head and another man runs forward screaming and drives a pitchfork into the witch hunter's chest. Total chaos breaks out and you and the %companyname% fend off the rabid peasants and get out of there as fast as you can.}
8be52c5dc11d88db4f65.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{你一边挥手，一边大声喊着走上前。人群渐渐安静下来，转身看向你。你斟酌着措辞，向他们解释，做买卖总得讲个信用：既然花钱雇了人，便不能因为情况有变就翻脸不认账。否则，村子只会落个不守信的名声，今后谁还愿意跟他们打交道？可你这番道理还没讲完，一块石头便擦着头顶飞过，另一个男人大叫着冲上来，把草叉捅进了猎巫人的胸膛。场面顿时乱成一团。你与%companyname%的弟兄们抵挡着发狂的农民，赶紧逃离了这里。}

91678d40b5902022e0c8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{%witchhunter% comes forward. He says the man in the black hat is a known fraud in witch hunting circles.%SPEECH_ON%We've been looking for this man for some time as his lies sully the name of our profession. I've long been looking for a chance to get this scalp.%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can say another word, %witchhunter% walks through the crowd and emerges on the other end with one of the peasant's pitchforks in hand and promptly drives it through the faux hunter's leg. The man bends over screaming. The faux hunter wheels up with the crossbow, but %witchhunter% catches it by the barrel and rides it upward where the shot harmlessly launches into the sky. He yanks the crossbow away, yelling that it does not belong to him, and he announces to the crowd that the man is a charlatan. He throws him to the ground, telling the crowd to do whatever it is they wish. They descend on the liar, though the extent of torture is hard to see through the excited ranks of laity. %witchhunter% returns with the crossbow, turning it one way and another. It is the most incredible weapon you've seen in some time. The witch hunter explains.%SPEECH_ON%This belonged to a guildmaster in the region. We believe this fool murdered him, took his clothes, and has been walking around pretending the part ever since. If his screams disturb you, captain, just remember he has burned countless innocents and stolen countless crowns from the desperate and confused. Fark him.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare over the man and into the crowd. You can just make out the man being hoisted onto the pyre and the early smoke of fires getting their start.}
91678d40b5902022e0c8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img]{%witchhunter%走上前，说那黑帽男人在猎巫人的圈子里，是个出了名的骗子。%SPEECH_ON%我们找他有一阵了。他的谎话败坏了整行的名声。我早就想找机会，剥下这张头皮。%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及开口，%witchhunter%已穿过人群，出来时手里多了一把农民的草叉，随即刺穿假猎巫人的腿。那人弯腰惨叫，又猛然抬起弩，%witchhunter%却一把抓住弩身，顺势推高，弩箭毫无威胁地射向天空。他夺过弩，大喊这东西不属于对方，又向众人宣布，此人是个骗子。他把那人摔在地上，告诉人群，想怎么处置都行。村民们一拥而上，隔着激动的人群，很难看清究竟折磨到了什么地步。%witchhunter%拿着弩回来，翻来覆去地查看。这是你近来见过最出色的武器。猎巫人解释道。%SPEECH_ON%这是本地一位行会长的东西。我们相信，这蠢货杀了他，偷走衣服，从此四处招摇撞骗。团长，若他的惨叫让你不安，记住，他烧死过无数无辜者，从绝望又无知的人手里骗走过无数克朗。去他娘的。%SPEECH_OFF%你越过他，望向人群，隐约看见那人被抬上火刑架，初燃的火焰开始冒出烟。}

661f41744bf947f93122.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{While the goings on of a drunken lynch mob is the preferred form of peasant entertainment, you smell a bit of danger in the air and move the %companyname% to the edge of town. You just never know when these things get out of hand and the laymen start laying hands on everyone in sight.}
661f41744bf947f93122.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{醉醺醺的暴民闹私刑，本就是农民最爱看的热闹，可你嗅到一丝危险，便将%companyname%带到镇外。这种事什么时候会失控、百姓什么时候会见谁就打，谁也说不准。}

752be4af63a554020eef.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{You see %anatomist% and %gladiator% sitting together near the campfire. The anatomist and gladiator seem ill-suited for conversation, and in little time does the latter rise to his feet with great fury.%SPEECH_ON%Enhancements? You think I take enhancements? You foolish, stick-shaped, daisy-pulling, corpse-chasing fool! My muscles are made out of sweat and blood! No pain, no gain!%SPEECH_OFF%The gladiator kicks a pile of ash onto the anatomist and storms off. %anatomist% cleans himself off, then takes out a ream of notes. He remarks that the 'subject' is experiencing flashes of hot anger. You ask the man if he's secretly doing something to the gladiator. %anatomist% snaps his notebook closed.%SPEECH_ON%Captain! I would never!%SPEECH_OFF%}
752be4af63a554020eef.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{你看见%anatomist%和%gladiator%坐在篝火旁聊天。解剖学者与角斗士似乎实在聊不到一块儿，没一会儿，后者就怒气冲冲地站了起来。%SPEECH_ON%强化药？你以为我吃那玩意儿？你这根细竹竿，就知道拔花弄草、追着尸体跑的蠢货！老子的肌肉是靠血汗练出来的！不吃苦，哪来的本事！%SPEECH_OFF%角斗士踢起一堆灰，扬了解剖学者满身，随后拂袖而去。%anatomist%掸掉身上的灰，掏出厚厚一摞笔记，记下“实验对象”出现突发性暴怒。你问他，是不是偷偷对角斗士做了什么。%anatomist%啪地合上笔记本。%SPEECH_ON%团长！我绝不会干这种事！%SPEECH_OFF%}

e0002cead13b6a87aa8d.translation: %anatomist%，难得听你这么言简意赅地回嘴……

0c75396e61520ee62dd0.source: Was accused of taking artificial enhancements
0c75396e61520ee62dd0.translation: 被指责靠药物增强体魄

107c2ae7131517076c7c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%oathtaker% and %gladiator% are ruminating over the proper use of weaponry. The Oathtaker is inclined to believe that every swing of the sword is powered by an intent to do good. The gladiator retorts that keeping oneself alive is the greatest good, such that the start of a sword swing already has good intentions, therefore its finality must not be for oneself, but instead for the crowd that is watching. Raising an eyebrow, %oathtaker% says,%SPEECH_ON%You think battles are shows, gladiator?%SPEECH_OFF%%gladiator% grins as he leans in.%SPEECH_ON%Life itself is a show, Oathtaker, and I'm its greatest star.%SPEECH_OFF%You regret listening in on the conversation.}
107c2ae7131517076c7c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%oathtaker%和%gladiator%正在探讨，该如何正确使用武器。立誓者认为，每一次挥剑，都应出于行善的本心。角斗士却反驳说，保住自己的命就是最大的善事，既然剑刚挥出去便已有了善意，那么最后收招就不必再顾着自己，而该顾着看热闹的观众。%oathtaker%扬起眉毛，问道。%SPEECH_ON%角斗士，你把战斗当成表演？%SPEECH_OFF%%gladiator%凑近一些，咧嘴笑道。%SPEECH_ON%立誓者，人生本就是一场戏，而我是台上最耀眼的主角。%SPEECH_OFF%你开始后悔听了这段对话。}

c902c9631659be568d45.source: Assured of his importance in the world
c902c9631659be568d45.translation: 确信自己在这世上举足轻重

63bd70ece4b4d6a4d952.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{As you're clearing a path through the snowy wastes, a strange figure steps out onto the road. You can see strings of rope attached to their shoulders, and far above them fly black kites which twirl and whirl as though he'd seen to himself a puppet of his own construction. His face looks the sort of man to make such a thing, a twist of madness, sneering with some joke that he thought of years ago and never stopped laughing about. His dark complexion is not usual to the north, and when he speaks he knows your tongue.%SPEECH_ON%You've oddities on you, good smelling oddities at that. What is that, though, what is it? It is not meat. It is not tender human meat. It is not meat of the birds, nor of the pups that go under the ice. It, well, is it even meat at all? Oh my, that is incense! Look, lemme have a whiff of that sweet spice and I'll give you something in return for it. Just a little sniff, that's all, I'll even pay for it.%SPEECH_OFF%You put your hand on your sword.}
63bd70ece4b4d6a4d952.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{你们正穿过积雪的荒野，一个古怪的身影忽然踏上道路。几根绳子系在他肩上，一直通往高空中盘旋翻飞的黑色风筝，仿佛他把自己变成了亲手制作的提线木偶。看他的脸，就知道他干得出这种事：神情疯癫扭曲，嘴角挂着讥笑，像是多年前想到了一个笑话，至今还没笑够。他深色的皮肤在北方并不常见，开口时说的却是你的语言。%SPEECH_ON%你们身上带着稀奇东西，还是香喷喷的稀奇东西。那是什么，究竟是什么？不是肉。不是鲜嫩的人肉。不是鸟肉，也不是那些钻进冰底的小崽子的肉。这个，唔，到底是不是肉呢？哎呀，是熏香！这样，让我闻闻那甜美的香气，我拿东西跟你换。就闻一小口，仅此而已，我甚至愿意掏钱。%SPEECH_OFF%你把手按在剑柄上。}

931be6d0db51b370c15a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{You tell him that he may take a smell of that which he desires, so long as he pays you for it in the end. He agrees, and shuffles over to your wagon, his long kites following above like eternal buzzards winking in and out of the snowy blinds. He leans into the wagon and sniffs around, his cold, red nose honking with every breath. He gets to the incense jars and a smile crosses his face.%SPEECH_ON%Ah yes. I have not smelled such magnificence in many, many years.%SPEECH_OFF%He rides up his jacket and slams a large purse of coins onto the tailgate. You count them out, seeing far more than you'd ever get for selling this incense anywhere. He turns to you, the incense cradled in his arms.%SPEECH_ON%Fair deal?%SPEECH_OFF%}
931be6d0db51b370c15a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{你告诉他，想闻什么都可以，只要最后付钱就行。他答应了，拖着脚步走向货车。长长的风筝跟在他头顶，如同盘旋不去的兀鹫，在雪幕间时隐时现。他探身进车里四处嗅闻，冻红的鼻子每吸一口气都呼呼作响。找到熏香罐后，他脸上露出了笑容。%SPEECH_ON%啊，没错。许多、许多年没闻到这么美妙的气味了。%SPEECH_OFF%他撩起外套，将一大袋钱重重放在车尾板上。你数了数，无论去哪里卖，这些熏香都绝对卖不出这么多钱。他将熏香抱在怀中，转头看向你。%SPEECH_ON%这买卖还公道吧？%SPEECH_OFF%}

d45e0fdde7c18bb2823c.source: A man knows what he loves.
d45e0fdde7c18bb2823c.translation: 人总知道自己喜欢什么。

28bbff029f6607e10b53.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{You take your hand off your sword and agree with the wily albeit seemingly harmless request. You say he may have a whiff of your wagon if he pays upfront for it. The man nods, and gives out a few crowns. Before cycling around to the back of the cart. He puts his bulbous nose in, snorting around like a pig rooting up the ground.

Suddenly, he snatches up a few jars of incense and tears off the covers. All the dust and powder goes flying, the snowy wastes briefly vibrant, and the chortling man dances through it. You go to knock him out, but he throws the cables of kites at you, knotting you up in their wiry grasps, all the while himself making a daring escape, cackling as the incense drifts off his shoulders like some wayward transient passing a celestial meridian. Furious, and cutting yourself loose of the damned kites, you take inventory of the damage wrought.}
28bbff029f6607e10b53.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{你将手从剑柄上移开，答应了这看似狡黠却无害的请求。想闻货车里的东西，可以，先付钱。那人点头，掏出几枚克朗，绕到车后，探进硕大的鼻子，像猪拱地般到处嗅闻。

 突然，他抓起几罐熏香，扯掉封盖。香粉漫天飞扬，让雪原短暂地绚丽起来。那人咯咯笑着，在粉尘间起舞。你正要将他打昏，他却把风筝线一股脑扔向你，细韧的线缠住手脚，自己趁机大胆逃走。他一路狂笑，熏香粉末从肩头飘落，像个任性的游子穿行在天界的经线上。你怒不可遏，割断那些该死的风筝线脱身，清点起他造成的损失。}

7d2137472d1dc6cc40e0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{%bellydancer% the belly dancer steps forward, peers into the snow, and rather unexpectedly wonders aloud if that is his father. The crazed man comes forward, his black kites following after him like buzzards in the tailwind of the doomed, then his face lights up and the two embrace. The man is apparently %bellydancer%'s long lost father, an incense merchant who had headed far north only to be ambushed and enslaved by the savage barbarians there whom he has since escaped. He smiles madly.%SPEECH_ON%It had been so long since I had seen good incense I could smell your wagon from miles away. My wife, your mother, %bellydancer%, how is she?%SPEECH_OFF%The belly dancer's smile fades. He mentions that she held out hope for as long as she could. The kite-kitted man nods solemnly, but also expectedly. He says it wouldn't be right for her to be married to a specter of what once was, and that he himself, with no hope of making a return home, moved on as well. The man pulls out an ornate weapon with a blade unlike anything you've seen before. He says that it is a long held relic of the family, and that he kept it buried and safe all his years in the north.%SPEECH_ON%Best you take it and make use of it before one of the savages here eats me and uses it as a toothpick.%SPEECH_OFF%The man smiles fondly and the two embrace for a time. Curious, you ask him why the kites. He responds that they are tools of fear meant to ward off dangerous animals and the like, including the more superstitious of the barbarians. You bid the man goodbye and suggest to %bellydancer% that he can leave if he needs to as well, but he shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%The son and father mustn't share the gilded path, for we know that we shall be together at its end as we were at its beginning.%SPEECH_OFF%He says a few words to his father in his native tongue, and then the two depart and that is that.}
7d2137472d1dc6cc40e0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{肚皮舞者%bellydancer%上前，凝望雪中，忽然出人意料地问，那会不会是自己的父亲。疯疯癫癫的男人走来，黑色风筝跟在身后，像秃鹫追随着将死之人扬起的风。他的脸突然亮了起来，两人紧紧相拥。原来，此人正是%bellydancer%失散已久的父亲，一名熏香商人。他曾远赴北方，却遭当地野蛮的蛮族伏击，沦为奴隶，后来才逃了出来。他笑得有些癫狂。%SPEECH_ON%太久没闻过好熏香了，你们的货车还在几英里外，我就闻见了。我的妻子，你母亲，%bellydancer%，她怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%肚皮舞者的笑容消失了。他说，母亲已经尽可能长久地抱着希望等过。挂满风筝的男人沉重点头，却也并不意外。他说，不该让她嫁给一个早已逝去的幻影；自己也因无望返乡，另寻了生活。男人取出一件华丽武器，刃形是你从未见过的。他说，这是家族世代相传的遗物，在北方的这些年，一直被他埋藏保护。%SPEECH_ON%你拿着用吧，免得哪天这儿的野人把我吃了，再拿它剔牙。%SPEECH_OFF%他慈爱地微笑，父子俩又拥抱了一阵。你好奇地问，为何带着风筝。他回答，这是吓唬危险动物的工具，也能赶走一些更加迷信的蛮族人。你向他告别，又告诉%bellydancer%，若有需要，他也可以离队，可他摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%父与子不必同走镀金之路，因为我们知道，终点处仍会团聚，正如起点时那样。%SPEECH_OFF%他用母语与父亲说了几句话，随后两人各走各的路，就此别过。}

820bc764c55fa72dedf8.source: Damn this incense is some good stuff.
820bc764c55fa72dedf8.translation: 这熏香，真他妈是好东西。

a9845ea0f23ba1e4075b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{You tell the man to step aside or else. He does as told, though he stands there with both hands reaching, fingers prying emptily at whatever scent his nose had picked up. You take a few looks back, making sure he isn't following. He stands in the snowy wastes staring at your wagon. Then he is but a sliver of black. Then he is gone, and his kites dance above where you know him to be, and then they are gone.}
a9845ea0f23ba1e4075b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]{你叫那人让开，否则后果自负。他照做了，却仍伸着双手，手指在空中抓挠，想攫住鼻子捕捉到的香气。你几次回头，确认他没有跟来。他站在茫茫雪地中，望着你的货车，渐渐缩成一线黑影，随后消失。风筝仍在他所在之处上空舞动，最后，也不见了。}

f5ead8cf1f4818d97a85.translation: 怎么也躲不开这些怪家伙。

e6df1638f48659913ddd.source: %bellydancer% the belly dancer, do you know this man?

ec9415e0e584f7994512.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{Seemingly out of nowhere, which you imagine is just how he prefers to behave, %killer% casually mentions that there's a body buried out here. You know he's a killer on the run, but you do the honor of inquiring as to how he might know that. He flatly states:%SPEECH_ON%Because I killed them and hid the corpse out this way. You know, it was a good kill. I mean that, because this individual was pained by diseases.%SPEECH_OFF%The very word 'diseases' elicits a turn of heads from the anatomists, as though they were hawks who'd just seen a scampering mouse. Soon enough, and much to your chagrin, the medical troupe is digging up a corpse. There's much discussion over what blights the body might have carried. It is beyond you, but the group agrees that learning of it will make great advances in whatever it is they're studying. After their discussions are over, %killer% sidles up to you with a smirk. He says that he killed that person cause he enjoyed it, and it was nice seeing the body again.%SPEECH_ON%It's just a shame those eggheads manhandled it like they did. It deserved more care, more...time.%SPEECH_OFF%You ease away from the man and get this bizarre company of men back on the road.}
ec9415e0e584f7994512.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{%killer%忽然若无其事地提起，这附近埋着一具尸体。话来得毫无征兆，你猜他就喜欢这样。你知道他是个逃亡凶犯，不过还是姑且给他个解释的机会，问他怎么知道。他平淡地答道。%SPEECH_ON%因为是我杀了那人，把尸体藏在这里。你知道，那次杀人算是做了件好事。真的，那人当时疾病缠身，很是痛苦。%SPEECH_OFF%光是“疾病”二字，就让解剖学者们齐齐转过头来，像鹰瞥见了乱窜的老鼠。很快，这群医者便开始挖尸体，让你懊恼不已。他们热烈讨论，死者究竟可能患过什么恶疾。你听不懂，但他们一致认为，弄清此事会让各自正在研究的那些东西大有进展。等讨论结束，%killer%带着一抹坏笑凑到你身旁，说他杀那人，只是因为自己喜欢，而且能再见到这具尸体，真让人高兴。%SPEECH_ON%可惜那群书呆子这么粗手粗脚。它本该得到更多照料，更多……时间。%SPEECH_OFF%你不动声色地离他远了些，带着这支古怪的队伍重新上路。}

622511889636637fbfda.source: The lot I cast my dice with...
622511889636637fbfda.translation: 我怎么就跟这帮人绑在了一起……

9f56cc76634661a6ec14.translation: 回忆起往日的一场杀戮

f0ff115a32587837d716.source: Got to examine an interesting blighted cadaver
f0ff115a32587837d716.translation: 得以检查一具有趣的染病尸体

3ce99c2fb7b80dd70d0e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{You're enjoying a drink at one of %townname%'s cozy taverns. Naturally, this comfort doesn't last long as a man struts into the place with his armor clinking and clanking. You make the error of glancing at him and catching his eye. He immediately heads over. Sighing, you put your opposite hand onto your sword and await what this could possibly be. The man stomps to the end of your table and straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%Let me introduce myself, in case rumor and myth have not done it already. I am %dragonslayer%. My chosen life in this world is to hunt and slay dragons.%SPEECH_OFF%You take a drink and set it down, telling the man that dragons don't exist. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%That is because my father slew them all. In truth, I am a killer of lindwurms, and I hear you are the captain of the %companyname%, an outfit some renown, almost as much as renown as yours truly. What would you say to combining our skills and talents, hm? I'd be willing to join you for %price% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%}
3ce99c2fb7b80dd70d0e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{你正在%townname%一家舒适的酒馆里喝酒。不出所料，这份惬意没能持续多久：一个男人趾高气扬地走了进来，身上的盔甲叮当作响。你不该抬头看他那一眼，偏偏还和他对上了视线。他立刻朝你走来。你叹了口气，把空着的那只手按在剑上，等着看又有什么麻烦。男人大步走到桌子尽头，挺直了腰板。%SPEECH_ON%容我自报家门，以免传闻和传奇还没替我效劳。我叫%dragonslayer%。我此生的志业，便是猎杀巨龙。%SPEECH_OFF%你喝了一口酒，放下杯子，告诉他世上根本没有巨龙。他咧嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%那是因为它们早被我父亲杀光了。说实话，我猎杀的是林德蠕龙。我听说你是%companyname%的团长，你们也算小有名气，差不多快赶上鄙人了。你觉得，把咱们的本领凑到一块儿，怎么样？只要%price%克朗，我就愿意加入。%SPEECH_OFF%}

d7b6913f96a06091ce74.source: Very well, I'll pay your %price% crown fee.

1028f03d4f952012b6d0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{You and the Oathtakers are walking the streets of %townname% when a man in glinting, Oathtaker-worthy armor suddenly appears. He strides right for you, and despite the company half-drawing their weapons as a sort of warning, the man continues unfaltered and holds his hand out.%SPEECH_ON%Hail! I am %dragonslayer%, son of the most famous dragonslayer in all the land.%SPEECH_OFF%Your men sheathe their weapons and everyone glances around. You shake the man's hand and ask what it is he wants. He steps back, straightens up as though for presentation, and peacocks his doings: that he's slain monsters of all sizes, and women of all sizes, and that he has a particular fondness for slaying dragons, and another fondness for bigger lasses because they remind him of- you cut him off, telling him that dragons no longer exist. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%That is correct! Dragons no longer exist, because my father is the one who killed the last one. I shall be honest, I am a lindwurm slayer, and I am quite good at it. And I have sought out you Oathtakers because of the renown and fame you have achieved, and of course because I wish to be a part of it.%SPEECH_OFF%This supposedly famous lindwurm slayer offers to join the %companyname% free of charge.}
1028f03d4f952012b6d0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{你和立誓者们正走在%townname%的街上，一个身披闪亮盔甲的男人忽然出现。那身甲胄倒配得上立誓者。他径直朝你走来，弟兄们将武器拔出半截以示警告，他却毫不退缩，仍走到面前，伸出手。%SPEECH_ON%幸会！我是%dragonslayer%，天下最著名屠龙者的儿子。%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们收起武器，彼此看了看。你握住他的手，问他有何贵干。他退后一步，像准备登台亮相般挺直腰板，孔雀开屏似的吹嘘起来：他杀过各种体形的怪物，也征服过各种体形的女人；尤其喜欢屠龙，也格外喜欢丰腴的姑娘，因为她们让他想起——你打断他，指出世上已经没有巨龙了。他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%正是！巨龙已经绝迹，因为最后一头就是我父亲杀的。坦白说，我是猎杀林德蠕龙的，而且相当在行。你们立誓者声名远播，所以我才专程来找。当然，也是因为我想成为其中一员。%SPEECH_OFF%这位据说很有名气的林德蠕龙猎手，提出免费加入%companyname%。}

26b779646cc88cc14f0a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{You reach into your pockets and put the purse on the table. The man takes it up, picking through the change. He nods and cinches the pursestrings.%SPEECH_ON%Very well. You have my services, captain of the %companyname%, and by my father's good name you shall not regret it.%SPEECH_OFF%}
26b779646cc88cc14f0a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{你掏出钱袋放到桌上。那人拿起来拨弄一番，点点头，收紧袋口。%SPEECH_ON%很好。%companyname%的团长，我为你效力了。我以父亲的名誉起誓，你不会后悔。%SPEECH_OFF%}

9f2c95db701793258ea8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{The man will either prove himself to be worthy of his stated accomplishments, or he'll end up dead meat. If he's willing to join without any upfront cost to you, what does it hurt to see how he fares? You hold your hand out and the man shakes it. His armor clinks and clanks as his arm bounces up and down.%SPEECH_ON%Your Oathtakers will not be disappointed, that I can promise you.%SPEECH_OFF%}
9f2c95db701793258ea8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]{这人要么证明自己配得上宣称的功绩，要么成为一堆死肉。既然肯免费加入，看看他的成色又有何妨？你伸出手，他握住，上下摇动的手臂带得护甲叮当作响。%SPEECH_ON%我保证，你的立誓者不会失望。%SPEECH_OFF%}

6335f3821930ad0e099b.source: {%name% is a supposedly famous monster hunter with a particular talent for slaying lindwurms. He says he is the son of Dirk the Dragonslayer, the monster hunter who ostensibly slew the last living dragon.}
6335f3821930ad0e099b.translation: {%name%自称是颇负盛名的猎兽者，尤其擅长斩杀林德蠕龙。他说自己是“屠龙者”德克之子；据称，那位猎兽者杀死了世上最后一条活龙。}

4efbbd1e6f07712ac19c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{As you wander the streets of %townname%, a bevy of skinny guards suddenly emerge from an alley like a pack of rats and, like rats themselves, they are dangerously numerous. While you keep your head low, %anatomist% the anatomist can't help but offer a dimwitted stare and acquire their attention. The guards make eye contact and come over and as expected they start proffering their corruptions.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there, travelers. Word around town is that someone is killing kids. Now we've reason to believe it's your strange fella here that's doing this awful, awful business.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist tries to defend himself, but you know that reason and rationality are not exactly on the table here. You ask the guards how much they want. They say.%SPEECH_ON%How about %blackmail% crowns, and we let this awful, awful kid killin' business slide. Or we don't let it slide and beat the shite out of you both.%SPEECH_OFF%}
4efbbd1e6f07712ac19c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{你正在%townname%的街上闲逛，一群瘦骨嶙峋的卫兵突然像耗子一样从巷子里钻了出来。而且就和耗子一样，他们多得让人不敢小觑。你低着头想避开，解剖学者%anatomist%却忍不住傻愣愣地盯着他们看，惹来了注意。卫兵和他对上视线，便走了过来，果然张口就露出了敲诈的嘴脸。%SPEECH_ON%喂，外乡人。镇上有人说，最近有个家伙在杀小孩。我们有理由怀疑，就是你们这位怪朋友在干这种伤天害理的勾当。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者想为自己辩白，但你知道，眼下根本不是讲道理的时候。你问卫兵想要多少钱。他们说。%SPEECH_ON%%blackmail%克朗，怎么样？给了钱，这桩伤天害理的杀小孩案子，咱们就不追究了。要不，咱们就追究到底，把你们两个揍得屎都喷出来。%SPEECH_OFF%}

853428487b7c9a71196a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{You pay them the gold. They take it and walk off laughing. %anatomist% explains that he never killed any kid, nor would he ever if there wasn't scientific value to be had in it. You close your eyes and ask him if he would kill a kid if there was scientific value in it. The anatomist scoffs.%SPEECH_ON%I'd lay waste to them, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%}
853428487b7c9a71196a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{你付了钱，他们拿钱笑着离开。%anatomist%解释，自己从没杀过孩子，也绝不会杀，除非那有科学价值。你闭上眼，问他：若真有科学价值，他就会杀孩子吗？解剖学者嗤笑一声。%SPEECH_ON%大人，我会把他们杀个精光。%SPEECH_OFF%}

b6f663e053fdae4da5d9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{You tell them you'll have to count how much money you got. Looking down at your pockets you say.%SPEECH_ON%I think I got five.%SPEECH_OFF%The scrawniest of the guards steps forward saying 'five what?' And you answer with a fist to his face. Before the man even hits the ground the rest of the guards are upon you both, kicking and punching and stomping. They run your pockets but you don't have a crown on you. Eventually they let up and stand off to the side, a crowd of peasants slowly gathering around the commotion. One guard slaps the other, indicating it is time to go. The lead guard stares down at you.%SPEECH_ON%Shite man, you sure can take a punch. Hope that beatin' was worth it. C'mon, let's get out of here.%SPEECH_OFF%Slowly, you get to your feet and then help %anatomist% up. He wipes the blood from his face. You're wise to an arse whoopin, but you figure this might be a first for the anatomist. The blood keeps leaking out of his nose and he keeps wiping. You tell him to lean his head back and lead him back to the wagon. The anatomist talks with a squeaky voice.%SPEECH_ON%It keeps bleeding. I know that this is what it was designed to do, but to see it and feel it in person...fascinating. Very fascinating.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b6f663e053fdae4da5d9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{你告诉他们，得先数数自己带了多少钱。你低头看看口袋，说道。%SPEECH_ON%我想，我有五个。%SPEECH_OFF%最瘦的卫兵上前问“五个什么”，你则用一记迎面重拳回答。他还没倒地，其余卫兵就扑到你们两人身上，拳打脚踢，连踩带跺。他们翻遍你的口袋，却连一枚克朗也没找到。终于，他们停手退到一旁，周围农民听见动静，正慢慢围拢。一个卫兵拍了另一个一下，示意该走了。领头的低头看着你。%SPEECH_ON%他娘的，伙计，你可真抗揍。但愿你觉得这顿打挨得值。走吧，咱们撤。%SPEECH_OFF%你缓缓站起来，又扶起%anatomist%。他擦着脸上的血。挨揍这事你早不陌生，不过对解剖学者来说，或许还是头一回。鼻血不停往外流，他便不停地擦。你叫他把头仰起来，领他回货车。他用尖细的声音说道。%SPEECH_ON%还在流血。我知道，这本来就是身体会有的反应，可亲眼看见，亲身感受……真有意思。非常有意思。%SPEECH_OFF%}

639d4e31f3367aaf4c19.source: It gets old fast, trust me.

b77cbb406b7233e642bb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{%hedgeknight% the hedge knight suddenly rounds the corner. The guards take a step back. He's eating an apple with one hand while the other sets on the pommel of his weapon like an executioner's hand on his lever. He looks down at the guards, casting his eye upon one person at a time, judging each and finding them wanting. He takes another bite of the apple and turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Is there a problem here, captain?%SPEECH_OFF%One of the guards quickly steps forward, smiling anxiously.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, no problem. We were just, uh, doing our due diligence in a certain matter.%SPEECH_OFF%The hedge knight tosses an apple core over his shoulder and then takes a long stretch, pieces of his armor grinding and clanking against each other. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%And how's that coming along?%SPEECH_OFF%The guards announce that they just finished. The hedge knight grins and says that if a man's time is spent in error, he should be compensated. Swallowing nervously, one of the guards forks over a purse of coins. He apologizes to you for wasting your time. The group of scrawny guards then beat a spooked, backpedaling retreat until they are gone. %hedgeknight% sighs. He says he was waiting on you to give the word. You ask him the word to do what. He produces another apple and crushes it in the ferocious squeeze of his hand. He thumbs one of the chunks into his mouth.%SPEECH_ON%What do you think?%SPEECH_OFF%}
b77cbb406b7233e642bb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]{流浪骑士%hedgeknight%忽然从街角转了过来，卫兵们后退一步。他一只手啃着苹果，另一只手搭在武器柄首，像刽子手将手放在行刑机关上。他低头俯视卫兵，目光逐一掠过，挨个掂量，显然没一个令他看得上眼。他又咬一口苹果，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，这里有麻烦？%SPEECH_OFF%一个卫兵赶紧上前，挤出不安的笑。%SPEECH_ON%啊，没有麻烦。我们只是，呃，为某件事尽职查问一下。%SPEECH_OFF%流浪骑士将果核往肩后一抛，长长伸了个懒腰，身上甲片互相摩擦，铿锵作响。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%那么，查得怎么样了？%SPEECH_OFF%卫兵们宣布，刚刚查完。流浪骑士咧嘴笑着说，若平白耽误了一个人的时间，总该给点补偿。一名卫兵紧张地咽了口唾沫，交出钱袋，为浪费你的时间道歉。这群瘦削的卫兵随后惊慌地倒退着离开，直至没了踪影。%hedgeknight%叹口气，说自己一直在等你下令。你问，等着下令干什么？他又拿出一个苹果，猛地一攥，生生捏碎，再用拇指挑起一块果肉，送进嘴里。%SPEECH_ON%你说呢？%SPEECH_OFF%}

d2559442866cfdc15be8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{Before you can answer, a small bag flies between the parties and when it lands a pile of chicken bones spew out. Footsteps follow, and everyone turns to see who is making them. %cultist% the cultist comes forward and leans down and picks up one of the bones. He turns to the guards and says that no child here has gone missing, that their reports are lies. One of the scrawny guards cocks his head.%SPEECH_ON%And just who in the hells are you?%SPEECH_OFF%The cultist walks toward the guards, bones crunching under his boots. He leans into one's ear and begins to whisper. After the cultist is finished, the guard leans back.%SPEECH_ON%I am testing his patience?%SPEECH_OFF%The cultist nods and says.%SPEECH_ON%And to draw an end to that which is meant to be eternal will have such dire consequences for you that you will come to believe that to have lived at all was but a tremendous error, which it is, it all is.%SPEECH_OFF%The guards glance at one another. One offers crowns as though it were penitence. You gladly take the crowns and strangely enough they are warm to the touch. %cultist% turns around and nods, whispering something about the resolve of beings far beyond your understanding. You look down at the bones, but you don't remember the company getting any chickens, nor do you remember any chicken coops on your way in.%SPEECH_ON%Those look like-%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist is talking a little too loudly about what those look like and you cut him off then and there, beating a hasty retreat from the street before anymore can come of this strange commotion.}
d2559442866cfdc15be8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{你还没来得及回答，一只小袋子便飞到双方之间，落地时洒出一堆鸡骨头。随后传来脚步，所有人都转头望去。教徒%cultist%走上前，俯身捡起一根骨头，转向卫兵，说这里没有孩子失踪，他们收到的报告全是谎话。一名瘦弱卫兵歪了歪头。%SPEECH_ON%你他娘的又是谁？%SPEECH_OFF%教徒朝卫兵走去，靴底踩得骨头咔嚓作响。他凑到一人耳边，低语了一阵。听完，那卫兵向后缩了缩。%SPEECH_ON%我在考验他的耐心？%SPEECH_OFF%教徒点头，说道。%SPEECH_ON%若让本应永恒之物迎来终结，你将承受如此可怕的后果，以至于相信，自己曾经活过，就是一个天大的错误。确实如此，一切都是。%SPEECH_OFF%卫兵们面面相觑。一人献上克朗，仿佛是在赎罪。你高兴地收下，奇怪的是，钱币摸起来居然温热。%cultist%转身点头，低声念叨着什么，说某些远超你理解的存在，其意志如何如何。你低头看着骨头，却不记得战团买过鸡，也不记得进来路上见过鸡舍。%SPEECH_ON%这些看着像——%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者谈论起这些骨头究竟像什么，声音有些太响，你立刻打断，匆匆离开街道，免得这场古怪的骚动再闹出什么来。}

fd18823d9c0d5f9a2893.source: Let's just get out of here.

ff34698d9403dea82bcd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{You open your mouth to answer when suddenly a woman shrieks. Both parties look over to see a half-naked man twisting at the end of a rope, his neck shunted to an angle that is most incompatible with life. However, it wasn't the fall that killed him: his body has been mangled and mutilated, carved up with all manner of torturous devices. There's a figure atop a balcony looking down, a pair of wild eyes staring out the depths of a cowl and a smirk beneath them belying any notion of a guilty conscious. The guards shout and give chase. Laughing, the figure disappears from the balcony. You listen to the footrace between guards and murderer as it carries further into %townname%. Soon, all that you can hear is the occasional spatter of blood dripping off the corpse and the lapping of alley dogs who'd come to lick it up. %anatomist% stares at it closely. He opens his mouth, but %killer% the killer on the run suddenly appears.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there captain. Thought you might enjoy these.%SPEECH_OFF%He hands over some armor attachments, the metals covered in blood. It need not take a genius to know where this item came from, but it is still yet quite nice and worth keeping. You tell him to clean it off and take it to inventory. The man nods. He takes a long great breath and lets it all out on a wide grin.%SPEECH_ON%Don't you just love life in the big city?%SPEECH_OFF%}
ff34698d9403dea82bcd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]{你刚张嘴要回答，忽然听见女人尖叫。双方一齐望去，只见一个半裸的男人在绳索末端扭转，脖子折成了绝不可能活着的角度。不过，杀死他的并不是坠落：他的身体早已遭到肢解与摧残，满是各种刑具留下的伤痕。阳台上站着一道俯视下方的人影，兜帽深处露出狂乱的双眼，下面那抹讥笑，看不出半点愧疚。卫兵大喊着追过去，那人笑了一声，消失在阳台后。卫兵与凶手追逐的脚步声，渐渐深入%townname%。很快，你能听见的便只剩尸体偶尔滴血的轻响，以及巷中野狗舔食鲜血的声音。%anatomist%凑近细看，刚要开口，逃亡凶犯%killer%却突然出现。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，团长。我想，你会喜欢这些。%SPEECH_OFF%他递来一些护甲附件，金属上沾满鲜血。这些东西从哪儿来的，不用天才也猜得到，不过确实精良，值得留下。你叫他清洗干净，收进库存。他点头，深深吸了口气，再舒畅地吐出，脸上绽开大大的笑容。%SPEECH_ON%大城里的生活，难道不叫人喜欢吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

8a9595377c8538adae1a.source: Well at least someone is living it up.
8a9595377c8538adae1a.translation: 至少还有人过得挺快活。

afd7225930d380619299.source: Where is that hedge knight %hedgeknight% when you need him?
afd7225930d380619299.translation: 该用到流浪骑士的时候，%hedgeknight%跑哪儿去了？

603548714437ea867b9d.source: Do you have something to say, %cultist% the Cultist?

1115fc8ce2b4e249beb3.source: %killer% the killer is always dodging guards, what would he do?
1115fc8ce2b4e249beb3.translation: 杀人犯%killer%总在躲卫兵，他会怎么做？

09646204f2c947ed93df.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{Ever since %gladiator% the gladiator imbibed one of anatomists' curios, the pit fighter has not stopped flexing. Many are growing annoyed with the bronzed, glistening, overly muscled man demanding that the other sellswords take him on, one-versus-one, in naked wrestling matches. When he's not plying for bouts of grabass, he's doing exercises, screaming out between every set as if he were in a pitched battle. Hopefully this phase of his life ends soon.}
09646204f2c947ed93df.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{自从角斗士%gladiator%喝下解剖学者的一瓶古怪药剂，他就没停止过炫耀肌肉。这个皮肤古铜、油光发亮、肌肉多得过头的男人，总缠着其他佣兵跟他一对一裸体摔跤，已经惹恼了不少人。不忙着找人搂抱扭打时，他就在锻炼，每做完一组都要嚎上一嗓子，像在打一场恶战。只盼他这阵子劲头早点过去。}

e359a13ed31705f6bae4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{You come across a man in a sort of disparate state: on one hand, he is covered in ornate armor that seems befitting a man sitting on a horse ready to joust at a grand tournament. On the other hand, he is laid out on the ground, legs scissoring back and forth in a drunken stupor, his arms slung out as if they were around the shoulders of friends but instead only find the comfort of mud.%SPEECH_ON%I beseech ye, traveler, buy m'armors and m'weapons, and leave me the crowns suitably worthy of both, such that I may seek redemption another way, for them martial matters are no longer kin to my path in this world, and -hic- I'd sooner buy m'way to Young Anselm's graces than see to it with the swing of a sword, may the old gods smite me for admittin' it aloud but I'll admit it aloud!%SPEECH_OFF%It seems he is offering his weapons and armor for a price of, if you get his babblings right, 9,000 crowns.}
e359a13ed31705f6bae4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{你遇见一个模样极不协调的男人。一方面，他披着华美盔甲，像个该骑在马上、准备参加盛大比武的骑士；另一方面，他正醉醺醺地瘫在地上，双腿来回乱蹬，两臂摊开，仿佛要搂住朋友的肩，搂到的却只有烂泥。%SPEECH_ON%旅人，求您买下我的盔甲与武器，给我配得上它们的克朗，让我另寻救赎。舞刀弄枪，已经不是我在世上该走的路。我——嗝——宁肯花钱求得小安塞尔姆的恩宠，也不愿再靠挥剑去挣。把这话说出口，旧神尽可降罚，可我还是要说！%SPEECH_OFF%听这番醉话，他似乎想以9,000克朗，卖掉自己的武器和盔甲。}

56a357d3969be277a96b.source: We'll take the armor for 9,000 crowns.

2af598c46276b8dfa971.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{You crouch down with the purse of crowns in hand.%SPEECH_ON%Take it off.%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods and starts shucking off the armor, wriggling out of it, sniffing now and again. He holds it all out, and the armor with it. You have it taken and put into inventory, then give the monies as agreed. His fingers clutch and grip and touch the purse like a spider's legs rolling up its prey, his drunken eyes darting left to right. He gets up and hobbles away. You have a feeling that he will not find the redemption he thinks he will with that money. %randombrother% puts a hand on your shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Don't dwell on him, captain. There's certain people in this world that you just don't want to be the last person who forgets them, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%}
2af598c46276b8dfa971.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{你握着钱袋，在他面前蹲下。%SPEECH_ON%脱下来。%SPEECH_OFF%那人点点头，扭动着身子脱下盔甲，不时吸一吸鼻子。他把盔甲连同所有东西一并递来。你让人收进储备，随后按约定给了钱。他的手指在钱袋上又抓又摸，像蜘蛛的腿裹住猎物，醉眼则不停地左右乱瞟。他站起身，一瘸一拐地走了。你有种预感，这笔钱换不来他以为能得到的救赎。%randombrother%把手搭在你肩上。%SPEECH_ON%团长，别老惦记他。世上有些人，还是早点忘了的好，别非得当最后一个还记着他的。明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

30896b9b7a78a6c45654.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{Instead of giving a hand out, you give out your hand.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, Young Anselm knew full well that no oath could be respected forever. To falter is to live, and to live is to falter. Do you think being here in the mud is error? Do you think your failures are something mended by money?%SPEECH_OFF%The man looks up. He asks if you, too, know Young Anselm. He still hasn't taken your hand, so you take his and pull him to his feet.%SPEECH_ON%Oathtaker, who do you think sent me?%SPEECH_OFF%The man stumbles a second, staring at you in disbelief. Then he cracks a wide grin and gives you a firm hug, embracing you and the company together. Wherever an Oathtaker is in the world, he is not alone, that was Young Anselm's first message.}
30896b9b7a78a6c45654.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{你没有施舍钱财，而是向他伸出了手。%SPEECH_ON%先生，小安塞尔姆早就明白，没有哪道誓言能永远不被辜负。只要活着，就难免失足；会失足，才是活生生的人。你以为自己跌在泥里，就是犯了错？你以为自己的失败，靠钱便能弥补？%SPEECH_OFF%那人抬起头，问你是否也知道小安塞尔姆。他仍没有握住你的手，你便抓住他的手，将他拉了起来。%SPEECH_ON%立誓者，你以为是谁派我来的？%SPEECH_OFF%他踉跄了一下，难以置信地望着你。随后，他咧嘴大笑，紧紧抱住了你，也接纳了整个战团。无论身在何处，立誓者都不会孤身一人。这正是小安塞尔姆最初传下的教诲。}

de8622ac252e50eb391b.source: Young Anselm has other plans for you. Join us!
de8622ac252e50eb391b.translation: 小安塞尔姆另有安排。加入我们！

29d4530ed3281bcf1825.source: Like many men, %name% was found in squalor. Ale on his lips, grime in his ears, piss and shit at least somewhere on his person. But he was an Oathtaker at heart, and by the providence of Young Anselm it was certainly no ordinary circumstance which brought him back into the faith. Of course, he'll still yet pair beer with belief, but now and again one must allow a man his vices, particularly if said man shares an interest in slaying Oathbringers.
29d4530ed3281bcf1825.translation: 和许多人一样，你遇见%name%时，他正落魄潦倒：嘴角酒渍未干，耳中积着污垢，身上总有哪处沾着屎尿。不过，他骨子里仍是个立誓者；蒙小安塞尔姆指引，让他重归信仰的经历，绝非寻常巧合。当然，他往后仍要把啤酒与信仰一同咽下。可人总得容许他人偶有恶习，尤其当这人与自己一样，热衷于杀死誓言使者时。

14915fdccd57e2957d07.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{%oathtaker% the oathtaker joins you by the campfire. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Respectfully, captain, I can say that it is a big ask to require a man to be of genuine goodness. When I first knew ya, I didn't think you had the chops for such an undertaking. I thought this world's creeping darkness would wither you away, grind you down like sand to a stone. But here you are. Stalwart. Keeping to the Oaths, one after the other. Good on ya. I think Young Anselm would be proud.%SPEECH_OFF%You thank the Oathtaker for the kind words.}
14915fdccd57e2957d07.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{立誓者%oathtaker%在篝火旁坐到你身边，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%团长，恕我直言，要求一个人真正向善，可不是件容易的事。刚认识你时，我以为你担不起这份责任，以为世间渐浓的黑暗迟早会磨垮你，就像风沙磨石。可你仍在这里，坚守不移，践行一个又一个誓言。干得好。我想，小安塞尔姆会为你骄傲。%SPEECH_OFF%你感谢了立誓者的这番好意。}

ddfea0de4f317a7fe79c.source: Is happy about the company's moral compass
ddfea0de4f317a7fe79c.translation: 为战团恪守正道而欣喜

95e68faa2d25705cfab8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{A man in armor approaches the company. He seems most usual, until he opens his mouth.%SPEECH_ON%Hear ye, hear ye, I am a proud Oathtaker! Now, I see you also have what appears to be a high regard for doing what is right. That makes me believe you, too, are Oathtakers. So! I have but one question for you: that skull hanging from a necklace, what is his name? If it is the one I seek, then ye shall have my hand.%SPEECH_OFF% | Men in armor are not a rare sight on the roads these days, but this man has a certain level of pomp and theatrics that draws the eye, as does the fact he confidently strides right over to you.%SPEECH_ON%I'd been carousing at a local pub when I got word that a band of Oathtakers had been passing through these lands. Now, either that is some graveyard skullduggery hanging from yer neck, or that is...well, you tell me. Give me the right name of that skull and I'll join you right here and now.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come across a man in armor. He stands in the road like he either wants to commit suicide by sellsword, or he's looking to risk his neck for a coin. As you draw near, he waves you down.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, the men I am looking for. Are you with the Oathtakers? I wish to join you on the path. The path of...%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses, gesturing toward the company's resident skull. Oh, he means... | A man in armor hurries out onto the road. You put a hand to your sword, but he simply bows as though you were an executioner.%SPEECH_ON%I prayed to the old gods to harden my virtues and keep me on the path. Surely, stranger, surely that is his skull there hanging from your neck? If it is, I shall join you and the oaths you're on this very minute. Please, tell me, is that the jawless skull of our dear...our...%SPEECH_OFF%}
95e68faa2d25705cfab8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{一个披甲男人走近战团。看着再寻常不过，直到他开口。%SPEECH_ON%听着，听着！我是一名自豪的立誓者！我看诸位似乎也十分推崇正义之举，所以我想，你们同样是立誓者。那么！我只问一句：项链上挂着的那颗头骨，他叫什么名字？若是我寻找的那位，我便愿为你们效力。%SPEECH_OFF% | 这些年，路上披甲之人并不少见，可眼前这位格外浮夸，颇有戏台上的做派，令人侧目；何况他还满怀自信，径直朝你走来。%SPEECH_ON%我在本地酒馆喝酒时，听说有一群立誓者经过此地。你脖子上挂着的，要么是从坟地里顺来的玩意儿，要么就是……嗯，你来说。说对那头骨的名字，我当场就加入。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你遇见一个披甲男人。他站在路中央，像是想借佣兵之手寻死，又或是打算为钱卖命。你走近时，他挥手叫住你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，正是我要找的人。你们是立誓者吗？我想与你们同行，踏上那条道路。那条……%SPEECH_OFF%他停下来，指向战团随身带着的头骨。噢，他是说…… | 一个披甲男人匆匆跑上道路。你把手搭上剑柄，他却只是鞠躬，低得仿佛你是个刽子手。%SPEECH_ON%我向旧神祈祷，愿祂们坚定我的美德，让我不偏离正道。陌生人，你脖子上挂着的，一定就是他的头骨吧？如果是，我现在就加入你们，一同践行誓言。请告诉我，那颗没有下颌的头骨，是否属于我们亲爱的……我们的……%SPEECH_OFF%}

ca1b3223e88bbf6ff2e6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{The man drops to a knee, his head down.%SPEECH_ON%Truly, Young Anselm has guided me here! I shall join you on the path, fellow Oathtakers!%SPEECH_OFF%}
ca1b3223e88bbf6ff2e6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{那人单膝跪地，垂下头。%SPEECH_ON%果然，是小安塞尔姆指引我来到此地！诸位立誓者，我愿与你们同行！%SPEECH_OFF%}

5f1a753d44ec0e0d57e8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{The man sighs.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, I see now. There are far too many Hugos in this world, it does not surprise me that yet another has appeared in such a state as that dreary skull, though I know not why you carry it around like so.%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%Hugo.%SPEECH_OFF%The man says.%SPEECH_ON%Another farkin' Hugo, huh? How many are out here? Every other man I run into is a Hugo.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns and walks off, mumbling angrily about the commoners and their unoriginal naming schemes. | The man sighs.%SPEECH_ON%Hugo, huh? Alright. Whelp, see you later.%SPEECH_OFF%}
5f1a753d44ec0e0d57e8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{那人叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%啊，现在明白了。世上叫雨果的人实在太多，又有一个落得那颗凄惨头骨的下场，我倒也不意外。不过，我不明白你们为什么要这样带着它到处走。%SPEECH_OFF% | %SPEECH_ON%雨果。%SPEECH_OFF%那人说道。%SPEECH_ON%又他妈是个雨果？外头到底有多少雨果？我碰见两个人，准有一个叫雨果。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身离开，愤愤嘟囔着，抱怨平民起名字实在毫无新意。 | 那人叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%雨果，是吧？好吧。那么，回头见。%SPEECH_OFF%}

2a135f479f7762ea032e.source: %townImage%{A boy suddenly runs up to the company. He practically gloms onto %oathtaker%'s leg and the Oathtaker's countenance takes on an appearance of confusion. He asks the runt if he is lost. The boy springs back.%SPEECH_ON%Lost? No, I'm not lost! I thought I'd never see your sort again, the vaunted Oathbringers!%SPEECH_OFF%%oathtaker%'s eye twitches, his hands tightens around the handle of his weapon. You're not sure when his screaming started and when the boy ended up on the ground with a blackened eye, but the righteous rage cracked from the Oathtaker like a bolt of holy fury, and you watch as he pushes the boy into the mud screaming and frothing that he is an Oathtaker, not some horrible, ugly, and inglorious Oathbringer, and he smooshes the boy's face into the grass and drags him into a pile of horse dung and sleds him across the road on the rolls of ordure until the boy cries out and runs for his life. Finished, %oathtaker% straightens up, affixing his attire, regirding his disheveled weaponry.%SPEECH_ON%Let us leave this hellhole of filthy degenerates, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%As he struts off, you turn around to see the townspeople staring at you in horror.}
2a135f479f7762ea032e.translation: %townImage%{一个男孩突然跑到战团跟前，几乎抱住了%oathtaker%的腿。这名立誓者满脸困惑，问小家伙是不是迷路了。男孩往后一跳。%SPEECH_ON%迷路？没有，我没迷路！我还以为再也见不到你们这样的人了，大名鼎鼎的誓言使者！%SPEECH_OFF%%oathtaker%的眼角抽了一下，握着武器柄的手骤然收紧。你都没弄清，他是何时开始咆哮，男孩又是何时眼眶乌青地倒在地上。正义之怒仿佛一道神圣的雷霆，从立誓者身上炸开。他把男孩按进泥里，唾沫横飞地吼叫，说自己是立誓者，绝非什么可憎、丑陋、毫无荣誉的誓言使者；他又把男孩的脸按进草里，拖入一堆马粪，借着滚动的污物，像拖雪橇般把他拖过道路。最后，男孩哭喊着挣脱，逃命去了。事毕，%oathtaker%直起身，整理衣裳，重新系好弄乱的武器。%SPEECH_ON%团长，离开这个满是肮脏败类的鬼地方吧。%SPEECH_OFF%他昂首阔步地走开，你回头，看见镇民们正惊恐地盯着你。}

1c0ea9b54b2a59911868.source: It's pretty much what it looks like.
1c0ea9b54b2a59911868.translation: 事情差不多就是你看到的这样。

b69e9c1d3e3f5c0d79d2.source: One of your men beat up a kid
b69e9c1d3e3f5c0d79d2.translation: 你的一名部下殴打了孩子

486f426a67d39045e07a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{The last of Young Anselm's Oaths have been completed. The Oathtakers have truly earned their name! Just one question remains: what now? You were never certain of what would happen once the First Oathtaker's oaths had been completed, and now that you have completed them, something is dawning on you and the rest of the company: to keep going. Why turn back now? Who wants to go back to the old, unguided life? Moribund and listless, floating through life without purpose? Surely that is not what Young Anselm intended by starting on the Final Path. You tell the men that every Oath has its meaning, and perhaps it is all the Oaths together which form a meaning of their own. The path of the Oathtaker ends when the Oathtaker wishes it to be so. You look out at the group of men.%SPEECH_ON%If you believe yourself free of the need for the Oaths, then please, leave.%SPEECH_OFF%A wave of pensive stares at the ground washes over the group. Eventually one looks up.%SPEECH_ON%There is only one way to leave Young Anselm's guidance, and that is to join him!%SPEECH_OFF%The group cheers. To Young Anselm, and to finding his jawbone, and to killing all Oathbringers!}
486f426a67d39045e07a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{小安塞尔姆留下的最后一项誓约也已完成。立誓者终于无愧于自己的名号！如今只剩一个问题：接下来呢？你从未想清楚，完成初代立誓者的全部誓约后会发生什么。现在，既然真的做到了，你和战团其他人都渐渐明白了一件事：继续走下去。为何偏偏此时回头？谁还愿意回到从前那种无人指引的生活，死气沉沉、无精打采，漫无目的地虚度一生？小安塞尔姆踏上终极之道，显然不是为了这个。你告诉弟兄们，每项誓约都有自己的意义，而把所有誓约合在一起，也许又会生出另一层意义。立誓者的道路，只会在他自己决定停下时结束。你望着眼前这些男人。%SPEECH_ON%如果有人觉得自己已不再需要誓约，那就请离开吧。%SPEECH_OFF%众人纷纷低头凝思。终于，有人抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%摆脱小安塞尔姆的指引，只有一种办法，那就是去与他相聚！%SPEECH_OFF%众人欢呼起来。为了小安塞尔姆，为了找回他的颌骨，为了杀尽所有誓言使者！}

d149fed1d7f9c485b866.source: Completed all of Young Anselm's oaths
d149fed1d7f9c485b866.translation: 完成了小安塞尔姆留下的全部誓言

fcad415daed0880b571e.source: Speak about those pieces of shite.

1e97e7dede620fc92382.source: We've said everything there is to say.

7e6879a8dd8fa77d0647.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{%townname%'s people are happy to see the %companyname%. It is an unusual reception for a band of mercenaries, but it seems the Oathtaking aspects of your business are held in high esteem with the laity.%SPEECH_ON%It's about time someone brought honor and pride back to these lands.%SPEECH_OFF%One peasant says. Women adorn you with flowers and other good graces. As you bring the wagon to a stop, a throng of children come up wanting to touch Young Anselm's skull.%SPEECH_ON%Will it give us strength? Or will it make me sick?%SPEECH_OFF%Another kid comes up and elbows him out of the way.%SPEECH_ON%Just have 'im tell us what they do and are already! Oaths, this here skull, and the other day we heard about Oathbringers, so what makes ye so different?%SPEECH_OFF%}
7e6879a8dd8fa77d0647.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{%townname%的居民很高兴见到%companyname%。一群佣兵能受到这样的欢迎，实在少见，不过战团践行誓言的名声，似乎很受普通百姓敬重。%SPEECH_ON%总算有人把荣誉与尊严带回这片土地了。%SPEECH_OFF%一个农民说道。女人们为你献上鲜花与种种好意。货车刚停下，一群孩子便围过来，想摸摸小安塞尔姆的头骨。%SPEECH_ON%摸了会有力气吗？还是会生病？%SPEECH_OFF%另一个孩子挤上来，一肘把他顶开。%SPEECH_ON%先让他讲讲他们到底是什么人、干什么的吧！又是誓言，又是这颗头骨，前两天还听说有什么誓言使者。你们到底哪里不一样？%SPEECH_OFF%}

3e422f061f02cdbd7b0b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{Hand to Anselm's head, you explain the Oaths.%SPEECH_ON%Every day that we rise and offer ourselves unto this world, we take an oath. An oath to ourselves, to our loved ones, to our neighbors, even to the earth, and to the animals which adorn it. We take an oath to the world entire.%SPEECH_OFF%A kid bites down on an apple. He says.%SPEECH_ON%If ever'one is takin' oaths, what makes you the Oathtakers? Aren't we all Oathtakers then?%SPEECH_OFF%You grin and nod.%SPEECH_ON%Precisely. We are all Oathtakers indeed. However, if I may let you in on a little secret...%SPEECH_OFF%The kids gather around, hushing one another. You explain.%SPEECH_ON%When you were born, you did not know all, yes? Same as our oaths. The old gods wish us to explore this world in full, not have all its mysteries merely handed to us. If they were handed to us, would we be where we are today? Or would our contentedness leave us in our first dwellings? We, Oathtakers, are exploring the extent to which the old gods have strengthened us, and also weakened us, and in seeking all our limits we shall become closer with the old gods, and closer with all others.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the kids kicks dirt. He asks if you have any sweet pies in that there wagon.}
3e422f061f02cdbd7b0b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你把手放在安塞尔姆的头骨上，解释起誓约。%SPEECH_ON%每天醒来，投身这个世界时，我们都在立誓。对自己，对所爱之人，对邻人，甚至对大地，以及点缀大地的生灵。我们向整个世界立誓。%SPEECH_OFF%一个孩子咬了口苹果，说道。%SPEECH_ON%要是人人都立誓，那你们凭什么叫立誓者？这样一来，我们不全都是立誓者了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你笑着点头。%SPEECH_ON%正是。我们的确全都是立誓者。不过，让我告诉你们一个小秘密……%SPEECH_OFF%孩子们围拢过来，互相示意安静。你解释道。%SPEECH_ON%你们刚出生时，并不是什么都懂，对吧？我们的誓约也是如此。旧神希望我们亲自探遍这个世界，而非把所有奥秘直接交到手里。若一切唾手可得，我们还会走到今天吗？还是会安于现状，永远困在最初的居所？我们立誓者要探明，旧神究竟赋予了我们多少力量，又留下了多少弱点。找出自己全部的极限，我们便能更接近旧神，也更接近世间所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%一个孩子踢了踢土，问你那边的货车上有没有甜馅饼。}

cca146bfe21156486d48.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You tap Young Anselm's skull.%SPEECH_ON%Young Anselm was the First Oathtaker, the beginning of the Oathtakers. He was the first to realize that the true nature of man required sacrifice. He believed, and rightly so, that when man first wandered the earth, he did so in a state of suffering, and it was in that being that he made his greatest advances. What we have now is so very far away from how things were. Things are simply too good now.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the kids scratches off a black scab and flicks it onto the face of another. The other kid wipes it away and pops a pustule and rubs the pus all over the other kid. While they quarrel, you continue on.%SPEECH_ON%Young Anselm realized this world needed to return to a life of sacrifice, to give up elements of what you enjoy, to sharpen oneself against the grindstone of suffering. Naturally, this made Young Anselm many enemies.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the kids looks up and asks how it was that Young Anselm died. You smile and say that is a story for another time.}
cca146bfe21156486d48.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你轻轻敲了敲小安塞尔姆的头骨。%SPEECH_ON%小安塞尔姆是初代立誓者，也是立誓者的起源。他第一个悟出，要找回人的本性，就必须有所舍弃。他相信——而且确实如此——人类最初行走在大地上时，饱受苦难，正是在那样的境遇中，才有了最伟大的进步。可如今的日子，早就离当初太远了。现在，人们实在过得太好了。%SPEECH_OFF%一个孩子抠下一块黑痂，弹到另一个孩子脸上。后者把痂擦掉，挤破一颗脓疮，又把脓液抹了对方一身。他们吵闹着，你继续讲下去。%SPEECH_ON%小安塞尔姆意识到，世人需要重新过上有所牺牲的日子，舍弃一部分享乐，用苦难这块磨刀石来砥砺自己。当然，这也为小安塞尔姆招来了许多敌人。%SPEECH_OFF%一个孩子抬起头，问小安塞尔姆是怎么死的。你微笑着说，那是另一个故事，留待以后再讲。}

a51035278a249a1f6b18.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{One of the kids pipes up.%SPEECH_ON%We had a group of men like you in town the other day. Said they were the 'Oathbringers.' Are they like yer brothers or somethin'?%SPEECH_OFF%You start to answer when %oathtaker% butts in.%SPEECH_ON%The Oathbringers are blasphemers! They are heathens, and not keepers of oaths, but breakers of them! They have stolen Young Anselm's jawbone, and we vow slay every Oathbringer to have it returned.%SPEECH_OFF%The boy says that the Oathbringers said they were wanting to get the skull from you, because you, the Oathtakers, were the true heathens. %oathtaker%'s anger reaches a boiling point.%SPEECH_ON%The Oathbringers say a lot of shite! They are peddlers of lies, nonsense and hysteria for a storefront, and cruel misapprehensions their goods!%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at the Oathtaker for a while, then put a hand on his shoulder and tell him maybe he should go count inventory to cool down for a bit.}
a51035278a249a1f6b18.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{一个孩子开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%前几天，镇上也来了一群跟你们差不多的人，说他们叫“誓言使者”。他们是你们的弟兄还是什么人吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你正想回答，%oathtaker%却抢先插了话。%SPEECH_ON%誓言使者是一群亵渎者！他们是异端！他们不守誓言，只会背弃誓言！他们偷走了小安塞尔姆的颌骨，我们发誓要杀尽所有誓言使者，将它夺回！%SPEECH_OFF%男孩说，誓言使者声称要从你们手里拿走头骨，因为你们这些立誓者才是真正的异端。%oathtaker%气得几乎炸开。%SPEECH_ON%誓言使者满嘴喷粪！他们就是一群贩卖谎言的奸商，拿胡言乱语和疯话当门面，兜售恶毒的歪曲与误解！%SPEECH_OFF%你盯着这名立誓者看了一会儿，把手搭在他肩上，叫他去清点一下库存，先消消火。}

0635de85ba1b4ecaf659.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{%oathtaker% bursts into the tent with trembling hands holding Young Anselm's skull.%SPEECH_ON%It's broken!%SPEECH_OFF%You jump out of your seat and take a look at Young Anselm's holy remains. There's a sliver of a crack going down the back of the skull. At first it doesn't look too bad, but when you stick a pinky finger in and lift, the bone splits apart. You both gasp and set the skull on the table. There's no doubt the skull could be broken apart with only a little bit more effort.%SPEECH_ON%What should we do? How do we fix it?%SPEECH_OFF%You ponder the question very carefully. The last time this happened Young Anselm's jawbone broke off, and so too did break the Oathtakers - with one group remaining as the Oathtakers, and the other forming the savage blasphemers, the Oathbringers. You're not going to let that happen again.}
0635de85ba1b4ecaf659.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{%oathtaker%冲进帐篷，双手颤抖着捧住小安塞尔姆的头骨。%SPEECH_ON%裂了！%SPEECH_OFF%你从座位上跳起来，查看小安塞尔姆的圣骸。头骨后方有一道细裂纹，乍看并不严重，可你将小指伸进去轻轻一抬，骨头竟裂开了。你俩同时倒吸一口气，把头骨放在桌上。毫无疑问，再稍稍用力，它就会彻底碎开。%SPEECH_ON%怎么办？怎么修好它？%SPEECH_OFF%你极其慎重地思索这个问题。上一次出了这样的事，小安塞尔姆的颌骨断落，立誓者也随之分裂：一派仍是立誓者，另一派则成了那群野蛮的亵渎者——誓言使者。你绝不会容许旧事重演。}

9232b415b3160a112da6.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{You take out a piece of string and coat it in ivy and sap. Then you gently lift Young Anselm's crack and run your finger down it with more sap. %oathtaker% stares nervously. Satisfied, you then insert the string along the crack and set the skull's parts back down, chomping down on the string and the sticky ivy with it.  You stand back, looking at your work. %oathtaker% swallows.%SPEECH_ON%I...I don't think anyone will notice.%SPEECH_OFF%You actually worry that it may be preferable that they find the crack in the skull absent of one's attempt to fix it, than to see the handiwork of some skulking skull restorer who tried to sneak one by. Either way, it's done, and Young Anselm's honor has been restored. %oathtaker% wipes the sweat from his brow.%SPEECH_ON%I believe this to have been a test, captain, and that Young Anselm has seen us through. His strength flows through me, and no words are capable of describing the honor I feel right now.%SPEECH_OFF%What? Young Anselm probably had no idea about sticky saps and ivies, and he presumably knew even less now that he's an unspeaking skull. But...you leave %oathtaker% to his interpretations, as shortchanging as they are to yourself.}
9232b415b3160a112da6.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{你取出一截细绳，裹上常春藤，涂满树胶。随后，你轻轻掀起小安塞尔姆头骨裂缝处的碎片，用手指沿着裂口再抹上一层树胶。%oathtaker%紧张地盯着。觉得差不多了，你便把细绳嵌进裂缝，将头骨碎片按回原位，夹紧细绳与黏糊糊的常春藤。  你退后一步，打量自己的手艺。%oathtaker%咽了口唾沫。%SPEECH_ON%我……我想不会有人看出来。%SPEECH_OFF%你却有些担心：与其让大家看见某个鬼鬼祟祟的修骨匠留下的掩饰痕迹，说不定让他们直接发现裂缝，反而更好。不过，无论如何，事已办妥，小安塞尔姆的体面也算保住了。%oathtaker%擦去额头的汗。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我相信这是一场考验，而小安塞尔姆已经指引我们渡过难关。他的力量在我体内流淌，此刻的荣幸，任何言语都不足以表达。%SPEECH_OFF%什么？小安塞尔姆多半根本不懂树胶和常春藤；如今成了不会说话的头骨，想必懂得更少了。不过……你还是任由%oathtaker%这么理解，尽管这把你的功劳抹了个干净。}

00420a7d1d99b7882f89.source: I should have been an undertaker.
00420a7d1d99b7882f89.translation: 我当初就该去做殡葬的。

c598a8d5b46e4ee06e81.source:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{You hush %oathtaker% and tell him to close the tent tarp. Taking the skull, you set it on the table and immediately work to fix it. Unfortunately, the second your hands put in any kind of effort, the crack widens and there's even fragments that fly off and scatter to who knows where. You let go of the skull as though it had burned you, Anselm's grace clopping hollowly on the table. %oathtaker% looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%What now? What should we do? Maybe we should take the best part and run off and form a new band?%SPEECH_OFF%Scoffing, you ask the fool if he takes you for an Oathtaker or an Oathbringer. He swallows and confirms the former. Damn right, and there's only one thing to do if that is the case: claim it is Young Anselm's desire to have this here skull crack, and that it is a display of how the %companyname% are not owning up to being true Oathtakers. He agrees, and you do end up showing the rest of the men the skull and its newly acquired bony demarcations.

At first they are fearful of its crack, but soon agree with you, that Young Anselm's influence is waning, not because of the First Oathtaker himself, but because you all, the last of the Oathtakers, are not owning up to your Oaths! And that you all must do better to follow the path of a true Oathtaker! The men roar and cheer, their convictions renewed by Young Anselm's crack.}
c598a8d5b46e4ee06e81.translation:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{你叫%oathtaker%小声些，关好帐篷门帘。接过头骨，你把它放到桌上，立刻动手修补。可惜，你的手刚稍稍用力，裂缝便扩大了，还有碎片崩飞，不知散到了哪儿。你像被烫着般松开手，安塞尔姆的圣物空洞地磕在桌上。%oathtaker%望着你。%SPEECH_ON%现在怎么办？咱们该怎么办？要不拿上最好的一块，逃出去，另组一支队伍？%SPEECH_OFF%你嗤了一声，问这蠢货，到底把你当立誓者，还是誓言使者？他咽了口唾沫，确认是前者。这就对了。既然如此，便只剩一个办法：宣称头骨开裂正是小安塞尔姆的意愿，是在昭示%companyname%没有尽到真正立誓者的本分。他表示赞同，于是，你把头骨和它新添的裂纹展示给其余弟兄。

起初，大家都被裂痕吓住，可很快便同意你的解释：小安塞尔姆的力量正在减弱，原因不在初代立誓者本人，而在于你们这些最后的立誓者，没有恪守誓约！你们都必须更加努力，沿着真正立誓者的道路前行！弟兄们高声欢呼，小安塞尔姆头骨上的裂缝，反而让他们重拾了信念。}

e09893b954186ce912f6.source: Had his faith in Young Anselm redoubled
e09893b954186ce912f6.translation: 对小安塞尔姆的信仰更加坚定

b88c0e540dc5d061100c.source: Convinced he hasn't upheld the oaths as well as he should
b88c0e540dc5d061100c.translation: 坚信自己未能尽心恪守誓言

283697c53767b1a13ede.source: Was compelled to redouble his efforts following the oaths
283697c53767b1a13ede.translation: 受到鞭策，决心更加努力地践行誓言

126217666d64664e8180.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{You find %oathtaker% staring intently into the eyesockets of Young Anselm's skull, the weight of the bone resting on his outstretched palm. He nods now and again and murmurs to himself in a sort of whispering prayer. Sensing your presence, the Oathtaker turns around.%SPEECH_ON%I was worried, but despite the seas of chaos, we have here Young Anselm, and he is provenance of courage such that I would swim into the world's ocean with full assurance that he would see me through it. I should spread Young Anselm's teachings with the others.%SPEECH_OFF%Absolutely he should. | The Oathtakers are enjoying a fine meal beside the fire. %oathtaker% has Young Anselm's skull on a stump. He occasionally turns, spoon of gristle in hand, and seems to think about feeding some to the bony maw. These moments make you uneasy, but for whatever reason the little skull has a tendency to compel the Oathtakers into a better mood by mere presence alone, so much so that you'll let these simultaneously girly and grisly peculiarities pass. | %oathtaker% is looking over a text with felt covers and a gilt bookmark. Beside him, Young Anselm's skull rests near a dying candle. You ask the Oathtaker what he's reading. The man looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Seeing to matters of the Oaths, as Young Anselm had written them. Remember the lad's wise words: ink is the strongest of memories, so it is wise to not depend solely on one's own capacities to follow the Oaths, but instead to refresh the springs of the mind through the writings themselves. This, too, was a part of Young Anselm's teachings. You would know if you tended to the texts as he advised.%SPEECH_OFF%A little snippy there, but he's not wrong. | You see %oathtaker% cleaning off the skull of Young Anselm. Wishing to test the man's faith in the First Oathtaker, you ask something you already know: how did Anselm die. The Oathtaker straightens up, staring at you with a sincere look of offense.%SPEECH_ON%Captain, it matters not how he died, or even when or why or to whom, and maybe there even isn't a whom, but what matters is that he was on the Oath of the Final Path, and so we are also with him, and will be to the end. We are not just Oathtakers, but the Final Oathtakers.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns around, flicking a bug off the bone and then cleaning the skull as though it had been profaned by the insect's steps.%SPEECH_ON%This is a grand experience we are undertaking here captain, but sometimes I think you're just along for the ride.%SPEECH_OFF%It is at the very least a grand experience in deepening your pockets. Thankfully, the only one who seems capable of noticing your more cynical nature is a supposedly poignant skull, Young Anselm's eyesockets emptily staring at you as the Oathtaker spit shines the bone. | %oathtaker% kneels before Young Anselm's skull.%SPEECH_ON%Give me strength in our Oaths, Young Anselm, for I cannot do it alone and certainly not with just the captain's help.%SPEECH_OFF%You almost tell him that he's not alone, he's with the %companyname% and you're not a slouch yourself, but figure this probably isn't the place for that sorta realist talk. The man suddenly jumps to his feet and nods.%SPEECH_ON%Such guidance is much appreciated, Young Anselm.%SPEECH_OFF%A part of you wishes you could look at a young lad's skull for guidance and actually find it, but the only thing you take from Young Anselm's bony visage is an empty stare. | The company has had its up and downs, but Young Anselm is still seen as its primary piety purveyor. You have to admit, sometimes you find yourself staring at the skull with a bit of contempt. Despite you leading the band, and despite you leading it quite well, much of the company's successes are given to the skull. When the men need help, they often go to the skull just as well, skipping right past their captain. %oathtaker% is an example of this, having had a rough go lately but, instead of talking to you, you find him scooping up Young Anselm for some bony counsel on Oathtaking matters. You sometimes dream of taking the First Oathtaker's dome and skipping it across a lake like a rock. | Young Anselm's skull is a touchstone for the most faithful of the Oathtakers, a source of knowledge and guidance and more, all springing out from a silent, bony vessel. %oathtaker%, who has been feeling rather down and out about his past few days, is given access to the skull. Even in this brief keeping, he is renewed in his belief in the Oaths. | You set Young Anselm's skull onto a stick and start spinning it, the bone rattling as it goes round and round, the hollow clatter horribly amusing. %oathtaker% comes through the bushes asking something and you grab the skull and set it down in an instant. The Oathtaker looks at you, the stick, the skull, then back to you. He clears his throat and explains he's been having a rough go of it the past few days. For guidance, and out of laziness, you hand him Young Anselm's skull, telling him to find within the First Oathtaker a revivification of his vitality, a renewal of his faiths, and a resurgence of his courage. The man nods dutifully.%SPEECH_ON%Young Anselm might be the First Oathtaker, but I still believe you are wise beyond your years, captain. I should have seen to Anselm in the first place!%SPEECH_OFF% | You got Young Anselm's skull set on a stump and are throwing pebbles through the eyesockets. One swooshes right through the hole and you pump your fist. Just then, %oathtaker% comes around. He looks at you, your clenched fist, and Young Anselm. The Oathtaker nods.%SPEECH_ON%If even a cynic such as you may be given courage by Young Anselm, then surely the First Oathtaker's abilities go beyond what even I believed. I will leave you alone so that you may find further guidance from Young Anselm.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you thank the Oathtaker, but after he leaves you return to the sport. Unfortunately, all you can muster is plinking pebble after pebble off Anselm's dome. It seems you've lost the touch of the toss. | You have a thick stick in hand and are tossing rocks into the air and slamming them off into the distance. Each crack is deep and pleasing, and the sight of the stones sailing immensely satisfying. As you lean down to pick up another stone, you see Young Anselm's skull there, staring up at you. Naturally, you take it up, weighing it one hand. It's so light. You toss it up and smash it with the stick, fragments of skull spiraling outward in every direction, the fine bonemeal powdering the air around you as though you'd cast a magic trick. Suddenly, you feel something in your side, and this world snaps away and you blink awake to %oathtaker% prodding you with his toe. Blinking your eyes, you realize you dozed off near the campfire. The Oathtaker sets a skull down beside you and nods.%SPEECH_ON%I sought counsel with Young Anselm and found it, captain, but seeing that you were sweating in your sleep I thought maybe you would like a moment with the First Oathtaker as well.%SPEECH_OFF%The man turns and leaves and you're left alone with the skull. It stares at you knowingly. A little too knowingly. You turn the head to look elsewhere and then go back to sleep. | %oathtaker% has had a rough go of it the past few days. You bring him Young Anselm's skull and tell him to sit with his thoughts, and to reflect on the Oaths. The man nods, and just a few minutes later he comes to you, skull in hand.%SPEECH_ON%You were right, captain. I had strayed from the path, but through the First Oathtaker's guidance I have found it again.%SPEECH_OFF% | Young Anselm's skull is starting to look a little ragged. Pieces of grass, mud, couple of bugs, all these things are smattered onto the bone. %oathtaker% comes up asking some inane question about inventory. You cut him off and hand him the skull and tell him to clean it. He nods, staring at the skull as though it were a pound of pure gold. He finishes the job within ten minutes, and when he gets back his disposition is entirely fresh, himself admitting that time alone with Young Anselm invigorated him, and reminded him why he took to the Oathtakers in the first place. That's all well and good, but the priority here is that he's also forgotten to talk to you about inventory which is fantastic.}
126217666d64664e8180.translation: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{你发现%oathtaker%正专注地凝视小安塞尔姆的眼窝，伸出的掌心托着那颗头骨。他不时点头，低声自语，像在喃喃祈祷。察觉你在身旁，立誓者转过身。%SPEECH_ON%我原本很担忧，可即使身处混沌之海，我们仍有小安塞尔姆在。他就是勇气的源泉，让我即便游入世间汪洋，也确信他会护我渡过。我该向其他人传扬小安塞尔姆的教诲。%SPEECH_OFF%当然该。 | 立誓者们在火边享用美餐，%oathtaker%将小安塞尔姆的头骨放在树桩上。他不时转过头，手里一勺肉筋，似乎在琢磨，要不要喂一点进那骨头嘴里。这些时刻让你不安，可不知为何，那小头骨只要在场，就常能让立誓者心情转好。因此，对这些既像姑娘哄娃、又阴森可怖的怪癖，你也就睁只眼闭只眼。 | %oathtaker%正在读一本毡布封面的书，夹着镀金书签。身旁，小安塞尔姆的头骨靠着一支即将燃尽的蜡烛。你问他在读什么，他抬头说。%SPEECH_ON%重温誓言，照小安塞尔姆亲笔所记。别忘了那位少年的箴言：墨迹是最牢靠的记忆。因此，践行誓言时，不该只依赖自己的本领，而要借文字不断滋养心灵的泉源。这也是小安塞尔姆的教诲。若你照他的劝告多读些经文，就会知道。%SPEECH_OFF%口气有点冲，不过他说得没错。 | 你看见%oathtaker%正在擦拭小安塞尔姆的头骨。想试试他对初代立誓者的信仰，你故意问了个早已知道答案的问题：安塞尔姆是怎么死的？立誓者挺直身子，望着你，满脸真切的受辱之色。%SPEECH_ON%团长，他怎么死的并不重要，何时、为何、死于谁手，也不重要，甚至未必有那个“谁”。重要的是，他正在践行终极之道的誓言，因此，我们也与他同行，直到尽头。我们不只是立誓者，更是最后的立誓者。%SPEECH_OFF%他转过身，弹掉骨头上的虫子，又仔细擦洗，仿佛虫足亵渎了它。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我们正在经历一场伟大的旅程，可有时，我觉得你只是顺路跟着。%SPEECH_OFF%至少，这是一场让钱袋变厚的伟大旅程。幸好，似乎只有那颗据说满怀深意的头骨，能看穿你更玩世不恭的一面。立誓者正用唾沫擦亮骨头，小安塞尔姆空洞的眼窝则直直盯着你。 | %oathtaker%跪在小安塞尔姆的头骨前。%SPEECH_ON%小安塞尔姆，请赐我践行誓言的力量。我独自做不到，光靠团长帮忙，更做不到。%SPEECH_OFF%你差点告诉他，他并非孤身一人，身边还有%companyname%，而你自己也不是什么废物。不过，这里大概不适合讲这些实在话。那人突然站起，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%多谢指引，小安塞尔姆。%SPEECH_OFF%你心里有一部分，也希望自己望着少年的头骨时，真能寻得指引。可小安塞尔姆那张骨头脸，只给了你空洞的凝视。 | 战团有过起伏，小安塞尔姆却始终被当作最主要的信仰来源。你得承认，有时自己望着那颗头骨，颇有几分轻蔑。明明是你率领队伍，而且带得很不错，可战团的许多成就，却全算在头骨账上。弟兄们需要帮助时，也常越过团长，直接找它。%oathtaker%就是个例子，近来过得不顺，却不来与你谈，反而抱起小安塞尔姆，求这颗骨头指点立誓之事。有时，你真想拿起初代立誓者的脑壳，像石头一样丢进湖里打水漂。 | 对最虔诚的立誓者而言，小安塞尔姆的头骨是精神的基石，知识、指引，以及更多东西，都从这只沉默的骨质容器中涌出。%oathtaker%为过去几天的遭遇颇感失落，如今获准接触头骨。哪怕只是短暂保管，他对誓言的信念也焕然一新。 | 你把小安塞尔姆的头骨架在棍子上转着玩，骨头一圈圈旋转，发出空洞的咔哒声，阴森得颇为有趣。%oathtaker%一边发问，一边穿过灌木走来，你立刻抓住头骨，放回原处。立誓者看看你、棍子、头骨，又看看你。他清清嗓子，解释近几天过得不顺。为了给点指引，也为了偷懒，你把小安塞尔姆的头骨递给他，叫他从初代立誓者那里重获活力、信仰与勇气。那人郑重点头。%SPEECH_ON%小安塞尔姆虽是初代立誓者，可我仍相信，团长，你的智慧远超年岁。我本该一开始就去找安塞尔姆！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你把小安塞尔姆的头骨放在树桩上，朝眼窝投小石子。一颗嗖地穿了过去，你兴奋地挥拳。这时，%oathtaker%恰好走来。他看看你、攥紧的拳头，以及小安塞尔姆，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%连你这样玩世不恭的人，也能从小安塞尔姆那里获得勇气。看来，初代立誓者的力量，甚至超出了我的想象。我就不打扰，好让你继续寻求他的指引。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头道谢，可他一走，你便继续游戏。不幸的是，接下来的石子只管一颗颗敲在安塞尔姆的脑壳上。看来，你已失去了投掷的手感。 | 你握着一根粗棍，将石头抛向空中，再奋力击向远处。每一下撞击都低沉悦耳，看着石头高高飞远，令人无比满足。你弯腰再捡一颗，却看见小安塞尔姆的头骨正望着你。自然而然，你把它拿起，在一只手里掂了掂，真轻。你将它抛起，一棍打碎。头骨碎片旋转着飞向四方，细细骨粉弥漫身周，仿佛施了个魔术。忽然，肋侧被什么碰到，眼前世界骤然散去。你睁眼醒来，见%oathtaker%正用脚尖轻戳你。眨了眨眼，你才意识到，自己在篝火边打了盹。立誓者把头骨放在你身旁，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%团长，我向小安塞尔姆求教，也得到了指引。不过，见你睡着还在冒汗，我想，也许你也愿意与初代立誓者独处片刻。%SPEECH_OFF%那人转身离去，只剩你与头骨相对。它望着你，仿佛什么都知道，知道得未免太多。你把脑袋转向别处，再次睡下。 | %oathtaker%过去几天过得不顺。你把小安塞尔姆的头骨送去，叫他静坐思索，反省誓言。那人点头，才过几分钟，便捧着头骨回来。%SPEECH_ON%团长，你说得对。我偏离了道路，但在初代立誓者指引下，又找回来了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 小安塞尔姆的头骨开始有些邋遢，草屑、泥巴、几只虫子，全粘在骨头上。%oathtaker%走来，问起库存方面某个无聊问题。你打断他，递过头骨，叫他擦干净。他点头，盯着头骨，像捧着一磅纯金。不到十分钟便做完，回来时整个人神清气爽，还承认，与小安塞尔姆独处，让他重振精神，也想起了当初为何加入立誓者。这都很好，可最要紧的是，他已经忘了问你库存的事，简直妙极了。}

9256542c6056eaaf0a6d.source: Young Anselm renewed his faith in the oaths
9256542c6056eaaf0a6d.translation: 小安塞尔姆让他重新坚定了对誓言的信念

8cd0fab6bc377ee10d5d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{You come across a monk standing before a priory. The walls of the building have been shattered, slabs of stone splintering out of the foundations, smaller stones turned to powder in the ensuing collapse. He explains that an earthquake shunted the place entirely, breaking chunks off and nearly bringing the whole place to the ground. He sighs.%SPEECH_ON%The worst of it isn't just the material damage, the worst of it is that the earthquake shook the faithful themselves, loosening their reserve for the suffering which is inherent in our day to day. They've not yet returned to me, for they fear that the old gods have chosen our grounds as a point of punishment for some heretofore unrealized error.%SPEECH_OFF%}
8cd0fab6bc377ee10d5d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{你遇见一名站在修道院前的修士。建筑的墙壁已经崩裂，大片石板从地基处断出，较小的石块则在随后的坍塌中碾成了粉末。他解释说，一场地震将这里震得面目全非，石块接连崩落，整座修道院险些夷为平地。他叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%最糟的还不是房屋受损，而是地震连信徒们的信心也一并动摇了。他们本就日日受苦，如今更失去了忍耐的心力。他们至今不肯回来，怕是自己犯下了某种尚未察觉的罪过，旧神才选中这里降下惩罚。%SPEECH_OFF%}

ab183d58aecd641ae4f2.source: We have gold. Could you rebuild with 2500 crowns?
ab183d58aecd641ae4f2.translation: 我们有钱。2500克朗够你重建吗？

edbbd5106d16622d9716.source: We have tools. I think 40 should be enough?
edbbd5106d16622d9716.translation: 我们有工具。40份应该够吧？

2798b5986aa25dcf1b8f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{You pay the monk monies to fix up the priory. He breaks into tears, saying that he did not expect such men of honor to even exist in this world, much less come and meet him personally. The very fact that you are here, and that you are so giving, is surely a sign that the old gods are not punishing him.%SPEECH_ON%Not only will these crowns allow me to rebuild, but such generosity will be seen by the locals as a sign that the old gods are not in fact punishing us! Here, please take this. It just barely survived the rubble, but perhaps you'll be able to make more use of it in time than we ever could.%SPEECH_OFF%}
2798b5986aa25dcf1b8f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{你出钱帮修士修缮修道院。他顿时泪流满面，说自己从没想过，世上竟还有这样高尚的人，更没想到竟能亲自遇见。你来到此地，又如此慷慨，足以证明旧神并非在惩罚他。%SPEECH_ON%这些钱不仅能让我重建修道院，这份善举也会让当地人明白，旧神并没有惩罚我们！来，请收下这个。它险些就毁在瓦砾里了，往后交给您，或许能比留在我们手里派上更大的用场。%SPEECH_OFF%}

071bc153eb9e0a9a0e68.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{You put your hand on the monk's shoulder. He looks back, tears in his eyes, then glances at the purse of crowns you're holding out. He takes it and holds it tenderly as though he'd never been gifted anything in his whole life.%SPEECH_ON%Is this...is this for the priory?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you tell him to use it to rebuild the place. You start to suggest maybe also adding a modest belltower, but just as you start in with the poor architectural references, a man comes screaming down the road, his finger pointing, his feet beating a mean path.%SPEECH_ON%Don't trust that rat! He's a no good beggar!%SPEECH_OFF%When you look back, the supposed monk who was at the priory steps is already running off, sprinting down the road before jumping through a cut of nettles and disappearing into some brush and trees, money in hand and his cackling in the air. The man coming down the road throws his hands up.%SPEECH_ON%That squirrely wretch has been playing woe is me for weeks now. This here buildin' is dead and gone, not been occupied since the greenskins wrecked it ten years ago. I know you was just lookin' to do right, but there are many in this world who see your generosity as a big bullseye to aim for. S'ry you got scammed, fellas.%SPEECH_OFF%}
071bc153eb9e0a9a0e68.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]{你把手放在修士肩上。他含泪回过头，随后看见你递出的钱袋。他接过，珍惜地捧在手中，仿佛这辈子从未收到过礼物。%SPEECH_ON%这是……这是给修道院的？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，让他拿去重建。你正想建议，不妨再添一座小钟楼，可才刚开始卖弄那点贫乏的建筑知识，一个男人便沿路狂奔而来，伸着手指，边跑边喊。%SPEECH_ON%别信那只耗子！他就是个坑蒙拐骗的乞丐！%SPEECH_OFF%你回头一看，刚才还坐在修道院台阶上的所谓修士，已经抱着钱袋撒腿跑了。他沿路狂奔，随后钻过一片荨麻，消失在灌木和树丛里，只留下阵阵得意的怪笑。跑来的男人摊开双手。%SPEECH_ON%这奸猾的混蛋装可怜，已经装了好几个星期。这破楼早就废了，十年前被绿皮毁掉后，就再没人住过。我知道你们是一片好心，可这世上有的是人，专挑你们这份慷慨下手。伙计们，让你们受骗了，真遗憾。%SPEECH_OFF%}

05e0a277cd9b1ff21f1e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]{You believe the %companyname% has the tools and manpower to complete the task themselves. Smiling, you tell the monk that they will set forth and rectify the rectory. The holy man is beside himself as you and the Oathtakers gather up their equipment and start the fixing. It takes a few hours, but the blood and sweat is worth it. By the time you are finished, a throng of peasants have appeared, and they leave not only with the old gods on their minds, but the %companyname% being carried on their tongues. No doubt many will hear of the Oathtakers for days to come!}
05e0a277cd9b1ff21f1e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]{你相信，%companyname%有足够的工具和人手，能自行完成修缮。你笑着告诉修士，弟兄们这就动手，把修道院修整好。你与立誓者们收拾器具、开始干活时，这位圣职人员高兴得难以自持。虽然花了几个时辰，流下的血汗却很值得。等到完工，已经聚来一大群农民。他们离开时，心里记着的不仅是旧神，嘴上谈论的还有%companyname%。往后的日子里，立誓者的事迹必定会传到更多人耳中！}

056d701591b31f8d4849.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{You grab the monk and pull him to his feet. You tell him that the %companyname% will repair the priory. He is tearful and happy, though warns that it might be beyond saving. Smiling, you tell him nothing is too great a task for the Oathtakers. A moment later, %injurybro% pushes on the busted wall only for the bottom half to spill inward and the top parts to spill out, promptly burying him in a pile of rubble. The company shouts in horror and goes to pull him out, and as they do the rest of the building collapses, folding unto itself in a stream of powdered stone. %injurybro% is rescued from the debris, albeit with a fair share of injuries.%SPEECH_ON%Well, I suppose it's the thought that counts.%SPEECH_OFF%The monk says, scratching the back of his head.%SPEECH_ON%Perhaps the old gods truly did seek to punish us here. But no matter, I think you still did right, and there is dignity in the attempt, is there not? I shall speak well of you, %companyname%.%SPEECH_OFF%}
056d701591b31f8d4849.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{你扶起修士，告诉他，%companyname%会修好这座修道院。他喜极而泣，但也提醒你，这里可能已经无可挽救。你微笑着告诉他，没有什么事能难倒立誓者。片刻之后，%injurybro%伸手推了推残墙，墙的下半截便向里坍去，上半截则向外倒下，当场把他埋进了一堆瓦砾。弟兄们惊叫着上前救人，可他们刚一动手，其余的建筑也轰然垮塌，伴着滚滚石粉，整个向内陷了下去。%injurybro%被从废墟里救了出来，不过伤得着实不轻。%SPEECH_ON%唉，我想，有这份心意就够了。%SPEECH_OFF%修士说着，挠了挠后脑勺。%SPEECH_ON%也许旧神确实想要惩罚我们。不过无妨，我仍认为你们做的是好事，肯付出努力本身就值得敬重，不是吗？我会为%companyname%说好话的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

ed23f2c8139bcf14f794.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{You decide that this venture is not yours to have. This choice has a few of the men questioning your leadership. Sure, the Oaths can't all be followed at all times, but to not even spare a drop of sweat or ounce of crown to help a holy man and his flock? It is in skipping over the little things, the things that require no effort at all, that a man can find himself spiraling into being an uncaring savage.}
ed23f2c8139bcf14f794.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{你决定不揽这件事，却让几个弟兄开始质疑你的带领。诚然，不可能时时刻刻恪守所有誓言，可帮助一位圣职者和他的信众，竟连一滴汗、一个克朗都不肯付出？恰恰是这样略过那些微不足道、举手之劳的小事，才会让人一步步沦为冷漠的野蛮之徒。}

95414a36ab893989a4e7.source: The company helped restore a priory
95414a36ab893989a4e7.translation: 战团帮助修复了一座修道院

238dbcd68613fe68b012.source: The company had its kindness taken advantage of
238dbcd68613fe68b012.translation: 战团的善意被人利用了

03b6eaad0828f781b0e5.source: The company was duped out of crowns by a charlatan
03b6eaad0828f781b0e5.translation: 战团被骗子骗走了一笔克朗

3e2703484d18b8f56715.translation: 帮助修复了一座受损的修道院

a47f5f0fd84063b39520.source: You refused to help a monk in need
a47f5f0fd84063b39520.translation: 你拒绝帮助一名有困难的修士

b6a46c8c2c46eec9986c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{The company has made camp next to an abandoned priory and the men are sitting around the campfire casting shadow animals across one of its stonewalls. First a rabbit, then a panting dog, of course the bird, the head of a snake and the little mouse for it to eat. One of the sellswords ponders what it is that these shadows get up to when they aren't looking. He holds his hands up, their shapes blackly set against the wall.%SPEECH_ON%I just mean we have these things following us everywhere we go, we toy with them, you know, and yet we don't really think much about it. I mean look at this, what is this?%SPEECH_OFF%He splays his hands wide, blobbing ten fat shadows against the wall. The men ponder...}
b6a46c8c2c46eec9986c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]{战团在一座废弃修道院旁扎营，弟兄们围着篝火，用手在石墙上投出各种动物的影子。先是兔子，然后是吐舌喘气的狗，当然也少不了鸟，接着是蛇头，再来只给它吃的小老鼠。一个佣兵忽然琢磨起来：没人看着的时候，这些影子都在干什么？他举起双手，黑色轮廓清清楚楚地映在墙上。%SPEECH_ON%我是说，咱们走到哪儿，它们就跟到哪儿。咱们还拿它们玩，却从没仔细想过。你们看，这到底算什么？%SPEECH_OFF%他张开十指，在墙上撑出十道粗胖的黑影。众人陷入了沉思……}

c8bda0cd1c30f031d4cf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{%anatomist% the anatomist looks up from the campfire, his face squirming with shadows as the flames rise and fall.%SPEECH_ON%Our shadows are but cuts upon the world which wound and mend all in one stride of black, dissecting the earth with our presence and self-same shaded presence in such a transient manner that it can't but be a preview of our stay here. But does the shadow think of dissecting you? Does it wish to free others which are like itself? Surely it is not alone. Surely our insides have shades. Do they cast tricks of themselves against our inner walls? What of when we sleep, are these things set against us from within or do they escape out into the world and wander? Are they the guards against our own minds, departing us in the night and leaving us to the horrors of dreamscapes which are surely present when we are awake? What distills the truth of the morning light better, than our shadow cast along the ground, and the fleeting memories of that which it has returned to ward away?%SPEECH_OFF%One of the sellswords stares at him.%SPEECH_ON%What?%SPEECH_OFF%The rest of the sellswords scoff.%SPEECH_ON%Hey man, we just wanna make like dicks and slags and shite. Check this out, I'm %anatomist%'s shadow. Blah blah blah blah!%SPEECH_OFF%The man mimes a mouth opening and closing over and over again as the company laughs.}
c8bda0cd1c30f031d4cf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_184.png[/img]{解剖学者%anatomist%从营火旁抬起头，火焰起落，阴影在他脸上蠕动。%SPEECH_ON%我们的影子，不过是划在世间的刀口。每迈出漆黑的一步，伤口便同时割开又愈合。我们以自身的存在，以及与之相同的阴影，短暂地剖开大地，那短暂，岂不正预示着我们在这里的逗留？可影子会不会也想剖开你？会不会想释放与你自身之影相似的同类？它必然并不孤独，我们体内也必然有阴影。它们会在我们内壁上投下自己的幻戏吗？我们睡着时，它们是在内部与我们为敌，还是逃入世间游荡？它们会不会其实在守护我们，抵挡我们自己的心智；一到夜晚便离开，任我们坠入梦境的恐怖，而那些恐怖，清醒时也一定存在？有什么比清晨投在地上的影子，更能揭示晨光的真相？还有那些转瞬即逝的梦中记忆——影子归来，正是为了再次将它们挡在外面。%SPEECH_OFF%一个佣兵盯着他。%SPEECH_ON%什么？%SPEECH_OFF%其余佣兵纷纷嗤笑。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，伙计，我们只是想弄点老二、骚娘们之类的手影。看这个，我是%anatomist%的影子。叭叭叭叭！%SPEECH_OFF%那人比划着一张不断开合的嘴，惹得整个战团大笑起来。}

901f69d1c8ea5218a397.source: At least the anatomist took it in stride.
901f69d1c8ea5218a397.translation: 好歹解剖学者还算看得开。

ccb99056a0ff31990a81.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{%cultist% the cultist leans toward the fire, his face almost touching the flames. The men glance at him as his eyes go wide, the wetness drying and peeling back until blood veins grow fat on the white. He leans back.%SPEECH_ON%Shadows are but ambassadors of the greater dark.%SPEECH_OFF%The campfire crackles and the man's shadow blossoms against the priory wall, and for a moment the company sees something else in that black, something twisted and leaning in, an entity not at all at the behest of %cultist%'s shape. As the fires die down, the shadow cuts to pieces and draws away into the greater night, and only the cultist's own shadowed self remains, flickering uncertainly against the priory walls.}
ccb99056a0ff31990a81.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]{教徒%cultist%朝篝火俯下身，脸几乎贴上火焰。弟兄们侧目看着他瞪大双眼，眼中的水分被烤干，泪膜渐渐退去，直到眼白上鼓起根根血丝。他这才向后靠去。%SPEECH_ON%影子，不过是无边黑暗派来的使者。%SPEECH_OFF%篝火噼啪作响，他的影子在修道院墙上骤然铺开。那一瞬间，众人在漆黑之中看见了别的东西：某种扭曲的存在，正俯身凑近，形体全然不受%cultist%的身形约束。火势渐弱，那道影子便碎裂散开，退入更深的夜色，只留下教徒自己的影子，在修道院墙上摇曳不定。}

047a03a7c17c19b5fd17.source: Strange shadows for a strange night.

0830c067f48a16728222.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{Standing up, %monk% the monk makes an appeal to the old gods.
