He has one hand to his chest as the other swings upward as though in a great oratory offering.%SPEECH_ON%It is not the shadows we should mind, but the fire which has produced them, for it is the flame which the gods have bestowed upon us, such that we may carry the day into the night, and make our productive habits unending, and our allegiance to that which is good unerring.%SPEECH_OFF%The men shout 'hear hear!'}
0830c067f48a16728222.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]{修士%monk%站起身，向旧神祈告。他一手按胸，一手高举，仿佛正在献上一场庄严演说。%SPEECH_ON%我们该关注的不是影子，而是投下影子的火。正是诸神赐予我们火焰，让我们将白昼带进黑夜，让勤勉永不止息，让向善之心永不偏移。%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们高喊“说得好”！}

5845cafc167d9930eb7e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]{One of the mercenaries stands up and points across the campfire and announces that %mercenary% has the scariest shadow of them all. The large sellsword looks over as if annoyed his name was spoken aloud. He grits his teeth and slowly raises his hands and the rest of the company fearfully rears back. %mercenary% laces his fingers and puts the thumbs out.%SPEECH_ON%This is a chicken. See?%SPEECH_OFF%The men glance at the shadows on the wall. It looks absolutely nothing like a chicken, but nobody dares to say that. They all nod and agree.%SPEECH_ON%Frankly, %mercenary%, that is the best cock I've ever seen.%SPEECH_OFF%The men roar with laughter, but %mercenary% gets to his feet and the laughter stops.%SPEECH_ON%I said it was a chicken, didn't I?%SPEECH_OFF%The other man nods hurriedly and agrees it was indeed a chicken. Tensions settle down, but the shadow games are effectively over.}
5845cafc167d9930eb7e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]{一个佣兵站起身，隔着篝火一指，宣布%mercenary%的影子最吓人。那个大块头望过来，像是光被人喊出名字就已不悦。他咬紧牙，慢慢抬起双手，其他弟兄吓得纷纷后仰。%mercenary%交扣手指，伸出拇指。%SPEECH_ON%这是只鸡。看出来没？%SPEECH_OFF%众人望向墙上的影子。半点都不像鸡，可谁也不敢说，全都点头称是。%SPEECH_ON%说实话，%mercenary%，这该是我见过最棒的鸡吧！%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们哄堂大笑，可%mercenary%一站起来，笑声便戛然而止。%SPEECH_ON%我说的是只鸡，没错吧？%SPEECH_OFF%那人忙不迭点头，承认确实是只鸡。气氛缓和下来，玩影子的兴致却也就此散了。}

4f72e292621f0b0466c9.source: It sorta looked like a worm to me.

cac7af1f39cf780daf75.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{%swordmaster% the swordmaster nods and speaks to it.%SPEECH_ON%I've long thought about the shadow. When you take to a fight in the light of day, are there two battles going on? One of flesh and blood, and one of the shades at your feet? When you kill a man, do you kill his shadow as well, or does your shadow kill his? What even are we to our own shadows? Because when I find myself in a fight absent of light, it is not a fight at all, but a matter of nonsense, limbs flying, swords slashing. Blindness manifest. It seems only when a shadow is at the hip can we truly say it is a fight of men, and a fight of their talents.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the sellswords tilts a mug dutifully.%SPEECH_ON%Well whatever or however things are, may my shadow never cross illwise of yours, %swordmaster%.%SPEECH_OFF%The company raises their drinks. Hear hear!}
cac7af1f39cf780daf75.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]{剑术大师%swordmaster%点点头，接过话。%SPEECH_ON%我想影子的事，已经很久了。白昼交锋时，是否有两场战斗同时发生？一场在血肉之间，一场在脚下的影子之间？杀死一个人，是否也杀了他的影子，还是你的影子杀了他的？对自己的影子而言，我们又算什么？每当我在没有光的地方作战，那根本算不上战斗，只有手脚乱挥、刀剑乱劈，荒唐至极，活生生把人变成瞎子。似乎唯有影子伴在身侧，才称得上是人与人之间的较量，是本领之间的较量。%SPEECH_OFF%一个佣兵郑重地举起酒杯。%SPEECH_ON%不管到底怎么回事，只盼我的影子永远别与你的为敌，%swordmaster%。%SPEECH_OFF%全团举杯。说得好！}

76005589340de901b6f5.source: His shadows traverses with great danger.

7b9956bfbfac4616bf23.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%minstrel% the minstrel stands up, his head cocked to a side, his walk a shuffling amble, his eyes affixed to his own shadow upon the priory wall, every step he takes drawing it smaller and smaller yet. He stares at the shadow as though it were a body, and his closing in on it was akin to that of solving who murdered it. Suddenly, he bolts upright, hands to his hips.%SPEECH_ON%By the gods, men, I've got it figured out! My shadow is an absolute womanizer! A scapegrace smellsmock. He's got a big hammer in his pants, and every woman's a nail! A philanderer, he is! And a drunk, a pitiful sot. And...and a thief! Filching crowns from the filthy, this he cannot resist. And a little prankster, a little rat filled with devilments. Just the other day, my shadow took a shit in %othersellsword%'s boot! I couldn't believe it!%SPEECH_OFF%%othersellsword% jumps to his feet, knocking over the fire and spewing embers that seem to twirl and twist on the laughter of the men. He comes forward.%SPEECH_ON%I knew that wasn't no farkin' dogshite you bastard! What sorta man shits in another man's boots!%SPEECH_OFF%The sellsword slips and falls which arises applause from the company, and the minstrel delicately prances away, his shadow bidding goodbye with a kiss and wave.}
7b9956bfbfac4616bf23.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{吟游诗人%minstrel%站起来，脑袋歪向一边，拖着步子慢慢晃荡，双眼紧盯修道院墙上的影子。每走一步，那影子便小上一些。他像端详一具尸体般看着它，而逐渐靠近，仿佛就是在追查谁杀了它。突然，他猛地挺直身子，双手叉腰。%SPEECH_ON%诸神在上，弟兄们，我弄明白了！我的影子是个彻头彻尾的色鬼！专追裙子的浪荡无赖！裤裆里揣着把大锤，看哪个女人都像钉子！花花公子，就是它！还是个酒鬼，可怜的醉猫。而且……而且还是小偷！专从脏家伙身上摸克朗，根本管不住自己。还是个爱捣乱的小混蛋，满肚子坏水。就在前两天，我的影子还往%othersellsword%的靴子里拉了泡屎！真叫我难以置信！%SPEECH_OFF%%othersellsword%猛地跳起来，踢翻柴火，火星随着众人的笑声旋转飞舞。他冲上前。%SPEECH_ON%我就知道那他娘的不是狗屎，你这混蛋！哪种人会往别人的靴子里拉屎！%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵脚下一滑，摔倒在地，赢得战团一片掌声。吟游诗人则轻巧地跳着躲开，影子还送来飞吻，挥手道别。}

5100a220260f501b43e9.source: The minstrel's shadow gets more action than me.
5100a220260f501b43e9.translation: 吟游诗人的影子都比我有艳福。

4499906990b6074b3659.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{As the men bandy back and forth making shadows, %killer%, the alleged killer on the run, walks up to the camp carrying armfuls of jewelry and other goods, their metals glistening with crimson sheens. He's murmuring to himself, but then suddenly stops and look at the rest of the company.%SPEECH_ON%Oh. You guys are still awake? I was just, uh, out. Doing things.%SPEECH_OFF%There's blood on his face and caked under his fingernails. Sensing himself in trouble, he drops the goods.%SPEECH_ON%These are for the company, of course. I'm just so, uh, thankful that you all took me in. Thought I'd repay the favor, you know?%SPEECH_OFF%The men stare at the goods. You ask the man if someone is going to come looking for those items. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%No sir, of course not. I made sure of it. Oh captain, did I make sure of it, heh, heh, heh.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the man to put the goods into inventory, but to be sure to clean them up first. As he walks away, the rest of the men quietly exchange glances. There's no more shadow games left to play, it seems.}
4499906990b6074b3659.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{弟兄们正你来我往地摆弄影子，据说是逃亡凶犯的%killer%回到了营地，怀里抱满珠宝和各种物件，金属表面泛着猩红的光。他低声嘟囔着，忽然停下脚步，看向其他人。%SPEECH_ON%噢。你们还没睡？我只是，呃，出去了一趟。办点事。%SPEECH_OFF%他脸上沾着血，指甲缝里也结着血垢。察觉到气氛不对，他连忙放下怀里的东西。%SPEECH_ON%这些当然都是给战团的。我只是，呃，特别感激你们肯收留我。想着回报一下，明白吧？%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们盯着那些东西。你问他，会不会有人来找这些失物。他咧开嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不会，长官，当然不会。我已经确保万无一失了。噢，团长，我可是好好地确保了一番，嘿，嘿，嘿。%SPEECH_OFF%你让他把东西收进库存，但务必先擦干净。他走开后，其余人默默交换着眼神。看来，没人再有兴致玩影子游戏了。}

1f7cde87349810e6d18e.source: Would somebody please keep an eye on that man?
1f7cde87349810e6d18e.translation: 能不能来个人看住那家伙？

c76db913c82b3b8ad61d.source: What does %anatomist% the anatomist have to say?

31851469f08294bfe009.source: Our monk %monk% seems keen to answer.

55234aeaa06ba4950054.source: Why's everyone lookin' at the biggest sellsword?
55234aeaa06ba4950054.translation: 怎么都盯着块头最大的那个佣兵？

3c9308c43ea04a2996e3.source: %swordmaster% the swordmaster seems to have a word.
3c9308c43ea04a2996e3.translation: 剑术大师%swordmaster%似乎有话要说。

76f5926b507dafa6d2ab.source: Naturally, %minstrel% the minstrel is ready to talk.
76f5926b507dafa6d2ab.translation: 不用说，吟游诗人%minstrel%已经准备开口了。

d2a56ad7fc8377125737.source: Felt intellectually superior to the other men

9ceb55a3ae0074564e22.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{A man comes to the company saying that there's an evil direwolf pup trapped in his barn. %anatomist% the anatomist overhears this and slides on over. He asks if he knows for a certainty that the pup is evil. The stranger nods.%SPEECH_ON%Part direwolf, I imagine that its pedigree is clothed in evil. Damn thing is holed up in the barn and there's only one way in, so the whole affair is damn bit prickly.%SPEECH_OFF%He asks that you go and kill the pup before it escapes. %anatomist% is quite curious about this endeavor as very little is known about direwolves when they're young. He elects himself as volunteer to go with you to see to this infantile creature.}
9ceb55a3ae0074564e22.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{一个男人来找战团，说他谷仓里困着一只邪恶的恐狼幼崽。解剖学者%anatomist%听见这话，立刻凑了过来，问他怎么能断定那幼崽是邪恶的。陌生人点点头。%SPEECH_ON%它有恐狼的血统，想必邪恶就是打娘胎里带来的。那该死的东西躲在谷仓里，偏偏只有一个入口，这事难办得很。%SPEECH_OFF%他请你赶在幼崽逃出来之前杀掉它。人们对幼年恐狼知之甚少，%anatomist%因此对这件事大感兴趣，自告奋勇要与你同去，见识一下这只年幼的生物。}

3970870a0e2275b4854c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]{You take up the stranger's request and head over to the barn. It's fairly nondescript, and he explains that there's only one way in. He leans against the door and listens, then nods.%SPEECH_ON%Oh yeah, it's still in there alright.%SPEECH_OFF%The door is opened and you and %anatomist% venture in, passing piles of shite and stalls with spooked animals crammed into corners and rearing their heads as you pass. You see at the far end of the barn that there's a slovenly creature rummaging in a pile of hay. %anatomist% panics and snatches up a pitchfork and goes charging forth. You stave him off, catching the pole and riding it into the air. You yell at him and then point down. The beast isn't a direwolf at all, but just a regular dog, the mutt itself staring up with teary eyes. The man stands behind you rubbing the back of his neck.%SPEECH_ON%Oof, ah, yeah, that is my bad. I was sure this was a wolven monstrosity.%SPEECH_OFF%With a bit of food and training, there's little doubt that this mutt could be made into something useful for the %companyname%.}
3970870a0e2275b4854c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]{你答应了陌生人的请求，朝牲口棚走去。棚子看着平平无奇，他解释说，这里只有一个出入口。他靠在门上听了听，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%噢，没错，那东西肯定还在里面。%SPEECH_OFF%门开了，你和%anatomist%走进去，绕过一堆堆粪便。畜栏里，受惊的牲口挤在角落，你们经过时便纷纷抬起头。棚子最里面，一只脏兮兮的动物正在干草堆里翻找。%anatomist%慌了，抓起干草叉就冲上去。你拦住他，抓住叉柄，使劲将叉尖挑向空中，冲他大喊，又指了指地上。那根本不是什么恐狼，只是一条普通的狗，眼泪汪汪地抬头望着你们。领你们来的男人站在身后，揉着后颈。%SPEECH_ON%哎，啊，是，怪我。我刚才真以为那是头狼形的怪物。%SPEECH_OFF%只要喂点东西，再好好训练一番，这条杂毛狗显然就能为%companyname%派上用场。}

d56274740e4c79f68e43.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{You venture over to a nondescript barn with chains across its door. The man leans against the frame for a moment, listening through it, then nods and takes the chains off. As he swings the door open, he retreats behind you and stares from this safe position.%SPEECH_ON%It's there, in the hay.%SPEECH_OFF%You see the shape of the beast and, drawing your sword, you creep forward. %anatomist%, however, jolts at the very sight of it, losing all composure with a graceless yelp and womanly cry. He grabs a pitchfork and stabs it into the hay. There's a shriek of the beast as the anatomist repeatedly thrusts the prongs in, again and again until the creature is slain. You crouch down and pick way the bloody straw. It isn't a direwolf at all, not even a hint of a small pup. It is in fact just a regular dog, and regularly dead at that.

Just then, you hear a voice behind you. It isn't the man who fetched you at all, but instead someone else. He cries out that you killed his dog. %anatomist% throws the pitchfork down. He explains that this was all a mistake. Seeing as how the anatomist elected to arbitrate the situation himself, you hurriedly leave the scene to him, only hearing the faint cries of the dog's owner and %anatomist% trying to argue that it was all an accident. You've mind to find the bastard who set you up in the first place, but you got the feeling he's made himself very scarce. All you can do is go count some inventory while ignoring the wailings of the dead dog's owner and %anatomist%'s pitiful gainsaying.}
d56274740e4c79f68e43.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{你们来到一间不起眼的牲口棚，门上缠着铁链。男人靠在门框上，隔门听了片刻，点头解下锁链。他推开门，随即躲到你身后，从这个安全的位置朝里张望。%SPEECH_ON%就在那儿，草堆里。%SPEECH_OFF%你看见野兽的轮廓，拔剑出鞘，慢慢靠近。%anatomist%却一见它便猛地一颤，彻底失态，先狼狈地叫了一声，又尖声惊呼。他抓起草叉，刺进干草。野兽惨叫起来，解剖学者却不断猛刺，一下又一下，直到把它杀死。你蹲下，拨开染血的草。那根本不是恐狼，连幼崽都算不上。事实上，只是一条普通的狗，如今也死得再普通不过。

就在这时，身后传来人声。不是领你们来的男人，而是另一个人。他哭喊着，说你们杀了他的狗。%anatomist%扔下草叉，解释说全是误会。既然解剖学者决定亲自出面调停，你便赶紧把现场留给他，远远只听见狗主人的哭声，以及%anatomist%反复争辩这纯属意外。你想找出一开始设局的那个混蛋，可觉得他早已躲得无影无踪。你能做的，只有回去清点库存，假装没听见死狗主人的哀嚎，以及%anatomist%那可怜巴巴的辩解。}

9b8ddfc330d597723a4a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_131.png[/img]{If it is indeed a beast, it's probably best %beastslayer% the actual slayer of beasts comes along. You all three go to the barn. After standing in silence, for a time, you count to three and you and the beast slayer kick the barn doors open. The anatomist is late and didn't even realize this was the plan and kicks last and way too late and finds his boot pushing air and his leg plants and scissors horribly across the barnfloor. He tries to regain his dignity and get back up, but it appears he's pulled a muscle in his groin. You and %beastslayer% burst out laughing. As you help the anatomist up, the beast slayer ceases all musings and there's a rush of movement and a burst of air and a hard thwack against one of the barn's stalls. You look over to see the beast slayer pinning a pale, ghoulish creature, his weapon bored through its skull as his arm pins it by the neck.%SPEECH_ON%It's a pup alright, but it sure as shite ain't a direwolf.%SPEECH_OFF%He says, and drops the small nachzehrer to the ground. He looks over.%SPEECH_ON%Kinda looks like the anatomist a little bit.%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist% takes this on the chin, awkwardly getting up and trundling forth in a bowlegged gait. He remarks that the beast could still be of scientific benefit. Despite not being as rough around the edges as some of the other men, you can't help but respect his admiration for study.}
9b8ddfc330d597723a4a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_131.png[/img]{若里面真是头野兽，那最好还是让真正以猎兽为生的%beastslayer%同行。你们三人来到牲口棚前，默默站了一阵。你数到三，与猎兽者一同踹开棚门。解剖学者慢了半拍，甚至没弄明白这就是计划，最后才跟着踢出去，结果只踹到空气。脚一落地，两腿便可怕地朝两侧劈开。他想挽回体面，赶紧站起，可似乎已经拉伤了大腿根。你和%beastslayer%笑出了声。你刚扶起解剖学者，猎兽者忽然收起笑意，身形一动，带起疾风，紧接着，畜栏处响起一声重重的撞击。你望过去，只见他已将一只苍白、食尸鬼般的生物钉住，武器刺穿头颅，手臂抵着它的脖子。%SPEECH_ON%确实是个崽子，可肯定他娘的不是恐狼。%SPEECH_OFF%说完，他把这只小型食尸鬼丢到地上，又看过来。%SPEECH_ON%倒有几分像解剖学者。%SPEECH_OFF%%anatomist%默默受下这句挖苦，尴尬地爬起，叉着两腿挪上前，说这野兽仍有研究价值。他虽不如有些弟兄那般粗犷硬朗，可对钻研的这份执着，你也不由得敬重。}

d4005bb0831c7160f1a6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_131.png[/img]{%farmer% the farmer comes up. He tells the man.%SPEECH_ON%That wasn't originally your barn, was it?%SPEECH_OFF%The man shakes his head. %farmer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Figured as much, because barns like that aren't just one way in. There's an earthen exit built in, you just have to know where to look. Give me one sec and I'll go spur this beast from the back end, you all just be ready for it in the front.%SPEECH_OFF%According to the plan, you all await at the front. It isn't long until you hear the yelp of a beast inside and it comes bumbling toward the doors. The second it steps outside you stab a sword through its skull, and as it flips over onto the ground you realize that it's a small nachzehrer. %anatomist% claps his hands for he has something that might be worth studying. %farmer% comes back around the sides of the barn holding a long two-handed weapon.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like someone forgot about this when they were auguring out the back of the barn. I think we'll go ahead and take it for ourselves as payment, won't we?%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, and the man who asked for your assistance gives no protest to the matter.}
d4005bb0831c7160f1a6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_131.png[/img]{农夫%farmer%走上前，对那人说道。%SPEECH_ON%这棚子原本不是你的，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%男人摇摇头。%farmer%点头。%SPEECH_ON%我就猜是这样。这种牲口棚可不止一个出入口，还留着一处土道出口，得知道上哪儿找。等我一下，我从后头把那东西赶出来，你们在前门守着。%SPEECH_OFF%你们依计等在门前。没过多久，里面响起野兽的尖叫，那东西跌跌撞撞地朝门口冲来。它刚踏出门，你就一剑刺穿头颅。等它翻倒在地，你才发现，这是一只小型食尸鬼。%anatomist%拍起手来，总算有了值得研究的东西。%farmer%从牲口棚侧面绕回来，手里拿着一把长柄双手武器。%SPEECH_ON%看来，有人打通后面那条土道时，把这东西忘在那儿了。咱们就拿它当报酬，怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，先前求助的男人也没有异议。}

972e2156dc210fe9d212.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{Despite %anatomist%'s desires, you tell the peasant that if it is indeed a direwolf in the barn then he should see to it himself. This sort of trouble isn't your concern, and if it will be, then somebody better damn well pay you for it. Hells, maybe the pup direwolf will provide ample opportunities for contract work down the road once it's big and strong to scare the peasantry into the %companyname%'s arms.}
972e2156dc210fe9d212.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_115.png[/img]{尽管%anatomist%很想插手，你还是告诉农民，粮仓里若真有恐狼，就让他自己解决。这种麻烦不归你管；真想让你管，就得有人他妈的掏钱。说不定那头幼年恐狼长大变壮后，还能把农民们吓得跑来求助%companyname%，给你们送上不少委托呢。}

dc199d67aca2fc892bf9.source: %beastslayer% the beast slayer should handle this.

75befc7b4040064cadbd.source: Our resident farmer %farmer% seems to have an idea.
75befc7b4040064cadbd.translation: 咱们的农夫%farmer%似乎有主意。

78bac61268179bb39281.source: Put his monster slaying skills to use
78bac61268179bb39281.translation: 派上了猎杀怪物的本事

5a729b4fc65d803f7e95.source: Embarrassed himself trying to slay a monster

b434cc98d11bf4f91fea.source: Got to study an interesting specimen
b434cc98d11bf4f91fea.translation: 得以研究一份有趣的标本

66af43f0cdd6b4a2b732.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{While in %townname%, you are approached by a person you had seen around one of the noblemen in the area. He is wearing a black cloak and he keeps his face deep in the cowl. He is the definition of suspicious. Naturally, %anatomist% the anatomist sets his eyes on him as though he were one of his objects of scientific observation. The man bows.%SPEECH_ON%I have come with great respect for the work you do, %anatomist%. We have read many of your texts.%SPEECH_OFF%You put a hand on your sword and wait to see where this is going. The man continues.%SPEECH_ON%We would like to invite you for a meal and to discuss matters of bodily import a little more...deeply.%SPEECH_OFF%Stepping between the men, you ask who this 'we' is. The man states that he is with a group of scribes and scholars who study matters of the human body, as well as the bodies who have comported themselves well to the nature of their bestial tasks, which is to say they study the world's monsters.%SPEECH_ON%We, of course, have a particular interest in the beasts which are man himself...after he has lost what he himself is.%SPEECH_OFF%With so much intrigue flitting about, you're not surprised that the anatomist wishes to go with the strange scribe.}
66af43f0cdd6b4a2b732.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{你在%townname%时，一个人走过来搭话。你曾在本地某位贵族身边见过他。他穿着黑斗篷，将脸深深藏在兜帽里，简直把“可疑”二字写在身上。解剖学者%anatomist%自然也盯住了他，像在审视一件研究对象。那人躬身行礼。%SPEECH_ON%%anatomist%，我怀着对你研究工作的莫大敬意前来。我们读过你的许多著作。%SPEECH_OFF%你把手搭在剑上，等着看他葫芦里卖什么药。那人接着说。%SPEECH_ON%我们想邀你共进一餐，再更加……深入地，探讨一些与躯体有关的重要问题。%SPEECH_OFF%你跨到两人之间，问这个“我们”究竟指谁。他说，自己来自一个抄写员与学者的团体，专门研究人体，也研究那些将兽性发挥得淋漓尽致的躯体——换句话说，就是世上的怪物。%SPEECH_ON%当然，我们尤其关注一种野兽：人本身……在失去其为人的本质之后。%SPEECH_OFF%话里藏着这么多神秘意味，解剖学者想跟这个古怪的抄写员走，你一点也不意外。}

72688098e78dc23f60f3.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{If %anatomist% is going anywhere in this town, he sure as shit isn't going alone. You tag along, your hand never leaving your sword. The strange man invites you to a beautiful stone house, candlelight beaming from every window. Inside, you are quickly ushered to what should be a dinner table, but instead find slabbed across it a pale man whose skin is barely hanging on. The strange scribe bows like a chef who has delivered his finest meal.%SPEECH_ON%We believe this is a wiederganger, a man who hath died yet walks again.%SPEECH_OFF%The strange scribe rolls up his sleeve and holds it over the decrepit corpse. Its maw suddenly juts left to right, the jaw unhinged, its white eyes rolling. %anatomist% merely leans back and mentions that it is 'interesting.' The two men begin to talk, while you nervously finger the hilt of your sword in case this 'wiederganger' takes an interest in escaping. When the two are finished, %anatomist% and the scribe take out quill pens and put their signatures in each other's tomes, all the while congratulating each other on their work.

The whole affair has you cringing, and you notice what looks like a bead of sweat on the wiederganger's brow, but before you can comment you are ushered out from the home. Whatever they discussed, the anatomist is renewed with energy. He speaks gingerly.%SPEECH_ON%The creature was a fraud, of course, don't think I did not notice that. However, this has given me plenty insight into the inventive depths of the locals. There's something to be preened from such creativity, being that one's imagination draws surreptitiously from the sublime and real, and makes inferences on what it intuits yet knows not how to describe with scientific distinction. Even in the mire and fog of regional superstition and legerdemain I can make great advances.%SPEECH_OFF%Well, alright. You mention that you knew it was a fraud because the supposedly dead cretin was sweating. The anatomist nods, and says you might not have an eye for diagnostic inquiry, but the street smarts are well enough for perspicuous scrying. You simply nod, hoping he meant well by whatever that means.}
72688098e78dc23f60f3.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{若%anatomist%要在这镇上去哪儿，肯定不能让他独自去。你跟在身旁，手始终没离开剑。怪人请你们进入一座美丽的石屋，每扇窗里都透出烛光。一进去，你们便被引到一张本该是餐桌的桌前，可上面却平躺着一个苍白男人，皮肤几乎挂不住。古怪抄写员鞠了一躬，像厨师端出自己最拿手的佳肴。%SPEECH_ON%我们相信，这是一具行尸，已经死去，却又重新行走的人。%SPEECH_OFF%抄写员卷起袖子，将胳膊伸到腐败的尸体上方。那张嘴突然左右摆动，下颌脱开，白眼乱转。%anatomist%只是稍向后靠，说了句“有意思”。两人开始讨论，你则紧张地摸着剑柄，免得这具“行尸”忽然对逃脱产生兴趣。谈完，%anatomist%与抄写员各自拿出羽毛笔，在对方的书上签名，一路互相恭贺研究成果。

这整件事都让你浑身别扭。你注意到，行尸额头上似乎有一颗汗珠，可还没来得及说，便被送出了门。不管谈了什么，解剖学者都精神焕发，谨慎地开口。%SPEECH_ON%当然，那生物是假的，别以为我没看出来。不过，这给了我充分的机会，了解当地人的创造力。这样的想象值得汲取，因为人的想象会悄悄借用崇高与真实之物，再对直觉察觉、却无法用严谨学理描述的东西作出推断。即便在地方迷信与戏法的泥沼迷雾中，我也能取得重大进展。%SPEECH_OFF%好吧。你说，自己知道是假的，因为那据说已死的蠢货还在出汗。解剖学者点头，表示你虽未必有诊断求知的眼光，可街头智慧也足以支撑明察秋毫。你只管点头，希望这些话不管什么意思，总归是在夸你。}

dd89fa4b3bb8154658db.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You agree to let the anatomist go, but you're coming along. This draws the attention of the strange scribe. He seems reluctant about the matter now, having lost the energy which he had in his initial invitations. As you round a corner, he makes a sharp birdlike call, and a few men step out and you draw your sword and push %anatomist% back. One makes an attempt to attack. You're not in much fighting shape these days, but with a quick parry you knock him back and dissuade him of further attack. The scribe and his minions then depart in a hurry, saying you're not worth it. %anatomist% looks disappointed.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, I see. So it was a scam, an endeavor that was as creative as it was criminal.%SPEECH_OFF%Looking around, you realize that your coinpurse is gone. You look over just in time to see a child holding it, then throwing it skyward to be caught by another child hanging on some gutters. %anatomist% stands beside you, looking up, fascinated by the engineering effort put in by the scamps.%SPEECH_ON%It seems where one offender fails, another may take his place. So it is that by attrition the criminals may succeed. Interesting.%SPEECH_OFF%The anatomist suddenly realizes he also is a bit light on the hip and sees that his purse, too, has been yoinked. You look past him to see yet another child running off like a rat with its cheese. Another child runs past and tries to pickpocket you when there's nothing left to steal. Angered by his empty hands, the boy yells back.%SPEECH_ON%Get a job!%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you say it's probably time to head back to the company.}
dd89fa4b3bb8154658db.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你同意解剖学者前去，但自己也要同行。古怪的抄写员注意到了这一点，似乎开始犹豫，最初邀请时那股热情已荡然无存。刚转过街角，他便发出一声尖锐鸟鸣，几个人随即现身。你拔剑，将%anatomist%推到身后。其中一人试图进攻。近来，你的身手虽已不比往日，可一次迅速格挡便将他逼退，也打消了他继续进攻的念头。抄写员与同伙匆匆逃走，嘴里喊着不值得为你们费事。%anatomist%满脸失望。%SPEECH_ON%啊，我明白了。原来是个骗局，既富于创意，又触犯律法。%SPEECH_OFF%你环顾四周，忽然发现钱袋不见了。转头一看，恰好瞧见一个孩子拿着它，随即向空中抛去，由另一个挂在排水槽上的孩子接住。%anatomist%站在你身旁，仰头观看，对小鬼们费心设计的这套协作着迷不已。%SPEECH_ON%看来，一个罪犯失败，另一个就能接替。因此，罪犯可以通过轮番消耗取得成功。有意思。%SPEECH_OFF%解剖学者突然察觉，自己腰侧也轻了，钱袋同样被顺走了。你越过他，看见又一个孩子飞奔而去，像只叼到奶酪的老鼠。另一个孩子跑过来，还想偷你的口袋，可里面已空无一物。男孩因空手而归而恼怒，回头嚷道。%SPEECH_ON%找个活儿干吧！%SPEECH_OFF%你叹口气，说该回战团了。}

b29219e5de9d58d6d0b9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{You agree to let %anatomist% and the strange scribe talk, but before you can even head down the street %minstrel% the minstrel steps forth, grinning and pointing.%SPEECH_ON%%fakescribe%! What in the hells are you doing these days? This some new scam you've got up your sleeve, huh?%SPEECH_OFF%The strange scribe clears his throat. He throws his hands out, and clears his throat again, he seems ready to speak deeply to some subject, but then sighs and throws back his cloak. A youngish and not at all scholarly looking fellow is revealed. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Life's been rough in the big city, %minstrel%. How are you doing?%SPEECH_OFF%The two chat for a time while you and %anatomist% look on bewildered. Eventually, the two minstrels turn to you, %minstrel% leading the way.%SPEECH_ON%Captain, this is %fakescribe%. He's on hard times out here in %townname%. What say he come along into the %companyname%? He's a lot like me, a shitass fighter, but a man of spunk, of moxy, a man who has what it takes if merely given the time to find it, especially if there's a woman involved.%SPEECH_OFF%%fakescribe% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Ehem, ehh, with them I never, uh, find it.%SPEECH_OFF%}
b29219e5de9d58d6d0b9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你同意让%anatomist%跟那古怪的抄写员谈谈，可还没来得及沿街走开，吟游诗人%minstrel%便笑着上前，伸手一指。%SPEECH_ON%%fakescribe%！你这阵子都在搞什么鬼？又想出了什么新骗局，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%怪抄写员清了清嗓子，摊开双手，又清了清嗓子，似乎准备就某个深奥话题发表高论。可最后，他只是叹了口气，掀开斗篷，露出一个颇为年轻、半点不像学者的家伙。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%%minstrel%，大城里的日子不好混啊。你过得怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%两人聊了一会儿，你和%anatomist%则在旁边看得一头雾水。终于，两位吟游诗人转向你，由%minstrel%先开了口。%SPEECH_ON%团长，这是%fakescribe%。他在%townname%混得很不如意。让他跟着咱们，加入%companyname%，怎么样？他跟我差不多，打起架来一塌糊涂，可有冲劲，也有胆气。只要给点时间，总能找到门道，尤其是碰上女人的时候。%SPEECH_OFF%%fakescribe%摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%咳，呃，碰上女人，我从来没，呃，找着过。%SPEECH_OFF%}

8c2db57635aa839999cf.source: We have no need of yet another charlatan.
8c2db57635aa839999cf.translation: 我们不需要再来一个骗子。

d96b8678096526ffc548.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{You take the minstrel along free of any hiring charges. %anatomist% the anatomist looks a little sullen about the whole affair, saying that he longs for rare knowledge, yet all this world seems to have on offer are scams and falsities. Smiling, you tell him to consider this street knowledge. He smiles as well.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, perhaps I should acquire more of these...street smarts.%SPEECH_OFF%No, street knowledge. 'Street smarts' sounds ridiculous.}
d96b8678096526ffc548.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{你免费收下了这个吟游诗人。解剖学者%anatomist%对整件事颇为沮丧，说自己一心渴求罕见的学问，这世道能给他的却似乎只有骗局与谎言。你笑着让他把这也当作街头学问。他也笑了。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，也许我该多学点这种……街头智慧。%SPEECH_OFF%不，是街头学问。“街头智慧”听着太荒唐。}

0c0206b20ea61dc7e6a7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]{You agree to let the anatomist and strange scribe have their conversations, yourself tagging along. The man takes you to the head of an alleyway which is considerably suspicious. He turns around with a wild grin on his face and he slowly starts to unsheathe a dagger from his sleeve, and then suddenly a knife stabs through his face, a glimmer of steel winking in his mouth. As he gargles, another knife comes in and cuts his throat in a quick slash. %killer%, the alleged killer on the run, appears from the alleyway.%SPEECH_ON%'Ello captain and, eh, anatomist? Mortician? This 'ere fella was a murderer. And an encroacher, encroaching on my...uh...affairs.%SPEECH_OFF%He drops the body to the ground and starts stripping away the cloak to reveal that this supposed scribe was in fact well armed and armored. The killer cuts off one of the ears and pockets it, then nods.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, looks like we got some free gear, eh? We should probably hide the body though. This man puts up a great front of eminence and some may find his absence worth investigation.%SPEECH_OFF%You know not what or who to trust on the matter, but a dead body bleeding out all over your boots tends to look bad no matter the circumstances. You hide the body, after happily stripping it the gear from it, of course. %anatomist% seems leery of %killer%. He mentions that the killer on the run's tone of voice seemed to be one of immediately produced conjecture or, as the layman puts it, 'acting.' Seeing as how what's done is done, you simply tell him to help carry the gear back to inventory.}
0c0206b20ea61dc7e6a7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]{你同意让解剖学者与那位古怪抄写员谈谈，自己也跟着去。那人把你们带到一条十分可疑的巷口，转过身，脸上挂着狂乱的笑，缓缓从袖中抽出匕首。突然，一把刀刺穿了他的脸，寒光在嘴里一闪。他喉中咯咯作响，另一把刀又迅速划开了喉咙。那个据称正在逃亡的凶犯%killer%，从巷中现身。%SPEECH_ON%你好啊，团长，还有，呃，解剖学者？殡葬师？这家伙是个杀人犯。还是个越界的，插手我的……呃……事务。%SPEECH_OFF%他把尸体丢下，剥开斗篷，露出里面精良的武器与盔甲。这位所谓抄写员，原来全副武装。凶犯割下一只耳朵，收进口袋，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，看来白捡了一套装备，是吧？不过，最好把尸体藏起来。这家伙平时把自己装得挺有身份，要是不见了，没准有人会查。%SPEECH_OFF%这件事里，该信什么、该信谁，你全然拿不准。不过，一具往你靴子上不断流血的尸体，无论怎么解释都不好看。你藏起尸体，当然，先高高兴兴地扒走了装备。%anatomist%似乎对%killer%心存疑虑。他说，这位逃亡凶犯的语气，像是在当场编造推断，或者用外行的话说，就是“演戏”。既然事已至此，你只叫他帮忙，把装备搬回库存。}

26449f3fa2238f9a8c82.source: It is what it allegedly is.

63f4d1efe85e9b4cfe9c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{You say the situation is far too suspicious to risk. %anatomist% says that all knowledge seems suspicious to the laity. You tell him that this 'layman' knows enough to smell a rat and that is that. The anatomist is upset, but you'd rather he be agitated than dead.}
63f4d1efe85e9b4cfe9c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]{你说这事太可疑，不值得冒险。%anatomist%却说，外行看什么学问都可疑。你告诉他，这个“外行”至少知道怎么闻出骗局，到此为止。解剖学者很不高兴，可你宁肯他生闷气，也不愿他丢性命。}

b0f0198d0f2c10e65cad.translation: 少耍小聪明，多长点真脑子。

733fd348c4f62900d049.translation: 吟游诗人%minstrel%是不是知道些什么？

7f839ce0a69686ef803c.source: Wait, where is our resident murderer %killer%?
7f839ce0a69686ef803c.translation: 等等，咱们的杀人犯%killer%去哪儿了？

72a030941e76ca70a7c0.source: Learned how to better deal with the laity
72a030941e76ca70a7c0.translation: 学会了更好地与平民打交道

d0e916beba6c2fe29034.source: {%name% was found deploying his minstrel talents in street scamming. Vouched for by a fellow minstrel, he joined the %companyname% to seek out a life on the road. Hopefully the charlatan-turned-sellsword will be able to 'fake it til he makes it', as he likes to say a little too often.}
d0e916beba6c2fe29034.translation: {遇见%name%时，他正把吟游诗人的本领用在街头行骗上。经另一位吟游诗人担保，他加入了%companyname%，寻求四处行走的生活。这骗子如今改当佣兵，只盼真能像他常挂嘴边的那句话一样：“装着装着，就真成了。”}

f24747f37fcbe27aaeaf.translation: 目睹了一场残忍的谋杀

851c06169ddd3ffda227.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You come across a group of kids sitting in a treehouse. Eyes glare out of the portholes and around the wooden bastion you can see readied slingshots. As you size up the fort, they draw up the rope ladder and tell you to scram. Curious, you wonder what they might have of value for such an overreaction to a group of men who would almost certainly destroy them.

Being that kids easily buckle under pressure, you ask if they're hiding something. One makes a jerking off motion and tells you to scram, while another kid slugs him on the shoulder and tells him to shut up. Not exactly the answers of kids hiding treats or pastries. They definitely got something valuable up there.}
851c06169ddd3ffda227.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你遇到一群待在树屋里的孩子。一双双眼睛从小孔中瞪着外面，木头堡垒四周架着蓄势待发的弹弓。你正打量，他们便拉起绳梯，叫你滚开。面对一群几乎肯定能轻易收拾他们的男人，这反应未免太过激烈，令你不禁好奇：他们到底藏着什么值钱东西？

孩子通常禁不住吓唬，你便问他们是不是藏了什么。一个做着撸管的手势，叫你快滚；另一个却在他肩上捶了一拳，让他闭嘴。这可不像只是藏了些糖果点心的反应。上头一定有什么值钱的东西。}

f69ebac62e2988a19dd6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You order the %companyname% to assault the fort. Unable to climb the tree under threat of rocks and slingshots, you have the men build ladders and throw up ropes of their own. The kids scream and throw down sticks and stones, dishing out an unignorable amount of pain, but not nearly as much as the words they call you, awful things like birdwatchers and pig dicks, the mean little bastards. A few manage to cut the ropes as the men are climbing up, leading to even more injuries. But eventually the sellswords roost the kids out, throwing the children out of the tree with great fervor. No surprise to you, your intuition was entirely correct: the kids had stowed away a few armaments and were stockpiling them in the tree fort. You take the goods and have the fort and the tree it rests on burned.}
f69ebac62e2988a19dd6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你命令%companyname%进攻树堡。石头与弹弓逼得人爬不上树，你便让弟兄们造梯子，抛上自己的绳索。孩子们尖叫着往下丢木棍和石块，打得人痛得不轻，可更扎心的还是他们骂出来的话——什么看鸟的蠢货、猪鸡巴，真是一群刻薄的小混蛋。还有几个趁人往上爬时割断绳子，又添了不少伤。可最终，佣兵们还是把这群孩子从窝里赶了出来，毫不留情地扔下树。你的直觉果然没错：孩子们藏了些武器装备，全囤在树堡里。你收走东西，又让人把树堡连同支撑它的大树一并烧掉。}

ce8e931fc0a4e7507143.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{You punch two fingers forward, ordering the men to assault the tree fort. The kids respond with slingshots and rocks. Pretending the rocks don't hurt like a mug, you tell the kids to give up. In return, they call you an inept fool and a witless schemer. These words hurt almost as much as the stones and rocks.

Suddenly, the fort finds reinforcements as a group of more kids join the fray from the adjacent tree's branches, the bastards streaming over like sea raiders boarding a ship. The whole assault is going to all the hells in many handbaskets and a few of the men are complaining that the whole affair is simply far too annoying an endeavor to have it be continued. You wonder if they're just worried about their pride. Sighing, you order a cease to the assault. The kids laugh and mock you, but it is what it is.%SPEECH_ON%They probably had nothing up there anyway. Not worth the hassle.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the men says. You disagree, but there's no point in dwelling on it. The kids rally into a fowl choir and make squawking chicken noises as you march away.}
ce8e931fc0a4e7507143.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]{你伸出两根手指向前一挥，命令弟兄们进攻树堡。孩子们以弹弓和石头回应。你假装这些石头砸在身上一点也不疼，叫孩子们投降，他们却骂你是无能的蠢货、没脑子的坏蛋。这些话伤人，几乎不输那些石块。

突然，树堡来了援军：更多孩子从邻树的枝丫间加入混战，像海盗登船般一个接一个涌过来。整场进攻乱得一塌糊涂，几个弟兄开始抱怨，说这事烦人得实在没法再干下去。你怀疑，他们只是怕丢脸。你叹了口气，下令停止进攻。孩子们大笑着嘲弄你们，可也只能如此。%SPEECH_ON%他们上头多半什么都没有，不值得费这劲。%SPEECH_OFF%一个弟兄说道。你不这么想，但再纠结也没意义。你们离开时，孩子们凑成一支鸡叫合唱队，咯咯嘎嘎地送你们上路。}

d01a2eccb7e5e0c73265.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{You take Anselm's skull and hold it up. With a booming voice, you explain the trials and triumphs of Young Anselm, the original Oathtaker. The kids are wowed, looking at one another as you regale them with tale after tale of courage and honor. Eventually, the kids produce a rather extravagant weapon.%SPEECH_ON%We found it in a pond.%SPEECH_OFF%Another kid pushes another.%SPEECH_ON%No, it was in a stone! Remember, I'm the one who pulled it out!%SPEECH_OFF%The kids fight each other for a time, but eventually a small girl takes the weapon and hurls it out of the tree fort's window. Its blade stakes into the ground, the steel warbling as it bends back and forth. She scoffs.%SPEECH_ON%Maybe it's for the best that someone else takes this thing, all they do is fight over it!%SPEECH_OFF%You wrap your hand around the sword's handle and its steel song hums to a quiet end. You unsheathe it from the earth and thank the kids for their contribution to the quest of the Oathtakers. The kids glance around at each other. One asks another.%SPEECH_ON%Do we have some sorta purpose now?%SPEECH_OFF%}
d01a2eccb7e5e0c73265.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{你取出安塞尔姆的头骨，高高举起，用洪亮的声音讲述初代立誓者小安塞尔姆所经受的磨难与取得的胜利。一个接一个关于勇气和荣誉的故事，让孩子们听得惊叹不已，彼此交换着眼神。最终，他们拿出了一把相当华丽的武器。%SPEECH_ON%我们在池塘里找到的。%SPEECH_OFF%另一个孩子推了同伴一把。%SPEECH_ON%不对，是在石头里！记得吗，是我拔出来的！%SPEECH_OFF%孩子们争打了一阵，最后，一个小女孩抓过武器，从树堡的窗户里扔了出来。剑刃扎进土地，钢铁来回颤动，发出嗡鸣。她不屑地哼道。%SPEECH_ON%还是让别人拿走这东西吧，他们就知道为了它打架！%SPEECH_OFF%你握住剑柄，钢铁的鸣声渐渐止息。你将剑从泥土中拔出，感谢孩子们为立誓者的使命出了一份力。孩子们面面相觑，其中一个问另一个。%SPEECH_ON%咱们现在也算有个什么使命了？%SPEECH_OFF%}

c925c64a99d2498b7401.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]{You are sitting in your tent and flipping a quill pen through your fingers. Awhile back you saw a scribe doing it, but you can't figure out how he did it so fast without dropping the damned thing. Even a breeze carries out from your shuffling fingers. %randombrother% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Will we ever financially recover from this?%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, you look up. You'd hoped the men would keep it together and not fret over losses but given a whole series of recent events the company almost seems on the precipice of incurring irreversible damage. Morale is low, the treasury is low, but even if you had the monies it seems like many might not even wish to join the company anyway given its lousy performance. Just then, a sellsword enters your camp with three men in tow. The man in front introduces himself, then makes his case.%SPEECH_ON%We knew of the %companyname% for its reputation, and we marched far to see it for ourselves. Now, if I may speak honestly, y'all seem beat to hell and not at all like the stories spoke of, but, shite, we know this world is hard on people and the only thing to do is make hay of it. We didn't walk all this way to get upset at a little scuff, y'know?%SPEECH_OFF%The men offer their services without upfront hiring costs, and not only this but the rest of the company is emboldened by the fact that the world still thinks highly of them and their efforts. All that time spent furnishing the %companyname%'s renown has finally paid off.}
c925c64a99d2498b7401.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]{你坐在帐篷里，试着用手指转动羽毛笔。前些天见一个抄写员这样做，你始终想不明白，他怎么能转得那么快，还不把这该死的东西掉下去。你的手指翻来覆去，连风都带起来了。%randombrother%摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%咱们的钱袋，还有缓过来的那天吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你叹息着抬头。本希望弟兄们振作一点，别总为损失担忧，可最近接连遭遇变故，战团仿佛已站在万劫不复的边缘。士气低落，金库空虚；即便有钱，凭眼下这糟糕的表现，恐怕也没几个人愿意加入。就在这时，一名佣兵领着三个人走进营地。领头者自报姓名，说明来意。%SPEECH_ON%我们听过%companyname%的名声，走了很远的路，想亲眼瞧瞧。恕我直言，你们现在像被打得七零八落，跟传闻完全不一样。不过，娘的，谁不知道这世道难为人，能做的也只有尽力过下去。我们走这么远，可不会因为一点磕碰就扫兴，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他们愿意效力，连预付的雇佣费都不要。不仅如此，其他弟兄也因此振作起来：原来世人仍看重他们，看重他们的努力。为%companyname%积攒声望的那些时日，终于有了回报。}

fde5a2d4ff9ea8a1e1be.source: %townImage%%doghandler% asks you to enter %wardog% into a local dog fighting circle. That sounds like an awful idea, but the man goes on to explain that a lot of money stands to be made in dogfighting. All the doghandler needs is an ante of two hundred crowns.
fde5a2d4ff9ea8a1e1be.translation: %townImage%%doghandler%问你，能否让%wardog%参加当地的斗狗赛。这主意听着糟透了，可他接着解释，斗狗能赚不少钱。他只需要两百克朗作为本钱。

c95688a7d57db1475d4f.source: Alright, but I'm going with you.

fea09db3e87b564b380b.source: %townImage%You take a purse of crowns and follow %doghandler% through a wind of darker and darker streets. Soon enough, there isn't much to see. Wet cobblestones, licked white by strobes of moonlight, lazily guide you into what depths the city hides from those who prefer the day. Suddenly, a torch flares up and a man's face, afloat and disembodied in the dark, speaks out to you.%SPEECH_ON%That dog here for da'fights?%SPEECH_OFF%%doghandler% nods. The stranger tilts the torch forward.%SPEECH_ON%Alright then. Right this way, gen-teel-men. Watch yer step. All manner of piss goes downhill.%SPEECH_OFF%
fea09db3e87b564b380b.translation: %townImage%你带上一袋克朗，跟着%doghandler%穿过曲折的街巷，越走越暗。很快，眼前几乎再看不清东西。月光时隐时现，将潮湿的鹅卵石路照得发白，慢悠悠地引着你们走进这座城藏在白昼背后的深处。突然，一支火把亮起，照出一张仿佛悬浮在黑暗中的脸。那人开口问道。%SPEECH_ON%这狗是来斗的？%SPEECH_OFF%%doghandler%点头。陌生人将火把朝前一倾。%SPEECH_ON%成，那就这边请，体面老爷们。脚下留神，什么尿水都往低处流。%SPEECH_OFF%

ae67f150ba483a42b4c5.source:
%townImage%Following the man's torch through the dark, you come to a building with a sliding portal at its door. The stranger gives the door a pattern of knocks and it pops open as if commanded by the final rap. You are ushered in, leering faces watching from the side as you enter. Immediately, you hear the unsettling din of snarling and barking. This is what you are here for, right?

 Stairs lead you to the pits where a crowd huddles around a makeshift arena of dirt and wobbly fenceposts. The action can't be seen yet, but off to the side are a pile of dead dogs and beside them sit their killers, eyes wild, blood frothing mouths agape in horrified panting. As two dogs clash in the arena, you glance at %doghandler%.
ae67f150ba483a42b4c5.translation:
%townImage%你跟着那人的火把穿过黑暗，来到一栋建筑前，门上开着一扇可以滑动的小窗。陌生人按节奏敲了几下，最后一下刚落，门便应声而开。你被领进屋内，两旁一张张不怀好意的脸盯着你。令人不安的低吼与犬吠立刻传入耳中。这不正是你来这里的目的吗？

 你沿楼梯向下，来到斗犬场。人群挤在用泥地和摇晃木桩围成的简陋场地四周。你还看不见场内的厮斗，却先看见旁边堆着一摞死狗。杀死它们的狗就坐在一旁，眼神狂乱，张着满是血沫的嘴，惊魂未定地喘息。场内两条狗扑到一起时，你转头看了看%doghandler%。

b91f5260e6ec05184db2.source: Time to ante up and see what our mutt can do.
b91f5260e6ec05184db2.translation: 押上钱，看看咱们的狗有几分本事。

def97df57c12f00c6ada.source: This is bad. Let's get out of here.

ab5abfe21594fb96e8b5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]After paying the ante of two hundred crowns, you and %doghandler% take %wardog% inside the arena.

Its eyes dart around and as its shoulder rests against your pantleg, you can feel a quickening heartbeat. Across from you stands your competition: a scummy looking doghandler and a massive beast more wolf than dog. The mutt is missing its bottom lip, displaying a jagged row of teeth that have been chiseled to be deadlier than they already are. Scabs and sores mottle its crooked body, but the musculature of its frame is apparent and %doghandler% whispers that this will be ugly.

 %wardog% yips and jabs forward, the mongrel bred with war in him, and with an outstretched hand you unleash your hound just as your opponent does his.
ab5abfe21594fb96e8b5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]交了两百克朗的入场赌注后，你与%doghandler%带着%wardog%走进斗犬场。

它的目光四处乱转，肩膀贴着你的裤腿，你能感觉到它越来越急促的心跳。对面站着你的对手：一个满脸龌龊相的驯犬人，还有一头与其说是狗、不如说更像狼的巨兽。那杂种狗的下唇没了，露出参差的尖牙，牙齿还被刻意凿尖，显得更加致命。它扭曲的身躯遍布痂疤与烂疮，可浑身肌肉依然清晰可见。%doghandler%低声说，这场面怕是会很难看。

 %wardog%吠了一声，猛地向前挣去，血脉中的斗性已被唤醒。你伸出手，松开了猎犬，对方也在同一刻放开了他的狗。

9a7cf309bc772429350e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]The two dogs sprint toward one another and cover the small arena in a flash. They collide, their crude bodies wheeling away from one another before their feet plant and charge in for another shot. The opponent's dog ducks beneath %wardog% then rises back up, glomming onto the underside of your dog's neck.

%doghandler%'s hands go to his face, his eyes staring out between his fingers. You watch as %wardog% is shaken from side to side. Blood spurts from its nose as it yelps. You can hear the scratch of scissoring, helpless legs as the dog tries to kick across the dirt. The audience jeers and laughs.
9a7cf309bc772429350e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]两条狗相向疾冲，转眼便跨过狭小的斗场。它们迎面撞上，粗壮的身躯各自翻滚开，随即四爪落地，再次扑向彼此。对手的狗钻到%wardog%下方，猛地抬头，死死咬住你战犬的喉咙下侧。

%doghandler%双手捂脸，从指缝间瞪大眼睛看着。你眼见%wardog%被左右甩动，惨叫着，鼻孔喷出鲜血。它无助地蹬腿，双腿交错，在泥地上抓挠的声音清晰可闻。观众嘘声四起，放声大笑。

b39f7790c0d899d37709.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]The two dogs sprint across the arena. %wardog% goes high, and its opponent low. You watch in horror as the opponent's mutt shoots up from its low stance and clamps its jaws under %wardog%'s neck. They tumble across the arena and in the violent momentum %wardog%'s throat is ripped clean out. Blood sprays so fiercely that the audience jumps back to get away. The victorious mongrel returns to its owner and drops a rag of flesh and muscle at his feet.

%wardog% stumbles across the dirt. It retches for breath, its throat puckering and wheezing and gargling. %doghandler% jumps the fence and kneels beside the mutt. He tries to cover the wound, but it's no use. The dog stares at you as it dies.
b39f7790c0d899d37709.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]两条狗飞奔着冲过场地。%wardog%高高跃起，对手却压低身子。你惊恐地看着那条杂种狗从低处猛然蹿起，一口扣住%wardog%的颈下。它们在场中翻滚，猛烈的冲势将%wardog%的喉咙整个扯了出来。鲜血喷涌得如此凶猛，观众纷纷向后跳开躲避。得胜的狗回到主人身边，把一团撕碎的皮肉丢在他脚下。

%wardog%在泥地上踉跄着走了几步，拼命想要呼吸，喉部的伤口一缩一张，发出嘶哑的咕噜声。%doghandler%翻过围栏，跪在它身旁，试图捂住伤口，却无济于事。它望着你，咽下了最后一口气。

1fa9f43e2dda2fcefaad.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]The two dogs briefly growl before charging. They collide and simultaneously glom onto each other's necks, spiraling and wheeling across the arena like some sort of furry and violent pinwheel.

%wardog% drives its opponent into a fence post. You watch as your dog buries its jaws into its opponent's face, jamming its teeth through an eye in one bite, and taking a chunk of tongue in another. The defeated mutt is bitten to pieces, literally, and as it falls in defeat your dog commits to a throat-ripping execution.

Your opponent cries out and tries to jump the fence, but the audience reels him back. %doghandler% pats you on the back.%SPEECH_ON%Easy money, no?%SPEECH_OFF%
1fa9f43e2dda2fcefaad.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]两条狗低吼片刻，便迎面冲了过去。它们撞在一起，同时咬住彼此的脖子，在场中翻滚打转，像一架裹着皮毛、疯狂旋转的风车。

%wardog%把对手顶到一根围栏木桩上。你看着它咬住对手的脸，一口刺穿眼睛，又一口扯掉了半截舌头。那条败犬被咬得支离破碎；等它倒下，你的狗便一口撕开它的喉咙，结束了性命。

对手哀叫着想翻进围栏，却被观众拖了回去。%doghandler%拍了拍你的背。%SPEECH_ON%这钱挣得轻松，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%

99ca66fcecdd3ea3e8be.source: It appears the company also has the meanest and baddest dogs.
99ca66fcecdd3ea3e8be.translation: 看来，连最凶最狠的狗也在咱们战团。

434533896f8708fe85cc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]You decide not to intervene, instead letting %wardog%'s fight, and potential demise, go where it may. The choice is soon rewarded: you watch as your dog gets its hind paws against one of the fenceposts circling the arena. With a good kick it manages to slide itself underneath its combatant and there tear out the dangling testicles in a disgusting display of survivalism. The poor emasculated mongrel, shrieking, wheels around only to put its neck directly into the jaws of %wardog%. The fight ends quickly, and almost mercifully, from there.

 You go to collect your reward while %doghandler% hugs the now tail-wagging %wardog%.
434533896f8708fe85cc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]你决定不插手，任由%wardog%继续搏斗，哪怕它可能就此丧命。这个决定很快有了回报：你看见自己的狗用后爪抵住场边的一根木桩，猛地一蹬，滑到了对手腹下，随即扯下了垂着的睾丸。这求生的手段恶心得令人作呕。可怜的杂种狗惨叫着转过身，却正好将脖子送进%wardog%的嘴里。接下来的厮杀很快便结束了，快得几乎称得上仁慈。

 你去领取赢来的钱，%doghandler%则抱住了已经开始摇尾巴的%wardog%。

6cd9b09c862914990b84.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]You don't intervene and even have to hold back %doghandler% as the man tries to jump the fence. The two of you can only watch in horror as the fierce mongrel's snapping bites tear away at %wardog%'s face piece by piece. Soon, your dog sinks to the ground, giving up its neck. Bloody tearing follows suit and %wardog% is very quickly a dead dog. Distraught, %doghandler% can only sink to the ground and cover his face.
6cd9b09c862914990b84.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]你没有干涉，甚至还拉住了想翻过围栏的%doghandler%。你们只能惊恐地看着那凶悍的杂种狗连连撕咬，将%wardog%的脸一块块扯烂。很快，你的狗倒在地上，暴露出脖子。紧接着又是一阵血肉撕裂，%wardog%转眼便断了气。%doghandler%悲痛欲绝，瘫坐在地，双手捂住脸。

7f65f947f8bfd4fc2f6d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]You throw your betting ticket into the dirt.%SPEECH_ON%Fark it.%SPEECH_OFF%With a quick leap you jump the fence and run into the arena. %doghandler% is right behind you. The two dogs are still at it, but a swift kick gets them separated. The houndmaster quickly grabs %wardog% and lifts him out of danger. The crowd boos and bottles and glasses start flying in. A man blows a whistle that silences them all. He steps into the arena.%SPEECH_ON%These people paid to see blood. If you are not going to give it to them, then you best find another way to pay. How about two hundred crowns crowns? That or you just go ahead and put that dog back down.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd is cracking their knuckles and drawing out knives, chains, and other crude weaponry.
7f65f947f8bfd4fc2f6d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]你把赌票扔在地上。%SPEECH_ON%去他娘的。%SPEECH_OFF%你一跃翻过围栏，冲进斗犬场，%doghandler%紧随其后。两条狗还在撕咬，你猛踢一脚，将它们分开。驯犬师赶紧抱起%wardog%，把它带离险境。人群嘘声四起，酒瓶和杯子纷纷砸了过来。一个男人吹响哨子，让所有人安静下来，随后走进场内。%SPEECH_ON%大伙花钱就是来看见血的。你不让他们看，总得另想个法子赔偿。两百克朗，怎么样？要么付钱，要么就把狗放回去。%SPEECH_OFF%人群捏响了指关节，纷纷掏出刀子、锁链和各种粗制武器。

3d6ce07f8b67a711a695.source: Take your damn crowns, then. We're leaving with our dog.
3d6ce07f8b67a711a695.translation: 拿去，你那该死的克朗。狗我们要带走。

9f3ccca9ded5b41b60d9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]You take out %demand% crowns and hand them over. The crowd boos, but the man in charge blows his whistle again.%SPEECH_ON%Shut it, the lot of ya! The man paid the fee so the man and his dumb dog walk.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd pipes down. You start to leave, %doghandler% behind you with an unconscious %wardog% strung limply across his arms. A few patrons hiss and spit, but that's about the most they do and you're perfectly fine with that.
9f3ccca9ded5b41b60d9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]你取出%demand%克朗交过去。人群发出嘘声，管事的又吹响哨子。%SPEECH_ON%都闭嘴！钱交了，人和他那条蠢狗就能走。%SPEECH_OFF%人群安静下来。你转身离开，%doghandler%跟在后面，昏迷的%wardog%软绵绵地横在他臂弯里。有些看客仍嘘叫、吐口水，可也仅此而已；这样已经很好了。

2a10a55c8bc0484e362f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]You order %doghandler% to put the dog down. His eyes widen.%SPEECH_ON%You can't be serious.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you say you are. %wardog%'s barely awake, snorting between frightened alertness and deadened unconsciousness. When %doghandler% hesitates again, you grab the dog and pull it away. You nod to the crowd, and then to your opponent who unleashes his murderous hound a second time. %wardog%'s weary, watery eyes look up at you, blink, then close. You put the dog down and your opponent's hound descend upon it with bestial fury. You try not to listen to the horrific demise unfolding at your feet.
2a10a55c8bc0484e362f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_20.png[/img]你命令%doghandler%把狗放下。他瞪大眼睛。%SPEECH_ON%你不是认真的吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，表示自己是认真的。%wardog%几乎已醒不过来，喷着鼻息，在惊恐的清醒与麻木的昏迷间挣扎。见%doghandler%再次迟疑，你一把接过狗，将它拉开。你朝人群点头，又向对手示意。对方第二次放出了那条凶狠的猎犬。%wardog%用疲倦、含泪的眼睛望着你，眨了一下，随后闭上。你将狗放到地上，对手的猎犬立刻带着兽性的狂暴扑了上来。你尽量不去听，脚边那场可怕的死亡正在发出的声响。

68f273e6b7378e226ab2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]While along the roads, your wardogs suddenly scamper off and begin digging into the earth. You're not sure why as you don't recall giving either one a bone. A few moments later and they're fighting over what appears to be %finding%. You interrupt the tug of war, taking the goods for yourself. The hounds whine, but a few good pets settles them down.
68f273e6b7378e226ab2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]行路途中，战犬们突然跑开，刨起地来。你不明所以，记得自己并没给过它们骨头。不一会儿，它们就为挖出的东西争抢起来，看上去是%finding%。你打断这场拔河，把东西拿走。猎犬虽呜呜抱怨，摸了几下，便安静了。

28966c86a13dbbea9f77.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]While taking inventory last night, %drunkard% had a little too much to drink and ended up losing %item%!

You've had him brought to you and the man, swaying on his feet, still reeks of alcohol. He hiccups as he tries to explain himself, but the best he can do is collapse to the ground in a drunken heap. The man laughs and laughs, but you see nothing funny about this. %otherguy% asks what you want to do with him.
28966c86a13dbbea9f77.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]昨晚清点物资时，%drunkard%喝多了，竟把%item%弄丢了！

你叫人将他带来。这人仍满身酒气，站都站不稳，一边打嗝一边想解释，最后却只能醉醺醺地瘫倒在地。他笑个不停，可你丝毫不觉得好笑。%otherguy%问你打算如何处置。

498e0f4ff9ef742fe310.source: If he won't put down the drink I'll force him to. Get the whip.
498e0f4ff9ef742fe310.translation: 他不肯放下酒杯，我就逼他放下。拿鞭子来。

4563d9d5f058f4b660ac.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]The drunkard falls onto his back, staring aimlessly at the sky. You see tears in his eyes and he covers his face, trying to hide his shame. There is something about him and his past that you do not know, perhaps something that led him to the drink in the first place. You can't possibly punish a man for what he cannot control.
4563d9d5f058f4b660ac.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]酒鬼仰面倒下，茫然地望着天空。你看见他眼中有泪，他捂住脸，想藏起羞耻。他身上、他的过去里，还有你不知道的事，也许正是那些事最初把他逼向酒杯。对于一个人无法控制的事，你实在罚不下手。

7a4abd374ab7bb172217.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You grab a shovel, a bucket, and a crusty bit of wool wrapped around a stick.%SPEECH_ON%Latrine duty. One month.%SPEECH_OFF%The drunkard looks at you and with wide eyes makes something of a plead.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, please. I -hic- don't... the men, sir, they -hic-...%SPEECH_OFF%You hold your hand up, stopping him. The man sways as he tries to stand straight. Cracking your knuckles, you explain the other option.%SPEECH_ON%If you do not wish to have these duties, then we can expedite your punishment by the whip. Which would you prefer?%SPEECH_OFF%Amazingly, the drunkard actually spends a few moments thinking it over, his eyebrows rising and falling and a grimace passing from side of his mouth to the other with a stream of realizations that there's no way out of it. Finally, he submits to the smellier of the two options. Quite shocked to see the choice even took any time at all, you begin to wonder just how bad the company's diet has gotten.
7a4abd374ab7bb172217.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你拿来一把铲子、一个桶，还有根缠着一团结壳羊毛的棍子。%SPEECH_ON%清理茅坑。一个月。%SPEECH_OFF%酒鬼瞪大眼睛看着你，含含糊糊地求起情来。%SPEECH_ON%长官，求你了。我——嗝——不……弟兄们，长官，他们——嗝——……%SPEECH_OFF%你抬手打断了他。他想站直，身子却直晃悠。你掰得指节咔咔作响，告诉他还有另一种选择。%SPEECH_ON%不愿干这活也行。换成鞭刑，受罚就快多了。你选哪样？%SPEECH_OFF%令人吃惊的是，酒鬼竟当真考虑了一会儿。他的眉毛忽高忽低，嘴角抽来抽去，每想明白一点，就更清楚自己无处可逃。最终，他还是认下了两种惩罚里更臭的那一种。你很震惊，这种选择竟然还需要犹豫，不禁开始怀疑战团的伙食到底糟糕到了什么地步。

c950ebd527242f39f805.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]The man was driven to the drink, so you plan to drive it out of him. You order a flogging. A few battle brothers drag the drunk away. He is hiccupping and moaning, his head bouncing aloll as he is seemingly unaware of what is going on. They string him up beneath a tree and shred the clothes off his back. After a few lashings, the drunkard wakes up to his punishment and begins crying out uncontrollably. He begs for mercy in a tongue blurred by drink and pain, like a man fighting for freedom from a nightmare. One thing is for certain: he'll never make this mistake again.
c950ebd527242f39f805.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]既然这人被逼得借酒浇愁，你就打算把酒劲从他身上逼出去。你下令鞭笞。几个弟兄拖走醉汉，他打着嗝，哼哼唧唧，脑袋晃来晃去，似乎还不明白出了什么事。他们把他吊在树下，撕开背后的衣服。挨了几鞭，醉汉才从酒意中醒悟，明白自己正在受罚，顿时哭喊不止。他被酒与疼痛绞乱了舌头，含糊地求饶，像在拼命挣脱一场噩梦。有一点可以肯定：他再也不会犯同样的错。

71168d8b2bd39778e397.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]The man was driven to the drink, so you plan to drive it out of him. You order a flogging. A few men drag the drunk away. He is hiccupping and moaning, his head bouncing aloll as he is seemingly unaware of what is going on. They string him up beneath a tree and shred the clothes off his back. After a few lashings, the drunkard wakes up to his punishment and begins crying out uncontrollably. He begs for mercy in a tongue blurred by drink and pain, like a man fighting for freedom from a nightmare.
71168d8b2bd39778e397.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]既然他是被逼得借酒浇愁，你就打算把酒瘾再逼出去。你下令鞭打。几个人拖走酒鬼，他打着嗝呻吟，脑袋软软地晃来晃去，似乎全不明白发生了什么。他们把他吊在树下，撕开背后的衣服。几鞭子下去，酒鬼终于意识到自己正在受罚，开始失控地哭喊。酒意与疼痛绞得他的求饶含糊不清，像个拼命想从噩梦中挣脱的人。

df98b9c8de862fa22066.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]During your travels, %scholar% has taken some interest in %dumbguy%'s intellectual shortcomings. %scholar_short% says that, with some time, he could learn the man a thing or two. %dumbguy_short% can put one foot in front of the other - and sometimes quite confidently - but you think that's about where his aptitude for all things comes to an end. Not only that, but %scholar_short% has gotten easily frustrated in the past. Teaching the dumb brother might just be an exercise in inflating his own ego.
df98b9c8de862fa22066.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]旅途中，%scholar%对%dumbguy%的脑筋不灵光起了兴趣。%scholar_short%说，只要花点时间，总能教会他些东西。%dumbguy_short%能把一只脚迈到另一只前头——有时还迈得挺自信——可在你看来，他的全部天分也就到此为止了。何况，%scholar_short%过去很容易失去耐心。教这个迟钝的弟兄，也许不过是满足自己优越感的一场折腾。

5b32309cfb8217db8cc5.source: See what you can teach him.

e6612b97f4441e129a9f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]{You come across %scholar% and %dumbguy% staring at a patch of dirt. Along the brown canvas you see that %scholar_short% has drawn geometric shapes, letters, numbers, and what look like constellations. It appears that they've been at this for hours now. 

A teaching stick in hand, %scholar% madly points at one of the star clusters and demands to know what it is. %dumbguy%, with a pained expression, guesses a sheep. %scholar% snaps the teaching stick in half and kicks dirt all over his drawings. It's a horse! A horse! %scholar% sighs heavily before marching off to the beat of endless profanity. Personally, you thought it was a crab. | You find %scholar% standing over %dumbguy%. Count the beetles, don't smash them, the learned man says with exasperation. %dumbguy% looks down at his beetle-juiced hands where {fragments of insect carapaces | carapaces of once-insects} dot his flesh. He nods, understandingly, and turns to pulling the beetles' legs off instead. %scholar% lets out a string of swears you've never heard in your life. | You find %scholar% and %dumbguy% yelling at one another. It appears they're at a very red-faced crossroads. %dumbguy_short% says he doesn't care if he's dumb, and the %scholar_short% argues that every man should be learned. Well it appears %dumbguy_short% would prefer to be left to his devices for he shows %scholar_short% his back as he walks away. Guess that's the end of the lesson for both men. | You find %dumbguy% squatting beside a creek, staring at himself in the shimmering reflection. He must have been at it for a while now for he's showing signs of sunburn. You ask if everything is alright, to which he explains that he is not 'getting it' with %scholar%'s teachings, and that %scholar% nearly went mad today before finally giving up on the venture. You explain that %dumbguy% doesn't have to be smart, he just needs to know how to swing a sword and shoot a bow. That's what you hired him for, after all. The man tries to hide a smile, but the running water betrays him. You take him back to camp where you then tell %scholar% to lay off for a while.}
e6612b97f4441e129a9f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]{你发现%scholar%和%dumbguy%正盯着一片泥地。褐色的“画布”上，%scholar_short%画了几何图形、字母、数字，还有看似星座的东西。他们似乎已这样待了好几个小时。 

%scholar%手持教鞭，激动地指着一簇星，逼问那是什么。%dumbguy%满脸痛苦，猜是只羊。%scholar%啪地折断教鞭，踢起泥土，将画全盖住。是马！是马！%scholar%重重叹息，踏着没完没了的脏话走了。依你看，那倒像只螃蟹。 | 你发现%scholar%站在%dumbguy%面前。学者气急败坏地说，是数甲虫，不是捏甲虫。%dumbguy%低头看看沾满虫汁的双手，皮肤上散着{昆虫甲壳的碎片 | 曾经属于昆虫的甲壳}。他一副明白了的模样，点头，改去拔甲虫的腿。%scholar%随即骂出一串你这辈子都没听过的脏话。 | 你发现%scholar%与%dumbguy%正互相吼叫，似乎已争到面红耳赤、谁也不让的地步。%dumbguy_short%说，他不在乎自己笨不笨，%scholar_short%则坚持，人人都该求学。看来，%dumbguy_short%还是更愿意独自待着，转身离去，只留给%scholar_short%一个背影。想必，两人的课都到此结束了。 | 你发现%dumbguy%蹲在溪边，盯着粼粼水面中的自己。他想必已经待了很久，皮肤都有晒伤迹象。你问是否一切安好，他解释，自己就是“弄不懂”%scholar%教的东西，今天%scholar%几乎被逼疯，终于放弃了。你告诉%dumbguy%，不必多聪明，只需知道怎么挥剑、怎么射箭就行。毕竟，你雇他就是为了这个。那人想藏住笑意，流动的水面却出卖了他。你把他带回营地，随后叫%scholar%暂时别再教了。}

1966c7464991bee85239.source: {Why will you not learn?! | Ignorance is bliss.}
1966c7464991bee85239.translation: {你怎么就是不肯学？！ | 无知也有无知的福气。}

49dabfee852458663726.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]{You come across %dumbguy% mulling over a set of coins on a table. You inquire as to what he is doing and he says he's trying to figure out how much to save for retirement. First off, you're surprised he even knows what the word retirement is. Second off, counting? Looks like you might owe %scholar% a pint. | You find %dumbguy% sitting on a stump as he writes across a scroll. When you ask what he's doing, he says he's writing a letter. When you ask to whom it is addressed, the man looks up with a sheepish grin and asks, does it matter? Just then, you spot %scholar% in the distance, arms crossed, a look of satisfaction on his face.}
49dabfee852458663726.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]{你撞见%dumbguy%正对着桌上的几枚钱币苦思冥想。你问他在做什么，他说，自己在算退隐养老得攒多少钱。先不说别的，他居然知道“退隐养老”是什么意思，就已经让你吃了一惊。更何况，他还在算数？看来你得请%scholar%喝上一杯了。 | 你发现%dumbguy%坐在树桩上，正往卷轴上写字。你问他在干什么，他说在写信。你又问信写给谁，他抬起头，不好意思地咧嘴一笑，反问：这重要吗？就在这时，你看见远处的%scholar%抱着双臂，脸上满是欣慰。}

ffad7ce2453c2e154c7d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]{Your arrival in %townname% seems to be cause for some celebration. One of the town's councilman greets you, offering refreshments. | %townname% shows its appreciation for your business there by handing you and your men a tray of refreshments. %randombrother% slams a few mugs down as a dainty, girlish server looks on in awe. He wipes his mouth.%SPEECH_ON%Appreciated. More, please.%SPEECH_OFF% | Business in %townname% has been good and the people there seem to appreciate you more and more: on today's arrival they gave you {plenty of useless thanks | a storm of gratitude | flowers upon flowers which you have no use for | trinkets and other things that you throw away when the peasants aren't looking | a tray of ale which your men quickly consume | a cask of ale which your men tactlessly criticize as 'tasting wooden' | a few marriage proposals which you gracefully turn down | a few marriage proposals which you can't turn down fast enough | one marriage proposal from the town ugly. She has a face that could stop a sundial. You decline the offer | a quick celebration wherein a few people shouted incoherently. Their tone seemed cheery, anyway | a few slaps on the back. You reminded them that such a doing might leave them handless on the next go around | an offering of orphans. You've no idea what gave them the notion that you'd accept such a gift, but you return the children to their sad home, also known as the streets}.}
ffad7ce2453c2e154c7d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]{你的到来，似乎让%townname%有了庆祝的理由。镇议会的一位议员迎上前，送来酒水点心。 | 为感谢你们在%townname%的生意往来，镇民端来一盘酒水点心，招待你和弟兄们。%randombrother%连灌几杯，把杯子砰砰放下，旁边娇小的女侍看得目瞪口呆。他擦擦嘴。%SPEECH_ON%多谢。请再来点。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你们在%townname%的生意一直不错，当地人似乎也越来越喜欢你们。今天刚到，他们便送来{许多派不上用场的感谢 | 一阵铺天盖地的谢意 | 一束又一束你根本用不上的花 | 小饰物和其他东西，你趁农民没看见时全扔了 | 一盘麦酒，弟兄们很快喝了个精光 | 一桶麦酒，弟兄们毫不客气地嫌它“一股木头味” | 几桩求婚，你都婉言谢绝 | 几桩求婚，你拒绝得唯恐不够快 | 镇上丑姑娘的一次求婚。她那张脸，连日晷看了都能停。你拒绝了 | 一场简短的庆祝，几个人喊得语无伦次，不过听语气应该挺高兴 | 几下热情的拍背。你提醒他们，再来一次，手可就未必保得住了 | 一群作为礼物送来的孤儿。你不知道是什么让他们觉得你会收下这种赠礼，只好把孩子们送回那悲惨的“家”——也就是街头}。}

1103753590fb0be77700.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{The {denizens | citizens | peasants | laymen | townfolk} of %townname% greet you with {a few rotten eggs thrown with such velocity and aim that you can't help but think these people do not take kindly to your presence. | a tarred and feather doll swinging from a nearby tree. The face of it is remarkably similar to your own, but you consider this nothing more than a coincidence. | a few rambunctious children, no doubt set loose by their parents to do evil that, in the adult world, would have garnered some measure of violent response. As the little runts go after you causing chaos, you order your men to put their boots to work. A few good stomps and kicks drive the bastards off, but for how long? | a burning effigy in your likeness. The peasants douse it in a pig trough. They stand around it, making sure you can't see what's left of the you-shapened wood.}
1103753590fb0be77700.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]{%townname%的{居民 | 市民 | 农民 | 平头百姓 | 镇民}这样迎接你：{几枚臭鸡蛋又快又准地砸来，让你很难不怀疑，他们对你的到来十分不满。 | 附近树上吊着一个涂满焦油、粘着羽毛的玩偶，随风摇荡。那张脸与你像得惊人，不过你只当是巧合。 | 几个顽劣孩子冲来，显然是父母故意放出来捣乱的。这些事若由大人来做，多半早就挨了揍。眼看小崽子们围着你闹个不停，你命令弟兄们让靴子派上用场。一番跺脚踢踹，总算赶跑了小混蛋，可又能清静多久？ | 一个照着你的模样扎成的偶像正在燃烧。农民们把它按进猪食槽里熄灭，又围在四周，故意不让你看见那具形似你的木头还剩下什么。}

c24f3bd30baaafbefe2d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]Word is spreading about %eunuch% the eunuch. Apparently, him and some brothers visited the town brothel. The whores and brothers alike initially made fun of the eunuch, but he demanded only five minutes with the most experienced of the ladies. She came back out after two minutes and the rumors about %eunuch%'s bedroom prowess has only exploded from there.

Now, half the town, more precisely its women, speak highly of the %companyname% and would love to see it visit again. %eunuch% himself gives you a wink and a smile. You notice that he's rather warty around the lips.
c24f3bd30baaafbefe2d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]关于阉人%eunuch%的传闻渐渐传开。据说，他跟几个弟兄去了镇上的妓院。起初，妓女和弟兄们都拿他取笑，他却只要求与最有经验的女子独处五分钟。才过两分钟，那女子就出来了，从此，关于%eunuch%房中本事的传闻便越传越盛。

如今，半个镇子——更准确地说，是镇上的女人们——都对%companyname%赞不绝口，巴不得战团再来。%eunuch%本人笑着朝你眨了眨眼。你注意到，他嘴边长着不少疣。

40c4eaec1ea8e4b538fe.source: One of your men got a reputation with the ladies
40c4eaec1ea8e4b538fe.translation: 你的一名部下在姑娘们中间出了名

90f736833bf16639a2be.source: Got friendly with some ladies in

8b75f346dd581bf9e7c1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]You find %fainthearted% leaning back and forth before the campfire. His face is speckled with dried blood and his hands are shaking. A few brothers try and talk to him, but none manage to get through. It appears the fainthearted man has been rattled by the horrors of a recent and brutal battle.
8b75f346dd581bf9e7c1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]你发现%fainthearted%坐在篝火前，身子来回摇晃。脸上斑斑血迹已干，双手仍在颤抖。几个弟兄试着跟他说话，却谁也没能唤回他的神。看来，这个胆小的人被最近那场残酷战斗中的恐怖景象吓坏了。

457e2ef5a48bebd3f5e7.source: Shocked by the horrors of battle
457e2ef5a48bebd3f5e7.translation: 被战场上的惨状吓坏了

aacd8b39f899282908ac.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]You find %farmhand% sitting beside the company wagon. He's rolling some boomstraw between his teeth, gritting it here and there and spitting out the flakes. You ask what he's thinking about. The farmer shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%What my pa told me about baling hay. He had this method of turning the wrist at the catch and again at the release. Never could get the second part right.%SPEECH_OFF%The man takes the straw out and flicks it. You ask.%SPEECH_ON%But you could get the first part right? Where ya stab the hay and yank?%SPEECH_OFF%He nods. You tell the man that he only needs the first part of that technique to properly gut a man. You watch as his face glows with realization.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah... yeah that's right! Why didn't I think of that before? Yer a genius, sir! I'll try it our next go out! It'll just be like baling hay!%SPEECH_OFF%With a lot more screaming and bleeding, but sure.
aacd8b39f899282908ac.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]你发现%farmhand%坐在战团货车旁，嘴里叼着一根草秆，来回嚼几下，吐出碎屑。你问他在想什么。农夫耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%想我爹教我捆干草的法子。叉进去时转一下手腕，甩出去时再转一下。后半步，我总做不好。%SPEECH_OFF%他取出草秆，弹到一旁。你问。%SPEECH_ON%可前半步没问题吧？就是把草叉进去，再猛地一扯？%SPEECH_OFF%他点点头。你告诉他，要给人开膛破肚，只会前半步就够了。他的脸一下亮了起来，恍然大悟。%SPEECH_ON%对……对呀！我怎么早没想到？长官，您真是天才！下回打仗我就试试，跟捆干草一个样！%SPEECH_OFF%当然，惨叫和流血会多得多，不过也差不离。

5a5a7164c7150571a572.source: Just don't try and throw them over your shoulder.
5a5a7164c7150571a572.translation: 可别真把人当干草往肩后抛。

0d1a607c560d9863079c.source: Realized he has some fighting knowledge
0d1a607c560d9863079c.translation: 发现自己原来懂些打仗的门道

838f57a7b713579f2308.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]You find %farmhand% and %butcher% arguing with one another over a piece of meat. The farmhand raises his voice.%SPEECH_ON%The best meat is from the shoulder. That's why you cut it off first! And you cut it like this, NOT like this you idiot.%SPEECH_OFF%Also raising his voice, and clenching a fist at his side, the butcher shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Why do you even question me? I'm a farkin' butcher, yer a pithy peasant! I did this for a living, you did it because you killed a cow grabbing its udder a little too hard, no doubt mistaking it for yer father's cock!%SPEECH_OFF%The fighting words kick off a scuffle. Someone gets slashed, someone else's nose cratered. The men are separated, but not before the damage is done.
838f57a7b713579f2308.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你发现%farmhand%和%butcher%正为一块肉争得不可开交。农场工人提高嗓门。%SPEECH_ON%肩肉才是最好的，所以得先切下来！而且得这么切，不是你那样切，蠢货！%SPEECH_OFF%屠夫也吼了起来，垂在身侧的手攥成拳头，连连摇头。%SPEECH_ON%你也配质疑我？老子是屠夫，你就是个种地的！我靠这手艺吃饭，你呢？准是挤奶时把牛奶子当成了你爹的鸡巴，下手太重把牛掐死了，才不得不动刀吧！%SPEECH_OFF%这番话立刻引发了一场扭打。一个被划伤，另一个被打塌了鼻子。众人总算把他们拉开，可伤已经受了。

0b2d6d80b8a1fe44cfb6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]%fatguy%, once a lumbering lump of belly fat on two legs, has lost a considerable amount of weight since he's with the company. No longer does the mere notion of a sparring fight leave him without breath. In fact, he's got more bounce in his step and is showing a sort of agility you've never seen from him before. Looks like all this walking about has done wonders.
0b2d6d80b8a1fe44cfb6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_75.png[/img]%fatguy%过去简直是两条腿驮着一大团赘肉，自从加入战团，已经瘦了不少。如今，他不再光想到要比划几招就喘不上气，走路甚至轻快起来，还展现出了你从未见过的灵活。看来，天天跋涉还真有奇效。

43f7f3fffca78bf5ea54.source: He might make a good sellsword yet.
43f7f3fffca78bf5ea54.translation: 他或许真能成为个好佣兵。

36190ecb999234de9522.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]A woman jumps out of the treeline beside the path.%SPEECH_ON%Oh thank the gods, my prayers have been answered! Please, come quick! My grandpap has fallen down the well!%SPEECH_OFF%She turns and hurries away as though you've already agreed to help her. %otherbrother% glances at you and shrugs.
36190ecb999234de9522.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]一个女人从路旁林缘冲出来。%SPEECH_ON%谢天谢地，诸神回应了我的祈祷！快，求你们快来！我爷爷掉进井里了！%SPEECH_OFF%她转身就跑，仿佛你已经答应帮忙。%otherbrother%看了你一眼，耸耸肩。

251c024219116795e75c.source: I guess we can help her.

278ccbcc55a1afdd7b02.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]You decide it's worth your time and go and take a look. The old man was doing repairs on the wellhead, a wooden framework meant to cover its opening, when it broke apart and sent him plunging down. Staring into the well, you find the man staring back up. He gives a wave.%SPEECH_ON%Oy' there, fellas. I'm in a bit of a pickle. I'm actually being pickled, now that I think about it...%SPEECH_OFF%Eh, right. %otherbrother% throws down a rope and the old man ties it around himself. You and the sellsword pull the woman's grandfather up and back onto dry land. He shakes your hand and thanks you cordially.%SPEECH_ON%Farkin' hell, glad you came when you did, I was about to shit and piss like no other. Let me tell ya, this ain't my first time going down a well. Five years ago I'd done it while repairing the wellhead, because the wellhead breaks often, you see. And it's not really a wellhead, we just call it that cause we're lazy. Back in my day we called it a... well, heh well, I actually done forgot. I guess a 'wellhead' makes sense now, as I'm not well in the head! Ho! Still got it. I was quite the charmer in my days, you see, and it's not often I get to put the practice in. M'wife died ten years ago, and the one prior to her left me twenty winters ago! I say winters, because that's when she left me, in the winter. It was a brutal one and I had asked her to help chop the wood lest we all freeze. She said she wasn't doing that shit and taking care of the kids at the same time. I had kids with her as well as with the second wife. Five total. One died. Measles. Another disappeared, so he's probably dead. I try to be honest to myself about it, but you know, there's hope. If a random stranger can be found in the forest to save me in the nick of time, then maybe my son survived that battle with the greenskins. Ain't heard of him, though. I pray to the old gods and even that Davkul fella every now and again. Do you know of Davkul? I'm not sure what to make of it. One time this man came by with a scar on his forehead, said he'd show me the way of darkness. I said I see darkness everytime I nap. This scarred fella said one day I won't wake and I said good! Ha! So then this scarred bastard starts getting upset with me...%SPEECH_OFF%As he drones on, you look around for %otherbrother% only to find him stepping out of the woman's home, the lady herself carrying a bit of... obvious warmth on her face. You retrieve your sellsword and leave before the old man lops your head with the most longwinded and one-sided conversation ever.
278ccbcc55a1afdd7b02.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]你觉得值得花点时间，便去看看。原来，老人修理井口遮盖用的木架时，架子突然散开，把他摔进了井里。你向下望去，他也正仰头看你，挥了挥手。%SPEECH_ON%喂，伙计们，我这下可泡进麻烦里了。仔细一想，真是泡着呢……%SPEECH_OFF%呃，是啊。%otherbrother%扔下绳子，老人绑在身上。你与佣兵合力，将那女人的祖父拉回干地。他握住你的手，热情道谢。%SPEECH_ON%他娘的，幸好你们来得及时，我差点屎尿一起吓出来。我跟你说，这可不是头一回掉井了。五年前修井盖时，也掉过一次。你瞧，那井盖老坏。其实也不算井盖，我们懒，就这么叫。以前我们叫它……井，嘿，井什么来着，我还真忘了。不过叫井盖也好，我这天灵盖底下，也快跟井一样空了！哈！风采不减当年！你知道，我年轻时可招人喜欢，只是如今没什么机会练嘴皮子。老婆十年前死了，再前头那个，二十个冬天前就跑了！说冬天，是因为她就在冬天走的。那年冷得厉害，我让她帮着劈柴，免得全家冻死。她说，一边照看孩子，一边还干这破活，她不干。我跟她有孩子，跟第二任也有，一共五个。一个死了，麻疹。另一个失踪了，多半也死了。我尽量不骗自己，可你知道，总还有点盼头。要是林子里随便遇见的陌生人，都能及时来救我，那没准我儿子也从与绿皮的那场仗里活下来了。不过，一点消息也没有。我时不时向旧神祈祷，连那个达夫库尔也拜。你知道达夫库尔吗？我还真拿不准该怎么看。有回来了个人，额头一道疤，说要带我走黑暗之路。我说，每回打盹，我都看见黑暗。那疤脸说，总有一天我醒不过来，我说，那好啊！哈！于是，那疤脸混蛋就开始生我的气……%SPEECH_OFF%他唠叨不休，你四下寻找%otherbrother%，却见他刚从女人家里出来，那位女士脸上还带着一抹……再明显不过的红晕。你领回自己的佣兵，赶在老人用史上最漫长的单方面谈话把你脑袋念掉之前，离开了。

3d2f776557c35ae79f57.source: Nobody's ever there to save me.

8c72a55491785359f008.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]The old man was doing repairs atop the wooden wellhead when it broke apart. Unfortunately, if you're standing atop a wellhead when it goes bust there's only one place to go: down. Very, very far down. As you look over the edge of the well, you can see the old man floating in a matter that is most unlively. %otherbrother% sidles up next to you and whispers, using a hand to keep his words from being heard.%SPEECH_ON%Uh, he's not moving.%SPEECH_OFF%An expertly observation, truly. You inform the lady of the man's passing. She purses her lips and asks that you remove the body anyway, explaning her reasoning rather succinctly.%SPEECH_ON%We can't be drinking his filth after all.%SPEECH_OFF%Fair enough. %otherbrother% manages to hook a rope-loop around the corpse and pull it up, its limbs dangling loosely like white washrags. He asks if she needs you to bury it, too. The woman wipes a tear and shakes her head.%SPEECH_ON%Nah. I'll bury that feller myself, weep over his grave tomorrow, and then get on with living.%SPEECH_OFF%
8c72a55491785359f008.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]老人站在井口的木架上修东西，木架却突然散了。可惜，人站在井架上时，脚下要是塌了，就只剩一个去处：往下掉。而且要掉很深，很深。你探头往井里看，见老人浮在水面上，那姿态怎么看都不像还活着。%otherbrother%悄悄挪到你身边，用手掩着嘴，低声说道。%SPEECH_ON%呃，他不动了。%SPEECH_OFF%真是行家般敏锐的观察。你把老人的死讯告诉那位女子。她抿起嘴，请你们无论如何也把尸体捞上来，理由说得简明扼要。%SPEECH_ON%我们总不能喝泡着他尸身的脏水吧。%SPEECH_OFF%有道理。%otherbrother%设法用绳圈套住尸体，把它拉了上来，四肢软软地垂着，像几条白色洗脸布。他问她是否也需要你们帮忙下葬。女人抹去一滴眼泪，摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不用。我自己埋了这老家伙，明天到他坟前哭一场，然后接着过日子。%SPEECH_OFF%

6d2f477799fb4fdded49.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]You decide it's worth your time and go and take a look. The wellhead, a wooden framework meant to cover its opening, has broken apart. Apparently, the old man was doing repairs atop it when this happened and so he plunged down into the well. He looks up at you.%SPEECH_ON%Oy' there, fellas. I'm in a bit of a pickle. I'm actually being pickled now that I think about it...%SPEECH_OFF%Eh, right. %strongbrother% throws down a rope. The old man ties it around himself. You and the sellsword pull the woman's grandfather up and back onto dry land. He shakes your hand and thanks you cordially.%SPEECH_ON%Farkin' hell, glad you came when you did, I was about to shit and piss like no other.%SPEECH_OFF%You talk with the old fella for a time, learning a lot about him. A while later, you realize %strongbrother% is nowhere in sight. Just as you think to start looking for him he steps out of the woman's home. She's glomming onto his muscles and being rather touchy feely.
6d2f477799fb4fdded49.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_91.png[/img]你觉得值得花点时间帮忙，便过去查看。井口原本架着遮盖用的木架，如今已经散了。显然，事发时老人正站在上面修缮，于是一头栽进了井里。他抬头望着你们。%SPEECH_ON%喂，伙计们。我这回算是泡在麻烦里了。仔细想想，都快泡成咸菜了……%SPEECH_OFF%呃，确实。%strongbrother%放下一根绳子，老人把它系在身上。你和佣兵一起把那女子的祖父拉上来，让他重新踩上干地。他握住你的手，热情地道谢。%SPEECH_ON%他娘的，幸好你们来得及时，我差点就要屎尿齐流了。%SPEECH_OFF%你和老头聊了好一会儿，对他了解了不少。过了一阵，你才发现%strongbrother%不见了。正想着去找，他却从女子的屋子里走了出来。她紧紧贴着他结实的身子，两只手很不安分。

dcdc8349c89a797a933f.source: Gonna be some strong lads roaming these part soon, no doubt...
dcdc8349c89a797a933f.translation: 看来用不了多久，这一带就要多几个壮小伙了……

68c5781271444013d469.source: %strongbrother%, you're strong. Give her a hand.

c42f30ca0171de008163.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{While stopped near a river of water, it appears %fisherman% went out to practice his old trade and netted a few fish! | You've come to a body of water and stopped to talk to a few locals about the surrounding land. %fisherman% the once-fisherman took that opportunity to go catch a few salmon and other river-running critters. | While marching near a river, %fisherman% the once-fisherman managed to run along the banks and collect a bucketful of crawdads! Boiled in a pot, they make for some good eats.}
c42f30ca0171de008163.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{河边停留时，%fisherman%似乎重操旧业，下网捕到了几条鱼！ | 你们来到一片水域，停下来向当地人打听周边情况。曾当过渔夫的%fisherman%趁机捉了几条鲑鱼，还有些河里的小东西。 | 沿河行军时，曾当过渔夫的%fisherman%顺着河岸跑了一趟，弄回来一桶小龙虾！下锅煮熟，又是一顿好饭。}

0007ba2d27cbf4efe7c9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%fisherman%, the ol' fisherman, regals the company with tales of his fishing days.%SPEECH_ON%{T'was this big. I swear on me mum! Fish so big that when I yanked it from the waters the whole river dried a foot! | The ocean is a beast, aye, and the skies above its master, the winds its leash, and we men the fleas. | Lost I was! A summer adrift, the whole boat run through with hunting waters, each wave having taken a sailor for itself until only I remained, aye, aye! Tis the truth! By autumn, I saw land again, and so happy I was to see the trees and the mountains and the birds that dwell above both that I smashed my ship right into the rocks and kissed the sands as debris drifted about me. T'was the happiest day of m'life. | Never seen a great white whale before, but a green one? Aye. Wore a coat of moss, a stolen land fur if nothing else. We hunted it down with spears and ol' sailor spirit. Alas, it realized we were on it when %randomname% - a man with the finest harpoon aim there is - struck it in the blowhole. I did not know a whale could turn 'round so quickly, but it did, and it made short work of our ship and drowned a number of sailors in a fit of vengenace. | I once caught a bass about, yeigh, big. Can you believe that? Alright, it was this big. Okay, maybe this big. Alright I've never caught a bass. Fine! I've never even seen a bass! I just know they're out there! Leave me alone you land lovers! I fish the big seas, dammit! I know nothing of your silly ponds. Except bass, of course, I know about them.}%SPEECH_OFF%
0007ba2d27cbf4efe7c9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]老渔夫%fisherman%向弟兄们讲起往昔捕鱼的故事，逗得众人兴致盎然。%SPEECH_ON%{就这么大！我拿我娘发誓！那鱼大得，给它拽出水的时候，整条河都浅了一英尺！ | 大海是头野兽，是啊。头顶的天空是它的主人，风是牵它的绳，而我们这些人，不过是跳蚤。 | 我迷航啦！整整漂了一个夏天，海水像追猎似的灌透全船，每一道浪都带走一个水手，最后只剩我一个。没错，没错！千真万确！到了秋天，我才重新看见陆地。看见树木、群山，还有在它们上空栖居的飞鸟，我高兴得直接把船撞上礁石，扑过去亲吻沙滩，碎木就在身旁漂。那是我这辈子最快乐的一天。 | 大白鲸没见过，可绿鲸？见过。它披着一身苔藓，简直是从陆地偷来的毛皮。我们靠长矛和老水手的胆气追上了它。可惜，%randomname%——那可是鱼叉掷得最准的人——一叉扎中了喷水孔，它这才发现我们骑在背上。我不知道鲸竟能转身那么快，可它就是转了，三两下便毁掉我们的船，发狠报复，淹死了好些水手。 | 我有次钓到一条鲈鱼，大概，喏，这么大。信不信？好吧，是这么大。行，也许这么大。好吧，我没钓过鲈鱼。行了！我连鲈鱼都没见过！我只知道肯定有这种鱼！别缠着我，你们这些旱鸭子！老子是在大海上捕鱼的！你们那破池塘里的事，我一概不懂。当然，鲈鱼除外，这我还是懂的。}%SPEECH_OFF%

78c8f113ea14ffc9140a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%farmhand% and %fisherman% are having a bit of an arm-wrestling contest. It's all in good fun, having apparently been borne out of an argument on whether fishermen or farmers are more important or whose food is best, that which walks the land or that which swims the oceans. With a long, salty belch, and singing with praise for some long-lost whale, the fisherman puts the last of his strength into the bout and pins %farmhand%'s arm. Both men get up and clap one another on the shoulders.
78c8f113ea14ffc9140a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%farmhand%与%fisherman%正在掰腕子。两人玩得开心，起因似乎是争论渔夫和农夫谁更重要，以及地上走的和海里游的，究竟哪种更好吃。渔夫打了个悠长、满是海腥味的嗝，又唱起歌，赞颂一头不知失踪多久的鲸鱼，最后使足力气，将%farmhand%的手臂压倒。两人站起来，互相拍了拍肩膀。

9ea51b068d828b883bff.source: None of us are born a mercenary.
9ea51b068d828b883bff.translation: 谁也不是生来就当佣兵的。

8620998859c1504a47ca.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%farmhand% and %fisherman% are having a bit of an arm-wrestling contest. It's all in good fun, having apparently been borne out of an argument on whether fishermen or farmers are more important or whose food is best or some such thing.
