With a long retelling of the history of his fathers tilling the soils of the land, %farmhand% puts the last of his strength into pinning %fisherman%'s arm. Both men get up and clap one another on the shoulders.
8620998859c1504a47ca.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%farmhand%与%fisherman%正在掰腕子。两人玩得开心，起因似乎是争论渔夫和农夫谁更重要、谁的食物更好，或类似的小事。%farmhand%滔滔不绝地讲着祖辈耕耘土地的历史，随即使出最后一把力气，将%fisherman%的手臂压倒。两人站起来，互相拍了拍肩膀。

e20ef8907a92c2c2cb36.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]The campfire shines bright, twisting the faces of men in flowing orange as though they themselves were of burning stock.

 It is here you find %monk% and %flagellant% talking to one another. Their discussion is, at first, an easy one. The monk pleads with the flagellant to set aside his whip. While you don't necessarily wish to step in, you can't help but agree that destroying your own body on a glorified gore-schedule is not the best way to live. But then the flagellant retorts with something that gives you both pause. It is a phrase so well crafted that to think it might justify the man's personal habits has you pushing the notion out of your head as fast as possible. Disturbing, too, was the ease with which he said it. That such a soothing voice could be so warmly bundled in that scarred husk of flesh. What could muster it?

 The monk stammers for a moment, but then puts his hands to the flagellant's shoulders, holding him to keep their eyes on one another. He whispers, words which tickle your ears, but don't pronounce themselves loud enough to have real meaning. You can only assume they are meant to, once again, persuade the flagellant to a better, less violent life.

 But, again, the flagellant begins to respond and so back and forth they continue to go.
e20ef8907a92c2c2cb36.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]营火明亮，流动的橙光扭曲着众人的脸，仿佛他们自己也是燃烧的柴薪。

 你在这里看见%monk%与%flagellant%正在交谈。起初，这场谈话并不难懂：修士恳求苦修者放下鞭子。你虽不一定想插手，却也不得不同意，按着一套被奉为神圣的流血日程摧残自己，实在算不上好活法。可苦修者随后的反驳，让你们都愣住了。那句话说得如此巧妙，竟似乎真能替他的所作所为辩护，你只得赶紧将这个念头赶出脑海。更令人不安的是，他说得那么从容：如此舒缓的嗓音，竟能温暖地藏在那具伤痕累累的皮囊里。究竟是什么支撑着它？

 修士结巴了一会儿，随后把双手放在苦修者肩上，扶住他，让彼此目光相对。他压低声音，话语轻轻掠过你的耳朵，却低得听不出真正的含义。你只能猜想，他仍在劝苦修者换一种更好、更少伤害自己的生活。

 可苦修者又开始回应，两人就这样，你一言我一语，继续谈了下去。

40b455db7a4f44a03298.source: This is fascinating. Let's see where it goes.
40b455db7a4f44a03298.translation: 有意思，看看接下来会怎样。

630150bd2a7d3a526f9c.source: Alright that's enough. We've got actual work to do.
630150bd2a7d3a526f9c.translation: 好了，够了。我们还有正事要做。

fcf9a75543cedd03168e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Deciding to let the men talk, you step away for a time. When you return, you find the flagellant sitting next to the monk. The two saw back and forth on a log, their hands clasped in prayer as whispers of heavenly words part their lips. You've no urge to get closer to hear what they are saying for it is a comforting sight in and of itself. While you have no dog in what way is best to appease the gods, you can't help but feel a little better seeing the flagellant put down his tools of self-torture.
fcf9a75543cedd03168e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你决定让两人自己谈，暂时走开。回来时，苦修者正坐在修士身旁，两人坐在原木上轻轻前后摇晃，双手交握祈祷，低声念着神圣的话语。你无意凑近听他们在说什么，光是这幅景象便令人宽慰。虽然你并不偏好哪一种取悦诸神的方式，可看见苦修者放下折磨自己的器具，心里还是轻松了些。

1cc10de393e0dab6eeb4.source: May the man find his peace now.
1cc10de393e0dab6eeb4.translation: 愿他如今能找到内心的安宁。

68f975d21d6b598643d0.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Deciding to let the men talk, you step away for a time.

When you come back, the monk is naked and bent over with tears in his eyes. His shape is craven, but his face is gutting as though this is always what he wanted. With a gulp of air he straightens up and flicks his wrist over his shoulder. The flagellant's whip is in hand and you hear the leather slap against the monk's back. He pulls the tool away and the sound of glass and barbs tearing flesh causes a ringing in your ears. The flagellant himself says nothing. He has set himself down by the monk's side. He stares out across the land, but there is hardly a shimmer of life in his eyes, though you certainly see the blood of his life leaving his backside as he treats himself to a beating.

You step away once more, but the grass beneath your feet doesn't have the same crunch to it and the air carries a copper scent. Little leather snickers follow you all the way back to your tent.
68f975d21d6b598643d0.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你决定让他们继续聊，先离开一会儿。

等你回来时，修士已脱得精光，弯着腰，眼里含着泪。他的身子怯懦地蜷缩着，脸上却满是令人心惊的痛楚，仿佛这正是他一直渴求的东西。他猛吸一口气，直起腰，手腕越过肩头一甩。苦修者的鞭子正握在他手里，你听见皮鞭抽在他背上的脆响。他往回一扯，玻璃和倒刺撕开皮肉的声音刺得你耳中嗡鸣。苦修者本人一言不发，已经在修士身旁坐下。他眺望远方，眼中几乎没有一丝生气；不过，随着他一鞭鞭抽向自己，你倒能清楚地看见鲜血正从他背上流走。

你又一次离开了，只是脚下青草的脆响似乎变了味，空气里也带上了一股铜腥气。皮鞭细碎的响声一路跟着你，直到你走回帐篷。

447d4c27ec1063898eca.source: A man left to torture himself can find the truest of horrors.
447d4c27ec1063898eca.translation: 一个人若是尽情折磨自己，真能尝到世间最深的恐惧。

306bb237989834502886.translation: 如今成为弃鞭的苦修者

d5ba394caccbc75aa588.source: is now a Monk turned Flagellant

d860c9ae062077b71171.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]%flagellant% the flagellant is found sitting cross-legged before a campfire. He's all alone save the millmoths fluttering dangerously close to the flames. Sensing your presence, he calls you over. You take a seat beside him and he smiles at you.%SPEECH_ON%I've become a better man since joining this company.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod as he surely has. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%I've bled for the gods a great deal, but my wounds... they are but scars now. I feel stronger than ever.%SPEECH_OFF%Again you nod, but then quickly ask if he is going to stop hurting himself. The man's eyes stare into the red-brimming embers. He shakes his head no.%SPEECH_ON%I will bleed for the gods until they say no more.%SPEECH_OFF%Wondering aloud, you ask if the gods have spoken to him at all. Without a pause the man shakes his head no again.%SPEECH_ON%They have not and so I shall bleed until their silence is broken or until I join them in the forever quiet.%SPEECH_OFF%
d860c9ae062077b71171.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]你发现苦修者%flagellant%独自盘腿坐在营火前，只有几只飞蛾在火焰边危险地扑腾着。察觉到你来了，他招呼你过去。你在他身旁坐下，他朝你微微一笑。%SPEECH_ON%自从加入战团，我已比过去长进了许多。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，他确实如此。他接着说道。%SPEECH_ON%我为诸神流了很多血，但那些伤口……如今都成了疤痕。我觉得自己从未这样强健过。%SPEECH_OFF%你又点了点头，随即问他，是否打算停止伤害自己。男人凝视着泛红的余烬，摇头否认。%SPEECH_ON%我会为诸神流血，直到祂们说够了。%SPEECH_OFF%你忍不住问，诸神究竟有没有对他说过话。男人毫不迟疑，再次摇头。%SPEECH_ON%没有。所以我会一直流血，直到祂们打破沉默，或是我前去与祂们同归永恒的寂静。%SPEECH_OFF%

ce78b2589e8cf33f2e08.source: So time does heal all wounds, then.
ce78b2589e8cf33f2e08.translation: 看来，时间还真能治好一切伤口。

a13f41459010899c250e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%otherguy% approaches with a pained look on his face. His helmet is in hand as he wipes his brow.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, uh, you should come and see this.%SPEECH_OFF%You inquire as to what it is you are going to see.%SPEECH_ON%I don't have the words for it. You'd best come and see with your own eyes.%SPEECH_OFF%You look down at your work - plotting the march for the coming days - but, judging by the look on the brother's face, it can wait.
a13f41459010899c250e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%otherguy%神情难受地走来，一手拿着头盔，一手抹额头。%SPEECH_ON%团长，呃，你最好过来看看。%SPEECH_OFF%你问到底要看什么。%SPEECH_ON%我说不出来，你还是亲眼看看吧。%SPEECH_OFF%你低头看看手头的工作——接下来几日的行军路线——再看看这弟兄的脸色。路线可以稍后再定。

ce7c6181dd4f0eecad23.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]You get up and have him lead you to whatever it is that's causing an issue. You come across a throng of brothers circled around something or someone. Breaking your way through the crowd, the company quiets as you come into the clearing to find %flagellant_short% the flagellant unconscious on the ground.

His back is stripped raw and you think you can even see a rib or two. Thorns have broken off his brutish whip, embedding themselves in his flesh, and his skin hangs in strands where it hangs at all. It is good he has passed out. Not because he would be horrible in pain, but because you think he might not otherwise have stopped. You order the men to clean him up, dress his wounds, and hide his tools of misery.
ce7c6181dd4f0eecad23.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]你站起身，让他带你去看看究竟出了什么事。一群弟兄围在那里，不知围着的是人还是东西。你挤进人群，众人随之安静下来。空地上，苦修者%flagellant_short%已经昏死过去。

他的后背被抽得血肉模糊，你甚至觉得能看见一两根肋骨。凶狠鞭具上的尖刺折断后嵌在肉里，仅剩的几片皮肤也成条地垂着。幸亏他晕过去了。倒不是因为痛苦难忍，而是你觉得，若没失去知觉，他恐怕根本不会停手。你命人替他清洗、包扎伤口，再把那些折磨自己的家伙什藏起来。

d5452efbd10943b299ae.source: At least he didn't kill himself.

fc0cd6b77ab1fd07f90b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]Flesh torn asunder. Parts of man rendered unfamiliar. A copper stench in the air. These are the things you find when beckoned by a brother's call.

 %flagellant% the flagellant stooped over on a stump, his whole body unmoving save for his arm which flicks a glass and thorn-peppered whip against his own back. A gargling belch draws your eyes to %weakbro% who is bent over in the tall grass losing his lunch. Sensing that he is disturbing the others, %flagellant% cracks something of a smile that doesn't falter an inch to the horror he's committing to his own hide.%SPEECH_ON%Fear not the reaper, %weakbro%, I shall bleed even more in favor of saving your soul.%SPEECH_OFF%
fc0cd6b77ab1fd07f90b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]皮肉绽裂，肢体已难辨原貌，空气里弥漫着铜锈般的血腥味。你应着一个弟兄的呼喊赶来，看见的便是这幅景象。

 苦修者%flagellant%弓身坐在树桩上，浑身一动不动，唯有一条胳膊不断挥舞，将嵌满碎玻璃与尖刺的鞭子抽向自己的后背。一阵翻涌的干呕声将你的目光引向%weakbro%，他正弯腰趴在高草里，把午饭吐得一干二净。察觉到自己惊扰了旁人，%flagellant%露出一丝近似微笑的表情。即便鞭子正把自己的皮肉抽烂，那笑容也没有丝毫动摇。%SPEECH_ON%别怕死神，%weakbro%。为了拯救你的灵魂，我愿流更多的血。%SPEECH_OFF%

7a8db7b7eab713d30b78.source: {A strange custom. | This can't be healthy.}
7a8db7b7eab713d30b78.translation: {真是怪异的习俗。 | 这样可养不好身子。}

279e4e2a24b285496c21.translation: 这些本来还能派上用场……

cdaa57a9c4a4a03a57c2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{While pulling inventory duty, %randombrother% alerts you to a bit of dire news: a good sum of food has gone bad. Simple and to the point, you nod and thank him for telling you quickly. | %randombrother% comes to you rubbing his jaw. He says he almost broke his teeth on a bit of bread. Apparently he found the piece at the bottom of a food crate and it appears to have been sitting there for some time. You take a sword to the loaf, chopping it in two as a few brothers cheer with sarcastic bravado. Taking up the halved bread, you show the men the insides: a dark core of black. That's what your stomach will look like if you eat this, you say before throwing the bread into the bushes where you can hear it tumbling like a heavy stone.}
cdaa57a9c4a4a03a57c2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{%randombrother%在清点物资时向你报了个坏消息：不少食物已经变质。他说得简明扼要，你点点头，谢他及时告知。 | %randombrother%揉着下巴来找你，说自己吃面包时差点崩了牙。那块面包是他从食物箱底翻出来的，看样子已经放了很久。你抽剑将面包劈成两半，几个弟兄故意喝彩，夸你神勇。你拿起半块面包，向众人展示里头漆黑的芯，说谁要吃了这东西，肚子里也会变成这样。说完，你把它扔进灌木丛，听着它像块沉重的石头一样滚落。}

2f59155be72aab9600c7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{While pulling inventory duty, %randombrother% alerts you to a bit of dire news: a good sum of food has gone bad. Simple and to the point, you nod and thank him for telling you quickly. | %randombrother% yelps and leaps up off the log he was sitting on. You walk over to see he's thrown a fish by the wayside and he can't stop pointing at it. While he warns you to not go near it, you decide to go near it. Apparently a water-spider had birthed a clutch of eggs inside the fish's abdomen. You now stare at the little spiderlings bubbling forth in a cloud of scuttling legs and bodies.

Throwing the entire lot into a fire, you ask the brother to check the rest of the fish. Unfortunately, they are all in a similar state and nobody is willing to replace fish-food for spider-food.}
2f59155be72aab9600c7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{%randombrother%在清点物资时向你报了个坏消息：不少食物已经变质。他说得简明扼要，你点点头，谢他及时告知。 | %randombrother%尖叫一声，从坐着的圆木上跳起来。你走过去，只见他把一条鱼扔在路旁，指着它说个不停。他警告你别靠近，你偏要过去看看。原来，一只水蜘蛛在鱼腹里产了卵。此刻，小蜘蛛正成群往外涌，密密麻麻的细腿与身体乱爬，像冒出一团活物的云。

你把整堆东西扔进火里，让那弟兄检查余下的鱼。可惜，其他鱼也差不多，没人愿意把吃鱼改成吃蜘蛛。}

d7ab3ea23adeda83d0b8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{While pulling inventory duty, %randombrother% alerts you to a bit of dire news: a good sum of food has gone bad. Simple and to the point, you nod and thank him for telling you quickly. | You sift through a few crates of foodstuffs to find an entire carton of apples covered in what looks like grey fur. %randombrother% has a word for it, but you've never heard it before. Regardless, none of it can be salvaged and you toss the rotten fruit away.}
d7ab3ea23adeda83d0b8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{%randombrother%清点物资时，带来一个坏消息：不少食物坏了。他说得简短直白，你点点头，感谢他及时禀报。 | 你翻查几箱食物，发现整整一箱苹果都长了像灰毛般的东西。%randombrother%说了个名称，你却从没听过。总之，一个也救不回来，你把这些烂果子全扔了。}

9f79e25931a9494a8ca8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{While pulling inventory duty, %randombrother% alerts you to a bit of dire news: a good sum of food has gone bad. Simple and to the point, you nod and thank him for telling you quickly. | Maggots wriggle about a few chunks of meat. Your men stare at the food, some looking as though they're willing to risk a bit of illness to have a bite. You tell everyone off and get rid of the meat personally before someone does something stupid.}
9f79e25931a9494a8ca8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{%randombrother%清点物资时，带来一个坏消息：不少食物坏了。他说得简短直白，你点点头，感谢他及时禀报。 | 几块肉上爬满蛆虫。弟兄们盯着食物，有些人的神情像是宁肯病一场也要尝上一口。你把众人赶开，亲自扔掉烂肉，免得有人犯蠢。}

96ead546bcc85c3bff83.source:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]While pulling inventory duty, %randombrother% alerts you to a bit of dire news: a good sum of food has gone bad. Simple and to the point, you nod and thank him for telling you quickly. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]Childish giggling wakes you from a nap. You rise up to see that some of the food is gone and the only evidence as to where it departed is a field of still moving tall grass. Thinking fast, you take up a sword and follow its trail. Unfortunately, it isn't long before you are lost in the midst of enormous stalks of green that pedal against your face with every rush of wind. The giggling doesn't stop, however, and you hear the pitter-patter of footsteps cross behind you and then in front. A voice speaks, sounding like a child deep in a well.%SPEECH_ON%Chase us! Over here! Chase us! Chase us... CHASE US. CHASE US NOW!%SPEECH_OFF%You suddenly feel no urge to retrieve the grain. You slowly put your sword back in its sheath and back out of the field. As you stare into the tall grass, it begins to part, slowly, like a piece of leather being torn at the seams. You hear horrible cries as each stem cracks in half.

%randombrother% startles you when he asks what it is you're doing. You turn to look at him, then turn back to the field which sways gently to a breeze. Instead of answering, you just tell him to get ready as you'll be marching again very soon. Thankfully, the mercenary does not inquire about the missing food.}
96ead546bcc85c3bff83.translation:
{[img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]%randombrother%清点物资时，带来了一个坏消息：相当一部分食物已经变质。他说得简明扼要，你点点头，感谢他及时告知。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_36.png[/img]一阵孩童般的嬉笑将你从午睡中吵醒。你起身一看，发现有些食物不见了，唯一的线索，是一片仍在晃动的高草。你立即提剑，循着动静追了进去。可没过多久，你便迷失在高大的绿茎之间，每有风吹过，草叶就拍打你的脸。嬉笑声却没有停。细碎的脚步一会儿从身后掠过，一会儿又到了前头。一个声音响起，像是井底深处传来的童声。%SPEECH_ON%来追我们呀！在这儿！来追呀！追我们……追我们。现在就来追！%SPEECH_OFF%你忽然一点也不想找回粮食了。你慢慢将剑插回鞘中，退出草丛。你望着高草，它们开始缓缓分开，仿佛一张皮革正沿接缝被撕裂。每根草茎断裂时，都发出可怕的哭叫声。

%randombrother%开口问你在做什么，吓了你一跳。你转头看他，再望向草地，草叶只是在微风中轻轻摇摆。你没有回答，只叫他做好准备，很快就要重新上路。幸好，他没有追问食物去了哪里。}

4e26278ab91db313f4e6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img] {%forestlover% looks up at the forest canopy, his hand playfully strumming through the lightfalls. He looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%I used to play through these forests as a kid.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, then wonder aloud.%SPEECH_ON%I thought you were born outside %randomtown%?%SPEECH_OFF%%forestlover%'s hand falls and he stares at the ground.%SPEECH_ON%Oh yeah, that's right. Well, we should get moving then, right?%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can say anything more, the red-faced man marches on. | You find that %forestlover% appears to be in better spirits lately. As it turns out, these forests are familiar to him and a return to their greenery has the man beaming with warm nostalgia. | Even though you've marched through plenty of forests, this one's viridscapes has you impressed. No doubt %forestlover% is loving a return to the trees' thick domain. | Trees, fat trunks and strong-limbed, rise above you. %forestlover% seems to be mesmerized by their towering. You find the man smiling all the time lately, as though a return to the forest is a return to better times.}
4e26278ab91db313f4e6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img] {%forestlover%仰望林冠，伸手拨弄着垂落的光束，像在抚琴。他看向你。%SPEECH_ON%我小时候常在这些林子里玩。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，随即有些疑惑。%SPEECH_ON%你不是生在%randomtown%城外吗？%SPEECH_OFF%%forestlover%放下手，低头看着地面。%SPEECH_ON%噢，对，是这么回事。唔，咱们该继续走了，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及再说什么，他便红着脸赶路去了。 | 你发现%forestlover%近来精神好了不少。原来，这些森林让他十分熟悉，重新回到绿荫间，温暖的怀旧之情便写满了他的脸。 | 虽然已经穿过不少森林，眼前这片苍翠景色仍让你印象深刻。毫无疑问，%forestlover%很高兴能重返这浓密的林木天地。 | 树木高耸在你们头顶，树干粗壮，枝条遒劲。%forestlover%似乎被这巍峨的景象迷住了。近来，你总能看见他微笑，仿佛回到森林，就是回到了更美好的岁月。}

a1a2e9c2a724cd62aea4.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{%gambler% and %nongambler% walk up to mottled with bruises. It appears they've been in a bit of a scuffle. Seeing as how neither one is dead, you don't really care what it was over, but they tell you anyway.

Apparently the gambler took some money in a bit of sly cardsmanship. You ask either man if the company's money was involved. They say no. You ask what the hell they want from you then. | A game of cards comes to a table-flipping end when %nongambler% jumps off his stool and launches a tirade at %gambler%. The professional gambler looks around with sheepish incredulity. How could such a man come into so much money over a game of cards, he asks, but when his hands go up to feign confusion a few 'extra' cards slip out of his sleeves. The ensuing battle is amusing, but you put a stop to it before anyone gets seriously hurt.}
a1a2e9c2a724cd62aea4.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]{%gambler%和%nongambler%带着满身青紫走来，显然刚打过一架。既然谁也没死，你其实懒得管缘由，可他们还是讲了起来。

原来，赌徒靠一点牌桌上的小手段赢走了钱。你问，有没有动用战团的公款？两人都说没有。那他们到底找你干什么？ | 一场牌局以掀桌收场。%nongambler%从凳子上跳起来，冲着%gambler%破口大骂。职业赌徒故作无辜，带着尴尬与难以置信的神色四下张望，问自己怎么能一场牌就赢这么多钱。可他刚举起双手装糊涂，袖子里便滑出几张“多余”的牌。随后那场扭打倒很有趣，不过赶在有人受重伤前，你还是叫了停。}

ab0b294edd2c306b44ca.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]You pass through a wall of shrubs and find yourself stopped by quite a sight. To call it a tree would seem insulting. The trees about it are so low beneath their neighbor they appear to be bending at midtrunk, swearing fealty to that which is arboreally suzerain, a domain rippled with roots as thick as any man, and enough shade above to lose time between the days and night.

 You walk to the base of the enormity and run a hand along its bark, but then you stop, fearing that your flesh may have just trespassed upon holy ground like a child tumbling playfully into a church of one wholly quiet crowd. %monk% the monk comes to your side nodding and with his hands firmly behind his back.%SPEECH_ON%This is a godtree. The roots go through the earth and into the realm of the gods. It is said they once listened, but now... we are not so sure.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at the man, and his particularly withheld posture, and ask if he fears the tree. He smiles at you and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I respect it like a man would the sea, for the waters of the oceans hold many things to fear and, yet, the sailor sails anyway. Were the ocean a docile beast, would man refer to it so lovingly?%SPEECH_OFF%
ab0b294edd2c306b44ca.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你穿过一道灌木墙，被眼前的景象惊得停下脚步。仅仅称它为一棵树，仿佛都是冒犯。周围的树木在它面前如此矮小，像是从树干中段弯下腰，向这位林木之王宣誓效忠。它的领地上，树根隆起如波，每条都粗得抵得上一个人；上方浓荫遮天，足以让人忘记昼夜的交替。

 你走到这庞然巨物的根部，伸手抚过树皮，却又停住，生怕血肉之躯刚刚擅闯了圣地，像个嬉闹的孩子，一头滚进满座寂然的教堂。修士%monk%走到你身边，点着头，双手牢牢背在身后。%SPEECH_ON%这是神树。它的根穿过大地，直达诸神的国度。据说，诸神曾借此聆听，可如今……我们也说不准了。%SPEECH_OFF%你看着他，尤其是他那刻意克制的姿态，问他是否害怕这棵树。他微笑着摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我敬畏它，就像人敬畏大海。海水中藏着许多可怕的东西，可水手照样扬帆。若海洋只是头温顺的野兽，人们还会如此深情地谈起它吗？%SPEECH_OFF%

33ace7e5ea8aa94029a1.source: Saw a godtree with his own eyes

f8c527169a2b0c8e43f6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img] You find %glutton% helping himself to a third helping of food. That's far too much and so you demand that it be his last. Another brother joins in, mocking the man for his habits. The glutton, enraged, slams his food down and stands up. His stomach however, sways at a different pace than the rest of him and the rather fattened man goes down in a heap of flailing limbs. While the rest of the company has a laugh, you can't help but wonder if the sellsword really has gotten too fat.
f8c527169a2b0c8e43f6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]你发现%glutton%已经在拿第三份饭。这未免太多，你勒令他吃完这份就停。另一个弟兄也凑过来，嘲笑他的贪吃。饕餮者怒气上涌，把食物一摔，霍然起身；可肚皮晃动的节奏却跟身体其余部分不合拍，这个明显发福的家伙顿时手脚乱舞，摔成一团。全团都在笑，你却不禁琢磨，他是不是确实太胖了。

e6e51a3e7604dfa3a248.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{You find a dead goblin. But it's no ordinary goblin - this is an elder. He or she's showing signs of dying of old age. There's also ceremonial trinkets all about it. This here goblin didn't get here by accident: it died and received a proper burial. Which means only one thing: you're in those damned greenskins' territory. | You come across a dead dog on a hillside. Its tongue hangs out, its eyes almost ready to pop from the skull. A number of darts are sticking out of its fur. %randombrother% plucks one and looks at the tallowed tips of metal.%SPEECH_ON%Goblin poison.%SPEECH_OFF%You inquire as to why the dog, though. The man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%A scared dog makes for good target practice, I suppose.%SPEECH_OFF% | A wreath of odd and discolored flowers, weeds, and tree limbs. Amongst them, dozens of large beetles rattle as their shells bump into one another. They seem to be feasting on the sap or other oddity seeping from the vegetative collection. %randombrother% wonders aloud.%SPEECH_ON%I think I've seen one of these before. It's some sort of marking.%SPEECH_OFF%You glance at him.%SPEECH_ON%We need to be keeping an eye out for bored spinsters or something?%SPEECH_OFF%The man shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Naw. This here is a goblin's fabrication. We're in their land now.%SPEECH_OFF% | While marching through the land, you come across a dead orc. He seems almost unhurt, as though you'd stumbled across him sleeping. But when you get a closer look, you spot almost a dozen small darts sticking out of his side. You immediately get a good look at your surroundings, then turn to your men.%SPEECH_ON%Step carefully, men, we're in goblin territory now.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find a number stones arranged into a circle. In the middle of this oddity is a human skull with its top cut away. Inside the brainpan are a number of what appear to be dice and chicken bones. Such shamanistic designs aren't found by accident - you're in goblin lands. | You come across a dead deer ensnared by a horrifying trap. It would have all the markings of an ordinary trap - one that intends to kill via spikes - were it not for the obvious poison tips it came laden with. Poison that is unique to one group only: goblins. Best step carefully from now on. | A smoldering fire. Sticks and stones arranged for this or that. One standing armory stocked with blowguns. Curved blades. And one dead wolf pup with a leash around its neck. Having observed this evidence, you quickly inform the men of what circumstances are before them.%SPEECH_ON%This is goblin territory, men, and by the look of things they aren't far, either.%SPEECH_OFF% | A litter of dead wolf pups. Their open-bellied mother is by them, a collar around her neck. There's a line of gore trailing away from the scene, some tiny footsteps in the grass.%SPEECH_ON%The goblins been gettin' more of their mounts.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% is by your side. He points at the pups.%SPEECH_ON%They say the gobbos like the wild ones. They look for the freshest litters and only take the strongest.%SPEECH_OFF%All you're hearing is that you are in goblin territory. You advise the men to keep a close eye on their surroundings, lest the tricky gits get the drop on you.}
e6e51a3e7604dfa3a248.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{你发现一具地精尸体。不过，这不是普通地精，而是一位长老。看起来，无论雌雄，它都是老死的，身旁还摆着仪式用的小饰物。它并非偶然倒在这里，而是死后得到了正式安葬。这只意味着一件事：你们已踏入那些该死绿皮的领地。 | 你在山坡上遇见一条死狗，舌头耷拉着，眼珠几乎要从头骨里突出来。皮毛上插着许多小镖。%randombrother%拔下一支，查看涂着油膏般物质的金属尖。%SPEECH_ON%地精的毒。%SPEECH_OFF%你问，可为什么要杀狗？那人耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%受惊的狗，拿来练准头挺合适吧。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个由古怪变色的花、杂草与树枝编成的环。里面几十只大甲虫互相碰撞，甲壳咔哒作响。它们似乎在啃食这堆植物渗出的汁液，或其他怪东西。%randombrother%自言自语。%SPEECH_ON%我好像见过这个。是一种标记。%SPEECH_OFF%你瞥他一眼。%SPEECH_ON%所以，我们得小心无聊的老姑娘之类的？%SPEECH_OFF%那人摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不，这是地精做的。我们进它们的地盘了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 行军途中，你遇见一个死去的兽人。它几乎看不出伤，仿佛只是睡着了。可凑近一看，侧腹插着将近一打细小吹镖。你立刻仔细环顾四周，随后转向弟兄们。%SPEECH_ON%小心走，弟兄们，我们进地精领地了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你发现几块石头围成一个圈，中间摆着人类头骨，颅顶已被切去。颅腔里放着一些像骰子和鸡骨头的东西。这种萨满仪式的布置，可不会凭空出现。你们到了地精的地盘。 | 你遇见一头死鹿，困在可怕的陷阱里。若非那些尖刺明摆着淬了毒，它本该只是个寻常的刺杀陷阱。那种毒，只属于一个群体：地精。往后的路，最好格外小心。 | 一堆尚在冒烟的火。棍棒与石头摆成各种用途的形状。一座直立武器架，放满吹管。弯曲的刀刃。还有一只死去的幼狼，脖子上系着绳。看过这些证据，你赶紧告诉弟兄们眼下的处境。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，这是地精的地盘。看这模样，它们离得也不远。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一窝死去的幼狼，旁边是开膛破肚的母狼，脖子上套着项圈。一路血污从现场延伸出去，草间留着细小的脚印。%SPEECH_ON%地精又在弄坐骑了。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%站在你身旁，指了指幼狼。%SPEECH_ON%听说，那帮小绿皮喜欢野生的。专找刚下崽的窝，只带走最壮的。%SPEECH_OFF%你听出的重点，只有你们正身处地精领地。你叫弟兄们紧盯四周，免得被狡猾的混蛋偷袭。}

1a34cbe81fcfbe61bdf5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{You watch as the men chow down on plates about as colorful as the men's personalities. Supplying the company with such a diverse stock of food has raised their spirits as good as any victory! | A hot meal is what any man needs, but a hot meal, with a couple of sides and entrees? Well, that's something else entirely! Your purchases of diverse foods has the men gleefully chowing down and feeling good about life. | Food as diverse as any nobleman's - or close enough, anyway. That's what you have supplied the company and the men are supremely appreciative as they chow down.}
1a34cbe81fcfbe61bdf5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_61.png[/img]{你看着弟兄们大快朵颐，盘里的饭菜五颜六色，正如他们各不相同的性情。给战团备下如此丰富的食物，提振士气的效果丝毫不亚于一场胜仗！ | 谁都需要一顿热饭，可要是热饭之外，还有主菜和几样配菜呢？那可就是另一回事了！你买来的各色食物让弟兄们吃得欢天喜地，连日子都觉得有了盼头。 | 战团的伙食已经能和贵族比一比，至少也相差不远。这都是你备下的，弟兄们吃得痛快，心里也感激得很。}

0826535a0df7b1c081ce.source: Very much appreciated the food variety
0826535a0df7b1c081ce.translation: 对丰富的伙食格外满意

4787ff19a7bf55a08d91.translation: 对丰富的伙食感到满意

2154e79b6b7116d00b20.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]The weather is nice. A fine evening, if any, for the moon to be where it is: an orange rind of it slipping in and out of the clouds - clouds that pass by on the seemingly innocuous gesture that a light breeze can have. So bright is this rim of a moon you wonder if any flowers might bloom, mistaking the evening light for its brighter cousin. You wonder if the millmoths and flies and armor-backed beetles see the moon and dance toward it as they would any candle or torch. Do they have that quiet desperation? That inescapable cruelty of realizing that, when your stock is placed against the greater whole, you have and are nothing... and the hatred that realization can bring, and the jealousy...

Suddenly, %graverobber% the graverobber appears by your side, his smell skewering your thoughts with miasmic proficiency. He's hardly a man at all, but a golem, mudslaked and grass-peppered with two white eyes peering out. Sighing, you ask what he wants. He thumbs over one shoulder, the other occupied by a shovel.%SPEECH_ON%Went digging through a grave or three. Found somethin' and I don't mean just what them graves are for. Wanna come take a look?%SPEECH_OFF%Of course you do...
2154e79b6b7116d00b20.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]天气很好。若要挑个适合月亮高挂的夜晚，今夜便再好不过：橙色的月牙像一瓣薄皮，时而滑进云里，时而露出来。云朵则随着轻风挪移，那姿态看上去毫无恶意。月缘明亮得让你怀疑，会不会有花朵错把这暮夜的光当成更耀眼的日光，就此绽放。你又想，飞蛾、苍蝇和披甲般的甲虫看见月亮，会不会也像追逐蜡烛或火把那样，朝它飞舞？它们是否也有那种无声的绝望？当你将自己放到浩瀚万物面前，发现自己一无所有，也微不足道，那份无从逃脱的残酷；以及随之而来的憎恨、妒忌……

突然，盗墓贼%graverobber%出现在你身旁，他身上的恶臭像瘴气利箭，一下刺穿了你的思绪。他几乎已不像个人，倒像一具泥塑的魔像，浑身糊满烂泥，撒着草屑，只有两只眼睛露出白光。你叹了口气，问他要什么。他一边肩上扛着铲子，另一只手的拇指朝身后一指。%SPEECH_ON%刚去挖了一两座坟，也可能三座。找着点东西，不是坟里本来就该装的那种。要来看看吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你当然要看……

d890c2eeb8f1cf8d2b6a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%graverobber% brings you to a big hole in the ground. The top half of a skeleton is at the bottom, its arms loose over the earth as though it had bedded there for a night's rest. Empty eye sockets look up at you. The graverobber crouches and grabs something. He wipes the mud and worms off it and hands it over.%SPEECH_ON%I think we can use that.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, but tell the man to quickly fill the grave before anyone sees what he's done.
d890c2eeb8f1cf8d2b6a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]%graverobber%把你带到一个大坑旁。坑底露着半具骷髅，双臂松松搭在土上，像是躺在那里歇了一宿；空洞的眼窝正对着你。盗墓贼蹲下，拿起一件东西，擦去泥土与虫子，递过来。%SPEECH_ON%我想，这东西用得上。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，却也叫他赶紧把坟填好，别让人发现他干了什么。

bd5e9d94ed30102bb4d8.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]While looking down at the goods, %historian% the rather astute scholar and historian sidles up next to you. He's rubbing his chin and a faint hum ruminates deeply within him.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, yes...%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to him to ask what he's going on about. He snaps his fingers and points down at what the graverobber had found. He explains that this isn't just any chest plate or weapon, but indeed the gear of a famous fighter, nobleman, and womanizer, %noblename%.
bd5e9d94ed30102bb4d8.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你低头打量物件时，颇为敏锐的历史学者%historian%挪到身旁，摸着下巴，喉间发出沉思的低吟。%SPEECH_ON%对，对……%SPEECH_OFF%你转头问他在念叨什么。他打了个响指，指向盗墓贼的收获，解释这不是寻常胸甲或武器，而是%noblename%的装备——那人既是著名战士与贵族，也是个风流浪子。

741889b0a9635f113255.source: Let's fetch %historian% the Historian, he'll know about buried treasure.
741889b0a9635f113255.translation: 去叫历史学者%historian%来，他懂这些埋在地下的宝物。

ce45f3eb67673699071e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%graverobber% the grimy graverobber enters your tent with his hands behind his back. You don't wish to delay what madness has been brought before you much longer, so you go ahead and ask what the man wants.%SPEECH_ON%Sir... I've... I've gotten word that a local baron - a wealthy man, indeed! - has been recently put to rest in a graveyard not far from here.%SPEECH_OFF%Leaning back in your chair, you give the man a shrug. He continues.%SPEECH_ON%I... I don't wish to ask the other men to help, for they look at me like some sort of horrid thing. But you... you're different. You hired me after all.%SPEECH_OFF%You lean forward, drawing your armor taught and the chair beneath you to a groaning wooden whine.%SPEECH_ON%Let me guess: you want me to help you dig up this baron's grave.%SPEECH_OFF%The man grins, a pathetic sight, one that reminds you of the time you scolded a dog for stealing a biscuit.
ce45f3eb67673699071e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]脏兮兮的盗墓贼%graverobber%背着双手走进帐篷。你不愿再等他慢吞吞地说出这回又有什么疯主意，索性直接问他想干什么。%SPEECH_ON%长官……我……我听说，一位本地男爵——可有钱了！——最近刚安葬在离这里不远的墓地。%SPEECH_OFF%你向椅背一靠，耸了耸肩。他继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%我……我不想找其他弟兄帮忙，他们看我的眼神，像在看什么可怕的东西。可您……您不一样，毕竟是您雇了我。%SPEECH_OFF%你向前倾身，盔甲随之绷紧，身下木椅发出吃力的呻吟。%SPEECH_ON%让我猜猜，你想让我帮你挖这位男爵的坟。%SPEECH_OFF%那人咧嘴一笑，模样可怜巴巴，让你想起从前训斥一条偷饼干的狗时，它露出的神情。

17d3bc6234e6577c6263.source: I'm not going to, and neither are you.

61bdd6875bcacdcf4c07.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Having excused yourself from the excavating expedition, you get back to work. Time flies, millmoths arcing in rote loops about a candle that droops lower and lower, its glassy flame so easily flicked to the wingbeats of the creatures about it. Finally, %graverobber% returns, heaving a bit of a chest into the tent. He looks more mud than man.%SPEECH_ON%I got it, sir!%SPEECH_OFF%The graverobber quickly looks behind himself, then says again, his voice a bit quieter this time.%SPEECH_ON%I got it... I got all of it. Look, I'll split it with you. I mean, you didn't help me avoid the watchman, or shovel up the earth, or drag the body out, or drag the chest out, or put the coffin back in its place, or put the dirt back on the coffin, or avoid the watchman a second time, or drag the chest all the way into camp... but you did let me do it!%SPEECH_OFF%
61bdd6875bcacdcf4c07.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你婉拒了同行挖坟，继续处理自己的事。时辰飞逝，飞蛾绕着蜡烛反复盘旋，烛身越来越短，明亮的火苗随着翅膀扇动轻轻摇曳。终于，%graverobber%回来了，费力将一只箱子拖进帐篷。他浑身泥浆，几乎看不出人样。%SPEECH_ON%长官，到手了！%SPEECH_OFF%盗墓贼迅速回头张望，又压低声音说了一遍。%SPEECH_ON%到手了……全到手了。您看，我跟您分。虽说您没帮我躲守夜人，没帮我挖土，没帮我拖尸体，也没帮我搬箱子、把棺材放回原处、把土填回去、再躲一次守夜人，或者把箱子一路拖回营地……不过，您准许我去干了呀！%SPEECH_OFF%

32128670d67da6bebb20.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Having excused yourself from the excavating expedition, you get back to work. Time flies, millmoths arcing in rote loops about a candle that droops lower and lower, its glassy flame so easily flicked to the wingbeats of the creatures about it. Finally, %graverobber% returns, the first sign of him the edge of your tent flap moving just so. You set your quillpen down and ask the man to enter. He does so, rather tentatively, as a man about to cross a threshold he'd rather not. Even in the dim candlelight you can see the colors darkness is so ordinarily good at hiding: purples and blues and dark reds. He grins sheepishly.%SPEECH_ON%They, uh, caught me sir.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, I can see that.%SPEECH_OFF%The man quickly raises a finger, a slop of mud flying waywardly into nowhere but a wet sound.%SPEECH_ON%But next time!%SPEECH_OFF%You stop the man with a raised hand.%SPEECH_ON%How about you go get patched up and then we'll talk about this 'next time', yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%
32128670d67da6bebb20.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你谢绝了这趟挖坟的邀约，回去继续办事。时间飞逝，飞蛾绕着蜡烛一圈圈打转，烛身越烧越短，晶亮的火苗随着周围振翅的微风轻轻摇晃。终于，%graverobber%回来了。帐篷门帘的边角微微一动，最先透露了他的到来。你放下羽毛笔，叫他进来。他犹犹豫豫地迈过门槛，仿佛实在不愿踏进这里。即便烛光昏暗，你仍看清了那些平时能被黑夜掩去的颜色：青一块、紫一块，还有暗红的血迹。他难为情地咧嘴笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%他们，呃，把我逮住了，长官。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，看得出来。%SPEECH_OFF%他赶紧竖起一根手指，一团稀泥随之甩飞，不知落到哪儿，只听见湿漉漉的一声。%SPEECH_ON%可下次一定！%SPEECH_OFF%你抬手打断他。%SPEECH_ON%先去包扎一下，再来谈你这个“下次”，怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%

0c3afed68fb8bd2464f8.source: And see that you don't fling anymore mud around on your way out.
0c3afed68fb8bd2464f8.translation: 出去的时候留神点，别再弄得到处都是泥。

1c503560e1f9a97d4439.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%townname% is not the pillar upon which you wish to sacrifice your good standing in the world - or at least, what good standing a mercenary can have. You tell %graverobber% that not only will you not be accompanying him, but that you refuse to let him go off and do this alone. He pouts like a young hunter whose bow has been taken away by an angry father.%SPEECH_ON%Well... alright then... I suppose it was only riches...%SPEECH_OFF%
1c503560e1f9a97d4439.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你不想为了%townname%这点事，葬送自己在世上的好名声——至少是佣兵还能拥有的那点名声。你告诉%graverobber%，不但不会陪他去，也不许他独自行动。他撅起嘴，活像一个被愤怒父亲没收了弓的小猎人。%SPEECH_ON%那……好吧……反正也不过是些财宝……%SPEECH_OFF%

8431bd466760d63f4ee6.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You and %graverobber% stalk low through the bushes, a gangly duo of absurdity, silhouettes murky and ruminating of obvious hijinks even in the darkest of nights. The two of you enter the graveyard as though you were to happen about it by accident, merrily pretending that what is to unfold next would surely not come from two stranges such as yourselves.

 About the graveyard are rows and rows of gray slabs and marbled statues with no faces and black iron gates that hee-hawed in the wind. Tall grass everywhere, fertilizer in abundance. Flowers homegrown and others laid down from elsewhere, and some a bit of both.

Pursing his lips, the graverobber turns about. He stabs his shovel into the ground and puts his fists to his hips.%SPEECH_ON%Goddammit.%SPEECH_OFF%Sensing something off, you ask what's wrong. He spits and answers.%SPEECH_ON%I can't 'member if it is that grave, that one, or that one.%SPEECH_OFF%He points to three different sites: one is a modest little stone, bleached and balded to commemorate a death; another is gated with gothic spires; another is but a door to a mausoleum. The graverobber turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%We probably don't have much time here, which grave you think it be?%SPEECH_OFF%
8431bd466760d63f4ee6.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你和%graverobber%弓着身子，在灌木间潜行。这两个瘦高家伙凑成的荒唐搭档，即便在最漆黑的夜里，那两道模糊轮廓也透着明摆着要干坏事的鬼祟。你们装作偶然路过，走进墓园，煞有介事地假装接下来要发生的事，绝不会与自己这两个陌生人有关。

 墓园里，一排排灰色石碑、没有面孔的大理石雕像和漆黑铁门错落分布，铁门在风中发出驴叫般的怪响。高草四处丛生，肥料想必是不缺的。花有自己长出来的，也有别人从外面带来的，还有些两者兼有。

盗墓贼抿着嘴，转了一圈，将铲子插进土里，双拳叉腰。%SPEECH_ON%真他娘的。%SPEECH_OFF%你察觉不对，问怎么了。他啐了一口，答道。%SPEECH_ON%我记不清是那座坟，还是那座，还是那座了。%SPEECH_OFF%他接连指向三处：一处只有块朴素的小石碑，被风雨磨得发白光秃，记着一个人的死；一处围着尖顶铁门；另一处则只露出陵墓的入口。盗墓贼转向你。%SPEECH_ON%咱们在这儿恐怕待不了太久。你觉得是哪座？%SPEECH_OFF%

04a81f72feae26b24d68.source: We'll dig up the motley grave.
04a81f72feae26b24d68.translation: 我们挖开那座杂乱的坟墓。

6a3d90f5f4e7e76e3d16.source: We'll break past the gothic fence.
6a3d90f5f4e7e76e3d16.translation: 我们翻过那道哥特式围栏。

256f0a7b75a4d7ba9d60.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]With a swift crack of your spade, the gothic gate is broken open. The twang of metal on metal is sent grumbling between the gravestones and swaying tree branches seem to snicker at your rather loud trespass. When you swing the gate open, the hinges squall as if they themselves were awakened spirits. You enter the little square plot and lean against the spires of the fence. A short order gets %graverobber% to work while you keep a look out like a man unimpressed by the nature of his own crimes. Some minutes of scrupulous shoveling later and the robber of graves is finished. What ends up being found is a very large coffin that has no hopes of being dragged out of the ground, not with just two men anyway.

 Using the same manner with which you dealt the gate a blow, you break the latches off the casket and throw it open. A freshly-dead man stares back up at you, two stones painted with eyes rolling away from his sockets. The sight startles you, but you quickly start rifling through the dead man's baggage. As it turns out, %graverobber% was right: the man was buried with great satchels of gold and goblets and golden goblets. You take it all, close the casket, and sneak back out of the graveyard.
256f0a7b75a4d7ba9d60.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你挥铲猛地一砸，撬开那扇尖拱铁门。金属相撞的嗡鸣在墓碑间低低回荡，摇曳的树枝仿佛也在窃笑，讥讽你这场动静过大的擅闯。你推开门，铰链尖叫起来，像是它们自己成了被惊醒的亡魂。你走进这块方正的小墓地，倚着围栏尖顶，简短地吩咐%graverobber%动手，自己则负责望风，对亲手犯下的罪行颇不以为意。几分钟仔细挖掘后，盗墓贼干完了活。下面露出一口极大的棺材，根本别想拖出土坑，至少只靠两个人不行。

你用刚才对付铁门的办法，砸断棺材上的扣锁，掀开棺盖。一个刚死不久的男人仰面望着你，两颗画着眼睛的石头从眼窝上滚落。这景象让你一惊，但你很快便翻起死者的随葬物。事实证明，%graverobber%说得没错：陪他下葬的，有整袋整袋的金子，有高脚杯，还有金高脚杯。你们全都收走，合上棺材，悄悄溜出了墓园。

fae7cb4dfdc04dec78c2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You enter the mausoleum like a man fearful that the door behind him might forever snap closed. The coffin rests on a slab of marble with candles burning about its four corners. While there was no wind outside, you can't help but hear a faint moan of it circling about the room. Shaking away your fears, you and %graverobber% push the casket's lid off, careful not to let it drop off the otherside and presumably wake half the town.

 Inside the sarcophagus, you find a man attired in a knight's clothing: a helmet, chest plate, and shield. His sword crosses his body from neck to groin, his hands clasped around the handle in a battle-ready embrace. You look to %graverobber% who shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Suppose this fella was a knight.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. The graverobber glances from dead man to living.%SPEECH_ON%Suppose... this knight don't need that stuff no more...%SPEECH_OFF%Seeing as how you don't plan to leave empty handed, you nod again. The dead knight puts up quite the fight as %graverobber% struggles to free him of that which he no longer needs. After a few minutes of battle, you lend a hand in removing the helmet. What falls out is a great bundle of blonde hair. %graverobber% steps back.%SPEECH_ON%That's a woman!%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly, voices rise up from outside the graveyard. You grab all the things you can and tell the graverobber to start running.
fae7cb4dfdc04dec78c2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你走进陵墓，心里直犯嘀咕，生怕身后的门突然合上，再也打不开。棺椁放在大理石台上，四角点着蜡烛。外面明明无风，墓室里却仿佛有微弱的风声盘旋呜咽。你甩开惧意，与%graverobber%一起推开棺盖，小心不让它从另一侧滑落，否则怕是半个镇子都会被惊醒。

 石棺里躺着一人，穿戴着骑士的行头：头盔、胸甲，还有盾牌。一把剑自颈部纵贯到胯下，双手紧握剑柄，仿佛随时准备迎战。你看向%graverobber%，他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%看来这家伙是个骑士。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。盗墓贼的目光从死人移到活人身上。%SPEECH_ON%看来……这位骑士也用不上这些东西了……%SPEECH_OFF%你可不打算空手而归，于是又点了点头。要剥下这些死者已不再需要的东西，却颇费周折，%graverobber%简直像在跟死骑士搏斗。折腾几分钟后，你也搭手帮忙摘下头盔。一大蓬金发随之散落。%graverobber%后退一步。%SPEECH_ON%是个女人！%SPEECH_OFF%这时，墓地外突然响起人声。你抓起尽可能多的东西，叫盗墓贼赶紧跑。

74069b6b81aeb97b392a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]Just as you take your shovel into hand, a man's voice calls out to you.%SPEECH_ON%Just what in the hell do you think y'all are doing?%SPEECH_OFF%You wheel around to see a man lighting a lantern. He holds it up, the handle creaking as it swivels back and forth.%SPEECH_ON%Y'all look like graverobbers to me.%SPEECH_OFF%%graverobber% unsheathes a knife from his belt. The watchman unsheathes a bell from his own belt, a large, rotund instrument that glistens gold on the side of the lantern's light and white on the side of the moon's.%SPEECH_ON%Come after me ye may, but not before I give this here bell a good ringing. Then the next bell you'll hear shall toll for thee.%SPEECH_OFF%You grab %graverobber% by the collar and tell him to leave. There's no sense in causing trouble. The watchman barks at you as you depart.%SPEECH_ON%I'll remember yer faces! Like a kicked dog knows the boot that done did it, I'll remember yer faces!%SPEECH_OFF%
74069b6b81aeb97b392a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你刚把铲子拿到手里，就听见一个男人冲你们喊道。%SPEECH_ON%你们他娘的想干什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你猛地转身，看见一个男人点亮了提灯。他将灯举起，灯身前后摇晃，把手吱呀作响。%SPEECH_ON%我瞧你们就是盗墓的。%SPEECH_OFF%%graverobber%从腰带上拔出刀。守夜人也从自己的腰带上取出一件东西——一只硕大的圆铃，迎着灯光的一侧闪着金色，映着月光的一侧则泛着银白。%SPEECH_ON%尽管来追我，可在那之前，我准能把这铃铛摇个痛快。到时候，你们再听到的，可就是给自己送葬的丧钟了。%SPEECH_OFF%你揪住%graverobber%的衣领，叫他走人。没必要惹麻烦。你们离开时，守夜人仍在身后吼叫。%SPEECH_ON%我记住你们的脸了！就像挨踢的狗认得那只靴子一样，我记住你们的脸了！%SPEECH_OFF%

d52353bc40eacdc601b1.source: Was forbidden to rob a grave

64dff2b7462776d34d77.source: Had no success robbing a grave with you
64dff2b7462776d34d77.translation: 与你一起盗墓，却一无所获

eb5466012bda49a0897c.source: Found treasure while robbing a grave

e2bdeaadd55b867ca20d.source: You and your men attempted to rob a local grave
e2bdeaadd55b867ca20d.translation: 你和手下曾试图盗掘当地坟墓

2165c808b1892945cf0b.source: Was caught trying to rob a grave
2165c808b1892945cf0b.translation: 试图盗墓时被抓了个正着

f44df31613ed5549f445.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]After burying a dead comrade, %gravedigger% pitches his shovel into the earth and grabs %graverobber% by his tunic, driving him backward as he lifts him into the air. Before even a word or threat can be exchanged, the dangling man throws a kick into his attacker's groin. They both fall to the ground and immediately start tumbling about in the mud. The muck makes them indistinguishable, but their fit of anger is well heard.

The gravedigger climbs on top of the graverobber and starts piling mud into his opponent's face.%SPEECH_ON%What'd I tell ya, huh? What'd I say about thievin' from those who can't see your grimy little hands comin', huh?%SPEECH_OFF%With a nice little reversal that suggests this isn't his first time wrestling in the mud, the graverobber throws his assailant off and clambers atop him. He grabs great big piles of grass and grime and shoves it into the gravedigger's face. Bizarrely, the graverobber thinks it's time to make his case.%SPEECH_ON%It only be his shoes! It only be his gloves! Dead needn't be walkin' or pickin' things up, let 'em be mine I say!%SPEECH_OFF% Ah, it appears that the gravedigger and graverobber have come across a mild difference on what goes into the ground and what shant come back out. You let them work through their troubles - there is little harm to be done between the two of them and it is making good entertainment for the rest of the company, anyway.
f44df31613ed5549f445.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]刚埋葬一位死去的战友，%gravedigger%便把铁锹往地上一插，一把揪住%graverobber%的衣襟，将他提离地面，逼得他不断后退。还没来得及争吵或放出狠话，双脚悬空的家伙便一脚踹中对方裤裆。两人一同倒地，立即在泥里扭打起来。泥浆糊得谁也认不出谁，可怒骂声听得一清二楚。

掘墓人骑到盗墓贼身上，抓起泥巴往他脸上糊。%SPEECH_ON%我跟你说过什么，嗯？那些人连你伸来的脏手都看不见，别偷他们的东西！我是不是这么说的，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%盗墓贼一个漂亮的翻身，把对手掀了下来，反骑到他身上，熟练得显然不是头一回在泥地里摔跤。他抓起大把草叶和污泥，往掘墓人脸上塞。奇怪的是，他竟觉得这会儿正适合讲道理。%SPEECH_ON%不就是双鞋嘛！不就是副手套嘛！死人又不用走路，也不用拿东西，给我用怎么了！%SPEECH_OFF% 啊，看来这两位对什么该埋进土里、什么不该再拿出来，存在一点小小的分歧。你让他们自行解决——两人也伤不到哪去，何况还给其他弟兄添了不少乐子。

bcd729f196f4dc7ed279.source: Just don't fall into the grave.

c5c904951b35cc8593a9.source: You'll get what we agreed upon and no more.
c5c904951b35cc8593a9.translation: 说好多少就是多少，一个子儿也不多。

7bb487ea6d5f3faf49f3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{You agree to %bro%'s terms. He's very unsurprisingly happy about it and you get on with your day. | %bro%'s demands aren't too much and you are happy to fork him a few extra crowns a day. He gives you a handshake. It's firm, but not too firm. | %bro% wavers on his feet as he readies for your answer. You tell him to relax as you've agreed to his terms. He finally sighs in relief.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sir. I thought I might have to, I dunno.%SPEECH_OFF%You raise an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%I hope that wasn't a threat.%SPEECH_OFF%The man awkwardly laughs and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%No, no of course not!%SPEECH_OFF% | You tell %bro% you'll increase his pay under one condition: he do a little dance.%SPEECH_ON%A victory dance?%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Any dance.%SPEECH_OFF%He raises his arms and swings them a little. You burst into laughter.%SPEECH_ON%No number of kills would amount to whatever that was.%SPEECH_OFF%The man snickers.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sir.%SPEECH_OFF% | You agree to give %bro% a higher wage.%SPEECH_ON%It would be my privilege.%SPEECH_OFF%The man raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%Spare me the ceremony. I'm here to kill, let's not dance around it.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod.}
7bb487ea6d5f3faf49f3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{你答应了%bro%的条件。他果然高兴得很，而你继续处理当天的事务。 | %bro%的要求不算过分，你也乐意每天多付他几个克朗。他和你握了握手，力道结实，却不过分用力。 | 等待你答复时，%bro%站得有些不安稳。你让他放松，告诉他，你已经答应了。他终于如释重负地叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢，长官。我还以为自己得……唉，我也说不清。%SPEECH_OFF%你挑起眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%但愿这不是威胁。%SPEECH_OFF%男人尴尬地笑着，连忙摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不，不，当然不是！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你告诉%bro%，给他加薪可以，只有一个条件：跳支小舞。%SPEECH_ON%庆祝胜利的舞？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%什么舞都行。%SPEECH_OFF%他举起胳膊，晃了几下。你放声大笑。%SPEECH_ON%杀再多人，也抵不上刚才这一出。%SPEECH_OFF%男人也跟着嘿嘿笑了。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢，长官。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你同意提高%bro%的薪水。%SPEECH_ON%这是我的荣幸。%SPEECH_OFF%男人挑起眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%省了这些客套吧。我是来杀人的，咱们别绕弯子。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。}

18ff823c6427b327b135.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{You decline %bro%'s request. He purses his lips, wrings his hands, then nods, turns and leaves. The silence is a bit harsh, but the message well received: he ain't a happy man. | Declining %bro%'s request leads to a sudden outburst.%SPEECH_ON%Well, fark this shit. I'll still fight fer ya, but don't expect the best out of me!%SPEECH_OFF%You nod, but tell him he'd be dead without putting forth his best, so you'll get what you want regardless. | %bro% winces when you decline the suggestion.%SPEECH_ON%Alright then, I see how this place is run. In we go, out we go. No matter to you, right? We're just the pawns you use to get what you want. That's fine. That's absolutely fine.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns and leaves. You get the feeling it is not at all 'fine.' | You tell %bro% that you do not agree with his estimations of how much he should get paid. He responds with a few swears with an estimated volume of 'loud.' When he's finished, he nods.%SPEECH_ON%But that's alright. I get the business. And I'm sure you understand that you get why I must look after the business that is myself, too.%SPEECH_OFF% | %bro% presses for more pay, but you put your foot down.%SPEECH_ON%You'll get what we agreed upon, no more.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods and then slowly back out of the tent.%SPEECH_ON%As you say, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%}
18ff823c6427b327b135.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{你拒绝了%bro%的要求。他抿紧嘴唇，搓了搓双手，随后点头，转身离开。这片沉默有些难熬，意思却很清楚：他很不高兴。 | 你拒绝了%bro%的要求，他当即发起火来。%SPEECH_ON%去他娘的！我还是会替你打仗，不过别指望我卖力！%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，告诉他，打仗不卖力就是个死。如此说来，你想要的终究还是能得到。 | 听见你拒绝，%bro%的脸绷紧了。%SPEECH_ON%行吧，我算看明白这里怎么回事了。招进来，送出去。你根本不在乎，对吧？我们就是让你得偿所愿的棋子。行，完全没问题。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身离开。你觉得，这恐怕很有“问题”。 | 你告诉%bro%，对他该拿多少薪水，你与他的估价不同。他回敬了一串脏话，音量大致可归为“震耳欲聋”。骂完，他点点头。%SPEECH_ON%不过没关系。生意嘛，我懂。那你肯定也能明白，我也得照顾好我自己这门生意。%SPEECH_OFF% | %bro%坚持要涨薪，你却寸步不让。%SPEECH_ON%说好多少，你就拿多少，一分不加。%SPEECH_OFF%他点头，慢慢退出帐篷。%SPEECH_ON%听您的，长官。%SPEECH_OFF%}

7e817f971cc7a2592ad6.source: We can't always get what we want.

5f1b7fc60698e85e8692.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%raider% is sitting out beside the campfire, his eyes set deep into the flames. A few moments ago, a couple of the men were heard yelling at him. A past as a raider isn't winning the man many friends. The hedge knight, %hedgeknight%, walks over and stands there beside him. As the two exchange glances, you're suddenly worried a fight you can't stop is going to break out. Instead, the hedge knight takes a seat. He speaks calmly, though his deep voice is still soundly scary.%SPEECH_ON%You raided coasts, yes? Killed women and children? Stole from the clergy?%SPEECH_OFF%The raider nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, and worse.%SPEECH_OFF%%hedgeknight% picks up a chunk of smoldering wood from the fire. He crushes it in his hand, the flames hissing into ash and smoke. He lets it crumble out of a calloused palm.%SPEECH_ON%You shouldn't mind what others say, raider. This is a nasty, hungry world, and you mind its teeth well. Let the weak cry out and die. We can only armor ourselves by our very being, wreathed in the envy of the dead who would gladly crush an infant's skull for a mere sip of the breath our lungs draw.%SPEECH_OFF%The raider grabs his own chunk of firewood and grinds it up. They shake hands and say nothing more.
5f1b7fc60698e85e8692.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%raider%坐在营火旁，目光深陷火焰。就在片刻之前，你还听见几个弟兄冲他吼叫。曾为劫掠者的经历，没能替他赢得多少朋友。流浪骑士%hedgeknight%走过来，站在他身旁。两人交换眼神时，你突然担心，一场连你也拦不住的恶斗就要爆发。可骑士只是坐下，平静地开了口，尽管那低沉的嗓音仍很吓人。%SPEECH_ON%你劫掠过海岸，对吧？杀过妇孺？抢过神职人员？%SPEECH_OFF%劫掠者点头。%SPEECH_ON%是，还干过更坏的。%SPEECH_OFF%%hedgeknight%从火里捡起一块阴燃的木头，攥在手中捏碎。火焰嘶嘶作响，化为烟与灰，碎屑从满是老茧的掌心散落。%SPEECH_ON%劫掠者，别在意别人怎么说。这世界卑劣而饥饿，你能躲过它的獠牙，就已经做得很好。让软弱的人去哭、去死吧。我们只能凭自己的本性披上铠甲，周围尽是死者的妒意。那些死人只要能再尝一口我们肺里的气，叫他们砸碎婴儿的头骨，他们也会乐意。%SPEECH_OFF%劫掠者也拿起一块燃烧的木头，将它碾碎。两人握了握手，没再说话。

169aa0b15f68a719b417.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%nonhedgeknight% sprints into your tent, nearly taking out one of the stakes and bringing the whole thing down. Sweat flies off his face and onto your maps. You look at the man with a stare that demands a good answer for what he's doing. He explains that the hedge knights %hedgeknight1% and %hedgeknight2% are getting into it. They've both picked up weapons and look about ready to kill each other. Having the two largest men in the company do battle probably isn't best for the health of... well, everyone. You quickly rush to the scene.
169aa0b15f68a719b417.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%nonhedgeknight%冲进帐篷，差点撞掉帐桩，让整顶帐篷塌下来。汗水从他脸上甩到你的地图上。你盯着他，等一个足以解释这副样子的理由。他说，两个流浪骑士%hedgeknight1%与%hedgeknight2%闹起来了，双方都抄起了兵器，眼看要拼个你死我活。战团里最魁梧的两个人开打，对……嗯，对所有人的安危都不是好事。你连忙赶去现场。

0930327c2baade085062.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]You find %hedgeknight1% with a great sword in hand and %hedgeknight2% is twirling a giant axe around like a child would a stick. Most of the men have cleared out. %nonhedgeknight% explains that the two {have unfinished business from a jousting tournament | met before on the battlefield, on opposite sides, and now look to continue a battle long past | seek to end a dispute between them by the old tradition of mortal combat}. Another brother steps forward, begging that the hedge knights put their differences aside, but %hedgeknight2% throws him out of the way. Golems of might and terror that they are, perhaps it is wise to seek an end to this confrontation?
0930327c2baade085062.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]你看见%hedgeknight1%手握巨剑，而%hedgeknight2%挥舞着一柄巨斧，轻巧得如同小孩耍木棍。大多数弟兄早已躲远。%nonhedgeknight%解释说，这两人{在一场马上比武大会里结下了梁子，至今还没了结 | 从前曾在战场上分属敌对双方，如今打算把那场早已结束的仗继续打下去 | 想按古老的规矩，以生死决斗解决彼此的争端}。另一个弟兄上前，恳求他们放下恩怨，却被%hedgeknight2%一把甩开。这两个家伙简直是力量与恐怖铸成的巨像，或许还是设法让他们停手为妙？

4a2a870349938b21897b.source: Listen to me, save yourselves for the battlefield!
4a2a870349938b21897b.translation: 听我的，把力气留到战场上！

238b0ff8f014ddb9e54c.source: A thousand crowns to both of you to stop this madness now!
238b0ff8f014ddb9e54c.translation: 每人一千克朗，立刻给我住手！

ef6c19138f675abad891.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]%nonhedgeknight% calls out to you, asking you to stop the fight. The two hedge knights look over, each breath heaving their massive chests. You throw a dismissive hand. The knights nod and charge one another. The clash is loud, metal-shattering, bone-crunching. Growls follow every attempt to kill, so sonorous become the weapon swings. The sword catches the shaft of the giant axe and the two blades snap against one another. The hedge knights exchange cruel stares over the crossing, then quickly disarm and pull daggers, stabbing each other repeatedly as they fall to the ground. Neither man seems the least bit bothered by the wounds. They give up on the pitiful daggers and turn to using their own mitts, punching each other so fiercely you see teeth scattering amongst the bloodsprays.

Again, the company looks to you for guidance as it is becoming readily obvious that these men seek to fight to a finish.
ef6c19138f675abad891.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]%nonhedgeknight%朝你喊话，求你阻止决斗。两名流浪骑士望过来，宽厚的胸膛随着呼吸剧烈起伏。你不以为意地挥挥手。骑士们点头，随即冲向彼此。撞击声震耳欲聋，混着金属崩裂与骨骼碎响。每一次杀招都伴着低吼，兵刃挥动也愈发沉重响亮。长剑架住巨斧的柄，两刃锵然相抵。两人隔着交错的武器狠盯对方，随即弃械拔匕首，一边跌向地面，一边接连刺向彼此。伤口似乎丝毫没让他们在意。他们又嫌小刀不过瘾，改用双拳，打得如此凶猛，你看见牙齿随着血沫四处飞溅。

众人再次望向你，等你拿主意。这两个人显然是要不死不休。

5e43c1f33e327ce634bf.source: This is getting out of hand. Everyone, stop them!
5e43c1f33e327ce634bf.translation: 闹得太过火了。所有人，把他们拉开！

e3515b55a3596d4f778e.source: Let's see who is strongest in battle.

61a4c81a999be4857ed7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]The two hedge knights stand there, eyes only on their opponent and with no regard to your words, each breath heaving their massive chests. A short moment and they charge one another. The clash is loud, metal-shattering, bone-crunching. Growls follow every attempt to kill, so sonorous become the weapon swings. The sword catches the shaft of the giant axe and the two blades snap against one another. The hedge knights exchange cruel stares over the crossing, then quickly disarm and pull daggers, stabbing each other repeatedly as they fall to the ground. Neither man seems the least bit bothered by the wounds. They give up on the pitiful daggers and turn to using their own mitts, punching each other so fiercely you see teeth scattering amongst the bloodsprays.

The company looks to you for guidance as it is becoming readily obvious that these men seek to fight to a finish.
61a4c81a999be4857ed7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]两名流浪骑士站在那里，眼里只有对手，对你的话充耳不闻，宽厚的胸膛随着呼吸剧烈起伏。片刻后，他们冲向彼此。撞击声震耳欲聋，混着金属崩裂与骨骼碎响。每一次杀招都伴着低吼，兵刃挥动也愈发沉重响亮。长剑架住巨斧的柄，两刃锵然相抵。两人隔着交错的武器狠盯对方，随即弃械拔匕首，一边跌向地面，一边接连刺向彼此。伤口似乎丝毫没让他们在意。他们又嫌小刀不过瘾，改用双拳，打得如此凶猛，你看见牙齿随着血沫四处飞溅。

众人望向你，等你拿主意。这两个人显然是要不死不休。

d8b30fb51541b348c05f.source: %monk% the monk! Can you find a peaceful resolution?
d8b30fb51541b348c05f.translation: 修士%monk%！你能让他们和平解决吗？

fa1fdf6e8ff283ebe7a0.source: %monk% the monk, can you find a peaceful resolution?
fa1fdf6e8ff283ebe7a0.translation: 修士%monk%，你能让他们和平解决吗？

848e4886c6017f7f45ea.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]You bring out a satchel heavy with coins. The two hedge knights look over, the sound of gold clinking against itself hard to miss.%SPEECH_ON%A thousand crowns to each of you, yeah?%SPEECH_OFF%The men exchange a glance. They shrug. You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, but this isn't happening again, understand?%SPEECH_OFF%The men nod too, walking over and accepting the crowns with shameless ease. Some brothers look a little miffed that these men just got free money for essentially choosing not to fight. The hedge knights begrudgingly find peace amongst themselves, being more concerned with counting money than killing each other. You just hope they got an equal amount lest the 'festivities' resume.
848e4886c6017f7f45ea.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]你取出一只沉甸甸的钱袋。金币碰撞的叮当声实在难以忽视，两个流浪骑士都望了过来。%SPEECH_ON%每人一千克朗，行了吧？%SPEECH_OFF%两人对视一眼，耸了耸肩。你点头道。%SPEECH_ON%好，但下不为例，明白吗？%SPEECH_OFF%两人也点头，走过来收钱，坦然得毫无羞耻之心。有些弟兄颇为不满：这两人不过是答应不打架，居然就能白拿钱。流浪骑士们勉强言和，比起杀死对方，眼下还是数钱更要紧。你只希望他们分到的一样多，免得这场“热闹”重新上演。

5a72a1c8f332200a013a.translation: 但愿这回真能消停下来。

b601a093989b87bfdc0a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]Having seen enough, you order the men to intervene. They hesitate, but you quickly remind them of their contractual duties. The men grab great tarps of leather and blankets and some pots and pans and a few carry buckets. Their strategy is sound: buckets are slammed over the heads of the hedge knights, blinding them just long enough to throw everything else over them. As a man would wrestle a bull, the men tangle with the hedge knights, occasionally being thrown into the air, and one brother eats a kick to the face, suffering a black-gapped smile for his troubles. Another is swallowed up in the mass of blankets, being smashed in between the growling hedge knights like an amorphous blob of anger.

Eventually, the two men cool down and the battle is over. They begrudgingly make peace, lest you have the rest of your men pick up real weapons to end the scuffle. The rest of the company recovers, picking themselves up as though a great tornado had just torn through the camp. You take account of the injuries and begin distributing aid.
b601a093989b87bfdc0a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]你看够了这场闹剧，命令弟兄们上前拉架。他们有些迟疑，你立刻提醒他们，拿了钱就得听命。弟兄们取来大片皮革篷布、毯子和锅碗瓢盆，还有几人提着桶。他们的办法倒也不错：先把桶扣在流浪骑士头上，趁两人看不见，再一股脑把其余东西盖上去。弟兄们像在搏牛般与两名骑士扭作一团，时不时就有人被抛到半空。一个弟兄脸上挨了一脚，咧嘴时多了道缺牙的黑豁口；另一个则被卷进毯子堆，夹在两个怒吼的骑士中间，挤得不成人形，只剩一团怒气。

最终，两人总算冷静下来，争斗也结束了。他们勉强言归于好，免得你叫其他弟兄拿起真家伙来平息这场斗殴。其余人东倒西歪地爬起来，营地里活像刚被龙卷风扫过。你清点伤员，开始安排救治。

248db65d44781e222895.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]You set yourself down on a stump and watch the rest of the fight. The men roll around on the ground, smashing each other in the face with punches that would kill a horse. Eventually, %hedgeknight1% squats on %hedgeknight2%'s shoulders. Seeing a rock nearby, %hedgeknight1% grabs it and cracks it over his opponent's skull. A bit of flesh is sheared off, revealing a slop of red and white beneath. The rock is brought down again. The brain pan splinters, shards of bone rupturing into fragments. %hedgeknight2% goes a bit limp, showing only a modicum of fight left in him. %hedgeknight1% punches his fist into the brainbox and rips out the namesake in one big gush of crimson. You gag at the sight, and a few men turn and vomit.

%hedgeknight1% gets to his feet and throws his trophy into the tall grass. He wipes his forehead and says only one word.%SPEECH_ON%Finished.%SPEECH_OFF%
248db65d44781e222895.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]你在树桩上坐下，继续看这场决斗。两人在地上翻滚，用足以打死马的重拳猛砸对方的脸。最后，%hedgeknight1%骑上%hedgeknight2%的肩头。发现旁边有块石头，%hedgeknight1%抓起来，狠狠砸向对手头颅。皮肉被削掉一块，露出底下红白相间的烂糊。石头再次落下，颅骨裂开，骨片崩碎。%hedgeknight2%身子软了些，只剩一点挣扎的力气。%hedgeknight1%把拳头捣进破开的脑壳，猛地扯出大脑，鲜血顿时涌出。你看得直犯恶心，几个弟兄转身吐了。

%hedgeknight1%站起身，把战利品扔进高草，抹了抹额头，只说了一句话。%SPEECH_ON%完事了。%SPEECH_OFF%

8986b322553e8fa1df46.source: A death in battle for %hedgeknight2%, at least.

32a50dea350217a0ee8c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]You look to set yourself down on a nearby stump but jump back when the two hedge knights come barreling your way. %hedgeknight1%'s head smashes face first into what was to be your seat. He quickly turns around to face his assailant. All he meets is %hedgeknight2%'s boot, the interfacing of flesh and leather sounding off with a sickening clap. Now gargling on his own teeth, %hedgeknight1% asks if that's the best %hedgeknight2%'s got. To answer, %hedgeknight2% kicks him in the head again and again, and each rearing of his boot reveals %hedgeknight1% to be in a worse state, from bloodied red to a nightmarish twisting of flesh and eyelids and a flattened nose and a grin of horror where his teeth are either missing or hanging from blood engorged gums like they were nails on a skinless finger.

Finally, the brainpan is crushed, the series of splintering boneplates sounding like something falling through a winter tree's branches. You turn your gaze in abhorrence, but some brothers cannot, one spews vomit. Peeking to see what damage was done, you see %hedgeknight2%'s heel is halfway down a throat and the toe of his boot is churning another man's brain. He curses as he struggles to retrieve what delivered the killing blow.

The surviving hedge knight has to pull on his thigh to help yank his foot out of the brainpan. Turning around, he drags his foot across the grass and picks his heel up like a child coming in after a day's play, looking intently to make sure there was no mess to be dragged in after him. He peels off a slug of brain matter and throws it aside like he just shucked some corn. Rubbing his belly, he asks if anyone's hungry before grabbing a plate of grits and heading back to his own tent.

Later in the night, after you've put down a short-lived plot to have the man eliminated for the safety of the company, you find %hedgeknight2% sleeping like a baby.
32a50dea350217a0ee8c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]你正想坐到附近的树桩上，两名流浪骑士却猛冲过来，逼得你跳开。%hedgeknight1%的脸迎面撞在你原本要坐的位置。他赶紧翻身，面对袭击者，迎来的却只有%hedgeknight2%的靴子。皮肉与皮革相撞，发出令人作呕的脆响。%hedgeknight1%含着自己碎掉的牙齿，咕哝着问，%hedgeknight2%就这点本事吗？作为回答，%hedgeknight2%一次次踢向他的脑袋。靴子每抬起一回，%hedgeknight1%的模样便更惨几分：先是满脸鲜红，继而皮肉与眼皮扭曲得如同噩梦，鼻子塌陷，咧开的嘴骇人至极。牙齿不是缺失，就是挂在充血的牙龈上，像无皮手指上的指甲。

终于，颅骨被踩碎了，骨板接连迸裂的声音，像有什么从冬日的树枝间一路坠下。你厌恶地移开目光，有些弟兄却挪不开眼，其中一人吐了出来。你又瞥了一眼，只见%hedgeknight2%的脚跟已陷入对方喉中，靴尖正在搅动脑浆。他一边咒骂，一边试着拔出那只完成致命一击的脚。

活下来的流浪骑士不得不扳住大腿，帮着把脚从颅腔里拔出来。他转身，在草上蹭了蹭脚，随后抬起脚跟细看，像玩了一天回家的孩子，确认不会把脏东西带进屋。他剥下一团脑浆，随手扔开，仿佛只是剥掉玉米皮。接着，他揉揉肚子，问有没有人饿了，便端起一盘粗粮粥，走回自己的帐篷。

夜深时，有人短暂谋划过，为战团安全除掉此人，你已将这念头压了下去。随后，你发现%hedgeknight2%睡得像个婴儿。

1ff750a677df2a2a2fe7.source: A death in battle for %hedgeknight1%, at least.

d51998cd0bbbf6f1a66f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]The monk nods, stepping forward and calmly walking between the two men. His hands are raised, the fingers trailing to and fro as they mimic the shapes of old religious rites. He speaks of the gods and how they judge men for what they are and what they do. He says that some gods might find this battle favorable, but that most would not. Most of all, though, the monk says that if they truly wish to fight, then there is plenty of room for that after they die. However, if they kill one another, the loser is given great prestige in the afterlife, and the winner will not, for this violence serves no purpose than to give the victor pride. Surprisingly, this oddity in religious rules calms the men down. The monk invites them to talk more and they do so, the three walking off, hands gesticulating, backs arching in bellowing laughter. As for the rest of the company, they just seem happy nobody got killed.
d51998cd0bbbf6f1a66f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]修士点点头，平静地走到两人之间。他举起双手，手指来回划动，重现古老宗教仪式中的手势。他谈起诸神，说祂们如何依人的本性与作为作出裁断；有些神也许赞许这场决斗，但大多数不会。更要紧的是，修士说，他们若真想打，死后有的是机会。可若现在自相残杀，败者反而能在来世获得极高声望，胜者却不能——因为这场暴力除了满足胜者的傲慢，毫无意义。出人意料，这条古怪的宗教规矩竟让两人冷静下来。修士邀他们继续谈谈，他们也答应了。三人边走边比画，笑得直不起腰。至于其他弟兄，光是没人死，就足以让他们高兴了。

85ea92b83ff51811042e.source: Angry about you bribing men to stop their fight
85ea92b83ff51811042e.translation: 因你花钱平息手下的争斗而愤怒

1a7b3a1f66bcbee871f3.source: Concerned about you bribing men to stop their fight
1a7b3a1f66bcbee871f3.translation: 对你花钱平息手下争斗的做法感到担忧

dbacdabd56842656bcb3.translation: 在决斗中被杀，杀死他的是

9548ed3c1a55655de16f.source: %terrainImage%While heading toward your destination, %volunteer% runs up to you with a bundle of herbs in hand. Now you know this fool knows nothing about plants or wildlife, but he seems rather persistent in wanting to try them out. Something about 'hearing' of magical powers to be found in the essence of herbs. This talk gets the attention of a few others in the company. Soon, a number of them are asking to try out the 'medicine' for the good of their brothers.
9548ed3c1a55655de16f.translation: %terrainImage%赶路时，%volunteer%手捧一束草药跑过来。你明知这傻子对草木鸟兽一窍不通，他却执意要尝尝，说是“听说”草药精华里藏着神奇力量。这番话引来几个弟兄围观。很快，便有好些人请求试试这份“药”，号称是为了弟兄们的福祉。

6a7c97c69250fa627469.source: They look good, any volunteer to try them?
6a7c97c69250fa627469.translation: 看着不错，有谁愿意尝尝？

d974e1cf1d0dbb455492.source: {Better not try our luck. | You fools will only poison yourselves.}
d974e1cf1d0dbb455492.translation: {还是别碰运气了。 | 你们这帮蠢货只会把自己毒倒。}

95d887cb24b9b69d33e4.source: %terrainImage%It appears that the herbs are not just harmless, but rather even proactive in taking care of some nagging issues with the men. %volunteer%'s cold seems to have lifted, and the stomach pains of %otherguy% have abated. After trying some yourself, you see a splinter wiggle its way out of your thumb. Amazing!
95d887cb24b9b69d33e4.translation: %terrainImage%这些草药不仅无害，似乎还治好了弟兄们的一些老毛病。%volunteer%的风寒好像退了，%otherguy%的胃痛也缓解了。你自己尝了些，竟看见拇指里的一根木刺蠕动着钻了出来。神了！

4e4111399770f18079f0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]From one end comes vomit and from the other shite. It appears the herbs were not worth a try after all. %volunteer% bravely elected himself ready to chow down on the mystery plants and, suffice it to say, the proportions which you are seeing come out of him are definitely mystical in that strange, 'can the body really hold that much?', sort of way.
4e4111399770f18079f0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]上头吐，下头拉。看来，这草药终究不值得一试。%volunteer%勇敢地自告奋勇，吞下了来路不明的植物。只能说，你眼前这排泄的分量，确实称得上神奇——神奇到让人怀疑，一个身体里怎么能装下这么多。

8ef87f81e11c416563d1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]The forest is no friend of man which is why men of ill-repute sure love to put their keepsakes there. And today you've stumbled across one: a cache that %otherbrother% found by way of stubbing his toe on the edge of it. Digging out the crate and cracking it open, you find an assortment of weapons, armor, and gold. You clap the sellsword on the shoulder and thank him for his 'hard work'. He wags his boot around.%SPEECH_ON%Yessir, I've got a toe like the nose of a bloodhound.%SPEECH_OFF%
8ef87f81e11c416563d1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]森林对人并不友善，所以名声不好的人偏爱把家当藏在这里。今天你们就撞见了一处：%otherbrother%的脚趾踢到箱沿，发现了藏匿点。挖出木箱撬开，里面有各式武器、护甲与金币。你拍拍佣兵的肩膀，感谢他的“辛勤劳动”。他晃了晃靴子。%SPEECH_ON%是，团长，我这脚趾跟寻血犬的鼻子一样灵。%SPEECH_OFF%

29706513ab349bd6cccc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]As you get ready to leave, %graverobber% the graverobber stops you.%SPEECH_ON%Wait a minute.%SPEECH_OFF%He jumps down into the pit in which the cache was buried. He starts knocking around on the dirt. Tap. Tap. Tap. Clack. His knuckle raps hard and a smile crosses his face.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, that's what I thought.%SPEECH_OFF%The man digs into the earth and drags out another crate and opens it up. You're wowed by the sight of what's inside. The graverobber nods.%SPEECH_ON%If someone has something good to hide, they don't just hide it in the ground, they hide it with things of lesser value. That way, even if you find their treasure there's still a chance you'll get distracted from the real good stuff. Quite clever, really, but it don't fool me none.%SPEECH_OFF%
29706513ab349bd6cccc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]你正准备离开，盗墓贼%graverobber%叫住了你。%SPEECH_ON%等一下。%SPEECH_OFF%他跳进埋过财物的坑里，四处敲打泥土。笃、笃、笃，咔。他的指节叩上硬物，脸上随即浮出笑容。%SPEECH_ON%没错，我就知道。%SPEECH_OFF%他挖开土，又拖出一只箱子，掀开箱盖。里面的东西让你大吃一惊。盗墓贼点头道。%SPEECH_ON%真有好东西要藏，光埋在地下可不够，还得拿些不太值钱的东西掩护。这样，即使有人找到财宝，也可能顾着眼前这些，忽略真正的宝贝。这招其实挺聪明，可糊弄不了我。%SPEECH_OFF%

916d073396d7581dbd74.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]You come across an abandoned chapel. Cobwebs dress its cracks, and bird nests the corners. The pews are tipped over or have been chopped up for firewood. The old gods have surely left this place.

 %historian% the historian comes to you with what look like muddy logs in his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Would you look at this? Old scripts!%SPEECH_OFF%He blows the blackened dust and ash off the scrolls.%SPEECH_ON%Have you ever seen something so spectacular? I don't know what they say yet, but it's still a most interesting of finds!%SPEECH_OFF%Right, whatever.
916d073396d7581dbd74.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_57.png[/img]你们遇见一座废弃礼拜堂。缝隙挂满蛛网，角落筑着鸟巢；长椅或倒在地上，或早被劈成柴火。旧神想必早已离开这里。

历史学者%historian%捧着些像泥木头的东西走来。%SPEECH_ON%快看！古老的文稿！%SPEECH_OFF%他吹去卷轴上发黑的尘土与灰烬。%SPEECH_ON%你见过这么了不起的东西吗？我还不知道写的是什么，但这发现已经够有意思了！%SPEECH_OFF%行，随你。

b7bc61a35eea78e180ab.source: Just read it and tell me what it says already.
b7bc61a35eea78e180ab.translation: 赶紧读吧，告诉我上面写了什么。

aae4e2c436bbfc303c51.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]As you make camp outside the temple, %historian% the historian enters your tent.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, I think you might be interested in this.%SPEECH_OFF%He's got the scrolls from the chapel in his arms and unravels a few of them across your desk. There you see the historian's sloppy scribblings. His notes are in a language you can't read, but you can easily follow the arrows he's drawn over the pages to connect segments together. He then unfurls another scroll, a fresh one, with all the translations.%SPEECH_ON%These are old training manuals. They speak of techniques I never knew existed. Shall I disperse them amongst the men?%SPEECH_OFF%
aae4e2c436bbfc303c51.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]你们在神殿外扎营时，历史学者%historian%走进了你的帐篷。%SPEECH_ON%长官，我想您会对这个感兴趣。%SPEECH_OFF%他抱着从礼拜堂找到的卷轴，在你桌上摊开几卷。上面满是他潦草的批注。那种文字你看不懂，但顺着他画的箭头，倒很容易看出各段之间的关联。随后，他又铺开一张新卷轴，上面写着完整的译文。%SPEECH_ON%这些是古老的训练手册，记载了一些我闻所未闻的技法。要发给弟兄们看看吗？%SPEECH_OFF%

b3b487b9a039ac7cc15b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]While sitting in your tent outside the abandoned temple, %historian% the historian enters in a manner best described as reluctant. In his hands are the scrolls he found in the chapel a few days back.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, uh, the scrolls... they were most interesting.%SPEECH_OFF%Bored, you inquire as to 'how interesting.' The man explains.%SPEECH_ON%Well, they've been written in a very ancient language. I'm not well versed in it, but I can certainly read portions here and there.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask him what he wants then.%SPEECH_ON%I'd like to read the scrolls, but I could use a little bit of confidence before I do. Would you grace the reading? That is what my old professors would do before any great undertaking.%SPEECH_OFF%
b3b487b9a039ac7cc15b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]你坐在废弃神殿外的帐篷里，历史学者%historian%犹犹豫豫地走了进来，手里抱着几天前在礼拜堂找到的卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%长官，呃，那些卷轴……实在很有意思。%SPEECH_OFF%你有些不耐烦，问他到底“有意思”在哪里。他解释道。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，它们是用一种非常古老的语言写成的。我不算精通，不过零零星星的段落还是读得懂。%SPEECH_OFF%你问他究竟想要什么。%SPEECH_ON%我想试着解读这些卷轴，只是动手之前，还缺一点信心。您能为这次研读赐个祝福吗？以前我的教授们在开始任何重要研究前，都会这样做。%SPEECH_OFF%

1852bf64b84fb870b59f.source: Alright, go on ahead and read.

69c1c324c6323876c369.source: If you're so scared to read, perhaps it is best we don't.
69c1c324c6323876c369.translation: 你要是这么害怕，也许还是别读了。

2bfc1b1b58772c3a3b3b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]%historian% picks up the scrolls. He licks his lips, clears his throat, and begins to read aloud. The words that come forth are not ones you'd easily recognize. They sound so lazily produced as though he were a man being wrangled from a deep sleep, and indeed bringing with him the monsters that would inhabit the dreamworlds.

 He stops and looks up.%SPEECH_ON%That was it. Do you feel anything?%SPEECH_OFF%You raise an eyebrow. Feel anything? Why would--

 Madness. You see a spiraling darkness wreathed in living shadows, the screaming specters of creatures that still yet yearn for finality in death, and amongst them swirl beings, grinning and yapping, like bestial puppet masters, maws slipped to yonder depths, their boned teeth the only light in this realm, their smiles but crescents of ill-shaped moons come to feast on the stars themselves.%SPEECH_ON%Oh naive one, does thou think Davkul does not listen?%SPEECH_OFF%You suddenly awake to %historian%'s screams. He says all manner of monsters are afoot. With not a moment to waste you go to warn the men before all the hells and those not yet known can break loose.
2bfc1b1b58772c3a3b3b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]%historian%拿起卷轴，舔舔嘴唇，清了清嗓子，开始高声诵读。那些词句你很难认出来，发音拖沓懒散，仿佛他刚被人从沉睡中强行拽起，还把栖居梦境的怪物一并带了出来。

 他停下，抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%就这些。你有什么感觉吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你挑起眉毛。什么感觉？为什么会——

 疯狂。你看见盘旋的黑暗，周遭缠满活着的阴影；幽魂尖叫，那些生物直到此刻仍渴望死亡能带来真正的终结。其间又有怪异的存在回旋，咧嘴、狂吠，像野兽般的提线操偶者。它们的巨口裂向遥远深渊，森白骨牙是这方天地唯一的光，笑容像畸形月亮弯成的镰钩，前来吞食星辰本身。%SPEECH_ON%无知之人，你以为达夫库尔不曾聆听？%SPEECH_OFF%你猛然被%historian%的尖叫惊醒。他喊着，到处都有怪物。你一刻也不敢耽搁，赶紧去警告弟兄们，免得已知与未知的地狱一同降临。

07be278822a32953a56b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]%historian% picks up the scroll and begins to read. The language is at both familiar and yet primordially ancient. It tickles the ear like the scratch of vipers over sand and by no means any less threatening. When he's finished, the historian looks up.%SPEECH_ON%Feel anything?%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly a dark, yet soft hand wraps around the man from behind, curving down toward his loins.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, humans. We did not think you would survive this long, and indeed it has been long since our services were called upon.%SPEECH_OFF%Lithe, hip-swaying creatures slip so lightly into the tent as though they were hardly more than the wind itself. Outside, you can hear the murmur of the rest of the company being overcome by the seductive beings. One walks toward you, her shape flashing between all the women of your life, testing your response, and when your heart warms it settles on a young lady that once broke your heart. The succubus falls atop you.%SPEECH_ON%Don't mind me, human, this is for you. Relax.%SPEECH_OFF%You let the pleasures wash over you.

 Immeasurable hours later you awake with your trousers down and %historian% in the corner rubbing his head.%SPEECH_ON%They were so wonderful, but the scroll's gone. I think it burned up after I said the words. Oh by the old gods do I wish I remember what they said!%SPEECH_OFF%
07be278822a32953a56b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]%historian%拿起卷轴，开始诵读。那语言既似曾相识，又古老得仿佛来自天地初开之时。声音擦过耳畔，像毒蛇游过沙地，危险的感觉也丝毫不减。读完后，历史学者抬起头。%SPEECH_ON%有什么感觉吗？%SPEECH_OFF%忽然，一只幽暗却柔软的手从身后环住他，沿着身体向腰胯滑去。%SPEECH_ON%啊，人类。没想到你们能活这么久。确实，也很久没人召唤我们来侍奉了。%SPEECH_OFF%身形柔曼的生灵摇曳着腰肢，轻盈地滑入帐篷，仿佛不过是一阵风。帐外传来弟兄们的低语，显然也都被这些妖娆的生灵俘获。一个朝你走来，身形在你此生见过的女人之间不断变换，试探你的反应。当你的心泛起柔情，她便定格成一位年轻姑娘——那姑娘曾伤透你的心。魅魔伏到你身上。%SPEECH_ON%别顾虑我，人类，这一切都是为你。放松。%SPEECH_OFF%你任欢愉将自己淹没。

 不知过了多少个时辰，你醒来时裤子还褪着，%historian%则缩在角落里揉脑袋。%SPEECH_ON%她们真是妙极了，可卷轴没了。我想，念完那些词后，它就烧成灰了。噢，旧神在上，真希望我还记得上面写了什么！%SPEECH_OFF%

9724cc58aa894672ce49.translation: 有过一次愉快的超自然体验

8292264c58160874b347.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]Carrying a leathered tome in hand, %historian% shuffles into your tent. Without a word spoken he lays the book on the table and takes a step back. You set your quill pen down and ask what it is. He says to open it. Sighing, you open the book and come to find pages littered with names and events you know well. It is a history of the company and its adventures. You flip through the pages, seeing old tales that warm the heart and some that break it. You close the book and push it back across the table. The historian asks if it is alright, and you nod. You say give it to the men to read around camp for it will surely lift their spirits.
8292264c58160874b347.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_15.png[/img]%historian%捧着一本皮面厚书，缓步走进你的帐篷。他一言不发地把书放在桌上，又退开一步。你搁下羽毛笔，问这是什么。他让你翻开看看。你叹了口气，打开书，发现满纸都是自己熟悉的名字与往事。这是一本记述战团及其冒险经历的史书。你一页页翻过，有些旧事令人心头一暖，有些则令人心碎。你合上书，将它沿桌面推了回去。历史学者问写得是否还行，你点点头，让他拿给营里的弟兄们传阅，相信这一定能让大家打起精神。

7936d9b0cd97b942955b.source: The deeds of the %companyname% shan't be forgotten.

49114b7d9ac4966479f9.translation: 为战团的成就感到自豪

995b4a8b5d98f7f013be.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]While traversing the snowy wastelands of the realm's north, %houndmaster% the houndmaster has come to befriend a creature that's been trailing beside the company's march: a wolf. The houndmaster frequently remained in the rearguard, crouched low, hands at his side, locking eyes with the lone wolf for minutes on end. But today, using a bit of leftover meat, he plied the beast right into the middle of the camp. Now he squats at its side, dwarfed by its prominent, muscled withers, its pointed and attentive ears, and a lapping maw lined with mankilling canines.

 The rest of the men stand behind their weapons. One yells at the houndmaster to stop what he is doing. Another says the wolf can smell fear. Yet another throws a rock at it. The wolf winces, but doesn't react. Laughing, the houndmaster makes a 'tssst!' noise and points. The wolf launches forward, picking up the stone and bringing it back to the man. He rubs the beast's mane.%SPEECH_ON%See, easily trained, just any dog. Only bigger, faster, and stronger. Smarter, too.%SPEECH_OFF%Its eyes meet yours. The wolf lays low, almost like a man bowing. %houndmaster% laughs again.%SPEECH_ON%See? It already knows who is alpha of this pack.%SPEECH_OFF%
995b4a8b5d98f7f013be.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]穿越北方冰雪荒原时，驯犬师%houndmaster%渐渐与一头始终尾随战团的野兽交上了朋友：一匹狼。他常留在队尾，压低身子，双手垂在身侧，与那匹孤狼对视，一看就是好几分钟。可今天，他竟用一点剩肉，将它一路引进了营地中央。如今，他蹲在狼身边，在它高耸而强健的肩背、竖起警觉的双耳，以及不断舔动、长满夺命獠牙的大嘴旁，显得小了许多。

 其余弟兄都把武器挡在身前。有人喊着叫驯犬师住手，有人说狼能闻出恐惧，还有人朝它扔了块石头。狼缩了一下，却没还击。驯犬师笑着发出一声“嘶”，伸手一指。狼猛地蹿出去，叼起石头，送回他面前。他揉了揉野兽颈上的鬃毛。%SPEECH_ON%瞧，和狗一样好训。只是更大、更快、更强，也更聪明。%SPEECH_OFF%狼的目光对上了你，随即伏低身子，几乎像人在鞠躬。%houndmaster%又笑了。%SPEECH_ON%看见没？它已经知道这群里的头领是谁了。%SPEECH_OFF%

d98289918df6b9aeea4a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]While resting, the men start a conversation about how far away the sun is. %otherbrother% looks up at it, wincing and gritting his teeth as he just about blinds himself in his measuring. Finally, he looks back down.%SPEECH_ON%I'd wager it's about ten to fifteen miles away.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods at his own presumably accurate summation.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, probably not even that far. I heard a story about an archer in a faraway land hitting it with an arrow.%SPEECH_OFF%
d98289918df6b9aeea4a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]休息时，弟兄们聊起太阳究竟离得多远。%otherbrother%仰头眺望，眯眼咬牙，这番丈量险些看瞎了双眼。最后，他低下头。%SPEECH_ON%我赌它离这儿也就十到十五英里。%SPEECH_OFF%他对自己这番自认精准的估算点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%对，说不定还没那么远。我听过个故事，说远方有个弓箭手，一箭就射中了它。%SPEECH_OFF%

b6a2fd70e9fea6e791a3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%historian% the historian starts in on the conversation.%SPEECH_ON%I doubt the veracity of that claim about shooting it with a bow. Here's a much more truthful tale I've read of: there are men in the mountains of the east who have big spyglasses to stare up at the night sky. They think the sun is quite far away. At least ten thousand miles, even. They also think the nightlights are other suns and not the souls of dead heroes.%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother% gets up.%SPEECH_ON%Watch yer mouth, fool, and don't speak ill of our ancestors.%SPEECH_OFF%The historian nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course! It was only an idea.%SPEECH_OFF%What hogwash. Pretty dumb shite for a supposed 'smart' man like %historian%. A few of the brothers have a laugh at the historian's silly notions.
b6a2fd70e9fea6e791a3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]历史学者%historian%加入了谈话。%SPEECH_ON%关于用弓射中太阳的说法，我很怀疑。我倒读过一个更可信的故事：东方群山里，有人用很大的望远镜观察夜空。他们认为，太阳离我们十分遥远，至少有一万英里。他们还认为，夜里的星光来自别的太阳，并非死去英雄的灵魂。%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother%站起来。%SPEECH_ON%蠢货，嘴巴放干净点，别亵渎咱们的先人。%SPEECH_OFF%历史学者连忙点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然！只是个想法而已。%SPEECH_OFF%简直胡说八道。%historian%这样一个所谓的“聪明人”，竟也能说出如此蠢话。几个弟兄拿历史学者那些荒唐想法取笑起来。

1403a6f2fa0866772266.source: What a laugh riot he is.

0094613aa43feb40d1d5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%monk% the monk starts in on the conversation.%SPEECH_ON%The sun is neither far nor close.
