It is the eye of many of the gods, the scope through which they use to watch over us.%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother% nods, but then, curious, asks about the moon. The monk smiles confidently.%SPEECH_ON%Do you think the gods would shine upon us for all hours? Of course they dim the lights a bit, to give us mortals a nice night to sleep in.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. Truly the old gods are always looking out for us.
0094613aa43feb40d1d5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]修士%monk%加入了话题。%SPEECH_ON%太阳既不远，也不近。它是众神的眼睛，是他们注视世人的镜孔。%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother%点点头，随后又好奇地问起月亮。修士自信地笑了。%SPEECH_ON%难道诸神会整日整夜照着我们？他们当然要把灯光调暗些，好让凡人睡个安稳觉。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。旧神果然时时照顾着我们。

05cc7d41a4e82cb0456c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%cultist% the cultist gets up and looks at the sun. As he continues to stare at it, a shadow slowly emerges over his face, as though some entity were shielding him from the light. Suddenly, he raises a hand and starts drawing some aerial rites with his hand. You swear the darkness on his face is moving as though an imprint of his drawings, a sort of shifting tattoo. When he's finished, he takes a seat.%SPEECH_ON%The sun is dying.%SPEECH_OFF%The men look concerned. One interjects.%SPEECH_ON%Dying? What do you mean?%SPEECH_OFF%%cultist% stares at him.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul wills it that all may die.%SPEECH_OFF%One man asks if this supposed 'Davkul' will die too. The cultist nods.%SPEECH_ON%When there is nothing left to die, Davkul may finally rest. A crueler god would have departed already. It is by Davkul's good graces that he will go last, and for that we praise him.%SPEECH_OFF%
05cc7d41a4e82cb0456c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]教徒%cultist%站起来，望向太阳。他一直盯着，脸上却渐渐浮出阴影，仿佛有某种存在替他挡住了光。忽然，他抬手在空中划起仪式符号。你敢发誓，他脸上的黑暗正随手势变化，像一幅不断移动的刺青。做完，他重新坐下。%SPEECH_ON%太阳正在死去。%SPEECH_OFF%众人面露忧色，一个人插嘴问。%SPEECH_ON%死去？什么意思？%SPEECH_OFF%%cultist%盯着他。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔意欲让万物都能迎来死亡。%SPEECH_OFF%有人问，那位所谓的“达夫库尔”是否也会死。教徒点点头。%SPEECH_ON%等再没有什么可死，达夫库尔方能安息。若是更残酷的神，早已自行离去。正因达夫库尔仁慈，祂才留到最后，为此，我们赞颂祂。%SPEECH_OFF%

7f11efbbd75863929461.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%archer% takes the challenge, grabbing his bow and a couple of arrows. He licks his finger and holds it up.%SPEECH_ON%Wind's right for a good star shootin'.%SPEECH_OFF%The archer nocks an arrow, draws, and takes aim. The blistering light is instantly blinding.%SPEECH_ON%Fark, I can't see shit.%SPEECH_OFF%His aim wobbles as dark spots take over his vision. The arrow is loosed and sails wide of the sun. Real wide. He looks at the company, eyes dimmed, hands out as he tries to steady himself while his sight returns.%SPEECH_ON%Did I hit it?%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother% hides his chuckling.%SPEECH_ON%Right on the button!%SPEECH_OFF%The men burst into laughter.
7f11efbbd75863929461.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%archer%接下挑战，取来弓和几支箭。他舔了舔手指，举起来试风。%SPEECH_ON%这风正好，适合射个天上的星星。%SPEECH_OFF%弓手搭箭、拉弦、瞄准，刺眼的阳光却立刻晃得他睁不开眼。%SPEECH_ON%操，什么都看不见了。%SPEECH_OFF%视野里浮起片片黑斑，他瞄准的手也开始摇晃。箭离弦而去，远远偏开了太阳。偏得非常远。他两眼发黑地转向众人，伸出双手稳住身子，等着视力恢复。%SPEECH_ON%射中了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother%憋着笑。%SPEECH_ON%正中靶心！%SPEECH_OFF%众人顿时笑成一团。

4777e7faabd905d1e4a2.source: I see you thinking, %cultistfull%. What say you?
4777e7faabd905d1e4a2.translation: %cultistfull%，看你若有所思，有什么想说的？

5354a9dc22615704d508.source: %archerfull%, why don't you take a shot?

1a7d2468d7230ca0ee8b.source: Enough star talk. Back to the road.
1a7d2468d7230ca0ee8b.translation: 星星的事说够了，赶路吧。

aec5fde0705ed5aeff14.translation: 对太阳那番可笑的见解

60c0aa6114b8e70eab48.source: Relished the opportunity to talk about the dying sun
60c0aa6114b8e70eab48.translation: 很高兴有机会谈论太阳将死之事

4d4c403b0064eee59e5d.source: Angry about the heretical ramblings of
4d4c403b0064eee59e5d.translation: 因异端邪说而愤怒，散布者是

6476436efddf7572ad7e.source: Terrified at the prospect of a dying sun
6476436efddf7572ad7e.translation: 想到太阳将死就恐惧不已

bfef2a1fe55381215e72.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{As you help %otherguy% get his boot out of the mud, %hunter% comes out of the bushes with what must be nearly a dozen rabbits strung together. He sets them down and starts to untie them. The little bunnies - eyes wide, horrified in the end - all look quite tasty. The hunter grabs one by its neck and twists its body in a circle before pushing all its guts out in one swift motion. He repeats this process until every rabbit has been slaughtered. As he wipes his hand on %otherguy%'s cloak, the hunter points to the mound of emptied bunnies at his feet.%SPEECH_ON%That there is the eating pile.%SPEECH_OFF%He then points to the lump of rabbit guts.%SPEECH_ON%That there is not the eating pile. Got it? Good.%SPEECH_OFF%  | %hunter% ran on ahead of the party a few hours ago and just now you catch back up to him. He's standing with his foot on a dead deer, its chest punctured by a single arrow. As you approach, he grins and steps off. He says if some of the brothers can help string it up he'll skin it and prep it. | Forest birds chitter and chatter above the company's march. The sun winks between the canopy branches, a soft glint that peppers the ground with dots of light. You spot a squirrel resting in one of the sun beams, enjoying the warmth as it gnaws on an acorn. It stops, sensing you watching it, and then it suddenly jerks and a fleck of its blood meets your cheek. You wipe it away, turning back to see that the squirrel has been impaled by an arrow, every shrieking death throe quieter than the last as the volume of its life slowly turns down. %hunter% suddenly breaks through the bushes with a bow in hand and a grin on his face. The hunter retrieves his kill and throws it in with a litter of others, a long hunter's line around which are tied all manner of critters foe and friend alike.}
bfef2a1fe55381215e72.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]{你正帮%otherguy%把靴子从泥里拔出来，%hunter%便从灌木后走出，手里串着将近一打兔子。他放下兔子，开始解绳。小家伙们睁大双眼，临到头来惊恐万分，看起来却都十分美味。猎人抓住一只的脖子，将身体拧了一圈，随即干净利落地挤出全部内脏。他如此重复，直到每只兔子都已宰好。他在%otherguy%的斗篷上擦擦手，指着脚边那堆掏空的兔子。%SPEECH_ON%这堆是吃的。%SPEECH_OFF%接着，又指向那团兔子内脏。%SPEECH_ON%这堆不是吃的。懂了？很好。%SPEECH_OFF%  | 几小时前，%hunter%跑到了队伍前头，如今你们才追上。他一脚踩着死鹿，鹿胸口只插着一支箭。见你们靠近，他咧嘴一笑，收回脚，说只要几个弟兄帮忙把鹿吊起来，他就能剥皮处理。 | 战团行进时，林鸟在头顶啾啾鸣叫。阳光从树冠枝隙中闪过，在地面洒下柔和的光点。你看见一只松鼠歇在光柱里，一边啃橡果，一边享受暖意。它察觉到你的注视，停了下来，随即猛地一抽，一点鲜血溅上你的脸颊。你抹去血点，再看时，松鼠已被箭贯穿。它垂死的尖叫一声比一声弱，仿佛生命的音量正慢慢调低。%hunter%突然持弓钻出灌木，满脸笑容。他取下猎物，扔进另一堆猎获之中。长长的猎绳上，绑着各种小兽，平日是敌是友，如今都凑在了一起。}

1b25e989e29faaefa230.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]While on the march, you come across a line of stopped wagons. You realize the wagons are cages with each serving a prison to a wild animal. Touring the line of carts, you come to face a variety of beasts. A haunched and mewling black cat launches its mankiller claws through the bars. Jumping away, you back into another cage which violently rattles with a bear's roaring. Thankfully, its powerful paws are too fat to fit between the bars. Another cage sizzles with the hissing of snakes.

 A man leans back from behind one of the wagons. He's got a wild look on his face as though you'd just caught him getting one off the wrist.%SPEECH_ON%Hey! Who are you? What are you doing here?%SPEECH_OFF%You inform the stranger that you are the captain of the %companyname%. The man straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, sellswords then! And I thought my luck had up and run off on me! Look, I got a problem that my hired hands refused to help with. They didn't care when they didn't know better, but the damn cloak fell off the wagon and then they just wouldn't shut up about how I wasn't paying them enough to transport such goods!%SPEECH_OFF%
1b25e989e29faaefa230.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]行军途中，你们遇见一列停下的货车。走近才发现，车上装的全是笼子，每只笼子都囚着一头野兽。沿着车队查看，你见到了各式各样的动物。一只黑色的大猫弓起身子低吼，猛地从栏杆间探出足以杀人的利爪。你跳开，向后一退，却撞上另一只笼子。熊的怒吼声中，笼子剧烈摇晃，幸好那对有力的熊掌太宽，挤不过栏杆。还有只笼子里，群蛇嘶嘶作响。

 一个男人从货车后探出身子，脸上神情慌乱，仿佛刚被你撞见正偷偷自渎。%SPEECH_ON%喂！你是谁？在这里干什么？%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，自己是%companyname%的团长。男人挺直了身子。%SPEECH_ON%噢，佣兵！我还以为好运早把我丢下，独自跑了呢！听着，我碰上个麻烦，雇来的帮工都不肯搭手。原先不知道是怎么回事时，他们倒没意见，可那该死的罩布一从车上掉下来，他们就嚷个没完，说我给的工钱，根本不够让他们运这种货！%SPEECH_OFF%

e4bb03b399c07eeda658.source: What do you need help with?

8e7d3a0d47d45c3ef66f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]The animal tamer leads you to a carriage. You immediately see why his hired hands quit: a frenzied and mercurial wildman is sitting inside the cage. Raw wrists bleed against his shackles, signs of attempted escapes. Half-starved, the wildman gnaws on sticks poking out from a tumbleweed of a beard. Seeing this sad sight, you grab the stranger by his shirt and slam him against the wagon.%SPEECH_ON%Does that look like an animal to you?%SPEECH_OFF%The animal tamer grins, ivory for teeth. He explains himself.%SPEECH_ON%Cityfolk have gotten wind of the 'uncivilized' wildmen and wish to see them up close. I am only fulfilling this new demand as any businessman would. Now, all I need help with is to get that dead body out of the cage.%SPEECH_OFF%He points toward a corpse in the corner of the cage. The wildman rears back, snarling, and goes to protectively sit on the body. The animal tamer shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%One of my helpers got too close and, well, yeah. I can't go into town with that mess in there so I thought maybe you could help me fish it out. I'll pay plenty, of course. A pouch of 250 crowns sound good to you? Just reach on in there and yank that garbage out.%SPEECH_OFF%
8e7d3a0d47d45c3ef66f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]驯兽师领你来到一辆马车旁。你立刻明白他雇的帮工为什么不干了：笼子里坐着一个狂躁易怒的荒野人。他的手腕被镣铐磨得皮开肉绽，仍在渗血，显然曾试图逃脱。他饿得半死，正啃着从蓬乱如风滚草的胡子里支出来的木棍。看着这悲惨景象，你一把揪住陌生人的衣襟，将他撞在车上。%SPEECH_ON%你看他，像是头畜生吗？%SPEECH_OFF%驯兽师咧嘴笑了，露出一口象牙白的牙齿，解释道。%SPEECH_ON%城里人听说了这些“未开化”的荒野人，都想亲眼瞧瞧。我不过是像其他生意人一样，满足一下新需求。现在，我只需要你帮忙把笼子里的尸体弄出来。%SPEECH_OFF%他指向笼子角落的一具尸体。荒野人猛地后缩，龇牙低吼，又挪过去坐在尸体上，护得死死的。驯兽师摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我一个帮工靠得太近，然后，唉，就是这样。我可不能带着这玩意儿进城，所以想请你们帮忙捞出来。当然，报酬绝不会少。一袋250克朗，怎么样？伸手进去，把那堆垃圾拽出来就行。%SPEECH_OFF%

54a14ca1e1adc8ef57ab.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]The animal tamer leads you to a carriage. You immediately see why his hired hands quit: a frenzied and mercurial wildman is sitting inside the cage. Raw wrists bleed against his shackles, signs of attempted escapes. Half-starved, the wildman gnaws on sticks poking out from a tumbleweed of a beard. The animal tamer grins, ivory for teeth.%SPEECH_ON%Cityfolk have gotten wind of the 'uncivilized' wildmen and wish to see them up close. I am only fulfilling this new demand as any businessman would. Now, all I need help with is to get that dead body out of the cage.%SPEECH_OFF%He points toward a corpse in the corner of the cage. The wildman rears back, snarling, and goes to protectively sit on the body. The animal tamer shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%One of my helpers got too close and, well, yeah. I can't go into town with that mess in there so I thought maybe you could help me fish it out. I'll pay plenty, of course. A pouch of 250 crowns sound good to you? Just reach on in there and yank that garbage out.%SPEECH_OFF%
54a14ca1e1adc8ef57ab.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]驯兽师领你来到一辆马车旁。你立刻明白他雇的帮工为什么不干了：笼子里坐着一个狂躁易怒的荒野人。他的手腕被镣铐磨得皮开肉绽，仍在渗血，显然曾试图逃脱。他饿得半死，正啃着从蓬乱如风滚草的胡子里支出来的木棍。驯兽师咧嘴笑了，露出一口象牙白的牙齿。%SPEECH_ON%城里人听说了这些“未开化”的荒野人，都想亲眼瞧瞧。我不过是像其他生意人一样，满足一下新需求。现在，我只需要你帮忙把笼子里的尸体弄出来。%SPEECH_OFF%他指向笼子角落的一具尸体。荒野人猛地后缩，龇牙低吼，又挪过去坐在尸体上，护得死死的。驯兽师摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我一个帮工靠得太近，然后，唉，就是这样。我可不能带着这玩意儿进城，所以想请你们帮忙捞出来。当然，报酬绝不会少。一袋250克朗，怎么样？伸手进去，把那堆垃圾拽出来就行。%SPEECH_OFF%

fe78d82b682d059f4cfd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]%taskedbro% is the one tasked with cleaning out the wildman's corpse-featured terrarium. He rolls up his sleeves and approaches the cage with both hands out.%SPEECH_ON%Whoa there, easy now. Easy!%SPEECH_OFF%The wildman gets up off the dead body and goes to the other side of its habitat. The sellsword easily grabs the boot of the corpse and drags it toward the bars. It slips through with sickening ease, already clumped up in the fashion of discarded wet clothes. Guts and limbs dribble off the edge of the wagon's platform. The animal tamer cheers happily.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you so much! And you made it look so easy, too!%SPEECH_OFF%%taskedbro% stares at the dead body with the realization that could have easily been him.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah. You're welcome.%SPEECH_OFF%
fe78d82b682d059f4cfd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]%taskedbro%被派去清理荒野人那间以尸体为陈设的兽笼。他卷起袖子，伸着双手走近。%SPEECH_ON%喔，别急，别急！%SPEECH_OFF%荒野人从死人身上起身，走到笼子另一头。佣兵轻易抓住尸体的靴子，朝栏杆拖去。尸体已软成一团，像丢弃的湿衣服，滑过栏杆的轻松程度令人作呕。内脏与肢体从车台边缘淌落。驯兽人高兴地欢呼。%SPEECH_ON%太谢谢你了！看你做得可真轻松！%SPEECH_OFF%%taskedbro%盯着尸体，意识到躺在那儿的很可能就是自己。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，不客气。%SPEECH_OFF%

0b0ac5858d2dbb88e8e7.source: Well, at least we got paid.

e255bf856ac3604aba66.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]%taskedbro% is tasked with getting the corpse out of the habitat. He approaches the cage like a harlot streetwalking a particularly pious town. When he gets close the bars, he smiles like an old friend.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there buddy. That's a nice corpse you got there. A great corpse, truly one of the best I've ever seen. How about I just... take it... out...%SPEECH_OFF%When the mercenary reaches in, the wildman swipes out. It's too fast to even see. %taskedbro% slowly turns around. There's a black hole where one of his eyes used to be. The wildman squishes the eye between his teeth, a white goop bursting forth like a popped pustule, and it turns into a filmy paste as he chews. The animal tamer throws you a sack of crowns and runs off.%SPEECH_ON%Not liable! I am not liable!%SPEECH_OFF%%taskedbro% passes out as a few vengeful brothers stab the imprisoned wildman to death. All the caged beasts roar up as though you'd just slain their leader. You quickly order the men away from the caravan before one of its beasts gets free and causes more damage.
e255bf856ac3604aba66.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]你指派%taskedbro%把尸体从笼子里弄出来。他朝笼子走去，那副小心翼翼的样子，活像妓女在一座格外虔诚的城镇里沿街揽客。走到铁栏边，他露出老朋友般的笑容。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，伙计。你这具尸体真不错。好尸体，真是我见过最好的尸体之一。要不我就……把它……拿出来……%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵刚把手伸进去，荒野人便猛地挥爪，快得根本看不清。%taskedbro%缓缓转过身，原本一只眼睛的位置已经变成了黑洞。荒野人用牙齿挤破那颗眼球，白色浆液像脓疮破裂般迸出，随着咀嚼化成一团黏糊糊的东西。驯兽师丢给你一袋克朗，转身就跑。%SPEECH_ON%我不负责！这可不关我的事！%SPEECH_OFF%%taskedbro%昏了过去，几个愤怒的弟兄则举起武器，将笼中的荒野人捅死。其他笼子里的野兽齐声咆哮，仿佛你们刚杀了它们的首领。你赶紧命令弟兄们离开商队，免得哪头野兽挣脱牢笼，再添伤亡。

9bacea2f5785a6dce6a5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]You tell this animal tamer that his problems are his own. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, I don't blame ya. You're smarter than you look, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%
9bacea2f5785a6dce6a5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]你告诉驯兽人，自己的麻烦自己解决。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%行，我不怪你。佣兵，你比看起来聪明。%SPEECH_OFF%

313638e175090e535adf.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]If anyone in the party could help talk the caged wildman down, it's probably %wildman%. He goes to the cage, stares in. There's an exchange of hoots. Your wildman raps the bars with a knuckle, and the prisoner raps back and hoots somberly. Suddenly, %wildman% grabs the animal tamer by the head and drives him into the bars. You go to save the tamer, but the imprisoned wildman soars across the cage with atavistic terror in his eyes. Stepping back for your own safety, you can only watch as this bestial man sets upon the tamer. Both wildmen pull and drag on the man's face. The concussed man groggily yells.%SPEECH_ON%I thought we had an agreeeeeemeeeaahh!%SPEECH_OFF%%wildman% corks his thumbs into the man's eyes while the imprisoned wildman grips the tamer's mouth and pulls down. His head is literally ripped apart by the seams and sinews. A few men vomit as the tamer's brains falls out where his tongue should be, a truly awful way of speaking one's mind. The 'warden' taken care of, %wildman% looks at you and at the wildman with a sort of 'can we keep him?' gesture.
313638e175090e535adf.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]队伍里若有人能劝笼中的荒野人冷静下来，那多半就是%wildman%。他走到笼边，往里盯着，两人互相吼了几声。你的荒野人用指节敲敲铁栏，囚犯也敲了回去，发出低沉的哀鸣。突然，%wildman%抓住驯兽师的脑袋，猛地撞上栏杆。你本想去救人，笼中的荒野人却已冲过来，眼中迸发着原始而骇人的凶光。为保自身安全，你只得后退，眼看着这个兽性十足的人扑向驯兽师。两个荒野人一同撕扯他的脸。被撞得神志不清的驯兽师含糊大喊。%SPEECH_ON%我们不是说好——啊啊啊！%SPEECH_OFF%%wildman%将拇指深深按进他的眼睛，笼中的荒野人则攥住他的嘴，往下猛扯。脑袋沿着骨缝和筋腱被生生撕开，脑浆从本该是舌头的地方淌出，恶心得几个弟兄当场吐了出来。这回他真把脑子里的东西全“说”了出来，场面惨不忍睹。解决了“狱卒”之后，%wildman%看看你，又看看笼中的荒野人，比划出一副“我们能留下他吗”的意思。

9872b1f439e67115eddd.translation: 恶心得很，正合我们胃口。

7665cb6fd7316cadeeda.source: No, he's clearly far too dangerous.

323829c2d62d6389d4b5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]An outstanding capacity for violence is well-suited to a mercenary band. You agree to take the imprisoned wildman on.
323829c2d62d6389d4b5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]如此出众的暴力天分，正合佣兵团的需要。你同意收下这个被囚禁的荒野人。

046f93ff1de5474b2655.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]You don't think the imprisoned wildman would fit in with the company, but you do set him free nonetheless. He shoots out his cage like a banshee and runs for the tree line. There he stands at a distance hooting and hollering until he runs off again.
046f93ff1de5474b2655.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]你觉得这个被囚禁的荒野人融不进战团，却还是放了他。他像厉鬼般尖叫着冲出笼子，奔向林缘，站在远处又吼又叫，随后再次跑开。

3640b5fa8381e2206f39.source: I guess that's his way of saying thanks.
3640b5fa8381e2206f39.translation: 我猜，这就是他道谢的方式。

585e79ed03c46b16b934.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]%monk% the monk steps forth, hands clasped, head borrowed forward. The embodiment of a sermon, the posture of good morals, or misguided ones. He pulls the tamer aside.%SPEECH_ON%The old gods would frown upon what you have done here.%SPEECH_OFF%The animal tamer laughs and leans against the cage, smugly crossing his arms. He states that in the south they consider slavery a part of the natural order. The monk continues.%SPEECH_ON%True, but neither you nor this wildman are kin to their way of life. You wish to enslave him by means of his being an outsider. He does not understand the relationship which makes it especially grievous and improper. My suggestion is to have him work for you and learn from you. Make him a friend and you will have a friend for life-%SPEECH_OFF%The imprisoned wildman's hands dart through the bars and digs his fingers into his eyeballs. His face is ripped apart like a loaf of old bread, a couple of coathangers for a jawbone, a tongue lolling like an uprooted snake. %monk% vomits as his face is doused in blood. %otherbrother% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I'd say he'd fit right in with the %companyname%...%SPEECH_OFF%
585e79ed03c46b16b934.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_100.png[/img]修士%monk%双手交握，低着头走上前，那姿态简直就是一篇活生生的布道，满是道德的光辉，也可能只是认错了方向。他把驯兽师拉到一旁。%SPEECH_ON%你在这里做的事，旧神不会赞许。%SPEECH_OFF%驯兽师笑了，靠着笼子，得意地抱起双臂，说南方人把奴役看作自然秩序的一部分。修士接着说。%SPEECH_ON%不错，可你和这位荒野人，都不是按那种方式生活的人。你只因他是个异类，就想奴役他。他根本不明白这层关系，这才使此事格外令人痛心，也格外不妥。依我看，让他替你做事，向你学习。与他交朋友，你便能得到一位终生的朋友——%SPEECH_OFF%笼中的荒野人猛地将双手探出铁栏，手指抠进驯兽师的眼睛。他的脸像陈旧的面包一样被撕开，颌骨成了两只扭曲的衣架，舌头软软垂着，像被拔出洞的蛇。%monk%满脸溅血，当场呕吐起来。%otherbrother%摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%要我说，他倒挺适合加入%companyname%的……%SPEECH_OFF%

62325ff8b791ee353c7b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]Well, the animal tamer is gone and with him there's no one left to take care of the beasts. %randombrother% comes up and asks what should be done with them.
62325ff8b791ee353c7b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_47.png[/img]驯兽人已经不在，也就没人照料这些野兽了。%randombrother%走过来，问你打算如何处置它们。

c9571ca50a078e1a561a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You feel it just wouldn't be right to leave them out here to starve to death and a caged creature no doubt has gamey meat when it comes to harvesting. You decide to let them on out of their cages. Most of these strange creatures make a beeline for the treeline, but two remain behind: a husky dog and a hooded falcon, both seemingly looking for a master.
c9571ca50a078e1a561a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你觉得不能把它们丢在这里活活饿死，何况笼养的动物真宰来吃，肉味想必也很重。于是，你决定打开笼子放它们走。大多数奇异的生灵径直奔向树林，却有两个留了下来：一条壮实的狗，以及一只戴着眼罩的猎鹰，看上去都在寻找主人。

250807bf85693812a5f4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]It'd be a crime to leave these animals out here to starve and rot. And it'd also be a terrible waste of good meat. You have the creatures slaughtered. It's an easy, albeit brutal job, stabbing and slicing a bunch of hapless critters and beasts. The bear is the last to go, and it does not go easily. It manages to drag %hurtbro% close for a nasty swipe, but beyond that your men put it to a slow, grisly death. The rest of the wagons are turned over and looted.
250807bf85693812a5f4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_14.png[/img]把这些动物丢在这里活活饿死、腐烂，未免造孽，何况还糟蹋了这么多好肉。你叫人将它们宰了。这活轻松，却很残忍，无非是对着一群无助的大小禽兽捅刺劈砍。熊留到最后，也最不肯就范：它将%hurtbro%拖近，狠狠拍了一爪。不过除此之外，弟兄们终究让它缓慢而惨烈地死去。其余货车也被翻查、搜刮一空。

9bd4d1a4aecc2da6d8c8.source: Alright, I'll send a man in.

c2e004584df34977b688.source: We got our own wildman who could help.
c2e004584df34977b688.translation: 我们也有个荒野人，也许能帮忙。

fb193c18cfc34f52e13f.source: Our monk seems a little disturbed by this.
fb193c18cfc34f52e13f.translation: 我们的修士似乎对此有些不安。

0cb256a48bf2d2ecee0b.source: I won't put the life of my men at risk for this.
0cb256a48bf2d2ecee0b.translation: 我不会为这事拿弟兄们的命冒险。

739646dfb6e9313979bf.source: %name% was 'saved' by you during a confrontation with an animal tamer-turned-enslaver. A sense of gratitude and debt overcomes any language barriers: the once imprisoned wildman serves the company loyally for rescuing him.
739646dfb6e9313979bf.translation: 你与一个由驯兽人转为奴役者的家伙冲突时，“救”下了%name%。感激与报恩之心跨过了语言障碍：这个曾遭囚禁的荒野人忠诚地为战团效力，以报救命之恩。

c96333d68dfa18fdbb42.source: Shaken by the violence he witnessed
c96333d68dfa18fdbb42.translation: 亲眼目睹暴行，心有余悸

5d106d631409c36f7cdc.source: %townImage%Walking about %townname% with a few sellswords, you turn a corner to find an opulent man surrounded by thieves and bandits. They look over their shoulders and widen their eyes. One nicks the merchant on the cheek.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, we'll get you next time ya bastard!%SPEECH_OFF%The scoundrels quickly make their leave. A moment later and the merchant's heavily-armed guards appear. Nursing his wound, he starts yelling at them.%SPEECH_ON%What am I paying you for you sorry bastards? The second I get into trouble and you're nowhere to be seen? Look at this man here, that's who I should be paying! Hey, take this for your troubles, stranger.%SPEECH_OFF%The merchant throws you a satchel of crowns for your 'trouble,' though all you did was turn a corner and run into a coincidence.
5d106d631409c36f7cdc.translation: %townImage%你带着几个弟兄在%townname%闲逛，拐过街角，正撞见一个衣着华贵的男人被一群贼匪围住。他们回头看见你们，顿时瞪大了眼。其中一个在商人脸上划了一刀。%SPEECH_ON%好，算你走运，下回再收拾你这混蛋！%SPEECH_OFF%恶棍们迅速溜走。片刻后，商人那些全副武装的护卫才赶来。他捂着伤口，冲他们破口大骂。%SPEECH_ON%我花钱养你们这群废物干什么？一出事就连个人影都找不到？看看这位，我的钱就该付给他！喂，陌生人，拿着，辛苦你了。%SPEECH_OFF%商人扔来一袋克朗，酬谢你的“辛苦”。可你做的，不过是拐了个弯，恰巧路过而已。

c9770e51653a2645b4e7.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%jouster% comes to you with a paper in hand. He slams it on your table and says he wishes to enter. You pick up the scroll, unfurling it to show that a local town is hosting a jousting tournament. The man crosses his arms, awaiting your response.
c9770e51653a2645b4e7.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%jouster%拿着一张纸来找你，啪地拍在桌上，说自己想参加。你拿起卷轴展开，原来附近镇子要举办骑枪比武大会。他抱起双臂，等着你答复。

b9b7ea279fff5c90eaa9.source: Very well, you may take part in this.

e5dbd47c79938a9ff9fb.source: No, we have more important matters to attend to.
e5dbd47c79938a9ff9fb.translation: 不行，我们还有更要紧的事。

4b232d67087548ab4bb7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]You agree to let %jouster% go to the tournament and, wanting to see it for yourself, you go along, too.

The jousting tourney crackles with energy as you near it. Squires hurry to and fro, carrying great armfulls of armor and weapons, and some step slowly about with enormous lances hefted over their shoulders. Other men brush very regal looking horses, many of which wear breastplates decorated with sigils. In the distance, you listen to brief gallops, heavy hooves stamping roughshod and lumbering and then there's a snapping twang of wood on metal and cheers erupt.

As you look about the festivities, a nobleman walks up and stops you. Weighing a purse in one hand and twisting a piece of broomstraw about the corner of his mouth with the other, he asks if you'd like to make a wager. You ask what for. He nods, pointing toward %jouster% who is across the mustering point signing himself into the tourney. Apparently he is to face this nobleman's own rider, a man by the name of %opponent%.%SPEECH_ON%A little bit of gamesmanship never hurt, no? How does %bet% crowns sound to you? Winner take all, of course.%SPEECH_OFF%
4b232d67087548ab4bb7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]你同意让%jouster%参加比武，自己也想亲眼看看，便一同前往。

还没走近，比武大会那股热烈的气氛便扑面而来。侍从们抱着大堆盔甲和武器来回奔忙，有的则肩扛巨大的骑枪，小心挪步。其他人正刷洗看上去格外神骏的马匹，其中许多还披着饰有纹章的胸甲。远处传来短促的疾驰声，沉重的铁蹄踏得粗砺而急骤，随后，木枪撞上金属，清脆断裂，欢呼声骤然爆发。

你正四处打量这场盛会，一名贵族走来拦住你。他一只手掂着钱袋，另一只手拨弄着咬在嘴角的细草梗，问你愿不愿意赌一把。你问赌什么。他点点头，指向候场处另一边正在报名的%jouster%。看来，他要对上的正是这位贵族麾下的骑士，一个名叫%opponent%的人。%SPEECH_ON%添点小彩头，总没坏处，对吧？%bet%克朗，怎么样？当然，赢的人全拿走。%SPEECH_OFF%

e34b9f23ca7bedceda77.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]You take a seat amongst commoners and noblemen alike. Only the local lord has any separation from the riff-raff, sitting on a heightened row with the likes of his sons, daughters, and various royalty from around the land.

%jouster% is up next, a squire helping lead his horse to one of the jousting lanes. Down the battleline, %opponent% rides onto the field, his horse black, his armor a vibrant purple with gold trimmings and tassels here and there. Both he and %jouster% take up their lances and slap down the faceplates of their helmets.

A barker shouts their names from the royal-box, and then a clergyman says a few words about how this was ordained by the gods and, were anybody here to die today, they'd sit amongst the greatest of men in the next realm, and be remembered with them in this one. All that said, the two jousters lower their lances and charge before either the barker or priest can even take a seat.
e34b9f23ca7bedceda77.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]你在平民与贵族混坐的人群中找了个座位。只有本地领主与这些杂七杂八的观众隔开，坐在高台的一排席位上，身边是他的子女，以及来自各地的王公贵胄。

下一场轮到%jouster%。一名侍从帮他把马牵到比武跑道的一端。另一端，%opponent%骑马入场，胯下是匹黑马，身上鲜紫色的甲胄饰有金边，几处还垂着流苏。他与%jouster%各自举起骑枪，啪地合上头盔的面甲。

司仪从贵宾席上高声报出他们的名字，随后一名教士讲了几句，说这场比武乃是诸神的旨意；今日若有人战死，便会在来世与最伟大的人物同席，在现世也将与他们一同流芳。话音刚落，两名骑士便放平骑枪，策马冲出，连司仪和教士都还没来得及坐下。

f3a40aa8a29605260e58.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]Having never been to such an event, you can't help but hold your breath as the two riders barrel down the lanes toward each other. The horses are majestic, their legs in rhythm, their hooves tearing up great clods of earth, their armors glinting sundots across the crowds as they run, altogether leaving in their wake streams of giddy observers and shouting kids and drunks spilling their raised mugs and young princesses gripping their dresses and wantingly brave princes clapping their hands and, not knowing how it even came to be, you yourself are standing and shouting.

 %opponent% struggles to keep his aim steady, his lance bobbing up and down, the point of it wobbling in search of a true target.

He doesn't find it.
f3a40aa8a29605260e58.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]你从未看过这样的比赛。两名骑手沿着赛道迎面疾驰时，你不由屏住呼吸。骏马昂扬，四蹄起落有序，蹬起大块泥土；飞驰间，甲胄将点点阳光反射到人群之中。它们所过之处，观众兴奋得如痴如醉，孩子们放声尖叫，醉汉举着杯子洒得满身是酒，年轻公主攥紧裙摆，渴望展现勇气的王子们不停鼓掌。连你自己都不知何时已经站起身来，跟着大喊大叫。

 %opponent%竭力稳住骑枪，可枪杆仍上下颠簸，枪尖晃来晃去，迟迟对不准目标。

最终，他也没能瞄准。

3685469a172fedf6f869.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]%jouster%'s lance shatters on his opponent's chest, a proverbial explosion of sawdust and splinters through which rides a horse with no rider, the jouster having been driven back over his cantle and clear of his saddle altogether, coming facedown on the battleground with nary a move or breath. A roar bursts from the crowd, an uncorked tempest which you are quick to join, drowning your ears in a blistering cacophony, swept up in a time and place you will never forget.
3685469a172fedf6f869.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]%jouster%的骑枪在对手胸前炸裂，木屑与碎片四散飞扬。一匹空鞍的马从中冲出，骑手已被击得越过鞍后桥，整个摔离马背，面朝下落在场地上，几乎连动静与呼吸都没有。人群爆发出怒涛般的欢呼，你也立刻加入，任震耳欲聋的喧嚣淹没双耳。这一时、这一地，你永远不会忘记。

6aaee3f56e1f8842f15e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]%jouster%'s lance shatters on his opponent's chest, a proverbial explosion of sawdust and splinters through which rides a horse with no rider, the jouster having been driven back over his cantle and clear of his saddle altogether, coming facedown on the battleground with nary a move or breath. A roar bursts from the crowd, an uncorked tempest which you are quick to join, drowning your ears in a blistering cacophony, swept up in a time and place you will never forget.

While still celebrating, the nobleman you made a wager with comes over and places a purse into your hand. You wish to say a few words, but before you can he angrily turns and walks off.
6aaee3f56e1f8842f15e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]%jouster%的骑枪撞上对手胸膛，炸成漫天木屑与碎刺。一匹空鞍战马冲出碎屑飞扬的云团；它背上的骑手被撞得向后翻过鞍桥，整个掀下马背，脸朝下摔在场中，几乎没了动静与气息。人群的欢呼骤然爆发，仿佛挣脱束缚的风暴。你也立刻加入呐喊，双耳淹没在震天喧嚣之中。这一刻的狂热将你彻底卷入，成了永难忘怀的记忆。

你还在庆祝，先前与你对赌的贵族走过来，把一只钱袋塞进你手里。你本想说上两句，可还没开口，他便怒气冲冲地转身离去了。

091d6b498bae1dae8df6.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]Having never been to such an event, you can't help but hold your breath as the two riders barrel down the lanes toward each other. The horses are majestic, their legs in rhythm, their hooves tearing up great clods of earth, their armors glinting sundots across the crowds as they run, altogether leaving in their wake streams of giddy observers and shouting kids and drunks spilling their raised mugs and young princesses gripping their dresses and wantingly brave princes clapping their hands and, not knowing how it even came to be, you yourself are standing and shouting.

%jouster% struggles to keep his aim steady, his lance bobbing up and down, the point of it wobbling in search of a true target.

He doesn't find it.
091d6b498bae1dae8df6.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]你从未看过这样的比赛。两名骑手沿着赛道迎面疾驰时，你不由屏住呼吸。骏马昂扬，四蹄起落有序，蹬起大块泥土；飞驰间，甲胄将点点阳光反射到人群之中。它们所过之处，观众兴奋得如痴如醉，孩子们放声尖叫，醉汉举着杯子洒得满身是酒，年轻公主攥紧裙摆，渴望展现勇气的王子们不停鼓掌。连你自己都不知何时已经站起身来，跟着大喊大叫。

%jouster%竭力稳住骑枪，可枪杆仍上下颠簸，枪尖晃来晃去，迟迟对不准目标。

最终，他也没能瞄准。

ffef8ea5d63e5c54084f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]%opponent%'s lance explodes as it lands square on %jouster%'s chest. The man is bent back in his saddle, a cloud of spinning splinters and powdered wood swirling in his wake. He reaches desperately for his reins. Finding them, you think he's recovered, but the bridlebit breaks off and the reins slip free. %jouster% falls backward, tumbling over the mount's hindquarters and landing on his feet. Standing he may be, he's lost.

The crowd erupts, clapping fervently to both winner and loser. Rolling his shoulder in a bit of pain, %jouster% clears the field. You find him back at the mustering grounds. He says something was off about his lance, and you mention that his horse's bridlebit came loose. Just then, the winner walks by, a retinue of adoring women behind him and a squire leading a rather pompous looking horse. To your surprise, %opponent% and %jouster% shake hands and bid each other congratulations on a well-fought match.
ffef8ea5d63e5c54084f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]%opponent%的骑枪正中%jouster%的胸口，当场炸成碎片。他在马鞍上向后仰去，身后卷起纷飞的木刺和木屑。他拼命伸手去抓缰绳。好不容易抓住，你以为他已经稳住了，马嚼子却突然断脱，缰绳也随之松开。%jouster%向后跌去，翻过马臀，双脚落地。他虽然站住了，却已输了比赛。

观众欢声雷动，为胜者和败者都送上热烈的掌声。%jouster%忍痛转着肩膀，离开赛场。你在候场处找到了他。他说自己的骑枪有些不对劲，你则提起，他的马嚼子也松脱了。就在这时，获胜者从旁边经过，身后跟着一群满眼倾慕的女人，还有一名侍从，牵着匹看上去颇为神气的马。令你意外的是，%opponent%与%jouster%握了握手，互相称赞对方打了一场漂亮的比赛。

db17112770906149d374.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]%opponent%'s lance explodes as it lands square on %jouster%'s chest. The man is bent back in his saddle, a cloud of spinning splinters and powdered wood swirling in his wake. He reaches desperately for his reins. Finding them, you think he's recovered, but the bridlebit breaks off and the reins slip free. %jouster% falls backward, tumbling over the mount's hindquarters and landing on his feet. Standing he may be, he's lost.

 The crowd erupts, clapping fervently to both winner and loser. Rolling his shoulder in a bit of pain, %jouster% clears the field. You find him back at the mustering grounds. He says something was off about his lance, and you mention that his horse's bridlebit came loose. Just then, the winner walks by, a retinue of adoring women behind him and a squire leading a rather pompous looking horse. To your surprise, %opponent% and %jouster% shake hands and bid each other congratulations on a well-fought match. 

 The nobleman you made a wager with isn't so keen on good sportsmanship. He comes to you rubbing his hands beneath a cheap grin. You begrudgingly pay the man what he is owed.
db17112770906149d374.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_96.png[/img]%opponent%的骑枪正中%jouster%的胸口，当场炸成碎片。他在马鞍上向后仰去，身后卷起纷飞的木刺和木屑。他拼命伸手去抓缰绳。好不容易抓住，你以为他已经稳住了，马嚼子却突然断脱，缰绳也随之松开。%jouster%向后跌去，翻过马臀，双脚落地。他虽然站住了，却已输了比赛。

 观众欢声雷动，为胜者和败者都送上热烈的掌声。%jouster%忍痛转着肩膀，离开赛场。你在候场处找到了他。他说自己的骑枪有些不对劲，你则提起，他的马嚼子也松脱了。就在这时，获胜者从旁边经过，身后跟着一群满眼倾慕的女人，还有一名侍从，牵着匹看上去颇为神气的马。令你意外的是，%opponent%与%jouster%握了握手，互相称赞对方打了一场漂亮的比赛。 

 跟你打赌的那位贵族，可没这么热衷于比武的风度。他搓着手走来，脸上挂着讨厌的笑。你不情不愿地付了赌账。

c97f9d92f35d7ec2a74e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]Telling %jouster% no does not go over well. He goes on a great deal about how much money he could have made at the tournament and how you are robbing him of those crowns. All very interesting complaints, sure, until he turns to you and demands %compensation% crowns, compensation for what he claims are lost earnings.
c97f9d92f35d7ec2a74e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你拒绝了%jouster%，他很不高兴，滔滔不绝地说起自己本可在比武大会挣到多少钱，而你又如何夺走了那些克朗。这些抱怨听来倒挺有意思——直到他转身索要%compensation%克朗，声称要你赔偿他损失的收入。

608282b0dc788b286234.source: Very well, I shall compensate you.

cbb039c7b3ebb108a427.source: You're a mercenary now, not a jouster. Better get used to it.
cbb039c7b3ebb108a427.translation: 你如今是佣兵，别再惦记骑枪比武了。早点习惯吧。

66aaae1114ba8e97cae3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You stand up and pat %jouster% on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%I've no doubt that a man of your skill and prowess would have run clean through the tournament. But I need a man such as yourself here, at camp. You need not prove any lost earnings, I will compensate you for them simply enough.%SPEECH_OFF%The rather diplomatic words calm the man down. He nods and briefly looks as though it would be dishonorable to accept the payment. Not wanting the sellsword to test his resolve any further, or perhaps look a fool or a man of low honor, you order him to take it.
66aaae1114ba8e97cae3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你起身拍拍%jouster%的肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%凭你的本事和勇武，我毫不怀疑你能横扫大会。可营地这里也需要你这样的人。无须证明损失了多少收入，我会补偿。%SPEECH_OFF%这番圆融的话让他平静下来。他点点头，有那么一瞬，似乎觉得拿这钱有失体面。你不想让他继续为难，也不想让他显得愚蠢或贪财，便命令他收下。

fd48aa5de087ca6caa8b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You grab the tournament poster and put it to a candle. While flames eat away the paper, you set some ground rules for %jouster%.%SPEECH_ON%I hired you to be a sellsword, not some nimby-namby jouster. If you want to go off fighting in tournaments, then you can return all your equipment and base pay. Otherwise, get the hell out of my tent.%SPEECH_OFF%This doesn't go over especially well, but ultimately the mercenary does only leave your tent and not the whole company altogether.
fd48aa5de087ca6caa8b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你拿起比武告示，凑到烛火上。火焰吞噬纸张时，你给%jouster%立下规矩。%SPEECH_ON%我雇你来当佣兵，不是当个矫情的比武骑士。想出去打比武大会，就把装备和雇佣费都退回来。否则，滚出我的帐篷。%SPEECH_OFF%他显然不怎么受用，不过最终走出的只是帐篷，并没有离开战团。

a8f9f537f75cbd29aa75.source: Was denied participation in a jousting tournament
a8f9f537f75cbd29aa75.translation: 未获准参加骑枪比武大会

6adfbc3372f0529369b1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]As the men wander through %townname% looking for things to do, %juggler% the juggler takes it upon himself to provide his own entertainment. He takes a message barker's scroll and folds it into a paper hat with horns. Placing it upon his head, he then glides into a crowd of peasants and asks for anything with which to juggle. They toss him all manner of objects from carrots to knives and one man even offers a newborn infant before the mother slaps him for even suggesting it. Whatever is thrown up there, the juggler easily hurls through the air, his own body twisting and turning, his feet alternating between hands to kick things back into the air. It's dexterous poetry in motion - and a boon for the town's downtrodden. You get the feeling that the juggler has represented the %companyname% well this day.
6adfbc3372f0529369b1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]弟兄们在%townname%闲逛找乐子，杂耍艺人%juggler%索性自己找起了乐。他拿过传令人的卷轴，折成一顶长角的纸帽戴上，轻快地钻进农民堆里，讨要任何能拿来抛接的东西。人们扔来胡萝卜、刀子，五花八门；甚至有人想递上刚出生的婴儿，才一提议，就被孩子母亲扇了一巴掌。不管抛来的是什么，艺人都能轻巧地让它在空中翻飞。他转身扭腰，手脚交替接物，再用脚将东西踢回半空。动作灵巧得如同一首活的诗，也让镇上那些愁苦的人得了片刻欢乐。你觉得，今天他着实替%companyname%挣了个好名声。

b5fd4f4d0d13df856a24.source: One of your men entertained the masses
b5fd4f4d0d13df856a24.translation: 你的一个手下逗乐了民众

1f18bf8ab21c27bac6b8.source: One of your men entertained the townsfolk
1f18bf8ab21c27bac6b8.translation: 你的一个手下逗乐了镇民

c2669eb36f5ee4d07d27.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%juggler% the light-footed, swift-handed juggler is going around asking the brothers to throw him some knives. It appears that he is looking to show off his act.
c2669eb36f5ee4d07d27.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]手快脚轻的杂耍艺人%juggler%正四处请弟兄们朝他扔刀子。看来，他想露一手。

b1a19b392b2ef060f654.source: Let's see what you can do!

1a70dd7e4d8bf04def74.source: That's not what I'm paying you for.
1a70dd7e4d8bf04def74.translation: 我付钱可不是让你干这个的。

ebc048eee02c58cf1c5e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%nonjuggler% throws a knife across the campground. The blade turns in the sun and you see a strobe of reflected light beam across the juggler's eyes. He blinks just long enough for the weapon to sheathe itself in his shoulder. He blinks again, just long enough for the pain to start kicking in. Within a moment, %juggler% is bowled over, clutching his wound in howling pain. A few men tend to him while others can only laugh.
ebc048eee02c58cf1c5e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%nonjuggler%隔着营地掷出一把刀。刀锋在阳光下翻转，一道反光掠过杂耍艺人的双眼。他只眨了一下，刀就扎进了肩膀。再眨一下，疼痛才涌上来。转眼间，%juggler%已经弯倒在地，捂着伤口嚎叫。有几个弟兄赶去照料，另一些却笑得停不下来。

1a700ce0aa437e6de3aa.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]The axe %juggler% asked for is picked up and heaved toward him. It spins at an awkward angle as if the man who threw it intentionally sent it wobbling in indeterminate ways. Not expecting this, the juggler adjusts to try and catch the haywire axe handle, but the weapon smashes into one of the daggers and cuts across his shoulder. He falls to the ground in an instant, a shower of knives falling all around him. While some men tend to his wounds, other can't help but be delighted in his suffering.
1a700ce0aa437e6de3aa.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]有人拿起%juggler%要的斧头，朝他掷去。斧头转得十分别扭，像是出手的人存心让它乱晃。杂耍艺人始料未及，急忙调整姿势，想抓住乱转的斧柄；可斧头撞上一把匕首，划过他的肩膀。他瞬间倒地，刀子如雨落在四周。一些人上前处理伤口，另一些则忍不住幸灾乐祸。

00079a73e60c3dccff30.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%nonjuggler% picks up the requested flail and, after a moment's hesitation, lofts it toward %juggler%. Mid-flight, the chain of the weapon wraps around the handle. The juggler seems to adjust himself for it, but at the last moment the chain unfurls, whipping back around with deadly intent. You see the man's eyes flare open as he sees a calamity he can't stop from coming. The flail crashes through his maelstrom of metal and clips him in the face. Knocked out cold, he spins on his feet and collapses to the ground. A falling dagger penetrates his leg and the axe cuts tumbles right into his hip. The men gasp in horror and soon every one of them gets up and rushes to his aid.
00079a73e60c3dccff30.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%nonjuggler%拿起他要的连枷，迟疑片刻，抛向%juggler%。连枷飞到半空，铁链绕住了握柄。艺人似乎已经调整好动作，准备接住，可就在最后一刻，铁链突然展开，凶险地甩了回来。他眼睛猛然睁大，眼看着灾祸逼近，却再也无力阻止。连枷撞穿飞旋的利刃，打在他脸上。他当场昏厥，身子打了个转，倒在地上。一把落下的匕首刺穿了他的腿，斧头也翻滚着砍进了他的胯部。弟兄们惊恐地倒吸一口凉气，随即纷纷起身，冲上去救人。

90c9f5b93b26b27d6443.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You sit down and let the men throw %juggler% a few knives and daggers. They come in and at all shapes and sizes, and from all angles, but he catches them with ease and starts tossing them up into the air, their revolutions glinting and sparkling in the sunlight. Being that each weapon carries a different weight, you're impressed by how able he is to keep them all going in seamless unison.

 Of course, that couldn't just be the end of it. With one hand alternately waving the men on in between juggles, he asks for someone to throw him an axe.
90c9f5b93b26b27d6443.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你坐下，让弟兄们给%juggler%扔去几把小刀和匕首。兵器大小各异，从四面飞来，他却接得轻轻松松，随即一把把抛向空中，翻转的刀锋在阳光下闪闪发亮。每件兵器分量不同，他却能让它们毫不相撞、流转如一，这本事着实令人佩服。

当然，他还不肯就此收场。一只手趁抛接间隙朝众人招呼，请谁再扔把斧头来。

382b774a5ecf19dfc068.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%nonjuggler% gets up and heaves an axe into the orbit of %juggler%'s incredible act. The juggler's ring of dangerous weaponry seems to eat the axe in an instant, the weapon simply joining the rest of the knives and daggers in a seamless transition. The men clap and cheer, though a few are seen grinning as though they are waiting for this deck of incredibly sharp cards to come crashing down.

 But this isn't the end of the act, apparently. This time not waving anybody on, but simply focusing on the swooshing, swishing weaponry swirling about him, the juggler asks for a flail. Someone stands up.%SPEECH_ON%Did he say a flail?%SPEECH_OFF%The juggler stamps his foot.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, a flail! Throw me a flail!%SPEECH_OFF%
382b774a5ecf19dfc068.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%nonjuggler%站起身，把一柄斧头抛进%juggler%那令人眼花缭乱的杂耍阵中。飞旋的利器仿佛一口吞下了斧头，它转眼便与其他刀刃和匕首融为一体，衔接得天衣无缝。弟兄们鼓掌欢呼，也有几个咧嘴坏笑，似乎正等着这座由利刃搭成的纸牌屋轰然倒塌。

 可表演显然还没结束。这回，杂耍艺人没法再招手示意，只能紧盯着身边呼啸翻飞的兵器，开口要一柄连枷。有人站了起来。%SPEECH_ON%他说的是连枷？%SPEECH_OFF%艺人跺了跺脚。%SPEECH_ON%对，连枷！扔一柄连枷过来！%SPEECH_OFF%

4c8f9a50b148a18a49bf.source: Impossible and yet... I want to see it!
4c8f9a50b148a18a49bf.translation: 这怎么可能……可我还真想看看！

70b76528475e3be7f44a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]A flail is retrieved and lobbed toward %juggler%. Everyone grimaces as the flail snakes and twirls and undulates toward the spinning storm of weaponry the juggler calls his 'act.' But, just like the axe, it is quickly absorbed into the maelstrom of metal. Louder than ever, the men get to their feet to cheer and clap. A few sigh in relief, wiping sweat from their brow, while others can only grin and clap, being rather disappointed that nothing spectacularly awful didn't happen, but impressed nonetheless.
70b76528475e3be7f44a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]有人找来链枷，朝%juggler%抛去。链枷蜿蜒翻转、起伏飞来，扑向他所谓“表演”的那团兵器旋风，众人看得龇牙咧嘴。可它和斧头一样，很快就融入了金属漩涡。弟兄们站起来，喝彩与掌声比先前更响。有人松口气，擦去额头的汗；有人没看到什么惊天惨剧，虽有些失望，仍不得不咧嘴鼓掌，佩服他的本事。

457c57b3cdb3b5805199.source: Failed his act and injured himself

d8b31c21ed2a02fb468a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]You find a kid wearing a rather opulent chain around his neck. It's so heavy his head is bent forward, but that minor struggle doesn't wipe the mile wide grin off his face. %randombrother% pushes the kid down and takes the necklace.%SPEECH_ON%Where did you get this?%SPEECH_OFF%The kid cries out, trying to grab his treasure back, but he's about three feet and a good jump too short.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, that's mine! Give it back!%SPEECH_OFF%Another kid comes over flashing a ring so large it's pinching two fingers at once. Alright. That's enough. The company fans out and eventually find a dead merchant in some tall grass beside a treeline. His face is purpled and jagged with broken bones. It appears he has been stoned to death.

 A group of about forty or fifty youngsters appear from the treeline, each juggling a stone in hand. Their leader, a little runt with red hair and sleeves of tattoos, asks what you want. You tell him that you'll be taking the merchant's goods. The leader laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Oy is that so? I'll give ya ten seconds to rethink that choice, oy that I will, mister!%SPEECH_OFF%
d8b31c21ed2a02fb468a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]你发现一个孩子脖子上挂着条相当奢华的项链，重得他脑袋直往前垂，可这点不便丝毫没能抹去他脸上夸张的笑容。%randombrother%把孩子推倒，夺下项链。%SPEECH_ON%哪儿来的？%SPEECH_OFF%孩子叫喊着，想把宝贝抢回去，可他个头矮了约三英尺，就算使劲跳起来，也还是够不着。%SPEECH_ON%喂，那是我的！还给我！%SPEECH_OFF%另一个孩子走来，炫耀着一枚大得要套住两根手指的戒指。好吧，够了。战团散开搜寻，终于在林缘旁的高草中找到一个死去的商人。他的脸青紫肿胀，碎裂的骨头顶得面容凹凸不平，看来是被石头活活砸死的。

四五十个少年从林缘现身，手里各掂着一块石头。领头的是个红头发的小个子，两条胳膊布满刺青。他问你想干什么，你告诉他，商人的货物归你们了。小头目笑了。%SPEECH_ON%哟，是吗？先生，我就给你十秒，重新想想这个主意，十秒！%SPEECH_OFF%

6dfc765f8f3e50b276b6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]Despite the miniature military force arrayed before you, the goods are ordered to be taken. The little tyke in charge of this operation screams a warcry more dying cat than diving hawk.%SPEECH_ON%Take them down! Throw! Throw! Throooowww!%SPEECH_OFF%On his command, the mob of children start hurling stones from the treeline. The sellswords band together, holding shields up in a formation akin to a tortoise, and slowly move forward. It's a strange effort, like a shell-game artist sliding his cup over the ball, but the company manages to grab the merchant's goods and slide away out of the field, all the while being pelted from every which way. The little leader kid shakes his fist at you. You give him the finger and start back onto the path where you take a good look at the merchant's goods. %randombrother% stares at the rewards while rubbing a welt on his forehead.%SPEECH_ON%Goddam, man. I've seen armies not nearly so fierce. I weep for the future men who have to cross swords with those lads and lasses.%SPEECH_OFF%
6dfc765f8f3e50b276b6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]尽管眼前摆开了一支小小军队，你还是命人搬走货物。领头的小鬼发出一声战吼，听着不像俯冲的鹰，倒像垂死的猫。%SPEECH_ON%打倒他们！扔！扔！给我扔啊！%SPEECH_OFF%他一声令下，孩子们纷纷从林缘投出石头。佣兵聚拢起来，举盾结成龟壳般的阵形，缓缓向前挪动。这场面着实古怪，活像街头耍把戏的人把杯子滑到小球上方。不过，战团总算搬走了商人的货物，又顶着四面八方飞来的石头，一点点退离了空地。领头的小鬼朝你挥舞拳头，你回敬他一根中指，走回道路，仔细查看缴获的货物。%randombrother%盯着战利品，揉着额头上的肿包。%SPEECH_ON%老天，伙计。我见过的有些军队都没这么凶。以后谁要跟这群男孩女孩刀剑相向，我可真替他们难过。%SPEECH_OFF%

9f8d57af549817b95ae0.source: Those little bastards really gave it to us.
9f8d57af549817b95ae0.translation: 这帮小崽子还真让我们吃了苦头。

33a2e8e5ab95802a24ff.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]%hedgeknight% steps forward and heaves his weapon to the fore. He waves it at all the kids.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, so you want to be little bandits or heroes or some such shit? Well, that's good. That's fine. But I'll be watching to see who throws the first stone. He, or she, who does so will find out what happens when I get angry. And then after the rest of you have watched, I'll kill the lot of you. And I'll follow your little footprints all the way home, find your kin, and smash their farkin' heads in.%SPEECH_OFF%The hedge knight pauses to glare about.%SPEECH_ON%So, which of you shall throw the first stone?%SPEECH_OFF%The tyke in charge of this miniature army raises his hand and speaks.%SPEECH_ON%Let the men go. We've better things to do than quarrel with these travelers.%SPEECH_OFF%Hey, that's a wise move. With pride-swallowing smarts like that the red-headed bugger might someday lead a company to great fortunes. But this day is yours. You take the merchant's goods and make your leave.
33a2e8e5ab95802a24ff.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]%hedgeknight%迈步上前，把武器横在身前，朝那群孩子挥了挥。%SPEECH_ON%啊，你们想当小强盗、小英雄，还是什么狗屁玩意儿？好啊，挺好。不过我会盯着，看是谁先扔石头。不管是男孩还是女孩，第一个动手的，都会知道惹怒我是什么下场。等你们其他人看完了，我再把你们全杀光。然后沿着你们的小脚印一路找到家，揪出你们的亲人，把他们的狗头统统砸烂。%SPEECH_OFF%流浪骑士停下来，瞪着眼扫视四周。%SPEECH_ON%那么，谁先扔第一块石头？%SPEECH_OFF%率领这支小小军队的孩子举起手，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%让他们走。我们还有更重要的事，没空跟这些过路人争执。%SPEECH_OFF%嘿，明智之举。这红头发的小子懂得把面子咽下去，将来或许真能带领一支战团赚下大笔财富。不过，今天占上风的是你。你拿走商人的货物，离开了这里。

322649fc21cc245ca11d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]While you attempt to study some poorly drawn maps, the sound of blades being drawn pierces your ears. You roll up your work and put it into a scroll's sleeve before making way to the disturbance.

%killerontherun% is being held down by one brother's knee, while %otherguy1% and %otherguy2% look about ready to chop his head off. Seeing your arrival, the men calm down for a moment. They explain that the killer tried to slay one of them. Indeed, the brother has a nick on his neck. A little bit deeper and something other than words would be coming out of his mouth right about now. The men demand %killerontherun% be hanged for this attempted murder.
322649fc21cc245ca11d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你正努力研究几张画得蹩脚的地图，刀剑出鞘的声音突然传进耳中。你卷好地图，收进卷筒，前去查看动静。

一个弟兄用膝盖把%killerontherun%死死压在地上，%otherguy1%和%otherguy2%则像是随时准备砍下他的脑袋。见你来了，众人暂时冷静了一些，解释说这杀人犯刚才想杀掉他们中的一个。那弟兄脖子上果然有一道伤口，再深一点，此刻从他嘴里出来的恐怕就不只是话了。众人要求把%killerontherun%绞死，惩罚这次谋杀未遂。

1b59fecb833810c157f3.source: This is your family now. Do not ever dare such a thing again!
1b59fecb833810c157f3.translation: 如今这些人就是你的家人。你再敢干这种事试试！

519d256587c6464590a9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]You order the man flogged. %killerontherun% spits on your name as the brothers tie him up to a tree. You say do that again and you'll add more lashings. They rip his shirt off and take turns with the whip as you stand by the side, counting. On the first lash a straight line of skin is stripped from his back. The man flinches and you hear the ropes that bind him draw taut as his hands clench into fists. By the fifth lashing he is no longer standing. By the tenth he is no longer awake. After five more you call it and order the men to take him down and tend his wounds.
519d256587c6464590a9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_38.png[/img]你命人鞭笞。弟兄们将%killerontherun%绑上树时，他破口辱骂你。你说，再骂就多加几鞭。他们撕开他的上衣，轮流执鞭，你在旁边数着。第一鞭便从背上抽掉一长条皮。那人猛地一缩，双手攥拳，你听见捆他的绳索骤然绷紧。到第五鞭，他已经站不住了。第十鞭时，他已失去知觉。又打了五鞭，你才叫停，命弟兄们把他放下来，照料伤口。

caa84c1e29814736e222.source: I hope this is a lesson learned.
caa84c1e29814736e222.translation: 但愿他记住了这个教训。

219ea2b8390349954425.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]While you try to bring peace between a party of misfits, your attempts for neutrality only seem to anger a few of the men. In particular, the man with the nicked neck is seething, swearing and kicking things over. A few of the other men worry aloud about a lack of discipline.
219ea2b8390349954425.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你试着让这群难缠的家伙和睦相处，可保持中立的做法似乎只惹怒了几个人。尤其脖子被划伤的那个，气得破口大骂，踢翻东西。另一些弟兄则公开担忧起战团的纪律。

5e0e1d1587f89826b7bc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]The call for cooler heads to prevail seems to have failed as %killerontherun%'s body is found dead anyway. {It appears someone stabbed him in the back. | Someone garroted the man with a line of strong linen. | He was nearly chopped in half, the work of a truly angry person. | His head was found resting on his chest, his hands placed in such a manner as to be holding it. | Emphasis on the word 'body', as his head was nowhere to be found. | Someone had slit his throat in the night. | Bruises on his body and cuts on his hands suggests a fight, but whoever it was managed to gut the man anyway.} You have a good guess as to who did it, but none of the men seem all that upset about the man's death and certain proof would elude any kind of investigation. While all of that may be true, you still order the suspected brother to help bury the dead.
5e0e1d1587f89826b7bc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你劝众人冷静的努力似乎白费了，%killerontherun%还是被发现死了。{看起来，有人从背后捅了他。 | 有人用结实的麻绳将他勒死。 | 他几乎被劈成两半，下手的人显然怒不可遏。 | 他的头颅搁在胸前，双手被摆成捧着它的姿势。 | 准确地说，找到的只有无头尸体，脑袋根本不知所踪。 | 有人在夜里割开了他的喉咙。 | 身上的淤青与手上的刀伤表明，他曾奋力反抗，但凶手最终还是剖开了他的肚子。}你大致猜得到是谁干的，可弟兄们似乎都不为此人的死感到难过，真要调查，也找不出确凿证据。尽管如此，你仍命令那个可疑的弟兄帮忙埋葬死者。

894528a5ce57b4aad41c.source: Well, %killerontherun% isn't dead, but he stands before you broken and beaten. It looks like vengeful justice found him out anyway. He demands that some suspected brothers be punished for going around your orders. You consider this, but then ask the man what will happen if you continue this cycle of violence. It's hard to see the man's face as it is puffed up in blacks and purples, and his eyes are lost behind puckered lids, but he nods gingerly. You are right, he says. It is best to let this whole thing die down lest it get out of control.
894528a5ce57b4aad41c.translation: %killerontherun%倒是没死，可站在你面前时，已经被打得不成人形。看来，报复终究找上了他。他要求惩罚几个涉嫌违抗你命令的弟兄。你想了想，反问他：若继续这般以暴还暴，最后会怎样？他满脸青紫肿胀，眼睛埋在鼓起的眼皮后，几乎看不清神情，只小心地点头。他说，你是对的。最好让整件事慢慢平息，免得彻底失控。

4650dccd33c5878f3c63.source: Angry about lack of justice under your command
4650dccd33c5878f3c63.translation: 因你治下有冤不伸而愤怒

b57e898fd256ad5e5117.source: Was beaten up by men of the company
b57e898fd256ad5e5117.translation: 被战团里的弟兄痛打了一顿

d71bec392558530255d8.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]Riders crest a nearby hill, their silhouettes dark and oddly shaped on its rim like a reef of rippling black. Not wholly able to see who they are, you order a few of your brothers to hide away. An ambush might be needed to defend yourself otherwise you stand no chance against such a mounted force. As the selected mercenaries dip into the bushes, the horsemen begin heading down the hill. The thunder of the hooves grows louder, but you stand resolute, hoping to give your men a good show of bravery.

You see that the bannerman is carrying a sigil of %noblehousename%. Behind him another horseman is dragging a travois with a few shackled men for cargo. When the men arrive, their leader stands up between the withers of his horse and points at you before talking.%SPEECH_ON%Mercenary! We have by the lord's authority the right to claim the - shackled! - hands of a sir %criminal%. Said man is within your midst. He must pay for his crimes. Hand him over immediately and you will be rewarded.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn your head and spit. You nod at the lawman before asking him a question.%SPEECH_ON%And whose authority do you have? There are a lot of lords in these lands and not all of them pay me well.%SPEECH_OFF%The lawmen's captain sits back down in his saddle. His hands cross over his pommel, resting there with armored authority. He does not look the least bit amused and voices his displeasure as such.%SPEECH_ON%The punishment for willfully harboring a fugitive is death. You've but one more chance to release this criminal to me or you shall face a fate well suited for a sword-selling dog.%SPEECH_OFF%
d71bec392558530255d8.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_90.png[/img]一队骑手登上附近山丘，轮廓沿山脊铺开，漆黑而形状古怪，像一道起伏的黑色暗礁。还看不清来者身份，你便叫几个弟兄藏起来。面对这样的骑兵，正面毫无胜算，也许只能靠伏击自保。被点中的佣兵钻进灌木时，骑手们开始下坡。蹄声如雷，越来越响，你却站定不动，希望给弟兄们做个勇敢的榜样。

你看见掌旗手举着%noblehousename%的纹章。后方另一名骑手拖着一副曳架，上面载着几个戴镣铐的人。众人来到面前，领头者从马鞍上撑起身，指向你，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！奉领主之命，我们有权将一位名叫%criminal%的先生拿下——戴上镣铐！此人就在你们之中，必须为罪行付出代价。立即交人，你会得到奖赏。%SPEECH_OFF%你侧头啐了一口，朝执法者点点头，反问道。%SPEECH_ON%你奉的是谁的命？这片土地上的领主多得很，可不是个个都肯给我好价钱。%SPEECH_OFF%执法队长重新坐回鞍中，戴甲的双手交叠在鞍桥上，摆出十足威势。他丝毫不觉得好笑，开口便表露不满。%SPEECH_ON%蓄意窝藏逃犯，处以死刑。你只剩最后一次机会，把罪犯交给我，否则就去领受你这条卖命野狗应得的下场。%SPEECH_OFF%

a6d4e579afd4776decef.source: The company would only suffer if we fought over this. The man is yours.
a6d4e579afd4776decef.translation: 为这事动手只会害了战团。人归你们。

b6495ed643253cf28e6e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]You stand no chance against these men. Although it pains you mightily, you hand %criminal% over. He barks curses at you as the lawmen chain him up, and swears your name into the mud as they throw him in with the rest of the bound men. The captain of the lawmen trots his horse over to you. He sneers at you before throwing a purse of coins to the ground. His body is close and there's an opening in his armor. You could fit a knife in there, right between the ribs, lead the blade right to his heart. It'd be quick. But you wouldn't last much long after, and all of your men would be quickly slain.

Instead, you lean over and pick up the coins, swallow you pride, and say your thanks. The lawmen waste little time returning from whence they came.
b6495ed643253cf28e6e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_53.png[/img]你们根本不是这些人的对手。尽管心里难受至极，你还是交出了%criminal%。执法队给他套上锁链时，他冲你破口大骂；被扔进其他捆绑的囚犯堆里时，他仍在诅咒你的名字。队长骑马小跑到你面前，先冷笑一声，再把一袋钱扔在地上。他离得很近，甲胄间露着一条缝。你完全可以从那儿捅进一把刀，穿过肋骨，直刺心脏。很快就能了结。可之后你也活不了多久，手下的弟兄更会被迅速杀光。

于是，你俯身捡起钱袋，咽下这口气，道了声谢。执法队没多耽搁，沿来路返回了。

88577470d9058d8e2c82.source: I can't put the whole company on the line for you.
88577470d9058d8e2c82.translation: 我不能为你押上整个战团。

132de44ab0003e39e1ea.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]As the lawman stares at you, waiting for an answer, you let out a sharp whistle. Half of the company emerges from the bushes, whooping and hollering in ambush. The steed pulling the travois bucks its rider to the ground before taking off altogether, a group of wide-eyed criminals going along for the ride. Another lawman retreats, abandoning his troop.

%randombrother% plucks one man from his saddle while another brother drives a spear into a horse's chest, bringing both beast and man crashing to the ground. The captain falls off his horse when it rears up in wild fear. It's a hard tumble, but he manages to roll back to his feet only for the bucking horse to clip him in the head. It is a quick, blunt demise that leaves the captain face down in the cradle of his own helmet.

The rest of his men come to stand by his body and they look to you with vengeance in their eyes.
132de44ab0003e39e1ea.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]执法者盯着你，等你答话，你却吹了声尖锐的口哨。半个战团从灌木丛中跃出，呼喝着发动伏击。拉着拖架的马把骑手掀下地，狂奔而去，带着一群目瞪口呆的囚犯颠簸逃远。另一个执法者则抛下同伴，独自退走。

%randombrother%将一人从马鞍上拽下，另一个弟兄则把长矛刺进马胸，连人带马一同摔倒。队长的坐骑受惊直立，他也跌下马背。虽摔得重，他还是翻身站了起来，却被乱蹬的马蹄击中头部。他死得突然而干脆，脸朝下栽倒，脑袋埋在自己的头盔里。

剩下的手下站到尸体旁，望向你，眼中满是复仇的怒火。

22a2dcb56dbbc1413321.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]The captain of the lawmen snaps his fingers at one of the bannermen. He hands over a scroll which the captain unfurls before handing it to you. The man you see looks remarkably like %criminal%, but since you've been on the road the mercenary has gained a few scars that separate his visage from the one on the paper. But they won't buy that. So you lie instead.%SPEECH_ON%The man you're looking for is dead. He was a criminal, just as you said, and we found him thieving from our foods. %other_bro% ran a sword through him when we'd found out.%SPEECH_OFF%The brother looks at you, and then the lawmen. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%That I did. He had a mouthful of my bread when I stuck him like a pig! I saved the rest of the loaf for m'self, thank goodness.%SPEECH_OFF%The lawmen chuckle amongst themselves. Their captain looks back on them, his gaze a quieting one. He looks back to you. You can see why they shut up: his eyes are stern, unmoving, fierce, black. The man holds you in this stare for nearly half a minute before he nods and gathers his reins.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, mercenary. Thank you for letting us know.%SPEECH_OFF%The lawmen pack up and head back from whence they came. A sigh of relief passes over the company as a whole and you order the men hiding in the bushes to come out. It's a long road ahead and hopefully there won't be more problems like this one.
22a2dcb56dbbc1413321.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]执法队长朝一个掌旗手打了个响指。对方递来一卷纸，队长展开后交到你手里。画上的人与%criminal%像极了，只是这一路上，佣兵脸上添了几道疤，与画像稍有不同。可凭这点糊弄不过去。于是，你撒了个谎。%SPEECH_ON%你们要找的人已经死了。他确实是个罪犯，正如你所说。我们发现他偷吃粮食，%other_bro%一剑捅穿了他。%SPEECH_OFF%这位弟兄看了看你，又看了看执法队，点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，是我干的。我像杀猪一样捅进去时，他嘴里还塞着我的面包！谢天谢地，剩下的面包我还给自己保住了。%SPEECH_OFF%执法队员们笑了起来。队长回头看了他们一眼，众人随即安静下来。他又转向你。你明白他们为何噤声了：那双漆黑的眼睛严厉、凶狠，目光纹丝不动。他这样盯了你近半分钟，才点头收拢缰绳。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，佣兵。多谢告知。%SPEECH_OFF%执法队收拾妥当，沿来路离去。整个战团都松了一口气。你叫藏在灌木中的弟兄出来。前路还长，但愿别再遇上这样的麻烦。

d4513d5ecd8df10d92b9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]The captain hands you a scroll with %criminal%'s face on it. True, the resemblance is there. But the man has been in your company long enough to gain a scar or two. Maybe they won't realize it's him? You ask the criminal to step forward and, nervously, he does as told. You look to the captain.%SPEECH_ON%Is this the man you are after? I can see why you might think this is him, but look at these scars. The man in the drawing has none. And look at his hair! The one in the drawing is straight, and this man's is clearly matted and curly.%SPEECH_OFF%You stop because judging by the faces of your audience this isn't even coming close to working. The captain draws his sword.%SPEECH_ON%Do you take me for a fool? Kill them all.%SPEECH_OFF%Well, so much for that. Before the lawmen can charge you whistle as loud as you can. Half the company surges forth from the bushes, whooping and hollering like banshees. The sudden fright drives the horses wild, pitching their riders into the dirt and the travois-puller even runs off altogether, carrying with it a couple of very confused criminals.

%randombrother% comes charging across the field of mayhem with a spear in hand. He plunges it deep into the captain's steed, bringing both man and beast crashing to the ground. The lawmen, what's left of them, gather around their captain. Seemingly growling, the man wipes blood from his face and spits out a tooth. He grins a gapped smile before ordering his men to charge.
d4513d5ecd8df10d92b9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_78.png[/img]队长递来一卷纸，上面画着%criminal%的脸。确实，模样很像。可这人在战团待得够久，脸上已添了一两道疤。也许他们认不出来？你叫那罪犯上前，他紧张地照做。你看向队长。%SPEECH_ON%这是你们要找的人？我能理解你为什么觉得像，可看看这些疤，画里的人可没有。再看头发！画上是直的，这人却明摆着又乱又卷。%SPEECH_OFF%你停了下来，因为从听众的脸色看，这番话根本没起半点作用。队长拔剑。%SPEECH_ON%你当我是傻子？全杀了。%SPEECH_OFF%好吧，这招到此为止。执法队尚未冲锋，你已使出全力吹了一声口哨。半个战团从灌木中涌出，像报丧女妖般尖叫呼喊。突如其来的惊吓令马匹发狂，把骑手掀进泥里；拖曳架前的那匹马甚至径直逃走，还拖着几个一头雾水的囚犯。

%randombrother%持矛冲过混乱的场地，将矛深深扎入队长的坐骑，人和马轰然倒地。剩下的执法队员聚到队长身旁。那人仿佛在低吼，抹掉脸上的血，吐出一颗牙，露出漏齿的笑，随后下令冲锋。

6890ca5a5c34d95401fe.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]The captain's threats are cooled when you retrieve a large satchel of crowns. His men exchange glances as you hold the bag up.%SPEECH_ON%We've no time for this. What I have here is %bribe% crowns. Take it and go away. Stay, and earn yourself a grave. Your choice, lawman.%SPEECH_OFF%Sensing the stares of his fellow riders, the captain is especially careful in mulling this one over. He sizes up your men, and briefly does the same to his men. He must see great losses for he finally nods. Jerking his horse's bridle, he drives his steed forward and the two of you come face to face. You smile as you hand the crowns over.%SPEECH_ON%Spend it well.%SPEECH_OFF%The captain takes the satchel and cinches it to the side of his saddle, looping the leather harness over the hilt of a sword while his men look on. He nods, but does not smile back.%SPEECH_ON%My daughter is to be wed in a fortnight. I'd like to be there.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and bid the humorless captain farewell.%SPEECH_ON%May her husband be kind, and her children bountiful.%SPEECH_OFF%The captain haws his horse and leads it back to his men. They depart, the hooves of their mounts steadily thumping into the distance until there is nothing but the scratch of wind-tickled grass to fill the air.
6890ca5a5c34d95401fe.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]你拿出一大袋克朗，队长的威胁便缓了下来。你举起钱袋，他手下的人交换着眼神。%SPEECH_ON%我们没工夫耗在这里。这儿有%bribe%克朗，拿钱，走人。留下，就给自己挣座坟。执法官，你自己选。%SPEECH_OFF%察觉同伴们都在看着自己，队长格外谨慎地权衡起来。他打量你的弟兄，又匆匆看了看自己的人。想必看出了硬拼必然死伤惨重，终于点了头。他一扯缰绳，策马上前，与你面对面。你微笑着递出钱袋。%SPEECH_ON%好好花。%SPEECH_OFF%队长接过钱，在手下的注视中，将钱袋系到马鞍侧面，又把皮带绕过剑柄。他点了点头，却没回以笑容。%SPEECH_ON%我女儿两星期后成婚。我想亲眼看着。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，与这位不苟言笑的队长道别。%SPEECH_ON%愿她嫁得良人，儿孙满堂。%SPEECH_OFF%队长吆喝一声，拨马回到手下身边。他们离开了，马蹄声有节奏地渐行渐远，最后，空气里只剩风拂草叶的沙沙声。

e15d8c9bc278c2287e2a.source: What I don't do for you lot...
e15d8c9bc278c2287e2a.translation: 为了你们，我还真是什么事都干了……

e3492a2b050cd624a87c.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]You walk directly toward the captain, stopping halfway between your men and his. With your fists to your hips, you call out to the captain's lawmen, asking if they know the name of the %companyname%. You see a few of the riders shift up on their saddles, balancing tented arms on their pommels as they stare intently at your banner. They quickly sit back down and hushed whispers trickle down and back up their battle line.

One man calls out, asking if it's true that you shorn the noses of those you slay. It is not true, but you've no reason to spill the truth. Another man asks if %randombrother% is in your ranks, and if he has a necklace of ears and eats bonemeal for breakfast. You stifle the urge to laugh, only nodding in return. Quite naturally, the rumors overtake your opponents and they begin to cry out that this fight is not theirs to have.

The captain tells them that you're full of shit and to charge, but none follow his orders. Eventually, the captain is forced to turn back, heading after his men who are now in retreat.

The supposed cannibal-brother walks up, scratching his head.%SPEECH_ON%Bonemeal for breakfast?%SPEECH_OFF%A crackle of laughter rips through the company and soon a chant of 'don't eat me!' is to be had.
e3492a2b050cd624a87c.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_12.png[/img]你径直走向队长，在双方人马之间停下，双拳叉腰，高声问他手下的执法者们，是否听过%companyname%的名字。几个骑手在鞍上撑起身子，双臂支着鞍桥，仔细看向你的旗帜。很快，他们又坐了回去，低低的耳语沿着阵列来回传递。

有人喊着问，你是否真的会割下所杀之人的鼻子。这不是真的，但你没理由道出实情。另一个人问，%randombrother%是否在你麾下，是不是真的戴着耳朵串成的项链，早饭吃骨粉。你强忍笑意，只是点头。流言很快淹没了对面的队伍，他们开始嚷嚷，说这仗根本不该由自己来打。

队长骂你满嘴胡话，命令他们冲锋，可没人听从。最终，他也只得调头，追上已经撤退的手下。

传闻中吃人的那位弟兄挠着头走来。%SPEECH_ON%早饭吃骨粉？%SPEECH_OFF%战团里爆发出一阵大笑，不一会儿，众人便齐声喊起“别吃我！”。

e028c9756c2140135deb.source: Surely this isn't something that can't be solved with a fat purse of crowns?
e028c9756c2140135deb.translation: 一大袋克朗，难道还不能把这事了结？

8359c5e38d848ee0cd35.source: You know who it is you're threatening? The %companyname%!

a3c7e4da56aeadd8229a.source: You got a drawing of the man you're after? Let me take a look.
a3c7e4da56aeadd8229a.translation: 你们有要抓的人的画像吗？让我瞧瞧。

d28ab07316d3411937b3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]While approaching %townname%, a local man waves you down. He's standing beside the skeleton of what appears to be a mill. Exasperated, he explains that his laborers didn't show up today and he needs to finish the mill before a local baron arrives. If he doesn't finish it, the baron might not ever give him another contract. You do have a few former laborers in the company. Perhaps they can be used to help the man?
d28ab07316d3411937b3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]接近%townname%时，一个当地人挥手拦下你。他站在一座像是磨坊的建筑框架旁，焦急地解释，工人今天没来，可他必须赶在当地男爵到访前完工。不然，男爵可能再也不会给他工程做。战团里倒有几个当过工人的弟兄，或许能派去帮忙？

65a5b462c71f0fd82d67.source: You build, we kill. Find someone else.
65a5b462c71f0fd82d67.translation: 你们造房子，我们杀人。另找别人吧。

1b22f4b54603203d2442.source: Alright, I can spare a man or few.

bae6225dcaa4c9427afe.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]You agree to lend a few of the %companyname%'s finest to the project. They fall back into their old roles like a glove, quickly bandying about to collect resources, hammering, bricking, dooring? Whatever it is to put a door in, they do it and quickly. When it's all said and done, the local man comes to you grinning ear-to-ear. He hands a satchel over.%SPEECH_ON%You've earned this, good sir! And more, you've earned my word - I shall spread your benevolence whenever I can!%SPEECH_OFF%
bae6225dcaa4c9427afe.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你同意借出%companyname%的几个好手。他们重操旧业，熟练得像戴回旧手套，迅速收集材料，敲钉、砌砖、装门——反正把门安上去的活叫什么不重要，他们干得飞快。工程结束，当地人笑得合不拢嘴，走来递上一袋钱。%SPEECH_ON%大人，这是你们应得的！不止如此，我也向你保证，今后有机会，我就会传扬你们的善举！%SPEECH_OFF%

b2ef45f02551cb3c367c.source: Don't get too used to this kind of work, men.
b2ef45f02551cb3c367c.translation: 弟兄们，别干这种活干上了瘾。

95e2f635d240b8d6c215.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]You agree to help the man. Unfortunately, it appears as though he didn't plan things out too well. The rooftop collapses the second one of your 'laborers' steps foot on it, sending the man through a sinkhole of shingles. Another man hammers a nail into place only for the wooden support to splinter right in two, catching him in the face with shards of wood. Loose bricks find freedom, wet mud has men slipping, and all manner of workplace hazards ends the whole project in disaster.

 The local man apologizes profusely in between biting his nails and wondering how he's going to deal with the baron. Snapping his fingers, he exclaims that he'll just pay him the crowns.
95e2f635d240b8d6c215.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你答应帮忙。可惜，那人似乎根本没把工程安排妥当。你的一个“工人”刚踩上屋顶，屋面就塌了，将他连人带瓦吞进破洞。另一个弟兄才钉下一颗钉子，木支架便劈成两半，飞溅的碎木扎了他一脸。松动的砖头纷纷掉落，湿泥让人脚下打滑，各种险情接踵而至，整项工程最终成了一场灾难。

 那个当地人一边不停道歉，一边咬着指甲，发愁该如何向男爵交代。最后，他一打响指，大声说，干脆直接给男爵交钱算了。

50f02b35a45f2bfbc986.source: Good luck with the baron, then.
50f02b35a45f2bfbc986.translation: 那祝你应付男爵时好运。

859d490f6c82a5f5385c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]As the man's mind drifts off into a satisfactory conclusion of his problem, you snap your fingers to bring him back down to cruel reality.%SPEECH_ON%Those crowns belong to us, peasant. That was the deal.%SPEECH_OFF%The man's jowls flip and flop as he shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%But the mill... it's not even finished!%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug.%SPEECH_ON%Not our problem. Now hand it over, before I make you our problem.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding solemnly, the man obeys and gives you his satchel of crowns.
859d490f6c82a5f5385c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]那人正沉浸在问题圆满解决的幻想里，你打了个响指，把他拉回残酷的现实。%SPEECH_ON%农民，那些克朗是我们的。当初说好了的。%SPEECH_OFF%他连连摇头，两颊肥肉晃来晃去。%SPEECH_ON%可磨坊……还没建完啊！%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%不关我们的事。现在交钱，别让我亲自来解决你。%SPEECH_OFF%他沉着脸点头，老老实实交出钱袋。

90542f965b9ea02cf198.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]For a brief moment, you see an image of yourself running the squinty-eyed man through with your sword. It'd really wake him up to the reality of the world, but instead you give him a break. The laborers who took part in the disaster of a project aren't too happy. Hopefully, the lessons learned will steel them anyway.
90542f965b9ea02cf198.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]有那么一瞬，你想象自己一剑刺穿这个眯着眼的男人。那肯定能让他看清世道的真相，不过你最终还是放了他一马。参与这场灾难般工程的弟兄们可不高兴。只盼这次教训多少也能磨炼他们。

d0f01233abbb9636a79a.source: You lend some men to help build a mill
d0f01233abbb9636a79a.translation: 你派了些人手帮忙建磨坊

407d0a7b920b4791df64.source: You pressed hard an important citizen to get paid for helping build a mill
407d0a7b920b4791df64.translation: 你强逼当地一位要人支付修建磨坊的报酬

4f6d6bcb638a7d87ba0a.source: Helped build a mill without getting paid
4f6d6bcb638a7d87ba0a.translation: 帮忙建磨坊，却没拿到报酬

2867bb46747b6be2b91b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_178.png[/img]{You stand over one of the...things you just fought. %randombrother% curls a blade underneath the goop and holds it up. A great mop of flesh elongates in stitched segments, arms spindling out like they were the branches of a tree, fat chunks sliding down the appendages like sap. The rest are incongruencies left and right: here a foot hanging from a torso like a doorhandle, there a face spreading apart as if melting into a river of sinews and ligaments. When your sellsword lets it slide off his blade, the fleshbag slops into the ground, the bones rattling like a collapsing rope ladder. %randombrother2% walks up with a quiver of arrows and a small book.%SPEECH_ON%Got this quiver of, uh, interesting arrows. Looks like some sort of reservoir in the bottom of it is for dipping the arrowheads. The old gods know what that material is. I also found this here book tethered to one of their heads. Seems important.%SPEECH_OFF%Opening the book, you find lists of villages with lines crossing them out one by one, and beside each is a simple number. Fifty. Sixty. Seventy. At the back of the book you find a map to another location, what appears to be some sort of estate.}
2867bb46747b6be2b91b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_178.png[/img]{你站在刚才交手的一个……东西旁边。%randombrother%用刀从黏浆下面一挑，将它举起。一大团拖把般的血肉，沿着缝合处一节节拉长，手臂像树枝般向外支出，脂肪块则如树液般顺着肢体滑落。其余部分也处处错乱：这里，一只脚像门把手般挂在躯干上；那里，一张脸向两侧摊开，仿佛融进肌腱与韧带组成的河流。佣兵让它从刀上滑落，那袋血肉便啪嗒瘫在地上，骨头像坍落的绳梯般哗啦作响。%randombrother2%拿着一筒箭和一本小册子走来。%SPEECH_ON%找到这么一筒，呃，有意思的箭。底部好像有个储液的槽，是用来浸箭头的。旧神才知道里面装的什么。我还找到这本书，绑在它们其中一个脑袋上，看着挺重要。%SPEECH_OFF%翻开书，你看见一列列村庄名字，被逐一划去，旁边各记着一个简单的数字：五十，六十，七十。书的末尾夹着一张地图，指向另一处地点，看起来像某座庄园。}

b1e1028acadb384388f1.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_178.png[/img]{The fight is being lost. You know these monstrosities must, in part, be made of those who have fallen before them already. Not wishing to suffer such a fate, you order a retreat. The Flesh Golems are not quick enough to give chase and lumberingly peel off the rearguard and disappear.

You might still yet return to this place, for why are those things even here at all?}
b1e1028acadb384388f1.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_178.png[/img]{战局已无可挽回。你明白，这些怪物的身体里，必然有一部分来自先前倒在它们面前的人。不愿落得同样的下场，你下令撤退。血肉魔像动作迟缓，追赶不及，笨重地脱离你们的后卫，渐渐消失。

也许你们还会回来。毕竟，这些东西究竟为什么会在这里？}

2a4c6d09a9299ebdec44.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_178.png[/img]{As expected, the Flesh Golems are still meandering around the town's faceless statue. Judging by the range of freshness and decay, it seems they have had some new members added to the roster, while the older ones are falling apart. But they are all one-minded when their gooey eyes clap down on you and the company. You draw your sword and order in the formations. If this town has a secret, you are going to find it!}
2a4c6d09a9299ebdec44.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_178.png[/img]{果然，血肉魔像仍在镇上的无面雕像周围游荡。从肉块新鲜与腐烂的程度来看，它们似乎添了些“新人”，而旧的正在散架。不过，当黏腻的眼睛齐齐盯住你和战团时，它们的心思倒完全一致。你拔出剑，命令列阵。这镇子若有秘密，你一定要找出来！}

e24e6e1c1cd14a4c1f01.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{The estate towers over the area with pure cut stoneworks and colored roofing tiles. It has something most royalty cannot afford, which is a sense of taste. With grass trimmed low, the lawn seemed almost like a footprint unto an unkept land. Statues of people dot the landscape, capturing poses both regaling and regretful. Amidst the crowd of sculptures are hedges cut into the shapes of animals and fountains with clear water in them. The company stands outside a black fence, idling and staring through the bars like farm animals. %randombrother% shakes his head and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, it's all quite pretty and all, but no deep pocket fark is just gonna leave the front gate open like this for no reason, ya know? I think either somebody has already ran through the place, or something awful is inside and it don't mind the occasional innocent passerby.%SPEECH_OFF%You agree. When looking further in, you can see the path leads to a bowled out decline, as if the gods had knuckled a bit of the earth itself with overhangs and escarpments encircling the area. If you're going to explore such a place, you know in your heart that you might not make it back. You could still leave now and return later...}
e24e6e1c1cd14a4c1f01.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{庄园高耸于周围地势之上，石材切砌齐整，屋顶覆着彩瓦。它拥有一种连许多王公贵族也买不起的东西：品位。草坪修剪得极低，像荒芜土地上留下的一道精整足印。人物雕像点缀其间，有的姿态欢欣，有的神情悔恨。雕像群中还夹着修成动物形状的绿篱，以及流淌清水的喷泉。战团站在黑色围栏外，无所事事地透过栏杆往里看，像一群农场里的牲口。%randombrother%摇摇头，啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%是，这地方确实漂亮，可哪有阔佬会平白无故把大门敞着，你说是不是？要么已经有人把这里扫过一遍，要么里面有可怕的东西，而且不介意偶尔吃几个无辜路人。%SPEECH_OFF%你同意。再往里看，小径通向一处碗状的低地，四周围着悬岩与陡坡，仿佛诸神用指节在大地上按出了一个凹坑。若要探索这样的地方，你心里清楚，自己未必还能回来。现在仍可以离开，日后再来……}

542abf189eaef33c0b64.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{You order the company into the moon-like escarpment. Suddenly, a man wearing a tall black helm swings himself around a statue. He wield an unusual staff, a trail of green mist wafting behind its glassy top.%SPEECH_ON%Welcome! Have you come to understand my work? It is in the warmth of mothering that one finds the primal instincts, the flashes of intellect which all creatures, from the feeblest worms to the most soaring birds, understand, and without which man shall never have supremacy over all things. I, a man, am mother now. I, a man, have broken the order, and on this instinct native to all creatures, I shall rise, wombless, ascending above the architecture of nature herself, and become nurturer to all! I, the Grand Diviner, the one who shall moisten this dry earth with manifestations...%SPEECH_OFF%Monologuing madmen wielding strange staffs rarely have good intentions. You draw your sword and, seeing your blade, the Grand Diviner goes quiet. He nods and swings his arms wide, a flash of green sparking from his staff. Creatures like those you’ve seen before – gelatinous, bulbous assemblages of vague appendages – all start shuffling out from behind the statues. More yet encircle the entire company, occupying spaces on high, saddling themselves onto the lip of the escarpments like visitors in a coliseum, ever-ready to watch a good fight. The Grand Diviner grins and points his staff at you.%SPEECH_ON%Smile, sellsword, for when you die I shall mother you back into this world, and you shall find nurture in the bosom of my power!%SPEECH_OFF%}
542abf189eaef33c0b64.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{你命战团进入那片月牙般的陡壁。突然，一个戴高耸黑盔的男人从雕像后转了出来。他挥着一根奇特法杖，玻璃般的杖顶后拖着绿雾。%SPEECH_ON%欢迎！你们是来领会我的造诣的吗？唯有在母性的温暖中，才能找到最原始的本能，那一道智慧的闪光。从最孱弱的蠕虫，到翱翔最高的飞鸟，一切生灵都懂得它；没有它，人类绝无法凌驾万物。我，一个男人，如今已成为母亲。我，一个男人，打破了秩序！凭借所有生灵与生俱来的本能，我将崛起，无需子宫，超越自然本身的构造，成为万物的养育者！我，大先知，将以造物滋润这片干涸的大地……%SPEECH_OFF%挥着古怪法杖、喋喋自语的疯子，向来少有好意。你拔出剑。看见剑刃，大先知安静下来，点头张开双臂，杖上闪出一道绿光。那些你曾见过的生物——胶质般臃肿，由模糊肢体拼成的怪物——开始从雕像后缓缓走出。更多怪物则将整支战团围住，占据高处，跨坐在陡壁边缘，像竞技场里随时准备欣赏恶斗的观众。大先知咧嘴笑着，将法杖指向你。%SPEECH_ON%笑吧，佣兵！等你死后，我将如母亲般让你重返世间，在我力量的怀抱中，得到哺育！%SPEECH_OFF%}

f07ca1361a6650b82492.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{The Diviner is found in the mire of his creatures, a wounded man strewn across the afterbirth of his own manifestations. His heavy helmet guards his neck, but you simply crouch down and lever the point of your sword under it, like lifting a bucket with a dagger. He coughs and says.%SPEECH_ON%You can truly kill me no more than you can kill mother nature.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and drive the steel through his chin until you hear its tip touch the top of his helm. Blood spews over the neckguard. Standing, you say,%SPEECH_ON%I am mother nature.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Nice line, captain. Sorta dumb if you think about it too much but-%SPEECH_OFF%You cut the sellsword off and tell him and the rest of the men to loot the place. Surely the gothic estate has some valuables that will have made this venture worthwhile. As for the Diviner's curious staff still yet swirling with a faint green glow, you have it taken to inventory. As you prepare to leave, a report comes in that a number of the 'flesh golems' ran out of the gothic estate and fled into the wild. Their progenitor is dead, but it seems you may still yet continue to find his creations.}
f07ca1361a6650b82492.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{你在那些造物留下的血肉泥沼里找到了先知。他身负重伤，横卧在自己创造之物的残渣中，像躺在一堆产后的胞衣里。沉重的头盔护住他的脖子，但你只需蹲下，将剑尖从下面探入，像用匕首挑起一只桶。他咳嗽着说。%SPEECH_ON%你杀不死真正的我，正如你杀不死自然之母。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头，将剑从他下巴直贯而入，直到听见剑尖碰上盔顶的声音。鲜血喷满护颈。你站起身，说道。%SPEECH_ON%我就是自然之母。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%这话漂亮，团长。不过仔细想想，有点傻——%SPEECH_OFF%你打断他，叫他和其他弟兄搜刮此地。这座尖拱庄园里肯定有些值钱东西，能让这一趟冒险有所回报。至于先知那根仍缭绕着微弱绿光的古怪法杖，你命人收进库存。正准备离开，有人来报，说不少“血肉魔像”逃出了庄园，遁入荒野。它们的创造者虽已死去，看来你们往后仍可能遇上他的造物。}

c72beeb29a61a349cda8.source: At least the most monstrous of the lot is dead.
c72beeb29a61a349cda8.translation: 至少最凶的那个已经死了。

6ef59f263690b0c3e911.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{You're losing the fight, and you'd rather not lose more - for it seems against the Grand Diviner that death may not be the end of you. Cutting your losses, you call a retreat and break your way out of the encirclement. The 'watchful' flesh golems mockingly groan at you like a displeased coliseum audience.

Choking on laughter, the Grand Diviner holds his ground and fades into the background. A lick of wispy green mist reaches for you, forming the shape of a mouth that grins, and then all is gone and you are back out of the place. Returning is a large ask, but you now feel determined to see this madman slain.}
6ef59f263690b0c3e911.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{战局对你们不利，你不愿再付出更大的代价——面对大先知，死亡似乎还不意味着一切终结。你决定及时抽身，下令撤退，杀出包围。那些一直“旁观”的血肉魔像发出嘲弄的呻吟，活像角斗场里看得不尽兴的观众。

大先知笑得几乎喘不过气，站在原地，身影渐渐隐入背景。一缕淡薄的绿雾伸向你，凝成一张咧嘴而笑的嘴，随后一切都消失了，你们已经退到了外面。要再闯进去绝非易事，可你如今愈发决心要杀掉这个疯子。}
