5e17fc249a99f0c34ffd.source: Will probably have to kill him to get him out of our dreams anyway.
5e17fc249a99f0c34ffd.translation: 反正多半得杀了他，才能把他从咱们的梦里赶出去。

934f6525e17372656ae4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{You venture into the bowled soil, and in turn the flesh golems predictably take to this 'venue' and settle about the rim of the escarpment. The Grand Diviner stands center, unusual staff in hand, and a grin on his face.%SPEECH_ON%Welcome back. Let the mothering continue.%SPEECH_OFF%}
934f6525e17372656ae4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_182.png[/img]{你走进碗状洼地，血肉魔像也如预料般围拢过来，沿着陡坡边缘落位，仿佛要观看这场演出。大先知立在中央，手持奇异法杖，脸上带着笑。%SPEECH_ON%欢迎回来。让孕育继续吧。%SPEECH_OFF%}

2cbffd8df8056fd312cb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]While traipsing between the trees, a man suddenly emerges from one of the bushes. Twigs and brush are all twisted up in his sweat swept hair. He rears up at the sight of you.%SPEECH_ON%Please, no more.%SPEECH_OFF%You raise your hand to calm him then ask what is going on. The stranger takes a step back.%SPEECH_ON%Please, no more!%SPEECH_OFF%He turns and runs off, thrashing his way back from whence he came. %randombrother% hurries to your side.%SPEECH_ON%Should we follow him?%SPEECH_OFF%
2cbffd8df8056fd312cb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]你在树间行走，一个男人突然从灌木里钻出，汗湿的头发缠满枝条与草叶。他见到你，猛地缩身。%SPEECH_ON%求求你，别再来了。%SPEECH_OFF%你抬手安抚，问他出了什么事。陌生人后退一步。%SPEECH_ON%求你，别再来了！%SPEECH_OFF%他转身就跑，横冲直撞地钻回原来的方向。%randombrother%赶到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%要跟上去吗？%SPEECH_OFF%

92f90876af0b97646bba.source: He's not our concern. Let him go.
92f90876af0b97646bba.translation: 他不关我们的事。让他走。

876f33d0d9d7bd396356.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]You follow the man into the thicket. His muddy footsteps aren't hard to track, his ungraceful retreat leaving much evidence. But suddenly, they disappear. The man exited into a clearing and then his tracks are gone. You hear a whistle above you. Looking up, you see the man sitting on a branch. He waves.%SPEECH_ON%Howdy, strangers.%SPEECH_OFF%He glances across the clearing. Men are approaching and they are well armed. The man in the tree snorts.%SPEECH_ON%Goodbye, strangers.%SPEECH_OFF%
876f33d0d9d7bd396356.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]你跟着那人钻进灌木丛。他逃得狼狈，泥脚印留下许多痕迹，并不难追。可足迹突然消失了：他走进一片空地，然后便再无踪迹。头顶响起一声口哨。你抬头，看见那人坐在树枝上，挥着手。%SPEECH_ON%各位，幸会。%SPEECH_OFF%他朝空地另一侧瞥去。一群武装齐备的人正在逼近。树上的男人哼笑一声。%SPEECH_ON%各位，再会。%SPEECH_OFF%

f608dad2b5faac2a1cf3.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]The man's tracks lead away in the hurry that so frightfully forced him out of your sight. A scared man such as he is not hard to find, unfortunately he's not scared anymore, because all you find of him is thoroughly eviscerated corpse.

A slight growl vibrates the nearby bushes. You look over to see slick, black fur slowly stepping out from behind a tree. You yell to the men to arm themselves.
f608dad2b5faac2a1cf3.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]足迹延伸向远方，清楚显出那股逼得他仓皇逃离的恐惧。如此惊慌的人不难追，可惜他已经不会再怕了：你找到的，只是一具被彻底开膛破肚的尸体。

附近灌木微微颤动，传来低吼。你转头看去，一团油亮的黑毛正从树后缓缓移出。你大声命令弟兄们准备武器。

2a5b9dc910b46e740738.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]The frightened man was not hard to find. You spot him curled up at the base of a tree. He's clutching something to his chest as though he were seeking warmth from it on a cold night. The man himself, however, is dead. You pry the item from his glomming grasp.
2a5b9dc910b46e740738.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_25.png[/img]那个惊恐的男人并不难找。你发现他蜷缩在树下，怀里死死抱着一件东西，仿佛想在寒夜里借它取暖。不过，他本人已经死了。你从紧攥的双手间把东西撬了出来。

01cf32607a66ac4cbef1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%mason% the mason is stoking the campfire with %thief% standing nearby. The thief is mulling a question over.%SPEECH_ON%Hmm, what was the hardest to break into? Well, vaults were the easiest, let's get that out of the way first. I once stole so much from a vault that they tried to hang the locksmith for being so easily defeated by a common thief. They couldn't find the locksmith, for you see I'm no common thief, for the locksmith was me. Ha-ha! To answer your question, a tower is the hardest to break into, especially a tower standing alone.%SPEECH_OFF%Sitting back on his laurels, the mason nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, thought you might say so. Towers be built for prisoners of import or items of peculiar fancy. Little more than cages in the sky for creatures with no wings. But one time, a prisoner, some notorious fish thief, did manage an escape. He spent years upon years pulling out strands of his own hair and tying them together until the 'rope' was long enough for him to throw it out and climb down. They caught him a day later, unfortunately. He did the same trick again a few years later, but that time he roped it half-as-long and simply hanged himself instead.%SPEECH_OFF%%thief% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%That's interesting and all, but I'm a true thief, mason, not a mere robber of fishmongers. My question is how do I get -into- the tower.%SPEECH_OFF%The mason nods.%SPEECH_ON%Simple. Commit a... herring offense.%SPEECH_OFF%
01cf32607a66ac4cbef1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]石匠%mason%正拨旺篝火，盗贼%thief%站在旁边，琢磨着一个问题。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，什么地方最难潜进去？先说好，金库最容易。我有一回从金库偷走太多东西，他们居然想吊死锁匠，怪他的锁轻易就被普通小偷撬开。可他们找不着锁匠，因为我不是普通小偷——锁匠就是我。哈哈！说回你的问题，塔楼最难进，尤其是孤零零立着的一座塔。%SPEECH_OFF%石匠颇为自得，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，就知道你会这么说。塔楼是用来关押要犯，或存放稀罕物件的。说白了，就是给没翅膀的东西造的空中牢笼。不过，有次一个囚犯逃了出来，是个臭名昭著的偷鱼贼。他花了好多年，一根根拔下自己的头发，接成长绳，直到够长，才扔到塔外，顺着爬了下去。可惜，隔天就被抓回来了。几年后，他又来这招，不过这回只搓了上次一半长，直接把自己吊死了。%SPEECH_OFF%%thief%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%这故事是挺有意思，可我是正经盗贼，石匠，不是什么抢鱼贩的小毛贼。我问的是，怎么进塔里去。%SPEECH_OFF%石匠点头。%SPEECH_ON%简单，去犯个……偷鱼的罪。%SPEECH_OFF%

82fd5718345999541e46.source: %townImage%While walking about %townname%, you run into an old man dragging a youthful man by the ear.%SPEECH_ON%You want to be a master, it takes time! Blood! Sweat! Tears if yer of the cryin' sort and there's no shame in that if ya are. Here, look! A sellsword! If you want to fight so bad, why not go to him?%SPEECH_OFF%You hold your hands out and ask for an explanation before getting offloaded some annoying git. The elderly man calms himself and lets the kid's ear go.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, I suppose you are owed more of an explanation. I'm the fencing master of this town, but I teach discipline and patience before anyone so much can touch a sword! And this damned student of mine has neither! So I told him, if you want to fight so bad, get the hell out!%SPEECH_OFF%You look at the kid. He's got a fresh face, but there is in fact some impatient eagerness in his eyes. You ask him if what the swordmaster says is true. The kid nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yessir. And I'd be more than happy to fight for you, too.%SPEECH_OFF%
82fd5718345999541e46.translation: %townImage%你在%townname%闲逛时，遇见一个老人揪着年轻人的耳朵，一路拖着走。%SPEECH_ON%想当大师，就得花时间！流血！流汗！爱哭的话还得流泪，哭也没什么丢人的。瞧，那儿有个佣兵！你要是这么想打架，怎么不去找他？%SPEECH_OFF%你伸出双手，让他先解释清楚，别一上来就把什么讨厌鬼塞给你。老人平静了些，松开年轻人的耳朵。%SPEECH_ON%是，是该跟你讲明白。我是这镇上的剑术师父，可在让人碰剑之前，我都先教他们自律和耐心！偏偏我这该死的徒弟，两样都没有！所以我告诉他，既然这么想打，就给我滚出去！%SPEECH_OFF%你打量着那年轻人。他面容稚嫩，眼中却确实透着一股按捺不住的急切。你问他，剑术大师说的是不是真的。年轻人点点头。%SPEECH_ON%是的，长官。而且我很乐意为你战斗。%SPEECH_OFF%

c4509ecac7568eee6eca.translation: 不了，谢谢。你自己留着吧。

778ba36f016ce69bf643.source: An impatient student of a fencing and swordmaster, %name% didn't have the mental aptitude to stick with the trials and tribulations of becoming a master of the blade himself. But what he lacks in mental fortitude he more than makes up for in effort. You 'hired' him simply by taking him off the old man's hands.
778ba36f016ce69bf643.translation: %name%曾师从一位剑术大师，却是个急躁的学徒，心性不足以承受通往大师之路的磨炼。不过，他肯下的苦功远能弥补意志上的欠缺。你所谓的“雇用”，不过是从那老人手里接走了他。

3c3c01d07f044e00a255.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]You eye a large group of screaming villagers. They're drunkenly carrying a felled tree like a throng of ants would a beetle. There's a blindfolded and shackled man astride the wood. As the crowd draws near, the pungency of alcohol emanates from the mob like miasma from a particularly angry swamp.

 %otherbro% asks the riffraff where they're off to. A bearded stooge swerves forward, braking on a heel and toe tip at the same time like an unpracticed puppet.%SPEECH_ON%Oy! We off to tar and feather this, this, uh...%SPEECH_OFF%Someone yells out 'fruit philanderer!' from the crowd. The stooge snaps his fingers.%SPEECH_ON%Right! This melon mugger is getting what's, er, coming... to him.%SPEECH_OFF%
3c3c01d07f044e00a255.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你看到一大群吵嚷的村民。他们喝得醉醺醺，抬着一棵砍倒的树，像一群蚂蚁搬着甲虫。树干上骑着一个蒙眼戴镣的男人。人群越走越近，刺鼻酒气扑面而来，仿佛一片暴躁的沼泽正在喷吐瘴气。

 %otherbro%问这群乌合之众要去哪里。一个蓄须的蠢汉歪歪扭扭地凑上来，一只脚用脚跟、另一只脚用脚尖勉强刹住身子，像个手艺生疏的木偶师摆弄出来的傀儡。%SPEECH_ON%喂！我们要去给这、这个，呃……涂焦油、粘羽毛！%SPEECH_OFF%人群里有人喊道：“糟蹋水果的色鬼！”蠢汉一打响指。%SPEECH_ON%没错！这欺负瓜的家伙，就要受到他，呃，应得的……惩罚了。%SPEECH_OFF%

ff3167b85d1d5873a542.source: Yeah, this is very much not our business.
ff3167b85d1d5873a542.translation: 没错，这事还真跟我们毫不相干。

47d7f7ccaef16a4ccd09.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]The stooge sways on his feet. There's enough beer foam in his beard to get a wench drunk. He points forward.%SPEECH_ON%Thas... that's right! Mugged a melon right-oh, but not just any ord'nary thief! Naw, he corked it something fierce! We found the raw sewage of his work all about him when we'd caught up to his doings! And by raw sewage I mean his cock's ill-measured spillage!%SPEECH_OFF%Hardly catching any of that, you ask the man to explain - slowly this time. He throws his hands up as though you're an idiot.%SPEECH_ON%What's all this talk? You hump a melon and thass that! Such fornications are, well, thass... thass beyond ordinary appeals to justice! Now out of our way, stranger, we've feathers to collect and then to redistribute by means of a bonafide tarrin' and a featherin' and mayhaps a little more tarrin' if we got us some left!%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd cheers to this.
47d7f7ccaef16a4ccd09.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]那蠢汉站得摇摇晃晃，胡子里的啤酒沫都够灌醉一个姑娘。他朝前一指。%SPEECH_ON%对、对喽！偷了个瓜，没错，可不是普通偷法！他把那瓜狠狠捅了一通！咱们逮着他时，周围全是干坏事留下的脏水！脏水，就是他裤裆里那玩意儿乱喷出来的东西！%SPEECH_OFF%你几乎一句也没听懂，让他解释清楚，这次慢点说。他举起双手，像在看个傻子。%SPEECH_ON%还说什么说？操了个瓜，就是这么回事！这种淫行，呃，那可……可不是讲普通道理能算完的！陌生人，快让开。咱们还得去收羽毛，再正经给他涂焦油、粘上去。要是还有剩，兴许再多涂一层！%SPEECH_OFF%人群为这番话欢呼起来。

1f04d1f9b59e6f942dad.translation: 拿瓜做那种事？%otherbro%，往这蠢货身上泼焦油！

808fd8b167fa206ed858.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]You ask the man atop the tree what he has to say, if anything. He shrugs and speaks.%SPEECH_ON%Look, what happens between a man and a melon is their business and their business alone. No harm, no foul.%SPEECH_OFF%The stooge cracks the man with a stick.%SPEECH_ON%Naw, you tell this fella straight, tell 'im what ya did!%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, the melon man nods.%SPEECH_ON%Well alright then, if that's the end of them negotiations, and things being what they is with me up here and the smell of tar in the air, I'll speak truthfully to the matter at hand. I fucked that melon and I enjoyed myself.%SPEECH_OFF%The crowd hisses and boos as your men laugh amongst themselves.
808fd8b167fa206ed858.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你问骑在树干上的男人，还有什么话可说。他耸耸肩，开口道。%SPEECH_ON%听着，一个男人和一个瓜之间发生什么，只关他们自己的事。又没伤着谁，算什么错。%SPEECH_OFF%那蠢汉抄起棍子抽了他一下。%SPEECH_ON%少来，老老实实告诉这位，你到底干了什么！%SPEECH_OFF%瓜男叹了口气，点点头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，既然没得商量了，我又被架在这上头，空气里还一股焦油味，那咱们就实话实说。我操了那个瓜，而且爽得很。%SPEECH_OFF%人群嘘声四起，你手下的弟兄却在一旁笑作一团。

ed38b9950055f61399d0.source: We can't let you tar this man.
ed38b9950055f61399d0.translation: 我们不能让你们往他身上泼焦油。

be56b754a86328195779.source: Fornicating fruit? %otherbro%, go help tar this fool!
be56b754a86328195779.translation: 拿瓜做那种事？%otherbro%，去帮忙往这蠢货身上泼焦油！

5545fc2aff8fd5b44a0d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]You grab the stooge.%SPEECH_ON%Let this man go.%SPEECH_OFF%The man asks if you're really defending this fruit farker. You nod and tell him that adultery with a melon, while disgusting and confusing, is ultimately a harmless endeavor. A drunken peasant thumbs over his shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Sss'what? Juss last week we took ol' Bentley behind the shed for breaking that poor duck's neck.%SPEECH_OFF%The man's face frowns and he drowns the rest of his drink. He mutters something about really missing that duck. Perhaps not making yourself clear, and tiring of these idiots' hijinks, you draw your sword and cut the melon mugger free. You turn the sword toward the crowd and they quickly disperse in a drunken retreat, fanning out beside the road, randomly scattering to get from whence they came like a bunch of rocks skipped over a wavy lake.
5545fc2aff8fd5b44a0d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你抓住那个蠢汉。%SPEECH_ON%放了他。%SPEECH_OFF%对方问，你真要护着这个糟蹋水果的家伙？你点头，告诉他，与瓜通奸虽恶心又令人费解，说到底却没伤着谁。一个醉醺醺的农民用拇指朝肩后一指。%SPEECH_ON%什、什么？就在上周，老本特利拧断了那只可怜鸭子的脖子，咱们还把他拖到棚子后头收拾了呢。%SPEECH_OFF%那人脸一垮，灌完剩下的酒，嘟囔着自己真想那只鸭子。看来你没说清，可你也烦透了这群蠢货的胡闹，便拔剑割断绳索，放开瓜男。你将剑锋转向人群，他们立刻醉醺醺地四散退去，沿路边七零八落地逃回原处，像一把石子在起伏的湖面上乱打水漂。

dedb96a479f49a56347a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]The 'melon mugger' comes to you. He fixes up his drawers with a bit of rope and bindings.%SPEECH_ON%So, uh, seeing as how you spared me that awful fate, what say I try and pay you back? I'm tired of this town anyhow.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him that sellswording is not an enviable vocation to take up on the fly. He points a snarky finger.%SPEECH_ON%Look, if you're worried I'll pork yer produce then I promise on me mother's grave that I will keep my shire-borer in its pants.%SPEECH_OFF%
dedb96a479f49a56347a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]那个“劫瓜客”走到你面前，用绳子和布带扎好裤子。%SPEECH_ON%那个，呃，既然你救我免了那场罪，不如让我报答一下？反正这镇子我也待腻了。%SPEECH_OFF%你告诉他，佣兵这行可不值得心血来潮就往里跳。他狡黠地竖起手指。%SPEECH_ON%听着，要是你怕我糟蹋你们的瓜果，我向亡母起誓，一定把我那根钻地锥好好收在裤裆里。%SPEECH_OFF%

89c4d2c1f1c4ad698b51.source: No, we'd rather not be double-checking our food every time we take a bite.
89c4d2c1f1c4ad698b51.translation: 免了，我们可不想每吃一口东西都得先检查一遍。

f5000f573164a8aa7d12.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]%otherbro% nods.%SPEECH_ON%With pleasure! Out of the way peasantry, let a real man get some work done here.%SPEECH_OFF%The sellsword picks up the 'pitch bucket' and hurls it completely over the fruit fornicator. The man screams as the hot liquids sizzle and a rather potent order wisps into a smoky air. You watch as %otherbro% grabs a few naked chickens - not their feathers, just the chickens themselves - and starts beating the melon mugger with them like an angry frock swinging chained censers. The tarred man hollers out, partly in pain, partly confused. The crowd, also confused, reluctantly cheers. When he's finished, %otherbro% drops the chickens, which are but a slop of drooping meat and tar at this point. He wipes his forehead.%SPEECH_ON%Hell yeah, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%
f5000f573164a8aa7d12.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]%otherbro%点头。%SPEECH_ON%乐意效劳！农民们，闪开，让真汉子来干活。%SPEECH_OFF%佣兵提起“沥青桶”，将桶里的东西全泼在那个糟蹋水果的家伙身上。热液滋滋作响，那人惨叫起来，浓烈气味飘入烟雾。接着，%otherbro%抓起几只拔光毛的鸡——不是羽毛，就是鸡本身——抡起来痛打瓜男，活像暴怒的教士挥着链香炉。浑身焦油的男人嚎个不停，一半因为疼，一半因为搞不懂这是什么刑罚。围观者同样困惑，却仍勉强喝起彩。打完，%otherbro%丢下鸡，那些鸡此时已成了软垂的肉与焦油混成的一团。他抹了抹额头。%SPEECH_ON%他娘的，痛快，长官。%SPEECH_OFF%

8009d2a39db3c1514c68.source: I don't quite think he gets it, but that works.
8009d2a39db3c1514c68.translation: 我看他没听懂，不过这样也行。

03637731a46009e63006.source: %name% is just a regular melon thief - is what you tell people who ask.
03637731a46009e63006.translation: %name%不过是个普通的偷瓜贼——有人问起时，你总是这么说。

6e10550fb261055c3746.source: Satisfied his needs with a melon
6e10550fb261055c3746.translation: 拿一个瓜满足了自己的欲望

de84e8a5b396b6e88feb.translation: 险些被泼焦油、粘上羽毛示众

1ebd30a9d305c64f0f4e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%messenger% and %houndmaster% share stories over a campfire. The messenger laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Lemme tell you about my first delivery. I walked up to this keep that had a nice, beautiful moat. Most dangerous thing in the waters were lily pads and fly-fattened frogs. Walked right over the drawbridge and stepped inside, letter in hand, my belly turning with excitement. I get in there and what do I hear? Roo-roo-roo-roo! Ruh-ruh-ruh! This farkin' mongrel comes barreling out of its doghouse, teeth bared, ears pinned. I'm like oh shite, I didn't sign up for this and climb a chicken coop while this furred beast tries and eats me feet. Eventually, the lord comes out and the dog sits as though it'd done nothing at all. The nobleman laughs and takes the letter I came to deliver. He says, 'what, you didn't see the sign?' I said, uh no sir, but I'll be going now. When I left, they drew that drawbridge back up and wouldn't you know it, on the underside they'd painted this big 'Beware of Dog' warning!%SPEECH_OFF%%houndmaster% bursts into laughter.%SPEECH_ON%For your first day on the job, that ain't so bad. But I'll have you know, no dog of the %companyname% will hurt you! I'll train them mutts proper!%SPEECH_OFF%
1ebd30a9d305c64f0f4e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%messenger%和%houndmaster%围着营火讲故事。信使笑道。%SPEECH_ON%我跟你说说头一回送信吧。我走到一座城堡前，护城河漂亮得很，水里最危险的东西，也就是睡莲叶子和吃苍蝇吃肥了的青蛙。我径直过了吊桥，拿着信走进去，兴奋得肚子直翻。刚一进去，你猜我听见什么？汪汪汪汪！嗷嗷嗷！一条该死的杂毛狗从狗窝里冲出来，龇着牙，耳朵紧贴脑袋。我心想，坏了，我可没答应干这种活，赶紧爬上鸡舍，那毛畜生还在下面想啃我的脚。后来领主出来了，狗立刻坐下，像什么也没干过。贵族笑着接过信，问：“怎么，没看见告示？”我说，呃，没有，长官，不过我这就走。等我出去，他们把吊桥拉起来，你猜怎么着？桥底下写着老大几个字：“小心恶犬”！%SPEECH_OFF%%houndmaster%放声大笑。%SPEECH_ON%头一天干这活，算不错了。不过你放心，%companyname%的狗，没一条会伤你！我会把那群家伙训好的！%SPEECH_OFF%

372a9baa52dc78b6f3cc.source: %terrainImage%{Upon hearing some sellswords yelling at each other, you reluctantly set aside your quill pen and step outside your tent. There you find %hauntedbrother1% and %hauntedbrother2% in each other's faces - and between them they're pulling at the Grand Diviner's flail. What is being screamed between them are obscenities of a most graphic nature, and just as you're about to step in the flail glows a bright green and both sellswords drop the weapon to lunge at each other. The fight is ended fast, but not without injuries.}
372a9baa52dc78b6f3cc.translation: %terrainImage%{听见佣兵们互相吼叫，你不情愿地放下羽毛笔，走出帐篷。%hauntedbrother1%与%hauntedbrother2%正脸对着脸，中间各拽着大先知链枷的一端，嘴里全是露骨至极的脏话。你正要干涉，链枷忽然亮起绿光，两人同时丢下武器，扑向对方。架很快被拉开，可伤已经受了。}

78c5e74116988d8081d5.source: Was ensorcelled by the Grand Diviner's Flail
78c5e74116988d8081d5.translation: 受到大先知链枷的蛊惑

56a151c1c150786a8898.source: %terrainImage%{You dream of your mother. You had not seen her face in some time, and thought you'd forgotten it, the world having ground down most memories. She is as lovely as you'd expect, and she draws you in, hand about your hair, threading her fingers through it, the soft hiss of her touch met by the gentlest of whispers. And a moment later she offers a breast to you, and you reel back, unsure, and when you look up the Grand Diviner is there, grinning madly.%SPEECH_ON%Wombless, I ascend, sellsword. The grand nurturer...%SPEECH_OFF%A fleshy golem wraps its red appendages over his shoulders, coiling you up in its greasy grip.%SPEECH_ON%Find in my bosom the raw power of this world, sellsword! Let me mother you into the man you should have been!%SPEECH_OFF%With a snarl, you rip out of the dream and flip off your cot and hit the ground, gasping for air and slapping your face as if whatever dreamt of came back with you. The rest of the company is in an equal state of disrepair, every sellsword having been struck by the same nightmare. You glance over to inventory to see the Grand Diviner's flail bristling a bright green, then it fades from your stare, the slightest chuckle following it out...}
56a151c1c150786a8898.translation: %terrainImage%{你梦见了母亲。已经很久没见过她的脸，你原以为自己忘了，毕竟这世道早已磨去了大半记忆。她和你想象中一样温柔美丽，将你揽近，手掌抚着你的头发，手指轻轻穿过发丝。细微的摩挲声，伴着最柔和的低语。片刻后，她向你袒露乳房，你迟疑地向后一缩，再抬头时，眼前却成了大先知，正疯狂地咧嘴笑着。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我虽无子宫，却已升华。我是伟大的养育者……%SPEECH_OFF%一具血肉魔像将赤红的肢体搭过他的双肩，用油腻的触肢把你卷住。%SPEECH_ON%在我的怀里，寻得这世界最原始的力量吧，佣兵！让我像母亲一般，将你养成你本该成为的男人！%SPEECH_OFF%你怒吼着挣脱梦境，翻下行军床，重重摔到地上，大口喘气，不停拍打自己的脸，仿佛梦里的东西也跟着回来了。战团其他人同样狼狈，每个佣兵都遭遇了这场噩梦。你瞥向库存，看见大先知的连枷正泛起刺目的绿光。随后，那光在你注视下褪去，似乎还带走了一声极轻的窃笑……}

9dc3130098a9b3cfc7a7.source: Had a disturbing nightmare involving the Grand Diviner
9dc3130098a9b3cfc7a7.translation: 做了一个与大先知有关的可怕噩梦

a683c66e36c784730bf5.source: %terrainImage%{%hauntedbrother% spills into your tent yelling that you did terrible things to him while he was sleeping. You stand and draw your sword, for the details of his accusations are certainly worth killing another man over, but as you both pause to breathe, you realize %hauntedbrother% has the Grand Diviner's flail firmly grasped in a whiteknuckled hand. The green mist swirling in its center brims bright, then fades as you both look at it. The sellsword throws it to the ground.%SPEECH_ON%Godsdammit, captain. We should get rid of this farking thing!%SPEECH_OFF%}
a683c66e36c784730bf5.translation: %terrainImage%{%hauntedbrother%跌撞着冲进帐篷，叫嚷说你趁他睡着，对他做了可怕的事。你起身拔剑：他那些指控的细节，足够让人杀人泄愤。可双方停下来喘气时，你才发现，%hauntedbrother%正死死握着大先知链枷，指节发白。两人一同望去，枷头中盘旋的绿雾先是陡然明亮，随后又暗了下来。佣兵将它扔到地上。%SPEECH_ON%诸神在上，团长，我们该把这该死的东西扔了！%SPEECH_OFF%}

1374c58b4046cae4f40f.source: But it took so much to get it...
1374c58b4046cae4f40f.translation: 可得到它费了我们那么大的劲……

103204eb1985ca68f065.source: %terrainImage%{You find %hauntedbrother% staring into the Grand Diviner's flail. The glassy bulb is filled with mist, and the sellsword is raking his tongue to suck up the condensation. Hand to your sword, you ask what he's doing, and the man freezes, and his eyes open and he jerks back like a man snorting awake knowing he's late for work.%SPEECH_ON%Augh! What the fark? How did... I was sleeping, when... what the fark!%SPEECH_OFF%Some of the men have said the weapon has been murmuring when nobody's looking, and it seems every so often it does capture someone's ear...}
103204eb1985ca68f065.translation: %terrainImage%{你发现%hauntedbrother%正盯着大先知链枷。玻璃般的球体里雾气翻涌，他竟伸着舌头，舔吸表面凝出的水珠。你按住剑柄，问他在干什么。他先是一僵，随即睁大眼睛，猛地后仰，像睡醒才发觉误了工的人。%SPEECH_ON%啊！什么鬼？怎么……我明明在睡觉，刚才……他妈的怎么回事！%SPEECH_OFF%有弟兄说，这武器会趁无人注视时低声呢喃，看来它偶尔还真能勾住人的耳朵……}

c1fcf42252a05db7cdf8.source: It's only a weapon, you fools.

1324a3adab77dac57c14.source:
%terrainImage%{A voice seeps into the darkness: wherever she is... your mother knows she abandoned you... wherever I am... you know I would love you as greatly as her absence has harmed you. I will mother you to power, sellsword, I will feed you the milk of life from...

 You snap awake to a bright green hue and slap it out of your face. %hauntedbrother% falls to the ground and beside him the Grand Diviner's flail clangs. The sellsword shakes his head and his eyes widen as he looks around, confused.%SPEECH_ON%Wh-what? How did I get here?%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at the flail, watching as the viridian glow shimmers and then dims, a grotesque chuckling echoing as it fades.}
1324a3adab77dac57c14.translation:
%terrainImage%{一个声音渗入黑暗：无论她在哪里……你母亲都知道自己抛弃了你……无论我在哪里……你都知道，她的缺席伤你有多深，我就会爱你有多深。佣兵，我会像母亲一样抚育你，赐你力量，让你吮吸生命的乳汁，从……

你猛然惊醒，眼前一片亮绿，抬手便将它拍开。%hauntedbrother%跌倒在地，大先知的连枷也在他身旁哐当落下。佣兵晃着脑袋，茫然地睁大眼睛，四下张望。%SPEECH_ON%什、什么？我怎么到这儿来了？%SPEECH_OFF%你盯着连枷，看那碧绿的光芒闪烁、黯淡。一阵怪诞的低笑随之回荡，渐渐消散。}

38fe05aba71d63c00816.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]The company marches into the mountains, or what %randombrother% poetically referred to as the 'realm's tits'. Clouds start passing at eye-level and the air gets so thin it's like you're breathing through a straw. Snow crunches underfoot and harsh winds threaten to your eyes into ice cubes. Despite the steep escarpments and dangerous crevasses to cross, %miner% the miner seems rather happy to be this far up.%SPEECH_ON%It's like we're on top of the world! Isn't this wonderful?%SPEECH_OFF%He can hardly breathe for shit, but the miner is too happy to care. Years of digging deep into the earth has made this reversal of perspective all the more wonderful.
38fe05aba71d63c00816.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]战团向群山进发，或者用%randombrother%那颇有诗意的说法，正攀上“王国的奶子”。云从眼前飘过，空气稀薄得仿佛只能隔着麦秆吸气。脚下积雪咯吱作响，凛冽寒风几乎要把眼珠冻成冰块。尽管一路得翻越陡崖、跨过险峻裂隙，矿工%miner%却因能爬到这么高而兴奋不已。%SPEECH_ON%咱们简直站在世界之巅！多美妙啊，不是吗？%SPEECH_OFF%他明明已经喘得够呛，却高兴得完全顾不上。多年埋头地底挖掘之后，如今换个方向看世界，对他而言便格外美妙。

fc3b69c1cb597e921d66.source: Well, at least someone is enjoying themselves.

b3acdd4b3c8f845c35fb.source: Enjoyed the view from atop a mountain

ae6031ced53849d44dc2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img] %gambler%, the man with a gambling problem, has apparently gone around camp asking men to play a game of horseshoes - with a few crowns on the line, of course. It appears that %minstrel%, the wily minstrel, has obliged him and taken the bet. He says he's pretty good at the game to which the gambler responds that he is the best. 

 The two men heave horseshoes until their arms tire and the sun wanes. Nobody is the winner as the game can't move off of a tie. After another indecisive round, %minstrel% says he'll go for a double-or-nothing round if they go left-handed. %gambler% agrees. He goes first, throwing three horseshoes. The first two go haywire, but the third manages to spin around the ring. He grins as he wishes the minstrel good luck. %minstrel% nods and rolls up his sleeves. He sticks his tongue out and slims his eyes, lining up the shot. His feet do a little tap-dance and just before he throws he looks back and says,%SPEECH_ON%I should probably let you know that I *am* left-handed.%SPEECH_OFF%Without even looking forward, the minstrel lets loose his horseshoe. The throw is perfect, landing dead center about the stake, and the next two are tossed so quickly and so seamlessly that anybody watching erupts in hooting laughter. The gambler's mouth can only drop in disbelief.
ae6031ced53849d44dc2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img] 嗜赌的%gambler%显然在营里问了一圈，想找人玩掷马蹄铁——当然，得押上几个克朗。机灵的吟游诗人%minstrel%似乎答应奉陪，接下了赌局。他说自己挺擅长，赌徒则表示，自己可是个中第一。 

 两人一直掷到胳膊发酸，夕阳西沉。谁也没赢，比分始终打平。又一轮不分胜负后，%minstrel%提议，换左手再来一轮，赢了双倍，输了清零。%gambler%答应了。他先掷，连扔三枚马蹄铁。前两枚都飞偏了，第三枚总算绕着桩子落稳。他咧嘴一笑，祝吟游诗人好运。%minstrel%点头，挽起袖子，吐出舌尖，眯眼瞄准，脚下还轻轻踢踏了几步。出手前，他忽然回过头说。%SPEECH_ON%我大概该先告诉你，我本来就是个左撇子。%SPEECH_OFF%吟游诗人连头都没转回去，便将马蹄铁掷出。那一掷完美无缺，正正落在木桩周围；接下来的两枚又快又稳，一气呵成，围观众人顿时爆发出哄笑和喝彩。赌徒只能张着嘴，满脸难以置信。

1c32c16f8f86abe31e74.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img] The company sits around a fire when %minstrel% the minstrel notices the refugee, %refugee%, sitting solemnly by himself. Within but a moment, the minstrel is on his feet, standing high on a stump, and waving his arms wide.%SPEECH_ON%Lo', the town of %refugee% was small, its place quaint, and its food, well, a little on the 'eh' side. But ho'! Were its people big! For here sits amongst our company one of its kin, the world after his spirit, death on his heels, yet here he be, and we've but only thanks - and crowns! - to offer him! Such is the price of his company, and such we are willing to give.%SPEECH_OFF%The minstrel sits back down and bows to the refugee. All of the %companyname% stands up and cheers, bringing a rare smile to %refugee%'s face.
1c32c16f8f86abe31e74.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img] 战团围坐在火堆旁，吟游诗人%minstrel%注意到难民%refugee%独自坐着，神色落寞。转眼间，诗人便跳上一截树桩，张开双臂。%SPEECH_ON%诸位且听！%refugee%的家乡是座小镇，地方古朴，吃食嘛，稍稍有点……一言难尽。可嘿！那里的人却何等了不起！如今就有一位坐在咱们中间，世道要磨灭他的斗志，死神在身后紧追不舍，可他依然活着，来到了这里！咱们能献上的唯有感谢——还有克朗！能得他相伴，这份酬劳咱们付得心甘情愿。%SPEECH_OFF%诗人坐回原处，向难民欠身致意。%companyname%全体起立欢呼，让%refugee%的脸上露出了难得的笑容。

b1da7b8879047be9d698.translation: 听故事听得很开心，讲述者是

82682f2bc284dd1721e0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img] As the campfire crackles, %minstrel% the minstrel gets up and stands high on his stump. He beats his chest and then points to %deserter%.%SPEECH_ON%Yo, yee man of such fleeting feet, feet that flee before you've been beat! The deserter! Oh, the deserter! A dessert for the deserter! His courage he did curdle, his honor he did hurdle, his manliness he did murder! The deserter!%SPEECH_OFF%In one swift motion the minstrel claps his hands and drops back down onto his seat. He's only there for a moment before %deserter%'s hands are around his neck. The company is an uproar, stuck somewhere between separating the two and succumbing to fits of manic laughter.
82682f2bc284dd1721e0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img] 篝火噼啪作响，吟游诗人%minstrel%站起身，登上树桩。他捶了捶胸，指向%deserter%。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，你这双腿倒得巧，还没挨打先开跑！逃兵呀，逃兵！赏你甜点压压惊！胆气早已馊，荣誉甩身后，男儿气概亲手丢！逃兵呀，逃兵！%SPEECH_OFF%诗人利落地一拍巴掌，坐回原位。可屁股还没坐热，%deserter%的双手就掐上了他的脖子。战团顿时闹成一锅粥，弟兄们一边想把两人拉开，一边又笑得几乎直不起腰。

1a263ee5fae07e43d14c.source: An epic for all the wrong reasons!
1a263ee5fae07e43d14c.translation: 这下算是出了名，可惜不是好名声！

3e118d32fea0d493d66d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%minstrel% the minstrel picks up a lute. You've no clue where he got the instrument, but he gives the strings a few strokes, drawing the attention of the rest of the company. He picks up his head, eyes closed, and begins to sing.%SPEECH_ON%I... -strum- joined a band of mercenaries, my coffers all gone... -strum-... they wanted a fighter, but all I had were songs. The end.%SPEECH_OFF%The company laughs as the fool throws the lute over his shoulder. | %minstrel% the minstrel produces a lute seeming out of thin air like a magician would a rabbit. He gives it a practiced strum, then breaks into song.%SPEECH_ON%There once was a monster that terrorized fair Riggabong... -strum-... They called it, if I recall, a real problem... -strum strum-...

This beast could only feast on the ladies, but just the virgins oh yeah it had great taste!...-plucky strum-... but obviously that was not, for man or woman, a desired fate!...-sketchy strum, a new one-...

 So they hired Sir Galicock, the greatest sword-swinger in the land...-playful strum-...and so he went door to door, and vanquished every virgin a good swordsman can!...-a lingering, sad strum-... and the monster starved to death. The end.%SPEECH_OFF% | As a fire crackles and the men begin to get weary eyed in front of its flame, %minstrel% the minstrel clears his throat in a manner best described as 'everybody listen.' He stands up, too, and raises his hand as though it carried a glass with which to toast.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, you are some of the finest men I've ever met. I say that because I never knew my father and I spent all my years with the womenfolk.%SPEECH_OFF%He stares longingly into the distance.%SPEECH_ON%Damn, have I been with a lot of women.%SPEECH_OFF%And then he sits down. A moment of silence lingers in the air before it's broken with uproarious laughter. | %minstrel% the minstrel is looking for his lute. Upon not to being able to find it, he resorts to an 'air lute' instead, plucking playfully with his thumb.%SPEECH_ON%Hold on, that didn't sound quite right, lemme tune it.%SPEECH_OFF%He raises his hand and twists his finger, then goes for another strum.%SPEECH_ON%The hell? That was worse than the first. Just a sec, I'll get it, I promise.%SPEECH_OFF%He tries again, but apparently this 'strum' wasn't any good either.%SPEECH_ON%To hell with this piece of shite!%SPEECH_OFF%The minstrel jumps to his feet and repeatedly smashes the invisible lute against the ground before heaving it into the tall grass. He sweeps the sweat from his brow.%SPEECH_ON%You were right, dear father, I should have been a blacksmith.%SPEECH_OFF%And then he storms off, confused laughter from the company crackling behind him. | While throwing dirt into the fire, %minstrel% the minstrel begins to speak, to whom nobody can be sure.%SPEECH_ON%The old gods said let there be light, did they not? 'Tis the first thing they did, so clearly light must be important.%SPEECH_OFF%He picks up a piece of dirt and seems to analyze it.%SPEECH_ON%So why is there so much pleasure to be found where a woman is darkest?%SPEECH_OFF%The initially confused onlookers burst into laughter. | %minstrel% the minstrel stands up and clacks his boots together.%SPEECH_ON%Shall I show you fools how to dance?%SPEECH_OFF%A few men look up and shake their heads.%SPEECH_ON%Oh come on. It's simple. Watch.%SPEECH_OFF%The man raises a leg, it goes into an angle no man's leg should before planting back on the ground. He twirls, arms above his head. He then fans his arms out as if to fly. It's actually quite beautiful, though you'd never admit as much to any living soul. You watch as the minstrel continues, leaning forward when suddenly he rips a horrendous fart right into %otherbrother%'s face.

 %minstrel% straightens up in an instant, as though the gas had fixed a bad back and he sought the immediate use of it.%SPEECH_ON%I, uh... well, that's all folks! So hopefully you got the moves down pat!%SPEECH_OFF%He runs off, a particularly slighted and smelly man on his heels. The rest of the men bowl over with laughter.}
3e118d32fea0d493d66d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{吟游诗人%minstrel%拿起一把鲁特琴。你不知道乐器从哪儿来的，只见他拨了几下弦，吸引了众人的目光。他抬头闭眼，开口唱道。%SPEECH_ON%我……——拨弦——钱袋空空，投身佣兵一帮……——拨弦——他们要的是战士，我却只会歌唱。完。%SPEECH_OFF%这傻瓜把鲁特琴往肩后一扔，弟兄们大笑起来。 | 吟游诗人%minstrel%仿佛凭空掏出一把鲁特琴，像魔术师变出兔子。他娴熟地拨弦，随即唱了起来。%SPEECH_ON%从前有个怪物，让美丽的Riggabong遭殃……——拨弦——要我没记错，人们说这麻烦可真大……——再拨两下——

那怪物只吃姑娘，偏挑处女下肚，口味真不差！——轻快拨弦——可无论男人女人，谁都不想落这下场！——生涩地试了个新调——

于是他们请来加利科克爵士，天下最会舞剑的好儿郎……——俏皮拨弦——他便挨家挨户，用一身剑术，把处女全数“扫荡”！——余音拖长，略带悲伤——结果怪物饿死了。完。%SPEECH_OFF% | 篝火噼啪作响，弟兄们望着火光，渐渐眼皮发沉。吟游诗人%minstrel%清了清嗓子，那架势只能形容为“都听着”。他还站起来，举起一只手，仿佛握着杯子要祝酒。%SPEECH_ON%诸位，你们是我见过最出色的一批男人。这么说，是因为我从没见过亲爹，这辈子又一直跟女人混。%SPEECH_OFF%他满怀眷恋地望向远方。%SPEECH_ON%娘的，我可真跟过不少女人。%SPEECH_OFF%随后，他坐下了。空气沉默片刻，终于被哄堂大笑打破。 | 吟游诗人%minstrel%正在找鲁特琴。找不到，便改弹一把“空气鲁特琴”，拇指煞有介事地拨弄。%SPEECH_ON%等等，这声儿不对，让我调调。%SPEECH_OFF%他抬手拧了拧手指，又拨一下。%SPEECH_ON%见鬼？比刚才还糟。等会儿，我保证能调好。%SPEECH_OFF%他再试，可这一“拨”显然还是不行。%SPEECH_ON%去他娘的破烂！%SPEECH_OFF%吟游诗人跳起身，把那看不见的琴往地上砸了一次又一次，最后远远扔进高草。他抹去额头的汗。%SPEECH_ON%亲爱的父亲，你说得对，我就该去当铁匠。%SPEECH_OFF%说完怒气冲冲地走了，身后战团响起满带困惑的笑声。 | 吟游诗人%minstrel%一边往火里扔土，一边开口，谁也不知是在跟谁说话。%SPEECH_ON%旧神说，要有光，对吧？这是祂们最先做的事，所以光显然很重要。%SPEECH_OFF%他捡起一块土，似乎在仔细研究。%SPEECH_ON%那为什么，女人最暗的地方，偏偏藏着最多乐趣？%SPEECH_OFF%原先不明所以的旁观者，顿时爆笑起来。 | 吟游诗人%minstrel%站起身，双靴一碰，咔哒作响。%SPEECH_ON%要不要我教教你们这些笨蛋，什么叫跳舞？%SPEECH_OFF%几个弟兄抬头，摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%来嘛，很简单。看着。%SPEECH_OFF%他抬起一条腿，弯出常人不该有的角度，才重新落地。接着举臂过头，旋转身体，再把双臂展开，仿佛要飞。其实相当优美，不过你绝不会向任何活人承认。你看着吟游诗人继续表演，身体向前一倾，忽然对着%otherbrother%的脸，放了一个骇人的响屁。

%minstrel%瞬间挺直腰，仿佛这股气治好了坏背，而他急着立刻用一用。%SPEECH_ON%我，呃……好了，各位，到此为止！希望你们都把动作学会了！%SPEECH_OFF%他拔腿就跑，一个受尽冒犯、又沾了一脸臭气的男人紧追其后。其余弟兄笑得前仰后合。}

5a1864bb713e7ae218ff.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] Ah, the campfire is brimming with talk and chatter. The men are enjoying some beer and food when rather suddenly the shouts of two men in particular get everyone else to quiet down, not because they yell louder than the rest, but because it's rather out of character for the both of them: the monks %monk1% and %monk2% are screaming-deep in a theological debate.

You've not the education to understand the intricacies nor complexities of what they are arguing, but you do understand that getting into another man's face and pointing furiously at him, or at a holy book, is probably asking for trouble one way or another.
5a1864bb713e7ae218ff.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] 篝火旁谈笑声不断，弟兄们喝着啤酒，吃着东西。突然，两个人的叫嚷让其他人都安静下来。并不是他们喊得最响，而是这场面实在与他们平日的模样相去甚远：修士%monk1%和%monk2%正为神学争论得面红耳赤。

你没读过足够多的书，听不懂他们那些精妙复杂的道理。但有一点你明白：凑到别人脸前，怒气冲冲地指着对方或圣书，无论如何都像是在自找麻烦。

cc3355988684f77fd918.source: A mercenary company is no place to talk religion!

981829ed7d14aed2f533.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] For a moment, you think to stop the debate before it gets out of hand and into fists, but then you remember that this isn't the first time you've seen two holy men exchanging rather heatedly. It's just what they do. So you decide to let the men hash it out. In time, their voices lower in volume, and their faces lower together into a book. They quietly peruse it, bumping heads as they draw their eyes over the pages. Finally, %monk1% raises up, pointing to some sentence.%SPEECH_ON%There! Right there! 'Man from mud', not 'man from blood'. Man can't be from blood, he is blood! Man can't be from himself, see? Now does it make sense?%SPEECH_OFF%Scratching his chin, %monk2% nods, but then wonders aloud.%SPEECH_ON%What if...%SPEECH_OFF%Before he can even finish the thought %monk1% slaps the book closed and throws his hands into the air.
981829ed7d14aed2f533.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] 有那么一瞬，你想趁争论尚未失控、变成拳脚相向之前制止他们。可转念一想，这又不是头一回见两位神职人员吵得激烈，他们本就如此。于是，你决定让两人自己谈出个结果。过了一会儿，嗓门渐渐低下，两颗脑袋也一同凑到书前。他们安静翻阅，顺着字行看去，不时碰到彼此的头。最后，%monk1%抬起身，指着一句话。%SPEECH_ON%这儿，就这儿！“人由泥生”，不是“人由血生”。人怎么能来自血？人本身就是血肉！人总不能来自自己，明白吗？这下说得通了吧？%SPEECH_OFF%%monk2%摸着下巴点点头，又出声琢磨。%SPEECH_ON%可如果……%SPEECH_OFF%话还没说完，%monk1%便啪地合上书，双手朝天一摊。

5be241116563ea841d1c.source: The holy men avert another crisis.
5be241116563ea841d1c.translation: 两位圣职者又化解了一场危机。

aff5c499016cdd566a57.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]Now, this isn't the first time you've seen two monks squabbling. The last time it happened the debaters hashed it out right quick. So naturally you think these two will do the same. Alas, it isn't to be. Their voices grow louder and louder. You never knew monks could be so sharp-tongued. Fierceness and lewdness don't even begin to describe the insults being thrown back and forth. It isn't but a few seconds later that they are on the ground, wrestling and punching until you order %otherguy% to put an end to it.

The company of sellswords and their bloody daywork, it seems, have left a mark on the once peaceful demeanor of the two.
aff5c499016cdd566a57.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你并非头一回见到修士争吵。上一次，那些辩论者很快便谈妥了，所以你自然以为这两位也会如此。可惜，事情并未如你所料。他们嗓门越来越高，你从不知道修士的嘴竟能这么毒。凶狠、下流都不足以形容那些来回对骂的污言秽语。没过几秒，两人便滚到地上，扭打挥拳，直到你命令%otherguy%把他们拉开。

看来，与佣兵为伍，日日见血，终究还是在这两个曾经平和的人身上留下了痕迹。

cb54384d9dffbb615067.source: I suppose this is what they call a crisis of faith.
cb54384d9dffbb615067.translation: 我想，这就叫信仰危机吧。

63fdf246821e67b468c0.source: Had a stimulating discourse on religious matters
63fdf246821e67b468c0.translation: 就宗教问题进行了一番酣畅的辩论

c73486dca979e5e041c7.source: Lost his composure and resorted to violence

3298ec16fd7948249e73.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You're sitting in your tent enjoying the peace and quiet which, like some increasable quantity, seemingly has accrued in such a way that each day is more enjoyable than the last. Suddenly, %combatbro1% and %combatbro2% enter. They demand you have a talk. You oblige, fanning your hands across your table and inviting them to sit. They do and quickly state that it has been a long while since they last saw combat. Taken aback, you quite literally lean back in your chair.%SPEECH_ON%Isn't that a good thing?%SPEECH_OFF%%combatbro1% shakes his head and cuts a determined hand through the air.%SPEECH_ON%No. We were hired to fight, and fighting is what we want. We want battles, we want carnage, and we want the glory that comes with both.%SPEECH_OFF%
3298ec16fd7948249e73.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你坐在帐篷里享受难得的清静。这份安逸仿佛也能日积月累，让日子一天比一天舒坦。突然，%combatbro1%和%combatbro2%走了进来，要求与你谈谈。你摊开双手，示意他们坐下。他们刚坐定便直奔主题：已经很久没打过仗了。你一愣，身子不由向椅背靠去。%SPEECH_ON%这不是好事吗？%SPEECH_OFF%%combatbro1%摇摇头，斩钉截铁地挥了下手。%SPEECH_ON%不是。咱们受雇就是来打仗的，想干的也只有打仗。咱们要战斗，要杀戮，也要由此赢得的荣耀。%SPEECH_OFF%

91680d30f0edcf20fc70.source: We'll see battle soon - you have my word!

4b44e0479326c3b36463.source: You're getting paid either way - and now you even get to live and spend the crowns.
4b44e0479326c3b36463.translation: 反正军饷照拿，如今你们还能活着花这笔钱。

fd07766e4627678166fc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You nod.%SPEECH_ON%I understand. You are two battle-earnest men. You even remind me of myself though, with your skills, I can assure you that only I come out looking better by such a comparison. You are fine warriors, but is it not true that you will be paid the same regardless of this battle or that? Why be so worried about battles? They will come. I've not paid you to sit. I've paid you to be ready to stand.%SPEECH_OFF%The men exchange a glance and then shrug and nod. They stand up in unison.%SPEECH_ON%You are right, sir. And, when the time comes, we will be ready to stand and fight for you!%SPEECH_OFF%
fd07766e4627678166fc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我明白，你们两个都盼着打仗，甚至让我想起自己。不过，凭你们的本事，这一比，显得更强的肯定还是我。你们都是好战士，可打这一仗也好，那一仗也好，拿的钱难道不都一样？何必这么着急？仗总会有。我付钱，可不是让你们坐着，而是让你们随时准备站起来。%SPEECH_OFF%两人对视一眼，耸耸肩，又点点头，一同站起身。%SPEECH_ON%你说得对，团长。等时候到了，我们一定站出来，为你而战！%SPEECH_OFF%

3645e122b5d60a2b6913.source: Good to have the men burn for battle like this.
3645e122b5d60a2b6913.translation: 弟兄们如此渴望战斗，是件好事。

1d9d881475867c3677c2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You try and explain to the men that, regardless of whether or not they're fighting, they are going to be getting paid. But money is not their primary concern. They truly wish to fight and you words have little effect on their rather earnest attitudes.
1d9d881475867c3677c2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你试着解释，无论有没有仗打，军饷都照样发。可钱并不是弟兄们最在意的东西。他们确实渴望战斗，你这番话对那股热切几乎毫无作用。

9ac69c5bc354fc2c974c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You stand up and flatten your knuckles on the table.%SPEECH_ON%Is it fighting you want?%SPEECH_OFF%The men exchange a glance then quickly nod at you.%SPEECH_ON%Then it is fighting you shall have! Fear not the sheathed sword, mercenaries. I will find you a good battle in due time!%SPEECH_OFF%Rising to their feet, the men shake your hand. They thank you as they leave the tent. Once they're gone, you go to your maps and look for the nearest ass to kick.
9ac69c5bc354fc2c974c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你站起来，指节撑在桌上。%SPEECH_ON%想打仗，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们互看一眼，赶紧点头。%SPEECH_ON%那就有仗给你们打！佣兵们，别怕刀剑闲在鞘里，我很快就给你们找场好仗！%SPEECH_OFF%他们起身与你握手，道着谢离开帐篷。人一走，你便摊开地图，寻找最近那个欠收拾的家伙。

f2ce86767d4e6a1235e1.translation: 得到承诺，很快就会有仗打

c26e1436fee3aeef1c65.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]The entire company - a motley little crew if you say so yourself - enters your tent all at once. A troupe of sellswords appearing in such a fashion is not the friendliest of sights and so for a split-second you think to reach for your sword. But then you notice that none of them have their weapons out nor do they carry the faces of men about to commit a murder. While they don't seem to be forming a mutiny to take your head, you keep the thought in mind nonetheless.

 You are only further relieved when they don't immediately start talking, instead waiting for your words to come first. This is a show of respect, and so the thought of reaching for your sword grows more distant. Crossing your arms over the table, you ask them what is on their minds.

 They explain that the company is too thin. Everywhere they go there is danger and the men are now concerned that every new battle shall be their last. Finally, they state their wants outright: if they are going to survive, they're going to need more brothers by their side.
c26e1436fee3aeef1c65.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]整个战团的人一齐挤进你的帐篷——说实话，也就是这么一小撮杂牌人马。一群佣兵如此登门，怎么看都不像是好事，有那么一瞬间，你甚至想伸手拔剑。但随即你注意到，没人亮出武器，脸上也没有即将动手杀人的神情。看起来，他们不是来哗变砍你脑袋的，不过你仍暗自留了个心眼。

 他们没有立刻开口，而是等着你先说话，这又让你松了一口气。这是尊重的表现，你拔剑的念头也越发淡了。你把双臂交叠在桌上，问他们有什么心事。

 弟兄们解释，战团的人手太少了。无论走到哪里都危机四伏，大家越来越担心，下一场战斗就是自己的最后一战。最终，他们直截了当地说出了要求：要想活下去，就得有更多弟兄并肩作战。

76675fcc3eb69c817ea9.source: I'd hire more men if only we could afford it.
76675fcc3eb69c817ea9.translation: 只要养得起，我也想多招些人。

16b722de760f3265ee6b.source: We'll reinforce the company with new men soon - you have my word.
16b722de760f3265ee6b.translation: 我保证，很快就招新人来补充战团。

e1e760c432c1d4300e67.source: There is no need to hire men, we're doing fine this way.
e1e760c432c1d4300e67.translation: 用不着再招人，这样就挺好。

5f41ec6e75fd5fe321fe.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You immediately stand up and rap the table with your knuckles.%SPEECH_ON%The best of minds truly must think alike for I have already set aside some crowns for hiring new brothers!%SPEECH_OFF%The anxious, almost sad faces on the men slowly begin to change. They smile and nod and say things like 'alright' and 'that's good.' When they turn to leave, you notice they've got daggers sheathed behind their backs.
5f41ec6e75fd5fe321fe.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你立刻起身，用指节敲了敲桌子。%SPEECH_ON%果然英雄所见略同，我已经留出一笔克朗，准备招募新弟兄了！%SPEECH_OFF%众人忧虑得近乎悲伤的表情渐渐变了，开始微笑、点头，说着“那就好”“不错”。他们转身离开时，你注意到，每个人背后都藏着一把带鞘的匕首。

9c53abdad6cf69d26035.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Unfortunately, you just don't agree.%SPEECH_ON%You are some of the finest soldiers I've ever seen. I don't think you have anything to fear. Our enemies fear for their own lives when they see you!%SPEECH_OFF%But your words don't go over well. One man leans forward with an arm behind his back, but another man claps a hand on his shoulder and quickly shakes his head. He only looks at you and says.%SPEECH_ON%This is most concerning news, sir, but we shall carry on.%SPEECH_OFF%When they turn to leave, you notice the clasp on one man's sheathed dagger has been unlatched.
9c53abdad6cf69d26035.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]可惜，你并不赞同。%SPEECH_ON%你们是我见过最出色的战士。我不觉得有什么好怕的。敌人见到你们，才该担心自己的小命！%SPEECH_OFF%可这番话并没有起到好作用。一人探身向前，手藏在背后；另一人却一把按住他的肩，迅速摇头。那人只是看着你，说道。%SPEECH_ON%这回答实在让人忧心，团长。不过，我们会继续干下去。%SPEECH_OFF%两人转身离开时，你注意到，其中一人腰间匕首的鞘扣已经解开。

fe1b931e3a52822722f0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Fanning your arms out and pressing forth a smile that couldn't sell water to a thirsty man, you lie.%SPEECH_ON%We've simply not the coffers to take on more men.%SPEECH_OFF%The men don't take it well. One immediately turns around and exits the tent, a wake of curses and swears in the wake of his leaving. Another brother momentarily reaches behind his back. You glance at your sword again. He sees you doing this, and then puts his hands back where you can see them. Finally, he nods.%SPEECH_ON%We'll do as told, sir. For now.%SPEECH_OFF%
fe1b931e3a52822722f0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你摊开双臂，挤出一个连渴鬼都骗不到水钱的笑，撒了个谎。%SPEECH_ON%账上实在没有余钱再招人。%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们很不买账。一个人立刻转身出帐，一路咒骂不止；另一个人的手短暂地伸向背后。你又瞥了眼自己的剑。他看见了，便把双手放回你看得见的地方，最后点头。%SPEECH_ON%我们会听令，团长。至少眼下会。%SPEECH_OFF%

6f06c9f0b0b32d2a8810.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]When you let the men know that you've not enough crowns on hand to hire more men, they nod.%SPEECH_ON%We thought you might say that. So here's our suggestion, and we don't say this lightly, but each of us will give you part of what we saved up for retirement so that you may hire others. And you'll pay us back with our wages.%SPEECH_OFF%You quickly glance up, the suggestion seemingly coming out of nowhere.
6f06c9f0b0b32d2a8810.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你告诉弟兄们，手头的克朗不够再雇人，他们点点头。%SPEECH_ON%猜到你会这么说。所以我们有个提议，也不是随口讲讲：大家从养老钱里各拿出一部分给你，让你招些新人。之后，再随军饷慢慢还给我们。%SPEECH_OFF%你猛地抬头，这提议实在出乎意料。

a6984bc5eb2ea644b988.source: This is the way we shall do it then - thank you all for your sacrifice.
a6984bc5eb2ea644b988.translation: 那就这么办，多谢大家的牺牲。

5e8c9b0544b9439b8d74.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You let the men know that you've not the crowns to take on more sellswords. They collectively sigh and nod.%SPEECH_ON%That's alright, sir. T'was only a suggestion. As always, we shall march on your orders.%SPEECH_OFF%The men turn and leave, a little slouched over and quieter than before.
5e8c9b0544b9439b8d74.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你告诉弟兄们，没钱再招更多佣兵。他们一同叹气，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%没事，团长，只是个提议。和往常一样，我们听你的命令。%SPEECH_OFF%他们转身离开，背比刚才更弯，话也更少了。

ed2318a2183ec84f9c63.source: Things will pick up for the company, I'm sure.
ed2318a2183ec84f9c63.translation: 战团的日子会好起来的，我确信。

01228f1ab8a1c223e20f.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You get up and shake the hands of each man. While you loudly state that you wish it didn't come to this, you are secretly beaming at the fact you now have more crowns at your disposal.
01228f1ab8a1c223e20f.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你起身与每个人握手，嘴上大声说着真不愿事情走到这一步，心里却因手头又多了些可用的克朗而暗自高兴。

89d7598da4652e75d7e6.source: Let's go hire some more men for the company!

48cc8039d7572ee7cdea.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You look the men over. They are solemn creatures, not the ones you last saw grinning and laughing over their latest victory or triumph. While you can't yet afford to get them more men, there really is no need to cut their pay.%SPEECH_ON%I appreciate the selflessness and bravery it must've took to suggest such a thing, but I cannot possibly consider myself a man of honor and grant you this request. Your savings shall remain untouched.%SPEECH_OFF%
48cc8039d7572ee7cdea.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你打量众人。此刻他们神情肃穆，已不是上次为胜利笑闹的模样。虽然暂时没钱给他们添些帮手，却也实在不必动他们的军饷。%SPEECH_ON%能提出这种办法，需要多少无私与勇气，我心里有数。可若答应你们，我还有什么脸自称有荣誉的人？你们的积蓄，一个子儿也不动。%SPEECH_OFF%

61e20af7149a0e20b2ee.translation: 无论如何，你的好意我领了。

5cc7d5e1356ce8a94f7e.source: Was lied to and lost confidence in your leadership
5cc7d5e1356ce8a94f7e.translation: 受骗后不再信任你的领导

91d9060bdffbf4aaf744.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]Climbing and barreling through the ups and downs of the mountain range has tested the men as well as any foe. While the company is a little worse for the wear, they have been made better by the rigors and trials of the harsh landscape - %dude% most of all.
91d9060bdffbf4aaf744.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]在起伏的群山中攀爬奔走，对弟兄们的考验不亚于任何敌人。战团虽有些疲惫磨损，却也被这片险峻大地的艰苦磨炼得更强了，尤其是%dude%。

1d342f12c535dd8fc1ee.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]Although deep in the mountains, you can see the peaks of the cordillera stretching further onward yet, each one piping up between the valleys of the other. It is a beautiful sight, but also an exhausting one. Hiking through the passes - and sometimes finding passes of your own - has been hard on the men. Slopes of whinstone and sediment and unruly gravel have your men clambering on hands and knees. Each slippery talus funnels the weary back down from whence they came, testing the resolve of those who are not keen on so many a repeat journey.

 And yet, around you there are mountain goats traipsing about. One bounds impossibly up an anticline with mocking ease and another chamfers on dry grass between confused bleats. Bridges of stone, cantilevered overhead with jurassic geology, bear the winking heads of curious mountain lions. You get the feeling they've seen your kind before. They know not to attack, but they follow nonetheless. Maybe one of you will fall and break something and the maimed shall be left behind because carrying the wounded in such a place is a death for two.

Taking stock of your men, you find many are suffering injuries. Shin splints. Sore calves. Throbbing knees. Probably some broken bones, but nothing fatal. Only the strong and agile can safely navigate their way through a place such as this, and indeed they are typically the first to the top of every climb.
1d342f12c535dd8fc1ee.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]虽已深入山中，你仍能看见群峰连绵，朝更远处延伸，一座座峰顶从彼此的山谷间探出。这景色壮丽，却也让人疲惫。翻越山口，乃至自行寻找可走的缺口，让弟兄们吃尽苦头。玄武岩、沉积土与松散碎石铺成的斜坡，逼得众人手脚并用。湿滑的碎石坡不断把疲惫的人滑送回原处，反复重攀，格外考验那些已不愿再走一遍的人的意志。

 然而，身旁的山羊却来去自如。一只轻而易举地跃上隆起的岩层，简直不可思议，仿佛在嘲弄你们；另一只嚼着枯草，间或茫然地咩叫几声。自远古便悬挑在头顶的石桥上，好奇的山狮探出脑袋，眨眼打量。你觉得，它们以前见过你们这样的人。它们知道不该进攻，却仍一路跟随。也许会有人失足，摔断些什么，然后被迫留下；因为在这种地方抬着伤员走，就等于让两个人一起送命。

你查看弟兄们的状况，发现不少人都受了伤：胫骨刺痛、小腿酸胀、膝盖抽疼。大概还有人骨折，不过都不致命。只有强健敏捷的人，才能安然穿过这样的险地，而每次攀登，他们也往往最先抵达顶端。

a19a97373690143c9550.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{Food stocks have run out! Despite the horrors of this world, the %companyname% can't be fielding a company of skeletons! You need to get the men food fast before they rightfully leave. | Even the most loyal of men is only as good as about five or six missed meals. After that, anyone is apt to leave and get themselves fed. Acquire food - and do it fast before the company falls apart! | You've miscalculated the food reserves and placed the %companyname% into a unique danger - that of going hungry. Even the deadliest of companies would fall apart in days if it goes unfed and this company will be no different if you don't change things fast!}
a19a97373690143c9550.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{食物已经耗尽！这世道再怎么可怕，%companyname%也不能带着一群骷髅上阵！赶紧给弟兄们找吃的，否则他们离开也是理所当然。 | 再忠心的人，也不过能忍上五六顿饿。再往后，谁都可能离队，自谋生路。快去弄些食物，别等战团散了才后悔！ | 你算错了粮食储备，让%companyname%陷入一种格外棘手的危险——挨饿。再凶悍的战团，断粮几天也会土崩瓦解。你若不赶紧想办法，这支战团也不会例外！}

f506d3e70670f21da603.source: I need to get the men something to eat.

6c36e6349835329cbec2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{You find the mercenaries circled around a campfire, except they've no real food to put over the flames. One throws his bowl of soup down. It is such a sludge that it barely moves to spill which is, honestly, quite disgusting. %randombrother% looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, please, let us get some meat! Or something beyond this shite!%SPEECH_OFF%A bit of variety wouldn't hurt, you agree. | %randombrother% comes to you and slams a spoon on your desk. There's something on the spoon, but what exactly you can't tell. The mercenary leans back, thumbs jacked into his beltline, his chest growing with breath. Then he sighs, for he knows not to behave in such ill-manner in your presence. But he does explain himself.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, the men are complaining about the food. I think it'd be great for company morale if perhaps we picked up some meats and other goods in the next town. Only a suggestion, of course.%SPEECH_OFF%He quickly leaves. You pick up the spoon and look at whatever is in the scoop of it. That... that can't really be what they're eating out there, can it? Perhaps some variety wouldn't hurt... | %randombrother% approaches with a bowl in hand. He tilts it forward, showing the contents which are colorless and slide ever so slowly down the rim of the bowl. The mercenary shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%The men are unhappy sir, and myself too, about the dinners we've been eating. A man can only eat the same contents day after day for so long, especially when he knows he can afford so much more. It is only a suggestion, sir, from myself and from all the men, that perhaps we liven up our food stocks so that not every meal is... well, this.%SPEECH_OFF%He sets the bowl down and walks off. | A few of your mercenaries are complaining around a campfire. You stay within earshot, carefully listening as they might say things they wouldn't in your presence. Thankfully, it's not a mutiny in motion, but instead a series of cooking criticisms. There simply is not enough variety in the company's food stocks. They're tired of eating the same thing over and over. Perhaps this could be remedied in the next town the %companyname% visits?}
6c36e6349835329cbec2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_52.png[/img]{你发现佣兵们围坐篝火，却没什么像样食物可架上火烤。一人摔下汤碗，里面的东西稠得像泥，几乎连洒都洒不动。说实话，相当恶心。%randombrother%望着你。%SPEECH_ON%长官，求你了，弄点肉吧！或者随便什么，总比这破玩意儿强！%SPEECH_OFF%你同意，换换口味没坏处。 | %randombrother%走来，将一把勺子砰地拍在桌上。勺上有东西，可究竟是什么，你看不出来。佣兵向后一仰，拇指插进腰带，胸膛随深呼吸鼓起，随后叹了口气。他知道，不该在你面前如此无礼。不过，还是解释道。%SPEECH_ON%长官，弟兄们都在抱怨饭食。我想，下个镇子买点肉和别的吃食，对战团士气会很有好处。当然，只是建议。%SPEECH_OFF%他匆匆离开。你拿起勺子，端详里面那团东西。这……外面吃的不会真就是这个吧？也许，多些花样确实不坏…… | %randombrother%端碗走来，向前一倾，让你看里面的东西。毫无颜色，沿着碗边极其缓慢地滑动。佣兵摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%长官，弟兄们对近来的饭食很不满意，我也一样。一个人总不能日复一日吃同样的东西，尤其明知道还有钱买更好的。这只是建议，长官，是我的，也是所有弟兄的：也许该让粮仓丰富些，别每顿都是……嗯，这个。%SPEECH_OFF%他放下碗，走了。 | 几个佣兵围着篝火抱怨。你停在听得见的地方，仔细聆听，毕竟他们可能说出些当面不会说的话。幸好，不是在酝酿叛变，只是一连串关于饭食的批评。战团存粮的种类实在太少，大家吃来吃去都是同样的东西，已经腻了。也许，%companyname%下次进镇时，可以解决这个问题？}

d4e96b1182eaeb713f56.source: Has eaten nothing but ground grains for days

fcaffbf357075eda943e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img] %noble% suddenly enters your tent. He's attired in armor and his weapon is at his side. It almost seems as if he dressed up for this occasion, and he does indeed stand upright and proper. You ask what it is he wants, and he speaks with his head held high and his eyes looking straight ahead.%SPEECH_ON%It has come to my attention that %lowborn% is paid more than I. While I've no issue with the man personally, I do want to point out that he is a man with no birthright to anything but his own two feet. You can't possibly have a lowborn being paid more than a man of the purple. We noblemen deserve more.%SPEECH_OFF%
fcaffbf357075eda943e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img] %noble%突然走进你的帐篷。他披着盔甲，腰佩武器，仿佛专为这次会面整装而来，站姿也格外挺拔端正。你问他有什么事，他昂着头，目视前方，开口说道。%SPEECH_ON%我发现，%lowborn%的薪水竟然比我还高。我对他本人并无成见，但必须指出，他出身卑微，生来除了两条腿，什么也继承不了。您总不能让一个贱民拿得比贵族还多。我们这些出身高贵的人，理应得到更多。%SPEECH_OFF%

eb6bc80ace6232efba26.source: I will see to it you are paid no less than him.
eb6bc80ace6232efba26.translation: 我会让你的军饷不低于他。

11d92b52c81fd4eaf071.source: We pay by veterancy and skill, not bloodline.
11d92b52c81fd4eaf071.translation: 军饷看资历和本事，不看血统。

5df3638c6e50df2b48c0.source: How about we lower your pay instead?
5df3638c6e50df2b48c0.translation: 要不反过来，降你的军饷如何？

ade5c1621b2d25ead534.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You don't necessarily agree with him, but at the same time you can see that denying this request may cause some heretofore unseen problems. With a few dashes of your quill pen across the roster scroll, you assign %noble% a higher salary and tell him to expect a heavier purse come next payday. The man finally looks at you and bows from the waist.%SPEECH_ON%You've made the good and proper decision.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns on his heels and marches back out with as much gusto as he did coming in.
ade5c1621b2d25ead534.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你未必认同他的说法，可也看得出，拒绝这个要求可能引来未曾料到的麻烦。你在名册上挥了几笔，给%noble%加了军饷，告诉他下次发钱时，钱袋会更沉些。他终于正眼看你，弯腰鞠躬。%SPEECH_ON%你的决定既正确，也合乎体统。%SPEECH_OFF%他转身大步出帐，和来时一样神气。

cb70deccbf70de766eec.source: Equal pay will keep the peace.

6794671d3bd18b71113e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You tell the man to look at you. He slowly shifts his eyes to yours. Having his attention, you explain how it is around here.%SPEECH_ON%I pay on seniority and veterancy, not who you were before you signed the dotted line. You could be a goatfarmer for all I care, if you can swing a sword you'll get paid, and if you can swing it better than the next man then I'll be damned, you'll be getting paid more than the next man! Anything in that you don't understand?%SPEECH_OFF%%noble%'s jowls quiver as he bottles a sudden spurt of rage. He speaks through clenched teeth.%SPEECH_ON%No, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%With a flick of a wrist, you tell him to get out of your sight. He leaves in a hurry, his upright stance falling into a seething slouch.
6794671d3bd18b71113e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你叫他看着你。他慢慢将视线转向你的眼睛。等他听着了，你便讲清这里的规矩。%SPEECH_ON%我按资历和战场上的本事发钱，不看你签契约前是什么人。你就是个养山羊的，我也不在乎。会挥剑，就有钱拿；剑使得比别人好，那他娘的就该拿得比别人多！哪句没听明白？%SPEECH_OFF%%noble%强压着陡然升起的怒火，两腮直颤。他咬着牙回答。%SPEECH_ON%都听明白了，长官。%SPEECH_OFF%你一挥手，让他赶紧消失。他匆匆离去，方才挺拔的站姿已经塌下，只剩满肚子怨气。

e2f8fc2b19c97068dd62.source: If you want to see more crowns, earn them.
e2f8fc2b19c97068dd62.translation: 想多拿克朗，就凭本事挣。

589d672776aa91fa8dcd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]You stand up out of your chair and yell at the man to look at you. He does as told and so you explain what is going to happen.%SPEECH_ON%%lowborn% made it through this world by dragging himself out of the mud. You were born with a silver spoon, but this isn't where you were born now is it? So from today consider your pay effectively lowered. You want the right to a higher salary? Earn it.%SPEECH_OFF%The noble's stance falters. He opens his mouth, but you quickly raise your hand.%SPEECH_ON%No more words. Get out of my sight.%SPEECH_OFF%
589d672776aa91fa8dcd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你从椅子上站起，喝令他看着你。他照做，你便告诉他接下来会怎样。%SPEECH_ON%%lowborn%是从泥里一步步爬出来，才在这世上挣得位置。你生来就含着银匙，可这里不是你出生的地方，对吧？所以从今天起，你的军饷降了。想拿更多？凭本事挣。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族气势一挫，张嘴想说话，你立刻抬手。%SPEECH_ON%一个字也别说。从我眼前消失。%SPEECH_OFF%

f5194820f7834f2e8cfc.source: Was denied satisfaction over a lowborn
f5194820f7834f2e8cfc.translation: 未能在平民面前讨回颜面

81a95373ef0e591c6d47.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img] You find the nobleman %nobleman_short% and the rather ragged-looking %lowborn% quarreling over the last piece of food on a spit. Apparently the lowborn got his fork to it first, but the nobleman claimed that his high stature granted him the right to the meat.
81a95373ef0e591c6d47.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你发现贵族%nobleman_short%与衣衫颇为破烂的%lowborn%，正为烤叉上的最后一块肉争吵。显然，平民先把叉子伸了过去，可贵族却声称，自己的高贵身份让他更有资格吃这块肉。

ffe5c598c448b406df88.source: In the company of sellswords, no man is low or highborn.
ffe5c598c448b406df88.translation: 当了佣兵，出身就没有贵贱之分。

1d667f711c4db3a109e2.source: You know the rules of the land, give the noble what he wants.
1d667f711c4db3a109e2.translation: 你知道这世道的规矩。照贵族的意思办。

c8485ede0a7437e01a08.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img] As the two men look to you for guidance, you fold your arms and shrug. They slowly turn back to one another. The other men in the camp stand up and step back, giving room to what is coming. The lowborn draws his dagger first. It is a simple thing with a wooden handle and jagged, unnaturally serrated edges. The nobleman pulls his blade in return, brandishing a metal that curves with the care of a blacksmith's mastery. Two golden snakes curl up the handle to bite the pommel. Its wielder grins, saying the riff-raff should learn their place. The lowborn grins like a man who has had no practice doing it.

Surprisingly, both men then chuck the daggers into the stumps upon which they sat and close rank with fists raised, the most equal of fighting grounds. In the ensuing battle the spit is immediately knocked aside and flames fan upward, raining wild embers and the felled food is now flavored with ash and soot.

Seeing their meal ruined, the rest of the company finally puts an end to the combat, pulling the two men apart. They threaten and spit at one another, but after a few minutes everything settles down.
c8485ede0a7437e01a08.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img] 两人望向你，等着你拿主意。你抱起双臂，耸耸肩。他们慢慢转回身，看向彼此。营里其他人站起退开，为接下来的事腾出地方。平民先拔出匕首，那东西简陋得很，木柄，刀刃参差不齐，磨出了不该有的锯齿。贵族也拔出自己的刀，刀身弧线流畅，尽显铁匠精湛的手艺；两条金蛇沿柄盘绕，咬住柄首。他咧嘴笑着，说下等人该认清自己的位置。平民也笑了，却像个从没练习过这种表情的人。

出乎意料，两人接着都把匕首掷进刚才坐着的树桩，举起拳头贴近彼此，选了最平等的打法。混战中，烤架立刻被撞到一边，火苗蹿起，火星四溅，掉到地上的食物也添了一层灰烬与烟尘的“佐料”。

眼看饭食被毁，其余弟兄终于出手，将两人拉开，结束了打斗。他们仍互相威胁、吐唾沫，不过几分钟后，一切还是平息下来。

456637853377761ed106.source: They'll become brothers in battle soon enough.
456637853377761ed106.translation: 并肩打过几场仗，他们就会亲如兄弟。

84cbf15c038a3cce7078.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]%nobleman% looks aghast. He slowly lifts his fork from the spit and %lowborn% immediately shovels the last bit of meat into his mouth. The nobleman gets up and heads your way. He straightens before you, bumping his chest into yours as you lock eyes. A few of the men put their hands on their pommels.%SPEECH_ON%{Siding with the lowborn, huh? I fancied you would, being lowborn yourself. Don't ever expect to become one of us. You're a sellsword for life. Remember that. | You expect to get a piece of land when all this is said and done, yeah? I hope you do, because then I'll come and knock and show you how nobles really treat one another.}%SPEECH_OFF%
84cbf15c038a3cce7078.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]%nobleman%一脸惊愕，慢慢将叉子从烤架旁收回，%lowborn%立刻把最后一块肉塞进嘴里。贵族站起来，朝你走来。他在你面前挺直身子，胸膛顶住你的胸膛，与你四目相对。几个弟兄已经把手搭上了剑柄。%SPEECH_ON%{站在贱民那边，是吧？我早料到了，毕竟你自己也是贱民。别指望有朝一日跻身我们的行列。你这辈子都只是个佣兵，记住了。 | 你是不是还指望，等一切结束，自己也能捞块封地？我倒真希望你能如愿。到时候我会上门拜访，让你好好见识一下，贵族之间到底是怎么相处的。}%SPEECH_OFF%

caf12f60e55e768b973b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]%nobleman% grins as he knocks %lowborn%'s fork out of the way. The nobleman takes the food for himself as the lowborn gets up and storms toward you. As he nears, some men look ready to draw swords, but you hold a hand out, calming them.%SPEECH_ON%I thought you were one of us, but I guess not. I suppose you think someday you'll be one of them, huh? Keep dreaming. As that man would say to me, 'Know your place'.%SPEECH_OFF%
caf12f60e55e768b973b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]%nobleman%咧嘴一笑，拨开%lowborn%的叉子，把肉拿走。平民起身，怒气冲冲地朝你走来。有几个人眼看便要拔剑，你伸手制止。%SPEECH_ON%我以为你跟我们是一伙的，看来错了。你大概想着，有朝一日也能挤进他们中间吧？做梦去吧。借那人会对我说的话奉劝一句：认清你自己的身份。%SPEECH_OFF%

b58037daea8d8342aa75.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]You find %oldguard% nursing a rather large tankard next to a fire. In fact, it's not a tankard at all, but a wooden bucket filled with ale. A few more modest mugs are littered about his feet. He tips back, gulping from the bucket's lip. When he sees you, he tries to dress up, sloughing the foam off his face and attempting a smile that quickly sloops into a drunken frown.%SPEECH_ON%Hey there, captain. Didn't mean for you to see me like this.%SPEECH_OFF%You set yourself down by the man and ask how he is doing.%SPEECH_ON%Being drunk.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, you reach for the bucket and the man gives it up, though his hands are shaped as if to still be holding it. You set the bucket down and ask again how he is doing. He finally drops his hands into his lap.%SPEECH_ON%Like shit. That's how I'm feeling. First, %casualty% went down. Then %othercasualty%. I know there's been at least five or six others. Just dead men. Come and gone. I got memories of them talking, and memories of them screaming, and I can't have one without the other. But I'm alright now cause right now I can't even think straight. If I can't unlearn a memory, I'll just go ahead and drown it. The ale does me well, heh.%SPEECH_OFF%With a sigh, you hand the bucket back to the man. Eyes lost in the fire, his mind lost in the past, he says nothing else.
b58037daea8d8342aa75.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_39.png[/img]你发现%oldguard%坐在火边，抱着一个大得出奇的酒杯慢慢喝。其实，那根本不是酒杯，而是一只盛满麦酒的木桶。他脚边还散落着几个大小正常的杯子。他仰起头，凑着桶沿大口吞咽。见你走来，他试图收拾仪容，抹去脸上的酒沫，勉强挤出一笑，却很快又皱成一张醉醺醺的苦脸。%SPEECH_ON%啊，团长。没想让你看见我这副样子。%SPEECH_OFF%你在他身旁坐下，问他怎么样。%SPEECH_ON%喝醉了呗。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，伸手去拿酒桶。他松了手，双掌却仍弯着，仿佛还抱着桶。你把桶放下，又问了一遍。他终于将手垂到膝上。%SPEECH_ON%糟透了。这就是我的感觉。先是%casualty%倒下了，然后是%othercasualty%。我知道，至少还有五六个。全死了。来了，又没了。我记得他们说话，也记得他们惨叫。一想起这个，另一个就跟着来了。不过，现在我没事，因为现在我连想都想不清楚。既然没法忘掉，我就把那些记忆全泡死在酒里。麦酒对我挺好，嘿。%SPEECH_OFF%你叹口气，把桶递回去。他的目光迷失在火焰里，心神迷失在往昔中，再没说一句话。

6213ad2537abeb07feb3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]Despite a recent defeat, %optimist% still sees a bright future for the %companyname%.%SPEECH_ON%Not all of life can be spent standin', fellas. Sometimes it's gotta be spent getting' back up. But we'll never spend it layin' down forever, I know that much! This company's too good for that lollygaggin' shite.%SPEECH_OFF%The ever optimistic sellsword's relentless positivity rubs off on some of the men, raising their spirits and leaving them ready for the tomorrows to come.
6213ad2537abeb07feb3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]虽然刚吃了败仗，%optimist%仍觉得%companyname%前途光明。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，人这一生不可能总站着，有些时候就是得从地上爬起来。可我们绝不会躺着一辈子不起，我敢打包票！咱们这战团这么好，才不会干那种窝囊事。%SPEECH_OFF%这个始终乐观的佣兵把那股不屈的积极劲儿传给了几个人，让他们振作起来，准备迎接明天。

7a35ee307a7205eb314b.source: A man to go down fighting with.
7a35ee307a7205eb314b.translation: 这是个值得一同战死的弟兄。

e8330fcb4d0aea48d2c8.source: Is optimistic despite a recent setback

f384a8b75fddd09fe3f5.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{A cairn with an unusual skull atop it. Perhaps a memorial to a great orc warrior. No matter what it means to the greenskins, what it means to you is simple: you're in their territory now. | You come across a wooden totem with curvatures cut into it. %randombrother% believes that they are traces of the night sky, perhaps of this constellation or that.

%randombrother2% spits and says all it means is that you're in orc territory and you'd best pay better mind to that than what the lights in the night are doing. | You find bones in the grass. The curvature of the ribs is obscene - far too large for a man. You wonder if it is that of a donkey, but the discovery of an enormous and oddly human-shaped skull confirms your suspicions: you've come onto orc territory. | Human heads on spikes. Their bodies - limbless - clumped into piles. They've been cut and mutilated. The only sense of humanity they have left are the shreds of clothes barely clinging to their destroyed flesh.

%randombrother% comes up, nodding.%SPEECH_ON%We've stepped into some shit now. This is orc territory.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come across a man's body, but not his head. That's gone. His genitals are also gone. And his feet and hands. Javelins stick out of what's left, someone or something have turned what remains into gruesome target practice.

 Taking a close look at the weapons, %randombrother% nods and turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Orcs, sir. We're in their lands now and, uh, clearly they don't take kindly to trespassers.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find a shattered skeleton nailed to a tree by an enormous axe. It's mostly just the chest cavity for the rest of it has long since fallen apart. Long, curving artwork has been carved into the tree trunk.%SPEECH_ON%This is greenskin territory.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% talks as he walks up to you. He touches the handle of the axe, its weight almost as sturdy as the tree it's embedded in.%SPEECH_ON%I'd say orc territory by the looks of things...%SPEECH_OFF% | You come to a stack of stones carefully placed on a small hillside. Inspecting them, you find white carvings on the rocks. Each one displays a different story - ones where large brutes wander and cause disturbing amounts of violence toward smaller, thinner stick figures. %randombrother% laughs at the drawings.%SPEECH_ON%That's orc fancery - what passes for such a thing, anyway. We're the little men in those pictures in case you were wonderin'.%SPEECH_OFF% | A leather tarp is found flapping from some sticks on a hill. There's evidence of an abandoned camp around it - a smoldering fire, fleeting footprints, a few bits of odd debris. %randombrother% points at it all.%SPEECH_ON%Their smell still lingers on all this. The smell of... Orcs.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother2% hocks and spits.%SPEECH_ON%Ya gotta strong nose for shit, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% nods.%SPEECH_ON%It ain't bullshit, though. We're in orc territory, men.%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother% walks up to a stack of human skulls you've come across. He analyzes their mortal wounds - mostly the fact that their bodies are nowhere in sight, decapitation is a hell of a thing to survive. Standing back up, he nods.%SPEECH_ON%Orcish artwork, fellas. Study it close lest you join the gallery.%SPEECH_OFF%You also nod and tell the men to be aware of the dangers ahead. | There's a feeling to the wilderness and there's a feeling to civilization - and what you got here doesn't fit either. You got an odd sensation as though you'd just trespassed unto someone else's territory. A gruesome pile of dead bodies shorn of any humanity they once had also helps make the distinction, and settle the simple matter of fact that you have now entered orcish lands.}
f384a8b75fddd09fe3f5.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_46.png[/img]{一座石冢，顶上放着一颗异样的头骨，也许是在纪念某位伟大的兽人战士。不管它对绿皮意味着什么，对你而言很简单：你们已进入它们的领地。 | 你遇见一根木图腾，上面刻着弯曲纹路。%randombrother%认为，那是夜空的轨迹，也许是某个星座。

%randombrother2%啐了一口，说这只意味着你们进了兽人领地，与其琢磨夜里的亮点在干什么，不如多留意眼前处境。 | 你在草里发现骨头。肋骨弯曲的尺寸大得离谱，绝不可能属于人类。你猜会不会是驴，可随后发现一颗巨大的、偏偏又像人类的头骨，证实了你的怀疑：这里是兽人领地。 | 人头插在尖桩上，失去四肢的躯体堆成一团，遭到割切与肢解。破坏殆尽的血肉上，勉强挂着几缕破衣，那是他们曾为人类的最后痕迹。

%randombrother%走来，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%这下踩进粪坑了。是兽人的地盘。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你遇见一具男尸，却找不到脑袋。那已经没了，生殖器也没了，还有双脚、双手。剩下的部分插着标枪，有人，或者有什么东西，把这些残骸当成了骇人的练习靶。

%randombrother%仔细看过武器，点头转向你。%SPEECH_ON%兽人，长官。我们进了它们的领地，而，呃，显然，它们不怎么欢迎闯入者。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一把巨斧将破碎骸骨钉在树上。大部分只剩胸腔，其余早已散落。树干上刻着长而弯曲的图案。%SPEECH_ON%这是绿皮的地盘。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%一边说，一边走来，摸了摸斧柄。那分量几乎和它嵌入的树一样沉实。%SPEECH_ON%看这架势，我说是兽人的地盘……%SPEECH_OFF% | 你来到一座小山坡，那里精心堆着几块石头。细看之下，石面有白色刻画，每块都讲着不同的故事：高大的蛮横身影四处游荡，对更小、更细的火柴人施加骇人的暴力。%randombrother%看着图画笑了。%SPEECH_ON%兽人的雅趣，反正它们觉得算。要是你在纳闷，画上那些小人就是我们。%SPEECH_OFF% | 山丘上，几根木棍支着皮篷，随风扑动。周围有营地刚被弃用的迹象：还在冒烟的火、渐渐消退的足迹、零散的古怪杂物。%randombrother%指着这一切。%SPEECH_ON%这些东西上，还留着它们的味道。那是……兽人的味道。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother2%咳痰啐了一口。%SPEECH_ON%老兄，你这鼻子闻屎可真灵。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%点头。%SPEECH_ON%可我没在放屁。弟兄们，我们进兽人领地了。%SPEECH_OFF% | %randombrother%走向你们发现的一堆人类头骨，分析致命伤——主要依据是身体全都不知所踪，毕竟断了头还想活下来，可真不容易。他直起身，点头说道。%SPEECH_ON%兽人的艺术，伙计们。仔细学着点，免得自己也成了展品。%SPEECH_OFF%你也点头，叫弟兄们留心前方的危险。 | 荒野有荒野的气息，文明有文明的气息，可眼前之地，两者都不像。你有种古怪感觉，仿佛刚踏进了别人的领土。一堆骇人尸体，早已不剩半点生前的人样，也帮你认清了区别，并确认一个简单事实：你们进入了兽人的土地。}

b2465af21e973ee2700b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]While on the path, you come across a man staring at a hole in the ground. Naturally, you go over and ask what he's doing. He states that there's an orc in the pit. You look down. There is. Taking out your sword, you ask if you should take care of it for him. He reels back.%SPEECH_ON%What? No! I want that alive. I think we can try and understand it.%SPEECH_OFF%Understand it? What is this man on about? He pleads.%SPEECH_ON%Let us merely try! Everyone kills an orc on sight, but they're not mere animals. They show intelligence, and if they have intelligence it means that they can learn, and if they can learn then perhaps they can learn to coexist with us.%SPEECH_OFF%
b2465af21e973ee2700b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]路上，你遇见一个盯着地洞看的男人，自然走过去问他在干什么。他说，坑里有个兽人。你探头一看，还真有。你拔出剑，问要不要替他解决掉。他吓得往后一缩。%SPEECH_ON%什么？别杀！我要它活着。我觉得，我们可以试着了解它。%SPEECH_OFF%了解它？这人在说什么胡话？他恳求道。%SPEECH_ON%就让我们试试吧！人人见到兽人就杀，可它们并非普通野兽。它们有智慧，既然有智慧，就说明能够学习；既然能够学习，也许就能学会与我们共存。%SPEECH_OFF%

7a9898899a0c2dbbadff.source: Dogs are smart, too, but what do we do with the bad ones?
7a9898899a0c2dbbadff.translation: 狗也聪明，可碰上恶犬，我们会怎么做？

3d71a6c51df66d65da84.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]%houndmaster% the houndmaster nods and explains that an animal, no matter how intelligent or well trained, is still an animal. The peacenik thinks for a time.%SPEECH_ON%I-it's not a mere dog, though!%SPEECH_OFF%Your houndmaster takes the man by the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%But you've cornered it like one, haven't you? What do you think a man would do in this situation, all his intellect and wisdom with him, his back to a wall and enemies afoot? This is not the place nor time for making 'peace,' friend, whether it be with man or beast.%SPEECH_OFF%The stranger slowly begins to nod. He sees the sense of the argument and, thankfully, lets you destroy the orc without any incident. With the greenskin put away, the man gives you a satchel of crowns.%SPEECH_ON%I wanted to try and parlay with it using these. That ain't happening now, clearly, and I'd probably be dead if you hadn't shown up. Consider this my thanks, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%
3d71a6c51df66d65da84.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_40.png[/img]驯犬师%houndmaster%点点头，解释说，野兽无论多聪明、训练得多好，终究还是野兽。那和平主义者想了想。%SPEECH_ON%可、可它又不只是一条狗！%SPEECH_OFF%驯犬师按住他的肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%但你把它像狗一样逼进了死角，不是吗？换成一个人，就算有满脑子的智慧和学问，背后无路可退，面前全是敌人，你觉得他会怎么做？朋友，眼下无论是对人还是对野兽，都不是谈“和平”的时候，也不是谈和平的地方。%SPEECH_OFF%陌生人慢慢点起头来。他听懂了这番道理，谢天谢地，总算没再添乱，让你们杀了那兽人。解决绿皮后，他递给你一袋克朗。%SPEECH_ON%我本想拿这些钱试着跟它讲和。现在显然没这个可能了，要不是你们出现，我多半也没命了。佣兵，就当这是我的谢礼吧。%SPEECH_OFF%

4a11dfa33d87af33f3f8.source: Gave a lecture on the nature of animals
4a11dfa33d87af33f3f8.translation: 讲了一番动物本性的道理

ae9b4f1c66e768ceb19e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%peddler% comes to you, rubbing the back of his neck and nervously pulling on the front of his shirt. He proposes a plan wherein he goes into town with a handful of goods to peddle around, as he's done so often in the past.

Only problem is that he doesn't yet have the goods - he has to buy them from some local in the nearby hinterlands. All he needs now is a bit of money to get him started and help purchase the goods. A sum of 500 crowns all in all. Naturally, as a partner, you will get a cut of the profits once it's all said and done.
ae9b4f1c66e768ceb19e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%peddler%来找你，一会儿揉后颈，一会儿紧张地扯前襟。他提出一个计划：带些货进镇叫卖，就像过去常做的那样。

唯一的问题是，货还没到手，得先去附近乡下向当地人购买。他只需要一点启动的本钱，总共500克朗，帮他把货置齐。既然你是合伙人，事成之后，自然能分得一份利润。

60ea7076fcbf91990942.source: You're a mercenary now. Time to leave that old life behind.
60ea7076fcbf91990942.translation: 你如今是佣兵，该把过去的营生放下了。

87785a6807baf1ba3ef8.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]You hand %peddler% the crowns and off he goes.

A few hours later, the peddler comes running up with a small lockbox in hand. The wily grin on his face is undeniable and he's unwittingly fistpumping as he glides to you. When he tries to speak, gasps of breath seize him. You hold your hand out, telling him to take his time. Settling down, the man hands over a heavy purse of coins, stating that it is your cut of the profits.

Before you can even say anything, the man wheels on his heels and jumps away, giddy with his success.
87785a6807baf1ba3ef8.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]你把克朗交给%peddler%，他便出发了。

几个时辰后，小贩抱着一个带锁的小箱子跑回来，满脸藏不住的狡黠笑意，一边靠近，一边不自觉地挥拳庆贺。他想开口，却喘得说不成话。你抬手，让他慢慢来。缓过气后，他递上一只沉甸甸的钱袋，说这是分给你的利润。

你还没来得及说什么，他便脚跟一转，蹦跳着离开，兴奋得忘乎所以。

192e8afbcc5fddacb7a2.source: A pleasure to do business with you.

1617da1eff460b608f96.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%peddler% makes off and you tend to other business for the day.

As you step out of your tent hours later, you see a slumped shape in the distance, steadily heading your way. It appears to be the peddler. He carries nothing with him but a frown. As he gets closer, you begin to see the bruises that dot his body. He explains that while he managed to purchase the goods from his source, the actual townspeople weren't particularly warm to his selling tactics.

What money was invested has been lost and %peddler% heads to a tent to nurse his wounds.
1617da1eff460b608f96.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%peddler%出发了，你继续处理当天其他事务。

几个时辰后，你走出帐篷，看见远处一个垂头丧气的身影正慢慢靠近。似乎是那小贩，除了满脸苦相，什么也没带。走近后，你才看清他身上遍布的淤伤。他解释，货确实从熟人那里买到了，可镇民们对他的推销手法并不怎么欣赏。

投入的钱全赔了，%peddler%回帐篷养伤去了。

e78fef5b92d30b9af8a5.source: Failed in his plan and lost a large amount of money
e78fef5b92d30b9af8a5.translation: 计划落空，赔了一大笔钱

60ccb129efdcee209ff2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%For the last time, no, I won't buy a rat.%SPEECH_OFF%You see %ratcatcher% the ratcatcher turn a corner with the skeevy peddler %peddler% on his heels. The salesman throws another pitch.%SPEECH_ON%'Course you won't buy one! You're a ratcatcher, why would you buy one? But what if...%SPEECH_OFF%The ratcatcher stops and turns on his heels, planting a firm finger into the peddler's chest.%SPEECH_ON%Pet rats don't go grow on trees, %peddler%! They're born of a different stock! If I need a rat by my side I'll find him myself! Now, if you got a rat you need killin', that's a different matter.%SPEECH_OFF%%peddler%'s eyes fall to the ground, thinking for a moment. Suddenly, his gaze lifts along with his spirits and a pointing finger.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, a goldfish then? Would you buy a goldfish?%SPEECH_OFF%
60ccb129efdcee209ff2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%最后再说一遍，不买，我不买老鼠。%SPEECH_OFF%你看见捕鼠人%ratcatcher%拐过街角，油滑的小贩%peddler%紧跟在后，又换个说法兜售。%SPEECH_ON%当然不买！您是捕鼠人，干吗还花钱买老鼠？可要是……%SPEECH_OFF%捕鼠人停下，猛地转身，用手指顶住小贩胸口。%SPEECH_ON%%peddler%，宠鼠可不是随手就有的，它们另有血统！我要养只老鼠陪着，自会亲手去找！不过，你若有老鼠要弄死，那又另当别论。%SPEECH_OFF%%peddler%低头琢磨片刻，随即抬眼，精神一振，竖起手指。%SPEECH_ON%啊，那金鱼呢？您买不买金鱼？%SPEECH_OFF%

f2f4f62542ad7c219db0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]Ever the downer, %pessimist% mopes around, wallowing in victory as good as any pissy pessimist could. He throws a dismissive hand out.%SPEECH_ON%We have tasted victory and what of it? Our victory was their defeat, so it very well may be that one day someone else's victory is going to come at our expense, don't you see? Let us not put the cart in front of the horse lest the shadows of morrow sneak upon us whilst we bask in this supposedly glorious light.%SPEECH_OFF%A few sellswords tell him to stop being such a prick, but his brunt realism tempers the zeal of others.
f2f4f62542ad7c219db0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]一贯扫兴的%pessimist%又在闷闷不乐。哪怕打了胜仗，他也能像个十足的悲观鬼一样沉浸在苦恼中。他不以为然地挥挥手。%SPEECH_ON%我们尝到胜利了，那又怎样？我们的胜利就是他们的失败。所以总有一天，别人的胜利也可能要拿我们作代价，难道不明白吗？别高兴得太早，免得沉醉在这所谓荣耀的光芒里，却让明日的阴影悄悄摸到身后。%SPEECH_OFF%几个佣兵叫他别再这么讨人厌，但这番直白的现实之言，还是浇凉了另一些人的热情。

aa64165dc0336e9a0735.source: The worst part about pessimists is that they're usually right.
aa64165dc0336e9a0735.translation: 悲观的人最讨厌的一点，就是他们往往说中了。

8bd9582de7460cf37974.source: Is pessimistic despite a recent victory

39c1073b09c747cb749b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]While on the march, you come across a woman standing off the side of the road. She's standing at the head of a donkey-pulled wagon. Seeing you, she claps her hands and yells out some order. Within moments, wenches pour out the back of the wagon and line up before you.
