They're poorly dressed and, if this is some act, poorly rehearsed. Most look like they'd rather be somewhere else which is ordinary of any womanfolk stuck out in the sticks. You ask the 'leader' of this group what she's doing. She grins ear to ear.%SPEECH_ON%I am a merchant of flesh, a profiteer of good poundings. These, here, are my wares.%SPEECH_OFF%She swings her arms to the prostitutes. They straighten up, or loosen up, and feign interest in you and your men. The pimp nods.%SPEECH_ON%So, what say we help take the edge off, hm? Been a long day, no? For that many men, I'd wager it'd cost you a low %cost% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%
39c1073b09c747cb749b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]行军途中，你遇见一个站在路旁的女人，身边停着驴拉的货车。看见你，她拍着手高喊了一声。片刻后，一群姑娘从车后涌出，在你面前排开。她们衣着寒酸，若这算一场表演，也显然没怎么排练。大多数人看着都宁肯待在别处，不过女人被困在这种荒郊野外，倒也通常如此。你问这群人的“头儿”在做什么，她笑得嘴都快咧到耳根。%SPEECH_ON%我做皮肉买卖，挣的是快活钱。瞧，这些就是我的货。%SPEECH_OFF%她张开双臂，指向妓女们。她们有的挺起身，有的放松姿态，装出对你和弟兄们很有兴趣的样子。老鸨点点头。%SPEECH_ON%怎么样，让我们替各位解解乏？赶了一天路，累了吧？这么多弟兄，我看只收%cost%克朗就成。%SPEECH_OFF%

24ffadb729fc7b6d1304.source: How about you just hand over your valuables instead?
24ffadb729fc7b6d1304.translation: 不如把你们的值钱东西交出来？

495ada15be263fbe3aff.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]Despite the protests of some of your men, you decline the pimp's offer. She shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Damn, I knew I should have invested in little boys. Well, suit yerself.%SPEECH_OFF%
495ada15be263fbe3aff.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]尽管有几个弟兄反对，你还是拒绝了皮条客的生意。她耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%该死，早知道该把本钱投在小男孩身上。算了，随你。%SPEECH_OFF%

6cdaeb2cc56091f980df.source: There'll be entertainment in the next town.

a7bdc290de0b35a86cd2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]The womenfolk press forward, some winking lazily, some with lazy eyes winking wonkily. It's a sorry lot of wenches, but the men could use a bit of reprieve. You accept the pimp's price and the men sort out the rest, ducking into bushes and a variety of other cover. While they get some action, the pimp sidles up next to you.%SPEECH_ON%Thanks for not robbing us.%SPEECH_OFF%You shrug and say that's still on the table. She shrugs, too.%SPEECH_ON%I know, but I don't think you will. Me and you, we are a lot alike. You fight for food, we fuck for it.%SPEECH_OFF%Curious, you ask if she still 'fucks' for her food. She laughs.%SPEECH_ON%Only when I need to. This 'leadership' role is a pretty nice gig. Do you still 'fight' for yours?%SPEECH_OFF%You just give her the truth.%SPEECH_ON%I've killed many, many people.%SPEECH_OFF%She sidles up real close now and goes low with a hand.%SPEECH_ON%Well then.%SPEECH_OFF%Well then indeed.
a7bdc290de0b35a86cd2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]女人们凑上前来，有的懒洋洋地抛着媚眼，有的斜着眼，连媚眼都抛得歪歪扭扭。这群姑娘实在不怎么样，不过弟兄们也该放松一下了。你答应老鸨的价钱，剩下的便由他们自行安排，一个个钻进灌木丛和各处隐蔽的地方。趁他们忙着快活，老鸨挨到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%多谢你没抢我们。%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，说现在抢也不迟。她也耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我知道，可我觉得你不会。咱俩挺像的。你靠砍人混饭，我们靠睡人混饭。%SPEECH_OFF%你有些好奇，问她如今是不是还得靠“睡人”吃饭。她笑了。%SPEECH_ON%有必要才上。这份“带头”的差事挺不错。你呢，还得亲自“砍人”吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你只是实话实说。%SPEECH_ON%我杀过很多，很多人。%SPEECH_OFF%她这回贴得更近了，一只手往下探去。%SPEECH_ON%那好吧。%SPEECH_OFF%那好吧，确实如此。

fca6b2303c26b824d1e9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]You agree to the offer. The pimp and her harlots come forward, swarming into your ranks like a bunch of salacious snakes. Mere moments after most of your men have their pants down, a group of bandits step out of the bushes. You grab your sword, the actual bladed one, and naked-leggedly remove a thief's head from his shoulder and stab another through the chest. More robbers come forward, weapons out ready for combat, but the pimp jumps between everyone.%SPEECH_ON%Whoa! No one else needs to die here!%SPEECH_OFF%Some of your men still don't even realize what the hell is going on which is as good a sign as any that this wench has gotten the drop on you. That said, the %companyname% is still a force of nature, pants or no pants, and the pimp recognizes this. She scolds the hired hands.%SPEECH_ON%I thought I told you morons to not attack if the Johns appear dangerous. Don't they look farkin' dangerous? Goddam. Look, sellsword. I'll take double the offer and leave you be. Just double the offer and we'll go.%SPEECH_OFF%
fca6b2303c26b824d1e9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]你答应了这个提议。老鸨带着妓女们走上前，像一群淫荡的蛇钻进队伍。大多数弟兄刚脱下裤子，一群强盗就从灌木丛里蹿了出来。你抓起自己的剑——真有剑刃的那把——光着两条腿砍掉一个贼的脑袋，又刺穿了另一个的胸膛。更多劫匪拔出武器冲上来，准备开打，老鸨却跳到两方中间。%SPEECH_ON%等等！不用再死人了！%SPEECH_OFF%有些弟兄甚至还没弄明白出了什么事，可见这娘们确实打了你们个措手不及。不过，%companyname%无论穿不穿裤子，都不是好惹的，她也看出了这一点。她冲雇来的打手骂道。%SPEECH_ON%我不是告诉过你们这群蠢货，嫖客看着危险就别动手吗？他们他娘的看着还不够危险？真见鬼。听着，佣兵，给我原先价钱的两倍，我们就放过你们。只要两倍，拿钱就走。%SPEECH_OFF%

129c9e984338bf2c33a4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]You're not going to risk your men and agree to her terms. Taking the money, she nods.%SPEECH_ON%Most men would have let their pride take over there, but you know how to keep your men safe. A smart sellsword is rare these days and your men should be happy to have you as their leader.%SPEECH_OFF%As the robbers and harlots leave, %randombrother% walks up groaning.%SPEECH_ON%Well shit. I'm so warmed up I could split a wench in half.%SPEECH_OFF%
129c9e984338bf2c33a4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]你不愿拿弟兄们冒险，答应了她的条件。她收下钱，点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%大多数男人这时都要为面子逞强，你却知道怎么保住手下。如今聪明的佣兵难得，你的人该庆幸有你带领。%SPEECH_OFF%强盗和妓女离开后，%randombrother%呻吟着走来。%SPEECH_ON%妈的，兴头都撩起来了，老子憋得能把娘们折腾散架。%SPEECH_OFF%

7e66d0cf9c1ec0d12a52.translation: 这种事就不用告诉我了。

5659c4e9b6f726b2bf01.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]You don't say no deal so much as show it. Sword still in hand, you swing it back up and slash the pimp's face. As she stares at you in disbelief, you reverse the sword swing and cleave her head clean off. The men, trousers down, grab their gear and start to fight. A few harlots brandish daggers and get some stabs in, but they are quickly killed off. Most of the prostitutes are harmless, but get butchered in the confusion and chaos.

The robbers, who probably weren't expecting actual combat, say farewell to their short, shitty lives. When it's all said and done, there's a good twenty bodies spread over the field and most mercenaries did not come out the other side unharmed. You try and salvage what you can from the field.
5659c4e9b6f726b2bf01.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你用行动拒绝了这桩交易。剑还握在手里，你反手一挥，划开老鸨的脸。她难以置信地看着你，你随即回剑，将她的头颅齐颈斩落。弟兄们裤子还褪在腿上，便抓起装备开打。几个妓女亮出匕首，捅中了几下，但很快便被杀死。大多数妓女根本没有威胁，却也在混乱中惨遭屠戮。

那些劫匪大概没料到真会打起来，就此结束了短暂又悲惨的一生。等一切停下，地里横七竖八地躺了足足二十具尸体，大多数佣兵也都挂了彩。你试着从现场搜回些还能用的东西。

539c495e73423af9112d.source: Probably should avoid fighting with our pants down.
539c495e73423af9112d.translation: 以后还是别裤子没提就开打了。

30c0482cfdfcbbce708c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]You think the offer over, then realize these are just a bunch of women out in the middle of nowhere. With a solid back hand, you send the pimp to the ground. She rubs her cheek and says roughhousing will cost extra. You nod.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, it'll cost you everything you got. Men, take it all.%SPEECH_OFF%The pimp asks if this is a robbery and you nod. The second you make your intentions clear, a group of armed men step out of some nearby bushes. The pimp gets up and rubs her cheek.%SPEECH_ON%I'm still willing to part on neutral terms here, sellsword. A good slap ain't no problem in this business. It's expected, even, but so are robbers and murderers and rapists. Now, if you wish to keep on doing what you want, I'm gonna sic those men on you to do what I need, which is keep me and mine safe.%SPEECH_OFF%
30c0482cfdfcbbce708c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_07.png[/img]你考虑着这桩买卖，转念却想到，荒郊野外，这不过是一群女人。你反手一巴掌，将老鸨打倒在地。她揉着脸颊，说玩粗的可要加钱。你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%对，要你们付出所有家当。弟兄们，全拿走。%SPEECH_OFF%老鸨问，这是打劫吗？你点头。意图刚一挑明，一群武装男人便从附近灌木中走出来。老鸨站起身，揉着脸。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我仍愿意好聚好散。干这行挨上一巴掌，不算什么，甚至早有预料。不过，劫匪、杀人犯和强奸犯，我们也防着。你若还想为所欲为，我就放这些男人上来，办我需要办的事——护住我和我的姑娘们。%SPEECH_OFF%

5f070caa23bda7dbf3ac.translation: 那几个护卫不堪一击。动手！

6b9975705448f563ebb5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]Looking at the guards, and at your men who you don't wish to lose over this bullshit, you nod.%SPEECH_ON%Smart lady. Alright. There's no need for bloodshed.%SPEECH_OFF%The pimp sighs in relief.%SPEECH_ON%Glad we could come to an agreement. I'm afraid my previous offer is off the table. I'm sure you understand.%SPEECH_OFF%Sheathing your sword, you say that you do. A couple of the brothers spit and shake their heads. They think they missed out on a good lay because of your aggression here.
6b9975705448f563ebb5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你看了看护卫，又看了看弟兄们；不值得为这点破事丢掉他们的命。你点头。%SPEECH_ON%聪明的女人。好吧，没必要流血。%SPEECH_OFF%皮条客松了口气。%SPEECH_ON%能谈拢就好。不过刚才那桩生意作罢了，我想你能理解。%SPEECH_OFF%你收剑入鞘，表示明白。几个弟兄吐着口水、摇着头，觉得是你逞凶，才害他们错过一场好艳遇。

57306c323982f9fc871c.source: Can't you tell they were going to rob us anyway?
57306c323982f9fc871c.translation: 你看不出来吗？他们本来就打算抢我们。

0d1f4ee90f2aa0a5afe2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]These 'guards' ain't shit. You order your men to attack. The fight is a brief flurry of action. The harlot's hired hands act as though they didn't expect to see actual combat.

 With the combat over, you see that the wagon's still here, but the pimp and her prostitutes are gone. They must have made their leave during the fight. They even took the donkey, that lucky ass.

 Your men raid the wagon. While taking anything that's not nailed down, %randombrother% hears a knocking noise. He searches the bottom of the cart and pulls on a cord, dropping a slat of wood down which rolls a man completely covered in black leather. You pull back the mask covering his face. He sucks in a breath.%SPEECH_ON%Th-thank you! By the old gods, I thought they'd have me in there forever!%SPEECH_OFF%You ask who he is. He spits the leather scraps out of his mouth.%SPEECH_ON%Gimp.%SPEECH_OFF%Just 'Gimp'? He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yessir. Hey, those are some nice weapons you got there. Sleek armor, too. Hm. My master is gone, so...%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%Go to the closest town and get yourself cleaned up, stranger.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods.%SPEECH_ON%As you wish, master.%SPEECH_OFF%
0d1f4ee90f2aa0a5afe2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]这些“护卫”根本不值一提。你命令弟兄们进攻，短短一阵交锋，战斗便告结束。妓女雇来的打手，看样子压根没料到真得上阵厮杀。

 打完后，货车还在，老鸨和妓女们却不见了。想必是趁乱跑了，连驴也一起带走了，真是头走运的畜生。

 弟兄们开始搜刮货车。凡是没钉死的都被搬走时，%randombrother%忽然听见敲击声。他检查车底，拉动一根绳子，一块木板随即落下，滚出一个浑身裹着黑皮衣的男人。你扯开遮住他脸的面罩，他猛吸一口气。%SPEECH_ON%谢、谢谢！旧神在上，我还以为他们要把我关在里面一辈子！%SPEECH_OFF%你问他是谁。他吐出嘴里的碎皮革。%SPEECH_ON%皮奴。%SPEECH_OFF%只叫“皮奴”？他点头。%SPEECH_ON%是的，长官。嘿，你们的武器真不错，盔甲也挺漂亮。嗯，我的主人不在了，所以……%SPEECH_OFF%你摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%陌生人，去最近的镇子，把自己收拾干净吧。%SPEECH_OFF%他点头。%SPEECH_ON%遵命，主人。%SPEECH_OFF%

994bf19cb4d696b6d9c7.source: You refused to pay for harlots

e9565720be1e1b6d6880.source: Missed out on a good lay because of you
e9565720be1e1b6d6880.translation: 因为你错失了一场艳遇

a6a25c63554912523da5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]You come across a man and woman arguing outside one of the town's buildings.%SPEECH_ON%Why do I give you all of it? I'm the one doing all the work!%SPEECH_OFF%She yells. The man rubs his chin and responds.%SPEECH_ON%I manage the minge! How would you find work without me?%SPEECH_OFF%The woman, seeing you, turns and asks if you'd sleep with her. She could be shaped like two circles and a triangle and you'd probably still have a go. The woman throws her hands out.%SPEECH_ON%See? Half this world's ready for business if I so much as open my legs!%SPEECH_OFF%The wannabe-pimp asks you to talk some sense into his 'prospect.'
a6a25c63554912523da5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]你遇见一男一女，正在镇上一栋房屋外争吵。%SPEECH_ON%凭什么把钱全交给你？干活的明明是我！%SPEECH_OFF%女人吼道。男人摸着下巴回答。%SPEECH_ON%你那裤裆归我管！没我，你上哪儿找生意去？%SPEECH_OFF%女人看见你，转头便问你愿不愿意跟她睡一觉。她就算只长着两个圆和一个三角，你大概也乐意试试。女人摊开双手。%SPEECH_ON%看见没？老娘只要张开腿，世上就有一半人等着来做生意！%SPEECH_OFF%这位刚想入行的皮条客请你给他的“摇钱树”讲讲道理。

d804d6b0c9e483be2cad.source: Pimps keep you safe in this world.
d804d6b0c9e483be2cad.translation: 这世道，有皮条客罩着才安全。

beefcd47d88d9782064e.source: Nothing wrong with a sellwhore playing by her own rules.
beefcd47d88d9782064e.translation: 妓女按自己的规矩做生意，没什么不对。

8526a875e417a0676e37.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]You give your answer.%SPEECH_ON%A pimp provides security. Just cause every swinging dick wants what's between your legs don't make you safe. The smallest slight can bring out a customer's darker, more violent nature.%SPEECH_OFF% The pimp nods.%SPEECH_ON%That's right! Listen to 'im!%SPEECH_OFF%Thinking, the prostitute nods before suddenly slapping the pimp across the face. He cries out and rubs the welt. The woman nods again.%SPEECH_ON%This lark is supposed to protect me, really? Good day, sirs.%SPEECH_OFF%
8526a875e417a0676e37.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]你给出回答。%SPEECH_ON%皮条客能保你安全。别以为人人都惦记你两腿间那点东西，你就能高枕无忧。哪怕一点小小的怠慢，都能逼出客人心里更阴暗、更凶狠的一面。%SPEECH_OFF%皮条客连连点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错！听他的！%SPEECH_OFF%妓女想了想，点点头，忽然一巴掌扇在皮条客脸上。他叫出声，捂住肿起的脸。女人又点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%就这号人物，还能保护我？诸位，再会。%SPEECH_OFF%

87bf753a55f99d29eb4e.source: Damn. Thought he had a stronger pimp game.
87bf753a55f99d29eb4e.translation: 该死，还以为他拉皮条的本事更强些。

233801bb80dacdbc5793.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]With a fatherly appeal you take the pimp by the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%You can take the woman out of a whore, but you can't take the whore out of a woman.%SPEECH_OFF%The pimp thinks it over. You do, too, as you were never one for logic. The pimp looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%What?%SPEECH_OFF%The lady steps forward, taking the pimp by the other shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%I think he's saying to cut me loose.%SPEECH_OFF%When the pimp raises an eyebrow, the woman clarifies.%SPEECH_ON%Figuratively speaking.%SPEECH_OFF%The pimp sighs.%SPEECH_ON%I don't understand what the hell you two are saying, but alright. I thought maybe I could get a business going here. A woman here, a woman there, peddle their gooches and mooches, make some crowns, retire early. Oh well, back to grinding wheat into flour until I keel over and die.%SPEECH_OFF%The man walks off, his nose sniffling.
233801bb80dacdbc5793.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]你像长辈劝人般，按住皮条客的肩。%SPEECH_ON%可以让婊子没了女人样，却没法让女人没了婊子心。%SPEECH_OFF%皮条客琢磨起来。你自己也琢磨了一番，毕竟你向来不擅长讲逻辑。皮条客望着你。%SPEECH_ON%什么？%SPEECH_OFF%女人上前，搭住他另一侧肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%我想，他是叫你割断拴着我的绳子。%SPEECH_OFF%见皮条客扬起眉毛，她又解释。%SPEECH_ON%打个比方。%SPEECH_OFF%皮条客叹了口气。%SPEECH_ON%我压根听不懂你俩在说什么，不过好吧。本来还想在这里做点买卖，找几个女人，卖卖她们那点本钱，挣些克朗，早点退下来享福。唉，还是回去磨麦子吧，磨到一头栽倒死了为止。%SPEECH_OFF%那人吸着鼻子，走开了。

3cae753501bbc90fdf5d.source: The pimp game isn't for everyone.
3cae753501bbc90fdf5d.translation: 拉皮条这行，可不是什么人都干得了的。

aa1f54b25f4e4039d8dd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]%minstrel% the minstrel glides forward.%SPEECH_ON%Ahoy, what is this but a tale of a dullard and tail of a whore? With one look I know what you need to do my friend: profess your undying love to this minge!%SPEECH_OFF%The woman crosses her arms and creases her eyebrows.%SPEECH_ON%Just what are you on abou--%SPEECH_OFF%The minstrel bats her out of the way as he raises an arm and a singly voice with it.%SPEECH_ON%Ahoyyy! Love, yes, love is in the air! Best let it flare! - and I'm not just talking about his cock and balls. He loves you, my dear, can't you see? Why else would he make a harlot out of only thee? A pimp needs a diverse portfolio, not a business of one holy-oh, ohhh!%SPEECH_OFF%The pimp drops his head, face red and embarrassed. He admits it's true, all of it. The woman looks over, her face flushed. They lock eyes. You roll yours. They embrace and make off all lovey-dovey. %minstrel% scratches his chin.%SPEECH_ON%I'm a poet and I didn't even... realize it.%SPEECH_OFF%
aa1f54b25f4e4039d8dd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]吟游诗人%minstrel%轻快地走上前。%SPEECH_ON%啊哈，这不就是蠢汉的一段情，配上妓女的一身肉？朋友，我一眼就知道你该怎么做：向这小浪蹄子诉说你至死不渝的爱！%SPEECH_OFF%女人抱起双臂，皱紧眉头。%SPEECH_ON%你到底在胡说什——%SPEECH_OFF%吟游诗人挥手把她拨到一旁，抬起胳膊，独自放声唱了起来。%SPEECH_ON%啊呀——！爱呀，爱已满天飞！快让它尽情燃烧一回！我可不光是在说他的老二和卵蛋。亲爱的，他爱你，你难道看不见？不然为何只让你一个姑娘卖笑颜？拉皮条的得多找些姑娘，哪能只靠一个洞开张，噢——噢！%SPEECH_OFF%皮条客低下头，满脸通红，羞愧地承认他说的全是真的。女人看向他，也涨红了脸。两人四目相对，你则翻了个白眼。他们拥抱在一起，亲亲热热地离开了。%minstrel%挠了挠下巴。%SPEECH_ON%原来我出口成诗，自己竟……毫不自知。%SPEECH_OFF%

06b1c91c267fdbd5f626.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]'Tsk, tsk, tsk.' %tailor% the tailor struts on up shaking his head. He runs a finger along the prostitute's dress. He remarks that he thought whores were supposed to be pretty. The pimp raises his hand.%SPEECH_ON%That's my property you're spittin' on.%SPEECH_OFF%%tailor% bows.%SPEECH_ON%Apologies, sir, but I do believe you have already spit on her yourself dressing her in such a manner. I'd not know she's looking for a whore's coin had you not yelled at her with a pimp's, hm, lackadaisical sense of economics.%SPEECH_OFF%The pimp draws a dagger out and attacks. The tailor pirouettes, spinning beneath the blade's strike. He springs back upright and jams a thick pair of scissors to the pimp's throat.%SPEECH_ON%Mmm, what a quaint position to be in. I daresay you have but two ways out, and one is much shinier than the other. Yes, that's right, you get it don't you? Pay up or I'll cut yer throat and clip your nuts and the order which I do it just might surprise you.%SPEECH_OFF%The pimp hastily forks over some crowns to spare his life. The tailor 'snips' his scissors closed and pockets them.%SPEECH_ON%Good. Now for some advice. You can find linens for cheap down the street yonder. The man who works the shop there is, hm, particularly good at outfitting women... and men. Tata now.%SPEECH_OFF%%tailor% turns to you with a grin and asks if he can go and visit some shops to spend his newly found gold.
06b1c91c267fdbd5f626.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]“啧，啧，啧。”裁缝%tailor%摇着头，昂首走来。他用一根手指抚过妓女的裙子，说自己还以为妓女总该打扮得漂亮些。皮条客抬起手。%SPEECH_ON%你羞辱的可是我的财产。%SPEECH_OFF%%tailor%鞠了一躬。%SPEECH_ON%抱歉，先生。不过，把她打扮成这样，恐怕您早已亲自羞辱过她了。要不是您用皮条客那种，嗯，漫不经心的生意头脑冲她大喊，我还真看不出她想靠卖身挣钱。%SPEECH_OFF%皮条客拔出匕首扑来。裁缝一个旋身，从挥来的刀刃下转过，随即挺直身子，将一把厚重的剪刀顶在对方喉头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，真是个有趣的局面。依我看，您只有两条出路，其中一条可亮闪闪得多。没错，您明白了吧？掏钱，否则我就剪断你的喉咙，再剪掉你的卵蛋。而且，我先剪哪头，没准会让你吃一惊。%SPEECH_OFF%皮条客慌忙掏出一些克朗，保住性命。裁缝“咔嚓”合上剪刀，收进口袋。%SPEECH_ON%很好。再奉送一点建议。往那边沿街走，能买到便宜的亚麻布。那家店的老板，嗯，尤其擅长替女人打扮……男人也行。再会。%SPEECH_OFF%%tailor%笑着转向你，问能否去逛几家店，花花这笔新得的金子。

3593ed4009531992f08c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]%monk% the monk steps forward. He takes the pimp by the hands. Were you to do that, the pimp would not doubt shrink back or strike you. But the holy man does it with such grace and humility that the pimp simply stares at him. The monk smiles warmly.%SPEECH_ON%This is not the path for you, that much is clear. You have not the means to handle this woman, and this is but one woman, when a pimp really needs many. The old gods tell me you are meant for a different path, one which is for hardier men. I daresay you are fit for a mercenary company. Leave the women-wrangling to the snake handlers.%SPEECH_OFF%The pimp thinks for a time, but you can tell the words have gotten to him. He asks if you'd accept him into your company.
3593ed4009531992f08c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]修士%monk%走上前，握住皮条客的双手。换成你这么做，对方不是缩回去，就是一拳打来。可修士举止如此谦和，皮条客只是愣愣地望着他。修士温暖地笑道。%SPEECH_ON%这条路不适合你，已经再明白不过。你连这一个女人都管不住，而做皮条客却得管上许多个。旧神告诉我，你该走另一条路，一条更适合坚韧男子的路。依我看，你很适合加入佣兵团。至于调教女人的活儿，就留给那些耍蛇的人吧。%SPEECH_OFF%皮条客思索片刻，你看得出，这番话说进了他心里。他问你，是否愿意收他加入战团。

139ec8f192a0dd4be7a2.source: Looks like our minstrel has something to say.
139ec8f192a0dd4be7a2.translation: 看来我们的吟游诗人有话要说。

822b2d4c724a688dcd49.source: Does our monk wish to speak about this... trade?
822b2d4c724a688dcd49.translation: 我们的修士想谈谈这门……营生吗？

ec0c149c7d8ca0c44788.source: The company tailor might have some input here.
ec0c149c7d8ca0c44788.translation: 战团里的裁缝也许能出个主意。

5f2c916c179bc7a36911.source: Cut a pimp down to size
5f2c916c179bc7a36911.translation: 挫了一个皮条客的锐气

25059b0025134f1cd855.source: Led a man back onto the path of rightenousness
25059b0025134f1cd855.translation: 引导一名男子重归正途

00c37d58bb818b0fb0af.source: , you found %name% quarreling with his only harlot.
00c37d58bb818b0fb0af.translation: 时，你发现%name%正和他手下唯一的妓女争吵。

17af1994d58d4b6903fb.source: persuaded him to join the company and you agreed to take him along. Hopefully, he's better fighting in the shield wall than he is wrangling whores.
17af1994d58d4b6903fb.translation: 劝他加入战团，你也同意收下。只盼他在盾墙里作战的本事，胜过管教妓女的本事。

b4a4b2db8d53727086dc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]Over time, you've come to acquire a great deal of money. While you keep the war chest under lock and key, you can't help but notice a few brothers have gotten a bit greedier over the time they've spent in your company. Now you hear rumors of the men demanding higher pay.
b4a4b2db8d53727086dc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]这些日子，你攒下了一大笔钱。军资箱虽锁得严实，可你还是注意到，有几个弟兄随战团待得越久，胃口也越大。如今，已有传言说他们想要求加薪。

92c3b504cddf8986d72c.source: Aye, it's fine time you all get a raise.
92c3b504cddf8986d72c.translation: 是啊，是时候给你们都加薪了。

b4c88bd6d7bf131973a2.source: You all signed the dotted line and get paid according to it.
b4c88bd6d7bf131973a2.translation: 当初都签字画押了，军饷照约定拿。

120dd83588c7c85376c3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]Preempting any sort of mutiny or raise requests, you announce that the group shall have a company-wide raise. Three crowns a day for everyone. As it turns out, the men are quite fond of this move and cheer your name with a huzzah!
120dd83588c7c85376c3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]赶在任何哗变或加薪要求出现之前，你宣布全团涨薪，每人每天多拿三克朗。事实证明，弟兄们非常喜欢这个决定，齐声欢呼，高喊你的名字！

8b2218cdd5da2450b193.translation: 弟兄们，这是你们挣来的！

1dd37dfd71421d0cc8c0.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]Before anyone gets any ideas, you step up before the whole company and announce that there will be no raises. As far as you are concerned, every man present signed the contract. Any prospect of earning more pay shall be done by experience only, and that is only done by doing what sellswords do best: kill.
1dd37dfd71421d0cc8c0.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]不等有人动念头，你便站到全团面前，宣布不会加薪。在你看来，在场每个人都签过契约。想拿更多军饷，就得靠历练；而历练，只能靠佣兵最擅长的事来积累：杀人。

6afe320563f0141e76e0.source: That's how it works with the %companyname%.

34ab1c3b31f0acb13410.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]{Your company seems to have caught the attention of a messenger on the road.%SPEECH_ON%{Sirs, %settlement% to the %direction% is in dire need of help and has requested any and all able men, particularly those of the sword selling sort, to come and help. | Ah, the %companyname%, just the sort I was hunting for. %settlement% to the %direction% is requesting help with a problem. If you're looking for work, I wager you head that way. And make sure to tell them I sent ya, I get two extra crowns for it. | Hey there sword selling sirs, %settlement% to the %direction% is in need of your services. I suggest you head that way if you're looking for work. | Looking for work? You don't march like you got purpose, so let me tell ya that %settlement% to the %direction% has got some jobs for your lot. | Ah, a sellsword without a role in this world? Woe is ye. Well, %settlement% not far from here has got something for ya. I suggest you get on to it. | I'm here to tell yas that %settlement% is looking for workers. Not laborers, mind. I'm speaking to you for a reason. Take your swords and killers there if ya want some proper coin. | Hey there, ya should know that %settlement% is looking for men of your kind. Find your way there and you may have a new job yet. | Looking for work are ye? Then get on to %settlement% to the %direction%, it's no mystery to no one that they're looking for men like you.}%SPEECH_OFF%Thanking the courier, you check your maps to see if it's worth the trip.}
34ab1c3b31f0acb13410.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_92.png[/img]{你们的战团似乎引起了路上一名信使的注意。%SPEECH_ON%{诸位，%direction%边的%settlement%急需援手，正招请一切有本事的人，尤其是你们这种卖刀剑功夫的，前去帮忙。 | 啊，%companyname%，正是我要找的人。%direction%边的%settlement%有个麻烦，正在求助。想找活儿的话，我劝你们去那边。记得说是我叫你们去的，这样我还能多拿两克朗。 | 喂，各位佣兵老爷，%direction%边的%settlement%需要你们效力。想找活儿，就往那边走吧。 | 在找活儿？看你们走路也没什么目标，那我就告诉你们，%direction%边的%settlement%有些差事，适合你们干。 | 啊，佣兵在这世上竟找不到用武之地？真可怜。不过，离这里不远的%settlement%有事找你们。我劝你们赶快去。 | 我来告诉你们，%settlement%正在找人做事。别误会，不是找苦力。我特地找你们说，自然有原因。想挣点像样的钱，就带着刀剑和杀人的弟兄们过去。 | 喂，你们该知道，%settlement%正在找你们这类人。去一趟，说不定就有新活儿了。 | 在找活儿，是吧？那就去%direction%边的%settlement%。谁都知道，他们正需要你们这样的人。}%SPEECH_OFF%你谢过信使，查看地图，盘算这一趟是否值得走。}

0d3a7d2a547eff3ba060.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]While relaxing after the day's walk, %gambler% comes up to you with a pair of dice and a cup in hand. He asks if you wish to have a little game. The rules are quite simple: you roll the dice from the cup, whoever has the highest numbers wins. It's pure chance! The wager will be twenty-five crowns per dice roll.
0d3a7d2a547eff3ba060.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]一天的跋涉结束，你正歇息，%gambler%拿着两枚骰子和一只杯子走来，问你要不要玩一局。规则很简单：用杯子掷骰，谁的点数总和大谁赢，纯看运气！每掷一轮，赌注二十五克朗。

33b7ff838fdd4d2dc5ee.source: I have no time for this.

2206a387dc6421a2297d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]You roll the dice, landing a total of %playerdice%.

%gambler% goes next, rolling a total of %gamblerdice%.

The numbers are the same. A tie! Roll again?
2206a387dc6421a2297d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]你掷出了%playerdice%点。

随后%gambler%出手，掷出了%gamblerdice%点。

点数相同，平局！再掷一次？

a20f434c56ecdf433695.source: Has played a game of dice with you

3cc77e1926c6f66d94b5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]You walk out of your tent to see %poacher% and %thief% regaling one another with stories. You're not sure what a poacher and a thief would have in common, but they seem to be having a good time. Laughing, %poacher% gives another story.%SPEECH_ON%One time, I was out in this pithy nobleman's lands hunting this buck. Shooting the damned deer was the easy part. In the middle of field dressing it, I hear hooves beating over the earth. So run a rope up a tree, tie the carcass to it, and haul that sucker up there. No more than a minute later, badda-badda-badda, there's the nobleman with the constable and a retinue of lawmen.%SPEECH_OFF%%thief% raises an eyebrow.%SPEECH_ON%That's a tight spot, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%The poacher nods.%SPEECH_ON%Tighter than a cross-legged virgin it was. So this nobleman comes wandering just underneath me and sees all the blood. He starts barking that I come out and turn myself in. I had no intention of doing that, but unfortunately, the goddam buck starts slipping. I reach out for it and I suppose the branch couldn't take no more and snapped. The nobleman looks up just in time to get splattered by the belly of this deer, meanwhile I'm falling to certain death until the damned rope snags my foot and hangs me upside down before my makers. I give a bit of a wave, 'hey fellas, don't mean to barge in like this.'%SPEECH_OFF%The thief laughs, but his face is a bit concerned. %poacher% waves him off.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, they had a sense of humor about it, thank the old gods. I spent a short six months in a dark pit. Nothing too bad, really.%SPEECH_OFF%
3cc77e1926c6f66d94b5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你走出帐篷，见%poacher%与%thief%正在互相讲故事，聊得十分起劲。你不知道偷猎者和盗贼能有什么共同话题，不过，两人显然很开心。%poacher%笑着又讲起一桩往事。%SPEECH_ON%有一回，我跑到一个小气贵族的领地，猎一头公鹿。射倒那该死的鹿倒容易，难的是剖到一半，忽然听见马蹄声。我赶紧把绳子甩上树，绑住鹿尸，把那家伙吊上去。没过一分钟，哒哒哒哒，贵族就带着治安官和一队执法者来了。%SPEECH_OFF%%thief%挑起眉毛。%SPEECH_ON%老兄，那可真是进退两难。%SPEECH_OFF%偷猎者点头。%SPEECH_ON%挤得比夹紧腿的处女还紧。那贵族正好走到我下面，看见满地血，便开始吼，叫我出来自首。我压根没打算照做，可倒霉的是，那该死的鹿开始往下滑。我伸手去抓，树枝大概再也撑不住，咔嚓断了。贵族刚抬起头，就被鹿肚子砸了个正着。我也正往下掉，眼看必死，偏偏那破绳子缠住我的脚，把我倒吊在这群能要我命的家伙面前。我挥了挥手：“嘿，各位，不是有意这样打扰。”%SPEECH_OFF%盗贼笑了，脸上却还有几分担忧。%poacher%摆摆手。%SPEECH_ON%噢，幸好他们还有点幽默感，感谢旧神。我只在黑坑里待了短短六个月。真没什么大不了。%SPEECH_OFF%

7bfa68379d851bb54351.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]%randombrother% comes to you with a report of your food stocks. He explains that there's not much to go around and what bread is on hand could be better used to build a house or slay a man. Most of the fruit is soft to the touch, covered in what appears to be grey fur. All that's left otherwise has been thrown into a great stew which the men have aptly named 'crotch broth'. To be frank, it isn't looking good.

However, by some fortuitous coincidence, a small farm stands in the distance. The brother doesn't come right out and say it, but it is gently suggested that maybe the company could go raid it.
7bfa68379d851bb54351.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]%randombrother%来向你报告食物储备。吃的已经不多，现有的面包硬得拿来砌房子或砸死人，恐怕比填肚子更合适。水果大多一碰就软，表面长着灰毛。剩下的零碎都扔进一大锅里炖着，弟兄们给它起了个颇贴切的名字：裤裆汤。说实话，情况很不妙。

不过，也算机缘巧合，远处正有一座小农场。这位弟兄没把话挑明，却委婉地暗示，战团也许可以过去抢上一趟。

937485dd309091a2d00d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]You head off toward the farm. A few farmhands straighten up in the fields, staring at you as you approach and exchanging glances with one another. A worker baling hay plants his pitchfork in the ground and tents his hands over it. They all watch you with nervous curiosity as you cross the plains, your men not at all trying to hide their want of the passing crops.

When you near the homestead, a woman comes out to meet you. She wipes her brow and asks what it is that you want. A few children come out of a nearby home and stand on the porch. They eye you tentatively behind the legs of an older man, possibly the woman's father.
937485dd309091a2d00d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]你向农场走去。几个农场工人在地里直起腰，望着你们走近，彼此交换眼色。一个正在捆干草的人把草叉插进地里，双手搭在柄上。你们穿过平地时，他们都带着紧张与好奇看着，而你手下的弟兄丝毫不掩饰对沿途庄稼的渴望。

快到农舍时，一个女人出来迎接。她擦了擦额头，问你们想要什么。几个孩子从附近的屋里跑出来，站在门廊上，躲在一个老人的腿后怯怯地打量你。那老人或许是女人的父亲。

edeccf2d2f1b982ce5ee.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]You explain to the woman that your men need food. She gasps, but you hold a hand up.%SPEECH_ON%We'll only be taking what we need, no more, no less. We don't want any trouble, and I know you for sure don't want any. Right?%SPEECH_OFF%The woman quickly nods. You turn 'round and order your men to take a few crops, while at the same time the woman raises her voice and tells the farmhands to not try anything stupid. The whole affair lasts about ten minutes before your group is back on the road.
edeccf2d2f1b982ce5ee.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]你向女人解释，弟兄们需要食物。她倒吸一口气，你却抬手示意。%SPEECH_ON%我们只拿需要的，不多也不少。我们不想惹事，我知道你肯定也不想，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%女人赶紧点头。你转身命令手下拿些庄稼，她也同时提高声音，让农工们别犯傻。前后不过十分钟，你们便重新上路。

d3d7e39aa14b00649d59.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]The food here is plentiful. You turn around to your men and tell them to take everything they can. Gasping, the woman steps back and looks about ready to scream. You grab her, bringing a string of cries from the children. A few farmhands grab sickles and pitchforks in turn. You tell her to order the rest of the farmhands to put their weapons on the ground. She obeys, and the farmhands do as told, albeit somewhat reluctantly.

You hold the woman while your men take what they can. When they've pillaged as much as they can carry, you let her go and order your men to move out.
d3d7e39aa14b00649d59.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_72.png[/img]这里食物充足。你转身告诉弟兄们，能拿多少就拿多少。女人倒抽一口气，向后退，看样子马上就要尖叫。你一把抓住她，孩子们顿时哭喊起来。几个农工也拿起镰刀和草叉。你让她命令其他农工放下武器。她照办了，农工们虽不情愿，也还是依言将武器放到地上。

你扣住女人，任弟兄们搜刮物资。等众人抢够能带走的东西，你才放开她，下令离开。

a0c9723e0adc89731b76.translation: 这点东西是我们应得的。

f0516c8e28c0ebac2d2e.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]There's plenty of food here. And too many witnesses.

You turn around and give a knowing glance at %someguy1%. He nods back and nocks an arrow. Before the woman can scream, the brother releases the shot and the old man on the porch stumbles backward into the house, followed by a retinue of screaming children. The rest of your company fans out, unsheathing their swords as they run into the fields. A few farmhands try to fight back, but your well-armed band makes short work of them. %someguy2% sprints into the homestead and inside you hear a number of cries that, one by one, disappear until there is silence. You hand the woman off to a few brothers, telling them to just make sure she is dead before you leave. A few other sellswords immediately begin cutting down crops and stealing away items from the home. Before long, you're back out on the roads, your stocks now almost full. A few brothers are taking red rags to their wet blades.
f0516c8e28c0ebac2d2e.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_30.png[/img]这里粮食很多，目击者也太多。

你转过身，向%someguy1%递了个眼色。他点头会意，搭箭上弦。女人还没来得及尖叫，他便松开弓弦。门廊上的老人中箭向后跌进屋里，一群孩子尖叫着跟了进去。其余弟兄四散开来，拔剑冲向田地。几个农工试图反抗，却被你们这支装备精良的队伍迅速杀倒。%someguy2%冲进农舍，你听见里面传来好几声哭喊，随后一声接一声地消失，直至归于寂静。你把女人交给几个弟兄，只吩咐他们在离开前确保她已经死了。另外几个佣兵立刻动手收割庄稼，把屋里的东西搬走。没过多久，你们重新踏上道路，补给几乎装满。几个弟兄正用已经染红的破布，擦拭仍湿漉漉的刀刃。

5a21b95238d610b73ae0.source: No one left to tell what happened here.
5a21b95238d610b73ae0.translation: 没人能说出这里发生过什么了。

6de0713f2887e311b7bc.source: Was appalled by the company's conduct
6de0713f2887e311b7bc.translation: 对战团的行径感到震惊

6e32b3066dc7c0e94487.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] With rations down to nothing, %ratcatcher% feebly enters your tent, the moans of some hungry men passing by before the flaps close behind him. He explains that he has a resolution to your food problem. You fear to ask what it is, but you've little choice now. The ratchatcher swings a burlap sack onto the table. Some shape of it moves, skittering and bobbing and squealing. The man smashes it with his fist before smiling at you.%SPEECH_ON%Sorry, had a live one there!%SPEECH_OFF%He explains that rat isn't the most nutritious of animals, nor the healthiest, but it'd help the company enough until they can get back to a town or farm. You reluctantly agree to keep your men from starving.
6e32b3066dc7c0e94487.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] 口粮已经耗尽，%ratcatcher%有气无力地走进你的帐篷。帐帘合上之前，外头还传来几个饥饿弟兄的哀叹。他说自己有办法解决粮食问题。你有点不敢问是什么，可眼下也没得选。捕鼠人把一只粗麻袋甩到桌上，里头有什么东西乱窜乱拱，吱吱尖叫。他一拳砸下去，随后冲你笑了笑。%SPEECH_ON%抱歉，混进来一只活的！%SPEECH_OFF%他解释说，老鼠谈不上多有营养，也不算多干净，不过足以帮战团撑到下一个城镇或农场。为了不让弟兄们饿死，你勉强同意了。

98e723b0af1476c2f442.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]You come across %ratcatcher% sitting with his hands full of rope. He's got the cords looping so ferociously - as ropes can be looped - that you worry to not put your foot close to it. Curious, you ask the man what he's up to. As though he were expecting just that question, he quickly raises his project into the air and announces he's fashioned himself a net. Ah! You put your hands to your hips.%SPEECH_ON%That shall be great on the battlefield!%SPEECH_OFF%The ratcatcher purses his lips. He slowly lowers the net.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, I meant... to use it... to snag me some rat...%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses, then throws his head up, a cheeky if not cheesy smile adorned across it.%SPEECH_ON%But I shall use it on the field of battle! No rat, man or furry or that which scurries, shall escape me!%SPEECH_OFF%
98e723b0af1476c2f442.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你撞见%ratcatcher%坐着，满手都是绳子。他打绳圈的劲头凶猛得很——若编绳也称得上凶猛的话——弄得你都不敢把脚靠近。你好奇地问他在忙什么。他仿佛就等这句话，立刻举起手里的活计，宣布自己编好了一张网。啊哈！你双手叉腰。%SPEECH_ON%这在战场上可太有用了！%SPEECH_OFF%捕鼠人抿了抿嘴，慢慢放下网。%SPEECH_ON%哦，我本来……是想拿它……抓几只老鼠……%SPEECH_OFF%他停了停，随后猛地抬头，挤出一个俏皮却有些做作的笑。%SPEECH_ON%不过，我会把它用在战场上！不管是两条腿的耗子，还是长毛乱窜的耗子，谁也别想逃出我的手心！%SPEECH_OFF%

61bad4321a7cebecac86.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]%ratcatcher% the ratcatcher has earned his old vocation's namesake: apparently he's been rounding up rats as your party has been traveling about. Tonight, they all escaped. Some of the food stocks needed to be thrown away and a few men have fallen ill.
61bad4321a7cebecac86.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_18.png[/img]捕鼠人%ratcatcher%还真没辱没老本行的名头：原来，战团一路行进，他也一路收集老鼠。今晚，老鼠全逃了。部分粮食不得不丢弃，几个弟兄也病倒了。

b47bf2cab722ad99ae49.source: My throat's so scratchy I can barely squeak out a word!
b47bf2cab722ad99ae49.translation: 嗓子痒得要命，连句话都挤不出来！

e002dcd3660e8afd7267.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]%refugee%, a man who once forced onto the roads as a refugee, stares blankly at %raider%. The raider, sensing he's being stared at, lowers his plate of food.%SPEECH_ON%Whatcha farkin' looking at, huh?%SPEECH_OFF%The refugee points a dripping spoon.%SPEECH_ON%Yer a raider, right?%SPEECH_OFF%%raider% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Was. Might be again someday. What's it to you?%SPEECH_OFF%Standing up, %refugee% points.%SPEECH_ON%It were men like you who forced good people out of their homes. Good people to drag their whole lives onto the damned road.%SPEECH_OFF%Laughing, %raider% gets to his feet.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, is that right? And what made them so good? That they couldn't swing a sword or protect themselves? Do you believe for one moment that were the boot on the other foot they wouldn't do the same to me? Or to you, too? Folk are only as good as their options.%SPEECH_OFF%The spate's getting wild and some of the other mercenaries get to their feet. Nobody can stop the initial scuffle, the two men exchanging blows and curses as good as any tavern brawl you've seen. Thankfully, nothing too serious comes of the fight.
e002dcd3660e8afd7267.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]曾被迫流落道路、沦为难民的%refugee%，正面无表情地盯着%raider%。劫掠者察觉有人盯着自己，放下食盘。%SPEECH_ON%你他娘的看什么，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%难民举起还在滴汤的勺子，指着他。%SPEECH_ON%你是劫掠者，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%%raider%点头。%SPEECH_ON%以前是。说不定哪天还会干回去。关你什么事？%SPEECH_OFF%%refugee%站起身，伸手一指。%SPEECH_ON%就是你这种人，把好人赶出自己的家，逼着他们把一辈子的家当拖到该死的路上去！%SPEECH_OFF%%raider%笑着站起来。%SPEECH_ON%噢，是吗？他们哪儿好了？不会挥剑，保不住自己，就叫好人？你真信换个处境，他们不会对我干同样的事？甚至对你也一样？人有多善良，不过看他有多少选择。%SPEECH_OFF%争吵越来越激烈，其他几个佣兵也站了起来。谁都没来得及拦住最先那一阵扭打，两人拳脚与脏话齐飞，不逊于你见过的任何一场酒馆斗殴。好在这架终究没闹出太严重的后果。

3e6328781da4a1ae11ad.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]The forests have always been a refuge for man - the wilds from whence he came, to the wilds where he always wishes to return. And here you find a great number of men, a tribe of the lost, unconcerned with their departed civilizations, draped in religious habits, and carrying great sigils of faith, and tomes of truth. They're impoverished almost to the point of being decadently fashionable, like great kings looking to fit in with commoners. You sit and watch this shuffle by, clinking, clanging, hollow wooden beads rattling, whispers under their breath, raspy and dry. And so they go on, hardly even bothering to look at you.
3e6328781da4a1ae11ad.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]森林向来是人类的避难所——人从荒野中走出，却又总想着重归荒野。此刻，你便在这里遇见了一大群人，像一支迷失的部族，对身后舍弃的文明毫不留恋。他们披着宗教长袍，举着巨大的信仰徽记，捧着记载真理的典籍。他们穷得几乎成了一种奢靡的时尚，仿佛一群为了混入平民之中而刻意装穷的君王。你坐着看他们缓缓经过，听着叮当碰撞、空心木珠的哗啦声，以及压在喉间干涩沙哑的低语。他们就这样继续前行，几乎懒得看你一眼。

e56f6c728b2c3af841d5.source: Probably best to leave them be.

eb8ee2e4c360e3e3d22e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]Curious, you call out to the men to ask where they are going. The man in front slowly turns to you, his eyes peering out from the dark of a wrapped shawl. He slowly draws the cloak back, revealing a head scarred in a pattern of religious rites. All the men behind him slowly follow suit, like a row of cards falling by the brush of a chaotic and mad wind.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul shall see you in the next world!%SPEECH_OFF%One of them shouts and they charge.
eb8ee2e4c360e3e3d22e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_03.png[/img]出于好奇，你扬声问那些人要去哪里。领头者缓缓转向你，眼睛从裹头披巾的暗处望来。他慢慢掀开兜帽，露出满头依照宗教仪式刻下的伤疤。身后众人依次照做，像一排纸牌被混乱而疯狂的风逐个掀倒。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔会在另一个世界见你们！%SPEECH_OFF%一人高喊，众人随即冲来。

38e437ed0738d043e0d5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]Curious as to where these men are going, you open your mouth, but %monk% the monk steps forward, cutting you off. He goes to the man in front of the troop and has quiet counsel with him. There is plenty of nodding, hrrumphing, and other gesticulations of men who dwell long on things well beyond the human realm. Eventually, the monk comes back.%SPEECH_ON%They're on a pilgrimage and now our name travels with them. Many shall hear of it.%SPEECH_OFF%You thank the monk for a job well done.
38e437ed0738d043e0d5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]你正好奇这些人要去哪里，刚要开口，修士%monk%便抢先上前，与领头者低声交谈。两人时而点头，时而哼声，配着种种手势，像极了长期钻研尘世之外事物的人。最后，修士回来了。%SPEECH_ON%他们在朝圣，如今也会带着我们的名声同行。许多人都会听说我们。%SPEECH_OFF%你感谢他办得漂亮。

affa92f6467f8984b1ee.source: We are for sure damned souls, but they don't know that...
affa92f6467f8984b1ee.translation: 我们的确该下地狱，可他们不知道……

bc2f79f1a18bad5c72f6.source: Helped spread word about the company
bc2f79f1a18bad5c72f6.translation: 帮忙传扬了战团的名声

87c9cf806a8b0fb90fce.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]While the company takes a short rest, you sit down to examine the wound where an arrow punctured your side not long ago. It's been healing slowly and still aches if you move too quickly, but things are getting better. %bro1% joins you, seizing this opportunity to talk to his captain.%SPEECH_ON%So the way I see it, nobody knows about the %companyname% yet. We don't want to hunt rag-tag bands of brigands through the woods forever, but we'll have to make a name for ourselves first as reliable swords-for-hire that can get things done before the noble houses take notice. They'll want to use the company for far better paying tasks, I'm sure.%SPEECH_OFF%He adjusts his weapon belt and continues.%SPEECH_ON%Just we keep in mind that the high lords are playing a dangerous game and we don't want to get on their bad side. There's enough stories of people who crossed them only to end up quartered and fed to the pigs, and they have the means to squish even a company of sellswords.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses a short moment and then adds another thought.%SPEECH_ON%The guildmasters and councilmen running the villages and towns, too, have a good memory. We depend on them to hire the company for now, but having some influential friends may also help us get better deals with the merchants.%SPEECH_OFF%
87c9cf806a8b0fb90fce.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]战团短暂歇息时，你坐下来，查看不久前侧腹中箭留下的伤口。它愈合得缓慢，动作一快仍会隐隐作痛，不过正在好转。%bro1%走来坐下，趁机和你这位团长谈了起来。%SPEECH_ON%依我看，现在还没人听说过%companyname%。我们总不能一辈子钻林子，追着那些乌合之众的强盗跑。但要让贵族家族注意到我们，就得先闯出名声，让人知道咱们靠得住，能把事情办成。到时候，他们肯定会拿报酬高得多的活儿来找我们。%SPEECH_OFF%他调整一下武器腰带，继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%不过得记住，大领主们玩的可是危险的把戏，别惹恼他们。得罪了他们，被肢解喂猪的故事，听过的还少吗？他们有的是手段，连整支佣兵战团也能碾死。%SPEECH_OFF%他稍停片刻，又补充了一点。%SPEECH_ON%掌管村镇的行会长和议员，记性也都好得很。眼下，咱们还得靠他们雇佣战团来糊口。不过，多结交几个有分量的朋友，说不定还能让商人给个好价钱。%SPEECH_OFF%

854c8dca5354a04507f1.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%retiredsoldier% sits about the campfire telling war stories. If he's lying, it's merely an embellishment, as the scars all about his body speak unsightly truths. With each tale, the men become more engrossed, emboldened, and ready to get back out there and forge their own stories.
854c8dca5354a04507f1.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%retiredsoldier%坐在篝火旁，讲着战场往事。若说有假，也不过添油加醋；他满身难看的伤疤，已替那些故事作了证。听过一段又一段，弟兄们越发入迷，也越发振奋，恨不得立刻重返战场，写下属于自己的故事。

5a373625125e11feaf41.source: Killing men does make for great bedtime stories.
5a373625125e11feaf41.translation: 杀人的故事，还真适合睡前讲。

5704141207dfe5a0062d.source: Told one of his war stories
5704141207dfe5a0062d.translation: 讲了一段自己的战场往事

a2d5837b45f2c02673cb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]After the battle is over, you find %noncombat% on his knees, his body swaying back and forth as he nurses a wound. You hear muffled cries in between all-too-loud moans. Approaching, you ask the man if he is alright. He shakes his head and explains that this was his first taste of real, vicious combat. It was not what he expected and isn't sure if he can continue.
a2d5837b45f2c02673cb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]战斗结束，你发现%noncombat%跪在地上，捂着伤口，身子前后摇晃。响亮的呻吟之间，夹着压抑的哭声。你走近，问他还好吗。他摇头解释，这是自己第一次尝到真正残酷的战斗，和想象中完全不同。他不知道还能不能撑下去。

6c6e16d2b89012363be7.source: There is not a soul out here who isn't scared.
6c6e16d2b89012363be7.translation: 这里没一个人是不害怕的。

652b3ed5e6eccda18dee.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]You tell the mercenary to man up. When he pauses, stifling a cry, you tell him again. This time, he brings a leg out and plants a foot, steadying himself. With true grit, he manages to get himself standing again. His shirt is bloodslaked, his face covered in mud and crimson and other viscera battle makes of the living. But his eyes show a sign of resolve they did not before. He nods at you before walking back to join the rest of the men.
652b3ed5e6eccda18dee.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]你让佣兵拿出点男子气概。他顿住，压下一声哭泣，你又说了一遍。这一次，他迈出一条腿，踩稳脚，撑住身子，凭着一股狠劲终于重新站了起来。他衣衫浸透鲜血，脸上沾满泥土、血迹，以及战斗从活人身上扯出的污物，可眼中却有了先前没有的坚定。他朝你点头，走回弟兄们中间。

f0f5a8c48ca283892d49.translation: 铁与铁相磨，才能磨出锋刃。

7c7f1e6738cfd1df2c2e.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]Unfortunately, telling the man to 'suck it up' gets him nowhere. He turns to you, face covered in the blood and gore of battle, but before any words can come out his lip quivers and keels over again. You ask the man if he wishes to be cut from the company, but he shakes his head no. He'll get better, he explains. You nod and walk off, but there's little doubt that this poor show of resolve has hurt the man's pride.
7c7f1e6738cfd1df2c2e.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]可惜，叫他“挺住”并没有用。他转向你，满脸都是战场上的血污，话还没出口，嘴唇便颤抖起来，又一次弯下腰。你问他是否想被遣离战团，他却摇头，说自己会好起来。你点头离开，不过毫无疑问，这番怯弱的表现已经伤了他的自尊。

37bc2ba38df0458f66b5.source: He will be steeled by combat, or he will be killed by it.
37bc2ba38df0458f66b5.translation: 战斗要么把他锤炼成钢，要么要了他的命。

d9db977bb81e7ad19978.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]The man looks around him, at the bodies, at the land, at the sky. He nods and gets to his feet. Before heading back to camp, he thanks you for your words.%SPEECH_ON%Thankee, captain. I'll do a better job of hiding my fears.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod back with a terse smile before putting your fist to your chest.%SPEECH_ON%Bottle it all up right here and don't let anybody else see it. Half of any battle is convincing your opponent that you're crazier than they are. Being fearless is impossible, but faking it for a time is not.%SPEECH_OFF%The man nods again and heads back to camp with his head held a little bit higher.
d9db977bb81e7ad19978.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]那人环顾四周，看看尸体，看看大地，再看看天空。他点点头，站起身。回营前，他向你道谢。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢，团长。我会学着把害怕藏好些。%SPEECH_OFF%你报以短促的微笑，点头回应，然后握拳抵住胸口。%SPEECH_ON%全压在这里，别让旁人看出来。打仗有一半功夫，就是让对手相信你比他更疯。想完全不怕是不可能的，装上一阵却不难。%SPEECH_OFF%那人再次点头，回营时，头已比先前抬高了一些。

3bc4d151cb50f4d165b3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]The man turns to you, tears cutting through the crusts of blood on his cheeks. He shakes his head and asks how is it that he's the only one out here crying. You shrug and ask the man if he wishes to leave the company. He shakes his head again.%SPEECH_ON%I'll get better. I just.. I just need some time to do it, that's all.%SPEECH_OFF%
3bc4d151cb50f4d165b3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_22.png[/img]他转向你，泪水在脸颊凝结的血痂间冲出痕迹。他摇头，问为什么只有自己在哭。你耸耸肩，反问他想不想离开战团。他又摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我会好起来。我只是……只是需要一点时间，仅此而已。%SPEECH_OFF%

038029baf3c833ddefdf.source: Realized what being a mercenary means
038029baf3c833ddefdf.translation: 明白了当佣兵意味着什么

d60553ab711e62757ef1.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]As you walk along the roads, a throng of ragged-looking men speed past you. They clear off the path and jump down into an embankment and hide behind a wall of bushes.

With the shrubbery still swaying, another group of men soon appears. Before the first man even speaks you already know what's coming. Apparently some laborers had agreed in union to abandon a project over what the pursuing overseers simplify as 'issues'. They ask if you have seen these ne'er do wells.
d60553ab711e62757ef1.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]行路途中，一群衣衫破烂的男人从你身边飞奔而过，跳下路堤，躲进浓密的灌木后。

枝叶还没停止摇晃，另一群人就出现了。领头者还没开口，你已猜到来意。原来，几个工人因某些缘由商量好一起撂挑子，追来的监工却只笼统称之为“出了点问题”。他们问你，有没有见过那些不成器的家伙。

b3de7d7dfdfd278f5fde.source: We haven't seen anyone around these parts.
b3de7d7dfdfd278f5fde.translation: 我们在这附近没见过什么人。

b58e05556b21985897f6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]The overseers nod and draw clubs and pitchforks and even some nets. They scramble off the road and converge onto the bushes like a bunch of raiders would a wagon. It is a wild, though one-sided, fight. Men are beaten and battered like fish in a bush. Even far up the hillside you can hear the unmistakable clonking of wood on skull. You see one man fatally stabbed with a spear, perhaps the resolution of a conflict of a somewhat more personal matter. When the battle ends, the head overseer returns to you, a line of prisoners behind him looking rather worse for the wear. He hands you a purse of coins, clapping you on the shoulder and thanking you for keeping 'order'.
b58e05556b21985897f6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]监工们点头，拿出棍棒、草叉，甚至还有几张网。他们争先恐后地冲下道路，扑向灌木丛，像一群劫掠者扑向货车。打斗凶狠，却完全一边倒。逃亡者像困在灌木中的鱼一般，任人殴打。即便隔着老远的山坡，你仍能清楚听见木棍敲在头骨上的闷响。你看见一人被长矛刺死，或许那一击还了结了某段更私人的恩怨。打斗结束，领头的监工回到你面前，身后跟着一列被折磨得不成样子的俘虏。他递给你一袋钱，拍着你的肩，感谢你维护了“秩序”。

3dbba05f8abbd2bf938b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]With your finger still pointing the wrong way, the overseers take off. Their angry barking fades into the distance. When they are gone, the laborers slowly emerge. They appear rather surprised that a sellsword didn't sell word of them in the bushes. One by one they take off their hats and bless you for your mercy. One even calls it 'justice', a strange word in a mercenary's ear.

While most of them make off, one man stands idly behind. He asks if maybe he can join your company if, you know, you got room for him.
3dbba05f8abbd2bf938b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]你的手指还指着错误的方向，监工们便追了过去，愤怒的叫嚷渐渐远去。他们走后，工人们慢慢现身，似乎很惊讶：一个卖命的佣兵，居然没把灌木里的他们也卖了。他们逐一摘帽，为你的仁慈送上祝福。甚至有人称这叫“正义”——在佣兵耳中，多么陌生的词。

大部分人都走了，一个男人却仍站在原地。他问，假如你还有位置，不知能不能让他加入战团。

57cd3a5a0b3976fe25a9.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]All of the overseers take off in the wrong direction - except one. He stands still the by roadside, looking down the embankment. For a brief moment you consider taking a cool blade across his neck, drawing the words out of his throat instead of his mouth. The man quickly turns to his comrades and yells and points down the hillside. Sensing their being seen, the laborers dash out of the bushes going this way and that. They must be malnourished for most move with the speed of a skeleton climbing a flight of stairs.

The ensuing battle is rather gruesome and uncalled for, the overseers being quite punitive in their capturing measures. When it's all said and done they begin to depart just as quickly as they came, the laborers now tied up in rope and their heads covered with sacks. Before he leaves, the head overseer shares a word of contempt for you. With your blade slowly coming out of its sheathe, you ask the man if he has anything else he wishes to add. He spits and shakes his head no.
57cd3a5a0b3976fe25a9.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]监工们全都朝错误的方向追去——只有一个例外。他站在路边，低头望向坡下。有那么一瞬间，你考虑把冰冷的刀锋划过他的脖子，让声音从喉管里漏出来，而不是从嘴里喊出来。可他已迅速转向同伙，指着山坡下大声呼喊。劳工们察觉行踪暴露，纷纷从灌木丛中蹿出，四散奔逃。他们一定长期吃不饱，大多数人的速度慢得像一具骷髅在爬楼梯。

随后的打斗血腥得毫无必要，监工们抓人时下手极重。等一切结束，他们又像来时那样迅速离去，劳工们都被绳子捆住，头上套着麻袋。离开前，监工头子还轻蔑地骂了你一句。你缓缓将刀拔出鞘，问他还有什么话想补充。他啐了一口，摇头说没有。

c05e8fdcbf66107f4790.source: Then move out of my sight!

0ceac9cc979d9eb52e2a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]With your finger still pointing the wrong way, the overseers take off. Their angry barking fades into the distance. When they are gone, the laborers slowly emerge. They appear rather surprised that a sellsword didn't sell word of them in the bushes. One by one they take off their hats and bless you for your mercy. One even calls it 'justice', a strange word in a mercenary's ear.
0ceac9cc979d9eb52e2a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]你的手指还指着错误的方向，监工们便追了过去，愤怒的叫嚷渐渐远去。他们走后，工人们慢慢现身，似乎很惊讶：一个卖命的佣兵，居然没把灌木里的他们也卖了。他们逐一摘帽，为你的仁慈送上祝福。甚至有人称这叫“正义”——在佣兵耳中，多么陌生的词。

526d20673c6fe24e8546.source: %terrainImage%{Walking, running, fighting, fucking, all good for a man's heart. The time spent traveling the land has improved the vitality and vigor of the men. You even caught one of the cheekier mercenaries flexing into pondwater, admiring his own reflection like some smirkin' wench. | All this running about the land has increased the stamina of the men. One runs in place, holding a finger to his neck. He remarks that his heart rate isn't going up at all. Another brother remarks that the guy doesn't even know how to count. The running man pauses.%SPEECH_ON%Oh. That's right.%SPEECH_OFF%}
526d20673c6fe24e8546.translation: %terrainImage%{走路、跑步、打仗、上床，样样都有益心脏。这段四处奔波的日子，让弟兄们体力更足、精神更旺。你甚至撞见一个没脸没皮的佣兵对着池水秀肌肉，欣赏自己的倒影，活像个抿嘴傻笑的姑娘。 | 整天在大地上奔走，弟兄们的耐力也见长。有个人原地跑着，一根手指按在脖子上，说心跳根本没加快。另一个弟兄提醒，他连数都不会数。跑步的人停下来。%SPEECH_ON%哦，也是。%SPEECH_OFF%}

58ec01cdd31a8bf9af2a.source: %terrainImage%A strange sight: one dead man pinned to the earth with spears. His own blood has been used to circle his corpse and other strange ritualistic rites have been painted by way of his lifeblood. %otherbrother% starts retrieving the spears. You try and tell him to stop, but it's already too late. He holds one of the weapons up.%SPEECH_ON%What? These are of good quality. Why would we leave them here?%SPEECH_OFF%Well, if there was a deific protection here it's already been broken. You collect the spears.
58ec01cdd31a8bf9af2a.translation: %terrainImage%眼前景象诡异：一具男尸被长矛钉在地上，自己的鲜血在尸身周围画成圆圈，还绘出了其他古怪的仪式符号。%otherbrother%开始拔矛，你想叫停，却已来不及。他举起一把。%SPEECH_ON%怎么了？这些成色不错，为什么要留在这儿？%SPEECH_OFF%好吧，这里若真有神力庇护，如今也已被破坏。你们收走了长矛。

56cfdac60fa68f3d3802.source: %terrainImage%Before you can leave, %cultist% bends low to the sacrificed man and whispers into his ear. A moment later, the dead man's head lurches. His eyes widen and nostrils flare. The cultist looks over to you.%SPEECH_ON%He wasn't dead. His blood was used to satiate Davkul. Had we needed his death, we would have burned him.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses, turning to the man whose wounds are mysteriously healing before your eyes like mud filling in a footprint. %cultist% pets him on the cheek.%SPEECH_ON%Come, friend, and serve Davkul.%SPEECH_OFF%The un-sacrificed man jumps to his feet and instinctively turns toward you. Somehow, he already knows you're the captain here and bends a knee.%SPEECH_ON%If you allow it, I will fight for you and, in doing so, spread the faith of Davkul.%SPEECH_OFF%His voice is robotic, as if he'd spent the last year practicing the oath.
56cfdac60fa68f3d3802.translation: %terrainImage%你还没来得及离开，%cultist%便俯身凑到祭品耳边，低声说了几句。片刻后，死人的头猛然一动，眼睛睁大，鼻翼翕张。教徒转向你。%SPEECH_ON%他没死。他的血已经让达夫库尔满足。若需要的是他的死亡，我们就会把他烧掉。%SPEECH_OFF%他顿了顿，又看向那人。就在你眼前，伤口正神秘地愈合，像泥水重新填平脚印。%cultist%轻拍他的脸。%SPEECH_ON%来吧，朋友，侍奉达夫库尔。%SPEECH_OFF%这个未死的祭品跳起身，本能地转向你。不知为何，他已知道你是这里的团长，便单膝跪地。%SPEECH_ON%若您允许，我愿为您作战，并以此传播达夫库尔的信仰。%SPEECH_OFF%他的声音机械而僵硬，仿佛已将这段誓词练习了整整一年。

82d58db87004edef2034.source: I really don't need more of this. You're on your own.
82d58db87004edef2034.translation: 这种事我真是受够了。你自求多福吧。

a5a7481e07a34bd431bd.source: %terrainImage%You decide to take the man in. %otherbrother% stands by the wayside, a couple of spears in hand.%SPEECH_ON%We're still taking these, right?%SPEECH_OFF%
a5a7481e07a34bd431bd.translation: %terrainImage%你决定收下这个人。%otherbrother%拿着几把长矛站在一旁。%SPEECH_ON%这些还是要拿走的，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%

ffa9c8c6cf8d35044d5b.source: %terrainImage%You deny the born-again cultist. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course. I will find other ways to serve Davkul. Farewell, brother.%SPEECH_OFF%He bows to %cultist% before turning and leaving. %otherbrother% stands there with a couple of spears in hand.%SPEECH_ON%We're still taking these, right?%SPEECH_OFF%
ffa9c8c6cf8d35044d5b.translation: %terrainImage%你拒绝了这个重获新生的教徒。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然，我会另寻侍奉达夫库尔的办法。再会，兄弟。%SPEECH_OFF%他向%cultist%鞠躬，转身离开。%otherbrother%拿着几把长矛站在原地。%SPEECH_ON%这些还是要拿走的，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%

8877dd02476fe4941d19.source: You found this man as a sacrifice, but he arose from his fate to be a servant of Davkul. He asked to fight for you, and you, for some reason, actually agreed.
8877dd02476fe4941d19.translation: 你发现这个男人时，他已成了祭品，却又从既定的死局中站起，成了达夫库尔的仆从。他请求为你而战，而你不知出于什么缘故，居然答应了。

7756d9b0cf70169fe35f.source: You failed to recruit a fellow cultist

11af45393c9d3bcc09c7.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_181.png[/img]{You thought them bounty hunters at first, but they were quick to correct you in that they announced themselves as 'researchers,' not 'searchers.' When you were still yet confused, they explained that they were 'anatomists' which did not help their efforts. Frustrated, they called you a 'colloquial hole,' which you were proud to retort that you knew what 'colloquial' meant, but they laughed and said you misheard for they were referring to you in the bird-sense. With them laughing in your face, you drew your sword and at this point they put their hands in the air, each one holding a purse filled with crowns.

After some further talk, you figured out that they're eggheads with a keen interest in corpses. Being that you are quite talented in creating corpses yourself, they saw fit to hire you to do exactly that for them. You will traverse the land, hiring a formidable band of mercenaries, and help these peculiar men accomplish their scientific tasks. All that you ask is that they not do funny things with your body if you happen to die. The anatomists put on warm smiles and promise they'd never do such a thing to a man they're doing business with. Each one of them looks like they learned how to smile from a dead man, but you'll just have to take their word for it.}
11af45393c9d3bcc09c7.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_181.png[/img]{你起初以为他们是赏金猎人，可他们马上纠正，自称做的是研究，不是搜捕。见你仍然一头雾水，他们又解释，自己是“解剖学者”，可这解释也没帮上什么忙。他们急了，骂你是个“泄殖腔”。你却听岔了，还颇为得意地回嘴，表示自己知道“口语”是什么意思。他们大笑，说你听错了，他们说的是鸟身上的那个部位。被这样当面嘲笑，你拔出了剑。他们这才举起双手，每人手中都攥着一袋克朗。

又谈了一阵，你总算弄明白，他们是一群对尸体格外着迷的书呆子。你恰好颇有制造尸体的本领，于是他们觉得，雇你专门干这个再合适不过。你将走遍各地，招募一支强悍的佣兵战团，协助这些古怪家伙完成他们的学术研究。你只提了一个要求：万一自己死了，别拿你的尸体乱来。解剖学者们露出温和的微笑，保证绝不会这样对待生意伙伴。他们每个人的笑容都像是跟死人学来的，不过，你也只能姑且相信。}

b2766df03105c218a9c5.source: On second thought, promise to leave my body alone while I'm alive, too.
b2766df03105c218a9c5.translation: 再想想，也请保证我活着的时候别碰我的身体。

fd0e27b7eff330d32cef.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_124.png[/img]You met the man in his home. He offered food, drink, and the contract at hand. Kill the witch of the forest and you'll be paid in sum. You and your men set out and did just that, bringing back the wench's head.

But your employer only laughed upon your return. He said it was the witch who put him in power and that you had freed him of his debts to her, that he outsmarted you and your stupid men. His lackeys stepped out of the shadows, their swords already drawn. The ambush started upon the criminal's arrogance and ended with his head cleared from his shoulders. But it came at the cost of many of your fellow beast slayers, leaving only yourself, %bs1%, %bs2%, and %bs3% remaining.

 Monsters of this world are often kept out of sight: the cruelties of man hide behind blind allegiance, the horrors of beasts behind dark legends. As the leader of a band of beast slayers, it has become steadily more apparent that you can no longer differentiate between the two. If you are to make coin hunting creatures, then you might as well add more to the pot by adding man to the ledger.
fd0e27b7eff330d32cef.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_124.png[/img]你在那人的宅邸里见了他。他摆出酒食，又拿出委托：杀掉森林里的女巫，就能拿到约定的报酬。你和弟兄们动身，照办了，带回那婆娘的脑袋。

可等你们回来，雇主却只是大笑。他说，正是女巫扶他上位，而你们替他免去了欠她的债；他耍了你，也耍了你那群愚蠢的手下。他的爪牙从阴影里走出，早已利剑出鞘。这场伏击始于恶徒的狂妄，终于他的身首异处。代价却是许多同袍猎兽者的性命，最终只剩你、%bs1%、%bs2%和%bs3%。

 这世上的怪物常藏在视线之外：人的残酷藏在盲目的效忠背后，野兽的恐怖藏在阴暗的传说里。作为一支猎兽队的首领，你越来越清楚，自己已无法分辨两者。如果要靠猎杀怪物赚钱，那不妨把人也添上名册，让钱袋再鼓些。

e8abdff38189e2fa7112.source: The most wicked beast is the one that thinks itself more.
e8abdff38189e2fa7112.translation: 最邪恶的野兽，正是自认超脱了兽性的那种。

870a92a2b03fcc8ba700.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%I put the woman and child in the barn which you have surely already found in ashes. They were knocked unconscious for he does not seek their pain. Please do not dwell upon their demise, they are with him now and in their passing I have been freed of all obligations to do what must be done. By now I will be gone. I will have taken up a new role, a new face, and beneath both I will become something I am not. I will pretend. I will act. But in the end, it is with one purpose. And you know what that purpose is. I must not name it, but you shall find it in the moments when you realize no one truly believes they are going to die. The purity of one's own annihilation must be clouded by distraction and merriment. Not all can see him, not all should, but see him they will.

Be well, strangers that you have become, for Davkul awaits us all.%SPEECH_OFF%
870a92a2b03fcc8ba700.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_71.png[/img]%SPEECH_ON%我把那女人和孩子放进谷仓，想必你们找到那里时，已经只剩灰烬。我先打昏了她们，因为祂并不求索她们的痛苦。请勿纠缠于她们的死亡，如今她们已与祂同在，而我也因她们的离世卸下所有牵挂，得以去做必须做的事。你们看到这里时，我已离开，换上新的身份、新的面孔，藏在两者之下，扮成另一个人。我会伪装，会演戏，但归根结底，目的只有一个。你们知道那是什么。我不能说出它的名字，可当你们意识到，其实没有人真正相信自己会死时，便能在那些瞬间找到答案。一个人自身湮灭的纯粹，必须用分心与欢愉去遮掩。并非人人都能看见祂，也并非人人都该看见，但最终，他们都会看见。

保重吧，已经成为陌路人的你们。达夫库尔在等待我们所有人。%SPEECH_OFF%

c2a3ab16060733d9bf5d.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{Long marches on old boots. Snow? Fight. Rain? Fight. Being charged by a line of heavy horse? Pick up that spear. Fight. Fight. Always fight. But even the simplicities gnawed. Ask for socks, get told to steal them from the peasants. Ask for a better meal, have your serving given to the ground.

 The ways of the soldier do not bother you. Killing does not bother you, nor does the threat of death. The disrespect of the nobles, the lack of responsibility by the lieutenants who 'bravely' throw you to the meatgrinder, that is what saps the will. That and the boredom. The endless day after day after day tedium of nothingness.

 It is somewhat ironic that you and three other deserters abandoned the war camp on the day they did. A grand meal was given to the soldiers. A celebration of victory, they called it. Your plate was pushed to the rims with foodstuffs. Portions that belonged to the men who died that day. And you ate that food. You ate it right up. And then you picked up your bags, went on watch for the evening, and simply slipped away. For engineering the escape, three other deserters elected to follow your command.

 You'd forge your own path as a sellsword where the pay would at least match the pain. But first, you'll have to make your way to other lands, for if you stay here for long, the noose will surely be where you meet your end.}
c2a3ab16060733d9bf5d.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img]{穿着破靴子，走没完没了的长路。下雪？打仗。下雨？打仗。重骑兵排成一线冲来了？拿起长矛。打，打，永远在打。可就连最琐碎的事，也在一点点啃噬你。想要双袜子，就被叫去抢农民的。想吃顿好饭，碗里的那份却被掀到了地上。

 当兵的日子本身并不让你难受。杀人不会，死亡的威胁也不会。真正磨光斗志的，是贵族的轻蔑，是那些“英勇”地把你扔进绞肉场、自己却毫无担当的副官。还有无聊。日复一日，日复一日，无尽的空虚与乏味。

 说来讽刺，你和另外三个逃兵离开军营的那天，士兵们刚得到一顿大餐。他们说，那是庆祝胜利。你的盘子里，食物堆到了边沿。那些份额，本属于当天死去的人。你吃了。吃得干干净净。然后，你拿起行囊，去站晚上的岗，就这么溜走了。这场逃亡由你策划，另外三个逃兵便推举你来指挥。

 你要以佣兵的身份，闯出自己的路，至少让报酬配得上吃过的苦。不过，首先得逃往别处。若在此地待得太久，最后等着你的，必然是绞索。}

eb0accb4a813f1bd11ba.source: We'll take destiny in our own hands.
eb0accb4a813f1bd11ba.translation: 我们要把命运握在自己手里。

b5f0a2cb8c36b3a34cc2.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]You soak in the cool morning air. As the sun slowly rises, so does a new chapter in your life begin. After years of bloodying your sword for meager pay, you've saved enough crowns to start your very own mercenary company. With you are %bro1%, %bro2% and %bro3% with whom you've fought before side by side in the shieldwall. You are their commander now, the leader of the %companyname%.

As you travel the lands you should hire new men in the villages and cities to fill your ranks. Many who offer their services will have never picked up a weapon before. Maybe they are desperate, maybe they are greedy for quick spoils of war. Most of them will die on the battlefield. But do not be discouraged. Such is the mercenary life, and the next village will always have new men eagerly looking for a new start in life.

The lands are dangerous these times. Robbers and pillagers lay in ambush by the roads, wild beasts roam the dark forests and orc tribes are restless beyond the boundaries of civilization. There are rumors even of dark magic being at work, the dead rising from their graves and walking again. There is plenty of opportunity to earn good money, whether by taking on contracts you can find in the villages and cities all over the land, or by venturing out on your own to explore and raid.

Your men look to you to give a command. They live and die for the %companyname% now.
b5f0a2cb8c36b3a34cc2.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]清晨的凉意沁人心脾。旭日缓缓升起，你的人生也翻开了新的一页。多年来，你为微薄的报酬在刀口上讨生活，如今终于攒够克朗，组建了一支属于自己的佣兵战团。陪在你身边的是 %bro1%、%bro2% 和 %bro3%，他们都曾与你并肩列阵，浴血厮杀。如今，你成了他们的指挥官，也是%companyname%的团长。

行走四方时，你需要在各地城镇招募新人，补充战团的人手。前来投奔的人，许多甚至从未拿起过武器。有的人走投无路，有的人只想靠战利品发一笔横财。他们大多会死在战场上，但你不必灰心丧气。佣兵的命运向来如此，下一个村庄里，总会有人急切地盼着重新开始。

如今，这片土地危机四伏。强盗在路旁设伏，猛兽游荡于幽暗的森林，文明疆界之外的兽人部落也蠢蠢欲动。甚至有传闻说，黑暗巫术正在肆虐，死者从坟墓中爬出，再次四处游荡。不过，危险也意味着赚取克朗的机会。你可以承接各地城镇的委托，也可以带人深入荒野，探索遗迹，劫掠财宝。

手下们都望着你，等候命令。从此，他们将为%companyname%出生入死。

359ccf39e0588bd84f1a.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{It should be a simple matter, killing a man, but unfamiliarity toughens the flesh: murderers caught in the street, choking away, arms tensed, hands clenched, screaming why won't their victims die. The motherly estate come undone, hitting her husband with the fire iron, again and again, and yet he still draws breath long after the flames have died. A bored Vizier unsure of why his torturers struggle with a criminal, the maddened man mocking them as they cut away appendages most important.

But to a gladiator a man is not just a man, he is a wielder of weapons. Swords, axes, spears, tridents, and more. Once you are past all these manifested defenses, he is mere flesh most familiar, and to dispatch him is not a matter of struggle, but of entertainment. Entertainment! Competition with every ounce of skin in the game, and the revelry of the crowds. These are the things you love. Let the philosophers wax on and off about the nature of how things come to live and die. When you plunge a sword into some fool's neck, not only does blood gush upon your blade, but the crowd gushes upon your accomplishment! It is the most wonderful sound in the world! And the women who come after, so hot and bothered they don't even wait for you to clean the entrails off before jumping your bones? Glorious.

But it gets boring, too. How many fights has it been? You can't count. How many challenges? You can't even name a single one. Not a single one! %g1%, %g2%, and %g3% all agree: you're just too good. And they're pretty good, too, if you're being honest. All four of you agree, though: you shall depart the arenas and forge a champion's spirit across the whole world.

The gladiators have some proclivities for the opulent, particularly for scented baths and jewelry that spells their names, so be prepared to pay a tidy sum for each as you finance their lavish lifestyles outside the comfort of the city states. And so it will be. Your three solid, but not all-time great fighting buddies will display their martial prowess, and you will be matched with a new challenge: learning how to manage warriors (who are not at your level) and their needs.}
359ccf39e0588bd84f1a.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_147.png[/img]{杀死一个人，本该是件简单事，可不熟悉，便会觉得血肉格外顽强。街头凶手掐着人脖子，双臂绷紧，双手紧攥，嘶喊着受害者为何还不死。贤妻良母失了控，用拨火铁棍一遍遍殴打丈夫，可炉火早已熄灭，他却还在喘气。无聊的维齐尔想不通，为何刑吏对付一个罪犯如此费劲；他们割掉那些要紧部位时，疯癫的男人仍在嘲笑他们。

可对角斗士而言，一个人不只是一个人，更是武器的操使者。剑、斧、长矛、三叉戟，还有更多。越过这些有形的防御，剩下的便只是熟悉至极的血肉。了结他，不是苦战，而是娱乐。娱乐！以每一寸血肉为赌注的较量，以及观众的狂欢，这些才是你热爱的。让哲人去没完没了地谈生死的本性吧。当你把剑插进某个蠢货的脖子，涌上剑刃的不只是鲜血，更有观众为你壮举爆发的欢呼！那是世间最美妙的声音！而事后找上门的女人，热切得连你清掉身上内脏的工夫都等不及，就扑了上来？妙不可言。

不过，也会腻。打过多少场？数不清。遇过多少挑战？连一次都想不起来。一次都没有！%g1%、%g2%和%g3%一致认为，你实在太强。说实话，他们也不差。不过，你们四个达成共识：离开竞技场，到整个世界去锤炼冠军之魂。

角斗士们有些奢靡癖好，尤其喜欢香浴，以及拼出自己名字的珠宝。因此，离开舒适的城邦后，要供他们维持阔绰生活，你得准备好，为每个人付出不菲的薪水。那便如此。三位可靠、却算不上旷世奇才的战友将展示武艺，而你则要迎接新的挑战：学会管理这些本领不及自己的战士，以及他们的种种需求。}

df73d8c06b9adbc8e91e.source: Everyone can earn salvation by working off their debt to the Gilder.
df73d8c06b9adbc8e91e.translation: 人人都能靠劳作偿清欠镀金者的债，从而获得救赎。

92ad6e2c9088d298e5d4.source: For gold, glory, and Young Anselm!
92ad6e2c9088d298e5d4.translation: 为了黄金、荣耀和小安塞尔姆！

562c7553924efba901dc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]{After you and your party killed half of them, the villagers finally submitted. A white flag was raised, and they offered parlay which you were happy to grant. In a single line they walked out to the town square where they had been holding a festival. Jewels and treasures filled their arms and they dumped the goods where you stood, boot atop the smashed skull of their mayor. Your vanguard of %raider1%, %raider2%, %raider3% and %raider4% kept careful watch of the ceremony like buzzards watching a slow death.

 The last in the line was a monk. He had no gold or silver on him, but instead spoke to you, his words immediately drawing the weapons of your fellow raiders. You allowed him to speak, and he spoke at length about the old gods and how the treasures of the heavens superseded all of that which terra could offer. You told him his death was written by that wagging chin of his. The monk pursed his lips.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, then if you want gold, depart these silly games. This raiding and pillaging, it is all worthless compared to the treasures of the south. The nobles won't have you in their armies, but they are forever in need of mercenaries and rarely have the time or luxury of choosing where these hired fighters come from. You'd make all the crowns you'd ever want. Come south, raiders, and be sublimated into sellswords.%SPEECH_OFF%%raider3% demands the monk's head, but you stay the execution. Instead, you take the crafty monk at his word. You've long heard of southern riches and the travels of adventurous swords for hire. You decide to venture south - so long as the monk comes with. %raider3% protests, but you won't have it. If this pale little shit of a monk is your lucky charm to a new life, then it would be an affront to the old gods to leave him be. The raider storms off, but %raider1%, %raider2% and %raider4% have no qualms about following you. The rest of the war party returns north, a split in the loot being made. What remains of the village is left behind to recover, rebuild, and make new goods for stronger tribes to come and take for themselves.}
562c7553924efba901dc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]{你和部下杀掉一半村民后，余下的人终于屈服。白旗升起，他们请求谈判，你欣然应允。村民排成一列，走到原本举办节庆的广场上，怀抱珠宝与财物，堆在你脚前。而你的靴子，正踩着村长被砸碎的脑袋。先锋%raider1%、%raider2%、%raider3%和%raider4%警惕地看着这场仪式，像秃鹫守望缓慢到来的死亡。

队尾是个修士，身上没有金银，却开口对你说话，话音立刻引得劫掠者们拔出武器。你准他讲。他便长篇大论地谈起旧神，说天界的珍宝胜过大地能给的一切。你告诉他，那张喋喋不休的嘴，已经替自己写下死期。修士抿了抿唇。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，既然你要金子，就别再玩这些蠢把戏。劫掠、抢夺，与南方的财富相比，全都不值一提。贵族不会让你们加入军队，可他们永远需要佣兵，也少有时间和余地，挑剔这些雇来战士的出身。你想要多少克朗，都能挣到。去南方吧，劫掠者，让自己升格为佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%%raider3%叫嚷着要砍下修士的头，你却叫停处决，决定相信这狡猾修士的话。南方的财富，以及冒险佣兵四处闯荡的故事，你早有耳闻。你决定南下，但修士必须同行。%raider3%反对，你却不容争辩。若这苍白的小混账修士，是通往新生活的幸运符，把他丢下岂不是冒犯旧神？那劫掠者怒气冲冲地走了，可%raider1%、%raider2%和%raider4%毫不介意跟随你。分好战利品后，其余人北返。残存的村庄被留在身后，等着恢复、重建，再造出新的财物，供更强大的部落前来夺走。}

00be653a0e36e4e7c8fa.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]Despite tales of lone hungry hunters just looking to feed a family, poachers often work in teams and create whole businesses out of the trade of stolen furs and meats.

But as your local lord, %noble%, became increasingly annoyed with poachers hunting in his woods, most of the surrounding groups of hunters were caught, mutilated, and hanged. With just yourself, %hunter1%, %hunter2%, and %hunter3% remaining, a decision had to be made - how to make a living when all you know is how to use a bow?

It was decided to turn your collective talents to mercenary work, and you were promptly elected captain of the outfit.%SPEECH_ON%You have the sharpest eyes of us all.%SPEECH_OFF%%hunter2% said, and %hunter3% agreed, though tempered it.%SPEECH_ON%And you are, of course, easily the worst shot of the group. Don't whip for that one, CAPTAIN, ha-haaa!%SPEECH_OFF%Certainly, your merry band of poachers brings unique talents to the table - your men prefer to travel light, but they are quick on their feet, good shots with a bow and experts in scouting to avoid unfavorable engagements.
00be653a0e36e4e7c8fa.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]传说里，偷猎者总是独自挨饿、只想养活家人的猎人。但实际上，他们往往结伙行事，靠贩卖偷猎来的皮毛与肉，经营起一整门生意。

可当地领主%noble%对有人在自家林中偷猎越来越恼火，周围的大多数猎队都被抓住，遭到残害，最后吊死。只剩你、%hunter1%、%hunter2%和%hunter3%时，你们必须作出决定：除了使弓，别的什么都不会，还能靠什么谋生？

最终，大家决定把这一身本领用到佣兵的行当里，而你很快被推为团长。%SPEECH_ON%咱们这些人里，你眼睛最尖。%SPEECH_OFF%%hunter2%这么说，%hunter3%也同意，不过补了一句。%SPEECH_ON%当然，你射得也是咱们里头最烂的。可别为这句话抽我鞭子啊，团——长，哈哈哈！%SPEECH_OFF%你这伙快活的偷猎者确实身怀独特本领：弟兄们偏爱轻装上阵，脚步敏捷，弓术精湛，也精于侦察，能避开不利的交战。

9de32a3065a7b1156f9c.source: The Gilder will reveal to us the way.
9de32a3065a7b1156f9c.translation: 镀金者会为我们指明道路。

f7503f3b59c0f77a36b3.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_95.png[/img]The corpses are abuzz with flies and %ch1% stands amidst the swarm like he built the deathly totem which brought their presence. He turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Greenskins did this one. No man can hew a head in half like that, and no sane man would stack them in such a manner. And there's goblin poison on them arrow tips.%SPEECH_OFF% %ch2% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yesterday we find that merchant hanged by brigands, now this. The roads are getting too dangerous for a wagon carrying shine. Now, I ain't saying my swordhand ain't worth its weight in salt, but with just the two of us on duty we're throwing dice by the hour. Sir, you should look into hiring more guard.%SPEECH_OFF%
f7503f3b59c0f77a36b3.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_95.png[/img]尸堆上苍蝇嗡嗡作响，%ch1%站在虫群之中，仿佛正是他筑起这座死亡图腾，把它们招来。他转头看向你。%SPEECH_ON%这是绿皮干的。人没本事把脑袋劈成这样两半，脑子正常的人也不会把尸体堆成这副模样。还有，箭头上涂的是地精的毒。%SPEECH_OFF% %ch2%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%昨天才撞见一个被强盗吊死的商人，今天又来这出。载着钱货的车走在路上，越来越不安全了。倒不是说我剑术不济，可光靠咱俩值守，每过一个钟头都像是在赌命。先生，您得考虑多雇些护卫了。%SPEECH_OFF%

5790947451f0c3957cb5.source: We'll hire more guards and then some!
5790947451f0c3957cb5.translation: 我们不但要多雇护卫，还得再添些人手！

ee10e96c60aa1be2771b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_95.png[/img]You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%No. What we'll be doing is fighting back and then some. I aim to hire sellswords to fit a company of making, and if your swordhands want to earn a steady keep, you two can be the first.%SPEECH_OFF%
ee10e96c60aa1be2771b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_95.png[/img]你摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不，我们要还击，还要做得更多。我打算招募佣兵，组起一支真正成气候的战团。你们两个若想靠手里的剑挣份稳定的钱，就来当头一批。%SPEECH_OFF%

5e53bd4051b3c980f211.source: Onwards, now, we have wares to sell!

73b21104008b91574594.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_95.png[/img]You shake your head.%SPEECH_ON%We're hardly making a profit as is. I can't spare the coin to hire any more guards. Not unless we find a new profitable trade route, that is. And I aim to do just that!%SPEECH_OFF%
73b21104008b91574594.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_95.png[/img]你摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我们现在几乎没利润，哪有余钱再雇护卫？除非找到一条新的赚钱商路，而这正是我要做的！%SPEECH_OFF%

d7bb05323e3a803ba8ca.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]You come across an unexpected sight at the top of the mountain: a man sitting in a strange and wooden contraption, tilting it toward the edge of a deadly precipice. He's got a scarf over his eyes, pulling it down to talk.%SPEECH_ON%Ahoy, strangers. It appears you shall record history! For men governed the common horse to run faster than it knew how, I shall govern birds to... well, we can't ride birds, but I can, as you can see by this machine, simulate them. The shackles of space and time shall be lifted, much like these here wooden wings will lift me into the very skies!%SPEECH_OFF%This 'contraption' comes with pedals, wooden spokes, and tarps of very thin and hastily stitched leather.
d7bb05323e3a803ba8ca.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]山顶上，你看见一幕意料之外的景象：一个男人坐在古怪的木制装置里，正将它倾向万丈悬崖的边缘。他用围巾蒙着眼，拉下来后开口招呼。%SPEECH_ON%啊哈，陌生人！看来你们要替历史作个见证了！人既能驯服寻常马匹，让它跑得比自己想象的还快，我也能驯服鸟儿，让它们……好吧，鸟是没法骑，可你们看这台机器，我能模仿它们！空间与时间的枷锁即将被打破，正如这双木翼将把我托上苍穹！%SPEECH_OFF%这件“装置”上安着踏板、木辐条，还有用极薄皮革匆匆缝成的蒙皮。

e8fb5b3f846fbd7ac798.source: You need to stop this, you'll only kill yourself.
e8fb5b3f846fbd7ac798.translation: 别再干了，你只会把自己害死。

e23637434bfb41fd0b34.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]You step forward and explain the reality of the situation.%SPEECH_ON%Good... sir. What bird takes flight from such great heights? Does not a bird simply propel itself upward with the thrust of its wings? You're going to throw yourself off this cliff in the hopes that your machine will work, knowing deep in your heart that it will not.%SPEECH_OFF%The haggard looking mountain scientist looks at his feet. He nods solemnly.%SPEECH_ON%It could use some tinkering, I suppose. You have an avian eye, good sir. And you also have my thanks. I shall tell people of your great wisdom!%SPEECH_OFF%
e23637434bfb41fd0b34.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]你上前，把眼下的实情说清楚。%SPEECH_ON%这位……先生，哪只鸟非得从这么高的地方才能起飞？鸟不都是靠扇动翅膀，自己升上去的吗？你想从悬崖上跳下去，盼着这机器能飞，可心底分明知道，它飞不了。%SPEECH_OFF%那位面容憔悴的山中学者低头看着双脚，郑重地点头。%SPEECH_ON%我想，也许确实还得修整一下。好先生，你看鸟真有眼光。也请接受我的谢意。我会告诉大家，你有多么明智！%SPEECH_OFF%

f4800cca1aa419f67274.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]{You step back and let the man take flight. He wraps his face in the scarf and sits into the seat of his machine. With a few long breaths, he pedals it forward. It promptly falls over the edge. The man is hurled through the leather wings like some sort of screaming bat. He spins through the device as it explodes down the rockwall in a torrent of wood and poor design. A moment later, you hear the faint din of his final landing spots. Spectacular! | The man pushes his machine off the edge, hopping into its seat at the last moment. They both tip over the precipice and there's a brief scream. But, against all odds, the man quickly reappears! His contraption flutters from side to side like some drunken butterfly, but he's in the air nonetheless.%SPEECH_ON%I did it, by the gods I did it! Look at me...%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly, a shrieking falcon spears through one of his wings. The bird loops around for another strike, tearing apart the other wing. You wave your hands and try to scare the killer bird away.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, hey!%SPEECH_OFF%The machine totters and slowly starts to lose altitude. With the man pedaling harder to compensate, the spokes begin to break and a moment later the whole thing busts apart and you can only watch as the haggard scientist plummets to his doom. The falcon simply squats on the cliff face and watches its enemy die.}
f4800cca1aa419f67274.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]{你退到一旁，让那人起飞。他用围巾裹住脸，坐进机器的座位，深吸几口气，蹬着踏板向前。机器立即掉下了悬崖。那人像只尖叫的蝙蝠，从皮革翅膀间被甩了出去，又在装置中翻滚。木头与拙劣的设计一道沿岩壁崩散，轰然坠落。片刻后，几处轻微的撞击声传来，是他最后落地的动静。真壮观！ | 那人把机器推向崖外，最后一刻跳进座位。人与机器一同翻下峭壁，传来一声短促的尖叫。可出乎意料，他竟很快又升了回来！那装置像喝醉的蝴蝶般左右扑腾，但无论如何，他飞起来了。%SPEECH_ON%我成功了！诸神在上，我成功了！看我……%SPEECH_OFF%突然，一只猎隼尖啸着穿透他的一侧翅膀，又盘旋回来，撕裂了另一侧。你挥动双手，想赶走这只要命的鸟。%SPEECH_ON%嘿！嘿！%SPEECH_OFF%机器摇摇欲坠，开始缓缓失去高度。那人拼命蹬踏，试图补救，辐条却纷纷折断，转眼间整架机器四分五裂。你只能眼看着那位憔悴的学者坠向死地。猎隼则落在崖壁上，静静看着敌人死去。}

48de791b6e850794b79b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]{Against better judgment, you let the man fly. He bundles his face in the scarf as though that'll save him of the soon to come hard landing. With a deep breath, he pushes his contraption off the edge and leaps in at the last moment as though he were joining his lover in a romantic suicide. The man and machine quickly disappear. You start to laugh when suddenly the man reappears. He's furiously pedaling his machine, the wings flapping hard. He sails around, looping this way and that, slowly getting higher and higher.%SPEECH_ON%I did it! By the gods, I did it! Look at how high I can go!%SPEECH_OFF%He shoots upward into the clouds, the rickety din of its wooden spokes whining away.%SPEECH_ON%Ohh, ohhhhh!%SPEECH_OFF%That's the last you see or hear of him. | The man pushes the machine off the edge and hops into the seat just as it totters over the edge. Screaming, the man climbs back up the contraption as it falls away. He leaps off the last tip of its poorly constructed wooden frame, propelling himself back to the precipice where he hangs on for dear life. You sprint over and drag him back up. His machine smashes into the ground far below, a soft din of predetermined destruction. Brushing himself off, the man nods at you.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you sir. I had a moment of clarity. What does a bird do? It doesn't take off from great heights, it takes off wherever it pleases! I shall rework the project!
