Thank you for saving my life, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%The way you see it, that went as well as it could have. The men are mightily entertained anyway.}
48de791b6e850794b79b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_42.png[/img]{尽管理智劝你阻止，你还是让那人试飞。他用围巾裹紧脸，仿佛这样就能躲过即将到来的重重一摔。深吸一口气，他将装置推向崖外，最后一刻纵身跃入，像是追随爱人，去赴一场浪漫的殉情。人与机器很快消失。你刚要笑出声，那人忽然又升了回来。他拼命蹬踏，双翼奋力拍动，盘旋来回，越飞越高。%SPEECH_ON%我成功了！诸神在上，我成功了！看我能飞多高！%SPEECH_OFF%他直冲云端，木辐条摇摇欲坠的吱呀声渐渐远去。%SPEECH_ON%噢，噢——！%SPEECH_OFF%那是你最后一次见到他，也最后一次听到他的声音。 | 那人把机器推下悬崖，刚摇晃着越过边缘，便跳进座位。装置下坠时，他尖叫着攀回顶端，借着那粗劣木架最后一截支撑，奋力跳回崖边，死死扒住。你冲过去，把他拖了上来。远远下方，机器砸向地面，传来一阵轻响，仿佛它的毁灭早已注定。男人拍掉尘土，朝你点头。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，先生。我忽然想明白了。鸟是怎么飞的？它们可不是非得从高处起飞，而是想从哪儿飞，就从哪儿飞！我要重新设计！谢谢你救我一命，先生。%SPEECH_OFF%依你看，这已是最好的结果。无论如何，弟兄们都看得乐不可支。}

a670ee1d49301e9d3841.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]While counting inventory, %sellsword% joins your side, mindlessly picking at this sword or that shield. You set your quill pen down and ask him what's up for he sure as shit isn't here to count anything. He explains that another company wishes to use his swordhand - and they're willing to pay more. You ask how much and he holds up his hands to count.%SPEECH_ON%They're talking %newpay% crowns a day.%SPEECH_OFF%He's earning %pay% crowns a day with you.
a670ee1d49301e9d3841.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你正清点物资，%sellsword%走到身边，漫不经心地拨弄着这把剑、那面盾。你放下羽毛笔，问他有何事，反正他肯定不是来帮忙点数的。他解释，另一个战团想请他效力，而且愿意多付钱。你问多少，他举起双手数了数。%SPEECH_ON%他们说，每天%newpay%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%而他在你这里，每天拿%pay%克朗。

6038d26698e16b3331ec.source: I see, time to part ways then.

9c05cdb61cc8dc274e67.source: There must be a way I can talk you out of this.

6b11843600bbe1289f4a.source: Then I shall match their offer.

b2816f03f09f55eff86f.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] You turn around, crossing your arms and jacking a boot against a crate. Staring out across the land, you tell %sellsword% that the company has been through a lot together and everyone, yourself especially, would hate to see him go. He has a second family here with the the %companyname% and that's a rare treat in the mercenary world. Where he's going there is no guarantee of what he may find. You know, because you've been there. You've been in his very shoes, and you took those shoes and walked. And regretted it.

The sellsword looks at the ground, thinking your words over. Finally he nods and agrees to stay. You tell him he's made the right choice. The man turns and taps a quiver of arrows as he walks away.%SPEECH_ON%Might want to refill that.%SPEECH_OFF%
b2816f03f09f55eff86f.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] 你转过身，抱起双臂，将一只靴子抵在箱上，望向远处大地。你告诉%sellsword%，战团一同熬过这么多事，谁也不愿看他离开，尤其是你。他在%companyname%已经有了第二个家，这在佣兵行当里何其难得。到了别处会遇上什么，却没人能保证。你知道，因为你也曾面临同样的抉择。当时你一走了之，后来却后悔了。

佣兵低头思索着你的话，终于点头答应留下。你告诉他，这是正确的选择。他转身走开时，拍了拍一只箭袋。%SPEECH_ON%这儿该添点箭了。%SPEECH_OFF%

9ddeb81cb318e0319075.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img] You turn around, crossing your arms and jacking a boot against a crate. Staring out across the land, you tell %sellsword% that the company has been through a lot together and everyone, yourself especially, would hate to see him go. He has a second family here with the %companyname% and that's a rare treat in the mercenary world. Where he's going there is no guarantee of what he may find. You know, because you've been there. You've been in his very shoes, and you took those shoes and walked. And regretted it.

 The sellsword looks at the ground, thinking your words over. Finally he shakes his head and purses his lips with a look of 'sorry'. You tell him he's making the wrong choice, but he's having none of it. The man turns and taps a quiver of arrows as he walks away.%SPEECH_ON%Might want to refill that.%SPEECH_OFF%The arrows are a little low, but all you can think about is figuring out how to replace a good swordhand such as he.
9ddeb81cb318e0319075.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img] 你转过身，抱起双臂，把一只靴子支在木箱上。望着远方，你告诉%sellsword%，战团一同经历了那么多事，所有人都舍不得他走，尤其是你。在%companyname%，他拥有第二个家，而这在佣兵的世界里实属难得。至于他将要去的地方，谁也无法保证等待他的是什么。你之所以清楚，是因为自己也经历过。你曾经面临与他一模一样的选择，最终迈步离开，然后后悔了。

 佣兵低头看着地面，琢磨你的话。最终，他还是摇了摇头，抿着嘴，满脸歉意。你告诉他，这是个错误的选择，但他已听不进去。男人转身离开，顺手拍了拍一筒箭。%SPEECH_ON%该补些箭了。%SPEECH_OFF%箭确实不多了，可你满脑子想的，都是上哪儿再找一个像他这样的好手。

d0edf75103270083067a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img] You sigh. The man nods and starts to leave, but you stop him. You'll pay the amount so he can stay. The %companyname% simply cannot afford to lose a man like him.
d0edf75103270083067a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_04.png[/img]你叹了口气。那人点头，正要离开，你却叫住了他。你愿意照那个价付，只要他留下。%companyname%实在损失不起这样的好手。

36ab50b5bd39ec2fbb08.source: A good man doesn't come cheap.

b39d629487f0cadf9558.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]The raider, %raider%, is sharpening his weapon beside the campfire. He tells stories of his days raiding coasts and making off with piles of loot, his crooked smile grinning in the blade's sharpened sheen. %sellsword% the sellsword listens for a time then gets up laughing.%SPEECH_ON%Oh, fella, them quite the stories you tell. Here's mine: I earned my keep killing men, whether in their homes or in battle, but men nonetheless. You run about in yer boats, waitin' for the menfolk to be gone, then ya scamper across the beaches to kick the little lads, rape the lasses, and steal from old friars. You got nothing to boast of, raider.%SPEECH_OFF%%raider% lowers his blade.%SPEECH_ON%We islanders at least have honor amongst us, whereas you'd stab the %companyname% in the back for an extra crown in your purse. Speak ill of my past again, sellsword, and I'll have that mouth of yours gnawing dirt.%SPEECH_OFF%An exchange of fightin' words leads to just that: a fight. Blades flash and blood is spilled. The rest of the company jumps in before too much damage can be done.
b39d629487f0cadf9558.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]劫掠者%raider%正坐在营火旁磨刀，讲着从前袭掠海岸、满载战利品而归的故事，锋利的刀面映出他歪斜的笑容。佣兵%sellsword%听了一会儿，笑着站起身。%SPEECH_ON%噢，伙计，故事讲得真不赖。听听我的：我靠杀男人吃饭，不管在他们家里，还是在战场上，杀的终究都是男人。你们呢，坐着小船四处转，专等男人不在，才蹿上海滩，踢小男孩，强奸姑娘，抢老修士的东西。劫掠者，你有什么可吹的？%SPEECH_OFF%%raider%放下刀。%SPEECH_ON%我们岛民之间至少还讲荣誉，你却会为钱袋里多添一枚克朗，就在%companyname%背后捅刀子。再敢诋毁我的过去，佣兵，我就让你这张嘴啃个满口泥。%SPEECH_OFF%狠话说着说着，便真成了一场恶斗。刀光闪动，鲜血飞溅。其余弟兄赶紧冲上前，在伤势变得更严重前将两人拉开。

a25132aa9ae92e633b43.source: I don't give a rat's ass where you came from, stop fighting.
a25132aa9ae92e633b43.translation: 老子才不管你们从哪儿来，别打了。

758e16cc00aa197193f5.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]While marching along, a lone merchant with his packhorse emerges onto your path. He has his arms out and his hands visible.%SPEECH_ON%Evening, travelers. Might I interest you in some wares?%SPEECH_OFF%He lists off a number of things the %companyname% could possibly have no use for, but then he mentions a map. You must've raised an eyebrow, because he raises his and a smile with it.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, interested in a map are ya? This here cartographical, topographical, geographical oddity carried by a man who, I assure you, is quite sensical! This here paper tells you the exact location of the famous '%location%'. I'm sure you've heard about it, yes? Host to untold treasures! Resting place of some this world's finest arms! And all it'll cost you is a meager %mapcost% crowns!%SPEECH_OFF%He turns his head with a long grin. It appears he's sold some of his teeth in his days on the road.%SPEECH_ON%So, travelers, what you got to say to that?%SPEECH_OFF%
758e16cc00aa197193f5.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]行军途中，一个独行商人牵着驮马走到你们面前。他张开双臂，双手摊在明处。%SPEECH_ON%晚上好，各位旅人。要不要看看我的货？%SPEECH_OFF%他报出一串货物，%companyname%多半一样也用不上，随后却提到了一张地图。你大概挑了挑眉，因为他也跟着扬起眉毛，露出笑容。%SPEECH_ON%啊，对地图有兴趣？这可是制图学、地形学、地理学的奇珍，拿着它的人却绝不古怪，这点我向你保证！这张纸能告诉你，鼎鼎大名的“%location%”究竟在哪。你一定听说过吧？那里藏着数不尽的财宝！还埋藏着世间最精良的兵器！而你只需花区区%mapcost%克朗！%SPEECH_OFF%他歪过头，咧嘴长笑。看起来，在那些沿途讨生活的日子里，他还卖掉过几颗牙。%SPEECH_ON%那么，各位旅人，意下如何？%SPEECH_OFF%

026a94249ede33457e0d.source: I'm intrigued, we'll buy the map.

dac1bf02eca472d62f28.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]Having acquired the map, you take a good long look at it. You take out your own map and start looking between the two. There's nothing on the purchased map that can be cross-referenced. In fact, the map you bought has strange runes scribbled at the edges. It's either a recent fake, or it originated in a time when the common tongue was not your own. Either way, it seems very unusable.

 Just as you get ready to ball it up and throw it away, %historian% the historian walks up and gently takes it. He looks at the runes and begins nodding, running his finger along the edges before drawing them further inward, amongst the map's poorly drawn mountains and rivers and forests.%SPEECH_ON%Hmmm... Oh... Ah yes, I've read of this place before. And I know these runes, though I dare not speak them aloud.%SPEECH_OFF%He takes the company map and uses three quill pens pinched between his fingers to slowly triangulate and translate the directions. Finished, he nods and whacks the back of his hand against the company map.%SPEECH_ON%There, sir. That's where we'll find it.%SPEECH_OFF%
dac1bf02eca472d62f28.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]地图到手后，你仔细看了许久，又取出自己的地图，来回比对。买来的这张图上，竟没有一处能相互印证。事实上，它的边缘还潦草写着奇怪的符文。要么是刚做出来的假货，要么出自一个通用语尚与你们不同的年代。无论哪种，似乎都派不上用场。

 正当你准备把它揉成团丢掉时，历史学者%historian%走来，轻轻接了过去。他看着符文，开始点头，手指沿着边缘划过，又向内移入那些画得粗劣的山川、河流和森林之间。%SPEECH_ON%嗯……噢……啊，对，我以前读到过这个地方。这些符文我也认得，只是不敢念出声。%SPEECH_OFF%他拿来战团的地图，指间夹着三支羽毛笔，慢慢用三角定位法比对，将方位换算过去。做完后，他点点头，用手背拍了拍战团的地图。%SPEECH_ON%长官，就在这里。我们要找的地方。%SPEECH_OFF%

105a737b511692b8ded1.source: Good to have someone with your skills with us.
105a737b511692b8ded1.translation: 有你这样的能人跟着，真不错。

a622ce398d7dc8a7ed30.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]You take the map and give it a good read. You can identify some of the locations and, in time, translate its contents onto your own map. The %companyname% is murmuring with excitement over what might be there.
a622ce398d7dc8a7ed30.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]你拿过地图，仔细研究。上面有些地点认得出来，花点工夫，便把其中的信息转绘到自己的地图上。%companyname%的弟兄们兴奋地低声议论，猜测那里会有什么。

8b79c1f68fbf98450dee.source: Let's claim it for the company!

fa6bde7296bd1e8b3f27.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]You look at the map, you stare at it, you practically interrogate it with a long, long gaze. But you're just not seeing it. %randombrother% takes a look then shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I don't recognize a bit of it, sir.%SPEECH_OFF%It's a fake or a map to a land you do not recognize as your own - either way, it's completely useless.
fa6bde7296bd1e8b3f27.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]你看着地图，盯着地图，几乎要用长久的目光把它审出供词，可还是看不出所以然。%randombrother%瞧了一眼，摇头。%SPEECH_ON%团长，一处也认不出来。%SPEECH_OFF%这不是假图，就是画着某片你从未见过的土地。无论哪种，都毫无用处。

f66b5d2ef8f58c71d323.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]%peddler% the peddler steps forward, his hands out just like the traveling merchant's had been. Apparently this is a common tactic amongst honest thieves.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, sir, please. Come on. That price is outrageous.%SPEECH_OFF%The merchant's face sours.%SPEECH_ON%There is nothing outrageous about it, I promise you.%SPEECH_OFF%But your peddler persists.%SPEECH_ON%Clearly there is something outrageous, because I just said so, did I not?%SPEECH_OFF%The merchant nods. The peddler continues.%SPEECH_ON%So we've decided to not purchase it at your original asking price. That much is clear. So, friend, I think we will purchase it for %newcost%. That is fair to all parties involved, and surely a fine businessman such as yourself can see a deal! We're hardly businessmen ourselves, but we know that's a good deal!%SPEECH_OFF%The merchant scratches his chin, then nods.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, that price is fair.%SPEECH_OFF%
f66b5d2ef8f58c71d323.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]小贩%peddler%走上前，像刚才那个行商一样摊开双手。看来，这是一群正经骗子惯用的招数。%SPEECH_ON%先生，先生，得了吧。你这价钱也太离谱了。%SPEECH_OFF%行商沉下脸。%SPEECH_ON%我向你保证，这价钱一点也不离谱。%SPEECH_OFF%你的小贩却不依不饶。%SPEECH_ON%显然就是离谱，毕竟我刚才已经这么说了，不是吗？%SPEECH_OFF%行商点了点头。小贩接着说。%SPEECH_ON%所以，我们已经决定，不按你原先的开价买。这一点很清楚。那么，朋友，我看我们出%newcost%买下它吧。这个价钱对双方都公平，像你这么精明的生意人，肯定看得出这是笔好买卖！我们算不上什么生意人，可连我们都知道这买卖划算！%SPEECH_OFF%行商挠了挠下巴，随后点头。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，这价钱还算公道。%SPEECH_OFF%

0daf5c5905fd4bf3d3cb.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]While you're talking to the merchant, %thief% the thief sidles up next to you, appearing rather interested in the conversation. He glances at you. You do a double take. He grins and nods. You quickly eye the salesman then glance back at the thief and nod. The merchant is in the middle of his sales pitch and sees none of this. He keeps talking, but you hear little of it. You just know to keep nodding for a merchant such as he only tells you things you want to hear anyway.

 The thief slips around the back and drops a weapon into the mud.%SPEECH_ON%Clumsy me.%SPEECH_OFF%He bends down, pauses, there's a motion you can hardly detect, and then he's upright again. He gives you a wink. You tell the merchant you appreciate the offer, but you'll have to pass. When he's gone, %thief% presents you with the map and grins.%SPEECH_ON%They say the best things in life are free.%SPEECH_OFF%
0daf5c5905fd4bf3d3cb.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]你正与商人交谈，小偷%thief%悄悄凑到身边，对话题似乎颇感兴趣。他瞥你一眼，你又看了他一眼。他咧嘴笑着点头，你迅速扫过商人，再回望小偷，也点了点头。商人正忙着推销，丝毫没察觉。他继续滔滔不绝，你却没听进多少，只知道跟着点头就行——这类商人，说的反正都是你爱听的话。

 小偷绕到后面，失手似的将一件武器掉进泥里。%SPEECH_ON%瞧我这笨手笨脚的。%SPEECH_OFF%他弯腰，稍稍停顿，做了一个几乎看不出的动作，便又站直，朝你眨眨眼。你向商人道谢，说好意心领，买卖就免了。等他走远，%thief%拿出地图，咧嘴笑道。%SPEECH_ON%人家都说，世上最好的东西不用花钱。%SPEECH_OFF%

3f04c4defe92da7c57f5.source: Now that's what I call a discount.

b9082a629b6750b33119.source: %peddler%, you used to be a peddler. Get us a better deal!
b9082a629b6750b33119.translation: %peddler%，你以前干过小贩，替我们把价压下来！

6347d790ebb2394523f2.source: %thief%, you used to be a thief. Get us that map!
6347d790ebb2394523f2.translation: %thief%，你以前做过贼，把地图弄到手！

d8824a6df620645d1d7a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%ratcatcher% and %shepherd% are sitting beside the campfire. As their conversation carries on, the ratcatcher becomes a bit confused.%SPEECH_ON%Lemme, lemme, lemme get this straight. Y-you use a stick, and so they follow because you have the stick? It's all about the stick?%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, the shepherd explains.%SPEECH_ON%I prefer to call it a staff, but yes. Sheep are simple creatures and all that they demand is a leader. The staff is an itemization of my role. I wield the staff, therefore I am the leader. At least in a little sheep's eyes. An obedient dog helps a lot, too. Truthfully, a dog would be the true leader did they not have the loyalty and honor we wished we had ourselves.%SPEECH_OFF%%ratcatcher% nods.%SPEECH_ON%I'll have to try the stick, I mean staff, with my rats. And get a dog, too.%SPEECH_OFF%The shepherd smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Or a cat. What? I'm joking, friend, just joking.%SPEECH_OFF%
d8824a6df620645d1d7a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]%ratcatcher%和%shepherd%坐在营火旁。聊着聊着，捕鼠人有些糊涂了。%SPEECH_ON%让、让、让我捋一捋。你拿着一根棍子，所以它们就跟着你？就因为你有那根棍子？关键全在棍子上？%SPEECH_OFF%牧羊人点点头，解释道。%SPEECH_ON%我更愿意叫它牧杖，不过，没错。羊是很简单的动物，只需要一个领头的。牧杖就是我身份的象征。我拿着牧杖，所以我就是头领。至少在小羊眼里是这样。有条听话的狗，也能帮上大忙。说实话，要不是狗有着连我们都自愧不如的忠诚和荣誉，真正的头领就该是它们了。%SPEECH_OFF%%ratcatcher%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我得拿棍子——我是说牧杖——去对我的老鼠试试。再弄条狗。%SPEECH_OFF%牧羊人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%也可以弄只猫。怎么了？朋友，开个玩笑，开个玩笑而已。%SPEECH_OFF%

2d15d0a3de74a6b288b0.source: Like peas in a pod. Or pigs in a pen?
2d15d0a3de74a6b288b0.translation: 亲如同荚的豆子。还是同圈的猪？

d174ec3e76b72fddd467.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] A hint of murmuring grows louder and louder until you can no longer focus. You put your quill pen down with the sort of energy the ink bottle can take without breaking and step out of your tent. %archer1% and %archer2% are standing there bickering over who is the better shot. Seeing you, they waste little time asking if they can hold a shooting contest to decide who is right.
d174ec3e76b72fddd467.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]窃窃私语越来越响，终于吵得你无法专心。你重重搁下羽毛笔，力道刚好没让墨水瓶遭殃，随后走出帐篷。%archer1%与%archer2%正在外头争论谁射得更准。一看见你，两人立刻请求办场射术比试，分个高下。

4498ccfb0cc9e23ff93b.source: We can't afford to waste the arrows.

2f8b4d91f25e2ed5d677.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img] You throw your hands up and tell the men to do what they must before retiring back to your tent. Outside comes the twang of released arrows quickly followed by the thwap of them finding their targets. Again and again. The din of men grows louder as what you can only assume what is a throng of observers grows. Finally, the contest is at some sort of end - indicated by a refreshing silence - and you get back to work.
2f8b4d91f25e2ed5d677.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]你双手一摊，让他们爱怎么比就怎么比，随后回了帐篷。外头先是弓弦轻响，紧跟着箭矢中靶的闷声，一次又一次。人声越来越喧闹，想必围观的人也越来越多。终于，比试以某种结果结束了——周围一下清静下来，便是最好的证明——你总算能继续干活。

b5774d26939023605cfc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]Feeling as though their arguments will never end, you give them the go-ahead to have their little competition before retiring back to your tent. Soon thereafter you hear the arrows nocking, releasing, and finding targets. Things which go 'thwang' soon go 'thwap' and the air is slowly filled with the din of a watching crowd. As you try to focus, you notice that the men have been shooting fervently for quite some time now. You step back out of your tent to find the two archers bickering some more, each one pointing a finger at the other before picking up an arrow and angrily launching it downrange. Their targets aren't even targets anymore, but small bushes of arrow shafts upon which break every other shot that lands upon them.

Shaking your head, you order the two men to stop at once before they use up every last arrow the company has.
b5774d26939023605cfc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img]你觉得他们再争下去也没个完，便准许比上一场，自己回帐篷去。没多久，搭箭、放弦、命中靶子的声音接连传来，先是“崩”，后是“笃”，围观的喧闹也渐渐响起。你正努力集中精神，忽然发现，他们已经如此热火朝天地射了好一阵。走出帐篷，只见两个弓手仍在斗嘴，指着对方骂几句，又抓起箭，气冲冲地朝靶场射去。那些东西已不能叫靶子，简直成了箭杆堆出的灌木丛，后射来的箭撞在上头，隔三差五就折断一支。

你摇着头，命令两人立刻停手，免得把战团的箭全耗个精光。

7ab761ba1505f5672463.source: Can't leave you men alone for two seconds!
7ab761ba1505f5672463.translation: 才两秒钟不盯着，你们就惹事！

85fb40362bf760772ccd.source: You shake your head no for supplies are far too low to enage in such behavior. The men sigh and walk away, continuing to argue with one another long and loud into the distance.
85fb40362bf760772ccd.translation: 物资实在不够拿来这么消耗，你摇头拒绝。弟兄们叹气走开，仍一路高声争论，吵到远处都听得见。

5ddc920dad04e010b9b5.source: There are more important things to do.

3d1f47565173fde558b2.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img] You take a good, long look at the men, a gaze that flickers from one to the other and then back again, all the while shaking your head. %shortsightedtarget% is holding his head, a rather large lump cresting at the hairline. He looks at %shortsighted% then to you. Both men shrug. You ask %shortsighted% what happened. He explains.%SPEECH_ON%Thought I saw somethin' that wasn't there.%SPEECH_OFF%Incredulously, %shortsightedtarget% throws his hand out.%SPEECH_ON%I said, 'Hey, it's me' and you clocked me anyway.%SPEECH_OFF%Throwing out his own hands, %shortsighted% defends himself.%SPEECH_ON%'Hey it's me' aren't words beholden to ya! Any man can say them words! I reckon any man of ill-will would say them very words before he followed them with a sword, I bet he would!%SPEECH_OFF%It appears that %shortsighted%'s poor eyesight has led to something of an accident.
3d1f47565173fde558b2.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img] 你久久打量着两人，目光来回移动，不停摇头。%shortsightedtarget%捂着脑袋，发际边高高肿起一个包。他看看%shortsighted%，又看看你，两人都耸了耸肩。你问%shortsighted%出了什么事，他解释道。%SPEECH_ON%以为看见了什么，其实没有。%SPEECH_OFF%%shortsightedtarget%难以置信地摊开手。%SPEECH_ON%我都喊“喂，是我”了，你还是给了我一下。%SPEECH_OFF%%shortsighted%也摊手辩解。%SPEECH_ON%“喂，是我”又不是你专用的话！谁都能这么说！真有歹人，肯定也先这么喊一句，再一剑捅过来，我敢打赌！%SPEECH_OFF%看来，%shortsighted%那糟糕的视力又惹出了意外。

b8c271670eddde335f58.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img] {The swamp clutches at your every step, so wanting you to stay it is. While your boots sink into the mire, %someguy% turns and suddenly heaves, adding his breakfast to the bog. You turn to see another brother in the distance double over, loosing from his mouth a great spew that has you choking back some vomit yourself. The %companyname% express their collective discomfort as more men wretch and gag. This truly is no place for man to be. | While teeming with disgusting forms of life, the swamp actually smells of noxious death. Seemingly toxic steam undulates off the bog's still currents. It burns your eyes and throat and poisons all your foods with ill-tastes. What foul things would dare live here? You see toads and snakes and critters that certainly had the devil's touch in their birthing. The %companyname% are uniformly falling sick in this damned place. Only the strong may have the gut to bear it, everyone else is already heaving and seeing things which are not there.}
b8c271670eddde335f58.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_09.png[/img] {你每迈出一步，沼泽都死死拽住不放，仿佛非要把你留下。靴子正往烂泥里陷，%someguy%忽然转过身，猛地一呕，把早饭全倒进了泥沼。你回头，又看见远处一个弟兄弯下腰，张嘴喷出一大摊秽物，看得你也直犯恶心，差点没忍住。越来越多的人干呕、作呕，%companyname%的抱怨声响成一片。这里实在不是人该待的地方。 | 沼泽里明明挤满了令人作呕的活物，闻起来却尽是死亡的恶臭。看似有毒的水汽在几乎静止的泥水上翻涌，刺痛你的眼睛和喉咙，也让所有食物染上怪味。究竟是什么污秽之物，才敢在这里生活？你看见蟾蜍、蛇，还有些小东西，仿佛出生时就遭过魔鬼的摆弄。%companyname%的弟兄们在这个鬼地方接连病倒。也许只有最强壮的人肠胃才受得住，其他人早已吐得天昏地暗，眼前还出现了本不存在的幻象。}

083d49a56abb8b4b5434.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_08.png[/img] Your breath appears before you as though it were carried in purses of grey. It started slowly, this pain. Spits of snow. Winds that had come from ancient glaciers. One step sank your foot deep into the white powder and it was then you knew the rest of the journey would be a test of endurance.

You wonder how the men of old did it, living in these parts. They sat around campfires with all the world out to get them. Sat in the darkness surrounded by flurries of ice. Sat in isolation. They were born here, that must have been their trick. Ignorance was their warmth. Only a man who knows no better could live in a place such as this.

The men of the %companyname% stagger and fall and don't get back up with quite the speed they used to. A few have taken to coughing fits and others look about ready to succumb to exhaustion. Only the strongest of the bunch carry on with no problem. It is those men who surely share a link with the ancestors of this horrid land.
083d49a56abb8b4b5434.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_08.png[/img] 你呼出的气在眼前结成一团团灰白雾气。这份苦楚起初来得很慢：零星的雪花，来自古老冰川的寒风。直到有一步，你的脚深深陷进白雪里，你才知道，余下的路程都将是一场耐力的考验。

你想不明白，古人究竟如何在这种地方生活。他们围坐营火，仿佛整个世界都与他们为敌；他们坐在黑暗里，四周尽是纷飞的冰雪；他们孤独地坐着。他们生在这里，一定是这个缘故。不知别处是什么模样，便成了他们取暖的办法。只有不知道世上还有更好日子的人，才能在这样的地方活下去。

%companyname%的弟兄们踉跄跌倒，爬起来的速度已远不如从前。有人咳嗽不止，有人眼看就要被疲惫压垮。只有其中最强壮的几人仍能照常赶路。想必这些人，与这片可怕土地上的先民流着相似的血。

2c364da9862f30c933f9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] %spartan% has always been a bit tight with how much he eats. You're not sure if it's part of some religious rite, a sense of duty, or he's just not a big eater. Regardless, the lack of food has weakened the man and you find him barely able to sit upright on a log. You've got a bowl of meat and corn in hand, wondering if maybe you should offer it to him.
2c364da9862f30c933f9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%spartan%吃东西一向很克制。你不清楚这是宗教习俗、责任感，还是单纯饭量小。总之，吃得不足已让他虚弱不堪，如今连在原木上坐直都费劲。你手里端着一碗肉和玉米，琢磨着是不是该给他。

30426fbbe05596978c51.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] You decide that the man has probably been through this before and decide to leave him be. A few moments later, you catch him walking and talking just fine. In fact, he gets around pretty well for a man who eats so lightly!
30426fbbe05596978c51.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你觉得他大概早经历过这种情况，便决定随他。不久后，你发现他走路、说话都好端端的。说实话，一个吃得这么少的人，行动竟还颇为利索！

0a0039e46a4f0a0f3f5d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] The man's done this before, he can do it again. You turn around to go eat your meal elsewhere, only to hear the man crumple to the ground. He's completely passed out and appears to have hit his head on the way down.
0a0039e46a4f0a0f3f5d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]他以前也这么熬过，这次想必一样。你转身准备去别处吃饭，却听见他瘫倒在地。他彻底昏了过去，倒下时似乎还撞到了头。

af3ce39401c495c3621f.source: What in the seven hells is wrong with you?

84d49e4e92a832e6079c.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] You order the man to eat. He resists, but you remind him that it is an 'order', not a request. The sellsword does as told, eating rather gingerly from your bowl. He complains that he does not wish to eat anymore, but you order him to finish the meal. In time, whatever ailed him seems lifted. Energy returns to his eyes and he gets up with a good spring in his step. Unfortunately, he does not care for being told to break his personal codes.
84d49e4e92a832e6079c.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你命令他吃饭。他试图抗拒，你提醒他，这是命令，不是请求。佣兵照做，小心翼翼地吃着你碗里的东西。他抱怨不想再吃，你却勒令吃完。慢慢地，那股不适似乎退了，眼里恢复神采，起身时脚步也轻快起来。可惜，他并不喜欢被迫违背自己的准则。

4f8d3d3db5a66c34d396.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] Ordering the man to eat, the man does as told. At first, he seems rather reluctant, but after a few bites he dives into the bowl, engorging himself in juices and flecks of corn dot his cheeks. He is almost mad with delight. You've reminded him of just how good food can be. Personally, you thought the meat was a little overcooked.
4f8d3d3db5a66c34d396.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你命令他吃饭，他照做了。起初还不大情愿，可几口之后便一头埋进碗里，狼吞虎咽，满嘴肉汁，脸颊沾着玉米粒，几乎高兴得发狂。你让他重新想起，食物原来如此美味。至于你自己，倒觉得肉有点煮老了。

ced8c965262f403d5425.source: Forced to eat against his beliefs

705b6bff9127838ac079.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{%randombrother% grumbles.%SPEECH_ON%Giving up is not the way of this company, or at least I didn't think it was.%SPEECH_OFF%The men have been moping about today, cursing loudly about nothing and muttering into their drink. They are unhappy about the company not achieving the goal everyone agreed on.%SPEECH_ON%Certainly we could chase this task we set ourselves across the world and back, just as we could spend our days chasing butterflies, but if it cannot be done let's put this misfortune behind us and move on to what we do best: fighting, drinking, and spending our hard-earned coin!%SPEECH_OFF%%highestexperience_brother% encourages his brothers-in-arms. These words placate the men somewhat and you are relieved not to have a revolt on your hands. | As you walk around the tents of the camp, %randombrother% approaches to complain.%SPEECH_ON%I seem to recall signing up with a band of merciless fighting men. Men who let nothing stand in their path. Now the %companyname% feels more like a squad of tired children than an unstoppable force.%SPEECH_OFF%He pauses, bites his lips.%SPEECH_ON%Captain, sir, I mean.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and continue on your way. Clearly, the man is upset about the company's inability to fulfill the goal you announced to the men not long ago. | Despite your best efforts, you failed in fulfilling your latest ambition on the company's path to greatness. Worse, the men are all keenly aware of it, and seem more put out by this failure than you are. Feet are dragging, heads hanging, and griping and discontent louder than usual.

Still, the sun rises just the same, and to worry over one's failures is to waste time better spent on new opportunities. You know that the men of the %companyname% will ride out this setback and march on to greater glories. Or die in the attempt. | After much striving and effort, you are finally forced to give up on the ambition you chose for the %companyname% to pursue. A mercenary company must face many setbacks on the road to greatness, but this latest failure to follow through has been especially bitter for the men. It would be wise to secure a lucrative contract or provide some other distraction, perhaps the threat of imminent death, to distract them from their unhappiness. | After you tell the men that the company isn't going to be able to do what you so proudly announced it would accomplish, the men grow standoffish and moody. Like sulky children they turn away when you come near and whisper their complaints whenever your back is turned.%SPEECH_ON%How are we ever going to be famous if we don't finish what we started? I want to be known wherever we go, and have our drinks poured before we walk in the door.%SPEECH_OFF%}
705b6bff9127838ac079.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{%randombrother%抱怨道。%SPEECH_ON%放弃可不是我们战团的作风，至少，我原本不这么认为。%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们今天都闷闷不乐，无缘无故大声咒骂，对着酒杯低声嘀咕。大家一致定下的目标，战团却没能达成，这让他们十分不满。%SPEECH_ON%当然，我们可以追着自己定的差事，绕世界一圈再回来，也可以整天追蝴蝶。可既然办不到，就把这次倒霉事抛在身后，继续干最拿手的：打仗、喝酒，再把辛苦挣来的钱花出去！%SPEECH_OFF%%highestexperience_brother%鼓励着战友。这些话多少安抚了众人，你也松了口气，庆幸没闹成叛变。 | 你在营帐间巡视，%randombrother%走来抱怨。%SPEECH_ON%我记得，自己加入的是一群绝不手软的战士，什么都挡不住他们。可如今的%companyname%，更像一群疲惫小孩，哪还有势不可挡的样子。%SPEECH_OFF%他停下，咬了咬嘴唇。%SPEECH_ON%团长，长官，我是说。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，继续往前走。显然，战团没能实现你不久前宣布的目标，让他十分不快。 | 尽管已竭尽所能，你仍没能在战团通往伟业的道路上，实现最近立下的志向。更糟的是，弟兄们全都清楚，而且似乎比你还沮丧。脚步拖沓，脑袋低垂，抱怨与不满也比平日更响。

可太阳照常升起，纠缠失败，只会浪费本可把握新机会的时间。你知道，%companyname%的弟兄们会渡过这次挫折，继续迈向更大的荣耀，或死在追寻荣耀的途中。 | 努力奋斗许久，你终于被迫放弃为%companyname%选定的志向。佣兵战团通往伟业的路上，少不了挫折，可这次未能善始善终，尤其让弟兄们难以接受。最好找份报酬丰厚的委托，或者别的什么来转移注意，比如迫在眉睫的死亡威胁，好让他们暂且忘掉不快。 | 你告诉弟兄们，战团无法完成自己曾自豪宣布的目标后，众人变得冷淡而阴郁，像闹别扭的孩子。你一靠近，他们就转身；你一背过去，他们就低声抱怨。%SPEECH_ON%做事总是半途而废，我们怎么扬名？我想走到哪儿都有人认得，还没进门，酒就给倒好了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

3a38c82bf513b5261365.source: {Not everything goes as planned. | Oh well. | The men will understand. | This won't stop the %companyname%. | The important thing is that we're moving forward. | New challenges await.}
3a38c82bf513b5261365.translation: {世事并非总能如愿。 | 罢了。 | 弟兄们会理解的。 | 这拦不住%companyname%。 | 要紧的是，我们仍在前进。 | 还有新的挑战在等着。}

e396045cfab4d429877e.source: You went above and beyond in fulfilling the Oath
e396045cfab4d429877e.translation: 你履行誓言时超额达成了目标

3b7a1fdbc0e51079025d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{The past few days have been spent mulling over which of Young Anselm's beloved Oaths to take on. You feel it in your blood and bones that the right choice is... | Days have come and gone, and in the nights you have mostly sat alone, pondering. But you're not always alone. In moments of introspection the Oathtaker Young Anselm arrives, handing you purpose and duty, and this past evening he made it clear to you that the %companyname%'s next Oath should be... | Between battles internal and out, there remains one eternal war in that of following Young Anselm's Oaths. In these trials you must sequester yourself, thinking deeply and alone, until finally, it comes to you! The %companyname%'s next Oath is most surely... | Sitting alone in thought isn't just a physical task. You must clear your mind of all obstruction and distraction, cutting away every element until you are left to darkness in its purest state, where mere glimmers can become divinations, brightly standing amidst all that which is black. And there it is, coming to you in an instant, truth effervescent in its shimmering clarity, held out to you by the glow of Young Anselm's hand! The truth of your purpose, and the %companyname%'s future, it must undertake but one Oath... | Some Oathtakers take to silence, others to songs and ballads. You yourself stand in much quiet, though the noise of the %companyname%'s doings murmur from the campgrounds. If you are to seek out Young Anselm's guidance, then surely he needs to know that you don't come alone. As you start to think the Oathtaker is not going to show up, a thought flashes across your mind. The purpose and mission of the %companyname% is now clearer than ever. In an instant, Young Anselm's auguries come to your mind and you know that the company shall undertake but one Oath... | The %companyname% would be despondent without purpose. Sensing their needs, you retire yourself to a quiet spot and sit and clear your mind. Young Anselm never allowed himself distractions and you think this will work in your favor just as well. As time begins to pass, a thought nestles within your mind. You trust it to be flighty and will soon go, but instead it only grows and grows, until finally you are made to realize it is a kernel of Young Anselm's guidance. And that guidance says only one thing, that the %companyname%'s Oath should be...}
3b7a1fdbc0e51079025d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_183.png[/img]{过去几天，你一直在琢磨，该践行小安塞尔姆珍爱的哪项誓言。血脉与骨骼都在告诉你，正确的选择是…… | 日子来了又去，夜晚，你大多独自坐着思索。可你并非始终孤单。在内省的时刻，立誓者小安塞尔姆会来到身旁，赋予你目标与职责。就在昨夜，他已明确告诉你，%companyname%下一项誓言应当是…… | 内外的争斗之间，还有一场永恒的战争，那就是遵循小安塞尔姆的誓言。面对这些试炼，你必须独处，深思，再深思，直到终于豁然开朗！%companyname%下一项誓言，毫无疑问是…… | 独坐沉思，并不只是把身体安置好。你必须清空心中一切阻碍与杂念，逐一剔除，直到只剩最纯粹的黑暗。在那里，微光也能化为启示，在漆黑中灿然显现。就在这一瞬，真相清澈闪耀，由小安塞尔姆发光的手递到你面前！你使命的真谛，以及%companyname%的未来，都指向唯一一项誓言…… | 有些立誓者选择沉默，有些选择歌曲与颂诗。你静静站着，营地里却仍传来%companyname%活动的低响。既要寻求小安塞尔姆的指引，就得让他知道，你并非独自前来。你开始以为这位立誓者不会现身时，一个念头忽然闪过。%companyname%的目标与使命，从未如此清楚。转瞬之间，小安塞尔姆的启示涌入心中，你明白，战团应当践行唯一的一项誓言…… | 若没有目标，%companyname%便会意志消沉。察觉众人的需要，你退到安静处，坐下，清空思绪。小安塞尔姆从不容许自己分心，你想，这对自己也会奏效。时间慢慢流逝，一个念头栖入脑海。起初，你以为它转瞬即逝，可它却不断生长，直到你终于意识到，那是小安塞尔姆指引的种子。而这份指引只说了一件事，%companyname%的誓言应当是……}

ba19031e16d0e69aca98.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]{A fresh, cool breeze is blowing today, and you feel like it's a good time for the %companyname% to start something new. You call the men to gather round...

What do you tell them? | You feel good today, ready to lead the %companyname% through any challenge to come. You gather the men around, kicking %randombrother% to his feet and telling %randombrother2% to finish scraping away the hairs on his neck later. When their muttering has subsided, you start to address them.

What do you tell the men the company will do? | As is customary, you assemble the men to explain the company's next steps.%SPEECH_ON%Brothers, the %companyname% must show the world we are forged of a hotter fire than other mercenary bands. As our reputation grows, so will the influx of crowns to our coffers. Let us forge a path to greatness!%SPEECH_OFF%What do you tell the men the company will do? | As the company takes a break, you decide to address the men.%SPEECH_ON%Brothers, I want everyone to know the %companyname% are not just cutthroats and errand boys, but skilled fighters of the first order. Word of our deeds must spread, so that merchants and noblemen are begging us to take their contracts.%SPEECH_OFF%What do you tell the men the company will set out to do? | Sitting and jesting with the men while they check their kit, hone their blades and mend their armor, your mind wanders off to thinking about new ideas for improving the company and its reputation across the lands.

What is your conclusion and what do you tell the men? | It falls to you, the commander, to see that the company succeeds not just on the battlefield, but also in fame and riches. And so you spend the evenings pondering about a bigger plan for the %companyname% in your tent while the men talk and laugh around the fire. You're never going to become a legend simply by chasing brigands and doing small-time contracts.

What do you proclaim to the men the company will set out to do?}
ba19031e16d0e69aca98.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_58.png[/img]{今天吹着清爽的凉风，你觉得，正适合让%companyname%开始做些新事情。你把弟兄们召集过来……

你要对他们说什么？ | 你今天精神很好，准备带领%companyname%迎接任何挑战。你召集弟兄们，踢了%randombrother%一脚，叫他起来，又让%randombrother2%待会儿再刮脖子上的毛。等嘀咕声平息，你开始讲话。

你要告诉弟兄们，战团接下来做什么？ | 按照惯例，你召集弟兄们，说明战团接下来的打算。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，%companyname%必须让世人知道，锻造我们的烈火，比其他佣兵团更加炽热！名声越响，流进金库的克朗就越多。让我们闯出一条通往伟业的路！%SPEECH_OFF%你要告诉弟兄们，战团接下来做什么？ | 战团休息时，你决定向弟兄们讲几句。%SPEECH_ON%弟兄们，我要让所有人知道，%companyname%不只是杀人的凶徒、跑腿的小厮，更是本领一流的战士。我们的事迹必须传遍各地，让商人和贵族求着我们接下委托。%SPEECH_OFF%你要告诉弟兄们，战团准备着手做什么？ | 弟兄们检查行装、磨利兵刃、修补盔甲时，你坐在旁边与他们说笑。思绪却已飘远，盘算着新的办法，让战团更加强大，也让名声传遍各地。

你想出了什么，又要怎样告诉弟兄们？ | 身为团长，你的职责不仅是赢得战斗，还要让战团扬名立万、财源广进。因此，弟兄们围着篝火谈笑时，你常在帐篷里度过夜晚，为%companyname%构思更大的计划。光靠追打强盗、承接小差事，可成不了传奇。

你要向弟兄们宣布，战团准备着手做什么？}

3d776b2204003876bb32.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{%desertedbrother% has deserted the %companyname%. When the days seem endless and the road longer, a different sort of quality is challenged in men. You've discovered that even those who are fearless in battle sometimes don't have the stamina for the hardships of the mercenary life. Then there are men who are both cowards and layabouts. You can only hope you don't waste too much coin on that sort before finding them out.

%otherbrother% steps up to you.%SPEECH_ON%Never mind about %desertedbrother%, sir. Never liked the look of him. Without the %companyname% to take care of him, I wager in a fortnight's time he'll be swinging from the gibbet.%SPEECH_OFF% | Bellyaching is a time honored tradition among mercenaries, and among people in general, but you were quickly growing tired of %desertedbrother%'s endless complaints.

If the rations were stale, the beer too bitter, or the meat tough, he was the first to let you know about it, repeatedly. He would say the same regarding sore feet, bad weather, brittle shields, chafing armor, the caravan moving too slow, the caravan moving too fast, blunt blades, getting first watch, moldy bread, low pay, general boredom, and night owls keeping him awake after dark. This isn't the complete list of his grievances, but they are all you can recall at the moment.

%desertedbrother%'s complaints are unfortunately the regular fare of the traveling mercenary troop, and mostly unavoidable. So you're not exactly surpised when you find %desertedbrother% has left for a less cumbersome life. | %desertedbrother% has not been putting his heart into racing towards certain death and crushing the enemy before him for several days now. Having missed him around camp today, you are told by the other men that he went to find firewood. Since this job doesn't typically take twelve hours, it seems %desertedbrother% has finally decided to take his discontent on the road and try his luck elsewhere. You doubt you'll see him again. | In your recent travels, the company has unfortunately faced a series of mishaps. This has hit %desertedbrother% harder than the others. He's been sleeping late, starting fights, and acting insubordinate. That is, when you can find him at all. None of this endears him to you or his comrades, and it didn't help matters when %otherbrother% chucked %desertedbrother%'s bedroll into the shallow ditch the brothers had been using for a latrine.

It is usually best to let the men vent their unhappiness, and since the company has been having a run of raw luck you've been tolerant. When this morning you found him gone, it wasn't much of a surprise. %desertedbrother% has deserted the %companyname%. | You are troubled to learn that %desertedbrother% seems to have disappeared during the night. After questioning the others and ensuring he hadn't simply stepped behind a nearby boulder to relieve his bowels, you call out a search. Thinking that perhaps %desertedbrother% had been taken by treachery, kidnapped for ransom, or fallen afoul of some beast, you and the brothers spent several hours searching the area and calling his name.

Then %otherbrother% finally suggests that %desertedbrother% is not missing at all, but has deserted you all.%SPEECH_ON%He's been griping about the company lately, but I guess he hid it from you, sir, so he'd have a chance to slip away unseen.%SPEECH_OFF%Restraining the urge to give the bearer of bad news a solid box about the ears, you ask why he didn't come forward earlier, but the brother has no answer. | You never figured %desertedbrother% for the type to desert, but when the dawn comes and he's nowhere to be seen you realize you were being naive. On every march he had been falling farther and farther behind, and every time you gave the order to break camp, he was last to gather his gear and start walking. His equipment had also begun to look ratty. Though he kept his thoughts to himself, in retrospect his sour looks and disinterest in his comrades made it obvious he wasn't happy with the direction the company has been heading in lately.

You sound out the other men and discover discontent is on the rise generally. Keep the men well fed and watered like any beast, and make sure they get paid on time, and hopefully %desertedbrother% will be the last to flee in the night. | You do not know if it was the low pay, the threat of dismemberment, the forced marches in icy rain, the foul language and coarse food, the abuse at the hands of his brothers, the small children throwing stones, the cold wind or the sleepless nights, but %desertedbrother% has grown more and more unhappy this last while until apparently he gave up on the mercenary life altogether.%SPEECH_ON%Don't know what he has to complain about. Everything seems right normal to me.%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother% says when hearing about the whole thing. %desertedbrother% has chosen the open road over the %companyname%. At least he had the decency to tell you in person that he decided to leave - although, thinking about it, perhaps it was just to collect his remaining pay in person. | Lately, %desertedbrother% had begun to take long walks in the evening when the day's work was done. Though his habit of wandering off alone wasn't exactly safe, you could think of no reason to stop him when he wasn't needed in camp. However, the more hardships the company faced, the longer these walks became, until one morning %desertedbrother% did not return at all.

%desertedbrother% has deserted the %companyname%. It's probably for the best. | %desertedbrother% has been especially moody of late, spending all his off hours fondling an old throwing knife, a blade in such poor condition it more closely resembled a bit of scrap iron than a proper weapon. He spent the previous evening throwing it at the bole of a dead tree, each time rising with a groan to retrieve it and walking back several yards to squat down and throw it again, well into the night.

Clearly he was unhappy with the recent setbacks the company has faced, at this morning he mustered the courage to enter your tent and explain that he'll be leaving the company to seek his fortune elsewhere.}
3d776b2204003876bb32.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]{%desertedbrother%离开了%companyname%，成了逃兵。日子仿佛没有尽头，前路比日子更长时，人的另一种品质便会受到考验。你发现，即便在战场上无所畏惧的人，有时也熬不住佣兵生涯的艰辛。更有些人，既是胆小鬼，又是懒汉。你只能希望，在看清这种人的真面目前，别浪费太多钱。

%otherbrother%走到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%长官，别管%desertedbrother%了。我从没看他顺眼过。没了%companyname%照应，我打赌，不出两周，他就得在绞架上晃荡。%SPEECH_OFF% | 发牢骚是佣兵的悠久传统，也是世人的悠久传统，可%desertedbrother%没完没了的抱怨，已经让你迅速厌烦。

口粮不新鲜、啤酒太苦、肉太硬，他总是第一个告诉你，还要反复说。脚疼、天气坏、盾牌脆、盔甲磨肉、商队走得太慢、商队走得太快、刀刃钝、轮到头班岗、面包发霉、薪水太少、日子无聊，还有天黑后猫头鹰叫得他睡不着，都能被他念叨。这还不是完整清单，只是你眼下能想起来的。

可惜，%desertedbrother%抱怨的这些，本就是行军佣兵的家常便饭，大多无可避免。所以，发现%desertedbrother%已离队，去寻找不那么烦累的生活时，你并不怎么意外。 | 这几天，%desertedbrother%对冲向必死险境、碾碎眼前敌人这份工作，已经不怎么上心。今天营里没见到他，其他弟兄说，他去找柴了。可这差事通常用不着十二个钟头。看来，%desertedbrother%终于带着不满上了路，决定去别处碰碰运气。你怀疑，再也见不到他了。 | 近来的旅途中，战团不幸接连遭遇厄运，对%desertedbrother%的打击尤甚。他睡懒觉、挑事斗殴、违抗命令——前提是，你还能找得到他。这些行为自然不会让你或战友更喜欢他，而%otherbrother%把%desertedbrother%的铺盖扔进弟兄们当茅厕的浅沟后，事情更没好到哪去。

通常，让弟兄们发泄不快最为妥当。何况战团近来运气糟糕，你也一直宽容。因此，今早发现他不见时，你并不意外。%desertedbrother%已经逃离%companyname%。 | 得知%desertedbrother%似乎在夜里失踪，你颇为不安。询问众人，确认他并非只是躲到附近巨石后方便之后，你下令搜寻。担心%desertedbrother%遭人暗算、被绑架勒索，或遇上了某头野兽，你与弟兄们花了几个小时搜遍周围，呼喊他的名字。

最后，%otherbrother%终于提出，%desertedbrother%根本不是失踪，而是抛下大家逃了。%SPEECH_ON%长官，他最近一直抱怨战团，不过大概瞒着你，好找机会悄悄溜走。%SPEECH_OFF%你压下狠狠给报信者一耳光的冲动，问他为何不早点说，弟兄却答不上来。 | 你从没觉得%desertedbrother%像会当逃兵的人，可天亮后四处不见踪影，你才明白自己太天真。每次行军，他都落得越来越远；每次下令拔营，他也总是最后一个收好行装、动身上路。装备也开始破烂邋遢。虽然他从不说心里话，可如今回想，那张苦脸，以及对战友漠不关心的态度，早已表明，他不满战团近来的方向。

你探了探其他人的口风，发现不满情绪普遍上涨。像照料牲口一样，让弟兄们吃饱喝足，再确保按时发饷，但愿%desertedbrother%就是最后一个趁夜逃走的人。 | 你不知道，是薪水低、断肢的威胁、冰雨中的强行军、粗话与粗粮、弟兄们的欺负、孩子扔来的石头、寒风，还是无眠之夜，让%desertedbrother%近来愈发不快，最终显然彻底放弃了佣兵生活。%SPEECH_ON%不知道他有什么好抱怨的。我看一切都挺正常。%SPEECH_OFF%%otherbrother%听完事情后这样说。%desertedbrother%选择了自由的道路，离开%companyname%。至少，他还算有礼数，亲自来告诉你，自己决定离开。不过细想，也许只是为了亲手领走剩下的薪水。 | 近来，每天的活儿结束后，%desertedbrother%开始在傍晚长时间散步。独自走远虽不安全，可营中没有需要他做的事，你也找不到理由阻止。然而，战团遭遇的艰难越多，他散步的时间就越长，直到某天早晨，%desertedbrother%再也没有回来。

%desertedbrother%已经逃离%companyname%。也许这样最好。 | %desertedbrother%近来格外阴郁，闲暇时总把玩一把旧飞刀。刀破得厉害，与其说是武器，不如说更像废铁。昨晚，他一直朝一棵枯树的树干投掷，每次都呻吟着起身去捡，再退回几码，蹲下重投，直至深夜。

显然，战团近期的挫折让他不满。今早，他终于鼓起勇气走进你的帐篷，说明自己要离开战团，去别处谋个前程。}

a5086d8636c5ad35a7fb.source: {I can hardly force him to remain with the company... | Bad news, indeed. | A momentary setback. | I can not let something like this happen again.}
a5086d8636c5ad35a7fb.translation: {我总不能硬把他留在战团…… | 确实是个坏消息。 | 不过是一时受挫。 | 不能再让这种事发生。}

ca1aebeccaccf7c5cbdc.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]%dismissed%'s injuries proved too much: the man didn't die, but in your mind he might as well have for he was no longer fit for combat. You let him go. While this may have been an altruistic move that spared the sellsword's life, the rest of the company doesn't see it the same way. All they see is that one injury is all it took for you to cut a man loose. Now they worry that if they get wounded you might do the same to them, like a selfish man ridding himself of a lame horse.
ca1aebeccaccf7c5cbdc.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]%dismissed%的伤太重了。他虽没死，可在你看来，既然无法再战，也就相差无几。你让他离开。也许这算善举，免得佣兵日后送命，可其他弟兄并不这么想。他们只看见，一次伤就足以让你抛弃一个人。如今大家都担心，自己若受伤，也会被你同样处置，像自私的主人丢掉一匹瘸马。

1f5a5a51309726b29487.source: Afraid to be dismissed on account of his injury

3c840a107f7a5d3788c5.source: Lost confidence in the company's solidarity
3c840a107f7a5d3788c5.translation: 不再相信战团会同舟共济

10449e550db341d367eb.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]The man you let go wasn't just a part of the company: he was a legend. Many knew %dismissed%'s name, not just yourself and a few mercenaries, and having him leave is akin to firing a heroic general before a war-ending battle. The decision, naturally, does not go over well with the rest of the sellswords.
10449e550db341d367eb.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]你辞退的人不只是战团一员，更是个传奇。%dismissed%的名号，远不止你和几个佣兵知道。让他离开，无异于在终结战争的决战前，撤掉一位功勋赫赫的将军。其余弟兄自然很不认同这个决定。

8f058031751a5a986625.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]It was a tough decision, but you had to cut %dismissed% loose. However, it appears you should have consulted the rest of the men first for none of them are happy with your choice. The mercenary had been in the company long enough to make friends, and even those who weren't close to him still felt as though his place on the battlefield ensured their own safety.
8f058031751a5a986625.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_64.png[/img]虽然艰难，你还是决定辞退%dismissed%。可看来，你本该先问问其他弟兄，因为没人对这个选择满意。他在战团待得够久，结下不少朋友；即使交情不深的人，也觉得只要战场上有他，自己就多一分安全。

1cfb4f1cac3512319a5b.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{The caravan's lead merchant comes to you with thanks for saving him. Naturally, he provides more than just words: a number of goods are given, some of which will be of use. | %SPEECH_ON%Thank you, traveler, thank you!%SPEECH_OFF%The caravan's merchant master clasps his hands and shakes them up and down as though to thank you and the old gods alike. He also says thanks with material goods, providing the %companyname% with an assortment of rewards straight off the wagons. | It is rare for strangers in this world to see one another in good grace, but even a wily merchant understands that if he is saved from total annihilation then perhaps he best reward his saviors. The caravan lightens its load by rewarding you with a number of goods. | Had you not arrived this caravan surely would have met doom. It rewards you properly for your impromptu 'services.' | %SPEECH_ON%Oh by any higher power which may or may not exist to you, but whatever it is, it now reigns over me!%SPEECH_OFF%The merchant is clearly in shock. And, like any disturbed peddler, he immediately goes to the one thing he knows how to do.%SPEECH_ON%Look, we've goods to offer, how about these? Tokens of our gratitude, free of charge.%SPEECH_OFF% | Though the battle is over, the hysteria of the saved merchants is just as loud as the carnage which has just passed.%SPEECH_ON%Sellswords, sellswords! Our saviors!%SPEECH_OFF%Suddenly, you find the merchants swarming with goods as thanks for saving them.}
1cfb4f1cac3512319a5b.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{商队领头的商人前来感谢你的救命之恩。当然，他不只是嘴上说说，还送来一批货物，其中有些颇为实用。 | %SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，旅人，谢谢！%SPEECH_OFF%商队主人双手合拢，上下摇动，仿佛既在感谢你，也在感谢旧神。他还以实物致谢，直接从货车上搬来各式物品，酬谢%companyname%。 | 这世道，陌生人难得以善意相待。可再狡猾的商人也明白，既然有人救自己免于灭顶之灾，最好还是给救命恩人一点报酬。商队卸下一批货物送给你，也让自己的载重轻了些。 | 若非你及时赶到，这支商队必然难逃覆灭。对于你临时提供的“服务”，他们给出了像样的酬谢。 | %SPEECH_ON%噢，不管你信不信有神，不管那神究竟是谁，从今往后，我都归祂管了！%SPEECH_OFF%商人显然惊魂未定。而像每个乱了阵脚的小贩一样，他立刻回到自己最熟悉的那件事上。%SPEECH_ON%瞧，我们有货，这些怎么样？一点谢意，分文不收。%SPEECH_OFF% | 战斗虽已结束，获救商人们歇斯底里的叫喊，却与刚才的厮杀一样响亮。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！佣兵！我们的救命恩人！%SPEECH_OFF%转眼间，商人们捧着货物将你围住，感谢你的救命之恩。}

a3feafcf06896c7d6341.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{Two bodies on the ground, and a weight off your shoulders. But...you thought it would be different. Not that you are displeased with the results, such that the Oathbringers are no more, but there's something amiss. It is almost as if you put out a fire that threatened your home, only to realize those flames were the only warmth you had in a world of cold.%SPEECH_ON%Good riddance.%SPEECH_OFF%One of your men says and spits on the corpses. Staring at the dead, you realize you had become addicted to the hunt, addicted to the challenge, addicted to being strong. You weren't encumbered by a threat. You were weighted with purpose, and now it is gone. %randombrother% leans down and picks up Young Anselm's jawbone and hands it over. You take it and piece it to Young Anselm's skull. It fits with ease, almost as if even in its decay it had no reason to separate. The men cheer. They cheer the Oathtakers. They cheer your name. And they cheer for Young Anselm who in death has finally been made whole again. You take one last look at the Oathbringers and nod. They had a purpose, sure, but now it is fulfilled. May the old gods have mercy on their heathen souls.}
a3feafcf06896c7d6341.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{两具尸体躺在地上，你肩头的一副重担终于卸下。可……你原以为，这一刻会有所不同。倒不是对结果不满，誓言使者毕竟已不复存在，但总觉得少了些什么。仿佛你扑灭了一场威胁家园的大火，才发现，在这冰冷的世界里，那火焰竟是你唯一的温暖。%SPEECH_ON%死了干净。%SPEECH_OFF%一个弟兄说着，朝尸体吐了口唾沫。你凝视死者，忽然明白，自己早已沉迷于追猎，沉迷于挑战，沉迷于强大的感觉。压在你身上的不是威胁，而是使命，如今它却消失了。%randombrother%俯身捡起小安塞尔姆的颌骨，递给你。你接过，将它与小安塞尔姆的头骨拼合，严丝合缝，仿佛即便已经腐朽，它们也不该分离。弟兄们欢呼起来，为立誓者，为你的名字，也为终于在死后重获完整的小安塞尔姆。你最后看了一眼誓言使者，点点头。他们确实有过使命，但如今已然完成。愿旧神怜悯他们异端的灵魂。}

9ce06b3067e838d48871.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{You stare in disbelief as your chosen fighters go down. A thought crosses your mind to kill the Oathbringers, but rules are rules and you wouldn't dare infringe on Young Anselm's oath of proper combat. You watch as an Oathbringer takes up Young Anselm's jawbone, presses thumb to mandible, and promptly snaps the relic in half.%SPEECH_ON%Despite our victory, even we Oathbringers can see that we've both our errors. So let schism grace schism! Through us we all take on the Oath of Failure, and see unto this world that we find true followers of the Oaths...%SPEECH_OFF%The Oathbringer stares at you through the broken bones, himself shielded by a dead man's decree.%SPEECH_ON%When Young Anselm's guidance finds fulfillment, only then shall he be made whole again.%SPEECH_OFF%The Oathbringer turns and leaves. Your heart races with ideas of stabbing him in the back, cobbling Anselm's remains back together, and completing your ultimate task. But the notion passes. To do such a thing would curse you forever with having ruined your firmest beliefs. You simply watch the Oathbringer go, knowing that the Oaths and all its believers may one day come back together, but it will not be in your lifetime.}
9ce06b3067e838d48871.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_87.png[/img]{你难以置信地看着自己挑选的战士倒下。一瞬间，你想杀掉誓言使者，可规矩就是规矩，你不敢违背小安塞尔姆关于公平决斗的誓约。你眼看着一名誓言使者举起小安塞尔姆的颌骨，用拇指抵住，猛地将这件圣物折成两半。%SPEECH_ON%我们虽赢了，可即便是我们誓言使者，也看得出双方各有过错。那就以断裂，来回应分裂吧！由我们承受共同的失败之誓，向这世界表明，我们仍需寻找真正奉行誓约之人……%SPEECH_OFF%誓言使者隔着断骨盯住你，一个死者留下的训令正护着他的性命。%SPEECH_ON%只有当小安塞尔姆的指引真正得到践行，他才会再次完整。%SPEECH_OFF%誓言使者转身离开。你心跳如擂，脑中闪过一个念头：从背后刺死他，把安塞尔姆的遗骨拼回去，完成最终的使命。可这念头终究散了。若真这么做，你便亲手毁了自己最坚定的信仰，永远背负这份诅咒。你只是看着誓言使者离去。你知道，誓约及其所有信徒也许终有一天会重归一体，但你此生已无缘得见。}

a39eda0e047ef1f1a588.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{Against every fiber of your being, you turn the fight down. The reality is simple: the %companyname% is not ready for this battle. Unsurprisingly, the Oathtakers are not especially happy about this, and in fact show considerable concern that you would take a rare opportunity at slaying Oathbringers and piss all over it. As for the Oathbringers themselves, they laugh and crow at you as you leave.%SPEECH_ON%Young Anselm saw nothing good in you, Oathtakers! Your visions of him are a lie! Your whole existence is a lie! I'd say join us while you can, but we want nothing to do with you worms!%SPEECH_OFF%You pray that in the coming days you will be able to prove to your men that you made the right decision here.}
a39eda0e047ef1f1a588.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{尽管心中万般不愿，你还是拒绝了交战。事实很简单：%companyname%还没准备好打这一仗。立誓者们果然十分不满，眼见你把斩杀誓言使者的难得机会糟蹋掉，更是对你的决定忧心忡忡。至于那些誓言使者，他们在你们离去时放声嘲笑、得意叫嚣。%SPEECH_ON%立誓者，小安塞尔姆从没在你们身上看见半点可取之处！你们看见他的异象是谎言！你们的存在本身就是谎言！本想劝你们趁早投靠我们，可我们才不想跟你们这群蛆虫扯上关系！%SPEECH_OFF%你只盼接下来的日子里，能向弟兄们证明，自己此刻的决定是对的。}

2fd4fa63f10125666c54.source: It had to be this way.

36abd4d9883d7c176503.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{The company is still not ready. You are worried that they will leave you entirely, infuriated as they are, but you'd rather they be pissed than flat dead in the ground. With the decision weighing on your heart, and the Oathbringers screaming insults into your ear, you have the company once again march from the fight.}
36abd4d9883d7c176503.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{战团仍未准备好。弟兄们怒火中烧，你担心他们索性一走了之，可宁肯让他们发怒，也好过让他们横尸荒野。这个决定压在心头，誓言使者的辱骂又不断灌进耳里，你还是再一次带着战团离开了决斗。}

0a17142dec8910d68739.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{The Oathbringers are back. One grins wildly as he steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%Shall we see through Young Anselm's visions, or will you drop trou and shit on divine providence once again, Oathtaker?%SPEECH_OFF%You look at your men and decide...}
0a17142dec8910d68739.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{誓言使者又来了。其中一人咧嘴狂笑，走上前。%SPEECH_ON%立誓者，今天要成全小安塞尔姆的启示，还是又要脱下裤子，往神圣旨意上拉一泡？%SPEECH_OFF%你望向弟兄们，作出决定……}

dca95c42fccd123d6a41.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{'We'll be seeing you someday,' they said, spoken softly like old friends, but they meant it, meant it in only the way enemies can. Them. The Oathbringers. Now standing before you in glinting steel, chins up and weapons readied, a salient of hate, manifest from the untimely demise of Young Anselm. You thought you would find them in much larger number, but now only two stand wishing to confront the %companyname%. One steps forward. You see Young Anselm's jawbone dangling from his neck. The Oathbringer nods.%SPEECH_ON%I knew it the day we departed that it were only a matter of time until we saw each other again. I can see you have been fighting many a battle, as have we. It is clear that Young Anselm's prophecies bore such weight that this world would see us brought together one final time, not robbed of the ceremony on account of some brigand or greenskin. You and I both have been shielded by fate, clothed in the invincibility of one very certain inevitability. Oathtakers. Oathbringers. Let us settle this schism once and for all. As Young Anselm decreed, choose your finest fighters, and we shall see which of us are most deserving of upholding the Oaths!%SPEECH_OFF%}
dca95c42fccd123d6a41.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{“总有一天，我们还会见面。”当初他们说得轻柔，像老朋友，却是认真的，而且是只有仇敌才懂的那种认真。他们，誓言使者，如今身披闪亮钢甲，抬着下巴，握好武器，站在你面前。这股仇恨化为锋刃，源自小安塞尔姆过早的离世。你本以为会遇上更多人，可如今，想与%companyname%对峙的，只有两个。其中一人走上前，你看见小安塞尔姆的颌骨正挂在他颈间。誓言使者点点头。%SPEECH_ON%分别那天，我就知道，再次相见只是早晚的事。看得出，你们经历了许多战斗，我们也一样。小安塞尔姆的预言果然分量如此之重，竟让这世界容许我们最后重逢一次，没有让什么强盗或绿皮剥夺这场仪式。你我一直受命运庇护，那注定要发生的一刻，让我们在此之前无可摧折。立誓者，誓言使者，就让我们一次了结这场分裂。遵照小安塞尔姆的训令，选出你们最优秀的战士，看看谁才最配守护这些誓约！%SPEECH_OFF%}

35e60cc188e62a71d155.source: {Represent us in this fight | Be our champion | Reclaim Anselm's jawbone | Kill these Oathbringers},
35e60cc188e62a71d155.translation: {代表我们出战吧 | 做我们的勇士吧 | 夺回安塞尔姆的颚骨吧 | 杀死这些誓言使者吧}，

468f3709d2a4db426176.source: We can't win this. No fight.

deb978d66d594d2788b9.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]The Oathbringers stand before you, waiting for you to pick your champions.
deb978d66d594d2788b9.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]誓言使者站在面前，等你选出代表出战的勇士。

7a26af1b3977f41d9b2a.source: to fight. Is there another who shall help reclaim Young Anselm's jawbone?
7a26af1b3977f41d9b2a.translation: 出战。还有谁愿意帮忙夺回小安塞尔姆的颚骨？

3f4bac6b35952496b409.source: stands ready to fight. Who shall join him?
3f4bac6b35952496b409.translation: 已准备出战。谁与他并肩上阵？

837c816071cbcc963bc2.source: I've selected everyone I wish to. Now defeat those Oathbringers!
837c816071cbcc963bc2.translation: 人选齐了。现在，打败那些誓言使者！

ef7fad2319c8e666f6a6.translation: 夺回了小安塞尔姆的颚骨

9c37a230a73bff652348.source: You refused to fight Oathbringers, given the chance
9c37a230a73bff652348.translation: 有机会交战时，你拒绝迎战誓言使者

27984534d6de38788a1f.source: You refused to fight Oathbringers, given multiple chances
27984534d6de38788a1f.translation: 有过多次机会，你却始终拒绝与誓言使者交战

3c25ec86494a366886fd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{The men come to you with a startling discovery: on the inside cup of Young Anselm's brainpan was a tiny, rolled up letter - and its wax stamp bears the mark of a nobleman's ring. With agreement amongst the men, you tear it open and give it a read. You find that Young Anselm himself was of high birth, and that he had a writ of Curia in Absentia - or in mercenary parlance, an allowance to enter noble courts. You look out at the men and say,%SPEECH_ON%Young Anselm has blessed us all once again!%SPEECH_OFF%While the sensibilities of deracinated sellswords would prevent such scapegraces from ever talking with nobles, much less profaning their delicate stone floors, Young Anselm's letter carries a unique marker: anyone who is in his company will also gain the selfsame access, that includes this world or the next. The men surmise that Young Anselm must have held quite the high station in the noble circles for this to be the case, and that he must also have held your lot in high regard to offer the power to you.%SPEECH_ON%But, uhmm, who put the scroll inside his head?%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% inquires. You and the men tell him to shut his mouth. There's no point in dwelling on the how's and what's and why's. This is clearly a miracle and yet another acknowledgment that the Oathtakers are on the right path.}
3c25ec86494a366886fd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{弟兄们带来一个惊人的发现：小安塞尔姆的颅腔内侧，藏着一封卷得极小的信，封蜡上还印着贵族戒指的纹章。众人一致同意后，你拆信读了起来。原来，小安塞尔姆本人出身高贵，还拥有一份“缺席入廷敕书”——按佣兵的说法，就是获准出入贵族宫廷的凭证。你望着弟兄们，说道。%SPEECH_ON%小安塞尔姆又一次赐福于我们！%SPEECH_OFF%像你们这些无家无业的粗鄙佣兵，本来连与贵族交谈的资格都没有，更别提踏上他们精致的石地板，弄脏那些地方了。然而，小安塞尔姆的信上有一项特殊条款：凡与他同行之人，皆享有同等资格，无论今生还是来世。弟兄们推断，他在贵族圈中必定位高权重，才能有此特权；而愿意将权力赋予你们，也必定是对你们寄予厚望。%SPEECH_ON%不过，呃，是谁把信塞进他脑袋里的？%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%问道。你和弟兄们一起叫他闭嘴。何必纠缠怎么做、做了什么、为什么做？这分明就是奇迹，再次证明立誓者走在正道上。}

f821f7884872775bebbf.source: With this writ, even the nobles will give us work.
f821f7884872775bebbf.translation: 有了这份文书，贵族也肯把活交给我们了。

cdbf7ce507cf96c8cb17.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{The prestige and renown of the %companyname% is growing. Everywhere you go, people are looking to join - and not just sellswords, but followers who may be of other use! | With every battle your sellswords fight, the renown of the company grows. As this fame rises, more people, and not just sellswords, will be looking to join the %companyname%. Perhaps it is time the company takes on another follower? | Followers of the %companyname% need not just be fighters - it appears that with the company's growing renown and prestige there may be others willing to ride the coattails. Perhaps these tagalongs may be of great utility to the company, even if they are not contributing on the battlefield.}
cdbf7ce507cf96c8cb17.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]{%companyname%的威望与声名日益增长。无论走到哪里，都有人想要加入，其中不仅有佣兵，也有能在其他方面效力的随从！ | 每打一场仗，战团的声望便更上一层。随着名气渐长，会有更多人想加入%companyname%，而且不只是佣兵。或许是时候再招一名随从了？ | 追随%companyname%的人未必都得上阵作战。战团的名望越来越高，似乎有些别的人也愿意前来投靠。他们纵然不在战场上出力，或许也能给战团带来很大帮助。}

892f606bd87205017e3f.source: I'll take a look at our retinue!

3cf947f897bc463c9f0d.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]%squire% the young squire is eyeing %hedgeknight% from a safe distance. The hedge knight is sharpening his blades, running a whetstone over the edges and stropping the metals to give 'em a good sheen. Catching the squire staring, %hedgeknight% lowers his equipment.%SPEECH_ON%So you want to be a knight, is that it?%SPEECH_OFF%%squire% nods and answers proudly.%SPEECH_ON%It is my dream, yes, and one day it will happen.%SPEECH_OFF%The hedge knight stands and walks over, coming to tower over the youth.%SPEECH_ON%What is it you think a knight does? Saves damsels? Rules fiefs to be loved by the peasants? Owes allegiance to his lord? Well let me tell you, that's all bullshit. Dainty farks like yourself are nothing but mealworm. You want to be a knight you gotta learn to kill.%SPEECH_OFF%The squire straightens up and pulls his shoulders back.%SPEECH_ON%I've no issue killing.%SPEECH_OFF%The hedge knight pushes the man back with only a single finger.%SPEECH_ON%Is that so? And have you gutted a man and murdered his family while he bled out on the ground? What of crushing a child's head in your hands because your liege gave the order? Would you gouge out a woman's eyes because your lord believed that was due punishment for stealing a loaf of bread? Who do you think I am, squire? Do you think I was born big, mean, and savage? No, little squire, you will have to kill, and who you kill first is none other than yourself. That is how you become a knight in these lands, in these times.%SPEECH_OFF%The hedge knight returns to his work. The squire is visibly shaken, but seems to be earnestly thinking over what he'd just heard.
3cf947f897bc463c9f0d.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]年轻的骑士侍从%squire%站在安全距离之外，打量着%hedgeknight%。流浪骑士正在磨刀，先用磨刀石顺着刃口打磨，再用皮带抛出光泽。察觉到侍从的注视，%hedgeknight%放下工具。%SPEECH_ON%所以，你想当骑士，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%%squire%点头，骄傲地回答。%SPEECH_ON%没错，这是我的梦想，总有一天会实现。%SPEECH_OFF%流浪骑士起身走来，高大的身影笼罩着年轻人。%SPEECH_ON%你觉得骑士是干什么的？解救姑娘？治理封地，让农民爱戴？向领主效忠？我告诉你，全是狗屁。像你这种娇嫩的小混账，不过是条面包虫。想当骑士，就得学会杀人。%SPEECH_OFF%侍从挺直腰，向后收紧肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%杀人，我没问题。%SPEECH_OFF%流浪骑士只用一根手指，便把他推得后退。%SPEECH_ON%是吗？你剖开过一个人的肚子，再当着他流血等死的面，杀光他的家人吗？若领主下令，你会徒手捏碎一个孩子的脑袋吗？若领主认为，一个女人偷了条面包就该受此惩罚，你会挖掉她的眼睛吗？侍从，你以为我是谁？以为我生来就这么高大、凶狠、野蛮？不，小侍从，你得杀人，而第一个要杀掉的，就是你自己。在这片土地、这个时代，骑士就是这样炼成的。%SPEECH_OFF%流浪骑士回去继续干活。侍从显然受了震动，却也在认真思索刚才听到的话。

8c6f3b5ee6f27e609d13.source: Has been shaken in his beliefs

262f5c6ff37596d231f6.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] %strong1% and %strong2% - the strongest men in the outfit by some measure - are apparently undertaking something of a competition to see who is the better. You watch as they carry enormous stones from one side of an ad hoc competitive ground to the other. Then they take turns seeing how far they can throw these very stones. And then they roll the stones up a nearby hill. And then they see who can completely bury a stone the fastest.

All in all, there are a lot of heavy stones being jostled about and by the end of the festive affair both men are completely exhausted. Even without a winner, the time-honored tradition of moving rocks around to no real end has improved the men's morale.
262f5c6ff37596d231f6.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img] %strong1%和%strong2%算得上战团里力气最大的两人，此刻似乎正比试谁更强。你看着他们把巨石从临时划出的场地一头搬到另一头，接着轮流将同样的石头掷出去，看谁扔得更远。随后，他们又把石头推上附近的山坡，再比谁能最快挖坑将石头埋得严严实实。

总之，一大堆沉石被来回折腾。热闹散场时，两人都累得筋疲力尽。虽没分出胜负，这场沿袭已久、毫无实际用处的搬石头比赛，还是让弟兄们的心情好了不少。

59b2c151394dd3fa2fb0.translation: 我们终究都是头脑简单的家伙。

a697677b6338d5ca74dc.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]You cross into a small hamlet beside the path. It's a rather nondescript place save for the woman tied atop a soon-to-be bonfire. She's surrounded by a band of peasants as is usual for a woman in this position. A monk from the mob reads from a holy tome, apparently letting everyone know the deontological nature of her crimes. Another man dutifully stands by with a torch, his hands itchy to put it to use.

 Seeing you, the woman shouts for help.%SPEECH_ON%They're going to burn me! You must do something! I've done no wrong here!%SPEECH_OFF%
a697677b6338d5ca74dc.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你走进路旁一座小村。地方平平无奇，只有一名女子被绑在即将点燃的柴堆顶上，格外显眼。照惯例，她四周围着一群农民。人群里一个修士正诵读圣典，似乎在说明她的罪行违背了哪些神圣戒律。另一个男人恪尽职守地举着火把，手痒得恨不得立刻点火。

女人看见你，放声求救。%SPEECH_ON%他们要烧死我！你得做点什么！我什么坏事都没做！%SPEECH_OFF%

37a1cec16c16d8fee427.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]You will not stand idly by while an innocent woman is burned for some imaginary crime. Blade in hand, you climb the wooden pallets and cut her free. She quickly scurries away, seeking her own safety. The crowd, enraged, sets upon the company in an instant. A scuffle between peasants and sellswords ends poorly for the former, but they do put in some damage.

 For losing control of the crowd, you have the monk beaten up, and the man carrying the torch, too. A few of the brothers believe this was the right thing to do and are pleased with your decision.
37a1cec16c16d8fee427.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你不肯眼看一个无辜女人因虚构的罪名被烧死，便提刀爬上木架，割断绳索放了她。她迅速逃开，寻找安全之处。愤怒的人群顷刻扑向战团，农民与佣兵的一场混战，自然是前者吃亏，不过弟兄们也受了伤。

你以未能约束人群为由，让人揍了修士一顿，连举火把的那个也没放过。有些弟兄认为此举正当，对你的决定很满意。

856ab475145583627e5e.source: I hope she finds somewhere safe to be.
856ab475145583627e5e.translation: 但愿她能找到安全的去处。

e9fbd76a9cc019f31a12.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]You will not stand idly by while an innocent woman is burned for some imaginary crime. Blade in hand, you climb the wooden pallets and cut her free. When she's free, she leans down and takes you in her hands. Her skin is smooth and unmarked.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%She plants a kiss and it feels as though her lips are ice. You watch as she floats down the wooden pallets. Uh oh.

 The town monk retreats, trying to hide himself in the crowd, but the witch screams and splits the mob, leaving only the friar by himself on the ground. He slowly slides across the dirt before rising to his feet as though pushed by an invisible force. He tries to retreat again, but there's no going anywhere. She kisses him as she did you, but the man's eyes roll back in his head and you see his veins engorge, purpling violently, his whole body issuing blood out of every pore as he shakes. He screams, but it's lost in the mouth of the witch who eats it with a moan. When she lets go, he drops to the ground a sopping red corpse.

 The villagers scatter while your men try and fight this evil. She laughs and shrinks into the center of her clothes, her cloak rolling itself in a bundle out of which shoots a cackling specter. It's soars to the nearest tree line hopefully to never be seen again.
e9fbd76a9cc019f31a12.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]你不能坐视一个无辜女人因莫须有的罪名被烧死。你拔剑在手，爬上木架，割断绳索。脱困后，她俯下身，双手捧住你。她的皮肤光滑，没有半点伤痕。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢你，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%她吻了你一下，双唇冷得像冰。你看着她飘下木架。糟了。

 镇上的修士连连后退，想躲进人群。女巫却一声尖叫，将人群震散，只剩那修士独自倒在地上。他先是缓缓滑过泥地，随后像被无形的力量托住，直挺挺站了起来。他又想逃，却哪儿也去不了。她像吻你一样吻了他，可那人的双眼翻白，血管骤然鼓起，暴涨成紫色。他浑身颤抖，鲜血从每个毛孔涌出。他发出尖叫，却全被女巫的嘴吞没，她呻吟着，将那声音一并咽了下去。等她松手时，他倒在地上，已成了一具鲜血淋漓的尸体。

 村民四散奔逃，你的弟兄则试图对抗这邪物。她笑着缩进衣服中央，斗篷自行卷成一团，随后一道怪笑的幽影从中射出，飞向最近的林边。但愿再也见不到她。

a87f4fbd6dc8531a5145.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%witchhunter% steps forward with a skeptical eye. He looks at the woman who strains to say 'please.' The witch hunter stares her up and down, then he turns and drives a blade through the man holding the torch. He gargles with it in his throat and his hands work to try and pry it out.%SPEECH_ON%Stop with the farce, you will not fool me.%SPEECH_OFF%The witch hunter says. He yanks out the blade and the torch-wielder stands there for a moment, but his wide eyes slowly settle down and the 'blood' stops in an instant. His face widens, skin stretching taut like the melted visage of a puppeteer's most gruesome doll. Its voice is shrieking, every syllable the pitch of a dying cat.%SPEECH_ON%I am NOT the last! You'll NEVER be rid of us all!%SPEECH_OFF%And with that, %witchhunter% drives his weapon into the evil spirit's skull. The skin hardens like a desert earth before chipping away.

 With the truth out there, the woman is cut down and freed. The monk is defrocked by an angry mob with nowhere else to turn their energy. Naked and humiliated, he is driven from the hamlet for his wrongful accusations.
a87f4fbd6dc8531a5145.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%witchhunter%带着怀疑的目光走上前。女人艰难地挤出一声“求你”。猎巫人将她上下打量一遍，忽然转身，一刀刺穿举火把之人的喉咙。那人喉中咯咯作响，双手试图将刀拔出。%SPEECH_ON%收起这场闹剧，你骗不了我。%SPEECH_OFF%猎巫人说道，猛地抽出刀。举火把的人又站了一会儿，圆睁的眼睛却慢慢平静下来，“血”也瞬间止住。他的脸向两侧扩张，皮肤绷紧，像操偶师手中最骇人的玩偶，被熔化后扯开的面孔。它发出尖叫，每个音节都像垂死猫咪的哀鸣。%SPEECH_ON%我不是最后一个！你们永远杀不尽我们！%SPEECH_OFF%话音刚落，%witchhunter%便将武器刺进恶灵的头颅。皮肤像沙漠的大地般硬结，随后片片剥落。

 真相大白，女人被解开绳索，重获自由。愤怒的村民无处发泄，便将修士的袍子扒了个精光。他因诬告他人，赤身裸体、受尽羞辱地被赶出了村庄。

3c47479c6b29965696f6.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]The monk, %monk%, sits with the town's own friar and talks for a time. When they are done, a nod is given to the torchman who sets the wooden pallets aflame. The woman screams for mercy, but the flames have none for her, slowly working up feet first. It is a horrific sight and only when the smoke is a choking cloud does the dying woman go silent. The fire consumes her entirely as the rest of the town claps and cheers. %monk% states that she was clearly a witch and had to be done away with. You're not sure. All you saw was a woman burned alive, but you trust that he knows more than you about the war between the old gods and the evils of sorcery.
3c47479c6b29965696f6.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]修士%monk%与镇上的修士坐下来谈了一阵。谈完后，其中一人向执火把的人点头，后者便点燃了木架。女人尖叫着求饶，火焰却毫不留情，从她双脚开始慢慢向上爬。场面惨不忍睹，直到浓烟汇成令人窒息的云团，垂死的女人才终于没了声音。烈火将她完全吞没，镇民们却拍手欢呼。%monk%说，她显然是个女巫，必须铲除。你并不确定。你看见的只是一个女人被活活烧死，但对于旧神与邪恶巫术之间的斗争，你相信他懂得比你多。

fa00b239d49b948c6b30.source: Rooting out evil is never easy.
fa00b239d49b948c6b30.translation: 铲除邪恶从来不是易事。

aa4e79e186957ea1d4b4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%cultist% steps forward and looks the villagers up and down. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%You all should kill yourselves.%SPEECH_OFF%The town monk rustles up his cloak.%SPEECH_ON%E-excuse me?%SPEECH_OFF%The cultist starts to cut the woman down. A few of your mercenaries step forward to stop anyone from protesting. When she's free and sent running for her own safety, %cultist% speaks again.%SPEECH_ON%Kill yourselves. Each of you. Tonight. You've angered Davkul and his rage is a debt you'd do best to pay yourself.%SPEECH_OFF%The monk opens his mouth to say something, but his nose cracks as though indented by an invisible stone. He lurches, blood spewing from his nostrils. %cultist% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Hmm, he is angrier than I had thought. Davkul awaits us all, but he is now on your doorstep.%SPEECH_OFF%Screaming, the monk falls to the ground as his jaw sickeningly cracks open, his mouth left permanently ajar. The villagers scream and disperse like rabbits beneath the shadow of a hawk.
aa4e79e186957ea1d4b4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%cultist%走上前，把村民从头到脚打量了一遍，摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%你们全都该自行了断。%SPEECH_OFF%镇上的修士拢起斗篷。%SPEECH_ON%你、你说什么？%SPEECH_OFF%教徒动手割断绑住女人的绳索。几个佣兵上前站定，不让任何人阻拦。等女人重获自由、被催着逃去安全的地方后，%cultist%又开了口。%SPEECH_ON%自行了断吧。你们每一个人。就在今晚。你们激怒了达夫库尔，祂的怒火就是你们欠下的债，最好由你们自己来还。%SPEECH_OFF%修士张嘴想说什么，鼻子却猛地塌了下去，仿佛被一块看不见的石头砸中。他一个踉跄，鲜血从鼻孔里喷涌而出。%cultist%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，祂比我想的还要愤怒。达夫库尔等待着我们所有人，但如今，祂已来到你们门前。%SPEECH_OFF%修士惨叫着倒地，下颌传来令人牙酸的断裂声，嘴再也合不上了。村民们惊叫四散，像鹰影下逃窜的兔子。

b9663debb32bb82fa40b.source: What does a witch hunter say to this, %witchhunterfull%?

16dda6e50121543763cb.source: What do the old gods say, %monkfull%?

49d13febf840ec7141c4.source: What does your strange god make of this, %cultistfull%?
49d13febf840ec7141c4.translation: %cultistfull%，你那位古怪的神会怎么看这件事？

9ae19b5c78fa54e8fddb.source: You saved a woman from being burned at the stake
9ae19b5c78fa54e8fddb.translation: 你救下了一名即将被处以火刑的女子

ce800e68ecc39468d54c.source: You set free an evil spirit

d1d9252ac682afa10e72.source: Saw an evil spirit meet its end

f632c05805d4299834bf.source: Saw a witch burning at the stake
f632c05805d4299834bf.translation: 目睹女巫被绑在火刑柱上烧死

0725c863f7d81450180a.translation: 见识了达夫库尔的力量

ada05065cd4a2250a170.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]A few brothers come back to you with the most curious of stories. Apparently %surefooted%, the ever surefooted sellsword, managed to make a bit of a name for himself in %townname%.

 While carousing with ladies on a tavern staircase, the bannister broke and a damsel went careening downward. With a horn of ale in one hand and a wench wrapped in the tender grip of the other, the mercenary stuck his foot out and managed to catch the falling mistress on the toe of his boot, quite literally bringing her to heel much to the roaring applause of the inebriated crowd below. You ask where he is now. The mercenaries laugh.%SPEECH_ON%Dropping trou with the easily impressed, what else?%SPEECH_OFF%
ada05065cd4a2250a170.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_85.png[/img]几个弟兄回来，给你讲了个稀奇故事。原来，一向步履稳健的%surefooted%居然在%townname%出了回风头。

他正在酒馆楼梯上与姑娘们嬉闹，栏杆突然断了，一个姑娘失足摔了下去。佣兵一手端着盛麦酒的角杯，另一只手还温柔地搂着个姑娘，竟只伸出一只脚，就用靴尖接住了坠落的女子。如此脚下功夫，令楼下那群醉鬼爆发出雷鸣般的掌声。你问他现在在哪儿。弟兄们哈哈笑道。%SPEECH_ON%裤子都脱了，正陪着那些随便露一手就能哄到的姑娘呢，还能干什么？%SPEECH_OFF%

599a971d857ca0f6bb13.source: Had a bit of a partie carree
599a971d857ca0f6bb13.translation: 享受了一场四人风流韵事

2773199485c608aeaedd.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]An old man's voice is heard quietly issuing orders.%SPEECH_ON%The foot leads, the body follows. Again.%SPEECH_OFF%You find %swordmaster% the swordmaster and %swordstudent% practicing in a field. The elder shakes his head at the most recent display of swordsmanship.%SPEECH_ON%The foot leads, the body follows. Again!%SPEECH_OFF%The student practices what he is taught. Nodding, the swordmaster barks another order.%SPEECH_ON%Now do it in reverse. The foot retreats, the body follows. Do not retreat with your mind. Let your feet do the thinking for you. Instinct is survival! Thinking is death! Move as though the world demanded it. If a wind blows are you faster than the leaves which hear its call? I see. Good... you are learning. Now... again.%SPEECH_OFF%
2773199485c608aeaedd.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]一个苍老的声音正低声发出指令。%SPEECH_ON%脚先动，身随步走。再来。%SPEECH_OFF%你发现剑术大师%swordmaster%正在空地上指导%swordstudent%练剑。看完刚才那一招，老者摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%脚先动，身随步走。再来！%SPEECH_OFF%学生照着所教的动作练习。剑术大师点点头，又喝出一道指令。%SPEECH_ON%现在反过来。脚后撤，身体跟上。别先在脑子里想着退，让脚替你想。本能才能活命！迟疑思量就是死！动起来，仿佛整个世界都逼着你动。风一吹，树叶便应声而起，你能比它更快吗？嗯，好……你开始明白了。现在……再来。%SPEECH_OFF%

230221f9f46bb85733a7.source: Now put it to good use.
230221f9f46bb85733a7.translation: 现在，把学到的本事用起来。

9ea32167a9902ec64a1b.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]While stressing over where to go and when, %tailor% the tailor walks into your tent, something dark and heavy wrapped over both his outstretched arms. You take a step back, seeing what look like claws or some such manifestation glinting in the candlelight.

The tailor explains that he's made a suit of armor stitched together by the hide of direwolves. He sets the armor down on the table where a few left-over claws rap against the wood with deadly weight. He unfolds the armor and shows it in whole, a ghastly thing of black and sharpened bones, a creature shorn of its insides, left to be occupied by man or some other creature seeking warmth in its emptied hide, the head of the beast tilted up to look at its soon to be wearer. Altogether fearsome, no doubt, and has you pondering when and where the tailor got such an idea in the first place.
9ea32167a9902ec64a1b.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]你正为接下来去哪儿、何时动身发愁，裁缝%tailor%走进帐篷，伸出的双臂上搭着一团又黑又沉的东西。烛光下，像是利爪的物件闪了一闪，吓得你后退一步。

裁缝解释，他用恐狼皮缝成了一套盔甲。他将它放到桌上，留在皮上的几根爪子沉沉敲中木面，声响透着凶险。随后，他展开整副甲胄：漆黑皮毛与尖利骨头拼成一件骇人的东西，仿佛野兽被掏空内里，留下皮囊，等人或别的寻暖生物钻进去。兽首微微仰起，凝视着未来的穿戴者。毫无疑问，这甲够吓人，也让你不禁琢磨，裁缝究竟何时、又是从哪里想出了这种主意。

68168874e6b72e1f6152.translation: 光是看着就令人胆寒的护甲。

a08ac988ba70ed0a7ae7.source: %terrainImage%While on the path, you come to a man being dangled upside down from a tree branch. A bunch of men are sitting around him sharing a goatskin flask, looking like they're at the end of a day's hard work. When you ask what is going on, one of them looks up and smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Whipping this fella 'til he's raw.%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what for. Another man answers.%SPEECH_ON%Fornicating with this fella's wife.%SPEECH_OFF%A man drinking spurts and chokes on his drink. He wipes his mouth.%SPEECH_ON%Hardy-farkin'-har, very funny. No, this scumbag was caught farkin my dead horse.%SPEECH_OFF%
a08ac988ba70ed0a7ae7.translation: %terrainImage%行路途中，你看见一个男人被倒吊在树枝上。一群人围坐四周，传着羊皮酒囊，像是刚忙完一天的重活。你问怎么回事，其中一人抬头笑道：%SPEECH_ON%把这家伙抽得皮开肉绽。%SPEECH_OFF%你问为什么，另一个人回答：%SPEECH_ON%他跟这老兄的老婆鬼混。%SPEECH_OFF%一个正在喝酒的男人喷了出来，呛得直咳。他抹抹嘴。%SPEECH_ON%哈、他妈的、哈，真好笑。才不是，这人渣是在糟蹋我的死马时被逮住的。%SPEECH_OFF%

243fdf08a8c6d478c213.source: Let's talk to the dangling man.
243fdf08a8c6d478c213.translation: 去跟那个吊着的人谈谈。

475b88952af809715221.source: %terrainImage%You walk over to the dangling man. There's blood running down his back, streaking from a dozen slashes. He's got a cloth covering his eyes which you pull down. Blinking, he asks what it is you want as though you're interrupting his own hiding. You ask him if what they say is true. He spits and clears his throat.%SPEECH_ON%I mean, yeah, but the horse was dead, so of what matter was it? Can't a man have his fun?%SPEECH_OFF%The horse owner gets up, brandishing a dripping whip.%SPEECH_ON%Oy, you want us to go back at it? We got all day!%SPEECH_OFF%Sighing, the dangling man asks you a question.%SPEECH_ON%Yer a sellsword, right? Why don't I come and fight for ya? I'm a strong and able bodied man, a little horse, I mean worse, for the wear, but that aside, and the, uh, dead animal thing, I'm a man of upstanding and moral sensibilities.%SPEECH_OFF%
475b88952af809715221.translation: %terrainImage%你走到被吊着的男人面前。他背上十几道鞭痕流着血，蜿蜒成线。你拉下蒙住他双眼的布，他眨眨眼，问你想干什么，仿佛挨鞭子是他的私事，而你多管闲事。你问，那些人说的是否属实。他啐了一口，清清嗓子。%SPEECH_ON%嗯，是，可马已经死了，又有什么关系？就不许人找点乐子？%SPEECH_OFF%马主人站起身，挥着滴血的鞭子。%SPEECH_ON%喂，还想挨抽？咱们有的是工夫！%SPEECH_OFF%吊着的男人叹口气，转而问你。%SPEECH_ON%你是佣兵，对吧？不如让我跟你打仗？我身强力壮，只是有点马……不，是有点惨。除此之外，再除去，呃，那死牲畜的事，我可是个正直、有道德的人。%SPEECH_OFF%

ae23ee213226082243fe.source: %terrainImage%You take out your blade and cut the man down. He crumples onto his shoulders and splays out, his lashed back in the dirt. The soil may as well have been salt judging by his wailing. One of the whippers stands up.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, just what do you think you're doing? We ain't finished here!%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% draws his weapon and the man backs off. The horse owner spits and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Are you really going to defend this piece of work? Ain't that some fucking horseshit. I guess now I can say I've seen it all which is exactly what I said when I caught this bastard porkin' my dead horse!%SPEECH_OFF%The man catches his breath then points at the recently rescued.%SPEECH_ON%I hope you die on your first day out ya filly fiddling bastard.%SPEECH_OFF%
ae23ee213226082243fe.translation: %terrainImage%你拔出刀，割断绳索，把那人放了下来。他肩头着地，瘫倒在地，挨过鞭打的后背贴上泥土。听那惨叫，不知道的还以为地上铺的是盐。一个执鞭的人站了起来。%SPEECH_ON%喂，你想干什么？咱们还没打完呢！%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%拔出武器，那人便退缩了。马主人啐了一口，摇着头。%SPEECH_ON%你真要护着这号货色？真他妈荒唐。我这回算是开眼了——说起来，抓住这混蛋干我那匹死马时，我也是这么说的！%SPEECH_OFF%他喘了口气，指向刚获救的家伙。%SPEECH_ON%你这糟蹋母马的畜生，祝你上路第一天就死！%SPEECH_OFF%

97e6a0bd2aaaec3e2e47.translation: 欢迎入伙，你这玩马的混账。

3c859e2e5c9912256cb7.source: Just go. We have no place for you.
3c859e2e5c9912256cb7.translation: 走吧，我们这里没你的位置。

56be6fd6b2a1b8484d27.source: %terrainImage%You take out your blade and cut the man down. He falls right on his head and his neck breaks with a disgusting crack. The rest of his body crumples with his legs awkwardly heaved over his own chest, a position no doubt strange to this sexual deviant.
