There is all manner of chaos going on behind you - tools and weapons being broke, brothers running for their lives, and the absolute bedlam of a bunch of confused men beset by a wildman - but you dare not look.
6e50bdc56de53d3733ef.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你蹲下来，看着那堆散乱的克朗。%SPEECH_ON%亮闪闪的，真好看，是吧？%SPEECH_OFF%荒野人哼了一声，想把你赶走。你不肯走，反倒拿起一枚克朗。他停下手里的动作，猛地抬头瞪着你。你慢慢放下钱币，拿出一根顶端缠着绳子的木棍。他的目光缓和了；对这邋遢的荒野人来说，一根结实又趁手的木棍显然很有吸引力。你比划着，表示愿意用它换那些克朗。他拿走木棍，你拿走克朗。

 可荒野人刚拨弄起绳子，绳子便脱落，被风吹走了。他叫了一声，随即满眼杀气地盯住你。而你还站在原地，双臂圈得像只桶，费力抱着全部克朗。荒野人放声尖叫。你丢下钱，以最快的速度拔腿就跑。身后乱成一团：工具和武器被砸断，弟兄们四处逃命，一群摸不着头脑的男人遭到荒野人袭击，闹得鸡飞狗跳。可你根本不敢回头。

1d1cd3fb1f03c09ee825.source: Probably should not have done that.

5b666269f689b03cf980.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{You stroll into %townname% just in time to see a smoldering body keel forward from the blackened stake onto which they were tied. A few citizens pass you, cheering the death of a witch. Curious as to whether or not this was true, your very own witchhunter, %witchhunter%, goes to the body and examines it. With a sigh, he looks back at you and shakes his head. | %townname% welcomes you with horrifying screams. Three of its citizens are in the town center being burned alive. The fires grow beneath them until the flames come licking their feet, then crawling up their legs, drawing them to cry out for mercy to which the crowds responds by throwing rocks.

You about draw your sword to end this injustice when %witchhunter_short% the witchhunter stays your hand. He shakes his head and points at the burnings. Soon enough, the begging stops and all three victims open their mouths, issuing forth a rumbling that silences the crowd and even the crackle of fire beneath them. They speak in a guttural, uniform voice.%SPEECH_ON%Ye who watches us perish, shall perish themselves!%SPEECH_OFF%The bodies suddenly slump forward as though instantly made dead and the cooking of their flesh resumes with a steady popping. The witchhunter orders your men to look away, which you quickly do, and behind you comes renewed screams, but this time from the townspeople themselves. You shant forget this moment anytime soon.}
5b666269f689b03cf980.translation:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]{你走进%townname%，恰好看见一具仍在冒烟的尸体，从捆绑它的焦黑木桩上向前栽下。几个镇民从你身边经过，为女巫之死欢呼。你们自己的猎巫人%witchhunter%想知道死者究竟是不是女巫，便走过去检查尸体。最后，他叹了口气，回头朝你摇摇头。 | %townname%以可怕的惨叫迎接了你。三个镇民正在镇中心被活活烧死。火势从脚下升起，舔上双足，又爬上双腿，逼得他们开口求饶，人群却以石头回应。

你正要拔剑阻止这场暴行，猎巫人%witchhunter_short%却按住你的手，摇头指向火刑架。不久，求饶声停了。三人一齐张嘴，发出低沉的轰鸣，压住了人群的声音，甚至盖过脚下柴火的噼啪声。他们用同一个喉音粗重的声音说道。%SPEECH_ON%目睹吾等灭亡之人，也必将灭亡！%SPEECH_OFF%三具身体忽然向前垂下，仿佛顷刻间便已死去，烧灼的皮肉又开始不断爆响。猎巫人叫弟兄们转开目光，你也立即照做。身后再次响起惨叫，这一回，却来自围观的镇民。短时间内，你怕是忘不了这一幕。}

89126cc373c4b5c63951.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]%witchhunter% the witch hunter comes to you with a vial of unknown liquid.%SPEECH_ON%Anti-poison.%SPEECH_OFF%He explains. He pops the cork off and gives you a smell. There's a strong scent of piss. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, it's wretched, but you need the wretched to fight the wretched, and a goblin's poison is a real wretched matter to contend with. But this will help.%SPEECH_OFF%
89126cc373c4b5c63951.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_05.png[/img]猎巫人%witchhunter%拿着一小瓶不明液体来找你。%SPEECH_ON%解毒药。%SPEECH_OFF%他解释道，拔开瓶塞让你闻。浓烈的尿骚味扑鼻而来。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，很恶心。可就得用恶心东西对付恶心东西，地精的毒尤其难缠。这药能帮上忙。%SPEECH_OFF%

4199a3669a4028ab07c4.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_34.png[/img]{You discover %woundedbrother% passed out in the grass and there's no mead or ale beside him as a sort of coma culprit. Crouching down, you see that his eyes are dimmed and he does not respond to questions. His chest rises and falls to uneven breathing. You peel back the dressings over his %wound% to reveal green, sickly flesh. | %woundedbrother% is laughing with the rest of the men when he suddenly falls over with his eyes going to the back of his head. The rest of the men rush to his aid.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, his wound's beyond sore.%SPEECH_OFF%The flesh around his %wound% has gotten pulpy, slathered with dead skin and the pulsing viridian of infections ready to be sloughed off. | %woundedbrother%'s %wound% has gotten infected. The flesh around the injury is black and that which has color is green, both very bad signs. | Infection is settling into %woundedbrother%'s %wound%. There's no saying if he'll survive or not, but either way he's going to be in bad shape for a time. | You come to find %woundedbrother% leaning against a tree. He's shaking and saliva is dropping from his lips.%SPEECH_ON%I'm alright, sir. My %wound%'s just... a little infected. Give me time, I'll get better.%SPEECH_OFF%You purse your lips. Perhaps he'll get better on his own, but he'll be hardly in fighting shape if he goes without care. | %woundedbrother% is no longer in sound fighting shape. His wounds have gotten infected. Without immediate care, it may take some time for him to get back into fighting shape. | %woundedbrother% stumbles into your tent. He coughs into the crook of his elbow and a stringy bit of saliva trails between it and his lips.%SPEECH_ON%Ah shit, sorry sir. I'm uh, I think I'm a little sick.%SPEECH_OFF%Taking a look at him, you surmise that his wounds have gotten infected. He may still be able to fight, but you probably shouldn't risk that until he gets better. | While the company eats around a campfire, %woundedbrother% suddenly vomits. You see that there's sweat all over his brow and his eyes are a bit dazed. %otherbrother% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, his wounds have gotten infected.%SPEECH_OFF%The wounded brother sails back into the grass, arms pawing the air.%SPEECH_ON%I'm fine, ya gits. I'll fight the lot of you.%SPEECH_OFF%His balled fists pedal back and forth before he slides into a deep sleep. Yeah, he's probably not gonna be battle ready for awhile. | Battles take a toll on men, and sometimes they survive wounds that come back to get them. %woundedbrother% is such a man - infection from injuries has spread about his body. He's very sick and should not fight unless absolutely necessary. | With each battle, a man risks death. With each injury, he risks infection. %woundedbrother% has received the latter and it just may preempt the former. His wounds have become black and where they aren't black they are green. He's able to walk, but should probably be kept out of the frontlines until he gets better. | A man may survive a battle with terrible wounds, but it only starts another battle against infection. %woundedbrother%'s injuries have gotten worse and may need time to heal. Unless absolutely necessary, he should be kept out of the frontlines. | %woundedbrother%'s injuries have gotten worse, possibly infected. Some suggest maggots to help clear out the infection, while others hint at amputations and more drastic measures. As far as you're concerned, you simply need to give it time. That said, the mercenary should probably be kept out of the fights until he gets better.}
4199a3669a4028ab07c4.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_34.png[/img]{你发现%woundedbrother%昏倒在草里，旁边却没有蜂蜜酒或麦酒，不能把昏迷怪在酒上。蹲下细看，他眼神黯淡，对提问毫无反应，胸口随着不均匀的呼吸起伏。你揭开%wound%上的包扎，露出发绿的病变血肉。 | %woundedbrother%正与弟兄们说笑，忽然双眼翻白，倒了下去。众人赶紧上前救助。%SPEECH_ON%长官，他那伤，可不只是疼了。%SPEECH_OFF%%wound%周围的皮肉已经软烂，覆着死皮，感染处泛着深绿色，鼓动着，仿佛随时会剥落。 | %woundedbrother%的%wound%已经感染。伤口周围的血肉发黑，没黑的地方则发绿，两样都不是好兆头。 | 感染正在%woundedbrother%的%wound%处蔓延。能否活下来，还不好说，不过无论如何，他得难受一阵了。 | 你发现%woundedbrother%正靠着树，浑身发抖，唾液从嘴角滴下。%SPEECH_ON%我没事，长官。我的%wound%只是……有点感染。给我点时间，会好的。%SPEECH_OFF%你抿紧嘴。也许他会自行好转，可若无人照料，短时间内怕是难以作战。 | %woundedbrother%已不适合继续作战，他的伤口感染了。若不立即护理，恐怕得过些时日才能恢复战力。 | %woundedbrother%踉跄着走进帐篷，对着臂弯咳嗽，一丝黏稠唾液牵在手臂与嘴唇之间。%SPEECH_ON%啊，该死，抱歉，长官。我，呃，我想自己有点病了。%SPEECH_OFF%看过他的状况，你判断是伤口感染。他也许还能打，可好起来之前，大概不该让他冒这个险。 | 战团围着篝火吃饭时，%woundedbrother%突然吐了。你看见他额头满是汗，眼神也有些恍惚。%otherbrother%摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%长官，他的伤口感染了。%SPEECH_OFF%受伤的弟兄向后栽进草里，双臂在空中乱抓。%SPEECH_ON%我没事，你们这些蠢货。我能跟你们全打上一架。%SPEECH_OFF%他握拳来回挥舞，随后沉沉睡去。是啊，看来一时半会儿，是上不了战场了。 | 战斗会伤人，有时，人虽熬过当时的伤，伤口却会回来索命。%woundedbrother%便是如此，创伤引发的感染已扩散全身。他病得很重，除非万不得已，不该再上阵。 | 每场战斗，都有死亡的风险；每次受伤，都有感染的风险。%woundedbrother%遇上了后者，而它很可能引来前者。伤口已变黑，没黑的地方则发绿。他还能走动，可恢复之前，最好离前线远些。 | 一个人也许能带着重伤活着离开战场，却只是转而开始另一场对抗感染的战斗。%woundedbrother%的伤势恶化，需要时间愈合。除非万不得已，否则应当让他远离前线。 | %woundedbrother%的伤势恶化，可能已经感染。有人提议用蛆虫清理感染处，也有人提出截肢，甚至更激烈的办法。依你看，只需给它些时间。不过，在恢复之前，这名佣兵最好还是别再参战。}

685a1b29adf5473ad5b5.source: {Hope you'll pull through. | That doesn't look good. | Go get some rest, %woundedbrothershort%.}
685a1b29adf5473ad5b5.translation: {但愿你能挺过去。 | 这可不太妙。 | %woundedbrothershort%，去歇着吧。}

a72be4b9a836c2599f97.source: {Good to have you back. | Good as new.}
a72be4b9a836c2599f97.translation: {回来就好。 | 又生龙活虎了。}

279d4bc9a74c041dc75a.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_34.png[/img]{You go to check on %hurtbrother% - he'd suffered a terrible wound not long ago and sometimes it can lift a man's spirits just to let him know others care. Thinking you'll find the man nursing his injuries, you instead are surprised to see that he is in good health. The wounds have apparently healed in such speedy fashion that others might call it a miracle. | %hurtbrother% was injured in battle and you figure it'd be best to go see how he is doing. Surprisingly, he's doing quite well. His wounds have healed in such quick fashion you almost want to believe he consulted some dark arts while no one was looking. There are no signs of black magics around, just one sturdy and hard to kill man of flesh and blood. | %hurtbrother% enters your tent and flashes his wound - or what's left of it. The garish thing has seemingly healed entirely. The mercenary looks at you with a giddy smile.%SPEECH_ON%They'll have to try harder to take me out of this world, captain.%SPEECH_OFF% | %hurtbrother% comes into your tent and shows off an old wound. He speaks excitedly.%SPEECH_ON%Is that a miracle or what?%SPEECH_OFF%The injury has healed almost completely. You tell the man that he's made of hardier things and the gods had nothing to do with it. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%You need to have more faith.%SPEECH_OFF% | You go looking for %hurtbrother% - the mercenary had taken quite the injury last you saw. The man, however, is in high spirits. He turns to you, taking a break from sharpening some steel.%SPEECH_ON%Need something, sir?%SPEECH_OFF%You inquire about his injury. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%I don't die easy. {I ate a lot of them pointy orange things when I was young. | I ate a lot of lettuce growing up. One might say I'm hard to... kale.}%SPEECH_OFF%}
279d4bc9a74c041dc75a.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_34.png[/img]{你去探望%hurtbrother%。不久前，他受了重伤，有时只要让人知道还有人关心，便能提振精神。你以为会见到他苦熬伤痛，却惊讶地发现，他已经十分健康。伤口恢复得如此之快，旁人恐怕要称之为奇迹。 | %hurtbrother%在战斗中受伤，你觉得最好去看看他的情况。出乎意料，他恢复得相当不错。伤口好得如此之快，让你几乎怀疑，他是不是趁无人注意求助了某种邪术。可周围没有黑魔法的痕迹，只有一个结实、命硬的血肉之躯。 | %hurtbrother%走进帐篷，亮出伤口——或者说，伤口剩下的那点痕迹。原先那道狰狞创伤，似乎已彻底愈合。佣兵兴高采烈地笑着望你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，想把我送出这个世界，他们还得再加把劲。%SPEECH_OFF% | %hurtbrother%走进帐篷，展示一处旧伤，兴奋地说道。%SPEECH_ON%这不是奇迹，是什么？%SPEECH_OFF%伤口几乎完全愈合了。你告诉他，是他筋骨强健，与诸神无关。他摇摇头。%SPEECH_ON%你得多些信仰。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你去找%hurtbrother%。上次见面时，他伤得相当重，如今却精神抖擞。他停下磨刃，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%长官，有事吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你问起伤势，他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我没那么容易死。{小时候，我吃了不少尖尖的橙色玩意儿。 | 我从小吃了不少生菜。论挨刀，我可没那么……菜。}%SPEECH_OFF%}

2ed987d1df29c441cc90.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_34.png[/img]{You go to check on %hurtbrother% - he'd suffered a terrible wound not long ago and sometimes it can lift a man's spirits just to let him know others care. Thinking you'll find the man nursing his injuries, you instead are surprised to see that he is in good health. The wounds have apparently healed in such speedy fashion that others might call it a miracle. | %hurtbrother% was injured in battle and you figure it'd be best to go see how he is doing. Surprisingly, he's doing quite well. His wounds have healed in such quick fashion you almost want to believe he consulted some dark arts while no one was looking. There are no signs of black magics around, just one sturdy and hard to kill man of flesh and blood. | %hurtbrother% enters your tent and flashes his wound - or what's left of it. The garish thing has seemingly healed entirely. The mercenary looks at you with a giddy smile.%SPEECH_ON%They'll have to try harder to take me out of this world, captain.%SPEECH_OFF% | %hurtbrother% comes into your tent and shows off an old wound. He speaks excitedly.%SPEECH_ON%Is that a miracle or what?%SPEECH_OFF%The injury has healed almost completely. You tell the man that he's made of hardier things and the gods had nothing to do with it. He nods.%SPEECH_ON%Yeah, I know. But it'd be nice if they were looking out for me, too. Just in case...%SPEECH_OFF% | You go looking for %hurtbrother% - the mercenary had taken quite the injury last you saw. The man, however, is in high spirits. He turns to you, taking a break from sharpening some steel.%SPEECH_ON%Need something sir?%SPEECH_OFF%You inquire about his injury. He shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%I don't die easy. {I ate a lot of them pointy orange things when I was young. | I ate a lot of lettuce growing up. One might say I'm hard to... kale.}%SPEECH_OFF%}
2ed987d1df29c441cc90.translation: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_34.png[/img]{你去探望%hurtbrother%。不久前，他受了重伤，有时只要让人知道还有人关心，便能提振精神。你以为会见到他苦熬伤痛，却惊讶地发现，他已经十分健康。伤口恢复得如此之快，旁人恐怕要称之为奇迹。 | %hurtbrother%在战斗中受伤，你觉得最好去看看他的情况。出乎意料，他恢复得相当不错。伤口好得如此之快，让你几乎怀疑，他是不是趁无人注意求助了某种邪术。可周围没有黑魔法的痕迹，只有一个结实、命硬的血肉之躯。 | %hurtbrother%走进帐篷，亮出伤口——或者说，伤口剩下的那点痕迹。原先那道狰狞创伤，似乎已彻底愈合。佣兵兴高采烈地笑着望你。%SPEECH_ON%团长，想把我送出这个世界，他们还得再加把劲。%SPEECH_OFF% | %hurtbrother%走进帐篷，展示一处旧伤，兴奋地说道。%SPEECH_ON%这不是奇迹，是什么？%SPEECH_OFF%伤口几乎完全愈合了。你告诉他，是他筋骨强健，与诸神无关。他点头。%SPEECH_ON%是，我知道。不过，要是祂们也肯照看我，那就更好了。以防万一嘛……%SPEECH_OFF% | 你去找%hurtbrother%。上次见面时，他伤得相当重，如今却精神抖擞。他停下磨刃，转向你。%SPEECH_ON%长官，有事吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你问起伤势，他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%我没那么容易死。{小时候，我吃了不少尖尖的橙色玩意儿。 | 我从小吃了不少生菜。论挨刀，我可没那么……菜。}%SPEECH_OFF%}

6047f9e20e16546192f6.source: A ship transporting goods and passengers.
6047f9e20e16546192f6.translation: 一艘载运货物和旅客的船。

33fc75eaf036b871421e.source: A band of barbarians out to hunt game.

1be5cdd551bc1294314e.source: Pale and haggard creatures creeping around.
1be5cdd551bc1294314e.translation: 苍白枯槁的生物四处潜行。

0481e3aaff913fc69b8d.source: A malevolent old crone, said to lure and abduct little children to make broth and concoctions out of, strike sinister pacts with villagers, and weave curses.
0481e3aaff913fc69b8d.translation: 一个恶毒的老妪。据说她会诱拐孩童，将其熬成汤药，还会与村民订立邪恶的契约，施展诅咒。

1367f648fc04612e172c.source: A tentacled horror from another age.
1367f648fc04612e172c.translation: 来自远古时代的触手怪物，令人毛骨悚然。

5a454dbee2f587c102bb.source: A band of nomads scouting the area.
5a454dbee2f587c102bb.translation: 一群正在侦察周围地区的游牧民。

c26a4f95d39dbcdf9dfc.source: Farmers, craftsmen, pilgrims or other citizens of the great city states on their way between settlements.
c26a4f95d39dbcdf9dfc.translation: 农夫、工匠、朝圣者或其他城邦居民，正往来于各处聚落之间。

7424d4b624019ed9d4ff.source: Farmers, craftsmen, pilgrims or other peasants on their way between settlements.
7424d4b624019ed9d4ff.translation: 农夫、工匠、朝圣者或其他平民，正往来于各处聚落之间。

ba47c4a1b3e18581e155.source: Refugees fleeing the horrors of war - beaten down, tired and desperate.
ba47c4a1b3e18581e155.translation: 逃离战火的难民，饱受摧残，疲惫而绝望。

b5144fe3e6a74517bfdc.source: This necklace fashioned from trophies taken of various Alps declares the one wearing it a veteran of battle against supernatural nocturnal predators, and not easily daunted.
b5144fe3e6a74517bfdc.translation: 这条项链由数只梦魇身上的战利品制成。佩戴它的人曾与这些超自然的夜行猎食者交锋，身经百战，绝不会轻易畏缩。

1f528c4795afde73561a.source: An antidote for various types of poisons. Tastes quite bitter.
1f528c4795afde73561a.translation: 能解多种毒的药剂，味道苦涩。

07df2d90e514ee803274.source: A strong and loyal dog bred for war. Can be unleashed in battle for scouting, tracking or running down routing enemies. This one wears a leather coat for protection against cutting wounds.
07df2d90e514ee803274.translation: 为战争培育的战犬，强壮而忠诚。战斗中可将它放出，用于侦察、追踪或追击溃逃的敌人。这只战犬披着皮甲，能够抵御劈砍。

ef99af651a55e5375dfd.source: A strong and loyal northern hound bred for war. Can be unleashed in battle for scouting, tracking or running down routing enemies. This one wears a leather coat for protection against cutting wounds.
ef99af651a55e5375dfd.translation: 为战争培育的北方战猎犬，强壮而忠诚。战斗中可将它放出，用于侦察、追踪或追击溃逃的敌人。这只战猎犬披着皮甲，能够抵御劈砍。

2df95308d35226183abd.source: Clean bandages that can be used in combat to apply pressure to bleeding wounds and stop any hemorrhaging.
2df95308d35226183abd.translation: 干净的绷带，可在战斗中包扎伤口，通过加压止住流血。

243051bbe78caa258f1e.source: Strange mushrooms that have anyone chewing them enter a trance-like state of rage where they don't feel any pain and exhibit significantly increased aggression. Eat responsibly. Lasts for the next battle.
243051bbe78caa258f1e.translation: 嚼下这些奇异的蘑菇，便会陷入恍惚般的狂怒，感觉不到疼痛，攻击性也会大幅增强。食用请适量。效果持续下一场战斗。

e306821d9d8de1055aa5.source: No morale check triggered upon losing hitpoints
e306821d9d8de1055aa5.translation: 损失生命值时不会触发士气检定

3a756c08b1199544e2d2.source: Right-click or drag onto the currently selected character in order to eat. This item will be consumed in the process.
3a756c08b1199544e2d2.translation: 右键点击，或拖到当前选中的角色身上即可食用。使用后物品消失。

47b3ced28af14b54ca09.translation: 过量食用可能导致患病

d248083a63279b2a695f.source: Be quick as a cat! This potion promises to heighten your senses and sharpen your reflexes. Drink responsibly. Lasts for the next battle.
d248083a63279b2a695f.translation: 像猫一样敏捷！这瓶药剂号称能增强感官，让反应更加敏锐。饮用请适量。效果持续下一场战斗。

9d189a5cab9835e61db6.source: Right-click or drag onto the currently selected character in order to drink. This item will be consumed in the process.
9d189a5cab9835e61db6.translation: 右键点击，或拖到当前选中的角色身上即可饮用。使用后物品消失。

e3335338732e26a11d81.source: A trained falcon. Can be released in battle to discover hidden prey.
e3335338732e26a11d81.translation: 一只训练有素的猎鹰。战斗中可将它放飞，寻找隐藏的猎物。

bfc839829db5f0c4271b.source: This necklace fashioned from trophies taken of various Nachzehrers declares the one wearing it a veteran of battle against feral beasts, and not easily daunted.
bfc839829db5f0c4271b.translation: 这条项链由数只食尸鬼身上的战利品制成。佩戴它的人曾与凶残的野兽交锋，身经百战，绝不会轻易畏缩。

86e9a338f0f028c5e4d3.source: This necklace of goblin ears declares the one wearing it a veteran of many battles against the green menace, and not one to fall to their dirty little tricks anymore.
86e9a338f0f028c5e4d3.translation: 这条由地精耳朵串成的项链，昭示着佩戴者曾多次击败这些绿皮祸害，早已识破它们卑劣的小伎俩。

7427acb486a630f1892f.source: Grants immunity to being rooted by nets or grasping vines
7427acb486a630f1892f.translation: 免疫捕网和缠绕藤蔓的束缚

a021cb0338e1a6ccac69.source: A strong and loyal dog bred for war. Can be unleashed in battle for scouting, tracking or running down routing enemies. This one wears a heavy hide coat for protection.
a021cb0338e1a6ccac69.translation: 为战争培育的战犬，强壮而忠诚。战斗中可将它放出，用于侦察、追踪或追击溃逃的敌人。这只战犬披着厚重的兽皮甲。

efe98ec013e908c3be5b.source: A strong and loyal northern hound bred for war. Can be unleashed in battle for scouting, tracking or running down routing enemies. This one wears a heavy hide coat for protection.
efe98ec013e908c3be5b.translation: 为战争培育的北方战猎犬，强壮而忠诚。战斗中可将它放出，用于侦察、追踪或追击溃逃的敌人。这只战猎犬披着厚重的兽皮甲。

8725e53bc4c9ec452727.source: This necklace fashioned from trophies taken of slain Hexen declares the one wearing it a veteran of battle against vile sorcery, and not easily daunted.
8725e53bc4c9ec452727.translation: 这条项链由被杀女巫身上的战利品制成。佩戴它的人曾与邪恶巫术交锋，身经百战，绝不会轻易畏缩。

8caea939d1929e68b531.source: A drink to numb the pain and get the juices flowing. Expect a major burning sensation in your throat. Drink responsibly. Lasts for the next battle.
8caea939d1929e68b531.translation: 这种饮剂能麻痹痛觉，让人精神振奋。喝下去时，喉咙会有强烈的灼烧感。饮用请适量。效果持续下一场战斗。

09ad47b5068ef8b22d7d.source: Not affected by non-permanent injuries, new or old
09ad47b5068ef8b22d7d.translation: 不受任何暂时性伤势的影响，包括已有伤势和新伤

5e5f937dbcadd0f185e1.source: An eerie skull carved from a single large crystal. No scratch or other mark can be seen on its surface. Just being near it kills the fire of determination in almost any man, breaks hope and lets sprout doubts.
5e5f937dbcadd0f185e1.translation: 一颗由整块大水晶雕成的诡异骷髅，表面找不到一丝划痕。几乎任何人只要靠近它，心中的斗志就会熄灭，希望破碎，疑虑丛生。

ba14e27043fcbc4d5eb0.source: Reduces the Resolve of any opponent engaged in melee by [color=
ba14e27043fcbc4d5eb0.translation: 使与佩戴者近战交锋的敌人的决心降低[color=

21331a0262233bd8b3f0.translation: 佩戴者的士气永远无法达到[color=

d4f83b2314d6c259a687.source: Be brave as a lion! This potion inhibits fear and promotes courage, up to and including the gross overestimation of one's own abilities. Drink responsibly. Lasts for the next battle.
d4f83b2314d6c259a687.translation: 像狮子一样勇敢！这瓶药剂能压下恐惧、激发勇气，甚至让人严重高估自己的本事。饮用请适量。效果持续下一场战斗。

4586248829cbd64a9e00.source: This elixir, when consumed, brightens up the night as if it were the mid of day. Drink responsibly. Lasts for the next battle.
4586248829cbd64a9e00.translation: 喝下这瓶灵药，黑夜便会亮如白昼。饮用请适量。效果持续下一场战斗。

5d23dbaa8f18503bfa7f.source: The skull of Young Anselm, the first Oathtaker. Adorning oneself with such a priceless artifact would surely fill any man to the brim with honor and courage.
5d23dbaa8f18503bfa7f.translation: 首位立誓者——小安塞尔姆的头骨。将这件无价的圣物佩戴在身，定能让人满怀荣耀与勇气。

9af45de50460afba4139.translation: 小安塞尔姆的头骨与颌骨

e023ecf7c24c6036cbb1.source: The skull of Young Anselm, the first Oathtaker, worn alongside a reliquary containing his fractured jawbone. To enter battle adorned with such a powerful relic is to have complete assurance in victory, for who could be defeated with Young Anselm at their side?
e023ecf7c24c6036cbb1.translation: 首位立誓者——小安塞尔姆的头骨，以及装着他碎裂颌骨的圣物匣。带着如此强大的圣物步入战场，胜利便仿佛已成定局。毕竟，有小安塞尔姆相伴，又有谁会落败呢？

b6aed0a982f2a241b04b.source: Will start combat at confident morale if permitted by mood
b6aed0a982f2a241b04b.translation: 心情允许时，以自信士气进入战斗

2ac906ac277046775b8c.source: This necklace of bones taken from a berserking orc declares the one wearing it a veteran of many battles against the green beasts, and not one to be bested by their brute force.
2ac906ac277046775b8c.translation: 这条由兽人狂战士的骨头制成的项链，昭示着佩戴者曾多次击败这些绿皮猛兽，绝不会屈服于它们的蛮力。

fcb469a9c9906b4b616e.source: A flask of spider poison used by goblins. Can be used to coat your weapons and arrowtips.
fcb469a9c9906b4b616e.translation: 一瓶地精使用的蜘蛛毒液，可涂在武器和箭头上。

896f8a9becdde14e7884.source: A fatigued fighter is a dead fighter. This concoction of adrenaline and plant-based stimulants can be used to go the extra mile. Lasts for the next battle.
896f8a9becdde14e7884.translation: 筋疲力尽的战士离死不远。这种混合了肾上腺素和植物兴奋剂的药液，能让你再坚持一阵。效果持续下一场战斗。

6bb5e86ca9db4d49eaea.source: A sash worn by the company's sergeant, your second-in-command on the battlefield.
6bb5e86ca9db4d49eaea.translation: 战团军士佩戴的绶带。他是你在战场上的副手。

cc2e1206873f178bba7a.source: A collar worn by combatants in southern arenas.
cc2e1206873f178bba7a.translation: 南方竞技场斗士佩戴的项圈。

23d244a3780ca9f30c05.source: A necklace made out of what appear to be orc bones.
23d244a3780ca9f30c05.translation: 一条项链，似乎是用兽人的骨头制成的。

99609b34675999896066.source: A flask of oil laced with concentrated webknecht poison. Can be used to coat your weapons and arrowtips.
99609b34675999896066.translation: 一瓶掺有浓缩巨蛛毒液的油，可涂在武器和箭头上。

43bb7f4bfa3c0b03f71e.source: This ancient necklace taken from a pile of bones declares the one wearing it a veteran of many battles against the undead scourge, and one not to waver easily in the face of their horror.
43bb7f4bfa3c0b03f71e.translation: 这条从骸骨堆中取出的古老项链，昭示着佩戴者曾多次迎战亡灵大军，即使面对它们的恐怖威势也不会轻易动摇。

23b32545b156229870fb.source: Doubles your Resolve if defending against fear and mind control abilities
23b32545b156229870fb.translation: 抵抗恐惧和精神控制技能时，决心翻倍

42f8ca1a91e629d5668e.source: The collar of a wardog that has been unleashed onto the battlefield.
42f8ca1a91e629d5668e.translation: 战犬留下的项圈；它已被放入战场。

097a18ad157c8567db2a.source: A strong and loyal dog bred for war. Can be unleashed in battle for scouting, tracking or running down routing enemies.
097a18ad157c8567db2a.translation: 为战争培育的战犬，强壮而忠诚。战斗中可将它放出，用于侦察、追踪或追击溃逃的敌人。

b83e6d8e3cc5e87a1fd5.source: The collar of a warhound that has been unleashed onto the battlefield.
b83e6d8e3cc5e87a1fd5.translation: 战獒已被放上战场，手中只剩下它的项圈。

d672fab3368a383035f4.source: A strong and loyal northern hound bred for war. Can be unleashed in battle for scouting, tracking or running down routing enemies.
d672fab3368a383035f4.translation: 为战争培育的北方战猎犬，强壮而忠诚。战斗中可将它放出，用于侦察、追踪或追击溃逃的敌人。

81d35bd6fccf39704cfe.source: Unleash your warhound and send him charging into the enemy. Needs a free tile adjacent.
81d35bd6fccf39704cfe.translation: 松开战獒，命它扑向敌人。身旁须有一格空地。

9e0179b95ec332b8fc36.source: The collar of a wolf that has been unleashed onto the battlefield.
9e0179b95ec332b8fc36.translation: 战狼留下的项圈；它已被放入战场。

d840c5ad457f1a5731a3.source: A strong and wild wolf, tamed to be a loyal companion in battle. Can be unleashed in battle for scouting, tracking or running down routing enemies.
d840c5ad457f1a5731a3.translation: 一头强壮而野性十足的狼，经过驯养后成为了忠诚的战友。战斗中可将它放出，用于侦察、追踪或追击溃逃的敌人。

7f542437ff07beb18cf0.source: A large bag of black powder, used for arming exotic firearms. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.
7f542437ff07beb18cf0.translation: 一大袋黑火药，用于装填异域火器。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

1d7d1883791d662133d1.source: A large quiver of arrows, required to use bows of all kinds. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.
1d7d1883791d662133d1.translation: 一个大箭袋，使用各类弓时需要配备。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

a3c3751f9c6570dac108.source: A large quiver of bolts, required to use crossbows. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.
a3c3751f9c6570dac108.translation: 一个大弩矢袋，使用弩时需要配备。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

4292ed41c8c5707fc13f.source: This strange quiver holds mundane arrows and is meant to be used with bows of all kinds. At the bottom is some sort of mechanism that releases a strange material from a hidden reservoir, coating arrowheads and causing them to inflict particularly grievous serrations. Investigation reveals no obvious explanation to the coating's source, or a way to extract it without disassembling the quiver entirely. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.
4292ed41c8c5707fc13f.translation: 这个奇异的箭袋装着普通箭矢，适用于各类弓。底部有个机关，会从隐藏的储槽中释放一种古怪的物质，涂在箭头上，使其造成格外严重的撕裂伤。仔细查看后，仍不清楚这种涂层的来源；若不将整个箭袋拆开，也找不到取出它的办法。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

92b249159e85695edede.translation: 额外施加可叠加的流血效果，每回合造成[color=

44ce9a18d8c83abd5cda.source: [/color] bleeding damage per turn, for 2 turns

cab0804cf5ec852f40eb.source: A bag of black powder, used for arming exotic firearms. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.
cab0804cf5ec852f40eb.translation: 一袋黑火药，用于装填异域火器。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

7351229262c90ecd32cf.source: A quiver of arrows, required to use bows of all kinds. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.
7351229262c90ecd32cf.translation: 一个箭袋，使用各类弓时需要配备。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

0067a69bc6fe36ed4292.source: A quiver of bolts, required to use crossbows. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.
0067a69bc6fe36ed4292.translation: 一个弩矢袋，使用弩时需要配备。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

5ea5ca83b549389db3fa.source: A heavy chainmail hauberk worn under a thick riveted jacket and reinforced with vambraces. Adorned with trophies and lovingly maintained despite its extensive use, this is the armor of a true questing knight.
5ea5ca83b549389db3fa.translation: 厚重的长身锁甲外罩铆钉夹衣，并配有护臂。这副盔甲历经征战，缀满战利品，却始终得到悉心养护，唯有真正的游历骑士才配得上它。

e11f8b6ad383d77c2019.source: A heavy mail shirt covered by a quilted surcoat. An impressive and well-maintained piece, adorned with trophies and holy symbols.
e11f8b6ad383d77c2019.translation: 厚重的锁甲外罩绗缝罩袍，缀有战利品与圣徽。做工气派，保养得十分精心。

21e415fcecd86049df40.source: A long mail shirt covered by a riveted leather gambeson. Heavily worn from extensive use, but adorned with relics and well-maintained.
21e415fcecd86049df40.translation: 长身锁甲外罩铆钉皮制护衣。常年的征战留下不少磨损，缀于其上的圣物与细致的保养却显示出主人的珍重。

020c676e9d8eccd41ac2.source: A tarnished thick breastplate of ancient origin.
020c676e9d8eccd41ac2.translation: 一副来自古代的厚实胸甲，表面已黯淡锈蚀。

a6d6f427ea74d61a57b3.source: A heavy and rotten double-layered mail of ancient design. Not comfortable to wear but still useable.
a6d6f427ea74d61a57b3.translation: 古制双层锁甲，沉重而破败。穿着并不舒适，但尚能使用。

1fa5dc2bd2905c47acdc.source: An old and crusted heavy mail of ancient design. Some parts are missing, but it still offers decent protection.
1fa5dc2bd2905c47acdc.translation: 一副古制重型锁甲，年久失修，表面结满污垢。虽有缺损，仍能提供不错的防护。

d61de4512f6197ebef1f.source: Made of thick metal plates and mail, this heavy ancient armor still offers great protection after countless years. It's crusted and rotten in parts, however, severely limiting the mobility of the wearer.
d61de4512f6197ebef1f.translation: 这副古代重甲由厚钢板与锁甲构成，历经漫长岁月，防护依然出色。只是部分甲片结垢、衬料腐坏，严重妨碍穿戴者活动。

9d8d85ef925a4e9c1a3c.source: An ancient mail armor with plated arm guards. Very heavy and severely limiting the mobility of the wearer.
9d8d85ef925a4e9c1a3c.translation: 配有板甲护臂的古代锁甲。分量极重，严重妨碍穿戴者活动。

d0c7961d6fbd6521ba56.source: A heavy coat of scales, partly reinforced with a layer of plated metal on top. It's a massive armor of ancient origin that didn't age well.
d0c7961d6fbd6521ba56.translation: 厚重的鳞甲长衣，局部覆有金属板加固。这副古代重甲体积庞大，岁月已使它破败不堪。

e4ad5c3ffee0865fe01f.source: A heavy and tarnished scale coat of ancient design that belongs in a collection, not on the battlefield.
e4ad5c3ffee0865fe01f.translation: 一件沉重黯淡的古制鳞甲，更适合摆进藏品柜，而非穿上战场。

fe259b283d6b4da5e0dd.source: A sturdy, but heavy and partly decayed ancient scale harness.
fe259b283d6b4da5e0dd.translation: 一副结实而沉重的古代鳞甲，部分已经朽坏。

d2c9f6ac6982215dd22d.source: A leather apron usually worn by apprentices and craftsmen.
d2c9f6ac6982215dd22d.translation: 学徒和工匠常穿的皮围裙。

ddac8376720c7423dc39.source: Heavy hides patched together to create a decent makeshift armor.
ddac8376720c7423dc39.translation: 将厚实兽皮拼缝而成的简易甲衣，防护尚可。

6d22a619626c6c1b5ec8.source: This armor is made from heavy metal plates, scales and pieces of chainmal. The true armor of a northern warrior.
6d22a619626c6c1b5ec8.translation: 这副盔甲以厚重的金属板、鳞片和锁甲拼接而成，是北境勇士的真正战甲。

7c66be5b0ff1f5cfd76b.source: Hide and bone are common materials in the northern regions. This armor is using both for decent protection.
7c66be5b0ff1f5cfd76b.translation: 兽皮与骨头是北境常见的材料。这副盔甲将二者结合，提供了不错的防护。

2810cedf6f74a3f79fa5.source: A reinforced animal hide armor fashioned from thick leather pieces with added mail and metal scales.
2810cedf6f74a3f79fa5.translation: 以厚实兽皮制成，并用锁甲与金属鳞片加固的盔甲。

1cc272dd717f5a9d1f1c.source: A heavy body armor made from thick iron scales.
1cc272dd717f5a9d1f1c.translation: 用厚铁鳞片制成的重型身甲。

da7410458da64ea3c74d.source: This armor is pieced together from scavenged metal parts that are fixed to a crude leather tunic.
da7410458da64ea3c74d.translation: 将搜集来的金属碎片固定在粗制皮衣上，拼成的盔甲。

95526db6c51b68ffbcb4.source: Thick furs that are crudely dried and tied together to protect from both the cold and any incoming blows.
95526db6c51b68ffbcb4.translation: 将简单晾干的厚毛皮捆扎在一起，既能御寒，也能抵挡来袭的打击。

539624231178e3efc883.source: A heavy armor that is made from mostly metal. Only one chosen by the ancestors will own a set like this.
539624231178e3efc883.translation: 这副重甲几乎全由金属打造。只有蒙受先祖眷顾的勇士才有资格拥有它。

7e17e992b461b39b3417.source: A basic and simple mail shirt. Offers decent and affordable protection against slashing and piercing attacks.
7e17e992b461b39b3417.translation: 结构简单的基础锁甲衫，价格适中，能有效抵挡劈砍与穿刺。

e859d3a2e4b66b793a3c.source: A padded gambeson that has seen lots of patching and repairing.
e859d3a2e4b66b793a3c.translation: 一件反复缝补过的厚衬护衣。

d71978a6c67e4e2faebc.source: A rugged apron worn by butchers to protect against accidental cuts.
d71978a6c67e4e2faebc.translation: 屠夫穿的结实围裙，可以防止失手割伤自己。

34c552e99228349ecbf0.source: One layer of padding, one layer of strong mail, and heavy metal plates riveted ontop. A very heavy armor that offers great protection.
34c552e99228349ecbf0.translation: 内层厚衬、中层坚固锁甲、外层铆接厚重金属板。这副盔甲极为沉重，却有着出色的防护。

5f279776b9825817350e.source: A heavy armor made of thick, overlapping metal scales covering most of the body.
5f279776b9825817350e.translation: 厚实的金属鳞片层层搭叠，护住大半身躯的一件重甲。

3314fc9ddec8371d11ea.source: A thick leather armor covered with additional leather patches and occult insignia.
3314fc9ddec8371d11ea.translation: 厚实的皮甲，外面又缝上皮片，饰有神秘教派的符号。

e999ff7b7f43eda46249.source: A somewhat decayed coat of plates with rusted metal and brittle leather parts. Has probably been laying in the open for a while.
e999ff7b7f43eda46249.translation: 有些朽坏的板甲衣，金属已经生锈，皮革也变得脆硬。它大概在野外被遗弃了很久。

adc6a6c7660286697849.source: This coat of scales is worn and parts have come lose or are missing. It still offers very good protection if you don't mind the smell.
adc6a6c7660286697849.translation: 这件鳞甲磨损严重，有些部件已经松脱或遗失。如果不在意那股气味，它仍能提供很好的防护。

ad4299eebdd9b0b84658.source: A long mail shirt in bad condition. Some rings are missing and it is covered in dirt and has an odd smell about it.
ad4299eebdd9b0b84658.translation: 一件状况糟糕的长身锁甲，缺了不少铁环，覆满污垢，还散发着怪味。

68856eefaef2a780f654.source: A rugged vest worn by executioners, caked and crusted with blood.
68856eefaef2a780f654.translation: 刽子手穿的结实背心，上面凝结着厚厚的血垢。

6d4ff1de4b31afb5ed0a.source: A transitional armor consisting of a long mail shirt and a rivetted leather gambeson.
6d4ff1de4b31afb5ed0a.translation: 将长身锁甲与铆钉皮制护衣组合而成的过渡式盔甲。

f8cd3c5c46e477f0bbe0.source: A sturdy and heavy padded tunic that offers decent protection.
f8cd3c5c46e477f0bbe0.translation: 结实厚重的衬垫护衣，能够提供不错的防护。

719806e1edb7032090c7.source: Thick, padded robes permeated with the faint, lingering smell of blood and decay.
719806e1edb7032090c7.translation: 厚实的衬垫长袍，隐隐透着挥之不去的血腥与腐败气味。

1aecd676d7ec6a8c0253.source: The robes worn by the Grand Diviner. The sturdy layers of leather and heavy linen offer excellent protection.
1aecd676d7ec6a8c0253.translation: 大占卜师穿的法袍。多层结实的皮革和厚亚麻布提供了出色的防护。

54eaf06249968af71278.source: A heavy lamellar armor that covers most parts of the body with thick, overlapping metal plates for maximum protection.
54eaf06249968af71278.translation: 厚重的札甲，以层层搭叠的厚金属甲片覆盖身体的大部分部位，尽可能加强防护。

e0fe746446495ce35f69.source: A heavy and extraordinarily well crafted mail hauberk with added mail mittens and a padded undercoat. Only a true master could craft an armor like this.
e0fe746446495ce35f69.translation: 厚重而做工精湛的长身锁甲，配有锁甲手套和衬垫内衣。只有真正的大师才能打造出这样的铠甲。

23e92517204b877d5bf2.source: A body armor made of thick overlapping metal plates that cover most of the upper body.
23e92517204b877d5bf2.translation: 以厚实金属甲片层层搭叠而成的身甲，护住了上半身的大部分部位。

a3b7cb50044e7e3449c9.source: Numerous overlapping leather plates provide decent protection for most of the upper body.
a3b7cb50044e7e3449c9.translation: 多层搭叠的皮甲片护住上半身，提供了不错的防护。

a57f0b8c87e182bcdb8b.source: A mail shirt worn under a thick leather scale armor for added protection.
a57f0b8c87e182bcdb8b.translation: 锁甲外再罩上一层厚皮鳞甲，进一步加强防护。

28e92ec42b892e5fadd5.source: A leather vest ontop of a cloth tunic for improved protection.
28e92ec42b892e5fadd5.translation: 在布衣外加穿皮背心，以提高防护。

3dbae171de759fceb002.source: Various patches of rough leather sewn together.
3dbae171de759fceb002.translation: 用各色粗糙皮片缝合而成。

af4bd9c5e459d3b23f4e.source: A grisly aspect of Davkul, an ancient power not from this world, and the last remnants of %sacrifice% from whose body it has been fashioned. It shall never break, but instead keep regrowing its scarred skin on the spot.
af4bd9c5e459d3b23f4e.translation: 达夫库尔的骇人化身，凝聚着不属于这个世界的古老力量。它由%sacrifice%的肉身塑成，也是他最后的遗存。它永不破碎，伤痕累累的皮肤总会当即重新生长。

99b873834ec9ae9058d7.source: A shining armor once worn by the emperor of an age long past, made from the most wondrous of materials, imbued with mystical energies. Light reflects easily off the polished armor, turning the wearer into a shimmering figure of light during the day.
99b873834ec9ae9058d7.translation: 遥远年代的一位皇帝曾穿过这副光耀的铠甲。它由奇异的材料打造，蕴含神秘力量。阳光在光洁的甲面上流转，使穿戴者在白昼里宛若一道闪耀的人影。

ca8b30fa4d91e95632f5.source: ]25%[/color] of damage taken in melee back to the attacker

93f8bacee2eaa9b2f0fc.source: A shining armor once worn by the emperor of an age long past, made from the most woundrous of materials, imbued with mystical energies. Light reflects easily off the polished armor, turning the wearer into a shimmering figure of light during the day.
93f8bacee2eaa9b2f0fc.translation: 遥远年代的一位皇帝曾穿过这副光耀的铠甲。它由奇异的材料打造，蕴含神秘力量。阳光在光洁的甲面上流转，使穿戴者在白昼里宛若一道闪耀的人影。

a0b32488d3661686b2c7.source: Once a barbarian armor broken in battle, this piece has been bathed in the blood of the legendary Ijirok. Powers beyond your understanding mended it whole again, and will likewise mend any wounds of the wearer as well.
a0b32488d3661686b2c7.translation: 这副蛮族甲胄曾在战斗中破损，如今沐浴过传说中伊吉罗克的鲜血。超乎你理解的力量使它恢复完好，也将同样治愈穿戴者的伤口。

c3d5b233cb8c9dfc9949.source: ]10[/color] Hitpoints of the wearer each turn
c3d5b233cb8c9dfc9949.translation: ]10[/color]点生命值，每回合为穿戴者生效

c62da214cf081177ba14.source: A sturdy yet flexible armor composed of small, overlapping metal scales.
c62da214cf081177ba14.translation: 细小的金属鳞片层层搭叠，构成一副结实而灵活的盔甲。

8ba68113fc081cad4e5a.source: A simple cloth tunic. Fashionable but offering little in protection.
8ba68113fc081cad4e5a.translation: 一件简单的布衣，样式体面，却几乎起不到防护作用。

4809130cc115c77ec0a1.source: A long and heavy chainmail that offers good protection but is very fatiguing to wear.
4809130cc115c77ec0a1.translation: 长而厚重的锁甲，防护良好，但穿在身上十分耗费体力。

73513fb91e98150da795.source: A mail shirt with shoulder guards providing excellent protection against most weapons.
73513fb91e98150da795.translation: 配有护肩的锁甲衫，对大多数武器都有出色的防护效果。

1114624fa62cc3f1c2b1.source: A rugged, large robe made of simple cloth usually worn by monks and similar individuals who don't care for fashion.
1114624fa62cc3f1c2b1.translation: 宽大的粗布长袍，通常由修士之类不在意衣着打扮的人穿着。

4c7a27172dc18f1ec734.source: Ancient knowledge has been used when smithing this unique set of armor. Its light mail overlapped with golden splints offers high protection with manageable encumberment.
4c7a27172dc18f1ec734.translation: 这副独特的甲胄以古老技艺锻造而成。轻巧锁甲外覆金色甲条，在不过分增加负担的同时提供了强大的防护。

0c7806f6713ac5622f05.source: A well-crafted and hardened leather armor supported by a padded gambeson and chainmail. Light to wear but very sturdy.
0c7806f6713ac5622f05.translation: 精制硬皮甲配上衬垫软甲和锁甲，穿着轻便，却极为坚固。

d67f6d50e3f03cfaa793.source: This particular mail shirt is combined with a gambeson and covered with a sturdy, riveted leather jacket for a light yet protective armor.
d67f6d50e3f03cfaa793.translation: 这件锁甲衫配有衬垫软甲，外罩坚固的铆钉皮衣，兼顾了轻便与防护。

3b490bf1f1097986ee59.source: A thick mail hauberk combined with sturdy metal plates. This armor will protect its wearer even in the fiercest of battles.
3b490bf1f1097986ee59.translation: 厚实的长身锁甲配以坚固金属板，即使在最激烈的战斗中，也能护住穿戴者。

97f84cb45c0905de7ae9.source: A scale armor made of small, interlocking metal scales. The style and craftsmanship hint at the armor coming from a far-away region.
97f84cb45c0905de7ae9.translation: 由细小金属鳞片交叠相扣而成的鳞甲。其样式与工艺表明，它来自遥远的异乡。

c43d8800331eb08f86f7.source: A rare coat of plates enhanced with chainmail and additional padding. A piece of true craftsmanship!
c43d8800331eb08f86f7.translation: 一件罕见的板甲衣，辅以锁甲和额外衬垫加固，堪称匠心之作！

2c98ed4fd402ead85bb0.source: Truly fit for a knight, this mail hauberk is made from the highest quality materials and boasts precious decorations and ornaments.
2c98ed4fd402ead85bb0.translation: 这件长身锁甲采用上等材料，饰有贵重装饰，真正配得上骑士身份。

0a45521e8bb939ff8667.source: A heavy lamellar plate harness combined with fine mail and comfortable padding. A truly well made piece that is almost too precious to be torn in battle.
0a45521e8bb939ff8667.translation: 厚重的札甲配上精细锁甲与舒适衬垫，做工精湛，珍贵得几乎让人舍不得将它带上战场。

7bd2d78508f80ad755b7.source: The sturdy scales of a fierce Lindwurm sewn together ontop a heavy chainmail. Not only is it a trophy to a great hunter, but it also deflects the fiercest of blows, and the shimmering scales remain untouched by any corroding Lindwurm blood.
7bd2d78508f80ad755b7.translation: 将凶猛林德蠕龙的坚固鳞片缝在厚重锁甲外，制成了这副盔甲。它既是伟大猎人的战利品，也能挡下最猛烈的攻击；闪亮的鳞片还能抵御林德蠕龙鲜血的腐蚀。

fa7323fcf3cf90a6a954.translation: 不受林德蠕龙酸血影响

5e2a0f3a7dab44234448.source: This armor is composed of a strange alloy, and well crafted for barbarian standards. A truly rare and remarkable piece.
5e2a0f3a7dab44234448.translation: 以一种奇异合金打造的盔甲。按蛮族的标准，它的做工十分精良，是一件罕见的杰作。

97bd3d2665c5d70877d1.source: An extraordinarily well-crafted piece of lamellar armor. It is covered with beaten gold, which makes it truly stand out.
97bd3d2665c5d70877d1.translation: 工艺非凡的札甲，表面覆着锤薄的金片，分外夺目。

d585ca36dd475e0a3c6b.source: This piece of light mail armor was once the personal item of a well known fencing master. It is as light as a tunic, but protects all vital body parts.
d585ca36dd475e0a3c6b.translation: 这副轻型锁甲曾是一位著名剑术大师的私物。它轻若布衣，却能护住身体各处要害。

45bfb8dd021064823bee.source: A simple fur and leather armor with thick layers of metal plates rivetted ontop. A very simple and heavy design, but quite effective in combat.
45bfb8dd021064823bee.translation: 简单的毛皮甲外铆上层层厚金属板。结构朴实而沉重，在战斗中却颇为实用。

629f2e914fd671fc51af.source: This piece of layered armor belonged to a famed mercenary once. Its high resilience and flexibility make it a remarkable piece of craftsmanship. And it even comes with extra pockets!
629f2e914fd671fc51af.translation: 这副复层甲曾属于一位著名佣兵。它既坚韧又灵活，堪称工艺杰作。而且还多带了几个口袋！

6d56d919dcfde1cc7b75.source: A barbarian armor of crude making that has been adjusted to protect without being too cumbersome. It wears the typical markings of the northern barbarian tribes.
6d56d919dcfde1cc7b75.translation: 一副粗制的蛮族盔甲，经过调整，兼顾了防护与便捷。上面饰有北境蛮族特有的部落标记。

0fbd457c34838214bda4.source: A truly masterfully crafted set of mail armor. Very light and flexible to reduce encumberance while still offering good protection.
0fbd457c34838214bda4.translation: 一副由大师精心打造的锁甲，格外轻盈灵活，既能减少负担，又有着良好的防护。

44a8222d3e49248d049b.source: A fine linen tunic of exquisite material, embroided with pleasing patterns. Fashionable but offering little in protection.
44a8222d3e49248d049b.translation: 用精美布料制成的亚麻长衣，绣着赏心悦目的纹样。衣着体面，却几乎起不到防护作用。

bca74055bd0935693cd8.source: The dark robes of an assassin. Fine chainmail is tied and woven tightly into the fabric.
bca74055bd0935693cd8.translation: 刺客的深色长袍，细密的锁甲被牢牢缝织进布料之中。

9984e83a76e67a9e1a48.source: A double sash made from thick cloth that is worn across the body.
9984e83a76e67a9e1a48.translation: 用厚布制成，交叉披在身上的双层肩带。

c987de1735119250836b.source: A leather harness commonly worn by pit fighters in arenas of the southern city states.
c987de1735119250836b.translation: 南方城邦竞技场的斗士常穿的皮制护身带。

b1481e75bda7ccfd612d.source: A thick cloth robe with added leather parts for increased protection.
b1481e75bda7ccfd612d.translation: 厚布长袍上加缀皮革，以加强防护。

c502d3213bfcf91d2f31.source: A breastplate made of several layers of linen.
c502d3213bfcf91d2f31.translation: 以多层亚麻布制成的胸甲。

360c2fd282523f5f74ce.source: A lamellar shirt made from interlapping metal plates worn atop a mail shirt.
360c2fd282523f5f74ce.translation: 在锁甲衫外加穿一件札甲衫，由层层交叠的金属甲片构成。

8c0f50eb63a42cfa8e4d.source: A nomad cloth robe worn to protect against both the heat and against cuts and bruises.
8c0f50eb63a42cfa8e4d.translation: 游牧民穿的布袍，既能遮挡酷热，也能防止割伤与擦伤。

34999d0f0ca2dccd04d9.source: A heavy composite armor consisting of mail coat, padding and lamellar elements.
34999d0f0ca2dccd04d9.translation: 由长身锁甲、厚实衬垫和札甲部件组合而成的重甲。

ff7a019968916fb7e97e.source: A thick cloth vest padded with dense wool to protect against blunt hits.
ff7a019968916fb7e97e.translation: 厚布背心内填紧实羊毛，以抵挡钝击。

64243d24ec126fd58dbe.source: A slightly worn-down, thin and light mail with additional metal plates grafted onto it.
64243d24ec126fd58dbe.translation: 略有磨损的轻薄锁甲，外面又缀上金属甲片加固。

17e00d8659e38bb64acc.source: Southern Long Mail Shirt with Padding

13643aa57f3cd2e432b9.source: A long and heavy mail shirt with a thickly padded coat.
13643aa57f3cd2e432b9.translation: 厚重的长身锁甲，配有厚衬甲衣。

5af96ea45f1f3fe24cca.source: A mail shirt fashioned from slightly thinner and lighter metal rings than those used in the north.
5af96ea45f1f3fe24cca.translation: 编成这件锁甲衫的金属环，比北境所用的略薄，也更轻。

d1a9277702de50f4d0c4.source: A leather nomad armor stitched together from various hides and scraps.
d1a9277702de50f4d0c4.translation: 游牧民用各色兽皮与零碎皮料拼缝而成的皮甲。

7c6bd7e5cfe8f23ebde7.source: A double layered robe fashioned from thick cloth.
7c6bd7e5cfe8f23ebde7.translation: 用厚布制成的双层长袍。

9aa96dfa45312115f859.source: A padded tunic reinforced with leather fittings for added protection.
9aa96dfa45312115f859.translation: 衬垫护衣上加有皮革护片，以加强防护。

e303f393073f83a2992e.source: A cloth mantle padded with woolen filling.
e303f393073f83a2992e.translation: 填入羊毛作衬的布制罩衣。

f22e363d0462c4380180.source: This light mail shirt has seen better times but still grants decent protection.
f22e363d0462c4380180.translation: 这件轻型锁甲衫早已不复昔日光鲜，防护却仍然不错。

0dc25d158188ba583baf.source: This rusted scale vest was assembled from bits and pieces of other suits of armor, yet the result is less than the sum of its parts.
0dc25d158188ba583baf.translation: 这件生锈的鳞甲背心是用其他盔甲的零件拼成的，可惜拼凑起来反而没能发挥各部分应有的作用。

b314acd16d7a87e1e034.source: A heavy suit of lamellar worn over a mail shirt, surely taken from someone more well off than its current owner. Blood and sweat have turned it brown and rusted.
b314acd16d7a87e1e034.translation: 锁甲衫外罩一副沉重札甲，显然是从比现任主人富裕的人身上抢来的。血汗将它浸得发褐，锈迹斑斑。

ecac401aadaa5ceb0c81.source: A dark padded leather mantle, stuffed for added protection, with a pelt coat.
ecac401aadaa5ceb0c81.translation: 深色皮制罩衣内有厚实填充，外披毛皮，进一步加强了防护。

8f85f917f00de1197383.source: A padded leather mantle stuffed for added protection. Usually worn under armor.
8f85f917f00de1197383.translation: 皮制罩衣内塞入填充物以加强防护，通常穿在盔甲里面。

d7e83f1b2dbc3f216bc6.source: An ominous black coat worn over a sturdy tunic, reinforced with thick leather armor and iron bracers.
d7e83f1b2dbc3f216bc6.translation: 结实长衣外罩着阴沉的黑色外衣，又以厚皮甲和铁护臂加固。

499f3e3cd3db123af551.source: A mail hauberk reinforced with shoulder pauldrons and a riveted leather armor for added protection.
499f3e3cd3db123af551.translation: 一件长身锁甲，配以肩甲和铆钉皮甲，提供额外防护。

0007b9bdc57c4c7143f6.source: A long and heavy chainmail armor, turned rigid in places by rust and dirt.
0007b9bdc57c4c7143f6.translation: 厚重的长身锁甲，锈迹与污垢已使部分甲环僵硬难动。

70bfd563385b5f071436.source: A body vest with overlapping scales worn over a small mail shirt.
70bfd563385b5f071436.translation: 在短锁甲衫外，罩上一件鳞片层层搭叠的背心。

549d5f32c5d53e34c54a.source: A long leather coat reinforced with metal plates worn over a sturdy mail hauberk.
549d5f32c5d53e34c54a.translation: 坚固的长身锁甲外，罩着以金属甲片加固的皮制长衣。

d828ccc87da8f84c9cf1.source: A mail hauberk reinforced with shoulder pauldrons, additional metal plating and a riveted leather armor, covered with a tabbard in a noble houses' colors.
d828ccc87da8f84c9cf1.translation: 长身锁甲加装肩甲、金属护板和铆钉皮甲，外罩一件带有贵族家族纹色的罩袍。

9182659cf7d477dcdd49.translation: 勉强比光着身子强一点。

ea2d0538ba2affac81c9.source: A dark and thick cloth tunic consisting of multiple layers to protect against weather and scratches.
ea2d0538ba2affac81c9.translation: 深色厚布长衣，由多层布料制成，能够抵挡风寒和轻微擦伤。

d082c9768181f26b4e8f.source: A thick cloth tunic consisting of multiple layers to protect against weather and scratches.
d082c9768181f26b4e8f.translation: 以多层布料制成的厚长衣，能够抵挡风寒和轻微擦伤。

86e728a873773640b7aa.source: A thick leather apron that provides protection against light cuts and scratches.
86e728a873773640b7aa.translation: 厚实的皮围裙，能够防止轻微割伤和擦伤。

d73ec9540468ab370b16.source: A rugged traveling attire consisting of a layered tunic worn under a durable leather jacket.
d73ec9540468ab370b16.translation: 结实的旅行衣装，多层长衣外罩着耐磨的皮夹衣。

08e7d9d3998b28221dc8.source: A thick leather armor skillfully crafted from the pelt of a giant wolf. Donning the skin of a beast like this can turn one into an imposing figure.
08e7d9d3998b28221dc8.translation: 以巨狼毛皮精心制成的厚皮甲。披上这样的凶兽之皮，足以让人显得威风凛凛。

23eb9274de818a1667f8.source: A skillfully crafted mail shirt with the pelt of a giant wolf ontop. Donning the skin of a beast like this can turn one into an imposing figure.
23eb9274de818a1667f8.translation: 精心编成的锁甲衫，外披巨狼毛皮。披上这样的凶兽之皮，足以让人显得威风凛凛。

cff7a8eb847424594646.source: A cloth robe coverd in all kinds of mystical ornaments and symbols.
cff7a8eb847424594646.translation: 一件布袍，缀满各式神秘饰物与符号。

f095d2169f276c5a5fff.source: A reinforced mail shirt that lost some parts over the years.
f095d2169f276c5a5fff.translation: 一件加固锁甲衫，年深日久，已有部分零件遗失。

fa0254704f294dcbc212.source: Crafted from thick furs, this additional padding helps dampen the impact of any blow.
fa0254704f294dcbc212.translation: 这层衬垫用厚实毛皮制成，能够缓冲打击。

7659ae15445e0c285bda.source: Additional fur padding helps to further dampen the impact of any blow.
7659ae15445e0c285bda.translation: 附加的毛皮衬垫能进一步缓冲打击。

d299119f5a6a617eb267.source: ]66%[/color] of any damage that ignores armor

10797b56488ca47a1461.source: Right-click or drag onto an armor carried by the currently selected character in order to permanently fuse. This item will be consumed in the process to give the following effects:
10797b56488ca47a1461.translation: 右键点击，或拖到当前选中角色携带的护甲上，即可永久加装。此物品会被消耗，并赋予护甲以下效果：

a515fa00b8f908452dc7.source: Has an armor attachment which can be replaced, but will be destroyed in the process
a515fa00b8f908452dc7.translation: 已安装护甲附件；更换附件会摧毁原附件

c133192ada7e9eb5aba4.source: The ceremonial adornment of a self-proclaimed barbarian king. The rare and durable horns act as an suprisingly effective armor.
c133192ada7e9eb5aba4.translation: 一位自封蛮族之王的仪式装饰。这些稀有而坚韧的兽角，防护效果出奇地好。

b5d65978648c42ebb800.source: This armor has been adorned with ceremonial horns by barbarian craftsmen.
b5d65978648c42ebb800.translation: 蛮族工匠在这件护甲上加装了用于仪式的兽角。

67bc083e82a2bcee100a.source: Crafted from strong but surprisingly light bones, these ornate platings make for an ablative armor to be worn ontop of regular armor.
67bc083e82a2bcee100a.translation: 这些精制骨板用坚固而轻盈的骨骼制成，穿戴在常规护甲外，以自身的损毁承受打击。

1435a6cf5b18b23929ad.source: A layer of ornate bone plates is attached to this armor.
1435a6cf5b18b23929ad.translation: 这件护甲外加装了一层精制骨板。

395d92750dc67472ec5b.source: Completely absorbs the first hit of every combat encounter which doesn't ignore armor
395d92750dc67472ec5b.translation: 每场战斗中，完全吸收首次不无视护甲的命中

dc6972e859ce5922f27d.source: Pelts taken from ferocious direwolves, cured and sewn together to be worn as a beast hunter's trophy around the neck. Donning the skin of a beast like this can turn one into an imposing figure.
dc6972e859ce5922f27d.translation: 从凶猛恐狼身上剥下的皮毛，经过鞣制、缝合，制成猎兽者披在颈肩处的战利品。披上这样的兽皮，足以令人望而生畏。

60d84fcea9f84d85fc09.source: A mantle of direwolf pelts has been attached to this armor, which transforms the wearer into an imposing figure.
60d84fcea9f84d85fc09.translation: 这件护甲上加装了恐狼皮披肩，使穿戴者显得威风凛凛。

8c5e96184452cc1d9a0c.source: A thick double mail patch. Heavy, but effective in further adding to an armor's protection.
8c5e96184452cc1d9a0c.translation: 一块厚重的双层锁甲。虽然沉重，却能有效增强护甲的防护。

b3eb747dc4d34b68a89c.source: A thick double mail has been added to this armor for further protection.
b3eb747dc4d34b68a89c.translation: 这件护甲加装了厚重的双层锁甲，提供额外防护。

aa3762462b907ee18b57.source: Metal armor pieces that provides additional protection.
aa3762462b907ee18b57.translation: 提供额外防护的金属甲片。

ada71593f254a7ee9680.source: This harness has metal armor pieces attached that provide additional protection.
ada71593f254a7ee9680.translation: 这副护具加装了金属甲片，提供额外防护。

07c65c159bc2d689702e.source: Large protective plates to be fixed at the shoulders of an armor.
07c65c159bc2d689702e.translation: 固定在护甲肩部的大块防护甲板。

fd61f3d7617ddf1a0bb4.source: Large protective plates have been fixed at the shoulders of this armor.
fd61f3d7617ddf1a0bb4.translation: 这件护甲的肩部固定着大块防护甲板。

4cae9dec50bec213f8ed.source: These segments of horn plate are made from one of the hardest yet flexible materials nature has to offer. Worn over common armor, they can help to deflect incoming blows.
4cae9dec50bec213f8ed.translation: 这些甲片由天然角质制成，是自然界中兼具坚硬与韧性的材料。加装在普通护甲外，能够帮助偏转袭来的打击。

25ffaea7350687a69920.source: Segments of horn plate provide additional protection.
25ffaea7350687a69920.translation: 分块的角质甲片提供了额外防护。

d6d0bddefe9eea3defad.source: Reduces any melee damage to the body by [color=
d6d0bddefe9eea3defad.translation: 躯干受到的近战伤害减少[color=

7a84aef95f5205b7111d.source: Furs taken from ferocious hyenas, cured and sewn together to be worn as a beast hunter's trophy around the neck. Donning the skin of a beast like this bolsters one's drive to action.
7a84aef95f5205b7111d.translation: 从凶猛鬣狗身上剥下的毛皮，经过鞣制、缝合，制成猎兽者披在颈肩处的战利品。披上这样的兽皮，让人更有行动的冲劲。

7f5722918ffb9cf5cf12.source: A mantle of hyena furs has been attached to this armor, which bolsters the wearer's drive to action.
7f5722918ffb9cf5cf12.translation: 这件护甲加装了鬣狗皮披肩，令穿戴者行动更加迅捷。

bc7f2a10abad9b3d6193.source: Large metal plates that cover the vulnerable shoulder joints.
bc7f2a10abad9b3d6193.translation: 覆盖薄弱肩关节的大块金属甲板。

510bd677f8b075eda83b.source: Large metal plates have been added to protect the vulnerable shoulder joints.
510bd677f8b075eda83b.translation: 这件护甲加装了大块金属甲板，用以保护薄弱的肩关节。

c194ef328e2b334dba75.source: This neckguard of cured leather can be attached to any armor for some additional protection.
c194ef328e2b334dba75.translation: 这件鞣制皮革护颈可加装在任何护甲上，提供一些额外防护。

f42a0f99b26d0ab0d41d.source: A neckguard of cured leather has been attached to this armor for additional protection.
f42a0f99b26d0ab0d41d.translation: 这件护甲加装了鞣制皮革护颈，提供额外防护。

4b6e4d1cc1efa9546260.source: Studded leather shoulderguards can help in making even light armors a little bit more resilient.
4b6e4d1cc1efa9546260.translation: 铆钉皮革护肩能让轻甲也多几分防护。

043f17c22127baa1a59f.source: Shoulderguards made of studded leather have been added to this armor for additional protection.
043f17c22127baa1a59f.translation: 这件护甲加装了铆钉皮革护肩，提供额外防护。

04e1588110391f9df19b.source: Padded armpieces that provides additional protection.
04e1588110391f9df19b.translation: 带有衬垫的护臂，能够提供额外防护。

41601fb86c5ddeeadfff.source: This harness has padded armpieces attached that provide additional protection.
41601fb86c5ddeeadfff.translation: 这副护具加装了衬垫护臂，提供额外防护。

7ae85e5571fee96e5a8a.source: Crafted from exotic materials, this replacement padding can provide the same amount of protection as regular padding at less weight.
7ae85e5571fee96e5a8a.translation: 这种替换衬垫用异域材料制成，防护效果与普通衬垫相当，重量却更轻。

f40f4a0a4121e79b484f.source: This armor has its padding replaced by a lighter but no less durable one.
f40f4a0a4121e79b484f.translation: 这件护甲的衬垫已换成更轻、却同样坚韧的材料。

521058c415d65b2f8b7b.source: Reduces an armor's penalty to Maximum Fatigue by [color=
521058c415d65b2f8b7b.translation: 护甲对疲劳上限的惩罚降低[color=

f4a5fbbcccd8d94210a0.source: A cloak made out of the scales of a Lindwurm. Not only is it a rare and impressive trophy, it also offers additional protection and is untouchable by corroding Lindwurm blood.
f4a5fbbcccd8d94210a0.translation: 以林德蠕龙鳞片制成的披风。它既是罕见而耀眼的战利品，也能提供额外防护，并且不受林德蠕龙血液腐蚀。

fe85532043d152aeee4c.source: A cloak made out of Lindwurm scales is worn over this armor for additional protection, including from the corrosive effects of Lindwurm blood.
fe85532043d152aeee4c.translation: 这件护甲外披着一件林德蠕龙鳞披风，能提供额外防护，也能抵御林德蠕龙血液的腐蚀。

e604d05290cb85c1c531.source: A large patch of mail that can be added to any armor to further protect the most vulnerable areas.
e604d05290cb85c1c531.translation: 可加装在任何护甲上的一大块锁甲，进一步保护薄弱部位。

98e5bf57b0415ec96d48.source: A large patch of mail has been added to this armor to further protect the most vulnerable areas.
98e5bf57b0415ec96d48.translation: 这件护甲加装了一大块锁甲，进一步保护薄弱部位。

57022eaf6651aaca57cc.source: Sturdy metal pauldrons that can be added to any armor for increased protection of the shoulders and upper body. Of course, it will also make the armor a bit heavier.
57022eaf6651aaca57cc.translation: 可加装在任何护甲上的坚固金属肩甲，能增强肩部和上身的防护。当然，护甲也会因此变重。

988dfdd91ad4fba2798c.source: Sturdy metal pauldrons have been added to this armor for increased protection of the shoulders and upper body, but at the expense of additional weight.
988dfdd91ad4fba2798c.translation: 这件护甲加装了坚固的金属肩甲，增强了肩部和上身的防护，但也更加沉重。

2035caa0c083573f71db.source: Thick metal plates that are rivetted to the underlying armor. Very crude, but an easy way to quickly add protection.
2035caa0c083573f71db.translation: 铆接在护甲外层的厚金属板。做工粗糙，却能简单快捷地增强防护。

316781b1ec24bd373857.source: This armor has a layer of crudely riveted metal plates for additional protection.
316781b1ec24bd373857.translation: 这件护甲上粗糙地铆接着一层金属板，提供额外防护。

e068968c47852f0a4c71.source: This armor is close to falling apart. Negligence and long use have left it in a sad state long beyond repairability.
e068968c47852f0a4c71.translation: 这件护甲几乎快散架了。长期使用又缺乏保养，使它破败不堪，早已无法修复。

ee94f42fcdeac5e74cf1.source: This armor has been exposed to the elements for a long time. Leather is falling apart, cloth is rotten, metal is rusty and perforated.
ee94f42fcdeac5e74cf1.translation: 这件护甲经年遭受风吹雨打。皮革开裂，布料腐烂，金属锈蚀得千疮百孔。

bae7939c1d80a31a8977.source: It appears that the previous owner did not take care of it at all; parts are missing or have been replaced with improvised patchings.
bae7939c1d80a31a8977.translation: 前任主人似乎根本没有保养过它，许多部件不是缺失，就是用随手找到的东西勉强修补。

23c56523a2372c3a46ad.source: This armor is slightly weathered from dust and rain, which has made the metal dull and leather brittle.
23c56523a2372c3a46ad.translation: 这件护甲略有风尘雨蚀的痕迹，金属失去光泽，皮革变得干脆。

531508c5ed1bc1cf4113.source: Protective runes and sigils written on parched skin and emitting an unsettling aura.
531508c5ed1bc1cf4113.translation: 写在干燥皮肤上的护佑符文与法印，散发着令人不安的气息。

2611fd177d1ff9074c35.source: Protective runes and sigils written on parched skin are hefted to this armor.
2611fd177d1ff9074c35.translation: 这件护甲上缀着干燥的皮肤，上面写满护佑符文与法印。

268bc5cde597668f0922.source: ]+20[/color] Resolve at morale checks against fear, panic or mind control effects
268bc5cde597668f0922.translation: ]+20[/color]决心，用于抵抗恐惧、惊慌或精神控制的士气检定

14c971d8cef077f64e43.source: A large, rusted patch of mail that can be added to any armor to further protect the most vulnerable areas.
14c971d8cef077f64e43.translation: 可加装在任何护甲上的一大块生锈锁甲，进一步保护薄弱部位。

37f2b539290763cc259b.source: A large, rusted patch of mail has been added to this armor to further protect the most vulnerable areas.
37f2b539290763cc259b.translation: 这件护甲加装了一大块生锈锁甲，进一步保护薄弱部位。

0522932f4e7574db3cc8.source: A mantle crafted from the thin and shimmering scales of desert serpents, especially resistant to heat and flames.
0522932f4e7574db3cc8.translation: 以沙漠巨蛇薄而闪亮的鳞皮制成的披肩，尤其耐热、耐火。

56a248483e49e0eeedb0.source: A mantle of serpent skin has been attached to this armor, which makes it more resistant to heat and flames.
56a248483e49e0eeedb0.translation: 这件护甲加装了蛇皮披肩，使其更加耐热、耐火。

760f2e2d65bdc2d76a05.source: Reduces damage from fire and firearms by [color=
760f2e2d65bdc2d76a05.translation: 受到的火焰和火器伤害减少[color=

6078c81f0ef7c0cc61c8.source: A thick cloak made out of a Frost Unhold's majestic white fur. Can be worn atop any armor to make the wearer more resilient against ranged weapons.
6078c81f0ef7c0cc61c8.translation: 用冰霜巨魔丰厚的白毛皮制成的厚披风。可披在任何护甲外，增强对远程武器的防护。

4ad11bd0e4b3917f6c06.source: A cloak of thick white fur has been attached to this armor to make it more resilient against ranged weapons.
4ad11bd0e4b3917f6c06.translation: 这件护甲加装了厚实的白毛皮披风，增强了对远程武器的防护。

9db7c36d723e8f001601.source: Reduces any ranged damage to the body by [color=
9db7c36d723e8f001601.translation: 躯干受到的远程伤害减少[color=

38a4aa8e6340fe129af7.source: A closed helmet with complete faceguard and mail to protect the neck. Heavily worn from extensive use, but adorned with relics and well-maintained.
38a4aa8e6340fe129af7.translation: 封闭式头盔配有完整面甲和锁甲护颈。长期使用留下了不少磨损，却依然保养精心，饰有圣物。

676c73e356436be07698.source: A closed metal helm with breathing holes. Adorned with relics and lovingly maintained despite its extensive use, this is the helmet of a true questing knight.
676c73e356436be07698.translation: 开有透气孔的封闭式金属头盔，饰有圣物。尽管历经征战，仍得到悉心养护，唯有真正的游历骑士才配得上它。

998443da1d57c4b9effe.translation: 一顶带有厚实衬垫的布帽。

4147cc9932973b71649b.source: An ancient heavy helmet with intricate decoration.
4147cc9932973b71649b.translation: 装饰精巧繁复的古代重盔。

3b7ed785bdcdb2119006.source: An ancient light helmet that time has taken a toll on over many years.
3b7ed785bdcdb2119006.translation: 一顶古代轻盔，漫长岁月已使它损坏不少。

2363d17fb1948d9ae06f.source: A well-crafted but partly decayed helmet of ancient design.
2363d17fb1948d9ae06f.translation: 做工精良的古制头盔，已有部分朽坏。

92227e8295e03e2ebe9d.source: The dried and prepped head of a large bear. Offers some protection, but is mostly donned for the looks.
92227e8295e03e2ebe9d.translation: 用大熊头部干制而成的头饰，能提供少许防护，不过佩戴它主要还是为了威风。

f6c92de17547aa660b04.source: A headpiece with long horns, fashioned in tradition of barbarian beastmasters for generations.
f6c92de17547aa660b04.translation: 饰有长角的头饰，沿袭着蛮族驯兽师世代相传的样式。

b86a370edb18ee01b859.source: This heavy metal helmet also protects the wearer's face, albeit at the cost of visibility.
b86a370edb18ee01b859.translation: 这顶厚重的金属盔还能护住面部，代价是遮挡视线。

4d4d4f2636ba2cae2609.source: A crude and rusty barbarian helmet. What it lacks in finesse it makes up for in thickness.
4d4d4f2636ba2cae2609.translation: 粗制而锈蚀的蛮族头盔。做工不足，就用厚度来补。

76572d25ab2aef418804.source: Although crudely made and rusty, this metal helmet is a durable and sturdy piece of armor.
76572d25ab2aef418804.translation: 这顶金属头盔虽然粗糙生锈，却依然结实耐用。

06c03ea435ee20aa9c55.source: This heavy helmet has ornamental horns attached. This is a sign of high standing and reputation within barbarian warbands.
06c03ea435ee20aa9c55.translation: 厚重头盔上装有装饰性犄角，象征着佩戴者在蛮族战帮中的崇高地位与声望。

edf7c12db9f57152e48b.source: A dried and folded leather headband designed to protect the forehead.
edf7c12db9f57152e48b.translation: 将晾干的皮革折叠成护额，以保护前额。

f9534c0d4120e662c5a1.source: A thick leather helmet fashioned from cured hides. The animals these once belonged to were certainly dangerous game.
f9534c0d4120e662c5a1.translation: 以鞣制兽皮制成的厚皮盔。提供这些兽皮的动物，想必都不是好对付的猎物。

26362c0b435321960423.source: A sturdy yet light barbute helmet, a design uncommon in these lands, made from especially light and durable steel.
26362c0b435321960423.translation: 用格外轻韧的钢材打造的巴布特盔，坚固轻巧，样式在这片土地上并不常见。

40900c5b67f50b204569.source: A metal bascinet worn atop a thick mail coif, decorated with a ribbon in the colors of a noble house.
40900c5b67f50b204569.translation: 金属尖顶盔下配有厚实的锁甲头巾，饰带采用某个贵族家族的纹章色。

14425536f0b3babb5819.source: A metal bascinet worn atop a thick mail coif.
14425536f0b3babb5819.translation: 戴在厚实锁子头巾外的金属尖顶盔。

9f75cc1488ff9d407b9f.source: A closed helmet with complete faceguard. Hard to breathe in and limiting the field of view.
9f75cc1488ff9d407b9f.translation: 配有完整面甲的封闭式头盔。穿戴时呼吸不畅，视野也会受限。

7826f8730c7eda6e9bba.source: A closed helmet with complete faceguard and a mail coif covering the neck. Great in the way of protection but hard to breathe in and limiting the field of view.
7826f8730c7eda6e9bba.translation: 配有完整面甲和锁甲护颈的封闭式头盔。防护出色，但穿戴时呼吸不畅，视野也会受限。

b492177c04d9d44e7a8b.source: A closed helmet with complete faceguard and a padded coif underneath. Hard to breathe in and limiting the field of view.
b492177c04d9d44e7a8b.translation: 配有完整面甲的封闭式头盔，下方衬有软甲头巾。穿戴时呼吸不畅，视野也会受限。

a6c3d462c2f75c3961f1.source: A mail coif with added protection for the face.
a6c3d462c2f75c3961f1.translation: 增加了面部防护的锁甲头巾。

fcc0b7ea234585abac92.source: A heavy conic helmet with a full closed mail skirt for additional protection.
fcc0b7ea234585abac92.translation: 厚重的锥形盔，配有全封闭的锁甲围领，以加强防护。

68916f19063c1447a966.source: This conic helmet with mail has an attached metal faceguard. It is heavy and hard to see through, but offers excellent protection.
68916f19063c1447a966.translation: 配有锁甲的锥形盔，又加装了一块金属面甲。厚重且遮挡视线，却能提供出色的防护。

8461501b85d966aa58c0.source: A rough spun cloth bag with two holes in it.
8461501b85d966aa58c0.translation: 在粗布袋上开了两个洞。

4ddc36dda1cbdd3dabdc.source: A thick leather hood that covers the head and neck but limits vision.
4ddc36dda1cbdd3dabdc.translation: 包覆头颈的厚皮头罩，但会遮挡视线。

68df035e34ddcb0a9fd4.source: A sturdy hat and cowl made out of leather and cloth.
68df035e34ddcb0a9fd4.translation: 以皮革和布料制成的结实帽子，配有披肩头巾。

9397ddf108022fc34d91.source: Decayed Closed Flat Top with Mail

f7c148559d94c6913667.source: A worn and torn closed helmet with complete faceguard and a mail coif covering the neck. It has obviously been lying outdoors for a while.
f7c148559d94c6913667.translation: 破损的封闭式头盔，配有完整面甲和锁甲护颈。显然曾被丢在野外很长时间。

1ad48ddffaa7325c93f3.source: Covered Decayed Closed Flat Top with Mail

2ba7c2e9463508247d21.source: A worn and torn closed helmet with complete faceguard and a mail coif covering the neck, underneath a rotten cloth sack. It has obviously been lying outdoors for a while.
2ba7c2e9463508247d21.translation: 破损的封闭式头盔，配有完整面甲和锁甲护颈，外面套着一只腐烂的布袋。显然曾被丢在野外很长时间。

45fb4a66efbfb62ec999.source: This full helm suffers from rusty metal parts and brittle leather inlays but still offers good protection if you ignore its stench.
45fb4a66efbfb62ec999.translation: 这顶全覆盔的金属部件锈迹斑斑，皮衬也已脆硬。若能忍受那股臭味，它仍能提供良好的防护。

deca1805fa3a4354b1d7.source: A great helmet with torn off and rotten decorations. It must have once belonged to a renowned knight.
deca1805fa3a4354b1d7.translation: 一顶重型大盔，装饰已残破腐坏。它必定曾属于一位声名卓著的骑士。

8496720e0e4facd8add4.source: A dented metal nasal helmet that has seen some fighting.
8496720e0e4facd8add4.translation: 有些凹陷的金属护鼻盔，显然经历过不少战斗。

f5af407253f29b32f09f.source: A hood worn by executioners to protect their identity and prevent retaliation.
f5af407253f29b32f09f.translation: 刽子手用来遮掩身份、免遭报复的头罩。

455fccf3cf99d2c6ce21.source: A hood worn by executioners on the job.
455fccf3cf99d2c6ce21.translation: 刽子手行刑时佩戴的头罩。

31d8a34131dee929d2b7.source: A closed metal helm with breathing holes and intricate decoration ontop. Great in the way of protection, a piece of art to behold, but hard to breathe in and limiting the field of view.
31d8a34131dee929d2b7.translation: 带有透气孔的封闭式金属盔，顶部装饰精巧繁复。防护出众，宛如艺术品，只是呼吸不畅，视野也会受限。

af38077bed1f3947343d.source: A fancy feathered hat usually worn by minstrels or nobles.
af38077bed1f3947343d.translation: 一顶华丽的羽饰帽，通常由吟游诗人或贵族佩戴。

cdb8de22f092b7c53318.source: A flat full-metal helmet with noseguard.
cdb8de22f092b7c53318.translation: 带有护鼻的全金属平顶盔。

f46b37ea16f28192e3c9.source: A flat full-metal helmet with a mail coif covering the neck and face.
f46b37ea16f28192e3c9.translation: 全金属平顶盔，配有包覆颈部和面部的锁甲头巾。

f7a067c251595a0dc197.source: A flat full-metal helmet with noseguard and a mail coif underneath.
f7a067c251595a0dc197.translation: 全金属平顶盔，带有护鼻，下衬锁甲头巾。

1e6193839d89d6b1fb32.source: A worn flat full-metal helmet with a rusted mail coif covering the neck and face.
1e6193839d89d6b1fb32.translation: 破旧的全金属平顶盔，生锈的锁甲头巾包覆颈部和面部。

0a154eb60ea84c0f286b.source: A large padded cloth cap also covering the neck.
0a154eb60ea84c0f286b.translation: 能够护住颈部的大号厚衬布帽。

907cd0d35c81b1443c9d.source: A closed metal helm with breathing holes. Great in the way of protection but hard to breathe in and limiting the field of view.
907cd0d35c81b1443c9d.translation: 开有透气孔的封闭式金属盔。防护出色，但呼吸不畅，视野也会受限。

ccc2bf1aa75d61733b61.source: A closed leather cap that protects the head and neck. Padded for extra protection.
ccc2bf1aa75d61733b61.translation: 包覆头颈的皮帽，加有衬垫以加强防护。

6c35af6cc9560a4ed7a7.source: What once animated the Rachegeist's armor has long dissipated, leaving this ornate and well-preserved full helm behind.
6c35af6cc9560a4ed7a7.translation: 曾驱动复仇之灵甲胄的力量早已消散，只留下这顶华丽而保存完好的全覆盔。

0221daa50fc776e3a7cb.source: A tiny book, fashioned into a headband with leather straps. Its contents are unintelligible.
0221daa50fc776e3a7cb.translation: 一本小书，用皮带固定成了头饰。里面写的东西完全看不懂。

5db5954128649026c5a3.source: A crude mask bearing an occult symbol that covers the face.
5db5954128649026c5a3.translation: 遮住面部的粗制面具，上面绘着神秘教派的符号。

c8ea9b916abcde93b18a.source: Thick leather straps, wrapped crudely around the head for protection.
c8ea9b916abcde93b18a.translation: 将厚皮带粗略地缠在头上，用来防护。

fad97aa566100118eed5.source: The distinctive headdress worn by the Grand Diviner. The elaborate design limits the wearer's vision but offers excellent protection.
fad97aa566100118eed5.translation: 大占卜师佩戴的独特头饰。繁复的结构会遮挡视线，却提供了出色的防护。

bb36083a755e8e705420.source: A sturdy metal helmet with added padding, covered with a large feathered hat.
bb36083a755e8e705420.translation: 结实的金属头盔内加衬垫，外罩一顶宽大的羽饰帽。

7871f69c7baac790c996.source: A thick leather hat with ornaments and feathers.
7871f69c7baac790c996.translation: 饰有羽毛与其他装饰物的厚皮帽。

f9d6f76e9c7f978fc13a.source: A thick piece of cloth wrapped around the head.

bc599bf0f47c8ff6fe97.source: A full mail coif, heavier and sturdier than most others of its kind. Decorated with a colorful plait.
bc599bf0f47c8ff6fe97.translation: 全覆式锁甲头巾，比寻常同类更厚重结实，饰有彩色编带。

fe9f358d2314d0713838.source: A simple hood to protect against weather and scratches.
fe9f358d2314d0713838.translation: 简单的兜帽，可以遮挡风寒，防止轻微擦伤。

ca6055eac42ff96c886b.source: A thick felt hat decorated with feathers as a hunter's trophy.
ca6055eac42ff96c886b.translation: 厚实的毡帽，饰有猎人从猎物身上取下的羽毛。

4e400f6bb77daf766355.source: The colorful and iconic headpiece of jesters, entertainers and other traveling folk.
4e400f6bb77daf766355.translation: 弄臣、艺人及其他行旅表演者标志性的彩色头饰。

65acec59be0a763b9847.source: A full-metal helmet with a broad rim.

d3089deb7f263a69bd5c.source: A full-metal helmet with a broad rim and a mail coif covering the neck and face.
d3089deb7f263a69bd5c.translation: 宽檐的全金属头盔，配有包覆颈部和面部的锁甲头巾。

b5efc6345d267f38593a.source: A full-metal helmet with a broad rim and a mail coif underneath.
b5efc6345d267f38593a.translation: 宽檐的全金属头盔，下衬锁甲头巾。

4527735ab3b364e64499.source: A worn helmet with a broad rim and a rusted mail coif covering the neck and face.
4527735ab3b364e64499.translation: 破旧的宽檐头盔，生锈的锁甲头巾包覆颈部和面部。

0715c89eca84ae17470e.source: A golden helmet and facemask, showing the visage of an emperor from an age long past, imbued with mystical energies. When you hold it into the light, it almost looks as if the face were moving and making expressions of disgust.
0715c89eca84ae17470e.translation: 金色头盔配着面甲，塑出一位远古皇帝的容貌，其中蕴含神秘力量。将它举到光下，面容仿佛会微微扭动，露出嫌恶的神情。

28a91287f735329ea6c1.source: The Fangshire is a northern tiger's skull that nestles the faces of men deeply and darkly behind two ferocious fangs. Originally worn by Bjarund the Beastman, a fierce northern raider, it instilled fear into the hearts of his enemies as he went on bloody raids and burned down many a village along the coastline. When Bjarund was finally slain, Fangshire was taken as a trophy and went further south. Rumors proclaim that its wearer's eyes glow a sharpened yellow, allowing them to see through the very night.
28a91287f735329ea6c1.translation: “獠牙乡”由北境猛虎的颅骨制成，两根狰狞獠牙将佩戴者的脸深深藏在阴影里。它最初属于凶猛的北境劫掠者“兽人”比亚伦德。此人沿海岸烧毁村庄、四处血腥劫掠时，这顶头盔令敌人闻风丧胆。比亚伦德最终被杀后，獠牙乡成了战利品，辗转流入南方。据说，佩戴它的人双眼会发出锐利的黄光，甚至能看穿黑夜。

4632f87761708837df0c.source: Allows the wearer to see at night and negates any penalties due to nighttime.
4632f87761708837df0c.translation: 赋予佩戴者夜视能力，免除夜间带来的所有惩罚。

4c19767de29911397b9c.source: Once a barbarian helmet broken in battle, this piece has been bathed in the blood of the legendary Ijirok. Powers beyond your understanding mended it whole again, and will likewise mend any wounds of the wearer as well.
4c19767de29911397b9c.translation: 这顶蛮族战盔曾在战斗中破损，如今沐浴过传说中伊吉罗克的鲜血。超乎你理解的力量使它恢复完好，也将同样治愈佩戴者的伤口。

6ff62794d139703af938.source: The Glimpse of Davkul is a gift bestowed upon man by ancient and dark powers, a helmet merged with human skin and bones through the most unspeakable of rituals. A glimpse of a future where man shall become one with creations from a realm beyond. It shall never break, but instead keep regrowing its scarred skin on the spot.
6ff62794d139703af938.translation: “达夫库尔一瞥”是古老黑暗力量赐给人类的礼物：通过难以启齿的仪式，头盔与人的皮肉、骨骼融为一体。它让人窥见一种未来——人类终将与异界的造物合而为一。它永不破碎，伤痕累累的皮肤总会当即重新生长。

b339afbc6e8d6d3d0f74.source: A mail coif that also protects the neck.
b339afbc6e8d6d3d0f74.translation: 能够护住颈部的锁甲头巾。

e5a442b70d1ee5b265a9.source: A rusted helmet with an attached closed mail neck guard commonly used by coastal raiders.
e5a442b70d1ee5b265a9.translation: 沿海劫掠者常用的锈蚀头盔，配有全封闭的锁甲护颈。

97befc0bcb37a834e3fc.source: A rusted helmet with an attached mail neck guard commonly used by coastal raiders.
97befc0bcb37a834e3fc.translation: 沿海劫掠者常用的锈蚀头盔，配有锁甲护颈。

95c46f343d4de8a3a117.source: A brimmed metal helmet with an ominous black mask to cover the face.
95c46f343d4de8a3a117.translation: 宽檐金属盔，配有遮住面部、透着不祥气息的黑色面具。

531ea0c5d485287157d8.source: A piece of cloth covering the lower face to protect from breathing in dust or prevent identification.
531ea0c5d485287157d8.translation: 蒙住口鼻的布片，用来防止吸入尘土，或隐藏身份。

64122d987b16b368897c.source: This southern style helmet is not only richly decorated, but also well balanced and made from materials of the highest quality.
64122d987b16b368897c.translation: 这顶南方样式的头盔不仅装饰华美，还以顶级材料打造，重心分布也十分合理。

a205d13a8793fded5710.source: A sturdy alloy helmet of foreign design, combined with a full mail coif for excellent protection.
a205d13a8793fded5710.translation: 异国样式的坚固合金头盔，配上全覆锁甲头巾，防护极佳。

c8016819b218fd0a417f.source: A heavy bascinet with a moveable visor, worn over a mail coif. A showy piece befitting a true knight.
c8016819b218fd0a417f.translation: 厚重的尖顶盔配有活动面甲，下衬锁甲头巾，华丽气派，堪配真正的骑士。

2e8c67828a5cd4d341c0.source: This helmet must have once belonged to a daring and skilled hunter for it is covered in the scales of a dreaded Lindwurm. Not only do the scales deflect blows and hits, but they also remain unscathed by the acidic Lindwurm blood.
2e8c67828a5cd4d341c0.translation: 这顶头盔披覆着可怕的林德蠕龙鳞片，想必曾属于一位胆识与技艺俱佳的猎人。鳞片不仅能够抵挡打击，也不惧林德蠕龙酸血的侵蚀。

5194b19dc38df9842deb.source: This conic helmet has a faceguard attached and finely fitted scales to protect the neck. The faceguard resembles a fearsome warrior that is about to strike his enemy.
5194b19dc38df9842deb.translation: 这顶锥形盔装有面甲，并以贴合严密的鳞片保护颈部。面甲塑成凶悍战士的模样，仿佛下一刻便要扑向敌人。

29dff48c84751af1fe3b.source: A reinforced helmet made from an extremely sturdy alloy. It is richly decorated and heavy but offers extraordinary protection.
29dff48c84751af1fe3b.translation: 用极其坚固的合金制成的加固头盔，装饰华美而分量沉重，防护却格外出色。

524944f65f9b9c580826.source: This helmet must have belonged to a distinct warrior of the barbarians. Its size and design appear alien to all southern folks.
524944f65f9b9c580826.translation: 这顶头盔必定属于某位出众的蛮族勇士。它的尺寸与样式，对所有南方人来说都颇为陌生。

4c655523a779ce62949d.source: A heavy helmet typical of the northern barbarians with a skull-like facemask. This piece is as massive as it is impressive.
4c655523a779ce62949d.translation: 典型的北境蛮族重盔，配有骷髅形面甲，庞大厚重，令人望而生畏。

d9f162a9ca14c76832cc.source: This nordic helmet with faceguard is extraordinarly crafted, and as protective as it is impressive looking.
d9f162a9ca14c76832cc.translation: 这顶带有面甲的北境头盔做工非凡，防护与外观同样出色。

e0b9d83ca1d8e5d42375.source: A masterfully crafted helmet in the fashion of the steppe folks. Decorated with gold applications and equipped with additional cheek guards.
e0b9d83ca1d8e5d42375.translation: 依草原民族样式精心打造的头盔，饰有金片，还加装了护颊。

73af7c4ae61d10bac9d6.source: A hardened nasal helmet with a unique neckguard made from leather scales.
73af7c4ae61d10bac9d6.translation: 经硬化处理的护鼻盔，配有独特的皮鳞护颈。

db90f46bc5dccd9ba3b8.source: A richly ornated nordic helmet that must have belonged to a high ranking noble or exalted warrior.
db90f46bc5dccd9ba3b8.translation: 装饰华美的北境头盔，必定曾属于位高权重的贵族或功勋卓著的勇士。

e5a2e142d125ff46078d.source: This southern style helmet is not only richly decorated, but also well balanced and made from extremely high quality metals.
e5a2e142d125ff46078d.translation: 这顶南方样式的头盔不仅装饰华美，还以顶级金属打造，重心分布也十分合理。

3fa272814d5dcd55928a.source: A masterfully crafted sallet supported by a mail coif, crested with colored ribbons.
3fa272814d5dcd55928a.translation: 工艺精湛的萨莱特盔，内衬锁子头巾，盔顶饰有彩带。

accadb48515f7fe96c6d.source: A sturdy metal helmet with attached mail, covered with an impressive wolf head.
accadb48515f7fe96c6d.translation: 坚固的金属盔配有锁甲，外面覆着威风凛凛的狼首。

861183f57b025426712a.source: A metal helmet with added noseguard.
861183f57b025426712a.translation: 加装了护鼻的金属头盔。

709003a18eac1ca4418d.source: A metal helmet with a noseguard and a closed mail coif underneath.
709003a18eac1ca4418d.translation: 带有护鼻的金属头盔，下衬覆面锁甲头巾。

bcc33d06593fff488a3b.source: A metal helmet with added noseguard and a mail coif underneath.
bcc33d06593fff488a3b.translation: 加装了护鼻的金属头盔，下衬锁甲头巾。

0ab9de8292d2408bc7d7.source: A worn and used helmet with a rusty mail coif.
0ab9de8292d2408bc7d7.translation: 破旧头盔，配有生锈的锁甲头巾。

17ff19eff43878a1c20b.source: A nordic helmet guarding face and neck with additional metal plates.
17ff19eff43878a1c20b.translation: 加有金属甲片，保护面部与颈部的北境头盔。

507338fae585b04bde46.source: A metal nordic helmet with an attached closed mail neck guard.
507338fae585b04bde46.translation: 配有全封闭锁甲护颈的北境金属盔。

07935c7a8219d0319f1d.source: A sturdy leather cap that is not covering the ears and neck.
07935c7a8219d0319f1d.translation: 结实的皮帽，耳朵和颈部露在外面。

7682c690e16b0af1b972.source: An assassin's face mask and head wrap.

a80c2c4e31796d10cbb8.source: The dark head wrap of an assassin.

4bd25875b123a9dce7c6.source: This distinct red and black head wrap is traditionally worn by the most skilled warriors of the nomad tribes.
4bd25875b123a9dce7c6.translation: 独特的红黑头巾，依传统只有游牧部落中技艺最精湛的战士才会佩戴。

740a72bc6635dbd597cb.source: A thick head wrap with small hidden leather strings for added protection, adorned with a bronze scorpion.
740a72bc6635dbd597cb.translation: 厚头巾内暗缝细皮条以加强防护，外饰一只青铜蝎子。

fc0ad4f7dc255b6ef794.source: A finely wrapped cloth turban with insignia declaring the wearer a learned engineer from the city states.
fc0ad4f7dc255b6ef794.translation: 精心缠成的布头巾，其徽记表明佩戴者是一位来自城邦、学识渊博的工程师。

98946a5480433437f146.source: An impressive metal helmet crafted to intimidate the opponents of pit fighters in arenas of the southern city states.
98946a5480433437f146.translation: 气势十足的金属头盔，专为南方城邦竞技场中的斗士打造，用来震慑对手。

b2c0e9e4f54190d290bf.source: A finely wrapped cloth turban worn by those that practise the use of elaborate gunpowder weapons in armies of the city states.
b2c0e9e4f54190d290bf.translation: 城邦军中使用精密火药武器的士兵佩戴的布头巾，缠裹得十分整齐。

cd0ff028b45a5a8be26b.source: A heavy helmet made from overlapping metal plates.
cd0ff028b45a5a8be26b.translation: 用层层搭叠的金属甲片制成的重盔。

d4f8cb57f90bf3708866.source: A thick leather head wrap that protects against cuts and bruises.
d4f8cb57f90bf3708866.translation: 厚皮裹成的头巾，可以防止割伤和擦伤。

58fb6258ea970e77371c.source: A nomad style head wrap suited to protect against sun and heat.
58fb6258ea970e77371c.translation: 游牧式头巾，能够遮挡烈日与酷热。

51ca885d822d33112d91.source: A light helmet typical of the southern desert regions.
51ca885d822d33112d91.translation: 南方沙漠地区常见的轻型头盔。

a3174a07e3a2050f05d8.source: A nomad helmet reinforced with mail.
a3174a07e3a2050f05d8.translation: 以锁甲加固的游牧头盔。

14bf558ed1db22098cec.source: A traditional southern head wrap suited for desert climate.
14bf558ed1db22098cec.translation: 适合沙漠气候的传统南方头巾。

b220fd2e7e54333abbbb.source: A southern metal helmet with a mail coif to protect the neck.
b220fd2e7e54333abbbb.translation: 南方式金属头盔，配有保护颈部的锁甲头巾。

acded9b89401383dc407.source: A metal skull cap with a fashionable spike worn atop a mail coif.
acded9b89401383dc407.translation: 顶部饰有时兴尖刺的金属颅盔，下衬锁甲头巾。

92337bdda107ed0493f3.source: A full helmet crafted from overlapping long metal splints in the shape of a traditional southern head wrap.
92337bdda107ed0493f3.translation: 金属长条交叠拼成的全覆盔，外形仿照传统南方头巾。

1eecab34d52922b40da7.source: This metal helmet is wrapped in cloth to protect against the blazingly hot sun of the southern deserts.
1eecab34d52922b40da7.translation: 这顶金属头盔外裹布料，以抵挡南方沙漠炙热的阳光。

19590de0c0d6a6679b05.source: A flat full-metal helmet with noseguard and a padded coif underneath.
19590de0c0d6a6679b05.translation: 带有护鼻的全金属平顶盔，下衬软甲头巾。

2e2ad25f3decdde1e09d.source: A full-metal helmet with a broad rim and a padded coif underneath.
2e2ad25f3decdde1e09d.translation: 宽檐的全金属盔，下衬软甲头巾。

ecad6b6d9f95a83e625d.source: A metal helmet with added noseguard and a padded coif underneath.
ecad6b6d9f95a83e625d.translation: 带有护鼻的金属头盔，下衬软甲头巾。

7228bbebbfc2646a879f.source: A thick leather hood with a distinctive, bird-like mask. The beak acts as a ventilator, containing sweet-smelling herbs to ward away sickness and disease.
7228bbebbfc2646a879f.translation: 厚皮头罩配有独特的鸟嘴面具。空气通过鸟嘴流入，其中填放芳香药草，用来驱避疾病。

8ec129b7a48c39ba9972.source: ]50%[/color] of damage inflicted by harmful miasmas

0d6f6a6cd2ac3c9f2b9a.source: A mail coif with additional metal noseguard.
0d6f6a6cd2ac3c9f2b9a.translation: 加装金属护鼻的锁甲头巾。

e9adf36ff14088ec1bc9.source: A rusty mail coif that still offers good protection - it leaves horrible stains though.
e9adf36ff14088ec1bc9.translation: 生锈的锁甲头巾，防护依然不错，只是会蹭得满身锈污。
