25b3c35fd2bb1661f2a1.translation: 即使是长柄战锤这样粗犷的武器，也能倾注热忱、技艺与细致的打磨。眼前这柄，就是令人信服的明证。

dba534fbdfd984253c4c.source: A crude weapon like a polemace can also be crafted with passion, skill and attention to detail, as this exemplar showcases impressively.
dba534fbdfd984253c4c.translation: 即使是长柄钉锤这样粗犷的武器，也能倾注热忱、技艺与细致的打磨。眼前这柄，就是令人信服的明证。

ffdbbd2a4d5b5653b109.source: An exquisitely crafted curved blade, notoriously used by assassins of the southern deserts. Particularly effective against targets already debilitated.
ffdbbd2a4d5b5653b109.translation: 一柄精制弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已经陷入虚弱状态的目标格外有效。

0797a8c73db6d7c00fb6.source: This massive and exceptionally well-crafted warblade is covered with runes and decorations that are typical for the barbarian tribes of the north.
0797a8c73db6d7c00fb6.translation: 这柄巨大的战刃制作极为精良，布满北方蛮族特有的符文和纹饰。

fa0b6d2a50209eb40dac.source: A Shamshir already is an exquisite and exotic weapon in these parts, but this piece is of extraordinary quality. It will cut through flesh and bone just as easily as through a ripe melon.
fa0b6d2a50209eb40dac.translation: 在这片土地上，舍施尔弯刀本已是精美的异域武器，而这一柄的品质尤其出众。斩开血肉与骨头，对它而言就像切开熟透的瓜一样轻松。

669ef3900e4ff4e88e12.source: This crude and heavy hammer is decorated with additional animals skulls as if not impressive enough already. Like a ram's head, it will crush its target.
669ef3900e4ff4e88e12.translation: 这柄粗犷的重锤已经十分骇人，却还嫌不够似的，额外饰上了兽类头骨。它会像公羊的头槌一样，狠狠撞碎目标。

1d14cc922be4d376da45.source: A masterfully crafted spear that feels surprisingly light, yet sturdy.
1d14cc922be4d376da45.translation: 一柄制作精良的长矛，坚固之余，握持起来出奇地轻巧。

a947e247712ac2613bce.source: This Spetum is especially well-crafted, and its three tips have been honed into perfectly pointy spikes.
a947e247712ac2613bce.translation: 这柄三尖矛制作格外精良，三个尖端都已磨得锐利无比。

dda4b4be8934e9de8954.source: A well-balanced long sword with a double-edged blade. A weapon crafted as well as this one is hard to find.
dda4b4be8934e9de8954.translation: 一柄重心平稳的双刃长剑。如此精良的工艺，并不多见。

9a751fd3dffe8784479f.source: A long pole attached to a sharp and finely balanced curved blade, used to deliver deep sweeping strikes over some distance.
9a751fd3dffe8784479f.translation: 长杆上装着锋利而配重精良的弯刃，可以从较远处横扫，切出深深的伤口。

c4f4d1e939e38f24e2bc.source: A very rare weapon built from valuable and strong materials. Despite its ceremonial look it makes for a terrifying tool of destruction.
c4f4d1e939e38f24e2bc.translation: 以珍贵而坚固的材料制成的罕见武器。虽然看着像仪仗用品，却是一件可怕的杀戮利器。

5bb9afc917e7910209bf.source: Small axes to be thrown in an overhand motion towards a target. These ones are especially well-balanced and hardy enough to inflict serious damage to armor and shields from range.
5bb9afc917e7910209bf.translation: 从肩上扬臂掷向目标的小斧头。这一束配重尤其平稳，斧身坚实，足以从远处重创护甲与盾牌。

e47574db5ba54130bec8.source: This impressive two-handed flail has little left in common with the farming tool it originates from. It appears to have been designed by an experienced fighter and built by an extraordinarily skilled craftsman.
e47574db5ba54130bec8.translation: 这柄威势十足的双手连枷，已经几乎看不出原先农具的模样。它似乎由经验丰富的战士设计，再交给技艺卓绝的匠人打造。

33c44ac7ac5b7f150b29.source: A massive hammer that is surprisingly well-balanced, despite its huge weight. What it lacks in grace, it makes up for in raw force as it is used to shatter even heavily-armored enemy lines by knocking people away or to the ground.
33c44ac7ac5b7f150b29.translation: 这柄巨锤分量惊人，握持起来却出奇地平稳。它用蛮力弥补了招式上的笨拙，能将敌人击退、击倒，砸开重甲严阵。

3b95a0d6d557f57f9246.source: A large two-handed mace born in the fiery smithy of a true master. Despite its massive head, the weapon is well-balanced and reasonably easy to handle for an experienced individual.
3b95a0d6d557f57f9246.translation: 一柄在大师炉火中锻成的大型双手钉锤。锤头虽硕大，重心却很平稳，有经验的人驾驭起来并不太难。

a3b119b53518c653fbf4.source: A very large scimitar wielded with both hands. The curved blade cleaves right through any enemy, and the blade is surprisingly well balanced for its size.
a3b119b53518c653fbf4.translation: 需要双手挥舞的巨型弯刀。弯曲的刀刃足以劈开挡路的敌人，而以它的尺寸而言，重心竟出奇地平稳。

e4bd3a0de01f99a9f828.source: A heavy spiked mace crafted to resemble a human skull. Despite its crude appearance, this is a well balanced and deadly weapon.
e4bd3a0de01f99a9f828.translation: 一柄做成人类颅骨形状的重型尖刺钉锤。外表虽然粗犷，却重心平稳，十分致命。

ca62677c0400e48dd756.source: Made from very strong yet flexible wood, this warbow has massive pulling power and is a rare piece of skilled craftsmanship.
ca62677c0400e48dd756.translation: 以坚固而富有韧性的木材制成的战弓，拉力强劲，是难得一见的精工作品。

2c773c5d62239a1e32b6.source: A masterfully crafted and somewhat uncommon variant of the sword with a long and thin blade, sharpened only on one side, and no crossguard. Can be used both for quick slashes and sweeping strikes.
2c773c5d62239a1e32b6.translation: 一件精工打造、形制少见的剑类武器。刀身修长纤细，单侧开刃，没有十字护手，既能迅速劈斩，也能横扫敌人。

36e1fab89672fc5d5243.source: A well-crafted warhammer that easily batters through armor plates.
36e1fab89672fc5d5243.translation: 一柄精制战锤，能轻易击穿金属甲片。

bd62a39a92a243ae38f8.source: A long pole attached to a sharp curved blade, used to deliver deep sweeping strikes over some distance. This exemplar is particularly well-crafted.
bd62a39a92a243ae38f8.translation: 长杆上装着锋利的弯刃，可以从较远处横扫，切出深深的伤口。这一柄制作得格外精良。

549f4f39fdf603ba4fde.source: A well-balanced long sword with a double-edged blade.
549f4f39fdf603ba4fde.translation: 一柄重心平稳的双刃长剑。

45d6c6b47c41f108790a.source: A short bow made from composite layers for additional drawing power.
45d6c6b47c41f108790a.translation: 由多层材料复合制成的短弓，拉力更强。

20c680c72b0ec550ebfe.source: A spear of southern design with an explosive charge that will spew fire over two tiles when ignited. The charge is only usable once per battle, but automatically refilled after battle.
20c680c72b0ec550ebfe.translation: 一种南方设计的长矛，装有火药，点燃后能向前方两格喷出火焰。每场战斗只能喷射一次，战斗结束后会自动补充火药。

1dabf8bfaea9206d2827.source: An iron barrel with a long wooden handle. It fires shrapnel in a cone and can hit multiple targets with one shot. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
1dabf8bfaea9206d2827.translation: 铁制铳管装着长木柄，可向前方扇形范围喷射弹丸，一次击中多个目标。陷入近战时无法使用。

65180c9b173c72a38aed.source: A heavy winged mace commonly used by well equipped soldiers of the southern reaches.
65180c9b173c72a38aed.translation: 南方装备精良的士兵常用的重型翼刃钉锤。

413a8989f67dabd22ed5.source: A metal mace with extended wings for added effectiveness against armor.
413a8989f67dabd22ed5.translation: 一柄金属钉锤，锤头伸出翼状刃片，对付护甲更加有效。

0cc4ffc9ca0df4fb17bd.source: A simple wooden mace with a metal head. Weapons like this are popular among the nomads of the deserts.
0cc4ffc9ca0df4fb17bd.translation: 木柄配上金属锤头，构成了这柄简单的钉锤。这类武器颇受沙漠游牧民欢迎。

2f5311889b920c6f0f89.source: A leather sling on a metal-reinforced staff, used to hurl stones at the enemy. With stones abundant everywhere, it will never run out of ammunition.
2f5311889b920c6f0f89.translation: 经过金属加固的长杖顶端系着皮革投石索，用来向敌人投掷石块。石头随处可得，因此永远不会缺少弹药。

09ceb64b3e3aa245cda6.source: A long mace that can be used to deliver stunning blows over a distance.
09ceb64b3e3aa245cda6.translation: 一柄长柄钉锤，能从较远处重击敌人，使其眩晕。

44b449731a4799e819d2.source: A curved blade notoriously used by assassins of the southern deserts. Particularly effective against targets already debilitated.
44b449731a4799e819d2.translation: 一柄弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已经陷入虚弱状态的目标格外有效。

dd8857b9f0cd8c181a92.source: A curved sword typically found only in the southern reaches. Excellent for slashing, but not for thrusting or penetrating armor.
dd8857b9f0cd8c181a92.translation: 一种通常只见于南方的弯刀，擅长劈斩，却不适合刺击或穿透护甲。

73646b300d2b5dbd9da2.source: A long version of the Saif wielded with both hands. The curved blade can cleave gruesome wounds.
73646b300d2b5dbd9da2.translation: 加长的赛义夫弯刀，需要双手挥舞。弯曲的刀刃能劈出骇人的伤口。

b0f8b724460bca2ac0ac.source: A large scimitar wielded with both hands. The curved blade cleaves right through any enemy.
b0f8b724460bca2ac0ac.translation: 需要双手挥舞的大型弯刀。弯曲的刀刃足以劈开挡路的敌人。

1841b5ee61bd928cf34b.source: A hard head made from metal attached to a wooden handle, the Pickaxe is a miner's tool used to break up rocks. As an improvised weapon it's unwieldy but can deliver fatal injuries even through armor.
1841b5ee61bd928cf34b.translation: 坚硬的金属镐头装在木柄上，是矿工用来凿碎岩石的工具。临时拿来作武器虽然笨拙，却能穿透护甲，造成致命伤。

219bc5c4b97d2d0e51dc.source: A long pike used for thrusting over some distance and keeping the enemy at bay.
219bc5c4b97d2d0e51dc.translation: 一柄长枪，可以从较远处刺击，将敌人挡在身前。

d05d08e1d73c9a9e14cd.source: An agricultural tool with a long handle and thick pointed tines used to lift and pitch straw. As an improvised weapon it can be used to keep an opponent at bay, but it won't inflict the deadliest of injuries and will perform poorly against armor.
d05d08e1d73c9a9e14cd.translation: 一种带有长柄和粗壮尖齿的农具，用来挑起、抛掷干草。临时拿来作武器时，它能将敌人挡在一定距离之外，但杀伤力有限，也很难对付护甲。

e3e138e318002cef21e6.source: A versatile polearm designed for armored combat between knights. Can deliver a wide variety of injuries.
e3e138e318002cef21e6.translation: 专为披甲骑士之间的战斗设计的多用途长杆武器，能够造成多种伤害。

6451ec02f9cddd392735.source: A warhammer mounted on a long pole, used against armored targets over some distance and from behind the frontline.
6451ec02f9cddd392735.translation: 长杆上装着战锤，可从较远处攻击披甲目标，也可站在前排身后出手。

5bc6269139fd4be299b3.source: Two large sticks attached with a short chain and reinforced with metal, the Reinforced Wooden Flail is an agricultural tool turned weapon. A rather unpredictable one at that, but deadly enough to fell most men with a good hit to the head, and useful to strike over or around shield cover.
5bc6269139fd4be299b3.translation: 两根粗木棍以短链相连，再包上金属加固，便成了这件由农具改造而来的武器。强化木连枷的挥击轨迹颇难预料，但只要结结实实打中头部，就足以放倒大多数人，还能越过或绕开盾牌的防护。

f7ba9d20f9ff6fffbbd3.source: A long, quadrangular spike designed to pierce through weakpoints in armor.
f7ba9d20f9ff6fffbbd3.translation: 修长的四棱尖刃，专门用来刺入护甲的薄弱处。

b3c6ad6abfd3310fff3a.source: An exotic curved sword from the south that is excellent for slashing, but not for thrusting or penetrating armor.
b3c6ad6abfd3310fff3a.translation: 来自南方的异域弯刀，擅长劈斩，却不适合刺击或穿透护甲。

d27d5a51566f18fc198a.source: A long and heavy knife with a one sided blade used more for hacking than slashing.
d27d5a51566f18fc198a.translation: 一把长而沉重的单刃刀，比起划割，更擅长劈砍。

965bd9eaaebc78bfe466.source: This well-crafted exotic blade from the south has a curved edge that allows it to cut deep wounds with ease, but makes it less suited for thrusting and penetrating armor. A rare find in these lands.
965bd9eaaebc78bfe466.translation: 来自南方的精制异域弯刀，弯曲的刃口能轻易切出深深的伤口，却不适合刺击或穿透护甲。在这片土地上十分罕见。

814a6c5e0106453e08a7.source: A simple wooden short bow with medium range. Requires some expertise to use effectively.
814a6c5e0106453e08a7.translation: 一张简单的木制短弓，射程中等，需要一定技巧才能发挥威力。

154bb226f807abcef4fa.source: A short raw iron sword with some dents and notches, easy to wield in one hand.
154bb226f807abcef4fa.translation: 一柄带有些许凹痕和缺口的粗铁短剑，单手就能轻松挥动。

b9a0e5363f3a78270bcf.source: A cross between a spear and a pike, making for a good defensive weapon. Used for thrusting over some distance and keeping the enemy at bay.
b9a0e5363f3a78270bcf.translation: 兼具普通长矛与长枪特点的防御利器，可从较远处刺击，将敌人挡在身前。

7cb05399c5190f2d3b59.source: A leather sling on a staff, used to hurl stones at the enemy. With stones abundant everywhere, it will never run out of ammunition.
7cb05399c5190f2d3b59.translation: 长杖顶端系着皮革投石索，用来向敌人投掷石块。石头随处可得，因此永远不会缺少弹药。

2c421a97c4385f48d7eb.source: Three separate striking heads attached to a handle by chains. Each head can hit or miss a target separately and strike over or around shield cover.
2c421a97c4385f48d7eb.translation: 三个独立的打击头以链条连在握柄上。每个头部都会分别判定是否命中，也能越过或绕开盾牌的防护。

a0db60173b10b551b17c.source: Small axes to be thrown in an overhand motion towards a target. Heavy enough to inflict serious damage to armor and shields from range.
a0db60173b10b551b17c.translation: 从肩上扬臂掷向目标的小斧头。分量足以从远处重创护甲与盾牌。

0f0f691620a3097984eb.source: Lighter than a common spear, but heavier than a javelin, this weapon is intended to be thrown over short distances. The tip will bend on impact, potentially rendering shields unusable. Can be used against unshielded opponents as well for great effect.
0f0f691620a3097984eb.translation: 这种投矛比普通长矛轻，比标枪重，适合近距离投掷。矛尖命中后会弯折，扎进盾牌时可能使其难以继续使用。对付没有盾牌的敌人，同样杀伤力十足。

20825a1b1f1bf562729c.source: A large and heavy metal flail that requires two hands to use. Useful to strike over or around shield cover.
20825a1b1f1bf562729c.translation: 一柄巨大沉重的金属连枷，需要双手挥舞，能越过或绕开盾牌的防护。

0128bb4e3f925337d2c3.source: A large and heavy winged mace held with both hands. Receiving a blow from this weapon will leave anyone dazed and gasping for air, no matter their armor.
0128bb4e3f925337d2c3.translation: 一柄需要双手握持的重型翼刃钉锤。无论披着什么护甲，挨上一击都会头晕目眩、喘不过气。

b283bff15a6243e8bcf6.source: A large and heavy hammer held with both hands. What it lacks in grace, it makes up for in raw force as it is used to shatter even heavily-armored enemy lines by knocking people away or to the ground.
b283bff15a6243e8bcf6.translation: 一柄巨大沉重的双手战锤。它用蛮力弥补了招式上的笨拙，能将敌人击退、击倒，砸开重甲严阵。

9810b97c9fa592343c12.source: A massive wooden club with a spiked head. Receiving a blow from this weapon will leave anyone dazed and gasping for air, no matter their armor.
9810b97c9fa592343c12.translation: 一根装着尖刺头部的巨大木棒。无论披着什么护甲，挨上一击都会头晕目眩、喘不过气。

5988ab26163ac74db980.source: A heavy two-handed wooden flail that can strike over or around shield cover.
5988ab26163ac74db980.translation: 沉重的双手木连枷，能越过或绕开盾牌的防护。

5e2b3c4592842ccb537c.source: A large wooden mallet that is held with both hands. Can deal devastating blows that may knock even armored enemies away or to the ground.
5e2b3c4592842ccb537c.translation: 需要双手握持的大木槌，重击威力惊人，连披甲敌人也可能被击退或砸倒在地。

412b46f3cca3a475cc4f.source: A long bow with massive pulling power. Distinctively designed for battle.
412b46f3cca3a475cc4f.translation: 一张拉力强劲的长弓，专为战场打造。

b45c1a945d43e2b7fd4d.source: A two-handed variant of the sword with a long and thin blade, sharpened only on one side, and no crossguard. Can be used both for quick slashes and sweeping strikes.
b45c1a945d43e2b7fd4d.translation: 一种双手剑类武器，刀身修长纤细，单侧开刃，没有十字护手，既能迅速劈斩，也能横扫敌人。

c8b6975376d63e51ab43.source: A pitchfork re-forged into a battlefield weapon that is a cross between a spear and a pike. Used for thrusting over some distance and keeping the enemy at bay.
c8b6975376d63e51ab43.translation: 由草叉重新锻造的战场武器，兼具普通长矛与长枪的特点，可从较远处刺击，将敌人挡在身前。

2759cc5471ad60aaf8da.source: A short iron warhammer that easily batters through armor plates.
2759cc5471ad60aaf8da.translation: 一柄短柄铁制战锤，能轻易击穿金属甲片。

d12112f91c418c23b5ca.translation: 武器技能的额外疲劳消耗：[color=

37ede131db0c9f898d7b.source: A full-metal mace with a short shaft and attached blades.
37ede131db0c9f898d7b.translation: 一柄全金属短柄钉锤，锤头装有翼状刃片。

85f703317f937d3820c2.source: An ill-conceived bow if you ever saw one. The wood cricks and cracks when bent, the string frizzes and goes wiry every time you draw it back.
85f703317f937d3820c2.translation: 你见过做得最不靠谱的弓，大概也就这样了。弓身一弯便咯吱作响，仿佛随时会裂开；每次拉弦，弓弦都毛躁扭曲，像根乱铁丝。

f51886a2e9aa77365792.source: A long, two-handed axe that bears down heavy with every swing. Held with both hands it is used to cut down large trees, but will cut down men just as well.
f51886a2e9aa77365792.translation: 一柄长柄双手斧，每次挥落都势大力沉。双手握持可以砍倒大树，用来砍倒人也一样利落。

99c1b80c0498061758b7.source: Two large sticks attached with a short chain, the Wooden Flail is an agricultural tool used to strike piles of grain to loosen the husks. As an improvised weapon it's rather unpredictable but useful to strike over or around shield cover.
99c1b80c0498061758b7.translation: 木连枷由两根粗木棍和一截短链连成，原本用于敲打谷物、使谷壳脱落。临时拿来作武器时，挥击轨迹虽难以掌握，却能越过或绕开盾牌的防护。

601024c23f30bea02693.source: A simple wooden stick, usually an improvised weapon.
601024c23f30bea02693.translation: 一根简单的木棍，常被临时拿来充作武器。

13ee8021edd291961332.translation: 打开雇用界面以更换随从

dbd45624243425589b31.source: The Agent has eyes and ears everywhere and knows where to go for current events to take advantage of and well-paying contracts both.
dbd45624243425589b31.translation: 密探的耳目遍布各地，哪里有时局可供利用，哪里有报酬丰厚的委托，他都了如指掌。

f7ad473da64b1e646d04.source: Reveals available contracts and active situations in the tooltip of settlements no matter where you are
f7ad473da64b1e646d04.translation: 无论身在何处，都能在聚落的提示信息中查看可接取的委托和当前状况

3e774223b8f0f117e2ac.source: Have allied relations with a noble house or city state
3e774223b8f0f117e2ac.translation: 与一个贵族家族或城邦结为盟友

fb4ae0dbd8445b50defd.source: The Alchemist is knowledgeable in crafting all kinds of mysterious contraptions and concoctions from exotic ingredients when given access to taxidermist equipment, and uses less material to do so.
fb4ae0dbd8445b50defd.translation: 炼金术士熟知各种奇巧器具与神秘药剂的制作方法。只要借用剥制工坊的设备，他就能将稀奇古怪的材料变成成品，而且耗材更少。

af7e15ddeb81df406a17.source: Has a 25% chance of not consuming any crafting component used by you
af7e15ddeb81df406a17.translation: 制作物品时，有25%的几率不消耗所用材料

fa7805d812f556002b2e.source: Unlocks 'Snake Oil' recipe to earn money by crafting from various low tier components
fa7805d812f556002b2e.translation: 解锁“蛇油”配方，可将多种低级材料制成商品出售赚钱

9b1c5bbfaa3c311a6587.source: Mercenaries are good at getting arms and armor destroyed, but not at maintaining them. The Blacksmith will take care of this tedious task quickly and efficiently, and can mend even equipment otherwise thought lost.
9b1c5bbfaa3c311a6587.translation: 佣兵们糟蹋武器护甲的本事一流，保养起来却不在行。铁匠能迅速而高效地处理这些琐事，连原本以为报废了的装备也能修复。

653ccbb43aaa78128a8a.source: Recovers all equipment worn by your men even if broken or lost because of death
653ccbb43aaa78128a8a.translation: 收回弟兄们穿戴的所有装备，包括因损坏或战死而原本会损失的装备

5e051a4a89261f24c386.source: /5 items repaired at a town's smith

a491608ddf6012067d7a.source: This colorful Bounty Hunter has a pocket full of contracts on the most dangerous individuals. He knows how to get them from hiding and will pay handsomely for any bounty fulfilled.
a491608ddf6012067d7a.translation: 这位赏金猎人来历不凡，口袋里塞满了追捕穷凶极恶之徒的悬赏令。他知道怎样把目标从藏身处引出来，也会为每一笔完成的悬赏支付丰厚报酬。

dc5fd2514ad88621b931.source: Significantly increases the chance of encountering champions
dc5fd2514ad88621b931.translation: 大幅提高遭遇敌方精英的几率

725c9caf9a251e632e2c.source: Pays between 300 and 750 crowns for every champion slain
725c9caf9a251e632e2c.translation: 每击杀一名敌方精英，获得300至750克朗赏金

9413d1fb806daa5daacb.source: /3 named or legendary items in your possession

d1953e5a93be572bcbfb.source: The Brigand may be old and weak now, but at one point his name was feared across the land. In exchange for a hot meal he happily shares with you what he learns from his contacts about caravans on the road.
d1953e5a93be572bcbfb.translation: 这山贼如今虽已年老体衰，当年的名号却曾让四方闻风丧胆。只要给口热饭，他就乐意把从旧相识那里打听到的商队行踪都告诉你。

5f2055274986d0ebca7e.source: Makes you see the position of some caravans at all times and even if outside your sight radius
5f2055274986d0ebca7e.translation: 随时显示部分商队的位置，即使它们在你的视野之外

eee0ad1194d582c558c7.source: The Cartographer is a man of culture and knowledge, but he also realizes that traveling in the company of well-armed mercenaries is one of the best ways to safely see the world and explore places that few visited before.
eee0ad1194d582c558c7.translation: 制图师学识渊博，也很明白：想平安游历天下、探访人迹罕至之地，与一群全副武装的佣兵同行，是再好不过的办法之一。

de44adfdaf0126bb1ced.source: Pays you between 100 and 400 crowns for every location you discover on your own. The further away from civilization, the more you're paid. Legendary locations pay double.
de44adfdaf0126bb1ced.translation: 每自行发现一处地点，获得100至400克朗报酬。离人烟越远，报酬越高；传奇地点的报酬翻倍。

ad6ad9f8b645833b8b37.source: A good warm meal goes a long way towards healing body and mind. The Cook makes sure that no provisions go to waste, and provides the men with invigorating meals.
ad6ad9f8b645833b8b37.translation: 一顿可口的热饭足以抚慰身心。厨师能让粮食物尽其用，为弟兄们备好恢复精力的饭菜。

ecd76c7466403b1bed1f.source: Makes all provisions last 3 extra days
ecd76c7466403b1bed1f.translation: 所有食物的保质期延长3天

994162265b55f847e050.source: Increases hitpoint recovery by 1 per hour
994162265b55f847e050.translation: 每小时额外恢复1点生命值

abb4697bcb7532fd2b44.source: The Drill Sergeant was a mercenary once, but an injury ended his career prematurely. Now he drills discipline into your men and yells a lot to make sure that everyone learns from their mistakes.
abb4697bcb7532fd2b44.translation: 训练教官曾是一名佣兵，却因伤提前结束了战斗生涯。如今，他负责操练纪律，整日大声训斥，确保每个人都能从错误中长记性。

349f2d58957b9a857a32.source: Makes your men gain 20% more experience at level 1, with 2% less at each further level
349f2d58957b9a857a32.translation: 弟兄们在1级时获得的经验提高20%，此后每升一级，该加成递减2%

908b1a57e2ea362d2efe.source: Makes men in reserve never lose mood from not taking part in battles
908b1a57e2ea362d2efe.translation: 预备队成员不会因未参加战斗而心情变差

3db48edcc97d613ca4dc.source: Retired a man with a permanent injury that isn't indebted
3db48edcc97d613ca4dc.translation: 让一名身有永久伤残的弟兄退役，负债者除外

a045e212628db1964557.source: Having a quick Lookout with sharp eyes travel in advance of the company can prove invaluable in being aware of dangers and points of interests before others become aware of the company.
a045e212628db1964557.translation: 让一个行动敏捷、目光锐利的瞭望员走在战团前头，往往大有裨益：在别人发现你们之前，他就能先发现危险与值得探访的地方。

5e3a0e9b69f74748d32e.translation: 显示足迹的更多详细信息

b689f828959d9f33ded6.source: A good song and story play a large part in creating the reputation of a company. The Minstrel is a master of these crafts and will help to spread the word about your deeds to all ears - willing to hear them or not.
b689f828959d9f33ded6.translation: 一首好歌、一段好故事，都能让战团的名声传扬开来。吟游诗人深谙此道，会把你们的事迹唱进所有人的耳朵里——管他们愿不愿意听。

03678aa64aff44e67f98.source: Makes you earn 15% more renown with every action
03678aa64aff44e67f98.translation: 每次行动获得的声望提高15%

70c871852136e18acb35.source: Makes tavern rumors more likely to contain useful information
70c871852136e18acb35.translation: 酒馆传闻更有可能提供有用的信息

f53ecc06b712de8ea240.source: The Negotiator is home to noble courts and fancy halls, and not used to travelling with a band of sellswords with muddy boots, but he is an expert on traversing the mire of social relations and contract negotiations.
f53ecc06b712de8ea240.translation: 谈判专家惯于出入贵族宫廷与华贵厅堂，可不习惯跟一帮满靴泥巴的佣兵四处奔波。不过，要说在复杂的人际关系和委托谈判中周旋，他可是行家。

50df8a811e9182b6eab2.source: Allows for more rounds of contract negotiations with potential employers, and without any hit to relations
50df8a811e9182b6eab2.translation: 与潜在雇主商谈委托时，可进行更多轮讨价还价，且不会损害双方关系

6bfe219015aa56a8ca69.source: Makes good relations with any faction decay slower and bad relations recover faster
6bfe219015aa56a8ca69.translation: 与各势力的友好关系衰减更慢，恶劣关系改善更快

6b7a64b6720b5707de1b.source: The Paymaster takes care of all the day-to-day financial and organizational aspects of running a mercenary company, like paying out wages.
6b7a64b6720b5707de1b.translation: 军饷官负责战团的日常财务与管理事务，例如发放薪酬。

b5d57abdcfdf71022dc4.source: Reduces the daily wage of each man by 15%

6e5727c2c10fac1e8fbc.source: Reduces the chance of desertion by 50%

e516bac9fd6545725306.source: Prevents men demanding more pay in events
e516bac9fd6545725306.translation: 弟兄们不会在事件中要求加薪

ce1c543964c8f271d612.source: With years of experience from traveling with caravans, the Quartermaster is able to squeeze and rotate any piece of gear, luggage or armor into the perfect spot to use space as efficiently as possible.
ce1c543964c8f271d612.translation: 军需官随商队走南闯北多年，深谙收纳之道。无论装备、行李还是护甲，他总能翻转挪腾、见缝插针，将每一寸空间都利用到极致。

fa38aea175c28bd4c439.source: Increases the amount of ammunition you can carry by 100

b1d25633c14c0b94c3bb.source: Increases the amount of medical supplies and tools you can carry by 50 each
b1d25633c14c0b94c3bb.translation: 医疗物资与修缮物资的携带上限各增加50

cbb87b3a4fcfe95a8c67.source: The Recruiter is a sleazy jawsmith that tricks desperate people into joining a mercenary company to escape their poor lives, only to find their demise. Quite useful for anyone running a mercenary company.
cbb87b3a4fcfe95a8c67.translation: 招募官是个油嘴滑舌的无耻之徒，专骗走投无路的人加入战团，声称能让他们摆脱穷苦日子，结果只是把他们送上死路。对战团团长来说，这种人倒是相当有用。

3c542ec98437c2473672.source: Makes you pay 10% less up front for hiring new men, and 50% less for tryouts
3c542ec98437c2473672.translation: 招募新人的雇用费用降低10%，考察费用降低50%

bd427903c2db3b85c9c6.source: Makes between 2 and 4 additional men available to recruit in every settlement
bd427903c2db3b85c9c6.translation: 每处聚落额外增加2至4名可招募人员

6df4bc740b160275afc1.source: Whether the son of one of your men or an urchin you took pity on, the Scavenger pulls his weight by collecting bits and pieces from every battlefield.
6df4bc740b160275afc1.translation: 拾荒者或许是某个弟兄的儿子，也可能是你一时心软收留的流浪儿。不管出身如何，他都会在战后四处捡拾，为战团出一份力。

9e4b0f51c4c880d711d4.source: Recovers a part of all ammo you use during battle
9e4b0f51c4c880d711d4.translation: 回收战斗中消耗的部分弹药

19405a155229d98ea6ab.source: Recovers tools and supplies from every armor destroyed by you during battle
19405a155229d98ea6ab.translation: 从战斗中被你摧毁的护甲上回收修缮物资

3549ddc22ae0e2060726.source: The Scout is an expert in finding mountain passes, navigating through treacherous swamps, and guiding anyone safely through the darkest of forests.
3549ddc22ae0e2060726.translation: 寻找山间隘口、穿越险恶沼泽、带人平安走出幽暗密林，都是斥候的拿手本事。

7da321477477f607e420.source: Makes the company travel 15% faster on any terrain
7da321477477f607e420.translation: 战团在所有地形上的行进速度提高15%

8a6b820c976cce5ddb90.source: Prevents sickness and accidents due to terrain
8a6b820c976cce5ddb90.translation: 避免因地形引发的疾病与意外

2d8e3a08964f39c4cbbc.source: The Surgeon is a walking tome of anatomical knowledge. A mercenary company seems the perfect place both to apply that knowledge in healing, but also to learn more about how the insides of men are made up.
2d8e3a08964f39c4cbbc.translation: 外科医生就是一本行走的人体解剖全书。战团似乎是他的理想去处：既能运用所学救死扶伤，又能进一步了解人体内部的构造。

23a88340be5b0a33308e.source: Makes every man without a permanent injury guaranteed to survive an otherwise fatal blow
23a88340be5b0a33308e.translation: 没有永久伤残的弟兄遭受致命打击时，必定能够幸存

4b8d6017837d2c82c497.source: Makes every injury take one less day to heal
4b8d6017837d2c82c497.translation: 所有伤势的愈合时间缩短一天

b1066284547fc2ee3517.source: /5 men with injuries at a temple

2125b4f3ef2c11f127a2.source: Southern traders are renowned for their bartering skills. Lucky you that you could convince one such master of haggling to join your company. And at such a bargain!
2125b4f3ef2c11f127a2.translation: 南方商人以讨价还价的本事闻名。能说服这样一位砍价高手加入战团，你可真走运。何况价钱还这么便宜！

923f91ab1bbd048859a4.source: Increases the amount of trade goods for sale by 1 for each location that produces them, like salt near salt mines, allowing you to trade at higher volumes
923f91ab1bbd048859a4.translation: 每处出产贸易品的设施，都会使对应商品的待售数量增加1件。例如，盐矿会增加食盐供应，让你能做更大宗的买卖。

11a4edf35c94e3e839a7.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_181.png[/img][/p][p]Fueled by an unquenchable thirst for knowledge, the Anatomists have spent years dissecting the exotic and the alien. With social mores dogging their research, however, they've turned to you to form a mercenary company and provide them a new source of fresh specimens.

[color=#bcad8c]Anatomists:[/color] Start with three men and high funds.
[color=#bcad8c]Researchers:[/color] Research the corpses of your fallen foes and gain knowledge to empower your men.
[color=#bcad8c]Not Fighters:[/color] Your men will never be of Confident morale.[/p]
11a4edf35c94e3e839a7.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_181.png[/img][/p][p]求知欲永无止境。多年来，这群解剖学者一直在解剖各种奇异生物，探究其中的秘密。然而，世俗的禁忌让他们的研究处处受阻。于是，他们找到你，希望组建一支佣兵战团，为研究带来新鲜的标本。

[color=#bcad8c]解剖学者：[/color]开局拥有三名成员和充裕的资金。
[color=#bcad8c]研究者：[/color]研究战败敌人的尸体，利用所得知识强化战团成员。
[color=#bcad8c]不善征战：[/color]战团成员的士气永远无法达到斗志昂扬。[/p]

6c9913a749f3f7fbbf5a.source: {Captain? Is it alright if I call you captain? Ah, of course it is. What? No, we were not calling you by another name. Yers is a smooth costard, good sir, and we would not be of such derring-do to refer to you as a sellsword who is as ordinary as any of our coetaneous clodpolls, or state that we were in some sense importuning commerce by conducting business with a man of your particular skills. No sir, we would not. We are not children of perdition, sir.}
6c9913a749f3f7fbbf5a.translation: {团长？我可以称您为团长吗？啊，当然可以。什么？不，我们绝没用别的称呼叫您。您的头颅圆润光洁，好先生，我等岂敢如此放肆，称您为与同辈蠢材无异的寻常佣兵？更不会说，与您这样身怀本领的人做生意，是委屈了我们的行当。不，先生，我们绝不会。我们又不是无可救药的恶徒，先生。}

38d29c20f8e6ae101be9.source: {Despite others' hesitancies, I've no qualms calling you a javel, sir. You are, after all, a javel. A scapegrace. Some sellsword or another, yes? I think only a man who trucks cowardice would avoid calling you what you are. That someone disrespects your intelligence, thinking you yourself know not yourself. Even I see that in you accepting who you are, you are quite a good specimen. I mean, sellsword.}
38d29c20f8e6ae101be9.translation: {别人有所顾忌，我可不介意称您为无赖，先生。毕竟，您确实是个无赖，一个浪荡子，也就是寻常所说的佣兵，对吧？我认为，只有怯懦之人才会回避您的真实身份。那样的人才是在侮辱您的智慧，以为您连自己是谁都不清楚。而我看得出来，您坦然接受了自己，称得上一个很好的标本。我是说，佣兵。}

ea565f3188b882657525.source: {Though our quotidian dialogues are no doubt drollery, beneath the banausic surface I must admit I feel a touch of serotinous savagery lurking within you, coming to the fore as if my words be fire. Even our most desultory talks has me on edge, the way you stare at me with such hateful eyes. Well, know this, bounty hunter, I am no casuist, I speak in earnest. You are too fine a specimen-I mean captain to be lofting some sapskull's brickbats at. Understand?}
ea565f3188b882657525.translation: {尽管我们的日常谈话不乏诙谐，可我必须承认，您那粗朴的外表下似乎潜藏着一股尚未发作的凶性，我的话稍一点火，它便要冒出头来。即使只是随口闲聊，您那满含恨意的目光也常让我如坐针毡。不过您要明白，赏金猎人，我不是诡辩家，说话一向诚恳。您是如此出色的标本——我是说，团长，怎能任由蠢材用恶言中伤呢？明白吗？}

8501c26538250dd60aa2.source: Will never be of confident morale
8501c26538250dd60aa2.translation: 士气永远无法达到自信状态

54fd2bc0c692a5d397b5.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img][/p][p]You and your men make your living by hunting down the many beasts that beset villages on the fringes of civilization. It's dangerous work, but it pays well enough, and there's always a bigger beast to slay and more crowns to earn.

[color=#bcad8c]Beast Slayers:[/color] Start with three beast slayers and decent equipment, as well as some beast trophies.
[color=#bcad8c]Expert Trackers:[/color] See tracks from further away.
[color=#bcad8c]Expert Skinners:[/color] Each beast you slay has a 50% chance to drop an additional trophy.
[color=#bcad8c]Prejudice:[/color] Most people don't trust your kind, so you get 10% worse prices.[/p]
54fd2bc0c692a5d397b5.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img][/p][p]在文明边缘，村庄时常遭到野兽侵扰。你和手下靠猎杀这些猛兽谋生。这行当虽险，报酬倒也不差。总有更凶猛的猎物等着你们，也总有更多克朗可以赚。

[color=#bcad8c]猎兽者：[/color]开局拥有三名猎兽者、不错的装备和一些野兽战利品。
[color=#bcad8c]追踪高手：[/color]能够发现更远处的足迹。
[color=#bcad8c]剥皮能手：[/color]每只被击杀的野兽都有 50% 的概率额外掉落一份战利品。
[color=#bcad8c]世俗偏见：[/color]多数人不信任你们，买卖价格因此不利 10%。[/p]

fd6113b62e41533a9e87.translation: 杀死过一名危险的女巫

7fec5d5a2123ed2897fe.source: Lost most of the company in a betrayal
7fec5d5a2123ed2897fe.translation: 因背叛而失去了大半战团成员

9f462557c5f2b6617977.source: %name% saved you in the brigand's ambush that destroyed your band of slayers. He does not hang this fact over you, for you have saved him many a times yourself. The man suffers no emotion that does not bid him well in this world, and that alone makes him a sound slayer.
9f462557c5f2b6617977.translation: 土匪伏击摧毁了你们的猎兽队，是%name%救下了你。他从不拿这件事让你觉得亏欠，毕竟你也救过他许多次。他从不让无益于生存的情绪拖累自己，单凭这一点，就称得上可靠的猎兽者。

29256d49209ef896aafa.source: A young lad from the city, %name% got his start in beast slaying by rooting out the warrens of 'vicious rabbits', as he puts it. You're not sure how true that is, but regardless he has proven himself on the field of battle more times than you can count.
29256d49209ef896aafa.translation: %name%是个城里长大的年轻人。据他自己说，猎兽生涯始于清剿一窝“凶恶的兔子”。你也不知道这话有几分真，不过，他在战场上证明自己的次数，早已数不清了。

483127d666bce53d6ff8.source: Grizzled vets are a rarity in beast slaying, and %name% sure ain't one. Instead, he's an intelligent man who started his foray into monster hunting by reading books instead of training the sword. Still a good enough warrior at heart, it is his study and preparation that gives him the edge in battle.
483127d666bce53d6ff8.translation: 猎兽者中少有白发苍苍的老兵，%name%当然也不是那一类。他头脑聪明，入行猎杀怪物时，先读书，后练剑。骨子里，他也是个够格的战士，但真正让他在战斗中占尽先机的，是事前的研究和准备。

6622ed79f9feb0a5a08e.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img][/p][p]Davkul awaits. You lead a small flock devoted to the elder god, and it's time to spread the word. Find more followers, acquire riches, and please Davkul with sacrifices.

[color=#bcad8c]Cultists:[/color] Start with a group of four cultists with poor equipment. More cultists may flock to you for free.
[color=#bcad8c]Sacrifices:[/color] Davkul will occasionally demand sacrifices from you, but also bestow boons upon those loyal to him.[/p]
6622ed79f9feb0a5a08e.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img][/p][p]达夫库尔正在等待。你率领一小群效忠古神的信徒，是时候传播祂的教诲了。招揽更多信众，积聚财富，以献祭取悦达夫库尔。

[color=#bcad8c]邪教徒：[/color]开局拥有四名装备简陋的邪教徒。更多邪教徒可能免费加入。
[color=#bcad8c]献祭：[/color]达夫库尔会不时索要祭品，也会赐福于忠心的信徒。[/p]

1a4421c6d25ec5766e12.source: When %name% joined, he warmly called you captain, saying "tis a proper manner to pursue the path into the black from whence we came".
1a4421c6d25ec5766e12.translation: %name%加入时，热情地称你为团长，说道：“沿此正途，我们终将重返来时的黑暗。”

354e9f1422e6f1cb9002.source: %name% found you upon the road. He stated that he knew you were a mercenary captain. You wore but ordinary cloth at that moment, but he said by Davkul's darkness you had an aura of wanted black about you.
354e9f1422e6f1cb9002.translation: %name%在路上找到了你，直言知道你是佣兵团长。那时你明明只穿着普通布衣，他却说，在达夫库尔的黑暗中，你周身萦绕着他所寻觅的漆黑气息。

f2319b538e11a61cdca3.source: A quiet man, %name% has shadows beneath his fingerprints, running like the brine beneath a pallid shore. When he shook your hand, it was as though you could hear the hissing of your sanity.
f2319b538e11a61cdca3.translation: %name%沉默寡言，指纹下潜伏着阴影，像苍白海岸之下流动的咸水。他与你握手时，你仿佛听见自己的理智正发出嘶嘶声。

565855564ce0d626cdaa.source: %name% banded with you outside a tavern. The first time you saw him he had scars running up his arms and across veins that would imply he should not still be living. But each morning it appears as though his scars move, slowly creeping in one direction: toward his forehead.
565855564ce0d626cdaa.translation: 你在酒馆外结识了%name%。初见时，他双臂布满伤疤，有些横跨血管，照理说早该没命才对。可每天早晨，那些疤痕似乎都换了位置，慢慢朝同一个方向爬去：他的额头。

efd3f32a61c882987daa.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img][/p][p]For too long have you been dragged from one bloody battle to another at the whim of lords sitting in high towers. Last night, you absconded from camp together with three others. You're dressed like soldiers still, but you're deserters, and the noose will be your end if you stay here for too long.

[color=#bcad8c]Deserters:[/color] Start with three deserters and decent armor, but lower funds and a noble house that wants to hunt you down.
[color=#bcad8c]First to Run:[/color] Your men always are first to act in the very first round of combat.[/p]
efd3f32a61c882987daa.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_88.png[/img][/p][p]那些高坐塔楼的领主一声令下，你们便被赶往下一处血腥战场。这种日子，你受够了。昨夜，你与另外三人偷偷逃离军营。军装还穿在身上，身份却已是逃兵。再不离开这里，等着你们的便是绞索。

[color=#bcad8c]逃兵：[/color]开局拥有三名逃兵和不错的护甲，但资金较少，还有一个贵族家族正在追捕你们。
[color=#bcad8c]抢先一步：[/color]每场战斗的第一回合，你方所有成员都会先于敌人行动。[/p]

6182dbba288530015cd5.source: Was dragged from one bloody battle to the next
6182dbba288530015cd5.translation: 被迫辗转于一场又一场血战

10181e8bbcd7c2fcbe45.translation: 你与手下一同成了逃兵

8d87141ad638711feced.source: {Prior to his conscription into the army, %name% was a failed, illiterate baker. His poor work and frequent dessert errors made him prone to being pulled into military ranks. Having always hated the life, the deserter was quick to join your cause and company.}
8d87141ad638711feced.translation: {%name%入伍前是个不识字、手艺也不成的面包师。他活干得糟，做甜点又老出错，自然成了容易被抓去当兵的人选。他向来厌恶军旅生活，逃出来后，便很快投奔了你和战团。}

68fee685f15fa36e18bb.source: {A fine fighter by any judgment, %name% simply hated the low pay of being a soldier in the army. His pursuit of the sellsword's life makes sense. Though he is quite flighty, you believe his transient sense of allegiance will be buffered by a steady flow of good coin.}
68fee685f15fa36e18bb.translation: {无论谁来评判，%name%都是个出色的战士。他只是厌恶军中那点微薄薪水，所以转而当佣兵，倒也合情合理。虽然性子轻浮、忠心易变，但你相信，只要好钱不断，他总能安定下来。}

720069d8f6e2fac11af0.source: {%name% is like many deserters. You can see the spirit of a fighter in him, but the heart for it is withering. It doesn't make him a coward, as many assume deserters to be, but instead simply a man who may need change. Hopefully the coin of mercenary work can provide it.}
720069d8f6e2fac11af0.translation: {%name%与许多逃兵一样，你仍能看出他身上斗士的底子，但拼杀的心气正在枯萎。这并不意味着他就是人们口中的懦夫，只说明他或许需要改变。希望佣兵生涯的报酬能带来这种改变。}

f02da2baf66c71603839.source: Always acts first in the very first round of combat
f02da2baf66c71603839.translation: 战斗第一回合始终优先行动

b78a1fcbb9827301afa8.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img][/p][p]After years of bloodying your sword for meager pay, you've saved enough crowns to start your very own mercenary company. With you are three experienced mercenaries with whom you've fought side by side in the shieldwall before.

[color=#bcad8c]A quick start into the world, without any particular advantages or disadvantages.[/color][/p]
b78a1fcbb9827301afa8.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img][/p][p]多年来，你为微薄的报酬浴血厮杀，如今终于攒够克朗，可以组建自己的佣兵战团。与你一同出发的，是三名经验丰富的老佣兵——你们曾在盾墙中并肩作战，彼此都知根知底。

[color=#bcad8c]标准开局，没有额外的优势或限制，可以直接踏上征途。[/color][/p]

0f0cbe3bf291c55a91bd.source: {You saved %name%'s life in a battle against brigands, and he returned the favor in an alley ambush by thieves. Given that common criminals are a few levels beneath brigands, you often joke with him that he is still a little behind on the 'saving each other's asses' debt.}
0f0cbe3bf291c55a91bd.translation: {你在与土匪的战斗中救过%name%，后来你在巷子里遭窃贼伏击，他又救了你。考虑到小毛贼比土匪差了好几个档次，你常开玩笑，说这笔“互相救命”的账，他还欠着一点。}

6dec596a1c65775d6737.source: {Whatever is wrong with %name% you hope he never fixes it. A character with a particular taste for battling, whoring, gambling, singing, dogfighting, skirt chasing, weirdly dish washing, vomiting and, of course, drinking, he has always been a gift to have around. He also just happens to be an excellent fighter in his own right.}
6dec596a1c65775d6737.translation: {不管%name%究竟哪儿不对劲，你都希望他永远别改。他格外热衷于打架、嫖宿、赌博、唱歌、斗狗、追女人，还有莫名其妙的洗碗、呕吐，以及理所当然的喝酒。有他在，日子总不缺乐趣。碰巧，他本身也是个极好的战士。}

06b7d5cabc523d4b531b.source: You crossed paths with %name% a number of times prior to his joining the company. First time you were both simple laborers. The second time you were sellswords. And now is the third go of it with him joining your company. If all goes well, he'll finally stick around this time and you'll both find the riches you seek.
06b7d5cabc523d4b531b.translation: %name%加入战团前，你们曾数度相遇。第一次，你们都是普通苦力；第二次，你们都是佣兵。这一次是第三回，他终于进了你的队伍。若一切顺利，希望他这回能留下，你们也都能挣到梦寐以求的财富。

eb162448f6b6d824b315.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img][/p][p]You've fought in the arenas of the south for years. First for your freedom, then for crowns, and finally to become immortal. What else does fate have in stock for you?

[color=#bcad8c]Gladiators:[/color] Start with three experienced gladiators with good equipment, but very high daily wages.
[color=#bcad8c]Legends of the Arena:[/color] Each gladiator has a unique trait in combat.
[color=#bcad8c]Glorious Three:[/color] You can never have more than 12 men in your roster, and if all of your three starting men should die, your campaign ends.[/p]
eb162448f6b6d824b315.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img][/p][p]多年来，你们在南方的竞技场浴血搏杀。起初为自由，后来为克朗，最后则为名垂不朽。命运接下来又会为你们安排什么？

[color=#bcad8c]角斗士：[/color]开局拥有三名经验丰富、装备精良的角斗士，但他们的日薪也极为高昂。
[color=#bcad8c]竞技场传奇：[/color]每名角斗士都拥有独特的战斗特性。
[color=#bcad8c]荣耀三杰：[/color]战团最多拥有 12 名成员。若最初的三名角斗士全部阵亡，战役立即结束。[/p]

74fa2035f42f1ad48198.source: Eager to prove himself outside the arena
74fa2035f42f1ad48198.translation: 渴望在竞技场之外证明自己

e9593bba99b11c734f22.source: {%fullname% thinks muscles make for glory. Wrong. Captain, it is I,
e9593bba99b11c734f22.translation: {%fullname%以为肌肉就能带来荣耀。错了。团长，是我，

c03c4acb0798e6ec3c9e.source: , who commands the ladies of this realm. Need not ask me how. Behold! Look at it! Look at the size of it! Yeah. That's what I thought. Fools, train all you want, you can't have this!}
c03c4acb0798e6ec3c9e.translation: ，才让天下女人俯首称臣。别问我怎么做到的，看！瞧瞧它！瞧瞧这大小！对，就是这个表情。蠢货们，随你们怎么练，这本钱可练不出来！}

e5223477abdf8872768a.source: {%fullname% is not the best warrior here, let's be clear. Captain, look at my muscles, is it not I,
e5223477abdf8872768a.translation: {%fullname%绝不是这里最强的战士，这话得先说清楚。团长，看看我的肌肉！难道不是我，

e84c0b41e6bcdd4d6291.source: , who commands the greatest reward of life: the fear of one's own enemies! Look, if I lather a little and catch the light, the muscles gleam. Would it not be that the heavens were mistakened for above, when all the women say they find them right here, particularly here, upon my glorious pecs?}
e84c0b41e6bcdd4d6291.translation: ，才赢得了人生最伟大的奖赏：让自己的敌人恐惧！看，我往身上抹点油，迎着光一站，肌肉便闪闪发亮。说天堂在天上，恐怕是弄错了吧？所有女人都说，她们在这里找到了天堂，尤其是这里，我这伟岸的胸肌！}

e992d0ce5f21cc3eb8b6.source: {Why are you looking at %fullname%? Captain, it is I,

c64afd5a578f04bfc3c4.source: , who is your greatest gladiator. I am the one who swept the legs of a lindwurm and choked it out with its own tail! What you bastards say? You call that a tall tale? Pah! 'Tis a horizontal lizard at best.}
c64afd5a578f04bfc3c4.translation: ，才是你最强的角斗士！我曾一记扫堂腿放倒林德蠕龙，再用它自己的尾巴把它勒晕！你们这帮混账说什么？说我吹得比天高？呸，那玩意儿顶多是条横着躺的大蜥蜴！}

af7e316267658f76a500.source: {%fullname% is somber about the passing of a good friend, but he looks to the future knowing that he has someone behind him at all times. Behind him in a brotherly way, that is. And spiritually. Brotherly and spiritually, only.}
af7e316267658f76a500.translation: {%fullname%为挚友的离世而悲伤，却仍愿意望向未来，因为他知道，背后总有人支持他。所谓背后支持，指的是兄弟情谊上的。还有精神上的。只是兄弟情谊和精神上的，仅此而已。}

9c04835ac444bee7fc1f.source: {You should know something, captain. I'm glad you stay out of the fray. I haven't felt this alive in what must be ten years. And if you see me out there about to go down, you stay right where you are, because I'll be right where I want to be.}
9c04835ac444bee7fc1f.translation: {有件事得告诉你，团长。你肯待在战场外，我很高兴。我大概有十年没觉得自己这样活着了。要是你看见我快撑不住了，待在原处，千万别动，因为那时的我，就在自己最想待的地方。}

e204bf67cb5d0173d4cf.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img][/p][p]You've been traveling alone for a long time, taking part in tourneys and sparring with young nobles. A hedge knight tall as a tree, you never needed anybody for long. Is it true still?

[color=#bcad8c]Lone Wolf:[/color] Start with a single experienced hedge knight and great equipment, but low funds.
[color=#bcad8c]Elite Few:[/color] Can never have more than 12 men in your roster.
[color=#bcad8c]Avatar:[/color] If your hedge knight dies, the campaign ends.[/p]
e204bf67cb5d0173d4cf.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img][/p][p]你独自游历多年，参加比武大会，与年轻贵族切磋武艺。身为一个高大如树的流浪骑士，你从不需要长久依靠谁。今后也能如此吗？

[color=#bcad8c]孤狼：[/color]开局只有一名经验丰富的流浪骑士，装备精良，但资金匮乏。
[color=#bcad8c]精兵小队：[/color]战团最多拥有 12 名成员。
[color=#bcad8c]亲自出征：[/color]这名流浪骑士就是你本人。他若阵亡，战役立即结束。[/p]

4f04db970fac7c0873f7.source: A wandering hedge knight, you were a veteran of jousting and sparring tournaments. You were also a veteran of victory. Tis a scary thought for many, but if it were anything at all that turned your eye toward mercenary work it was boredom. Outwardly you state it is for the coin, but a part of you knows it's also for the company.
4f04db970fac7c0873f7.translation: 你曾是一名四处游历的流浪骑士，身经无数骑枪比武和切磋，也赢过无数场胜利。若非要说是什么让你转向佣兵生涯，答案多半会让人害怕：无聊。嘴上，你说是为了钱，但你心里清楚，也有一部分是为了有人作伴。

949dccd6de4100008685.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_172.png[/img][/p][p]Constant conflict between city states and nomads makes for good business. The bulk of your outfit are captives, forced to fight to earn their freedom, and their ranks grow after each battle.

[color=#bcad8c]Army of Captives:[/color] Start with two manhunters and four indebted. Take up to 16 men into battle at once. Having equal or fewer indebted than non-indebted will make your men dissatisfied.
[color=#bcad8c]Overseers:[/color] All non-indebted can whip indebted in combat to reset their morale and buff their stats.
[color=#bcad8c]Captives:[/color] Indebted earn 10% more experience, are capped at level 7, and will die if struck down.[/p]
949dccd6de4100008685.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_172.png[/img][/p][p]城邦与游牧民冲突不断，倒也成了一门好生意。你的队伍大多由俘虏组成，他们被迫以战斗换取自由。每次战斗过后，又有新俘虏加入他们的行列。

[color=#bcad8c]俘虏大军：[/color]开局拥有两名捕奴者和四名负债者，每场战斗最多可派出 16 人。若负债者人数不多于其他成员，队伍便会心生不满。
[color=#bcad8c]监工：[/color]其他成员均可在战斗中鞭笞负债者，使其士气恢复，并暂时提高属性。
[color=#bcad8c]俘虏：[/color]负债者获得的经验增加 10%，等级上限为 7 级，被击倒时必定死亡。[/p]

411f8e1b350962fcba9f.source: {In a sense, you don't particularly care for %name%. He's not hateful nor forgiving toward the prisoners of war, criminals, and the like. He just handles his business. But he's also this calm, unwavering way with you, and it's a bit bothersome. The man has so much potential, which is why you have him onboard for the %companyname%, but you just wished he showed some passion now and again.}
411f8e1b350962fcba9f.translation: {说起来，你并不怎么喜欢%name%。对待战俘、罪犯之流，他既无恨意，也不宽容，只是照章办事。可他对你也是这副波澜不惊的模样，着实让人有些不快。你看中了他的潜力，才把他招进%companyname%，只是希望他偶尔也能拿出点热情来。}

6f9601a512ace0e5630c.source: {%name% is one of the worst people you have ever come to know. He is relentlessly brutal on the indebted, even by your measure, and is responsible for outright killing a few of your catches. That said, his mean streak will serve the company well. And given that you've already whipped him a time or three for losing inventory, you know he can take a hit as well as he can give it.}
6f9601a512ace0e5630c.translation: {%name%是你见过最恶劣的人之一。他虐待负债者从不手软，连你都觉得过分，还活活弄死过几个俘虏。不过，他那股狠劲对战团确实有用。而且，因为他折损了“货物”，你也抽过他好几回鞭子，所以很清楚，这人不光打人狠，挨打也够能扛。}

b913535e8535b3b2d142.source: Annoyed by your recent reprimand not to mistreat your captives
b913535e8535b3b2d142.translation: 因你近日责令他不得虐待俘虏而不满

9533a9865d9120a01e35.source: {You found %name% being lawed by city guards. It looked like they were gonna play a game of 'catch the scimitar' with his wrists until you intervened, opining that he owed the Gilder far before he owed any man. You hoped to offload him to high-paying Viziers, but none would take him as he was too 'learned' and seemed the exact sort of threat to spur an uprising. Unusual to a man of his standing, he does harbor a fair bit of respect for you.}
9533a9865d9120a01e35.translation: {你遇见%name%时，城卫队正在拿他问罪。眼看他们就要让他的手腕尝尝弯刀的滋味，你出面干预，声称他首先欠的是镀金者，其次才是凡人。你本想把他转卖给出价慷慨的维齐尔，却没人肯要：这人太“有学问”，一看就是能煽动叛乱的祸根。奇怪的是，像他这样的人，倒对你颇为敬重。}

0f855c4d3ea2f6f320c8.source: {Not a friendly man by any means, but that's what the shackles are for. %name% was on the chopping block for a series of crimes when you happened upon him. You paid for his life as an investment, stating that he now owed hard work to find salvation in the Gilder's eyes. He's not so sure of your earnest beliefs, but you paid a priest to confirm that the man indeed owes his sweat to a higher sublimity.}
0f855c4d3ea2f6f320c8.translation: {这人实在称不上友善，不过，镣铐不就是干这个用的吗。你遇见%name%时，他正因一连串罪行等着掉脑袋。你花钱买下他的命，权当一笔投资，又告诉他，往后只有勤劳苦干，才能在镀金者眼中赎清罪孽。他对你这番虔诚之言半信半疑，于是你又花钱请来一位祭司，证明他的确应当挥洒汗水，侍奉至高的神明。}

c7e4ae481d38d0eb5fee.translation: 因逃过处决而松了口气

4118f48698e208eeeb3b.source: Worried about what awaits him next

403a5faa62b5e445967b.source: {%name% is an heirloom of heresy, a man gifted to you by one of the Vizier's priests. The man was a deserter in the high lord's army, but through wealthy connections managed to avoid execution. However, there's only one way to avoid the fire of the hells, and that is through indebted gratitude. He will work for you until he finds salvation, and when that happens is entirely up to you.}
403a5faa62b5e445967b.translation: {%name%是异端罪名留下的一件赠礼，一名服侍维齐尔的祭司将他送给了你。他原是大领主军中的逃兵，靠有钱人的门路才免于处决。然而，若想逃过地狱烈火，就只能以负债之身感恩偿还。他会为你劳作，直到得到救赎。至于何时得救，完全由你说了算。}

2839d3f2fe87b9cc7ea2.source: Feels cursed to have deserted one army only to end up an indebted in another
2839d3f2fe87b9cc7ea2.translation: 逃离一支军队，却在另一支队伍里沦为负债者，觉得自己遭了诅咒

7a958045d60a73014385.source: {Found on the streets, %name% never stood much of a chance. Being a beggar, it was physically easy to slap the chains on him, and socially no one would care. The Gilder cares not for those who do not work, and every day the man squandered without putting in his sweat he accrued a debt. Now it must be paid lest he taste that desert fire for eternity. He's actually healthier looking now than when you found him, though he never seems to thank you for this.}
7a958045d60a73014385.translation: {你在街头找到%name%，他根本没多少反抗余地。给一个乞丐戴上锁链并不费力，也没人在乎。镀金者不眷顾不劳作的人，他每白白耗过一天、不肯流汗，就多欠一天债。如今必须偿还，否则便得永远承受沙漠烈火。其实他现在看起来比初见时健康，却从没为此谢过你。}

2a73f626f84c07a3c8ad.source: Is permanently dead if struck down and will not survive with a permanent injury
2a73f626f84c07a3c8ad.translation: 被击倒时将永久死亡，不会以永久创伤为代价幸存

49fec99bae6446dd0e89.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img][/p][p]It started as a ragtag militia made up of anyone brave or desperate enough to volunteer for defending their homes, but has grown into a small army. An army that needs to be fed each day. Perhaps the militia's services could be rented out?

[color=#bcad8c]Peasant Army:[/color] Start with a roster of 12 poorly equipped peasants.
[color=#bcad8c]Human Wave[/color]: Take up to 16 men into battle at once, and have up to 25 in your roster.
[color=#bcad8c]Dirty Peasants[/color]: Can never hire anyone that isn't a lowborn peasant.[/p]
49fec99bae6446dd0e89.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_141.png[/img][/p][p]最初，这只是一群为保卫家园而集结的乌合之众。有的人勇敢，有的人只是走投无路。如今，他们已成了一支小型军队，而这支军队每天都得吃饭。或许，可以让民兵们靠替人打仗谋生？

[color=#bcad8c]农民军：[/color]开局拥有 12 名装备简陋的农民。
[color=#bcad8c]人海战术[/color]：每场战斗最多可派出 16 人，战团最多拥有 25 名成员。
[color=#bcad8c]寒门出身[/color]：只能雇用出身底层的平民。[/p]

b0d50b2a40e20351db27.source: Lost many a friend in battle

e4746f9f6441d37cb49f.source: %name% is a farmer's son, and presumably wishes to be the father of his own son at some point. For now, he's with you which is quite a regrettable clash between dreams and reality.
e4746f9f6441d37cb49f.translation: %name%是农夫的儿子，想来也盼着将来有个自己的儿子。可眼下他却跟着你讨生活，这梦想与现实之间的冲突，实在令人遗憾。

fc0c86b72efb5ff0d630.source: %name% owned a farmstead that has long since gone underfoot of countless passing armies, including the very ones he has fought for. His 'allegiance' to you is arguably the result of an empty belly more than anything.
fc0c86b72efb5ff0d630.translation: %name%原有一座农庄，早已被来来往往的军队踏成废墟，其中甚至包括他自己效力过的军队。他对你的“忠诚”，说到底多半只是饿肚子的结果。

a2c4ec34b03ed6dc5d4b.source: It is a common joke that %name% is in fact a nobleman hiding away from the world, but to the best of your knowledge he was a simple poacher. The grind of the world got him to where he is today, not much else need be said other than you hope he gets back on his feet.
a2c4ec34b03ed6dc5d4b.translation: 大家常开玩笑，说%name%其实是位隐姓埋名的贵族。不过据你所知，他不过是个偷猎者。世道艰难，一路磋磨，他才落到今日这般境地。多说无益，你只盼着他能重新振作。

69851c33441cc7a30e0c.source: You notice that %name% hides from certain noblemen. It is likely that he is a common criminal at large for some petty crime, but so long as he fights well it is no business to you.
69851c33441cc7a30e0c.translation: 你注意到，%name%总在躲着某些贵族。想来是犯了些小罪，至今还在逃。不过，只要他打仗卖力，这些事就与你无关。

d2b61d851478e67bfbc3.source: A daytaler and common laborer, %name% would rather join your outfit than go back to wasting his body building some nobleman's new fancy foyer.
d2b61d851478e67bfbc3.translation: %name%从前做短工、卖苦力。他宁可加入你的队伍，也不愿再回去耗尽一身力气，替哪个贵族修建华而不实的新门厅。

6ccfecd93ae08c47344f.source: Seeking riches, %name% has come to the right place in your newfound mercenary band. Unfortunately, his background is in farming, milling, and laying stone, particularly none of which he was any good at.
6ccfecd93ae08c47344f.translation: %name%一心求财，加入你这支新成立的战团，倒是来对了地方。可惜他从前只会种地、磨面和砌石头，而且没有一样做得好。

79cdfe850d10f827aa06.source: Looks forward to becoming rich as a sellsword
79cdfe850d10f827aa06.translation: 盼着靠当佣兵发家致富

674617632420c81ccb2f.source: %name% states he was a sailor prior to coming inland and falling in with the militia and now your mercenary band. He hopes to eventually own a boat and put its sails to the open ocean. You hope he can do that someday, truly.
674617632420c81ccb2f.translation: %name%说自己从前是个水手，后来到了内陆，先加入民兵，如今又进了你的战团。他盼着有朝一日能买条船，扬帆驶向大海。你也希望他终能如愿，真心的。

9bcf69da12a41765f7bf.source: %name% has apparently been in many militias, all of which eventually dissolved for one reason or another. At no point has he made any money in any of them, so he hopes to changes that with this whole new sellswording schtick.
9bcf69da12a41765f7bf.translation: %name%似乎参加过不少民兵队，最后却都因种种缘故解散了。他在任何一支队伍里都没挣到过钱，所以盼着这回改行当佣兵，能转一转财运。

4762cbac707591c7dc9a.source: A proper lad, %name% enjoys carousing ladies at the pub and chasing skirt in the church. You get the sense he's only tagged along to spread his sense of 'fun' around the world.
4762cbac707591c7dc9a.translation: %name%是个好小伙：酒馆里陪姑娘喝酒，教堂里也不忘追着裙摆跑。你总觉得，他跟着你四处闯荡，只是为了把这点“乐趣”传遍天下。

ba8f9a54db29dc1b9ea4.source: Daytaler, laborer, caravan hand, sailor, militiaman, %name%'s done a bit of it all. Hopefully this new foray into mercenary work will stick for him.
ba8f9a54db29dc1b9ea4.translation: 短工、苦力、商队伙计、水手、民兵，%name%样样都干过一点。但愿这回当佣兵，他能长久干下去。

b3d7886c9ad2831f1437.translation: 惯用的单刃短刀被偷了

819852f06916526cdfd9.source: Like yourself, %name% was fed up with militias being overused to solve the crises of unprepared nobles. He was arguably the most earnest of the men in joining the transition to mercenary work.
819852f06916526cdfd9.translation: %name%和你一样，受够了那些毫无准备的贵族动不动就征召民兵，替他们收拾烂摊子。说到改行当佣兵，弟兄们当中数他最为热切。

69291b6adb355cf89254.source: Disliked that some members of the militia were involved in a brawl
69291b6adb355cf89254.translation: 不满一些民兵卷入斗殴

ebfd8107f0ffdb5f6ff0.source: %name% is, ostensibly, running away from his wife. You met her once and approve his escape plan entirely, and not just because it affords you another body on the front line.That wench is genuinely crazy.
ebfd8107f0ffdb5f6ff0.translation: %name%看样子是在躲老婆。你见过她一回，完全赞成他的逃跑计划，而且不只是因为前排能多一个人。那个婆娘是真的疯。

45ba2ba167984368ced3.source: Managed to get away from his wife

4ba0023d81662c419bcb.source: Considered local heroes for keeping the village safe
4ba0023d81662c419bcb.translation: 因保卫村庄而被当地人视为英雄

c6047588cc266a2b9bdc.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img][/p][p]Oathtakers are knightly warriors beholden not to liege lords, but to the ideals and teachings of their founder, Young Anselm. The order now finds itself in dire straits, and they've turned to you to reverse their fortunes. Can you teach these zealots to become successful mercenaries?

[color=#bcad8c]Paladins:[/color] Start with two battle-hardened warriors and good equipment.
[color=#bcad8c]Oathtakers:[/color] Sworn to Young Anselm's teachings, you must take oaths that confer various advantages and disadvantages until fulfilled.[/p]
c6047588cc266a2b9bdc.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img][/p][p]立誓者是一群奉行骑士之道的战士。他们效忠的不是领主，而是创始人小安塞尔姆的理想与教诲。如今，骑士团陷入困境，他们希望你能带领众人扭转命运。你能教会这些狂热信徒，如何成为称职的佣兵吗？

[color=#bcad8c]圣骑士：[/color]开局拥有两名身经百战的战士和精良装备。
[color=#bcad8c]立誓者：[/color]遵循小安塞尔姆的教诲，立下各项誓言。誓言完成之前，会同时带来不同的优势与限制。[/p]

edd7f7a20cc702a0d419.source: {Perhaps of an age more suitable for caretaking than oathtaking, %name% is a rather old, nigh on decrepit Oathtaker. While age has robbed him of his more natural talents, it has at least gifted him with learning and experience that no physical capabilities can match. He is a man of many spirits, having gone around this world in the shell of soldier, farmer, sellsword, and more. Now he is an Oathtaker, and all those skills and traits he built up over the years has made him quite a formidable one at that. | When First Oathtaker Anselm first met %name%, it is said that the prime paladin divulged details no one else could have possibly known, thus proving the aethereal power behind his beliefs. %name% is an ardent believer in the Oaths, and in seeing Young Anselm's vision through.}
edd7f7a20cc702a0d419.translation: {%name%已经老态龙钟，照他的年纪，恐怕安享照料比立誓征战更合适。岁月夺走了他与生俱来的本领，却也赠予他再强健的体魄都换不来的学识与阅历。他这一生做过士兵、农夫、佣兵，还干过许多别的行当，仿佛一副躯壳里住着许多个人。如今他成了立誓者，往年积攒的种种本领与品性，使他成了一位不可小觑的高手。 | 据说，初代立誓者安塞尔姆第一次见到%name%时，就说出了一些旁人绝不可能知道的隐秘，借此证明其信仰背后确有超凡之力。%name%从此笃信誓言，誓要实现小安塞尔姆的理想。}

3a37f4da2a941c3e3020.source: {%name%, like many of the Oathtakers' more spry members, strives to be like Young Anselm. A youthful, capable man who has yet to let the world's horrors and grind wear him down. In moments of honesty, he reminds you of yourself. In moments of reflection, you realize that he will likely one day resemble you as you are now. But until then, to the youth of the world, for the Oaths are certainly not wasted upon them! | When Anselm set out on his quest, it was %name% whom joined him first. Despite Young Anselm's untimely death, %name% still sought to see the young man's vision through. He is an ardent believer in the Oaths and can be frequently found idolizing and commemorating Young Anselm's skull.}
3a37f4da2a941c3e3020.translation: {%name%和许多身手矫健的立誓者一样，立志追随小安塞尔姆的榜样。他年轻能干，还未被世间的恐怖与磨难消磨意气。坦白说，他让你想起了从前的自己；再细想，你又明白，他迟早也会变成你如今这副模样。但在那之前，且为天下的年轻人举杯吧，誓言托付给他们，绝不会白费！ | 当年安塞尔姆踏上征途，%name%是第一个追随他的人。小安塞尔姆虽英年早逝，%name%却仍决意将他的理想贯彻到底。他笃信誓言，常常对着小安塞尔姆的头骨顶礼致敬，追思故人。}

898a6d6036cb699ab4fb.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_139.png[/img][/p][p]For all your adult life you've been raiding and pillaging in these lands. But with the local peasantry poor as mice, you may want to finally expand into the profitable field of mercenary work - that is, if your potential employers are willing to forgive your past transgressions.

[color=#bcad8c]Warband:[/color] Start with three experienced barbarians.
[color=#bcad8c]Pillagers:[/color] You have a higher chance to get any items from slain enemies as loot.
[color=#bcad8c]Outlaws:[/color] Start with bad relations to most human factions.[/p]
898a6d6036cb699ab4fb.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_139.png[/img][/p][p]成年以来，你一直在这片土地上烧杀劫掠。可如今，当地农民已穷得叮当响。或许该转行做佣兵，赚些更丰厚的报酬了——前提是，那些潜在雇主愿意忘掉你过去的恶行。

[color=#bcad8c]蛮族战帮：[/color]开局拥有三名经验丰富的蛮族战士。
[color=#bcad8c]掠夺成性：[/color]被击杀敌人的装备更容易成为战利品。
[color=#bcad8c]法外之徒：[/color]开局时与大多数人类势力关系恶劣。[/p]

c2011ffec00a6d122add.source: A sturdy warrior, %name% has been through many campaigns of raiding and pillaging. Although a man of few words, the raider is an absolutely vicious specimen in battle. Even for a raider, what he does to defeated villagers irks many. It is likely he came with you to satiate his more sadistic lusts.
c2011ffec00a6d122add.translation: %name%身强体壮，参加过无数次劫掠。平日里话不多，上了战场却凶狠得骇人。就连同为劫掠者的人，也有不少看不惯他折磨战败村民的手段。他跟着你，恐怕只是为了进一步满足施虐的欲望。

a74bcbf528b91c35b083.source: %name% was a boy when taken from a southern village and raised amongst the barbarians of the wastes. While he learned the language and culture, he never fit in and was a constant victim of cruel jokes and games. You're not sure if he's followed you to return home or to get away from his northern 'family'.
a74bcbf528b91c35b083.translation: %name%幼年时从南边的村庄被掳走，在荒原上的蛮族中长大。虽然学会了他们的语言和习俗，他却始终格格不入，常常沦为残酷玩笑与嬉闹的受害者。你不知道他跟着你，是想回家，还是只想逃离北方那群“家人”。

821e9f500efc2b6806fa.source: Barbarian raiders often take from lands foreign to them. Most see their raids as a matter of material and women, but occasionally they will enslave formidable boys with great potential. %name%, a northerner, was such a child and he was raised to be a raider himself. Half his life was with his primitive clan, and the other half with those who took him. This has made him as hardy and brutish a warrior as one can get.
821e9f500efc2b6806fa.translation: 蛮族劫掠者常去异乡抢掠，大多图的是财物和女人，但偶尔也会掳走体格强健、颇有潜力的男孩。北方人%name%就是其中之一，后来也被养成了一名劫掠者。他前半生属于自己的原始部落，后半生属于掳走他的人。这番经历造就了一个坚韧而凶蛮、几乎无可匹敌的战士。

281d377f2119eb099f49.source: The man who put you on the path, you believe %name% may serve some greater role to your attaining immense treasures. You've seen northern gimps and one-armed men who would best him in combat, but his knowledge and intelligence may be sharper blades in good time.
281d377f2119eb099f49.translation: 正是%name%引你走上这条路，你相信，他能在你求取巨额财富的途中派上更大的用场。你见过的北方人里，连跛子和独臂汉都能在打斗中胜过他，但到了合适的时候，他的学识和头脑也许比刀剑更加锋利。

901836f903a93dd7e591.source: Thinks he managed to convince you to give up raiding and pillaging
901836f903a93dd7e591.translation: 自以为已经说服你放弃烧杀抢掠

bb1ef148ad8bd497e2ff.source: You are considered outlaws and barbarians
bb1ef148ad8bd497e2ff.translation: 你们被视为匪徒和蛮族

5e695886c5b608e4db72.source: [p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_74.png[/img][/p][p]Start a campaign with a randomly picked origin. How exciting![/p]
5e695886c5b608e4db72.translation: [p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_74.png[/img][/p][p]随机选择一个战团起源，开启未知的征途。命运会为你安排怎样的开局？[/p]

9bbce6fb5cde195d1dea.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img][/p][p]For years you've made a decent living by poaching in the local woods, evading your lord's men by being quick on your feet. But pickings have become slimmer and slimmer, and you're faced with a decision - how to make a living when all you know is how to use a bow?

[color=#bcad8c]Hunters:[/color] Start with a group of three woodsmen.
[color=#bcad8c]Expert Scouts:[/color] You move faster and can always get a scouting report for any enemies near you.
[color=#bcad8c]Travel Light:[/color] You can carry fewer items in your company's inventory.[/p]
9bbce6fb5cde195d1dea.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_10.png[/img][/p][p]多年来，你们靠在当地林地偷猎过活，凭着灵活的身手躲过领主的追兵。可猎物越来越少，眼前只剩一个难题：除了拉弓射箭，你们别无所长，往后该靠什么谋生？

[color=#bcad8c]猎人：[/color]开局拥有三名熟悉山林的猎手。
[color=#bcad8c]侦察高手：[/color]世界地图上的移动速度更快，并且总能获得附近敌人的侦察情报。
[color=#bcad8c]轻装上阵：[/color]战团仓库能够携带的物品更少。[/p]

abdf7e7fcab2668e0d6c.source: {A bit of a devious runt, though a good man at heart. %name% used to hunt for his local liege, but when the nobleman died falling into an unseen ravine the hunter was blamed and kicked out of court. With some guile, he turned his hunting talents into poaching and fur trade. He is of a merchant's mind and was quick to engender the idea of mercenary work because of it.}
abdf7e7fcab2668e0d6c.translation: {这小个子有些狡黠，本性倒不坏。%name%从前替当地领主打猎，后来领主失足跌进一道隐蔽的山涧，丢了性命，罪责便落在猎人头上，他也被赶出了宫廷。凭着几分机灵，他将打猎的本事用在了偷猎和皮毛买卖上。这人生着一副商人的头脑，因此很快便萌生了当佣兵的主意。}

04b73b141d2e76243e52.source: {%name% fell into poaching after a drought ravaged his farmstead. Like most poachers, he is not truly of the criminal mind. Long grouped together in the hunting gangs, %name% was quick to nominate you as captain of the new sellsword outfit.}
04b73b141d2e76243e52.translation: {一场旱灾毁掉农庄后，%name%便干起了偷猎。和大多数偷猎者一样，他并非天生的歹人。你们在猎队里相处多年，因此一说要成立战团，%name%立刻就推举你当团长。}

7f516d17fa0ef24aa671.source: {A former jester whose gag was to shoot three water jugs out of the sky. You don't know how he got into poaching, and in fact seems rather bitter about some jester-related drama, but he is an excellent archer. He also likes to remind you that he is a far better shot than you.}
7f516d17fa0ef24aa671.translation: {这人从前是个弄臣，拿手把戏是射落抛向空中的三个水壶。你不知道他后来怎么干上了偷猎，但他似乎还对弄臣生涯中的某场风波耿耿于怀。无论如何，他确实是个出色的弓手，而且总爱提醒你：他的箭术可比你强得多。}

b636863ead82e3af2fd3.source: Heard rumors of you poaching in their woods
b636863ead82e3af2fd3.translation: 听说你们在他们的林地里偷猎

7e1976a12779bf8097e1.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_156.png[/img][/p][p]You and your small band of mercenaries have done the dirty work of small-time merchants for years, yet you're barely a step above brigands. You want to be bigger than that. You want it all. And the Gilder will reveal to you the way.

[color=#bcad8c]A quick start into the southern part of the world, without any particular advantages or disadvantages.[/color][/p]
7e1976a12779bf8097e1.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_156.png[/img][/p][p]这些年来，你和手下这一小群佣兵一直替小商人干脏活，日子却过得只比强盗好一点。你不甘心止步于此。你想出人头地，想把一切握在手中。镀金者会为你指明道路。

[color=#bcad8c]从南方地区出发的标准开局，没有额外的优势或限制。[/color][/p]

419b277026f19e1d0358.source: {%name% was once in a Vizier's elite vanguard. A pitched battle saw his entire legion annihilated and himself buried underneath their bodies. He was abandoned to the desert and survived by means that even to this day he will not tell you. But his unerring loyalty to you speaks more than any war story ever could.}
419b277026f19e1d0358.translation: {%name%曾在一位维齐尔麾下的精锐先锋部队效力。一场恶战过后，整个军团全军覆没，他也被埋在袍泽的尸体底下。他被遗弃在沙漠里，究竟靠什么活了下来，时至今日仍不肯告诉你。不过，他对你始终如一的忠诚，胜过了任何战场传奇。}

924f5a52dafc46063100.source: {If loyalty was gold, %name% might be the wealthiest man to stand beneath the Gilder's eye. You found the man being ambushed in an alley. Helping him fight off the thieves, he swore allegiance to you for one year. And it has been many since. Despite getting his ass kicked at first sight, %name% is a very formidable fighter when not getting bushwhacked.}
924f5a52dafc46063100.translation: {若忠诚能换成黄金，%name%恐怕就是镀金者目光所及之处最富有的人。你在一条小巷里撞见他遭人围攻，出手帮他赶跑了盗贼。他发誓为你效忠一年，而如今已经过去了许多年。初见时，他虽然被揍得狼狈不堪，但只要不是遭人暗算，%name%也是个极其厉害的战士。}

60799aa0613c8ea79cc5.source: {You're not entirely sure of %name%'s past, only that his path has not had as much shine as one would hope. He says he's filled many roles, but the army won't have him, and the city guard won't have him, and the women certainly won't have him, so he's taken the life as a Crownling. He thinks a glorious and hastened death will bring him to the Gilder's eye so he can ask Him why exactly He's treated his life so harshly. When he's not moping about, %name% can be cheerful and funny. Just keep him away from drinks and priests.}
60799aa0613c8ea79cc5.translation: {你不太清楚%name%的过去，只知道他的日子远没有想象中光鲜。他说自己干过不少行当，可军队不要他，城卫队不要他，女人更不要他，于是他做起了克朗客。他盼着早些光荣战死，好到镀金者面前问个明白：祂为何偏要让自己这一生如此坎坷。只要不陷在自怨自艾里，%name%也能开朗风趣。只是别让他碰酒，也别让他挨着祭司。}

60d2dc61f777c3e1b9ff.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img][/p][p]You're running a small trade caravan and have most of your crowns invested into trading goods. But the roads have become dangerous - brigands and greenskins lay in ambush, and there's rumors of even worse things out there.

[color=#bcad8c]Caravan:[/color] Start with two caravan hands in your employ.
[color=#bcad8c]Trader:[/color] Get 10% better prices for buying and selling.
[color=#bcad8c]Not a Warrior:[/color] Start with no renown, and gain renown at only 66% the normal rate.[/p]
60d2dc61f777c3e1b9ff.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img][/p][p]你经营着一支小商队，大部分积蓄都换成了货物。可商路越来越不太平：强盗与绿皮四处设伏，传闻还有更可怕的东西潜藏在荒野。

[color=#bcad8c]商队：[/color]开局雇有两名商队伙计。
[color=#bcad8c]精于买卖：[/color]买入和卖出商品的价格均有利 10%。
[color=#bcad8c]经商之人：[/color]开局没有名望，之后获得名望的速度只有正常的 66%。[/p]

d849bfd2e4111149f9e7.source: Encountered another caravan slaughtered by greenskins
d849bfd2e4111149f9e7.translation: 遇见一支遭绿皮屠戮的商队

544063ca3eab95992b99.source: A daytaler, mason, miller, %name% had done it all, passing from task to task with no dallying in making a one of them a true vocation. You weren't sure if he was long to stay as a caravan hand either, but when asked to turn to mercenary work he had no problem agreeing to that...
544063ca3eab95992b99.translation: 短工、石匠、磨坊伙计，%name%全都干过。他不停地换活计，却从没在哪一行扎下根。你原本也拿不准他这商队伙计能干多久，不过一问他愿不愿改行当佣兵，他倒是痛快答应了……

ed50c3f58542030ebc3a.source: You found %name% being thrown out of a pub and at first glance was little more than a drunken miscreant. But you watched as he fought off three would-be muggers. They managed to take his boots in the end, sure, but they couldn't truly defeat his spirit. Impressed, you took him on as a caravan hand.
ed50c3f58542030ebc3a.translation: 你第一次见到%name%时，他正被人扔出酒馆，看上去不过是个酗酒滋事的无赖。可接下来，你亲眼见他与三个企图打劫的家伙搏斗。那几个人最后确实抢走了他的靴子，却没能打垮他的气势。你颇为欣赏，于是把他招进商队做了伙计。

d2d0a988358c4b415933.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_21.png[/img][/p][p]You are second-in-command in a mercenary company that has been tracking a brigand named Hoggart for some time now. An unexpected turn of events leaves the company in shatters, and you in charge to rebuild it to its former glory.

[color=#bcad8c]Recommended for new players as it includes some helpful guidance in the beginning.[/color][/p]
d2d0a988358c4b415933.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_21.png[/img][/p][p]你是一支佣兵战团的副团长，正在追捕名叫霍加特的强盗。一次意外让战团遭受重创，你临危接掌指挥，必须带领幸存者重整旗鼓，恢复昔日的声望。

[color=#bcad8c]推荐新玩家选择。开局包含教学引导，帮助你熟悉游戏。[/color][/p]

165c7fce0c22fafb780b.source: Feel the adrenaline rushing through your veins as you seize the opportunity to act faster than your opponent.
165c7fce0c22fafb780b.translation: 肾上腺素在血管中奔涌，让你抓住先机，抢在对手前面行动。

bbbf62da78f1d203ed42.source: Puts this character first in next round's turn order
bbbf62da78f1d203ed42.translation: 使该角色在下一回合的行动顺序中排在最前

e8827f113f8470b9c269.source: A focused and carefully aimed shot with a good outlook of hitting its intended target even at a distance. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
e8827f113f8470b9c269.translation: 凝神瞄准后射出的一箭，即使目标相距较远，也有较高的命中机会。陷入近战时无法使用。

a7589352670446bd5ea1.source: [/color] tiles on even ground, more if shooting downhill
a7589352670446bd5ea1.translation: [/color]格（平地）；从高处射向低处时射程更远

1d64321cc41b37e8597a.source: ]Needs a non-empty quiver of arrows equipped[/color]

e155d8442510adeb0c8a.source: ]Can not be used because this character is engaged in melee[/color]

4c3de1563d1dbdd763c5.source: A thrusting attack that is difficult to defend against. Followed up by a strike with the axehead if the target is staggered.
4c3de1563d1dbdd763c5.translation: 一记难以防御的突刺。若目标处于踉跄状态，还会紧接着以斧刃追加一击。

90411d14158c2cf942d6.source: Performs an additional attack against staggered targets
90411d14158c2cf942d6.translation: 对踉跄的目标追加一次攻击

dd74f7b2479983983d6a.source: Save yourself or another character from bleeding to death by applying pressure and provisional bandaging to any such wound. Does not heal hitpoints. Neither the character using this skill nor the patient may be engaged in melee.
dd74f7b2479983983d6a.translation: 通过压迫伤口和临时包扎，阻止自己或其他角色失血而死。不会恢复生命值。施用者和伤者都必须脱离近战。

2617fa61d5e89dc7ba5e.source: Removes fresh Cut Artery, Cut Neck Vein and Grazed Neck injuries
2617fa61d5e89dc7ba5e.translation: 治愈新近造成的动脉割伤、颈静脉割伤和颈部擦伤

72e35ee07ae6c5aea9ed.source: A brute force attack that inflicts additional fatigue with every hit.
72e35ee07ae6c5aea9ed.translation: 以蛮力发动攻击，每次命中都会使目标额外积累疲劳。

2d8a8ce44506de8beadc.source: A strike that can cover the distance of 2 tiles. Its effect can be felt through the thickest of armor.
2d8a8ce44506de8beadc.translation: 攻击距离可达2格的一击，震荡之力甚至能透过最厚重的铠甲。

a690c80e0903eda6dd40.source: [/color] damage to hitpoints, regardless of armor
a690c80e0903eda6dd40.translation: [/color]点生命值伤害，不受护甲厚度影响

a351183a0508072c0240.source: ]-15%[/color] chance to hit targets directly adjacent because the weapon is too unwieldy
a351183a0508072c0240.translation: ]-15%[/color]命中率：武器过于笨重，不便攻击紧邻的目标

6df29d2cc999f39c2170.source: Give to an adjacent ally or eat yourself strange mushrooms to enter a state of trance-like rage with no regard for your safety. May result in sickness. The effect will slowly wear off over 4 turns. Can not be used while engaged in melee, and anyone receiving the item needs to have a free bag slot.
6df29d2cc999f39c2170.translation: 自己食用，或交给相邻友军食用怪异蘑菇，进入恍如出神的狂怒状态，不再顾惜自身安危。可能引起不适，效果会在4回合内逐渐消退。陷入近战时无法使用；接受物品的角色须有一个空闲背包格。

6ac7e6a8c02f8fc68bac.source: Use everything at your disposal to free a nearby ally from what is holding them in place. Hack, slash, cut or gnaw at it if need be!
6ac7e6a8c02f8fc68bac.translation: 想尽办法，解开困住附近友军的束缚。劈、砍、割，必要时连牙齿都用上！

679575c7cd4750d1f7b6.source: %[/color] chance to succeed, based on Melee Skill, or higher if there's been attempts to free the ally before.
679575c7cd4750d1f7b6.translation: %[/color]成功率，取决于近战命中；此前若已尝试解救该友军，成功率还会提高。

6b85bc1abb9573d6e303.source: Use everything at your disposal to free yourself from what is holding you in place. Hack, slash, cut or gnaw at it if need be!
6b85bc1abb9573d6e303.translation: 想尽办法摆脱束缚。劈、砍、割，必要时连牙齿都用上！

155e6598d182f171cb89.source: %[/color] chance to succeed, based on Melee Skill. Each failed attempt will increase the chance to succeed for subsequent attempts.
155e6598d182f171cb89.translation: %[/color]成功率，取决于近战命中。每次挣脱失败，都会提高后续尝试的成功率。

ca9fdd73b7c0f6eddf08.source: Let loose a cascade of three striking heads on your opponent. Will strike over or around shield cover.
ca9fdd73b7c0f6eddf08.translation: 挥舞三个击锤，向对手倾泻连环攻击，越过或绕过盾牌的掩护。

088cbd8ececf6c618b26.source: Will make three separate strikes for one third of the weapon's damage each
088cbd8ececf6c618b26.translation: 分别攻击三次，每次造成武器伤害的三分之一

dec55b974ae7b906a151.source: Ignores the bonus to Melee Defense granted by shields
dec55b974ae7b906a151.translation: 无视盾牌提供的近战防御加成

1382c9a936a96bc080d4.source: A sweeping strike in a wide arc that hits three adjacent tiles in counter-clockwise order over some distance that leaves a harmful miasma in its wake. Be careful around your own men unless you want to relieve your payroll!
1382c9a936a96bc080d4.translation: 在一定距离外大幅挥扫，按逆时针顺序打击相邻的三个格子，并留下有害瘴气。小心别扫到自己人，除非你想少发几份薪饷！

7b30fa3116b09064d6b5.source: Leaves a cloud of miasma on target tiles

99275bbd804d00339444.source: Strike a target with a weaponized censer and leave a harmful miasma in the attack's wake. Somewhat unpredictable, but able to strike at a distance of 2 tiles and over or around shield cover with a bit of luck and skill.
99275bbd804d00339444.translation: 以武器化的香炉打击目标，在攻击路径上留下有害瘴气。招式不易掌控，但能攻击2格外的敌人；凭借技巧和几分运气，还能越过或绕过盾牌的掩护。

f590526bbc7d515d9b97.source: resists being charmed thanks to his resolve
f590526bbc7d515d9b97.translation: 凭借坚定的决心抵抗了魅惑

f317e773cab00863850f.source: resists being charmed thanks to his unnatural physiology
f317e773cab00863850f.translation: 凭借非同寻常的生理构造抵抗了魅惑

2997656d20d798ca9989.source: A powerful chopping attack that bears full force on any target.
2997656d20d798ca9989.translation: 倾尽全力的一记猛劈，对目标施以沉重打击。

5d4720703e98e8f8b77d.source: ]50%[/color] damage on a hit to the head

39b483c1b46840d619cf.source: A brute force cleaving attack that can inflict bleeding wounds if there is no armor absorbing the blow and if the target is able to bleed at all.
39b483c1b46840d619cf.translation: 以蛮力劈砍。如果没有护甲吸收这一击，且目标本身会流血，就能造成流血伤口。

10777d38ce25797e2c1d.source: Coat your weapons and arrowtips with poison. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
10777d38ce25797e2c1d.translation: 为武器和箭头涂上毒药。陷入近战时无法使用。

1977a0c688b90734f28d.source: ]4[/color] attacks will apply the Poisoned status effect.

3085425d84aea75eb05e.source: ]4[/color] attacks will apply the Poisoned status effect for [color=

ec092a585fa7eed278f1.source: causes a flesh cradle to explode!

9637802bd793851e6ba2.source: A heavy strike to make the enemy formation crumble. It can cover the distance of 2 tiles and can be used from behind the frontline, outside the range of most other melee weapons.
9637802bd793851e6ba2.translation: 足以瓦解敌军阵线的沉重一击。可攻击2格外的目标，从前排身后出手，避开大多数近战武器的攻击范围。

c5abcd14ee20ffb02b0c.source: Using the weapon to batter, deform, rip and otherwise render the target's armor unusable with great effect. Although the impact will be felt through the thickest of armor, it won't inflict the most injury to the wearer.
c5abcd14ee20ffb02b0c.translation: 用武器猛砸、撕扯，将目标护甲打得变形破损，高效削弱其防护。冲击能透过最厚重的铠甲，但对穿戴者造成的直接伤害有限。

1801be770e1cdc4adab9.source: [/color] damage to hitpoints that ignores armor

4de9c9739230fc2e5692.source: A slow overhead strike performed with full force to cudgel a target to pulp. Anyone hit with a blow like this will be dazed and gasping for air, unable to put full force behind their blows for two turns.
4de9c9739230fc2e5692.translation: 缓慢举起武器，以全力迎头砸下，要将目标捣成肉泥。被击中者会陷入恍惚、喘不过气，接下来两回合都无法全力出手。

99cb80e32fd31cc10887.source: ]100%[/color] chance to daze on a hit

463fde7281f0905a77f7.source: Land a deadly hit on a debilitated target to finish it off.
463fde7281f0905a77f7.translation: 对已陷入困境的目标施以致命一击，将其了结。

44535e398f37c9c943ca.source: ]33%[/color] more damage against and ignores additional [color=
44535e398f37c9c943ca.translation: ]33%[/color]额外伤害，并使护甲穿透提高[color=

6f5ec1afbdf2933d56e7.source: ]20%[/color] armor of targets that have the Dazed, Stunned or Trapped in Net status effects
6f5ec1afbdf2933d56e7.translation: ]20%[/color]。仅对恍惚、眩晕或被网缠住的目标生效

53542e15a13030167414.source: Prepare your next attack to debilitate a target for one turn, reducing their ability to inflict damage by [color=
53542e15a13030167414.translation: 让下一次攻击削弱目标一回合，使其造成的伤害受到[color=

2ae41fec02d2f3838228.source: ]-50%[/color]. Missing the target will waste the effect.
2ae41fec02d2f3838228.translation: ]-50%[/color]修正。攻击未命中也会消耗此效果。

d5800145abf7f9a8d8fe.source: A devastating blow aimed to decapitate the target on the spot. Does more damage to hitpoints, the more the target is already wounded. Killing the target will always decapitate it, if at all possible.
d5800145abf7f9a8d8fe.translation: 一记力求当场斩首的毁灭性打击。目标伤得越重，受到的生命值伤害越高。若击杀目标，且目标可以被斩首，就必定将其斩首。

b8d6067e797b517c8c8e.source: [/color] damage depending on how wounded the target already is, of which [color=
b8d6067e797b517c8c8e.translation: [/color]点伤害，具体取决于目标的受伤程度，其中[color=

047728026820b5d75770.source: Use the whip over significant distance to temporarily disarm an opponent on a hit. A disarmed opponent can not use any weapon skills, but may still use other skills and move freely. Unarmed targets can not be disarmed.
047728026820b5d75770.translation: 用鞭子攻击较远的敌人，命中后暂时将其缴械。被缴械者无法使用任何武器技能，但仍可施放其他技能并自由移动。无法缴械没有武器的目标。

80b12898a1d5fb5de2d0.source: ]100%[/color] chance to disarm on a hit

db6a4d1a37401fba14d2.source: Give to an adjacent ally or drink yourself an antidote to remove any poison effects. Can not be used while engaged in melee, and anyone receiving the item needs to have a free bag slot.
db6a4d1a37401fba14d2.translation: 自己饮用，或交给相邻友军饮用解毒剂，清除所有中毒效果。陷入近战时无法使用；接受物品的角色须有一个空闲背包格。

e8d0c8b171abc3648955.source: Grants immunity to Poison for 3 turns

138d34b1ea08be43abe5.source: A wide, heavy swing aimed at the head.
138d34b1ea08be43abe5.translation: 瞄准头部，挥出势大力沉的一击。

6066f373f6243d5dba4e.translation: 炸裂成四散飞射的骨片！

0de240041eb0f3befb66.source: Drink an alchemical marvel to brighten up the night like if it were the mid of day. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
0de240041eb0f3befb66.translation: 喝下神奇的炼金药剂，让黑夜在眼中亮如白昼。陷入近战时无法使用。

3672a87da51e49544dba.source: Ignite the fuse of your Handgonne. Can hit many targets at once, but targets farther away are less likely to be hit. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
3672a87da51e49544dba.translation: 点燃手铳的引信。能同时打击多个目标，但距离越远，命中率越低。近战缠斗时无法使用。

f57fe74c0528a88da33f.source: %[/color] per tile of distance. This chance is unaffected by objects or characters in the line of fire.
f57fe74c0528a88da33f.translation: %[/color]命中率。射击路径上的障碍物和角色不会影响这一命中率。

7da506f3ab3e58097d54.translation: ]需要装备仍有火药的火药袋[/color]

d8485d33823d9d1fde27.source: fires a shell high in the air
d8485d33823d9d1fde27.translation: 向高空发射了一枚炮弹

e0d916b1da98e9a973ae.source: A mortar shell impacts on the battlefield

4bcb2c798c3804feba7c.source: Save yourself from bleeding to death by applying pressure and provisional bandaging to any such wound. Does not heal hitpoints. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
4bcb2c798c3804feba7c.translation: 通过压迫伤口和临时包扎，阻止自己失血而死。不会恢复生命值。陷入近战时无法使用。

e90172f47accf7ac6d4c.source: Flailing at an opponent. Somewhat unpredictable in damage, but able to strike over or around shield cover.
e90172f47accf7ac6d4c.translation: 挥舞链枷攻击对手。伤害起伏较大，但能越过或绕过盾牌的掩护。

5b1994f5d5fb29d756df.source: Fleshy tentacles appear and drag in
5b1994f5d5fb29d756df.translation: 血肉触手突然出现，拖住了

68f943736c6b0d97b24a.source: unleashes a flurry of blows around it

6c848b028d125252f8d0.source: Use skillful footwork to leave a Zone of Control without triggering free attacks.
6c848b028d125252f8d0.translation: 以灵巧的步法离开敌人的控制区域，不触发借机攻击。

aae10f14bca7f5c1c863.source: ]Can only be used when in an opponent's Zone of Control[/color]
aae10f14bca7f5c1c863.translation: ]只能在敌人的控制区域内使用[/color]

894a480ea5ea28d6e002.source: A well-placed slashing attack that is likely to inflict debilitating injuries.
894a480ea5ea28d6e002.translation: 瞄准要害的一记斩击，容易造成削弱战斗能力的伤势。

66a50dab3ac6b06a4f00.source: A diagonal overhead strike performed with full force to devastating effect.
66a50dab3ac6b06a4f00.translation: 倾尽全力从上方斜劈而下，造成毁灭性的打击。

bf2ad8c90cc5a9d307d2.source: A wide swinging overhead attack performed for maximum reach rather than force that can hit two tiles in a straight line.
bf2ad8c90cc5a9d307d2.translation: 从上方大幅挥劈，牺牲部分力道以追求更远的攻击距离，可同时击中一条直线上的两个格子。

6c1b0e68b9aedffc4f24.source: Swinging the weapon in a wide arc that hits three adjacent tiles in counter-clockwise order. Be careful around your own men unless you want to relieve your payroll!
6c1b0e68b9aedffc4f24.translation: 将武器大幅横扫，按逆时针顺序打击三个相邻格子。小心别扫到自己人，除非你想少发几份薪饷！

508a6eb7bdbdef8fb76e.source: Long and sharp claws that can tear flesh with ease.
508a6eb7bdbdef8fb76e.translation: 又长又尖的利爪，能轻易撕开血肉。
