c2c64518dc78c01965a3.source: Aim for an opponent's head. Each striking head can hit or miss on its own for one third of the weapon's damage, and will strike over or around shield cover.
c2c64518dc78c01965a3.translation: 瞄准敌人的头部挥击。三个锤头分别判定命中，每次造成武器伤害的三分之一，还能越过或绕开盾牌的防护。

2e7ab7bc931729408ea4.source: Will make three separate strikes for one third of the weapon's damage each.
2e7ab7bc931729408ea4.translation: 连续挥击三次，每次独立判定命中，造成武器伤害的三分之一。

7734292276c3353c434c.source: A strike that can be felt through the thickest of armor and will leave a lasting mark.
7734292276c3353c434c.translation: 沉重的一击，即使身披厚甲也难以承受，必将留下伤痕。

792ff16c4a414494cd5e.source: The standard fist-fighting attack. Let them fly!
792ff16c4a414494cd5e.translation: 最基本的拳头攻击。放开手脚揍他！

71ce64413d1164da8375.source: resists being hexed thanks to his unnatural physiology
71ce64413d1164da8375.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质抵抗了诅咒

82b50ba6646f7f291d9e.source: A target 2 tiles away is hooked and pulled close if there is space. Anyone hit will be staggered and lose initiative. A target can not be pulled up a level of height, but may take damage if it is pulled down several levels of height at once. Shieldwall, Spearwall and Riposte will be canceled for a successfully hooked-in target. A rooted target can not be hooked.
82b50ba6646f7f291d9e.translation: 钩住2格外的目标，若身前有空位便将其拉近。命中后使目标踉跄，降低其先攻。无法将目标拉上高处，但若将其拉落数层高度，可能造成坠落伤害。成功拉近目标会解除其盾墙、矛墙和还击状态。无法拖拽被定身的目标。

2fc9a0d7a32df3df1a99.source: ]100%[/color] chance to stagger on a hit

b5c3ca4884020dcdd35a.source: Ignite the fuse of your Fire Lance and unleash a stream of fire and smoke at your opponents.
b5c3ca4884020dcdd35a.translation: 点燃火矛的引信，向敌人喷出烈焰与浓烟。

d02faf7a3d8c4fa02222.source: A thrusting attack that can cover the distance of 2 tiles and can be used from behind the frontline, outside the range of most melee weapons.
d02faf7a3d8c4fa02222.translation: 刺向2格外的目标。可从前排战线身后发动攻击，避开大多数近战武器的攻击范围。

6880029c628b6e9f1021.source: Gather all this character's physical strength and willpower to become indomitable until next turn.
6880029c628b6e9f1021.translation: 凝聚全部体力与意志，在下回合到来前屹立不倒。

c29a05a17e04778c0211.source: Become immune to being knocked back or grabbed

f7efb980159a57939cb8.source: Use the shield to knock a target away by one tile. Targets hit will receive fatigue and may take damage if they are pushed down several levels of height. Shieldwall, Spearwall and Riposte will be canceled for a target that is successfully knocked back. A rooted target can not be knocked back.
f7efb980159a57939cb8.translation: 用盾牌将目标击退一格。命中后使目标积累疲劳，若将其推落数层高度，还可能造成坠落伤害。成功击退目标会解除其盾墙、矛墙和还击状态。无法击退被定身的目标。

ddaca09c406e356d912b.source: A heavy blow intended to stun or incapacitate anyone unlucky enough to be hit for one turn, but not to do the most damage. Stunned targets can not keep up their Shieldwall, Spearwall or similar defensive skills.
ddaca09c406e356d912b.translation: 旨在击晕敌人的沉重一击，使不幸被击中的目标眩晕一回合，而非追求最大的伤害。眩晕中的目标无法维持盾墙、矛墙等防御技能。

6ebb3b8db35ad10924b2.source: ]100%[/color] chance to stun on a hit

f0aaedc911f6c238971e.source: %[/color] chance to stun on a hit

d9f4d6b3730473113ad2.source: Aim for an opponent's head. Somewhat unpredictable in damage, but able to strike over or around shield cover with a bit of luck.
d9f4d6b3730473113ad2.translation: 瞄准敌人的头部挥击。伤害起伏较大，但运气好时能越过或绕开盾牌的防护。

ca39d04ff366a50ec756.source: A swift lunge towards a target 2 tiles away, followed by a precise thrusting attack to catch them unprepared. The faster you are, the more damage you do.
ca39d04ff366a50ec756.translation: 迅速突进到2格外的目标身边，趁其措手不及时精准刺击。动作越快，伤害越高。

773d7ae7d0266b5ed769.source: Moves the user next to the target, ignoring Zone of Control
773d7ae7d0266b5ed769.translation: 无视控制区域，移动到目标身旁

bf12c0d34a51acee11f6.source: Inflicts additional damage, the higher the user's current Initiative
bf12c0d34a51acee11f6.translation: 使用者当前先攻越高，造成的额外伤害越高

6023f133e734635bd265.translation: 融合成了更庞大的形体

fb0bfb1c4caaadcd8c32.source: Become one with your weapon and gain perfect focus as if time itself were to stand still.
fb0bfb1c4caaadcd8c32.translation: 与手中兵刃融为一体，全神贯注，仿佛连时间都停了下来。

ecb8ad7f654adfc66e4e.source: The Action Point cost for using skills is reduced by half for the remainder of this round, but Fatigue costs are doubled.
ecb8ad7f654adfc66e4e.translation: 本回合剩余时间内，使用技能消耗的行动点减半，但疲劳消耗翻倍。

c9ff639224a3156e4951.source: A series of two or more thrusts made in quick succession, depending on how many injuries the opponent has suffered.
c9ff639224a3156e4951.translation: 接连刺击两次或更多次，攻击次数取决于敌人身上的伤势数量。

01b9e6f1e7db04202692.source: Performs an additional attack for every injury on the target
01b9e6f1e7db04202692.translation: 目标每有一处伤势，额外攻击一次

35c888613e9c707dd1a4.source: Pound the target into the ground with the chain and striking head. Somewhat unpredictable, but able to strike over or around shield cover with a bit of luck. A target hit with enough force may be stunned for one turn.
35c888613e9c707dd1a4.translation: 挥动链锤猛砸目标。伤害起伏较大，但运气好时能越过或绕开盾牌的防护。重击可能使目标眩晕一回合。

d3e4759a73d9b06c7727.source: Hits to the head ignore an additional [color=

e33abf1195b57d03c8b8.source: A well-placed attack at the opponent armor's weakspots. Ignores all armor but is harder to hit with and can not land critical hits for additional damage, nor inflict additional damage with double grip.
e33abf1195b57d03c8b8.translation: 瞄准敌人护甲的薄弱处精准刺击。完全无视护甲，但较难命中，无法通过暴击造成额外伤害，也不享受双手握持的伤害加成。

f74e58d1f9c2244b4e1f.source: A quick shot with little time used for drawing and aiming. Accuracy drops sharply with distance. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
f74e58d1f9c2244b4e1f.translation: 仓促拉弓瞄准后迅速射出一箭。距离越远，命中率下降越明显。近战缠斗时无法使用。

eb9dfd7015d2520ddc94.source: Raaaaally! Use this character's inspirational resolve to rally nearby fleeing allies and push everyone to go the extra mile. A single character can only be rallied once per round.
eb9dfd7015d2520ddc94.translation: 重整队伍！凭借自身坚定的决心鼓舞附近溃逃的战友，激励众人继续奋战。每名角色每回合只能被集结一次。

7015c2fe4095f9f18c09.source: Triggers a morale check to rally fleeing allies within 4 tiles distance, with a bonus to Resolve of [color=
7015c2fe4095f9f18c09.translation: 对4格内溃逃的友军进行士气检定，成功则使其重返战斗。检定获得的决心加成为[color=

6228b07155f3ff22586d.source: Triggers a morale check to raise the morale of anyone wavering or worse within 4 tiles distance, with a bonus to Resolve of [color=
6228b07155f3ff22586d.translation: 对4格内士气为动摇或更低的友军进行士气检定，成功则提升士气。检定获得的决心加成为[color=

a9cf6363c3e3e95cd0eb.source: [/color] based on this character's Resolve, but lowered by [color=
a9cf6363c3e3e95cd0eb.translation: [/color]，由使用者的决心决定；每相距一格，另受到[color=

94a7035f175418d22047.source: Removes the Sleeping status effect of allies within 4 tiles distance
94a7035f175418d22047.translation: 解除4格内友军的睡眠状态

4d3b97cd3deecb18b8fc.source: ]Can not rally others the same turn as being rallied himself[/color]
4d3b97cd3deecb18b8fc.translation: ]本回合刚受到集结的角色无法再集结他人[/color]

3a925f59556adc68b1c6.source: A sweeping strike in a wide arc that hits three adjacent tiles in counter-clockwise order over some distance. Be careful around your own men unless you want to relieve your payroll!
3a925f59556adc68b1c6.translation: 向远处挥出一道大幅横扫，按逆时针顺序击中三个相邻地格。当心身边的弟兄，除非你打算靠这个削减军饷！

5ab100b5113dbf257312.source: Take a deep breath and rest for a turn in order to recover your strength.
5ab100b5113dbf257312.translation: 深吸一口气，休息一回合以恢复体力。

bc1922ff45c4d5ddee39.source: Current Fatigue is reduced by half

d6068cc77b233bde27e4.source: Release your falcon to gain vision of the surrounding 12 tiles for the duration of the current round. Can be used once per battle.
d6068cc77b233bde27e4.translation: 放出猎鹰，获得周围12格的视野，持续至本回合结束。每场战斗只能使用一次。

134a4ac0fa3b4c874ee2.source: Ready another bolt to be fired. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
134a4ac0fa3b4c874ee2.translation: 装入下一支弩矢，准备射击。近战缠斗时无法使用。

d7c2c8b27df58c382e51.source: ]Needs a non-empty quiver of bolts equipped[/color]

12932077735786d7245a.source: Ready another shot to be fired. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
12932077735786d7245a.translation: 重新装填，准备下一次射击。近战缠斗时无法使用。

ee1d32448228fd4596c6.source: Poke and shove at a target in order to force it away from the user by one tile. Targets hit will be staggered and lose initiative, and may take damage if they are pushed down several levels of height. Shieldwall, Spearwall and Riposte will be canceled for a target that is successfully repelled. A rooted target can not be repelled.
ee1d32448228fd4596c6.translation: 以武器推刺目标，将其逼退一格。命中后使目标踉跄，降低其先攻；若将其推落数层高度，还可能造成坠落伤害。成功逼退目标会解除其盾墙、矛墙和还击状态。无法逼退被定身的目标。

906fe7568d8ab9758579.source: Use your superior fighting skills to assume a defensive stance and seek to incapacitate anyone attacking you that you can reach yourself.
906fe7568d8ab9758579.translation: 凭借高超的武艺采取守势，伺机制住攻击自己的敌人，前提是对方在自身攻击范围内。

73c83325cee5a91357b2.source: ]50%[/color] chance to stun any opponent missing this character with a melee attack (resistances and immunities still apply).
73c83325cee5a91357b2.translation: ]50%[/color]几率使近战攻击未命中的敌人眩晕（仍受对方的抗性和免疫效果影响）。

5e5629f5873108bcbdab.source: Prepare to immediately counter-attack any opponent that attempts to attack in melee and misses.
5e5629f5873108bcbdab.translation: 做好反击准备：敌人的近战攻击一旦落空，立即还击。

bbc5a0b16d9a000e49a5.source: Switch places with another character directly adjacent, provided neither the target is stunned or rooted, nor the character using the skill is. Rotate the battle line to keep fresh troops in front!
bbc5a0b16d9a000e49a5.translation: 与相邻角色交换位置，前提是双方均未眩晕或被定身。轮换战线，让体力充沛的弟兄顶上前排！

4212f900bd57a461d66c.source: Mow down all the targets around you, foe and friend alike, with a reckless round swing. Not hard to evade because it is not aimed at anything, but can be devastating if it connects. Be careful around your own men unless you want to relieve your payroll!
4212f900bd57a461d66c.translation: 不顾敌我地挥出一记回旋横扫，攻击身边所有目标。由于没有瞄准特定目标，这一击较易躲避，但一旦命中便能造成重创。当心身边的弟兄，除非你打算靠这个削减军饷！

52e2d2ce7563c005c17b.source: A thrusting attack that can cover the distance of 2 tiles and can be used from behind the frontline, outside the range of most melee weapons, and can tear bleeding wounds if not stopped by armor.
52e2d2ce7563c005c17b.translation: 刺向2格外的目标。可从前排战线身后发动攻击，避开大多数近战武器的攻击范围。若攻击未被护甲挡住，还会撕开伤口，使目标持续流血。

47a628403d4fc9f83e86.source: [/color] bleeding damage over time if not stopped by armor
47a628403d4fc9f83e86.translation: [/color]点持续流血伤害，前提是攻击未被护甲挡住

b855ed78532ab74bf0b9.source: Swing the weapon in a wide arc that hits three adjacent tiles in counter-clockwise order. A target hit may be knocked back or staggered from the force of the blow. Be careful around your own men unless you want to relieve your payroll!
b855ed78532ab74bf0b9.translation: 大幅挥动武器，按逆时针顺序击中三个相邻地格。猛烈的冲击可能将目标击退或使其踉跄。当心身边的弟兄，除非你打算靠这个削减军饷！

def95ff5a14896a8f1b8.source: ]33%[/color] chance to stagger on a hit

fb8bdebb82f92fc60a16.source: ]33%[/color] chance to knock back on a hit

baf087456ac84329febd.source: The shield is raised to a protective stance until next turn. Allies using Shieldwall next to each other further increase their protection by overlapping their shields.
baf087456ac84329febd.translation: 举起盾牌采取守势，持续至下回合。相邻友军若也使用盾墙，便能以相互交叠的盾牌进一步加强防护。

4ed89d87ec98924933f0.source: ]+5[/color] Defense against all attacks for each ally adjacent also using Shieldwall
4ed89d87ec98924933f0.translation: ]+5[/color]全类防御，每名相邻且同样使用盾墙的友军分别提供一次加成

fd90f53852b7eb20eba1.source: A quick pull of the trigger to loose a bolt. Must be reloaded after each shot to be able to fire again.
fd90f53852b7eb20eba1.translation: 扣动扳机，射出一支弩矢。每次射击后都必须重新装填。

199f4e5d6d8082a71041.source: A quick pull of the trigger to loose a heavy bolt. Must be reloaded after each shot to be able to fire again.
199f4e5d6d8082a71041.translation: 扣动扳机，射出一支重型弩矢。每次射击后都必须重新装填。

aff94e33662cf0090f49.source: A precise, powerful thrust utilizing the user's momentum and weight to pierce through gaps in armor.
aff94e33662cf0090f49.translation: 借助冲势与自身重量，精准而有力地刺入敌人护甲的缝隙。

0769ec0d60497ceb07bb.source: Ignores additional armor, the higher the user's current Initiative
0769ec0d60497ceb07bb.translation: 使用者当前先攻越高，额外无视的护甲越多

e26e9c4b587cd533c61f.source: A swift slashing attack dealing average damage.
e26e9c4b587cd533c61f.translation: 迅捷的挥砍，造成中等伤害。

6b1bebb2e84c252b2b4a.source: A swift slashing attack which, on a hit, will summon lightning that sparks from opponent to opponent.
6b1bebb2e84c252b2b4a.translation: 迅捷的挥砍。命中后召来闪电，在敌人之间接连跳跃。

9850f26d7011453709fe.source: resists the urge to sleep thanks to his resolve
9850f26d7011453709fe.translation: 凭借坚定的决心抵抗了睡意

2e2e4131499fd65a2648.source: Propel a stone towards a target with your sling. Accuracy drops sharply with distance. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
2e2e4131499fd65a2648.translation: 用投石索将石弹甩向目标。距离越远，命中率下降越明显。近战缠斗时无法使用。

fe8715dae09b751c3baf.source: %[/color] chance to hit per tile of distance
fe8715dae09b751c3baf.translation: %[/color]命中率修正，每相距一格计算一次

abd3f595cd032bc92d4a.source: ]100%[/color] chance to daze a target on a hit to the head
abd3f595cd032bc92d4a.translation: ]100%[/color]几率在击中头部后使目标恍惚

f275d08282bddd84f076.source: A slow overhead strike performed with full force to smash a target to bits. Anyone hit will be staggered and lose initiative.
f275d08282bddd84f076.translation: 举起武器，全力劈下，将敌人砸得粉碎。动作较慢，但命中后会使目标踉跄，降低其先攻。

6ae830feeafb2d7588e6.source: Prepare to immediately attack any opponent that attempts to move into melee range and, on a hit, prevent that opponent from closing in. Targets hit will receive half the damage of a normal
6ae830feeafb2d7588e6.translation: 做好迎击准备，立即攻击试图进入近战范围的敌人。命中便可阻止对方靠近，造成普通攻击一半的伤害。所用攻击：

5a8c3738187f7140b2e9.source: impales the area in front of it

84ee920353170be06a65.source: A wide-swinging overhead attack performed for maximum reach rather than force that can hit two tiles in a straight line.
84ee920353170be06a65.translation: 举起武器大幅劈下，追求攻击距离而非力量，可同时击中直线上的两个地格。

b975d4d6d3854c9455f6.source: A slow overhead attack performed with full force to split a target in two from top to bottom. Has enough force that it always hits both head and body for additional damage.
b975d4d6d3854c9455f6.translation: 举起武器，全力劈下，试图将敌人从头到脚一分为二。动作较慢，但力量足以同时打击头部和身体，造成额外伤害。

e25ad3b84fad9b933815.source: Hits both head and body for additional damage
e25ad3b84fad9b933815.translation: 同时击中头部和身体，造成额外伤害

23fcb335e9f1678d907b.source: An attack specifically aimed at destroying an opponent's shield. Can only be used against targets that carry a shield. Will always hit but may take several hits depending on type of shield and weapon used.
23fcb335e9f1678d907b.translation: 专门破坏敌人盾牌的攻击，只能对持盾目标使用。攻击必定命中，但所需攻击次数取决于盾牌和武器的类型。

edea5e5f54132a1f045f.source: Can not be used if currently visible to an opponent
edea5e5f54132a1f045f.translation: 当前被敌人看见时无法使用

ec33dddcc2d1a27c25b1.source: Strike a heavy blow intended to incapacitate and stun your target for two turns, but not to do the most damage. Stunned targets can not keep up their Shieldwall, Spearwall or similar defensive skills.
ec33dddcc2d1a27c25b1.translation: 旨在使敌人失去行动能力的沉重一击，使其眩晕两回合，而非追求最大的伤害。眩晕中的目标无法维持盾墙、矛墙等防御技能。

b9822957444db8781f1b.source: ]100%[/color] chance to stun for two turns on a hit
b9822957444db8781f1b.translation: ]100%[/color]几率在命中后使目标眩晕两回合

605a03b3e7670a423935.source: %[/color] chance to stun for two turns on a hit
605a03b3e7670a423935.translation: %[/color]几率在命中后使目标眩晕两回合

829961aa1670b1d05961.source: A sweeping strike that can cover the distance of 2 tiles and can be used from behind the frontline, outside the range of most other melee weapons.
829961aa1670b1d05961.translation: 挥击2格外的目标。可从前排战线身后发动攻击，避开大多数其他近战武器的攻击范围。

b406d482cc0a447481f7.source: ]-15%[/color] chance to hit targets directly adjacent
b406d482cc0a447481f7.translation: ]-15%[/color]命中率，攻击紧邻目标时生效

b7086ef9954f90843ee1.source: You fight like a cow! Taunt a single opponent into attacking this character instead of taking defensive actions or attacking another, potentially more vulnerable target.
b7086ef9954f90843ee1.translation: 你打架就像头笨牛！挑衅一名敌人，使其转而攻击自己，放弃防守或攻击其他可能更脆弱的目标。

bb753cc51fb36d5cab7a.source: Force the target to engage and attack this character, if possible, on their next turn. Note that targets will still adhere to their group strategy, and may not blindly charge forward.
bb753cc51fb36d5cab7a.translation: 迫使目标在下回合尽可能接近并攻击此角色。目标仍会遵循所属队伍的战术，不一定会不顾一切地向前冲。

3b26b2e10e1630b2448e.source: Threshing all the targets around you, foe and friend alike, with a reckless round swing. Not hard to evade because it is not aimed at anything, but can be devastating if it connects. Has a chance to stun targets hit for one turn. Be careful around your own men unless you want to relieve your payroll!
3b26b2e10e1630b2448e.translation: 不顾敌我地挥出一记回旋横扫，攻击身边所有目标。由于没有瞄准特定目标，这一击较易躲避，但一旦命中便能造成重创，并有几率使目标眩晕一回合。当心身边的弟兄，除非你打算靠这个削减军饷！

625fcb6a57fe60470fb9.source: Throw a flask of acid towards a target, where it will shatter and spray its contents. The acid will slowly corrode away any armor of those hit - friend and foe alike.
625fcb6a57fe60470fb9.translation: 向目标投出一瓶酸液。瓶子碎裂后，酸液四处飞溅，逐渐腐蚀所有被溅中者的护甲，无论敌我。

8651ebd4b1817333d7e1.source: Hurl an axe at a target. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
8651ebd4b1817333d7e1.translation: 向目标掷出一把飞斧。近战缠斗时无法使用。

5f177f9b65142a40555d.source: [/color] tiles on even ground, more if throwing downhill
5f177f9b65142a40555d.translation: [/color]格（平地）；从高处向低处投掷时射程更远

aacb3ebac2a45c3fab57.source: Hurl spiked bolas towards your target. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
aacb3ebac2a45c3fab57.translation: 向目标掷出带刺的套索球。近战缠斗时无法使用。

14456bcd1da808ea8d90.source: Throw a pot filled with mysterious powders that react violently on impact to create a bright flash and loud bang, and will daze anyone close by - friend and foe alike
14456bcd1da808ea8d90.translation: 投出装满神秘粉末的陶罐。粉末在撞击时剧烈反应，发出强光和巨响，使附近所有人陷入恍惚，无论敌我

57f8478c585ffc4f7c4f.source: Ignite and throw a pot filled with highly flammable liquids towards a target, where it will shatter and set the area ablaze. Anyone ending their turn inside the burning area will catch fire and take damage - friend and foe alike.
57f8478c585ffc4f7c4f.translation: 点燃装满易燃液体的陶罐并掷向目标。陶罐碎裂后会点燃周围区域。在火焰中结束回合的角色都会着火并受到伤害，无论敌我。

e968298db25eca6e4d90.source: ]7[/color] tiles ablaze with fire for 2 rounds. Water and snow can not burn.
e968298db25eca6e4d90.translation: ]7[/color]格，火焰持续2轮。水面与积雪无法燃烧。

656e1796b62e481cfaf4.source: Burns away existing tile effects like Smoke or Miasma
656e1796b62e481cfaf4.translation: 清除区域内原有的烟雾、瘴气等地格效果

e42c510087d993997155.source: Throw a flask of blessed water towards a target, where it will shatter and spray its contents. The blessed water will burn the undead, but will not affect other targets.
e42c510087d993997155.translation: 向目标投出一瓶圣水。瓶子碎裂后，圣水四处飞溅，灼烧亡灵，但不会伤及其他目标。

87dba6a0cb27b096072f.source: ]3[/color] turns, all of which ignores armor

cd32020db9cbd5c786fe.source: Hurl a javelin at a target. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
cd32020db9cbd5c786fe.translation: 向目标掷出一支标枪。近战缠斗时无法使用。

af52c39305085f28552d.source: Throw a net on your target in order to prevent them from moving or defending themself effectively. Will always hit if the enemy isn't immune.
af52c39305085f28552d.translation: 向目标投出一张网，限制其移动，削弱其防御。除非目标免疫，否则必定命中。

802d40f5316d5e254af2.source: Throw a pot filled with substances that upon impact will quickly create a dense cloud.
802d40f5316d5e254af2.translation: 投出一只装有特殊材料的陶罐，落地后迅速释放浓密烟雾。

cec700f072d110b5f4de.translation: 烟雾内所有角色的远程防御获得[color=

ae8769552b3c552cf467.source: Extinguishes existing tile effects like Fire or Miasma
ae8769552b3c552cf467.translation: 清除区域内原有的火焰、瘴气等地格效果

11e54637c154549586e2.source: Hurl a throwing spear at a target in order to render their shield unusable. Targets with a shield will always be hit. Hitting a target without a shield can inflict devastating damage instead, but the attack may miss. Can not be used while engaged in melee.
11e54637c154549586e2.translation: 向目标掷出投矛，使其盾牌无法继续使用。对持盾目标必定命中；对无盾目标则可造成巨大伤害，但可能落空。近战缠斗时无法使用。

d015dfbe89e7c2c9dcee.source: A well placed thrust attack that is hard to avoid or block.
d015dfbe89e7c2c9dcee.translation: 精准刺向目标，使其难以闪避或格挡。

26ba8fc6ede3cd485ba4.source: Unleash your wardog and send him charging into the enemy. Needs a free tile adjacent.
26ba8fc6ede3cd485ba4.translation: 解开战犬的缰绳，让它冲向敌阵。身旁需要有一个空地格。

e5c74f6d526816c01398.source: Become the fleshen conduit and the earthen voice of Davkul. Speak truth to his followers and make them give their everything to please their god.
e5c74f6d526816c01398.translation: 成为达夫库尔的血肉容器与尘世之声。向信徒宣示真理，让他们为取悦神明献出一切。

9f2d42a80b86892c9623.source: Lowers the fatigue of every cultist, friend or foe, by [color=
9f2d42a80b86892c9623.translation: 立即使所有邪教徒的疲劳值受到[color=

f43db5b8f4d846b31db0.source: ]-10[/color] instantly. Anyone not a cultist is not affected.
f43db5b8f4d846b31db0.translation: ]-10[/color]修正，无论敌我。对非邪教徒无效。

f283c9b976cd7c996f62.source: Forcibly wake an adjacent ally from unnatural sleep.
f283c9b976cd7c996f62.translation: 强行唤醒一名相邻友军，使其摆脱诡异的沉睡。

110989696ecb1df6292a.source: Crack the whip over significant distance to inflict two stacks of bleeding damage at once. Quite ineffective against armor.
110989696ecb1df6292a.translation: 从远处挥鞭抽击，一次施加两层流血效果。对护甲效果很差。

8e7c94847cb95c38f83c.source: Remind your indebted of who their master is by giving them a good whipping, so that they give their all - up to and including their very life.
8e7c94847cb95c38f83c.translation: 用鞭子提醒负债者谁才是他们的主人，逼他们拼尽全力，甚至献出性命。

c701e6a411b67c3912bb.source: ]3[/color] damage that ignores armor to the target
c701e6a411b67c3912bb.translation: ]3[/color]点无视护甲的伤害，作用于目标

1bfa958dc0fe70dfe791.source: Gives the targeted indebted the 'Whipped' status effect, increasing many of their stats for 2 rounds. The higher the level of the character using this skill, the higher the increase.
1bfa958dc0fe70dfe791.translation: 使目标负债者获得“鞭策”效果，提升多项属性，持续2轮。施放者等级越高，提升幅度越大。

40454b6e8c9c572175ae.source: Resets the morale of the targeted indebted to 'Steady' if currently below
40454b6e8c9c572175ae.translation: 若目标负债者的士气低于“稳定”，将其恢复至“稳定”

1f974221f5fc384861a3.source: Adventurous Nobles tend to have high resolve and melee skills, but often neglect ranged defense.
1f974221f5fc384861a3.translation: 冒险贵族通常决心坚定，近战技艺出众，却往往疏于防御远程攻击。

ccdf19514f357b73d963.source: Adventurousness never leaves the soul of a man like %name%. {Instead of returning to his noble family, he left the %companyname% and headed east in search of rare beasts. Word has it he returned to town with the head of what looked like a giant lizard, but you don't believe such fantastical tripe. | He departed the %companyname% and ventured west, sailing across the oceans to unseen lands. There's no telling where he is these days, but you've little doubt that he'll be coming back with stories to tell. | He retired from the %companyname% and, instead of returning to his noble family, headed south. Word has it he fought in a great noble civil war, killed an orc warlord, climbed the highest mountain in the land, and is currently writing an epic about his travels. | The nobleman left the %companyname% and, preferring the life of adventure to noble boredom, he headed north. Word has it that he's currently marching a troop of explorers to the furthest reaches of the world.}
ccdf19514f357b73d963.translation: 像%name%这样的人，一生都放不下冒险的念头。{他没有回归自己的贵族家族，而是离开%companyname%，向东寻找珍奇异兽。据说他后来带着一颗酷似巨蜥的脑袋回了城，不过你可不信这种荒诞的鬼话。 | 他离开%companyname%，向西远航，越过大洋，前往无人见过的土地。如今没人知道他身在何处，但你毫不怀疑，他回来时准会有一肚子故事。 | 他从%companyname%退役后，没有回归自己的贵族家族，而是一路南下。据说他参加过一场声势浩大的贵族内战，杀死过一名兽人军阀，还登上了当地最高的山峰，如今正把自己的游历写成一部史诗。 | 这位贵族离开了%companyname%。比起贵族生活的沉闷，他更钟情于冒险，于是踏上了北上的旅途。据说他眼下正带领一队探险者，向世界尽头进发。}

5c94f882e42dd13468a1.source: %name% departed the %companyname% and continued his adventuring elsewhere. {He headed east, hoping to discover the source of the greenskins, but the nobleman has not been heard from since. | He headed north into the snowy wastes. Word has it he was seen a week ago, marching south this time, looking rather pale and shuffling moreso than walking. | He headed south into brutal marshlands. Word has it that a mysterious flame appeared in the fog and he walked toward it. The men who saw this said he disappeared into the mist and never returned. | He headed west and sailed the open sea. Despite having no experience at sea, he saw fit to make himself captain of the boat. They say pieces of his ship and dead sailors kept washing ashore for weeks.}
5c94f882e42dd13468a1.translation: %name%离开了%companyname%，到别处继续冒险。{他向东进发，想找到绿皮的发源地。此后，这位贵族便杳无音信。 | 他一路北上，进入冰雪覆盖的荒原。据说一周前有人见过他，不过那时他正在往南走，脸色惨白，脚步拖沓，与其说是在走路，倒更像是在地上挪动。 | 他南下深入凶险的沼泽。据说雾中出现了一团诡异的火光，他便朝那火光走去。目击者说，他的身影消失在迷雾里，再也没有回来。 | 他向西而行，乘船驶入大海。尽管毫无航海经验，他仍觉得自己足以胜任船长。据说此后好几个星期，都有船只残骸和水手的尸体不断被冲上岸。}

1094e037706704ae5c59.source: {A minor noble | As the third in the line of succession | A young and brash noble | A skilled swordsman}, %name%'s life at court {had grown stale for him | was not exciting enough for him with endless studying of court etiquette and family lineage | felt like wasting the best time of his life | was not half as exciting to him as the tales of adventures, battles, fearsome beasts to vanquish and fair maidens to conquer}. {Wearing the family crest proudly | At the encouragement of his brother | To the frustration of his mother | Finally making a decision to change things}, %name% rode out to {prove himself | make a name for himself | earn glory on the battlefield | test his skills in battle} and {live life to its fullest as he imagined it from behind the castle walls | see all the wonders and exotic places of the world | earn his place in the world | be knighted for his valor | become famous and loved in all the known world | become infamous and feared in all the known world}.
1094e037706704ae5c59.translation: {身为一名小贵族 | 身为家族的第三顺位继承人 | 身为一名年轻气盛的贵族 | 身为一名技艺娴熟的剑士}，%name%{早已厌倦了宫廷生活 | 终日研习宫廷礼仪和家族谱系，只觉得这样的日子索然无味 | 觉得宫廷生活不过是在虚耗自己最好的年华 | 觉得宫廷生活远不及故事中那些冒险与战斗来得精彩，更别提斩杀凶兽、赢得佳人的芳心了}。{他自豪地佩着家族纹章 | 在兄长的鼓励下 | 尽管母亲对此十分恼火 | 终于下定决心改变这一切后}，%name%策马出发，决意{证明自己的本事 | 闯出一番名堂 | 在战场上赢得荣耀 | 在实战中检验自己的武艺}，并且{过上自己在城墙内憧憬已久的精彩人生 | 看遍世间的奇景异域 | 在这世上挣得一席之地 | 凭借英勇事迹受封为骑士 | 名扬天下，受世人爱戴 | 恶名远扬，令世人畏惧}。

73864e97774804950d0f.source: Part scientist and part surgeon, Anatomists are unaccustomed to battle but well served by steady hands.
73864e97774804950d0f.translation: 解剖师兼具学者与外科医师的本领，虽不熟悉战斗，一双稳健的手却颇有帮助。

b7406d81fd810c12cedc.source: Out of all the men you came to know in the %companyname%, it was %name% the anatomist who is perhaps the most difficult to forget. An unending stream of letters only helps ensure you never will. You skim over his latest, one-sided correspondence: "Captain! I've managed to..." skimming, skimming, "...the greatest invention! The most..." skimming, skimming. "I'm going to be famous! My brain will be studied for its weight is surely..." Nothing new, it seems, though you are glad he's still in good health, albeit perhaps more so in body than mind.
b7406d81fd810c12cedc.translation: 在%companyname%结识的所有人当中，解剖学者%name%大概是最让你难以忘怀的一个。他源源不断寄来的信，也确保了你想忘都忘不了。你草草翻看他最新寄来的又一封自说自话的信：“团长！我成功……”略过，略过。“……最伟大的发明！最……”略过，略过。“我要成名了！我的大脑将供人研究，它的重量肯定……”看来又没什么新鲜事。不过，你还是很高兴他依然健康——至少身体如此，脑子就不好说了。

6044c9a7d5392e08d976.source: Having fled the %companyname%, %name% the anatomist continued his studies elsewhere. He was admonished by his peers for venturing out in such an uncouth manner and found himself suffering in intellectual mediocrity. Some years later, he made a small contribution to the study of beetles after which he promptly threw himself off a seaside cliff, donating his brain to the rocks and his body to the ocean.
6044c9a7d5392e08d976.translation: 解剖学者%name%逃离%companyname%后，在别处继续自己的研究。同僚们斥责他当初出走的行径有辱斯文，他自己也苦于学问平庸，始终一事无成。几年后，他在甲虫研究上做出了一点微不足道的贡献，随即便从海边的悬崖上一跃而下，将大脑捐给了礁石，将躯体捐给了大海。

5e474f4cac7619807e2b.source: {%name% is a sharp man with a complexion wrecked by constant and virulent testing. You hope that his methodologies may be better applied to his enemies rather than his own self. | Rumors about %name% suggest he tried to figure out how to fly. Not by machine, rather, but by growing wings. How exactly he intended to do that, or what became of his experiments, is unknown. Yet, here he is, rather shrewdly grounded and looking over his shoulders. | Like many anatomists, %name% went out on his own into the world. Of course, also like many, he was quickly chewed up by the hungriness of those to whom science means nothing. For now, he will fight alongside sellswords, if only to buy himself extra time to truly get to his studies. | %name% is cynical to the world, upset that some of his peers could see to their education in full, while he must earn coin just to support his studies. May his anger present itself on the battlefield. | One would expect a man like %name% to appear after a battle, not actually participate in it. The fact such an intelligent, albeit bizarre figure would still need a sellsword's earnings has you wondering if your own prospects of getting anywhere in this world are even worse than you realized. | One cannot overstate %name%'s intellect. He is a wicked smart man, the sort who can make you question why the gods bothered to give you a mind of your own if it is to be so dwarfed. But, in sellsword matters, he would be just another fighter. Hopefully his martial skills are as sharp as his wits. | You can never know for certain if it were hard times which forced %name% into sellswording, or if he's merely pursuing scientific inquiries by another, far crueler path. That he spends evenings dissecting wagon-crushed dogs and wingless butterflies makes you ponder a lot of things about the curious fellow. | Curiosity, not coin, brought %name% to sellswording. He has a keen interest in discovering the creatures of the world, and what they look like on the inside. So long as he makes said insides visible, you could care less what else he does with them.}
5e474f4cac7619807e2b.translation: {%name%头脑敏锐，却因不断进行危险的实验而憔悴不堪。你希望他能把这些手段用在敌人身上，少拿自己折腾。 | 传闻%name%曾试图弄明白怎样才能飞起来。他想的不是造一部机器，而是给自己长出翅膀。至于他究竟打算怎么做，实验又有什么结果，谁也说不清。不过他如今确实站在这里，老老实实地脚踏实地，还不时警惕地回头张望。 | 和许多解剖学者一样，%name%曾独自出门闯荡。也和许多同行一样，他很快便被那些视学问如无物的贪婪之徒吞得连骨头都不剩。眼下，他愿意与佣兵并肩作战，哪怕只是为了给自己多争取一点潜心研究的时间。 | %name%愤世嫉俗。同僚们能安心读完学业，他却得自己挣钱供养研究，这让他愤懑不已。但愿他能把这股怒气发泄在战场上。 | 像%name%这样的人，按理说该在战斗结束后才出现，而不是亲自上阵。这样一个聪明绝顶、虽说也古怪透顶的家伙，居然仍得靠卖命挣钱，这不禁让你怀疑：自己在这世上的出路，是否比原先想的还要渺茫。 | %name%的聪明才智怎么夸都不为过。他精明得可怕，与你一比，简直让你怀疑诸神何必还费心给自己安个脑子。不过，到了佣兵这行，他也只是个普通战士。但愿他的武艺能和头脑一样出众。 | 你始终弄不清，%name%究竟是走投无路才当了佣兵，还是只想换一条更残忍的路来探求学问。他常在夜里解剖被车轮碾死的狗和失去翅膀的蝴蝶，让你对这个古怪家伙生出了许多疑问。 | 让%name%投身佣兵行当的是好奇心，而非金钱。他一心想认识世上的各种生物，尤其想知道它们肚子里面长什么样。只要他能把那些肚肠剖出来给你看，之后拿去做什么，你都懒得管。}

745b53e6d9ece330b59f.source: Apprentices tend to be eager for knowledge and learn faster than others.
745b53e6d9ece330b59f.translation: 学徒求知若渴，通常比其他人学得更快。

ca83e6b62fbdb218f718.source: Perhaps one of the sharpest men you've ever met, %name% the apprentice was the quickest learner in the %companyname%. With plenty of crowns stored, he retired from fighting to take his talents to the business world. Last you heard he was doing very well for himself across multiple trades. If you ever have a son, this is the man you'll send him to for apprenticeship.
ca83e6b62fbdb218f718.translation: 学徒%name%或许是你见过最聪明的人之一，也是%companyname%里学东西最快的一个。攒下大笔克朗后，他告别了厮杀，转而在生意场上施展才干。最近一次听说他的消息时，他在好几个行当里都混得风生水起。将来若有了儿子，你一定送去给他当学徒。

e393c218ab6f25659a7a.source: %name% the apprentice was, by far, the quickest learner in the %companyname%. Little surprise then that he was also one of the quickest to recognize its inevitable downfall and leave while he still could. Had he been born in a different time he would have gone on to do great things. Instead, many wars, invasions, and plagues spreading across the land ultimately ensured %name% and many other talented men went to total waste.
e393c218ab6f25659a7a.translation: 在%companyname%里，学徒%name%学东西的速度无人能及。因此，他也是最早看清战团必然覆灭、趁着还能脱身便赶紧离开的人之一，这丝毫不令人意外。倘若生在别的年代，他本可以成就一番事业。可惜，接踵而来的战争、入侵和瘟疫横扫大地，最终让%name%和许多同样有才华的人白白蹉跎了一生。

d1c553e2ba7fc60db896.source: {One enters the world always looking to be the best they can be, | Mastery of an art is prestigious, | Everybody looks up to the best,} {but no one gets there in an instant. | so what better way to be the best than to learn underneath one? | and it's no secret most look toward the masters for help.} {%name% thought the same, taking the role of an apprentice in %townname%. | Believing this to be true, %name% took up an apprenticeship in %townname%. | When %randomtown%'s college asked for apprentices, %name% was the first to sign up. | Urged by his parents to better his craft, %name% looked to start his career as an apprentice. | Not to be outdone by his overachieving brother, %name% began looking for an apprenticeship.} {Unfortunately, his master was poorly chosen: an insane carpenter with a penchant for chopping the neckline instead of the treeline. Fleeing the impending doom by association, %name% has ended up in the company of sellswords. | Learning all he could, %name% built the greatest work of art possibly ever seen in the field of underwater basket-weaving. His master, though, was a jealous one. Not to be outdone by a pupil, he burned the project to ash and eye-watering fumes. It was clear to %name%: he could learn fast, but perhaps there were better masters to study beneath. | He had soaked up all there was to learn: masonry, carpentry, blacksmithing, lovemaking. Now he turns his eyes on the martial arts. While he isn't exactly a warrior yet, %name% is a fast learner.}
d1c553e2ba7fc60db896.translation: {人活在世上，总想把自己的本事练到最好， | 精通一门手艺是件体面的事， | 人人都敬重那些技艺超群的人，}{但这绝非一朝一夕之功。 | 而想要学成一流的本事，还有什么比拜一流的师傅更好呢？ | 所以大多数人都会向名师求教，这并不稀奇。}{%name%也是这么想的，于是在%townname%当起了学徒。 | %name%对此深信不疑，于是在%townname%拜了师。 | %randomtown%的学院招收学徒时，%name%第一个报了名。 | 父母催促%name%精进手艺，他便打算从学徒做起。 | 不愿输给那个事事争先的兄弟，%name%开始四处找师傅拜师。}{可惜，他挑错了师傅：那是个疯疯癫癫的木匠，喜欢砍的不是树，而是人的脖子。为了躲开这场眼看就要牵连到自己的灾祸，%name%逃了出来，最后混进了佣兵队伍。 | 学会师傅的全部本领后，%name%编出了水下编篮这门行当中或许最了不起的杰作。然而，他的师傅嫉妒心极重，哪容得下徒弟胜过自己，一把火便将那件作品烧成了灰，只剩熏得人直流泪的浓烟。%name%算是明白了：自己学得确实快，不过或许该另找个更好的师傅。 | 砌石、木工、打铁、床笫之术——能学的他都学了个遍，如今又把目光转向了武艺。%name%眼下还算不上战士，但他学得很快。}

1490bc69bec2d6cfe2f2.source: %name% joined the company in place of the bastard nobleman he had come to kill. So strange was this agreement that you kept your eye on the assassin for many days. But all he did was fight for the %companyname%, and fight well. Last you heard, the assassin departed the company and has not been seen or heard from since. You checked in on the bastard nobleman himself to see if perhaps the assassin had finished the job, but the man was alive and well. A peculiar run in, in the end.
1490bc69bec2d6cfe2f2.translation: %name%本是来刺杀那位贵族私生子的，却答应代替目标加入战团。这桩约定实在古怪，你一连多日都盯着这名刺客。然而，他所做的不过是为%companyname%作战，而且战功不俗。最近听说，他已经离开战团，从此杳无音信。你还特意打听了一下那个贵族私生子的近况，想看看刺客是不是终于完成了差事，结果对方依然活得好好的。回头想想，真是一段奇遇。

105f79c48c5153b48682.source: %name% joined the company in place of the bastard nobleman he had come to kill. So strange was this agreement that you kept your eye on the assassin for many days. But all he did was fight for the %companyname%, and fight well. Last you heard, the assassin departed the company not long after your hurried retirement. You decided to check in on his target the bastard nobleman only to find out that he had been slain by an unseen assassin. It appears %name% finished the job in the end.
105f79c48c5153b48682.translation: %name%本是来刺杀那位贵族私生子的，却答应代替目标加入战团。这桩约定实在古怪，你一连多日都盯着这名刺客。然而，他所做的不过是为%companyname%作战，而且战功不俗。最近听说，就在你匆匆退隐后不久，他也离开了战团。你决定打听一下他的目标，也就是那位贵族私生子的近况，却得知此人已被一名来无影去无踪的刺客杀死。看来，%name%最终还是完成了差事。

b89654b417daf09504c6.source: An assassin has to be quick on his feet and skilled with the use of weapons.
b89654b417daf09504c6.translation: 刺客必须身手敏捷，并且精通兵器。

e60cab8b0d00f45c39b9.source: %name% the assassin departed the %companyname% with a large chest of gold and traveled far away. From what rumors you've heard, he built a castle in the mountains east of the southern kingdoms. You're not sure if it's true, but there's been a steady increase in dead viziers and lords alike as of late.
e60cab8b0d00f45c39b9.translation: 刺客%name%带着一大箱黄金离开%companyname%，远赴他乡。传闻他在南方诸国以东的山中修建了一座城堡。真假你不清楚，不过近来暴毙的维齐尔和领主确实越来越多了。

db847bb54a4b7578c4fc.source: %name% disappeared not long after your retirement from the %companyname%. The assassin presumably does not want to be found and there's no telling where he is. In moments of honesty, you tell others you wished you never hired him at all. You just can't shake the terror that it is you he is stalking and hunting, and you spend many nights with one eye open, looking for the man in black with the crooked dagger.
db847bb54a4b7578c4fc.translation: 你从%companyname%退隐后不久，%name%便消失了。这名刺客想必无意让人找到，谁也不知道他身在何处。偶尔说起真心话时，你会承认自己后悔当初雇了他。你始终摆脱不了一个可怕的念头：他此刻跟踪、猎杀的目标，或许就是你。于是，许多个夜晚你都不敢合眼，提防着那个手持弯匕首的黑衣人。

bb7537fd5cc15a9645f5.source: {You wouldn't think it at first, but %name% looks like any other man. Ordinary. Just an ordinary man. | %name% looks almost like the mold of every man you've ever met put together. He has a face you'd never remember. | %name% has a gentle smile and demeanor. He talks to all others as equals, weighing the opinions of wealthy and poor seemingly to measure himself between them. | %name% offers nothing with which to garner a second look. He is wholly simple, and wholly a man meant to be a part of this world.} {Of course, this is by design. He is an assassin sent by a guild of trained killers. A scroll he carries suggests, without threat, that you take him under your employ. | This unassuming existence is a trained face for a man who is, in actuality, a trained assassin carrying a one-of-a-kind Qatal dagger from his guild. | A bland face has a murderous past, though, for the man carries a Qatal dagger given only to the best killers of one of the South's guild of assassins. | But the 'familiar stranger' face is a put on, intended to hide the fact that he is a man from a guild of assassins sent out for reasons you may never know.} {%name% could be standing right next to you, yet feel as though he's disappeared into a crowd of two. | Despite knowing you've never met the man until now, you can't help but feel you've seen %name% somewhere before. | You naturally feel at ease around %name%, which almost feels like a setup in and of itself, so in turn you force yourself to stay alert around him instead.}
bb7537fd5cc15a9645f5.translation: {乍想之下或许令人意外，%name%看上去竟与旁人毫无区别。普通，就是个普通人。 | %name%的相貌仿佛把你见过的所有人揉在了一起，是张过眼即忘的脸。 | %name%笑容温和，举止谦逊。他待人一视同仁，富人的高见也好，穷人的想法也罢，他都会掂量一番，仿佛想借此认清自己的位置。 | %name%身上没有半点值得让人多看一眼的地方。他平平无奇，完完全全是这世间一个再寻常不过的人。}{当然，这副模样是刻意为之。他是一名由杀手行会派出的刺客。他随身带着一卷文书，措辞毫无威胁，只是建议你将他收入麾下。 | 这副不起眼的模样是训练出来的伪装。实际上，他是一名训练有素的刺客，身上带着行会赐予的独特卡塔尔匕首。 | 然而，这张平淡无奇的脸背后藏着一段染血的过去：他携带着一把卡塔尔匕首，只有南方某个刺客行会中最出色的杀手才有资格获赠。 | 但这副似曾相识的陌生面孔不过是伪装。实际上，他来自某个刺客行会，奉命外出，所为何事，你也许永远不会知道。}{%name%即便就站在你身旁，也仿佛能隐没在仅有你们两人的人群中。 | 你明知此前从未见过%name%，却总觉得曾在什么地方碰过面。 | 待在%name%身边，你会不由自主地放松下来。可这份安心本身又像个圈套，让你不得不强迫自己提高警惕。}

985a3ce8588484b978b7.source: %name% the barbarian took all the coin he earned with the company and ventured north. With his money, he gathered a band of warriors and conquered so many tribes that, last you heard, he had been ordained 'king of the north'.
985a3ce8588484b978b7.translation: 蛮族%name%带着在战团赚得的全部钱财北上。他出钱招揽了一群战士，征服了众多部落。你上次听到消息时，他已被拥立为“北境之王”。

8fca0de6fcb2b3a70ef6.source: With things the way they were, %name% departed. Last you heard he was traveling north. Penniless with little to his name but an axe, and not looking anything like the natives or speaking their tongue, you figure the barbarian did not get far. Based upon what you've seen happen to his ilk, he's either been killed already or captured as a slave.
8fca0de6fcb2b3a70ef6.translation: 眼见局势如此，%name%离开了。最后听说他正向北走去。他身无分文，除了一把斧头几乎一无所有，相貌与语言又都异于当地人，你觉得这蛮族走不了多远。照你对这类人遭遇的了解，他不是被杀了，就是沦为了奴隶。

3bf32e70f46d9ecf2ba9.source: {%name% survived the battle between yourself and his own tribe of warriors. He offered himself to your company or to your sword. Impressed by his bravery, you chose to take him in. A foreign brute, he hardly speaks your native tongue and he is not well liked by the rest of the company. But if anything can bond two men it is fighting beside one another, killing when it counts, and drinking the night away at the tavern.}
3bf32e70f46d9ecf2ba9.translation: {%name%在你们与他部落的战斗中活了下来。他给自己留下两条路：要么加入你的战团，要么死在你的剑下。你被他的勇气打动，决定收留他。这个异乡壮汉几乎不会说你们的语言，战团里的其他人也不怎么喜欢他。不过，若有什么能让两个男人结下交情，那便是并肩作战，在紧要关头一起杀敌，再到酒馆里痛饮一夜。}

ba666b1eeb25205b9730.source: Bastards often have profited from some training in melee fighting.
ba666b1eeb25205b9730.translation: 私生子通常受过一些近战训练。

7a9a134efd529c0d5935.source: {%name%, the bastard son of a familially inconsiderate nobleman, departed the %companyname% to try to carve out his own family lineage. The last you heard, he'd managed to acquire himself a good plot of land and a modest stone castle rests on it. While successful, he still harbors resentment for his family. | A bastard son of a nobleman, %name% couldn't help but always have that lingering feeling he just didn't belong in this world. But the %companyname% gave him a brotherhood to call family. As far as you know, he still fights with the company to this day.}
7a9a134efd529c0d5935.translation: {%name%的父亲是个薄情的贵族，而他只是个私生子。他离开%companyname%，想靠自己开枝散叶，建立一个家族。最近听说，他已经置下了一块不错的土地，上面还建有一座不大的石堡。虽说事业有成，他对旧日家族的怨恨却始终未消。 | 身为贵族的私生子，%name%总觉得自己不属于这世上的任何地方。但在%companyname%，他找到了可以视为家人的弟兄。据你所知，直到今天，他仍在为战团而战。}

589ecc1bc0bd1b740000.source: Bastards like %name% usually don't get far in this world. They're too hated in the highborn world in which they live, and hated by the lowborn because they don't understand the politics that would make a bastard more common to them than any nobleman. Not long after you left the company, you got wind of %name%'s passing. Apparently, a young and cruel lord took over his noble house and saw the bastard as a threat to his throne. Despite the bastard wanting nothing to do with that life anymore, it managed to catch up with him anyway. He was assassinated in a tavern bed, his throat cut as he slept.
589ecc1bc0bd1b740000.translation: 像%name%这样的私生子，在世上往往难有出路。他身处贵族之中，却遭高门大户厌弃；平民也同样憎恨他，因为他们不懂贵族之间的算计，不知道一个私生子的处境其实比任何贵族都更接近自己。你离开战团后不久，便听到了%name%的死讯。据说一位年轻而残忍的领主接掌了他的家族，将这个私生子视为王位的威胁。尽管他早已不愿再与那种生活有任何瓜葛，过去的阴影还是追上了他。他在酒馆的床上遇刺，睡梦中被人割开了喉咙。

ea6c2fb90db78163bccc.source: {%name% was born during a fiery military campaign far away from his father's home. | %name%'s mother hailed from a pub in %randomtown%. Which is strange, because his father is a married royal in %townname%. | With a wife cursed by a witch, %name%'s father gave himself to another woman to 'continue' the bloodline. | With the king away so long, %name%'s queen of a mother could hardly resist the temptations of a local servant. | %name% was born nine months after raiders pillaged his parents' castle.} {The life of a bastard was not an easy one: the man was constantly hounded by jealous half-brothers. | Like some kind of royal leper, the bastard was kept far away from the public eye. | Thankfully, for much of his life %name% knew not that he was a bastard child. | A controversy at birth, %name% was only spared abandonment by the omens of a local oracle. | Being a royal bastard gave the man a good life, so long as he kept his head low, and his unwanted status even lower. | Hatred by both strangers and family steeled the bastard for the eventual difficulties outside his royal upbringing.} {Angered by his role in life, %name% did attempt a coup to take the throne. It did not go far. He is now banished from every court in the land. | When a half-brother pelted him with stones, %name% felt little remorse running the sibling through with a sword. He blamed it on a servant, but quickly left his royal housing thereafter. | %name%'s father tried to pass him off as legitimate, but when a royal marriage fell through the ensuing scandal of impropriety proved too much. The bastard now roams the land, free of the shackles of controversy. | Being the oldest son in line made %name% a target for his younger, legitimate brothers. It was an easy choice to leave that life of politics and backstabbing. | Found in bed with a half-sister, the scandals in %name%'s life grew far too heavy to stay in the royal courts. | Tired of the trivialities of royal processions, %name% only wishes to join a group of men that care not for bloodlines and legitimacy. | When an assassin poisoned his father's wine, %name% was quickly blamed for the murder. Escaping an angry mob was only the beginning of an exciting, new life. | While he came to love him dearly, %name%'s father knew the royal court was not safe. He sent the man away to forge a life on his own terms.}
ea6c2fb90db78163bccc.translation: {%name%出生时，他的父亲正远离家乡，参加一场战火纷飞的远征。 | %name%的母亲来自%randomtown%的一间酒馆。奇怪的是，他的父亲却是%townname%一位早有妻室的王族。 | %name%父亲的妻子中了女巫的诅咒，于是他为了“延续”血脉，投入了另一个女人的怀抱。 | 国王离宫太久，身为王后的母亲终究没能抵挡当地一名仆人的诱惑，于是有了%name%。 | 掠夺者洗劫他父母的城堡九个月后，%name%降生了。}{私生子的日子并不好过：心怀嫉恨的同父异母兄弟总是纠缠不休。 | 仿佛得了麻风病的王族，这个私生子被严严实实地藏了起来，不许在公众面前露面。 | 所幸，%name%在很长一段人生里都不知道自己是个私生子。 | %name%一出生就引起了争议，只因当地先知给出的预兆才没有遭到遗弃。 | 王族私生子的身份让他衣食无忧，前提是低头做人，最好让所有人都忘了他这个多余的存在。 | 陌生人和家人同样憎恨这个私生子，也把他磨炼得足够坚韧，好去承受日后离开王族生活的艰辛。}{不甘受命运摆布，%name%曾发动政变，试图夺取王位，却很快便以失败告终。如今，这片土地上的所有宫廷都将他拒之门外。 | 一个同父异母的兄弟朝他扔石头，%name%便一剑刺穿了对方，心里没多少愧疚。他把罪名推给了一名仆人，随后很快离开了王族宅邸。 | %name%的父亲曾想将他冒充为婚生子，但一桩王族联姻告吹后，接踵而至的失德丑闻终究无法收场。如今，这个私生子四处流浪，总算摆脱了是非的纠缠。 | 身为长子，%name%成了几个婚生弟弟的眼中钉。离开那种充斥着权谋和暗算的生活，对他来说并不难决定。 | 被人撞见与同父异母的妹妹同床后，%name%背负的丑闻终于多到让他无法再留在宫廷。 | 厌倦了王族仪仗中的繁文缛节，%name%只想加入一群不在乎血统、也不在乎出身是否合法的汉子。 | 一名刺客在他父亲的酒里下毒，%name%很快就被指认为凶手。逃出愤怒人群的围堵，只是他刺激新生活的开端。 | 尽管父亲已渐渐深爱上这个儿子，他仍明白宫廷对%name%而言并不安全。于是，他将儿子送走，让他按自己的意愿闯出一条生路。}

0a9725f8e5ca889e6bb8.source: Beast Slayers are used to expertly hunt monstrous beasts at all ranges.
0a9725f8e5ca889e6bb8.translation: 猎兽人擅长在各种距离下猎杀凶兽。

5106aaed9f59f0cc670d.source: %name% retired from the company and bought the deed to an abandoned castle. There he commands a troop of fellow beast slayers who journey the land protecting it from monsters. Last you spoke to him he had a raven-haired lady friend who did not take kindly to your presence, nor the presence of anyone else for that matter. You're sure he's happy.
5106aaed9f59f0cc670d.translation: %name%从战团退役，买下了一座荒废城堡的地契。他在那里统领着一群猎兽同伴，行走四方，保护人们免遭怪物侵袭。上次见面时，他身边有位乌发女伴，对你很不友善——其实对任何人都一样。你相信他过得很幸福。

c8c88c149eefc7d9bcb1.source: After leaving the %companyname%, %name% retired from beast slaying altogether and last you heard he fathered an albino daughter. Unfortunately, rumors spread quickly about the girl having supernatural powers and her mother was executed by fire. The father and child were never caught nor seen again.
c8c88c149eefc7d9bcb1.translation: 离开%companyname%后，%name%彻底告别了猎兽生活。最后听说他生了个患白化病的女儿。不幸的是，女孩拥有超自然力量的传言迅速流传，她的母亲被处以火刑。父女二人始终未被抓住，从此也再无人见过。

6bb56f212e421c966fd6.source: {{%name%'s past is hardly an extravagant one. | %name% has been traveling these parts for some time, but not always in his current vocation. | Despite his grisly job, %name% did not come from an extraordinary life. | A long list of defeated beasts and the pelts to prove it misleads one as to %name%'s background.} {The beast slayer was once a mere hunter, armed with both bow and wisdom. However, upon discovering a monstrous direwolf in one of his traps he acquired a taste for hunting more dangerous foes. | When his village kept getting attacked by webknechts, the man took to learning all he could about hunting beasts. And then doing just that to much success. | It's said he was a village's miller until alps haunted the town whole. Never much of a sleeper himself, he spent nights learning about the monsters until he bettered them. | He served as prey finder for a local lord. But when a hunt went awry and into the jaws of an unhold, the man turned to studying beasts and how to slay them. | A mere lumberjack, the beast slayer came into true being when all his peers were slaughtered at the hands of a schrat, a living tree. He avenged his friends and vowed to learn all he could of monsters. | A former monk, the man turned to studying beasts and swords alike after nachzehrers ravaged his monastery.} {Times are changing, though, and not even this skilled monstrum hunter can go it alone. He seeks to join a company and kill as many beasts as he can. | The days are uncharacteristically short and the moon blooms bright every night. This slayer feels a change in the air, and if he's going to fight what's coming he'll need more than just himself to do it. | While not fond of company, the beast slayer wants to kill as many creatures as he can, and he'll need the help of some fine brothers to do just that. | In a world becoming more dangerous and desperate, the beast slayer seeks coin and company both. | A professional journeyman such as this man could be of great use to a mercenary company and you've little doubt he'll be diligent in his death dealing. | Unfortunately, the man took an apprentice under his wings only for the kid to be slaughtered by a direwolf. The broken beast slayer now seeks sturdier company.}}
6bb56f212e421c966fd6.translation: {{%name%的过去实在谈不上传奇。 | %name%在这一带闯荡已有些时日，但并非一直干着眼下这份营生。 | 尽管如今的行当血腥骇人，%name%的出身却平凡无奇。 | %name%杀过的野兽名单很长，手头还有兽皮为证，容易让人误以为他的身世也同样不凡。}{这名猎兽者原本只是个普通猎户，凭弓箭和经验为生。然而，自从在陷阱中发现了一头硕大的恐狼，他便迷上了追猎更危险的猎物。 | 村庄接连遭到巨蛛袭击，他便想尽办法学习猎兽的知识，随后亲自上阵，战果颇丰。 | 据说他原先是村里的磨坊主，直到梦魇笼罩了整个村镇。他本就不爱睡觉，便夜夜钻研这些怪物，最终将它们击败。 | 他曾替当地领主追踪猎物。可有一回狩猎出了岔子，一行人竟闯进了巨魔口中，自此他便开始钻研怪兽，以及杀死它们的办法。 | 他原本只是个伐木工。直到同伴全被一头树妖——一棵活生生的树——杀死，他才真正走上猎兽之路。他为朋友报了仇，并发誓要弄清有关怪物的一切。 | 他曾是一名修士。食尸鬼蹂躏了修道院后，他便转而钻研怪物与剑术。}{然而世道变了，即使是这样老练的猎兽者，也无法再独自支撑。他想加入一支战团，尽可能多地猎杀野兽。 | 白昼短得反常，明月却夜夜高悬。猎兽者察觉到风向已变，而若要应对将至的祸患，单凭他一人远远不够。 | 尽管不爱与人结伴，这名猎兽者还是想尽可能多地猎杀怪物。为此，他需要几位好弟兄相助。 | 世道越来越凶险，人心也越来越绝望。这名猎兽者既想挣些钱，也想找些同伴。 | 这样一位经验丰富的行家，对佣兵战团必定大有用处。你毫不怀疑，他在杀戮这件事上会尽心尽力。 | 可惜，他曾收下一名学徒，悉心教导，那孩子却被恐狼杀了。如今，心灰意冷的猎兽者想找些更经得起折腾的同伴。}}

617bf1cc1cac9b039bce.source: Beggars aren't the most determined persons, and living on the street tends to be detrimental to their health.
617bf1cc1cac9b039bce.translation: 乞丐通常意志不够坚定，流落街头也损害了他们的健康。

300b3e014b2f7d5d0cff.source: Having enough of all the fighting, %name% the once-beggar retired from the %companyname%. You know the man made a pretty crown in his time with the mercenary company, yet the other day you saw him out begging again. You asked if he'd wasted all his money and he laughed. He said he'd purchased land and was doing just fine. Then he held out his little tin and asked for a crown. You gave him two.
300b3e014b2f7d5d0cff.translation: 曾经的乞丐%name%受够了厮杀，从%companyname%退役了。你知道他在战团里挣了不少钱，可前几天竟又看见他在街上行乞。你问他是不是把钱全败光了，他哈哈大笑，说自己买了地，日子过得好着呢。随后，他递出那只小锡罐，向你讨一枚克朗。你给了他两枚。

bce4fa2fc43066d79d06.source: The fighting life is a rough one, and %name% the once-beggar saw fit to retire from it before it became a deadly one. Unfortunately, he went back to beggaring. Word has it that a nobleman cleaned a city of riff-raff and sent them marching north despite it being winter. Cold and hungry, %name% died on the side of a road, a tin cup frozen to his finger.
bce4fa2fc43066d79d06.translation: 刀口舔血的日子太苦，曾经的乞丐%name%决定趁着还没丢命，及时退出。可惜，他又回去乞讨了。据说一位贵族为了清理城里的闲杂人等，把他们统统赶往北方，全然不顾当时正值隆冬。%name%饥寒交迫，最终死在路边，那只锡杯冻在了他的手指上。

b935077c783189a2b4ba.source: {After losing everything to a fire | After his gambling addiction got the better of him | Framed for a crime he didn't commit, and having to pay the constable everything to keep himself out of the dungeons | A refugee after his village was burned to the ground | Banished from his home after a violent struggle with his brother | A man with few talents and no ambition | After being released from a lord's dungeon where he spent countless years chained to a wall | After giving all his worldly possessions to an obscure cult promising salvation of his eternal soul | A very intelligent man until a brigand knocked him over the head}, {%name% found himself on the streets, | %name% was forced onto the streets,} {having to beg for bread | depending on the goodwill of others | being beaten and resigned to his fate | spending what little coin he had to drink the days away | digging into the trash of others and scurrying away from lawmen | avoiding ruffians and thugs while he begged for crowns}. {While he seems earnest in becoming a mercenary, there is little doubt that all his time on the street have robbed %name% of his best years. | Years have passed and took a toll on his health by now. | Once a man like %name% has spent a few days on the streets, much less a few years, even the very dangerous job of being a sellsword seems like the greenest of pastures. | Only the gods know what %name% has done to survive, but he is a frail man standing before you now. | At the sight of you he rises with open arms to embrace you, claiming to know you well from years past and many a shared adventure, although your name escapes him at the moment.}
b935077c783189a2b4ba.translation: {一场大火夺走了他的一切 | 赌瘾最终毁了他的生活 | 他蒙受不白之冤，为了免进地牢，只得把所有家当交给治安官 | 村庄被烧成白地，他也成了难民 | 与兄弟大打出手后，他被逐出了家门 | 他没什么本事，也没什么志向 | 在领主的地牢里被锁在墙上熬过无数年后，他终于重获自由 | 一个神秘教派许诺救赎他不朽的灵魂，他便交出了全部财产 | 他原本聪明过人，直到强盗朝他脑袋上狠狠来了一下}，{%name%就这样流落街头， | %name%被迫流落街头，}{只能乞求别人施舍一口面包 | 靠旁人的善心度日 | 挨了打也只能认命 | 把仅有的几个钱拿去买酒，终日浑浑噩噩 | 翻捡别人的垃圾，一见差役就仓皇逃窜 | 一边讨几枚克朗，一边躲着恶棍和地痞}。{他似乎真心想当佣兵，可毫无疑问，街头的岁月已经耗尽了%name%最好的年华。 | 经年累月的流浪，已经拖垮了他的身子。 | 像%name%这样的人，在街头熬上几天就会觉得，哪怕是危机四伏的佣兵生涯，也算得上一条康庄大道，更何况他熬了几年。 | 只有诸神知道%name%为活下来做过什么。如今站在你面前的，只是个虚弱的男人。 | 一看见你，他便起身张开双臂，想给你一个拥抱，还说早年与你相识甚深，一同经历过许多冒险，只是一时想不起你的名字。}

eb6f86d2c59fcb933d6a.source: {After losing everything to a fire | After his gambling addiction got the better of him | Framed for a crime he didn't commit, and having to pay the constable everything to keep himself out of the dungeons | A refugee after his village was burned to the ground | Banished from his home after a violent struggle with his brother | A man with few talents and no ambition | After being released from a dungeon where he spent countless years chained to a wall | After giving all his worldly possessions to an obscure cult promising salvation of his eternal soul | A very intelligent man until a brigand knocked him over the head}, {%name% found himself on the streets, | %name% was forced onto the streets,} {having to beg for bread | depending on the goodwill of others | being beaten and resigned to his fate | spending what little coin he had to drink the days away | digging into the trash of others and scurrying away from lawmen | avoiding ruffians and thugs while he begged for crowns}. {While he seems earnest in becoming a mercenary, there is little doubt that all his time on the street have robbed %name% of his best years. | Years have passed and took a toll on his health by now. | Once a man like %name% has spent a few days on the streets, much less a few years, even the very dangerous job of being a sellsword seems like the greenest of pastures. | Only the gods know what %name% has done to survive, but he is a frail man standing before you now. | At the sight of you he rises with open arms to embrace you, claiming to know you well from years past and many a shared adventure, although your name escapes him at the moment.}
eb6f86d2c59fcb933d6a.translation: {一场大火夺走了他的一切 | 赌瘾最终毁了他的生活 | 他蒙受不白之冤，为了免进地牢，只得把所有家当交给治安官 | 村庄被烧成白地，他也成了难民 | 与兄弟大打出手后，他被逐出了家门 | 他没什么本事，也没什么志向 | 在地牢里被锁在墙上熬过无数年后，他终于重获自由 | 一个神秘教派许诺救赎他不朽的灵魂，他便交出了全部财产 | 他原本聪明过人，直到强盗朝他脑袋上狠狠来了一下}，{%name%就这样流落街头， | %name%被迫流落街头，}{只能乞求别人施舍一口面包 | 靠旁人的善心度日 | 挨了打也只能认命 | 把仅有的几个钱拿去买酒，终日浑浑噩噩 | 翻捡别人的垃圾，一见差役就仓皇逃窜 | 一边讨几枚克朗，一边躲着恶棍和地痞}。{他似乎真心想当佣兵，可毫无疑问，街头的岁月已经耗尽了%name%最好的年华。 | 经年累月的流浪，已经拖垮了他的身子。 | 像%name%这样的人，在街头熬上几天就会觉得，哪怕是危机四伏的佣兵生涯，也算得上一条康庄大道，更何况他熬了几年。 | 只有诸神知道%name%为活下来做过什么。如今站在你面前的，只是个虚弱的男人。 | 一看见你，他便起身张开双臂，想给你一个拥抱，还说早年与你相识甚深，一同经历过许多冒险，只是一时想不起你的名字。}

0e06b41efea7d62f8f00.source: %name% the southern belly dancer left the company in good time. While his... particularities made him an excellent soldier, it was not his life's passion. To entertain, through rhythmic, confusingly erotic motions, that is what he's wanted. The last you heard, he was in the court of a Vizier where he serves not only as an entertainer, but, thanks to his time with the %companyname%, also as an adviser on marital matters.
0e06b41efea7d62f8f00.translation: 南方的肚皮舞者%name%在合适的时候离开了战团。虽然他的那些……独特之处让他成了一名出色的士兵，但这并非他毕生的热爱。他真正想做的，是用富有节奏、令人心神荡漾又不知所措的舞姿取悦观众。最近听说，他进了某位维齐尔的宫廷，不仅负责献艺，还凭着在%companyname%积累的阅历，兼任婚姻顾问。

83fa639cf067cb0f7838.source: As the company failed to achieve the success you had hoped for, many departed its ranks. The southern belly dancer %name% joined them. Unfortunately, he sought to ply his trade in the north, thinking he may be able to spread his culture there. The indigenous population was quick to accuse him of 'unregulated body sorcery' and burn him at the stake.
83fa639cf067cb0f7838.translation: 战团未能取得你期望的成就，许多人先后离去，南方的肚皮舞者%name%也在其中。可惜，他想在北方重操旧业，以为能在那里传播自己的文化。当地人却很快指控他施展“未经许可的肉身妖术”，将他绑上火刑柱烧死了。

e594d53e9b1d041d0530.source: Bowyers tend to have some knowledge about how to use the ranged weaponry they used to craft.
e594d53e9b1d041d0530.translation: 制弓匠对自己亲手打造的远程武器，通常也懂得如何使用。

c7a60458840b1f81ff87.source: While at a jousting tournament, a young boy was using an oddly shaped, yet perfectly crafted bow. His aiming hand was shaky, yet the arrows did not wobble upon being loosed. After he won the competition, you inquired about where the boy had gotten such an incredible bow. He stated that a bowyer by the name of %name% had crafted it. Apparently, he's known for making the finest bows in all the land!
c7a60458840b1f81ff87.translation: 你在一次比武大会上看见一个少年，手持一张形状古怪、做工却极为精良的弓。他拉弓瞄准时手在发抖，射出的箭却稳得惊人。少年赢得比赛后，你问他从哪儿得来这么好的弓。他说，这张弓出自一位名叫%name%的制弓匠。据说那人打造的弓，已经冠绝各地！

1b0830cf07d58c280b56.source: After you left the %companyname%, you sent a letter inquiring about the status of %name% the bowyer. You got word that he had discovered a way to craft the finest bow possible and, instead of giving this secret to the company, he departed to start his own business. He did not get far: whatever he had learned about his trade died with him on a muddy road out {north | south | west | east} of here, his body ironically skewered with what is said to have been a dozen arrows.
1b0830cf07d58c280b56.translation: 离开%companyname%后，你写信打听制弓匠%name%的近况。听说他钻研出了打造极品弓的诀窍，却没将秘密传给战团，而是离队自立门户。可他没走多远，就死在此地{北面 | 南面 | 西面 | 东面}的一条泥泞道路上，手艺的秘密也随他而去。讽刺的是，据说他的尸体上插着足足一打箭。

6f9bcd48136d83cabc4d.source: {With calloused hands and an eye for thin strings, | Born to a blacksmith, it's definitely somewhat curious that | Picking up his trade from a long lineage of strong-sighted forefathers,} %name% is a fletcher and bowyer. {Plying his trade for royalty, his career came to an end when a bowstring snapped, cutting off the finger of a promising heir. | Unfortunately, war destroyed the forests from which he used to draw the finest wood. | Sadly, he sold a bow to a young boy which led to a horrible, arrow-related accident. After much debate, he was no longer wanted in town. | But after so many years of making weapons for others, he began to wonder what else there was to life besides wood and string.} {Now, %name% seeks a different path. If he can't sell bows, maybe he can use them. | Now %name% rests in the company of the very men he used to supply. | With his interest in bowmaking gone, can the former bowyer shoot arrows as well as he makes them?}
6f9bcd48136d83cabc4d.translation: {双手布满老茧，对细弦的品质一眼便能分辨， | 出身铁匠之家，却走上了另一条颇有意思的路， | 从世代眼力过人的祖辈手中继承了这门手艺，}%name%以制箭和造弓为生。{他曾为王室制作弓箭，直到一根断裂的弓弦割掉了一位前途无量的继承人的手指，他的生意也就此到头。 | 不幸的是，战争毁掉了为他提供上好木材的森林。 | 遗憾的是，他卖给一个少年的弓酿成了严重的射箭事故。镇民争论许久，最终决定不再欢迎他。 | 为别人造了这么多年武器，他开始想知道，木头和弓弦之外还有怎样的人生。}{如今，%name%想另寻出路。卖不了弓，也许还可以亲自用弓。 | 如今，%name%已与那些曾向他购买武器的人并肩谋生。 | 制弓的兴致已经消退，这位昔日工匠射箭的本事，能否赶得上造箭的手艺？}

c6d8c15b14497c02eaa7.source: Brawlers are unmatched in unarmed combat, and physical exercise tends to leave them in good shape.
c6d8c15b14497c02eaa7.translation: 拳师精于徒手格斗，长期锻炼也让他们身体强健。

abfa888605ed23106b11.source: A brawler like %name% is dangerous with just his fists, and proved himself similarly savage with weapons. Before you left the %companyname%, you talked to the fighter about whether or not he'd stay in the band. He said he had no desire to return to prizefighting, shook your hand, and thanked you for giving him the opportunity. Last you heard, the company chose him for a one-on-one, winner take all fight to settle compensation differences with a competing mercenary band. He won in the first round.
abfa888605ed23106b11.translation: 像%name%这样的拳师，赤手空拳就足够危险，拿起武器也同样凶悍。离开%companyname%前，你问他是否愿意继续留在战团。他说自己不想再回去打赏金拳赛，握住你的手，感谢你给了他这个机会。最近听说，战团与另一支佣兵队伍为了报酬起了争执，便推举他出面单挑，胜者拿走全部。他第一回合就赢了。

08a6470166cd1764ad94.source: %name% the brawler left the company when it became clear it would soon dissolve and probably end up killing everyone who stayed onboard. He returned to prizefighting, grinding out the following years in brutal, weekly bouts. As he got older, his chin disappeared, as did his speed and power. He was left jobbing, intentionally taking falls and losing badly when he didn't. Eventually, no one would give him a fight. A nobleman offered him a large sum to wrestle a bear and the desperate %name% took him up on it. When the 'fight' was over, the brawler lay dead, mangled beyond recognition, being dragged around the mud by a ferocious beast as drunken highborn cheered and clapped.
08a6470166cd1764ad94.translation: 眼见战团即将解散，再留下去恐怕连命都保不住，拳师%name%选择了离开。他重新打起赏金拳赛，往后的几年都耗在每周一场的残酷搏斗中。随着年岁增长，他越来越不经打，速度和力量也渐渐衰退。他只能充当垫场的败将，故意倒地；偶尔认真打，又会输得更惨。最后，再也没人肯安排他上场。一位贵族出重金让他与熊摔跤，走投无路的%name%答应了。所谓的“比赛”结束时，他已经死去，尸体支离破碎，被凶兽拖着在泥地里打转，醉醺醺的权贵却还在欢呼鼓掌。

6643bb93ba2f99a2b2bc.source: {Burly and with churchbells for fists, %name% has spent much of the past year sharpening his boxing skills on the grindstone that is his fellow man. | With a face contorted to the shapes of others' knuckles, it's not hard to realize that %name% is a career fighter. | %name% loves the drink as much as he does a good fight, a potent combination. | A hard upbringing by his father and brothers honed %name% into being a temperamental fighter. | Bullies in %name%'s spriteful youth forged him into a man that prefers to seek out a fight rather than wait for it to come to him.  | %name% only ever had one real talent: using his fists to bloody the noses of other men and not going down no matter what. | Growing up, %name% wrestled bulls on the family farm. Unfortunately for men, he found time to venture into the cities.} {For the past year he has been employed by a local lord, paraded around to fistfight the champions of royalty. | A lover of the bar brawl, the man has apparently been banned from too many taverns to count. | Gaining notoriety as a fighter in %randomtown% meant he had to fight every single proud, boasting, and drunk man who came his way. | Although he became an undefeated prizefighter, he was hardly earning enough to get by. | Fiery in spirit, he's always willing to take up fisticuffs. Local fighting rings say he's got a mean left hook.} {Hearing of greater fights to be had, %name% has put down his mitts to take up the more lucrative vocation of being a sellsword. | Only one person has bested %name%: his wife. After she chided him for being an embarrassment with no ambition, he decided to take up the more 'prestigious' field of mercenary work. | Years of martial combat practically destroyed his memory. Some think he mistook a mercenary camp as an item on his shopping list. | Very low on crowns and barely able to open his broken hands to hug his own son much less throw a punch, %name% seeks a new career. | After years of hardship, the promise of regular pay for mercenary work is a tempting offer for him, even though he has little idea of actual warfare. | This man could murder a rock and injure a stone - a good addition to any outfit.}
6643bb93ba2f99a2b2bc.translation: {%name%身材魁梧，一双拳头大如教堂的铜钟，过去一年大多拿别人的血肉当磨刀石，打磨自己的拳技。 | %name%的脸早已被各式拳头打得变了形，一看就是吃搏斗这碗饭的。 | %name%既爱酒又爱打架，这两样凑在一起可不得了。 | 父亲和兄弟严酷的管教，把%name%磨成了脾气暴躁的斗士。 | 年少时受尽欺凌，让%name%养成了主动找人打架的习惯，不愿再等着麻烦找上门。  | %name%只有一项真正的本事：把别人的鼻子打得鲜血直流，自己却无论如何也不倒下。 | %name%从小就在家里的农场与公牛角力。对城里人来说，不幸的是，他后来抽得出空进城了。}{过去一年，他受雇于当地领主，被带到各处，与贵族豢养的好手比拳。 | 他酷爱酒馆斗殴，禁止他入内的酒馆据说已经多得数不清。 | 在%randomtown%打出名气，也意味着沿途每个自负、好吹牛又喝醉的家伙都会找他挑战。 | 他虽成了未尝败绩的赏金拳师，挣的钱却仍只够勉强糊口。 | 他性烈如火，随时愿意挥拳相向。当地拳场的人都说，他的左勾拳狠得很。}{听说还有更大的仗可打，%name%便放下拳套，改干更赚钱的佣兵行当。 | 只有一个人制得住%name%：他的妻子。被她骂作胸无大志、丢人现眼之后，他决定去干更“体面”的佣兵活。 | 常年搏斗几乎毁掉了他的记性。有人怀疑，他是把佣兵营地误认成了买东西时该去的地方。 | %name%口袋里没剩几个克朗，伤得变形的双手连张开抱儿子都难，更别提挥拳，于是他想换条生路。 | 多年困顿之后，佣兵定期发薪的承诺很有诱惑力，尽管他几乎不懂真正的战争。 | 这人连岩石都能打死、石头都能打伤，哪支队伍都用得上这样的好手。}

e24fa67f65b859d3d9d9.source: Mercenary work is a bloody business, which is probably why a butcher like %name% felt right at home in it. While an outstanding fighter, you hear that he still has problems with the war dogs in the party and has been repeatedly caught trying to slaughter them. Eventually, if not desperately, the company gave the man an adorable puppy to raise as his own. From what you know of, the little runt's glowy doe eyes converted the dog hater into a lover. Now he goes into an insatiable bloodlust whenever a wardog is harmed and his little mongrel grew up to be the fiercest beast in the company!
e24fa67f65b859d3d9d9.translation: 佣兵干的是血腥营生，或许正因如此，屠夫%name%做起来才格外得心应手。尽管他是一名出色的战士，你却听说他始终和战团里的战犬过不去，好几次想宰了它们，都被逮个正着。最后，战团大概也是实在没辙，索性送了他一只可爱的小狗，让他自己养。据你所知，小家伙那双水汪汪的大眼睛，竟把这个讨厌狗的家伙变成了爱狗之人。如今，只要有战犬受伤，他就会杀红了眼，怎么也停不下来。而他那只小杂种狗，也长成了战团里最凶猛的野兽！

d35959602beb28812108.source: %name% the butcher eventually left the declining company. He joined up with another outfit, but was caught slaughtering one of their war dogs. Apparently, he had been feeding the mercenaries dogmeat from all their mongrels that had gone 'missing'. They did not take this news kindly, stripped the butcher, and fed him to the beasts.
d35959602beb28812108.translation: 屠夫%name%最终离开了日渐衰败的战团，加入另一支队伍，却在宰杀他们的战犬时被逮个正着。原来那些“失踪”的杂种狗，都被他做成了佣兵们的饭菜。众人闻讯大怒，将屠夫剥光，喂给了野兽。

694ea9072d5c2acae833.source: {After his father's death, %name% took over the family butcher shop in %randomtown%. | Growing up poor, %name% quickly learned to kill and strip animals, eventually founding a butcher's shop. | With droughts ruining the farmlands, %name%'s butcher shop took off in %randomtown%. | Always a strange boy, %name% took to butchering not only for profit, but for pleasure. | Grinning ear to ear, %name% never looked so happy as when his shop opened and he got his first order of live pigs in stock. | As a butcher, %name% has spent years squishing guts out of dead rabbits and lopping heads off sometimes-dead fish.} {But rumors of animal torture eventually drove the cleaver-swinger from his business. | Given the terrible rumors of dark arts already going around, it wasn't long until people began questioning the source of his meats and drove him out of business. | But killing animals, for one reason or another, didn't quite excite him anymore. He sought something new. | After a human finger was found in one of his deer wrappings, the man was driven from his business. | Some say he most enjoyed butchering for soldiers during the orc invasions and wishes to return to that experience once more. | Unfortunately, the war drove through his shop, leaving behind a number of carcasses he wouldn't dare butcher. | Living in a city under siege, he provided meat for the hungry. When it was found out where that meat came from, he was handed over to the besiegers who, unwittingly, let him live. | The man's friendliness with poachers caught up with him, ultimately leaving him on the road with a retinue of the local lords's men on his tail. | Butchering a tiny pig became a scandal when it turned out to be a nobleman's pet. He fled to save his own bacon.} {Something about blood and guts sits just right with %name%. In that case, welcome to the battlefield. | %name% looks at everything as a potential meat sale with breathing, moving packaging. | Many are disturbed by %name%'s mere presence and all-too-wide eyes. | %name% is known to bite his tongue and savor the blood. | %name%'s ears perk whenever a pig squeals. The same thing happens when a man screams. Interesting. | %name%'s a butcher, but apparently has little interest in actually feeding the outfit.}
694ea9072d5c2acae833.translation: {父亲去世后，%name%接手了家里位于%randomtown%的肉铺。 | %name%自幼贫苦，很早便学会了宰杀牲畜、剥皮剔肉，后来开了间肉铺。 | 干旱毁了农田，%name%在%randomtown%的肉铺生意却蒸蒸日上。 | %name%从小就是个怪孩子。他当屠夫，既为挣钱，也为取乐。 | 肉铺开张、第一批活猪送到时，%name%笑得合不拢嘴，你从没见他这么高兴过。 | 当了多年屠夫，%name%早已习惯挤出死兔子的内脏，或是一刀剁下鱼头——有时鱼已经死了，有时还没有。}{然而，虐待动物的传闻最终让这个挥着菜刀的家伙丢了生意。 | 黑魔法的骇人传闻早已四处流传，没过多久，人们便开始质疑他的肉从何而来，最终逼得他关了门。 | 可不知为何，宰杀牲畜已不再让他兴奋。他想找些新鲜的事做。 | 有人在他包好的鹿肉里发现了一根人的手指，他也因此被赶出了这一行。 | 有人说，兽人入侵时替士兵宰牲供肉，才是他最怀念的日子，他还想再体验一次。 | 可惜战火席卷了肉铺，只留下几具连他都不敢下刀的尸体。 | 城池被围时，他曾为饥饿的居民供肉。后来肉的来源败露，他被交给了围城的敌军。对方不知内情，竟饶了他一命。 | 他与偷猎者过从甚密，终于惹祸上身，只得逃上大路，身后还跟着当地领主的一队追兵。 | 他宰了一头小猪，却不料那是某位贵族的宠物，顿时闹得满城风雨。为了保住自己的皮肉，他赶紧逃了。}{血和内脏似乎总能让%name%心满意足。既然如此，欢迎来到战场。 | 在%name%眼里，万物都像是待价而沽的肉，只不过外头的包装还会喘气、会走路。 | 光是%name%站在那里，瞪着那双睁得过大的眼睛，就能让许多人浑身不自在。 | 据说%name%喜欢咬破自己的舌头，细细品尝血味。 | 只要猪一嚎，%name%就会竖起耳朵。人惨叫时也一样。有意思。 | %name%虽是屠夫，却似乎对给战团供肉毫无兴趣。}

c9db82c9058153c72b82.source: {After his father's death, %name% took over the family butcher shop in %randomtown%. | Growing up poor, %name% quickly learned to kill and strip animals, eventually founding a butcher's shop. | With droughts ruining the farmlands, %name%'s butcher shop took off in %randomcitystate%. | Always a strange boy, %name% took to butchering not only for profit, but for pleasure. | Grinning ear to ear, %name% never looked so happy as when his shop opened and he got his first order of live pigs in stock. | As a butcher, %name% has spent years squishing guts out of dead rabbits and lopping heads off sometimes-dead fish.} {But rumors of animal torture eventually drove the cleaver-swinger from his business. | Given the terrible rumors of dark arts already going around, it wasn't long until people began questioning the source of his meats and drove him out of business. | But killing animals, for one reason or another, didn't quite excite him anymore. He sought something new. | After a human finger was found in one of his deer wrappings, the man was driven from his business. | Some say he most enjoyed butchering for the viziers' men during one of their campaigns against the desert tribes and wishes to return to that experience once more. | Unfortunately, the war drove through his shop, leaving behind a number of carcasses he wouldn't dare butcher. | Butchering a tiny pig became a scandal when it turned out to be a nobleman's pet. He fled to save his own bacon.} {Something about blood and guts sits just right with %name%. In that case, welcome to the battlefield. | %name% looks at everything as a potential meat sale with breathing, moving packaging. | Many are disturbed by %name%'s mere presence and all-too-wide eyes. | %name% is known to bite his tongue and savor the blood. | %name%'s ears perk whenever a pig squeals. The same thing happens when a man screams. Interesting. | %name%'s a butcher, but apparently has little interest in actually feeding the outfit.}
c9db82c9058153c72b82.translation: {父亲去世后，%name%接手了家里位于%randomtown%的肉铺。 | %name%自幼贫苦，很早便学会了宰杀牲畜、剥皮剔肉，后来开了间肉铺。 | 干旱毁了农田，%name%在%randomcitystate%的肉铺生意却蒸蒸日上。 | %name%从小就是个怪孩子。他当屠夫，既为挣钱，也为取乐。 | 肉铺开张、第一批活猪送到时，%name%笑得合不拢嘴，你从没见他这么高兴过。 | 当了多年屠夫，%name%早已习惯挤出死兔子的内脏，或是一刀剁下鱼头——有时鱼已经死了，有时还没有。}{然而，虐待动物的传闻最终让这个挥着菜刀的家伙丢了生意。 | 黑魔法的骇人传闻早已四处流传，没过多久，人们便开始质疑他的肉从何而来，最终逼得他关了门。 | 可不知为何，宰杀牲畜已不再让他兴奋。他想找些新鲜的事做。 | 有人在他包好的鹿肉里发现了一根人的手指，他也因此被赶出了这一行。 | 有人说，在维齐尔们征讨沙漠部族的一次战役中替军队宰牲供肉，才是他最怀念的日子，他还想再体验一次。 | 可惜战火席卷了肉铺，只留下几具连他都不敢下刀的尸体。 | 他宰了一头小猪，却不料那是某位贵族的宠物，顿时闹得满城风雨。为了保住自己的皮肉，他赶紧逃了。}{血和内脏似乎总能让%name%心满意足。既然如此，欢迎来到战场。 | 在%name%眼里，万物都像是待价而沽的肉，只不过外头的包装还会喘气、会走路。 | 光是%name%站在那里，瞪着那双睁得过大的眼睛，就能让许多人浑身不自在。 | 据说%name%喜欢咬破自己的舌头，细细品尝血味。 | 只要猪一嚎，%name%就会竖起耳朵。人惨叫时也一样。有意思。 | %name%虽是屠夫，却似乎对给战团供肉毫无兴趣。}

b32c05eda6dcd9a2b401.source: Caravan hands are used to long and exhausting travels.
b32c05eda6dcd9a2b401.translation: 商队伙计早已习惯漫长而疲惫的旅途。

ef0f115b525c4851479e.source: %name% the once-caravan hand retired from fighting. He used his mercenary money to start a trade-guarding business that specializes in transporting goods through dangerous lands.
ef0f115b525c4851479e.translation: 曾当过商队伙计的%name%退出了战斗。他用当佣兵攒下的钱开办了护运生意，专门将货物送过危险地区。

0a620a685ae93b31f85f.source: %name% the caravan hand retired back into guarding trade wagons. He died when defending against an ambush by brigands. They took his shirt and left his body in a ditch.
0a620a685ae93b31f85f.translation: 商队伙计%name%退役后，重新干起了护送货车的老本行。他在抵挡强盗伏击时战死。强盗扒走他的衣服，把尸体丢在路旁的沟里。

44fd43931005124bd4e6.source: {Always the adventurous type, %name% was easily drawn to the life of a caravan hand. | Orphaned by war and pestilence, %name% grew up under the wings of a traveling merchant. | A caravan hand's life is tough, but %name% could hardly stand staying in one place for too long. | Though the work is dangerous, being a caravan hand allowed %name% to see the world. | When his family and obligations were destroyed by fire, %name% saw no reason not to join a passing caravan. | Hardy and resolute, %name% was the first chosen by a merchant to protect his stock as a caravan hand. | Running away from home, it didn't long for %name% to join and eventually work for a caravan.} {But the trader he worked for turned out to be abusive, nary a whip away from being a slave driver. After an intense argument with the woman, %name% thought it better to leave before he did something awful. | One day, goods went missing and the hand was blamed for it, promptly ending his time with the caravan. | But a caravan needs protection for a reason, and an ambush by brigands proved why. %name% barely made it out alive. | Years on the road went without a hitch until a new caravan master refused to pay %name%. With just one hand the caravanner punched his boss and grabbed his wages. He used both legs to run, though. | Caravans are frequently tense places to be. One fateful evening, in a dispute over gambling debts, he stove in the head of another traveler. Fearing retribution, %name% was gone before morning. | Sadly, with the expanding war the caravan's profits were marginal. %name% was let go as the merchants retired their wagons. | After seeing the foul work of beasts on a fellow caravan, it didn't take long for %name% to figure out his wages didn't quite meet the level of threats around him. | But war deprived the caravan of stock and soon its driver took to selling slaves. Appalled, %name% freed as many as he could before leaving for good. | Sadly, his caravan began to sell human chattel. While the profits were enormous, it garnered the attention of a local militia - and their pitchforks. One ambush later and %name% was running for his life.} {Now uncertain of what to do, he seeks any opportunity that might come by. | A man like %name% is no stranger to danger, making him a good fit for any mercenary group. | With his caravan days behind him, working as a sellsword was just another avenue for adventure and profit. | In %name%'s mind, being a mercenary is a lot like being a caravanner. Just better paid. | Well versed to traveling, %name% seems like a natural fit to the tasks already befit for a mercenary. | Years of road travel have molded %name% into quite the durable figure. Any group of mercenaries could use more men like him.}
44fd43931005124bd4e6.translation: {%name%天生喜爱冒险，很容易就被商队伙计的生活吸引。 | 战争和瘟疫夺走了%name%的双亲，他在一位行商的照拂下长大。 | 商队伙计的日子虽然艰苦，%name%却更受不了在一个地方待得太久。 | 活计虽然危险，当商队伙计却让%name%得以见识世界。 | 大火烧尽了家人，也烧尽了牵挂，%name%便加入一支路过的商队。 | %name%坚韧沉着，被商人第一个挑中，担任护卫货物的商队伙计。 | 离家出走没多久，%name%就跟上了一支商队，后来也开始替他们干活。}{可雇用他的女商人十分苛刻，只差手里没有鞭子，就与奴隶主无异。激烈争吵过后，%name%决定趁自己还没做出什么可怕的事，赶紧离开。 | 有一天货物丢失，罪责落到了他头上，他的商队生涯也随之告终。 | 商队需要护卫自有道理，一次强盗伏击便证明了这一点。%name%好不容易才捡回一条命。 | 多年来行路平安无事，直到新商队主人拒付%name%的工钱。他用一只手揍了老板、拿回工资，逃跑时倒是用上了两条腿。 | 商队里常常气氛紧绷。某个倒霉的夜晚，他因赌债争执打破了另一名旅人的脑袋。害怕报复的%name%没等天亮就溜走了。 | 遗憾的是，战火日渐蔓延，商队利润所剩无几。商人收起了货车，也辞退了%name%。 | 见过另一支商队被野兽撕碎后的惨状，%name%很快就明白，那点工钱远远抵不上身边的风险。 | 战争使商队无货可卖，赶车的人很快改行贩奴。震惊的%name%尽可能放走了奴隶，从此一去不返。 | 遗憾的是，他的商队开始买卖人口。暴利招来了当地民兵的注意，也招来了他们的草叉。一场伏击过后，%name%只顾得上逃命。}{眼下他还拿不定主意，只想抓住任何谋生机会。 | %name%这样的人早已见惯危险，放在哪支佣兵队伍里都很合适。 | 商队的日子已经过去，当佣兵不过是另一条冒险赚钱的路。 | 在%name%看来，佣兵和商队伙计差不多，只是工钱更高。 | %name%惯于奔波行旅，做起佣兵的活计似乎正合适。 | 多年的道路生涯把%name%磨成了一个耐劳的汉子，哪支战团都不嫌这样的人多。}

d7bbedd8c2f3dca6da1a.source: {Always the adventurous type, %name% was easily drawn to the life of a caravan hand. | Orphaned by war and pestilence, %name% grew up under the wings of a traveling merchant. | A caravan hand's life is tough, but %name% could hardly stand staying in one place for too long. | Though the work is dangerous, being a caravan hand allowed %name% to see the world. | When his family and obligations were destroyed by fire, %name% saw no reason not to join a passing caravan. | Hardy and resolute, %name% was the first chosen by a merchant to protect his stock as a caravan hand. | Running away from home, it didn't long for %name% to join and eventually work for a caravan.} {But the trader he worked for turned out to be abusive, nary a whip away from being a slave driver. After an intense argument with the woman, %name% thought it better to leave before he did something awful. | One day, goods went missing and the hand was blamed for it, promptly ending his time with the caravan. | But a caravan needs protection for a reason, and an ambush by desert raiders proved why. %name% barely made it out alive. | Years on the road went without a hitch until a new caravan master refused to pay %name%. With just one hand the caravanner punched his boss and grabbed his wages. He used both legs to run, though. | Caravans are frequently tense places to be. One fateful evening, in a dispute over gambling debts, he stove in the head of another traveler. Fearing retribution, %name% was gone before morning. | Sadly, with the expanding war the caravan's profits were marginal. %name% was let go as the merchants retired their wagons. | After seeing the foul work of beasts on a fellow caravan, it didn't take long for %name% to figure out his wages didn't quite meet the level of threats around him. | But war deprived the caravan of stock and soon its driver took to selling slaves. Appalled, %name% freed as many as he could before leaving for good. | Sadly, his caravan began to sell human chattel. While the profits were enormous, it garnered the attention of a local militia - and their pitchforks. One ambush later and %name% was running for his life.} {Now uncertain of what to do, he seeks any opportunity that might come by. | A man like %name% is no stranger to danger, making him a good fit for any mercenary group. | With his caravan days behind him, working as a sellsword was just another avenue for adventure and profit. | In %name%'s mind, being a mercenary is a lot like being a caravanner. Just better paid. | Well versed to traveling, %name% seems like a natural fit to the tasks already befit for a mercenary. | Years of road travel have molded %name% into quite the durable figure. Any group of mercenaries could use more men like him.}
d7bbedd8c2f3dca6da1a.translation: {%name%生性爱冒险，很容易便被商队护卫的生活吸引。 | 战争和瘟疫夺走了%name%的双亲，他在一名行商的照料下长大。 | 商队护卫的日子虽苦，%name%却更受不了长久待在同一个地方。 | 护卫商队固然危险，却也让%name%得以见识天下。 | 大火吞噬了家人，也烧尽了他的牵挂，%name%便觉得没理由不加入一支路过的商队。 | %name%坚韧果决，商人挑选护卫时，第一个便选中了他，托他保护货物。 | %name%离家出走后，没过多久便跟上了一支商队，最后成了其中的护卫。}{可他效力的商人却是个苛刻暴虐的女人，手里只差一根鞭子，就和奴隶监工没什么两样了。一次激烈争吵后，%name%觉得还是赶紧走为妙，免得自己做出什么可怕的事。 | 一天，商队丢了货物，罪名落到他头上，他的护卫生涯也随之结束。 | 商队需要护卫总是有原因的，一场沙漠掠夺者的伏击便说明了一切。%name%险些没能活着逃出来。 | 多年的行商路一直顺风顺水，直到新来的商队头领拒绝给%name%发工钱。他一只手便揍了老板、夺回了自己的工钱；不过，逃跑时还是用上了两条腿。 | 商队里时常气氛紧张。在一个改变命运的夜晚，他因赌债与人争执，砸烂了另一名旅人的脑袋。担心遭到报复，%name%没等天亮就走了。 | 可惜，战火不断蔓延，商队的利润也所剩无几。商人们封存了货车，%name%便失了业。 | 亲眼见过另一支商队被野兽蹂躏后的惨状，%name%很快就明白，自己这点工钱根本不值沿途的危险。 | 战争让商队无货可卖，赶车人很快便做起了贩奴生意。%name%大为震惊，尽可能放走了一些奴隶，随后彻底离开了商队。 | 可惜，他的商队开始贩卖人口。这门生意利润惊人，却也招来了当地民兵——还有他们手里的草叉。一场伏击过后，%name%只能夺路逃命。}{如今他不知道该做什么，任何送上门的机会都想试一试。 | %name%这样的人早已见惯危险，放进哪支佣兵队伍都合适。 | 商队生涯已经结束，当佣兵不过是另一条冒险挣钱的路。 | 在%name%看来，当佣兵和护卫商队差不多，无非是酬劳更高。 | %name%惯于长途跋涉，佣兵的种种差事似乎天生就适合他。 | 多年的奔波将%name%磨炼得相当结实耐劳。这样的汉子，哪支佣兵队伍都不会嫌多。}

3898807f3f169b024db1.source: He was with you from the start, %name%, and he was with you in retirement, leaving the company not long after you did. But he wasn't yet done with the fighting life and took up fighting for another company - his own. Having learned so much from your leadership, he is making you about as proud as any son could.
