51ddf3c9bd0009ef5a1e.translation:
[/color]回合后消退。

角色的决心越高，抵抗魅惑的几率越高。

f8bc7e249d425ad55c0a.source: This character has been chilled to the bone by cold. With their limbs frozen stiff, it takes a great deal of effort to move in a coordinated fashion. The effect will slowly wear off over [color=
f8bc7e249d425ad55c0a.translation: 此角色被冻得寒气入骨，四肢僵硬，连协调身体动作都十分费力。效果还将持续[color=

5a835422d8a5619caec1.source: is unaffected by the cold thanks to his unnatural physiology
5a835422d8a5619caec1.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质抵御了严寒

a5bf247eef3b71a1990b.source: This character has received so heavy a blow that they are dazed, confused and gasping for air. Will wear off in [color=
a5bf247eef3b71a1990b.translation: 此角色遭受了沉重的打击，头昏眼花、神志恍惚，只能大口喘气。效果还将持续[color=

b5156abfa6c4b2ebaa13.source: shook off being dazed thanks to his unnatural physiology
b5156abfa6c4b2ebaa13.translation: 因异于常人的体质而摆脱恍惚

8eb0c1ffc73c520cdee1.source: This character has a debilitating attack prepared. Hitting a target will temporarily reduce their ability to inflict damage for one turn. Missing the attack will waste the effect.
8eb0c1ffc73c520cdee1.translation: 此角色已准备好一记削弱打击。命中后将降低目标造成的伤害，持续一回合；攻击落空则效果作废。

fb49344faacfc089f857.source: ]-50%[/color] Damage inflicted by target hit for one turn
fb49344faacfc089f857.translation: ]-50%[/color]目标造成的伤害，命中后生效，持续一回合

fcef9d2411c6b7829d28.source: This character's muscles have mutated and respond differently to movement impulses. It is much less fatiguing to interrupt or stop mid-motion as a consequence, making it much easier to recover from errant or blocked attacks.
fcef9d2411c6b7829d28.translation: 此角色的肌肉发生了变异，对运动信号的反应方式随之改变。中途收势或停下动作所需的力气大幅减少，因此攻击落空或受阻后也更容易缓过劲来。

59f8c20cb10a4099e1c9.source: This character has been temporarily disarmed for [color=
59f8c20cb10a4099e1c9.translation: 此角色被缴械，暂时无法使用任何武器技能。效果还将持续[color=

cc262eb55ebbc990322d.source: [/color] more turn(s) and is unable to use any weapon skills. Switching to a different weapon will remove this effect immediately.
cc262eb55ebbc990322d.translation: [/color]回合；更换武器可立即解除此效果。

93894f150cbd9a05f25c.source: quickly recovers from being disarmed thanks to his unnatural physiology
93894f150cbd9a05f25c.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质迅速摆脱了缴械状态

c176b89c60e5b5218509.source: This character was on the receiving end of a dirty trick. Distracted for [color=
c176b89c60e5b5218509.translation: 此角色中了卑鄙的伎俩，注意力受到干扰。效果将持续[color=

cef587150a813564dc2a.source: [/color] more turn(s), they are slower to react and have a harder time landing clean strikes.
cef587150a813564dc2a.translation: [/color] 个回合内，他们反应迟缓，更难打出准确的攻击。

25494b41fcb236b2aa83.source: regained his focus thanks to his unnatural physiology
25494b41fcb236b2aa83.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质重新集中了注意力

b24e92179f845431d397.source: Quick reflexes allow this character to add part of their current initiative to melee and ranged defense.
b24e92179f845431d397.translation: 敏捷的反应让此角色能将当前先攻的一部分转化为近战和远程防御。

45f54f344097816a4626.source: Having just landed a hit, this character is ready to perform a powerful followup strike! The next attack will inflict [color=
45f54f344097816a4626.translation: 刚刚命中一击，此角色已准备好乘势追击！下一次攻击将获得[color=

4d0b81116010e1c19d10.source: ]+20%[/color] damage to a single target. If multiple targets are hit, only the first one will receive increased damage. If the attack misses, the effect is wasted.
4d0b81116010e1c19d10.translation: ]+20%[/color]单体伤害加成。若攻击命中多个目标，仅对第一个目标生效；攻击落空则效果作废。

e3c3cb6fa946f1f96e46.source: This character's body reacts to physical trauma, secreting a calciferous substance that causes their muscles to reflexively sieze and contract at points of impact to minimize muscle damage.
e3c3cb6fa946f1f96e46.translation: 此角色的身体会在受到外力创伤时分泌含钙物质，令受击处的肌肉反射性地紧绷收缩，尽量减轻肌肉损伤。

8ada1096344a04e21bc0.source: This character accumulates no Fatigue from enemy attacks, whether they hit or miss
8ada1096344a04e21bc0.translation: 敌人的攻击不会使此角色积累疲劳，无论是否命中

218d0ed3bdceec3145ff.source: This character is able to secrete a substance that vibrates rapidly when stimulated. When applied to weapons, this creates a strong kinetic force that aids in armor penetration.
218d0ed3bdceec3145ff.translation: 此角色能够分泌一种受刺激后迅速振动的物质。将其涂在武器上，便可产生强劲的动能，增强穿透护甲的能力。

7550298ec3139d1b982f.source: This character's legs have been mutated, allowing them to make swift, complex movements more smoothly and with greater rapidity. When at rest, the muscles can still occasionally be seen twitching underneath the skin.
7550298ec3139d1b982f.translation: 此角色的双腿发生了变异，可以更快、更流畅地完成复杂动作。即使静止不动，偶尔也能看见皮肤下的肌肉仍在抽动。

55c41f67996e903e048e.source: This character's eyes have been permanently mutated and are now capable of detecting the subtlest movements of wind and air. While minor on its own, this allows them to better predict the trajectory of projectile attacks and better land hits on vulnerable parts of a target.
55c41f67996e903e048e.translation: 此角色的双眼发生了永久变异，能捕捉风与气流最细微的变化。这能力看似微不足道，却能帮助他更准确地判断飞射物的轨迹，命中目标的要害。

ab6437cf73a2a077a7f4.source: This character has poison running through his veins. His vision is blurred, his speech slurred and it takes a great deal of effort for him to move in a coordinated fashion. The effect will slowly wear off over [color=
ab6437cf73a2a077a7f4.translation: 毒素正在此角色的血液中扩散。他视线模糊、口齿不清，连协调身体动作都十分费力。效果还将持续[color=

baa82933b0d434a52b38.source: When in high stress situations, this character's mutated body produces a slimy, viscous substance and begins sweating it excessively. They'll have a much easier time escaping from any nets or traps in such a state. Just bring a towel.
baa82933b0d434a52b38.translation: 此角色变异的身体在极度紧张时会分泌大量黏滑的液体，像汗水一样不断渗出。此时，无论渔网还是陷阱都更难困住他。记得备条毛巾。

bf42d4d1a4bcde69fa9e.source: Always able to successfully escape from ensnaring effects, such as from nets or roots
bf42d4d1a4bcde69fa9e.translation: 挣脱渔网、根须等缠绕效果时必定成功

2ea90aa9f42c4476443c.source: This character has seen things not meant to be seen and draws upon an experience that is not their own. You can glimpse the unfettered terror on their face in those rare moments you catch them alone. Or maybe that's just the pressures of mercenary life finally getting to them.
2ea90aa9f42c4476443c.translation: 此角色见过不该看见的事物，如今正借用不属于自己的经历。在难得撞见他独处的时候，你会发现他脸上毫不掩饰的恐惧。当然，也许只是佣兵生活的重压终于将他击垮了。

835c750cb1143e576178.source: This character's body has been irreversibly mutated, its chemical balance thrown into chaos by overproducing glands. By some miracle, it seems to have stabilized in a beneficial manner.
835c750cb1143e576178.translation: 此角色的身体发生了不可逆的变异。过度分泌的腺体打破了体内平衡，却奇迹般地以有利于他的方式稳定了下来。

4fe54eaa8687cb2fe375.source: This character has been cursed to feel the same pain and receive the same wounds as another character. Be careful, as it could kill him. The effect will persist for another [color=
4fe54eaa8687cb2fe375.translation: 此角色遭到了诅咒，会承受另一名角色所受的痛苦与伤害。务必小心，这可能要了他的命。效果还将持续[color=

071b65a1b86ac63aaaaa.source: There's something different about this character. Physically they seem unchanged, yet somehow a sense of dread precedes them. Any harm that they endure, on or off the battlefield, seems to affect another nearby. Useful in a fight, annoying in camp, and surely isolating in every day society.
071b65a1b86ac63aaaaa.translation: 此角色有些不一样了。外表并无变化，却总能让人先一步感到不安。无论在战场还是别处，他所受的伤害似乎都会殃及附近另一个人。战斗中倒是有用，在营地里却很烦人，平日更是没人愿意靠近他。

1048971c9b494e229acf.source: 's body has been sprayed with holy water

2ffb13bf37f9888482ac.source: This character's skin and subdermal tissue has mutated and will rapidly stitch itself back together. The effect is most pronounced on small puncture wounds, where the flesh can seal the wound from all directions evenly.
2ffb13bf37f9888482ac.translation: 此角色的皮肤与皮下组织发生了变异，受损后会迅速重新长合。对细小刺伤尤其有效，因为四周的血肉可以同时向伤口中央愈合。

340458f52a3286ab3a6b.translation: 此角色的伤害减免范围为[color=

d775ab828e3f0700a01d.source: This character is horrified and unable to act until next turn.
d775ab828e3f0700a01d.translation: 此角色被恐惧攫住，直到下回合都无法行动。

1491698cd15ac51c2abb.source: resists being frozen with fear thanks to his unnatural physiology
1491698cd15ac51c2abb.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质抵抗了令人僵直的恐惧

d1b173369d82fc30df56.source: When this character's skin is broken, a substance is secreted that drastically quickens the blood clotting process in the area. Bleeding wounds are much less harmful as a result, although some blood loss still occurs.
d1b173369d82fc30df56.translation: 此角色的皮肤破损时，会分泌一种物质，大幅加快伤口附近的凝血过程。因此，流血伤口的危害显著减轻，但仍会损失一些血液。

9cccb41a4c2b46a69925.source: This character's skin has mutated and now forms hard, rock-like patches that are much hardier and difficult to puncture. When broken, these patches will gradually reform in what is apparently a rather painful, uncomfortable process. You should tell them to stop picking at that scab.
9cccb41a4c2b46a69925.translation: 此角色的皮肤发生了变异，长出坚硬如岩石的斑块，更为结实，也更难刺穿。斑块受损后会逐渐重新长成，过程显然相当痛苦难熬。你该提醒他，别再抠那块痂了。

dee8ad1839a73ad89ddb.source: This character's skin is hard and stone-like, granting [color=
dee8ad1839a73ad89ddb.translation: 此角色的皮肤坚硬如岩石，提供[color=

9e3e041d8214ee3f583f.source: There's something wrong with this character. Fits of crazed laughter and muttered tirades aside, their body seems to, at random, reject changes visited upon it. In battle, this has the fortunate effect of letting them sometimes shrug off debilitating effects.
9e3e041d8214ee3f583f.translation: 此角色有些不对劲。除了阵阵狂笑和低声谩骂，他的身体似乎还会不时抗拒外来影响。好在战斗中，这能让他偶尔摆脱令人衰弱的状态。

0ff9334f78d95ee40898.source: This character has gathered all their physical strength and willpower to become indomitable until their next turn.
0ff9334f78d95ee40898.translation: 此角色凝聚了全部体力与意志，在下回合到来前屹立不倒。

006e2a19855d9f3c7fac.source: A thousand black flies buzz around this character, trying to crawl into every small opening of armor, into every orifice of the body. A terrible curse that makes it nigh impossible to fight for [color=
006e2a19855d9f3c7fac.translation: 成千上万只黑蝇在此角色周围嗡嗡盘旋，拼命钻进护甲的缝隙与身体的孔窍。这可怕的诅咒几乎令他无法战斗，效果将持续[color=

e619a269d60eadc5cbb5.source: repels insects with his unnatural physiology
e619a269d60eadc5cbb5.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质驱散了虫群

84927fbf1e8bf12ace6a.source: I feel invincible! Well, feelings may betray this character, but as he doesn't feel any injuries suffered, old or new, he also won't be affected by them until after combat ends and the adrenaline fades.
84927fbf1e8bf12ace6a.translation: 我简直天下无敌！虽然这种感觉未必可靠，但此角色已经感觉不到任何伤痛。无论新伤旧伤，都要等战斗结束、肾上腺素消退后才会重新影响他。

fe76f50318ca30909922.translation: 不受非永久性伤势影响

8068b0ed98e14aa53c13.source: RAAAARGH! This character is on a killing frenzy for [color=
8068b0ed98e14aa53c13.translation: 啊——！此角色陷入了杀戮狂热，效果还将持续[color=

6a32534f67a59589528f.source: [/color] more turn(s). Killing another opponent will refresh the killing frenzy for a 2 turn duration.
6a32534f67a59589528f.translation: [/color]回合。再次击杀敌人会将持续时间重置为2回合。

44e46e783b49116cc761.source: This character is entangled in a giant tentacle, drawing them ever closer to a gaping maw that threatens to devour them whole.
44e46e783b49116cc761.translation: 此角色被巨大的触手缠住，正被一步步拖向那张要将他整个吞下的血盆大口。

f463bf02047a28f61c92.source: This character is entangled in a giant tentacle, drawing them ever closer to a gaping maw that threatens to devour them whole. Each turn, the tentacle threatens to crush them by gripping ever tighter, resulting in the loss of [color=
f463bf02047a28f61c92.translation: 此角色被巨大的触手缠住，正被一步步拖向那张要将他整个吞下的血盆大口。触手每回合都会收得更紧，几乎要将他碾碎，造成[color=

2becb68402189dd05283.source: The character draws strength from some limitless source, with the health and durability of two men. You pretend to not notice the eviscerated corpses you sometimes find in their wake.
2becb68402189dd05283.translation: 此角色正从某个无穷无尽的源头汲取力量，拥有常人两倍的生命力与耐受力。至于偶尔在他经过的地方发现的开膛尸体，你只当没看见。

a20da77126f9e06ddcfc.source: This character's body has changed, arguably for the better, due to the application of an unnatural steroid.
a20da77126f9e06ddcfc.translation: 一种违背自然的类固醇改变了此角色的身体。从某种角度来看，倒算是变好了。

16a56498497641f69463.source: ]10%[/color] of head armor is lost each turn
16a56498497641f69463.translation: ]10%[/color]头部护甲损失，每回合生效一次

e74176ca3ded442152fb.source: ]10%[/color] of body armor is lost each turn
e74176ca3ded442152fb.translation: ]10%[/color]身体护甲损失，每回合生效一次

88caf3ab2cebe615a9e2.source: is unaffected by acid thanks to his unnatural physiology
88caf3ab2cebe615a9e2.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质抵抗了酸液侵蚀

00f92f8a808e360e3e52.source: This character's blood is highly pressurized and burns upon prolonged exposure to air. Attackers who break skin will find themselves unpleasantly surprised by the resultant spray.
00f92f8a808e360e3e52.translation: 此角色体内的血压极高，血液长时间接触空气后会产生灼蚀性。谁若划破他的皮肤，飞溅而出的鲜血便会带来一份令人不快的惊喜。

1da8bbdef389070b48d2.source: This character's blood burns with acid, damaging adjacent attackers whenever they deal hitpoint damage
1da8bbdef389070b48d2.translation: 此角色的血液具有强烈腐蚀性；相邻敌人对其造成生命值伤害时，会受到酸血伤害

d4a932a2971096d57b24.source: Thanks to a cocktail of psychoactive substances, this character's fears are inhibited along with their ability to reasonably judge the situation, and they have found courage instead to face impossible odds.
d4a932a2971096d57b24.translation: 多种影响精神的药物压制了此角色的恐惧，也妨碍了他理智判断局势的能力。取而代之的是足以直面绝境的勇气。

073a5604aa2701033a20.translation: 独来独往，我才能发挥本事。

7d869b188b7ca42d5462.source: This character has had part of the Lorekeeper's skeleton fused into their body, and as a result possesses the ability to rapidly recover when delivered seemingly fatal wounds. Now if they could just make it through the night without screaming in their sleep...
7d869b188b7ca42d5462.translation: 典籍守护者的一部分骨骼已与此角色的身体融合，使他能够从看似致命的伤势中迅速恢复。要是他晚上睡觉不再尖叫，就更好了……

a091802d5efd1975096b.source: This character's body has mutated to regrow skin and muscle tissue much more quickly than normal. Deep injuries heal much faster than normal as a result. They also seem to have developed a strong taste for red meat, but that's probably unrelated.
a091802d5efd1975096b.translation: 此角色的身体发生了变异，皮肤和肌肉组织的再生速度大幅加快，深重的伤势也能更快愈合。他似乎还格外渴望红肉，不过这两件事大概没什么关系。

564f8985396635ec6bce.source: This character has strange visions of things that have been and things to come. While less than cheery around the campfire, it does seem to give them a certain ability to connect and internalize new experiences faster.
564f8985396635ec6bce.translation: 此角色会看见诡异的幻象，既有往昔之事，也有尚未发生的未来。虽然这让他在营火旁显得郁郁寡欢，却似乎有助于他更快理解并掌握新的经验。

16b281f9ca4264f69742.source: This character's body has the incredible ability to incorporate different blood types - or indeed, blood from entirely different creatures - into itself. This grants them remarkable healing via absorption of blood through skin pores (or more dramatically by drinking it directly).
16b281f9ca4264f69742.translation: 此角色的身体能够吸收不同血型的血液，甚至连其他生物的血也不例外。借由皮肤毛孔吸血，或更直接地将鲜血饮下，他便能以惊人的速度恢复伤势。

1e801b705429ddff8ec5.source: A large net holds this character in place and hampers their ability to defend themself. To break free, the net will have to be cut.
1e801b705429ddff8ec5.translation: 一张大网将此角色困在原地，妨碍其防御。必须割开网才能脱身。

843a24dc52d2ba6b3a1b.source: Thanks to an alchemical marvel, the night is as bright as day for this character.
843a24dc52d2ba6b3a1b.translation: 炼金术的奇迹让此角色眼中的黑夜如同白昼。

a8700a9a5a1dbdedc533.source: This character is consumed by unnatural nightmares and is unable to act. As the horrors eat away at his sanity, he'll take [color=
a8700a9a5a1dbdedc533.translation: 此角色陷入了诡异的噩梦，无法行动。梦中的恐怖不断侵蚀他的神志，每回合造成[color=

0526a9d36773a207b42d.source: [/color] damage based on his resolve each turn. The character can be forcibly awoken from these nightmares by a nearby ally, but he won't wake up on his own.
0526a9d36773a207b42d.translation: [/color]点伤害，具体数值取决于他的决心。附近友军可以强行将他唤醒，但他无法自行醒来。

4c9c4ae9f9896c22af70.source: This character seems to have nine lives! Just having had a close encounter with death, they are in a heightened state of survival until their next turn.
4c9c4ae9f9896c22af70.translation: 此角色仿佛真有九条命！刚刚与死亡擦肩而过，他的求生本能全面激发，持续至下回合。

993fc4906c014de66f5a.source: This character's adrenaline and hormonal glands have mutated, causing a constant heightened emotional state. They can mostly keep this under control in camp, but in high-stress situations the effect is much stronger and fills them with an intense, unconsolable rage.
993fc4906c014de66f5a.translation: 此角色的肾上腺与激素腺体发生了变异，情绪始终处于亢奋状态。在营地里尚能勉强克制，但身处险境时便会爆发出难以平息的狂怒。

0a22f70a1ca7d8ed3c49.source: This character gains two stacks of Rage each time they take hitpoint damage, and loses one stack at the end of each turn.
0a22f70a1ca7d8ed3c49.translation: 此角色每次受到生命值伤害时获得两层怒气，每回合结束时失去一层。

df5b01284c1c0cf112b6.source: This character's limbic system has been altered with an additional substance that allows them to sustain particularly strenuous anaerobic activity for longer. Their skin seems vaguely greener than you remember, too, but you're sure that's a coincidence.
df5b01284c1c0cf112b6.translation: 一种额外的物质改变了此角色的边缘系统，使他能更长时间地维持高强度无氧活动。他的皮肤好像也比记忆中更绿了一点，不过你确信这只是巧合。

337a9c10fb22948a20ff.source: Using orc weapons no longer imposes additional fatigue costs
337a9c10fb22948a20ff.translation: 使用兽人武器不再额外消耗疲劳

bc85b0a2fb38c2bef576.source: This character's body has mutated to develop a number of redundant synapses, allowing them to maintain a degree of control over sight, hearing, and muscle control even when struck with debilitating blows.
bc85b0a2fb38c2bef576.translation: 此角色的身体发生了变异，长出许多备用的神经突触。即使遭受足以令人失能的重击，他也能在一定程度上维持视觉、听觉和肌肉控制。

d63674ced9b32ad1126e.source: ]33%[/color] chance to resist the Dazed, Staggered, Stunned, Distracted, and Withered status effects
d63674ced9b32ad1126e.translation: ]33%[/color]几率抵抗恍惚、踉跄、眩晕、分心和衰萎状态

6b36f74462bcd19ef8db.source: This character's wrists have mutated in such a way that the they dampen the initial shock of opposing forces. In more practical terms, they reduce the protective qualities of an enemy's armor when struck. They can also make some pretty outlandish shadow puppets.
6b36f74462bcd19ef8db.translation: 此角色的手腕发生了变异，可以缓冲迎面而来的反作用力。实际效果就是攻击时削弱敌人护甲的防护能力。除此之外，他还能摆出一些匪夷所思的手影。

98b7ab9d56d7024d0773.source: This character has been overwhelmed with a flurry of attacks to defend against, leaving few openings to effectively attack for himself.
98b7ab9d56d7024d0773.translation: 此角色疲于招架接连不断的攻击，几乎找不到反击的机会。

bca7bf40e0780ee6ea00.source: resists being overwhelmed thanks to his unnatural physiology
bca7bf40e0780ee6ea00.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质抵抗了压制

001ba06dda690e143ea6.source: This character is using a weapon coated with poison. The next few hits doing at least [color=
001ba06dda690e143ea6.translation: 此角色的武器涂有毒药。接下来数次攻击只要造成至少[color=

9bc0a0c799b372a0fbee.source: [/color] damage to hitpoints will apply it. Targets affected will have blurred vision and a hard time moving in a coordinated fashion until the effect has faded.
9bc0a0c799b372a0fbee.translation: [/color]点生命值伤害，便会使目标中毒。中毒者将视线模糊、行动迟缓，直到毒效消退。

fde526789002c4bdca18.source: This character has consumed a substance, now in their bloodstream, that emits a kinetic field. This field gets stronger as their health deteriorates, eventually emitting a blue shimmer and producing a noticable effect on any blows that they deal, or that are dealt to them. They also claim to hear a constant, almost imperceptible whisper when alone, but that's probably superstition.
fde526789002c4bdca18.translation: 此角色服下的物质已进入血液，在体外形成动能场。伤势越重，气场越强，最终会泛起蓝光，显著影响他造成与承受的打击。他还声称独处时总能听见若有若无的低语，不过那大概只是迷信。

bad162ad5c1ea8f8485b.source: You can make the difference! An inspirational leader has rallied this character to gather all his strength and keep on going. A character can only be rallied once per turn and can not rally others when just being rallied himself.
bad162ad5c1ea8f8485b.translation: 你还能扭转战局！一位鼓舞人心的领袖集结了此角色，让他振作精神、继续奋战。每名角色每回合只能被集结一次，且刚受到集结后不能再集结他人。

6f41218244160f345c45.source: I can do this all night! Thanks to a cocktail of ergogenic substances, euphemistically called a 'Second Wind Potion', this character's heart is racing, he doesn't tire easily and his stamina is enhanced. Also, is it getting hot in here?
6f41218244160f345c45.translation: 我能撑上一整晚！所谓“回气药剂”其实是多种强效提神成分的混合物。此角色服下后心跳加速，不易疲倦，耐力大增。不过，周围是不是越来越热了？

cf62da8151645e0eaf9a.source: This character's flesh is reforming and they are temporarily incapacitated for [color=
cf62da8151645e0eaf9a.translation: 此角色的血肉正在重新成形，暂时无法行动。效果还将持续[color=

5d1bb051b83c406b8fe3.source: [/color] more turn(s), and unable to act.

8aa0cd76e7a1583dc954.source: This character is prepared to immediately counter-attack on any failed attempt to attack him in melee.
8aa0cd76e7a1583dc954.translation: 此角色已摆好还击架势，敌人的近战攻击一旦落空，他便会立即反击。

9a4773d1afa3d1f36cd9.source: Thick vines of unnatural growth hold this character in place and hamper their ability to defend themself. To break free, the vines will have to be cut down.
9a4773d1afa3d1f36cd9.translation: 粗壮的藤蔓以诡异的速度生长，将此角色缠在原地，妨碍其防御。必须斩断藤蔓才能脱身。

e22d650d824f906eaba1.source: This character's legs have mutated to respond much more rapidly and powerfully to external force. As a practical matter, they can maintain their center of balance and respond to nearly any attempt to push them back or uproot them.
e22d650d824f906eaba1.translation: 此角色的双腿发生了变异，对外力的反应更快、更有力。因此，他几乎能在任何试图将他推退或掀离地面的力量面前稳住重心。

e483c6a669dc731ed368.source: This character is entangled in a giant serpent. Each turn, the serpent threatens to crush them by gripping ever tighter, resulting in the loss of [color=
e483c6a669dc731ed368.translation: 此角色被一条巨蛇缠住。巨蛇每回合都会收紧身躯，几乎要将他绞碎，造成[color=

1f3504087ecc59037d3f.source: This character's eyes are altered to more easily detect faults in a target's defenses. They also seem to very faintly hiss 's' sounds.
1f3504087ecc59037d3f.translation: 此角色的双眼发生了变化，更容易发现目标防御中的破绽。他说话时似乎也隐约带上了蛇一般的嘶声。

d28e5137c9cb97d473f3.source: This character is shellshocked from being near a mortar explosion. Their ears are ringing, their vision is blurred and they're slightly disoriented. The effect will slowly wear off over [color=
d28e5137c9cb97d473f3.translation: 此角色受到附近臼炮爆炸的震荡，耳鸣目眩，方向感也有些混乱。效果还将持续[color=

b5e80d48124bbb84df35.source: resists being shellshocked thanks to his unnatural physiology
b5e80d48124bbb84df35.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质抵抗了炮击震荡

0fbe0e2f4b4de9b29cfa.source: Having raised the shield to a protective stance, this character gains increased defense.
0fbe0e2f4b4de9b29cfa.translation: 此角色举盾采取守势，防御能力提高。

0744aff32bd5318978f8.source: For forming a sturdy shieldwall with allies nearby, the defense is increased further.
0744aff32bd5318978f8.translation: 与附近友军共同组成坚固的盾墙，进一步提升了防御。

6b35ef94cf435131e5f3.source: This character's body has mutated such that they can lock their limbs into certain positions almost indefinitely, allowing them to brace against blows while barely breaking a sweat.
6b35ef94cf435131e5f3.translation: 此角色的身体发生了变异，能够将四肢几乎无限期地固定在特定姿势，以极少的体力消耗抵御打击。

fbd33559fbb29a9b56b2.source: Reduces the Fatigue cost of the 'Shieldwall' skill by [color=

0eda5ac7b141a28bfb20.source: This character has fallen into unnatural sleep and is unable to act. They'll wake up after [color=
0eda5ac7b141a28bfb20.translation: 此角色陷入了诡异的沉睡，无法行动。他将在[color=

476839ec2f3871ef7dc7.source:
[/color] more turn(s), but can also be forcibly awoken by allies and will wake up when taking any amount of damage.

The higher a character's resolve, the higher the chance to resist the urge to sleep.
476839ec2f3871ef7dc7.translation:
[/color]回合后醒来，也可由友军强行唤醒；受到任何伤害时同样会醒来。

角色的决心越高，抵抗睡意的几率越高。

6a2540985269fbedd4a4.source: wakes up thanks to his unnatural physiology
6a2540985269fbedd4a4.translation: 因异于常人的体质而苏醒

57dc4825c5b88c062a51.source: This character is covered by dense layers of smoke. Slipping in and out of visibility, they can move freely and ignore any zones of control.
57dc4825c5b88c062a51.translation: 此角色被浓烟笼罩，身影时隐时现，可以无视控制区域自由移动。

e6b4b25f928f70511141.source: Not affected by Zones of Control

de5c0b3184b3a8261048.source: Having readied the spear, this character gains an automatic free attack on any opponent trying to enter into his Zone of Control.
de5c0b3184b3a8261048.translation: 此角色架好长矛，任何敌人试图进入其控制区域时，他都会自动进行一次不消耗行动的攻击。

1ebf58a3b3f2585bc2e3.source: This character is using a weapon coated with concentrated webknecht poison. The next few hits doing at least [color=
1ebf58a3b3f2585bc2e3.translation: 此角色的武器涂有浓缩巨蛛毒。接下来数次攻击只要造成至少[color=

5d27464bb8fca78decba.source: [/color] damage to hitpoints will apply it. Targets affected will lose [color=
5d27464bb8fca78decba.translation: [/color]点生命值伤害，便会使目标中毒。中毒者将损失[color=

cf360dc6df870a15195d.source: ]10[/color] hitpoints per turn until the effect has faded.
cf360dc6df870a15195d.translation: ]10[/color]点生命值，每回合生效一次，直到毒效消退。

423995084d389f2c5703.source: This character has a vicious poison running through his veins and will lose [color=
423995084d389f2c5703.translation: 剧毒正在此角色的血液中扩散，他将损失[color=

3089f36abf60ceb0a170.source: This character has received so heavy a blow that they are off-balance, scrambling and late to act. Will wear off in [color=
3089f36abf60ceb0a170.translation: 此角色遭受了沉重的打击，站立不稳、脚步踉跄，行动也慢了下来。效果还将持续[color=

ca35e23848e32ced4db5.source: shook off being staggered thanks to his unnatural physiology
ca35e23848e32ced4db5.translation: 因异于常人的体质而摆脱踉跄

255353807e28ba3c82c6.source: This character is stunned or otherwise incapacitated for [color=
255353807e28ba3c82c6.translation: 此角色陷入眩晕或以其他方式失去了行动能力。效果将持续[color=

31062a41280f97df341b.source: shook off being stunned thanks to his unnatural physiology
31062a41280f97df341b.translation: 因异于常人的体质而摆脱昏迷

d421b01734e60389ef83.source: This character has gotten the attention of nearby opponents and is more likely to get attacked over other potential targets.
d421b01734e60389ef83.translation: 此角色吸引了附近敌人的注意，相比其他目标更容易遭到攻击。

90fb04ab173d7c8d907d.source: This character's body has mutated to grow at an unnatural pace. In battle, this causes their wounds to close and heal within moments. Outside of battle, it causes unseemly growths, an unquenchable thirst, and disgustingly long finger nails. You once saw them lacerate both arms with a meat cleaver, screeching maniacally that it was 'the only way to keep it in check'. Odd.
90fb04ab173d7c8d907d.translation: 此角色的身体发生了变异，生长速度异乎寻常。战斗中，伤口转瞬便会闭合愈合；平日里，却会长出难看的赘肉和恶心的长指甲，还总是口渴得厉害。你曾见他用切肉刀划开双臂，歇斯底里地尖叫着说这是“唯一能控制住它的办法”。真古怪。

7102309b693b0f5aed32.source: This character has heard the voice of Davkul speak truth through his fleshen conduit. He's prepared to go beyond his physical limits to the bidding of his god.
7102309b693b0f5aed32.translation: 此角色听见达夫库尔借血肉容器之口宣示真理。他已准备好突破肉体极限，遵从神明的意志。

40db95450a392d416e05.source: A large and sticky web holds this character in place and hampers their ability to defend themself and to put real force behind any blows. To break free, the web will have to be cut.
40db95450a392d416e05.translation: 一张硕大黏稠的蛛网将此角色困在原地，妨碍其防御，也让攻击难以发力。必须割开蛛网才能脱身。

aede6c5e17138152946c.source: ]Twice as much damage received by a Webknecht's attack will ignore armor[/color]
aede6c5e17138152946c.translation: ]巨蛛攻击中的无视护甲伤害翻倍[/color]

984f698a6fb308816622.source: This character's body has mutated and propagates poisons and other hazardous substances through the bloodstream much more slowly, allowing them to be disposed of without serious health effects. Curiously, this doesn't seem to affect their ability to get drunk.
984f698a6fb308816622.translation: 此角色的身体发生了变异，毒素等有害物质在血液中传播得更慢，让身体有时间在受到严重损害前将其清除。奇怪的是，这似乎丝毫不妨碍他喝醉。

ffc0f67a1eb36c6b03f2.source: This character just received a hurtful reminder of what they need to do for their masters. It will last for another
ffc0f67a1eb36c6b03f2.translation: 一顿疼痛的鞭打刚刚提醒了此角色该如何为主人效命。效果还将持续

6e1a5798d9354a66e718.source: It's just a flesh wound! This character's subdermal flesh has mutated and automatically reacts to sudden trauma, lessening the chance to suffer injuries in battle.
6e1a5798d9354a66e718.translation: 不过是皮肉伤！此角色的皮下组织发生了变异，能自动应对突如其来的创伤，降低战斗中留下伤势的几率。

a9c8dfed60018cf0693f.source: By means of dark magic, this character has withered to have the physique of an old man. Will slowly wear off over [color=
a9c8dfed60018cf0693f.translation: 黑暗魔法使此角色的身体衰萎，变得如老人一般虚弱。效果还将持续[color=

ad539e3b9d561f9bb24a.source: quickly recovered from withering thanks to his unnatural physiology
ad539e3b9d561f9bb24a.translation: 凭借异于常人的体质迅速摆脱了衰萎状态

71d8453348b7bdba8731.source: Recent events have left this character afraid for his life. Either he's right and will meet his end soon, or it'll  pass in time.
71d8453348b7bdba8731.translation: 最近发生的事令此角色担心自己性命难保。或许他确实命不久矣，也或许过些时日就会放下恐惧。

13f48445fbb406a0ccbc.source: Is content with being in reserve

5ea318c7a250bca1a7f6.source: Hicks. This character is intoxicated with alcoholic liquor to the point of impairment of physical and mental faculties.
5ea318c7a250bca1a7f6.translation: 嗝。此角色喝得酩酊大醉，身体与头脑都已不太听使唤。

afb2763338aae0e8ca9b.source: ]50%[/color] chance to be followed by a hangover

c4c1457c881748107bc2.source: Recent events have left this character physically exhausted and barely in a condition to keep up with the rest of the company, let alone fight. A few days rest should do wonders.
c4c1457c881748107bc2.translation: 最近发生的事令此角色疲惫不堪，连跟上队伍都十分勉强，更别提战斗了。休息几天应该会大有好转。

ab32208d21064001c02c.source: Not so loud! This character suffers the consequences from recent excessive alcohol consumption.
ab32208d21064001c02c.translation: 小点声！此角色正在承受先前酗酒的后果。

68788ee6de890d3ac537.source: Thanks to a cocktail of nootropics euphemistically called 'Potion of Knowledge', this character's cognitive functions, and particularly his memory and ability to learn, are enhanced along with his propensity for displaying nervous ticks.
68788ee6de890d3ac537.translation: 所谓“知识药剂”其实是多种益智成分的混合物，增强了此角色的认知能力，尤其是记忆力与学习能力，也让他更容易出现紧张性抽动。

a3d16e737571ec5dc382.source: Having had the honor of training with and learning from experienced fighters recently, this character has soaked in knowledge and now needs to apply what he learned on the battlefield in order to fully grasp it and make it his own.
a3d16e737571ec5dc382.translation: 此角色最近有幸与经验丰富的战士一起训练，从中学到不少本领。接下来，他需要在战场上实践，才能真正融会贯通。

6de4fa8b6f35863be702.source: A broken arm makes it almost impossible to use any weapon effectively.
6de4fa8b6f35863be702.translation: 手臂骨折，几乎无法有效使用任何武器。

aa086160a06ef3328d3c.source: A broken leg severely limits mobility and can take a long time to heal.
aa086160a06ef3328d3c.translation: 腿部骨折，行动能力严重受限，痊愈也需要很长时间。

f97c4988a11954408dd8.source: ]2[/color] Additional Action Point per tile moved
f97c4988a11954408dd8.translation: ]2[/color]点额外行动点消耗，每移动一格计算一次

7390cd945bfed4624877.source: Blunt force broke this character's nose, making it hard for them to catch breath properly.
7390cd945bfed4624877.translation: 鼻子遭到钝击而骨折，连喘口气都变得困难。

b6ad86ca62b395742c16.source: Several ribs have been broken by blunt force, making every single breath a painful process.
b6ad86ca62b395742c16.translation: 多根肋骨被钝器打断，每一次呼吸都会引发剧痛。

b633b1e58af0b86a6851.source: A heavily bruised leg severely limits mobility, but won't take long to recover from.
b633b1e58af0b86a6851.translation: 腿部严重挫伤，行动能力大受限制，但恢复所需时间不长。

2e3befa6aeb668ce2923.source: ]1[/color] Additional Action Point per tile moved
2e3befa6aeb668ce2923.translation: ]1[/color]点额外行动点消耗，每移动一格计算一次

df117c2d20bf70665690.source: Burned patches over the face and eyes make it harder to see and focus on a target.
df117c2d20bf70665690.translation: 面部与眼睛周围被烧伤，视野受损，难以看清并瞄准目标。

d2732df93e327ae24c1f.source: Burnt hands severly reduce the ability to make swift and precise motions. Also, it stings like hell.
d2732df93e327ae24c1f.translation: 双手烧伤，难以完成迅速而精准的动作，而且疼得要命。

d152d45f7b5f205fd396.source: Burn wounds on the legs limit mobility and make it painful to move quickly.
d152d45f7b5f205fd396.translation: 腿部烧伤限制了行动，稍一加快脚步就会疼痛难忍。

a0f87ad80a5823148340.source: An unlucky hit crushed a finger, making it painful to maintain a firm grip.
a0f87ad80a5823148340.translation: 一次倒霉的打击碾伤了手指，用力握持便会疼痛。

4035fa553c6351e48fc6.source: A blow to the neck injured the windpipe, making it very hard and painful to draw breath, let alone to keep fighting.
4035fa553c6351e48fc6.translation: 颈部遭到重击，气管受损。连呼吸都既困难又痛苦，更别提继续战斗了。

d101a26e608ec98a92dc.source: An injury like this makes even the quickest man hobble across the battlefield.
d101a26e608ec98a92dc.translation: 即使是最敏捷的人，受了这种伤也只能在战场上蹒跚而行。

094a1634fd4a62ad7407.source: A deep cut at the arm makes it difficult to use.
094a1634fd4a62ad7407.translation: 手臂上的深切口使其难以活动。

64b377bed19f974902de.source: A partially cut arm sinew makes it difficult to put force into any strike.
64b377bed19f974902de.translation: 手臂筋腱被部分割断，攻击时难以发力。

8e92a3426530a0fd1d71.source: An artery has been cut, leading to massive hemorrhaging and ultimately death if not treated out of combat. If survived, it is followed by severely lowered constitution due to loss of blood.
8e92a3426530a0fd1d71.translation: 动脉被割破，导致大量失血。若不能脱离战斗接受治疗，最终将因失血而死。即使幸存，也会因失血而严重虚弱。

507fa0c8b0d27afd82cb.source: This character will continue to lose [color=

260e68a799fd5e217ea8.translation: ]3[/color]点生命值，战斗中每回合生效一次

b382b4405346bd26d3ae.source: A cut into the muscles of the leg makes any quick and sudden movements impossible.
b382b4405346bd26d3ae.translation: 腿部肌肉被割伤，无法做出迅速或突然的动作。

f5e2605627cfdf4dae10.source: A vein on the throat has been cut, leading to massive hemorrhaging and ultimately death if not treated out of combat. If survived, it is followed by a period of severely lowered constitution due to loss of blood, and will leave a menacing scar.
f5e2605627cfdf4dae10.translation: 颈部静脉被割破，导致大量失血。若不能脱离战斗接受治疗，最终将因失血而死。即使幸存，也会因失血而严重虚弱一段时间，并留下一道骇人的伤疤。

dabc42279184af90fe2f.translation: ]6[/color]点生命值，战斗中每回合生效一次

3e2f8b7a1de67466e138.source: A deep cut at the abdomen has injured the muscle and makes it painful to move or even stand upright, reducing the constitution of this character.
3e2f8b7a1de67466e138.translation: 腹部的深切口伤及肌肉，移动乃至站直身体都会疼痛，令此角色的体能下降。

e39f1b1f319264b1f402.source: A deep, bleeding cut into the chest and pectoral muscle makes it hard to keep standing, let alone use a weapon.
e39f1b1f319264b1f402.translation: 胸口与胸肌上的深切口血流不止，连站立都难以维持，更别提挥动武器了。

fe943df659fdfdfecaf8.source: A jagged cut across the face is bleeding profusely over eyes, nose and mouth.
fe943df659fdfdfecaf8.translation: 一道参差的伤口横贯面部，鲜血不断流过眼睛、鼻子与嘴巴。

314435278f310d6e3e57.source: A hard hit has knocked the shoulder out of its joint, making it hard to move the arm at all.
314435278f310d6e3e57.translation: 猛烈的一击使肩关节脱臼，整条手臂都难以活动。

76b5769dd0b53923a560.source: A deep cut to the side peeled the skin right off of this character's rib cage.
76b5769dd0b53923a560.translation: 侧腹被深深切开，胸廓旁的皮肉翻卷，露出了肋骨。

2fbc6abe5f9572ffc2e2.source: A fractured elbow makes it hard to block or parry any attacks effectively.
2fbc6abe5f9572ffc2e2.translation: 肘部骨裂，难以有效格挡或招架攻击。

523fe3e7d6f49c5ce1f0.source: Minor bone fractures at the hand make it difficult to hold firmly any weapon.
523fe3e7d6f49c5ce1f0.translation: 手部出现细小骨裂，难以握牢武器。

b985457d3baa35275592.source: Fractured ribs send a wave of pain through the body with every breath.
b985457d3baa35275592.translation: 肋骨出现裂痕，每一次呼吸都会带来遍及全身的疼痛。

8b987e292dd0b110e906.source: This character's skull has sustained multiple fractures, and the brain has sustained blunt trauma leading to swelling and a build-up of pressure inside the skull.
8b987e292dd0b110e906.translation: 此角色的颅骨多处骨裂，脑部受到钝击创伤，引发肿胀与颅内压力升高。

2045d0fe228b703d9a0d.source: A blow grazed and ripped the tissue close to the eye, causing it to fill with blood and swell shut.
2045d0fe228b703d9a0d.translation: 攻击擦过眼部，撕裂了眼睛周围的组织。鲜血涌入眼眶，肿胀令眼睛无法睁开。

64eac55cf4e12f371c7e.source: Abdominal pain, blood in the urine and always the danger of infection. A grazed kidney is a severe risk to the life of any character, draining their constitution.
64eac55cf4e12f371c7e.translation: 腹痛、血尿，还有随时感染的危险。肾脏受伤严重威胁着此角色的性命，不断削弱他的体能。

32bf2e76d7dd587ed9cb.source: A grazing wound on the neck bleeds profusely. If survived, it is followed by lowered constitution due to loss of blood.
32bf2e76d7dd587ed9cb.translation: 颈部擦伤，血流不止。即使幸存，也会因失血而虚弱。

c263ef28bb148a370555.translation: ]1[/color]点生命值，战斗中每回合生效一次

7614aaac4cc759f2e6c8.source: An unclean wound has painfully festered, draining this character's constitution.
7614aaac4cc759f2e6c8.translation: 未清理干净的伤口已经化脓，疼痛不止，削弱了此角色的体能。

9e5e01a26c06c0f45c03.source: A second opening for air proves of little use, except for sounding like a bagpipe.
9e5e01a26c06c0f45c03.translation: 多出一个通气的口子似乎毫无用处，只让呼吸听起来像在吹风笛。

543e7a99a0dd04ad86e1.source: The sensitive knee cap has been injured, resulting in pain with every movement and severely limiting the mobility of this character.
543e7a99a0dd04ad86e1.translation: 脆弱的膝盖骨受了伤，每次移动都会疼痛，严重限制了此角色的行动能力。

46b40326919e2738d765.source: Injured muscles in the shoulder make it hard to put any force into a strike.
46b40326919e2738d765.translation: 肩部肌肉受伤，攻击时难以发力。

8273079f3711242fe172.source: Is content for now with being in reserve
8273079f3711242fe172.translation: 暂时愿意留在后备队伍中

6b21141c6116c9d7ebb4.source: Will take effect only after combat ends due to the Iron Will effect
6b21141c6116c9d7ebb4.translation: 受钢铁意志影响，本场战斗结束后才会生效

28d753d9ae1c17d00be5.source: Will take effect again only after the next battle due to the Iron Will effect
28d753d9ae1c17d00be5.translation: 受钢铁意志影响，下场战斗结束后才会重新生效

df671ff76c73a10f89fa.source: Will not heal because you have no medical supplies
df671ff76c73a10f89fa.translation: 没有医疗用品，伤势不会恢复

0ed6d4f3b924bdb84a3c.source: Will not heal because this character has taken an oath of sacrifice
0ed6d4f3b924bdb84a3c.translation: 此角色立下了牺牲之誓，伤势不会恢复

c70ffb315427e9efb862.source: A piercing attack has punctured the arm and injured muscle tissue, limiting its mobility.
c70ffb315427e9efb862.translation: 穿刺攻击贯穿了手臂，损伤肌肉组织，限制了活动能力。

994e9fa34f708e0d5bab.source: Contrary to what one might think, having an additional hole in the cheek does not help with breathing.
994e9fa34f708e0d5bab.translation: 与你可能想象的相反，脸颊多一个窟窿并不能让呼吸更顺畅。

6a64e0bdf61a21bd498e.source: A piercing attack has punctured the chest, injured muscle tissue and grazed the ribs. Although no vital organs have been hit, it's still painful to just breathe.
6a64e0bdf61a21bd498e.translation: 穿刺攻击贯穿了胸部，损伤肌肉并擦伤肋骨。虽然没有伤及要害，单是呼吸也十分痛苦。

2b4bb15994a48228cf58.source: Having a hole in the hand may not stop a determined fighter, but it does make handling a weapon more difficult.
2b4bb15994a48228cf58.translation: 手上多了个窟窿，或许还不足以让意志坚定的战士停下，却会让操持武器变得更难。

4e1efb0308e34b5a49e0.source: Punctured leg muscles make any attempts to do quick and sudden movements a painful experience, if not outright impossible.
4e1efb0308e34b5a49e0.translation: 腿部肌肉被刺穿，任何迅速或突然的动作都会带来剧痛，有时根本无法做出。

fef417f04eda6c8ca25f.source: A piercing attack has punctured the side, injured muscle tissue and grazed the ribs. Although no vital organs have been hit, it's still painful to just breathe.
fef417f04eda6c8ca25f.translation: 穿刺攻击贯穿了侧腹，损伤肌肉并擦伤肋骨。虽然没有伤及要害，单是呼吸也十分痛苦。

6d555cdf56ef87e07fcb.source: This character's ear almost got torn off, sending blood down their head and neck, and making them less aware of their surroundings.
6d555cdf56ef87e07fcb.translation: 此角色的耳朵险些被撕掉，鲜血顺着头颈流下，对周围动静的感知也变迟钝了。

af804296959507fce064.source: A severe concussion makes it hard to focus, see or even walk straight. Not to mention the nausea and in some cases also amnesia.
af804296959507fce064.translation: 严重的脑震荡让人难以集中注意、看清事物，甚至走直线都很困难。此外还会恶心，有时甚至失忆。

9925dab8613928c27f00.source: Struck with sickness and disease, this character isn't feeling well at all and hardly in a condition to fight. If the fever doesn't take him, it'll probably pass in time.
9925dab8613928c27f00.translation: 疾病令此角色浑身不适，几乎无法战斗。如果高烧没有夺走他的性命，休养一阵或许就能恢复。

0d96f41d854cce031e81.source: A hand smashed by blunt force makes it almost impossible to hold on to any kind of weapon.
0d96f41d854cce031e81.translation: 手被钝器砸伤，几乎无法握住任何武器。

5c892006fe273a3b3930.source: A sharp cut split the hand right down the middle. Until healed, it can barely be used anymore.
5c892006fe273a3b3930.translation: 锋利的一击从中间劈开了手掌。在伤口愈合前，这只手几乎无法使用。

359f8843834d536d3863.source: A close swing split this character's nose in two and made any attempt to breathe an exercise in swallowing copious amounts of blood.
359f8843834d536d3863.translation: 擦面而过的一击将鼻子劈成两半，每一次呼吸都会吞下大口鲜血。

2a15cef3966e92246a48.source: A deep cut has split this character's shoulder open, injuring the muscle tissue and severely limiting mobility of the arms.
2a15cef3966e92246a48.translation: 深重的伤口劈开了此角色的肩部，损伤肌肉组织，严重限制了手臂活动。

665e9da345f3384a6e95.source: A sprained ankle makes even the quickest man hobble across the battlefield.
665e9da345f3384a6e95.translation: 脚踝扭伤，即使是最敏捷的人，也只能在战场上蹒跚而行。

b5d25a8bdb677a61b05c.source: A wound at the intestines drains constitution, and the high chance of infection and the prospect of a slow and painful death don't help either.
b5d25a8bdb677a61b05c.translation: 肠道受伤让身体虚弱不堪，还极易感染，甚至可能在漫长的痛苦中死去。

900f27243a53d0f465ff.source: A hard hit to the head shook some things up and didn't exactly benefit this character's cognitive skills. On the bright side, he may now be just too stupid to realize when it's time to run.
900f27243a53d0f465ff.translation: 头部遭到重击，脑子里的某些东西被震乱了，思考能力显然也没得到什么好处。不过往好处想，他现在也许笨得连什么时候该逃都不知道。

2866a9c315e9e443c525.source: A broken elbow that never fully healed hinders all movement of the arm and severely reduces combat effectiveness.
2866a9c315e9e443c525.translation: 骨折的肘部始终未能完全愈合，妨碍整条手臂的活动，大幅削弱战斗能力。

333bae2526c842289425.source: This character took something to the knee, and it never fully healed. Lunging forward or dodging can be painful, and it lacks any grace.
333bae2526c842289425.translation: 此角色的膝盖曾挨过一下，始终没能痊愈。向前突进或闪避时都会疼痛，动作更是毫无优雅可言。

31f40609ea7bbc38933c.source: A part of the lung has died, making it very hard for this character to catch breath.
31f40609ea7bbc38933c.translation: 一部分肺组织已经坏死，令此角色很难喘过气来。

eeba3332d1bd4f7ea562.source: An injury to the foot has never fully healed, making it hard to win any dancing competitions or otherwise move around quickly.
eeba3332d1bd4f7ea562.translation: 脚上的旧伤始终未能痊愈，想靠跳舞赢比赛大概没希望了，平日里也难以快步移动。

704da788a9f56df0db2a.source: Luckily, a missing ear isn't that much of a hindrance for this character. But it does look gross.
704da788a9f56df0db2a.translation: 好在少了一只耳朵并不会带来太多妨碍，只是模样有些吓人。

0e95eae5730aaa18ad5e.source: A missing eye makes it difficult to judge distance properly, and limits the field of view.
0e95eae5730aaa18ad5e.translation: 少了一只眼睛，既难以准确判断距离，视野也受到限制。

bfac07417bfc420ba37c.source: A missing finger makes it harder to firmly grab a weapon or shield, but it also makes for a good story.
bfac07417bfc420ba37c.translation: 少了一根手指，让武器和盾牌更难握牢，不过倒是多了个值得吹嘘的故事。

ee2a3e4a7b9219292e6e.source: A missing hand prevents this character from using shields and two-handed weapons.
ee2a3e4a7b9219292e6e.translation: 失去一只手，使此角色无法使用盾牌和双手武器。

e1618eb977a1dda4a1a8.source: A gaping hole is all that is left of the nose, making this character hard to look at.
e1618eb977a1dda4a1a8.translation: 原本的鼻子只剩下一个豁开的洞，让人不忍直视。

119367c1cbf2445425ba.source: This character has been to the other side. Faced with his own mortality, the experience of dying and coming back has left him a broken man.
119367c1cbf2445425ba.translation: 此角色曾走到生死彼岸。直面死亡又侥幸归来的经历彻底击垮了他的精神。

582004704ac7f04780c5.source: Past injuries left this character with a weakened heart, severely lowering his constitution.
582004704ac7f04780c5.translation: 旧伤削弱了此角色的心脏，大幅降低了他的体能。

bba508f43ddbb525bb83.source: ]5%[/color] of the current total armor value of both body and head armor. The heavier your armor and helmet, the more you benefit.
bba508f43ddbb525bb83.translation: ]5%[/color]；所得数值就是护甲伤害的减免百分比。护甲与头盔越厚重，收益越大。

9babcda6eeae2fab0e72.source: %[/color] of any damage to armor from attacks

f4ff8a8fc7a69329f1db.source: ]This character's armor isn't protective enough to grant any benefit from having the Battleforged perk[/color]
f4ff8a8fc7a69329f1db.translation: ]此角色的护甲防护不足，无法从“久经战阵”特长中获得收益[/color]

be557b5debadfce51a12.source: This character is adapting fast to their opponent's moves and gains an additional [color=
be557b5debadfce51a12.translation: 此角色正迅速适应敌人的招式，攻击命中率额外提高[color=

632851fa2ca8c6b9ee93.source: %[/color] chance to hit with any attack.

6047f22a9eb77008d899.source: This character is guaranteed to land a hit to the head on the next attack that connects.
6047f22a9eb77008d899.translation: 此角色的下一次命中必定击中头部。

07aa332223f700d6bf40.source: Nimble like a cat! This character is able to partially evade or deflect attacks at the last moment, turning them into glancing hits. The lighter the armor, the more you benefit.
07aa332223f700d6bf40.translation: 灵巧如猫！此角色能在最后一刻闪避或拨开攻击，将重击化作擦伤。护甲越轻，收益越大。

98e7d33684e9564c38d6.source: %[/color] of any damage to hitpoints from attacks

64ab39988b71d6e3ad78.source: ]This character's body and head armor are too heavy as to gain any benefit from being nimble[/color]
64ab39988b71d6e3ad78.translation: ]此角色的身体与头部护甲过重，无法从“轻灵”特长中获得收益[/color]

211badda9e8b8b9b43bf.source: Maybe use this instead? This character has quick hands and can still swap an item for free this turn.
211badda9e8b8b9b43bf.translation: 不如换这件？此角色动作麻利，本回合还可以免费更换一次物品。

5821101973eb822f63b2.source: This character is using the superior reach of their melee weapon to keep opponents at bay, increasing Melee Defense by [color=
5821101973eb822f63b2.translation: 此角色利用近战武器的长度优势将敌人挡在身外，近战防御提高[color=

1040671dfcb8d4af8cfe.source: ]Can not be used because this character has taken an oath precluding the use of ranged weapons or tools[/color]
1040671dfcb8d4af8cfe.translation: ]此角色的誓言禁止使用远程武器或工具，因此无法使用[/color]

7a074425d7e05d68f15b.source: AP[/color][/b] to use and builds up

88bc432d73dad6b27fea.source: Immune to being knocked back or hooked

10662a43c6c3153dfaa3.source: and the shot goes astray and hits

f744666397e4c323ab54.source: and the shot goes astray and misses

13718004e8a8c2d63335.source: With the second hand free, this character can get a firm double grip on his weapon and inflicts additional damage.
13718004e8a8c2d63335.translation: 空着另一只手时，此角色能用双手牢牢握住武器，造成额外伤害。

7dff982e83cde008a538.source:
This character is content with how things are going. Could be better, could be worse.

Mood will always trend towards this state over time.
7dff982e83cde008a538.translation:
此角色对现状还算满意。日子可以更好，也可以更糟。

随着时间推移，心情总会逐渐回到这一状态。

34a27d8af04480936f74.source: Not uncommon for someone living the hardships of mercenary life, this character isn't quite satisfied and is hoping for things to improve.
34a27d8af04480936f74.translation: 此角色对现状不太满意，盼着日子能有些起色。在艰苦的佣兵生活中，这并不稀奇。

e4a2cc776710580defda.source: Recent events have left this character disgruntled and disappointed how things are going. It may fade, or it may get a lot worse if other events tip him over the edge.
e4a2cc776710580defda.translation: 最近发生的事令此角色心怀不满，对现状感到失望。情绪或许会逐渐平复，也可能在新的打击下彻底恶化。

1a729ff20a7d163a273d.source: Recent events have left this character angry and vengeful towards those around him. If things don't improve very quickly, this character may decide to desert the company!
1a729ff20a7d163a273d.translation: 最近发生的事令此角色满腔怒火，对身边的人心怀怨恨。如果情况不能迅速好转，他可能会逃离战团！

43c4c5999971e3377294.source: Recent events have left this character in good spirit. It will probably pass as reality takes a grip again, but for now, things are looking well.
43c4c5999971e3377294.translation: 最近发生的事令此角色心情愉快。等现实的烦恼重新袭来，这份好心情大概也会消退，但眼下日子过得不错。

d3dc8bd84db56d05336b.source: ]25%[/color] chance to start battle at confident morale

bddfc536754436309f27.source: Recent events have left this character eager to fight with the company, pleased with how things are going and motivating to those around him.
bddfc536754436309f27.translation: 最近发生的事令此角色对现状十分满意，渴望与战团并肩作战，还不断鼓舞身边的同伴。

c7b6a3c664a833ddbb6c.source: ]50%[/color] chance to start battle at confident morale

10e6878d3b190eca1209.source: Recent events have left this character in a state of euphoria, happy to spend his time in service of the company and sure of victory against any foe. It's bordering on the annoying, really.
10e6878d3b190eca1209.translation: 最近发生的事令此角色欣喜若狂，心甘情愿为战团效力，坚信任何敌人都能战胜。说真的，他这股兴奋劲儿都有点烦人了。

d429bd6d16e9870d59fe.source: ]75%[/color] chance to start battle at confident morale

87b53b47292e76a470af.source: We'll be victorious! This character is confident that victory will be his.
87b53b47292e76a470af.translation: 胜利属于我们！此角色满怀信心，坚信自己必将获胜。

040f58889ff6caea82af.source: Uh oh. This character is wavering and unsure if the battle will turn out to his advantage.
040f58889ff6caea82af.translation: 不太妙啊。此角色的信心开始动摇，不确定这场战斗能否获胜。

dfeb16b6152d154d6d18.source: We can't win this! This character's morale is breaking and he is close to fleeing the battlefield.
dfeb16b6152d154d6d18.translation: 我们赢不了！此角色的士气濒临崩溃，几乎就要逃离战场。

bf1e2863fb34ba60dce3.source: Run for your lives! This character has lost it and is fleeing the battlefield in panic.
bf1e2863fb34ba60dce3.translation: 快逃命啊！此角色已惊慌失措，正试图逃离战场。

2b6c312ebd652fc5b416.source: Acts at the end of the round

05a754b09cdece24bc74.source: Did that shadow just move? The dim moon light makes it hard to see more than a few feet in front, reducing the view range and making the use of ranged weapons a bad proposition for anyone not able to see in the dark.
05a754b09cdece24bc74.translation: 那团影子刚才是不是动了？昏暗的月光让人看不清几步之外的事物，视野因此缩小。对无法在黑暗中视物的人来说，此时使用远程武器可不是好主意。

9e347497673d16237fb1.source: This character is out of ammunition for the currently equipped ranged weapon!
9e347497673d16237fb1.translation: 此角色当前装备的远程武器已没有弹药！

05270eda7184e5105bbd.source: This character has taken an Oath of Fortification and cannot move while steeling themselves for combat!
05270eda7184e5105bbd.translation: 此角色立下了坚守之誓，在严阵以待时无法移动！

bd5afa7bbf8f7ea0d231.source: This character has taken an Oath of Honor and refuses to use the currently equipped ranged weapon or tool!
bd5afa7bbf8f7ea0d231.translation: 此角色立下了荣誉之誓，拒绝使用当前装备的远程武器或工具！

210df1f32a675c23f743.source: This character's weapon is in poor condition and may permanently break if used again.
210df1f32a675c23f743.translation: 此角色的武器已严重磨损，再次使用可能彻底损坏。

5cf9ff7137f1a582c435.source: This character's weapon is in poor condition (
5cf9ff7137f1a582c435.translation: 此角色的武器已严重磨损（

2a77bf6756a51e15b0f6.source: %) and may permanently break if used again.

bb2be5a8c27ed8654aef.source: This character is hidden in terrain and can not be seen by opponents unless directly adjacent or attacking them first.
bb2be5a8c27ed8654aef.translation: 此角色隐蔽在地形中。除非敌人紧邻他，或他主动发动攻击，否则敌人无法发现他。

ba45da2b35ab8d86fb5a.source: Swamp with boggish ground is hampering movement and fighting abilities significantly.
ba45da2b35ab8d86fb5a.translation: 沼泽松软泥泞的地面严重妨碍移动与战斗。

bb75f9937b5b6457be24.source: This character has developed a substance addiction. If not provided with a regular supply, he may suffer symptoms of withdrawal.
bb75f9937b5b6457be24.translation: 此角色已经药物成瘾。若不能定期服用，便可能出现戒断症状。

958ee70106f77a616757.source: Currently no effect because drugs were consumed within the last 5 days
958ee70106f77a616757.translation: 过去5天内服用过药物，当前没有戒断影响

94ce4de1e9b2c801972f.source: This character is always pale and sickly, which makes him particularly susceptible to poisons.
94ce4de1e9b2c801972f.translation: 此角色总是一副苍白病弱的模样，尤其容易受到毒素侵害。

f05e463dccebda8ad9e8.source: Hearing a crowd chant your name can be addicting. This character is starting to enjoy the deadly fights of the arena and dispatching his opponents in a way that entertains the crowds.
f05e463dccebda8ad9e8.translation: 听人群高呼自己的名字，滋味足以让人上瘾。此角色开始享受竞技场中的生死搏杀，也学会了用取悦观众的方式解决对手。

ebb91655974b0f78533f.source: So far, this character has fought in
ebb91655974b0f78533f.translation: 迄今为止，此角色已参加

6ed3a197053e22e7b17f.source: This character has just dipped his toes into the brutal profession of arena fighting and did so without dying.
6ed3a197053e22e7b17f.translation: 此角色刚刚踏入残酷的角斗行当，而且活着走出了赛场。

7f885815eab8925af7f7.source: So far, this character has fought in one match
7f885815eab8925af7f7.translation: 迄今为止，此角色参加过一场比赛

72223459324d31417263.source: A veteran of the arena with many a scar, this character knows how to make the crowd cheer for a bloody spectacle. The worse the odds of winning, the better the entertainment!
72223459324d31417263.translation: 此角色已是伤痕累累的竞技场老手，懂得如何用血腥的表演引得观众欢呼。胜算越渺茫，场面就越精彩！

0de2afa8793a0e281b06.source: ]50%[/color] chance to survive if struck down and not killed by a fatality
0de2afa8793a0e281b06.translation: ]50%[/color]几率在被击倒后幸存，前提是未遭到致命处决

bd36d12b23020516b914.source: Being short of breath and prone to coughing, this character takes longer to recover from fatigue than others.
bd36d12b23020516b914.translation: 此角色容易气短咳嗽，从疲劳中恢复所需的时间比旁人更长。

0aae3e9bb54a74e0b5e1.translation: 此角色体格健壮，身手矫健。

f66228025d4fea6a9d1b.source: ]2[/color] less Fatigue for each tile travelled
f66228025d4fea6a9d1b.translation: ]2[/color]点疲劳消耗减免，每移动一格计算一次

bc71bfeefba24bd811a5.source: This character is prone to bleeding and will do so longer than most others.
bc71bfeefba24bd811a5.translation: 此角色容易出血，止血所需的时间也比常人更长。

77ee16ef524c859b6081.source: This character is prone to excessive violence and cruelty towards his enemies. An opponent isn't good enough dead, his head needs to be on a spike!
77ee16ef524c859b6081.translation: 此角色对敌人极其残暴，杀死对方还不够，非要将那颗脑袋挂上尖桩才罢休！

83200923c915dc077694.source: All kills are fatalities (if the weapon allows)
83200923c915dc077694.translation: 所有击杀均以致命处决收尾（武器允许时）

ab5d7f143ceb9d0b66a3.source: Just keep on going. This character will bravely venture into the unknown.
ab5d7f143ceb9d0b66a3.translation: 只管往前走。此角色有勇气踏入未知之地。

0b2b70bf9621154c5dc7.source: This character has an easier time than most with grasping new concepts and adapting to the situation.
0b2b70bf9621154c5dc7.translation: 此角色比大多数人更容易理解新事物，也更擅长随机应变。

fdfc8e66ebc1f0a51f1c.source: Not one for delicate attacks, this character will use full force for additional damage when striking an opponent's head in melee at the expense of some accuracy.
fdfc8e66ebc1f0a51f1c.translation: 此角色不擅长精细的招式，近战时宁愿牺牲些许精准度，也要全力砸向敌人的脑袋，造成额外伤害。

41b5cfd91a7ee0645352.source: ]+15%[/color] Damage on a hit to the head

4b65175904ede07279ec.source: Afflicted with clubfoot as a child, this character still has a harder time walking than most.
4b65175904ede07279ec.translation: 此角色幼时便患有足部畸形，至今行走仍比常人费力。

fb12b2d4555c0e6378df.source: ]2[/color] more Fatigue for each tile travelled
fb12b2d4555c0e6378df.translation: ]2[/color]点额外疲劳消耗，每移动一格计算一次

30ff4383be2b9f3330a1.source: This character can be as dangerous for himself as to his opponent.
30ff4383be2b9f3330a1.translation: 此角色对自己造成的危险，可能和对敌人一样大。

5ac8130fd4ad44981d6b.source: All too easy! This character can be a bit too cocky for his own good.
5ac8130fd4ad44981d6b.translation: 太轻松了！此角色有时过于自大，难免吃亏。

fc73161a1de96d496b2f.source: Run for your lives! This character is a craven and will run at the slightest sign of the odds turning against him.
fc73161a1de96d496b2f.translation: 快逃命啊！此角色胆小如鼠，局势稍有不利便会拔腿就跑。

6830d731bbc64aa44019.source: This character is an acolyte of Davkul, an individual with intimate knowledge of the teachings about the elder god. He embraces physical pain and peril as bringing him closer to salvation.
6830d731bbc64aa44019.translation: 此角色是达夫库尔的侍徒，对这位古老神明的教义颇为熟悉。他甘愿承受肉体的痛苦与危险，相信这能让自己更接近救赎。

b3e3281876d56a8f13f1.source: No morale check triggered upon allies dying
b3e3281876d56a8f13f1.translation: 友军死亡时不触发士气检定

97dfb687aba34f87a391.source: This character feels chosen by Davkul, something not many in this world can claim. He embraces physical pain and peril as bringing him closer to salvation, and he believes that his god will protect him so he can act on behest of his god.
97dfb687aba34f87a391.translation: 此角色自认被达夫库尔选中，这世上可没几个人敢如此宣称。他甘愿承受肉体的痛苦与危险，相信这能让自己更接近救赎，也坚信神明会护佑他完成使命。

a4523322ed7ea41c6d62.source: Is not affected by fresh injuries sustained during the current battle
a4523322ed7ea41c6d62.translation: 不受本场战斗中新获得的伤势影响

29e699e550960be0730b.source: This character is a disciple of Davkul, an individual with unquestionable loyalty to the elder god. He embraces physical pain and peril as bringing him closer to salvation.
29e699e550960be0730b.translation: 此角色是达夫库尔的门徒，对这位古老神明的忠诚毋庸置疑。他甘愿承受肉体的痛苦与危险，相信这能让自己更接近救赎。

7246f2c0afcf99879cb3.source: This character is a fanatic follower of Davkul, believing that Davkul embraces man in death.
7246f2c0afcf99879cb3.translation: 此角色狂热地追随达夫库尔，相信神明会在死亡中接纳凡人。

9f80c7055c7e65d5f297.source: This character is a prophet of Davkul, the fleshen conduit of his will and the earthen voice speaking his truth. Other believers listen to his every word and feel compelled to go above and beyond their physical limits on his behest.
9f80c7055c7e65d5f297.translation: 此角色是达夫库尔的先知，承载神意的血肉容器，宣示真理的尘世之声。其他信徒悉心聆听他的每一句话，甘愿遵其命令，超越自身肉体的极限。

fca29c15177f1ba33ac5.source: This character is a zealous follower of Davkul, so much so that he has come to embrace physical pain as bringing him closer to salvation.
fca29c15177f1ba33ac5.translation: 此角色热诚地追随达夫库尔，甚至甘愿承受肉体的痛苦，相信这能让自己更接近救赎。

f82a9cde8bf0e16eb49d.source: This character will turn tail on the first possible occasion. Better have an eye on him!
f82a9cde8bf0e16eb49d.translation: 此角色一有机会便会转身逃跑。最好盯紧他！

d9fa642da6ae1f0be142.source: Will start combat at wavering morale

8b8d2633bafe86062811.source: I'm not dead yet! This character doesn't care about receiving injuries and will fight on regardless.
8b8d2633bafe86062811.translation: 我还没死呢！此角色毫不在意自己受了多少伤，依然会奋战到底。

69ef71744c6eb88b5e93.source: Don't worry, I got this. This character shows a formidable amount of self-confidence.
69ef71744c6eb88b5e93.translation: 别担心，交给我。此角色有着令人惊叹的自信。

0a7f29a2919395f0eea2.source: A dexterous character has an easier time hitting his opponent in melee.
0a7f29a2919395f0eea2.translation: 此角色动作灵巧，近战时更容易命中敌人。

f68d7cd86719b83cb776.source: I have to put myself first! This character is rather disloyal and will be fast to leave should you ever run out of crowns or provisions.
f68d7cd86719b83cb776.translation: 我得先顾好自己！此角色缺乏忠诚，一旦战团没了克朗或食物，他很快就会离开。

1cc8325c7796d17eee32.source: There's no question what this character spends his crowns on. Expect him to drink heavily before any battle, in secret if need be.
1cc8325c7796d17eee32.translation: 此角色的克朗花去了哪里，根本不用猜。每场战斗前，他都会痛饮一番，哪怕得偷偷摸摸地喝。

98111830cb34c0857c5a.source: Umm, what? This character isn't the brightest, and new concepts take a while to really stick with him.
98111830cb34c0857c5a.translation: 呃，什么？此角色脑子不太灵光，学会新东西总要多花些时间。

04b691d604deece261b1.source: Blessed with the eyes of an eagle, this character can spot a fly from a hundred paces away.
04b691d604deece261b1.translation: 此角色天生拥有鹰一般的锐眼，百步之外的苍蝇也能看得一清二楚。

d57cf686fc2aadcfd7cc.source: This character needs some warm words and a pat on the back from time to time.
d57cf686fc2aadcfd7cc.translation: 此角色时不时就需要别人说几句暖心话，再拍拍他的背。

67d5cf09d6f9b26e34a7.source: This character is more interested in pork chops than exercising, and will run out of breath more easily.
67d5cf09d6f9b26e34a7.translation: 比起锻炼，此角色更喜欢猪排，稍一活动便容易上气不接下气。

83245fe7a0c7e0be0cdd.source: Some past event or particularly convincing story in this character's life has left him scared of what the monstrous beasts of the wild are capable of, making him less reliable when facing them on the battlefield.
83245fe7a0c7e0be0cdd.translation: 过去的某次经历，或一个格外逼真的故事，让此角色对荒野中凶兽的可怕本领心生恐惧，在战场上面对它们时也更容易动摇。

be4b5241535c6f1f79f6.source: ]-10[/color] Resolve when in battle with beasts

d543697c0ff398796dc8.source: Some past event or particularly convincing story in this character's life has left him scared of what greenskins are capable of, making him less reliable when facing them on the battlefield.
d543697c0ff398796dc8.translation: 过去的某次经历，或一个格外逼真的故事，让此角色对绿皮的可怕本领心生恐惧，在战场上面对它们时也更容易动摇。

5b177c109c7589407e54.source: ]-10[/color] Resolve when in battle with greenskins

e0503402212ca9f0ac4d.source: Some past event or particularly convincing story in this character's life has left him scared of what the walking dead are capable of, making him less reliable when facing them on the battlefield.
e0503402212ca9f0ac4d.translation: 过去的某次经历，或一个格外逼真的故事，让此角色对行尸走肉的可怕本领心生恐惧，在战场上面对它们时也更容易动摇。

647b1cb54743769e285a.source: ]-10[/color] Resolve when in battle with undead

73459b0266302029336b.source: There are a lot of old friends to meet in the afterlife. This character is not afraid of death.
73459b0266302029336b.translation: 彼岸还有不少老朋友等着重逢。此角色并不惧怕死亡。

1971baac51e12a5bc7e6.source: With a physique like an eggshell, this guy is not the natural born brawler.
1971baac51e12a5bc7e6.translation: 此角色的身板脆得像蛋壳，天生就不是肉搏的料。

bc8043add3ba8229b37d.source: Forged in the arenas of the south, this character has fought many a battle, and every blow will only strengthen his indomitable will and endurance. His fabulous lifestyle demands high pay, but he'll never desert you and can't be dismissed. If all three original members should die, your campaign ends.
bc8043add3ba8229b37d.translation: 南方的竞技场造就了这位身经百战的勇士，每一次打击都只会磨炼他不屈的意志与耐力。他奢华的生活需要高额薪酬，但他绝不会背叛，也无法被解雇。若最初的三名角斗士全部阵亡，战役便会结束。

e62d401ae346309e3270.source: Gains 5% damage reduction with every hit taken, up to a limit of 25%
e62d401ae346309e3270.translation: 每受到一次命中，获得5%伤害减免，最多叠加至25%

5997d9576ba8fe213783.source: Forged in the arenas of the south, this character has fought many a battle, and is an expert in dispatching multiple opponents in a row. His fabulous lifestyle demands high pay, but he'll never desert you  and can't be dismissed. If all three original members should die, your campaign ends.
5997d9576ba8fe213783.translation: 南方的竞技场造就了这位身经百战的勇士，他擅长接连击杀多个对手。他奢华的生活需要高额薪酬，但他绝不会背叛，也无法被解雇。若最初的三名角斗士全部阵亡，战役便会结束。

dc23768e864ee6e3412f.source: Upon killing an enemy on their turn, this character immediately regains [color=
dc23768e864ee6e3412f.translation: 此角色在自己的回合内击杀敌人后，立即恢复[color=

e789fc2f8eec4e788235.source: Forged in the arenas of the south, this character has fought man and beast alike, and it takes a lot to break his resolve. His fabulous lifestyle demands high pay, but he'll never desert you  and can't be dismissed. If all three original members should die, your campaign ends.
e789fc2f8eec4e788235.translation: 南方的竞技场造就了这位勇士，他与人类和野兽都交过手，决心极难撼动。他奢华的生活需要高额薪酬，但他绝不会背叛，也无法被解雇。若最初的三名角斗士全部阵亡，战役便会结束。

38b3b6cc47d48329e0b4.source: Re-roll every failed morale check for a second chance
38b3b6cc47d48329e0b4.translation: 每次士气检定失败后，可重新检定一次

b5c53bfc91b91da9d53b.source: Tasty, let's have another one! Better bring extra provisions when traveling with this character and expect them to leave fast if you ever run out of provisions entirely.
b5c53bfc91b91da9d53b.translation: 好吃，再来一份！带着此角色旅行时，最好多备些食物。一旦彻底断粮，他很快就会离开。

d970d099cfd5a7fceb69.source: I want more! This character is greedy and will demand a higher daily payment than others with a similar background, as well as being fast to leave you if you ever run out of crowns.
d970d099cfd5a7fceb69.translation: 我还要更多！此角色贪得无厌，要求的日薪高于出身相近的其他人。若你花光了克朗，他也会很快离开。

766cb060c60aab19e6c2.source: Some past event in this character's life has fueled a burning hatred for all things wild and monstrous.
766cb060c60aab19e6c2.translation: 过去的某次经历，让此角色对一切荒野凶兽都怀有刻骨的仇恨。

9b9b841feb48b5d0b997.source: ]+10[/color] Resolve when in battle with beasts

484d2a608f4d50ced0ac.source: Some past event in this character's life has fueled a burning hatred for all things green and mean.
484d2a608f4d50ced0ac.translation: 过去的某次经历，让此角色对一切凶恶的绿皮都怀有刻骨的仇恨。

f22192ddcb23c231aa07.source: ]+10[/color] Resolve when in battle with greenskins

6a30e09596348cdb38bc.source: Some past event in this character's life has fueled a burning hatred for all things that refuse to stay six feet underground.
6a30e09596348cdb38bc.translation: 过去的某次经历，让此角色对一切不肯安分躺在地下的死物都怀有刻骨的仇恨。

2b0fa00f1f588917f205.source: ]+10[/color] Resolve when in battle with undead

76506d937d35b19d894d.source: Umm... well... maybe. This character is hesitant to act.
76506d937d35b19d894d.translation: 呃……这个……也许吧。此角色总是迟迟拿不定主意。

faf097f4cddcc9cf9b75.source: Being particularly huge and burly, this character's strikes hurt plenty, but he's also a bigger target than most.
faf097f4cddcc9cf9b75.translation: 此角色身材格外高大魁梧，出手很重，却也比旁人更容易成为靶子。

7c7bb6307c1cf9f64798.source: Let's go already! What's taking so long? This character wants things to get started now.
7c7bb6307c1cf9f64798.translation: 快走吧！怎么还没好？此角色一刻也等不及。

8694f4d14c05b2b09a1b.source: I can't do it! This character could use a bit more self confidence.
8694f4d14c05b2b09a1b.translation: 我办不到！此角色实在需要多一点自信。

2914d88bcc931c8378d7.source: This character shakes off hits that would cripple a lesser man.
2914d88bcc931c8378d7.translation: 足以打残旁人的重击，此角色却能硬扛下来。

271843e68ef2137d0d31.source: This character will rarely run out of breath, whether swinging a heavy weapon or running across all the battlefield.
271843e68ef2137d0d31.translation: 无论挥舞沉重的武器，还是奔跑着穿过整个战场，此角色都很少喘不过气来。

23576f3a44c1e31216f9.source: The glass is half empty now but was half full just a moment ago.
23576f3a44c1e31216f9.translation: 刚才还庆幸杯里有半杯水，转眼又抱怨只剩半杯了。

d9a8d1efc5173d912e8d.source: ]-10[/color] Resolve randomly at every morale check
d9a8d1efc5173d912e8d.translation: ]-10[/color]决心，每次士气检定时随机波动

35cb40d516a892f4249c.source: I'm with you! This character is loyal to the end and much less likely to leave you even if you run out of crowns and provisions.
35cb40d516a892f4249c.translation: 我跟定你了！此角色忠心耿耿，即使战团的克朗与食物都已耗尽，也不太可能离开。

3df1c035c149275052b8.source: This character has a natural talent for getting out of harm's way in the last second.
3df1c035c149275052b8.translation: 此角色似乎天生就能在最后一刻躲开危险。

bb0c17aa5a8dc69558c3.source: ]10%[/color] chance to have any attacker require two successful attack rolls in order to hit
bb0c17aa5a8dc69558c3.translation: ]10%[/color]几率使来袭攻击必须连续通过两次命中检定才能命中

9304e15b955eb30efa9b.source: This character has gazed into the abyss, and the abyss has gazed right back at him, turning him quite mad. He often rambles unintelligibly, and his cryptic mind has become inaccessible both to his peers and to the enemy.
9304e15b955eb30efa9b.translation: 此角色凝视过深渊，而深渊也回望着他，彻底逼疯了他。他时常说些难以理解的胡话，诡异的心智既让同伴无法接近，也令敌人无从下手。

14a6ce5fe422a33ccd82.source: ]-15[/color] Resolve randomly at every morale check
14a6ce5fe422a33ccd82.translation: ]-15[/color]决心，每次士气检定时随机波动

f32631c32cb8816da350.source: Immune against fear and mind control abilities
f32631c32cb8816da350.translation: 免疫恐惧与精神控制技能

c3cfde6bdd4d5563ce52.source: During nighttime this character has to be tied to a flock, because he won't be able to see even his own nose.
c3cfde6bdd4d5563ce52.translation: 到了夜里，最好把此角色拴在队伍里，免得走丢——他连自己的鼻子都看不见。

16a5f172770b42ecbd3d.source: Some characters adapt to low light conditions better than others, and this individual is especially good at it.
16a5f172770b42ecbd3d.translation: 有些人更能适应昏暗的环境，而此角色尤其擅长。

4ee11f16aadcea87db5f.source: This character has taken an Oath of Camaraderie, and is sworn to stand and fall together with his allies. The general confusion of higher numbers on the battlefield, and the lack of focus on individual skill and personal glory has taken a toll on this character's resolve at the start of battle, however.
4ee11f16aadcea87db5f.translation: 此角色立下了同袍之誓，誓与战友同生共死。然而，更多人投入战场带来的混乱，以及对个人本领与荣耀的忽视，削弱了他开战时的决心。

5ef5595a3218b002fb9f.source: Will start combat at Wavering or Breaking morale
5ef5595a3218b002fb9f.translation: 以动摇或崩溃士气开始战斗

9f19435d0b6f13b1e167.source: This character has taken an Oath of Distinction, and is sworn to seek his own victories without the support of allies.
9f19435d0b6f13b1e167.translation: 此角色立下了卓越之誓，誓要凭自己的本事赢得胜利，不倚仗战友的援助。

93ab03e1a107a6d0ff4a.source: ]+10[/color] Resolve if there are no allies in adjacent tiles
93ab03e1a107a6d0ff4a.translation: ]+10[/color]决心，相邻地格没有友军时生效

2c30efa087d2c99fc748.source: ]+3[/color] Fatigue Regeneration per turn if there are no allies in adjacent tiles
2c30efa087d2c99fc748.translation: ]+3[/color]每回合疲劳恢复，相邻地格没有友军时生效

94e8728836b4f3789690.source: ]+10%[/color] damage if there are no allies in adjacent tiles
94e8728836b4f3789690.translation: ]+10%[/color]伤害，相邻地格没有友军时生效

9cd8074c8a03f8954b73.source: This character has taken an Oath of Dominion, and is sworn to protect mankind from the savagery of wild beasts.
9cd8074c8a03f8954b73.translation: 此角色立下了统御之誓，誓要保护人类，抵御凶残野兽的侵袭。

0b8623e8c6bfca56a332.translation: ]+10[/color]近战命中，与野兽作战时生效

8bd2cfce860d341ff168.translation: ]+10[/color]远程命中，与野兽作战时生效

2fe19077414e8428fda6.source: ]-5[/color] Melee Skill when not fighting beasts
2fe19077414e8428fda6.translation: ]-5[/color]近战命中，未与野兽作战时生效

1264748f5c6bea4c78dd.source: ]-5[/color] Ranged Skill when not fighting beasts
1264748f5c6bea4c78dd.translation: ]-5[/color]远程命中，未与野兽作战时生效

de473439e42afb432393.source: This character has taken an Oath of Endurance, and is sworn to outlast any foe in battle.
de473439e42afb432393.translation: 此角色立下了忍耐之誓，誓要在战斗中比任何敌人都坚持得更久。

d4758f63dc2102bfdc22.source: This character has taken an Oath of Fortification, and is sworn to trust in his shield above all else.
d4758f63dc2102bfdc22.translation: 此角色立下了坚守之誓，誓要将全部信任交给手中的盾牌。

60f02b947b5aae6946ac.source: The 'Shield Wall' shield skill grants an additional [color=
60f02b947b5aae6946ac.translation: 盾牌的“盾墙”技能额外提供[color=

6d487a892d066ca54d0e.source: The 'Knock Back' shield skill has a [color=

775f8f87bfac12b664c0.source: Is focused on defense, and cannot move in the first round of combat
775f8f87bfac12b664c0.translation: 专注防御，战斗第一轮无法移动

a804eaf12f9a683e1e17.source: This character has taken an Oath of Honor, and is sworn to seize victory up close.
a804eaf12f9a683e1e17.translation: 此角色立下了荣誉之誓，誓要与敌人近身搏杀，亲手夺取胜利。

c62f6b1e9bb066aebb92.source: Starts combat at Confident morale if permitted by mood
c62f6b1e9bb066aebb92.translation: 心情允许时，以自信士气开始战斗

473241715e6d5514f5f2.source: Cannot use ranged attacks or tools
473241715e6d5514f5f2.translation: 无法使用远程攻击或工具

ce9a6ec4be686ba2a5f2.source: This character has taken an Oath of Humility, and is sworn to self-reflection and self-improvement.
ce9a6ec4be686ba2a5f2.translation: 此角色立下了谦卑之誓，誓要反省自身、磨炼本领。

aabfa2976f1c091e0807.source: This character has taken an Oath of Righteousness, and is sworn to put the living dead to their final rest.
aabfa2976f1c091e0807.translation: 此角色立下了正义之誓，誓要让行走的死者得到最终的安息。

efd47f0f6740d6f3f176.translation: ]+10[/color]近战命中，与亡灵作战时生效

912edcee53689f462f11.translation: ]+10[/color]远程命中，与亡灵作战时生效

39ecc917dbbcc65f73f1.translation: ]+5[/color]近战防御，与亡灵作战时生效

9d036e0c567a7608940c.translation: ]+5[/color]远程防御，与亡灵作战时生效

2556769b89d4f48e155a.source: ]-5[/color] Melee Skill when not fighting undead
2556769b89d4f48e155a.translation: ]-5[/color]近战命中，未与亡灵作战时生效

50f0978b2ee430a328e4.source: ]-5[/color] Ranged Skill when not fighting undead
50f0978b2ee430a328e4.translation: ]-5[/color]远程命中，未与亡灵作战时生效

9fab7b58c32de163d95e.source: ]-5[/color] Melee Defense when not fighting undead
9fab7b58c32de163d95e.translation: ]-5[/color]近战防御，未与亡灵作战时生效

8a6c182440b96dc40d96.source: ]-5[/color] Ranged Defense when not fighting undead
8a6c182440b96dc40d96.translation: ]-5[/color]远程防御，未与亡灵作战时生效

092ab041902ad4971d2b.source: This character has taken an Oath of Sacrifice, and is sworn to forgo self-care to see the company succeed. Such drive takes a toll on physical well-being, however.
092ab041902ad4971d2b.translation: 此角色立下了牺牲之誓，誓要放下自身安危，全力成就战团。但这份执念也在损害他的身体。

cee338f3f5c581e2c8fa.source: This character has taken an Oath of Valor, and is sworn to hold fast in battle at any cost.
cee338f3f5c581e2c8fa.translation: 此角色立下了勇武之誓，誓要不惜一切代价在战斗中坚守到底。

e549c299eebe4f853718.source: This character has taken an Oath of Vengeance, and is sworn to battle the greenskin menace that plagues mankind.
e549c299eebe4f853718.translation: 此角色立下了复仇之誓，誓要对抗荼毒人类的绿皮。

fed8e80d5fda12e109e7.translation: ]+10[/color]近战命中，与绿皮作战时生效

520768b577354bfd0128.translation: ]+10[/color]远程命中，与绿皮作战时生效

f7edd1b81cba2cfd409a.translation: ]+5[/color]近战防御，与绿皮作战时生效

87991cdb4d69346fd2a8.translation: ]+5[/color]远程防御，与绿皮作战时生效

4e92b609ab89a4d25957.source: ]-5[/color] Melee Skill when not fighting greenskins
4e92b609ab89a4d25957.translation: ]-5[/color]近战命中，未与绿皮作战时生效

5fb73c4b225189f25ed1.source: ]-5[/color] Ranged Skill when not fighting greenskins
5fb73c4b225189f25ed1.translation: ]-5[/color]远程命中，未与绿皮作战时生效

f48bb496567780c6ba21.source: ]-5[/color] Melee Defense when not fighting greenskins
f48bb496567780c6ba21.translation: ]-5[/color]近战防御，未与绿皮作战时生效

48a5d176d5074d7fa8b0.source: ]-5[/color] Ranged Defense when not fighting greenskins
48a5d176d5074d7fa8b0.translation: ]-5[/color]远程防御，未与绿皮作战时生效

dd7d19f3694f91bb01b1.source: This character has taken an Oath of Wrath, and is sworn to smite even the greatest foe.
dd7d19f3694f91bb01b1.translation: 此角色立下了怒火之誓，誓要击败最强大的敌人。

5ce9a030ae31917244db.source: ]+15%[/color] chance to hit when wielding a two-handed or double-gripped melee weapon
5ce9a030ae31917244db.translation: ]+15%[/color]命中率，使用双手近战武器或双手握持近战武器时生效

0d368c2d74790bf140f5.source: All kills are fatalities (if the weapon allows).
0d368c2d74790bf140f5.translation: 所有击杀均以致命处决收尾（武器允许时）。

98cb3563c354825122b6.source: Old age has finally caught up with this character.
98cb3563c354825122b6.translation: 岁月终究还是追上了此角色。

7486a885f1d199c18523.translation: ]+5[/color]决心，提升士气的检定中生效

b3c94d1bf618516bfc26.source: I swear that bush over there was moving! This character is extra cautious and reluctant to move ahead.
b3c94d1bf618516bfc26.translation: 我发誓，那边的灌木刚才动了！此角色疑神疑鬼，格外谨慎，不愿贸然前进。

2c6a6ac93a93e72a890f.source: The glass is definitely half empty.
2c6a6ac93a93e72a890f.translation: 杯子明明已经空了一半。

287ecbd964e410fc6794.translation: ]-5[/color]决心，可能降低士气的检定中生效

98a215f10cc83d3a255a.source: This is your player character, or in other words, yourself. If he dies, your campaign ends. You can't dismiss him, and he'll never desert you.
98a215f10cc83d3a255a.translation: 这是你的角色，也就是你自己。他若阵亡，战役便会结束。你无法将他解雇，他也绝不会背叛。

04f77227cd53667a525c.source: Already there! This character is quick to act, often before his opponents do.
04f77227cd53667a525c.translation: 我已经到了！此角色行动迅速，经常抢在敌人之前出手。

7f31fdb884ea44f268fa.source: Is that a tree or an orc over there? This character is short sighted and can not see far.
7f31fdb884ea44f268fa.translation: 那边是棵树，还是个兽人？此角色近视，看不清远处的东西。

bb7cc81d0f22ae21a1d6.source: Who needs more than oatmeal and water? This character finds no joy in eating and will use less provisions, as well as not leaving you as fast should you ever run out of provisions entirely.
bb7cc81d0f22ae21a1d6.translation: 有燕麦粥和水不就够了吗？此角色对美食毫无兴趣，消耗的食物也更少。即使彻底断粮，他也不会那么快离开。

6016ad38936210c79ee0.source: Well fed and buffed to the max.
6016ad38936210c79ee0.translation: 吃得好，练得壮，浑身都是结实的肌肉。

eeb23ad58c30290173f5.source: It's cursed! This character is highly superstitious and therefore more vulnerable to skills that directly attack his Resolve.
eeb23ad58c30290173f5.translation: 有诅咒！此角色十分迷信，因此更容易受到直接打击决心的技能影响。

83fdbf3deec4719211fb.source: ]-10[/color] Resolve at morale checks against fear, panic or mind control effects
83fdbf3deec4719211fb.translation: ]-10[/color]决心，抵抗恐惧、惊慌或精神控制的士气检定中生效

22d2d2ca6a1d85da39d9.source: A sure footing makes it hard to catch this character off balance and land a hit.
22d2d2ca6a1d85da39d9.translation: 此角色下盘稳健，敌人很难打乱他的平衡并趁隙命中。

6db7e9f11f045b888f7e.source: Why won't you just stay dead? This character is a survivor and will outlive most of his peers.
6db7e9f11f045b888f7e.translation: 你怎么就是死不了？此角色命硬得很，多半能活得比身边的人更久。

f79337c72e64c934bcd0.source: ]90%[/color] chance to survive if struck down and not killed by a fatality
f79337c72e64c934bcd0.translation: ]90%[/color]几率在被击倒后幸存，前提是未遭到致命处决

ac02596bf4ad4950da9e.source: This character is naturally swift and agile, and has an easier time dodging incoming projectiles.
ac02596bf4ad4950da9e.translation: 此角色天生身手敏捷，更容易躲开飞来的箭矢等远程攻击。

4a50e67b2bfb47ebd7e5.source: This character makes sure to always announce his intentions to his brothers-in-arms. In fact, he'll never shut the hell up. At least it reduces the chance of accidents happening.
4a50e67b2bfb47ebd7e5.translation: 此角色总会把自己的行动意图告诉战友。说实在的，他那张嘴根本停不下来。至少能少出些误伤事故。

123aafc2582f2b46aecb.source: ]50%[/color] lower chance to inflict friendly fire

63dff295cc6726f762e4.source: Being very short of height, this character is used to slipping through.
63dff295cc6726f762e4.translation: 此角色个头矮小，早已习惯在人缝间钻来钻去。

691952be4d1180d46121.source: This character is tough as nails, shrugging off hits and blows.
691952be4d1180d46121.translation: 此角色坚韧得像铁钉，拳脚重击也难以将他打垮。

833c2a7e0ce769b23b8a.source: This character is swift as a weasel. Unfortunately, he seems to only be able to call on this ability when running to save his hide.
833c2a7e0ce769b23b8a.translation: 此角色像黄鼠狼一样敏捷。可惜，这份本领似乎只有在逃命时才使得出来。

1c4536302c637c298bdd.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img][/p]
[p=c]A simple scenario to learn combat basics. Easy.[/p]
1c4536302c637c298bdd.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img][/p]
[p=c]用于学习战斗基础的简单场景。难度较低。[/p]

86258bf0964f83e557c6.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_133.png[/img][/p]
[p=c]Few and easy opponents all over a map with lots of terrain features blocking sight. Well suited to get used to lines of sight, fog of war and ranged combat. Easy.[/p]
86258bf0964f83e557c6.translation:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_133.png[/img][/p]
