3e20ce9a1a8a2ac75889.source:
{And so it ends.

Crows circle above as the men of the company lie dead or dying, finally having found their match.

The %companyname% will soon be forgotten, but with no shortage of work for hired swords in this world, there is always the next mercenary band to take their place... | Crows cycle above the corpses of the %companyname%, waiting for looters to clear out so they can finally land and feast. It may have fought hard, but the company will be soon forgotten, washed out in a sea of similar violent venture companies to come. | The company has been slain to the last man. Only crows and worms will be in its future. But with no shortage of work for hired swords in this world, there is always the next mercenary band to take their place... | The %companyname% has been slain to its final man. You and the men gave a spirited effort, but that doesn't matter much when you're dead. Perhaps a spirited retreat would have been more suitable? | How lucky you've made the worms who now feast upon your failures as mercenary captain of the %companyname%. The men who died here will soon be forgotten, but with no shortage of work for hired swords in this world, there is always the next mercenary band to take their place... | You stare up at a sky of crows, the light in your world slowly dimming away, your dying body an offering so good that creatures gifted the miracle of flight will set it aside to come down and feast on your corpse. | You were supposed to lead the %companyname% to gold and glory. And perhaps some was found, but of what use is it now that you lie dead? | The %companyname% trusted you to bring them glory, riches, and women. Now they're all dead on the ground, yourself in their company. They'll soon be forgotten by everyone, but with no shortage of work for hired swords in this world, there is always the next mercenary band to take their place... | Crows begin to crowd the skies, blackening it with their shapes, filling it with their sickening squawks. Men come to loot the bodies of you and your men, and so your weapons and gear will continue on, doing biddings beyond your beckoning, beyond your call. | It's difficult to say where you had gone wrong. Was it in the last moments, choosing to stand your ground when you should have run? Was it when you took up the sword for the very first time, feeling it swing comfortably in your grip? Of what use was any of it?

The %companyname% lies dead, but with no shortage of work for hired swords in this world, there is always the next mercenary band to take their place... | A crow lands on your foot, perched there, seeing you through to death with a sexton's stare. The rest of the company is laid out across the earth, looters already picking through them for goods to take. | You fought a good fight, at least that's what you tell yourself as the light of the world slowly slips away.

The company's name will soon fade from history, but with no shortage of work for hired swords in this world, there is always the next mercenary band to take their place... | You thought death would be like sleeping, but you never remember falling asleep. It just happens. This isn't just happening. All you feel is pain. You wish hard for it to stop, and then it does. | The %companyname% has met its match. It isn't the first time but, in the past, you respected the facts of the situation. Now you did not and all the men beneath your command have paid for the mistake with their lives. | The %companyname% is dead to the last man. A scribe will hear of its passing and make a note in a gloomy candlelit room. And that note will be lost in a flood and all the ink of the %companyname% will disappear with it. | The blood of the %companyname%'s men will be transferred into a scribe's ink, and all its struggles and sufferings relegated to a footnote to be lost in the dark depths of an archive. | Was this the only way? Surely you could have done something differently. You spend your final moments desperately trying to relive a past in which you are not where you are, seeking a solemn remedy to the cruel finality you are about to experience. | Bodies of the %companyname% litter the field, soon to be fed to the worms and crows, all the armor for naught. The men who died here will soon be forgotten, but with no shortage of work for hired swords in this world, there is always the next mercenary band to take their place... |  What a gift you are, having spent all this time and gold collecting arms and armor for your men, just to give it all away to a bunch of looters. Your bodily donations to the crows and worms will also be well received. Congratulations. | The history of the %companyname% will be forgotten a few years from now. In that moment, a barkeep will be asked about mercenaries and he'll pause, thinking it over, and then your face will fade from his memory and your name will pass with it. He will shrug and pour another drink. | As the light leaves your world, you hope that perhaps the name of the %companyname% will live on and that people will remember what they did. They won't. | As the pain seizes your body, you simply let the corporeal world go, retreating into your own mind, barricading yourself there, desperately seeking any good reason for why you chose this life, because it seems readily obvious now that the life you chose also chose your death. | The %companyname% is dead to the last man, your corpse amongst the bodies, no rank or order to be followed now. Was it fated? In your death, will others rise? Or will the world be as it always has been? | The cruel finality you have doled out upon others has returned in totality, claiming the lives of the entirety of the %companyname%. Few will speak of you, and certainly no more than the crows who squawk out claims to your corpses. With no shortage of work for hired swords in this world, there is always the next mercenary band to take their place... | The %companyname% has been annihilated to the last brother. Looters now pick through the bodies, calling out what they find with excited surprise. You've made their day, a shame it had to happen in your last.}
3e20ce9a1a8a2ac75889.translation:
{一切就这样结束了。

乌鸦在头顶盘旋，弟兄们横七竖八地倒在地上，或已死去，或正垂死挣扎。你们终究撞上了无法战胜的对手。

%companyname%很快就会被人遗忘。但这世上从不缺雇人挥剑的活计，总会有下一支佣兵团来接替你们…… | 乌鸦在%companyname%的尸体上空盘旋，等着拾荒者离开，好落下来大快朵颐。你们或许曾拼死奋战，可后来还会有无数靠杀人谋生的战团涌现，很快就将你们淹没，抹去人们对你们的记忆。 | 战团已全军覆没。等待你们的，只剩乌鸦和蛆虫。但这世上从不缺雇人挥剑的活计，总会有下一支佣兵团来接替你们…… | %companyname%已战至最后一人。你和弟兄们奋勇拼杀，可人都死了，这又有什么用？或许当时奋勇逃命，才是更好的选择。 | 你身为%companyname%团长的失败，倒让蛆虫们交了好运，如今正饱餐一顿。死在这里的人很快就会被遗忘。但这世上从不缺雇人挥剑的活计，总会有下一支佣兵团来接替你们…… | 你仰望满天乌鸦，眼前的光亮渐渐暗去。你这具将死的身躯，是如此丰盛的供品，连那些天生能翱翔天际的生灵，都甘愿落到地上，来啄食你的尸体。 | 你本该带领%companyname%赢得金钱与荣耀。或许你确实挣到了些，可如今人已死去，那些又有什么用？ | %companyname%的弟兄相信，你会为他们带来荣耀、财富和女人。如今，他们全都横尸在地，而你也躺在其中。很快，所有人都会忘记你们。但这世上从不缺雇人挥剑的活计，总会有下一支佣兵团来接替你们…… | 乌鸦越聚越多，黑影遮住天空，刺耳的叫声令人作呕。有人来翻捡你和弟兄们的尸体。你们的武器与装备还会继续征战，只是再也不会听从你的号令，再也不会回应你的呼唤。 | 很难说，你究竟从哪一步开始走错。是最后关头本该逃跑，却选择了坚守？还是第一次拿起剑，觉得它握在手里如此趁手的那一刻？到头来，这一切又有什么意义？

%companyname%已尽数倒下。但这世上从不缺雇人挥剑的活计，总会有下一支佣兵团来接替你们…… | 一只乌鸦落在你的脚上，稳稳栖着，用守墓人般的目光，目送你咽下最后一口气。其他弟兄的尸体散落满地，拾荒者已经开始翻找值钱的东西。 | 你打了一场好仗。至少，在世间的光亮渐渐从眼前消失时，你是这样告诉自己的。

战团的名字很快就会从历史中淡去。但这世上从不缺雇人挥剑的活计，总会有下一支佣兵团来接替你们…… | 你以为死亡就像睡去，可你从来不记得自己是如何入睡的——不知不觉，便睡着了。眼下却全然不是这样。你只感觉到疼痛。你拼命祈求它停下来，然后，它终于停了。 | %companyname%遇上了无法战胜的敌人。这并非头一回，可从前，你总肯正视形势。这一次你没有，而你麾下的所有弟兄，都为这个错误付出了性命。 | %companyname%已无一人生还。一名书记员会听说你们的覆灭，在昏暗的烛光下记上一笔。后来，那张纸会毁于洪水，关于%companyname%的所有墨迹，也随之消失。 | %companyname%弟兄们流的血，最终化作书记员笔下的一点墨。你们所有的挣扎与苦难，只剩一则脚注，被埋进卷宗不见天日的深处。 | 难道只能这样结束吗？你分明可以做出别的选择。生命的最后一刻，你拼命回想另一种过去——一个不会把你带到此处的过去，徒劳地想从中找到一点慰藉，抵御眼前残酷而无可挽回的终局。 | %companyname%的尸体铺满战场，很快就会成为蛆虫和乌鸦的食粮。那一身护甲终究什么也没护住。死在这里的人很快就会被遗忘。但这世上从不缺雇人挥剑的活计，总会有下一支佣兵团来接替你们…… |  你可真是个大善人。花了这么多时间和金钱，为弟兄们置办武器护甲，到头来，全白送给了一群拾荒者。至于你们捐给乌鸦和蛆虫的身躯，想必也会大受欢迎。可喜可贺。 | 再过几年，%companyname%的故事就会被人遗忘。到了那时，有人向酒保打听佣兵的事，他会停下来想一想。然后，你的面容便从他的记忆里消散，连同你的名字一起。他耸耸肩，继续倒酒。 | 世间的光亮正离你而去。你盼着%companyname%的名字能流传下去，盼着世人记住你们曾做过的事。他们不会。 | 剧痛攫住你的身体，你索性放开眼前的世界，退入自己的脑海，把自己死死关在里面。你拼命想找出一个像样的理由，解释自己为何选择这条路。因为如今已再清楚不过：你选择的活法，也替你选好了死法。 | %companyname%无一人生还，你的尸体也倒在弟兄们中间。此处已不分高低，再无号令。这是命中注定吗？会有人踏着你的死亡崛起吗？还是说，这世界仍会一如往常？ | 你曾赐给别人的残酷终结，如今悉数奉还，夺走了%companyname%所有人的性命。今后少有人会提起你们，说得肯定还没那些争抢尸体的乌鸦多。但这世上从不缺雇人挥剑的活计，总会有下一支佣兵团来接替你们…… | %companyname%已覆灭，连最后一个弟兄也未能幸免。拾荒者正翻捡尸体，每找到一件东西，就惊喜地高声报给同伴。你们让他们过了愉快的一天。可惜，这一天恰好是你们的最后一天。}

165bc8e079b14ed02367.source: {Your dreams are more realistic than the life you've led! Under your command, not only did the %companyname% reach enormous heights of wealth, honor, and renown, you helped defeat a multitude of evils, invasions, and wars that nearly wrecked the entire realm! | The %companyname% is a name known throughout the land. Not only has it amassed wealth, power, and renown, it has been critical in defeating a number of crises that plagued the land. Scribes and historians will speak of the company so that even thousands of years from now people shall know the %companyname%! | After retiring, a scribe came to you with an artist at his side. They drew a figure of you and wrote down your words onto a very, very long scroll. It appears, having defeated multiple crises and amassed incredible wealth, people many years from now will know the name of the %companyname%. | Leaving the %companyname% wasn't easy, but you knew in your heart that it was the right choice. And it couldn't have been made at a better time: the company was renowned throughout the land, it had helped defeat a series of crises, and, most crucial of all, had attained unheard of levels of wealth. | Behind your leadership, the %companyname% acquired great fame around the land, not to mention considerable thanks for helping end a series of crises that threatened the entire realm! Mercenaries don't often make it into the history books, but you've no doubt that the scribes and scholars will run out of ink writing about the %companyname%!}
165bc8e079b14ed02367.translation: {连你做的梦，都比你这辈子的经历更像真的！在你的指挥下，%companyname%不仅积累了惊人的财富、荣誉与声望，还协助平息了无数险些毁掉整个天下的灾祸、入侵与战争！ | %companyname%的名号响彻天下。你们不仅拥有财富、实力与声望，更在化解席卷各地的多场危机时发挥了关键作用。书记员和史学家会写下战团的事迹，让千年之后的人也知道%companyname%的名字！ | 退隐后，一名书记员带着画师来拜访你。他们画下你的模样，又把你的话记在一张长得惊人的卷轴上。看来，凭着平息多场危机的功业，以及积累下的巨额财富，%companyname%的名字会被许多年之后的人们记住。 | 离开%companyname%并不容易，可你心里明白，这是正确的选择。时机也好得不能再好：战团名扬天下，协助化解了接连而来的危机。更要紧的是，你们挣到了从未有过的巨额财富。 | 在你的带领下，%companyname%声名远扬。你们协助终结了多场威胁整个天下的危机，也赢得了世人由衷的感激！佣兵鲜少名留史册，可你毫不怀疑，书记员和学者光是记述%companyname%的事迹，就能把墨水用个精光！}

4de47a64b2eaae1b8a32.source: {The other day, a hermit came up to your cabin asking if you knew of the %companyname%. You shook your head and feigned interest. The wildman says it is the greatest company in all the land. You asked him if he was totally sure about that. The hermit shrank back as if you'd insulted him personally.%SPEECH_ON%Am I sure? Mister, you'd best sit down. Let me tell you all about the %companyname%. First off, they say the man who ran it was seven-feet tall and made of all muscle. Went by the name of...%SPEECH_OFF% | It wasn't the easiest move to leave the company behind, but there's a room in your keep that lets you swim around in gold crowns so it's not too bad. | Now you spend your days not even sure what to do with all your gold. A lot of people come by the keep. Wenches of all shapes and sizes... strange men with even stranger, gold-sucking ideas... and a great deal of cloaked noble princes humbling themselves by asking for advice on warfare. Some days, while chopping away in your garden, you think about getting back into the field. Boredom, as it turns out, is the most sickly and nasty of beasts you've faced yet. | A man came by your keep the other day. He wanted help on starting a mercenary band, obviously taking inspiration from your own feats. You asked how many other successful sellswords he'd talked to. He shrugged.%SPEECH_ON%You're the only one so far.%SPEECH_OFF%You nodded back.%SPEECH_ON%That's right. I'm the only one despite hundreds of men like me having been out there. Maybe it's cause I'm that good, but I think the truth is that I'm just that lucky. So if you want my advice on starting a mercenary company, don't. That's all. One of my servants will show you the door. Good day now.%SPEECH_OFF% | While tending to your garden, you find a mouse nibbling on one of your tomatoes. It's so buzzed on the flavors you easily capture the rodent and hold it in both hands. Despondent defeatism spreads across its face as you stare at it, half its maw still gnawing away on a bit of tomato. A servant rushes over.%SPEECH_ON%I can rid you of that, my lord.%SPEECH_OFF%You stare at the servant and then back at the mouse.%SPEECH_ON%No, no I think I'll keep it. I could use a friend.%SPEECH_OFF%The servant looks down. You slap him on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%Cheer up now. You're my friend, too!%SPEECH_OFF%The servant smiles.%SPEECH_ON%Thank you, my lord.%SPEECH_OFF%}
4de47a64b2eaae1b8a32.translation: {前几天，一个隐士来到你的小屋，问你听没听过%companyname%。你摇摇头，装出很感兴趣的模样。这荒野里的家伙说，那可是全天下最厉害的战团。你问他是否当真如此。他向后一缩，仿佛受了莫大的侮辱。%SPEECH_ON%当真？先生，你最好先坐下。我来给你好好讲讲%companyname%。先说那位团长吧，听说他有七尺高，浑身上下都是腱子肉，名字叫……%SPEECH_OFF% | 离开战团实在不易，不过你的城堡里有一间屋子，克朗多得够你在里面游泳。所以，倒也不算太难熬。 | 如今，你每天都在发愁：这么多金子，究竟该怎么花？城堡里访客不断。有各色各样的女人，有满脑子古怪点子、专盯着你钱袋的怪人，还有许多披着斗篷的贵族王公，屈尊前来向你讨教用兵之道。有时候，你在园里挥锄，心里又会冒出重返战场的念头。原来，无聊才是你遇见过的最缠人、最难对付的怪物。 | 前几天，一个男人来到你的城堡，想请你指点如何组建佣兵团。显然，你的功业给了他不少鼓舞。你问他，在你之前还请教过多少功成身退的佣兵。他耸耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%到目前为止，只有你。%SPEECH_OFF%你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%没错，只有我。可跟我一样出去闯荡的，少说也有几百人。或许真是我本事过人，不过我觉得，实情大概只是我运气够好。所以，若你真想听我对组建佣兵团的建议，那就是：别干。就这些。仆人会送你出去。慢走。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你在园中干活时，发现一只老鼠正啃着番茄。它吃得太投入，竟被你轻轻松松地捧进双手。你盯着它，它摆出一副认命的模样，嘴边却还在嚼那点番茄。一个仆人赶过来。%SPEECH_ON%大人，我来替您处理掉。%SPEECH_OFF%你看看仆人，又看看老鼠。%SPEECH_ON%不，不用了。我想把它留下。我正缺个伴。%SPEECH_OFF%仆人垂下眼睛。你拍拍他的肩膀。%SPEECH_ON%打起精神来。你也是我的朋友！%SPEECH_OFF%仆人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%谢谢您，大人。%SPEECH_OFF%}

7ee65b0052717500a09b.source: {It's very rare for a mercenary to leave the life behind with his body intact, but you managed to do just that. While being of sound body and mind are important, you most appreciate the pile of crowns you spend your nights sleeping on. Last you heard, the nobles were squabbling their way into another war and you could not care less. | With good mind and health, you continue to live out the rest of your days in moderate peace. The most awful thing to happen to you in months was when a hermit ventured out of the wilderness to steal your firewood. That's the sort of life you always wanted and you could not be happier having it.}
7ee65b0052717500a09b.translation: {佣兵能全须全尾地退出这一行，实在难得，而你偏偏做到了。身心健全固然可贵，可你最中意的，还是每晚能枕着入睡的那堆克朗。最后一次听到外面的消息，是贵族们又吵吵嚷嚷地要打仗了。你半点也不关心。 | 如今你身子骨硬朗，脑子也清醒，余生过得还算太平。这几个月里遇到的最糟心的事，不过是有个隐士从荒野里跑出来，偷了你的柴火。这正是你一直想过的日子，如今终于如愿，你再满足不过了。}

73a7ee24301be3143e7c.source:
{When you took over the %companyname%, you did not foresee history rising up to repeat itself in the worst way possible. 'The Battle of Many Names' was just something you'd heard about, but to see the impetuous behind it - a great invasion of greenskins - repeat itself in your own lifetime was quite the sight. And you were ready to meet it.

 Though the company is unlikely to see very many mentions in the histories of the world, you've no doubt that it proved crucial in defeating the green savages. If not, then why else do you have an enormous pile of gold to speak for?

 And it was upon that pile of coin you decided to retire, leaving the outfit in the best hands available. | The Battle of Many Names, that's what the scribes called the great clash between all of mankind and the vast hordes of greenskins. You thought those stories were of a bygone age, but the horde of savages pouring over the eastern horizons proved otherwise. This time, the orcs and goblins learned to invade all across the land instead of in one place. Despite their new strategy, the world of man had a new weapon: the %companyname%.

 Perhaps it is just your own pride speaking, but you truly believe your company's admittedly greedy ventures proved crucial in turning the tides of green back. And with the greenskins defeated, you found yourself with a pile of gold to retire on, leaving the command of the company in the hands of its best and brightest.}
73a7ee24301be3143e7c.translation:
{接手%companyname%时，你从未想过，历史竟会以最糟糕的方式重演。“众名之战”原本只是个听来的故事，可引发那场战争的绿皮大举入侵，竟在你有生之年再度上演。眼前的景象足以令人震撼，而你早已准备好迎战。

史书或许不会给战团留下太多篇幅，但你毫不怀疑，你们在击败那些绿皮蛮族的过程中起了关键作用。否则，又该怎么解释你手边这堆高得吓人的金子？

也正是靠着这笔钱，你决定退隐，把战团交给最可靠的人。 | 众名之战——史官如此称呼全人类与绿皮大军之间的那场惨烈交锋。你以为那早已属于逝去的年代，直到蛮族从东方的地平线上蜂拥而来。这一次，兽人和地精学会了在各地同时进犯，不再只盯着一处。可他们有新战术，人类也有新利器：%companyname%。

也许只是你在自鸣得意，但你真心相信，战团那些贪财的冒险——这点你承认——确实是击退绿皮狂潮的关键。绿皮败退后，你也攒下了足够退隐的金子，便把指挥权交给战团里最出色、最有才干的人。}

670872cf0c516efa8dcf.source: {Some nights you wake up, sweat on your head, a berserker's growl fading into the stillborn memories of a dream rendered incomplete. These nightmares won't leave you alone, proving themselves the ultimate price for your newfound treasures. While the %companyname% is doing well, you sometimes wonder if it'd be best that you were leading it again. In the 'peace' of your retirement you've learned that the horrors that you can grab and kill are a world's difference from those which lurk amongst your worst fears. | Your days are now spent tending to a garden and slaying the rabbits which venture into your newfound domain. Every so often you'll get wind of the %companyname%'s doings, stories about its successes and, unfortunately, the occasional news that one of the brothers has fallen. These tales are a welcomed respite from days upon days of chasing rabbits out of your garden. You spent so much time fighting, you never realized what wars were waged between men of harvest and these goddam nibbling monsters.}
670872cf0c516efa8dcf.translation: {有些夜里，你会猛然惊醒，额头满是冷汗。兽人狂战士的咆哮还在耳边回荡，转瞬又消散在残缺的梦影里。这些噩梦始终不肯放过你，仿佛你挣下的财富，到头来都要用它们偿还。%companyname%如今过得不错，可你有时还是会想：也许回去领着他们，反倒更好。在退隐的“太平”日子里，你终于明白：能抓住、能杀死的恐怖，与藏在心底的恐惧，完全是两回事。 | 如今，你每天侍弄园子，顺手宰掉那些胆敢闯入这片新领地的兔子。偶尔也会听到%companyname%的消息：又打了什么胜仗，以及，令人遗憾的，又有哪个弟兄倒下了。比起日复一日地把兔子赶出菜园，这些消息总算让生活有了些变化。你打了大半辈子仗，竟一直不知道，种地的人和这些该死的啃菜怪物之间，也有如此惨烈的战争。}

839a54a3ce671ce25466.source:
{You thought you understood the cruelties of the world. When you took over the %companyname%, you believed that you could always be sure in leading the company to riches and renown. Dead men coming up out of their graves has a way of defeating this sort of naivety. But you were quick to adapt, earnestly seeking out contracts that would pay the most to deal with this bizarre and surreal threat. The undead hordes were eventually beaten back to whence they came.

 Crowns, honor, prestige, they had all been earned. You decided to retire, leaving the company in the trust of its best men. | When you took over the %companyname% you could not have possibly foresaw the future in which it was pivotal in defeating hordes of undead invaders. Unusual bounties on the dead proved incredibly profitable, however, and with a pile of gold made in the wake of the great evil's passing, you took the moment to retire. The %companyname% was left in the care of the members you trusted most.}
839a54a3ce671ce25466.translation:
{你曾以为，自己已经见识过世道有多残酷。接手%companyname%时，你相信，总能带着弟兄们挣到钱、闯出名声。可死人从坟墓里爬出来的时候，这点天真也就保不住了。不过，你适应得很快，专挑报酬丰厚的委托，去对付这种怪异得如同噩梦的威胁。最终，亡灵大军被赶回了它们爬出的地方。

克朗、荣誉、威望，你都已收入囊中。于是你决定退隐，把战团托付给最能干的弟兄。 | 接手%companyname%时，你无论如何也想不到，这支队伍日后竟会成为击败亡灵大军的关键。然而，悬赏死人这种怪事，做起来却极其赚钱。大祸平息后，你攒下了成堆的金子，便趁此机会退了下来，把%companyname%交给最信任的弟兄们。}

4340c2c34ee784838a94.source: {Nowadays, you spend a good deal of time wondering if you should add a second story to your cabin, or whether that's too much work. You could always pay someone else to help, but it just feels strange contracting someone else to the task. And, as far as the %companyname% is concerned, you've heard that it is doing splendidly well to this day. | You spend your days flirting with the neighbor. She's married, but that's what makes it more fun. The constable came by to speak to you about your newfound proclivities. This is about the height of the drama in your life now. It isn't dodging orcs or putting undead souls back into the grave, but it has its own unique sense of fun. You don't miss the old life at all. Instead, you can happily sit back and hear of the %companyname%'s successes.}
4340c2c34ee784838a94.translation: {如今，你常常琢磨要不要给小屋加盖一层，又嫌这活计太麻烦。雇人帮忙当然也行，可换成你给别人发委托，总觉得有点别扭。至于%companyname%，听说直到今天仍然混得风生水起。 | 你每天都忙着逗弄邻家的女人。她有丈夫，可这才更有意思。治安官还特意登门，跟你谈了谈这项新爱好。如今，你的日子再热闹也不过如此。虽然比不上躲兽人的斧头，或把亡灵塞回坟墓，却也别有一番趣味。你一点也不怀念从前。现在，只需舒舒服服地坐着，听人说起%companyname%的捷报，就足够了。}

bafc6f18d571c66d7e72.source: {Commanding the %companyname%, you thought it might play the part of sellsword with a dash of brigandage. Little did you realize that the whole world would be embroiled in religious turmoil. When the north and south turned on each other with their holy furies, you captained the company to opulent ends. If the old gods' followers asked for your sword, you brought the might and main of the northern mountains. If the Gilded asked for light, you brought the sun. | It is said that the godlier the man, the more human the god. When the religious shatterbelt between north and south exploded, all manner of religious chiselers washed across the holy transom. The sacred sort deified their own spirits, sharpening the utility of war as if it were the gods themselves which commanded it. Perhaps they did, but ultimately all you were concerned about was that the %companyname% serve itself. Gilder? Old gods? All you cared about were your own pockets and by the end of all that holy nonsense they were quite full indeed.}
bafc6f18d571c66d7e72.translation: {带领%companyname%时，你原本只打算接接雇佣活计，偶尔顺手干点劫掠，哪想到整个世界都会卷进宗教纷争。南北双方怒火中烧，以信仰之名向彼此开战，你则带着战团赚了个盆满钵满。旧神的信徒要借你的剑，你便让他们见识北境山岳般的威势；镀金之民要光明，你就给他们送上整个太阳。 | 都说人越是自诩虔诚，神明就越像他们自己。南北之间的宗教矛盾一朝爆发，各路披着信仰外衣的骗子便蜂拥而出。那些所谓的圣人，把自己的意志奉为神谕，将战争使唤得愈发顺手，仿佛真是神明亲自下令。也许确实如此。可到头来，你只关心%companyname%能不能替自己挣到好处。镀金者？旧神？你眼里只有自己的钱袋。等那些神圣的胡闹终于结束，钱袋果然已经装得满满当当。}

0c6fbcc6253303ca1b2c.source: {Few sellsword bands survive, and even fewer yet arrive in the annals of history. You believe that the %companyname%, through action in the holy war, very well may have earned itself a proper footnote. The thought amuses you, for how much can one or two sentences really say about all that you have done and experienced? | With retirement from the %companyname%, you actually find yourself with proper time to mull over these old gods and the Gilder. Maybe there is some truth to one or the other? Perhaps they are both correct. Or, and you weigh these thoughts gingerly, perhaps neither is right. But these faiths are not alone it seems. Religious uprisings are springing up everywhere, cast out in the debris of the religious wars no doubt, and just the other day, a third major entrant arrived, one you've come to be all too knowledgeable about: a Disciple of Davkul. As he professed his thoughts on the dark and the arcane, you shut the door on his face. Maybe another time. You've wood to chop and a sock drawer to organize.}
0c6fbcc6253303ca1b2c.translation: {佣兵团能善终的少，能名留青史的更少。你觉得，凭借圣战中的作为，%companyname%或许配得上在史书里占个脚注。想到这里，你不禁失笑：区区一两句话，又能写出你那些经历的几分呢？ | 从%companyname%退下来后，你总算有时间好好琢磨旧神和镀金者的事了。会不会有一方真说中了什么？也许双方都有道理。又或者——你小心翼翼地掂量着这个念头——两边都错了。不过，这世上似乎远不止这两种信仰。各地不断冒出宗教暴动，想来都是那场圣战留下的余波。就在前几天，第三路人马也找上了门：一个达夫库尔门徒。这些人，你实在太熟悉了。他正滔滔不绝地讲着黑暗与秘术，你就在他眼前关上了门。改天吧。你还有柴要劈，袜子抽屉也该收拾了。}

d4b1412e5c671b5c14c7.source:
You rebuilt well the %companyname%. You worked hard to bolster its ranks with fresh bodies, and you worked even harder to make sure that the name meant something again across the land. When you finally retired, you left %highestbravery_bro% in command of the company and wished him well.

Under his leadership, the %companyname% did well enough, working wherever there was coin to be made for crossing swords.

Then, several months after your leave, a feud between noble houses escalated. %highestbravery_bro% didn't hesistate to seize this opportunity to fill the company's coffers with spoils of war, but others chose to seek a different path.
d4b1412e5c671b5c14c7.translation:
你让%companyname%重振了旗鼓。你费尽心力招兵买马，又付出更多心血，让这个名字重新响彻各地。终于退隐时，你把战团交给%highestbravery_bro%，祝他往后一切顺利。

在他的带领下，%companyname%过得还不错。哪里有人肯出钱请他们拔剑，他们就去哪里。

然而，你离开几个月后，贵族家族之间的一场纷争愈演愈烈。%highestbravery_bro%毫不犹豫地抓住了机会，打算靠战利品填满战团的钱箱，可另一些人却选择了别的出路。

cd2758cfe954c307e240.source:
Nobles play their own dangerous game, and %highestbravery_bro% didn't see what was coming. A few successful skirmishes into the war, the %companyname% found themselves pitted against superior numbers with no way out and no reinforcements coming to their aid. They were made a pawn sacrifice, discarded as a ruse to draw out the enemy and strike elsewhere. Mercenaries are easily replaced, and dead ones don't ask to be paid, after all. It was a battle of little consequence to the war, but it was a devastating defeat for the company from which it never recovered.

The war raged on for another two years, but few still remembered the name '%companyname%' when it was over...
cd2758cfe954c307e240.translation:
贵族们有自己的险恶棋局，%highestbravery_bro%却未能看穿。开战后，%companyname%接连打赢了几场小仗，随后却陷入重围：敌军人数远胜己方，既无退路，也无援军。他们成了一枚被舍弃的棋子，用来引出敌人，好让主力转攻别处。毕竟，佣兵没了可以再找，死掉的更不会来讨军饷。这场战斗对整个战局无足轻重，却让战团遭受了毁灭性的打击，从此一蹶不振。

战争又持续了两年。等到战事结束，已没有多少人还记得%companyname%这个名字……

6a155c572e78a5bd4a39.source: {But that's just business for mercenaries. Some make it, some don't. No company lives forever and fewer yet will see so much as a line of mention in the history books. You plan to comfortably live out the rest of your days and hope those who survived their time in sellswording do the same. | And that's just the mercenary's life. Some win, some lose. Well, most just lose. You try to put that past out of mind and go on to live the rest of your days in peace. | Now that's just how it is for mercenaries. The only thing that's safe about mercenary work is the understanding that not everyone is going to make it out alive. Everyone knows this when they sign on, yourself included. You got lucky, others did not. That's just how it is. You plan to live out the rest of your days as well as you can, not only for yourself, but for those that didn't make it.}
6a155c572e78a5bd4a39.translation: {可佣兵这行就是如此。有人能熬出头，有人不能。没有哪个战团能长存，能在史书里留下一行字的就更少了。你打算安安稳稳地过完余生，也希望那些从刀口下活过来的同行能有同样的福气。 | 佣兵的日子就是这样。有人赢，有人输。好吧，多半都是输。你尽量不再想那些往事，只想平平静静地过完余生。 | 佣兵这行向来如此。干这一行，唯一能确定的，就是不可能人人都活着回来。入伙时大家都明白，你也一样。你运气好，别人没那么走运，仅此而已。你打算尽可能过好剩下的日子，不光为了自己，也为了那些没能活下来的人。}

99a48da5547e6e24d918.source: {Without your leadership, the %companyname% quickly broke apart. Everyone went their own way, but what is a man supposed to do whose only real talent is fighting? | The %companyname% fell apart not long after your retirement. The new leadership chose poorly with its contracts and proved to be an even poorer commander in battle. When making money and winning battles is your business, it's not that surprising the company failed shortly after your departure. | With you no longer leading it, the %companyname% acquired a series of poor contracts that eventually lead to it breaking apart. | You decided to retire from fighting before it got to you like it gets to everyone else - with a sword and an embarrassingly bloodcurdling scream. One of the brothers took over, but while they were great sellswords, there's a world of difference between battling and leading. The %companyname% suffered a series of bad contracts and even worse battles leading to its eventual demise. | Your decision to retire did not come easy, neither for you nor the %companyname% which desperately argued for you to stay. But the time had come and so you went. One of the mercenaries took over as head of the band, but being a good fighter does not make you a great leader and the company soon dissolved. | The mercenaries tried to get you to stay, but you felt it was time to retire from fighting altogether. Last you heard, the %companyname%'s new commander was fooled into a horrible contract. The money wasn't right, and the battle itself went south in a real hurry. The company completely broke apart not long after this misstep.}
99a48da5547e6e24d918.translation: {没有你的带领，%companyname%很快就散了。大家各奔东西。可一个除了打仗，别无所长的人，又能做什么呢？ | 你退隐后没多久，%companyname%就土崩瓦解了。新团长挑委托的眼光很差，临阵指挥的本事更差。既然做的是挣钱打仗的买卖，那战团在你离开后迅速败落，也就不足为奇了。 | 你不再领队后，%companyname%接连挑中糟糕的委托，最终分崩离析。 | 你决定趁战争还没像收拾别人那样收拾你——给你一剑，再逼出一声丢人的凄厉惨叫——便先退出这一行。一个弟兄接了班。可剑使得再好，也未必带得好队伍。%companyname%接连遇上糟糕的委托，打了更糟糕的仗，最终走向覆灭。 | 退隐的决定并不好做，对你如此，对拼命挽留你的%companyname%亦是如此。可时候到了，你还是走了。一名佣兵接任团长，但好战士未必是好头领，战团很快就散了。 | 佣兵们试图留住你，可你觉得，是时候彻底告别厮杀了。你最后听到的消息，是%companyname%的新团长受骗接了一份极其糟糕的委托：报酬少得可怜，战况也迅速急转直下。没过多久，这次失误就让战团彻底散了架。}

1cd8ae845ebbfb91806c.source: {You haven't gotten word from the others, but then, you have your own concerns now that you're retired and your savings are running low... | Now that you are sitting in squalor, a small candle's flame your only company, you're beginning to regret your decision. Things have not gone well for you and the stories of the men you left behind has troubled you greatly. | Now you sit in a shack with a crowd of sleeping strangers crowding for warmth. Using a faint candlelight, you stare at the frayed sigil of the %companyname%. You thumb it back and forth, reliving fond memories to overcome this new poverty, until someone coughs and the light goes out. | Now you sit in the basement of a tavern, sleeping amongst vagrants and vagabonds who've no coin to afford a room just for themselves. You want to get back into mercenary work, but with no coin you'll have to work from the bottom up, probably soldiering beneath some incompetent commander. Death by poverty or death by ineptitude, those seem to be your choices now. | Now you're sitting in a tavern by yourself, putting the last of your coin into a horn of ale. As you down the drink, a tall man enters the pub. Slabs of leather-founded ringmail are stacked on his pants, shoulders, and chest. There's a gold-handled weapon in a silver embroidered sheath. Standing straight with his fists at his hips, he stares about the room.%SPEECH_ON%Which of you men would be keen on killing for coin, hm? I'm looking for sellswords. All I ask is that you know how to swing a sword and that you can't be afraid of one being swung at you.%SPEECH_OFF%You finish your drink and the mercenary turns to you, as though he already knows who you are and what you are capable of. | Word of the others is hard to find. After a few months, you give up on trying to figure out where they are or how they're doing. Instead, you watch your savings slowly dwindle, spending each night fighting off the doubts and thoughts as to why you made this choice in the first place.}
1cd8ae845ebbfb91806c.translation: {你一直没收到其他人的消息。不过，你如今也有自己的烦心事：人已退隐，积蓄却快见底了…… | 如今，你独坐在肮脏的住处，只有一星烛火相伴，开始后悔当初的决定。你的日子过得并不顺心，那些被你留下的弟兄，他们后来的遭遇也让你久久难安。 | 如今，你蜷在一间破棚里，周围是一群挤在一起取暖的陌生人，都已睡去。借着微弱的烛光，你望着%companyname%那枚磨损的纹章。你用拇指来回摩挲，试图靠往日的美好回忆熬过眼前的穷困。忽然有人咳嗽，烛火灭了。 | 如今，你睡在酒馆的地窖里，身边尽是付不起房钱的流浪汉。你想重操旧业，可身无分文，就只能从头做起，多半还得听命于某个无能的团长。要么穷死，要么被蠢货害死——如今，你似乎只剩这两条路。 | 如今，你独坐酒馆，把最后一点钱换成了一角杯啤酒。正喝着，一个高大的男人走了进来。他的腿、肩和胸前，都覆着缝在皮革上的铁环护甲；一柄金柄兵器收在银线绣饰的鞘里。他挺直腰背，双手叉腰，扫视全场。%SPEECH_ON%谁愿意杀人挣钱，嗯？我在招佣兵。要求不高：会挥剑，别人朝你挥剑的时候，别吓破胆。%SPEECH_OFF%你喝完杯中的酒。那佣兵转头看向你，仿佛早就知道你是谁，也知道你有什么本事。 | 你很难打听到其他人的消息。几个月后，你不再追问他们去了哪里、过得如何，只是看着积蓄一天天减少。每到夜里，你都得跟同一个念头苦苦纠缠：当初为什么偏要做这个决定？}

You can't make out who is attacking you in time.
You have to defend yourself!

《战场兄弟》颇具挑战。遭受损失、重整旗鼓，都是游戏的一部分。

29896e6e9d9b50dd064b.source: The hiring fee will be paid immediately on hiring a man for signing up and proving you can back up your words with coin.
29896e6e9d9b50dd064b.translation: 雇佣费用在招募时立即支付，既是签约的报酬，也向对方证明你的承诺有真金白银作保障。

47c63577546336617d71.source: This fee will have to be paid up front for services to be rendered.

5f96d463c6611558fdb6.source: This fee will be paid immediately on giving this recruit a proper inspection to reveal his character traits, if any.

8f4ea7372a8627babb94.source: The daily wage will be paid every single day as payment for serving under your command. The wage is increased automatically by a cumulative 10% per level until the 11th, and then 3% afterwards.
8f4ea7372a8627babb94.translation: 每日都要支付薪水，作为这名弟兄在你麾下效力的报酬。升至11级前，每升一级，日薪会按累积比例增加10%；之后每级增加3%。

Replacing one arrow or bolt will take up one point of ammunition, replacing one shot of a Handgonne will take up two points, and replacing one throwing weapon or charge of a Fire Lance will take up three. Running out of ammunition will leave your quivers empty and your people with nothing to shoot with. You can carry no more than
4003c6438ed4d9421879.translation: 包含箭矢、弩矢和投掷武器，用于在战后自动补充弹药。补充一支箭矢或弩矢消耗一点弹药；补充一发手铳弹药消耗两点；补充一件投掷武器或一次火矛装药消耗三点。弹药耗尽后，弟兄们的箭袋便无从补充，远程武器也将无弹可用。最多可携带

6c82847f5e1102a07771.source: Assorted tools and supplies to keep your weapons, armor, helmets and shields in good condition. One point is required to repair 15 points of item condition. Running out of supplies may result in weapons breaking in combat and will leave your armor damaged and useless.
6c82847f5e1102a07771.translation: 用于保养和修理武器、护甲、头盔及盾牌的各种工具与物资。每消耗一点，可修复15点装备耐久。物资耗尽后，武器可能在战斗中损毁，受损护甲也将无法修复，难以提供有效防护。

2aac9e464443c391e116.source: Repairing all your equipment will take [color=

ef7982ee92c356e1b165.source:
Medical supplies consist of bandages, herbs, salves and the like, and are used to heal the more severe injuries sustained by your men in battle. One point of medical supplies is required each day for every injury to improve and ultimately heal. Lost hitpoints heal on their own.

Running out of medical supplies will leave your men unable to recover from severe injuries.
ef7982ee92c356e1b165.translation:
医疗物资包括绷带、草药和药膏等，用于治疗弟兄们在战斗中遭受的严重创伤。每处创伤每天需要消耗一点医疗物资，才能逐渐好转并最终痊愈。损失的生命值则会自行恢复。

医疗物资耗尽后，弟兄们的严重创伤将无法痊愈。

7278fecfa2af59cb1ebf.translation: 查看战团中所有战斗人员的名册。

4f33bfaa0ee79a524fc1.source: Your renown is your repute as a professional mercenary company and reflects how reliable and competent people judge you to be. The higher your renown, the higher-paid and more difficult contracts people will entrust you with. Renown increases on successfully completing ambitions and contracts, and winning battles, and decreases on failing to do so.
4f33bfaa0ee79a524fc1.translation: 名望体现战团作为职业雇佣兵的声名，也反映人们对你们实力与可靠程度的评价。名望越高，雇主越愿意交给你报酬丰厚、难度更大的委托。完成志向、履行委托和赢得战斗会提高名望，失败则会使其降低。

8d36003fd62c99c6d53d.source: Your reputation reflects how people in the world judge your mercenary company to conduct itself based on past actions. Do you show mercy to your enemies? Do you burn down farmsteads and massacre the peasantry? Based on your reputation, people may offer you different kinds of contracts, and both contracts and events may play out differently.
8d36003fd62c99c6d53d.translation: 声誉反映世人根据战团以往的所作所为，对你们行事作风的评价。你会宽恕敌人，还是焚毁农庄、屠戮农民？声誉会影响雇主交给你的委托类型，也可能改变委托和事件的发展。

c370c3e76968fb6a9220.source: You have not announced any ambition for your company to pursue. You'll be asked to do so as the game progresses.
c370c3e76968fb6a9220.translation: 你尚未为战团宣布志向。随着游戏推进，你将有机会为战团确立目标。

f799c108805ad32d2c1a.source: Shows the current and maximum load of the stash, your global inventory.
f799c108805ad32d2c1a.translation: 显示战团共用仓库的已用空间和总容量。

88db53a63f827d82b963.source:
Shows the current and maximum number of men placed in formation to fight in the next battle.

Drag and drop your men to where you want them to be; the top row is the front facing the enemy, the second row is your back row, and the bottom row is your reserves of characters not taking part in battle.
88db53a63f827d82b963.translation:
显示已编入下场战斗的人数，以及出战人数上限。

拖动弟兄的头像即可调整站位：最上排为迎敌的前排，第二排为后排，最下排则是不参加战斗的预备队。

fa4c76d7da9523fa3e5f.source: Shows the current items laying on the ground.
fa4c76d7da9523fa3e5f.translation: 显示当前地面上的物品。

1ac82a63d8e96acccec9.source: Action Points (AP) are spent for every action, like moving or using a skill. Once all points are spent, the current character's turn ends automatically. AP are fully refreshed each turn.
1ac82a63d8e96acccec9.translation: 移动、使用技能等行动都需要消耗行动点。行动点耗尽后，该角色的回合会自动结束。每回合开始时，行动点会全部恢复。

0da5ec33032d8704f0d6.source: Hitpoints represent the damage a character can take before dying. Once these reach zero, the character is considered dead. The higher the maximum hitpoints, the less likely it is a character will suffer debilitating injuries when hit.
0da5ec33032d8704f0d6.translation: 生命值表示角色在死亡前能够承受多少伤害。生命值降至零时，角色就会被判定为死亡。生命值上限越高，受击时遭受削弱能力的创伤的概率就越低。

77d5a9a1cb803f21ded0.source:
Morale is one of five states and represents the mental condition of combatants and their effectiveness in battle. At the lowest state, fleeing, a character will be outside your control - although they may eventually rally again. Morale changes as the battle unfolds, with characters that have high resolve less likely to fall to low morale states. Many of your opponents are affected by morale as well.

Morale checks trigger on these occasions:
- Killing an enemy
- Seeing an enemy be killed
- Seeing an ally be killed
- Seeing an ally flee
- Being hit for 15 or more damage to hitpoints
- Being engaged by more than one opponent
- Using certain skills, like 'Rally'
77d5a9a1cb803f21ded0.translation:
士气共有五个等级，反映战斗人员的精神状态，并影响其战斗表现。士气降至最低的溃逃状态时，角色会脱离你的控制，不过之后仍有可能重新振作。士气会随战况变化；意志越高，越不容易陷入低士气。许多敌人同样受到士气影响。

以下情况会触发士气检定：
- 击杀敌人
- 目睹敌人被杀
- 目睹友军被杀
- 目睹友军溃逃
- 一次攻击损失15点或更多生命值
- 同时与多名敌人接战
- 使用特定技能，例如“重振士气”

92edb0fad5894045be1e.source: Fatigue is gained for every action, like moving or using skills, and when being hit in combat or dodging in melee. It is reduced at a fixed rate of 15 each turn or as much as necessary for a character to start every turn with 15 less than his maximum fatigue. If a character accumulates too much fatigue they may need to rest a turn (i.e. do nothing) before being able to use more specialized skills again.
92edb0fad5894045be1e.translation: 移动、使用技能、在战斗中受到攻击或闪避近战攻击，都会积累疲劳。每回合减少15点疲劳；若仍不足以留出行动余量，则继续减少，直至疲劳值比上限低15点。疲劳积累过多时，角色可能需要休息一回合、不做任何行动，才能再次使用消耗较高的技能。

d4f1a119c3ed6c5b55c0.source: Maximum Fatigue is the amount of fatigue a character can accumulate before being unable to take any more actions and having to recuperate. It is reduced by wearing heavy equipment, especially armor.
d4f1a119c3ed6c5b55c0.translation: 疲劳上限表示角色在无法继续行动、必须休息前所能积累的最大疲劳值。穿戴沉重的装备，尤其是护甲，会降低这一上限。

1d81a4c472cc2905afa9.source: Head Armor protects, surprisingly, the head, which is harder to hit than the body, but more vulnerable to damage. The more head armor, the less damage will be applied to hitpoints on taking a hit to the head.
1d81a4c472cc2905afa9.translation: 头部护甲，顾名思义，就是保护头部的。头部比躯干更难命中，但受到攻击时也更脆弱。头部护甲越高，头部中招时损失的生命值就越少。

7dcbe38e09927a223de5.source: The more body armor, the less damage will be applied to hitpoints on taking a hit to the body.
7dcbe38e09927a223de5.translation: 身体护甲越高，躯干遭到攻击时损失的生命值就越少。

300199a0697f76f8e6e5.source: Determines the base probability of hitting a target with a melee attack, such as with swords and spears. Can be increased as the character gains experience.
300199a0697f76f8e6e5.translation: 决定使用剑、矛等武器进行近战攻击时的基础命中率。角色升级时可以提高这项属性。

df0a1cb8e9c027f4b766.source: Determines the base probability of hitting a target with a ranged attack, such as with bows and crossbows. Can be increased as the character gains experience.
df0a1cb8e9c027f4b766.translation: 决定使用弓、弩等武器进行远程攻击时的基础命中率。角色升级时可以提高这项属性。

a42a3aad28f55cba31c3.source: A higher melee defense reduces the probability of being hit with a melee attack, such as the thrust of a spear. It can be increased as the character gains experience and by equipping a good shield.
a42a3aad28f55cba31c3.translation: 近战防御越高，被长矛刺击等近战攻击命中的概率就越低。角色升级和装备优质盾牌都能提高近战防御。

6ebdb43b2faa8120c89f.source: A higher ranged defense reduces the probability of being hit with a ranged attack, such as an arrow shot from afar. It can be increased as the character gains experience and by equipping a good shield.
6ebdb43b2faa8120c89f.translation: 远程防御越高，被远处射来的箭矢等远程攻击命中的概率就越低。角色升级和装备优质盾牌都能提高远程防御。

191c609a890a82fb1bf4.source: Vision, or view range, determines how far a character can see to uncover the fog of war, discover threats and hit with ranged attacks. Heavier helmets and night time can reduce vision.
191c609a890a82fb1bf4.translation: 视野决定角色能够看清多远的范围，用于揭开战争迷雾、发现威胁和进行远程攻击。沉重的头盔和夜色都会缩小视野。

d0dde2da84b2dab03d98.source: The base damage the currently equipped weapon does. Will be applied in full against hitpoints if no armor is protecting the target. If the target is protected by armor, the damage is applied to armor instead based on the weapon's effectiveness against armor. The actual damage done is modified by the skill used and the target hit.
d0dde2da84b2dab03d98.translation: 当前武器的基础伤害。目标没有护甲保护时，伤害会全部作用于生命值；有护甲保护时，则按武器的护甲伤害倍率扣除护甲耐久。实际伤害还会受到所用技能及目标情况的影响。

8ecad01cc646cfae5c68.source: The base percentage of damage that will be applied when hitting a target protected by armor. Once the armor is destroyed, the weapon damage applies at 100% to hitpoints. The actual damage done is modified by the skill used and the target hit.
8ecad01cc646cfae5c68.translation: 攻击有护甲保护的目标时，武器基础伤害转化为护甲伤害的比例。护甲损毁后，武器伤害将以100%的比例作用于生命值。实际伤害还会受到所用技能及目标情况的影响。

ffb48c53b154fa775b61.source: The base percentage chance to hit a target's head for increased damage. The final chance can be modified by the skill used.
ffb48c53b154fa775b61.translation: 命中目标头部的基础概率。头部命中会造成更高伤害，最终命中头部的概率还会受到所用技能的影响。

fc33e4409ee35259ea82.source: The higher this value, the earlier the position in the turn order. Initiative is reduced by the current fatigue, as well as any penalty to maximum fatigue (such as from heavy armor). In general, someone in light armor will act before someone in heavy armor, and someone fresh will act before someone fatigued.
fc33e4409ee35259ea82.translation: 先攻越高，行动顺序越靠前。当前疲劳值，以及重甲等装备带来的疲劳上限惩罚，都会降低先攻。一般而言，轻装者先于重装者行动，精力充沛者先于疲惫者行动。

b8b9e9281fbec64dd9d5.source: Resolve represents the willpower and bravery of characters. The higher, the less likely that characters fall to lower morale states at negative events, and the more likely that characters gain confidence from positive events. Resolve also acts as defense against certain mental attacks that inflict panic, fear or mind control. See also: Morale.
b8b9e9281fbec64dd9d5.translation: 意志代表角色的意志力和勇气。意志越高，遭遇不利情况时越不容易士气低落，遇到有利情况时也越容易信心高涨。意志还可抵御某些造成恐慌、恐惧或精神控制的攻击。另见：士气。

08928f3fbd2e99bd1df3.source: This character already has experience in combat and starts with a higher level.
08928f3fbd2e99bd1df3.translation: 这名角色已有战斗经验，起始等级更高。

09ac5e793f9cc0ae316b.source: Save campaign at the selected slot.
09ac5e793f9cc0ae316b.translation: 将当前战役保存到选中的存档栏位。

c5c710acf835cad4848e.source: The name your mercenary company will be known by throughout the lands.
c5c710acf835cad4848e.translation: 为你的佣兵战团取个名字。今后，世人将以此称呼你们。

4ffd362a9f5b2b114666.source: A map seed is a unique string that determines how the world in your campaign will look like. You can see the seed of ongoing campaigns in the game menu accessible by pressing the Escape key, and then share it with friends to have them play in the same world.
4ffd362a9f5b2b114666.translation: 地图种子是一串决定世界布局的代码。战役开始后，按 Escape 键打开游戏菜单即可查看。将种子分享给朋友，他们也能在相同布局的世界中开始战役。

b2885d0b6b4fad656e48.source:
You'll face fewer and less challenging opponents, your men gain experience slightly faster, and retreating from battle is easier.

Your men get a small bonus to hit chance, and the enemy gets a small penalty, to ease you into the game.

Recommended for players new to the game.
b2885d0b6b4fad656e48.translation:
敌人较少，也较容易对付。战团成员获得经验略快，撤离战斗也更加容易。

己方命中率略有提高，敌方命中率略有降低，帮助你逐步熟悉战斗。

推荐初次游玩的玩家选择。

a4961fe62cc25418389d.source:
Provides for a balanced playing experience that can be quite challenging.

Recommended for veterans of the game or the genre.
a4961fe62cc25418389d.translation:
难度适中，但仍需认真应对各种挑战。

推荐熟悉本作或同类游戏的玩家选择。

fcf73dd8990a2d93b65f.source:
Your opponents will be more challenging and numerous.

Recommended for experts in the game who want an even deadlier challenge.
fcf73dd8990a2d93b65f.translation:
敌人更多，也更加难缠。

推荐熟悉本作、希望迎接更严酷挑战的高手选择。

87a70c0cb6e48c04438b.source:
Contracts will pay more, and you'll be able to carry more resources at once.

Recommended for players new to the game.
87a70c0cb6e48c04438b.translation:
委托报酬更高，战团能够携带更多物资。

推荐初次游玩的玩家选择。

b2d93749af6e2734155f.source:
Contracts will pay less, and deserters will take their equipment with them.

Recommended for experts in the game who want more of a challenge managing the company's funds and supplies.
b2d93749af6e2734155f.translation:
委托报酬更低，逃兵还会带走身上的装备。

推荐希望在资金和物资管理方面迎接更多挑战的高手选择。

fee965d1edaee532081f.source:
You'll start with more crowns and resources.

Recommended for new players.
fee965d1edaee532081f.translation:
开局拥有更多克朗和物资。

推荐新玩家选择。

f99dbc523ff9f2bf13fa.translation: 适合希望以适中难度开局的玩家。

36569cc2ccfece5a3c2f.source:
You'll start with fewer crowns and resources.

Recommended for expert players.
36569cc2ccfece5a3c2f.translation:
开局拥有较少的克朗和物资。

推荐高手选择。

4f70b5119b399d7c0332.source: Choose how your company starts out in the world. Depending on your choice, you'll start with different men, equipment, resources, and special rules.
4f70b5119b399d7c0332.translation: 选择战团的起源。不同起源拥有不同的初始成员、装备和物资，并可能带有特殊规则。

284c3676db96858b9735.source:
Ironman mode disables manual saving. Only a single save will exist for the company, and the game is automatically saved during the game and on exiting it. Losing the whole company means losing the save. Recommended for the best experience once you've learned the game.

Note that on weaker computers autosaves may result in the game pausing for a few seconds.
284c3676db96858b9735.translation:
铁人模式无法手动存档。每支战团只有一个存档，游戏进行期间和退出时会自动保存。若战团全军覆没，该存档也将随之失去。熟悉游戏后，推荐尝试这一模式，体验每次抉择的分量。

性能较弱的电脑在自动保存时，游戏可能会暂停几秒。

f80ebd57decb69b1cdee.source:
An optional way to play the game where the map is entirely unexplored and not visible to you at the start of your campaign. You'll have to discover everything on your own, which makes your campaign more difficult, but potentially also more exciting.

Recommended only for experienced players that know what they're doing.
f80ebd57decb69b1cdee.translation:
启用后，开局地图完全未知，你必须亲自探索，才能逐步揭开各地的面貌。这会让战役更加艰难，也更具探索的乐趣。

仅推荐熟悉游戏的老玩家选择。

4b33fbb5835217b78166.source: All crises will be randomly chosen between the options below.
4b33fbb5835217b78166.translation: 每次后期危机均从下列类型中随机选取。

7430d0bf0e1eba2485ee.source: There will be no late game crisis, and you can keep on playing the sandbox experience forever. Note that with this option selected, a significant part of the game's content and late game challenge won't be accessible. Not recommended for the best experience.
7430d0bf0e1eba2485ee.translation: 战役中不会发生后期危机，你可以一直自由探索和经营战团。但启用此选项后，将无法体验相当一部分后期内容与挑战，因此不推荐选择。

ee80a4e0080dc8118aaa.source: Cities, towns and castles can be permanently destroyed during a late game crisis, and having the world go down in flames is one of the many ways you can lose your campaign.
ee80a4e0080dc8118aaa.translation: 后期危机中，城镇和城堡可能被永久摧毁。若任由战火吞没这片土地，你的战役也可能就此失败。

52b965fb74752bf13877.source: The first late game crisis will be a ruthless war for power between noble houses. If you survive for long enough, the following ones will be chosen at random.
52b965fb74752bf13877.translation: 首次后期危机将是贵族家族之间残酷的权力争夺战。若战团存续得足够久，之后的危机类型将随机选取。

c041fdfce2fc086f273e.source: The first late game crisis will be an invasion of greenskin hordes threatening to sweep away the world of man. If you survive for long enough, the following ones will be chosen at random.
c041fdfce2fc086f273e.translation: 首次后期危机将是绿皮大军的入侵，人类的领土面临被夷为平地的威胁。若战团存续得足够久，之后的危机类型将随机选取。

fbdfb253faf12ff71775.source: The first late game crisis will be the ancient dead arising again to take back what was once theirs. If you survive for long enough, the following ones will be chosen at random.
fbdfb253faf12ff71775.translation: 首次后期危机将是古代亡灵复苏，企图夺回昔日的领土。若战团存续得足够久，之后的危机类型将随机选取。

8024dcfbd18606443b49.source: The first late game crisis will be a holy war between northern and southern cultures. If you survive for long enough, the following ones will be chosen at random.
8024dcfbd18606443b49.translation: 首次后期危机将是北方与南方之间的宗教战争。若战团存续得足够久，之后的危机类型将随机选取。

1b0464e956a8fb64890d.source: Enabling the Depth of Field effect will render height levels below the camera in tactical combat slightly out of focus (i.e. blurry), giving more of a miniature vibe and making it easier to differentiate heights, but potentially at the expense of some detail.
1b0464e956a8fb64890d.translation: 启用景深效果后，战斗中位于镜头焦点下方的地形层会略微失焦、变得模糊，营造微缩模型般的观感，也更容易辨别高低差，但可能损失一些画面细节。

bbd6c009af9556310cd4.source: Change the scale of the user interface, i.e. menus and texts.
bbd6c009af9556310cd4.translation: 调整界面的显示比例，包括菜单和文字大小。

1770c2eceb0cde90c642.source: Change the scale of the scene, i.e. everything that isn't the user interface, such as the characters shown on the battlefield.
1770c2eceb0cde90c642.translation: 调整场景的显示比例，影响战场上的角色等画面元素，不影响菜单等界面。

25b45970d5ee86b895fe.source: Scroll the screen by moving the mouse cursor to the edge of the screen.
25b45970d5ee86b895fe.translation: 将鼠标移到屏幕边缘，即可移动视角。

9bccfd0ceb60297ab3c6.source: Scroll the screen by pressing the left mouse button and dragging it (default).
9bccfd0ceb60297ab3c6.translation: 按住鼠标左键并拖动，即可移动视角（默认操作）。

92a6425f7ffa6bf94f0e.source: Using the hardware cursor minimizes input lag when moving the mouse in the game. Disable this if you experience problems with the mouse cursor.
92a6425f7ffa6bf94f0e.translation: 使用硬件光标可减少游戏中移动鼠标时的输入延迟。若遇到光标问题，请关闭此选项。

3b76e7280527032de07b.source: Use hardware-accelerated sound playback for better performance. Disable this if you experience any issues related to sound.
3b76e7280527032de07b.translation: 使用硬件加速播放音效，以提高性能。若遇到声音问题，请关闭此选项。

8490fe4faa18d973bf9f.translation: 始终跟随敌我部队移动

b3d4c0ec82601d3bfd8f.source: Always have the camera centered on any AI movement visible to you.
b3d4c0ec82601d3bfd8f.translation: 自动将镜头对准视野内正在移动的电脑控制单位。

5f2bdd544703768eb1c5.translation: 自动调整地形显示高度

74fc81fb4203787d71e0.source: Automatically adjust the camera's height level to see the currently active character in combat. Disabling this will prevent the camera from changing height levels when it isn't strictly necessary, but will also require manual adjustment of height levels when characters happen to be obstructed by terrain.
74fc81fb4203787d71e0.translation: 战斗中自动调整地形显示高度，使当前行动的角色保持可见。关闭后，除非确有必要，镜头不会切换高度层级；但若角色被地形遮挡，就需要你手动调整。

fb110708e5fc2a1d239a.source: Always show bars for hitpoints and armor floating above characters in combat, as opposed to only when characters get hit.
fb110708e5fc2a1d239a.translation: 战斗中始终在角色头顶显示生命值条和护甲条，而非仅在角色受到攻击时显示。

1a66fd80d8fa63fd95df.source: Show icons at the edges of your screen indicating the direction in which any characters currently outside the screen are on the map.
1a66fd80d8fa63fd95df.translation: 在屏幕边缘显示方向图标，指示当前画面之外的角色所在方位。

c52b1281352c55bf6b04.source: Speed up the movement of any characters controlled by you in combat significantly. Does not affect movement-related skills.
c52b1281352c55bf6b04.translation: 大幅加快战斗中你所控制角色的移动动画。不影响带有位移效果的技能。

f41c2b677654a00f1d7e.source: Speed up the movement of any characters controlled by the AI in combat significantly.  Does not affect movement-related skills.
f41c2b677654a00f1d7e.translation: 大幅加快战斗中电脑控制角色的移动动画。不影响带有位移效果的技能。

05ed31f5d11fc0324af2.source: Always and automatically loot everything found after combat once you close the loot screen - as long as you have the space to carry it.
05ed31f5d11fc0324af2.translation: 关闭战利品界面时，只要仓库还有空间，就会自动收取战斗后发现的所有物品。

bb9d0d0f8defbf5e44a9.source: Automatically place equipment back into the inventory slot it was in before battle, if possible. For example, if a character starts battle with a crossbow, but changes to a pike during battle, they'll automatically have the crossbow in hand again when the battle is concluded.
bb9d0d0f8defbf5e44a9.translation: 战后尽可能将装备恢复到战前的位置。例如，角色开战时手持弩，战斗中换用了长矛，战斗结束后就会自动重新装备弩。

a2ab65a5b334ec88bd25.source: Automatically pause the game after leaving a city so that you don't waste any time - but at the expense of having to manually unpause each time.
a2ab65a5b334ec88bd25.translation: 离开城镇后自动暂停游戏，避免时间白白流逝。每次都需要手动恢复游戏。

70416a4ba998cc26e8d9.source: Always render the top of trees and other large map objects semi-transparent, as opposed to only when they're actually occluding something.
70416a4ba998cc26e8d9.translation: 始终将树冠等大型地图物体的上部显示为半透明，而非仅在它们遮挡单位时才这样显示。

00658d52e93fa2c56374.source: Automatically end turns of characters controlled by you once you don't have any Action Points left to perform any action.
00658d52e93fa2c56374.translation: 当你控制的角色剩余行动点不足以执行任何行动时，自动结束他的回合。

fd9dba2915e5be497faa.source: Expands or retracts the Combat Event Log.

239a46c5d4a677f93e27.source: The number of Battle Brothers controlled by you and allies controlled by the AI on the battlefield.
239a46c5d4a677f93e27.translation: 战场上由你控制的弟兄，以及由电脑控制的友军人数。

6c392a8d71facfdce595.source: The number of opponents currently on the battlefield.
6c392a8d71facfdce595.translation: 当前战场上的敌方人数。

c4547b79f4af447a11a4.source: The number of rounds played since the battle began.
c4547b79f4af447a11a4.translation: 自战斗开始以来经过的轮数。

4e9862cdc00a0bc4d471.source: Center the camera on the currently acting character.
4e9862cdc00a0bc4d471.translation: 将镜头移到当前行动的角色身上。

336eb7dbc62b840baf0d.translation: 显示／隐藏障碍地格高亮（B）

3fe78c0b6456fc80e450.source: Toggle between showing and hiding red overlays that indicate tiles blocked with environmental objects (such as trees) that characters can not move onto.
3fe78c0b6456fc80e450.translation: 显示或隐藏障碍地格上的红色标记。这些地格被树木等环境物体占据，角色无法进入。

b7ce7aaa7bee28374768.source: Raise camera level to see the more elevated parts of the map.
b7ce7aaa7bee28374768.translation: 提高镜头显示的高度层级，查看地图上较高的部分。

bc9d6df57ce65d1c29a3.source: Lower camera level and hide elevated parts of the map.
bc9d6df57ce65d1c29a3.translation: 降低镜头显示的高度层级，隐藏地图上较高的部分。

51e21acc87a81d23111b.source: Toggle between showing and hiding armor and hitpoint bars, as well as status effect icons, ontop every visible character.
51e21acc87a81d23111b.translation: 显示或隐藏所有可见角色头顶的护甲条、生命值条和状态图标。

64f3a040dfb90859fbea.source: Toggle between showing and hiding trees and other large objects on the map.
64f3a040dfb90859fbea.translation: 显示或隐藏地图上的树木及其他大型物体。

e306477fb8c61d81c6f0.source: Retreat from combat and run for your lives. Better to fight another day than to die here pointlessly.
e306477fb8c61d81c6f0.translation: 从战斗中撤退，保住性命。与其在这里白白送死，不如留待来日再战。

b48385388cee62712b15.source: You cannot retreat from this particular fight

77b870aaa060c5e7ea04.source: Open menu to adjust game options.
77b870aaa060c5e7ea04.translation: 打开菜单，调整游戏设置。

e5a3f5b63394cc74bea1.source: End the active character's turn and have the next character in line act.
e5a3f5b63394cc74bea1.translation: 结束当前角色的回合，由行动顺序中的下一名角色行动。

a411578ddc18ddcc7acc.source: Pause the active character's turn and move them to the end of the queue. Waiting this turn will also have you act later next round.
a411578ddc18ddcc7acc.translation: 暂缓当前角色的行动，将他移到行动队列末尾。本轮选择等待，也会使他在下一轮较晚行动。

024a027567fcc005482c.source: End the current round and have all your men skip their turn until the next round starts.
024a027567fcc005482c.translation: 结束本轮，让所有弟兄跳过尚未进行的行动，直到下一轮开始。

40a22cab83df7169fed7.source: Open the character screen and inventory for the active Battle Brother.
40a22cab83df7169fed7.translation: 打开当前行动的弟兄的角色和物品界面。

7482ffe3d962cab5aecc.source: Leave tactical combat and return to the world map.
7482ffe3d962cab5aecc.translation: 退出战斗，返回世界地图。

e56070e616c336d71b59.source: This character just leveled up! Find him in your roster, accessible on the worldmap, to raise his attributes and select a perk.
e56070e616c336d71b59.translation: 这名角色刚刚升级！返回世界地图后，在战团名册中找到他，为他提升属性并选择特长。

4b550b56e317585b55aa.source: Light bruises, flesh wounds, loss of blood and similar that caused this character to lose hitpoints without impairing their abilities.
4b550b56e317585b55aa.translation: 轻微瘀伤、皮肉伤、失血等伤势会减少生命值，但不会削弱角色的能力。

b9837a7537082412ef3f.source: The number of kills this character had during the battle.
b9837a7537082412ef3f.translation: 这名角色在本场战斗中击杀的敌人数量。

217d1c1b06e4655b949f.source: The number of experience points gained during the battle from fighting and killing opponents. Gaining enough experience points will allow this man to level up, increase attributes and gain new perks.
217d1c1b06e4655b949f.translation: 在本场战斗中通过交战和击杀敌人获得的经验值。经验积累到一定程度后，角色可以升级、提升属性并学习新的特长。

ae2f2a876fac7a2a327d.source: The damage dealt by this character during battle, against hitpoints and against armor.
ae2f2a876fac7a2a327d.translation: 这名角色在本场战斗中造成的伤害，分为生命值伤害和护甲伤害。

7fc8532a436a5c9d4784.source: The damage received by this character, split into damage to hitpoints and damage to armor. The value is after any possible damage reduction.
7fc8532a436a5c9d4784.translation: 这名角色承受的伤害，分为生命值伤害和护甲伤害。数值已计入各种减伤效果。

6d18d4d1bad78cdff840.source: Loot all items found until the stash is full.
6d18d4d1bad78cdff840.translation: 收取发现的所有物品，直到仓库装满。

dc13b0e410877fac7410.source: Click here to change the character's name and title.
dc13b0e410877fac7410.translation: 点击此处修改角色的姓名和称号。

006c76c7e89e3584c8e1.source:
Characters gain experience as they or their allies slay enemies in battles. If a character has accumulated sufficient experience, he'll level up and be able to increase his attributes and pick a perk that grants a unique bonus.

Beyond the 11th character level, characters are veterans and will no longer gain perk points, but can still continue to improve.
006c76c7e89e3584c8e1.translation:
角色或友军在战斗中击杀敌人时，角色就会获得经验。积累足够经验后可以升级，提高属性，并选择一项具有独特效果的特长。

超过11级后，角色进入老兵阶段，不再获得特长点数，但仍可继续提升属性。

4e2743961e7b8b06841b.source:
The character's level measures experience in battle. Characters rise in levels as they gain experience and are able to increase their attributes and gain perks that make them better at the mercenary profession.

Beyond the 11th character level, characters are veterans and will no longer gain perk points, but can still continue to improve.
4e2743961e7b8b06841b.translation:
等级反映角色的战斗阅历。角色获得经验后会升级，从而提升属性、学习特长，成长为更出色的雇佣兵。

超过11级后，角色进入老兵阶段，不再获得特长点数，但仍可继续提升属性。

e6a3e45e832a3a46f52e.source: This character has leveled up. Increase his attributes and select a perk!
e6a3e45e832a3a46f52e.translation: 这名角色已升级。为他提升属性并选择特长吧！

d56958d94d8dd5a6fa6a.source: Dismiss this character from your roster to save daily wage and make room for someone else. Indebted characters will be freed from slavery and leave your company.
d56958d94d8dd5a6fa6a.translation: 将这名角色从队伍中解雇，节省日薪并腾出招募名额。若解雇的是负债者，他将重获自由并离开战团。

1b9db6683691799b7734.source: Switch to viewing the global stash of your mercenary company, or the ground beneath the currently selected character while in combat.
1b9db6683691799b7734.translation: 切换至战团共用仓库；战斗中则切换至当前选中角色脚下的地面物品。

c695ab61545b09ff696e.source:
Switch to viewing the perks of the currently selected character.

The number in braces, if any, is the number of available perk points.
c695ab61545b09ff696e.translation:
查看当前选中角色的特长。

括号内的数字表示尚未使用的特长点数。

47094469e0a8e4f90eb4.source: Show only weapons, offensive tools and accessories.
47094469e0a8e4f90eb4.translation: 只显示武器、进攻器具和配饰。

8eeca42c10cdc4871403.source: Show only armor, helmets and shields.
8eeca42c10cdc4871403.translation: 只显示护甲、头盔和盾牌。

806760bec55667da2e81.source: Show only supplies, food, treasure and miscellaneous.
806760bec55667da2e81.translation: 只显示补给、食物、财宝和杂物。

82d66c827206f81593b1.source: Show only items usable in inventory mode, like paint or armor upgrades.
82d66c827206f81593b1.translation: 只显示可在物品界面使用的物品，例如涂料和护甲附件。

3ff434188742cba7299c.source: Toggle between showing and hiding the mood of your men.
3ff434188742cba7299c.translation: 显示或隐藏弟兄们的心情。

d3a7d0da0d9e2871eed8.source: Start the battle using the selected equipment.
d3a7d0da0d9e2871eed8.translation: 使用选定的装备开始战斗。

82f03a049874957f1711.source:
Spend these points to increase any 3 out of 8 attributes per levelup by a random amount. A single attribute can only be increased once per levelup.

Stars mean that a character is especially talented with a specific attribute, resulting in consistently better dice rolls.
82f03a049874957f1711.translation:
每次升级可花费这些点数，从8项属性中任选3项提升，提升幅度随机。每项属性在一次升级中只能提升一次。

星星表示角色在该项属性上具有天赋，升级时更容易获得较高的提升数值。

d4f8254a97a4e2d4e0c7.source:
Paying a compensation, gratuity or pension for the time spent with the company will allow the dismissed to leave with dignity and something to start a new life with, and it will prevent others in the company from reacting with anger over the dismissal.

Indebted characters are paid reparations instead for their time with the company. Other indebted will appreciate it if you pay these, but no one will react with anger if you don't.
d4f8254a97a4e2d4e0c7.translation:
为被解雇的弟兄支付遣散费、酬金或退休金，既是对他为战团效力的回报，也能让他体面地离开，带着本钱开始新生活。这样还可避免其他弟兄因这次解雇而愤怒。

对于负债者，这笔钱则是对其服役经历的补偿。支付补偿会让其他负债者心怀感激；即使不付，也不会有人因此愤怒。

de743acf9515a913c2c7.translation: 让时间按正常速度流逝。

e4c7b1f12562ef90d116.source: Set time to pass faster than normal.

58589017ed158190a5f1.source: Set time to pass even faster than normal. Use judiciously.
58589017ed158190a5f1.translation: 进一步加快时间流逝。请谨慎使用。

7bf1263bf9f9a6c8ce1b.source: Show details of your active contract.
7bf1263bf9f9a6c8ce1b.translation: 查看当前委托的详细内容。

41b4e67455e4d7870e22.source: See all factions known to you and your relation to them.
41b4e67455e4d7870e22.translation: 查看已知的各方势力，以及你与它们的关系。

cf403631ad35f71789a8.source: Move the camera to center and zoom in on your mercenary company.
cf403631ad35f71789a8.translation: 将镜头移到战团所在位置并拉近。

60bf998f03a930edd936.source: Lock or unlock the camera to always be centered on your mercenary company.
60bf998f03a930edd936.translation: 锁定或解除镜头跟随。锁定后，镜头会始终以战团为中心。

910a5d3ed2782d092e8a.source: Show or hide the footprints left by other parties roaming the world so you can follow or avoid them more easily.
910a5d3ed2782d092e8a.translation: 显示或隐藏世界地图上其他队伍留下的足迹，方便追踪或避开它们。

d1eae0a1945be1e2c68e.source: Make or break camp. While encamped, time will go faster and your men will heal and repair their equipment at a faster rate. However, you're also more vulnerable to being caught in a surprise attack.
d1eae0a1945be1e2c68e.translation: 扎营或拔营。扎营时，时间流逝加快，弟兄们疗伤和修理装备的速度也会提高。不过，你也更容易遭到突袭。

2758904b4ed9cff6bf03.source: ]Unable to camp while travelling with other parties[/color]
2758904b4ed9cff6bf03.translation: ]与其他队伍同行时无法扎营[/color]

ee882ccd9b6ec91076df.source: See your retinue of non-combat followers that grant various advantages outside combat, and upgrade your cart for more inventory space.
ee882ccd9b6ec91076df.translation: 查看为战团提供各类战外助益的非战斗随从，并升级货车以扩充仓库容量。

a3e179cd867945d25e58.source: See the obituary which lists those who have fallen in service to the company since you took command.
a3e179cd867945d25e58.translation: 查看阵亡名册，缅怀自你接任团长以来为战团牺牲的弟兄。

da46b42950386df4ed81.source: Open menu to save or load your game, adjust game options or quit the campaign and return to the main menu.
da46b42950386df4ed81.translation: 打开菜单，以保存或载入游戏、调整设置，或退出当前战役并返回主菜单。

dc4b54c607edff1e390a.source: The number of days that the character served in the company until their demise.
dc4b54c607edff1e390a.translation: 这名角色生前在战团服役的总天数。

cbb0046fd0f83bf5c015.source: The number of battles that the character fought in until their demise.
cbb0046fd0f83bf5c015.translation: 这名角色生前参加的战斗总数。

cb8ae3b6efdc9146997e.source: The number of kills that the character scored in battle until their demise.
cb8ae3b6efdc9146997e.translation: 这名角色生前在战斗中击杀的敌人总数。

aaec8bddd5602aec02a9.source: Leave and return to the world map.
aaec8bddd5602aec02a9.translation: 离开此处，返回世界地图。

8634d81365057a8bd828.source: Someone is looking to hire mercenaries.

04da5582922615aee8cb.source: The terms of this contract have been negotiated. All that's left is for you to sign it.
04da5582922615aee8cb.translation: 委托的条款已经谈妥，只等你签字。

cb6d146c071e439ff148.source: You can only have one contract active at a time. Contract offers will remain while you fulfill your current contract, as long as the problem doesn't go away in the meantime.
cb6d146c071e439ff148.translation: 同一时间只能执行一项委托。只要期间相关问题尚未解决，其他委托就会保留，待你完成当前委托后仍可接取。

2a2dc77fc504356739d1.source: Only contracts by the noble house owning this fortification are available here, but they don't recognize you as worthy of their attention. Increase your renown and fulfill the ambition of noble houses to take notice of the company in order to unlock new contracts!
2a2dc77fc504356739d1.translation: 这里只提供所属贵族家族的委托，但他们目前还看不上你。提升战团名望，并完成让贵族家族注意到战团的志向，即可解锁新的委托！

412140174037f79fe571.source: Hire new men for your mercenary company. The quality and quantity of volunteers depends on the size and type of settlement, as well as your reputation here. Every few days, new people will arrive, and others will travel on.
412140174037f79fe571.translation: 为战团招募新人。应募者的数量和素质取决于聚居地的规模、类型，以及你在当地的声望。每隔几天都会有人到来，也会有人离开。

8a51c1c89322b60134c8.source: A large tavern filled with patrons from all over the lands, offering beverages, food and a lively atmosphere in which to share news and rumors.
8a51c1c89322b60134c8.translation: 一间汇聚各地旅客的大酒馆，供应酒水与食物。热闹的气氛很适合打听消息和传闻。

181efaf731a63a8517c6.source: A refuge from the harsh world outside. You can seek healing here for your wounded and pray for salvation of your eternal soul.
181efaf731a63a8517c6.translation: 一处远离尘世苦难的庇护所。你可以在这里为伤员寻求治疗，也可以为灵魂的永恒救赎祈祷。

5fb527279e5890df1373.source: A meeting point for those of the fighting profession. Have your men train with and learn from experienced fighters here, so you can mold them faster into hardened mercenaries.
5fb527279e5890df1373.translation: 以战斗为生的人们在此聚集。让弟兄们向经验丰富的战士学习、与他们对练，便能更快成长为久经沙场的雇佣兵。

14be4d845754b82c6e96.source: For the right price, a taxidermist can create useful items from all kinds of trophies you bring him.
14be4d845754b82c6e96.translation: 只要付得起钱，剥制工匠就能用你带来的各种猎物材料制作实用物品。

b448ce02fbfea9415b5f.source: A kennel where strong and fast dogs are bred for war.
b448ce02fbfea9415b5f.translation: 培育强壮、敏捷战犬的犬舍。

4d53de5845612a17f98b.source: Customize the appearance of your men at the barber. Have their hair cut and their beards trimmed or buy dubious potions to lose weight.
4d53de5845612a17f98b.translation: 在理发店调整弟兄们的外貌：剪发、修须，或购买来历可疑的减肥药水。

239c9458ea0d3f87eca6.source: A fletcher offering all kinds of expertly crafted ranged weaponry.
239c9458ea0d3f87eca6.translation: 制弓师的工坊，出售各种精心制作的远程武器。

90854cc465bc7c9da054.source: An alchemist offering exotic and quite dangerous contraptions for a tidy sum.
90854cc465bc7c9da054.translation: 炼金术士出售各种稀奇而危险的器具，价格也相当可观。

d5432d7c353e8135d4c8.source: The arena offers an opportunity to earn gold and fame in fights that are to the death, and in front of crowds that cheer for the most gruesome manner in which lives are dispatched.
d5432d7c353e8135d4c8.translation: 竞技场让你有机会在生死搏杀中赢得金钱和名声。观众们最乐于为残酷的杀戮欢呼。

59a107188310469f1287.source: No more matches take place here today. Come back tomorrow!
59a107188310469f1287.translation: 今天的比赛已经结束，明天再来吧！

4e936c24f188baee068e.source: You cannot fight in the arena while contracted to do other work
4e936c24f188baee068e.translation: 执行其他委托期间，无法参加竞技场比赛

f487f43b6b6dc3fe1e79.source: You need at least 5 empty inventory slots to fight in the ongoing tournament
f487f43b6b6dc3fe1e79.translation: 参加当前锦标赛需要至少5个空余仓库栏位

5378332075f62a050503.source: You need at least 3 empty inventory slots to fight in the arena
5378332075f62a050503.translation: 参加竞技场比赛需要至少3个空余仓库栏位

46cafc9539084787bab2.source: A harbor that serves both foreign trading ships and local fishermen. You'll likely be able to book passage by sea to other parts of the continent here.
46cafc9539084787bab2.translation: 供外来商船和本地渔船停泊的港口。你通常可以在这里雇船，前往大陆其他地区。

b1630347bfff3df6e0a8.source: You cannot use the harbor while contracted to escort a caravan
b1630347bfff3df6e0a8.translation: 护送商队期间，无法使用港口

870d146c946ea9df949e.source: A lively market offering all sorts of goods common in the region. New wares will be on offer every few days, and when trading caravans reach this settlement.
870d146c946ea9df949e.translation: 热闹的集市，出售当地常见的各类货物。每隔几天，或有商队抵达此地时，都会补充新货。

e794a16ceadb691cd347.source: A weapon smith's workshop displaying all kinds of well crafted weapons. Damaged equipment can also be repaired here for a price.
e794a16ceadb691cd347.translation: 武器匠的工坊，陈列着各类精良武器。也可以付费请匠人修理损坏的装备。

ef3bfe660d3b2c53eb05.source: This armorer's workshop is the right place to look for well-made and durable protection. Damaged equipment can also be repaired here for a price.
ef3bfe660d3b2c53eb05.translation: 想找做工精良、结实耐用的防具，就来这间制甲工坊。也可以付费请匠人修理损坏的装备。

4a23fb301c83581705e0.source: Leave this screen and return to the previous one.
4a23fb301c83581705e0.translation: 离开此界面，返回上一级。

60e9c19a8f18b3a0094b.source: Hire the selected recruit and have him join your roster.
60e9c19a8f18b3a0094b.translation: 雇用选中的应募者，让他加入战团。

8b88166b3ff9621a7048.source: Give the selected recruit a proper tryout to reveal his hidden character traits, if any.
8b88166b3ff9621a7048.translation: 考察选中的应募者，揭示他尚未公开的性格特质。

6bf3a211b1850a7d4964.source: This character may have unknown traits. You can pay for a tryout to reveal these.
6bf3a211b1850a7d4964.translation: 这名角色可能具有尚未公开的性格特质。你可以付费考察，揭示这些特质。

ed68b6d1edd0d62f9b56.source: Pay the indicated fee, and hand over the necessary components, to receive the crafted item in return.
ed68b6d1edd0d62f9b56.translation: 支付所示费用并交出所需材料，即可获得制成的物品。

fb37971fa8e5f17ac55a.source: Book passage for your company and fast travel to the selected destination.
fb37971fa8e5f17ac55a.translation: 为战团雇船，快速前往选定的目的地。

aa50a8dc9a2082a6d43f.source: Have your man participate in a sparring fight with experienced opponents and various fighting styles. The bruises collected and lessons learned will result in [color=
aa50a8dc9a2082a6d43f.translation: 让弟兄与经验丰富的对手切磋，领教不同的战斗风格。挨过的打和学到的教训，将使他获得 [color=

8fad7c0571383daa13b6.source: ]+50%[/color] Experience Gain for the next battle.
8fad7c0571383daa13b6.translation: ]+50%[/color]的经验获取加成，在下一场战斗生效。

bd1e2d85b9c6a3a3021b.source: Have your man learn valuable lessons and insights from a true veteran of the trade. The knowledge imparted will result in [color=
bd1e2d85b9c6a3a3021b.translation: 让弟兄向久经沙场的老兵请教，学习宝贵的实战经验。受益于这番指点，他将获得 [color=

a9cec9503c7f380ae75c.source: ]+35%[/color] Experience Gain for the duration of three battles.
a9cec9503c7f380ae75c.translation: ]+35%[/color]的经验获取加成，持续三场战斗。

12e3e7697dbae420d151.source: Have your man undergo a rigorous training regimen to shape him into a skilled fighter. The blood and sweat spent today will benefit him in the long run with [color=

9f91fc33ff6411f940f4.source:
Your relations with a faction determine whether they'll fight or deal peacefully with you, their willingness to hire you for contracts, as well as the prices they give you and the number of recruits available to you at their settlements.

Relations increase when working successfully for factions, and decrease on failing to do so, betraying or attacking them. Over time, relations slowly trend back towards neutral.
9f91fc33ff6411f940f4.translation:
你与某个势力的关系，决定了对方是与你交战还是和平往来、是否愿意雇用你执行委托，也会影响其聚居地的交易价格和可供招募的人数。

成功完成委托会改善关系；失败、背叛或攻击对方则会使关系恶化。随着时间推移，关系会缓慢趋于中立。

e1c70f72a853d7f1355b.source: The Beasts & Exploration DLC adds a variety of new beasts roaming the wilds, a new crafting system to create items from trophies, legendary locations with unique rewards to discover, many new contracts and events, a new system of armor attachments, new weapons, armor and usable items, and more.

f393d915e6c2fbd7a807.source: The Warriors of the North DLC adds a new human faction of northern barbarians with their own fighting style and equipment, different starting scenarios for your company, new nordic and rus inspired equipment, as well as new contracts and events.
f393d915e6c2fbd7a807.translation: 《北方勇士》扩展包加入了北方蛮族势力，他们拥有独特的战法与装备。此外，还新增了多种战团起源、受北欧与罗斯文化启发的装备，以及新的委托和事件。

7c4cbf674f13fa5e1d0e.source: The Blazing Deserts DLC adds a new desert region to the south inspired by medieval Arabic and Persian cultures, a new late game crisis involving a holy war, a retinue of non-combat followers with which to customize your company, alchemical contraptions and primitive firearms, new human and beastly opponents, new contracts and events, and more.
7c4cbf674f13fa5e1d0e.translation: 《炽热沙漠》扩展包在世界南方加入了一片沙漠，其风貌取材于中世纪阿拉伯与波斯文化。新增内容包括圣战危机、可供招募的非战斗随从、炼金器具、早期火器、新的人类与野兽敌人，以及更多委托和事件。

5d3f9244360e64a1ef82.source: The free Of Flesh and Faith DLC adds two new and very unique origins for you to play as: The Anatomists and the Oathtakers. In addition, there's two new banners, new equipment, new backgrounds to hire and lots of new events.
5d3f9244360e64a1ef82.translation: 免费扩展包《血肉与信仰》带来两种独特的战团起源：解剖学者与立誓者。此外，还加入了两面新旗帜、新装备、新的可招募人物背景，以及大量新事件。

你深吸一口清凉的晨风。朝阳缓缓升起，你的人生也翻开了新的一页。多年来，你以刀头舔血换取微薄报酬，如今终于攒够克朗，组建了自己的佣兵战团。与你同行的%allbrothers%曾在盾墙中与你并肩作战。如今，你成了他们的指挥官，%companyname%的团长。

行走各地时，你应在村庄和城市招募新人，补充队伍。许多前来投效的人从未握过真正的武器；有人走投无路，有人贪图战利品。他们大多会死在战场上，但不必因此灰心。佣兵的日子就是如此，而下一个村庄总有新人盼着重新开始。

如今的世道危机四伏。盗匪潜伏在路旁，野兽徘徊于幽暗的森林，东方沼泽里的兽人部落也蠢蠢欲动。甚至有传言说，黑暗魔法正在施虐，死者从坟墓中爬起，再次行走于世间。不过，赚大钱的机会同样不少：你可以在各地村庄、城市和要塞接取委托，也可以自行探索、出征劫掠。
